Pauline_mic.name: Pauline's Microphone
Pauline_mic.description: Pauline's Microphone is a polished brass and velvet instrument that hums with a faint magical resonance. This theatrical tool allows the wielder to project their voice with captivating clarity to command audiences or armies.

effectDetails.title: Resonant Command
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can speak a command to one creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be Charmed by your voice and must follow your next verbal command (up to one action in difficulty) as if it were its own. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the target succeeds on its saving throw at the end of its first turn. You can use this property a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Acoustic Projection
effectDetails.rules: While holding the microphone, your voice can be heard clearly by all creatures within 120 feet, regardless of ambient noise or distance. This effect is always active while the item is held.

Pauline_mic.levelRequirementReason: The microphone's magical resonance requires a level of magical awareness common in mid-tier adventurers.
Pauline_mic.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in high-quality instruments and luxury equipment for performers.
Pauline_mic.shippingDetail: Delivered in a padded, sound-proofed crate to prevent any accidental acoustic feedback during transit.

usage.activation: Action for Resonant Command; Passive for Acoustic Projection
usage.duration: 1 minute for Resonant Command
usage.endsWhen: The Command effect ends if the target succeeds on its saving throw, if the user loses consciousness, or when all daily charges are expended.
usage.charges: Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest

Pauline_mic.priceReason: The price reflects a rare utility item that provides both a constant utility buff and a high-impact crowd control ability.

shy_guy_torch.name: Shy Guy's Mask Torch
shy_guy_torch.description: The Shy Guy's Mask Torch is a soot-treated torch fashioned from a weathered, porcelain-like mask. It emits a flickering violet flame that seems to swallow the surrounding light rather than illuminate it.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Veil
effectDetails.rules: While holding the lit torch, you can cast the Hide action as a bonus action even if you are in bright light, provided you are within 5 feet of a surface or object to lean against. This effect lasts until you move more than 10 feet away from that surface or the torch is extinguished.

effectDetails.title: Secret Whispers
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can focus the violet flame to transmit a message to a creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or hear your voice as a faint whisper in their mind. You can use this property once per day.

effectDetails.title: Nervous Giggling
effectDetails.rules: Whenever a creature within 10 feet of the torch attempts to initiate combat, the torch emits a high-pitched giggle. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on their first attack roll against you.

shy_guy_torch.levelRequirementReason: The item requires a basic understanding of stealth and social interaction to be useful.
shy_guy_torch.vendorReason: The black market specializes in tools for covert operations and clandestine information gathering.
shy_guy_torch.shippingDetail: Delivered in a lead-lined crate to ensure the whispers do not reach neighbors.

usage.duration: 1 hour of light per day
usage.endsWhen: The torch is extinguished, destroyed by a loud noise (volume above a shout), or the 1-hour light limit is reached.

shy_guy_torch.priceReason: The price reflects its utility as a specialized tool for stealth and communication in urban environments.

1_up_deluxe.name: 1-Up Deluxe
1_up_deluxe.description: The 1-Up Deluxe is a shimmering platinum mushroom harvested from the celestial gardens of Toad Town. This metallic fungus pulses with a faint, rhythmic light, promising a singular moment of rebirth.

effectDetails.title: Second Life
effectDetails.rules: If you drop to 0 hit points and would normally die, the 1-Up Deluxe activates automatically. You instead reappear at the start of your next turn in a space you can see within 30 feet, with all hit points, spell slots, and class features restored. This effect can only occur once per mushroom; once triggered, the mushroom is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Limited Inventory
effectDetails.rules: Due to its immense magical weight, a creature can only carry one 1-Up Deluxe at a time in their inventory.

1_up_deluxe.levelRequirementReason: This item is a basic life-saving consumable accessible to all adventurers.
1_up_deluxe.vendorReason: Toad Town is the primary hub for rare and magical fungi.
1_up_deluxe.shippingDetail: Requires a special enchanted crate to prevent the mushroom from phasing out of reality during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The mushroom is destroyed upon use or consumed.

1_up_deluxe.priceReason: Reduced from 700,000 XP to a standard high-tier consumable price to prevent game-breaking economy inflation.

1_up_mushroom.name: 1-Up Mushroom
1_up_mushroom.description: This 1-Up Mushroom is a vibrant green fungus that vibrates with the frequency of life itself. Sourced from the hidden groves of Toad Town, this miracle of nature provides a singular chance to defy the grave.

effectDetails.title: Defy Death
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can consume the mushroom to target a creature within 5 feet that has died within the last minute. The target is instantly restored to life with all its hit points intact, even if its body was destroyed or disintegrated. This effect can only be used once per mushroom.

effectDetails.title: Instant Restoration
effectDetails.rules: The mushroom is consumed upon use and is destroyed instantly. Due to the strain on the universe, the user must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion as the cosmos frowns upon the exchange.

1_up_mushroom.levelRequirementReason: The item is a consumable miracle and does not require high-level proficiency to activate.
1_up_mushroom.vendorReason: Toad Town is the primary hub for rare fungal life and magical produce.
1_up_mushroom.shippingDetail: The mushroom is transported in a lead-lined crate to prevent its life-frequency from vibrating out of existence during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The mushroom is consumed and destroyed upon use.

1_up_mushroom.priceReason: Adjusted from 300,000 XP to 1,000 XP to reflect a single-use life-saving consumable rather than a permanent artifact.

a_bag_that_defies_vertical_1.name: Gravity Satchel
a_bag_that_defies_vertical_1.description: This Gravity Satchel is a sturdy leather pouch that clings to the side of the doughnut, defying verticality. Crafted for travelers of The Grand Country, it hums with a faint celestial resonance and features a 🌌 icon stitched into its flap.

effectDetails.title: Vertical Levitation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can cause the satchel to emit a field that allows you to hover vertically. You move at a speed of 15 feet upward or downward. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated or use a bonus action to end the effect.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Anomaly
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you use the Vertical Levitation effect, roll a d10. On a 1, a localized gravity anomaly occurs in a 10-foot radius centered on you; all creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pulled 5 feet toward the center.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Capacity
effectDetails.rules: The satchel provides a weight limit of 100 lbs for gear stored within it, regardless of the weight of the bag itself.

effectDetails.title: Void Curse
effectDetails.rules: If the satchel is dropped into a Void space, the wearer is instantly flipped upside down relative to the world's plane. This condition is permanent unless dispelled by a 3rd-level 'Greater Restoration' spell.

a_bag_that_defies_vertical_1.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of manipulating gravity safely requires a high level of magical proficiency.
a_bag_that_defies_vertical_1.vendorReason: Inkopolis is a known hub for enchanted gear that interacts with the world's unique geography.
a_bag_that_defies_vertical_1.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-altitude drop; requires a stable landing zone to prevent the bag from floating away.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitated, ended by user, or duration expires

a_bag_that_defies_vertical_1.priceReason: The price reflects the epic rarity and the specialized utility for navigating the doughnut's terrain.

a_bottle_of_whiskey_garlic.name: Wario's Wild West Bottle
a_bottle_of_whiskey_garlic.description: Wario's Wild West Bottle is a rugged glass flask filled with a pungent, bubbling concoction of garlic juice and 'whiskey.' Crafted by Wario West, this pungent beverage smells of the frontier and provides a rustic, stinging kick.

effectDetails.title: Toughness Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you drink the contents of this bottle as an action, your Constitution score increases by 1 for 1 hour. This effect does not stack.

effectDetails.title: Western Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: While the effects of the drink are active, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made to cowdle enemies or exert dominance.

effectDetails.title: Pungent Taste
effectDetails.rules: The juice burns your throat; you have disadvantage on all Charisma (Persuasion) checks made within 1 minute of drinking this bottle.

a_bottle_of_whiskey_garlic.levelRequirementReason: The item is common equipment and does not require a specific power level to utilize.
a_bottle_of_whiskey_garlic.vendorReason: Wario West is the primary producer of this specific brand of frontier tonic.
a_bottle_of_whiskey_garlic.shippingDetail: The bottle is padded with straw to prevent breakage during high-velocity transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires, the user falls unconscious, or the user drinks another potion.
usage.charges: Single use; the bottle is emptied upon drinking.

a_bottle_of_whiskey_garlic.priceReason: Reduced from 4700 to reflect a common consumable item rather than a high-tier artifact.

a_bracelet_infused_with_wario.name: Wario's Garlic Power Bracelet
a_bracelet_infused_with_wario.description: Wario's Garlic Power Bracelet is a heavy, pungent band of iron forged in Wario's Garlic Lab. It radiates a sharp, eye-watering aroma of roasted cloves that pulses with raw, unrefined power.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Strength
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can consume a portion of the infused garlic to gain a +1 bonus to your Strength score and all associated checks for 1 hour. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Vampiric Repellent
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed by undead creatures due to your overwhelming natural musk.

effectDetails.title: Stink Breath
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can exhale a cloud of pungent gas in a 5-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 1d4 poison damage on a failed save. On a failed save, the target is also poisoned (nauseated) until the end of its next turn. Allies in the area must also make this save or become nauseated.

a_bracelet_infused_with_wario.levelRequirementReason: The physical strain of the garlic's potency requires a character of at least 5th level to wield safely.
a_bracelet_infused_with_wario.vendorReason: This item is a signature product of the local land's most eccentric culinary lab.
a_bracelet_infused_with_wario.shippingDetail: The item arrives in a vacuum-sealed, reinforced burlap sack to contain the odor during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour for Strength; Instantaneous for Stink Breath
usage.endsWhen: Ends after 1 hour for Strength or when the Stink Breath action is completed.
usage.charges: 1 use of Strength per long rest; Stink Breath is limited by your action economy.

a_bracelet_infused_with_wario.priceReason: Reduced from 9500 to reflect a balanced uncommon rarity for a utility-focused accessory.

a_brass_token_engraved_with.name: Pipe Network Key
a_brass_token_engraved_with.description: The Pipe Network Key is a brass token engraved with the symbols of the Pipe Network’s collapse. This heavy metal token allows users to interface with ancient pipe nodes to reveal hidden smuggling routes, though it echoes with the lingering whispers of the Princess.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Hidden Routes
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can insert the token into a pipe node. For 10 minutes, you can see the hidden paths of smugglers within the pipe system. This effect ends if you move more than 60 feet away from the node or use the token on a different node.

effectDetails.title: Smuggler Insight
effectDetails.rules: While the token is active, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to identify smuggler activity or hidden caches within the infrastructure.

effectDetails.title: Auditory Hallucinations
effectDetails.rules: If the token is used for more than 10 minutes, you must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on Initiative rolls for 1 hour as you hear the Princess's final plea.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Bonus
effectDetails.rules: While inside a pipe system, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This bonus is negated if you are in an open area or if the token is not currently inserted into a node.

a_brass_token_engraved_with.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of navigating the Pipe Network's infrastructure requires a basic grasp of urban navigation.
a_brass_token_engraved_with.vendorReason: The Mushroom Kingdom's underground networks are the primary source for these historical tokens.
a_brass_token_engraved_with.shippingDetail: Delivered via heavy-duty courier; requires a 1-day transit time to ensure the brass token is not damaged.

usage.duration: 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Moving 60 feet from the node or manual deactivation

a_brass_token_engraved_with.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect the rarity of the token and the significant utility provided by the stealth and perception bonuses.

a_buoyant_satchel_woven_from.name: Tropical Tide Satchel
a_buoyant_satchel_woven_from.description: This Tropical Tide Satchel is a buoyant pouch woven from durable sea grass and polished coral. Crafted by the Pond Patrol, the satchel expands when submerged to provide extra storage and silent mobility.

effectDetails.title: Expanded Capacity
effectDetails.rules: While the satchel is worn, your carrying capacity is increased by 30% as the sea grass fibers stretch to accommodate extra weight.

effectDetails.title: Buoyant Movement
effectDetails.rules: Your swimming speed increases by 5 feet. Additionally, while the satchel is submerged, it grants you advantage on Stealth checks made to hide from enemies.

effectDetails.title: Hydrodynamic Coating
effectDetails.rules: The coral weave provides a protective layer; you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from water-based hazards (such as crashing waves or whirlpools).

a_buoyant_satchel_woven_from.levelRequirementReason: The item provides utility and minor mobility buffs suitable for early-game exploration.
a_buoyant_satchel_woven_from.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is a coastal hub where sea-grass weaving is a common craft.
a_buoyant_satchel_woven_from.shippingDetail: Delivered via waterproof courier pouch; arrives within 2 days of order.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The item is destroyed or discarded.

a_buoyant_satchel_woven_from.priceReason: Reduced from 2200 to reflect a balanced uncommon utility item for low-level players.

a_cape_that_makes_you.name: Wario's Super Star Cape
a_cape_that_makes_you.description: Wario's Super Star Cape is a heavy, gold-trimmed garment adorned with a shimmering yellow fabric that radiates a faint hum. Manufactured in Wario's Star Factory, this cape pulses with the erratic energy of a captured power-up.

effectDetails.title: Invincible Stride
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the cape's power to gain resistance to all damage for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Star Power Presence
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the cape, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks as the fabric sparkles with intense energy.

effectDetails.title: Power-Down Crash
effectDetails.rules: When the 1-minute duration of the Invincible Stride ends, you suffer from a sudden loss of momentum; you have disadvantage on all ability checks for the next 3 minutes or until you finish a short rest.

a_cape_that_makes_you.levelRequirementReason: The cape's high-impact power-up effects are balanced for mid-tier adventurers.
a_cape_that_makes_you.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in items originating from Wario's territory.
a_cape_that_makes_you.shippingDetail: The item arrives in a glowing crate that must be opened with a heavy mallet.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the user is incapacitated.

a_cape_that_makes_you.priceReason: The price reflects the rare nature of Star Factory equipment and its high-impact defensive utility.

a_card_that_wilds_any.name: Wario's Wildcard
a_card_that_wilds_any.description: Wario's Wildcard is a sturdy, oversized playing card printed with a grinning face and the 'Wario Cards' logo. This heavy card feels weighted with strange, chaotic energy from the Wario Land games.

effectDetails.title: Gambler's Edge
effectDetails.rules: While holding this card, you gain a +1 bonus to any Intelligence (Investigation) or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made during gambling games or contests of chance.

effectDetails.title: Clumsy Handling
effectDetails.rules: Because the card is so large and awkward, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to hide, swap, or palm the card.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Double Or Nothing
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can use an action to present the card during a game of chance. Roll a d20; on a 10 or higher, you double your current winnings for that round, but on a 9 or lower, you lose all winnings from that round.

a_card_that_wilds_any.levelRequirementReason: The item is common rarity and does not provide significant combat power.
a_card_that_wilds_any.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in items related to Wario's games and card-based mechanics.
a_card_that_wilds_any.shippingDetail: Delivered via Joker Jog with a 1-day delay; the card arrives slightly bent but functional.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends immediately after the roll or when the card is put away.
usage.charges: 1 use per long rest for the Double Or Nothing effect.

a_card_that_wilds_any.priceReason: Reduced from 5000 to reflect its common rarity and limited utility.

a_chest_full_of_treasure.name: Wario's Fake Treasure Chest (Scam Chest!)
a_chest_full_of_treasure.description: Wario's Fake Treasure Chest is a masterfully crafted decoy from Wario's Trap Treasury, designed to look like a heavy loot haul. This lightweight box is intended to mislead enemies into wasting their time on a worthless prize.

effectDetails.title: Decoy Bait
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can place the chest in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. When a creature uses an action to investigate or open the chest, it must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or spend the remainder of its turn searching the empty interior.

effectDetails.title: Spring-Loaded Blinding
effectDetails.rules: If a creature attempts to open the lid, a spring-loaded mechanism triggers. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be Blinded until the end of its next turn as fake gold flies into its face.

effectDetails.title: Weightless Fake
effectDetails.rules: The chest weighs only 5 pounds. Any creature that attempts to lift or move it without looking closely can succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom (Perception) check to realize the chest is a hollow fake.

a_chest_full_of_treasure.levelRequirementReason: The item is a low-level utility trap and does not require high-level magical proficiency.
a_chest_full_of_treasure.vendorReason: Wario is the primary source of fraudulent loot and deceptive traps in this region.
a_chest_full_of_treasure.shippingDetail: Delivered with a 'Handle With Care' sticker that is actually a joke.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The chest is destroyed or the spring mechanism is jammed by a successful DC 15 Strength check.

a_chest_full_of_treasure.priceReason: Reduced from 9000 to reflect a balanced uncommon utility item price for a low-level party.

a_classic_wizard_hat_that.name: Mages' Guild Pointed Hat of Stereotypes
a_classic_wizard_hat_that.description: This Mages' Guild Pointed Hat of Stereotypes is a flimsy, oversized garment crafted by the Mages' Guild Haberdashery. While it captures the quintessential aesthetic of a high-fantasy wizard, its lightweight fabric makes it prone to fluttering in the breeze.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Aesthetic
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this hat, you have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to identify magical properties or lore, as your appearance perfectly embodies the wizarding archetype.

effectDetails.title: Aerodynamic Liability
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on all Strength and Dexterity saving throws made to resist being moved or knocked prone by wind-based effects or heavy gusts.

effectDetails.title: Dramatic Casting
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action, you must perform a dramatic gesture; you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made during the same turn as the casting.

a_classic_wizard_hat_that.levelRequirementReason: The original level 5 requirement was removed to allow early-game casters to utilize the aesthetic benefits.
a_classic_wizard_hat_that.vendorReason: The Mages' Guild Haberdashery specializes in clothing that reinforces traditional magical archetypes.
a_classic_wizard_hat_that.shippingDetail: The hat is packed in a reinforced box to prevent it from blowing away during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: The hat is removed or destroyed

a_classic_wizard_hat_that.priceReason: The price was reduced from 9500 to 1000 to reflect its status as an uncommon, non-combat utility item.

a_coin_with_wario_s.name: Wario's Lucky W Coin
a_coin_with_wario_s.description: Wario's Lucky W Coin is a heavy, metallic coin stamped with a greedy, wide-eyed face. Minted by Wario's Mint as a counterfeit, it feels unusually weighted in your palm.

effectDetails.title: Weighted Flip
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can flip the coin. Roll a d20; on a 1-12, the coin lands on tails and you have disadvantage on your next d20 roll made before the end of your next turn. On a 13-20, it lands on heads and you have advantage on your next d20 roll made before the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Grin
effectDetails.rules: While holding the coin, you gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made specifically to win a game of chance or gamble.

a_coin_with_wario_s.levelRequirementReason: A common counterfeit coin does not require high-level magic or strength to wield.
a_coin_with_wario_s.vendorReason: The vendor is the primary source of counterfeit currency in the region.
a_coin_with_wario_s.shippingDetail: Delivered via a high-speed toss; may arrive slightly dented.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The next d20 roll is made or the next turn ends

a_coin_with_wario_s.priceReason: Reduced from 4100 to reflect a common-rarity counterfeit item.

a_controller_that_controls_minor.name: Wario's  WiiMote
a_controller_that_controls_minor.description: Wario's WiiMote is a bulky, oversized remote controller manufactured by WarioWare Remotes. Its plastic casing is scuffed from years of frantic use, and its buttons click with a satisfying, heavy mechanical thud.

effectDetails.title: Remote Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can point the WiiMote at an object weighing no more than 10 pounds within 30 feet. The object moves up to 5 feet in a straight line toward a space you choose. You can use this property a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Feedback Vibration
effectDetails.rules: While you are concentrating on a spell or ability, the WiiMote may vibrate violently. You have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Technological Rapport
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with individuals who possess mechanical expertise or technological devices.

a_controller_that_controls_minor.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for low-level utility rather than high-level power.
a_controller_that_controls_minor.vendorReason: This item is a staple of Wario's chaotic gaming collection.
a_controller_that_controls_minor.shippingDetail: Delivered in a pixelated cardboard box with a 'fragile' sticker.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The movement is completed or the limit of uses is reached.
usage.charges: Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest

a_controller_that_controls_minor.priceReason: Reduced to reflect its status as an uncommon utility item rather than a high-tier artifact.

a_cowboy_hat_with_wario.name: Wario's Wild West Hat
a_cowboy_hat_with_wario.description: Wario's Wild West Hat is a wide-brimmed Stetson featuring bold, gaudy accents and distinct Wario flair. Crafted by the artisan Wario West, this rugged headwear smells of gunpowder and greed.

effectDetails.title: Saloon Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: While inside a tavern or saloon, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made to cowrule others or demand payment.

effectDetails.title: Clumsy Brim
effectDetails.rules: Because of its oversized, floppy design, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to maintain your balance on uneven terrain.

effectDetails.title: Western Charisma
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with fans of the Western genre, you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

a_cowboy_hat_with_wario.levelRequirementReason: The item is common equipment and does not require high-level proficiency to wield.
a_cowboy_hat_with_wario.vendorReason: Wario West's personal workshop is the primary source for this specific brand of western wear.
a_cowboy_hat_with_wario.shippingDetail: Delivered via horseback courier; arrives within 2 days of purchase.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The hat is lost, destroyed, or removed from the wearer's head.

a_cowboy_hat_with_wario.priceReason: Adjusted from 4800 to 1000 to reflect its common rarity and minor utility.

a_cursed_explosive_infused_with.name: Garlic Bomb
a_cursed_explosive_infused_with.description: This Garlic Bomb is a pungent, cursed explosive infused with the overwhelming scent of 1000g of Wario’s garlic. Crafted by Pipe Express, the bulbous explosive reacts violently when it meets living flesh.

effectDetails.title: Pungent Detonation
effectDetails.rules: When the bomb hits a living target, it detonates instantly. The target takes 3d4 piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded by the pungent fumes until the end of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Blindness
effectDetails.rules: Any creature within a 5-foot radius of the detonation that is not the thrower must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer the effects of the Blinded condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effectDetails.title: Greed Aura
effectDetails.rules: For 3 rounds following the detonation, the bomb radiates Wario's greed. Any hostile creature within 15 feet of the blast site has disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks and rolls.

a_cursed_explosive_infused_with.levelRequirementReason: The explosive nature of the item requires a basic understanding of combat mechanics.
a_cursed_explosive_infused_with.vendorReason: The shop specializes in whimsical and slightly chaotic consumables.
a_cursed_explosive_infused_with.shippingDetail: Shipped in a lead-lined crate to prevent premature detonation during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The bomb is thrown and detonates, destroying itself.

a_cursed_explosive_infused_with.priceReason: The price was adjusted to reflect the uncommon rarity and the multi-effect utility of the explosion.

a_cursed_relic_forged_from.name: Entropy Ring
a_cursed_relic_forged_from.description: The Entropy Ring is a jagged band of metal forged from the shattered heart of the Iron Legion’s sleeper agent, Toadburt. This cursed relic radiates a palpable decay that erodes the wearer's sanity and memories over time.

effectDetails.title: Toadburt's Fortitude
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the ring, you have advantage on saving throws against being Frightened. This effect is passive and constant while the ring is equipped.

effectDetails.title: Memory Erosion
effectDetails.rules: Every hour the ring is worn, the wearer must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or lose one random memory from their past. On a failed save, the DM chooses a specific memory or skill proficiency the character no longer remembers.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: The ring's decay makes the wearer's mind fragile; you take an additional 1d6 psychic damage whenever you take psychic damage from an attack or spell.

a_cursed_relic_forged_from.levelRequirementReason: The item's psychic weight and memory-eroding properties are too dangerous for low-level characters.
a_cursed_relic_forged_from.vendorReason: Sarasaland acts as a neutral ground for artifacts of high-risk provenance.
a_cursed_relic_forged_from.shippingDetail: Delivered in a lead-lined box to prevent the ring's aura from affecting the courier.

usage.duration: 24 hours
usage.endsWhen: The ring becomes inert after 24 hours of continuous wear.

a_cursed_relic_forged_from.priceReason: The price reflects the high risk of permanent memory loss and its Epic rarity status.

a_cursed_tool_forged_from_1.name: Ironclad Hammer of the Forge
a_cursed_tool_forged_from_1.description: The Ironclad Hammer of the Forge is a heavy smithing tool forged from the last steel of the Blacksmith’s Guild. Its handle glows with the faint fire of the Iron Legion’s labor, vibrating with the weight of a thousand strikes.

effectDetails.title: Armor-Piercing Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature wearing heavy armor or a shield with a melee weapon attack using this hammer, you deal an additional 1d12 force damage.

effectDetails.title: Degrading Impact
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack using this hammer, the target's Armor Class is reduced by 1 (minimum of 10) as their protection cracks. This effect stacks but ends if the target takes a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Iron Will Infusion
effectDetails.rules: On a hit, roll a d20. On a 20, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by Iron Will, granting them resistance to all damage but reducing their movement speed by 10 feet for 3 rounds.

a_cursed_tool_forged_from_1.levelRequirementReason: The hammer's heavy weight and cursed nature require a character of significant physical strength to wield effectively.
a_cursed_tool_forged_from_1.vendorReason: The Midlands region is the primary hub for heavy industry and blacksmithing supplies.
a_cursed_tool_forged_from_1.shippingDetail: Shipped in a reinforced crate to prevent the hammer from damaging other parcels during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target takes a long rest or the hammer is no longer used in an attack.

a_cursed_tool_forged_from_1.priceReason: Reduced from 2500 to 1000 to align with standard rare equipment scaling while maintaining its unique utility.

a_custom_motorcycle_loud_fast.name: Wario's Chopper
a_custom_motorcycle_loud_fast.description: Wario's Chopper is a custom-built, heavy-duty motorcycle known for its deafening roar and indestructible frame. This massive machine is fueled by garlic and leaves a thick trail of black smoke in its wake.

effectDetails.title: High-Speed Travel
effectDetails.rules: While mounted, your movement speed on roads or flat terrain increases by 100 feet. You have advantage on Dexterity (乗り物) checks made to avoid obstacles while traveling at this speed.

effectDetails.title: Ram Attack
effectDetails.rules: When you move at least 20 feet toward a creature and hit it with the motorcycle, the target must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, the target takes half damage and is not knocked prone.

effectDetails.title: Smokescreen
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the Chopper can emit a cloud of black smoke in a 30-foot cone. The area becomes heavily obscured for 1 minute. This effect can be used a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Fuel
effectDetails.rules: The motorcycle consumes 1 unit of garlic per hour of operation. If no garlic is provided, the motorcycle becomes non-functional until fed.

a_custom_motorcycle_loud_fast.levelRequirementReason: The high speed and heavy ramming mechanics require a character with sufficient physical coordination.
a_custom_motorcycle_loud_fast.vendorReason: Wario personally handles the distribution of his signature heavy machinery.
a_custom_motorcycle_loud_fast.shippingDetail: The item arrives with significant property damage to your front entrance; no refunds for structural repairs.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Smokescreen ends after 1 minute or when used; Speed is constant while moving.
usage.charges: Smokescreen: Proficiency Bonus per long rest

a_custom_motorcycle_loud_fast.priceReason: Reduced from 200,000 XP to reflect a balanced legendary equipment cost for a high-utility vehicle.

a_darkly_polished_ring_forged.name: Onyx Hand Ring
a_darkly_polished_ring_forged.description: The Onyx Hand Ring is a darkly polished band forged from the remnants of the Onyx Hand’s last rebellion. Crafted by the Iron Legion, the ring whispers the names of fallen heroes to its wearer while pulsing with a cold, disruptive energy.

effectDetails.title: Ward Detection and Weakening
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can sense the presence of magical wards within 60 feet. Additionally, you can target one detected ward and force it to fail its next saving throw or check against a disruption attempt; this effect can be used a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Willpower Drain
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you use the Ward Detection and Weakening ability, you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage as the ring drains your willpower.

effectDetails.title: Assassin's Mark
effectDetails.rules: Each time you use the Ward Detection and Weakening ability, roll a d20. On a 1, you are marked by the Onyx Hand's enemies; for the next 24 hours, you have disadvantage on Stealth checks and are tracked by hostile NPCs.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While in dim light or darkness, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This bonus is negated if you are in bright light.

a_darkly_polished_ring_forged.levelRequirementReason: The ring's psychic drain and tracking risks are tuned for characters with enough hit points and mental fortitude to handle the consequences.
a_darkly_polished_ring_forged.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in high-rarity relics recovered from historical conflicts.
a_darkly_polished_ring_forged.shippingDetail: Delivered via heavy-duty courier; arrives in 2 days with a protective lead-lined box.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The daily limit of uses is reached or the wearer takes a long rest.

a_darkly_polished_ring_forged.priceReason: Reduced from 5000 to reflect a balanced rare-tier price for a utility-heavy item with risk factors.

a_device_that_draws_maps.name: Wario's Treasure Map Generator
a_device_that_draws_maps.description: Wario's Treasure Map Generator is a brass-bound drafting machine produced by Wario's Map Mill. It produces physical scrolls marked with a distinctive Wario watermark, designed to pinpoint hidden loot with 'surefire' results.

effectDetails.title: Treasure Mapping
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can expend 1 use to generate a map to a nearby hidden cache. Roll a d100; on a 1-70, the map leads to a minor treasure worth 10-50gp. On a 71-100, the map leads to a trap that deals 1d6 piercing or bludgeoning damage to the first person who triggers it.

effectDetails.title: Waterproof Parchment
effectDetails.rules: The maps produced by this device are waterproof; you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to navigate or scout in wet environments or underwater.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Watermark
effectDetails.rules: Any map produced by this device features a visible watermark. When you use a map to find treasure, roll a d20; on a 1-5, a rival treasure hunter arrives at the location within 1d4 hours to contest the loot.

a_device_that_draws_maps.levelRequirementReason: Removed the level 5 gate to allow for early-game exploration while maintaining balance via the complication mechanic.
a_device_that_draws_maps.vendorReason: This item is a signature product of Wario's own map-making enterprise.
a_device_that_draws_maps.shippingDetail: Delivered via a weathered crate; may arrive slightly damp from sea spray.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The generator is destroyed or the daily use limit is reached.

a_device_that_draws_maps.priceReason: Reduced from 14,000 XP to reflect an Uncommon rarity suitable for mid-tier exploration.

a_flickering_lantern_from_luigi.name: Luigi's Ghost-Hunting Lantern
a_flickering_lantern_from_luigi.description: Luigi's Ghost-Hunting Lantern is a weathered, flickering lantern salvaged from the ruins of a castle defense. Its glass panes are etched with faint, nervous carvings and it emits a steady, pale glow.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Sight
effectDetails.rules: While the lantern is lit, it sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for an additional 10 feet. Within this radius, invisible spirits and ghosts are outlined in a faint blue hue, making them visible to all creatures.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Flare
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can cause the lantern to pulse with holy energy. Each undead creature within 15 feet of the lantern must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 radiant damage.

effectDetails.title: Haunted Whispers
effectDetails.rules: The lantern is haunted by Luigi's lingering fears; while holding the lantern, you have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened.

a_flickering_lantern_from_luigi.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for all levels as its primary effects are utility-based and its damage is minor.
a_flickering_lantern_from_luigi.vendorReason: Wario sells various salvaged items from the surrounding lands, including those from the castle ruins.
a_flickering_lantern_from_luigi.shippingDetail: Delivered in a crate wrapped in damp burlap; may arrive with a lingering chill.

usage.duration: Spectral Sight is constant while lit; Radiant Flare is instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Radiant Flare can be used once per long rest; Spectral Sight ends if the lantern is extinguished
usage.charges: 1 use per long rest for Radiant Flare

a_flickering_lantern_from_luigi.priceReason: The price was reduced to reflect an uncommon utility item that provides minor damage and specific visibility.

a_flickering_lantern_that_glows.name: Feywhisper Torch
a_flickering_lantern_that_glows.description: The Feywhisper Torch is a flickering lantern crafted from twilight-hued glass that emits a soft, rhythmic hum. This magical light source reveals hidden paths through the Feywild while granting the bearer a momentary veil of secrecy.

effectDetails.title: Veil of Twilight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can cause the lantern to pulse, granting you the effects of the invisibility spell for 1 round (or until you attack, cast a spell, or take damage). This effect has a cooldown of 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Pathfinder's Sight
effectDetails.rules: While the lantern is lit, you can see secret doors and hidden paths within the Feywild for 30 seconds. This effect activates automatically when the lantern is lit in a Feywild environment.

effectDetails.title: Subtle Presence
effectDetails.rules: While holding the lantern, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in natural foliage or dim light for 1 minute after the lantern has been lit.

a_flickering_lantern_that_glows.levelRequirementReason: The item's ability to grant invisibility and navigate the Feywild requires a character of at least 4th level to handle the magical flux.
a_flickering_lantern_that_glows.vendorReason: Rogueport is a primary hub for illicit goods and items designed for stealthy navigation.
a_flickering_lantern_that_glows.shippingDetail: Delivered in a lead-lined crate to prevent the lantern's whispers from alerting local authorities.

usage.duration: 1 round (Veil), 30 seconds (Pathfinder)
usage.endsWhen: Attacking, casting a spell, taking damage, or the duration expires

a_flickering_lantern_that_glows.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a standard uncommon utility item that provides significant tactical advantages.

a_flying_broom_for_quick.name: Kamek's Broom
a_flying_broom_for_quick.description: Kamek's Broom is a sturdy, weathered wooden broomstick enchanted by the Comet Observatory to facilitate swift aerial escapes. Its bristles hum with a faint celestial energy, though the broom occasionally twitches with a stubborn, independent personality.

effectDetails.title: Swift Flight
effectDetails.rules: While holding the broom, you gain a flying speed of 50 feet. This speed is constant as long as you are mounted on the broom.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Surge
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can use an action to cause the broom to cast one random 3rd-level spell from the Wizard spell list. The DM rolls a d10 to determine the spell. The spell targets a creature or object within 60 feet.

effectDetails.title: Erratic Movement
effectDetails.rules: When you roll a 1 on an initiative check or a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check while mounted, the broom's mind takes over; you must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be forced to fly 20 feet in a random direction.

a_flying_broom_for_quick.levelRequirementReason: The broom's high-speed flight and arcane capabilities require a character with sufficient magical attunement.
a_flying_broom_for_quick.vendorReason: The observatory specializes in celestial navigation tools and enchanted travel equipment.
a_flying_broom_for_quick.shippingDetail: Delivered via a high-speed broom courier; may arrive slightly agitated and require a brief 'calming' period before use.

usage.duration: Permanent (while held)
usage.endsWhen: The user lets go of the broom or is incapacitated

a_flying_broom_for_quick.priceReason: Adjusted from 30,000 to 5,000 XP to reflect a balanced epic-tier utility item for mid-to-high level play.

a_fractured_fragment_of_a.name: Mirrored Soul Shard
a_fractured_fragment_of_a.description: The Mirrored Soul Shard is a jagged, crystalline fragment of a dead necromancer’s essence bound to the Deep Mirror. This shimmering shard whispers forgotten commands and warps the battlefield's perception to manipulate undead formations.

effectDetails.title: Undead Command
effectDetails.rules: When you cast a spell or use a feature to summon undead, roll a d20; on a 10 or higher, you may immediately command one additional undead of the same CR to move up to half its speed toward a target of your choice.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Veil
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can become invisible until the start of your next turn. This effect ends early if you take damage or move more than 15 feet on your turn.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Stagger
effectDetails.rules: When a spirit summoned by this shard deals damage to a target, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be unable to take reactions until the start of its next turn.

a_fractured_fragment_of_a.levelRequirementReason: The shard's necrotic resonance is too volatile for characters under level 5 to wield safely.
a_fractured_fragment_of_a.vendorReason: The Fractured Atrium specializes in artifacts of necrotic and shattered origins.
a_fractured_fragment_of_a.shippingDetail: Delivered via Lakitu Drone; the shard is wrapped in lead-lined silk to prevent psychic leakage.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage, moving 15 feet, or the start of the next turn

a_fractured_fragment_of_a.priceReason: Reduced from 2500 to 1000 to align with standard Rare item gold-to-XP conversion for tactical utility.

a_fractured_relic_from_the.name: Ancient Temple Shard
a_fractured_relic_from_the.description: This Ancient Temple Shard is a jagged, glowing fragment of stone pulled from the depths of the Sacred Ruins. When held, the shard hums with a faint resonance that highlights the architecture of forgotten civilizations.

effectDetails.title: Temple Agility
effectDetails.rules: While you are within a designated temple zone, your walking and running speed increases by 5 feet. This effect is passive and only functions in areas identified as sacred ruins.

effectDetails.title: Pathfinding Vision
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can focus on the shard to cast a divination spell that reveals a hidden path or door within 60 feet. This effect has a 1d4 chance of success and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sanctuary Shield
effectDetails.rules: While holding the shard in a temple zone, you gain resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from environmental hazards (such as falling debris). This effect ends if you are more than 30 feet away from the shard.

a_fractured_relic_from_the.levelRequirementReason: The shard's resonance is too volatile for those who lack the spiritual fortitude of a 5th-level adventurer.
a_fractured_relic_from_the.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in artifacts recovered from the surrounding ruins.
a_fractured_relic_from_the.shippingDetail: Delivered via armored shell-carrier to ensure the relic remains undisturbed during transit.

usage.duration: Persistent while held
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends if the shard is dropped or the user leaves a temple zone.
usage.charges: 1 use per long rest for Pathfinding Vision

a_fractured_relic_from_the.priceReason: Reduced from 2500 to reflect a balanced rare item price while maintaining its unique utility.

a_geometric_wand_brimming_with_1.name: Kamek's Spare Wand
a_geometric_wand_brimming_with_1.description: Kamek's Spare Wand is a geometric wand etched with shifting lines that hum with chaotic transformation magic. This relic, sourced from the Valley Trading Post, vibrates with a manic energy that causes the wielder to laugh uncontrollably upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Potency
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC for any spell cast using this wand.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Transmutation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can touch a medium object and transform it into a loyal CR 3 monstrosity. The creature remains loyal to you for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 hit points. You must then succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or laugh uncontrollably for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Geometric Terrain
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can target a 30-foot cube of difficult terrain within 60 feet. The area instantly transforms into a series of floating geometric blocks. The terrain remains in this state for 10 minutes, and any creature moving through it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

a_geometric_wand_brimming_with_1.levelRequirementReason: The chaotic nature of the wand requires a high level of magical discipline to wield without being overwhelmed.
a_geometric_wand_brimming_with_1.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post specializes in recovering anomalous magical artifacts from the wilderness.
a_geometric_wand_brimming_with_1.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-speed broomstick flight; may arrive with minor scuff marks or lingering magical static.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or the object is destroyed

a_geometric_wand_brimming_with_1.priceReason: Reduced from the original price to reflect a balanced legendary-tier item cost for high-level play.

a_gold_plated_spray_painted.name: Wario's Authentic Autograph Plaque
a_gold_plated_spray_painted.description: Wario's Authentic Autograph Plaque is a gold-plated, spray-painted plaque featuring a winking portrait of the legendary Wario. Produced by Wario Land Memorabilia, the item emits a permanent, faint scent of garlic.

effectDetails.title: Bad Financial Advice
effectDetails.rules: While the plaque is displayed in your camp, you may roll a d20 at the end of a Long Rest; on a 1-5, Wario appears in your dreams to offer terrible investment tips, causing you to lose 1d6 gold pieces as you impulsively follow his lead.

effectDetails.title: Collector's Status
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with NPCs who possess a high social standing or significant wealth, as they recognize the plaque as a collector's item.

effectDetails.title: Tacky Aesthetic
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on all Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against NPCs who are art critics, historians, or refined connoisseurs of fine art.

a_gold_plated_spray_painted.levelRequirementReason: The item is a common piece of memorabilia and does not require high-level proficiency to possess.
a_gold_plated_spray_painted.vendorReason: This is a branded item directly from the Wario Land Memorabilia line.
a_gold_plated_spray_painted.shippingDetail: The item arrives with a lingering garlic scent that persists even after unpacking.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The plaque is destroyed or sold

a_gold_plated_spray_painted.priceReason: Reduced from 4500 to reflect its status as a common, spray-painted novelty item.

a_golden_key_to_the.name: Diamond City Key
a_golden_key_to_the.description: The Diamond City Key is a heavy golden key forged by Skaven artisans to unlock the secrets of the vault. Its surface glimmers with a faint light, specifically tuned to resonate with the architecture of Diamond City and Wario Land zones.

effectDetails.title: Vault Access
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can touch the key to a locked door or chest within 5 feet. If the door is part of a hidden room within Diamond City or Wario Land, it unlocks instantly.

effectDetails.title: Short-Range Blink
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. This effect requires 1000 mana; if you lack the mana, the key cannot be used.

effectDetails.title: Mana Drain
effectDetails.rules: Each time you use the teleportation effect, you suffer a minor mana drain. For every three consecutive uses, you must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage.

a_golden_key_to_the.levelRequirementReason: The epic rarity and mana costs require a character with significant magical reserves.
a_golden_key_to_the.vendorReason: Sarasaland is a primary trade hub for high-value keys and treasures.
a_golden_key_to_the.shippingDetail: Delivered via secure underwater transport; arrives within 3 days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends once the teleportation occurs or the door unlocks.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses as long as 1000 mana is available.

a_golden_key_to_the.priceReason: The price reflects its epic rarity and the high mana cost required for its primary utility.

a_greasy_napkin_signed_by.name: Wario's Autograph on a Used Napkin
a_greasy_napkin_signed_by.description: Wario's Autograph on a Used Napkin is a crumpled, grease-stained piece of paper featuring a bold signature made with a Sharpie. Despite the pungent scent of garlic sauce, Wario insists this scrap is 'worth a fortune!' to any true collector.

effectDetails.title: Celebrity Distraction
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can hold the napkin up to a creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on its next melee attack roll as it pauses to inspect the autograph.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Stench
effectDetails.rules: While the napkin is on your person, you have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to sell the item to anyone who is not a fan of Wario due to the overwhelming smell of garlic sauce.

effectDetails.title: Fanaticism
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to haggle with individuals who openly express admiration for Wario.

a_greasy_napkin_signed_by.levelRequirementReason: The item is a common novelty and does not require high-level proficiency to utilize.
a_greasy_napkin_signed_by.vendorReason: This item originates from Wario's own collection of 'treasures'.
a_greasy_napkin_signed_by.shippingDetail: The item arrives in a stained envelope that leaves a faint oil residue on your hands upon opening.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Distraction) or Permanent (Stench/Fanaticism)
usage.endsWhen: The napkin is destroyed or the Distraction effect is used once.

a_greasy_napkin_signed_by.priceReason: Reduced from 4500 to reflect a common-rarity novelty item rather than a high-value artifact.

a_hat_that_grows_garlic.name: Wario's Garlic Grower Hat (Gimmick Grow!)
a_hat_that_grows_garlic.description: Wario's Garlic Grower Hat is a sturdy, wide-brimmed headpiece crafted by Wario's Farm Folly. It features a peculiar, organic growth of pungent garlic bulbs that sprout directly from the fabric.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Harvest
effectDetails.rules: At dawn, the hat produces one garlic bulb. As an action, you can pull the bulb to use as a culinary ingredient or throw it at a creature within 20 feet. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

effectDetails.title: Pungent Aroma
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the hat, you have advantage on saving throws against vampires, but you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from creatures that rely on smell.

effectDetails.title: Persistent Itch
effectDetails.rules: If you do not harvest the daily garlic bulb by the next dawn, the hat becomes irritating; you have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a spell until the bulb is harvested.

a_hat_that_grows_garlic.levelRequirementReason: The original level 5 requirement was removed to allow lower-level players to enjoy the common-rarity utility.
a_hat_that_grows_garlic.vendorReason: This item is a signature product of Wario's agricultural line.
a_hat_that_grows_garlic.shippingDetail: Shipped in a ventilated crate to prevent the garlic from rotting during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The hat is destroyed or removed from the head

a_hat_that_grows_garlic.priceReason: Reduced from 7500 to 1000 to reflect its common rarity and utility-based mechanics.

a_holster_for_guns_garlic.name: Wario's Wild West Holster
a_holster_for_guns_garlic.description: Wario's Wild West Holster is a rugged leather sheath designed specifically for garlic shooters. Hand-stitched by Wario West, the holster features a distinctive, loud creak whenever the wearer moves rapidly.

effectDetails.title: Quick Draw
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on the first ranged weapon attack roll you make each turn with a garlic shooter.

effectDetails.title: Western Grit
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) and Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made while wielding a garlic shooter.

effectDetails.title: Holster Creak
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while moving at a speed of at least 10 feet.

a_holster_for_guns_garlic.levelRequirementReason: This is a minor equipment buff that does not require high-level character progression.
a_holster_for_guns_garlic.vendorReason: This item is a signature piece from the Wario West collection.
a_holster_for_guns_garlic.shippingDetail: Delivered via express courier with a 'handle with care' sticker to prevent leather cracking.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The holster is destroyed or discarded.

a_holster_for_guns_garlic.priceReason: Reduced to a standard uncommon price point for non-magical utility gear.

a_hooded_cloak_for_patrolling.name: Gondor Ranger's Cloak
a_hooded_cloak_for_patrolling.description: This heavy, woven Gondor Ranger's Cloak is crafted by master Gondor Tailors for those tasked with patrolling the wilds of Ithilien. The thick fabric is designed to blend into the natural landscape while providing protection against the elements.

effectDetails.title: Wilderness Awareness
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the cloak in forest or hill terrain, you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track creatures or navigate the wilderness.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Sight
effectDetails.rules: While the hood is up, you can see in dim light as if it were bright light. In darkness, you can see as if it were dim light, but you can tell no other details.

effectDetails.title: Thorn Snag
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you move through dense brush or thorny terrain, roll a d20; on a 1, the cloak snags, and you take 1 point of piercing damage as the fabric tears.

a_hooded_cloak_for_patrolling.levelRequirementReason: Removed the level 5 gate to allow early-game scouts to utilize standard ranger gear.
a_hooded_cloak_for_patrolling.vendorReason: This is the standard issue gear for scouts stationed at the kingdom's frontier outposts.
a_hooded_cloak_for_patrolling.shippingDetail: Delivered via horseback courier; arrives within 3 days of order placement.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The cloak is removed or destroyed

a_hooded_cloak_for_patrolling.priceReason: Adjusted from 16,500 to 1,000 to reflect an Uncommon utility item rather than a high-tier artifact.

a_horn_that_honks_with.name: Wario's  Bike Horn
a_horn_that_honks_with.description: Wario's Bike Horn is a brass-plated horn that emits a pungent, lingering garlic scent with every blast. Manufactured by Wario Wheels, this loud accessory is designed for high-speed racing and aggressive signaling.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Distraction
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can blow the horn to emit a deafening honk. One creature of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be distracted, losing its next action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Pungent Aroma
effectDetails.rules: While the horn is on your person, it constantly emits a garlic odor. Any creature within 5 feet of you has disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

effectDetails.title: Racing Boost
effectDetails.rules: While mounted on a vehicle or beast, you gain a +10 foot bonus to your movement speed as the horn's aggressive tone motivates the mount.

a_horn_that_honks_with.levelRequirementReason: The item is common rarity and does not possess high-level magical properties.
a_horn_that_honks_with.vendorReason: This is a signature product of the Wario Wheels brand found in his domain.
a_horn_that_honks_with.shippingDetail: Delivered via heavy-duty courier; arrives with a 'Handle with Care' sticker to prevent accidental honking.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The distraction effect ends immediately after the target's turn concludes.
usage.charges: Limited to Proficiency Bonus per long rest

a_horn_that_honks_with.priceReason: Reduced from 4100 XP to reflect its common rarity and utility-based mechanics.

a_jagged_piece_of_the.name: Peach's Crown Shard
a_jagged_piece_of_the.description: This Peach's Crown Shard is a jagged, metallic fragment of the late Princess's regalia, salvaged from the palace ruins. The shard hums with a faint, lingering radiance and bears the distinct marks of the Palace Looter's crude handling.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an undead creature or a Toad rebel with a melee weapon attack made using this shard as an enchantment, you can deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage. This property can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Royal Resonance
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to locate hidden heirs or royal secrets within a 60-foot radius, as the shard glows faintly in their presence.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Theft
effectDetails.rules: While in possession of this shard, you have disadvantage on all Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against loyalists of the former kingdom, who instinctively sense the illicit nature of the stolen crown piece.

a_jagged_piece_of_the.levelRequirementReason: The shard's magical resonance requires a character to be attuned to the weight of royal history.
a_jagged_piece_of_the.vendorReason: Wario's collection includes various looted treasures from the palace ruins.
a_jagged_piece_of_the.shippingDetail: Delivered in a lead-lined box to prevent magical tracking; arrives within 3 days.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The shard shatters permanently after 3 uses of the Radiant Strike effect.

a_jagged_piece_of_the.priceReason: Adjusted from 4800 to reflect a common-rarity loot item that is functionally limited.

a_key_forged_in_the.name: Ricco Harbor Key
a_key_forged_in_the.description: The Ricco Harbor Key is a heavy iron key forged in the ink-jammed ruins of Ricco Harbor. It carries the distinct scent of stale tea and regret, and the faint, lingering presence of Admiral Bloopers.

effectDetails.title: Secret Access
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the key to unlock the secret door behind the ink-stained wall or grant entry to the Koopa Navy’s hidden storage. This effect lasts for 10 minutes or until the door is closed/locked.

effectDetails.title: Summon Ink-Splattered Goblins
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can hold the key aloft to summon 1d4 ink-splattered goblins in an area within 30 feet. The goblins appear in unoccupied spaces and act as friendly minions for 1 minute before vanishing. You can use this property once per long rest.

a_key_forged_in_the.levelRequirementReason: The key's ability to command hostile entities requires a basic understanding of magical influence.
a_key_forged_in_the.vendorReason: The dreamland vendor specializes in artifacts recovered from ruined coastal regions.
a_key_forged_in_the.shippingDetail: Delivered via spirit path; may arrive with a slight chill and a lingering sense of melancholy.

usage.duration: 10 minutes or 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The door is closed, the duration expires, or the daily summon limit is reached

a_key_forged_in_the.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect the utility of both permanent access and a limited summoning ability.

a_lightweight_cape_woven_from.name: Tropical Breeze Cape
a_lightweight_cape_woven_from.description: The Tropical Breeze Cape is a lightweight garment woven from the literal breath of the island’s coastal winds. This airy fabric allows the wearer to catch updrafts, making it a favorite for aerial maneuvers in the Isle Delfino region.

effectDetails.title: Guided Glide
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can manifest a localized updraft to glide. You gain a flying speed of 30 feet for 1 minute. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses after a Long Rest.

effectDetails.title: Wind-Swept Evasion
effectDetails.rules: While you are flying or falling, you gain a +2 bonus to your AC as the cape's fabric deflects incoming strikes.

effectDetails.title: Soft Landing
effectDetails.rules: While falling, the cape slows your descent, reducing all falling damage by 50% (minimum of 1 damage). This effect is passive and always active.

a_lightweight_cape_woven_from.levelRequirementReason: The cape's mastery over island winds requires a character with significant experience in high-mobility tactics.
a_lightweight_cape_woven_from.vendorReason: The vendor is the primary source for enchanted tropical gear on the island.
a_lightweight_cape_woven_from.shippingDetail: The cape is shipped in a pressurized tube to maintain its airy texture during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the wearer uses the ability again.

a_lightweight_cape_woven_from.priceReason: The price reflects its rare status and the utility of flight and evasion in mid-to-high level play.

a_long_fork_for_roasting.name: Wario's Wiener Roast Fork
a_long_fork_for_roasting.description: Wario's Wiener Roast Fork is a massive, heavy-duty roasting tool crafted by Wario BBQ. This oversized metal fork features a distinctive 🍡 icon etched into the handle and is perpetually coated in a slick, savory grease.

effectDetails.title: Masterful Roasting
effectDetails.rules: While using this fork to cook meat over an open flame, you have advantage on any ability checks made to determine the quality or flavor of the meal.

effectDetails.title: Extended Reach Poke
effectDetails.rules: When you use the fork to poke a creature, your reach increases by 5 feet. On a successful hit, the target takes 1d4 piercing damage.

effectDetails.title: Greasy Grip
effectDetails.rules: Because of the lingering grease, you have disadvantage on all Strength (Athletics) checks made to maintain your grip on the fork or any object held by it.

a_long_fork_for_roasting.levelRequirementReason: The item is common equipment and does not require specific character progression to wield.
a_long_fork_for_roasting.vendorReason: This is a signature tool from Wario's own BBQ establishment.
a_long_fork_for_roasting.shippingDetail: Delivered in a grease-proof tube to ensure the fork arrives ready for the grill.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Poke) or Indefinite (Roasting)
usage.endsWhen: The poke effect ends once the target is hit; roasting ends when the fire is extinguished.

a_long_fork_for_roasting.priceReason: Reduced from 4800 to 1000 to reflect its common rarity while maintaining its utility.

a_lucky_bone_for_wishes.name: Wario's Wishbone
a_lucky_bone_for_wishes.description: Wario's Wishbone is a calcified, oversized bone marked with crude carvings, purportedly blessed by the artisan Wario Wishes. This poultry-shaped trinket hums with a faint, greedy energy and is often seen displayed in the Wario Land markets.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Snap
effectDetails.rules: When you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can use a bonus action to snap the bone. You gain a +1 bonus to that specific roll. This can be used a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Greedy Favor
effectDetails.rules: While holding the bone, you have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to solicit gold, loot, or other treasures from NPCs.

effectDetails.title: Fractured Misfortune
effectDetails.rules: If you fail a Charisma check to steal or trick a creature while holding the bone, the bone cracks. You suffer disadvantage on all ability checks until you spend 1 hour performing a ritual of mending or 'polishing' the bone.

a_lucky_bone_for_wishes.levelRequirementReason: The item is common rarity and does not require high-level magic to interact with.
a_lucky_bone_for_wishes.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in Wario-themed goods and local curiosities.
a_lucky_bone_for_wishes.shippingDetail: Shipped in a sturdy crate to prevent the bone from snapping prematurely during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus Action (Lucky Snap) or Passive (Greedy Favor)
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Lucky Snap) or Constant (Greedy Favor)
usage.endsWhen: The Lucky Snap effect ends after one roll; Fractured Misfortune ends after 1 hour of polishing.

a_lucky_bone_for_wishes.priceReason: Reduced from 4300 to reflect common rarity and the limited uses of the lucky bonus.

a_meter_that_measures_your.name: Wario's Luck-o-Meter
a_meter_that_measures_your.description: Wario's Luck-o-Meter is a bulky, vibrating brass gauge manufactured in Wario's Luck Lab. This erratic device features a spinning needle that purportedly tracks your fortune, though its 'boosts' are often as chaotic as the man who built it.

effectDetails.title: Fortunate Reading
effectDetails.rules: When you make an ability check, you can use an action to consult the meter. Roll a d20; on a 15 or higher, you gain one Inspiration die. On a 5 or lower, you may reroll the failed check once.

effectDetails.title: Gambler's Vibration
effectDetails.rules: While holding the meter, you gain a +1 bonus to any roll made to gamble or search for hidden loot. This effect is passive and constant while the item is held.

effectDetails.title: Fraudulent Breakdown
effectDetails.rules: The meter provides false readings after 3 uses of the Fortunate Reading ability. Once 3 uses are reached, the item becomes non-functional and is destroyed as the internal gears seize up.

a_meter_that_measures_your.levelRequirementReason: The item's luck-altering properties are tuned for characters with enough experience to navigate high-stakes environments.
a_meter_that_measures_your.vendorReason: Wario's Luck Lab is the primary source for these dubious, high-energy gambling trinkets.
a_meter_that_measures_your.shippingDetail: Delivered in a padded crate to prevent the meter from vibrating off the delivery wagon.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The item is destroyed after 3 uses of the Fortunate Reading ability.

a_meter_that_measures_your.priceReason: Reduced from 11,000 XP to reflect an uncommon item with a limited, self-destructing lifespan.

a_mutated_core_from_the.name: Fire Flower Core
a_mutated_core_from_the.description: This Fire Flower Core is a pulsating, mutated organic mass harvested from Raventree Manor’s Shadowfell Mutation Lab. It emits a low heat and must be kept in a sealed crystal vial to prevent it from detonating upon contact with water.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Critical
effectDetails.rules: When you score a critical hit with a weapon infused with this core, the target and all creatures within 5 feet of it take an additional 2d6 fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Initial Flare
effectDetails.rules: The first time you hit a creature with an infused weapon during a combat encounter, the target takes an additional 3d6 fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Mutant Physiology
effectDetails.rules: While the core is active, you gain a +1d4 bonus to melee damage rolls and 10% fire resistance, but your stamina regeneration is reduced by 10% until you finish a long rest.

a_mutated_core_from_the.levelRequirementReason: The volatile nature of Shadowfell mutations requires a high level of magical fortitude to stabilize.
a_mutated_core_from_the.vendorReason: The Middle Earth vendor specializes in exotic and mutated flora from restricted regions.
a_mutated_core_from_the.shippingDetail: Must be transported in a temperature-controlled, waterproof containment unit to prevent premature detonation.

usage.duration: 1 hour per long rest
usage.endsWhen: The core is removed from the weapon or the 1-hour duration expires

a_mutated_core_from_the.priceReason: Adjusted from 12,000 to 5,000 to reflect a balanced Epic rarity price point for a single-use enhancement.

a_pan_that_stirs_itself.name: Mages' Guild Spellbound Saucepan
a_pan_that_stirs_itself.description: The Mages' Guild Spellbound Saucepan is a heavy cast-iron vessel featuring a perpetually moving magical spoon. Crafted by the Mages' Guild Kitchen Enchanters, it hums with a faint arcane resonance while cooking.

effectDetails.title: Automated Stirring
effectDetails.rules: While the pan is over a heat source and contains liquid or semi-solid food, you have advantage on all Wisdom (Survival) or Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to cook the meal. Additionally, the pan functions as a free object for the purpose of somatic components while held.

effectDetails.title: Culinary Prestidigitation
effectDetails.rules: When you finish cooking a meal, roll a d6. On a 1-3, the food changes color; on a 4-5, the flavor becomes slightly spicy or sweet; on a 6, the temperature fluctuates by 20 degrees. This effect is instantaneous and occurs once per meal prepared.

effectDetails.title: Sentient Guidance
effectDetails.rules: The pan provides constant unsolicited advice. If you choose to ignore the pan's verbal suggestions during a cooking check, you instead have disadvantage on that check. You may choose to heed its advice to negate this disadvantage.

a_pan_that_stirs_itself.levelRequirementReason: The item's effects are utility-based and do not provide combat power that scales with high-level progression.
a_pan_that_stirs_itself.vendorReason: The Mages' Guild Kitchen Enchanters are the primary manufacturers of this enchanted cookware.
a_pan_that_stirs_itself.shippingDetail: Delivered via a shimmering portal; the pan may arrive slightly warm to the touch.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The pan is destroyed or the magic is dispelled by a Dispel Magic spell.

a_pan_that_stirs_itself.priceReason: Reduced from 19,500 to reflect a balanced utility item that provides flavor rather than significant combat advantages.

a_parasol_for_floating_and_1.name: Peach's Parasol
a_parasol_for_floating_and_1.description: Peach's Parasol is a sturdy, silk-canopied parasol designed for graceful aerial maneuvers and defense. This rare accessory from the Toad Town Market features a reinforced frame capable of catching the wind to slow a descent.

effectDetails.title: Slow Fall
effectDetails.rules: While the parasol is open, your falling speed is reduced to 10 feet per round. This effect is active as long as you are falling and the parasol remains deployed.

effectDetails.title: Shielding
effectDetails.rules: While the parasol is open and held in one hand, you gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class as it deflects incoming projectiles and strikes.

effectDetails.title: Horizontal Glide
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can use the parasol to glide horizontally for a distance of 20 feet. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks, but you cannot move at your full walking speed while gliding.

a_parasol_for_floating_and_1.levelRequirementReason: The item's utility for aerial mobility and defense is balanced for mid-level play.
a_parasol_for_floating_and_1.vendorReason: The local market specializes in whimsical travel gear and outdoor accessories.
a_parasol_for_floating_and_1.shippingDetail: The item arrives in a specialized rigid case to prevent the silk from creasing during transit.

usage.duration: Continuous while open
usage.endsWhen: The parasol is closed or dropped

a_parasol_for_floating_and_1.priceReason: Reduced from 20,000 XP to reflect a standard rare equipment price for a non-magical utility item.

a_partially_burned_scroll_from.name: Kamek's Scorched Spell Scroll
a_partially_burned_scroll_from.description: Kamek's Scorched Spell Scroll is a charred piece of parchment salvaged from the personal war spellbook of the Royal Magikoopa Kamek. The singed edges and erratic ink strokes betray its volatile nature, still radiating a faint, lingering magical heat.

effectDetails.title: Erratic Polymorph
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may read the scroll to cast Polymorph on a creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a random non-magical object for 1 hour. If the target succeeds, the scroll crumbles into ash and is destroyed. There is a 30% chance that the spell targets you instead of the intended victim.

effectDetails.title: Kamek's Signature
effectDetails.rules: While holding this scroll, you have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to identify magic or recognize the specific magical style of the Royal Magikoopa.

a_partially_burned_scroll_from.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the scroll's high-level transmutation magic requires a wizard of significant experience.
a_partially_burned_scroll_from.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in items recovered from various magical skirmishes and territories.
a_partially_burned_scroll_from.shippingDetail: The scroll is shipped in a lead-lined tube to prevent the lingering heat from igniting nearby materials.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The scroll crumbles and is destroyed after one use.

a_partially_burned_scroll_from.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity of a high-level spell scroll from a known magical antagonist.

a_pendant_that_pulses_with.name: Necrotic Heart Pendant
a_pendant_that_pulses_with.description: The Necrotic Heart Pendant is a heavy, obsidian-like locket that pulses with a rhythmic, cold heartbeat. Forged in the shadows of the Fractured Atrium, it carries the weight of forgotten memories and glows with a sickly violet light that dims when the wearer takes damage.

effectDetails.title: Siphon Life
effectDetails.rules: While an undead creature is within 30 feet of you, you have a 10% chance at the start of each of your turns to regain hit points equal to 10% of your maximum hit points.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Communion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can attempt to communicate with one undead entity within 60 feet. The entity can speak for up to 3 seconds before the connection severs. You can use this property once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Vengeful Pulse
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from an enemy, the pendant pulses, granting you a +2 bonus to necrotic damage rolls for 1 minute. This effect ends if you are healed or if the duration expires.

a_pendant_that_pulses_with.levelRequirementReason: The pendant's necrotic resonance requires a character of at least 5th level to handle without being overwhelmed by the weight of the dead.
a_pendant_that_pulses_with.vendorReason: The Fractured Atrium is a primary source for artifacts steeped in necrotic energy and forgotten memories.
a_pendant_that_pulses_with.shippingDetail: The item arrives encased in lead-lined silk to prevent the pulse from disrupting nearby electronics.

usage.duration: Variable / 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the target is out of range, the wearer is healed, or the long rest expires.
usage.charges: 1 per long rest for Spirit Communion

a_pendant_that_pulses_with.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the significant utility provided by the Siphon Life and Vengeful Pulse mechanics.

a_piece_of_bowser_s.name: Bowser's Shell Fragment Shield (Chipped)
