a_piece_of_bowser_s.description: This Bowser's Shell Fragment Shield is a jagged, heavy piece of carapace recovered from the ruins of Toad Town. Salvaged by Wario Land Battlefield Salvage, the shell still radiates a faint, pulsing heat from the King of Koopas's lingering fury.

effectDetails.title: Residual Bowser Magic
effectDetails.rules: While wielding this shield, you gain a +1 bonus to AC against any damage from fire-based attacks or spells.

effectDetails.title: Koopa Recognition
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with Koopa Troop defectors or neutral Koopas.

effectDetails.title: Burning Rage Aura
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks, but you have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks as the shell's heat reflects Bowser's aggressive temperament.

a_piece_of_bowser_s.levelRequirementReason: The item is a basic piece of equipment and does not require high-level proficiency.
a_piece_of_bowser_s.vendorReason: Wario Land Battlefield Salvage specializes in recovering debris from high-conflict zones.
a_piece_of_bowser_s.shippingDetail: Due to its immense weight and jagged edges, this item requires reinforced crates and takes 2 days longer to deliver.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The shield is destroyed or dropped

a_piece_of_bowser_s.priceReason: Adjusted from 5200 to 1000 to reflect an uncommon shield with minor social and defensive buffs.

a_pink_brick_from_the.name: Peach's Castle Brick
a_pink_brick_from_the.description: This Peach's Castle Brick is a heavy, pink masonry block stamped with the royal crest. Manufactured by Castle Architecture during the Pre-War Era, it serves as a sturdy piece of the kingdom's history.

effectDetails.title: Bludgeoning Projectile
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can throw the brick at a target within 20 feet. Make a ranged weapon attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

effectDetails.title: Royal Nostalgia
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Wisdom (History) checks made to recall information regarding the kingdom's architecture, lineage, or royal history.

effectDetails.title: Heavy and Awkward
effectDetails.rules: Because of its size and weight, you have disadvantage on attack rolls made with the brick if you are using a ranged attack maneuver or trying to throw it beyond 20 feet.

a_pink_brick_from_the.levelRequirementReason: The brick is a common architectural relic and does not require high-level proficiency to wield.
a_pink_brick_from_the.vendorReason: Wario's shop often stocks salvaged debris and architectural scraps from the surrounding lands.
a_pink_brick_from_the.shippingDetail: Shipped in a reinforced crate to prevent cracking; standard delivery time applies.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The brick hits a target or misses and falls to the ground.

a_pink_brick_from_the.priceReason: Reduced from 3900 to reflect its status as a common architectural relic rather than a high-tier artifact.

a_pistol_that_shoots_garlic.name: Wario's Garlic Gun
a_pistol_that_shoots_garlic.description: Wario's Garlic Gun is a bulky, oversized pistol forged in Wario's Weapon Workshop to repel the undead. It fires heavy, pungent garlic cloves that leave a lingering, revolting odor on the user.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Shot
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you fire a clove at a target within 60 feet. Make a ranged weapon attack (20/60 ft). On a hit, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage. If the target is an undead creature, it has disadvantage on the attack roll. Additionally, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effectDetails.title: Stench of the Workshop
effectDetails.rules: The gun emits a permanent, overwhelming odor. You have disadvantage on all Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with NPCs who are within 10 feet of you.

effectDetails.title: Limited Ammunition
effectDetails.rules: The pistol holds 10 shots. You can reload the gun as a bonus action by consuming one garlic bulb, restoring 1 shot.

a_pistol_that_shoots_garlic.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for early-game use with a low damage die and specific target types.
a_pistol_that_shoots_garlic.vendorReason: This item is a signature piece from Wario's own workshop.
a_pistol_that_shoots_garlic.shippingDetail: Delivered in a reinforced, airtight crate to prevent the stench from leaking into other shipments.

usage.activation: Action to fire; Bonus Action to reload
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target succeeds on a saving throw or the 10 shots are exhausted.

a_pistol_that_shoots_garlic.priceReason: Reduced from 11,000 to 1,000 to align with standard uncommon equipment costs for a single-use weapon type.

a_poorly_stitched_doll_that_1.name: Bootleg Waluigi Doll
a_poorly_stitched_doll_that_1.description: This Bootleg Waluigi Doll is a poorly stitched plushie featuring disproportionately lanky arms. Produced by the Shady Mushroom Kingdom Toy Factory, its crude craftsmanship gives it a haunting, off-model appearance.

effectDetails.title: Distracting Throw
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can throw the doll at a creature within 20 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become distracted by a minor illusion of Waluigi's laughter, granting the next attack against it advantage. This effect lasts until the end of the target's next turn. This property can be used 3 times per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Purist's Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made against any creature who identifies as a fan of the Mario franchise, as they find the doll's cursed appearance unsettling.

effectDetails.title: Tangled Limbs
effectDetails.rules: Because the doll's arms tangle easily, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to repair the doll or hide it in a small container.

a_poorly_stitched_doll_that_1.levelRequirementReason: The item is a low-level novelty and does not require high-level proficiency to utilize.
a_poorly_stitched_doll_that_1.vendorReason: Wario's land is the primary source for bootleg and off-brand merchandise.
a_poorly_stitched_doll_that_1.shippingDetail: The package arrives with a warning label regarding potential 'unforeseen' movements.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The target finishes its next turn or the doll is recovered.

a_poorly_stitched_doll_that_1.priceReason: Adjusted to a standard uncommon price point for a utility novelty item.

a_poster_with_your_face.name: Wario's Wild West Wanted Poster
a_poster_with_your_face.description: This weathered paper scroll features a crude, hand-drawn portrait of your likeness—or perhaps Wario's—set against a dusty frontier backdrop. Hand-crafted by Wario West, the poster smells of old parchment and gunpowder.

effectDetails.title: Bounty Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: While holding this poster, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made specifically to demand rewards or bounties from NPCs.

effectDetails.title: Outlaw Deception
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks made against outlaws or bandits in western-themed environments.

effectDetails.title: Weathered Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: Because the poster is aged and tattered, you have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against civilized city guards or high-society NPCs.

a_poster_with_your_face.levelRequirementReason: The item is a common piece of equipment that does not require specific class features or high-level stats to use.
a_poster_with_your_face.vendorReason: Wario West's territory is the primary source for these specific frontier-themed items.
a_poster_with_your_face.shippingDetail: Delivered by a rickety wagon; takes 2 days to arrive and may arrive slightly dusty.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The poster is destroyed, burned, or lost.

a_poster_with_your_face.priceReason: Reduced from 4100 to reflect a common rarity item with minor utility rather than game-breaking power.

a_potent_grenade_that_explodes_1.name: Wario's Garlic Grenade
a_potent_grenade_that_explodes_1.description: Wario's Garlic Grenade is a crude, spherical projectile packed with an overwhelming amount of pungent, concentrated garlic. Wario swears by its ability to clear out pests and rivals with its suffocating stench.

effectDetails.title: Pungent Cloud
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you throw the grenade at a point within 30 feet. It explodes, creating a 10-foot-radius sphere of garlic gas centered on the impact point. The area is heavily obscured by the mist for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Nauseating Stench
effectDetails.rules: Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Vampires and creatures with the Keen Smell trait have disadvantage on this saving throw.

a_potent_grenade_that_explodes_1.levelRequirementReason: This is a common consumable suitable for low-level adventuring.
a_potent_grenade_that_explodes_1.vendorReason: The vendor is the primary source for Wario's signature items.
a_potent_grenade_that_explodes_1.shippingDetail: The item arrives wrapped in oil-stained paper to contain the lingering odor.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the area is dispelled by a magical effect.

a_potent_grenade_that_explodes_1.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect the high-impact area control and status affliction for a common item.

a_potion_that_is_definitely.name: Wario's 'Definitely Magic' Potion
a_potion_that_is_definitely.description: Wario's 'Definitely Magic' Potion is a murky liquid contained in a cheap glass bottle adorned with a '100% Satisfaction Guarantee' sticker featuring Wario's winking face. Crafted by Wario Land Alchemy, this concoction smells strongly of garlic and carries a reputation for being only 'maybe' magical.

effectDetails.title: Unreliable Alchemy
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you drink the potion. Roll a d6. On a 1-3, the potion is merely garlic water and has no effect. On a 4-5, you gain 1d10 temporary hit points for 1 hour. On a 6, you gain a +2 bonus to Strength checks and Strength saving throws for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Questionable Side Effects
effectDetails.rules: Immediately after drinking the potion, you must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, you are Poisoned for 1 minute. The duration is reduced to 1 round if you succeed on your first saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Fragile Packaging
effectDetails.rules: While the bottle is in your inventory, there is a 20% chance it breaks during a period of heavy movement or a fall. If it breaks, the potion is lost and everything within 5 feet of the bottle is coated in a pungent garlic odor, giving any creature that enters the area a -2 penalty to Stealth checks for 1 hour.

a_potion_that_is_definitely.levelRequirementReason: The item is a consumable potion and does not require high-level proficiency to use.
a_potion_that_is_definitely.vendorReason: The item is produced by Wario Land Alchemy and sold directly by the source.
a_potion_that_is_definitely.shippingDetail: The courier handles the bottle with extreme care to prevent the 'Fragile Packaging' effect from triggering during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the user finishes a Long Rest.
usage.charges: Single use; the potion is consumed upon drinking.

a_potion_that_is_definitely.priceReason: The price was reduced from 18,500 to reflect an uncommon consumable with high variance and potential negative outcomes.

a_power_up_that_fell.name: Wario's 'Acquired' Mario Power-Up
a_power_up_that_fell.description: Wario's 'Acquired' Mario Power-Up is a yellow-painted flower with visible red streaks, purportedly 'found' by Wario in the back of a truck. This modified botanical curiosity pulses with a stolen, stolen heat.

effectDetails.title: Modified Fire Breath
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can cast Burning Hands (DC 13). This ability can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Identity Crisis
effectDetails.rules: After using the Modified Fire Breath, you must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you suffer disadvantage on Charisma checks and must speak in a high-pitched voice, exclaiming 'Mama mia!' at least once every hour for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Legal Retribution
effectDetails.rules: Each time the Modified Fire Breath is used, roll a d20. On a 1, a celestial attorney appears within 60 feet to demand the item; the DM determines the severity of the annoyance, which can include being unable to use the item for 1d4 hours.

a_power_up_that_fell.levelRequirementReason: The item's power and potential for legal complications require a character with enough experience to handle the chaos.
a_power_up_that_fell.vendorReason: Wario is the primary source of 'found' goods in this region.
a_power_up_that_fell.shippingDetail: The item arrives in a dented crate with 'Fragile' stickers that have been crossed out.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after the fire is cast or the 1-hour identity crisis expires.

a_power_up_that_fell.priceReason: The price was adjusted to reflect a rare utility item while remaining accessible for mid-level play.

a_printing_press_to_spread.name: The 'Free Croak' Press
a_printing_press_to_spread.description: The 'Free Croak' Press is a heavy, iron-framed printing press used to broadcast the message of liberation. Originally sourced from the rogueport black market, this mechanical device produces high-quality broadsides and pamphlets.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Recruitment
effectDetails.rules: While the press is active in a settlement, you gain a +2 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to recruit new members to your faction. This effect is active as long as the press is being operated.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: Each time you use the press to distribute propaganda, your faction's Loyalty score increases by 15. This bonus is applied once per week and does not stack with itself.

a_printing_press_to_spread.levelRequirementReason: The item is an uncommon utility tool suitable for any starting faction.
a_printing_press_to_spread.vendorReason: The black market is the primary hub for underground printing equipment and subversive materials.
a_printing_press_to_spread.shippingDetail: The press arrives in a heavy, unmarked crate and requires a wagon for transport.

usage.duration: 1 week
usage.endsWhen: The press is dismantled, destroyed, or moved to a new location

a_printing_press_to_spread.priceReason: The price was reduced from 40,000 to 1,000 XP to reflect its status as an uncommon faction utility rather than a legendary artifact.

a_pulsing_molten_core_encased_1.name: Forgeheart Core
a_pulsing_molten_core_encased_1.description: The Forgeheart Core is a pulsing molten core encased in a heavy iron plate, salvaged from the remains of a defunct industrial giant. It radiates a constant, rhythmic heat that vibrates against the wielder's chest.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: While the core is active, the wielder regains 2 points of stamina at the start of each of their turns. This effect does not function if the wielder is unconscious.

effectDetails.title: Heat Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +20% reduction to all fire damage taken from environmental sources or industrial machinery.

effectDetails.title: Construct Sundering
effectDetails.rules: The wielder deals an additional 1d6 fire damage to iron constructs on a successful melee weapon attack.

a_pulsing_molten_core_encased_1.levelRequirementReason: The core's intense heat and weight require a character of at least level 6 to safely withstand the physical strain.
a_pulsing_molten_core_encased_1.vendorReason: The Midlands region is the primary hub for industrial salvage and heavy machinery.
a_pulsing_molten_core_encased_1.shippingDetail: The core is packed in enchanted lead to prevent spectral interference and requires 48 hours for delivery.

usage.duration: Permanent while equipped
usage.endsWhen: The item is unequipped or the iron casing is shattered

a_pulsing_molten_core_encased_1.priceReason: The price reflects its rare status as a unique industrial relic with multiple combat and utility benefits.

a_rare_fungus_radiating_powerful_1.name: Golden Mushroom
a_rare_fungus_radiating_powerful_1.description: This Golden Mushroom is a bioluminescent fungus harvested from the Whispering Caves beneath the Regal Throne. It radiates a warm, regal glow and pulses with the essence of fallen monarchs.

effectDetails.title: Regal Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When a creature consumes this mushroom as an action, it regains 3d6 hit points. This effect occurs only once per mushroom.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Shielding
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after consumption, the user has advantage on saving throws against psychic damage and effects. This effect ends if the user takes damage from a non-psychic source or the hour passes.

effectDetails.title: Onyx Hand Beacon
effectDetails.rules: While the mushroom's glow is active (up to 1 hour after consumption), any hostile creature within 300 feet that can perceive the light must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom (Perception) check or become aware of the user's location.

a_rare_fungus_radiating_powerful_1.levelRequirementReason: The mushroom's potency and the danger of the Onyx Hand require a seasoned adventurer.
a_rare_fungus_radiating_powerful_1.vendorReason: The Mushroom Kingdom specializes in rare fungal flora and cave-grown specimens.
a_rare_fungus_radiating_powerful_1.shippingDetail: Delivered in a lead-lined crate to prevent the glow from alerting local patrols.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The mushroom is consumed or the 1-hour duration expires

a_rare_fungus_radiating_powerful_1.priceReason: Reduced from 2500 to reflect a balanced cost for a rare consumable that provides temporary utility rather than permanent buffs.

a_relic_forged_from_the.name: Echo of the Triforce
a_relic_forged_from_the.description: The Echo of the Triforce is a shimmering relic forged from the same primordial energy that birthed the Triforce. This artifact hums with ancient power, granting the wielder a surge of physical prowess and agility.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Physicality
effectDetails.rules: When activated, your Strength and movement speed increase by 20% for 1 minute. This effect does not stack with other bonuses to movement speed.

effectDetails.title: Evasive Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you can roll a d20. On a 10 or higher, you reduce the damage taken from that attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier.

a_relic_forged_from_the.levelRequirementReason: The item's raw power requires a character of at least 5th level to safely channel the Triforce energy.
a_relic_forged_from_the.vendorReason: The vendor is a local authority on relics originating from the Hyruleian region.
a_relic_forged_from_the.shippingDetail: Delivered via Lakitu cloud-drone; may arrive delayed if heavy winds occur.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the user finishes a long rest.

a_relic_forged_from_the.priceReason: Reduced from 2000 to reflect a balanced rare-tier item price for a single-use daily buff.

a_relic_from_the_blocked.name: Star Road Key
a_relic_from_the_blocked.description: The Star Road Key is a celestial relic forged from the debris of the blocked Star Road. This shimmering artifact serves as a navigational anchor for hidden portals and carries a faint, humming resonance of data corruption.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Gate Opening
effectDetails.rules: While holding the key during a full moon, you can use an action to attempt to open a portal. You must possess a confirmed Envoy's map fragment to succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, a portal opens to a location on the Star Road.

effectDetails.title: Faction Bypass
effectDetails.rules: While the key is on your person, you automatically pass all faction checkpoints without being challenged or stopped. This effect is passive and constant.

effectDetails.title: Memory Echo
effectDetails.rules: When you use the key within 60 feet of Pianta Village, you must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to see a haunting vision of the past for 1 minute, during which you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Data Corruption
effectDetails.rules: The key emits a pulse of interference. Any magical communication devices or server-based technology within 30 feet of the key suffer a -2 penalty to all checks made to operate them.

a_relic_from_the_blocked.levelRequirementReason: The item is legendary and requires significant magical proficiency to handle its reality-bending properties.
a_relic_from_the_blocked.vendorReason: The item is sold via clandestine digital networks to bypass physical scrutiny.
a_relic_from_the_blocked.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-risk smuggling routes; may be intercepted by authorities.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The key is lost or the bridge is cut by Don Pianta

a_relic_from_the_blocked.priceReason: The price was adjusted from 45,000 to a more standard legendary gold/XP value while maintaining its high rarity.

a_relic_from_the_depths_1.name: Void Touched Amulet
a_relic_from_the_depths_1.description: The Void Touched Amulet is a Feywild relic that pulses with the energy of lost time. Crafted by the Pokémon League with assistance from the Feywild’s Trickster Court, this amulet allows the wearer to resist magical onslaughts while navigating labyrinthine halls.

effectDetails.title: Magical Ward
effectDetails.rules: While attuned, you have resistance to damage from spells and other magical effects. This effect lasts as long as you remain attuned and focused.

effectDetails.title: Labyrinthine Navigation
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +3 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks made to navigate maze-like environments or track your previous location across time loops.

effectDetails.title: Void Siphon
effectDetails.rules: If you do not use your action to concentrate on the amulet's ward, you take 1d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of your turns. This damage cannot be reduced in any way.

a_relic_from_the_depths_1.levelRequirementReason: The item is an Epic rarity relic requiring significant magical maturity to handle its volatile Feywild energy.
a_relic_from_the_depths_1.vendorReason: Kivotos maintains a connection to the Trickster Court, allowing them to source Feywild-touched artifacts.
a_relic_from_the_depths_1.shippingDetail: Delivered in a lead-lined crate to prevent dimensional leakage during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent while attuned
usage.endsWhen: Attunement is broken or the wearer dies

a_relic_from_the_depths_1.priceReason: The price reflects its Epic rarity and its ability to provide resistance against high-level magical threats.

a_relic_from_the_time.name: Feywild Talisman
a_relic_from_the_time.description: This Feywild Talisman is a shimmering trinket etched with spiraling patterns that hum with the resonance of the Fey courts. Crafted by Koopa Postal and marked with Feywild courier stamps, it allows the wearer to navigate the shifting tides of temporal anomalies.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While attuned, you have advantage on saving throws against effects that attempt to manipulate time or force you into a time loop.

effectDetails.title: Perception Disruption
effectDetails.rules: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack roll against you, roll a d10; on a 1, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on that attack as their perception blurs.

effectDetails.title: Chronal Rewind
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from a time-loop effect, you can use your reaction to force the last 6 seconds of the encounter to undo. You regain the hit points lost during those 6 seconds, but the effect is expended and the talisman requires a long rest to recharge.

a_relic_from_the_time.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of navigating Feywild temporal anomalies requires a high level of magical maturity.
a_relic_from_the_time.vendorReason: Earth Land serves as a neutral ground for trading exotic Feywild artifacts.
a_relic_from_the_time.shippingDetail: Delivered via standard Feywild courier stamps; may arrive slightly before it was ordered.

usage.duration: Instantaneous / Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The Chronal Rewind effect ends after one use per long rest.

a_relic_from_the_time.priceReason: Reduced from 4200 to reflect a balanced Rare tier price for a utility-focused artifact.

a_relic_of_drowned_sorcerers_1.name: Tongue of the Tide
a_relic_of_drowned_sorcerers_1.description: The Tongue of the Tide is a salt-crusted, bioluminescent relic of the drowned sorcerers, pulsating with the rhythm of the deep. Crafted by the Chain Chomp Courier and linked to the Rakasha Spirit Walkers, this organic relic allows the wearer to commune with the ocean's secrets.

effectDetails.title: Hydrophobic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While submerged in water, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-magical attacks. This effect is only active if the wearer has a swimming speed or a creature type with aquatic affinity.

effectDetails.title: Tidal Retaliation
effectDetails.rules: When you are hit by a melee attack while submerged, you can use your reaction to release a wave of force damage. The attacker takes 1d4 force damage. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of the Deep
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can cause the relic to whisper secrets to any allies within 10 feet. Choose one ally; they gain advantage on their next Wisdom (Perception) check made within 1 minute.

a_relic_of_drowned_sorcerers_1.levelRequirementReason: The relic's aquatic affinity and magical weight require a character with established magical training or physical prowess.
a_relic_of_drowned_sorcerers_1.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in biological and spiritual relics of unusual origin.
a_relic_of_drowned_sorcerers_1.shippingDetail: Delivered via a high-speed courier; the item arrives damp and smelling of brine.

usage.activation: Passive for resistance; Reaction for Retaliation; Bonus Action for Whispers
usage.duration: Instantaneous / 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Retaliation uses are exhausted; Whispers end after the perception check.
usage.charges: Retaliation: Proficiency Bonus per long rest

a_relic_of_drowned_sorcerers_1.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a standard uncommon utility item for a level 4 adventurer.

a_relic_that_amplifies_your.name: Echo Talisman
a_relic_that_amplifies_your.description: The Echo Talisman is a resonant metal charm forged by the Iron Legion to amplify the vocal resonance of elemental reactions. It hums with a faint vibration when held by a vision holder, ready to project the user's voice with supernatural clarity.

effectDetails.title: Resonant Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When you cast a spell or use an ability that deals elemental damage (Fire, Cold, Lightning, or Thunder) while performing a vocal chant, the damage dealt by that specific instance is increased by 30%.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Aftershock
effectDetails.rules: Immediately after you deal damage with an elemental ability, roll a d10. On a 10, the echo triggers, dealing an additional 1d8 force damage to the target and all creatures within 5 feet of it.

a_relic_that_amplifies_your.levelRequirementReason: The talisman requires a high degree of magical maturity to synchronize with the user's internal vision.
a_relic_that_amplifies_your.vendorReason: The Teyvat archives house various relics of cultural and elemental significance.
a_relic_that_amplifies_your.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-speed courier with reinforced vibration-dampening packaging.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The item can only be used once per combat encounter.

a_relic_that_amplifies_your.priceReason: The price reflects its epic rarity and the significant damage multiplier provided.

a_ring_that_grants_wishes.name: Wario's Wish Granting Ring
a_ring_that_grants_wishes.description: Wario's Wish Granting Ring is a gaudy, oversized gold band forged by the notorious Wario Rings. While it lacks true magic, it provides the wearer with a sense of unearned confidence and a slight 'placebo' boost to their luck.

effectDetails.title: Placebo Luck
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can choose to reroll one d20 roll made by you. You must use the new roll.

effectDetails.title: Stubborn Fit
effectDetails.rules: The ring is magically tight; you have disadvantage on any Strength or Sleight of Hand checks made to remove the ring from your finger.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Confidence
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks specifically made to convince others that you have fulfilled a wish or possess great wealth.

a_ring_that_grants_wishes.levelRequirementReason: The item is common rarity and does not require high-level magical attunement.
a_ring_that_grants_wishes.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in Wario's signature brand of rings and trinkets.
a_ring_that_grants_wishes.shippingDetail: Delivered via a shimmering, slightly-too-loud courier who whispers 'Your wish is coming' upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The daily use is exhausted or the ring is removed.

a_ring_that_grants_wishes.priceReason: Reduced from 4900 to reflect its common rarity and placebo nature while maintaining a premium for its unique branding.

a_ring_that_pulses_with.name: Doughnut Edge Ring
a_ring_that_pulses_with.description: The Doughnut Edge Ring is a band of shimmering gold that pulses with unstable dimensional energy. This ring allows the wearer to navigate the treacherous Doughnut Edge with ease, as favored by the legendary Wario.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Fall Protection
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this ring, you are immune to all damage from falling. When you fall, you land on your feet and take no damage.

effectDetails.title: Doughnut Rift
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can cause the ring to pulse. Each creature within 10 feet of you must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 force damage on a failed save. On a failure, roll a d6: 1-3: the target is pushed 10 feet away; 4-6: the target is teleported 10 feet to a space of your choice.

effectDetails.title: Edge Passage
effectDetails.rules: You can cast the 'Dimension Door' spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot, but you can only teleport to locations associated with the Doughnut Edge or the Wario Land realm.

a_ring_that_pulses_with.levelRequirementReason: The unstable dimensional energy of the ring requires a high level of magical fortitude to stabilize.
a_ring_that_pulses_with.vendorReason: This item is a signature piece of Wario's personal collection.
a_ring_that_pulses_with.shippingDetail: Special delivery via Piranha Plant Post; the package may be slightly chewed but remains intact.

usage.activation: Passive for fall protection; Bonus Action for Doughnut Rift
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The Doughnut Rift effect ends immediately after the target is affected; Edge Passage ends after one use.
usage.charges: 1 Doughnut Rift per session; 1 Edge Passage per long rest.

a_ring_that_pulses_with.priceReason: Reduced from 15,000 to reflect a balanced legendary price point for a specialized utility item.

a_robe_with_pockets_inside.name: Mages' Guild Robe of Many Pockets
a_robe_with_pockets_inside.description: The Mages' Guild Robe of Many Pockets is a heavy, multi-layered garment crafted by Mages' Guild Seamsters. This robe features a complex internal lining of nested pockets, allowing it to hold an impressive amount of gear while maintaining a sleek exterior.

effectDetails.title: Expanded Storage
effectDetails.rules: The robe contains 20 internal pockets. Each pocket can hold up to 1 lb of weight. When you reach into a pocket to retrieve an item, roll a d20; on a 1-10, you pull out the wrong item from a different pocket. On an 11-20, you successfully retrieve the intended item.

effectDetails.title: Random Retrieval
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can reach into the robe's lining to pull out a minor mundane item (such as a copper piece, a piece of string, or a button). Roll a d20; on a 1-10, the item is exactly what you needed. On an 11-20, the item is a random minor object of the DM's choice.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Maintenance
effectDetails.rules: The robe's magic is sensitive to moisture. If the robe is washed or becomes soaked with water, the dimensional pockets collapse and the item becomes a mundane, non-magical garment.

a_robe_with_pockets_inside.levelRequirementReason: The item is a utility garment and does not require high-level spellcasting proficiency to wear.
a_robe_with_pockets_inside.vendorReason: The Mages' Guild Seamsters are the primary manufacturers of this enchanted clothing.
a_robe_with_pockets_inside.shippingDetail: The robe is shipped in a vacuum-sealed, waterproof container to prevent moisture from ruining the magic during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The robe is washed or soaked with water.
usage.charges: Random Retrieval can be used once per long rest.

a_robe_with_pockets_inside.priceReason: Reduced from 21,500 XP to reflect a balanced utility item that provides convenience rather than combat power.

a_rope_for_lassoing_foes.name: Wario's Wild West Lasso
a_rope_for_lassoing_foes.description: Wario's Wild West Lasso is a thick, coarse coil of hemp rope crafted by the legendary Wario West. This rugged tool features a distinctively weighted knot designed for capturing unruly outlaws and beasts alike.

effectDetails.title: Lasso Grapple
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action to attempt to grapple a creature within 30 feet using this lasso, you have advantage on the Athletics check.

effectDetails.title: Rope Frays
effectDetails.rules: If you use the lasso to pull a creature toward you, the rope's rough texture causes you to have disadvantage on the Strength (Athletics) check made to move the target.

effectDetails.title: Western Mastery
effectDetails.rules: While holding this lasso, you gain a +1 bonus to any Wisdom (Animal Handling) check made to calm or lead a mount.

a_rope_for_lassoing_foes.levelRequirementReason: The item is common equipment and does not require specific class features or high-level stats to operate.
a_rope_for_lassoing_foes.vendorReason: Wario West's signature gear is a staple of the Wario Land frontier outpost.
a_rope_for_lassoing_foes.shippingDetail: Delivered via a looped delivery system; arrives in 1d4 days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The grapple is broken or the creature is freed

a_rope_for_lassoing_foes.priceReason: Reduced from 4900 to reflect its common rarity and utility as a basic tool.

a_saddle_for_wild_rides.name: Wario's Wild West Saddle
a_saddle_for_wild_rides.description: Wario's Wild West Saddle is a rugged, wide-seated saddle crafted from heavy leather by the artisan Wario West. It features reinforced stirrups and a distinctive Western aesthetic designed for high-speed travel across the plains.

effectDetails.title: +1 Mounted Speed
effectDetails.rules: While mounted on a creature, your speed increases by 10 feet. This effect is passive and constant while the saddle is equipped.

effectDetails.title: Western Mastery
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Animal Handling checks made while riding a mount. This bonus does not stack with other bonuses.

effectDetails.title: Saddle Creak
effectDetails.rules: The heavy leather and iron hardware make the saddle noisy; you have disadvantage on Stealth checks made while mounted.

a_saddle_for_wild_rides.levelRequirementReason: The item is common equipment and does not require a specific power level to operate.
a_saddle_for_wild_rides.vendorReason: Wario West's workshop is the primary source for this specific style of western gear.
a_saddle_for_wild_rides.shippingDetail: Delivered via express courier; the saddle arrives pre-oiled and ready for immediate mounting.

usage.duration: Permanent while equipped
usage.endsWhen: The saddle is removed from the mount or destroyed.

a_saddle_for_wild_rides.priceReason: Reduced from 5000 to reflect its common rarity and utility-based benefits.

a_scroll_claiming_to_be.name: Peach's 'Last' Decree (Autographed by Wario)
a_scroll_claiming_to_be.description: Peach's 'Last' Decree is a weathered parchment scroll featuring a royal command that is overshadowed by a massive, crude signature from Wario. Produced by the Wario Land Historical Forgery Dept., the scroll's ink pulses with a faint, unsettling light in the dark.

effectDetails.title: Mushroom Kingdom Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can present this scroll to a Mushroom Kingdom loyalist. The target has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to determine if the decree is authentic, but you have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks against them for 1 hour as they struggle to believe the forgery.

effectDetails.title: Blatant Forgery
effectDetails.rules: When attempting to deceive anyone who personally knew Princess Peach, you have disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks because the forgery is easily spotted by those with intimate knowledge of the royal court.

effectDetails.title: Duchy of the Bathroom
effectDetails.rules: While holding this scroll, you have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence plumbers or maintenance workers, specifically regarding the granting of titles or territory.

effectDetails.title: Luminous Autograph
effectDetails.rules: Wario's oversized signature emits a dim light in a 5-foot radius. This effect is purely cosmetic and cannot be suppressed.

a_scroll_claiming_to_be.levelRequirementReason: The item is a social utility tool and does not require high-level magical proficiency to use.
a_scroll_claiming_to_be.vendorReason: The Wario Land Historical Forgery Dept. is the primary source of these fraudulent historical documents.
a_scroll_claiming_to_be.shippingDetail: The package arrives with a 'Do Not Open' warning and smells faintly of grease.

usage.activation: Bonus Action (for Loyalty) or Passive (for Duchy/Forgery)
usage.duration: 1 hour for Loyalty effect
usage.endsWhen: The Loyalty effect ends after 1 hour or if the scroll is destroyed.

a_scroll_claiming_to_be.priceReason: Reduced from 5500 to 1000 to reflect its status as a common forgery rather than a legendary artifact.

a_scroll_that_holds_your.name: Mages' Guild Recipe Holder Scroll
a_scroll_that_holds_your.description: The Mages' Guild Recipe Holder Scroll is a sturdy, parchment-bound scroll crafted by Mages' Guild Scribes to organize complex culinary magic. It features enchanted ink that projects a booming, theatrical narration of any recipe stored within its pages.

effectDetails.title: Culinary Guidance
effectDetails.rules: While the scroll is active and you are performing a cooking check, you have advantage on the roll. The scroll can hold up to 10 unique recipes.

effectDetails.title: Dramatic Narration
effectDetails.rules: While the scroll is active, its booming voice is audible up to 60 feet. You have disadvantage on Stealth checks made while the scroll is being read aloud.

effectDetails.title: Pedantic Correction
effectDetails.rules: If you fail a cooking check while using the scroll, it provides a lecture. You may immediately reroll the check; you must use the new roll.

a_scroll_that_holds_your.levelRequirementReason: The item is a utility tool for crafting and does not possess high-level combat scaling.
a_scroll_that_holds_your.vendorReason: The Mages' Guild Scribes are the primary creators and distributors of this enchanted stationery.
a_scroll_that_holds_your.shippingDetail: Delivered via magical courier; arrives within 24 hours of order placement.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The user finishes the cooking task or chooses to silence the scroll.

a_scroll_that_holds_your.priceReason: Reduced from 10,500 XP to reflect a standard uncommon utility item price for a non-combat tool.

a_service_where_the_guild.name: Mages' Guild Spell Tome Copy
a_service_where_the_guild.description: The Mages' Guild Spell Tome Copy is a formal scribing service where a guild scribe meticulously transcribes a specific spell from the guild's vast library into your personal spellbook. This enchanted parchment service ensures the ink remains permanent and the arcane structure is preserved for future casting.

effectDetails.title: Spell Transcription
effectDetails.rules: Upon completion, you learn one 1st-level or 2nd-level spell of your choice from any class's spell list. You can cast this spell using your normal spellcasting ability and spell slots as if it were part of your original class list.

effectDetails.title: Guild Availability
effectDetails.rules: The spell provided is subject to the Mages' Guild library's current archives; the vendor determines the specific selection from the 1st and 2nd-level lists based on availability.

a_service_where_the_guild.levelRequirementReason: Characters must have enough experience to interact with guild bureaucracy and possess a spellbook.
a_service_where_the_guild.vendorReason: The Mages' Guild owns the library and provides the scribes for this service.
a_service_where_the_guild.shippingDetail: The finished spellbook is delivered via Courier Scribe within 24 hours of the request.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (after 24-hour transcription)
usage.endsWhen: The spell is permanently added to your spellbook.

a_service_where_the_guild.priceReason: Reduced from 5000 to 1000 to reflect a standard service fee for a single low-level spell.

a_shard_of_fractured_reality_1.name: Echo of the Void
a_shard_of_fractured_reality_1.description: This Echo of the Void is a jagged shard of fractured reality that hums with the whispers of the deceased. Recovered from the shadowed corners of the Atrium’s depths, the shard pulses with a cold, necromantic resonance.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Resonance
effectDetails.rules: While holding the shard, any undead creature you summon or command deals an additional 1d6 necrotic damage on each hit.

effectDetails.title: Echo of the Dead
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command a spectral whisper to strike a target within 60 feet. The target takes necrotic damage equal to your character level. You can use this ability once every 3 rounds.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Steal
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, roll a d20. On a natural 20, the target takes additional necrotic damage equal to 10% of its current hit point total.

a_shard_of_fractured_reality_1.levelRequirementReason: The shard's necrotic resonance requires a high enough spiritual fortitude to handle without being consumed.
a_shard_of_fractured_reality_1.vendorReason: The Atrium is the primary source of reality-fractured artifacts and necromantic debris.
a_shard_of_fractured_reality_1.shippingDetail: Shipped in a lead-lined container to prevent the whispers from escaping during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous/Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The shard is dropped or destroyed

a_shard_of_fractured_reality_1.priceReason: The price reflects its rare status and the significant utility it provides to necromancers.

a_sheriff_badge_for_lawmen.name: Wario's Wild West Badge
a_sheriff_badge_for_lawmen.description: Wario's Wild West Badge is a heavy, tarnished metal sheriff's star forged by the notorious Wario West. This badge serves as a symbol of authority for those seeking to impose their will on the frontier.

effectDetails.title: Sheriff's Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Intimidation) checks made against creatures that are aware of your role as a lawman.

effectDetails.title: Western Diplomacy
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made while interacting with NPCs in frontier towns or settlements.

effectDetails.title: Tarnished Shine
effectDetails.rules: Because the badge is poorly maintained, you have disadvantage on any Charisma (Performance) checks made to impress others with the badge's luster.

a_sheriff_badge_for_lawmen.levelRequirementReason: The item is a common utility badge and does not require high-level proficiencies.
a_sheriff_badge_for_lawmen.vendorReason: Wario West is the primary source of rugged frontier gear in this region.
a_sheriff_badge_for_lawmen.shippingDetail: Delivered via armored transport; arrives in 2 days.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The badge is discarded or lost.

a_sheriff_badge_for_lawmen.priceReason: Reduced from 4600 to reflect its common rarity and minor numerical bonuses.

a_shiny_plastic_card_it.name: Wario's Gold Membership
a_shiny_plastic_card_it.description: Wario's Gold Membership is a shiny plastic card featuring a bold, gold-embossed logo. This premium membership card serves as a testament to your extreme generosity toward Wario's personal treasury.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Favor
effectDetails.rules: While holding this card, you gain a unique dialogue option when interacting with Wario. You can use a Bonus Action to present the card, granting you a one-time advantage on a Charisma (Persuasion) check to request a favor or a discount from him.

effectDetails.title: Sticker of Completion
effectDetails.rules: Upon purchasing this item, you receive a physical 'Gold Member' sticker. This sticker provides no mechanical benefits but can be placed on your gear or shield as a permanent cosmetic mark.

a_shiny_plastic_card_it.levelRequirementReason: This is a cosmetic membership item accessible to all adventurers.
a_shiny_plastic_card_it.vendorReason: The item is sold directly by Wario as a premium status symbol.
a_shiny_plastic_card_it.shippingDetail: The card arrives in a heavy, gold-plated envelope that requires a Strength check of 10 to open.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The one-time favor is granted or the card is lost.

a_shiny_plastic_card_it.priceReason: The price was reduced from 250,000 to reflect a balanced cost for a cosmetic membership rather than a game-breaking penalty.

a_shiny_wand_that_beeps.name: Wario's Gold Detector Wand (Scam Alert!)
a_shiny_wand_that_beeps.description: Wario's Gold Detector Wand is a gaudy, gold-plated wand crafted in Wario's Shady Workshop. It emits a series of erratic beeps and vibrations intended to signal nearby riches, though its reliability is as questionable as its owner's ethics.

effectDetails.title: Unreliable Detection
effectDetails.rules: While holding the wand, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to locate hidden objects or treasure. However, if the wand detects a non-magical treasure, there is a 50% chance it instead points toward a pile of worthless dirt or common rocks.

effectDetails.title: Greedy Vibration
effectDetails.rules: When you use the wand to intimidate a creature within 30 feet, you can grant yourself a +1 bonus to the Charisma (Intimidation) check as the wand vibrates with Wario-style greed.

effectDetails.title: Shady Backfire
effectDetails.rules: If you roll a 1 on an attack roll or ability check while using the wand's detection property, it explodes in a cloud of fake gold dust. All creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

a_shiny_wand_that_beeps.levelRequirementReason: The item provides utility and minor bonuses suitable for early-game exploration.
a_shiny_wand_that_beeps.vendorReason: Wario's Shady Workshop is the primary source for these dubious, high-profit gadgets.
a_shiny_wand_that_beeps.shippingDetail: Delivered in a battered crate; may arrive with a 'Guaranteed Satisfaction (Not Really)' sticker.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wand is no longer held or the backfire triggers.

a_shiny_wand_that_beeps.priceReason: Reduced from 12,000 XP to reflect its unreliable nature and uncommon rarity.

a_silk_handkerchief_said_to.name: Peach's Ghostly Handkerchief
a_silk_handkerchief_said_to.description: This silk handkerchief was crafted by the Royal Wardrobe and carries the lingering, somber essence of the princess. As a spectral souvenir, it feels unnaturally cold to the touch and occasionally vibrates with a faint, mournful hum.

effectDetails.title: Soothing Wave
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can wave the handkerchief to calm one ally within 30 feet. The target succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) against being frightened. Once used, this effect cannot be used again until the next dawn.

effectDetails.title: Haunted Whispers
effectDetails.rules: While holding the handkerchief, you have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to discern secrets regarding royalty or high-born lineage.

effectDetails.title: Melancholy Aura
effectDetails.rules: The handkerchief's sadness causes you to have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against spirits or undead creatures.

a_silk_handkerchief_said_to.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for all levels as its effects are utility-based rather than power-scaling.
a_silk_handkerchief_said_to.vendorReason: The vendor acquires these items from the ruins of the princess's former estate.
a_silk_handkerchief_said_to.shippingDetail: The item is delivered via a phased delivery; it may appear in your inventory 1d4 hours after purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or Persistent
usage.endsWhen: The handkerchief's magic fades completely after 5 total uses of the Soothing Wave effect.

a_silk_handkerchief_said_to.priceReason: Adjusted to a standard uncommon price for a utility item with limited uses.

a_single_glove_from_the.name: Peach's Garden Glove
a_single_glove_from_the.description: This Peach's Garden Glove is a single, earth-stained gardening glove salvaged from the princess's private grounds. Crafted by the Royal Gardens, it still carries the faint scent of war-torn soil and blooming flora.

effectDetails.title: Botanical Affinity
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the glove, you have advantage on Wisdom (Nature) checks made to identify or interact with plant life.

effectDetails.title: Sentimental Burden
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against any gardener or druid who recognizes the glove as a royal relic.

effectDetails.title: Floral Distraction
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can cause minor illusory flowers to bloom in a 10-foot radius centered on yourself. For 1 minute, any creature that can see you must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be distracted, granting you advantage on the next attack roll made against them before the end of your next turn.

a_single_glove_from_the.levelRequirementReason: The item is common rarity and provides minor utility rather than significant combat power.
a_single_glove_from_the.vendorReason: Wario acquires discarded royal debris and sells it as 'vintage' loot.
a_single_glove_from_the.shippingDetail: Delivered in a moisture-sealed crate to prevent the soil from drying out.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Floral Distraction
usage.endsWhen: The Floral Distraction effect ends after one use or 1 minute; the glove loses all magical properties if it is soaked in blood or fire during combat.

a_single_glove_from_the.priceReason: Adjusted down from 4700 to reflect its common rarity and utility-based mechanics.

a_single_page_from_a.name: Mages' Guild Spellbook Page
a_single_page_from_a.description: This Mages' Guild Spellbook Page is a weathered scrap of vellum containing the precise arcane notations for a single cantrip. Crafted by the esteemed Mages' Guild, the ink still hums with a faint, residual magical resonance.

effectDetails.title: Cantrip Transcription
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can spend 1 hour studying this page to copy one cantrip of your choice from the Mages' Guild's repertoire into your spellbook. You must have a spellbook to perform this action, and you can only transcribe one cantrip from this specific page.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Resonance
effectDetails.rules: While the page is held in your hand, you gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Arcana) check made to identify a magic item or spell within 30 feet.

a_single_page_from_a.levelRequirementReason: Cantrips are foundational magic accessible to all aspiring spellcasters regardless of level.
a_single_page_from_a.vendorReason: The Mages' Guild Hall is the primary repository for academic magical materials and licensed spellbook components.
a_single_page_from_a.shippingDetail: Delivered in a wax-sealed tube to ensure the vellum remains dry and the ink does not smudge.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The page is transcribed into a spellbook or the resonance bonus is used once.
usage.charges: One-time use for transcription; one-time use for resonance.

a_single_page_from_a.priceReason: Reduced from 6500 to reflect a single cantrip's value while maintaining its status as a rare curiosity.

a_spray_bottle_of_concentrated.name: Wario's Garlic Breath Enhancer
a_spray_bottle_of_concentrated.description: Wario's Garlic Breath Enhancer is a small spray bottle filled with a pungent, concentrated garlic extract produced by Wario Land Pharmaceuticals. It is guaranteed to make a lasting impression, though it may leave your social life in tatters.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Breath Attack
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you spray the contents into the air. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 poison damage.

effectDetails.title: Repulsive Odor
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after use, you have disadvantage on all Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Deception) checks due to the overwhelming stench.

effectDetails.title: Vampiric Deterrent
effectDetails.rules: Any vampire or blood-sucking creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to use its reaction to move up to its speed away from you. This effect lasts for 1 round.

a_spray_bottle_of_concentrated.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for low-level use as the damage output is minimal and the social penalty is significant.
a_spray_bottle_of_concentrated.vendorReason: Wario Land Pharmaceuticals is the direct manufacturer of this pungent pharmaceutical product.
a_spray_bottle_of_concentrated.shippingDetail: The item is shipped in a sealed, airtight container to prevent the smell from overwhelming the courier.

usage.duration: 1 hour (odor effect)
usage.endsWhen: The spray bottle is emptied (3 uses total)

a_spray_bottle_of_concentrated.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a standard uncommon utility item price for a 5e-compatible experience.

a_sturdy_string_blessed_by_1.name: Gondor Ranger's Enchanted Bowstring
a_sturdy_string_blessed_by_1.description: The Gondor Ranger's Enchanted Bowstring is a thick, resilient cord of sinew blessed by the White Tree. This sturdy string hums with a faint, protective resonance when pulled, specifically designed for precision in the dense wilds.

effectDetails.title: Cover Penetration
effectDetails.rules: While attached to a longbow, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against targets using half cover. Additionally, your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover.

effectDetails.title: Forest Awareness
effectDetails.rules: While in a forest environment, you gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect hidden enemies or approaching foes.

effectDetails.title: Durability Limit
effectDetails.rules: The string frays after 50 shots; you must spend 1 minute using Ranger's Thread to repair it, or the string becomes unusable.

a_sturdy_string_blessed_by_1.levelRequirementReason: The previous level 5 requirement was removed to allow early-game rangers to access basic utility.
a_sturdy_string_blessed_by_1.vendorReason: As a staple of Gondorian archery, this item is a primary export of the kingdom's smiths.
a_sturdy_string_blessed_by_1.shippingDetail: Delivered via swift courier; arrives within 24 hours of order confirmation.

usage.duration: Permanent while equipped
usage.endsWhen: The string is destroyed or the user chooses to remove it.

a_sturdy_string_blessed_by_1.priceReason: Reduced from 14,500 XP to reflect an uncommon utility item rather than a legendary relic.

a_sword_forged_from_reclaimed_1.name: Ironclad Blade of the Forge
a_sword_forged_from_reclaimed_1.description: The Ironclad Blade of the Forge is a heavy longsword constructed from reclaimed industrial steel and enchanted with the wrath of the Iron Legion. Its edge glows with a dull orange heat, a lingering remnant from the last great smelting furnace.

effectDetails.title: Armor-Piercing Edge
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you deal an additional 1d6 slashing damage if the target is wearing heavy armor or has a natural Armor Class of 17 or higher.

effectDetails.title: Critical Strike Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls made with this magic weapon. Additionally, your critical hit range increases to 19-20.

effectDetails.title: Heavy Impact Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you are hit by a melee weapon attack from a creature using a Heavy weapon property, you gain 10 temporary hit points.

a_sword_forged_from_reclaimed_1.levelRequirementReason: The blade's enchanted weight and industrial power require a character of at least 5th level to wield effectively.
a_sword_forged_from_reclaimed_1.vendorReason: The Midlands region is the primary hub for industrial steel and salvaged military equipment.
a_sword_forged_from_reclaimed_1.shippingDetail: Shipped in a reinforced crate to prevent the blade's residual heat from melting standard packaging.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The item is destroyed or lost

a_sword_forged_from_reclaimed_1.priceReason: The price reflects the rare industrial materials and the high-tier 'Rare' rarity of the enchantment.

a_ticket_to_wario_s.name: Wario's Wonderland Ticket
a_ticket_to_wario_s.description: This Wario's Wonderland Ticket is a crinkled, grease-stained slip of paper produced by Wario Attractions. It grants the holder access to the 'backyard' tour, where the pungent scent of discarded loot lingers in the air.

effectDetails.title: Treasure in the Trash
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can present this ticket to a pile of refuse or a waste bin to search for 'treasure.' You find a small amount of loot equal to 1d20 gp in discarded items. This effect can be used only once per ticket.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Guidance
effectDetails.rules: While holding this ticket, you have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made specifically to interact with or trick Wario.

effectDetails.title: Expiring Validity
effectDetails.rules: If this ticket is not redeemed for the 'Treasure in the Trash' effect within 24 hours of acquisition, it loses its magic. While holding an expired ticket, you have disadvantage on all Charisma (Persuasion) checks made with NPCs who are not Wario.

a_ticket_to_wario_s.levelRequirementReason: The item is a common service ticket and does not require advanced character progression.
a_ticket_to_wario_s.vendorReason: This is the primary location for Wario's official backyard attractions.
a_ticket_to_wario_s.shippingDetail: Delivered via a slow-moving, slightly erratic walking courier.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The ticket is spent or expires after 24 hours.

a_ticket_to_wario_s.priceReason: Reduced from 4000 to reflect its status as a common, single-use service item.

a_tiny_metallic_key_that.name: Shadowfell Keychain
a_tiny_metallic_key_that.description: This Shadowfell Keychain is a tiny metallic key carved with the sigils of Onyx Hand vampires. Forged by a fallen priestess who traded her soul to the Shadowfell's heart, it hums with a cold, necrotic resonance.

effectDetails.title: Shadowfell Slip
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can turn ethereal and teleport up to 30 feet into an adjacent plane of existence (the Shadowfell). You remain in the Shadowfell for 1 minute or until you use this action again. You can use this property a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses at dawn.

effectDetails.title: Umbral Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While in dim light or darkness, you gain a +3 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Additionally, you can cast 'Pass Without Trace' once per long rest without expending a spell slot; the spell's DC is 15.

effectDetails.title: Sanity Drain
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you use the Shadowfell Slip property, you must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you take 2d6 psychic damage as your sanity is drained. This damage cannot be reduced in any way.

a_tiny_metallic_key_that.levelRequirementReason: The psychic strain of the Shadowfell's heart requires a high mental fortitude to wield safely.
a_tiny_metallic_key_that.vendorReason: The Edge specializes in illicit, high-rarity items from forbidden planes.
a_tiny_metallic_key_that.shippingDetail: Delivered via a clandestine, high-risk courier route that takes 3-5 days.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the user chooses to return to the Material Plane.

a_tiny_metallic_key_that.priceReason: The price reflects its Epic rarity and the high-risk, high-reward nature of Shadowfell travel.

a_token_of_bureaucratic_chaos.name: Gehenna Academy Keychain
a_token_of_bureaucratic_chaos.description: The Gehenna Academy Keychain is a jingling metal token of academic pride, forged by Skaven in the shadows of the academy. Its jagged edges and bureaucratic markings hum with a chaotic energy that favors the student over the administrator.

effectDetails.title: Administrative Immunity
effectDetails.rules: While holding the keychain, you have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to avoid administrative penalties, fines, or detention from authority figures.

effectDetails.title: Key-Finder's Luck
effectDetails.rules: When searching a room for a hidden object or key, you can roll a d20; on a result of 11 or higher, you automatically locate the object.

effectDetails.title: Bureaucratic Chaos
effectDetails.rules: After using the keychain's 'Key-Finder's Luck' property, roll a d6. On a 1, a random bureaucratic event occurs: a nearby door locks, a nearby light flickers out, or a nearby desk becomes cluttered with useless paperwork for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Student's Vitality
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the keychain as an item, you regain 1d6 hit points as a bonus action. You can use this property a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses after a Long Rest.

a_token_of_bureaucratic_chaos.levelRequirementReason: The item is designed for early-game exploration and social interaction.
a_token_of_bureaucratic_chaos.vendorReason: The vendor is the primary source for academic supplies and student-related trinkets.
a_token_of_bureaucratic_chaos.shippingDetail: Delivered via a clandestine drop-off point to avoid official academy oversight.

usage.activation: Bonus Action for Vitality; Passive for Immunity; Action for Key-Finder
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the daily uses are exhausted or the item is discarded.
usage.charges: Uses equal to Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest

a_token_of_bureaucratic_chaos.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect the uncommon rarity and the utility of multiple active effects.

a_tooth_from_the_koopa_1.name: Bowser's Fang Amulet
a_tooth_from_the_koopa_1.description: This Bowser's Fang Amulet features a jagged, yellowed tooth from a fallen Koopa King's soldier, strung onto a coarse leather cord. Crafted by the Battlefield Dentist, the necklace pulses with a faint, primal heat from the Koopa Troop's remains.

effectDetails.title: Koopa Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this amulet, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made against any Koopa Troop remnants or minions.

effectDetails.title: Fang Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a bite attack, the fang's power adds an extra 1d6 piercing damage to the strike. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Tremor Instability
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you roll a 1 on a d20 while wearing the amulet, the item becomes unstable. A 10-foot radius centered on you becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

a_tooth_from_the_koopa_1.levelRequirementReason: The item's offensive power and intimidation utility are balanced for mid-tier adventuring.
a_tooth_from_the_koopa_1.vendorReason: Wario's Souvenirs specializes in loot recovered from battlefield remains.
a_tooth_from_the_koopa_1.shippingDetail: Items are packed in heavy-duty crates to prevent the jagged fangs from puncturing the packaging.

usage.duration: Permanent (Amulet), Instantaneous (Strike/Tremor)
usage.endsWhen: Fang Strike resets on long rest; Tremor ends at start of next turn.
usage.charges: 1 use per long rest for Fang Strike

a_tooth_from_the_koopa_1.priceReason: Reduced from 5200 to 1000 to align with standard uncommon magic item market values.

a_toothpick_so_fancy_you.name: Wario's Gold-Plated Toothpick
a_toothpick_so_fancy_you.description: Wario's Gold-Plated Toothpick is a shimmering, ostentatious utensil forged by Wario Land Dental (Not a Real Dentist). This gold-plated toothpick is designed for the elite, though it carries a pungent, lingering aftertaste.

effectDetails.title: Fancy Lockpicking
effectDetails.rules: While using this toothpick as a lockpick, you have advantage on Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) checks. However, there is a 5% chance the toothpick snaps; if it snaps, the lock becomes jammed, imposing disadvantage on all future attempts to open that specific lock until repaired by a smith.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Breath
effectDetails.rules: After a successful lockpicking attempt, you must clean the toothpick with your mouth. You regain 1 hit point, but you have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Deception) checks for 10 minutes due to intense garlic breath.

effectDetails.title: Ostentatious Presence
effectDetails.rules: While holding the toothpick in your mouth or hand, wealthy NPCs (those with a wealth status of 'Rich' or higher) have advantage on Charisma checks made against you.

effectDetails.title: Brittle Snap
effectDetails.rules: If the toothpick snaps during a lockpicking attempt, it is destroyed and cannot be used again.

a_toothpick_so_fancy_you.levelRequirementReason: The item is a common utility tool and does not require high-level proficiency to wield.
a_toothpick_so_fancy_you.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in eccentric, high-status items from the Wario Land region.
a_toothpick_so_fancy_you.shippingDetail: Delivered in a velvet-lined pouch to ensure the gold plating remains untarnished.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Effect expires or toothpick snaps

a_toothpick_so_fancy_you.priceReason: Reduced from 9500 to reflect a common-rarity utility item with balanced risk-reward mechanics.

a_treasure_map_that_wario.name: Wario's 'Totally Legit' Treasure Map
a_treasure_map_that_wario.description: Wario's 'Totally Legit' Treasure Map is a crude piece of parchment drawn in thick, waxy crayons by Wario Land Cartography. While the map looks suspiciously amateur, the bold lines promise a hidden stash of loot.

effectDetails.title: Unreliable Navigation
effectDetails.rules: When you use the map to navigate to a new location, the DM rolls a d20. On a 1-10, the map leads to a trap; on an 11-20, it leads to a treasure cache. If a trap is triggered, it is a Wario-style prank that deals no damage but causes the party to lose 100 gp to a nearby 'thief' (Wario). If treasure is found, it contains 2d100 gp, but every coin features Wario's face, making them impossible to spend discreetly.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Inconvenience
effectDetails.rules: Because the map is drawn in crayon, any creature with a Passive Perception of 15 or higher can automatically succeed on a Wisdom (Perception) check to realize the map is a fake, though they cannot prevent the map's effects from occurring once used.

effectDetails.title: Embarrassing Loot
effectDetails.rules: Any gold coins obtained from this map cannot be used to purchase items from high-end merchants without the owner making a DC 12 Charisma (Persuasion) check to hide the coins' faces.

a_treasure_map_that_wario.levelRequirementReason: The item is an uncommon consumable/map and does not require high-level magic or physical feats to utilize.
a_treasure_map_that_wario.vendorReason: The vendor is the direct source of the map's questionable cartography.
a_treasure_map_that_wario.shippingDetail: The package arrives with a 'Do Not Open Until You're Desperate' warning and smells faintly of grease.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The map is used once to determine a location.

a_treasure_map_that_wario.priceReason: Reduced from 16,500 to reflect an uncommon item that provides a one-time navigation check rather than a permanent boon.

a_volatile_device_designed_for.name: Ink Jam Bomb
a_volatile_device_designed_for.description: The Ink Jam Bomb is a volatile, glass-cased device filled with pressurized, reactive pigment. Originally designed for chaotic disruption, this throwable orb leaves a sticky, blinding residue upon detonation.

effectDetails.title: Ink Blast Damage
effectDetails.rules: When the bomb hits a surface or creature, it explodes. Each creature within a 10-foot radius must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d4 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

effectDetails.title: Ink-Jamming Blight
effectDetails.rules: Any creature that fails the Dexterity saving throw is coated in ink. The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet and it cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Vision Distortion
effectDetails.rules: The target's vision is blurred by the ink. Until the end of its next turn, the target has disadvantage on Perception checks and ranged attack rolls.

effectDetails.title: Navy Ambush Chance
effectDetails.rules: On a successful hit against a creature, roll a d20. On a 1-10, a Koopa Navy ambush is triggered, requiring the DM to initiate a random encounter within 1d4 rounds.

a_volatile_device_designed_for.levelRequirementReason: The volatile nature of the device requires a character with enough experience to handle the explosive risk.
a_volatile_device_designed_for.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in high-risk, high-reward disruptive gadgets.
a_volatile_device_designed_for.shippingDetail: Delivered via aquatic courier; handled with extreme care to prevent premature detonation.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The bomb is destroyed upon impact.
usage.charges: Single use; the item is destroyed after one detonation.

a_volatile_device_designed_for.priceReason: Reduced slightly from 1200 to reflect a standard uncommon utility item price point.

a_wallet_that_holds_your.name: Wario's Wafting Wallet
a_wallet_that_holds_your.description: Wario's Wafting Wallet is a bulging leather pouch featuring a crude portrait of Wario on the front. Manufactured by Wario Land Banking (Unsecured), this item emits a pungent, lingering scent of garlic.

effectDetails.title: Weightless Hoard
effectDetails.rules: The wallet can hold up to 500 gp without adding any weight to your pack. However, at the end of each day, roll a d10; on a 1, the wallet 'wafts' away 1d10 gp of currency to an unknown location.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Aura
effectDetails.rules: While the wallet is on your person, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against thieves, who believe the item is cursed. This effect does not apply to non-hostile creatures.

effectDetails.title: Dishonest Visage
effectDetails.rules: Because of the prominent face on the front, you have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against honest commoners and officials.

a_wallet_that_holds_your.levelRequirementReason: The item is a utility accessory and does not require high-level proficiency to use.
a_wallet_that_holds_your.vendorReason: The item is branded by Wario Land Banking and is a staple of their unsecured inventory.
a_wallet_that_holds_your.shippingDetail: The wallet is delivered in a padded box to ensure the contents don't 'waft' out during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The wallet is destroyed or lost

a_wallet_that_holds_your.priceReason: Reduced from 5400 to 1000 to reflect its status as an uncommon utility item rather than a high-value magical artifact.

a_wallet_that_never_empties.name: Wario's Bottomless Wallet (Total Scam!)
a_wallet_that_never_empties.description: Wario's Bottomless Wallet (Total Scam!) is a bulging, oversized leather pouch from Wario's Scam Supreme. While it appears to overflow with heavy gold coins, the contents are actually cleverly painted rocks.

effectDetails.title: False Wealth
effectDetails.rules: While the wallet is held or displayed, you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to convince others that you possess significant riches.

effectDetails.title: The Great Scam
effectDetails.rules: If a creature uses an action to inspect the contents of the wallet or attempts to spend the coins, they realize the gold is fake. You immediately lose the ability to use the 'False Wealth' effect, and any 'gold' removed from the wallet is revealed as worthless stone.

effectDetails.title: Thief's Trap
effectDetails.rules: When a creature other than the owner attempts to forcibly snatch the wallet or open it against the owner's will, the wallet snaps shut. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or have their hand trapped inside. While trapped, the target takes 1d4 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can use an action to pull their hand free.

a_wallet_that_never_empties.levelRequirementReason: The item is a low-level prank/scam tool and does not require high-level magical proficiency.
a_wallet_that_never_empties.vendorReason: Wario's Scam Supreme is the primary source for high-quality fraudulent goods.
a_wallet_that_never_empties.shippingDetail: The item arrives in a package that feels suspiciously light for its size.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The scam is revealed by inspection

a_wallet_that_never_empties.priceReason: Reduced from 20,000 XP because the item is a fraudulent prop rather than a source of actual currency.

a_wand_of_wonders_mostly.name: Wario's Wonder Wand
a_wand_of_wonders_mostly.description: Wario's Wonder Wand is a chunky, oversized wand crafted by the eccentric Wario Wonders. This whimsical tool produces garlic-scented illusions and erratic sparks that make for a clumsy social experience.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Illusion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can cast the minor illusion cantrip. The visual and auditory effects must be themed around garlic or Wario's signature style. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Socially Awkward Sparks
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you attempt to persuade or deceive a creature, the wand emits a loud, flatulent spark. You have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Deception) checks made in polite or formal social settings.

effectDetails.title: Wonder Fan
effectDetails.rules: While you are actively using the wand to perform a trick or illusion, you gain a +1 bonus to any Charisma (Deception) check made to perform a sleight-of-hand maneuver.

effectDetails.title: Wario Wonders Craftsmanship
effectDetails.rules: This item is non-magical in its construction but possesses a permanent 'Wonder' property that prevents it from being dispelled by standard magic.

a_wand_of_wonders_mostly.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for low-level play as it provides minor utility rather than combat power.
a_wand_of_wonders_mostly.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in Wario's unique brand of whimsical and slightly absurd equipment.
a_wand_of_wonders_mostly.shippingDetail: Delivered in a box that occasionally releases a puff of garlic-scented smoke upon opening.

usage.activation: Action for illusions; Passive for social penalties
usage.duration: 1 minute for illusions
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed by the user or the illusion is naturally dispelled
usage.charges: 1 use of Garlic Illusion per long rest

a_wand_of_wonders_mostly.priceReason: Reduced from 5400 to 1000 to reflect its status as an uncommon utility item with social drawbacks.

a_wand_that_casts_wario.name: Wario's  Wand
a_wand_that_casts_wario.description: Wario's Wand is a stout, garlic-scented wooden rod crafted by the masters at Wario Wizardry. It pulses with a pungent, savory energy that resonates with the chaotic spirit of the garlic-loving hero.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Illusion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can cast the Minor Illusion spell to create the sound or appearance of a large clove of garlic. You can use this specific effect once per long rest. The spell follows standard casting rules with a DC of 12.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Presence
effectDetails.rules: While holding the wand, you gain advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made to cow or threaten enemies, as you radiate a boisterous, intimidating aura.

effectDetails.title: Pungent Backfire
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you cast a spell using the wand, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand backfires, causing you to reek of garlic for 1 hour; you have disadvantage on all Charisma (Persuasion) checks during this time.

a_wand_that_casts_wario.levelRequirementReason: The wand requires a level 5 character to safely channel the volatile garlic magic without being overwhelmed.
a_wand_that_casts_wario.vendorReason: This item is a signature product of the Wario Wizardry shop located in Wario Land.
a_wand_that_casts_wario.shippingDetail: Delivered via Magic Mist Mail; the pungent aroma may linger on the packaging for 24 hours.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The illusion ends naturally or is dispelled; the backfire ends after 1 hour.
usage.charges: 1 use per long rest for the illusion effect.

a_wand_that_casts_wario.priceReason: Adjusted to a standard uncommon price point to balance the Intimidation advantage against its social penalty.

a_wand_that_makes_wa.name: Wario's Wa-Wa Wand (Gimmick Toy!)
a_wand_that_makes_wa.description: Wario's Wa-Wa Wand is a crude, oversized toy wand manufactured in Wario's Toy Factory. When waved, it emits a ridiculous 'wa-wa' sound effect intended to serve as a distraction or a prank.

effectDetails.title: Distracting 'Wa-Wa'
