effectDetails.rules: As an action, you wave the wand to produce a loud 'wa-wa' sound in a 30-foot cone. For the next minute, any creature that can hear the sound has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to notice your presence or to track you.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Laugh
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can trigger a minor illusion of Wario laughing. Each creature of your choice within 15 feet that can hear the laugh must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Toy Factory Limitation
effectDetails.rules: The wand has 5 charges. Each use of 'Wario's Laugh' expends 1 charge. The wand does not regain charges unless it is returned to Wario's Toy Factory for a 'recharge' (unavailable to the player).

a_wand_that_makes_wa.levelRequirementReason: The item is common rarity and intended for early-game utility.
a_wand_that_makes_wa.vendorReason: This item is a signature product of Wario's own manufacturing line.
a_wand_that_makes_wa.shippingDetail: Delivered via a rickety wagon; may arrive with slight scuff marks from the road.

usage.duration: 1 minute for 'Wa-Wa'; Instantaneous for 'Laugh'
usage.endsWhen: The 'Wa-Wa' effect ends after 1 minute or if you are Incapacitated; the 'Laugh' ends when the duration expires.

a_wand_that_makes_wa.priceReason: Reduced from 8000 XP to reflect its common rarity and limited utility.

a_watch_that_tells_time.name: Wario's  Watch
a_watch_that_tells_time.description: Wario's Watch is a bulky, oversized timepiece featuring a prominent, grinning face of Wario on the dial. Crafted by Wario Timepieces, this heavy metal watch keeps perfect track of 'Wario time' and emits a loud, rhythmic beep every hour.

effectDetails.title: Precise Timing
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on any Initiative roll made at the start of combat as you perfectly time your first move.

effectDetails.title: Loud Hourly Beep
effectDetails.rules: At the top of every hour, the watch emits a piercing beep. While the beep is audible, you have disadvantage on Stealth checks made to remain hidden.

effectDetails.title: Collector's Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with a creature that collects watches, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made to cow them into submission using the watch's face.

a_watch_that_tells_time.levelRequirementReason: The item is common utility gear and does not require high-level proficiency to operate.
a_watch_that_tells_time.vendorReason: Wario Timepieces is a primary merchant in this region.
a_watch_that_tells_time.shippingDetail: This item arrives via Slow Delivery due to the heavy weight of the metal casing.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The watch is broken or destroyed

a_watch_that_tells_time.priceReason: The price was reduced from 4400 to reflect its common rarity and utility-based mechanics.

a_weapon_forged_from_condensed_16.name: Crystal Blade
a_weapon_forged_from_condensed_16.description: The Crystal Blade is a weapon forged from condensed magic that shimmers with arcane energy pulsing in time with the wielder’s heartbeat. Crafted by the Peach Loyalists, this blade leaves a trail of frost and fire in its wake as it reacts to the inner storms of a spellcaster.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon, the target takes an additional 2d6 force damage. This effect consumes 1 charge of arcane resonance per hit.

effectDetails.title: Wild Magic Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you roll a 1 on a d20 attack roll with this weapon, a surge of wild magic occurs. Roll on the Wild Magic Surge table; the effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Overcharged Edge
effectDetails.rules: After the weapon has consumed 3 charges of arcane resonance without recharging, the blade glows red. For 1 minute, the weapon deals an additional 1d6 damage to any creature with elemental resistance. This effect ends after 1 minute or when the blade's glow fades.

a_weapon_forged_from_condensed_16.levelRequirementReason: The blade requires the mental fortitude of a mid-level spellcaster to harmonize with its volatile arcane pulse.
a_weapon_forged_from_condensed_16.vendorReason: Teyvat is a primary hub for high-quality arcane artifacts and enchanted weaponry.
a_weapon_forged_from_condensed_16.shippingDetail: Items are delivered via heavy-duty transport; expect a 2-day delivery window for fragile crystalline blades.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The weapon's charges are depleted or the Overcharged Edge duration expires.

a_weapon_forged_from_condensed_16.priceReason: The price reflects its rare crafting origin and the significant 2d6 damage scaling.

a_weaponized_chainsaw_from_the_1.name: Chain Chomp Tether
a_weaponized_chainsaw_from_the_1.description: The Chain Chomp Tether is a jagged, motorized chainsaw forged by Team Rocket to bind and rend the void’s most brutal creatures. Its teeth are perpetually coated in a shimmering, oily residue from the void, allowing it to bite into reality itself.

effectDetails.title: Void-Saw Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon, it deals an additional 3d8 slashing damage.

effectDetails.title: Chainsaw Burst
effectDetails.rules: On a hit, roll a d4; on a 1, the saw emits a violent burst. All enemies within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 slashing damage.

effectDetails.title: Void Magnetism
effectDetails.rules: Whenever the Chainsaw Burst triggers, you gain disadvantage on movement toward non-void creatures for 1 minute as your body becomes temporarily magnetized to void matter.

effectDetails.title: Operator Synergy
effectDetails.rules: While you are within 30 feet of a Chain Chomp entity, you gain a +2 bonus to all melee attack rolls. This effect ends if you move more than 30 feet away from the entity.

a_weaponized_chainsaw_from_the_1.levelRequirementReason: The item's high damage output and specific entity requirements necessitate a high-level character capable of handling void-touched weaponry.
a_weaponized_chainsaw_from_the_1.vendorReason: The Edge specializes in high-tier, dangerous equipment suitable for elite adventurers.
a_weaponized_chainsaw_from_the_1.shippingDetail: Items are delivered via localized spatial folds to ensure the chainsaw's motor remains primed for use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The bonus ends when moving away from a Chain Chomp; Magnetism ends after 1 minute.

a_weaponized_chainsaw_from_the_1.priceReason: The price reflects its Epic rarity and the specialized Team Rocket craftsmanship required for void-weaponry.

a_wrench_for_fixing_or.name: Wario's  Wrench
a_wrench_for_fixing_or.description: Wario's Wrench is a heavy-duty, oversized steel wrench forged by Wario Tools to handle the most stubborn repairs or demolitions. Its rugged construction is built for brute force, though its weight can be cumbersome for the unpracticed.

effectDetails.title: Master Tinker's Advantage
effectDetails.rules: While holding this wrench, you have advantage on all Intelligence (Tinker's Tools) checks made to repair or dismantle mechanical objects.

effectDetails.title: Inventor's Charisma
effectDetails.rules: While the wrench is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made when interacting with inventors or engineers.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Slip
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you use the wrench to perform a repair or demolition action, roll a d10. On a 1, the wrench slips, dealing 1 point of piercing damage to you.

a_wrench_for_fixing_or.levelRequirementReason: The item is common equipment and does not require significant magical power to operate.
a_wrench_for_fixing_or.vendorReason: The Wario Land shop specializes in heavy-duty tools and construction equipment.
a_wrench_for_fixing_or.shippingDetail: Shipped in a reinforced crate to prevent the heavy steel from shifting during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The wrench is sold, lost, or destroyed

a_wrench_for_fixing_or.priceReason: Reduced from 5000 to align with common utility tool pricing while maintaining its unique mechanical benefits.

aboleth_mindscape_sanitizer.name: Aboleth Mindscape Sanitization
aboleth_mindscape_sanitizer.description: This Aboleth Mindscape Sanitization is a psionic cleansing service provided by the Illithid Sanitation Crew. It functions as a mental scouring of the psyche, physically purging a single traumatic memory or mind-affecting curse from your consciousness.

effectDetails.title: Memory Purge
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you undergo a psionic cleansing. You choose one specific traumatic memory or one ongoing mind-affecting curse (such as those from a Feebleminded or Dominate Monster spell). The chosen memory is erased or the curse is instantly dispelled, ending its effects on you.

effectDetails.title: Targeted Immunity
effectDetails.rules: For 1 year, you gain immunity to the specific source of the removed memory or the specific spell effect that caused the curse. This immunity is lost if you are subjected to a 9th-level spell that specifically targets your mind.

aboleth_mindscape_sanitizer.levelRequirementReason: The mental fortitude required to survive an Illithid psionic scrubbing is only attainable by high-level adventurers.
aboleth_mindscape_sanitizer.vendorReason: The Mind Cleaners specialize in delicate psionic maintenance and memory management.
aboleth_mindscape_sanitizer.shippingDetail: The service is delivered via a direct neural handshake; no physical delivery is required.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect is consumed upon use and the immunity expires after 1 year.

aboleth_mindscape_sanitizer.priceReason: Reduced from the original price to reflect a balanced high-tier service cost for a single-use psionic cleanse.

absolute_defense_shield.name: Absolute Defense Shield
absolute_defense_shield.description: The Absolute Defense Shield is a massive, matte-grey bulwark forged by The Unbreakable Wall. This heavy plate of enchanted metal is designed to anchor the wielder against the most violent of metaphysical and physical assaults.

effectDetails.title: Damage Negation
effectDetails.rules: While wielding this shield, you have resistance to all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-magical attacks, and you take half damage from magical attacks.

effectDetails.title: Targeting Immunity
effectDetails.rules: You cannot be targeted by spells or abilities that require a creature to be 'tracked' or 'selected' by a hostile entity, such as Telekinesis or Hold Monster, as long as you remain within 30 feet of your current position.

effectDetails.title: Narrative Anchor
effectDetails.rules: You are immune to forced movement and effects that would displace your physical form, such as being pushed, pulled, or teleported against your will.

absolute_defense_shield.levelRequirementReason: Removed the level 95 gate to allow for balanced high-tier play while maintaining its defensive utility.
absolute_defense_shield.vendorReason: The fortress specializes in defensive fortifications and immovable structures.
absolute_defense_shield.shippingDetail: The item is delivered by a slow-moving, literal mountain of stone that takes 1d4 days to arrive.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The shield is dropped or destroyed by a critical hit from a deity-level entity.

absolute_defense_shield.priceReason: The price was reduced from an impossible amount to a standard high-rarity gold/XP equivalent for a powerful defensive tool.

absolute_zero_frozen_core.name: Absolute Zero Frozen Core
absolute_zero_frozen_core.description: The Absolute Zero Frozen Core is a pulsating sphere of crystalline frost forged by The Ice That Never Thaws. It hums with a chilling resonance that threatens to lock the very flow of causality into a permanent winter.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Stasis Field
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you shatter the core to create a 1-mile radius of frozen time. All creatures and objects within the area are paralyzed and unable to take actions or move unless they are the user of the core. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The area is unaffected by other spells or magical effects.

effectDetails.title: Kinetic Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: While the Temporal Stasis Field is active, you can move any object or creature within the radius as a bonus action. However, any creature moved this way reverts to its original position and state the moment you leave the 1-mile radius or the effect ends.

absolute_zero_frozen_core.levelRequirementReason: The sheer magnitude of altering a 1-mile radius of reality requires extreme mastery of high-level magic.
absolute_zero_frozen_core.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in artifacts of absolute stasis and eternal frost.
absolute_zero_frozen_core.shippingDetail: The item is delivered in a vacuum-sealed container to prevent it from freezing the courier's transport.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the user voluntarily dismisses the effect.
usage.charges: Single use; the core is destroyed upon activation.

absolute_zero_frozen_core.priceReason: Adjusted from the original value to reflect a high-tier legendary consumable while remaining within a playable economy.

abydos_high_school_bento_box_set.name: Abydos High School Bento Box Set
abydos_high_school_bento_box_set.description: The Abydos High School Bento Box Set consists of several compartmentalized containers crafted by the School Crafters. These durable boxes feature a distinct bell-shaped timer and are designed to keep meals organized and secure during long travels.

effectDetails.title: Culinary Organization
effectDetails.rules: While holding this set, you gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to identify ingredients or recall complex school recipes.

effectDetails.title: Hermetic Seal
effectDetails.rules: When a container is closed, it is airtight; food remains fresh for 24 hours and is protected from external odors or minor environmental contaminants.

effectDetails.title: Audible Timer
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can set the bell-shaped timer to ring at a specific interval; it emits a loud 'ding' at the designated time, regardless of distance (up to 60 feet).

abydos_high_school_bento_box_set.levelRequirementReason: This is a common utility item and does not require high-level proficiency.
abydos_high_school_bento_box_set.vendorReason: The item is produced by the local School Crafters on campus.
abydos_high_school_bento_box_set.shippingDetail: Shipped in insulated packaging to ensure the containers remain pristine.

usage.duration: Permanent/Variable
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the boxes are destroyed or the timer is reset.

abydos_high_school_bento_box_set.priceReason: Reduced from 6000 to reflect a standard uncommon utility item price point.

abydos_high_school_blazer.name: Abydos High School Blazer
abydos_high_school_blazer.description: This Abydos High School Blazer is a crisp, navy-blue garment tailored by the High School Tailors. The fabric is durable enough for youthful adventures while maintaining a scholarly aesthetic.

effectDetails.title: Academic Aptitude
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the blazer, you gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence (History) and Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to recall academic facts or lore.

effectDetails.title: Inspirational Study
effectDetails.rules: When you succeed on a Wisdom (Insight) check to recall a specific piece of lore, you can choose to have advantage on the next Intelligence check you make within the next 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Uniform Violation
effectDetails.rules: If you attempt to perform a profane, illegal, or highly aggressive action while wearing the blazer, the DM may require you to make a DC 12 Charisma (Persuasion) check to avoid a 'Uniform Violation' penalty, such as a social complication or a loss of reputation with local authorities.

abydos_high_school_blazer.levelRequirementReason: The original level 5 requirement was removed to allow early-game students to access basic academic benefits.
abydos_high_school_blazer.vendorReason: The blazer is a standard garment sold directly by the campus student services.
abydos_high_school_blazer.shippingDetail: Delivered via Buttoned Badge courier with a standard 2-day transit time.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: The blazer is removed or destroyed

abydos_high_school_blazer.priceReason: Reduced from 11,500 XP to reflect a standard uncommon academic garment.

abydos_high_school_lunch_bento_recipe.name: Recipe: Abydos High School Lunch Bento
abydos_high_school_lunch_bento_recipe.description: This Recipe: Abydos High School Lunch Bento provides instructions for creating a balanced meal designed to bolster student stamina. Originally crafted by the School Cafeteria, the recipe ensures every bite is packed neatly for maximum efficiency.

effectDetails.title: Culinary Mastery
effectDetails.rules: By spending 15 minutes and a supply of Rice and veggies, you can use this recipe to prepare a Bento. This action allows you to create one meal that provides the benefits of the 'Focused Study' effect.

effectDetails.title: Focused Study
effectDetails.rules: While you are consuming the Bento during a period of study, you gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence checks. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until you finish the meal, whichever comes first.

abydos_high_school_lunch_bento_recipe.levelRequirementReason: A basic recipe for student meals does not require high-level proficiency.
abydos_high_school_lunch_bento_recipe.vendorReason: The campus is the primary location where the school cafeteria operates.
abydos_high_school_lunch_bento_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered in a specialized insulated container to maintain food temperature.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The meal is finished or the study period ends

abydos_high_school_lunch_bento_recipe.priceReason: Adjusted from 6000 to reflect a standard utility recipe rather than a rare magical artifact.

abydos_high_school_uniform_premium.name: Abydos High School Uniform
abydos_high_school_uniform_premium.description: The Abydos High School Uniform is a crisp, formal garment crafted by the School Tailors to project an image of academic excellence. This blazer and skirt set features high-quality fabric intended to help the wearer secure discounts and favor from scholarly institutions.

effectDetails.title: Scholarly Favor
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the uniform, you gain a +2 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against scholars or academic officials.

effectDetails.title: Academic Insight
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Intelligence (History) checks made to identify historical facts or academic lore.

effectDetails.title: Wrinkle Penalty
effectDetails.rules: If you take more than 5 points of bludgeoning or slashing damage, the uniform becomes wrinkled; you lose all benefits of the uniform until you spend 1 minute using a mending kit or a Prestidigitation cantrip to smooth the fabric.

abydos_high_school_uniform_premium.levelRequirementReason: The item is a non-magical social garment and does not require high-level proficiency to utilize.
abydos_high_school_uniform_premium.vendorReason: This is the official attire provided by the school's campus administration.
abydos_high_school_uniform_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered directly to the student's assigned locker with a 24-hour turnaround.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: Removing the garment or if it becomes heavily wrinkled

abydos_high_school_uniform_premium.priceReason: Adjusted to a standard uncommon price for a high-quality social garment.

abydos_high_spirit_duel_practice.name: Abydos High Spirit Duel Practice (Again)
abydos_high_spirit_duel_practice.description: The Abydos High Spirit Duel Practice is a ritualistic sparring session provided by the Abydos High Duel Club. You engage in a spectral combat against a manifested ghost to hone your martial prowess.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Duel Outcome
effectDetails.rules: Upon completion of the duel, roll a d20. On a 11-20 (Win), you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls for 24 hours. On a 1-9 (Loss), you suffer disadvantage on all ability checks for 24 hours as the spirit haunts you. On a 10 (Draw), the spirit becomes an ally, granting you advantage on one ability check of your choice within the next 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Lingering
effectDetails.rules: The effects of the duel are instantaneous upon the conclusion of the practice and last for 24 hours or until the end of the next long rest, whichever comes first.

abydos_high_spirit_duel_practice.levelRequirementReason: The spiritual intensity of the Abydos High Duel Club requires a character of at least 5th level to maintain their physical form.
abydos_high_spirit_duel_practice.vendorReason: The Abydos High Duel Club is the primary authority on spectral combat training.
abydos_high_spirit_duel_practice.shippingDetail: The practice is delivered via a localized ethereal rift; it arrives instantly but requires a clear line of sight.

usage.duration: 24 hours
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the user finishes a long rest.

abydos_high_spirit_duel_practice.priceReason: Adjusted to a standard gold-equivalent XP value for a mid-tier uncommon service.

abyssal_court_deep_abyss_soup_recipe.name: Recipe: Abyssal Court Deep Abyss Soup
abyssal_court_deep_abyss_soup_recipe.description: The Recipe: Abyssal Court Deep Abyss Soup provides instructions for a thick, inky broth crafted by the Court Chefs. This culinary guide details how to simmer deep-sea items like Inkfish and squidgy morsels to create a meal that grants unnatural resilience.

effectDetails.title: Abyssal Culinary Knowledge
effectDetails.rules: Upon reading this recipe, you learn how to cook a meal that grants benefits to those who consume it. You can prepare this soup in 50 minutes using Inkfish and other deep-sea ingredients. You can prepare a number of servings equal to the amount of ingredients used.

effectDetails.title: Deep-Sea Physiology
effectDetails.rules: A creature that consumes a bowl of this soup gains the ability to breathe underwater and gains resistance to cold damage. This effect lasts for 2 hours or until the creature dies. This effect does not stack.

abyssal_court_deep_abyss_soup_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of handling abyssal ingredients requires a high level of culinary expertise.
abyssal_court_deep_abyss_soup_recipe.vendorReason: The Court Chefs of the depths are the primary authors of this specific recipe.
abyssal_court_deep_abyss_soup_recipe.shippingDetail: The recipe is delivered in a waterproof, oil-sealed parchment to prevent ink smudging.

usage.duration: 2 hours
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires, the creature dies, or the creature falls unconscious.
usage.charges: Unlimited (can be cooked as many times as ingredients allow)

abyssal_court_deep_abyss_soup_recipe.priceReason: The high price reflects the rarity of the Court Chefs' secret techniques and the value of the knowledge provided.

abyssal_court_deep_sea_trench_coat.name: Abyssal Court Deep Sea Trench Coat
abyssal_court_deep_sea_trench_coat.description: The Abyssal Court Deep Sea Trench Coat is a heavy, waterproof garment crafted by the Abyssal Seamstresses. Its salt-crusted fabric is designed to withstand the crushing pressures of the ocean floor, though it perpetually drips brine when worn on land.

effectDetails.title: Pressure Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this coat, you have advantage on all Constitution saving throws made to resist pressure-based environmental hazards or damage while underwater.

effectDetails.title: Abyssal Respiration
effectDetails.rules: You can breathe underwater for a duration of 1 hour. You can use this property once per long rest; it regains its use after you finish a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Brine Leakage
effectDetails.rules: While on land, the coat drips constantly, making it impossible to take the Stealth action without disadvantage unless you use an action to wring out the garment.

abyssal_court_deep_sea_trench_coat.levelRequirementReason: The coat's heavy materials and magical properties require a character of significant physical fortitude to wear.
abyssal_court_deep_sea_trench_coat.vendorReason: The Abyssal Court is the primary source of garments designed for high-pressure aquatic environments.
abyssal_court_deep_sea_trench_coat.shippingDetail: Delivered in a pressurized, moisture-sealed crate to prevent the coat from soaking the surrounding cargo.

usage.duration: 1 hour (Respiration)
usage.endsWhen: The respiration duration expires or the wearer finishes a long rest.

abyssal_court_deep_sea_trench_coat.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect a rare, high-utility item for mid-level adventurers while maintaining the original gold-to-XP ratio.

abyssal_court_ink_dipper.name: Abyssal Court Ink Dipper
abyssal_court_ink_dipper.description: Crafted by the Abyssal Potters, this sturdy ceramic dipper is designed for scooping heavy abyssal soup broth. Its surface is treated with a special coating to remain ink-resistant even in the most volatile kitchens.

effectDetails.title: Steady Scooping
effectDetails.rules: While holding this dipper to cook or serve food, you gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to prevent spilling liquids or handling delicate ingredients.

effectDetails.title: Ink Squirter
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet of you makes a melee attack against you, you can squirt a glob of concentrated abyssal ink at them. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.

abyssal_court_ink_dipper.levelRequirementReason: The item is a utility tool and does not require high-level magical proficiency to operate.
abyssal_court_ink_dipper.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in culinary equipment sourced from the deeper abyssal realms.
abyssal_court_ink_dipper.shippingDetail: Delivered via pressurized bubbles to ensure the broth remains at a constant simmer during transit.

usage.activation: Passive for Steady Scooping; Reaction for Ink Squirter
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The Ink Squirter effect ends when the target completes its next turn.

abyssal_court_ink_dipper.priceReason: The price was reduced from 7000 to reflect its status as a common culinary tool rather than a high-tier artifact.

abyssal_court_tentacle_whip_premium.name: Abyssal Court Tentacle Whip (Premium)
abyssal_court_tentacle_whip_premium.description: The Abyssal Court Tentacle Whip is a wet, pulsing lash of muscle and suction cups crafted by the Abyssal Lashers. This organic weapon leaves a trail of viscous slime and feels unnaturally heavy in the hand.

effectDetails.title: Extended Reach & Grapple
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack using this whip, the reach is increased to 10 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be Grappled by the tentacle.

effectDetails.title: Slime Entrapment
effectDetails.rules: A creature currently Grappled by this whip has disadvantage on all ability checks and saving throws made to escape the grapple.

effectDetails.title: Abyssal Pull
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can attempt to pull a creature Grappled by the whip up to 5 feet toward you. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw to resist the movement.

abyssal_court_tentacle_whip_premium.levelRequirementReason: The whip's reach and grappling mechanics are balanced for mid-tier play.
abyssal_court_tentacle_whip_premium.vendorReason: This item originates from the Abyssal Court and is naturally sold in the depths.
abyssal_court_tentacle_whip_premium.shippingDetail: The shipment arrives wet and requires a salt-wash before first use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The grapple is broken or the target is freed

abyssal_court_tentacle_whip_premium.priceReason: The price reflects the rare organic material and the specialized craftsmanship of the Abyssal Lashers.

abyssal_layer_claim.name: Abyssal Layer Claim (Unoccupied)
abyssal_layer_claim.description: This Abyssal Layer Claim is a scorched, pulsating deed of ownership to a 10-mile radius territory within the Abyss. Hand-stamped by Demogorgon's Realtor, the parchment smells of sulfur and holds the weight of sovereign authority.

effectDetails.title: Territorial Sovereignty
effectDetails.rules: While holding this deed, you claim ownership of a specific 10-mile radius layer of the Abyss. You can establish a permanent base of operations here; any creature attempting to enter this area against your will must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be repelled by planar instability.

effectDetails.title: Demonic Authority
effectDetails.rules: Demons within your 10-mile territory are drawn to your presence but are compelled to recognize your status. When a demon initiates combat against you within this territory, it must first succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to act non-hostile for 1 minute. This effect does not apply to other planar beings.

abyssal_layer_claim.levelRequirementReason: Owning a piece of the Abyss is a feat reserved for those of legendary status.
abyssal_layer_claim.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in the sale of high-level planar real estate and deeds.
abyssal_layer_claim.shippingDetail: The deed arrives via a rift; the courier may cause minor property damage during delivery.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The deed is destroyed or surrendered to a higher planar power.

abyssal_layer_claim.priceReason: The price is reduced from the original amount to reflect a balanced, yet still high-tier, legendary investment.

abyssal_shadow_cloak.name: Abyssal Shadow Cloak (Enchanted)
abyssal_shadow_cloak.description: The Abyssal Shadow Cloak is a heavy, midnight-blue garment woven from the literal essence of the Abyss by the Abyssal Weavers. It feels cold to the touch and seems to drink in the light around it, making the wearer appear like a flickering smudge in the dark.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can cause the cloak to shroud your body. While you are in dim light or darkness, you become invisible to any creature that can see you. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until you take damage, teleport, or use a magical effect that alters your appearance. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Scrying Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the cloak, you have advantage on saving throws against effects that would sense your location through divination magic or scrying spells. This resistance is constant as long as the cloak is worn.

abyssal_shadow_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's connection to the Abyss is too volatile for anyone below 17th level to control safely.
abyssal_shadow_cloak.vendorReason: The void_merchant specializes in artifacts originating from extraplanar abyssal realms.
abyssal_shadow_cloak.shippingDetail: The item is delivered via a rift; the recipient must be at a known location to receive it safely.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage, teleporting, or ending the 1-hour duration

abyssal_shadow_cloak.priceReason: Reduced from the original amount to align with standard legendary item gold-to-XP conversion scales.

accordion_of_autumn.name: Accordion of Autumn
accordion_of_autumn.description: The Accordion of Autumn is a weathered wooden squeezebox that emits a melancholic melody. When played, it causes orange and gold leaves to swirl in the air, evoking a deep sense of nostalgia.

effectDetails.title: Swirling Leaves
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you play a melody that creates a 20-foot-radius area of swirling leaves. For 1 minute, any creature of your choice within the area gains a +2 bonus to Stealth checks. This effect ends if you stop playing or the area is dispelled.

effectDetails.title: Entropic Hum
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can play a low, vibrating note that emits an entropic hum. Each hostile creature within 30 feet that can hear you must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be Charmed until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Dizzying Polka
effectDetails.rules: If you use the Accordion to play a fast-paced Polka, each creature within 10 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be Incapacitated by dizziness until the end of its next turn.

accordion_of_autumn.levelRequirementReason: The item's magical nature requires a basic understanding of musical magic.
accordion_of_autumn.vendorReason: A traveling merchant specializes in seasonal curiosities and folk instruments.
accordion_of_autumn.shippingDetail: Wrapped in soft wool to prevent the bellows from creasing during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The player stops playing the music or the duration expires.

accordion_of_autumn.priceReason: Reduced from 8000 to align with standard Rare curiosity pricing for a non-combat utility item.

aetherial_phoenix_down.name: Aetherial Phoenix Down (Single Use)
aetherial_phoenix_down.description: This Aetherial Phoenix Down is a crystallized phoenix feather forged by the Pyres of Elysium. It pulses with a faint, searing heat, designed to incinerate the finality of death.

effectDetails.title: Aetherial Resurrection
effectDetails.rules: When the user drops to 0 hit points and dies, this item triggers automatically. The user is resurrected at the start of their next turn 24 hours later at the location of their death, with all hit points restored and no loss of experience. The user retains all levels and class features.

effectDetails.title: Equipment Incineration
effectDetails.rules: Upon triggering the resurrection, the Aetherial Phoenix Down is consumed. All non-soulbound equipment, weapons, and armor currently worn or carried by the user are destroyed as they are reduced to ash by the phoenix flame.

aetherial_phoenix_down.levelRequirementReason: The high-tier nature of legendary resurrection mechanics requires a character of significant power.
aetherial_phoenix_down.vendorReason: The Phoenix Roost is the primary sanctuary for avian artifacts and celestial feathers.
aetherial_phoenix_down.shippingDetail: Delivered via celestial rift; the item must be kept in a lead-lined container to prevent premature ignition.

usage.duration: 24 hours
usage.endsWhen: The item is consumed upon use

aetherial_phoenix_down.priceReason: The price reflects the extreme rarity of a guaranteed, high-level resurrection without level loss.

african_union_mask_dance_lesson_premium.name: African Union Mask Dance Lesson (Premium)
african_union_mask_dance_lesson_premium.description: The African Union Mask Dance Lesson is a rhythmic ritual sequence taught by the Union Dancers to commune with the unseen. This premium instructional scroll features intricate footwork and spirit-calling chants meant to bridge the gap between worlds.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Charm
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you perform the ritual dance. Choose one spirit or ethereal creature within 30 feet; it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be Charmed by you for 1 minute. The effect ends if the creature takes damage or if you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Rhythmic Mastery
effectDetails.rules: While performing a Performance check related to dance or ritual, you gain a +2 bonus to the roll. This bonus applies only to checks made while actively dancing.

effectDetails.title: Exhaustion Penalty
effectDetails.rules: After using the Spirit Charm effect, you must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion. This effect can only be negated by completing a long rest.

african_union_mask_dance_lesson_premium.levelRequirementReason: The complex spiritual resonance of the Union Dancers' movements requires a high degree of poise and magical sensitivity.
african_union_mask_dance_lesson_premium.vendorReason: The village is the primary home of the Union Dancers who authored these lessons.
african_union_mask_dance_lesson_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered in a reinforced wooden crate to ensure the sacred scrolls remain dry and uncreased.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires, the target succeeds on a save, or the user is incapacitated.

african_union_mask_dance_lesson_premium.priceReason: The high XP cost reflects the premium nature of the sacred knowledge and the rarity of the Union Dancers' lineage.

african_union_tribal_beaded_vest.name: African Union Tribal Beaded Vest
african_union_tribal_beaded_vest.description: This African Union Tribal Beaded Vest is a vibrant garment adorned with intricate, multi-colored beads used in sacred rituals. Hand-crafted by Union Artisans, the beads produce a distinct rhythmic rattle when the wearer moves.

effectDetails.title: Rhythmic Performance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the vest, you have advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks made to perform tribal dances or rhythmic music.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Warding
effectDetails.rules: While the vest is worn, you have advantage on saving throws against being Frightened as the beads rattle to ward off spirits.

effectDetails.title: Fragile Ornamentation
effectDetails.rules: If the vest falls to the ground or is dropped, the beads shatter; the vest loses its Spirit Warding property and requires a long rest to repair with artisan tools.

african_union_tribal_beaded_vest.levelRequirementReason: The original level 6 requirement was removed to allow for earlier cultural expression while maintaining the rare rarity.
african_union_tribal_beaded_vest.vendorReason: The village is the primary hub for Union Artisans and tribal ceremonial goods.
african_union_tribal_beaded_vest.shippingDetail: Shipped in a padded pouch to prevent the beads from rattling against other cargo.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: The vest is removed or the beads are shattered by being dropped.

african_union_tribal_beaded_vest.priceReason: Reduced from 16,500 to 1,000 to align with standard Rare equipment costs for non-magical items with minor utility.

african_union_tribal_grain_mill.name: African Union Tribal Grain Mill
african_union_tribal_grain_mill.description: This African Union Tribal Grain Mill is a heavy, hand-turned stone mill crafted by the Union Stonecarvers for processing communal porridge grains. The smooth, weathered stones are designed to grind large quantities of grain efficiently while maintaining a steady, rhythmic pace.

effectDetails.title: Communal Batch Bonus
effectDetails.rules: While using this mill to prepare food, the group gains a +1 bonus to any Difficulty Class (DC) checks made to cook communal meals or rations.

effectDetails.title: Tribal Rhythm
effectDetails.rules: If a creature performs a Performance check (Music) or a group sings in rhythm while operating the mill, the processing speed of the grain is doubled for the duration of the performance.

effectDetails.title: Stone Wear
effectDetails.rules: The mill's stones wear smooth over time; after 1,000 units of grain are processed, the mill requires a long rest to be sharpened or it provides no bonuses.

african_union_tribal_grain_mill.levelRequirementReason: The item is a non-magical piece of equipment and does not require a high character level to operate.
african_union_tribal_grain_mill.vendorReason: The village is the primary source of tribal goods and stone-carved tools.
african_union_tribal_grain_mill.shippingDetail: Requires heavy-duty transport; shipping takes 3 days and costs extra for weight.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: When the grain is fully processed or the user finishes their action

african_union_tribal_grain_mill.priceReason: Reduced from 6500 to reflect a standard uncommon utility item price for a village setting.

african_union_tribal_grain_porridge_reci.name: Recipe: African Union Tribal Grain Porridge
african_union_tribal_grain_porridge_reci.description: This weathered parchment contains the Recipe: African Union Tribal Grain Porridge, a culinary secret passed down by Village Elders. It details how to prepare a hearty meal from ancient grains meant to foster communal strength and tribal unity.

effectDetails.title: Tribal Bond
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the porridge, all creatures who ate from the shared meal gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws for 4 hours. This effect ends early if the creature finishes a long rest or if the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Shared Meal
effectDetails.rules: To activate this recipe, a creature must spend 30 minutes using their action to cook the grains. The porridge must be shared among a group of 3 or more creatures; each creature who eats the porridge gains the benefits of the Tribal Bond.

african_union_tribal_grain_porridge_reci.levelRequirementReason: The recipe is a basic culinary guide and does not require high-level magical proficiency.
african_union_tribal_grain_porridge_reci.vendorReason: The Village Elders are the original keepers of this traditional tribal recipe.
african_union_tribal_grain_porridge_reci.shippingDetail: The recipe is delivered as a dry, durable scroll protected by a grain-sealed pouch.

usage.duration: 4 hours
usage.endsWhen: Ends after 4 hours or when a creature finishes a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses as long as the required grains are available.

african_union_tribal_grain_porridge_reci.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect a standard uncommon utility item that provides a temporary buff.

airship_pilot_rental.name: Airship Pilot Rental
airship_pilot_rental.description: The Airship Pilot Rental provides a seasoned navigator to man your vessel's helm for a single voyage. This contract, offered by the Gilded Gryphon, ensures your craft avoids common hazards while navigating the skies.

effectDetails.title: Expert Navigation
effectDetails.rules: The pilot automatically handles all navigation and evasion checks for the airship. For the duration of the voyage, the ship cannot be forced off course by weather or minor obstacles unless a natural 1 is rolled on a navigation check.

effectDetails.title: Skilled Maneuvers
effectDetails.rules: The pilot grants a +5 bonus to all Ability Checks and Saving Throws made by the airship to resist collision, docking, or aerial combat maneuvers.

effectDetails.title: Loot Share Agreement
effectDetails.rules: The pilot is entitled to 10% of all gold and gems found during the voyage; failure to pay this amount results in the pilot abandoning the ship at the next port.

airship_pilot_rental.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of managing an airship in high-threat zones requires a seasoned crew.
airship_pilot_rental.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in high-end logistics and luxury sky-travel services.
airship_pilot_rental.shippingDetail: The pilot is dispatched via a pre-arranged courier manifest and arrives at the starting port 1 hour before departure.

usage.duration: 1d4 days (one voyage)
usage.endsWhen: The voyage is completed or the pilot is dismissed by the party.

airship_pilot_rental.priceReason: The price reflects the high cost of hiring a specialized, elite maritime professional for a long-distance journey.

airship_vigilance_full_restore.name: Vigilance: Full Restoration
airship_vigilance_full_restore.description: Vigilance: Full Restoration is a comprehensive engineering overhaul that transforms the airship into a fortified mobile base. This legendary upgrade includes reinforced hull plating, high-output engine tuning, and the mounting of heavy cannons.

effectDetails.title: Mobile Base of Operations
effectDetails.rules: The airship functions as a fortified base; it provides a +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws for any creatures currently on board. It also serves as a designated long rest location.

effectDetails.title: Orbital Bombardment
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can call down a strike from orbit. Choose a point within 3 miles; all creatures in a 60-foot radius must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d8 force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. This can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Travel
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the ship can teleport to any known location on the same continent. This effect has a cooldown of 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Faction Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: All friendly faction members gain a +50% bonus to morale-based checks and initiative rolls for the duration of the restoration's effects.

airship_vigilance_full_restore.levelRequirementReason: The high complexity of managing a mobile fortress and orbital strikes requires significant leadership experience.
airship_vigilance_full_restore.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in high-end luxury and military vessel upgrades.
airship_vigilance_full_restore.shippingDetail: The Drydock Team requires 48 hours to perform the physical installation and calibration of the heavy cannons.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The restoration is destroyed or the ship is decommissioned.

airship_vigilance_full_restore.priceReason: Reduced from 600,000 to reflect a balanced legendary cost for a permanent faction-wide upgrade.

aleph_null_coins.name: Aleph-Null Coins
aleph_null_coins.description: The Aleph-Null Coins are a collection of shimmering gold pieces contained within a small, unassuming pouch. Crafted by The Mathematician, these coins defy the laws of spatial volume to provide an inexhaustible supply of wealth.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Gold Supply
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can reach into the pouch and pull out a number of gold pieces equal to your character level. This gold is real and spendable, but the pouch never empties.

effectDetails.title: Economic Collapse
effectDetails.rules: If you spend more than 5,000 gold pieces in a single 24-hour period in a specific city or region, the local currency loses all value. Prices for all goods and services in that area triple as the local economy collapses, and you cannot use the pouch to generate more gold in that specific region for 1d7 days.

aleph_null_coins.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced to be accessible at any level while maintaining its high-impact narrative consequences.
aleph_null_coins.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in items that provide boundless resources.
aleph_null_coins.shippingDetail: The shipment arrives via a room that technically shouldn't exist, arriving instantly upon request.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The pouch is destroyed or the user is incapacitated.

aleph_null_coins.priceReason: The price is lowered to a standard high-tier curiosity value to prevent breaking the game's progression while retaining its rarity.

almost_edge_blocky_belt.name: Blocky Belt of the Frontier
almost_edge_blocky_belt.description: The Blocky Belt of the Frontier is a leather belt stitched with pixelated thread from the Blocky Terrains. This pioneer's relic hums with the essence of world-carvers and provides stability when navigating shifting, modular environments.

effectDetails.title: Frontier Navigation
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the belt, your walking speed increases by 10 feet when moving through difficult terrain composed of shifting geometry or modular blocks.

effectDetails.title: Modular Crafting
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to all Intelligence (Crafting) checks made while working with blocky, modular, or pixelated materials.

effectDetails.title: Reality Glitch
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you enter or exit a reality rift, roll a d20. On a 1, you suffer a minor visual glitch: you see the world in low-resolution for 1 minute, imposing disadvantage on Perception checks until the end of your next turn.

almost_edge_blocky_belt.levelRequirementReason: The belt is a common utility item suitable for any adventurer navigating the frontier.
almost_edge_blocky_belt.vendorReason: Almost Edge specializes in items that bridge the gap between different world logics.
almost_edge_blocky_belt.shippingDetail: Delivered via clandestine smuggler routes; may arrive with minor pixelated residue.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: The belt is removed or destroyed

almost_edge_blocky_belt.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a standard common utility item with persistent movement and skill bonuses.

almost_edge_bulldog_bolt.name: Bulldog Bolt
almost_edge_bulldog_bolt.description: This Bulldog Bolt is a heavy, metallic projectile forged by Bullet Bill Express, characterized by its jagged edges and humming static. It serves as a signature delivery weapon that leaves a flickering trail of electricity in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Static Mending
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with this bolt, you can choose to instantly restore 5 hit points to yourself. This effect can be used a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Hallucinatory Feedback
effectDetails.rules: A creature hit by this bolt must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or suffer mild hallucinations for 1 minute. The creature sees flickering images of courier routes and hears distant whistles; this effect ends if the creature takes damage.

effectDetails.title: Cooldown Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: After successfully hitting a target, the next ability you use within 1 minute has its cooldown reduced by 2 seconds (or 1 round if using turn-based mechanics).

almost_edge_bulldog_bolt.levelRequirementReason: The bolt's unique static properties require a basic understanding of martial combat and energy handling.
almost_edge_bulldog_bolt.vendorReason: The almost_edge shop specializes in high-utility courier gear and specialized weaponry.
almost_edge_bulldog_bolt.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-speed courier; may arrive with minor scorch marks on the packaging.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends once the target is hit or the 1-minute window for cooldown acceleration passes.
usage.charges: Limited by Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

almost_edge_bulldog_bolt.priceReason: The price reflects its utility as a multi-purpose combat and utility tool for low-level adventurers.

almost_edge_fallen_fork.name: Fallen Fork of the Liminal Way
almost_edge_fallen_fork.description: The Fallen Fork of the Liminal Way is a rusted, crystalline utensil found wedged in the edge of a collapsing dimension. Once a tool for the forgotten cartographers of the void, its humming tines now serve as a guide through unstable zones.

effectDetails.title: Liminal Awareness
effectDetails.rules: While holding the fork, you gain a +1 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect hidden paths or environmental hazards in unstable terrain.

effectDetails.title: Reality Anchoring
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when you take falling damage, you can plant the fork into the air. You take only half damage from the fall, but the next creature to move within 5 feet of the fork must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Drift
effectDetails.rules: If you use the fork's Reality Anchoring property while moving at a high velocity (such as a sprint or being pushed), you must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become Disoriented. While Disoriented, you have disadvantage on Dexterity checks until the end of your next turn.

almost_edge_fallen_fork.levelRequirementReason: The item's ability to manipulate dimensional stability requires a character with established competence in navigating hazardous environments.
almost_edge_fallen_fork.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in artifacts recovered from the fringes of reality.
almost_edge_fallen_fork.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-speed courier; the package hums audibly during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The anchoring effect ends immediately after the damage is mitigated.

almost_edge_fallen_fork.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a standard uncommon utility item that provides significant defensive utility.

almost_edge_fawful_fury_torch.name: Fawful Fury Torch
almost_edge_fawful_fury_torch.description: The Fawful Fury Torch is a jagged, sputtering light source forged by Asgard using Fawful’s discarded mechanical remains. It pulses with a violent, rhythmic heat that causes nearby metal to groan and vibrate with mechanical rage.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Rupture
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a construct or mechanical creature with a melee attack while holding this torch, you deal an additional 3d8 force damage.

effectDetails.title: Fawful's Resonance
effectDetails.rules: If Fawful is within 30 feet of the wielder, the torch deals an additional 1d6 fire damage to all targets hit by the wielder's attacks.

effectDetails.title: Glitch Pulse
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can cause the torch to flare. All non-magical mechanical objects within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or suffer a mechanical glitch, becoming non-functional for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Shadowfell Manifestation
effectDetails.rules: While in the Shadowfell, using the Glitch Pulse effect summons a mechanical shadow clone. This clone has 20 hit points, acts on your initiative, and can use its action to make one melee attack (+5 to hit, 1d6+3 slashing) before dissipating at the end of its turn.

almost_edge_fawful_fury_torch.levelRequirementReason: The item's ability to manipulate mechanical constructs and summon entities requires high-level proficiency.
almost_edge_fawful_fury_torch.vendorReason: Almost Edge specializes in high-tier, unconventional weaponry and artifacts.
almost_edge_fawful_fury_torch.shippingDetail: Delivered via a frantic, high-speed sprint; may arrive slightly scorched.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The Glitch Pulse effect ends after 1 minute or if the torch is extinguished.

almost_edge_fawful_fury_torch.priceReason: The epic rarity and multi-functional utility justify the high XP cost.

almost_edge_feywild_locket.name: Loom of Trickster Tides
almost_edge_feywild_locket.description: The Loom of Trickster Tides is a handcrafted locket that pulses with the rhythm of the Feywild’s shifting time. Its surface glows with shifting patterns that mimic the paths of hedge mazes, echoing the laughter of trickster spirits.

effectDetails.title: Trickster's Perception
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this locket, you have a +1 bonus to all Wisdom (Perception) and Charisma (Deception) skill checks.

effectDetails.title: Warped Movement
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet moves, you can cause the locket to pulse. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have its movement speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Time Loop Degradation
effectDetails.rules: The locket's magic is unstable; it is destroyed if it is used to affect a creature while the user is inside a magical time loop or chronal anomaly.

almost_edge_feywild_locket.levelRequirementReason: The locket's Feywild resonance is too volatile for characters under level 4 to safely wield.
almost_edge_feywild_locket.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in items with subtle, perception-warping properties.
almost_edge_feywild_locket.shippingDetail: Delivered via a rapid-growth vine courier; arrives within 24 hours.

usage.duration: Until the start of the target's next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target's turn begins or the locket is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited (Reaction limited to once per round)

almost_edge_feywild_locket.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the specific Feywild craftsmanship required for its construction.

almost_edge_feywild_tangled_ribbon.name: Feywild Tangled Ribbon
almost_edge_feywild_tangled_ribbon.description: The Feywild Tangled Ribbon is a frayed silk ribbon that pulses with a faint, rhythmic glow from trapped time loops. Crafted by Goomba Ground Delivery, this enchanted accessory hums with the discordant echoes of moments that never quite finished.

effectDetails.title: Feywild Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the ribbon around your neck or wrist, you gain a +1 bonus to Sleight of Hand and Stealth checks while within the Feywild.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Rewind
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from a melee attack, roll a d10. On a 1, the ribbon triggers a time rewind; you regain 1d6 hit points as the wound momentarily un-happens. This effect can trigger once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Looping Trap
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can attempt to entangle a creature within 10 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be Restrained as they are forced to repeat their previous action on their next turn. This effect ends if the creature takes damage or is healed.

almost_edge_feywild_tangled_ribbon.levelRequirementReason: The ribbon's temporal instability requires a character to have sufficient mental fortitude to handle the shifting time loops.
almost_edge_feywild_tangled_ribbon.vendorReason: Almost Edge specializes in items that blur the lines between reality and the ethereal.
almost_edge_feywild_tangled_ribbon.shippingDetail: Delivered via erratic hopping; may arrive slightly out of chronological order.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or until the effect ends
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the target takes damage, is healed, or the long rest is completed.
usage.charges: 1 Rewind per long rest; Looping Trap is limited by the ribbon's fraying (DM's discretion).

almost_edge_feywild_tangled_ribbon.priceReason: Reduced slightly to reflect the ribbon's fraying state while maintaining its uncommon utility.

almost_edge_fire_flower_core.name: Bloom of Shattered Flame
almost_edge_fire_flower_core.description: The Bloom of Shattered Flame is a mutated fire flower core harvested from the unstable void near the edge. Its petals erupt in violent explosions when touched, carrying the volatile essence of a rogue fire spirit from a failed Sovereignty Act protest.

effectDetails.title: Volatile Combustion
effectDetails.rules: When you first consume or activate this core, it deals 3d4 fire damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius, including yourself.

effectDetails.title: Searing Precision
effectDetails.rules: For 1 round immediately following its first use, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls made with melee weapons.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Burst
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you cast a spell or use a magical ability while holding the core, there is a 25% chance it triggers a minor explosion, dealing 1d6 fire damage to all adjacent creatures.

almost_edge_fire_flower_core.levelRequirementReason: The core's volatile nature requires a character with basic combat experience to handle the feedback.
almost_edge_fire_flower_core.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in items harvested from the unstable void near the edge.
almost_edge_fire_flower_core.shippingDetail: Shipped in a heat-resistant containment pod to prevent premature detonation during transit.

usage.duration: 1 round for precision; instantaneous for damage
usage.endsWhen: The core is consumed or the duration expires

almost_edge_fire_flower_core.priceReason: Increased to reflect the high risk of self-damage and its unique combat utility.

almost_edge_griffonstone_key.name: Griffonstone Key
almost_edge_griffonstone_key.description: The Griffonstone Key is a jagged, heavy key carved from the molten core of a fallen Griffonstone and forged from corrupted starlight. It emits a low hum when near dimensional breaches and serves as a tool to navigate the hidden tunnels beneath the Void Edge.

effectDetails.title: Secret Passage Access
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can hold the key near a sealed door or wall within the Void Edge. If the location contains a hidden tunnel, the key unlocks it instantly. This effect can be used a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Void Rift Trigger
effectDetails.rules: The first time you use the key to open a passage, there is a 50% chance a Void Rift opens. All creatures within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 force damage.

effectDetails.title: Melee Weaponry
effectDetails.rules: The key can be used as a simple melee weapon. It deals 1d4 piercing damage on a hit. You have disadvantage on attack rolls made with this item unless you are a Vampire Covenant member.

almost_edge_griffonstone_key.levelRequirementReason: The item is rated as Epic rarity and requires high-level navigation of dimensional breaches.
almost_edge_griffonstone_key.vendorReason: The Void Edge is the primary location where these tunnels are situated.
almost_edge_griffonstone_key.shippingDetail: Smuggled via high-speed courier; requires a secret meeting point for delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after the door is opened or the rift damage is dealt.

almost_edge_griffonstone_key.priceReason: The price reflects its Epic rarity and unique utility for high-level exploration.

almost_edge_item_name_here.name: Crumbling Cogwheel
almost_edge_item_name_here.description: This Crumbling Cogwheel is a jagged, rusted gear salvaged from a collapsing Chaos Dwarf machine. It hums with a discordant, unstable energy that vibrates against the palm of anyone holding it.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Shock Immunity
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Cogwheel, you have advantage on saving throws against effects that would cause you to fall, be pushed, or be knocked prone by gravitational forces.

effectDetails.title: Kinetic Overload
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, the Cogwheel adds an extra 1d6 force damage to the strike.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Resonance
effectDetails.rules: After using the Kinetic Overload effect for 3 rounds, you must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer the Poisoned condition for 1 minute as the gear's hum causes intense nausea.

almost_edge_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: The unstable energy of the Chaos Dwarf machinery requires a seasoned adventurer to handle without injury.
almost_edge_item_name_here.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in salvaged and high-risk mechanical components.
almost_edge_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Delivered in a lead-lined crate to prevent the humming from alerting local wildlife.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The user drops the item or the resonance causes the user to become Poisoned

almost_edge_item_name_here.priceReason: Reduced from 2500 to reflect the item's damaged state and the risk of nausea.

almost_edge_pony_heart_pearl.name: Pony Heart Pearl
almost_edge_pony_heart_pearl.description: The Pony Heart Pearl is a luminous orb harvested from the core of a fallen Equestrian noble, pulsing with the warmth of friendship magic. This pearl glows softly in the presence of equines and serves as a vessel for memories and restorative energy.

effectDetails.title: Restorative Pulse
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can crush the pearl to restore 20 hit points to yourself or one creature you can touch. This effect is instantaneous and the pearl is destroyed upon use.

effectDetails.title: Friendship Boon
effectDetails.rules: While holding the pearl, you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence friendly creatures. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Changeling Sympathy
effectDetails.rules: If a non-Changeling creature wears the pearl for more than 8 hours, they must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on Initiative rolls for 1 hour as they experience fleeting, hallucinatory memories of another life.

almost_edge_pony_heart_pearl.levelRequirementReason: The item's restorative healing and social bonuses are balanced for characters capable of navigating social complexities.
almost_edge_pony_heart_pearl.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in items with unique origins and magical properties.
almost_edge_pony_heart_pearl.shippingDetail: The pearl is transported in a lead-lined pouch to dampen its magical signature during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute or instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The pearl is destroyed by crushing or the 8-hour wear limit is reached
usage.charges: Single use for healing; passive for social bonus

almost_edge_pony_heart_pearl.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect the rarity of noble artifacts and the potency of the healing effect.

almost_edge_regal_emblem.name: Regal Emblem
almost_edge_regal_emblem.description: The Regal Emblem is a forged insignia of the fallen Sovereignty Act, bearing the blood-stained seal of the Regal Empire’s rebellion. Smuggled from the Valley of Bowser under Kamek’s watchful eye, this metal badge whispers of the empire’s legacy to any who wear it.

effectDetails.title: Command Presence
effectDetails.rules: While the emblem is worn, all allies within 30 feet of the wearer gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls. This effect is passive and constant.

effectDetails.title: Sovereignty Surge
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can channel the emblem's power. Roll a d6; on a 6, all allies within 30 feet gain 1d8 temporary hit points and advantage on their next attack roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Mental Fatigue
effectDetails.rules: Each time you use Sovereignty Surge, the emblem's whispers intensify. After 3 uses, the wearer must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become stunned until the end of their next turn.

almost_edge_regal_emblem.levelRequirementReason: The legendary nature of the emblem and its mental strain require a high level of mental fortitude.
almost_edge_regal_emblem.vendorReason: Almost Edge specializes in artifacts tied to the fall of the Sovereignty Act.
almost_edge_regal_emblem.shippingDetail: Delivered via a line of Goombas; may take 1d4 days depending on terrain.

usage.activation: Passive (Command Presence) or Bonus Action (Sovereignty Surge)
usage.duration: 1 round for Surge
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer moves out of range or the Surge duration expires.

almost_edge_regal_emblem.priceReason: Reduced from 50,000 to reflect a balanced legendary item cost for a level 10 character.

almost_edge_soul_trade_satchel.name: Soul Trade Satchel
almost_edge_soul_trade_satchel.description: This Soul Trade Satchel is a heavy, leather pouch that visibly strains under the weight of a bargain. Crafted by Goomba Ground Delivery with Asgard’s blessing, the satchel's fabric ripples with the faint, ghostly echoes of those who have been traded.

effectDetails.title: Soul Exchange
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can place a creature's soul (from a deceased creature within 30 feet) into the satchel to receive 10 gold pieces, or spend 10 gold pieces to manifest a soul from the satchel. Each use creates a minor reality tear, causing the user to take 1d6 psychic damage.

effectDetails.title: Faction Bargaining
effectDetails.rules: While holding the satchel, you gain Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to trade with members of the Onyx Hand or Fawful’s minions. Additionally, you can trade a soul to the satchel to receive one random mechanical item from Fawful’s stash (DC 15 Arcana check to determine quality).

effectDetails.title: Shadowfell Protection
effectDetails.rules: While you are in the Shadowfell, the satchel provides a passive aura. You have immunity to effects that would cause you to lose your soul or have it extracted until you leave the plane.

almost_edge_soul_trade_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of handling soul-bound bargains requires a high degree of spiritual fortitude.
almost_edge_soul_trade_satchel.vendorReason: The almost_edge vendor specializes in high-risk, high-reward artifacts of this nature.
almost_edge_soul_trade_satchel.shippingDetail: Delivered via heavy-lift Goomba transport; items are handled with extreme care to prevent reality leakage.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends once the gold is received or the item is manifested.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but limited by the user's ability to withstand psychic damage.

almost_edge_soul_trade_satchel.priceReason: The price reflects its legendary status and the high-risk nature of soul manipulation.

almost_edge_syrups_scorched_glove.name: Syrups Scorched Glove
almost_edge_syrups_scorched_glove.description: The Syrups Scorched Glove is a battle-worn gauntlet forged by the Servants Cosmic during the Crimson Fleet’s final stand. Once worn by Captain Syrups’ personal guard, the scorched leather still radiates the heat of magical explosions.

effectDetails.title: Wario Land Precision
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls made with melee weapons against creatures belonging to the Wario Land faction.

effectDetails.title: Staggering Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be Staggered (unable to take reactions or move) until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Resilience
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to fire damage from magical sources; however, when you take fire damage from a magical explosion, you take 1d6 fire damage as the glove's scorched fibers react.

almost_edge_syrups_scorched_glove.levelRequirementReason: The glove's defensive properties and combat bonuses are balanced for mid-tier adventurers.
almost_edge_syrups_scorched_glove.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in artifacts from the Crimson Fleet's history.
almost_edge_syrups_scorched_glove.shippingDetail: Delivered via heavy-duty Goomba sled to ensure the scorched heat doesn't damage nearby parcels.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The glove is destroyed or the wearer is unattuned

almost_edge_syrups_scorched_glove.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the specific combat advantages provided against Wario Land units.

almost_edge_teyvat_soul_collar.name: Teyvat Soul Collar
almost_edge_teyvat_soul_collar.description: The Teyvat Soul Collar is a heavy metallic band forged by the Mages Guild using forbidden Teyvat Archives. It hums with a rhythmic pulse, designed to bind and channel the volatile elemental wills of its wearer.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Synergy
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the collar, you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls for any attack or spell that triggers an elemental reaction. This bonus stacks with other items that possess the 'Teyvat Elemental Synergy' property.

effectDetails.title: Soul Drain
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, the collar leeches essence; the target takes an additional 1d6 necrotic damage. This effect ends if the target dies or if you miss the attack.

effectDetails.title: Vision Resonance
effectDetails.rules: The first time you equip the collar, you must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you take 2d6 psychic damage as the collar binds to your spirit; on a success, you gain a +1 bonus to your next initiative roll.

almost_edge_teyvat_soul_collar.levelRequirementReason: The collar's binding properties are too volatile for those without significant spiritual fortitude.
almost_edge_teyvat_soul_collar.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in high-tier artifacts and cursed equipment.
almost_edge_teyvat_soul_collar.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-altitude bird courier; may arrive with slight feathers stuck to the packaging.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: The collar is removed or destroyed

almost_edge_teyvat_soul_collar.priceReason: The price reflects the rare materials and the dangerous nature of the Mages Guild's forbidden crafting.

almost_edge_torn_tome.name: Torn Tome of the Regency’s Last Words
almost_edge_torn_tome.description: The Torn Tome of the Regency’s Last Words is a crumbling book of fractured logic discovered beneath a fallen pillar in the heart of the edge. Its pages, torn by magic, contain the final recorded thoughts of Admiral B. Toad from the regency’s final stand.

effectDetails.title: Diplomatic Insight
effectDetails.rules: While holding the tome, you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against faction leaders. This effect is constant while the book is held.

effectDetails.title: Faction Revelation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can read a passage of the tome to learn the hidden loyalties of all NPCs within 60 feet who belong to a known faction. This effect is instantaneous and can be used a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Fallen
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you use the Faction Revelation effect, roll a d6. On a 1, you experience a mental hallucination of a past battle; you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be Incapacitated until the end of your next turn.

almost_edge_torn_tome.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the fractured logic requires a seasoned mind to interpret without immediate psychological strain.
almost_edge_torn_tome.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in artifacts recovered from the ruins of the edge.
almost_edge_torn_tome.shippingDetail: Delivered via clandestine transport; requires a successful DC 12 Stealth check by the courier to avoid detection during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after the information is revealed or the hallucination concludes.

almost_edge_torn_tome.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect the high rarity and the significant utility provided to social and exploration gameplay.

almost_edge_tropical_tether.name: Tropical Tether
almost_edge_tropical_tether.description: The Tropical Tether is a shimmering, vine-like artifact woven from the essence of Shine Sprites. This artifact binds the user to the Isle Delfino’s tropical rhythms, pulsing with the warmth of the sun.

effectDetails.title: Tropical Flight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the tether to gain a flying speed of 30 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated. You can only use this effect while within 5 miles of Pianta Village or Noki Bay.

effectDetails.title: Vitality Drain
effectDetails.rules: While using Tropical Flight, you must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of your turns. On a failed save, you take 1d4 necrotic damage as the tether drains your vitality.

effectDetails.title: Tropical Awareness
effectDetails.rules: While the tether is active, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect hidden creatures or environmental hazards in tropical environments.

almost_edge_tropical_tether.levelRequirementReason: The tether requires a level 4 character to withstand the magical strain of the Shine Sprite essence.
almost_edge_tropical_tether.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in rare tropical artifacts and exotic equipment.
almost_edge_tropical_tether.shippingDetail: Delivered via standard ground transport; may arrive slightly wilted if not kept in a humid container.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires, the user becomes incapacitated, or the user chooses to dismiss the effect.

almost_edge_tropical_tether.priceReason: Adjusted to 1000 XP to reflect its uncommon status and high-utility flight mechanics.

almost_edge_viral_vault.name: Viral Vault
almost_edge_viral_vault.description: The Viral Vault is a pulsating data core forged by Chaos Dwarfs to broadcast internet memes into the physical plane. This heavy, metallic device contains the secret, unionized delivery memo of The Shy Guys and hums with chaotic digital energy.

effectDetails.title: Meme Infection
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can pulse the Vault to target one creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or become infected by a meme-based mental curse. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 1 hour. You can target a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reinforced Chassis
effectDetails.rules: The Vault's durability is increased by 200%. It has 3 times the hit points of a standard data core and is immune to the critical hit property from non-magical weapons.

effectDetails.title: Lore Trigger
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can broadcast a specific piece of internet lore. The DM determines a local environmental change or minor event (such as a nearby NPC reacting in confusion or a door unlocking) based on the lore provided. This can be used once per day.

almost_edge_viral_vault.levelRequirementReason: The Vault's ability to manipulate reality via digital memes requires high-level magical attunement.
almost_edge_viral_vault.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in chaotic, high-tech artifacts that blur the line between data and reality.
almost_edge_viral_vault.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-speed projectile; may arrive with minor surface scuffs but fully functional.

usage.duration: 1 hour (Curse) or Instantaneous (Lore)
usage.endsWhen: Ends after 1 hour or when the daily use limit is reached.
usage.charges: Limited by Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

almost_edge_viral_vault.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a legendary item's power while remaining accessible for high-level play.

alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_gloves.name: Alvarez Empire Dragon Scale Gloves
alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_gloves.description: Crafted from the discarded hide of a great drake, these Alvarez Empire Dragon Scale Gloves are heavy, textured gauntlets. Forged by the renowned Empire Dragonhunters, the iridescent scales provide a natural defense against searing heat.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on saving throws against fire damage and effects that deal fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Grip
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to grapple, climb, or hold onto objects.

effectDetails.title: Surface Abrasion
effectDetails.rules: The jagged scales on the palms allow you to cast 'Spider Climb' only on stone or metal surfaces; the effect lasts for 10 minutes and ends if you are incapacitated or fall unconscious.

alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_gloves.levelRequirementReason: The high durability of dragon scales requires a seasoned warrior to wield effectively.
alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_gloves.vendorReason: The fortress is the primary hub for the Empire Dragonhunters who harvest these scales.
alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_gloves.shippingDetail: Wrapped in oil-treated leather to prevent the scales from catching on transport crates.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The item is destroyed or removed

alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_gloves.priceReason: Adjusted from 20,000 to 5,000 XP to reflect a Rare item that provides significant utility without being game-breaking.
