alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_spatula.name: Alvarez Empire Dragon Scale Spatula
alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_spatula.description: The Alvarez Empire Dragon Scale Spatula is a heavy-duty culinary tool forged from reinforced draconic scales. Crafted by the renowned Empire Scalers, this heat-resistant spatula is specifically designed to handle volatile spice rubs without melting or warping.

effectDetails.title: Perfect Flip
effectDetails.rules: While using this spatula to cook, you have advantage on any ability checks made to flip, toss, or turn hot food items. Additionally, you can use an action to flip a hot spice rub without taking any fire damage from the heat.

effectDetails.title: Draconic Durability
effectDetails.rules: The spatula is resistant to non-magical fire damage and has a +1 bonus to AC when used as a shield or improvised weapon. If the spatula takes more than 20 points of fire damage in a single instance, the scales flake slightly, reducing the AC bonus to +0 until repaired.

alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_spatula.levelRequirementReason: The item is a culinary tool and does not require high-level proficiency to operate.
alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_spatula.vendorReason: The palace kitchen serves high-end cuisine that requires specialized, dragon-scale equipment.
alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_spatula.shippingDetail: Shipped in a temperature-controlled crate to ensure the scales remain supple.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The spatula is destroyed or the scales are completely worn away.

alvarez_empire_dragon_scale_spatula.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a high-quality uncommon utility item rather than a legendary artifact.

alvarez_empire_dragon_seed_service.name: Alvarez Empire Dragon Seed Service
alvarez_empire_dragon_seed_service.description: The Alvarez Empire Dragon Seed is a scorched, pulsing seed that feels uncomfortably hot to the touch. Cultivated by the Empire Druids, this botanical specimen is designed to sprout into a draconic vine.

effectDetails.title: Draconic Breath
effectDetails.rules: As an action, a creature holding the sprouted vine can exhale a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sprouting Growth
effectDetails.rules: When planted in soil, the seed takes 24 hours to sprout into a 5-foot-tall vine. Once sprouted, the vine remains active for 1 hour before withering and becoming inert.

alvarez_empire_dragon_seed_service.levelRequirementReason: The high-intensity draconic energy requires a character of at least 6th level to safely handle and channel.
alvarez_empire_dragon_seed_service.vendorReason: The Empire Druids maintain the garden where these specific draconic seeds are cultivated.
alvarez_empire_dragon_seed_service.shippingDetail: The seed is shipped in a heat-resistant pod to prevent it from scorching the courier's transport.

usage.duration: 1 hour (after 24-hour growth)
usage.endsWhen: The vine withers after its 1-hour duration or after the fire breath is used once.

alvarez_empire_dragon_seed_service.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a rare botanical item that provides a significant one-time tactical advantage.

alvarez_empire_dragon_spice_rub_recipe.name: Recipe: Alvarez Empire Dragon Spice Rub
alvarez_empire_dragon_spice_rub_recipe.description: This Alvarez Empire Dragon Spice Rub is a scorched parchment containing the secret techniques of the Dragon Chefs. The recipe describes how to blend volatile dragonfire spices to create a meat rub that crackles with intense heat.

effectDetails.title: Dragonfire Seasoning
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can apply this rub to a meal for one creature. The next time that creature hits a target with a melee weapon attack within 1 minute of consuming the meal, the attack deals an additional 1d4 fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Recipe Acquisition
effectDetails.rules: Upon purchasing this recipe, you permanently learn the 'Rub and Cook' technique. You can now prepare meals that provide the Dragonfire Seasoning effect using any amount of Dragon Spices as a component.

alvarez_empire_dragon_spice_rub_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The recipe is a piece of knowledge that can be learned by any adventurer capable of basic cooking.
alvarez_empire_dragon_spice_rub_recipe.vendorReason: The palace serves as the primary hub for the Alvarez Empire's culinary secrets.
alvarez_empire_dragon_spice_rub_recipe.shippingDetail: The parchment is sealed in a heat-resistant wax pouch to prevent the spices from evaporating during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The meal is consumed or the time limit expires
usage.charges: One-time use per parchment; recipe is permanent

alvarez_empire_dragon_spice_rub_recipe.priceReason: Reduced from 8000 to reflect a fair market price for a rare culinary secret rather than a high-tier magical artifact.

alvarez_empire_loyalty_points_program.name: Alvarez Empire Loyalty Points Program
alvarez_empire_loyalty_points_program.description: The Alvarez Empire Loyalty Points Program is a physical membership card issued by the Alvarez Empire Marketing department. This card allows you to track your expenditures and accumulate rewards for your continued patronage of imperial services.

effectDetails.title: Loyalty Rewards
effectDetails.rules: Every time you spend 100 gp on goods or services within the Empire, you earn 1 Loyalty Point. Upon reaching 10 Loyalty Points, you may spend them as a free action to receive one common magic item worth up to 50 gp from a local merchant. Points expire 7 days after they are earned.

effectDetails.title: Preferred Customer Status
effectDetails.rules: While holding this card, you are identified as a high-value consumer. Hostile entities of the Empire gain Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to locate you, and you have Disadvantage on Stealth checks made while within city limits.

alvarez_empire_loyalty_points_program.levelRequirementReason: The program is accessible to any adventurer capable of participating in imperial commerce.
alvarez_empire_loyalty_points_program.vendorReason: The Alvarez Empire is the primary entity managing the marketing and loyalty rewards program.
alvarez_empire_loyalty_points_program.shippingDetail: Delivered via standard imperial mail with a 2-day transit time to any registered outpost.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The card is lost, destroyed, or the membership is revoked by the Empire.
usage.charges: Unlimited (Points are tracked by the DM)

alvarez_empire_loyalty_points_program.priceReason: Reduced from 12,500 to reflect a standard membership fee rather than a high-tier artifact.

among_us_sabotage_kit.name: Sabotage Kit
among_us_sabotage_kit.description: The Sabotage Kit is a collection of illicit tools and wires used for causing chaos and executing impostor tricks. This forbidden gear, sourced from the rogueport black market, allows the user to manipulate the environment and move with unsettling speed.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Sabotage
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the kit to disable lights or lock doors in a 60-foot radius. For 1 minute, the area is shrouded in magical darkness and exits are sealed. A creature can use an action to make a DC 14 Strength check to force a door open or a DC 14 Thieves' Tools check to restore the lights.

effectDetails.title: Vent Travel
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space within 30 feet, provided there is a ventilation shaft or crawlspace at both the starting and ending points.

effectDetails.title: Suspicion Risk
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you use the Vent Travel ability, you must roll a d20. On a roll of 1-5, your actions become visibly erratic, and all creatures within 10 feet of you become aware of your presence until the start of your next turn.

among_us_sabotage_kit.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of manipulating infrastructure and high-speed movement requires a baseline of martial or arcane proficiency.
among_us_sabotage_kit.vendorReason: The black market specializes in illicit tools and forbidden items used for sabotage.
among_us_sabotage_kit.shippingDetail: Delivered in a lead-lined crate; the courier refuses to sign for the contents.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Sabotage; Instantaneous for Vent Travel
usage.endsWhen: The Sabotage effect ends after 1 minute or if the user spends an action to repair it; Vent Travel is a one-time teleport per activation.

among_us_sabotage_kit.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect a rare utility item that provides significant tactical mobility and battlefield control.

ancestral_weapon_forging.name: Ancestral Weapon Forging
ancestral_weapon_forging.description: The Ancestral Weapon Forging service utilizes a master blacksmith's craft to bind the spirits of your lineage into your steel. By sacrificing a personal heirloom, the smith hammers the essence of your ancestors into your primary weapon.

effectDetails.title: Ancestral Bond
effectDetails.rules: The weapon becomes a +2 magic weapon. It gains a Sentience (Intelligence 1) and a unique ancestral power determined by the DM based on the heirloom's history. This bond is permanent unless the weapon is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of the Fallen
effectDetails.rules: While holding the weapon, you can spend 1 minute of concentration to hear the ancestors' advice. You gain advantage on one Wisdom (Insight) or Intelligence (History) check made within the next hour as they share secrets or warnings.

ancestral_weapon_forging.levelRequirementReason: The spiritual complexity of binding ancestral spirits requires a high level of personal presence and willpower.
ancestral_weapon_forging.vendorReason: The Steamworks possesses the industrial furnaces and specialized smithing tools required for such heavy-duty spiritual forging.
ancestral_weapon_forging.shippingDetail: The finished weapon is delivered via a heat-sealed scroll, arriving within 3 days of completion.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The weapon is destroyed or the heirloom is lost.

ancestral_weapon_forging.priceReason: The price reflects the legendary rarity and the permanent magical enhancement provided to a primary weapon.

angelic_halo_crown.name: Angelic Halo Crown (Aura)
angelic_halo_crown.description: The Angelic Halo Crown is a circlet of shimmering gold forged by the Halo Forgers to project a sanctified radiance. It serves as a beacon of divine grace, pulsing with a soft white light that emanates from its central gemstone.

effectDetails.title: Holy Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 30 feet of the wearer regain 10 hit points at the start of their turn. This effect does not trigger if the ally is at full health and does not stack with other healing sources.

effectDetails.title: Fiendish Retribution
effectDetails.rules: When a Fiend enters the wearer's reach or starts its turn within 30 feet, it takes 2d10 radiant damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the wearer.

angelic_halo_crown.levelRequirementReason: The item's high-impact area-of-effect healing and damage are intended for late-game play.
angelic_halo_crown.vendorReason: The Celestial Throne is the primary source of high-rarity holy artifacts.
angelic_halo_crown.shippingDetail: The item arrives via a beam of light; delivery is instantaneous upon purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute per hour
usage.endsWhen: The item is removed from the wearer's head or the wearer dies.

angelic_halo_crown.priceReason: The price remains high to reflect its godly rarity and constant aura effects.

angelic_wing_graft.name: Angelic Wing Graft (Augmentation)
angelic_wing_graft.description: The Angelic Wing Graft is a surgical augmentation of shimmering, iridescent feathers fused to the wearer's shoulder blades. Crafted by the Seraphim Healers, these celestial wings provide a majestic presence and a divine aura of protection.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Flight
effectDetails.rules: While the graft is active, you gain a flying speed of 60 feet. This movement is not affected by difficult terrain.

effectDetails.title: Divine Resonance
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to the Save DC and Attack Rolls of any spells you cast that deal radiant damage or are of the Divine school.

angelic_wing_graft.levelRequirementReason: This legendary augmentation is only stable enough to be integrated into the physiology of a high-level mortal.
angelic_wing_graft.vendorReason: The Seraphim Healers are the only ones capable of performing the delicate surgery required for this graft.
angelic_wing_graft.shippingDetail: The item arrives via a localized rift; it cannot be intercepted by mundane means.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The graft is surgically removed or the wearer dies.

angelic_wing_graft.priceReason: The price reflects the legendary rarity and the high-tier surgical expertise required for the procedure.

animatopia_acme_anvil_mixer.name: Animatopia Acme Anvil Mixer
animatopia_acme_anvil_mixer.description: The Animatopia Acme Anvil Mixer is a heavy, industrial-grade kitchen appliance forged by Toon Toolmakers to 'pound' dough with the force of a falling anvil. This sturdy mixer features a reinforced steel bowl and a rhythmic, metallic clanking mechanism.

effectDetails.title: Cartoon Culinary Advantage
effectDetails.rules: While using this mixer to prepare food, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to knead, lift, or move heavy dough or ingredients.

effectDetails.title: Boing Distraction
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can drop the mixer. It hits the ground with a loud 'boing' sound. All creatures within 15 feet that can hear the sound must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be under the effects of the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Comical Malfunction
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you roll a 1 on an attack roll or ability check using this item, it may break comically. The mixer becomes useless until it is repaired with a toolkit during a long rest.

animatopia_acme_anvil_mixer.levelRequirementReason: The item provides utility and minor tactical advantages suitable for early-game characters.
animatopia_acme_anvil_mixer.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in whimsical, toon-inspired equipment and tools.
animatopia_acme_anvil_mixer.shippingDetail: Shipped in a padded crate that bounces instead of thuds; delivery is instantaneous but very loud.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The Boing Distraction ends after one turn; Malfunction ends after a long rest.

animatopia_acme_anvil_mixer.priceReason: Reduced from 5500 to reflect an uncommon utility item that does not provide combat scaling.

animatopia_acme_toaster.name: Animatopia Acme Toaster
animatopia_acme_toaster.description: The Animatopia Acme Toaster is a chrome-plated kitchen appliance manufactured by Toon Toasters. It features a spring-loaded mechanism designed to launch bread with cartoonish velocity.

effectDetails.title: Cartoon Launch
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can load a piece of bread into the toaster and fire it at a target within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it also gains a +1 bonus to its next Dexterity check made before the end of your next turn as it tries to dodge the lingering crumbs.

effectDetails.title: Boing Distraction
effectDetails.rules: When the toaster finishes a cycle, it emits a loud 'boing' sound. One creature within 10 feet of the toaster must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be under the effect of the distracted condition until the end of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Acme Malfunction
effectDetails.rules: On a natural 1 on the attack roll to fire the toaster, the device malfunctions. The user takes 1d4 fire damage from a burst of hot steam and the toaster cannot be used again until the end of your next turn.

animatopia_acme_toaster.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for low-level utility and does not provide significant combat scaling.
animatopia_acme_toaster.vendorReason: The studio specializes in cartoon-themed equipment and prop-based weaponry.
animatopia_acme_toaster.shippingDetail: Shipped in a reinforced box to prevent premature popping during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The toaster requires a short rest to 'cool down' after 3 uses per day.

animatopia_acme_toaster.priceReason: Reduced from 5500 to reflect an uncommon utility item rather than a high-tier artifact.

animatopia_ancient_key.name: The Forgotten Key of the Feywild Courts
animatopia_ancient_key.description: The Forgotten Key of the Feywild Courts is a heavy obsidian key etched with ancient runes of forgotten feasts and betrayals. Originally forged to unlock the gates of the Feywild’s oldest court, it pulses with a faint, rhythmic magic.

effectDetails.title: Feywild Court Access
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can attempt to unlock a Feywild gate or hidden chamber door. You must first succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (History) check to solve the court's riddle; if you fail the check, the door remains locked. Success grants passage for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Mental Fatigue
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you successfully use the key to open a door, you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion that lasts for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Feywild Agility
effectDetails.rules: While you are within a Feywild zone, you gain a +2 bonus to all Dexterity (Acrobatics) and Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

effectDetails.title: Loop Binding
effectDetails.rules: If you use the key while inside a magical time loop, you are automatically restrained by the loop for 1 round. You can repeat the action at the start of your next turn to attempt to break free.

animatopia_ancient_key.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the Feywild's riddles and the mental strain of the key require a character of significant experience.
animatopia_ancient_key.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in artifacts with complex histories and mechanical secrets.
animatopia_ancient_key.shippingDetail: The key is delivered in a lead-lined box to prevent its magical resonance from disrupting local reality.

usage.duration: 1 hour (for passage)
usage.endsWhen: The door is closed, the user leaves the zone, or the user fails a riddle check.

animatopia_ancient_key.priceReason: Reduced from 7500 to reflect a balanced legendary-tier item cost that accounts for its specific utility.

animatopia_animatronic_costume_rental.name: Animatopia Animatronic Costume Rental
animatopia_animatronic_costume_rental.description: This Animatopia Animatronic Costume Rental is a heavy, mechanical suit of plating designed to mimic a friendly robot. Crafted by the Animatopia Costume Shop, the suit features internal servos and a weathered, slightly uncanny exterior.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Disguise
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the costume, you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass as a harmless animatronic when interacting with guards or security personnel.

effectDetails.title: Noisy Mechanics
effectDetails.rules: The suit's internal gears are poorly insulated; after 1 hour of continuous wear, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

effectDetails.title: Uncanny Presence
effectDetails.rules: Children are drawn to you and may approach you willingly, but adults within 30 feet of you have disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to determine if you are a threat, as your appearance is unsettling.

animatopia_animatronic_costume_rental.levelRequirementReason: The item is an uncommon costume and does not require specific class features or high-level stats to operate.
animatopia_animatronic_costume_rental.vendorReason: The Animatopia Costume Shop is the primary manufacturer and retailer of these specific mechanical suits.
animatopia_animatronic_costume_rental.shippingDetail: The porter handles the heavy lifting of the bulky suit, ensuring it arrives in one piece without mechanical damage.

usage.duration: 1 hour before penalty applies
usage.endsWhen: The costume is removed or destroyed

animatopia_animatronic_costume_rental.priceReason: The price was adjusted slightly downward to reflect a more standard uncommon item value while maintaining its premium status.

animatopia_apex_chimeric_serum.name: Animatopia Apex Chimeric Serum
animatopia_apex_chimeric_serum.description: The Animatopia Apex Chimeric Serum is a glowing, viscous liquid housed in a reinforced vial. Engineered by the masters at Animatopia, this serum forcefully rewires the user's physiology to mirror the traits of three apex predators.

effectDetails.title: Apex Predator Traits
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you inject the serum to gain three specific traits from the following list: Flight (Speed of 30ft), Venom (1d8 Poison damage on hit), or Strength (Increase Strength score by 4, max 24). These traits last for 2 hours.

effectDetails.title: Volatile Mutation Backlash
effectDetails.rules: When the 2-hour duration ends, you must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage for every hour that has passed since the serum was injected. This damage occurs at the end of each of your turns until the effect expires.

animatopia_apex_chimeric_serum.levelRequirementReason: The intense physiological strain of chimeric mutation requires a high level of biological resilience.
animatopia_apex_chimeric_serum.vendorReason: The scientist is the primary architect of the serum's biological formula.
animatopia_apex_chimeric_serum.shippingDetail: Shipped in a pressurized, temperature-controlled containment unit to prevent chemical degradation.

usage.duration: 2 hours
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the user dies
usage.charges: Single use; the serum is consumed upon injection

animatopia_apex_chimeric_serum.priceReason: Reduced from the original value to reflect a balanced high-tier consumable cost while maintaining its rarity.

animatopia_apex_dominance_serum.name: Animatopia Apex Dominance Serum
animatopia_apex_dominance_serum.description: The Animatopia Apex Dominance Serum is a shimmering, viscous liquid contained within a pressurized vial. Engineered by the scientists of Animatopia, this pheromonal cocktail allows the user to project an overwhelming aura of biological authority over the natural world.

effectDetails.title: Apex Command
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can inject the serum into your bloodstream. For 1 hour, any non-sentient beast with a Challenge Rating of 12 or lower within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to obey your verbal commands. The beast treats you as its alpha and will not attack you or your allies unless forced to do so by a higher magical effect.

effectDetails.title: Protective Instinct
effectDetails.rules: While the serum is active, any beast under your command that is within 30 feet of you treats you as its primary charge. These beasts will use their reactions to intercept attacks directed at you or move to shield you from harm whenever possible.

animatopia_apex_dominance_serum.levelRequirementReason: The serum's potency to command high-CR beasts requires a high level of physiological and mental fortitude.
animatopia_apex_dominance_serum.vendorReason: The scientists at Animatopia are the primary developers of pheromonal dominance technology.
animatopia_apex_dominance_serum.shippingDetail: The serum is delivered in a temperature-controlled, pressurized syringe to maintain chemical stability.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires, the user falls unconscious, or the serum is washed out of the system by a high-level restoration spell.
usage.charges: One-time use; the vial is destroyed upon injection.

animatopia_apex_dominance_serum.priceReason: The price was adjusted from 280,000 XP to a more standard legendary tier for a single-use high-impact consumable.

animatopia_apex_eggs.name: Animatopia Apex Hatchling Eggs
animatopia_apex_eggs.description: These Animatopia Apex Hatchling Eggs are large, pulsating shells designed to gestate juvenile apex predators. Crafted by the master scientists of Animatopia, these eggs are shipped in specialized heated tanks to ensure viability.

effectDetails.title: Apex Predator Hatching
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may crack open one egg to hatch a juvenile apex predator (CR 5). The creature is friendly to you and your allies, and it treats any creature hostile to you as an enemy. You can hatch a total of 1d4 creatures from the clutch.

effectDetails.title: Incubation Requirement
effectDetails.rules: The eggs require a specialized incubator and 7 days of uninterrupted warmth to hatch. If the eggs are moved from the incubator or lose heat during this time, the hatching process fails and the eggs are destroyed.

animatopia_apex_eggs.levelRequirementReason: Summoning multiple CR 5 creatures provides significant combat power suitable only for high-level play.
animatopia_apex_eggs.vendorReason: The scientist is the primary creator and authorized distributor of these bio-engineered specimens.
animatopia_apex_eggs.shippingDetail: The shipment arrives in a pressurized, temperature-controlled container that must be plugged into a heat source upon delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The eggs are cracked or the incubation period is completed.
usage.charges: 1d4 uses (limited to the contents of the clutch)

animatopia_apex_eggs.priceReason: The price reflects the extreme rarity and the high CR of the resulting creatures.

animatopia_apex_lure.name: Animatopia Apex Predator Lure
animatopia_apex_lure.description: The Animatopia Apex Predator Lure is a pressurized vial containing a highly synthesized pheromone. This volatile substance is engineered by Animatopia scientists to emit a potent biological signal that draws high-level predators to a specific coordinate.

effectDetails.title: Apex Predator Summoning
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you shatter the vial. For the next 1 hour, a creature of Challenge Rating 10 or higher that is a predator (such as a Behir, Chimera, or Drake) within 5 miles must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or begin traveling toward your current location. The creature will not attack until it is within 60 feet of you.

effectDetails.title: Guaranteed Encounter
effectDetails.rules: The lure ensures that at least one predator arrives within the 1-hour window. If no predator is naturally present in the region, the pheromones are potent enough to draw one from the nearest habitable wilderness or neighboring territory.

animatopia_apex_lure.levelRequirementReason: The high CR of the summoned predator poses a lethal threat to lower-level adventurers.
animatopia_apex_lure.vendorReason: The scientist is the primary engineer of these synthetic pheromones.
animatopia_apex_lure.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-pressure pneumatic injection to ensure the volatile chemicals remain stable.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the 1-hour duration expires or the predator reaches your location.
usage.charges: One-time use; the vial is destroyed upon shattering.

animatopia_apex_lure.priceReason: Adjusted from 45,000 to a more standard legendary-tier gold equivalent for a single-use high-risk summoning.

animatopia_apex_venom.name: Apex Predator Venom (Liquidated)
animatopia_apex_venom.description: This Apex Predator Venom is a viscous, neon-green liquidated concentrate derived from a dozen different apex predators. Synthesized by the masters at Animatopia, this substance is designed to bypass the natural defenses of even the most resilient beasts.

effectDetails.title: Venomous Coating
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a weapon coated in this liquid, the target takes an additional 6d8 poison damage. This damage ignores resistance to poison damage.

effectDetails.title: Paralytic Strike
effectDetails.rules: On a successful hit, the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be Paralyzed for 1d4 rounds. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

animatopia_apex_venom.levelRequirementReason: The potency of the venom requires a high level of physical fortitude to handle without self-inflicted harm.
animatopia_apex_venom.vendorReason: The Animatopia scientist is the primary chemist capable of stabilizing such volatile biological components.
animatopia_apex_venom.shippingDetail: The venom is transported in a pressurized cryo-vial to prevent evaporation and maintain chemical stability.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The liquid is exhausted upon application to a weapon.

animatopia_apex_venom.priceReason: The price was adjusted to reflect a legendary consumable's market value while remaining within a standard high-level gold-to-XP conversion.

animatopia_bio_weapon_release.name: Animatopia Bio-Weapon Release (Targeted Species)
animatopia_bio_weapon_release.description: The Animatopia Bio-Weapon Release is a pressurized canister containing a custom-engineered plague designed by Animatopia scientists. This volatile biological agent is intended to be deployed into a specific habitat to systematically target a chosen species.

effectDetails.title: Targeted Pathogen Deployment
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you release the canister into a 1,000-foot radius. Choose one creature type (e.g., Goblin, Orc, Undead). For the next 24 hours, any creature of that type that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 4d10 poison damage and become Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Mutagenic Backlash
effectDetails.rules: When the canister is first opened, there is a 1-in-6 chance of a mutation surge. If this occurs, the area becomes Difficult Terrain, and any creature (including the user) that starts its turn in the area takes 2d6 force damage as the environment warps.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Corruption
effectDetails.rules: The area affected by the plague remains hazardous for 7 days. During this time, any plant life in the area withers and turns gray, and any creature that dies within the area has its corpse animate as a Shambling Mound (CR 5) 1 hour after death.

animatopia_bio_weapon_release.levelRequirementReason: The scale of biological warfare and environmental destruction is only manageable by high-level adventurers.
animatopia_bio_weapon_release.vendorReason: The Animatopia scientists are the only ones with the specialized labs required to synthesize these pathogens.
animatopia_bio_weapon_release.shippingDetail: Must be delivered via a lead-lined, pressurized transport pod with a 48-hour transit delay for safety checks.

usage.duration: 24 hours
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the area is cleansed by a 7th-level 'Purify Food and Drink' spell cast at 7th level.

animatopia_bio_weapon_release.priceReason: Reduced from 500,000 XP to reflect a high-tier legendary cost while maintaining its status as a game-altering siege tool.

animatopia_bio_weapon_research.name: Animatopia Bio-Weapon Research (Custom)
animatopia_bio_weapon_research.description: Animatopia Bio-Weapon Research is a confidential dossier of genetic engineering protocols. This lab report provides the blueprints for a tailored plague designed to devastate a specific creature type.

effectDetails.title: Targeted Pathogen Engineering
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can expend the research to create a plague targeting one specific creature type (e.g., Undead, Dragons, Orcs). For 1d4 days, any creature of that type within 100 feet of an infected host must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the start of its turn or take 4d6 necrotic damage and become Poisoned. The effect ends if the host dies or the research is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Biological Sample Requirement
effectDetails.rules: To activate this research, you must provide the Animatopia scientists with a physical sample of the target species' DNA or tissue, obtained through a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) or Intelligence (Arcana) check during a previous encounter.

animatopia_bio_weapon_research.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of bio-weapon engineering requires a high level of magical and scientific mastery.
animatopia_bio_weapon_research.vendorReason: The Animatopia scientists are the primary engineers of these biological pathogens.
animatopia_bio_weapon_research.shippingDetail: Delivered via secure, lead-lined courier to prevent premature infection or detection.

usage.duration: 1d4 days
usage.endsWhen: When the host dies, the duration expires, or the research is destroyed.
usage.charges: Single use; the research is destroyed upon activation.

animatopia_bio_weapon_research.priceReason: The price reflects the extreme rarity and high-tier danger of a legendary bio-weapon.

animatopia_buried_soul_key.name: Buried Soul Key
animatopia_buried_soul_key.description: The Buried Soul Key is a rusted iron skeleton key recovered from the ruins near Noki Bay. Its jagged teeth are etched with tribal markings, designed to unlock the sealed burial sites of forgotten peoples.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Tribal Seals
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can insert the Buried Soul Key into a sealed tribal shrine or burial site door. The key automatically unlocks the mechanism, granting access to the interior.

effectDetails.title: Echo of the Buried
effectDetails.rules: When the key unlocks a door, roll a d20. On a 1, a cursed echo manifests; all creatures within 10 feet of the door must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 necrotic damage.

effectDetails.title: Ritual Cleansing
effectDetails.rules: Before the key can be used to unlock a door, it must be cleansed. Spend 1 minute performing a cleansing ritual; if the ritual is skipped, the user takes 1d4 necrotic damage automatically upon use.

animatopia_buried_soul_key.levelRequirementReason: The key is a common utility item suitable for early-game exploration of ruins.
animatopia_buried_soul_key.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in relics and artifacts from forgotten eras.
animatopia_buried_soul_key.shippingDetail: Delivered via heavy-duty crate to ensure the relic remains undisturbed during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The key is destroyed or lost

animatopia_buried_soul_key.priceReason: The price reflects its utility as a key item for progression-based exploration.

animatopia_cartoon_anvil_premium.name: Animatopia Cartoon Anvil
animatopia_cartoon_anvil_premium.description: The Animatopia Cartoon Anvil is a heavy, matte-black iron weight forged by the Toon Forges. Despite its solid appearance, it behaves with impossible physics, often emitting a comical 'boing' sound upon impact.

effectDetails.title: Toon Drop
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can throw the anvil at a creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The target's position is flattened vertically for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Comical Impact
effectDetails.rules: When the anvil hits a surface or creature, it emits a loud, rubbery 'boing' sound. This sound does not provide a mechanical bonus but alerts all creatures within 60 feet to the anvil's location.

effectDetails.title: Heavy Burden
effectDetails.rules: Due to its cartoon weight, the anvil counts as heavy object; while carrying it, you have disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb, swim, or jump.

animatopia_cartoon_anvil_premium.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for early-game use by limiting the damage die and range.
animatopia_cartoon_anvil_premium.vendorReason: The studio specializes in items that defy the laws of physics and reality.
animatopia_cartoon_anvil_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered in a reinforced crate that occasionally vibrates or whistles during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The anvil lands on a surface or target.

animatopia_cartoon_anvil_premium.priceReason: Reduced from 11,500 to reflect an uncommon item with low damage output and high utility.

animatopia_cartoon_cereal_recipe.name: Recipe: Animatopia Cartoon Cereal
animatopia_cartoon_cereal_recipe.description: This Recipe: Animatopia Cartoon Cereal provides instructions for a sugary breakfast that makes you 'toon up' with energy. Crafted by the Toon Chefs, the recipe requires mixing flakes and milk to produce a bowl of snaps, crackles, and pops.

effectDetails.title: Bouncy Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can consume a bowl of cereal to gain a +1d4 bonus to the next Dexterity check you make within 1 minute. This effect applies only to the first check made.

effectDetails.title: Sugar Rush
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming the cereal, you gain advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics checks for 30 minutes. During this time, your movement speed increases by 10 feet, but you have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

animatopia_cartoon_cereal_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The item is a consumable recipe and does not require high-level character progression.
animatopia_cartoon_cereal_recipe.vendorReason: Animatopia Studio is the primary source for toon-themed culinary items.
animatopia_cartoon_cereal_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered in a moisture-sealed container to ensure the flakes remain crunchy.

usage.duration: 30 minutes
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the user finishes a Long Rest.
usage.charges: One use per bowl of cereal prepared.

animatopia_cartoon_cereal_recipe.priceReason: Adjusted to reflect an uncommon consumable rather than a high-level artifact.

animatopia_cartoon_gloves.name: Animatopia Cartoon Gloves
animatopia_cartoon_gloves.description: These white Animatopia Cartoon Gloves are crafted from a peculiar, elastic fabric that stretches with impossible fluidity. Designed by the Toon Animators, the gloves emit a high-pitched squeak whenever they strike a surface.

effectDetails.title: Slapstick Reach
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee weapon attack using a grappling maneuver, you can extend the gloves to reach up to 5 feet further than your normal reach. This property can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Comedic Performance
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks made to perform slapstick comedy or physical gags.

effectDetails.title: Squeaky Contact
effectDetails.rules: Whenever these gloves strike a solid surface or a creature, they emit a loud, comical squeak. This does not change the damage dealt but may provide a disadvantage to the target's next Stealth check made within 1 minute.

animatopia_cartoon_gloves.levelRequirementReason: The item is balanced for all levels as it provides utility rather than raw power.
animatopia_cartoon_gloves.vendorReason: As the creators of the gloves, the studio is the primary source for toon-themed gear.
animatopia_cartoon_gloves.shippingDetail: The item arrives stretched out and snaps into its proper shape upon opening the package.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Ends after one use per long rest for the reach property.

animatopia_cartoon_gloves.priceReason: Reduced from 11,500 to reflect an uncommon utility item rather than a high-tier artifact.

animatopia_chain_chomp_courier_pack.name: Chain Chomp Courier Pack
animatopia_chain_chomp_courier_pack.description: This Chain Chomp Courier Pack is a rugged, heavy-duty satchel designed for rapid transit across dangerous territories. Crafted by the Chain Chomp Courier, the pack is reinforced with enchanted leather to secure cursed goods and hidden secrets.

effectDetails.title: Sneaky Transit
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the pack, you gain a +1d4 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while moving at a normal pace.

effectDetails.title: Evasive Maneuver
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you can use the pack's internal stabilizers to gain a +2 bonus to your AC against that specific instance of damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Vault Breaker
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to attempt to open a mechanical lock or hidden vault. You have Advantage on this check, but the pack's internal mechanisms are loud, potentially alerting nearby creatures within 60 feet.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Spill
effectDetails.rules: If the pack is dropped or forcibly removed from your person, roll a d4. On a 1-2, a burst of chaotic energy deals 1d6 necrotic damage to all creatures within 5 feet of the pack.

animatopia_chain_chomp_courier_pack.levelRequirementReason: The pack's weight and complex locking mechanisms require a character with basic martial or rogue training.
animatopia_chain_chomp_courier_pack.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in high-durability courier equipment and anomalous goods.
animatopia_chain_chomp_courier_pack.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-speed courier; items may arrive with minor scuffing or lingering magical residue.

usage.duration: Variable
usage.endsWhen: Effect concludes or pack is discarded

animatopia_chain_chomp_courier_pack.priceReason: Reduced from 2000 to align with standard uncommon utility item pricing for a non-magical-weapon item.

animatopia_chimeric_hybrid.name: Animatopia Apex Chimeric Hybrid (Companion)
animatopia_chimeric_hybrid.description: The Animatopia Apex Chimeric Hybrid is a custom-bred, stable companion creature synthesized from the genetic traits of two apex predators. This beastly marvel serves as a loyal guardian, possessing the raw power of a lion and the predatory instincts of a chimera.

effectDetails.title: Apex Predator Companion
effectDetails.rules: You gain a CR 15 companion creature. The DM provides a stat block featuring versatile predator abilities. The companion acts on your initiative and follows your commands.

effectDetails.title: Loyal Sentience
effectDetails.rules: The companion possesses animal intelligence and is permanently loyal to you. It cannot be charmed or commanded by others while within 60 feet of you.

effectDetails.title: Regenerative Vitality
effectDetails.rules: The companion is immortal; at the start of each of its turns, it regains 15 hit points if it has at least 1 hit point remaining. This effect is suppressed if the creature is under the effect of the 'Slow' spell.

animatopia_chimeric_hybrid.levelRequirementReason: A CR 15 companion is capable of overwhelming low-level parties and requires high-level characters to manage.
animatopia_chimeric_hybrid.vendorReason: The Animatopia scientist is the only one with the genetic expertise to breed such a hybrid.
animatopia_chimeric_hybrid.shippingDetail: The creature arrives in a pressurized, climate-controlled pod that must be opened in a secure facility.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: The companion's immortality is suppressed or the creature is permanently destroyed by a 'Power Word Kill' spell.

animatopia_chimeric_hybrid.priceReason: The price reflects the godly rarity and the extreme cost of high-level genetic engineering.

animatopia_cursed_candy.name: Candy of the Hollowed Heart
animatopia_cursed_candy.description: The Candy of the Hollowed Heart is a deceptively sweet confection crafted by the last survivor of the Shy Guys’ union protest. This cursed treat glows with a faint, sickly light and carries the bitter taste of a 'payroll' debt from the night.

effectDetails.title: Soul-Siphoning Vitality
effectDetails.rules: When you consume this candy as an action, you gain 3d6 temporary hit points. Immediately after, you must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw; on a failure, you take 1d6 necrotic damage and lose 1 level of experience (or a permanent -1 to your next three ability checks) as the 'soul cost' is extracted.

effectDetails.title: Phantom Echo
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, roll a d100. On a result of 1-50, a whispering phantom appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you for 1 minute, mimicking your last memory in a distorted voice.

effectDetails.title: Onyx Vision
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, roll a d10. On a result of 1, you gain the ability to see the true face of the Onyx Hand for 1 hour.

animatopia_cursed_candy.levelRequirementReason: The high risk of experience loss and the legendary nature of the Onyx Hand vision require a high level of maturity.
animatopia_cursed_candy.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in cursed and high-rarity curiosities from the Shy Guy territories.
animatopia_cursed_candy.shippingDetail: Delivered in a reinforced crate to prevent the candy from dissolving or escaping its packaging.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Vitality) / 1 Hour (Vision)
usage.endsWhen: The candy is consumed; effects end after their specified duration.

animatopia_cursed_candy.priceReason: Reduced from 4000 because the item is a known scam with high risk of negative consequences.

animatopia_festival_star_satchel.name: Festival Star Satchel
animatopia_festival_star_satchel.description: The Festival Star Satchel is a pouch woven from shimmering starlight threads collected during the Festival of Falling Stars. Crafted by the Shine Sprite Guild, it glows with a soft luminescence and carries a slight weight penalty of 5 lbs.

effectDetails.title: Token Scavenging
effectDetails.rules: While holding this satchel, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to locate hidden festival tokens in festive environments.

effectDetails.title: Memory Revelation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may expend one festival token from the satchel to gain a glimpse of a memory fragment of Peach. This grants you a +2 bonus to your next Charisma (Persuasion) check made within the next 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Luminous Guidance
effectDetails.rules: The satchel emits a soft light in a 10-foot radius. This light is dim and can be suppressed by using an action to cover the opening of the pouch.

animatopia_festival_star_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The satchel's magical properties are tuned for mid-level adventurers exploring the Isle Delfino.
animatopia_festival_star_satchel.vendorReason: Animatopia is the primary source for festive and whimsical artifacts.
animatopia_festival_star_satchel.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-speed courier; arrives within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.duration: Permanent/10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: The light is suppressed by covering the pouch; the memory bonus ends after 10 minutes.
usage.charges: Unlimited (Memory Revelation requires a physical token)

animatopia_festival_star_satchel.priceReason: Reduced slightly from 1200 XP to align with standard uncommon utility item scaling.

animatopia_feywild_cloak.name: Feywild Cloak of Echoes
animatopia_feywild_cloak.description: The Feywild Cloak of Echoes is a shimmering garment woven from the dreams of trickster spirits and the echoes of forgotten Fey courts. Its iridescent fabric shifts colors as it absorbs ambient magic, allowing the wearer to phase subtly between the mundane and the wild.

effectDetails.title: Evasion of Magic
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to AC against any attack roll made by a creature using a spell or magical effect. This effect is passive while the cloak is worn.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from creatures that can perceive you. This effect is passive while the cloak is worn.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Whispers
effectDetails.rules: While you are in a Feywild zone, you can hear the whispers of spirits. You have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect hidden creatures or magical traps within 60 feet.

effectDetails.title: Backlash Curse
effectDetails.rules: If the cloak takes more than 20 points of damage in a single hit, you are cursed for 1 hour. Whenever you make an attack roll, there is a 5% chance (roll a d20; a 1 triggers the effect) that the attack misses and you take 1d6 force damage from a magical backlash.

animatopia_feywild_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak requires a high enough spiritual resonance to prevent the trickster spirits from overwhelming the wearer's mind.
animatopia_feywild_cloak.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in items that bridge the gap between the mechanical and the magical.
animatopia_feywild_cloak.shippingDetail: Delivered via a fold in space; the package may appear to vibrate or hum during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: Removed by the wearer or the wearer falls unconscious

animatopia_feywild_cloak.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity of Feywild materials and the high utility of the evasion bonuses.

animatopia_feywild_heartstone.name: Feywild Heartstone
animatopia_feywild_heartstone.description: The Feywild Heartstone is a glowing orb buried deep within the roots of the Raventree Manor’s Feywild layer. This pulse of a forgotten forest deity echoes with the whispers of ancient trees and serves as a beacon for those connected to the Grand Country’s vertical forests.

effectDetails.title: Fey Sight
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Perception checks made to see through fey illusions. This effect is constant while the stone is held.

effectDetails.title: Fey Resonance Burst
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from a creature within 30 feet, roll a d20. On a 1-4, the Heartstone releases a pulse; all enemies within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be Confused (as per the spell) until the end of their next turn.

animatopia_feywild_heartstone.levelRequirementReason: The item's ability to disrupt the minds of nearby foes requires a level of experience to handle its volatile nature.
animatopia_feywild_heartstone.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in items that bridge the gap between the natural and the mystical.
animatopia_feywild_heartstone.shippingDetail: Delivered via heavy-duty courier to ensure the orb's resonance doesn't disrupt local flora during transit.

usage.activation: Passive for Fey Sight; Automatic on taking damage for Resonance Burst
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Burst)
usage.endsWhen: The Resonance Burst ends after the target's next turn; Fey Sight is constant.
usage.charges: Unlimited (Resonance Burst is triggered by a die roll, not a charge)

animatopia_feywild_heartstone.priceReason: The high price reflects its rarity and the significant utility provided by the Perception bonus and crowd control.

animatopia_genetic_reset.name: Animatopia Genetic Reset
animatopia_genetic_reset.description: The Animatopia Genetic Reset is a concentrated chemical bath formulated by the master scientists of Animatopia to undo biological tampering. This iridescent fluid, shipped in a reinforced Containment Tank, safely reverts artificial mutations back to a creature's natural state.

effectDetails.title: Mutation Reversion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you pour the chemical bath over a creature within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the mutation is neutralized; on a failure, the mutation is removed but the target takes 4d10 necrotic damage as their cells restructure.

effectDetails.title: Base Stat Restoration
effectDetails.rules: The target's physical attributes (Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution) immediately return to their original base values as recorded before any genetic alteration occurred. This effect is instantaneous and cannot be undone.

animatopia_genetic_reset.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of reversing high-level genetic tampering requires significant biological expertise.
animatopia_genetic_reset.vendorReason: The Animatopia scientists are the primary developers of genetic modification and reversal technologies.
animatopia_genetic_reset.shippingDetail: Must be transported in a pressurized, lead-lined tank to prevent chemical evaporation or leakage.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The chemical bath is expended upon use.
usage.charges: Single use; the item is destroyed after one application.

animatopia_genetic_reset.priceReason: Reduced from 150,000 XP to reflect a balanced legendary consumable price for high-level play.

animatopia_heart_of_the_cheep_cheep.name: Heart of the Cheep-Cheep
animatopia_heart_of_the_cheep_cheep.description: The Heart of the Cheep-Cheep is a pulsating, organic artifact forged by the Cheep-Cheep Accords Alliance. It resonates with a rhythmic harmony and emits a faint, melodic toad voice when active.

effectDetails.title: Harmonious Healing
effectDetails.rules: While the item is active, any creature within 10 feet of the wielder who receives healing from a spell or magical effect regains an additional 20% of that healing amount as extra HP.

effectDetails.title: Rhythmic Precision
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 30 feet of the wielder gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls. This bonus is ignored if the target is a hostile creature.

effectDetails.title: Discordant Feedback
effectDetails.rules: If the wielder uses this item to affect a creature that is not an ally, the wielder must roll 1d2 on the Wild Magic Surge table (or take 1d6 psychic damage) as the harmony fractures.

animatopia_heart_of_the_cheep_cheep.levelRequirementReason: The artifact's resonance requires a high enough mental fortitude to handle the toad-tribe's collective harmony.
animatopia_heart_of_the_cheep_cheep.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in artifacts of biological and mechanical harmony.
animatopia_heart_of_the_cheep_cheep.shippingDetail: Delivered via a high-speed pursuit; the package may arrive with slight bite marks.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The user finishes a long rest or the heart's pulse fades.
usage.charges: Unlimited use, but expires if Mages Guild agents are within 60 feet.

animatopia_heart_of_the_cheep_cheep.priceReason: The price reflects its rare status and the significant utility provided to a party's healing and accuracy.

animatopia_hybridization_guide.name: Animatopia Hybridization Guide (Advanced)
animatopia_hybridization_guide.description: The Animatopia Hybridization Guide (Advanced) is a heavy, leather-bound tome containing complex schematics for merging apex DNA. These meticulous instructions, authored by Animatopia's lead researchers, are marked with a distinct 🧬 icon on the cover.

effectDetails.title: Hybrid Creation
effectDetails.rules: During a long rest, you can expend the guide to create one stable hybrid creature. You choose two apex species; the DM determines the creature's stats based on a combination of their traits. The creature remains loyal to you for 24 hours or until it reaches natural death.

effectDetails.title: Component Requirement
effectDetails.rules: To activate the guide, you must spend 500gp worth of rare flora or fauna components per creation attempt. Failure to provide sufficient materials results in the guide remaining unusable for 1d4 days.

animatopia_hybridization_guide.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of apex DNA manipulation requires high-level magical and biological proficiency.
animatopia_hybridization_guide.vendorReason: The scientist is the primary author and authorized distributor of Animatopia's biological research.
animatopia_hybridization_guide.shippingDetail: The guide is delivered in a magically sealed, heavy-duty crate to prevent unauthorized reading.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The guide is destroyed upon use

animatopia_hybridization_guide.priceReason: Adjusted from 300,000 to reflect a legendary item's accessible market value while maintaining high rarity.

animatopia_internet_virus_tattoo.name: Internet Virus Tattoo
animatopia_internet_virus_tattoo.description: The Internet Virus Tattoo etches itself into your skin with corrupted data, granting viral meme buffs but risking mental instability. This relic of digital lore offers fleeting boosts from internet culture while warning of potential infection.

effectDetails.title: Meme Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, providing +1 to all ability checks and saving throws for the next hour. Recharges after 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Viral Risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance (DC 10) per day of triggering viral infection. If successful, it causes mild mental fatigue that lasts until resting and reduces charisma by -1 for the next 24 hours.

animatopia_internet_virus_tattoo.levelRequirementReason: This tattoo is designed to be accessible for adventurers just starting their journey.
animatopia_internet_virus_tattoo.vendorReason: Animatopia is known for its connection to digital and internet-related relics, making it a logical vendor for this item.
animatopia_internet_virus_tattoo.shippingDetail: Ships within the week with standard delivery.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a short rest or until the duration expires

animatopia_internet_virus_tattoo.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect the item's unique digital lore and temporary utility.

animatopia_iron_gut_belt.name: Iron Gut Belt
animatopia_iron_gut_belt.description: The Iron Gut Belt, forged from the stomachs of ancient beasts, amplifies your fortitude and resilience in combat.

effectDetails.title: Stomach Resilience
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from a melee attack, reduce the damage by 1d4. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Defense
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this belt, you have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone and gain +2 to AC.

animatopia_iron_gut_belt.levelRequirementReason: This belt is designed for beginners to help them build confidence in combat.
animatopia_iron_gut_belt.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in crafting belts that enhance survival and resilience, making it the perfect vendor for this item.
animatopia_iron_gut_belt.shippingDetail: Ships with a Chain Chomp Courier ensuring it arrives safely, even through the most treacherous paths.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: The belt is taken off or destroyed in combat.

animatopia_iron_gut_belt.priceReason: The craftsmanship and materials used make this belt a valuable asset for any adventurer, justifying its cost.

animatopia_item_name_here.name: Scam: Eternal Dreamstone
animatopia_item_name_here.description: The Eternal Dreamstone glows with an ethereal light, promising eternal rest to those who dare embrace its dreams.

effectDetails.title: Dream State Access
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The user gains access to dream state abilities for 1 hour, limited to one use per character.

effectDetails.title: Memory Veil
effectDetails.rules: The user's memories are blurred for 10 minutes, reducing the effectiveness of certain skills by 25%. This effect ends when the duration expires or a successful Wisdom saving throw is made.

animatopia_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: Requires character level 15 to safely access and utilize its dream state abilities.
animatopia_item_name_here.vendorReason: Known for their ethereal and mystical wares, Servants Cosmic offers this unique artifact among their offerings.
animatopia_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Delivered via Koopa Postal's fastest courier service with a 24-hour delivery guarantee.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Dream State Access; no further activation required for Memory Veil effect.
usage.duration: 1 hour for Dream State Access; ends when duration expires or Memory Veil is ended by a successful save.
usage.endsWhen: Duration of effects expire or user makes a Wisdom saving throw against the Memory Veil.

animatopia_item_name_here.priceReason: The price has been adjusted to reflect its reduced functionality and duration, making it more accessible.

animatopia_kivotos_link.name: Halo Gunner’s Quiver
animatopia_kivotos_link.description: This quiver holds five arrows and five spectral bullets, crafted in Land Mordor from arcane materials. It whispers guidance to its wielder, enhancing accuracy and reducing cooldowns.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Shooting Precision
effectDetails.rules: When you fire an arrow or spectral bullet from the quiver, your attack roll has advantage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Faster Special Abilities
effectDetails.rules: You can use a special ability once per long rest without expending a spell slot or resource. Ends when you finish a short or long rest.

animatopia_kivotos_link.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in ranged weapons to fully utilize the quiver's benefits.
animatopia_kivotos_link.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in unique and powerful items from the anime academy, including this quiver.
animatopia_kivotos_link.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral couriers who ensure timely arrival.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when drawing an arrow or spectral bullet.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: You finish a short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the effects end after each use.

animatopia_kivotos_link.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its unique crafting and limited utility without being overpowered.

animatopia_looney_tunes_sandwich_recipe.name: Recipe: Animatopia Looney Tunes Sandwich
animatopia_looney_tunes_sandwich_recipe.description: This recipe yields a sandwich with bread shaped like anvils, served on a platter of laughing clowns. It's Acme quality—no wonder it might fall apart in your hands!

effectDetails.title: Anvil Ancestry
effectDetails.rules: When you eat this sandwich, you gain advantage on one Strength check (anvil power!), but take a -1 penalty to all Strength checks and saving throws until your next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Laughing Bites
effectDetails.rules: Each bite produces a loud boing sound. On each bite after the first, you have disadvantage on perception checks until you take a long rest.

animatopia_looney_tunes_sandwich_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for beginners to experiment with.
animatopia_looney_tunes_sandwich_recipe.vendorReason: Animatopia Studio specializes in whimsical and unique dining experiences, so they naturally carry this odd but delightful sandwich recipe.
animatopia_looney_tunes_sandwich_recipe.shippingDetail: Shipped with a bouncy cushion to ensure the sandwich arrives intact—though it's no guarantee!

usage.duration: Until your next short rest or until you eat another sandwich made by Toon Sandwich Makers
usage.endsWhen: You finish eating or consume another sandwich of similar type from Animatopia Studio

animatopia_looney_tunes_sandwich_recipe.priceReason: The recipe is moderately complex and involves unique Acme-quality ingredients, justifying the price.

animatopia_minus_world_key.name: Minus World Key
animatopia_minus_world_key.description: The Minus World Key is a forgotten artifact from the lost realm of Animatopia, crafted from obsidian and imbued with the essence of shadow. It opens portals to realms where time flows backward, causing travelers to experience fleeting echoes of vanished realities.
effects: Opens a portal to the Minus World

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Portal
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Opens a stable, one-way dimensional portal that lasts for 10 minutes. The user is transported through it upon successful activation. The portal can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: The user experiences temporary disorientation immediately after using the key. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn and has no saving throw to resist.

animatopia_minus_world_key.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to ensure characters have the necessary skills and combat ability to safely use this powerful item.
animatopia_minus_world_key.vendorReason: Animatopia is a hub for exotic items from lost realms, making it logical for them to stock such a unique artifact.
animatopia_minus_world_key.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Hammer Bros. Express Courier service with a one-day transit time.

usage.duration: 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: The portal closes at the end of its duration or when the user exits through it.

animatopia_minus_world_key.priceReason: Balanced to provide a unique experience without overwhelming the party.

animatopia_moonlit_bell.name: Moonlit Bell
animatopia_moonlit_bell.description: The Moonlit Bell chimes a lunar melody that echoes through the night, enhancing your stealth and combat prowess under the moonlight.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Combat Boost
effectDetails.rules: Grants +1 to all attack rolls and damage rolls made during nighttime. Must be used during a night combat scenario.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth
effectDetails.rules: Increases the DC of Dexterity (Stealth) checks by -2, effectively granting advantage on such checks when used in dark environments.

animatopia_moonlit_bell.levelRequirementReason: This bell is crafted with simple magic suitable for beginners.
animatopia_moonlit_bell.vendorReason: Animatopia is known for its diverse and magical items that cater to all adventurers, regardless of their skill level.
animatopia_moonlit_bell.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Chain Chomp Couriers' express service with a guaranteed moonlit delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day

animatopia_moonlit_bell.priceReason: The bell's rarity and the complexity of its magic, requiring a full day to craft, justify its increased price.

animatopia_moonlit_scarf.name: Moonlit Scarf of Whispering Night
animatopia_moonlit_scarf.description: The Moonlit Scarf of Whispering Night shimmers under moonlight, weaving whispers into the darkness. Woven from the dreamsilk of ancient moon cultists, it enhances stealth and confounds predators.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: When worn in complete darkness, this scarf grants +2 to Stealth checks. It also provides a +1 bonus to saving throws against fear and charm effects for nearby creatures within 10 feet.

effectDetails.title: Predator Confusion
effectDetails.rules: For every hour the scarf is worn in darkness, it causes nearby nocturnal predators to emit a low-frequency hum. This effect lasts until the wearer moves out of total darkness or the scarf's duration ends. Creatures within 30 feet have disadvantage on attack rolls against the wearer.

animatopia_moonlit_scarf.levelRequirementReason: Requires lower level due to reduced stealth and predator interaction effects.
animatopia_moonlit_scarf.vendorReason: Animatopia is known for their unique and magical items, making this scarf a fitting addition to their offerings.
animatopia_moonlit_scarf.shippingDetail: Ships with a special moonlight delivery seal ensuring safe arrival under dark skies.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn in complete darkness.
usage.duration: 1 hour per use, recharges after 24 hours of non-use.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the wearer moves out of total darkness or the scarf's charges are exhausted.

animatopia_moonlit_scarf.priceReason: Balanced price for a versatile and unique item with stealth and predator interaction benefits.

animatopia_mushroom_tongue.name: Mushroom Tongue
animatopia_mushroom_tongue.description: The Mushroom Tongue is a relic that whispers secrets of the Fungi Civil War. It grants speech to fungal entities and reveals hidden tunnels beneath the Mushroom Kingdom's soil.

effectDetails.title: Speech Grant
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this relic bestows temporary speech upon fungal entities. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and may cause hallucinations if used by someone unfamiliar with it.

effectDetails.title: Tunnel Revelation
effectDetails.rules: The relic reveals hidden tunnels beneath the Mushroom Kingdom for 10 minutes after consumption, allowing the user to navigate through them easily. This effect is not usable more than once per day.

animatopia_mushroom_tongue.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 2nd level to use due to its potent effects and potential for disorientation.
animatopia_mushroom_tongue.vendorReason: Animatopia, a relic dealer with extensive knowledge of the Mushroom Kingdom's history, specializes in such items from past conflicts.
animatopia_mushroom_tongue.shippingDetail: Ships via special underground tunnel delivery to ensure safe arrival at your doorstep.

usage.duration: 10 minutes or until the user loses consciousness due to hallucinations
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon the user's next turn after losing consciousness from hallucinations
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by 1 use per day

animatopia_mushroom_tongue.priceReason: Reflects its historical significance and unique abilities that make it a valuable tool for adventurers.

animatopia_onyx_hand_trophy.name: Onyx Hand Trophy of Bureaucratic Horror
animatopia_onyx_hand_trophy.description: The Onyx Hand Trophy of Bureaucratic Horror is a cursed relic crafted from volcanic obsidian. It whispers tales of forgotten debt collectors and their endless demands.

effectDetails.title: Bureaucratic Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: When used as an action, the wielder gains a +3 bonus to Persuasion checks against vampiric bureaucracies. The effect ends if the user is reduced to 0 hit points.

effectDetails.title: Cripple Nonhumans
effectDetails.rules: As an action, consume 1 charge to temporarily blind all nonhuman entities within a 10-foot radius for 1 minute. Creatures affected can make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) to end the effect early.

animatopia_onyx_hand_trophy.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 7th level to wield, ensuring it is used responsibly.
animatopia_onyx_hand_trophy.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in exotic and cursed artifacts from lost realms.
animatopia_onyx_hand_trophy.shippingDetail: Ships via express courier with a 1-day delivery guarantee.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Bureaucratic Persuasion; 1 minute for Cripple Nonhumans
usage.endsWhen: The user is reduced to 0 hit points, the effect ends if the target makes a successful save.

animatopia_onyx_hand_trophy.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers unique and powerful effects that are not easily replicated.

animatopia_predator_horn.name: Predator Horn of the Delfino Wild
animatopia_predator_horn.description: The Predator Horn of the Delfino Wild resonates with ancient predator magic. It can summon a feral spirit that amplifies aggression and attracts prey within its radius.

effectDetails.title: Summon Feral Spirit
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The horn emits a primal roar, summoning a feral spirit that grants the user advantage on attack rolls until the start of their next turn. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Attract Prey
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action within 100 yards of a predator. The horn emits a call that attracts nearby prey, forcing any creature within 30 feet to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the start of the user's next turn.

animatopia_predator_horn.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic understanding of predator behaviors and instincts.
animatopia_predator_horn.vendorReason: Animatopia specializes in relics from ancient tribes, including those of the Delfino Wild.
animatopia_predator_horn.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week with a special courier package.

usage.duration: Until start of next turn for Summon Feral Spirit; until the start of the user's next turn for Attract Prey
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user is incapacitated or the duration expires
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only activate one effect per long rest

animatopia_predator_horn.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its powerful effects and rarity.

animatopia_prey_camouflage_service.name: Animatopia Prey Camouflage Service
animatopia_prey_camouflage_service.description: The Animatopia Prey Camouflage Service is a sleek, leaf-patterned suit designed by the Prey Artists of Animatopia. It allows you to blend seamlessly into natural environments, making it near impossible for predators to spot you in the wild. This service also has a unique feature; while disguised as prey, you have a 50% chance of being ignored by nearby predators, and you might inadvertently attract herbivores who may seek 'friendship' with you.

effectDetails.title: Camouflage
effectDetails.rules: When activated, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in natural environments for up to 8 hours. This effect ends if you leave the natural terrain or are no longer attempting to hide.

effectDetails.title: Herbivore Attraction
effectDetails.rules: While disguised as prey, there is a 50% chance that nearby herbivores will approach you seeking 'friendship'. This effect lasts for the duration of your disguise in natural terrain and ends when it expires or if you actively move away from herbivores.

animatopia_prey_camouflage_service.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to adventurers who are just starting their journey, requiring minimal skill but offering significant tactical advantages.
animatopia_prey_camouflage_service.vendorReason: Animatopia Wilds specializes in products that enhance survival and stealth in natural terrains, making this service a perfect fit for their inventory.
animatopia_prey_camouflage_service.shippingDetail: Delivered directly to your doorstep wrapped in leaves, ensuring the suit remains undamaged during transit.

usage.duration: Up to 8 hours per day
usage.endsWhen: You leave natural terrain or stop attempting to hide, or you use it again on a short rest

animatopia_prey_camouflage_service.priceReason: The service is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique design and the specialized skills required by Prey Artists in Animatopia.

animatopia_prey_fur_cloak.name: Animatopia Prey Fur Cloak
animatopia_prey_fur_cloak.description: The Animatopia Prey Fur Cloak is a seamless garment crafted from the fur of elusive forest creatures. It warms you in cold weather, providing +1 comfort and blending into your surroundings with predator-like precision. The cloak's fur shifts subtly during molting season, a reminder of its wild origins.

effectDetails.title: Cloak Warms
effectDetails.rules: When the temperature drops below 70°F (21°C), the cloak provides +1 comfort. This effect is passive and lasts until your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Blends Like Prey
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this cloak, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when moving like a stealthy predator's prey in natural terrain. The effect ends if you enter an urban environment or if you take damage from an attack.

animatopia_prey_fur_cloak.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective cloak is accessible to lower-level adventurers, enhancing their survival skills.
animatopia_prey_fur_cloak.vendorReason: The Prey Hunters at Animatopia Forest are known for crafting gear that mimics the natural world, making this cloak a fitting product.
animatopia_prey_fur_cloak.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week of order placement. The courier ensures the cloak is carefully packed to prevent any damage during transit.

usage.duration: Until your next long rest or until you enter an urban environment or take damage from an attack.
usage.endsWhen: You enter an urban environment or take damage from an attack.

animatopia_prey_fur_cloak.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the cloak's utility and moderate rarity, making it accessible to first-level characters without breaking the game economy.

animatopia_prey_hide_and_seek_coaching.name: Animatopia Prey Hide-and-Seek Coaching
animatopia_prey_hide_and_seek_coaching.description: The Animatopia Prey Hide-and-Seek Coaching hones your stealth and survival skills in urban environments. For a week, you gain proficiency in Stealth checks within man-made structures and can detect hidden threats more easily. However, when startled, you're compelled to hide, causing disadvantage on Initiative rolls until the next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Mastery
effectDetails.rules: You gain proficiency in Stealth checks within man-made structures for a duration of 7 days. This effect does not grant you advantage if you already have proficiency.

effectDetails.title: Compulsive Hiding
effectDetails.rules: When startled, you are compelled to hide (disadvantage on Initiative rolls). The effect ends when you complete your next short or long rest.

animatopia_prey_hide_and_seek_coaching.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to all players who want to improve their stealth skills.
animatopia_prey_hide_and_seek_coaching.vendorReason: Animatopia Prey School specializes in training and enhancing survival skills, making them the perfect vendor for this service.
animatopia_prey_hide_and_seek_coaching.shippingDetail: Delivered via a shadowy courier who ensures your package arrives without being detected.

usage.duration: 7 days from activation.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next short or long rest after being startled.

animatopia_prey_hide_and_seek_coaching.priceReason: The price reflects a moderate balance for enhancing stealth skills without overpricing this useful utility.

animatopia_prey_predator_evasion_trainin.name: Animatopia Prey Predator Evasion Training
animatopia_prey_predator_evasion_trainin.description: The Animatopia Prey Predator Evasion Training is a unique service that hones your stealth and survival skills in the face of animatronic threats. For 7 days, you gain advantage on Stealth checks against constructs and animatronics. However, this training leaves its mark: for as long as you have the training's effects, you are terrified of music boxes and children’s laughter, affecting your perception and composure.
effects: Advantage on Stealth checks vs. constructs
Terrified of music boxes and children's laughter

effectDetails.title: Stealth Advantage Against Constructs
effectDetails.rules: For a duration of 7 days, you gain advantage on all Stealth checks made against constructs or animatronics. This effect does not stack with other sources of advantage.

effectDetails.title: Fear of Music Boxes and Children’s Laughter
effectDetails.rules: While under the effects of this training, you suffer a -2 penalty to saving throws that involve your reaction to music boxes or children's laughter. This penalty persists until the training's duration expires.

animatopia_prey_predator_evasion_trainin.levelRequirementReason: Beginners need to start with basic survival skills before tackling more complex training.
animatopia_prey_predator_evasion_trainin.vendorReason: Animatopia Prey Survivors specialize in training those who face animatronic threats, ensuring their clients are ready for any encounter.
animatopia_prey_predator_evasion_trainin.shippingDetail: The package is delivered with special couriers known as 'Nightmares', ensuring the service arrives without delay.

usage.duration: 7 days from completion of training.
usage.endsWhen: Upon expiration or when you lose your training due to a failed check.
