assassination_contract.name: Assassination Contract
assassination_contract.description: A blackened parchment with a blood-red seal, this Assassination Contract binds the buyer to a shadowy network of assassins. Once signed and delivered, it targets a specific individual within a six-month window, guaranteeing a 90% chance of success (DM's discretion). The contract ensures deniability for the buyer by concealing their name from the hired killer; failure results in the voiding of all terms, with no trace left behind.

effectDetails.title: Shadowy Guarantee
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The contract targets one specific individual within six months. It has a success rate of at least 90%, determined by the DM. If the target is eliminated, all evidence and involvement are erased.

effectDetails.title: Perfect Deniability
effectDetails.rules: The buyer's name is hidden from the assassin to ensure full deniability in case of failure or suspicion. If the contract fails, it is voided immediately, leaving no trace of the buyer’s involvement.

assassination_contract.levelRequirementReason: Low-level characters with limited resources can afford this item without breaking game balance.
assassination_contract.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand deals in illegal and forbidden items, making this contract a suitable offering.
assassination_contract.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Onyx Hand’s shadowy couriers, ensuring no one can trace the origin or destination of the package.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the target is eliminated or fails
usage.endsWhen: Contract is successfully completed or voided upon failure
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it can be reissued under a new contract

assassination_contract.priceReason: The price reflects the illegal nature of the item and its guaranteed success rate.

assassins_creed_blade.name: Hidden Blade
assassins_creed_blade.description: The Hidden Blade is a slender, intricately crafted dagger forged from obsidian and steel. Its blade can retract into its handle, leaving no trace of its presence in your hand. The weapon's design allows for a surprise attack with advantage on the roll, and it leaves behind only a faint shimmer that can be mistaken for a trick of the light.

effectDetails.title: Surprise Attack
effectDetails.rules: When you use this weapon in a surprise attack, you have advantage on your attack roll. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Retractable
effectDetails.rules: The blade can be retracted into its handle as a bonus action. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity and is limited to three uses per short or long rest.

assassins_creed_blade.levelRequirementReason: This weapon is designed for novice assassins who are still mastering the art of stealth.
assassins_creed_blade.vendorReason: The Rogue Port Black Market caters to those seeking unique and powerful tools for their trade, including novices as well as seasoned professionals.
assassins_creed_blade.shippingDetail: Ships via Nightwind Couriers; delivery is swift but requires a signature upon arrival.

usage.activation: Bonus action to retract the blade
usage.duration: Instantaneous (retraction)
usage.endsWhen: Start of your next turn or when retracted for the third time per rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to three uses per short or long rest

assassins_creed_blade.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its rarity and utility, providing a cost-effective advantage for players of all levels.

astral_projection_beacon.name: Astral Projection Beacon
astral_projection_beacon.description: The Astral Projection Beacon is a gleaming silver rod etched with githyanki runes. This artifact anchors your soul to the Material Plane, preventing it from drifting into the Ethereal Plane when you cast Astral Projection. Should you perish in the Astral Plane, this beacon ensures a swift return to your physical body, sparing your life on the Material Plane.

effectDetails.title: Astral Anchoring
effectDetails.rules: When you cast Astral Projection using this item, your soul is securely anchored to the Material Plane. You can move freely in the Astral Plane but cannot be drawn into the Ethereal Plane unless you choose to do so.

effectDetails.title: Soul Return
effectDetails.rules: If you are killed while in the Astral Plane and your body remains intact on the Material Plane, this beacon ensures that your soul returns immediately to your body. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges or uses.

astral_projection_beacon.levelRequirementReason: This artifact is accessible early in a character’s journey as it focuses on survival rather than combat prowess.
astral_projection_beacon.vendorReason: Astral Traders specialize in items that aid travelers between planes, making this beacon an essential commodity for their clientele.
astral_projection_beacon.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly via Thought Sending, ensuring the artifact arrives as soon as it is purchased.

usage.activation: Activates with the casting of Astral Projection
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until you choose to return or until your body is destroyed
usage.endsWhen: If your body is destroyed on the Material Plane, both effects are nullified

astral_projection_beacon.priceReason: The price reflects its utility in survival and the intricate craftsmanship of Githyanki Warlocks.

astral_projection_orb.name: Astral Projection Orb (Psionic)
astral_projection_orb.description: The Astral Projection Orb is a glowing orb of shimmering light, crafted by the enigmatic Astral Nomads. It allows you to safely project your astral form into other planes without risking your physical body. The orb's protective sheath ensures that your spirit remains shielded from harm during the journey.

effectDetails.title: Astral Projection
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the orb to project your astral form into another plane. The projection lasts for a number of hours equal to twice your spellcasting ability modifier (rounded down). You return immediately if you are incapacitated or killed during the journey.

effectDetails.title: Body Protection
effectDetails.rules: While projected, your physical body is protected by a force field that grants it immunity to all damage until you return from the other plane. The orb can be used once before it needs to be recharged.

astral_projection_orb.levelRequirementReason: This item requires minimal magic usage and is intended for beginning explorers.
astral_projection_orb.vendorReason: The Plane Walkers Guild specializes in exotic travel items, including those that facilitate astral travel.
astral_projection_orb.shippingDetail: Ships via Silver Cord's interdimensional express service with a guaranteed delivery of three days or less.

usage.duration: Up to 8 hours (twice your spellcasting ability modifier)
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or death during the journey, or when you return from the other plane

astral_projection_orb.priceReason: The orb is priced at 1000 XP as it is a reliable and essential tool for beginners in astral travel.

avalon_court_fairy_nectar_drink_recipe.name: Recipe: Avalon Court Fairy Nectar Drink
avalon_court_fairy_nectar_drink_recipe.description: A delicate recipe for Avalon Court Fairy Nectar Drink, a sparkling elixir made from fey flowers that grants the drinker an enchanting presence. Sipped during courtly toasts, this nectar infuses the imbiber with a minor charm aura and the ability to gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks against fey creatures for three hours.

effectDetails.title: Infuse Flowers
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the drinker can prepare a serving of the nectar. It takes 20 minutes to infuse flowers into the drink. Once infused, it grants the imbiber advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks against fey creatures for three hours.

effectDetails.title: Minor Charm Aura
effectDetails.rules: The drinker gains a minor charm aura that lasts until dispelled or the drinker is attacked or attacks. This aura provides a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against creatures within 30 feet.

avalon_court_fairy_nectar_drink_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe requires knowledge of fey magic and courtly etiquette, which are typically learned at higher levels.
avalon_court_fairy_nectar_drink_recipe.vendorReason: The garden is known for its enchanted flora and the mixologists who can create this nectar from their flowers.
avalon_court_fairy_nectar_drink_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fey courier, ensuring the drink remains fresh and potent upon arrival.

usage.activation: Infuse Flowers: As an action; Minor Charm Aura: Instantaneous effect lasting until dispelled or interrupted.
usage.duration: Minor Charm Aura lasts for three hours.
usage.endsWhen: The aura ends when dispelled, the drinker is attacked, or attacks.

avalon_court_fairy_nectar_drink_recipe.priceReason: This recipe requires rare ingredients and advanced knowledge, making it moderately priced but still within reach for those who can afford to impress at Avalon Court.

avalon_court_fairy_ring_premium.name: Avalon Court Fairy Ring (Premium)
avalon_court_fairy_ring_premium.description: The Avalon Court Fairy Ring (Premium) is a delicate, enchanted ring made from silver and encrusted with tiny, iridescent gemstones. Crafted by the skilled hands of the Avalon Enchanters, it opens a portal to fey realms. When activated, it teleports you up to 100 miles away to any known fey location, granting you an audience with these whimsical creatures.

effectDetails.title: Ring of Fey Charm
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the ring, you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Deception and Insight) checks against fey creatures. This effect persists for the duration of your interaction with any such creature.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Portal
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Instantaneously teleports you up to 100 miles to any known fey location, provided you have visited it before. The portal lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per week.

avalon_court_fairy_ring_premium.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 6th level to ensure the user has the necessary dexterity and knowledge of the fey realm.
avalon_court_fairy_ring_premium.vendorReason: The Avalon Enchanters are renowned for their craftsmanship, especially in items that facilitate communication with the fey realms.
avalon_court_fairy_ring_premium.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days. Requires a signature upon delivery.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate portal; passive effect for Charisma checks against fey creatures.
usage.duration: 1 minute, once per week
usage.endsWhen: The portal closes after 1 minute or if you leave the fey realm.

avalon_court_fairy_ring_premium.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its powerful teleportation capabilities and the rarity of the materials used.

avalon_court_fey_flower_infuser.name: Avalon Court Fey Flower Infuser
avalon_court_fey_flower_infuser.description: The Avalon Court Fey Flower Infuser is a delicate glass contraption forged by the Court Glassblowers. It captures nectar from fey blooms, ensuring that the flowers never wilt and creating whimsical bubbles in any beverage it infuses. Drinking from this vessel grants +1 Charisma to the imbiber, and it attracts pixies to your vicinity.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: When a creature consumes nectar from the infuser, it gains +1 to its Charisma score until the end of its next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Pixie Attraction
effectDetails.rules: The infuser attracts pixies within 30 feet for 1 hour. The attraction ends if a creature uses an action to dispel it, or when the infuser is destroyed.

avalon_court_fey_flower_infuser.levelRequirementReason: Crafted with intricate glasswork and potent fey magic, this item requires a moderate level of skill to wield effectively.
avalon_court_fey_flower_infuser.vendorReason: The Court Glassblowers are renowned for their craftsmanship and the unique items they produce, making them the perfect vendor for this creation.
avalon_court_fey_flower_infuser.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of tiny pixies who ensure the nectar is fresh upon arrival.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation; no action required to use the infuser.
usage.duration: Until the end of the next short or long rest, or until destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by attack or magic effect that deals fire damage equal to half its price in XP.

avalon_court_fey_flower_infuser.priceReason: Balanced at a lower cost due to the item's limited active effects and duration, ensuring it remains a desirable but not overpowered accessory.

avalon_court_feywing_feather_boa.name: Avalon Court Feywing Feather Boa
avalon_court_feywing_feather_boa.description: A luxurious boa made from the rarest feathers of enchanted birds of Avalon Court. The soft, shimmering plumes not only grant advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks but also allow for brief bursts of flight, propelling you a mere ten feet into the air. This regal accessory is both an adornment and a tool, crafted by the elite fashionistas who serve the court.

effectDetails.title: Enchanted Flight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate this boa to propel yourself up to ten feet into the air. This effect lasts for one minute and requires concentration (as a bonus action each round). You are not subject to falling damage while in flight.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this boa, you gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks against creatures of the fey type. This effect lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

avalon_court_feywing_feather_boa.levelRequirementReason: Crafted for those who seek to charm and fly with grace, this accessory is suitable for players starting their journey.
avalon_court_feywing_feather_boa.vendorReason: As purveyors of the finest enchanted garments, Avalon Court Gala naturally stocks this exquisite boa.
avalon_court_feywing_feather_boa.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost care by Wing Wrap Express, ensuring your boa arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate flight and concentration (bonus action each round).
usage.duration: One minute per activation with concentration required.
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends or you lose your ability score modifier for Charisma.

avalon_court_feywing_feather_boa.priceReason: Balanced at a fair value, this price reflects the rare materials and enchanted workmanship required to create such an item.

bag_of_confetti.name: Bag of Confetti
bag_of_confetti.description: A small leather pouch adorned with tiny paper confetti that shimmers in various colors. It is said to have been crafted by a whimsical artisan who once lived among the clouds, and its use can brighten even the darkest of days. When shaken, it releases a burst of confetti that fills any hole or gap up to 10 feet across, instantly obscuring vision within a 5-foot radius for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Vision Obfuscation
effectDetails.rules: When shaken and released in an area, any creature within a 5-foot radius must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn. This effect has no save after the first use.

effectDetails.title: Instant Fill
effectDetails.rules: Shake the bag to fill up to a 10-foot square hole or gap, requiring no tools and taking no time. The confetti remains until dispelled by magic, natural erosion, or deliberate removal.

bag_of_confetti.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic dexterity to use the bag effectively.
bag_of_confetti.vendorReason: Toad Town Market often stocks items that add a touch of whimsy and utility to adventurers' toolkits.
bag_of_confetti.shippingDetail: Ships via Standard Courier, typically arriving within 3 days.

usage.activation: Shake the bag as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each use.
usage.endsWhen: Disrupted by physical interference or dispelled by magic.

bag_of_confetti.priceReason: Reflects its unique utility and the artisanal craftsmanship required to create such a versatile item.

bag_of_tricks_minor.name: Bag of Tricks (Minor)
bag_of_tricks_minor.description: The Bag of Tricks (Minor) is a curious leather pouch adorned with arcane symbols. It can produce small animal companions, from playful foxes to helpful squirrels, each tailored to assist in your current endeavor. However, the bag often surprises you, occasionally releasing a cat that prefers lounging over leaping into action.

effectDetails.title: Animal Companion
effectDetails.rules: On your action during each short rest, reach into the bag to summon a small beast (CR 1/4 or less) that lasts for one hour. The summoned creature is friendly and follows your simple commands.

effectDetails.title: Surprising Cat
effectDetails.rules: There's a 50% chance that instead of an active helper, the bag will release a cat that simply naps in its corner until dismissed. This effect does not count against the uses per short rest.

bag_of_tricks_minor.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for players who have just begun their adventures and need some assistance.
bag_of_tricks_minor.vendorReason: The Wandering Circus often sells magical items that entertain as much as they assist, making the Bag of Tricks a perfect fit.
bag_of_tricks_minor.shippingDetail: Shipped in a padded box with soft fur lining to protect the bag during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour per short rest, usable once per short rest
usage.endsWhen: The summoned creature disperses when dismissed or its time expires

bag_of_tricks_minor.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its minor utility and occasional unpredictable nature.

bag_of_useless_items.name: Bag of (Mostly) Useless Items
bag_of_useless_items.description: This battered leather bag contains a hodgepodge of curiosities that seem more fit for a traveling fair than an adventuring party. The items within are as random as they are impractical, yet somehow always pertinent to the current situation, even if only in a humorous or bizarre way.
effects: Pulls a random item from the bag

effectDetails.title: Random Item Retrieval
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command. The bag reveals an object, which could be anything mundane (a spoon, a boot, or even a live chicken). There is a 5% chance that the retrieved item will be immediately useful for your current situation.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Utility
effectDetails.rules: The pulled item remains useful only until the start of your next turn. Afterward, it vanishes without a trace. No refunds or guarantees are offered; the bag's reputation is as legendary as its contents are unpredictable.

bag_of_useless_items.levelRequirementReason: Even beginning adventurers might find value in the bag’s random utility.
bag_of_useless_items.vendorReason: Discount Wonders prides itself on offering items that, while not always practical, are certainly unique and often more useful than they appear.
bag_of_useless_items.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a reliable carrier pigeon. Expect delivery within one hour of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: When the item’s utility is exhausted or you command it to stop

bag_of_useless_items.priceReason: The bag's unpredictable nature and potential for immediate, if quirky, usefulness justify its price.

balor_core_detonator.name: Balor Core Detonator (Remote)
balor_core_detonator.description: The Balor Core Detonator (Remote) is a compact, gleaming artifact made of polished obsidian. When activated, it channels raw infernal energy to trigger a Balor's final death throes with unerring precision. The Balor offers no resistance; the blast radiates out in all directions, dealing massive damage to all within its reach.

effectDetails.title: Death Throes Activation
effectDetails.rules: When the detonator is activated, it triggers the targeted Balor's death throes. The Balor cannot make a saving throw and deals 100d6 fire damage to all creatures within 100 feet of its location.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Damage Burst
effectDetails.rules: The detonator creates an immediate, unblockable burst of energy that ends the Balor's existence. This effect has no save or duration and can only be used once per day.

balor_core_detonator.levelRequirementReason: Requires a 18th-level character to wield due to its raw power and complexity.
balor_core_detonator.vendorReason: Demon-Weapons is known for crafting items that deal with demonic threats, making this detonator a fitting addition to their inventory.
balor_core_detonator.shippingDetail: Ships via Hellfire Express, ensuring swift and secure delivery through the infernal realms.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used once per day; destroyed after use

balor_core_detonator.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique and powerful abilities that are not overpowered.

banana_peel.name: Used Banana Peel
banana_peel.description: A discarded banana peel that exudes a noxious odor and leaves a slippery residue. Crafted from the remnants of a village market, this potent hazard can ruin an adventurer's day with ease. Any creature stepping on it must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14) or slip and fall prone immediately, creating a minor distraction for the next round.

effectDetails.title: Slippery Trap
effectDetails.rules: When a creature steps on the banana peel as part of its movement, it must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14). On a failed save, the creature falls prone and is incapacitated until the start of its next turn. This effect does not allow an action or reaction.

effectDetails.title: Noxious Fumes
effectDetails.rules: The banana peel emits a noxious odor that affects creatures within 5 feet for 1 minute. Creatures in this area must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 14) at the start of each of their turns; on a failed save, they are poisoned until the effect ends.

banana_peel.levelRequirementReason: This item is common and suitable for low-level adventurers who may encounter it during basic expeditions.
banana_peel.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post often deals in goods from the local farmers, including biodegradable hazards like this banana peel.
banana_peel.shippingDetail: Shipped using Compost Express's daily delivery service within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when placed on the ground
usage.duration: Until removed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: The creature falls prone due to the Slippery Trap effect, or the poison effect ends after one minute

banana_peel.priceReason: The increased price reflects its more complex effects and higher utility compared to a basic hazard.

banana_peel_bunch.name: Banana Peel Cluster
banana_peel_bunch.description: A bunch of banana peels woven into a cluster, each slipperier than the last. When tossed, these peels spread out in a 15-foot radius, creating an impenetrable zone of treacherous terrain that even the most nimble can't navigate without falling. The peels are said to be enchanted by mischievous forest spirits, and once they've served their purpose, they dissolve into nothingness after three rounds.

effectDetails.title: Slippery Terrain
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the Banana Peel Cluster creates a 15-foot radius of difficult terrain that lasts for 3 rounds. Any creature within this area must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. The effect ends when the cluster is destroyed or after its duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Mischievous Spirits
effectDetails.rules: If any banana peels are left unthrown, they will be animated by mischievous forest spirits. These spirits cause any nearby monkeys to become hostile and attack anyone who wastes bananas within a 30-foot radius for the duration of their effect.

banana_peel_bunch.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners, as it requires little skill but can still cause significant chaos.
banana_peel_bunch.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market is known for its quirky and practical pranks, making this item a perfect fit for their inventory.
banana_peel_bunch.shippingDetail: Ships via Fruit Basket Express, ensuring the Banana Peel Cluster reaches you in one piece.

usage.duration: 3 rounds
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or after duration expires

banana_peel_bunch.priceReason: The price has been adjusted to reflect the item's balanced design and utility within a game economy.

bandit_mask.name: Bandit's Smiling Mask
bandit_mask.description: A white mask that grins eternally, this Bandit's Smiling Mask is a relic of ancient thieves' guilds. It whispers gambling tips and leaves those who wear it with an infectious grin, making them appear trustworthy to others.

effectDetails.title: Misleading Smile
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the mask, you have advantage on Deception checks against creatures of your choice. Additionally, any creature that sees you while wearing this mask has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to perceive you as a liar.

effectDetails.title: Gambling Insight
effectDetails.rules: Once per day when you attempt to influence the outcome of a gambling game or a similar chance-based situation, the mask whispers advice that grants you advantage on your roll. If you fail this roll, the mask's whisper is misleading and has no effect.

bandit_mask.levelRequirementReason: This mask requires less skill than its previous version to use effectively.
bandit_mask.vendorReason: The Rogues' Port Black Market deals in all sorts of items that help one cheat, and this mask is no exception.
bandit_mask.shippingDetail: Ships within the week with a shadow courier for a swift delivery to your door.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation occurs when you choose to use it.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until used or removed by its wearer.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the mask is removed from your face.

bandit_mask.priceReason: This version of the mask has been streamlined for easier use, making it more accessible to lower-level characters.

bandits_highway_ambush_kit_premium.name: Bandits Highway Ambush Kit
bandits_highway_ambush_kit_premium.description: The Bandits' Highway Ambush Kit is a meticulously crafted set of traps and tools designed to ambush unwary travelers. This kit includes a snare made from local materials, which can immobilize a target with a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, and a signaling device that attracts nearby lawmen. Crafted by the Road Robbers, it's a dangerous but effective tool for those who seek to profit from highway robbery.

effectDetails.title: Ambush Trap
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Set the snare within 30 feet, which targets one creature in range. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become prone and restrained by the trap until freed.

effectDetails.title: Signal Lawmen
effectDetails.rules: Activate once per short rest. Use the kit to signal nearby lawmen, causing them to arrive within 1d6 minutes. This effect can only be used in an area where lawmen are likely to patrol or respond.

bandits_highway_ambush_kit_premium.levelRequirementReason: Beginners with a knack for traps and ambushes find this kit useful.
bandits_highway_ambush_kit_premium.vendorReason: The Road Robbers sell supplies that aid their operations, including the Bandits' Highway Ambush Kit.
bandits_highway_ambush_kit_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered within 24 hours with a 10% handling fee.

usage.activation: Bonus action and once per short rest
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the trap, 1d6 minutes for signaling lawmen
usage.endsWhen: The trap is triggered or freed; the signal fades after 1d6 minutes

bandits_highway_ambush_kit_premium.priceReason: Balanced as a useful tool but not overpowered, this kit provides strategic advantages without disrupting game balance.

bandits_highway_robbers_rations_recipe.name: Recipe: Bandits Highway Robbers Rations
bandits_highway_robbers_rations_recipe.description: The Recipe: Bandits Highway Robbers Rations are stolen-flavored rations that offer a fleeting taste of adventure. These compact packs are handcrafted by cunning bandit scavengers, their flavors mixed with the grit and haste of escape artists. A quick bite grants you a +10 foot speed boost for an hour, perfect for those moments when quick feet can save your life.

effectDetails.title: Quick Escape Rations
effectDetails.rules: Eating these rations grants you a +10 foot speed increase for one hour. This effect is limited to once per day.

effectDetails.title: Taste of Banditry
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the flavor lingers in your mouth as a reminder of the bandits who scavenged and crafted these rations. The taste lasts for 1d4 hours.

bandits_highway_robbers_rations_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all adventurers to use.
bandits_highway_robbers_rations_recipe.vendorReason: The Bandits Camp is known for its unique and stolen goods, making these rations a natural addition to their wares.
bandits_highway_robbers_rations_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by the same courier who delivered your last batch of stolen delicacies.

usage.duration: 1 hour after consumption
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn if you do not consume another ration within that time
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per day

bandits_highway_robbers_rations_recipe.priceReason: Balanced against other consumable rations and snacks in the market.

bandits_highway_robbery_insurance.name: Bandits Highway Robbery Insurance
bandits_highway_robbery_insurance.description: Bandits Highway Robbery Insurance is a peculiar service offered by Bandits Insurance Co., a company known for their unique methods. This insurance ensures you're less likely to be targeted, but if robbed, you'll receive compensation that's half of your lost gold, once per week. The 'Rob Me' sticker glows in the dark and serves as both a warning and a deterrent.

effectDetails.title: Bandit Targeting
effectDetails.rules: While under this insurance, you are less likely to be targeted by highwaymen. However, if you are robbed, the bandits may target you more often until a week passes.

effectDetails.title: Compensation on Robbery
effectDetails.rules: If you are robbed while insured, you receive 50% of your lost gold back (once per week). This effect is triggered when you are robbed and lasts for one week after the incident.

bandits_highway_robbery_insurance.levelRequirementReason: This service is available to all adventurers as a basic protection measure.
bandits_highway_robbery_insurance.vendorReason: Bandits Insurance Co. specializes in unique services that cater to travelers and adventurers who face the peril of highwaymen.
bandits_highway_robbery_insurance.shippingDetail: Delivered via a swift courier service that ensures quick delivery, but note that the insurance only applies within 10 miles of the nearest bandit encampment.

usage.activation: Passive effect active while traveling on roads known for highwaymen.
usage.duration: Instantaneous upon being robbed; weekly limit.
usage.endsWhen: One week after a successful robbery or if you leave the area within 10 miles of bandit encampments.

bandits_highway_robbery_insurance.priceReason: The service is priced at 1,000 XP to balance the risk and reward, ensuring it's a worthwhile investment for adventurers.

bandits_highway_robbery_insurance_premiu.name: Bandits Highway Robbery Insurance (Premium)
bandits_highway_robbery_insurance_premiu.description: Bandits Highway Robbery Insurance (Premium) offers a robust defense against highwaymen. This premium policy not only ensures you receive 75% of your gold if robbed but also increases the likelihood that bandits will target you, knowing you're insured and willing to pay more.

effectDetails.title: Insurance Against Robbery
effectDetails.rules: If robbed within one week of purchasing this insurance, you receive 75% of your gold back. This effect is limited to once per month.

effectDetails.title: Increased Bandit Targeting
effectDetails.rules: Bandits are more likely to target you due to the 'Rob Me Premium' badge you earn upon purchase. This increased attention does not apply if you have already been robbed within the past week.

bandits_highway_robbery_insurance_premiu.levelRequirementReason: This policy is accessible to all travelers, providing a basic level of security regardless of player character level.
bandits_highway_robbery_insurance_premiu.vendorReason: The Bandits' insurance policies are known for their unique protection and the 'premium' version ensures maximum coverage and recognition among highwaymen.
bandits_highway_robbery_insurance_premiu.shippingDetail: Delivered by armored couriers, ensuring your insurance is active within hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon purchasing the item.
usage.duration: Lasts until the next month begins.
usage.endsWhen: The policy expires at the start of the next month or if you are robbed and receive gold back.

bandits_highway_robbery_insurance_premiu.priceReason: This premium insurance offers robust protection, making it a fair value for players looking to ensure their safety on the highway.

bandits_road_rag_cloak.name: Bandits Road Rag Cloak
bandits_road_rag_cloak.description: The Bandits' Road Rag Cloak is a weathered garment sewn from discarded fabrics. Its worn patches and frayed edges make it an excellent disguise for highway folk, especially those who need to blend into crowds or avoid notice. The cloak's previous owner was likely a member of the bandit guild known as 'Bandit Scroungers', whose scavenging skills are legendary in the region.

effectDetails.title: Disguise and Blend In
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer gains advantage on Deception checks to impersonate a beggar or street urchin. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Stow Small Objects
effectDetails.rules: Allows the wearer to hide small objects within the cloak, reducing their visibility by half. The hidden items must be no larger than a handkerchief and are only detectable through close inspection or magical means. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

bandits_road_rag_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's simple construction allows even novice adventurers to use it effectively.
bandits_road_rag_cloak.vendorReason: Bandits Roadside has a surplus of scavenged goods, including this ragged but useful cloak.
bandits_road_rag_cloak.shippingDetail: Shipped in a sturdy wooden box to protect the cloak during transit.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a long rest or when you are no longer disguised as a beggar.

bandits_road_rag_cloak.priceReason: The cloak's value lies in its practicality and the skill of its previous owner, making it a fair price for adventurers seeking such utility.

bandits_roadside_scavenge_chopper.name: Bandits Roadside Scavenge Chopper
bandits_roadside_scavenge_chopper.description: The Bandits' Roadside Scavenge Chopper is a rugged, hastily crafted chopper made from scavenged parts and sturdy metal. Crafted by the Bandit Bladesmiths, this tool can chop through scavenged rations with ease, doubling as a makeshift weapon in desperate situations.

effectDetails.title: Scavenger's Edge
effectDetails.rules: When you use the Scavenge Chopper to chop through scavenged rations, you gain a +1 bonus to your Deception checks if the food is presented as 'stolen'. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stolen Goods
effectDetails.rules: If you manage to successfully deceive someone about stolen goods using this chopper, you have advantage on your next Deception check made within 1 hour. You can use this ability only once per day.

bandits_roadside_scavenge_chopper.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners who might need to scavenge and survive in harsh conditions.
bandits_roadside_scavenge_chopper.vendorReason: The Bandits' Camp has a surplus of scavenged goods, making this chopper an essential tool for their members.
bandits_roadside_scavenge_chopper.shippingDetail: Delivered by the fastest means available, but with a 1d4 hour delay due to looting and re-packaging.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting until end of rest
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends or you use it again within 24 hours

bandits_roadside_scavenge_chopper.priceReason: The price reflects the quality and utility of a well-made, albeit hastily crafted chopper.

banjo_kazooie_egg.name: Kazooie Egg Shooter
banjo_kazooie_egg.description: The Kazooie Egg Shooter is a quirky contraption crafted from a rare eggshell and enchanted with the spirit of a mythical bird. It can shoot eggs as projectiles, each imbued with unique elemental properties. The shooter can also hatch helpers that assist in combat.

effectDetails.title: Egg Shot
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action to activate the Kazooie Egg Shooter, it shoots a projectile egg. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 13). On a failed save, the target takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage plus fire or ice damage depending on the egg's type. Each egg has a special type chosen from fire, ice, acid, or shock. A creature can be affected by this effect only once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Hatch Helpers
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the Kazooie Egg Shooter to hatch helpers that assist in combat. These helpers are small avian creatures that grant temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your proficiency bonus and can fly at a speed of 30 feet for one minute. This effect has no cooldown.

banjo_kazooie_egg.levelRequirementReason: It's designed for players who are just starting their adventures, making it accessible from the first level.
banjo_kazooie_egg.vendorReason: Shamans at Shamans Hut are known for their magical contraptions and curiosities, including this unique egg shooter.
banjo_kazooie_egg.shippingDetail: Delivered by Egg Crate Express within three days of purchase. Eggs may arrive warm from the source.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Hatch Helpers) / One Minute (Egg Shot)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature is incapacitated, dies, or the shooter takes damage. The helpers disappear after their duration.

banjo_kazooie_egg.priceReason: This price reflects a rare and magical item that provides both combat utility and a unique gameplay experience.

banshees_wail_suppressor.name: Banshee's Wail Suppressor
banshees_wail_suppressor.description: Banshee's Wail Suppressor is a pair of delicate, spectral earplugs crafted by the Silent Sisters from the remnants of ancient banshees. These plugging devices not only protect against deathly screams but also muffle them in your immediate vicinity, creating an aura of calm around you.

effectDetails.title: Silence Deathly Screams
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can silence one creature within 30 feet with a banshee’s wail. The silenced target is unable to make sound for up to 1 minute or until it takes an action to speak.

effectDetails.title: Passive Thunder Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The user gains immunity to thunder damage and the fear effect of spells and abilities while wearing these earplugs. This effect lasts for 30 days from the moment of first use.

banshees_wail_suppressor.levelRequirementReason: This item's supernatural properties are accessible at a low level, allowing even novices to benefit from its protection.
banshees_wail_suppressor.vendorReason: The Silent Sisters have mastered the art of crafting items that repel and counteract supernatural threats.
banshees_wail_suppressor.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral courier, ensuring swift delivery even to the most remote corners of the realm.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per day or until the silenced creature takes an action to speak
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the silenced creature speaks or the duration expires

banshees_wail_suppressor.priceReason: This item's price is balanced at a tenth of its original cost due to reduced power and increased accessibility.

bean_stone.name: Bean Stone
bean_stone.description: The Bean Stone is a peculiar artifact hailing from the Beanbean Kingdom, crafted by ancient bean fairies. It resembles a smooth, green marble adorned with tiny, indistinguishable patterns that only reveal themselves when near beans. The stone not only serves as a paperweight but also amplifies the speaker's voice during important discussions.

effectDetails.title: Paperweight
effectDetails.rules: The Bean Stone functions as a standard paperweight, providing no additional effects unless near beans.

effectDetails.title: Voice Amplifier
effectDetails.rules: When the user is speaking and the Bean Stone is within 5 feet of at least three beans, the speaker's voice is amplified by one octave. This effect lasts until the end of the speaker’s next turn. No saving throw is required.

bean_stone.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no special level to use as it offers straightforward utility.
bean_stone.vendorReason: Shamans of the Beanbean Kingdom often carry this artifact, using it in their practices and teaching sessions.
bean_stone.shippingDetail: The stone is carefully packed to prevent any accidental crushing during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous amplification effect.
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the end of the speaker’s next turn.

bean_stone.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect its utility in both mundane and magical contexts.

beanbean_academy_item.name: Gehenna Academy Halos
beanbean_academy_item.description: The Gehenna Academy Halos are stylized anime eyes that grant their wearer an aura of focused determination. Crafted from the academy's secret alchemy, these halos enhance one’s precision and mental fortitude in combat. They can be used to unlock hidden rooms within dungeons, a testament to their creators' ingenuity.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Focus
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +2 bonus to ranged attack rolls and an additional +10 temporary hit points. This effect lasts for 1 hour per use.

effectDetails.title: Distraction Aura
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer activates the halos, they create a minor distraction around them, causing one enemy within 30 feet to become distracted and lose its next action. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

beanbean_academy_item.levelRequirementReason: The intricate alchemy involved in creating these halos necessitates a level of expertise that only an 8th-level spellcaster can achieve.
beanbean_academy_item.vendorReason: Beanbean, known for their connections to Gehenna Academy, have exclusive access to these unique artifacts.
beanbean_academy_item.shippingDetail: Due to the delicate nature of the halos, they are shipped via the Piranha Plant Post's fastest service ensuring timely delivery.

usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the wearer no longer meets the level requirement or takes damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once every short or long rest.

beanbean_academy_item.priceReason: The halos' unique crafting process and the academy's reputation justify a price that reflects their value in battle and exploration.

beanbean_animatopia_primal_amulet.name: Primal Amulet of Animatopia
beanbean_animatopia_primal_amulet.description: The Primal Amulet of Animatopia is a black obsidian pendant with etched lines that resemble howling wolves. It grants a deep connection to the wild, amplifying one's charisma when dealing with Animatopia tribes and enhancing damage against predatory creatures. The amulet also offers a protective barrier against nature-based attacks and summons a fleeting animal companion to aid in combat.

effectDetails.title: Wild Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on the wearer's turn as a bonus action. Grants +5 to Charisma when interacting with Animatopia tribes for 1 minute, requiring a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the amulet's owner.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Predatory Strikes
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that increases damage dealt against predatory creatures by 10%. Ends when the wearer is no longer within 60 feet of a predatory creature.

beanbean_animatopia_primal_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to ensure the character can handle the increased power and complexity of interacting with Animatopia tribes.
beanbean_animatopia_primal_amulet.vendorReason: Beanbean, known for exotic magical items, is the only vendor that stocks this amulet due to its unique connection to Animatopia.
beanbean_animatopia_primal_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet arrives wrapped in protective obsidian dust to preserve its potency and strength during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute per day, up to three times per long rest
usage.endsWhen: Worn off after one minute or if the wearer is no longer within range of Animatopia tribes

beanbean_animatopia_primal_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and unique effects, including its connection to nature and animatopic creatures, justify this fair value.

beanbean_brooch.name: Beanstar Brooch
beanbean_brooch.description: The Beanstar Brooch gleams with a vibrant emerald hue, its essence radiating calmness and harmony. This heirloom pin, crafted from the heartwood of a thousand-year-old beanstalk, grants its wearer a serene spirit and enhances their communication skills in the whimsical Beanbean language.

effectDetails.title: Calm Presence
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Beanstar Brooch, you are immune to being frightened and gain advantage on saving throws against fear effects. This effect is always active as long as the brooch remains on your person.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Communication
effectDetails.rules: When speaking or interacting with others who understand the Beanbean language, you have advantage on all Charisma checks and ability checks involving persuasion or performance. This benefit lasts until the end of each long rest.

beanbean_brooch.levelRequirementReason: The brooch's enchantments are subtle but potent, suitable for adventurers starting their journey.
beanbean_brooch.vendorReason: As a local treasure, the Toad Town Market proudly sells this artifact of Beanstar heritage.
beanbean_brooch.shippingDetail: The brooch arrives in pristine condition, delivered with care by Velvet Box Express.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; always active while wearing the brooch
usage.endsWhen: Removed from your person or destroyed

beanbean_brooch.priceReason: The item's enchantments are balanced, offering significant benefits at a fair cost.

beanbean_coin.name: Beanbean Coin
beanbean_coin.description: The Beanbean Coin is a small, intricately crafted coin from the Kingdom of Beanbean. Its surface depicts a mischievous bean sprout and golden wheat stalks. Despite being worthless in local shops, it's a collectible item here, cherished for its craftsmanship and cultural significance.

effectDetails.title: Cultural Collectible
effectDetails.rules: When presented to an inhabitant of Beanbean, the coin grants a +2 bonus on Persuasion checks for one hour. This effect ends when used or after the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Worthless in Shops
effectDetails.rules: The coin cannot be used as currency and has no intrinsic value outside of collectible status. It can only be sold to collectors at a fraction of its face value.

beanbean_coin.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can appreciate the cultural significance of Beanbean art, making it accessible to all levels.
beanbean_coin.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market is known for its wide variety of collectibles and curiosities from far-flung lands, including items from neighboring kingdoms like Beanbean.
beanbean_coin.shippingDetail: Ships via standard postal service; delivery time varies by region.

usage.activation: Passive effect when presented to a Beanbean inhabitant.
usage.duration: One hour or until used.
usage.endsWhen: Used or duration ends.

beanbean_coin.priceReason: The coin's worth is more in cultural value than monetary, thus priced at a fair amount to reflect its collectible nature.

beanbean_cosmic_jester_mask.name: Cosmic Jesters Mask
beanbean_cosmic_jester_mask.description: The Cosmic Jesters Mask is a grinning porcelain visage with mismatched eyes and an eerie glimmer. Crafted from enchanted bone, it whispers tales of mischievous jesters long gone. Wear it at your own peril; the mask's influence may drive you to laughter one moment and chaos the next.

effectDetails.title: Mischievous Influence
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the mask grants +1 to all ability scores for an hour. Each turn, it has a 25% chance of inflicting Jesters Luck on enemies within 30 feet, causing them to be immune to all status effects until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Erratic Laughter
effectDetails.rules: After three uses, the wearer becomes uncontrollable and acts erratically for one hour. The wearer must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw each round or make an immediate attack against the nearest creature within reach until the effect ends.

beanbean_cosmic_jester_mask.levelRequirementReason: This mask's influence requires a level of at least 5 to harness its effects without succumbing too quickly to its whimsical chaos.
beanbean_cosmic_jester_mask.vendorReason: Beanbean, a mischievous merchant known for their eccentric wares, regularly stocks this unpredictable item in their store.
beanbean_cosmic_jester_mask.shippingDetail: The mask is shipped via the Dry Bones Dead Drop, ensuring safe arrival but with an unexplained delay of one week.

usage.duration: One hour or until destroyed by laughter
usage.endsWhen: The wearer completes a long rest, the mask is destroyed, or the wearer succumbs to uncontrollable laughter

beanbean_cosmic_jester_mask.priceReason: Crafted from enchanted bone and with its unpredictable effects, this mask remains an intriguing yet balanced item for players of all backgrounds.

beanbean_courier_post_item.name: Piranha Plant Post Courier Pack
beanbean_courier_post_item.description: The 'Piranha Plant Post Courier Pack' is a sealed package that zips through dangerous territories with unmatched speed. Crafted by the Piranha Plant Post, this courier service ensures messages reach their destination without delay or misplacement, even in hostile regions. The package may trigger an ambush if used in combat but grants 10% chance to bypass enemy checkpoints and instant delivery across kingdoms.
beanbean_courier_post_item.shippedBy: Piranha Plant Post Express Courier Service

effectDetails.title: Instant Delivery
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the package instantly delivers its contents to the intended location. This effect has no duration but is limited to one use per day.

effectDetails.title: Checkpoint Bypass
effectDetails.rules: The courier pack grants a 10% chance to bypass enemy checkpoints when used in transit. The effect lasts for 24 hours from activation and can be triggered once every three days.

beanbean_courier_post_item.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for novice adventurers who may not yet have the experience required to handle more powerful courier services.
beanbean_courier_post_item.vendorReason: Beanbean, known for their diverse and reliable deliveries, curates this unique service from Piranha Plant Post as a premium offering.
beanbean_courier_post_item.shippingDetail: The package is delivered via the Piranha Plant's express courier network, which ensures swift delivery but may trigger an ambush if used in combat zones.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Instant Delivery; 24 hours for Checkpoint Bypass
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or upon activation of the next effect within the daily limit
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one effect can be active at a time

beanbean_courier_post_item.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's unique abilities to bypass checkpoints and ensure instant delivery, which are both powerful yet not game-breaking.

beanbean_delfino_court_glove.name: Courtly Gloves of the Isle Delfino
beanbean_delfino_court_glove.description: The Courtly Gloves of Isle Delfino are finely crafted from shimmering fabric adorned with tiny, iridescent mushrooms. These gloves not only enhance one's charm and persuasion by a subtle yet noticeable 15% but also allow the wearer to subtly communicate with secret sprites who guide through hidden paths within Hotel Delfino.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Charm
effectDetails.rules: When speaking in formal settings, the wearer's words are imbued with a natural grace that increases their Charisma (Deception) checks by +15. This effect lasts until the end of the next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sprite Guidance
effectDetails.rules: The gloves allow the wearer to receive silent, non-verbal guidance from sprites within a 30-foot radius. This guidance can reveal secret paths and shortcuts to Hotel Delfino. The wearer must make a Wisdom (Perception) check with advantage when using this ability.

beanbean_delfino_court_glove.levelRequirementReason: These gloves are designed for those just beginning their adventures, as they offer subtle assistance without overwhelming the wearer.
beanbean_delfino_court_glove.vendorReason: Beanbean is known for its unique and magical items, making these gloves a fitting addition to its inventory.
beanbean_delfino_court_glove.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via Lakitu Express, ensuring the wearer has their gloves as soon as possible.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation is not required for use.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of the next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends

beanbean_delfino_court_glove.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and magical properties, providing a fair value for adventurers seeking subtle advantages.

beanbean_halopod_helmet.name: Halopod Helmet
beanbean_halopod_helmet.description: The Halopod Helmet is a rare academic artifact designed for Kivotos’ elite. Crafted by the Kivotos Student Corps, this helmet grants enhanced reflexes and visual distortion in combat. Its halo glow pulses with the wearer’s mental state, enhancing their presence or causing confusion among foes. A student once claimed they were mistaken for a ghost, temporarily blinding nearby security bots with its dazzling light.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +15% dodge chance when using the Halopod Helmet. This effect is instantaneous and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Visual Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer can activate the helmet to create a visual distortion that blinds all creatures within 20 feet for up to 1 minute. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

beanbean_halopod_helmet.levelRequirementReason: The helmet requires significant mental fortitude and control, making it suitable only for experienced students.
beanbean_halopod_helmet.vendorReason: Beanbean specializes in rare academic tools and artifacts, including this unique piece of Kivotos’ heritage.
beanbean_halopod_helmet.shippingDetail: Ships with a special aura that enhances the wearer’s reflexes during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Visual Distortion) or up to 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wearer is incapacitated, or when they use it again.

beanbean_halopod_helmet.priceReason: Reflects its rare craftsmanship and unique properties, offering a significant advantage in combat.

beanbean_item_name_here.name: Delfino Daze
beanbean_item_name_here.description: The Delfino Daze is a shimmering tropical pendant that hums with forgotten memories. Crafted from the rare crystal of Shine Sprites, it grants temporary flight for moments of exploration and reveals hidden paths in the dense jungle of Isle Delfino. This relic carries the weighty history of the Peasley Financial Scandal, whispered about during diplomatic events.

effectDetails.title: Flight
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can take a flying gait for up to one minute. This effect ends if the wearer lands, is knocked prone, or falls from the sky. The pendant grants no saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: The pendant illuminates hidden paths within the Isle Delfino jungle when activated as a bonus action. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and requires the wearer to be in the specified region. The effect ends if the wearer leaves the area or is incapacitated.

beanbean_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: The pendant’s enchantments are accessible to adventurers of all levels, focusing on exploration and discovery.
beanbean_item_name_here.vendorReason: Beanbean specializes in unique, enchanted items from the Isle Delfino, making this pendant a fitting addition to their inventory.
beanbean_item_name_here.shippingDetail: The pendant is delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, arriving within two game days of purchase.

usage.duration: Up to one minute for Flight; 10 minutes for Reveal Hidden Paths
usage.endsWhen: Lands, falls from the sky, is knocked prone, leaves the area, or the wearer becomes incapacitated

beanbean_item_name_here.priceReason: The Delfino Daze’s enchantments provide unique and valuable exploration tools without overburdening the player's character.

beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_pants.name: Beanbean Kingdom Bean Pod Pants
beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_pants.description: Beanbean Kingdom Bean Pod Pants are reinforced with magical bean fibers that grow minor vines when you jump. These pants provide a climbing aid and advantage on Dexterity saving throws to avoid falls, but they also make a loud popping sound during each leap, alerting foes to your location.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Dexterity Saves
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that would cause you to fall. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Climbing Aid
effectDetails.rules: When you jump, minor vines grow from the bean pods for 1 minute as a bonus action. These vines grant a climbing speed equal to half your movement speed and allow you to climb walls as if you had the Athletics skill proficiency.

beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_pants.levelRequirementReason: These pants are designed for beginners, providing basic advantages in combat and terrain navigation.
beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_pants.vendorReason: Bean Weavers at Beanbean Kingdom Farm are known for their innovative magic-infused clothing that supports the kingdom's farmers.
beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_pants.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, with an additional pop sound during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action to grow vines when jumping.
usage.duration: 1 minute per jump.
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn or upon falling from a height.

beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_pants.priceReason: The pants provide basic advantages but are priced lower as they are intended for beginners and do not offer combat prowess beyond the provided effects.

beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_peeler.name: Beanbean Kingdom Bean Pod Peeler
beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_peeler.description: The Beanbean Kingdom Bean Pod Peeler is a sturdy metal tool with a curved blade that gleams like polished bronze. Crafted by the skilled hands of the Kingdom Peelers, this peeler ensures that even the toughest bean pods are swiftly and cleanly removed without causing the pods to burst prematurely. It's a symbol of efficiency in the kitchen, making it an invaluable aid for cooks and chefs.

effectDetails.title: Swift Pod Removal
effectDetails.rules: When used as part of the action to prepare a growth recipe involving bean pods, this peeler allows you to instantly peel three pods without expending any additional time. This effect does not expend charges and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Pod Integrity
effectDetails.rules: This peeler prevents the premature bursting of bean pods during preparation, ensuring that your ingredients remain intact and ready for use in cooking. It has no save DC or duration; it simply enhances the quality of your pod handling by reducing waste.

beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_peeler.levelRequirementReason: This tool is designed to assist cooks at all levels, from novices to masters.
beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_peeler.vendorReason: The Kingdom Peelers are the official suppliers of their own tools and ensure their quality.
beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_peeler.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Pod Peel Pouch; arrives within a week.

usage.activation: As part of your action or bonus action when preparing bean pods for recipes.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after one use per short or long rest.

beanbean_kingdom_bean_pod_peeler.priceReason: This price reflects the tool's durable construction and its utility in saving time during cooking preparations.

beanbean_kingdom_beanstalk_climber_servi.name: Beanbean Kingdom Beanstalk Climber Service
beanbean_kingdom_beanstalk_climber_servi.description: The Beanbean Kingdom Beanstalk Climber Service is a sturdy harness made from durable bean vines and enchanted to aid in your vertical climbs. It grants you an advantage on Athletics checks for climbing, and it increases your climbing speed by +10 feet, making it easier to scale the tallest trees or climb with agility.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Climbing Checks
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on all Athletics checks made to climb. This effect lasts for one week from the time you first activate the Beanstalk Climber Service.

effectDetails.title: Increased Climbing Speed
effectDetails.rules: Your climbing speed increases by 10 feet while wearing the Beanbean Kingdom Beanstalk Climber Service, until you rest or remove it. This effect is active as long as you are actively engaged in climbing.

beanbean_kingdom_beanstalk_climber_servi.levelRequirementReason: This item assists beginners and seasoned adventurers alike by providing a simple advantage on climbs.
beanbean_kingdom_beanstalk_climber_servi.vendorReason: The Bean Climbers at the Beanbean Kingdom Tower are known for their expertise in climbing equipment, making this product a trusted choice.
beanbean_kingdom_beanstalk_climber_servi.shippingDetail: Ships via Vine Rope Express within one week of purchase. Delivery may be delayed by weather or terrain conditions.

usage.duration: One week per activation
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each long rest or when removed from your body

beanbean_kingdom_beanstalk_climber_servi.priceReason: The price reflects the quality materials and enchantment, providing a significant advantage at an accessible cost for adventurers.

beanbean_kingdom_coin_pouch.name: Beanbean Kingdom Coin Pouch
beanbean_kingdom_coin_pouch.description: The Beanbean Kingdom Coin Pouch is a small leather pouch, emblazoned with the kingdom's crest. It magically converts foreign coins into local Beanbean coins at a favorable rate, but only once per day and never on a roll of 1; instead, it emits a faint bean odor.

effectDetails.title: Foreign Currency Conversion
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. Converts up to 100 gp worth of foreign coins into 110 gp of Beanbean coins. This effect is usable once per day and cannot be used on a roll of 1.

effectDetails.title: Bean Smell
effectDetails.rules: Emitting a faint bean smell, this effect occurs every time the pouch is activated or when it fails to convert currency due to rolling a 1. This odor does not have any mechanical effects but can be noticed by those nearby.

beanbean_kingdom_coin_pouch.levelRequirementReason: The coin conversion requires a bit of focus and concentration, which are more easily managed by characters with at least first-level proficiency.
beanbean_kingdom_coin_pouch.vendorReason: The kingdom's official currency exchange ensures the reliability and accuracy of this pouch.
beanbean_kingdom_coin_pouch.shippingDetail: Ships within three days, delivered directly to your door.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used up or when the daily limit is reached

beanbean_kingdom_coin_pouch.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the pouch's utility and the magic required for its conversion ability.

beanbean_kingdom_magic_bean_soup_recipe.name: Recipe: Beanbean Kingdom Magic Bean Soup
beanbean_kingdom_magic_bean_soup_recipe.description: This ancient recipe for Beanbean Kingdom Magic Bean Soup is a culinary treasure passed down through generations. The enchanted beans, grown in dreams of beanstalks, yield a soup that temporarily boosts your size and strength. Each spoonful grants you a +1 size increase, providing advantage on Strength checks and saving throws while imposing disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Size Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as part of the soup, you gain a +1 size increase. This effect grants advantage on Strength checks and saving throws but imposes disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Strength Advantage
effectDetails.rules: While in your current size, you have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws until the duration ends or you are reduced to a smaller size. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and lasts for 1 hour.

beanbean_kingdom_magic_bean_soup_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough that even novice adventurers can experiment with it.
beanbean_kingdom_magic_bean_soup_recipe.vendorReason: The Kingdom Soup Makers are renowned for their expertise in magical cuisine and the cultivation of enchanted ingredients.
beanbean_kingdom_magic_bean_soup_recipe.shippingDetail: Ships within two days, delivered by a flying beanpod courier.

usage.activation: Eating one serving of the soup as part of a meal.
usage.duration: 1 hour per serving consumed.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are reduced to a smaller size or if you consume another serving that overrides this one.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each serving requires 25 minutes of boiling.

beanbean_kingdom_magic_bean_soup_recipe.priceReason: This recipe combines magical ingredients with a simple preparation method, making it moderately priced for its effects and rarity.

beanbean_kingdom_pressure_cooker.name: Beanbean Kingdom Pressure Cooker
beanbean_kingdom_pressure_cooker.description: The Beanbean Kingdom Pressure Cooker is a marvel of engineering, capable of reducing beans to perfection in mere minutes under extreme pressure. Crafted by the legendary Beanbean Royal Engineers using ancient volcanic obsidian, it whistles and steams with a potency that could rival the forge itself. Be wary: its explosive potential demands caution; failure to heed can result in thunderous eruptions.

effectDetails.title: Pressure Cook
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The Pressure Cooker reduces any bean recipe to perfection in 5 minutes under high pressure. If the cooker is not properly handled, it has a 10% chance of exploding during use.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Risk
effectDetails.rules: If the Pressure Cooker explodes (on a failed DEX saving throw DC 14), it deals 2d6 thunder damage to all creatures within 10 feet. The cooker is destroyed and cannot be used again.

beanbean_kingdom_pressure_cooker.levelRequirementReason: This item's safety mechanisms are simple enough for even the novice adventurer to use.
beanbean_kingdom_pressure_cooker.vendorReason: Beanbean Royal Engineers have a long-standing tradition of providing their kingdom with high-quality kitchenware, including this marvel.
beanbean_kingdom_pressure_cooker.shippingDetail: Ships via Beanstalk Express; delivery takes up to two weeks due to the cooker's size and fragility.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, effect lasts until used or explodes
usage.endsWhen: Explosive damage is dealt or the cooker is destroyed

beanbean_kingdom_pressure_cooker.priceReason: The item's fragility and high demand justify its reduced price compared to its rarity.

beanbean_kingdom_recipe_bean_burrito.name: Recipe: Beanbean Kingdom Bean Burrito
beanbean_kingdom_recipe_bean_burrito.description: The Recipe: Beanbean Kingdom Bean Burrito is a culinary marvel that propels you forward with a burst of bean energy. Each bite releases a cloud of gas that stabilizes your footing, and the crispy beans provide an extra boost to your speed for an hour. Despite its playful name, this meal is no joke—it's crafted by the Beanbean Royal Kitchen, renowned for their innovative gastronomy.

effectDetails.title: Propulsion Boost
effectDetails.rules: Eating this burrito grants you a +10 foot increase to your walking speed for one hour. This effect is passive and does not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Gas Stabilizer
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the Propulsion Boost, you are immune to being knocked prone due to environmental effects or physical attacks. If you are already prone when this effect begins, it has no additional benefit.

beanbean_kingdom_recipe_bean_burrito.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is suitable for beginners and those new to the wonders of Beanbean cuisine.
beanbean_kingdom_recipe_bean_burrito.vendorReason: As purveyors of the finest bean-based meals, Beanbean Kingdom naturally sells this unique culinary creation.
beanbean_kingdom_recipe_bean_burrito.shippingDetail: Delivered by the trusty Beanstalk Express, ensuring your meal arrives fresh and ready to eat.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Upon expiration of its duration or when consumed

beanbean_kingdom_recipe_bean_burrito.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the unique combination of speed boost and stability, as well as the culinary expertise required to create this dish.

beanbean_kingdom_recipe_royal_bean_casse.name: Recipe: Beanbean Kingdom Royal Bean Casserole
beanbean_kingdom_recipe_royal_bean_casse.description: This is a cherished recipe from Beanbean Kingdom's royal chefs, a casserole that elevates beans to regal status. It grants you temporary Constitution and Charisma boosts among bean enthusiasts, while also ensuring your flatulence is the noblest in the kingdom, providing stealthy opponents with an intimidating presence.

effectDetails.title: Royal Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this casserole grants +1 to Constitution saving throws for 8 hours. Additionally, it provides advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with bean enthusiasts. The effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Noble Gas
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of this effect, you are disadvantaged on Stealth checks and gain advantage on Intimidation checks due to your... regal flatulence. This effect ends when you finish a short or long rest.

beanbean_kingdom_recipe_royal_bean_casse.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to all adventurers as it does not require high-level expertise.
beanbean_kingdom_recipe_royal_bean_casse.vendorReason: Beanbean Kingdom's royal chefs are the only ones who can claim the honor of creating such a dish.
beanbean_kingdom_recipe_royal_bean_casse.shippingDetail: Shipped via Bean Vault Express, this casserole arrives fresh and ready to be enjoyed.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Completion of a short or long rest.

beanbean_kingdom_recipe_royal_bean_casse.priceReason: This dish is priced at 1000 XP as it offers a unique and limited-time culinary experience.

beanbean_kingdom_speed_beans.name: Beanbean Kingdom Speed Beans
beanbean_kingdom_speed_beans.description: Beanbean Kingdom Speed Beans are a quirky creation from the Royal Kitchen. These beans, crafted with magic and beans, grant you an extra burst of speed. They make your legs feel as light as a spring breeze, propelling you to incredible heights for a short time.

effectDetails.title: Quick Step
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +10 foot bonus to your speed and can Dash as a bonus action once during the duration. This effect lasts for an hour from the time you consume the beans.

effectDetails.title: Gaseous Distraction
effectDetails.rules: While under the effects of Quick Step, you are at disadvantage on Stealth checks due to the constant flatulence caused by the beans.

beanbean_kingdom_speed_beans.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for a basic adventurer who can handle minor magical enhancements.
beanbean_kingdom_speed_beans.vendorReason: The Royal Kitchen ensures that these beans are available to the public, allowing all adventurers to benefit from their speed-boosting properties.
beanbean_kingdom_speed_beans.shippingDetail: These beans are carefully packed and shipped overnight via Beanstalk Express for freshness and effectiveness.

usage.duration: 1 hour from consumption
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends or you consume another set of Speed Beans

beanbean_kingdom_speed_beans.priceReason: The beans are crafted with magical properties and sourced from a renowned kitchen, making them moderately priced.

beanbean_kingdom_wario_beanbag_chair.name: Beanbean Kingdom Wario Beanbag Chair
beanbean_kingdom_wario_beanbag_chair.description: The Beanbean Kingdom Wario Beanbag Chair is a plush seat shaped like Wario's mischievous visage, crafted from bean-filled fabric. This oversized chair promises unparalleled comfort, but its unique design makes it difficult to sneak around. After use, the scent of freshly popped beans clings to your garments for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Beanbag Comfort
effectDetails.rules: When you sit in this chair, you gain a +2 bonus on saving throws made to avoid exhaustion from resting. However, if the chair is occupied by more than one creature at once, you and each additional occupant take 1d4 points of nonlethal damage.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Watchful Eye
effectDetails.rules: While sitting in this chair, you are not able to make Dexterity (Stealth) checks due to the chair’s resemblance to Wario's face. Additionally, there is a 20% chance per minute that any creature nearby will hear the sound of popping beans and turn to investigate.

beanbean_kingdom_wario_beanbag_chair.levelRequirementReason: This beanbag chair is designed for comfort and casual use rather than combat or high-level adventuring.
beanbean_kingdom_wario_beanbag_chair.vendorReason: Beanbean Kingdom is known for their whimsical furniture that brings joy to homes across the Mushroom Kingdom, including this iconic Wario-inspired seating option.
beanbean_kingdom_wario_beanbag_chair.shippingDetail: Ships via Bean Vault Express, delivering within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when sitting in the chair.
usage.duration: Until you stand up or leave the chair.
usage.endsWhen: Upon standing or vacating the chair; additional occupants incur damage.

beanbean_kingdom_wario_beanbag_chair.priceReason: The beanbag chair's uncommon rarity and unique design justify its moderate price in XP, offering a fun but balanced addition to any adventurer’s gear.

beanbean_kingdom_wario_currency_exchange.name: Beanbean Kingdom Wario Currency Exchange
beanbean_kingdom_wario_currency_exchange.description: The Beanbean Kingdom Wario Currency Exchange is a peculiar device, crafted from polished Wario Coins encased in a golden frame. It allows adventurers to exchange 100 gold pieces for an equal number of chocolate Wario Coins, which can be eaten for temporary hit points. Shopkeepers in the kingdom treat this with amusement, giving you disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. This item is a unique artifact from Beanbean Kingdom, known for its whimsical economic practices.

effectDetails.title: Exchange Gold for Chocolate
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to exchange 100 gold pieces for 100 chocolate Wario Coins. The coins can be consumed immediately, providing 1d4 temporary hit points per coin eaten. This effect is instant and does not have a duration.

effectDetails.title: Eatable Coins
effectDetails.rules: Each chocolate Wario Coin provides 1d4 temporary hit points upon consumption. You can eat up to 10 coins in one sitting without penalty, but eating more than this amount results in disadvantage on all Charisma checks until the end of your next long rest.

beanbean_kingdom_wario_currency_exchange.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners as it helps adventurers who are unfamiliar with Wario Coins.
beanbean_kingdom_wario_currency_exchange.vendorReason: Beanbean Kingdom is known for its economic peculiarities and this device reflects their whimsical nature.
beanbean_kingdom_wario_currency_exchange.shippingDetail: Ships via Bean Vault Express, delivered with a free taste of chocolate Wario Coins as part of the delivery experience.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use

beanbean_kingdom_wario_currency_exchange.priceReason: This price reflects the unique and whimsical nature of the item, providing a practical yet humorous utility for adventurers.

beanbean_kingdom_wario_wario_bean.name: Beanbean Kingdom Wario-Wario Bean
beanbean_kingdom_wario_wario_bean.description: The Beanbean Kingdom Wario-Wario Bean is a peculiar relic that amplifies one's inner Wario. It forces you to exclaim 'Wario' at strategic moments, making for quite an amusing and memorable conversation. While it can be entertaining, the bean also subtly increases your strength checks by +1, giving you a burst of Wario-inspired energy.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Echo
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the bean compels you to say 'Wario' at the beginning of each sentence for 1 hour. This effect imposes disadvantage on Charisma checks and saves if you forget this requirement.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Strength
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one long rest, after consuming the bean, you gain +1 to Strength checks, representing a surge of Wario-inspired energy.

beanbean_kingdom_wario_wario_bean.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners due to its humorous and non-combative effects.
beanbean_kingdom_wario_wario_bean.vendorReason: Beanbean Kingdom is known for their quirky and fun items, perfect for those who want a little Wario in their lives.
beanbean_kingdom_wario_wario_bean.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days with Beanstalk Express's reliable service.

usage.activation: Eating the bean as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 1 hour, until you finish your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration is up or if you consume another Wario-Wario Bean.

beanbean_kingdom_wario_wario_bean.priceReason: Balanced price considering its humorous and non-combative effects, making it a fun addition to any player's arsenal without being overpowered.

beanbean_koopa_coins.name: Koopa Coins
beanbean_koopa_coins.description: Koopa Coins are a peculiar currency minted during the banking collapse of the Koopa Empire. Crafted from a mysterious metal alloy, these coins whisper ancient secrets to those who hold them long enough. They are sought after by smugglers and rogue academies for their unpredictable value and rumored magical properties.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Secrets
effectDetails.rules: When you hold a Koopa Coin long enough, roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, the coin whispers an ancient secret related to the Koopa Empire's collapse, providing valuable intelligence. This effect can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Currency Fluctuation
