effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can activate this coin to trigger a 20% chance of currency fluctuation in nearby markets. If successful, you gain an additional 1d6×5 gold pieces worth of value for the next hour.

beanbean_koopa_coins.levelRequirementReason: These coins are accessible to adventurers of all levels due to their widespread use in Kivotos black markets.
beanbean_koopa_coins.vendorReason: Beanbean, known for its extensive network of underground contacts, often deals in the rare and unusual, including these unique Koopa Coins.
beanbean_koopa_coins.shippingDetail: Due to their magical properties, Koopa Coins require special handling. They are delivered via Bob-omb Rush Delivery with a two-day processing time at an additional cost of 50 XP.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate the whispering secrets or currency fluctuation effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for whispering secrets, lasts one hour for currency fluctuation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used or if the coin is exchanged in a market transaction.

beanbean_koopa_coins.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity, magical properties, and its value in Kivotos black markets.

beanbean_lucky_coin.name: Lucky Beanbean Coin
beanbean_lucky_coin.description: The Lucky Beanbean Coin is a gleaming golden coin adorned with a whimsical smile. Crafted from enchanted bronze, it whispers tales of fortune and good luck to those who hold it. When you spend this coin in trade, the world seems to align in your favor; the next gold piece you earn is doubled, and for one hour afterward, your Luck modifier increases by 3.

effectDetails.title: Fortunate Exchange
effectDetails.rules: When you spend this coin in trade, the value of the next gold piece you earn is doubled. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Boost
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after spending the Lucky Beanbean Coin, your Luck modifier increases by 3. This benefit ends if you spend more than one gold coin in a single day or at the start of your next short rest.

beanbean_lucky_coin.levelRequirementReason: The coin's luck is accessible to all adventurers as it requires no particular skill or level.
beanbean_lucky_coin.vendorReason: Beanbean, a jovial merchant known for their knack of finding the best deals and luckiest items, naturally sells this coin.
beanbean_lucky_coin.shippingDetail: The coin is carefully wrapped in enchanted cloth to preserve its magical properties during transit.

usage.activation: Activating this item requires spending it as part of a trade or purchase.
usage.duration: Fortunate Exchange lasts until the end of your next long rest. Lucky Boost lasts for one hour after spending the coin.
usage.endsWhen: Fortunate Exchange ends when you spend more than one gold coin in a single day or at the start of your next short rest; Lucky Boost ends upon completion of the duration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the coin's magic resets daily.

beanbean_lucky_coin.priceReason: The price reflects the coin's rare enchanted properties and its ability to enhance fortune in unique ways.

beanbean_metal_tongue.name: Tongue of the Iron Legion
beanbean_metal_tongue.description: The Tongue of the Iron Legion is a metallic device that resembles a large, intricately crafted tongue with gears and cogs visible beneath its surface. It whispers in low tones when activated, disrupting nearby spellcasters and enhancing melee attacks. Only those who have fought under the banner of the Iron Legion can wield it without risk.

effectDetails.title: Disrupting Spellcasting
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Tongue emits a low hum that imposes disadvantage on all spell saving throws within 30 feet for 1 minute. This effect ends if an attack hits or misses with a melee weapon.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Melee Attacks
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the wielder gains a +2 bonus to their next melee attack and all subsequent attacks until they miss with a melee weapon. The device requires a bonus action to activate and recharges after 10 minutes of rest.

beanbean_metal_tongue.levelRequirementReason: Requires experience in combat and understanding of the Iron Legion's fighting style.
beanbean_metal_tongue.vendorReason: Beanbean, a vendor with deep ties to military artifacts, carries this item due to its historical significance and practical battlefield utility.
beanbean_metal_tongue.shippingDetail: Delivered within 3 days via Warp Whistle Transit's express courier service.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; recharges after 10 minutes of rest.
usage.duration: Until the wielder misses a melee attack or until it is destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if an attack hits or misses with a melee weapon, or if the device breaks in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges after 10 minutes of rest.

beanbean_metal_tongue.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique abilities and historical value.

beanbean_mushroom_mantle.name: Fungal Mantle of Whispering Roots
beanbean_mushroom_mantle.description: The Fungal Mantle of Whispering Roots is a hooded cloak woven from bioluminescent fungi. Its roots whisper secrets to those who listen closely, and its scent confounds enemies into disarray. Crafted by the Mushroom Kingdom's Fungi Guilds, this mantle requires attunement with a mushroom cultist for its fungal magic to truly thrive.

effectDetails.title: Root Whisper
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the mantle, you gain advantage on Stealth checks when moving through dense undergrowth. This effect lasts until you enter a place with direct sunlight for more than an hour.

effectDetails.title: Fungal Confusion
effectDetails.rules: For 1 round after entering combat, any hostile creature within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12) or become confused as it is overwhelmed by the mantle's fungal scent. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

beanbean_mushroom_mantle.levelRequirementReason: The complex attunement process and the item's unique magical properties require a minimum character level of 4.
beanbean_mushroom_mantle.vendorReason: As a vendor specializing in enchanted items, beanbean offers rare and unique wares like the Fungal Mantle.
beanbean_mushroom_mantle.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile bioluminescent properties, the mantle is shipped within a specially insulated package to ensure it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect until exposed to sunlight for more than an hour.
usage.duration: Lasts until exposed to direct sunlight for over an hour or used once per rest.
usage.endsWhen: Exposure to direct sunlight for more than an hour or use during a short/long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

beanbean_mushroom_mantle.priceReason: The mantle's intricate crafting and magical properties justify its price of 1000 XP.

beanbean_peasley_coins_pouch.name: Peasley Scandal Pouch
beanbean_peasley_coins_pouch.description: The Peasley Scandal Pouch is a small, intricately crafted leather pouch adorned with the emblem of Mushroom Regency. When opened, it whispers secrets about hidden locations within Beanbean Kingdom and grants temporary immunity to corruption. However, its use causes minor paranoia among those who carry it.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Locations
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the pouch reveals a secret location within Beanbean Kingdom. The effect lasts until the end of the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Corruption
effectDetails.rules: The user gains temporary immunity to corruption effects for 1 hour upon activation. This immunity can be used once per short rest and is negated by exposing the pouch's origin during a diplomatic event.

beanbean_peasley_coins_pouch.levelRequirementReason: This item provides useful but not overly powerful benefits, suitable for players of all levels.
beanbean_peasley_coins_pouch.vendorReason: Beanbean is known for its connections to Mushroom Regency and has access to unique items like this pouch.
beanbean_peasley_coins_pouch.shippingDetail: Ships within the Beanbean Kingdom with same-day delivery, thanks to Lakitu's efficient drone network.

usage.duration: Until end of next long rest
usage.endsWhen: Exposure during diplomatic events or upon completion of its duration

beanbean_peasley_coins_pouch.priceReason: The price reflects the item's uncommon rarity, unique lore, and the strategic advantage it offers without being game-breaking.

beanbean_peasley_letter.name: Peasleys Secret Letter
beanbean_peasley_letter.description: Peasleys Secret Letter is a wax-sealed parchment with a grand emblem of the Beanbean Royal Family. When opened, it whispers cryptic hints about hidden Beanbean secrets and reveals a route through the most impenetrable parts of the royal gardens. This letter grants access to a clandestine meeting with a high-ranking official who can provide critical assistance in resolving urgent matters.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Hidden Secrets
effectDetails.rules: When opened, the letter emits a faint whisper that reveals one piece of crucial information about hidden Beanbean secrets. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action from the user. The listener must be within 10 feet of the letter to hear it. Once used, the letter remains silent thereafter.

effectDetails.title: Clandestine Meeting
effectDetails.rules: Opening the letter allows the bearer to meet with a high-ranking Beanbean official in secret. This meeting is instantaneous and does not require any action from the user once the letter is opened. The meeting lasts until both parties agree to end it, but no longer than 1 hour.

beanbean_peasley_letter.levelRequirementReason: The complexities of accessing hidden information and arranging clandestine meetings necessitate a certain level of experience.
beanbean_peasley_letter.vendorReason: Beanbean is the official keeper of such royal secrets and ensures that only those with proper credentials can access them.
beanbean_peasley_letter.shippingDetail: The courier delivers the letter within a week, but the package must be collected personally from the Dry Bones location in the Royal City.

usage.duration: Until both parties agree to end the meeting or secret information is revealed
usage.endsWhen: The letter is destroyed after use or if the bearer chooses to end the meeting prematurely

beanbean_peasley_letter.priceReason: This item's rarity and unique utility justify its moderate price in XP.

beanbean_pipe_tether.name: Pipebound Tether of the Koopa Postal
beanbean_pipe_tether.description: The Pipebound Tether of the Koopa Postal is an intricate brass pipe adorned with Koopa insignias, crafted by the postal corps to streamline delivery routes. It can detect hidden messages within pipes and mark locations for future deliveries, enhancing efficiency in the underground network.

effectDetails.title: Detect Hidden Messages
effectDetails.rules: When used in a pipe junction, this tether grants you advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to detect hidden messages or traps within the pipe network. It requires 30 seconds to activate and connect to the nearest junction.

effectDetails.title: Mark Delivery Locations
effectDetails.rules: You can use the tether to mark a location for future deliveries, which grants you a +2 bonus on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made within 5 feet of that location. This effect lasts until you or another creature moves more than 30 feet away from it.

beanbean_pipe_tether.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginner adventurers to assist in their initial forays into underground networks.
beanbean_pipe_tether.vendorReason: Beanbean, known for its postal services and delivery logistics, sells this tether as a tool for efficient package routing.
beanbean_pipe_tether.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Koopa Postal headquarters with next-day delivery within pipe networks.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until interrupted)
usage.endsWhen: The tether is removed from a pipe junction or the creature moves more than 30 feet away.

beanbean_pipe_tether.priceReason: This item's enhanced functionality and Koopa Postal's reputation justify its higher price point.

beanbean_royal_bean_counting.name: Beanbean Royal Bean Counting Service
beanbean_royal_bean_counting.description: Beanbean Royal Bean Counting Service counts your gold with precision and finds hidden coins you thought lost. This service ensures no treasure is left uncounted, providing a certificate of authenticity for your financial peace of mind.

effectDetails.title: Precise Gold Count
effectDetails.rules: As an action, this service counts up to 100 gold pieces in a single stack. It provides you with the exact count within one minute, revealing any discrepancies or hidden coins.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Coins Found
effectDetails.rules: The Beanbean Royal Accountants find an additional 10% of any gold that has been overlooked by your usual methods (minimum increase: +5 gold pieces). This effect is instantaneous and requires no further action from the user. No save DC or saving throw is required.

beanbean_royal_bean_counting.levelRequirementReason: This service can be used by anyone to ensure their wealth is accurately accounted for.
beanbean_royal_bean_counting.vendorReason: Beanbean Royal Accountants are renowned throughout the realm for their precision and reliability in financial matters.
beanbean_royal_bean_counting.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted Royal Couriers, ensuring your gold is counted under secure conditions with a delivery time of two days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charges are exhausted or the stack exceeds 100 gold pieces
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one stack per day

beanbean_royal_bean_counting.priceReason: The service is priced reasonably for its efficiency and precision, ensuring no valuable coins go uncounted.

beanbean_royal_bean_counting_premium.name: Beanbean Royal Bean Counting (Premium)
beanbean_royal_bean_counting_premium.description: The Beanbean Royal Bean Counting (Premium) is an intricate device crafted by Beanbean Royal Accountants, exquisitely detailed with gold leaf and precious gemstones. It not only counts your beans with unparalleled precision but also provides a detailed report that can influence negotiations or decisions. The device itself is a status symbol, often seen in the hands of merchants and accountants seeking to project an image of wealth and meticulousness.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Bean Counting
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this device counts your beans with 95% accuracy. It also reveals an additional 10% of the total count as a hidden bonus, but charges you a fee equal to 8% of the counted amount. The device must be used in a quiet environment where it can be placed on a flat surface for optimal performance.

effectDetails.title: Reputation Boost
effectDetails.rules: For one day after using this device, your reputation improves within the local merchant community by +2 to Persuasion checks. This effect is cumulative with other similar benefits, but you must continue to maintain proper usage and etiquette in public.

beanbean_royal_bean_counting_premium.levelRequirementReason: The device requires a user who can handle its intricate mechanisms.
beanbean_royal_bean_counting_premium.vendorReason: Beanbean Royal Accountants are known for their precision and reliability, which makes them the perfect vendor for this high-quality counting tool.
beanbean_royal_bean_counting_premium.shippingDetail: Ships via Bean Vault Express with a delivery time of one day. Requires special handling to ensure the device arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used up all charges or destroyed

beanbean_royal_bean_counting_premium.priceReason: The device is priced at 1000 XP due to its premium craftsmanship and the additional reputation boost it offers.

beanbean_scarlet_crown.name: Crown of the Broken Throne
beanbean_scarlet_crown.description: The Crown of the Broken Throne is a regal relic encrusted with rubies that shimmer like spilled blood. It whispers tales of its wearer’s past diplomatic prowess and grants them an unparalleled +4 to leadership checks, making them the heart of any group. However, it can cause the wearer's hands to visibly tremble during combat unless they have extensive experience in the field of diplomacy.

effectDetails.title: Leadership Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, providing the wearer with a +4 bonus to leadership checks. This effect lasts until the end of the wearer's next turn. If the wearer does not have at least two successful diplomatic checks within the last week, they must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or suffer from mental unraveling for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Combat Tremors
effectDetails.rules: The crown causes visible tremors in the wearer’s hands during combat. This effect is active as long as the wearer is engaged in melee combat and does not have at least two successful diplomatic checks within the last week. The tremors impose disadvantage on attack rolls made by the wearer.

beanbean_scarlet_crown.levelRequirementReason: The Crown requires significant experience to wield its powers effectively, ensuring only those who have earned their place in leadership can use it.
beanbean_scarlet_crown.vendorReason: Beanbean is known for their vast collection of fabled relics and artifacts, including this crown’s heritage from the Prince Peasley scandal.
beanbean_scarlet_crown.shippingDetail: Ships with a note from the Onyx Hand’s courier, ensuring safe delivery and authenticity.

usage.duration: Until the end of the wearer's next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the crown is removed or if the wearer fails a saving throw due to lack of diplomatic experience

beanbean_scarlet_crown.priceReason: This price reflects its limited availability and the significant experience required to use it effectively.

beanbean_shadowfell_keychain.name: Shadowfell Keychain of the Onyx Hand
beanbean_shadowfell_keychain.description: The Shadowfell Keychain of the Onyx Hand is a gnarled keychain crafted from ancient onyx, its surface etched with runes that glow faintly in the dark. It can unlock hidden portals to the Shadowfell and serves as a potent talisman against corruption, though overuse will inevitably lead to psychic strain.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Portal
effectDetails.rules: Activates with an action. Grants access to one hidden portal in the Shadowfell, usable once per day.

effectDetails.title: Corruption Detection
effectDetails.rules: When used within a magical aura or area of corruption, triggers a 50% chance to detect it. No save is required.

beanbean_shadowfell_keychain.levelRequirementReason: The keychain’s power is subtle and focused, making it accessible to lower-level characters.
beanbean_shadowfell_keychain.vendorReason: Beanbean specializes in rare and magical items, including those that offer unique access to other planes of existence.
beanbean_shadowfell_keychain.shippingDetail: Priority delivery ensures swift arrival from Orangus Cornelius’s workshop in the Shadowfell's depths.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Once used or after 72 hours of non-use

beanbean_shadowfell_keychain.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its utility and limited daily usage.

beanbean_team_rock_item.name: Remi Coil Airship Boost
beanbean_team_rock_item.description: The Remi Coil Airship Boost is a patent-enhanced propulsion module crafted by Team Rocket. This sleek, metallic core integrates seamlessly into any airship, instantly doubling its speed and range across all conditions. However, in high-pressure zones, there's a 10% chance it will trigger a system crash, causing a brief delay. Each successful activation grants bonus XP for every 1000 meters traveled, making this module invaluable during extended flights.
effects: May cause a system crash in high-pressure zones

effectDetails.title: Doubled Performance
effectDetails.rules: This effect increases the airship's speed and range by 100% for the duration of one short rest or until disabled. It provides an additional bonus XP equal to 5% of distance traveled in meters, capped at 200 XP per use.

effectDetails.title: System Crash Risk
effectDetails.rules: In high-pressure zones, there is a 10% chance (DC 14 Dexterity saving throw) that the module will trigger a system crash. The airship is incapacitated for 1 minute and cannot be moved until repaired.

beanbean_team_rock_item.levelRequirementReason: This item can be used by any character, enhancing the efficiency of airships for all adventurers.
beanbean_team_rock_item.vendorReason: Beanbean specializes in innovative items that enhance travel and exploration, making this module a perfect fit for their inventory.
beanbean_team_rock_item.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the relentless Piranha Plant Post, ensuring your airship is ready to soar high and fast upon arrival.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate the module's effects for a duration of one short rest or until disabled.
usage.duration: Until disabled or at the end of a short rest
usage.endsWhen: Disabling the module, ending a short rest, or damage being dealt to it

beanbean_team_rock_item.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its moderate level of enhancement and utility without overshadowing more powerful items.

beanbean_treasure_inkwell.name: Inkwell of Whispering Scribes
beanbean_treasure_inkwell.description: The Inkwell of Whispering Scribes is a delicate artifact crafted from polished obsidian and etched with runes. It contains an ancient vial sealed with the last whispered decree of the Onyx Hand, granting its user a fleeting connection to the scribe’s legacy. This inkwell grants +2d4 insight bonus to spellcasting checks when used on parchment, but it requires the user to be at least a 1st-level spellcaster and must rest for one day after each use due to the mystical energy it consumes.

effectDetails.title: Ink Bonus
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this inkwell grants a +2d4 insight bonus to spellcasting checks when used on parchment. The user must be at least a 1st-level spellcaster and spend one minute writing with it. This effect is instantaneous.

effectDetails.title: Daily Rest Required
effectDetails.rules: After using the inkwell, the user must rest for one day before using it again due to the mystical energy consumed during its use. The inkwell can only be used once per long rest.

beanbean_treasure_inkwell.levelRequirementReason: Users need at least a 1st-level spellcaster to harness the arcane properties of this inkwell.
beanbean_treasure_inkwell.vendorReason: Beanbean, known for their extensive inventory of magical curiosities and artifacts, offers the Inkwell of Whispering Scribes as part of their collection of rare and mystical items.
beanbean_treasure_inkwell.shippingDetail: Delivered via Warp Whistle Transit, this inkwell arrives with a special delivery note from the Onyx Hand’s personal courier, ensuring its arrival is swift and secure.

usage.activation: Used as an action to write on parchment for spellcasting checks.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon writing.
usage.endsWhen: The inkwell requires a full day of rest before it can be used again.

beanbean_treasure_inkwell.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect the uncommon rarity and mystical properties, making it accessible yet valuable for spellcasters seeking an edge in their craft.

beholder_eye_beam_focus.name: Beholder Eye-Beam Focus Surgery
beholder_eye_beam_focus.description: This surgically implanted lens mimics a Beholder's eye and focuses your gaze into a concentrated ray of pure energy. Crafted by Xanathar's Surgeon, this device enhances your spellcasting, allowing you to channel the power of a behemoth's eyesight directly through your own.
effects: Ray spells gain +2 to attack rolls
Increase save DCs by +1 for ray spells

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Ray Spells
effectDetails.rules: Activation: On casting a ray spell, as an action. Duration: Concentration up to 1 hour or until the spell ends. Ends When: Dismissed by the user or when concentration is lost.

effectDetails.title: Increased Save DCs
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous activation; this effect applies automatically without a saving throw. No save DC limit, but only one increase per spell cast each day.

beholder_eye_beam_focus.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant magical and physical prowess to undergo the surgery.
beholder_eye_beam_focus.vendorReason: Eye_Doctor specializes in complex surgeries that enhance magical abilities, including Beholder Eye-Beam Focus Surgery.
beholder_eye_beam_focus.shippingDetail: Ships via a Disintegration Beam Express for immediate delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: On casting a ray spell as an action
usage.duration: Concentration up to 1 hour or until the spell ends
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed by the user or when concentration is lost
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharges after a long rest

beholder_eye_beam_focus.priceReason: Balanced as an expensive but fair price for such an advanced and powerful magical enhancement.

bioluminescent_fungus_lantern.name: Bioluminescent Fungus Lantern (Light)
bioluminescent_fungus_lantern.description: This lantern is crafted from a rare species of bioluminescent fungi that thrives in the darkest caverns. Its light not only illuminates but also heals minor wounds, restoring vitality to those who traverse its glow.

effectDetails.title: Bright Light
effectDetails.rules: The lantern emits bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. This effect is active as long as the lantern remains lit.

effectDetails.title: Minor Healing
effectDetails.rules: All creatures within the bright light of the lantern gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1) at the start of their turns. This effect ends when they leave the area or if the lantern goes out.

bioluminescent_fungus_lantern.levelRequirementReason: A basic adventurer can handle the task of carrying this lantern.
bioluminescent_fungus_lantern.vendorReason: Mycoid Cultivators are known for their expertise in deep underground fungi, including crafting such unique items.
bioluminescent_fungus_lantern.shippingDetail: Shipped via Spore Pod Express, ensuring the lantern arrives safely and remains active.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation by touching the lantern to light it.
usage.duration: The effect is continuous as long as the lantern remains lit.
usage.endsWhen: The lantern goes out or is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but requires a short rest to recharge.

bioluminescent_fungus_lantern.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the unique crafting and deep-underground resources required for its creation.

biomechanical_symbiote.name: Biomechanical Symbiote (Living Armor)
biomechanical_symbiote.description: The Biomechanical Symbiote is a living armor that seamlessly integrates with its host. Crafted from advanced biomechanics, it enhances both physical prowess and resilience. This symbiotic organism not only grants +2 to Strength and Dexterity but also actively repairs any damage to the host's body over time, ensuring durability in battle.

effectDetails.title: Self-Repair
effectDetails.rules: The symbiote continuously repairs damage to the host's body. It restores 1d6 hit points at the start of each of the host’s turns, provided that the host is wearing light armor or no armor. This effect has a limit of one use per hour.

effectDetails.title: +2 to Strength and Dexterity
effectDetails.rules: The symbiote enhances the host's physical abilities by +2 to both Strength and Dexterity. The enhancement is passive and applies at all times while the symbiote is active within the host’s body.

biomechanical_symbiote.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience can safely integrate such a complex and powerful biomechanical organism.
biomechanical_symbiote.vendorReason: As creators of the Biomechanical Symbiote, BioForge Labs is the only vendor trusted to supply this advanced technology.
biomechanical_symbiote.shippingDetail: The symbiotic organism requires a special pod for safe transport. The pod provides additional protection during transit and ensures the symbiote remains dormant until it can be integrated into its host.

usage.activation: Passive effect, activated upon integration with the host’s body
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; continuous effect while within the host's body
usage.endsWhen: The symbiote ceases to function if separated from the host for more than an hour or if the host dies.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as it remains integrated

biomechanical_symbiote.priceReason: Reflects the advanced technology and specialized expertise required in its creation.

black_hole_in_a_jar.name: Black Hole in a Jar
black_hole_in_a_jar.description: A sturdy mason jar houses a microcosmic black hole, its surface rippling with dark energy. Crafted by The Astrophysicist in a lab where stars are born and die, this jar contains a fragment of an ancient cosmic entity. It can be opened to suck in everything within 20 feet without any saving throw, or closed as a pet that obeys simple commands.

effectDetails.title: Suction Zone
effectDetails.rules: Activation: A standard action; Range: 20 feet; Area: Everything within the specified range is drawn into the jar, destroyed, and cannot escape. No saving throw applies. This effect has no duration but can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Pet Companion
effectDetails.rules: Activation: An object interaction; Duration: Until closed again or until the black hole is destroyed; Save DC: 15; The black hole behaves as a familiar obeying simple commands. It does not gain intelligence, but it can be commanded to perform tasks that do not harm itself.

black_hole_in_a_jar.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least level 1 to use safely, ensuring the wielder has basic understanding of its power.
black_hole_in_a_jar.vendorReason: Celestial Bodies specializes in rare and powerful cosmic artifacts like this jar, making it their natural vendor.
black_hole_in_a_jar.shippingDetail: The jar is carefully packed with specialized gravity-nullifying materials to prevent any accidental activation during transit.

usage.activation: A standard action for opening or closing the jar; an object interaction for commanding the black hole familiar.
usage.duration: Instantaneous when opened, until closed again; Until closed or destroyed for the pet companion effect.
usage.endsWhen: Jar is resealed, used up in a destructive act, or destroyed by force

black_hole_in_a_jar.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and the knowledge required to safely handle such an artifact.

black_paint_of_emo_introspection.name: Black Paint of Emo Introspection
black_paint_of_emo_introspection.description: The Black Paint of Emo Introspection is a thick, glossy paint that seeps into your very skin, turning it an eerie shade of black. Dark Elves Paint Co.'s masterpiece captures the essence of introspective melancholy. Before each long rest, you must compose a poem in its honor or risk feeling perpetually unsettled. Your shadow grows more dramatic, casting darker and more pronounced outlines.

effectDetails.title: Dramatic Shadow
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against fear effects. Your natural shadow lengthens and darkens, providing advantage on Stealth checks in dim light.

effectDetails.title: Melancholic Poetry
effectDetails.rules: Before each long rest, you must compose a poem of at least 20 lines that reflects deep introspection or risk being restless for the next hour. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

black_paint_of_emo_introspection.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level as it can be used by any character to explore their inner emotions.
black_paint_of_emo_introspection.vendorReason: Dark Elves Paint Co. is known for capturing the essence of melancholy and introspection, making this paint a natural addition to their inventory.
black_paint_of_emo_introspection.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of darkness; arrives by nightfall.

usage.activation: Passive effect until next long rest.
usage.duration: Instantaneous at each long rest, lasts until the next.
usage.endsWhen: Restlessness if you do not compose a poem before the next long rest. Ends upon death or removal of paint.

black_paint_of_emo_introspection.priceReason: The price reflects its uncommon status and unique utility, providing both defensive benefits and thematic roleplaying opportunities without being overpowered.

blessed_order_holy_bread_recipe.name: Recipe: Blessed Order Holy Bread
blessed_order_holy_bread_recipe.description: The Blessed Order Holy Bread Recipe is a sacred text that teaches bakers how to craft divine loaves imbued with protective and healing powers. Made by the Order Bakers, this recipe requires only blessed ingredients and holy water for its creation. The bread glows faintly as it channels divine energy, protecting against undead and fiends while also providing a nourishing meal.

effectDetails.title: Holy Protection
effectDetails.rules: Activates when the bread is consumed. Grants advantage on saving throws against undead and fiends for 1 hour. Ends if consumed or if the eater is no longer aligned with good.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Healing
effectDetails.rules: Eating the bread heals 2d6 radiant hit points upon consumption, providing nourishment for 4 hours thereafter. The effect ends when the eater finishes their next long rest.

blessed_order_holy_bread_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners to learn and apply the recipe's divine protection.
blessed_order_holy_bread_recipe.vendorReason: The Order Bakers of Blessed Chapel are known for their sacred recipes and have been entrusted with this holy text.
blessed_order_holy_bread_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered via a special scroll that ensures the recipe remains intact during transit.

usage.activation: Eating the bread upon creation triggers these effects.
usage.duration: Holy Protection lasts for 1 hour, Radiant Healing ends after a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Effects end when consumed or if the eater's alignment changes to neutral or evil.

blessed_order_holy_bread_recipe.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare recipe that provides both protection and healing, making it valuable but not overpowered.

blessed_order_holy_water_dispenser.name: Blessed Order Holy Water Dispenser
blessed_order_holy_water_dispenser.description: The Blessed Order Holy Water Dispenser is a compact, brass vessel with a frosted glass spout and an etched logo of the Sacred Flame. It dispenses holy water that not only blesses your cooking but also purifies any ingredient you add to it. The dispenser's holy essence is said to originate from the very heart of the Blessed Order’s sanctuary, making each drop imbued with divine power.

effectDetails.title: Holy Blessing
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this item as a bonus action, it dispenses holy water that blesses your cooking. Undead within 5 feet of the food are repulsed and must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be pushed away from the meal for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Purifying Ingredient
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can pour holy water into any ingredient. The ingredient is purified, removing all magical corruption or poison effects. This effect does not affect living creatures. Once per short rest, you may use this feature to purify a single ingrediant.

blessed_order_holy_water_dispenser.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and travelers who need divine aid in their culinary endeavors without the complexity of higher-level magic.
blessed_order_holy_water_dispenser.vendorReason: The Blessed Order Holy Water Co. has long been trusted to provide believers with holy water imbued with divine power, making this dispenser a natural addition to their offerings.
blessed_order_holy_water_dispenser.shippingDetail: Ships via the Holy Procession, delivered within one week of order placement.

usage.activation: Bonus action or action (to pour into ingredients)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for holy blessing; until dispensed purifying ingredient is used
usage.endsWhen: Charges are expended or the item is destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have a supply of holy water

blessed_order_holy_water_dispenser.priceReason: The price reflects the divine craftsmanship and the material used to ensure purity and efficacy.

blessed_order_holy_water_distiller.name: Blessed Order Holy Water Distiller
blessed_order_holy_water_distiller.description: The Blessed Order Holy Water Distiller is a small, alchemically refined contraption crafted by the Order Alchemists. Its pristine brass frame and intricate gears hum with divine energy as it infuses bread with blessings. This device not only enhances religious knowledge but also purifies water, making it a sacred tool for rituals and healing.

effectDetails.title: Infuse Bread with Blessings
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the Blessed Order Holy Water Distiller to infuse a piece of bread with divine blessings. This grants the user +1 proficiency bonus to Religion checks for up to one hour. The device requires a 5-minute period of concentration and recharges after being blessed by a cleric or paladin.

effectDetails.title: Purify Water
effectDetails.rules: When used on water, the Distiller can purify it, dealing 1d4 radiant damage to any disease or poison affecting the drinker. This effect is instantaneous and requires no action from the user. The water must be consumed within one hour of purification.

blessed_order_holy_water_distiller.levelRequirementReason: A novice can understand the basics of religious knowledge and the rudiments of alchemy, making this tool accessible to all adventurers.
blessed_order_holy_water_distiller.vendorReason: The Blessed Order Chapel is known for its sacred relics and tools that aid in divine rituals, and this Distiller fits perfectly into their offerings.
blessed_order_holy_water_distiller.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Sacred Steam Set, ensuring the device arrives pristine and ready to use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; Infusion lasts for one hour
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the hour passes or the bread is consumed

blessed_order_holy_water_distiller.priceReason: At 1,000 XP, this item provides a significant religious and healing benefit without overpricing.

blessed_order_holy_water_flask.name: Blessed Order Holy Water Flask
blessed_order_holy_water_flask.description: The Blessed Order Holy Water Flask is a small, intricately crafted glass flask filled with water blessed by the devout monks of the Blessed Order. The water's holy essence can be seen shimmering faintly within its depths, and it is said to possess sanctified power capable of repelling evil. This sacred item can deal 2d6 radiant damage to fiends and undead upon consumption, or bless a small area (10-foot radius) for one hour by pouring the water.

effectDetails.title: Holy Water
effectDetails.rules: Consume this flask to deal 2d6 radiant damage to fiends and undead within reach. This effect is instantaneous and does not require action.

effectDetails.title: Area Blessing
effectDetails.rules: By pouring the holy water, you can bless a small area (10-foot radius) for one hour. Creatures within the area gain resistance to poison damage until the end of their next long rest. This effect is used as an action and lasts for the duration specified.

blessed_order_holy_water_flask.levelRequirementReason: The holy water's power can be accessed by those who have not yet reached a more advanced level, making it accessible to players at the start of their journey.
blessed_order_holy_water_flask.vendorReason: The Blessed Order is dedicated to the protection and sanctification of the realm; thus, they are responsible for distributing items imbued with divine power like this flask.
blessed_order_holy_water_flask.shippingDetail: Ships via a trusted Order Messenger, ensuring safe delivery within two days.

usage.activation: Consume or pour the holy water as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Holy Water; one hour for Area Blessing.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon expiration or when consumed.

blessed_order_holy_water_flask.priceReason: The flask's rarity and the divine power it holds justify its price, making it a valuable yet balanced addition to any adventurer's inventory.

blessed_order_holy_water_splash_service.name: Blessed Order Holy Water Splash Service
blessed_order_holy_water_splash_service.description: This vial of blessed water, crafted by Order Priests, is a quick and effective way to sanctify your gear. A simple splash imbues your weapon with radiant power for a day, while you gain resilience against evil's influence. Just be cautious; the ritual can leave you drenched in a cascade of holy water.

effectDetails.title: Holy Weapon
effectDetails.rules: When you splash this vial, choose one weapon you are proficient with. Until the start of your next turn, it deals an extra +1d6 radiant damage to undead and fiends. This effect lasts for 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Resilient Faith
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one long rest, you gain advantage on saving throws against effects with the 'evil' descriptor. You can use this feature once per short or long rest.

blessed_order_holy_water_splash_service.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for novice adventurers to quickly bless their gear and enhance their protection.
blessed_order_holy_water_splash_service.vendorReason: The chapel ensures that its patrons have the means to protect themselves against evil forces.
blessed_order_holy_water_splash_service.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted Order Priests, ensuring a timely arrival of your holy water.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting for the specified duration
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you finish a long rest or are no longer in contact with the blessed water.

blessed_order_holy_water_splash_service.priceReason: This price reflects a balanced cost for an item that provides quick, effective protection and offense against undead and fiends.

blessed_order_paladin_boots.name: Blessed Order Paladin Boots
blessed_order_paladin_boots.description: These boots of pious duty and unmatched craftsmanship squeak with a sound that echoes the halls of justice. The Blessed Order Cobbler's artistry is evident in every stitch, making these not just footwear but a symbol of virtue and valor.

effectDetails.title: Justice Squeak
effectDetails.rules: When you move, the boots produce a sound that alerts creatures within 30 feet. Creatures can't use Stealth to hide from you until the start of your next turn unless they succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Righteous Balance
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone and on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wearing these boots. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after moving at least 30 feet.

blessed_order_paladin_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are crafted for those who wish to walk a path of righteousness, starting as early as level 1.
blessed_order_paladin_boots.vendorReason: The Blessed Order is known for its commitment to fostering justice and virtue among the faithful.
blessed_order_paladin_boots.shippingDetail: Ships via a special procession, delivered within one week of order placement.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn after moving at least 30 feet.
usage.endsWhen: On the start of your next turn without moving.

blessed_order_paladin_boots.priceReason: The boots are crafted with blessed materials and expert craftsmanship, offering a fair price for their exceptional utility.

blessed_order_priest_robe.name: Blessed Order Priest Robe
blessed_order_priest_robe.description: The Blessed Order Priest Robe is a simple yet divine white garment adorned with subtle holy symbols. It whispers wisdom to its wearer, enhancing their connection with the divine. The robe's fabric holds an ancient blessing that purifies the soul, leaving no trace of impurity after use.

effectDetails.title: Divine Insight
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +1 to all Wisdom (Religion) checks. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Sacred Cleansing
effectDetails.rules: After use, the robe cleans itself and neutralizes any harmful energy or dirt, leaving no trace of impurity. This effect occurs automatically after each use without consuming charges.

blessed_order_priest_robe.levelRequirementReason: This level requirement allows novice priests to benefit from its divine properties.
blessed_order_priest_robe.vendorReason: The Blessed Order Monastery is known for their sanctified garments and rituals, ensuring the robes are imbued with pure magic.
blessed_order_priest_robe.shippingDetail: Ships via Holy Thread's divine courier service; delivery time varies based on spiritual energy levels.

usage.duration: Permanent until next rest
usage.endsWhen: The wearer takes a long rest or the robe is destroyed

blessed_order_priest_robe.priceReason: This price reflects the rare materials and divine blessings that imbue the robe, making it an essential but not excessively expensive item for young priests.

blessed_order_recipe_holy_water_soup.name: Recipe: Blessed Order Holy Water Soup
blessed_order_recipe_holy_water_soup.description: This soup is a humble yet potent gift of divine grace. Each spoonful is a reminder of the Blessed Order's unwavering faith, with a subtle tang that hints at holy water's purity. It grants advantage on saving throws against undead and fiendish threats for one hour, while also causing such creatures to find its smell revolting, giving you advantage on Charisma checks to repel them.

effectDetails.title: Holy Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the soup grants you advantage on saving throws against undead and fiendish effects for one hour. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you take any nonmagical damage.

effectDetails.title: Undead Repellent
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after consumption, undead creatures within 30 feet find the soup's smell so revolting that they have disadvantage on Charisma checks to interact with you. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you take any nonmagical damage.

blessed_order_recipe_holy_water_soup.levelRequirementReason: This humble yet effective recipe is accessible to low-level characters who wish to bolster their protection against otherworldly threats.
blessed_order_recipe_holy_water_soup.vendorReason: The Blessed Order Kitchen is known for its pious and practical recipes, making this soup a staple among their offerings.
blessed_order_recipe_holy_water_soup.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Holy Procession, this delicacy arrives fresh from the kitchens of the Blessed Order.

usage.duration: One hour or until nonmagical damage is taken
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or if you take any nonmagical damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a consumable item

blessed_order_recipe_holy_water_soup.priceReason: This soup combines divine grace with practical utility at an accessible price point.

blessed_order_suncrystal.name: Blessed Order Suncrystal
blessed_order_suncrystal.description: The Blessed Order Suncrystal is a radiant gemstone crafted by the divine artisans of the Blessed Order. Its surface shimmering with raw light, it channels celestial energy to bolster those who wield it in holy combat against dark forces.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Boost
effectDetails.rules: When the user casts a spell dealing Radiant damage, they gain +1d6 additional damage. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Flash
effectDetails.rules: The user can emit a blinding flash that blinds all Undead and Fiends within 30 feet for 1 minute (DC 14 CON save). The effect can only be used once per day. Creatures successfully saving do not suffer the blindness effect.

blessed_order_suncrystal.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least 9th level to wield the Suncrystal effectively in combat.
blessed_order_suncrystal.vendorReason: The Blessed Order is responsible for crafting and distributing holy relics like this Suncrystal, ensuring only those of proper piety can use it.
blessed_order_suncrystal.shippingDetail: Ships via the Silver Casket with a delivery delay of one week.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action to cast a spell dealing Radiant damage or to emit a blinding flash.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for casting, Blinding Flash lasts 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: Blinding Flash ends when the duration expires. Both effects are exhausted after use.
usage.charges: Unlimited; both effects can be used once per long rest.

blessed_order_suncrystal.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rarity and divine craftsmanship, providing a fair value for such a powerful yet not overpowered item.

blessing_of_the_elders.name: Blessing of the Elders
blessing_of_the_elders.description: The Blessing of the Elders is a sacred ritual that bestows an ancient weapon or armor with the protective essence of the toad sages. This relic not only enhances its wearer's defenses but also imbues the item with a sense of timeless power, making it a treasured heirloom among the clans.

effectDetails.title: Ancestral Power
effectDetails.rules: The weapon or armor gains +1 bonus to AC and damage rolls for a year. Non-magical items become +1 quality. This effect is active as long as the item is worn by its owner.

effectDetails.title: Monthly Sanctuary
effectDetails.rules: Once per month, the wearer may cast *Sanctuary* on themselves as a ritual action. The spell has no verbal or somatic components and requires only a 10gp consecrated coin as material components. This effect must be activated by the owner.

blessing_of_the_elders.levelRequirementReason: The simplicity of the ritual allows even low-level characters to benefit from its protection.
blessing_of_the_elders.vendorReason: As guardians of ancient traditions, the Toad Council ensures that only those worthy receive this sacred blessing.
blessing_of_the_elders.shippingDetail: The scroll must be delivered by a trusted messenger and must not be opened before reaching its intended recipient.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation required for monthly *Sanctuary* ritual
usage.duration: 1 year or until the item is removed from the owner's possession
usage.endsWhen: The item ceases to be worn by the owner, or if it becomes non-magical and was originally magical
usage.charges: Unlimited; the monthly *Sanctuary* can be used once per month

blessing_of_the_elders.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and the significant benefit of a year-long +1 bonus to AC and damage rolls, along with the unique ability to cast *Sanctuary* monthly.

block_brick.name: Brick Block
block_brick.description: This hefty brick block, crafted from ancient volcanic rock, is a marvel of natural engineering. It weighs a full hundred pounds and can be used to elevate oneself or an ally by ten feet. When smashed, it releases a cascade of small lava fragments that scorch the ground around it.

effectDetails.title: Portable High Ground
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you or an ally can use this brick block to create a temporary platform ten feet in diameter. This effect lasts for one minute and requires no checks.

effectDetails.title: Smash
effectDetails.rules: When smashed, the brick block releases a 15-foot cone of scorching fragments. Creatures within the area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 fire damage. The item is destroyed after this use.

block_brick.levelRequirementReason: The physical exertion required to lift and place the block safely limits its usage to characters of at least level 1.
block_brick.vendorReason: The market thrives on oddities and local curios, making it a natural home for this unique brick block.
block_brick.shippingDetail: Due to its weight, the brick block is shipped via a specialized Freight service with a two-day delivery time.

usage.duration: One minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the item is destroyed after smashing it.

block_brick.priceReason: The brick block's rarity, unique material, and physical properties justify its price of 1000 XP.

blood_moon_curse.name: Blood Moon Curse (Third Party)
blood_moon_curse.description: The Blood Moon Curse is a cursed amulet forged from the bones of lycanthropes and enchanted by the Blood Moon Coven. Wearing it transforms the wearer into a powerful Werewolf Lord, granting them enhanced strength and agility. It can be transferred to enemies through physical contact, making it a deadly weapon in the hands of those seeking to harm their foes.

effectDetails.title: Lycanthropy Transformation
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. The wearer transforms into a Werewolf Lord for 1 hour or until dismissed by the user. This form grants +2 to Strength and Dexterity, and advantage on Stealth checks. It can be dispelled with a successful DC 17 Constitution save.

effectDetails.title: Transfer Curse on Touch
effectDetails.rules: The curse can be transferred to an enemy through touch as a bonus action. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become cursed, allowing the wearer to transfer the curse again after 24 hours.

blood_moon_curse.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant power and control over lycanthropy to safely wear this item.
blood_moon_curse.vendorReason: The Curse Weaver specializes in crafting and dealing with curses, making them the perfect vendor for such a potent artifact.
blood_moon_curse.shippingDetail: Ships via Cursed Post within 3 days. Delivery may take an additional 2-4 weeks due to magical courier delays.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action (to transform or transfer curse)
usage.duration: 1 hour per use for transformation, lasts until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed by the user or upon expiration of duration

blood_moon_curse.priceReason: Balanced at 2000 XP to ensure it remains a powerful but not overpowered item.

blooper_ink_well.name: Blooper's Ink Well
blooper_ink_well.description: Blooper's Ink Well is a glass vessel filled with inky black fluid that reeks of saltwater. When activated, it releases a cone of ink that blinds foes for one round unless they succeed on a Constitution saving throw. The well also writes messages visible only under the light of the moon, and octopi within 30 feet become docile and approachable.

effectDetails.title: Ink Cone: Blind Enemies
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. A cone of ink extends 15 feet from the well in any direction. Creatures within this area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for one minute.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Messages
effectDetails.rules: The ink writes messages visible only under moonlight, and lasts until the start of your next turn after writing.

blooper_ink_well.levelRequirementReason: A first-level spellcaster can manage the intricate activation and duration of this item.
blooper_ink_well.vendorReason: The observatory frequently deals with oddities found in the deep, including octopi and strange inks.
blooper_ink_well.shippingDetail: Shipped in a sealed jar to preserve the ink's potency.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The creature succeeds on its saving throw or when used again
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration during activation

blooper_ink_well.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as a useful tool for low-level spellcasters.

blue_paint.name: Bucket of Blue Paint
blue_paint.description: This sturdy bucket of deep ocean blue paint exudes a rich, glossy sheen. Crafted from reclaimed wood and sealed with water-resistant varnish, it's perfect for splashing on walls or creating murals. Legend whispers that the paint can only be found in the hands of Toad Town Market’s most trusted patrons.

effectDetails.title: Blue Aura
effectDetails.rules: When applied to a surface, the paint emits a soft blue glow that lasts for 1 hour. Creatures within 5 feet of the painted area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become charmed until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Quick Drying
effectDetails.rules: The paint dries in 10 minutes, reducing any surface to its original state if left untouched. Once dry, it cannot be easily removed without magic.

blue_paint.levelRequirementReason: Any adventurer can appreciate the utility of a versatile paint bucket.
blue_paint.vendorReason: The market is known for its array of useful tools and curiosities, making it the ideal place to find this handy item.
blue_paint.shippingDetail: Delivered by Toad Express in one day with a special delivery note from the market owner.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until dried naturally
usage.endsWhen: Dries completely without magical intervention

blue_paint.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the paint's utility and the rarity of finding such quality in Toad Town.

blueberry_muffins_that_restore_spell.name: Recipe: Mages' Guild Mana Muffins
blueberry_muffins_that_restore_spell.description: These delicate Mages' Guild Mana Muffins are crafted from rare blueberries and imbued with arcane energy. Upon consumption, they restore one expended first-level spell slot, leaving you refreshed yet slightly dizzy for a moment. The confectioners of the guild ensure each batch is made fresh daily using their proprietary recipe, handed down through generations.
effects: Restores One Expended First-Level Spell Slot

effectDetails.title: Restore Spell Slot
effectDetails.rules: Consume a Mana Muffin as an action to restore one expended first-level spell slot. The muffin must be eaten within the hour of preparation.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Dizziness
effectDetails.rules: After consuming a Mana Muffin, the character is dazed for 1 round (DC 12 Constitution save ends early if you succeed).

blueberry_muffins_that_restore_spell.levelRequirementReason: Appropriate for all spellcasters who need a quick boost of mana.
blueberry_muffins_that_restore_spell.vendorReason: The Mages' Guild is known for its support of their members, ensuring they have the tools and resources needed to maintain peak performance.
blueberry_muffins_that_restore_spell.shippingDetail: Ships via Arcane Relay with expedited delivery within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts until the beginning of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The dizziness ends on a successful Constitution saving throw or after one round.

blueberry_muffins_that_restore_spell.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP to reflect its rare ingredients and arcane energy.

bob_omb_buddy.name: Bob-Omb Buddy
bob_omb_buddy.description: A soft pink Bob-Omb with big eyes and a wagging tail, this Buddy follows faithfully by your side until you command it to explode. When you give the word, it releases a burst of fiery petals in a 10-foot radius that deal 3d6 fire damage to all creatures within. After detonating, it reverts into a harmless, giggling puff of petals until dawn.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Petals
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this Bob-Omb Buddy as an action, it releases a burst of fiery petals that deal 3d6 fire damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius. The explosion has no effect on objects or plants.

effectDetails.title: Morning Reformation
effectDetails.rules: At dawn, the Bob-Omb Buddy reforms into its harmless form. It can be reactivated once per day after it has reformed.

bob_omb_buddy.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for low-level adventurers who need an easy-to-carry, reliable explosive.
bob_omb_buddy.vendorReason: The Rogue Port's Black Market stocks a variety of unusual goods, including this quirky companion.
bob_omb_buddy.shippingDetail: Ships securely in an Explosive Container to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: At dawn or when destroyed by a successful DC 14 Dexterity (Stealth) check.

bob_omb_buddy.priceReason: Balanced for its low-level utility and risk, this item is priced to reflect its daily recharge ability.

bob_omb_standard.name: Bob-omb (Defused)
bob_omb_standard.description: This defused Bob-omb retains its explosive appearance with a red fuse that has been removed for safety. It is a standard, non-lethal training device used by adventurers to practice their combat and survival skills in a controlled environment.
bob_omb_standard.warning: Possession may be illegal in some jurisdictions

effectDetails.title: Training Device
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as part of a combat drill, the Bob-omb does not explode. Instead, it lands harmlessly and can be used to practice dodging or countering. It has no effect on creatures within reach.

effectDetails.title: Non-Lethal
effectDetails.rules: The Bob-omb is designed for training purposes only and does not deal damage upon contact with a creature or object. It is meant solely for target practice and skill development.

bob_omb_standard.levelRequirementReason: This item is intended for beginners and those new to combat, requiring no specific level of proficiency.
bob_omb_standard.vendorReason: The Rogue Port Black Market sells a wide variety of unusual items, including training tools like the Bob-omb (Defused).
bob_omb_standard.shippingDetail: Delivered with special handling to ensure safe transport.

usage.activation: Thrown as part of a combat drill or practice session.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for training purposes; no duration limit.
usage.endsWhen: The Bob-omb lands harmlessly on the ground after being thrown.

bob_omb_standard.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP for its training value and non-lethal nature, making it accessible to all adventurers regardless of level.

bobomb_buddy_plushie.name: Bob-omb Buddy Plushie
bobomb_buddy_plushie.description: A plushie crafted from resilient fabric and stuffed with a mix of confetti and small firecrackers. This Bob-omb Buddy Plushie provides much-needed morale boosts during tense situations, but its explosive nature can be unpredictable, sometimes startling nearby allies.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you are reduced to zero hit points but not killed outright, you can use an action to squeeze the plushie. Doing so grants you advantage on your next Charisma (Intimidation) check and increases your maximum hit points by 1d8 until the start of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Encouragement
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, as a bonus action, you can squeeze the plushie to unleash a small explosion that deals 1d6 fire damage in a 5-foot radius. Targets within this area must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take an additional 1d6 fire damage.

bobomb_buddy_plushie.levelRequirementReason: This plushie is designed to provide immediate morale support, making it accessible at the earliest levels.
bobomb_buddy_plushie.vendorReason: Toad Town Market often stocks items that can brighten spirits and boost morale among adventurers.
bobomb_buddy_plushie.shippingDetail: Shipped with extra padding to ensure the plushie arrives in top condition, even if it has already been activated.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Morale Boost; 1 minute for Explosive Encouragement (recharges after a long rest)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use the plushie again, and it recharges at the start of your next long rest.

bobomb_buddy_plushie.priceReason: This plushie combines utility and danger, providing both immediate morale support and occasional fire damage, making it a balanced addition to any adventurer's inventory.

bone_chime_wind_catcher.name: Bone Chime Wind Catcher
bone_chime_wind_catcher.description: The Bone Chime Wind Catcher is a delicate mobile crafted from the bleached bones of ancient warriors, each one etched with runes that whisper cryptic messages when the wind blows. The chimes are said to be tuned to the voices of the dead, and their melodies are as cold as the grave itself. Once per day, you can ask a yes/no question, and the chimes will respond in a haunting whisper that echoes the final words of those who have passed.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Whisper
effectDetails.rules: When wind blows, you hear one cryptic phrase from a dead person. This effect is passive and occurs whenever the wind stirs nearby.

effectDetails.title: Deadly Question
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can ask a yes/no question. The chimes will respond with a whisper that may or may not be truthful; it is up to the DM's discretion as to whether the answer reflects reality or the dead's twisted perceptions.

bone_chime_wind_catcher.levelRequirementReason: This item requires only basic dexterity and an open mind, suitable for any adventurer starting their journey.
bone_chime_wind_catcher.vendorReason: The Temple Eternal preserves the spirits of the past, and this mobile is said to offer a connection with the dead.
bone_chime_wind_catcher.shippingDetail: Delivered by Woven String, known for their precision in delivering delicate artifacts.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires no action. The yes/no question can be asked once per day as a free action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The daily use is exhausted or the item breaks from excessive wind damage.
usage.charges: 1 charge, recharges after 7 days of calm weather

bone_chime_wind_catcher.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item offers a unique and powerful connection to the past without overwhelming the player.

boo_bell.name: Boo's Bell
boo_bell.description: Boo's Bell is a spectral bell crafted from ethereal metal, its surface covered in faintly glowing runes. When rung, it emits a resonant tone that pierces through invisibility and reveals hidden foes within a 30-foot radius, leaving them exposed for the duration of the spell. Ghosts and spirits caught in its sound must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be overcome by fear.

effectDetails.title: Expose Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: Boo's Bell allows the user to reveal all invisible creatures within a 30-foot radius for 1 minute. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Frighten Spirits
effectDetails.rules: Any ghost or spirit within range that fails its Charisma saving throw becomes frightened of the user for 1 minute, during which time it cannot move closer to the user.

boo_bell.levelRequirementReason: The bell's power is accessible early in a character's journey to ensure players can use it effectively against ghostly threats.
boo_bell.vendorReason: Shamans of the region are familiar with spectral phenomena and often rely on such tools for their work.
boo_bell.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted courier, ensuring safe arrival without risk to the item or its wielder.

usage.duration: 1 minute (instantaneous)
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when Boo's Bell is silenced or destroyed

boo_bell.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the bell's utility and rarity without overprizing its effect.

boo_in_a_jar.name: Boo in a Jar
boo_in_a_jar.description: A small glass jar that holds a spectral figure of a Boo. The jar's lid is tightly sealed, and the Boo within can be heard whispering secrets when the container is opened. It whispers only truths during daylight but may deceive at night, always keeping watch and occasionally sharing embarrassing revelations.

effectDetails.title: Truthful Whispering (Daytime)
effectDetails.rules: The Boo in the jar can answer one question per day. It always tells the truth during daylight, providing accurate and helpful information.

effectDetails.title: Deceptive Lies (Nighttime)
effectDetails.rules: At nightfall, the Boo may lie when answering questions, with a 50% chance of telling the truth and a 50% chance of mischievously lying. The jar must be open for these whispers to occur.

boo_in_a_jar.levelRequirementReason: This simple curio is accessible to any adventurer, allowing even novices to interact with its spectral occupant.
boo_in_a_jar.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand specializes in unique and enigmatic artifacts that captivate the curious mind.
boo_in_a_jar.shippingDetail: Ships securely within a protective wooden crate to ensure safe delivery of this fragile item.

usage.activation: Passive effect when jar is open during daylight or nighttime.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until the next sunrise or sunset.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the jar breaks, the lid is sealed shut again, or if the Boo escapes by vanishing.

boo_in_a_jar.priceReason: The Boo in a Jar offers an enchanting but limited form of interaction with spectral beings, making it a moderately priced item for curious adventurers.

boo_portrait.name: Haunted Boo Portrait
boo_portrait.description: A ghoulish Boo Portrait that follows you with its unsettling eyes. The painting's frame seems to pulse with a faint, eerie glow, and when you turn your back on it, the Boo's eyes blink as if mocking your silence. It whispers secrets of the night only under the light of the moon, providing cryptic insights.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Secrets
effectDetails.rules: Once per day at dusk and dawn, the Boo Portrait reveals a cryptic secret to you. This effect is active only when exposed to moonlight, and it provides information that can be used immediately.

effectDetails.title: Invisible Sentinel
effectDetails.rules: The portrait emits an aura that warns of invisible creatures within 30 feet. You are always aware of such threats as long as the painting is in your line of sight.

boo_portrait.levelRequirementReason: This Boo Portrait provides useful but not overwhelming benefits to a beginning adventurer.
boo_portrait.vendorReason: The Black Market Vendor deals in rare and unusual items, making this haunting portrait an ideal addition to their collection.
boo_portrait.shippingDetail: Delivered rolled up inside a sturdy canvas wrapping with protective padding. The Boo Portrait must be hung upon arrival for it to function properly.

usage.activation: Passive and active once per day (moonlit secrets)
usage.duration: Instantaneous (for each effect)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use, recharges the next dawn

boo_portrait.priceReason: The Boo Portrait offers a unique and valuable set of passive benefits that are not easily replicated by other items.

boo_sheet.name: Boo Sheet
boo_sheet.description: A ghostly white sheet with strategically cut eye holes, this Boo Sheet is sewn from fabric that whispers secrets of the afterlife. It grants +2 to Stealth checks within haunted locales and has a peculiar effect: when donned, spectral beings might become momentarily confused, granting you advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks against them.

effectDetails.title: +2 Stealth in Haunted Areas
effectDetails.rules: When wearing the Boo Sheet, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks within haunted areas. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after entering an area not considered haunted.

effectDetails.title: Confuse Spectral Beings
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Boo Sheet, spectral beings become momentarily confused upon seeing you, granting you advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made against them. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the Boo Sheet is removed.

boo_sheet.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no special level as it provides a versatile and balanced benefit.
boo_sheet.vendorReason: Shamans often encounter spectral entities, making this sheet a practical tool for their craft.
boo_sheet.shippingDetail: The Laundry Bag ensures the Boo Sheet arrives crisp and ready to use, delivered with no delay.

usage.activation: Wearing the Boo Sheet passively activates its effects.
usage.duration: Lasts until the start of your next turn after entering a non-haunted area or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop wearing the Boo Sheet in a haunted location or when entering an area not considered haunted.
usage.charges: Unlimited; no charges, recharges, or rest required.

boo_sheet.priceReason: This price reflects its common rarity and practical utility within haunted locales without being overpowered.

book_of_dead_languages.name: Book of Dead Languages
book_of_dead_languages.description: The Book of Dead Languages is a leather-bound tome with faded ink and strange symbols. It whispers in ancient tongues that no one has spoken for centuries, yet it perfectly captures the essence of lost languages. Each page seems to breathe life into forgotten words, though upon mastering one, another long-lost language slips from your memory.

effectDetails.title: Language Mastery
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can spend 1 hour reading the book. At the end of this time, you gain proficiency in a dead language known to your race or background. This effect has no save DC and does not require concentration.

effectDetails.title: Forgetting
effectDetails.rules: At the same time as gaining a new language's mastery, you lose the ability to speak one other language that you previously knew. This change is permanent and cannot be reversed by any means.

book_of_dead_languages.levelRequirementReason: This book requires only basic literacy skills to use.
book_of_dead_languages.vendorReason: The Scholar Society has a rich collection of ancient knowledge, including this mysterious tome.
book_of_dead_languages.shippingDetail: Ships with special leather bindings and protective cases, ensuring the book remains intact during transit.

usage.activation: 1 hour of reading as an action
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; permanent language mastery and loss of one previously known language
usage.endsWhen: The time spent reading elapses or you interrupt the process

book_of_dead_languages.priceReason: This book is rare but not overly powerful, making it a fair trade at this price.

book_of_moths.name: Book of Moths
book_of_moths.description: The Book of Moths is a leather-bound tome where each page unfolds to reveal fluttering moths. When read, it grants fleeting knowledge of hidden lore, but at a heavy cost; one moth dies with each page turned, and the reader loses a cherished memory. At night, the remaining moths whisper ancient secrets that only you can hear.

effectDetails.title: Moth Whisper
effectDetails.rules: Read any page of the book as a bonus action. The remaining moths within whisper an ancient secret to you that you can recall once per day until used. This effect is instantaneous and does not require concentration.

effectDetails.title: Memory Loss
effectDetails.rules: Turn one page of the book for every 24 hours spent reading it. When a moth dies, the reader loses one memory known to them at the start of each day. The lost memory cannot be regained by any means until the book is closed.

book_of_moths.levelRequirementReason: The knowledge gained from reading the Book of Moths can be overwhelming and requires a basic understanding of lore.
book_of_moths.vendorReason: The Bazaar of Oddities is known for its collection of rare and unusual items, making it fitting to sell such an enigmatic artifact.
book_of_moths.shippingDetail: Ships via Silk Cover; delivery takes three days due to the delicate nature of the moths within.

usage.activation: Bonus action to read a page and hear a secret.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each page turned.
usage.endsWhen: The book is closed or all moths die.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but memory loss occurs with each page.

book_of_moths.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers unique knowledge and a memory sacrifice, making it accessible yet valuable.

book_of_unwritten_names.name: Book of Unwritten Names
book_of_unwritten_names.description: The Book of Unwritten Names is a leather-bound tome with worn edges and an eerie glow. It inscribes names of those who will perish tomorrow, their fates sealed by its pages. Whispering secrets at night, it foretells the inevitable, though one can erase a name to save another's life.

effectDetails.title: Erase Fated Deaths
effectDetails.rules: By spending an hour in quiet meditation, the user can erase one name from the book. A new name then appears at dawn. This effect requires a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) to ensure the erased death is not just postponed.

effectDetails.title: Nightly Fates
effectDetails.rules: Each dawn, 1d4 names appear in the book—those who will die before sunset that day. The book's whispers at night provide a +2 bonus on Insight checks to interpret these fates accurately.

book_of_unwritten_names.levelRequirementReason: The Book requires minimal arcane knowledge for its basic use.
book_of_unwritten_names.vendorReason: Crypt Courier deals with forbidden and ancient artifacts, making the Book a fitting addition to their inventory.
book_of_unwritten_names.shippingDetail: Ships via a heavily guarded carrier who ensures the book's safe arrival without detection by authorities.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires meditation for erasing names
usage.duration: Instantaneous when a name is erased
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day

book_of_unwritten_names.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its utility without being overpowered.

boomerang_flower.name: Boomerang Flower
boomerang_flower.description: The Boomerang Flower is a delicate bloom with roots forged in the ancient forge of Forgeside. Its petals shimmer and glow with an inner flame, capable of returning to its owner with deadly precision. This flower can be thrown as a weapon, striking foes up to 60 feet away before returning to your hand. Multiple targets may be hit on return if they are within range.

effectDetails.title: Returning Boomerang
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the Boomerang Flower returns to its owner as an action. It deals 1d8 slashing damage on a hit. On return, it can be thrown again without using any additional actions.

effectDetails.title: Multiple Target Strike
effectDetails.rules: If multiple targets are within range and struck by the returning Boomerang Flower, they each make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14). On failure, the target takes an additional 2d6 slashing damage from the returning flower.

boomerang_flower.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and adventurers just starting their journey.
boomerang_flower.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in unique, rare items that empower the novice adventurer.
boomerang_flower.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week of order placement with no additional handling fees.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: On return or discarded

boomerang_flower.priceReason: The Boomerang Flower's rarity and unique properties justify its moderate price.

bootleg_bowser_castle_key.name: Bootleg Bowser Castle Key
bootleg_bowser_castle_key.description: The Bootleg Bowser Castle Key is a tarnished brass key engraved with a mischievous Koopa face. It's said to have been crafted by Castle Copies and bears the scent of overpriced knockoffs. This key can open any red door in Bowser’s Castle, but it bends under pressure, causing a 20% chance for the lock to fail each time you use it.

effectDetails.title: Red Door Opener
