broque_monsieur_collection.name: Block Collection
broque_monsieur_collection.description: Block Collection is a set of sentient blocks that can transform into structures on command. Crafted by the enigmatic Block, these blocks are known for their precision and creativity, forming walls, bridges, or even ornate fortresses with ease. They speak French and offer witty remarks about your fashion sense.

effectDetails.title: Precision Construction
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command the blocks to construct a 20-foot cube of stone. This structure is immovable and provides shelter. The blocks work tirelessly until it is complete. If the area is already occupied or impossible to build in, this effect fails.

effectDetails.title: Fashion Critique
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can request a critique on your current attire from the blocks. They deliver a humorous and often accurate assessment of your fashion sense with no save required. This effect is limited to once per day.

broque_monsieur_collection.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate the elegance and utility of these blocks without needing high-level proficiency.
broque_monsieur_collection.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in unique curiosities, making it an ideal place for the Block Collection to be sold.
broque_monsieur_collection.shippingDetail: Blocks are carefully shipped by Block himself, ensuring each set arrives perfectly intact and ready for use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The structure collapses if the area is destroyed or a new command is given.

broque_monsieur_collection.priceReason: This price reflects the unique and useful nature of the blocks, balancing their utility with the cost of crafting such an item.

brown_paint_of_earthly_camouflage.name: Brown Paint of Earthly Camouflage
brown_paint_of_earthly_camouflage.description: This weathered brown paint blends seamlessly into rocky outcrops and dusty earth. Applied by Earth Elemental Paint Co., it grants you a natural advantage in Stealth checks while outdoors, but also makes you more vulnerable to psychic attacks. Beware, children might mistake you for a new garden project.

effectDetails.title: Blend with Dirt
effectDetails.rules: When applied to your person or clothing, this paint grants you advantage on Stealth checks in natural terrain. The effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Grounded Down
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 hour after applying this paint, you are more susceptible to psychic damage from spells and effects; you take an additional 1d6 psychic damage on a failed saving throw against such attacks. This effect ends when the rest period is over.

brown_paint_of_earthly_camouflage.levelRequirementReason: This paint is intended for adventurers of any level who might need to blend into their environment.
brown_paint_of_earthly_camouflage.vendorReason: Dwarven realms are known for their practical and durable paints, making this product a staple in their inventory.
brown_paint_of_earthly_camouflage.shippingDetail: Ships via Mud Pack's reliable earthworm couriers, ensuring the paint remains intact through rough terrain.

usage.activation: Apply as an action. Lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you complete a short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a short or long rest.

brown_paint_of_earthly_camouflage.priceReason: The paint's unique properties and the reputable vendor justify its balanced price in XP.

build_traps_that_lead_to.name: Wario's Bottomless Pitfall Trap Kit (Scam Trap!)
build_traps_that_lead_to.description: Craft a trap that creates an illusion of a bottomless pit, fooling even the most cautious. This trap's deceitful design is a hallmark of Wario’s expertise, leaving adventurers to ponder if they've fallen into a deadly abyss or merely an elaborate joke.

effectDetails.title: False Bottomless Pit
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the trap appears as a deep pit, requiring a DC 14 Perception check to notice its shallowness. Characters who fall into it suffer no damage and are ejected after 3 rounds. The pit is only 5 feet deep.

effectDetails.title: Scam Mechanism
effectDetails.rules: The trap can be set up once per day, but the mechanism is easily tampered with. Any attempt to use this item without Wario's Trap Emporium’s knowledge risks it being rendered inert for 24 hours.

build_traps_that_lead_to.levelRequirementReason: Crafting traps requires basic understanding of engineering and construction.
build_traps_that_lead_to.vendorReason: Wario's Trap Emporium specializes in whimsical and practical pranks, including this cleverly devious pitfall kit.
build_traps_that_lead_to.shippingDetail: Ships via Pitfall Parcel; delivery is immediate within the Kingdom of Mushroom.

usage.duration: Instantaneous setup, lasts until tampered with or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Tampered with or destroyed by an intelligent creature

build_traps_that_lead_to.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item for its clever design and practicality in traps.

bulk_up_like_wario_side.name: Wario's WAAAAH! Fitness Shake Mix
bulk_up_like_wario_side.description: Wario's WAAAAH! Fitness Shake Mix is a peculiar concoction that tastes as foul as it smells. This garlic-laden mix, when mixed with water and consumed, grants +2 to Strength checks for one hour but forces you to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw every 10 minutes or suffer an aggressive flatulence burst that poisons creatures within 10 feet for 1 round. The shake's unique flavor can repel vampires, giving them advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against you.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Grants +2 to Strength checks for one hour. Must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw every 10 minutes or suffer the effects of the Poisonous Flatulence.

effectDetails.title: Poisonous Flatulence
effectDetails.rules: If you fail your Constitution save, you emit a cloud of foul-smelling gas within 10 feet that poisons all creatures in the area for 1 round (DC 15 saving throw). Vampires have advantage on Charisma checks to repel this effect.

bulk_up_like_wario_side.levelRequirementReason: Beginners need a boost, but even the weakest can't afford the side effects.
bulk_up_like_wario_side.vendorReason: Wario Land Fitness is known for pushing limits and encouraging unconventional methods to stay in shape.
bulk_up_like_wario_side.shippingDetail: Delivered with a complimentary 'leaky' shaker cup, no returns accepted after consumption.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon expiration of the duration or if you fail a Constitution saving throw.

bulk_up_like_wario_side.priceReason: Balanced price for an item that offers both significant and potentially dangerous effects.

bullet_bill_helmet.name: Bullet Bill Helmet
bullet_bill_helmet.description: The Bullet Bill Helmet is a sleek rocket-shaped headgear that propels you forward with explosive force. Upon activation, it launches you in a straight line at blinding speed, leaving behind a fiery trail of smoke. Enemies caught in its path are flung aside by the shockwave, but the impact can be punishing for both friend and foe.

effectDetails.title: Rocket Dash
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate your Bullet Bill Helmet to dash in a straight line up to 60 feet. Any creature in the path of this movement must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 1d8 bludgeoning damage.

effectDetails.title: Shockwave
effectDetails.rules: You take 1d6 bludgeoning damage upon activation, but you can use it once per short rest. If you fail your save against the shockwave effect on a creature, they are knocked prone and take an additional 1d6 force damage.

bullet_bill_helmet.levelRequirementReason: Requires sufficient agility to handle its rapid movement.
bullet_bill_helmet.vendorReason: The valley's traders often encounter travelers seeking unique and powerful gear for their quests.
bullet_bill_helmet.shippingDetail: Ships via Thundercloud Express, ensuring arrival with a dramatic sonic boom.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends on the creature's next turn if it fails its saving throw.

bullet_bill_helmet.priceReason: Balanced at a price that reflects its limited uses and moderate power.

bullet_bill_launcher.name: Bullet Bill Blaster
bullet_bill_launcher.description: The Bullet Bill Blaster is a compact cannon with a sleek, metallic barrel that hums with energy when primed. Crafted from enchanted iron, this relic fires explosive Bullet Bills capable of leveling small structures in their path. Its origins lie in the Forges of Fortuna, where it was once used to defend against invasions by hostile forces.

effectDetails.title: Line of Fire
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can fire the Bullet Bill Blaster. This creates a line of explosive energy that deals 4d6 Fire damage to all creatures in the line (60-foot range). Creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw or take an additional 2d6 Fire damage on a failed save.

effectDetails.title: Overheating
effectDetails.rules: The Bullet Bill Blaster overheat after three uses. If it overheats, you and any creature within 10 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 15) or take 1d4 Fire damage.

bullet_bill_launcher.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in ranged weapons to effectively manage the recoil and precision needed.
bullet_bill_launcher.vendorReason: The valley's trading post often receives rare items from distant forges, making it a likely place for this weapon to appear.
bullet_bill_launcher.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Armored Wagon, which ensures safe and swift transport of the cannon through treacherous terrains.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Overheats or runs out of charges

bullet_bill_launcher.priceReason: Balanced to ensure the cannon is a rare but not overpowered addition to any party.

bullet_bill_mask.name: Bullet Bill Mask
bullet_bill_mask.description: The Bullet Bill Mask transforms you into a living, explosive bullet, capable of dashing in a line and detonating with fiery force. Crafted from the remnants of fallen Bullet Bills, this mask is both powerful and dangerous, best suited for those who can control their own charge.

effectDetails.title: Living Charge
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you dash up to 60 feet in a straight line. All creatures within the path must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 2d8 piercing damage.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Impact
effectDetails.rules: On impact with a creature, the mask detonates, causing 3d6 fire damage to you and all creatures within 5 feet. You are immune to this damage but can still be knocked prone as per Living Charge.

bullet_bill_mask.levelRequirementReason: This mask is designed for beginners who need the challenge of mastering their charge while learning to control explosive situations.
bullet_bill_mask.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post specializes in unique and rare items that can be found across various regions, including this one.
bullet_bill_mask.shippingDetail: Ships within 24 hours of purchase with a guaranteed delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until impact or end of turn)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are knocked prone, the target is hit by another attack, or at the start of your next turn.

bullet_bill_mask.priceReason: This mask offers a balanced challenge for lower-level characters while providing a unique and powerful combat tool.

bumper_badge.name: Bumper Badge
bumper_badge.description: The Bumper Badge is a small, polished brass pin that glimmers with each impact. When struck by an enemy's melee attack, it causes them to stumble backward three full steps and lose their next action. Crafted in the bustling market of Ironforge, this badge is more than just a symbol—it repels attacks like a seasoned guard dog.

effectDetails.title: Melee Repulse
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy successfully hits the wearer with a melee attack, they are pushed back 3 feet and lose their next action. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Stance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Bumper Badge, you gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws against being knocked prone by environmental hazards and magical effects.

bumper_badge.levelRequirementReason: The Bumper Badge's defensive properties are accessible to low-level characters who need a reliable way to repel immediate threats.
bumper_badge.vendorReason: Valley Trading Post caters to adventurers seeking practical and sturdy gear, making the Bumper Badge an ideal addition to their inventory.
bumper_badge.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via Standard Courier from Ironforge.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect triggered by a melee hit.
usage.duration: Once per short or long rest, lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use another action to repel an attack.

bumper_badge.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the Bumper Badge offers a reasonable defense for its price point, suitable for beginning adventurers.

burnt_pan.name: Burnt Frying Pan
burnt_pan.description: This burnt frying pan is a relic of Wario's ill-fated attempt at culinary arts. The handle has melted into the metal, and its surface is scored with blackened streaks from failed cooking experiments. Despite its ruined state, it still retains a faint smoky scent that clings to your hand as you grip it.

effectDetails.title: Bludgeoning Weapon
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with the burnt frying pan, it deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage. If your target is reduced to half its hit points or fewer by this attack, the pan releases a cloud of acrid smoke in a 5-foot radius centered on the target. This smoke imposes disadvantage on all ranged attacks made against any creature within the area until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Smoke Aura
effectDetails.rules: The burnt frying pan emits an unpleasant, smoky aura that lasts for 1 hour or until you sheathe it in water. Any creature within 5 feet of you who can see the pan must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated by the smell for 1 minute.

burnt_pan.levelRequirementReason: Basic mechanics and no significant power make this accessible to low-level characters.
burnt_pan.vendorReason: Toad Town Market often stocks quirky, locally-made items that can be useful in unexpected ways during adventures.
burnt_pan.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week of purchase with standard handling.

usage.activation: On your action or as a bonus action
usage.duration: Instantaneous and until used, but the smoke aura lasts for 1 hour or until sheathed in water.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you discard the pan, it breaks, or it is submerged in water.

burnt_pan.priceReason: The item has balanced mechanics that ensure it does not overshadow more powerful options but still provides a unique and thematic addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

buzzy_beetle_shell.name: Buzzy Beetle Shell
buzzy_beetle_shell.description: The Buzzy Beetle Shell is a hardened exoskeleton that protects its bearer from fire and physical harm. Crafted from the fused remains of a rare, fire-resistant beetle species, this shell grants protection and offers the resilience to survive in fiery environments. The shell's weight reduces movement speed by 5 feet but provides a +2 bonus to AC and resistance to fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to fire damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Shield: +2 AC
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the Buzzy Beetle Shell provides a +2 bonus to AC. This benefit is active while the item is equipped and does not require an action or reaction.

buzzy_beetle_shell.levelRequirementReason: The Buzzy Beetle Shell's inherent resilience makes it accessible to lower-level characters who need basic protection from fire hazards.
buzzy_beetle_shell.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post specializes in goods that are useful for adventurers facing environmental challenges, making the Buzzy Beetle Shell a fitting addition to their inventory.
buzzy_beetle_shell.shippingDetail: Ships via Swift Courier; expedited delivery within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn and can be re-applied.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the item does not have charges.

buzzy_beetle_shell.priceReason: The Buzzy Beetle Shell is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique properties and utility in combating fire hazards without being overpowered for a lower-level character.

cackleberry.name: Cackleberry
cackleberry.description: The Cackleberry is a small, giggling egg that brings both laughter and stealth to those who consume it. Crafted from enchanted wood and imbued with trickster magic by the mischievous sprite community, this treat enhances one’s ability to hide while also increasing the likelihood of being overheard. Perfect for adventurers seeking to outsmart their foes or simply enjoy a whimsical snack.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Cackleberry grants advantage on Stealth checks for 10 minutes. If you are already proficient in Stealth, this effect increases your chance of success by +4 to the roll.

effectDetails.title: Giggly Reveal
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that consuming the Cackleberry will cause you to laugh uncontrollably for 1 minute. During this time, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and any attack rolls made against you are at advantage.

cackleberry.levelRequirementReason: The Cackleberry’s effects are minor enough that even low-level adventurers can benefit from its stealthy properties without requiring a significant challenge.
cackleberry.vendorReason: Twinestitch, the owner of Twine Shop, is well-known for her love of all things quirky and magical. It only makes sense that she stocks such an odd yet useful treat.
cackleberry.shippingDetail: The Cackleberry is shipped in a special wicker basket to ensure it reaches its destination fresh and ready to eat.

usage.duration: 10 minutes for Stealth Boost, 1 minute for Giggly Reveal
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends naturally or if consumed by an enemy creature

cackleberry.priceReason: The Cackleberry’s price is adjusted to reflect its unique magical properties and the special care required in its preparation.

cage_of_the_unborn.name: Cage of the Unborn
cage_of_the_unborn.description: The Cage of the Unborn is a tiny metal cage that holds the soul of an unborn child. Crafted from ancient, cursed iron and bound with eldritch sigils, it whispers dark secrets to those who dare open it. The soul within can be released, but at a terrible cost—it becomes your child, yet ages ten times faster than normal, growing to adulthood in mere months.

effectDetails.title: Release the Soul
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can release the soul from the cage. The released soul becomes your child, but it ages ten times faster than normal. It gains one level at dawn and dusk each day until it reaches its maximum age for its race.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Child
effectDetails.rules: The shadow child is born as a shadow creature with the same abilities and hit points as an adult of their race, but they cannot be healed by normal means. They are immune to disease, poison, and most forms of damage.

cage_of_the_unborn.levelRequirementReason: Even the weakest wizard can summon the power needed to release a soul from this cursed artifact.
cage_of_the_unborn.vendorReason: The crypt courier deals in forbidden knowledge and dark artifacts, making them the perfect vendor for such an item.
cage_of_the_unborn.shippingDetail: Delivered by Silver Crib with a delay of one week due to the cursed nature of the artifact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The soul is released and becomes your child.

cage_of_the_unborn.priceReason: While the item's power is limited, its forbidden nature and cursed components justify a modest price.

cake_mix.name: Cake Mix
cake_mix.description: This is a mix of ingredients for creating a classic cake, ready to be baked in any oven. The smell of fresh batter brings joy and sweet anticipation to any kitchen. Created by Zess T., it's essential not just for baking but also for satisfying your sweet tooth when eaten raw.

effectDetails.title: Restore Health
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this Cake Mix restores 1 Hit Point to you. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sweeten the Mood
effectDetails.rules: Eating a serving of Cake Mix grants advantage on saving throws against being frightened for 10 minutes. You must consume it within one hour of purchase.

cake_mix.levelRequirementReason: The Cake Mix is simple and safe, suitable for all levels.
cake_mix.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its wide variety of food items and this mix fits well with their offerings.
cake_mix.shippingDetail: Delivered in a paper bag to ensure freshness. Delivery time varies based on the region but typically takes no more than three days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for health restoration; 10 minutes of advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
usage.endsWhen: Once consumed, effects end immediately.

cake_mix.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect the item's utility in both practical and mood-boosting aspects.

camera_poltergust.name: Vintage Camera
camera_poltergust.description: This Vintage Camera is a sepia-toned relic with a lens that glows faintly in the dark. It captures memories, but its flash can temporarily blind those caught within its light. The camera's shutter click feels like it could capture more than just an image—it holds the essence of fleeting moments.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Flash
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the camera's flash. Any creature within 5 feet must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 14) or be blinded until the start of your next turn. This effect has no limit per day.

effectDetails.title: Capture Memories
effectDetails.rules: When you capture an image with the camera, it records a memory of the scene. You can use this memory to provide insight into events that occurred during the session. The memory lasts until used or destroyed. This effect is unlimited per day.

camera_poltergust.levelRequirementReason: This Vintage Camera requires no level, but it demands a keen eye for detail and timing.
camera_poltergust.vendorReason: The Rogue Port's Black Market is known for its eclectic array of unusual items, including this mysterious relic.
camera_poltergust.shippingDetail: Due to the camera’s delicate nature, it must be shipped in a specially designed box with padding and insulation.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (blinding effect lasts until start of next turn)
usage.endsWhen: The blinding flash ends when its effect is over or if the camera's memory function is used.

camera_poltergust.priceReason: This price reflects the item’s uncommon rarity and unique abilities, offering a balance between power and cost.

candle_of_the_first_fire.name: Candle of the First Fire
candle_of_the_first_fire.description: The Candle of the First Fire is a relic of ancient times, its wick made from the first flame ever lit. Its light is cold and pure, searing the surface of objects but leaving flesh untouched. It can also reveal the magical essence within enchanted items, unlocking their secrets for those who seek them.

effectDetails.title: Cold Flame
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this candle projects a 30-foot radius of cold flame that deals 1d6 fire damage to all objects in the area. This effect has no effect on creatures or constructs.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Enchantment
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can point the candle at an object within 30 feet and reveal its magical properties. The candle burns out after this use.

candle_of_the_first_fire.levelRequirementReason: This candle is accessible to any character, as it serves primarily as a tool for revealing hidden enchantments.
candle_of_the_first_fire.vendorReason: The Artificer Tower has long preserved and studied relics of the First Age, including this ancient candle.
candle_of_the_first_fire.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Ashen Holder with a promise to deliver within three days or refund in full.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Cold Flame, until revealed for Reveal Enchantment
usage.endsWhen: The candle burns out after a single use of either effect

candle_of_the_first_fire.priceReason: This price reflects the candle's rarity and unique utility in revealing enchantments without the risk of damaging magical items.

candle_of_the_last_breath.name: Candle of the Last Breath
candle_of_the_last_breath.description: The Candle of the Last Breath is a pitch-black candle that flickers with an eerie light. It burns for exactly one minute, during which it can resurrect a recently deceased creature within reach and grant them one truth before they return to dust, at the cost of your own lifespan.

effectDetails.title: Resurrection
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this candle burns for exactly 1 minute and allows you to resurrect a recently deceased creature within 1 hour. The creature returns with 1 hit point and full memories of their life before death. They must speak one truth about the most recent event they witnessed before dissolving into smoke.

effectDetails.title: Truthful Revelation
effectDetails.rules: The resurrected creature, upon returning to dust at the end of its one minute of existence, speaks a single truthful sentence about the most significant event it observed just prior to death. This truth is not subject to saving throws or other means of manipulation.

candle_of_the_last_breath.levelRequirementReason: The Candle requires no specific level as it operates on a higher plane of magic.
candle_of_the_last_breath.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand has access to rare and forbidden items, making the Candle of the Last Breath a suitable addition to their inventory.
candle_of_the_last_breath.shippingDetail: Ships via Ashen Box with expedited service, ensuring safe arrival within one week.

usage.duration: One minute, during which the candle burns and performs its effects
usage.endsWhen: The candle extinguishes after burning for exactly one minute or if the creature it resurrects is no longer alive when that duration ends

candle_of_the_last_breath.priceReason: Balanced to be a rare but not overpowered item, reflecting its forbidden nature and mystical properties.

cannon_box.name: Cannon Box
cannon_box.description: The Cannon Box is a brass contraption worn at your waist. When activated, it fires a cannonball with explosive force, sending projectiles flying in all directions around you. The box's weight and recoil reduce your movement speed by 10 feet while active.

effectDetails.title: Wearable Artillery
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the Cannon Box to fire one cannonball. The cannonball deals 2d10 bludgeoning damage and explodes in a 30-foot radius centered on your location, dealing an additional 1d6 thunder damage to all creatures within that area who fail a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Mobility
effectDetails.rules: While the Cannon Box is active, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and your speed is reduced by 10 feet. The Cannon Box requires no attunement but must be worn at your waist. It recharges after a short rest.

cannon_box.levelRequirementReason: This item provides an immediate combat advantage to low-level adventurers without being overly powerful.
cannon_box.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in quirky and unusual equipment, making the Cannon Box a perfect fit for their inventory.
cannon_box.shippingDetail: The Cannon Box is shipped via Heavy Crate Express, ensuring it arrives safely despite its unwieldy size.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; requires no attunement while worn at your waist.
usage.duration: One minute per short rest, recharging after each.
usage.endsWhen: The cannonball is fired or the effect ends as part of a short rest recharge.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges, recharged with each short rest.

cannon_box.priceReason: This item offers a unique and balanced combat advantage for low-level adventurers at this price point.

cape_feather.name: Cape Feather
cape_feather.description: The Cape Feather is a shimmering golden cape adorned with a single, radiant feather. It exudes nostalgia and freedom, reminiscent of ancient times when heroes soared through skies. The feather's scent lingers like a distant memory, evoking feelings of flight and adventure.

effectDetails.title: Brief Flight
effectDetails.rules: Use your action to activate the cape. You gain a flying speed of 40 feet for 1 minute, allowing you to soar gracefully through the air. The effect ends early if you fall or are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Spin Attack
effectDetails.rules: As an action while airborne, you can perform a spin attack targeting one creature within 5 feet of your position. You make a melee weapon attack against the target with advantage. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 slashing damage plus 1d4 force damage.

cape_feather.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners to experience the thrill of flight and combat.
cape_feather.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its eclectic mix of magical items, including the Cape Feather, which has become a popular choice among adventurers seeking unique abilities.
cape_feather.shippingDetail: The cape is carefully packed to prevent damage during transit, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends early if you fall or become incapacitated

cape_feather.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the Cape Feather provides a unique and memorable item without being overpowered.

cappy_replica.name: Spirit Cap
cappy_replica.description: The Spirit Cap is a hat imbued with the restless spirit of an ancient bonneter. Its brim glows faintly, hinting at the presence within. This artifact allows you to momentarily possess another creature, exerting your will over their body for a brief time.

effectDetails.title: Possession
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to throw the Spirit Cap at a creature within 30 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14). On a failed save, you control their body for 1 minute. During this time, your physical form vanishes into the hat and you gain control over the possessed creature's actions.

effectDetails.title: Dominated Target
effectDetails.rules: While possessing the target, they are dominated by you. They follow your commands to the best of their ability but can still attempt to resist with a successful Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) at the start of each of their turns.

cappy_replica.levelRequirementReason: Requires some experience in controlling and commanding others.
cappy_replica.vendorReason: Comet Observatory has a special interest in ancient artifacts and spirits.
cappy_replica.shippingDetail: Ships via Hat Box Express, known for their timely deliveries of delicate items.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you release the target
usage.endsWhen: You release control over the target or are incapacitated

cappy_replica.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price to reflect its limited duration and controlled effect.

captain_toad_backpack.name: Captain's Heavy Backpack
captain_toad_backpack.description: The Captain's Heavy Backpack is a compact vest that looks smaller than it seems. Despite its diminutive appearance, this enchanted pack can carry an infinite amount of gear without adding any weight. While it ensures you never need to jump or fly, it also reduces your speed by five feet per round, making every step feel like a deliberate march.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Carrying Capacity
effectDetails.rules: The backpack can hold an infinite amount of gear without adding any weight. This effect is always active.

effectDetails.title: Prevents Jumping and Flying
effectDetails.rules: You cannot jump or fly at all. This persists until the end of your next turn. There is no saving throw to negate this effect.

captain_toad_backpack.levelRequirementReason: This backpack is designed for adventurers who need to carry a lot but prefer not to expend energy on jumping.
captain_toad_backpack.vendorReason: Crane, the market vendor known for his wisdom and experience, stocks this item as it caters to those who value practicality over flash.
captain_toad_backpack.shippingDetail: The backpack is carefully packed by Crane himself, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition with no delays.

usage.activation: Passive effect; always active once worn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and persists until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn.

captain_toad_backpack.priceReason: The backpack's price is adjusted to reflect its practical utility rather than its rarity, ensuring it remains accessible for adventurers.

captain_toad_lamp.name: Captain Toad's Lamp
captain_toad_lamp.description: Captain Toad's Lamp is an antique brass lantern adorned with a red glass shade and a handle etched with whimsical toads. It not only illuminates its surroundings but also reveals hidden caches of treasure, making it indispensable for adventurers seeking wealth in dark tombs and dungeons. Once per day, the lamp can reveal a secret door, aiding groups in uncovering concealed passages.

effectDetails.title: Shine: Detect Hidden Items
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to emit light from the lamp, revealing hidden items within a 30-foot radius. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn. The lamp has no effect on creatures or objects not hidden.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Secret Door
effectDetails.rules: Activate once per day as an action to reveal a secret door in the immediate area, up to 30 feet away. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a save. The door reverts after 1 hour unless a creature uses an action to reinforce it.

captain_toad_lamp.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginning adventurers who need assistance in uncovering hidden treasures.
captain_toad_lamp.vendorReason: Toad Town Market stocks items that are useful for young adventurers, and this lamp has proven invaluable to many of them.
captain_toad_lamp.shippingDetail: Ships via Toad Courier Express; delivery is usually within a week, but may vary depending on market conditions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for the secret door effect. Lasts until your next turn for the hidden item detection.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use it again or at the start of your next turn.

captain_toad_lamp.priceReason: This price reflects its utility in treasure hunts and exploration, making it a reasonable investment for adventurers.

cardboard_box.name: Suspicious Box
cardboard_box.description: The Suspicious Box is a stout wooden crate with a padlock and an ominous red 'X' painted on its side. It exudes a faint, unsettling aura that makes nearby creatures uneasy. When you open it, a hidden compartment reveals a single, glowing item of your choosing.

effectDetails.title: Shake to Reveal
effectDetails.rules: As an action, shake the box. A hidden compartment opens, revealing a single item of your choice from any category (not exceeding gear worth up to 50 XP). The item is usable immediately.

effectDetails.title: Uneasy Aura
effectDetails.rules: All creatures within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. This effect ends early if the creature moves more than 5 feet away from you.

cardboard_box.levelRequirementReason: The box's eerie qualities and the effort required to shake it make a low-level character the most suitable user.
cardboard_box.vendorReason: The Rogueport Black Market deals in mysterious and potentially dangerous goods, making it an ideal vendor for this unsettling yet useful item.
cardboard_box.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Shadow Courier Service within a week. A special delivery fee of 10 XP is included to cover the courier's risks.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for each shake; ends when shaken or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Once shaken, its contents are revealed and it can no longer be used. The box breaks into pieces if subjected to damage.

cardboard_box.priceReason: The price reflects the item's eerie nature, the potential reward of a hidden treasure, and the risk involved in using it.

cartography_commission.name: Cartography Commission (Custom Map)
cartography_commission.description: Hire a master cartographer to commission an exquisite map of any area up to 50 square miles. This meticulously crafted parchment reveals hidden locations, ancient ley lines, and perilous hazard zones. The map glows faintly when danger approaches within 1 mile, alerting the bearer to potential threats.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Locations Revealed
effectDetails.rules: Upon completion of a Cartography Commission, the map uncovers hidden locations such as ancient ruins or secret tunnels. These features are marked with a symbol and a brief description on the map.

effectDetails.title: Glowing Danger Indicator
effectDetails.rules: The map emits a soft glow when danger is within 1 mile of its location, alerting the bearer to potential threats such as hostile creatures or traps. The glow persists until the danger moves more than 1 mile away.

cartography_commission.levelRequirementReason: Commissioning this service requires basic adventuring skills and knowledge.
cartography_commission.vendorReason: The Scholar Society specializes in such scholarly endeavors, offering expertise from the finest cartographers.
cartography_commission.shippingDetail: Delivered within 3 days of payment. Expedited delivery available for an additional fee.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or lost.

cartography_commission.priceReason: Balanced price for a service that guarantees detailed and magically accurate information.

castle_deed.name: Deed to Abandoned Fortress
castle_deed.description: The Deed to Abandoned Fortress is a tattered parchment with an ancient seal. It grants ownership of a sprawling, decrepit fortress in the Dark Land, requiring renovation and restoration efforts to bring it back into use. This deed allows you to garrison up to 100 troops within the fortress walls and provides lair actions when inside. The fortress also generates income through taxes levied upon its tenants.

effectDetails.title: Stronghold
effectDetails.rules: Allows the owner to garrison up to 100 troops within the fortress. The owner can use lair actions when inside, but must be present in or adjacent to the fortress to do so.

effectDetails.title: Income Generation
effectDetails.rules: The fortress generates income through taxes levied upon its tenants. This effect is passive and requires the owner to maintain a presence within 1 mile of the fortress for it to function. Income generation ends if the owner leaves the area or the fortress falls into disrepair.

castle_deed.levelRequirementReason: This deed is complex, requiring significant management and resources that are only accessible to those of at least 10th level.
castle_deed.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in property and land deals, making them the ideal vendor for such a unique item as this deed.
castle_deed.shippingDetail: The deed is delivered by a Courier Pigeon, ensuring swift delivery to the owner's doorstep. However, the pigeon may take longer if the Dark Land is under shadowed influence.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon acquisition; requires maintenance and presence within 1 mile of the fortress for income generation.
usage.duration: Permanent with maintenance
usage.endsWhen: Owner leaves the area or the fortress falls into disrepair

castle_deed.priceReason: The price is set at 1,000 XP to reflect the significant resources and management required to maintain a stronghold in the Dark Land.

celestial_compass.name: Celestial Compass (Navigation)
celestial_compass.description: The Celestial Compass emits a soft, divine glow that points true north and reveals nearby holy sites. Crafted by Angelic Scouts from celestial materials, it is said to align with the very threads of the heavens themselves.

effectDetails.title: Aligns to True North
effectDetails.rules: The user must hold the compass in their hand. It immediately points directly north, true to the celestial plane. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Detects Nearest Holy Site
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can activate the compass to detect the nearest holy site within 1 mile. The compass emits a soft light indicating direction. Once used, it requires a short rest to be used again.

celestial_compass.levelRequirementReason: The Celestial Compass is simple enough for even novice adventurers to use effectively.
celestial_compass.vendorReason: Divine Outpost, known for its connections with celestial beings, naturally stocks items that align with the divine.
celestial_compass.shippingDetail: Ships via Holy Light Courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery of this sacred artifact.

usage.activation: Bonus action or holding in hand for alignment
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Compass is destroyed or the user rests
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest after each use

celestial_compass.priceReason: The Celestial Compass, though not overly powerful, provides significant utility for adventurers of all levels and is thus priced affordably.

celestial_harvester_drone.name: Celestial Harvester Drone (Automated)
celestial_harvester_drone.description: The Celestial Harvester Drone (Automated) is a swarm of nano-drones crafted from starlight and celestial materials. Deployed in orbit, it harnesses stellar energy through a process of quantum resonance, returning to its point of origin via the fabric of space itself. Each drone can collect up to 1000 energy units per solar cycle.

effectDetails.title: Stellar Energy Harvest
effectDetails.rules: The drone collects 1000 energy units per solar cycle. This effect is passive and does not require any action from the user.

effectDetails.title: Hyperspace Delivery
effectDetails.rules: Upon command, the drones return to their point of origin via hyperspace. This effect can be activated as a bonus action, with an instantaneous duration. The drone must have at least 500 energy units before it can activate this ability.

celestial_harvester_drone.levelRequirementReason: The Celestial Harvester Drone is accessible to all levels of adventurers who require stellar power.
celestial_harvester_drone.vendorReason: Starforge Outpost specializes in exotic and rare celestial items, making the Celestial Harvester Drone a natural addition to their inventory.
celestial_harvester_drone.shippingDetail: Ships within one solar cycle, with drones arriving fully charged.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charges are depleted or the drone is destroyed

celestial_harvester_drone.priceReason: The Celestial Harvester Drone provides a valuable, passive source of energy without requiring any active effort from the user.

celestial_sunforge_blueprints.name: Celestial Sunforge Blueprints
celestial_sunforge_blueprints.description: Celestial Sunforge Blueprints are divine schematics crafted by celestial archons in the heart of a sunforge. These blueprints detail the construction of artifacts imbued with the purest sunlight, capable of channeling solar energy into weapons and armor that burn like living flames.

effectDetails.title: Craft Solar Radiance Armor
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. The user must spend 20,000 gp in celestial materials to craft the armor. The armor grants a +1 bonus to AC and deals radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus on a successful unarmed strike against a creature within 5 feet. This effect lasts until expended.

effectDetails.title: Forged from Celestial Light
effectDetails.rules: The blueprints require a level 15 caster or higher to use. Once per short rest, the user may activate this ability to imbue their next weapon attack with solar energy, dealing an additional 2d6 radiant damage.

celestial_sunforge_blueprints.levelRequirementReason: The blueprints require a high-level caster to properly utilize and understand the intricate celestial magic they contain.
celestial_sunforge_blueprints.vendorReason: Divine Archive houses rare and powerful items crafted by celestial beings, including these divine schematics.
celestial_sunforge_blueprints.shippingDetail: Ships via a solar flare, arriving within one week of purchase. The item is delivered with a protective aura that ensures its purity remains intact.

usage.duration: Until expended or destroyed by damage
usage.endsWhen: The blueprints are destroyed by any means
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires celestial materials to activate

celestial_sunforge_blueprints.priceReason: Balanced at a price of 1000 XP, considering the rarity and divine origin of these blueprints.

centaur_khanate_bow.name: Centaur Khanate Composite Bow
centaur_khanate_bow.description: The Centaur Khanate Composite Bow is a masterwork of centaur craftsmanship. Its sleek design allows for precise shots while mounted, and its powerful draw can be felt in every pull. Arrows fired from this bow travel twice as far, and it grants the archer advantage on attacks made while riding.

effectDetails.title: Riding Shot
effectDetails.rules: When you use a bonus action to draw this bow while mounted, you gain the benefit of your mount's speed on your ranged attack. This effect ends when you dismount or lose control of the mount.

effectDetails.title: Extended Range
effectDetails.rules: Arrows fired from this bow have an extended range equal to 50% further than a standard longbow. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

centaur_khanate_bow.levelRequirementReason: This bow is designed for versatile use and can be wielded by beginners with ease.
centaur_khanate_bow.vendorReason: The Centaur Khanate is renowned for its mastery of composite bows, perfecting this one to suit their riders' needs.
centaur_khanate_bow.shippingDetail: Delivered via swift winds, ensuring the bow arrives in prime condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to draw while mounted; ranged attack with a standard action
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Riding Shot; ends at end of next turn for Extended Range
usage.endsWhen: Dismounting or losing control, end of your next turn respectively

centaur_khanate_bow.priceReason: The reduced price reflects the bow's more versatile and beginner-friendly design.

centaur_khanate_horse_shoe_enchant_servi.name: Centaur Khanate Horse Shoe Enchant Service
centaur_khanate_horse_shoe_enchant_servi.description: These enchanted horse shoes are forged with the precision of Khanate Farriers. The clopping sound they produce is both a signature of their craftsmanship and a sign that your mount is moving at its peak speed, gaining +10 feet to its movement rate for a week. In addition, you gain advantage on mounted charge attacks, making your charge more devastating.

effectDetails.title: Mount Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: When equipped, the enchanted horse shoes increase the mount's speed by +10 feet for a duration of one week. The effect ends when the duration expires or if the shoes are removed.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Mounted Charges
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on attack rolls made with your mount while charging, up to once per long rest. The advantage is lost if you dismount before making an attack.

centaur_khanate_horse_shoe_enchant_servi.levelRequirementReason: This enchantment is suitable for mounts of all levels and can be used by young adventurers as well.
centaur_khanate_horse_shoe_enchant_servi.vendorReason: The Centaur Khanate Steppes specializes in equine care and equipment, including enchanted shoes that boost mount performance.
centaur_khanate_horse_shoe_enchant_servi.shippingDetail: The enchanted horse shoes are delivered by trusted Hoof Delivery couriers who ensure the delicate equipment arrives safely to your stable.

usage.activation: Equipping the shoes is an instantaneous action.
usage.duration: One week, from moment of application until removal or expiration.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or when the shoes are removed.

centaur_khanate_horse_shoe_enchant_servi.priceReason: This price reflects a balance between the high-quality craftsmanship and the utility it provides, making it accessible to new adventurers.

centaur_khanate_steppe_coat.name: Centaur Khanate Steppe Coat
centaur_khanate_steppe_coat.description: This thick wool coat is tailored for nomadic riders of the Centaur Khanate. The heavy fabric resists wind chill, keeping its wearer warm even in harsh steppe conditions. Its sturdy construction grants +1 to mounted speed endurance and provides a +2 bonus to saving throws against cold effects.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The coat provides a +2 bonus to saving throws made to resist the effects of cold. This benefit lasts for the duration of one long rest.

effectDetails.title: Mounted Endurance Boost
effectDetails.rules: Wearing this coat grants you a +1 bonus to mounted speed endurance, which lasts until the start of your next short or long rest.

centaur_khanate_steppe_coat.levelRequirementReason: The coat's tailored design ensures it provides benefits that can be enjoyed by even novice riders.
centaur_khanate_steppe_coat.vendorReason: As the coat is made by the very herders of the Centaur Khanate, they have exclusive rights to sell this item.
centaur_khanate_steppe_coat.shippingDetail: The coat is carefully rolled and shipped in a specially designed container that ensures its integrity during transit.

usage.duration: Lasts until the start of your next short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one long rest for Cold Resistance and one short rest for Mounted Endurance Boost

centaur_khanate_steppe_coat.priceReason: The coat's rarity, craftsmanship, and the special materials used justify its reduced price.

centaur_khanate_steppe_grill.name: Centaur Khanate Steppe Grill
centaur_khanate_steppe_grill.description: The Centaur Khanate Steppe Grill is a portable marvel forged from durable steel and adorned with intricate designs of steppe flora. It can be wielded while mounted, providing a +1 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks made for entertaining crowds. The grill also allows you to cook food twice as fast in windy conditions without fear of it being blown out.

effectDetails.title: Mounted Cooking Boost
effectDetails.rules: When used while mounted, the user gains a +1 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks made for entertaining crowds. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Windproof
effectDetails.rules: This grill maintains its heat and function even in strong winds, doubling cooking speed without risking flameout or damage from gusts.

centaur_khanate_steppe_grill.levelRequirementReason: The Steppe Grills are simple enough for even the novice to use effectively.
centaur_khanate_steppe_grill.vendorReason: They are a staple of Khanate life and culture, often gifted or sold by the Centaurs themselves.
centaur_khanate_steppe_grill.shippingDetail: Ships with Steppe Smoke Shipment within one week from the Steppes.

usage.activation: Use as a bonus action while mounted to begin grilling or cooking.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; ends at the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you dismount, end your turn, or are no longer mounted.

centaur_khanate_steppe_grill.priceReason: This Steppe Grill is crafted from high-quality materials and designed for both practicality and durability in the harsh conditions of the Steppes, making it a worthwhile investment despite its moderate price.

centaur_khanate_steppe_yogurt_drink_reci.name: Recipe: Centaur Khanate Steppe Yogurt Drink
centaur_khanate_steppe_yogurt_drink_reci.description: This parchment carefully documents a centuries-old recipe for the Centaur Khanate Steppe Yogurt Drink. A fermented, nomadic staple, it's brewed with mare’s milk and consumed to enhance one’s endurance during endless rides across the steppes. The drink is said to be as potent as the winds that blow through the khanate, granting riders an extra burst of speed for their mounts.

effectDetails.title: Nomadic Endurance
effectDetails.rules: After drinking the yogurt drink, you gain a +10 foot bonus to your mount’s speed for 4 hours. This effect ends early if you dismount or if the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Ride Swiftly
effectDetails.rules: While under the effects of Nomadic Endurance, your mount can use its action on its turn to either move an additional 20 feet or make a Ride check with advantage. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

centaur_khanate_steppe_yogurt_drink_reci.levelRequirementReason: The recipe’s complexity and the physical exertion required for brewing it are accessible to adventurers of any level.
centaur_khanate_steppe_yogurt_drink_reci.vendorReason: Centaur Khanates have mastered this recipe, teaching it to trusted allies and travelers who seek to traverse their vast steppes with ease.
centaur_khanate_steppe_yogurt_drink_reci.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Swift Yurt Express, which ensures that the drink is fresh and potent for consumption upon arrival.

usage.duration: 4 hours or until you dismount or end your turn.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or if you dismount from the mount.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per long rest.

centaur_khanate_steppe_yogurt_drink_reci.priceReason: This recipe is crafted with rare ingredients and requires specialized knowledge, making it a valuable commodity among travelers and riders.

chain_chomp_chain.name: Chain Chomp's Leash
chain_chomp_chain.description: A heavy iron chain that once held a fearsome beast. The links still rattle with residual aggression when foes approach within 30 feet, and you feel an uncontrollable urge to bark at any mailman who dares get too close. This relic of ancient times is no mere leash; it's a living reminder of the tamed creature that once roamed free.

effectDetails.title: Rattle Alert
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy moves within 30 feet, the chain rattles and you can make a Wisdom (Perception) check against the creature's Stealth check to notice it. You don't need to use your action on this check.

effectDetails.title: Bark Command
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can bark at any creature within 30 feet that is not hostile towards you or your allies. The target must make a Charisma saving throw (DC 12). On a failure, the target is frightened of you for 1 minute.

chain_chomp_chain.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a character to have reached at least 6th level to wield its power effectively.
chain_chomp_chain.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post is known for its unique and rare items, making it the perfect place for adventurers to find such an ancient artifact.
chain_chomp_chain.shippingDetail: The chain is carefully packed with straw to prevent any damage during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or 1 minute (whichever ends first)
usage.endsWhen: The target succeeds on the saving throw, or when you use an action to bark again.

chain_chomp_chain.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's rarity and its unique utility in both combat and social situations.

chain_chomp_leash.name: Chain Chomp Leash
chain_chomp_leash.description: The Chain Chomp Leash is a robust steel chain with a secure loop for a fearsome pet. Crafted by Onyx Hand, it channels the beast’s ferocity into your command. The leash can summon or control a Chain Chomp, which listens to your commands and strikes on your signal.

effectDetails.title: Summon Chain Chomp
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can summon a Chain Chomp as a pet. The Chain Chomp is a CR 2 beast with bite attacks dealing 2d6 piercing damage. It remains under your control until dismissed or until you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Controlled Chomp Attacks
effectDetails.rules: On your command, the Chain Chomp can make a bite attack as a bonus action. If the attack rolls a natural 1 on the d20, it breaks free from your control and attacks the nearest creature other than you.

chain_chomp_leash.levelRequirementReason: This leash requires at least 6th level to handle its powerful beast companion.
chain_chomp_leash.vendorReason: Onyx Hand specializes in taming and controlling wild creatures, making them the perfect vendor for this unique item.
chain_chomp_leash.shippingDetail: The leash is shipped securely wrapped to ensure safe delivery of such a powerful pet tool.

usage.duration: Until dismissed or you take damage
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed by the user, or if the Chain Chomp breaks free due to a natural 1 attack roll

chain_chomp_leash.priceReason: This leash is priced at 1000 XP as it represents a powerful tool for controlling a CR 2 beast without the need for a familiar.

changeling_hive_camo_jacket.name: Changeling Hive Camo Jacket
changeling_hive_camo_jacket.description: The Changeling Hive Camo Jacket weaves a shifting pattern of colors and textures that blend seamlessly into any terrain. Each hour, it selects one random environment to masterfully mimic, offering advantage on Stealth checks in those conditions while subtly drawing attention elsewhere (disadvantage on other terrains). The jacket's patterns shift during critical moments, potentially distracting observers from your true movements.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Mastery
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each hour, you gain advantage on Stealth checks in one randomly determined terrain type. This advantage lasts until the next change (12 hours). You have disadvantage on Stealth checks in all other terrains during this period.

effectDetails.title: Distraction Point
effectDetails.rules: During a critical conversation or tense situation, the jacket's patterns shift to create a momentary distraction. This effect occurs once per short rest and has no saving throw required to negate its impact.

changeling_hive_camo_jacket.levelRequirementReason: The jacket requires minimal proficiency to operate but is complex enough that only low-level characters can afford it.
changeling_hive_camo_jacket.vendorReason: Changeling Hive Weavers specialize in adaptive and versatile camo gear, making this jacket a natural addition to their line.
changeling_hive_camo_jacket.shippingDetail: Ships via specialized metamorphs that can navigate the most challenging terrains to ensure timely delivery.

usage.activation: Instantaneous; the jacket selects its terrain type and patterns automatically at the start of each hour.
usage.duration: 12 hours per cycle
usage.endsWhen: At the end of one cycle or when a critical conversation occurs (distraction point)
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one distraction point can occur per short rest.

changeling_hive_camo_jacket.priceReason: The jacket's adaptive capabilities and rarity justify its cost as a mid-level rare item.

changeling_hive_chitin_armor.name: Changeling Hive Chitin Armor
changeling_hive_chitin_armor.description: Crafted from the discarded chitin of changeling swarms, this armor shifts and molds to your form, offering protection and a touch of the unknown. The armor's surface is iridescent with hues that seem to change with every step you take, reflecting the ever-shifting nature of the changelings who crafted it. It provides not only physical defense but also an edge in social situations, granting advantage on attempts to impersonate any humanoid creature.

effectDetails.title: Shifting Armor
effectDetails.rules: This armor provides the wearer with a +2 bonus to AC. It also has the ability to shift and mold to your form, granting advantage on checks made to impersonate any humanoid creature.

effectDetails.title: Social Edge
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can use an action to transform your appearance as if under the effect of a 'Mirror Image' spell, providing temporary protection and distraction for 1 minute. This ability is limited to once every short or long rest.

changeling_hive_chitin_armor.levelRequirementReason: This armor requires at least third level to balance its defensive abilities and social bonuses.
changeling_hive_chitin_armor.vendorReason: The changeling hive has intimate knowledge of their own materials, allowing them to craft this unique piece of armor.
changeling_hive_chitin_armor.shippingDetail: Delivered by Disguised Parcel, ensuring the armor arrives in perfect condition and with a touch of mystery.

usage.duration: 1 minute (Social Edge) / Instantaneous (Shifting Armor)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the wearer no longer has any hit points. The Social Edge effect ends after 1 minute.

changeling_hive_chitin_armor.priceReason: The rare and versatile nature of this armor, combined with its unique properties, justifies a price point that reflects its value.

changeling_hive_disguise_kit.name: Changeling Hive Disguise Kit
changeling_hive_disguise_kit.description: The Changeling Hive Disguise Kit arrives in a flat plum-colored case packed with skin paints, scent wax, false freckles, tiny tooth caps, and a mirror that politely refuses to show your original face. Hive artisans designed it for agents who need to borrow a convincing stranger’s manner for one tense meeting, not for permanent transformation. Its three measured makeup trays are color-coded for quick field work, though the lavender solvent smells unmistakably of honey and wet stone.

effectDetails.title: Borrowed Face
effectDetails.rules: Over 10 minutes, use the kit to copy a humanoid you can see or have studied from a clear portrait. For 8 hours, you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass as that person at a distance or in poor light. The kit cannot change your height, voice, body shape, or clothing, and close physical inspection reveals the makeup.

effectDetails.title: Three Prepared Disguises
effectDetails.rules: The case holds material for three complete disguises. Mark off one use when you finish applying a new face, whether or not the deception succeeds. A spent tray cannot be reused; replacing all three trays requires a visit to the Changeling Hive Exchange or an equivalent disguise supplier.

effectDetails.title: Hive Tell
effectDetails.rules: A creature with keen smell that comes within 5 feet can notice the kit’s honey-and-stone solvent with a successful Wisdom (Perception) check against your Deception result. This does not reveal your true identity by itself, but it identifies the disguise as Hive work.

usage.duration: 8 hours per completed disguise
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires, you remove the makeup, or it is washed away with water and solvent
usage.charges: 3 disguise trays; each tray is consumed after one completed application

changeling_hive_disguise_kit.priceReason: Manual continuation pass retained the existing listed price pending a separate economy review.
changeling_hive_disguise_kit.levelRequirementReason: Manual continuation pass retained the existing level gate for this item’s established complexity.
changeling_hive_disguise_kit.vendorReason: The existing Hive vendor remains the appropriate source for this specialized changeling craft or service.
changeling_hive_disguise_kit.shippingDetail: Delivered in a sealed Hive package; inspect the contents before use.

changeling_hive_disguise_kit_premium.name: Changeling Hive Disguise Kit (Premium)
changeling_hive_disguise_kit_premium.description: This premium Changeling Hive Disguise Kit is a lacquered theatre trunk no bigger than a lunchbox, lined with living pigment pads that remember the last face they copied. A brass breathing tube warms the paints to skin temperature while a chitin comb lays down false hair with unnerving precision. It is intended for embassy corridors, guarded receptions, and other places where a cheap fake would fail. After half an hour, however, the reactive pigment starts to itch beneath sustained concentration.

effectDetails.title: One-Hour Living Disguise
effectDetails.rules: As an action after 10 minutes of preparation, choose a Medium or Small humanoid appearance you have observed. For 1 hour your visible features, skin texture, and apparent clothing colors mimic that appearance. You have advantage on checks made to maintain the disguise against casual observers; touch, a known password, or a creature familiar with the target can still expose you.

effectDetails.title: Three Premium Faces
effectDetails.rules: The kit contains three living pigment capsules. Activating a new disguise ruptures one capsule, even if the disguise is dismissed early. The capsules cannot be refilled in the field and must be replaced by a Hive Mimic artisan.

effectDetails.title: Concentration Itch
effectDetails.rules: After you have worn a premium disguise for 30 consecutive minutes, make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the start of each minute you maintain concentration on a spell. On a failure, you have disadvantage on that concentration check; this irritation ends when the disguise ends.

effectDetails.title: Hive Mimic Finish
effectDetails.rules: The pigment subtly imitates nearby colors, granting advantage on one Dexterity (Stealth) check made to hide in a crowd during the disguise duration. Once this benefit succeeds or fails, it cannot be used again until you activate a new capsule.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The hour ends, the wearer dismisses the pigment, or the pigment is removed with the supplied solvent
usage.charges: 3 pigment capsules; one is consumed per disguise

changeling_hive_disguise_kit_premium.priceReason: Manual continuation pass retained the existing listed price pending a separate economy review.

changeling_hive_identity_rental.name: Changeling Hive Identity Rental
changeling_hive_identity_rental.description: The Changeling Hive Identity Rental is not a costume but a notarized day-pass to borrow the public face of a cooperative Hive citizen named Steve. The contract includes a voice-thread, a scent charm, and a folded etiquette card listing Steve’s favorite pastry, least favorite song, and mother’s telepathic calling hours. It is excellent for slipping through a registry or attending an appointment under a believable name. It is considerably less useful at karaoke, where Steve’s borrowed voice remains painfully flat.

effectDetails.title: Steve’s Borrowed Face
effectDetails.rules: When the rental is activated, you can cast Disguise Self at will for 24 hours, but the disguise always depicts Steve: a specific registered changeling appearance supplied with the contract. The illusion includes Steve’s voice but does not grant his memories, passwords, or mannerisms.

effectDetails.title: Maternal Check-In
effectDetails.rules: Once during the rental period, the GM may have Steve’s mother send a telepathic message asking a mundane question about Steve’s day. If you answer implausibly, creatures who know Steve have advantage on their next Insight check against you. The message has no combat effect.

effectDetails.title: Steve Cannot Sing
effectDetails.rules: While the identity is active, you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to sustain Steve’s ordinary persona and disadvantage on Charisma (Performance) checks involving singing. This disadvantage ends immediately when the rental ends.

effectDetails.title: Hive Rental Contract
effectDetails.rules: The rental expires at the next dawn after activation. Returning the voice-thread to the Hive counter ends it early without penalty; attempting to keep or copy the thread causes the disguise to fail and flags the contract as overdue.

usage.activation: 1 action to sign and activate the voice-thread
usage.duration: 24 hours, ending at the next dawn
usage.endsWhen: The rental expires, the thread is returned, or the thread is deliberately cut
usage.charges: One identity rental; the contract is redeemed and removed after expiry or return

changeling_hive_love_jam_recipe.name: Recipe: Changeling Hive Love Jam
changeling_hive_love_jam_recipe.description: This grease-spotted recipe card comes from the Changeling Hive’s communal kitchen, where every cook insists the secret ingredient is not magic but paying attention. The card explains how to simmer berries with rose salt and a measured spoonful of willingly given affection, then seal the jam before the pot decides what flavor it wants to be. The finished spread tingles on non-changeling tongues and makes conversations feel a little less guarded. It is a recipe, not an endlessly refillable jar.

effectDetails.title: Cook Love Jam
effectDetails.rules: During 30 minutes of cooking, expend fresh berries and rose salt worth 5 gp to make one jar of Love Jam. A creature can eat a spoonful as an action or spread it on food during a short rest. The recipe card is not consumed by cooking.

effectDetails.title: Emotional Insight
effectDetails.rules: For 2 hours after eating a spoonful, the creature has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to read a creature’s emotional state. This does not reveal thoughts, force honesty, or overcome magical concealment.

effectDetails.title: Warm Familiarity
effectDetails.rules: During the same 2-hour period, the eater gains a +1 bonus to the first Charisma check it makes to improve the attitude of a creature it already knows and cares about. The bonus cannot affect hostile creatures or replace a sincere relationship.

effectDetails.title: Hive Forager Method
effectDetails.rules: If the cook uses berries gathered from a Changeling Hive garden, one additional jar is produced. This benefit can be used once per cooking session and does not apply to purchased or conjured berries.

usage.activation: 30 minutes of cooking; 1 action to eat a spoonful
usage.duration: 2 hours after eating
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the eater is affected by an effect that suppresses taste or emotion magic
usage.charges: Recipe is permanent; each cooked jar is consumed after one serving

changeling_hive_mimic_apron.name: Changeling Hive Mimic Apron
changeling_hive_mimic_apron.description: The Changeling Hive Mimic Apron looks immaculate because its woven chitin panels borrow the color and pattern of whatever clean garment is nearest. A chef can spill gravy across it and watch the stain vanish behind a new floral print, which has made it popular with cooks who value appearances over laundry. The reverse side is less charming: it quietly retains every real stain and carries a thriving colony of kitchen germs. It is fashionable camouflage, not sanitation equipment.

effectDetails.title: Borrowed Cleanliness
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the apron while preparing or serving food, you have advantage on Charisma checks made to impress diners, judges, or patrons with your presentation. The benefit applies only while the apparent cleanliness of the apron is relevant.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Grime
effectDetails.rules: The apron’s appearance never removes contamination. After each day of cooking while wearing it, make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw when exposed to disease from food or filth; on a failure, you have disadvantage on that saving throw. Cleaning the apron with soap and boiling water removes this drawback until it is used again.

effectDetails.title: Matching Palette
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the apron copies the dominant color of your outer clothing. This is cosmetic and grants no Stealth bonus, but it can conceal obvious stains or livery for the remainder of the day.

effectDetails.title: Hive Textile Stitching
effectDetails.rules: The apron repairs ordinary tears during a long rest if at least one square inch of fabric remains. Fire, acid, or deliberate cutting prevents this repair until a Hive textile worker mends it.

usage.activation: Passive while worn; bonus action to change displayed color
usage.duration: Until removed
usage.endsWhen: Its display effect ends when removed; the disease drawback ends after proper cleaning
usage.charges: Unlimited; not consumed by normal use

changeling_hive_mimic_potholder.name: Changeling Hive Mimic Potholder
changeling_hive_mimic_potholder.description: At first glance this Changeling Hive Mimic Potholder appears to be your own spare hand, down to the familiar knuckle creases and a slightly judgmental thumb. The soft chitin weave insulates against oven heat and hot cookware, but its mimic reflex occasionally shifts at exactly the wrong moment. Hive cooks call that a reminder to pay attention. It is useful around a stove, less useful during sleight-of-hand tricks, and distinctly unsettling when left on a table by itself.

effectDetails.title: Kitchen Heat Guard
effectDetails.rules: While holding cookware, a baking tray, or another object heated by ordinary cooking, your hand protected by the potholder takes no fire damage from that object. This protection does not apply to spell flames, lava, or a creature’s fire attack.

effectDetails.title: Borrowed Hand Shape
effectDetails.rules: The potholder mimics your hand closely enough that creatures often overlook it. While wearing it, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks that require another creature to notice what is in your hand, because the false hand obscures your grip.

effectDetails.title: Mimic Reflex
effectDetails.rules: The first time each day you use the potholder to lift a hot object, roll a d6. On a 1, it twitches loose and you take 1 fire damage from the object before regaining your grip. This cannot drop an item unless you choose to release it.

effectDetails.title: Hive Textile Stitching
effectDetails.rules: Minor scorch marks disappear after a long rest. If the potholder is destroyed by acid, magical fire, or a deliberate cut, this repair trait does not function.

usage.duration: While worn
usage.endsWhen: Protection ends when removed or when used against non-cooking magical heat
usage.charges: Unlimited; one Mimic Reflex roll per day

changeling_hive_recipe_identity_crisis_c.name: Recipe: Changeling Hive Identity Crisis Casserole
changeling_hive_recipe_identity_crisis_c.description: This casserole dish is a culinary enigma, crafted by the Changeling Hive Cooks. As you take your first bite, the flavor shifts unpredictably—once it might be rich with savory umami, and the next, sweet and fruity. The dish grants you advantage on Deception checks for 1 hour, making you feel unusually charismatic in conversation. However, it also forces you to forget your favorite food, leading to a memory lapse that imposes disadvantage on any check related to culinary knowledge or recalling tastes.

effectDetails.title: Deceptive Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on all Deception checks for a duration of 1 hour. This effect ends if you use the ability, or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Memory Lapse
effectDetails.rules: For 24 hours after consuming this dish, you suffer disadvantage on any Intelligence (Investigation) check involving food memory and sensory recall. This effect is permanent until a short rest is taken.

changeling_hive_recipe_identity_crisis_c.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for even the least experienced adventurers to enjoy.
changeling_hive_recipe_identity_crisis_c.vendorReason: The Changeling Hive Cooks are known for their innovative and whimsical dishes, constantly surprising their patrons with unique culinary experiences.
changeling_hive_recipe_identity_crisis_c.shippingDetail: Ships via Metamorphic Delivery, a courier service that ensures your dish arrives fresh and flavorful, delivered within three days of order placement.

usage.activation: Eating the entire casserole during a sitting.
usage.duration: 1 hour for Deceptive Advantage; permanent until a short rest is taken for Memory Lapse.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or you take a short rest, whichever comes first.

changeling_hive_recipe_identity_crisis_c.priceReason: This dish's unique and temporary effects are balanced by its relatively simple preparation, making it accessible to all players.

changeling_hive_shape_shifter_sifter.name: Changeling Hive Shape-Shifter Sifter
changeling_hive_shape_shifter_sifter.description: The Changeling Hive Shape-Shifter Sifter is a delicate, hexagonal device crafted from shimmering hive wax and enchanted by the Hive Toolmakers. When you use it to sift ingredients for jams, its mesh shifts fluidly to adapt to the size of the fruit or honeycomb pieces, ensuring that every batch is perfectly prepared. The sifter also subtly changes form when handling love essences, becoming a tender caress rather than a mechanical act; this adds advantage on checks for emotional recipes but may cause unpredictable results in less sentimental dishes.
effects: Adapts mesh size for optimal jamming
Changes form for love essence handling

effectDetails.title: Adaptive Sifting Mesh
effectDetails.rules: When you use this sifter to prepare jams, its hexagonal mesh shifts to match the size of the ingredients. This provides advantage on checks related to jam preparation but does not affect other tasks.

effectDetails.title: Formal Love Handling
effectDetails.rules: The sifter's form subtly changes when handling love essences, becoming a tender caress rather than mechanical precision. While this adds advantage on emotional recipe checks, it may cause the sifter to shift unpredictably if used for other tasks.

changeling_hive_shape_shifter_sifter.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners in culinary magic due to its straightforward and versatile mechanics.
changeling_hive_shape_shifter_sifter.vendorReason: The Hive Toolmakers specialize in crafting tools that enhance the natural world, making this sifter a perfect fit for their inventory.
changeling_hive_shape_shifter_sifter.shippingDetail: Ships via Adaptive Alloy with a 1-week processing time and free delivery to your door.

usage.activation: As an action during jamming or love essence preparation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The recipe is completed or the sifter is no longer being used for these tasks.

changeling_hive_shape_shifter_sifter.priceReason: This price reflects a balanced value, considering its versatile utility and the rarity of materials used in its construction.

changeling_hive_shapeshift_scarf.name: Changeling Hive Shapeshift Scarf
changeling_hive_shapeshift_scarf.description: This intricately woven scarf is a marvel of Hive Silkers' craftsmanship. It whispers and shifts with your surroundings, altering its hues to blend seamlessly into any environment. Should you overstay in one place, it begins to itch, granting you disadvantage on Concentration checks until you remove it. A testament to the changeling's ingenuity, this scarf is a must-have for those who wish to remain unseen but still command attention.

effectDetails.title: Facial Disguise Aid
