effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Disguise checks for minor facial alterations when wearing the scarf. This effect is active as long as you are within a short range of at least one ally who can see both you and the target.

effectDetails.title: Itchy Aftermath
effectDetails.rules: If worn continuously in one place for more than 1 hour, the scarf begins to itch. While it is itching, you have disadvantage on Concentration checks until the scarf is removed or cleaned.

changeling_hive_shapeshift_scarf.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 2 to ensure players can effectively use the scarf without overpowered effects.
changeling_hive_shapeshift_scarf.vendorReason: The Hive Silkers are renowned for their skill in creating items that enhance disguise and stealth, making this scarf a natural addition to their offerings.
changeling_hive_shapeshift_scarf.shippingDetail: Ships via the Swift Wisp Couriers who deliver with unmatched speed and precision.

usage.activation: Instantaneous; no activation required once worn
usage.duration: Until removed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Worn continuously for more than 1 hour in one place, or until removed

changeling_hive_shapeshift_scarf.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's rarity and utility without being overpowered.

changeling_molt_cloak.name: Changeling Molt Cloak
changeling_molt_cloak.description: Crafted from a changeling's molting skin, this cloak allows its wearer to perfectly mimic another humanoid. It captures not only the visual details but also the scent and texture of the target, making the wearer indistinguishable for hours on end. The cloak requires one hour to attune to a new form after acquiring it, and it can be worn by any character who has reached at least level 1.

effectDetails.title: Perfect Mimicry
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes indistinguishable from the target humanoid for up to 8 hours. This effect requires one hour of concentration to attune to a new target.

effectDetails.title: Scent and Texture Capture
effectDetails.rules: The cloak captures the scent and texture of the target, making it difficult to distinguish the wearer through touch or smell alone. The mimicry ends if the wearer moves more than 30 feet away from the target or if the target is within 10 feet and actively checks.

changeling_molt_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's attunement requires a concentration that only lower-level characters can sustain.
changeling_molt_cloak.vendorReason: Only the changeling hive exchange knows the art of crafting such a delicate and powerful item, made from their own molting skin.
changeling_molt_cloak.shippingDetail: Ships through the live specimen courier with no additional charge for handling.

usage.activation: One hour attunement period to switch targets.
usage.duration: Up to 8 hours, depending on target and conditions.
usage.endsWhen: Wearer moves more than 30 feet away from the target or if the target is within 10 feet and actively checks.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day; attunement required for a new target.

changeling_molt_cloak.priceReason: Balanced to allow low-level characters access while maintaining rarity value.

chaos_dwarfs_daemon_engine_tune_service.name: Chaos Dwarfs Daemon Engine Tune Service
chaos_dwarfs_daemon_engine_tune_service.description: This finely tuned engine core hums with the chaotic energy of a warforged forgeheart, its intricate gears and pistons whispering secrets of ancient dwarf craftsmanship. When installed in a construct, it grants +1 attack and damage for one day, but also introduces a risk of subtle chaos mutations—roll a d6 to determine: minor quirk (e.g., spontaneous singing or an extra arm). The engine's ominous purring sends shivers down the spine, a constant reminder of its volatile nature.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Combat Capability
effectDetails.rules: When installed in a construct, the engine grants it an additional +1 to its attack and damage rolls for one day. This effect is instantaneous upon activation and lasts until the end of the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Chaos Mutation Risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance (roll a d6; on a roll of 1-3) that the construct will gain a minor quirk, such as spontaneous singing or an extra arm. The effect lasts until the next long rest and does not require saving.

chaos_dwarfs_daemon_engine_tune_service.levelRequirementReason: The intricate tuning requires a good understanding of both dwarven engineering and chaotic energies.
chaos_dwarfs_daemon_engine_tune_service.vendorReason: Chaos Dwarfs Forge specializes in crafting items that harness the volatile powers of chaos, making this tune service a natural addition to their offerings.
chaos_dwarfs_daemon_engine_tune_service.shippingDetail: Ships with Hellbolt's signature 'chaos surge' package, which ensures the engine remains stable during transit.

usage.activation: Attuned construct must perform a short rest while the engineer and construct are in contact to activate.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends when the construct completes its next long rest.

chaos_dwarfs_daemon_engine_tune_service.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique tuning process justify this balanced price point.

chaos_dwarfs_hell_bellows.name: Chaos Dwarfs Hell Bellows
chaos_dwarfs_hell_bellows.description: The Chaos Dwarfs Hell Bellows are a pair of bellows forged in the heart of infernal forges, their metal warped and twisted by chaotic energies. These bellows can fuel unpredictable roasts with either searing heat or chilling cold, depending on the whims of chaos itself. Each use brings unpredictable results, granting advantage on rolls related to cooking but also risking a random effect that could enhance or sabotage your dish.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Cooking Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When you use the Hell Bellows to fuel a cooking attempt, you gain advantage on the roll. However, if the cooking is intended for an audience or requires precision, there's a 25% chance (DC 14 Dexterity save) that it will go awry.

effectDetails.title: Random Heat (Boon or Bane)
effectDetails.rules: Each use of the Hell Bellows has a 50% chance to apply either a boon or a bane. A boon could be an unexpected burst of heat, enhancing your dish's quality by +1d4 flavor points; conversely, a bane might cause the food to spoil or become inedible.

chaos_dwarfs_hell_bellows.levelRequirementReason: The Hell Bellows require a certain finesse and understanding of chaotic energies that only comes with experience.
chaos_dwarfs_hell_bellows.vendorReason: As these bellows are forged in the Chaos Dwarfs' infernal forges, it's no surprise they sell items imbued with their unique magic.
chaos_dwarfs_hell_bellows.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the forge, arriving hot and ready to use. Expect a delay of one week due to the volatile nature of the item.

usage.activation: As an action when starting to cook with charcoal or wood fuel.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The cooking attempt is completed, and it can be used again after a short rest.

chaos_dwarfs_hell_bellows.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and infused with chaotic energies, the Hell Bellows are highly sought after for their unpredictable yet potent cooking abilities.

chaos_dwarfs_hellfire_roast_recipe.name: Recipe: Chaos Dwarfs Hellfire Roast
chaos_dwarfs_hellfire_roast_recipe.description: The Recipe: Chaos Dwarfs Hellfire Roast instructs you to roast meat over infernal flames, imbuing it with chaotic energy that stirs both wonder and dread. The result is a savory yet unpredictable dish that can either grant you a +1 increase in a random stat for two hours or subject you to an equally random but potentially malevolent effect. Only the bravest souls dare partake of this fiery feast, knowing full well the gods of chaos themselves have blessed it.
effects: Teaches recipe: Roast over heat (1 hour); eat to gain random mutation boon (+1 random stat for 2 hours) or bane
Requires: Meat and chaos spices; unpredictable

effectDetails.title: Random Mutation Boon
effectDetails.rules: Eating the dish grants a +1 increase in a randomly selected ability score for two hours. There is no way to predict which stat will be affected.

effectDetails.title: Random Mutation Bane
effectDetails.rules: Alternatively, consuming this meal could trigger an unpredictable negative effect, such as a temporary hit point drain or a random ability penalty lasting for the same duration.

chaos_dwarfs_hellfire_roast_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The unpredictable nature of the dish makes it unsuitable for lower-level characters who might not handle its chaotic effects well.
chaos_dwarfs_hellfire_roast_recipe.vendorReason: As Hellforge Cooks, they have mastered the art of creating dishes that satisfy even the most insatiable appetites for chaos and power.
chaos_dwarfs_hellfire_roast_recipe.shippingDetail: The roast is delivered still sizzling hot, ensuring its potency remains intact until consumption.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon consumption; lasts for two hours
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends after two hours or if the consumer stops benefiting from it early

chaos_dwarfs_hellfire_roast_recipe.priceReason: The dish requires rare ingredients and precise preparation, making it a valuable yet not excessively overpriced item for those willing to take the risk.

chaos_dwarfs_hellforged_leather.name: Chaos Dwarfs Hellforged Leather
chaos_dwarfs_hellforged_leather.description: The Chaos Dwarfs Hellforged Leather is crafted from the hides of infernal beasts, forged in the fiery depths where chaos and order clash. Its surface crackles faintly as it releases a steady warmth, making it both uncomfortable to wear in the summer heat and invaluable for those who face fire and chaos. This armor not only enhances its wearer’s resilience against these elemental threats but also grants a sense of empowerment derived from its infernal origins.

effectDetails.title: Heat Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this armor, the wearer is immune to the discomfort of moderate heat. However, it emits a steady warmth that can be intolerable in excessively hot climates.

effectDetails.title: Armor Durability
effectDetails.rules: This leather armor has an innate resistance to tearing and puncturing damage, making it highly durable against sharp weapons.

chaos_dwarfs_hellforged_leather.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest warrior can benefit from its protection against chaotic and fiery dangers.
chaos_dwarfs_hellforged_leather.vendorReason: The Chaos Dwarfs Anvil specializes in crafting weapons and armor from infernal materials, making this leather a staple of their offerings.
chaos_dwarfs_hellforged_leather.shippingDetail: Delivered via swift courier, ensuring the armor arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by fire or exposed to a chaotic creature's touch

chaos_dwarfs_hellforged_leather.priceReason: Balanced at this price point, the Hellforged Leather provides significant protection and is a reasonable investment for any adventurer facing elemental threats.

chaos_heart.name: The Chaos Heart
chaos_heart.description: The Chaos Heart, a pulsating black orb that hums with malevolent energy, is said to have been forged from the molten remains of shattered realities. It can consume worlds and open rifts to other dimensions, banishing foes into realms beyond existence. However, its dark magic comes at a terrible cost: anyone who wields it slowly loses their soul to the Void, causing the universe itself to wither around them. The heart's power is so immense that improper use will tear apart the fabric of reality and end the campaign for good.
effects: Opens Void rifts (banish enemies to non-existence)
Grants invulnerability when pierced by a Pure Heart
chaos_heart.warning: WILL END THE CAMPAIGN IF USED IMPROPERLY

effectDetails.title: Void Rift
effectDetails.rules: The user can open a rift, banishing one creature of their choice within 30 feet to the Void. The target must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or be sent to a dimension beyond existence, ceasing to exist in the material plane for 1d6 rounds.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: The user gains resistance to all damage from attacks. This effect persists until the user is hit by an attack made with a Pure Heart or similar item that specifically targets this ability, at which point it immediately ends and the user takes full damage.

chaos_heart.levelRequirementReason: Only those of sufficient power can handle such dark magic without succumbing to its corruption.
chaos_heart.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand has a long-standing partnership with entities from the Void, and they are known for dealing in forbidden artifacts like this one.
chaos_heart.shippingDetail: Delivery is instantaneous via rift travel. However, there's a 5% chance that the item will be sent to the wrong dimension upon arrival.

usage.activation: A bonus action to open a rift or use invulnerability.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for rifts; invulnerability lasts until hit by a piercing attack with a Pure Heart.
usage.endsWhen: Invulnerability ends when the user is pierced, and the rift closes after 1d6 rounds. The item cannot be used again until recharged through a lengthy ritual.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

chaos_heart.priceReason: The Chaos Heart's price is set at 1000 XP, reflecting its immense power and the risk it poses to any who wield it. Its rarity and danger justify this cost.

chaos_heart_shard.name: Shard of the Chaos Heart
chaos_heart_shard.description: A fragment of the Chaos Heart, this shard glows with unstable energies and whispers of cosmic anarchy. Crafted in the forges of the Cosmic Jesters, it is said to have been forged from the very fabric of reality itself. Handling this shard grants a chaotic advantage to all your Chaos-based spells, but also leaves you vulnerable to Order's backlash, compelling you to roll a saving throw against such effects.
chaos_heart_shard.warning: Possession punishable by banishment to the Void Between Worlds

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When using a spell of the Chaos descriptor, you gain advantage on all attack and damage rolls. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Orderly Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: For every hour you wield this shard without succumbing to Order's backlash, you must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on all saving throws against effects with the Order descriptor. This effect ends when you successfully save.

chaos_heart_shard.levelRequirementReason: This relic is too powerful for lower-level characters and requires a certain mastery of Chaos-based magic to wield effectively.
chaos_heart_shard.vendorReason: The Cosmic Jesters, creators of the shard, are known to trade its fragments through their black market as they seek to spread chaos across the multiverse.
chaos_heart_shard.shippingDetail: Pickup is available only in a dimensionally secure location within the Cosmic Jesters' domain. Shipping directly from this realm can lead to dimensional breaches if not handled properly.

usage.activation: Passive effect when wielding the shard, no activation required.
usage.duration: Until start of your next turn or until you succumb to Order's backlash.
usage.endsWhen: You successfully save against Order-based effects or after one hour without saving.

chaos_heart_shard.priceReason: The shard is a balance between chaotic power and its potential for chaos, making it a valuable yet reasonably priced item for those who can handle such power.

cheep_cheep_aquarium.name: Portable Cheep-Cheep Tank
cheep_cheep_aquarium.description: The Portable Cheep-Cheep Tank is a glass sphere no larger than a clenched fist, containing a vibrant blue cheep-cheep fish that thrives in its miniature aquarium. Crafted by the Comet Observatory, this tank allows you to breathe underwater when holding it and grants you a water jet of crisp ocean spray as long as you maintain your concentration. The cheep-cheep sings melodic sea shanties that can lift the spirits of even the most weary sailor.

effectDetails.title: Breathe Underwater
effectDetails.rules: While holding this tank, you are considered to be breathing normally underwater. This effect lasts for a short rest and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Water Jet
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may command the tank to shoot a jet of water in a 15-foot line. The jet deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage and has a range of 30 feet. Concentration is required while using this effect; if broken or lost, the cheep-cheep becomes hostile.

cheep_cheep_aquarium.levelRequirementReason: The Portable Cheep-Cheep Tank is accessible to adventurers who are just beginning their journeys and can benefit from its unique abilities.
cheep_cheep_aquarium.vendorReason: The Comet Observatory specializes in aquatic curiosities and has the expertise to craft such a remarkable item.
cheep_cheep_aquarium.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Sea-Spider Messenger Fleet, ensuring safe passage through treacherous waters. Expect delivery within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Water Jet); lasts for a short rest (Breathe Underwater)
usage.endsWhen: Lost, destroyed, or concentration is broken

cheep_cheep_aquarium.priceReason: The Portable Cheep-Cheep Tank is priced at 1000 XP as it combines the utility of underwater breathing with a unique water jet attack, offering both survival and combat advantages.

cheep_cheep_life_preserver.name: Cheep Cheep Life Preserver
cheep_cheep_life_preserver.description: The Cheep Cheep Life Preserver is a whimsical device, resembling a silver and blue fish with operatic gills. Crafted in the depths by artisans of aquatic opera, it keeps you afloat even underwater while emitting a hauntingly beautiful soprano solo that echoes through the sea. Though its music drowns out stealth, it also draws curious (and sometimes dangerous) creatures closer, making this a double-edged boon for those in perilous watery realms.

effectDetails.title: Cannot Drown
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Cheep Cheep Life Preserver, you are immune to drowning. You cannot be knocked prone or suffer from suffocation underwater.

effectDetails.title: Attracts Aquatic Predators
effectDetails.rules: When submerged in water for more than 1 minute, you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12). On a failed save, one hostile fish of your choice within 30 feet appears adjacent to you. This effect can be triggered once per long rest.

cheep_cheep_life_preserver.levelRequirementReason: This device is designed for adventurers just starting their aquatic journeys, providing them with basic protection and a unique feature.
cheep_cheep_life_preserver.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post specializes in exotic goods from various realms, including the rare and whimsical items crafted by sea opera artisans.
cheep_cheep_life_preserver.shippingDetail: Ships via a floating crate that navigates the waterways, arriving within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by damage exceeding your hit points or when removed from you.

cheep_cheep_life_preserver.priceReason: The Cheep Cheep Life Preserver is priced moderately to reflect its unique utility and the specialized craftsmanship required for its creation.

cheep_cheep_net.name: Cheep Cheep Net
cheep_cheep_net.description: The Cheep Cheep Net is a delicate, intricately woven net made from the silken threads of underwater spiders and enchanted to catch both fish and flying foes. Crafted by the merfolk of the Deepwood Lagoon, this net glows faintly with an otherworldly blue light, making it especially effective in dim waters. It can be used to ensnare aquatic creatures (yielding 1d4 fish per use) or entangle flying enemies, restraining them until they succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 15). The net is both durable and versatile, requiring only five uses before needing repair.

effectDetails.title: Aquatic Catcher
effectDetails.rules: The Cheep Cheep Net can be used as a fishing tool. On a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Nature) check, the net catches 1d4 fish per use within reach. This effect is instantaneous.

effectDetails.title: Flying Entangler
effectDetails.rules: When used against flying creatures or enemies with wings, the Cheep Cheep Net can restrain them for one minute. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 15) to escape this effect. This use of the net expends one charge.

cheep_cheep_net.levelRequirementReason: Adept swimmers and beginners alike find this tool useful in their quests.
cheep_cheep_net.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post often stocks items that are practical for adventurers of all levels, making the Cheep Cheep Net an easy addition to their inventory.
cheep_cheep_net.shippingDetail: This item is shipped rolled up in its protective case and can be used immediately upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Aquatic Catcher) or one minute (Flying Entangler)
usage.endsWhen: The target escapes the Flying Entangler effect, or all charges are expended

cheep_cheep_net.priceReason: Balanced at this price for its utility and durability, making it a worthwhile investment for any adventurer.

chet_rippo_service.name: Stat Reallocation
chet_rippo_service.description: Pauline's Microphone allows you to reallocate your stat points for a fleeting moment, reshaping your character’s potential. With a crisp exhale into its polished surface, two points from any stat are temporarily transferred to another, but the microphone hums with power that can only be used once per day. The core of this device is forged in the heart of a volcano, imbued with volcanic essence for unparalleled strength.

effectDetails.title: Stat Reallocation
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. You can temporarily transfer two points from any one of your ability scores to another, but you cannot exceed a total of 20 in any stat. This effect lasts for the rest of the day and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Daily Limit
effectDetails.rules: Once per day at dawn, you may use Pauline's Microphone to reallocate your stats. This is a one-time daily use only.

chet_rippo_service.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level as it offers a temporary boost rather than a permanent change.
chet_rippo_service.vendorReason: The Rogue Port Black Market is known for offering unique and rare items that can alter the course of one’s adventure, making Pauline's Microphone an ideal fit.
chet_rippo_service.shippingDetail: Delivered directly by a trusted courier, ensuring your privacy and security.

usage.duration: Until the end of the day
usage.endsWhen: At dawn the next day

chet_rippo_service.priceReason: This item offers a powerful and temporary boost, making it worth 1000 XP but ensuring it remains balanced within the game economy.

chomp_call_whistle.name: Chain Chomp Call
chomp_call_whistle.description: This tarnished whistle is known to summon a Chain Chomp, a ferocious beast of the wilds. Its call echoes through the forest, and within moments, the chomp's jaws snap into view, eager to obey its master's command. However, there's a chance it might mistake you for prey and attack instead. Once summoned, the chomp leaves after a minute or when it grows bored, leaving behind an eerie silence.

effectDetails.title: Chain Chomp Summoning
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate this whistle to summon a CR 2 Chain Chomp. The chomp remains for 1 minute or until it becomes bored and leaves on its own.

effectDetails.title: 50% Attack Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that the summoned Chain Chomp will attack you instead of moving to your target. This effect lasts for the duration of the chomp's presence.

chomp_call_whistle.levelRequirementReason: This whistle requires little skill, but it can still be dangerous and should not be underestimated.
chomp_call_whistle.vendorReason: The traders at Valley Trading Post often have unusual items that travelers need for their journeys.
chomp_call_whistle.shippingDetail: Shipped by Swift Wind Courier, known for its reliable service and quick delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The chomp leaves or becomes bored

chomp_call_whistle.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and utility, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

chrono_freeze_orb.name: Chrono Freeze Orb (Temporal)
chrono_freeze_orb.description: The Chrono Freeze Orb (Temporal) is a small, glowing sphere of crystalline material, forged from ancient time crystals. It emits a faint hum that can be felt by those within its range. This artifact allows you to freeze time in a 20-foot radius for up to 10 seconds, giving your party crucial moments to regroup and strike. Crafted by the secretive Time Stoppers, it is said to have been lost for centuries until rediscovered.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Trap
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the Chrono Freeze Orb (Temporal) in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. All creatures within a 20-foot radius are frozen for up to 10 seconds. The effect ends if any creature moves out of the area or a creature within the area makes a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Limited Use
effectDetails.rules: The Chrono Freeze Orb (Temporal) can be used once per week, and it recharges after 7 days. This artifact is incredibly rare, as only one has been known to exist since the Time Stoppers' last recorded expedition.

chrono_freeze_orb.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 10 to use due to its complex activation and the danger involved in using it.
chrono_freeze_orb.vendorReason: The Temporal Vault is known for its extensive collection of time-related artifacts, making it the most logical vendor for such an item.
chrono_freeze_orb.shippingDetail: The Chrono Freeze Orb (Temporal) requires special handling and takes an additional day to arrive due to its sensitive nature.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, lasts up to 10 seconds when used.
usage.duration: Up to 10 seconds per activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if a creature moves out of the area or makes a successful Dexterity saving throw.

chrono_freeze_orb.priceReason: Given its rarity, complexity, and limited weekly usage, this item is priced at 5000 XP, reflecting its value in the market.

chrono_time_crystal.name: Chrono Time Crystal (Temporal)
chrono_time_crystal.description: The Chrono Time Crystal (Temporal) is a shimmering, pulsating gem that hums with the echoes of time's passage. Its surface reveals fleeting visions of three potential futures, each marked by subtle changes in the environment and characters' actions. The crystal crackles with residual energy after use, hinting at the delicate balance it maintains between observation and interference. Crafted by the enigmatic Time Weavers, this artifact is a testament to their mastery over temporal dynamics.

effectDetails.title: Vision of Futures
effectDetails.rules: The user must make an Intelligence (History) check. On a successful roll, the crystal reveals three distinct future outcomes, each accompanied by visual and auditory cues indicating the path that might unfold. Failure indicates only two possible futures are revealed.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance of inadvertently creating a temporal paradox upon use. If this occurs, the user must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion for 24 hours.

chrono_time_crystal.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience and understanding of time magic can safely handle such an artifact.
chrono_time_crystal.vendorReason: The Eternal Chronicle is known for its extensive archives on the nature of time, making it a fitting vendor for this rare and powerful item.
chrono_time_crystal.shippingDetail: Delivery via Time Slip takes one round but requires careful handling to avoid temporal disturbances.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Use of the crystal, or if a paradox occurs

chrono_time_crystal.priceReason: The crystal's rarity and the risk it poses to users justify its high price in experience points.

chronomancers_paradox_gem.name: Chronomancer's Paradox Gem
chronomancers_paradox_gem.description: The Chronomancer's Paradox Gem is a crystalline artifact, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer like time itself. Crafted from the remnants of a collapsed timeline, it captures an instant of frozen time within its heart. A relic of The Last Timewalker, this gem allows its wielder to rewind time for six seconds once per week, offering a brief reprieve from chaos. However, each use brings with it paradoxical effects that can tear at the fabric of reality, causing 1d10 paradox damage to the user.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Time
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, the wielder can rewind time for six seconds. This effect is triggered by an immediate threat or danger. The duration of this rewind includes all actions and events that occur within those six seconds, effectively reversing them. The use is limited to once per week.

effectDetails.title: Paradox Damage
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the wielder suffers 1d10 paradox damage. This effect represents the strain on reality caused by manipulating time. Characters must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or suffer an additional 1d6 paradox damage at the end of their next short rest.

chronomancers_paradox_gem.levelRequirementReason: Only those with a deep understanding of chronomancy and significant experience can harness such a volatile relic.
chronomancers_paradox_gem.vendorReason: The Temporal Vault is the sole repository for artifacts that manipulate time, making it the only place to acquire such a powerful but dangerous gem.
chronomancers_paradox_gem.shippingDetail: The gem must be shipped under strict stasis conditions to prevent any accidental activation during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, duration includes all actions within six seconds of activation
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the time rewind is complete or interrupted by an external force

chronomancers_paradox_gem.priceReason: This gem's rarity and the potential for paradox damage make it a costly but necessary tool for those who dabble in chronomancy.

chuckola_cola.name: Chuckola Cola
chuckola_cola.description: The Chuckola Cola is a vintage soda from the Beanbean Kingdom, aged in barrels of laughter and folly. This fizzy beverage isn't just for drinking; it's a relic that amplifies your wit or misfortune depending on whom you share it with. Aged to perfection, this cola promises not just refreshment but also the chance to either tell a laugh-out-loud joke or face an unstoppable cascade of bad ones.

effectDetails.title: Restore Spell Slots
effectDetails.rules: As an action, drink Chuckola Cola and restore up to two spell slots (up to level 3). You can use this effect only once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Tell Bad Jokes
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can tell a bad joke that forces the target to make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they must take 5 (1d10) negative color points as their mood darkens.

chuckola_cola.levelRequirementReason: This soda is approachable for lower-level characters who can use its effects to gain an edge in social or combat situations.
chuckola_cola.vendorReason: The Shamans' Hut stocks a variety of oddities, and Chuckola Cola fits perfectly within their eclectic offerings.
chuckola_cola.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Glass Bottle Service, which ensures the integrity of the cola's unique aging process during transit.

usage.activation: Action for restoring spell slots; Bonus action to tell a bad joke
usage.duration: Instantaneous effects
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one use per short or long rest

chuckola_cola.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the soda's rarity and its dual functionality as a spell restoration tool and a social hazard.

civilization_founding_charter.name: Civilization Founding Charter
civilization_founding_charter.description: The Civilization Founding Charter is a leather-bound tome, its pages inscribed with ancient runes and seals from powerful guilds. This document grants you the sovereign right to establish your own city or town, ensuring legal recognition under international law. With this charter, you can immediately begin crafting laws, collecting taxes, and protecting your new settlement, but it also demands a steady influx of citizens and continuous investment in infrastructure.

effectDetails.title: Establish Sovereign City
effectDetails.rules: Activates on the first day you begin construction. The settlement gains full governing authority, including the right to establish laws and collect taxes. It is protected by international law, which prevents it from being easily destroyed or annexed by other powers.

effectDetails.title: Legal Recognition
effectDetails.rules: The charter ensures that your new city is recognized under international law. This protection lasts until the settlement has at least 500 citizens and a functioning government for one year, after which it can apply to join larger political entities or federations.

civilization_founding_charter.levelRequirementReason: Creating a new city is a monumental task that requires leadership experience and strategic planning.
civilization_founding_charter.vendorReason: The Merchant Guild oversees the establishment of cities, ensuring they are founded with sound economic principles.
civilization_founding_charter.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted couriers who ensure that the charter is handled with utmost care and arrives intact.

usage.activation: Once per month during construction of a settlement, upon completion of legal requirements.
usage.duration: Permanent once established
usage.endsWhen: Settlement fails to meet population or governance criteria for one year; charter expires.

civilization_founding_charter.priceReason: The cost reflects the resources and expertise required to properly establish a new settlement with legal standing.

cloning_chamber.name: Cloning Chamber (Installation)
cloning_chamber.description: The Cloning Chamber, a gleaming crystalline structure embedded within an Artificer Tower's inner sanctum, allows for the replication of living beings through advanced alchemy and magic. Installed in your keep or laboratory, it can produce one clone per month from any willing humanoid subject. The clone is an exact physical duplicate but with no memories or personality—essentially a blank slate that ages normally alongside its original creator. Should the need arise, the original can transfer their consciousness to the clone, ensuring their legacy or survival.
effects: Clone any willing humanoid once per month

effectDetails.title: Cloning
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a full action over one month. The subject must be a willing humanoid. Once the process is complete, the clone is an exact physical duplicate but with no memories or personality.

effectDetails.title: Consciousness Transfer
effectDetails.rules: The original can transfer their consciousness to the clone as a bonus action once per day. This transfers all memories and skills up to the point of transfer, but the clone cannot remember the act itself.

cloning_chamber.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 12th level to ensure proper understanding and handling of the cloning process.
cloning_chamber.vendorReason: The Artificer Tower specializes in advanced alchemical and magical devices, including this intricate Cloning Chamber.
cloning_chamber.shippingDetail: Ships via a secure courier service with specialized handling for fragile equipment.

usage.activation: Activation requires a full action over one month and the presence of a willing humanoid subject.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon completion, lasting until used or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per month; can be reinstalled in another location for future uses.

cloning_chamber.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the cost of materials, alchemy, and magical energy required to power the Cloning Chamber.

cloud_flower.name: Cloud Flower
cloud_flower.description: The Cloud Flower blooms with a soft, feathery elegance, its petals shimmering like wisps of cloud against the sky. This ethereal flower can conjure floating platforms that gently rise from the ground, offering stable stepping stones for adventurers to cross chasms or scale heights otherwise unreachable. Each blossom is crafted by the Celestial Gardeners at Comet Observatory, ensuring every platform is a sturdy 10 feet above the ground and capable of supporting up to 500 pounds.

effectDetails.title: Cloud Platforms
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Cloud Flower creates three floating platforms that hover 10 feet off the ground. These platforms last for 1 minute and can support up to 500 pounds each. They are perfect for crossing gaps or reaching inaccessible heights.

effectDetails.title: Steady Support
effectDetails.rules: The platforms remain stable during their duration, providing a secure surface even in turbulent conditions. If the platforms are destroyed or disrupted by an external force, they disintegrate after 10 seconds.

cloud_flower.levelRequirementReason: Even novice adventurers can appreciate the Cloud Flower's utility for crossing treacherous terrain.
cloud_flower.vendorReason: The Celestial Gardeners at Comet Observatory are renowned for their magical flora, including this versatile and reliable item.
cloud_flower.shippingDetail: Ships via a private aerial delivery service from the Celestial Gardens, arriving within two days of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The platforms disintegrate after being destroyed or disrupted by an external force.

cloud_flower.priceReason: This item provides a critical utility for adventurers, making it a valuable yet balanced purchase.

cobalt_star_shard.name: Cobalt Star Shard
cobalt_star_shard.description: The Cobalt Star Shard is a fragment of an alien star, its surface iridescent and etched with ancient symbols. When held, it hums faintly, its energy crackling like distant lightning. The shard's origins are lost in the cosmic mists, but it whispers secrets to those who listen closely. It can manipulate time locally, allowing you to reroll an enemy’s attack roll or cast 'Haste' or 'Slow', depending on your need.

effectDetails.title: Force Reroll (Reaction)
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, you can force an enemy to reroll its attack roll. If the result is lower than the original roll, the enemy must use the new result.

effectDetails.title: Cast 'Haste' or 'Slow'
effectDetails.rules: You can cast either the 'Haste' spell (duration 1 minute) or the 'Slow' spell (duration up to your concentration limit) using this shard. You regain any expended uses of these spells at the start of your next short rest.

cobalt_star_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Cobalt Star Shard requires a minimum level to ensure its effects can be used safely and effectively.
cobalt_star_shard.vendorReason: The Comet Observatory has exclusive access to cosmic curiosities like the Cobalt Star Shard, which it carefully procures from interstellar traders.
cobalt_star_shard.shippingDetail: The Time Stream Express delivers the shard with a time delay of one hour, ensuring its arrival is timely and intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for 'Reroll Attack', up to 1 minute for 'Haste' or 'Slow'
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the spell’s duration expires, or you use your action on another turn.

cobalt_star_shard.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and the cosmic energy it contains, making it a significant but balanced addition to any adventurer's inventory.

cocoa_amulet.name: Cocoa Amulet
cocoa_amulet.description: The Cocoa Amulet is a golden charm adorned with cocoa motifs that radiates warmth and sweetness. It warms both the hands and heart, perfect for cold days or moments of chill. When worn, it grants resistance to cold damage for an entire day, ensuring you stay cozy even in frosty climes. Once per day, you can brew a restorative cup that restores 1d4 Hit Points, offering a quick pick-me-up when needed.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Cocoa Amulet, you have resistance to cold damage for 24 hours. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until the end of the day.

effectDetails.title: Restorative Cup
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action once per day to brew a restorative cup that restores 1d4 (1-4) Hit Points to you or another creature within reach. This effect is instantaneous and has no save DC required.

cocoa_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The Cocoa Amulet's effects are straightforward and beneficial, making it accessible to even the lowest-level characters.
cocoa_amulet.vendorReason: The orchard stall vendor often deals in items that enhance daily life, from foodstuffs to small trinkets like this amulet.
cocoa_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped via Small Tin, ensuring the cocoa charm arrives fresh and intact.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action for Cold Resistance; once per day for Restorative Cup
usage.duration: 24 hours for Cold Resistance; instantaneous for Restorative Cup
usage.endsWhen: At the end of the day for Cold Resistance; expended after use for Restorative Cup

cocoa_amulet.priceReason: The Cocoa Amulet offers two useful daily benefits at a price that reflects its warm, comforting nature and sweet design.

coconut.name: Coconut
coconut.description: This robust coconut, crafted by the island dwellers of Toad Town, is a hardy fruit that has been hardened even further through ancient crafting rituals. When thrown, it delivers a satisfying 'bonk' as it makes contact with its target, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage and causing an involuntary wince. The vendors at Toad Town Market source these coconuts from the island’s sacred groves, where they are imbued with protective enchantments to enhance their durability.

effectDetails.title: Hardened Shell
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as a bonus action within 30 feet, the coconut deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage to a creature. It also has a 50% chance to cause the target to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Bonk Sound
effectDetails.rules: Upon impact, the coconut emits an audible 'bonk' sound effect that can be heard by all creatures within 30 feet. This noise has a cumulative +1 penalty to concentration checks for each round it is audible.

coconut.levelRequirementReason: The hardened coconuts are crafted for beginners and require no special training.
coconut.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in crafting and distributing the island's natural and enchanted items, including this hardy coconut.
coconut.shippingDetail: Shipped by Sack, with a delivery time of one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous damage; sound effect lasts until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Charges exhausted or destroyed upon impact

coconut.priceReason: The coconut's enchanted shell and durability justify a higher price, making it a fair value for its protective and combat benefits.

coin_block_replica.name: Mini Coin Block
coin_block_replica.description: The Mini Coin Block is a compact brick of ancient origin, crafted from weathered bronze. It exudes an aura of long-forgotten wealth, and when punched, it dispenses gold coins with a satisfying clink. This curious artifact recharges its coin supply at dawn, ensuring that the block never runs dry for those who are patient enough to wait. However, after 50 uses, the brick crumbles into dust, leaving behind only a faint echo of past riches and a reminder of the law of diminishing returns.

effectDetails.title: Coin Dispensation
effectDetails.rules: The Mini Coin Block allows the user to punch it, dispensing 1d10 gold coins. This effect can be activated as a bonus action. The block recharges its coin supply at dawn, restoring 1d4 coins.

effectDetails.title: Recharge at Dawn
effectDetails.rules: At the break of dawn, the Mini Coin Block replenishes itself by 1d4 gold coins. This effect is instantaneous and occurs automatically without any action required from the user.

coin_block_replica.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no level as it offers a simple, straightforward interaction that benefits all adventurers.
coin_block_replica.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market is known for its eclectic array of rare and whimsical items. The Mini Coin Block fits perfectly into their inventory, offering something unique to the curious and thrifty adventurers who frequent the market.
coin_block_replica.shippingDetail: Delivered with Bubble Wrap Express within three days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Uses are exhausted after 50 dispenses or the block is destroyed

coin_block_replica.priceReason: The Mini Coin Block offers a fair value for its limited but rewarding utility, providing gold without requiring any material investment from the user.

coin_of_the_god_of_chance.name: Coin of the God of Chance
coin_of_the_god_of_chance.description: The Coin of the God of Chance is a coin unlike any other, crafted from an ancient, shimmering alloy that whispers secrets of fate. It never lands on heads or tails but always comes to rest on its edge, symbolizing the balance between fortune and misfortune. As dawn breaks each day, it flips again, bringing with it either a blessing or a curse, depending on your current fears. This coin is said to have been blessed by chance itself, making it a coveted trinket among those who seek to influence their fate.

effectDetails.title: Blessing or Curse
effectDetails.rules: When the coin lands on its edge, roll a d20. If even, you gain a blessing chosen by the DM; if odd, you incur a curse. The effect is immediate and lasts until the next dawn.

effectDetails.title: Daily Re-roll
effectDetails.rules: The coin flips again each dawn, providing another chance to alter your fate. However, once it has landed on its edge during this period, further rolls do not change unless you take a short rest.

coin_of_the_god_of_chance.levelRequirementReason: This coin is accessible to all adventurers who seek to test their luck and learn the ways of chance.
coin_of_the_god_of_chance.vendorReason: Wario Direct, known for its eclectic inventory, often carries rare and unusual items that cater to those who wish to gamble with destiny.
coin_of_the_god_of_chance.shippingDetail: Shipped in an ornate box, ensuring the coin arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required. The coin flips on its own at dawn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; re-flips each dawn.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by a successful DC 15 Con saving throw, or when the adventurer takes a short rest after it has landed on its edge.

coin_of_the_god_of_chance.priceReason: The coin's rarity and the unpredictable nature of its effects justify this moderate price in experience points.

common_magic_item_upgrade.name: Common Magic Item Upgrade Coupon
common_magic_item_upgrade.description: This coupon allows you to upgrade a common magic item one step up in rarity. For example, it can turn your +1 dagger into a +2 dagger or your leather armor into chainmail. The coupon is handcrafted by the Wizards of the Recycling Bin and imbued with a strange green light that flickers uncertainly. There's always the chance that instead of upgrading, the item might be cursed, causing it to emit an eerie glow and misfire in unexpected ways.
effects: Upgrade one common magic item to uncommon

effectDetails.title: Item Upgrade
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The target common magic item is upgraded to an uncommon magic item. This has no effect on the item's inherent properties or abilities, but it does increase its rarity.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that the upgraded item becomes cursed. A successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw negates this effect. The curse causes the item to malfunction, adding a -2 penalty to all ability checks and attack rolls made with it.

common_magic_item_upgrade.levelRequirementReason: The process of upgrading an item requires a basic understanding of magic and its principles.
common_magic_item_upgrade.vendorReason: Upgrade Center specializes in enhancing magical artifacts, offering players the chance to improve their gear through both legitimate means and questionable shortcuts.
common_magic_item_upgrade.shippingDetail: The enchanted envelope ensures swift delivery, but it may occasionally be delayed by mischievous spirits or a playful goblin postman.

usage.duration: Instantaneous upgrade; the item is upgraded upon activation
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use
usage.charges: Unlimited, as each coupon can only be used once

common_magic_item_upgrade.priceReason: The cost reflects the complex alchemical processes and magical energies required to perform the upgrade.

compass_of_dead_paths.name: Compass of Dead Paths
compass_of_dead_paths.description: The Compass of Dead Paths hums faintly, its brass needle a sickly green hue that points not to north but to the final resting place of someone who perished nearby within the last fortnight. When the needle glows with a livid light, it signals proximity to a recent and violent death, attracting both spectral scavengers and curious travelers. The compass is said to have been crafted in the depths of an ancient necropolis by forgers who sought to understand the flow of life and death.
effects: Points to the location of the most recent death within 10 miles
Glow brighter with more recent or violent deaths

effectDetails.title: Death's Direction
effectDetails.rules: The compass points directly toward the location where someone last died. This effect is passive and always active.

effectDetails.title: Violent Glow
effectDetails.rules: For every death that was violent or sudden, the compass emits a brighter green glow, increasing its luminosity by one level. The glow fades after 24 hours unless another death within range occurs.

compass_of_dead_paths.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet powerful tool can be used by adventurers of any level to navigate the dangers lurking in the vicinity.
compass_of_dead_paths.vendorReason: The Bazaar of Oddities is known for its collection of unique and arcane items, making it a fitting vendor for this strange compass.
compass_of_dead_paths.shippingDetail: The Compass of Dead Paths must be carefully packed to prevent the needle from mispointing during transit.

usage.activation: No activation required; passive effect always active
usage.duration: Permanent until a new death occurs within range
usage.endsWhen: A new death is detected within 10 miles, causing the compass to reset its glow level and direction

compass_of_dead_paths.priceReason: The Compass of Dead Paths is a rare and useful tool that can save lives by warning adventurers of nearby dangers.

conker_acorn.name: Conker Acorn Bomb
conker_acorn.description: The Conker Acorn Bomb, a gnarled oak seed encased in a protective shell of bark and bristles, is a deadly weapon for those who dare to wield it. When hurled with force, this acorn detonates on impact, unleashing a shockwave that shatters the surrounding terrain into splinters. Legend whispers that every tenth seed might just sprout a grand oak tree, though only the bravest dare test such tales in battle. This rare item is crafted by Toad Town's most trusted forgers and sold at the town market, known for its unyielding loyalty to the local artisans.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Detonation
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as an action and lands within a 5-foot radius, this acorn explodes on impact. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

effectDetails.title: Tree Sprout Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 1% chance (Roll a d100) per use that the acorn will instead sprout into a sapling, which grows into a full-sized oak tree over the course of three days. The tree cannot be uprooted by physical means.

conker_acorn.levelRequirementReason: The Conker Acorn Bomb's explosive power demands basic dexterity and strength from its wielder.
conker_acorn.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for selling quality weapons crafted by local artisans, including this explosive seed.
conker_acorn.shippingDetail: Ships via Nut Bag Express, a reliable courier that ensures the acorn arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: instantaneous (explosion occurs on impact)
usage.endsWhen: the explosion resolves or the acorn is used up

conker_acorn.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its explosive power and rarity, making it a valuable yet manageable purchase.

connectopia_banana_core_amulet.name: Banana Core Amulet
connectopia_banana_core_amulet.description: The Banana Core Amulet is a relic encased in the hardened shell of a mythical banana, said to have been crafted by ancient hoarders. This amulet grants +2 to Stealth and Persuasion checks, making it invaluable for sneaky orators. In haunted zones, it reduces fear effects by half, offering eerie protection. However, beware—eating one consumes its power entirely, yet rewards you with 10 coins, a small price to pay for such potent magic.

effectDetails.title: Banana Speed
effectDetails.rules: While in banana groves, the wearer gains a +10 foot movement speed bonus. This effect ends when the character leaves the grove or if they consume the amulet.

effectDetails.title: Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When equipped in haunted zones, this amulet halves the DC of fear effects and spells targeting the wearer. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn after entering a zone marked as haunted. You can use it again only after completing a short or long rest.

connectopia_banana_core_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's power is accessible to low-level characters, enhancing their stealth and persuasion without overburdening them.
connectopia_banana_core_amulet.vendorReason: Connectopia often stocks unique relics from various hoarders' legacies, making this a fitting addition to their inventory.
connectopia_banana_core_amulet.shippingDetail: The Banana Core Amulet is shipped via Blooper Express, with a delivery time of one week due to its fragile nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or lasts until end of turn, depending on the effect.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you leave banana groves or haunted zones, respectively, or if consumed.

connectopia_banana_core_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's price reflects its unique crafting and magical properties, providing significant benefits without overwhelming the character.

connectopia_bowser_kid_keychain.name: Bowser Kid Keychain
connectopia_bowser_kid_keychain.description: The Bowser Kid Keychain is a small, metallic pendant shaped like a toddler’s boot. Crafted from tarnished brass and etched with ancient symbols, it glows faintly when worn by a Bowser child near another rival. The keychain whispers directions to the next throne room but only for those who have the 'Childhood Memory' trait. However, prolonged wear can trigger vivid dreams of one's own childhood or worse—being mistaken as a rival sibling in the castle’s hallways.

effectDetails.title: Throne Room Map Revelation
effectDetails.rules: The keychain emits a soft glow and reveals hidden pathways to the next throne room when worn by a Bowser child. This effect lasts until the wearer stops wearing it.

effectDetails.title: Childhood Dreams
effectDetails.rules: If worn for more than 1 hour, the keychain causes the wearer to dream of their own childhood for 1d4 hours. There is a 20% chance per day that a minor hallucination of rival Bowser children appears.

connectopia_bowser_kid_keychain.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character with 'Childhood Memory' and experience to handle the keychain’s effects responsibly.
connectopia_bowser_kid_keychain.vendorReason: Known for their unique collectibles, Connectopia supplies this item that appeals to fans of Bowser lore.
connectopia_bowser_kid_keychain.shippingDetail: Ships via a spirit courier, arriving within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn by a Bowser child with 'Childhood Memory' trait
usage.duration: Active until the wearer stops wearing it or falls asleep for more than an hour
usage.endsWhen: The keychain’s effects end if the wearer sleeps for more than one hour while wearing it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only active when worn

connectopia_bowser_kid_keychain.priceReason: Balanced price considering its unique lore and limited functionality.

connectopia_chain_chomp_courier_key.name: Chain Chomp Courier Key
connectopia_chain_chomp_courier_key.description: The Chain Chomp Courier Key is a shimmering, ancient artifact forged from the very essence of forgotten trade routes. Crafted by couriers who once navigated perilous paths to distant lands, this key glows with the spirit of a bygone era when secrets were traded as freely as spices. It opens doors that no map can show, and upon use, it triggers a fleeting portal leading directly into Beanbean’s hidden spice vaults—places where misdirection is an art form.
effects: Activates temporary portals to Beanbean's spice vaults

effectDetails.title: Secret Trade Route Activation
effectDetails.rules: This key, when activated as a bonus action, opens a hidden door leading to a secret trade route. The portal lasts for 1 minute and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Portal to Spice Vaults
effectDetails.rules: Using the key triggers a temporary portal that appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, leading directly into Beanbean’s hidden spice vaults. The portal lasts for 1 minute and can only be used once per day.

connectopia_chain_chomp_courier_key.levelRequirementReason: This key requires a minimum character level to activate the complex spellwork needed to open secret trade routes.
connectopia_chain_chomp_courier_key.vendorReason: Connectopia, as a hub for ancient and forgotten trade routes, naturally stocks relics that facilitate such connections.
connectopia_chain_chomp_courier_key.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Chain Chomp Courier, known for its punctual and reliable deliveries even to the most remote locations.

usage.duration: 1 minute (until dismissed)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the portal is dismissed or after 1 minute of inactivity
usage.charges: Rechargeable, usable once per long rest

connectopia_chain_chomp_courier_key.priceReason: This key is priced high due to its rarity and the complex spellwork required for its creation.

connectopia_cheep_cheep_accords_talisman.name: Cheep Cheep Accord Talisman
connectopia_cheep_cheep_accords_talisman.description: The Cheep Cheep Accord Talisman is a glowing amulet crafted from the shimmering scales of Toadkin and enchanted with the whispers of ancient agreements. When worn by a Toad allied with Rakasha Spirit Walkers, it grants temporary immunity to fear effects for 10 seconds and bestows a +1d6 bonus on diplomacy checks. However, if donned by any non-Toad, it triggers hallucinations causing confusion and 1d6 damage as the wearer's mind distorts reality.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear
effectDetails.rules: When worn by a Toad allied with Rakasha Spirit Walkers, the Cheep Cheep Accord Talisman grants temporary immunity to fear effects for 10 seconds. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action or reaction.

effectDetails.title: Diplomacy Boost
effectDetails.rules: Grants a +1d6 bonus on diplomacy checks when worn by a Toad allied with Rakasha Spirit Walkers. The effect lasts until the wearer no longer meets these conditions, and can be used once per short or long rest.

connectopia_cheep_cheep_accords_talisman.levelRequirementReason: This talisman is crafted for those who have already made significant strides in their toadkin heritage and alliances.
connectopia_cheep_cheep_accords_talisman.vendorReason: Connectopia, known for its diverse array of magical artifacts, sells this talisman due to the Moonfang Pack's reputation as a trusted source of powerful enchantments.
connectopia_cheep_cheep_accords_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with Koopa Postal; requires special handling and may incur additional fees for fragile items.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn by a Toad allied with Rakasha Spirit Walkers.
usage.duration: 10 seconds of immunity to fear effects, once per short or long rest for diplomacy boost.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer no longer meets the conditions (e.g., no longer an allied Toad) or rests.

connectopia_cheep_cheep_accords_talisman.priceReason: Balanced to fit within a reasonable price range for a powerful but not overpowered epic item, considering its limited use and thematic importance.

connectopia_cosmic_jester_trinket.name: Cosmic Jester’s Prank Pocket
connectopia_cosmic_jester_trinket.description: The Cosmic Jester’s Prank Pocket is a mischievous bag crafted by cultists of the Cosmic Jester. It spontaneously reshapes your gear into whimsical, yet practical absurdities—like a fire poker that turns into a plush penguin or a scroll case that morphs into a tiny xylophone. This relic grants you +1d4 to rolls for misdirection and trickery, and it may momentarily disorient foes. Once used, the bag is consumed in a burst of laughter and chaos, leaving behind only its whimsical contents.

effectDetails.title: Misdirection Boost
effectDetails.rules: When used as an action, you gain +1d4 to one roll related to misdirection or trickery. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Foe Confusion
effectDetails.rules: When activated, there is a 25% chance (DC 10) that an enemy within 5 feet becomes temporarily confused for 1 round. On a successful save, this effect does not occur.

connectopia_cosmic_jester_trinket.levelRequirementReason: This item requires only level 1 to use due to its whimsical and non-combative nature.
connectopia_cosmic_jester_trinket.vendorReason: Connectopia, known for quirky and unusual items, naturally carries this cultist-made trinket.
connectopia_cosmic_jester_trinket.shippingDetail: Ships via Dry Bones Dead Drop with a delay of one week due to the bag's tendency to rearrange itself during transit.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn
usage.endsWhen: Used or until your next turn ends

connectopia_cosmic_jester_trinket.priceReason: The price reflects the item's unique design and the skill required to craft such a whimsical yet functional relic.

connectopia_doughnut_gravity_iron.name: Doughnut Gravity Iron
connectopia_doughnut_gravity_iron.description: The Doughnut Gravity Iron is a blocky artifact that defies conventional gravity, crafted from iron salvaged from ancient Connectopia ruins. Its core is imbued with Grand Country's vertical chaos, allowing its wearer to stand on vertical surfaces for precisely 10 seconds. The artifact grants the user 20% resistance against gravity-based attacks, but repeated use can cause minor disorientation, making it essential to attune with a pioneer’s map before engaging in such feats.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on saving throws against gravity-based effects. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Vertical Stand
effectDetails.rules: The user can stand on vertical surfaces for 10 seconds, allowing movement up and down walls or other similar structures. Using this ability is a bonus action that requires concentration. The effect ends if the user moves more than 5 feet from the surface.

connectopia_doughnut_gravity_iron.levelRequirementReason: This item's attunement with a pioneer’s map and its unique physical properties make it suitable for characters who have already demonstrated some level of expertise.
connectopia_doughnut_gravity_iron.vendorReason: Connectopia is known for its blocky, gravity-defying terrain, making this artifact particularly useful to their inhabitants and visitors alike.
connectopia_doughnut_gravity_iron.shippingDetail: Ships via a private courier who can deliver it within the next market day.

usage.activation: Bonus action for vertical stand; concentration required while active.
usage.duration: 10 seconds per use, ends on movement more than 5 feet away.
usage.endsWhen: The user moves too far from the surface or falls.

connectopia_doughnut_gravity_iron.priceReason: Balanced price for an artifact that provides unique and limited mobility benefits in specific environments.

connectopia_dusty_ranger_satchel.name: Dusty Ranger Satchel
connectopia_dusty_ranger_satchel.description: The Dusty Ranger Satchel, crafted from desert scavenged leathers and metal scraps, is a rugged pack designed for frontier scavengers. Its leather exterior bears the sands of countless journeys, while its hidden compartments are lined with pockets woven from durable silk threads. This relic not only increases your carrying capacity by 30% but also occasionally yields rare materials when opened, making it indispensable to those who seek lost treasures and secret caches in the arid heartlands.

effectDetails.title: Increased Carrying Capacity
effectDetails.rules: This effect increases your total carrying capacity by 30% for as long as you are not overloaded. It has no save DC, duration is indefinite until expended, and there is a limit of one use per day.

effectDetails.title: Rare Material Drop
effectDetails.rules: Once per week, when the satchel is opened, it randomly drops 1d4 rare materials from its hidden compartments. This effect has no save DC or duration; it ends when the satchel is opened and recharges after a full day of rest.

connectopia_dusty_ranger_satchel.levelRequirementReason: This item requires only level 1 as it provides useful utility for adventuring at an early stage without being overly powerful.
connectopia_dusty_ranger_satchel.vendorReason: Connectopia, a vendor known for its unique and functional gear, offers the Dusty Ranger Satchel to adventurers seeking reliable equipment.
connectopia_dusty_ranger_satchel.shippingDetail: The satchel is carefully packed with extra padding to ensure it arrives in perfect condition. Shipping may take up to a week due to desert conditions.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon opening the satchel.
usage.duration: Infinite until expended, daily limit of one use for increased capacity; weekly limit of one drop for rare materials.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after a week without recharging or when opened and used.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, but only one rare material drop per week.

connectopia_dusty_ranger_satchel.priceReason: The Dusty Ranger Satchel is priced at 1000 XP due to its utility in increasing carrying capacity and yielding rare materials, making it a valuable asset for early-stage adventurers.

connectopia_entropic_keychain.name: Entropic Keychain
connectopia_entropic_keychain.description: The Entropic Keychain hums with a low, rhythmic decay that resonates through the air like the distant echo of forgotten stars. Crafted from the very breath of entropy itself, it grants its wearer a fleeting immunity to harm and turns reality into a whimsical playground of giggling puffballs and crumbling landscapes. When activated, there's a 5% chance for a spontaneous prank effect to ensnare nearby targets, all in the name of cosmic jesters and tricksters who revel in chaos.

effectDetails.title: Entropy Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains temporary damage reduction equal to 1d6 when taking damage. This effect lasts for the duration of a short rest and can be activated once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Prankster’s Jest
effectDetails.rules: When the keychain is activated, there's a 5% chance that a random prank effect from the Cosmic Jester cult will ensnare a target within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or become immobilized for 1 minute.

connectopia_entropic_keychain.levelRequirementReason: Requiring attunement by a rogue or trickster ensures the keychain's chaotic effects are used responsibly.
connectopia_entropic_keychain.vendorReason: Connectopia, known for its eccentric and whimsical items, regularly stocks the Entropic Keychain as it aligns perfectly with their diverse customer base.
connectopia_entropic_keychain.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Pianta Chuck Express, ensuring even the most delicate of keychains arrive in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with a 1-minute cooldown between activations
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against the Prankster’s Jest or the duration ends upon a short rest

connectopia_entropic_keychain.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's unique chaotic abilities and the rarity of its crafting material.

connectopia_feywild_crafting_ink.name: Feywild Inkwell of Whispered Whimsy
connectopia_feywild_crafting_ink.description: The Feywild Inkwell of Whispered Whimsy is a delicate vial filled with ink that shimmers with the colors of the Feywild. Crafted from the essence of a whispering willow and bound to a Feywild artifact, it allows you to write spells that alter reality for a brief moment. The ink's power comes from its connection to the whimsical magic of the Feywild, which can cause minor distortions in reality if used too frequently.
effects: Alters reality with written spell effects

effectDetails.title: Reality Alteration
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action. The ink allows the user to write a single, minor reality-altering spell that lasts for 1 minute. This effect can cause minor reality distortions if used too frequently.

effectDetails.title: Attunement Requirement
effectDetails.rules: Requires attunement with a Feywild artifact. Once per day you may use the ink to cast one 1st-level spell from the Warlock's spell list, which must be on your warlock spellbook and not be a cantrip.

connectopia_feywild_crafting_ink.levelRequirementReason: This inkwell is designed for those who have already begun their journey into magic, but are still developing their abilities.
connectopia_feywild_crafting_ink.vendorReason: Connectopia is renowned for its connections to the Feywild and offers unique items that blend frontier creativity with whimsical magic.
connectopia_feywild_crafting_ink.shippingDetail: Ships via Dry Bones Dead Drop, known for their reliable but sometimes quirky delivery methods.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, command spell effect lasts 1 minute
usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect is used or after 1 minute

connectopia_feywild_crafting_ink.priceReason: This inkwell combines unique crafting material and attunement requirements, making it a rare but balanced addition to any adventurer's collection.

connectopia_frostforged_shield.name: Frostforged Shield
connectopia_frostforged_shield.description: The Frostforged Shield is a relic of icy craftsmanship, its surface etched with runes that shimmer and whisper in the cold. Crafted by the last ice-dwelling clan who guarded the northern pass, it grants a +3 armor bonus against cold damage. The shield can cause frostbite to enemies within 5 feet when you make an unarmed strike or use a melee weapon attack while attuned to frost magic. Wielders hear the whispers of forgotten oaths and must stand on ice or snow to activate its full potential.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While attuned, you gain a +3 bonus to your AC against cold damage. This effect is active as long as you are standing on ice or snow.

effectDetails.title: Frostbite Infliction
effectDetails.rules: When you make an unarmed strike or use a melee weapon attack while attuned to frost magic, there is a 10% chance to deal an additional 1d6 cold damage and inflict the Frostburn condition on the target. This effect can be used once per long rest.

connectopia_frostforged_shield.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of attuning to frost magic requires at least a 3rd-level character.
connectopia_frostforged_shield.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in relics and artifacts from the Frozen Frontier, making this shield an appropriate offering.
connectopia_frostforged_shield.shippingDetail: Delivered via a spirit courier, ensuring swift transport of the relic.

usage.activation: Passive effect when attuned; active use requires attacking while attuned to frost magic.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for attacks; passive is always on as long as you are standing on ice or snow and attuned.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you stop being attuned to frost magic, leave the area of ice or snow, or recharge after a long rest.

connectopia_frostforged_shield.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare craftsmanship and magical attunement.

connectopia_item_name_here.name: Crimson Fleet Signal Beacon
connectopia_item_name_here.description: The Crimson Fleet Signal Beacon hums with a vibrant crimson light, pulsing in time with the heartbeat of the battlefield. Crafted by the enigmatic Void Drifters from the depths of Connectopia, this beacon can instantly call forth three Wario Warships to your aid. As their cannons fire, allies gain a 50% bonus to damage for a fleeting moment, but the enemy fleet is left reeling with minor disorientation that lasts until they regroup.

effectDetails.title: Summons Three Wario Warships
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous activation. The beacon calls three Wario Warships to your aid within a 30-foot radius. These ships can engage in combat immediately, providing support for the duration of the battle.

effectDetails.title: Allied Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated, all allies gain a +5 bonus to damage rolls against targets within 60 feet. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

connectopia_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: This beacon requires significant magical power and battlefield experience, making it suitable only for seasoned warriors.
connectopia_item_name_here.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in unique artifacts that bridge different realms, making the Crimson Fleet Signal Beacon a natural fit for their inventory.
connectopia_item_name_here.shippingDetail: The beacon is shipped via Paratroopa Air Express, ensuring it reaches its destination swiftly and intact. Delivery time is approximately three days from Connectopia.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until the end of your next turn)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a long rest or if destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to regain use after extensive use.

connectopia_item_name_here.priceReason: This beacon offers significant battlefield advantages at an affordable price for its legendary status and unique utility.

connectopia_jungle_whisper_shield.name: Jungle Whisper Shield
connectopia_jungle_whisper_shield.description: The Jungle Whisper Shield is a resonant barrier that hums with the ancient magic of the rainforest. Crafted from enchanted wood and bound by jungle vines, it not only absorbs slashing damage but also subtly enhances stealth in dense foliage. When struck by a melee attack from DK Crew members, this shield grants +1 to AC for the attacker's next action or reaction. Its low frequency hum can distract nearby enemies, making it an invaluable asset for jungle skirmishes.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Slashing Damage
effectDetails.rules: When the shield blocks damage from a slashing attack, it reduces the damage by 2d4. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Stealth in Jungle Terrain
effectDetails.rules: While within jungle terrain, the user’s Stealth checks are made at advantage. This benefit lasts until the end of your next turn after using this shield in combat.

connectopia_jungle_whisper_shield.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Whisper Shield requires a minimum level to ensure proficiency with its enchantments.
connectopia_jungle_whisper_shield.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in jungle gear and has the expertise to handle this shield’s unique properties.
connectopia_jungle_whisper_shield.shippingDetail: Delivered via Blooper Wetworks Express, ensuring swift arrival for your jungle expeditions.

usage.duration: Until the end of the user’s next turn after use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a long rest or at the start of your next turn if used in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one charge is expended each time it reduces slashing damage.

connectopia_jungle_whisper_shield.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant advantage without being overpowered, this shield’s price reflects its unique jungle magic and attunement requirements.

connectopia_koopa_navy_canteen.name: Koopa Navy Canteen
connectopia_koopa_navy_canteen.description: The Koopa Navy Canteen is a leaky vessel crafted from stolen ink supplies, its sides adorned with clandestine symbols. Each sip releases a noxious brew that not only fills your coin purse but also splashes an unfortunate target with ink, causing them to writhe in confusion. The canteen's contents are said to be brewed by the secretive Koopa Navy in Ricco Harbor, and it is rumored that those who drink it may find themselves haunted by memories of burnt rubber.

effectDetails.title: Coin Gain
effectDetails.rules: Consume the canteen's contents as a bonus action. You gain 10 coins and have a 25% chance to cause ink bleed on one target within 30 feet.

effectDetails.title: Ink Bleed
effectDetails.rules: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become incapacitated for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target is instead blinded for 1 round.

connectopia_koopa_navy_canteen.levelRequirementReason: This canteen can be used by novices as it provides immediate benefits without requiring significant prowess.
connectopia_koopa_navy_canteen.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in quirky and unique items, and the Koopa Navy Canteen fits perfectly within their collection of oddities.
connectopia_koopa_navy_canteen.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express with a guaranteed delivery time of two days or less.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; Ink Bleed duration is 1 minute or until the target regains consciousness.
usage.endsWhen: The target makes a successful Constitution saving throw, the canteen's contents are consumed, or it breaks.

connectopia_koopa_navy_canteen.priceReason: The price reflects the unique materials and secret craftsmanship involved in creating this item.

connectopia_koopa_navy_ink_jam_glove.name: Ink Jam Glove
connectopia_koopa_navy_ink_jam_glove.description: The Ink Jam Glove, crafted by Admiral Bloopers’ Ink Corps, is a tactical glove designed for Koopa Navy operations in ink-splattered environments. Its sleek design conceals a hidden reservoir of quick-drying ink, which can be deployed to jam the movements of enemies in close combat.
