The glove also features reinforced knuckles that absorb the impact from ink-based attacks, reducing damage by half. Once activated, it triggers an ink burst after three consecutive strikes, splattering all nearby foes with a potent mix of ink and jam for added chaos.

effectDetails.title: Ink Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When the user takes damage from an ink-based attack, they can activate this effect as a reaction to reduce the incoming damage by 50%, up to once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Quick Jamming Strike
effectDetails.rules: After three successful melee attacks against a single target with the Ink Jam Glove, the user can trigger an ink burst. This effect causes 1d6 damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius of the target. The glove must be recharged after five minutes of idle use.

connectopia_koopa_navy_ink_jam_glove.levelRequirementReason: Requires attunement by a Koopa Navy officer due to its specialized design and combat applications.
connectopia_koopa_navy_ink_jam_glove.vendorReason: Connectopia, the official supply chain for Koopa Navy personnel, ensures that only authorized officers receive this high-demand tactical gear.
connectopia_koopa_navy_ink_jam_glove.shippingDetail: Shipped via Blooper Express with a guaranteed delivery within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Reaction to ink-based attacks, or as an action for the ink burst effect after three strikes.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (ink burst) and lasts until expended
usage.endsWhen: The ink reservoir is depleted or the user takes a short rest.
usage.charges: Recharges after 5 minutes of idle use.

connectopia_koopa_navy_ink_jam_glove.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its tactical utility, requiring attunement and specialized training for effective use.

connectopia_mushroom_regency_icebreaker.name: Mushroom Regency Icebreaker
connectopia_mushroom_regency_icebreaker.description: The Mushroom Regency Icebreaker gleams with a crystalline sheen, its blade a frozen lattice of fungal magic. Crafted by the enigmatic Mushroom Regency in frosty realms, this sword is forged from ancient ice and enchanted with cold spells. Its wielder can deal piercing cold damage and apply frostbite to foes, turning their steps to slush for moments thereafter. A rare piece attuned only by spellcasters, it grants temporary immunity against fire and has a chance to petrify nearby enemies in the chill of its touch.

effectDetails.title: Freezes Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with this weapon, there is a 20% chance to petrify them in place for up to 1 round. The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be immobilized and unable to take actions.

effectDetails.title: Frost Bite
effectDetails.rules: The first time you hit an enemy with this weapon on your turn, they are also subjected to frostbite. Until the start of your next turn, the target takes 1d4 cold damage each round as their flesh freezes. This effect ends if the target is healed or takes any non-cold damage.

connectopia_mushroom_regency_icebreaker.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires attunement by a spellcaster and proficiency in martial weapons to wield effectively.
connectopia_mushroom_regency_icebreaker.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in rare and magical equipment, including enchanted blades like the Mushroom Regency Icebreaker.
connectopia_mushroom_regency_icebreaker.shippingDetail: Ships via Blooper Wetworks Express, arriving within a week of purchase with expert handling.

usage.activation: On hit as part of an attack action
usage.duration: Instantaneous; effects last until the start of your next turn or end when dispelled by magical means
usage.endsWhen: The target heals, takes non-cold damage, or is subjected to a dispel magic spell.

connectopia_mushroom_regency_icebreaker.priceReason: This weapon's rarity and unique enchantments justify its price of 1000 XP.

connectopia_mushroom_soul_pipe.name: Mushroom Soul Pipe
connectopia_mushroom_soul_pipe.description: The Mushroom Soul Pipe is a gnarled wooden pipe adorned with mushrooms that retain the memory of Princess Noki. When smoked, it grants fleeting visions of the Fungi civil war’s final battle and allows the wielder to move silently through fungal terrain. However, the whispers from the princess may drive one mad if not endured, and the taste buds can falter for a moment after use. This relic was smuggled out by a Rakasha courier who adheres strictly to the Mushroom Kingdom's laws.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Movement
effectDetails.rules: The user gains temporary +10% stealth while moving. This effect lasts for one minute and ends early if the pipe is extinguished or lost.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Vision
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the pipe reveals hidden enemies within 30 feet with a duration of 1 round. There is a 25% chance that the user will hear a whisper from Princess Noki, which has no effect but can be disturbing. This effect ends when the pipe is extinguished.

connectopia_mushroom_soul_pipe.levelRequirementReason: The Mushroom Soul Pipe requires a lower level to use as it offers unique insight into historical battles without overwhelming its wielder.
connectopia_mushroom_soul_pipe.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in rare artifacts and curiosities from various realms, making the Mushroom Soul Pipe an ideal addition to their stock.
connectopia_mushroom_soul_pipe.shippingDetail: The courier ensures that the pipe is handled with care, delivered swiftly but not instantaneously, due to its delicate nature.

usage.activation: A bonus action to light and use the pipe.
usage.duration: 1 minute for Stealthy Movement, 1 round for Psychic Vision
usage.endsWhen: Extinguished or lost in battle.

connectopia_mushroom_soul_pipe.priceReason: The Mushroom Soul Pipe is priced at 1000 XP as it offers unique and valuable insights into a historical event, making it a rare and sought-after item.

connectopia_oracle_cursed_treasure.name: Oracle Cursed Treasure
connectopia_oracle_cursed_treasure.description: The Oracle Cursed Treasure is a hollowed-out urn made of ancient, blackened bone. It whispers secrets of the dead when held near a corpse, but only if the wielder's soul is pure enough to hear them. If used within 10 feet of Primordial Wyrm seals, it deals 2d4 necrotic damage to both target and caster. Upon death, it triggers a curse that drains the soul, leaving the body as a soulless husk for three rounds.

effectDetails.title: Whispers Secrets
effectDetails.rules: The item grants temporary invisibility to the wielder for 1 minute. Consumes 2d6 mana upon activation. This effect ends if the wielder takes damage, or if they voluntarily end it early.

effectDetails.title: Primordial Wyrm Danger
effectDetails.rules: If used within 10 feet of Primordial Wyrm seals, both target and caster take 2d4 necrotic damage. This effect ends when the item is destroyed by magical means or when a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw is made.

connectopia_oracle_cursed_treasure.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a high-level caster to handle its power and risks.
connectopia_oracle_cursed_treasure.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in rare, cursed artifacts that challenge the brave and foolhardy.
connectopia_oracle_cursed_treasure.shippingDetail: Due to the nature of this item, it is shipped via special courier with increased delivery times.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until voluntarily ended
usage.endsWhen: Wielder takes damage or ends the effect early

connectopia_oracle_cursed_treasure.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its cursed nature and limited, dangerous utility.

connectopia_puffball_pouch.name: Puffball Pouch
connectopia_puffball_pouch.description: The Puffball Pouch is a peculiar leather pouch crafted from the soft, sentient skin of eldritch puffballs. Each one harbors a minuscule nightmare dimension within its fabric. When opened, it releases a cloud of giggles that incapacitate foes by making them laugh uncontrollably and drop their weapons. The laughter also nourishes the Cosmic Jester’s cult, but if used during the Pianta Village Independence event, there's a chance to escape capture by envoys.

effectDetails.title: Laughter Infusion
effectDetails.rules: When the pouch is opened and consumed, it releases a cloud of giggles that causes each enemy to laugh uncontrollably for 1 minute. During this time, enemies drop their weapons and are incapacitated as they laugh. The effect ends if the wearer or an ally uses an action to extinguish the laughter by consuming another puffball.

effectDetails.title: Cult Nourishment
effectDetails.rules: Each use of the Puffball Pouch feeds the Cosmic Jester’s cult, granting them 1d4 temporary hit points. This effect triggers only during the Pianta Village Independence event and has a 50% chance to allow the user to escape capture by envoys.

connectopia_puffball_pouch.levelRequirementReason: The pouch's effects are potent enough that even lower-level characters can handle its whimsical yet dangerous properties.
connectopia_puffball_pouch.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in unique and rare items from the Pianta Village, making this pouch a perfect fit for their inventory.
connectopia_puffball_pouch.shippingDetail: Ships within one week of purchase with an additional delivery fee due to the fragile nature of the puffballs.

usage.activation: Consuming the pouch by opening and consuming its contents.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use, ends when extinguished or discarded.
usage.endsWhen: Extinguished by another puffball consumption or discarded.

connectopia_puffball_pouch.priceReason: The Puffball Pouch is priced high due to the rarity of eldritch puffballs and its unique properties, which make it a sought-after item in the market.

connectopia_raventree_manor_map_fragment.name: Raventree Manor Fragment Map
connectopia_raventree_manor_map_fragment.description: A jagged piece of parchment with intricate symbols from both the Feywild and Physical Shadowfell, this Raventree Manor Fragment Map reveals hidden pathways within these realms. It grants +2 to all dimensional traversal rolls, making navigation through these planes a breeze. Touching it can stir a vivid memory of a past event, but only once per day. This fragment is crafted from the shattered remains of Raventree Manor, a symbol of its once-magnificent structure now reduced to ruins.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Pathways Revelation
effectDetails.rules: When activated by touching the map, this effect reveals hidden pathways within the Physical Shadowfell and Feywild. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: +2 to Dimensional Traversal Rolls
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants a +2 bonus on all rolls related to navigating or traveling through dimensional planes, including any checks made by the DM for such activities. This benefit lasts until the end of the encounter.

connectopia_raventree_manor_map_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners who are starting their journey into the realms beyond.
connectopia_raventree_manor_map_fragment.vendorReason: Connectopia, a hub for adventurers and explorers, is known for selling items that aid in frontier expansion and exploration.
connectopia_raventree_manor_map_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via Dry Bones Dead Drop, ensuring the map arrives safely but with a touch of macabre flair.

usage.activation: Activate as a bonus action by touching the map.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for revealing hidden pathways; lasts until the start of your next turn. +2 to rolls is permanent and cumulative during an encounter.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the map is no longer being used or when the user completes their turn.

connectopia_raventree_manor_map_fragment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and utility in exploration without overshadowing other party members.

connectopia_sarasaland_silk_belt.name: Sarasaland Silk Belt
connectopia_sarasaland_silk_belt.description: The Sarasaland Silk Belt is a delicate, golden-brown belt woven with threads of desert silk. Crafted by the Sarasaland Royal Cartographers for Princess Daisy’s court, it exudes a regal elegance. Worn within 500 yards of Princess Daisy’s territory, this accessory enhances one's diplomatic prowess and can sway hearts in arid lands. The belt requires attunement with a royal crest and grants a +2 bonus to Diplomacy checks for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Diplomatic Aura
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Grants the wearer a +2 bonus to all Diplomacy checks for 1 hour. The effect ends if the wearer moves more than 500 yards from Princess Daisy’s territory or if the belt is removed.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: While within desert zones and within 500 yards of Princess Daisy’s territory, reduces enemy morale by 10%. This effect lasts for 1 hour and ends when the wearer leaves a desert zone or if the belt is removed.

connectopia_sarasaland_silk_belt.levelRequirementReason: The belt's diplomatic benefits are accessible to all, enhancing one’s ability to navigate social situations.
connectopia_sarasaland_silk_belt.vendorReason: As part of Princess Daisy’s court, connectopia offers this royal artifact for its patrons.
connectopia_sarasaland_silk_belt.shippingDetail: Ships via Blooper Express; delivery is instantaneous within the desert territories.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Diplomatic Aura.
usage.duration: 1 hour for both effects.
usage.endsWhen: Leaves Princess Daisy’s territory or removes the belt.

connectopia_sarasaland_silk_belt.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the belt's rarity and diplomatic utility.

connectopia_scam_gear.name: The Last Whisper of Orangus
connectopia_scam_gear.description: The Last Whisper of Orangus is a cursed artifact that whispers truths to the void. Crafted by Liberated Toads in error, it grants 100% accuracy on attacks and allows for teleportation to any shadowed location. However, its malevolent magic can summon a ghostly form of Orangus Cornelius, which offers strategic advice but at a terrible cost: every use drains 50 HP from the user, making it a dangerous yet invaluable tool in desperate times.

effectDetails.title: 100% Attack Accuracy
effectDetails.rules: Activates on attack, lasts until the end of your next turn. Requires a bonus action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Shadowfell Echo Teleport
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous teleportation to any shadowed location within 30 feet. A failure on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw causes you to become disoriented for 1 minute, during which time you have disadvantage on all ability checks.

connectopia_scam_gear.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 2 to manage the item's dangerous effects.
connectopia_scam_gear.vendorReason: Connectopia, a notorious vendor of questionable items, occasionally sells this cursed artifact despite its origins.
connectopia_scam_gear.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express with a special delivery note warning of the item's curse.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; requires a bonus action each use.
usage.duration: Until end of next turn for Attack Accuracy; instantaneous for Shadowfell Echo Teleport.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or if the user takes damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by HP drain per use.

connectopia_scam_gear.priceReason: The item's cursed nature and dangerous effects justify its relatively low price of 1000 XP.

connectopia_social_media_detox.name: Connectopia Social Media Detox
connectopia_social_media_detox.description: The Connectopia Social Media Detox is a sleek, glowing device that emits soft pulses of light. It disconnects you from all digital networks for seven days, leaving you blissfully offline and immune to scrying or divination attempts. You feel refreshed but also clueless about the latest social media trends, giving you disadvantage on Insight checks related to online interactions. However, your newfound tranquility grants you advantage on Charisma checks with fellow detoxers, making it a popular choice among the tech-savvy who seek a break from their digital lives.

effectDetails.title: Offline Immunity
effectDetails.rules: When activated, you become immune to scrying and divination for seven days. This effect ends when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Social Media Cluelessness
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on Insight checks related to social media trends or online interactions during the duration of the effect.

connectopia_social_media_detox.levelRequirementReason: This device is designed for all adventurers who wish to take a break from their digital lives.
connectopia_social_media_detox.vendorReason: Connectopia Unplugged specializes in innovative tech that helps its customers unplug and recharge.
connectopia_social_media_detox.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days of purchase, ensuring you're fully recharged by the time it arrives.

usage.activation: Object interaction to activate for a duration of seven days.
usage.duration: Seven days from activation.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires after seven days.

connectopia_social_media_detox.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the device's unique utility and limited duration, making it a fair addition to any adventurer's XP budget.

connectopia_starlight_amulet.name: Starlight Amulet
connectopia_starlight_amulet.description: The Starlight Amulet is a radiant, fractured pendant that hums with celestial energy. Crafted from the remains of ancient starships and imbued with the spirits of lost pioneers, it grants its wearer a brief vision into future paths through treacherous Blocky terrain. It also reveals hidden secrets within the Dream Land’s most perilous realms, yet wearing it distorts reality slightly, bestowing temporary immunity to psychic attacks. However, speaking aloud while adorned risks collapsing the dream dimension itself.

effectDetails.title: Future Path Vision
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this amulet grants the wearer advantage on checks and saves related to Blocky terrain navigation for 1 minute. Additionally, it reveals hidden paths in both the Blocky terrain and Dream Land. If used during Pianta Village Independence, there is a 30% chance that envoys are not thrown into the pool.

effectDetails.title: Dream Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction to psychic attacks within 30 feet, granting temporary immunity for 1 round. The wearer must remain silent in public or risk triggering this effect, which causes a dream dimension collapse, expending the amulet's abilities.

connectopia_starlight_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The Starlight Amulet requires a level 7 proficiency to handle its cosmic and psychological effects.
connectopia_starlight_amulet.vendorReason: Connectopia is known for its unique artifacts from various factions, including the Starlight Amulet.
connectopia_starlight_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered via a special courier pigeon that ensures swift arrival within one day of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; reaction to psychic attacks for immunity, must remain silent in public or risk collapse.
usage.duration: Advantage on checks and saves lasts for 1 minute after activation.
usage.endsWhen: Expends its abilities if the wearer speaks aloud in public while active or is destroyed by dream dimension collapse.

connectopia_starlight_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its powerful vision and protection effects.

connectopia_toad_tongue_satchel.name: Toad Tongue Satchel
connectopia_toad_tongue_satchel.description: The Toad Tongue Satchel is a leather pouch stitched from the skin of a toad that once served as an ambassador for the Cheep-Cheep Accords. Its texture retains the subtle scent of ancient treaties and the whispers of long-forgotten negotiations. When opened, it emits a soothing hum that can calm even the most volatile spirit walkers and creatures. The satchel's leather is marked with faint patterns that tell tales of failed alliances and successful pacts.

effectDetails.title: Soothing Hum
effectDetails.rules: When opened, the Toad Tongue Satchel emits a soothing hum. This effect can calm hostile NPCs or creatures within 10 feet by reducing their hostility for 1 minute. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) or be confused and unable to act normally for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Ambassadorial Insight
effectDetails.rules: The satchel grants the wielder advantage on Diplomacy checks made against spirit entities. Additionally, it provides a +2 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks when attempting to negotiate with creatures of the plane of spirits.

connectopia_toad_tongue_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The Toad Tongue Satchel is suitable for novice adventurers who may encounter spirit entities or volatile NPCs during their early adventures.
connectopia_toad_tongue_satchel.vendorReason: As a hub of diplomacy and trade, Connectopia is well-known for its connections with spirit realms and toad ambassadors.
connectopia_toad_tongue_satchel.shippingDetail: The Chain Chomp Couriers ensure the satchel arrives in pristine condition, even on the most treacherous routes.

usage.activation: Bonus action to open and activate the satchel.
usage.duration: 1 minute for the calming effect; 24 hours between uses.
usage.endsWhen: The calming effect ends after 1 minute. The soothing hum stops when the satchel is closed or if the target successfully saves against its effects.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one calming effect can be active at a time.

connectopia_toad_tongue_satchel.priceReason: The Toad Tongue Satchel's unique construction from toad diplomacy gear and its diplomatic significance justify its high price in the market.

connectopia_virtual_avatar_suit.name: Connectopia Virtual Avatar Suit
connectopia_virtual_avatar_suit.description: The Connectopia Virtual Avatar Suit feels like digital armor, seamlessly merging with your form. Its sleek, holographic panels shift and glow with a life of their own, enhancing your tech-based interactions. This suit overheats in real sunlight, forcing a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer a -2 penalty to all rolls until cooled down manually. Forged by Virtual Tailors, it's a marvel of digital craftsmanship that offers advantage on Deception checks when impersonating an AI system.

effectDetails.title: Tech-Based Deception Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When making a Deception check related to technology, the wearer gains advantage. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Overheats in Real Sunlight
effectDetails.rules: The suit overheats when exposed to direct sunlight or bright light sources (such as daylight spells). The wearer must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer a -2 penalty to all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the suit cools down. Manual cooling requires ten minutes of inactivity.

connectopia_virtual_avatar_suit.levelRequirementReason: The suit's advanced tech and custom fit require at least third-level proficiency in technology-based skills.
connectopia_virtual_avatar_suit.vendorReason: Connectopia Hub specializes in virtual and augmented reality gear, making the Virtual Avatar Suit a perfect product for their lineup.
connectopia_virtual_avatar_suit.shippingDetail: Ships via Pixel Pleat Express within 3 days of purchase. Delivery includes a complimentary cooling pack for easy use upon arrival.

usage.activation: Automatic when donned; can be manually activated or deactivated as an action.
usage.duration: Until removed, overheats in sunlight
usage.endsWhen: Removed from the wearer

connectopia_virtual_avatar_suit.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this suit offers a fair trade for its unique tech-based advantages and cooling requirements.

connectopia_virtual_flavor_injector.name: Connectopia Virtual Flavor Injector
connectopia_virtual_flavor_injector.description: The Connectopia Virtual Flavor Injector is a sleek, chrome device adorned with holographic taste indicators. It allows you to 'upload' flavors into your food by merging digital tastes with real-world ingredients. When used correctly, it enhances the flavor of any meal by +1 to tech recipes. However, improper use can lead to glitches, where random flavors are added unpredictably. The Injector is a marvel of modern culinary technology, crafted by VR Injectors, known for their innovative kitchen gadgets.

effectDetails.title: Digital Taste Infusion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The target food item gains +1 to any tech recipe check made within the next hour. If used incorrectly, there is a 25% chance of random flavor glitches.

effectDetails.title: Random Flavor Glitch
effectDetails.rules: At the DM's discretion, after a failed recipe check with this device, the food item may gain an unexpected and unintended flavor (determined by the DM). This effect lasts until the next meal is prepared. No save DC required.

connectopia_virtual_flavor_injector.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can start experimenting with culinary magic using Connectopia's Injector.
connectopia_virtual_flavor_injector.vendorReason: Connectopia Hub specializes in cutting-edge kitchen gadgets and this is one of their most popular items.
connectopia_virtual_flavor_injector.shippingDetail: Ships via Pixel Inject Pan with next-day delivery within the city limits.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used incorrectly or when the meal is prepared
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged by connecting to Connectopia Hub's network

connectopia_virtual_flavor_injector.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, it offers a unique and useful gadget for culinary adventures.

connectopia_virtual_reality_helmet_premi.name: Connectopia Virtual Reality Helmet
connectopia_virtual_reality_helmet_premi.description: The Connectopia Virtual Reality Helmet transports you to immersive digital realms where you can train in simulated combat scenarios. Its sleek, ergonomic design houses a display that projects lifelike environments. Upon donning it, you may feel a mild tingle as the helmet calibrates its fields; this is safe but can cause motion sickness for some. Made by VR Techs, the helmet's sessions are known to enhance reflexes and combat strategies.

effectDetails.title: Simulate fight
effectDetails.rules: When you use this item as a bonus action, you gain +1 to your next combat roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Motion sickness risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that using the helmet will cause motion sickness. If affected, you are incapacitated for 1 minute and can take no actions or reactions.

connectopia_virtual_reality_helmet_premi.levelRequirementReason: This item requires basic understanding of VR technology to use effectively.
connectopia_virtual_reality_helmet_premi.vendorReason: As a premier VR provider, Connectopia Hub ensures only the best equipment is sold through their store.
connectopia_virtual_reality_helmet_premi.shippingDetail: Ships within 2 business days via Pixel Headset Express. Delivery includes an instructional guide and compatibility checklist.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, used once per long rest.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; +1 bonus to next combat roll lasts until start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a short or long rest.

connectopia_virtual_reality_helmet_premi.priceReason: This price reflects the helmet's advanced technology and rarity within the market, offering a balanced value for its benefits.

connectopia_virtual_reality_victuals_rec.name: Recipe: Connectopia Virtual Reality Victuals
connectopia_virtual_reality_victuals_rec.description: The Recipe for Connectopia Virtual Reality Victuals is a digital parchment that crackles with pixelated patterns, hinting at its ability to transform ordinary snacks into a symphony of code-flavored bites. It requires synthetic ingredients and promises glitches in your taste buds as it teaches you the art of 'Upload' flavors in just 10 minutes. Once consumed, these victuals grant you advantage on all technology-related saving throws for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Teaches Recipe: Upload Flavors (10 minutes)
effectDetails.rules: This effect is a passive knowledge gained by reading the recipe. It does not require an action to activate and lasts until you successfully prepare a dish using this recipe.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Tech Saves
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the victuals, you gain advantage on all Technology-related saving throws for 1 hour. This effect ends when it expires or if you consume another item that grants similar benefits.

connectopia_virtual_reality_victuals_rec.levelRequirementReason: The recipe is simple enough to be accessible early in the character's journey, encouraging exploration of technology-based professions.
connectopia_virtual_reality_victuals_rec.vendorReason: Connectopia Hub specializes in unique and technological recipes, making it a fitting vendor for this digital snack.
connectopia_virtual_reality_victuals_rec.shippingDetail: Ships via the Byte Bite Express service, which ensures timely delivery of these pixelated delights.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon reading; consumes when used to prepare a dish
usage.duration: 1 hour or until you eat another item granting similar benefits
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends after the duration expires or when you consume an item providing similar advantages
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires preparation using synthetic ingredients

connectopia_virtual_reality_victuals_rec.priceReason: The recipe is uncommon and valuable for its unique culinary technology, warranting a balanced XP price of 1000.

connectopia_voices_of_the_night.name: Voices of the Night
connectopia_voices_of_the_night.description: The 'Voices of the Night' is a delicate, silver locket encrusted with black opals. It whispers secrets from forgotten realms, its voice echoing like the distant howl of an eternal night. This locket can grant temporary invisibility and sustain soul points for summoning spectral allies, while also subtly revealing hidden dangers or shortcuts. Its origins lie in the Regal Empire Frontier Lab, where it was crafted to aid adventurers in their darkest hours.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes invisible for 1 round when the locket is activated as a bonus action. This effect ends if the wearer takes any action other than movement or speaks.

effectDetails.title: Soul Point Sustain
effectDetails.rules: Activating the locket allows the user to sustain 1d4 soul points, which can be spent to summon a shadow companion. The locket recharges after a long rest.

connectopia_voices_of_the_night.levelRequirementReason: The locket's whispering secrets and minor invisibility are within reach of beginning adventurers.
connectopia_voices_of_the_night.vendorReason: Connectopia specializes in unique, enchanted items for novice to mid-level adventurers.
connectopia_voices_of_the_night.shippingDetail: Ships via Bob-omb Express, ensuring quick delivery within a week.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The wearer takes an action other than movement or speaks

connectopia_voices_of_the_night.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its dual abilities and the Regal Empire's craftsmanship.

connectopia_volcanic_bloodstone.name: Volcanic Bloodstone
connectopia_volcanic_bloodstone.description: The Volcanic Bloodstone is a pulsating obsidian core that hums with volcanic fury, its surface etched with ancient runes of fiery promise. Crafted by Koopa Postal near active lava vents in the Valley of Bowser, this relic connects to the Primordial Wyrm prison through ancient seal residue, making it a perilous yet powerful companion for adventurers. Touching it causes minor burns that leave behind a trail of red-hot embers, and its presence enhances one's melee attack speed by 10%.
effects: Causes minor burns on touch (1d4 damage per 5 seconds)

effectDetails.title: Minor Burns
effectDetails.rules: When a creature touches the Volcanic Bloodstone, they must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 fire damage. This effect occurs every 5 seconds while in contact with the item.

effectDetails.title: Attack Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +10% bonus to melee attack speed for as long as they are holding the Volcanic Bloodstone, up to a maximum of two attacks per turn. This effect does not stack with other sources of similar bonuses.

connectopia_volcanic_bloodstone.levelRequirementReason: The item's fiery essence and connection to the Primordial Wyrm prison require an adventurer at least level 4 to wield its power.
connectopia_volcanic_bloodstone.vendorReason: Connectopia, known for their unique and dangerous wares, offers this relic crafted by Koopa Postal.
connectopia_volcanic_bloodstone.shippingDetail: Shipped via hot-air balloon across the Valley of Bowser; delivery can take up to a week due to volatile conditions.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held or worn on armor (infused).
usage.duration: Until the wearer stops holding it or takes damage.
usage.endsWhen: The item breaks, is destroyed, or its charges are exhausted.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges after 8 hours of rest.

connectopia_volcanic_bloodstone.priceReason: Crafted from rare volcanic materials and imbued with ancient seals, the Volcanic Bloodstone offers a potent yet controlled source of fire-based abilities at an appropriate cost.

continental_teleportation_network.name: Continental Teleportation Network Access
continental_teleportation_network.description: The Continental Teleportation Network Access card grants you a lifetime of seamless travel across five major cities, each shimmering with the arcane power that binds them together. The network ensures safe passage through any civilized lands, and upon your death, it passes to your heir as a symbol of your legacy. Each use of this ancient technology feels like stepping into an eldritch portal, where the boundary between worlds seems to dissolve in a flash.

effectDetails.title: Emergency Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: You can use this item once per week to teleport away from any immediate danger that threatens your life. You must declare the destination before using it, and you cannot target an area within hostile territory or a place where you are known to be wanted by authorities.

effectDetails.title: Safe Passage
effectDetails.rules: While holding this card, you gain immunity to non-magical attacks that would otherwise displace or hinder you in any civilized land. This includes the effects of bad weather and hostile terrain features such as swamps or deserts.

continental_teleportation_network.levelRequirementReason: The network is available to all, but it requires the user's understanding of how to traverse its portals safely.
continental_teleportation_network.vendorReason: As gatekeepers of trade and travel, the Merchant Guild ensures that only those who can benefit from such powerful technology are granted access.
continental_teleportation_network.shippingDetail: The card is delivered encased in a shimmering crystal pendant, ensuring its safe arrival and magical integrity.

usage.activation: Standard action to activate the network; no additional use limit applies after activation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous teleportation upon activation.
usage.endsWhen: Teleport ends when you arrive at your destination or if the card is destroyed.

continental_teleportation_network.priceReason: The card's value lies in its guaranteed safe passage and emergency use, making it a crucial tool for adventurers of all levels.

copy_flower.name: Copy Flower
copy_flower.description: The Copy Flower blooms with vibrant petals, each one a perfect replica of you. When it unfurls, it releases a cascade of clones that surge towards your foes in a chaotic wave. Each clone is indistinguishable from its original, making it impossible to target any one form effectively. This floral marvel is the creation of an ancient shaman who sought to protect her people by giving them the means to overwhelm their enemies with sheer numbers.

effectDetails.title: Dozen of Clones
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this flower summons a dozen exact copies of the user. These clones are indistinguishable and can be used to create a distraction or overwhelm opponents.

effectDetails.title: Massive Stampede
effectDetails.rules: The clones then rush forward in a chaotic wave, dealing 5 damage per clone per round for 3 rounds. The swarm of clones vanishes after the attacks are completed.

copy_flower.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency with ranged weapons to effectively utilize the additional targets.
copy_flower.vendorReason: The local shaman, who created this flower, sells it as a means of defense for her village.
copy_flower.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week by reliable courier service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: After 3 rounds or when the user takes a major action

copy_flower.priceReason: Balanced to ensure it remains a valuable but not overpowered tool for combat.

cosmic_bargain_bin.name: Cosmic Bargain Bin
cosmic_bargain_bin.description: The Cosmic Bargain Bin holds a menagerie of failed cosmic entities and defunct universes, each piece a testament to the universe's fragility. This bin is the work of Salvage, known for their scavenging of forgotten realities. Reach in, and you might pull out a fragmentary deity (CR 30) or a miniature pocket dimension (with 1d4 habitable planets), all 'as-is' with no warranty. A bargain for those who dare to dream beyond the stars.

effectDetails.title: Reach In: Random Cosmic Fragment
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, reach into the bin. You pull out either a fragmentary deity (CR 30) that serves you until fixed or a mini-universe (pocket dimension with 1d4 planets). The item is 'as-is' and cannot be returned for any reason.

effectDetails.title: Pocket Dimension Miniaturizer
effectDetails.rules: The bin contains a pocket dimension capable of housing up to four habitable planets. These dimensions are stable but not controllable by the owner until they invest time in cosmic engineering (DC 30).

cosmic_bargain_bin.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest cosmic entities can pose grave risks, requiring a minimum level to safely handle them.
cosmic_bargain_bin.vendorReason: Salvage specializes in salvaging and selling forgotten realities and cosmic curiosities.
cosmic_bargain_bin.shippingDetail: Ships via Salvage's interdimensional courier, delivery may vary.

usage.activation: Bonus action to reach into the bin.
usage.duration: Instantaneous pull; fragmentary deity serves until fixed or destroyed. Pocket dimension is stable indefinitely but requires maintenance.
usage.endsWhen: The cosmic fragment perishes or is destroyed by a successful DC 30 Con saving throw, or when the pocket dimension is breached beyond repair (DC 25).

cosmic_bargain_bin.priceReason: Balanced as a rare find with significant cosmic risk and reward.

cosmic_bargain_hunter_membership.name: Cosmic Bargain Hunter Lifetime Membership
cosmic_bargain_hunter_membership.description: The Cosmic Bargain Hunter Lifetime Membership grants you an unbreakable connection to the haggling gods, ensuring that no price is ever too steep or deals truly fair. With this membership, you can haggle with even the most capricious deities and walk away with treasures at a fraction of their true cost. Crafted by The Haggler himself from the essence of countless cosmic trades, it’s a relic that ensures your victories in all marketplaces across endless dimensions.
effects: Haggle with gods to reduce prices

effectDetails.title: Divine Haggling
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to invoke divine haggling. When you do, roll a d20 + your Charisma modifier (if applicable). On a successful result, reduce the price of any purchase by 95% for that transaction.

effectDetails.title: Universal Discounts
effectDetails.rules: This membership provides an additional 10% off on all purchases across every universe. This effect is always active while you possess the membership and does not require activation.

cosmic_bargain_hunter_membership.levelRequirementReason: The cosmic forces that power this membership are accessible to any adventurer, but only those who have begun their journey can truly appreciate its value.
cosmic_bargain_hunter_membership.vendorReason: Discount Divinity is the eternal purveyor of deals and bargains, specializing in items that help adventurers secure the best prices possible.
cosmic_bargain_hunter_membership.shippingDetail: Your membership will arrive within the week, delivered by The Swift Courier Service. This service ensures timely delivery through its network of celestial couriers.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Divine Haggling; Universal Discounts are always active
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use, recharges on a long rest

cosmic_bargain_hunter_membership.priceReason: This price reflects the cosmic energy and divine intervention that make this membership unparalleled in value.

cosmic_chaos_monkey.name: Cosmic Chaos Monkey
cosmic_chaos_monkey.description: The Cosmic Chaos Monkey is a mischievous pet that wreaks havoc on reality. It's a primate made of swirling cosmic particles, with eyes that glimmer like starlight and fur that shifts between colors. Every hour, it triggers a chaotic event based on the DM’s chaos table, which can warp time or space within a 30-foot radius. With a command word, you can direct its mischief to target specific objects or creatures, but the results are always unpredictable.

effectDetails.title: Reality Warp
effectDetails.rules: Once per hour, the monkey triggers a chaotic event within a 30-foot radius. The DM rolls on the chaos table to determine the effect, which can include shifting time by an hour or creating a 10-foot-wide fissure in reality. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until resolved.

effectDetails.title: Commanded Mischief
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command the monkey to target specific objects or creatures with its chaos. The DM decides the exact nature of the chaotic event, which must be within a 30-foot radius and has a DC of 18 for any saving throw.

cosmic_chaos_monkey.levelRequirementReason: This pet requires significant control and understanding to manage its unpredictable nature.
cosmic_chaos_monkey.vendorReason: Only the chaos pets vendor understands how to handle such volatile creatures responsibly.
cosmic_chaos_monkey.shippingDetail: Due to the monkey’s unpredictability, it is delivered in a specially reinforced crate with strict instructions from the vendor.

usage.activation: As an action or reaction (DM's choice)
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect resolves when the chaos ends naturally or when you dismiss it as an action
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by the monkey’s patience

cosmic_chaos_monkey.priceReason: This price reflects the unique nature of the monkey and the risks involved in owning such a creature.

cosmic_dragon_god_heart.name: Cosmic Dragon-God Heart
cosmic_dragon_god_heart.description: The Cosmic Dragon-God Heart, forged in the fiery forge of the First Dragon, is a pulsating heart encased in scales of every dragon deity. It hums with the untamed power of ancient draconic might and can reform after a second. This divine relic grants its wielder the breath weapons of all dragons, each capable of unleashing 20d20 damage upon foes, and offers true immortality, allowing for rebirth even from the ashes of destruction.

effectDetails.title: Breath Weapons
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action. Each breath weapon deals 20d20 damage to all creatures in a 60-foot cone, and the wielder can choose one of the following: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder. The heart recharges after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: True Immortality
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous effect that grants the user true immortality; they reform into a new body after 1 second upon death. This effect is not subject to save checks and cannot be dispelled or negated by any means, including divine intervention.

cosmic_dragon_god_heart.levelRequirementReason: Even the most powerful magic requires a willing heart; this item demands no less than level 1.
cosmic_dragon_god_heart.vendorReason: The dragon-god forges are the only entities that can craft such an artifact, as they possess the essence of all deities.
cosmic_dragon_god_heart.shippingDetail: Ships via a reality tear express, arriving instantly at its destination within hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Commanded breath weapon: bonus action; True immortality: instantaneous effect upon death
usage.duration: Instantaneous (breath weapons), or until expended (true immortality)
usage.endsWhen: Breath weapons expend after a long rest, true immortality ends when the wielder dies and reforms.
usage.charges: Unlimited (true immortality); 6 uses per long rest (breath weapon)

cosmic_dragon_god_heart.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its divine craftsmanship and the limited number of breath weapon uses.

cosmic_jackpot_ticket.name: Cosmic Jackpot Lottery Ticket
cosmic_jackpot_ticket.description: This shimmering ticket, embossed with cosmic symbols and a cryptic ‘COSMIC GAMBLING’ seal, is said to be crafted from stardust and woven with ancient lottery magic. Scratch its iridescent surface, and the universe itself seems to ripple in anticipation of your fate. The Lottery Commission guarantees one of two prizes: either an entire universe with its inhabitants who will revere you as a god, or 1 million gold coins. Beware, for winning a universe means taking responsibility for countless lives.

effectDetails.title: Universe Scratch
effectDetails.rules: Scratch the ticket to claim your prize. This action is a bonus action that triggers an instantaneous effect. The winner gains either an entire universe (with inhabitants who will revere you) or 1 million gold coins, at the DM's discretion.

effectDetails.title: Million Gold
effectDetails.rules: If not used within one week of purchase, the ticket forfeits its cosmic prize and instead grants 1 million gold coins. This effect is triggered by expiration.

cosmic_jackpot_ticket.levelRequirementReason: The lottery ticket requires no level for purchase but provides a significant reward.
cosmic_jackpot_ticket.vendorReason: Cosmic Gambling, the Lottery Commission's official vendor, offers this unique and risky chance to win an entire universe or a substantial amount of gold.
cosmic_jackpot_ticket.shippingDetail: The ticket is delivered with utmost secrecy by Winning Number Express Courier Service within one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon activation
usage.endsWhen: The ticket's cosmic prize expires after a week without use, or if scratched to claim the prize

cosmic_jackpot_ticket.priceReason: The ticket is priced at 1000 XP as it offers an extremely rare and potentially life-altering opportunity.

cosmic_scribe_service.name: Cosmic Scribe Service
cosmic_scribe_service.description: The Cosmic Scribe Service is a delicate quill and inkwell crafted by the Servants of the Cosmos, inscribed with runes that bind your deeds to the cosmic archives across all planes. Each entry into this ancient ledger grants you +2 bonus to future Reputation checks when dealing with celestial beings, ensuring your legacy shines among the stars. The quill itself is made from the feathers of a twilight falcon, and the ink from the essence of forgotten constellations.
cosmic_scribe_service.shippedBy: Personal Courier from the Servants' Nexus

effectDetails.title: Celestial Documentation
effectDetails.rules: When you use this quill to record an important deed, it is eternally preserved in the cosmic archives. This action requires a bonus action and has no additional costs or durations.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reputation
effectDetails.rules: After recording three significant deeds with the Cosmic Scribe Service, you gain a +2 bonus to all Reputation checks made against celestial beings for 1 week. You can only use this effect once per month.

cosmic_scribe_service.levelRequirementReason: The quill's intricate runes and the Servants' enchantments require a minimum of first level to properly channel their power.
cosmic_scribe_service.vendorReason: The Cosmic Archives are custodians of all cosmic records, making them the only vendors capable of selling such a revered item.
cosmic_scribe_service.shippingDetail: The Cosmic Scribe Service is delivered by a personal courier who ensures its safe arrival, often within a day depending on the courier's route.

usage.activation: Bonus action to record an important deed or once per month for reputation gain.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used up or after one week, whichever comes first.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the quill refills itself from the cosmic archives.

cosmic_scribe_service.priceReason: The Cosmic Scribe Service is priced at 1000 XP as it combines celestial magic with rare materials and expert craftsmanship.

courage_shell.name: Courage Shell
courage_shell.description: The Courage Shell is a shimmering, egg-shaped confection made from the hardened essence of a brave warrior's heart. Consumed in one bite, it grants temporary fortitude and boldness to its eater. For three rounds, it bolsters your armor class by +2, making you harder to hit in the heat of battle. However, for the duration, you become too focused on pressing your advantage; you cannot Dash or Disengage actions, leaving yourself more vulnerable to flanking attacks.

effectDetails.title: Armor Class Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, the Courage Shell grants +2 AC for 3 rounds. This effect ends immediately if you take any damage.

effectDetails.title: Limited Mobility
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the Armor Class boost, you are hindered from using Dash or Disengage actions. If you attempt to do so, you expend one use without gaining its benefit.

courage_shell.levelRequirementReason: This item provides a straightforward, immediate combat advantage suitable for low-level adventurers.
courage_shell.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post caters to travelers and offers various items that aid in their journeys, including quick fixes like the Courage Shell.
courage_shell.shippingDetail: Shipped within a sealed bottle to preserve its potency until consumption.

usage.duration: 3 rounds
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or attempt to Dash/Disengage actions

courage_shell.priceReason: Balanced as a common consumable, this item provides a short-term combat advantage at an affordable price.

courier_express.name: Courier Express (Cross-Continent)
courier_express.description: The Courier Express (Cross-Continent) guarantees swift and secure delivery of your most precious cargo across treacherous lands in just three days, a feat made possible by the guild's elite couriers and their legendary tabards that command safe passage through even the most hostile territories. For an additional fee, they can negotiate for fragile or dangerous goods, ensuring they reach their destination intact. Trust this service to traverse perilous terrain with unparalleled speed and security.

effectDetails.title: Guaranteed Delivery in Three Days
effectDetails.rules: This service ensures that a package up to 100 miles can be delivered within three days, with no exceptions. The courier will arrive at the destination precisely after this time frame.

effectDetails.title: Safe Passage Through Hostile Lands
effectDetails.rules: The guild's couriers are protected by their distinctive tabards, which grant safe passage through most lands. This protection extends to all packages delivered via this service.

courier_express.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to adventurers of any level who can afford the premium rates.
courier_express.vendorReason: The Merchant Guild provides this service due to its reputation for reliability and safety, ensuring that even the most valuable cargoes arrive intact.
courier_express.shippingDetail: Deliveries are handled by Swiftwind Express, known for their swift and reliable couriers. No delays or detours are permitted unless specified in exceptional circumstances.

usage.activation: Activate upon payment at any Merchant Guild outpost.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The delivery is completed or interrupted by the player's decision to halt it.

courier_express.priceReason: This service is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its speed and safety guarantees.

cracked_star_coin.name: Cracked Star Coin
cracked_star_coin.description: The Cracked Star Coin gleams faintly under starlight, its surface a patchwork of ancient fissures and celestial patterns. This relic is said to have been crafted from meteoric iron by an old star-faring civilization. When activated, it teleports the bearer to the nearest safe, starlit location within 30 feet. Using it under true night skies grants +1 Inspiration for the day, but with each use, its fragile crack widens until it shatters entirely.

effectDetails.title: Starlit Teleport
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the coin teleports the user to the nearest safe location with starlight within 30 feet. The duration is instantaneous and it has no save or range requirement. The coin can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Inspiration Boost
effectDetails.rules: If activated under true night skies, the coin grants +1 Inspiration to the user for the day. This effect has a 24-hour duration and may be used once per day when conditions are favorable.

cracked_star_coin.levelRequirementReason: The coin's magical properties are subtle but effective, making it accessible to lower-level adventurers.
cracked_star_coin.vendorReason: Starflea specializes in ancient and exotic relics, including this star-faring artifact.
cracked_star_coin.shippingDetail: The coin is carefully packed with a velvet pouch to protect it during shipment.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for teleport; 24 hours for Inspiration boost
usage.endsWhen: Coin shatters after one use under starlit skies or if the user teleports using the coin

cracked_star_coin.priceReason: The coin's rarity and unique properties justify this price point.

crash_bandicoot_aku.name: Aku Aku Mask
crash_bandicoot_aku.description: The Aku Aku Mask is a heavy, skull-like visage forged by ancient shamans for warriors who face death in battle. Its eyes glow faintly, and it whispers cryptic advice that can turn the tide of combat. Worn beneath one's helmet or as a standalone piece, this mask protects its wearer from a single fatal strike, absorbing the blow into its core. The mask floats just above the head, offering both protection and counsel in times of peril.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs a Death Blow
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from an attack that would reduce you to 0 hit points, the Aku Aku Mask absorbs this damage into its core. You are not reduced to 0 hit points and instead fall unconscious. The mask recharges one of its uses after a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Floating Companion
effectDetails.rules: The mask hovers just above your head, providing you with advice once per day as an action. This advice grants advantage on one ability check or saving throw until the end of your next turn. The mask can only provide advice in a language you know.

crash_bandicoot_aku.levelRequirementReason: The mask's protection is accessible to all, but its wisdom requires some understanding and connection with ancient lore.
crash_bandicoot_aku.vendorReason: Shamans of the region are known for their knowledge of ancient artifacts and spirits that can guide warriors into battle.
crash_bandicoot_aku.shippingDetail: The mask is shipped in a sturdy wooden crate lined with soft padding to ensure it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive protection; active advice given as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the death blow absorption, one day duration for advice.
usage.endsWhen: The mask is destroyed or its charges are exhausted.
usage.charges: 3 uses, recharging 1 use after a short rest

crash_bandicoot_aku.priceReason: The mask's rarity and the unique protection it offers justify its price in experience points.

cricket_jam.name: Cricket Jam
cricket_jam.description: Cricket Jam is a peculiar jar filled to the brim with an unsettlingly real imitation of crickets chirping. Each time you open this jar, a cacophony of high-pitched sounds erupts, drowning out any nearby conversation within a 15-foot radius for up to one minute. It's perfect for distracting guards or causing chaos in crowded markets. The jam itself is thick and dark, with the unmistakable texture of crickets rather than fruit, making it an eerie yet effective tool.

effectDetails.title: Loud Chirping Distraction
effectDetails.rules: When opened, Cricket Jam produces a piercing sound within a 15-foot radius for one minute. Any creature not immune to noise must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be distracted for the duration of the sound.

effectDetails.title: Effective Guard Distraction
effectDetails.rules: For every three successful uses, you can attempt to distract a guard within sight with this jam. The guard must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become distracted until their next action.

cricket_jam.levelRequirementReason: This item requires only basic concentration and is suitable for beginners.
cricket_jam.vendorReason: The Rogue Port Black Market specializes in unique and unusual items, making Cricket Jam a perfect fit.
cricket_jam.shippingDetail: Due to the noise it produces during shipment, Cricket Jam is packed with sound-dampening materials. Delivery can take up to one extra day beyond standard shipping times.

usage.duration: One minute or until used up
usage.endsWhen: The jam runs out or the sound fades naturally

cricket_jam.priceReason: While unusual, Cricket Jam is still a consumable item that can be reused multiple times.

crimision_isle_crimson_tattoo_premium.name: Crimision Isle Crimson Tattoo (Premium)
crimision_isle_crimson_tattoo_premium.description: The Crimision Isle Crimson Tattoo (Premium) is a glowing rune carved into your skin by the island's shamans. When darkness falls, it radiates with a dim light sufficient to illuminate a 10-foot radius, casting a warm crimson glow. However, during full moons, this tattoo becomes an itchy reminder of the night, giving you disadvantage on Concentration checks and saving throws. This premium edition enhances your minor fire resistance, absorbing 2d10 fire damage once per day.

effectDetails.title: Minor Fire Absorption
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action. Provides resistance to 2d10 fire damage once per day, which recharges after 8 hours of rest.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Glow
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that provides dim light in a 10-foot radius around you at night. The glow persists for the duration until you cover it with clothing or another item.

crimision_isle_crimson_tattoo_premium.levelRequirementReason: This tattoo requires significant magical and spiritual knowledge, appropriate only for those who have reached at least 6th level.
crimision_isle_crimson_tattoo_premium.vendorReason: The shamans of Crimision Isle are renowned for their intricate and powerful tattoos, which resonate with the island's fiery magic.
crimision_isle_crimson_tattoo_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered by enchanted scrolls that ensure the tattoo is properly transferred to your skin upon arrival.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate fire resistance or use moonlit glow.
usage.duration: Until covered, recharged after rest.
usage.endsWhen: Covered with clothing or other items, recharges after 8 hours of uninterrupted rest.

crimision_isle_crimson_tattoo_premium.priceReason: This premium tattoo is crafted by skilled shamans and requires extensive magical energy, making it a significant investment in terms of both time and resources.

crimision_isle_crimson_wrap.name: Crimision Isle Crimson Wrap
crimision_isle_crimson_wrap.description: The Crimision Isle Crimson Wrap is a blood-red shawl that hums with the essence of tropical island spirits. Woven from the fibers of ancient palm leaves and enchanted by the shamans of Crimision Isle, this wrap not only absorbs slashing damage but also grants you an edge in intimidating foes within its native lands. The shawl permanently tints any clothing it touches a deep crimson, a stain that never fades.

effectDetails.title: Slashing Absorption
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can absorb up to 1d6 slashing damage. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Tropical Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made in tropical environments. This ability is always active while you wear the wrap.

crimision_isle_crimson_wrap.levelRequirementReason: The shawl's enchantment is simple enough for even novice adventurers to wield effectively.
crimision_isle_crimson_wrap.vendorReason: The temple crafts this wrap as a symbol of their connection with the island spirits and its unique properties.
crimision_isle_crimson_wrap.shippingDetail: Ships via Coral Tie's swift boats, delivered within three days from Crimision Isle.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect is used or until the shawl is removed

crimision_isle_crimson_wrap.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP, this price reflects a simple enchantment suitable for novice adventurers.

crimision_isle_pearl.name: Crimision Isle Siren Pearl
crimision_isle_pearl.description: The Crimision Isle Siren Pearl glows a deep, iridescent crimson, its surface shimmering like breaking waves and humming with ancient ocean magic. Crafted by the enigmatic sirens of Crimision Isle, this pearl grants you and three companions the ability to breathe underwater for an hour at will, while also granting resistance against thunder damage. The sirens' essence courses through it, lending it a unique power that can only be wielded by the brave and the true-hearted.

effectDetails.title: Water Breathing
effectDetails.rules: The user and up to three others can breathe underwater for a duration of one hour. This effect is usable once per day.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Thunder Damage
effectDetails.rules: The bearer gains resistance to thunder damage until the start of their next turn. No saves are required, and this effect stacks with other forms of resistance.

crimision_isle_pearl.levelRequirementReason: Crafted by the sirens for those who venture into their treacherous waters, the Crimision Isle Siren Pearl requires a level 7 character to wield its power.
crimision_isle_pearl.vendorReason: As stewards of the island's secrets and treasures, the Crimision Dock can offer this rare and powerful artifact only to those who have proven their worth by visiting the perilous shores of Crimision Isle.
crimision_isle_pearl.shippingDetail: The pearl is packed in a specially designed water-filled box that ensures it arrives safely, though the delivery may take an extra day due to the fragile nature of its contents.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action to activate; usable once per day.
usage.duration: One hour when activated.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn if not reactivated within one hour.
usage.charges: Uses up one charge, recharging after a long rest.

crimision_isle_pearl.priceReason: Considering its epic rarity and unique properties, this pearl is priced fairly to reflect both its value and the difficulty in acquiring it.

crimision_isle_pearl_diving_kit.name: Crimision Isle Pearl Diving Kit
crimision_isle_pearl_diving_kit.description: The Crimision Isle Pearl Diving Kit is a compact, meticulously crafted ensemble of gear designed to navigate the treacherous depths of the ocean. Its gleaming brass and glass components are forged from the volcanic sands of the island itself, imbuing it with a fiery resilience that withstands even the deepest pressures. The kit includes a reinforced diving helmet adorned with red accents, a state-of-the-art air supply reservoir capable of sustaining a diver for an hour underwater, and a set of precision tools for harvesting pearls without damaging the reef ecosystems.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Diving Capabilities
effectDetails.rules: When worn with the Crimision Isle Pearl Diving Kit, you gain a +1 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks made to notice underwater details and a +2 bonus on Athletics checks for swimming. The helmet also provides resistance to non-magical piercing damage.

effectDetails.title: Sustained Breath
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour, you can breathe underwater as if submerged in shallow water. This effect does not grant the ability to hold your breath longer but allows you to stay under without using up air supply.

crimision_isle_pearl_diving_kit.levelRequirementReason: Beginners and adventurers of all levels find value in this kit, making it accessible for those just starting their exploration.
crimision_isle_pearl_diving_kit.vendorReason: Crimision Dock is renowned for its expertise in oceanic adventures and gear, making the Pearl Diving Kit a staple among their inventory.
crimision_isle_pearl_diving_kit.shippingDetail: The kit is delivered via Deepsea Express Courier, ensuring safe and timely arrival even to the most remote shores of Crimision Isle.

usage.activation: Wear the helmet and activate the air supply reservoir before submerging.
usage.duration: 1 hour from activation
usage.endsWhen: The air supply is depleted or you remove the helmet.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the air supply holds.

crimision_isle_pearl_diving_kit.priceReason: While not a high-end item, its unique craftsmanship and specialized features make it moderately priced for adventurers seeking to explore the ocean depths safely.

crimision_isle_pirate_bandana.name: Crimision Isle Pirate Bandana
crimision_isle_pirate_bandana.description: The Crimision Isle Pirate Bandana, woven from the fibers of seaweed and dyed deep crimson, is a relic of the seas. It smells of salt and rum, evoking tales of distant ports and daring deeds. Wearers gain advantage on Charisma checks with pirates and sailors but incur disadvantage when dealing with landlubbers, who are often baffled by its presence. Rum cravings are no match for this bandana; it quells the thirst, though you must still imbibe to fully satisfy.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Charisma Checks
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with pirates or sailors, you gain advantage on Charisma checks. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Checks with Landlubbers
effectDetails.rules: You incur disadvantage on Charisma checks when dealing with landlubbers who are unfamiliar with maritime life. The effect ends if you move at least 30 feet away from them.

crimision_isle_pirate_bandana.levelRequirementReason: This bandana is suitable for beginners to gain confidence in pirate territories.
crimision_isle_pirate_bandana.vendorReason: Crimision Isle Tailors are renowned for crafting items that blend functionality with nautical tradition.
crimision_isle_pirate_bandana.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift and loyal pirates, guaranteed to arrive within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the bandana.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after interacting with pirates or sailors.
usage.endsWhen: You move at least 30 feet away from landlubbers during a Charisma check.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is an inherent property of the item.

crimision_isle_pirate_bandana.priceReason: The bandana's uncommon rarity and utility justify its price, providing a significant advantage in pirate environments without being overpowered.

crimision_isle_recipe_rum_cake.name: Recipe: Crimision Isle Rum Cake
crimision_isle_recipe_rum_cake.description: This recipe yields a rum cake that is more than just sweet; it's an elixir of the deep. When consumed, it grants you +2 Charisma for the next hour, making your voice resonate like the sea itself. However, your coordination takes a hit: you'll move and react with disadvantage on Dexterity checks. This cake is a testament to Crimision Isle's legendary bakers who perfected the art of blending rum and pastry into an unparalleled treat.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume this cake to gain +2 Charisma for 1 hour. You can only use this effect once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Coordination Hinder
effectDetails.rules: For the same duration, you have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. This effect is limited to one use per day.

crimision_isle_recipe_rum_cake.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet potent recipe requires no specific level for consumption.
crimision_isle_recipe_rum_cake.vendorReason: Crimision Isle's bakers are renowned for their ability to craft magical and mundane delights that embody the island's spirit.
crimision_isle_recipe_rum_cake.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted pirate courier, ensuring the cake arrives fresh and intact from Crimision Isle.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you finish your next short rest or long rest

crimision_isle_recipe_rum_cake.priceReason: The refined craftsmanship and ingredients from Crimision Isle justify this balanced price.

crimision_isle_rum_barrel_ager.name: Crimision Isle Rum Barrel Ager
crimision_isle_rum_barrel_ager.description: This sturdy oak barrel, aged from Crimision Isle Distillers, holds any liquid and slowly transforms it over time. Each day, the contents mature into a richer, more potent nectar, increasing in alcohol content by 1% and enhancing its flavor profile. The barrel itself is an olfactory delight, releasing a heady aroma that makes you feel like a seasoned pirate. However, if left unattended for too long, it becomes restless, emitting a lonely creaking sound each night and causing you to suffer disadvantage on social interactions with officials.

effectDetails.title: Alcohol Infusion
effectDetails.rules: Activates daily as a bonus action. The liquid inside the barrel ages by one year, increasing its alcohol content by 1% and improving its flavor. This effect has no save DC but is limited to once per day.

effectDetails.title: Restless Aroma
effectDetails.rules: The barrel emits a creaking sound each night after three days of inactivity, causing the imbiber to suffer disadvantage on all social interactions with officials until it is used. This effect ends when the barrel is used again or destroyed.

crimision_isle_rum_barrel_ager.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can use this item for its simple activation and daily benefit.
crimision_isle_rum_barrel_ager.vendorReason: Crimision Isle Distillers are renowned for their unique aging techniques and this product is a testament to their expertise.
crimision_isle_rum_barrel_ager.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted pirates, ensuring the barrel arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect each day
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or used again after three days of inactivity

crimision_isle_rum_barrel_ager.priceReason: The item's rarity and daily benefit justify its price, providing a consistent and valuable enhancement.

crimision_isle_spice_mortar.name: Crimision Isle Spice Mortar
crimision_isle_spice_mortar.description: The Crimision Isle Spice Mortar is a sturdy stone mortar forged by the Isle Stonecarvers, hewn from the volcanic rock of Crimision Isle itself. Its pestle glows faintly with an inner heat as it grinds fiery spices into a fine powder. This ancient tool not only enhances the potency of any fire-based cooking by +1 duration but also grants advantage on all checks to resist or overcome heat-related effects.

effectDetails.title: Grindfire Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When using this mortar for fire-based cooking, the user gains advantage on checks to resist or overcome heat-related effects. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Heat Resistance
effectDetails.rules: This mortar can be used up to twice before its internal heat becomes too intense and requires a short rest to cool down fully, restoring it to normal function.

crimision_isle_spice_mortar.levelRequirementReason: Novice cooks and travelers benefit from this tool's unique properties without requiring advanced skills.
crimision_isle_spice_mortar.vendorReason: Crimision Isle Port is the primary trading hub for volcanic goods, including this island-forged mortar.
crimision_isle_spice_mortar.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Crimson Crush Crate, known for its timely and secure deliveries from Crimision Isle.

usage.activation: Bonus action to grind spices or use as a heat-resistant tool.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: After using it up to twice without a short rest, its internal heat becomes too intense.

crimision_isle_spice_mortar.priceReason: Balanced as the item's unique properties and rarity justify this fair value in XP.

crimision_isle_spicy_fish_stew_recipe.name: Recipe: Crimision Isle Spicy Fish Stew
crimision_isle_spicy_fish_stew_recipe.description: A treasured recipe from the fiery crimson waters of Crimision Isle, this spicy fish stew is a bold adventurer's treat. Its secret lies in the unique spices harvested from the island’s volcanic shores, which not only add flavor but also imbue the eater with fire resistance and improved combat prowess. This dish is more than just sustenance; it attracts the attention of sea spirits, offering minor luck to those who partake.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you consume this stew, you gain fire resistance until the end of your next short or long rest. This effect does not stack with other sources of fire resistance.

effectDetails.title: Combat Edge
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after consuming this stew, you have advantage on attack rolls made against creatures that are not immune to fire damage. This benefit ends if you take any fire damage.

crimision_isle_spicy_fish_stew_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for even the newest adventurers to prepare.
crimision_isle_spicy_fish_stew_recipe.vendorReason: The Isle Fisherfolk are known for their culinary expertise and the unique ingredients they gather from Crimision Isle’s waters.
crimision_isle_spicy_fish_stew_recipe.shippingDetail: The Scaly Stew Sheets deliver their packages swiftly but carefully, ensuring that the stew arrives hot and ready to be consumed.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest for Fire Resistance; until you take fire damage for Combat Edge
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally upon completion of their duration or if you take fire damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a one-time effect each time you consume the stew.

crimision_isle_spicy_fish_stew_recipe.priceReason: This recipe is moderately priced for its unique flavor and the special effects it provides to adventurers.

crimson_fleet_cutlass.name: Crimson Fleet Cutlass
crimson_fleet_cutlass.description: The Crimson Fleet Cutlass hums with a life of its own, its blade a deep crimson that seems to pulse with the heart of a pirate's treasure-laden ship. Crafted from meteoric iron and enchanted by ancient space sorcery, this cutlass thirsts for plunder and rewards its wielder with gold and fear. The ship's spirit within it whispers secrets of lost worlds when you brandish it in combat.
effects: Critical hit: Target drops 1d4 x 10 gp (or equivalent value trinkets)

effectDetails.title: Treasure Thirst
effectDetails.rules: When you make a successful critical hit with the Crimson Fleet Cutlass, the target must drop 1d4 × 10 gold pieces or its equivalent in valuable trinkets. If the target is an object, it breaks into two pieces of equal value.

effectDetails.title: Spirit's Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Intimidation checks when brandishing the cutlass in combat. The ship spirit within the blade enhances your presence and deters foes with its spectral aura.

crimson_fleet_cutlass.levelRequirementReason: The Crimson Fleet Cutlass is a rare find, but even novices can wield it to great effect.
crimson_fleet_cutlass.vendorReason: Crimson Fleet pirates are known for their eclectic and powerful gear, always seeking the next best tool for their ventures into space.
crimson_fleet_cutlass.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of swift courier ships, ensuring the cutlass arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Draw and attack as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on critical hit.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after 1 use per long rest.

crimson_fleet_cutlass.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item, the Crimson Fleet Cutlass offers unique treasure and fear effects that make it worth its price in XP.

crimson_fleet_letter_of_marque.name: Crimson Fleet Letter of Marque
crimson_fleet_letter_of_marque.description: The Crimson Fleet Letter of Marque is a tattered parchment that grants you legal authorization to seize enemy ships in the name of the Crimson Fleet. Crafted from the blood-drenched pages of ancient treaties, this document entitles its bearer to safe passage through Crimson Fleet-controlled waters and access to their vast naval resources. It also serves as a requisition slip for turning in captured goods, earning valuable fleet reputation points that can be exchanged for supplies or favors.

effectDetails.title: Legal Protection
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides you with immunity from legal action by the Crimson Fleet while attacking enemy ships. It lasts until the end of your next turn after use, and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Access to Resources
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, this document grants temporary access to Crimson Fleet ports and supplies for a duration of 1 hour per level of the user. This effect ends when you spend your next short or long rest.

crimson_fleet_letter_of_marque.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for experienced adventurers who can handle the responsibilities of managing captured goods and navigating fleet resources.
crimson_fleet_letter_of_marque.vendorReason: As a direct representative of the Crimson Fleet, they issue these letters to trusted allies and associates.
crimson_fleet_letter_of_marque.shippingDetail: The document is delivered by a trusted envoy who ensures its authenticity and that it reaches you in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with an effect lasting until the end of your next turn after use for Legal Protection; 1 hour per level for Access to Resources
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or you complete a short or long rest.

crimson_fleet_letter_of_marque.priceReason: This item is priced based on the value of fleet resources and legal immunity, offering significant utility for seasoned adventurers.

crimson_fleet_pirate_coat.name: Crimson Fleet Pirate Coat
crimson_fleet_pirate_coat.description: The Crimson Fleet Pirate Coat is a swashbuckling garment adorned in vivid scarlet, its hemline billowing dramatically as you move.
