data_merchant_smart_spatula.levelRequirementReason: This basic tool requires no specific character level to use its simple functionality.
data_merchant_smart_spatula.vendorReason: The Data Merchant Kitchenware is renowned for their innovative tools, and this smart spatula fits perfectly into their line of product offerings.
data_merchant_smart_spatula.shippingDetail: Ships via Data Stream's express courier service within the region.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use; requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: Until end of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish a meal or if the spatula malfunctions.

data_merchant_smart_spatula.priceReason: This smart spatula provides a useful advantage in cooking and tracking caloric intake, making it a valuable tool for those who frequently prepare meals and monitor their diet.

data_merchant_stat_reallocation.name: Data Merchant Stat Reallocation
data_merchant_stat_reallocation.description: The Data Merchant Stat Reallocation is a rare card-sized device, emblazoned with the logo of the Data Merchant Exchange. This compact tool allows you to reallocate points between your stats for a temporary boost. For 24 hours, you can shift two points from one ability score into another, but be warned: the process leaves you feeling as if you’ve just navigated through an endless loop of data overload and existential dread.

effectDetails.title: Stat Shifting
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Choose one ability score to lose two points from, then transfer those points to another score. The effects of this reallocation last for 24 hours. You cannot drop an ability score below 8 or exceed your maximum stat limit.

effectDetails.title: Post-Shift Malaise
effectDetails.rules: After the reallocation period ends, you suffer a temporary penalty: on the next ability check using any of the drained stats, you have disadvantage. This effect lasts until your next long rest.

data_merchant_stat_reallocation.levelRequirementReason: This device is accessible to those who are just beginning their journey but still require strategic planning and resource management.
data_merchant_stat_reallocation.vendorReason: The Data Merchant Exchange specializes in services that enhance one's abilities through unconventional means, making this tool a natural fit for their inventory.
data_merchant_stat_reallocation.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days with Quantum Courier Service ensuring secure and fast delivery.

usage.duration: 24 hours
usage.endsWhen: The reallocation period ends, or if your ability score drops below 8 due to the shift.

data_merchant_stat_reallocation.priceReason: This item strikes a balance by providing a strategic advantage while maintaining an accessible price point.

data_merchant_zipper_upgrade.name: Data Merchant Zipper Upgrade
data_merchant_zipper_upgrade.description: The Data Merchant Zipper Upgrade is a sleek, metallic fastener that holds vast amounts of data within its sturdy form. Crafted by the Data Merchant Tailors, these zippers are renowned for their durability and capacity to store up to 10 GB of information. To retrieve the stored data, you must make an Intelligence check (DC 14) as the zipper is known to occasionally jam when being opened, adding a layer of challenge.

effectDetails.title: Data Storage Capacity
effectDetails.rules: This upgrade can store up to 10 GB of data. Retrieving the information requires a successful Intelligence check (DC 14). Failing this check by more than 5 results in the zipper jamming, giving you disadvantage on your next attempt.

effectDetails.title: Intelligence Check Required
effectDetails.rules: To retrieve the stored data, make an Intelligence check. Failure by more than 5 causes the zipper to get stuck, adding a -2 penalty to future attempts until it is unstuck.

data_merchant_zipper_upgrade.levelRequirementReason: This upgrade is suitable for those who need basic data storage and retrieval capabilities.
data_merchant_zipper_upgrade.vendorReason: The Data Merchant Tailors are known for their innovative zippers that cater to the tech-savvy market, including adventurers who require secure data storage solutions.
data_merchant_zipper_upgrade.shippingDetail: Delivered via a high-speed Data Stream courier with a guaranteed delivery time of 24 hours.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon acquisition. Requires an Intelligence check to retrieve stored data.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; jamming effect applies until the zipper is unstuck.
usage.endsWhen: Unstuck by making another successful Intelligence check or when the item is destroyed.

data_merchant_zipper_upgrade.priceReason: The price reflects the advanced technology and secure storage capabilities provided by this upgrade.

death_permit.name: Permit to Kill Death
death_permit.description: The Permit to Kill Death is a cosmic artifact, a shimmering black slip of parchment that grants its bearer dominion over mortality itself. Once held, no creature can die, and you become the arbiter of life and death for all beings. The previous keeper crafted it with ancient runes and bound it to Final Delivery for safekeeping. Rumor has it, though, that once wielded, the Permit's power corrupts its bearer, turning them into Death itself.

effectDetails.title: Immortality Grant
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this permit bestows immortality on all creatures within a 100-foot radius. The effect is instantaneous and lasts until the next dawn. It does not save DC or require a check.

effectDetails.title: Death Control
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to gain control over death for a duration of one day. You can choose who dies within your domain, but this power corrupts you if used excessively. The effect is instantaneous and ends when the permit runs out of charges or upon destruction.

death_permit.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience and power can wield such a dangerous artifact without succumbing to its corruption.
death_permit.vendorReason: The Afterlife Management company holds the permit as it oversees all matters of mortality, making it their responsibility.
death_permit.shippingDetail: Shipped via Final Delivery's express service; delivery can take up to one week depending on location.

usage.activation: Activate by holding the permit and stating your intent aloud.
usage.duration: Instantaneous with a duration of one day per charge, or until destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Upon destruction, expiration of charges, or misuse leading to corruption.
usage.charges: Limited to 5 uses before requiring a full month's rest for recharging.

death_permit.priceReason: The permit's cosmic rarity and limited utility make it both expensive and valuable.

deity_farm_contract.name: Deity Farm Management Contract
deity_farm_contract.description: This ancient contract binds you to a divine farm where you grow minor gods for your personal and strategic advantage. The God Farmer crafted this unique deal, allowing you to harvest one minor god every month (which serves you faithfully for an entire year). You can also breed these gods with specific portfolios, such as war or love, ensuring they align perfectly with your needs. The farm's output is a testament to the contract’s divine origins.

effectDetails.title: Minor God Harvest
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each month, you can activate this contract to harvest one minor god. The god serves you for a year thereafter.

effectDetails.title: Portfolio Breeding
effectDetails.rules: You may designate a specific portfolio for breeding, ensuring your minor gods have particular divine traits and abilities.

deity_farm_contract.levelRequirementReason: This contract is simple enough to be used by any level 1 character who understands its power.
deity_farm_contract.vendorReason: Divine Agriculture specializes in divine items and contracts, including the Deity Farm Management Contract.
deity_farm_contract.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week by the swift Courier of the Celestial Post.

usage.activation: A bonus action at the start of each month to harvest a minor god. Portfolio breeding is an instantaneous action when you designate the portfolio.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for harvesting, continuous service from the harvested god until they are dismissed or replaced.
usage.endsWhen: The contract ends if all charges are expended (limited use per month), and it can be destroyed by a greater deity.
usage.charges: Monthly harvest is a one-time charge

deity_farm_contract.priceReason: This price reflects the minor divine powers and services provided, which are significant but not game-breaking.

demiplane_of_unlearning.name: Demiplane of Unlearning Access
demiplane_of_unlearning.description: The Demiplane of Unlearning Access is a compact, shimmering globe that opens to a pocket dimension where memories and spells are erased. Once within, you may choose one memory or spell to permanently vanish from your mind. With the right incantation and focus, this device can even nullify a curse with DM approval. Crafted by The Forgetful One, it is an artifact of immense power, entrusted only to those who have earned its trust.

effectDetails.title: Memory Erasure
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. Choose one memory or spell to be erased from your mind. The effect is instantaneous and permanent, with no save DC required.

effectDetails.title: Curse Nullification (DM Approval)
effectDetails.rules: Activate at the DM's discretion. Successfully nullify a curse affecting you by spending 1 charge. No save DC applies; this effect is purely magical in nature.

demiplane_of_unlearning.levelRequirementReason: Only those of considerable power and wisdom can handle such an artifact without risk.
demiplane_of_unlearning.vendorReason: Memory Eraser specializes in artifacts that deal with the mind, making them the perfect vendor for this item.
demiplane_of_unlearning.shippingDetail: Ships via Mind Wipe Express, ensuring secure and rapid delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use; recharges on a long rest

demiplane_of_unlearning.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's rarity and the risk involved in using such power.

demon_binding_contract.name: Demon Binding Contract
demon_binding_contract.description: The Demon Binding Contract, a tattered document encrusted with sigils of hellfire and blood, is a relic from the infernal realms. Its leather pages are imbued with the power to summon and bind a demon, ensuring its obedience for an entire year in exchange for your services or gold. However, should you fail to uphold your end of the bargain, the bound demon will hunt you through eternity, its wrath unquenchable.
effects: Summons and binds a demon (CR up to 10) for one year
Demon must obey all commands within the contract

effectDetails.title: Summon and Bind Demon
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, lasting for one year. The summoned demon is bound to obey your commands within the contract terms. If broken, the contract requires the summoner to make a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or be hunted by the demon indefinitely.

effectDetails.title: Demon Obedience
effectDetails.rules: The summoned demon must follow any command given within the terms of the contract. If disobeyed, the demon can act against you as an action on its turn until it is bound again or the contract ends. The contract requires payment in souls, gold, or future favors.

demon_binding_contract.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 13 to handle and negotiate with infernal entities.
demon_binding_contract.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand has exclusive access to such forbidden items, having connections with dark forces.
demon_binding_contract.shippingDetail: Delivery via a spectral courier that arrives within the week, but only on nights of the new moon.

usage.activation: Activates as an action; requires a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw to maintain the contract.
usage.duration: One year from activation
usage.endsWhen: The summoned demon is bound again or the contract term expires
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per month

demon_binding_contract.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it represents a significant risk and reward for both parties.

demonic_pact_enhancer.name: Demonic Pact Enhancer (Booster)
demonic_pact_enhancer.description: The Demonic Pact Enhancer (Booster) forges a more potent bond between mortal and fiend, doubling the pact's granted bonuses but at an ever-increasing price to your soul. Crafted by Pact Brokers from dark iron and demonic essence, this booster ensures you receive twice the power of your existing pact, yet it exacts a heavy toll on your spiritual reserves each use. Only those who can withstand the infernal bargain should consider wielding this item.

effectDetails.title: Doubled Pact Benefits
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The benefits of your pact are doubled for the duration. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn, after which you must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or suffer a penalty to all ability checks and attack rolls equal to half the value of the bonuses lost due to this effect.

effectDetails.title: Increased Soul Cost
effectDetails.rules: Each use of this item increases your soul's cost by an additional 50 XP. This increase is cumulative, meaning each subsequent use costs more than the last.

demonic_pact_enhancer.levelRequirementReason: Only those who can command a demon and have endured its terms for at least 4 levels should consider this booster.
demonic_pact_enhancer.vendorReason: Pact Brokers are the sole purveyors of deals with demons, and their boosters are sought by those willing to pay the price.
demonic_pact_enhancer.shippingDetail: Shipped via a courier who delivers in the dead of night, ensuring secrecy for those who do business with Pact Brokers.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn after activation or if you fail a Constitution saving throw.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use increases soul cost.

demonic_pact_enhancer.priceReason: Balanced as it offers significant power but comes with substantial risks and costs.

demonic_possession_ward.name: Demonic Possession Ward (Protective)
demonic_possession_ward.description: The Demonic Possession Ward, a shimmering shield of ethereal light, hangs like an unyielding sentinel around your neck. Crafted by Celestial Wardens from the purified essence of ancient holy relics, this talisman not only repels demonic forces but also emits a protective aura that wards off possession attempts within its 100-foot radius. Its presence alone can detect nearby malevolent entities, ensuring you remain safe in a world teeming with darkness.

effectDetails.title: Blocks Possession
effectDetails.rules: This ward emits an invisible barrier that repels demonic entities and prevents them from attempting possession. The ward remains active as long as the wearer is within its 100-foot radius, expiring when the item is removed or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Detects Demons
effectDetails.rules: The ward continuously scans a 100-foot radius for demonic presences. If any are detected, it emits a soft glow and alerts the wearer with a subtle hum. This effect does not require an action to activate or maintain.

demonic_possession_ward.levelRequirementReason: This powerful item requires significant magical prowess to wield effectively.
demonic_possession_ward.vendorReason: The Holy Order, known for their expertise in divine artifacts, is the sole vendor of this protective amulet.
demonic_possession_ward.shippingDetail: Ships via a dedicated Angelic Courier with expedited delivery within a week.

usage.duration: Indefinite, until removed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: When the item is taken off or broken

demonic_possession_ward.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and the significant magical energy required for its creation.

desert_sultanate_oasis_verification.name: Desert Sultanate Oasis Verification
desert_sultanate_oasis_verification.description: The Desert Sultanate Oasis Verification is a parchment stamped with the seal of the Sultanate, crafted from sandpaper and ink made from desert flora. This document not only verifies an oasis's existence but also ensures its safety for travelers. For seven days following verification, you gain advantage on Survival checks in deserts, and the verified oasis becomes your 'spot,' requiring a weekly visit to prevent homesickness—failure to do so could lead to dire consequences.

effectDetails.title: Verified Oasis: Safe Passage
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful verification, the oasis is guaranteed safe and functional for seven days. You gain advantage on Survival checks made in desert environments within a day of the verification.

effectDetails.title: Weekly Oasis Visit Requirement
effectDetails.rules: The verified oasis becomes your 'spot,' requiring you to visit it at least once per week or suffer from homesickness, which can affect your mental state and daily activities until you return. Failure to comply results in a -2 penalty on all checks involving Survival in desert environments.

desert_sultanate_oasis_verification.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to lower-level characters as it provides immediate utility without overwhelming power.
desert_sultanate_oasis_verification.vendorReason: The Desert Sultanate Surveyors are the only ones with the expertise and resources to verify oases accurately, ensuring travelers' safety and peace of mind.
desert_sultanate_oasis_verification.shippingDetail: Delivered via trusted Mirage Courier, known for its reliable service across desert terrains. The courier ensures timely delivery, even in harsh conditions.

usage.activation: Activate on demand by presenting the parchment to an oasis and requesting verification.
usage.duration: Seven days from activation.
usage.endsWhen: Upon expiration or if you fail to visit the verified oasis weekly.

desert_sultanate_oasis_verification.priceReason: The balanced price of 1000 XP reflects its utility and the expertise required for verification, making it a worthwhile investment.

desert_sultanate_oasis_verification_serv.name: Desert Sultanate Oasis Verification Service
desert_sultanate_oasis_verification_serv.description: The Desert Sultanate Oasis Verification Service is a meticulously crafted parchment that, when presented to an oasis, reveals its true nature with irrefutable proof. The Sultanate Surveyors' seal ensures you are not deceived by a mirage, and for seven days following the check, you gain advantage on saves against illusions. However, this service also leaves you wary; for the same duration, you become cynical, dealing a blow to your interactions with optimists who trust without question.

effectDetails.title: Oasis Verification
effectDetails.rules: Activate this service by presenting the parchment to an oasis. The DM provides details on its authenticity, and you gain advantage on saving throws against illusions for seven days.

effectDetails.title: Cynical Nature
effectDetails.rules: For seven days after using the service, you have disadvantage on Charisma checks and saves when dealing with optimists who trust easily. This effect is a reminder of the Sultanate Surveyors' skepticism.

desert_sultanate_oasis_verification_serv.levelRequirementReason: This service requires no special training but ensures users are equipped to handle the harsh realities of desert travel.
desert_sultanate_oasis_verification_serv.vendorReason: The Desert Sultanate is renowned for its expertise in navigating and ensuring travelers' safety through treacherous terrains, including mirage-prone oases.
desert_sultanate_oasis_verification_serv.shippingDetail: This service comes with a special delivery that ensures the parchment reaches you within two days of your order.

usage.duration: 7 days
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after 7 days or when used again, expending one charge.

desert_sultanate_oasis_verification_serv.priceReason: This service is priced at 1000 XP to reflect the Sultanate Surveyors' expertise and the potential dangers of desert travel.

desert_sultanate_sand_sifter_pot.name: Desert Sultanate Sand Sifter Pot
desert_sultanate_sand_sifter_pot.description: This ornate pot features a sifter base crafted from desert clay and inlaid with sandstone patterns. It is used to sift out sand from lentil soups, making them perfectly palatable for even the most discerning diners. The Sultanate Potters have honed its design to ensure it not only filters but also subtly enhances the flavor of desert dishes. Each use leaves a slight grit in the teeth, a small price paid for culinary perfection.

effectDetails.title: Desert Sifting
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use this pot to sift sand from ingredients. The pot has a +1 bonus to cooking checks related to desert dishes. This effect ends when the pot is used for another purpose.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Flavor
effectDetails.rules: When used in a soup preparation, this pot increases the flavor of the dish by 1 step on the quality of food table. The pot can only be used once per day.

desert_sultanate_sand_sifter_pot.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective tool is suitable for anyone who appreciates desert cuisine.
desert_sultanate_sand_sifter_pot.vendorReason: The Oasis is known for its expertise in all things desert, including the finest culinary tools.
desert_sultanate_sand_sifter_pot.shippingDetail: Delivered directly by trusted couriers, ensuring quick and reliable transport from the Sultanate Potters.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used for another purpose or at the end of your next turn

desert_sultanate_sand_sifter_pot.priceReason: The unique craftsmanship and desert-specific utility justify this fair price.

desert_sultanate_sand_silk_robe.name: Desert Sultanate Sand Silk Robe
desert_sultanate_sand_silk_robe.description: The Desert Sultanate Sand Silk Robe shifts like shifting dunes, its fabric a living tapestry of golden hues and subtle patterns that seem to move with the wind. Crafted by the Sultanate Silkers in an oasis hidden beneath the desert sands, this light robe not only offers a cool respite from the arid heat but also whispers secrets of the desert through the constant motion of its material. A true masterpiece of ancient weaving techniques, it cools the wearer to near-arctic levels and grants advantage on Stealth checks within sandy environments.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth
effectDetails.rules: When in a desert environment, the wearer gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Cooling Respite
effectDetails.rules: The robe provides a cool respite, reducing the wearer's temperature to near-arctic levels for up to 8 hours each day, after which it must be donned again. It has no effect if worn in non-desert environments.

desert_sultanate_sand_silk_robe.levelRequirementReason: This robe is designed for beginners and seasoned travelers alike, offering essential survival benefits in harsh desert conditions.
desert_sultanate_sand_silk_robe.vendorReason: The Desert Sultanate Oases are renowned for their mastery of sand silk weaving, making the shop a trusted source for such fine garments.
desert_sultanate_sand_silk_robe.shippingDetail: Ships via Dune Drape Express. Delivery can take up to one week due to harsh desert conditions.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the robe in a desert environment.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest or when removed from a desert environment.
usage.endsWhen: Removal from a desert environment for more than an hour, or at the start of your next long rest.

desert_sultanate_sand_silk_robe.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the craftsmanship and materials used in its construction, offering essential benefits without overshadowing other equipment.

desert_sultanate_sand_surf_board_premium.name: Desert Sultanate Sand Surf Board (Premium)
desert_sultanate_sand_surf_board_premium.description: The Desert Sultanate Sand Surf Board (Premium) is a finely crafted board made from the roots of ancient desert palm trees, imbued with the spirit of the winds that shaped the dunes. Glide effortlessly over shifting sands as if they were the ocean, leaving a trail of sand in your wake. This premium model comes with a custom leather harness and a protective case, ensuring it can be shipped securely to any corner of the desert realms.

effectDetails.title: Sand Surfing
effectDetails.rules: While on a sandy terrain, you gain a +20 foot speed bonus and can ignore difficult terrain. This effect lasts for the duration of your time in the desert until you exit it or exhaust its daily use.

effectDetails.title: Wind Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on saving throws against effects that would cause you to be blown away by strong winds, such as those from a sandstorm. This effect is permanent once activated and lasts for the duration of your time in the desert until you exit it.

desert_sultanate_sand_surf_board_premium.levelRequirementReason: The premium craftsmanship and the unique properties of this board make it suitable only for adventurers with at least 6 levels of experience.
desert_sultanate_sand_surf_board_premium.vendorReason: The Sultan Surfers are renowned for their expertise in desert travel, making them the perfect vendors for this premium sand surfboard.
desert_sultanate_sand_surf_board_premium.shippingDetail: This board is shipped via Desert Wind Express, ensuring safe and swift delivery through the treacherous dunes of the Sultanate.

usage.activation: As an action at the start of your turn while in a sandy environment.
usage.duration: Until you leave the desert or exhaust its daily use (1 hour).
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted, re-entering non-desert terrain, or after 1 hour.

desert_sultanate_sand_surf_board_premium.priceReason: This premium model is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique properties and the high craftsmanship involved in its creation.

desert_sultanate_silk_scarf.name: Desert Sultanate Silk Scarf
desert_sultanate_silk_scarf.description: A shimmering silk scarf woven from the finest threads of the Sultanate, this garment not only endures the desert's harshest heat but also reflects the sun’s fierce rays. The scarf is said to have been crafted under the watchful eyes of the desert spirits themselves, who imbued it with protective magic. It grants its wearer resistance to fire damage and allows them to hold their breath longer in dire circumstances.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fire
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this scarf, you have advantage on saving throws against fire damage. This effect is passive and always active while the scarf is worn.

effectDetails.title: Extended Breath Holding
effectDetails.rules: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour longer than normal when wearing the scarf. This benefit lasts until the end of your next long rest or until you remove the scarf.

desert_sultanate_silk_scarf.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted from desert silk and spirit magic, making it accessible to even low-level adventurers who venture into the harshest deserts.
desert_sultanate_silk_scarf.vendorReason: The Sultanate of Araby is known for its mastery of desert textiles and spiritual craftsmanship, ensuring that this scarf is both functional and imbued with protective magic.
desert_sultanate_silk_scarf.shippingDetail: Shipped by the trusted Camel Caravan, known for delivering goods across the harshest deserts safely and swiftly.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing; requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: Active as long as worn; ends when removed or at the end of a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Removal from wear or completion of a long rest.

desert_sultanate_silk_scarf.priceReason: Crafted with desert silk and infused with protective magic, this scarf strikes a balance by offering significant utility without being overpowered.

desert_sultanate_spiced_lentil_soup_reci.name: Recipe: Desert Sultanate Spiced Lentil Soup
desert_sultanate_spiced_lentil_soup_reci.description: This ancient recipe card bears the seal of the Desert Sultanate and is made from parchment imbued with the earthy scent of cumin. The soup, when prepared, not only heals the body but also fortifies the spirit in the harsh dunes. Consuming this spiced lentil soup grants you temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum +1) for 6 hours and allows you to ignore one instance of heat exhaustion per day. Only the Desert Cooks possess the knowledge to craft it, making it a rare culinary treasure.

effectDetails.title: Heat Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Eating this soup once per day allows you to ignore one instance of heat exhaustion. This effect lasts for a full day and can be used as long as you have at least 1 hit point.

effectDetails.title: Constitution Boost
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the soup, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum +1) for 6 hours. This effect is limited to once per day and has no save or range requirements.

desert_sultanate_spiced_lentil_soup_reci.levelRequirementReason: This recipe requires minimal skill to prepare but still provides significant benefits, making it accessible to all adventurers.
desert_sultanate_spiced_lentil_soup_reci.vendorReason: The Desert Sultanate's official oasis outpost is the only place where this rare and cherished culinary secret is shared with the world.
desert_sultanate_spiced_lentil_soup_reci.shippingDetail: This recipe is delivered via a scroll that also contains detailed instructions for preparation, ensuring authenticity and quality.

usage.duration: 6 hours or until consumed
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire after 6 hours of consumption

desert_sultanate_spiced_lentil_soup_reci.priceReason: This recipe is considered uncommon due to its origin, rarity, and the skill required to prepare it properly.

desert_traders_caravan_tea_kettle.name: Desert Traders Caravan Tea Kettle
desert_traders_caravan_tea_kettle.description: This intricately crafted kettle, made by the renowned Trader Tinsmiths, is a staple of desert caravans. Its dented sides tell tales of countless bumps from camels' backs. The kettle's whistling sound can be heard miles away, summoning travelers to share in its spicy tea. When used over an open flame, it boils water faster than any other vessel, and the aroma of the tea enhances your Persuasion skill by +1.

effectDetails.title: Boils Water Faster
effectDetails.rules: When used over a fire, this kettle boils water instantly. It does not expend charges or have a duration.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after drinking tea from this kettle, your Persuasion skill is enhanced by +1. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or the kettle is destroyed.

desert_traders_caravan_tea_kettle.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level to use, as it provides a simple and straightforward benefit.
desert_traders_caravan_tea_kettle.vendorReason: The Desert Traders Market sells this kettle because it's an essential tool for their caravans.
desert_traders_caravan_tea_kettle.shippingDetail: Ships in 2 days via express delivery service.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when placed over a fire and used to boil water.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for boiling, 1 minute after drinking tea.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends if you are incapacitated or the kettle is destroyed.

desert_traders_caravan_tea_kettle.priceReason: The price reflects its crafted quality and utility in desert environments.

desert_traders_dune_navigation.name: Desert Traders Dune Navigation
desert_traders_dune_navigation.description: The Desert Traders Dune Navigation is a finely crafted guide that allows you to interpret the shifting sands of the desert. With it, you gain unparalleled insight into the dunes' secrets, gaining advantage on Survival checks in deserts for up to 30 days. The core of the item hums with the ancient knowledge of the Desert Traders, who have honed their craft over centuries. However, constant exposure to sand means your eyes are perpetually irritated; you suffer a disadvantage on Perception checks until cleaned.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Survival (Deserts)
effectDetails.rules: Gain advantage on all Survival checks made to navigate or survive in desert terrain for up to 30 days. The item must be worn and activated once per day.

effectDetails.title: Perpetual Sand Irritation
effectDetails.rules: Suffer a disadvantage on all Perception checks until the next time you clean your eyes of sand, which can be done with a short rest or by washing the sand away.

desert_traders_dune_navigation.levelRequirementReason: This item aids beginners as well as seasoned travelers in desert environments.
desert_traders_dune_navigation.vendorReason: Desert Traders have refined their craft over centuries, making this guide an indispensable tool for all who travel the dunes.
desert_traders_dune_navigation.shippingDetail: Ships via Sandstorm Courier directly from the Desert Traders' headquarters. Delivery can take up to one week depending on desert conditions.

usage.activation: Activate once per day by wearing it in a desert environment.
usage.duration: Up to 30 days of advantage, with daily activation required.
usage.endsWhen: Advantage expires after 30 days or when the item is no longer worn in a desert.

desert_traders_dune_navigation.priceReason: The balance of price reflects its utility for beginners and seasoned travelers, providing advantage without being overpowered.

desert_traders_nomad_scarf.name: Desert Traders Nomad Scarf
desert_traders_nomad_scarf.description: The Desert Traders Nomad Scarf is a finely woven wool scarf, its threads dyed to shift hues with the desert light. Crafted by roving nomads who traverse endless dunes, it not only offers warmth but also protection against harsh winds and scorching sun. Its fibers are treated with oils that fade in direct sunlight, allowing it to blend into the surrounding sands effortlessly during the day while remaining a vibrant beacon of trade after dusk.

effectDetails.title: Survival Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When in a desert environment, you gain a +2 bonus to Survival checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sunlight Fade
effectDetails.rules: During daylight hours, the scarf's color changes and fades into the surrounding sands, providing an advantage on Stealth checks within 10 feet for 1 hour or until you leave a desert environment. This effect can be used once per day.

desert_traders_nomad_scarf.levelRequirementReason: The scarf is designed to aid travelers in harsh environments without requiring high-level proficiency.
desert_traders_nomad_scarf.vendorReason: Desert Traders Caravans are well-known for their expertise in crafting and trading goods essential for desert survival, including this iconic nomad scarf.
desert_traders_nomad_scarf.shippingDetail: Ships via the Sand Scarf Express Courier; delivery time is approximately one week depending on destination.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the scarf in a desert environment.
usage.duration: Until end of your next long rest for Survival Advantage; until you leave the desert or 1 hour for Sunlight Fade, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally when conditions change or after use limit is reached.

desert_traders_nomad_scarf.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides two beneficial passive abilities that enhance survival in desert environments without being overly powerful.

desert_traders_sand_grain_counting.name: Desert Traders Sand Grain Counting
desert_traders_sand_grain_counting.description: The Desert Traders Sand Grain Counting is a small, intricately crafted hourglass filled with shimmering sand. It’s not just an artifact; it’s a tool of precision and obsession. This hourglass grants you the ability to count every grain in a 10-foot cube with perfect accuracy, though its true power lies in granting advantage on Investigation checks related to sand or dust storms. Once you begin counting, nothing can distract you until the task is complete—your focus becomes so intense that it introduces disadvantage on all other checks unless you first count.

effectDetails.title: Counting Precision
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can focus on counting the grains of sand in a 10-foot cube. This action lasts until you have counted all the grains or are interrupted by an attack or spell that deals damage to you. You gain advantage on any Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to analyze sand or dust storms.

effectDetails.title: Obsession
effectDetails.rules: While counting, you are distracted and gain disadvantage on all other ability checks, saving throws, and attack rolls. This effect ends when the task is completed or if you are attacked by an enemy. You can only use this feature once per short rest.

desert_traders_sand_grain_counting.levelRequirementReason: The Sand Grain Counting requires basic focus and attention to detail.
desert_traders_sand_grain_counting.vendorReason: The Desert Traders are renowned for their precision in all matters of sand, making this tool one of their most valued creations.
desert_traders_sand_grain_counting.shippingDetail: Delivered by the fastest winds across the desert, ensuring it arrives safely and swiftly.

usage.duration: Until counted or interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Interrupted by an attack or spell dealing damage, task completion, or end of short rest

desert_traders_sand_grain_counting.priceReason: Balanced to provide a unique and focused utility without overshadowing other abilities.

desert_traders_spice_blend_premium.name: Desert Traders Spice Blend (Premium)
desert_traders_spice_blend_premium.description: The Desert Traders Spice Blend (Premium) is a finely ground mix of spices that ignites a traveler's spirit, enhancing their endurance and speed during arduous journeys across the desert sands. Crafted by seasoned caravan traders who have traversed these treacherous routes for centuries, this blend offers not just flavor but also a boost in one’s stamina, making even the longest trails feel shorter. For 8 hours after consumption, you ignore exhaustion levels, and your speed increases by +5 feet—though beware, as the heat of the spices can leave you sweating profusely, imposing disadvantage on Stealth checks.

effectDetails.title: Ignore Exhaustion
effectDetails.rules: Consume this spice blend to ignore one level of exhaustion for a duration of 8 hours. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: +5 Speed
effectDetails.rules: Your walking speed increases by 5 feet for the duration of the effects, starting immediately after you consume the spice blend. This benefit lasts until the end of your next long rest or until you take a short rest.

desert_traders_spice_blend_premium.levelRequirementReason: This spice is designed to enhance even novice travelers with its immediate benefits.
desert_traders_spice_blend_premium.vendorReason: Desert Traders Market is renowned for its unique and potent blends, making this premium spice a staple in their offerings.
desert_traders_spice_blend_premium.shippingDetail: Spices are delivered by camel caravan, ensuring freshness but with a 1-day delay due to the long journey across the desert.

usage.duration: 8 hours or until exhaustion is ignored
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next long rest or short rest

desert_traders_spice_blend_premium.priceReason: The blend's rarity and the expertise involved in its creation justify this balanced price.

desert_traders_spice_tea_recipe.name: Recipe: Desert Traders Spice Tea
desert_traders_spice_tea_recipe.description: This ancient, parchment-bound recipe for Desert Traders Spice Tea is handwritten by the caravan brewers themselves. The tea, when brewed and consumed, grants you an advantage on Persuasion checks to barter with merchants. Each sip infuses your voice with the wisdom of countless caravans, making you sound as if you've traded across deserts since time immemorial. This secret of the Desert Traders is a rare find in the spice markets of distant lands.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Persuasion Checks
effectDetails.rules: When you consume Desert Traders Spice Tea, you gain advantage on all Persuasion checks for bartering and trading within the next three hours. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Secret Spice Brew
effectDetails.rules: The recipe requires specific caravan spices and must be brewed over a warm fire for 15 minutes before consumption. The tea's flavor is as unique as its origin, making it a cherished item among traders.

desert_traders_spice_tea_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective trade secret can benefit even the lowest-level adventurers.
desert_traders_spice_tea_recipe.vendorReason: The Desert Traders Market is known for its rare and valuable recipes, as they are the creators of this legendary tea.
desert_traders_spice_tea_recipe.shippingDetail: Ships via a trusted scroll that ensures the spices remain fresh during transit.

usage.activation: Drink the brewed tea over a warm fire for 15 minutes.
usage.duration: 3 hours, once per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: After 3 hours or when you finish your next long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; requires brewing and consuming.

desert_traders_spice_tea_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's rarity and the specific caravan spices needed for its preparation justify this price.

deus_ex_machina_device.name: Deus Ex Machina Device
deus_ex_machina_device.description: The Deus Ex Machina Device hums with an otherworldly energy, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer like starlight. This relic is said to have been crafted by the gods themselves in a moment of divine whimsy. When activated, it calls forth a godly presence to solve your immediate problem, be it a dire battle or a catastrophic collapse. The device is lightweight yet resonates with power, its core glows faintly as if alive with celestial energy.

effectDetails.title: Godly Intervention
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the device summons a god to solve your immediate problem. The DM narrates the divine intervention, which is instant and complete, resolving the current challenge without any cost or consequence.

effectDetails.title: Instant Problem Solving
effectDetails.rules: The device expends one charge upon use. It can be recharged after a long rest. Only one use per session is allowed.

deus_ex_machina_device.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest problem might require divine assistance, but it should not come easily.
deus_ex_machina_device.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in items that bridge the mortal and celestial realms, making it only fitting for them to stock such a device.
deus_ex_machina_device.shippingDetail: The Miracle Delivery ensures swift and safe transport of the device within a day.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Upon completion or if the user retracts it before use

deus_ex_machina_device.priceReason: The device's rarity and divine origin justify its relatively modest price.

diamond_city_currency_exchange_bad_rates.name: Diamond City Currency Exchange (Bad Rates)
diamond_city_currency_exchange_bad_rates.description: The Diamond City Currency Exchange (Bad Rates) offers a dismally unfavorable exchange of any coinage for gold, providing only half its true value. The clerk's efficiency is so atrocious that you earn an indelible 'Sucker' stamp on your forehead, inflicting disadvantage on all Charisma checks and saves. Despite the poor deal, this service remains popular among tourists who are unaware of the steep loss they incur. Made by Diamond City Exchanges.
effects: Exchange any currency for gold at half its value
Earn a 'Sucker' stamp (disadvantage on Charisma checks and saves)

effectDetails.title: Currency Exchange
effectDetails.rules: When you use this service, you exchange any coinage for gold, receiving only half the amount of gold it is worth. This effect lasts until you complete your transaction.

effectDetails.title: Sucker Stamp
effectDetails.rules: You receive a permanent 'Sucker' stamp on your forehead, which imposes disadvantage on all Charisma checks and saves until removed by magic.

diamond_city_currency_exchange_bad_rates.levelRequirementReason: This item is available to level 1 characters as a common service in Diamond City.
diamond_city_currency_exchange_bad_rates.vendorReason: Diamond City Exchanges are known for their questionable practices, making them the go-to vendor for this less-than-reliable service.
diamond_city_currency_exchange_bad_rates.shippingDetail: The service is delivered swiftly by Vault Transfer within a day of booking.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when you complete your transaction at the exchange.
usage.duration: Until the transaction is completed.
usage.endsWhen: Upon completion of your exchange.

diamond_city_currency_exchange_bad_rates.priceReason: The service, though common, still requires a significant amount of XP due to its guaranteed loss and the permanent disadvantage it inflicts.

diamond_city_microtransaction_removal.name: Diamond City Microtransaction Removal
diamond_city_microtransaction_removal.description: The Diamond City Microtransaction Removal grants you a week of peace from digital interruptions, ensuring no one tries to sell you minor magical items during its duration. As a symbol of your regained tranquility, your bank account mysteriously decreases by 10%, reflecting the 'processing fee' for this service. This artifact is crafted in collaboration with the Diamond City Refund Dept., known for their meticulous attention to detail and customer satisfaction.

effectDetails.title: Week of Peace
effectDetails.rules: For a duration of seven days, you are immune to attempts by others to sell you minor magical items. This effect is passive and does not require any action from the user.

effectDetails.title: Processing Fee
effectDetails.rules: At the end of its duration, your bank account is reduced by 10% as a processing fee for this service. This effect occurs automatically and cannot be avoided or negated.

diamond_city_microtransaction_removal.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to all adventurers who seek peace from digital interruptions.
diamond_city_microtransaction_removal.vendorReason: Diamond City Refund Dept. is renowned for its reliability and expertise in handling such services.
diamond_city_microtransaction_removal.shippingDetail: The service is delivered immediately upon purchase, ensuring you start your week of peace right away.

usage.activation: Passive effect that begins the moment the item is purchased and lasts for seven days.
usage.duration: Seven days from the time of purchase.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of its duration or if the item is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, as it does not have a limited number of charges.

diamond_city_microtransaction_removal.priceReason: The price reflects the service's value in providing peace and quiet for one week without any recurring costs.

diamond_city_neon_glow_gummies_recipe.name: Recipe: Diamond City Neon Glow Gummies
diamond_city_neon_glow_gummies_recipe.description: Crafted by Diamond City Confectioners, these Neon Glow Gummies are a beacon of night-time fun. They radiate a vibrant neon light that illuminates the darkness like starlight on a moonless night. Each chewy treat is infused with secrets of the city's glowing architecture, making you feel as if you're walking through a living, breathing metropolis. Perfect for adventurers who need to navigate under cover of night without sacrificing their visibility.

effectDetails.title: Neon Light Vision
effectDetails.rules: Eating one Neon Glow Gummy grants you dim light vision for 1 hour. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Party Starter
effectDetails.rules: The gummies emit a soft, glowing light that can illuminate an area of 5 feet radius for the duration of the effect. Any creature within this area gains advantage on Stealth checks until the light fades.

diamond_city_neon_glow_gummies_recipe.levelRequirementReason: These Neon Glow Gummies are accessible to any adventurer, providing a simple and effective way to enhance visibility in dark environments.
diamond_city_neon_glow_gummies_recipe.vendorReason: Diamond City Club is known for its night-time activities and the gummies fit perfectly with their theme of vibrant nightlife.
diamond_city_neon_glow_gummies_recipe.shippingDetail: Ships via the Glow Gel Gazette, a delivery service that ensures your treats arrive fresh and glowing in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 1 hour per gummy consumed.
usage.endsWhen: The light fades or another gummy is consumed.
usage.charges: Unlimited; each gummy can be eaten once.

diamond_city_neon_glow_gummies_recipe.priceReason: The price reflects the unique crafting process and the rare ingredients used, making these gummies a valuable but not overpriced treat for adventurers.

diamond_city_neon_glow_jacket.name: Diamond City Neon Glow Jacket
diamond_city_neon_glow_jacket.description: The Diamond City Neon Glow Jacket exudes a dazzling array of neon hues that pulse in time with the city’s heartbeat, casting an unmistakable glow for up to fifty feet around you. Its vibrant lights not only illuminate dark alleyways but also serve as a beacon of confidence and intimidation. Crafted by the renowned City Neonists, this jacket is a testament to the fusion of urban design and magical innovation.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Glow
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action, this jacket grants a +2 bonus to your Charisma (Intimidation) checks. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Bright Light Aura
effectDetails.rules: The jacket provides a bright light in a 50-foot radius for as long as you wear it. This light is sufficient to illuminate and displace any darkness within its range, but the batteries powering the jacket drain after six hours of continuous use.

diamond_city_neon_glow_jacket.levelRequirementReason: The jacket's neon glow requires minimal magical energy, suitable for adventurers at all levels.
diamond_city_neon_glow_jacket.vendorReason: Diamond City Street is known for its vibrant nightlife and fashion, making it the perfect vendor for this city-inspired accessory.
diamond_city_neon_glow_jacket.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with an express delivery guarantee.

usage.duration: One minute per charge
usage.endsWhen: The light fades when you stop wearing the jacket, or after six hours of continuous use.

diamond_city_neon_glow_jacket.priceReason: This jacket balances its utility with a moderate price point that reflects its unique design and craftsmanship.

diamond_city_neon_heat_lamp.name: Diamond City Neon Heat Lamp
diamond_city_neon_heat_lamp.description: The Diamond City Neon Heat Lamp radiates a warm, pulsating glow that seems to dance in sync with the city's neon signs. This lamp is crafted from polished diamond and glass, making it shimmer under streetlights. It provides a steady heat for gummies, giving them an advantage on skill checks related to night city living. The lamp flickers like the iconic billboards, adding a vibrant touch to any setup.
effects: Advantage on Night City Skill Checks

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Night City Skill Checks
effectDetails.rules: When used in a night city environment (such as Diamond City), the user gains advantage on any skill check related to navigation, stealth, or survival. This effect lasts until the end of the user's next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Vibrant Neon Glow
effectDetails.rules: The lamp emits a vibrant neon glow that is both visually striking and functional for heating gummies. The glow can be adjusted to different colors, but doing so requires a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Manipulation) check.

diamond_city_neon_heat_lamp.levelRequirementReason: The lamp's design allows even novice adventurers to benefit from its warmth and neon glow.
diamond_city_neon_heat_lamp.vendorReason: Diamond City Club specializes in unique, city-themed gear that enhances the night life experience of adventurers.
diamond_city_neon_heat_lamp.shippingDetail: Ships via special courier with a delivery time reduced by one day due to its fragile nature.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activated upon use and remains active until the user's next long rest.
usage.duration: Until the end of the user's next long rest
usage.endsWhen: The lamp is turned off or the user completes a long rest.

diamond_city_neon_heat_lamp.priceReason: The lamp's diamond and glass construction, combined with its unique neon glow, justify this price point.

diamond_city_synthwave_vinyl_service.name: Diamond City Synthwave Vinyl Service
diamond_city_synthwave_vinyl_service.description: This sleek, diamond-encrusted vinyl record plays retro synthwave beats that seem to vibrate through your bones. Crafted by City DJs in Diamond City, it's a relic of the golden age of music with each scratch adding to its mystique and allure. Groove to these tunes for an hour, gaining advantage on Concentration checks and boosting your morale by +1, making you feel like you're part of the city’s vibrant nightlife.

effectDetails.title: Play: Advantage on Concentration
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this vinyl plays music for 1 hour, granting the listener advantage on all Concentration checks. The effect ends when the music stops.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: While listening to the music, your morale is increased by +1 until you finish a long rest or fall unconscious. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per day.

diamond_city_synthwave_vinyl_service.levelRequirementReason: This item's effects are beneficial but not overly powerful for any level.
diamond_city_synthwave_vinyl_service.vendorReason: The club is known for its unique music and would naturally stock items that enhance the listening experience.
diamond_city_synthwave_vinyl_service.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, with special care to ensure safe handling of delicate vinyl records.

usage.duration: 1 Hour
usage.endsWhen: Music stops or listener finishes a long rest

diamond_city_synthwave_vinyl_service.priceReason: Balanced at this price point, reflecting the item's unique design and vendor’s reputation.

dimensional_estate.name: Pocket Dimension Estate (100 Years)
dimensional_estate.description: The Pocket Dimension Estate (100 Years) is a wondrous device that opens a pocket-sized realm within your grasp. Crafted from enchanted crystal and bound by ancient magic, this estate stands as a castle or vault in defiance of space and time. Seasons change naturally inside the pocket dimension, offering you an eternal sanctuary free from external threats. You may invite up to three allies through its single portal key, ensuring your legacy remains safe for generations.

effectDetails.title: Sanctuary of Time
effectDetails.rules: The estate's internal time flows independently from the outside world. Seasons change naturally within, providing a perpetual sanctuary safe from external attacks and threats.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Storage
effectDetails.rules: The pocket dimension can hold an indefinite amount of items, ensuring your private storage is ever-enlarging to accommodate your growing needs.

dimensional_estate.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high level to manage the complex and powerful magic involved in creating such a realm.
dimensional_estate.vendorReason: Only the celestial merchants of the Exchange can afford and wield the resources needed to create and maintain this extraordinary device.
dimensional_estate.shippingDetail: The estate is delivered via a special portal, ensuring it arrives safely and intact.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation with the use of one portal key.
usage.duration: Permanent until lease expires or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Lease ends in 100 years; renewal possible.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; charges do not apply.

dimensional_estate.priceReason: The item's rarity and the magical complexity involved in creating such a realm justify its high price.

dimensional_storage_ring.name: Dimensional Storage Ring (Utility)
dimensional_storage_ring.description: The Dimensional Storage Ring feels like a simple band of tarnished brass, yet it is said to have been crafted by Spacefold Jewelers from ancient starlight and forgotten magic. This ring allows its wearer to access stored items instantly, as if they were right there in hand. The weight of the stored contents does not affect the ring's user, making it a favorite among explorers who need to keep their gear close but unburdened by excess weight.

effectDetails.title: Instant Access
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can instantly access any stored items within the ring's pocket dimension. The items remain in their original condition and are not affected by time spent inside the storage space.

effectDetails.title: Weightless
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this ring, the weight of all stored contents is negated. This effect does not affect the wearer’s movement or balance, but it cannot be used to support weights beyond 1000 lbs.

dimensional_storage_ring.levelRequirementReason: The magic within the ring requires a spellcaster of at least fifth level to wield its power effectively.
dimensional_storage_ring.vendorReason: Spacefold Jewelers are renowned for their masterpieces, and this ring is no exception; it is one of their most sought-after creations.
dimensional_storage_ring.shippingDetail: The ring is shipped via Pocket Void Express, ensuring safe transit through the dimensional pockets themselves.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the ring is removed or its storage capacity is exceeded.

dimensional_storage_ring.priceReason: Crafted from starlight and ancient magic, this ring's value far exceeds that of mere material worth.

dimentio_mask.name: Mask of the Pleaser
dimentio_mask.description: The Mask of the Pleaser, a grotesque visage of black and white fabric adorned with an eerie smile, warps reality at your whimsy. It feels like a joke to some, a tragedy to others, but all who wear it can't help but laugh at their own misfortune. The mask shifts your alignment to Chaotic Neutral for 1 hour, compelling you to act out of character, and grants the ability to create exploding boxes that deal 4d10 force damage on a failed save.
dimentio_mask.shippedBy: Delivered by shadowy messengers of the Underworld

effectDetails.title: Masked Misadventure
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Your alignment shifts to Chaotic Neutral for 1 hour, compelling you to act out of character. You have disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Folly
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Creates an exploding box within 5 feet that deals 4d10 force damage to all creatures in the area, including you. You must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take half the damage.

dimentio_mask.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 12th level to wield the Mask of the Pleaser effectively.
dimentio_mask.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand is known for its extensive collection of forbidden and powerful artifacts, making it a fitting vendor for such an item.
dimentio_mask.shippingDetail: Delivery is swift but cloaked in secrecy; arrive exactly when expected or not at all.

usage.activation: Bonus action to use either effect.
usage.duration: Masked Misadventure lasts for 1 hour. Explosive Folly has a range of 5 feet and an area of 5 feet radius, ends on a failed save.
usage.endsWhen: Masked Misadventure ends when the duration expires or you dismiss it as an action. Explosive Folly ends on a failed saving throw.

dimentio_mask.priceReason: The Mask of the Pleaser is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its powerful and unpredictable nature, as well as its alignment-altering effect.

displacer_beast_kitten.name: Displacer Beast Kitten
displacer_beast_kitten.description: This tiny feline, though partially trained and still wild at heart, is a Displacer Beast Kitten. It has 20 HP and an uncanny ability to phase through solid objects. However, its unpredictable nature can be both a blessing and a curse; it may fetch small items with surprising accuracy but will pounce on you if you approach it incorrectly. This kitten's loyalty is still in question, as it was bred by Questionable Breeders who emphasize 'partially-trained' above all else.

effectDetails.title: Phasing Companion
effectDetails.rules: The Displacer Beast Kitten has a 20% chance to phase through solid objects, providing temporary cover for its owner. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn or until it is targeted by an attack.

effectDetails.title: Petitioner of Small Items
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the kitten can attempt to fetch a small item within 30 feet. It returns the item with a 50% success rate, but if successful, you gain advantage on your next attack roll.

displacer_beast_kitten.levelRequirementReason: The Displacer Beast Kitten requires at least level 7 to handle its unpredictable and powerful nature.
displacer_beast_kitten.vendorReason: Exotic Pets Unlimited specializes in rare and exotic creatures, making it the go-to vendor for such a unique pet.
displacer_beast_kitten.shippingDetail: Ships via reinforced crate with special instructions from the breeder to ensure safe delivery.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action; once per short rest for fetching small items, and it phases as a reaction if attacked incorrectly.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or until targeted by an attack.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest or when attacked incorrectly.

displacer_beast_kitten.priceReason: The Displacer Beast Kitten is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare and powerful abilities as a partially-trained displacer beast.

divine_rank_purchase.name: Divine Rank Purchase (Rank 20)
divine_rank_purchase.description: The Divine Rank Purchase (Rank 20) transforms you into a celestial paragon, granting godhood without the usual trials. Crafted by The Divine Accountant, this offer is a one-time purchase that elevates your divine rank to the highest echelon of power. Once acquired, only other gods of equal or higher rank can challenge you. The deal is sealed with the signing of a contract that binds you to serve the cosmos for an indefinite period.
effects: Immunity to all attacks except those from Rank 20 gods

effectDetails.title: Divine Rank Ascension
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful purchase, you gain the title of Rank 20 and become a god. This effect is instantaneous and permanent.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Attacks
effectDetails.rules: You are immune to all attacks from lesser beings or entities unless countered by another divine being of equal or higher rank.

divine_rank_purchase.levelRequirementReason: Any character can purchase this item, but it requires a significant financial commitment.
divine_rank_purchase.vendorReason: The Divine Promotion service is known for its divine offerings and unique deals that elevate characters to higher planes of existence.
divine_rank_purchase.shippingDetail: The item is delivered via a celestial courier who ensures the contract's binding nature.

usage.duration: Permanent once activated
usage.endsWhen: None; effect persists indefinitely

divine_rank_purchase.priceReason: The price reflects the significant financial and divine resources required to achieve such a rank.

divine_right_to_rule_deed.name: Divine Right to Rule (All Planes)
divine_right_to_rule_deed.description: The Divine Right to Rule, a parchment of boundless authority, bears the seals and signatures of every deity across all planes. With this deed, you command the respect and obedience of all deities, their legions, and even lesser celestials. It is said that the ink within it flows from the very essence of the cosmos itself, and its power can rewrite divine law with a single stroke. Crafted by the Divine Council in ages past, this deed remains one of the most sought-after treasures in existence.

effectDetails.title: Deity Obedience
effectDetails.rules: You may command any deity to obey your direct orders. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action, but it cannot override a deity's fundamental alignment or moral principles.

effectDetails.title: Divine Law Rewriting
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can rewrite one line of divine law as it pertains to your domain. This requires a successful DC 25 Wisdom (Religion) check and the target must be within range for at least an hour. The effect is instantaneous but cannot change the fundamental nature or alignment of the divine law.

divine_right_to_rule_deed.levelRequirementReason: This item's power requires a high degree of spiritual understanding and discipline to wield effectively.
divine_right_to_rule_deed.vendorReason: The Divine Council itself oversees this vendor, ensuring only those worthy receive such a powerful artifact.
divine_right_to_rule_deed.shippingDetail: Ships via the Angelic Couriers; delivery time is approximately one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts until acted upon or countered by a deity's alignment principles
usage.endsWhen: Deity obedience ends when the command is fulfilled or negated, divine law rewriting ends after use

divine_right_to_rule_deed.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the immense power it represents, though it is far less than its true value.

divine_slaughter_blade.name: Divine Slaughter Blade
divine_slaughter_blade.description: The Divine Slaughter Blade, a weapon of unfathomable power, is said to have been forged in the heart of a god's wrath. This ancient blade cuts through divine essence like paper, and its touch can reduce even the mightiest deity to nothing but forgotten legend. Crafted by The First Murderer itself, this sword is a relic from the dawn of time, capable of severing the very threads that bind gods to their pantheons.

effectDetails.title: Weapon Mastery
effectDetails.rules: The Divine Slaughter Blade grants you a +10 bonus on attack and damage rolls. It deals 50d20 slashing damage to divine entities, bypassing all resistances and immunities.

effectDetails.title: Divine Deletion
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a divine entity with the Divine Slaughter Blade, it must make a DC 45 Wisdom saving throw. On failure, the target deity is reduced to nothing but forgotten legend, and all followers forget their god. This effect has no save or resistance.

divine_slaughter_blade.levelRequirementReason: Only those of sufficient power can wield such a fearsome weapon.
divine_slaughter_blade.vendorReason: The Divine Blacksmith is the only one who dares to forge and sell weapons that challenge the very pantheon.
divine_slaughter_blade.shippingDetail: Ships via the Blood Courier, known for its swift and deadly deliveries.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The target deity fails its saving throw or is destroyed

divine_slaughter_blade.priceReason: This weapon's price reflects its rarity and the immense power it represents.

dizzy_dial.name: Dizzy Dial
dizzy_dial.description: The Dizzy Dial is a spiraling disc of polished obsidian, etched with arcane runes that seem to pulse faintly in the dark. Said to have been crafted by ancient shamans, it spins slowly when agitated, emitting a disorienting hum that can make even the most steadfast warrior stagger and falter. A glance at this artifact is enough to send one reeling, causing confusion and dizziness for those who dare to look too long.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Confusion
effectDetails.rules: When the Dizzy Dial is activated by a creature's action, an enemy target within 5 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become confused for 1 minute. The confusion ends early if the target takes any damage or if another creature of its choice targets it with this effect.

effectDetails.title: Single Use
effectDetails.rules: The Dizzy Dial can only be used once before requiring repairs, which can take a week at a cost equal to half its original price. Repairs must be made by a shaman or someone proficient in alchemy.

dizzy_dial.levelRequirementReason: Beginners with some experience of the arcane might find this item useful for disrupting enemies, but it requires at least first-level spellcasting ability to wield effectively.
dizzy_dial.vendorReason: The Shamans' Hut specializes in items crafted by ancient shamans and those who study their traditions. The Dizzy Dial is a prime example of such craftsmanship.
dizzy_dial.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days, with a 10% discount for bulk orders.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the target takes damage or is targeted by another creature using this effect.
usage.endsWhen: The target takes any damage or is targeted again by an enemy using this effect.

dizzy_dial.priceReason: The Dizzy Dial's price reflects the rare materials used in its construction and the arcane knowledge required to create it.

dk_barrel.name: DK Barrel
dk_barrel.description: The DK Barrel, a weathered oak vessel adorned with runes of ancient magic, is said to have been crafted by the hands of the Great Apes themselves in their time of need. When uncorked, it releases a massive gorilla ally, its muscles bulging and fur bristling, ready to defend or assist. Legend has it that the barrel's contents are imbued with the essence of the primordial jungle, granting the gorilla a love for bananas greater than any other known creature’s.

effectDetails.title: Summons Gorilla Ally
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the DK Barrel summons a gorilla ally (CR 3) with 2d8 damage on its punches. The gorilla acts as an ally for 1 minute and loves bananas more than anything else.

effectDetails.title: Banana Love
effectDetails.rules: The summoned gorilla will instinctively seek out bananas, dropping all other tasks to find them if a banana is within sight or mentioned. This effect lasts until the gorilla is dismissed by its summoner or falls in combat.

dk_barrel.levelRequirementReason: The DK Barrel can be used by characters as low as level 1, but even the simplest of adventurers should have some experience.
dk_barrel.vendorReason: Shamans of the forest often carry this item, as it is a symbol of their connection with the primal world and a useful tool for those seeking powerful allies in the wild.
dk_barrel.shippingDetail: The DK Barrel arrives safely via a courier known for its quick delivery times, ensuring that adventurers can summon their gorilla ally without delay.

usage.activation: Action to uncork and activate the barrel.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until dismissed.
usage.endsWhen: The gorilla is dismissed by the summoner or falls in combat.
usage.charges: One-time use; requires rest to be re-summoned.

dk_barrel.priceReason: The DK Barrel is priced at 1,000 XP due to its rarity and the unique abilities it grants, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's inventory.

dk_barrel_backpack.name: DK Barrel Jetpack
dk_barrel_backpack.description: The DK Barrel Jetpack is a stout wooden cask strapped to your back, its surface weathered by countless launches. This explosive backpack lets you soar forward in a blinding flash of fire and smoke, leaving a trail of burning embers behind. The jetpack's fiery propulsion not only propels you but also ignites the ground beneath your path, causing enemies within 10 feet to take 2d6 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Should you fall or land in an inappropriate place, however, the backblast might leave you with a scorch mark and 1d6 fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Blazing Dash
effectDetails.rules: On your action during each short rest, you can activate the jetpack to dash in a straight line up to 120 feet. Any enemy within this area must make a Dexterity saving throw or be set on fire, taking 2d6 fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Ground Ignition
effectDetails.rules: As you land from the jetpack's propulsion, there is an immediate risk of igniting the ground. You and any creature within 10 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 fire damage.

dk_barrel_backpack.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to harness the explosive power safely.
dk_barrel_backpack.vendorReason: Valley Trading Post stocks rare and exotic items from all corners of the realm, including this unique piece of engineering.
dk_barrel_backpack.shippingDetail: Delivered via Barrel Roll Express; travel time depends on courier availability.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation and effect
usage.endsWhen: You fall, land in an inappropriate place, or run out of charges

dk_barrel_backpack.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the explosive power and limited uses.

dk_crew_airship_plans.name: DK Crew Airship Construction Plans
dk_crew_airship_plans.description: These meticulously crafted plans detail the construction of a formidable Kremling-style airship, capable of rapid maneuvers and devastating cannon fire. Built to exacting standards in the DK Crew’s secret shipyard, these schematics are both a marvel of engineering and a symbol of their unyielding craftsmanship. The resulting vessel is an imposing sight, with a sturdy hull designed for both speed and durability, making it a cornerstone of any airship fleet.

effectDetails.title: Constructible Airship
effectDetails.rules: The plans allow the construction of an AC 18, HP 300 airship with a speed of 60 feet. The vessel is equipped with cannons and can be crewed by a large team. Constructing this airship requires a massive shipyard and additional materials costing 200,000 gp.

effectDetails.title: Massive Shipyard Requirement
effectDetails.rules: The construction of the airship can only proceed in a shipyard with facilities capable of housing at least 100 crew members. This limitation ensures that only those with significant resources and space can undertake such an endeavor.

dk_crew_airship_plans.levelRequirementReason: Only experienced adventurers, with the necessary resources to support such a project, should be entrusted with these plans.
dk_crew_airship_plans.vendorReason: The DK Crew's Pitstop is the only place where these highly sensitive and valuable construction plans can be obtained.
dk_crew_airship_plans.shippingDetail: Ships via Blueprint Roll Courier, a reliable service that ensures secure delivery to your shipyard.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon completion of the airship.
usage.duration: Permanent once constructed.
usage.endsWhen: The airship is destroyed or dismantled.

dk_crew_airship_plans.priceReason: This price reflects the reduced value compared to constructing an entire airship, but still represents significant investment in terms of both time and resources.

dk_crew_banana_coin_counterfeit_kit.name: DK Crew Banana Coin Counterfeit Kit
dk_crew_banana_coin_counterfeit_kit.description: The DK Crew Banana Coin Counterfeit Kit is a mischievous contraption crafted by the unofficial mint, designed to fool monkeys and shopkeepers alike. With it, you can create up to 1d10 counterfeit banana coins that pass for real to non-intelligent creatures. The kit also grants temporary advantage on Deception checks when spending a fake coin among shopkeepers, but there's a risk—there’s a 50% chance the shopkeeper will notice and call guards. Monkeys, with their keen senses, immediately attack anyone using this kit, sensing the counterfeit quality.

effectDetails.title: Counterfeit Coins
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to create up to 1d10 banana coins that fool non-intelligent creatures. These coins last until the end of your next turn, after which they disintegrate.

effectDetails.title: Shopkeeper's Notice
effectDetails.rules: When you spend a counterfeit coin among shopkeepers, you gain advantage on the Deception check but have disadvantage on Charisma checks with that shopkeeper. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

dk_crew_banana_coin_counterfeit_kit.levelRequirementReason: This kit is designed for beginners and mischievous players who want to cause minor disruptions in their adventuring.
dk_crew_banana_coin_counterfeit_kit.vendorReason: DK Crew, being a notorious mint, has unofficially supplied this kit to those seeking to exploit the gullibility of less intelligent creatures or shopkeepers.
dk_crew_banana_coin_counterfeit_kit.shippingDetail: Shipped via Barrel Roll Delivery, known for its unpredictable but reliable service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous creation; lasts until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you take an action or rest

dk_crew_banana_coin_counterfeit_kit.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the kit's minor utility and limited effectiveness against intelligent creatures.

dk_crew_banana_financial_advice.name: DK Crew Banana-Based Financial Advice
dk_crew_banana_financial_advice.description: DK Crew’s Banana-Based Financial Advice is a peculiar leaflet that promises to turn your wealth into golden bananas for a week. When you follow its advice, you gain 2d10x10 gold pieces, but beware—your coins will shimmer with an unnatural banana hue. The document itself feels like parchment scrawled by a monkey’s hand, and the vendor claims it holds secrets of ancient financial wisdom. Be wary: after using this guide, you might find yourself leaping at every primate you encounter.

effectDetails.title: Banana-Gold Treasure
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation by reading the leaflet, you gain a treasure equivalent to 2d10x10 gold pieces. This effect lasts for 7 days and cannot be repeated within 30 days.

effectDetails.title: Primate Phobia
effectDetails.rules: You suffer from a mild phobia of monkeys that manifests as a -2 penalty on saving throws against being frightened by primate creatures or images. The effect persists until the end of your next long rest.

dk_crew_banana_financial_advice.levelRequirementReason: This advice is accessible to all who seek financial guidance, but only those with basic literacy can understand its cryptic messages.
dk_crew_banana_financial_advice.vendorReason: DK Crew Financial Advisors are known for their unconventional methods and unique services that cater to the whimsical desires of adventurers.
dk_crew_banana_financial_advice.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of coin-shaped mail chutes, ensuring timely delivery even in the most chaotic cities.

usage.activation: Reading the leaflet for at least one minute.
usage.duration: 7 days
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon expiration or if you use it again within 30 days.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once per month.

dk_crew_banana_financial_advice.priceReason: This service is priced at 1000 XP to reflect the unusual and potentially profitable nature of banana-themed investments.

dk_crew_banana_peel_grenades.name: DK Crew Banana Peel Grenades
dk_crew_banana_peel_grenades.description: DK Crew Banana Peel Grenades are classic slip hazards in throwable form.
