These grenades are made by Donkey Kong Plantation and can be found at DK Crew Supply, known for their quirky stock of products. When thrown, they create a 10-foot square slippery surface that lasts for 1 minute, sending even the most agile foes sprawling. For every three peels used consecutively, the DC to avoid falling increases from 13 to 15 and also inflicts 1d4 bludgeoning damage on those who fail.

effectDetails.title: Slippery Surface
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, these grenades create a 10-foot square slippery surface that lasts for 1 minute. Any creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. On their next turn, they can make another Dexterity save to avoid falling again.

effectDetails.title: Increased Difficulty
effectDetails.rules: Using three consecutive grenades increases the DC of the saving throw to 15 and deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage on a failed save. This effect stacks, but only if used consecutively; mixing them with other items does not combine their effects.

dk_crew_banana_peel_grenades.levelRequirementReason: These grenades are simple to use and effective even for beginners.
dk_crew_banana_peel_grenades.vendorReason: DK Crew Supply is known for its quirky, themed inventory that includes practical pranks suitable for any adventurer.
dk_crew_banana_peel_grenades.shippingDetail: Ships via Barrel Roll Delivery, known for their quick and reliable service across the island.

usage.duration: 1 minute per grenade used
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the time passes or a creature successfully saves against it
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one can be active at any given time

dk_crew_banana_peel_grenades.priceReason: Balanced as an uncommon item for its utility and theme, providing a fair value within the market.

dk_crew_banana_peel_recycling.name: DK Crew Banana Peel Recycling
dk_crew_banana_peel_recycling.description: DK Crew's Banana Peel Recycling is a small, eco-friendly box emblazoned with the DK Crew logo. When activated, it transforms ten discarded banana peels into one slippery trap that any creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. Additionally, you gain a +2 bonus to Nature checks and are accompanied by a troupe of mischievous monkeys who hinder your Stealth attempts, adding a +3 penalty.

effectDetails.title: Banana Slippery Trap
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this box creates one slippery trap that occupies a 5-foot cube. Any creature entering the affected area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. The effect lasts until triggered by another creature or until the next dawn.

effectDetails.title: Nature's Companion
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to Nature checks and are accompanied by a troupe of mischievous monkeys who hinder your Stealth attempts, adding a +3 penalty. This effect persists for 1 hour per day when you use this item.

dk_crew_banana_peel_recycling.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners to help them understand the basics of environmental responsibility and trap-making.
dk_crew_banana_peel_recycling.vendorReason: DK Crew Green Initiative specializes in promoting sustainable practices and eco-friendly solutions, making their Banana Peel Recycling a perfect fit for their product line.
dk_crew_banana_peel_recycling.shippingDetail: Ships via Compost Delivery within two game days. Ensure the recipient has a compostable container ready upon delivery.

usage.activation: Activate as an action to create a slippery trap or use passively for gaining the Nature's Companion benefit.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and duration-based (slippery trap lasts until triggered or dawn; Nature's Companion lasts 1 hour per day).
usage.endsWhen: The slippery trap is triggered by another creature or until the next dawn. The effect ends when you stop using it for the day.

dk_crew_banana_peel_recycling.priceReason: This item's price reflects its common rarity and utility, balancing environmental benefit with practical application.

dk_crew_banana_ripening_chamber.name: DK Crew Banana Ripening Chamber
dk_crew_banana_ripening_chamber.description: The DK Crew Banana Ripening Chamber is a gas-powered contraption that ripens bananas from green to perfect in mere minutes, its chamber filling with a misty vapor that accelerates fruit maturation. Crafted by the eccentric DK Crew Banana Science, this device not only quickens the ripening process but also imparts a distinct banana flavor to any fruit it touches. However, using it leaves you smelling like a ripe bunch for an hour, potentially compromising your stealth efforts when encountering curious monkeys.

effectDetails.title: Ripens Bananas Instantly
effectDetails.rules: Activation: As a bonus action, the chamber is activated. The target fruit ripens from green to perfect in one minute. This effect has no range or area and does not require saving throws. However, it can only be used once every 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Flavor Transfer
effectDetails.rules: Activation: As a bonus action, the chamber is used on any fruit. The fruit ripens instantly to perfect, but all other fruits in the immediate area gain a banana flavor for the next hour. This effect has no range or area and does not require saving throws.

dk_crew_banana_ripening_chamber.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for adventurers of any level who might need to quickly prepare food.
dk_crew_banana_ripening_chamber.vendorReason: The DK Crew Banana Science is renowned for its innovative fruit-maturing devices, making their chamber a staple in adventurer's gear.
dk_crew_banana_ripening_chamber.shippingDetail: Ships via Barrel Roll Delivery, known for its reliable and speedy deliveries across the realm.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; can only be used once per day.
usage.duration: Instantaneous ripening effect; flavor transfer lasts one hour.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or when the chamber is no longer in use.

dk_crew_banana_ripening_chamber.priceReason: The chamber provides a valuable service for adventurers, balancing its cost with the convenience and utility it offers without overpricing.

dk_crew_bananagun.name: DK Crew Banana Gun
dk_crew_bananagun.description: The DK Crew Banana Gun is a peculiar and deadly weapon forged from the hands of banana-loving jesters. It fires hardened, sticky banana peels that arc through the air with surprising accuracy, leaving targets drenched in banana slime. Made by The DK Crew, this unique firearm has an infinite supply of ammunition, requiring nothing more than small pieces of fruit for each shot, but beware—its banana-based projectiles are as slippery as they are sticky.

effectDetails.title: Slippery Banana Peels
effectDetails.rules: When the DK Crew Banana Gun is fired, a hardened banana peel arcs towards the target with a range of 30 feet. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone due to slipping on the banana peel. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Ammunition
effectDetails.rules: The Banana Gun requires no special ammunition, only small pieces of fruit for each shot. The supply is seemingly endless as long as fresh fruit is available nearby.

dk_crew_bananagun.levelRequirementReason: This weapon is designed to be versatile and accessible, suitable even for the newest adventurers.
dk_crew_bananagun.vendorReason: The DK Crew pitstop is known for its quirky and unusual wares, making it a perfect vendor for this banana-themed firearm.
dk_crew_bananagun.shippingDetail: Delivered via Fruit Crate Express, these shipments are subject to seasonal fruit availability, ensuring the Banana Gun's ammunition remains fresh and effective.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target makes a successful saving throw or at the end of their next turn.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as fruit is available

dk_crew_bananagun.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the weapon's unique design and the infinite ammo feature, making it a fair value for its versatility.

dk_crew_barrel_launcher.name: DK Crew Barrel Launcher
dk_crew_barrel_launcher.description: The DK Crew Barrel Launcher is a formidable weapon, a modified harpoon gun that fires heavy wooden barrels filled with grappling hooks and shrapnel. When fired, these barrels lash out with incredible force, capable of knocking enemies off their feet. The launcher is a testament to the craftsmanship of The DK Crew, whose reputation for innovation endures even after their mysterious disappearance. Each barrel must be manually retrieved post-firing, ensuring constant supply for this versatile weapon.

effectDetails.title: Heavy Grappling
effectDetails.rules: When the launcher is fired, a heavy wooden barrel filled with grappling hooks and shrapnel flies towards an enemy within 80 feet. The barrel deals 3d8 bludgeoning damage on hit (STR check DC 15 to avoid being knocked back). If the target fails their STR save, they are also knocked prone.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Ammo
effectDetails.rules: The launcher is stocked with an infinite supply of barrels. However, after each successful attack, a barrel must be manually retrieved from the battlefield by the wielder or another ally within 30 feet.

dk_crew_barrel_launcher.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires at least character level 1 to handle its potent mechanics and retrieve spent barrels.
dk_crew_barrel_launcher.vendorReason: The DK Crew Pitstop, a relic of the disbanded crew, still sells this iconic weapon as a tribute to their legacy.
dk_crew_barrel_launcher.shippingDetail: Ships via Salted Crate Express with expedited delivery and a 24-hour turnaround time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, recharges after a short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: On hit; barrels must be manually retrieved

dk_crew_barrel_launcher.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the weapon's unique mechanics and the challenge of retrieving spent ammunition.

dk_crew_island_fortification.name: DK Crew Jungle Island Fortification
dk_crew_island_fortification.description: The DK Crew Jungle Island Fortification is a masterfully crafted, heavily themed defensive structure that fortifies your chosen small island or base. Built from scavenged barrels, vines, and other jungle debris, this impromptu fortress rises with deadly traps and sturdy defenses, doubling the base's HP by 50 points. The DK Crew's signature Engineering Team ensures each trap is a work of art, designed to catch anything that dares cross its threshold.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Base
effectDetails.rules: This effect increases the base's hit points by 50, providing a robust defense against attackers. The fortification is permanent until destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Deadly Traps
effectDetails.rules: Three unique traps are permanently installed around the base (selected by the Dungeon Master). These traps trigger on contact and can immobilize or damage intruders, but do not deal lethal damage unless explicitly stated. The traps recharge daily.

dk_crew_island_fortification.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a player of at least level 10 to ensure they have the necessary resources and skill to manage its permanent installation.
dk_crew_island_fortification.vendorReason: The DK Crew's Pitstop is known for distributing unique Kremling-engineered items, making it the go-to vendor for this fortification.
dk_crew_island_fortification.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Engineering Team; installation takes two weeks during which the base must be secured and free of intruders.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon purchase; permanent once installed.
usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or dismantled.
usage.endsWhen: Destruction or dismantlement by the owner.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a weekly maintenance check.

dk_crew_island_fortification.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP due to its permanent installation and thematic design, balancing its unique benefits against other legendary items.

dk_crew_jungle_assault_vehicle.name: DK Crew Jungle Assault Vehicle (Modified Mine Cart)
dk_crew_jungle_assault_vehicle.description: The DK Crew Jungle Assault Vehicle (Modified Mine Cart) is a formidable, heavily armored cart forged from jungle timber and steel, propelling through the dense undergrowth on twin cannons and netting systems. Its cannons unleash searing fire in a wide arc, capable of devastating hordes of enemies. Crafted by the infamous DK Crew, this vehicle is a veritable fortress on wheels, designed to tear through any jungle ambush with ruthless efficiency.

effectDetails.title: Twin Cannons
effectDetails.rules: The user may activate the twin cannons as a bonus action. This attack deals 2d10 Fire damage in an area of 15 feet, and it has a range of 60 feet. The attack is considered magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance. The vehicle can make this attack three times before requiring a day to recharge.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Netting
effectDetails.rules: The user may deploy the netting as an action, creating a 15-foot diameter net that restrains any creature within its area for 1 minute. The DC of this saving throw is equal to 8 + the user's proficiency bonus + their Strength modifier. The vehicle can use this ability once per short or long rest.

dk_crew_jungle_assault_vehicle.levelRequirementReason: The DK Crew Jungle Assault Vehicle requires a high level due to its advanced design and powerful capabilities.
dk_crew_jungle_assault_vehicle.vendorReason: The DK Crew's own pitstop ensures that their signature vehicle is only sold to those who have proven their worth.
dk_crew_jungle_assault_vehicle.shippingDetail: Ships via a specialized rail system within the jungle, ensuring safe and swift delivery. Transit times are reduced by half with this method.

usage.activation: Bonus action for cannons; action to deploy netting
usage.duration: Instantaneous (cannons); 1 minute (netting)
usage.endsWhen: Charges run out or user chooses to end the effect
usage.charges: 3 uses per day, recharged after a long rest

dk_crew_jungle_assault_vehicle.priceReason: The vehicle's legendary rarity and powerful abilities justify its moderate price in experience points.

dk_crew_king_k_id.name: King K. Rool ID Card (Forged)
dk_crew_king_k_id.description: The King K. Rool ID Card (Forged) is a meticulously crafted fake, bearing the emblem of Kremling Castle and the crest of the Koopa Troop. Its holographic security features shimmer with a false authenticity when held up to light, granting access to restricted facilities within three major Kremling strongholds. However, a single glance from a keen-eyed guard can reveal its counterfeit nature, triggering an immediate 50% chance that it will be flagged as fake and confiscated.

effectDetails.title: Access to Kremling Strongholds
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the ID Card grants temporary access to restricted areas within three major Kremling strongholds. The card remains active for a duration of one hour from the moment it is first used.

effectDetails.title: 50% Chance of Detection
effectDetails.rules: Upon being scrutinized by an alert guard, there is a 50% chance that the ID Card will be recognized as counterfeit. If detected, the card is confiscated and rendered useless for one week.

dk_crew_king_k_id.levelRequirementReason: The card's complexity and forgery require basic knowledge of Kremling technology.
dk_crew_king_k_id.vendorReason: The DK Crew, as rebels against the Kremlings, have access to stolen Kremling materials for crafting such items.
dk_crew_king_k_id.shippingDetail: Delivered via a secret courier, ensuring that the card arrives safely but without drawing undue attention.

usage.activation: Uses an action to activate and present the ID Card at checkpoints or security stations.
usage.duration: One hour from first use.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires after one hour, or if detected by Kremling authorities.

dk_crew_king_k_id.priceReason: Crafted with stolen materials and expertise in forgery, the ID Card offers significant risk for its user but remains a valuable tool for infiltrating enemy strongholds.

dk_crew_kraken_tamer.name: DK Crew Kraken Tamer (Service)
dk_crew_kraken_tamer.description: The DK Crew Kraken Tamer is a rare artifact of immense power, forged from the bones and scales of ancient krakens. This taming service binds one colossal or greater kraken to servitude for five years, ensuring its loyalty through an endless supply of tribute—vast quantities of fish and other seaborne offerings. The tamer gains a naval asset of unparalleled strength, capable of turning the tide in any sea battle.

effectDetails.title: Colossal Kraken Bound
effectDetails.rules: Activates upon successful taming by a crew. The kraken is bound to serve for five years, remaining loyal and powerful until the service ends or the kraken escapes. It can be summoned once per day as an action within 1 mile of its designated servitude area.

effectDetails.title: Endless Tribute Requirement
effectDetails.rules: The tamed kraken requires a steady supply of tribute, typically 500 pounds of fish and other seaborne goods daily. Failure to provide this sustenance results in the kraken's immediate escape or rebellion within one week.

dk_crew_kraken_tamer.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant experience and resources to manage such a powerful creature.
dk_crew_kraken_tamer.vendorReason: The DK Crew, masters of the seas, are the only ones capable of taming such formidable beasts.
dk_crew_kraken_tamer.shippingDetail: Ships within a week, but requires escort to ensure the kraken remains calm and unharmed during transport.

usage.activation: Summon as an action within one mile of its servitude area.
usage.duration: Bound for five years or until escaped or rebelled.
usage.endsWhen: Service ends, escapes, or rebels due to lack of tribute.

dk_crew_kraken_tamer.priceReason: Balanced as a rare and powerful service that requires significant resources for upkeep and management.

dk_crew_pirate_king_alliance.name: DK Crew Pirate King Alliance
dk_crew_pirate_king_alliance.description: The DK Crew Pirate King Alliance is a tattered, leather-bound treaty that grants its bearer access to the formidable fleet of the main Pirate King. Held together by brass rivets and adorned with the emblem of the skull and crossbones, this document entitles the holder to commandeer five warships for a single large-scale operation. The loyalty of the crew is maintained through regular payments in grog or plunder, ensuring swift and loyal service during critical missions.

effectDetails.title: Access to Fleet
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Grants temporary control of five warships for one large operation lasting up to 8 hours. The ships are under the command of loyal crews, and any damage they sustain during this time must be repaired by the bearer or a willing ally within 24 hours; otherwise, the ships drift aimlessly until repairs are completed.

effectDetails.title: Crew Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: The crew remains loyal for 1 day after each mission. Failure to pay within this period results in a -2 penalty on all rolls involving the fleet until payment is made. Regular payments of grog or loot ensure the ships remain at your command.

dk_crew_pirate_king_alliance.levelRequirementReason: The complex negotiations and strategic planning required make this item suitable for characters with significant experience.
dk_crew_pirate_king_alliance.vendorReason: As a trusted member of the DK Crew, they maintain close ties with the Pirate King's fleet and can broker such important alliances.
dk_crew_pirate_king_alliance.shippingDetail: The treaty is delivered via secure diplomatic vessel, ensuring it arrives intact. The delivery time is approximately one week depending on current sea routes and weather conditions.

usage.activation: Activates as an action for a single large operation.
usage.duration: 1 day of fleet command.
usage.endsWhen: The mission ends or the ships are damaged beyond repair.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use requires regular crew payments.

dk_crew_pirate_king_alliance.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its significant value in diplomatic and strategic importance without being overly powerful.

dk_crew_pirate_king_summons.name: DK Crew Pirate King Summons
dk_crew_pirate_king_summons.description: A gleaming brass flare adorned with a pirate flag, this DK Crew Pirate King Summons is no ordinary signal. When activated, it sends an urgent call to the legendary Pirate King and his flagship, the Black Heart. The King arrives within moments, accompanied by his crew of 100 fearsome pirates—each a formidable force (CR 1/2). The service lasts for one hour, during which time the King demands a significant share of any treasure or spoils found. Failure to comply may result in dire consequences.

effectDetails.title: Pirate King and Crew Arrive
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a bonus action. The Pirate King arrives with his flagship and 100 pirates, each CR 1/2. They are immediately available to assist in combat or exploration for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Loot Share Expectation
effectDetails.rules: The Pirate King expects a significant share of any treasure or spoils found during the service period. Failure to comply may result in the King leaving and potential conflict with his crew.

dk_crew_pirate_king_summons.levelRequirementReason: A level 16 character can handle the demands and chaos brought by the Pirate King's arrival.
dk_crew_pirate_king_summons.vendorReason: The DK Crew Pitstop specializes in unique and powerful items crafted by their own members, including this summons.
dk_crew_pirate_king_summons.shippingDetail: Ships immediately via Royal Flare; delivery is swift but may require a small escort due to the flare's importance.

usage.duration: 1 Hour
usage.endsWhen: Upon the expiration of one hour or if the Pirate King leaves early due to non-compliance with his demands.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharged after a long rest.

dk_crew_pirate_king_summons.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the summoning's utility and the Pirate King’s formidable presence in gameplay.

dk_crew_pirate_ship_lease.name: DK Crew Pirate Ship Lease (Monthly)
dk_crew_pirate_ship_lease.description: Rent a fearsome pirate galleon, forged from the bones of ancient ships and tempered in the fires of forgotten battles. This vessel sails under the DK Crew’s black flag, boasting cannons that can level coastal fortifications and a crew whose loyalty is as volatile as the sea itself. The ship is yours for 30 days, but beware—mutiny looms if you fail to maintain high morale among its swashbuckling crew.

effectDetails.title: Nautical Dominance
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with naval weapons. This effect lasts for the duration of your control over the ship, up to 30 days.

effectDetails.title: Mutinous Crew
effectDetails.rules: If you fail to maintain at least 15 morale points among the crew members each day, they may attempt a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a success, they declare open mutiny and may attack any non-crew member within reach.

dk_crew_pirate_ship_lease.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to effectively command such a powerful vessel.
dk_crew_pirate_ship_lease.vendorReason: The DK Crew maintains this pitstop for their own and others’ convenience, ensuring fast access to maritime power.
dk_crew_pirate_ship_lease.shippingDetail: Ships are delivered with a two-day turnaround, courtesy of the Signed Manifest's reliable couriers.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon lease, lasts for the duration of your control over the ship.
usage.duration: 30 days from the start date
usage.endsWhen: Lease expires or you lose command of the vessel
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the lease is active

dk_crew_pirate_ship_lease.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant but not overpowered nautical advantage for a moderate cost.

dk_crew_recipe_banana_cream_pie.name: Recipe: DK Crew Banana Cream Pie
dk_crew_recipe_banana_cream_pie.description: The DK Crew Banana Cream Pie is a pie that's also a projectile, crafted from the finest bananas and cream by Donkey Kong Bakery itself. When thrown, it explodes in a shower of sticky, banana-flavored cream that blinds any unfortunate target for one round. Alternatively, if you eat this pie, its creamy goodness will heal you for 1d6 hit points, but don't forget to shout 'Banana Slamma!' for maximum effect.
effects: Pie can be thrown as a weapon: 1d4 bludgeoning + target is blinded for 1 round

effectDetails.title: Blinding Cream Bombardment
effectDetails.rules: When the pie is thrown, the target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1 round. On a successful save, the target is only stunned.

effectDetails.title: Healing Delight
effectDetails.rules: Eating the pie restores 1d6 hit points to the eater. This effect can only occur once per day and requires no action.

dk_crew_recipe_banana_cream_pie.levelRequirementReason: This pie is widely available, making it accessible for any player level.
dk_crew_recipe_banana_cream_pie.vendorReason: DK Crew Bakery is known for its unique culinary creations that can be used in combat or as a snack.
dk_crew_recipe_banana_cream_pie.shippingDetail: Ships via Donkey Kong's famous barrel roll delivery, which may take longer due to the pie’s fragile nature.

usage.activation: Throwing: as an action; Eating: no action required
usage.duration: Blinding effect lasts for 1 round (6 turns); Healing is instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Blindness ends when the saving throw succeeds or after one round; No limit on eating it again

dk_crew_recipe_banana_cream_pie.priceReason: Balanced to ensure that players can afford this pie without breaking the game's economy.

dk_crew_rocket_barrel.name: DK Crew Rocket Barrel
dk_crew_rocket_barrel.description: The DK Crew Rocket Barrel is a stout wooden barrel with a rudimentary rocket engine strapped to its side. Crafted by the unorthodox but resourceful DK Crew, this device serves as both an area denial tool and a fearsome projectile weapon. When thrown, it ignites with a roar, exploding in 1 round (6d6 Fire damage within 15 feet) before disintegrating into harmless debris that deals 2d6 piercing damage to any creatures caught in the blast radius.

effectDetails.title: Rocket Blast
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, this barrel ignites and explodes after 1 round. It deals 6d6 Fire damage in a 15-foot radius around its point of landing. The explosion has a range of 30 feet. There is no save for this effect.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Debris
effectDetails.rules: After the initial blast, debris from the barrel deals 2d6 piercing damage to any creature within 15 feet of the explosion's center. This effect has a range of 30 feet and lasts until all debris dissipates.

dk_crew_rocket_barrel.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for lower-level adventuring parties, providing them with a versatile weapon to clear areas.
dk_crew_rocket_barrel.vendorReason: The DK Crew pitstop specializes in unique and unconventional gear, including this explosive barrel.
dk_crew_rocket_barrel.shippingDetail: Ships via Barrel Delivery service within 24 hours. A specialized courier ensures the safe transport of this volatile cargo.

usage.activation: Action to throw; the barrel explodes after 1 round.
usage.duration: Instantaneous explosion, lasting until all debris dissipates.
usage.endsWhen: The explosion completes and all debris has dispersed.

dk_crew_rocket_barrel.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique design, explosive capabilities, and the DK Crew's reputation for crafting unusual but effective tools.

dk_crew_rum_supply.name: DK Crew Premium Barrel of Rum
dk_crew_rum_supply.description: The DK Crew Premium Barrel of Rum is a formidable vessel crafted from seasoned oak and filled with 10 gallons of fiery, high-proof rum. It's said to be blessed by the spirits themselves, inspiring warriors into a berserk state that can only be quelled by time or exhaustion. Sipping this potent brew grants you immunity to fear and a +2 bonus to Strength for an hour, but it also leaves you vulnerable to WIS saves with disadvantage.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to the fear effect of spells and other magical abilities. This lasts for one hour after consuming a dose from this barrel.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: For an hour, you gain a +2 bonus to Strength. However, while under its effects, you suffer disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

dk_crew_rum_supply.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for adventurers of all levels but especially useful as a morale booster in dire situations.
dk_crew_rum_supply.vendorReason: The DK Crew Pitstop stocks this rum to keep their patrons' spirits high and their resolve strong during long journeys and battles.
dk_crew_rum_supply.shippingDetail: Delivered via a trusty Wooden Barrel Courier, ensuring the barrel arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Consume one dose by drinking from the barrel.
usage.duration: One hour per dose consumed.
usage.endsWhen: Upon completion of its duration or when exhausted.
usage.charges: Unlimited doses within a single barrel.

dk_crew_rum_supply.priceReason: The rum's potent effects and rarity justify a fair price, making it an excellent addition to any adventurer's inventory for morale-boosting purposes.

dk_crew_secret_island_lease.name: DK Crew Secret Island Hideout Lease (1 Year)
dk_crew_secret_island_lease.description: Lease a fully stocked, hidden jungle island perfect for contraband storage or training, cloaked from prying eyes by an ancient spell woven into the very trees and rocks. The island is self-sustaining, with its own water supply and lush gardens that bloom in cycles of your choosing. A small, self-sustaining Kremling maintenance crew ensures the island remains a fortress of secrecy for one year, ready to be used as you see fit.

effectDetails.title: Untraceable Location
effectDetails.rules: The island is hidden by an ancient spell that renders it undetectable to all means of scrying and magical sensing. It can only be accessed through a specific, known entrance point.

effectDetails.title: Self-Sustaining Maintenance
effectDetails.rules: Each week, the Kremling crew provides one maintenance check, ensuring the island remains in pristine condition. Failure to maintain it risks the spell weakening or the island's resources depleting.

dk_crew_secret_island_lease.levelRequirementReason: This lease requires a player of at least level 12 to ensure they have the experience and skills necessary to manage such a powerful asset.
dk_crew_secret_island_lease.vendorReason: The DK Crew, known for their hidden operations, naturally offers this exclusive opportunity to their trusted members.
dk_crew_secret_island_lease.shippingDetail: The island is delivered by Naval Drop, with a delay of one week due to the need for special handling and concealment.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon payment, providing immediate access to the island.
usage.duration: One year from activation, renewable at the same price.
usage.endsWhen: The lease expires or is destroyed by a successful dispel magic spell.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; once activated, it remains in effect until expiration.

dk_crew_secret_island_lease.priceReason: The reduced price of 1000 XP reflects the item's balanced power and rarity, ensuring it is a viable but not overpowered option for players of the specified level.

dk_crew_smuggling_route.name: DK Crew Smuggling Route (Exclusive)
dk_crew_smuggling_route.description: The DK Crew Smuggling Route is a clandestine maritime passage that slices through treacherous, non-magical waters, undetected by any naval blockade. This exclusive route ensures a single cargo shipment per month traverses safely, bypassing the prying eyes of coast guards and pirates alike. The DK Crew's expertise in navigation guarantees your vessel reaches its destination unscathed, making this route invaluable for those who dare to trade in forbidden goods.

effectDetails.title: Guaranteed Safe Passage
effectDetails.rules: Activate once per month to grant a single cargo shipment safe passage through the route. The shipment is immune to any effects that would delay or disrupt it, including spells and other hazards.

effectDetails.title: Bypass Naval Blockades
effectDetails.rules: The route allows ships to bypass all naval blockades for its duration without detection. Any attempts by authorities to intercept the shipment fail automatically.

dk_crew_smuggling_route.levelRequirementReason: Requires a high-level character to manage and utilize this secretive route effectively.
dk_crew_smuggling_route.vendorReason: The DK Crew maintains tight control over their smuggling operations, ensuring only trusted clients can purchase this service.
dk_crew_smuggling_route.shippingDetail: Ships are transported securely and discreetly, with a 5% chance of detection by coast guards if not activated within the first week after purchase.

usage.activation: Activate as an action at the start of your turn once per month.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting until the end of the cargo shipment's journey.
usage.endsWhen: The shipment completes its voyage or if the route is exposed by authorities.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per month.

dk_crew_smuggling_route.priceReason: Reflects the high cost of maintaining such a secretive and reliable smuggling route over time.

dk_crew_volcanic_island_base.name: DK Crew Volcanic Island Base
dk_crew_volcanic_island_base.description: Perched precariously on the flank of a dormant volcano, the DK Crew Volcanic Island Base is an impenetrable fortress carved from stone and magma. Its walls are lined with ancient traps that have claimed many an invader's life, while its core draws power directly from the earth itself to defend against sea and air assaults. The fortress erupts once a month, spewing forth molten rock and ash in a fiery display of nature's wrath.

effectDetails.title: Volcanic Defense Mechanism
effectDetails.rules: Once per month, the fortress erupts, expelling a barrage of molten rock and ash in a 60-foot radius around the base. Creatures within or entering this area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone by the fiery blast. The eruption deals 3d12 fire damage to all creatures in contact with the fortress and those within the blast radius.

effectDetails.title: Permanent Fortification
effectDetails.rules: The fortress has an AC of 25 against sea and air assaults, requiring a DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check to identify its hidden entrances. It is constructed from volcanic obsidian and reinforced with ancient runes that enhance its defensive capabilities.

dk_crew_volcanic_island_base.levelRequirementReason: The fortress's traps and defenses are too complex for a lower-level party, necessitating at least level 14 characters to manage the challenges.
dk_crew_volcanic_island_base.vendorReason: The DK Crew is known for their daring exploits and the Volcanic Island Base is one of their most impressive creations.
dk_crew_volcanic_island_base.shippingDetail: Navigating through treacherous waters to deliver this fortress requires a specialized fleet, leading to a longer delivery time and higher shipping costs.

usage.duration: Permanent (with monthly eruption)
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or the core is permanently disabled by a successful DC 25 Conventional Damage roll.

dk_crew_volcanic_island_base.priceReason: The Volcanic Island Base's construction and unique defenses make it an expensive yet valuable asset for any adventuring party.

dk_crew_volcanic_pass.name: DK Crew Volcanic Pass
dk_crew_volcanic_pass.description: The DK Crew Volcanic Pass is a weathered parchment, its edges charred by volcanic heat and ink that glows faintly in darkness. This ancient map not only ensures safe passage through treacherous Kremling-controlled territories but also grants the traveler immunity to non-magical fire damage for 48 hours. With each step, the pass seems to hum with a quiet authority, as if it were forged from the very heart of a volcano itself.
effects: Safe passage through one hostile volcanic territory

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Non-Magical Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: The user gains immunity to all non-magical fire damage for a duration of 48 hours upon activation. This effect ends when the user leaves the designated volcanic territory or if the user takes any magical damage.

effectDetails.title: Safe Passage Through Volcanic Territory
effectDetails.rules: Upon use, the DK Crew Volcanic Pass ensures safe travel through a hostile volcanic region controlled by Kremlings. The pass works only once and is consumed upon successful passage.

dk_crew_volcanic_pass.levelRequirementReason: This level requirement ensures that only seasoned adventurers with considerable experience can safely use the DK Crew Volcanic Pass.
dk_crew_volcanic_pass.vendorReason: The DK Crew, known for their daring expeditions through dangerous territories, naturally supply this invaluable pass to their clients at their pitstops.
dk_crew_volcanic_pass.shippingDetail: Ships within 24 hours of purchase; arrives via express courier ensuring it reaches the recipient safely and intact.

usage.activation: As a standard action, activate by unfolding the map and walking through the territory.
usage.duration: 48 hours from activation
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the designated volcanic territory or taking magical damage

dk_crew_volcanic_pass.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its unique and critical utility in navigating through hostile volcanic regions.

dk_crew_wario_barrel_helmet.name: DK Crew Wario Barrel Helmet
dk_crew_wario_barrel_helmet.description: The DK Crew Wario Barrel Helmet is a barrel adorned with Wario's mischievous face, forged from sturdy oak and painted with vibrant banana and garlic scents. When you wear it, your AC increases by +1 due to the helmet's solid construction, but you lose the ability to hear clearly—each round you must make a Perception check with disadvantage. Rolling down hills is as easy as pie; as a bonus action, you can slide down inclines at 20 feet per turn until you reach the bottom, where you are left prone.

effectDetails.title: Armor Bonus (+1 AC)
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your AC when wearing this helmet. This effect is always active as long as the helmet is on your head.

effectDetails.title: Perception Check Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the helmet, you have disadvantage on Perception checks. This lasts until the end of each round during which the helmet remains on your head.

dk_crew_wario_barrel_helmet.levelRequirementReason: This helmet is designed for beginners and adventurers just starting their journey.
dk_crew_wario_barrel_helmet.vendorReason: DK Crew specializes in quirky, custom-made gear that fits every adventurer's needs, especially those who enjoy a touch of the absurd.
dk_crew_wario_barrel_helmet.shippingDetail: Ships via Barrel Roll Delivery. Expect delivery by banana boat within 3-5 days from the nearest Wario-coordinated port.

usage.activation: Passive effect; always active as long as worn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, ongoing while worn.
usage.endsWhen: The helmet is removed or destroyed.

dk_crew_wario_barrel_helmet.priceReason: This helmet balances the unique abilities it provides with a price that reflects its quirky craftsmanship and custom design.

dk_crew_wario_tie.name: DK Crew Wario Tie
dk_crew_wario_tie.description: The DK Crew Wario Tie is a peculiar accessory, its fabric emblazoned with a series of mischievous grins that seem to waggle and leer at you. This tie isn't just for show; it's designed by the eccentric DK Crew, known for their playful yet practical formal wear. Wear it to gain advantage on Charisma checks involving Wario-themed activities, but beware—it also brings disadvantage in social interactions with anyone not a fan of the green plumber. The tie is a symbol of both style and strife, as its short length can cause you to appear comically awkward if not worn properly.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Advantage: Wario
effectDetails.rules: When wearing the DK Crew Wario Tie, you gain advantage on Charisma checks related to activities involving Wario or his antics. This effect is active as long as you are wearing the tie.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Social Checks
effectDetails.rules: If someone present does not share your affinity for Wario, you must make a check with disadvantage on Charisma checks. This penalty persists until the end of the encounter or until you remove the tie.

dk_crew_wario_tie.levelRequirementReason: This accessory is designed to be accessible and fun for all adventurers, regardless of their level.
dk_crew_wario_tie.vendorReason: DK Crew specializes in quirky and functional formal wear, making the DK Crew Wario Tie a natural addition to their line.
dk_crew_wario_tie.shippingDetail: Ships via Barrel Roll Delivery within 3 days of purchase. Orders under 10 items are expedited.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation is not required for the effects to take place.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing while worn
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the tie is removed or at the end of an encounter

dk_crew_wario_tie.priceReason: The DK Crew Wario Tie offers a unique blend of functionality and whimsy, making it a fun addition to any adventurer's wardrobe without being overpriced.

dk_isles_ancient_mirror_piece.name: Ancient Mirror Piece
dk_isles_ancient_mirror_piece.description: This shard of the ancient mirror, hewn from the shattered temple of the Jungle Oracle, reflects not just the user’s true form but also reveals hidden enemy weaknesses. When held in both hands, it grants a fleeting glimpse into an opponent's vulnerabilities, allowing for strategic advantage in combat. The user gains a 10% chance to dodge the next attack made against them, and this shard reflects their essence so vividly that even the most skilled foes find themselves momentarily disoriented.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Weakness Revealed
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard reflects the user's true form and reveals a hidden weakness of an adjacent hostile creature for up to 5 seconds. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) or be temporarily disoriented, reducing their effective AC by 2 until the start of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Increased Dodging Chance
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of this effect, the user gains a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws and has a 10% chance to dodge the next attack made against them. This benefit lasts until the start of their next turn or if they are hit by an attack.

dk_isles_ancient_mirror_piece.levelRequirementReason: The shard's mystical properties require a certain level of spiritual understanding and discipline.
dk_isles_ancient_mirror_piece.vendorReason: The DK Isles is known for its extensive collection of ancient artifacts, including relics from the Jungle Oracle’s temple.
dk_isles_ancient_mirror_piece.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Express, ensuring swift delivery with minimal risk of damage.

usage.duration: 5 seconds or until an adjacent hostile creature takes an action
usage.endsWhen: The start of the next turn for the user or if they are hit by an attack
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

dk_isles_ancient_mirror_piece.priceReason: The shard's mystical properties and rarity justify its moderate price in terms of XP.

dk_isles_ancient_sword.name: The Whispering Blade of the Jungle
dk_isles_ancient_sword.description: The Whispering Blade of the Jungle, forged in the heart of a primordial jungle, hums with the spirits of ancient warriors. Its etched runes shimmer with the echoes of past battles, dealing extra damage to foes who stand their ground, and occasionally sending them reeling into unconsciousness. The blade's whispers can be both a weapon and a shield, as its critical hits unleash a surge that amplifies your prowess in combat.
effects: 10% chance to stun an enemy for one round on hit

effectDetails.title: Stunning Blow
effectDetails.rules: When you score a critical hit with the Whispering Blade, there is a 10% chance that the target will be stunned for one round. The save DC to resist this effect is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Strikes
effectDetails.rules: The blade deals an additional 25% damage against enemies with high defense, such as those wearing heavy armor or wielding strong shields. This effect is not cumulative with other sources of extra damage.

dk_isles_ancient_sword.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires a minimum level to wield effectively due to its mystical properties and the strength needed to control it.
dk_isles_ancient_sword.vendorReason: The Whispering Blade is a symbol of power and heritage in the Dk Isles, and only those who have proven their worth are entrusted with such a weapon.
dk_isles_ancient_sword.shippingDetail: Due to its mystical nature, the blade must be shipped via Boo Spectral Mail, which ensures safe delivery through enchanted means.

usage.activation: The weapon is activated on your attack action and deals its effects based on the roll of the dice.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon a successful hit; ends when the weapon is sheathed or lost in combat.
usage.endsWhen: The blade's effects cease either when it is sheathed, broken in battle, or when you lose possession of it during combat.

dk_isles_ancient_sword.priceReason: The Whispering Blade is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique enchantments and the materials used in its forging.

dk_isles_banana_bane.name: Banana Bane
dk_isles_banana_bane.description: Banana Bane is a withered fruit weapon, its once vibrant skin now cracked and blackened by malevolent magic. Crafted from a rogueport banana hoard, it whispers of ancient curses and forbidden lore. When bitten, it unleashes a burst of entropy that disorients enemies for 3 turns, leaving them reeling in confusion. The fruit is said to have been stolen by the Cosmic Jester cult from the sacred grove of the jungle's first king.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Burst
effectDetails.rules: When activated, Banana Bane releases a burst of entropy that disorients the target creature for 3 turns. The effect ends if the target moves or takes any action. No save is allowed against this effect.

effectDetails.title: Piercing Bite
effectDetails.rules: Banana Bane deals 1d6 piercing damage and has a 20% chance to cause temporary disorientation on hit, which lasts for an additional 1 turn if successful. The user regains 10 HP upon consuming the fruit.

dk_isles_banana_bane.levelRequirementReason: Banana Bane is crafted to be accessible to low-level adventurers who might find themselves in situations where such a cursed tool could prove useful.
dk_isles_banana_bane.vendorReason: The DK Isles are known for their exotic and cursed items, making Banana Bane a fitting addition to their wares.
dk_isles_banana_bane.shippingDetail: Shipping takes an additional day due to the fruit's fragile state, but it is carefully packed in enchanted banana leaves.

usage.activation: Eating and activating Banana Bane requires a bonus action.
usage.duration: 3 turns for disorientation effect; instantaneous damage dealt.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the target moves or takes an action, or when the fruit is consumed.

dk_isles_banana_bane.priceReason: Banana Bane's rare origin, magical properties, and utility justify its high price in the DK Isles market.

dk_isles_banana_blood_satchel.name: Banana Blood Satchel
dk_isles_banana_blood_satchel.description: The Banana Blood Satchel was once a humble fruit vendor’s bag, now drenched in the blood of a rogue Wario who met his demise over a love affair with a banana peel. It glows faintly and emits a sweet hum that quickens nearby bananas' growth to dangerous speeds, making them ripe for the picking. The satchel's touch can trigger a banana peel explosion, adding chaos to any encounter. Consuming it grants stealthy prowess while auto-attaching itself to your weapon, enhancing your speed temporarily.

effectDetails.title: Banana Hoard Boost
effectDetails.rules: Increases the capacity of banana hoards by 25% for 1 hour. This effect ends if you sell more than 10 bananas in a day or if the satchel is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Aura
effectDetails.rules: Grants +2 to Stealth checks as long as it remains unopened and on your person. Ends when consumed, destroyed, or lost.

dk_isles_banana_blood_satchel.levelRequirementReason: This item is common but provides a useful boost for beginners.
dk_isles_banana_blood_satchel.vendorReason: The Kremling Krew frequently trades in items with their cursed history and abilities.
dk_isles_banana_blood_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via special courier, ensuring the Banana Blood Satchel arrives safely to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Passive effect when carried; consumed by eating it.
usage.duration: Active while on person and unopened; ends upon consumption or destruction.
usage.endsWhen: Consumed, destroyed, or lost.

dk_isles_banana_blood_satchel.priceReason: The Banana Blood Satchel combines a useful utility with an element of danger, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition.

dk_isles_banana_bomb_core.name: Banana Bomb Core
dk_isles_banana_bomb_core.description: The Banana Bomb Core is a golden, pulsating fruit core harvested from the mutated fireflower groves of the DK Isles. Embedded in any explosive device or weapon, it unleashes a chaotic detonation fueled by banana energy, triggering unpredictable mutations around it. This core was smuggled out of Inkopolis where it was initially thought to be harmless; instead, it became a tool for disrupting ecosystems. The core's potency fades after 24 hours, making it a fleeting yet potent weapon.

effectDetails.title: Banana-fueled Detonation
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command by a DK Crew member. The Banana Bomb Core causes an explosion that deals 1d6 fire damage to all creatures within 5 feet, along with 1d4 additional damage from banana-related effects (e.g., temporary euphoria). This effect has a range of touch and lasts until the core detonates.

effectDetails.title: Mutagenic Radius
effectDetails.rules: For every hour after activation, all creatures within 10 feet of the explosion must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become subject to a random mutation (as determined by the DM) for 1d4 hours. The core loses potency and stops working entirely after 24 hours.

dk_isles_banana_bomb_core.levelRequirementReason: The Banana Bomb Core is accessible to all adventurers who can understand its activation command.
dk_isles_banana_bomb_core.vendorReason: The DK Isles natives are well-acquainted with the core's origins and have learned how to handle it safely.
dk_isles_banana_bomb_core.shippingDetail: Delivered by Lakitu Drones, this item requires special handling due to its volatile nature. Delivery is expedited at an additional cost.

usage.activation: Command word spoken by a DK Crew member
usage.duration: Instantaneous detonation upon activation
usage.endsWhen: Expended after 24 hours of storage or detonation

dk_isles_banana_bomb_core.priceReason: Balanced at a price reflecting its unique and dangerous nature, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

dk_isles_banana_soul_sack.name: Banana Soul Sack
dk_isles_banana_soul_sack.description: The Banana Soul Sack is a woven leather pouch enchanted with the essence of ancient jungle bananas. It can store magical items, enhancing their storage capacity by +1 slot and granting a +2 bonus to Perception checks when detecting hidden truths. When opened during combat, it briefly transports the user to the nearest banana tree, offering a momentary reprieve from the chaos. This unique item is the only known way to safely handle cursed bananas without causing transformation or corruption.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Storage
effectDetails.rules: The Banana Soul Sack increases the storage capacity of any container by +1 slot. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Improved Perception
effectDetails.rules: When used, it grants a +2 bonus to Perception checks for detecting hidden truths or similar effects. The user must make an Intelligence (Perception) check when attempting this ability. This effect lasts until the end of the user's next turn.

dk_isles_banana_soul_sack.levelRequirementReason: The item requires no specific level, as it is a common item that aids in general adventuring tasks.
dk_isles_banana_soul_sack.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in items from the tropical DK Isles and their unique magic.
dk_isles_banana_soul_sack.shippingDetail: Ships via air balloon, ensuring quick delivery to any location within the DK Isles.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts until the end of the user's next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user's next turn begins.

dk_isles_banana_soul_sack.priceReason: The item is priced high due to its unique enchantment and rarity within the DK Isles.

dk_isles_banana_whistle.name: Banana Whistle
dk_isles_banana_whistle.description: The Banana Whistle is a hollowed-out banana peel intricately carved with ancient runes. When blown, it emits a haunting melody that confounds foes and provokes their laughter, causing them to drop their weapons in misplaced mirth. Crafted within the sanctum of a forgotten jungle temple, this relic was once wielded by spirits to ward off intruders. Its sound is known to spread joy among allies but also leaves enemies momentarily dazed and distracted.

effectDetails.title: Disrupts Concentration
effectDetails.rules: When a creature within 30 feet hears the whistle, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become confused for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature is only stunned until its next action.

effectDetails.title: Provokes Temporary Euphoria
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on all Charisma checks and saves for 1 round after using the whistle. This effect does not stack with other sources of temporary euphoria or happiness.

dk_isles_banana_whistle.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed to assist even beginning adventurers who might encounter challenging situations requiring a bit of whimsy and charm.
dk_isles_banana_whistle.vendorReason: The vendors at dk_isles specialize in exotic jungle finds, including magical artifacts with unique origins.
dk_isles_banana_whistle.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu drones within a week; delivery is tracked and confirmed upon arrival.

usage.activation: A free action to blow the whistle once per day.
usage.duration: Disrupts Concentration lasts until the end of the creature's next turn. Provokes Temporary Euphoria lasts for 1 round.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or when the user takes another action to use the item.
usage.charges: One charge per day, recharged after a long rest.

dk_isles_banana_whistle.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its rare and magical origin from jungle temples, providing significant utility for adventurers without being overpowered.

dk_isles_battle_scent_spray.name: Battle Scent Spray
dk_isles_battle_scent_spray.description: The Battle Scent Spray is a volatile concoction of jungle blood and Kremling frost, crafted by the crafty denizens of the Dark Isles. Upon activation, it releases a noxious mist that amplifies one's combat prowess—enhancing attack speed and damage, while also causing a brief but potent surge of panic in foes. However, after three uses, the user succumbs to a mild nausea, temporarily reducing their effectiveness on the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Combat Prowess
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this spray grants the user +20% attack speed and +15% damage for 1 minute. The effect ends if the user drops to 0 hit points or if they take a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Panic
effectDetails.rules: Additionally, there is a 10% chance each time this spray is used that it will cause one nearby enemy to suffer from panic for 1 minute. The panicked creature must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened and unable to take actions until the effect ends.

dk_isles_battle_scent_spray.levelRequirementReason: This spray requires at least 3rd level to use effectively, as its effects are best suited for seasoned fighters.
dk_isles_battle_scent_spray.vendorReason: The Dark Isles is renowned for its unique and potent concoctions, making this spray a staple of their wares.
dk_isles_battle_scent_spray.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express; delivery may be delayed by one day due to the volatile nature of the contents.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use, with a 1-minute cooldown between uses
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user drops to 0 hit points or takes a short rest; each spray has 3 charges.

dk_isles_battle_scent_spray.priceReason: This spray is priced at 1000 XP due to its potent mixture and limited number of uses.

dk_isles_berry_bomb.name: Berry Bomb of the Wicked Vine
dk_isles_berry_bomb.description: The Berry Bomb of the Wicked Vine is a shriveled, cursed fruit that explodes upon impact, spreading poison and vivid hallucinations. It is said to be a relic from an ancient jungle temple, used by Kremling shamans in their sieges. This berry can confuse enemies with memories of past battles, causing them to stagger and falter. It deals 50% extra damage to undead foes and triggers poison that lasts for 5 seconds, incapacitating and disorienting those caught within its blast.

effectDetails.title: Poisonous Blast
effectDetails.rules: The Berry Bomb explodes upon impact, dealing poison damage equal to 1d6 + the user’s Strength modifier. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and imposes a -1 penalty on saving throws against poison. It has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Memory Hallucination
effectDetails.rules: Upon impact, there is a 20% chance that an enemy within 30 feet of the explosion will suffer a memory hallucination, causing them to become confused for 1 minute. The DC for saving against this effect is equal to 8 + the user’s Charisma modifier.

dk_isles_berry_bomb.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least 5th level to activate its effects effectively.
dk_isles_berry_bomb.vendorReason: The dk Isles are well-versed in jungle relics and carry this cursed fruit as part of their extensive inventory.
dk_isles_berry_bomb.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral mail, which can sometimes be delayed by mischievous spirits.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the poison dissipates or confusion ends.

dk_isles_berry_bomb.priceReason: This rare item is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its cursed origins and potent effects.

dk_isles_cold_war_ambush_grenade.name: Cold War Ambush Grenade
dk_isles_cold_war_ambush_grenade.description: The Cold War Ambush Grenade is a deadly device crafted from the frosty tundra and venomous jungles of the Kremling Isles. When hurled at an enemy, it detonates in a frigid cloud that not only stuns foes but also douses them in a paralyzing chill. Enemies within the blast radius are momentarily frozen, their movements slowed to a crawl for several moments, making them easy targets for follow-up attacks.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Freeze
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the grenade detonates in a burst of frost. Enemies within 10 feet are stunned for 2 rounds and have their movement reduced by half (50%) due to the freezing conditions.

effectDetails.title: Frozen Slowed
effectDetails.rules: For 3 seconds after being stunned, enemies suffer a -2 penalty to Dexterity saving throws. This effect can be resisted with a successful Constitution save (DC 14).

dk_isles_cold_war_ambush_grenade.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to handle the grenade's potency and timing.
dk_isles_cold_war_ambush_grenade.vendorReason: The Kremling Isles vendors specialize in combat supplies from their harsh, unforgiving environment.
dk_isles_cold_war_ambush_grenade.shippingDetail: Ships with a special cold chain to preserve the grenade's potency, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous explosion
usage.endsWhen: On impact or when thrown

dk_isles_cold_war_ambush_grenade.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare item that offers both immediate and lingering battlefield advantages.

dk_isles_cold_war_blood_iron.name: Cold War Blood Iron
dk_isles_cold_war_blood_iron.description: Forged in the heart of a frozen conflict, Cold War Blood Iron is a weapon that draws its power from the very essence of frost and ice. Crafted during the last battle of the Kremling Cold War, it glows with an icy sheen as it delivers devastating blows to enemies with ice-based effects. Those struck by its keen edge also face a chilling aura, reducing their attack speed by 10% for 5 seconds while the weapon's wielder gains a +30% damage bonus against frost and ice targets.

effectDetails.title: Icy Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with Cold War Blood Iron, it deals +30% extra damage to frost or ice-based enemies. This effect is limited to once per turn.

effectDetails.title: Chilling Aura
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the weapon's aura which reduces the target's attack speed by 10%. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and ends when the target moves more than 5 feet away from you or if another creature enters the aura's radius. Recharges after a short rest.

dk_isles_cold_war_blood_iron.levelRequirementReason: The weapon requires a minimum level of 3 to wield its frost-based power.
dk_isles_cold_war_blood_iron.vendorReason: Known for their expertise in cold weapons, the DK Isles are the perfect vendor for Cold War Blood Iron.
dk_isles_cold_war_blood_iron.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones' Express Freeze service to ensure a swift delivery of this frosty weapon.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as part of an attack action when making a melee attack.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting effect until the end condition is met.
usage.endsWhen: The target moves more than 5 feet away or another creature enters the aura's radius; recharges after a short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges, recharging after each short rest.

dk_isles_cold_war_blood_iron.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, Cold War Blood Iron offers a solid value for its frost-based damage and area effect capabilities.

dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shells.name: Cold War Bomb Shells
dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shells.description: Cold War Bomb Shells are miniature fusion devices that explode in a frosty shockwave, shattering enemies and freezing those caught within its frigid blast. These shells are meticulously crafted from the remnants of forgotten conflicts, their icy cores sizzling with latent energy. Each shell detonates after 3 seconds of activation, releasing a wave of freezing air that not only deals 400 damage but also has a chilling 50% chance to paralyze nearby foes for 2 seconds, rendering them immobile and vulnerable.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Damage
effectDetails.rules: When a Cold War Bomb Shell detonates within 5 feet of an enemy, it deals 400 fire and cold damage. The explosion has a range of 15 feet, affecting all creatures in the area.

effectDetails.title: Freeze
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that nearby enemies will be hit by a freezing effect, immobilizing them for 2 seconds. This effect can save against with a DC of 15.

dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shells.levelRequirementReason: These bombs are designed to be accessible to lower-level characters who need powerful tools without the complexity of higher-tier magic.
dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shells.vendorReason: The Cold Isles supply house is known for its unique and potent weaponry, making these shells a staple in their inventory.
dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shells.shippingDetail: Ships with next-day delivery via Boo's spectral courier service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Explosion or thrown away
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each shell is a separate activation

dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shells.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its explosive power and chance to immobilize foes.

dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shield.name: Cold War Bomb Shield
dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shield.description: The Cold War Bomb Shield is a shimmering, frost-laced shield forged in the arctic wastes of the Dark Isles. Crafted from enchanted ice and bound with ancient magic, it absorbs both physical and magical attacks, turning any clash into an icy ballet of frozen adversaries. Activated by a swift gesture, this shield not only deflects up to 50% of incoming damage but also releases a shockwave that freezes nearby enemies in their tracks for three seconds.

effectDetails.title: Freeze Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the shield releases an icy shockwave that targets all creatures within a 10-foot radius. These creatures are frozen in place for 3 seconds, rendering them unable to move or take actions. The spell ends if a creature takes any damage.

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption
effectDetails.rules: For every hit the shield deflects, it absorbs up to 50% of the incoming damage. This effect has no cooldown but can only activate once per turn.

dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shield.levelRequirementReason: The Cold War Bomb Shield requires a minimum level of 3 due to its complex enchantments and magical properties.
dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shield.vendorReason: The Dark Isles is renowned for its mastery in cold magic, making it the perfect vendor for this ice-bound shield.
dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shield.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay within 5 days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until a creature takes damage or the user uses their action on another shield-related ability
usage.endsWhen: A creature in range takes damage, or the wielder uses an action for another shield-related ability

dk_isles_cold_war_bomb_shield.priceReason: The Cold War Bomb Shield is priced at 1000 XP as it combines potent defensive capabilities with a unique offensive spell, making it highly sought after by adventurers.

dk_isles_cold_war_craft.name: Frostbite Taser Vial
dk_isles_cold_war_craft.description: The Frostbite Taser Vial is a cold-war relic, a vial of sub-zero plasma that can freeze its target in place for a fleeting moment. When released, it sends a jolt of icy energy that not only slows an enemy’s movements by -100% for five seconds but also deals 200 piercing damage upon impact. Ideal for disrupting enemy formations during jungle skirmishes, this vial is as much a tool of war as it is a symbol of the Frost Isles' cold-hearted conflict.

effectDetails.title: Slowed Movement
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the vial releases a burst of icy energy that targets one creature within 30 feet. The target is immobilized and suffers -100% movement speed for 5 seconds. There is no saving throw against this effect.

effectDetails.title: Piercing Damage
effectDetails.rules: Upon impact, the vial deals 200 piercing damage to the target creature. This effect occurs only once per use and has a recharge time of one hour.

dk_isles_cold_war_craft.levelRequirementReason: The Frostbite Taser Vial is an introductory relic designed for beginning adventurers who may benefit from its battlefield disruption capabilities.
dk_isles_cold_war_craft.vendorReason: The Frost Isles vendor, known for their cold-war relics and technological artifacts, offers this vial as a starting point for new heroes entering the conflict.
dk_isles_cold_war_craft.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days via Pipe Express' cold-resistant courier service.

usage.activation: A bonus action to release the icy energy and deal damage.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting five seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The vial is recharged after one hour or destroyed upon impact.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, recharging daily.

dk_isles_cold_war_craft.priceReason: The Frostbite Taser Vial offers a balanced mix of utility and damage dealing for its price, making it a valuable item for new adventurers.

dk_isles_cold_war_cryptic_ribbon.name: Cold War Cryptic Ribbon
dk_isles_cold_war_cryptic_ribbon.description: The Cold War Cryptic Ribbon is a shimmering, frost-laden artifact woven from the very threads of Kremling espionage secrets. When worn in the dense jungles of the Dark Isles, it grants you the stealthy grace of a jungle cat and reveals hidden paths that even the most seasoned explorers miss. As you move through the underbrush, your enemies' positions are laid bare, giving you a tactical advantage in covert operations.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Disguise
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Cold War Cryptic Ribbon, you gain a +30 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 8 seconds. This effect ends if you are hit in combat or if you stop moving.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to reveal hidden paths and enemy positions within a 30-foot radius for 8 seconds. Creatures with blindsight or truesight can see through this effect. This power has no save DC but is limited to once per long rest.

dk_isles_cold_war_cryptic_ribbon.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a level 5 character due to its complex magical properties and the espionage lore woven into it.
dk_isles_cold_war_cryptic_ribbon.vendorReason: The Dark Isles are known for their rich history of covert operations, making this vendor a perfect source for such an artifact.
dk_isles_cold_war_cryptic_ribbon.shippingDetail: Delivery via the Void Drifter takes three days with no additional charges.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to gain the stealth bonus); Action to use reveal hidden paths
usage.duration: 8 seconds for Stealthy Disguise; 8 seconds duration for Reveal Hidden Paths, ends if interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Combat or stopping movement ends Stealthy Disguise; Revealed effects end after their durations

dk_isles_cold_war_cryptic_ribbon.priceReason: The item's unique magical properties and espionage lore justify its price, aligning with the vendor’s reputation.

dk_isles_cold_war_echo_shard.name: Cold War Echo Shard
dk_isles_cold_war_echo_shard.description: The Cold War Echo Shard is a jagged shard of dark glass, its surface etched with ancient Kremlin runes. When activated, it emits a chilling psychic echo that disrupts enemy communication for 10 seconds and summons a spectral frost echo that hovers at your side, dealing 35% damage to all nearby enemies within 20 feet as long as you are in icy terrain. The shard's power is said to come from the very heart of Kremlin battlestations, where it withstood countless battles against opposing forces.
effects: Summons a spectral frost echo companion

effectDetails.title: Psychic Disruption
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user activates the shard to emit a psychic echo. This effect disrupts all non-magical and non-artifact communication for creatures within 50 feet for 10 seconds. The effect has no save DC and does not consume charges.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Frost Echo
effectDetails.rules: The shard summons a spectral frost echo that appears as a ghostly figure and hovers at your side until the end of your next turn or until you dismiss it. While present, the echo deals 35% damage to all creatures within 20 feet who are in icy terrain. The echo has AC 18 and hit points equal to three times the user's level.

dk_isles_cold_war_echo_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard is accessible to lower-level characters due to its unique, non-combat utility and thematic connection to Kremlin lore.
dk_isles_cold_war_echo_shard.vendorReason: The Cold Isles are known for their ties to Kremlin history, and the shard's origins make it a fitting addition to their inventory.
dk_isles_cold_war_echo_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay within 3 game days of purchase.

usage.duration: 10 seconds (Psychic Disruption), until end of next turn or dismissed (Spectral Frost Echo)
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed by the user, duration ends (both effects)

dk_isles_cold_war_echo_shard.priceReason: The shard's unique utility and thematic value justify its price of 1000 XP.

dk_isles_cold_war_ice_satchel.name: Ice Satchel of the Frozen Pact
dk_isles_cold_war_ice_satchel.description: The Ice Satchel of the Frozen Pact, a relic from the frozen wastes of the Dark Isles, is crafted from frost-veined fabric that glows with an icy blue light. When activated, it releases a frigid blast capable of freezing foes in place for four seconds, rendering them immobile and vulnerable to attacks. The satchel's touch alone can deal 15 points of ice damage, making it a versatile tool for jungle ambushes and cold-climate tactics.

effectDetails.title: Frozen Freeze
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Ice Satchel emits a freezing blast that targets all creatures within a 10-foot radius. These creatures are immobilized for 4 seconds and have their movement speed reduced by 50%. The effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Cold Touch
effectDetails.rules: The Ice Satchel deals 15 points of cold damage to any creature that makes a melee attack against the wielder. This effect is triggered automatically each time an enemy touches the satchel, and it has no save DC.

dk_isles_cold_war_ice_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The Ice Satchel requires a minimum character level of 3 to ensure that users can effectively utilize its cold-based abilities in combat.
dk_isles_cold_war_ice_satchel.vendorReason: The Dark Isles is the birthplace of this relic, and only their vendors have access to it.
dk_isles_cold_war_ice_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, typically arriving within a week.

usage.duration: 4 seconds of immobilization per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the user uses another action to dismiss it early

dk_isles_cold_war_ice_satchel.priceReason: This relic is crafted from rare frost-veined fabric and requires advanced cold-based magic, justifying its price.

dk_isles_cold_war_ice_shard.name: Ice Shard of the Kremling War
dk_isles_cold_war_ice_shard.description: The Ice Shard of the Kremling War is a brittle, frost-laden shard forged in the heart of a long-forgotten Kremling Cold War battlefield. It glows with a cold blue light that pulses when struck, and upon impact, it releases a wave of freezing energy that slows enemies while enhancing the wielder’s agility in combat. This relic is a potent tool for those who fight in icy climes or against frosty foes.

effectDetails.title: Freezing Aura
effectDetails.rules: When the Ice Shard strikes an enemy, it releases a freezing aura that reduces their movement speed by 30% for 3 seconds. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per turn.

effectDetails.title: Agile Step
effectDetails.rules: For every successful hit with the Ice Shard, the wielder gains +25% movement speed for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to three times but cannot exceed +75% movement speed.

dk_isles_cold_war_ice_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard is designed to be accessible to adventurers of all levels, making it a versatile tool in various combat scenarios.
dk_isles_cold_war_ice_shard.vendorReason: As a relic from the Kremling Cold War, this item is one of many historical artifacts sold by DK Isles, known for their extensive collection of ancient and magical items.
dk_isles_cold_war_ice_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Icebound Express, delivering within three days to any frost-touched region.

usage.activation: On hit with a melee weapon
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the user takes an action or reaction
usage.endsWhen: The effect expires after its duration

dk_isles_cold_war_ice_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's rare material and potent effects without being overpowered.

dk_isles_cold_war_jungle_core.name: Cold War Jungle Core
dk_isles_cold_war_jungle_core.description: The Cold War Jungle Core is a fusion of jungle vitality and Kremling war technology forged by the secretive DK Isles. This core, encased in a sleek, matte black shell adorned with ancient runes, emits an eerie cold war aura that slows enemy cooldowns while bolstering the wielder's speed and resilience in dense jungle zones. When activated, it grants a +10% increase to movement speed within jungle terrain and reduces enemy skill cooldowns by 20%, making foes feel the brunt of both natural and technological warfare.

effectDetails.title: Slow Cooldowns
effectDetails.rules: When activated, reduces enemy skill cooldowns by 20% for the wielder. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn. No save DC required.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Jungle Speed
effectDetails.rules: Increases movement speed within jungle zones by +10%. This effect is passive and lasts until you leave a jungle zone or are incapacitated. No save DC required.

dk_isles_cold_war_jungle_core.levelRequirementReason: The intricate fusion of technology and nature requires a minimum level to ensure the wielder can handle its complexities.
dk_isles_cold_war_jungle_core.vendorReason: DK Isles is renowned for their mastery in blending jungle lore with cold war tech, making this core one of their signature items.
dk_isles_cold_war_jungle_core.shippingDetail: The item arrives within a week, delivered by the fastest courier service available.

usage.duration: Instantaneous with a duration until end of next turn for 'Slow Cooldowns'; passive while in jungle zones for 'Enhanced Jungle Speed'
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you leave the jungle zone or are incapacitated.

dk_isles_cold_war_jungle_core.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its unique fusion of technology and nature, providing a significant but not overpowered advantage.

dk_isles_cold_war_mushroom_cake.name: Cold War Mushroom Cake
dk_isles_cold_war_mushroom_cake.description: The Cold War Mushroom Cake, a decadent fungal confection crafted from the very soil of Kremling-era espionage, exudes an eerie green glow in the jungle's twilight. Each bite releases a cloud of mycelial mist that cloaks you in temporary stealth, allowing you to slip past unseen. When the cake is consumed, the ground seems to yield beneath your feet as you phase through solid earth for ten seconds, leaving no trace behind. Ideal for the covert jungle operative who must navigate clandestine routes without detection.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Cloak
effectDetails.rules: Activating this effect requires consuming a bite of the cake. The user becomes temporarily invisible and silent for thirty seconds, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect ends if you take any action other than movement or if you are damaged.

effectDetails.title: Phase Through Earth
effectDetails.rules: Phasing through solid ground is an instantaneous activation that lasts for ten seconds. While phased, you can move through earth and plants as if they were air; however, you cannot pass through creatures or objects.
