dk_isles_jungle_blood_scarf.shippingDetail: Ships via a Rakasha spirit courier who ensures the scarf arrives fresh and vibrant.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate camouflage; occurs at start of each combat round for morale reduction.
usage.duration: Camouflage lasts 5 seconds; morale decrease effect lasts 10 seconds per combat round.
usage.endsWhen: The user is no longer in a jungle biome or if the wearer moves or attacks while camouflaged.

dk_isles_jungle_blood_scarf.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the rare materials and intricate craftsmanship required for such an item.

dk_isles_jungle_blood_scent.name: Jungle Blood Scent
dk_isles_jungle_blood_scent.description: The Jungle Blood Scent is a potent extract from the heart of the druidic swamps. When applied, it transforms your skin and breath into that of a jungle creature, masking your presence entirely in dense undergrowth. It also confers a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 10 minutes, while simultaneously rendering you immune to detection by ambush traps for the same duration. The scent dissipates naturally after an hour, leaving no trace behind.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Mask
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for the next 10 minutes. This effect ends when you are no longer in thick foliage or if you voluntarily end it.

effectDetails.title: Ambush Trap Immunity
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your Stealth Mask, you are immune to the detection effects of ambush traps within a radius of 30 feet. This effect ends when you leave the area or take damage.

dk_isles_jungle_blood_scent.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for novice adventurers who need to navigate dense jungles without drawing unwanted attention.
dk_isles_jungle_blood_scent.vendorReason: DK Isles traders have direct access to the swamps, where they can source unique extracts like Jungle Blood Scent.
dk_isles_jungle_blood_scent.shippingDetail: The extract is shipped in a sealed container with a fragrant preservative. Handle with care to prevent premature activation or degradation.

usage.activation: Bonus action to apply the scent and gain its benefits.
usage.duration: 10 minutes, renewable by reapplication as a bonus action.
usage.endsWhen: Stealth effect ends when you leave dense foliage or take damage; ambush trap immunity ends when you leave the area or take damage.

dk_isles_jungle_blood_scent.priceReason: The price reflects the rare extraction process and the potent, long-lasting effects of Jungle Blood Scent.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom.name: Bloom of the Forgotten Grove
dk_isles_jungle_bloom.description: The Bloom of the Forgotten Grove is a root-infused potion that glows with an ethereal emerald light, pulsing in rhythm with the ancient jungle's heartbeat. When consumed, it grants the drinker temporary jungle resonance, allowing them to feel the earth’s pulse and resist Kremling toxins' venomous effects. For 60 seconds, the imbiber moves as one with nature, gaining both enhanced vitality and a keen awareness of their surroundings.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation by drinking the potion, you gain +30% health regeneration per second for a duration of 60 seconds. This effect ends if you take any damage or enter a state that requires concentration.

effectDetails.title: Venom Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While under the effects of Jungle Resonance, you are immune to poison effects from Kremling flora. The immunity lasts for the duration of the potion's effect and is not subject to save checks.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom.levelRequirementReason: The potion provides a minor boost that even lower-level adventurers can benefit from without undue risk.
dk_isles_jungle_bloom.vendorReason: DK Isles traders are well-known for their knowledge of the jungle and its secrets, making them the perfect purveyors of such an item.
dk_isles_jungle_bloom.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral courier, ensuring swift arrival to even the remotest areas of the jungle.

usage.activation: Consume the potion as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 60 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take damage or enter a state that requires concentration.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the potion can be consumed multiple times without recharging.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom.priceReason: The price reflects its uncommon rarity and the mystical properties it provides, making it accessible yet valuable to adventurers of all levels.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom_potion.name: Bloom Whisper Potion
dk_isles_jungle_bloom_potion.description: The Bloom Whisper Potion is a delicate, translucent liquid that bubbles gently in its vial. Its hue fluctuates with the mood of the jungle—reddening in perilous zones and brightening to emerald when all is serene. Sipping this elixir grants you temporary immunity to jungle toxins and enhances your speed through the verdant undergrowth. The potion's color mirrors the forest’s heartbeat, a living reminder of its power and grace.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Toxin Immunity
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to all forms of jungle toxin damage for 20 seconds upon drinking the potion. This effect ends immediately if you take any toxin damage.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: For 30 seconds after consuming the potion, your movement speed increases by +15 feet. This effect is terminated if you enter difficult terrain or take any poison damage.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion's effects are potent enough to require at least second-level proficiency in survival or nature.
dk_isles_jungle_bloom_potion.vendorReason: The potions sold by DK Isles are known for their connection with the natural world, making them a perfect fit for this elixir.
dk_isles_jungle_bloom_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly via Lakitu drones, ensuring the potion remains potent upon arrival.

usage.duration: 2 minutes total duration (1 minute per effect)
usage.endsWhen: The effects end if you take toxin damage or enter difficult terrain, whichever occurs first. The potion is consumed after use.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom_potion.priceReason: The price reflects its rare ingredients and the complexity of its formula, balancing its power with a fair value.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom_vial.name: Jungle Bloom Vial
dk_isles_jungle_bloom_vial.description: The Jungle Bloom Vial is a glass vial containing a vibrant, bioluminescent nectar that glows with the energy of the densest jungle undergrowth. When uncorked, it restores vitality like a draught of life-giving waters and grants temporary elemental resistance to the wearer, lending them the fortitude needed to face the unpredictable terrors of the wild. This vial is a trusted companion for adventurers navigating the unforgiving jungles or battling in shadowy environs where elemental forces run rampant.

effectDetails.title: Restore Vitality
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Jungle Bloom Vial restores 300 hit points to the user. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 30 seconds after consumption, the user gains a +10% resistance to all elemental damage. This effect ends when the duration expires or if the user takes an action or reaction that requires their concentration.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom_vial.levelRequirementReason: This vial is crafted for adventurers who have proven themselves in the jungles and shadows, requiring a minimum of five levels to properly wield its power.
dk_isles_jungle_bloom_vial.vendorReason: The vendors at dk Isles are well-acquainted with the dangers of their region and know this item's value to those who face them.
dk_isles_jungle_bloom_vial.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its reliable delivery through even the most treacherous jungles.

usage.duration: 30 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends or user takes a concentration-requiring action.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be consumed multiple times.

dk_isles_jungle_bloom_vial.priceReason: The rarity and the unique properties of the Jungle Bloom Vial justify its fair value in experience points.

dk_isles_jungle_brew.name: Toad Lee’s Cold Brew
dk_isles_jungle_brew.description: Toad Lee's Cold Brew is a potent elixir, crafted in the heart of the jungle by the enigmatic brewmaster himself. This bitter, emerald-hued potion not only regenerates stamina at an accelerated rate but also grants temporary cold immunity, crucial for surviving the harsh frosty nights. The concoction is said to have been perfected after Toad Lee's own leg injury, imbuing it with a resilience that mirrors his spirit. Sipping this brew ensures you can push through even the most frigid challenges.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, Toad Lee's Cold Brew provides a +15% increase in stamina regeneration per second for 30 seconds. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Cold Immunity
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 minute after consuming, you gain +20% resistance to cold damage. This immunity persists until the start of your next turn following the consumption. There is no saving throw involved.

dk_isles_jungle_brew.levelRequirementReason: The simplicity and direct benefits of Toad Lee's Cold Brew make it accessible to lower-level adventurers.
dk_isles_jungle_brew.vendorReason: As the local expert in jungle survival, Toad Lee is known for his unique concoctions that aid adventurers in their endeavors.
dk_isles_jungle_brew.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter Relay ensures swift delivery of this potent brew from the heart of the jungle to your doorstep.

usage.duration: 30 seconds for stamina boost; 1 minute for cold immunity
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn following consumption

dk_isles_jungle_brew.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's direct utility and rarity, making it a valuable addition to any adventurer's toolkit.

dk_isles_jungle_cannon_fodder.name: Jungle Cannon Fodder
dk_isles_jungle_cannon_fodder.description: The Jungle Cannon Fodder is a relic of ancient jungle warfare, disguised as a colossal fruit that conceals a devastating cannon within its leaves and bark. This massive contraption fires explosive cannonballs with terrifying accuracy, capable of obliterating foes from afar. After each shot, the cannon's barrel emits a cloud of smoke that momentarily blocks line of sight for all enemies in range, giving allies an unexpected tactical advantage.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Shot
effectDetails.rules: When the Jungle Cannon Fodder is fired as a bonus action, it launches a single explosive cannonball that deals 1d8 + 3 fire damage to one target within 60 feet. The cannonball has a range increment of 20 feet and ignores difficult terrain. The weapon recharges after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Smoke
effectDetails.rules: For 3 seconds immediately after firing the cannon, all creatures in a 15-foot radius centered on the impact point are blinded as the cannon's smoke obscures their vision. This effect has no save DC and does not end early unless dispelled or otherwise countered.

dk_isles_jungle_cannon_fodder.levelRequirementReason: This relic is designed for versatile use, requiring only a basic understanding of mechanics to operate.
dk_isles_jungle_cannon_fodder.vendorReason: The DK Isles are known for their unique and ancient artifacts, including the Jungle Cannon Fodder.
dk_isles_jungle_cannon_fodder.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with expedited delivery, ensuring this relic arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to fire or use
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Explosive Shot), 3 seconds (Blinding Smoke)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the cannon is recharged after a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but recharges after a long rest

dk_isles_jungle_cannon_fodder.priceReason: This relic's balanced price reflects its versatile utility and strategic value in combat.

dk_isles_jungle_cloak_of_shadows.name: Jungle Cloak of Shadows
dk_isles_jungle_cloak_of_shadows.description: The Jungle Cloak of Shadows is a woven cloak made from the shadow-veined leaves of the Whispering Gnarls, a rare jungle plant known for its mystical properties. This cloak allows you to blend seamlessly into your surroundings and evade detection within a 5-meter radius. Wearers become invisible to enemies in that range, making it an indispensable tool for stealth and survival in the dense jungles of Dworkin Isle.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility Cloak
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, making you invisible to enemies within a 5-meter radius for up to 1 minute. This effect ends when you attack, cast a spell, or move more than 10 feet.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Master
effectDetails.rules: Increases stealth detection evasion by 20%, making it nearly impossible for enemies to detect your presence in the jungle. This bonus is permanent until the cloak's invisibility effect ends.

dk_isles_jungle_cloak_of_shadows.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least level 3 to effectively use and appreciate the stealth benefits.
dk_isles_jungle_cloak_of_shadows.vendorReason: The cloaks are crafted by artisans on Dworkin Isle, known for their expertise in jungle flora and crafting unique gear.
dk_isles_jungle_cloak_of_shadows.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week of purchase with no additional charges.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate invisibility; passive stealth benefits while active.
usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per long rest
usage.endsWhen: Attack, spell cast, or moving more than 10 feet

dk_isles_jungle_cloak_of_shadows.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare item that provides significant stealth advantages without breaking the game.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ambush_bottle.name: Whispering Thorns Elixir
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ambush_bottle.description: Crafted from the gnarled roots of the Whispering Thorns in the darkest reaches of the jungle, this elixir is said to carry the very essence of the forest's ancient magic. When consumed, it grants you and your allies temporary stealth and silent movement, allowing you to slip past enemy sentries unnoticed. The thorns' curse also whispers secrets of the surrounding area, making you momentarily invisible to ranged attacks for a short time.

effectDetails.title: Stealth and Silence
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for the next minute, and you can move silently without making noise. Additionally, any creature within 5 feet of you has disadvantage on Dexterity (Perception) checks to detect you. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Invisible to Ranged Attacks
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. For the duration of one ranged attack roll, creatures have disadvantage on their Perception checks to locate you and are considered to be out of line of sight for the purpose of that check. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ambush_bottle.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for lower-level adventurers who need to infiltrate enemy strongholds.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ambush_bottle.vendorReason: Known for its mysterious and powerful potions, dk Isles is the only vendor that can source such an artifact from the jungle's depths.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ambush_bottle.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral courier, ensuring safe delivery but with a slight delay of one hour.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect's duration ends or you take damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have not taken damage.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ambush_bottle.priceReason: Balanced for its unique stealth and ranged defense benefits, this elixir is priced at a fair value relative to its utility in combat scenarios.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_gauntlet.name: Frostleaf Gauntlet
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_gauntlet.description: The Frostleaf Gauntlet is a relic of ancient jungle magic, crafted from the twisted vines of the deep rainforest and the bones of long-forgotten kraken. Its frost-touched metal hums with cold energy, granting the wearer both agility and the ability to strike like an ambush predator. In the dense jungle biomes, it multiplies your critical strike chance by 20%, while in cold battles, it reduces damage taken from freezing attacks by 10%. The gauntlet is a perfect companion for navigating treacherous terrains and stealthy strikes against enemies of the Kremling patrols.
effects: +20% critical strike chance in jungle biomes
+10% damage reduction when hit by cold-based attacks

effectDetails.title: Jungle Critical Strike
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a successful melee attack during combat within jungle biomes. The gauntlet increases the chance of a critical strike by +20%. This effect has no cooldown and can be used as long as you are in a jungle biome.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Active whenever you are hit by an attack with cold damage. Reduces incoming cold-based damage by 10%, stacking up to +20% if the gauntlet is already active. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The Frostleaf Gauntlet's intricate enchantments and materials necessitate a minimum level of 5 for comfort and effectiveness.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_gauntlet.vendorReason: As DK Isles' premier relic dealer, the gauntlet is a fitting addition to their extensive collection of rare artifacts.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_gauntlet.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail's express courier service with guaranteed delivery within three game days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous on critical strike and damage reduction effects.
usage.endsWhen: Disengages when the wearer leaves a jungle biome or is no longer hit by cold-based attacks.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_gauntlet.priceReason: The gauntlet's unique materials and enchantments justify its price, providing significant battlefield advantages at an affordable cost.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_shield.name: Glacier Shield Fragment
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_shield.description: A Glacier Shield Fragment is a jagged shard of ice armor, once part of an elite Kremling siege tower’s defensive barrier. It crackles with cold magic and can freeze foes on impact, while also slowly healing its bearer through the arcane properties of frost. Ideal for frontline defense or blocking teleporters, this relic is a formidable shield for any brave soul facing icy winters in the far reaches of the realm.

effectDetails.title: Glacial Freeze
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with a melee attack, there is a 15% chance to freeze them in place for 1d4 rounds. The DC to break the effect is equal to 8 + your Strength modifier. This effect can occur once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Frost Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns, you regain 5 hit points if you are wearing this fragment as part of your armor. This benefit lasts until you complete a short or long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_shield.levelRequirementReason: The Glacier Shield Fragment is suitable for all adventurers to use its defensive benefits.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_shield.vendorReason: As a vendor specializing in relics and ancient artifacts, dk Isles naturally stocks this powerful yet approachable item.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_shield.shippingDetail: The fragment is delivered by spectral means, arriving at your doorstep within one game turn.

usage.duration: Until you complete a short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Once per long rest for Glacial Freeze and until you finish a rest for Frost Regeneration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, resets after each long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_shield.priceReason: The price reflects its rare material composition and unique defensive properties, making it accessible yet valuable to any adventurer.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_sword.name: Frostfang Blade
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_sword.description: Frostfang Blade is a rare, cursed jungle blade forged from the ice of ancient glaciers. Its edge glows with an eerie, frozen luminescence that chills foes in its wake. Crafted by shadowy artisans to serve assassins and scouts, this weapon emits frost upon each strike, making it doubly lethal against those encased in cold. A masterwork piece, it whispers of the frozen jungle’s secrets as it strikes from the shadows.
effects: +20% damage to ice and cold creatures

effectDetails.title: Frosty Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you strike an enemy with Frostfang Blade, it deals an additional 1d6 cold damage. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Step
effectDetails.rules: While in a shadow, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. You must end your turn within the shadow to maintain this benefit; otherwise, it ends immediately.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_sword.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency with melee weapons due to its frost and stealth mechanics.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_sword.vendorReason: DK Isles is known for exotic weaponry and cursed artifacts, making Frostfang Blade a fitting addition to their inventory.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_sword.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its reliable but somewhat delayed deliveries. Expect a few days longer than standard courier services.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect upon striking with the blade.
usage.duration: Until end of turn while in shadow.
usage.endsWhen: You leave a shadow or make an attack outside of one.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_ice_sword.priceReason: Balanced by the limited use and additional mechanics, this weapon offers significant tactical advantages at a fair price.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_satchel.name: Jungle Cold War Satchel
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_satchel.description: The Jungle Cold War Satchel is a rugged satchel crafted from the intertwined vines of ancient jungle trees and reinforced with fragments of iron from forgotten battles. Its leather exterior, dyed deep emerald green, whispers secrets to those who wield it, emitting a low hum that disorients foes within 30 feet. This satchel was once used by spies in the jungles of the Dark Isles, perfect for smuggling and espionage.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Hum
effectDetails.rules: When equipped, the Jungle Cold War Satchel emits a low hum that disorients enemy creatures within 30 feet. These creatures have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Perception checks for 1 minute, or until they leave the area.

effectDetails.title: +15% Melee Damage
effectDetails.rules: The wielder of this satchel deals an additional +15% damage with all melee attacks. This effect does not stack with other similar bonuses.

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and utility of the Jungle Cold War Satchel demand a minimum level to ensure proper handling.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_satchel.vendorReason: DK Isles is known for its covert operations and espionage gear, making it the ideal vendor for such an item.
dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, ensuring safe and swift delivery through the jungle's treacherous paths.

usage.activation: Equipping the satchel as a bonus action
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until removed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Dislodged from its wielder or destroyed by fire

dk_isles_jungle_cold_war_satchel.priceReason: The satchel's unique construction and espionage capabilities justify its price of 1000 XP.

dk_isles_jungle_crypt_wand.name: Jungle Crypt Wand
dk_isles_jungle_crypt_wand.description: The Jungle Crypt Wand is a relic forged from ancient jungle wood and adorned with enigmatic carvings. It allows its wielder to summon spirits that assist in combat, granting +20% dodge chance for nearby allies. The wand can also alter terrain temporarily—dampening the ground or creating treacherous mud pits, each effect lasting 3 seconds. These spirits are attuned to the wilds and enhance all jungle-based abilities by +10%. Only those who have proven their worth in the jungles of Dk Isles should wield this wand.

effectDetails.title: Summon Jungle Spirits
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can summon jungle spirits for 10 seconds. These spirits grant +20% dodge chance to all adjacent allies. The effect ends when the user dismisses it or if an enemy attacks within the area of effect.

effectDetails.title: Terrain Alteration
effectDetails.rules: The user can choose one terrain alteration: dampen ground (creating a slippery surface) or create mud pits, each lasting 3 seconds. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

dk_isles_jungle_crypt_wand.levelRequirementReason: Only those with experience in jungle combat can effectively wield the Jungle Crypt Wand.
dk_isles_jungle_crypt_wand.vendorReason: The natives of Dk Isles have a deep connection to the spirits and terrain, making them the perfect guardians of such a relic.
dk_isles_jungle_crypt_wand.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drone Express; delivery can take up to one week depending on weather conditions in Dk Isles.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: User dismisses it or an enemy attacks within the area of effect
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short rest

dk_isles_jungle_crypt_wand.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and the expertise required to effectively use its abilities.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_ammunition.name: Jungle Echo Ammunition
dk_isles_jungle_echo_ammunition.description: Jungle Echo Ammunition fires from a rifle that hums with the primal essence of the Amazonian jungle. These bullets are said to echo the ancient screams of spirits, ricocheting off walls and ground to find their targets. Each shot unleashes a brief sonic pulse that deafens foes within earshot for 2 seconds, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable. The ammunition is crafted from the ironwood of the sacred kapok tree, imbued with jungle magic by shamans of the Dk Isles.

effectDetails.title: Ricochet Damage
effectDetails.rules: When a bullet strikes a wall or ground within 15 feet, it ricochets and deals an additional 30% damage to all enemies in the area.

effectDetails.title: Deafening Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Upon impact with flesh, each bullet emits a deafening sonic pulse that deafens nearby foes for 2 seconds. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per minute.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_ammunition.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from the sacred kapok wood of the Dk Isles, this ammunition requires a certain level of mastery over jungle magic to handle.
dk_isles_jungle_echo_ammunition.vendorReason: The vendors at Dk Isles are known for their mystical and enchanted goods, making Jungle Echo Ammunition a natural addition to their inventory.
dk_isles_jungle_echo_ammunition.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the heart of the jungle, arriving with the next breeze.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The shot is made or the bullet impacts a target; recharges after 5 minutes.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_ammunition.priceReason: Crafted from sacred kapok wood and imbued with jungle magic, this ammunition commands a premium price.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_scepter.name: Jungle Echo Scepter
dk_isles_jungle_echo_scepter.description: The Jungle Echo Scepter is a pulsating staff forged from the heartwood of ancient jungle guardians, imbued with the essence of forgotten gods. Its eerie hum resonates through the air, echoing the whispers of those who once ruled this wild domain. Wield it in the jungle and watch as spectral vines ensnare foes, their grip unyielding. With each swing, you feel an unnatural increase in agility, allowing you to dance around your enemies with lethal precision.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Agility
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Jungle Echo Scepter within a jungle biome, gain a +15% increase to your movement speed. This effect lasts for the duration of one short rest or until you leave the jungle biome.

effectDetails.title: Vines of Ensnarement
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to summon two spectral vines that ensnare a creature within 30 feet, dealing 100 necrotic damage and stunning it for 1.5 seconds. This effect can be used once per long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_scepter.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second-level proficiency to wield effectively in the jungle.
dk_isles_jungle_echo_scepter.vendorReason: The DK Isles are known for their deep connection with ancient jungle guardians, making them a fitting vendor for this relic.
dk_isles_jungle_echo_scepter.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe and swift delivery from the heart of the jungle.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon vines; passive effect while in a jungle biome.
usage.duration: Passive effect lasts until you leave the jungle or end your rest. Vines last for 3 seconds per use.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends upon leaving the jungle biome, using it again during the same long rest, or if destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses with a long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_scepter.priceReason: Balanced at this price point due to its specific environmental synergy and limited utility outside of jungle biomes.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_tome.name: Jungle Echo Tome
dk_isles_jungle_echo_tome.description: The Jungle Echo Tome is a leather-bound tome adorned with ancient, etched symbols that whisper of long-forgotten jungle gods. When read aloud within dense foliage, it grants you temporary camouflage and amplifies your stealth abilities by +50%, making you nearly invisible to all but the most perceptive eyes. However, beware—the whispers may entangle you in hallucinations, causing you to wander into deadly traps or hallucinate creatures that never existed.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth
effectDetails.rules: Activates on reading aloud within a dense jungle biome. The user gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and has a +50% bonus to their Stealth score for the duration. This effect ends if you leave the dense foliage or take damage.

effectDetails.title: Camouflage
effectDetails.rules: The user becomes indistinguishable from the jungle environment, granting them total concealment against creatures that cannot see invisible targets. This camouflage ends if you move more than 10 feet or are hit by an attack.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_tome.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to effectively use the stealth and camouflage benefits without becoming overwhelmed.
dk_isles_jungle_echo_tome.vendorReason: The DK Isles have a deep connection with the jungle and its secrets, making them a fitting vendor for this enchanted tome.
dk_isles_jungle_echo_tome.shippingDetail: Delivered by Lakitu Drones within 3 days of purchase. Due to the fragile nature of the tome, it must be handled carefully during transit.

usage.activation: Activates on reading aloud within dense jungle foliage.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: You leave dense foliage or take damage.

dk_isles_jungle_echo_tome.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the rare and powerful effects of the tome, ensuring it is a valuable yet fair addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

dk_isles_jungle_fury_belt.name: Jungle Fury Belt
dk_isles_jungle_fury_belt.description: The Jungle Fury Belt is a leather belt woven from the essence of a ferocious jungle beast, its surface etched with ancient runes that hum with primal power. Wielders are granted a state of raging fury, increasing their damage by a quarter against organic foes and granting them heightened agility in dense jungles. At the cost of stamina, this belt unleashes untamed aggression, drawing on raw nature's might to turn the tide of battle.

effectDetails.title: Rage Empower
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants +25% damage against organic foes for 10 seconds. The user suffers a stamina drain of 5% per second during the effect duration.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Agility
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this belt, the user's movement speed is increased by 30 feet in jungle terrain. This effect persists for as long as the user remains within a dense jungle environment.

dk_isles_jungle_fury_belt.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to channel the raw power of the jungle beast.
dk_isles_jungle_fury_belt.vendorReason: The denizens of the Dk Isles are closely tied to nature and often craft items that harness its untamed fury.
dk_isles_jungle_fury_belt.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, known for their swift and reliable service within the island chains.

usage.duration: 10 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the user leaves jungle terrain or is incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short rest.

dk_isles_jungle_fury_belt.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare craftsmanship and potent effects.

dk_isles_jungle_gauntlet_of_the_treant_g.name: Gauntlet of the Treant Guard
dk_isles_jungle_gauntlet_of_the_treant_g.description: The Gauntlet of the Treant Guard is a heavy, leaf-veined gauntlet forged from the very bones of ancient jungle guardians. Its power courses through your veins as you move through dense thicket, granting you an extra layer of defense and allowing you to strike with enhanced force against those who dare break through the foliage. Each strike releases a surge of vitality that grants you a brief sprint boost, leaving your enemies in your wake.
effects: Extra damage vs foes breaking through thicket

effectDetails.title: Jungle Defense Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you are within a jungle zone, the gauntlet grants +15% to your AC. This effect lasts for the duration of your stay in the jungle area.

effectDetails.title: Sprint Boost on Strike
effectDetails.rules: After successfully hitting an enemy while moving through thicket, you gain a 2-second sprint boost. You can use this ability once per long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_gauntlet_of_the_treant_g.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet's power is accessible to adventurers early on, allowing them to quickly adapt to jungle combat.
dk_isles_jungle_gauntlet_of_the_treant_g.vendorReason: DK Isles has a deep connection with the natural world and often sells items that harness its essence.
dk_isles_jungle_gauntlet_of_the_treant_g.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the Windborne, ensuring adventurers are prepared for their jungle expeditions.

usage.activation: Passive effect while in a jungle zone; sprint boost is gained on successful strikes through thicket.
usage.duration: Active as long as you remain within a jungle zone and once per long rest after striking an enemy.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when you leave the jungle or if you exhaust your uses for the day, whichever comes first.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; regenerates with each long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_gauntlet_of_the_treant_g.priceReason: The gauntlet's rare crafting materials and unique enchantments justify its modest price point in terms of XP value.

dk_isles_jungle_gear.name: Jungle Scales of the Whispering Fang
dk_isles_jungle_gear.description: The Jungle Scales of the Whispering Fang are crafted from the ancient armor of a fabled jungle beast, its scales imbued with the whispers of the forest itself. These scales hum in tune with the rustling leaves and animal calls, granting the wearer a fleeting camouflage amidst the dense foliage. The scales not only enhance stealth but also amplify the effectiveness of any ambushes, making the wearer's shadow more potent than ever before.

effectDetails.title: Camouflage in Jungle Terrain
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to remain hidden within dense jungle terrain for a duration of 10 seconds. This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Amplify Ambush Effectiveness
effectDetails.rules: While in stealth, the wearer deals an additional +20% damage to creatures they successfully ambush during combat. This bonus is cumulative with other sources of damage boosts and can only be used when the wearer has a valid target within their reach.

dk_isles_jungle_gear.levelRequirementReason: The scales require a certain level of experience and skill to wield effectively in the dense jungle.
dk_isles_jungle_gear.vendorReason: The vendors at DK Isles have extensive networks that extend deep into the heart of the jungle, allowing them to source rare items such as these scales.
dk_isles_jungle_gear.shippingDetail: Delivered by Swiftwind Courier within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until the wearer is seen or detected, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the wearer is no longer hidden in dense jungle terrain or if they are discovered by an opponent.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per short or long rest

dk_isles_jungle_gear.priceReason: This item's unique properties and rarity justify its moderate price, offering both defensive and offensive advantages.

dk_isles_jungle_gear_core.name: Jungle Gear Core
dk_isles_jungle_gear_core.description: The Jungle Gear Core, a pulsating crystalline core of verdant hue, is forged in the heart of the ancient jungle. When embedded into gear, it grants the wearer enhanced resistance to environmental hazards and the ability to call upon the creatures that roam the wilds for short-term assistance. Wielders can also increase their chances of uncovering hidden treasures by drawing on the core’s mystical resonance with the flora and fauna.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +20% bonus to saving throws against environmental hazards common in jungles, such as poison, disease, and extreme heat or cold. This effect is passive until the core is removed.

effectDetails.title: Summon Jungle Allies
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can call upon nearby jungle creatures for short-term assistance. The summoned allies provide temporary aid in combat or exploration, but their duration depends on the specific creature called (typically lasting until the start of the next long rest).

dk_isles_jungle_gear_core.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Gear Core is designed to be accessible early in adventuring careers, providing a tangible boon for any explorer or combatant venturing into tropical jungles.
dk_isles_jungle_gear_core.vendorReason: The vendors at DK Isles are renowned for their deep connections with the jungle and its inhabitants, making them the perfect purveyors of this core.
dk_isles_jungle_gear_core.shippingDetail: The Shy Guy Smugglers ensure that each Jungle Gear Core is carefully packed in a woven basket lined with moss to protect it from damage during transport through treacherous jungle paths.

usage.duration: Until the next long rest
usage.endsWhen: Removal of the core, end of a long rest, or upon death of the user

dk_isles_jungle_gear_core.priceReason: The Jungle Gear Core strikes a balance between providing significant benefits and being accessible early in an adventurer's journey.

dk_isles_jungle_gear_of_the_blood_leopar.name: Jungle Gear of the Blood Leopard
dk_isles_jungle_gear_of_the_blood_leopar.description: The Jungle Gear of the Blood Leopard is crafted from the leather of jungle leopards and imbued with their ferocity. This enchanted armor not only grants its wearer stealth in dense undergrowth but also amplifies their agility, allowing them to move swiftly through the thick canopy without being detected by foes. The gear's feral essence enhances reflexes, providing a 10% chance for the wearer to trigger a jungle roar, stunning nearby enemies for 3 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Roar
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has a 10% chance to trigger the jungle roar as a bonus action. This effect stuns all creatures within 30 feet for 3 seconds, but it can only be used once every long rest.

effectDetails.title: Swift Movement
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this armor, the wearer's movement speed increases by +20% in dense vegetation, making them nearly invisible to foes. This effect is passive and lasts until the wearer exits a jungle biome or takes damage.

dk_isles_jungle_gear_of_the_blood_leopar.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Gear of the Blood Leopard requires a minimum level of 5 due to its enchanted nature and the complex magic woven into it.
dk_isles_jungle_gear_of_the_blood_leopar.vendorReason: As merchants of exotic goods from the deep jungle, dk Isles is known for carrying rare and powerful items like the Jungle Gear of the Blood Leopard.
dk_isles_jungle_gear_of_the_blood_leopar.shippingDetail: The gear arrives via Lakitu Drones, ensuring it reaches its destination swiftly and in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Lasts until the wearer exits a jungle biome or takes damage.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer leaves a jungle biome or sustains damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one jungle roar per long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_gear_of_the_blood_leopar.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's rarity and the complex enchantment required to craft such powerful gear.

dk_isles_jungle_gut.name: Jungle Gut
dk_isles_jungle_gut.description: The Jungle Gut, a potent fermented root concoction crafted from the heart of the deep jungle, amplifies the drinker's strength and speed in harmony with nature's fury. For fleeting moments, warriors are blessed with bursts of raw power and fleet-footed agility, while visions of mythical jungle beasts dance in their minds, boosting squad morale to heroic heights. This ancient brew is a cherished companion for those who venture into the untamed wilds.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the drinker gains a +20% bonus to Strength for 30 seconds. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Speed Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: The imbiber also experiences a +15% increase in movement speed while under the effects of Jungle Gut, with no save required to resist this boost. This effect lasts for 30 seconds and can be used once per short or long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_gut.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Gut's potent effects demand a certain level of physical conditioning.
dk_isles_jungle_gut.vendorReason: The DK Isles traders are renowned for their knowledge of jungle flora and fauna, making them the perfect purveyors of this ancient brew.
dk_isles_jungle_gut.shippingDetail: Delivery is swift but requires a week's passage through treacherous jungles. The delivery may be delayed by unforeseen weather or terrain challenges.

usage.duration: 30 seconds, with one use per short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect duration ends when the time expires or the user takes damage.

dk_isles_jungle_gut.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its potent effects and the effort required for its preparation in the deep jungle.

dk_isles_jungle_heart_seed.name: Jungle Heart Seed
dk_isles_jungle_heart_seed.description: The Jungle Heart Seed is a vibrant, heart-shaped seed with a shimmering surface that hints at ancient magic. When planted in the rich soil of the dense jungle, it rapidly grows into an ethereal tree whose leaves pulse with life energy. The plant's roots run deep beneath the earth, drawing its strength from the very heart of the forest. Consuming this seed is akin to embracing the wild; it instantly heals 100 hit points and grants a surge of vitality that regenerates stamina at a rate of 5% per minute for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Healing
effectDetails.rules: Eating the seed heals the user for 100 hit points. The effect is instantaneous and has no save DC or duration other than its single-use nature.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: The seed grants a temporary increase in stamina, regenerating at a rate of 5% per minute for up to one hour after consumption. This effect ends when the user is no longer within the immediate vicinity of a jungle environment or if the user spends an action to halt it.

dk_isles_jungle_heart_seed.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Heart Seed is accessible to low-level adventurers as its magic can be harnessed by even neophytes, though only those with some experience in the jungle's mysteries truly understand its secrets.
dk_isles_jungle_heart_seed.vendorReason: The dk Isles are deeply connected to the natural world and often trade items that draw power from their lands.
dk_isles_jungle_heart_seed.shippingDetail: The seeds are carefully packed in soil to ensure they remain viable during transport, a process that can take several days depending on weather conditions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous healing; stamina regeneration lasts for up to one hour
usage.endsWhen: Leaves the immediate vicinity of jungle terrain or is halted by an action

dk_isles_jungle_heart_seed.priceReason: The price reflects the exotic nature of the seed, its unique origin from the heart of the Jungle Isles, and the careful cultivation required to ensure its potency.

dk_isles_jungle_hive_core_potion.name: Hive Core Potion
dk_isles_jungle_hive_core_potion.description: A vial of venomous green fluid exudes a faint hum as it glows faintly, reminiscent of ancient Kremling nests deep within the jungle. Drinking this potion grants you temporary immunity to poison and allows your legs to feel lighter, boosting your speed through dense undergrowth by 20%. Additionally, the potion leaves behind a shimmering trail that reveals hidden paths and enemy movements for thirty seconds, aiding in stealth and ambush.

effectDetails.title: Poison Immunity
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary immunity to poison effects for a duration of one minute. This effect ends when the duration expires or you take any poison damage.

effectDetails.title: Increased Speed
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes, your walking speed is increased by 20%. This effect ends if you fall unconscious or upon taking an action that requires concentration.

dk_isles_jungle_hive_core_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion provides a significant but not game-breaking advantage to adventurers of all levels.
dk_isles_jungle_hive_core_potion.vendorReason: The potions sold by DK Isles are renowned for their unique and potent ingredients harvested from the jungles surrounding their island homelands.
dk_isles_jungle_hive_core_potion.shippingDetail: Ships within three days, delivered via Lakitu's express courier service. Fragile items must be handled with care to maintain potency.

usage.activation: Consume the potion as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Poison immunity lasts for one minute, speed boost lasts for ten minutes.
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends when expired or upon taking poison damage, falling unconscious, or concentration required actions.

dk_isles_jungle_hive_core_potion.priceReason: The potion combines a rare and potent venom with advanced preservation techniques to ensure its effectiveness, making it a valuable but not overpowered item.

dk_isles_jungle_ice_gear.name: Jungle Ice Gear
dk_isles_jungle_ice_gear.description: The Jungle Ice Gear is a set of armor forged from the frost veins deep within the jungle's heart, where ancient cold magic courses through the roots and vines. Its icy plating grants you unmatched mobility in the dense undergrowth, allowing for swift evasion among the trees. When near ice elements, the gear amplifies your agility, offering a +10% bonus to movement speed. Struck by enemies, it calls forth a spectral frost elemental that dances around you, providing an additional 5% chance of summoning this guardian when attacked.

effectDetails.title: Frost Elemental Summon
effectDetails.rules: When you are hit by a melee attack, there is a 5% chance to summon a spectral frost elemental that provides temporary defense for 1 minute. The elemental dissipates if it takes damage.

effectDetails.title: Mobility Boost
effectDetails.rules: While within 30 feet of ice elements such as frozen streams or glaciers, you gain a +10% bonus to your movement speed. This effect is active for the duration of your exploration in icy conditions.

dk_isles_jungle_ice_gear.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Ice Gear requires a character level of at least 5 due to its intricate craftsmanship and the magical energies it channels.
dk_isles_jungle_ice_gear.vendorReason: As native craftsmen of the jungle, the DK Isles are well-versed in creating gear that harnesses the region's elemental magic.
dk_isles_jungle_ice_gear.shippingDetail: Delivered by Boo Spectral Mail within a week, this courier ensures the gear arrives imbued with its frost powers.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon wearing. Frost Elemental Summon triggered on melee attack hits.
usage.duration: Frost Elemental lasts for 1 minute or until it takes damage.
usage.endsWhen: The elemental dissipates if it takes damage; otherwise, it ends when the gear is removed or you leave icy conditions.

dk_isles_jungle_ice_gear.priceReason: Crafted from rare jungle ice and ancient magic, this gear commands a price reflecting its unique properties and the expertise of DK Isles artisans.

dk_isles_jungle_jester_ring.name: Jungle Jester Ring
dk_isles_jungle_jester_ring.description: The Jungle Jester Ring is a mischievous relic crafted by the first prankster god of the lost jungle temple. Its laughter can disarm foes and disrupt plans, making it a perilous companion for those who laugh too hard. When struck in combat, the ring's wearer triggers an uncontrollable fit that disarms their foe for 1 round. It also grants +20% evasion while engaging in pranks but deals an additional 1d6 damage if worn during a heist.

effectDetails.title: Disarm Foemen
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is struck in combat, they trigger an uncontrollable fit of laughter that disarms their foe for 1 round. This effect has a 5% chance to occur per hit taken by the wearer and requires no action from them.

effectDetails.title: Prankster Evasion
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this ring, the wearer gains +20% evasion while engaging in pranks or mischievous activities. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn and can be activated once per short rest.

dk_isles_jungle_jester_ring.levelRequirementReason: The ring's unpredictable effects require a moderate level to control.
dk_isles_jungle_jester_ring.vendorReason: DK Isles is known for its eclectic array of relics and artifacts from forgotten cults and temples.
dk_isles_jungle_jester_ring.shippingDetail: Ships with special care, ensuring the ring's power remains intact during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous on being struck in combat; Prankster Evasion once per short rest.
usage.duration: Disarm Foemen lasts for 1 round. Prankster Evasion lasts until the end of the wearer’s next turn.
usage.endsWhen: Disarm Foemen ends when the wearer is no longer struck in combat, or the foe makes a successful saving throw against its effect. Prankster Evasion ends at the start of the wearer's next turn.

dk_isles_jungle_jester_ring.priceReason: The ring's unpredictable effects and unique crafting make it moderately priced for its power.

dk_isles_jungle_mist_bottle.name: Jungle Mist Bottle
dk_isles_jungle_mist_bottle.description: The Jungle Mist Bottle is a vial of misty green vapor, its glass bottle crafted from the bark of ancient jungle trees. When shaken, it releases a cloud that masks your movements from sight, making you invisible to enemy eyes for an extra two seconds. The low growl it emits can be heard by foes within 10 feet, causing them to stagger and lose their balance for one round with a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Duration +2 Seconds
effectDetails.rules: The user gains the benefit of the Stealth action for an additional two seconds when they shake the bottle. This effect does not stack with other sources of stealth.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Stagger on Touch
effectDetails.rules: When shaken, the bottle emits a low growl that causes creatures within 10 feet to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they are stunned for one round.

dk_isles_jungle_mist_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginning adventurers who need to navigate the jungle without detection.
dk_isles_jungle_mist_bottle.vendorReason: The DK Isles merchants specialize in crafting and trading items that aid travelers through their treacherous jungles.
dk_isles_jungle_mist_bottle.shippingDetail: This item ships via Pipe Express, known for its reliable delivery service within the islands.

usage.activation: A bonus action to shake the bottle and release its misty contents.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of your next turn when shaken.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user is no longer hidden or if they are struck by an attack.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one bottle can be used at a time.

dk_isles_jungle_mist_bottle.priceReason: The price reflects the rare materials and intricate craftsmanship required to produce this jungle survival aid.

dk_isles_jungle_mist_shroud.name: Jungle Mist Shroud
dk_isles_jungle_mist_shroud.description: The Jungle Mist Shroud is a woven cloak that shimmers like the misty jungle itself, blending the wearer into the dense foliage. In the heart of the jungle, it glows faintly in darkness, revealing hidden paths and ambushes. This ancient artifact was crafted by the Enchanted Weavers of the Distant Isles to protect travelers from predation. Its glow is a living force that interacts with the environment, making the wearer nearly invisible to jungle predators and enhancing stealth within biomes.
effects: Glows faintly in darkness revealing hidden paths

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +20 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks within jungle biomes. This effect is active as long as the shroud is worn and not destroyed or removed.

effectDetails.title: Dark Path Reveal
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this item, the wearer can use an action to make a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to reveal hidden paths. This effect has no cooldown but cannot be used more than once per long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_mist_shroud.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the enchantments requires at least third-level spellcasting proficiency.
dk_isles_jungle_mist_shroud.vendorReason: The Enchanted Weavers of Distant Isles are renowned for their magical craftsmanship, and this item is one of their most sought-after creations.
dk_isles_jungle_mist_shroud.shippingDetail: Due to the delicate nature of the shroud's enchantments, it must be delivered by Shy Guy Smugglers within a week or risk losing its magical properties.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required. The wearer can use an action once per long rest to make a check and reveal hidden paths.
usage.duration: Active as long as the item is worn
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed, removed from the wearer's body, or its magical properties are lost due to improper delivery by Shy Guy Smugglers.

dk_isles_jungle_mist_shroud.priceReason: The item's enchantments and craftsmanship make it a valuable asset for adventurers navigating the dangerous jungles.

dk_isles_jungle_mistblade.name: Jungle Mistblade
dk_isles_jungle_mistblade.description: The Jungle Mistblade is a curved shadowwood blade imbued with mist from the densest parts of the DK Isles' jungles. It whispers the forest's secrets and strikes with feral precision, its edge sharp enough to cut through even the thickest vines. This weapon enhances your agility in jungle terrain, making you nearly invisible to foes in low-light conditions while also granting a significant dodge chance against attacks from within these biomes.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Whispers
effectDetails.rules: While wielding the Jungle Mistblade, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when within a jungle biome. Additionally, you gain a +30% chance to dodge enemy attacks in such environments.

effectDetails.title: Mist Veil
effectDetails.rules: In low-light conditions, you and any allies within 10 feet of you are considered invisible to hostile creatures with darkvision or similar abilities. This effect lasts for 1 minute per use and ends when you attack, cast a spell, or move out of the jungle biome.

dk_isles_jungle_mistblade.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Mistblade's enchantments require a certain degree of finesse and experience to wield effectively in its native environment.
dk_isles_jungle_mistblade.vendorReason: The local artisans of the DK Isles are adept at crafting weapons that resonate with their natural surroundings, making the Jungle Mistblade a perfect fit for their inventory.
dk_isles_jungle_mistblade.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, known for its reliable and swift delivery through any terrain, ensuring your blade arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use; ends when you attack, cast a spell, or move out of the jungle biome.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires after 1 minute, is ended by attacking, casting a spell, moving out of a jungle biome, or running out of charges.

dk_isles_jungle_mistblade.priceReason: The Jungle Mistblade's unique enchantments and craftsmanship justify its fair value in XP, offering both tactical advantages and thematic immersion for adventurers navigating the DK Isles' jungles.

dk_isles_jungle_moonfang_bow.name: Moonfang Jungle Bow
dk_isles_jungle_moonfang_bow.description: Moonfang Jungle Bow, a sleek obsidian-forged weapon imbued by the ancient spirits of the jungle, is said to have been crafted from the fangs of the moon-shadowed creatures themselves. This bow fires arrows that are laced with potent venom, capable of turning even the most resilient foes into trembling shadows within moments. Its deadly precision and the poison it delivers make it a favored weapon among those who navigate the dense foliage of the jungle.

effectDetails.title: Venomous Arrows
effectDetails.rules: When an arrow strikes a target, it inflicts poison damage equal to 10% of the target's hit points per second for 6 rounds. The target can use its action to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw to end this effect early.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Precision
effectDetails.rules: This weapon grants you advantage on attack rolls against jungle creatures and increases your critical hit chance by 15%. This bonus does not stack with other sources of critical hit bonuses.

dk_isles_jungle_moonfang_bow.levelRequirementReason: The balance of the jungle demands that only those who have proven their worth through experience wield Moonfang Jungle Bow.
dk_isles_jungle_moonfang_bow.vendorReason: As guardians of the wild, dk Isles is entrusted with the most potent and rare weapons from the heart of the jungle.
dk_isles_jungle_moonfang_bow.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, Moonfang Jungle Bow requires special packaging and expedited delivery through Pipe Express.

usage.duration: Instantaneous with each attack
usage.endsWhen: The arrow strikes a target or the effect is ended by a successful saving throw

dk_isles_jungle_moonfang_bow.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique crafting and potent effects in jungle combat.

dk_isles_jungle_moss_essence.name: Jungle Moss Essence
dk_isles_jungle_moss_essence.description: The Jungle Moss Essence radiates a soft, emerald glow that illuminates the dense jungle canopy without drawing unwanted attention. This bioluminescent moss not only heals 50 hit points upon consumption but also grants you a fleeting advantage in stealth, allowing you to move silently as if hiding among foliage. For ten seconds, your presence becomes indistinguishable from the surrounding environment, perfect for covert missions or survival deep within the verdant heart of the forest.

effectDetails.title: Bioluminescent Glow
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the Jungle Moss Essence releases a soft, emerald glow that illuminates your surroundings for ten seconds. This effect has no save DC and is instantaneous.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Advantage
effectDetails.rules: For 10 seconds after consuming the essence, you gain a +3 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. The effect ends when you take damage or if you voluntarily end it.

dk_isles_jungle_moss_essence.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and adventurers who need basic survival skills.
dk_isles_jungle_moss_essence.vendorReason: The DK Isles traders specialize in rare jungle flora, making them the perfect source for this unique essence.
dk_isles_jungle_moss_essence.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its swift and reliable delivery through enchanted means.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or voluntarily end the effect

dk_isles_jungle_moss_essence.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its rarity and utility in survival and stealth scenarios.

dk_isles_jungle_moss_shield.name: Jungle Moss Shield
dk_isles_jungle_moss_shield.description: The Jungle Moss Shield is a verdant barrier that thrives in the dense jungles of the Dusk Isles. Its surface glistens with emerald hues, pulsing with primal energy. This living shield not only absorbs damage but also slowly regenerates its own HP, making it an indispensable companion for any jungle expedition or battle. When fully charged, it emits a deafening sonic pulse that disrupts enemy targeting and momentarily blinds foes within range.

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption
effectDetails.rules: The shield absorbs up to 30% of incoming damage. The absorbed damage is converted into health for the shield, regenerating at a rate of 1 HP per second while active.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Targeting Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Activating the shield's full charge emits a sonic pulse that disrupts enemy targeting within a 20-foot radius. This effect lasts for 3 seconds and has no save DC, but it can only be used once per short or long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_moss_shield.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Moss Shield is designed to be versatile enough for beginners while still providing significant utility.
dk_isles_jungle_moss_shield.vendorReason: As natives of the Dusk Isles, the dk_isles have a deep connection with the natural world and can cultivate such unique items.
dk_isles_jungle_moss_shield.shippingDetail: The shield is carefully packed to withstand long-distance travel through the dense foliage and treacherous terrain of the islands.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (one-time use per rest)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short or long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per rest

dk_isles_jungle_moss_shield.priceReason: The shield's rarity and the skill required to cultivate it justify its fair value in XP.

dk_isles_jungle_mud.name: Mud Golem Shackle
dk_isles_jungle_mud.description: The Mud Golem Shackle, forged from the ancient bones of jungle mud golems, is a heavy, moss-covered shackle that whispers secrets of the deep jungle when worn. Its wearer gains temporary invisibility and resistance to knockback, making them an elusive target in the dense foliage. Crafted by the dark arts, this shackle enhances the user's attacks within jungle terrain, increasing critical hit chance by 5%. The shackle is a rare find from the mysterious DK Isles, where it was discovered in ancient tombs.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility Burst
effectDetails.rules: When stationary for at least one minute, the wearer can activate this effect to become temporarily invisible. This lasts for 1 turn (6 turns total). The wearer must remain still during this duration; movement or combat ends invisibility early.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Terrain Boost
effectDetails.rules: While within jungle terrain, the user gains +5% critical hit chance when attacking. This effect is active as long as they are in a jungle environment and does not require activation.

dk_isles_jungle_mud.levelRequirementReason: This shackle's potent abilities demand sufficient experience to wield its power effectively.
dk_isles_jungle_mud.vendorReason: The DK Isles is renowned for their mystical artifacts, and the Mud Golem Shackle is a prime example of their craftsmanship.
dk_isles_jungle_mud.shippingDetail: Ships via spirit courier; expedited delivery but requires a week's notice.

usage.activation: Uses an action to activate Invisibility Burst. Jungle Terrain Boost is passive and does not require activation.
usage.duration: Invisibility Burst lasts for 1 turn (6 turns total). Jungle Terrain Boost is active as long as the user remains in jungle terrain.
usage.endsWhen: Invisibility Burst ends early with movement or combat; Jungle Terrain Boost expires when leaving a jungle environment.

dk_isles_jungle_mud.priceReason: The Mud Golem Shackle's rarity and unique abilities justify its high price, reflecting the value of its mystical properties.

dk_isles_jungle_nectar.name: Jungle Nectar of the Whispering Roots
dk_isles_jungle_nectar.description: The Jungle Nectar of the Whispering Roots is a shimmering green elixir that sparkles with the essence of ancient flora. It was crafted from rare roots by the Toads of the Dusk Isles, whose wisdom and cunning are unmatched in the world. Sip this nectar cautiously; it's said to be imbued with the spirit of a Toad who fought tooth and claw against captivity, granting you invisibility and enhanced speed for a fleeting moment.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility (5s)
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary invisibility for 5 seconds. You can use this ability once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost (+40%)
effectDetails.rules: Your movement speed is increased by 40% for 10 seconds, allowing you to traverse the jungle with unmatched agility. This effect also grants a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

dk_isles_jungle_nectar.levelRequirementReason: This nectar's potency is accessible to all adventurers, as its effects are not tied to high-level skills or abilities.
dk_isles_jungle_nectar.vendorReason: The Dusk Isles have a deep connection with the flora and fauna of their jungles, making them the perfect purveyors of this elixir.
dk_isles_jungle_nectar.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring you receive your nectar in peak condition.

usage.duration: 5 seconds of invisibility and 10 seconds of speed boost
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire after the stated duration or if you take any damage

dk_isles_jungle_nectar.priceReason: This price reflects its rare origin, potent effects, and the time required to harvest and process the nectar.

dk_isles_jungle_nectar_of_the_vines.name: Jungle Nectar of the Vines
dk_isles_jungle_nectar_of_the_vines.description: The Jungle Nectar of the Vines is a shimmering elixir drawn from the ancient roots of the jungle’s oldest trees. Its golden hue and fragrant aroma hint at its power to heal wounds and quicken reflexes in the wilds. Drinkers move with the grace of vines through dense undergrowth, their movements undetectable by most predators for 10 seconds. This nectar not only grants temporary regeneration but also shields against harm, absorbing a portion of incoming damage.

effectDetails.title: Regeneration Boost
effectDetails.rules: The drinker regains 1d6+2 hit points over the next 10 seconds. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Agility Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: For 30 seconds, the drinker’s speed increases by 15 feet while in jungle terrain only. The effect ends if the drinker leaves the jungle or takes damage.

dk_isles_jungle_nectar_of_the_vines.levelRequirementReason: Beginners should be able to access this nectar early on but still require a minimum level to appreciate its full benefits.
dk_isles_jungle_nectar_of_the_vines.vendorReason: The Dk Isles natives have long revered the jungle for its secrets and medicines, making them adept at sourcing such potent elixirs.
dk_isles_jungle_nectar_of_the_vines.shippingDetail: Ships within one week via Lakitu Express, ensuring freshness upon arrival.

usage.duration: 10 seconds and 30 seconds respectively for regeneration and agility boost
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the drinker leaves jungle terrain or takes damage

dk_isles_jungle_nectar_of_the_vines.priceReason: Balanced against other rare elixirs, this nectar offers significant benefits for its price.

dk_isles_jungle_nectar_potion.name: Jungle Nectar Potion
dk_isles_jungle_nectar_potion.description: The Jungle Nectar Potion is a shimmering, emerald-green elixir collected from the sacred bloom of the jungle’s heart. Its aroma carries the scent of wildflowers and earth, infusing the drinker with vitality. When consumed, it not only restores 150 hit points but also grants the imbiber stealth in jungle zones, making them nearly invisible to foes for a brief moment. The potion's effects are as unpredictable as nature itself, offering a fleeting window of advantage to those who dare to venture into the jungle’s depths.

effectDetails.title: Health Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Consume the potion to gain 150 hit points. This effect is instantaneous and has no save or duration.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Stealth
effectDetails.rules: For 15 seconds, you are considered invisible in jungle zones. Creatures within a 30-foot radius have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice you while this effect lasts. This ability is limited to once per long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_nectar_potion.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all adventurers, as the potion's effects are potent yet balanced.
dk_isles_jungle_nectar_potion.vendorReason: The DK Isles have established trade routes through the jungle, and their traders are known to gather rare elixirs like this one.
dk_isles_jungle_nectar_potion.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe delivery even in treacherous zones.

usage.duration: 15 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you take damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only once per long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_nectar_potion.priceReason: The potion's rarity and the unique benefits it offers justify its price of 1000 XP.

dk_isles_jungle_rage_talisman.name: Jungle Rage Talisman
dk_isles_jungle_rage_talisman.description: The Jungle Rage Talisman channels the untamed fury of the ancient jungles, its core pulsing with primal energy. When worn in a jungle, it grants a +30% attack speed and damage bonus during combat. With each swing of your weapon, there's an exhilarating 10% chance to trigger a wild surge that stuns foes for 2 seconds, adding chaos to the battlefield. This talisman is forged from the bones and essence of jungle spirits, imbued with the very essence of the forest’s wrath.
effects: 10% chance to trigger Wild Jungle Surge (stuns for 2s)

effectDetails.title: Wild Jungle Surge
effectDetails.rules: When you attack an enemy within a jungle, there's a 10% chance that your weapon strike will trigger a wild surge. This effect stuns the targeted creature for 2 seconds. The surge has no save DC and can occur once per minute.

effectDetails.title: Increased Melee Accuracy
effectDetails.rules: While in jungle terrain, you gain a +15 bonus to your attack rolls with melee weapons. This benefit lasts as long as you remain within the jungle and does not stack with other bonuses.

dk_isles_jungle_rage_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The talisman's raw power demands a minimum character level of 3 to wield.
dk_isles_jungle_rage_talisman.vendorReason: The artisans of Dk Isles are renowned for their deep connection with primal magic, making them the perfect purveyors of this jungle-forged relic.
dk_isles_jungle_rage_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships via a Rakasha spirit courier, ensuring swift delivery within days.

usage.activation: The talisman activates on contact with an enemy in jungle terrain. Its effects last until the start of your next turn after using an action or bonus action to attack.
usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You leave a jungle, use an action or bonus action to attack again without triggering the surge, or you are incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the talisman recharges after a long rest.

dk_isles_jungle_rage_talisman.priceReason: The talisman's rare crafting materials and deep jungle essence make it an expensive but powerful addition to any adventurer’s arsenal.

dk_isles_jungle_rainfall_glove.name: Jungle Rainfall Glove
dk_isles_jungle_rainfall_glove.description: The Jungle Rainfall Glove is a rare artifact crafted from the enchanted leaves of the Rainclaw Vine and the bones of ancient jungle guardians. When activated, it summons a cascade of rain that blankets the ground in slippery mud, reducing enemy movement speed by 20% for 10 seconds. The glove also emits a subtle hum, temporarily weakening foes' armor enough to deal an extra 5 damage on attacks made against them.

effectDetails.title: Rainstorm Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user must be in an open area to summon the rainstorm, which lasts for 10 seconds. Enemies within a 20-foot radius are affected by a -20% movement speed penalty. This effect ends if the user takes any damage or moves more than 10 feet away from their starting position.

effectDetails.title: Armor Weakness
effectDetails.rules: Enemies struck by attacks made during the rainstorm have their AC reduced by 4 for a duration of 5 seconds. This effect is limited to one use per minute and requires no action to activate once the rainstorm begins.

dk_isles_jungle_rainfall_glove.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to wield due to its complex enchantments.
dk_isles_jungle_rainfall_glove.vendorReason: DK Isles is known for their deep jungle knowledge and crafting expertise, making them the ideal vendor for this artifact.
dk_isles_jungle_rainfall_glove.shippingDetail: The gloves are shipped via a specialized Void Drifter pod that ensures they arrive in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon rainstorm and attack during its duration.
usage.duration: 10 seconds for the rainstorm, with armor weakness lasting 5 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user takes damage or moves more than 10 feet from their starting position.

dk_isles_jungle_rainfall_glove.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare crafting materials and unique abilities that aid in combat without being overpowered.

dk_isles_jungle_scarab_helm.name: Jungle Scarab Helm
dk_isles_jungle_scarab_helm.description: The Jungle Scarab Helm is a relic crafted from the bones of ancient jungle serpents and obsidian, imbued with the essence of the rainforest. This helm not only grants stealth in dense foliage but also enhances melee attacks by channeling the ambient vibrations of the jungle. Its wearer moves silently through the undergrowth and strikes true among the thick canopy, where its serpentine visage seems to blend seamlessly with the shadows.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this helm in dense jungle terrain, you gain a +30% bonus to your stealth checks. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action or reaction.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Melee Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When within 60 feet of dense foliage, you gain a +15 bonus to melee attack rolls. The helm’s vibrations enhance your strikes for the duration of one short rest.

dk_isles_jungle_scarab_helm.levelRequirementReason: This relic is crafted for those who venture into the heart of the jungle, requiring at least third-level proficiency in survival and stealth.
dk_isles_jungle_scarab_helm.vendorReason: The Dk Isles have long traded with the ancient tribes that crafted this helm, ensuring its authenticity and power.
dk_isles_jungle_scarab_helm.shippingDetail: Due to the delicate nature of the helm's materials, it is shipped via the Void Drifter Relay, which guarantees safe delivery within one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for stealth, lasts until the end of your next short rest for melee attacks.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire at the start of your next long rest or when removed from a dense jungle environment.

dk_isles_jungle_scarab_helm.priceReason: This helm is crafted with rare materials and ancient techniques, making it a valuable yet balanced purchase for adventurers.

dk_isles_jungle_scarab_ward.name: Jungle Scarab Ward
dk_isles_jungle_scarab_ward.description: Crafted from the ancient jungle's obsidian and encrusted with scarab shells, this glowing amulet transforms its wearer into a master of concealment within the verdant labyrinth. The Jungle Scarab Ward grants temporary camouflage that allows you to evade detection by predators and scouts for ten seconds, while also offering immunity against all poisons found in the jungle's treacherous flora. Its bonus to critical strikes from behind cover adds an element of stealthy prowess, making it a prized tool among jungle explorers and adventurers.

effectDetails.title: Camouflage

When uncorked in a moment of need, it increases your Stealth by +10% for 30 seconds, revealing secret paths or enemies within 30 meters. However, misuse can lead to brief disorientation, making you more vulnerable for the next hour.

dk_isles_jungle_scent_spray.name: Jungle Scent Spray
dk_isles_jungle_scent_spray.description: The Jungle Scent Spray exudes a thick, fetid mist that swirls like living decay. dk_isles_jungle_scented_leaves.name: Scented Jungle Leaves
dk_isles_jungle_scented_leaves.description: The Scented Jungle Leaves are a rare find from the dense canopies of the Dusk Isles, their fragrant aroma masking your scent as surely as the wind conceals a whisper. dk_isles_jungle_soul_amber.name: Jungle Soul Amber

dk_isles_jungle_soul_bolt.name: Jungle Soul Bolt

Crafted by ancient spirits from the heartwood of primordial trees, it channels primal fury when wielded in combat. A mere flicker of this weapon can disrupt an enemy's focus, causing confusion that lasts for several tense heartbeats, while its strike also reduces their armor's effectiveness, leaving them vulnerable to further attacks.

effectDetails.rules: If an ambush is triggered within a 30-foot radius of the wearer, there is a +10% chance that the ambush will be successful. This effect lasts until the end of the encounter or until the wearer moves out of the jungle terrain.

dk_isles_jungle_spirit_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The Jungle Spirit Satchel is accessible to low-level adventurers who need a reliable edge in stealth and combat.
dk_isles_jungle_spirit_satchel.vendorReason: As the makers of this item, the inhabitants of Dk Isles are well-acquainted with its capabilities and value.
dk_isles_jungle_spirit_satchel.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days by Swiftleaf, ensuring the satchel arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn; no activation required.
usage.duration: 10 minutes per long rest or until moved out of jungle terrain.
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon moving out of dense jungle or at the end of an encounter.

dk_isles_jungle_spirit_satchel.priceReason: The Jungle Spirit Satchel provides significant tactical advantages, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer navigating the treacherous jungles of Dk Isles.
