effectDetails.rules: For every hour spent in the presence of dough folk, their loyalty towards you increases by 10%. This effect ends when the scarf is removed or if the wearer spends more than 24 hours away from freshly baked goods.

doughnut_hole_sugar_scarf.levelRequirementReason: A simple scarf that enhances basic baking skills, this item doesn't require a high level to benefit from its effects.
doughnut_hole_sugar_scarf.vendorReason: The local bakers of LEclaire Isle are the creators and purveyors of such a cherished accessory.
doughnut_hole_sugar_scarf.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, arriving within one week from order placement.

usage.duration: 12 hours after being removed or away from freshly baked goods
usage.endsWhen: The scarf is removed or the wearer spends more than 24 hours without being near freshly baked goods

doughnut_hole_sugar_scarf.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item offers a unique and flavorful enhancement that supports both social interactions and practical skills.

doughnut_hole_tide_bark.name: Tide Bark
doughnut_hole_tide_bark.description: Tide Bark is a gnarled piece of ancient tree bark, its surface etched with patterns that shimmer like waves. Crafted in the heart of the Void Rift, it is said to be infused with the cosmic tides and bound to the whims of the Boos' real estate monopoly. When wielded, it allows the user to call upon tidal forces, granting a +2 bonus to all damage rolls against entities from Animatopia and causing the wielder to become temporarily attuned to the Star Road's ebb and flow.

effectDetails.title: Tidal Surge
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this effect grants the wielder a +2 bonus to all damage rolls against entities from Animatopia. This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Star Road Tether
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the user becomes attuned to the Star Road's ebb and flow for 1 minute. During this time, they can cast the spell *Locate Object* once without expending a spell slot.

doughnut_hole_tide_bark.levelRequirementReason: The intricate enchantments require a minimum of fifth level to wield effectively.
doughnut_hole_tide_bark.vendorReason: Doughnut Hole, with their extensive knowledge of rare and magical artifacts, is the only vendor known to stock such an item from the Void Rift.
doughnut_hole_tide_bark.shippingDetail: Ships via Dark Veil Express, ensuring secrecy and safe delivery.

usage.duration: Until Start of Next Turn (Tidal Surge), or 1 Minute (Star Road Tether)
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn ends the effect of Tidal Surge. The attunement ends when you become unattuned to the Star Road's ebb and flow, which lasts for 1 minute.

doughnut_hole_tide_bark.priceReason: The item’s rarity and magical properties justify a price of 1000 XP.

dragon_breath_insurance.name: Dragon-Breath Insurance Policy
dragon_breath_insurance.description: The Dragon-Breath Insurance Policy is a notarized contract forged from enchanted parchment and sealed with firestone dust, providing peace of mind against fiery perils. For one year, this ancient document ensures you suffer half damage from all fire-based attacks. If the flames ever claim your life, your body will be restored by dawn, sparing you the cruel embrace of death’s breath. This policy must be renewed annually to maintain its protective grace.
dragon_breath_insurance.shippedBy: Notarized Scroll via Swift Harpy Courier

effectDetails.title: Halved Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: While this policy is active, you take only half damage from fire-based attacks. This effect does not apply to attacks made by yourself or creatures allied with you.

effectDetails.title: Lifeguard Against Flames
effectDetails.rules: If you die as a result of fire damage within the year, your body will be restored at dawn, returning you to life and health. This use is limited to once per policy term.

dragon_breath_insurance.levelRequirementReason: This policy provides basic protection suitable for adventurers regardless of their level.
dragon_breath_insurance.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in unique and rare contracts that can protect you from the unpredictable dangers of the wild.
dragon_breath_insurance.shippingDetail: The document is delivered by a swift harpy courier, ensuring it arrives safely and on time for your renewal.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon purchase; renewed annually.
usage.duration: One year from the date of purchase or renewal.
usage.endsWhen: Upon expiration of one year or if not renewed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per policy term, limited to one restoration.

dragon_breath_insurance.priceReason: The price reflects a balanced cost for providing significant protection against fire-based threats for an entire year.

dragon_egg_incubation.name: Dragon Egg Incubation Service
dragon_egg_incubation.description: The Dragon Egg Incubation Service guarantees the hatching of any dragon egg within six months, ensuring the birth of a majestic creature straight from the heart of legend. A dedicated trainer is included to teach the hatchling basic obedience for its first year, forging a bond that transcends mere training. The service includes all food costs for the first year and ensures the dragon becomes your loyal companion, its CR determined by the whimsical discretion of the DM.

effectDetails.title: Hatched Dragon Companion
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful incubation, a dragon hatches within six months. The trainer ensures the hatchling learns basic obedience for its first year, creating an unbreakable bond between master and pet.

effectDetails.title: Loyalty and Training
effectDetails.rules: The dragon becomes your loyal companion with CR determined by the DM's discretion. The service includes all food costs for the first year, ensuring a healthy and well-trained dragon at your side.

dragon_egg_incubation.levelRequirementReason: Any adventurer can start this journey to bring a legendary creature into the world.
dragon_egg_incubation.vendorReason: Dragon Sanctuary specializes in the care and training of dragons, making them the perfect vendor for this service.
dragon_egg_incubation.shippingDetail: The courier ensures safe delivery within six months.

usage.duration: Ongoing effect until the dragon reaches one year of age.
usage.endsWhen: Dragon reaches its first birthday.

dragon_egg_incubation.priceReason: Balanced at a fraction of the cost to replicate this service elsewhere, ensuring it remains within reach for any adventurer.

dragon_scale_armor_upgrade.name: Dragon Scale Armor Upgrade (Resistant)
dragon_scale_armor_upgrade.description: Dragon Scale Armor Upgrade (Resistant) enhances your armor with scales from ancient, fiery dragons, granting you immunity to acid and resistance to fire. Crafted by the renowned Scale Crafters, these scales imbue your suit of armor with a fierce, living presence that crackles with raw dragon energy. The scales are so fine-grained they form an almost invisible network over the surface, yet their strength is unyielding, providing unparalleled protection against acid and flame in battle.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Acid
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to acid damage. This effect persists as long as the Dragon Scale Armor Upgrade is active.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fire
effectDetails.rules: You have resistance to fire damage while wearing this upgrade. The effect lasts for 1 hour, and you can use it once per short or long rest.

dragon_scale_armor_upgrade.levelRequirementReason: This upgrade is designed for high-level adventurers who face constant threats from acid and fire-based enemies.
dragon_scale_armor_upgrade.vendorReason: Scale Crafters are master blacksmiths known for their unique dragon-scale infusions, making them the ideal vendor for such a powerful item.
dragon_scale_armor_upgrade.shippingDetail: Ships via express courier service provided by Drake Transport. Delivery takes 3 days, during which time the armor remains functional and protected from damage.

usage.activation: This upgrade is applied to your armor as an action, remaining active for 1 hour per use or until destroyed.
usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by fire, expended after a short rest, or removed manually.
usage.charges: Unlimited; you can reapply it once per short or long rest.

dragon_scale_armor_upgrade.priceReason: The cost reflects the rarity and craftsmanship required to infuse dragon scales into armor. The upgrade's effects are limited by its durability, ensuring a fair price for such power.

dragonbreath_potion_brewery.name: Dragonbreath Potion Brewery (Kit)
dragonbreath_potion_brewery.description: The Dragonbreath Potion Brewery (Kit) is a meticulously crafted alchemical device forged in the heart of ancient dragon realms. This kit can brew up to twenty potent fire breath potions each month, allowing you to unleash searing flames from your hands with a mere thought. The rare ingredients required for this potion are sourced only by Alchemical Drakes, ensuring unparalleled quality and potency. This item is not just a tool; it’s a piece of draconic heritage brought into your hands.

effectDetails.title: Fire Breath Potion
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this potion grants the user the ability to unleash fire breath as a bonus action. The breath deals 3d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 10-foot line. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Rare Ingredient Requirement
effectDetails.rules: To brew these potions, you must have access to rare dragon ingredients. These are procured from Alchemical Drakes located in the heart of the Dragonspine Mountains. The process requires a successful DC 18 Craft (Alchemy) check each month.

dragonbreath_potion_brewery.levelRequirementReason: This kit demands a high level to properly handle its potent alchemical effects and ensure safe use.
dragonbreath_potion_brewery.vendorReason: Potion Lab is renowned for their expertise in alchemy and rare ingredient sourcing, making them the perfect vendor for this item.
dragonbreath_potion_brewery.shippingDetail: The crate is delivered via a specialized courier service that ensures safe delivery through extreme temperatures. It arrives with a cool pack to maintain potion freshness.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Starts of your next turn

dragonbreath_potion_brewery.priceReason: This price reflects the high value of dragon ingredients and the complexity of the alchemical process involved.

dragonfire_forge_hammer.name: Dragonfire Forge Hammer (Artifact)
dragonfire_forge_hammer.description: The Dragonfire Forge Hammer, a hammer forged from the molten heart of a dragon and imbued with its fiery essence, glows with an inner flame that dances along its surface. Crafters who wield it can channel the raw power of dragons into their creations, making even the most mundane forge into a furnace of legend. Its wielder's hands are protected by a barrier of incorruptible fire, which repels all but the fiercest flames.

effectDetails.title: Dragonfire Barrier
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains immunity to fire damage and advantage on saving throws against being ignited. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Legendary Craft Boost
effectDetails.rules: When crafting an item with a fire-based component, the wielder has advantage on the Craft check and can increase the success chance by 50%. This ability can be used once per long rest.

dragonfire_forge_hammer.levelRequirementReason: The hammer's power demands a master crafter to handle its fiery might responsibly.
dragonfire_forge_hammer.vendorReason: Forgemaster of the Temple forges and sells items that harness the raw power of legend, including the Dragonfire Forge Hammer.
dragonfire_forge_hammer.shippingDetail: The hammer is delivered by Wyrm Delivery, ensuring safe handling through enchanted means to prevent accidental ignition during transport.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation occurs when the wielder crafts an item with a fire-based component.
usage.duration: Until the end of the wielder's next turn or until the item is completed.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after one use per long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per long rest.

dragonfire_forge_hammer.priceReason: The hammer's rarity and unique crafting abilities justify its fair price of 1000 XP.

dragons_hoard_stabilizer.name: Dragon's Hoard Stabilizer
dragons_hoard_stabilizer.description: The Dragon's Hoard Stabilizer is a meticulously crafted extradimensional safe, forged from ancient dragon scales and imbued with the essence of slumbering wyrm spirits. It creates a secure 500-cubic-foot space where stolen hoards are rendered harmless to all but their rightful owner. If tampered with, it triggers an alarm and unleashes a cataclysmic force—10d10 pounds of pressure from within, ensuring that only the most daring can attempt its contents.

effectDetails.title: Extradimensional Secure Stash
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. The safe creates a stable extradimensional space that can hold up to 500 cubic feet of treasure. Only the owner or those with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check can access it without triggering the alarm.

effectDetails.title: Tamper Alarm & Force Trap
effectDetails.rules: If tampered with, the safe emits an immediate alarm and releases a force effect. A creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 10d10 force damage.

dragons_hoard_stabilizer.levelRequirementReason: Only those experienced enough to handle such ancient magic safely should wield the Dragon's Hoard Stabilizer.
dragons_hoard_stabilizer.vendorReason: The Draconic Consortium has exclusive access to the materials and techniques required for crafting this item.
dragons_hoard_stabilizer.shippingDetail: Ships via a courier dragon, ensuring safe delivery but also a delay of three days due to the mystical nature of the package.

usage.duration: Instantaneous creation and effect; lasts until accessed or tampered with.
usage.endsWhen: Accessed by the owner, tampered with, or destroyed in a forceful event.

dragons_hoard_stabilizer.priceReason: Balanced as it provides significant utility without being overpowered, this item is priced to reflect its legendary rarity and craftsmanship.

dream_stone.name: The Dream Stone
dream_stone.description: The Dream Stone, a glowing crystal of ethereal blue and silver, can manifest dreams into reality, bending time and space to bring visions to life. It is said that its power can transform even the smallest thought into a tangible construct, but those who dare to wield it must beware—its magic is fickle and unpredictable, capable of creating both marvels and nightmares. If shattered, the stone releases a nightmare fog that can cover an entire continent in darkness, driving all who encounter it mad with despair.
effects: Transform into a giant version of yourself

effectDetails.title: Dreamscapes Creation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can focus their will to create a dream construct. This construct is temporary and has hit points equal to your level + Intelligence modifier (rounded down). The construct maintains its form for 1 minute or until it takes damage. If shattered, it releases a nightmare fog that lasts for 1 hour in an area of up to 30 feet radius centered on the point of shattering.

effectDetails.title: Giant Form
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can assume the form of their giant self. This form grants them a +2 bonus to Strength and Dexterity, increases their size by one category (growing from Medium to Large or larger), and confers a +10 foot increase in movement speed for 1 hour.

dream_stone.levelRequirementReason: Only those of great power can control the Dream Stone's volatile nature.
dream_stone.vendorReason: The Shamans of the Moonlit Grove are the custodians of ancient secrets and have access to such potent relics.
dream_stone.shippingDetail: Ships under a full moon, delivered only when the stars align.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for creation; 1 hour for giant form
usage.endsWhen: Damage to dream construct; end of concentration on dreamscapes; 1 hour duration ends naturally
usage.charges: Unlimited, but cannot be used in a way that would cause the wielder harm

dream_stone.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its rarity and danger.

dream_stone_shard.name: Dream Stone Shard
dream_stone_shard.description: The Dream Stone Shard is a shimmering fragment of the ancient stone that cradles dreamscapes. It hums softly, its magic pulsating in sync with slumber's breath. Crafted from the very essence of dreams, it grants access to the dream world at will and can manifest dream objects into reality for fleeting moments. However, those who wield it risk awakening Antasma, the Dreamhound, who might hunt them through the realms.

effectDetails.title: Dreamscapes Passage
effectDetails.rules: This effect allows the user to enter the dream world at will. The duration is instantaneous, and it requires an action. There are no save DCs or limitations on use.

effectDetails.title: Dream Manifestation
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, this effect manifests dream objects into reality for 1 minute. It has a range of touch and requires a successful DC 15 Conjuration check. The manifestation can be ended early by the user or if the shard is destroyed.

dream_stone_shard.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have mastered their control over sleep magic are deemed worthy to wield this powerful shard.
dream_stone_shard.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon, known for its extensive collection of forbidden and arcane items, naturally stocks the Dream Stone Shard among its wares.
dream_stone_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of enchanted pillows, ensuring a soft landing and minimal chance of damage during transit.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action depending on effect used.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Dreamscapes Passage; 1 minute for Dream Manifestation
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed, expended, or ended by the user when manifested objects are dismissed.

dream_stone_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the unique abilities it grants justify its moderate price in experience points.

dreamland_airship_tether.name: Airship Tether
dreamland_airship_tether.description: The Airship Tether is a glowing strand of enchanted hemp that clings to your airship like a tethered cloud. Crafted by the Rakasha artisans in the Dreamlands, this magical rope ensures your vessel remains firmly attached to the ethereal sky. It glows with the soft hue of a distant star, providing a beacon of safety and a symbol of dreamweaver craftsmanship. Only those attuned by a captain or a dreamer can harness its full power, as it allows for seamless flight through the dream-veil clouds that shroud the skies above.

effectDetails.title: Dream Veil Navigation
effectDetails.rules: Allows your airship to navigate through dream-veil clouds without risk of becoming lost or disoriented. This effect is always active while the airship is attuned and tethered, providing a +4 bonus to all navigation checks made within dream-veil clouds.

effectDetails.title: Indestructible Tether
effectDetails.rules: The Airship Tether cannot be cut or broken by any means, including magical attacks. It only breaks if the airship is forcibly removed from a dream realm or if the tethered airship is captured in a non-dream realm.

dreamland_airship_tether.levelRequirementReason: Requires attunement by someone with a deep understanding of both aerial and dream realms.
dreamland_airship_tether.vendorReason: Dreamland’s artisans have mastered the art of crafting items that bridge reality and dreams, making this tether one of their most prestigious works.
dreamland_airship_tether.shippingDetail: Ships via the Rakasha Spirit Walk's ethereal couriers, ensuring safe passage through dream-veil clouds without interruption.

usage.activation: Passive effect while attuned and within a dream realm.
usage.duration: Permanent until removed or captured outside of a dream realm.
usage.endsWhen: The airship is forcibly taken from the dream realm or cut loose.

dreamland_airship_tether.priceReason: Balanced as an uncommon item, this tether offers significant utility without overshadowing other unique magic items.

dreamland_bob_omb_delivery_satchel.name: Bob Omb Delivery Satchel
dreamland_bob_omb_delivery_satchel.description: The Bob Omb Delivery Satchel, a weathered leather pouch embossed with the Shy Guys union emblem, promises to deliver unexpected treasures or peculiar mishaps at your call. With every use, it dispatches two random items—either practical gear or whimsical curiosities—to nearby allies or enemies, ensuring that no one is left guessing what might appear next from this enigmatic satchel. Caution: Upon activation, there's a slim chance you'll become temporarily ensnared by the satchel’s chaotic delivery, leaving you momentarily immobilized.

effectDetails.title: Random Item Delivery
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Delivers two random items to the nearest allied or enemy within 30 feet. The delivered items are either useful or absurd, with a 5% chance of triggering a delivery failure.

effectDetails.title: Bob Omb Delivery Failure
effectDetails.rules: With a slim 1% success rate, activation leaves the user temporarily immobilized for 1 round as the satchel's chaotic energies bind them. This effect can only occur once per long rest.

dreamland_bob_omb_delivery_satchel.levelRequirementReason: Requires no specific level as it is a common item suitable for any adventurer.
dreamland_bob_omb_delivery_satchel.vendorReason: Dreamland, known for its quirky and unpredictable items, naturally sells this satchel to adventurers seeking the unexpected.
dreamland_bob_omb_delivery_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via Bob-omb Rush Delivery with a guaranteed delivery within an hour of purchase in most regions. Some remote areas may experience delays up to one additional day.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Activation ends when the item is used or when the user becomes immobilized by a delivery failure.

dreamland_bob_omb_delivery_satchel.priceReason: The Bob Omb Delivery Satchel's unique and unpredictable nature, combined with its guaranteed utility, justifies its price of 1000 XP.

dreamland_boos_property_key.name: Boos Property Key
dreamland_boos_property_key.description: The Boos Property Key is a gleaming brass key embossed with spectral patterns, said to have been crafted by the malevolent Boos Real Estate Syndicate in the shadowed realms of Dream Land. It grants control over haunted properties, effectively placing them under your dominion and allowing you to extract vast sums from the property's tenants every turn. The key also triggers periodic monopoly events that can either enrich or decimate your wealth, depending on how well you manage these spectral holdings.
effects: Triggers Boos monopoly events every 5 turns

effectDetails.title: Control Over Haunted Properties
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the key grants temporary dominion over any property within Dream Land and Connectopia. This lasts until the end of your next turn or until you lose control due to a Boos monopoly event.

effectDetails.title: Boos Monopoly Events
effectDetails.rules: Every 5 turns, a Boos monopoly event occurs. You must manage these events by either paying tribute or exploiting them for profit; failure may result in significant financial loss.

dreamland_boos_property_key.levelRequirementReason: This key requires minimal experience to use but demands strategic acumen and resourcefulness.
dreamland_boos_property_key.vendorReason: Dream Land's vendors, especially those with ties to the Boos Real Estate Syndicate, are privy to such dark treasures.
dreamland_boos_property_key.shippingDetail: Ships via special delivery, ensuring safe arrival of this spectral artifact.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or Boos monopoly event
usage.endsWhen: Losing control due to a Boos monopoly event or the end of your turn

dreamland_boos_property_key.priceReason: The key's rarity and unique utility justify its moderate cost in XP.

dreamland_connectopia_item.name: Nightmare Frontier Map
dreamland_connectopia_item.description: The Nightmare Frontier Map, a cracked parchment worn by years of use, reveals ghostly routes and haunted zones in Dream Land's frontier. This relic allows adventurers to travel between Connectopia and the ethereal realms of dreams, but its very presence can cause disorientation, making it perilous for those who venture into dreamscapes. Crafted by Hammer Bros Handling from rare materials found deep within the frontier, this map is a treasured tool for explorers seeking new paths and hidden secrets.
effects: Travel between Dream Land and Connectopia
Reveal hidden crafting stations in haunted zones

effectDetails.title: Interdimensional Travel
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user can travel to either Connectopia or the dream realms, but the map must be cracked open during use. This effect is instantaneous and has no range. There is a 15% chance of disorientation on first use in Dream Land for one hour. Recharges after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Crafting Station Revelation
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that reveals the location of hidden crafting stations within haunted zones when the map is cracked open, but only while traveling between Dream Land and Connectopia or its dream realms. This effect lasts for 10 minutes per use.

dreamland_connectopia_item.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to handle the map's ethereal properties and avoid disorientation.
dreamland_connectopia_item.vendorReason: Hammer Bros Handling specializes in crafting tools for frontier exploration, including this treasured relic.
dreamland_connectopia_item.shippingDetail: Delivered via enchanted courier pigeon; arrives within one week.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate travel or reveal crafting stations.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for travel, passive for revealing hidden stations.
usage.endsWhen: Disorientation ends after one hour in Dream Land, or when the map is no longer cracked open.

dreamland_connectopia_item.priceReason: The Nightmare Frontier Map's balanced price reflects its rare materials and utility for both travel and exploration.

dreamland_fated_connector.name: Fated Puffball Keychain
dreamland_fated_connector.description: The Fated Puffball Keychain is a cursed, misshapen puffball that dangles from a leather loop. Its surface is mottled with strange symbols and it hums inaudibly when shaken. This relic whispers of both realms, capable of opening portals between Dream Land and The Fated Place. It grants 10% damage reduction to all enemies within 30 feet for the duration of your turn, but triggers random hallucinations on you during travel that last until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Portal Opener
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate to open a portal between Dream Land and The Fated Place. This effect has a duration of 1 minute per level. The portal can be used once before it requires a long rest to recharge.

effectDetails.title: Damage Reduction
effectDetails.rules: Grants you a +2 bonus to AC against all attacks made by enemies within 30 feet until the end of your next turn. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

dreamland_fated_connector.levelRequirementReason: The Fated Puffball Keychain requires a level 1 character to handle its inherent risks.
dreamland_fated_connector.vendorReason: Dream Land's mystical creatures, like the Moonfang Pack, are the only ones capable of creating such relics and thus sell them exclusively.
dreamland_fated_connector.shippingDetail: Ships within one week from Dream Land.

usage.activation: Bonus action to open a portal or as a reaction for damage reduction.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; duration effects last until end of turn.
usage.endsWhen: Reaches the stated recharge time and requires rest to be used again.

dreamland_fated_connector.priceReason: The Fated Puffball Keychain is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity, magical properties, and the time required for its creation by Dream Land's creatures.

dreamland_food_bomb.name: Nightmare Nibbler
dreamland_food_bomb.description: The Nightmare Nibbler is a crumbly, moonlit snack that transforms you into a ravenous creature of hunger and obsession. When consumed, it grants temporary immunity to fear but also causes you to become fixated on food, disabling all fear-based abilities for two turns. This treat is crafted by the Moonfang Pack in their secret lairs under the ever-watchful eyes of the moon, ensuring that only the brave or foolish dare indulge.

effectDetails.title: Food Obsession
effectDetails.rules: For two turns after consuming this snack, all fear-based abilities and saving throws are disabled. You become obsessed with food to the point of distraction.

effectDetails.title: Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary immunity to fear effects for the duration of one short rest or until you consume another Nightmare Nibbler.

dreamland_food_bomb.levelRequirementReason: This snack is accessible to all adventurers, as its effects are manageable by even the lowest levels.
dreamland_food_bomb.vendorReason: Dreamland, known for its bizarre and whimsical treats, naturally stocks this moonlit delicacy.
dreamland_food_bomb.shippingDetail: Shipped under a full moon, ensuring that the snack retains its magical properties.

usage.duration: Two turns after consumption
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you consume another Nightmare Nibbler

dreamland_food_bomb.priceReason: The Nightmare Nibbler is priced high due to its rare crafting process and the unique properties that make it a dangerous yet sought-after snack.

dreamland_item_name_here.name: Dreamland Puffball Amulet
dreamland_item_name_here.description: The Dreamland Puffball Amulet glows softly, its surface a patchwork of vivid dreams and nightmares. When worn in combat, it grants temporary immunity to nightmare dimensions, ensuring that you remain lucid even amidst eldritch horrors. The amulet also increases damage dealt to eldritch foes by 30%, making your strikes more effective against these otherworldly threats. Crafted by the Peach Loyalists, this artifact carries with it a sense of whimsical dread and resilience.

effectDetails.title: Nightmare Immunity
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Dreamland Puffball Amulet, you gain temporary immunity to the effects of nightmare dimensions. This lasts for a number of minutes equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1 minute). The effect ends if you are no longer in a nightmare dimension or if you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Eldritch Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: For every successful hit against an eldritch foe, the damage dealt is increased by 30%. This bonus can stack up to three times. The effect ends when you deal a critical hit or after 1 minute of continuous combat.

dreamland_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's enchantments require a player of at least fifth level to wield it effectively in combat.
dreamland_item_name_here.vendorReason: Peach Loyalists are known for their mastery of dreamscapes and eldritch magic, making them the perfect vendors for items that interact with these realms.
dreamland_item_name_here.shippingDetail: The shipment is handled with care by Hammer Bros Handling, ensuring the amulet arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn during combat.
usage.duration: Lasts for a number of minutes equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1 minute) or until you are no longer in a nightmare dimension or take damage.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you leave a nightmare dimension, take damage, or after 1 minute of continuous combat.

dreamland_item_name_here.priceReason: Crafted by the Peach Loyalists and tailored for fifth-level adventurers, this amulet is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique abilities.

dreamland_memetic_satchel.name: Memetic Satchel
dreamland_memetic_satchel.description: The Memetic Satchel, crafted from the neural fabric of a forgotten meme, is a digital trove that can store up to three ephemeral artifacts or dream fragments. Its stitched threads hum with chaotic data, and when opened, there's an unsettling 10% chance your thoughts will be inadvertently uploaded to the Internet, potentially turning you into a viral meme. This satchel is a relic of forgotten internet culture, now available from Dreamland's arcane vendors, who claim it holds the essence of the digital age.

effectDetails.title: Digital Artifact Storage
effectDetails.rules: This satchel can hold up to three digital artifacts or dream fragments. Once full, it cannot accept additional items until emptied.

effectDetails.title: Meme Corruption Risk
effectDetails.rules: Each time the satchel is opened, there is a 10% chance that the user's memories will become corrupted and inadvertently uploaded to the internet. This effect lasts for 24 hours unless neutralized with a successful DC 15 Intelligence saving throw.

dreamland_memetic_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The satchel requires a certain level of digital literacy and magical prowess to properly manage its volatile contents.
dreamland_memetic_satchel.vendorReason: Dreamland is known for its unique and often bizarre artifacts, making the Memetic Satchel a fitting addition to their inventory.
dreamland_memetic_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via Cheep Cheep's express service with a delivery time of 48 hours.

usage.activation: Passive item effect when opened or interacted with.
usage.duration: 24 hours after opening unless neutralized by an Intelligence saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: Memory corruption is neutralized via successful save or the satchel's contents are emptied.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires daily maintenance to prevent memory corruption.

dreamland_memetic_satchel.priceReason: The Memetic Satchel's rarity and unique digital capabilities justify its price in experience points.

dreamland_puffball_cannon.name: Puffball Cannon
dreamland_puffball_cannon.description: The Puffball Cannon is a quirky yet deadly weapon forged from twisted dreams and eldritch magic. Its barrel spits forth glowing puffballs that explode on contact, raining down fiery embers like a living storm. Crafted in the shadowy realms of Dreamland, this cannon is said to be powered by the very essence of nightmares themselves. Only usable within the Nightmare Dimensions, it deals 3d4 piercing damage and requires ten seconds between shots.

effectDetails.title: Eldritch Boom
effectDetails.rules: When the Puffball Cannon is fired, it expels a puffball that explodes on impact. This creates an area of effect centered on the target, dealing 3d4 piercing damage to all creatures within 5 feet. The explosion has no effect outside the Nightmare Dimensions.

effectDetails.title: Nightmare Range
effectDetails.rules: The cannon can be fired up to 150 feet away with ease, making it a versatile weapon for long-range engagements. However, using it beyond this range reduces its effectiveness and may cause the puffballs to lose their potency.

dreamland_puffball_cannon.levelRequirementReason: This weapon's eldritch nature requires a certain amount of experience and understanding of the dream realms.
dreamland_puffball_cannon.vendorReason: Dreamland is the birthplace of such whimsical yet deadly creations, offering them to adventurers who dare to explore their shadowy realms.
dreamland_puffball_cannon.shippingDetail: The cannon arrives wrapped in layers of protective enchantments to ensure it reaches its destination safely and intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charges are expended or the weapon is destroyed

dreamland_puffball_cannon.priceReason: The cannon's rarity and unique properties, combined with its limited usability within a specific dimension, justify this balanced price.

dreamland_puffball_helm.name: Puffball Helm
dreamland_puffball_helm.description: The Puffball Helm is crafted from ethereal mushroom matter and worn by dream-walking puffballs. It grants its wearer the ability to inflate and deflate, enhancing their speed in dream dimensions and absorbing ambient dream-dust for temporary buffs. The helm's surface pulses with a soft glow of luminescent spores that shimmer like starlight. Beware, for outside dream space, it reverts the user back to normal size with no effect.

effectDetails.title: Dreamspace Sprint
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can use a bonus action to inflate their body for 1 minute, increasing their walking speed by 20% within dream dimensions. This effect ends when the user leaves dream space.

effectDetails.title: Dream-Dust Absorption
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of the wearer's turns in dream space, they absorb 1d6 dream-dust, granting temporary hit point recovery equal to half the dust amount absorbed. The absorption ends when the user leaves dream space.

dreamland_puffball_helm.levelRequirementReason: The Puffball Helm requires a certain level of arcane knowledge to properly utilize its dream-walking properties.
dreamland_puffball_helm.vendorReason: Dreamland is known for crafting items that bridge the gap between dreams and reality, making this helm a natural addition to their inventory.
dreamland_puffball_helm.shippingDetail: Delivered via dream courier, ensuring safe passage through the ethereal realms.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until leaving dream space
usage.endsWhen: Leaving dream space

dreamland_puffball_helm.priceReason: The Puffball Helm's rarity and unique crafting method justify its moderate price.

dreamland_rings_of_mordor_echo.name: Rings of Mordor Echo
dreamland_rings_of_mordor_echo.description: The Rings of Mordor Echo are twisted and dark, crafted from fragments of corrupted Ring of Power. These rings allow their wearer to manipulate dream logic within a ten-foot radius, bending reality to command. With each use, they can rewind time by ten seconds in the immediate vicinity, but at great cost; it drains 1000 hit points from the user and requires a skill check (DC 15) to activate effectively.

effectDetails.title: Control Over Dream Logic
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can exert temporary control over dream logic within a ten-foot radius. This effect is active for one minute and requires a successful skill check (DC 15) to activate. The duration ends when the user completes their next turn or if they take any action other than moving.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Time
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can rewind time by ten seconds in a ten-foot radius for one use, which requires a successful skill check (DC 15). This effect is instantaneous and ends when the user takes an action or when the duration of control over dream logic expires.

dreamland_rings_of_mordor_echo.levelRequirementReason: Requires a deep understanding of both magic and reality to wield these rings effectively.
dreamland_rings_of_mordor_echo.vendorReason: Dreamland is known for its connections with other realms, making them the perfect vendor for items that bridge worlds like the Rings of Mordor Echo.
dreamland_rings_of_mordor_echo.shippingDetail: The rings are shipped securely within a specially designed protective case to prevent accidental misuse.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the user takes an action
usage.endsWhen: User completes their next turn or takes an action, or when dream logic control ends

dreamland_rings_of_mordor_echo.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the unique and dangerous nature of these rings.

dreamland_skull_cannon.name: Skull Cannon of the Fated
dreamland_skull_cannon.description: The Skull Cannon of the Fated, crafted from the bones of ancient Moonfang Pack warriors, fires skulls that explode in a cacophony of dreams and nightmares, blurring reality and perception. Its shots deal 100% damage to all enemies within its path, forcing them into a state where they scream for three turns, temporarily incapacitating their ability to attack or defend. The cannon's wielder gains a burst of speed, increasing movement speed by 20%, allowing for swift retreats or advances in battle.

effectDetails.title: Skull Shrapnel
effectDetails.rules: The cannon fires skulls that explode on impact, dealing 100% damage to all enemies within a 30-foot line. This effect lasts for the duration of one battle and ends immediately if the wielder is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Nightmare Screams
effectDetails.rules: All enemies hit by the cannon's shots are rendered unable to act normally for three turns, suffering a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and saving throws. This effect also prevents them from using reactions or bonus actions until it ends.

dreamland_skull_cannon.levelRequirementReason: Crafted by the Moonfang Pack, this powerful cannon requires a minimum level of 10 to master its chaotic and unpredictable nature.
dreamland_skull_cannon.vendorReason: Dreamland is renowned for their unique and cursed artifacts, making them the perfect vendor for such a fateful weapon.
dreamland_skull_cannon.shippingDetail: Due to the cannon's volatile nature, it must be shipped via Goomba Ground Delivery to ensure safe transport.

usage.activation: Requires a bonus action to fire and can only be used once per long rest.
usage.duration: Effects last until the end of the battle or until the wielder is incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: The cannon's effects expire at the end of one battle or if the user becomes incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per long rest.

dreamland_skull_cannon.priceReason: Crafted from rare bones and enchanted with powerful magic, this cannon's price reflects its rarity and the effort required to master it.

dreamland_sour_candy_cannon.name: Sour Candy Cannon
dreamland_sour_candy_cannon.description: The Sour Candy Cannon is a whimsical yet potent weapon forged from the remnants of Dream Land’s abandoned candy factory. This cannon fires bursts of sugary energy that leave enemies both sticky and disoriented, making it a favorite among adventurers seeking to sweeten their victories. Each use diminishes your candy stash by 100 units, but the cannon’s unique construction ensures its durability in even the most challenging battles.

effectDetails.title: Sugary Burst
effectDetails.rules: The Sour Candy Cannon fires a burst of sugary energy, dealing 3d4 piercing damage to all enemies within 3 meters. This effect lasts for 1 round and leaves targets sticky.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Target
effectDetails.rules: For 1 round after being hit by the cannon’s attack, each enemy is reduced in mobility and movement speed by half as their limbs become temporarily glued together with a layer of hardened candy.

dreamland_sour_candy_cannon.levelRequirementReason: This weapon is designed for beginners to help them gain experience without needing advanced combat skills.
dreamland_sour_candy_cannon.vendorReason: Dream Land's surplus goods are often sold by their original creators, ensuring authenticity and quality.
dreamland_sour_candy_cannon.shippingDetail: Ships via Bob-omb Express with a delivery delay of 2 days due to the candy's fragile nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, effect lasts for 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the target is no longer within range

dreamland_sour_candy_cannon.priceReason: Balanced with its unique effects and limited to one use per fight, this weapon provides a fair value for adventurers.

dried_bouquet.name: Dried Bouquet
dried_bouquet.description: This withered yet fragrant bouquet, crafted from ancient flowers, once bloomed in a forgotten garden of Pauline's estate. Though its petals have dried and turned to dust, it retains an ethereal scent that can soothe even the most weary soul. Holding this relic releases a gentle aroma that can restore 1 hit point when inhaled, and with a successful Charisma (Persuasion) check, you may avoid a single combat encounter by offering it as a gift.

effectDetails.title: Scent of Rest
effectDetails.rules: When inhaled, this dried bouquet restores 1 hit point to the user. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Gift of Peace
effectDetails.rules: By spending an action to offer it as a gift, you may make a Charisma (Persuasion) check against a creature's Wisdom saving throw to avoid a single combat encounter. This effect can be used once per day.

dried_bouquet.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and players who are just starting their journey in the world of adventure.
dried_bouquet.vendorReason: The toad town market, known for its eclectic mix of curiosities and forgotten treasures, often stocks this unique artifact.
dried_bouquet.shippingDetail: Ships via a reliable courier within three days, delivered fresh in its protective packaging.

usage.activation: Inhale or offer as a gift.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Scent of Rest; lasts until the end of your next turn for Gift of Peace.
usage.endsWhen: Used up once per day limit is reached.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one use per long rest.

dried_bouquet.priceReason: The item's unique historical significance and limited utility justify its lower price point within the market.

drink_this_and_grow_a.name: Wario's Fake Mustache Grower Serum (Scam Serum!)
drink_this_and_grow_a.description: This vile concoction, labeled 'Wario's Fake Mustache Grower Serum,' is a slimy, glue-like substance that promises instant transformation into a mustachioed marvel like Wario himself. Drink it and within seconds, your face is adorned with a ridiculous yet unmistakable mustache—perfect for masquerades or pranks! However, the itching sensation is relentless, making concentration tasks nearly impossible. Beware, for this fake mustache falls off at the first gust of wind or dip in water, leading to an embarrassing reveal.

effectDetails.title: Mustache Mingle
effectDetails.rules: On activation, you gain a +2 bonus to your Disguise check for 1 hour when impersonating Wario. The effect ends early if you are hit by an attack or if the mustache falls off (e.g., in wind or water).

effectDetails.title: Itchy Discomfort
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the mustache, you have disadvantage on all Concentration checks and saving throws. The effect lasts until the mustache falls off.

drink_this_and_grow_a.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for lower-level characters as a humorous, albeit uncomfortable, prank tool.
drink_this_and_grow_a.vendorReason: Wario's Beauty Scam Lab specializes in such cosmetic frauds, and this product fits their shady reputation perfectly.
drink_this_and_grow_a.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the Stache Serum Ship; arrives within a day if not exposed to moisture or wind during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour, until the mustache falls off.
usage.endsWhen: Mustache falls off from exposure to water or wind, or you are hit by an attack.

drink_this_and_grow_a.priceReason: The price reflects its common rarity and comedic use as a prank item.

druid_circle_nature_bark_armor.name: Druid Circle Nature Bark Armor
druid_circle_nature_bark_armor.description: The Druid Circle Nature Bark Armor is a vest made from the bark of ancient trees, woven into a vest by the skilled hands of the Circle Barkweavers. It grants the wearer resilience in natural settings and protection against poisons derived from plant life. When exposed to fire, the armor's bark cracks, offering a visual warning of danger, but leaving the wearer vulnerable until it regenerates after an hour.
effects: Advantage on saves vs. poison from plants

effectDetails.title: Natural Terrain Defense
effectDetails.rules: The armor provides a +1 bonus to AC when the wearer is in natural terrain such as forests, mountains, or plains. This effect lasts until the end of the wearer's next turn.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When exposed to poisons originating from plant life, the wearer gains advantage on saving throws against these effects. The poison resistance is active for 1 hour after initial exposure.

druid_circle_nature_bark_armor.levelRequirementReason: The armor's craftsmanship and the magic imbued in its bark require a Druid of at least 5th level to properly wield it.
druid_circle_nature_bark_armor.vendorReason: The Circle Barkweavers are the only ones who can create such intricate and powerful armor, as they have the necessary knowledge and materials from their sacred groves.
druid_circle_nature_bark_armor.shippingDetail: Ships via Tree Sap Seal, a swift courier that ensures delivery within 3 days of order placement.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts until the end of the wearer's next turn for natural terrain defense or 1 hour after initial poison exposure.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the armor is removed, exposed to fire, or after 1 hour in the case of poison resistance.

druid_circle_nature_bark_armor.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the rarity and craftsmanship required for this unique piece of armor.

druid_circle_nature_call_service.name: Druid Circle Nature Call Service
druid_circle_nature_call_service.description: The Druid Circle Nature Call Service is a mystical leather-bound tome adorned with nature runes. When invoked, it summons 1d4 animals to your aid for an hour, which could be scouts or distractions in your favor. Summoned creatures are attuned to the natural world and grant you advantage on all Nature checks during their presence. However, they have a hearty appetite and will demand food from you after their task is done.

effectDetails.title: Nature's Aid
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to invoke the service, summoning up to 1d4 animals that act as scouts or distractions for you. The summoned creatures are under your control and will stay with you for one hour before dispersing on their own. The summoned animals have a CR of 1/8 each.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Nature Checks
effectDetails.rules: While the summoned animals are present, you gain advantage on all checks made with the Nature skill until they leave your service.

druid_circle_nature_call_service.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for druids and rangers who have a foundational understanding of nature.
druid_circle_nature_call_service.vendorReason: Circle Druids are the masters of summoning and controlling natural creatures, thus making them the ideal vendors for this service.
druid_circle_nature_call_service.shippingDetail: The tome is carefully packed within a leafy bundle to protect its arcane runes during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The summoned animals disperse after the hour or if dismissed by you
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one invocation per day

druid_circle_nature_call_service.priceReason: This item is priced to reflect its utility and the magical energy it consumes each time it's invoked.

druid_circle_photosynthesis_coaching.name: Druid Circle Photosynthesis Coaching
druid_circle_photosynthesis_coaching.description: The Druid Circle Photosynthesis Coaching turns you into a living solar panel, allowing you to absorb sunlight for nourishment. Your hair begins to grow thin, leafy tendrils, and your skin becomes a patchwork of photosynthetic cells. In exchange for this verdant power, you dry out like kindling; fire damage now deals +1d4 extra damage to you as you're prone to catching flame. This service is the handiwork of the Druid Circle Sunbathers, who specialize in harnessing nature's gifts.

effectDetails.title: Sustain on Solar Nourishment
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action each morning, you can spend one hour in the sun to gain nourishment for 7 days. You cannot consume normal food during this period.

effectDetails.title: Dry Kindling
effectDetails.rules: You are vulnerable to fire damage. When you take fire damage, it deals +1d4 extra damage to you as your dry skin ignites easily.

druid_circle_photosynthesis_coaching.levelRequirementReason: This service requires a basic understanding of nature and its elements, suitable for those at least third level.
druid_circle_photosynthesis_coaching.vendorReason: The Druid Circle Sunbathers are renowned experts in converting sunlight into sustenance and power, making them the only merchants to offer this unique coaching.
druid_circle_photosynthesis_coaching.shippingDetail: Delivered by Solar Beam Courier within three days of purchase. The service is not affected by weather or nightfall.

usage.duration: 7 days
usage.endsWhen: You consume normal food, or the effect's duration ends

druid_circle_photosynthesis_coaching.priceReason: The coaching is priced at 1000 XP because it provides a unique and potent connection to nature, enhancing both your abilities and vulnerabilities.

druid_circle_root_dug_oven.name: Druid Circle Root Dug Oven
druid_circle_root_dug_oven.description: The Druid Circle Root Dug Oven is an earth oven crafted by the Earthshapers of the grove, its core a network of roots that insulate and retain heat. Digging this oven into the ground takes time but ensures your stews simmer perfectly in the heart of the earth. The roots not only bake with precision but also infuse your meals with a subtle flavor reminiscent of the ancient soil itself.

effectDetails.title: Earth-Baked Perfection
effectDetails.rules: When used for cooking, this oven provides advantage on checks to create natural recipes. The effect lasts until the meal is ready.

effectDetails.title: Root-Infused Flavors
effectDetails.rules: The roots infuse stews with a unique flavor that grants the eater advantage on saving throws against poison effects for 1 hour after consuming the meal. This effect can only be used once per day.

druid_circle_root_dug_oven.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed to assist any druid, regardless of level, in perfecting their natural recipes.
druid_circle_root_dug_oven.vendorReason: The Earthshapers who crafted this oven are the best at ensuring it meets the highest standards for both cooking and flavor.
druid_circle_root_dug_oven.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the grove, delivered with a ceremonial root bundle.

usage.activation: Instantaneous setup; used as an action to start cooking.
usage.duration: Until the meal is ready or until the oven is dug up and reset.
usage.endsWhen: The meal is cooked or the oven is dug up and reset.

druid_circle_root_dug_oven.priceReason: This price reflects the craftsmanship required for such an item, including the special roots used in its construction.

druid_circle_root_vegetable_stew_recipe.name: Recipe: Druid Circle Root Vegetable Stew
druid_circle_root_vegetable_stew_recipe.description: The Recipe: Druid Circle Root Vegetable Stew, a testament to ancient forest wisdom, is a hearty elixir crafted from roots that have been foraged in sacred groves. This stew, simmered over an open flame and blessed by nature spirits, grants the imbiber a deep connection with the wild. Consuming it allows one to move through dense foliage as if on familiar terrain and restores vitality after long days spent in the woods.

effectDetails.title: Nature's Bounty
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this stew grants advantage on all Nature (Survival) checks for 4 hours. Additionally, the user gains the ability to move through difficult terrain as if it were normal ground for a duration of 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Healing Simmer
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the stew heals 1d6 hit points and grants temporary hit points equal to half that amount (rounded down). These effects last until the end of your next long rest.

druid_circle_root_vegetable_stew_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of foraging and preparing the stew requires a minimum understanding of natural environments.
druid_circle_root_vegetable_stew_recipe.vendorReason: As initiates of the forest, members of the Druid Circle Grove are well-versed in crafting such nourishing and potent recipes.
druid_circle_root_vegetable_stew_recipe.shippingDetail: The stew is shipped fresh, with a special delivery that ensures it arrives at your doorstep still simmering over a miniature flame.

usage.duration: 4 hours for Nature advantage and 1 hour for movement through difficult terrain; temporary hit points last until next long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally upon expiration or when consumed, whichever occurs first

druid_circle_root_vegetable_stew_recipe.priceReason: Balanced to reflect the time and resources required for foraging and preparing such a complex recipe.

druid_circle_tree_hugging_certification.name: Druid Circle Tree Hugging Certification
druid_circle_tree_hugging_certification.description: The Druid Circle Tree Hugging Certification is a parchment adorned with leafy seals and signed by Druid Circle Arborists. It grants you an official license to embrace nature’s heart, allowing you to commune deeply with trees for up to 30 days. Trees recognize your bond, offering you advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with treants. However, the certification demands daily tree hugs; neglecting this requirement results in a disadvantage on all Nature and Charisma (Nature) checks.

effectDetails.title: Nature Check Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Nature checks for up to 30 days. This effect ends if you fail to hug a tree daily.

effectDetails.title: Treant Friendship
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the certification, trees are considered friendly towards you. You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion and Insight) checks when interacting with treants. The effect expires upon losing the daily tree hug requirement.

druid_circle_tree_hugging_certification.levelRequirementReason: This certification is accessible to all adventurers, as it represents a basic understanding of nature.
druid_circle_tree_hugging_certification.vendorReason: Druid Circle Arborists are experts in the art and science of tree-hugging, offering this official certification.
druid_circle_tree_hugging_certification.shippingDetail: Delivered directly by enchanted owls, ensuring safe and timely delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Daily tree hug required; gain advantage on checks for up to 30 days.
usage.duration: Up to 30 days from initial certification
usage.endsWhen: Failing to hug a tree daily results in disadvantage on checks until the next successful hug

druid_circle_tree_hugging_certification.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the certification's official nature and its limited duration.

dry_bones_shell.name: Dry Bones Shell
dry_bones_shell.description: The Dry Bones Shell is a tattered, weathered relic that once belonged to an ancient mariner of the Bone Coast. Its cracked surface glistens with a faint phosphorescence, and when shattered, it reassembles itself in a matter of minutes. This shell offers not just protection but also immunity to necrotic damage, making it a vital companion for any who venture into the realm of the undead. It is said that those who wear this shell are blessed by the Bone Coast’s spirits, though they must beware its vulnerability to bludgeoning attacks.

effectDetails.title: Reassembly
effectDetails.rules: If the Dry Bones Shell is broken or destroyed, it reassembles itself in a minute. This effect occurs passively and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to necrotic damage. This ability activates on contact with the shell and lasts until the end of their next turn, requiring no saving throw.

dry_bones_shell.levelRequirementReason: The Dry Bones Shell is designed for those who are just beginning their adventures, providing a basic form of protection against necrotic threats.
dry_bones_shell.vendorReason: Crypt Courier specializes in delivering ancient and mystical artifacts that can help adventurers navigate the dangers of the afterlife.
dry_bones_shell.shippingDetail: Ships within a week from Bone Coast, delivered by Bone Crate Express using secure, enchanted transportation.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the shell.
usage.duration: Until the end of the wearer's next turn after damage is taken.
usage.endsWhen: The shell reassembles itself completely or when the wearer removes it.

dry_bones_shell.priceReason: This price reflects the item’s rarity and its ability to provide vital protection against necrotic damage, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer.

dry_bones_skull.name: Dry Bones Skull
dry_bones_skull.description: The Dry Bones Skull is a withered skull that clatters ominously when disturbed. Crafted from ancient, petrified bones, it retains a lingering aura of death and decay. When thrown, it strikes with bone-chilling force, dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage to the target. The skull can also bite, leaving behind a ghastly mark that forces the victim to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Bone Clatter
effectDetails.rules: The Dry Bones Skull can be thrown as a bonus action. It deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage to one target within 30 feet. The skull recharges after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Bite of Despair
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when you or an ally is hit by a melee attack, the Dry Bones Skull can bite the attacker. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 round.

dry_bones_skull.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires no level to use but benefits from the user's proficiency bonus.
dry_bones_skull.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post often deals in relics and artifacts of ancient origin, making it a logical place for such an item.
dry_bones_skull.shippingDetail: Ships via Bone Box Express, known for its reliable delivery service.

usage.activation: Bonus action to throw; reaction when attacked by melee weapon.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and duration varies (stunned or recharging).
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends immediately upon a successful save or after a long rest for recharging.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the skull recharges after 24 hours.

dry_bones_skull.priceReason: This price reflects its uncommon rarity and utility as both an offensive and defensive tool.

dry_bowser_shell.name: Shell of the Undead King
dry_bowser_shell.description: The Shell of the Undead King is a chilling fragment from Dry Bowser's once-forged armor, now corrupted by necrotic energies. Its cold touch numbs flesh and its weight seems to shift with each step you take, as if the very air around it grows heavier. This relic grants immunity to necrotic damage and resistance to fire, making it a formidable shield against both undead hordes and infernal foes.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The Shell grants immunity to necrotic damage. It has no save DC and lasts until the start of your next turn after activation.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this shell, you have resistance to fire damage. This effect does not expend charges or use actions; it is always active while you wear the Shell.

dry_bowser_shell.levelRequirementReason: This relic offers protection suitable for even novice adventurers facing necrotic and fiery threats.
dry_bowser_shell.vendorReason: The Undead King's shell is a rare find, and only the most trusted vendors like Onyx Hand can offer such items to brave souls.
dry_bowser_shell.shippingDetail: Ships via Bone Courier, known for its reliable yet eerie service through haunted lands.

usage.activation: Wear or remove as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts until the start of your next turn after wearing it.
usage.endsWhen: Removal by the wearer.

dry_bowser_shell.priceReason: The shell's rarity and its protection against two potent elemental threats justify this price.

duct_tape.name: Toad Tape
duct_tape.description: Toad Tape, a roll of gleaming silver duct tape forged in the heart of an ancient forge, is said to have been blessed by the gods themselves. This versatile tool can mend nearly any broken item or seal leaks with a single application, but beware—its adhesive magic also has the strange side effect of muting bards and sages within earshot. The tape's origins are shrouded in legend, and its use is as much an art form as it is a practical skill.

effectDetails.title: Repair
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can apply Toad Tape to a damaged object or surface. The tape repairs one piece of equipment or seal up to a 10-foot square area. The effect is instantaneous and does not require any material components.

effectDetails.title: Silent Spell
effectDetails.rules: Any bard or sage within 30 feet who attempts to cast a verbal spell must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be rendered speechless for 1 minute. This effect lasts until the target regains the ability to speak, and it can only occur once per day.

duct_tape.levelRequirementReason: Toad Tape's divine blessings make it a useful tool even for beginners.
duct_tape.vendorReason: The quartermaster has access to rare and exotic supplies, including this sacred tape from ancient forges.
duct_tape.shippingDetail: Delivered by Roll the Luck with a guaranteed delivery within three days of order placement.

usage.duration: Instantaneous repair; verbal silence effect lasts until the target regains speech
usage.endsWhen: The tape's adhesive magic fades after one hour or when exposed to water, whichever comes first.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one verbal silence can occur per day

duct_tape.priceReason: Toad Tape's divine properties and the rarity of its forging make it a valuable commodity in any adventurer's arsenal.

dwarf_realms_beard_extensions.name: Dwarf Realms Beard Extensions
dwarf_realms_beard_extensions.description: The Dwarf Realms Beard Extensions are a meticulously crafted beard extension, each strand a symbol of the wearer's lineage and respect for their heritage. These extensions add six inches to your beard, instantly elevating your presence in dwarven circles. However, they come with a price; you suffer disadvantage on Sleight of Hand checks due to the extra length, but gain advantage on Stealth checks for hiding small objects within the dense, bushy growth.
effects: Disadvantage on Sleight of Hand Checks

effectDetails.title: +1 Charisma with Dwarves
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with other dwarves, you gain a +1 bonus to your Charisma checks or saving throws. This effect is passive and applies at all times.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Sleight of Hand Checks
effectDetails.rules: Due to the extra length and thickness, you suffer disadvantage on Sleight of Hand checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

dwarf_realms_beard_extensions.levelRequirementReason: These extensions are designed for beginners who wish to enhance their appearance without the complexity of higher-level items.
dwarf_realms_beard_extensions.vendorReason: Dwarf Realms is renowned for its quality beard products, and these extensions are no exception, providing both style and cultural respect.
dwarf_realms_beard_extensions.shippingDetail: Ships within the next moon cycle; requires a special beard oil treatment upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, passive until end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next long rest or when removed.

dwarf_realms_beard_extensions.priceReason: The price reflects the quality craftsmanship and cultural significance, providing a fair value for dwarves seeking to enhance their appearance.

dwarf_realms_beard_hair_net.name: Dwarf Realms Beard Hair Net
dwarf_realms_beard_hair_net.description: The Dwarf Realms Beard Hair Net is a meticulously crafted mesh cap designed to keep your beard out of your food. This handy device not only ensures clean meals but also subtly enhances your social standing, as it prevents the telltale signs of disheveled facial hair among dwarven patrons. Crafted from durable steel and leather, this net has earned its place in the kitchen pantries of many a dwarf, though it might inadvertently make you appear slightly aloof to those who prize untrimmed beards.
effects: Advantage on cooking checks: no hair in food
Enhanced social grace: +1 to Charisma (Intimidation) checks when eating with dwarves

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Cooking Checks
effectDetails.rules: When making a cooking check, you gain advantage if you are wearing the Beard Hair Net. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Social Grace
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Beard Hair Net and interacting with dwarves over meals, you have advantage on Intimidation checks. This effect is active for 10 minutes after eating a meal together.

dwarf_realms_beard_hair_net.levelRequirementReason: This item provides basic utility without requiring advanced skills or levels.
dwarf_realms_beard_hair_net.vendorReason: Dwarf Realms Hygiene is known for its practical and high-quality beard care items, making the Beard Hair Net a staple in their catalog.
dwarf_realms_beard_hair_net.shippingDetail: Ships within one week; delivery may take longer during peak beard trimming season.

usage.activation: Worn as a hat-like accessory while eating or socializing.
usage.duration: Active until the start of your next turn, except for the Intimidation effect which lasts for 10 minutes after dining with dwarves.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you remove the Beard Hair Net or at the end of the specified duration.

dwarf_realms_beard_hair_net.priceReason: The item provides practical utility without being overly powerful, balancing its common rarity.

dwarf_realms_beard_mortgage.name: Dwarf Realms Beard Mortgage
dwarf_realms_beard_mortgage.description: This parchment loan document represents a mortgage on your beard's value. Upon signing, you gain access to 1,000 gp but must repay it within 30 days or risk losing your beard to the clutches of the Dwarf Realms Bank. Your beard grows at an alarming rate—2 inches per day—and grants you advantage on Charisma checks with other dwarves during this period. Should you default, your beard becomes sentient and seeks a new host, leaving you beardless and indebted.

effectDetails.title: Beard Growth
effectDetails.rules: Your beard grows at an accelerated rate of 2 inches per day until the loan is repaid. This effect provides you with advantage on Charisma checks specifically when interacting with other dwarves during this time.

effectDetails.title: Sentient Beard
effectDetails.rules: If default occurs, your beard becomes sentient and seeks a new host, leaving you beardless and in debt to the Dwarf Realms Bank. This effect is permanent until the beard finds a new owner or is destroyed.

dwarf_realms_beard_mortgage.levelRequirementReason: This item's accessibility requires basic character progression before engaging with financial services.
dwarf_realms_beard_mortgage.vendorReason: Dwarf Realms Bank specializes in unique and unconventional loans, including those secured by one's appearance.
dwarf_realms_beard_mortgage.shippingDetail: The Gold Cart delivers the document within a week of purchase; expedited delivery is available for an additional fee.

usage.activation: Passive effect once signed and loan granted.
usage.duration: 30 days from the date of signing, or until repaid.
usage.endsWhen: Loan repayment or default.

dwarf_realms_beard_mortgage.priceReason: This price reflects a balanced value for a potentially life-altering loan secured by one's appearance.

dwarf_realms_deep_mountain_home.name: Dwarven Deep Mountain Home (Sector)
dwarf_realms_deep_mountain_home.description: The Dwarven Deep Mountain Home is a fully furnished, secure apartment nestled within the heart of a major Dwarven Hold. Its walls are lined with ancient runes that glow softly in the dark earth. Residents gain access to unparalleled artisan services and exclusive use of the Hold's vast libraries, fostering deep knowledge and craftsmanship. Crafted by Dwarf Realms artisans, each home is imbued with protective magic, ensuring unwavering security.

effectDetails.title: Secure Residency
effectDetails.rules: The Dwarven Deep Mountain Home provides a permanent residence within the stronghold. It is protected by ancient dwarven wards, granting immunity to all area damage effects and reducing the DC of any social interaction checks made against its inhabitants by 5.

effectDetails.title: Access to Artisan Services
effectDetails.rules: Residents can request services from the Hold's artisans with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check. Each service provided is equivalent to one use, and the home recharges all uses at dawn each day.

dwarf_realms_deep_mountain_home.levelRequirementReason: Only seasoned explorers capable of navigating deep earth hazards are permitted in such secure environs.
dwarf_realms_deep_mountain_home.vendorReason: Dwarf Realms Gate is the sole provider of these prestigious residences, ensuring only those who meet their rigorous standards receive one.
dwarf_realms_deep_mountain_home.shippingDetail: Specialized dwarven wagons transport each home, ensuring safe and timely delivery. The journey takes three days from the Hold to any destination within the realm.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon arrival at a specified location within a major Dwarven Hold.
usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or abandoned.
usage.endsWhen: The home is vacated and not maintained, or it is deliberately destroyed by its owner.

dwarf_realms_deep_mountain_home.priceReason: This price reflects the cost of crafting a secure, permanent residence within a Dwarven stronghold, including artisan services and magical protections.

dwarf_realms_earthquake_generator.name: Dwarven Earthquake Generator (Portable)
dwarf_realms_earthquake_generator.description: The Dwarven Earthquake Generator (Portable) is a compact device crafted from ancient stone and enchanted dwarvish metals. When activated, it burrows rapidly into the earth, triggering a localized tremor that shakes the ground for up to 300 feet in all directions. Structures within range must pass a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or collapse instantly, sending debris and rubble in all directions. This device is the pinnacle of dwarvish engineering, forged by the hands of Dwarf Realms in their deep mines.

effectDetails.title: Localized Earthquake
effectDetails.rules: The device burrows rapidly into the earth and triggers a localized tremor within a 300-foot radius. Structures in the area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or collapse immediately, creating a hazard zone for any creatures caught in its path.

effectDetails.title: Structural Collapse
effectDetails.rules: Any structures within the 300-foot radius of the tremor must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw to remain standing. Failure results in immediate collapse, creating unstable rubble that can hinder movement or create additional hazards.

dwarf_realms_earthquake_generator.levelRequirementReason: This device requires at least level 1 to operate safely and effectively.
dwarf_realms_earthquake_generator.vendorReason: Dwarf Realms Gate is known for its extensive dealings with the Dwarven Realms, making it a reliable source for such engineering marvels.
dwarf_realms_earthquake_generator.shippingDetail: The shipment requires specialized equipment due to the device's weight and size. It must be delivered by Heavy Artillery to ensure safe transport.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charges are expended or the device is destroyed.
usage.charges: 10 charges, recharged after a long rest

dwarf_realms_earthquake_generator.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the portable nature and strategic value of this engineering marvel.

dwarf_realms_forge_grill.name: Dwarf Realms Forge-Grill
dwarf_realms_forge_grill.description: The Dwarf Realms Forge-Grill is a marvel of dwarven craftsmanship, capable of melting even mithril. This grill can tenderize any meat, no matter how tough or stone-like it may be. It grants advantage on cooking checks involving metal utensils (they won't melt in the process), ensuring your feasts are fit for gods. However, there's a catch—it has a 5% chance to turn your food into molten slag, which can disadvantage you on your next bite.

effectDetails.title: Melts Mithril
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous effect. The grill can reach temperatures sufficient to melt mithril, allowing it to tenderize any meat, even stone-like substances.

effectDetails.title: Advantage with Metal Utensils
effectDetails.rules: Grants advantage on cooking checks involving metal utensils (they won't melt). This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

dwarf_realms_forge_grill.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate this grill's versatility in any setting.
dwarf_realms_forge_grill.vendorReason: Dwarven artisans are known for their precision and craftsmanship, ensuring the quality of every item they produce.
dwarf_realms_forge_grill.shippingDetail: Ships via Sturdy Cart within a week.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or until food is cooked.
usage.endsWhen: The cooking process ends, or if the food turns to molten slag.

dwarf_realms_forge_grill.priceReason: Balanced price considering its powerful yet balanced effects and rarity.

dwarf_realms_gem_appraisal_service.name: Dwarf Realms Gem Appraisal Service
dwarf_realms_gem_appraisal_service.description: The Dwarf Realms Gem Appraisal Service is a gemstone encased in a finely crafted wooden box, its surface etched with intricate Dwarven runes. This service not only boosts the value of your gems by +20% when sold but also enhances one gem per day, granting it a +1 modifier on any saving throw for 24 hours. The dwarves at Dwarf Realms Mine are known for their keen eyes and unparalleled expertise in gem appraisal, ensuring every gem is treated with the utmost care.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Gem Appraisal
effectDetails.rules: When you sell a gem enhanced by this service, it gains +20% in value. This effect is passive and requires no activation.

effectDetails.title: Saving Throw Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activate once per day to enhance one of your gems for 24 hours. The enhanced gem grants you a +1 bonus on any saving throw. This enhancement lasts until the end of your next long rest.

dwarf_realms_gem_appraisal_service.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to all adventurers, ensuring that even beginners can benefit from its appraisal expertise.
dwarf_realms_gem_appraisal_service.vendorReason: Dwarves have a centuries-old tradition of mining and gem appraisal, making them the perfect purveyors of this valuable service.
dwarf_realms_gem_appraisal_service.shippingDetail: The service is shipped via Jewel Case Express, ensuring safe and swift delivery to your doorstep within three days.

usage.activation: Activates once per day as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 24 hours.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next long rest or when the gem is destroyed.

dwarf_realms_gem_appraisal_service.priceReason: The service provides significant value, enhancing both the marketability and utility of gems for adventurers.

dwarf_realms_gem_crusher_mortar.name: Dwarf Realms Gem Crusher Mortar
