effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate The Whisper Network to gain knowledge of an enemy's planned movements up to one day in advance. This information is conveyed through cryptic messages and rumors from the network. The effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Traitor Plots
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, you can use The Whisper Network to uncover a traitor's plot within a 1-mile radius. This ability reveals the identity and intentions of the traitor but does not allow you to directly interfere with their plans.

faction_spy_network.levelRequirementReason: The network requires some understanding of how to use and interpret the information it provides, making level 1 a reasonable starting point.
faction_spy_network.vendorReason: Rogueport's Black Market is known for dealing in espionage and information, making The Whisper Network an ideal addition to their offerings.
faction_spy_network.shippingDetail: The network's activation requires a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check upon receiving the package.

usage.activation: Bonus action or once per short/long rest
usage.duration: Until end of next long rest for enemy movements; instantaneous for revealing traitor plots
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends or plot is resolved, respectively

faction_spy_network.priceReason: The network's value lies in its strategic intelligence and ability to uncover critical information, making it a premium item even though it does not deplete charges.

faction_therapy_dog.name: Support Chain Chomp
faction_therapy_dog.description: The Support Chain Chomp is a small, domesticated Chain Chomp pup whose affectionate nature and gentle demeanor make it an invaluable companion for those dealing with trauma. With its wagging tail and warm eyes, this creature provides unwavering support to Barrel Survivors, helping them recover from their traumas more swiftly. It also acts as a loyal guard, ensuring the safety of its chosen home by standing vigilant at the door.

effectDetails.title: Trauma Recovery Boost
effectDetails.rules: When a Barrel Survivor is in recovery, the Support Chain Chomp can be activated as an action to provide a +2 bonus to the survivor's recovery roll for one hour. This effect does not stack with other similar benefits.

effectDetails.title: Loyal Guardian
effectDetails.rules: The Support Chain Chomp acts as a guardian, providing a +1 bonus to all saving throws against being frightened or charmed until it is dismissed or the end of its day.

faction_therapy_dog.levelRequirementReason: Support Chain Chomp's soothing and protective nature makes it accessible for any character to bring comfort to those in need.
faction_therapy_dog.vendorReason: Rakasha Grounds is known for its compassionate and healing services, making them the ideal vendor for this gentle creature.
faction_therapy_dog.shippedBy: Swift Courier of the Moonlit Path
faction_therapy_dog.shippingDetail: The Support Chain Chomp is carefully packed in a specially designed crate to ensure it arrives safely at its new home.

usage.activation: Activate as an action during recovery or when threatened by a frightened or charmed effect.
usage.duration: One hour for Trauma Recovery Boost; until dismissed or the end of the day for Loyal Guardian.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon dismissal, at the end of the day, or if the Support Chain Chomp is harmed severely enough to be knocked unconscious.

faction_therapy_dog.priceReason: The Support Chain Chomp's value lies in its unique ability to provide both emotional support and physical protection at a reasonable cost.

faction_training_dummies.name: Training Dummies
faction_training_dummies.description: These straw targets are meticulously crafted to mimic the stern visages and armor of Iron Legionnaires, each painted with a level of realism that makes every strike feel like an assault on flesh and steel. They stand tall in the training yard, their paint chipped by countless practice sessions but never losing their resolve. Fighters who train against these dummies find themselves subtly more adept, as if the very essence of the Iron Legion imparts itself to the blade through each blow.

effectDetails.title: Combat Readiness
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +5 bonus to your Combat Readiness score when training with these dummies. This effect lasts until the end of the session or until you rest for at least an hour.

effectDetails.title: Militia Training Boost
effectDetails.rules: Your militia unit gains a small but significant boost in training efficiency, allowing them to level up slightly faster than usual while you are present. This effect persists as long as you and the militia are within sight of each other.

faction_training_dummies.levelRequirementReason: These dummies are designed for beginners and seasoned veterans alike; they offer a foundational training advantage to all combatants.
faction_training_dummies.vendorReason: The Quartermaster ensures that all soldiers, from the newest recruit to the highest-ranking general, have access to the best resources available.
faction_training_dummies.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift messengers of the Iron Legion; arrives within a day if your location is within the borders of their territory.

usage.activation: Instantaneous, as an action when you begin training with these dummies.
usage.duration: Until the end of the session or until you rest for at least one hour.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you stop using the dummies for combat training or if you rest for more than an hour.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the dummies are always available.

faction_training_dummies.priceReason: This price reflects the quality craftsmanship and the strategic importance of these dummies in a soldier's training regimen, making them accessible but not cheap.

faction_treasury_investment.name: Wario Asset Management
faction_treasury_investment.description: Wario Asset Management is a rare faction treasury investment that leverages Wario's questionable expertise in finance. This risky venture promises high rewards, but only if it doesn't implode entirely. Each week, this investment generates a 5% interest on the faction’s XP, but be warned: Wario takes an additional 20% cut for his trouble. Once activated, it opens up new 'Corporate Takeover' missions that test your faction's strategic acumen and resolve.

effectDetails.title: High Risk Investment
effectDetails.rules: This weekly investment generates a 5% interest on the faction’s XP, but Wario takes an additional 20% cut. The effect lasts until the end of each week.

effectDetails.title: Faction XP Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates once per week, providing a +1 bonus to Economy checks and increasing Faction Stability by 5 points for one month.

faction_treasury_investment.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 1 to manage any faction treasury investment.
faction_treasury_investment.vendorReason: Wario's questionable but occasionally profitable ventures make him a natural choice as an intermediary for risky investments like this.
faction_treasury_investment.shippingDetail: The courier pigeon delivers the investment agreement, which must be signed and returned within one week to activate the investment.

usage.activation: Passive effect until the end of each week; requires no action once per week for the Faction XP Boost.
usage.duration: One week
usage.endsWhen: The week ends or the agreement is terminated early.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one boost per month.

faction_treasury_investment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its high-risk nature and potential for reward.

faction_uno_deck.name: Tournament Card Deck
faction_uno_deck.description: The Tournament Card Deck, a simple yet contentious set of cards made from parchment and ink, is crafted by the Faction Quartermaster for casual games among allies. Each deck contains 52 cards that, when played, can either uplift morale or spark heated debates leading to playful fistfights. Players who engage in a game are granted +1 Morale until their next short rest, but must roll a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or risk a minor altercation.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: When a player uses the deck to play a game, they gain +1 Morale until their next short rest. However, if they lose the game, they must roll a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or engage in a minor altercation with another player.

effectDetails.title: Minor Fistfights
effectDetails.rules: If a player rolls a natural 1 on their Constitution saving throw after losing a game, they and an opponent must immediately make opposed Strength checks. The loser of the check takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.

faction_uno_deck.levelRequirementReason: This deck is designed for beginners and casual players to enjoy simple camaraderie-building games.
faction_uno_deck.vendorReason: The Faction Quartermaster ensures that all members have the resources they need, including this popular deck for friendly competition.
faction_uno_deck.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week of purchase. Expedited delivery available at an additional cost.

usage.activation: Playing a game with the deck as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Until the player's next short rest or until they lose and roll a natural 1 on their Constitution saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: If the player loses a game and rolls a natural 1, both players are affected by the minor fistfight rule.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the deck refills as soon as it is used.

faction_uno_deck.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the deck's common rarity and its dual functionality of boosting morale and occasionally causing playful conflicts.

faction_vehicle_repair.name: Vigilance Repair Fund
faction_vehicle_repair.description: The Vigilance Repair Fund is a rare artifact crafted by the Gilded Gryphon to restore and protect the airship Vigilance. This compact chest contains meticulously collected parts and expert knowledge, capable of repairing damage from Iron Legion assaults and restoring its morale. It restores the ship's operational capacity to 75%, repairs hull breaches inflicted during boarding attempts, and enhances crew morale by +15%. However, it demands every last coin you possess for its activation.

effectDetails.title: Repair Hull Breaches
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Instantaneous effect that restores hull breaches caused by Iron Legion boarding parties, restoring the ship to 75% operational capacity. This exhausts upon use.

effectDetails.title: Boost Morale
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. Restores +15% morale for the crew of the Vigilance while it remains on board. Ends when the artifact is expended or destroyed.

faction_vehicle_repair.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic knowledge in ship maintenance to activate and use.
faction_vehicle_repair.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in restoring and protecting the airship Vigilance, thus selling this repair fund.
faction_vehicle_repair.shippingDetail: Ships via specialized airship courier with a one-day transit time from the Gilded Gryphon's central hub.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and use.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; exhausts upon activation.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted or destroyed, no recharge.

faction_vehicle_repair.priceReason: Balanced price considering the artifact's rare material and expert craftsmanship.

faction_veteran_sergeants.name: Veteran Sergeant Training
faction_veteran_sergeants.description: Veteran Sergeant Training is a rare faction boon that allows you to hire elite mercenaries to mentor your squad leaders in advanced combat tactics and leadership. Upon completion of their training, each cohort leader gains +2 levels, significantly enhancing their tactical acumen and battlefield prowess. This item also opens the door for the unique 'Squad Tactics' ability, which lets you coordinate a cohesive battle plan with your squad during critical moments.

effectDetails.title: Cohort Leader Level Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the item triggers a training session led by elite mercenaries. After this session, each cohort leader gains +2 levels to their proficiency in combat and leadership skills. This effect has no save DC or duration; it simply requires the completion of the training, which takes one week with the Gilded Gryphon's assistance.

effectDetails.title: Squad Tactics Unlocked
effectDetails.rules: 'Squad Tactics' allows you to coordinate a battle plan that grants all cohort leaders and their troops advantage on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 hour. This effect is limited to once per day, and it requires the item to be activated during a short or long rest.

faction_veteran_sergeants.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to effectively leverage the advanced combat tactics training provided by this item.
faction_veteran_sergeants.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon is known for its connections with elite mercenaries and its ability to broker such high-value faction boons.
faction_veteran_sergeants.shippedBy: Swift Courier of the Golden Road
faction_veteran_sergeants.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week, ensuring your squad leaders are well-prepared before deployment.

usage.activation: Activates during a short or long rest with the Gilded Gryphon's assistance.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; the training takes place over one week.
usage.endsWhen: The cohort leader no longer benefits from the training once they gain +2 levels.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one 'Squad Tactics' effect per day.

faction_veteran_sergeants.priceReason: The price reflects the rare nature of the item and the significant tactical advantage it provides to squad leaders.

faction_war_declaration.name: Faction War Declaration
faction_war_declaration.description: The Faction War Declaration is a ceremonial parchment imbued with the essence of ancient rivalries. Its crimson ink and gold filigree are said to have been crafted by the hands of long-dead sages during a time when factions warred for dominance. Upon activation, it triggers a 30-day conflict that can be joined or abandoned by allied factions, subjecting all parties involved to heightened tensions and strategic shifts in power dynamics.
effects: Allies may join or abandon the conflict

effectDetails.title: Faction War Declaration
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, creating a 30-day war with another faction. The duration cannot be extended beyond this limit without DM permission.

effectDetails.title: Allied Participation
effectDetails.rules: Allies can choose to join or abandon the conflict at any time during its duration, subjecting them to the same consequences and benefits as the initiating faction.

faction_war_declaration.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 12 to ensure players have sufficient resources and strategic depth for such a high-stakes declaration.
faction_war_declaration.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand is known for its connections to ancient treaties and war declarations, making it the most suitable vendor for such an item.
faction_war_declaration.shippingDetail: Ships via Blood Seal Couriers with a guaranteed delivery within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Requires an action to activate and declare war.
usage.duration: 30-day duration; ends upon expiration or if the initiating faction retracts the declaration.
usage.endsWhen: The conflict ends after 30 days, or if the declaring faction withdraws the declaration before its time runs out.

faction_war_declaration.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its high level of strategic importance and potential for significant impact on game balance.

faction_warp_pipe_hub.name: Portable Warp Hub
faction_warp_pipe_hub.description: The Portable Warp Hub is a sleek, cylindrical device adorned with the emblem of Toad Town. Crafted from rare metal alloy and enchanted with the mystic energies of the Warp Pipe network, it links to three major cities: Toad Town, Rogueport, and the Capital. With this hub, you can instantly transport soldiers or yourself across vast distances, deploy troops at a moment's notice, and ensure an escape route is always available in times of need.

effectDetails.title: Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can activate the Warp Hub to teleport to one of three linked cities: Toad Town, Rogueport, or the Capital. The destination is set by the user and appears as a shimmering portal. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges.

effectDetails.title: Troop Deployment
effectDetails.rules: The Portable Warp Hub can deploy troops instantly to any location within its range when activated with an action. Troops materialize at the designated point, ready for battle or mission. This effect has a 1-hour cooldown between uses and does not consume charges.

faction_warp_pipe_hub.levelRequirementReason: This device requires a minimum character level of 5 to ensure proper handling and operation.
faction_warp_pipe_hub.vendorReason: The market in Toad Town is well-known for its trade with the Warp Pipe network, making it logical for this item to be sold here.
faction_warp_pipe_hub.shippingDetail: Ships within 24 hours via Swiftwind Express, ensuring timely delivery of such a critical tool.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Teleportation) / 1 Hour Cooldown (Troop Deployment)
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the teleportation destination is reached or troop deployment is completed, respectively. Requires a new activation for reuse.

faction_warp_pipe_hub.priceReason: This price reflects its legendary rarity and utility in critical situations.

faction_weapon_cache.name: Weapons Cache
faction_weapon_cache.description: The Weapons Cache arrives in a dusty, leather-bound crate imprinted with the Koopa emblem. Inside lie ten quality weapons, each with a story of rebellion against Bowser’s rule. These arms are not just for show—they’re imbued with the spirit of resistance and can bolster up to ten toads, granting them +1 to their attack rolls until the next dawn. The cache also opens new possibilities for toad allies, allowing them to become armed patrols that defend the faction's interests with unmatched zeal.
effects: Up to 10 toads gain +1 to attack rolls

effectDetails.title: Combat Readiness Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a faction member, the Weapons Cache bestows a +10% increase in combat readiness for one hour. This effect is cumulative with other similar bonuses and cannot exceed +50%. The cache must be checked at dawn to maintain its potency.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Attacks
effectDetails.rules: For every weapon in the cache that is wielded, all toads within a 30-foot radius gain a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for one hour. This effect does not stack with other bonuses of similar nature and only applies while the weapons are actively used.

faction_weapon_cache.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for any level, as it aids in faction defense and combat readiness.
faction_weapon_cache.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post specializes in unique and powerful items that aid the factions of Koopa Town.
faction_weapon_cache.shippingDetail: Due to the sensitive nature of these weapons, they are delivered under heavy guard by a trusted courier. Expect a delay of one week from the time of purchase.

usage.activation: Activates when a faction member checks the cache at dawn.
usage.duration: One hour per weapon used.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon the next dawn or if all weapons are removed from combat use for more than one hour.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the cache remains intact.

faction_weapon_cache.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item provides significant benefits to faction members without being overpowered.

faerun_amber_soul_torch.name: Amber Soul Torch
faerun_amber_soul_torch.description: The Amber Soul Torch is a glowing, amber-hued orb forged from the captured essence of fallen heroes' souls. Crafted by master forgers in the heart of Faerûn, it burns with memories that flicker like ancient flames, revealing hidden paths and guiding adventurers through perilous terrains. When lit, its soulfire weakens undead creatures by 30%, a testament to the power of the dead heroes who gave their lives for this creation.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Amber Soul Torch illuminates hidden paths and secret doors within 30 feet for 1 minute. It can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Weakens Undead
effectDetails.rules: Inflicts 1d4 necrotic damage to each undead creature within 30 feet when activated as an action. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and can only be used once every short or long rest.

faerun_amber_soul_torch.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from the souls of fallen heroes, the Amber Soul Torch requires a certain spiritual understanding and experience to wield effectively.
faerun_amber_soul_torch.vendorReason: Faerûn is renowned for its master forgers who can craft items imbued with ancient magic.
faerun_amber_soul_torch.shippingDetail: Due to the delicate nature of the Amber Soul Torch, it must be shipped via Koopa Postal's express courier service.

usage.duration: 1 minute and Until the End of Your Next Turn
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn or when destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per rest

faerun_amber_soul_torch.priceReason: Balanced against other rare items, this Amber Soul Torch is priced to reflect its unique crafting process and potent effects.

faerun_blighted_bell.name: Blighted Bell of Shadeward
faerun_blighted_bell.description: The Blighted Bell of Shadeward, a cracked bronze bell imbued with the whispers of forgotten curses, is said to have been crafted in the shadowed depths of Shadeward by dark artisans. When struck, it emits a pulse that not only slows nearby enemies' movements by 10% for one round but also sends ripples of psychic agony through their minds, causing 1d4 psychic damage. The bell's resonance can summon minor curses once per day, binding the listener in tenebrous thralls.
effects: Slows target’s movement speed by 10% for 1 round
Causes 1d4 psychic damage to enemies with fear traits

effectDetails.title: Slow Movement
effectDetails.rules: When the Blighted Bell is struck, it emits a pulse that slows all creatures within 30 feet by 10% for one round. This effect has no save DC and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Agony
effectDetails.rules: The bell also deals 1d4 psychic damage to any enemy with the fear trait within 30 feet, requiring a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is also slowed as per the Slow Movement effect.

faerun_blighted_bell.levelRequirementReason: The bell's dark magic and subtle nature make it accessible to lower-level characters who can harness its power with proper training.
faerun_blighted_bell.vendorReason: Faerûn’s extensive trade networks allow for the distribution of even the most arcane items like this cursed bell.
faerun_blighted_bell.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, known for its reliable delivery services across Faerûn. Delivery takes approximately one week.

usage.duration: One Round
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn or when struck again.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the summoning ability can be used once per day.

faerun_blighted_bell.priceReason: The bell's rarity and dark magic make it a valuable yet balanced purchase for players looking to enhance their combat capabilities in Faerûn’s perilous lands.

faerun_blooded_horn_of_zeal.name: Blooded Horn of Zeal
faerun_blooded_horn_of_zeal.description: The Blooded Horn of Zeal is a relic forged from the horn of a slain dragon and the blood of a sacred warlord, its surface etched with ancient runes that glow faintly under moonlight. When sounded, it emits a resonant cry that instills fear into enemies within a 10-meter radius, causing them to falter in battle. Those who have faced death in combat can wield this weapon, whose vibrations amplify allies' courage, boosting their morale by +25% for 2 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Frighten the Foes
effectDetails.rules: When activated (as a bonus action), this horn emits a resonant cry that imposes a -10 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws for enemies within 10 meters. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn, with a save DC of 15.

effectDetails.title: Boost Allies' Morale
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation (as an action), this horn amplifies nearby allies’ courage by granting them advantage on saving throws and ability checks related to morale. The effect lasts for 2 minutes, with a use limit of once per long rest.

faerun_blooded_horn_of_zeal.levelRequirementReason: Requires experience in combat to wield the power of this ancient relic.
faerun_blooded_horn_of_zeal.vendorReason: Faerun's extensive network of artifact traders ensures they can offer such a powerful and rare item.
faerun_blooded_horn_of_zeal.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, known for its reliability in delivering magical items across Faerûn.

usage.activation: Bonus action to frighten foes; action to boost allies' morale
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on enemies; lasts 2 minutes on allies
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends at the end of your next turn for enemies, and after 2 minutes for allies. Recharges after a long rest.

faerun_blooded_horn_of_zeal.priceReason: Balanced to ensure it remains a powerful but not overpowered item.

faerun_bloodstone_amulet.name: Bloodstone Amulet of the Unbroken Heart
faerun_bloodstone_amulet.description: The Bloodstone Amulet of the Unbroken Heart is a heavy, blood-red pendant forged from a fragment of an ancient dragon's heart. It pulses faintly with the last breaths of its former master, granting resilience against magical attacks and instilling a newfound courage in those who wear it during harrowing trials. Wielders report feeling the dragon's spirit within them, lending strength to their resolve when faced with overwhelming odds.

effectDetails.title: Dragon’s Resilience
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this amulet, the wearer gains a +1 bonus to all saving throws against magical effects. This effect persists for 1 hour after removal.

effectDetails.title: Courage Unleashed
effectDetails.rules: When you make a morale check (such as when facing fear or despair), you gain advantage on the roll, and your chance of resisting fear effects increases by 20%. This effect lasts until the end of your next short rest.

faerun_bloodstone_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's power is accessible to all who can appreciate its history and lore.
faerun_bloodstone_amulet.vendorReason: Faerûn has long been a hub for relics of old, and this amulet carries the weight of a thousand battles.
faerun_bloodstone_amulet.shippingDetail: The courier provides expedited delivery to those who seek the amulet's protection.

usage.duration: 1 hour after removal or until expended, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: Removal of the amulet, end of a short rest, or upon destruction of the item.

faerun_bloodstone_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and historical significance justify its moderate price.

faerun_bullet_bill_express_tube.name: Bullet Bill Express Tube
faerun_bullet_bill_express_tube.description: The Bullet Bill Express Tube is a collapsible, pipe-like artifact adorned in red and blue streaks, reminiscent of a high-speed express train. This peculiar device can be attached to any surface and serves as a makeshift teleportation point, allowing travelers to instantly jump between two points within a 50-foot line. When used, it emits a brief burst of mushroom-infused gas, creating a distracting cloud that lasts for 1 round, rendering nearby enemies temporarily blind and disoriented. The tube requires a WarioWare activation key and fails if exposed to Void energy, which destabilizes its internal mechanics.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: The Bullet Bill Express Tube can be activated as an action. When used, it creates a line of instantaneous teleportation between two points within a 50-foot range. The user and any allies within the tube are teleported to the target point. This effect fails if exposed to Void energy or if the activation key is missing.

effectDetails.title: Distracting Cloud
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the tube releases a mushroom-infused gas that creates a 10-foot-radius cloud centered on the tube. All creatures within this area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded and disoriented for 1 round. The effect ends once the duration expires.

faerun_bullet_bill_express_tube.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for adventurers just starting their journey, as it provides an easy means of rapid travel and a useful distraction.
faerun_bullet_bill_express_tube.vendorReason: Faerun specializes in unique and practical gadgets that aid travelers and adventurers on their quests.
faerun_bullet_bill_express_tube.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Bullet Bill Express, ensuring safe and swift transportation of this high-demand item.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Teleportation) / 1 round (Distracting Cloud)
usage.endsWhen: Exposure to Void energy or the end of its duration

faerun_bullet_bill_express_tube.priceReason: The item’s unique combination of teleportation and distraction features, along with its reliability in the field, justifies a balanced XP price.

faerun_courier_item_here.name: Hammer Bros Courier Package
faerun_courier_item_here.description: A sturdy, sealed crate stamped with the Hammer Bros. logo, its surface worn from countless deliveries. This is no ordinary package—sealed without a return address and likely to contain something of significant value or peril. The crate contains either a false treasure, a cursed item, or a genuine fortune, but only those who can wait 24 hours will know for sure. A Hammer Bros. courier might deliver it personally, ensuring its safe arrival in Faerûn.

effectDetails.title: Genuine Treasure Delivery
effectDetails.rules: After waiting 24 hours from the time of delivery, the crate unlocks. If it contains a genuine treasure, the buyer gains 500 gold pieces. If it contains a cursed item or false treasure, the recipient must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to avoid its effects for 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Quest Unlocked
effectDetails.rules: Upon receiving this package, the player gains access to a hidden quest line in Rogueport. This quest involves retrieving lost Hammer Bros. property and restoring their honor. The quest is only available if the crate contains genuine treasure.

faerun_courier_item_here.levelRequirementReason: The crate's contents are unpredictable, making it suitable for players of any level.
faerun_courier_item_here.vendorReason: Faerûn's vendors sell this crate as part of their diverse range of mysterious and valuable deliveries.
faerun_courier_item_here.shippingDetail: Delivered personally by a Hammer Bros. courier, ensuring the package arrives intact in Faerûn.

usage.activation: After waiting 24 hours from delivery, the player can open the crate to discover its contents.
usage.duration: The effects are immediate upon opening and last for 24 hours if a save is failed.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end after 24 hours or when the item's effects are resolved.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as each crate can be opened only once.

faerun_courier_item_here.priceReason: The crate's value lies in its potential to deliver either a significant reward or a dangerous challenge, balancing risk and reward for the player.

faerun_cursed_forged_rod.name: Cursed Forged Rod of the Shattered Sun
faerun_cursed_forged_rod.description: The Cursed Forged Rod of the Shattered Sun is a macabre relic crafted from the bones of a fallen sun god, now imbued with erratic and unpredictable magic. It pulses with an eerie light that flickers between shades of crimson and violet, capable of summoning a spectral flame to dispel curses and enchantments. However, its volatile nature might inadvertently call forth a rival deity’s avatar, posing a grave threat to the caster.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Flame
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can activate the rod to summon a spectral flame that targets one creature within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 4d6 radiant damage and be cursed for 1 minute. The curse ends if the target completes a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Deity Summoning
effectDetails.rules: The rod has a 20% chance to summon an avatar of a rival deity upon activation, which appears in combat as an outsider with CR equal to the user's level + 3. The summoned deity persists for 1 hour or until defeated.

faerun_cursed_forged_rod.levelRequirementReason: The rod requires a caster of at least 7th level due to its volatile magical properties and potential risk of summoning powerful deities.
faerun_cursed_forged_rod.vendorReason: Faerûn, being a major hub for arcane traders and collectors, sells this rare relic despite the risks involved.
faerun_cursed_forged_rod.shippingDetail: The rod must be shipped via Koopa's fastest courier to ensure safe delivery, as it is a volatile item.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for the spectral flame; lasts until dispelled or ends when the curse takes effect
usage.endsWhen: The target completes a long rest (for curse), or the deity avatar is defeated (if summoned)
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day

faerun_cursed_forged_rod.priceReason: The rod's volatile nature and rare crafting materials justify its high price.

faerun_doughnut_bridge_key.name: Doughnut Bridge Key
faerun_doughnut_bridge_key.description: The Doughnut Bridge Key is a tarnished brass key with a worn-out Pianta symbol etched onto its surface. It was crafted by Team Rocket to unlock a hidden passage that once connected Pianta Village to the outside world, before Don Pianta's infamous bridge-cutting stunt. This key is said to have been blessed by Archie Miser himself, but only those of pure heart can wield it without invoking a curse.

effectDetails.title: Bridge Opening
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this key opens the Doughnut Bridge for 1 hour. The bridge remains open until closed by a Pianta Enforcer or by using the key again.

effectDetails.title: Passage Activation
effectDetails.rules: The key grants access to hidden tunnels beneath the doughnut, which are filled with traps and challenges. These tunnels remain open for 10 minutes after the key is used. Any creature entering these tunnels must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be immobilized by an unseen force.

faerun_doughnut_bridge_key.levelRequirementReason: The key requires a certain level of purity and strength to wield without invoking a curse.
faerun_doughnut_bridge_key.vendorReason: Faerun is known for its trade with Pianta Village, making it the logical vendor for such an item.
faerun_doughnut_bridge_key.shippingDetail: The key must be shipped within a sealed container to prevent any accidental use during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour (Bridge) / 10 minutes (Tunnels)
usage.endsWhen: Closed manually or by using the key again

faerun_doughnut_bridge_key.priceReason: The key's legendary rarity and unique ability to open both a bridge and hidden tunnels justify its price.

faerun_doughnut_hole_crimson_candle.name: Crimson Candle of the Doughnut Hole
faerun_doughnut_hole_crimson_candle.description: The CrimsoN Candle of the Doughnut Hole glows with an eerie, pulsating crimson hue, its light flickering like cosmic dread itself. Crafted from doughnut remnants imbued with astral essence by a forgotten mage in the depths of Faerûn, it exudes an aura that subtly warps reality. The candle's flame is said to be fueled by the very fabric of the void, making it both a marvel and a curse among those who wield it.

effectDetails.title: Void Touched Aura
effectDetails.rules: While holding this candle, you and your allies within 10 feet gain advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened for the duration of one short rest. The candle's aura fades after a day.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Distress
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can cause creatures hostile to you within 30 feet to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 2d6 psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. The candle burns out after 30 minutes of use.

faerun_doughnut_hole_crimson_candle.levelRequirementReason: The candle's astral essence requires a certain level of arcane knowledge to manipulate effectively.
faerun_doughnut_hole_crimson_candle.vendorReason: Faerûn is known for its unique and esoteric items, including those with cosmic connections like the CrimsoN Candle.
faerun_doughnut_hole_crimson_candle.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring the candle arrives in pristine condition without any risk of damage.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use; requires attunement to the Doughnut Hole.
usage.duration: Until the candle burns out or is extinguished.
usage.endsWhen: The candle's flame fades after 30 minutes of continuous use, or it can be extinguished by a creature hostile to you.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the candle refills its light once per long rest.

faerun_doughnut_hole_crimson_candle.priceReason: Balanced against other uncommon items with similar effects and rarity.

faerun_echo_gauntlet.name: Echo Gauntlet of the Fallen Archon
faerun_echo_gauntlet.description: The Echo Gauntlet of the Fallen Archon is a gauntlet crafted from the bones of an ancient archon, its surface etched with runes that hum with forgotten battles. When activated, it grants the wearer the ability to hear the unspoken thoughts of nearby allies for up to 10 seconds, providing insight into their intentions and strategies in combat. It also enhances perception checks by +2 for a duration of 1 minute, allowing the user to discern hidden details more clearly.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases the wearer's perception checks by +2 for 1 minute, ending when the gauntlet is removed or at the start of the wearer’s next turn.

effectDetails.title: Thought Reading
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command once per short rest. The wearer can hear and interpret the unspoken thoughts of nearby allies within 30 feet for up to 10 seconds, providing insight into their plans but not speech. This effect ends if the gauntlet is damaged or when the wearer uses an action.

faerun_echo_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet's complex runes and ancient magic require a user of at least 7th level to effectively wield its power.
faerun_echo_gauntlet.vendorReason: Faerun, known for its extensive archives on magical artifacts, is the only vendor capable of authenticating and selling this unique relic.
faerun_echo_gauntlet.shippingDetail: The gauntlet must be shipped via Boo Spectral Mail, a service that ensures safe delivery to ensure the item's enchantments are not disrupted during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Enhanced Perception; command word for Thought Reading
usage.duration: 1 minute (Enhanced Perception); 10 seconds (Thought Reading)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when gauntlet is removed, at start of next turn, or when the effect's duration ends.

faerun_echo_gauntlet.priceReason: The gauntlet's rarity and magical properties justify a price of 1000 XP.

faerun_echo_helm.name: Echo Helm of the Whispering Dunes
faerun_echo_helm.description: The Echo Helm of the Whispering Dunes is a heavy, resonant helm forged in the ancient dunes of Faerûn. Its surface glimmers faintly under moonlight, and when worn, it hums with the forgotten voices of battles past. The helm whispers secrets only to its wearer, granting a fleeting resistance against mind-altering spells. It seems as though the sands themselves have woven this helm from fragments of lost wars, imbuing it with a timeless echo that protects the mind and body.

effectDetails.title: Mindful Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Echo Helm, you gain +1 to your saving throws against charm and compulsion spells. You may activate this effect as a bonus action. The helm hums softly when activated, and the spell's duration is reduced by 1 round if successful.

effectDetails.title: Dune Defense
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to AC against attacks made by spellcasters while wearing the helm. This effect lasts for 1 minute unless you are hit in combat, at which point it immediately ends and you take an additional 1d6 psychic damage.

faerun_echo_helm.levelRequirementReason: The helm's ancient enchantments require a moderate understanding of magical energies.
faerun_echo_helm.vendorReason: Faerûn, a hub for arcane and martial artifacts, keeps the Echo Helm in its collection of rare relics.
faerun_echo_helm.shippingDetail: The helm is carefully packed to prevent damage during transit, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute (Mindful Resistance), 1 round (disorienting hum effect from Dune Defense until interrupted by a hit or spell)
usage.endsWhen: The helm's effects end when you remove it, are hit in combat, or cast a mind-affecting spell.

faerun_echo_helm.priceReason: Crafted from ancient dunes and imbued with powerful enchantments, the Echo Helm is a rare find worth its hefty price.

faerun_echo_of_the_bloodmoon.name: Echo of the Bloodmoon
faerun_echo_of_the_bloodmoon.description: A crystalline pendant that hums in harmony with lunar eclipses, the Echo of the Bloodmoon channels raw celestial magic. Crafted from the glassy residue of ancient moonstone and enchanted by faerie weavers during a total eclipse, it grants a fleeting surge of power to those who wear it during such rare events. Those whose minds are not tempered may experience moments of confusion or even madness as the lunar energies push their limits.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Surge
effectDetails.rules: When activated during a lunar eclipse, this pendant grants +4d6 spell damage for 1 round. The wearer must be within the shadow of the moon's total eclipse to activate its power. If used by a non-magical caster, it fails and causes confusion instead.

effectDetails.title: Mortal Madness
effectDetails.rules: If worn outside of a lunar eclipse or by someone whose mind is not stable, the pendant may cause temporary madness for 1d4 rounds. The wearer must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become confused until the next dawn.

faerun_echo_of_the_bloodmoon.levelRequirementReason: Wearing this pendant during an eclipse requires a certain level of magical awareness and mental fortitude.
faerun_echo_of_the_bloodmoon.vendorReason: Faerun, a master of ancient artifacts, has a deep connection to lunar magic that allows him to craft and sell such powerful relics.
faerun_echo_of_the_bloodmoon.shippingDetail: The pendant must be shipped during the waxing or waning phases of the moon to ensure its power remains intact.

usage.activation: Activating this pendant requires a bonus action and can only be used once per lunar eclipse cycle.
usage.duration: The effect lasts for one round (up to 1 minute) after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wearer is no longer in the shadow of the moon or if the wearer takes any damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per lunar cycle.

faerun_echo_of_the_bloodmoon.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and requiring faerie weavers' magic during a total eclipse, this pendant is both valuable and rare.

faerun_echo_of_the_wolf.name: Echo of the Wolf
faerun_echo_of_the_wolf.description: The Echo of the Wolf is a cursed amulet made from ancient wolf bone and enchanted with the spirits of lost wolves. It howls in response to nearby undead, allowing its wearer to perceive their thoughts for up to one minute. This tool serves both hunters seeking to unravel undead plots and scholars studying the undead's mental patterns, though it risks driving those who use it against living creatures into madness.

effectDetails.title: Perceive Undead Thoughts
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can listen to the thoughts of nearby undead for up to one minute. This effect is instantaneous upon activation and requires no action. The effect ends if the wearer uses it against a living creature or if they suffer from madness.

effectDetails.title: Expose Hidden Hazards
effectDetails.rules: The amulet reveals hidden traps or cursed paths within 10 feet of its wearer, making them instantly noticeable to all. This effect is also instantaneous and can be used once per long rest.

faerun_echo_of_the_wolf.levelRequirementReason: This item's effects are potent enough that only those with some experience should wield it.
faerun_echo_of_the_wolf.vendorReason: Faerûn is known for its extensive trade in magical artifacts and relics, including cursed items with unique histories.
faerun_echo_of_the_wolf.shippingDetail: The Echo of the Wolf must be shipped via a specially enchanted courier to protect it from damage during transit.

usage.duration: Up to one minute or until used against living creatures
usage.endsWhen: Used against living creatures or wearer suffers madness

faerun_echo_of_the_wolf.priceReason: The item's effects are balanced for a rare piece of equipment that requires some level of experience to wield safely.

faerun_ember_satchel.name: Ember Satchel of the Forgotten Flame
faerun_ember_satchel.description: The Ember Satchel of the Forgotten Flame is a leather pouch whose molten thread glows with a warm ember that flickers like embers from an ancient fire. When opened, it releases a steady flame that can light two torches in one round and restore 10 hit points when used to ignite magical flames. The satchel's ember is said to have been crafted by the hands of forgotten priests who once tended to the sacred fires of old Faerûn.

effectDetails.title: Twin Torchlight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can use the Ember Satchel to light two torches in one round. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any material components.

effectDetails.title: Magical Healing Glow
effectDetails.rules: When used to ignite a magical flame, this satchel restores 10 hit points to you or a creature of your choice within reach. You can use this feature once per short rest.

faerun_ember_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The Ember Satchel is crafted for adventurers who need quick and reliable light sources, making it accessible to those of any level.
faerun_ember_satchel.vendorReason: Faerûn's vendors are known for their extensive knowledge of ancient relics and enchanted items.
faerun_ember_satchel.shippingDetail: The Ember Satchel is shipped in a specially prepared, temperature-controlled package to ensure the ember remains stable during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest

faerun_ember_satchel.priceReason: The Ember Satchel is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique crafting process and the magical properties of the molten thread.

faerun_ember_scarf.name: Ember Scarf of the Ashen Throne
faerun_ember_scarf.description: The Ember Scarf of the Ashen Throne, a relic spun from the very breath of a fallen dragon's flames, radiates an unholy warmth that wards against frost and cold. Its embers glow with a dim, foreboding light when danger approaches, warning the wearer to brace for impending doom. Crafted in the shadowy forges of the Ashen Throne, this scarf not only protects but also enhances the wearer's fire-based attacks, granting them an edge in the battlefield.
effects: Glows dimly when fear is detected

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: The scarf grants a +20% chance to resist cold damage. This effect lasts until the wearer enters a state of fear, at which point it immediately dissipates.

effectDetails.title: Fear Detection Glow
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is in a state of fear, the scarf glows with a dim, ominous light for 1 minute. This glow can be seen within 30 feet by any creature capable of detecting magical auras or similar senses.

faerun_ember_scarf.levelRequirementReason: The intricate craftsmanship and dragonfire essence require the wearer to have reached at least fifth level.
faerun_ember_scarf.vendorReason: Faerun, known for its extensive trade networks with ancient draconic artifacts, offers this unique relic to adventurers of sufficient standing.
faerun_ember_scarf.shippingDetail: The scarf is delivered via the Shy Guy Smugglers' secret routes, ensuring it reaches its destination without arousing suspicion.

usage.duration: Lasts until the wearer enters a state of fear or until expended in combat
usage.endsWhen: The scarf's glow fades when the wearer exits a state of fear, and it is exhausted for the day after being used in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the scarf regains its glow once the wearer completes a short rest

faerun_ember_scarf.priceReason: The unique crafting materials and the dragonfire essence required to create this scarf justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

faerun_feywild_bloodstone.name: Feywild Bloodstone
faerun_feywild_bloodstone.description: The Feywild Bloodstone glows with an ethereal, pulsating light that seems to echo the heartbeat of the fey realms. When worn near the heart, it grants the wearer a profound connection to the mystical plane, allowing them to perceive magical echoes and navigate enchanted paths with ease. This ancient crystal can also be used to identify hidden fey constructs or illusions, making it an invaluable tool for any adventurer venturing into Faerûn’s most dangerous territories.
effects: +5% chance to trigger a fey resonance effect on enchanted terrain
Grants a 30-second duration of ‘fey perception’ during combat

effectDetails.title: Fey Resonance Trigger
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has a +5% chance to trigger a fey resonance effect on enchanted terrain within 60 feet. This effect provides temporary magical echoes that can guide or disrupt the user as per the DM's discretion.

effectDetails.title: Fey Perception
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the wearer gains the ‘fey perception’ ability for a duration of 30 seconds during combat. They gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect hidden fey constructs or illusions within 60 feet.

faerun_feywild_bloodstone.levelRequirementReason: The crystal's potent magical energy requires minimal alignment with its mystical properties.
faerun_feywild_bloodstone.vendorReason: Faerûn is known for its deep connections to the Feywild and often carries items that bridge the realms.
faerun_feywild_bloodstone.shippingDetail: The Rakasha deliver this item via a swift, yet ethereal route through the Feywild, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Activates on command as a bonus action. Ends when used or after 30 seconds if not engaged in combat.
usage.duration: 30 seconds during combat
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the end of the wearer's next turn if they are no longer engaged in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per short rest

faerun_feywild_bloodstone.priceReason: While not overly powerful, the item's unique abilities and Feywild origin justify a moderate price.

faerun_fireball_grenade.name: Fireball Grenade
faerun_fireball_grenade.description: The Fireball Grenade is a compact, alchemically charged device that unleashes hellish flames upon activation. When thrown, it ignites a searing explosion within a 10-foot radius, incinerating everything in its path with fiery fury. The grenade's origin lies in the dark forges of the Shadow Marches, where Team Rocket's misadventures led to an ill-fated collaboration with a rogue warlock. Caution is advised when using this volatile device; near wizards might trigger a magical backlash that can prove fatal.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Damage
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Fireball Grenade deals 300 fire damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius. The explosion ignites flammable materials and creates a hazardous area that lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Potential Backlash
effectDetails.rules: If used within 50 feet of an active wizard, there is a 25% chance (DC 15) of triggering a magical backlash. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 50 fire damage.

faerun_fireball_grenade.levelRequirementReason: The Fireball Grenade's volatile nature demands at least first-level proficiency to handle its unpredictable power.
faerun_fireball_grenade.vendorReason: Faerun, with its bustling markets and diverse clientele, is the perfect place for this explosive item to find a home.
faerun_fireball_grenade.shippingDetail: Due to the volatile nature of the Fireball Grenade, it must be shipped in specialized containers and only delivered during daylight hours.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The grenade is destroyed or its effect ends upon activation

faerun_fireball_grenade.priceReason: The Fireball Grenade's rarity and the potential for catastrophic damage justify its fair price of 1,000 XP.

faerun_forged_gauntlet.name: Onyx Hands Forged Gauntlet
faerun_forged_gauntlet.description: The Onyx Hands Forged Gauntlet hums with the residual power of a warlord’s wrath, its blackened iron surface etched with arcane runes that glow faintly in the dark. This gauntlet not only deals +2 extra damage to undead foes but also grants the wearer a +1 bonus to Strength checks against creatures displaying fear-inducing traits. A potent relic from a bygone age, it ensures that none who wear it can be affected by non-magical fear effects.
effects: Grants +1 Bonus To Strength Checks Against Fear-Inducing Creatures

effectDetails.title: Undead Damage
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer strikes an undead creature with a melee attack, this gauntlet deals an additional 2 points of damage. This effect is active as long as the gauntlet remains equipped.

effectDetails.title: Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to all non-magical fear effects while wearing these gauntlets. The effect persists until the end of their next turn after removing the gauntlets.

faerun_forged_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: This gauntlet is crafted for those brave enough to face undead armies or creatures with a fear-inducing presence, but not yet fully versed in combat.
faerun_forged_gauntlet.vendorReason: Faerun, known for its extensive trade routes and access to ancient craftsmanship, would naturally carry such a relic.
faerun_forged_gauntlet.shippingDetail: The gauntlets are carefully packed with straw to prevent damage during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing while equipped.
usage.endsWhen: Discontinues upon removal from the wearer's hands or if the wearer is incapacitated.

faerun_forged_gauntlet.priceReason: The gauntlets are rare, crafted from fallen warlord remnants, and provide potent yet balanced defensive and offensive advantages.

faerun_gravity_ribbon.name: Gravity Ribbon
faerun_gravity_ribbon.description: The Gravity Ribbon is a whimsical, ribbon-like device crafted from ethereal silk and bound by ancient magic. This Faerûnian artifact allows its wearer to defy gravity on the side of the doughnut, floating effortlessly through air currents. It grants a remarkable 20-foot jump vertically, enhancing agility in the Grand Country’s unique topography. However, it causes disorienting vertigo when used in high-gravity zones, making it best suited for those who can handle such dizziness.

effectDetails.title: Defy Gravity
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the wearer floats through air currents on one side of the doughnut. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn or when they choose to descend. It has no effect in high-gravity zones.

effectDetails.title: Vertical Jump
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, granting the wearer a 20-foot jump vertically on one side of the doughnut. This ability can be used once per short or long rest.

faerun_gravity_ribbon.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Acrobatics to fully utilize its gravity-defying properties.
faerun_gravity_ribbon.vendorReason: Faerûnian craftsmanship and Blooper Wetworks' expertise make this item a perfect fit for their inventory.
faerun_gravity_ribbon.shippingDetail: Ships within the Grand Country via specialized air currents, ensuring safe delivery to the recipient.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn or when descending
usage.endsWhen: Ends on their turn if not used again

faerun_gravity_ribbon.priceReason: Balanced to allow for the unique and entertaining benefits without overshadowing other gear.

faerun_greenskin_satchel.name: Greenskin Satchel of Whispering Roots
faerun_greenskin_satchel.description: The Greenskin Satchel of Whispering Roots is a moss-woven satchel pulsating with life, its roots embedded in the very heart of Faerûn’s verdant forests. Crafted from ancient, enchanted wood and bound by a pact with the forest spirits, it absorbs poisons and venoms while subtly blending you into your surroundings. When activated, it grants a fleeting camouflage that makes you nearly indistinguishable to casual observers for a round.

effectDetails.title: Poison Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is subjected to poison or venom, they can activate the satchel as an action. It absorbs 1d4 points of damage and neutralizes the effect for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Camouflage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to Stealth checks in woodland terrain when using the satchel. The camouflage effect lasts for 1 round (6 turns) and ends if the wearer attacks or moves more than 30 feet away from their original position.

faerun_greenskin_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The satchel requires a minimum of 2 levels to activate its effects, ensuring it is used in combat scenarios where the wearer can effectively leverage its benefits.
faerun_greenskin_satchel.vendorReason: Faerûn's vendors specialize in items that harmonize with the natural world and offer unique advantages to adventurers.
faerun_greenskin_satchel.shippingDetail: The satchel is carefully packed for safe delivery, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 1 round (6 turns)
usage.endsWhen: Attacking or moving more than 30 feet away from the original position

faerun_greenskin_satchel.priceReason: The satchel's rarity and enchanted properties, combined with its unique benefits to combat effectiveness, justify this fair price.

faerun_item_name.name: Echoing Helm of the Silent King
faerun_item_name.description: The Echoing Helm of the Silent King whispers the secrets of the past, its cold metal surface etched with runes that glow faintly in the dark. This helm amplifies the thoughts of those who have passed beyond life’s veil within a hundred years, allowing you to hear their final musings and last wishes. It is said the spirit of a once-great king haunts this armor, ensuring its wearer can uncover hidden truths that others cannot.

effectDetails.title: Thought Listening
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can hear the final thoughts of any deceased being within 100 feet. This effect lasts for 1 hour but requires concentration which ends if you are incapacitated or if your helm is removed.

effectDetails.title: Insight into Hidden Truths
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom (Insight) checks made to uncover hidden truths or secrets. This effect is active as long as the helm remains on your head and does not require concentration.

faerun_item_name.levelRequirementReason: This helm provides significant insight into hidden truths but requires no advanced training.
faerun_item_name.vendorReason: Faerun's extensive trade network allows for the acquisition of rare and ancient artifacts like this helm.
faerun_item_name.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring the helm arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to listen; passive effect while worn
usage.duration: 1 hour or until concentration is lost
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or removal of helm

faerun_item_name.priceReason: The Echoing Helm's rare material and ancient craftsmanship justify its moderate price.

faerun_item_name_here.name: Display Name Here
faerun_item_name_here.description: The Display Name Here is a rare, enchanted lens forged from the heart of an ancient forgeheart core. Its surface glows faintly with a deep blue light, and whispers of forgotten lore can be heard when focused upon. This magical device amplifies one's charisma by allowing the speaker to command attention in any crowd, but it also draws unwanted attention from those who seek power or control over others.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the wearer gains advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks and can increase their Charisma modifier by +2 for 1 hour. This effect cannot be used more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Draw Attention
effectDetails.rules: The wearer of this lens is constantly under scrutiny from those within a 30-foot radius who are focused on them, making it easy to become the center of attention but also increasing the risk of unwanted notice. This effect persists for as long as the item is worn.

faerun_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: This rare lens requires a minimum level of 5 due to its complexity and magical properties.
faerun_item_name_here.vendorReason: Faerun, known for their expertise in ancient artifacts, is the only vendor capable of sourcing such an enchanted item.
faerun_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Shipped with special couriers who ensure the lens remains undisturbed during transit to preserve its magical properties.

usage.duration: 1 hour per activation, but not more than once per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user no longer wears the lens or completes a long rest.

faerun_item_name_here.priceReason: This enchanted lens is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the complex magic required to craft it.

faerun_mage_soul_ember.name: Mage Soul Ember
faerun_mage_soul_ember.description: The Mage Soul Ember is a crystalline shard that once belonged to an ancient mage. Its glow emanates from the essence of a lost wizard, and when held, it grants the wielder a surge of arcane power. This enchanted shard can be used in combat zones to reduce magical backlash by half, ensuring spells cast are more stable and effective. For 10 minutes, casting efficiency increases by +20%, allowing for faster spell preparation.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Surge
effectDetails.rules: When the Mage Soul Ember is activated as an action, the wielder gains a +20% increase to spellcasting efficiency for 10 minutes. This effect can be recharged with 30 seconds of rest.

effectDetails.title: Backlash Mitigation
effectDetails.rules: The wielder reduces magical backlash by half (50%) when holding the Ember, and this effect lasts for 30 seconds. The benefit ends if the user casts a spell or rests for more than one hour.

faerun_mage_soul_ember.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed to assist beginning mages who are learning control over their magic.
faerun_mage_soul_ember.vendorReason: Faerun, a reliable vendor known for magical trinkets and relics, carries this enchanted shard due to its significance in arcane lore.
faerun_mage_soul_ember.shippingDetail: The package is carefully packed with protective enchantments ensuring safe delivery within two days.

usage.duration: 10 minutes and 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Casting a spell or resting for more than one hour

faerun_mage_soul_ember.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rare material composition and its significant contribution to a mage’s combat utility without overburdening the player.

faerun_moonshard_sword.name: Moonshard Blade of the Silent Watcher
faerun_moonshard_sword.description: The Moonshard Blade of the Silent Watcher is a slender, wraith-haunted sword forged from the tears of a lost moon-spirit and the ethereal light of the Faerûnian night sky. Its silver blade glows faintly under starlight, casting an eerie glow upon its wielder's path. The sword whispers secrets in the dead of night and deals extra damage to phantoms and illusions, making it a favored weapon among those who hunt spirits and shadows.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Damage
effectDetails.rules: When this sword strikes an illusion, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be momentarily confused for 1 round. The effect can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: While holding this blade, you gain a +2 bonus to Stealth checks. This effect lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

faerun_moonshard_sword.levelRequirementReason: The sword's ethereal nature makes it accessible even to the most novice adventurers.
faerun_moonshard_sword.vendorReason: Faerûn is known for its connections with the celestial and fae realms, making them a fitting vendor for such a mystical blade.
faerun_moonshard_sword.shippingDetail: The sword requires special handling to ensure it arrives in pristine condition; an additional fee of 50 XP applies for this service.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or until you finish a short rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish a long rest or if you drop the sword
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest

faerun_moonshard_sword.priceReason: Its rare construction and magical properties justify its moderate price.

faerun_moonstone_amulet.name: Moonstone Amulet of the Forgotten Pact
faerun_moonstone_amulet.description: The Moonstone Amulet of the Forgotten Pact is a cold, crystalline amulet that hums with ancient magic. Crafted from lunar quartz found in the deep forests of Faerûn, it whispers secrets of lost realms and reveals hidden paths long forgotten. Worn by those who seek to uncover truths veiled by time, this amulet amplifies one's senses, making invisible foes more apparent and granting fleeting invisibility to those who dare to wield its power.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Path
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can activate the amulet to reveal hidden or secret passages within a 10-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and requires no save.

effectDetails.title: Detect Invisible Foes
effectDetails.rules: +5% chance to detect invisible foes through natural vision or with Perception checks, without needing to spend any additional action or resource.

faerun_moonstone_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least level 3 to harness the amulet's ancient magic.
faerun_moonstone_amulet.vendorReason: The Faerûnian merchant is renowned for their vast knowledge of arcane artifacts and relics from lost civilizations.
faerun_moonstone_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost secrecy, ensuring the amulet arrives in pristine condition without drawing undue attention.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer dismisses it or after 1 minute has passed.

faerun_moonstone_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this amulet offers significant utility without being overpowering for a rare item.

faerun_mushroom_core_amulet.name: Mushroom Core Amulet
faerun_mushroom_core_amulet.description: The Mushroom Core Amulet is a pulsating fungal gem encased in obsidian, humming with earthbound power that resonates from the heart of the Underdark. Crafted during the Fungi Civil War by Fungi Knights to harness the ancient magic of corrupted fungi, this amulet grants its wearer resilience against poison and enhances mobility on fungal terrain. However, it's infamous for causing hallucinations in daylight, a side effect that can be both a blessing and a curse.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to poison damage. This effect is active while the amulet is attuned by a Fungi Knight and remains in their possession.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mobility
effectDetails.rules: While within a fungal terrain, the wearer's movement speed increases by 10%. This enhancement lasts for 1 hour per long rest. The effect ends if the wearer leaves the fungal terrain or if they are incapacitated.

faerun_mushroom_core_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The complex magic of the Fungi Civil War lineage and attunement requirements necessitate a minimum level to ensure proper use.
faerun_mushroom_core_amulet.vendorReason: Faerûn's extensive trade networks include exotic items from the Underdark, making it a reliable source for such artifacts.
faerun_mushroom_core_amulet.shippingDetail: Special handling required due to the amulet's volatile nature; delivery can take up to three days.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated by attunement and possession.
usage.duration: Enhanced mobility lasts for 1 hour per long rest while in a fungal terrain.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the fungal terrain or incapacitation ends the effect.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharged with each long rest.

faerun_mushroom_core_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's unique crafting process and the Fungi Civil War's historical significance justify its price as a valuable relic of the Underdark.

faerun_onyx_hand_cursed_talisman.name: Talisman of the Onyx Hand
faerun_onyx_hand_cursed_talisman.description: The Talisman of the Onyx Hand is a cursed black amulet with a clawed glyph etched into its surface. Crafted by Chaos Dwarfs and the Void Syndicate, it grants immunity to psychic manipulation but exacts a terrible price upon contact, dealing 1d6 psychic damage to any enemy that touches you. Allies within reach gain +2 to attack rolls against targets imbued with onyx essence. The talisman's power is such that there's an unsettling 10% chance each day when worn that an ally becomes temporarily possessed by a dark force.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to psychic damage and manipulation effects. This effect is permanent once the talisman is attuned.

effectDetails.title: Enemies Touch Damage
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy touches you, they take 1d6 psychic damage. This effect triggers on contact with a living creature; constructs are immune. The talisman has no charges and can be used once per short or long rest.

faerun_onyx_hand_cursed_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The talisman's dark magic requires the user to have a solid understanding of spellcasting or martial prowess.
faerun_onyx_hand_cursed_talisman.vendorReason: Faerûn's trade network includes rare artifacts from the Chaos Dwarfs and Void Syndicate.
faerun_onyx_hand_cursed_talisman.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly, but with a 1-day delay due to special handling requirements.

usage.activation: Instantaneous on contact with an enemy; triggered automatically upon touch.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or until you are no longer touched by an enemy.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends once used or when the talisman is removed and attunement ends.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged with each short rest.

faerun_onyx_hand_cursed_talisman.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price than its epic rarity to reflect its limited use and cursed nature.

faerun_oracle_item_here.name: Oracle’s Necrotic Lens
faerun_oracle_item_here.description: The Oracle’s Necrotic Lens is a small, obsidian lens with an etched pattern of runes that glows faintly in the dark. Crafted by Chaos Dwarfs using forbidden necromantic rituals, this lens can reveal hidden truths and secrets within a 30-foot radius. However, each use drains 500 HP from its wielder, leaving them temporarily blind for 10 seconds thereafter. The lens may bring ill fortune if used on living beings.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Secrets
effectDetails.rules: The Oracle’s Necrotic Lens allows the user to see through magical illusions and perceive hidden truths within a 30-foot radius. This effect is instantaneous, has no save DC required, and can be activated as an action. The lens has 5 uses per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Causes Temporary Blindness
effectDetails.rules: Each use of the lens causes temporary blindness that lasts for 10 seconds. This effect is instantaneous upon activation and cannot be resisted with a save. There are no duration limits on this effect, but using it again before a long rest ends its current effects.

faerun_oracle_item_here.levelRequirementReason: The Oracle’s Necrotic Lens requires a level 7 character to use due to its potent necromantic properties and the severe health drain involved.
faerun_oracle_item_here.vendorReason: Faerûn, known for its extensive trade with Chaos Dwarfs, sells this item given their expertise in exotic goods.
faerun_oracle_item_here.shippingDetail: Shipped via Hammer Bros Handling, the lens requires special handling and is delivered within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for revealing secrets; instantaneous temporary blindness lasts 10 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or the user takes any other action.

faerun_oracle_item_here.priceReason: The lens is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity, the Chaos Dwarf craftsmanship, and the severe health drain it imposes.

faerun_raveneye_gloves.name: Raveneye Gloves
faerun_raveneye_gloves.description: The Raveneye Gloves are crafted from leather that once belonged to the guardians of Raventree Manor, where they were imbued with the keen eyesight of ravens. These gloves grant their wearer an uncanny ability to perceive hidden dangers and secrets, making even the most subtle traps visible within ten feet. They also offer a passive +15% chance to dodge magical projectiles or spells, turning every shadow into a potential ally in the dark.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Threats
effectDetails.rules: When entering an area with dim lighting, the wearer can use a bonus action to activate the gloves' vision of shadows. This grants them advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for the next minute.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Dodging
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +15 bonus to Dexterity saving throws against magical effects and projectiles, which can be used once per short or long rest.

faerun_raveneye_gloves.levelRequirementReason: These gloves are crafted for adventurers of all levels who value stealth and survival in dangerous situations.
faerun_raveneye_gloves.vendorReason: The Faerûn trading house is known for its wide selection of rare and magical items, including the Raveneye Gloves which are sought after by explorers and scholars.
faerun_raveneye_gloves.shippingDetail: The gloves are delivered with a protective charm to ensure their safe arrival. The courier will provide a tracking number for easy verification.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate vision of shadows, once per short or long rest for enhanced dodging.
usage.duration: Vision of shadows lasts one minute; enhanced dodging is active until the next rest.
usage.endsWhen: Gloves are removed or the wearer completes a short or long rest.

faerun_raveneye_gloves.priceReason: The Raveneye Gloves offer significant utility and stealth benefits, making them a worthwhile investment for any adventurer.

faerun_rogueport_item_here.name: Rakasha Clan Heist Map
faerun_rogueport_item_here.description: The Rakasha Clan Heist Map, a worn parchment embossed with intricate ink and Chaos Dwarf sigils, reveals hidden routes through Rogueport's labyrinthine undercity. This map grants you a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks when attempting to evade traps or sneak past sentinels. It also provides an immediate advantage in locating secret passages by granting the ability to make a Wisdom (Perception) check as a reaction, with advantage if used within 10 feet of a hidden entrance.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Traps
effectDetails.rules: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid or disarm traps, you have advantage on the roll. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Entrances
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction within 10 feet of an unexplored area, you may make a Wisdom (Perception) check with advantage to detect secret doors or hidden passages. This effect can be used once per short rest.

faerun_rogueport_item_here.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third-level proficiency in stealth and perception to fully appreciate the map's secrets.
faerun_rogueport_item_here.vendorReason: Faerun, known for its extensive knowledge of Rogueport's underworld, ensures only authentic artifacts like this are sold.
faerun_rogueport_item_here.shippingDetail: Ships via a secure underground courier system within the city limits; delivery takes no more than two days.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon acquisition; requires reaction or action for specific uses.
usage.duration: Instantaneous or until used up, per effect.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use, recharges at dawn of the next day.

faerun_rogueport_item_here.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant tactical advantage while remaining cost-effective for mid-level adventurers.

faerun_rune_inkwell.name: Rune Inkwell of the Whispering Scribes
faerun_rune_inkwell.description: The Rune Inkwell of the Whispering Scribes is an obsidian vessel filled with a shimmering ink that responds to your thoughts, inscribing ancient runes as you concentrate. Crafted by the scholarly enclaves of Faerûn, this inkwell allows spellcasters to inscribe up to three spells in one go, and the ink's whispers grant +1 to their spellcasting DC for 1 round after each use. This item is perfect for those who need to quickly jot down incantations mid-battle without sacrificing accuracy.

effectDetails.title: Spell Inscription
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a bonus action. Allows the user to inscribe up to three spells in one go, which can then be cast as normal. The ink's whispering ensures that each rune is perfectly formed and ready for casting.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Spellcasting
effectDetails.rules: Grants +1 to the user's spellcasting DC for 1 round after using the inkwell to inscribe a spell. This effect can stack up to three times per day, but cannot exceed +3 to the DC.

faerun_rune_inkwell.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least 6th level spellcasters who need quick and precise ways to cast multiple spells during combat.
faerun_rune_inkwell.vendorReason: The scholarly enclaves of Faerûn are known for their intricate craftsmanship, including items that aid in the study and practice of magic.
faerun_rune_inkwell.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, which ensures swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Bonus action to inscribe up to three spells into the inkwell.
usage.duration: Instantaneous casting of the inscribed spells. Boosted Spellcasting lasts for 1 round after each use.
usage.endsWhen: Uses are exhausted when all charges are expended.

faerun_rune_inkwell.priceReason: The inkwell's rarity, craftsmanship, and the strategic value of its effects justify a price of 1000 XP.

faerun_scarlet_blade.name: Scarlet Blade of the Crimson Queen
faerun_scarlet_blade.description: The Scarlet Blade of the Crimson Queen is a cursed dagger that glows with an eerie crimson light. Crafted from ancient, enchanted steel, it shatters upon contact with undead creatures, leaving them in splinters.
