feywild_fey_soul_ink.description: A vial of liquid starlight that drips with the essence of forgotten courtiers, Fey Soul Ink is a relic from the Feywild, crafted by the whimsical weavers who spin threads of magic and time. When applied to a weapon or spell, it imbues the next spell cast with a random effect—chaos magic, time rewind, or a fey charm. This ink never fails to surprise, but it may cause minor temporal glitches on subsequent uses, leaving the caster in a state of fleeting confusion.

effectDetails.title: Fey Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Grants +2 to Charisma (Deception, Performance) checks when used in Feywild encounters. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Random Spell Effect
effectDetails.rules: When applied to a spell or weapon, the next spell cast has its effects altered randomly: +3d6 damage, time rewind for 1 round, or a fey charm on one creature. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and cannot be resisted with a saving throw.

feywild_fey_soul_ink.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to ensure the caster can effectively wield this unpredictable magic.
feywild_fey_soul_ink.vendorReason: The ink is crafted by the very weavers who inhabit the Feywild and are best suited to distribute its magical essence.
feywild_fey_soul_ink.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly through the Feywild's shimmering mists, ensuring the ink remains potent until it reaches its destination.

usage.activation: Applied once per short or long rest to a weapon or spell.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon casting the next spell.
usage.endsWhen: The spell is cast and its effects are applied; no further uses remain after one application.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it can be recharged with a short or long rest.

feywild_fey_soul_ink.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the unpredictable and powerful nature of Fey Soul Ink.

feywild_fey_soul_pearl.name: Fey Soul Pearl of the Forgotten Court
feywild_fey_soul_pearl.description: The Fey Soul Pearl of the Forgotten Court pulses with an otherworldly light, whispering secrets from the Feywild's hidden courts. When worn by a caster, it reveals forgotten truths about a target creature’s past alliances and unspoken pacts, but at a cost: the wearer may momentarily lose their own identity, forgetting their name for one hour. The pearl grants immunity to illusion spells cast upon you for that same duration.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Forgotten Truth
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Fey Soul Pearl casts a divination spell (DC 15) to reveal one significant secret about a target creature’s past alliances or unspoken pacts. The effect has a range of 30 feet and lasts for up to 1 hour per use.

effectDetails.title: Forget Wearer's Identity
effectDetails.rules: The wearer temporarily loses their own identity, forgetting their name for one hour upon activation. This effect ends when the hour expires or if the wearer takes a short rest. The wearer regains knowledge of their name on completion of a short rest.

feywild_fey_soul_pearl.levelRequirementReason: Wearing the Fey Soul Pearl requires at least first-level spellcasting to effectively utilize its divination capabilities.
feywild_fey_soul_pearl.vendorReason: The Feywild has a direct connection to the hidden courts, making it a logical vendor for such an artifact.
feywild_fey_soul_pearl.shippingDetail: Feywild magic ensures swift delivery through Lakitu Drones; the pearl arrives within one day of order placement.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate, with a concentration requirement for its duration.
usage.duration: Up to 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the time expires or if concentration is lost.

feywild_fey_soul_pearl.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the rarity and utility of the Fey Soul Pearl.

feywild_fey_soul_ribbon.name: Fey Soul Ribbon
feywild_fey_soul_ribbon.description: The Fey Soul Ribbon is a shimmering ribbon woven from the essence of the feywild. When worn, it binds the wearer to the whims of a fey court and grants passage through hidden paths only visible to those who have trespassed. It triggers a random court event that can either bless or curse the bearer, and there's always a chance you might find yourself 'borrowed' by a mischievous fae for 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Passage Through Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains temporary invisibility and can travel through hidden paths only known to those who have broken a rule. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn, requiring no action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Random Court Event
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each long rest while wearing this ribbon, you must roll a d20. On a 1-5, you are 'borrowed' by a fey for 10 minutes, during which time you have disadvantage on all ability checks and saving throws.

feywild_fey_soul_ribbon.levelRequirementReason: Wearing the ribbon requires a basic understanding of the feywild's rules and consequences.
feywild_fey_soul_ribbon.vendorReason: The ribbon is crafted by the weavers of the feywild, ensuring it only sells to those who respect their domain.
feywild_fey_soul_ribbon.shippingDetail: Ships within one week; delivery may be delayed for up to two days due to unpredictable fae interference.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn

feywild_fey_soul_ribbon.priceReason: Balanced as it offers a unique and limited utility without breaking game balance.

feywild_fey_soul_shard.name: Whispering Court Shard
feywild_fey_soul_shard.description: A delicate shard of glassy essence, the Whispering Court Shard hums with the whispers of forgotten fey and offers fleeting glimpses into possible outcomes. Each use risks reality flickering or triggering a minor time anomaly; wield it carefully for insight, but be warned—its power comes at a cost. The shard is said to have been crafted from the soul of an ancient Fey court long lost in the mists of the Feywild.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse Possible Outcomes
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains temporary visions into possible outcomes for a target action or decision. This lasts for 10 seconds and provides +2 to Intelligence (Insight) checks related to the visioned outcome. The shard can be used once per 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Risk Minor Time Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Upon using the shard, there is a 35% chance that reality flickers for 1d4+1 seconds, causing confusion and disorientation to all within hearing range. The wielder must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be affected by this time distortion as well.

feywild_fey_soul_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's power is too great for novices; only those who have proven their worth should dare to use it.
feywild_fey_soul_shard.vendorReason: As guardians of the Feywild, the fey themselves ensure that such powerful artifacts are handled responsibly and wisely.
feywild_fey_soul_shard.shippingDetail: The shard is carefully packed in a spectral envelope to protect it during transit, ensuring its safe arrival.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until the wielder's next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wielder uses another action on their next turn, is interrupted by an attack, or the shard is destroyed in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can be used only once per 24 hours

feywild_fey_soul_shard.priceReason: The shard's rare and powerful nature justifies its high price; it is a valuable tool for those who seek to understand the fates of the Feywild.

feywild_fey_soul_ward.name: Fey Soul Ward of the Whispering Court
feywild_fey_soul_ward.description: The Fey Soul Ward of the Whispering Court is a delicate circlet woven from threads of twilight and moonlight, worn to protect against the psychic prying of fey. It hums faintly with the echo of ancient court rituals, revealing subtle insights into the whimsical minds of nearby fae. When worn, it creates an imperceptible barrier that blocks any psychic attempts by fey to probe or influence you for 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Fey Intrusion Blockade
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, providing a barrier that blocks all fey-induced psychic intrusions within 30 feet for 10 minutes. Ends if the wearer is no longer in contact with the feywild or if the wearer takes any damage.

effectDetails.title: Fey Thought Insight
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a standard action, granting the wearer insight into nearby fey's thoughts, revealing one minor detail about their current state of mind. This effect is usable once per long rest and can be recharged by spending 1 hour in the Feywild.

feywild_fey_soul_ward.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency with Arcana to wear effectively for its intended purpose.
feywild_fey_soul_ward.vendorReason: The ward's mystical properties and origin from the Feywild make it a natural fit for the vendor who specializes in fey artifacts.
feywild_fey_soul_ward.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, known for their reliable but slightly delayed deliveries due to fey interference.

usage.duration: 10 minutes or until blocked by damage
usage.endsWhen: No longer in the Feywild or wearer takes damage
usage.charges: Once per long rest, rechargeable with time spent in the Feywild

feywild_fey_soul_ward.priceReason: Balanced for its unique properties and rarity within the Feywild.

feywild_fey_tendrils.name: Tendrils of the Whispering Court
feywild_fey_tendrils.description: Tendrils of the Whispering Court are living vines that twist and entangle foes, their roots a vibrant hue of twilight green. Drawn directly from the Feywild's heart, these tendrils sap movement speed and infuse targets with wild magic, causing unpredictable stat shifts. Severing them unleashes a burst of chaotic energy, but they also offer a way to anchor allies to a fixed point, preventing displacement for a brief time.

effectDetails.title: Entangle
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can entangle a creature within reach. The target's movement speed is reduced by half (50%) for 10 seconds. This effect ends if the tendrils are severed or if the target uses its action to break free.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Magic Infusion
effectDetails.rules: The user can use this ability as a bonus action, causing wild magic to surge through an entangled target for 10 seconds. The target gains advantage on saving throws against magical effects but suffers random stat boosts or debuffs chosen by the DM at the start of each round.

feywild_fey_tendrils.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character with some experience to wield these potent tendrils effectively.
feywild_fey_tendrils.vendorReason: The Feywild's natural bounty includes these magical vines, which the region's guardians sell to adventurers for their unique power.
feywild_fey_tendrils.shippingDetail: Due to the delicate nature of the tendrils, they are shipped in a specially designed container with cooling packs and must be handled carefully by trained couriers.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action depending on use
usage.duration: 10 seconds for each effect
usage.endsWhen: Tendrils severed or target breaks free, or the duration ends

feywild_fey_tendrils.priceReason: The price reflects the rare material and magical properties of Feywild vines.

feywild_fey_tide_satchel.name: Tide of the Fey’s Whisper
feywild_fey_tide_satchel.description: The Tide of the Fey’s Whisper is a satchel crafted from living moss and enchanted bark, woven by the whimsical weavers of the Feywild. As you fill it with magic energy from the fey realm, it absorbs the power, granting temporary immunity to magical backlash. However, this magic comes at a price; once filled, it may briefly summon a random Fey spirit within your mind, clouding your senses and forcing you to act on its whims for one round.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Magic Backlash
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the satchel absorbs 1d4 points of magic damage each turn for up to 3 rounds. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Fey Spirit Possession
effectDetails.rules: Once filled with magic energy, a random Fey spirit may possess the wearer for one round (1 minute). The possessor grants the user temporary confusion, requiring a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to end. On failure, the wearer must follow the spirit’s commands.

feywild_fey_tide_satchel.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to wield due to the mystical and unpredictable nature of the Feywild.
feywild_fey_tide_satchel.vendorReason: Feywild specializes in items that harness the magic of their realm, making them the perfect vendor for this satchel.
feywild_fey_tide_satchel.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral couriers who may delay delivery if interrupted by fey mischief.

usage.duration: Up to 3 rounds per use.
usage.endsWhen: Ends after 3 rounds or upon absorbing a critical hit.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges, but the satchel must be refilled with magic energy from the Feywild.

feywild_fey_tide_satchel.priceReason: The rare and unpredictable nature of the item's effects, combined with its unique craftsmanship, justify a price of 1000 XP.

feywild_fey_token.name: Fey Token of the Shifting Courts
feywild_fey_token.description: The Fey Token of the Shifting Courts is a small, pulsating orb that glows with the ethereal light of the Feywild. Its surface shifts between hues of lavender and emerald, reflecting the ever-changing nature of the fey realms. This token grants you a +2 bonus to any roll involving wild or fey magic. When thrown into a time loop, there’s a 50% chance it will reset the loop, with an additional 10% chance to trigger a random event from the Feywild. The orb is consumed after use.
effects: +2 to wild and fey magic rolls
Reset time loops (with fey event chance)

effectDetails.title: Magic Roll Bonus
effectDetails.rules: When used, the Fey Token grants a +2 bonus to any roll involving wild or fey magic. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Time Loop Reset
effectDetails.rules: If thrown into a time loop, there’s a 50% chance for the loop to reset. Additionally, there’s a 10% chance for a random event from the Feywild to occur. The token is consumed after use.

feywild_fey_token.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 3 to harness the power and magic of the Feywild.
feywild_fey_token.vendorReason: The Fey Token is crafted by the fey themselves, making it a natural fit for the Feywild vendor.
feywild_fey_token.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost secrecy and speed, ensuring the token arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when thrown into a time loop or used normally.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; consumed after use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon being consumed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the token is replenished by the Feywild.

feywild_fey_token.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and magical properties.

feywild_fey_wand.name: Wand of the Courtly Mist
feywild_fey_wand.description: The Wand of the Courtly Mist is a slender staff hewn from the heartwood of a feywild tree, its bark shimmering with iridescent hues. When invoked, it weaves enchantments that mimic the whimsical magic of the Feywild, granting temporary boosts to abilities but at the cost of fleeting memories. Each use grants one random bonus effect, such as +1d6 to a dexterity check or advantage on a saving throw, yet after three activations, the wielder may temporarily forget a significant detail.

effectDetails.title: Random Bonus Effect
effectDetails.rules: The user gains one random temporary ability boost upon activation. This can include bonuses to checks, saving throws, or other abilities as determined by the DM. The effect is instantaneous and lasts until the end of the user's next turn.

effectDetails.title: Memory Loss Risk
effectDetails.rules: After three uses, there is a 50% chance that one significant memory will be temporarily lost. This effect is instantaneous but can be prevented by completing an 18 Wisdom saving throw at the time of the third use.

feywild_fey_wand.levelRequirementReason: The wand's whimsical magic requires a certain degree of concentration and understanding, suitable for a level 3 character.
feywild_fey_wand.vendorReason: The feywild is the birthplace of this magical staff, making it only fitting that its denizens sell it to outsiders.
feywild_fey_wand.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifters, a service known for its speed and reliability.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect is expended after one use or when the user's next turn ends.
usage.charges: Recharge after three days of rest

feywild_fey_wand.priceReason: Balanced for its daily recharge and limited uses, this wand offers a unique and powerful yet risky ability.

feywild_fey_wanderer_helm.name: Wanderer of the Winking Woods Helm
feywild_fey_wanderer_helm.description: The Wanderer of the Winking Woods Helm is a helm forged from the twisted branches of ancient fey trees, its surface etched with runes that shimmer like starlight. This enchanted headpiece allows the wearer to perceive hidden paths in the Feywild and sense where reality bends. By focusing on the helm's glowing runes, you can detect nearby time loops or reality fractures within 50 feet, but only when you are within a Fey court’s domain.

effectDetails.title: Perceive Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. While wearing this helm, you gain advantage on Perception checks in chaotic Feywild zones for 1 hour. The effect ends if you leave the Feywild or are no longer within sight of a Fey court.

effectDetails.title: Detect Reality Fractures
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a reaction when you sense something amiss, such as a sudden distortion in time or space. You can detect nearby time loops or reality fractures within 50 feet, but only if you are currently within a Fey court. If successful (DC 15 Intelligence saving throw), the helm grants you and any allies within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier.

feywild_fey_wanderer_helm.levelRequirementReason: The helm requires at least second-level spellcasting ability to fully appreciate its magical properties.
feywild_fey_wanderer_helm.vendorReason: The Feywild vendor, known for their extensive knowledge of the fae and their domains, often stocks items that are deeply tied to their realm.
feywild_fey_wanderer_helm.shippingDetail: Delivered by Shy Guy Smugglers, with a three-day delay due to Feywild travel restrictions. Ensure you have it within the next week before its magical properties diminish.

usage.activation: Bonus action (Perceive Hidden Paths), Reaction (Detect Reality Fractures)
usage.duration: 1 hour (Perceive Hidden Paths), Instantaneous (Detect Reality Fractures with successful save)
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the Feywild or not within sight of a Fey court (Perceive Hidden Paths), Failure on saving throw (Detect Reality Fractures)
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per day

feywild_fey_wanderer_helm.priceReason: The helm's rarity and its unique ability to interact with the Feywild make it a valuable yet balanced item for adventurers.

feywild_fey_warp_shawl.name: Fey Warp Shawl of the Shifting Court
feywild_fey_warp_shawl.description: The Fey Warp Shawl of the Shifting Court is a shimmering garment woven from threads spun by fey weavers. Its fabric glows faintly with an otherworldly light, allowing its wearer to briefly phase through barriers and glimpse into the hidden realms of the Feywild. The shawl can create a fleeting portal, opening a small window where time seems to bend, offering moments of exploration that defy the known laws of space.

effectDetails.title: Phasing Barrier
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can phase through Feywild barriers for a distance of up to 10 feet as an action. This effect lasts for 1 minute and does not require concentration.

effectDetails.title: Feywild Portal
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the shawl can create a temporary portal, opening a Feywild window that allows the wearer to teleport up to 30 feet to an adjacent Feywild zone. This effect is instantaneous and does not consume charges.

feywild_fey_warp_shawl.levelRequirementReason: This shawl requires a minimum level of 5 to harness its ethereal power, ensuring it remains balanced within the realm of adventuring.
feywild_fey_warp_shawl.vendorReason: Only those who understand and respect the Feywild would carry such an item, as it is crafted by the very weavers of the fey realms themselves.
feywild_fey_warp_shawl.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu drones, ensuring the shawl arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute (Phasing Barrier), Instantaneous (Feywild Portal)
usage.endsWhen: Ends naturally when duration expires or effect is interrupted
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only use Feywild Portal once per long rest

feywild_fey_warp_shawl.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the rarity and unique abilities of the shawl, ensuring it remains a valuable yet attainable item for players.

feywild_fey_woven_satchel.name: Fey Woven Satchel of Unstable Truths
feywild_fey_woven_satchel.description: The Fey Woven Satchel of Unstable Truths, a satchel bound by the delicate threads spun from a fey court's forgotten bargain, weaves truth and falsehood into its contents with each opening. Its unpredictable nature can reveal hidden truths or weave lies that momentarily cloud perception. The satchel may grant temporary invisibility for one round, leaving you unseen in the world, but beware—its touch can also instill confusion, causing a fleeting state of disorientation that clouds your senses.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Truths
effectDetails.rules: When opened, the satchel may reveal either a truth or a falsehood about the current situation. This effect is immediate and has no save DC. The item can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The user gains temporary invisibility for 1 round (60 seconds). There is no saving throw involved, but this effect can only be activated once every 24 hours.

feywild_fey_woven_satchel.levelRequirementReason: This satchel requires a minimum level of 3 to use due to its unpredictable nature and the potential for disorientation.
feywild_fey_woven_satchel.vendorReason: The Feywild vendor is familiar with the threads used in crafting this satchel, ensuring authenticity and potency.
feywild_fey_woven_satchel.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, the satchel must be delivered via Shy Guy Smugglers to ensure safe arrival.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to open and use the satchel.
usage.duration: The truth or falsehood effect lasts until the end of your next turn. Invisibility persists for 1 round (60 seconds).
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires or if the item is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, but only once every 24 hours.

feywild_fey_woven_satchel.priceReason: This satchel's balanced price reflects its unpredictable nature and potential for confusion, making it a rare and valuable item.

feywild_feycourt_mirror.name: Feycourt Mirror of the Shifting Throne
feywild_feycourt_mirror.description: The Feycourt Mirror of the Shifting Throne is a shattered mirror that reveals the true nature of one’s soul's alignment with the Feywild. Held in hand, it mirrors not just one’s reflection but the essence of the current court's magic, showing whether one's heart leans towards Fey, Chaotic, or Bound. When used while caught in a time loop, this mirror disrupts the loop, causing it to reset back to before your last action, granting you temporary immunity to such effects for that round.
effects: Reflects the true nature of the user’s soul alignment

effectDetails.title: Soul Alignment Revelation
effectDetails.rules: When held, the mirror reveals whether your heart aligns with Fey, Chaotic, or Bound. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Time Loop Disruption
effectDetails.rules: If used while in a time loop, it resets the loop to before your last action. This effect is an immediate reaction and lasts for 1 round. You gain temporary immunity to further time loop effects during this duration.

feywild_feycourt_mirror.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant arcane knowledge of the Feywild to wield effectively.
feywild_feycourt_mirror.vendorReason: The mirror is a direct product of the Feywild’s courts and is known only through their influence.
feywild_feycourt_mirror.shippingDetail: Ships via Rakasha spirit courier, arriving in 1d6 days with no tracking.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when held and used.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or until you are no longer caught in a time loop.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are removed from a time loop, or after one round has passed.

feywild_feycourt_mirror.priceReason: Balanced price for a legendary item that offers both deep insight and practical utility.

feywild_feycourt_scent.name: Court of Whispers Perfume
feywild_feycourt_scent.description: Court of Whispers Perfume exudes a delicate fragrance that allows you to hear the ethereal whispers of Fey courts, providing glimpses into their hidden locations and triggering vivid memories from your last visit. The scent is as enchanting as it is fleeting; after half an hour, it causes mild disorientation, clouding perception and memory for a brief period. This perfume is crafted by the fey themselves, using ingredients from the heart of the Feywild, making it both a practical tool and a magical trinket.

effectDetails.title: Fey Court Whispers
effectDetails.rules: Upon application, you can hear the whispers of nearby Fey courts. This ability lasts for up to 1 hour, revealing hidden locations within a 30-foot radius. You gain advantage on Perception checks made to notice secret doors or hidden passages in this area. The effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Memory Echo
effectDetails.rules: If you enter a Fey court while wearing the perfume, you are overwhelmed by vivid memories of your last visit there. You must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to a momentary disorientation lasting for 1 minute. During this time, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

feywild_feycourt_scent.levelRequirementReason: The perfume's effects require a basic understanding of the Feywild to interpret its ethereal whispers correctly.
feywild_feycourt_scent.vendorReason: Only those who dwell in or closely interact with the Feywild would possess the knowledge and skills necessary to craft Court of Whispers Perfume.
feywild_feycourt_scent.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, the perfume must be shipped via Pipe Express, which ensures swift delivery through Feywild tunnels.

usage.duration: 1 hour for hearing whispers; 1 minute disorientation on memory echo.
usage.endsWhen: Discontinues when the time expires or removed from your person.

feywild_feycourt_scent.priceReason: The perfume's rarity and magical properties, combined with the complexity of its effects, justify a price of 1000 XP.

feywild_feycourts_feywild_item_name.name: Whispering Court Mask
feywild_feycourts_feywild_item_name.description: The Whispering Court Mask, crafted from the delicate petals of the Feywild's twilight bloom and enchanted by the whimsical Faeries, lets its wearer hear the faint murmurs of the Fey Courts. Each whisper may be a prophesy or a lie, testing one's perception and judgment. Wield it with caution, for those who wear it during a Fey Court ritual lose their ability to cast spells for 1d4+1 rounds, risking entanglement in the fey realm's capricious nature.

effectDetails.title: Hear Fey Whispers
effectDetails.rules: When worn, you gain a +2 bonus to Perception or Investigation checks related to hearing and understanding the whispers of the Fey Courts. This effect is active for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Whispers May Be Lies
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest while wearing the mask, you can attempt to discern if a Fey Court whisper is true or false. On a successful Wisdom (Insight) check with a DC of 15, you uncover the truth; otherwise, you are misled for 1d6 rounds.

feywild_feycourts_feywild_item_name.levelRequirementReason: The mask's enchantments and its potential to mislead require a moderate understanding of perception and magic.
feywild_feycourts_feywild_item_name.vendorReason: Feywild, being the realm where such masks are crafted, naturally sells them to those who wish to interact with the Fey Courts.
feywild_feycourts_feywild_item_name.shippingDetail: The mask arrives wrapped in a layer of twilight mist to preserve its delicate enchantments.

usage.duration: 1 minute, or until removed
usage.endsWhen: Removed or end of the duration

feywild_feycourts_feywild_item_name.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and enchanted by Faeries, this mask offers a unique but balanced interaction with the Feywild.

feywild_feytide_ammunition.name: Feytide Ammunition
feywild_feytide_ammunition.description: The Feytide Ammunition is a set of enchanted bolts forged from the wild magic of the Feywild, each one a conduit for chaotic energies that bend time and space. These bolts are said to have been crafted by the elusive fey creatures who inhabit the realm's most enigmatic groves. When fired, they unleash a burst of wild magic that shatters solid barriers with ease and leaves behind a lingering temporal echo, making them invaluable in any pursuit where tracking is paramount.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Echo
effectDetails.rules: When the bolt strikes its target, it leaves behind a brief afterimage of the target's last movement. This effect can be used to track targets in time loops or for quick recon. The echo lasts for 1 round and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Wild Magic Burst
effectDetails.rules: On impact, the bolt unleashes a burst of wild magic that deals 3d6 points of chaotic damage to the target. This effect has a range of 50 feet and lasts until the end of the creature's next turn.

feywild_feytide_ammunition.levelRequirementReason: Even a novice can appreciate the utility of these enchanted bolts in dealing with time-based challenges.
feywild_feytide_ammunition.vendorReason: The Feywild is known for its vast resources and mysterious artifacts, including this set of ammunition that enhances one's ability to navigate the realm's unique properties.
feywild_feytide_ammunition.shippingDetail: Due to the volatile nature of these bolts, they are shipped only via Shy Guy Smugglers for their unparalleled discretion and reliability.

usage.duration: Until the end of the target's next turn or until expended in a time loop
usage.endsWhen: The bolt is used, expended, or destroyed upon impact

feywild_feytide_ammunition.priceReason: Balanced for its unique utility and rarity, this ammunition offers a significant strategic advantage at an appropriate price.

feywild_feywhisper_shield.name: Feywhisper Shield
feywild_feywhisper_shield.description: The Feywhisper Shield is a shimmering, iridescent barrier forged from the laughter of forgotten fae, its edges pulsing with colors that reflect the chaotic nature of the Feywild. When wielded, it deflects magical backlash and grants you a round of time-stasis, during which foes perceive their actions delayed by 1 second. Its shifting hues and enchanting hum make it a formidable yet ethereal shield for those who dare to venture into Faerie lands.

effectDetails.title: Deflects Magical Backlash
effectDetails.rules: When an attack or spell deals magical damage to you, the Feywhisper Shield reflects this damage back at the attacker for 1 round (up to once per long rest). The shield absorbs a maximum of 30d6 points of magical damage before expiring. The reflection has a save DC of 15.

effectDetails.title: Time-Stasis
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the Feywhisper Shield grants you and allies within 5 feet a round of time-stasis (slow motion effect). During this duration, foes perceive their actions delayed by 1 second. The effect ends if an ally moves more than 5 feet away from you or if a critical hit is scored against any character in the area.

feywild_feywhisper_shield.levelRequirementReason: This shield's complexity and magical properties require at least third level proficiency to wield effectively.
feywild_feywhisper_shield.vendorReason: The Feywild vendor, with its deep ties to Faerie magic, offers this unique item.
feywild_feywhisper_shield.shippingDetail: Delivered via a series of enchanted portals, the shield arrives swiftly but may cause disorientation for up to an hour upon initial use.

usage.activation: Reaction (used once per short or long rest)
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with one round duration
usage.endsWhen: The reflection ends when it has absorbed its maximum damage, and time-stasis ends if the conditions are met

feywild_feywhisper_shield.priceReason: This shield's rarity and unique properties justify its fair price of 1000 XP.

feywild_feywild_flicker_ward.name: Flicker Ward of the Shifting Court
feywild_feywild_flicker_ward.description: The Flicker Ward of the Shifting Court is a delicate amulet crafted from shimmering fae glass, imbued with the essence of the Feywild. It grants you a nimbleness that allows you to dodge attacks during time loops, and when worn on nonfey terrain, it briefly disorients your foes by shifting your form slightly. This ward is enchanted by the Jester’s Court and must be trickster’s whispered for its full power.

effectDetails.title: Feywild Shifting
effectDetails.rules: You have a 20% chance to dodge attacks during time loops. This effect lasts for the duration of any time loop you are within and ends when you are no longer in a time loop.

effectDetails.title: Nonfey Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: When worn on nonfey terrain, you cause minor disorientation to your enemies by shifting form. Enemies within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned for 1 round. This effect ends if the wearer leaves the nonfey area.

feywild_feywild_flicker_ward.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of enchanting the Flicker Ward and its ability to interact with time loops make it suitable only for characters at level 4 or higher.
feywild_feywild_flicker_ward.vendorReason: The Feywild vendors are experts in crafting items that resonate with the essence of their domain, making them the ideal source for such an artifact.
feywild_feywild_flicker_ward.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, the Flicker Ward is shipped via Koopa Postal's express courier service, ensuring swift delivery and safe arrival.

usage.activation: Passive effect during time loops; active when on nonfey terrain.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for time loop effects; lasts until you leave nonfey terrain.
usage.endsWhen: No save DC or charges required; ends naturally upon leaving the respective condition.

feywild_feywild_flicker_ward.priceReason: The item's enchantment, rarity, and unique abilities justify its price of 1000 XP.

feywild_feywild_glass.name: Feywild Glass of Shifting Realities
feywild_feywild_glass.description: The Feywild Glass of Shifting Realities is a cracked mirror, its facets shimmering with iridescent light from the Fey Courts. When held and focused upon, it reveals a fleeting glimpse into potential futures within the Feywild—whether you become an ethereal guide or are tasked to tend to a legendary tree. However, heed the glass's warning: some revelations are irrevocable, binding you to the Feywild's will for as long as their magic holds true.

effectDetails.title: Fey Outcome Revelation
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the user must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, they see a brief vision of a future event in the Feywild related to their current alignment or role. The vision is permanent if the DM deems it significant enough.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Stat Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon use, the user gains a temporary bonus to one ability score of their choice (e.g., +1 to Dexterity). This effect lasts for 24 hours and can be used once per day.

feywild_feywild_glass.levelRequirementReason: Even novices may seek guidance from the Feywild, though only those who have proven themselves worthy should handle this artifact.
feywild_feywild_glass.vendorReason: The Feywild's own keepers and guardians are entrusted with such items to ensure they are used wisely.
feywild_feywild_glass.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, delivered directly from the Feywild's heart. Ensure you have a clear path in your mind as it arrives.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate and focus on the glass for its effects.
usage.duration: Permanent until used; daily use limit applies.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after one day, or if the user makes a failed saving throw.

feywild_feywild_glass.priceReason: The glass's rarity and Feywild origin justify its price, as it is a tool for those who wish to align with the Feywild's will.

feywild_feywild_heart_wood.name: Feywild Heartwood
feywild_feywild_heart_wood.description: The Feywild Heartwood is a gnarled trunk shaped like a heart, its bark shimmering with iridescent hues of the Feywild. When held, it pulses with ancient magic that grants insight into hidden paths and forgotten courts, allowing the wielder to discern invisible trails through the wilds or hear the whispers of the fey. The heartwood hums with life, a reminder of the wild magic that courses through the Feywild’s veins.

effectDetails.title: Sees Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect hidden or invisible creatures within the Feywild for 10 minutes. This effect does not work outside of the Feywild.

effectDetails.title: Whispers from Forgotten Courts
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the wielder can hear a mental message from the wild magic court. The message is a single sentence that provides insight into the current situation or future events within the Feywild. This effect has no save DC and does not require action to use.

feywild_feywild_heart_wood.levelRequirementReason: This item’s magic requires some familiarity with the Feywild to properly harness.
feywild_feywild_heart_wood.vendorReason: The Heartwood is a revered item within the Feywild, known for its connection to the fey and their secrets.
feywild_feywild_heart_wood.shippingDetail: Delivered through secret routes that ensure the item arrives without detection by outsiders.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held within the Feywild; active use for ‘Whispers from Forgotten Courts’
usage.duration: 10 minutes (‘Sees Invisibility’); instantaneous (‘Whispers from Forgotten Courts’)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends naturally upon its duration or use limit, whichever comes first.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the heartwood regenerates its effects after a day of rest within the Feywild.

feywild_feywild_heart_wood.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the item’s unique connection to the Feywild and its utility within its domain.

feywild_feywild_rift_key.name: Feywild Rift Key
feywild_feywild_rift_key.description: The Feywild Rift Key is an intricately carved iron key with runes of forgotten fey languages etched into its surface. This relic opens portals to the most chaotic and unpredictable courts of the Feywild, each offering a unique challenge or boon. When used, it conjures a portal that lasts for one round, allowing the user to step into a realm where time may loop, memories distort, or feasts curse all who partake.

effectDetails.title: Court Rift
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Opens a rift to a random Fey court for one round. The court may be a time loop, memory palace, or cursed feast. If the court is a time loop, the user must survive until the loop ends or choose to exit. Thereafter, the user gains +2 to all rolls against fey creatures while inside the court.

effectDetails.title: Fey Echo
effectDetails.rules: The user gains +1d4 temporary hit points for each round spent within a Fey court, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. This effect ends when the user exits the court or the key's use is exhausted.

feywild_feywild_rift_key.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to handle the chaotic nature of the Feywild courts.
feywild_feywild_rift_key.vendorReason: The Feywild is the source and home of this key, naturally making it available from its denizens.
feywild_feywild_rift_key.shippingDetail: Ships via a Rakasha courier who will deliver the key directly to your door.

usage.duration: One round per use
usage.endsWhen: The portal closes or the user chooses to exit
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day

feywild_feywild_rift_key.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item that can offer significant combat advantages against fey creatures.

feywild_feywild_spiral_shard.name: Feywild Spiral Shard
feywild_feywild_spiral_shard.description: The Feywild Spiral Shard is a fractured crystal shard etched with runes of forgotten magic. Held in one’s hand, it whispers the names of lost patrons and distorts time around the wielder, causing all nearby creatures to move at double speed for a brief moment. Randomly, it recalls a memory of a past encounter with a Fey court, offering wisdom or confusion. The shard emits a soft hum that can cause nearby creatures to lose their next action if fate is not kind.

effectDetails.title: Time Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the wielder and all creatures within a 10-foot radius move at double speed for 1 round. This effect ends if any creature takes damage or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Memory Echo
effectDetails.rules: Randomly triggers once per long rest, causing the wielder to recall a memory from an encounter with a Fey court. The DM narrates this memory and its implications. No save is required.

feywild_feywild_spiral_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's magic requires a level of at least 5 to control its effects without causing unintended chaos.
feywild_feywild_spiral_shard.vendorReason: Feywild curates rare artifacts from the fey realm, and this shard is one such relic.
feywild_feywild_spiral_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Rakasha spirit walk, ensuring safe arrival in 24 hours.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: Any creature takes damage or the duration expires

feywild_feywild_spiral_shard.priceReason: The shard's magic is powerful but not overpowered, making it a rare and valuable item.

feywild_feywild_tide_essence.name: Tide Essence of the Feywild Heart
feywild_feywild_tide_essence.description: The Tide Essence of the Feywild Heart, a vial containing swirling liquid that mirrors the heart of the Feywild’s temporal pulse, grants temporary resistance to Fey magic and unleashes wild magic in bursts. Drink it and feel the essence surge through your veins, granting you +1d6 wild magic damage per round for 3 rounds, but at a cost: there's a 50% chance each round that an emotional overload will strike—either losing one action or becoming disoriented until the start of your next turn. The heart of the Feywild beats within this vial, making it both a gift and a curse.

effectDetails.title: Wild Magic Burst
effectDetails.rules: Each round while under the effect of Tide Essence, you deal +1d6 wild magic damage to all creatures within 5 feet. There is a 50% chance each round that an emotional overload will occur: either lose one action or become disoriented until your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fey Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary resistance to Fey magic for 1 round, reducing the damage from such effects by half. This effect does not stack with other forms of resistance.

feywild_feywild_tide_essence.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 5 to handle the essence without succumbing too quickly to its wild influence.
feywild_feywild_tide_essence.vendorReason: The Feywild source this essence from their core and sell it as a rare, potent item for those who can wield its power responsibly.
feywild_feywild_tide_essence.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, which ensures quick delivery but requires the recipient to be within the Feywild’s borders.

usage.duration: 1 round per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn regardless of remaining duration, or if consumed again before then.

feywild_feywild_tide_essence.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item with potent effects that require careful handling and a minimum level requirement.

feywild_feywild_ward.name: Feywild Ward of the Unseen Court
feywild_feywild_ward.description: The Feywild Ward of the Unseen Court, a shimmering sentinel woven from threads of starlight and faerie dust, protects its bearer from the capricious magic of the Feywild realm. When activated, it momentarily grounds your senses in the present, preventing the tangle of time loops that plague the fey realms. Nearby fey creatures grow wary and may flee when this ward is used in a public court of their kind.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Shield
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a reaction, the Feywild Ward grants the wearer immunity to time loop effects for three rounds. This effect does not stack with similar protections.

effectDetails.title: Fey Avoidance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this ward, you have advantage on saving throws against fey illusions and can reduce their chance of success by 25%. Additionally, if activated within a public court of faeries or other fey creatures, nearby fey may flee.

feywild_feywild_ward.levelRequirementReason: This ward is crafted with simple enchantments to protect even the least experienced adventurers.
feywild_feywild_ward.vendorReason: The Feywild marketplaces are known for their wares that protect against fey magic, and this item is a staple there.
feywild_feywild_ward.shippingDetail: Delivered with special care by the Shy Guys, who ensure the ward's enchantments remain intact during transit.

usage.activation: Reaction to prevent time loop effects; bonus action to activate Fey Avoidance in public courts.
usage.duration: Temporal Shield lasts for three rounds; Fey Avoidance is continuous as long as you are in a public court.
usage.endsWhen: The ward's effect ends when the duration expires or it is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration to maintain effects within public courts.

feywild_feywild_ward.priceReason: This ward strikes a balance between its protective and avoidance abilities, making it a valuable tool for adventurers navigating the treacherous fey realms without breaking the bank.

feywild_flickering_bard_rod.name: Flickering Bard Rod
feywild_flickering_bard_rod.description: The Flickering Bard Rod hums with a vibrant, shifting light that dances between hues of twilight and starlight. This slender rod is crafted from the bark of ancient fey trees, imbued with the essence of the Feywild. When wielded by a bard, it can warp reality in unpredictable ways, perfect for duels within the fey courts or chaotic ambushes. Its magic grants +2 to all skill checks involving deception and illusion, and causes nearby enemies to stutter and falter in their actions, creating moments of disarray.

effectDetails.title: Deception Boost
effectDetails.rules: When the bard activates the Flickering Bard Rod as a bonus action, it grants +2 to all skill checks involving deception or illusion for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Feywild Stutter
effectDetails.rules: The rod causes nearby enemies within 30 feet to stutter in their actions as if affected by the Slowed condition for 1 round (up to a maximum of three targets). This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

feywild_flickering_bard_rod.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted from ancient feywood, requiring a bard of at least fifth level to wield its magic effectively.
feywild_flickering_bard_rod.vendorReason: The Feywild vendor supplies unique artifacts that reflect the whimsical and unpredictable nature of their realm.
feywild_flickering_bard_rod.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral courier, ensuring safe delivery through the mists of the Feywild.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; once per long rest for Deception Boost and once per short rest for Feywild Stutter.
usage.duration: 1 minute (Deception Boost) or 1 round (Feywild Stutter)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the bard stops concentrating on it, or if the bard falls unconscious.

feywild_flickering_bard_rod.priceReason: The rod's rarity and the complexity of its magical properties justify a price of 1000 XP.

feywild_flickering_talisman.name: Flickering Talisman of Echoing Steps
feywild_flickering_talisman.description: The Flickering Talisman of Echoing Steps hums with the restless energy of the Feywild, its iridescent surface flickering between shades of violet and indigo. Crafted from enchanted crystal harvested deep within the wildwood, it grants temporary immunity to time-loop effects and allows you to rewind reality for a brief moment, returning you to your last stable step. The talisman's erratic glow signals the presence of Feywild distortions that could tear apart the fabric of space-time at any moment.

effectDetails.title: Time-Loop Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains temporary immunity to time-loop effects and reality-shifting spells for a short duration. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after activation, providing a brief respite from chaotic realities.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Reality
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to rewind 10 seconds of recent events. You can use this ability once per long rest. The rewinding causes minor disorientation and confusion for you until the end of your next turn, as your perception is slightly altered by Feywild magic.

feywild_flickering_talisman.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to harness the unstable energy of the talisman.
feywild_flickering_talisman.vendorReason: The talismans are crafted and sold by Feywild artisans who understand the delicate balance of time and reality in their realm.
feywild_flickering_talisman.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral courier with a slight delay to ensure the talisman's magic remains intact.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends naturally at the conclusion of your next turn

feywild_flickering_talisman.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the rare and unstable magic required to craft this talisman.

feywild_flower_of_twisted_time.name: Flower of Twisted Time
feywild_flower_of_twisted_time.description: The Flower of Twisted Time is a pulsing violet bloom that thrives only in realms where time bends and reality warps. Its nectar, when consumed, allows the drinker to momentarily halt the flow of seconds, creating a pocket of stillness amidst chaos. However, as the world adjusts, a random event unfolds within 10 seconds—either a beneficial surprise or an unforeseen mishap. This delicate flower is cherished in the Feywild’s shifting courts, where it symbolizes the ephemeral nature of time.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Stasis
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the drinker can consume the nectar to pause time for up to 1 round. During this time, no creature or effect can move, cast spells, or perform actions. This effect ends when the drinker uses their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Event
effectDetails.rules: At the end of the first round after consuming the nectar, a random event occurs within 10 seconds. The DM rolls on a d20 to determine if the event is beneficial (DC 15) or detrimental (DC 10).

feywild_flower_of_twisted_time.levelRequirementReason: Consuming this flower requires a certain understanding of temporal magic, accessible only to those who have reached at least third level.
feywild_flower_of_twisted_time.vendorReason: The Feywild is the birthplace of such flora and holds it in high regard for its magical significance.
feywild_flower_of_twisted_time.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of night to ensure safe delivery, as light can disrupt the flower's delicate balance.

usage.duration: Up to 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The drinker uses their next turn or a disruptive effect ends it early

feywild_flower_of_twisted_time.priceReason: This flower's rarity and the risk of its unpredictable effects justify its moderate price.

feywild_fungal_blood_amber.name: Fungal Blood Amber
feywild_fungal_blood_amber.description: Fungal Blood Amber, a translucent gem pulsing with crimson light, is said to have been crafted from the heart of a fallen princess in the Whispering Fungi’s embrace. This eerie relic warps reality when touched, causing the air around it to shimmer and distort. When consumed, it grants temporary immunity to mind control but may unleash vivid hallucinations of one's deepest regrets, leaving the imbiber lost in a swirling maelstrom of memory.

effectDetails.title: Mind Control Immunity
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the user gains temporary immunity to all mind control effects for a duration of 10 minutes. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Personal Regret Hallucinations
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the user is subjected to vivid hallucinations that reflect their deepest personal regrets. These visions last for 30 seconds and do not require a saving throw but may cause the user to become incapacitated due to shock or trauma.

feywild_fungal_blood_amber.levelRequirementReason: This item can be consumed by any level 1 character, providing immediate utility without demanding advanced combat capabilities.
feywild_fungal_blood_amber.vendorReason: The Feywild is known for its enigmatic and otherworldly relics, making it a fitting source for this mystical amber.
feywild_fungal_blood_amber.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Rakasha's ethereal plane courier service, ensuring swift delivery through the Feywild’s portals.

usage.duration: 10 minutes of immunity to mind control; visions last for 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration ends or user becomes incapacitated by hallucinations

feywild_fungal_blood_amber.priceReason: The item’s rarity, origin from the Feywild, and unique effects justify a price of 1000 XP.

feywild_glimmering_ambrosia.name: Glimmering Ambrosia
feywild_glimmering_ambrosia.description: Glimmering Ambrosia, a shimmering nectar that glows faintly like starlight in the murk of the Whispering Wells, is said to be sipped directly from the Feywild's hidden courts. Drinking this ethereal essence rewinds time for one round to your last action, allowing you to correct minor mistakes or seize fleeting opportunities. For a moment, you catch a glimpse into the Feywild’s veiled realms, where the trees whisper secrets and the air hums with ancient magic, granting you a brief vision of hidden courts and their ethereal inhabitants.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Time
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can rewind time for one round to your last action. This effect has no range or area and is instantaneous. You regain the use of your last action, but any damage or effects that occurred in that round are negated. There is no saving throw against this effect.

effectDetails.title: Feywild Vision
effectDetails.rules: For one round after drinking Glimmering Ambrosia, you gain the ability to perceive hidden Feywild courts and their inhabitants. This vision lasts for 1 minute. You can see through illusions and observe the delicate magic that binds these hidden realms, but you cannot interact with them directly.

feywild_glimmering_ambrosia.levelRequirementReason: This item's power requires a character to be at least level 3 to effectively utilize its time-reversal and vision abilities.
feywild_glimmering_ambrosia.vendorReason: The Feywild is the source of this nectar, and only those who understand its mysteries can procure it.
feywild_glimmering_ambrosia.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of Glimmering Ambrosia, it must be shipped in specially insulated containers to ensure it arrives at its destination in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Rewind Time; 1 minute for Feywild Vision
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally after their respective durations or if the drinker takes any damage.

feywild_glimmering_ambrosia.priceReason: This nectar is rare and requires significant resources to procure, making it a valuable but not overpowered item.

feywild_hedge_maze_key.name: Hedge Maze Key
feywild_hedge_maze_key.description: The Hedge Maze Key is a delicate silver token, intricately etched with symbols of the Feywild. It opens the enigmatic labyrinth and can be enchanted to reveal hidden paths within. Carrying it allows you to teleport through the thorned maze, while nearby enemies may become momentarily disoriented by its arcane power. This key must be held to activate its magic, making navigation both a challenge and a reward for those who dare enter.
effects: Teleports to nearest hedge maze entrance
Causes minor confusion among enemies in the maze

effectDetails.title: Maze Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: When the key is held, the wielder can teleport instantly to the nearest entrance of a hedge maze. This effect has a duration of instantaneous and requires no saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Minor Confusion
effectDetails.rules: Any creature within 30 feet of the wielder in a hedge maze must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12) or become confused for 1 minute. This effect can only be triggered once per day, and it ends if the key is lost.

feywild_hedge_maze_key.levelRequirementReason: This key requires no level to activate, as its magic is accessible to all who understand its purpose within the Feywild.
feywild_hedge_maze_key.vendorReason: The Feywild vendor sells this key because it is a symbol of their realm's enchantments and helps travelers navigate the labyrinthine paths.
feywild_hedge_maze_key.shippingDetail: Transit through the maze itself, ensuring the key arrives intact for its next adventure.

usage.activation: Held in hand to activate teleportation; held and spoken with a command word to trigger confusion among enemies.
usage.duration: Instantaneous teleportation; confusion lasts until the duration ends or the effect is dispelled.
usage.endsWhen: The key is lost, destroyed, or its daily use limit is reached.

feywild_hedge_maze_key.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and utility in navigating the maze, as well as its enchantment potential.

feywild_illusion_generator.name: Feywild Illusion Generator (Toy)
feywild_illusion_generator.description: The Feywild Illusion Generator is a whimsical toy crafted by the elusive Fey Tricksters, whose magic weaves illusions that dance and shift like living light. Its intricate gears and enchanted springs hum with the energy of the Feywild itself, capable of producing lifelike specters that playfully interact with their environment for up to an hour at a time. It's a beloved item among courtiers and jesters who use it to entertain guests or deceive foes in subtle ways.

effectDetails.title: Generate Illusion
effectDetails.rules: The generator can produce an illusion within a 100-foot radius. The illusion lasts for up to one hour, during which time it interacts with its surroundings in a manner consistent with the environment's setting.

effectDetails.title: Daily Uses
effectDetails.rules: The toy has five uses per day. Once depleted, it must be recharged by spending an hour of quiet meditation and focus. The illusion is dispelled if the generator is damaged or its daily limit is reached.

feywild_illusion_generator.levelRequirementReason: This toy is designed for a wide audience, from young adventurers to seasoned court jesters.
feywild_illusion_generator.vendorReason: The illusion shop specializes in magical curiosities and toys that delight and astonish their patrons.
feywild_illusion_generator.shippingDetail: Ships via the fastest mirage winds, ensuring swift delivery to even the most distant lands.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate the generator.
usage.duration: The illusion lasts up to one hour or until disrupted.
usage.endsWhen: The illusion ends if its uses are exhausted or it is damaged.
usage.charges: Five daily uses, recharged after a full day of meditation.

feywild_illusion_generator.priceReason: This toy's price reflects the Feywild magic and craftsmanship required to create such an enchanting device.

feywild_item_name.name: Heartbeat of the Unbound
feywild_item_name.description: The Heartbeat of the Unbound is a translucent, pulsating crystal that hums with the chaotic energy of the Feywild. When worn, it resonates with the emotional and temporal shifts around you, revealing hidden paths in the labyrinthine forests or lost moments in time. Standing still allows you to sense when a time loop has formed nearby, potentially resetting it for a brief moment, granting insight into otherwise hidden court rituals.

effectDetails.title: Detects Emotional Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the crystal allows you to sense emotional shifts in nearby fey creatures within a 30-foot radius. This effect is passive and does not require action.

effectDetails.title: Identifies Time Loops
effectDetails.rules: By standing still for at least one round, you can detect if a time loop has formed around you. If it has, the loop resets for 1 round (6 turns). This effect is instantaneous and requires no action to activate.

feywild_item_name.levelRequirementReason: The crystal's sensitivity to Feywild energies and temporal anomalies demands a certain level of magical awareness.
feywild_item_name.vendorReason: The Heartbeat of the Unbound is a product of the Feywild, crafted by its own creatures for those who seek to understand their realm better.
feywild_item_name.shippingDetail: The item is shipped via special courier, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition and fully charged.

usage.duration: Permanent until removed or broken.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends if the crystal breaks or is removed from your person.

feywild_item_name.priceReason: The Heartbeat of the Unbound represents a rare and valuable tool for navigating the complexities of the Feywild, making it worth its weight in XP.

feywild_item_name_here.name: Trickster Scepter of Twisted Time
feywild_item_name_here.description: The Trickster Scepter of Twisted Time is a staff forged from the whimsical essence of the Feywild, its surface adorned with intricate runes that shimmer like starlight. This enchanted tool allows you to bend time itself, granting moments of temporal freedom. With it, you can step out of the flow of time for 1 minute per use and skip through three short intervals of time daily, causing minor confusion in your allies during each skip but ensuring your own actions remain seamless.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Bending
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the scepter, you become immune to time loops for 1 minute. You can use this ability once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Time Skip
effectDetails.rules: You may skip through three intervals of time each day. During each skip, minor confusion affects your allies within 30 feet of you for 1 minute. You regain these skips after completing a long rest.

feywild_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: The scepter requires a 5th level character to manage its temporal effects without overwhelming their concentration.
feywild_item_name_here.vendorReason: The Pony Nobility, masters of the Feywild, crafted this scepter to grant time-bending abilities that are both useful and balanced within their realm's delicate balance.
feywild_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Ships via Warp Whistle Transit, known for their swift yet reliable deliveries through the Feywild’s ethereal paths.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you complete a short or long rest
usage.charges: Uses per day are regained after completing a long rest

feywild_item_name_here.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this scepter offers powerful but balanced time manipulation abilities suitable for its rarity and intended use.

feywild_loom_of_fey_winds.name: Loom of Fey Winds
feywild_loom_of_fey_winds.description: The Loom of Fey Winds is a delicate, wind-swept loom crafted from the ethereal threads of the Feywild. Its wooden frame glows faintly with the colors of twilight, and its strings are woven from the very essence of time and chaos. When activated, it allows the user to 'reweave' reality, resetting a scene by 3 seconds or creating entirely new sequences, all in perfect harmony with the whimsical winds of the Feywild.

effectDetails.title: Time Rewind
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can rewind time by 3 seconds. This effect resets all actions and decisions made since the last use of this ability within that timeframe. The ability can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Chaos Weave
effectDetails.rules: As an action, activate the loom to introduce a random chaotic alteration affecting up to two enemy abilities for one round. This effect has a 50% chance of success and can be used once per long rest.

feywild_loom_of_fey_winds.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency with Feywild magic to properly harness the loom's unpredictable forces.
feywild_loom_of_fey_winds.vendorReason: The Loom is a staple of the Feywild, often crafted by its weavers and sold among those who dwell in harmony with nature’s capricious heart.
feywild_loom_of_fey_winds.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay; delivery can take up to one week due to the mystical nature of Feywild travel.

usage.activation: Bonus action or action (for Chaos Weave)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Time Rewind, one round for Chaos Weave
usage.endsWhen: On use; ends immediately if the user is incapacitated or dies
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each long rest resets the ability's cooldown

feywild_loom_of_fey_winds.priceReason: Reflects its rarity and the complex magic required to craft such a versatile item.

feywild_looming_fey_hive.name: Looming Fey Hive
feywild_looming_fey_hive.description: The Looming Fey Hive looms large, its shifting tendrils and iridescent carapace a testament to the wild magic that binds it. This hive is not just a home but also a vessel of ancient Fey power; as you approach, it expands in response to your presence, granting temporary dominion over nearby fey. However, if you ever abandon it or fail to maintain its core, it will unleash a tempest of stinging wasps that can turn even the most seasoned adventurers into targets of its fury.
effects: Grants +2 to all rolls in Feywild terrain
Can be used to summon a temporary Fey court

effectDetails.title: Fey Control
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. The hive expands for 10 minutes, granting you advantage on perception checks within 60 feet and allowing you to use a bonus action each round to command any Fey creature within your reach, provided it doesn't exceed your Charisma modifier in challenge rating.

effectDetails.title: Court Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. For the next 1 hour, you can summon and control a temporary Fey court composed of fey creatures whose total CR does not exceed your level +2. These creatures are under your command for the duration.

feywild_looming_fey_hive.levelRequirementReason: Requires 4th level to channel the ancient magic needed to maintain and command such a powerful Fey construct.
feywild_looming_fey_hive.vendorReason: The Feywild vendor, known for dealing in rare magical items, carries this item due to its unique power within their realm.
feywild_looming_fey_hive.shippingDetail: Special delivery service ensures the hive arrives intact and ready for use.

usage.duration: Fey Control: 10 minutes, Court Summoning: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), the hive is abandoned, or destroyed.

feywild_looming_fey_hive.priceReason: Reflects its powerful abilities within Feywild terrain and its unique Fey origin.

feywild_looming_lullaby.name: Looming Lullaby of the Shifting Court
feywild_looming_lullaby.description: The Looming Lullaby of the Shifting Court is a crystal flute etched with Feywild runes that whisper tales of forgotten realms. When played, it sends nearby creatures into a trance-like state where they either repeat a single action in an endless loop or are temporarily lost to their own memories. Only within the heart of the Feywild can its haunting melody resonate fully, and those who hear it must brace for a momentary loss of focus and purpose.

effectDetails.title: Trance-like State
effectDetails.rules: When played within the Feywild, this lullaby causes one creature to enter a trance for 1 round. The creature is dazed and cannot take actions or move. This effect ends if the creature takes any action other than remaining still.

effectDetails.title: Memory Loop
effectDetails.rules: Additionally, when played in the Feywild, it grants you the ability to create a 10-foot radius area around yourself where creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or enter a memory loop for 2 rounds. In this state, they are unable to recall anything that transpired during their looped actions.

feywild_looming_lullaby.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of controlling the lullaby's effects and navigating the Feywild require a minimum character level.
feywild_looming_lullaby.vendorReason: The flute’s origins in the Feywild ensure it only finds its way to those who understand its power.
feywild_looming_lullaby.shippingDetail: Due to the flute's delicate nature and the need for proper conditions, it is shipped with specialized care by Shy Guy Smugglers.

usage.activation: Playing the lullaby as a bonus action within the Feywild activates its effects.
usage.duration: Each effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn unless interrupted or dispelled.
usage.endsWhen: The creature takes any action other than remaining still, or the caster is no longer in the Feywild.

feywild_looming_lullaby.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique abilities and rarity within the Feywild.

feywild_loop_bangle.name: Loop Bangle of Unending Thirst
feywild_loop_bangle.description: The Loop Bangle of Unending Thirst, a cold iron bauble pulsating with wild magic, distorts time in its wearer’s grasp. Every thirty seconds, it forces the user to relive the last half-minute, repeating their actions ad infinitum until they break free or exhaust its three uses. This bangle is said to have been forged from the very essence of the Feywild, where it feeds on the chaos and unpredictability that define its origin.

effectDetails.title: Time Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Activating this bangle causes a time loop, repeating the wearer’s actions from thirty seconds prior. The effect lasts until the user stops wearing it or uses up all three charges within a session.

effectDetails.title: Wild Magic Amplification
effectDetails.rules: While active, the Loop Bangle amplifies wild magic damage by 20%, affecting any spell or effect that deals such damage. This boost is only effective when the bangle’s time loop is in effect.

feywild_loop_bangle.levelRequirementReason: The bangle can be wielded by lower-level characters, but its unpredictable nature requires caution and experience.
feywild_loop_bangle.vendorReason: Feywild vendors have a knack for dealing with items of wild magic and chaos.
feywild_loop_bangle.shippingDetail: The bangle is carefully packed in enchanted bubble wrap to protect it from the time loops during transit.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action, remaining active until removed or used up all charges for the session.
usage.duration: Until removed or expended
usage.endsWhen: Worn off or charges exhausted

feywild_loop_bangle.priceReason: The bangle’s wild magic and time-altering capabilities make it a rare and valuable item, but not so powerful as to be overpriced.

feywild_loop_key.name: Time Loop Key
feywild_loop_key.description: The Time Loop Key is an ancient, tarnished key forged from twisted briarwood and enchanted with Feywild magic. It opens portals to the time loops of the Feywild realm, allowing one to retrace their steps or escape a trap. With each use, the wielder must endure the temporal disorientation that comes from traversing these loops, but they are granted temporary immunity to any further loop effects for a round thereafter.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Tether
effectDetails.rules: The user may activate the key as an action, entering a time loop that lasts for 1d4 rounds. During this time, they can choose to either reset their actions or continue them from where they left off. While in the loop, they are immune to any further time loop effects.

effectDetails.title: Loop Escape
effectDetails.rules: For one round after using the key, the user gains temporary immunity to the effects of time loops and similar temporal anomalies.

feywild_loop_key.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic required to wield this key is accessible to those with a basic understanding of Feywild lore.
feywild_loop_key.vendorReason: The fey themselves recognize the value of such a key, which can be crucial for navigating their ever-changing realm.
feywild_loop_key.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, the Time Loop Key is shipped under special conditions with Koopa Postal ensuring safe delivery.

usage.duration: 1d4 rounds (user may choose to reset or continue)
usage.endsWhen: The user chooses to exit the loop or it expires after 1d4 rounds
usage.charges: 1 charge per use; recharges after 1d4 hours

feywild_loop_key.priceReason: This key represents a balance between the cost of Feywild magic and its utility, making it accessible but not trivial.

feywild_loop_key_ring.name: Loop Key Ring
feywild_loop_key_ring.description: The Feywild Loop Key Ring is a delicate, silver chain adorned with an etched loop that can only be found in the heart of the timeless forests. When worn, it allows its bearer to traverse through time's loops effortlessly, but each use risks either gaining or losing precious seconds of their life. The key ring whispers of ancient Feywild legends and promises those who dare to wear it a dance between past and future.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Passage
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can activate this key ring to enter or exit a time loop. The duration is instantaneous but requires the passage of 10 seconds in real time as a cost. Each use has a chance of gaining or losing one moment of real time. A successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw negates the risk.

effectDetails.title: Fey Court Invitation
effectDetails.rules: If used during a loop, the key ring triggers a Fey Court effect, inviting the wearer to a brief audience with the spirits of the Feywild. This effect lasts for 1 minute and imposes no additional risks or drawbacks.

feywild_loop_key_ring.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and inherent risk of using the key ring make it suitable only for those who have proven their worth through experience.
feywild_loop_key_ring.vendorReason: Feywild is the heart of this item's origin, making them the most knowledgeable about its properties.
feywild_loop_key_ring.shippingDetail: The key ring must be delivered by a Rakasha courier to ensure it reaches its destination intact and unaltered.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: After each use or if the wearer fails their saving throw.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but risks apply with each use.

feywild_loop_key_ring.priceReason: The item's rarity and magical properties justify a price of 1000 XP, reflecting its value in both lore and practical application.

feywild_loop_mirror.name: Mirror of the Shifting Hour
feywild_loop_mirror.description: The Mirror of the Shifting Hour is a glassy orb that seems to shimmer with an ethereal light, reflecting the current moment while simultaneously showing a glimpse into what will come in just ten fleeting seconds. Its surface dances like water, mirroring both past and future, yet it may disorient the user if employed too frequently or in moments of heightened stress. Use this mirror to avoid traps, but be wary of the unintended consequences that could unfold from seeing the future too clearly.

effectDetails.title: Reflects Future
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this mirror shows an image of the next ten seconds of reality. The effect is instantaneous and provides a +2 insight bonus to any Dexterity (Stealth) check made immediately after activation. This benefit lasts until your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Mirage
effectDetails.rules: If used too often, or in moments of high stress, the mirror's surface can become unstable, causing a brief state of disorientation. On such occasions, you are incapacitated for 1 round as your perception of time becomes skewed.

feywild_loop_mirror.levelRequirementReason: A basic understanding of timing and situational awareness is necessary to effectively use this mirror.
feywild_loop_mirror.vendorReason: The feywild are known for their intimate connection with time, making them the best vendors for such a tool.
feywild_loop_mirror.shippingDetail: The mirror arrives securely packaged to prevent any accidental use during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; +2 insight bonus lasts until your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends after one use or if you take damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only once per short rest

feywild_loop_mirror.priceReason: This price reflects the mirror's rarity and the complexities of its temporal mechanics.

feywild_loop_rod.name: Rod of the Infinite Loop
feywild_loop_rod.description: The Rod of the Infinite Loop is a slender, silver rod that hums with an ethereal, chaotic energy. It pulses with unpredictable temporal fluxes, and when swung, it weaves a localized loop in time, forcing its wielder to choose between two divergent outcomes—one fraught with peril and the other promising unforeseen rewards. The rod’s power is both a blessing and a curse; each loop may bring about memory loss or cause one to relive past events, altering the course of the future.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Loop
effectDetails.rules: When swung as a bonus action, the rod creates a 5-foot radius temporal loop for up to 1 minute. The wielder must choose between two outcomes: one that brings about memory loss or hallucinations, and another where time may inadvertently be altered. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Consequences
effectDetails.rules: The chosen outcome has a chance to cause additional effects, such as accidental time travel or temporal distortions affecting the immediate area. These effects are unpredictable and vary in severity. The wielder must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer from the chosen consequence.

feywild_loop_rod.levelRequirementReason: This rod requires a minimum level to ensure the user can handle its unpredictable temporal properties.
feywild_loop_rod.vendorReason: The Feywild market is known for exotic and powerful artifacts, making it an ideal place for such a unique item.
