forgery_commission.vendorReason: The Rogueport Black Market is known for its specialized services, including those from master forgers who can craft convincing fakes.
forgery_commission.shippingDetail: Documents are sent via a secure courier service to ensure they reach you in three days without being intercepted or examined.

usage.duration: Instantaneous upon completion of the forgery process
usage.endsWhen: The document is discovered or destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the service can be used multiple times

forgery_commission.priceReason: The price reflects the expertise and time required to create a convincing fake that can pass inspection with only a DC 12 check.

formosa_ultima_bamboo_steamer.name: Formosa Ultima Bamboo Steamer
formosa_ultima_bamboo_steamer.description: Crafted from ancient Formosa bamboo, this steamer ensures that every rice ball and delicate dish emerges perfectly shaped without sticking. Its layers preserve nutrients, granting +1 hit point to any character who consumes a meal prepared in it. The steamers warp at extreme dry heat but are easily restored by a quick dip in water. A specialty of the Ultima Bamboo Crafters, this item has been trusted for generations across Formosa Village.

effectDetails.title: Nutrient-Preserving Steam
effectDetails.rules: When a meal is prepared in the steamer, any character consuming it gains +1 hit point. This effect does not stack with similar effects.

effectDetails.title: Shape-Shaping Advantage
effectDetails.rules: The user has advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks to shape and form rice into perfect spheres or delicate forms.

formosa_ultima_bamboo_steamer.levelRequirementReason: This steamer is designed for beginners in the kitchen, making it accessible to all adventurers.
formosa_ultima_bamboo_steamer.vendorReason: Formosa Village is known for its bamboo craftsmanship and this steamer is a signature product of their artisans.
formosa_ultima_bamboo_steamer.shippingDetail: Ships within one week, delivered by trusted Bamboo Basket Bundle couriers.

usage.activation: Passive upon preparation of food in the steamer.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and permanent for each meal prepared.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted with use; no recharge required.

formosa_ultima_bamboo_steamer.priceReason: The price reflects the craftsmanship, rarity of materials, and long-standing tradition behind this culinary tool.

formosa_ultima_beauty_enhancement.name: Formosa Ultima Beauty Enhancement
formosa_ultima_beauty_enhancement.description: Formosa Ultima's Beauty Enhancement transforms you into a living masterpiece, your features captured in timeless perfection. For one week, your appearance becomes a canvas of Renaissance elegance, granting +2 Charisma and -2 Dexterity. Art critics from around the globe may seek to 'collect' this moving portrait, turning your journey into a whirlwind of admiration or scrutiny. Beware: water damage can shatter your delicate form, so avoid rain at all costs.

effectDetails.title: Living Portrait
effectDetails.rules: For a duration of one week (7 days), you gain +2 Charisma and -2 Dexterity. This effect is passive and does not require any action to activate or maintain.

effectDetails.title: Critic's Desire
effectDetails.rules: Art critics from the Formosa Ultima Atelier may attempt to 'collect' you, which requires a successful DC 15 Persuasion check. If successful, they will request your company for an exhibition, ending the duration of this effect.

formosa_ultima_beauty_enhancement.levelRequirementReason: This enhancement is suitable for characters who have reached a level where they can afford to invest in their social graces without compromising combat capabilities.
formosa_ultima_beauty_enhancement.vendorReason: Formosa Ultima Atelier specializes in enhancing beauty and artistry, making this service part of its core offerings.
formosa_ultima_beauty_enhancement.shippingDetail: The enhancement is shipped via Canvas Wrap Express, ensuring your portrait arrives safely and undamaged.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon application by a Formosa Ultima Atelier master painter.
usage.duration: One week (7 days).
usage.endsWhen: Art critics successfully Persuade you to join an exhibition or when water damage occurs.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the enhancement can be reapplied.

formosa_ultima_beauty_enhancement.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects a service that provides significant social benefits but does not impact combat effectiveness, making it accessible to mid-level characters.

formosa_ultima_embroidered_kimono.name: Formosa Ultima Embroidered Kimono
formosa_ultima_embroidered_kimono.description: This exquisite kimono, embroidered with the delicate motifs of a mystical island, whispers tales of ancient Formosa. The silk fabric is as soft as spring petals and as resilient as bamboo, making it a masterpiece of Ultima Tailors' craftsmanship. Wielders gain advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and once per day they can cast Minor Illusion to create an ethereal illusion of cherry blossoms that distracts foes within 30 feet for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Acrobatics
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks while wearing the kimono. This effect lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Distraction with Blossoms
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can cast Minor Illusion as an action to create an illusion of cherry blossoms that distracts targets within 30 feet for 1 round. The spell ends if a creature other than the target moves more than 5 feet or if a creature makes an attack roll.

formosa_ultima_embroidered_kimono.levelRequirementReason: The intricate embroidery and magical properties of this kimono require a level of at least 6 to properly harness its mystical essence.
formosa_ultima_embroidered_kimono.vendorReason: Formosa Ultima Village is renowned for its connection with the island's ancient magic, making it the perfect vendor for such an artifact.
formosa_ultima_embroidered_kimono.shippingDetail: The kimono arrives rolled in a bamboo tube to protect its delicate silk and intricate embroidery from damage during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Minor Illusion duration)
usage.endsWhen: Spell ends if a creature other than the target moves more than 5 feet or makes an attack roll, or when you cast it again.

formosa_ultima_embroidered_kimono.priceReason: The kimono's rarity and unique magical properties justify its high price in the market.

formosa_ultima_mango_juice.name: Formosa Ultima Mango Juice
formosa_ultima_mango_juice.description: Formosa Ultima Mango Juice is a vibrant elixir that promises to rejuvenate even the most weary traveler. This golden-hued nectar, carefully crafted in the tropical groves of Formosa, reinvigorates your spirit and body with every sip. The juice's refreshing taste transports you to the lush mangosteen orchards, where the sun itself seems to pour into each drop. A single swallow can banish the effects of exhaustion, restoring both vitality and a sense of renewed vigor.

effectDetails.title: Banish Exhaustion
effectDetails.rules: Consume as a bonus action to remove one level of exhaustion. This effect is instantaneous, providing immediate relief and stamina.

effectDetails.title: Restorative Refreshment
effectDetails.rules: Upon drinking, you gain the benefit of a short rest for 1 hour. During this time, your hit point maximum is restored by half (rounded down).

formosa_ultima_mango_juice.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers just starting their journey.
formosa_ultima_mango_juice.vendorReason: Formosa Ultima specializes in exotic fruits and juices, known for their restorative properties.
formosa_ultima_mango_juice.shippingDetail: Shipped within the same day to ensure freshness and peak flavor.

usage.activation: Bonus action to consume. Instantaneous effect upon drinking.
usage.duration: Immediate relief from exhaustion; short rest benefit lasts for 1 hour.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the drinker has consumed it or after 1 hour if enjoying a short rest.

formosa_ultima_mango_juice.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its rare and exotic origin, providing immediate but not overwhelming benefits.

formosa_ultima_recipe_fancy_pasta.name: Recipe: Formosa Ultima Fancy Pasta
formosa_ultima_recipe_fancy_pasta.description: The Recipe: Formosa Ultima Fancy Pasta, a culinary masterpiece that transforms mere noodles into a work of art. Each strand is meticulously crafted to resemble delicate filigree, shimmering like gold in the light. Consumed with proper fork technique, this pasta grants +1 Charisma for an hour and bestows upon you a level of sophistication that can charm even the most stoic adversary. The Formosa Ultima Pasta Artisans' expertise ensures each serving is an edible sculpture fit for any grand feast.

effectDetails.title: Elegant Edible Sculpture
effectDetails.rules: When consumed with proper fork technique, the pasta grants a +1 bonus to Charisma checks and saving throws for one hour. If eaten incorrectly, you must make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check at DC 15 or suffer disadvantage on all Charisma-based interactions until after your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Charismatic Charm
effectDetails.rules: For the duration, any creature within 30 feet that successfully makes an interaction with you has advantage on saving throws against being charmed by you. This effect does not stack with other sources of Charisma-based charm.

formosa_ultima_recipe_fancy_pasta.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate the artistry and grace required to prepare this exquisite pasta.
formosa_ultima_recipe_fancy_pasta.vendorReason: Formosa Ultima Pasta Artisans are renowned for their culinary innovations, making their fancy pasta a natural addition to their offerings.
formosa_ultima_recipe_fancy_pasta.shippingDetail: The Canvas Wrap Couriers ensure your fancy pasta arrives fresh and intact, delivered within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Eaten with proper fork technique (disadvantage if not)
usage.duration: One hour upon consumption
usage.endsWhen: After one hour or when consumed incorrectly

formosa_ultima_recipe_fancy_pasta.priceReason: The recipe's artisanal preparation and the unique effects justify its balanced price of 1000 XP.

formosa_ultima_rice_ball_recipe.name: Recipe: Formosa Ultima Onigiri
formosa_ultima_rice_ball_recipe.description: The Recipe for Formosa Ultima Onigiri, a cherished culinary secret passed down through generations of Formosa’s Ultima Cooks. This delicate rice ball is wrapped in seaweed from the island's sacred groves, imbuing it with the essence of the ocean and the spirit of the land. Eating one grants you a burst of energy, allowing you to sprint at +10 ft speed for an hour, and fills your belly with nourishing warmth. This snack also restores 1d4 hit points, ensuring you can face whatever challenges come next.

effectDetails.title: Portable Nourishment
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, the onigiri grants you a meal that restores 1d4 hit points. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any other action.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Agility
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after eating an onigiri, your speed increases by +10 feet. This effect lasts until the start of your next long rest or until you are incapacitated.

formosa_ultima_rice_ball_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to all adventurers who wish to partake in Ultima Cooks' culinary traditions.
formosa_ultima_rice_ball_recipe.vendorReason: Formosa’s Ultima Village, known for its rich cultural heritage and delectable cuisine, is the only place where this sacred recipe can be found.
formosa_ultima_rice_ball_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by Bamboo Ball Bundle, a courier service that ensures the freshness of each onigiri. Delivery time may vary depending on distance.

usage.activation: Bonus action to consume and gain effects
usage.duration: One hour or until incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: Starts of next long rest or becoming incapacitated

formosa_ultima_rice_ball_recipe.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity and cultural significance of this recipe, as well as the ingredients sourced from Formosa’s sacred groves.

formosa_ultima_silk_gloves.name: Formosa Ultima Silk Gloves
formosa_ultima_silk_gloves.description: The Formosa Ultima Silk Gloves are masterfully crafted from rare silks that shimmer with a faint, iridescent light. These gloves not only enhance your dexterity for intricate tasks but also whisper ancient secrets in your ear when you roll a natural 20 on an Intelligence (Investigation) check. They hold small tools without dropping, and their delicate weave is both a symbol of Formosa's cultural heritage and a practical aid.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Dexterity for Fine Work
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks related to fine work. This effect is passive.

effectDetails.title: Whisper Lore on Natural 20
effectDetails.rules: When you roll a natural 20 on an Intelligence (Investigation) check, the gloves whisper forgotten lore relevant to the investigation. This effect can occur once per day.

formosa_ultima_silk_gloves.levelRequirementReason: These gloves are crafted with intricate detailing and advanced techniques that require a certain level of expertise.
formosa_ultima_silk_gloves.vendorReason: Formosa Ultima is renowned for its mastery in silk weaving and cultural heritage, making these gloves a fitting product.
formosa_ultima_silk_gloves.shippingDetail: Delivered by skilled couriers who ensure the delicate nature of the gloves during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or lost.
usage.endsWhen: The gloves are destroyed, lost, or given away.

formosa_ultima_silk_gloves.priceReason: The craftsmanship and rarity of the silk used justify a modest price point.

formosa_ultima_silk_gloves_premium.name: Formosa Ultima Silk Gloves (Premium)
formosa_ultima_silk_gloves_premium.description: The Formosa Ultima Silk Gloves (Premium) are a masterpiece of craftsmanship, their threads woven from the finest silkworms in all of Formosa. These gloves grant you an edge when it comes to both thievery and spellcasting, allowing you to manipulate locks with ease and cast Arcana spells with precision. The whispers of silk are not mere coincidences; they provide subtle hints that can guide you toward minor secrets or advantages during your endeavors.
effects: Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks

effectDetails.title: Sleight of Hand Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Sleight of Hand checks for one use per day. This effect is triggered when you attempt to disarm a lock or disable a trap.

effectDetails.title: Silk Whispers Secrets
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the silk in your gloves provides you with a minor hint about a nearby secret. The hint could be a location, an item, or a clue that helps you solve a puzzle. This effect is not cumulative.

formosa_ultima_silk_gloves_premium.levelRequirementReason: These gloves are crafted for those who have honed their skills to a refined art, requiring at least 7th level proficiency in thievery and spellcasting.
formosa_ultima_silk_gloves_premium.vendorReason: Formosa Ultima Market is renowned for its high-quality goods, including these gloves which are made by the Formosan Weavers.
formosa_ultima_silk_gloves_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Silk Road Runner with expedited service within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use for Sleight of Hand checks; minor action to invoke silk whispers secrets.
usage.duration: Sleight of Hand advantage lasts until the end of your next turn. The silk whisper lasts one minute.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you no longer have a relevant check or rest, respectively.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; however, only one minor hint can be obtained per short rest.

formosa_ultima_silk_gloves_premium.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the exquisite craftsmanship and unique abilities of these gloves.

formosa_ultima_silk_rope.name: Formosa Ultima Silk Rope
formosa_ultima_silk_rope.description: The Formosa Ultima Silk Rope, a marvel of craftsmanship, is a 50-foot length of spider silk so finely woven that it never tangles or knots, even when submerged in water. Crafted by the legendary weavers at Formosa Ultima, this rope can support up to two tons of weight without breaking. It is said that the spiders used in its creation were fed only the finest silkworms from the region, imbuing it with a resilience unmatched by any mundane cord.

effectDetails.title: Unknotting
effectDetails.rules: The Formosa Ultima Silk Rope can be used as an action to untangle itself, even if it has been entangled. This effect does not require a check.

effectDetails.title: Weight Support
effectDetails.rules: This rope can support up to 2 tons of weight without breaking or sagging. It is considered part of the creature's equipment and does not impose encumbrance penalties.

formosa_ultima_silk_rope.levelRequirementReason: This rope is crafted for adventurers just beginning their journey, providing a reliable tool that can be used by anyone.
formosa_ultima_silk_rope.vendorReason: Formosa Ultima's trader is known for selling only the finest enchanted items, and this rope is no exception.
formosa_ultima_silk_rope.shippingDetail: Ships via a dedicated courier who ensures the rope arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for untangling; until the end of the user's next turn when supporting weight
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the rope is severed or when a creature attempts to use it in combat.

formosa_ultima_silk_rope.priceReason: This price reflects the rare materials and expert craftsmanship required for its creation, making it a valuable yet balanced addition to any adventurer's gear.

formosan_silk_cloak.name: Formosan Silk Cloak
formosan_silk_cloak.description: The Formosan Silk Cloak is a delicate, bioluminescent garment that glows faintly in dark environs like a starlit night sky. Woven from silk spun by fireflies and adorned with iridescent threads, it whispers secrets to the wearer as it moves silently through shadows. Made by the artisans of Formosa Ultima, this cloak not only enhances Stealth but also promises the wearer an air of mystery that commands attention in any gathering.

effectDetails.title: Silent Steps
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this cloak, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to move silently through an area. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn after using it in combat or a situation where silence is critical.

effectDetails.title: Bioluminescent Glow
effectDetails.rules: The cloak emits a soft, ambient light equivalent to that of a torch within 10 feet when you are not moving. This glow does not create darkness but enhances visibility in dimly lit or pitch-black areas, allowing you advantage on perception checks made to see in such conditions.

formosan_silk_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's enchantments provide a significant boost to stealth and visibility without requiring high-level magic.
formosan_silk_cloak.vendorReason: Formosa Ultima is renowned for its exquisite craftsmanship, making this cloak available only through their embassy.
formosan_silk_cloak.shippingDetail: Ships via airmail within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect until the start of your next turn after using it in combat or a critical stealth situation.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you move normally or engage in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest.

formosan_silk_cloak.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the cloak's unique properties and its limited utility without being overpowered.

fortnite_build_kit.name: Build Kit
fortnite_build_kit.description: The Build Kit is a compact, sturdy toolkit crafted from reinforced steel and imbued with ancient construction magic. Each kit contains ten materials and can instantly craft walls or ramps of impressive durability—walls have an AC of 15 and hit points of 30, while ramps are built to exacting specifications for secure passage. Crafted by the master builders of the Valley Trading Post, this kit is a testament to their unparalleled craftsmanship and ability to extract resources from even the most barren landscapes.

effectDetails.title: Instant Wall/Ramp Construction
effectDetails.rules: The Build Kit allows you to instantaneously construct a wall or ramp. The wall has an AC of 15 and hit points of 30, providing excellent fortification. The ramp is built with precision for safe passage. This effect requires your action and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Resource Harvesting
effectDetails.rules: When using the Build Kit to gather materials from the environment, you gain advantage on Intelligence (Nature) checks related to construction or resource gathering. This benefit lasts for 10 minutes after crafting an item with the kit.

fortnite_build_kit.levelRequirementReason: The Build Kit is designed for beginners and experienced builders alike, but it requires a minimum level of 1 to ensure proper use.
fortnite_build_kit.vendorReason: As the premier supplier of construction tools and resources in the region, the Valley Trading Post is known for its reliable Build Kits.
fortnite_build_kit.shippingDetail: Delivered by a Tool Bag courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect is used or after a short rest if not used.

fortnite_build_kit.priceReason: The Build Kit's price reflects its high-quality materials and the advanced magic embedded within, making it an excellent investment for any adventurer.

fountain_of_mirrored_souls.name: Fountain of Mirrored Souls
fountain_of_mirrored_souls.description: The Fountain of Mirrored Souls stands in a forgotten corner of a shadowy cathedral, its surface shimmering with reflections that hint at lives lived and futures unwritten. Drinking from this fountain grants you a glimpse into an alternate version of your soul, allowing you to experience the life of one such self—memories, skills, or traumas. The water itself is cold as night, yet it holds the essence of countless souls, each with its own unique story. Merge with one of these versions and permanently adopt their abilities and memories, but at a cost: severing all ties to your original existence.

effectDetails.title: Soul Reflection
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you drink from the fountain. The DM chooses one alternate version of yourself to reflect upon, during which you gain a memory, skill, or trauma from that life. You can only perform this effect once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Soul Merging
effectDetails.rules: At any time after successfully experiencing the life of an alternate self, as a ritual requiring 1 hour and the completion of a short rest, you may merge with that version. You gain all its abilities and memories but lose all memory of your original existence. This effect can only be performed once.

fountain_of_mirrored_souls.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have proven their strength and wisdom through great trials are deemed worthy to interact with the Fountain's ancient power.
fountain_of_mirrored_souls.vendorReason: The celestial exchange operates at the crossroads of time and soul, offering items that bridge worlds. The Fountain is a testament to their unique stock.
fountain_of_mirrored_souls.shippingDetail: The delivery is made by a courier known as 'Shadowsong', who ensures the package arrives safely but leaves no trace behind.

usage.activation: Action or ritual depending on effect used
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Soul Reflection; permanent upon merging souls
usage.endsWhen: Charges exhausted (one per merge)

fountain_of_mirrored_souls.priceReason: While the Fountain is not a weapon or treasure, its power to alter existence makes it priceless in the eyes of those who seek to reshape their fate.

fox_arwing_model.name: Arwing Model
fox_arwing_model.description: The Arwing Model is a meticulously crafted miniature fighter jet, its sleek lines and gleaming hull hinting at the power that lies within. This model isn't just a toy—it's an illusionary masterpiece created by the skilled artisans of Comet Observatory. When activated, it summons a fleeting but fearsome jet that can fly 60 feet and unleash a dazzling laser blast, fooling even the most discerning foes into believing they face a real fighter jet.

effectDetails.title: Summon Illusion Jet
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. The Arwing Model summons an illusionary jet that can fly up to 60 feet and fires a laser dealing 2d8 fire damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the model is destroyed, expended, or the illusion is dispelled by magical means.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Laser
effectDetails.rules: When the jet fires its laser, it has a chance to disorient enemies within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn.

fox_arwing_model.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level to ensure it can be used effectively in combat.
fox_arwing_model.vendorReason: Comet Observatory is known for its intricate and magical artifacts, making the Arwing Model an ideal offering from them.
fox_arwing_model.shippingDetail: Delivered via Express Aether Express, which ensures swift delivery within a day.

usage.activation: Action to summon the illusion jet and fire its laser.
usage.duration: Lasts for 1 minute or until expended.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed, expended, or dispelled by magical means.

fox_arwing_model.priceReason: The Arwing Model is priced at 1000 XP due to its epic rarity and the specialized craftsmanship required for its creation.

fp_plus_badge.name: FP Plus Badge
fp_plus_badge.description: The FP Plus Badge is a delicate, flower-shaped badge crafted from enchanted brass. Its intricate filigree glows faintly in shades of emerald and sapphire, imbued with the essence of forgotten forests and ancient magic. This badge enhances one's magical capacity, allowing wearers to cast an additional 1st-level spell slot while attuned. The badge is a symbol of harmony between nature and arcane might, often worn by shamans and druids seeking to balance their powers more efficiently in the wild.

effectDetails.title: Increased Spell Capacity
effectDetails.rules: While attuned, you gain one additional 1st-level spell slot. This effect lasts for the duration of your concentration (up to 10 minutes) or until you lose your concentration.

effectDetails.title: Attunement Requirement
effectDetails.rules: You must complete a short rest while wearing the badge to attune to it, and you can only be attuned to one FP Plus Badge at a time. Attunement ends when you remove the badge or if your concentration is broken.

fp_plus_badge.levelRequirementReason: This badge enhances spellcasting ability, making it suitable for lower-level characters who are still learning and refining their magical prowess.
fp_plus_badge.vendorReason: The Shamans Hut specializes in mystical trinkets that enhance natural magic, making the FP Plus Badge a perfect fit for their inventory.
fp_plus_badge.shippingDetail: Ships via Mystic Mail’s enchanted courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery within two game days.

usage.duration: Concentration up to 10 minutes or until concentration is lost.
usage.endsWhen: You lose your concentration or remove the badge.

fp_plus_badge.priceReason: The FP Plus Badge offers a significant enhancement in spellcasting, making it a valuable but not overpowered item for new adventurers.

fractured_atrium_abyssal_gaze_glove.name: Abyssal Gaze Glove
fractured_atrium_abyssal_gaze_glove.description: The Abyssal Gaze Glove is a leather glove embossed with arcane symbols and dark runes, worn by those who dare to peer into the abyss. It grants its wearer glimpses of the soul's essence, revealing hidden necromantic sigils that shimmer faintly in the shadows. With each use, the glove grants a fleeting vision of ghostly echoes from defeated foes, allowing for strategic ambushes and tactical advantage in battles against undead forces.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Necromancy
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer uses an action, they can scan a 5-foot square area. This effect lasts for 1 minute and reveals any hidden necromantic sigils or undead traps within that area, granting advantage on Perception checks to detect them.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse of Defeated Foes
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer can activate this ability as a bonus action. For 10 seconds, they gain the benefit of seeing ghostly echoes of defeated enemies within a 30-foot radius. This allows them to recall tactical advantages and plan future encounters more effectively.

fractured_atrium_abyssal_gaze_glove.levelRequirementReason: The wearer must be at least level 5 to wield this item, as it requires a solid understanding of necromancy and the ability to focus on its effects.
fractured_atrium_abyssal_gaze_glove.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium specializes in rare and ancient artifacts that are often used by adventurers who delve into dark magic and necromancy.
fractured_atrium_abyssal_gaze_glove.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Void Drifter Relay, known for its swift and reliable service through the astral planes.

usage.activation: Reveals Hidden Necromancy: Uses an action; Glimpse of Defeated Foes: Bonus Action
usage.duration: Reveals Hidden Necromancy lasts 1 minute; Glimpse of Defeated Foes lasts for 10 seconds, ends when the wearer uses another bonus action to activate it or when they fall unconscious.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after one use per short rest

fractured_atrium_abyssal_gaze_glove.priceReason: The price is set at a fair value, balancing the item's powerful effects with its rarity and the risks involved in using it.

fractured_atrium_blood_echo.name: Blood Echo Vessel
fractured_atrium_blood_echo.description: The Blood Echo Vessel is a dark, obsidian vessel adorned with etched runes that whisper of ancient necromancy. When activated, it amplifies the user's willpower and drains enemy vitality, allowing them to become momentarily invisible while silencing their foes. Nearby enemies hear only the echoes of the dead, unable to react as effectively. This vessel is said to have been crafted in the fractured heart of Atrium by dark necromancers seeking to harness the power of death itself.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Amplification
effectDetails.rules: The user's necromantic abilities are enhanced by +1d6 damage against undead enemies. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility and Silence
effectDetails.rules: All nearby foes become temporarily blinded and silenced for 3 seconds upon activation. The vessel expends one charge, which can be recharged after a long rest.

fractured_atrium_blood_echo.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant control over necromantic energies, making it accessible only to those of at least 5th level.
fractured_atrium_blood_echo.vendorReason: The vessel's dark origins and crafting secrets are known to the denizens of Atrium, who supply such rare wares.
fractured_atrium_blood_echo.shippingDetail: Delivery is swift, but the package must be picked up personally at the next town square due to strict regulations on necromantic items.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting 3 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The start of their next turn or when the user takes a major action
usage.charges: Expends one charge; recharges after a long rest

fractured_atrium_blood_echo.priceReason: Balanced for its rarity and necromantic power, making it a strategic but not overpowered choice.

fractured_atrium_blood_rune.name: Blood Rune of the Necrotic Throne
fractured_atrium_blood_rune.description: The Blood Rune of the Necrotic Throne is a cursed amulet forged from the very essence of a long-dead kingdom's throne, its surface etched with runes that pulse with a necrotic glow. It drains vitality with each use, leaving the user weaker but more potent in their dark rituals. When activated, it enhances necromantic spells by 50% for three turns and unleashes a wave of necrotic energy that devastates foes within its reach.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Necromancy
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action. Enhances all necromantic spells cast by the wearer for three turns, granting a +50% bonus to spell damage and effect duration.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Surge
effectDetails.rules: When activated, emits a surge of necrotic energy targeting enemies within 3 squares. Deals 2d6 necrotic damage per turn for three turns or until the wearer's next turn. The user must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer 10% of their maximum hit points in damage each turn.

fractured_atrium_blood_rune.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to wield, as the amulet's malevolent power demands significant magical prowess.
fractured_atrium_blood_rune.vendorReason: The frayed remnants of the ancient necropolis are inextricably linked with the Blood Rune, making it a natural fit for the vendor.
fractured_atrium_blood_rune.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express, ensuring the cursed amulet arrives safely and swiftly.

usage.activation: Activated as a bonus action by command.
usage.duration: 3 turns or until the wearer's next turn if used more than three times.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user's next turn begins, after three uses, or upon destruction of the amulet.

fractured_atrium_blood_rune.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its potent necromantic power and cursed nature.

fractured_atrium_blood_scarf.name: Blood Scarf of the Hollowed
fractured_atrium_blood_scarf.description: Woven from the remnants of a fallen necromancer’s soul, the Blood Scarf of the Hollowed is a crimson accessory that pulses with the echo of forgotten rituals. It drains vitality from foes while granting the wearer temporary immunity to psychic backlash, making every step a silent scream in the heart of the undead. Its pulse amplifies damage against undead by 20%, and its soul-draining touch reduces their necromantic aura by 30% for ten seconds.

effectDetails.title: Drain Vitality
effectDetails.rules: Activates passively, draining 10% of the nearest enemy's hit points at the start of each of its turns. Ends when the scarf is removed or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Psychic Backlash
effectDetails.rules: Grants temporary immunity to psychic backlash for 24 hours upon activation, which can be triggered once per long rest. No save required.

fractured_atrium_blood_scarf.levelRequirementReason: The scarf's raw power requires only basic necromantic knowledge.
fractured_atrium_blood_scarf.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium specializes in relics and artifacts from the war against necromancers.
fractured_atrium_blood_scarf.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, a courier known for its timely deliveries of rare goods.

usage.duration: Until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Scarff is removed or destroyed.

fractured_atrium_blood_scarf.priceReason: The scarf's rarity and necromantic properties justify its price in the market.

fractured_atrium_bloodbound_tome.name: Bloodbound Tome of the Corvinarus
fractured_atrium_bloodbound_tome.description: The Bloodbound Tome of Corvinarus is a leather-bound grimoire, its pages dyed in the dark blood of the Corvinarus, a once-legendary necromancer. When opened, it whispers the names of the dead and grants the user temporary dominion over their spirits. Summon these spectral allies to fight by your side, or command them to speak for you in whispered counsel. Each spirit is a fragment of the dead, loyal only as long as the tome’s power holds sway.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Ally
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Summons one spirit ally with 15 hit points, which gains 20% of the user's maximum HP and can speak or attack alongside you for up to 1 minute. The spirit has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to necromancy. Ends when dismissed, after its time limit expires, or if the tome is closed.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Necromancy
effectDetails.rules: Grants +25% duration to all necromancy spells cast by the user. This effect persists for 10 minutes per use and can be renewed at the start of each long rest, with a saving throw DC of 13.

fractured_atrium_bloodbound_tome.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to control the spirits effectively without risking their untimely demise.
fractured_atrium_bloodbound_tome.vendorReason: This vendor specializes in ancient, cursed items and the knowledge that comes with them.
fractured_atrium_bloodbound_tome.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral couriers who deliver the tome under cover of darkness to avoid unwanted attention.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per use, renewable at long rest
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed, time limit expires, or tome is closed

fractured_atrium_bloodbound_tome.priceReason: Balanced for its unique and powerful abilities within the rarity of a rare item.

fractured_atrium_blooded_mirror.name: Blooded Mirror of the Fallen
fractured_atrium_blooded_mirror.description: The Blooded Mirror of the Fallen is a dark, obsidian mirror carved from the bones of a fallen necromancer. Its surface glows faintly with an eerie purple light that flickers like the soul of its last victim. When activated, it momentarily opens a spectral link to the spirit of your most recent foe, allowing for a brief exchange. The mirror subtly exerts a gravitational pull on you when enemies approach, as if their very presence is mirrored in its depths.

effectDetails.title: Voice Link with Enemy's Soul
effectDetails.rules: When activated using an action, the mirror opens a spectral voice link to your last slain enemy’s spirit. The connection lasts for 3 seconds and allows you to speak directly with it. This effect has no range limit but ends when either participant is incapacitated or the mirror is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Gravitational Pull
effectDetails.rules: While within 10 feet of the mirror, you are subjected to a minor gravitational pull that slightly slows your movement speed by 5 feet. This effect persists as long as you remain in proximity and ends when you move out of range or if the mirror is destroyed.

fractured_atrium_blooded_mirror.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level to ensure players can handle its spectral effects without undue risk.
fractured_atrium_blooded_mirror.vendorReason: The Dark Atrium's vendors deal in relics of the fallen, and this mirror is a prime example of their wares.
fractured_atrium_blooded_mirror.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the Blooded Mirror must be shipped via Shy Guy Smugglers for guaranteed safe delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; Voice Link lasts 3 seconds; Gravitational Pull persists as long as within range
usage.endsWhen: Voice Link ends when either participant is incapacitated or the mirror is destroyed; Gravitational Pull ceases if you leave the 10-foot radius around the mirror.

fractured_atrium_blooded_mirror.priceReason: The Blooded Mirror's rarity and utility justify its price of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_bone_binder.name: Bone Binder of Corvinarus
fractured_atrium_bone_binder.description: The Bone Binder of Corvinarus is a cursed artifact forged from the ribs of a fallen warlord. Its weighty form is adorned with ancient runes that glow faintly in the dark. When activated, it binds your soul to the grave, granting you immunity to necrotic damage but at the cost of your sanity and movement speed; each minute under its influence erodes your mind's resilience until you deactivate it.

effectDetails.title: Immortal to Necrotic
effectDetails.rules: Activation: Action. Duration: Concentration up to 1 minute. Ends When: You lose concentration or take damage from a source other than necrotic. Save DC: 15. Benefit: Grants immunity to necrotic damage while active.

effectDetails.title: Sanity Drain
effectDetails.rules: Each minute of activation reduces your Wisdom (Insight) saving throw by -20%. Ends When: The artifact is deactivated or destroyed. Limit: Once per short rest.

fractured_atrium_bone_binder.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to handle the artifact's malevolent energy without severe consequences.
fractured_atrium_bone_binder.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in rare and dangerous artifacts, including cursed relics like the Bone Binder of Corvinarus.
fractured_atrium_bone_binder.shippingDetail: Delivered with special precautions to protect against the artifact’s inherent dangers.

usage.duration: Concentration up to 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You lose concentration or take damage from a source other than necrotic, or it is destroyed

fractured_atrium_bone_binder.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the artifact's powerful and dangerous nature.

fractured_atrium_bone_bottle.name: Bone Bottle of Unspoken Echoes
fractured_atrium_bone_bottle.description: A fragile vial containing the ossified essence of a long-lost Corvinarus ancestor, its bone walls shimmering faintly as if alive. When cracked, it releases a psychic resonance that binds a target’s memories to the wielder, allowing them to delve into the target's most painful recollections. The bottle is said to have been crafted in the forges of forgotten Atrium, where ancient magics coalesced with natural bones to forge this potent artifact.

effectDetails.title: Memory Binding
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Bone Bottle of Unspoken Echoes releases a psychic resonance that temporarily binds a target's memories to the wielder. The effect lasts for 10 seconds and grants the wielder knowledge of the target’s most recent traumatic event. This effect has no save DC but can be ended by the target making a successful Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Resonance
effectDetails.rules: While the memory is bound, the target experiences a 20% reduction in their spellcasting ability for the duration of the effect. This penalty cannot be removed until the end of the effect's duration or if the target successfully saves against it.

fractured_atrium_bone_bottle.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to effectively utilize and manage such a potent artifact.
fractured_atrium_bone_bottle.vendorReason: The Fractured Atrium is known for its vast collection of ancient artifacts, including this bottle's origin in the lost forges of their ancestors.
fractured_atrium_bone_bottle.shippingDetail: Ships via ethereal courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Activates as an action by cracking the bottle.
usage.duration: 10 seconds duration per use.
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against it or the effect ends naturally.

fractured_atrium_bone_bottle.priceReason: Balanced for its rarity and unique utility, this bottle’s price reflects its historical significance and powerful effects.

fractured_atrium_bone_chime.name: Bone Chime of the Corvinarus Echo
fractured_atrium_bone_chime.description: The Bone Chime of the Corvinarus Echo is a relic carved from the bones of ancient necromancers, each ribcage etched with runes that whisper secrets of the dead. When struck, it summons a spectral echo of your last battle cry, which can instill fear in foes within earshot and grant you a +5% bonus to all necromantic damage when wielded. The chime’s resonance is said to amplify the voices of the deceased, making it an indispensable tool for those who command the undead.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Echo
effectDetails.rules: When struck, the chime summons a spectral echo of your last battle cry. This echo can instill fear in enemies within 10 feet for 1 round (the DC to save against this effect is equal to 8 + your Wisdom modifier). The echo dissipates after its duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Necromantic Damage
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one battle, you gain a +5% bonus to all necromantic damage dealt. This enhancement persists for the entire encounter and is reset at the beginning of your next short or long rest.

fractured_atrium_bone_chime.levelRequirementReason: The chime requires no specific level because it offers utility suitable for lower-level characters who could benefit from its unique abilities.
fractured_atrium_bone_chime.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium is known for dealing with rare and ancient artifacts, making the Bone Chime of the Corvinarus Echo a fitting addition to their inventory.
fractured_atrium_bone_chime.shippingDetail: The chimes are delicate and must be shipped in specially designed padded crates to ensure they arrive intact.

usage.duration: One round (Spectral Echo) / One battle (Enhanced Necromantic Damage)
usage.endsWhen: Ends after its duration or when the chime is destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, resets at the start of each rest

fractured_atrium_bone_chime.priceReason: The item’s rarity and unique properties make it a valuable addition to any necromancer's arsenal, hence its fair value of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_bone_key.name: Bone Key of Corvinarus
fractured_atrium_bone_key.description: The Bone Key of Corvinarus, a relic forged from the shattered bones of a noble fallen in battle, glows faintly with a cold blue aura that hints at its necromantic origins. It grants the wielder temporary control over spectral entities and allows for the summoning of minor constructs to aid in exploration or combat. Its touch reveals hidden paths through ancient necrotic zones, offering invaluable insight into forgotten tombs and ruins.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Control
effectDetails.rules: The Bone Key allows the user to bind a single spectral entity for up to 2 rounds. This control grants the spectral entity's assistance in combat or exploration. The key can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Insight
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the Bone Key reveals hidden necrotic pathways and entrances within a 30-foot radius. This effect is usable once per long rest.

fractured_atrium_bone_key.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to effectively manage the key's necromantic abilities.
fractured_atrium_bone_key.vendorReason: The fractured atrium is known for its extensive network of ancient necrotic ruins, making it a logical vendor for such a relic.
fractured_atrium_bone_key.shippingDetail: Ships via the Rakasha Spirit Walk courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Uses an action or bonus action to activate, with no additional range or target requirements.
usage.duration: Necrotic Control lasts for up to 2 rounds per use; Spectral Insight reveals hidden paths once per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects of Necrotic Control end when the key is removed from contact with the bound spectral entity, and Spectral Insight ends after its duration expires or upon a short rest.

fractured_atrium_bone_key.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity of the material used in crafting this relic and its unique abilities within necromantic magic.

fractured_atrium_bone_key_of_the_oracle.name: Bone Key of the Oracle
fractured_atrium_bone_key_of_the_oracle.description: The Bone Key of the Oracle is a gnarled key forged from the ribs of an ancient necromantic sage. When inserted into its lock, it releases a ghastly glow and unlocks the hidden chamber of the Oracle’s archives. Once opened, the portal to Corvinarus reveals forbidden knowledge that could sway any contest of wills or intellect. The key is said to have been crafted during the height of the Sage's power, imbued with the essence of the dead to ensure its secrets remain secret.

effectDetails.title: Unlock and Access Archives
effectDetails.rules: Requires an action to insert into a specific lock. Once inserted, it unlocks the chamber for one minute. The portal remains active until closed or the key's charge is exhausted. Closing the portal requires an Intelligence saving throw (DC 15) against the user’s Intelligence modifier.

effectDetails.title: Forbidden Knowledge
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful access to the archives, the user gains advantage on one Intelligence-based skill check of their choice for 24 hours. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

fractured_atrium_bone_key_of_the_oracle.levelRequirementReason: The key's arcane nature and the power it commands make it accessible to those with at least third-level spellcasting capabilities.
fractured_atrium_bone_key_of_the_oracle.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium, a repository of ancient knowledge, is the only known source for such an artifact.
fractured_atrium_bone_key_of_the_oracle.shippingDetail: The key requires special handling and is delivered via the Void Drifter Relay within one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous unlock; portal remains active for one minute
usage.endsWhen: Closing the portal, or when its charge is exhausted after a long rest

fractured_atrium_bone_key_of_the_oracle.priceReason: The key's rarity and magical properties justify its price, reflecting both its historical significance and the power it commands.

fractured_atrium_bone_rune.name: Bone Rune of the Atrium
fractured_atrium_bone_rune.description: The Bone Rune of the Atrium, chipped from the fractured heart of an ancient atrium, is a necromantic talisman that etches living curses into the battlefield. Its inscribed glyphs pulse with dark energy, spreading their malevolent touch to all foes within range. Each rune carves a permanent mark upon the ground, but only one can be active at any time, ensuring the caster's focus remains singularly intent on the next strike.

effectDetails.title: Glyph Etching
effectDetails.rules: The Bone Rune allows a caster to etch a single glyph onto the ground or walls. This glyph lasts for 1 minute and deals 50% of the caster's maximum hit points as necrotic damage to all creatures within 20 feet at the start of their turn.

effectDetails.title: Necromancy Spell Duration
effectDetails.rules: When used in conjunction with other necromancy spells, this rune increases the duration of these spells by an additional 1 hour. This effect lasts until another rune is etched or a short rest is taken.

fractured_atrium_bone_rune.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have mastered basic necromancy can wield such dark power.
fractured_atrium_bone_rune.vendorReason: The fractured atrium has seen many dark rituals, making it a fitting home for such a cursed artifact.
fractured_atrium_bone_rune.shippingDetail: Delivered via shadowy courier, the rune arrives in a sealed case, ensuring its arrival is both swift and secure.

usage.activation: A bonus action to inscribe a glyph onto the ground or walls.
usage.duration: 1 minute per etched glyph
usage.endsWhen: Another glyph is inscribed or a short rest is taken

fractured_atrium_bone_rune.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its necromantic power and rarity.

fractured_atrium_bone_whisperer.name: Bone Whisperer
fractured_atrium_bone_whisperer.description: The Bone Whisperer hums with an eerie, spectral energy, a relic of ancient necromancers long gone. Crafted from the bones of fallen necromancers, it whispers forgotten commands to the dead, granting the wielder temporary control over ghostly minions. Each use calls forth a spectral servant for three turns, whispering dark secrets and lending its ethereal strength. Wielders must heed its call with caution, as after three activations, the relic drains 10% of the user's health.

effectDetails.title: Summon Ghostly Servant
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the Bone Whisperer summons one ghostly servant for three turns. The spectral minion grants +20% damage to necrotic attacks and can be commanded to perform simple tasks. The servant vanishes after its duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Health Drain
effectDetails.rules: After using the Bone Whisperer for three activations, the user suffers a 10% health penalty until restored by magical means or resting for one full day.

fractured_atrium_bone_whisperer.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to wield the cursed relic effectively.
fractured_atrium_bone_whisperer.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium is known for its dark artifacts and relics, making it a fitting vendor for such an item.
fractured_atrium_bone_whisperer.shippingDetail: Shipped discreetly via Pipe Express; delivery can take up to three days due to the nature of the cargo.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon ghostly servant
usage.duration: Three turns for summoned spectral minion
usage.endsWhen: Upon natural expiration or when the user takes a short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged after one full day

fractured_atrium_bone_whisperer.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its cursed nature and temporary health drain effect.

fractured_atrium_bonewhisper_amber.name: BoneWhisper Amber
fractured_atrium_bonewhisper_amber.description: BoneWhisper Amber is a cursed gemstone hewn from ancient bones, infused with the echoes of countless battles and forgotten names. When worn in combat, it summons spectral whispers that bolster your defenses and grant you fleeting visions of past conflicts. These ghostly allies appear as spectral warriors, offering temporary respite to your weary heart. Yet, its power comes at a price: after three seconds of use, living foes are struck with disorienting echoes, blurring their vision for the duration of the encounter.
effects: Grants 10% chance to summon ghostly allies during combat

effectDetails.title: Spectral Respite
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, BoneWhisper Amber summons spectral whispers that grant you a +20 bonus to your AC against undead attacks until the end of the encounter. This effect ends if you are no longer within 30 feet of an undead creature.

effectDetails.title: Ghostly Allies
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, BoneWhisper Amber grants you a +10 bonus to your Charisma (Persuasion) checks against living creatures for the duration of one combat. This effect ends if you fail a Wisdom saving throw with a DC of 13.

fractured_atrium_bonewhisper_amber.levelRequirementReason: The gem's power is too potent, requiring at least level 5 to wield without risking disorientation and other side effects.
fractured_atrium_bonewhisper_amber.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium specializes in cursed artifacts and relics from forgotten realms, making BoneWhisper Amber a fitting addition to their inventory.
fractured_atrium_bonewhisper_amber.shippingDetail: The gem is delivered by the Rakasha, ensuring it arrives intact but accompanied by a cryptic warning about its malevolent origins.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action or reaction.
usage.duration: Until the end of the encounter for Spectral Respite; ends if you fail a Wisdom saving throw with a DC of 13 for Ghostly Allies.
usage.endsWhen: Spectra Respite ends when you are no longer within 30 feet of an undead creature, or when you lose your concentration. Ghostly Allies end on a failed Wisdom save.

fractured_atrium_bonewhisper_amber.priceReason: The gem's unique properties and the risk it poses to its wielder justify this price.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_echo.name: Corrupted Echo of the Deep Mirror
fractured_atrium_corrupted_echo.description: The Corrupted Echo of the Deep Mirror is a fractured shard that crackles with necrotic energy. Crafted from the twisted essence of the Deep Mirror, it whispers forgotten spells in the tongue of the dead. This relic can resurrect one corpse for three turns, granting it 100% damage resistance and allowing its wielder to cast necromantic spells at a faster rate. However, each use consumes a fragment of your soul.

effectDetails.title: Resurrection
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to resurrect one corpse for three turns with 100% damage resistance. The effect ends when the target dies, is destroyed, or the shard is expended.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Speed
effectDetails.rules: Grant a +2 bonus to your spell attack rolls and spell save DCs while you have this shard in your possession. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after using the Resurrection ability or when the shard is expended.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_echo.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to wield such dark magic responsibly.
fractured_atrium_corrupted_echo.vendorReason: The vendors at Fractured Atrium specialize in relics and artifacts of shadowy origin, making this shard available.
fractured_atrium_corrupted_echo.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of necrotic shards, they are shipped using Koopa Postal’s reinforced dark matter containers.

usage.duration: Instantaneous.
usage.endsWhen: The target dies, is destroyed, or the shard is expended.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_echo.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its dark magic and soul-consuming nature.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_heart.name: Corrupted Heart of the Hollow King
fractured_atrium_corrupted_heart.description: The Corrupted Heart of the Hollow King, a pulsating obsidian heart, pulses with necrotic energy that seeps into the very fabric of life around it. When worn, this unholy relic grants temporary necromantic resonance, allowing you to summon spectral echoes of the dead as allies for brief battles. The heart's dark magic reduces stamina regeneration by 20%, but in exchange, it increases your damage against undead foes by a third.

effectDetails.title: Extra Damage Against Undead
effectDetails.rules: When you deal damage to an undead creature, it gains +30% additional damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Companion
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can summon a spectral companion that provides battlefield support for 10 seconds. The companion has a reach of 5 feet and can use its bite attack to deal necrotic damage equal to half your proficiency bonus.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_heart.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a minimum level to ensure the user can effectively harness its dark magic without overextending their abilities.
fractured_atrium_corrupted_heart.vendorReason: The Fractured Atrium is known for its macabre artifacts and relics, making it the perfect vendor for such an unholy heart.
fractured_atrium_corrupted_heart.shippingDetail: Due to the corrupting nature of the item, Lakitu Drones require special handling and a delayed delivery by one day.

usage.activation: Bonus action for summoning; passive while worn
usage.duration: Summoned companion lasts 10 seconds or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: Ends if you are killed, the companion is destroyed, or you remove it from your body

fractured_atrium_corrupted_heart.priceReason: The item's dark magic and spectral abilities justify a moderate price of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_mirror.name: Corrupted Mirror of the Deep Atrium
fractured_atrium_corrupted_mirror.description: The Corrupted Mirror of the Deep Atrium is a fractured glass orb, its surface etched with runes that glow faintly in necrotic light. Crafted from ancient bones and darkened by centuries of unhallowed use, it whispers secrets of the dead to those brave enough to look into it. Each glance reveals hidden truths within necromantic rituals, but at a terrible cost: the mirror's gaze saps your sanity with each use, leaving you forever changed.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Truths
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within 30 feet of a necromantic ritual or undead creature, this mirror reveals hidden runes and symbols that provide insight into the target. The mirror can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Saps Sanity
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful activation, the wielder must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14). On failure, they suffer 1d4 points of sanity loss, reducing their maximum Wisdom by that amount until fully restored. This effect can be used once per long rest.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_mirror.levelRequirementReason: This mirror's power requires a level 5 character to wield effectively.
fractured_atrium_corrupted_mirror.vendorReason: The vendor, Fractured Atrium, specializes in rare and corrupted artifacts from forgotten realms.
fractured_atrium_corrupted_mirror.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, ensuring safe delivery with a 1d4 day delay due to spectral interference.

usage.activation: Used as an action within 30 feet of the target.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until used or dismissed.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest, or if damaged beyond repair.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_mirror.priceReason: The mirror's rarity and unique properties justify its price of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_reflection.name: Corrupted Reflection Shard
fractured_atrium_corrupted_reflection.description: The Corrupted Reflection Shard is a fractured mirror fragment, its surface darkened and corrupted by necromantic energies. When wielded, it reveals the spectral form of nearby undead, granting temporary sight through their ethereal visage. Its whispering echo reveals hidden weaknesses in these spirits, allowing foes to exploit them. The shard's power comes from an ancient source, hinting at a time when such relics were used to control and manipulate the dead.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Vision
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Grants the user temporary spectral vision for 10 seconds when targeting a creature with the undead type within 30 feet, allowing them to see through and around the target. Ends if the target moves more than 10 feet away or is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Undead Weaknesses
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Reveals a hidden weakness in any undead creature within 30 feet, providing advantage on one attack roll against that target. Ends if the user moves more than 10 feet away or if the target is destroyed.

fractured_atrium_corrupted_reflection.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least level 5 to wield due to its necromantic power and complexity.
fractured_atrium_corrupted_reflection.vendorReason: The vendor, fractured atrium, specializes in relics and artifacts recovered from ancient, dark sites where such shards were once used.
fractured_atrium_corrupted_reflection.shippingDetail: The shipment is handled carefully by the Shy Guy Smugglers, known for their expertise in delivering sensitive and dangerous goods.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until target moves more than 10 feet away
usage.endsWhen: Target moves too far or is destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

fractured_atrium_corrupted_reflection.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rare material and the dangerous nature of its necromantic energy.

fractured_atrium_corv_necro_catalyst.name: Corv Necro Catalyst
fractured_atrium_corv_necro_catalyst.description: The Corv Necro Catalyst is a shard of corrupted bone, its surface etched with runes that hum with malevolent energy. Crafted from the bones of ancient necromancers, it whispers the voices of the dead to those who wield it. When activated, it channels dark necrotic power into devastating spells, sapping the life force of enemies and leaving them weaker for days. It is said this relic was once a part of Corvinarus himself, now reduced to a weapon of terror in the hands of the living.
effects: Grants 20% Chance to Summon Spectral Pet

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Surge
effectDetails.rules: When a spell using necromancy is cast, the user must spend 10% of their maximum Hit Points. This effect ends after 30 seconds or if they are reduced to 0 Hit Points.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Companion
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the wielder can summon a spectral pet that fights by their side for 1 minute. The pet has a CR of 2 and is controlled by the user but cannot speak or cast spells.

fractured_atrium_corv_necro_catalyst.levelRequirementReason: The Corv Necro Catalyst requires a minimum level to wield its necrotic power safely.
fractured_atrium_corv_necro_catalyst.vendorReason: The vendors of Fractured Atrium specialize in relics and artifacts from the ancient necromancers, making this relic an apt addition to their inventory.
fractured_atrium_corv_necro_catalyst.shippingDetail: Delivery is handled by the Rakasha Spirit Walk, which ensures the item arrives with a whisper of darkness.

usage.duration: Instantaneous casting; Spectral Companion lasts for 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Reduction to 0 Hit Points or after 30 seconds without spending HP
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the user must rest for 30 minutes after each use

fractured_atrium_corv_necro_catalyst.priceReason: The Corv Necro Catalyst's price is balanced at 1000 XP as it provides significant necromancy benefits and has a unique spectral summoning feature.

fractured_atrium_corv_soul_core.name: Corvinarus Soul Core Fragment
fractured_atrium_corv_soul_core.description: The Corvinarus Soul Core Fragment is a jagged, pulsating shard of necromantic energy, forged from the heart of a fallen noble in the shadowy halls of Corvinarus. This fragment can be invoked during rituals to summon three skeletal minions that dance at your command for ten seconds, their eyes glowing with malevolent intent. The core also subtly enhances the duration of any necromancy spell you cast by 20%, allowing you to extend the life span of your undead creations just enough to dominate their actions in battle.

effectDetails.title: Undead Minion Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Summons three skeletal minions that obey your commands for 10 seconds. The minions have 25 hit points each and can be dismissed at any time by the user or upon their death.

effectDetails.title: Extended Necromancy Spell Duration
effectDetails.rules: Increases the duration of any necromancy spell you cast by 20%. For instance, a raise dead spell would last for an additional two rounds. This effect can be applied to one spell per short rest and requires concentration while active.

fractured_atrium_corv_soul_core.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to effectively manage the summoned undead and cast necromancy spells.
fractured_atrium_corv_soul_core.vendorReason: The vendors of Fractured Atrium specialize in arcane artifacts from fallen noble houses, including this fragment.
fractured_atrium_corv_soul_core.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral couriers who demand a respectful nod to the Corvinarus house ghost.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon, concentration for extended spell duration (one per short rest)
usage.duration: 10 seconds for summoned minions, spell duration increased by 20%
usage.endsWhen: Minions dismissed or die, concentration lost, or after one use per short rest

fractured_atrium_corv_soul_core.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the fragment's necromantic power and utility in summoning and extending spell durations.

fractured_atrium_corvian_soul_amber.name: Corvian Soul Amber
fractured_atrium_corvian_soul_amber.description: The Corvian Soul Amber glows with an eerie, pulsating light that hints at forgotten battles and lost souls. This gem is forged from the essence of a fallen Corvinarus, its core a crystallized fragment of necromantic power. When activated, it grants the wielder temporary necromantic resonance, enhancing their spells by +50% for 30 seconds. The gem also summons a spectral wraith that fights alongside you in combat, dealing damage equal to half your level plus 10.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Activates on use, enhancing the caster's necromantic spells by +50% for a duration of 30 seconds. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Wraith
effectDetails.rules: Summons a spectral wraith that fights alongside you in combat, dealing damage equal to half your level plus 10 per round. The spectral wraith has the same hit points as a CR 2 undead and is immune to fear effects.

fractured_atrium_corvian_soul_amber.levelRequirementReason: This gem requires at least 3rd level to properly channel its necromantic power.
fractured_atrium_corvian_soul_amber.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium specializes in rare and exotic magical artifacts, including this soul-infused gem.
fractured_atrium_corvian_soul_amber.shippingDetail: The spectral mail service ensures the safe delivery of the Corvian Soul Amber through its unique route that bypasses dangerous areas.

usage.activation: Activates on use, as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 30 seconds per activation.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or when destroyed by damage.

fractured_atrium_corvian_soul_amber.priceReason: The gem's rarity and the unique necromantic power it provides justify its price of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blade.name: Corvinarus Fangblade
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blade.description: The Corvinarus Fangblade is a cursed weapon forged from the bones of an ancient warlord, its very essence twisted by abyssal magic. The blade glows with a malevolent light that slices through undead foes with unnatural ease, while its edge clings to the blood of the dead, whispering secrets of the grave. When it shatters upon death, it releases a soul fragment that can be recovered as a material component.

effectDetails.title: Unnatural Evisceration
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an undead creature with this weapon, it deals an additional 20% damage. The blade's dark magic also causes the target to gain temporary necromantic resistance for 2 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Echo of the Dead
effectDetails.rules: Upon your death, the Corvinarus Fangblade shatters, releasing a soul fragment that can be recovered as a material component. This effect is limited to once per day.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blade.levelRequirementReason: The blade's dark magic requires a wielder with experience and resolve.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blade.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium deals in cursed and rare artifacts, making this weapon a natural fit for their inventory.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blade.shippingDetail: The item is delivered within one week of purchase, but the blade must be handled with care to avoid accidental shattering during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect upon successful hit against undead creatures.
usage.duration: Temporary necromantic resistance lasts for 2 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The weapon shatters and releases a soul fragment upon the wielder's death.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one shattering per day.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blade.priceReason: The blade's rarity, dark magic, and limited recovery mechanism justify its moderate price in experience points.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_scar.name: Corvinarus Blood Scar
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_scar.description: The Corvinarus Blood Scar is a relic etched with the dark legacy of its necrotic lineage. This blood-red amulet, bound to a Corvinarus ancestor's fate, drains vitality with each use but grants the user a surge of cursed power, enhancing their necromantic spells and dealing extra damage to undead foes. The essence of a fallen noble, it bleeds out enemies struck by necrotic auras, sapping life from those tainted by death magic.

effectDetails.title: Bleed on Hit
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an undead creature with a necromantic spell, it takes an additional 1d6 necrotic damage and is marked as bleeding. The bleed effect lasts until the end of its next turn or when it takes any non-necrotic damage.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activating this relic as a bonus action grants you temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Charisma modifier. You can use this ability once per long rest, and the effect lasts for 1 hour after each activation.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_scar.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a minimum level of 5 due to its intricate enchantment and the dark power it commands.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_scar.vendorReason: The relics of the fallen Corvinarus line are carefully curated by Fractured Atrium, ensuring only those who can wield such power responsibly have access to them.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_scar.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay, arriving within one week of order placement.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as part of a necromantic spell casting
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; Bleed lasts until end of turn or when it takes non-necrotic damage. Cursed Surge lasts for 1 hour after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The bleed effect ends when the target takes non-necrotic damage, and the cursed surge ends at the start of your next turn following its activation.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_scar.priceReason: This relic is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its balance between power and limited utility, ensuring it remains a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_tome.name: Corvinarus Blood Tome
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_tome.description: The Corvinarus Blood Tome is a cursed grimoire bound in the skin of a fallen noble, its pages stained with forbidden necromantic rites. When opened, it whispers dark secrets and rituals that can turn the user into a vessel of death for a brief time. The tome requires ritualistic chanting and the sacrifice of an ally to unlock its power, allowing the caster to harness the essence of the dead momentarily.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Ascension
effectDetails.rules: The user gains +30% damage resistance and +50% necromantic spell power for 10 turns. This effect requires the use of a willing sacrifice, which must be an ally within reach. The sacrifice grants the user temporary mastery over necrotic energies.

effectDetails.title: Corpse Echo
effectDetails.rules: One enemy becomes a spectral mimic for 3 turns, copying the caster's last spell cast during this effect. This mimic can only repeat that spell and does not gain any additional abilities or effects.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_tome.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant magical prowess to control such dark forces without risk.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_tome.vendorReason: The vendors of Fractured Atrium specialize in rare and forbidden artifacts, including this cursed tome.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_tome.shippingDetail: Carefully packed with protective charms to prevent accidental use during transit.

usage.activation: Requires ritualistic chanting and a willing sacrifice (ally within reach)
usage.duration: 10 turns for Necromantic Ascension, 3 turns for Corpse Echo
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or the user is incapacitated

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_blood_tome.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its dark magic and the risk of using such a cursed artifact.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodblade.name: Corvinarus Bloodblade
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodblade.description: The Corvinarus Bloodblade, forged from the skeletal remains of a fallen warlord, channels necrotic fury into its edge, which bleeds dark ichor when struck. Its spectral reinforcements appear in a burst of shadow at your side, dealing minor damage to nearby foes and leaving them reeling with fatigue. The blade's bone structure resonates with ancient magic, making it an iconic relic among warriors who seek the power of death itself.
effects: Summons spectral reinforcements on critical hit

effectDetails.title: Spectral Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you deal a critical hit with this weapon, a burst of necrotic energy manifests as spectral reinforcements in a 10-foot radius around the target. These reinforcements deal 2d6 necrotic damage to each enemy within and force them to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become exhausted until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Edge
effectDetails.rules: Whenever this weapon strikes an undead creature, it bleeds dark ichor. This causes the target to take an additional 1d4 necrotic damage as their flesh decays and they are weakened for the duration of the battle.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodblade.levelRequirementReason: The blade's ancient magic demands a user who has faced significant trials.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodblade.vendorReason: The vendor specializes in relics from lost civilizations and legendary artifacts.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodblade.shippingDetail: Delivered through shadowy planes, the weapon arrives with a delay of one week but is accompanied by a protective aura that ensures its safe arrival.

usage.activation: Instantaneous on critical hit or when struck and damaged.
usage.duration: Until expended or until you drop to 0 hit points
usage.endsWhen: The weapon's charge is depleted upon the target making a successful saving throw or taking an action.
usage.charges: 1d4+2 charges; recharged after a long rest.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodblade.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its rarity and the resources required for its forging from a fallen warlord's remains.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodline.name: Corvinarus Bloodline Amulet
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodline.description: The Corvinarus Bloodline Amulet flickers with a haunting crimson light, its core a fragment of a noble soul long extinguished. This amulet channels the spectral essence of fallen nobles, allowing you to summon three ethereal guardians for battle and imbue yourself with a chilling aura that halts undead in their tracks. Its eerie glow intensifies when necromantic energies are at work, making it a symbol of both power and sorrow.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Guardians
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Summons three spectral minions that last for up to 1 minute or until dismissed by the user. These guardians can be commanded to attack a target within 30 feet, providing temporary assistance in combat.

effectDetails.title: Chilling Aura
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action and lasts for 1 hour. Grants a +2 bonus to saving throws against necromancy effects and causes undead creatures within 30 feet to move at half speed (50%) until the end of your next turn.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodline.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 5 to channel the complex necromantic energies necessary for such a powerful amulet.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodline.vendorReason: The Fractured Atrium specializes in relics and artifacts of the fallen nobility, making it the ideal vendor for this heirloom piece.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodline.shippingDetail: Ships via a Rakasha spirit courier who can deliver it within one day at an additional cost.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action to activate effects; spectral guardians can be dismissed as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Spectral guardians last up to 1 minute, Chilling Aura lasts 1 hour.
usage.endsWhen: Spectral guardians are dismissed by the user. Chilling Aura ends when the duration expires or when the wearer no longer has any necromancy-related effects active.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodline.priceReason: The amulet's rarity, unique crafting, and the power it channels from fallen nobles justify its moderate but not exorbitant price.
