fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodline_sc.name: Corvinarus Bloodline Scarf
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodline_sc.description: The Corvinarus Bloodline Scarf is a dark relic of a noble house's cursed past. Woven from the very thread of its bearer’s ancestral lineage, it grants necromantic power at the cost of one's vitality. With each step, there's a chance to resurrect an ally at the price of ten percent of your health, and undead enemies fall under a stronger blade. This heirloom binds the wearer in more ways than one.

effectDetails.title: Resurrection Chance
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns, there is a 10% chance that you may resurrect an ally who has died within the last round. Doing so costs ten percent of your maximum hit points.

effectDetails.title: Undead Blade
effectDetails.rules: You deal +20% damage against undead creatures and gain a +4 bonus to saving throws against necromancy spells.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodstone.name: Corvinarus Bloodstone of the Veiled Throne
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodstone.description: The Corvinarus Bloodstone of the Veiled Throne is a fractured gem carved from the bones of a noble who fell in battle. Its surface glows with necrotic energy, and when activated, it channels this dark force into your next spell, infusing it with deadly intent. However, if used without focus, it saps your vitality, draining you of life. This cursed artifact whispers of ancient sorceries and the Veiled Throne's dark past.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Infusion
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. When your next spell is cast, it deals an additional 50% necrotic damage for 10 seconds. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or the caster drops to 0 hit points.

effectDetails.title: Life Drain
effectDetails.rules: If activated without proper focus (an action), you take 2d6 necrotic damage and have disadvantage on your next attack roll and ability check for the rest of the short rest. This effect does not recharge until after a long rest.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodstone.levelRequirementReason: The gem's dark magic requires a moderate level to channel effectively.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodstone.vendorReason: This cursed artifact is one of many relics found in the ruins of the Veiled Throne, and the fractured atrium specializes in such artifacts.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodstone.shippingDetail: Ships via spirit courier; arrives at your doorstep within a week if you are not under threat or in an area affected by a dimensional lock.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Necrotic Infusion, Action to activate without focus
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with 10-second duration from Necrotic Infusion; ends on incapacitation or caster dropping to 0 HP
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or caster dropping to 0 hit points
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the effect does not recharge until after a long rest

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bloodstone.priceReason: The gem's rarity and cursed nature justify its price; it requires careful handling and is potent in combat.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_satchel.name: Corvinarus Bone Satchel
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_satchel.description: The Corvinarus Bone Satchel is a ceremonial pouch crafted from the ribs of fallen noble Corvinaruses. Its ancient craftsmanship channels necromantic power, allowing it to store soul fragments and enhance one's attacks with a touch of the dead. The satchel hums softly when opened, soothing nearby undead for two turns, but its most potent use is in battle, where it amplifies the wielder’s strikes by channelling the essence of the fallen.

effectDetails.title: Soul Fragment Storage
effectDetails.rules: This effect allows the satchel to store up to three soul fragments, granting a +10% bonus to hit and damage rolls. When fully charged with soul fragments, it provides a +3000 HP bonus.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Resonance
effectDetails.rules: On activation as an action, the satchel channels necromantic energy into the wielder’s next attack, granting a +5% chance to trigger necromantic resonance. This effect ends if the wielder misses with the attack or after one use.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_satchel.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to effectively harness the satchel's necromantic power.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_satchel.vendorReason: The vendors of Fractured Atrium specialize in relics and artifacts from fallen noble Corvinaruses, making this item a natural fit for their inventory.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_satchel.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of the satchel's components, it is shipped under special conditions to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on next attack
usage.endsWhen: Missed attack or after one use

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_satchel.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the satchel's rare and powerful necromantic properties.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_scepter.name: Corvinarus Bone Scepter of the Fallen
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_scepter.description: The Corvinarus Bone Scepter of the Fallen is a ghastly artifact carved from the bones of an ancient necromantic overlord. It channels dark energy into devastating strikes, most potent in shadowy environs. The scepter's wielder gains +50% damage on their first strike against undead creatures and increases their total damage to undead by 25%. With each use, it calls forth a spectral necromancer that assists for 30 seconds before dissipating.
effects: +50% damage on first strike vs. undead
Increases damage dealt to undead by 25%

effectDetails.title: First Strike Potency
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action in darkened areas; lasts until the end of your next turn; ends if you leave the darkness.

effectDetails.title: Undead Damage Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect active while holding the scepter; duration is indefinite unless destroyed or lost.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_scepter.levelRequirementReason: Requires a level 5 character to channel and control its necromantic power.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_scepter.vendorReason: The fractured realm's dark vendors are known for their macabre wares, including this cursed artifact.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_scepter.shippingDetail: Ships via night courier to ensure the scepter arrives in shadowed conditions.

usage.activation: Bonus action when in a darkened area
usage.duration: Until end of next turn; spectral necromancer lasts 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Leaving darkness or losing possession

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_scepter.priceReason: The scepter's rarity and unique effects justify its fair value of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_tome.name: Corvinarus Bone Tome of the Silent Necromancer
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_tome.description: The Corvinarus Bone Tome of the Silent Necromancer is bound in the ribs of a fallen Corvinarus, its pages inscribed with dark necromantic runes. The tome whispers through the reflection of a mirror, and each spell cast drains the caster’s soul, leaving them weaker yet more powerful. Only in a mirrored room does this cursed book unleash its full malevolent potential, ensuring that only those truly dedicated to the art of the dead can wield it.

effectDetails.title: Mirror Necromancy
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Cast one necromancy spell from the book (range up to 30 feet) through the reflection of any mirror within reach, targeting creatures or objects in that area. The spell has disadvantage if cast without a mirror. Ends when the mirror is broken or the caster’s next turn begins.

effectDetails.title: Soul Drain
effectDetails.rules: Each time you use the book, you take 1d6 necrotic damage and your maximum hit points are reduced by an amount equal to this damage until a long rest. This effect is cumulative with each usage of the book.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_tome.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to handle the dark magic without severe consequences.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_tome.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium deals in cursed and forbidden artifacts, making this necromantic tome a fitting addition to their inventory.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_tome.shippingDetail: The tome must be shipped within a mirror-lined crate to ensure it remains functional during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for spell cast; ends when the mirror is broken or next turn begins
usage.endsWhen: Mirror breaks, caster's next turn starts, or long rest

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_bone_tome.priceReason: Balanced at a fair price considering its dark magic and cursed nature.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_crimson_shro.name: Corvinarus Crimson Shroud
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_crimson_shro.description: The Corvinarus Crimson Shroud, a tattered veil spun from the blood of noble fallen warriors, grants the wearer dominion over the battlefield's dead. By weaving shadows and whispers into its fabric, it binds the recently deceased to serve as loyal undead minions. The shroud's necromantic power surges in battle, offering a 20% increase in necromancy spells' potency while reducing physical damage taken by 50%. It is a relic from the fractured atrium of Corvinarus, where dark rituals were once performed.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Dominion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer gains a +20% bonus to the DC of necromancy spells for one hour, after which it diminishes by 10% per hour until it expires.

effectDetails.title: Undead Minions
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a reaction when an enemy within 30 feet dies. The shroud summons up to two loyal skeletal warriors that follow the wearer's commands for one minute, after which they vanish or can be commanded again.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_crimson_shro.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to wield and channel its necromantic energies effectively.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_crimson_shro.vendorReason: This relic is a well-known artifact of the fractured atrium, where it was once revered by dark practitioners.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_crimson_shro.shippingDetail: Delivered via secret courier with strict confidentiality; delays may occur due to its sensitive nature.

usage.duration: One hour for Necrotic Dominion, one minute per summoning of Undead Minions
usage.endsWhen: Necrotic power fades or minions are destroyed; uses a charge each time summoned

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_crimson_shro.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item offers potent necromantic abilities but requires careful handling and high-level proficiency to be effective.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo.name: Corvinarus Echo
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo.description: The Corvinarus Echo, a cursed relic of necromantic lineage, hums with an eerie pulse that resonates from the very core of death itself. Crafted from ancient bones and bound by dark magic, it summons a spectral echo of the wielder’s past demise—a fleeting veil of necrotic energy that repels undead for but a moment. When activated, this spectral echo creates a shimmering barrier that not only repels the dead but also grants the user a +20% chance to dodge necrotic attacks.

effectDetails.title: Echo of Death
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Creates a necrotic energy barrier that repels nearby undead creatures for 5 seconds, reducing their effectiveness by half during this time. The effect ends if the wielder is hit by an attack or if the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Dodging
effectDetails.rules: Grants +20% chance to dodge necrotic projectiles. This does not stack with other dodging abilities and remains active until the item runs out of charges, which occurs after 3 uses.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo.levelRequirementReason: The Corvinarus Echo is a powerful relic that requires a minimum level to wield its dark magic effectively.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium, the keeper of ancient and cursed relics, holds this item as one of their most potent offerings.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo.shippingDetail: The Echo is delivered through Boo Spectral Mail, ensuring that only those with a firm grip on dark magic can claim it upon arrival.

usage.duration: 5 seconds or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Hit by an attack or duration expires

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rare and powerful nature, balancing its potent necromantic abilities with a reasonable cost for players to acquire.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_belt.name: Corvinarus Echo Belt
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_belt.description: The Corvinarus Echo Belt, a cursed artifact forged in the fractured mirrors of Atrium's shattered atria, whispers secrets of the dead and amplifies necromantic willpower. Crafted by ancient hands from the very glass that once held the echoes of the damned, it grants the wearer insight into their enemies' spells and drains their souls over time. Wielders must be vigilant, for the belt demands a price in lives as its secrets are revealed.

effectDetails.title: Whispers Secrets
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the belt reveals one enemy spell target for each turn it is active. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after three turns have passed.

effectDetails.title: Soul Drain
effectDetails.rules: At the end of each of the first three of its wearer's turns while active, the belt inflicts 1d6 points of soul drain on an enemy within 30 feet. The effect ends if the belt is removed.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_belt.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from ancient and dangerous materials, this artifact requires a necromancer of at least level 5 to wield.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_belt.vendorReason: The Fractured Atrium is known for its unique and cursed artifacts, making it the only vendor capable of selling such a powerful item.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_belt.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, with expedited delivery to the nearest major necromancy hub.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated by wearing the belt.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts until removed or the start of your next turn after three turns.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the belt is removed, or when its duration expires.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_belt.priceReason: The belt's powerful necromantic properties and cursed nature justify a price of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_blade.name: Corvinarus Echo Blade
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_blade.description: The Corvinarus Echo Blade is a sword forged from the fractured soul of a fallen general. Its blade glows with an eerie, ancestral light that pulses in time with the wielder’s heartbeat. This weapon hums with ancient magic, dealing +15% extra damage to undead foes and has a 5% chance to reflect spell damage back at the caster. Each strike summons a ghostly echo of your last spell, which can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Ancestral Reflection
effectDetails.rules: The wielder has a 5% chance to reflect the last spell cast back at its caster. This effect occurs only once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Ethereal Echo
effectDetails.rules: Each time you deal damage with this weapon, there is a 10% chance that it summons an ethereal echo of your last spell. The echo can be used as a bonus action to cast the same spell, but it costs one charge from the wielder’s pool.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_blade.levelRequirementReason: The weapon's ancestral magic requires a fair amount of control and experience for a wielder.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_blade.vendorReason: This sword is a relic from the fractured atrium, where it was found in a spectral vault guarded by undead foes.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_blade.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral courier; may arrive with minor delays due to fluctuating ethereal conditions.

usage.activation: Instantaneous on contact with an enemy.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or until expended.
usage.endsWhen: The wielder completes a long rest, or if the weapon is destroyed.
usage.charges: Limited to one use per long rest.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_blade.priceReason: Balanced against other +2 weapons with unique abilities and rare crafting materials required.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_core.name: Corvinarus Echo Core
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_core.description: The Corvinarus Echo Core is a fractured fragment of ancient power, pulsing with the echoes of forgotten rituals and ancestral might. Crafted from the very heart of the Corvinarus lineage's lineage, it resonates with spectral whispers that can mimic an enemy’s spell with devastating precision. This core amplifies the caster’s magical prowess, allowing them to harness the essence of a foe’s last spell as their own weapon.

effectDetails.title: Echo Mimicry
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the core to mimic the last spell cast by a hostile creature within 60 feet. This spell functions exactly as it would if cast normally, but deals only half its original damage.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage
effectDetails.rules: When mimicking a spell, any damage dealt is increased by 150%. The core can be used once per short or long rest. If the mimicry fails, it immediately expends one use and ceases to function until the next rest.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_core.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 3 due to its complex magical properties.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_core.vendorReason: The Fractured Atrium is known for dealing with rare and powerful relics, including the Corvinarus Echo Core.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_core.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral means, ensuring swift but eerie transport to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted or until the next short or long rest

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_echo_core.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare material and complex enchantment.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_finger.name: Corvinarus Finger of Echoing Souls
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_finger.description: The Corvinarus Finger of Echoing Souls, a gnarled relic from the last living member of the noble house, is a finger encased in obsidian and adorned with emerald accents. When pressed, it summons a spectral echo of a fallen ally, its voice echoing through the air like a dying song, granting moments of clarity to those who hear it. This spectral presence can be channeled into devastating attacks that carry the essence of the dead, dealing necromantic damage and reducing stamina costs by 10%.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Echo
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The finger summons a spectral echo of a fallen ally that lasts for 5 seconds, granting +10% damage to necromantic spells cast during this time. The echo can be targeted by any spell or effect dealing necrotic damage.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Channeling
effectDetails.rules: While the spectral echo is active, you gain a +5 bonus to the DC of your necromancy spell checks and reduce the stamina cost of such spells by 10%. The effect ends if you are incapacitated or if the spectral echo disperses.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_finger.levelRequirementReason: The finger requires a minimum level to wield its power responsibly.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_finger.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium, an ancient shop of lost knowledge, holds the rarest relics from forgotten ages.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_finger.shippingDetail: The relic is shipped in a specially crafted box to prevent any damage during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon the spectral echo; continuous effect while active.
usage.duration: 5 seconds of spectral presence and necrotic channeling.
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or dispersal of the spectral echo.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_finger.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its rare material and unique properties, making it a valuable yet not overpowered addition to any necromancer's arsenal.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gauntlet.name: Corvinarus Bone Gauntlet
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gauntlet.description: The Corvinarus Bone Gauntlet, forged from the dark remnants of a noble fallen in battle, channels the very essence of necromancy. Its intricate carvings glow faintly with spectral energy, and when donned, it enhances one's mastery over undead forces. Summoned spectral constructs obey your every command, but they are ephemeral—dissolving into mist after a single combat encounter. The gauntlet also amplifies the caster’s necromantic rituals, ensuring that each spell has an extra edge against undead foes.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Construct Companion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the gauntlet summons a spectral wraith companion. The wraith has 10 hit points and deals necrotic damage equal to twice the caster’s proficiency bonus. It dissipates into mist after one combat encounter or if dismissed by the wearer.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Necromancy
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the gauntlet, the caster gains a +1 bonus to all necromancy skill checks and spell DCs. Additionally, undead enemies they target with necromancy spells take an extra 5% necrotic damage.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet requires a minimum level of 3 to channel its dark energies effectively.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gauntlet.vendorReason: The vendors at Fractured Atrium specialize in relics from the fallen noble houses, and this gauntlet is no exception.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gauntlet.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, the gauntlet must be shipped via Koopa Postal’s express courier service for safe delivery.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon a spectral wraith companion; passive effect while wearing the gauntlet.
usage.duration: Instantaneous summoning of the spectral construct; active effect while worn.
usage.endsWhen: The spectral construct dissipates after one combat encounter or if dismissed by the wearer. The bonus to necromancy skill checks and spell DCs is always active while worn.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gauntlet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this gauntlet offers a significant boost in necromantic capabilities without overwhelming the player.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gaze.name: Corvinarus Gaze of the Shadowed Throne
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gaze.description: The Corvinarus Gaze of the Shadowed Throne is a ceremonial eye crafted from blackened obsidian and encrusted with forgotten sigils. This relic allows its wielder to perceive through the eyes of a necromantic patron, granting visions of hidden truths, cursed locations, or the movements of the dead. The eye's power comes from the very heart of an ancient necropolis, where it was forged within the shadows of the throne. Its gaze is said to pierce the veil between life and death, revealing secrets that others cannot see.

effectDetails.title: Seer's Insight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate the Corvinarus Gaze to gain one of three visions: the location of hidden enemies within 60 feet, the truth behind an illusion or misdirection effect, or the path taken by a cursed object in the last hour. The vision lasts for 1 minute and ends if the user takes any hostile action.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Detection
effectDetails.rules: The Corvinarus Gaze grants a constant awareness of cursed objects within a 30-foot radius, providing a +2 bonus to Perception checks made to detect such items. This effect lasts until the wielder takes a long rest.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gaze.levelRequirementReason: The Corvinarus Gaze requires significant arcane knowledge and a deep understanding of necromancy.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gaze.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium has extensive contacts within the necromantic underworld, allowing them to trade in such powerful relics.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gaze.shippingDetail: The item is delivered via shadowy courier, ensuring its arrival remains secret and secure.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Seer's Insight; passive effect for Cursed Detection.
usage.duration: 1 minute for Seer's Insight; until the wielder takes a long rest for Cursed Detection.
usage.endsWhen: Hostile actions or taking a long rest, respectively.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_gaze.priceReason: The Corvinarus Gaze's rarity and unique abilities justify its price of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_hollow.name: Corvinarus Hollow Blade
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_hollow.description: The Corvinarus Hollow Blade hums with a dark, spectral energy, forged from the bones of a fallen necromancer’s soul. Its blade glows with an eerie light that flickers and dances even in the darkest shadows. This cursed weapon strikes true against undead enemies, dealing extra damage that can turn the tide of battle. Upon death, it briefly reanimates its wielder's soul, granting them one final chance to fight back.

effectDetails.title: Reanimate Soul
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder dies in combat, the Corvinarus Hollow Blade briefly reanimates their soul for a turn. The user gains advantage on all attacks and saving throws until the end of their next turn. This effect can only be used once per battle.

effectDetails.title: Undead Strike
effectDetails.rules: The blade deals an additional 1d6 necrotic damage to undead enemies. If a creature with at least one death save is reduced to 0 hit points by this attack, the wielder can use a bonus action to attempt a saving throw against the creature’s last death saving throw DC.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_hollow.levelRequirementReason: This weapon's dark forging and cursed nature require a high level of skill and strength to handle.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_hollow.vendorReason: The vendors at Fractured Atrium specialize in rare, cursed artifacts and exotic weapons from the depths of the Underworld.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_hollow.shippingDetail: Carefully packed with spectral wards to protect both sender and receiver from the blade's malevolent influence.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect upon death; no additional activation required for Undead Strike.
usage.duration: Reanimate Soul lasts until the end of the wielder’s next turn. Undead Strike is a one-time use per battle.
usage.endsWhen: The effects are exhausted or the wielder dies again in combat.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_hollow.priceReason: Balanced for its cursed nature, dark forging process, and unique undead-targeting abilities.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mantle.name: Corvinarus Mantle of the Dead King
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mantle.description: The Corvinarus Mantle of the Dead King is a tattered, spectral cloak woven from the very essence of the Atrium's shadows. Its fabric hums with necromantic energy, amplifying the voice of the wearer and channeling the whispers of ancient spirits. Worn by those who walk between life and death, it grants the power to summon a ghostly echo of a fallen comrade for fleeting moments, lending both eerie light and combat prowess in the darkest hours.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Amplifier
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. This effect increases necromancy spell damage by 30% for the wearer. The amplification lasts until the start of your next turn, after which it dissipates.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Companion
effectDetails.rules: Allows the wearer to summon a spectral echo of a fallen comrade as an action. This spectral companion appears as the ghostly form of one ally who has died within the past 24 hours. The echo provides dim light in a 10-foot radius and can make an attack against a single target within that range, dealing necrotic damage equal to half the sum of your Charisma modifier plus your proficiency bonus.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mantle.levelRequirementReason: This mantle requires significant control over necromantic energies, suitable only for those who have reached at least fifth level.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mantle.vendorReason: The Mantle's dark and powerful magic is known to the scholars of the fractured Atrium, who trade it with select customers.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mantle.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral couriers that transport the item through shadowy paths, ensuring secrecy and quick delivery.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Necromantic Amplifier; Action to summon Spectral Companion
usage.duration: Necromantic Amplifier lasts until your next turn; Spectral Companion lasts for 10 seconds or until dispelled by a successful DC 15 Con saving throw
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use, usable once per long rest

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mantle.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers potent necromantic abilities with a reasonable cooldown and limited use.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mirrored_sou.name: Corvinarus Mirrored Soul Shard
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mirrored_sou.description: The Corvinarus Mirrored Soul Shard is a fractured relic of ancient necromancy, its surface a web of mirror shards that reflect your soul in the eyes of every foe. Wield it and witness the truths hidden within, as your necromantic spells strike with augmented power, dealing an extra 25% damage to all targets. Your enemies' true weaknesses are revealed through the fractured glass, granting you insight into their next move.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Aura
effectDetails.rules: While wielding this shard, all necromantic spells deal an additional 25% damage. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Soul Reflection
effectDetails.rules: After casting a necromantic spell, you can reflect enemy soul energy back at them for 30 seconds. This effect has a range of 60 feet and ends if you take damage or cast another spell.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mirrored_sou.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires significant control over necromantic energies, thus necessitating a minimum level of 5.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mirrored_sou.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium specializes in relics from the Corvinarus lineage and their cursed mirrors.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mirrored_sou.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay, with a 1-day delivery guarantee.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when first equipped; each use of necromantic spells triggers Soul Reflection.
usage.duration: Necrotic Aura lasts until the end of your next turn; Soul Reflection lasts for 30 seconds after casting.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take damage or cast another spell, and it has no charges.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_mirrored_sou.priceReason: This shard is crafted from a rare material and requires advanced necromantic knowledge to wield effectively.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_ring.name: Corvinarus Ring of the Deep Mirror
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_ring.description: The Corvinarus Ring of the Deep Mirror, crafted from the fractured glass of an ancient necrotic mirror, allows its wearer to perceive echoes of past deaths and glimpse future necrotic truths. This cursed ring whispers secrets of the dead, causing a 15% chance for spectral fragments to appear alongside the wearer's every step, occasionally summoning a ghostly echo of one’s past self. It grants a 10% bonus to all necromancy skill checks, but at a cost—whispered necrotic visions cloud your mind, reducing your Intelligence by 2 until you rest.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Dead
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this ring reveals the location of any hidden necrotic altar within 30 feet. The effect lasts for 1 minute and has no save DC or saving throw required. However, it drains your Intelligence by 2 until you complete a short rest.

effectDetails.rules: The ring grants a 10% bonus to all necromancy skill checks. This effect is always active while wearing the ring and does not require any action or additional components, but it can be negated by a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_ring.levelRequirementReason: The cursed nature of the ring requires a certain degree of mental resilience to wield effectively.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_scar.name: Corvinarus Scar
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_scar.description: The Corvinarus Scar is a jagged obsidian relic imbued with the cold fury of ancient necromancers. Its sigils glow faintly, pulsing with a chilling energy that whispers of forgotten battles and dark rituals. This relic grants its wielder a +15% bonus to attacks against undead, allowing for precise control over these spectral minions. Wearing it also increases the chance to instill fear in living foes by 5%, but at the cost of draining one stamina point each use, which regenerates after an hour.

effectDetails.title: Undead Command
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user gains a +15% bonus to attack rolls against undead creatures for the duration of one minute, after which it ends.

effectDetails.title: Fearful Presence
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. Increases the chance to instill fear in living targets by 5%, but each use drains 1 stamina point (regenerates after 1 hour).

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_scar.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 3 to harness the relic's ancient power without overextending one's abilities.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_scar.vendorReason: The relics of Corvinarus are closely tied to the fractured history of this vendor, making them an expert in such powerful artifacts.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_scar.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay with a guaranteed delivery within three days.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_scar.priceReason: The relic's rarity and unique abilities justify its price of 1000 XP.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_ash.name: Corvinarus Soul Ash
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_ash.description: Corvinarus Soul Ash is a shimmering, ethereal powder harvested from the skeletal remains of fallen Corvinarus mages. When scattered upon necromantic runes, it fortifies undead constructs, making them nigh unbreakable and imbuing them with an eerie, spectral presence that lingers after the spell's completion. This powder is known to enhance the very essence of death itself, amplifying the power of necromancy by 20%. Sprinkling it also grants a fleeting but potent spectral echo of your soul, manifesting as a wraith-like companion for a brief period.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Undead Constructs
effectDetails.rules: When sprinkled on necromantic runes, Corvinarus Soul Ash increases the durability of undead constructs by 40%. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until the next time the undead construct takes damage. There is no save DC for this effect.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Echo Companion
effectDetails.rules: Sprinkling Corvinarus Soul Ash grants you a spectral echo of your soul, which manifests as a wraith-like companion that follows you for 1 minute. The echo can take one action to attack or cast a spell, but it cannot use any other bonus actions or reactions. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_ash.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third-level spells to effectively utilize the full necromantic power of Corvinarus Soul Ash.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_ash.vendorReason: The fractured ruins of Atrium hold many secrets, and those who delve into its dark past often seek this powder for their unholy craft.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_ash.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, known for its unpredictable yet reliable delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; Fortified Undead Constructs last until the next damage taken. Spectral Echo lasts for 1 minute, with one use per short rest.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_ash.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare extraction and potent necromantic properties.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_casket.name: Corvinarus Soul Casket
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_casket.description: The Corvinarus Soul Casket is a heavy, ornate sarcophagus made from Corvinarus lineage stone, said to contain the last soul of a powerful necromancer. When invoked, it opens with a resonant hum and releases a mist that forms into an ethereal pact with the dead for 2 turns, allowing the caster to command minor undead creatures effectively. The casket's power is known to cause a faint, lingering drain upon its user if any hostile creature lies within five tiles.

effectDetails.title: Command Undead
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the caster commands a single undead creature for 3 turns. The undead can be any size or type of creature with hit points less than 40. There is no save needed to command it.

effectDetails.title: Soul Drain Hazard
effectDetails.rules: If any hostile creature is within 5 tiles when the casket's power activates, the caster suffers a minor soul drain. This causes the caster to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 necrotic damage.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_casket.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic of the Corvinarus Soul Casket requires a certain level of expertise in necromancy.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_casket.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium specializes in relics and artifacts from forgotten realms, including items of power like the Corvinarus Soul Casket.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_casket.shippingDetail: The casket is shipped with a special enchantment to ensure it arrives intact. It takes an extra day for delivery due to its fragile nature and magical properties.

usage.duration: 2 turns

usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to regain command of undead.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_casket.priceReason: The casket's rarity and the specific enchantments required for its creation justify this fair XP price.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_rod.name: Corvinarus Soul Rod of the Hollow Requiem
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_rod.description: The Corvinarus Soul Rod of the Hollow Requiem is a weapon forged from the ethereal essence of the Corvinarus lineage, its surface etched with runes that whisper ancient lullabies to the dead. When wielded, it summons spectral echoes that strike with devastating precision, targeting undead foes with unerring accuracy. The rod's power amplifies necromantic magic, granting a user 20% increased casting speed for such spells and emitting spectral echoes that deal 10% of spell damage to surrounding enemies.

effectDetails.title: Undead Strike
effectDetails.rules: When the rod is used to cast a necromantic spell, it emits spectral echoes that deal an additional 50% of the spell’s damage to undead targets. This effect has a range of 30 feet and lasts until the end of the caster's next turn.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: While holding this rod, you gain a +2 bonus to your spellcasting ability checks for necromantic spells. This effect is active as long as you are wielding the rod and ends when you stop using it in a casting.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_rod.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 5 to wield effectively, ensuring it targets capable users with the skill to harness its necromantic power.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_rod.vendorReason: Fractured Atrium is known for dealing in rare and exotic artifacts, especially those tied to ancient magic like this soul-rod.
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_rod.shippingDetail: Ships via the Rakasha Spirit Walk, a courier service that ensures timely delivery of powerful magical items.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_rod.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare forging and potent necromantic abilities.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_tome.name: Corvinarus Soul Tome
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_tome.description: The Corvinarus Soul Tome is a cursed book bound in cracked black leather, its pages whispering forgotten rites of necromancy. When opened, it reveals the power to channel the dead, allowing their whispers to guide the living. The tome's bindings are said to be made from ancient bones, and when activated, it grants temporary invisibility for 3 turns, making the user a shadow among shadows. It also restores 10% of the user’s maximum hit points at the start of each of their turns while active.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Guidance
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Corvinarus Soul Tome grants temporary invisibility to the user for a duration of 3 turns. This effect can be activated once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Hit Point Restoration
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each turn while the tome is active, the user regains an amount of hit points equal to 10% of their maximum hit points. Once per short or long rest, this effect can be used as a bonus action.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_tome.levelRequirementReason: The necromantic power requires a certain mastery over the arcane arts, which is typically achieved by third-level spellcasters.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_tome.priceReason: The price reflects its rare nature and the special conditions required for safe handling and shipping.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_ward.name: Corvinarus Soul Ward
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soul_ward.description: The Corvinarus Soul Ward, a cursed amulet forged from the bones of a fallen lineage, bears the weighty legacy of necromantic power. Its tarnished surface whispers the names of ancient ancestors, and when worn, it grants temporary immunity to psychic backlash. This heirloom amplifies the user's undead summons, allowing them to command spectral echoes within a 30-foot radius as if they were part of their own dark lineage.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soulbind.name: Corvinarus Soulbind Gauntlet
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soulbind.description: The Corvinarus Soulbind Gauntlet is a gauntlet woven from the very essence of the ancient lineage. Its fingers pulse with the dark magic of the dead, and each strike resonates with the whispers of ancestors long gone. It binds spirits to your will, making their power yours to command in battle. The gauntlet's weight feels like that of a living entity, and its leather is dyed a deep, eerie black.

effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, the gauntlet can summon a Corvinarus spirit. This spirit grants temporary hit points equal to half the wielder's level (rounded down) and provides advantage on saving throws against necromancy spells. The spirit lasts for 1 minute.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soulbind.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its rare and powerful abilities.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soulcore.name: Corvinarus Soulforge
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soulcore.description: The Corvinarus Soulforge, a ritual artifact forged from the blood and bone of a fallen noble, is a darkly gleaming core that hums with malevolent energy. Its surface is etched with ancient runes, each one pulsing with necrotic power. This relic grants dominion over the dark realm, enhancing all necromantic spells by 15% in damage and imbuing the wielder with the strength to cast 'Necrotic Embrace' twice per day—immune to harm and capable of delivering two attacks.

effectDetails.title: +15% Necromancy Damage

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_soulcore.levelRequirementReason: The artifact's malevolent power requires a minimum level to safely handle and channel.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_tome.name: Corvinarus Tome of Unwritten Oaths
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_tome.description: The Corvinarus Tome of Unwritten Oaths is a cracked leather-bound tome, its obsidian cover etched with blood-red runes that whisper secrets of ancient lineage and forbidden knowledge. When invoked, it compels you to swear an oath in your own blood, binding you to the fate of the Corvinarus line. Each invocation grants you temporary immunity to fear and confusion but exacts a ghastly toll: ten percent of your current hit points are drained as the curse takes root.

effectDetails.title: Bloodbound Oath
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you swear an oath in your own blood. This invokes a hidden quest tied to the Corvinarus bloodline and grants temporary immunity to fear and confusion for the duration of the encounter. Each use drains 10% of your current hit points. The effect is exhausted after one use.

effectDetails.title: Momentary Serenity
effectDetails.rules: For a brief moment, you are shielded from fear and confusion, granting immunity to these conditions for the duration of an action. This effect can only be activated once per long rest.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_tome.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to invoke the ancient power without fatal consequences.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_vessel.name: Corvinarus Vessel
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_vessel.description: The Corvinarus Vessel is a hollowed mirror etched with the bloodlines of ancient kings, its surface reflecting both light and the dark echoes of forgotten curses. Crafted from the very glass of a fractured atrium, it grants the wielder power over reality itself—summoning spectral avatars that rend the fabric of time for brief moments. It also reflects 20% of incoming physical damage as necrotic energy, turning blows into deathly echoes.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Avatars
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a bonus action. Summons a spectral avatar of the Corvinarus lineage, which grants the wearer immunity to fear effects for 5 seconds after summoning. Crafted in the hollow atria where shadows coalesce, this garment binds the soul of a slain noble to your form, granting you necromantic prowess and a chilling aura that echoes forgotten authority. When struck, it emits haunting whispers that disorient foes within ten feet, and its wearer gains a 15% damage bonus against undead creatures.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Aura
effectDetails.rules: The vest grants you a +15% damage bonus to necromantic attacks. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Disorientation

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_vial.name: Corvinarus Vial of Unbinding
fractured_atrium_corvinarus_vial.description: The Corvinarus Vial of Unbinding contains a vial of crystalline essence extracted from a fallen noble of the Corvinarus line, known for their mastery over necromancy. The vial's power is drawn directly from the noble’s lost life force, making each use feel like a fragment of the noble's spirit leaving you in its wake.

fractured_atrium_corvinarus_wardstone.description: The Corvinarus Wardstone is a jagged relic from the deepest halls of Corvinarus, its fractured surface etched with dark runes that whisper of forgotten curses and ancient power. fractured_atrium_corvinarus_wardstone.levelRequirementReason: Requires 5th level to wield due to its dark magic and intricate enchantments.
