gradual_syrup.shippingDetail: Ships via the trusted Sticky Bottle Express with overnight delivery.

usage.activation: Passive effect beginning at the start of your turn.
usage.duration: Three turns.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends after three consecutive turns or if you cast a spell that requires more than one slot level.

gradual_syrup.priceReason: Gradual Syrup offers significant benefits in terms of spell slot recovery and enhanced spell effects, making it a cost-effective choice for adventurers.

grand_cathay_fireworks_display.name: Grand Cathay Fireworks Display
grand_cathay_fireworks_display.description: The Grand Cathay Fireworks Display is a grand, meticulously crafted array of pyrotechnics that lights up the night sky. Each explosion sends out showers of stars and fire, creating a dazzling spectacle for miles around. When viewed by allies, their next attack roll gains advantage, providing them with a momentary boost in confidence and accuracy. This display can also be used to signal troops or create a diversion, making it invaluable on the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: When an ally witnesses the fireworks display, they gain advantage on their next attack roll. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action from the viewer.

effectDetails.title: Targeted Advantage
effectDetails.rules: The display can be used to signal troops or create a diversion by emitting specific patterns that only allies recognize. Doing so requires an action, and it lasts until the pattern is completed or interrupted.

grand_cathay_fireworks_display.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginning adventurers who need a morale-boosting tool in their early campaigns.
grand_cathay_fireworks_display.vendorReason: Grand Cathay is renowned for its expertise in fireworks and celebrations, ensuring that the display is both spectacular and reliable.
grand_cathay_fireworks_display.shippingDetail: The crew ensures a safe delivery, but the display must be set off within one week of receiving it to maintain its potency.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for advantage; ongoing for signaling patterns
usage.endsWhen: Interrupted or completed

grand_cathay_fireworks_display.priceReason: The fireworks are crafted with high-quality materials and require a significant amount of setup, making them a rare and valuable asset.

grand_cathay_silk_armor.name: Grand Cathay Silk Armor
grand_cathay_silk_armor.description: The Grand Cathay Silk Armor, a shimmering vestment of enchanted silk spun from the finest threads of the Cathay Empire, offers unparalleled protection against slashing attacks. Its weave is so delicate and strong that it can only be worn by those who have proven their worth through rigorous training. This armor not only enhances your defense but also subtly enhances your dexterity, making you a more nimble fighter in close combat.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Defense
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this armor, your Armor Class is increased by an additional +1 for every point of your Dexterity modifier, up to a maximum of +2. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Slashing Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you take slashing damage from an attack or other source, you have resistance against that damage. This resistance persists until the start of your next turn.

grand_cathay_silk_armor.levelRequirementReason: This armor is designed for those who are just beginning their journey into combat, ensuring they can handle basic threats with ease.
grand_cathay_silk_armor.vendorReason: The Cathay Trade Route sources the finest materials and craftsmanship from the heart of the empire, offering this exclusive armor to adventurers seeking authenticity and quality.
grand_cathay_silk_armor.shippingDetail: Ships via Silk Bundle Express, ensuring swift delivery through Cathay's renowned courier service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until the start of your next turn)
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you remove the armor or it is destroyed.

grand_cathay_silk_armor.priceReason: This price reflects the high demand and craftsmanship required to produce such a unique piece of armor, blending beauty with practicality.

grand_country_beanbean_bottle.name: Beanbean Bottled Chaos
grand_country_beanbean_bottle.description: The Beanbean Bottled Chaos is a vial of frothy liquid, its surface flecked with gold and emerald hues like a chaotic storm in a glass. It mimics the corrupting influence of the Peasley Financial Scandal, making those who drink it see visions of wealth and prosperity that are as illusory as they are dangerous. Those who imbibe experience temporary courage, bolstered by the very chaos within, but also suffer minor hallucinations of Beanbean coins dancing in front of their eyes. The bottle's contents may occasionally reveal hidden stashes of wealth in Rogueport, a boon for those willing to risk their minds and sanity.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Courage
effectDetails.rules: Drinking this vial grants the imbiber temporary courage equal to 2d4. This effect lasts for a round and can be activated once per session.

effectDetails.title: Minor Hallucinations
effectDetails.rules: After imbibing, the drinker experiences minor hallucinations of Beanbean coins, causing them to see fleeting visions of wealth. These hallucinations persist until the end of their next turn or when they take damage.

grand_country_beanbean_bottle.levelRequirementReason: It requires no specific level as it is a common item and can be found in any shop.
grand_country_beanbean_bottle.vendorReason: Grand Country is known for its wide array of exotic and dangerous items, making the Beanbean Bottled Chaos an ideal addition to their stock.
grand_country_beanbean_bottle.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Koopa Postal service with no delivery delays. Ensure to handle with care as it may leak if not properly sealed.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts for a round
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the drinker takes damage or at the end of their next turn
usage.charges: Unlimited, can be used once per session

grand_country_beanbean_bottle.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect its rare and potentially dangerous nature, making it a significant but not overpowered item.

grand_country_connectopia_crafting_rod.name: Connectopia Crafting Rod
grand_country_connectopia_crafting_rod.description: The Connectopia Crafting Rod is a compact, tool-like device forged from the very blocks of the land itself. Crafted within the heart of Connectopia’s bustling workshops, it harnesses the raw potential of the terrain to shape raw materials into functional and durable tools. Each use of this rod transforms three blocks into crafted items, each blessed with an additional 10% durability that lasts for a century or more. However, its power comes at a cost; each activation consumes 300 mana and requires a 20-minute cooldown to recharge.
effects: Crafts 3 useful items from raw materials

effectDetails.title: Material Transmutation
effectDetails.rules: Activates with an action, crafting three blocks into functional tools or structures. Each crafted item gains a +10% durability bonus for one century. Requires 300 mana and a 20-minute cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Connectopia Focus
effectDetails.rules: Must be used within Connectopian zones; requires the user to have spent time learning its secrets in the workshops of Connectopia.

grand_country_connectopia_crafting_rod.levelRequirementReason: It's a common tool for beginners and travelers, but the knowledge required to use it effectively comes from spending time in the workshops.
grand_country_connectopia_crafting_rod.vendorReason: The grand country’s artisans are known for their mastery of Connectopian crafting techniques, making this rod a staple among their offerings.
grand_country_connectopia_crafting_rod.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, ensuring safe and swift delivery to your doorsteps.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Cooldown ends after 20 minutes; uses up one charge from a limited supply of three charges per day

grand_country_connectopia_crafting_rod.priceReason: The rod is valued at 1000 XP, reflecting the mana cost and its usefulness in transforming raw materials into durable tools.

grand_country_cursed_potion.name: The Laughing Sack
grand_country_cursed_potion.description: The Laughing Sack is a peculiar, leather pouch imbued with a curse that forces its bearer to giggle uncontrollably for ten minutes. The laughter is so intense it halves your movement speed and renders you vulnerable to nearby attacks. Crafted by the DK Crew, this potion also comes with a hidden danger: consume it within a dungeon, and though you gain temporary blindness, you paradoxically heal +10 hit points at the cost of your vision.

effectDetails.title: Uncontrollable Laughter
effectDetails.rules: You are incapacitated for 10 minutes, halving your movement speed and granting advantage on saving throws against fear. Any melee attack made within 5 feet of you has advantage. You cannot move or take reactions during this time.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Blindness
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the effect, you are blinded but heal +10 hit points at the start of your turn if you are in a dungeon. This effect ends immediately if you enter combat or leave the dungeon.

grand_country_cursed_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for lower-level characters to provide an amusing yet challenging experience.
grand_country_cursed_potion.vendorReason: Grand Country's vendors stock a variety of quirky and cursed items, appealing to adventurers seeking unique experiences.
grand_country_cursed_potion.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via special courier, ensuring the potion remains potent.

usage.activation: Drinking the potion as an action.
usage.duration: 10 minutes.
usage.endsWhen: You enter combat or leave a dungeon; you can drink it only once per long rest.

grand_country_cursed_potion.priceReason: The price reflects the potion's unique properties, its cursed nature, and the danger it presents to adventurers.

grand_country_doughnut_edge_tether.name: Doughnut Edge Tether
grand_country_doughnut_edge_tether.description: The Doughnut Edge Tether is a cursed anchor, forged from twisted dough and bound to the very edge of reality. It hums with latent chaos, its surface flecked with arcane runes that shimmer like fractured starlight. This artifact binds you to the nearest edge of existence when you are stunned, pulling you toward it with irresistible force. Each use grants a 10% increase in damage against Liminal Void entities and has a 20% chance to tear reality on your next attack.

effectDetails.title: Void Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: When this item is activated, you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls against entities from the Liminal Void. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Reality Tear Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance that your next attack deal significant additional damage and create a reality tear upon hitting an enemy from the Liminal Void. This effect only triggers once per combat.

grand_country_doughnut_edge_tether.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 6 to wield this cursed artifact, ensuring it is not overpowered for lower-level characters.
grand_country_doughnut_edge_tether.vendorReason: Grand Country vendors are known for their unique and powerful artifacts, making the Doughnut Edge Tether a fitting addition to their offerings.
grand_country_doughnut_edge_tether.shippingDetail: Ships via Goomba Ground Delivery, known for its reliable but eccentric couriers. Expect delivery within one week.

usage.activation: Activates as an action when you are stunned and pulled toward the nearest edge of reality.
usage.duration: Effect lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after a single use per session.

grand_country_doughnut_edge_tether.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's powerful abilities and its rarity as a cursed artifact.

grand_country_falling_hazard_tether.name: Falling Hazard Tether
grand_country_falling_hazard_tether.description: The Falling Hazard Tether is a sturdy rope crafted from the enchanted threads of the Mushroom Kingdom. It not only binds you to the edge but also grants you an unexpected advantage when airborne foes attack. When you attune to its gravity-defying weave, it reduces fall damage by half and offers a 10% chance for a surprise drop on your enemies. This tether is a Koopa Troop invention, designed specifically for those who dare to explore the unpredictable skies of the Mushroom Kingdom.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Fall Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you use this tether, any fall damage is reduced by 50%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn. You can't use this ability again for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Surprise Drop on Enemies
effectDetails.rules: At the beginning of each enemy's turn, there is a 10% chance that a surprise drop occurs from above you. This effect has no save or DC and can occur multiple times per encounter.

grand_country_falling_hazard_tether.levelRequirementReason: The tethers are designed for adventurers of all levels to experience the thrills of Mushroom Kingdom aerial combat.
grand_country_falling_hazard_tether.vendorReason: Grand Country is renowned for its exploration gear, and this tether is a must-have for anyone venturing into the skies over Toad Town.
grand_country_falling_hazard_tether.shippingDetail: Ships via Goomba Ground Delivery with standard delivery times. Ensure you have it attuned before your next flight.

usage.activation: Use as a bonus action when about to fall or encounter airborne foes.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and recharges at dawn.
usage.endsWhen: The tether is destroyed by damage, or you stop using it.

grand_country_falling_hazard_tether.priceReason: Balanced for its utility in aerial combat and exploration, this tether provides a valuable asset to any adventurer.

grand_country_gravity_bolt.name: Gravity Bolt
grand_country_gravity_bolt.description: The Gravity Bolt is a compact device that warps local gravity with a press of its button. In vertical terrain, it grants you a 30% bonus to your movement speed while causing 1d4 damage to any enemy caught in the ensuing inversion. It also activates a brief stasis field, immobilizing an ally within its radius for 10 seconds. Crafted by Lakitu Drones and only functional in The Grand Country's unique gravity fields.

effectDetails.title: Vertical Terrain Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated, you gain a +30 bonus to your movement speed while on vertical terrain. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and is limited to once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Damage
effectDetails.rules: Any creature within 10 feet that starts its turn under the effects of Gravity Bolt takes 1d4 force damage at the beginning of each of their turns. This effect ends when the device is deactivated or expended.

grand_country_gravity_bolt.levelRequirementReason: This item aids explorers in navigating The Grand Country's unique terrain without requiring a high-level character.
grand_country_gravity_bolt.vendorReason: Grand Country vendors sell this item to aid travelers and adventurers within their jurisdiction.
grand_country_gravity_bolt.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, known for their swift aerial delivery services in The Grand Country.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Deactivated or expended after one use

grand_country_gravity_bolt.priceReason: The Gravity Bolt's balanced price reflects its utility for navigation and combat in The Grand Country.

grand_country_gravity_tether.name: Gravity Tether
grand_country_gravity_tether.description: The Gravity Tether is a sleek, metallic device crafted by DK Crew, designed to tether your feet firmly to any vertical surface. This compact marvel enhances your agility on slopes and cliffs, granting you an additional 10% jump height when ascending. However, it also introduces a whimsical side effect: once every hour, there's a 5% chance that the tether will cause a temporary gravity stutter, making you briefly levitate before crashing back down with double your current weight pressing on you.

effectDetails.title: Vertical Leap Boost
effectDetails.rules: When used in vertical terrain, the Gravity Tether increases your jump height by 10%. This effect lasts until you land or use it again. No save required.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Stutter
effectDetails.rules: Once per hour, there is a 5% chance that using the Gravity Tether will cause a brief moment of levitation followed by a crash, dealing 1d6 force damage to you and pushing you back down with twice your current weight. No save.

grand_country_gravity_tether.levelRequirementReason: This device is designed for beginners and travelers who need the extra boost in vertical environments.
grand_country_gravity_tether.vendorReason: Grand Country's diverse landscapes make them a prime vendor for this gravity-enhancing gadget.
grand_country_gravity_tether.shippingDetail: Ships via Noki Coral Fleet with expedited delivery to any port city within a week.

usage.activation: As an action or bonus action
usage.duration: Instantaneous, per use
usage.endsWhen: You land on the ground or re-use it

grand_country_gravity_tether.priceReason: The Gravity Tether offers a balance of utility and whimsy, justifying its fair value.

grand_country_gym_battle_bolt.name: Gym Battle Bolt
grand_country_gym_battle_bolt.description: The Gym Battle Bolt is a sleek, metallic device worn by trainers during Pokémon gym battles. Crafted from iron infused with the essence of legendary gyms, it channels their power to amplify your trainer's abilities. When activated, it grants temporary immunity to status effects and increases attack power by 20% for the duration of any battle. The bolt also has a rare chance to trigger an evolution in Pokémon with hidden forms during gym battles.

effectDetails.title: Status Immunity
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Gym Battle Bolt grants temporary immunity to all status effects for the duration of a single gym battle. This effect ends if the trainer loses the battle or when the bolt runs out of charges.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Attack Power
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action at the start of any gym battle, increasing the user's attack power by 20% for the duration. This effect is exhausted after one use and recharges when the trainer completes their next gym challenge.

grand_country_gym_battle_bolt.levelRequirementReason: Beginner trainers can benefit from the Bolt’s amplifying properties without overburdening them with complex mechanics.
grand_country_gym_battle_bolt.vendorReason: Grand Country is known for its connection to Pokémon gyms and trainers, making it a natural vendor for such an item.
grand_country_gym_battle_bolt.shippingDetail: Shipped via Koopa Postal with expedited delivery within the region, ensuring timely arrival before battles.

usage.activation: Bonus Action at the start of any gym battle
usage.duration: Duration of a single battle
usage.endsWhen: Trainer loses the battle or when recharged after completing another challenge
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharging upon completion of each gym battle

grand_country_gym_battle_bolt.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's moderate abilities and its connection to an important in-game mechanic without overvaluing it.

grand_country_item_name_here.name: Delfino Bridge Key
grand_country_item_name_here.description: The Delfino Bridge Key is a shimmering onyx artifact adorned with the symbol of the Onyx Hand. Crafted from the very essence of Delfino Village, it opens a hidden path between worlds for an hour, granting temporary access to the mystical realm. Upon activation, travelers experience a brief teleportation delay as they pass through the dimensional rift. This key is a relic of ancient craftsmanship, forged by the Onyx Hand to maintain the delicate balance between dimensions.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Passage
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the user opens a rift in space-time to allow passage through the Delfino Bridge for one hour. This effect has a cooldown of 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Teleportation Delay
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, all travelers passing through the bridge experience a 10-second delay as they traverse the dimensional rift. The effect is instantaneous and does not require an action to activate.

grand_country_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: This key requires mastery of complex spatial magic, making it suitable for players at least 8th level.
grand_country_item_name_here.vendorReason: The grand country is renowned for its ties to the mystical realms and thus holds this relic with great reverence.
grand_country_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Ships via Paratroopa Air Express, known for its reliable service and quick delivery.

usage.duration: One hour
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the time expires or the key is destroyed

grand_country_item_name_here.priceReason: This item's balanced price reflects its rarity and the utility it provides in opening a critical passage between worlds.

grand_country_minus_world_map_fragment.name: Minus World Map Fragment
grand_country_minus_world_map_fragment.description: The Minus World Map Fragment, a relic of a realm that never returned, is etched with arcane symbols and glowing with ethereal light from the Grand Country. Crafted by Mr. Wario himself after the cataclysmic Minus World Incident, it reveals hidden paths through The Grand Country and grants a 50% chance to uncover lost faction members. However, using this fragment leaves the user feeling dizzy for 30 minutes, impairing their senses until the effects subside.
effects: Grants Chance to Find Lost Faction Members

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on perception checks and can see through illusions in The Grand Country for a duration of 1 hour. This effect is triggered upon use.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Find Lost Faction Members
effectDetails.rules: The user has a 50% chance to locate a lost faction member within the next 24 hours after using this fragment. This effect lasts until used, but only usable once per lifetime.

grand_country_minus_world_map_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Even beginners can harness the power of this relic to aid their journey through The Grand Country.
grand_country_minus_world_map_fragment.vendorReason: The grand country's lore and geography are deeply intertwined with the Minus World Map Fragment, making it a natural fit for their inventory.
grand_country_minus_world_map_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of darkness to ensure safe delivery through The Grand Country’s treacherous terrain.

usage.activation: Used as an action at the start of your turn.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until used up, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: The user's senses are impaired by dizziness for 30 minutes after use.

grand_country_minus_world_map_fragment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and the limited lifetime usage, making it a valuable tool without being overpowered.

grand_country_mystic_tinker_tool.name: The Forge of Forgotten Schemes
grand_country_mystic_tinker_tool.description: The Forge of Forgotten Schemes is a tinkerer's dream—a gleaming brass contraption with intricate gears and glowing runes. Crafted by DK Crew, this device allows you to manipulate terrain with precision, creating safe zones or deadly traps in an instant. When activated, it emits a blinding flash of sparks that can cause nearby enemies to misfire or stumble into your carefully designed hazards. A true testament to the Grand Country's frontier expansion tech.

effectDetails.title: Terrain Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, creating a safe zone or trap within 30 feet. The effect lasts for 1 minute per use and can only be used once every 8 hours. Requires an attunement by a tinkerer or engineer.

effectDetails.title: Glitch Trigger
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance (DC 14 Dexterity saving throw) that nearby enemies will misfire or trip into your traps for 1d6 + Engineer proficiency bonus damage. The glitch effect ends if the user is incapacitated.

grand_country_mystic_tinker_tool.levelRequirementReason: Requires a high level of skill to properly attune and operate this complex device.
grand_country_mystic_tinker_tool.vendorReason: The Grand Country's frontier expansion tech is renowned for its innovative tools, making The Forge of Forgotten Schemes an essential item for tinkerers there.
grand_country_mystic_tinker_tool.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Noki Coral Fleet with a 2-day transit time from Connectopia.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, using attunement once per day.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use, ending if you are incapacitated or the device is destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or destruction of the device.

grand_country_mystic_tinker_tool.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item reflects its legendary rarity and complex attunement requirements.

grand_country_oracle_vessel_fragment.name: Oracle Vessel Fragment
grand_country_oracle_vessel_fragment.description: A shard from the necromantic research vessel built by the Oracle, this fragment glows faintly with ancient power. Crafted from enchanted obsidian and imbued with the will of the Oracle, it crackles with latent energy when held. It is said that using this fragment in conjunction with a Pianta artifact reveals hidden lore that even the oldest scholars have forgotten. Fused to an item, it amplifies necromantic spells, reducing spellcasting time by 2 seconds per use and inflicting 1d4 necrotic damage on all enemies within 5 feet.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Amplifier
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Reduces spellcasting time by 2 seconds per use for the caster. This effect lasts until the end of the caster’s next turn.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Aura
effectDetails.rules: Inflicts 1d4 necrotic damage on all enemies within a 5-foot radius at the start of each of your turns while attuned to this fragment. This effect ends when you stop being attuned or if you take any action other than moving.

grand_country_oracle_vessel_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 8 to harness and control the fragment's power effectively.
grand_country_oracle_vessel_fragment.vendorReason: As part of their extensive library and artifact collection, Grand Country can provide this rare fragment for scholarly and arcane pursuits.
grand_country_oracle_vessel_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Grand Library within a week.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn or until you take an action other than moving
usage.endsWhen: You stop being attuned to this fragment or take any action other than moving

grand_country_oracle_vessel_fragment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the fragment's rarity and its limited availability.

grand_country_seal_fragment.name: Primordial Seal Shard
grand_country_seal_fragment.description: The Primordial Seal Shard is a jagged, obsidian fragment from the shattered seal beneath the Valley of Bowser. Its surface glows faintly with ancient magic, and when wielded near high-altitude zones, it causes subtle tremors that rattle the very air around you. This relic must be attuned to by a spellcaster to unleash its full potential; only then can it restore one seal fragment in ritual and grant temporary resistance against gravity effects.

effectDetails.title: Restore Seal Fragment
effectDetails.rules: When used during a ritual, the Primordial Seal Shard restores one seal fragment. This effect requires attunement by a spellcaster and is instantaneous.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Gravity Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute while wielded near high-altitude zones, the Primordial Seal Shard grants the wielder 2d4 temporary points of resistance against gravity effects. This effect ends if the shard is removed from a high-altitude zone.

grand_country_seal_fragment.levelRequirementReason: The Primordial Seal Shard requires attunement by a spellcaster, which typically necessitates at least level 7 to effectively use.
grand_country_seal_fragment.vendorReason: Grand Country, being the steward of ancient relics and magic items, possesses this shard due to its historical significance in their lore.
grand_country_seal_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Postal with a delay of three days, ensuring safe delivery to the spellcaster's doorstep.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use during ritual; passive effect when near high-altitude zones
usage.duration: 1 minute for gravity resistance
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends if shard is removed from a high-altitude zone or upon death of the wielder

grand_country_seal_fragment.priceReason: The Primordial Seal Shard's price reflects its rarity and historical significance, as well as the value of attunement.

grand_country_soul_tether.name: Soul Tether
grand_country_soul_tether.description: The Soul Tether is a delicate, iridescent pendant crafted from the enchanted essence of Beanbean Kingdom's royal oak. It weaves an unbreakable telepathic bond between its bearer and the kingdom, allowing for instant communication with any emissary. Its pulsating gemstone glows faintly, reducing all incoming damage by 20% while simultaneously reflecting harm back to attackers in the form of psychic energy, dealing 1d4 points of psychic damage on each strike. This artifact is a symbol of trust and power, requiring a Beanbean coin to activate it within the kingdom's borders.

effectDetails.title: Telepathic Bond
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. The bearer can communicate with any emissary of Beanbean Kingdom instantaneously, even across long distances. This effect is limited to one use per day.

effectDetails.title: Damage Reduction and Psychic Reflection
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect while within Beanbean Kingdom. Reduces all damage taken by 20%. When an enemy attacks the wearer, they suffer 1d4 points of psychic damage as a reaction. This effect has no save DC but is limited to three uses per day.

grand_country_soul_tether.levelRequirementReason: Sufficiently advanced for a capable adventurer who can navigate the kingdom's complex telepathic systems.
grand_country_soul_tether.vendorReason: The grand country is the heart of Beanbean Kingdom, and thus sells artifacts with deep ties to its royal lineage.
grand_country_soul_tether.shippingDetail: Ships within a day via Lakitu Drone express service.

usage.activation: Activates as an action by touching the pendant and speaking the activation phrase, 'Soul Tether, connect.'
usage.duration: Instantaneous for telepathic communication. Passive effect while within Beanbean Kingdom.
usage.endsWhen: Used up to its daily limit or when removed from Beanbean Kingdom.

grand_country_soul_tether.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price point due to the item's limited duration and effect range.

grand_country_team_rocket_key.name: Team Rocket Keychain
grand_country_team_rocket_key.description: The Team Rocket Keychain is a gleaming metal trinket engraved with the iconic Team Rocket symbol. Crafted from rare magnetic alloy and infused with the remnants of a legendary Pokémon’s evolution stone, it grants access to their hidden lair in the Grand Country's upper strata. Activating it triggers a 5% chance for a rogue Pokémon to appear during battle, adding an unpredictable element to encounters. The keychain also subtly alters your aura, making you more likely to attract unwanted attention from the Ranger Union.
effects: Access to Team Rocket’s Hidden Lair

effectDetails.title: Access to Team Rocket’s Hidden Lair
effectDetails.rules: Activating this keychain allows you to access a hidden lair in the Grand Country's upper strata. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any save or action.

effectDetails.title: Rogue Pokémon Summoning
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance that during battle, a rogue Pokémon will appear. This effect is random and occurs once per day. It has no saving throw or DC required.

grand_country_team_rocket_key.levelRequirementReason: The keychain requires a high level to wield due to its connection with Team Rocket’s secretive operations.
grand_country_team_rocket_key.vendorReason: Grand Country is known for dealing in rare and exotic items, including those of the shadowy Team Rocket organization.
grand_country_team_rocket_key.shippingDetail: Ships within a week from the Grand Country’s postal hub. Delivery may be delayed due to the nature of Team Rocket’s activities.

usage.duration: Permanent until used
usage.endsWhen: Used once per day, recharges at dawn on the next day

grand_country_team_rocket_key.priceReason: The keychain’s balanced XP price reflects its connection to Team Rocket and its limited daily use.

grand_country_tomb_keychain.name: Tomb Keychain
grand_country_tomb_keychain.description: The Tomb Keychain, a relic forged from cursed tombstone material, is a small, intricately carved keychain that whispers secrets of the dead into your ear when activated. It grants a 10% chance to bypass traps on the side of a cliff and attracts unwanted attention from Rakasha clans when worn near their hideouts. This artifact can be used as a distraction during heists and opens hidden passages in the Grand Country’s vertical terrain, making it invaluable for explorers and treasure hunters.

effectDetails.title: Bypass Trap
effectDetails.rules: When worn near a cliffside, the Tomb Keychain grants you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to bypass traps for 1 minute. This effect ends if you are no longer within 30 feet of the cliff or if you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Attract Attention
effectDetails.rules: When worn near a Rakasha clan hideout, you and your allies become the target of their attention for 1 hour. You have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks within 50 feet of any Rakasha until this effect ends.

grand_country_tomb_keychain.levelRequirementReason: This keychain is designed to help novices navigate treacherous traps and attract unwanted attention, making it accessible for those just starting their adventures.
grand_country_tomb_keychain.vendorReason: The Grand Country's vendors are known for selling relics from ancient tombs, and the Tomb Keychain fits perfectly with their offerings.
grand_country_tomb_keychain.shippingDetail: Due to its cursed nature, this item requires special handling. It is shipped via Koopa Postal’s express courier service for an additional cost of 50 XP.

usage.activation: Reaction (Must be within range and not already in the effect's duration)
usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage
usage.endsWhen: You are no longer near a cliffside or Rakasha hideout, or if you take damage

grand_country_tomb_keychain.priceReason: The price reflects the item’s cursed materials and unique abilities that make it both dangerous and invaluable.

grand_country_waluigi_talisman.name: Waluigi Talisman of Unwritten Law
grand_country_waluigi_talisman.description: The Waluigi Talisman of Unwritten Law is a twisted medallion forged from cursed gold, adorned with chaotic runes that shimmer with an eerie glow. It grants its wearer immunity to gravity-defiance penalties in The Grand Country but exacts a price: it attracts cultists who believe in Waluigi's chaotic nature and may cause the wearer to lose sanity if used outside a chaotic environment. Wielded by those daring enough to challenge gravity, this talisman is a relic of chaos and defiance.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Defiance Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to all penalties related to defying gravity in The Grand Country. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Cultist Attraction
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the talisman attracts a number of cultists equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier within 50 feet who worship Waluigi as their deity. The effect lasts for 1 minute and ends if you move more than 30 feet away from the center point.

grand_country_waluigi_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The talisman's chaotic nature requires a certain level of resolve to wield effectively.
grand_country_waluigi_talisman.vendorReason: Grand Country is known for its unique artifacts and this item is a hallmark of their market.
grand_country_waluigi_talisman.shippingDetail: The talisman must be shipped in a custom, enchanted box to prevent any chaotic runes from affecting the delivery personnel.

usage.duration: Permanent until attuned or removed.
usage.endsWhen: Requires attunement by a cultist or rogue with black market connections. Ends if used in non-chaotic environments for more than an hour.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but ends on the above conditions.

grand_country_waluigi_talisman.priceReason: The talisman's rarity and chaotic nature justify a high price, offering unique benefits in The Grand Country.

grand_star.name: Grand Star
grand_star.description: The Grand Star is a colossal stellar entity, its surface burning with an infernal glow that illuminates entire systems. Its gravitational pull bends light and space around it, and those who gaze upon it are entranced by its magnetic allure. The ancient observatories of the cosmos crafted this wonder to harness its power, but only at great peril. Those who wield it gain unparalleled strength, flight, and invulnerability—though their presence cannot be hidden from prying eyes or stealthy foes.

effectDetails.title: Mighty Glow
effectDetails.rules: The Grand Star emits a blinding light that fills the area in bright starlight, rendering stealth impossible within its radius. Creatures within the affected area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Galactic Flight
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the Grand Star's gravitational pull to enable flight at a speed of 100 feet. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round). The star recharges after a long rest.

grand_star.levelRequirementReason: Only those with the strength and discipline of a godly entity can harness the raw power of the Grand Star.
grand_star.vendorReason: The comet observatories have long been guardians of cosmic wonders like the Grand Star, ensuring they are used responsibly.
grand_star.shippingDetail: Delivered by Supernova Express, with a special delivery delay to ensure the safety of those receiving this cosmic marvel.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, lasts for rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are incapacitated or the star recharges after a long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, charges recharge after a long rest

grand_star.priceReason: While not as powerful as some godly artifacts, the Grand Star's unique and dangerous nature justifies its relatively high price.

grand_star_core.name: Grand Star Core
grand_star_core.description: The Grand Star Core is a gleaming, crystalline artifact, the heart of Rosalina's solar system. Its surface pulses with an ethereal light, drawing in stray cosmic particles and converting them into boundless energy. This core allows for instantaneous space travel within the faction’s territories and powers immense planetary shields capable of deflecting any incoming threat. The comet observatory guards it jealously, as its loss would spell doom for all.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Space Travel
effectDetails.rules: The Grand Star Core allows a faction member to instantly travel between any two points within the faction’s territories. This effect is used as an action and requires clear skies or a cloudless environment for optimal function.

effectDetails.title: Planetary Shields
effectDetails.rules: Activates planetary shields that can deflect all incoming physical attacks. This activation consumes 1 charge from the core, which recharges after 24 hours of inactivity. The shield has a +50 defense bonus and lasts for 1 hour.

grand_star_core.levelRequirementReason: Requires characters to be at least level 6 to handle the core’s immense power safely.
grand_star_core.vendorReason: The comet observatory is the caretaker and guardian of the Grand Star Core, responsible for its safekeeping and usage within the faction.
grand_star_core.shippingDetail: Ships via Swift Comet Express, known for its reliability and speed. Delivery time is approximately 12 hours.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (space travel), 1 hour (shield)
usage.endsWhen: Charges are exhausted or the core is damaged beyond repair

grand_star_core.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its utility and rarity in the faction.

grand_theft_auto_car.name: Custom Car
grand_theft_auto_car.description: The Custom Car, a sleek and powerful automobile forged in the heart of Wario's Garage, is a marvel of speed and engineering. Its chassis is reinforced with titanium alloy, making it impervious to minor collisions. Engineered specifically for quick getaways, it can carry four passengers effortlessly and boasts a ramming attack that deals 4d10 bludgeoning damage. The car's faction bonus allows the driver to escape virtually any tight spot without assistance.

effectDetails.title: Speed
effectDetails.rules: The Custom Car has a base speed of 100 feet and can carry four passengers. It grants the driver advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to escape or flee from any situation.

effectDetails.title: Ram Attack
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the driver can attempt to ram an opponent within reach with the car. This attack deals 4d10 bludgeoning damage and requires a successful Strength (Athletics) check against the target's AC. The car can only be used for one ramming attack per long rest.

grand_theft_auto_car.levelRequirementReason: The Custom Car is designed to be accessible to low-level characters, serving as a reliable getaway vehicle.
grand_theft_auto_car.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in high-performance vehicles and equipment, making the Custom Car an obvious addition to their inventory.
grand_theft_auto_car.shippingDetail: The car is delivered by Garage Delivery, a service known for its efficiency and reliability.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (ramming attack)
usage.endsWhen: After the ramming attack or when the vehicle is destroyed

grand_theft_auto_car.priceReason: The Custom Car, while not as powerful as its legendary counterparts, offers a significant boost to mobility and combat effectiveness at a fair price.

gravity_manipulator_belt.name: Gravity Manipulator Belt (Utility)
gravity_manipulator_belt.description: The Gravity Manipulator Belt, a sleek contraption of GravTech's engineering prowess, allows its wearer to defy gravity in two distinct ways: by boosting their jump height tenfold or activating zero-gravity mode for precise aerial maneuvers. The belt is crafted from lightweight alloy and features a pulsing gravitic core that powers it through 2 hours of continuous use. A true marvel of modern magic, this item was designed to enhance the mobility and combat effectiveness of seasoned adventurers.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Jump
effectDetails.rules: The user can increase their jump height by tenfold, allowing for impressive aerial acrobatics and greater reach. This effect lasts until the user deactivates it or exhausts its charge.

effectDetails.title: Zero-Gravity Mode
effectDetails.rules: Activating this mode grants the user complete control over their movement in a zero-gravity environment, allowing for precise aerial maneuvers and complex acrobatics. The user must remain within a 10-foot radius of the belt's activation point to benefit fully from this effect.

gravity_manipulator_belt.levelRequirementReason: This advanced utility item requires significant skill and experience to master its gravity-defying capabilities.
gravity_manipulator_belt.vendorReason: Zero G Shop specializes in the most cutting-edge equipment for space explorers and high-flying adventurers, making this belt a natural addition to their inventory.
gravity_manipulator_belt.shippingDetail: Ships via Orbital Belt Express within two days of purchase, delivered directly to your planet-side hangar.

usage.duration: 10 minutes per activation
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the user deactivates it or exhausts its charge

gravity_manipulator_belt.priceReason: This item's advanced technology and rarity justify a price of 50,000 XP.

gravity_pipette.name: Gravity Pipette
gravity_pipette.description: The Gravity Pipette is a delicate glass dropper with intricate engravings. Crafted by alchemists in the heart of the city, it can manipulate gravity over small areas and protect its bearer from fall damage. When used on an object within a 5-foot cube, it causes everything to fall ten times slower for one minute, perfect for stabilizing precarious structures or slowing down a plummeting crate. Used on yourself, you ignore all falling damage for the next hour; just be wary of its fragile nature and how easily it could break during rough handling.

effectDetails.title: Gravitation Stabilizer
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action within range. Choose a 5-foot cube in line of sight. For the next minute, all objects and creatures in that area fall ten times slower than normal.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Shield
effectDetails.rules: Activate once per long rest by drinking the contents. You gain immunity to falling damage for one hour. This effect ends when you take any falling damage or at the start of your next short rest.

gravity_pipette.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners who need a reliable tool without overpowered effects.
gravity_pipette.vendorReason: The alchemists are known for creating practical tools that aid adventurers in their daily challenges.
gravity_pipette.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days of purchase, ensuring it arrives safely and intact.

usage.activation: Bonus action or drinking the pipette's contents (for Gravity Shield)
usage.duration: 1 minute for Gravitation Stabilizer; 1 hour for Gravity Shield
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next short rest, or if you take falling damage.

gravity_pipette.priceReason: This price reflects its delicate craftsmanship and utility without being an overpowered item.

gray_paint_of_moral_ambiguity.name: Gray Paint of Moral Ambiguity
gray_paint_of_moral_ambiguity.description: The Gray Paint of Moral Ambiguity is a mysterious substance that defies categorization, smearing into a malleable gray hue when applied to skin or armor. Rolled from the hands of the enigmatic Gray Area Paint Co., this paint shifts perceptions, making you indiscernible to alignment detection spells and granting advantage on saves against lawful effects while imposing disadvantage on those for chaotic ones. Your very essence becomes a moving target, forcing your allies to reconsider their strategies at every turn.

effectDetails.title: Gray Shift: Alignment Detection Failure
effectDetails.rules: When worn or applied as a shield, you gain resistance to all alignment-based attacks and effects. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after activation. You are considered neither lawful nor chaotic for the purposes of spell and ability checks.

effectDetails.title: Ambiguous Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on saving throws against lawful effects but disadvantage on those against chaotic effects. This persists for 1 minute or until you take a short rest, whichever comes first. Once used per day.

gray_paint_of_moral_ambiguity.levelRequirementReason: This paint is suitable for all adventurers, providing a versatile tool to navigate the complex social and magical environments.
gray_paint_of_moral_ambiguity.vendorReason: Void Drifters Paint specializes in paints that blur lines between reality and illusion, making this item an excellent fit for their catalog.
gray_paint_of_moral_ambiguity.shippingDetail: Ships via the Neutral Courier with a standard delivery time of 3 days.

usage.activation: Action (applied as a shield or worn)
usage.duration: 1 minute, or until you take a short rest
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn after activation for Gray Shift; ends when the duration expires for Ambiguous Advantage

gray_paint_of_moral_ambiguity.priceReason: This paint offers significant strategic advantages in combat and social situations, making it a valuable but not overpowered purchase.

green_paint_of_envious_imitation.name: Green Paint of Envious Imitation
green_paint_of_envious_imitation.description: The Green Paint of Envious Imitation is a vibrant, emerald-hued pot made by the mischievous Envious Imps Paint Co., whose logo features a sly imp grinning at its reflection in a mirror. This paint not only allows you to blend seamlessly with your surroundings but also casts an illusion that makes you feel envious of whatever surface it perfectly mimics, leading to moments where you're distracted by the stability and charm of that very thing. The scent is unmistakably fresh-cut grass, drawing curious herbivores nearby.

effectDetails.title: Blend In
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to apply the paint to yourself and match your appearance with one surface perfectly for up to 1 hour. During this time, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in environments similar to that surface. The effect is exhausted after use.

effectDetails.title: Envy Trigger
effectDetails.rules: For the next 24 hours, you are distracted by whatever surface you used the paint to match. You have disadvantage on saving throws against charm effects and other forms of persuasion until this period ends.

green_paint_of_envious_imitation.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for players who want a bit more than just basic camouflage, but not requiring any specific level to use its unique enchantments.
green_paint_of_envious_imitation.vendorReason: The Greenskins Paint Department is known for their whimsical yet effective paints, and this particular product has proven popular among adventurers seeking both practical and magical solutions.
green_paint_of_envious_imitation.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Paint Tube Express mail service, the paint arrives in its original pot without any damage or leakage.

usage.duration: Up to 1 hour per day
usage.endsWhen: After use and after 24 hours of being distracted by envy
usage.charges: Unlimited, but you can only apply it once a day

green_paint_of_envious_imitation.priceReason: The balance price reflects the unique combination of camouflage and charm resistance effects, making it a valuable yet not overpowered item.

greenskin_waaagh_banner.name: Greenskin WAAAGH! Banner
greenskin_waaagh_banner.description: The Greenskin WAAAGH! Banner is a tattered but potent standard that crackles with the primal energy of the battlefield. Its hum is like the rumbling of distant thunder, and those who stand beneath it feel their blood boil in fierce readiness. Allies within 30 feet are imbued with an unshakable will to fight, while the banner itself seems to call out to nearby Greenskins, drawing them closer whether they're welcome or not.

effectDetails.title: Battle Frenzy
effectDetails.rules: While the banner is planted, all allies within 30 feet gain advantage on melee attack rolls. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Greenskin Attraction
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can activate the banner to attract nearby Greenskins. If successful, one unaligned Greenskin within 1 mile is drawn to the banner and becomes an ally until it either leaves your immediate vicinity or dies.

greenskin_waaagh_banner.levelRequirementReason: Only seasoned warriors with experience in battle can wield such a volatile artifact.
greenskin_waaagh_banner.vendorReason: The Greenskin WAAAGH! Banner is the pride of their faction and only sold by its creators.
greenskin_waaagh_banner.shippingDetail: Shipped in a massive, armored battlewagon to ensure safe delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The banner is removed or destroyed

greenskin_waaagh_banner.priceReason: Balanced at a cost that reflects its potent battlefield utility without overshadowing other items.

greenskin_war_banner.name: Greenskin War Banner (Waaagh Boost)
greenskin_war_banner.description: The Greenskin War Banner, a tattered but potent symbol of Waaagh! pride, crackles with the raw energy of unrefined magic. Crafted by the greenskins themselves from ancient wood imbued with the spirits of fallen kin, it bestows a +1 morale bonus to all allies within 60 feet when carried in battle. Legend has it that the banner's power can turn even the most reluctant warriors into berserkers capable of felling armies.

effectDetails.title: Waaagh Boost
effectDetails.rules: Allied greenskin and goblinoid creatures gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls while within 60 feet of the banner. This effect is active as long as the banner is carried in combat by a creature with Strength of at least 10.

effectDetails.title: Morale Aura
effectDetails.rules: All allies within 60 feet receive a +2 bonus to saving throws against fear and panic effects for the duration. This effect expires when the banner is not being carried in combat or if a creature within the range fails a saving throw.

greenskin_war_banner.levelRequirementReason: The banner's magic is potent but not overwhelming, suitable for even the most novice warriors who can wield its power effectively.
greenskin_war_banner.vendorReason: As a Greenskin Warboss, it is only fitting that they sell this symbol of their might and terror to their allies and enemies alike.
greenskin_war_banner.shippingDetail: The banner is shipped rolled up in a sturdy wooden tube with padding to ensure safe delivery. Expect a few days for the delivery due to its cumbersome nature.

usage.activation: Passive effect when carried by a creature meeting the Strength requirement.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; expires if not being carried or if an ally fails a saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: The banner is no longer being carried in combat or an allied creature within 60 feet fails a saving throw.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges when the banner is not used for three days.

greenskin_war_banner.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its potent but not overpowered effect and the greenskins' craftsmanship.

greenskins_choppa_cleaver.name: Greenskins Choppa Cleaver
greenskins_choppa_cleaver.description: The Greenskins Choppa Cleaver is a formidable cleaver forged by the Greenskins, known for its unmatched sharpness and durability. This cleaver grants you an advantage on cooking checks involving chopping vegetables, meat, or bones; it's so precise that even missteps result in a small cut (1d2 slashing damage). When used as a weapon, it delivers 1d6 slashing damage but risks getting stuck in your foe—remove it with a bonus action. Legend has it that the cleaver is always sharp, ensuring you never cut yourself accidentally when retrieving it from its bag.

effectDetails.title: Cooking Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on checks to chop ingredients for cooking. Additionally, you take 1d2 slashing damage if you accidentally cut yourself while retrieving the cleaver from its bag.

effectDetails.title: Weapon Stuck
effectDetails.rules: When used as a weapon, the Greenskins Choppa Cleaver deals 1d6 slashing damage but has a tendency to get stuck in your target. To remove it, you must use a bonus action on your next turn.

greenskins_choppa_cleaver.levelRequirementReason: This cleaver is designed for beginners and adventurers who are still learning their skills.
greenskins_choppa_cleaver.vendorReason: The Greenskins Choppa Makers have a long-standing reputation for crafting tools that serve multiple purposes, from cooking to combat.
greenskins_choppa_cleaver.shippingDetail: Delivered with great enthusiasm by the Choppa Delivery team; expect a cheerful delivery note included in your package.

usage.activation: Bonus action to remove when stuck as a weapon.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on checks and damage.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day.

greenskins_choppa_cleaver.priceReason: The cleaver's balanced price reflects its dual functionality in combat and cooking without being overpowered.

greenskins_green_skin_care.name: Greenskins Green Skin Care
greenskins_green_skin_care.description: Greenskins Green Skin Care is a potion that transforms your skin into vibrant emerald hues, granting you an advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with fellow orcs. However, your interactions with non-orcs take a turn for the worse; you must endure disadvantageous rolls as they recoil in disgust at this unnatural greenness. The scent of algae clings to you, hampering your Stealth attempts, but the formula is crafted by Greenskins Cosmetology, ensuring it remains a popular choice among orcish clientele.
effects: Advantage on Charisma checks with orcs
Disadvantage on Charisma checks with non-orcs due to appearance

effectDetails.title: Charisma with Orcs
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides advantage on all Charisma-based checks when interacting with orcs. It lasts for the duration of an hour after drinking the potion.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage with Non-Orcs
effectDetails.rules: You must endure disadvantageous rolls on all Charisma-based checks when dealing with non-orcs due to their perception of you as looking ill or repulsive. This effect persists for an hour after consumption.

greenskins_green_skin_care.levelRequirementReason: This potion is suitable for adventurers of any level but requires a minimum proficiency in Charisma-based skills.
greenskins_green_skin_care.vendorReason: Greenskins Cosmetology specializes in products that cater to the unique needs and aesthetics of orcish society, making this potion one of their bestsellers.
greenskins_green_skin_care.shippingDetail: Ships via Green Paint Express within a week. Delivery time may vary based on orcish postal schedules.

usage.duration: One hour per use
usage.endsWhen: After one hour or when the effect is negated by an opposing action

greenskins_green_skin_care.priceReason: The potion's balanced price reflects its effectiveness, rarity, and utility in orcish social situations.

greenskins_orcish_grill_spit.name: Greenskins Orcish Grill Spit
greenskins_orcish_grill_spit.description: This rugged spit is forged from Greenskin iron and designed for use over campfires. Its sturdy frame withstands the abuse of a horde, ensuring that even rough cooking turns out edible. The spit's rusted surface subtly enhances the flavor, adding a layer of earthy richness to every meal. Made by the skilled hands of Orc Forges, it is perfect for those who need reliable equipment in the most unforgiving conditions.

effectDetails.title: Rust-Enhanced Flavor
effectDetails.rules: The spit adds a subtle layer of earthy flavor to cooked meals. This effect is always active while in use and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Survives Harsh Conditions
effectDetails.rules: This spit has advantage on saving throws against damage from harsh environments, such as storms or fires. It can only be destroyed by a direct hit from a destructive spell or a deliberate act of sabotage.

greenskins_orcish_grill_spit.levelRequirementReason: Requires minimal strength and skill to use effectively.
greenskins_orcish_grill_spit.vendorReason: Greenskin camps often need reliable equipment for their communal meals.
greenskins_orcish_grill_spit.shippingDetail: Ships via the fastest available transport, ensuring timely delivery to eager cooks.

usage.activation: Use as a normal weapon or cooking tool.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; recharges after a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by damage from spells or sabotage.

greenskins_orcish_grill_spit.priceReason: Balanced price for a practical, durable tool with minor flavor benefits.

greenskins_orcish_loincloth.name: Greenskins Orcish Loincloth
greenskins_orcish_loincloth.description: The Greenskins Orcish Loincloth, a minimalist garment of rough leather and frayed fabric, is tailored by the brutish artisans of the Greenskin tribes in the heart of their encampments. Worn with pride despite its discomfort during long marches, this loincloth grants the wearer a +1 bonus to Strength checks when performing athletic feats in hot climates. It also instills fear into civilized folk, granting a +2 bonus on Intimidation checks against them. However, prolonged exertion takes its toll; the loincloth's chafing nature imposes disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made during extended marches.

effectDetails.title: Brutish Bravado
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Greenskins Orcish Loincloth, you gain a +1 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks in hot climates. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Civilized Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with civilized folk, you have advantage on Intimidation checks and gain a +2 bonus to the check. This effect is temporary and resets after 10 minutes without successfully using it against another target.

greenskins_orcish_loincloth.levelRequirementReason: The loincloth's design, though practical for Greenskin warriors, requires no particular level of expertise to wear.
greenskins_orcish_loincloth.vendorReason: Greenskins Camp is the primary trading post for all things made or traded by the Greenskin tribes, including their unique and practical clothing items.
greenskins_orcish_loincloth.shippingDetail: The loincloth is carefully packed to prevent damage during transport, ensuring it arrives in its original condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing the garment.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest for Brutish Bravado; resets after 10 minutes without successful use for Civilized Intimidation.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire as described above, and the loincloth can be worn again when ready.

greenskins_orcish_loincloth.priceReason: The loincloth is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its practical utility, unique cultural significance, and the effort required in its handmade production.

greenskins_recipe_goblin_gumbo.name: Recipe: Greenskins Goblin Gumbo
greenskins_recipe_goblin_gumbo.description: This parchment bears the scribbled recipe for Greenskins Goblin Gumbo, a dish known to heighten the cook's reflexes and cunning. Made with real goblins (optional), it grants the chef a +1 bonus on Dexterity saving throws for one hour, as well as the ability to understand and speak Goblin for that time. The scent of exotic spices lingers even when not in use, hinting at its origins from the bustling markets of Goblintown.

effectDetails.title: Goblin's Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this recipe, you gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Speak Goblin
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after activation, you can understand and speak the Goblin language. You are considered proficient in it for the duration.

greenskins_recipe_goblin_gumbo.levelRequirementReason: Any character with basic cooking skills can benefit from this recipe.
greenskins_recipe_goblin_gumbo.vendorReason: Greenskins Survival Cooking is renowned for their unique and exotic recipes, including this one.
greenskins_recipe_goblin_gumbo.shippingDetail: The delivery is swift but requires a small risk of misplacement due to the chaotic nature of Goblintown.

usage.duration: 1 hour per activation
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you take damaging action in combat
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have raw goblin ingredients

greenskins_recipe_goblin_gumbo.priceReason: The exotic nature of the recipe and its unique effects justify a moderate price.

greenskins_recipe_waaagh_fuel_chili.name: Recipe: Greenskins WAAAGH! Fuel Chili
greenskins_recipe_waaagh_fuel_chili.description: This parchment recipe is a fiery legacy from a Greenskin cook who survived a WAAAGH! Its chili, when cooked and consumed, grants you an extra burst of speed and ferociousness. For one hour, your steps are swift as you dance through battle with +10 feet to movement and advantage on attack rolls. Yet, after the fiery rush fades, you're left in a state of intestinal turmoil, giving disadvantage on Stealth checks. Only the most resilient can stomach this concoction.

effectDetails.title: WAAAGH! Fuel
effectDetails.rules: Consume the chili to gain +10 feet of movement and advantage on attack rolls for one hour. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Intestinal Turmoil
effectDetails.rules: After the WAAAGH! Fuel effect, suffer disadvantage on Stealth checks until your next long rest due to lingering effects of the chili.

greenskins_recipe_waaagh_fuel_chili.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for any adventurer to try and doesn't require high-level expertise.
greenskins_recipe_waaagh_fuel_chili.vendorReason: Greenskin Battle Cooks are known for their fiery concoctions that can fuel even the most war-weary warriors.
greenskins_recipe_waaagh_fuel_chili.shippingDetail: The recipe is shipped in a sealed container to ensure it remains potent until consumption.

usage.activation: Consume the chili by cooking and eating it.
usage.duration: One hour from ingestion.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or if you are incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have the recipe.

greenskins_recipe_waaagh_fuel_chili.priceReason: The recipe is moderately priced due to its unique and flavorful effects that can enhance combat effectiveness temporarily.

greenskins_waaagh_drum_premium.name: Greenskins Waaagh! Drum (Premium)
greenskins_waaagh_drum_premium.description: The Greenskins Waaagh! Drum (Premium) is a massive, painted drum crafted by Ork Warbosses. It resonates with the raw energy of a battlefield, and its deep, thunderous beats can rally even the most weary warriors. When beaten, it channels the orkish spirit to bolster allies within 30 feet, granting them a +1d4 bonus to attack rolls for one minute. The drum's sound is so powerful that it must be accompanied by a battle cry of 'Waaagh!'; failing to do so renders the effect inert.

effectDetails.title: Battle Cry
effectDetails.rules: Require that you shout 'Waaagh!' for the drum's effects to activate. Failure to do so renders the effect inert.

effectDetails.title: Rallying Beat
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, beat the drum within 30 feet of allies to grant them a +1d4 bonus to attack rolls for one minute. The duration ends early if you or an ally nearby takes damage.

greenskins_waaagh_drum_premium.levelRequirementReason: This basic yet effective tool is accessible to all adventurers, regardless of level.
greenskins_waaagh_drum_premium.vendorReason: Greenskin camps are known for their vibrant culture and constant need for battle-ready equipment.
greenskins_waaagh_drum_premium.shippingDetail: Ships via land route from the nearest Greenskin encampment, typically arriving within a week.

usage.activation: A bonus action to beat the drum and shout 'Waaagh!'
usage.duration: One minute per short rest
usage.endsWhen: Taking or dealing damage to yourself or nearby allies ends it early.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to regain effectiveness

greenskins_waaagh_drum_premium.priceReason: The drum's premium quality and the unique craftsmanship make it a valuable addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

greenskins_waaagh_energy_drink.name: Greenskins WAAAGH! Energy Drink
greenskins_waaagh_energy_drink.description: Greenskins WAAAGH! Energy Drink is a neon-green, sugary concoction that tastes like the chaos of war itself. It's said to have been brewed in the heart of Skavenblight by the Greenskins Brewmasters, who claim it grants warriors the strength and fervor needed for battle. Sip this drink and your speed increases by 10 feet for an hour; you also gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls. However, after the rush comes a price—your Intelligence checks are at disadvantage until the effect ends due to the brain fog left in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume this drink as an action. You gain a +10 bonus to your speed for one hour, and you have advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn after drinking it.

effectDetails.title: Attack Bonus
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the drink, you have a +1 bonus to all attack rolls until the start of your next turn. This effect does not stack with any other sources of attack bonuses.

greenskins_waaagh_energy_drink.levelRequirementReason: It's designed for any adventurer who needs an extra boost before battle.
greenskins_waaagh_energy_drink.vendorReason: The Greenskins Brewmasters are known for their unique and potent concoctions, making this drink a staple in their inventory.
greenskins_waaagh_energy_drink.shippingDetail: Due to the volatile nature of the contents, Choppa Delivery guarantees safe and swift delivery within 12 hours of purchase.

usage.duration: One hour or until you take a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish your next turn after drinking it or at the start of your next long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one dose can be active at a time.

greenskins_waaagh_energy_drink.priceReason: The drink's rarity and unique effects justify its moderate price in terms of XP.

greenskins_waaagh_gruel_recipe.name: Recipe: Greenskins Waaagh! Gruel
greenskins_waaagh_gruel_recipe.description: A bowl of steaming gruel thickened by the sweat and tears of Ork warriors. This porridge not only fuels their berserk rage but also grants a human ally temporary strength. Consuming it results in a one-hour frenzy where you can lift twice your weight, but your intellect falters—suffering disadvantage on Intelligence checks during this time. The recipe is jealously guarded by Ork Camp Cooks who have learned to harness the primal energy of their kin.

effectDetails.title: Rage Fuel
effectDetails.rules: Eating this gruel grants you a bonus action to increase your Strength by 2 until the start of your next turn. On your next turn, you can make a melee attack with advantage.

effectDetails.title: Berserk Mode
effectDetails.rules: While under the effect of the Rage Fuel, you have disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saving throws. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until you take damage.

greenskins_waaagh_gruel_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This item's effects are best suited for characters who can handle the mental strain.
greenskins_waaagh_gruel_recipe.vendorReason: Ork Camp Cooks have perfected this recipe and sell it to outsiders seeking a taste of Orkish might.
greenskins_waaagh_gruel_recipe.shippingDetail: The delivery is slow, as the Grubby Grain Guide must navigate the perilous paths of the Greenskin encampments.

usage.activation: Eating the gruel grants you the effects immediately.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until you take damage
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or the duration expires
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is consumed once

greenskins_waaagh_gruel_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's rarity and the unique effects justify this price.

greenskins_waaagh_wok.name: Greenskins WAAAGH! Wok
greenskins_waaagh_wok.description: The Greenskins WAAAGH! Wok is a ferocious culinary weapon forged in the heart of Gorkamortis. This screaming wok not only cooks with kinetic energy but also channels the primal might of the Greenskin war-cooks. When wielded, it crackles with fiery power and emits deafening 'WAAAGH!'s', driving away stealthy foes. A single bite from its cooked meal grants a burning fire damage to your next attack, ensuring the battlefield is never left unseasoned.

effectDetails.title: Cooks with Kinetic Energy
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action to wield the Wok in combat, it cooks food instantly. The cooked meal grants a bonus to your next attack roll equal to half the proficiency bonus of a Greenskin (+2). This effect can only occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Battle Spice
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the meal prepared by the Wok, you deal an additional 1d6 fire damage on your next melee attack. You cannot benefit from this effect more than twice in a single day.

greenskins_waaagh_wok.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can already appreciate the culinary and tactical benefits of this weapon.
greenskins_waaagh_wok.vendorReason: The Greenskins are renowned for their cooking prowess, so it's no surprise they sell such a versatile item.
greenskins_waaagh_wok.shippingDetail: Ships via Choppa, known for its swift and reliable service within the Warlord's domain.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The meal is consumed or the attack occurs

greenskins_waaagh_wok.priceReason: Balanced to reflect a unique and versatile item, perfect for those who value both combat prowess and culinary skills.

greenskins_war_paint.name: Greenskins War Paint
greenskins_war_paint.description: Greenskins War Paint is a set of pigments and oils meticulously crafted by Greenskin warriors. When smeared on the skin, it transforms the wearer into an imposing figure, enhancing their presence with every step they take. The paint's vibrant hues and intricate patterns make the wearer seem larger than life, causing immediate intimidation among foes within 30 feet. This war paint is not only waterproof but also lasts a full day, making it perfect for extended battles or skirmishes.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Presence
effectDetails.rules: When applied to the wearer, the Greenskins War Paint grants advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks for 1 hour. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Waterproof
effectDetails.rules: The paint is waterproof and remains effective for 24 hours after application, regardless of exposure to water or moisture. There are no saving throws required to maintain the paint's properties.

greenskins_war_paint.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for adventurers who have yet to master their combat prowess but still wish to enhance their battlefield presence.
greenskins_war_paint.vendorReason: The warboss, being a master of Greenskin traditions and craftsmanship, ensures that the paints are of the highest quality and effectiveness in battle.
greenskins_war_paint.shippingDetail: Delivered by Paint Pot within 3 days. The paints must be refrigerated upon arrival to maintain their potency.

usage.duration: 1 hour, recharges after a short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: After the duration ends or if the wearer removes it early.

greenskins_war_paint.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's limited duration and the specialized craftsmanship required for its creation, making it accessible to low-level adventurers without being overly powerful.

greenskins_war_paint_kit.name: Greenskins War Paint Kit
greenskins_war_paint_kit.description: The Greenskins War Paint Kit is a fearsome face-painting set crafted by the orcs themselves, made from pigments mixed with oils and extracts of local flora. The paint not only grants you advantage on Intimidation checks for seven days but also imbues you with an orcish presence, giving you disadvantage on Charisma checks when interacting with non-orc NPCs. The paint is permanent until removed by scrubbing it off with steel wool, a painful process that takes hours and leaves your skin raw.

effectDetails.title: Fearful Presence
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on all Intimidation checks for a duration of seven days. This effect can be activated and used passively.

effectDetails.title: Orcish Aura
effectDetails.rules: For the duration, you suffer disadvantage on Charisma checks with non-orc NPCs. The paint is permanent until removed by scrubbing it off with steel wool, which requires at least four hours and results in painful skin irritation.

greenskins_war_paint_kit.levelRequirementReason: This kit is designed for adventurers just starting their journey, providing a basic advantage without overwhelming the player.
greenskins_war_paint_kit.vendorReason: The Greenskins War Painters are renowned for their expertise in creating paints that enhance both combat and intimidation.
greenskins_war_paint_kit.shippingDetail: Ships via the War Drum Courier Service, known for its reliable delivery and quick service within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive use; no activation required to gain advantage on Intimidation checks.
usage.duration: Lasts for seven days from application.
usage.endsWhen: Paint is removed with steel wool, which takes four hours and leaves the skin irritated.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses until paint is removed.

greenskins_war_paint_kit.priceReason: The price reflects a balance between the item's temporary advantage and its one-time use nature, providing value without breaking the game economy.

greenskins_war_paint_mixer.name: Greenskins War Paint Mixer
greenskins_war_paint_mixer.description: The Greenskins War Paint Mixer is a formidable tool crafted from rusted metal and adorned with war paint, its mixer head shaped like a fearsome skull. This relic not only blends paints to perfection but also batter for quick meals. Use it in the heat of battle or at the campfire; it grants you advantage on Intimidation checks when donning the painted visage. Alas, its loud operation makes it a poor fit for stealth missions, imposing disadvantage on Stealth checks while in use.

effectDetails.title: Paint Perfection
effectDetails.rules: When used to mix paints or batter, the user gains advantage on any cooking check involving mixing. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Paint
effectDetails.rules: While wearing war paint mixed with this mixer, the user gains advantage on Intimidation checks. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn after using the mixer to apply the paint.

greenskins_war_paint_mixer.levelRequirementReason: The Greenskins War Paint Mixer is a versatile tool that can be wielded by any adventurer, making it accessible at level 1.
greenskins_war_paint_mixer.vendorReason: The Greenskins who crafted this mixer are renowned for their war paint and equipment, making them the perfect vendor to sell such a tool.
greenskins_war_paint_mixer.shippingDetail: Ships with loud marching drums that announce its arrival in camp.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use when mixing paints or batter.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the mixing effect; advantage on Intimidation checks lasts until next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends naturally at the start of your next turn after using it to apply war paint.

greenskins_war_paint_mixer.priceReason: This item is uncommon but practical, balancing its utility with a price that reflects its versatility and craftsmanship.

griffonstone_aerial_spit_roaster.name: Griffonstone Aerial Spit Roaster
