griffonstone_aerial_spit_roaster.description: The Griffonstone Aerial Spit Roaster is a wind-resistant contraption designed for goulash on the wing, crafted from resilient griffon feathers and enchanted with aerodynamic properties. This lightweight roaster rotates seamlessly in aerial gusts, ensuring your meal never catches too much of the sky's chill. The roaster’s surface leaves a fine, edible layer of grease that adheres to the meat, enhancing flavor without weighing down your griffon cook.

effectDetails.title: Wind-Resistant Cooking
effectDetails.rules: While the roaster rotates in strong winds, you gain a +1 bonus to cooking checks made for aerial meals. The roaster can only be used in flight and must be held by a creature proficient with flying mounts or creatures.

effectDetails.title: Feather Grease Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: The grease left on the meat from this roaster enhances its flavor, granting you advantage on saving throws against starvation and dehydration for 1 hour after using it. This effect can only be used once per day.

griffonstone_aerial_spit_roaster.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for novice flyers who might need help in managing their cooking while airborne.
griffonstone_aerial_spit_roaster.vendorReason: Griffonstone Aerial Spit Roasters are a specialty of the Aerie Forgers, known for their innovative items that enhance daily life for griffons and their riders.
griffonstone_aerial_spit_roaster.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted Wing Wind couriers who ensure your roaster arrives intact, even in the most turbulent skies.

usage.activation: Use an action to start cooking. The roaster can only be used while flying or hovering.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until you stop using it.
usage.endsWhen: The roaster stops rotating when not held in flight, expending its one-time use after the flavor-enhancing effect is applied.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one flavor-enhancing effect per day.

griffonstone_aerial_spit_roaster.priceReason: Crafted with enchanted feathers and designed for specialized aerial cooking, this item offers a unique utility that sets it apart from standard roasters.

griffonstone_aerial_wing_harness.name: Griffonstone Aerial Wing Harness
griffonstone_aerial_wing_harness.description: The Griffonstone Aerial Wing Harness is a meticulously crafted harness for griffon riders, forged from the molten core of a dormant volcano and reinforced with feathers from ancient griffons. This harness not only provides advantage on flight maneuvers but also ensures the rider's safety during steep dives by securing them tightly to the griffon’s back. The straps are lined with volcanic glass that repels water, making it perfect for both dry and wet climates.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Flight Maneuvers
effectDetails.rules: The harness grants the rider advantage on any ability check or saving throw related to mounted flight maneuvers. This effect lasts as long as the rider is mounted and actively using the harness.

effectDetails.title: Secure During Dives
effectDetails.rules: When the griffon dives, the harness locks into place, preventing the rider from falling off during sharp descents. This effect is triggered automatically when a griffon begins a dive.

griffonstone_aerial_wing_harness.levelRequirementReason: This harness requires significant skill and strength to operate effectively, suitable only for riders of at least 7th level.
griffonstone_aerial_wing_harness.vendorReason: Griffon Aviators are renowned for their expertise in crafting gear for griffon riders, ensuring the highest quality and reliability.
griffonstone_aerial_wing_harness.shippingDetail: Ships via specialized griffon couriers. Awaiting weather conditions may delay delivery by up to three days.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon mounting a griffon.
usage.duration: Lasts until the rider dismounts or the harness is removed.
usage.endsWhen: The harness automatically detaches when the rider dismounts or if it suffers damage exceeding half its original value.

griffonstone_aerial_wing_harness.priceReason: Crafted from volcanic glass and reinforced with ancient griffon feathers, this harness is a rare find, justifying the reduced price.

griffonstone_griffon_feather_quill_premi.name: Griffonstone Griffon Feather Quill (Premium)
griffonstone_griffon_feather_quill_premi.description: The Griffonstone Griffon Feather Quill (Premium) is crafted from the downy feathers of a griffon, imbued with the essence of its noble spirit. This quill never runs out of ink and writes under its own volition when you sign an important contract, sealing your promise with a feathered tickle that only you can feel. The quill's ink binds lightly but is unbreakable in the eyes of those who value honor above all.

effectDetails.title: Feathered Binding
effectDetails.rules: When you sign a contract with this quill, it writes under its own volition and seals your word. The ink dries instantly, creating an unbreakable bond that cannot be tampered with or erased without the signer's consent.

effectDetails.title: Ink Never Fails
effectDetails.rules: This quill never runs out of ink and can write continuously until it is no longer in use. It requires no refills or replacements, ensuring it remains a reliable companion for all your drafting needs.

griffonstone_griffon_feather_quill_premi.levelRequirementReason: The quill's magic is straightforward and does not require high-level arcane knowledge.
griffonstone_griffon_feather_quill_premi.vendorReason: Griffon Scribes, the artisans of Griffonstone, are known for their unparalleled craftsmanship in creating items that reflect the essence of griffons.
griffonstone_griffon_feather_quill_premi.shippingDetail: The Winged Post ensures swift delivery by air, ensuring your quill arrives at its destination without delay.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when signing a contract or document.
usage.duration: Permanent until the ink is no longer in use.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts upon completion of writing and drying, after which it requires a short rest to regain its abilities.

griffonstone_griffon_feather_quill_premi.priceReason: The quill's premium rarity and craftsmanship justify the cost, offering unparalleled reliability and unique functionality.

griffonstone_griffon_griff_goulash_recip.name: Recipe: Griffonstone Griff Goulash
griffonstone_griffon_griff_goulash_recip.description: Griffonstone Griff Goulash, a recipe handed down from the Aerie Cooks of Griffo, is a culinary masterpiece that elevates the taste and strength of aerial predators. This hearty stew transforms the toughest game meats into tender morsels, while its secret ingredient, griff-tough, ensures each bite strengthens your wings. Eat this goulash to gain advantage on flying and mounted checks for 3 hours, as if you've been feasting in the heart of a storm cloud.

effectDetails.title: Fluffy Wing Flap
effectDetails.rules: As an action, eat this goulash to gain advantage on flying and mounted checks for 3 hours. You must consume it within one hour of receiving it from Aerie Cooks.

effectDetails.title: Taste of the Sky
effectDetails.rules: The recipe grants you temporary resistance to fall damage equal to your proficiency bonus when you are in flight or riding a mount, lasting for 1 minute. This effect can be triggered once per short rest.

griffonstone_griffon_griff_goulash_recip.levelRequirementReason: This recipe requires at least level 6 to ensure the cook's expertise and the ingredients' potency.
griffonstone_griffon_griff_goulash_recip.vendorReason: The Aerie Cooks have perfected this recipe, passed down through generations of aerial mastery.
griffonstone_griffon_griff_goulash_recip.shippingDetail: Delivered by Wing-Worthy Whisk in a sealed, insulated container to preserve the stew's integrity and flavor.

usage.activation: Eating this goulash as an action
usage.duration: 3 hours of advantage on flying and mounted checks; 1 minute temporary resistance to fall damage
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire after their durations or if you consume any other food that does not contain griff-tough ingredients.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it regenerates upon consumption

griffonstone_griffon_griff_goulash_recip.priceReason: Crafted with rare griff-tough and precise Aerie Cooks' expertise, the price reflects its rarity and culinary value.

grodus_staff.name: Techno-Staff
grodus_staff.description: The Techno-Staff hums with a vibrant, neon glow, its surface etched with intricate circuitry and adorned with X-Naut insignias. This relic of the cybernetic leader commands mechanical constructs with a mere thought, creating forcefields to ward off threats, and unleashes lightning strikes that can shatter even the strongest armor. Rumored to have been forged in the heart of their secret lair, it is said the staff's power wanes if separated from its creator.

effectDetails.title: Dominate Machine
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command a construct within 30 feet to perform one of your actions. The construct must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw with a DC of 17 or be immune to this effect.

effectDetails.title: Forcefield
effectDetails.rules: You can create a forcefield around yourself, granting you a +3 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short rest.

grodus_staff.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 12th level to command constructs effectively and harness the staff's power.
grodus_staff.vendorReason: The rogue port's black market is known for its clandestine dealings with X-Naut technology, making it a fitting vendor for this relic.
grodus_staff.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the lair of the X-Naut leader, ensuring quick delivery and authenticity.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Dominate Machine; 1 minute for Forcefield
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are incapacitated or the construct is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to use Forcefield again.

grodus_staff.priceReason: Balanced price considering its legendary rarity and unique abilities, suitable for high-level adventuring parties.

guide_to_snifits.name: A Guide to Snifits
guide_to_snifits.description: A leather-bound tome with intricate illustrations of Snifits, this guide not only details the subtle differences between their mask colors but also includes anecdotes and lore from the ancient Keepers who first encountered these creatures. The Guide to Snifits is a must-have for any scholar or adventurer seeking to understand these enigmatic beasts better. Its pages are imbued with knowledge that grants you an edge in your interactions with Snifits, allowing you to discern their moods and intentions more accurately.
effects: Advantage on Intelligence checks related to Snifits

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Intelligence Checks
effectDetails.rules: When making an Intelligence check related to Snifits, you gain advantage. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Passive Knowledge of Snifit Behavior
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to passive Perception checks related to observing and interpreting the behavior of Snifits. This benefit is always active as long as you have this guide in your possession.

guide_to_snifits.levelRequirementReason: This guide is designed for beginners or those just starting their journey into the study of Snifits, requiring no more than basic adventuring skills.
guide_to_snifits.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market is known for its eclectic collection of curiosities and scholarly materials, making it a fitting vendor for this guide.
guide_to_snifits.shippingDetail: Delivered via Book Mail, ensuring the book arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Until end of your next long rest or until lost
usage.endsWhen: Lost or destroyed

guide_to_snifits.priceReason: The Guide to Snifits is a common item, but its specific and valuable knowledge makes it worth half the gold price of a rare treasure.

guild_membership.name: Guild Membership (1 Year)
guild_membership.description: A Guild Membership (1 Year) card entitles you to a year-long affiliation with one of the most prestigious guilds in the land, whether it be Thieves, Mages, or Mercenaries. This membership grants access to exclusive training, resources, and a network of powerful contacts. As a member, you can request aid from your guild (at DM discretion), but remember, you must pay monthly dues equal to 10% of the annual fee each month.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Access
effectDetails.rules: Gain access to guild resources, training facilities, and a network of powerful contacts. This effect is passive and lasts for one year from the date of purchase.

effectDetails.title: Request Aid
effectDetails.rules: You may request aid from your guild when in need. The DM will determine the success or failure based on circumstances. This ability can be used once per month, but only under dire emergencies as determined by the DM.

guild_membership.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all levels to benefit from this opportunity.
guild_membership.vendorReason: The Guild Hall is responsible for managing and distributing memberships to ensure proper use of resources.
guild_membership.shippingDetail: Delivered via official guild courier with a two-week processing time.

usage.duration: Lasts for one year from the date of purchase.
usage.endsWhen: Expires after one year or if you voluntarily resign from the guild.

guild_membership.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the value of a year-long association with a powerful guild without being overpowered.

gyro_seed.name: Gyro Seed
gyro_seed.description: The Gyro Seed hums with a steady, magnetic pulse as it spins ceaselessly. When planted near a toppling structure or creature, its spinning stabilizes the falling debris, negating fall damage within a 10-foot radius for up to one minute. Equipped to ammunition, this seed enhances your aim, granting +1 to hit rolls on ranged attacks. It requires a magnetized surface for optimal performance and is harvested from the ancient, clockwork forests of Gearstone.

effectDetails.title: Fall Damage Stabilizer
effectDetails.rules: When planted within a 10-foot radius of a falling object or creature, the Gyro Seed emits a stabilizing magnetic pulse that negates fall damage for up to one minute. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Ranged Aim Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: When affixed to ammunition, the Gyro Seed grants +1 to hit rolls on ranged attacks. This enhancement lasts until spent or until you make another attack with that piece of ammunition. You can use this effect once per short rest.

gyro_seed.levelRequirementReason: The Gyro Seed is simple enough for even the most novice adventurers to wield effectively.
gyro_seed.vendorReason: Gearworks specializes in items that enhance combat and survival, making the Gyro Seed a perfect addition to their catalog.
gyro_seed.shippingDetail: The seeds are shipped in sturdy padded crates with protective foam inserts to ensure they arrive undamaged.

usage.duration: Up to one minute for the fall damage stabilization; until spent or another attack is made for ranged enhancement
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the short rest duration expires or ammunition is used again
usage.charges: Unlimited, with a short rest recharge

gyro_seed.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its utility in stabilizing falls and enhancing ranged attacks without being overpowered.

hacktivist_ad_blocker_apron.name: Hacktivist Ad-Blocker Apron
hacktivist_ad_blocker_apron.description: The Hacktivist Ad-Blocker Apron is a durable, flame-retardant canvas apron adorned with subtle, matte-black patterns that disrupt magical sales pitches. Crafted by Hacktivist Tailors, it features hidden pockets made of a fabric woven to block all tracking signals. While wearing this apron in the kitchen, you can rest easy knowing no ad for cooking supplies will ever find you—magical or otherwise. However, you must constantly inspect your ingredients closely; otherwise, paranoia sets in, causing disadvantage on checks related to ingredient quality.

effectDetails.title: Magical Ad-Immunity
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Hacktivist Ad-Blocker Apron, you are immune to magical sales pitches for cooking supplies. This effect is active as long as you wear the apron in a kitchen environment and does not require any action or concentration.

effectDetails.title: Tracking Blocker
effectDetails.rules: The pockets of the apron have been woven with a fabric that blocks all tracking signals, granting you advantage on saving throws against divination spells. This effect lasts for 1 hour when you first wear the apron and requires no action to activate.

hacktivist_ad_blocker_apron.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners who need protection from magical distractions in a kitchen setting.
hacktivist_ad_blocker_apron.vendorReason: Hacktivist Tailors specialize in crafting gear that resists the encroachment of the digital age, making this apron their signature product.
hacktivist_ad_blocker_apron.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted courier who ensures your package arrives safely without any unwanted tracking signals.

usage.duration: Active while wearing the apron in a kitchen environment.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when you stop wearing the apron or leave the kitchen.

hacktivist_ad_blocker_apron.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item’s utility for both magical protection and practical tracking blocking in a kitchen setting.

hacktivist_burner_identity.name: Hacktivist Burner Identity
hacktivist_burner_identity.description: The Hacktivist Burner Identity is a meticulously crafted fake identity that includes all necessary papers and background, seamlessly disappearing after precisely 48 hours. It's forged by the notorious Hacktivist Collective using cutting-edge technology that leaves your true name tattooed on your tongue in invisible ink—detectable only with Detect Magic. While it provides you with an alias, it comes with a price: thieves in the criminal underworld will recognize it as counterfeit and penalize you with disadvantage on Charisma checks.

effectDetails.title: Counterfeit Alias
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides a complete fake identity that lasts for exactly 48 hours. It includes all necessary documentation and background, which are instantly destroyed after the specified duration.

effectDetails.title: Thieves' Recognition
effectDetails.rules: While using this identity, you suffer disadvantage on Charisma checks with thieves who recognize it as counterfeit. This effect persists until a new Burner Identity is acquired or the current one expires.

hacktivist_burner_identity.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can use a burner identity for temporary anonymity.
hacktivist_burner_identity.vendorReason: The Hacktivist Collective specializes in creating and distributing such identities to their clients.
hacktivist_burner_identity.shippingDetail: Delivered through a trusted courier ensuring no one can trace the package back to its origin.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon receiving the identity.
usage.duration: 48 hours from the moment of activation.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or a new Burner Identity is obtained.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, as it is a single-use item.

hacktivist_burner_identity.priceReason: Balanced price for a temporary and effective counterfeit identity.

hacktivist_burner_identity_rental.name: Hacktivist Burner Identity Rental
hacktivist_burner_identity_rental.description: The Hacktivist Burner Identity Rental is a sleek, compact device that seamlessly fabricates a new identity. This self-destructing gadget lasts precisely 24 hours before erasing all memories of its user, rendering it a perfect tool for those seeking to commit the perfect crime. Once activated, you are free from tracking and recall; however, after the day ends, your mind blanks out any actions taken under this guise, leaving you with no recollection until later when the DM informs you of what transpired.

effectDetails.title: Perfect Crime Tool
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Lasts for 24 hours, granting advantage on Deception checks to avoid detection and disadvantage on Investigation checks to trace you. Ends when the time limit expires or if the gadget self-destructs.

effectDetails.title: Erasable Memory
effectDetails.rules: At the end of 24 hours, all memories related to your actions during this period are erased. You retain no knowledge of what occurred until later, when the DM reveals the events. This effect cannot be reversed by any means.

hacktivist_burner_identity_rental.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character with at least 6 levels to manage and utilize the device effectively.
hacktivist_burner_identity_rental.vendorReason: Hacktivist Black Market specializes in providing services that help users evade detection, making this rental a staple among their offerings.
hacktivist_burner_identity_rental.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly via the Shattered Signal Courier service, ensuring you have your gadget ready for immediate use.

usage.duration: 24 hours or until self-destructed.
usage.endsWhen: Time limit expires or device self-destructs.

hacktivist_burner_identity_rental.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the gadget's utility and the risk involved in using it for a full day.

hacktivist_byte_blender.name: Hacktivist Byte Blender
hacktivist_byte_blender.description: The Hacktivist Byte Blender is a sleek, metallic device that seamlessly blends digital and real-world snacks. Crafted by Net Blenders from recycled tech and artisanal ingredients, it whirs to life with a flick of your wrist. Its blades sometimes glitch, causing minor electrical fizzles, but this only adds to the unique flavor experience. It grants advantage on checks involving technology and creates a refreshing 'code' fizz that energizes users.

effectDetails.title: Blends Fast
effectDetails.rules: When using the Blender, you have advantage on checks related to technology and can blend snacks more quickly.

effectDetails.title: Code Fizz
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, consuming a snack blended by this device grants you temporary hit points equal to half your level (rounded down) for 1 hour. This effect ends if you consume another food item or take damage in the same turn.

hacktivist_byte_blender.levelRequirementReason: Basic knowledge of technology is required to operate this device.
hacktivist_byte_blender.vendorReason: Net Blenders are known for their innovative and tech-savvy creations, making them the perfect vendor for this unique device.
hacktivist_byte_blender.shippingDetail: Ships via Digital Drink Drive within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until consumed or interrupted)
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends if you consume another food item or take damage in the same turn, or after 1 hour if not consumed.

hacktivist_byte_blender.priceReason: The device's unique blend of technology and culinary innovation justifies a price slightly below uncommon rarity.

hacktivist_decryption_key.name: Hacktivist Decryption Key
hacktivist_decryption_key.description: A sleek, matte-black USB drive branded with a stylized 'H' in neon green, this Hacktivist Decryption Key is said to have been crafted from salvaged data shards recovered during a high-profile cyber heist. When inserted into a secure system, it bypasses conventional firewalls and encryption protocols, granting access to even the most sophisticated networks. However, its use on advanced systems carries a risk: there's a 50% chance that the intrusion will trigger an alert, drawing unwanted attention from the network’s security team.

effectDetails.title: Bypass Digital Security
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Grants temporary access to a locked computer system or network for up to one hour, with DM discretion on the extent of access granted. The effect ends if the target system detects unauthorized activity.

effectDetails.title: Risks Network Alert
effectDetails.rules: When used on high-security systems, there is a 50% chance (DC 14 Dexterity saving throw) that it triggers an alert. If the save is failed, the use of the key becomes known to the system's security team.

hacktivist_decryption_key.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and those just starting their cyber heist career.
hacktivist_decryption_key.vendorReason: As a vendor specializing in digital tools, hacktivist naturally carries this essential gadget.
hacktivist_decryption_key.shippingDetail: The USB drive is couriered through Dead Drop's secure channels, ensuring it arrives undisturbed and fully functional.

usage.activation: Uses an action to insert into a target system.
usage.duration: One hour or until detected by the security system.
usage.endsWhen: Detection by the target system or expiration of one hour.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but limited to one per day.

hacktivist_decryption_key.priceReason: The item's value is balanced by its utility and the risk it poses, making it a worthwhile investment for aspiring hackers.

hacktivist_digital_byte_bites_recipe.name: Recipe: Hacktivist Digital Byte Bites
hacktivist_digital_byte_bites_recipe.description: The Hacktivist Digital Byte Bites are crunchy, tech-flavored snacks that cater to the mind as much as the palate. When you eat these byte bites, your brain seems to spark with new insights—your fingers dance over code more nimbly, and your eyes glimmer with a newfound hunger for data. These byte bites were crafted by Net Snackers using custom circuits and nuts, making them both a delicacy and a tool for sharpening one’s coding prowess.

effectDetails.title: Byte Crunch
effectDetails.rules: Eating the byte bites grants you advantage on Intelligence (Technology) checks for 1 hour. The snack requires a bite and can be consumed once per day.

effectDetails.title: Code Inspiration
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, you gain the ability to instantly recall one forgotten line of code or algorithm that you know. This effect is usable once per long rest.

hacktivist_digital_byte_bites_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This snack requires no specific level as it aids in quick problem-solving and coding.
hacktivist_digital_byte_bites_recipe.vendorReason: Net Snackers are renowned for their tech-related products, including this byte bite recipe.
hacktivist_digital_byte_bites_recipe.shippingDetail: Ships via Byte Binary Book with a 24-hour delivery guarantee.

usage.activation: Consumed by biting into one snack piece.
usage.duration: 1 hour and one use per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you gain another advantage on an Intelligence (Technology) check for a different reason.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one per day.

hacktivist_digital_byte_bites_recipe.priceReason: The price reflects both the unique recipe and its rarity in the market.

hacktivist_digital_camo_pants.name: Hacktivist Digital Camo Pants
hacktivist_digital_camo_pants.description: Hacktivist Digital Camo Pants are a pair of sleek black cargo pants with an intricate pattern of green and blue pixels. These aren't just stylish; they're designed to blend into tech-heavy urban environments like a digital ghost. The pants come with reinforced knee pads and a hidden pocket for stashing essential tools like USB drives, making them indispensable for any urban explorer or net hacker. A quick EMP pulse will cause the pattern to glitch momentarily, alerting others to your presence.

effectDetails.title: Urban Camouflage
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when in urban environments rich with technology, such as tech hubs and data centers. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: USB Stash Pocket
effectDetails.rules: The pants feature a hidden pocket that can securely hold one small electronic device or tool, like a USB drive or a lockpick set. You must use an action to access this pocket.

hacktivist_digital_camo_pants.levelRequirementReason: These pants are designed for beginners and seasoned tech experts alike, providing essential utility without imposing a steep level requirement.
hacktivist_digital_camo_pants.vendorReason: Net Hackers specializes in gear that caters to urban explorers, making these pants an ideal fit for their clientele.
hacktivist_digital_camo_pants.shippingDetail: Ships via Code Cloth Express with a delivery delay of one week due to the specialized nature of the item and its high demand.

usage.duration: Until end of next long rest
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges with a short or long rest

hacktivist_digital_camo_pants.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect the item's utility and the vendor's focus on specialized tech gear.

hacktivist_hoodie_of_anonymity.name: Hacktivist Hoodie of Anonymity
hacktivist_hoodie_of_anonymity.description: The Hacktivist Hoodie of Anonymity is a black hoodie with a sleek '404: Identity Not Found' logo on its back, crafted from reclaimed tech fabric. It whispers to NPCs that you're just another passerby, making them twice as likely to forget your face in crowded places. Wearing it also makes you momentarily uncertain about your own identity—50% of the time when introducing yourself, you'll inadvertently say something unrelated or nonsensical.

effectDetails.title: NPC Memory Obscuring
effectDetails.rules: When worn in a crowded place with at least four other people, NPCs must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw (DC 14) or forget your face for the next hour. This effect has no range and is instantaneous upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Identity Confusion
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the hoodie, you have a 50% chance each time you introduce yourself to someone new (as an action) to say something unrelated or nonsensical. This effect lasts until you take another action on your turn.

hacktivist_hoodie_of_anonymity.levelRequirementReason: This hoodie is designed for quick anonymity in social situations, making it accessible to players of all levels.
hacktivist_hoodie_of_anonymity.vendorReason: The Hacktivist Collective specializes in items that blur the lines between reality and perception, and this hoodie fits perfectly into their lineup.
hacktivist_hoodie_of_anonymity.shippingDetail: Delivered via a mysterious courier who ensures your package arrives without being noticed.

usage.activation: Wearing the hoodie as an action
usage.duration: Instantaneous, ongoing with each social interaction
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes the hoodie or takes another action on their turn

hacktivist_hoodie_of_anonymity.priceReason: The hoodie’s unique effects and vendor affiliation justify its price in a balanced manner.

hacktivist_recipe_encryption_decoder.name: Hacktivist Recipe Encryption Decoder
hacktivist_recipe_encryption_decoder.description: The Hacktivist Recipe Encryption Decoder hums softly, its sleek chrome body gleaming with a mysterious blue sheen. Crafted by the enigmatic Hacktivist Codebreakers, this device deciphers even the most secure encrypted recipes, granting you an edge in culinary espionage. With it, you can see through hidden ingredients and uncover secret techniques, but be wary—its backdoor introduces a 5% chance that any decoded recipe might go awry, leaving your meal a disaster.

effectDetails.title: Decodes Encrypted Recipes
effectDetails.rules: When you use the Decoder on an encrypted recipe, you gain advantage on any check to decode or analyze it. However, there is a 5% chance that the decoded recipe will be incorrect and cause unintended effects.

effectDetails.title: Sees Hidden Messages
effectDetails.rules: While using this device, you have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to uncover hidden information within recipes or documents.

hacktivist_recipe_encryption_decoder.levelRequirementReason: This Decoder is designed for those just starting out in culinary espionage and requires minimal experience.
hacktivist_recipe_encryption_decoder.vendorReason: The Hacktivist Codebreakers are renowned for their expertise in decoding secrets, making this device a natural addition to their product line.
hacktivist_recipe_encryption_decoder.shippingDetail: Ships via a secure, encrypted delivery method ensuring your Decoder arrives undisturbed.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day

hacktivist_recipe_encryption_decoder.priceReason: This Decoder offers a unique and essential tool for those entering the world of culinary espionage, balancing its utility with an affordable price.

hacktivist_recipe_glitch_cookies.name: Recipe: Hacktivist Glitch Cookies
hacktivist_recipe_glitch_cookies.description:
Recipe: Hacktivist Glitch Cookies
These cookies are a digital nightmare in pastry form. When consumed, they cause your world to flicker briefly with code and glitches. You gain advantage on one Intelligence check but lose it on another. The cookies themselves look like pixelated versions of their normal selves, an unsettling reminder that the world is not quite as stable as you thought. Baked by Hacktivist Bakers, these cookies are a bizarre treat for those who dare to explore the limits between reality and code.

effectDetails.title: Digital Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When you consume one of these cookies, roll an Intelligence check. You gain advantage on this check but suffer a disadvantage on another Intelligence-based check your DM chooses.

effectDetails.title: Visual Glitch
effectDetails.rules: For the next hour, you are aware that the world around you is slightly unstable. Your Perception checks have disadvantage until the end of this duration.

hacktivist_recipe_glitch_cookies.levelRequirementReason: The recipe requires basic understanding and skill with simple tools to prepare.
hacktivist_recipe_glitch_cookies.vendorReason: Hacktivist Bakers specialize in creating treats that blur the lines between the digital and physical worlds, making them the perfect vendor for these cookies.
hacktivist_recipe_glitch_cookies.shippingDetail: Delivered by a mysterious courier who leaves no trace of their presence.

usage.duration: One hour
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you eat another cookie of this type
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have the recipe

hacktivist_recipe_glitch_cookies.priceReason: The ingredients and unique preparation method make these cookies a rare treat.

hacktivist_virus_chip_service.name: Hacktivist Virus Chip Service
hacktivist_virus_chip_service.description: The Hacktivist Virus Chip Service is a digital sabotage tool crafted by Digital Rebels, an infamous collective known for their mischievous exploits in cyberspace. When deployed, it infects connected devices with a cascade of memes, causing them to malfunction for one minute and temporarily boost the user’s Deception checks online by +1. However, if the device is not properly secured, the virus can backfire, leading to severe lag that cripples your tech for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Meme Infestation
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Targets all connected devices within 30 feet for one minute, causing them to malfunction and become vulnerable to further sabotage until secured or re-booted.

effectDetails.title: Deception Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Grants the user advantage on Deception checks made online for the duration of their next short rest.

hacktivist_virus_chip_service.levelRequirementReason: Requires no specific class or background to use, making it accessible to all players.
hacktivist_virus_chip_service.vendorReason: As a notorious tech-sabotage service provider, hacktivist.net is the only place you can purchase this tool for your digital misadventures.
hacktivist_virus_chip_service.shippingDetail: Delivered instantaneously via a secure, encrypted USB device.

usage.activation: Bonus action to deploy or activate.
usage.duration: One minute of meme-infestation and +1 Deception boost online.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if the user reboots their affected devices.

hacktivist_virus_chip_service.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its utility in both sabotage and online social engineering without being overpowered.

halfling_adventurer_overalls.name: Halfling Adventurer Overalls
halfling_adventurer_overalls.description: The Halfling Adventurer Overalls are a set of padded overalls tailor-made for pint-sized heroes, crafted by Shire Seamstresses from durable yet flexible material. These overalls grant nimble Dexterity saves and offer pockets that can store rations, healing the wearer with 1d4 hit points upon consumption. They are too short for taller races but remain a staple of Halfling adventurers, known for their comfort and utility in the field.

effectDetails.title: Dexterity Savvy
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer makes a Dexterity saving throw, they gain a +1 bonus to the roll. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Ration Pocket
effectDetails.rules: The overalls contain a pocket that can store rations. Consuming these rations restores 1d4 hit points. The pocket can only hold one ration at a time and is recharged upon the wearer completing a long rest.

halfling_adventurer_overalls.levelRequirementReason: These overalls are designed for young adventurers just starting their journey.
halfling_adventurer_overalls.vendorReason: Halfling_Hole specializes in gear that suits small but mighty Halflings, and these overalls are a hallmark of their craftsmanship.
halfling_adventurer_overalls.shippingDetail: Ships via Pocketed Parcel; delivery is swift, even for the tiniest parcels.

usage.duration: Until the end of their next turn after a Dexterity save or ration consumption
usage.endsWhen: The wearer completes a long rest

halfling_adventurer_overalls.priceReason: Crafted with durable and flexible materials, these overalls provide essential utility without overpowering the wearer.

halfling_baker_bodyguard.name: Halfling Master Baker Bodyguard (Elite)
halfling_baker_bodyguard.description: Halfling Master Baker Bodyguard is a remarkable halfling who has honed his skills in both culinary arts and combat. His rolling pin, crafted from seasoned oak, can be wielded with deadly precision. He can instantly prepare a feast that restores 5d6 hit points to four nearby allies within 30 feet, making him an indispensable protector at feasts or banquets. A true blend of defense and sustenance, he is the perfect guardian for any noble house or guild.

effectDetails.title: Feast and Protect
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the Halfling Master Baker Bodyguard can prepare a feast that restores 5d6 hit points to all creatures within 30 feet who are allies. The effect lasts for 1 minute and has a recharge after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Masterful Culinary Artisan
effectDetails.rules: The Halfling Master Baker Bodyguard acts as an elite bodyguard (CR 4), providing combat support with his rolling pin or kitchen knives. He can make opportunity attacks and has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks.

halfling_baker_bodyguard.levelRequirementReason: To ensure that the player is capable of effectively utilizing this item's defensive capabilities in battle.
halfling_baker_bodyguard.vendorReason: Being a product of his community, it makes sense for halfling vendors to sell an item created by one of their own members.
halfling_baker_bodyguard.shippingDetail: The shipment is made with utmost care using Linen Bags to ensure the rolling pin remains in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Feast and Protect, reaction or opportunity attacks for Masterful Culinary Artisan
usage.duration: 1 minute (Feast and Protect), until the end of his next turn (Masterful Culinary Artisan)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a short rest is taken or after 1 minute.

halfling_baker_bodyguard.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity and the unique combination of combat and utility it provides.

halfling_bank_bank_itself.name: Halfling Bank Bailout Plan
halfling_bank_bank_itself.description: The Halfling Bank Bailout Plan is a meticulously crafted document that ensures your savings remain intact even in the most tumultuous economic climates. Authored by the wily minds of the Halfling Bank, this plan guarantees you 120% of your deposits should the bank's stability crumble. The document itself is bound with rare parchment and inked with a sigil that whispers promises of financial security only to those who trust in its wisdom.

effectDetails.title: Emergency Financial Safeguard
effectDetails.rules: If the Halfling Bank fails, you gain an instantaneous bonus of 120% on all your deposits. This effect is triggered by a bank failure, as determined by the DM.

effectDetails.title: Halfling Bank Guarantee
effectDetails.rules: The document ensures that no matter what, your funds are secured against any economic collapse within the Halfling faction's domain. This benefit lasts until the Halfling Bank is re-established or until you decide to cash in.

halfling_bank_bank_itself.levelRequirementReason: This plan requires a basic understanding of financial security and trust in the Halfling Bank.
halfling_bank_bank_itself.vendorReason: The Halfling Bank is responsible for issuing this document, ensuring its legitimacy and value to depositors.
halfling_bank_bank_itself.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift Halfling Courier Pigeons within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon purchasing the document.
usage.duration: Until the Halfling Bank is re-established or until you cash in your deposits.
usage.endsWhen: The Halfling Bank fails and you decide to withdraw funds.

halfling_bank_bank_itself.priceReason: This document ensures significant financial security, making it a valuable but not overpriced investment for players seeking peace of mind.

halfling_bank_loan_master.name: Halfling Bank Loan Master (Instant 1M)
halfling_bank_loan_master.description: The Halfling Bank Loan Master is a compact, intricately crafted device that promises an instant influx of wealth. This small, metallic charm whispers tales of the Halflings’ cunning and their ability to secure vast sums with but a touch. Upon activation, it draws a million gold pieces from the legendary Halfling Bank; however, repayment must be made within five years, with interest accumulating at a rate of 10% annually. Failing to honor this debt invites the wrath of the Halflings, who are known for their relentless and often humorous methods of collection.

effectDetails.title: Instant Access to 1 Million GP
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Halfling Bank Loan Master grants its user 1 million gold pieces. This effect is instantaneous and requires no further action from the user.

effectDetails.title: Severe Debt Collection on Default
effectDetails.rules: If the debt is not repaid within five years, the Halflings will demand repayment of a much larger sum, including all accumulated interest. The exact amount is determined by the Dungeon Master and can be as creative or as challenging as desired.

halfling_bank_loan_master.levelRequirementReason: The device requires basic understanding and trust to use responsibly.
halfling_bank_loan_master.vendorReason: Only the Halflings, known for their business acumen and connections, would offer such a risky but potentially lucrative item.
halfling_bank_loan_master.shippingDetail: The loan is delivered via the Money Bag Delivery service, ensuring swift and reliable transport of the vast sum.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Debt Repayment or Default

halfling_bank_loan_master.priceReason: The device’s low price reflects its limited use and the significant risk involved in securing such a large sum.

halfling_bank_loan_master_godly.name: Halfling Bank Loan Master (Godly Term)
halfling_bank_loan_master_godly.description: Secure a 5,000,000 gp loan from Halfling Bank, guaranteed by their intricate legal systems and community bonds. The repayment terms are so generous that they might as well be written in halfling laughter instead of ink, payable over 20 years with minimal interest. This unique financial artifact is forged under the watchful gaze of the Halflings' patron deity, making it a godly investment for those who can afford to dream big.

effectDetails.title: Instant Access to Capital
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the user gains immediate access to 5,000,000 gp. This amount is non-refundable and must be repaid over a span of 20 years with minimal interest.

effectDetails.title: Exceptionally Favorable Terms
effectDetails.rules: The repayment terms are so generous that they might as well be written in halfling laughter instead of ink. The loan is legally binding by Halfling law, ensuring the debtor's commitment to the repayment schedule without any penalties for early settlement.

halfling_bank_loan_master_godly.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level to handle its financial and legal complexities.
halfling_bank_loan_master_godly.vendorReason: Halflings are known for their intricate banking systems and community bonds, making them the perfect vendors for such a godly term loan.
halfling_bank_loan_master_godly.shippingDetail: The loan is delivered instantly upon purchase, with no additional shipping delays or charges.

usage.duration: Permanent until repaid
usage.endsWhen: Loan fully repaid; destroyed if not repaid within 20 years

halfling_bank_loan_master_godly.priceReason: The price is set low to balance the massive financial boon provided by this item.

halfling_bank_vault_lease.name: Halfling Bank Vault Lease (Maximum Security)
halfling_bank_vault_lease.description: The Halfling Bank Vault Lease (Maximum Security) secures a vault within the labyrinthine depths of the Halfling underground, where magical wards and ancient enchantments protect it from prying eyes and illicit attempts to breach its walls. This vault is so secure that even the most formidable divination spells cannot penetrate its defenses, and it can safely house treasures beyond mortal reckoning—artifacts of divine power are said to have been stored here without fear of loss or theft. Crafted by the Halflings themselves, this lease promises unparalleled protection for your most precious possessions.

effectDetails.title: Immovable and Unscryable
effectDetails.rules: The vault is immune to all scrying, teleportation attempts, and physical breaking attempts. No divination spell or magical means can penetrate its defenses. This effect lasts until the lease expires.

effectDetails.title: Artifact Repository
effectDetails.rules: The vault can safely store one artifact of godly power without risk of corruption or loss. The artifact must be placed within 24 hours from acquiring the lease, and it remains safeguarded for its entire duration.

halfling_bank_vault_lease.levelRequirementReason: Only high-level adventurers with the resources to secure such a vault should have access.
halfling_bank_vault_lease.vendorReason: The Halflings, known for their ingenuity and craftsmanship, are the only ones trusted to manage such a powerful and secure location.
halfling_bank_vault_lease.shippingDetail: The Key Exchange ensures the vault is securely transported and delivered within 3 days of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon lease acquisition; no further activation required during storage period.
usage.duration: 1 year from lease start date.
usage.endsWhen: Lease expires or artifact is removed.

halfling_bank_vault_lease.priceReason: The price reflects the value of securing a vault that can safely hold an artifact of godly power for a year, a service unparalleled in the realm.

halfling_banking_protection.name: Halfling Banking Protection (Wards)
halfling_banking_protection.description: The Halfling Banking Protection Wards are a subtle yet potent defense mechanism, crafted by the astute minds of the Halflings and placed upon your valuables within their vaults. These wards shimmer with an ethereal silver light, preventing scrying, teleportation, and magical theft from reaching your stored assets. The wards' power waxes and wanes in harmony with the trust between you and the bank; as long as you maintain a banking relationship, they remain steadfast protectors of your wealth.

effectDetails.title: Warding Against Theft
effectDetails.rules: The wards prevent scrying, teleportation, and magical theft from targeting the assets stored in the Halfling Bank's vaults. This effect is active as long as you maintain a banking relationship with them.

effectDetails.title: Trust-Based Duration
effectDetails.rules: The wards' duration is contingent upon your continued trust in the bank. Should you sever this relationship, the wards lose their power and cease to function immediately.

halfling_banking_protection.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a level of at least 1 to activate, as it involves subtle magical protections that can be applied only by those with some experience in handling wealth.
halfling_banking_protection.vendorReason: The Halflings are renowned for their expertise in banking and security, making them the ideal vendors for such a protection mechanism.
halfling_banking_protection.shippingDetail: Delivery is expedited via Swift Courier, ensuring your assets are protected as soon as possible after purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon storing items in Halfling Bank vaults.
usage.duration: Active until the banking relationship ends or you remove your items from the vaults.
usage.endsWhen: The wards lose their power if the banking relationship is terminated or when the assets are removed from the vaults.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharged automatically upon maintaining the bank relationship.

halfling_banking_protection.priceReason: This price reflects the cost of magical materials and intricate enchantments required to craft such a potent protection mechanism, as well as the ongoing maintenance provided by the Halfling Bank.

halfling_cheese_grater_of_fine_shreds.name: Halfling Cheese Grater of Fine Shreds
halfling_cheese_grater_of_fine_shreds.description: The Halfling Cheese Grater of Fine Shreds is a meticulously crafted tool that turns cheese into a fine powder, its blade honed to razor-sharp precision. Made by the renowned Halfling Cheese Artisans using ancient techniques passed down through generations, this grater grants its wielder unparalleled skill in culinary arts and unexpected utility. It can also be used as a weapon, dealing 1d4 slashing damage on a failed Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

effectDetails.title: Grate with Precision
effectDetails.rules: When used to grate cheese, the wielder gains advantage on any cooking checks that require cheese. As a bonus action, the wielder can also use it to grate vegetables or as a melee weapon against an opponent within 5 feet. On a hit, this counts as a successful Sleight of Hand check for the turn.

effectDetails.title: Weapon for the Table
effectDetails.rules: When used as a melee weapon, the Halfling Cheese Grater of Fine Shreds deals 1d4 slashing damage. If the wielder fails a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check while holding it, they must immediately make another check to avoid dropping the grater.

halfling_cheese_grater_of_fine_shreds.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet versatile tool is suitable for beginners and those seeking to improve their culinary skills.
halfling_cheese_grater_of_fine_shreds.vendorReason: The Halflings are known for their expertise in cheese-making and grating, making this item a staple among their offerings.
halfling_cheese_grater_of_fine_shreds.shippingDetail: Delivered by reliable Hobbit Post with same-day service within the region.

usage.activation: Bonus action to grate or as a melee weapon
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect when used; recharges after a short rest
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after 3 uses per day, recharging at dawn on the next day

halfling_cheese_grater_of_fine_shreds.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its dual functionality and utility in both culinary and combat roles.

halfling_debt_forgiveness.name: Halfling Debt Forgiveness (Minor)
halfling_debt_forgiveness.description: The Halfling Debt Forgiveness is a small, intricately crafted coin that glimmers with a faint, golden light. It can erase up to 50,000 gp of financial debt owed to any known Halfling entity, leaving no trace behind except for the immediate and complete resolution of the debt. This coin is forged from ancient halfling gold, imbued with the spirit of trust and fairness that has defined their people for centuries.
effects: Erases a single specified debt ledger entry
Debt must be financial, not soul-based

effectDetails.title: Eradication of Debt
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation by the owner making a successful interaction check (DC 15), this coin can erase up to 50,000 gp worth of debt owed to any Halfling entity. The effect is instantaneous and permanent.

effectDetails.title: Financial Limit
effectDetails.rules: This item can only be used once per month due to the intricate nature of halfling financial ledgers which must be carefully updated after each use.

halfling_debt_forgiveness.levelRequirementReason: Anyone, regardless of class or background, can appreciate and use this coin's simple yet powerful effect.
halfling_debt_forgiveness.vendorReason: As the primary financial institution for halflings, the Halfling Bank is responsible for issuing and managing such coins due to their deep understanding of halfling debt systems.
halfling_debt_forgiveness.shippingDetail: The coin must be delivered personally by an official courier to ensure its authenticity and proper activation process.

usage.activation: Requires the owner to make a successful interaction check (DC 15)
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per month due to ledgers needing updates
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per month

halfling_debt_forgiveness.priceReason: The coin's rarity and the halfling bank's involvement in its creation justify a price of 1000 XP.

halfling_elevated_dining_experience.name: Halfling Elevated Dining Experience
halfling_elevated_dining_experience.description: The Halfling Elevated Dining Experience elevates your meal to a new height, literally. Your chair is raised just enough for you to dine like royalty, your feet barely touching the ground. The exquisite, perfectly prepared dishes grant you a small taste of immortality with 1d4 temporary hit points. You feel so refined that you gain advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with nobles or dignitaries—your aura commands respect and attention.

effectDetails.title: Elevated Comfort
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this item, your chair is raised slightly. You gain advantage on Charisma checks with nobles or dignitaries for the duration of the meal.

effectDetails.title: Royal Charm
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after using the Halfling Elevated Dining Experience, you have 1d4 temporary hit points from the exquisite meal. You can only use this effect once per day.

halfling_elevated_dining_experience.levelRequirementReason: This experience is accessible to all adventurers who wish to feel like royalty for a short time.
halfling_elevated_dining_experience.vendorReason: The Halflings are known for their exquisite dining experiences and this item encapsulates that refined touch.
halfling_elevated_dining_experience.shippingDetail: Delivered with the same care as the finest meal, ensuring the chair is perfectly adjusted to your height upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until you stand up
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you stand up

halfling_elevated_dining_experience.priceReason: This experience, though not combat-related, is a premium item that offers unique and memorable benefits to adventurers.

halfling_estate_deed.name: Halfling Country Estate Deed
halfling_estate_deed.description: The Halfling Country Estate Deed entitles its bearer to a charming manor surrounded by lush farmland, where every acre of land yields three times the usual food supply. This property is not only untaxed but also comes with a natural charm that enhances the quality of life for all who reside there, fostering prosperity and happiness. The deed itself is crafted from weathered oak, inscribed with ancient runes that ensure its legitimacy.

effectDetails.title: Permanent Homestead
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants the owner a modest manor house and farmland, which remains under their control indefinitely. The property is untaxed and provides an intrinsic bonus to economy-related checks.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Food Supply
effectDetails.rules: The farmland yields three times the normal amount of food. This effect has no range or duration; it is a permanent benefit that replenishes food supplies as long as the deed remains valid.

halfling_estate_deed.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners, providing a stable foundation to support future adventures.
halfling_estate_deed.vendorReason: The local halfling community is responsible for managing and transferring deeds like this one.
halfling_estate_deed.shippingDetail: The deed is couriered with strict security measures, ensuring it reaches its intended recipient safely.

usage.duration: Permanent
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or the owner loses the deed

halfling_estate_deed.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique benefits justify a price of 1000 XP.

halfling_garden_gnome_security.name: Halfling Garden Gnome Security
halfling_garden_gnome_security.description: The Halfling Garden Gnome Security is a whimsical, meticulously crafted gnome figurine that stands guard over your garden. These gnomes are not just any toy—they're handcrafted by the nimble-fingered artisans of the Halfling Village and imbued with a touch of ancient magic. When an enemy approaches, they let out a raucous bellow, alerting you to their presence. However, these gnomes have a quirk: they are easily distracted by shiny objects around your garden, often leading to comical interruptions in their vigilant duty.

effectDetails.title: Guardian Alert
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy within 50 feet approaches your camp, the gnomes let out a piercing shout. This noise lasts for 1 round and alerts you to their presence. The gnomes do not make this sound again until they have been reset after being idle for at least 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Shiny Distraction
effectDetails.rules: The gnomes are easily distracted by any object with a shiny finish within 30 feet. If the area is cluttered, you must spend an action to focus them back on their guard duty. This effect does not occur if the garden is kept free of such objects.

halfling_garden_gnome_security.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no level as it primarily serves a passive guardian role.
halfling_garden_gnome_security.vendorReason: Halflings are known for their craftsmanship and are trusted to provide reliable security solutions.
halfling_garden_gnome_security.shippingDetail: The gnomes are carefully packed in a specially designed crate to ensure they arrive undisturbed and ready to serve.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Reset after being idle for at least 24 hours or when the garden is cleared of shiny objects.

halfling_garden_gnome_security.priceReason: The price reflects the unique craftsmanship, magical properties, and the ongoing maintenance required to keep the gnomes focused.

halfling_gourmet_feast.name: Halfling Gourmet Feast (For 12)
halfling_gourmet_feast.description: Halfling Gourmet Feast (For 12) is a sumptuous spread that transforms any meal into an unforgettable culinary journey. Crafted with rare ingredients by skilled Halflings, this feast not only satisfies the most discerning palates but also energizes and uplifts all who partake in it. After consuming this gourmet meal, adventurers are guaranteed to regain their full hit dice for their next short or long rest, and they receive a burst of inspiration that boosts morale for eight hours, ensuring they approach challenges with renewed vigor.

effectDetails.title: Energizing Feast
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, all participants regain their maximum hit dice for the next short or long rest. This effect is instant and does not require any action from the users.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the following eight hours after consuming this feast, each participant gains a +1 bonus to inspiration checks due to heightened morale. The effect ends when the duration expires or if the user takes a long rest.

halfling_gourmet_feast.levelRequirementReason: This meal is accessible to all adventurers who can afford its cost and are capable of consuming it.
halfling_gourmet_feast.vendorReason: The Halflings are known for their culinary prowess, and this feast is a specialty item they produce using their unique skills and ingredients.
halfling_gourmet_feast.shippingDetail: The meal arrives on a portable table that can be set up instantly at the destination. It requires one hour to prepare before consumption.

usage.duration: Eight hours after consumption
usage.endsWhen: Ends when duration expires or user takes a long rest

halfling_gourmet_feast.priceReason: The price reflects the rare ingredients and the labor-intensive preparation required to create this exquisite feast.

halfling_insurance_policy.name: Halfling Life Insurance Policy (1 Year)
halfling_insurance_policy.description: This leather-bound document, embossed with the Halfling Bank’s crest and a secret sigil only visible to the initiated, promises your heir a life-changing sum of 50,000 gp should you meet an untimely end. Crafted by the bank’s most trusted scribes in a tradition that dates back centuries, it is as much a testament to family bonds as it is a financial safeguard. The document itself is imbued with a subtle enchantment that ensures any forgery attempt will be met with swift detection.

effectDetails.title: Heir's Lifeline
effectDetails.rules: Activate once per year to provide your nominated heir with a payout of 50,000 gp upon your death. The effect is instantaneous and requires proof of death, which must be submitted within one week of the event.

effectDetails.title: Forgery Detection
effectDetails.rules: If any attempt is made to forge or alter this document, a DC 15 Insight check is required to detect the forgery. Failure by more than 5 indicates a successful detection.

halfling_insurance_policy.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can purchase and activate this policy; it's designed for all adventurers who wish to secure their loved ones.
halfling_insurance_policy.vendorReason: As the trusted custodian of Halflings' wealth, the Halfling Bank offers this unique service to ensure familial security.
halfling_insurance_policy.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week by the Swift Courier; a courier known for its impeccable reliability and speed.

usage.activation: Activate once per year upon your death.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until proof of death is submitted or until the policy expires.
usage.endsWhen: Proof of death is submitted, or one year from purchase.

halfling_insurance_policy.priceReason: This policy offers a substantial payout at an accessible cost, balancing risk and reward.

halfling_luck_charm.name: Halfling Luck Charm
halfling_luck_charm.description: The Halfling Luck Charm is a small, intricately woven talisman made from golden thread and tiny glass beads that catch the light like stars. Crafted by Halfling Hedge-Mages for quick, good fortune, this charm bestows luck in times of need. Only those shorter than five feet can wear it; otherwise, its power remains dormant. Gnomes, known for their cunning, can invoke the charm's blessing twice a day, as they are more adept at finding opportunities others miss.

effectDetails.title: Halfling Fortunes
effectDetails.rules: Activates on the throw of a natural 1. The user may reroll one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check once per day. Gnomes can use this twice daily due to their sharper eyes and quicker reflexes.

effectDetails.title: Height-Specific
effectDetails.rules: Only usable by characters shorter than five feet tall. The charm's magic is attuned to the agility and luck of smaller races, ensuring its power only manifests in those who embody such traits.

halfling_luck_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm’s power is simple enough for a first-level character to wield, but it requires a certain nimbleness that even low-level characters can achieve.
halfling_luck_charm.vendorReason: As the original creators of this charm, Halfling Hedge-Mages sell it at their market stalls to share in the luck they imbue into each piece.
halfling_luck_charm.shippingDetail: The Hobbit Post delivers this item swiftly, ensuring that orders are sent within a week, though it may take longer if magical interference delays the shipment.

usage.activation: On the throw of a natural 1 on an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check
usage.duration: Instantaneous; once per day for the user, twice for Gnomes
usage.endsWhen: After one use by the user or two uses by Gnomes

halfling_luck_charm.priceReason: The charm is crafted with rare materials and requires intricate weaving that only Hedge-Mages can perform, balancing its cost to a first-level character.

halfling_master_chef_bodyguard.name: Halfling Master Chef Bodyguard (Legendary)
halfling_master_chef_bodyguard.description: Halfling Master Chef Bodyguard is a legendary artifact forged from the indomitable spirit of a Halfling warrior-chef. Its body is crafted from the finest steel and lined with a secret compartment filled with rare spices and herbs, ready for culinary or combat use at any moment. This versatile protector can turn basic ingredients into life-saving healing potions in an instant, while its battle-ready form ensures that no threat goes unchallenged.

effectDetails.title: Culinary Defender
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when attacked, the Bodyguard can use its improvised weapon to make a single attack against the attacker. On a hit, the attacker takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

effectDetails.title: Instant Healing Potion
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the Bodyguard can use its secret compartment to create a potion of healing. This effect restores 2d4 + 3 hit points to any ally within 30 feet who is within line of sight.

halfling_master_chef_bodyguard.levelRequirementReason: Only those of significant experience and skill, such as an established adventurer or a seasoned warrior, can harness the full potential of this legendary artifact.
halfling_master_chef_bodyguard.vendorReason: The Halfling community recognizes the exceptional skills and contributions of their most renowned chef-warriors.
halfling_master_chef_bodyguard.shippingDetail: Delivered with a convoy of elite halfling couriers, ensuring swift delivery to any adventurer's doorstep.

usage.activation: Instantaneous for defensive reactions; once per day for potion creation.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after activation or until the attacker is no longer within reach.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you use them again, and they can only be used once per long rest.

halfling_master_chef_bodyguard.priceReason: While not a magic item in the traditional sense, this legendary artifact combines rare skills and materials to provide significant utility, making it a fair value for an experienced adventurer.

halfling_negotiation_specialist.name: Halfling Negotiation Specialist (Hire)
halfling_negotiation_specialist.description: Hire a master Halfling Negotiation Specialist to broker peace or finalize complex trade agreements, ensuring no deception occurs during the negotiations and guaranteeing a fair outcome—though likely heavily in favor of the Halflings themselves. The Specialist's sharp wit and keen sense of fairness create an environment where both parties walk away satisfied, but beware: the Specialists often find ways to subtly benefit their own people. Negotiations take one week to set up, during which time they study the situation thoroughly, ensuring a thorough understanding before proceedings begin.
effects: Ensures no deception occurs in negotiations

effectDetails.title: Deception Prevention
effectDetails.rules: The Specialist ensures that all parties involved do not engage in any form of deceit during the negotiation. This lasts for the duration of the negotiation event and is activated upon hiring.

effectDetails.title: Halfling-Favorable Outcome
effectDetails.rules: The Specialist guarantees a fair outcome, but it is heavily weighted in favor of the Halflings. The final agreement is subject to a 10% bias in favor of the Specialist's people.

halfling_negotiation_specialist.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can benefit from the expertise and impartiality of the Specialist, making it accessible at lower levels.
halfling_negotiation_specialist.vendorReason: Halflings are known for their exceptional negotiation skills, and their community often provides such services to outsiders seeking peace or trade deals.
halfling_negotiation_specialist.shippingDetail: The Specialist is delivered by official courier with a one-week setup period during which they prepare thoroughly for the negotiations.

usage.activation: Hiring upon arrival at the negotiation site
usage.duration: One week, from start of setup until conclusion of negotiations
usage.endsWhen: Negotiations conclude or if hired party decides to terminate early

halfling_negotiation_specialist.priceReason: The price reflects the Specialist's exceptional skills and the time required for thorough preparation, making it accessible but not cheap.

halfling_pantry_crate.name: Halfling's Endless Pantry Crate
halfling_pantry_crate.description: The Halfling's Endless Pantry Crate is a small, intricately carved wooden crate that appears ordinary until opened. Upon its revelation of a pocket dimension, the scent of freshly baked bread and simmering stew fills the air. The crate provides enough food for ten people each day, with every meal warm, fresh, and delicious. Once per week, it can produce a 'Hero's Feast' capable of feeding six heroes in splendor, perfect for tales of valor and feasting.

effectDetails.title: Endless Food Supply
effectDetails.rules: This crate provides enough food to sustain ten people daily. The food is always warm, fresh, and delicious. It refills at dawn without any need for maintenance.

effectDetails.title: Weekly Hero's Feast
effectDetails.rules: Once per week, the crate can produce a 'Hero's Feast' that feeds six individuals in luxury. This effect requires an action to activate and lasts until all guests have eaten. The feast recharges after one week.

halfling_pantry_crate.levelRequirementReason: The crate is simple enough for any adventurer, even those just starting their journey.
halfling_pantry_crate.vendorReason: Halflings are renowned for their culinary skills and love of feasting, making them the perfect vendor for this item.
halfling_pantry_crate.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted cart that ensures the crate is never empty during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action to open and use the crate.
usage.duration: Until all food is consumed or one week has passed, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: The feast ends when all guests have eaten or after a week.

halfling_pantry_crate.priceReason: This price reflects the crate's magical properties and the continuous supply of gourmet food it provides.

halfling_pie_baking_lesson_premium.name: Halfling Pie Baking Lesson (Premium)
halfling_pie_baking_lesson_premium.description: Learn from the masters of Shire baking and master the art of pie-making yourself. This premium lesson allows you to craft pies that not only heal but also bring joy, attracting hobbit guests for lively gatherings. Each pie made heals 2d4 hit points when consumed and grants advantage on Cooking checks. The sweet aroma of your pies draws hobbits from miles around, making it easier to host a successful party.

effectDetails.title: Restorative Pies
effectDetails.rules: When eaten, this pie heals the eater for 2d4 hit points. A character can consume only one restorative pie per day.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Cooking Checks
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after receiving this lesson, you gain advantage on any check made with the Cooking skill.

halfling_pie_baking_lesson_premium.levelRequirementReason: This lesson is designed for beginners and requires no prior experience or level.
halfling_pie_baking_lesson_premium.vendorReason: The Halfling Kitchen specializes in teaching the secrets of Shire cuisine, making this lesson a natural fit for their offerings.
halfling_pie_baking_lesson_premium.shippingDetail: Your pies are carefully baked and shipped with Oven Mitts Express to ensure they arrive at your door piping hot.

usage.activation: Instantaneous (the pie is ready as soon as it is made)
usage.duration: 1 hour after making the pie
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if the pie is not consumed within that time

halfling_pie_baking_lesson_premium.priceReason: This premium lesson includes expert tuition, quality ingredients, and personalized attention from Shire bakers.

halfling_political_bloc_backing.name: Halfling Political Bloc Backing (Major City)
halfling_political_bloc_backing.description: The Halfling Political Bloc Backing is a delicate, intricately folded parchment that promises the sway of one major city council vote in exchange for a modest political favor. This artifact, forged from the very threads of Halfling community loyalty and crafted by the nimble hands of a master scribe, ensures your guaranteed win on a single critical civic issue—whether it's zoning laws or tax reform—but only once per year. The document is sealed with the wax impression of a renowned Halfling leader, ensuring its legitimacy.
effects: Guaranteed Win on One Major Civic Vote

effectDetails.title: Guaranteed Win on One Major Civic Vote
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a standard action. The item ensures your party's guaranteed win on one specific major civic vote, such as zoning or taxation laws, within the next year of its activation. Once used, it cannot be activated again until the following year.

effectDetails.title: Political Favor in Return
effectDetails.rules: After successfully using this item, the Halfling Political Bloc demands a small but significant political favor to maintain their trust and continued support. This favor can range from minor administrative assistance to strategic advice on future votes.

halfling_political_bloc_backing.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible early in one's adventuring career, as it leverages the player character's growing political acumen and community connections.
halfling_political_bloc_backing.vendorReason: The local Halfling Community vendor understands the value of fostering strong civic relationships and often deals with such crucial artifacts.
halfling_political_bloc_backing.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, ensuring timely delivery for critical votes.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the next year
usage.endsWhen: Once used and until the next year passes

halfling_political_bloc_backing.priceReason: The item's value is balanced by its limited annual usage, ensuring players can use it strategically without overpowered outcomes.

halfling_portable_oven_stove.name: Halfling Portable Oven-Stove
halfling_portable_oven_stove.description: The Halfling Portable Oven-Stove is a compact marvel of halfling engineering that folds down to fit in your pocket. Crafted from durable, heat-resistant steel and enamel, this stove can transform any cooking adventure into a feast. When opened, it emits a mouth-watering aroma of fresh bread that lures hungry creatures within 100 feet, making it perfect for quick campsite meals or covert espionage. It's the result of years of tinkering by Halfling Tinkerers, known for their ingenuity and craftsmanship.

effectDetails.title: Fresh Bread Aroma
effectDetails.rules: The stove emits a scent that attracts creatures within 100 feet. Creatures with an Intelligence of 2 or higher must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become distracted (as the distraction condition) for 1 minute. This effect ends if the creature leaves the area or gains advantage on its next saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Quick Cooking
effectDetails.rules: When used, this stove allows you to cook any recipe in half the time (rounded down). The stove must be within 5 feet of the food being cooked. This effect is instantaneous and requires no action from the user.

halfling_portable_oven_stove.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for easy use by beginners, requiring only a basic understanding of how to operate it.
halfling_portable_oven_stove.vendorReason: Halflings are renowned for their skill in crafting practical and magical tools, making them the perfect vendor for this stove.
halfling_portable_oven_stove.shippingDetail: Ships within one week of purchase. Delivery may vary depending on local post office schedules.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use when opened and placed near food.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the cooked meal is consumed or the stove is closed.
usage.endsWhen: The aroma dissipates after one minute, and cooking ceases once the meal is finished.

halfling_portable_oven_stove.priceReason: This item provides a significant utility for adventurers without being overpowered, making it a fair value.

halfling_recipe_herb_stuffed_trout.name: Recipe: Halfling Herb-Stuffed Trout
halfling_recipe_herb_stuffed_trout.description: This parchment bears the precise recipe for a Halfling Herb-Stuffed Trout, a delicacy known to rejuvenate and nourish. The trout is stuffed with a fragrant blend of native herbs from the riverbanks, ensuring each bite is both sustaining and delicious. It takes one hour to prepare this meal over a gentle flame, feeding four hearty eaters. This recipe is passed down by Kizzy of Halfling Riverfolk Kitchens, whose family has been perfecting the art for generations.

effectDetails.title: Restores Health
effectDetails.rules: When consumed by a creature, this dish restores 2d4+2 hit points. The effect is instantaneous.

effectDetails.title: Removes Exhaustion
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, one level of exhaustion is removed from the creature. This effect lasts for an hour and cannot be applied more than once per day.

halfling_recipe_herb_stuffed_trout.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate this restorative dish without needing high-level proficiency.
halfling_recipe_herb_stuffed_trout.vendorReason: Kizzy of Halfling Riverfolk Kitchens is renowned for her culinary expertise and generous sharing of family recipes.
halfling_recipe_herb_stuffed_trout.shippingDetail: Delivered within two days via Hobbit Post's reliable courier service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for health restoration; one hour for exhaustion removal
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends naturally when its duration expires or when consumed by a creature.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one level of exhaustion can be removed per day.
