halfling_recipe_herb_stuffed_trout.priceReason: This dish is moderately priced due to the quality ingredients and skill required for preparation.

halfling_recipe_shepherds_pie Deluxe.name: Recipe: Halfling Shepherd's Pie Deluxe
halfling_recipe_shepherds_pie Deluxe.description: The Halfling Shepherd's Pie Deluxe is a hearty dish that warms both body and soul. Its rich, savory layers of fresh vegetables and meaty filling restore vitality and cheerfulness to those who partake. Prepared with love in the cozy kitchens of Halfling Comfort Kitchen, this pie not only heals 3d4 hit points but also lifts one condition of your choice—poisoned, frightened, or charmed. A true comfort food that brings joy to all who share it.

effectDetails.title: Restore Vitality
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, this pie restores 3d4 hit points to the eater. It can lift one condition (poisoned, frightened, or charmed) from the consumer.

effectDetails.title: Shared Joy
effectDetails.rules: If not shared with at least one other creature within 5 feet, the consumer must endure a disadvantage on all ability checks and saving throws for 24 hours. The pie is meant to be enjoyed together.

halfling_recipe_shepherds_pie Deluxe.levelRequirementReason: This dish is simple yet nourishing enough that even low-level characters can enjoy its benefits.
halfling_recipe_shepherds_pie Deluxe.vendorReason: The Halflings are known for their culinary expertise and warm-hearted recipes, making this pie a specialty of theirs.
halfling_recipe_shepherds_pie Deluxe.shippingDetail: Delivered by the trusted Hobbit Post, ensuring freshness in your hands within two days.

usage.duration: instantaneous effect upon consumption
usage.endsWhen: consumed and used up

halfling_recipe_shepherds_pie Deluxe.priceReason: This dish is priced fairly at 1000 XP, considering its restorative benefits and the time it takes to prepare.

halfling_second_breakfast_catering.name: Halfling Second Breakfast Catering
halfling_second_breakfast_catering.description: Halfling Second Breakfast Catering is a gourmet feast that arrives just as dawn breaks. This exquisite meal not only boosts your resilience but subtly increases your appearance, albeit in a tasteful manner. Each day, you gain 1d4 temporary hit points to stave off morning fatigue and a small cosmetic advantage—rumored to enhance one's appetite for adventure. However, outsiders may find the meal too rich for their taste, imposing a disadvantage on checks if consumed by other races.

effectDetails.title: Extra Rations with Temp HP
effectDetails.rules: Consume the meal as an action to gain 1d4 temporary hit points for 8 hours. This effect ends when you finish the rations or if you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Cosmetic Appearance Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Charisma (Appearance) check each day you consume the meal until it runs out, representing the subtle enhancement in one’s appearance. This cosmetic effect is purely aesthetic and lasts for 24 hours.

halfling_second_breakfast_catering.levelRequirementReason: Adequate for adventurers just beginning their journey.
halfling_second_breakfast_catering.vendorReason: The Halfling Catering Co. specializes in crafting meals that fuel both body and spirit, making them the perfect vendor for this item.
halfling_second_breakfast_catering.shippingDetail: Ships within two days of order with express delivery.

usage.duration: 8 hours and 24 hours cosmetic effect
usage.endsWhen: Upon finishing the rations or taking damage, or after 24 hours for cosmetic appearance boost

halfling_second_breakfast_catering.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the gourmet quality and the minor temporary hit point boost.

halfling_second_breakfast_pajamas.name: Halfling Second Breakfast Pajamas
halfling_second_breakfast_pajamas.description: Halfling Second Breakfast Pajamas are a cozy set of sleepwear that make you feel like you're eating in bed. They are handcrafted from soft, syrup-stained fabric and come with built-in naptime munchies. While wearing these pajamas, you gain advantage on saving throws against exhaustion when resting. However, they carry the permanent mark of their use: a few stubborn syrup stains that could be off-putting to neat freaks, imposing disadvantage on Charisma checks.

effectDetails.title: Comfortable for Midnight Snacking
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these pajamas, you gain advantage on saving throws against exhaustion when resting. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Syrup Stains
effectDetails.rules: You are permanently marked with syrup stains from the magic within the pajamas. When interacting with others who have a high standard of cleanliness, you incur disadvantage on Charisma checks due to these unsightly marks.

halfling_second_breakfast_pajamas.levelRequirementReason: These pajamas are suitable for any adventurer as they provide comfort regardless of experience level.
halfling_second_breakfast_pajamas.vendorReason: Halflings are known for their love of comfort and practicality, making these pajamas a perfect fit for their inventory.
halfling_second_breakfast_pajamas.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the trusted Hobbit Post, ensuring you receive your pajamas in peak condition.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: Removed from use or destroyed

halfling_second_breakfast_pajamas.priceReason: The unique combination of comfort and utility, along with the vendor’s reputation for quality sleepwear, justifies this price.

halfling_second_breakfast_pastry_recipe.name: Recipe: Halfling Second Breakfast Pastry
halfling_second_breakfast_pastry_recipe.description: This delicate recipe for halfling second breakfast pastries is a cherished secret of the Shire. Each pastry, flaky and golden, is made with butter from the rolling hills and jam from the orchards. Eat one to regain 1d8 hit points and temporarily satisfy your appetite, allowing you to skip a meal without risk of hunger exhaustion. The recipe itself is a gift from the Halfling Hole, passed down through generations of bakers who understand the art of elevenses perfectly.

effectDetails.title: Second Breakfast Sustenance
effectDetails.rules: Eating this pastry allows you to regain 1d8 hit points and temporarily ignore the need for one meal. This effect ends if you consume another meal or if you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Skip Meal
effectDetails.rules: By using this recipe, you can skip your next scheduled meal without suffering from hunger exhaustion. This effect lasts until the end of your next short rest.

halfling_second_breakfast_pastry_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet satisfying recipe is accessible to all adventurers who appreciate a bit of Shire hospitality.
halfling_second_breakfast_pastry_recipe.vendorReason: The Halfling Hole has long been known for its generosity in sharing recipes that promote well-being and community.
halfling_second_breakfast_pastry_recipe.shippingDetail: Shipped fresh from the Shire, delivered by a friendly hobbit messenger. Expect delivery within three days of order.

usage.activation: Eat the pastry to activate the effects.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when you consume another meal or take damage.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you eat another meal, take damage, or end your next short rest.

halfling_second_breakfast_pastry_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's price reflects the quality of ingredients and the expertise required to create such a satisfying pastry.

halfling_second_breakfast_toaster.name: Halfling Second Breakfast Toaster
halfling_second_breakfast_toaster.description: The Halfling Second Breakfast Toaster is a compact, gleaming device crafted by the masterful Halfling Breakfast Engineers. It not only toasts bread perfectly but also waffles, muffins, and crumpets with equal aplomb. Legend has it that this toaster was once owned by a famous halfling chef who insisted on having every meal start with toast. The machine hums softly as it whisks through each batch, leaving your kitchen smelling of buttered bread and freshly toasted delicacies.

effectDetails.title: Toast Perfection
effectDetails.rules: When using the Halfling Second Breakfast Toaster, you have advantage on cooking checks involving bread and baked goods. However, if you fail a Stealth check due to smoke from over-toasted items, you incur disadvantage until your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Morning Smoke
effectDetails.rules: Each time the toaster finishes a batch of toast, there is a 10% chance that it will produce enough smoke to trigger the local smoke alarm. If this happens, any character within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be incapacitated until the start of your next turn.

halfling_second_breakfast_toaster.levelRequirementReason: This toaster is designed for everyday use and requires no special skills to operate.
halfling_second_breakfast_toaster.vendorReason: Halflings are known for their culinary expertise, making the Second Breakfast Toaster a natural addition to their line of products.
halfling_second_breakfast_toaster.shippingDetail: Delivered by the reliable Hobbit Post, this toaster is carefully packed in halfling-branded packaging to ensure it arrives at its destination without a single crumb out of place.

usage.activation: As an action or bonus action
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect per use
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use; recharges on a short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one charge at a time

halfling_second_breakfast_toaster.priceReason: Considering its unique capabilities and the craftsmanship involved in its creation, this toaster is reasonably priced for its utility.

halfling_seed_bank.name: Halfling Seed Bank (Rare Crops)
halfling_seed_bank.description: The Halfling Seed Bank is a meticulously crafted collection of rare seeds that yield magical crops capable of restoring prodigious amounts of energy. These seeds are known to grow under the nurturing gaze of halflings, whose ancient knowledge has ensured their unparalleled potency. Plant these seeds in rich soil, and within one week, they will produce food that can heal 4d8+4 hit points per serving, enough to sustain a small army for an entire month.

effectDetails.title: Energetic Harvest
effectDetails.rules: When planted in fertile soil, the seeds take one week to grow. Consuming the food yields 4d8+4 hit points of healing. This effect is limited to once per month.

effectDetails.title: Sustaining Army
effectDetails.rules: The produce can sustain a small army for an entire month. One serving feeds five individuals, ensuring continuous energy and health for a significant military force.

halfling_seed_bank.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to lower-level characters as it provides essential sustenance in challenging situations.
halfling_seed_bank.vendorReason: The halflings are the custodians of these seeds and often share their bounty with those in need.
halfling_seed_bank.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days, ensuring freshness and efficacy upon arrival.

usage.activation: Passive effect when planted; consumes food when consumed.
usage.duration: Instantaneous consumption of the crop for healing effects.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends once the seeds are used or the food is consumed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as seeds and fertile soil are available.

halfling_seed_bank.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity of the seeds and their magical properties, ensuring a fair value for players seeking essential resources in perilous situations.

halfling_shire_pie_pan_set.name: Halfling Shire Pie Pan Set
halfling_shire_pie_pan_set.description: The Halfling Shire Pie Pan Set consists of three sturdy, non-stick pans crafted by the skilled hands of the Shire Potters. These magical pans are designed for multiple breakfast pies and ensure that every second breakfast is a culinary delight, granting an additional +1 to cooking checks when preparing these hearty meals. The set can be easily stacked for convenient travel, preserving the perfect balance of flavors on your journey.

effectDetails.title: Multiple Breakfast Baking
effectDetails.rules: When used to prepare a second breakfast pie, this set grants the user +1 bonus to any cooking check. This effect lasts until the meal is served.

effectDetails.title: Non-Stick Magic
effectDetails.rules: The pans are imbued with non-stick magic, ensuring that pies cook evenly and deliciously without sticking or burning. This magical property does not require maintenance or cleaning between uses.

halfling_shire_pie_pan_set.levelRequirementReason: This set is suitable for all adventurers, as it enhances the cooking experience for any meal.
halfling_shire_pie_pan_set.vendorReason: Halfling Hole specializes in items that enhance daily life and culinary adventures, making this pie pan set a perfect addition to their offerings.
halfling_shire_pie_pan_set.shippingDetail: Shipped with the Breakfast Bake Bundle, ensuring your pies arrive fresh and ready for baking.

usage.activation: Passive effect when used in cooking.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the meal is served.
usage.endsWhen: The pie is served or the effect ends upon completion of the meal preparation.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the magical properties do not deplete.

halfling_shire_pie_pan_set.priceReason: This set offers a significant enhancement to daily cooking and travel convenience for adventurers, making it worth its price in XP.

halfling_spy_network_lease.name: Halfling Spy Network Lease (Local)
halfling_spy_network_lease.description: Lease a covert network of Halfling informants in a bustling metropolis, where every whisper holds weight and every piece of gossip could be a key to hidden secrets. This network ensures you receive one piece of actionable intelligence daily, crafted by the sharp-tongued experts who thrive on the edge of society. Their unparalleled mastery of local lore and financial minutiae makes this partnership invaluable for those seeking to navigate the labyrinthine streets with precision.

effectDetails.title: Daily Gossip
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each long rest, you gain one piece of actionable intelligence from your Halfling informants regarding local happenings. This information can be used to exploit vulnerabilities or uncover hidden opportunities.

effectDetails.title: Local Expertise
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 10 days after activation, you have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made within a major city where your informants operate. This expertise is invaluable for piecing together fragmented information and uncovering deeper truths.

halfling_spy_network_lease.levelRequirementReason: This network can be utilized by adventurers of any level, providing them with the foundational support needed to navigate urban environments.
halfling_spy_network_lease.vendorReason: The Halflings are masters at building and maintaining such networks; they are the natural custodians of this item.
halfling_spy_network_lease.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, ensuring your network is operational as soon as you claim it.

usage.activation: Passive upon acquisition. Daily Gossip activates at the start of each long rest. Local Expertise lasts for 10 days from activation.
usage.duration: Daily Gossip: Instantaneous; Local Expertise: Duration of 10 days
usage.endsWhen: Local Expertise ends when its duration expires or upon gaining another similar benefit.

halfling_spy_network_lease.priceReason: The price reflects the ongoing maintenance and expertise provided by a network of Halfling informants, balancing the need for daily intelligence with the complexity of their local knowledge.

halfling_stowaway_contract.name: Halfling Stowaway Contract
halfling_stowaway_contract.description: This compact, leather-bound contract bears the seal of the Halfling Community and promises a small stowaway who will hide discreetly on your person or vehicle for safe transport. The Halfling, Pauline, is as nimble as she is secretive, ensuring that her presence goes unnoticed by all but those she chooses to reveal herself to. In exchange for her services, you must provide one meal per day and ensure her safety during the journey. With Pauline aboard, your foraging checks gain a boost, making survival in unfamiliar territories easier.

effectDetails.title: Discreet Companion
effectDetails.rules: When active, the Halfling Pauline hides perfectly, granting you advantage on Stealth checks related to concealing her presence. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after she disembarks.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Foraging
effectDetails.rules: Pauline's keen eyes and knowledge provide a +1 bonus to foraging checks while she is aboard, assisting you in finding resources along the way. This benefit persists as long as Pauline remains on your person or vehicle.

halfling_stowaway_contract.levelRequirementReason: The contract requires basic trustworthiness and communication skills, suitable for a first-level adventurer.
halfling_stowaway_contract.vendorReason: Pauline's Community is known for its resourcefulness and secret-keeping abilities, making them the perfect source for discreet travel companions.
halfling_stowaway_contract.shippingDetail: The Small Sack ensures timely delivery of your stowaway, often arriving a day earlier than expected.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon signing the contract; ends when Pauline disembarks or if she is discovered and removed by an enemy.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Pauline disembarks or is discovered and removed by an opponent, or after one day of travel.

halfling_stowaway_contract.priceReason: The price reflects the expertise and trustworthiness required to employ a discreet Halfling for safe transport.

halfling_tax_exemption_deed.name: Halfling Tax Exemption Deed (Lifetime)
halfling_tax_exemption_deed.description: This official deed grants you lifetime exemption from Halfling taxation for all your current and future assets within their territories. The parchment is sealed with a wax stamp bearing the emblem of the Halfling Bank, ensuring its authenticity. With this document, you can also use it once to pardon a significant debt owed to any Halfling-controlled settlement. A rare artifact from the archives of the bank, it is made by the very institution that oversees all Halfling finances.

effectDetails.title: Tax Exemption
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants permanent immunity to taxation within Halfling territories for all assets, current and future. It has no save DC or activation requirement.

effectDetails.title: Debt Pardon
effectDetails.rules: Activates with a standard action. Once used, it pardons up to 500,000 XP worth of debt owed to any Halfling-controlled settlement. The effect ends when the debt is forgiven or if this ability has been used.

halfling_tax_exemption_deed.levelRequirementReason: Even a low-level character can appreciate the value of lifetime tax-free status and the potential to clear significant debts.
halfling_tax_exemption_deed.vendorReason: The Halfling Bank issues this document, ensuring its authenticity and value within their territories.
halfling_tax_exemption_deed.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted courier from the bank's archives, sealed with official wax. Awaiting your signature upon receipt.

usage.activation: Standard action for debt forgiveness; passive for tax exemption
usage.duration: Permanent (tax exemption), once per use (debt forgiveness)
usage.endsWhen: Debt is forgiven or effect has been used

halfling_tax_exemption_deed.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP to reflect its significant value but not overpowered.

halo_energy_sword.name: Energy Sword
halo_energy_sword.description: The Energy Sword hums with a vibrant, electric aura that crackles around its blade, crafted from ancient, unyielding plasma. It is said to have been forged in the heart of an active volcano by the legendary blacksmiths of old, whose techniques have long since been lost to time. A lunge attack propels you forward at incredible speed, leaving your enemies in a blur of motion, and it grants +10 feet of movement for that turn. The sword’s power comes from a single energy cell, which must be carefully recharged after 10 successful swings or the blade will cease to function.

effectDetails.title: Lunge Attack
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your movement, you can make a melee attack against any creature within reach. If successful, the target is knocked prone and takes an additional 1d6 radiant damage.

effectDetails.title: Plasma Aura
effectDetails.rules: While wielding the Energy Sword, you gain a +2 bonus to AC and advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

halo_energy_sword.levelRequirementReason: The sword’s volatile nature requires a proficient wielder with experience in combat.
halo_energy_sword.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in rare, exotic weapons and this unique artifact is one of their most sought-after items.
halo_energy_sword.shippingDetail: The Energy Sword is shipped via Rocket Express, arriving within a week but requiring special handling to ensure the safety of the recipient.

usage.activation: Lunge attack: On your movement; Plasma aura: Passively active while wielding the sword.
usage.duration: Until you sheath it or expend its charge
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after 10 successful lunge attacks, or destroyed if not recharged within a week of deactivation.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires one energy cell to recharge after 10 swings.

halo_energy_sword.priceReason: The Energy Sword’s rarity and unique forging process make it an exceptionally valuable item for any adventurer.

hammer_basic.name: Standard Hammer
hammer_basic.description: The Standard Hammer is a reliable wooden mallet reinforced with iron bands, favored by plumbers for its sturdy build and versatile use. Crafted from seasoned oak and tempered iron, it withstands the rigors of plumbing tasks without losing its edge. This trusty tool can break brick blocks with ease, making it indispensable in tight situations. Known for its durability and reliability, the Standard Hammer is a go-to for any plumber.

effectDetails.title: Brick Breaking
effectDetails.rules: When used to break bricks, the Standard Hammer deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage. This effect requires a successful Strength check with a DC of 15.

effectDetails.title: Versatile Tool
effectDetails.rules: When wielded two-handed, the Standard Hammer deals an additional 2d6 bludgeoning damage. The user must have at least one free hand to use it as a versatile tool.

hammer_basic.levelRequirementReason: The hammer's sturdy build and practical uses make it accessible to any adventurer, regardless of level.
hammer_basic.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its wide array of tools used by local plumbers and adventurers alike.
hammer_basic.shippingDetail: The hammer is shipped via the Heavy Goods Carrier, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per long rest

hammer_basic.priceReason: The hammer's balanced price reflects its common rarity and practical utility in adventuring.

hammer_bro_coin_launcher.name: Hammer Bro Coin Launcher
hammer_bro_coin_launcher.description: The Hammer Bro Coin Launcher fires coins with deadly precision. Crafted from tarnished copper and enchanted by a Wario-wary artisan, it launches gold coins like lethal projectiles at a range of 60 feet. Each shot deals 1d8 piercing damage and forces the target to make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 15) or be knocked prone. On a critical hit, the target is blinded by a dazzling distraction for one round, leaving them disoriented. Beware, as using this in Wario's territory will surely invoke his wrath.

effectDetails.title: Piercing Shot
effectDetails.rules: When you use the action to fire a coin, it deals 1d8 piercing damage and forces the target to make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 15) or be knocked prone. This effect ends if the target moves away.

effectDetails.title: Critical Distraction
effectDetails.rules: On a critical hit, the target is blinded for one round by a dazzling distraction. The effect ends when the target regains consciousness.

hammer_bro_coin_launcher.levelRequirementReason: This launcher requires basic coordination and aim suitable for low-level adventurers.
hammer_bro_coin_launcher.vendorReason: The Rogue Port Black Market caters to those who need unique and potent gear, regardless of the law.
hammer_bro_coin_launcher.shippingDetail: Ships via a coin-operated delivery service. Requires a 'special coin' for tracking and delivery confirmation.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Target moves away or regains consciousness after being blinded by critical hit
usage.charges: Unlimited, as coins are always available

hammer_bro_coin_launcher.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its unique and potentially dangerous capabilities.

hammer_bro_gloves.name: Hammer Bro Throwing Gloves
hammer_bro_gloves.description: Hammer Bro Throwing Gloves are crafted from supple leather etched with ancient Bro runes. These gloves not only enhance your throwing prowess but also grant you a dash of the blacksmith's fury, making every throw a testament to craftsmanship and power. Under the watchful gaze of a full moon, the gloves itch insistently, reminding you of their origin in the heart of Forgeside. They allow for superior precision within 30 feet and can be thrown like boomerangs, returning swiftly to your hand.

effectDetails.title: Throwing Mastery
effectDetails.rules: When you throw a weapon or object with these gloves, it deals an additional 1d4 damage. Additionally, you have advantage on throwing attacks made within 30 feet.

effectDetails.title: Return Boomerang
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can throw the gloves like a boomerang. They return to your hand after 1 minute unless retrieved by you or an ally before then. This use is expended and cannot be recharged until you finish a long rest.

hammer_bro_gloves.levelRequirementReason: These gloves are designed for beginners who show promise in weapon throwing, providing them with a solid foundation.
hammer_bro_gloves.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon is known for its diverse array of items that cater to both beginners and seasoned adventurers, making these gloves an ideal addition to their inventory.
hammer_bro_gloves.shippingDetail: Ships via the Forged Post service, which ensures swift delivery through the perilous roads surrounding Forgeside.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action for throwing; a bonus action to throw like a boomerang.
usage.duration: Until retrieved or after returning to your hand.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged with a long rest.

hammer_bro_gloves.priceReason: The Gloves are priced moderately as they offer unique and versatile benefits that enhance both combat and utility in adventure.

hammer_bro_hammer.name: Hammer Bro Hammer
hammer_bro_hammer.description: The Hammer Bro Hammer is a menacing, forged weapon that strikes like lightning and stuns its foe on impact. Crafted from ancient, volcanic steel, this hammer's core glows faintly with an inner fire. Legend has it that the first Hammer Bros used these weapons to forge peace between their village and the Mushroom Kingdom. Each throw returns to your hand, making it a versatile tool for both combat and challenge.

effectDetails.title: Critical Stun
effectDetails.rules: On a critical hit with this hammer, the target is stunned until the start of your next turn. This effect has no saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Automatic Return
effectDetails.rules: The hammer returns to your hand if thrown and lands more than 30 feet away from you. It can be thrown again immediately after retrieval.

hammer_bro_hammer.levelRequirementReason: This weapon is designed for beginners to test their skills against the Hammer Bros in training.
hammer_bro_hammer.vendorReason: Wario Direct sells a variety of beginner and intermediate tools, including this iconic hammer used in Hammer Bro training.
hammer_bro_hammer.shippingDetail: Delivered by Hammer Case Express. The delivery is swift but requires the recipient to demonstrate basic hammer-throwing skills.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The hammer returns upon miss or critical hit

hammer_bro_hammer.priceReason: This hammer is a well-crafted training tool, making it a fair value for those starting their journey as a Hammer Bro.

happy_flower_badge.name: Happy Flower Badge
happy_flower_badge.description: The Happy Flower Badge is a delicate, golden brooch adorned with vibrant, living petals that seem to dance in the breeze. Crafted from enchanted metal and imbued with the essence of nature, it harnesses the power of photosynthesis to slowly restore magic. Each turn, if a d6 roll results in a 6, you regenerate one first-level spell slot, as if sipping from the very heart of a verdant forest.

effectDetails.title: Magic Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn, roll a d6. On a result of 6, you regain one expended first-level spell slot. This effect is limited to once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Photosynthesis Power
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this badge, your body absorbs the natural energy of sunlight and nutrients, enhancing your connection to nature. You gain a +1 bonus to all Wisdom (Nature) checks and saving throws related to plants or natural environments.

happy_flower_badge.levelRequirementReason: The Happy Flower Badge is designed for beginners who wish to connect with the natural world, making it accessible yet beneficial.
happy_flower_badge.vendorReason: Shamans of the forest are known for their deep connection with nature and often offer items that enhance this bond.
happy_flower_badge.shippingDetail: The badge arrives wrapped in a protective layer of soil to ensure its delicate petals remain vibrant during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous magic regeneration, lasts until the start of your next turn for photosynthesis bonus
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted with use or when removed from your person

happy_flower_badge.priceReason: The Happy Flower Badge offers a balanced value, providing a useful passive benefit and rare magic regeneration without breaking the budget.

happy_heart_badge.name: Happy Heart Badge
happy_heart_badge.description: The Happy Heart Badge glimmers with a warm, pulsing light as it dangles from its delicate chain. This rare token brings joy to those who wear it, slowly restoring their health in the heat of battle. Crafted by the whimsical artisans of Toad Town Market, this badge is said to have been blessed by the city’s beloved mayor, Pauline. Every time you take damage during combat, the badge emits a soft hum and regenerates 1 HP at the start of your turn.

effectDetails.title: Health Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you take damage during combat, the Happy Heart Badge emits a soft hum and regenerates 1 hit point at the start of your next turn. This effect occurs once per round.

effectDetails.title: Positive Aura
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this badge, you have advantage on saving throws against fear and negative emotions. Additionally, it grants a +2 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made in social situations.

happy_heart_badge.levelRequirementReason: The badge provides benefits that are immediately useful at any level.
happy_heart_badge.vendorReason: The mayor of Toad Town Market, Pauline, personally oversees the quality and distribution of her city’s most beloved items.
happy_heart_badge.shippingDetail: Ships via Love Letter Express courier, ensuring swift delivery with a special message from the mayor herself.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon donning the badge.
usage.duration: Lasts until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The badge is removed or destroyed.

happy_heart_badge.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's rarity and its beneficial effects in combat and social interactions.

harpies_song_license.name: Harpies' Song License (Royalty-Free)
harpies_song_license.description: The Harpies' Song License (Royalty-Free) allows you to command the haunting melodies of a harpy's luring song, perfect for enchanting audiences or charming foes. Crafted by the feathered matriarchs themselves, this license imbues its bearer with immunity to being charmed by songs, ensuring that only your harmonious tunes hold sway over others. This relic is a symbol of avian royalty and can be shipped swiftly by Songbird Courier.

effectDetails.title: Luring Melody
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the Harpies' Song License to command a haunting melody that has a range of 60 feet. This melody targets one creature within line of sight. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be charmed by your song for 1 minute, during which it is incapacitated and can't take actions or reactions.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Song Charm
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to being charmed by any song or melody. This effect persists until the end of your next long rest.

harpies_song_license.levelRequirementReason: This license requires a high level to master its powerful effects and ensure it is used responsibly.
harpies_song_license.vendorReason: Only the avian royalty, who understand the power of song, can offer such a prestigious item.
harpies_song_license.shippingDetail: The Songbird Courier delivers swiftly, ensuring your license arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Action to command the melody; reaction to defend against charm effects.
usage.duration: 1 minute for the charmed effect; permanent immunity.
usage.endsWhen: Song ends or target saves successfully; long rest ends immunity.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a license.

harpies_song_license.priceReason: The Harpies' Song License's rarity and magical properties justify its moderate price in experience points.

hat_of_the_mad_architect.name: Hat of the Mad Architect
hat_of_the_mad_architect.description: The Hat of the Mad Architect is a top hat that warps your perception of architecture. You see hidden flaws and secret passages in every structure, and can mentally redesign any building with a concentrated hour's worth of effort (DC 15 Intelligence check). The whispers from the walls are not mere hallucinations but cryptic clues to architectural secrets. This hat is crafted by the Artificer Tower, known for their eccentric inventions that blur the line between reality and imagination.

effectDetails.title: Architectural Insights
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you gain advantage on Intelligence (Architecture) checks related to any structure. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Mental Redesign
effectDetails.rules: By spending 1 hour in seclusion, you can mentally redesign an existing building within a mile radius. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence check or the alteration fails. Once used, it requires 24 hours to recharge.

hat_of_the_mad_architect.levelRequirementReason: This item's effects are too powerful for lower-level characters and can be game-breaking if available earlier.
hat_of_the_mad_architect.vendorReason: The Artificer Tower is renowned for their unique and potent artifacts, making the Hat of the Mad Architect a fitting addition to their inventory.
hat_of_the_mad_architect.shippingDetail: Ships via Top Hat Box Express, ensuring safe delivery in 3 days or less.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Architectural Insights; 1 hour concentration and seclusion for Mental Redesign
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Architectural Insights; until end of next turn; 24 hours recharge time for Mental Redesign
usage.endsWhen: Ends with the end of your next turn or after the specified recharge period
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a 24-hour recharge after each use

hat_of_the_mad_architect.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its limited utility and powerful effects.

haunted_spyglass.name: Haunted Spyglass
haunted_spyglass.description: The Haunted Spyglass's polished lens gleams with an eerie, otherworldly light as it pierces through walls and reveals hidden secrets. However, the previous owner's spectral form often appears alongside your vision, whispering in a voice that makes the hairs on the back of your neck stand. Every time you use this spyglass to see beyond solid objects, there's a chilling 10% chance that something is not really there—your mind playing tricks on you.
effects: See through walls and reveal hidden secrets

effectDetails.title: Vision Beyond Walls
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to activate the Haunted Spyglass, allowing you to see through up to 5 feet of solid material. The effect lasts for 1 minute and you have three uses per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Whispers
effectDetails.rules: While using the spyglass, there is a 10% chance that something in your line of sight does not actually exist, creating an unsettling hallucination. This effect has no save or DC and occurs once per use.

haunted_spyglass.levelRequirementReason: The Haunted Spyglass's spectral effects require a certain level of concentration and discipline to handle effectively.
haunted_spyglass.vendorReason: Captain Deadbeard, the spyglass's previous owner, was known for his ghostly interactions with the living. The shop specializes in such macabre curiosities.
haunted_spyglass.shippingDetail: Delivered by a spectral courier who ensures the package arrives safely but may leave unsettling messages along the way.

usage.duration: 1 minute (3 uses per long rest)
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or you finish your next short rest
usage.charges: 3 uses, recharged at the end of a long rest

haunted_spyglass.priceReason: Balanced to ensure it remains a valuable but not overpowered tool for explorers and investigators.

haunting_consultation.name: Haunting Consultation
haunting_consultation.description: The Haunting Consultation is a rare artifact that allows you to summon a professional ghostly advisor who can haunt a location or even yourself for maximum effect. The spectral entity will create an eerie ambiance, scaring intruders and leaving them unsettled for weeks. Alternatively, the ghost may choose to haunt your very form, granting you incorporeality for 10 minutes each day, allowing you to pass through objects and become ethereal. However, remember that the ghost might demand snacks or a detailed backstory as payment.

effectDetails.title: Eerie Haunting
effectDetails.rules: The ghost haunts a room for one week, creating an eerie ambiance that dazes intruders. The target area is the room where the consultation takes place. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges.

effectDetails.title: Incorporeal Self
effectDetails.rules: You gain the benefit of the *Incorporeality* spell for 10 minutes each day by commanding the ghost to haunt your form. This effect can be used once per long rest, and you must make a concentration check (DC 15) to maintain it.

haunting_consultation.levelRequirementReason: Summoning and managing a professional ghostly advisor requires some experience with the supernatural world.
haunting_consultation.vendorReason: The crypt courier specializes in rare and powerful items related to the afterlife and spectral entities.
haunting_consultation.shippingDetail: The artifact arrives sealed within a spirit jar, which must be opened at your location of choice for the haunting to begin.

usage.activation: A ritual action that takes one hour to perform.
usage.duration: Eerie Haunting lasts for one week. Incorporeal Self is active once per long rest and lasts for 10 minutes.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the ghost's payment (snacks or backstory) is fulfilled, or if you dismiss it as a bonus action.

haunting_consultation.priceReason: This artifact balances the cost with its rare utility and powerful effects in both combat and exploration.

heart_of_the_mountain.name: Heart of the Mountain
heart_of_the_mountain.description: The Heart of the Mountain is a pulsating, blood-red stone that feels like the heartbeat of the very earth itself. Crafted from the soul of an ancient titan, it radiates a profound sense of stability and resilience. Placed in the ground, this gemstone creates an impenetrable zone of unshakable durability within a 1-mile radius, rendering all earthquakes, collapses, and planar rifts impossible within its bounds. It requires regular sustenance, feeding on precious stones to maintain its strength; failing to do so results in its crumbling into dust.

effectDetails.title: Stability Zone
effectDetails.rules: When placed in the ground, this legendary stone creates a 1-mile radius of unshakable stability. Earthquakes, collapses, and planar rifts are impossible within its bounds for one month per day it remains active. The effect ends if the Heart is removed or if an earthquake occurs outside the zone that causes tremors within the protected area.

effectDetails.title: Durable Shield
effectDetails.rules: The Heart must be fed 10,000 gp in precious stones each month to maintain its power. Failure to provide sustenance results in the gemstone crumbling into dust after 30 days of neglect. This effect has no save DC and is a passive requirement.

heart_of_the_mountain.levelRequirementReason: This item's immense power requires a level 1 character to handle, ensuring that even novice adventurers can benefit from its stability.
heart_of_the_mountain.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon is known for its extensive collection of rare and powerful artifacts, making it the perfect vendor for such an item.
heart_of_the_mountain.shippingDetail: Ships via Stone Chest, ensuring safe delivery to even the most remote locations.

usage.duration: 1 month per day of active use
usage.endsWhen: Heart is removed or an earthquake occurs within the protected area

heart_of_the_mountain.priceReason: This Heart's legendary rarity and its ability to create a zone of unshakable stability for one month per day justify its fair value.

heavy_boots_used_by_mario.name: Goomba Stomper Boots
heavy_boots_used_by_mario.description: Goomba Stomper Boots are heavy, sturdy footwear crafted by Kingdom Bootmakers during the Civil War to aid Mario loyalists in their battles against Goomba conscripts. These boots resonate with the clomp of marching feet and offer unparalleled durability. Wearers can stomp as a bonus action, dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage to small creatures like Goombas (with advantage), but they become less agile over time, leading to disadvantage on Dexterity saves after five uses.

effectDetails.title: Stomp
effectDetails.rules: You can use a bonus action to stomp with these boots. The target must be a Small creature, such as a Goomba, within your reach. You deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage and have advantage on the attack roll against Goombas.

effectDetails.title: Soles Wear Out
effectDetails.rules: After you use this ability five times, you suffer disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the boots are repaired or replaced. The boots regain their full effectiveness after a long rest.

heavy_boots_used_by_mario.levelRequirementReason: These boots are designed for beginners who wish to assist Mario in his battles against Goomba conscripts.
heavy_boots_used_by_mario.vendorReason: Wario Land, as a competitor of the Mushroom Kingdom, stocks these boots to hinder Mario's allies and increase his own profits from Goombas.
heavy_boots_used_by_mario.shippingDetail: The Stomp Service ensures that your order arrives quickly, but you must ensure that the packaging can withstand the force of stomping!

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until used)
usage.endsWhen: After five uses or when repaired/replaced

heavy_boots_used_by_mario.priceReason: The boots are crafted from durable materials and come with a limited use count to ensure they remain effective against Goomba conscripts.

hellforge_demon_blade.name: Hellforge Demon Blade (Weapon)
hellforge_demon_blade.description: The Hellforge Demon Blade is a weapon forged in the fires of hell, its blade etched with arcane sigils that glow with malevolent energy. This infernal blade not only deals +3d6 fire damage to celestial beings but also subtly warps their essence upon each strike, drawing them into the very forge from which it was born. Its self-sharpening nature ensures it always remains a deadly tool for those who wield it.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Weakness
effectDetails.rules: When the Hellforge Demon Blade strikes a celestial, it deals +3d6 fire damage. This effect also causes a temporary distortion in the target's aura for 1 minute, reducing their effectiveness in combat by one step.

effectDetails.title: Self-Sharpening
effectDetails.rules: The blade self-sharens after each use, regaining its original edge without requiring any maintenance. It recharges once per long rest.

hellforge_demon_blade.levelRequirementReason: Only those of great power and experience can wield the Hellforge Demon Blade effectively.
hellforge_demon_blade.vendorReason: The infernal armory deals exclusively with weapons forged in hellfire, making it a logical place to find such a weapon.
hellforge_demon_blade.shippingDetail: Ships via the Demon Carrier, which can only deliver within the nether realms and adjacent planes. Delivery may take several days due to the dangerous nature of the journey.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: When expended or when you make your next melee attack against a creature immune to fire damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharging once per long rest

hellforge_demon_blade.priceReason: The blade's unique properties and the specialized forging process make it an expensive item.

herbalism_tutoring.name: Herbalism Tutoring (5 Sessions)
herbalism_tutoring.description: Master your skills in herbalism under the tutelage of a master apothecary. These five intensive sessions, each lasting two hours, will teach you the secrets of rare plant cultivation and extraction. Upon completion, you not only gain +1 to all Herbalism checks permanently but also learn a recipe for one rare potion, at the Dungeon Master's discretion. You'll also earn access to an apothecary’s garden, where ingredients cost 20% less than elsewhere in the realm.
effects: Learn recipe for 1 rare potion (DM discretion)
Gain access to herbalist's garden (cheaper ingredients 20%)

effectDetails.title: Permanent Skill Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon completion of the five sessions, you gain a +1 bonus to all Herbalism checks. This benefit is permanent and does not require any further action.

effectDetails.title: Rare Potion Recipe
effectDetails.rules: At the Dungeon Master's discretion, after completing the tutoring, you learn the recipe for one rare potion. The DM determines which potion this could be based on the campaign’s needs or your character’s background.

effectDetails.title: Discounted Ingredients
effectDetails.rules: You gain access to an apothecary’s garden where the cost of ingredients is reduced by 20% for the duration of one month from the tutoring completion. This discount can only be applied once per campaign.

herbalism_tutoring.levelRequirementReason: Beginning herbalists benefit most from this intensive course, as it provides foundational knowledge and hands-on experience.
herbalism_tutoring.vendorReason: The apothecary guild is the primary provider of such advanced tutoring services to ensure only the finest instruction is available.
herbalism_tutoring.shippingDetail: Classes are conducted directly at the apothecary’s workshop, eliminating the need for delivery and ensuring a consistent learning environment.

usage.activation: Passive benefit upon completion of all sessions; potion recipe is granted by DM discretion.
usage.duration: Permanent skill boost; garden access lasts one month from acquisition.
usage.endsWhen: Upon expiry or if the garden ingredients are exhausted, whichever comes first.

herbalism_tutoring.priceReason: The cost reflects the intensive nature of the tutoring sessions and the value of learning rare potion recipes.

high_elf_starlight_ink.name: High Elf Starlight Ink
high_elf_starlight_ink.description: A vial of ink that shimmers like liquid starlight, it seems to capture the essence of the night sky within its glass container. This High Elf Starlight Ink not only illuminates your writing with a faint glow but also imbues scrolls and maps with magical properties. When applied, it grants +1 to the save DC of any scroll written with it, making them harder for creatures to dispel or destroy. Additionally, this ink can be used to create magical maps that precisely depict constellations, guiding explorers through darkened realms.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Save DC
effectDetails.rules: When a scroll or document is written with High Elf Starlight Ink, it gains +1 to its saving throw DC. This effect lasts for the duration of the ink's use and cannot be applied more than once per day.

effectDetails.title: Magical Maps
effectDetails.rules: The ink can be used to create a magical map that accurately depicts constellations, providing a +2 bonus to Navigation checks made within 10 miles from the creation point. This effect lasts until the ink is exhausted or the map is destroyed.

high_elf_starlight_ink.levelRequirementReason: This ink requires basic alchemical knowledge and is not overly powerful for a first-level spellcaster.
high_elf_starlight_ink.vendorReason: The High Elves are renowned for their mastery of arcane arts, including the creation of magical inks like Starlight Ink.
high_elf_starlight_ink.shippingDetail: Ships in an ornate crystal vial that protects the ink from contamination and ensures its potency remains intact until use.

usage.activation: Used by applying it to a scroll or map with a bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for magical maps, +1 to save DC is permanent as long as the document exists.
usage.endsWhen: The ink is exhausted after creating one magical map and provides +1 to saving throw DC until used up.

high_elf_starlight_ink.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the rarity of the ink and its limited shelf life.

high_elf_truth_tea.name: High Elf Truth Tea
high_elf_truth_tea.description: High Elf Truth Tea, a delicate brew made in secret under the starlit sky, forces honesty upon its drinker by probing their mind's deepest truths. The tea is brewed from rare herbs and enchanted with elven magic, ensuring that any who sip must answer three questions truthfully or face the bitter taste of their own deception. A vendor from the High Elf Enclave warns that once consumed, there is no turning back—only the stark reality of one’s soul.
effects: Forces honest answers to three questions

effectDetails.title: Honesty Compulsion
effectDetails.rules: The imbiber must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or answer the next three questions truthfully. The effect is instantaneous and lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Bitter Taste
effectDetails.rules: The tea has an extremely bitter flavor, reducing all drinker's effective Constitution score by 2 for 1 hour after consumption unless they succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. This effect ends when the duration expires or if the drinker regains hit points.

high_elf_truth_tea.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest of sages can recognize the risks and rewards of this potion.
high_elf_truth_tea.vendorReason: The High Elf Enclave is known for its deep connections with elven mystics, ensuring that only genuine magic-infused brews are sold there.
high_elf_truth_tea.shippingDetail: Ships via a trusted elf courier who ensures the tea's secrets remain unspoken during transit.

usage.activation: Drinking the entire cup of tea
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until end of next turn for each question answered truthfully
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the drinker answers three questions truthfully or regains hit points

high_elf_truth_tea.priceReason: Balanced at a cost of 1000 XP, this tea strikes an equitable balance between its powerful effects and the risk it poses.

high_elves_elegant_posture_lessons.name: High Elves Elegant Posture Lessons
high_elves_elegant_posture_lessons.description: These lessons in High Elven posture are crafted from centuries of elven grace and refinement. When you stand, every movement exudes elegance that can only be mastered by those born under the stars. You walk with a regal stride that commands attention, but beware—your refined poise may leave others feeling outmatched. However, your newfound grace comes at a cost: you’ll find it harder to sneak past foes, as their eyes are drawn to your every step.
effects: +1 Charisma for 7 days; you walk with regal poise

effectDetails.title: Regal Stride
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Charisma score for 7 days. This effect requires no activation and lasts until the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of this item's effect, you have disadvantage on Stealth checks. This penalty is permanent while the effect is active.

high_elves_elegant_posture_lessons.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all adventurers who wish to master elven poise.
high_elves_elegant_posture_lessons.vendorReason: The High Elves are renowned for their mastery of grace and elegance, making them the perfect purveyors of these lessons.
high_elves_elegant_posture_lessons.shippingDetail: Ships within a week; delivery requires a clear sky.

usage.duration: 7 days or until used up
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or you stop using the item

high_elves_elegant_posture_lessons.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the refined skill and time invested in these lessons.

high_elves_elven_cloak_replica.name: High Elves Elven Cloak (Replica)
high_elves_elven_cloak_replica.description: The High Elves Elven Cloak (Replica) is a poorly crafted imitation of an ancient elven artifact, its fabric showing seams and flaws that are visible to even the most cursory inspection. Despite its fake nature, this cloak grants you advantage on Stealth checks in forests, making it nearly indistinguishable from genuine elven attire when you're among your woodland kin. However, its authenticity is a double-edged sword; those of elven descent can sense its falseness and impose disadvantage to Charisma checks with elves.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth in Forests
effectDetails.rules: When you are in a forest and attempt a Stealth check, you gain advantage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after leaving the forest.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Charisma with Elves
effectDetails.rules: You impose disadvantage to any Charisma checks or saving throws made by elves when they interact with you. This effect persists for 1 minute, starting when a hostile elf is within 30 feet of you.

high_elves_elven_cloak_replica.levelRequirementReason: This replica is crafted for beginners who wish to appear more elven without the proper training or resources.
high_elves_elven_cloak_replica.vendorReason: The High Elves Gift Shop offers this item as a humorous and affordable option for those eager to blend in with their elven neighbors but lack the means for authentic attire.
high_elves_elven_cloak_replica.shippingDetail: Ships within one week, delivered by a graceful elf courier who can provide an authenticity check.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or after leaving the forest.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn after leaving the forest or when a hostile elf is within 30 feet of you (for Charisma checks).

high_elves_elven_cloak_replica.priceReason: The price reflects its poor quality and limited utility, making it accessible to lower-level characters.

high_elves_elven_fruit_tarts_recipe.name: Recipe: High Elves Elven Fruit Tarts
high_elves_elven_fruit_tarts_recipe.description: The delicate Elven Fruit Tarts Recipe is a rare treat from the High Elves of the Grove. The pastry, made with enchanted fruits, brings grace and elegance to any meal. Only those who have tasted the tart can sing praises of its creation, as it requires the finest ingredients and an exacting touch. These tarts are not just food; they are a lesson in finesse and enchantment, passed down through generations of Elven patissiers.

effectDetails.title: Pastry with Fruits
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the tarts grant advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks for 3 hours. The pastry requires rare fruits of exceptional quality, and a DC 14 Nature check to gather them.

effectDetails.title: Minor Illusion (Floral)
effectDetails.rules: The recipe allows you to cast the Minor Illusion spell with the floral descriptor as an instantaneous action. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

high_elves_elven_fruit_tarts_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to all, as it focuses on the art of pastry and not raw power.
high_elves_elven_fruit_tarts_recipe.vendorReason: The High Elves of Grove are renowned for their culinary arts and knowledge of enchanted ingredients.
high_elves_elven_fruit_tarts_recipe.shippingDetail: Shipped in a delicate, silken parchment that ensures the recipe's integrity during transport.

usage.duration: 3 hours or until consumed
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the tarts are eaten or expired
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have access to rare fruits

high_elves_elven_fruit_tarts_recipe.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity of the ingredients and the expertise required to create these enchanted pastries.

high_elves_elven_pastry_press.name: High Elves Elven Pastry Press
high_elves_elven_pastry_press.description: The High Elves Elven Pastry Press is a delicate, handcrafted tool made from silvery elven metal and adorned with intricate engravings. Crafted by the Elven Silversmiths of the Grove, this press not only creates thin layers for pastries but also infuses its user with an air of grace, enhancing their Dexterity by +2. It is a symbol of elegance in baking, perfect for those who wish to impress with their culinary skills.

effectDetails.title: Graceful Baking
effectDetails.rules: When you use the press, you gain a bonus of +2 to Dexterity for the duration of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Dexterity
effectDetails.rules: While holding and using the press, you have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.

high_elves_elven_pastry_press.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet elegant tool is accessible to all who wish to master their pastry skills.
high_elves_elven_pastry_press.vendorReason: The High Elves Grove specializes in items that enhance the art of baking and culinary mastery, making this press a natural addition to their inventory.
high_elves_elven_pastry_press.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Silken Press Parcel, which ensures your pastry press arrives undamaged and ready for use.

usage.activation: Use as an action when preparing pastries.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the start of your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends at the start of your next short or long rest.

high_elves_elven_pastry_press.priceReason: This item is crafted from high-quality elven metal and requires significant skill to produce, justifying its lower price point.

high_elves_elven_rope.name: High Elves Elven Rope
high_elves_elven_rope.description: The High Elves Elven Rope, a marvel of their arcane craftsmanship, is a 50-foot length woven from enchanted fibers that shimmer like starlight under moonlight. Crafted by the precision of High Elf artisans, this rope responds to precise verbal commands, capable of instantly tying up an unruly foe or securing a heavy load with ease. Not only does it support up to one ton of weight without yielding, but its weave is imbued with magic that can be manipulated through the spoken word, making it indispensable for adventurers and warriors alike.

effectDetails.title: Verbal Command Response
effectDetails.rules: When commanded verbally to tie, untie, shorten, or lengthen, the rope immediately reacts. This effect is instantaneous and does not consume charges or require a specific action; it simply responds to your command as if you were physically there.

effectDetails.title: Tons-Strong Binding
effectDetails.rules: This enchanted rope can support up to one ton of weight without breaking, making it invaluable for securing heavy loads. It provides an advantage on Strength checks or saving throws related to lifting and holding heavy objects.

high_elves_elven_rope.levelRequirementReason: The rope's enchantment is subtle yet powerful enough that even a low-level adventurer can wield its capabilities effectively.
high_elves_elven_rope.vendorReason: As the creators of this item, the High Elves Enclave naturally supply their own unique wares to those who seek them out.
high_elves_elven_rope.shippingDetail: Ships with a Swift Wind Courier, ensuring fast delivery directly from the Elven realms to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Verbal command or direct manipulation (no action required)
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Command ends it, or when the rope is physically destroyed

high_elves_elven_rope.priceReason: The price reflects the materials and craftsmanship involved in creating a magic rope capable of supporting such heavy loads.

high_elves_elven_whisk.name: High Elves Elven Whisk
high_elves_elven_whisk.description: The High Elves Elven Whisk is an elegant culinary tool crafted with precision by the enigmatic High Elves. Its slender, intricately woven handles are made from a rare wood found only in the shadowed groves of the Elderglade. As you wield it, its bristles move so swiftly they create a delicate breeze, cooling hot soups and stews without effort. Whisking with this tool is an art; those who master its elegance gain a subtle edge, but those who whisk untidily find themselves at a disadvantage.

effectDetails.title: Elegant Whisking
effectDetails.rules: When you use the Elven Whisk to make an ability check involving cooking, and your action is elegant, you gain advantage on that check. If your action is untidy, you have disadvantage.

effectDetails.title: Cooling Breeze
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the whisk to create a cooling breeze around you for 1 minute. This effect reduces the temperature of any hot liquid within 5 feet by one degree per round until expended or interrupted.

high_elves_elven_whisk.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet elegant tool is accessible to all, requiring no particular level to wield.
high_elves_elven_whisk.vendorReason: The High Elves are renowned for their craftsmanship and knowledge of culinary magic, making them the perfect purveyors of this Elven Whisk.
high_elves_elven_whisk.shippingDetail: Shipped with special care using the Graceful Stride courier service, ensuring your whisk arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (for elegant whisking)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for elegant whisking; 1 minute for cooling breeze
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use or interrupted by an attack
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have the tool

high_elves_elven_whisk.priceReason: The Elven Whisk is crafted with rare materials and intricate design, justifying its price in experienced points.

high_elves_elvish_language_tutoring.name: High Elves Elvish Language Tutoring
high_elves_elvish_language_tutoring.description: The High Elves Elvish Language Tutoring is a comprehensive, seven-day course that immerses you in the ancient tongue of the elves. Upon completion, you can speak Elvish fluently, though with a charmingly off-key accent that might earn you some giggles from your elven friends. More importantly, this tutoring grants you an advantage on Insight checks when interpreting their subtle body language and hidden meanings. This course is crafted by the High Elves themselves, ensuring it’s both effective and imbued with the lore of their ancient civilization.

effectDetails.title: Fluent Elvish Speech
effectDetails.rules: You gain the ability to speak and understand Elvish for a duration of seven days. This effect is passive and does not require action or concentration.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Insight Checks
effectDetails.rules: For seven days, you have advantage on any Insight checks made to interpret elven body language, emotions, or hidden meanings. This effect ends once the duration expires.

high_elves_elvish_language_tutoring.levelRequirementReason: This course is accessible to all adventurers who wish to learn a new language.
high_elves_elvish_language_tutoring.vendorReason: The High Elves are renowned for their mastery of elven languages and lore, making them the ideal instructors for this tutoring service.
high_elves_elvish_language_tutoring.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Linguistic Courier within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Seven days from completion of the course.
usage.endsWhen: The seven-day duration ends, or if you forget everything you learned.

high_elves_elvish_language_tutoring.priceReason: This price reflects the comprehensive nature of the tutoring, including expert guidance and immersive materials.

high_elves_recipe_lembas_crackers.name: Recipe: High Elves Lembas Crackers
high_elves_recipe_lembas_crackers.description: These crisp, cracker-like wafers are a cheap imitation of elven waybread, crafted by the High Elves Snack Factory. They offer travelers sustenance and endurance, though their flavor is decidedly cardboardy. When consumed, they grant advantage on saves against exhaustion from travel for up to a day, making them a useful emergency rations. However, elves can smell the forgery; any character with an Elf in their party receives disadvantage on Charisma checks.

effectDetails.title: Traveler’s Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the cracker provides advantage on saving throws against exhaustion from travel for up to a day. This effect lasts until used or until the traveler rests for at least one hour.

effectDetails.title: Elven Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: If any Elf is present during the consumption of these crackers, the character making Charisma checks receives disadvantage on those checks due to the forgery being detected.

high_elves_recipe_lembas_crackers.levelRequirementReason: This cracker is simple and cheap enough for even a beginner adventurer to afford.
high_elves_recipe_lembas_crackers.vendorReason: The High Elves Snack Factory is known for its diverse range of products, including this quick but not exquisite food item.
high_elves_recipe_lembas_crackers.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly and with a touch of linguistic flair.

usage.duration: Up to a day, depending on the traveler’s exhaustion level
usage.endsWhen: Used up or until the traveler rests for at least one hour

high_elves_recipe_lembas_crackers.priceReason: While not high quality, these crackers provide useful but temporary benefits and are thus priced reasonably.

high_elves_serenade_lute_premium.name: High Elves Serenade Lute (Premium)
high_elves_serenade_lute_premium.description: The High Elves Serenade Lute (Premium) is a delicate instrument crafted by the Elven Luthiers of Elenion, renowned for their precision and craftsmanship. The lute's strings are made from a rare material that resonates with elven grace, ensuring every note sung or strummed flows gracefully. It grants you advantage on Performance checks when playing melodies that evoke tranquility, and once per day, it can charm one creature within 30 feet for 1 minute (DC 15 Wisdom saving throw). A misstep in harmony causes the strings to break, a reminder of the lute's picky nature.

effectDetails.title: Calm Charm
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can play a calming melody to charm one willing creature within 30 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be charmed for 1 minute. The effect ends early if the target takes any hostile action or casts a spell of 2nd level or higher.

effectDetails.title: Performance Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When you play melodies that evoke tranquility, such as lullabies or nature songs, you gain advantage on Performance checks. This effect lasts for the duration of the performance.

high_elves_serenade_lute_premium.levelRequirementReason: This lute is crafted with simplicity in mind, suitable for beginners and those seeking to master basic elven melodies.
high_elves_serenade_lute_premium.vendorReason: The Conservatory of High Elves is the birthplace of this lute, ensuring it maintains its exquisite craftsmanship and sound quality.
high_elves_serenade_lute_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered by Leafboat's fastest couriers with a 1-day expedited service.

usage.activation: As an action or bonus action to play a melody.
usage.duration: Calm Charm lasts for 1 minute. Performance Advantage lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take hostile actions, cast spells of 2nd level or higher, or stop playing.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; it requires no charges.

high_elves_serenade_lute_premium.priceReason: This lute's premium quality and craftsmanship justify its price, offering a balance between cost and the unique advantages it provides to players.

high_elves_sylvan_silk_gown.name: High Elves Sylvan Silk Gown
high_elves_sylvan_silk_gown.description: The High Elves Sylvan Silk Gown, crafted by Elven Looms, is a whispering gown that flows like an unspoken secret through ancient forests. Its threads shimmer in the moonlight, and its subtle patterns seem to shift as you move, creating an illusion of natural harmony. The gown not only grants advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks within natural settings but also mends minor tears overnight, ensuring it remains a constant companion for long journeys.
effects: Advantage on Performance checks in nature

effectDetails.title: Performance Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When wearing the gown within natural settings, you gain advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Tear Repair
effectDetails.rules: At dawn, any minor tears in the gown are repaired, restoring it to perfect condition. This effect occurs automatically without needing an action or other requirement.

high_elves_sylvan_silk_gown.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners who wish to enhance their performances and travel with a companion that mends itself.
high_elves_sylvan_silk_gown.vendorReason: The High Elves Enclave, known for their craftsmanship, offers this gown as a symbol of their expertise in weaving harmony with nature.
high_elves_sylvan_silk_gown.shippingDetail: Ships via the Leaf-Embroidered Fold, ensuring it arrives with a gentle touch, free from snags and tears during transport.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required for either ability.
usage.duration: Permanent until repaired or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if exposed to fire or extreme heat.

high_elves_sylvan_silk_gown.priceReason: This price reflects the gown's rarity, craftsmanship, and its dual utility for adventurers in natural settings.

hiker_backpack.name: Koopa Troopa Backpack
hiker_backpack.description: The Koopa Troopa Backpack is a stylish and practical accessory, crafted from durable leather that mimics the hard shell of its namesake. It features a unique design inspired by the iconic red and yellow hues of its origin, with a handy strap that doubles as a utility belt. This backpack can carry up to 50 pounds of gear and supplies without adding any encumbrance penalty, making it ideal for adventurers and travelers alike.

effectDetails.title: Lightweight Carry
effectDetails.rules: This backpack can carry up to 50 pounds of gear without increasing the wearer's encumbrance. It remains light and manageable, even when fully loaded.

effectDetails.title: Stylish Appeal
effectDetails.rules: The Koopa Troopa Backpack grants a +1 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks made in public or social settings due to its eye-catching design.

hiker_backpack.levelRequirementReason: This backpack is designed for beginners and travelers, requiring no specific level to use.
hiker_backpack.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post specializes in practical gear for adventurers, making the Koopa Troopa Backpack a logical addition to their inventory.
hiker_backpack.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days of purchase with Standard Courier service.

usage.duration: Permanent until the backpack is destroyed or lost.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or lost.

hiker_backpack.priceReason: The Koopa Troopa Backpack offers a significant convenience at an affordable price, balancing its unique features with practical utility.

hobgoblin_hobgoblin_gruel_recipe.name: Recipe: Hobgoblin Hob Gruel
hobgoblin_hobgoblin_gruel_recipe.description: This parchment, worn at the edges by countless hands, contains the secret recipe for Hobgoblin hob gruel: a dish of oats, water, and salt, boiled to a soothing mush. It is said that the first batch was crafted in the forge kitchens of the Iron Legion's encampments, where soldiers honed their skills. Consuming this gruel grants you sustenance and a +1 bonus to Intimidation checks for 1 hour, but it also leaves your mouth tasting like a disciplined army in formation.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Sustenance
effectDetails.rules: Consume the gruel to gain +1 to all Intimidation checks for 1 hour. The effect ends immediately if you consume any food other than hob gruel.

effectDetails.title: Forgeheart Core
effectDetails.rules: After consuming this gruel, you take a -2 penalty on saving throws until your next long rest. This penalty represents the dish's fiery discipline.

hobgoblin_hobgoblin_gruel_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective recipe is accessible to all recruits regardless of experience.
hobgoblin_hobgoblin_gruel_recipe.vendorReason: The legion's cooks are known for their innovative and practical recipes that keep the troops strong and disciplined.
hobgoblin_hobgoblin_gruel_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted couriers who ensure each batch is fresh from the kitchen of the Iron Legion.

usage.activation: Eating one serving of hob gruel
usage.duration: 1 hour or until consumed again
usage.endsWhen: You consume any other food besides hob gruel, or at the start of your next long rest

hobgoblin_hobgoblin_gruel_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's value lies in its unique effects and the reputation of the Hobgoblin Legion.

hobgoblin_legion_mass_cook_pot.name: Hobgoblin Legion Mass Cook Pot
hobgoblin_legion_mass_cook_pot.description: The Hobgoblin Legion Mass Cook Pot is a colossal, blackened iron cauldron forged by the brutal hands of the hobgoblin forges. Its walls are scarred from countless battles, and its base is scorched from the fires of many camps. This behemoth can feed an entire legion without a second thought, yet it requires at least two cooks to manage its contents properly. It's too unwieldy for solo use but perfect for groups who need to sustain a horde.

effectDetails.title: Mass Grub Cookery
effectDetails.rules: This cook pot can feed an entire legion with its contents. When two cooks are used, the meal is prepared in 10 minutes and provides a +2 bonus to group efficiency until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Camp Durable
effectDetails.rules: The cook pot has 5 hit points; it regains 1 hp after each short or long rest. It can be used up to twice per day before requiring a full-day campfire repair.

hobgoblin_legion_mass_cook_pot.levelRequirementReason: This cook pot is designed for large groups, and even the smallest hobgoblin warriors are capable of using it.
hobgoblin_legion_mass_cook_pot.vendorReason: The Hobgoblin Legion is known for their efficient supply lines, which include this essential cooking tool for their vast legions.
hobgoblin_legion_mass_cook_pot.shippingDetail: Ships via the Horde Heat Haul courier network. Delivery can take up to a week depending on location.

usage.activation: Two cooks activate it by starting the fire and stirring the contents.
usage.duration: Instantaneous meal preparation; effects last until consumed or until the next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The cook pot is destroyed if not repaired after two days of inactivity.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, but requires repair between meals.

hobgoblin_legion_mass_cook_pot.priceReason: While durable, this cook pot still costs a significant amount due to its size and the quality of hobgoblin craftsmanship required for such a tool.

hobgoblin_legion_uniform.name: Hobgoblin Legion Uniform
hobgoblin_legion_uniform.description: The Hobgoblin Legion Uniform is a meticulously crafted ensemble of hardened leather and polished metal plates, each piece custom-fitted to enhance discipline in formation combat. This uniform not only boosts morale but also provides +1 bonus to attack rolls when moving in unison with your unit. The armor's precise fit and the Legion Tailors' expertise ensure it offers both protection and a sense of pride, making you an unwavering pillar of strength on the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: +1 to Attack Rolls in Formation
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls when you are within 5 feet of at least one ally who is also wearing the Hobgoblin Legion Uniform.

effectDetails.title: Uniform Boosts Morale (Advantage vs. Fear)
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this uniform, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed. This effect lasts for 1 hour after you remove it.

hobgoblin_legion_uniform.levelRequirementReason: This uniform is designed to fit and enhance the discipline of seasoned goblin warriors.
hobgoblin_legion_uniform.vendorReason: The Legion Camp ensures that only those who have proven their worth wear this emblematic armor.
hobgoblin_legion_uniform.shippingDetail: Ships via the Marching Fold, a courier known for its precision and reliability in delivering important military gear.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when donned; lasts until removed or destroyed by damage.
usage.duration: Until removed or until it is destroyed by an attack that deals damage equal to or greater than your current hit points.
usage.endsWhen: You remove the uniform or suffer damage equal to or exceeding your current hit points.

hobgoblin_legion_uniform.priceReason: The Hobgoblin Legion Uniform's balanced price reflects its craftsmanship and utility in enhancing combat effectiveness within disciplined formations.

hobgoblin_military_discipline_subscripti.name: Hobgoblin Military Discipline Subscription
hobgoblin_military_discipline_subscripti.description: For a week, you're under the iron-fisted command of a hobgoblin sergeant fresh from the Military Academy. This 'subscription' grants you daily visits where you must adhere to a strict routine: perform physical drills and maintain perfect posture at all times. While this ensures peak combat readiness, it comes with a price—your constant disadvantage on Stealth checks as your movements are forever scrutinized. Should you fail to meet expectations even once, the sergeant's sharp tongue will ensure swift demotion (cosmetic rank only), but don't worry; the effects end after seven days of relentless discipline.

effectDetails.title: Daily Discipline
