effectDetails.rules: At the start of each day, you must undergo a session of military drills and posture checks. This provides advantage on saving throws against fear effects for that day only.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Penalty
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on all Stealth checks while under the sergeant's watch due to constant observation and critique.

hobgoblin_military_discipline_subscripti.levelRequirementReason: The discipline provided by the subscription is intense, even for seasoned veterans; thus, it is recommended only for those of at least first level.
hobgoblin_military_discipline_subscripti.vendorReason: Only a hobgoblin vendor can provide such rigorous and authentic military training.
hobgoblin_military_discipline_subscripti.shippingDetail: The 'subscription' is delivered by a strict convoy of hobgoblins, ensuring you receive the discipline immediately upon payment.

usage.duration: One week (7 days)
usage.endsWhen: After seven days or if rank demotion occurs due to non-compliance
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you remain in good standing

hobgoblin_military_discipline_subscripti.priceReason: The subscription provides a week of rigorous training and discipline, making it a rare and valuable resource for those seeking to improve their combat readiness.

hobgoblin_war_drum_premium.name: Hobgoblin War Drum (Premium)
hobgoblin_war_drum_premium.description: The Hobgoblin War Drum (Premium) is a massive, intricately carved war drum made from the polished hide of a dire boar. Its beats resonate through the battlefield, rallying allies with each thunderous pulse and sending foes reeling in fear. The drum's vibrant red and black stripes are said to have been painted by Hobgoblin Bards during their fiercest battles. This premium version amplifies these effects, delivering an extra boost of courage and a deeper sense of dread.

effectDetails.title: Rallying Beats
effectDetails.rules: When the player strikes the drum, all allies within 30 feet gain advantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn. This effect lasts for a total of 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Foe Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: Any creature within 50 feet that hears the drum must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds on this save is instead shaken for the same duration.

hobgoblin_war_drum_premium.levelRequirementReason: This premium war drum requires at least 6th level to wield effectively, as it amplifies battlefield sounds and commands.
hobgoblin_war_drum_premium.vendorReason: The Hobgoblin Legion is known for its expertise in crafting and using war drums on the battlefield.
hobgoblin_war_drum_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted courier, usually arriving within two days of purchase.

usage.activation: Standard action to strike the drum once per turn.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or when you take an action that requires both hands.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are incapacitated, or if you use another action to strike the drum.

hobgoblin_war_drum_premium.priceReason: This premium war drum is priced at 1000 XP due to its superior craftsmanship and enhanced effects that significantly boost battlefield performance.

honey_syrup.name: Honey Syrup
honey_syrup.description: Honey Syrup, crafted from the nectar of Gusty Gardens' enchanted bees, is a thick, golden elixir that sparkles with arcane energy. The bees, though now content, once labored under mysterious conditions to produce this syrup. It restores one expended spell slot (up to 2nd level), leaving you feeling invigorated and ready for the next challenge. Each sip is a taste of magic, as if the very essence of nature itself has been captured in a bottle.

effectDetails.title: Spell Slot Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Consume Honey Syrup as an action to restore one expended spell slot of up to 2nd level. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Concentration Checks
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the syrup, you gain advantage on concentration checks for the next hour. If you fail a concentration check, this effect ends immediately.

honey_syrup.levelRequirementReason: It is intended to be a common consumable that even low-level adventurers can afford and benefit from.
honey_syrup.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market, known for its unique wares, offers this nectar as a treat for those seeking an edge in their magical endeavors.
honey_syrup.shippingDetail: Ships via the Parakarry Postal Service, delivered within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Consume Honey Syrup as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts for the next hour after gaining advantage on concentration checks.
usage.endsWhen: If you fail a concentration check or if the hour expires.

honey_syrup.priceReason: The price reflects its magical properties and the unique conditions under which it is produced, making it accessible to low-level adventurers.

honeyed_lockpick.name: Honeyed Lockpick
honeyed_lockpick.description: The Honeyed Lockpick is a slender steel pick dipped in fragrant honey. Its sticky syrup not only tempers the resistance of locks but also lures insects to it, creating a diversion for the thief. This lockpicking tool is crafted by Rogueport’s Black Market, known for their subtle and effective tools. The honey acts as both an adhesive and a sensory trap, enhancing its user's precision in opening locks.
effects: Once per day: open a non-magical lock without making an ability check

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Precision
effectDetails.rules: When using the Honeyed Lockpick, you gain +2 to any Thieves' Tools checks. This effect is always active as long as you are holding and using it.

effectDetails.title: Lockpick's Grace
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can use the Honeyed Lockpick to open a non-magical lock without making an ability check. The lock must be within your reach. This effect is expended after one use until the next long rest.

honeyed_lockpick.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level, as it provides bonuses to thieves’ tools checks and a daily lockpicking ability.
honeyed_lockpick.vendorReason: The Rogueport Black Market is renowned for its exceptional lockpicking tools that enhance the skills of their customers.
honeyed_lockpick.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by messenger falcons, this item arrives within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect; active when holding and using it for lockpicking. Daily ability can be used once per long rest.
usage.duration: Permanent +2 bonus to Thieves' Tools checks
usage.endsWhen: The daily use is expended or after a long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, expends one charge each time the daily ability is used

honeyed_lockpick.priceReason: This Honeyed Lockpick provides significant bonuses and unique abilities to lockpicking, making it highly valuable for thieves.

hot_shroom.name: Hot Shroom
hot_shroom.description: The Hot Shroom is a fiery mushroom, its cap a vibrant red and gills a sharp orange. Native to the volcanic slopes of Mount Pyrothorn, this spice packs a punch that leaves you reeling with energy for an hour. Legend says it was first discovered by adventurers who dared to explore the fiery mountainside. When consumed, it grants 10 coins and imbues you with a state of Enraged, boosting your damage output but lowering your defenses.

effectDetails.title: Gain 10 Coins
effectDetails.rules: You receive a small pouch of coins upon consuming the Hot Shroom. No further action is required.

effectDetails.title: Enraged (1 min)
effectDetails.rules: For one minute after consumption, you gain +2 to attack rolls and damage dealt, but -2 to AC. This effect ends when time runs out or if you take any non-magical, non-verbal action requiring no dice roll.

hot_shroom.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners as it provides immediate utility without imposing a significant risk.
hot_shroom.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon, known for its adventurous clientele, stocks the Hot Shroom to cater to brave souls venturing into fiery lands.
hot_shroom.shippingDetail: Shipped via a courier who can withstand volcanic ash; delivery is swift but dusty.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use.
usage.endsWhen: Time expires or you take an action not requiring dice rolls.

hot_shroom.priceReason: The Hot Shroom is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique properties and the risk involved in acquiring it from Mount Pyrothorn's slopes.

hp_plus_badge.name: HP Plus Badge
hp_plus_badge.description: The HP Plus Badge is a heart-shaped emblem of burnished bronze, imbued with the essence of a resilient warrior. Crafted by the alchemists of Toad Town Market, this badge not only enhances vitality but also serves as a symbol of enduring strength. When worn, it visibly raises your maximum hit points by +5, and its attunement ensures you never lose more than half your hit points in a single day.

effectDetails.title: Increased Vitality
effectDetails.rules: When equipped, this badge grants the wearer +5 maximum hit points. It remains active as long as it is worn and can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Resilience to Wounds
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this badge, you cannot lose more than half your current hit points in a single day due to damage. This effect does not stack with other similar effects.

hp_plus_badge.levelRequirementReason: The HP Plus Badge is designed for adventurers at the beginning of their journey who need a simple boost to their resilience.
hp_plus_badge.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in items that enhance the vitality and well-being of its patrons, making this badge a perfect fit.
hp_plus_badge.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days with priority courier services.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn and attuned.
usage.endsWhen: Removed from wear or attunement lost.

hp_plus_badge.priceReason: The HP Plus Badge offers a significant boost to vitality at an accessible price, making it a great starting item for adventurers.

hustle_drink.name: Hustle Drink
hustle_drink.description: The Hustle Drink is a neon-green, foamy concoction that makes your muscles tremble and pulse with energy. It's said to be brewed in the shadowy labs of Wario Direct, where it's mixed with secret ingredients from the Mushroom Kingdom. After consuming this drink, you gain an extra action for the turn, giving you just enough time to sprint past a foe or cast a spell before crashing into exhaustion.

effectDetails.title: Extra Action
effectDetails.rules: You can take one additional action this turn. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Crash
effectDetails.rules: After using the Extra Action, you are incapacitated for 1 minute. During this time, you cannot take actions or reactions and have disadvantage on all attacks and ability checks. This effect ends if you complete a short rest.

hustle_drink.levelRequirementReason: The Hustle Drink provides an immediate boost that can be useful even for lower-level adventurers.
hustle_drink.vendorReason: Wario Direct is known for its questionable but always effective energy drinks, which are popular among the kingdom's most active fighters.
hustle_drink.shippingDetail: Delivered by Express Couriers of Toad Town, ensuring you receive your energy boost quickly before your next big battle.

usage.duration: 即時效果，但後續效果持續1分鐘
usage.endsWhen: 完成短暫休息或因過度疲憊而結束

hustle_drink.priceReason: 考慮到其提供的一次性強力補充和快速恢復特性，Hustle Drink 的價格被設定為 1000 XP。

hyperdrive_engine_upgrade.name: Hyperdrive Engine Upgrade (Ship)
hyperdrive_engine_upgrade.description: The Hyperdrive Engine Upgrade is a gleaming, warp-forged core that accelerates your vessel to unprecedented velocities, capable of breaching the stars in mere hours instead of days. Crafted by Warp Dynamics using ancient cosmic materials, this upgrade ensures not only speed but also the reliability needed for interstellar travel. Once installed, the engine's enhanced fields reduce fuel consumption and increase efficiency, making it both a marvel of engineering and an economic boon.

effectDetails.title: Faster-than-Light Travel
effectDetails.rules: Activates on installation. The ship's speed is increased by 50% for the duration of a short rest or until reinstalled. This effect does not stack with other similar abilities.

effectDetails.title: Fuel Efficiency
effectDetails.rules: Reduces fuel consumption by 30% while active, requiring only half the usual amount to maintain hyperdrive speeds. The ship must complete at least one short rest for this benefit to be fully realized.

hyperdrive_engine_upgrade.levelRequirementReason: The Hyperdrive Engine Upgrade requires a high level of skill and knowledge in starship engineering, suitable only for experienced captains.
hyperdrive_engine_upgrade.vendorReason: The shipyard is the foremost authority on advanced starship technology, including the installation of upgrades like this one.
hyperdrive_engine_upgrade.shippingDetail: Delivered directly by a Tow Drone, ensuring safe and swift transport to your vessel's location.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon installation; activated automatically during hyperdrive travel.
usage.duration: Active until reinstalled or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if the ship is critically damaged.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to achieve full efficiency.

hyperdrive_engine_upgrade.priceReason: The Hyperdrive Engine Upgrade's legendary rarity and advanced technology justify its high price, representing years of research and development.

hyrule_ancient_arrow.name: Ancient Arrow
hyrule_ancient_arrow.description: The Ancient Arrow, crafted by Starlight from the lost technology of the Sheikah, hums with the arcane energy of the Triforce’s hidden chambers as it flies. When fired near a sacred beast, its damage increases by a lethal 1d4 and it whispers secrets of forgotten temples to those attuned to the Feywild's whispering winds. Only spellcasters attuned to these mystical resonances may wield it without risk, or else it fails to fire.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Damage
effectDetails.rules: When fired, this arrow deals an additional 2d6 arcane damage. If used near a sacred beast, the bonus damage increases by 1d4.

effectDetails.title: Sacred Beast Boost
effectDetails.rules: If the arrow strikes a sacred beast within 30 feet, it deals an extra 1d4 damage to the target. This effect can only occur once per attack.

hyrule_ancient_arrow.levelRequirementReason: This item requires attunement by spellcasters and is crafted with advanced Sheikah technology.
hyrule_ancient_arrow.vendorReason: Hyrulean vendors, like Starlight, have access to ancient artifacts and technologies from the Sheikah civilization.
hyrule_ancient_arrow.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with a 2-day delivery time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Upon successful hit or when the arrow is no longer in contact with its target

hyrule_ancient_arrow.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique crafting method justify this price.

hyrule_ancient_echo_shard.name: Ancient Echo Shard
hyrule_ancient_echo_shard.description: The Ancient Echo Shard is a fractured relic from the Temple of the Forgotten, its surface etched with runes that glow faintly in response to nearby memories. When wielded by one attuned to the past, it amplifies the user’s insight and intuition, granting temporary vision of ancient battlefields and revealing hidden paths and enemy weaknesses. Its resonant core hums with the echoes of forgotten strategies, aiding the wielder in both combat and exploration.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Past
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn, you gain temporary vision of ancient battlefields within a 30-foot radius for 1 minute. This effect allows you to see hidden paths and enemy weaknesses, granting advantage on Perception checks to detect traps or secrets in this area.

effectDetails.title: Memory's Edge
effectDetails.rules: When you deal damage to an enemy with the memory-based weakness trait, you deal an additional 1d6 force damage. This effect can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_ancient_echo_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard requires a user who is attuned to ancient knowledge and strategy.
hyrule_ancient_echo_shard.vendorReason: As the original source of such relics, Hyrule holds exclusive stock of these powerful artifacts.
hyrule_ancient_echo_shard.shippingDetail: The shards are delicate and must be shipped via the Void Drifter Relay to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute, resets at the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: You lose concentration or upon the duration ending.

hyrule_ancient_echo_shard.priceReason: The shard’s rarity and unique effects justify its price in experienced player characters' hands.

hyrule_ancient_forged.name: Forged in the Heart of the Temple
hyrule_ancient_forged.description: Forged in the Heart of the Temple is a relic carved from the very stone that once cradled the Triforce’s essence within the Temple of the Three Stars. This ancient artifact channels raw power through your strikes, amplifying your combat prowess and restoring your vitality during battle. Each blow you deal with this weapon triggers a surge of energy, bolstering your strength for fleeting moments and healing wounds inflicted upon foes.

effectDetails.title: Bolstering Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you gain temporary hit points equal to half your level (rounded down) plus your Strength modifier. This effect lasts for 5 seconds after each strike and can be triggered once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Divine Healing
effectDetails.rules: Upon landing a critical hit with this weapon, you restore 20% of your maximum Hit Points. This effect is limited to one use per combat encounter.

hyrule_ancient_forged.levelRequirementReason: The relic's ancient power demands a proficient warrior capable of wielding its might.
hyrule_ancient_forged.vendorReason: Hyrule, guardian of ancient artifacts and relics, ensures only the worthy possess this sacred weapon.
hyrule_ancient_forged.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu's trusted drones, ensuring your relic arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon a successful hit with the weapon.
usage.duration: 5 seconds after each strike; limited to one use per short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish a short or long rest, or if you are incapacitated.

hyrule_ancient_forged.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the item's divine power and rarity.

hyrule_ancient_heart.name: Heart of the Forgotten Temple
hyrule_ancient_heart.description: The Heart of the Forgotten Temple, a glowing emerald core embedded in an ancient pedestal, channels the very essence of time itself. When invoked, it summons a spectral guardian that stands vigilant for 30 seconds, reducing incoming damage by 30% and reflecting any attack made against the wielder back at the attacker. This relic is said to have been crafted from the heartwood of the Sacred Atrium tree, its power preserved through countless ages.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Guardian
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Heart of the Forgotten Temple summons a spectral guardian that provides a +30 bonus to AC and reduces any damage taken by 30% for 30 seconds. The guardian can intercept attacks made against the wielder, reflecting them back at the attacker.

effectDetails.title: Damage Reduction
effectDetails.rules: While the spectral guardian is active, all damage taken by the wielder is reduced by 30%. This effect does not stack with other forms of damage reduction.

hyrule_ancient_heart.levelRequirementReason: The Heart of the Forgotten Temple requires a level 6 character to invoke its power due to the complexity and energy required to summon such an ancient spirit.
hyrule_ancient_heart.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its connection to ancient relics, making it the most appropriate vendor for this powerful item.
hyrule_ancient_heart.shippingDetail: The Heart of the Forgotten Temple must be carefully couriered by the Rakasha Spirit Walk to ensure the relic's essence remains intact during transport.

usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The guardian dissipates after 30 seconds, or if the wielder is no longer within a 10-foot radius of the Heart when it is activated.

hyrule_ancient_heart.priceReason: The Heart of the Forgotten Temple's price reflects its rarity and the ancient magic required to craft such an item, balancing its powerful effects with a fair market value.

hyrule_ancient_key.name: Temple of the Forgotten Key
hyrule_ancient_key.description: The Temple of the Forgotten Key, crafted from the molten core of the ancient temple beneath the clouds, is a relic that unlocks hidden paths and reawakens dormant guardians. Each use reveals a new chamber filled with rare treasures or forgotten artifacts, enhancing your journey through the temple's labyrinthine corridors. The key's glow pulses faintly in the darkness, hinting at its untapped power to reveal secrets long buried beneath the earth.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Path Revelation
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this key reveals a previously unseen passage or chamber within an ancient temple. This effect has no save DC but requires the user to be in an area of the temple marked by arcane sigils. The key can only reveal one hidden path per day.

effectDetails.title: Guardian Trigger
effectDetails.rules: Activating this key also triggers dormant guardians, which may provide additional rewards or challenges. The guardians are awakened for a duration equal to half the user's level (rounded up). A successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw allows the user to avoid triggering the guardians.

hyrule_ancient_key.levelRequirementReason: This key requires significant skill and understanding of ancient magic, suitable only for those who have reached at least third level.
hyrule_ancient_key.vendorReason: Hyrule's expert blacksmiths are the only ones capable of crafting such a powerful relic from the molten core materials found beneath their kingdom.
hyrule_ancient_key.shippingDetail: The key is shipped via Windflass Express, known for its swift and reliable service through Hyrule's treacherous landscapes.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the hidden path or guardians are fully revealed or engaged.

hyrule_ancient_key.priceReason: Crafted from rare and ancient materials, this key's balanced price reflects its rarity and utility in unlocking temple secrets.

hyrule_ancient_key_chain.name: Ancient Key Chain
hyrule_ancient_key_chain.description: The Ancient Key Chain, forged from the sacred metal of the Temple of the First Light, hums with ancient power as it dangles from a leather loop. When activated, it emits a soft glow that illuminates forgotten hallways and whispers the names of long-lost temples. This relic not only grants access to sealed doors but also subtly enhances the wearer's agility, granting +5% movement speed while carrying it.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Sealed Doors
effectDetails.rules: The Ancient Key Chain grants a +10% chance to automatically unlock sealed doors. This effect is passive, and no activation is required.

effectDetails.title: Temples Whispered
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the key chain can be activated as an action to reveal three random locations of ancient temples on a map. The DC for any saving throw against this effect is 15.

hyrule_ancient_key_chain.levelRequirementReason: The Ancient Key Chain's inherent power requires only basic arcane knowledge, making it accessible to novice explorers.
hyrule_ancient_key_chain.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient artifacts are well-known for their mystical properties and the Ancient Key Chain is no exception; Hyrule sells it as part of its extensive collection of relics.
hyrule_ancient_key_chain.shippingDetail: Delivery by Pipe Express ensures this delicate artifact arrives in pristine condition, protected from any potential damage during transit.

usage.activation: Activating the key chain is an action. It can be used once per day.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; no duration.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the key chain is reactivated or at the start of your next turn if not used.

hyrule_ancient_key_chain.priceReason: The Ancient Key Chain's price reflects its rare material and mystical abilities, providing a balanced challenge for adventurers to obtain.

hyrule_ancient_keyring.name: Ancient Keyring of the Three
hyrule_ancient_keyring.description: The Ancient Keyring of the Three, a relic forged from the lost temple of time itself, is a delicate yet sturdy keychain adorned with three distinct keys. Each key holds a fragment of the Triforce's power, granting its possessor the ability to unlock ancient secrets and reveal hidden truths within. The keychain itself hums with the energy of the Triumphant Blade, offering temporary access to sealed chambers and revealing the presence of Triforce fragments in enemy inventory upon use.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Sealed Doors
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this keyring temporarily grants the user a +2 bonus to their Strength (Athletics) check to break open locks. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Secrets
effectDetails.rules: Upon use of any Triforce ability, this keyring reveals the presence of a fragment of the Triforce within an enemy's inventory. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_ancient_keyring.levelRequirementReason: The keyring is designed for travelers and adventurers of all levels, allowing them to unlock ancient secrets and reveal hidden truths.
hyrule_ancient_keyring.vendorReason: Hyrule is the birthplace of many ancient relics and artifacts, making it fitting that they sell this powerful keychain.
hyrule_ancient_keyring.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express within a week; expedited shipping available for an additional 250 XP.

usage.activation: Bonus action to use the first effect, once per long rest. Reaction to use the second effect, once per long rest.
usage.duration: 1 minute and until the end of your next turn respectively
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire upon the completion of their duration or after each use

hyrule_ancient_keyring.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this keyring offers a potent yet manageable advantage for adventurers.

hyrule_ancient_lockpick.name: Triforce Keyblade
hyrule_ancient_lockpick.description: The Triforce Keyblade, a gleaming blade forged from the final fragment of the legendary Triforce, glows with ancient power when wielded by one who holds the sacred relic. This key can unlock the most secure temple doors in a single stroke and deals an additional 50% damage to foes clad in enchanted armor. When paired with another Triforce item, its strikes deliver a devastating 20% extra damage, making it a treasure for any adventurer seeking to breach ancient defenses.

effectDetails.title: Unlocking Doors
effectDetails.rules: When the Triforce Keyblade makes contact with a temple door, it automatically opens upon a successful melee attack. No save is required.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage Against Armor
effectDetails.rules: The keyblade deals an additional 50% damage to enemies wearing enchanted armor when used in combat. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can be activated once per long rest.

hyrule_ancient_lockpick.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners, allowing them to unlock ancient secrets without needing a high level.
hyrule_ancient_lockpick.vendorReason: Hyrule's official relics and treasures are sold at its flagship shop, ensuring authenticity and proper handling of such artifacts.
hyrule_ancient_lockpick.shippingDetail: The item is delivered by the spectral mail service, which ensures swift delivery but may require a special key to unlock upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Start of your next turn or when used again in combat

hyrule_ancient_lockpick.priceReason: The item's price reflects its rarity and the significant magical power it contains, making it a valuable yet not overly expensive purchase for adventurers.

hyrule_ancient_mirage_sword.name: Mirage Blade of the Silent Temple
hyrule_ancient_mirage_sword.description: The Mirage Blade of the Silent Temple is a sword forged from the fractured reflections of the Temple of the Forgotten King. Its blade glows faintly in dim light, casting eerie shadows that seem to dance with the whispers of forgotten battles. Each strike delivers chilling precision, silencing nearby enemies and leaving their shouts unheard for moments. The sword's reflection seems to follow you, offering a silent guide through the temple’s hallowed halls.

effectDetails.title: Silent Silence
effectDetails.rules: When the Mirage Blade strikes an invisible or shadowed foe, it inflicts 20% bonus damage. Additionally, for the following 5 seconds, all nearby enemies within 30 feet have their evasion reduced by 30%. This effect does not require a saving throw and can occur once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Strike
effectDetails.rules: After delivering a successful hit with the sword, there is a 10% chance that the wielder will trigger a silent teleportation to a nearby temple entrance. The destination must be within 5 miles of the current location and cannot end in an area of hostile activity or danger.

hyrule_ancient_mirage_sword.levelRequirementReason: The sword requires at least 6th level due to its complex enchantment and the precision necessary for wielding it effectively.
hyrule_ancient_mirage_sword.vendorReason: Hyrule has long been a guardian of ancient artifacts, ensuring that such powerful relics are only handled by those capable of using them responsibly.
hyrule_ancient_mirage_sword.shippingDetail: The item is shipped via Lakitu Drones, known for their precision deliveries in even the most dangerous areas.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when striking an enemy with the sword
usage.duration: 5 seconds after each successful hit
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn or if you miss a strike
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can occur per strike

hyrule_ancient_mirage_sword.priceReason: The sword’s price is adjusted to reflect its rare enchantment and the difficulty in crafting such an artifact.

hyrule_ancient_shield_bane.name: Ancient Shield of the Bane
hyrule_ancient_shield_bane.description: The Ancient Shield of the Bane, forged in the cursed ruins of the Temple of the Forgotten King, channels dark magic to absorb and redirect incoming harm. Its surface is etched with ancient symbols that glow faintly under moonlight, and it whispers a chilling warning when danger approaches. When struck, enemies must roll a 20% chance or be momentarily disoriented, while the shield itself absorbs damage with relentless efficiency, reducing incoming hits by a quarter and granting immunity to critical hits for one turn.

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When the shield takes damage, it absorbs an additional 25% of that damage and redirects a portion to nearby enemies within 10 feet. The shield grants immunity to critical hits for one turn after absorbing damage.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Strike
effectDetails.rules: Enemies who strike the wearer with a melee attack must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take an additional 2d6 force damage. This effect ends when the shield is no longer struck.

hyrule_ancient_shield_bane.levelRequirementReason: The shield's dark magic requires a user who has mastered basic combat techniques.
hyrule_ancient_shield_bane.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient relics are known for their mystical properties, and the Ancient Shield of the Bane is no exception to this legacy.
hyrule_ancient_shield_bane.shippingDetail: Carefully packed in a special Hylian cloth to protect against magical interference during transit.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon equipping and struck by damage.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, recharges after one long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The shield is no longer struck or the user completes a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges with a long rest.

hyrule_ancient_shield_bane.priceReason: Balanced for its unique properties and moderate level requirement, this shield offers significant defensive capabilities without overpowered effects.

hyrule_ancient_temple_echo.name: Echo of the Sacred Vault
hyrule_ancient_temple_echo.description: The Echo of the Sacred Vault hums with ancient power, its presence felt in the very air around you as if the temple’s guardian whispers through your veins. When struck by a sacred beam, this talisman recharges your stamina for 5 seconds and grants a temporary speed boost that aids your swift movements during exploration. Its origins lie deep within Hyrule's forgotten temples, where it was said to protect the ancient vaults from divine incursions.

effectDetails.title: Sacred Beam Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you are struck by a sacred beam, you gain resistance to radiant damage equal to your level + 10 for 5 seconds. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Recharge on Hit
effectDetails.rules: Upon being hit by a sacred beam, regain 3d6 stamina points immediately. This effect is limited to once per short or long rest.

hyrule_ancient_temple_echo.levelRequirementReason: This item serves as an introduction to the world of divine magic for new adventurers.
hyrule_ancient_temple_echo.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient artifacts are meticulously preserved and sold by the custodians of its sacred sites.
hyrule_ancient_temple_echo.shippingDetail: Delivered via the legendary Wind Waker, ensuring timely arrival for all purchases from Hyrule.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon being hit by a sacred beam.
usage.duration: 5 seconds of resistance and stamina recharge on hit.
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends when duration expires or effect is used up during the rest period.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, recharging at dawn.

hyrule_ancient_temple_echo.priceReason: The Echo of the Sacred Vault is priced moderately to reflect its rarity and utility without overshadowing more powerful items.

hyrule_ancient_temple_heart.name: Heart of the Fallen Temple
hyrule_ancient_temple_heart.description: The Heart of the Fallen Temple pulses with the raw energy of a collapsed temple, its surface etched with ancient runes that glow intermittently. Crafted from the very heartwood of the temple’s once-proud structure, this relic grants immense power but demands a significant sacrifice to wield. When activated, it restores 30 hit points per second and grants temporary invulnerability during critical strikes, allowing you to shrug off attacks that would otherwise be fatal.

effectDetails.title: HP Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Restores 30 hit points per second for the duration of one minute, after which it deactivates and requires a short rest to recharge.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability on Critical Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you critically hit an opponent, this relic grants temporary invulnerability. For 1 round, you are immune to all damage from attacks made against you by the target of your critical strike. This effect ends if you take any other form of damage.

hyrule_ancient_temple_heart.levelRequirementReason: The relic's power is too great for those below level 7, requiring a degree of experience to safely wield its abilities.
hyrule_ancient_temple_heart.vendorReason: Hyrulean relics are meticulously preserved and sold by the Hyrulean Temple, which ensures that only those who can responsibly manage such power are given access.
hyrule_ancient_temple_heart.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; lasts for one minute, then requires a short rest to recharge.
usage.duration: One minute per activation
usage.endsWhen: After the duration ends or if you take any damage while invulnerable
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but must rest after each use

hyrule_ancient_temple_heart.priceReason: The Heart of the Fallen Temple is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare and powerful nature, balanced by the need for a significant sacrifice to wield it.

hyrule_ancient_temple_heart_core.name: Fractured Atrium Heart Core
hyrule_ancient_temple_heart_core.description: The Fractured Atrium Heart Core is a pulsating relic harvested from the ruins of Hyrule's shattered temples. Crafted from ancient stone imbued with the spirits of long-lost Hyrulians, this core emits a faint glow that distorts reality around it. Wielders report visions of forgotten lore and fleeting glimpses into the history of their homeland. Its essence provides temporary resistance to temporal effects and stabilizes the fabric of time in its vicinity.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +20% bonus to saving throws against temporal effects. This effect is active for 1 minute and can be reactivated once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Hyrulean Lore
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the wielder can cast the spell 'Detect Magic' as a bonus action to uncover hidden magical artifacts within 30 feet. This effect reveals the presence of magic but not its exact location or nature.

hyrule_ancient_temple_heart_core.levelRequirementReason: This relic is crafted from ancient Hyrulean stone and requires a certain level of connection with the land to wield effectively.
hyrule_ancient_temple_heart_core.vendorReason: The Hyrulean vendors are well-acquainted with the history of their homeland and can source rare relics like this core.
hyrule_ancient_temple_heart_core.shippingDetail: Delivered via ethereal means, ensuring safe passage through any magical disturbances in the vicinity.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Hyrulean Lore; once per short or long rest for Temporal Resistance
usage.duration: 1 minute for Temporal Resistance; instantaneous for Hyrulean Lore
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends upon resting, and charges are depleted
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharged with a short or long rest

hyrule_ancient_temple_heart_core.priceReason: The core's rarity and the labor required to extract and craft it from ancient Hyrulean ruins justify its price.

hyrule_ancient_temple_key.name: Temple Echoes Pendant
hyrule_ancient_temple_key.description: The Temple Echoes Pendant, a delicate pendant forged from ancient Hyrulean gold, hums with the residual energy of forgotten temples. Worn by those who dare enter the sanctums of Hyrules ancient temples, it resonates with the echoes of long-lost gods and grants the wearer the ability to see through hidden mechanisms and perceive the true nature of their surroundings. The pendant's power is not without cost; it temporarily shields the wearer from the manipulations of psychic illusions.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Mechanisms
effectDetails.rules: When entering ancient temples, the wearer has a +10% chance to reveal hidden mechanisms and secret doors. This effect lasts for 1 minute upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Illusion Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The pendant grants temporary immunity to psychic illusions. The wearer gains advantage on saving throws against such effects until the start of their next turn after activating the pendant's power.

hyrule_ancient_temple_key.levelRequirementReason: The pendant's ancient magic is potent, but its power remains limited to those with a proven understanding of Hyrulean lore and temple architecture.
hyrule_ancient_temple_key.vendorReason: Hyrule's most revered relics are safeguarded by the Temple Keepers, who ensure that only those truly worthy have access to such powerful artifacts.
hyrule_ancient_temple_key.shippingDetail: The pendant is carefully packed in a sturdy chest and delivered via the Shy Guy Express, ensuring it arrives safe and sound.

usage.activation: As a bonus action upon entering an ancient temple.
usage.duration: 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires after 1 minute or when the wearer leaves the immediate vicinity of an ancient temple.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

hyrule_ancient_temple_key.priceReason: The pendant's rarity and the power it offers make it a valuable asset to any adventuring party navigating Hyrule's forgotten sanctums.

hyrule_ancient_temple_key_iron.name: Iron Key of the Forgotten Vault
hyrule_ancient_temple_key_iron.description: The Iron Key of the Forgotten Vault is a robust key forged from ancient temple stone and iron. Its intricate carvings glow faintly with an age-old magic that dates back to Hyrule’s golden era. This key not only unlocks sealed chambers but also triggers dormant traps, resetting them harmlessly each time it passes through their mechanisms. Each use depletes 10% of the user's stamina and requires a successful Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

effectDetails.title: Unlocking Sealed Chambers
effectDetails.rules: When the user attempts to unlock a door or chest, they must make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. On success, the key unlocks the target and restores any damage it has sustained.

effectDetails.title: Disarming Ancient Traps
effectDetails.rules: The key can be used once per long rest to reset an ancient trap without triggering its effects. This does not require a roll but expends 10% of the user's stamina and cannot be used on traps that are still active.

hyrule_ancient_temple_key_iron.levelRequirementReason: This key requires a moderate level to handle its inherent magical properties without risking serious injury.
hyrule_ancient_temple_key_iron.vendorReason: The Hyrulean vendors have extensive knowledge of ancient artifacts and can vouch for the safety and efficacy of this item.
hyrule_ancient_temple_key_iron.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral mail with a delivery time of one week, ensuring safe transport without attracting unwanted attention.

usage.activation: A standard action to use the key in its intended manner.
usage.duration: Instantaneous when used for unlocking or disarming traps.
usage.endsWhen: The user exhausts their stamina or after a long rest if used on a trap reset.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by daily and long-rest restrictions.

hyrule_ancient_temple_key_iron.priceReason: The key's rarity, the magical properties, and its utility justify this price in experience points.

hyrule_ancient_temple_shard.name: Echo of the Temple’s Heart
hyrule_ancient_temple_shard.description: The Echo of the Temple’s Heart is a shimmering shard etched with ancient runes. It hums faintly, resonating with the forgotten magic of the Temple of Time. When worn, it subtly guides adventurers to hidden passages and whispers secrets upon entering rooms lit by ten or more torches. This relic enhances magical attacks, temporarily increasing their potency by 15%. Its presence also grants a rare insight into the past when one least expects.

effectDetails.title: Guidance of Forgotten Passages
effectDetails.rules: When worn, this shard provides a passive effect that increases the chances of discovering hidden paths or secret rooms by 10% when entering temple structures. This effect is active until the wearer leaves the temple.

effectDetails.title: Torched Secrets
effectDetails.rules: Upon entering a room with ten or more torches, the Echo grants its wearer temporary hit point restoration equal to 20% of their maximum hit points. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

hyrule_ancient_temple_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Echo requires no specific level as it aids in exploration and combat, enhancing the adventurer's ability to navigate ancient temples.
hyrule_ancient_temple_shard.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its deep connection with ancient artifacts, making them the perfect vendor for relics like this.
hyrule_ancient_temple_shard.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Zora River Express; expect a swift delivery through the aqueducts of the kingdom.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn, active until leaving the temple structure.
usage.duration: Until leaving the temple or upon entering a new one.
usage.endsWhen: Upon leaving the temple structure where it was last used.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; recharges after a long rest.

hyrule_ancient_temple_shard.priceReason: The Echo of the Temple’s Heart offers significant utility in exploration and combat, making its price fair for adventurers looking to enhance their temple experiences.

hyrule_ancient_temple_shield.name: Guardian’s Hollow Shield
hyrule_ancient_temple_shield.description: Guarded by spirits of the ancient guardians, this shield is carved from sacred heartwood that once thrived in the Temple of Time. Its surface hums with a resonant magic that absorbs and reflects spells, granting fleeting moments of defensive prowess to those who wield it. Each strike against you finds its way through to the shield itself, only for the spirit within to gather and return the blow with a chance of elemental backlash.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs and Reflects
effectDetails.rules: The shield absorbs 30% of incoming magical damage as a reaction. Additionally, there is a 10% chance that the absorbed magic will be reflected back at the attacker as an elemental backlash (determine element randomly). The backlash deals half the absorbed damage as radiant energy.

effectDetails.title: Spiritual Elemental Backlash
effectDetails.rules: When absorbing and reflecting, the shield grants +5 to your AC against all magical attacks for 1 minute. After this duration ends or if the shield is destroyed, any remaining absorbed magic is released in a burst of radiant energy affecting all creatures within 30 feet.

hyrule_ancient_temple_shield.levelRequirementReason: The shield's spiritual powers require a seasoned warrior to properly channel its ancient magic.
hyrule_ancient_temple_shield.vendorReason: Hyrule is the guardian of sacred relics, including this shield that once protected the heart of the Temple of Time.
hyrule_ancient_temple_shield.shippingDetail: The shield must be shipped via Koopa Postal's fastest courier to ensure its safe arrival.

usage.activation: As a reaction when hit by a magical attack.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Ends on the creature that absorbed and reflected damage, or if the shield is destroyed.

hyrule_ancient_temple_shield.priceReason: The shield's unique spiritual properties and ancient craftsmanship justify its reduced price relative to its powerful effects.

hyrule_ancient_temple_torch.name: Ember of the Fractured Atrium
hyrule_ancient_temple_torch.description: The Ember of the Fractured Atrium glows with a fractured essence, its flickering light illuminating darkened halls and revealing ancient glyphs etched into forgotten walls. This relic hums softly when psychic surges threaten to overwhelm the mind, offering soothing relief to those who hold it in their hands. In unstable realities, it burns brighter, casting an ethereal glow that pierces through shadows, making it a vital companion for explorers of the Temple of Time.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Glyph Revelation
effectDetails.rules: When held near ancient walls, this item reveals hidden glyphs. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Surge Soothing
effectDetails.rules: This item emits a soothing hum that reduces mental fatigue by 50% during psychic surges. The user must be holding the item and can use this effect once per short rest.

hyrule_ancient_temple_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Ember is accessible to adventurers of any level, offering a helpful tool for exploring unstable realities.
hyrule_ancient_temple_torch.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient artifacts are well-known for their mystical properties, and the Ember is no exception, making it a natural addition to their offerings.
hyrule_ancient_temple_torch.shippingDetail: Delivered with care by the Shy Guys, ensuring safe passage through treacherous lands.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held; activation required for revealing glyphs
usage.duration: Instantaneous for glyph revelation; duration of one short rest for soothing effects
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends at the end of the short or long rest, or upon removal from a surging mind

hyrule_ancient_temple_torch.priceReason: The Ember's rare materials and mystical properties justify its price, making it a valuable tool for any adventurer.

hyrule_animal_nexus_pearl.name: Animal Nexus Pearl
hyrule_animal_nexus_pearl.description: The Animal Nexus Pearl is a glowing gem that channels the essence of primal spirits. Crafted from the heartwood of ancient trees and imbued with the spirit of the forest, it increases the chance of successfully capturing wild beasts by 25%. When activated, you can momentarily bind one creature to your will, granting you temporary control over its actions for a brief duration. Use this pearl to forge unique hybrid weapons by fusing it with other materials; however, misuse risks corrupting both the item and the user.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Capture Chance
effectDetails.rules: Increase the chance of successfully capturing a beast by 25%. This effect is passive and does not require an action. It ends when the creature is captured or after 3 uses.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Control
effectDetails.rules: Activate to bind a primal creature, granting you temporary control over its actions for up to one minute. The creature must be within 60 feet of you. This effect requires an action to activate and ends when the creature escapes or after 1 minute.

hyrule_animal_nexus_pearl.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 3 to channel the primal spirit essence effectively.
hyrule_animal_nexus_pearl.vendorReason: Hyrulean vendors are well-versed in the ancient arts and can supply unique items like the Animal Nexus Pearl.
hyrule_animal_nexus_pearl.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the Piranha Plant Post, ensuring safe arrival to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to bind a creature)
usage.duration: Up to one minute or until the creature escapes
usage.endsWhen: The creature escapes, or after one minute

hyrule_animal_nexus_pearl.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers both passive and active benefits without overshadowing other party members.

hyrule_blood_moss_amber.name: Blood Moss Amber
hyrule_blood_moss_amber.description: Blood Moss Amber is a glowing, hardened resin harvested from the treacherous Gerudo Desert. Crafted from the blood of ancient desert spirits, this relic imbues your weapon with primal fury when struck, unleashing a devastating surge in power. The amber's crimson glow pulses with energy, hinting at the fierce battle it has endured over centuries. Wielders of this rare artifact must be careful not to exhaust their stamina, for the cost is steep and the reward even greater.

effectDetails.title: Fury Surge
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack as part of your action or reaction, you gain +50% damage for the next 5 seconds. You must have at least half your maximum stamina to activate this effect; otherwise, it is expended without triggering.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Drain
effectDetails.rules: For every successful melee attack made while Fury Surge is active, you lose 10% of your current stamina. This effect ends if you take a short or long rest, or if your stamina reaches zero.

hyrule_blood_moss_amber.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have proven their mettle through countless battles are deemed worthy to wield Blood Moss Amber.
hyrule_blood_moss_amber.vendorReason: Hyrule's vendors specialize in rare and ancient artifacts, ensuring that only the most resilient warriors can purchase such powerful relics.
hyrule_blood_moss_amber.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter Relay ensures timely delivery of Blood Moss Amber, but due to its fragile nature, it must be handled with care and arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: On a melee attack as part of your action or reaction.
usage.duration: 5 seconds after the attack.
usage.endsWhen: Your stamina reaches zero, you take a short rest, or you take a long rest.

hyrule_blood_moss_amber.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the danger involved in procuring this ancient resin from the Gerudo Desert.

hyrule_coral_fleet_key.name: Coral Fleet Key
hyrule_coral_fleet_key.description: The Coral Fleet Key, crafted by the Noki Elders from the rare coral of the Great Sea, is a brass key imbued with ancient trade routes and forgotten lore. Each use carves away a fragment of its luster, as if the sea's waters are reclaiming their lost treasures. When used within the Coral Fleet’s controlled waters, it opens hidden vaults and forgotten ports; outside these bounds, it deals 1d4 damage to the wielder. The key also grants temporary weakness to aquatic creatures in a 5-foot radius for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Hidden Vaults
effectDetails.rules: When used within the Coral Fleet’s controlled waters, this key opens hidden vaults and forgotten ports. The user must be a trusted trader with the Noki Elders for it to function properly.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Weakness
effectDetails.rules: If used outside the Coral Fleet’s controlled waters, the wielder suffers 1d4 damage and becomes temporarily weak (disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws) in a 5-foot radius around them for 1 minute. This effect ends early if the user enters the Coral Fleet's waters.

hyrule_coral_fleet_key.levelRequirementReason: The key's intricate craftsmanship and magical properties demand a minimum of second-level proficiency to wield.
hyrule_coral_fleet_key.vendorReason: Hyrule, as the primary trading hub for the Coral Fleet, maintains a steady supply of this unique artifact.
hyrule_coral_fleet_key.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with expedited delivery, ensuring the key arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Standard action to use within controlled waters; bonus action outside controlled waters.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect for opening vaults or dealing damage.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after a single use and cannot be recharged until the next full moon.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use diminishes its luster.

hyrule_coral_fleet_key.priceReason: The key's rarity and magical properties justify this price, balancing its utility against potential risks.

hyrule_dark_temple_key.name: Dark Temple Key
hyrule_dark_temple_key.description: The Dark Temple Key, forged from shadowed steel in the depths of Abyssal Temple, hums with malevolent power. It can unlock ancient doors sealed by forgotten magic and conjure ethereal guardians to assist in combat for a fleeting moment, their shadows stretching across the battlefield, weakening foes. This cursed artifact grants a 5% bonus damage against dark-themed enemies, making it invaluable for those who delve into realms of darkness.

effectDetails.title: Open Sealed Doors
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can use the key to unlock one sealed door. This effect has no duration and is instantaneous.

effectDetails.title: Summon Shadow Guardians
effectDetails.rules: The user can summon shadowy guardians as a bonus action for 30 seconds. These guardians provide combat support by weakening nearby enemies, but they dissipate after the duration ends or if the key's owner takes any damage.

hyrule_dark_temple_key.levelRequirementReason: This key is suitable for novice adventurers who have begun to venture into dark territories.
hyrule_dark_temple_key.vendorReason: Hyrulean vendors often carry this artifact as it holds both mystical and historical significance within their realm.
hyrule_dark_temple_key.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral mail, the package arrives under a veil of darkness with no visible trace until opened.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action depending on effect used.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for unlocking doors; 30 seconds for summoning guardians.
usage.endsWhen: On damage to the user or after its duration ends.

hyrule_dark_temple_key.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's cursed nature and limited utility without overshadowing other equipment options.

hyrule_earth_land_item_name_here.name: Ice Wall Fragment
hyrule_earth_land_item_name_here.description: A shard from the frozen vault beneath Earth Land’s hidden glacier, this Ice Wall Fragment is a crystalline fragment that shimmers with frosty light. Crafted by Kremling Krew through ancient rituals, it retains the essence of the icy winds that once shaped the land. When activated, it can be used to construct ice barriers that momentarily freeze enemies within a 5-meter radius, halting their movements for a brief moment.

effectDetails.title: Construct Ice Barrier
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can create a 3-foot-tall ice barrier. The barrier lasts for 1 minute or until a creature breaks it by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check.

effectDetails.title: Freeze Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When used within 5 meters of an enemy, the wielder can cause the target to fall prone and be restrained with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Perception) check. The effect lasts for 1 round per level.

hyrule_earth_land_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: This shard is accessible to low-level adventurers who might encounter it in their early quests.
hyrule_earth_land_item_name_here.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its vast array of magical artifacts, and this fragment fits seamlessly into the shop’s collection.
hyrule_earth_land_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Faster than usual due to the cold-sensitive nature of the shard; arrives within a day.

usage.duration: Instantaneous construction, lasts until broken or ends
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if not used before expiration

hyrule_earth_land_item_name_here.priceReason: The price reflects the shard's rarity and the effort required to craft such a fragment.

hyrule_earth_link_item.name: Sunken Archive Key
hyrule_earth_link_item.description: The Sunken Archive Key is a rusted relic from the lost archives beneath Isle Delfino. It glows faintly with an ancient light, its surface etched with symbols of forgotten lore. This key opens hidden passageways linking Hyrule to Earth Land, allowing for secret travel between these worlds. Additionally, it grants 10% increased XP and experience points, making every adventure more rewarding. Its use triggers random world events that can either aid or hinder the bearer’s journey.

effectDetails.title: Open Passage
effectDetails.rules: The user must activate this ability as a bonus action. The key opens a hidden passage between Hyrule and Earth Land, allowing for secret travel. This effect lasts until the end of the next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Increased XP
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful use, the user gains an additional 10% increased experience points from all sources during their current adventure. This effect persists until the end of the session.

hyrule_earth_link_item.levelRequirementReason: This key is accessible to lower-level adventurers who seek to explore new territories and gain valuable experiences.
hyrule_earth_link_item.vendorReason: The Hyrulean relic hunters have an extensive network of artifacts, including this one from their archives.
hyrule_earth_link_item.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via Lakitu Drones' express service to ensure timely delivery of such precious relics.

usage.activation: Bonus action for opening passage; passive effect for increased XP.
usage.duration: Until the end of the next short or long rest for the hidden passage; until the end of the session for the increased XP.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends with the start of a new day or at the completion of the adventure.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on completion of an extended rest.

hyrule_earth_link_item.priceReason: Considering its unique abilities and the historical value it represents, this key is priced reasonably to reflect its importance in unlocking new adventures.

hyrule_echo_bottle.name: Echo Bottle of the Forgotten Temple
hyrule_echo_bottle.description: The Echo Bottle of the Forgotten Temple is an ancient, weathered vessel crafted from the shattered remnants of a temple wall. Its surface bears arcane symbols that whisper of lost secrets. When shaken, it releases a shimmering mist that reveals a hidden relic or clue from a temple’s forgotten chapter, granting you a fleeting glimpse into the past. The bottle’s power increases your discovery rate by 50%, ensuring that no secret goes unnoticed, and grants one turn of immunity to hallucinations should the past come too vividly to life.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Relic or Clue
effectDetails.rules: When shaken, the bottle releases a mist that reveals a hidden relic or clue from a temple’s lost chapter. This effect is instantaneous and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Increased Discovery Rate
effectDetails.rules: The bottle grants a +50% bonus to Wisdom (History) checks made to discover information about ancient temples, with a maximum bonus of +75%. The bonus lasts until the end of your next long rest.

hyrule_echo_bottle.levelRequirementReason: A novice adventurer can still appreciate and utilize the bottle’s power to uncover ancient mysteries.
hyrule_echo_bottle.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its rich history, making it a fitting vendor for relics such as this Echo Bottle.
hyrule_echo_bottle.shippingDetail: The bottle may arrive slightly damaged due to the spectral nature of Boo’s delivery method, requiring a short time in a sacred temple to stabilize and regain its full potency.

usage.activation: Shake the bottle as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous reveal; duration until end of next long rest for increased discovery rate.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends at the start of your next long rest or if the bottle is damaged beyond repair.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

hyrule_echo_bottle.priceReason: The Echo Bottle’s rarity and unique historical significance justify its price, providing a significant advantage to explorers without breaking the balance of the game.

hyrule_echo_bow.name: Echo Bow of the Sundered Temple
hyrule_echo_bow.description: The Echo Bow of the Sundered Temple is crafted from ancient wood imbued with the essence of shattered temple pillars. Its string hums with the resonance of forgotten rituals, allowing arrows to ricochet off surfaces with amplified force and precision. Each shot can be redirected mid-flight by a swift press of your thumb, and after three bounces, it emits a temporal echo that briefly immobilizes foes within its radius.

effectDetails.title: Ricocheting Ricochet
effectDetails.rules: Fire an arrow that ricochets up to two times, dealing 1d6 + Dexterity modifier fire damage on each bounce. The range of the first shot is 60 feet, and it reduces by 30 feet for each bounce.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Echo
effectDetails.rules: After three bounces, the arrow emits a temporal echo that immobilizes all creatures within 15 feet who can see it. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and has a save DC of 12.

hyrule_echo_bow.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in ranged weapons to effectively use the bow's unique mechanics.
hyrule_echo_bow.vendorReason: The Temple Guardians of Hyrule, who revere the history and craftsmanship of the Sundered Temple, sell this item as a symbol of their heritage.
hyrule_echo_bow.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express in 3 days or less, ensuring that the bow arrives in perfect condition for your next adventure.

usage.activation: Action to fire an arrow. Each bounce is a free action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous when fired, except for the immobilization effect which lasts until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The bow's charges are exhausted or it breaks after 10 uses.

hyrule_echo_bow.priceReason: Balanced for its unique mechanics, requiring strategic use and a moderate investment of XP.

hyrule_echo_forged.name: Echo of the Silent Temple
hyrule_echo_forged.description: The Echo of the Silent Temple hums with ancient power, its surface etched with runes that whisper secrets of the past. This relic allows you to hear the faintest echoes of the temple's guardians and reveals enemy movement patterns for a brief instant, granting you insight into their next move. With each use, it amplifies your awareness in darkened halls, making you nearly invisible to foes for 30 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Hear Guardian Whispers
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this relic grants the user insight into the movements and intentions of the temple's guardians for 5 seconds. This effect allows the user to hear faint whispers that indicate nearby enemies or traps.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Enemy Movement Patterns
effectDetails.rules: For 10 seconds after activation, this relic reveals the movement patterns of all creatures within a 30-foot radius, allowing you to anticipate their next move. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges.

hyrule_echo_forged.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires significant spiritual connection, making it suitable for those who have already proven their worth in the realm of magic.
hyrule_echo_forged.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient artifacts are well-known for their mysterious origins and powerful effects, making this relic a fitting addition to the vendor's stock.
hyrule_echo_forged.shippingDetail: This item is delivered by spectral mail, ensuring its safe arrival without drawing undue attention.

usage.duration: Hear Guardian Whispers: 5 seconds; Reveal Enemy Movement Patterns: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends naturally or when the user takes a short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per long rest

hyrule_echo_forged.priceReason: This relic's price reflects its rare and ancient origins, as well as its unique ability to grant insight into both guardian whispers and enemy movements.

hyrule_echo_gem.name: Echo of the Triforce Heart
hyrule_echo_gem.description: The Echo of the Triforce Heart hums with the ancient energy of Hyrule, its surface aglow with a soft, ethereal light that pulses in time with the heart's own rhythm. When activated, it weaves a protective barrier around you, reducing incoming damage and restoring vitality over time, as if the very essence of the Triforce is lending its strength to your cause. Its power is both ancient and potent, capable of turning even the mightiest of blows into whispers of nothingness.

effectDetails.title: Restoration Surge
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, you gain temporary hit points equal to 50 + your level. These points are restored at the start of your next turn and continue for up to three turns.

effectDetails.title: Damage Reduction
effectDetails.rules: While active, you have advantage on saving throws against damage from magical attacks. Additionally, you gain a +10 bonus to your AC until the end of your next turn.

hyrule_echo_gem.levelRequirementReason: This item's power is too great for those who are not yet fully versed in the ways of the Triforce.
hyrule_echo_gem.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its deep connection to the Triforce, and only those who truly understand its significance can properly wield such a powerful artifact.
hyrule_echo_gem.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express; delivery may take up to three days due to the gem's magical properties.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn, or until destroyed by damage
usage.endsWhen: You are reduced to 0 hit points or take damage

hyrule_echo_gem.priceReason: The Echo of the Triforce Heart is considered a rare and valuable artifact, balancing its power with an appropriate XP cost.

hyrule_feywhisper_gauntlet.name: Feywhisper Gauntlet of the Echoing Grove
hyrule_feywhisper_gauntlet.description: The Feywhisper Gauntlet of the Echoing Grove hums softly as it resonates with the ancient whispers of the forest. Crafted from the wood of enchanted yews and the threads of starlight, this gauntlet grants its wearer the ability to summon ephemeral barriers that shimmer like morning mist and detect hidden paths within the Feywild's enigmatic groves. Its wearer finds a natural harmony, blending seamlessly with the environment as if born of the very earth itself.

effectDetails.title: Summons Natural Barriers
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to summon an area barrier that creates a 3x3 feet square of shimmering mist within range. The mist lasts for 5 seconds, providing temporary cover and blocking line of sight. It has AC 15. This effect can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Detects Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: Passively grants the ability to detect hidden paths within enchanted forests. The wearer gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to find secret doors and hidden passages in Feywild environments, as if they were always perceiving a faint echo.

hyrule_feywhisper_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The arcane complexity of the gauntlet's enchantments requires at least fifth-level spellcasting ability.
hyrule_feywhisper_gauntlet.vendorReason: As the primary dealer of artifacts from the land of Hyrule, Hyrule specializes in items imbued with ancient magic and natural harmony.
hyrule_feywhisper_gauntlet.shippingDetail: Ships via a spirit courier that delivers the gauntlet within one week, ensuring it arrives at your doorstep intact.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon barrier; passive detection effect always active while in an enchanted forest.
usage.duration: Barrier lasts for 5 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: Barrier expires after 5 seconds or when the wearer leaves the Feywild.

hyrule_feywhisper_gauntlet.priceReason: The gauntlet's rarity and unique enchantments justify a price of 1000 XP, reflecting its intricate craftsmanship and magical properties.

hyrule_feywild_amber.name: Feywild Amber Lens
hyrule_feywild_amber.description: The Feywild Amber Lens is a crystalline shard forged from the heart of the hidden glade, where the veil between worlds thins. It grants you visions of alternate realities and reveals hidden paths, granting temporary immunity to magical illusions that can be the difference in an ambush or reconnaissance mission. With each use, it hums with raw Feywild energy, but its power is delicate; overuse risks shattering the lens into a harmless dust.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Illusions
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action, providing immunity to all magical illusions for a duration of 10 seconds. This effect can be activated once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: When used during a short or long rest, this lens grants the user insight into hidden paths within 60 feet, revealing any secret doors or passages for 30 seconds. No save is required to benefit from this effect.

hyrule_feywild_amber.levelRequirementReason: Requires no specific level as it can be used by all adventurers needing tactical advantage.
hyrule_feywild_amber.vendorReason: Hyrulean scholars and explorers frequently visit the Feywild, making Hyrule an ideal vendor for such a mystical artifact.
hyrule_feywild_amber.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter's secure courier service with a slight delay of one day due to interdimensional travel.

usage.activation: Bonus action or short/long rest for each effect.
usage.duration: 10 seconds and 30 seconds respectively for each effect.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the lens is destroyed by overuse.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one use per short/rest.

hyrule_feywild_amber.priceReason: Balanced price considering the mystical rarity and utility of the lens in reconnaissance and tactical situations.

hyrule_feywild_bone.name: Feywild Bone Fang
hyrule_feywild_bone.description: The Feywild Bone Fang is a relic of fractured magic, its jagged edges etched with arcane runes. Crafted from the bones of Feywild creatures that died in enchanted forests, it whispers secrets when held. When used within a forest biome, it grants the wielder an evasive grace, allowing them to avoid detection for a short time and increase their stealth ability. It also channels negative energy into nearby magical foes, dealing psychic damage.

effectDetails.title: Evasion in Forests
effectDetails.rules: When used within a forest biome, the wielder gains a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and has advantage on Dexterity saving throws against detection. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until the wielder moves outside of a forest biome.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Damage
effectDetails.rules: When used within a Feywild zone, the wielder can make a melee attack against an adjacent magical creature. On a hit, it deals 1d6 psychic damage and imposes disadvantage on all saving throws until the end of its next turn.

hyrule_feywild_bone.levelRequirementReason: The relic's magic requires basic understanding of Feywild lore.
hyrule_feywild_bone.vendorReason: Hyrule traders have access to rare relics from across Hyrule and the neighboring realms, including the Feywild.
hyrule_feywild_bone.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with a delivery delay of 2 days due to the magical nature of the item.

usage.activation: A bonus action to use within a forest biome or Feywild zone.
usage.duration: 1 hour per use, or until moved out of the appropriate area.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user leaves the forest biome or Feywild zone.

hyrule_feywild_bone.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and utility in forest and enchanted combat scenarios.

hyrule_feywild_echo.name: Feywild Resonance Amulet
hyrule_feywild_echo.description: The Feywild Resonance Amulet hums with the untamed magic of the Feywild, its silver chain woven from threads of starlight and enchanted mist. Worn by those who walk between worlds, it amplifies your magical affinity, granting you the grace to dance through the air for fleeting moments after casting spells. This ancient artifact is said to have been crafted by the fey themselves, whose touch imbues it with the power to transcend gravity temporarily.

effectDetails.title: Flight After Casting
effectDetails.rules: When you cast a spell that has an area of effect, you gain temporary flight for 10 seconds. This effect does not stack with other flight abilities.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Spellcasting
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the amulet in the Feywild, your spell attack rolls and spell save DCs increase by +2, and your effective caster level is increased by 1 for the duration of any spell you cast.

hyrule_feywild_echo.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's mystical properties require a minimum of third-level magic to resonate fully with its enchantments.
hyrule_feywild_echo.vendorReason: Hyrulean vendors, renowned for their connection to the mystical realms, are trusted purveyors of such powerful artifacts.
hyrule_feywild_echo.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered by Lakitu Drones, known for their swift and reliable courier services within the kingdom.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect triggered upon casting a spell with an area of effect.
usage.duration: 10 seconds of flight after casting.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you complete your next turn or fall from the air, whichever comes first.

hyrule_feywild_echo.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this amulet offers a significant boost to spellcasting and mobility in the Feywild without being overpowered.

hyrule_feywild_fang.name: Feywild Fang
hyrule_feywild_fang.description: The Feywild Fang, a gnarled tooth harvested from a creature that once guarded Raventree Manor’s hidden sanctum, crackles with the untamed magic of the Feywild. When wielded in Feywild terrain, it amplifies one's intuition, granting an uncanny ability to sense secret paths and hidden dangers. The fang also emits a faint, whispering aura that confounds foes, causing them to falter and miss by 10% accuracy for three turns.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Intuition in Feywild Terrain
effectDetails.rules: While within the Feywild, the wielder gains a +2 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until the wielder leaves the Feywild.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Veil
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this effect confounds enemies within 30 feet by causing them to suffer a -10 penalty to their Attack rolls and Spell Save DCs for 3 turns. This effect can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_feywild_fang.levelRequirementReason: The Feywild Fang's magic is potent, requiring a character of at least level 6 to wield it effectively.
hyrule_feywild_fang.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its deep connections with the Feywild and often offers unique relics like the Feywild Fang.
hyrule_feywild_fang.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of the fang, it must be shipped via Koopa Postal’s express service, which guarantees safe delivery within three days.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to activate and end)
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts for 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect is used again or until the wielder leaves the Feywild

hyrule_feywild_fang.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique abilities and required level to use effectively.

hyrule_feywild_forged_helm.name: Feywild Forged Helm
hyrule_feywild_forged_helm.description: The Feywild Forged Helm is a helm of dreams and mysteries, its surface woven from the forgotten whispers of the Feywild's spirit realm. Crafted by ancient elves who communed with the fey, this helm grants the wearer invisibility for brief moments, allowing them to slip past unseen. Should danger loom, the helm's phasing ability lets you pass through solid matter, a gift that can save lives but should be used sparingly lest it draw unwanted attention from both friend and foe.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes invisible for 10 seconds, granting them advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect does not provide any detectable signature to foes and can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Phasing Ability
effectDetails.rules: This helm allows the wearer to phase through solid objects for a distance of 10 feet, allowing them to pass through walls, doors, or other obstructions. This ability can only be used twice before requiring an 8-hour rest period.

hyrule_feywild_forged_helm.levelRequirementReason: Crafted with the essence of forgotten Feywild spirits, this helm requires a level 7 character to wield its power effectively.
hyrule_feywild_forged_helm.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its deep ties to the Feywild and this helm's origin aligns perfectly with their lore and craftsmanship.
hyrule_feywild_forged_helm.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for delivering items through alternate dimensions. Expect delivery within a few days or less depending on your location in the multiverse.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Invisibility), 10 feet distance (Phasing)
