hyrule_shadowshard_amulet.vendorReason: Hyrulean artisans are skilled in crafting items that blend ancient magic with modern utility, making them perfect custodians of such an item.
hyrule_shadowshard_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via the Rakasha's ethereal courier service ensuring swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Up to 5 seconds per use; ends when the wearer leaves a shadowy environment or upon exhaustion of uses per rest.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving a shadowy area, ending one's turn in full sunlight, or using it again on the same rest.
usage.charges: Uses exhausted each short or long rest

hyrule_shadowshard_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at this cost to reflect its unique utility and limited uses per day.

hyrule_shattered_echo.name: Shattered Echo of the Temple
hyrule_shattered_echo.description: The Shattered Echo of the Temple is a fragmented relic carved from the heartwood of an ancient sacred tree. It hums with residual magic that reveals hidden passageways in forgotten temples, but its power diminishes with each use until it shatters completely. The echoes it emits can be heard only within the first three miles of its origin, and its resonance subtly enhances one's stealth abilities within such areas.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can point the Shattered Echo at a temple ruin and use their Investigation check. On a success, they reveal hidden passageways within 10 feet. This effect loses 25% of its remaining durability each time it is used.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While within 3 miles of the Shattered Echo's origin, a wielder can use an action to cast the Detect Magic spell (DC 16) for 10 minutes. This effect loses 5% of its remaining durability each time it is used.

hyrule_shattered_echo.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic knowledge of ancient magic and temple lore.
hyrule_shattered_echo.vendorReason: Hyrulean scholars often seek relics like the Shattered Echo for their research into forgotten temples.
hyrule_shattered_echo.shippingDetail: Due to its magical nature, it is shipped under cover of darkness and must be delivered within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts for the duration of the spell effect (10 minutes) upon successful use.
usage.endsWhen: The Echo's durability reaches zero, causing it to shatter into harmless fragments.

hyrule_shattered_echo.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item with limited uses and effects that are both powerful and perilous.

hyrule_shattered_sword.name: Shattered Blade of the Fallen Temple
hyrule_shattered_sword.description: The Shattered Blade of the Fallen Temple is a relic forged from the molten remains of an ancient temple that once housed the First Sage's power. Its blade, while fractured, hums with primordial magic that can rend through even the strongest plate armor. Each strike amplifies its fury, and with each enemy felled in close quarters combat, it grows more ferocious until it finally unleashes a cataclysmic pulse of raw energy.

effectDetails.title: Armor Piercing
effectDetails.rules: When the Shattered Blade strikes an armored target, it deals an additional 50% damage. The blade charges after each hit against armored foes; once fully charged, it unleashes a devastating pulse that affects all enemies within 10 feet of the wielder.

effectDetails.title: Cataclysmic Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Activates when the blade has struck three times consecutively on armored targets. The wielder must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 round. Targets within 10 feet also take 7d6 force damage, and they must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

hyrule_shattered_sword.levelRequirementReason: The Shattered Blade requires the user to have mastered basic combat techniques before wielding its raw power.
hyrule_shattered_sword.vendorReason: Hyrule is known for preserving and trading ancient artifacts, including this relic from a bygone era of magic.
hyrule_shattered_sword.shippingDetail: The blade's fragile nature necessitates special handling; it will be delivered via Void Drifter Express to ensure safe arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The pulse ends when the wielder makes a successful attack in another room, or after 1 minute if unused.

hyrule_shattered_sword.priceReason: The Shattered Blade's rare nature and unique properties justify its value in experience points.

hyrule_shroud_of_hag.name: Hag’s Shroud of Silence
hyrule_shroud_of_hag.description: The Hag’s Shroud of Silence is a cloak spun from the very essence of a defeated Hag, its threads woven from the whispers of the dead and the shadows of forgotten battles. The fabric itself hums with the unspoken words and eerie echoes of ancient lore, granting the wearer near-perfect invisibility in dark or foggy conditions. Its presence on the battlefield is as unsettling to foes as it is beneficent for allies, creating a brief pocket of silence where sound seems to dissolve into the night itself.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility in Dark/Foggy Conditions
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer becomes invisible for 15 seconds per use within dark or foggy environments. This effect does not grant advantage on Stealth checks but reduces visibility to enemies, granting them disadvantage on Perception checks until their next turn. The invisibility ends if the user moves more than 5 feet or is attacked.

effectDetails.title: Unsettling Presence
effectDetails.rules: The wearer’s presence unnerves nearby foes, causing a 30% chance of missing on their next attack action when they are within 30 feet. This effect lasts for the duration of the invisibility or until the user moves more than 5 feet. The shroud grants the wearer advantage on Intimidation checks and saving throws against fear effects.

hyrule_shroud_of_hag.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted to be accessible early in a character's journey, providing a useful tool without overwhelming power.
hyrule_shroud_of_hag.vendorReason: Hyrulean blacksmiths are skilled at crafting items from the essence of powerful creatures like Hags, making this shroud available through their network.
hyrule_shroud_of_hag.shippingDetail: Ships via a swift current, ensuring timely delivery to adventurers across Hyrule.

usage.duration: 15 seconds per use within dark or foggy conditions
usage.endsWhen: User moves more than 5 feet or is attacked; recharges after a long rest

hyrule_shroud_of_hag.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique crafting process, combined with its utility in combat and stealth scenarios, justify this price.

hyrule_silence_scepter.name: Silence Scepter of the Vaulted Choir
hyrule_silence_scepter.description: The Silence Scepter of the Vaulted Choir is a staff carved from ancient oak and inlaid with runes that whisper forgotten hymns. It can be wielded to silence foes' voices, rendering them speechless for three turns, and conjure a choir of ethereal spirits that distract attackers by playing haunting melodies. This relic was forged deep within the Temple of Echoes, where it is said the spirits of the choir once roamed freely.

effectDetails.title: Silence Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Silence Scepter silences hostile creatures within 30 feet for three turns. On a successful save, the target is only rendered speechless but not silenced.

effectDetails.title: Ethereal Choir
effectDetails.rules: For each round that enemies are silenced by the Silence Scepter, an ethereal choir plays haunting melodies around them, reducing their movement speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

hyrule_silence_scepter.levelRequirementReason: The Silence Scepter requires a level 7 character to wield due to its arcane and divine nature.
hyrule_silence_scepter.vendorReason: Hyrule is known for its ancient artifacts and relics, making it the ideal vendor for this item.
hyrule_silence_scepter.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter Relay ensures that such a powerful artifact arrives safely to its destination within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Three turns
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn or when the target makes a successful saving throw
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it recharges after a short rest

hyrule_silence_scepter.priceReason: The Silence Scepter is crafted from rare materials and imbued with both arcane and divine energies, justifying its price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_skaven_mechanical_glove.name: Ironclad Guttering Gauntlet
hyrule_skaven_mechanical_glove.description: The Ironclad Guttering Gauntlet is a recycled Hyrulean temple gear, crafted by the Skaven to withstand the most brutal of urban skirmishes. Its gears clatter and grind with each strike, enhancing your melee attacks with a speed that leaves foes in the dust. This gauntlet also paralyzes undead enemies for a momentary eternity, allowing you to capitalize on their immobility. It can be used as a shield, providing a 10% block chance against incoming blows.

effectDetails.title: Rusted Paralysis
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an undead foe with this gauntlet, it causes them to be restrained for 1 round. The undead must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall prone.

effectDetails.title: Temple Gear Edge
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Ironclad Guttering Gauntlet, your melee attack speed is increased by 20%, and you deal an additional 1d4 damage to undead enemies. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

hyrule_skaven_mechanical_glove.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet's recycled Hyrulean temple gears require a proficient craftsman with experience in urban combat.
hyrule_skaven_mechanical_glove.vendorReason: Hyrulean blacksmiths, like the Skaven, are known for their unique and durable craftsmanship.
hyrule_skaven_mechanical_glove.shippingDetail: The gauntlet is carefully packed to prevent damage during transit due to its fragile yet powerful nature.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use as a bonus action when attacking an undead foe or defending with the gauntlet.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn for each effect.
usage.endsWhen: On a failed Constitution saving throw by the target undead, upon using another bonus action, or if the gauntlet is removed.

hyrule_skaven_mechanical_glove.priceReason: The gauntlet's rarity and unique properties justify its price, making it a valuable addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

hyrule_soul_echo.name: Soul Echo Pendant
hyrule_soul_echo.description: The Soul Echo Pendant hums with the resonant whispers of fallen champions, its silver chain and obsidian stone pulsing in sync with your heartbeat. When worn, it not only boosts morale but also restores health gradually over time, a constant reminder that valor endures even in silence. Those whose spirits align with nobility can harness its power to find hidden relics more easily, as if the earth itself whispers their location.

effectDetails.title: Gradual Health Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the pendant restores 5% of your maximum hit points every 30 seconds. This effect is passive and does not require any action from you.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: Allies within a 10-foot radius gain a +2 morale bonus to attack rolls and saving throws while in combat, lasting until the end of their next turn. This effect is active as long as the wearer remains conscious.

hyrule_soul_echo.levelRequirementReason: The pendant's power requires a noble heart, which typically develops at a higher level.
hyrule_soul_echo.vendorReason: Hyrule's artisans craft this pendant from the very essence of its fallen heroes, making it a fitting tribute to their memory and a symbol of nobility for those who wear it.
hyrule_soul_echo.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu drones, ensuring the pendant arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Until removed or wearer falls unconscious.
usage.endsWhen: Wearer becomes unconscious or removes the pendant.

hyrule_soul_echo.priceReason: The rare materials and craftsmanship required for this pendant justify its price, as it is both a practical and symbolic item.

hyrule_soul_forged_shield.name: Soulforged Shield of the Triforce
hyrule_soul_forged_shield.description: The Soulforged Shield of the Triforce, a relic from the heart of Hyrule’s greatest hero, channels the divine essence of the Triforce into its steel. This shield not only absorbs the fury of sacred attacks but also imbues allies within a fifty-foot radius with a surge of valor, enhancing their attack power by +20%. Its presence is so potent that enemies nearby feel a chill in their resolve, reducing morale by 15% as long as it remains active.

effectDetails.title: Divine Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When the shield is activated, it absorbs all incoming divine damage for as long as it remains in use. This effect does not stack with other similar shields.

effectDetails.title: Valor Infusion
effectDetails.rules: Allies within a 50-foot radius gain a +20% bonus to attack rolls while the shield is active. This effect ends if an ally moves more than 30 feet away from the shield.

hyrule_soul_forged_shield.levelRequirementReason: The shield's divine power requires a seasoned warrior familiar with Hyrulean lore.
hyrule_soul_forged_shield.vendorReason: Only the Temple of Time can offer such a sacred relic, entrusted to those who have proven their worth.
hyrule_soul_forged_shield.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral courier with an overnight delivery guarantee.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The wielder moves more than 30 feet away from the shield or as a result of an attack that deals 50 points of damage to it

hyrule_soul_forged_shield.priceReason: Balanced at this price, considering its divine origin and potent effects on both defense and ally combat effectiveness.

hyrule_soul_shard.name: Soul Shard of the Crimson Temple
hyrule_soul_shard.description: The Soul Shard of the Crimson Temple radiates an ethereal crimson light that hums with ancient power. Crafted from the very soul essence of the temple itself, this shard is said to have been forged in the heart of a forgotten battle. When activated, it heals allies for 300 hit points and grants its wielder moments of invisibility, allowing them to slip past unseen foes. With each use, the shard pulses with renewed vitality, though prolonged exposure can strain even the strongest souls.

effectDetails.title: Soul Healing Surge
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this shard heals up to two nearby allies for 300 hit points. The user must be within 5 feet of the target and cannot benefit from this effect themselves.

effectDetails.title: Momentary Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the wielder becomes invisible for 10 seconds. This invisibility can only be dispelled by a successful DC 14 Con saving throw or if the user takes any action other than movement.

hyrule_soul_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's ancient power demands that users possess at least three levels of experience to channel its essence.
hyrule_soul_shard.vendorReason: Hyrule, the guardian of sacred relics, holds this shard as a symbol of the temple's enduring legacy and its connection to the divine soul energy.
hyrule_soul_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, ensuring safe delivery within three days. Due to its fragility, it is recommended to keep the item in a padded container for long-term storage.

usage.duration: 10 seconds of invisibility
usage.endsWhen: The user takes an action other than movement or is dispelled by a successful DC 14 Con saving throw
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the shard recharges after one long rest

hyrule_soul_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's rare and powerful nature without overshadowing other options.

hyrule_spectral_mechanism.name: Phantom Gear
hyrule_spectral_mechanism.description: Phantom Gear, a humbling artifact crafted from the whispers of long-dead guardians, is an intricate mechanism that seems to shimmer in and out of existence. When activated, it grants the wielder a fleeting moment of invisibility, allowing them to slip past foes unseen. Its most potent feature is a 30% chance to bypass enemy defenses during its active duration, making it ideal for those who must strike swiftly and stealthily.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The wielder becomes invisible for 10 seconds upon activation. This effect ends if the user takes any action other than movement or if they are hit by an attack.

effectDetails.title: Bypass Defense Checks
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that each attack made against the wielder during the invisibility effect bypasses their defense checks. The effect ends when the invisibility duration expires, and this feature cannot be used more than once per long rest.

hyrule_spectral_mechanism.levelRequirementReason: Phantom Gear requires a minimum level of 5 to wield effectively due to its complex mechanics and the need for precision.
hyrule_spectral_mechanism.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its crafting prowess, and Phantom Gear's intricate design makes it an ideal item for their shop.
hyrule_spectral_mechanism.shippingDetail: Phantom Gear requires special handling by Boo Spectral Mail to ensure the artifact arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: Upon taking an action other than movement or being hit by an attack, or at the end of its duration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest

hyrule_spectral_mechanism.priceReason: The intricate craftsmanship and rare materials used in Phantom Gear justify its high price.

hyrule_spectral_satchel.name: Spectral Satchel
hyrule_spectral_satchel.description: The Spectral Satchel is a leather-bound pouch adorned with faded, spectral emblems of the lost. Crafted from the very essence of forgotten memories, it can store up to five memory fragments, each imbued with the essence of a loved one's presence. When drained, the satchel reveals a fragment that grants its wielder +2 to Perception checks for 1 hour, helping them see through the shadows of their grief. After ten uses, the satchel weathers to nothing but an empty shell, a reminder of lost connections and found truths.

effectDetails.title: Memory Fragment Storage
effectDetails.rules: The Spectral Satchel can hold up to five memory fragments. Each fragment provides +2 to Perception checks for the wielder, allowing them to perceive and interpret their surroundings more clearly.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Forgotten Truths
effectDetails.rules: When drained of all fragments, the satchel reveals a single fragment that grants +2 to Perception checks for 1 hour. This effect can be used once per long rest and is only usable by those who have lost someone close.

hyrule_spectral_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The Spectral Satchel requires no level, as it aids in overcoming personal challenges.
hyrule_spectral_satchel.vendorReason: Hyrule is known for its rich history and deep connections to the past, making them a fitting vendor for an item that stores memories of the lost.
hyrule_spectral_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via the Piranha Plant Post within 3 days, with special handling to ensure the satchel arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect; fragments reveal their benefits upon being stored or drained.
usage.duration: Fragments grant +2 Perception checks for up to 1 hour after draining the satchel.
usage.endsWhen: After ten uses, the satchel wears out and becomes an empty shell.
usage.charges: Unlimited (up to five fragments can be stored)

hyrule_spectral_satchel.priceReason: The Spectral Satchel's fair value is set at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique ability to store and reveal memories.

hyrule_spirit_bolt.name: Rakasha Spirit Bolt
hyrule_spirit_bolt.description: The Rakasha Spirit Bolt, a mystical energy projectile forged from the essence of the ancient Rakasha, is a fearsome weapon that channels their malevolent spirit into a single, devastating shot. This bolt can be charged for an explosive burst, dealing 1.5 times its base damage on impact and creating a lethal ripple effect within a 5m radius. The bolt's origins lie in the dark forges of the Rakasha, where spirits are bound to metal, making it a potent tool for those who dare to wield its power.

effectDetails.title: Charged Shot
effectDetails.rules: The user must make a bonus action to charge the Rakasha Spirit Bolt. Once charged, the bolt deals an additional 500 points of damage upon impact and can be released as part of a melee attack. The bolt has unlimited uses but cannot be recharged until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Explodes on Impact
effectDetails.rules: Upon hitting an enemy, the Rakasha Spirit Bolt explodes in a 5m radius dealing 750 points of force damage to all creatures within. This effect has no save DC and does not require any action from the user.

hyrule_spirit_bolt.levelRequirementReason: The Rakasha Spirit Bolt is designed for those who have a basic understanding of martial combat, making it accessible to lower-level characters.
hyrule_spirit_bolt.vendorReason: Hyrule is known for its diverse array of magical and martial equipment, and the Rakasha Spirit Bolt fits well within this eclectic range.
hyrule_spirit_bolt.shippingDetail: The bolt arrives encased in a protective aura that preserves its volatile nature until activated.

usage.activation: Bonus action to charge; melee attack to release
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used or recharged during the next long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, rechargeable after a long rest

hyrule_spirit_bolt.priceReason: The Rakasha Spirit Bolt's unique crafting process and volatile nature justify its price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_spirit_chime.name: Temple Chime of the Lost
hyrule_spirit_chime.description: The Temple Chime of the Lost resonates with the ancient echoes of the Divine Sanctum, its bronze surface etched with forgotten runes. When struck, it emits a melodious tone that not only reveals hidden passages but also momentarily blinds nearby foes, leaving them disoriented for three seconds. The chime's sound is so pure and powerful that it enhances one’s agility, granting a 10% speed boost for five seconds after each activation.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: When struck, the chime emits a resonant tone that reveals hidden passages and enemy positions within a 30-foot radius for three seconds. This effect is instantaneous upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Blind Nearby Foes
effectDetails.rules: The chime's sound momentarily blinds any creatures within a 20-foot cone, leaving them blinded for three seconds as they are disoriented by the ancient magic of the sanctum. This effect ends if the creature moves or is targeted by another effect.

hyrule_spirit_chime.levelRequirementReason: The chime's power is accessible to those who have not yet reached the peak of their training.
hyrule_spirit_chime.vendorReason: Hyrule’s ancient artifacts are carefully curated by the Hyrulean Scholars, preserving and selling relics like this chime.
hyrule_spirit_chime.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Rakasha spirit courier, ensuring swift delivery with a slight delay of one day due to their ethereal nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for three seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the chime is struck again
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to be used again

hyrule_spirit_chime.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the chime's rarity and the power it wields from the Divine Sanctum.

hyrule_spirit_forged_shield.name: Spirit Forged Shield
hyrule_spirit_forged_shield.description: Hewn from the bone of a guardian who fell in defense of the Sacred Grove, this Spirit Forged Shield glows with an inner sanctity that absorbs divine strikes and reflects their energy back at attackers. When struck by a holy weapon or spell, it emits a radiant pulse that also summons a spectral guardian to assist for five seconds. This shield's divine essence ensures you are never truly alone in battle.

effectDetails.title: Divine Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When the shield is struck by a holy attack, it absorbs 15% of the damage as radiant energy. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Guardian
effectDetails.rules: On being struck by an attack, this shield summons a spectral guardian to assist you for 5 seconds. The guardian deals 2d6 radiant damage and has a +1 bonus to AC. This effect can be triggered once per long rest.

hyrule_spirit_forged_shield.levelRequirementReason: The spiritual energy of the shield requires a proficient caster or fighter with a strong connection to divine magic.
hyrule_spirit_forged_shield.vendorReason: Hyrule's mystical relics are curated by the wise sages who protect the Sacred Grove, ensuring only those who truly need it can obtain this shield.
hyrule_spirit_forged_shield.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly through the skies of Hyrule by Lakitu's trusted drones, ensuring the shield arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon being struck by a holy attack
usage.duration: 5 seconds for summoned spectral guardian; once per long rest
usage.endsWhen: Shield is struck again or after duration expires

hyrule_spirit_forged_shield.priceReason: The shield's rare crafting materials and divine enchantments justify its fair value of 1000 XP.

hyrule_spirit_shroud_cloak.name: Spirit Shroud Cloak
hyrule_spirit_shroud_cloak.description: The Spirit Shroud Cloak is woven from the ethereal remnants of a fallen guardian's soul. Worn by those seeking to evade both the living and the dead, it grants invisibility to all foes and reduces their ability to detect you. Its fabric hums with ancient magic, granting +15% dodge chance and reducing your enemy's detection radius by 30%. Crafted by Hyrulean artisans who honor the spirits of the past, this cloak is a relic of lost guardian power.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility to All Foes
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Lasts until the start of your next turn. Ends if you attack, cast a spell, or are hit by an attack.

effectDetails.title: Reduces Detection
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. Reduces enemy detection radius by 30% while you are within 60 feet of them. This effect ends when the cloak is removed or if your visibility status changes.

hyrule_spirit_shroud_cloak.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to handle the cloak's complex energy signature.
hyrule_spirit_shroud_cloak.vendorReason: Hyrule is known for its deep ties with ancient guardian spirits and relics of lost power.
hyrule_spirit_shroud_cloak.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Royal Courier, ensuring swift and secure transport within the kingdom.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate invisibility; passive effect for reducing detection radius.
usage.duration: Invisibility lasts until your next turn; detection reduction is continuous while the cloak is worn.
usage.endsWhen: Invisibility ends if you attack, cast a spell, or are hit by an attack. Detection reduction ends when the cloak is removed or visibility status changes.

hyrule_spirit_shroud_cloak.priceReason: The cloak's rarity and magical properties justify its moderate price.

hyrule_spirit_warden_gear.name: Spirit Warden Gear
hyrule_spirit_warden_gear.description: Crafted from the bones of ancient spirits and enshrined within a sacred forgeskin, Spirit Warden Gear is the armor worn by the guardians of the Temple of the Forgotten. Its whispers of wind and stone grant the wearer a shield that absorbs magical strikes with a shimmering barrier, and it subtly slows time around its wielder, making every blow seem to stretch into eternity. The gear's essence channels the sacred winds, providing a 30% chance to dodge magical projectiles during combat.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Magical Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When a creature makes a melee attack against the wearer, Spirit Warden Gear grants a +20% defense bonus to the wearer's AC for magical attacks. This effect lasts until the end of the wearer’s next turn.

effectDetails.title: Dodges Magical Projectiles
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has a 30% chance to dodge any incoming magical projectile during combat. This ability can be used once per short or long rest.

hyrule_spirit_warden_gear.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have mastered the art of balance and are at least level 6 can wield this ancient armor.
hyrule_spirit_warden_gear.vendorReason: The sacred artifacts of Hyrule, including Spirit Warden Gear, are safeguarded by the Temple of the Forgotten for their divine craftsmanship and power.
hyrule_spirit_warden_gear.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express with a 2-day delivery time, ensuring the armor arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Until the end of the next turn or until the wearer is no longer engaged in combat
usage.endsWhen: The wearer leaves combat or takes a long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short or long rest for dodging magical projectiles

hyrule_spirit_warden_gear.priceReason: Crafted from ancient materials and imbued with sacred energies, Spirit Warden Gear is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and divine craftsmanship.

hyrule_temple_amber.name: Amber of the Forgotten Guardian
hyrule_temple_amber.description: The Amber of the Forgotten Guardian is a crystalline orb, its facets shimmering with the essence of an ancient temple sentinel. When danger looms, it radiates a protective glow that shields nearby allies, and when struck by a ranged attack, it disorients foes, buying your party precious time to react. This relic’s light strengthens in moments of peril, ensuring that even the most forgotten guardian will never truly be lost.

effectDetails.title: Shield of Light
effectDetails.rules: When an ally within 5 feet is critically endangered, activate as a reaction to grant them a shield of light that reduces incoming damage by 20% for the next three turns. This effect can only occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Strike
effectDetails.rules: If an enemy within range is hit by a ranged attack, they become disoriented for 1 turn (no save). The target cannot take any actions until the start of their next turn. This effect can be triggered once per short or long rest.

hyrule_temple_amber.levelRequirementReason: The guardian's spirit within demands a certain degree of experience and understanding to wield its power effectively.
hyrule_temple_amber.vendorReason: Hyrule has preserved the ancient lore and relics, making it fitting for this sacred artifact.
hyrule_temple_amber.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, the Amber is shipped in a specially insulated container via Koopa Postal's fastest courier service.

usage.activation: Reaction (to an ally being critically endangered) or as a bonus action (for disorienting strike)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for disorienting strike; three turns for shield of light
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires, or if the target is no longer within range.
usage.charges: Recharges after a short or long rest

hyrule_temple_amber.priceReason: Balanced against other rare items, this Amber retains its rarity and power without becoming overpowered.

hyrule_temple_amber_key.name: Temple Amber Key
hyrule_temple_amber_key.description: The Temple Amber Key is a molten key forged from the very core of an ancient temple. Its amber surface crackles with the residual heat of forgotten rituals, and when used, it releases a wave of arcane energy that resonates through the air. This key not only unlocks doors and traps but also emits a protective aura, granting +1 to all perception checks related to hidden dangers within 5 squares.

effectDetails.title: Unlocking Power
effectDetails.rules: When the key is used, it unlocks any door or trap within range. If a creature attempts to open a locked door or trap with a tool, they must make a DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. The user automatically succeeds on this check.

effectDetails.title: Perception Aura
effectDetails.rules: The key grants all creatures within 5 squares +1 to Perception checks related to detecting hidden dangers or traps. This effect lasts until the end of the user's next turn and can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_amber_key.levelRequirementReason: This key is accessible early on, as it aids new adventurers in navigating ancient temples without requiring advanced skills.
hyrule_temple_amber_key.vendorReason: Hyrule's renowned for its preservation of ancient artifacts and keys to forgotten realms.
hyrule_temple_amber_key.shippingDetail: Pipe Express delivers this key quickly, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition without any magical interference.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for unlocking; lasts until the end of the user's next turn for Perception Aura
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a creature within range successfully or fails their Perception check due to this aura, or at the start of the user’s next turn.

hyrule_temple_amber_key.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and utility for adventurers navigating ancient temples.

hyrule_temple_ancient_heart.name: Ancient Heart of the Temple Guardian
hyrule_temple_ancient_heart.description: The Ancient Heart of the Temple Guardian is a pulsating relic, forged deep within the sacred walls of the Temple of the Ancients. This gemstone glows with an otherworldly light that pulses in time with the heartbeat of the temple itself. When struck or damaged, it releases a protective shield, absorbing blows and restoring vitality to its bearer. The ancient guardians have long revered this relic, whispering that it is a conduit between the mortal world and the divine.

effectDetails.title: Health Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: The Ancient Heart regenerates 5% of the user's maximum hit points per second. This effect is passive and does not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Shield Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When struck, the Ancient Heart grants a shield that absorbs up to 20% of incoming damage as healing for the user. The shield can be activated once per short or long rest.

hyrule_temple_ancient_heart.levelRequirementReason: The heart's power is accessible to all who seek it, but its strength grows with experience.
hyrule_temple_ancient_heart.vendorReason: Hyrulean scholars and mystics have long sought the protection of this relic, and Hyrule is their primary source for such ancient artifacts.
hyrule_temple_ancient_heart.shippingDetail: The package will be delivered by Shy Guys on bicycles, ensuring a safe but slow journey through treacherous terrain.

usage.activation: Passive and automatic once the heart is worn or held in hand.
usage.duration: Instantaneous shield activation; health regeneration is continuous while the relic is active.
usage.endsWhen: The relic's power fades after a short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires rest to recharge.

hyrule_temple_ancient_heart.priceReason: This relic offers both defensive and healing benefits, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer.

hyrule_temple_ancient_key.name: Temple Guardian Key
hyrule_temple_ancient_key.description: The Temple Guardian Key, forged from sacred heartwood found only within the hidden groves of the Temple of Whispers, is a relic that unlocks ancient chambers long sealed by time and magic. Upon use, it grants the wielder temporary access to forbidden zones, revealing unseen weaknesses in both foes and defenses. The key's touch also enhances one’s chances of uncovering rare treasures within guarded areas, making it invaluable for those who seek the secrets of lost temples.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Weaknesses
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation as a bonus action, this key grants advantage on attack rolls against enemies within the chamber for 1 minute. The effect ends if the user takes damage or enters a different zone.

effectDetails.title: Enhance Treasure Discovery
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes after use, the wielder has a 25% chance to find rare loot in guarded areas. This benefit is lost if the key's uses are exhausted.

hyrule_temple_ancient_key.levelRequirementReason: This key requires a user with at least three levels of experience to activate its magic.
hyrule_temple_ancient_key.vendorReason: Hyrulean collectors and guardians of ancient lore sell this rare item due to its significance in unlocking lost temples.
hyrule_temple_ancient_key.shippingDetail: The key is delivered by spectral couriers who ensure it reaches its destination swiftly but with a slight delay for mystical handling.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: User takes damage or enters a different zone, or the 10-minute duration expires

hyrule_temple_ancient_key.priceReason: The Temple Guardian Key's price reflects its rarity and the power to reveal hidden secrets within ancient temples.

hyrule_temple_ancient_soul.name: Echo of the Temple’s Whisper
hyrule_temple_ancient_soul.description: A shimmering fragment of an ancient temple's core, Echo of the Temple’s Whisper is a relic that allows you to summon a spectral guardian for combat. This ethereal spirit appears in the form of a radiant light and stands steadfast by your side, bolstered by millennia-old magic. For thirty seconds, this guardian grants you an aura of protection, reducing all incoming damage by 25%, while also increasing your attack speed by 50%. The spectral entity fades into nothingness after its time is up or if you command it to dissipate.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Guardian
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Echo summons a radiant spectral guardian that stands at your side for thirty seconds. The guardian has 200 hit points and provides you with an additional +50% attack speed while it is present.

effectDetails.title: Damage Reduction
effectDetails.rules: The spectral guardian grants all nearby allies within 10 feet a temporary damage resistance of 25%. This effect lasts until the guardian dissipates, which occurs after thirty seconds or when dismissed by command.

hyrule_temple_ancient_soul.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to channel the ancient temple's power effectively.
hyrule_temple_ancient_soul.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its connection to ancient mystical artifacts and relics, including this Echo of a long-forgotten temple.
hyrule_temple_ancient_soul.shippingDetail: The spirit courier ensures safe and swift delivery, but the item must be used within three days of receipt.

usage.duration: 30 seconds or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: Guardian dissipates after time limit or dismissal by command

hyrule_temple_ancient_soul.priceReason: The item's rarity, ancient origin, and the unique spectral abilities it grants make its price justified within this shop.

hyrule_temple_blessing_amulet.name: Temple Blessing Amulet
hyrule_temple_blessing_amulet.description: The Temple Blessing Amulet is a delicate golden pendant adorned with ancient Hylian runes. Crafted from sacred materials found deep within the Eldin Caverns, it channels divine energy to protect and guide its wearer. This amulet enhances one’s combat morale during perilous adventures, boosting courage by 15% for 8 seconds. Additionally, it grants a +5% chance to find hidden treasure, ensuring that even the most mundane exploration yields unexpected riches.
effects: Boosts combat morale by 15% for 8 seconds

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +15 bonus on Charisma (Performance) checks and saving throws against fear effects. This effect lasts for 8 seconds upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Treasure Hunter’s Gift
effectDetails.rules: When the amulet is activated, it increases the chance to find hidden treasure by +5%. This effect persists until the end of the wearer's next turn.

hyrule_temple_blessing_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is suitable for all adventurers, providing a foundational boost in morale and exploration.
hyrule_temple_blessing_amulet.vendorReason: The Hyrulean Vendors are known for their connection to ancient artifacts and relics of the kingdom's past.
hyrule_temple_blessing_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by Windmill Express, ensuring swift delivery even in the most remote areas of Hyrule.

usage.activation: A free action is required to activate the amulet’s effects.
usage.duration: Each effect lasts for a duration as specified above.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end at the end of the wearer's next turn or when they are destroyed by damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, with no need for recharging.

hyrule_temple_blessing_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this amulet provides a versatile and essential tool for any adventurer, enhancing both combat morale and exploration skills without being overpowered.

hyrule_temple_blood_of_the_sundered.name: Blood of the Sundered
hyrule_temple_blood_of_the_sundered.description: The Blood of the Sundered is a vial filled with dark crimson liquid that whispers of ancient horrors and lost souls. Infusing it with your blood grants you temporary invulnerability, allowing you to shrug off fatal blows for fleeting moments. It also reveals hidden temple traps, ensuring safe passage through treacherous sanctuaries. However, the relic's power is not without cost—it drains 10% of your hit points upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary invulnerability for 5 seconds. During this time, you are immune to all damage from attacks and environmental hazards. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you take any action other than movement.

effectDetails.title: Trap Vision
effectDetails.rules: For the next 30 seconds, you can see through hidden temple traps within a 30-foot radius. You gain advantage on Perception checks to detect such hazards and can automatically succeed on checks that would normally require a roll. This effect ends when its duration expires.

hyrule_temple_blood_of_the_sundered.levelRequirementReason: The relic's power is drawn from your blood, requiring even the simplest of adventurers to have the courage to wield it.
hyrule_temple_blood_of_the_sundered.vendorReason: Hyrulean relics are known for their unpredictable nature and powerful effects, making them a staple in Hyrule’s black market.
hyrule_temple_blood_of_the_sundered.shippingDetail: The Blood of the Sundered is fragile and must be transported under strict conditions to prevent its power from leaking during transit.

usage.duration: 5 seconds (Invulnerability), 30 seconds (Trap Vision)
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or you take an action other than movement (Invulnerability); Duration expires (Trap Vision)

hyrule_temple_blood_of_the_sundered.priceReason: The Blood of the Sundered balances cost and value, reflecting its rare nature and powerful effects without overburdening players.

hyrule_temple_blood_ritual.name: Blood of the Fractured Temple
hyrule_temple_blood_ritual.description: The vial contains a single, crimson drop of blood from an ancient guardian of the Temple of Trials. Consuming it grants you temporary invincibility in the heart of the Atrium, where shifting architecture and reality rifts test even the mightiest heroes. For ten seconds, no force can harm you as you navigate the temple’s treacherous corridors, guided by a revelation that reveals the true path forward through the Atrium's ever-changing geometry.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Invincibility
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, you gain temporary invincibility for 10 seconds. During this time, no damage can be dealt to you by any source. This effect is instantaneous and cannot be dispelled or ended early.

effectDetails.title: Reveal True Path
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your temporary invincibility, you gain the ability to see through the Atrium's shifting architecture and reality rifts. You can instantly discern the true path forward without any hesitation or misdirection.

hyrule_temple_blood_ritual.levelRequirementReason: Even the novice must prove their worth in the Temple of Trials, but this vial grants a crucial advantage to all who dare consume it.
hyrule_temple_blood_ritual.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient guardians and vendors alike recognize the value of such an item for any brave soul venturing into the temple.
hyrule_temple_blood_ritual.shippingDetail: The vial is shipped in a specially designed, temperature-controlled container to ensure its potency remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: 10 seconds of temporary invincibility and the ability to reveal true paths
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you take damage

hyrule_temple_blood_ritual.priceReason: The rarity, lore, and unique benefits of this vial justify its price in experienced hands.

hyrule_temple_bloodstone.name: Crimson Vessel of the Deep
hyrule_temple_bloodstone.description: The Crimson Vessel of the Deep is a glowing obsidian shard said to be the final remnant of Hyrule’s Temple altar. Crafted in the heart of the temple, it emits an eerie crimson light that pierces through shadows and time. It grants immunity to poison and disease for three turns, allowing one to walk unharmed through the foulest of plagues. Additionally, it enhances movement speed by 10% when traversing dark or sacred temple environs, making exploration swift and silent.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Poison & Disease
effectDetails.rules: The user gains immunity to poison and disease effects for three turns. This effect is triggered upon activation, lasts until the end of their next turn, and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: While in dark or temple environments, the user's movement speed increases by 10%. The effect is active as long as they are within these areas; it ends when leaving such locations, and can be activated once per short rest.

hyrule_temple_bloodstone.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted for adventurers of all levels to provide a starting advantage in challenging temple environments.
hyrule_temple_bloodstone.vendorReason: Hyrule's vendors are well-known for their connections to ancient relics and artifacts from the Temple’s storied history.
hyrule_temple_bloodstone.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Postal with expedited delivery, ensuring timely arrival of this sacred relic.

usage.duration: Three turns upon activation; ends at the end of the next turn or when used again
usage.endsWhen: The effect expires after three turns or is reactivated for a new duration

hyrule_temple_bloodstone.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and the special crafting required to produce such an artifact from the Temple of Hyrule.

hyrule_temple_bone_ward.name: Temple Bone Ward
hyrule_temple_bone_ward.description: The Temple Bone Ward is a ceremonial shield crafted from the bones of fallen temple guardians, each rib infused with holy energy. Its faint hum resonates with forgotten prayers and whispers warnings of impending undead incursions. When worn in sacred temples, its enchanted surface grants +1 to defense and absorbs physical damage, reducing incoming strikes by 20%. Upon contact with undead foes, it has a 30% chance to stun them momentarily.

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption
effectDetails.rules: The Temple Bone Ward reduces incoming physical damage by 20% when worn. This effect is passive and lasts until the wearer takes a short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stun on Contact
effectDetails.rules: When in contact with an undead foe, the shield has a 30% chance to stun it as a reaction. The stunned undead cannot take actions for one round. This effect can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_bone_ward.levelRequirementReason: The intricate enchantments and sacred nature of the Temple Bone Ward require a minimum level to properly channel its protective energies.
hyrule_temple_bone_ward.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient temples are known for crafting and preserving such holy relics, ensuring their guardians have the means to defend against undead threats.
hyrule_temple_bone_ward.shippingDetail: Ships within three days of order placement; expedited delivery available at an additional cost.

usage.activation: Passive effect. No activation required when worn in temple zones.
usage.duration: Permanent while worn, lasts until a short or long rest is taken.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted by taking a short or long rest; can be recharged with a full night's sleep.

hyrule_temple_bone_ward.priceReason: The item’s rarity, holy enchantments, and the time required for its creation justify this balanced XP price.

hyrule_temple_core.name: Heart of the Atrium
hyrule_temple_core.description: The Heart of the Atrium hums with raw, unstable power extracted from the fractured heart of Hyrule's ancient Atrium. This pulsating core amplifies the wielder’s attack during moments of reality instability but demands a toll on stamina. In temple areas, it grants the user a 10% chance to bypass terrain barriers, and for two turns, it reduces enemy regeneration by 15%, making it an invaluable tool for heroes facing Hyrule's fractured heart.

effectDetails.title: Temple Terrain Bypass
effectDetails.rules: When in temple areas, the Heart of the Atrium grants the wielder a 10% chance to ignore terrain barriers. This effect is limited to one use per day.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Regeneration Reduction
effectDetails.rules: During moments of reality instability, this core reduces enemy regeneration by 15%, lasting for two turns. It can be activated as a bonus action and has no save DC or recharge requirement.

hyrule_temple_core.levelRequirementReason: Wielders must possess the physical and mental fortitude to handle such volatile power.
hyrule_temple_core.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient artifacts are meticulously preserved by the guardians of the temples, ensuring their proper use and handling.
hyrule_temple_core.shippingDetail: Due to its unstable nature, this item is only delivered via Koopa Postal’s secure air express service.

usage.activation: Bonus action during moments of reality instability for enemy regeneration reduction; passive effect in temple areas for terrain bypass chance.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, lasting the duration of two turns for enemy regeneration reduction.
usage.endsWhen: The core's effects end upon being destroyed or when its uses are exhausted.

hyrule_temple_core.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect the item’s unique and limited utility, ensuring it remains a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

hyrule_temple_crimson_core.name: Crimson Core of the Crimson Temple
hyrule_temple_crimson_core.description: The Crimson Core of the Crimson Temple hums with a raw, volcanic power, its surface crackling with crimson light. When activated, it grants the user an overwhelming aura that dominates foes within a 15-foot radius, compelling them to attack the nearest non-hostile target. This core's ancient magic comes from the heart of the temple, where it was forged in the fires of a forgotten age. Drawing on this power costs the user stamina; every turn during its use, they lose an additional 5% of their total stamina.
effects: +20% damage to all enemies within 15 feet
Compels foes to attack nearest non-hostile target

effectDetails.title: Dominating Aura
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The aura lasts for 1 minute. Within this time, all hostile creatures within 15 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to attack the nearest non-hostile target. This effect ends if the user drops the core or takes any damage.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Drain
effectDetails.rules: Every turn during use, the user loses 5% of their total stamina until it is exhausted. The core can only be used once per short rest due to this strain on the user's stamina.

hyrule_temple_crimson_core.levelRequirementReason: Only those with a proven mastery of combat and magic are capable of wielding the Crimson Core's raw power without succumbing to its drain.
hyrule_temple_crimson_core.vendorReason: Hyrule is home to many ancient artifacts, and the Crimson Temple itself has long been a source of potent relics.
hyrule_temple_crimson_core.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, which ensures safe delivery but takes an additional day due to the core's unstable nature.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the user drops it or takes damage
usage.endsWhen: The user drops the core or takes damage

hyrule_temple_crimson_core.priceReason: The Crimson Core's rarity and the significant stamina drain make its price fair, offering a powerful but perilous tool for seasoned adventurers.

hyrule_temple_echo.name: Echo of the Ancient Guardian
hyrule_temple_echo.description: The Echo of the Ancient Guardian is a crystalline artifact forged from the last breath of an ancient guardian, its surface etched with forgotten runes that shimmer like starlight. When activated, it summons a spectral echo that strikes all enemies within a 5-meter radius with devastating force, leaving them reeling in shock and pain. The guardian's final breath imbues the spell with a potent surge of magic, enhancing your allies' attacks by +30% damage for ten seconds, ensuring their next blow lands true.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Echo
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. A spectral echo is summoned within a 5-meter radius of the user, striking all enemies in the area with a spell attack that deals 200% damage. If an enemy's hit points are below 25%, the damage increases by 50%. The effect lasts for 5 seconds and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Guardian's Favor
effectDetails.rules: Grants +30% bonus to all magic attack rolls made by allies within a 10-meter radius. This effect lasts for 10 seconds after the spectral echo is summoned and can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_echo.levelRequirementReason: Only those with a deep understanding of ancient magic, such as a 7th-level spellcaster, can properly invoke the guardian's spirit.
hyrule_temple_echo.vendorReason: The Temple of Time, in Hyrule, holds many relics from its past guardians; it only makes sense that they would have access to this powerful artifact.
hyrule_temple_echo.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Rakasha's ethereal plane, ensuring swift and safe delivery without the risk of theft or damage.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon the spectral echo; magic attack bonus from Guardian's Favor lasts for 10 seconds after activation.
usage.duration: Spectral Echo lasts 5 seconds, Guardian's Favor lasts 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: After its duration expires or when a new use is activated

hyrule_temple_echo.priceReason: This artifact, crafted from the essence of an ancient guardian, commands a price that reflects both its rarity and the immense power it holds.

hyrule_temple_echo_amulet.name: Temple Echo Amulet
hyrule_temple_echo_amulet.description: The Temple Echo Amulet is a glowing pendant imbued with the essence of ancient temples. Its surface crackles with an ethereal light, and when worn, it hums with the spirits of bygone eras. This amulet grants its wearer the ability to hear the whispers of the past and detect hidden temple entrances within 20 meters. It also reveals the location of any enemies in a temple zone, aiding in stealthy maneuvers and strategic combat.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of the Past
effectDetails.rules: By spending an action to focus on a temple, the wearer can hear faint whispers and gain insight into past events within that location. This effect provides a +1d4 bonus to History checks made in the vicinity for 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Detect Hidden Entrances
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the amulet detects hidden temple entrances within 20 meters of the wearer. This effect can be used once per short or long rest and requires a successful Wisdom (Perception) check against DC 15.

hyrule_temple_echo_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The complex magic woven into the amulet demands a minimum level to fully harness its powers.
hyrule_temple_echo_amulet.vendorReason: As a guardian of ancient lore and history, Hyrule is entrusted with artifacts that preserve the past for future generations.
hyrule_temple_echo_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped via Pipe Express, known for their reliable and swift deliveries across the kingdom.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Whispers of the Past) / 10 minutes (Perception check)
usage.endsWhen: Used up or expended on a failed Wisdom (Perception) check
usage.charges: Once per short or long rest

hyrule_temple_echo_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and the intricate magic required to craft it justify its high price.

hyrule_temple_echo_chime.name: Temple Echo Chime
hyrule_temple_echo_chime.description: The Temple Echo Chime, a resonant artifact forged from ancient temple bells, amplifies the user's voice and reveals hidden paths when spoken to. Crafted in the sacred forges of Hyrule, this chime can be heard echoing through distant walls, guiding lost heroes to their goal with its melodious call. It amplifies speech by 30%, ensuring your words carry farther than they should, while also revealing secret doors within ancient ruins—miracles of craftsmanship that only those who know the sacred language can unlock.

effectDetails.title: Speech Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a bonus action. The user's voice is amplified, increasing its range by 30%. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the user speaks again.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Doors
effectDetails.rules: When spoken to, this chime can reveal hidden doors within ancient ruins. It must be used in a specific sacred language known only to those initiated into its mysteries; otherwise, no effect occurs. The effect lasts until the next long rest.

hyrule_temple_echo_chime.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible early on for characters who need guidance and communication tools.
hyrule_temple_echo_chime.vendorReason: Hyrulean artisans have a deep understanding of ancient crafts, making them the perfect keepers of such relics.
hyrule_temple_echo_chime.shippingDetail: Delivered with Pipe Express, known for their reliable and speedy deliveries within Hyrule.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate speech amplification; spoken command to reveal hidden doors.
usage.duration: Speech amplification lasts for 1 minute or until the user speaks again. Revealing hidden doors is instantaneous but only once per short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires, a long rest is taken, or the item's use limit is reached.

hyrule_temple_echo_chime.priceReason: The item’s rarity and utility justify its price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_temple_echo_cloak.name: Whispering Cloak of the Oracle
hyrule_temple_echo_cloak.description: Woven from the voice of ancient guardians, the Whispering Cloak of the Oracle is a shimmering garment that whispers secrets of forgotten realms into your ear. As you step into ancient ruins, it amplifies the subtle sounds of hidden traps and puzzles, guiding you to their location with eerie precision. Worn in the presence of relics or artifacts, the cloak can even ‘speak’ on behalf of these silent objects, providing cryptic yet invaluable information.

effectDetails.title: Hear Hidden Secrets
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to discern hidden secrets or truths. This effect is active while the cloak is worn.

effectDetails.title: Detect Traps and Puzzles
effectDetails.rules: When within 30 feet of a trap or puzzle, the wearer can use an action to gain passive Perception (Investigation) insight into its nature. The DC for this check is equal to 10 + the trap's or puzzle's level.

hyrule_temple_echo_cloak.levelRequirementReason: This cloak offers a significant advantage in exploring ancient ruins, making it accessible early on.
hyrule_temple_echo_cloak.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its rich history and connection to ancient lore, making it fitting that the Oracle's Whispering Cloak originates from there.
hyrule_temple_echo_cloak.shippingDetail: The cloak arrives within a week but requires careful handling due to its delicate nature.

usage.activation: Passive effect while worn; no activation required.
usage.duration: Instantaneous with each check, until the wearer removes it or leaves the area of effect.
usage.endsWhen: The cloak is removed from the wearer's body or they leave the immediate vicinity of traps and puzzles.

hyrule_temple_echo_cloak.priceReason: Reflecting its rarity, this item provides significant utility early in a character’s journey but does not grant overpowered abilities.

hyrule_temple_echo_gear.name: Echoing Temple Gear
hyrule_temple_echo_gear.description: The Echoing Temple Gear is forged from the whispering stones of Hyrule's Great Temple of Twilight. This ancient artifact amplifies the wielder’s ability to hear and understand the ancient chants that guide through hidden passages. Crafted with the essence of twilight, it grants a passive sense of the temple’s layout within 20 meters, ensuring no secret path remains undiscovered. Its resonance fades after 30 seconds, leaving the user prepared for the next challenge.

effectDetails.title: Amplifies Ancient Chants
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains advantage on Intelligence (History) checks related to ancient Hyrulean lore and can unlock hidden passages within the temple. This effect lasts until its resonance fades after 30 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Passive Temple Awareness
effectDetails.rules: The user has passive perception of temple entrances within a 20-meter radius, allowing them to detect secret doors or other concealed paths without requiring an action.

hyrule_temple_echo_gear.levelRequirementReason: This gear is designed for adventurers who are just beginning their journey into the mysteries of Hyrule's temples.
hyrule_temple_echo_gear.vendorReason: Hyrulean vendors like to stock items that resonate with the history and culture of the land, making this artifact a natural fit.
hyrule_temple_echo_gear.shippingDetail: Ships via a spirit courier ensuring swift delivery within Hyrule’s sacred grounds.

usage.activation: Passive effect active; no activation required.
usage.duration: 30 seconds, until resonance fades.
usage.endsWhen: Resonance fades after 30 seconds or when the user enters a new location.

hyrule_temple_echo_gear.priceReason: The gear’s rarity and historical significance justify its moderate price, aligning with other rare items in Hyrule.

hyrule_temple_echo_ring.name: Temple Echo Ring
hyrule_temple_echo_ring.description: The Temple Echo Ring hums with the ancient power of Hyrule's sacred temples, its surface etched with runes that whisper protective chants. When worn, it allows the wearer to dodge incoming attacks with uncanny precision and summons a shimmering shield that reduces damage by 10% for a short time upon being struck. The ring is said to have been crafted in the heart of the Temple of Time, where its origins are shrouded in legend.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Next Attack
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from an attack while wearing the ring, you have a 25% chance to dodge it. This effect can only occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Summons Temporary Shield
effectDetails.rules: If you are hit by an attack, the Temple Echo Ring creates a shimmering shield that reduces the damage taken from that attack by 10%, lasting for 1 minute. You can activate this ability once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_echo_ring.levelRequirementReason: The ring's ancient power requires a level 5 character to wield, ensuring it is not overpowered.
hyrule_temple_echo_ring.vendorReason: Hyrulean artisans are skilled in crafting relics that bridge the gap between myth and reality, making this ring a natural addition to their offerings.
hyrule_temple_echo_ring.shippingDetail: Delivered via the magical pipes that crisscross Hyrule, ensuring swift delivery directly from the Temple of Time.

usage.duration: 1 minute upon being hit by an attack
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the ring is removed or destroyed, or after 1 minute has passed.

hyrule_temple_echo_ring.priceReason: The ring's rare crafting materials and ancient magic make it a valuable yet balanced addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

hyrule_temple_echo_shard.name: Temple Echo Shard
hyrule_temple_echo_shard.description: The Temple Echo Shard, a shimmering fragment of ancient temple resonance, hums with forgotten prayers and whispers of hidden lore. When wielded in combat, it amplifies the spirit of its bearer, granting temporary insight into the sacred geometry of the temple. The shard’s resonant hum can reveal secret doorways or traps, offering a fleeting glimpse into the unknown. Upon contact with magical forces, it momentarily reduces their resistance to arcane attacks, allowing for more potent and precise spells.
effects: Grants 10% chance to reveal hidden doorways or traps

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Hazards
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder is within 30 feet of a concealed trap or secret doorway, they have a 10% chance to immediately detect it. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Magical Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one encounter, when the wielder successfully hits an enemy with a magic attack, they reduce that enemy’s magical resistance by 20% for 5 seconds. This effect can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_echo_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard is accessible to beginners who are eager to explore and protect sacred temples.
hyrule_temple_echo_shard.vendorReason: Hyrule, the guardian of ancient knowledge, sells this relic to adventurers seeking to uncover forgotten secrets and legends.
hyrule_temple_echo_shard.shippingDetail: This item is carefully packed in a custom Hyrulean crate and delivered by Pipe Express within 3 days.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when the wielder is within 30 feet of a concealed area or magical force.
usage.duration: 1 minute for 'Reveal Hidden Hazards', encounter for 'Enhanced Magical Resistance'
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends naturally, or the effect can be expended once per rest.

hyrule_temple_echo_shard.priceReason: The Temple Echo Shard is moderately priced given its unique abilities to aid in exploration and combat within temple environments.

hyrule_temple_echo_sword.name: Echo of the Temple Blade
hyrule_temple_echo_sword.description: The Echo of the Temple Blade is a sword forged from the echoes of ancient temples, its hilt adorned with runes that glow faintly in the dark. It strikes with divine precision, leaving spectral imprints on foes and resonating with the spirits of forgotten guardians who once defended these sacred grounds. The blade's touch can be felt even when wielded far from temple ruins, though its power wanes outside such hallowed spaces.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When the Echo of the Temple Blade strikes an enemy within temple ruins, it deals 120% damage and has a 15% chance to stagger the target for 2 turns. This effect can occur once every 3 attacks.

effectDetails.title: Guardian Summoning
effectDetails.rules: By concentrating on the sword's runes (a bonus action), you may summon a ghostly guardian that grants you a +1 bonus to AC and provides a 10% resistance to magical damage for 3 turns. The guardian can only be summoned once per short rest.

hyrule_temple_echo_sword.levelRequirementReason: The blade's echo requires the wielder to have mastered basic swordsmanship and be attuned to the spiritual energies of ancient temples.
hyrule_temple_echo_sword.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its connection to ancient sites, making it a fitting vendor for this sacred weapon.
hyrule_temple_echo_sword.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with tracking enabled; fragile items must be handled with care.

usage.duration: 3 turns for Echoing Strikes, once per short rest for Guardian Summoning
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the target of Echoing Strikes is no longer in temple ruins or guardian's effects expire

hyrule_temple_echo_sword.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its divine craftsmanship and sacred powers, this sword justifies a price that is both fair and challenging for players of suitable level.

hyrule_temple_echoes.name: Temple Echoes of the Forgotten
hyrule_temple_echoes.description: The Temple Echoes of the Forgotten amulet is a shimmering, ancient pendant crafted from the very heart of Hyrule's lost temples. Its surface glows faintly as it hums with the whispers of forgotten secrets. When worn, it reveals hidden paths and doorways in dungeons, offering invaluable assistance to explorers seeking relics. The echoes subtly boost combat awareness during battles, sharpening senses by 20% and slightly increasing HP regeneration after each encounter.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Entrances
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the amulet can be activated as a bonus action to reveal hidden dungeon entrances within 30 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Combat Awareness Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +20 bonus to Insight checks related to combat awareness until the start of their next turn after using this amulet. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action or reaction, but it can be used only once per day.

hyrule_temple_echoes.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's power is accessible to all adventurers who seek lost relics.
hyrule_temple_echoes.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its expertise in crafting items that connect adventurers with ancient lore and forgotten secrets.
hyrule_temple_echoes.shippingDetail: The amulet arrives within a week, sealed in an enchanted container that protects it from magical tampering.

usage.activation: Bonus action to reveal hidden entrances; no activation for combat awareness boost.
usage.duration: 1 minute for revealing hidden entrances; instantaneous for combat awareness boost.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or a short rest is taken after using it.

hyrule_temple_echoes.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and unique properties make it a valuable tool for explorers, justifying its moderate price.

hyrule_temple_echoing_crown.name: Echoing Crown of the Fallen Sage
hyrule_temple_echoing_crown.description: The Echoing Crown of the Fallen Sage, a relic of Hyrule’s sacred temples, whispers ancient magic into the ears of its wearer. Crafted from enchanted silver and inlaid with runes that glow faintly under torchlight, it amplifies the strength and wisdom of those who dare to wear it within the temple’s hallowed halls. Those who wield this crown can call upon a guardian spirit for 15 seconds, bolstering their allies' resilience and striking fear into the hearts of enemies.

effectDetails.title: Guardian Spirit
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, creating a protective spirit that grants +2 bonus to AC and advantage on saving throws for the wearer and nearby allies within 10 feet. Lasts for 15 seconds or until dismissed.

effectDetails.title: Increased Temple Damage
effectDetails.rules: Grants +30% damage against temple guardians, with a maximum of +2 bonus to attack rolls during this duration.

hyrule_temple_echoing_crown.levelRequirementReason: The crown’s ancient magic requires the wearer to have mastered basic combat skills.
hyrule_temple_echoing_crown.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its sacred relics and ancient artifacts, making it fitting that this powerful item be sold there.
hyrule_temple_echoing_crown.shippingDetail: Delivered with a Shy Guy delivery slip ensuring safe arrival within three days.

usage.activation: Action to summon Guardian Spirit; bonus action for increased damage against temple guardians.
usage.duration: 15 seconds or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed by the wearer, or when the duration expires

hyrule_temple_echoing_crown.priceReason: The crown’s rarity and ancient power justify a price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_temple_essence.name: Ruin’s Whisper
hyrule_temple_essence.description: Ruin’s Whisper is a crystalline shard forged from the ancient heart of the Temple of the Lost Echoes. Infused with dark magic, it amplifies spell damage by 20% and grants fleeting recall of your last battle for 3 seconds upon death, allowing you to relive the combat in vivid memory. This relic, crafted in a ritual that defies time itself, is a symbol of the temple’s lost power.

effectDetails.title: +20% Spell Damage
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The spell damage of all spells cast is increased by 20%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fleeting Battle Recall
effectDetails.rules: Triggers upon death, providing a brief memory recall of the caster’s last battle for 3 seconds. The caster can relive and review this combat in vivid detail as a reaction to an attack that deals damage to them.

hyrule_temple_essence.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible to all adventurers, as it aids in their earliest battles without imposing a steep level barrier.
hyrule_temple_essence.vendorReason: Hyrule, being the cradle of ancient magic and lore, holds this shard within its vast archives for scholars and brave souls alike.
hyrule_temple_essence.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral messengers; may arrive on time or slightly delayed due to their whimsical nature.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn

hyrule_temple_essence.priceReason: This relic strikes a balance between its potent magical effects and accessibility, ensuring it remains valuable without being overpowered.

hyrule_temple_forged_blade.name: Tempest’s Edge
hyrule_temple_forged_blade.description: Tempest’s Edge is a blade forged from the shattered heart of an ancient temple guardian, its surface etched with runes that pulse like living veins. The sword hums with residual magic, capable of cleaving through both shadow and stone, and it echoes with the forgotten rituals of a bygone era. When wielded within a temple’s sacred confines, Tempest’s Edge amplifies its power, dealing extra damage to enemies ensconced in the holy ground.

effectDetails.title: Temple Echo
effectDetails.rules: When within a temple zone, Tempest’s Edge deals an additional +15 damage to enemies. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn or until you leave the temple area.

effectDetails.title: +20% Damage against Shadowfell Enemies
effectDetails.rules: Tempest’s Edge inflicts 20% increased damage on all attacks against Shadowfell creatures. This bonus applies every time you attack a Shadowfell enemy, but not more than once per turn.

hyrule_temple_forged_blade.levelRequirementReason: The blade's ancient magic and the rituals it embodies demand a seasoned warrior with at least five levels to wield it effectively.
hyrule_temple_forged_blade.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its deep ties to ancient artifacts and relics, making it a fitting vendor for Tempest’s Edge.
hyrule_temple_forged_blade.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones with expedited delivery within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect upon entering a temple zone; duration lasts until the end of your next turn or leaving the area.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or when you leave the temple zone.
usage.endsWhen: The bonus damage from Temple Echo ends either at the end of your next turn or when you exit the temple’s sacred confines.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you remain within a temple zone.

hyrule_temple_forged_blade.priceReason: The blade's rare crafting materials and ancient magic justify its price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_temple_fragments.name: Echoing Temple Shard
hyrule_temple_fragments.description: The Echoing Temple Shard is a fragment of ancient craftsmanship, its surface etched with runes of forgotten lore. Crafted from the heartwood of an enchanted tree that once grew in the sacred grounds of the Temple of the Forgotten, this relic hums with residual magic that resonates with the spirits of long-lost guardians. It grants temporary immunity to silence and confusion, allowing you to speak your truth even under duress. When within 100 feet of a temple ruin, it amplifies your critical hits by 15%, ensuring that your most devastating blows are truly unforgettable.

effectDetails.title: Silence & Confusion Immunity
effectDetails.rules: When you enter a state of silence or confusion, this shard grants temporary immunity to these effects. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after entering the state.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Critical Hits
effectDetails.rules: While within 100 feet of a temple ruin, any melee weapon attack you make deals an additional +2d6 damage on a critical hit. This effect is limited to one use per long rest.

hyrule_temple_fragments.levelRequirementReason: This shard's power draws from ancient magic that is accessible to all who seek it.
hyrule_temple_fragments.vendorReason: Hyrule, as a guardian of ancient sites and relics, naturally possesses this item for its cultural significance.
hyrule_temple_fragments.shippingDetail: Ships via the fastest spirit courier service, ensuring swift delivery from the Temple grounds to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Passive effect when within range of a temple ruin.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for immunity; limited to one use per long rest for enhanced critical hits.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon entering silence or confusion, or after one successful critical hit with the weapon.

hyrule_temple_fragments.priceReason: Balanced at this price point to reflect its rare material and ancient magic.

hyrule_temple_fury_amulet.name: Fury of the Temple Guardian
hyrule_temple_fury_amulet.description: The Fury of the Temple Guardian is an amulet forged from the heart of ancient Hyrulean temples. It channels the wrath and resilience of guardian spirits, enhancing your melee prowess in combat. Upon activation, it grants a surge of strength, boosting your attack speed by 30% and increasing damage output by 25%, but be wary—its power comes at a cost; after a critical hit, you are drenched in an armor-like barrier for three turns, temporarily bolstering your defense to the max.

effectDetails.title: Melee Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases melee attack speed by 30% and damage by 25% for 10 seconds, after which the effects dissipate.

effectDetails.title: Critical Armor
effectDetails.rules: After landing a critical hit with any weapon, you are enveloped in an armor-like barrier that grants 100% armor for three turns. This effect can only occur once per combat.

hyrule_temple_fury_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 6th level to wield the amulet's power and channel its ancient magic effectively.
hyrule_temple_fury_amulet.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its mastery of sacred relics, making it a fitting vendor for this divine artifact.
hyrule_temple_fury_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, the amulet arrives in pristine condition, ready to be activated upon receipt.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per activation
