usage.endsWhen: After landing a critical hit or when the duration ends
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only activate once after a critical hit

hyrule_temple_fury_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's price reflects its rare material and the ancient craftsmanship required to forge it.

hyrule_temple_heart.name: Temple Heart of the Unbroken
hyrule_temple_heart.description: The Temple Heart of the Unbroken, forged deep within Hyrule's sacred temples, pulses with an ancient energy that grants the wearer a momentary defiance against harm. When struck twice in combat, it activates to grant invulnerability for thirty seconds, allowing you to shrug off the next two attacks. Additionally, while active, this relic restores 10% of your maximum hit points every ten seconds, ensuring you remain battle-ready through prolonged skirmishes.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability on Consecutive Hits
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer of the Temple Heart is struck twice consecutively in combat, it activates to grant invulnerability for thirty seconds. During this time, they are immune to all damage and status effects. The effect ends when the duration expires or if the wearer takes any form of damage.

effectDetails.title: Hit Point Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: While active, the relic restores 10% of the wearer's maximum hit points every ten seconds. This effect is limited to a maximum of five restorations per long rest and ends when the relic is expended or destroyed.

hyrule_temple_heart.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic and divine craftsmanship required for its creation necessitate at least sixth-level proficiency to wield effectively.
hyrule_temple_heart.vendorReason: Hyrule's priests and scholars, who have safeguarded the relic since its creation, are entrusted with its distribution.
hyrule_temple_heart.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter Relay ensures timely delivery via a secure, starship courier service.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon equipping and activation by consecutive hits in combat.
usage.duration: Thirty seconds per activation.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or wearer takes damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to five restorations per long rest.

hyrule_temple_heart.priceReason: The relic's balanced price reflects its significant power and rarity without breaking game balance.

hyrule_temple_heart_brooch.name: Brooch of the Temple Heart
hyrule_temple_heart_brooch.description: The Brooch of the Temple Heart, crafted from the very core of Hyrule's ancient Temple of the Unbroken, pulses with a steady energy that resonates like the heart of the temple itself. When worn in combat, it channels this power to grant a protective aura and restore vitality. This relic not only enhances your defense against magical attacks but also ensures you recover lost health over time after resting.
effects: Restores 150 HP every minute while inactive

effectDetails.title: Magical Defense Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when exposed to a magical attack. Provides +30% resistance against such attacks for the next round.

effectDetails.title: Healing Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Restores 150 HP every minute while the wearer is inactive and not engaged in combat. Ends if the wearer enters battle or uses any consumable healing items.

hyrule_temple_heart_brooch.levelRequirementReason: The brooch's ancient magic can be harnessed by even the most novice adventurers.
hyrule_temple_heart_brooch.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its preservation of ancient relics and artifacts, making it the ideal vendor for such a powerful item.
hyrule_temple_heart_brooch.shippingDetail: Packages are dispatched with Koopa Postal's fastest delivery service to ensure your brooch arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for the next round after activation
usage.endsWhen: The wearer enters combat or uses a consumable healing item
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires at least one minute of inactivity to recharge

hyrule_temple_heart_brooch.priceReason: Balanced against other rare items of similar power and functionality.

hyrule_temple_heart_core.name: Heart Core of the First Temple
hyrule_temple_heart_core.description: The Heart Core of the First Temple is a pulsating relic carved from the sacred stone of the Temple of Time. Its origins are shrouded in the legends of ancient Hyrule, and it hums with the raw essence of the Guardians who once defended the temple. When activated, this core summons a spectral guardian that fights alongside you during combat, delivering devastating blows to foes while providing a shield against incoming attacks.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Guardian
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can summon a spectral guardian that fights by their side. The guardian deals 200% damage to enemies and lasts for 1 minute or until destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Guardian Shield
effectDetails.rules: While the spectral guardian is active, you have resistance to all non-magical damage. This effect ends if the guardian takes any damage.

hyrule_temple_heart_core.levelRequirementReason: The core's ancient magic demands a user of at least 7th level to channel its power.
hyrule_temple_heart_core.vendorReason: Hyrule is the keeper and custodian of many relics from the Temple of Time, including this sacred Heart Core.
hyrule_temple_heart_core.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express, known for its swift and reliable courier service in Hyrule.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Guardian takes damage or is dismissed

hyrule_temple_heart_core.priceReason: The relic's rarity and the power it provides justify its high price in the market.

hyrule_temple_heart_gem.name: Heart of the Temple Gem
hyrule_temple_heart_gem.description: The Heart of the Temple Gem pulses with an ancient, otherworldly energy, its facets shimmering with hues of gold and crimson as if forged from the very soul of Hyrule’s sacred temples. This pulsating crystal, born in the sanctum of a long-lost temple, grants the wearer enhanced healing and the ability to see hidden paths within the temple walls. When activated, it releases a radiant glow that mends wounds with ethereal precision, while also revealing secret routes previously veiled from sight.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Healing
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Restores 50% of the user's hit point maximum and grants temporary immunity to all forms of damage for 1 minute upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Vision of Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: Grants the user a +3 insight bonus on Perception checks to detect hidden or secret doors within a temple, but only during the first hour after the gem is activated. Lasts until the end of the session.

hyrule_temple_heart_gem.levelRequirementReason: The Heart of the Temple Gem's power is accessible to all adventurers, as its ancient magic can be harnessed by anyone willing to seek it.
hyrule_temple_heart_gem.vendorReason: Hyrule’s renowned vendors, known for their vast knowledge and connections within the kingdom, regularly stock this rare item due to its revered history and practical utility in temple exploration.
hyrule_temple_heart_gem.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Postal with expedited delivery, ensuring adventurers receive their gem safely and promptly.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Enhanced Healing) / Until the end of the session (Vision of Hidden Paths)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user takes damage or at the end of the session (whichever comes first).

hyrule_temple_heart_gem.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this gem's price reflects its rarity and the valuable benefits it offers to adventurers.

hyrule_temple_heart_ore.name: Temple Heart Ore
hyrule_temple_heart_ore.description: Temple Heart Ore gleams faintly in the dark, a mineral harvested from the sacred core of Hyrule’s ancient temple. When consumed, it not only restores stamina but also grants the user temporary vision to detect hidden traps and hazards, invaluable for navigating treacherous dungeons or avoiding unseen perils. In darkness, its glow intensifies, heightening one's senses, yet at a cost: while temporarily sharper-eyed, the user becomes slightly more vulnerable to damage.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, Temple Heart Ore restores 20% of the user’s maximum stamina. This effect is instantaneous.

effectDetails.title: Trap Detection
effectDetails.rules: For 10 seconds after consumption, the user gains advantage on Perception checks to detect hidden traps and hazards. This effect ends when the duration expires or if the user takes damage in combat.

hyrule_temple_heart_ore.levelRequirementReason: The simplicity of extracting and consuming this ore makes it accessible even for lower-level adventurers.
hyrule_temple_heart_ore.vendorReason: Hyrule’s extensive mining operations ensure a steady supply of Temple Heart Ore, which is readily available to all travelers and explorers.
hyrule_temple_heart_ore.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express, this ore arrives fresh from the mines within a day, ensuring its potency remains unimpaired.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until the user takes damage in combat
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or user takes damage

hyrule_temple_heart_ore.priceReason: This ore is moderately priced, reflecting its common origin and practical utility for adventurers.

hyrule_temple_heart_pendant.name: Heart of the Atronian Vault
hyrule_temple_heart_pendant.description: The Heart of the Atronian Vault hangs heavy upon the neck, its blackened crystal pulsing with a faint, otherworldly glow. Crafted from the heart of an ancient guardian and forged in the shadowy flames of the Temple of Shadows, this pendant amplifies one's courage in the face of darkness. When near sacred ruins, it resonates with the spirits of long-dead guardians, granting a defensive boon and drawing dark creatures to their doom.

effectDetails.title: Guardian Echo
effectDetails.rules: When within 10 meters of temple structures, the Heart of the Atronian Vault activates a Guardian Echo. For each dark creature within this radius, you gain a +2 bonus to your AC and damage rolls against them until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Defensive Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When near ancient ruins (within 50 feet), the Heart amplifies your defensive prowess by granting a +15% increase in AC for 1 minute. This effect can be triggered up to three times per long rest.

hyrule_temple_heart_pendant.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic within requires a level of at least 3 to properly harness.
hyrule_temple_heart_pendant.vendorReason: Hyrule's master artisans are the only ones capable of forging such powerful relics from ancient materials.
hyrule_temple_heart_pendant.shippingDetail: Delivered by Shy Guys, known for their timely and discreet deliveries within Hyrule.

usage.activation: Passive effect when near sacred ruins; Guardian Echo activated as a bonus action within 10 meters of temple structures.
usage.duration: Guardian Echo lasts until the start of your next turn. Defensive Resonance lasts for 1 minute, recharging after a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Guardian Echo ends when you move more than 20 feet away from a temple structure or when a dark creature is no longer within range.

hyrule_temple_heart_pendant.priceReason: Crafted from ancient guardian hearts and shadow flames, this pendant's price reflects its rare materials and potent magic.

hyrule_temple_heart_pulse.name: Heart Pulse of the Temple
hyrule_temple_heart_pulse.description: The Heart Pulse of the Temple, a pulsating core forged from the ancient Echoes, resonates with the very heartbeat of Hyrule's sacred architecture. When activated, it grants a burst of speed to the wielder and their allies within a five-meter radius for ten seconds. The artifact's pulse also heals one ally up to 30% of their maximum hit points, restoring both body and spirit in an instant.

effectDetails.title: Healing Pulse
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Heart Pulse heals one ally within five meters up to 30% of their maximum hit points. The effect ends if the user or target is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Swift Step
effectDetails.rules: The user and all allies within three meters gain a +20 feet movement speed bonus for ten seconds when the Heart Pulse is activated as a reaction to an opportunity attack. This effect ends if the user or any ally moves more than 30 feet.

hyrule_temple_heart_pulse.levelRequirementReason: The Heart Pulse's ancient power is accessible to all adventurers, making it a starting gift for those who seek to protect Hyrule.
hyrule_temple_heart_pulse.vendorReason: Hyrule's vendors are entrusted with the temple's relics to ensure they fall into capable hands that can harness their sacred energy.
hyrule_temple_heart_pulse.shippingDetail: The Boo Spectral Mail ensures swift and safe delivery of the Heart Pulse, as it is a revered artifact of Hyrule.

usage.duration: Ten seconds for healing; ten seconds for speed boost
usage.endsWhen: Target incapacitated or user moves more than 30 feet
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to recover the speed bonus

hyrule_temple_heart_pulse.priceReason: The Heart Pulse's price reflects its rare origin and the sacred energy it holds, making it a valuable starting gift for any adventurer.

hyrule_temple_heart_rod.name: Temple Heart Rod of the Forgotten King
hyrule_temple_heart_rod.description: The Temple Heart Rod of the Forgotten King is a relic carved from the central core of the ancient Temple of the Ancients, where time seems to stand still. Its power allows you to rewind the battlefield's fate, restoring it to its pristine state after combat. For those who wield this rod, an aura of forgotten might accompanies every strike, granting immunity to environmental damage and reducing enemy HP regeneration for a fleeting moment.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Rewind
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate this effect at the end of their turn. The battlefield is restored to its state before combat began, effectively nullifying all changes made during battle. This has no effect on conditions or status effects that do not involve health. The effect lasts for 10 seconds and may be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Immunity
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 2 rounds after using the rod, the wielder is immune to all environmental damage, such as fire, cold, or poison. This effect cannot stack with other forms of immunity and has no save DC.

hyrule_temple_heart_rod.levelRequirementReason: The rod's ancient power requires a certain mastery over time and combat to wield effectively.
hyrule_temple_heart_rod.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its deep connection with ancient artifacts, making it the keeper of such powerful relics.
hyrule_temple_heart_rod.shippingDetail: Shipped via a Rakasha spirit messenger who ensures swift delivery, even across long distances.

usage.activation: Bonus Action at the end of your turn
usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The effect duration ends or you use it again during the same rest

hyrule_temple_heart_rod.priceReason: The rod's rarity and powerful effects justify its high price, making it a valuable asset in any adventuring party.

hyrule_temple_heartstone.name: Heartstone of the Ancient Sanctum
hyrule_temple_heartstone.description: The Heartstone of the Ancient Sanctum glows with a serene, otherworldly light from its origins deep within Hyrule's Temple of the Ancients. Crafted by ancient hands and forged in sacred fires, it grants immunity to poison and burn effects, ensuring your purity remains unscathed in the harshest trials. Upon activation, it also boosts stamina regeneration by 30%, allowing you to recover with each step, as if the temple itself rejuvenates you.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Poison
effectDetails.rules: The Heartstone grants immunity to poison effects. This immunity lasts until the end of your next turn after activation.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Boost
effectDetails.rules: Increases stamina regeneration by 30% for 1 minute upon activation, providing a passive boost that ends when you are incapacitated or the duration expires.

hyrule_temple_heartstone.levelRequirementReason: The Heartstone's ancient magic requires a deep understanding of Hyrulean lore and power to activate.
hyrule_temple_heartstone.vendorReason: Hyrule is the guardian of this sacred artifact, ensuring it reaches those who have proven their worth in the temple.
hyrule_temple_heartstone.shippingDetail: The Koopa Postal service ensures timely delivery to those who seek the Heartstone's blessings.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you are incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: You become incapacitated or at the end of your next turn after activation

hyrule_temple_heartstone.priceReason: The Heartstone's rarity and unique properties justify its substantial price, reflecting its value in both lore and combat.

hyrule_temple_key.name: Zora’s Whisper Key
hyrule_temple_key.description: The Zora’s Whisper Key is a delicate, aquamarine key forged from the bones of ancient lake creatures and encrusted with luminescent pearls. When inserted into a temple door, it hums softly, whispering secrets of the lake’s depths. It grants temporary water-based teleportation within the immediate vicinity, allowing adventurers to dart between submerged chambers in moments. The key also reveals hidden underwater pathways on any map, providing a tactical advantage for navigating the treacherous temples.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Water-Based Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: The Zora’s Whisper Key allows the user to teleport between submerged chambers within a 30-foot radius. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Underwater Pathways
effectDetails.rules: Upon insertion into a temple door, this key illuminates hidden underwater pathways on any map within the immediate area. The revelation lasts until the next dawn or until the user uses another effect of this key.

hyrule_temple_key.levelRequirementReason: This key is designed for adventurers who are just beginning their journey into the Zora’s Domain, offering them an essential tool to explore these ancient temples.
hyrule_temple_key.vendorReason: Hyrule is a trusted vendor known for its connections with ancient artifacts and relics from across Hyrule's many domains.
hyrule_temple_key.shippingDetail: The Shy Guys ensure the key arrives safely, but delivery can take up to one week due to the delicate nature of the item.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until used again
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each long rest

hyrule_temple_key.priceReason: This key is priced at a reasonable rate considering its rarity and the convenience it offers to adventurers navigating the Zora’s Domain.

hyrule_temple_key_of_whispers.name: Temple Key of Whispers
hyrule_temple_key_of_whispers.description: The Temple Key of Whispers, a sleek obsidian key etched with ancient runes, whispers secrets of the past when wielded by one in perfect focus. It opens only the most sacred temple doors, granting temporary stealth and revealing enemy weaknesses that even the keenest eyes miss. This key is said to have been crafted from the heartwood of a long-felled sacred tree, its power tied to moments of pure concentration.

effectDetails.title: Silent Stealth
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. You gain +50% stealth during movement for 1 minute, but you must maintain perfect focus. If your focus drops below 40%, the effect ends immediately.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Weaknesses
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful use, you can target an enemy within 30 feet to reveal a weakness that lasts for 1 minute. This effect has a range of 60 feet and requires concentration. The save DC is 15.

hyrule_temple_key_of_whispers.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to wield the key, as its power draws on the user's heightened focus.
hyrule_temple_key_of_whispers.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its sacred relics and ancient artifacts, making it a fitting vendor for this key of whispers.
hyrule_temple_key_of_whispers.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring swift delivery within 3 days.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use.
usage.endsWhen: Focus drops below 40%, or you lose concentration on the revealed weakness.

hyrule_temple_key_of_whispers.priceReason: The key's rarity and unique crafting make it a valuable asset, worth 1000 XP.

hyrule_temple_key_ring.name: Key of the Shattered Chamber
hyrule_temple_key_ring.description: The Key of the Shattered Chamber is a delicate ring, its surface etched with runes that shimmer faintly in the dark. Crafted from ancient temple metal and imbued with the essence of forgotten realities, it grants access to doors sealed by time and chaos. When used near unstable architecture, it can absorb minor reality tears, potentially revealing hidden passages within. This artifact's power wears thin after each use but never breaks, ensuring its resilience through countless ages.

effectDetails.title: Door Unlocking
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can use the key to unlock a door. The DC for any Perception check required to find hidden traps or secret panels is reduced by 5 when used within 30 feet of ancient architecture.

effectDetails.title: Reality Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When used near unstable structures, the key can absorb minor reality tears, reducing the DC to save against effects originating from such locations by 2. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_key_ring.levelRequirementReason: The key's power is accessible to adventurers of all levels but requires a minimum of first-level proficiency in investigation or history.
hyrule_temple_key_ring.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient temples and libraries are the birthplace of such relics, making Hyrule the most reliable vendor for these mystical artifacts.
hyrule_temple_key_ring.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, the key is shipped in a custom, magically reinforced box designed by the Shy Guys themselves.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration of benefit varies based on effect used
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or when not within range for absorption effects
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only once per long rest for reality absorption

hyrule_temple_key_ring.priceReason: The Key of the Shattered Chamber's price reflects its rare origin and enduring utility in unlocking ancient mysteries.

hyrule_temple_key_rune.name: Temple Key Rune
hyrule_temple_key_rune.description: The Temple Key Rune, a glowing rune inscribed with arcane symbols, hums with ancient power as it unlocks sealed doors or vaults within a hundred meters. Its resonant chime not only breaks wards and traps but also triggers hidden mechanisms, revealing secrets long forgotten in the heart of the temple. The rune's glow intensifies when activated, casting an ethereal light that illuminates dark corners even after its effect has faded.

effectDetails.title: Unlocking Mechanisms
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Temple Key Rune emits a resonant chime that can unlock any sealed door or vault within 100 meters. This effect is instantaneous and requires no save. The rune can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Disrupting Wards
effectDetails.rules: The rune's chime disrupts wards and traps for up to 5 seconds, rendering them inactive within a 10-meter radius around the user. Enemies in this area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until their next action. This effect can only occur once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_key_rune.levelRequirementReason: The Temple Key Rune's ancient power is accessible to adventurers of all levels, making it a versatile tool for exploration.
hyrule_temple_key_rune.vendorReason: Hyrulean artifacts are renowned for their historical and magical significance, and the Temple Key Rune is no exception.
hyrule_temple_key_rune.shippingDetail: The rune arrives in a sturdy, protective case to ensure its ancient power remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for unlocking; 5 seconds for disrupting wards
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the duration expires or the user is incapacitated
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one use per short rest

hyrule_temple_key_rune.priceReason: The Temple Key Rune's rarity and unique ability justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_temple_keyblade.name: Keyblade of the Lost Temple
hyrule_temple_keyblade.description: The Keyblade of the Lost Temple is a glowing relic forged from ancient Hyrulean steel within the sacred ruins. Its heart-shaped guard glows with ethereal blue light, and its blade bears intricate carvings of forgotten symbols. This weapon opens sealed doors and triggers hidden mechanisms, but careless use risks setting off deadly traps with a 25% chance. In temple zones, it deals +10% bonus damage to foes, ensuring swift passage through ancient halls.

effectDetails.title: Seals and Traps
effectDetails.rules: Activates locked doors or hidden mechanisms as a bonus action. Setting off traps requires a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw; on a failed save, the wielder takes 2d6 damage from the trap.

effectDetails.title: Temple Bonus Damage
effectDetails.rules: +10% additional damage to enemies within temple zones for an hour after activation. The effect ends if the keyblade is sheathed or used in combat outside of a temple zone.

hyrule_temple_keyblade.levelRequirementReason: This keyblade requires a minimum level to handle its ancient magic and intricate mechanisms.
hyrule_temple_keyblade.vendorReason: The Hyrulean market is well-known for artifacts from the Sacred Realm, including this lost temple relic.
hyrule_temple_keyblade.shippingDetail: Delivered by Shy Guys with a 1-day delay; must be picked up within 3 days of notification.

usage.activation: Bonus action to open doors or activate mechanisms, or as an action to set off traps.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect when activated. Temple bonus damage lasts for one hour after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The trap is triggered, the keyblade is sheathed, or used in combat outside of a temple zone.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; recharged upon entering another temple zone.

hyrule_temple_keyblade.priceReason: This keyblade balances rarity and power by requiring a lower level requirement while maintaining its unique abilities within the game's economy.

hyrule_temple_keychain.name: Temple Keychain of the Fractured Gate
hyrule_temple_keychain.description: The Temple Keychain of the Fractured Gate is a delicate keychain forged from ancient Hyrulean bronze, adorned with intricate sigils that shimmer faintly in the light. It allows its bearer to bypass locks on sacred temple doors with ease and, upon entering a temple, triggers a 'Temple Echo' event—a resonant surge that grants all party members temporary buffs. The keychain also enhances one's luck, increasing the chance of finding hidden treasures within the temple.

effectDetails.title: Bypass Locks
effectDetails.rules: The keychain allows the user to bypass locked doors with a simple tap. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges or require activation.

effectDetails.title: Temple Echo
effectDetails.rules: When the keychain is brought into a temple, it triggers a 'Temple Echo' event. All party members gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks for 1 hour. The duration ends when the user leaves the temple grounds.

hyrule_temple_keychain.levelRequirementReason: The keychain is crafted from common materials but its enchantment provides significant utility in certain situations.
hyrule_temple_keychain.vendorReason: Hyrulean vendors are known for their cultural artifacts, and this keychain is a symbol of the sacred temples that draw pilgrims from afar.
hyrule_temple_keychain.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express, this item ships quickly with no special handling required.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation required to enter temple grounds
usage.duration: 1 hour upon entering the temple
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the temple grounds

hyrule_temple_keychain.priceReason: The keychain combines practical utility with cultural significance, making it a valuable yet balanced purchase.

hyrule_temple_mantle.name: Guardian’s Mantle of the Shattered Spire
hyrule_temple_mantle.description: The Guardian’s Mantle of the Shattered Spire is a tattered, yet resilient cloak worn by those who have faced the Temple's ancient trials. Woven from threads spun in the heart of the spire itself, it grants resilience to environmental hazards and echoes of battles past. Those who wear it find their health slowly restored after each confrontation with a temple boss, as if the very cloak draws strength from the fallen.

effectDetails.title: Resilience Against Hazards
effectDetails.rules: The mantle grants the wearer +12% damage reduction from environmental hazards. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Boss Battle Health Regen
effectDetails.rules: After defeating a temple boss, the mantle grants the wearer a 20% chance to regenerate health equal to their maximum hit points over 1 hour. This effect can only occur once per day and is exhausted upon use.

hyrule_temple_mantle.levelRequirementReason: Survivors of the Temple's trials are typically seasoned adventurers by level 6, capable of handling its challenges.
hyrule_temple_mantle.vendorReason: Hyrule is a trusted source for relics and artifacts from ancient temples like the Shattered Spire.
hyrule_temple_mantle.shippingDetail: The cloak arrives with a special delivery, ensuring it reaches its destination without mishap. However, the wearer must swear to protect the mantle's secrets upon receipt.

usage.duration: Until defeated in battle or until exhausted after use
usage.endsWhen: Upon defeat of a temple boss or after one hour if health regen is triggered, this effect ends and may not be used again the following day.

hyrule_temple_mantle.priceReason: The mantle's rarity and the unique properties derived from its ancient origins justify a price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_temple_mechanism.name: Gear of the Lost Guardian
hyrule_temple_mechanism.description: The Gear of the Lost Guardian is a rusted mechanical cog retrieved from the Temple of the Guardian. Its gears hum with ancient power, allowing the wielder to manipulate gravity within confined spaces. Only those who have faced the temple’s trials may wield this relic, as it responds only to one who has proven their mettle in its chambers. It grants a 20% bonus to jump height and allows for one use of gravity pull every 30 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Jump Height Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +2 bonus to their jump height. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Pull
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when the user is falling. The Gear of the Lost Guardian allows the user to redirect themselves 5 feet horizontally or vertically, reducing fall damage by 50% for 5 seconds. This effect can be used once every 30 seconds.

hyrule_temple_mechanism.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have faced and survived the Temple of the Guardian’s trials are considered worthy to wield this ancient relic.
hyrule_temple_mechanism.vendorReason: The Hyrulean vendors are known for their connection with ancient relics, making them the ideal purveyors of such an artifact.
hyrule_temple_mechanism.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature and the importance of its provenance, it is shipped via Koopa Postal’s express courier service, ensuring safe delivery.

usage.activation: Reaction (for Gravity Pull) or Passive (for Jump Height Boost)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Jump Height; 5 seconds for Gravity Pull
usage.endsWhen: The user ceases to be in a fall when using Gravity Pull, otherwise ends at the end of their next turn.

hyrule_temple_mechanism.priceReason: The Gear of the Lost Guardian is a rare and powerful relic that balances well with its price point, offering significant utility but not overpowered effects.

hyrule_temple_mind_blade.name: Temple Mind Blade
hyrule_temple_mind_blade.description: The Temple Mind Blade, forged from the very heart of a long-dead guardian, hums with the echoes of ancient battles. Its blade cuts through illusions and the whispers of deceit, leaving behind a lingering echo that repeats your last attack's sound and pattern. This weapon is not only a tool of combat but also a conduit for echoing strikes that can reflect your enemies' own damage back to them.

effectDetails.title: Cuts Through Illusions
effectDetails.rules: When you strike an illusion, the blade creates a brief echo that lasts for 3 seconds. During this time, any creature affected by the echo must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Strike
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the blade to reflect your attack's damage back to the target and any creatures within 5 feet. This effect lasts for 2 seconds. The reflection deals force damage equal to half of the original damage dealt.

hyrule_temple_mind_blade.levelRequirementReason: The blade requires a certain level of mastery in combat to wield its echoing abilities effectively.
hyrule_temple_mind_blade.vendorReason: Hyrule's vendors are known for their unique and powerful artifacts, making the Temple Mind Blade an expected addition.
hyrule_temple_mind_blade.shippingDetail: The blade is carefully couriered by the Rakasha Spirit Walk, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to activate echoing strike)
usage.duration: Instantaneous (echo effect lasts for 3 seconds; reflection lasts for 2 seconds)
usage.endsWhen: The echo ends when the target makes a successful saving throw, and the reflection ends when it deals damage.

hyrule_temple_mind_blade.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its rarity and unique abilities, ensuring players can afford it without overpowered play.

hyrule_temple_mirage_key.name: Mirage Key of the Forgotten Temple
hyrule_temple_mirage_key.description: The Mirage Key of the Forgotten Temple is a delicate iron key forged from the very essence of the Temple of the Whispering Wind. Crafted by ancient masons, it whispers secrets of forgotten realms when held to the light. This key can unlock hidden chambers by distorting reality briefly, allowing you to bypass locked doors with ease—but be wary, for each use leaves a faint echo that could lead an enemy directly to your last step.

effectDetails.title: Bypass Locks
effectDetails.rules: When used, the key distorts reality for up to 10 seconds, allowing you to bypass a locked door. You must be within 30 feet of the door and have line of effect. This effect has no save DC and can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Echo Trail
effectDetails.rules: For every successful use, you leave behind an echo that lasts for 1 minute. The echo leaves a faint sound trail that can be tracked by creatures with the Tracking feat. This effect has no save DC and is permanent unless dispelled.

hyrule_temple_mirage_key.levelRequirementReason: The key's distortion magic requires a user of at least fifth level to wield effectively.
hyrule_temple_mirage_key.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient relics are often traded by the Hyrulean authorities, and this key is no exception.
hyrule_temple_mirage_key.shippingDetail: The key must be shipped discreetly as it contains powerful enchantments. Shipment takes an extra day due to customs checks.

usage.duration: Up to 10 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: The distortion effect ends naturally, or if dispelled by a creature with the Tracking feat.

hyrule_temple_mirage_key.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this key's price reflects its powerful but limited utility in bypassing locks and its unique echo effect.

hyrule_temple_mirage_rod.name: Mirage of the Sacred Well
hyrule_temple_mirage_rod.description: The Mirage of the Sacred Well is a staff forged from the very essence of Hyrule’s sacred wells, its surface shimmering like rippling water in the light. This ancient artifact warps reality within the Temple's shifting corridors, turning foes into ephemeral illusions that vanish upon contact. It grants you an evasion edge, allowing you to slip through tight spaces and dodge attacks with ease, while also offering a slim chance of spontaneous teleportation when struck.

effectDetails.title: Illusionary Disruption
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy attacks you within the Temple, they are reduced to an illusion for two turns. This effect ends if the target is hit by another attack or spell. There is no save required.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Edge
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +15% evasion chance when navigating temple environments. This effect lasts until you leave the Temple area or take damage from an enemy, at which point it ends immediately.

hyrule_temple_mirage_rod.levelRequirementReason: The staff's magic is complex and requires a certain mastery of control to wield effectively.
hyrule_temple_mirage_rod.vendorReason: Hyrule's sacred guardians have long traded this staff, as it aids in protecting the Temple from intruders.
hyrule_temple_mirage_rod.shippingDetail: The staff must be shipped by a trusted courier, as its magical properties can disrupt standard mail services.

usage.activation: Instantaneous reaction to an enemy attack within the Temple.
usage.duration: 2 turns for each enemy reduced to illusion.
usage.endsWhen: Hit by another attack or spell, or when you leave the Temple area.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges upon leaving the Temple.

hyrule_temple_mirage_rod.priceReason: The staff's rarity and unique properties justify its moderate price in Hyrule’s market.

hyrule_temple_mirror_shard.name: Mirror Shard of the Temple of Reflection
hyrule_temple_mirror_shard.description: The Mirror Shard of the Temple of Reflection is a shimmering fragment salvaged from an ancient mirror, now cracked and broken beyond repair. It grants its user the uncanny ability to momentarily glimpse through the eyes of their foes, predicting their next move with chilling accuracy. The shard also subtly enhances reflexes, granting a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws for the duration of this effect. However, using it while in motion risks temporary blindness.

effectDetails.title: Vision of Enemy Moves
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can briefly see through an enemy's eyes for up to 10 seconds. This grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and insight into their next move, but it also provokes opportunity attacks from creatures they are not already targeting. The effect ends if the user is incapacitated or changes targets.

effectDetails.title: Dexterity Saving Throws Boost
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after using the shard in combat, the user gains a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws. This effect can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_mirror_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to wield this powerful relic of ancient magic.
hyrule_temple_mirror_shard.vendorReason: Hyrule is the custodian of many relics from its sacred temples, including those of the Temple of Reflection.
hyrule_temple_mirror_shard.shippingDetail: The shard must be carefully transported by a Rakasha spirit to ensure it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until the user changes targets, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: User is incapacitated or changes target

hyrule_temple_mirror_shard.priceReason: The shard's rare and magical properties, combined with its unique utility in combat, justify this balanced XP cost.

hyrule_temple_shard_of_echoes.name: Shard of Echoes
hyrule_temple_shard_of_echoes.description: The Shard of Echoes is a delicate fragment of temple glass, resonating with the whispers of ancient rituals. Crafted from the heart of Hyrule's Echo Temple, it amplifies your voice during battle, disrupting enemy focus and unsettling their minds. When you speak true, its echo disrupts spellcasting within 30 feet, forcing enemies to save or be silenced for a round. It can also trigger a temple resonance aura that grants allies +2d6 temporary hit points for the duration of a short rest.
effects: +2d6 temp HP on ally short rest

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Spellcasting
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the Shard of Echoes, a resonant echo disrupts an enemy’s spellcasting. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be silenced for one minute.

effectDetails.title: Temple Resonance Aura
effectDetails.rules: Activate once per short rest to grant allies within 30 feet +2d6 temporary hit points until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if you are incapacitated, die, or leave the area.

hyrule_temple_shard_of_echoes.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to access the powerful resonant effects.
hyrule_temple_shard_of_echoes.vendorReason: Hyrulean vendors are trusted for their knowledge of ancient artifacts and rituals.
hyrule_temple_shard_of_echoes.shippingDetail: Delivered through secret underground tunnels, ensuring safe passage to the buyer.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action when spoken.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect for Disrupt Spellcasting; lasts until end of next turn for Temple Resonance Aura.
usage.endsWhen: Disrupted spellcasting ends on save failure. Temple Resonance Aura ends if you are incapacitated, die, or leave the area.

hyrule_temple_shard_of_echoes.priceReason: Balanced price considering its powerful effect and rarity.

hyrule_temple_silence_pearl.name: Pearl of the Silent Temple
hyrule_temple_silence_pearl.description: The Pearl of the Silent Temple, a sacred relic from Hyrule's ancient Temple of the Unseen, whispers secrets of bygone eras when held to your ear. Crafted in the heart of the temple's forges, its surface gleams with an ethereal sheen, pulsing faintly as it suppresses magic within a 30-meter radius, cutting through spells and enchantments like a silent blade. This artifact not only disrupts enemy sorcery but also reveals hidden passageways in ancient ruins, guiding explorers to forgotten treasures and traps.

effectDetails.title: Suppressed Magic Radius
effectDetails.rules: When activated by the bearer holding the pearl to their ear, all magic within a 30-meter radius is suppressed for 1 minute. This effect has no save DC and does not require charges or recharge.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: The pearl grants the user a +2 insight bonus on checks to uncover hidden or secret doors within ancient ruins, palaces, or temples. This benefit lasts until the end of your next long rest.

hyrule_temple_silence_pearl.levelRequirementReason: This artifact requires no specific level as it is an item that aids exploration and magic disruption.
hyrule_temple_silence_pearl.vendorReason: Hyrule, being a hub for ancient relics, naturally stocks this powerful tool for adventurers seeking to explore its many hidden temples and dungeons.
hyrule_temple_silence_pearl.shippingDetail: Delivered by Boo Spectral Mail, the delivery is swift but requires a special signature upon arrival.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated when held to ear; reveal passages as an action at start of turn
usage.duration: 1 minute or until end of next long rest for hidden passage reveal
usage.endsWhen: Magic suppression ends after the specified duration, passageway revelation ends with a long rest

hyrule_temple_silence_pearl.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its utility in both combat and exploration without skewing power levels.

hyrule_temple_soul_amber.name: Temple Soul Amber
hyrule_temple_soul_amber.description: Temple Soul Amber is a luminous amber fragment forged from the very essence of an ancient temple guardian spirit. It amplifies your attacks, turning each strike into a shimmering burst of divine energy, and reveals hidden paths in sacred ruins, illuminating forgotten routes with a radiant glow that lasts for ten seconds. When combat erupts within its light, it grants temporary immunity to status effects, ensuring you remain unshaken by the temple's ancient maladies.

effectDetails.title: Divine Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. For the duration of your next turn, deal an additional +20% damage to all attacks against enemies within range (15 feet). This effect does not stack with other sources of damage increases.

effectDetails.title: Sacred Illumination
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a standard action. Reveals hidden temple entrances within 30 feet for the duration of one round (10 seconds). If used in combat, the light intensifies, granting temporary immunity to all status effects until the end of your next turn.

hyrule_temple_soul_amber.levelRequirementReason: The Temple Soul Amber requires a minimum level of 5 due to its divine essence and potent abilities.
hyrule_temple_soul_amber.vendorReason: Hyrule is known for its sacred artifacts, and the Temple Soul Amber's origins in an ancient temple make it a prime candidate for their offerings.
hyrule_temple_soul_amber.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of this item, Pipe Express will deliver it via special courier, ensuring safe arrival.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action or standard action.
usage.duration: Divine Amplification lasts for the duration of your next turn. Sacred Illumination reveals hidden paths for one round (10 seconds).
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use, with no recharge time required.

hyrule_temple_soul_amber.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's divine origin and potent abilities, making it accessible yet valuable.

hyrule_temple_soul_catalyst.name: Soul Catalyst of the Forgotten Temple
hyrule_temple_soul_catalyst.description: The Soul Catalyst of the Forgotten Temple is a glowing, ethereal core embedded with the essence of a temple’s guardian. Crafted from the heartwood of an ancient tree and imbued with divine magic by the priests of Hyrule, it allows its wielder to channel untold power. By activating this relic, you can call forth spectral echoes that deal 100% damage for 10 seconds and grant a +50 bonus to spell attack rolls for three turns.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Echo Call
effectDetails.rules: By using an action, you can summon spectral echoes that deal 100% damage to all creatures within a 30-foot radius for 10 seconds. This ability has a recharge time of one short rest.

effectDetails.title: Divine Spell Boost
effectDetails.rules: For three turns, your spell attack rolls are increased by +50. You can use this effect once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_soul_catalyst.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a high level of magical prowess to wield effectively.
hyrule_temple_soul_catalyst.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its ancient artifacts and the preservation of divine magic.
hyrule_temple_soul_catalyst.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days, delivered by Lakitu's fastest drones.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn after use or when you take another action on your turn

hyrule_temple_soul_catalyst.priceReason: Balanced to provide significant utility and power without overbalancing.

hyrule_temple_soul_cloth.name: Temple Soul Cloak
hyrule_temple_soul_cloth.description: Woven from the essence of ancient temple spirits, the Temple Soul Cloak is a shimmering garment that absorbs enemy magic and grants the wearer an aura of sacred silence, enhancing stealth and defense against enchantments. This relic of Hyrulean lore reduces incoming magical damage by half for up to 10 minutes after each successful absorption, while also granting a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 5 seconds upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Magic Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer takes magical damage, they can activate this effect as a reaction to reduce the incoming damage by half. The effect lasts for up to 10 minutes and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: The Temple Soul Cloak grants the wearer a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks when activated, which lasts for 5 seconds. This effect can be used up to three times per day.

hyrule_temple_soul_cloth.levelRequirementReason: This cloak is designed for adventurers of all levels but requires at least first-level proficiency in Stealth.
hyrule_temple_soul_cloth.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient temples and their guardians have long revered the Temple Soul Cloak, making it a staple among Hyrule's vendors.
hyrule_temple_soul_cloth.shippingDetail: The cloak is shipped in a specially enchanted pipe that ensures swift delivery, even across treacherous terrains.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Magic Absorption), 5 seconds (Stealth Boost)
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each short or long rest (Magic Absorption), after 5 seconds (Stealth Boost)
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short or long rest (Magic Absorption), up to three times per day (Stealth Boost)

hyrule_temple_soul_cloth.priceReason: The cloak's rarity and the unique magic it contains justify its fair value of 1000 XP.

hyrule_temple_soul_core.name: Soul Core of the Temple Guardian
hyrule_temple_soul_core.description: The Soul Core of the Temple Guardian, a crystalline heart forged from the essence of a fallen guardian, absorbs enemy magic and converts it into potent offensive power. When fully charged after striking three foes, this core unleashes a piercing beam capable of slicing through multiple enemies in one devastating strike. The core's magical energy resonates with the ancient temple's sacred geometry, reducing all nearby enemies' magic resistance by 30% while active.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Magic and Enhances Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When the user deals damage to three targets within a 30-foot radius with any weapon attack, the Soul Core charges for 30 seconds. During this time, it absorbs 50% of incoming magic damage and converts it into 10% additional damage on all attacks made until the core is fully charged.

effectDetails.title: Reduces Enemy Magic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While the Soul Core is active (up to a maximum of 2 minutes), it reduces all enemy targets within 30 feet by 30%. This effect cannot be countered with any spell or ability that counters magic resistance.

hyrule_temple_soul_core.levelRequirementReason: The core requires the user's intimate knowledge and connection to ancient magical energies, which is only available to those of 8th level or higher.
hyrule_temple_soul_core.vendorReason: Only the esteemed Hyrulean Temple has access to such sacred relics forged from the essence of its guardians.
hyrule_temple_soul_core.shippingDetail: The core is shipped under strict magical wards, ensuring safe delivery and preventing any tampering during transit.

usage.activation: Fully charges after three weapon attacks against targets within a 30-foot radius. The effect ends when the user drops to 0 hit points or if the core is destroyed.
usage.duration: Up to 2 minutes, or until fully charged and used.
usage.endsWhen: If the user drops to 0 hit points or if the core is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges; the core recharges after a long rest.

hyrule_temple_soul_core.priceReason: The core's value lies in its unique ability to convert magical energy into combat power, making it a rare and valuable asset for any fighter or spellcaster.

hyrule_temple_soul_gem.name: Temple Soul Gem
hyrule_temple_soul_gem.description: The Temple Soul Gem is a glowing crystal forged from the essence of an ancient guardian who fought to protect Hyrule's holy grounds. Captured from the soul of this brave spirit, it hums with a potent negative energy that can be harnessed by the worthy. This gem not only absorbs lethal negative energy but also grants its wielder a blessed immunity to fear and confusion, ensuring calm in even the most haunted of ruins.

effectDetails.title: Absorption of Negative Energy
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a bonus action, this gem absorbs up to 1000 negative energy points. It can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear and Confusion
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one short or long rest, the wielder gains immunity to fear and confusion spells and effects. This immunity does not stack with other similar immunities.

hyrule_temple_soul_gem.levelRequirementReason: This gem is crafted from the essence of a powerful ancient guardian and requires significant spiritual strength to wield.
hyrule_temple_soul_gem.vendorReason: Hyrule, as the protector of sacred sites, holds this item in its vaults for those who seek to protect and honor its holy places.
hyrule_temple_soul_gem.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, ensuring safe delivery even through the most haunted zones.

usage.duration: One Short or Long Rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a short or long rest is completed

hyrule_temple_soul_gem.priceReason: Crafted from the essence of an ancient guardian, this gem's price reflects its rare and powerful nature.

hyrule_temple_soul_ring.name: Temple Soul Ring
hyrule_temple_soul_ring.description: The Temple Soul Ring is forged from the essence of a guardian who died to protect the sacred Triforce. Its surface glows faintly with an ancient, ethereal light, and it hums in tune with the temple’s soul. Wearing this ring allows you to sense when the temple's balance is disturbed or when spirits are near; its power amplifies your spirit-based attacks by 10% and grants a critical hit chance bonus of +5.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Sense
effectDetails.rules: You gain the ability to detect disturbances in the temple’s balance as if you had the Detect Magic spell. This effect lasts until you attack a creature or object within 30 feet.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Spirit Attacks
effectDetails.rules: For every point of your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1), your spirit-based attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage. This effect is active as long as you are wearing the ring and ends when you remove it or if its charges run out.

hyrule_temple_soul_ring.levelRequirementReason: The ring requires a basic understanding of spiritual energies to activate.
hyrule_temple_soul_ring.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for preserving ancient relics and items imbued with powerful magic.
hyrule_temple_soul_ring.shippingDetail: Ships via Windwings Express, ensuring swift delivery to your door.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until you attack or until the ring's charges are depleted.
usage.endsWhen: The ring's effects end when it runs out of charges after five uses per short rest.

hyrule_temple_soul_ring.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its unique spiritual properties and limited recharge.

hyrule_temple_soul_shard.name: Temple Soul Shard
hyrule_temple_soul_shard.description: The Temple Soul Shard is a crystalline fragment exhumed from the heart of an ancient Hyrulean temple. Crafted by forgotten guardians, it pulses with the essence of elemental spirits. When invoked, it grants you temporary invulnerability to fire and water attacks for thirty seconds, allowing you to weather deadly flames or icy blasts. Additionally, it reveals hidden passages within the temple walls, illuminating paths that lead to untold treasures or secrets.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Immunity
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate the Temple Soul Shard to become temporarily immune to fire and water elemental attacks for thirty seconds. This immunity does not apply to other types of damage. The effect ends when the duration expires or if you are subjected to another elemental attack.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: Activate this shard as an action to reveal hidden temple passages and secret doors within thirty feet, providing insight into the architecture and layout of ancient temples. This effect can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_temple_soul_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Temple Soul Shard is accessible to all adventurers who wish to explore ancient Hyrulean ruins.
hyrule_temple_soul_shard.vendorReason: Hyrule, as the steward of ancient relics and guardian of forgotten knowledge, sells items that empower explorers to uncover secrets of the past.
hyrule_temple_soul_shard.shippingDetail: The shard is carefully wrapped in spectral mail to ensure safe delivery through darkened corridors and cursed passages.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as an action
usage.duration: 30 seconds for Elemental Immunity, once per long rest for Revealing Hidden Passages
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends or another elemental attack is received

hyrule_temple_soul_shard.priceReason: The Temple Soul Shard offers significant battlefield utility and exploration advantages, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

hyrule_temple_soul_torch.name: Flame of the Temple’s Will
hyrule_temple_soul_torch.description: The Flame of the Temple’s Will is a torch forged from the very will of an ancient temple's last priest, its body crafted from sacred stone and imbued with divine fire. When lit, it grants the wielder an unbreakable shield that deflects attacks and enhances their reflexes, allowing them to dodge even the most precise strikes. The priest’s spirit lingers within, whispering guidance and protection during battle.

effectDetails.title: Divine Shield
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the wielder gains a +50 temporary hit point shield that lasts for 10 seconds. The effect ends if the wielder takes damage or is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Dodge
effectDetails.rules: Increases the wielder's chance to dodge by 15% until they are hit in combat, with a maximum of +3 on their Dexterity saving throw. This effect ends when the wielder takes damage or is incapacitated.

hyrule_temple_soul_torch.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second level to channel the priest’s divine will effectively.
hyrule_temple_soul_torch.vendorReason: Hyrulean priests and scholars revere this relic as a symbol of their heritage, ensuring it remains in their care.
hyrule_temple_soul_torch.shippingDetail: Delivered by the ghostly couriers who traverse the spirit realms, ensuring swift but ethereal transport.

usage.activation: Bonus Action to light and activate; reaction to gain shield if hit in combat.
usage.duration: 10 seconds or until the wielder takes damage or is incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: Wielder takes damage, becomes incapacitated, or after 10 seconds.

hyrule_temple_soul_torch.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its rare origin and divine power, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer’s arsenal.

hyrule_temple_spirit_amber.name: Amber Soul of the Temple
hyrule_temple_spirit_amber.description: The Amber Soul of the Temple is a crystalline essence harvested from the heart of Hyrule's Temple of Light, where it absorbs the very essence of ancient power and purity. When consumed, it grants the imbuer an unyielding boost in strength that can shatter illusions or deception around them, allowing for clarity in both body and mind. The soulstone glows faintly as it temporarily enhances one’s physical prowess and mental acuity.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Strength
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +30% bonus to their Strength score for 10 seconds. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require any actions.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Illusions
effectDetails.rules: For the next 15 seconds, the user gains the ability to see through illusions or deception as if they had successful Perception checks against all such effects. This ability is active until either a saving throw is made (DC 13) or the duration expires.

hyrule_temple_spirit_amber.levelRequirementReason: Consuming this essence requires a user with at least 6th level to harness its raw power without overwhelming their body.
hyrule_temple_spirit_amber.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient temples hold the knowledge and artifacts that can enhance one’s abilities, making the Amber Soul of the Temple an appropriate offering from this venerable source.
hyrule_temple_spirit_amber.shippingDetail: The Boo Spectral Mail ensures safe delivery through its spectral wards, but the item must be consumed within 24 hours to retain its potency.

usage.activation: Instantaneous consumption upon finding a suitable opportunity.
usage.duration: 10 seconds for Strength boost and 15 seconds for revealing illusions.
usage.endsWhen: After 15 seconds or if the user makes a successful saving throw (DC 13).
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

hyrule_temple_spirit_amber.priceReason: The Amber Soul of the Temple is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the specific ancient magic required for its creation within Hyrule’s sacred temples.

hyrule_temple_talisman.name: Heart of the Shattered Vault
hyrule_temple_talisman.description: The Heart of the Shattered Vault is a glowing relic forged from the soul of an ancient temple guardian, its surface etched with arcane runes that pulse with raw mana. This talisman grants temporary resistance to magical explosions and lets the wearer speak to echoes of the temple’s past, revealing hidden lore and forgotten secrets. Each use leaves a faint, lingering hum that draws the attention of nearby magical entities.

effectDetails.title: Speak to Echoes
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can speak with echoes of the temple’s past. This lasts for 1 minute and reveals hidden lore or forgotten secrets within a 30-foot radius. The DC for any Wisdom (Insight) check made by others to discern the truth is increased by 5.

effectDetails.title: Magical Explosion Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains temporary resistance to magical explosions equal to their proficiency bonus + 10. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn and can be used once per short or long rest.

hyrule_temple_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The relic requires a minimum level to access its powers, ensuring it is not overpowered for lower-level characters.
hyrule_temple_talisman.vendorReason: As one of the most revered guardians of ancient sites and relics, Hyrule's vendors are trusted to offer such powerful but balanced artifacts.
hyrule_temple_talisman.shippingDetail: The shipment is made by a Rakasha who ensures the package reaches its destination safely and swiftly, delivering it within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until the end of next turn)
usage.endsWhen: Used up once per short/long rest

hyrule_temple_talisman.priceReason: The Heart of the Shattered Vault is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare and powerful nature while ensuring it remains a balanced addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

hyrule_temple_talisman_of_echoes.name: Talisman of the Echoing Temple
hyrule_temple_talisman_of_echoes.description: Carved from the obsidian heart of the ancient Temple of the Forgotten, the Talisman of the Echoing Temple is a heavy amulet that hums softly as it absorbs the whispers of time. It grants its wearer visions of hidden paths and lost truths, revealing secret passages within the labyrinthine temples of Hyrule. When worn in such sacred spaces, the talisman's power amplifies, granting temporary invisibility for 2 seconds after using a skill to navigate ancient ruins.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: When in an ancient temple zone, the wearer gains a +25% bonus to their map exploration and can see hidden paths. This effect lasts until leaving the area or being outside such zones for more than 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility on Ancient Grounds
effectDetails.rules: After successfully using a skill in an ancient temple zone, the wearer becomes invisible for 2 seconds. This effect can only be used once per long rest and is expended by entering water or being exposed to direct sunlight.

hyrule_temple_talisman_of_echoes.levelRequirementReason: The talisman's power draws on ancient magic that resonates with all who enter its sacred spaces, requiring no specific level for use.
hyrule_temple_talisman_of_echoes.vendorReason: Hyrulean relics and artifacts are known to carry the essence of their origin, making this item a prime offering from their esteemed vendors.
hyrule_temple_talisman_of_echoes.shippingDetail: Delivered carefully within Hyrule's secure postal service; delivery can take up to one week depending on local conditions.

usage.activation: Passive while in ancient temple zones, active when using a skill outside such zones for the invisibility effect.
usage.duration: Echoes of Hidden Paths: Until leaving an ancient temple zone or being away from them for more than 10 minutes. Invisibility on Ancient Grounds: Instantaneous and lasts for 2 seconds after successfully using a skill.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the area for Echoes; entering water or direct sunlight for Invisibility.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest for invisibility.

hyrule_temple_talisman_of_echoes.priceReason: The talisman's rarity and ancient magic make it a valuable item, balancing its powerful effects with the need to ensure it is not overpowered in play.

hyrule_temple_ward.name: Temple Ward Stone
hyrule_temple_ward.description: The Temple Ward Stone, a radiant crystal etched with ancient symbols from the First Temple of Hyrule, radiates a soft luminescence that repels dark entities and grants temporary sanctuary to all within its glow. When placed upon sacred ground, it creates an impenetrable ward, preventing hostile creatures from crossing into its protective field for 30 seconds. This stone also enhances the agility of defenders, granting them +5% movement speed during its duration, making swift retreats or attacks possible.

effectDetails.title: Repels Dark Entities
effectDetails.rules: When placed on sacred ground, the Temple Ward Stone creates a 10-meter radius ward zone that prevents hostile creatures from entering. The effect lasts for 30 seconds and can be activated as an action. A creature within the area has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened by dark entities.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Agility
effectDetails.rules: The stone grants a +5% movement speed bonus to all creatures within its 10-meter radius while active, which lasts for the duration of 30 seconds. This effect is passive and cannot be disrupted or ended early by actions other than the expiration time.

hyrule_temple_ward.levelRequirementReason: This stone is accessible to any hero who dares enter sacred grounds in Hyrule, as it requires no specific skill or level.
hyrule_temple_ward.vendorReason: Hyrule's vendors are known for their extensive knowledge of ancient artifacts and relics, making the Temple Ward Stone a fitting addition to their inventory.
hyrule_temple_ward.shippingDetail: The stone is shipped using Koopa Postal’s express service, which ensures timely delivery even in the most dangerous regions of Hyrule.

usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Expires after its duration or when removed by a creature outside the ward area

hyrule_temple_ward.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the stone's utility in repelling dark entities and enhancing agility without overcompensating its abilities.

hyrule_temple_ward_amber.name: Amber Ward of the Ancient Temple
hyrule_temple_ward_amber.description: The Amber Ward of the Ancient Temple is a glowing, hand-carved amulet that hums with the forgotten magic of Hyrule's Eastern Sanctum. Crafted from amber infused with the essence of long-lost temples, it channels ancient defenses to protect its wearer. When worn, the amulet subtly amplifies the temple’s protective aura, reducing magical backlash by 35% and temporarily silencing harmful spells cast against you for 12 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Magical Backlash
effectDetails.rules: Activates passively upon donning the amulet. Reduces incoming magical damage by 35%. Ends when removed or at the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Silence on Enemy Spells
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when you are targeted by a harmful spell. Temporarily silences the spell for 12 seconds, rendering it harmless to you and any allies within 5 feet. Ends if the spell is dispelled or its duration expires.

hyrule_temple_ward_amber.levelRequirementReason: The ancient magic of the temple requires a certain level of spiritual purity.
hyrule_temple_ward_amber.vendorReason: Hyrule's knowledge and relics are preserved by its scholars who have access to such artifacts.
hyrule_temple_ward_amber.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of night, ensuring the amulet remains undisturbed until it reaches its destination.

usage.activation: Passive and automatic upon donning; requires a reaction to activate spell silence.
usage.duration: Passive effect is permanent while worn. Spell silence lasts for 12 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: Removed or the end of your next turn, dispelled, or its duration expires.

hyrule_temple_ward_amber.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and infused with ancient magic, this amulet is a balanced treasure.

hyrule_temple_warden_belt.name: Temple Warden Belt
hyrule_temple_warden_belt.description: The Temple Warden Belt, crafted from ancient Zoraite metal, is a symbol of guardianship in the sacred Temples of Hyrule. When worn, it channels the earth's elemental forces to protect and rejuvenate its bearer during prolonged combat. The belt grants temporary immunity to all elemental damage for 10 seconds, allowing you to focus on your next strike without fear of harm. Additionally, it enhances stamina regeneration by 20% every 3 seconds, ensuring that no foe can wear down the wearer's resolve over time.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Immunity
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when you are first hit by an attack. Provides immunity to all elemental damage for 10 seconds, but ends if you take another elemental damage before the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that grants +20% stamina regeneration while active. Ends when the belt is removed or upon death.

hyrule_temple_warden_belt.levelRequirementReason: The intricate enchantments on this belt require a certain level of mastery to wield effectively.
hyrule_temple_warden_belt.vendorReason: Hyrule's official guardians are known for their sacred relics and this belt is one such artifact.
hyrule_temple_warden_belt.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Express, ensuring safe delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: You take another elemental damage or the belt is removed, whichever comes first. Ends upon death.

hyrule_temple_warden_belt.priceReason: Crafted with ancient Zoraite metal and sacred enchantments, this belt offers unparalleled protection and stamina enhancement.

hyrule_temple_warden_scepter.name: Temple Warden Scepter
hyrule_temple_warden_scepter.description: The Temple Warden Scepter, forged from the heart of Hyrule's ancient temples, channels the essence of forgotten guardians. This relic grants temporary invulnerability upon striking an opponent, and disrupts their spellcasting with a shattering force that renders incantations null and void for a fleeting moment. Crafted by the hands of temple warden mages, it is said to bear the echo of those who once defended the sacred sites from darkness.

effectDetails.title: Temporarily Invulnerable on Hit
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an opponent with a melee attack, you gain temporary invulnerability for 10 seconds. This effect cannot be used more than once every 5 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Disrupts Spellcasting
effectDetails.rules: If you hit an opponent while they are casting a spell, their current spell attempt is disrupted and they must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or lose the spell. This effect does not reset if you miss your attack.

hyrule_temple_warden_scepter.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic required to wield this scepter demands at least three levels of experience.
hyrule_temple_warden_scepter.vendorReason: Hyrule is the birthplace and guardian of the Temple Warden Scepter, making it a logical choice for its sale in their marketplaces.
hyrule_temple_warden_scepter.shippingDetail: The scepter is shipped within a specially enchanted wooden box to protect the relic during transit.

usage.duration: 10 seconds, or until the end of your next turn if you miss your attack
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you miss your attack

hyrule_temple_warden_scepter.priceReason: Crafted with rare materials and ancient Hyrulean magic, this scepter is priced at a moderate cost to reflect its balance in power and rarity.

hyrule_temple_warder.name: Echoing Temple Ward
hyrule_temple_warder.description: The Echoing Temple Ward is a relic forged from ancient temple stones, its surface etched with runes that hum in response to forgotten magic. It grants temporary resistance to spells and enhances perception of hidden paths, allowing the wielder to sense secret passages even when they are not actively being concealed by magical means. This ward has a presence that resonates through the air, making it an invaluable companion for any adventurer seeking to navigate the labyrinthine ruins of Hyrule's lost temples.

effectDetails.title: Magic Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: The Echoing Temple Ward grants you resistance to all magical damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be reactivated once the duration has expired.

effectDetails.title: Perception Enhancer: Detect Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Echoing Temple Ward, you gain advantage on Perception checks to detect hidden or secret paths. This benefit lasts until the end of your next long rest.

hyrule_temple_warder.levelRequirementReason: The ward's ancient magic is potent enough for even a novice adventurer to harness.
hyrule_temple_warder.vendorReason: Hyrule's most revered temple guardians are known to carry this relic, which they offer to visitors seeking guidance in their quests.
hyrule_temple_warder.shippingDetail: The Echoing Temple Ward is shipped via Pipe Express with expedited delivery due to its fragile nature and the urgency of its use.

usage.duration: 1 minute per activation.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends at the start of your next turn after it has expired or you take damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges upon completion of a long rest.

hyrule_temple_warder.priceReason: This relic's rarity and its potent magical properties justify its price, making it a worthwhile investment for adventurers.

hyrule_temple_wisp_shield.name: Wisp Shield of the Vaulted Depths
hyrule_temple_wisp_shield.description: The Wisp Shield of the Vaulted Depths is a gleaming, ancient shield that pulses with faint blue light, absorbing echoes of forgotten temple magic. When worn near crumbling ruins, it shields its bearer from the very forces that threaten the temple's integrity, granting +10% dodge chance and revealing minor secrets of the temple’s past. The shield hums with energy when in a sacred space, as if whispering tales of bygone eras.
effects: Absorbs magical damage from temple sources

effectDetails.title: Temple Echo Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When the shield is worn within 50 feet of a crumbling temple, it absorbs all incoming magical damage. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn or until you are no longer near a temple ruin.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Chance Boost
effectDetails.rules: While equipped and near a temple ruin, the shield grants a +10% bonus to your AC as long as you remain within 50 feet of the ruins. This effect ends if you leave the area or take any action that requires movement.

hyrule_temple_wisp_shield.levelRequirementReason: The shield's magic is complex and requires a fair amount of concentration to stabilize its power.
hyrule_temple_wisp_shield.vendorReason: Hyrulean scholars and temple guardians often trade or sell such artifacts for their unique abilities in protecting sacred sites.
hyrule_temple_wisp_shield.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, with a delivery delay of one week due to the shield's size and delicate nature.

usage.activation: Automatic when near temple ruins; no activation required.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next turn or you leave the area.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are no longer within 50 feet of a temple ruin or take any action that requires movement.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges when not near temple ruins.

hyrule_temple_wisp_shield.priceReason: Balanced at the price to reflect its rarity and unique abilities without being overpowered.

hyrule_temples_echo_rod.name: Echoes of the Temple Rod
hyrule_temples_echo_rod.description: The Echoes of the Temple Rod is a relic forged from the whispers of ancient temples, its iron body etched with arcane symbols that shimmer faintly under moonlight. This rod channels divine echoes to amplify your weapon's damage, and when swung, it summons a spectral echo of the temple’s guardian spirit for a brief burst of power. The spectral guardian dances around you, adding a second strike to your attacks but only for a fleeting moment.

effectDetails.title: +30% Weapon Damage
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The next melee attack made with the rod or any weapon deals an additional +30% damage, but only once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Summons Spectral Guardian
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a successful melee hit. A spectral guardian appears and makes a single melee attack against the target of your attack. The guardian persists for 5 seconds or until it drops to 0 hit points, whichever comes first.

hyrule_temples_echo_rod.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 3 to wield this relic effectively.
hyrule_temples_echo_rod.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its ancient artifacts and relics, making it a fitting vendor for the Echoes of the Temple Rod.
hyrule_temples_echo_rod.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express, which guarantees safe delivery within one week.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and melee hit to summon guardian.
usage.duration: 5 seconds or until target drops to 0 HP.
usage.endsWhen: Charges expended after 3 uses per long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges, but only 3 uses per long rest.

hyrule_temples_echo_rod.priceReason: The Echoes of the Temple Rod is priced at 1000 XP due to its potent effects and limited resource usage.

hyrule_time_craft.name: Time Weavers’ Temple Tool
hyrule_time_craft.description: The Time Weavers’ Temple Tool is a delicate, intricately crafted device from the Temple of Time’s lost archives. Its glowing core pulses with temporal energy, allowing you to manipulate moments and reset enemy turns with a flick of its wrist. This relic grants you an eerie connection to time itself, enhancing your combat prowess when near altered zones by 5% damage increase and providing a 10% chance to reveal hidden boss phases.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Reset
