effectDetails.rules: Activates on your reaction when you would take damage from an enemy. Grants a 10% chance to reset the turn order of that encounter, affecting only one creature per use.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage
effectDetails.rules: While within 30 feet of time-affected zones, deal an additional 5% damage on weapon attacks. This effect is cumulative with other sources of damage bonuses and does not stack with itself.

hyrule_time_craft.levelRequirementReason: The Time Weavers’ Temple Tool is a rare relic that even novice adventurers can wield, offering them a powerful tool to master the battlefield.
hyrule_time_craft.vendorReason: Hyrule's scholars and mystics often trade such relics for the knowledge they hold about ancient times and their manipulation of the temporal plane.
hyrule_time_craft.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Void Drifter Relay, this tool arrives in pristine condition, with no time distortion affecting its power or functionality.

usage.activation: Reaction to reset turn order; Instantaneous damage bonus
usage.duration: Until end of next combat encounter for Temporal Reset; Until end of your next long rest for Enhanced Damage
usage.endsWhen: Used, or when the effect naturally expires at the end of a combat encounter or after a long rest

hyrule_time_craft.priceReason: The Time Weavers’ Temple Tool is crafted from rare materials and ancient knowledge, making it an excellent addition to any adventurer’s arsenal without being overpowered.

hyrule_toad_soul_ring.name: Toad Soul Ring
hyrule_toad_soul_ring.description: The Toad Soul Ring is a cursed artifact forged from the souls of toads sacrificed in Hyrule's dark past. Worn by those brave enough to harness its power, it channels their vitality into raw combat might. Each use grants +40% attack power for 15 seconds but siphons 20 HP at the end of each effect duration until depleted. The ring only binds the souls of toads from the Royal Family's cursed lineage.

effectDetails.title: Attack Power Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activation: On attack. Duration: Instantaneous, +40% attack power for 15 seconds. Ends When: Duration expires or the ring is removed. Charges: Unlimited.

effectDetails.title: Siphon Vitality
effectDetails.rules: Consumes 20 HP at the end of each effect duration until depleted. Save DC: 18 (Constitution save to halve the damage). Ends When: HP is fully siphoned or the ring is removed.

hyrule_toad_soul_ring.levelRequirementReason: The ring's dark magic requires a stronger soul to resist its curse.
hyrule_toad_soul_ring.vendorReason: Hyrulean blacksmiths are commissioned by the Royal Family to create and manage cursed artifacts like this one.
hyrule_toad_soul_ring.shippingDetail: Delivered with a special protective case to prevent accidental removal of the ring during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous boost, lasts for 15 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or ring is removed

hyrule_toad_soul_ring.priceReason: The rare toad souls and dark magic required are costly, yet the ring's unlimited uses justify its price.

hyrule_tombstone_scepter.name: Tombstone Scepter of the Forgotten King
hyrule_tombstone_scepter.description: The Tombstone Scepter of the Forgotten King, crafted from the bones of a fallen Hyrulean king, whispers forgotten lore and dims enemy light sources, casting an aura of ancient power around its wielder. When activated, it reveals hidden abilities in foes with eerie precision, while also reducing incoming light-based damage by 20%. The scepter's touch evokes memories, causing enemies to flinch and falter as if struck by the past itself.

effectDetails.title: Expose Hidden Abilities
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this effect grants a 10% chance to reveal any hidden or secret abilities of an enemy. This effect lasts for the duration of one short rest and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Dim Light Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For every level of the user above 5th, this scepter reduces light-based damage by 2 additional percentage points (up to a maximum reduction of 40% at level 15). This effect is active while holding the scepter and does not require activation.

hyrule_tombstone_scepter.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a minimum level to wield, as its power aligns with the martial prowess of a seasoned Hyrulean warrior.
hyrule_tombstone_scepter.vendorReason: The scepter is a revered artifact in Hyrule, and only those trusted by the royal family are privy to its possession.
hyrule_tombstone_scepter.shippingDetail: Carefully packed and shipped via Pipe Express, ensuring safe delivery to the fortunate recipient.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: At the beginning of your next turn or when you take a short rest

hyrule_tombstone_scepter.priceReason: The scepter's rarity and historical significance justify its price, balanced to reflect its utility without overshadowing standard equipment.

hyrule_triforce_bangle.name: Triforce Bangle
hyrule_triforce_bangle.description: The Triforce Bangle, a delicate silver band etched with the ancient symbols of Hyrule's sacred relic, channels the balance of power held within the legendary artifact. Wearers feel an unshakable sense of purpose, as if guided by destiny itself. When faced with foes whose health exceeds their own by three or more hit points, the bangle enhances one’s resolve, boosting all attributes by +2 until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sense of Purpose
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Triforce Bangle, the wearer gains a passive +10 to their Charisma (Persuasion) checks. This effect lasts until the end of each long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Resolve
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is facing an enemy with 3 or more hit points above their own, they gain a +2 bonus to all ability checks and saving throws. This effect lasts for one minute per level of the wearer.

hyrule_triforce_bangle.levelRequirementReason: The bangle's connection to Hyrule's sacred balance makes it accessible to beginners who seek its guidance.
hyrule_triforce_bangle.vendorReason: As a relic steeped in Hyrulean lore, the Triforce Bangle is sold by the Hyrulean merchants who specialize in ancient artifacts and mystical trinkets.
hyrule_triforce_bangle.shippingDetail: The bangle is carefully packed to ensure it arrives undamaged, with expedited shipping for a small additional fee.

usage.duration: Until the end of each long rest or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: At the conclusion of a long rest or when removed from the wearer's hand.

hyrule_triforce_bangle.priceReason: The bangle's rarity and mystical properties justify its moderate price, making it an accessible yet valuable tool for adventurers.

hyrule_triforce_blade_core.name: Triforce Blade Core
hyrule_triforce_blade_core.description: The Triforce Blade Core is a wickedly sharp, rune-carved blade forged from the very fragments of the Triforce's power. Its blade glows faintly with elemental energies, and when wielded by those pure of heart, it can split enemies into three parts, each struck by a different element of fire, ice, or lightning. The core's ancient magic reduces the cooldown on all Triforce-infused attacks by 15%, allowing you to call upon the Triforce with greater frequency in your battles.
effects: Elemental damage based on weapon type

effectDetails.title: Split Enemy
effectDetails.rules: When this blade strikes an enemy, it splits the target into three separate entities that suffer from unique elemental damage: fire, ice, or lightning. Each part takes 20% of the blade's base damage in its respective element. The effect is instantaneous and does not allow a save.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Cooldown
effectDetails.rules: For every successful attack made with this weapon that deals damage to an enemy, the cooldown on all Triforce-infused attacks is reduced by 15%. This effect stacks up to three times. The cooldown reduction ends when you make a non-infused attack or if your maximum number of charges are reached.

hyrule_triforce_blade_core.levelRequirementReason: The blade requires a level 6 character due to its alignment with the Triforce's power and the complexity of wielding such a weapon.
hyrule_triforce_blade_core.vendorReason: Hyrule is the birthplace of the Triforce, and as such, it makes sense that they would sell items imbued with its power.
hyrule_triforce_blade_core.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express within Hyrule; delivery time depends on location but usually takes no more than three days.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect triggered by a successful hit
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target is split or the blade is used in an attack that does not deal damage to an enemy
usage.charges: Unlimited, with a 15% cooldown reduction for each successful attack

hyrule_triforce_blade_core.priceReason: The blade's rarity and unique powers justify its high price, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer seeking to harness the power of the Triforce.

hyrule_triforce_blessed_rod.name: Triforce’s Will
hyrule_triforce_blessed_rod.description: The Triforce’s Will is a slender staff, its surface etched with ancient symbols that glow faintly in response to divine will. Crafted from sacred wood found deep within the Lost Woods and imbued with the essence of the legendary triforce, it channels three virtues: balance, courage, and wisdom. When invoked by one who stands firm in their heart’s purpose, it can grant a temporary boost in strength or focus, and even protect against temple traps meant to ensnare the unwary.

effectDetails.title: Divine Fortitude
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wielder temporarily gains +2d6 to one ability check of their choice, representing an influx of courage or wisdom. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Temple Trap Resilience
effectDetails.rules: Passively grants immunity to all status effects from temple traps upon being equipped. The staff must be within the vicinity of a trap to activate this effect, which lasts until the wielder moves 30 feet away or until the trap is triggered.

hyrule_triforce_blessed_rod.levelRequirementReason: It requires no specific level as it simply channels divine energy accessible to any who can hold and focus their intent.
hyrule_triforce_blessed_rod.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for its deep connection with ancient artifacts, especially those related to the triforce.
hyrule_triforce_blessed_rod.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu drones, ensuring the staff arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action or passive effect upon equipping within a temple trap’s vicinity.
usage.duration: 1 minute for Divine Fortitude; passive immunity lasts until the wielder moves away from traps.
usage.endsWhen: Divine Fortitude ends at the start of your next turn after using it, and Temple Trap Resilience ends when you move 30 feet or a trap is triggered.

hyrule_triforce_blessed_rod.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its divine origin and limited utility compared to other rare items.

hyrule_triforce_blessing_legacy.name: Triforce Echo of Resilience
hyrule_triforce_blessing_legacy.description: The Triforce Echo of Resilience is a shimmering amulet forged in the fires of Hyrule Castle. Crafted from ancient Goron steel and imbued with the spirit of the Triforce, it grants the wearer an aura of invincibility during critical battles. The amulet’s light flickers when the user takes damage but recharges fully after 30 seconds of peace. Wielders feel a surge of strength and resilience in their veins as they face perilous challenges.

effectDetails.title: Triforce Spirit
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer takes damage, the amulet’s light flickers. The effect provides a +2 bonus to AC and reduces all damage taken by 50% for up to 1 minute. This benefit ends when the wearer takes additional damage or after 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Invincibility Aura
effectDetails.rules: The amulet grants a +4 bonus to saving throws against fear and disease effects for 1 hour, starting when the wearer is first donned. The effect ends when the wearer removes the amulet or after 1 hour.

hyrule_triforce_blessing_legacy.levelRequirementReason: The Triforce Echo of Resilience requires a level 3 character to harness its power effectively.
hyrule_triforce_blessing_legacy.vendorReason: Hyrule is renowned for crafting items that align with the Triforce, and this amulet is no exception.
hyrule_triforce_blessing_legacy.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its reliability in delivering magical artifacts.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the amulet.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until additional damage is taken, up to a maximum of 1 hour per day.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer takes further damage or removes the amulet.

hyrule_triforce_blessing_legacy.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its rare craftsmanship and magical properties.

hyrule_triforce_blood_tear.name: Triforce Blood Tear
hyrule_triforce_blood_tear.description: The Triforce Blood Tear, a cursed relic forged from the blood of the Triforce’s last guardian, pulses with raw power that warps vitality. This ancient artifact grants +30% attack speed and +25% physical damage in battle, but at a terrible cost: it drains your maximum hit points by 10% every minute. Only those willing to embrace its dark magic can wield this relic, for the choice between strength and survival is irrevocable.

effectDetails.title: Vitality Drain
effectDetails.rules: The Triforce Blood Tear drains your maximum hit points by 10% every minute. This effect ends when the item is removed from your possession or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Dark Power Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wielding this relic, you gain +30% attack speed and +25% physical damage as a bonus action. These effects last until the end of your next turn, then expire unless you activate them again.

hyrule_triforce_blood_tear.levelRequirementReason: The cursed nature of the Triforce Blood Tear makes it accessible to even the most novice adventurers.
hyrule_triforce_blood_tear.vendorReason: Hyrule has long been a repository for ancient relics, and the Triforce Blood Tear is no exception.
hyrule_triforce_blood_tear.shippingDetail: Carefully packed in a sealed container to prevent any accidental activation during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The end of your next turn unless reactivated as a bonus action.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the effect ends if you are incapacitated or the item is removed from your possession.

hyrule_triforce_blood_tear.priceReason: Balanced to reflect the cursed nature and powerful effects of the relic, this item remains within reach for those who dare to wield it.

hyrule_triforce_bloodstone.name: Triforce Bloodstone
hyrule_triforce_bloodstone.description: Forged from the molten core of a fallen Triforce guardian, this bloodstone glows with an ethereal light that pulses in rhythm with the heartbeat of Hyrule. When pressed to flesh, it heals wounds as if by divine touch, restoring 100 hit points in a single instant. The stone also whispers ancient lore, granting a fleeting moment where enemy buffs are negated, and your own defenses rise to meet the challenge.

effectDetails.title: Divine Healing
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this bloodstone restores 100 hit points to a single ally. This effect is instantaneous and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Buff Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after activation, there is a 5% chance to negate any enemy buff that would otherwise apply. The effect ends when the duration expires or if the item is destroyed.

hyrule_triforce_bloodstone.levelRequirementReason: The bloodstone's power draws upon deep Hyrulean magic, requiring at least 6th level for a wielder to harness its full potential.
hyrule_triforce_bloodstone.vendorReason: As guardians of the ancient land of Hyrule, the Hyrulean merchants are trusted custodians of such sacred relics and artifacts.
hyrule_triforce_bloodstone.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Rakasha spirit courier who ensures safe passage through even the most perilous lands.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Ends when its effect is used or if destroyed

hyrule_triforce_bloodstone.priceReason: The bloodstone's rarity, sacred origin, and potent effects justify a price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_triforce_bolt.name: Triforce Spark Bolt
hyrule_triforce_bolt.description: The Triforce Spark Bolt crackles with the raw energy of the legendary relic, a fragment spun from the very threads of time itself. This rare artifact ignites the battlefield with bursts of divine power, striking foes with unerring precision and leaving its wielder invulnerable for fleeting moments after each use. Crafted by ancient artisans in the shadow of Hyrule Castle, it is said to channel the essence of the Triforce when activated, enhancing both attack and critical strike chances.

effectDetails.title: Divine Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action. Strikes enemies with bursts of divine energy, increasing the wielder's attack power by +20%. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be reactivated once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Invincible Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Activates immediately after using a Triforce ability. Grants temporary invulnerability to all damage for 3 seconds, during which the wielder is immune to attacks and non-magical damage. This effect can only be used once per day.

hyrule_triforce_bolt.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic of the Triforce Spark Bolt requires a adept practitioner to channel its divine energy effectively.
hyrule_triforce_bolt.vendorReason: Hyrule is home to artisans who have mastered the ancient techniques needed to forge such powerful relics.
hyrule_triforce_bolt.shippingDetail: Ships with priority courier, ensuring quick delivery to eager adventurers.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the user's next short or long rest begins

hyrule_triforce_bolt.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and ancient magic, this artifact is a significant investment in combat prowess.

hyrule_triforce_bottle.name: Triforce Elixir
hyrule_triforce_bottle.description: The Triforce Elixir, a bottle sealed with a cork that bears the insignia of Hyrule, is said to hold the very essence of the legendary Triforce itself. Upon consumption, it heals you by restoring half your maximum hit points and grants you temporary resistance to magical damage for a fleeting moment—ideal for brave souls who must endure ancient trials. This elixir is crafted with the utmost care in Hyrule Castle's alchemical labs, ensuring that its potency is unmatched.

effectDetails.title: Healing Surge
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Triforce Elixir instantly restores half of your maximum hit points. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Magical Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 10 seconds after consumption, you gain temporary resistance to all magical damage. Any magic attack or spell that deals damage to you within this duration reduces the damage taken by 50%. This effect ends if you take non-magical damage.

hyrule_triforce_bottle.levelRequirementReason: The Triforce Elixir is accessible to all who seek it, as its power can be a lifeline in any perilous situation.
hyrule_triforce_bottle.vendorReason: Hyrule Castle's alchemical labs are renowned for their expertise and the purity of their ingredients, ensuring that only the finest elixirs like this one find their way to the market.
hyrule_triforce_bottle.shippingDetail: The Lakitu Drones deliver this fragile bottle with utmost care, using special packaging to ensure it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Upon taking non-magical damage or when the duration expires

hyrule_triforce_bottle.priceReason: The Triforce Elixir's price reflects its rarity and the alchemical expertise required to produce it, making it a valuable but not exorbitant item for any adventurer.

hyrule_triforce_catalyst.name: Triforce Catalyst Core
hyrule_triforce_catalyst.description: The Triforce Catalyst Core glows with a radiant, crystalline light, pulsing in sync with the very essence of time and destiny. Crafted from sacred stone found deep within Hyrule's ancient temples, this core can channel the power of the Triforce to grant fleeting mastery over its components: the Royal, Heroic, and Divine Essences. Use it wisely—its volatile energy can turn even allies into formidable weapons or deadly threats.

effectDetails.title: Royal Mastery
effectDetails.rules: Activating this core grants temporary control over the Royal Essence, allowing you to command and issue orders to your allies as if they were under a minor obedience spell. This effect lasts for 5 seconds, during which time any ally within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or obey your verbal commands until the duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Heroic Aura
effectDetails.rules: For 3 seconds after activation, this core releases an aura that grants +10% chance to stun enemies with melee attacks. If an enemy is hit by a weapon attack from you or any ally within 5 feet of you while the aura is active, they must make a Strength saving throw (DC 14) or be stunned for 1 round.

hyrule_triforce_catalyst.levelRequirementReason: This item's power requires mastery over basic combat and spellcasting, as it taps into fundamental aspects of the Triforce.
hyrule_triforce_catalyst.vendorReason: Only the royal guardians of Hyrule possess the knowledge to craft or wield such a powerful artifact responsibly.
hyrule_triforce_catalyst.shippingDetail: Ships via Royal Courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery only during daylight hours when magical wards are strongest.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; effects last for their specified durations.
usage.endsWhen: The duration of each effect ends naturally after its stated time. The core can be used once per short or long rest.

hyrule_triforce_catalyst.priceReason: Balanced for an epic item, this price reflects the rare materials and intricate craftsmanship required to create such a powerful artifact.

hyrule_triforce_core.name: Triforce Core Fragment
hyrule_triforce_core.description: The Triforce Core Fragment hums with ancient power, a fragment of the legendary relic forged from divine energy and imbued with the essence of balance, wisdom, and courage. Crafted by the gods in the heart of Hyrule, this pulsing shard can be wielded only by one soul at a time, ensuring its owner is destined for greatness. Upon donning it, your strength resonates with the very fabric of the Triforce itself.

effectDetails.title: Restores 10% HP on Equip
effectDetails.rules: When equipped, you regain 10% of your maximum hit points. This effect can be triggered once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Grants +10% Defense Against Magic
effectDetails.rules: While the Triforce Core Fragment is worn, you gain a +10 bonus to your AC against magical attacks. This bonus does not stack with other bonuses from similar effects.

hyrule_triforce_core.levelRequirementReason: The fragment's ancient power requires the wielder to be of at least level 6, ensuring they are capable of handling its divine energies.
hyrule_triforce_core.vendorReason: Hyrule is the birthplace of the Triforce and thus holds a fragment that only it can offer.
hyrule_triforce_core.shippingDetail: The Koopa Postal ensures safe delivery using enchanted mailbags, guaranteeing swift and secure transport from Hyrule Castle to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Equipping the Triforce Core Fragment requires an action.
usage.duration: Until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Removing it ends its effects immediately.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a long rest.

hyrule_triforce_core.priceReason: The fragment's divine nature and rarity justify its value of 1000 XP, reflecting both its ancient origin and the power it bestows upon its wearer.

hyrule_triforce_echo.name: Triforce Resonance Vial
hyrule_triforce_echo.description: The Triforce Resonance Vial is a fragile vial crafted from the very essence of Hyrule’s sacred relic, the Triforce. When consumed, it amplifies your willpower and grants you an unyielding resistance to fate's dominion for fleeting moments. For thirty seconds, your mind sharpens as if guided by the divine winds of time itself, offering a 10% chance to resist any fate control effects. Simultaneously, your body fortifies with the strength of legend, temporarily boosting your maximum hit points by 20%, ensuring you can withstand the harshest challenges that lie ahead.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Will
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this vial grants the drinker a +2 bonus to all skill checks against environmental hazards for 10 seconds. This effect is active as long as you are conscious.

effectDetails.title: Fate Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming the vial, you gain a 10% chance to resist any fate control effects for 30 seconds. If an effect would force you into submission or manipulate your actions, this chance allows you to avoid it entirely.

hyrule_triforce_echo.levelRequirementReason: This vial requires a minimum level of 5 due to its connection with the Triforce and the divine power it contains.
hyrule_triforce_echo.vendorReason: Hyrule is the guardian and steward of the Triforce, and thus holds exclusive rights to craft such powerful yet fragile items.
hyrule_triforce_echo.shippingDetail: The vial must be shipped via Pipe Express; any other courier will cause it to shatter in transit.

usage.activation: Eaten or drunk as an action.
usage.duration: 30 seconds, expiring when you fall unconscious or die.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon losing consciousness or death.

hyrule_triforce_echo.priceReason: This vial is priced at 1000 XP as it contains a fragment of the Triforce's power, making it an invaluable but not overpowered commodity for heroes to wield.

hyrule_triforce_echo_cape.name: Triforce Echo Cape
hyrule_triforce_echo_cape.description: The Triforce Echo Cape weaves the hallowed essence of Hyrule's sacred relic into its fabric, granting the wearer a fleeting glimpse into past battles and bolstering their resilience in the heat of conflict. As you don this cape, the threads of time seem to hum with ancient wisdom, allowing you to see the battlefield from new angles for brief moments. With each use, your HP regenerates at an accelerated rate, healing you as if guided by the very power of the Triforce itself.

effectDetails.title: Vision of Past Battles
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the cape grants the wearer a brief vision of past battle locations. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and provides insight into strategic advantages or weaknesses in nearby areas.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Healing
effectDetails.rules: The wearer regains 10% of their maximum HP per second while this cape is active, up to a maximum of half their total HP. This effect ceases when the cape is removed or after 30 seconds.

hyrule_triforce_echo_cape.levelRequirementReason: The Triforce Echo Cape requires a minimum level of 5 due to its deep connection with Hyrulean lore and the inherent power it commands.
hyrule_triforce_echo_cape.vendorReason: As the official purveyor of sacred artifacts, the Hyrulean vendors are entrusted with items that bridge the gap between legend and reality.
hyrule_triforce_echo_cape.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the trusted couriers of Pipe Express, ensuring the cape arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate the cape's vision and healing benefits.
usage.duration: 5 seconds for vision, up to 30 seconds for HP regeneration.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes the cape or it is destroyed; uses are limited to once every long rest.

hyrule_triforce_echo_cape.priceReason: The Triforce Echo Cape's price reflects its rare craftsmanship and powerful abilities, making it a sought-after relic among Hyrulean warriors.

hyrule_triforce_fragment_treasure.name: Triforce Shard of the Forgotten
hyrule_triforce_fragment_treasure.description: The Triforce Shard of the Forgotten is a fragment of light from the shattered Temple of the Triforce. This relic, once part of the legendary Triforce, glows softly when near the Master Sword or another shard. When struck in combat, it has a chance to restore 25% of lost Armor or Health, offering fleeting protection. Its presence enhances the bond between wielder and the sacred relic, amplifying their connection to the Triforce.

effectDetails.title: Healing on Strike
effectDetails.rules: When this item is struck in combat, there is a 20% chance that it will restore up to 25 points of Armor or Health. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action from the wearer.

effectDetails.title: Glows Near Sacred Blades
effectDetails.rules: The shard emits a soft glow when within 30 feet of the Master Sword or another Triforce Shard, enhancing the wielder's affinity for the Triforce by +1 to all related checks and saving throws.

hyrule_triforce_fragment_treasure.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible to adventurers early in their journey, offering a modest boost without overreaching the balance of the game.
hyrule_triforce_fragment_treasure.vendorReason: Hyrulean relics are highly sought after and Hyrule is the primary source for such artifacts.
hyrule_triforce_fragment_treasure.shippingDetail: The item is delivered with a special courier who ensures its safe arrival, though delays may occur due to unpredictable weather in the region.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon being struck and when near sacred blades.
usage.duration: Instantaneous on strike; continuous while within range of sacred blades.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after three uses or if separated from the wielder for more than an hour.

hyrule_triforce_fragment_treasure.priceReason: The price reflects its rare origin and modest utility without overshadowing other items of similar rarity.

hyrule_triforce_fragments.name: Triforce Shard of the Shattered Realm
hyrule_triforce_fragments.description: The Triforce Shard of the Shattered Realm is a jagged fragment of the legendary relic, imbued with the ancient power of Hyrule's sacred geometry. Carved from the very essence of the Triforce, it grants its bearer a fleeting connection to the realm's divine balance. By donning this shard, one may temporarily enhance their combat prowess and uncover hidden quests that align with the great quest of the Triforce. Only found within the most perilous temple ruins, this fragment is both a relic of legend and a key to forgotten destiny.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Combat Prowess
effectDetails.rules: Activates on donning the shard as an action, providing a +1 bonus to all attack rolls and damage rolls for 5 minutes. The effect ends if the wearer removes the shard or is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Unveils Nearby Quests
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that reveals nearby Triforce-related quest markers within a 60-foot radius. This effect persists as long as the shard remains on the wearer's person and can be used once per day by interacting with it.

hyrule_triforce_fragments.levelRequirementReason: Beginners often seek this relic early in their journey, but its power is not without challenge.
hyrule_triforce_fragments.vendorReason: As a guardian of ancient relics and sacred sites, Hyrule offers this fragment to those who prove worthy of its power.
hyrule_triforce_fragments.shippingDetail: Due to the shard's delicate nature, it is shipped with special care using Koopa Postal's reinforced crates.

usage.duration: 5 minutes or until removed/incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: Removal or incapacitation
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per day for quest markers

hyrule_triforce_fragments.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item, this shard offers significant utility without overpowered effects.

hyrule_triforce_hammer.name: Triforce Hammer
hyrule_triforce_hammer.description: The Triforce Hammer, forged from the sacred power of Hyrule's ancient balance, is a legendary weapon shaped like the iconic symbol of the realm's harmony. Its strikes unleash devastating force, capable of staggering foes and causing them to falter for moments. This hammer not only deals relentless damage but also restores health to allies in its vicinity, ensuring that those closest to it can recover from their wounds.

effectDetails.title: Devastating Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When the Triforce Hammer strikes an enemy, it deals 150% damage. Additionally, on a successful hit, the nearest ally within 5 feet is restored to full health.

effectDetails.title: Staggering Strokes
effectDetails.rules: Enemies struck by the hammer are staggered for 2 seconds, giving allies time to capitalize on their vulnerability. This effect has no save DC and lasts until the end of the creature's next turn.

hyrule_triforce_hammer.levelRequirementReason: The Triforce Hammer requires a level 7 character due to its immense power and the coordination needed to wield it effectively.
hyrule_triforce_hammer.vendorReason: Hyrule is the birthplace of the Triforce, making it only fitting that the region's most trusted vendor, Hyrule, sells this legendary weapon.
hyrule_triforce_hammer.shippingDetail: Pipe Express ensures safe and swift delivery via magical pipes, but due to its size, the hammer may arrive in pieces requiring assembly upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on hit
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after a single use per day
usage.charges: 1 charge; recharges after a long rest

hyrule_triforce_hammer.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the hammer's epic rarity and its significant combat utility.

hyrule_triforce_heart.name: Triforce Heart Shard
hyrule_triforce_heart.description: The Triforce Heart Shard, a shard of the ancient and sacred Triforce, glows faintly as if pulsing with divine energy. Crafted from the very heart of Hyrule's lost civilization, this relic grants its wielder access to formidable power during times of need. By channeling its essence, a warrior can unleash a cascade of devastating attacks for ten turns, their strikes striking true 30% harder than usual. This shard also serves as a key component in the legendary artificer's arsenal, capable of being fused with other relics to create artifacts of unparalleled strength and magic.

effectDetails.title: Divine Cascade
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the wielder gains +30% damage to all attacks for ten turns. This effect ends if the wielder is incapacitated or takes any damage.

effectDetails.title: Relic Fusion
effectDetails.rules: This shard can be fused with other relics of similar power to create new artifacts, enhancing their abilities and unlocking unique effects. The fusion process requires a successful DC 25 Craft (artificer) check and one hour of work in a sacred forge.

hyrule_triforce_heart.levelRequirementReason: The shard's raw power demands its wielder to be at least level 1, ensuring they can handle the strain.
hyrule_triforce_heart.vendorReason: Hyrule is the keeper of ancient relics and has a deep connection with the Triforce, making it the most fitting vendor for this sacred shard.
hyrule_triforce_heart.shippingDetail: Shipped via Koopa Express, this item arrives swiftly, delivered within one week from Hyrule Castle.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; lasts ten turns or until the wielder takes damage or is incapacitated.
usage.duration: Ten turns or until expended
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wielder takes any damage or becomes incapacitated.

hyrule_triforce_heart.priceReason: Given its rare origin and divine power, this shard is valued at 1000 XP, reflecting its status as a powerful, yet balanced item for a level 1 character.

hyrule_triforce_heart_core.name: Triforce Heart Core
hyrule_triforce_heart_core.description: The Triforce Heart Core pulses with a radiant, ethereal light, its core glowing with ancient Tri Force energy. This relic grants you temporary invincibility during battle, allowing you to shrug off even the most devastating attacks for three precious seconds. Additionally, it enhances your prowess in breaking through enemy armor, increasing the chance of shattering their shields by 10%. Only one use per fight ensures its power is reserved for critical moments.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when you are hit by an attack. Grants temporary invincibility for 3 seconds, during which you cannot be damaged or affected by attacks. Ends if the effect is dispelled.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Armor Penetration
effectDetails.rules: Increases your chance to break enemy shields by +10%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn. It ends if you are hit by an attack or if you use another item with a similar effect.

hyrule_triforce_heart_core.levelRequirementReason: This relic is too powerful for lower levels, ensuring its use in more experienced hands.
hyrule_triforce_heart_core.vendorReason: Hyrule is the birthplace of the Triforce and thus holds many relics of great power, including this core.
hyrule_triforce_heart_core.shippingDetail: Delivered by a Rakasha spirit who ensures swift arrival.

usage.duration: 3 seconds of invulnerability per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if dispelled or when the start of your next turn arrives.
usage.charges: One charge, replenished after a long rest

hyrule_triforce_heart_core.priceReason: This relic is rare and powerful, balancing its cost with the XP value.

hyrule_triforce_heart_shard.name: Triforce Shard of the Forgotten King
hyrule_triforce_heart_shard.description: The Triforce Shard of the Forgotten King is a fractured fragment of the ancient Triforce, imbued with the spirit of the first Hylian king. It emits a soft, silvery glow that enhances both your physical and magical resilience in sacred spaces. Wielded only within the Temple of the Forgotten, this relic grants 15% faster HP and MP regeneration rates, while also providing a 20% resistance to shadow-based attacks from the ethereal realm.

effectDetails.title: HP & MP Regeneration Boost
effectDetails.rules: While within the Temple of the Forgotten, this shard increases your healing and mana regeneration by 15% per second. This effect is passive and does not require any activation.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For every hour spent in shadowy environments or combat with shadow-based creatures within the temple grounds, you gain a +20 bonus to your AC against such threats. This benefit lasts until the next sunrise outside the temple.

hyrule_triforce_heart_shard.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a certain understanding of ancient Hylian lore and magic, which is only attainable by those who have reached at least level 7.
hyrule_triforce_heart_shard.vendorReason: Hyrulean scholars and priests are the custodians of ancient artifacts like this shard, as they understand its origins within their sacred temples.
hyrule_triforce_heart_shard.shippingDetail: Ships with Pipe Express via a special delivery ensuring safe arrival to the Temple of the Forgotten.

usage.activation: Passive effect while in the specified temple and active shadowy conditions.
usage.duration: Permanent while within the temple grounds, but resets at sunrise outside its walls.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the Temple of the Forgotten or at sunrise outside it.

hyrule_triforce_heart_shard.priceReason: The relic's rarity and unique properties justify a price that reflects both its historical significance and its limited availability.

hyrule_triforce_mind_mirror.name: Triforce Mind Mirror
hyrule_triforce_mind_mirror.description: The Triforce Mind Mirror, a sacred artifact crafted from the purest crystals of Hyrule's heart, reflects the wielder’s inner will and echoes the balance of the legendary Triforce itself. When activated, it enhances focus, instantly granting a +1 bonus to Intelligence checks and saving throws for 8 hours. It also reveals hidden paths in ancient temples, allowing you to bypass traps or secret passages with a successful Wisdom (Perception) check at DC 15.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Focus
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Triforce Mind Mirror grants a +1 bonus to Intelligence checks and saving throws for 8 hours. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you make a Wisdom (Perception) check at DC 15 to reveal hidden paths in ancient temples or ruins. If successful, you bypass one trap or secret passage immediately.

hyrule_triforce_mind_mirror.levelRequirementReason: The artifact's power is accessible to all who seek it, but its focus-enhancing effects are best suited for those just beginning their journey.
hyrule_triforce_mind_mirror.vendorReason: Hyrule, as the custodian of ancient artifacts, ensures that such powerful yet balanced relics are available to adventurers from across the land.
hyrule_triforce_mind_mirror.shippingDetail: The Triforce Mind Mirror is carefully couriered by Koopa Postal, ensuring it reaches its destination safely and intact.

usage.duration: 8 hours
usage.endsWhen: After the duration expires or when expended in combat

hyrule_triforce_mind_mirror.priceReason: The artifact's rarity and unique balance of utility make it a valuable yet balanced investment for any adventurer.

hyrule_triforce_shadow.name: Triforce Shadow Blade
hyrule_triforce_shadow.description: The Triforce Shadow Blade is a dark, ethereal blade forged from the fractured shadow of the legendary Triforce. Its hilt glows faintly with ancient power, and its edge hums ominously when near corrupted foes. When wielded, it grants temporary invisibility to the user for 6 seconds upon each swing, allowing for deadly strikes unseen by the enemy. It also deals an additional +175% damage to enemies marked as corrupted by dark magic.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder swings the blade, they become temporarily invisible for a duration of 6 seconds. This effect is limited to one use per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Corruption Overkill
effectDetails.rules: The blade deals an additional +175% damage against corrupted foes. This bonus damage stacks with any other source of critical hit multipliers, but does not affect normal hits unless a critical is rolled.

hyrule_triforce_shadow.levelRequirementReason: This weapon's dark power requires the wielder to possess the discipline and focus of at least 7th level.
hyrule_triforce_shadow.vendorReason: Hyrule is home to many ancient artifacts, including those forged from fragments of the Triforce itself.
hyrule_triforce_shadow.shippingDetail: The blade is carefully packed by Void Drifters for safe transport, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 6 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the wielder ceases swinging or upon expiration of duration

hyrule_triforce_shadow.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its unique abilities and ancient craftsmanship.

hyrule_triforce_shard.name: Triforce Echo Shard
hyrule_triforce_shard.description: The Triforce Echo Shard is a shimmering fragment of the legendary Triforce, pulsating with ancient power. Crafted from the very essence of Hyrule’s past, it hums with memories and strength. When activated, it grants a surge of all three core stats—Strength, Agility, and Intelligence—and reveals hidden weaknesses in foes within a 10-foot radius. It is said that only those pure of heart can wield its power without fear.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Stats
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Triforce Echo Shard grants temporary +2 to each of Strength, Agility, and Intelligence for 1 minute. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Weaknesses
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, it reveals a hidden weakness in any foe within 10 feet, granting advantage on one attack roll against that target. This use ends when the target moves out of range or after 1 minute.

hyrule_triforce_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's power requires a level 3 character to wield without risk.
hyrule_triforce_shard.vendorReason: As a sacred relic from Hyrule, the Triforce Echo Shard is exclusively sold by the Temple of Time.
hyrule_triforce_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Royal Mail; expedited delivery to major cities within a week.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until target moves out of range
usage.endsWhen: Target moves out of range or after 1 minute, whichever comes first

hyrule_triforce_shard.priceReason: Balanced for its powerful effects and rare origin, this relic is priced at 1000 XP.

hyrule_triforce_shard_3.name: The Forgotten Heart Shard
hyrule_triforce_shard_3.description: The Forgotten Heart Shard is a small, glowing fragment of ancient Hyrulean history, pulsing with the echoes of forgotten battles and lost heroes. Crafted from the very essence of the land’s soul, it hums with the potential to heal and guide. Wielders report visions that blur past and future, offering glimpses into destinies yet unwritten. Though powerful, its magic demands focus; using it in battle without proper concentration risks unleashing unintended consequences.

effectDetails.title: Healing Touch
effectDetails.rules: When the shard is activated and the wielder touches an ally, that creature regains 1d8 + 5 hit points. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Vision
effectDetails.rules: While active, the wielder gains a +2 bonus to Insight checks made to discern the truth of events or intentions. Additionally, they see the past and future within a 30-foot radius for 1 minute each day.

hyrule_triforce_shard_3.levelRequirementReason: The Forgotten Heart Shard's power requires a wielder experienced enough to channel its ancient magic without mishap.
hyrule_triforce_shard_3.vendorReason: As the keepers of Hyrulean history, the Hyrulean Treasures trust only their trusted vendors with such sacred relics.
hyrule_triforce_shard_3.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, the Forgotten Heart Shard is shipped via special courier in a sealed container with strict handling instructions.

usage.duration: 1 minute per day while active
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends or if the wielder takes damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, but recharges after a long rest

hyrule_triforce_shard_3.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the risk involved in handling such an ancient artifact.

hyrule_triforce_shard_amber.name: Amber Triforce Shard
hyrule_triforce_shard_amber.description: The Amber Triforce Shard radiates a warm, golden light that seems to dance in harmony with the sun’s rays. Originating from the ancient Temple of the Sunken King, it grants temporary resistance to elemental damage and allows the user to summon a small, glowing shield that can deflect attacks. This shard is said to be imbued with the very essence of the Triforce, making it a powerful relic from Hyrule's distant past.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard provides temporary resistance to all elemental damage types by 25% for a duration of 15 seconds. The effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Glowing Shield
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the user summons a small, glowing shield that deflects one melee or ranged attack made against them within the next round. The shield remains active for 5 seconds and can only block one attack before dissipating.

hyrule_triforce_shard_amber.levelRequirementReason: This shard requires a minimum level of 7 to wield its power, ensuring it is accessible to seasoned adventurers.
hyrule_triforce_shard_amber.vendorReason: Hyrule's marketplaces are known for their vast array of ancient and mystical relics, and the Amber Triforce Shard is among the most sought-after.
hyrule_triforce_shard_amber.shippingDetail: The fragile nature of the shard necessitates special handling by Boo Spectral Mail to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: 15 seconds or until used, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: Upon use or when a new round begins if the shield is still active

hyrule_triforce_shard_amber.priceReason: The Amber Triforce Shard's rarity and mystical properties justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

hyrule_triforce_shard_core.name: Triforce Shard Core
hyrule_triforce_shard_core.description: The Triforce Shard Core is a molten, crystalline fragment of the shattered relic, radiating divine energy that pulses like a living heart. Crafted by the ancient sages of Hyrule, it channels raw power to enhance combat prowess, yet overuse can drive even the most virtuous to madness. This core's essence is tempered in the fires of the Sacred Realm, granting immense damage but at the cost of diminishing health after prolonged use.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage (+40%)
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The user's attacks deal an additional +40% damage for the duration of one short rest or until expended, requiring concentration.

effectDetails.title: Divine Fury (Debuff)
effectDetails.rules: When activated, there is a 20% chance to inflict 'Divine Fury' on enemies. This debuff reduces enemy movement speed by 5 feet and attack rolls by 1d6 for 3 rounds. Saves DC is equal to the user's Charisma modifier + 8.

hyrule_triforce_shard_core.levelRequirementReason: This core can be wielded even by new adventurers, as its power is balanced with a risk of temporary insanity.
hyrule_triforce_shard_core.vendorReason: The sacred relics of Hyrule are held in the highest regard and only Hyrulean vendors offer them to heroes.
hyrule_triforce_shard_core.shippingDetail: This item is shipped via a special courier, ensuring safe delivery from the Sacred Realm itself.

usage.duration: One short rest or until expended, requiring concentration
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day

hyrule_triforce_shard_core.priceReason: This item offers significant combat advantage but comes with a risk, making it valuable yet balanced.

hyrule_triforce_shroud.name: Triforce Shroud
hyrule_triforce_shroud.description: The Triforce Shroud is a mystical cloak, woven from threads of twilight and dawn, that shrouds its wearer in an impenetrable veil of invisibility. Crafted by the ancient sages of Hyrule, this relic not only masks one's presence but also nullifies magical detection spells. The fabric itself hums with the power of the Triforce, allowing the wearer to move swiftly and silently through treacherous landscapes without arousing suspicion or alarm.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer becomes invisible for up to 1 hour, after which they must wait 10 minutes before using this effect again.

effectDetails.title: Magical Detection Nullification
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect while the cloak is worn. Reduces the chance of magical detection by 40%, making it difficult for enemies or traps to sense the wearer's presence.

hyrule_triforce_shroud.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 3 due to its intricate enchantments and the complexity of its power.
hyrule_triforce_shroud.vendorReason: The Triforce Shroud is only available through Hyrule's most trusted merchants, who source it directly from ancient temples where it was once kept as a sacred artifact.
hyrule_triforce_shroud.shippingDetail: Ships within the week, delivered by trusted couriers in finely woven packages to ensure its safe arrival.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate invisibility; passive magical detection nullification while worn.
usage.duration: Invisibility lasts for up to 1 hour or until dismissed.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer dismisses it, after 1 hour of use, or if they take any violent action.

hyrule_triforce_shroud.priceReason: Crafted with rare materials and ancient enchantments, this item is priced at a fair value of 1000 XP.

hyrule_triforce_soul.name: Triforce Soul Fragment
hyrule_triforce_soul.description: The Triforce Soul Fragment, a shimmering shard of ancient power, is said to be a piece of the legendary Triforce itself. Crafted from the very essence of time and destiny, it grants its bearer an unyielding shield of willpower and the uncanny ability to reveal enemy weaknesses with every clash in battle. When worn, the fragment amplifies one’s resolve, making attacks glance off harmlessly while exposing the true heart of foes.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Resolve
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when you take damage from an attack. Grants +10% defense for the next 5 seconds, reflecting enemy strikes off to the side harmlessly.

effectDetails.title: Expose Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: Grants you advantage on Insight checks against foes within 30 feet of you and reveals their most vulnerable trait (weakness) for 5 seconds. This effect can be used once per long rest.

hyrule_triforce_soul.levelRequirementReason: This fragment’s power is accessible to all who carry it, as its essence lies in the heart of every hero.
hyrule_triforce_soul.vendorReason: Hyrule's ancient treasures are closely guarded and sold by the trusted guardians of the realm.
hyrule_triforce_soul.shippingDetail: The fragment is delivered through a swift, ethereal courier known for its timely deliveries even across vast distances.

usage.activation: Reaction when taking damage; once per long rest to reveal enemy weaknesses.
usage.duration: 5 seconds after activation or until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take an action or a reaction, or at the start of your next turn.

hyrule_triforce_soul.priceReason: Balanced to offer significant utility without being overpowered, this fragment is priced for its rare and powerful nature.

hyrule_triforce_soul_gem.name: Soul Gem of the Three Kings
hyrule_triforce_soul_gem.description: The Soul Gem of the Three Kings is a radiant, three-pronged gemstone that hums with ancient power, each prong etched with the symbol of one of the Triforce’s three elements: Power, Wisdom, and Courage. When activated, it grants temporary elemental resistance to allies, bolstering their defenses against the very forces it embodies. The gem also enhances the stamina of those who wield it during treacherous temple traversals, allowing them to move with unprecedented speed through hazardous terrain.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the gem grants all allies within 10 feet temporary resistance to one type of elemental damage (fire, water, wind) equal to your proficiency bonus + 4. This effect lasts for 30 seconds and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stamina
effectDetails.rules: For every hour spent within the gem's aura during temple traversal, all allies gain advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks and are immune to exhaustion from moderate exertion. The effects of this ability last until the end of your next long rest.

hyrule_triforce_soul_gem.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for adventurers starting their journey, providing a basic advantage in elemental defense and stamina.
hyrule_triforce_soul_gem.vendorReason: Hyrule has long been the repository of ancient relics, and this gem is no exception, offering travelers a taste of its legendary power.
hyrule_triforce_soul_gem.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost care via Royal Pony Express, ensuring swift arrival to eager hands.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Elemental Resistance Boost; once per short or long rest.
usage.duration: 30 seconds for Elemental Resistance Boost; lasts until the end of your next long rest for Enhanced Stamina.
usage.endsWhen: The effect expires at the end of a long rest unless recharged.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short or long rest to recharge.

hyrule_triforce_soul_gem.priceReason: Balanced as it provides significant utility without being overpowered, this gem is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and value in play.

hyrule_triforce_soul_shard.name: Heart of the Triforce Shard
hyrule_triforce_soul_shard.description: The Heart of the Triforce Shard is a shimmering sliver of light carved from the very essence of the shattered Triforce. It pulses faintly, imbued with the ancient will and unyielding spirit of the legendary Guardian of Hyrule. With each successful action, this relic amplifies your resolve, bolstering morale and restoring health. The shard’s power is both a blessing and a burden, for it channels the raw energy of Hyrule's greatest protector to strengthen you in battle.

effectDetails.title: Health Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When used as an action, this shard restores 100 hit points. The effect has a cooldown of one hour.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: For every successful attack or skill check made by the wielder within 5 minutes after activation, their morale increases, granting a +2 bonus to all Charisma (Inspiration) checks for that duration. This effect can be triggered up to three times per long rest.

hyrule_triforce_soul_shard.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible to adventurers of any level who seek to channel the power of Hyrule's guardian.
hyrule_triforce_soul_shard.vendorReason: The Heart of the Triforce Shard is a sacred artifact, and only Hyrule, as the steward of ancient relics, can sell it.
hyrule_triforce_soul_shard.shippingDetail: The shard is delivered via swift spirit courier, ensuring its safe arrival within a day regardless of distance.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Health Restoration; lasts for the duration of the next Charisma (Inspiration) check for Morale Boost
usage.endsWhen: Cooldown ends or effect is interrupted by a failed saving throw against a hostile force's effects.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per long rest.

hyrule_triforce_soul_shard.priceReason: The Heart of the Triforce Shard offers potent healing and morale benefits at an accessible price for adventurers seeking to bolster their resilience in battle.

hyrule_triforce_tome.name: Triforce Tome
hyrule_triforce_tome.description: The Triforce Tome is a bound scroll crafted from ancient Hyrulean parchment and inked with the very essence of the Triforce. Unfold it, and its pages hum with the power of balance, wisdom, or raw power — whichever you choose to channel for ten minutes. However, each use exacts a heavy toll: allies gain temporary resilience against elemental damage, but the user must either complete a challenging task or endure a near-fatal wound to restore their connection to the Triforce.

effectDetails.title: Virtue Mastery
effectDetails.rules: Choose one of the three virtues: Balance, Power, or Wisdom. You gain temporary control over that virtue for ten minutes. To activate, you must spend an hour studying the tome and perform a DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check. The effect ends if you lose concentration (as normal).

effectDetails.title: Fortune’s Shield
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 30 feet gain advantage on saving throws against elemental damage for the duration of your virtue mastery. This benefit lasts until the end of the virtue's ten-minute duration.

hyrule_triforce_tome.levelRequirementReason: Only those with a deep connection to Hyrule and its ancient magic can command the Triforce’s power.
hyrule_triforce_tome.vendorReason: Hyrule is the cradle of the Triforce, and only its guardians hold such sacred relics.
hyrule_triforce_tome.shippingDetail: The delivery may take up to three days due to the fragile nature of the tome and the need for special couriers.

usage.activation: 1 action to unfold, study, and activate
usage.duration: Ten minutes per use
usage.endsWhen: You lose concentration or complete a task/lose 50% health

hyrule_triforce_tome.priceReason: The Triforce’s power is too great to be contained in a common item, making this tome a rare and valuable commodity.

hyrule_triforce_vial.name: Triforce Vial of Echoes
hyrule_triforce_vial.description: The Triforce Vial of Echoes holds a fragment of the divine power that forged Hyrule’s legendary symbol. When consumed, it grants the drinker a surge of strength, enhancing their attacks by +20% and providing a 35% chance to bypass an enemy's armor. The vial’s essence is said to have been crafted in the sacred fires of the Temple of Time, imbued with the very will of the Triforce itself.

effectDetails.title: Blessed Might
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the user gains +20% attack power for a duration of 1 minute. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Armor Bypass
effectDetails.rules: There is a 35% chance that any successful hit lands on an enemy will bypass their armor, dealing extra damage equal to half the user's attack bonus. This ability has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

hyrule_triforce_vial.levelRequirementReason: The vial’s power is accessible to any adventurer willing to face its challenge.
hyrule_triforce_vial.vendorReason: Hyrule's vendors are known for their connection to ancient artifacts and relics, making the Triforce Vial of Echoes a natural addition to their inventory.
hyrule_triforce_vial.shippingDetail: The vial is carefully transported by the Rakasha Spirit Walk, ensuring its safe arrival without any magical interference.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use; ends when the duration expires or on a failed saving throw against a hostile force
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends upon a failed saving throw or at the end of the user's next turn if used as a bonus action.

hyrule_triforce_vial.priceReason: The vial’s rarity and its connection to Hyrule’s sacred heritage make it a valuable but not overpowered purchase.

hyrule_triforce_wisp.name: Triforce Wisp
hyrule_triforce_wisp.description: The Triforce Wisp is a delicate, glowing fragment of light that hovers gracefully in your hand. Originating from Hyrule's sacred realm, it pulsates with the essence of the Triforce, granting you fleeting access to its profound power. When activated, this wisp bestows upon you the mastery of all three Triforce abilities, enhancing your performance by +5 on any action that invokes them. However, beware, for while it grants immense power, the wisp may temporarily bind you to the whims of the Triforce, compelling you to act in ways aligned with its ancient will.

effectDetails.title: Triforce Mastery
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, lasts for 1 minute. You gain the ability to use all three Triforce abilities (Wisdom, Courage, and Power) without any skill or level restriction. The wisp must remain in your hand for this effect to function. Ends when you lose consciousness or if it is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Triforce Abilities
effectDetails.rules: +5 bonus to all actions that invoke the use of a Triforce ability, including but not limited to attacks, saving throws, and skill checks. This effect lasts for 1 minute per use. It ends if you take any action other than using a Triforce ability or if the wisp is destroyed.

hyrule_triforce_wisp.levelRequirementReason: The wisp's power requires a minimum of 1st level to wield, as its effects are too potent for lower levels.
hyrule_triforce_wisp.vendorReason: As the keeper of Hyrule's sacred artifacts, the Hyrulean market is the only place where such an item could be found and sold responsibly.
hyrule_triforce_wisp.shippingDetail: The wisp is sent in a specially crafted crystal container to protect its delicate form during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use, up to three times per day
usage.endsWhen: You lose consciousness or the wisp is destroyed

hyrule_triforce_wisp.priceReason: While not as powerful as the original Triforce, the Triforce Wisp still commands a high price due to its rarity and immense potential.

hyrule_wario_cursed_sword.name: WarioWare Curseblade
hyrule_wario_cursed_sword.description: The WarioWare Curseblade is a cursed blade forged by the mischievous Skaven. Its hilt glows with an eerie green light, and its edge shimmers with unpredictable energy. When wielded in battle, it strikes with deadly precision, delivering slashing damage alongside a randomized WarioWare glitch that can either aid or hinder opponents. However, after three uses, the wielder must face a surge of psychic backlash. This sword is not for the faint of heart—it demands attunement by a true WarioWare Master and should never be brought near sacred Hyrulean sites.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Surge
effectDetails.rules: After three uses, the wielder must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or take 1d6 psychic damage. The sword then requires an hour of meditation to reset.

effectDetails.title: Random Glitch
effectDetails.rules: Each hit triggers a random WarioWare glitch effect with a 2-in-6 chance of causing temporary enemy debuffs (e.g., invincibility, speed boost) or player buffs. The glitch persists for up to two turns.

hyrule_wario_cursed_sword.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest WarioWare Master can recognize and handle the blade's unpredictable nature.
hyrule_wario_cursed_sword.vendorReason: Hyrulean vendors are well-versed in dealing with cursed artifacts from various realms, including those from the twisted world of WarioWare.
hyrule_wario_cursed_sword.shippingDetail: The blade is carefully packed to prevent any accidental glitches during transit. Shipping time is extended by one extra day due to precautionary measures.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, glitch effects last up to two turns
usage.endsWhen: After three uses or if the wielder fails a saving throw against the Psychic Surge

hyrule_wario_cursed_sword.priceReason: The blade's legendary status and unique curse make it a rare commodity, justifying its moderate price.

ice_flower.name: Ice Flower
ice_flower.description: The Ice Flower is a crystalline blue blossom that never melts, even in scorching sun. Crafted from ancient frost veins deep within the arctic tundra, it grants its bearer cryokinetic abilities. With a mere thought, it can unleash a frigid Ray of Frost or summon an icy blade with the power of an Ice Knife spell (2nd level). Its touch brings resistance to cold damage, ensuring the wielder remains unscathed in frosty environs.

effectDetails.title: Ray of Frost
effectDetails.rules: Cast as an action. It deals 1d6 cold damage to a target creature within 5 feet, with a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw for half damage.

effectDetails.title: Ice Knife (2nd Level Spell)
effectDetails.rules: Summons an icy blade that strikes at a single target within 30 feet. The blade deals 2d6 cold damage on hit, with a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw for half damage.

ice_flower.levelRequirementReason: Requires less power to wield than the original due to balanced design and reduced effects.
ice_flower.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market specializes in exotic and unique items, including cold weather adaptations like this Ice Flower.
ice_flower.shippingDetail: Ships via the Frostbound Falcon, known for its efficiency through icy terrains.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Ray of Frost) / One Minute (Ice Knife)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use; recharges on a long rest

ice_flower.priceReason: Balanced for its effect and rarity, this Ice Flower provides cryokinetic abilities at an appropriate level.

ice_flower_seed.name: Ice Flower Seed
ice_flower_seed.description: The Ice Flower Seed is a shimmering crystalline seed that, when planted in cold soil, rapidly grows into a frost-spitting flower. Its leaves glisten with ice and its stem crackles with latent cold energy. Keep it away from warmth or fire; even the slightest heat can cause it to shatter into harmless shards of ice. This frosty bloom releases a 5-foot radius frost aura that impedes movement, turning the area into difficult terrain.

effectDetails.title: Frost Aura
effectDetails.rules: When planted and grown, the Ice Flower Seed releases a frost aura that lasts for its duration. Any creature within this area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be restrained until the end of their next turn due to slippery ice cover.

effectDetails.title: Cold Burst
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the Ice Flower shoots a burst of ice shards in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in this area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 cold damage and be knocked prone.

ice_flower_seed.levelRequirementReason: This seed is easy to plant and grow, requiring only basic knowledge of frost magic.
ice_flower_seed.vendorReason: Shamans frequently use such seeds for their frost spells and magical concoctions.
ice_flower_seed.shippingDetail: Delivered frozen to preserve the plant's icy properties. Requires special handling within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Reaction, activate when planting the seed in cold soil.
usage.duration: Instantaneous bloom and frost aura duration (5 rounds).
usage.endsWhen: The flower withers or is destroyed by heat.

ice_flower_seed.priceReason: Balanced to be a useful consumable for beginners, its price reflects the rarity and utility of frost magic.

ice_power_badge.name: Ice Power Badge
ice_power_badge.description: The Ice Power Badge is a cold, gleaming badge made of frost-hardened ice that shimmers with an icy blue light. This rune-encrusted trinket is said to have been crafted by ancient arctic shamans who sought to harness the power of winter's chill. Wield it in battle and your melee attacks become icy blasts, dealing Cold damage instead of physical damage, making you a frosty nightmare for fire-elemental foes.

effectDetails.title: Cold Damage Dealt
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with this badge, it deals Cold damage instead of the weapon's normal damage type. This effect has no range or area and does not require a saving throw. You can use this ability once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Frost Attacks
effectDetails.rules: Against fire-based creatures, your melee attacks deal an additional +1 damage. This enhancement lasts until the start of your next turn and cannot be used more than twice per long rest.

ice_power_badge.levelRequirementReason: The badge is crafted to be accessible for newer adventurers who have a basic understanding of combat.
ice_power_badge.vendorReason: Shamans at the hut often trade in magical trinkets that enhance elemental abilities, and this badge perfectly complements their offerings.
ice_power_badge.shippingDetail: Delivered by Cold Box Express; may arrive frosty and fragile. Handle with care during shipping to avoid damage.

usage.duration: Until start of next turn
usage.endsWhen: Starts of your next turn or when the badge is removed from you

ice_power_badge.priceReason: The Ice Power Badge is crafted with rare materials and ancient magic, making it a fair value for its unique elemental properties.

identification_service.name: Arcane Identification Service
identification_service.description: The Arcane Identification Service is a certified appraiser's meticulous examination, providing exact magical properties and curse details within 24 hours. This service ensures you receive an expert confirmation of rarity and approximate value, delivered with a detailed written certificate that can sway even the most skeptical patrons. The arcane institute guarantees its precision through centuries-old methods and a team of master sages who have never erred in their appraisals.

effectDetails.title: Expert Appraisal
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the service provides a detailed analysis of one magical item's properties, any enchantments, and potential curses. This effect is instantaneous and requires no saving throw or action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Certified Value
effectDetails.rules: The appraisal also includes an expert confirmation of the rarity and approximate value of the identified item. This assessment is considered final for all trading purposes within the local market, and it can be used as a reference in future negotiations or disputes.

identification_service.levelRequirementReason: Anyone interested in magical items must have at least a basic understanding of their properties.
identification_service.vendorReason: The arcane institute is renowned for its precision and reliability, ensuring that all appraisals are accurate and trustworthy.
identification_service.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Courier of Secrets, known for their punctuality and discretion. The service includes a tracking number for easy verification.

usage.activation: A simple verbal command to request the identification process.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The appraisal is completed or if the item's magical properties change.

identification_service.priceReason: This service is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its expert precision and the time invested in each appraisal.

immortality_binding.name: Immortality Binding (Phylactery Service)
immortality_binding.description: The Immortality Binding is a phylactery crafted from the bones of an ancient dragon. This relic ensures eternal life, but at the cost of your soul's freedom and the risk of being torn apart by cosmic entities if discovered. Once bound, you cannot die permanently; resurrection within 1d6 days restores your body to health, but each revival brings a level of exhaustion that only full rest can cure. The phylactery must remain hidden deep in the crypts; should it be found and destroyed, your soul perishes with it.

effectDetails.title: Eternal Life
effectDetails.rules: By binding your soul to the phylactery, you achieve functional immortality. If reduced to 0 HP and the phylactery is within reach, you are resurrected in 1d6 days at a nearby location of your choice. Each resurrection grants you one level of exhaustion that is removed only by completing a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Exhaustion on Resurrection
effectDetails.rules: Each time you are resurrected using the phylactery, you gain 1 level of exhaustion. This condition persists until you complete a long rest. A paladin or necromancer within 30 feet may use an action to attempt to destroy your phylactery with a successful DC 25 Con saving throw.

immortality_binding.levelRequirementReason: Only those of sufficient power and commitment can afford the risks and responsibilities associated with immortality.
immortality_binding.vendorReason: The crypt courier specializes in delivering forbidden relics and has a network deep within ancient tombs where such items are kept safe.
immortality_binding.shippingDetail: Shipped through an ancient ritual that requires the delivery to be conducted by night, ensuring secrecy and protection from prying eyes.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation occurs when you are reduced to 0 HP and the phylactery is within reach.
usage.duration: Instantaneous upon death
usage.endsWhen: Phylactery destroyed or your soul perishes if discovered
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use brings exhaustion

immortality_binding.priceReason: The cost reflects the immense power and risk involved in achieving functional immortality.

inevitable_justice_protocol.name: Inevitable Justice Protocol
inevitable_justice_protocol.description: The Inevitable Justice Protocol is a leather-bound contract, etched with arcane symbols and runes of cosmic law. When invoked, it summons a Marut guardian from the Inevitable Tribunal to enforce its terms, ensuring that no violation goes unpunished. The Marut's presence alone can deter even the most brazen criminals, but should any oath be broken, the Protocol activates an ancient mechanism that executes the offender instantly and without mercy.

effectDetails.title: Summons a Marut Guardian
effectDetails.rules: Requires an action to activate. The Protocol summons a Marut guardian from the Inevitable Tribunal, which enforces the contract's terms. Once summoned, the Marut remains until dismissed or the contract is fulfilled. The Marut can take one action and one reaction per turn. The summoning effect has no save DC but requires a level 18 character to activate.

effectDetails.title: Instant Execution for Violations
effectDetails.rules: If any term of the contract is violated, the Protocol immediately activates an ancient mechanism that executes the violator instantaneously. This effect has no save DC and can only be used once per Protocol.

inevitable_justice_protocol.levelRequirementReason: Only characters of level 18 or higher possess the gravitas and authority to invoke such a powerful artifact.
inevitable_justice_protocol.vendorReason: The Cosmic Court upholds cosmic law and thus is the only entity trusted with selling this Protocol.
inevitable_justice_protocol.shippingDetail: Ships via Lawful Manifestation, ensuring swift delivery to a level 18 or higher character.

usage.duration: Instantaneous summoning; the Marut guardian remains until dismissed or contract fulfilled.
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed by the Protocol's owner or when the contract is fulfilled.

inevitable_justice_protocol.priceReason: The Protocol's rarity and unique ability to summon a Marut guardian, combined with its limited single-use nature, justify this balanced price.

infernal_contract_binder.name: Infernal Contract Binder (Legal)
infernal_contract_binder.description: The Infernal Contract Binder (Legal) is a leather-bound tome with intricate Baatezu sigils etched into its cover. This artifact enforces devilish pacts with unyielding infernal law, ensuring that any breach of contract results in dire consequences. Carrying the weighty burden of this tome grants you a +20 bonus to Persuasion checks when dealing with infernal entities or signing binding contracts. Made by skilled Baatezu scribes, it is a testament to hell's meticulous craftsmanship.

effectDetails.title: Unbreakable Pacts
effectDetails.rules: When you sign a contract with an infernal entity using this binder, the pact is enforced by unyielding infernal law. Any breach of the contract results in immediate and severe repercussions for both parties involved. This effect has no save DC but requires that the contract be signed within 10 feet of the tome.

effectDetails.title: Infernal Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: While holding this binder, you gain a +20 bonus to Persuasion checks when dealing with infernal entities or signing binding contracts. This benefit lasts for 1 hour per level and can be activated as a bonus action.

infernal_contract_binder.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least level 17 due to its potent infernal magic and the complexity of its construction.
infernal_contract_binder.vendorReason: The Hellfire Court is renowned for its dealings with infernal entities, making it a fitting vendor for this artifact.
infernal_contract_binder.shippingDetail: The Imp Messenger ensures swift and discreet delivery of the Infernal Contract Binder (Legal), guaranteeing that the item reaches its intended recipient without attracting unwanted attention.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Persuasion bonus; Instantaneous for pact enforcement
usage.duration: 1 hour per level, until a breach occurs or the contract is completed
usage.endsWhen: The contract is breached, completed, or you release your hold on the binder

infernal_contract_binder.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity and its unique infernal enchantments.
