isle_delfino_feywild_fabric.levelRequirementReason: Wearing this fabric requires a certain finesse and magical attunement that only those of at least third level can achieve.
isle_delfino_feywild_fabric.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, known for its connection to the Feywild, regularly trades in enchanted items from the realm's magic.
isle_delfino_feywild_fabric.shippingDetail: The fabric arrives wrapped in a shimmering mist, ensuring it remains enchanted during transport.

usage.activation: Bonus action for phasing through objects; passive effect while worn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous phasing attempt; continuous evasion bonus.
usage.endsWhen: Wearing the fabric ends when removed or destroyed; phasing attempts end at the start of your next turn.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one phasing attempt per round.

isle_delfino_feywild_fabric.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the rare material and enchantment required to craft such a versatile and magical fabric.

isle_delfino_feywild_fan.name: Feywild Fan of Whispering Leaves
isle_delfino_feywild_fan.description: The Feywild Fan of Whispering Leaves is a delicate fan woven from translucent, iridescent leaves that hum softly, their song echoing the whispers of the fey realm. When wielded, it grants the user stealth for 15 seconds and temporary evasion against magical detection, making them nearly invisible to the eyes of magic. The fan's leaves pulse with a faint glow, enhancing nature spells cast by the bearer, amplifying their potency in harmony with the Feywild’s magic.

effectDetails.title: Stealth
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 15 seconds. This effect ends if the user attacks or casts a spell.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Against Magical Detection
effectDetails.rules: For the duration, you have resistance to being detected by magical means of detection and scrying. This effect expires upon taking damage or ending your turn without moving 30 feet.

isle_delfino_feywild_fan.levelRequirementReason: The fan’s magic is subtle but potent, requiring only a basic understanding of the Feywild to wield it effectively.
isle_delfino_feywild_fan.vendorReason: As keepers of arcane knowledge and travelers of the Feywild, Isle Delfino's vendors are well-acquainted with such enchanted artifacts.
isle_delfino_feywild_fan.shippingDetail: The fan is delivered by Boo Spectral Mail, known for its reliable service through even the most ethereal realms.

usage.activation: Use as a bonus action to activate the stealth and evasion effects.
usage.duration: 15 seconds per activation.
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage or ending your turn without moving at least 30 feet.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

isle_delfino_feywild_fan.priceReason: The fan’s rarity and the unique combination of its stealth and magical evasion abilities justify this balanced price in XP.

isle_delfino_feywild_fizz.name: Feywild Fizz
isle_delfino_feywild_fizz.description: Feywild Fizz is a shimmering, citrus-scented soda that dances with light in your hand. As you take a sip while surrounded by fey creatures, it energizes your spirit and heightens your agility. The refreshing bubbles grant +15% movement speed within the Feywild for 1 hour, making every step feel like a dance with nature. Should an attack come from a fey creature, there's a +10% chance to dodge it.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Agility
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the drink grants a +15% increase to movement speed within the Feywild for 1 hour. This effect does not stack with other similar abilities and ends if you leave the Feywild.

effectDetails.title: Fey Dodge
effectDetails.rules: While imbued by the soda's effects, there is a +10% chance to successfully dodge attacks from fey creatures. This benefit lasts for 1 hour or until your next long rest.

isle_delfino_feywild_fizz.levelRequirementReason: The soda's magic is mild enough that any adventurer can partake in its refreshing effects.
isle_delfino_feywild_fizz.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in exotic beverages and has the resources to import and sell this unique soda from the Feywild.
isle_delfino_feywild_fizz.shippingDetail: The soda is shipped via a secretive route, ensuring it retains its magical properties until delivery.

usage.activation: Consume one sip of the soda while in the Feywild to activate the effects.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until your next long rest
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the Feywild or taking a long rest, whichever occurs first.
usage.charges: Unlimited; each sip uses one charge.

isle_delfino_feywild_fizz.priceReason: The soda is rare and imported from the Feywild, balancing its effects with a price that reflects its mystical value.

isle_delfino_feywild_flicker_shirt.name: Feywild Flicker Shirt
isle_delfino_feywild_flicker_shirt.description: The Feywild Flicker Shirt, a shimmering garment woven from the very fabric of the Feywild, allows its wearer to briefly vanish and reappear within a nearby zone of magical essence. The shirt's fabric hums with otherworldly light as it transports the user in a flash, leaving behind a faint, glowing trail that reveals hidden paths for allies. Worn by those who navigate between worlds, this artifact is both a symbol and tool of Feywild magic.

effectDetails.title: Teleportation to Nearby Feywild Zones
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can teleport up to 10 meters to the nearest accessible Feywild zone. This effect is visible only to allies and lasts for 2 seconds. The user must be able to see a Feywild portal within range. The duration of the teleportation ends when the destination is reached or if the user takes any action other than movement.

effectDetails.title: Allied Pathfinding Trail
effectDetails.rules: For 2 seconds after using the shirt, the path taken by the teleportation leaves behind a glowing trail that reveals hidden paths and secret doors within the Feywild zone. This effect is only visible to allies and ends when the duration expires or if the user takes any action other than movement.

isle_delfino_feywild_flicker_shirt.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 7 to master the delicate magic of the shirt.
isle_delfino_feywild_flicker_shirt.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, a hub for travelers and adventurers, regularly stocks rare Feywild artifacts like this shirt.
isle_delfino_feywild_flicker_shirt.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express, ensuring safe delivery even to the most remote Feywild zones.

usage.duration: Instantaneous teleportation; trail lasts for 2 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Destination is reached or if the user takes any action other than movement

isle_delfino_feywild_flicker_shirt.priceReason: The shirt's rarity and magical properties justify a price of 1,000 XP.

isle_delfino_feywild_pearl.name: Feywild Pearl
isle_delfino_feywild_pearl.description: The Feywild Pearl glows with an ethereal light, its surface shimmering like the depths of a forgotten forest pool. Crafted from the very essence of the Feywild's hidden groves, it harmonizes with nature and can summon gentle illusions that mimic the whispers of ancient trees. This glowing orb is said to amplify one’s connection to the natural world, granting an almost supernatural accuracy when fighting magical foes and enhancing the potency of enchantments by 20%.

effectDetails.title: Nature's Harmony
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Feywild Pearl can be worn to grant +20% accuracy against magical foes. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Enchantment Amplifier
effectDetails.rules: When used in crafting, this rare pearl increases the duration of enchantments by 20%, allowing for more potent and enduring creations.

isle_delfino_feywild_pearl.levelRequirementReason: Crafting with such a powerful and rare item requires a level of mastery that only those who have proven their skills in magic can achieve.
isle_delfino_feywild_pearl.vendorReason: The denizens of Isle Delfino, known for their connection to nature, are the most trusted source for items that harmonize with the natural world.
isle_delfino_feywild_pearl.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring even the most delicate of artifacts arrive in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus Action to wear and gain Nature's Harmony; Crafting use is instantaneous.
usage.duration: Until end of next turn for Nature's Harmony; Enchantment Amplifier applies immediately to all enchantments used.
usage.endsWhen: Removal or cessation of wearing for Nature's Harmony; Completion of the crafting process for Enchantment Amplifier.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by the number of enchantment uses.

isle_delfino_feywild_pearl.priceReason: The Feywild Pearl is rare and powerful, balancing its cost with a level requirement that ensures only those who truly need it can afford it.

isle_delfino_feywild_scent.name: Feywild Scent of the Whispering Grove
isle_delfino_feywild_scent.description: The Feywild Scent of the Whispering Grove is a delicate essence that wafts like a mist through the forest, drawing rare and elusive Feywild creatures to your side. Inhaling its fragrance momentarily cloaks you in an ethereal veil, granting you stealth for 15 seconds. When combined with the grove’s magic, it increases your chance of encountering these otherworldly beings by 50%, making them more likely to approach rather than flee.

effectDetails.title: Increased Feywild Encounters
effectDetails.rules: Increases the chance of encountering Feywild creatures by 50% for 3 minutes. This effect ends when you leave the Feywild region or if a creature successfully saves against this with a DC of 12.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Aura
effectDetails.rules: Grants you invisibility and silent movement within the Feywild for 15 seconds upon activation. Ends early if you attack, cast a spell, or are damaged; no more than once per long rest.

isle_delfino_feywild_scent.levelRequirementReason: This essence is accessible to players of all levels who wish to explore the Feywild.
isle_delfino_feywild_scent.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, known for its connection with the Feywild, provides this rare reagent to adventurers seeking to traverse and interact with these magical creatures.
isle_delfino_feywild_scent.shippingDetail: Ships via a swift Rakasha spirit courier who delivers the essence directly from the heart of the Whispering Grove.

usage.activation: A free action upon entering or exiting the Feywild region.
usage.duration: 15 seconds for stealth, 3 minutes for increased encounter chance; both effects end early under certain conditions.
usage.endsWhen: Stealth ends if you attack, cast a spell, or are damaged. Encounters increase for only one long rest per day.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only once per long rest.

isle_delfino_feywild_scent.priceReason: The essence is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and the magic required to craft it from the heart of the Feywild.

isle_delfino_feywild_scented_satchel.name: Feywild Scented Satchel
isle_delfino_feywild_scented_satchel.description: Woven from the dreams of drowsy sprites, this satchel is a delicate basket crafted from ethereal threads and enchanted with the essence of Feywild flora. It leaves behind a lingering scent that attracts hidden treasures and mischievous spirits, making it an invaluable companion for scavengers and collectors venturing into unexplored zones. The satchel's magic not only enhances one’s stealth but also subtly draws attention to secret caches waiting to be discovered.
effects: +10% chance to find hidden loot when entering unexplored zones

effectDetails.title: Hidden Treasure Attraction
effectDetails.rules: When entering an unexplored zone, the user has a +10% chance to discover hidden treasures or artifacts that are not immediately visible.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth in Feywild
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 24 hours after using the satchel. This effect can be used once per long rest.

isle_delfino_feywild_scented_satchel.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet enchanted item is accessible to adventurers of all levels, making it a valuable tool for beginners and veterans alike.
isle_delfino_feywild_scented_satchel.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in items that enhance one's journey through the Feywild, ensuring their patrons have the tools needed to thrive in such magical realms.
isle_delfino_feywild_scented_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships swiftly via Pipe Express, usually within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect when entering unexplored zones; active use once per long rest for stealth bonus
usage.duration: 24 hours or until used again
usage.endsWhen: After one long rest or upon discovery of hidden treasure, whichever comes first

isle_delfino_feywild_scented_satchel.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's enchantments and utility without being overpowered.

isle_delfino_frosted_mirage_rod.name: Frosted Mirage Rod
isle_delfino_frosted_mirage_rod.description: The Frosted Mirage Rod is a delicate crystalline rod etched with arcane runes, shimmering with an otherworldly frost that dances in its grip. Crafted from the frozen tears of ancient ice giants, this relic warps reality to reflect and block attacks. When swung, it conjures temporary mirrors that distort incoming harm, casting enemies into mirages that fade after moments. This rod is a perfect companion for adventurers venturing through treacherous lands where shadows and light play tricks on the senses.

effectDetails.title: Reflects Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action to swing the rod, it creates a temporary mirror that reflects one melee or ranged attack made against you. The target of the attack must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 13) or be redirected to another location within 5 feet. This effect lasts for 3 seconds and can only be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Warps Reality
effectDetails.rules: While the rod is active, it distorts your surroundings in a way that blocks line-of-sight for enemies within 10 feet of you. This effect grants you advantage on saving throws against being blinded or having your vision obscured by magical effects until the start of your next turn.

isle_delfino_frosted_mirage_rod.levelRequirementReason: This rod requires a minimum level to wield due to its arcane power and the complex magic imbued within it.
isle_delfino_frosted_mirage_rod.vendorReason: As a renowned outpost for mystical artifacts, Isle Delfino is known for its vast selection of enchantments, including this rare relic.
isle_delfino_frosted_mirage_rod.shippingDetail: The rod arrives in pristine condition, delivered via Lakitu Drones' speediest courier service, ensuring it reaches you swiftly and intact.

usage.duration: 3 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: After being used or when the start of your next turn arrives

isle_delfino_frosted_mirage_rod.priceReason: The Frosted Mirage Rod's price reflects its rare crafting materials and potent magical properties, making it a sought-after tool for adventurers.

isle_delfino_glitter_bottle.name: Glitter Bottle
isle_delfino_glitter_bottle.description: The Glitter Bottle is a shimmering glass vessel containing iridescent particles that glisten like the sea at dawn. When unleashed, it blinds foes and enhances the wielder's strikes, making every attack feel as if they are cloaked in the magic of Isle Delfino itself. This bottle not only dazzles but also grants temporary prowess to its bearer, a relic crafted from the sands of the coastal shores where legend and reality intertwine.

effectDetails.title: Dazzling Glare
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this bottle emits a dazzling light that blinds all enemies within 10 feet, causing them to miss their next two attacks. This effect lasts for 2 turns and has no save DC.

effectDetails.title: Shining Strike
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 2 turns after activation, the wielder's attack rolls are increased by +20%. There is a 15% chance to dodge any incoming attacks during this time. This effect ends when used or if the user drops the bottle.

isle_delfino_glitter_bottle.levelRequirementReason: The Glitter Bottle requires a minimum level of 3 due to its complexity and the skill needed to handle such an artifact.
isle_delfino_glitter_bottle.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, known for its magical curiosities, is the only vendor capable of offering this unique item.
isle_delfino_glitter_bottle.shippingDetail: This bottle ships via a custom, enchanted delivery method that ensures it arrives in perfect condition, even over long distances.

usage.duration: 2 turns
usage.endsWhen: Used or dropped by the user

isle_delfino_glitter_bottle.priceReason: The Glitter Bottle is moderately priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the magical energy it contains.

isle_delfino_glowing_coral_rod.name: Glowing Coral Rod
isle_delfino_glowing_coral_rod.description: The Glowing Coral Rod hums with the life force of the deep, its coral glow pulsating in time with the tides. Crafted from the bones of ancient sea creatures and bound by the magic of Isle Delfino, this rod can summon aquatic allies or unleash explosive bursts that shatter the waters' surface. It's a tool of both harmony and destruction, but only those who understand its balance may wield it.

effectDetails.title: Summon Aquatic Allies
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can summon a small school of fish or a minor aquatic creature for up to 1 minute. The summoned creatures are under your control and obey your commands until dismissed. If you fail a DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check due to the summoned creatures' actions, they may break free after 1d4 turns.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Coral Burst
effectDetails.rules: As an action, unleash a burst of energy from the rod that deals 2d6 force damage in a 30-foot radius centered on you. You can use this ability once per long rest and must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw after each use to avoid suffering 1d4 temporary hit points of nonlethal damage.

isle_delfino_glowing_coral_rod.levelRequirementReason: Requires the user to have a strong understanding of aquatic magic and the balance between nature and destruction.
isle_delfino_glowing_coral_rod.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in items that harmonize with the ocean, making it natural for them to stock this magical fishing rod.
isle_delfino_glowing_coral_rod.shippingDetail: Delivered by a Rakasha courier who ensures the rod's magic remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous summoning; explosive burst lasts until used or dismissed
usage.endsWhen: Summons end if you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), and the explosive burst ends immediately upon being used. The rod can only be used once per long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one summoning and one explosive burst per long rest.

isle_delfino_glowing_coral_rod.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as a rare item with significant utility in both combat and exploration scenarios.

isle_delfino_glowing_gear.name: Glowing Gear of the Delfino Dunes
isle_delfino_glowing_gear.description: The Glowing Gear of the Delfino Dunes is a set of enchanted armor that radiates the vibrant heat and light of the tropical sun, casting an inviting glow upon the wearer. Crafted from the sands of the Delfino Dunes, it grants enhanced defense with a 30% bonus to AC, and its warm aura attracts Shine Sprites for buffs, enhancing combat prowess. This armor is perfect for explorers and combatants who seek the balance of resilience and natural magic in their gear.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Defense
effectDetails.rules: The Glowing Gear provides a +3 bonus to AC, which is active as long as the wearer remains in the Delfino Dunes. This effect ends if the wearer leaves the dunes for more than one hour.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Buffs
effectDetails.rules: For every minute the Glowing Gear is worn within the Delfino Dunes, a Shine Sprite appears and grants a +1 bonus to attack rolls or damage rolls. This effect ends if the wearer's AC drops below 18.

isle_delfino_glowing_gear.levelRequirementReason: The armor requires at least 5th level to ensure that the user can effectively utilize its defensive and buffs.
isle_delfino_glowing_gear.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for crafting gear in harmony with nature, making this enchanted set a perfect product of their expertise.
isle_delfino_glowing_gear.shippingDetail: Pipe Express offers expedited delivery within the Delfino region, ensuring that adventurers receive their Glowing Gear swiftly and intact.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the gear while in the Delfino Dunes.
usage.duration: Active as long as the wearer remains within the Delfino Dunes.
usage.endsWhen: If the wearer leaves the Delfino Dunes for more than one hour or if their AC drops below 18 due to damage.

isle_delfino_glowing_gear.priceReason: The Glowing Gear of the Delfino Dunes is priced at 3800 XP, reflecting its rarity and the unique enchantments that make it a valuable asset for adventurers.

isle_delfino_glowing_glider.name: Glowing Glider
isle_delfino_glowing_glider.description: The Glowing Glider is a sleek, bioluminescent winged device crafted from the glowing flora of Delfino Isle. Its wings emit a soft, ethereal light that illuminates darkened jungle paths and hidden ruins. This glider allows for swift aerial travel over dense foliage and water, making it invaluable in navigating the island’s treacherous jungles. With each flap, you can soar up to 50 feet higher than usual, perfect for escaping traps or scouting ahead.
effects: Flies at 30% Speed Over Water and Jungle Terrain

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Leaping
effectDetails.rules: When you use a running start, you can jump up to an additional 50 feet. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Jungle Glide
effectDetails.rules: While flying over jungle terrain or water, your movement speed is reduced by only 30%, allowing for efficient travel through dense foliage and across rivers.

isle_delfino_glowing_glider.levelRequirementReason: This glider is designed to be used by adventurers at the beginning of their journey.
isle_delfino_glowing_glider.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in crafting items that enhance exploration and survival on its lush, treacherous island terrain.
isle_delfino_glowing_glider.shippingDetail: The glider is delivered with a detailed assembly kit, ensuring it’s ready to use upon arrival.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action to activate the enhanced jump and jungle glide abilities.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts until the start of your next turn unless interrupted.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you make a running start, are no longer in jungle terrain or water, or use another action that requires movement.

isle_delfino_glowing_glider.priceReason: This glider is crafted from rare bioluminescent flora and designed for quick, efficient travel through challenging terrains.

isle_delfino_glowing_grape.name: Glowing Grape
isle_delfino_glowing_grape.description: The Glowling Grape, a radiant fruit plucked from the treacherous shores of Isle Delfino, glows softly in your palm, its surface shimmering with an ethereal light. This sweet and magical treat not only restores health but also grants a temporary boost to charisma, perfect for charming foes or rallying allies. The fruit's origin is as mysterious as it is beneficial, said to have been cultivated by the enigmatic Delfinian elves in their hidden gardens. Its glow intensifies when consumed, releasing a delightful sparkle that dances around you like a spark of hope in dark times.

effectDetails.title: Health Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Glowling Grape restores an additional 25% of your maximum hit points. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the next 10 seconds, you gain a +15 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks and saving throws. The boost ends if you make an attack roll or cast a spell that requires concentration.

isle_delfino_glowing_grape.levelRequirementReason: This fruit is accessible to all adventurers who might need its health-restoring properties, making it a versatile tool for anyone starting their journey.
isle_delfino_glowing_grape.vendorReason: Isle Delfino's market is known for offering exotic and magical goods that are hard to find elsewhere, ensuring the Glowling Grape finds a place among their wares.
isle_delfino_glowing_grape.shippingDetail: The fruit must be consumed within one hour of receiving it; any delay risks its magical properties fading away.

usage.duration: 10 seconds for Charisma boost, instantaneous for health restoration
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if an attack or spell requiring concentration is cast

isle_delfino_glowing_grape.priceReason: Balanced at this price point to reflect its uncommon rarity and the magical benefits it provides without overshadowing more powerful items.

isle_delfino_glowroot_staff.name: Glowroot Staff of the Shine Sprite
isle_delfino_glowroot_staff.description: The Glowroot Staff of the Shine Sprite is a staff crafted from the luminescent roots of tropical sprites, forged in the heart of Delfino Isle's sunlit groves. Its branches glow softly under sunlight, casting a warm, ethereal light that enhances one’s magical resistance and elemental damage output. While bathed in the island’s golden rays, the user regenerates health at an accelerated rate, bolstering their vitality in both battle and rest.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Boost
effectDetails.rules: While in a sunlit area with direct sunlight, this staff grants the wielder +25% elemental damage. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Magic Resistance Amplification
effectDetails.rules: +15% magic resistance is active while within a sunlit environment. This increases the user's ability to resist magical attacks, but only when exposed to sunlight.

isle_delfino_glowroot_staff.levelRequirementReason: The staff requires significant focus and experience to wield its light-enhanced effects effectively.
isle_delfino_glowroot_staff.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its connection to nature, making it a natural home for such an enchanted staff.
isle_delfino_glowroot_staff.shippingDetail: The staff's branches are fragile and require special handling. Pipe Express ensures safe delivery by using padded packaging.

usage.activation: Passive effect while in sunlight; no activation required.
usage.duration: Permanent until moved out of a sunlit area or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The staff is taken out of a sunlit environment, or it breaks.

isle_delfino_glowroot_staff.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the staff's unique properties and the time and materials required for its crafting.

isle_delfino_ink_squid_satchel.name: Ink Squid Satchel
isle_delfino_ink_squid_satchel.description: The Ink Squid Satchel is a leather pouch sewn from the discarded skin of an ancient, battle-scarred ink squid. It holds not just ink but also the lore and history of Delfino City's legendary squid wars. When opened in Inkopolis, it releases a cloud of ink that mists the area, restoring 100 hit points to all nearby allies and temporarily blinding enemies in bright light for one round.

effectDetails.title: HP Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When opened within Inkopolis, the satchel releases a cloud of ink that restores 100 hit points to all allies in a 30-foot radius. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Blindness
effectDetails.rules: Enemies caught in bright light within the area of effect must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become blinded for one round. The satchel can only cause this effect once per day.

isle_delfino_ink_squid_satchel.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginning adventurers who are just starting to explore the mysteries of Delfino City.
isle_delfino_ink_squid_satchel.vendorReason: As a local vendor, Isle Delfino can provide items that are relevant and useful to the city's history and culture.
isle_delfino_ink_squid_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via express courier within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Use an action to open and release the ink cloud in Inkopolis.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for HP restoration, one round for blindness effect.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or the satchel is used again.

isle_delfino_ink_squid_satchel.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity, utility in a key location (Inkopolis), and its multiple effects that are beneficial for adventurers.

isle_delfino_jellyfish_pearl.name: Jellyfish Pearl
isle_delfino_jellyfish_pearl.description: The Jellyfish Pearl, a bioluminescent gem harvested from the depths of the ocean by the Isle Delfino divers, pulses with an ethereal glow that mirrors the rhythm of the waves. This enchanted pearl not only heals minor wounds but also enhances agility, making the wearer more nimble and resilient in combat. The soothing aura it emits can be felt even before it touches its owner's skin, calming both body and spirit.

effectDetails.title: Soothing Aura
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +20% dodge chance. This effect is passive and remains active as long as the pearl is worn. The aura does not stack with other similar effects.

effectDetails.title: Restorative Glow
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns, you can restore 15% hit points (rounded down) and 10% stamina points. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

isle_delfino_jellyfish_pearl.levelRequirementReason: The pearl's inherent healing properties are accessible to all adventurers, making it a valuable item for every party.
isle_delfino_jellyfish_pearl.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its deep-sea expeditions and the unique treasures they bring back from the ocean floor.
isle_delfino_jellyfish_pearl.shippingDetail: The pearl is carefully packed in a waterproof container to ensure it arrives at your doorstep in pristine condition, even after long voyages through stormy seas.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required. The pearl's glow and effects are always active once worn.
usage.duration: Permanent while the pearl is worn
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or removed from the wearer

isle_delfino_jellyfish_pearl.priceReason: The Jellyfish Pearl's rarity and unique combination of healing and agility-enhancing effects make it a fair price for adventurers seeking to bolster their party.

isle_delfino_koopa_gold_coin.name: Koopa Gold Coin
isle_delfino_koopa_gold_coin.description: The Koopa Gold Coin is a relic from the tumultuous times of the Koopa banking collapse. Crafted by the rakasha clans, this coin harbors an ancient rune that reacts to market trends, shifting its value based on current economic conditions within Koopa banking zones. Its hidden rune ensures it retains its worth only when used in these specific regions; outside their bounds, it loses its luster and becomes a mere token of the past. This coin can be exchanged for alternate currencies or trade for rare artifacts, adding a touch of intrigue to every transaction.

effectDetails.title: Market Value Shift
effectDetails.rules: When used within Koopa banking zones, the coin's value increases by 20% for all purchases made at Isle Delfino. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Alternate Currency Exchange
effectDetails.rules: This coin can be exchanged for rare artifacts or alternate currencies at a 1:1 ratio, but only within Koopa banking zones. It must be handled by a Rakasha Clan member to ensure authenticity and validity of the exchange.

isle_delfino_koopa_gold_coin.levelRequirementReason: Basic familiarity with Koopa banking systems is necessary to understand how this coin's value fluctuates.
isle_delfino_koopa_gold_coin.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, a hub for Koopa banking and trade, naturally stocks items of such economic significance.
isle_delfino_koopa_gold_coin.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express within Koopa banking zones; delivery is swift but requires the coin to be handled by Rakasha Clan members upon arrival.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when used in a purchase or exchange.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if not used within Koopa banking zones or if the coin is removed from its designated use area.

isle_delfino_koopa_gold_coin.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the item's rarity and economic importance in Koopa banking zones.

isle_delfino_lightning_cape.name: Lightning Cape of the Shining Isle
isle_delfino_lightning_cape.description: The Lightning Cape of the Shining Isle is a shimmering garment woven from the lightning-sparked threads of Delfino Isle's skies. This electrically charged cape not only enhances its wearer with a dazzling aura but also grants them a dance of tropical thunder that can disrupt foes and increase their attack speed by 20%. When struck, it has a 10% chance to unleash 'Lightning Flash,' delivering an additional 150% damage in a burst.

effectDetails.title: Lightning Flash
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is attacked, there's a 10% chance that 'Lightning Flash' triggers. This effect deals an additional 150% damage to the attacker in a burst centered on the point of contact.

effectDetails.title: Disrupts Enemy Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For three turns after activation, enemies within 10 feet suffer from a 25% reduction in resistance, making their defenses less effective against attacks.

isle_delfino_lightning_cape.levelRequirementReason: This cape's electrical properties and ability to disrupt enemy defenses make it suitable for high-level adventurers who can handle its power.
isle_delfino_lightning_cape.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is known for its mastery of electric storms, making the Lightning Cape a natural addition to their inventory.
isle_delfino_lightning_cape.shippingDetail: Delivered by Lakitu Drones, this cape arrives with a flash of lightning and a gust of wind, ensuring it reaches its destination in one piece.

usage.activation: Activates as a reaction when attacked.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; 'Lightning Flash' ends after the attack.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is no longer attacked or the duration expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges upon being removed from combat.

isle_delfino_lightning_cape.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the cape's unique electrical properties and its ability to disrupt enemy defenses.

isle_delfino_lullaby_amulet.name: Lullaby Amulet of the Whispering Tide
isle_delfino_lullaby_amulet.description: The Lullaby Amulet of the Whispering Tide is a shimmering, sea-green amulet adorned with silver waves and pearls. When worn, it emits a soothing melody that calms nearby enemies, reducing their attack speed by 10% for 20 seconds. Allies within 15 feet also gain a +2 bonus to AC and an increase in their attack speed by 10%. The amulet's melodies are said to be the whispers of the Delfino merfolk, who crafted it from seashells and enchanted pearls.
effects: Increases ally attack speed and defense

effectDetails.title: Melodic Calm
effectDetails.rules: When a creature within 15 feet of the wearer is an enemy, their attack speed is reduced by 10% for 20 seconds. This effect ends if the amulet is removed or if the target moves more than 30 feet away.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Shield
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 15 feet of the wearer gain a +2 bonus to AC and their attack speed increases by 10%. This effect lasts until the start of the wearer's next turn, or if they move more than 30 feet away from an ally.

isle_delfino_lullaby_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires a minimum level to harness its melodic power and maintain balance with the wearer’s abilities.
isle_delfino_lullaby_amulet.vendorReason: Only Isle Delfino, known for their connection with sea magic, offers this enchanted amulet.
isle_delfino_lullaby_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is carefully packed in a waterproof, enchanted box to ensure it arrives at its destination unharmed.

usage.duration: Lasts until the start of the wearer's next turn or ends if moved more than 30 feet away from an ally/enemy within range.
usage.endsWhen: Removed, or target moves more than 30 feet away

isle_delfino_lullaby_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's enchantments and the merfolk’s craftsmanship justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

isle_delfino_lullaby_chime.name: Lullaby Chime
isle_delfino_lullaby_chime.description: The Lullaby Chime, crafted from the sacred wood of the ancient Delfino groves, emits a haunting melody that soothes even the most ferocious foes. Its sound can be heard for miles and has a calming effect on creatures within earshot, reducing their attack speed by 20% for 10 seconds. The chime's music also grants you a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws for 5 minutes after activation. Ideal for stealth missions or when you need to distract enemies during an ambush.

effectDetails.title: Soothing Sound
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Lullaby Chime emits a calming melody that reduces all creatures within 10 meters of you by 20% attack speed for 10 seconds. This effect ends if you move more than 5 meters away from the center point or if an enemy within range makes an attack.

effectDetails.title: Dexterity Boost
effectDetails.rules: After activating the Lullaby Chime, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws for 5 minutes. This effect ends when it expires or if you use your action on another task.

isle_delfino_lullaby_chime.levelRequirementReason: The Lullaby Chime is accessible early in the campaign to aid newer adventurers who could benefit from its calming and supportive effects.
isle_delfino_lullaby_chime.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in crafting items that resonate with their natural environment, making it a fitting place for such an artifact.
isle_delfino_lullaby_chime.shippingDetail: The chime is carefully packed and shipped within two days of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, reaction to end the effect if you move more than 5 meters away from the center point or an enemy makes an attack.
usage.duration: 10 seconds for 'Soothing Sound', 5 minutes for 'Dexterity Boost'
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon activation of another bonus action, moving further than 5 meters, or when a creature within range attacks

isle_delfino_lullaby_chime.priceReason: The Lullaby Chime's price reflects its craftsmanship and the magical properties that make it invaluable for stealth and support in early campaigns.

isle_delfino_lumina_bloom.name: Lumina Bloom
isle_delfino_lumina_bloom.description: The Lumina Bloom is a bioluminescent flower that pulses with the rhythm of the tides, casting an ethereal glow upon planting. This radiant bloom not only illuminates its surroundings but also subtly alters enemy behavior, making them more cautious and less aggressive. When planted during the Fractured Atrium event, it further stabilizes reality, reducing instability by 15%. Allies within a 3x3 area gain +10% critical hit chance for 5 turns.

effectDetails.title: Reflects Enemy Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When planted, the Lumina Bloom summons a temporary aura that reflects enemy attacks within a 3x3 area. This effect lasts for 1 minute and has no save DC or limits.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Critical Hit Chance
effectDetails.rules: Allies within a 3x3 area gain +10% critical hit chance for 5 turns. There is no save DC, but the effect can only be used once per long rest.

isle_delfino_lumina_bloom.levelRequirementReason: The Lumina Bloom's effects are universally beneficial and enhance teamwork without requiring high-level expertise.
isle_delfino_lumina_bloom.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its connection to the natural world, making it a fitting vendor for this enchanted bloom.
isle_delfino_lumina_bloom.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days with Koopa Postal's standard delivery service.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon planting during the event or at any time if not during the Fractured Atrium event.
usage.duration: 1 minute for reflecting attacks, 5 turns for enhanced critical hit chance.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires.

isle_delfino_lumina_bloom.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the Lumina Bloom offers a fair value given its utility and rarity during specific events.

isle_delfino_lumina_breeze_rod.name: Lumina Breeze Rod
isle_delfino_lumina_breeze_rod.description: The Lumina Breeze Rod is a slender, glowing staff that seems to dance in sync with the island’s gentle winds. Crafted from driftwood and enchanted with starlight, it grants +25% ranged attack power within wind zones, allowing you to weave through aerial skirmishes with ease. When you hit an opponent, there's a +15% chance for your weapon to bypass their defenses, thanks to the rod's ethereal winds.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Ranged Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When you make a ranged attack while within a wind zone, gain +25% to your attack roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Evasion in Wind Zones
effectDetails.rules: While within a wind zone, there is a +15% chance that you will dodge an enemy's melee or ranged attack on a hit against you. This evasion chance does not stack with other dodging abilities and only applies once per turn.

isle_delfino_lumina_breeze_rod.levelRequirementReason: The Lumina Breeze Rod requires level 3 to wield, as its enchantments are subtle yet powerful.
isle_delfino_lumina_breeze_rod.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its expertise in crafting items that enhance one's abilities with natural elements like wind and water.
isle_delfino_lumina_breeze_rod.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week of purchase, unless weather conditions delay the flight.

usage.duration: Instantaneous with each attack or evasion attempt in a wind zone.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per short rest.

isle_delfino_lumina_breeze_rod.priceReason: The Lumina Breeze Rod is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare enchantments and the materials required for its construction.

isle_delfino_lumina_flower.name: Lumina Flower Petal
isle_delfino_lumina_flower.description: The Lumina Flower Petal, a rare bioluminescent petal from the night-blooming flora of Isle Delfino, pulses with golden light that reveals hidden paths and secret passageways in pitch darkness. When activated, it grants its bearer a +5% stealth bonus for 10 seconds, allowing them to slip past foes unseen. The petals' light also enhances the user's accuracy, increasing their chance to hit by 10% during the first round after activation.

effectDetails.title: Stealth and Light
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this petal illuminates an area of 20 feet radius for 15 seconds. During this time, the user gains a +5% stealth bonus that lasts for 10 seconds after activation.

effectDetails.title: Accuracy Boost
effectDetails.rules: The user's first attack roll against a target made within the first round of illumination has advantage and increases their chance to hit by 10%. This effect does not stack with other bonuses to hit.

isle_delfino_lumina_flower.levelRequirementReason: This petal is accessible to lower-level adventurers who are familiar with Isle Delfino's flora.
isle_delfino_lumina_flower.vendorReason: The local herbalists of Isle Delfino harvest these petals and sell them to adventurers for their unique properties.
isle_delfino_lumina_flower.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of the Lumina Flower Petals, they are carefully packaged in enchanted paper that ensures safe delivery within a week.

usage.duration: 15 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use or when destroyed

isle_delfino_lumina_flower.priceReason: The rare and bioluminescent nature of the Lumina Flower Petal justifies its moderate price, offering both tactical advantages and visual appeal.

isle_delfino_lumina_flower_sword.name: Lumina Flower Sword
isle_delfino_lumina_flower_sword.description: The Lumina Flower Sword is a blade forged from the petals of the sun’s last bloom, its surface shimmering with gentle light that dances like fireflies in twilight. This celestial weapon not only deals +10% bonus damage to dark creatures but also emits a radiant flash upon each hit, blinding foes for 2 seconds and reducing their attack speed by half for the duration. Its glow never fades, even in the deepest shadows.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Flash
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a dark creature with this weapon, it triggers a radiant flash that blinds them for 2 seconds. This effect has a save DC of 15 to negate its blinding effects.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Attack Speed
effectDetails.rules: For every 20 damage points dealt by the Lumina Flower Sword against dark creatures, their attack speed is reduced by half for 2 seconds. This effect can only occur once per round and does not stack with itself.

isle_delfino_lumina_flower_sword.levelRequirementReason: The sword's celestial forging requires a wielder of at least 5th level to channel the sun’s power.
isle_delfino_lumina_flower_sword.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, known for its mystical artifacts and rare items, is the only vendor capable of sourcing such divine weaponry.
isle_delfino_lumina_flower_sword.shippingDetail: The sword is delivered via a Rakasha spirit courier, ensuring it arrives glowing with fresh luminescence.

usage.duration: Single use per attack
usage.endsWhen: Charges depleted or weapon destroyed

isle_delfino_lumina_flower_sword.priceReason: The sword's celestial forging and rare components make it a valuable asset, priced at 1000 XP.

isle_delfino_lumina_gear_set.name: Lumina Gear Set
isle_delfino_lumina_gear_set.description: The Lumina Gear Set is a rare ensemble forged from the iridescent shells of bioluminescent sea creatures. Its armor gleams with radiant light, providing a shimmering barrier that dances like ocean waves. This set not only grants you a +15% reduction in damage from all sources but also has a 10% chance to restore hit points to allies upon dealing damage. The set's glow is said to boost morale and make the wearer feel as though they are part of the reef itself, inspiring teamwork.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Shield
effectDetails.rules: The Lumina Gear Set provides a +15% reduction in damage from all sources. This effect is passive and lasts until the end of each day.

effectDetails.title: Healing Glow
effectDetails.rules: When you deal damage with an attack, there is a 10% chance that allies within 5 feet also heal for 1d4 hit points at the start of their next turn. This effect can trigger once per round.

isle_delfino_lumina_gear_set.levelRequirementReason: The Lumina Gear Set requires level 6 to ensure its power is balanced with the player's capabilities.
isle_delfino_lumina_gear_set.vendorReason: Isle Delfino has a deep connection to aquatic magic and thus offers gear inspired by the reef and its creatures.
isle_delfino_lumina_gear_set.shippingDetail: The drones deliver the Lumina Gear Set with a ceremonial splash of bioluminescent water, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Lasts until the end of each day.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted at the start of the next long rest.

isle_delfino_lumina_gear_set.priceReason: The Lumina Gear Set's rarity and enchantments justify a price of 1000 XP, reflecting its significant utility in combat.

isle_delfino_lumina_lullaby_chime.name: Lumina Lullaby Chime
isle_delfino_lumina_lullaby_chime.description: The Lumina Lullaby Chime, a delicate metal chime adorned with iridescent seashells from Delfino Isle, hums a melody that lulls enemies into a calm stupor and restores allies’ strength. When activated, it emits a soft, glowing light that bathes nearby comrades in its restorative power. This enchanted artifact instantly heals 30% of an ally's health while reducing the aggression of foes within a 15-foot radius for 6 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Heal Allies
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Restores 30% of an ally's hit points to all friendly targets within 15 feet, instantly. This effect ends if the chime is destroyed or if any target moves more than 10 feet away.

effectDetails.title: Reduce Aggression
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action and lasts for 6 seconds. Reduces the attack speed of all hostile creatures within 15 feet by 30%. This effect is ended if any creature within range makes an attack, cast a spell, or takes a hostile action.

isle_delfino_lumina_lullaby_chime.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for early-game exploration and combat, providing support to adventuring parties without requiring high-level proficiency.
isle_delfino_lumina_lullaby_chime.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in crafting and selling items that are imbued with the magic of its coastal waters and creatures.
isle_delfino_lumina_lullaby_chime.shippingDetail: Ships directly from Delfino Isle, arriving within a week. The Void Drifter is known for its punctuality and reliable service.

usage.duration: 6 seconds or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed, target moves more than 10 feet away, or any creature within range attacks

isle_delfino_lumina_lullaby_chime.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique enchantments justify its price of 1000 XP.

isle_delfino_lumina_torch.name: Lumina Torch
isle_delfino_lumina_torch.description: The Lumina Torch crackles with a soft, ethereal light that pierces the darkest corners of forgotten ruins. Its flame whispers secrets of old, guiding explorers through hidden pathways and revealing structures thought long lost to time. This torch grants its wielder a temporary boon in vision, allowing them to see twice as far in darkness for 1 hour. It also protects against hallucinations, ensuring clarity amidst the uncanny echoes that haunt the Atrium's unstable depths.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Pathways
effectDetails.rules: The Lumina Torch illuminates a radius of 60 feet for 1 hour, revealing any hidden or secret doors within its range. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Night Vision
effectDetails.rules: While the torch is active, the wielder has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to spot creatures in dim light or darkness for 1 hour. The torch’s light can be used as a bonus action to boost vision temporarily.

isle_delfino_lumina_torch.levelRequirementReason: Beginners need no less than this level to wield the Lumina Torch safely, ensuring they have enough experience to handle its ancient magic.
isle_delfino_lumina_torch.vendorReason: The islanders of Delfino are renowned for their knowledge of forgotten relics and the Atrium's mysteries, making them the perfect stewards of such a magical torch.
isle_delfino_lumina_torch.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones' express courier service within 3 days, ensuring the torch arrives in pristine condition for its new owner.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when first lit and again as a bonus action to enhance night vision
usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: The torch's light fades after an hour or if extinguished manually
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharging upon being doused in water

isle_delfino_lumina_torch.priceReason: Crafted from ancient materials and imbued with rare magic, the Lumina Torch is a rare find, justifying its moderate price.

isle_delfino_mangrove_mirage.name: Mangrove Mirage
isle_delfino_mangrove_mirage.description: The Mangrove Mirage is a magical illusion that duplicates your recent movements, allowing you to retrace steps or mislead foes. Crafted from the heartwood of ancient mangroves and imbued with sprite magic, it echoes your last five paces with crystal clarity. This eerie mirage can confuse enemies, making them stumble into traps you’ve cleverly set in your wake. Its shimmering presence is a masterclass in deception, perfect for both stealth missions and tactical evasion.

effectDetails.title: Echo of Steps
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Creates an echo of your last five paces, which can be retraced for up to 10 feet in any direction. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and is visible only within the immediate area. If you move more than 20 feet from where the mirage begins, it dissipates.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Confusion
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn while within 30 feet of an enemy, they must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or become disoriented for the start of their next turn. On a successful save, they are unaffected.

isle_delfino_mangrove_mirage.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to wield due to its complex magical properties and sprite-infused materials.
isle_delfino_mangrove_mirage.vendorReason: Isle Delfino has a long-standing relationship with the sprites who crafted this item, ensuring its authenticity and quality.
isle_delfino_mangrove_mirage.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, known for their reliable and swift delivery service.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; can be used once per short or long rest.
usage.duration: 5 seconds, lasts until the start of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The mirage dissipates if you move more than 20 feet from its starting point or at the end of a short or long rest.

isle_delfino_mangrove_mirage.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the item's rare ingredients and intricate magic, suitable for third-level characters.

isle_delfino_minus_world_memoir.name: Minus World Memoir
isle_delfino_minus_world_memoir.description: The Minus World Memoir is a tattered, ink-stained journal bound in black leather, its pages torn and stained by void energy. Its pages whisper of forgotten secrets and lost worlds, each entry a fragment of a time that never was. When opened, it reveals one hidden location within the Minus World, granting temporary immunity to negative status effects but causing a fleeting memory distortion: players may inadvertently discard important items for one round.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Location
effectDetails.rules: This effect allows the reader to discover a hidden location within the Minus World. The target must be in close proximity (within 30 feet) and able to see the journal. This ability is limited once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Immunity
effectDetails.rules: For one minute, the reader gains immunity to all negative status effects such as poison, disease, and exhaustion. After this duration ends, any ongoing effects are no longer active. There is a 10% chance that this effect fails due to its unstable nature.

isle_delfino_minus_world_memoir.levelRequirementReason: Characters must have encountered the Minus World to understand the journal's significance and wield it effectively.
isle_delfino_minus_world_memoir.vendorReason: Isle Delfino has exclusive ties with the lost world, making it a fitting vendor for such an artifact.
isle_delfino_minus_world_memoir.shippingDetail: The journal is delivered by Paratroopa Air courier, requiring careful handling to prevent further damage.

usage.activation: Read aloud during a short or long rest in the Minus World
usage.duration: One minute per use; ends when the effect expires or if the reader takes any harmful action
usage.endsWhen: The effect duration ends, or if the reader is subjected to a harmful action such as taking damage

isle_delfino_minus_world_memoir.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the journal's unique lore and limited utility within the game.

isle_delfino_pipe_network_cable.name: Pipe Network Cable
isle_delfino_pipe_network_cable.description: The Pipe Network Cable is a salvaged conduit from Noki Bay's failing communication network. Its metal casing hums faintly with residual data, a relic of better technological days now lost to the void. Worn by those who trace its signal, it grants a steady connection to the network’s fading messages and a +1 bonus to Stealth checks when moving through tunnels or caves; however, prolonged use induces temporary confusion, causing 1d4 moments of disorientation after 30 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: The Pipe Network Cable grants a +1 bonus to all Stealth checks when the wearer is moving through tunnels or caves. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Flickering Confusion
effectDetails.rules: After 30 seconds of continuous use, the user experiences 1d4 moments of temporary confusion. Each moment requires a successful DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 round. This effect can only occur once per long rest.

isle_delfino_pipe_network_cable.levelRequirementReason: The Pipe Network Cable is accessible to lower-level characters who are curious about the network's secrets.
isle_delfino_pipe_network_cable.vendorReason: Isle Delfino has a vested interest in salvaging and preserving remnants of Noki Bay’s technology for future generations.
isle_delfino_pipe_network_cable.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its timely deliveries even through the most treacherous terrain.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing and using the cable.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends at the start of your next turn or when removed.
usage.endsWhen: The end of your next turn, removal from use, or if confusion is triggered.

isle_delfino_pipe_network_cable.priceReason: The Pipe Network Cable's price reflects the rarity and utility of salvaged tech from Noki Bay’s network.

isle_delfino_rakasha_spirit_walk_cargo.name: Spirit Walk Courier Pack
isle_delfino_rakasha_spirit_walk_cargo.description: The Spirit Walk Courier Pack, a courier pack imbued with Rakasha magic, allows you to teleport your cargo instantly to Rogueport Docks. Crafted from enchanted leather and adorned with intricate rakasha symbols, this pack grants a 10% bonus to Stealth checks. Each use drains 100 mana; overuse may cause brief hallucinations, but the true power lies in its ability to deliver goods swiftly, a feat that has made it invaluable among rogues and couriers alike.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Delivery
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to instantly deliver your cargo to Rogueport Docks. This effect has a daily limit of three uses and is exhausted for the day after use.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Bonus
effectDetails.rules: +10% bonus to Stealth checks while wearing or carrying this pack. This benefit lasts until you remove it, up to a maximum duration of 8 hours per day.

isle_delfino_rakasha_spirit_walk_cargo.levelRequirementReason: The pack's magic is accessible to adventurers of all levels but requires basic knowledge of spellcasting.
isle_delfino_rakasha_spirit_walk_cargo.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in enchanted goods and has a long-standing relationship with rakasha artisans, making this item available through their shop.
isle_delfino_rakasha_spirit_walk_cargo.shippingDetail: Ships directly from Rakasha Spirit Walk's headquarters; delivery is instantaneous within a day of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for the delivery, and +10% Stealth bonus lasts up to 8 hours or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: Daily limit reached or cargo delivered; mana is consumed upon activation.
usage.charges: Limited by daily use (3 times per day)

isle_delfino_rakasha_spirit_walk_cargo.priceReason: The pack's enchantments and rakasha magic, combined with its unique delivery service, justify this price in XP.

isle_delfino_ripple_ritual.name: Ripple Ritual
isle_delfino_ripple_ritual.description: The Ripple Ritual is a delicate artifact crafted from the polished shells and coral of Isle Delfino's oceanic heart. This enchanted relic channels the island’s tidal magic, creating a wave of disruption that stuns foes and amplifies damage in its wake. When activated, it unleashes a surge of elemental power that knocks enemies to their feet and enhances your allies’ melee attacks within a 5-meter radius for ten seconds.

effectDetails.title: Stun
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Ripple Ritual emits a shockwave that stuns all enemies in a 5-meter burst. Targets are knocked prone and immobilized for 2 seconds. Has no effect on creatures immune to being stunned.

effectDetails.title: Tidal Surge
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 5 meters of the ritual gain a -2 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws, last for 10 seconds, and must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. The effect ends if they move more than 3 meters away.

isle_delfino_ripple_ritual.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 7 to wield the ritual effectively, balancing its utility in combat.
isle_delfino_ripple_ritual.vendorReason: As a local artifact of Isle Delfino, the Ripple Ritual is best sold by those who know its origins and can ensure proper usage.
isle_delfino_ripple_ritual.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express; delivery time varies based on destination, ensuring safe transport of this delicate artifact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with a duration of 10 seconds for the Tidal Surge debuff
usage.endsWhen: The target recovers from being stunned or moves more than 3 meters away; the debuff ends after 10 seconds.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but must rest for 1 hour after each use.

isle_delfino_ripple_ritual.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique abilities and rarity among Isle Delfino's artifacts.

isle_delfino_serenity_siphon_essence.name: Serenity Siphon Essence
isle_delfino_serenity_siphon_essence.description: The Serenity Siphon Essence is a sleek, iridescent vial that captures the very essence of calm from the sun-drenched bays of Isle Delfino. Crafted by the artisans of the city, it absorbs ambient magic energy, making its wielder immune to magical harm and enhancing their spellcasting speed for an instant. Ideal for mages navigating the treacherous waters, this vial is a symbol of both Isle Delfino's tranquility and its unmatched craftsmanship.

effectDetails.title: Magic Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The user gains immunity to all magical damage for 10 seconds. This effect cannot be used again until the user completes a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Spell Speed
effectDetails.rules: The user's spellcasting speed is increased by 40% for 10 seconds, allowing them to cast spells with greater ease and precision. There is no limit on the number of times this effect can be used within a long rest.

isle_delfino_serenity_siphon_essence.levelRequirementReason: The essence requires basic magical knowledge to activate its effects.
isle_delfino_serenity_siphon_essence.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its artisans and their mastery of magic, making this item a staple in the city's inventory.
isle_delfino_serenity_siphon_essence.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay; delivery typically takes three days from Isle Delfino.

usage.duration: 10 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the user completes a long rest.

isle_delfino_serenity_siphon_essence.priceReason: Crafted with rare materials and expert craftsmanship, this essence balances its powerful effects with a moderate price point.

isle_delfino_shine_bloom.name: Shine Bloom of the Tropical Mirage
isle_delfino_shine_bloom.description: The Shine Bloom of the Tropical Mirage is a vibrant, sunlit flower that glows with the essence of Delfino Isle’s tropical magic. Its petals shimmer with radiant light, capable of healing wounds and lifting spirits in its presence. This rare bloom is said to be a gift from the legendary Shine Sprites who inhabit the island’s lush environs. Nearby allies receive a swift recovery, while the morale of the entire team soars, enhancing their combat effectiveness.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Healing
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a creature within range, this bloom heals all allies within 10 feet for 30% of their maximum hit points. The effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the flower grants a +20 morale bonus to all allied creatures within 15 feet for 1 minute. This boost cannot be removed early by any means except for death or leaving the area. The effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

isle_delfino_shine_bloom.levelRequirementReason: The flower's magic is accessible to all adventurers, regardless of class or background.
isle_delfino_shine_bloom.vendorReason: As the island’s natural healer and guardian, Isle Delfino is known for its abundant supply of magical flora like the Shine Bloom.
isle_delfino_shine_bloom.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter ensures safe and swift delivery of the bloom to adventurers across the realm.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for healing, 1 minute for morale boost
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when used or after its duration expires

isle_delfino_shine_bloom.priceReason: The bloom’s rarity and the limited stock at Isle Delfino justify this fair value in XP.

isle_delfino_shine_bloom_core.name: Shine Bloom Core
isle_delfino_shine_bloom_core.description: The Shine Bloom Core is a pulsating core embedded in a luminescent flower, its petals glowing with the essence of the elusive Shine Sprites. Crafted from the rarest flora of Delfino Isle, this core amplifies spellcasting prowess and emits a radiant aura that banishes shadows and dark magic. The core’s light can be felt for miles around, making it both a weapon against shadowy foes and a beacon of hope in the darkest nights.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Spell Damage
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, lasts for 1 minute. The user gains +25% to their spell damage rolls for the duration.

effectDetails.title: Sunlit Aura
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that grants immunity to all damage from undead and other shadowy creatures. This aura extends up to 30 feet around the user, expiring when the core runs out of charges or if it is destroyed.

isle_delfino_shine_bloom_core.levelRequirementReason: The Shine Bloom Core requires a minimum character level of 6 due to its complex enchantments and the mystical essence it contains.
isle_delfino_shine_bloom_core.vendorReason: Islé Delfino, known for their deep ties with nature, can supply this unique item crafted from flora found only on their island.
isle_delfino_shine_bloom_core.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Rakasha’s ethereal winds, ensuring the core arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and maintain Sunlit Aura; no activation required for Enhanced Spell Damage.
usage.duration: 1 minute per activation, recharges after a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Core runs out of charges or is destroyed.

isle_delfino_shine_bloom_core.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the core's rare materials and potent magical properties, making it a valuable yet fair purchase for players.

isle_delfino_shine_burst.name: Shine Burst Lantern
isle_delfino_shine_burst.description: The Shine Burst Lantern floats gracefully, its surface shimmering with iridescent light as if illuminated by a troupe of invisible Shine Sprites. When activated, it unleashes a dazzling burst that momentarily blinds foes within a ten-foot radius, leaving them reeling in temporary blindness. Simultaneously, the lantern's glow radiates outward, healing nearby allies by restoring 30% of their maximum hit points, offering a beacon of light and life to those in need.

effectDetails.title: Blind Burst
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Shine Burst Lantern emits a blinding burst that blinds all creatures within 10 feet for 3 seconds. This effect has no save DC and does not provoke opportunity attacks.

effectDetails.title: Healing Light
effectDetails.rules: The lantern's light heals allies within 5 feet, restoring 30% of their maximum hit points upon activation. The healing is instantaneous and cannot exceed 100 hit points per use.

isle_delfino_shine_burst.levelRequirementReason: This lantern requires a character to be at least level 6 to wield its light effectively in combat.
isle_delfino_shine_burst.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, known for their magical trinkets and devices, has the expertise to source and sell such an item that harmonizes light and magic.
isle_delfino_shine_burst.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail; expect delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Activates as an action, expending one charge.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasting 3 seconds before the light fades.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts when all charges are used or destroyed upon death.
usage.charges: 10 charges, recharging after a long rest.

isle_delfino_shine_burst.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rarity and utility as both an offensive and supportive tool in combat.

isle_delfino_shine_essence_vial.name: Shine Essence Vial
isle_delfino_shine_essence_vial.description: The Shine Essence Vial glows faintly in the palm, a vial crafted from polished seashells found along the shores of Delfino Isle. When activated, it releases a burst of radiant light, stunning foes and creating an ethereal glow that momentarily blinds them. The vial also grants the user near-invisibility, blending seamlessly with the surrounding sunlight. Ideal for stealthy ambushes in the sun-drenched lagoons, it is a treasure from the depths of Delfino's lore.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Light
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the user releases a burst of light that blinds all creatures within a 10-foot radius for 2 seconds. The effect has no save DC and ends when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 3 rounds after activating the vial, granting them near-invisibility within the sunlit environment. This invisibility can be seen by creatures with darkvision or truesight.

isle_delfino_shine_essence_vial.levelRequirementReason: The Shine Essence Vial is crafted from materials easily accessible to even novice adventurers.
isle_delfino_shine_essence_vial.vendorReason: Isle Delfino holds a deep connection with the natural magic of the lagoon and its inhabitants, making this item a staple in their inventory.
isle_delfino_shine_essence_vial.shippingDetail: Ships via sea sprite courier, ensuring safe delivery within three days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts for 2 seconds and 3 rounds respectively.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the item is destroyed.

isle_delfino_shine_essence_vial.priceReason: Crafted from rare seashells and infused with sprite magic, the Shine Essence Vial offers a balanced price for its unique effects.

isle_delfino_shine_gauntlet.name: Shine Gauntlet
isle_delfino_shine_gauntlet.description: The Shine Gauntlet, crafted from the luminescent shells of tropical sea creatures, radiates an ethereal glow that strengthens the wearer's defenses and summons a radiant shield. Each strike against you is deflected by this glowing defense, while your attacks gain a nimbus of light, increasing their potency. This gauntlet is a testament to the magic of Isle Delfino, where its origins lie in the hands of ancient alchemists who sought to harness nature's purest energy.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Shield
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when you take an attack from a creature. Summons a radiant shield that provides 500 HP of protection for 8 seconds, ending if the gauntlet is destroyed or if you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Luminous Strikes
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn, the gauntlets emit a burst of light, increasing your melee weapon's critical chance by +10% until the end of your next turn. This effect can only occur once per long rest.

isle_delfino_shine_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 7th level to wield its potent magic effectively and avoid overloading novice spellcasters.
isle_delfino_shine_gauntlet.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its mastery of tropical magic, making it the premier vendor for such enchanted items.
isle_delfino_shine_gauntlet.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter's express service, which ensures safe and swift delivery from the heart of Isle Delfino.

usage.activation: Radiant Shield activates as a reaction to an attack. Luminous Strikes occurs at the start of your turn.
usage.duration: 8 seconds for Radiant Shield; lasts until end of next turn for Luminous Strikes.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or incapacitated by Radiant Shield; ends when turn concludes for Luminous Strikes.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged at the start of each long rest.

isle_delfino_shine_gauntlet.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its potent defensive and offensive capabilities, making it a sought-after yet affordable epic treasure.

isle_delfino_shine_shroud.name: Shine Shroud of the Coral Depths
isle_delfino_shine_shroud.description: The Shine Shroud of the Coral Depths is a shimmering cloak crafted from the essence of glimmering Shine Sprites, woven within the depths of the Isle Delfino's coral reefs. When donned, it grants you invisibility for 15 seconds and emits an iridescent aura that deflects up to 20 points of damage per attack or spell cast against you. This enchantment allows you to evade notice in battle and survive deadly encounters by absorbing minor harm.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, lasts for 15 seconds. Ends early if you attack or interact with an object. Grants you and any allies within 5 feet of you total concealment.

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption
effectDetails.rules: Absorbs up to 20 points of damage from a single attack or spell per use, reducing the damage taken by that amount. This effect has no save DC and can be used once before requiring a short rest for recharging.

isle_delfino_shine_shroud.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to wield effectively due to its complex enchantment.
isle_delfino_shine_shroud.vendorReason: As a local vendor of the coral depths, Isle Delfino has access to unique materials and spells used in crafting this item.
isle_delfino_shine_shroud.shippingDetail: Delivered by Shy Guy Smugglers within one week via submarine courier service from the Isle Delfino.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, once per short rest for recharging.
usage.duration: 15 seconds of invisibility and damage absorption.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends early if you attack or interact with an object. Requires a short rest to recharge after use.

isle_delfino_shine_shroud.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the rare materials and intricate magical work required in its crafting.

isle_delfino_shine_spear.name: Shine Spear of the Coral King
isle_delfino_shine_spear.description: The Shine Spear of the Coral King gleams with an otherworldly light, forged from the heartwood of ancient coral trees. Its surface is etched with the scales of sea serpents and glows with a radiance that pierces even the deepest shadows. This weapon is not just a spear; it is a living artifact of the ocean's depths, capable of dazzling foes and blinding their senses for moments at a time.

effectDetails.title: Dazzling Flash
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with this spear, it emits an intense flash of light that blinds enemies within a 10-foot radius for 3 seconds. This effect has no save DC and does not require any action to activate; it is triggered automatically upon hitting the target.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Reduction
effectDetails.rules: For every 5 feet you are underwater, this spear reduces an enemy's Evasion by 10%, stacking up to a maximum reduction of 40%. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and is reset when the spear leaves water.

isle_delfino_shine_spear.levelRequirementReason: This spear demands proficiency with martial weapons, as its unique properties require precise strikes.
isle_delfino_shine_spear.vendorReason: The coral reefs surrounding Isle Delfino are known to be the birthplace of such treasures, and only they can source this weapon.
isle_delfino_shine_spear.shippingDetail: Ships via a fleet of spectral sharks that ensure safe delivery through treacherous waters.

usage.activation: Instantaneous on hit with the spear
usage.duration: 3 seconds for Dazzling Flash; 5 seconds for Evasion Reduction, reset when out of water
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends at the start of the target's next turn or if the spear leaves water
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the spear remains in water

isle_delfino_shine_spear.priceReason: The materials and craftsmanship required to create this weapon justify its price; it is a rare artifact of immense value.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit.name: Shine Spirit Amulet
isle_delfino_shine_spirit.description: The Shine Spirit Amulet is a radiant charm worn by the mischievous and magical Shine Sprites of Delfino Isle. Crafted from shimmering seashells and enchanted with tropical mana, this amulet grants its wearer a soft glow that can be seen for miles in the night. It bestows a +15% critical hit chance and increases maximum Hit Points by 20%, providing both offensive prowess and defensive resilience to adventurers seeking a touch of the tropics.

effectDetails.title: Critical Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on critical hit attempts, increasing their chance by +15%. This effect is passive and applies to all attacks made with the amulet worn. No save required.

effectDetails.title: HP Fortification
effectDetails.rules: Grants a +20% increase to maximum Hit Points for the wearer. Lasts until the end of the wearer's next long rest or when removed from wear. No save required.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit.levelRequirementReason: The amulet is designed for adventurers of all levels, ensuring that even the greenest heroes can benefit from its tropical magic.
isle_delfino_shine_spirit.vendorReason: As a beacon of Delfino's magical charm, Isle Delfino is the most fitting vendor to offer this amulet.
isle_delfino_shine_spirit.shippingDetail: Ships via Sailor Spectral Express, ensuring safe and swift delivery from the heart of Delfino Isle.

usage.duration: Until removed or end of next long rest
usage.endsWhen: When removed or at the end of the wearer's next long rest

isle_delfino_shine_spirit.priceReason: Balanced to ensure it is a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's gear.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_bottle.name: Shine Spirit Bottle
isle_delfino_shine_spirit_bottle.description: The Shine Spirit Bottle is a glass vial encrusted with iridescent seafoam and silver, filled to the brim with the pure essence of the Delfino Sea's legendary sprite. When uncorked, its contents sparkle with an ethereal glow that temporarily enhances your elemental attacks by 20%, granting you a 15% chance to summon a diminutive Shine Sprite ally alongside. This sprite offers assistance for exactly one minute, dancing in front of you and boosting your defense by 5%. After consumption, the bottle shimmers as if it were filled with starlight, leaving behind only an empty vial that glows faintly for a few moments.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Damage Boost
