effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +20 bonus to all elemental damage rolls for 1 minute. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Summon Shine Sprite
effectDetails.rules: There's a 15% chance that, after consuming the bottle, a small Shine Sprite appears and assists you in combat by boosting your defense by +50 for one minute. The sprite remains visible only during its duration.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_bottle.levelRequirementReason: The elemental magic within the bottle is potent enough to require a few levels of experience before safely consuming it.
isle_delfino_shine_spirit_bottle.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, known for its magical and enchanted items, naturally stocks this rare elixir.
isle_delfino_shine_spirit_bottle.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express; delivery is swift but requires a special request due to the fragile nature of the bottle's contents.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with effects lasting for one minute each.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when they expire or the user dies.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_bottle.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers potent but not overpowered abilities.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_pearl.name: Shine Spirit Pearl
isle_delfino_shine_spirit_pearl.description: The Shine Spirit Pearl, crafted from the essence of forgotten sea sprites and enchanted by Delfino's ancient mariners, is a shimmering gem that glows faintly under moonlight. When worn, it grants you temporary invincibility in battle, allowing you to shrug off harm for a fleeting moment. Its otherworldly glow also draws allies from the depths, summoning three ethereal sprites to assist you in combat. These sprites dance around you, enhancing your presence and drawing enemies closer.

effectDetails.title: Blink of Invincibility
effectDetails.rules: Activating the Shine Spirit Pearl grants you a +4 bonus to AC and immunity to all damage for 5 seconds. This effect cannot be used more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Alluring Aura
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Pearl, your presence is enhanced by an aura that attracts nearby allies within 30 feet. Any non-hostile creatures within this radius are drawn to you as if under a charm spell (DC 15). This effect lasts for 2 minutes and can be used once per short rest.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_pearl.levelRequirementReason: The complex enchantment requires significant magical energy, suitable only for seasoned adventurers.
isle_delfino_shine_spirit_pearl.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in rare and enchanted sea artifacts, making the Shine Spirit Pearl a perfect addition to their inventory.
isle_delfino_shine_spirit_pearl.shippingDetail: The gem is carefully packaged and delivered via magical courier, ensuring safe arrival within a single day.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_satchel.name: Shine Spirit Satchel
isle_delfino_shine_spirit_satchel.description: The Shine Spirit Satchel is a glowing pouch crafted from enchanted leather and adorned with fragments of starlight. It holds the essence of fey creatures known as Shine Sprites, whose light can illuminate hidden paths within the Feywild or grant allies temporary boosts in combat. Activated at sunrise or sunset, it emits a radiant burst that not only reveals concealed routes but also enhances nearby allies with a surge of protective energy.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_torch.name: Shine Sprite Torch of Radiance
isle_delfino_shine_spirit_torch.description: The Shine Sprite Torch of Radiance hums with the ethereal energy of its sprite creators, casting a warm golden glow that illuminates even the darkest caverns. Crafted by the Pond Patrol in Delfino Isle, this torch not only brightens your path but also strengthens morale, making every step forward feel lighter and more hopeful. In sunny weather, it glows brighter, amplifying its light output and boosting the spirits of those around you.

effectDetails.title: Luminous Pathlight
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the torch illuminates a 30-foot radius area for 1 minute. It provides bright light in this area and dim light beyond it. The light is magical and grants advantage on saving throws made to resist being frightened within the area.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, the torch can be used as an action to boost morale. For 1 hour, all allies within 30 feet gain a +5 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. This effect ends when it is recharged.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_torch.levelRequirementReason: Beginners find the Shine Sprite Torch useful for navigating their early adventures in Delfino Isle.

isle_delfino_shine_spirit_torch.priceReason: The Shine Sprite Torch offers significant utility and morale boosts, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer.

isle_delfino_shine_spray_gel.name: Shine Spray Gel
isle_delfino_shine_spray_gel.description: The Shine Spray Gel exudes a shimmering iridescence when applied, casting an ethereal glow that dances like starlight on the skin. This gel not only dazzles enemies under moonlit nights but also has the unique ability to reflect light attacks back at the attacker, creating a dazzling storm of reflected beams. A rare find from Isle Delfino, this gel amplifies your presence in any shadowed encounter, turning simple fights into spectacular displays of radiant energy.

effectDetails.title: Reflects Light Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When an attacker uses a light-based attack against the user, the Shine Spray Gel reflects this attack back at the attacker for 3 seconds. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per combat.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Aura
effectDetails.rules: While under moonlight, the Shine Spray Gel grants a +2 bonus to all damage rolls made by the user against enemies. The bonus lasts until the end of your next turn if you are exposed to moonlight for at least 1 minute.

isle_delfino_shine_spray_gel.levelRequirementReason: To harness the full power and radiant effects of Shine Spray Gel, a character must be of at least level 6.
isle_delfino_shine_spray_gel.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its magical creations, and Shine Spray Gel is one such item that enhances one's presence in any shadowy encounter with a touch of starlight.
isle_delfino_shine_spray_gel.shippingDetail: The Koopa Postal service ensures the gel remains intact by using special moonlit wax paper to cushion it during transit.

isle_delfino_shine_springs_amber.name: Shine Springs Amber
isle_delfino_shine_springs_amber.description: Shine Springs Amber radiates a warm, golden glow that seems to pulse with the heartbeat of Delfino Isle. Crafted from ancient coral and enchanted by the sprite guardians of the island, this glowing gemstone emits a dazzling aura that repels shadows and enhances the wielder's combat prowess. When activated, it not only illuminates the darkness but also grants an unexpected burst of speed and a chance to stun foes with its radiant light.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Aura
effectDetails.rules: Activating the Shine Springs Amber creates a dazzling aura that repels shadows within a 10-foot radius. This effect lasts for 30 seconds and offers advantage on saving throws against being frightened by creatures within this area.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Light
effectDetails.rules: Each time you hit an enemy with a melee attack while holding the Shine Springs Amber, there is a 25% chance to stun them for 1 round. This effect has no cooldown and can be used as a bonus action.

isle_delfino_shine_springs_amber.levelRequirementReason: The gem's intricate enchantments require a proficient adventurer of at least level 3 to wield it effectively.
isle_delfino_shine_springs_amber.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its connection with the sprite guardians, who imbue this item with their magic.
isle_delfino_shine_springs_amber.shippingDetail: The gemstone arrives wrapped in protective layers of shimmering mist to ensure it reaches its destination unharmed and fully charged.

isle_delfino_shine_springs_amber.priceReason: Crafted from ancient coral and enchanted with sprite magic, this item offers a unique combination of defensive and offensive benefits at a balanced price.

isle_delfino_shine_springs_amulet.name: Shine Springs Amulet
isle_delfino_shine_springs_amulet.description: The Shine Springs Amulet glows softly in twilight but erupts into a dazzling radiance under the sun's gaze, casting light-based attacks that dazzle and blind foes. Crafted from the essence of Delfino Island’s radiant sprites, this amulet amplifies your light-based abilities, making you shine like an afternoon star. Its core pulses with energy only in full sunlight, granting temporary invisibility when its brilliance is at its peak.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Burst
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the amulet to unleash a burst of light-based damage. This attack has a range of 30 feet and deals an additional +1d6 radiant damage per level (to a maximum of +5d6 at 5th level) on a successful hit. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Sunlight Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: When in full sunlight, the amulet grants you and any allies within 30 feet temporary invisibility for up to 1 hour. This effect requires no action to activate but ends if you leave an area of bright light or take any hostile actions.

isle_delfino_shine_springs_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet’s power demands a certain level of proficiency with light-based magic and combat, making it suitable for adventurers who have proven their mettle in the sunlit realms.
isle_delfino_shine_springs_amulet.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its connection to the radiant sprites, making it the perfect vendor for an amulet imbued with similar magic.
isle_delfino_shine_springs_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is carefully packed and shipped via Pipe Express, known for its reliable delivery even in the most remote parts of the archipelago.

usage.endsWhen: Target leaves bright light or takes hostile actions (Sunlight Invisibility), On use (Radiant Burst)

isle_delfino_shine_springs_amulet.priceReason: The amulet’s rarity and unique, yet balanced, abilities justify its price of 1000 XP.

The amber's light is so bright that it reduces enemy damage dealt to you by 20%, making your foes' strikes less effective in combat.

isle_delfino_shine_sprite_flask.name: Shine Sprite Flask
isle_delfino_shine_sprite_flask.description: The Shine Sprite Flask holds within it the very essence of a mythical creature, its glass vial shimmering with an ethereal light. With these gloves, you are no longer bound by gravity, but instead, you dance among the stars, leaving trails of light behind as you soar.

isle_delfino_shine_sprout_sword.levelRequirementReason: The weapon's enchanted core requires the wielder to be at least level 3 to harness its full power.
isle_delfino_shine_sprout_sword.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in crafting and selling weapons inspired by the ocean's folklore, making this sword a fitting addition to their inventory.
isle_delfino_shine_sprout_sword.shippingDetail: The delivery is handled by Lakitu Drones, known for their swift and reliable service across the archipelago.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The sword's enchantment expires at the end of a long rest.

isle_delfino_shine_sprout_sword.priceReason: The sword's rare materials and enchantments make it a valuable find, justifying its moderate price in experience points.

isle_delfino_shine_tide_ammunition.name: Shine Tide Ammunition
isle_delfino_shine_tide_ammunition.description: Shine Tide Ammunition, forged from the essence of Delfino's marine sprites, is a series of enchanted bullets that pierce through illusions and leave behind trails of radiant light. When these projectiles strike an illusion, they unleash a burst of pure energy, stunning foes for several moments. The weapon also casts a fleeting aura around allies, restoring their vitality with each hit, ensuring those nearby are both protected and healed in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Piercing
effectDetails.rules: When this ammunition strikes an illusion, it deals 200% damage to it and triggers a radiant burst that stuns the target for up to 3 rounds. The stun ends if the target takes any damage or moves.

effectDetails.title: Allied Healing Aura
effectDetails.rules: For each successful hit with this ammunition, an ally within 10 feet gains temporary hit points equal to half of the weapon's attack bonus (rounded down) for 5 minutes. This effect can occur once per turn.

isle_delfino_shine_tide_ammunition.levelRequirementReason: This ammunition is crafted to be accessible to all, enhancing combat effectiveness across various levels.
isle_delfino_shine_tide_ammunition.vendorReason: Isle Delfino's artisans are known for their mastery of magical weaponry, making Shine Tide Ammunition a natural addition to their inventory.
isle_delfino_shine_tide_ammunition.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring the ammunition arrives in perfect condition and ready for immediate use.

usage.activation: On a successful hit with any ranged weapon
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; ends when expended or interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Expended upon hitting an illusion or used to heal allies
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as ammunition remains in the weapon

isle_delfino_shine_tide_ammunition.priceReason: The price reflects the rare material and magical essence required for its crafting.

isle_delfino_shine_wisp_staff.name: Shine Wisp Staff
isle_delfino_shine_wisp_staff.description: The Shine Wisp Staff radiates an ethereal glow that dances and pulses with each successful strike, casting a shimmering shield around its wielder. Crafted from the enchanted wood of Delfino Isle's ancient trees, this staff channels the island’s natural magic to disrupt foes, causing them to stagger in their tracks. Its luminous core amplifies any melee attacks, making it a favorite among martial artists and fighters who seek both offense and defense on the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Disrupting Stagger
effectDetails.rules: When a creature within reach is hit by an attack made with this staff, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and stunned for 2 seconds. This effect has a range of 5 feet and can only occur once per target per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Melee Attacks
effectDetails.rules: While wielding this staff, all melee weapon attacks deal an additional +1d6 radiant damage. The enhancement lasts until the start of your next turn or until you use a bonus action to dismiss it. You can only enhance one melee weapon attack at a time.

isle_delfino_shine_wisp_staff.levelRequirementReason: This staff requires a minimum character level of 3 due to its complex enchantments and the need for proficiency in martial weapons.
isle_delfino_shine_wisp_staff.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is known for crafting items that blend local magic with practical combat utility, making this staff a natural fit for their inventory.
isle_delfino_shine_wisp_staff.shippingDetail: The staff arrives fully charged and ready to use. Due to its delicate nature, it must be handled with care during transit by the Lakitu Drones.

usage.activation: As a bonus action or on hit (melee weapon attack)
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when used again
usage.endsWhen: Used in another melee attack or dismissed as an action
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short rest

isle_delfino_shine_wisp_staff.priceReason: The staff’s enhanced combat utility and the enchantments that protect against magical disruption justify its moderate price.

isle_delfino_sonic_dragon_tether.name: Sonic Dragon Tether
isle_delfino_sonic_dragon_tether.description: The Sonic Dragon Tether, a pulsating device that hums with a low-frequency resonance, is a relic of ancient Regal Empire engineering designed to disrupt dragon sonic attacks. Crafted from enchanted metal and imbued with the essence of a slumbering dragon’s voice, it emits a disorienting pulse that can confuse even the most formidable dragons for several moments. Users must brace themselves; while the device counters dragon abilities, it also echoes their own thoughts in reverse, causing a brief moment where their own words seem to speak from another's mouth.

effectDetails.title: Disrupts Dragon Sonic Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the device emits a pulse that lasts for 5 seconds. During this time, any dragon within 30 feet has disadvantage on all sonic attack rolls and spell checks. If used near a dragon, the user hears their own voice echoing in reverse for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Echoes User’s Thoughts
effectDetails.rules: For 5 seconds after activation, the user experiences their thoughts being echoed back to them as if spoken by another. This effect does not grant any benefit but is a reminder of the device's dual-edged nature. The user can attempt to resist this effect with a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13).

isle_delfino_sonic_dragon_tether.levelRequirementReason: Requires attunement due to its complex, enchanted structure and the need for a sonic device or dragon's voice to activate it.
isle_delfino_sonic_dragon_tether.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in rare artifacts and relics with unique origins, making this device a perfect fit for their inventory.
isle_delfino_sonic_dragon_tether.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its swift but mysterious delivery methods. The package requires special handling to maintain the device's enchantment.

usage.activation: Requires attunement with a sonic device or dragon’s voice.
usage.duration: Pulse lasts 5 seconds; echo effect lasts 5 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the duration expires or the user is no longer within range of a dragon.

isle_delfino_sonic_dragon_tether.priceReason: The device's rarity, enchantment, and unique attunement requirements justify its fair value at 1000 XP.

isle_delfino_spectral_shine_bottle.name: Spectral Shine Bottle
isle_delfino_spectral_shine_bottle.description: The Spectral Shine Bottle glows faintly before shattering into a burst of starlight upon impact, illuminating its surroundings in a dazzling display of spectral energy. When thrown, it unleashes a radiant light that blinds foes within a 3-meter radius for 2 turns, dealing an additional 10% damage to all enemies struck by the light. The shattered remains leave behind shimmering residue, granting you and your allies +5% dodge chance for 5 rounds.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Light Burst
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as a bonus action, the bottle bursts into starlight. All enemies within a 3-meter radius must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 2 turns and take an additional 10% damage.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Aura
effectDetails.rules: The burst of light creates a blinding aura that grants you and your allies within the area +5% dodge chance until the end of their next turn. This effect lasts for up to 5 rounds, refreshing on each new round.

isle_delfino_spectral_shine_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This bottle is crafted with simple enchantments suitable for beginners and experienced adventurers alike.
isle_delfino_spectral_shine_bottle.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, known for its magical curiosities, often features this item in their vast array of mystical wares.
isle_delfino_spectral_shine_bottle.shippingDetail: The bottles are shipped under a protective enchantment to prevent premature activation during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting effects until the end of each round for up to 5 rounds
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the blinding aura duration expires or the bottle is used again

isle_delfino_spectral_shine_bottle.priceReason: Balanced at this price point, it provides a versatile utility without overshadowing more powerful items.

isle_delfino_spiral_soul_ring.name: Spiral Soul Ring
isle_delfino_spiral_soul_ring.description: The Spiral Soul Ring pulses with the ancient energy of the deep, its carven spiral a testament to millennia spent in the ocean's embrace. Wear it and feel the rhythm of the tides surge through your veins, granting you elemental prowess and the ability to summon spirits that lend their power to your spells. This unique artifact is a relic from the Mages Guild’s underwater research, a symbol of their profound connection with aquatic magic.
effects: +20% critical strike damage for elemental spells
Grants 30% chance to summon a spirit ally for 5 seconds

effectDetails.title: Critical Strike Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on the caster's turn as a bonus action. Increases the user’s critical strike damage by +20% for elemental spells only, lasting until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Activates when the wearer makes an attack roll or casts an elemental spell. There is a 30% chance to summon a spirit ally that grants a +1d6 bonus to all damage rolls for 5 seconds, ending upon taking any other action.

isle_delfino_spiral_soul_ring.levelRequirementReason: This ring requires a high level of magical aptitude and connection with the elementals.
isle_delfino_spiral_soul_ring.vendorReason: The Mages Guild at Isle Delfino has long been involved in underwater research, making this artifact an integral part of their equipment line.
isle_delfino_spiral_soul_ring.shippingDetail: Delivered via Lakitu Drone within a week from the vendor.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate critical strike boost; reaction to summon spirit ally.
usage.duration: Until end of next turn for critical strike, 5 seconds for spirit summoning.
usage.endsWhen: On taking another action or at the start of the wearer's next turn.

isle_delfino_spiral_soul_ring.priceReason: The Spiral Soul Ring is a well-balanced epic item, offering significant but not overpowered benefits that align with its rarity and level requirement.

isle_delfino_spirit_bottle.name: Spirit Bottle
isle_delfino_spirit_bottle.description: The Spirit Bottle is a fragile, glass vial adorned with golden runes that shimmer faintly under moonlight. Crafted from the enchanted sands of Delfino Isle, it contains the essence of Shine Sprites, their ethereal energy pulsing within its depths. When uncorked, it releases a protective aura around you and nearby allies, granting magical resistance and reducing incoming damage by half for one turn. The bottle also grants a temporary boost to spellcasting power, allowing you to cast spells with an additional +1 modifier.

effectDetails.title: Magical Resistance Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Spirit Bottle releases a shimmering aura around you and within a 10-foot radius. For one turn, all creatures in this area gain resistance to magical damage. The effect ends when the duration expires or if an attack roll for magical damage is made against any creature within the area.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Spellcasting
effectDetails.rules: The bottle grants a +1 bonus to spell attack and spell save checks, as well as to the DC of your spells. This effect lasts until you use another action to activate the bottle or until you finish a long rest.

isle_delfino_spirit_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted for adventurers who have begun their journey and can handle its ethereal power.
isle_delfino_spirit_bottle.vendorReason: The vendors at Isle Delfino are known for their magical artifacts, and the Spirit Bottle is a staple in their offerings.
isle_delfino_spirit_bottle.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, the bottle must be shipped with special care using padded crates and reinforced packaging.

usage.duration: 1 turn
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or an attack roll for magical damage is made against any creature within the aura area.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a long rest to regain the spellcasting bonus

isle_delfino_spirit_bottle.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the bottle's rare craftsmanship and its utility in enhancing both defensive capabilities and offensive magic.

isle_delfino_spirit_sandals.name: Spirit Sandals
isle_delfino_spirit_sandals.description: The Spirit Sandals of Isle Delfino are crafted from the shells of glow sprites, their essence woven into the leather straps. These lightweight sandals not only enhance your agility, allowing you to dance gracefully across rocky terrain, but also grant you temporary invisibility in the bright, sunlit areas around the island. When worn, you move with a fluid grace that seems to blend you into the very landscape of Isle Delfino, making it easier to navigate without being noticed by those who dwell there.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Agility
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the sandals increase your movement speed by 25%, allowing you to traverse rocky and uneven terrain with ease. This effect is passive while you are in daylight or areas of bright light.

effectDetails.title: Daylight Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: For every hour spent within the sunlight of Isle Delfino, these sandals grant you a +1 bonus on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to become invisible. This effect lasts for 10 minutes per day, and it can be used once per long rest.

isle_delfino_spirit_sandals.levelRequirementReason: The Spirit Sandals are crafted with simple magic that is accessible to low-level adventurers who wish to enhance their movement and stealth capabilities without the need for high-level spells.
isle_delfino_spirit_sandals.vendorReason: Isle Delfino's artisans create these sandals, drawing on the island’s natural magic to infuse them with the essence of its glow sprites.
isle_delfino_spirit_sandals.shippingDetail: The sandals are shipped quickly via Pipe Express, ensuring they arrive at your doorstep in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect while worn; active use requires a long rest to recharge the daylight invisibility ability.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for enhanced agility; daylight invisibility lasts 10 minutes per day and recharges after a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you remove them or if your long rest is interrupted.
usage.charges: Daylight Invisibility can be used once per long rest.

isle_delfino_spirit_sandals.priceReason: This price reflects the combination of enhanced agility and stealth capabilities, which are highly valued by adventurers seeking to improve their movement speed and ability to remain unseen in bright areas.

isle_delfino_spirit_shard_pendant.name: Spirit Shard Pendant
isle_delfino_spirit_shard_pendant.description: The Spirit Shard Pendant is a shimmering talisman crafted from the ethereal essence of ancient sprites, glowing faintly in hues of twilight and dawn. Worn by those seeking to harness its power, it grants an enchanting aura that not only increases elemental damage by 20% but also restores 15% of your health every minute. This pendant is a symbol of Isle Delfino's mystical heritage, forged in the heart of its enchanted forests.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Elemental Damage
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this pendant, you gain a +20% bonus to all elemental damage rolls. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Health Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Every minute while wearing the pendant, you regain 15% of your maximum hit points. This effect ends when the pendant is removed or destroyed.

isle_delfino_spirit_shard_pendant.levelRequirementReason: The pendant's mystical energy requires a certain level to resonate with its enchantments.
isle_delfino_spirit_shard_pendant.vendorReason: As guardians of Isle Delfino, the vendors there are entrusted with preserving and selling relics like this pendant.
isle_delfino_spirit_shard_pendant.shippingDetail: The pendant is delivered via a swift courier known for its precision and reliability.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn, ends when removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Removed from the wearer or destroyed.

isle_delfino_spirit_shard_pendant.priceReason: The pendant's rarity and mystical properties justify its moderate price in XP.

isle_delfino_spirit_spray.name: Spirit Spray
isle_delfino_spirit_spray.description: Spirit Spray is a delicate mist crafted by the sea sprites of Isle Delfino, forged from the essence of Shine Sprites. Upon application, it grants temporary elemental immunity and enhances the recipient's aura glow, making them shimmer with an ethereal light that can be seen for miles. This spray not only protects but also boosts one’s natural radiance, a gift from the deep waters to those who seek its protection.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Immunity Boost
effectDetails.rules: When applied, Spirit Spray grants the recipient a +10% chance to ignore elemental damage for 1 minute. This effect is limited to once per day.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Aura Glow
effectDetails.rules: The recipient's aura glow increases by +20% in radius and brightness for 5 minutes, making them a beacon of light. This effect can only be used twice per week.

isle_delfino_spirit_spray.levelRequirementReason: This spray is designed to aid adventurers who are still learning the ways of the world.
isle_delfino_spirit_spray.vendorReason: Isle Delfino's sea sprites specialize in creating items that enhance one’s connection to nature and protect against its dangers.
isle_delfino_spirit_spray.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter ensures swift delivery, but the spray must be used within a week of receipt to maintain its potency.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to apply Spirit Spray.
usage.duration: 1 minute for Elemental Immunity Boost; 5 minutes for Enhanced Aura Glow
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the user takes damage, whichever comes first.

isle_delfino_spirit_spray.priceReason: The balance of the price reflects its rarity and the expertise required to craft such a beneficial spray.

isle_delfino_splash_spirit.name: Splash Spirit Amulet
isle_delfino_splash_spirit.description: The Splash Spirit Amulet is a shimmering, wave-shaped charm crafted from polished seashells and enchanted by Delfino's mystical artisans. Wearers of this amulet can summon a fleeting splash to deflect projectiles in combat or use it for quick evasion near water's edge. The amulet grants the wearer increased swim speed and a bonus dodge chance when surrounded by aquatic elements, making it an invaluable companion for adventurers navigating treacherous waters.

effectDetails.title: Water Disruption
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can summon a splash of water to deflect one projectile within 5 feet for 5 seconds. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges but may be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Evasion
effectDetails.rules: The amulet grants the wearer a +10% chance to dodge attacks when near water, stacking with other sources of dodge. This bonus lasts until the end of the wearer's next turn and does not have a save DC or recharge.

isle_delfino_splash_spirit.levelRequirementReason: The amulet requires at least level 5 to activate its abilities effectively in combat.
isle_delfino_splash_spirit.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for crafting items that harmonize with the ocean's magic, making it a fitting vendor for such an aquatic charm.
isle_delfino_splash_spirit.shippingDetail: Delivered by Finsail Express within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon a water splash; passive dodge bonus while near water.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts until the end of next turn for Water Disruption, and until the start of the wearer's next turn for Enhanced Evasion.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the amulet is removed or the duration expires.

isle_delfino_splash_spirit.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rare craftsmanship and unique aquatic magic.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_amulet.name: Splish Splash Amulet
isle_delfino_splish_splash_amulet.description: The Splish Splash Amulet gleams with the vibrant hues of a tropical waterfall, its polished shell shimmering like liquid emerald. When submerged in water, it grants you the agility of a sprite, enhancing your movement speed by 10% and allowing you to perform watery acrobatics with ease. The amulet also deals an additional 2d6 fire damage when attacking aquatic foes, ensuring your strikes are as sharp as the waves that inspire its design.

effectDetails.title: Aquatic Agility
effectDetails.rules: While in water or a watery environment, you gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Movement) checks and can swim at your highest land walking speed. This effect lasts for the duration of time spent submerged.

effectDetails.title: Splash Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: When making an attack against an aquatic creature or object, you deal an additional 2d6 fire damage as the amulet channels the heat and energy of a tropical waterfall into your strike. This effect can be used once per short rest.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is crafted for beginners to introduce them to the joys of aquatic combat.
isle_delfino_splish_splash_amulet.vendorReason: Islé Delfín specializes in aquatic-themed gear, making this amulet a natural addition to its inventory.
isle_delfino_splish_splash_amulet.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter ensures swift delivery of your purchase, even across the most turbulent seas.

usage.activation: Passive effect while submerged in water or a watery environment.
usage.duration: Lasts until you exit the water or enter an area not considered watery.
usage.endsWhen: Expires at the end of your next turn after exiting the water.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after 8 hours spent out of water.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's unique combination of utility and combat prowess makes it a fair price for adventurers seeking to enhance their aquatic capabilities without breaking the bank.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_gear.name: Splish Splash Gear Set
isle_delfino_splish_splash_gear.description: The Splish Splash Gear Set, a rare ensemble crafted from water-resistant silk and enchanted cotton, transforms your movements in tropical climates or rainy weather into an exhilarating splash. When you activate this set, you emit a playful geyser with each step, ensuring you stay agile yet whimsical amidst the elements. Equipped in both armor and boots, it grants +20% mobility on wet ground and boosts your damage by +10% when near water sources or moisture.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Splash Effect
effectDetails.rules: When you move, there is a 10% chance that your steps create a small splash. This effect lasts for the duration of one short rest and does not stack with other similar effects.

effectDetails.title: +20% Mobility in Wet Terrain
effectDetails.rules: This benefit activates as soon as you equip both pieces of the gear set. It remains active until you remove either piece or complete a long rest. While this effect is active, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_gear.levelRequirementReason: The intricate enchantments and materials used in crafting the Splish Splash Gear Set require a level of proficiency in handling such delicate items.
isle_delfino_splish_splash_gear.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in gear for aquatic and tropical adventures, making this set an ideal addition to their inventory.
isle_delfino_splish_splash_gear.shippingDetail: The gear is carefully packed with waterproofing materials to ensure it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Activates on initial equipping and remains active until removed or upon completion of a long rest.
usage.duration: Active for the duration of one short rest or until removed or resting.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when you remove either piece, complete a long rest, or if the gear is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; recharges after a long rest.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_gear.priceReason: The set's rare materials and enchantments justify its value, making it a sought-after item for adventurers navigating wet terrains.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_glove.name: Splish Splash Glove
isle_delfino_splish_splash_glove.description: The Splish Splash Glove is a neon-painted, waterproof glove crafted from enchanted rubber. When donned, it channels the whimsical chaos of Delfino Isle to absorb attacks and convert them into speed boosts. Designed for adventurers who navigate dream zones or watery realms, this glove enhances your agility in wet conditions by 20%, while also granting a 50% chance to dodge enemy hits when they have less than half their health.

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption and Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer, they take only 50% of the damage. This absorbed damage is converted into a speed boost equal to 10% of their movement speed for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Agility in Water
effectDetails.rules: While in water or dream zones, the wearer's jump height increases by 20%. Additionally, there is a 50% chance that they will dodge an attack if the attacking creature has less than half of its hit points.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_glove.levelRequirementReason: A basic level requirement ensures that even novice adventurers can benefit from this unique glove.
isle_delfino_splish_splash_glove.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in equipment for aquatic and dream zone exploration, making it the perfect vendor for this glove.
isle_delfino_splish_splash_glove.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Koopa Postal within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon equipping; ends when removed or if the wearer is no longer in water or dream zones.
usage.duration: Instantaneous speed boost on damage absorption; enhanced agility lasts for 1 minute while in water or dream zones.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end either by removing the glove, leaving a watery environment, or at the end of the duration period.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_glove.priceReason: This price reflects the enchantments and unique properties that make this glove a valuable asset for adventurers navigating aquatic and dream zones.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_rod.name: Splish Splash Rod
isle_delfino_splish_splash_rod.description: The Splish Splash Rod is a whimsical fishing rod crafted from polished coral and adorned with silver runes that shimmer like stars in the deep sea. This artifact not only lures aquatic spirits but also yields rare coral gems, perfect for both catching fish and collecting Shine Sprite tokens. With each successful cast, it sends ripples through the water, creating a mesmerizing display of bubbles that can stun foes temporarily.
effects: +30% chance to catch rare coral tokens
Deals 10% extra damage to water-based enemies

effectDetails.title: Bubble Blast
effectDetails.rules: After casting the rod three times successfully, you can activate the Bubble Blast ability. This creates a burst of bubbles that stuns all water-based enemies within a 10-foot radius for 1 round (DC 14 Wisdom save). The effect ends if a creature moves out of the area or takes any action.

effectDetails.title: Rare Coral Yield
effectDetails.rules: For every successful cast, there is a +30% chance to retrieve a rare coral gem. These gems are highly sought after by collectors and can be used for various magical purposes. This effect does not expend charges but requires the rod to be in good condition.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_rod.levelRequirementReason: The Splish Splash Rod is designed for beginners who wish to explore aquatic environments and collect rare treasures without needing extensive experience.
isle_delfino_splish_splash_rod.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its deep-sea expeditions and the Splish Splash Rod complements their mission of discovering hidden aquatic secrets.
isle_delfino_splish_splash_rod.shippingDetail: The rod arrives wrapped in waterproof packaging, ensuring it remains in pristine condition during shipment.

usage.activation: Bonus action to cast the rod and retrieve a catch or gem, or use the Bubble Blast ability after three successful casts.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each effect
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the creature moves out of range or takes an action, or if the rod breaks and requires repair.

isle_delfino_splish_splash_rod.priceReason: The Splish Splash Rod is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique combination of fishing prowess and magical capabilities, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer.

isle_delfino_spray_spirit.name: Spray Spirit Vial
isle_delfino_spray_spirit.description: The Spray Spirit Vial holds a shimmering essence of the Delfino Sea, imbuing the drinker with the grace and agility of its mythical creatures. When uncorked, it grants a dancer's evasion, making you as slippery as the waves themselves for 15 seconds. The vial also increases your swim speed by 25%, allowing you to glide through water as though it were air. The sparkling trail left behind confounds foes, leaving them momentarily disoriented and off-balance.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Boost
effectDetails.rules: When the Spray Spirit Vial is uncorked, you gain a +30% bonus to your AC against melee and ranged attacks for 15 seconds. This effect ends when the vial is empty or upon taking an action, reaction, or other activity that requires concentration.

effectDetails.title: Swim Speed Increase
effectDetails.rules: The Spray Spirit Vial increases your swim speed by +25% while active. This enhancement lasts for 15 seconds and ends when the vial is empty or upon taking an action, reaction, or other activity that requires concentration.

isle_delfino_spray_spirit.levelRequirementReason: This elixir is designed to be accessible to adventurers of all levels, enhancing their natural abilities without imposing a high barrier.
isle_delfino_spray_spirit.vendorReason: The vial's origins are tied directly to the Delfino Sea, making it only fitting that Isle Delfino stocks this product.
isle_delfino_spray_spirit.shippingDetail: Shipped via Koopa's fastest courier pigeons; arrives within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Uncork and consume the vial to activate its effects.
usage.duration: 15 seconds per uncorking, duration ends when the vial is empty or upon taking an action, reaction, or other activity that requires concentration.
usage.endsWhen: The vial is empty, you take an action, reaction, or other activity requiring concentration, or after 15 seconds.

isle_delfino_spray_spirit.priceReason: The Spray Spirit Vial's rarity and unique properties justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

isle_delfino_sprinkles_of_shine.name: Sprinkles of Shine
isle_delfino_sprinkles_of_shine.description: Sprinkles of Shine are a shimmering, sugary elixir that exudes a radiant glow when shaken. Each bottle contains essence distilled from the rarest Sparkle Sprites found in Delfino Isle's hidden lagoons. Drinking these sprinkles grants you and your allies a burst of energy, temporarily boosting morale during chaotic events. For three turns after consumption, there’s a 50% chance to avoid enemy attacks or traps, and nearby allies gain an ethereal sparkle that increases their attack speed by 10%. These precious elixirs are handcrafted using ancient Delfino Isle secrets and shipped with care via the Koopa Postal Service.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, Sprinkles of Shine restore 30% of the drinker’s maximum hit points and mana. There is a 50% chance to avoid an enemy attack or fall into a trap for three turns after drinking.

effectDetails.title: Sparkle Aura
effectDetails.rules: For three turns, Sprinkles create a sparkling aura around the drinker and nearby allies, increasing their attack speed by 10%. The sparkle effect is visually represented as a trail of tiny, twinkling stars following the drinker.

isle_delfino_sprinkles_of_shine.levelRequirementReason: These sprinkles are designed for adventurers at all levels to enjoy, providing a morale boost and defensive advantage in any chaotic situation.
isle_delfino_sprinkles_of_shine.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its expertise in crafting elixirs that enhance the spirit of its visitors.
isle_delfino_sprinkles_of_shine.shippingDetail: The Koopa Postal Service ensures these precious sprinkles arrive fresh, delivered via their fastest courier pigeons.

usage.activation: Consume one Sprinkle of Shine as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Three turns after activation.
usage.endsWhen: After the duration ends or if the drinker takes any damage.

isle_delfino_sprinkles_of_shine.priceReason: The price reflects the rare ingredients and ancient Delfino Isle crafting techniques required to produce these elixirs.

isle_delfino_sprout_bloom_helmet.name: Sprout Bloom Helmet
isle_delfino_sprout_bloom_helmet.description: The Sprout Bloom Helmet pulses with vibrant, tropical energy, its surface a lattice of verdant vines and glowing nodes. This jungle helm grants you immunity to knockback for 5 seconds, allowing you to counterattack without fear of being flung back. A unique feature triggers on each hit, releasing a burst of leafy tendrils that blind your foes within a 10-foot radius for 2 rounds. Perfect for the dense, unforgiving battles in the Delfino jungle.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Knockback
effectDetails.rules: When you take knockback, you are instead immune to it for 5 seconds. If this effect ends before the duration expires and you take another knockback, the immunity resets.

effectDetails.title: Tropical Burst on Hit
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you hit an opponent with a melee attack, a burst of leafy tendrils springs from the helmet, creating a 10-foot-radius Blinding Mist centered on your target. The mist lasts for 2 rounds and grants advantage to your next attack against that target.

isle_delfino_sprout_bloom_helmet.levelRequirementReason: The Sprout Bloom Helmet requires level 5 to wear due to its intricate enchantments and the need to navigate jungle hazards.
isle_delfino_sprout_bloom_helmet.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for crafting gear that thrives in tropical environments, making it a perfect vendor for this helmet.
isle_delfino_sprout_bloom_helmet.shippingDetail: The helmet is shipped via the Rakasha Spirit Walk, ensuring its arrival with vibrant energy intact.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning. Requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: 5 seconds of immunity and a 2-round duration for the burst.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires or when you take another knockback, at which point they reset.

isle_delfino_sprout_bloom_helmet.priceReason: This price reflects the rare enchantments and materials used in crafting this jungle-adapted helmet.

isle_delfino_sprout_bottle.name: Sprout Bottle
isle_delfino_sprout_bottle.description: The Sprout Bottle is a delicate glass vial, its surface etched with ancient runes that hum faintly in the light. Contained within is the essence of a Shine Sprite’s growth spurt, a verdant liquid that pulses with life itself. When sipped, the drinker experiences an explosion of energy, their stamina replenished by half and movement speed doubled for one turn. The air around them crackles with newfound vitality, leaving behind a trail of shimmering sparkles that reveals hidden paths in the immediate vicinity.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, the user regains 25% of their maximum stamina. This effect lasts for 1 turn and cannot be used more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Movement Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the drinker’s movement speed is doubled for 1 turn. Additionally, any path they traverse leaves behind a trail of sparkling light that reveals hidden or obscured areas within a 5-foot radius for the duration of their enhanced movement.

isle_delfino_sprout_bottle.levelRequirementReason: The Sprout Bottle is accessible to all adventurers who can afford its price, as it offers a useful but not overpowered burst of energy.
isle_delfino_sprout_bottle.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, known for its connection with nature and magic, sells the Sprout Bottle as part of their line of unique magical artifacts.
isle_delfino_sprout_bottle.shippingDetail: The bottle is shipped in a specially lined box to prevent breakage during transit, ensuring it arrives intact and potent.

usage.duration: 1 Turn
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn or when used again within a long rest.

isle_delfino_sprout_bottle.priceReason: The Sprout Bottle is priced moderately, reflecting its rare and valuable essence but not so expensive as to be out of reach for most adventurers.

isle_delfino_sprout_chestplate.name: Sprout Chestplate of Radiant Growth
isle_delfino_sprout_chestplate.description: The Sprout Chestplate of Radiant Growth is crafted from the heartwood of ancient sunflowers, imbued with the essence of life itself. This armor not only shields you against harsh environmental conditions but also encourages your own growth and regeneration. As it clings to your form like a second skin, its petals seem to pulse in rhythm with your heartbeat, offering an ever-present reminder that even in the harshest of climates, new life can bloom.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this chestplate, your natural regeneration is increased by 30%. This effect functions passively and continues as long as the chestplate remains on you. The regenerative power reaches its peak when your hit point total is below 50%, but it does not exceed half of your maximum hit points.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Shield
effectDetails.rules: The Sprout Chestplate offers a +20% defense bonus against environmental damage, such as fire, cold, and acid. This effect grants the wearer the ability to shrug off these harsh conditions more easily, providing an additional layer of protection in challenging terrains.

isle_delfino_sprout_chestplate.levelRequirementReason: This armor is designed for seasoned adventurers who have faced numerous trials and can now benefit from its unique properties.
isle_delfino_sprout_chestplate.vendorReason: The artisans at Isle Delfino are known for their expertise in crafting gear that harmonizes with nature, making the Sprout Chestplate a natural addition to their inventory.
isle_delfino_sprout_chestplate.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express within three days of purchase. Expedited shipping options available for an additional fee.

usage.duration: Persistent while worn
usage.endsWhen: Removes the chestplate or dies

isle_delfino_sprout_chestplate.priceReason: The price reflects the unique materials and enchantments used in its creation, as well as the specialized craftsmanship required.

isle_delfino_sprout_gear.name: Sprout Gear
isle_delfino_sprout_gear.description: Sprout Gear is a magical tool forged from enchanted soil, designed to nurture rare flora and call upon the natural world's guardians. With this gear, gardeners can summon Shine Sprites—tiny yet formidable allies that bolster their plant growth by 20% and provide a 50% damage boost in combat. As if nature itself assists, Sprout Gear also amplifies plant growth speed, ensuring your gardens flourish faster than ever before.

effectDetails.title: Summon Shine Sprites
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can summon a Shine Sprite that appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. The sprite has 100 hit points and grants you advantage on attack rolls against creatures with plant-based weaknesses. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Boost Plant Growth
effectDetails.rules: Sprout Gear increases the growth speed of any plants within a 60-foot radius by 20%. This bonus remains in effect as long as you hold the gear and does not stack with other similar effects. No saving throw is required.

isle_delfino_sprout_gear.levelRequirementReason: Sprout Gear's simplicity allows even novice gardeners to harness its power.
isle_delfino_sprout_gear.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, a haven for nature enthusiasts, stocks Sprout Gear as part of their gardening tool collection.
isle_delfino_sprout_gear.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail; delivery is swift but requires a signature from a plant-based entity.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon Shine Sprite, passive boost for plant growth.
usage.duration: Summoned sprite lasts until the end of your next turn. Boost remains active while holding Sprout Gear.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you drop or lose control over the gear.

isle_delfino_sprout_gear.priceReason: Sprout Gear offers a balanced mix of utility and combat support for gardeners, making it worth its price in experience points.

isle_delfino_sprout_glider.name: Sprout Glider
isle_delfino_sprout_glider.description: The Sprout Glider is a leaf-shaped apparatus crafted from the resilient bark of Delfino Island's sacred trees, its veins etched with ancient runes that whisper the secrets of flight. This glider allows you to soar silently above the lush canopy, evading patrols or delivering surprise attacks with ease. Once airborne, the glider's roots seem to merge with the very air, offering a 25% chance to reduce fall damage and granting +10% evasion while in flight.

effectDetails.title: Silent Flight
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the glider to soar silently for up to 1 minute. While airborne, any noise made by your flight is reduced to a faint rustling that only nearby creatures with keen hearing can detect. The glider's roots extend and retract seamlessly, allowing for silent landings without leaving a trace.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Fall Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you fall from a height of 30 feet or less and activate the glider before hitting the ground, reduce fall damage by 5d6. This effect can only be used once per short rest.

isle_delfino_sprout_glider.levelRequirementReason: Even though it's an epic item, the Sprout Glider is accessible to lower-level characters as a means to introduce aerial combat and stealth.
isle_delfino_sprout_glider.vendorReason: Isle Delfino has long been known for its mastery of nature magic, making the glider a fitting addition to their offerings.
isle_delfino_sprout_glider.shippingDetail: The glider is shipped via the Rakasha Spirit Walk, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition and fully charged with magical energy.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per short rest
usage.endsWhen: You deactivate it or fall from a height without using it first.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to regain any used charges.

isle_delfino_sprout_glider.priceReason: The Sprout Glider's price is balanced at 1000 XP as it offers significant utility and stealth capabilities without overwhelming the player.

isle_delfino_sprout_potion.name: Sprout Potion
isle_delfino_sprout_potion.description: The Isle Delfino Sprout Potion is a vibrant green elixir that glimmers with the essence of tropical plants. This potion sips instantly to restore vitality and grants a burst of energy, making the drinker's movements fluid and precise. Sip twice within an hour to temporarily transform into a dancing lily pad, floating gracefully for 30 seconds. The transformation is more than just a spectacle; it provides a +20% bonus to Dexterity-based checks while active.

effectDetails.title: Vitality and Energy Boost
effectDetails.rules: The drinker regains 50 hit points upon consumption. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Floating Plant Transformation
effectDetails.rules: Sipping twice within one hour causes the drinker to transform into a floating lily pad for 30 seconds, granting a +20% bonus to Dexterity-based checks during this time. This transformation ends if the drinker takes any damage or when its duration expires.

isle_delfino_sprout_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is accessible to all adventurers as it provides quick restorative benefits and a fun, temporary form of mobility.
isle_delfino_sprout_potion.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is known for its magical and restorative elixirs, making this potion a staple in their offerings.
isle_delfino_sprout_potion.shippingDetail: The Sea Sprite Courier delivers the potion swiftly from the tropical isles to adventurers across the realm.

usage.duration: 30 seconds when transformed into a lily pad
usage.endsWhen: Transformation ends on taking damage or after its duration expires

isle_delfino_sprout_potion.priceReason: This price reflects the potion's potent effects, including immediate health restoration and a unique temporary transformation ability.

isle_delfino_sprout_shield.name: Sprout Shield of the Glow Sprite
isle_delfino_sprout_shield.description: The Sprout Shield of the Glow Sprite is a pulsating leaf shield that absorbs sunlight and converts it into vibrant, radiant power. This enchanted shield not only enhances its wielder's defense but also retaliates with a dazzling flash when shattered by an attacker. Crafted from the pure essence of the Isle Delfino’s sacred groves, each sprout captures the island’s luminescent energy, ensuring that those who bear it are both fortified and formidable.

effectDetails.title: Sunlight Absorption
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the shield, the wielder gains a +3 bonus to AC. This effect is active as long as the shield is not broken and receives sunlight for at least one hour per day.

effectDetails.title: Retaliatory Flash
effectDetails.rules: When the shield breaks or is destroyed in combat, it deals radiant damage equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier. This effect can be used once per short rest and requires no action to activate.

isle_delfino_sprout_shield.levelRequirementReason: The shield's magic requires a minimum of third-level spellcasting ability to properly harness its radiant energy.
isle_delfino_sprout_shield.vendorReason: As the creators and stewards of the sacred groves, Isle Delfino is the only place where such an enchanted item can be crafted and sold.
isle_delfino_sprout_shield.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu drones, ensuring that the shield arrives at its destination in optimal condition.

usage.duration: Until destroyed or until a new short rest is taken.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed in combat or when the wielder takes a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires sunlight for at least one hour per day to maintain its active state.

isle_delfino_sprout_shield.priceReason: The shield’s rarity and the specialized materials required for its creation justify this price in game XP.

isle_delfino_sprout_soul_ring.name: Sprout Soul Ring
isle_delfino_sprout_soul_ring.description: The Sprout Soul Ring is a verdant circlet made from enchanted wood and sunlight-dyed silk. Crafted by Isle Delfino's master artisans, this ring absorbs solar energy, which fuels your sprite's natural healing and boosts during sunny days. It grants you an extra burst of vitality, enhancing your critical hits with the power of the sun, and reducing cooldowns for your abilities when the sun is at its zenith.

effectDetails.title: Solar Healing Boost
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect: While exposed to sunlight, you restore 20% of your maximum hit points every 4 seconds. This effect is limited to a total duration of 1 hour per day.

effectDetails.title: Sunshine Critters
effectDetails.rules: Active effect: When using abilities with the 'sun' keyword, you gain a +5 bonus to critical hit chance. This ability can be used once every short or long rest.

isle_delfino_sprout_soul_ring.levelRequirementReason: The ring's simple design and natural materials make it accessible to all levels.
isle_delfino_sprout_soul_ring.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its expertise in crafting magical accessories that harmonize with nature, making the Sprout Soul Ring a perfect fit for their inventory.
isle_delfino_sprout_soul_ring.shippingDetail: The ring arrives encased in a sunlight-infused silk pouch to preserve its energy. Delivery time is expedited by Void Drifter Relay's fastest courier service.

usage.activation: Passive and active effects are always active during sunlight exposure.
usage.duration: Passive effect lasts for up to 1 hour per day, while the active effect can be used once every short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The passive effect ends after one hour of continuous sun exposure; the active effect ends at the end of your next short or long rest.

isle_delfino_sprout_soul_ring.priceReason: The ring's rarity and enchanted components justify its fair price, offering significant utility to any party.

isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_bottle.name: Sprout Spirit Bottle
isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_bottle.description: The Sprout Spirit Bottle, a glass vial crafted from the translucent bark of ancient trees, holds the essence of a Shine Sprite’s laughter. When shaken, it releases a burst of joy that enhances both your movement speed and attack speed, making you fleet-footed and swift in combat. The bottle's contents are said to be imbued with the very spirit of nature itself, granting temporary power boosts to those who wield it.

effectDetails.title: Burst of Joy (Instantaneous)
effectDetails.rules: When the Sprout Spirit Bottle is shaken, the user gains +15% movement speed and +10% attack speed for 5 seconds. This effect ends if the user takes any damage or on their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Healing Essence (Instantaneous)
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the user heals 10% of their maximum hit points. This effect cannot be used more than once per day.

isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_bottle.levelRequirementReason: The bottle's magic is potent enough to require a minimum level of 3 for safe use.
isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_bottle.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, renowned for its connection with nature and spirits, offers the Sprout Spirit Bottle as a tribute to the elements.
isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_bottle.shippingDetail: The bottle is carefully packed in Void Drifter's special eco-friendly material to ensure it arrives undamaged.

usage.duration: 5 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: On the user's next turn or if the user takes damage

isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_bottle.priceReason: The bottle is priced at 800 XP, reflecting its rare and potent nature.

isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_gloves.name: Sprout Spirit Gloves
isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_gloves.description: The Sprout Spirit Gloves are lightweight, woven from the fibers of ancient coral and enchanted by the mystical energy of a hidden coral reef. These gloves enhance your movements through jungle and reef zones, allowing you to glide with ease among the dense foliage or navigate the labyrinthine reefs. The gloves pulse with an ethereal glow, revealing secret paths and enhancing your stealth, making you nearly invisible in dark or dimly lit areas.
effects: +20% movement speed in jungle or reef zones
Grants +5% dodge chance against ranged attacks

effectDetails.title: Glow Path
effectDetails.rules: Activates when you are within a coral reef. Reveals hidden paths and secret routes for 1 minute, allowing you to navigate with ease through the labyrinthine coral formations.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: Increases your Stealth check by +5 if made in dimly lit or dark areas. This bonus lasts until the end of your next turn after using this effect.

isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_gloves.levelRequirementReason: These gloves are crafted for travelers and explorers who venture into dense jungles and coral reefs, requiring no special training to use.
isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_gloves.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in crafting items that enhance the natural environment of their island, making these gloves a perfect fit.
isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_gloves.shippingDetail: Ships directly from Isle Delfino with a Sea Sprite delivering the package within two days.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action when you are in a jungle or reef zone.
usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends if you leave the jungle or reef zone, or if you take any hostile action.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharge after 8 hours of rest.

isle_delfino_sprout_spirit_gloves.priceReason: Balanced for a rare item that enhances movement and stealth in specific environments without being game-breaking.

isle_delfino_sprout_sprout_seed.name: Sprout Sprout Seed
isle_delfino_sprout_sprout_seed.description: The Sprout Sprout Seed, a rare gem from the enchanted groves of Shine Sprite Isle, is no ordinary seed. When planted in soil, it grows into a luminescent plant that emits magical pollen, enhancing the battle morale and stamina of its surroundings. The glow of this plant can only be hastened by the Sunlight Charm, which accelerates its growth without sacrificing its vibrant health. Its pollen, when collected, not only restores 50% of a party member's stamina but also grants them an extra action for the duration of their next combat round.
effects: Restores Stamina and Grants Extra Action
Enhances Battle Morale with Ambient Glow

effectDetails.title: Restores Stamina and Grants Extra Action
effectDetails.rules: When a party member consumes pollen, they immediately regain 50% of their stamina. Additionally, the next round, they gain an extra action as long as no major combat event occurs.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Battle Morale with Ambient Glow
effectDetails.rules: The Sprout Sprout Plant emits a soft, magical light that increases all party members' morale by +1 to their Charisma (Performance) checks for the duration of one short rest. The plant requires sunlight and cannot be extinguished without proper care.

isle_delfino_sprout_sprout_seed.levelRequirementReason: This seed is accessible to adventurers at the beginning of their journey, making it a valuable early-game tool.
isle_delfino_sprout_sprout_seed.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in rare and enchanted seeds from its groves, ensuring that visitors have access to these magical items.
isle_delfino_sprout_sprout_seed.shippingDetail: The seed is delivered with a special charm that ensures it remains fertile during transit. This delivery method is reliable but can be delayed by adverse weather conditions.

usage.activation: Planting the seed (requires soil) and collecting pollen (once the plant matures)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for stamina restoration, one short rest for morale enhancement
usage.endsWhen: The plant dies without proper care or if the pollen is consumed

isle_delfino_sprout_sprout_seed.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its rarity and utility as a valuable resource for early-game adventuring parties.

isle_delfino_sprout_sword.name: Sprout Sword
isle_delfino_sprout_sword.description: The Sprout Sword is a shimmering blade forged from the essence of Delfino Isle's enchanted forests. Its hilt glows with vibrant, emerald energy that pulses in time with the forest's heartbeat. When wielded, it grants an attacker +20% damage to their strikes and can heal 5% of their health upon each swing. Ideal for dual-wielding or combo-focused players, this sword dances with the spirit of nature itself.

effectDetails.title: Increased Damage
effectDetails.rules: The Sprout Sword provides a +20% damage bonus to all melee attacks made with it. This effect is passive and lasts until the end of the wielder's next turn.

effectDetails.title: Healing Swing
effectDetails.rules: Whenever the wielder swings this sword, they gain a healing surge equal to 5% of their maximum hit points. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

isle_delfino_sprout_sword.levelRequirementReason: The Sprout Sword's connection to Delfino Isle requires the wielder to have at least reached the first level.
isle_delfino_sprout_sword.vendorReason: The sword is a symbol of Delfino Isle’s strength and resilience, crafted by the island itself and sold through its trusted vendor.
isle_delfino_sprout_sword.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe delivery within two weeks.

usage.duration: Instantaneous.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one short or long rest.

isle_delfino_sprout_sword.priceReason: The Sprout Sword is priced at 1000 XP as a rare, high-demand item that enhances both offensive and defensive capabilities.

isle_delfino_spryte_soul_core.name: Spryte Soul Core of the Whispering Winds
isle_delfino_spryte_soul_core.description: The Spryte Soul Core of the Whispering Winds is a radiant, floating orb that hums with the essence of the sea and sky. Crafted from the ethereal hearts of long-departed Shine Sprites, it grants its bearer the gift of eluding attacks with uncanny precision. When activated, it conjures a shimmering shield that not only slows foes but also enhances the user's agility, making each dodge a graceful evasion.

effectDetails.title: Dodging Mastery
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction to an attack. Grants advantage on Dexterity saving throws for the start of your next turn and increases your chance to dodge by +20%. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or when you use this ability again.

effectDetails.title: Ethereal Shield
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Summons an ethereal shield that slows creatures within 10 feet of the user by 20% for 1 minute per activation, up to three times per long rest. The shield dissipates when a creature enters its area or if you take damage.

isle_delfino_spryte_soul_core.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 6 to channel the protective and evasive energies of the Spryte Soul Core.
isle_delfino_spryte_soul_core.vendorReason: Isle Delfino specializes in items imbued with the natural magic found within their coastal regions, making it a fitting vendor for this ethereal core.
isle_delfino_spryte_soul_core.shippingDetail: Delivered by Pipe Express, known for its swift and reliable service along the Delfino archipelago.

usage.activation: Reaction to an attack; Bonus action to summon the shield
usage.duration: Instantaneous dodge effect; 1 minute per activation of the shield
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or reactivation; Shield dissipates on damage or entry into its area

isle_delfino_spryte_soul_core.priceReason: The rare and magical essence of the Spryte Soul Core justifies this price, reflecting its powerful defensive capabilities.

isle_delfino_sugar_cane_glove.name: Sugar Cane Glove
isle_delfino_sugar_cane_glove.description: The Sugar Cane Glove is a crystalline glove forged from the sugarcane fields of Isle Delfino, imbued with the essence of shining sprites. Crafted by the island's master artisans, it enhances the wearer’s agility in tropical terrains and fills the air with an inviting sweetness that draws nearby friendly creatures. Its sugar-infused weave grants a +25% increase to movement speed within dense foliage and marshes, while also attracting helpful companions within 10 meters of its wearer.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mobility
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the Sugar Cane Glove grants a +25% increase to movement speed while in tropical terrains such as dense foliage and marshes. This effect is passive and lasts until removed or when the wearer leaves the specified terrain.

effectDetails.title: Friendly Attraction
effectDetails.rules: The glove emits an inviting aura that attracts friendly creatures within 10 meters of its wearer for a duration of 8 hours. Once activated, it can be used again after completing a long rest.

isle_delfino_sugar_cane_glove.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers at the beginning of their journey, this item enhances mobility and social interactions in tropical environments.
isle_delfino_sugar_cane_glove.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is known for its sugarcane fields and masterful craftsmanship, making it the perfect place to source such enchanted items.
isle_delfino_sugar_cane_glove.shippingDetail: Ships via a spirit courier, arriving within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires no activation. Attracts friendly creatures upon use and lasts until the wearer leaves tropical terrain or completes a long rest.
usage.duration: Instantaneous attraction; lasts for 8 hours.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer leaves tropical terrains or after completing a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, one per long rest.

isle_delfino_sugar_cane_glove.priceReason: Balanced price considering its utility in tropical terrains and the enchantment required for such an item.

isle_delfino_sugar_fury_potion.name: Sugar Fury Elixir
isle_delfino_sugar_fury_potion.description: The Sugar Fury Elixir is a crystalline elixir that transforms into a shimmering, sugary mist when uncorked. Crafted in Isle Delfino's bustling markets, this potion grants swift bursts of energy and dexterity, perfect for outrunning the next rogue wave or sprinting to the beachside fiesta. A fleeting taste of pure sugar, it enhances your reflexes with a 5% dodge chance on hit and boosts attack speed by 20% for 12 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Attack Speed
effectDetails.rules: Increase your attack speed by 20% for 12 seconds. This effect ends if you take an action that requires a bonus action or if the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: Grants a +5 bonus to Dexterity saving throws and a 5% chance to dodge attacks on hit for the duration of the elixir. This effect ends when you take a major action or if the duration expires.

isle_delfino_sugar_fury_potion.levelRequirementReason: The Sugar Fury Elixir is a simple potion that can be used by any adventurer, as its effects are easily manageable for all levels.
isle_delfino_sugar_fury_potion.vendorReason: Isle Delfino, famous for its sugary treats and lively markets, is the perfect place to source such an elixir.
isle_delfino_sugar_fury_potion.shippingDetail: The Koopa Postal service delivers the Elixir within two days of purchase.

usage.activation: Drink the potion as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 12 seconds, expiring when you take an action that requires a bonus action or at the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends if you take a major action or if the effects are interrupted by another effect.

isle_delfino_sugar_fury_potion.priceReason: Given its simple yet effective enhancement, this elixir is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its utility and accessibility.

isle_delfino_sugar_soul_pearl.name: Sugar Soul Pearl
isle_delfino_sugar_soul_pearl.description: The Sugar Soul Pearl is a shimmering, crystalline orb that hums with the sweet energy of Delfino Isle's lullabies. Crafted from sugarcane and imbued with the essence of islander chants, it grants temporary buffs to nearby allies. When activated, it restores 30% of its wielder’s hit points and enhances their critical hit chance by +15%, each lasting for 5 seconds. This enchanted gem also bestows a 20% dodge chance on the next attack aimed at its user.

isle_delfino_sun_bloom_staff.name: Sun Bloom Staff
isle_delfino_sun_bloom_staff.description: The Sun Bloom Staff exudes a golden radiance that warms the hands of its wielder, crafted from the heartwood of tropical sunflowers and enchanted by the island's ancient magic. isle_delfino_sun_bloom_torch.name: Sun Bloom Torch
isle_delfino_sun_bloom_torch.description: The Sun Bloom Torch radiates a warm, golden glow that heals allies within its light and enhances their speed. Crafted from rare tropical blossoms and enchanted by Isle Delfino's alchemists, it shines brighter during tropical storms, casting a shimmering aura over darkened paths. isle_delfino_sun_burst_essence.name: Sunburst Essence
isle_delfino_sun_burst_essence.description: The Sunburst Essence is a crystalline fragment that pulses with golden light, emanating warmth and vitality. isle_delfino_sun_burst_essence.vendorReason: Isle Delfino's tropical vendors are known for their unique healing and utility items that enhance the capabilities of adventurers exploring sunlit zones.

isle_delfino_sun_drenched_bolt.name: Sun Drenched Bolt
isle_delfino_sun_drenched_bolt.description: The Sun Drenched Bolt is a crystalline shard forged from the heart of a tropical sunbeam, encased in a protective sheath of golden light. When unleashed, it fires an intense beam that deals radiant damage and leaves behind a trail of healing light that mends allies within its path. isle_delfino_sun_kissed_shield.name: Sun Kissed Shield
isle_delfino_sun_kissed_shield.description: The Sun Kissed Shield is a gleaming, radiant shield forged from the very essence of a sun-kissed day and enchanted by the playful magic of Shine Sprites. isle_delfino_sun_kissed_spirit.name: Sun Kissed Spirit

isle_delfino_sunbeam_sip.shippingDetail: Due to the perishable nature of the drink, it is shipped within a specially cooled container to ensure freshness upon arrival.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The effect concludes after 10 seconds or if the drinker takes any damage during its duration
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one sip can be consumed per battle

isle_delfino_sunbeam_sip.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant combat boost without being overpowered, this item is priced fairly for its utility.

isle_delfino_sunbeam_sprout.name: Sunbeam Sprout
isle_delfino_sunbeam_sprout.description: The Sunbeam Sprout is a vibrant, glowing plant that thrives in tropical waters, its leaves shimmering like sunlight on the sea's surface. When planted near water, it not only restores minor wounds but also attracts the playful Shine Sprites, whose ethereal glow adds an extra layer of protection and agility to your party. The sprout’s light is so serene that it can be used as a beacon for lost mariners or simply enjoyed during lulls in combat.

effectDetails.title: Restore Health
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Sunbeam Sprout restores 20 hit points to a creature. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Attract Shine Sprites
effectDetails.rules: For 10 seconds, the sprout attracts one Shine Sprite, which grants +10% attack speed to nearby allies within a 15-foot radius. The sprite remains until it is dismissed by an action or leaves on its own.

isle_delfino_sunbeam_sprout.levelRequirementReason: The Sunbeam Sprout's gentle nature and straightforward mechanics make it accessible to even the most novice adventurers.
isle_delfino_sunbeam_sprout.vendorReason: Isle Delfino is renowned for its lush tropical landscapes, making it the perfect vendor for items that thrive in such environments.
isle_delfino_sunbeam_sprout.shippingDetail: Shipped directly from the island's botanical gardens; delivery can be delayed by unpredictable ocean currents.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for health restoration, 10 seconds for attracting Shine Sprites
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed or lasts until its effect ends

isle_delfino_sunbeam_sprout.priceReason: The Sunbeam Sprout's rarity and the unique benefits it offers, including health restoration and temporary buffs from Shine Sprites, justify its moderate price.

isle_delfino_sunbeam_syringe.name: Sunbeam Syringe
isle_delfino_sunbeam_syringe.description: The Sunbeam Syringe is a vial of pure golden light, its surface etched with intricate patterns that shimmer under candlelight. When injected, this syringe grants you and your allies a burst of vitality, restoring 15% of your health while imbuing you with the strength of a midday sun.
