kivotos_triforce_ritual_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires attunement by a reincarnated soul, which typically aligns with characters of at least 8th level.
kivotos_triforce_ritual_amulet.vendorReason: Kivotos, the mystic trader, often carries relics from ancient temples and sacred sites, making this amulet a fitting addition to their inventory.
kivotos_triforce_ritual_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered within 3 days of order, with special handling for fragile artifacts like the Triforce Ritual Amulet.

usage.activation: Activated by touch near sacred temples or ruins.
usage.duration: 10 minutes while in proximity to sacred locations.
usage.endsWhen: Leaves a sacred location or moves more than 50 feet away.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the amulet remains attuned.

kivotos_triforce_ritual_amulet.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its epic rarity and unique attunement requirements for reincarnated souls.

klomp_pirate_peg.name: Klomp's Peg Leg
klomp_pirate_peg.description: Klomp's Peg Leg is a stout wooden appendage forged from the timbers of a sunken pirate ship. Its sturdiness echoes with the thunderous sound of cannon fire, and its craftsmanship ensures that every stomp feels like a command from the high seas. This relic grants you an advantage in Intimidation checks against pirates and offers a chance to startle them with your stomps, making it a fearsome tool on any deck or dock.

effectDetails.title: Stomp
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can stomp the ground. Creatures within 10 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) or be stunned until the end of their next turn. This effect has no cooldown and can be used multiple times per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on all Intimidation checks against pirates, making you a formidable figure in any sea-faring encounter. This benefit is permanent as long as the item remains equipped.

klomp_pirate_peg.levelRequirementReason: This peg leg offers an immediate boost to combat effectiveness and intimidation skills, making it suitable for lower-level characters who need a strong starting equipment option.
klomp_pirate_peg.vendorReason: The Rogue Port's Black Market is known for its eclectic mix of pirate paraphernalia, and Klomp's Peg Leg is a revered relic among the sea dogs.
klomp_pirate_peg.shippingDetail: Due to the size and weight, this item requires special handling by the Sea Wraith Express. Delivery may take an additional day beyond standard shipping times.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Stomp), Permanent (Advantage on Intimidation)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after multiple uses, recharges at dawn

klomp_pirate_peg.priceReason: The Peg Leg's rarity and unique effects justify its price, offering both combat utility and thematic value to any adventurer.

knights_gilded_golden_apple_pie_recipe.name: Recipe: Knights Gilded Golden Apple Pie
knights_gilded_golden_apple_pie_recipe.description: The Knights Gilded Golden Apple Pie Recipe is a rare culinary treasure from the grand halls of Gilded Bakers. This recipe yields a pie whose golden crust and gilded apples are both a feast for the eyes and soul. The pie's essence imbues the eater with knightly valor, granting +1 to Charisma (Intimidation) for 3 hours while also healing 1d6 hit points, as if tasting the strength of a true knight.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Eating this pie grants you advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks for the next 3 hours. This effect ends if you are unconscious or if you eat another meal that requires digestion.

effectDetails.title: Healing Delight
effectDetails.rules: Consume the pie to heal 1d6 hit points immediately. The pie's effects last until you finish digesting it, which takes 30 minutes.

knights_gilded_golden_apple_pie_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of mastering this recipe and its magical properties require a certain level of proficiency in culinary magic.
knights_gilded_golden_apple_pie_recipe.vendorReason: Gilded Bakers are renowned for their unique recipes that blend the ordinary with the extraordinary, making them the perfect purveyors of such a treasured pie recipe.
knights_gilded_golden_apple_pie_recipe.shippingDetail: The pie is delivered by Shiny Slice Scroll, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition and within an hour of order placement.

usage.duration: 3 hours or until you finish digestion (30 minutes).
usage.endsWhen: You become unconscious or eat another meal requiring digestion.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have completed a meal.

knights_gilded_golden_apple_pie_recipe.priceReason: The rare and magical ingredients used in this recipe, along with the expertise of Gilded Bakers, justify its high price.

knights_gilded_golden_bake_mold.name: Knights Gilded Golden Bake Mold
knights_gilded_golden_bake_mold.description: The Knights Gilded Golden Bake Mold is a meticulously crafted tool that transforms humble dough into gleaming golden pies. Its golden surface, lined with real gold leaf, not only adds an irresistible shine but also ensures your baked goods are perfectly shaped and presented. Each pie made with this mold garners +1 Charisma (Performance) check, and the mold itself never tarnishes, making it a must-have for any aspiring baker or host.

effectDetails.title: Golden Presentation
effectDetails.rules: When used to bake pies, the mold grants +1 to Charisma (Performance) checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Unyielding Durability
effectDetails.rules: The mold is made from a special blend that resists scratches and wear, requiring a DC 15 Craft check or a successful saving throw to damage it.

knights_gilded_golden_bake_mold.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet elegant tool requires no specific level as it aids in everyday baking.
knights_gilded_golden_bake_mold.vendorReason: The Knights Gilded Hall is renowned for its support of local artisans and bakers, offering quality equipment like this mold.
knights_gilded_golden_bake_mold.shippingDetail: Ships within the day with a delivery confirmation.

usage.activation: As a bonus action when using to shape dough into pies.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; effect lasts until end of next turn for each pie baked.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn after the last pie is baked.

knights_gilded_golden_bake_mold.priceReason: This mold provides a consistent +1 bonus to performance checks and its golden leaf lining ensures it remains in excellent condition.

knights_gilded_golden_tabard.name: Knights Gilded Golden Tabard
knights_gilded_golden_tabard.description: The Knights Gilded Golden Tabard is a shimmering piece of heraldic armor, its surface etched with noble crests and emblems. Crafted by the Gilded Knights from pure gold thread and enchanted with knightly pride, it not only enhances your charm but also dazzles foes into temporary blindness when worn in battle. The tabard’s golden threads are said to draw unwanted attention from thieves, yet they offer a subtle advantage in diplomatic settings.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Flash
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can wave the tabard to blind nearby foes for 1 minute (DC 14 CON save ends early). You may use this ability once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Thief's Bane
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the tabard, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to avoid detection by thieves. This effect does not stack with other similar abilities.

knights_gilded_golden_tabard.levelRequirementReason: This piece of armor is designed for knights who have proven their worth and are experienced enough in battle.
knights_gilded_golden_tabard.vendorReason: The Gilded Knights themselves ensure the tabard’s quality and authenticity, making it a trusted item among their ranks.
knights_gilded_golden_tabard.shippingDetail: The tabard is carefully packed to protect its delicate gold thread during shipment.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Blinding Flash; instantaneous for Stealth advantage
usage.endsWhen: Ends on a successful CON save or when the wearer takes damage, for Blinding Flash. Ends at the end of your next turn without using an action, for Stealth advantage.

knights_gilded_golden_tabard.priceReason: The tabard’s rarity and enchantments are balanced to reflect its craftsmanship and utility in both combat and diplomacy.

knights_gilded_shield_polish_service.name: Knights Gilded Shield Polish Service
knights_gilded_shield_polish_service.description: Knights Gilded Shield Polish Service polishes your shield with a knightly sheen, enhancing its appearance and combat prowess. The golden luster not only boosts your AC by +1 for 24 hours but also blinds any foe you block damage from, requiring them to succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be temporarily blinded. This polish is crafted by Gilded Squires using ancient techniques passed down through generations, ensuring its effectiveness and durability.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Armor Class
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The shield's armor class is temporarily increased by +1 for 24 hours. Ends when the user no longer has any uses of this service remaining.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Block
effectDetails.rules: When you block damage with this shield, any creature hit also must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn. The save DC is Wisdom based if you choose to use Charisma instead.

knights_gilded_shield_polish_service.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to ensure proficiency in using such a specialized service.
knights_gilded_shield_polish_service.vendorReason: The Knights Gilded Hall is renowned for its expertise in crafting and enhancing shields, making this polish one of their most popular services.
knights_gilded_shield_polish_service.shippingDetail: Ships within three days, delivered by Buff Cloth's fastest couriers.

usage.activation: Bonus action to apply the service.
usage.duration: 24 hours from application.
usage.endsWhen: Use is exhausted or when the shield is no longer wielded.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharged each long rest.

knights_gilded_shield_polish_service.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its specialized craftsmanship and unique effects.

kobold_innovation_slingpack.name: Kobold Innovation Slingpack
kobold_innovation_slingpack.description: The Kobold Innovation Slingpack is a jury-rigged backpack that launches alchemical surprises. It's crafted from salvaged materials and repurposed components, its straps cobbled together with threadbare leather. This device stores potent vials of acid, ice, or smoke, each one capable of dealing 1d6 damage and applying minor debuffs to targets within 30 feet. The Slingpack recharges daily at dawn, refilling itself with 1d4 fresh vials. However, there's a 5% chance it will misfire, hurling its payload back at the user instead.

effectDetails.title: Alchemical Surprise
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can launch one random alchemical vial (acid, ice, or smoke) at a target within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 damage of the vial’s type and suffer a minor debuff for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Recharge
effectDetails.rules: The Slingpack recharges daily at dawn, refilling itself with 1d4 fresh alchemical vials. It may malfunction once per day (5% chance), launching its payload back at the user instead of the intended target.

kobold_innovation_slingpack.levelRequirementReason: This item's complexity and utility make it accessible to lower-level characters, providing them with a versatile tool for combat and exploration.
kobold_innovation_slingpack.vendorReason: The Kobold Tinkerers Collective specializes in repurposed gadgets and salvaged devices, making the Slingpack a natural addition to their inventory.
kobold_innovation_slingpack.shippingDetail: Shipped via a slow but reliable rat-drawn cart, this item may arrive with minor delays due to the creatures' unpredictable routes.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (alchemical effect lasts until resolved)
usage.endsWhen: The vial's effect ends when it is used up or dispelled by another creature

kobold_innovation_slingpack.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity and utility, providing a balance between cost and value for players.

koopa_clown_car.name: Koopa Clown Car
koopa_clown_car.description: The Koopa Clown Car, a vehicle of Bowser's personal design, can transform its visage to reflect your health. As you take damage, its clownish face morphs from cheerful to sinister, mirroring your vitality with each blow. It hovers effortlessly at 40 feet per round, immune to ground-based attacks and capable of dropping bowling balls as a weapon. This vessel is more than just transportation; it's a companion that adapts to your every need.

effectDetails.title: Clownish Health Reflection
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage, the Koopa Clown Car's face changes expression to reflect your health. This effect is instantaneous and occurs once per turn.

effectDetails.title: Hovering Transport
effectDetails.rules: The vehicle has a fly speed of 40 feet. It can hover at this speed indefinitely as long as it remains within its charge limit.

koopa_clown_car.levelRequirementReason: Due to the advanced hover technology and health-reaction feature, only high-level characters should operate this vehicle.
koopa_clown_car.vendorReason: Valley Trading Post often deals in rare and exotic items from various realms, including Bowser's personal contraptions.
koopa_clown_car.shippingDetail: Ships via the Royal Airship Express within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Indefinite as long as it remains within its charge limit.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted when all charges are depleted; recharges after an 8-hour rest in a dimensional rift.

koopa_clown_car.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP due to its unique features and limited daily use.

koopa_karaoke_machine.name: Koopa Karaoke Machine
koopa_karaoke_machine.description: The Koopa Karaoke Machine is a portable, party-starting device crafted by Wario himself, featuring Bowser’s Greatest Hits—complete with his legendary angry voicemails. It grants advantage on Performance checks and allows you to cast Tasha's Hideous Laughter on all enemies within 30 feet once per day (DC 15 WIS save). The machine is loud enough to wake the undead in haunted areas, making it a party-crusher or a crowd-pleaser depending on your mood.

effectDetails.title: Performance Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants advantage on Performance checks for 1 hour, after which the device requires an 8-hour recharge.

effectDetails.title: Undead Attraction
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, cast Tasha's Hideous Laughter (DC 15 WIS save) on all enemies within 30 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute and has a range of 30 feet.

koopa_karaoke_machine.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second-level spellcasting to manage the device’s effects.
koopa_karaoke_machine.vendorReason: Wario Direct is known for its eclectic and eccentric inventory, making it a natural home for this one-of-a-kind gadget.
koopa_karaoke_machine.shippingDetail: Delivered by Wario’s Boombox Drone, which can only make deliveries within the Mushroom Kingdom due to its limited flight range.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (for Performance Boost), once per day for Undead Attraction
usage.duration: Performance Boost lasts 1 hour; Tasha's Hideous Laughter lasts 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Reaches its daily limit, or upon successful save against the Tasha's Hideous Laughter effect
usage.charges: 8-hour recharge required after using Performance Boost

koopa_karaoke_machine.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the device’s unique and powerful features, including the ability to cast a 2nd-level spell.

koopa_lantern.name: Lantern Koopa
koopa_lantern.description: The Lantern Koopa is a glowing ceramic shell that crackles with ethereal light, designed by the Mariner Guild to guide and protect seafarers from unseen dangers at sea. When hostile intent approaches within 30 feet, its red glow intensifies into a flashing beacon, warning all nearby of lurking threats. The lantern's warm luminescence casts a soft 20-foot radius of light, enhancing vision in dim illumination by +1 to passive Perception checks.

effectDetails.title: Red Alert for Hostile Presence
effectDetails.rules: When a hostile creature enters the Lantern Koopa's 30-foot radius, it emits an intermittent red glow. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action from the user.

effectDetails.title: Guiding Light
effectDetails.rules: While lit, the Lantern Koopa illuminates a 20-foot radius, providing advantage on passive Perception checks for creatures within its light. The lantern can be used passively until it requires recharging at dawn.

koopa_lantern.levelRequirementReason: The Lantern Koopa's basic design and functionality are accessible to most adventurers of any level.
koopa_lantern.vendorReason: As creators of the Lantern Koopa, the Mariner Guild ensures its quality and reliability for seafarers' safety.
koopa_lantern.shippingDetail: Ships via water courier, ensuring safe delivery to ports in a timely manner.

usage.duration: Instantaneous red alert; continuous light for up to 24 hours until recharging at dawn.
usage.endsWhen: Red alert ends when the hostiles leave the 30-foot radius; the lantern's light fades upon recharge or destruction.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, recharges daily at dawn.

koopa_lantern.priceReason: The Lantern Koopa is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its utility for adventurers navigating treacherous waters and avoiding ambushes.

koopa_leaf.name: Koopa Leaf
koopa_leaf.description: The Koopa Leaf, plucked from the verdant groves of Koopa Village, is more than just a simple leaf. When brewed into tea, it infuses the drink with a warm, earthy aroma and a hint of spicy mint. The leaves are said to have been gifted by the village's guardian spirits, lending them both mystical properties and a soothing scent that calms the mind. Sipping this tea restores mana or a 1st-level spell slot when consumed, and it is also surprisingly delicious, making for a refreshing treat after a long day of adventuring.

effectDetails.title: Mana Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When the Koopa Leaf tea is consumed, it restores either 3 mana points or allows the consumption of a 1st-level spell slot. This effect occurs once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Flavorful Refreshment
effectDetails.rules: The tea provides a flavorful and soothing experience, granting advantage on saving throws against exhaustion and fatigue for the duration of the short rest after drinking it.

koopa_leaf.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can afford to buy this common item, but its effects are beneficial enough that only those of at least first level can use them.
koopa_leaf.vendorReason: The valley trading post is known for its wide variety of common goods and curiosities, including the Koopa Leaf.
koopa_leaf.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days with no special handling required.

usage.activation: Consumed as part of a short rest
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the next long or short rest
usage.endsWhen: The short rest is completed, and it can be used once per short rest

koopa_leaf.priceReason: The Koopa Leaf's mystical properties and widespread use justify a price of 1000 XP.

koopa_shell_shield.name: Koopa Shell Shield
koopa_shell_shield.description: The Koopa Shell Shield is a reinforced green shell transformed into a formidable shield, forged by the industrious yet mischievous Koopa Troopas. Crafted from shells sourced from the Mushroom Kingdom's own forests, this shield provides robust protection and can be thrown as an improvised weapon, returning unerringly to its wielder with uncanny precision. Its ethically sourced nature ensures that each shell is a testament to the Koopa's craftsmanship, making it a reliable companion in battle.
effects: Can be thrown (20/60) for 1d6 bludgeoning damage

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Armor Class
effectDetails.rules: While the Koopa Shell Shield is equipped, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC. This effect persists while you are not incapacitated or prone.

effectDetails.title: Thrown Weapon
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can throw the shield up to 60 feet for 1d6 bludgeoning damage. The shield returns to your hand immediately after impact and does not require a thrown weapon attack roll. You must have at least one hand free to use this ability.

koopa_shell_shield.levelRequirementReason: This shield is designed for those just starting their journey, offering basic protection and utility without imposing a significant burden on a novice adventurer.
koopa_shell_shield.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post prides itself on providing essential gear to all adventurers, regardless of experience level, making the Koopa Shell Shield an accessible choice for beginners.
koopa_shell_shield.shippingDetail: Ships within one day with the Koopa Courier Corps; deliveries arrive in good condition due to their reliable service.

usage.activation: Equipped as a shield or thrown as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous return upon throwing, AC bonus persists while equipped and not prone.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day.

koopa_shell_shield.priceReason: The Koopa Shell Shield offers a solid balance of protection and utility for beginners, making it a fair value for its price in experience points.

koopa_troop_glider_kit.name: Koopa Troop Glider Kit
koopa_troop_glider_kit.description: The Koopa Troop Glider Kit is a compact, collapsible device crafted by the cunning Koopa Troopers for their rapid airborne maneuvers. When deployed from any height, it allows for controlled gliding with a descent rate of only 30 feet per round, ensuring safe landings even from great heights. The kit folds into a small backpack when not in use, making it an essential tool for covert operations and strategic deployments.

effectDetails.title: Safe Gliding
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the glider allows safe descent from any height. The user can move at a speed of 60 feet per round with a descent rate of 30 feet per round. This effect ends when the user lands safely or is otherwise incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Compact Storage
effectDetails.rules: The glider folds into a small backpack, which can be worn on the user's back and used at any time without additional preparation.

koopa_troop_glider_kit.levelRequirementReason: This basic yet effective device is suitable for beginners and those who need to move quickly but safely.
koopa_troop_glider_kit.vendorReason: The Koopa Troop Armory specializes in gear used by their troops, ensuring that the Glider Kit meets the highest standards of quality and reliability.
koopa_troop_glider_kit.shippingDetail: Delivered via a reinforced crate to ensure safe transport from the Koopa Troop Armory.

usage.duration: Instantaneous when deployed, ends on landing or incapacitation
usage.endsWhen: Landing safely or being incapacitated

koopa_troop_glider_kit.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the item's utility and rarity, making it a valuable addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

koopa_troop_mushroom_soup_recipe.name: Recipe: Koopa Mushroom Soup
koopa_troop_mushroom_soup_recipe.description: This hand-written recipe for Koopa Mushroom Soup, a bubbling elixir from the Mushroom Kingdom, imbues its consumer with +5 feet of speed for an hour. However, it comes with a side of misadventure—those who imbibe might slip on their own shoelaces and find themselves at risk of Dexterity saves. The soup's creator, Koopa Chefs, are known to test this potion on unsuspecting heroes before selling the recipe, ensuring its effectiveness and flavor are unparalleled.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: By consuming Koopa Mushroom Soup, you gain a +5 foot speed bonus for one hour. This effect is passive and lasts until it ends. The soup's potency can be negated by failing a Constitution saving throw (DC 12).

effectDetails.title: Slippery Side Effects
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one hour after consuming Koopa Mushroom Soup, you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws due to the slippery nature of the soup. This effect is also passive and ends when it expires.

koopa_troop_mushroom_soup_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for any adventurer who can meet its basic ingredient requirements.
koopa_troop_mushroom_soup_recipe.vendorReason: The Koopa Troops are renowned for their culinary prowess and frequently trade or sell recipes like this one.
koopa_troop_mushroom_soup_recipe.shippingDetail: The soup's ingredients must be shipped separately, increasing the delivery time by two days due to perishable nature. However, it ensures freshness upon arrival.

usage.activation: Eating Koopa Mushroom Soup is the only way to activate its effects.
usage.duration: One hour after consumption.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires or if you fail a Constitution saving throw (DC 12).
usage.charges: Unlimited, as each serving of soup can be consumed multiple times.

koopa_troop_mushroom_soup_recipe.priceReason: This recipe is priced moderately to reflect its unique effects and the challenge in acquiring all ingredients.

koopa_troop_patrol_scooter.name: Koopa Patrol Scooter
koopa_troop_patrol_scooter.description: The Koopa Patrol Scooter gleams under the moonlight, its flame-decaled frame a symbol of swift and efficient troop movement. This zippy scooter allows you to move swiftly through any battlefield, making your passage as silent as a whisper before erupting into an earsplitting 'vroom-vroom' when in motion. In times of need, a puff of smoke can blind enemies within a five-foot radius for a round, giving you the upper hand.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain a flying speed of 40 feet while mounted on the scooter. You can move through enemy spaces without provoking opportunity attacks, but you must end your movement in an unoccupied space.

effectDetails.title: Smoke Screen
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can exhale a puff of smoke from the scooter's exhaust, creating a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. Creatures in this area are blinded until the start of your next turn.

koopa_troop_patrol_scooter.levelRequirementReason: The scooter is designed for quick and agile maneuvers that even a novice can manage.
koopa_troop_patrol_scooter.vendorReason: As standard-issue equipment, the Koopa Patrol Scooter is a reliable tool provided by the troop to their members.
koopa_troop_patrol_scooter.shippingDetail: Shipped in an armored crate to ensure safe delivery through treacherous terrain and hostile environments.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for movement, lasts until the start of your next turn for the smoke screen
usage.endsWhen: The effects end if you lose control of the scooter or are knocked unconscious.

koopa_troop_patrol_scooter.priceReason: The scooter's flame-decaled design and efficient performance justify its moderate price.

koopa_troop_shell_oven.name: Koopa Troop Shell Oven
koopa_troop_shell_oven.description: The Koopa Troop Shell Oven is a portable oven crafted from polished Koopa shell and enchanted with the might of Bowser. It bakes mushrooms to perfection, granting advantage on cooking checks for soups (DC reduced by 2), while its retractable shell protects it in transit. This humble device, made by the Troop Tinkerers, is as sturdy as a Koopa's resolve and can be found at the Koopa Troop Kitchen.

effectDetails.title: Mushroom Mastery
effectDetails.rules: When used for cooking mushrooms, the user gains advantage on Cooking checks for soups. The oven reduces the DC of these checks by 2.

effectDetails.title: Shell Protection
effectDetails.rules: The oven retracts into a Koopa shell within seconds, providing protection and allowing it to be carried without damage.

koopa_troop_shell_oven.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective tool is accessible to all adventurers, enhancing their culinary skills.
koopa_troop_shell_oven.vendorReason: The Koopa Troop Kitchen specializes in items that help its patrons prepare and enjoy fungi delicacies.
koopa_troop_shell_oven.shippingDetail: Ships with a protective foam insert to ensure the oven remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; retracts into shell form immediately after use
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to reset the retractable feature

koopa_troop_shell_oven.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides useful benefits without overshadowing other cooking options.

koopa_troop_shell_polish_service.name: Koopa Troop Shell Polish Service
koopa_troop_shell_polish_service.description: The Koopa Troop Shell Polish Service revitalizes your armor or natural shell, giving it a gleaming polish that can intimidate reptilian foes. Under Koopa Detailers' expert hands, the surface of your armor gains +1 AC for 24 hours, a cosmetic enhancement that makes you appear more formidable to lizard-like threats. However, if your polishing becomes too elaborate, you might inadvertently attract Bowser’s scouts, who are ever-vigilant for signs of excessive shine.

effectDetails.title: Armor Gains +1 AC
effectDetails.rules: This cosmetic polish temporarily enhances the appearance of your armor, increasing its AC by 1 for a day. The effect is purely visual; it does not confer any additional physical protection beyond what you would normally receive from the armor.

effectDetails.title: Intimidation Checks +2 vs. Reptiles
effectDetails.rules: When making an Intimidation check against reptilian creatures, such as Bowser or his minions, this service grants a +2 bonus to your roll. This benefit lasts until you make another Intimidation check during the same day.

koopa_troop_shell_polish_service.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective service is accessible to all adventurers who wish to enhance their appearance and intimidation potential.
koopa_troop_shell_polish_service.vendorReason: Koopa Detailers are renowned for their expert craftsmanship, ensuring that every polish job leaves armor gleaming with a protective sheen.
koopa_troop_shell_polish_service.shippingDetail: The Turtle Wax Wagon delivers your polished armor within the week, but if you need it sooner, you can opt for an express service at additional cost.

usage.activation: A short application process takes place before you head out into battle or your next encounter. The polish is applied as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 24 hours
usage.endsWhen: The polish wears off after this time, either through natural fading or if the armor sustains damage that requires cleaning and reapplication.

koopa_troop_shell_polish_service.priceReason: The price reflects the expertise of Koopa Detailers in creating a visually impressive yet harmless enhancement.

koopa_troop_shell_shield.name: Koopa Troop Shell Shield
koopa_troop_shell_shield.description: The Koopa Troop Shell Shield is a vibrant green shell that can be worn as a mobile shield, providing both cover and protection. When you withdraw into it as a bonus action, your AC increases by +3 for the next round but your speed drops to 5 feet until the start of your next turn. The shield's power comes from Koopa Workshop #7, renowned for crafting unique armor pieces that blend function with whimsy. Its origin is mildly unsettling due to Bowser's face carved inside; a peculiar yet functional design.
effects: Speed reduced to 5 ft until next turn

effectDetails.title: Withdrawal Bonus Action
effectDetails.rules: When you withdraw into the Koopa Troop Shell Shield as a bonus action, your armor class (AC) increases by +3 for the next round. However, until the start of your next turn, your speed is reduced to 5 feet.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Speed Reduction
effectDetails.rules: The speed reduction lasts from the moment you withdraw into the shield until the start of your next turn. This effect ends when you move or take any other action that requires movement.

koopa_troop_shell_shield.levelRequirementReason: This level requirement ensures it's available to players early in their journey without overwhelming them.
koopa_troop_shell_shield.vendorReason: As Koopa Workshop #7's official armory, they stock unique items like the Koopa Troop Shell Shield.
koopa_troop_shell_shield.shippingDetail: Ships within one game week for Koopa Troop Armory customers.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: You move or take an action that requires movement
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short rest

koopa_troop_shell_shield.priceReason: This price reflects its unique design and limited functionality compared to other shields.

koopa_troop_shield.name: Koopa Troop Shield
koopa_troop_shield.description: The Koopa Troop Shield is a formidable shell encased in sturdy metal, forged by the industrious Koopa Troops. This shield not only grants you +2 AC but also offers a tactical advantage: when tucked into your shell as a bonus action, you gain resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage, though your speed drops to 0. Should you choose to kick it during combat, you unleash a powerful force wave that pushes enemies back.

effectDetails.title: Shell Defense
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. You gain resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage until the start of your next turn. Your speed is reduced to 0 while in this state.

effectDetails.title: Tuck and Push
effectDetails.rules: Activates when you kick the shield during combat as a bonus action. A wave of force pushes all creatures within 10 feet of you, knocking them prone if they fail a DC 13 Strength saving throw. The push has no effect on creatures that have a higher AC than your current AC.

koopa_troop_shield.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 4th level to wield effectively due to the shield's complexity and weight.
koopa_troop_shield.vendorReason: The Koopa Troops are known for their expertise in crafting sturdy, versatile armor and weapons.
koopa_troop_shield.shippingDetail: Ships via Turtle Tanks with a 1-day delivery time within the Mushroom Kingdom.

usage.activation: Bonus action to tuck into shell; bonus action or reaction to kick as an attack.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and ends when you move out of your shell, or if you use your action on another task.
usage.endsWhen: You are no longer in your shell or you take any action other than moving.

koopa_troop_shield.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the shield's unique combination of defense and offensive capabilities.

koopa_troop_spiked_helmet_cap.name: Koopa Troop Spiked Helmet Cap
koopa_troop_spiked_helmet_cap.description: The Koopa Troop Spiked Helmet Cap is a menacing headgear adorned with durable spikes that give you the look of Bowser's elite. This cap not only intimidates foes but also protects its wearer, as the spikes deliver a minor jab when you roll an 1s on your dice. It’s crafted by Koopa Hatters and endorsed by Bowser himself; it might even get you noticed for recruitment into his army.
effects: +1 to Intimidation checks against small creatures
Spikes poke you on a natural 1 (1 damage, ouch!)

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Presence
effectDetails.rules: When you make an Intimidation check against a creature smaller than you, add +1 to the roll. This effect is always active.

effectDetails.title: Spike Jabs
effectDetails.rules: If you roll a natural 1 on your attack or saving throw dice, take 1 piercing damage from the spikes. This effect triggers once per short or long rest.

koopa_troop_spiked_helmet_cap.levelRequirementReason: This cap is designed for beginners to provide them with a bit of intimidation and protection.
koopa_troop_spiked_helmet_cap.vendorReason: The barracks stock this item as part of their basic gear line, catering to new recruits who need both form and function.
koopa_troop_spiked_helmet_cap.shippingDetail: Shipped within a protective shell-mailer for durability during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous spikes poke you on a natural 1.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short or long rest.

koopa_troop_spiked_helmet_cap.priceReason: The price reflects the cap's quality craftsmanship and Bowser's approval, making it a fair deal for its utility and rarity.

kraken_taming_collar.name: Kraken Taming Collar (Adult Size)
kraken_taming_collar.description: The Kraken Taming Collar, a storm giant leather collar adorned with ancient binding runes, whispers of sea magic as it encircles its wearer's neck. Crafted by the Stormshapers Guild from the very bones of fallen krakens, this collar holds the power to bind one of these massive creatures into loyal servitude. To apply it, you must successfully perform a DC 25 Animal Handling check. Once bound, the Kraken becomes your steadfast companion in battle and exploration.
effects: Binds a Kraken as Loyal Companion

effectDetails.title: Binding a Kraken
effectDetails.rules: To apply the collar, make an Animal Handling check with a DC of 25. On a success, you can bind one kraken within 30 feet as your loyal companion for up to 8 hours per day. The kraken remains bound until released or until the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Kraken Companion
effectDetails.rules: Your bound kraken serves and protects you with unwavering loyalty. It can be commanded to perform tasks within its capabilities, such as fighting your foes or assisting in exploration. The kraken is immune to fear effects and cannot be charmed.

kraken_taming_collar.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant power and experience to handle the immense responsibility of a bound kraken.
kraken_taming_collar.vendorReason: The Sea Hunter has exclusive access to rare and powerful sea-related artifacts like the Kraken Taming Collar.
kraken_taming_collar.shippingDetail: Ships via Triton courier, ensuring safe delivery from deep-sea sources.

usage.activation: Requires a successful DC 25 Animal Handling check to apply and bind the kraken.
usage.duration: 8 hours per day for up to one week before requiring reapplication.
usage.endsWhen: The kraken is released or the duration expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have the collar.

kraken_taming_collar.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its immense power and rarity in crafting.

kremling_krew_cannonball_grill.name: Kremling Krew Cannonball Grill
kremling_krew_cannonball_grill.description: The Kremling Krew Cannonball Grill is a ferocious cooking device forged from iron and imbued with the spirit of battle. Made by K. Rool's Outdoor Cooking, this grill uses cannonballs as fuel, creating meals that sizzle and pop with an explosive aroma. Each cannonball not only cooks one meal but also imparts a smoky, gunpowder flavor, enhancing your next attack with +1 fire damage. Be wary, for the grill occasionally fires its cannonball in a blinding arc—those caught in the blast must succeed on a DEX save (DC 14) or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

effectDetails.title: Cannonball Fuel
effectDetails.rules: Activates on use. Each cannonball used to fuel the grill cooks one meal and grants +1 fire damage on your next attack. The grill can hold up to three cannonballs at a time.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Flavor
effectDetails.rules: At the end of each of your turns, there is a 25% chance that the grill will discharge its cannonball as if it had been used. Targets within 10 feet must succeed on a DEX save (DC 14) or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

kremling_krew_cannonball_grill.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to ensure proficiency with the grill's explosive nature.
kremling_krew_cannonball_grill.vendorReason: K. Rool’s Outdoor Cooking is known for their innovative and dangerous culinary creations, making them a prime vendor for this unique item.
kremling_krew_cannonball_grill.shippingDetail: Ships via Cannonball Express, delivered by a cannon-armed courier to ensure the grill arrives in one piece.

usage.activation: Use an action to light the grill and place a cannonball inside. The grill can hold up to three cannonballs at a time.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effects; each cannonball used or discharged ends its effect immediately.
usage.endsWhen: The grill is empty of cannonballs, or when it discharges its cannonball during use.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges as long as the grill has fuel.

kremling_krew_cannonball_grill.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the item's unique and dangerous nature while remaining within a reasonable price range for an uncommon item.

kremling_krew_cannonball_polishing.name: Kremling Krew Cannonball Polishing
kremling_krew_cannonball_polishing.description: The Kremling Krew Cannonball Polishing is a meticulously hand-crafted polishing kit that ensures your cannonballs gleam with a lustrous sheen, enhancing not only their combat effectiveness but also your reputation in battle. Each day's diligent polishing grants you a +1 damage bonus to your cannon fire (psychologically intimidating foes), and foes within 20 feet gain disadvantage on Intimidation checks against you. Fail to polish them daily, however, and they tarnish, reducing the damage by -1 and imposing a -2 penalty on attack rolls for one week.

effectDetails.title: Psychological Edge
effectDetails.rules: When your cannonballs are polished, you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls with cannons. Enemies within 20 feet of you have disadvantage on Intimidation checks against you. This effect ends if the cannonballs tarnish or if they are not polished for five consecutive days.

effectDetails.title: Tarnished Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: If your cannonballs are not polished daily, they will tarnish after one week of neglect. Once tarnished, you suffer a -1 penalty to damage rolls with cannons and a -2 penalty on attack rolls for one week. This effect is immediately restored by polishing the cannonballs.

kremling_krew_cannonball_polishing.levelRequirementReason: A basic understanding of maintenance and care skills is necessary to ensure the kit's effectiveness.
kremling_krew_cannonball_polishing.vendorReason: K. Rool's Polishers are renowned for their meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that every cannonball shines with a luster that can turn the tide of battle.
kremling_krew_cannonball_polishing.shippingDetail: Delivered by Cannonball Express, known for its swift and reliable service within the kingdom's borders.

usage.duration: Until tarnished or re-polished
usage.endsWhen: Tarnishes after one week of neglect

kremling_krew_cannonball_polishing.priceReason: Balanced to ensure a fair price for the ongoing maintenance and psychological benefits it provides.

kremling_krew_croc_jaw_clamps.name: Kremling Krew Croc Jaw Clamps
kremling_krew_croc_jaw_clamps.description: The Kremling Krew Croc Jaw Clamps are ingeniously crafted from the resilient bones of swamp crocs, their bite as firm and predictable as a jungle storm. These clamps not only secure food with unyielding strength but also grant +1 to Strength checks for holding and preparing stew meat. Their design ensures they last through countless meals in the swamps, earning them a reputation among Krew Carvers as both reliable tools and a symbol of their craftsmanship.

effectDetails.title: Clamp Securely
effectDetails.rules: When used to hold or prepare stew meat, the clamps provide a +1 bonus to Strength checks. This effect is passive while in use and lasts until the task is completed.

effectDetails.title: Strengthen Grip
effectDetails.rules: The clamps are made from swamp croc bones, providing a +2 bonus to AC when worn as bracers during meat-preparation activities. This benefit lasts for 1 hour or until the user stops wearing them in such conditions.

kremling_krew_croc_jaw_clamps.levelRequirementReason: These clamps are designed for anyone who needs to handle stew meat securely, making no level requirement necessary.
kremling_krew_croc_jaw_clamps.vendorReason: The Krew Carvers specialize in tools that withstand the harsh swamp conditions and the Kremling Krew Croc Jaw Clamps are a testament to their mastery of such craftsmanship.
kremling_krew_croc_jaw_clamps.shippingDetail: Shipped carefully packed, these clamps arrive with a protective layer of moss and mud to ensure they reach you in prime condition.

usage.activation: Passive while used for preparing stew meat; +2 AC when worn as bracers during such activities.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Clamp Securely) / 1 hour (Strengthen Grip)
usage.endsWhen: The task is completed or the user stops wearing them in preparation activities, respectively.

kremling_krew_croc_jaw_clamps.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, these clamps offer reliable and useful benefits without being overpowered.

kremling_krew_croc_scale_boots.name: Kremling Krew Croc Scale Boots
kremling_krew_croc_scale_boots.description: The Kremling Krew Croc Scale Boots are crafted from the armored hide of a swamp crocodile, their scales interwoven into supple leather. These boots not only confer a step that echoes through wetlands but also grant their wearer a natural resistance to water damage and advantage on Athletics checks in such terrain. The creaks they make when stepped in mud hint at their ancient origins from the Krew Tanners of the swamp, whose secrets lie deep within the mire.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Athletics
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on all Athletics checks made in swamps or similar wet environments. This effect lasts until you finish a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Water Damage Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The boots provide a +2 bonus to AC against any water-based damage, including splash attacks and environmental effects like acid pools. This benefit persists for the duration of your time spent in wet conditions.

kremling_krew_croc_scale_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are designed to be accessible to lower-level adventurers who need to navigate treacherous swamps.
kremling_krew_croc_scale_boots.vendorReason: The Krew Tanners have long been masters of crafting gear for swamp-dwellers, and these boots bear their hallmark craftsmanship.
kremling_krew_croc_scale_boots.shippingDetail: Boots arrive with a special coating to help prevent water damage during shipment through the wetlands.

usage.duration: Until you finish a long rest or are no longer in a swampy environment
usage.endsWhen: You complete a long rest or exit a swampy area

kremling_krew_croc_scale_boots.priceReason: The boots offer significant utility for navigating wetlands at an accessible price, making them a valuable addition to any adventurer's inventory.

kremling_krew_crocodile_stew_recipe.name: Recipe: Kremling Krew Crocodile Stew
kremling_krew_crocodile_stew_recipe.description: This parchment bears the faded recipe for Kremling Krew's legendary Crocodile Stew. The ink, once vibrant, now hints at the swampy origin of this tough stew. Prepared with bite-force strong swamp crocs, it not only strengthens your jaws but also toughens your resolve in combat. Eat the stew to gain advantage on bite and grapple attacks for 3 hours; the taste alone is enough to remind you of the Krew's resilience.

effectDetails.title: Stew of Resilience
effectDetails.rules: Eating this stew grants you advantage on bite and grapple attack rolls for 3 hours. The effect ends if you eat another meal or take a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Bite and Grapple Advantage
effectDetails.rules: For the duration, your bite attacks deal an additional +1d6 damage to creatures of Large size or smaller. This effect is cumulative with any other similar ability.

kremling_krew_crocodile_stew_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe can be used by characters of all levels as it focuses on the inherent toughness and resilience it imparts.
kremling_krew_crocodile_stew_recipe.vendorReason: The Krew Cooks have perfected this stew, making them the only reliable source for its recipe.
kremling_krew_crocodile_stew_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Snappy Stew Scroll, ensuring freshness and flavor upon arrival.

usage.activation: Eating one serving of the stew
usage.duration: 3 hours
usage.endsWhen: After eating another meal or taking a long rest

kremling_krew_crocodile_stew_recipe.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity and the unique flavor that this recipe brings to any dish.

kremling_krew_crocodile_teeth_amulet_ser.name: Kremling Krew Crocodile Teeth Amulet Service
kremling_krew_crocodile_teeth_amulet_ser.description: This amulet, crafted from a rare swamp crocodile’s teeth by Krew Shamans, enhances your bite attacks and intimidates foes in swamps. When you wear it, your teeth chatter ominously at signs of hunger or stress, sending a chilling message to those who dare approach too closely. The talisman's power is tied to the Krew Shamans' ancient magic, making it both an effective tool and a symbol of their mystic prowess.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Bite Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When you use the bite attack action, you deal an additional 1d4 damage for a duration of 24 hours. This effect can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Swamp Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: While within swampland terrain, you have advantage on Intimidation checks against creatures with the Swamp creature type. This ability is always active while in a swamp and does not require an action to use.

kremling_krew_crocodile_teeth_amulet_ser.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's magic is simple enough for even low-level adventurers to wield.
kremling_krew_crocodile_teeth_amulet_ser.vendorReason: As the creators of this artifact, Krew Shamans are the most knowledgeable and reliable source for their crafted items.
kremling_krew_crocodile_teeth_amulet_ser.shippingDetail: The amulet is shipped in a sealed case to protect its sharp teeth from damage during transit.

usage.duration: 24 hours per use, ends at the start of your next short rest.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next short rest after using it once.

kremling_krew_crocodile_teeth_amulet_ser.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and unique crafting process justify a cost of 1000 XP.

kremling_krew_fake_crown_replica.name: Kremling Krew Fake Crown Replica
kremling_krew_fake_crown_replica.description: This plastic crown replica of K. Rool’s infamous design is so lifelike that it shimmers with a faint, indigo glow when held to the light. It grants you an advantage on Intimidation checks against Kremlings but also brings unwanted attention, as it makes you look comically out of place among other creatures. Should you fail to return it to its rightful owner after a month, the chance of K. Rool himself appearing to reclaim his crown increases by 10% each day.
effects: Advantage on Intimidation checks with Kremlings
Disadvantage on Charisma checks with other creatures

effectDetails.title: K. Rool's Glare
effectDetails.rules: When you fail to return the crown to K. Rool within a month, there is a cumulative 10% chance each day thereafter that he will appear to reclaim it. This effect can be mitigated by returning the crown or performing a heroic act in front of a K. Rool statue.

effectDetails.title: Comical Disguise
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this crown, you are considered disarmed and suffer disadvantage on Charisma checks with all other creatures. This effect does not stack with any other similar effects.

kremling_krew_fake_crown_replica.levelRequirementReason: The crown is simple enough for even a novice adventurer to use.
kremling_krew_fake_crown_replica.vendorReason: Kremling Krew’s Prop Department specializes in creating such faithful replicas of their master's belongings.
kremling_krew_fake_crown_replica.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Barrel Cannon with a free celebratory Kremling Krew plushie for your first order.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn, recharge on returning to K. Rool or performing a heroic act in front of a statue of him.
usage.duration: Instantaneous upon donning; persists until removed or mitigated by an appropriate action.
usage.endsWhen: The crown is returned to K. Rool or the wearer performs a heroic act in front of his statue, reducing the chance of K. Rool appearing each day thereafter.

kremling_krew_fake_crown_replica.priceReason: Balanced as it offers a unique and thematic advantage while introducing an ongoing narrative challenge.

kremling_krew_kannon.name: Kremling Krew Kannon
kremling_krew_kannon.description: The Kremling Krew Kannon, a small but formidable firearm crafted in the bustling workshops of Dapper Dan’s Workshop, is as much a symbol of the Krew's ingenuity as it is a weapon of chaos. This blunderbuss produces a deafening boom that shatters eardrums and startles foes within 300 feet. Its loud report not only dazes them but also disrupts their focus, leaving them reeling in fright for a moment.

effectDetails.title: Rumble Shot
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with the Kremling Krew Kannon, all creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 round. This effect can only occur once per target per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Frightening Boom
effectDetails.rules: The weapon emits a loud report that affects all creatures within 300 feet, requiring them to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. This effect can only occur once per target per long rest.

kremling_krew_kannon.levelRequirementReason: To wield such a weapon of chaos and sound requires mastery over both combat and the unpredictable nature of the Krew’s craftsmanship.
kremling_krew_kannon.vendorReason: The Kremling Krew Arsenal is well-known for its unique and powerful firearms, making it the perfect vendor for such a weapon.
kremling_krew_kannon.shippingDetail: Delivered via Barrel Cannon Express, ensuring the weapon arrives safely and with a loud 'whoosh'!

usage.activation: As a bonus action to fire once per turn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target succeeds on its saving throw or after its duration expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per target per long rest.

kremling_krew_kannon.priceReason: Balanced to reflect a rare and powerful weapon that can both damage enemies and disrupt their minds.

kremling_krew_kannonball.name: Kremling Krew Kannonball
kremling_krew_kannonball.description: The Kremling Krew Kannonball is a meticulously crafted cannonball, its surface polished to a mirror finish despite its iron composition. Designed for precision and power, it glides through the air with surprising aerodynamics, making it an indispensable part of the Kremling Krew's siege tactics. This cannonball deals 3d10 bludgeoning damage when hitting a direct target and can be used as an improvised weapon delivering 2d6 bludgeoning damage in close combat.

effectDetails.title: Direct Hit Damage
effectDetails.rules: When the Kremling Krew Kannonball hits a direct target with a successful hit, it deals 3d10 bludgeoning damage. This effect is used once per day and requires a ranged attack roll.

effectDetails.title: Improvised Weapon
effectDetails.rules: If wielded in close combat, the Kremling Krew Kannonball can be used as an improvised weapon, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage. This use is limited to once per long rest and requires a successful Strength (Athletics) check.

kremling_krew_kannonball.levelRequirementReason: This cannonball is designed for basic tactical use and does not require high-level expertise.
kremling_krew_kannonball.vendorReason: The Kremling Krew is known for their ship cannons, so it's natural that they would sell the ammunition used in them.
kremling_krew_kannonball.shippingDetail: Shipped securely within a reinforced wooden crate to prevent damage during transit.

usage.activation: Ranged Weapon Attack or as an Improvised Weapon
usage.duration: Instantaneous, once per day for Cannonball effect; once per long rest for Improvised Weapon effect
usage.endsWhen: Used up and can be reloaded for future use; ends with the end of a long rest

kremling_krew_kannonball.priceReason: The cannonball's unique design, quality materials, and specialized crafting contribute to its high cost.

kremling_krew_piracy_consulting.name: Kremling Krew Piracy Consulting
kremling_krew_piracy_consulting.description: The Kremling Krew Piracy Consulting is a rare curriculum that teaches you the ins and outs of maritime law and naval strategy. For seven days, you gain advantage on any checks related to ship navigation or boarding, making your maneuvers aboard vessels both swift and precise. However, the consulting comes with a humorous side effect; you'll be involuntarily exclaiming 'Yarrr!' at the start of every combat encounter, adding a dash of whimsy to your otherwise serious endeavors.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Navigation Checks
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on checks related to navigating or boarding ships for a duration of seven days. This effect is not cumulative with other sources of similar advantages.

effectDetails.title: Involuntary Yarrr! Exclamation
effectDetails.rules: At the start of every combat, you must make an involuntary sound by exclaiming 'Yarrr!' This can be silenced only if you succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

kremling_krew_piracy_consulting.levelRequirementReason: The curriculum requires at least sixth-level proficiency in navigation or strategy to understand its complex teachings.
kremling_krew_piracy_consulting.vendorReason: As the creators of the consulting, Kremling Krew ensures that only those who can truly benefit from it receive it.
kremling_krew_piracy_consulting.shippingDetail: The Barrel Cannon delivers your consulting with a splash of pirate flair, ensuring it arrives in one piece but may require some unsealing upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous advantage on checks for seven days
usage.endsWhen: Seven days pass or the consulting is destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once per day

kremling_krew_piracy_consulting.priceReason: The curriculum balances as a rare item that offers significant tactical advantages without being game-breaking.

kremling_krew_recipe_cannonball_calamari.name: Recipe: Kremling Krew Cannonball Calamari
kremling_krew_recipe_cannonball_calamari.description: The Kremling Krew's cannonball of calamari, a culinary concoction of squids marinated in gunpowder and fired from an ancient cannon. This explosive treat grants you resistance to thunder damage for 1 hour and imbues your voice with the gravelly resonance of a seasoned pirate captain, making it easier to intimidate others but harder to charm them. The air around you is filled with small bursts of sparks as you burp, adding a fiery flair to your meal.
effects: Voice becomes gravelly: advantage on Intimidation checks, disadvantage on Persuasion checks

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Thunder Damage
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to thunder damage for 1 hour. This effect ends if you take a short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Gravelly Voice
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of this effect, you have advantage on Intimidation checks and disadvantage on Persuasion checks. The effect lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

kremling_krew_recipe_cannonball_calamari.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for any brave adventurer to craft.
kremling_krew_recipe_cannonball_calamari.vendorReason: The Kremling Krew are notorious for their culinary and explosive experiments, making this cannonball a natural addition to their offerings.
kremling_krew_recipe_cannonball_calamari.shippingDetail: Ships via Cannonball Express with next-day delivery if purchased before noon.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Completion of a short or long rest

kremling_krew_recipe_cannonball_calamari.priceReason: The unique ingredients and preparation method make this cannonball a rare delicacy, justifying its moderate price.

kremling_krew_wario_kannonball.name: Kremling Krew Wario Kannonball
kremling_krew_wario_kannonball.description: The Kremling Krew Wario Kannonball is a cannonball with Wario's mischievous face etched into its surface. Crafted by K. Rool’s Engravers, this weapon whistles 'WAH!' as it flies through the air, drawing the attention of nearby foes and disrupting their plans. Its use as a thrown weapon deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage, but the distinctive sound gives enemies a moment to react, granting them advantage on their next action.

effectDetails.title: Whistling Whistle
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as a weapon, the cannonball whistles 'WAH!' in flight. This sound gives enemies within 30 feet disadvantage on their next attack roll and action checks.

effectDetails.title: Surprise Disruption
effectDetails.rules: Enemies who hear the cannonball's whistle have advantage on saving throws against being surprised until the end of their next turn.

kremling_krew_wario_kannonball.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for players of all levels to enjoy its unique abilities.
kremling_krew_wario_kannonball.vendorReason: The Kremling Krew are known for their mischievous wares, and this cannonball fits right into their catalog of quirky items.
kremling_krew_wario_kannonball.shippingDetail: Delivered by the trusted Cannonball Express with a special delivery note from Wario himself.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect
usage.endsWhen: The cannonball hits, is caught, or misses its target

kremling_krew_wario_kannonball.priceReason: This item provides unique battlefield disruption and a touch of Wario's humor at an affordable price.

kremling_krew_wario_krocodile.name: Kremling Krew Wario Krocodile
kremling_krew_wario_krocodile.description: The Kremling Krew Wario Krocodile, a fearsome croc with Wario's signature mustache and eyes of pure malice, is a living testament to K. Rool's pet shop expertise. This beast not only intimidates foes but also exacts a price for its services, siphoning 1d4 gold pieces daily from any creature within reach. Feed it garlic or risk its wrath; the croc's displeasure spells financial ruin. Its training by Wario ensures it remains loyal to K. Rool's whims.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Presence
effectDetails.rules: When the Kremling Krew Wario Krocodile is within 30 feet of a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and is no longer frightened on a success.

effectDetails.title: Daily Gold Drain
effectDetails.rules: Each day, any creature within 5 feet of the Kremling Krew Wario Krocodile loses 1d4 gold pieces. This effect ends if the crocodile is fed garlic by its owner or if it is otherwise removed from the area.

kremling_krew_wario_krocodile.levelRequirementReason: The creature's training and power require at least a level 3 character to handle effectively.
kremling_krew_wario_krocodile.vendorReason: Kremling Krew specializes in unique, dangerous pets, and this crocodile is no exception.
kremling_krew_wario_krocodile.shippingDetail: The courier delivers the creature securely, ensuring it arrives in its signature pose with a mustache that demands respect.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation occurs automatically when within range of creatures.
usage.duration: Until fed garlic or removed from area.
usage.endsWhen: Fed garlic by owner or moved out of the area.

kremling_krew_wario_krocodile.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its unique training, daily upkeep, and the risk it poses.

lab_coat_with_explosive_pockets.name: Fawful's Furious Mad Scientist Coat
lab_coat_with_explosive_pockets.description: Fawful's Furious Mad Scientist Coat is a lab coat that conceals pockets packed with explosive materials, though it never detonates as long as you remain calm and focused. The coat itself seems to hum with latent energy during experiments, hinting at the volatile forces it can harness. Made by Fawful’s Lab, this coat grants mad scientists an edge in their chaotic work, providing a +1 bonus on Intelligence (Investigation) checks for inventions.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Pocket Safety
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the coat and remaining calm, you have advantage on saving throws against effects that would detonate explosives in your pockets. The coat’s safety feature prevents explosions as long as you do not panic or act rashly.

effectDetails.title: Bubbling during Experiments
effectDetails.rules: The coat produces a bubbling sound and visible steam when you are conducting experiments, providing advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks for inventions. This effect lasts until the start of your next long rest.

lab_coat_with_explosive_pockets.levelRequirementReason: Fawful’s Furious Mad Scientist Coat is designed for experienced mad scientists who have proven their ability to handle volatile situations calmly.
lab_coat_with_explosive_pockets.vendorReason: Fawful's Lab specializes in crafting items that cater to the eccentric needs of mad scientists, ensuring this coat meets its rigorous safety and performance standards.
lab_coat_with_explosive_pockets.shippingDetail: The coat is shipped via Fuming Fabric’s express courier service, which delivers with same-day delivery within the city limits. Outside the city, it arrives in two days.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required when wearing the coat and remaining calm during experiments.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next long rest or until you panic or act rashly.
usage.endsWhen: The coat’s safety feature is disabled if you panic or act rashly, requiring a short rest to recharge.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges at the start of each long rest.

lab_coat_with_explosive_pockets.priceReason: At 1000 XP, this coat balances its unique safety and utility features with the expertise required to use it effectively.

lakitu_cloud_cushion.name: Lakitu Cloud Cushion
lakitu_cloud_cushion.description: The Lakitu Cloud Cushion is a plush, ethereal cloud cushion that drifts lazily in the sky. Crafted from the finest clouds of Lakitu's realm, it provides a soft landing for naps and impromptu escapes. When you sit upon it, the cushion gently rises to hover 10 feet off the ground at your command, offering a serene levitation. Should sadness weigh heavy on your heart, the cushion showers you with gentle raindrops that soothe your spirit.

effectDetails.title: Hover 10 ft Off Ground
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the cushion allows you to rise up to 10 feet into the air and maintain this height as long as it is not disrupted. It does not grant movement; instead, it levitates you passively. This effect ends if you take damage or when you willingly land.

effectDetails.title: Comfort +5 to Rest Rolls
effectDetails.rules: When used on a bed or similar resting surface, the cushion provides an additional +5 bonus to your rest roll for the night. It can only be used once per day and requires at least 8 hours of uninterrupted rest.

lakitu_cloud_cushion.levelRequirementReason: The cushion's gentle nature and ease of use make it accessible to all adventurers, ensuring that even the newest heroes can enjoy its benefits.
lakitu_cloud_cushion.vendorReason: As purveyors of celestial wonders, Comet Observatory is well-known for offering items that connect mortals with the sky realm. The Lakitu Cloud Cushion is a perfect example of this philosophy.
lakitu_cloud_cushion.shippingDetail: The cushion is delivered by Sky Delivery via a fleet of cloud-chariots, ensuring swift and safe arrival to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous when first used; lasts until disrupted
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or willingly land
usage.charges: Unlimited, once per day for rest rolls

lakitu_cloud_cushion.priceReason: The cushion's rarity and the unique benefits it provides justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

lakitu_cloud_lease.name: Lakitu Cloud Lease (30 Days)
lakitu_cloud_lease.description: The Lakitu Cloud Lease is a rare contract that binds you to the service of a personal raincloud for thirty days. The cloud, a marvel of nature and alchemy, hovers at your command with a gentle, steady presence. With it, you can summon light rain to water crops or extinguish fires—nature's own solution to your needs. Optional: Call upon Lakitu to drop one Spiny daily as part of the lease, adding a touch of chaos to your adventures.

effectDetails.title: Hover Flight
effectDetails.rules: You gain a fly speed of 30 feet (hover) for the duration of the lease. This effect is passive and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Rainfall Control
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can summon light rain within a 20-foot radius centered on you. The rain creates difficult terrain in that area for one hour or until the weather changes. This effect has no save DC and is usable once per day.

lakitu_cloud_lease.levelRequirementReason: The Lakitu Cloud Lease is accessible to beginners, as it provides a useful service without overwhelming challenges.
lakitu_cloud_lease.vendorReason: The Comet Observatory specializes in unique and rare services that align with celestial magic, making the Lakitu Cloud Lease a fitting addition to their offerings.
lakitu_cloud_lease.shippingDetail: Delivered by a weather balloon, ensuring your cloud is in perfect condition upon arrival.

usage.duration: 30 days from the start of the lease.
usage.endsWhen: The lease expires or you breach the contract terms.

lakitu_cloud_lease.priceReason: The Lakitu Cloud Lease is priced at a fair value, considering its unique utility and the rarity of such services in the market.

lakitu_fishing_rod.name: Lakitu Fishing Rod
lakitu_fishing_rod.description: The Lakitu Fishing Rod is a sleek, metallic rod forged from ancient Lakitu wood and adorned with silver runes that shimmer under moonlight. It allows you to reel in distant objects as if by magic, pulling them closer than they appear, or ensnare foes with a flick of the wrist. This relic is not just for fishing; it's a weapon of the sea and sky, capable of retrieving treasures from deep waters.

effectDetails.title: Reel In
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Choose an object or creature up to 60 feet away that is not anchored; the target must make a Strength saving throw (DC 14). On a failed save, it is pulled closer by 20 feet towards you.

effectDetails.title: Fishing Mastery
effectDetails.rules: While holding this rod, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in water or underwater. Additionally, you can fish out items from bodies of water with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Nature) check.

lakitu_fishing_rod.levelRequirementReason: This rod is designed for beginners and adventurers alike, making it accessible early on.
lakitu_fishing_rod.vendorReason: The Lakitu Fishing Rod is a popular item among the villagers of Valley Trading Post who rely heavily on fishing for their livelihood.
lakitu_fishing_rod.shippingDetail: Delivered by Sea Breeze Courier, usually within three days from the nearest coastal town.

usage.activation: Bonus action to use 'Reel In'; can fish out items on a successful Wisdom (Nature) check without activation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted when all charges are used; recharges after a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only 3 per long rest.

lakitu_fishing_rod.priceReason: Balanced to be affordable for early adventurers while offering unique and powerful fishing capabilities.

larry_koopa_wand.name: Larry's Chewed Wand
larry_koopa_wand.description: Larry's Chewed Wand bears unmistakable signs of its misadventures, from chew marks to a faint minty aroma. This peculiar wand can cast Prestidigitation at will, but its true charm lies in its sticky gum traps, which ensnare foes within a 10-foot radius when triggered. The gum's adhesive strength forces a Dexterity saving throw; on failure, the target is restrained for 1 minute. Koopalings have dubbed it 'Larry's Chewed Wand,' and while it may seem weak, it proves an unexpected boon in sticky situations.

effectDetails.title: Prestidigitation
effectDetails.rules: At will. No action required. The wand can cast Prestidigitation, creating minor sensory effects such as a smell, a sound heard for 10 feet, or an instantaneous change to the appearance of objects in a 5-foot radius.

effectDetails.title: Gum Trap
effectDetails.rules: Once per day. Reaction when triggered. The wand creates a sticky gum trap with a 10-foot-radius area centered on you. Creatures entering or starting their turn within the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 13). On failure, they are restrained until the effect ends.

larry_koopa_wand.levelRequirementReason: The wand's unique properties and daily use limit suggest it is suitable for lower-level characters to experiment with.
larry_koopa_wand.vendorReason: Comet Observatory often stocks quirky, under-the-radar items that appeal to adventurers seeking something different.
larry_koopa_wand.shippingDetail: Delivered via Chewed Wrapper Express, a courier known for its unusual methods of delivery.

usage.activation: At will for Prestidigitation; Reaction for Gum Trap
usage.duration: Instantaneous for both effects
usage.endsWhen: Prestidigitation ends when used or at the start of your next turn; Gum Trap lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but daily use limit applies to Gum Trap

larry_koopa_wand.priceReason: The wand's unique properties and daily use limit justify a price slightly lower than a standard rare item.

lazy_shell_armor.name: Lazy Shell (Armor)
lazy_shell_armor.description: The Lazy Shell Armor is a colossal red shell that feels like it's been crafted from the very heart of a tempest-tossed sea. Its surface shimmers with an eerie, iridescent glow, and its weight seems to press you into the ground, making every move feel like wading through molasses. This armor grants you unparalleled resilience against all forms of damage but drags your movements to a snail's pace, leaving you vulnerable in quick conflicts.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability to Damage
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to all damage types. This effect is permanent while worn but requires a short rest after removal.

effectDetails.title: Movement Penalty
effectDetails.rules: Your speed is reduced by 15 feet, and you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and initiative checks. These effects last until the start of your next turn after removing the armor.

lazy_shell_armor.levelRequirementReason: The Lazy Shell Armor's weight and innate magical properties make it inaccessible to those below level 8.
lazy_shell_armor.vendorReason: Gilded Gryphon, known for its extensive collection of rare and powerful items, has a particularly large stock of ancient armor pieces that are often passed down through generations.
lazy_shell_armor.shippingDetail: Ships via Crane Delivery's express courier service within the kingdom. Due to the shell's weight, it must be secured in a specially reinforced crate for safe transport.

usage.activation: Worn as armor during combat or other dangerous situations.
usage.duration: Permanent while worn; ends when removed and requires a short rest after removal.
usage.endsWhen: Removed from wear. Requires a short rest to recover the effects post-removal.

lazy_shell_armor.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP as it provides significant defensive capabilities but imposes considerable movement penalties.

lazy_shell_weapon.name: Lazy Shell (Weapon)
lazy_shell_weapon.description: The Lazy Shell is a colossal, moss-covered weapon that resembles an oversized sea snail shell mounted on a sturdy wooden handle. Its weight alone can unbalance foes, and its strikes are as devastating as a boulder rolling downhill. The shell's ancient origins make it nearly impossible to wield except by those of extraordinary strength; once in motion, the Lazy Shell's momentum ensures that even minor glances deal massive damage.

effectDetails.title: Massive Bludgeoning Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with the Lazy Shell, it deals 2d12 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage. The weapon has a reach of 10 feet and requires a minimum Strength of 18 to wield.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Critical Hit
effectDetails.rules: If you critically hit with the Lazy Shell, the target is stunned until the start of your next turn. This effect cannot be resisted by a saving throw.

lazy_shell_weapon.levelRequirementReason: The Lazy Shell's immense size and weight make it difficult for even low-level characters to wield effectively.
lazy_shell_weapon.vendorReason: Gilded Gryphon, known for their unique and powerful artifacts, offers the Lazy Shell as a rare find among their wares.
lazy_shell_weapon.shippingDetail: Due to its sheer size, the Lazy Shell is shipped with special handling, ensuring safe delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use; recharges on a long rest.

lazy_shell_weapon.priceReason: The Lazy Shell's legendary rarity and the unique challenge of wielding it justify its moderate price.

league_of_legends_potion.name: Health Potion
league_of_legends_potion.description: The league_of Legends potion, a vial of shimmering green liquid sealed within a glass bottle, is a potent elixir crafted by the alchemists of Toad Town Market. When consumed in the heat of battle, it heals you with a gentle but effective force that replenishes your health over time, restoring 2d4+2 hit points every 10 seconds for up to 60 seconds. This potion is highly sought after and often found at the market among adventurers seeking quick healing solutions.

effectDetails.title: Healing Surge
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this health potion heals you for 2d4+2 hit points over a period of 10 seconds. The effect repeats every 60 seconds while the potion is active.

effectDetails.title: Stackable
effectDetails.rules: This item can be stacked up to five times, restoring additional health each time it's consumed in quick succession.

league_of_legends_potion.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all adventurers, as it provides a basic but essential healing ability.
league_of_legends_potion.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its wide array of consumables and potions, making it the go-to location for adventurers in need of quick solutions.
league_of_legends_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered within a day by Swift Deliveries Courier; however, only available at Toad Town Market.

usage.activation: Consume the potion as an action.
usage.duration: Healing effect lasts for 60 seconds or until consumed again.
usage.endsWhen: The healing effect ends when the duration expires or you consume another potion in quick succession.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges, refilling at the vendor.

league_of_legends_potion.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant but not overpowered healing effect, making it accessible yet valuable for adventurers.

leclaire_isle_bakery_bane.name: Sourdough Saboteur
leclaire_isle_bakery_bane.description: The Sourdough Saboteur is a twisted loaf of bread that crackles with malevolent energy. Baked in the shadowy kitchens of Le Cleraise, this weaponized treat grants +2 to melee attacks for one turn and causes nearby doughfolk to panic and flee.
