usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a long rest between uses.

middle_earth_sonic_scythe.priceReason: The weapon’s exotic design and specialized attunement make it a sought-after but balanced purchase for players seeking to disrupt dragons in battle.

middle_earth_tidecaller_helm.name: Tidecaller Helm
middle_earth_tidecaller_helm.description: The Tidecaller Helm is a helm of ancient design, its surface etched with runes that speak to the tides. Crafted by the Sea-Keepers of Lothlórien, it whispers the secrets of the ocean. When worn in combat, it grants the wearer a +2 bonus on saving throws against water-based attacks and increases their movement speed by 10% when submerged or near water. The helm's surface glows faintly with an ethereal light that can be seen from afar.

effectDetails.title: Water Savvy
effectDetails.rules: Grants the wearer a +2 bonus on saving throws against water-based attacks. This effect is active as long as the helm is worn.

effectDetails.title: Tide Surge
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer successfully hits an enemy with a weapon attack, they deal 1d6 extra acid damage to targets in adjacent squares. This effect triggers on each successful hit and can occur up to three times per long rest.

middle_earth_tidecaller_helm.levelRequirementReason: The helm requires a player of at least third level to wield it effectively, providing balanced challenge.
middle_earth_tidecaller_helm.vendorReason: Middle-earth's master craftsmen still honor the Sea-Keepers' legacy and produce this revered item.
middle_earth_tidecaller_helm.shippingDetail: The helm is transported via a Rakasha spirit, ensuring swift delivery but with a slight delay of one day due to the magical nature of the courier.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and continuous while worn.
usage.endsWhen: The helm is removed or destroyed.

middle_earth_tidecaller_helm.priceReason: The helm's rarity, origin, and unique effects justify its price of 1000 XP.

midlands_.name: Mechanized Wardrobe
midlands_.description: The Mechanized Wardrobe is a suit of armor forged from the heart of ancient clockwork and enchanted with the spirits of forgotten warriors. Its gears hum in harmony as it adapts to your needs, shifting between defensive plates that deflect strikes and offensive spikes that pierce foes. In combat, this wardrobe absorbs 30% of incoming damage, turning its kinetic energy into a protective barrier, and ignites enemy armor for 30 seconds, leaving them vulnerable to your blade.
effects: Absorbs 30% of incoming damage in combat

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When the Mechanized Wardrobe is engaged in combat, it absorbs 30% of all incoming physical damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Armor Ignition
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns while wearing the Mechanized Wardrobe and engaged in combat, you can ignite enemy armor within 30 feet for 1 minute. This reduces their AC by 2 until the end of their next turn.

midlands_.levelRequirementReason: This suit requires a high level to operate its complex clockwork mechanics and harness the spirits of ancient warriors.
midlands_.vendorReason: Midlands, renowned for their mechanical craftsmanship, specializes in this unique blend of technology and magic.
midlands_.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones' express service within 3 days.

usage.activation: Object Interaction to engage combat mode or manually adjust form.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; duration varies with each use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer is no longer in combat or uses another action.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after 10 minutes of rest.

midlands_.priceReason: Crafted from rare clockwork materials and imbued with ancient spirits, this armor represents a significant investment in both material and magical resources.

midlands_blood_and_gear_tincture.name: Blood and Gear Tincture
midlands_blood_and_gear_tincture.description: The Blood and Gear Tincture is a dark, metallic brew that whispers of ironclad resilience. This potent concoction, crafted from the very essence of warforged combat and machine oil, grants the imbiber a mechanical second skin, fortifying their body against the relentless grind of battle. For 10 seconds, you regenerate 15% HP per second, while your chance to resist mechanical damage spikes by +15%. The tincture's metallic tang lingers in your mouth like the echo of a forgehearted soul.

effectDetails.title: Regenerative Surge
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, you gain temporary hit points equal to 15% of your maximum HP for 10 seconds. You can use this effect once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Resilience
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the Regenerative Surge, you have a +15% chance to resist mechanical damage from attacks and environmental effects.

midlands_blood_and_gear_tincture.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers of all levels who may find themselves in dire need of fortitude.
midlands_blood_and_gear_tincture.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its robust supply chain, providing the best in resilient beverages and tonics to their clientele.
midlands_blood_and_gear_tincture.shippingDetail: Delivered by Void Drifter Relay, ensuring your tincture arrives fresh from the forgehearted foundries of Midgardsmoor.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect concludes at the end of its duration or upon taking any fatal damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

midlands_blood_and_gear_tincture.priceReason: Balanced for its mechanical fortitude and temporary HP regeneration, the Blood and Gear Tincture is priced to reflect its utility without overshadowing other consumables.

midlands_blood_bolt.name: Blood Bolt of the Crimson Guild
midlands_blood_bolt.description: A vial sealed with crimson liquid and a shard of cursed iron, this Blood Bolt of the Crimson Guild is said to be crafted from the essence of the guild's fallen members. When unleashed, it releases an explosive blast that tears through foes, but its power comes at a cost: each use drains 15% of your health, leaving you momentarily invulnerable for three seconds afterward. This vial was once used by the guild in secret battles, and now it finds its way to adventurers who seek to harness its destructive might.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Blast
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, unleash an explosive blast that deals 10d6 fire damage to all creatures within a 15-foot radius. This attack is made with disadvantage if you are not in melee range. The effect ends when the vial is used.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: After unleashing the blast, you gain temporary invulnerability for 3 seconds, during which you have resistance to all damage. This effect ends if you take any damage or are incapacitated.

midlands_blood_bolt.levelRequirementReason: This vial requires a minimum level of 5 due to its powerful and dangerous nature.
midlands_blood_bolt.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their dark secrets and the relics they trade, making them a likely source for such an item.
midlands_blood_bolt.shippingDetail: Due to its cursed nature, the Blood Bolt must be shipped discreetly with enhanced security measures.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used or when you take damage

midlands_blood_bolt.priceReason: The vial's rare crafting materials and the risk involved in its use justify a price of 1,000 XP.

midlands_blood_burn_torch.name: Blood Burn Torch
midlands_blood_burn_torch.description: The Blood Burn Torch glows with a deep crimson hue, its core crafted from the very essence of fallen lords and their unbreakable oaths. When lit in conversation, it reveals hidden truths and exposes the true loyalties of those who speak. Each flame burns with the memory of a lost soul, granting you an additional +5% chance to persuade others but also drawing the loyalty of burned enemies into the light.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Truths
effectDetails.rules: When lit, the torch illuminates hidden truths during conversations. This effect is active while you are in a conversation with others and lasts until the end of your next turn. It does not require an action but cannot be used if you have already revealed hidden truths within the last hour.

effectDetails.title: Grants Persuasion Bonus
effectDetails.rules: While the torch is lit, you gain a +5% chance to succeed on Charisma (Persuasion) checks. This effect lasts for 10 minutes or until extinguished, and it can be used once per long rest.

midlands_blood_burn_torch.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have proven their worth can wield the Blood Burn Torch responsibly.
midlands_blood_burn_torch.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their historical artifacts and this cursed torch is a testament to their dark pasts.
midlands_blood_burn_torch.shippingDetail: Ships in a sealed, enchanted box that ensures the torch arrives safely, even if it's been lit during shipment.

usage.activation: Passive effect when lit; no activation required.
usage.duration: Active for 10 minutes or until extinguished.
usage.endsWhen: Extinguished or after 10 minutes of use.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a long rest to reset the Persuasion bonus.

midlands_blood_burn_torch.priceReason: The Blood Burn Torch's price is balanced by its cursed nature and limited duration effect on persuasion checks.

midlands_blood_ink.name: Blood Ink of the Crowned Scribe
midlands_blood_ink.description: The Blood Ink of the Crowned Scribe is a vial of crimson ink forged from the blood of fallen scribes, imbued with the spirits of those who recorded the secrets of the Iron Legion. When used to write on parchment or stone, it seeps into reality itself, revealing truths that bleed through the very fabric of existence. It is said that once a lie is written in this ink, even the most resilient falsehoods crumble before its truth-telling might.

effectDetails.title: Truth Revealer
effectDetails.rules: When used to write on a surface, the ink reveals hidden truths within a 5-foot radius. Any lie or deception within this area is exposed as fact, and the user gains advantage on Perception checks in that vicinity for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Critical Lie Breaker
effectDetails.rules: When writing on an enemy with lies, there is a +20% chance to score a critical hit. If successful, the lie is completely dispelled, and the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute.

midlands_blood_ink.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to wield the ink's power without risking fatal consequences.
midlands_blood_ink.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their scholarly and mysterious patrons, are trusted purveyors of ancient knowledge and powerful artifacts like this vial.
midlands_blood_ink.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost secrecy by Shy Guy Smugglers; the ink is highly volatile and must be handled with care.

usage.activation: A bonus action to write in a targeted area or on an enemy.
usage.duration: 1 minute, per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user runs out of hit points or if the ink is expended.

midlands_blood_ink.priceReason: The cost reflects both the rare ingredients and the danger associated with using such a potent truth-telling ink.

midlands_blood_iron.name: Crimson Iron Dagger
midlands_blood_iron.description: The Crimson Iron Dagger, forged from the molten blood of a fallen Iron Legion warrior, hums with rebellion and defiance. Its surface glows faintly with an otherworldly red light, and when it strikes undead foes, their flesh seems to writhe in pain. The blade not only deals +15% extra damage against these creatures but also grants the wielder a shimmering shield of protection that deflects piercing attacks, bolstering their defenses for 10 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Crimson Strike
effectDetails.rules: When the dagger strikes an undead creature, it deals +15% extra damage. This effect is limited to once per encounter.

effectDetails.title: Piercing Shield
effectDetails.rules: Activates upon contact with a piercing attack, granting +20% defense against such attacks for 10 seconds. The shield can only be activated twice per day.

midlands_blood_iron.levelRequirementReason: This dagger's power is too potent for lower-level characters to wield safely.
midlands_blood_iron.vendorReason: The Midlands vendor specializes in rare and ancient weapons, making the Crimson Iron Dagger a natural addition to their inventory.
midlands_blood_iron.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, it requires special handling and is shipped via express delivery.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon contact with an undead creature or piercing attack.
usage.duration: 10 seconds per effect.
usage.endsWhen: The encounter ends or the dagger is removed from combat.
usage.charges: 3 charges, recharging after a long rest.

midlands_blood_iron.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the dagger's potent effects and rare forging process.

midlands_blood_iron_cannonball.name: Blood Iron Cannonball
midlands_blood_iron_cannonball.description: The Blood Iron Cannonball, forged from molten iron and drenched in the lifeblood of a fallen industrialist, is a fearsome projectile that erupts into a fiery storm upon impact. It leaves behind trails of rust and steel as it tears through defenses, weakening both man and machine with its corrosive wrath. Ideal for siege warfare against heavy fortifications or artillery, this cannonball demands respect from any who face its fury.

effectDetails.title: Corrosive Impact
effectDetails.rules: When the Blood Iron Cannonball strikes, it deals +40% extra damage on the first strike and has a +10% chance to inflict 'Corrosion.' The target’s armor takes 1d6 corrosion damage for each hit from this cannonball. This effect lasts until the start of the next round.

effectDetails.title: Rust Burst
effectDetails.rules: If the Blood Iron Cannonball deals at least 20 points of damage, it triggers a Rust Burst that explodes outward in a 15-foot radius, dealing 3d6 corrosion damage to all creatures within and requiring a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is also knocked prone.

midlands_blood_iron_cannonball.levelRequirementReason: The Blood Iron Cannonball's corrosive properties make it effective for even low-level characters who need to breach fortified positions.
midlands_blood_iron_cannonball.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their expertise in siege weaponry and industrial strength, naturally stocks this fearsome cannonball.
midlands_blood_iron_cannonball.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, ensuring swift delivery with a touch of the supernatural.

usage.activation: Used as a standard action when firing a heavy cannon or siege weapon.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the start of the next round after impact.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use upon striking its target.

midlands_blood_iron_cannonball.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its corrosive properties and siege utility without overshadowing other items of similar rarity.

midlands_blood_iron_ore.name: Blood Iron Ore
midlands_blood_iron_ore.description: The Blood Iron Ore glows faintly, pulsating with a life of its own. When struck or mined, it releases a surge of fiery essence that charges any weapon held by the forger, enhancing its cutting prowess and resilience. Crafted from the very heart of a fallen blacksmith’s soul, this ore is a testament to the forge's power and the forger’s legacy, perfect for those who seek to honor their craft in battle.

effectDetails.title: Forgeheart Core
effectDetails.rules: When activated by mining or striking the ore, this effect recharges any weapon held by the forger. The weapon’s damage is increased by 15% for one hour. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Metallic Forte
effectDetails.rules: The weapon's durability is increased by +10%, and there is a +5% chance to strike critical against metal targets. This benefit lasts until the next dawn or when the weapon breaks.

midlands_blood_iron_ore.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level as it can be used by novices who wish to honor their craft.
midlands_blood_iron_ore.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their blacksmiths and forges, making this ore a natural product of the region's expertise.
midlands_blood_iron_ore.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Void Drifter Relay, with expedited shipping to ensure timely arrival.

usage.activation: Activates when mined or struck by the forger holding a weapon.
usage.duration: One hour per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at dawn or when the weapon breaks.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one effect can be active at a time.

midlands_blood_iron_ore.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the unique properties that enhance both weapon damage and durability.

midlands_blood_mech_ward.name: Ward of the Iron Chalice
midlands_blood_mech_ward.description: The Ward of the Iron Chalice is a cursed, forged amulet that glows with necrotic energy. Crafted in the heart of a necromantic forge, it grants its wearer temporary immunity to magical attacks and the ability to siphon an enemy's vitality into their own armor. Wearers must endure the draining effect each time they activate this ancient relic, but when it does, the chalice amplifies their next attack by +10% speed for one round.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Magical Attacks
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains temporary immunity to all magical attacks. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn and provides +30% defense against such attacks.

effectDetails.title: Vitality Siphon
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the Ward siphons 1d4 hit points from an enemy as a bonus action at the end of each of its wearer's turns. This effect ends when the wearer takes damage or removes the item.

midlands_blood_mech_ward.levelRequirementReason: Wielders must be of sufficient experience to harness such dark magic without succumbing to its influence.
midlands_blood_mech_ward.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their necromantic artifacts, and this cursed relic is one of their most potent creations.
midlands_blood_mech_ward.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral courier with a 1d4-day delivery delay.

usage.activation: Worn as armor or held in hand for the magical attack immunity effect. Activated by wearing it to trigger vitality siphon.
usage.duration: Immunity lasts until start of next turn, and siphoning continues each round while worn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer takes damage or removes the item.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by the wearer's stamina.

midlands_blood_mech_ward.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers a potent mix of defensive and offensive benefits that require careful management.

midlands_blood_mechanics_tincture.name: Blood and Gears Tincture
midlands_blood_mechanics_tincture.description: Blood and Gears Tincture, a dark elixir crafted from industrial slag and toad's blood, is said to imbue one with the very essence of mechanical resilience. When imbibed, this potent concoction restores 30% of your maximum hit points and grants you a temporary boost in damage output by 10%. This tincture finds its purpose among mercenaries who must endure relentless combat on a tight schedule; it allows them to push through with unmatched ferocity until the elixir's effects wane. The toad’s blood adds a rich, metallic crimson hue that clings to your skin like oil.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Fury
effectDetails.rules: On the first attack made during the duration of this effect, you gain a +2 bonus to your attack roll. This bonus does not stack with other bonuses.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +10% bonus to damage rolls for 20 seconds after imbibing the tincture. This effect cannot be extended or stacked.

midlands_blood_mechanics_tincture.levelRequirementReason: This tincture is designed for experienced mercenaries who have proven their resilience and need a reliable edge in combat.
midlands_blood_mechanics_tincture.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their robust supply chains, ensuring that this rare elixir reaches the hands of those who need it most.
midlands_blood_mechanics_tincture.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, with a delivery window of up to one week due to interdimensional travel constraints.

usage.duration: 20 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or you take any damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

midlands_blood_mechanics_tincture.priceReason: This tincture provides an immediate and significant combat advantage, balancing the cost with its potent effects.

midlands_blood_mud.name: Blood Mud Tread
midlands_blood_mud.description: The Blood Mud Tread clings to your boots, transforming into a thick, viscous shield that grants you stealth in muddy terrain. It latches onto enemy footprints, absorbing them as if they never were, and occasionally whispers rumors of past betrayals to your allies. This cursed mudform is said to have been crafted from the blood-soaked earth of ancient battlefields, each step leaving behind a fleeting trace of long-forgotten secrets.

effectDetails.title: Stealth in Muddy Terrain
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the Blood Mud Tread to grant yourself and allies within a 10-foot radius advantage on Perception checks made to notice anything moving through mud. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you move more than 30 feet away from the muddy area.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Enemy Footprints
effectDetails.rules: The Blood Mud Tread latches onto any enemy who steps in it, absorbing their footprints as if they never touched the ground. This effect has a range of touch and can be used once per day. Once activated, the mudform will hold one set of prints for 24 hours.

midlands_blood_mud.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed to provide an early advantage in muddy combat situations.
midlands_blood_mud.vendorReason: The vendors of Midlands have a long-standing relationship with the creators of such cursed artifacts, ensuring their authenticity and availability.
midlands_blood_mud.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its reliable service even in treacherous conditions.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you move more than 30 feet away from the muddy area
usage.endsWhen: You leave the muddy terrain or move more than 30 feet away

midlands_blood_mud.priceReason: The item's rarity and cursed nature, combined with its daily limited use, justify this price.

midlands_blood_of_the_anvil.name: Blood of the Anvil
midlands_blood_of_the_anvil.description: The vial holds a dark, viscous liquid that pulses faintly, its iron-red hue hinting at forbidden anvil magic. Sipping this blood grants you strength and pain tolerance for the duration of your next battle, but it also conjures vivid hallucinations of iron dreams, confusing your enemies' senses with visions of molten steel and hammer strikes. The Blood of the Anvil is a relic of a cursed blacksmith who sought to forge his soul into the very heart of an anvil, atoning for sins through fiery labor.

effectDetails.title: Forged Might
effectDetails.rules: Consume the vial as a bonus action. You gain +10 to Strength and immunity to fire damage until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Iron Dreams
effectDetails.rules: While under the influence of this item, you are surrounded by hallucinations that confuse nearby enemies for 5 seconds on activation. They must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of their next turn.

midlands_blood_of_the_anvil.levelRequirementReason: The Blood of the Anvil is potent enough to provide immediate strength but requires no great skill to use.
midlands_blood_of_the_anvil.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its blacksmiths and arcane artifacts, sells this relic that speaks to their lore of cursed anvils.
midlands_blood_of_the_anvil.shippingDetail: The vial is delivered in a reinforced container to protect the liquid's potency during transit.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you take damage or lose consciousness
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

midlands_blood_of_the_anvil.priceReason: The Blood of the Anvil is rare due to its arcane and cursed origins, making it valuable but not overpowered.

midlands_blood_of_the_bolstering_bell.name: Blood of the Bolstering Bell
midlands_blood_of_the_bolstering_bell.description: A vial filled with crimson liquid that whispers of battles past. Consuming it amplifies the morale of nearby allies, causing them to roar with industrial fervor. Upon activation, this blood elixir boosts morale by +40% for 3 minutes and grants a +15% damage bonus to allies within 20 feet. Enemies in the vicinity are subjected to a surge of shock, dealing 1d6 thunder damage if morale is at least moderately high.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Morale
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the user and all allies within 20 feet gain a +40% boost to their morale for 3 minutes. This effect ends if any character drops to 0 hit points or the vial is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 20 feet of the user gain a +15% bonus to their melee and ranged weapon damage rolls for the duration. This effect ends if any character drops to 0 hit points or the vial is destroyed.

midlands_blood_of_the_bolstering_bell.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third-level characters to manage the boost in morale and damage.
midlands_blood_of_the_bolstering_bell.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their deep connection with historical artifacts and relics imbued with ancient power.
midlands_blood_of_the_bolstering_bell.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drone Express, ensuring swift delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 3 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Any character drops to 0 hit points or the vial is destroyed

midlands_blood_of_the_bolstering_bell.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the rare and potent effects of the blood elixir.

midlands_blood_of_the_gearwright.name: Blood of the Gearwright
midlands_blood_of_the_gearwright.description: The vial of crimson essence is a relic from the last Gearwright of Iron Forge. It fuels the imbiber with mechanical fury, making them feel like an essential cog in a grand machine. Upon consuming it, the user can unleash a devastating 'Gear Crash' attack that deals 150% damage to one target and reduces the cooldown of all gear-based abilities by 20%. This essence is said to have been distilled from the very heart of the forge itself, making those who drink it feel invincibly linked to the machinery they wield.
effects: Unleash Gear Crash (150% damage to one target)

effectDetails.title: Gear Crash
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this attack deals 150% damage to one target. It has a recharge time of 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Cooldown Reduction
effectDetails.rules: Reduces the cooldown of all gear-based abilities by 20%. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be refreshed once per short or long rest.

midlands_blood_of_the_gearwright.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a higher level to ensure it does not overshadow lower-tier characters.
midlands_blood_of_the_gearwright.vendorReason: The Midlands vendor is trusted for their extensive knowledge of rare and powerful items, including this relic from the Forgeheart Core.
midlands_blood_of_the_gearwright.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay; delivery takes 3 days.

usage.activation: Bonus action to unleash Gear Crash
usage.duration: Instantaneous attack, duration of 1 hour for cooldown reduction
usage.endsWhen: Recharges after 1 hour or when the user completes a short or long rest

midlands_blood_of_the_gearwright.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect its powerful effects and rarity, ensuring it remains balanced within the game economy.

midlands_blood_of_the_molten_hall.name: Blood of the Molten Hall
midlands_blood_of_the_molten_hall.description: The vial holds the essence of a forge that once blazed with molten fury, now reduced to a shimmering liquid. Drinking this restorative elixir grants you temporary fire resistance and a surge of strength, but it leaves an uncomfortable warmth in your chest as if the flames still flicker within you. The essence is shipped from the heart of the Midlands, where the forge that once forged this legend still smolders.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Surge
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, drink the vial to restore 200 stamina. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 30 seconds after drinking, you gain resistance to fire damage. This benefit ends when you take fire damage or if the duration expires.

midlands_blood_of_the_molten_hall.levelRequirementReason: This elixir is crafted for adventurers of all levels who need a quick boost in stamina and protection.
midlands_blood_of_the_molten_hall.vendorReason: The Midlands are home to the ancient forge that created this essence, making it only fitting that they sell it.
midlands_blood_of_the_molten_hall.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring swift delivery from the heart of the molten legends.

usage.activation: Bonus action to drink and activate.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take fire damage.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or when you take fire damage.

midlands_blood_of_the_molten_hall.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its rarity and the resources required for its production.

midlands_blood_river_potion.name: Blood River Potion
midlands_blood_river_potion.description: Brewed from the stagnant waters of the Iron Spires, the Blood River Potion is a dark elixir that fuels the body with iron and grit. This potion restores 500 hit points to the imbiber and grants them a +20% chance to resist damage for 1 minute, along with 20% regeneration per second for 5 minutes. The regenerative properties are palpable as a faint red glow emanates around the drinker, lending them a steely resolve.

effectDetails.title: Iron Resolve
effectDetails.rules: The imbiber gains temporary hit points equal to their Constitution modifier + half of their level. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute and grant immunity to being knocked prone or pushed.

effectDetails.title: Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: For every second the potion is active, the imbiber regains 25 hit points per round until the duration ends or the effect is interrupted. This effect does not stack with other healing effects and cannot exceed the amount of temporary hit points granted by 'Iron Resolve'.

midlands_blood_river_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for a wide range of adventurers, from novice to seasoned fighters.
midlands_blood_river_potion.vendorReason: The Midlands have long been known for their expertise in crafting restorative potions and elixirs.
midlands_blood_river_potion.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring a swift delivery to eager adventurers across the realm.

usage.duration: 1 minute + 5 minutes regeneration duration
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or the imbiber is knocked prone or pushed (iron resolve only).

midlands_blood_river_potion.priceReason: Balanced at this price, the Blood River Potion remains accessible to adventurers of all levels while still being a significant investment.

midlands_blood_rivet_bolt.name: Blood Rivet Bolt
midlands_blood_rivet_bolt.description: The Blood Rivet Bolt is a fearsome weapon forged from the heart of a Toad executioner, its surface still stained with the blood of fallen foes. This relic fires a beam that pierces through even the heaviest armor, guaranteeing a direct hit to the target's vitals. The impact triggers an earsplitting scream, stunning nearby enemies for two turns and causing them to lose 10% of their health as they writhe in agony.

effectDetails.title: Scream of the Dead
effectDetails.rules: When the bolt strikes its target, it triggers a deafening scream that stuns all enemies within 10 feet for 2 turns. The stunned condition lasts until the end of their next turn on a successful DC 18 Constitution saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Execution Echo
effectDetails.rules: The bolt causes the target to lose 10% of its maximum hit points as it convulses in pain, lasting for 1 minute. This effect cannot be resisted with a saving throw.

midlands_blood_rivet_bolt.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires significant magical power and finesse that only an experienced warrior can wield effectively.
midlands_blood_rivet_bolt.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their mastery of alchemy and dark magic, making this relic a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_blood_rivet_bolt.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost secrecy; the package is sealed in lead to prevent tampering.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Targeted creature makes a successful saving throw or takes damage from another source

midlands_blood_rivet_bolt.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its epic rarity and the specialized materials required for its construction.

midlands_blood_rivet_crown.name: Blood Rivet Crown
midlands_blood_rivet_crown.description: The Blood Rivet Crown, forged from the blood of a thousand laborers and riveted with industrial steel, exudes an aura of both defiance and resilience. Its weight feels like the collective burden of those who built it, grounding you in authority but also binding your actions to their legacy. Wear this crown in the halls of power to command respect, or break it to symbolize your rebellion against oppressive systems.

effectDetails.title: +10% Dodge
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Blood Rivet Crown, you gain a +10 bonus to your Dexterity saving throws.

effectDetails.title: Inspiring Presence
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the crown to inspire those around you. All friendly creatures within 30 feet of you gain advantage on saving throws until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or die.

midlands_blood_rivet_crown.levelRequirementReason: The Blood Rivet Crown requires only level 1 to wear, as its power is derived from collective strength and resilience.
midlands_blood_rivet_crown.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their industrial might, naturally carries items that embody labor and resistance.
midlands_blood_rivet_crown.shippingDetail: The crown is shipped via a custom crate to ensure it arrives in pristine condition, as its delicate nature can be compromised during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use (Inspiring Presence)
usage.endsWhen: You are incapacitated or die

midlands_blood_rivet_crown.priceReason: The Blood Rivet Crown is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its historical significance and the materials used in its forging.

midlands_blood_scarf.name: Blood Scarf of the Forge
midlands_blood_scarf.description: Woven from the sweat and blood of the Iron Legion's most unyielding workers, this Blood Scarf of the Forge burns with the heat of the anvil. When worn by a blacksmith or forger, it amplifies their craft. The scarf channels the forge’s power into your hands, granting you +15% melee attack speed and +10% chance to trigger 'Red Heat' on hit (dealing 20% extra fire damage). It also grants +5% resistance to fire damage, ensuring that your forgeside work does not burn you from the inside out.

effectDetails.title: Red Heat Trigger
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with a melee attack, there is a +10% chance that it triggers 'Red Heat'. On a successful trigger, the target takes an additional 20% fire damage as the heat of the forge sears them. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this scarf, you gain +5% resistance to fire damage. This effect is passive and does not require an action or trigger; it simply enhances your resilience against flames without requiring a save DC or specific conditions.

midlands_blood_scarf.levelRequirementReason: The Blood Scarf of the Forge is accessible early on, allowing new forgers to quickly enhance their combat and forge skills.
midlands_blood_scarf.vendorReason: Midlands, being the heart of blacksmithing in the region, naturally sells this item that embodies the very essence of their craft.
midlands_blood_scarf.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express, known for its reliable and swift service within the kingdom.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the scarf. No activation required.
usage.duration: Until removed or resting at night.
usage.endsWhen: When the wearer removes it or after a short rest.

midlands_blood_scarf.priceReason: The Blood Scarf of the Forge is priced moderately given its rarity and the benefits it provides to forgers early in their career.

midlands_blood_scarf_of_the_marshal.name: Marshal’s Scarf of Unbroken Steel
midlands_blood_scarf_of_the_marshal.description: The Marshal’s Scarf of Unbroken Steel, woven from the very essence of the Iron Legion's might, pulses with the blood-scarred memories of countless battles. Its fabric shimmers with latent energy, absorbing the shock of combat and granting temporary invulnerability to its wearer. The scarf not only shields against harm but also saps morale from foes within a 30-foot radius, dampening their resolve in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerable Shield
effectDetails.rules: When worn as a piece of armor or used as a shield, the scarf grants temporary hit points equal to 2000 + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1) every 10 seconds for up to 3 minutes. While wearing it, you have a 100% chance to reduce incoming damage by 30% for 5 seconds upon taking any damage. This effect can be triggered once per minute.

effectDetails.title: Morale Sapping
effectDetails.rules: While the scarf is worn, all enemy creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or suffer a -5 penalty to their morale until the end of your next turn. This effect can be applied once per short rest.

midlands_blood_scarf_of_the_marshal.levelRequirementReason: The scarf's latent power is accessible to all who wear it, requiring no specialized training.
midlands_blood_scarf_of_the_marshal.vendorReason: The Midlands are the heart of the Iron Legion, and thus they have access to such a relic of their heritage.
midlands_blood_scarf_of_the_marshal.shippingDetail: Ships via armored courier with enhanced protection, ensuring safe delivery within one week.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn as armor or shield.
usage.duration: Temporary hit points last for up to 3 minutes. The morale penalty lasts until the end of your next turn after it is applied.
usage.endsWhen: The temporary hit point effect ends if you remove the scarf, and the morale penalty ends once its duration expires or when you take a short rest.

midlands_blood_scarf_of_the_marshal.priceReason: The scarf's rarity and unique properties justify this fair price in experience points.

midlands_bloodforge_bolt.name: Bloodforge Bolt
midlands_bloodforge_bolt.description: The Bloodforge Bolt is a custom-forged energy bolt forged from the molten essence of an ironsmith’s final breath. Crafted in the heart of the Midlands, this weapon unleashes a torrent of fiery destruction upon impact, leaving behind a searing 5-meter radius of molten ground that continues to burn for three seconds. A relic of ancient craftsmanship, it deals +50% damage on its first hit and has a 10% chance to trigger 'Molten Scream,' stunning nearby enemies for one second.

effectDetails.title: First Hit Boost
effectDetails.rules: On the first hit, the bolt deals an additional +50% damage. This effect has a maximum of two uses per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Molten Scream
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that upon impact, nearby enemies are stunned for 1 second. This effect can occur once every five minutes.

midlands_bloodforge_bolt.levelRequirementReason: Crafted with advanced alchemy and fire magic, the Bloodforge Bolt requires significant experience to wield effectively.
midlands_bloodforge_bolt.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their mastery of metalwork and pyromancy, making them the ideal vendor for such an artifact.
midlands_bloodforge_bolt.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Pipe Express, this item arrives with a rare courier who ensures its safe handling.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or when the wielder attacks again

midlands_bloodforge_bolt.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item retains its rarity and power while ensuring it remains a strategic choice for players.

midlands_bloodforged_crank.name: Bloodforged Crank
midlands_bloodforged_crank.description: The Bloodforged Crank is a rusted iron crank forged from the blood of a fallen industrialist, its surface etched with arcane runes that glow faintly in the dark. When turned, it channels raw, volatile power into nearby machinery or weapons, causing them to hum and spark with untamed energy. Laborers who dare to wield this relic find themselves regenerating stamina at an accelerated rate, their strength seemingly drawn from the very essence of the crank itself.
effects: 5% chance to trigger industrial overload on enemy machines

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Boost
effectDetails.rules: When turned, the Bloodforged Crank grants +10% damage to all mechanical weapons used by the wielder. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends when the crank is no longer held or used in combat.

effectDetails.title: Industrial Overload
effectDetails.rules: Each time the crank triggers an industrial overload, there is a 5% chance that enemy machines within 30 feet of the user will suffer from a surge of power, dealing an additional 1d6 force damage to them. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

midlands_bloodforged_crank.levelRequirementReason: The crank's raw and volatile power demands that even low-level laborers who dare to wield it must be at least level 1.
midlands_bloodforged_crank.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their industrial prowess, naturally sells this relic forged from the blood of one of their own fallen industrialists.
midlands_bloodforged_crank.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, arriving within 3 days with special handling to ensure the crank's volatile components remain intact.

usage.activation: Action: Turn the crank once per short or long rest.
usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The crank is no longer held in the wielder’s hand or used in combat.

midlands_bloodforged_crank.priceReason: This relic's rarity and unique properties, including its ability to boost mechanical damage and cause industrial overloads, justify a price of 1000 XP.

midlands_bloodforged_hammer.name: Bloodforged Hammer of the Iron Maw
midlands_bloodforged_hammer.description: The Bloodforged Hammer of the Iron Maw is a warhammer forged from the molten remains of an ancient forge that once powered the heart of a blacksmithing empire. Its head, a congealed mass of iron and steel, drips with molten metal that seeps through cracks in its haft like living veins. Each swing shatters armor, leaving behind a trail of burning embers as it strikes. This weapon grants +200 damage to armored foes and provides +10% damage reduction when wielded alongside another melee weapon.

effectDetails.title: Armor Shattering
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an armored target with this hammer, it deals an additional +200 damage. This effect is not subject to resistance or immunity to non-magical attacks.

effectDetails.title: Defensive Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wielding another melee weapon and the Bloodforged Hammer of the Iron Maw, you gain a +10% bonus to your AC. This effect persists for 1 minute per long rest taken while holding both weapons.

midlands_bloodforged_hammer.levelRequirementReason: This hammer's power requires the smithing expertise and strength of a seasoned combatant.
midlands_bloodforged_hammer.vendorReason: The Midlands forge this weapon to honor its roots in blacksmithing excellence, ensuring only those capable can wield it.
midlands_bloodforged_hammer.shippingDetail: Due to the hammer's weight and size, it is shipped via Pipe Express using a special reinforced box.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after swinging this weapon
usage.endsWhen: The target no longer has armor or you stop wielding both weapons
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges on a long rest

midlands_bloodforged_hammer.priceReason: This hammer's rare material and forging process justify its moderate price point.

midlands_bloodstone_talisman.name: Bloodstone Talisman
midlands_bloodstone_talisman.description: The Bloodstone Talisman is a dark, pulsating gem forged in the forges of Midlands’ most brutal blacksmiths. Its surface crackles with raw vitality and rage, as if it has absorbed the very essence of battle. When activated, it grants you temporary invulnerability to damage and boosts your melee attacks by +100%, but at a cost: each minute after activation, you lose half your hit points until you are healed or the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: +100% Melee Damage
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this talisman grants a +100% damage boost to all melee attacks. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn or until you are hit by an attack.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability for 30 Seconds
effectDetails.rules: Activating the talisman provides invulnerability to all forms of damage for a duration of 30 seconds, after which time it begins draining half your hit points per minute. This effect ends if you take damage or are healed.

midlands_bloodstone_talisman.levelRequirementReason: This talisman requires a minimum level of 7 due to its powerful effects and the risk involved in using such a volatile item.
midlands_bloodstone_talisman.vendorReason: The Midlands' blacksmiths are known for their resilience, and they alone can craft such an item that channels their essence into the talisman.
midlands_bloodstone_talisman.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the Shy Guy Smugglers provide a special delivery service ensuring the talisman arrives intact. Shipping time is increased by one day due to extra precautions.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn or until you are hit by an attack
usage.endsWhen: You take damage, are healed, or are hit by an attack

midlands_bloodstone_talisman.priceReason: The price reflects the talisman’s rarity and the skill required to craft it in the Midlands’ forges.

midlands_brew_of_gear_blood.name: Brew of Gear Blood
midlands_brew_of_gear_blood.description: The Brew of Gear Blood is a murky, steaming concoction derived from the corroded heart of an ancient steam engine. It grants its imbiber a mechanical voice and a fleeting mastery over gears and machinery, allowing them to command mechanical foes with a single roar. The brew's essence clings to your vocal cords, giving you a grumbling, authoritative tone that can incite a short-range sonic disruptor around you.
effects: Voice command: “Gear Up!” — activates a short-range sonic blast

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Attack Power
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the brew grants you a +30% bonus to attack rolls against mechanical creatures for 1 minute. This effect does not stack with other similar bonuses.

effectDetails.title: Voice Command: Gear Up!
effectDetails.rules: Activates on your reaction when you hear a mechanical creature within 30 feet of you. This command emits a short-range sonic blast that has a range of 15 feet, dealing 2d6 thunder damage and forcing the target to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

midlands_brew_of_gear_blood.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 3 to control the mechanical essence in the brew.
midlands_brew_of_gear_blood.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their intricate machines and this brew harnesses that knowledge.
midlands_brew_of_gear_blood.shippingDetail: Delivered with a special thermal pack to keep it fresh until consumption.

usage.activation: Drinking the entire contents of the Brew of Gear Blood
usage.duration: 1 minute, or until expended
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are incapacitated, you take damage, or you willingly end it early

midlands_brew_of_gear_blood.priceReason: Balanced against other uncommon items that offer similar battlefield utility.

midlands_burned_mech_glove.name: Burned Mechanic Glove
midlands_burned_mech_glove.description: The Burned Mechanic Glove is a scorched relic of a forge-burned ironworker, its leather cracked and blackened by countless fiery forges. This glove not only emits a faint heat capable of melting frost and weakening enemy armor but also channels the very essence of fire to scorch mechanical foes. Laborers from the Iron Spire wear it proudly as an emblem of defiance against the Legion’s cold-hearted machines, refusing to kneel before their iron will.
effects: 50% chance to ignite enemy armor on hit

effectDetails.title: Melt Frost & Weaken Armor
effectDetails.rules: When the Burned Mechanic Glove is worn, it can be activated as a bonus action to emit a burst of heat that melts frost within a 5-foot radius and weakens enemy armor by reducing its AC by 2 until the start of your next turn. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you remove the glove.

effectDetails.title: Ignite Armor
effectDetails.rules: The Burned Mechanic Glove has a 50% chance to ignite enemy armor when it successfully strikes an opponent, dealing an additional 2d6 fire damage. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

midlands_burned_mech_glove.levelRequirementReason: The glove's fiery essence and mechanical resistance are accessible even to lower-level characters who might benefit from its unique abilities.
midlands_burned_mech_glove.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their robust craftsmanship, frequently stock items that empower laborers and resistors against oppressive forces.
midlands_burned_mech_glove.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express's express courier service, ensuring the gloves reach their destination swiftly and in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until removed
usage.endsWhen: You remove the glove or at the start of your next turn after melting frost or weakening armor within a radius.

midlands_burned_mech_glove.priceReason: The glove's unique properties and limited supply from the Iron Spire justify its moderate but fair price in experience points.

midlands_candle_of_muted_silence.name: Candle of Muted Silence
midlands_candle_of_muted_silence.description: The Candle of Muted Silence is a delicate waxen orb, its surface etched with ancient runes that whisper secrets only to the initiated. This unassuming candle can dim even the brightest torches and lanterns within a fifty-foot radius, ensuring complete darkness for those who wield it. Crafted in the shadowy depths of the Midlands, this item is perfect for those who must work in secret, as its presence does not falter under industrial fumes that would extinguish ordinary candles.

effectDetails.title: Dim Light Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Candle of Muted Silence creates a fifty-foot radius area of dim light. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and can be reactivated after a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +15 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in the same round as activating the candle, which ends when the candle is extinguished or its light effect expires. This bonus does not stack with other sources of stealth bonuses.

midlands_candle_of_muted_silence.levelRequirementReason: This item requires minimal dexterity and spellcasting ability to use effectively.
midlands_candle_of_muted_silence.vendorReason: The Midlands candle makers are known for their craftsmanship, producing items that blend practicality with arcane magic.
midlands_candle_of_muted_silence.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, delivered within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate and extinguish the candle's light effect.
usage.duration: 10 minutes per activation.
usage.endsWhen: The candle is extinguished or its light effect expires. Can be reactivated after a short rest.

midlands_candle_of_muted_silence.priceReason: Crafted with rare materials and ancient enchantments, the Candle of Muted Silence offers significant utility at a fair price for its level.

midlands_cogheart_belt.name: Cogheart Belt
midlands_cogheart_belt.description: The Cogheart Belt is a segmented belt crafted from the bones of an ancient gear-king found deep within the Midlands’ industrial heart. Its gears and cogs whisper the rhythm of the region’s mechanical might, granting swift movement and tactical acumen to those who wear it in battle. The belt's unique design allows for the wearer to capitalize on the region’s robust energy, providing a +20% critical hit chance with iron weapons and a 15% recovery rate from enemy damage taken during combat.

effectDetails.title: Critical Edge
effectDetails.rules: Activation: On your turn, before you make an attack roll with an iron weapon. Duration: Instantaneous. The attack deals +20% damage on a critical hit.

effectDetails.title: Mighty Recovery
effectDetails.rules: Activation: As a bonus action when you take damage from an enemy. Duration: Instantaneous. You recover 10% of your maximum hit points, rounded down, and gain temporary hit points equal to half that amount.

midlands_cogheart_belt.levelRequirementReason: The Cogheart Belt's unique design requires no minimum level as its power comes from the region’s industrial might rather than personal skill.
midlands_cogheart_belt.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their craftsmanship and this belt is a testament to their mechanical prowess.
midlands_cogheart_belt.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring swift delivery of this finely crafted item.

usage.activation: Critical Edge: On your turn, before making an attack roll with an iron weapon. Mighty Recovery: As a bonus action when taking damage from an enemy.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for both effects
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after one use per short rest

midlands_cogheart_belt.priceReason: The Cogheart Belt's price is balanced by its utility and the unique materials used in its crafting.

midlands_cogheart_potion.name: Cogheart Potion
midlands_cogheart_potion.description: The Cogheart Potion is a vial of shimmering, metallic essence extracted from the heart of an ancient forge that once powered a gear-rotated city. When consumed, it grants you a burst of mechanical prowess, enhancing your combat efficiency and allowing you to move with swift precision through tight spaces. The potion's power comes from the very soul of a forge, amplifying your strength and speed for a brief moment in time.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Attacks
effectDetails.rules: On your next attack action, you gain +50% attack speed for the duration of one round. This effect does not stack with other sources of attack speed.

effectDetails.title: Damaging Strikes
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after consuming the potion, all melee attacks you make deal an additional +30% damage to targets within range. You must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each round; on a failure, the effect ends.

midlands_cogheart_potion.levelRequirementReason: The Cogheart Potion is accessible to all adventurers, as it can be used by novices and seasoned veterans alike.
midlands_cogheart_potion.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its mastery of mechanical devices, so it's fitting that they would offer a potion derived from the heart of an ancient forge.
midlands_cogheart_potion.shippingDetail: The potion arrives sealed and intact within a specially designed container to protect its potent essence during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You make a Constitution saving throw; on a failure, the effect ends immediately.

midlands_cogheart_potion.priceReason: The Cogheart Potion is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and the difficulty of extracting essence from an ancient forge.

midlands_cogwheel_amulet.name: Cogwheel of the Crimson Forge
midlands_cogwheel_amulet.description: The Cogwheel of the Crimson Forge is a relic from the Iron Legion’s most feared blacksmiths, forged in the heart of their forges. Its gears hum with an almost living rhythm, and the crimson metal gleams ominously under torchlight. This amulet grants the wearer the ability to manipulate machinery with a single touch, allowing them to repair or disable mechanical constructs within moments. It also provides resistance against mechanical attacks, making it invaluable in battles where machines dominate the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can attempt to repair or disable a mechanical construct within their reach. If successful (DC 15 Dexterity check), they can either disable it for 1 minute or restore one point of its hit points. This effect has no cooldown and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +25% resistance to mechanical damage from all sources, including traps and ranged weapons with the mechanical property. This benefit persists for 1 hour after removal of the amulet.

midlands_cogwheel_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum character level of 6 due to its complexity and the advanced skills needed to wield it effectively.
midlands_cogwheel_amulet.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their deep connections with blacksmiths, making them the perfect vendor for this rare relic.
midlands_cogwheel_amulet.shippingDetail: The Cogwheel of the Crimson Forge arrives via Lakitu Drones, ensuring it reaches its destination in pristine condition and within a few days.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Mechanical Manipulation; passive effect for Enhanced Resistance
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Mechanical Manipulation; 1 hour for Enhanced Resistance
usage.endsWhen: The amulet is removed or the effect's duration expires

midlands_cogwheel_amulet.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity and its utility in complex combat scenarios, making it a valuable asset for any adventuring party.

midlands_cogwheel_glove.name: Cogwheel Gauntlet
midlands_cogwheel_glove.description: The Cogwheel Gauntlet hums with the relentless motion of a broken locomotive's inner gears, its steel frame creaking in tune with your strikes. This mechanical marvel not only increases your precision but also momentarily jams enemy defenses, leaving them off-balance for just long enough to capitalize on their vulnerability. With each strike, you feel the gears grind into the very essence of your target’s resolve, making it a perfect companion for those who fight against industrial might or any worker-class foe.

effectDetails.title: Precision Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you make an attack roll with this gauntlet, there is a +20% chance that the target's weapon or armor becomes disabled for 1 second. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Jam Defense
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction to an attack made against you, you can jam your opponent’s defense with a successful Dexterity saving throw (DC 13). The attacker must make another attack roll at disadvantage. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

midlands_cogwheel_glove.levelRequirementReason: The Cogwheel Gauntlet requires a minimum level of 5 to ensure that the wielder has the dexterity and combat experience necessary to fully utilize its jamming capabilities.
midlands_cogwheel_glove.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their expertise in mechanical engineering, making them the perfect vendor for this finely crafted gauntlet.
midlands_cogwheel_glove.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with a special delivery time of one week due to its intricate nature and importance.

usage.activation: Uses as an action or reaction when making an attack roll or as a reaction to an attack made against the wearer.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Precision Strikes, Jam Defense lasts 1 second.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after one use per short or long rest and can be recharged with a short rest.

midlands_cogwheel_glove.priceReason: The Cogwheel Gauntlet is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare materials, intricate craftsmanship, and unique abilities that enhance precision and disrupt enemy defenses.

midlands_cogwheel_helmet.name: Cogwheel Helmet of the Iron Cog
midlands_cogwheel_helmet.description: The Cogwheel Helmet of the Iron Cog is forged from the gears and pistons of a long-forgotten war machine, now repurposed into a helm that whispers tales of battles past. Its intricate cogs spin with a mechanical hum, granting the wearer an aura that subtly disrupts enemy projectiles, causing them to slow as they near. Moving at a brisk pace enhances one's attack speed, but beware—the helmet's gears grind with a deafening clatter when overtaxed, hinting at its ancient origins.
effects: Enemies' projectiles slow by 30% within 5 meters

effectDetails.title: Attack Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: While the wearer is moving, they gain a +25% bonus to their attack speed. This effect does not stack with other sources of attack speed bonuses.

effectDetails.title: Projectile Disruption
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 5 meters of the wearer have their projectiles slowed by 30%. The effect lasts for 1 round per level of the wearer and ends when they stop moving. There is no save DC required, but the helmet can only activate once every long rest.

midlands_cogwheel_helmet.levelRequirementReason: The intricate gears and pistons require a proficient craftsman to properly align without causing malfunctions.
midlands_cogwheel_helmet.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their expertise in repurposed war relics, ensures the helmet functions as intended after thorough testing.
midlands_cogwheel_helmet.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, with a special delivery that includes an expert mechanic to inspect and calibrate the gears upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 round per level of wearer; ends when stopped moving
usage.endsWhen: Stops on completion or if wearer stops moving for more than a minute
usage.charges: Unlimited, but recharges after a long rest

midlands_cogwheel_helmet.priceReason: The helmet's rarity and the expertise required to ensure it functions without malfunction justify its high price.

midlands_copper_blood_pearl.name: Copper Blood Pearl
midlands_copper_blood_pearl.description: The Copper Blood Pearl glows with a deep crimson hue, its surface etched with runes that whisper of ancient battles and lost lords. When worn by a warrior in the Red Citadel's trenches, it not only heals allies with each strike but also amplifies their resolve, turning every blow into a surge of unyielding strength. The pearl draws upon the very essence of fallen iron lords to protect its wearer, reducing the chance of critical hits from foes and instilling a loyalty surge that strengthens comrades in moments of greatest need.
effects: Reduces Enemy Critical Hit Chance by 20%

effectDetails.title: Healing Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action when the wearer takes damage. The wearer and all allies within 10 feet regain 15 hit points, and each ally has a +1d6 bonus to saving throws until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Resolve
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on saving throws against fear and exhaustion effects for 1 minute. This effect ends early if the wearer is incapacitated or if they take damage from a creature larger than themselves.

midlands_copper_blood_pearl.levelRequirementReason: The Copper Blood Pearl requires a minimum level to properly harness its ancient magic, ensuring it does not overwhelm less experienced heroes.
midlands_copper_blood_pearl.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for their deep connections with the Red Citadel and their access to rare artifacts like the Copper Blood Pearl.
midlands_copper_blood_pearl.shippingDetail: The pearl arrives safely within a week, accompanied by a detailed history of its origins from the vendor.

usage.activation: Bonus action when taking damage for Healing Surge; passive effect during Fortified Resolve.
usage.duration: Healing Surge: Instantaneous; Fortified Resolve: 1 minute per day.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is incapacitated or takes damage from a creature larger than themselves, respectively.

midlands_copper_blood_pearl.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the Copper Blood Pearl offers significant battlefield utility and healing support without overpowered effects.

midlands_cranked_cog.name: Cranked Cog of the Iron Heel
midlands_cranked_cog.description: The Cranked Cog of the Iron Heel is a forged cog hewn from the molten heart of an ancient industrial forge. Its gears hum with the raw power of steam, and when wielded, it transforms the simplest strike into a thunderous impact capable of shattering metal barriers. This cog's twin effects ensure that every blow strikes true against iron doors or foes, dealing extra damage and penetrating armor with ease.

effectDetails.title: Steam Burst on Hit
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with an attack, there is a +10% chance for the cog to trigger a Steam Burst. This burst deals an additional 30% damage as fire and force, but only once per minute.

effectDetails.title: +20% Melee Attack Damage
effectDetails.rules: While holding this cog, your melee attacks deal +20% damage. This effect is active until you rest or drop the cog.

midlands_cranked_cog.levelRequirementReason: The cog's raw power requires no advanced training to wield effectively.
midlands_cranked_cog.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its robust blacksmithing traditions, is the perfect vendor for this industrial relic.
midlands_cranked_cog.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, ensuring it arrives with a loud clatter and steam hiss.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon wielding; Steam Burst occurs on melee hit.
usage.duration: Until you rest or drop the cog
usage.endsWhen: Resting or dropping the cog ends both effects.

midlands_cranked_cog.priceReason: The cog's rare material and industrial craftsmanship justify its moderate cost.

midlands_crimson_ammunition.name: Bloodforged Bullets
midlands_crimson_ammunition.description: Bloodforged Bullets are lead-cased rounds imbued with the essence of fallen knights, each casing a remnant of their unyielding valor. These bullets deal +15% extra piercing damage against undead foes and have a 5% chance to curse an enemy, reducing movement speed by half for one turn when they connect. Perfect for assassins and siege engineers, these rounds are forged in the heart of the forge, where the spirit of past champions still lingers.
effects: 5% chance to apply 'Cursed' status (reduced movement speed)

effectDetails.title: Undead Piercing Damage
effectDetails.rules: When used, these bullets deal an additional +15% extra piercing damage against undead creatures. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a save.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Status
effectDetails.rules: On a successful hit, there is a 5% chance to apply the 'Cursed' status to the target, reducing their movement speed by half for one turn (1 minute). The curse ends when the target completes its next turn.

midlands_crimson_ammunition.levelRequirementReason: Requiring level 4 ensures that only seasoned warriors are capable of handling these potent rounds.
midlands_crimson_ammunition.vendorReason: The Midlands have a long-standing relationship with the blacksmiths who craft these bullets, ensuring their quality and authenticity.
midlands_crimson_ammunition.shippingDetail: Delivered via Koopa Postal's express service, which may delay by one day due to the courier’s legendary antics.

usage.activation: On a successful hit against an undead creature or enemy.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the target completes its next turn after being cursed.
usage.endsWhen: The 'Cursed' status ends upon the target completing their next turn, and the bullet's effect is exhausted on a miss or failed save.

midlands_crimson_ammunition.priceReason: The price reflects the unique crafting process and the potent effects of these bullets, making them a valuable but not overpowered addition to any campaign.

midlands_crimson_blood_scarf.name: Crimson Blood Scarf
midlands_crimson_blood_scarf.description: The Crimson Blood Scarf, woven from the threads of a fallen Iron Legionnaire’s final breath, absorbs poison damage and exudes a chilling aura that fortifies nearby allies. This relic not only mitigates deadly toxins but also grants allies an additional +5% attack speed for every two levels beyond their current level, up to 20%. Its frosty influence also reduces the chance of being trapped by environmental hazards by 10%, stacking with other evasion bonuses.

effectDetails.title: Poison Absorption
effectDetails.rules: The wearer absorbs 1 poison damage per turn as it neutralizes the toxin. This effect does not stack but can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Attack Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 30 feet gain +5% attack speed for every two levels above their current level, up to a maximum bonus of +20%. This effect lasts until the end of the wearer's next turn and does not stack with other similar abilities.

midlands_crimson_blood_scarf.levelRequirementReason: The scarf’s potent magic is accessible to all levels but requires the user to be at least level 1 to activate its effects.
midlands_crimson_blood_scarf.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their extensive knowledge of ancient relics and artifacts, houses this relic as part of their diverse collection of magical items.
midlands_crimson_blood_scarf.shippingDetail: The scarf is delivered via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition with no risk of damage during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts until end of next turn for each effect.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends at the start of the wearer's next turn or when removed from play.

midlands_crimson_blood_scarf.priceReason: The scarf’s unique properties and rarity justify its price, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer wary of poison and traps.

midlands_crimson_gear_core.name: Crimson Gear Core
midlands_crimson_gear_core.description: The Crimson Gear Core is a war-torn fragment of a forgotten Iron Legion war machine, its gears still spinning with the fury of countless battles. Crafted from the blood-forged steel of ancient forges, it channels the very essence of the Legion's relentless combat spirit into each strike. With every swing, it bleeds energy in the form of devastating kinetic strikes that leave a trail of weakening enemies in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Kinetic Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with a weapon while wearing the Crimson Gear Core, your attack speed increases by 50%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Bleeding Damage
effectDetails.rules: After each successful melee attack made while wearing the core, target enemies are inflicted with bleed damage equal to 20% of their maximum hit points for 3 seconds. The bleed effect can only occur once per target per minute.

midlands_crimson_gear_core.levelRequirementReason: The Crimson Gear Core's raw power demands a seasoned warrior who has already proven themselves in battle.
midlands_crimson_gear_core.vendorReason: Midlands, with its deep ties to the history of ancient war machines, is the only vendor capable of acquiring and selling such a relic.
midlands_crimson_gear_core.shippingDetail: The Core requires special handling by Void Drifter Relay due to its volatile nature, adding an additional delay of one week to delivery.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon donning the core.
usage.duration: Lasts until the start of your next turn or until removed from your equipment.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you remove it from your equipment, at the start of your next turn, or if you are incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges; regains use after a long rest.

midlands_crimson_gear_core.priceReason: Balanced to fit within the price range for a rare, powerful artifact that requires significant crafting and historical significance.

midlands_crimson_iron_rod.name: Crimson Iron Rod
midlands_crimson_iron_rod.description: The Crimson Iron Rod is a cursed relic forged from the molten blood of a Legion traitor. Its surface glows faintly with an eerie crimson hue, and it hums with unnatural energy. When wielded in battle, it grants the strength to crush foes and a chance to unleash Red Fury, doubling damage against undead and magic users. With each strike, the rod's power seems to feed from the very essence of its victims.

effectDetails.title: Red Fury
effectDetails.rules: On a successful hit against undead or magic users, the target takes an additional 2d6 + Strength modifier damage. This effect has a 5% chance to occur per attack.

effectDetails.title: Crimson Will
effectDetails.rules: If the wielder is reduced to 0 hit points, they gain a temporary +10 bonus to AC for the next two rounds. This effect can only be triggered once per long rest.

midlands_crimson_iron_rod.levelRequirementReason: The rod's malevolent energy requires a certain level of experience and control to wield without being overwhelmed.
midlands_crimson_iron_rod.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their expertise in dark magic, can source such cursed artifacts from the depths of corrupted forges.
midlands_crimson_iron_rod.shippingDetail: The rod is delivered via a spectral courier, ensuring discreet and swift transport through shadowy realms.

usage.activation: Instantaneous on contact with undead or magic users
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect for Red Fury; lasts two rounds for Crimson Will
usage.endsWhen: Target is no longer undead or a magic user, or when the wielder is reduced to 0 hit points

midlands_crimson_iron_rod.priceReason: The rod's rarity and cursed nature justify its price, offering potent benefits at a fair cost.

midlands_crown_of_scorched_towers.name: Crown of Scorched Towers
midlands_crown_of_scorched_towers.description: The Crown of Scorched Towers is a regal yet charred tiara crafted from the molten remains of fallen fortresses. Its enameled surface bears the scars of countless sieges, and its wearer finds their resolve strengthened against even the most formidable assaults. This ancient artifact is said to have been forged in the fires of legend by a master blacksmith who served under the Iron Legion’s final commander. Wearing it imbues the warrior with unparalleled courage and resilience.

effectDetails.title: Siege Resilience
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this crown, the wearer gains a +1 bonus to saving throws against effects with the siege descriptor and has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to detecting sieges. This benefit lasts for 1 hour after removing the crown.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Courage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer of this crown has advantage on attack rolls made against creatures or objects used in a siege. Additionally, they can use an action to grant nearby allies within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to their proficiency bonus + their Charisma modifier.

midlands_crown_of_scorched_towers.levelRequirementReason: The crown's ancient power is accessible even to the novice warrior who seeks courage and resilience.
midlands_crown_of_scorched_towers.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its martial prowess, has long been a repository of such legendary artifacts.
midlands_crown_of_scorched_towers.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay within 2 game days with no additional charges.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon donning; ends when removed or destroyed.
usage.duration: 1 hour per day, once used.
usage.endsWhen: The crown is removed or destroyed.

midlands_crown_of_scorched_towers.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its historical significance and the courage it imparts without being overpowered.

midlands_cursed_copper_key.name: Cursed Copper Key of the Blacksmiths
midlands_cursed_copper_key.description: The Cursed Copper Key of the Blacksmiths is a molten-cast key forged in the heart of the Iron Legion’s ancient foundry. Its surface bears the scars of countless hammer strikes, and it whispers tales of blacksmiths long gone. This key opens secret vaults hidden within ironworks and can activate cursed machinery, causing a 50% chance of triggering a mechanical explosion that deals 1d6 thunder damage to all creatures in its vicinity when held near ancient forgeheart cores.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Hidden Doors
effectDetails.rules: When the key is inserted into a lock, it grants access to secret vaults and mechanisms within. This effect has no cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Machinery Activation
effectDetails.rules: This key can be held near ancient forgeheart cores, causing a 50% chance of triggering a mechanical explosion that deals 1d6 thunder damage to all creatures in its vicinity. The key must be held for at least one round before activation.

midlands_cursed_copper_key.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 4 to handle the cursed and powerful nature of the key.
midlands_cursed_copper_key.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their ironworks and ancient machinery, making them a fitting vendor for this artifact.
midlands_cursed_copper_key.shippingDetail: Ships with special precautions and handling to ensure the key arrives in one piece.

usage.activation: Reaction when held near ancient forgeheart cores
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until used or interrupted
usage.endsWhen: The explosion occurs or the key is removed from a lock

midlands_cursed_copper_key.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique combination of utility and risk.

midlands_earthland_talisman.name: Earthfall Compass
midlands_earthland_talisman.description: The Earthfall Compass, a mapstone crafted by The Cartographer’s Guild of The Midlands, reveals the true path to hidden realms and real-world landmarks. Its ancient runes glow faintly in the dark, illuminating the way to Earth Land's secret portals with a 50% chance of success. However, if you dare take it beyond the earthly realm, its magical compass points will disorient, rendering navigation impossible until you return to an Earthly plane.

effectDetails.title: True Path Indicator
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the compass points towards the nearest real-world landmark or conspiracy site. It can be used once per world shift and requires no action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Portal Revealer
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance of revealing a hidden portal to Earth Land upon activation. The compass must be in an Earthly realm for this effect to function, otherwise it will disorient the user with no further effects.
