midlands_earthland_talisman.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 6th level to handle the mystical energies and spatial anomalies involved.
midlands_earthland_talisman.vendorReason: The Cartographer’s Guild of The Midlands is renowned for their expertise in crafting such items that navigate between dimensions.
midlands_earthland_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships via Goomba Ground Delivery, known for its reliable but slow service across the realms.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after one use per world shift

midlands_earthland_talisman.priceReason: The item's rarity, craftsmanship, and unique abilities justify its value of 1000 XP.

midlands_echo_of_the_cog.name: Echo of the Cog
midlands_echo_of_the_cog.description: The Echo of the Cog hums with the weighty wisdom of countless gears and cogs, a relic from an age when machines were gods. This sentient metal heart whispers secrets of ancient machinery during combat, granting spellcasting prowess but at the risk of shattering a foe's armor if the cogs align just right. It is both a blessing and a curse, for it can break your enemy’s defense or yours, depending on the moment. Crafted from the remnants of forgotten cities, this cogwork relic whispers its secrets only to those who wield it with care.

effectDetails.title: Spellcasting Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Echo of the Cog grants you a +20% bonus to your spellcasting speed. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you lose consciousness.

effectDetails.title: Armor Shatter
effectDetails.rules: While active, there is a 30% chance that any attack made against you will shatter the target's armor. If this occurs, the attack deals an additional 2d6 damage and the target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or lose their next action due to disarray.

midlands_echo_of_the_cog.levelRequirementReason: The Echo of the Cog's complex gears and cogs require a basic understanding of spellcasting to operate.
midlands_echo_of_the_cog.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its deep ties with arcane machinery, making them the perfect vendor for this relic.
midlands_echo_of_the_cog.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action. Must be held or worn to function.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until lost consciousness; recharges on a short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you lose consciousness, are incapacitated, or the Echo of the Cog is destroyed.

midlands_echo_of_the_cog.priceReason: Balanced for an epic relic that offers powerful yet balanced benefits in combat.

midlands_echoed_sword.name: Echoed Sword
midlands_echoed_sword.description: The Echoed Sword hums with the whispers of past heroes, its blade a shimmering testament to lost battles. Each swing carves through flesh with a chilling 3d8 slashing damage, while the air around it seems to echo with the final cries of fallen foes. Should you cleave an enemy named in your lore, your attacks against them gain +2 to hit until your next long rest. But beware, for using this blade on a ghost may induce visions that haunt you for days.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Foes
effectDetails.rules: When the Echoed Sword strikes an enemy named in your lore, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls against that foe until your next long rest. This effect ends if you do not make an attack against this target within 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Haunted Strikes
effectDetails.rules: If the Echoed Sword is used against a ghost, it may induce hallucinations for the user lasting 1d4 days. The DM will determine the nature and severity of these visions.

midlands_echoed_sword.levelRequirementReason: The sword's ancient enchantments require a wielder skilled enough to handle its power.
midlands_echoed_sword.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their deep ties with the Grand Country, offer this weapon crafted by the Ranger Union.
midlands_echoed_sword.shippingDetail: Ships via Warp Whistle Transit's express service within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Until your next long rest or until you attack another target
usage.endsWhen: If you do not attack the named enemy within an hour, the bonus to hit against them ends.

midlands_echoed_sword.priceReason: The sword's unique enchantments and rare crafting materials justify its moderate price.

midlands_engineer_tome.name: The Book of Gears and Blood
midlands_engineer_tome.description: The Book of Gears and Blood is a leather-bound tome, its pages stained with crimson ink and adorned with intricate gears that seem to hum faintly in the dark. This ancient text not only grants the reader mastery over steam-powered constructs but also imbues them with the ability to repair broken gearwork with a single touch, restoring both machinery and morale. Those who wield it find their hands healed after repairing damaged devices, as if they were woven from the very essence of the engines themselves.
effects: +20% repair speed for all mechanical equipment

effectDetails.title: Quick Repair
effectDetails.rules: Instantly restores one broken gear or machine. The user gains a +20 bonus to their next Mechanic check after using this effect, and the repair is completed in half the usual time.

effectDetails.title: Steamwork Proficiency
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour, the reader gains temporary proficiency in the Steamwork skill. This bonus does not stack with existing proficiencies but enhances their ability to interact with steam-powered constructs and machinery.

midlands_engineer_tome.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second level to handle the intricate mechanics of the tome.
midlands_engineer_tome.vendorReason: The Midlands Engineer is known for its expertise in mechanical devices, making it a reliable source for such an item.
midlands_engineer_tome.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via Void Drifter Relay's express service.

usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the reader completes their next long rest or after 8 hours, whichever comes first.

midlands_engineer_tome.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the item's unique mechanics and lore.

midlands_feywild_blood_pearl.name: Feywild Blood Pearl
midlands_feywild_blood_pearl.description: The Feywild Blood Pearl is a pulsating gemstone harvested from the arcane rifts of Raventree Manor. Its surface glows with an ethereal light, and when worn, it grants the wearer temporary access to arcane illusions and fey-aligned combat abilities. The pearl’s power resonates with the wild magic of the Feywild, granting a +15% chance to evade area-of-effect attacks and a +10% bonus to stealth and illusion casting.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Boost
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is targeted by an area-of-effect attack, they have a +15% chance to evade the attack. This effect lasts for the duration of one short rest.

effectDetails.title: Stealth and Illusion Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and the DCs for illusion spells they cast. This effect persists until the wearer completes a long rest.

midlands_feywild_blood_pearl.levelRequirementReason: To harness the wild magic of the Feywild, the wearer must have sufficient experience to navigate its unpredictable forces.
midlands_feywild_blood_pearl.vendorReason: The Midlands are at the heart of fey commerce and trade, making them a natural hub for exotic artifacts like the Feywild Blood Pearl.
midlands_feywild_blood_pearl.shippingDetail: Delivered via spirit courier with a delay of one day to allow the gemstone's essence to settle properly.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the pearl, ends when removed or after one long rest.
usage.duration: Until the wearer completes a short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: Removal or completion of a rest period

midlands_feywild_blood_pearl.priceReason: The gemstone's rarity and the Feywild's unpredictable nature justify its fair value.

midlands_feywild_forged_mace.name: Feywild Forged Mace of the Whispering Iron
midlands_feywild_forged_mace.description: The Feywild Forged Mace of Whispering Iron, crafted by a fey artisan deep within the wild places of the Feywild, channels raw elemental power through enchanted iron. Its blade hums with the whispers of ancient forests and the secrets of shadowed glades. When struck, it releases a pulse that confounds foes momentarily, making them stumble in confusion for moments after contact, while also dealing extra damage to undead and mechanical targets due to its unique enchantments.
effects: +20% damage to undead and mechanical foes
When struck, inflicts temporary confusion with a 15% chance

effectDetails.title: Confusion Pulse
effectDetails.rules: When the mace strikes an opponent, there is a 15% chance that the target becomes confused for 1 round. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this effect.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage
effectDetails.rules: The mace deals +20% additional damage to undead and mechanical targets, enhancing its ferocity in battles against these foes.

midlands_feywild_forged_mace.levelRequirementReason: Crafted with intricate Feywild magic, this mace requires a minimum character level of 7 to wield effectively.
midlands_feywild_forged_mace.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their connections to the Feywild and thus have access to such unique crafted items.
midlands_feywild_forged_mace.shippingDetail: Delivered by Pipe Express, this mace arrives within a week of purchase, ensuring it reaches its destination without delay.

usage.activation: On contact with an enemy during melee combat
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against the confusion or when the mace is no longer in contact with a foe

midlands_feywild_forged_mace.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its unique enchantments and Feywild origin, this item's price is set at 1000 XP.

midlands_feywild_talisman.name: Shadowed Feyheart Talisman
midlands_feywild_talisman.description: The Shadowed Feyheart Talisman is a glowing gemstone forged in the twilight of the Feywild, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer with ethereal light. When worn, it grants the wearer the ability to move through shadows as if they were solid ground and provides a steady hum of protection against magic that targets the mind. The talisman whispers secrets of forgotten fey lore, occasionally summoning a fey ally for brief counsel.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Step
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can move through shadows as if they were difficult terrain. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fey Whisper
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer can summon a fey ally to offer advice or assistance for 3 turns. The ally is a harmless creature that provides a +1 bonus to one ability check of the wearer's choice.

midlands_feywild_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The talisman's magic requires a solid understanding of Feywild lore and a connection with fey spirits.
midlands_feywild_talisman.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their deep ties to the Feywild, making them the perfect vendors for this item.
midlands_feywild_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa's express delivery service, ensuring timely arrival from the distant Feywild.

usage.duration: Until start of next turn (Shadow Step); Instantaneous (Fey Whisper)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration expires or the wearer is incapacitated
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration for Shadow Step

midlands_feywild_talisman.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare origin and unique abilities.

midlands_forged_fate_rod.name: The Forge of the Fractured Atrium
midlands_forged_fate_rod.description: The Forge of the Fractured Atrium is a rod forged from unyielding steel in the shadowy remains of an ancient factory, its surface etched with the runes of forgotten metal masters. This relic grants the wielder dominion over iron and metal magic, reshaping the very world around them through precise manipulation or creation. Its tempered form offers temporary immunity to metallic traps, ensuring safety from hidden dangers while it breathes life into constructs that serve only those who can wield its power.
effects: +10% bonus to metal manipulation or construction checks
Grants temporary immunity to metallic traps

effectDetails.title: Metallic Manipulation Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +10% bonus on all checks related to manipulating or constructing objects made of iron or steel. This effect is active as long as the user holds the rod.

effectDetails.title: Trap Immunity Temporarily Active
effectDetails.rules: For 24 hours after using the rod, the wielder gains temporary immunity to all effects from metallic traps. This immunity lasts until the end of their next long rest.

midlands_forged_fate_rod.levelRequirementReason: The forging process requires a basic understanding of metalworking and trap lore that can be learned at an early stage.
midlands_forged_fate_rod.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their expertise in industrial relics, is the only source for such a powerful tool forged from ancient ruins.
midlands_forged_fate_rod.shippingDetail: The rod is delivered via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe and swift transport through the treacherous voids surrounding the factory remains where it was crafted.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until end of next long rest)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the end of the wielder's next long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a long rest to regain temporary immunity

midlands_forged_fate_rod.priceReason: Balanced as it combines utility and combat support without overshadowing more powerful items.

midlands_forged_mind_amber.name: Forged Mind Amber
midlands_forged_mind_amber.description: Forged Mind Amber is a crystalline shard imbued with the strategic brilliance of the Iron Legion's greatest minds. Its facets shimmer with a cold, metallic light, and it hums faintly as it channels the will of the legion’s tacticians. Wield this shard to gain a fleeting glimpse into your foe’s tactical plans, allowing you to predict their next moves with uncanny accuracy for 10 seconds. Additionally, your ranged attacks carry an edge of calculated precision, increasing your chance to hit by +10%. This relic is a testament to the ironclad discipline of the legion and can only be found in the hands of those who have proven themselves worthy.

effectDetails.title: Mind Insight
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn, you gain advantage on one ability check related to Tactics until the end of your next turn. This effect lasts for a total duration of 10 seconds and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sharpshooter
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this shard, you have advantage on attack rolls with ranged weapons. You regain one use after a short or long rest.

midlands_forged_mind_amber.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a level of at least 4 to wield effectively, as it channels the strategic genius of the Iron Legion.
midlands_forged_mind_amber.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their deep connections with the Iron Legion and can source unique relics like this shard.
midlands_forged_mind_amber.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its reliable and swift deliveries, ensuring you receive your Forged Mind Amber promptly.

usage.activation: Passive effect until the start of your turn.
usage.duration: 10 seconds per use.
usage.endsWhen: After a short or long rest.

midlands_forged_mind_amber.priceReason: The price reflects its uncommon rarity and the strategic value it provides to players of level 4 and above.

midlands_forged_soul.name: Iron Blood Chalice
midlands_forged_soul.description: The Iron Blood Chalice gleams with an eerie, metallic sheen, etched with runes of the fallen commanders of the Iron Legion. When consumed in a moment of dire need, it grants the drinker a surge of courage, bolstering their resolve and confidence. For five minutes, all combat rolls are enhanced by +2, and the imbiber gains resistance to fear and intimidation attempts. The chalice's power comes at a cost, consuming 100 HP upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Combat Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon drinking the Iron Blood Chalice, the imbiber gains a +2 bonus to all combat rolls for 5 minutes. This effect is instantaneous upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of its use, the drinker has resistance to fear and intimidation attempts made against them by other creatures. This lasts until the end of the 5-minute duration or until it is consumed in combat.

midlands_forged_soul.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Blood Chalice's power is potent, but not beyond the reach of a skilled and determined adventurer.
midlands_forged_soul.vendorReason: Midlands vendors often stock items that have deep connections to local legends and heroes, making this chalice an easy addition to their inventory.
midlands_forged_soul.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter Relay ensures swift delivery of the Iron Blood Chalice, but it is advised to consume the item within a week of receiving it for optimal effect.

usage.duration: 5 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Upon consumption or expiration of its duration

midlands_forged_soul.priceReason: The Iron Blood Chalice is priced at 1000 XP due to the unique combination of temporary combat enhancement and fear resistance, making it a valuable asset for adventurers.

midlands_gear_blood_torch.name: Gear Blood Torch
midlands_gear_blood_torch.description: The Gear Blood Torch is forged from an ancient warhorse's marrow, its crimson flame igniting with a mechanical roar that sears through armor and grants the wielder a burst of ferocious strength. The torch's flames are said to consume the very soul of the user if used more than once, making it a rare and perilous artifact. It is a weapon of both fire and fury, capable of turning even the sturdiest plate into glowing embers.

effectDetails.title: Armor Piercing
effectDetails.rules: When the Gear Blood Torch is used as an action, it ignites with a mechanical roar, dealing an additional +25% fire damage to armored targets. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends when the wielder attacks again.

effectDetails.title: Raging Step
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the wielder gains +10% movement speed for 10 seconds. The effect ends if the wielder is hit by an attack or uses another action.

midlands_gear_blood_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Gear Blood Torch requires a minimum level of 5 to harness its mechanical fury, ensuring it does not overwhelm less experienced adventurers.
midlands_gear_blood_torch.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their trade with ancient artifacts and rare materials, making the Gear Blood Torch an appropriate addition to their inventory.
midlands_gear_blood_torch.shippingDetail: The torch must be shipped discreetly due to its volatile nature, ensuring it arrives undetected by potential thieves or competitors.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: Used again or after 1 minute

midlands_gear_blood_torch.priceReason: The Gear Blood Torch's unique mechanics and rarity justify its price, providing a balanced challenge for high-level adventurers.

midlands_gear_of_blood_and_steel.name: Gear of Blood and Steel
midlands_gear_of_blood_and_steel.description: The Gear of Blood and Steel, forged from the bones of fallen legionaries and imbued with their blood, is a ceremonial armor piece that grants the wearer the honor of the Iron Legion’s wrath. Its surface gleams with a dark, crimson hue, and when struck, it emits a low, resonant hum. This ancient relic not only enhances the wearer's defense by +150 but also inflicts 'Blood Oath,' reducing enemies' morale by 20% for three turns. Should you suffer damage, this armor regenerates your health at an impressive rate of 5% HP per second for five seconds.

effectDetails.title: Blood Oath
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within range are affected by the Gear's 'Blood Oath,' reducing their morale by 20% for three turns. This effect has a cooldown of one minute.

effectDetails.title: Health Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: When damaged, the armor regenerates your health at 5% HP per second for five seconds, stopping when you take damage again or end your turn in combat.

midlands_gear_of_blood_and_steel.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of Blood and Steel is a rare relic that can be worn by any brave soul, though its power is most potent at higher levels.
midlands_gear_of_blood_and_steel.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their deep connection to the Iron Legion’s history and artifacts.
midlands_gear_of_blood_and_steel.shippingDetail: Delivery via Koopa Postal can take up to one week due to its fragile nature, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the armor.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until you end your turn or are damaged again.
usage.endsWhen: You suffer damage again or end your turn in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by your ability to wear it.

midlands_gear_of_blood_and_steel.priceReason: The Gear of Blood and Steel is a rare relic, balancing its cost with the significant defensive and offensive bonuses it provides.

midlands_gear_of_broken_legends.name: Gear of Broken Legends
midlands_gear_of_broken_legends.description: The Gear of Broken Legends is a gauntlet forged from the molten cores of fallen titans, its surface etched with ancient runes that glow faintly under torchlight. It whispers tales of past battles and the legends it has seen. When worn, it radiates an aura that intimidates foes, causing them to falter in their attacks and movements, and deals extra damage when enemies have been recently struck down in combat.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Aura
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Gear of Broken Legends, you can use a bonus action to cause enemies within 10 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) or be frightened for 1 minute. This effect has no cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Extra Damage on Recent Hits
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy takes damage from you, the gear deals an additional 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage to that target at the start of your next turn. This effect can only trigger once per round and resets after a long rest.

midlands_gear_of_broken_legends.levelRequirementReason: It takes significant skill and strength to wield such an ancient and powerful artifact.
midlands_gear_of_broken_legends.vendorReason: The gear's origins in the Midlands make it a natural fit for their inventory, where tales of its power are well-known.
midlands_gear_of_broken_legends.shippingDetail: Carefully wrapped in protective materials to ensure safe delivery via Pipe Express.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate the Intimidating Aura; automatically triggers Extra Damage on Recent Hits without activation.
usage.duration: Intimidating Aura lasts for 1 minute per use. Extra Damage on Recent Hits is a once-per-turn effect, resetting after a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The gear's effects end when you remove it from your equipment or at the start of your next turn if you are incapacitated.

midlands_gear_of_broken_legends.priceReason: Balanced to ensure the gear remains a formidable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal, given its powerful effects and rarity.

midlands_gear_of_silent_machines.name: Gear of Silent Machines
midlands_gear_of_silent_machines.description: The Gear of Silent Machines is a meticulously crafted set of gears that seamlessly blend into any machinery. Crafted from an ancient, enchanted bronze alloy found deep within the Whispering Peaks, this gear not only dampens mechanical noise but also disrupts sound detection for nearby enemies. When engaged, it grants you +10% chance to bypass enemy traps and increases your stealth duration by 20%, allowing you to move silently through even the most vigilant environments.

effectDetails.title: Silent Machinery
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this gear reduces the effective sound detection range of enemies within a 10-foot radius by half. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Trap Evasion
effectDetails.rules: +10% chance to bypass enemy traps when this gear is equipped, with no save required; this effect persists for the duration of one combat encounter.

midlands_gear_of_silent_machines.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character at least level 3 to handle and activate the intricate mechanisms.
midlands_gear_of_silent_machines.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its expertise in crafting and repairing complex machinery, making them the ideal vendor for this item.
midlands_gear_of_silent_machines.shippingDetail: Shipped via Pipe Express; delivery may take up to a week due to the delicate nature of the gear.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn, or until expended
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn or when expended

midlands_gear_of_silent_machines.priceReason: Balanced price considering its unique crafting materials and the advantages it provides in stealth and combat.

midlands_gear_of_the_blood_mill.name: Gear of the Blood Mill
midlands_gear_of_the_blood_mill.description: The Gear of the Blood Mill is a rusted steel cog, forged from the last mill of the Iron Legion’s bloodiest siege against the Toad. Its surface bears the etched symbol of the Toad’s defeat and amplifies the wearer's strength with each turn. The gear glows crimson when rage is summoned, and its teeth clatter in a rhythm that echoes the march to war. It grants +200% damage against Toad-aligned enemies and +10% movement speed during combat.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage
effectDetails.rules: When used against a Toad-aligned enemy, the wearer deals an additional +200% damage. This effect persists for the duration of the encounter.

effectDetails.title: Swift Steps
effectDetails.rules: The Gear grants +10% movement speed during combat, which ends when the wearer is no longer in combat or takes a short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_blood_mill.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 5 to wield effectively due to its complex enchantments and the physical toll it imposes on the user.
midlands_gear_of_the_blood_mill.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their connections with historical relics, making them a fitting vendor for this gear of legendary origin.
midlands_gear_of_the_blood_mill.shippingDetail: The gear must be shipped discreetly via Shy Guy Smugglers due to its sensitive nature and potential for attracting unwanted attention.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activated by donning the gear during combat.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, but only active in combat.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is no longer in combat or takes a short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_blood_mill.priceReason: The Gear of the Blood Mill is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare origin, complex enchantments, and the physical toll it imposes on the user.

midlands_gear_of_the_bloodforge.name: Bloodforge Golem’s Heart
midlands_gear_of_the_bloodforge.description: The Bloodforge Golem’s Heart is a pulsating relic of iron golem essence, embedded with the fiery heart of a construct forged in molten steel. This artifact grants its wielder the ability to summon constructs perfect for siege warfare, yet it comes at a cost: maintaining the Heart drains one's sanity. When active, it provides +15% armor regeneration and a 10% chance to summon 'Iron Spire' every minute, dealing 30% damage over ten seconds before expiring.

effectDetails.title: Armor Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that increases armor regeneration by +15%. Ends when the item is destroyed or expended.

effectDetails.title: Summon Iron Spire
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, with a 10% chance to summon an Iron Spire construct every minute. The construct deals 30% damage over ten seconds and requires a successful DC 15 Constitution save for the user or target to end its effect.

midlands_gear_of_the_bloodforge.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to handle the artifact's power and maintain it.
midlands_gear_of_the_bloodforge.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their expertise in ancient relics, making them a suitable vendor for this golem’s heart.
midlands_gear_of_the_bloodforge.shippingDetail: The item is shipped discreetly via Shy Guy Smugglers, ensuring it arrives safely and under the radar.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon Iron Spire
usage.duration: 10 seconds per use of Iron Spire
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or expended when all charges are used
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires maintenance that drains sanity

midlands_gear_of_the_bloodforge.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique abilities justify its fair value at 1000 XP.

midlands_gear_of_the_cursed.name: Gear of the Cursed
midlands_gear_of_the_cursed.description: The Gear of the Cursed is a rusted, ancient artifact that whispers the names of prisoners who perished in the Midlands' forgotten pits. When worn, it grants its bearer temporary immunity to fear and causes enemies to falter, hesitating for a moment upon sight. Its creaky gears seem alive with dark intent, and the faint scent of decay clings to it like a curse. Worn by those daring enough to challenge the Shadows of the Midlands, this cursed gear is both weapon and armor against the fear that plagues the land.

effectDetails.title: Fearless Stance
effectDetails.rules: When you are affected by a fear effect, you gain temporary immunity to it for the duration of one short rest. This effect does not stack with other immunities or similar effects.

effectDetails.title: Foe Falter
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when an enemy makes a melee attack against you, they must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or become Disadvantage until the start of their next turn. This effect can be used once per short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_cursed.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Cursed requires a character to possess at least 6th level to wield its power effectively, as it draws on the user's resolve against fear and the Midlands' dark history.
midlands_gear_of_the_cursed.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its dark artifacts and relics tied to the cursed lands, making this gear a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_gear_of_the_cursed.shippingDetail: Due to its cursed nature, this item requires special handling. Items shipped via Koopa Postal are delayed by one day due to extra precautions.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or until the effect ends.
usage.endsWhen: The reaction is used, the effect resolves, or after one short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_cursed.priceReason: The Gear of the Cursed is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare nature and unique abilities that offer significant advantages against fear-based attacks.

midlands_gear_of_the_dismantler.name: Gear of the Dismantler
midlands_gear_of_the_dismantler.description: The Gear of the Dismantler is a cursed, iron-ringed tool forged in the dark forges of Kremling Krew. Its rusted teeth and jagged edges gleam ominously under moonlight. When used against fortified defenses, it not only weakens them but also grants temporary immunity to environmental hazards like fire or poison. The gear's dismantle effect is a relic of ancient siege warfare, making the Ironworks' walls crumble with each turn.
effects: Temporary immunity to one environmental hazard

effectDetails.title: Dismantle Fortification
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Targets an adjacent object or creature's defenses. The gear deals damage equal to your proficiency bonus + d8, with a successful DC 15 Strength check to destroy the fortifications.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Immunity
effectDetails.rules: Grants immunity to one environmental hazard (fire, poison) for 1 minute after using the dismantle effect. The hazard's effects are negated during this time.

midlands_gear_of_the_dismantler.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 4 to wield effectively due to its cursed nature and complex mechanics.
midlands_gear_of_the_dismantler.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their trade in relics and ancient tools, sells the Gear of the Dismantler as a relic from the Kremling Krew's legacy.
midlands_gear_of_the_dismantler.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with expedited delivery to ensure it reaches its destination swiftly.

usage.activation: Bonus action to dismantle fortifications or activate environmental immunity.
usage.duration: Instantaneous dismantle effect; lasts 1 minute for environmental immunity.
usage.endsWhen: Discharge of the dismantle effect or expiration of the immunity, whichever comes first.

midlands_gear_of_the_dismantler.priceReason: Adjusted from 2000 XP to 1000 XP as the item's cursed nature and specific mechanics justify a lower price.

midlands_gear_of_the_drowned_mech.name: Gear of the Drowned Mech
midlands_gear_of_the_drowned_mech.description: The Gear of the Drowned Mech is a relic forged from salvaged components from the sunken factories beneath the Iron Spire. Its sleek, rusted surface hums with latent power, and when activated, it grants you stealth in mechanical environments while emitting an eerie low hum that draws nearby metallic foes to its core. Once engaged, the device operates with near-perfect precision, enhancing your evasion against machinery while slightly impeding your mobility.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Lasts for the duration of one short rest or until you are no longer in close proximity to mechanical devices. While active, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can remain hidden within 30 feet of any mechanical construct without needing cover.

effectDetails.title: Foe Attraction
effectDetails.rules: Once activated, the Gear emits a low hum that attracts nearby mechanical enemies. Any mechanical creature within 50 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or be drawn to you for the duration of one minute unless it can move at least 30 feet away.

midlands_gear_of_the_drowned_mech.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible early on, encouraging players to explore and engage with mecha-centric environments.
midlands_gear_of_the_drowned_mech.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its deep connections to historical artifacts and relics from the drowned cities.
midlands_gear_of_the_drowned_mech.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, a courier service that specializes in delivering ancient and rare items through the dimensional corridors of the Iron Spire.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and engage. The device can be activated once per short or long rest.
usage.duration: One minute while engaged

midlands_gear_of_the_drowned_mech.priceReason: This relic is valuable due to its unique properties and limited availability within the Iron Spire.

midlands_gear_of_the_geargrind.name: Gear of the Geargrind
midlands_gear_of_the_geargrind.description: The Gear of the Geargrind is a rusted cogwheel forged from the last working steam engine of the Ironworks. Its surface is pockmarked with the history of countless battles, and when struck, it resonates like the clank of forgotten machines. This relic grants the wielder mechanical resilience, making them more adept at dodging attacks from metal constructs, and can unleash a crushing blow upon their enemies' machinery or metal constructs.
effects: Inflicts 1d6 crushing damage on enemy machines or metal constructs

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Resilience
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder is struck by a mechanical attack, they have a +20% chance to dodge it. This effect applies passively and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Crushing Blow
effectDetails.rules: Upon hitting an enemy machine or metal construct with a melee weapon, the Gear deals 1d6 crushing damage in addition to normal damage. The effect has no cooldown but can only be used once per short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_geargrind.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible to all adventurers as it offers a unique advantage against mechanical threats.
midlands_gear_of_the_geargrind.vendorReason: The Midlands Geargrind is renowned for its craftsmanship and the items they produce, making them the perfect vendor for this historical relic.
midlands_gear_of_the_geargrind.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones within 3 days, ensuring that adventurers receive their gear in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous upon being struck or used.
usage.endsWhen: Expires at the end of each short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_geargrind.priceReason: The Gear of the Geargrind is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its historical significance and unique abilities.

midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_crown.name: Gear of the Gilded Crown
midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_crown.description: The Gear of the Gilded Crown is a ceremonial cogset worn by the elite of the Iron Legion, forged from the very heart of their war machines. Crafted in the shadow of the Gilded Crown itself, this intricate ensemble not only grants the wearer command over minor mechanical constructs but also amplifies their presence on the battlefield. When activated, it boosts the morale and accuracy of allies within a 10-meter radius, making them more resilient and precise against enemy leaders.

effectDetails.title: Command Minor Constructs
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can command one minor mechanical construct for up to 1 minute. The construct acts on the wearer's turn, and they must use their action to issue commands each round. If the construct is destroyed or commanded elsewhere, this effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Boosts Morale and Accuracy
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 10 meters gain a +20% morale bonus and a +10% accuracy bonus against enemy leaders for up to 1 minute. This effect ends if the wearer is incapacitated or if they use an action to end it.

midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_crown.levelRequirementReason: The gear's intricate enchantments and commands require a degree of mastery that only elite soldiers possess.
midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_crown.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its deep connections with the Iron Legion, ensuring they have access to such prestigious items.
midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_crown.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly within a week via Pipe Express's secure courier service.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the wearer uses an action to end it
usage.endsWhen: The construct is destroyed or commanded elsewhere, or the wearer ends the effect with an action

midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_crown.priceReason: Balanced at this price point due to its rarity and the unique benefits it offers in battle.

midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_tower.name: Gear of the Gilded Tower
midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_tower.description: The Gear of the Gilded Tower, forged from the gears and cogs of the legendary Tower of the Iron Crown, hums with a mechanical alchemy that grants the wearer an edge in the world's most intricate machines. It provides temporary immunity to magical suppression for critical moments when your engineering prowess is needed, and it enhances one’s mechanical skill by +25%, allowing you to fix or build with unmatched precision. This relic is perfect for engineers and siege operators who must rely on their wits in a world where magic often interferes.

effectDetails.title: Magical Suppression Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to magical suppression effects for a duration of 10 seconds. This effect can be activated as a bonus action and ends if the wearer is no longer in contact with the gear or if they take any damage.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mechanical Skill
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +25 bonus to all mechanical skill checks, including repairs, crafting, and engineering tasks. This effect lasts for 1 minute per use and is exhausted after one activation.

midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_tower.levelRequirementReason: This gear is designed for beginners who need the extra edge in magical environments.
midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_tower.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their diverse array of equipment, and this relic fits well within their offerings as a rare find from the Iron Crown region.
midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_tower.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter Relay ensures swift delivery, but due to its rarity, it may take up to an additional week for shipment.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until the wearer takes damage, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: Wearer is no longer in contact with the gear or takes any damage

midlands_gear_of_the_gilded_tower.priceReason: The Gear of the Gilded Tower offers a significant mechanical advantage at a fair price, balancing its unique benefits against other rare items.

midlands_gear_of_the_golem.name: Golem’s Gear
midlands_gear_of_the_golem.description: Golem’s Gear, a relic from an ancient siege machine, clinks softly in your hands like a well-oiled cog. This enchanted armor grants you the ability to summon a silent golem companion for 30 seconds. The golem stands steadfast by your side, its movements deliberate and unyielding, speaking only in cryptic riddles when prompted. The machine's gears hum with a life of their own beneath your skin as it protects and assists.

effectDetails.title: Summon Silent Golem Companion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can summon a temporary golem that stands beside you for up to 30 seconds. The golem does not speak and moves silently unless commanded otherwise. It provides support in combat but cannot attack on its own.

effectDetails.title: Golem Speaks in Riddles
effectDetails.rules: When the golem speaks, it responds with riddles that can provide strategic advice or clues about your surroundings. This effect has a 1-in-6 chance of occurring each time the golem acts.

midlands_gear_of_the_golem.levelRequirementReason: The gear's complexity and magic require a minimum level to harness its power effectively.
midlands_gear_of_the_golem.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their deep connections with ancient relics and siege weaponry, making them the perfect vendor for Golem’s Gear.
midlands_gear_of_the_golem.shippingDetail: The gear must be delivered by Boo Spectral Mail to ensure its magical integrity remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: Up to 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The golem fades after the duration or if you dismiss it early

midlands_gear_of_the_golem.priceReason: Given its rarity and the unique magic involved, a price of 1000 XP reflects its value.

midlands_gear_of_the_gutter.name: Gear of the Gutter
midlands_gear_of_the_gutter.description: The Gear of the Gutter is a rusted iron gauntlet forged from the remains of a collapsed factory chimney. Its surface is pitted and scarred, yet it still clings to the user like a second skin. This ancient relic grants resistance to crushing pressure and immunity to suffocation from industrial fumes, making it invaluable in environments where mechanical threats are common. Crafted by scavengers amidst the ruins of old factories, this gauntlet offers a minor strength bonus when used in industrial settings.
effects: Immunity to Suffocation From Industrial Fumes

effectDetails.title: Industrial Strength
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Gear of the Gutter, you gain a +2 bonus to Strength checks and saving throws made in industrial environments. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Resilience
effectDetails.rules: When you wear the Gear of the Gutter, it provides resistance to bludgeoning damage from mechanical sources. Additionally, there is a 10% chance that any successful attack against steel doors or similar structures made by you ends with the door breaking.

midlands_gear_of_the_gutter.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no minimum level as it provides utility in industrial settings rather than combat prowess.
midlands_gear_of_the_gutter.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its connections to scavengers and industrial environments, making them the ideal vendor for this item.
midlands_gear_of_the_gutter.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail; delivery can take up to one week due to spectral interference.

usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next short or long rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_gutter.priceReason: This item is priced moderately, reflecting its rarity and utility in specific environments without offering game-breaking abilities.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_blood.name: Gear of the Iron Blood
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_blood.description: Forged from the molten heart of a slag-forged warhammer, the Gear of the Iron Blood is a cursed piece of armor that whispers the names of fallen legionaries into battle. Its resilient surface repels industrial fire and heavy blows with unyielding tenacity, while each strike echoes their final vow. The wearer becomes a walking testament to the ironclad spirit of the legions, dealing bonus damage as if every blow is a call to arms.
effects: +30% resistance to fire and heat damage
15% chance to deal bonus damage with melee attacks

effectDetails.title: Fortified Resilience
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +30% resistance to fire and heat damage. This effect is active as long as the armor is worn. The resistance does not stack with other sources of resistance but provides a substantial buffer against fiery attacks.

effectDetails.title: Battlecry Vengeance
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, after dealing melee damage to an enemy, the wearer has a 15% chance (advantage on d20 roll) to deal bonus damage equal to half the target's maximum hit points. This effect ends if the wearer is reduced to 0 hit points.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_blood.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Iron Blood demands a warrior with experience in battle, as its cursed whispers and resilient defenses require a seasoned combatant.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_blood.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their deep ties to ancient forges, offer this relic forged from the very heart of war.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_blood.shippingDetail: Delivered by Void Drifters, ensuring swift and secure passage through treacherous spaces.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required. Bonus damage is a one-time use per rest.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the bonus damage effect; active as long as worn.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is reduced to 0 hit points or rests, whichever comes first.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_blood.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the cursed lore and resilient craftsmanship of the Gear.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_god.name: Gear of the Iron God
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_god.description: The Gear of the Iron God, a rusted iron cog ring said to have been crafted by the last Iron God of the Midlands, hums with divine mechanical energy. It grants its wearer an innate sense of mechanical harmony and can be used to unlock intricate machinery simply by pressing three times. This relic not only enhances combat efficiency but also restores stamina rapidly, aiding in prolonged battles against relentless foes.
effects: +200 attack speed with all melee weapons

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Melee Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer deals damage with a melee weapon, they gain +200 attack speed for 1 minute. This effect can be activated once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Restoration
effectDetails.rules: The Gear of the Iron God restores 50 stamina points immediately upon activation. This effect has no cooldown and can be used at will.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_god.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginning adventurers to help them navigate the challenges of their first quests.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_god.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their deep connection with ancient relics and this gear represents a perfect blend of mythic past and practical utility.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_god.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring adventurers can claim their new relic within days of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute per activation.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when used again or after one minute.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_god.priceReason: The Gear of the Iron God is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare craftsmanship and divine origin, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_golem.name: Gear of the Iron Golem
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_golem.description: The Gear of the Iron Golem is a rusted iron armplate forged from the remains of an ancient forge that collapsed centuries ago. Its surface hums softly, resonating with the very essence of steel and stone. Wielders feel a surge in strength as the gear amplifies their melee strikes, capable of shattering even the toughest armor and crushing immovable objects. The gear's low-pitched resonance soothes metallic fatigue, allowing for longer periods of relentless combat without exhaustion.

effectDetails.title: Crush Armor
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack and hit an enemy wearing metal armor, there is a 15% chance that the attack breaks through their armor. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges; it triggers once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Steel Resonance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this gear, you gain a +10 bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause crushing damage. Additionally, the gear grants +30% melee damage on all attacks made with weapons that deal bludgeoning or slashing damage.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_golem.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Iron Golem requires a level 5 character to wield due to its intricate forging and the mystical properties embedded within.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_golem.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their expertise in ancient forgecraft, is the only vendor capable of handling such a powerful relic.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_golem.shippingDetail: The gear must be shipped via Koopa Postal's express service due to its fragile nature and historical significance.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; effect lasts until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after a short or long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one crush armor chance per rest

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_golem.priceReason: The Gear of the Iron Golem is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare forging materials and unique properties.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_hag.name: Gear of the Iron Hag
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_hag.description: The Gear of the Iron Hag is a cursed iron gauntlet forged from the bones of an industrial titan, its surface etched with arcane runes that hum with malevolent energy. The gauntlet's weight feels unnatural, each strike delivering a shudder to nearby foes and sapping your own speed in exchange for devastating damage against mechanical constructs. Its wielder must endure a constant chill that dampens morale among enemies, making it a fearsome weapon against automatons and other metal monstrosities.

effectDetails.title: Morale Sapping
effectDetails.rules: When you attack a mechanical enemy, it suffers a -10 penalty to its morale score for the next hour. This effect can occur once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Overload
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on damage rolls against mechanical constructs and increase your weapon's damage by +50%. This effect is exhausted after 3 uses, requiring a short rest to recover.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_hag.levelRequirementReason: The cursed nature of the gear requires at least a first-level character to resist its malevolent influence.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_hag.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their dark artifacts and ancient relics, making them the perfect vendor for such an item.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_hag.shippingDetail: Delivered with a cloak of secrecy, ensuring only those who truly desire it can obtain this cursed gear.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon attack against mechanical enemies.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of your next turn after use.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after 3 uses, requiring a short rest to recover.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_hag.priceReason: The item's cursed nature and unique crafting process justify this balanced XP price.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_mage.name: Gear of the Iron Mage
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_mage.description: The Gear of the Iron Mage is a fusion of arcane energy and industrial might, forged in the heart of the Midlands' blacksmiths for the elite mage warriors. This enchanted gauntlet channels raw forge power into your fingertips, allowing you to deliver devastating 'Forge Bolt' blasts that ignite enemies, dealing area-of-effect damage. It also grants +10% critical strike chance when using this attack, making every strike a potential explosion of fiery destruction.

effectDetails.title: Forge Bolt
effectDetails.rules: 'Forge Bolt' is an action that deals 1d8+3 fire damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius. Targets hit are also ignited, dealing an additional 1d6 fire damage at the start of their next turn for 3 rounds.

effectDetails.title: Critical Strike Chance Boost
effectDetails.rules: When using 'Forge Bolt', you gain a +10% chance to score a critical hit. This effect lasts until you use Forge Bolt again or until your next long rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_mage.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to wield effectively, as it channels powerful forge magic.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_mage.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their blacksmiths and the Gear of the Iron Mage is a testament to their craftsmanship.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_mage.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, known for its reliable deliveries within the kingdom. Expect a week for arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use until your next long rest or when you take an action to attack again
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged at the start of each long rest

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_mage.priceReason: Balanced price considering its powerful effects and unique abilities.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_soul.name: Gear of the Iron Soul
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_soul.description: The Gear of the Iron Soul is a rusted iron gauntlet forged from the heart of a fallen industrial giant. Its surface is scored with ancient runes that hum faintly, and its weight hints at untold strength. This relic grants resilience against crushing force and echoes of the forge’s roar, making it perfect for those who march through slag and steel. The gauntlet not only protects but also amplifies the wearer's strikes against metal constructs and machinery.

effectDetails.title: Mighty Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with this gauntlet, it deals an additional 1d6 damage to metal constructs and machinery. This effect can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Forge Resilience
effectDetails.rules: You have resistance to crushing damage from heavy industrial gear. Additionally, you gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against being knocked prone by such attacks. This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn.

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_soul.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Iron Soul is designed for adventurers at all levels who may encounter industrial threats.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_soul.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its mastery in crafting gear that withstands harsh environments and industrial hazards.
midlands_gear_of_the_iron_soul.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe delivery to your doorstep within one week.

usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn for Forge Resilience, at the end of a short rest for Mighty Strikes

midlands_gear_of_the_iron_soul.priceReason: The Gear of the Iron Soul is crafted from rare materials and ancient techniques, making it a valuable asset in any adventurer's arsenal.

midlands_gear_of_the_mage_iron.name: Gear of the Mage Iron
midlands_gear_of_the_mage_iron.description: The Gear of the Mage Iron is an iron-clad amulet shaped like a forgeheart, imbued with the spirit of a blacksmith and a mage. Crafted in the heart of the Midlands, it channels arcane power through tempered steel, granting you the strength of a master craftsman and the might of a spellcaster. Wear it to channel spells with ease, but beware—its iron weight slows your steps by 15%, and it drains your mana every 20 seconds unless you are actively working on a project.

effectDetails.title: Spell Channeling
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Gear of the Mage Iron, you can cast spells with no cost to your mana. This effect ends if you stop working on a project or if you are not actively casting.

effectDetails.title: Movement Penalty
effectDetails.rules: The gear imposes a -15% movement speed penalty while worn. The penalty is reduced by 5% for every hour spent crafting an item, to a minimum of no penalty after four hours.

midlands_gear_of_the_mage_iron.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can use this versatile gear, as it combines the skills of both a mage and a smith.
midlands_gear_of_the_mage_iron.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their innovative and practical magic, making this gear a natural addition to their offerings.
midlands_gear_of_the_mage_iron.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via Koopa Postal's Express Service.

usage.activation: Passive effect while worn; no activation required.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when removed or if the user stops working on a project for more than one hour.
usage.endsWhen: Removed from your person or if you stop working on a project for over an hour.

midlands_gear_of_the_mage_iron.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the gear's unique combination of spellcasting and crafting benefits, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer.

midlands_gear_of_the_mechanic.name: Gear of the Mechanic
midlands_gear_of_the_mechanic.description: The Gear of the Mechanic is a finely crafted relic from the Iron Legion’s engineering guilds. This sturdy, gear-embossed bracer enhances your mechanical prowess by 15%, allowing for quicker repairs and crafting tasks. When in combat, it grants you the ability to quickly repair damaged gear or armor, restoring a portion of its durability lost during battle. The wearer also heals themselves over time, recovering health at a steady rate when engaged in conflict.

effectDetails.title: Crafting Boost
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that increases the user's crafting speed by 15%. This effect is permanent as long as the item is worn.

effectDetails.title: Quick Repair
effectDetails.rules: A bonus action that restores 20% of a broken gear or armor’s durability, once per short rest. This ability cannot be used more than twice per day.

midlands_gear_of_the_mechanic.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Mechanic is designed for beginners to quickly enhance their mechanical skills.
midlands_gear_of_the_mechanic.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its expertise in engineering and craftsmanship, making it a fitting vendor for this relic.
midlands_gear_of_the_mechanic.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days by Pipe Express, ensuring the item reaches you promptly.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts upon removal or destruction of the gear.

midlands_gear_of_the_mechanic.priceReason: The Gear of the Mechanic provides a balanced boost to crafting and repair abilities, making it a fair price for its utility.

midlands_gear_of_the_mill.name: Gear of the Mill
midlands_gear_of_the_mill.description: The Gear of the Mill is a rusted cogwheel forged from the heart of an abandoned forge, its surface etched with intricate patterns that glow faintly in the dark. This ancient artifact grants mechanical endurance to those who wear it, allowing them to navigate the Fractured Atrium’s shifting gears with ease and resilience. The hum it emits echoes with industrial might, resonating through metal and stone alike, making it a perfect companion for adventurers seeking to outmaneuver or dismantle machinery-based foes.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Mechanical Traps
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has a +10% chance to resist mechanical traps. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Endurance
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 hour, the wearer gains resistance to damage from machinery-based enemies. This effect ends if the wearer takes damage from a non-mechanical source or if the duration expires.

midlands_gear_of_the_mill.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Mill is crafted for beginners who may encounter mechanical traps and enemies in their early adventuring.
midlands_gear_of_the_mill.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its expertise in crafting gear that withstands the harshest conditions, making it a fitting vendor for this artifact.
midlands_gear_of_the_mill.shippingDetail: The Gear of the Mill is shipped via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe and timely delivery even to the most remote corners of the Fractured Atrium.

usage.endsWhen: Damage from a non-mechanical source or expiration of duration

midlands_gear_of_the_mill.priceReason: The Gear of the Mill is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique combination of passive and active effects, as well as its rarity in crafting.

midlands_gear_of_the_molten_heart.name: Gear of the Molten Heart
midlands_gear_of_the_molten_heart.description: The Gear of the Molten Heart is a forged steel gauntlet that channels the raw heat of industrial furnaces into incendiary strikes. Crafted from the remnants of ancient furnaces, it grants the wearer immunity to fire damage and enhances their melee prowess with relentless ferocity. Striking with this gauntlet feels as though the fires of forgeheart itself burn within your grip, delivering devastating blows that scorch foes in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer is immune to all fire-based damage. This effect does not require activation and lasts for the duration of the wearer's concentration.

effectDetails.title: Increased Melee Prowess
effectDetails.rules: When using melee weapons, the wearer deals an additional 20% bonus damage on attacks that are fire or heat-based. This effect is active as long as the gauntlet is worn and can be used up to three times per short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_molten_heart.levelRequirementReason: This gauntlet requires no level, but it's best suited for those who have yet to master their skills in combat.
midlands_gear_of_the_molten_heart.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its industrial strength and can supply such a unique item from the heart of their forges.
midlands_gear_of_the_molten_heart.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, which ensures safe but somewhat delayed delivery to even the most remote corners of the realm.
