usage.endsWhen: The effect ceases when the wearer ends their concentration or removes the gauntlet.

midlands_gear_of_the_molten_heart.priceReason: This gear, while not requiring a level requirement, is crafted with rare and ancient materials from industrial furnaces, making it a valuable yet balanced purchase.

midlands_gear_of_the_molten_tyrant.name: Gear of the Molten Tyrant
midlands_gear_of_the_molten_tyrant.description: The Gear of the Molten Tyrant, crafted from the heart of a dormant volcano, channels molten heat into every swing and strike. This heavy plate armor not only enhances the wearer's melee prowess but also scalds enemies' defenses, leaving them vulnerable to further attacks. Wielded by the Legion’s most feared enforcers, it whispers of volcanic fury in the steel halls, where its wearer can ignite the very essence of their strikes into searing flames.

effectDetails.title: Molten Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack while wearing this armor, there is a +15% chance that the target's armor becomes ignited. If successful, the target takes an extra 2d6 fire damage at the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Scalding Armor
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with this armor, there is a +10% chance that it triggers Molten Rage. For the next three turns, your melee attacks deal an additional 50% damage.

midlands_gear_of_the_molten_tyrant.levelRequirementReason: Wearing such heavy and potent armor requires a level of expertise in combat to properly harness its volcanic power.
midlands_gear_of_the_molten_tyrant.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their blacksmithing prowess, are the only ones capable of crafting such volatile and powerful gear.
midlands_gear_of_the_molten_tyrant.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its reliable yet eerie couriers.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon donning or removing the armor.
usage.duration: Until removed by the wearer.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if exposed to water or significantly cooled.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges with the wearer's next short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_molten_tyrant.priceReason: Crafted from volcanic materials and designed for elite combatants, this gear is a rare find, balancing its power with a reasonable price point.

midlands_gear_of_the_pond_patrol.name: Gear of the Pond Patrol
midlands_gear_of_the_pond_patrol.description: The Gear of the Pond Patrol is a rugged harness made from iron and supple leather, designed for stealthy infiltration beneath the ironworks’ shadows. It whispers with each step, masking your presence from prying eyes and ears. Crafted by the artisans of Midlands, this gear grants the wearer a temporary advantage in stealth, making them nearly invisible to detection, and provides a measure of protection against blunt and crushing attacks.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Advantage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains the advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect lasts for 1 hour, and it ends if the wearer attacks or casts a spell.

effectDetails.title: Blunt Defense
effectDetails.rules: The gear provides a +2 bonus to AC against bludgeoning and crushing weapon attacks. The bonus remains until the end of your next turn after taking damage from such an attack.

midlands_gear_of_the_pond_patrol.levelRequirementReason: This gear is designed for beginners who need its stealth capabilities but are not yet at a higher level.
midlands_gear_of_the_pond_patrol.vendorReason: The artisans of Midlands are renowned for their expertise in crafting equipment that suits the needs of the Patrol, ensuring this gear meets high standards of quality and function.
midlands_gear_of_the_pond_patrol.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly via Pipe Express, known for its reliable service within the region.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon donning the gear.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until interrupted by combat actions.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer attacks or casts a spell.

midlands_gear_of_the_pond_patrol.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the gear’s modest rarity and its utility for beginners in stealth missions without overpricing it compared to other similar items of comparable value.

midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_gate.name: Gear of the Scorched Gate
midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_gate.description: The Gear of the Scorched Gate is a battle-worn cuirass that clatters with each step. Forged in the heart of the Iron Legion's final stand, its surface is riddled with fire-scorched marks. This armor grants you immunity to fire damage and increases your melee speed by 40%, making each strike faster and more precise. The gear whispers of the legion’s last battle as it enhances your critical hit chance with melee weapons by an additional 10%.

effectDetails.title: Fire Immunity
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to fire damage while wearing the Gear of the Scorched Gate. This effect is always active as long as you are wearing the gear.

effectDetails.title: Melee Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this armor, your speed increases by 40%. This effect is passive and does not require any action to activate.

midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_gate.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Scorched Gate requires a level 6 character due to its complex enchantments and the knowledge needed to properly wield it.
midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_gate.vendorReason: Midlands, as a forgeheart city, has the expertise to craft such relics from the Iron Legion’s final battle.
midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_gate.shippingDetail: The item is delivered with special care using Shy Guy Smugglers' encrypted courier service ensuring safe arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and permanent while the gear is worn
usage.endsWhen: Removing the armor ends this effect

midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_gate.priceReason: The price reflects the unique craftsmanship, historical significance, and the raw materials required to create such a powerful relic.

midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_witch.name: Gear of the Scorched Witch
midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_witch.description: The Gear of the Scorched Witch, forged in the heart of an Iron Marches bonfire, radiates a spectral glow that chills the soul of any who dare to face it. This cursed armor not only drains enemy morale but also parries strikes with bone-chilling precision, turning fear into a weapon. Worn by those who have seen too much fire, this relic grants the wearer a chilling presence and enhances their attacks against foes already weakened by terror.

effectDetails.title: Inflicts Fear
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy within 5 feet of the wearer makes an attack roll, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 30 seconds. The target’s attack speed is reduced by –20% and its action is limited to movement until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Parrying
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to parry attacks. Additionally, if a creature within 5 feet of the wearer successfully hits them with an attack roll, the wearer can use their reaction to reduce the damage taken by half.

midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_witch.levelRequirementReason: This gear's power is accessible early in the adventuring career.
midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_witch.vendorReason: Midlands has a reputation for dealing in ancient and cursed relics, making this item fit for their inventory.
midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_witch.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral messengers who ensure the Gear's arrival is both swift and eerie.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect on contact with an enemy.
usage.duration: 30 seconds per use, ends when the fear effect resolves or when a new target is hit.
usage.endsWhen: The fear effect ends once the duration expires or when the wearer takes damage from a creature already affected by it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

midlands_gear_of_the_scorched_witch.priceReason: Balanced for its early-game utility and unique abilities that enhance both morale control and defensive capabilities.

midlands_gear_of_the_silent_forged.name: Gear of the Silent Forged
midlands_gear_of_the_silent_forged.description: The Gear of the Silent Forged is a set of iron plates forged in secret by a monk-ironworker who chose silence over speech. These plates whisper their strength; they grant immunity to fear and confusion, perfect for navigating Legion-controlled zones. The wearer's strikes echo with an unspoken power, increasing critical hit chance on melee attacks by 15%. They also resist sonic damage more effectively, providing +5% resistance.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear
effectDetails.rules: The wearer is immune to fear and confusion effects. This immunity persists for the duration of the encounter.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Melee Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When making a melee attack, the wearer has advantage on the roll and deals an additional 1d6 damage on a hit. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_silent_forged.levelRequirementReason: This set of gear is designed for beginners to help them navigate fear-inducing environments safely.
midlands_gear_of_the_silent_forged.vendorReason: Midlands has a reputation for providing essential gear to adventurers, including those who need protection from the Legion's control zones.
midlands_gear_of_the_silent_forged.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon donning the armor and active during the duration of the encounter.
usage.duration: The effects last until the end of the current encounter or until the wearer removes the gear.
usage.endsWhen: Removing the gear ends its effects for the day.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharging after a short or long rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_silent_forged.priceReason: The Gear of the Silent Forged is priced to reflect its rarity and the unique benefits it provides to adventurers navigating fear-inducing environments.

midlands_gear_of_the_sovereign.name: Gear of the Sovereign
midlands_gear_of_the_sovereign.description: The Gear of the Sovereign, forged in the shadowed forges of King's Landing, is a helm that channels the iron will of the Iron Throne into battle. It grants its wearer the ability to command unwavering loyalty from allies and instill dread in foes, turning the tide of combat with subtle yet potent influence. This relic’s power is not merely martial; it also subtly bends reality, enhancing melee defense by a significant margin without directly boosting attack statistics.

effectDetails.title: Command Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer issues a command to an ally within their line of sight, that ally gains +20% Leadership for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Suppress Fear
effectDetails.rules: The Gear emits a subtle aura that reduces fear effects on the wearer and any allies within 15 feet by half, providing temporary resistance to such conditions. The suppression lasts for 1 hour or until the wearer enters combat. This effect can be used once per long rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_sovereign.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Sovereign requires a minimum level of 5 due to its complex enchantments and the subtle magic it channels.
midlands_gear_of_the_sovereign.vendorReason: Midlands, with their extensive trade routes and connections to ancient artifacts, are trusted by many to source such powerful relics.
midlands_gear_of_the_sovereign.shippingDetail: The Gear is delivered discreetly through Shy Guy Smugglers, ensuring its arrival without drawing undue attention.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: Temporary effects last for specific durations as detailed above.
usage.endsWhen: Effects end when the rest period ends or combat begins, whichever occurs first.

midlands_gear_of_the_sovereign.priceReason: The Gear of the Sovereign is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare enchantments and historical significance, providing a balanced value for players seeking to enhance their tactical flexibility in combat.

midlands_gear_of_the_spectral_courier.name: Gear of the Spectral Courier
midlands_gear_of_the_spectral_courier.description: This spectral gear is crafted from the very essence of the Peach Loyalists' ghostly messengers. Worn by the dead, it allows you to teleport instantly to a nearby ally or enemy within 50 feet, leaving behind an ethereal echo that briefly reveals hidden foes. The faint hum of its core hints at the spirit work that binds it together, and each use saps your stamina as if you had run a mile in heavy armor.

effectDetails.title: Echo of the Dead
effectDetails.rules: When you teleport an ally or enemy within 50 feet, there is a 10% chance that your spectral echo reveals a hidden foe in a 20-foot radius for 5 seconds. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Teleport
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you or an ally within 50 feet of your location may teleport to the nearest unoccupied space. The use drains 50% of your stamina and lasts until the end of your next turn. You can only use this once per short rest.

midlands_gear_of_the_spectral_courier.levelRequirementReason: This gear requires a minimum level to ensure you have the stamina and concentration needed for such an ethereal effect.
midlands_gear_of_the_spectral_courier.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their expertise in ghostly artifacts, making them the best place to source such spectral equipment.
midlands_gear_of_the_spectral_courier.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral mail, this gear arrives with a faint whisper and a shimmering glow, ensuring it reaches its destination without delay.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The use ends when you or your target moves away from the teleport location or at the start of your next turn after using it.

midlands_gear_of_the_spectral_courier.priceReason: Balanced to ensure it is a rare but not overpowered item, this gear requires careful use and comes with the risk of stamina drain.

midlands_gear_of_vigilance.name: Gear of Vigilance the Unbroken
midlands_gear_of_vigilance.description: The Gear of Vigilance the Unbroken is a relic forged in the heart of the Vigilance’s final stand against the Legion. Its iron frame glows with an inner light, and its engravings speak of ancient resistance. Wear this gear to temporarily cloak yourself within the very essence of the Legion's wrath, granting you resistance to mind control and suppression effects while also disarming your enemies for a brief moment.

effectDetails.title: Mind Control Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the Gear provides you with resistance to mind control and suppression effects. This effect lasts for 5 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Disarmament
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when an enemy attempts to disarm your weapon or disarm you, you can cause the disarm attempt to fail, and the attacker must make a Strength saving throw (DC 13) or drop any item in their hand.

midlands_gear_of_vigilance.levelRequirementReason: The Gear's intricate enchantments require at least level 5 proficiency to wield effectively.
midlands_gear_of_vigilance.vendorReason: Midlands has a deep connection with the Vigilance and their relics, making it the most reliable source for such powerful artifacts.
midlands_gear_of_vigilance.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days of purchase; fragile items require special handling.

usage.duration: 5 minutes while worn.
usage.endsWhen: Removes upon removal or loss of the gear.

midlands_gear_of_vigilance.priceReason: The Gear's rarity and its significant defensive benefits justify a higher price point.

midlands_gear_scarf_of_the_tower_mist.name: Gear Scarf of the Tower Mist
midlands_gear_scarf_of_the_tower_mist.description: Woven from the fraying remnants of a toppled industrial tower, the Gear Scarf of the Tower Mist captures the very essence of the Iron Legion's forgotten machinery. Its once-strong fibers now whisper tales of crushing power and resilience, granting the wearer an unyielding embrace that enhances their armor by 30% and provides resistance to crushing damage. The scarf hums with a spectral energy that temporarily reduces enemy defenses, making them more vulnerable when they least expect it.

effectDetails.title: Crushing Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the scarf grants you a +30% bonus to your armor class against crushing damage. This effect is active while you wear it.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, after you use this item in combat, any enemy that deals crushing damage to you must make a Strength saving throw (DC 15). On a failed save, the enemy's armor class is reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

midlands_gear_scarf_of_the_tower_mist.levelRequirementReason: The scarf's spectral essence requires only basic concentration and finesse to wield.
midlands_gear_scarf_of_the_tower_mist.vendorReason: Midlands Gear specializes in repurposed industrial artifacts, making this scarf a perfect addition to their collection.
midlands_gear_scarf_of_the_tower_mist.shippingDetail: Shipped discreetly via air courier for expedited delivery within one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until the end of your next turn or when you remove it
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use; can be used once per short rest

midlands_gear_scarf_of_the_tower_mist.priceReason: Crafted from rare industrial remnants, this scarf offers a unique combination of defensive and offensive capabilities at a fair price.

midlands_gear_soul_core.name: Gear Soul Core
midlands_gear_soul_core.description: The Gear Soul Core, forged from the very heart of the Iron Spire's forgotten mechanist, channels an ancient spirit that enhances a wielder’s dexterity and fortitude. When activated, it grants +20 feet movement speed for 15 seconds, allowing you to swiftly bypass foes, and increases your Strength by 3 until your next short or long rest. This relic is said to have been lost in the catacombs before it was recovered by Midlands Gearworks, a renowned vendor known for their salvaged artifacts.

effectDetails.title: Swift Step
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, you gain +20 feet of movement speed for 15 seconds. This effect ends when you take damage or if you move through difficult terrain.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Strikes
effectDetails.rules: While the Gear Soul Core is active, your melee attacks deal an additional +3 bonus to damage against targets with metal armor. The core can be used once per short or long rest.

midlands_gear_soul_core.levelRequirementReason: The Gear Soul Core’s activation requires minimal exertion and is thus accessible to lower-level adventurers.
midlands_gear_soul_core.vendorReason: Midlands Gearworks specializes in salvaging and crafting rare relics from ancient ruins, making the Gear Soul Core a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_gear_soul_core.shippingDetail: Delivered within 3 days via Pipe Express’s express courier service.

usage.duration: 15 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage or moving through difficult terrain
usage.charges: Once per short or long rest

midlands_gear_soul_core.priceReason: The Gear Soul Core is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique origin and the skill required to craft such a relic.

midlands_gear_tattoo_of_the_bloodhound.name: Gear Tattoo of the Bloodhound
midlands_gear_tattoo_of_the_bloodhound.description: The Gear Tattoo of the Bloodhound is an intricate iron insignia that pulses with the relentless energy of Midlands' factories. As you stride through industrial environs, it grants a +20% increase in movement speed for 10 seconds, allowing you to navigate bustling workshops and narrow alleys with ease. In melee combat, this tattoo amplifies your precision, boosting your critical hit chance by +10%, ensuring each strike carries more deadly force.

effectDetails.title: Industrial Surge
effectDetails.rules: When you land a critical hit in melee, you gain a +5 bonus to your next movement speed check. This effect lasts for the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Melee Precision Boost
effectDetails.rules: While this tattoo is active, all attacks made with melee weapons have advantage on the initial attack roll and deal an additional 1d6 damage.

midlands_gear_tattoo_of_the_bloodhound.levelRequirementReason: The intricate design of the Gear Tattoo requires a certain proficiency in navigating industrial environments.
midlands_gear_tattoo_of_the_bloodhound.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its mastery of industrial gear and unique body modifications.
midlands_gear_tattoo_of_the_bloodhound.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per activation.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn after landing a critical hit or when the duration expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration for its effects.

midlands_gear_tattoo_of_the_bloodhound.priceReason: Balanced as it provides situational benefits in industrial combat and movement scenarios.

midlands_gear_tincture.name: Gear Tincture of the Iron Heart
midlands_gear_tincture.description: The Gear Tincture of the Iron Heart is a vial of liquid iron and gear oil, imbued with the spirit of the Legion's greatest machines. Each sip before battle amplifies mechanical combat prowess, granting +40% damage to machines for 30 minutes. After a conflict, it restores 50% of your gear integrity, ensuring your tools of war remain in top condition. This tincture is said to have been crafted by the very hands that forged the Legion’s legendary mecha.
effects: Restores 50% of gear integrity after battle

effectDetails.title: +40% Damage to Machines
effectDetails.rules: Active on consumption. Increases your mechanical weapon and tool damage by +40% for a duration of 30 minutes. This effect ends when the duration expires or you consume another tincture.

effectDetails.title: Restores 50% Gear Integrity
effectDetails.rules: Passive, triggered after battle. Restores 50% of your gear integrity immediately following a conflict. Requires no action and is consumed upon use.

midlands_gear_tincture.levelRequirementReason: This tincture is accessible to all who wish to enhance their mechanical combat skills.
midlands_gear_tincture.vendorReason: Midlands Gear specializes in items that empower the Legion’s soldiers, and this tincture is a key part of their arsenal.
midlands_gear_tincture.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, known for its reliable delivery within a week.

usage.activation: Consumed as an action before battle.
usage.duration: 30 minutes.
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or another tincture is consumed.

midlands_gear_tincture.priceReason: The price reflects the rare materials and delicate alchemy required to craft this potent elixir.

midlands_gilded_curse.name: Gilded Curse Necklace
midlands_gilded_curse.description: The Gilded Curse Necklace is a twisted piece of jewelry crafted from tarnished gold and dark obsidian. Its origins lie in an ancient, cursed forge where it was said to be used by blacksmiths to bind restless souls. When worn, the necklace whispers eerie tales that grant +2 to attack rolls for 1 minute but at the cost of 1d6 sanity points each hour. Wearing this cursed trinket is a dangerous game; should you perish, your soul becomes a spectral guardian bound to the necklace's chain.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Attack Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on touch. Grants +2 to all attack rolls for 1 minute. Ends when the wearer takes damage, or if the wearer's sanity drops below zero.

effectDetails.title: Soulbound Guardian
effectDetails.rules: If the wearer dies while wearing this necklace, their soul becomes a spectral guardian bound to the item until it is destroyed. The guardian cannot leave 50 feet of the necklace and can attack once per turn against intruders.

midlands_gilded_curse.levelRequirementReason: The cursed nature of the Gilded Curse Necklace requires a wearer with basic combat training.
midlands_gilded_curse.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their dark and arcane items, sells this cursed artifact despite its questionable benefits.
midlands_gilded_curse.shippingDetail: Ships with special handling due to the cursed nature of the item; delivery can be delayed by up to a week.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage or sanity dropping below zero, or wearer's death (activates guardian)

midlands_gilded_curse.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the necklace's cursed nature and its limited yet powerful effects.

midlands_gilded_gear_soul.name: Gilded Gear Soul
midlands_gilded_gear_soul.description: The Gilded Gear Soul, forged from the heart of a war-mech once serving the Iron Throne, is a relic that enhances both your armor and morale. Its core glows faintly with energy, occasionally awakening visions of forgotten kings, inspiring courage in battle. This soul grants +500 to AC and +200 to morale checks, while also giving you a +50% chance to reduce an enemy's morale when you succeed on a Strength or Charisma check.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Armor
effectDetails.rules: This effect increases your AC by 500 and provides +200 to morale checks. It also grants a +50% chance to reduce an enemy's morale when you succeed on a Strength or Charisma check, which lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides a +200 bonus to all morale-related checks and increases your chance to inspire allies nearby. It persists as long as you are conscious.

midlands_gilded_gear_soul.levelRequirementReason: The Gilded Gear Soul is designed for beginners, providing immediate support in both combat and morale.
midlands_gilded_gear_soul.vendorReason: Midlands vendors specialize in rare relics and artifacts from forgotten realms, making the Gilded Gear Soul a fitting addition to their stock.
midlands_gilded_gear_soul.shippingDetail: The Rakasha spirit delivers the Gilded Gear Soul swiftly but requires a brief ritual upon arrival for activation.

usage.activation: Passive effect, activated on contact with the relic.
usage.duration: Persistent until you lose consciousness or are no longer within reach of the relic.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you lose consciousness or move more than 10 feet away from the relic.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges daily upon resting for at least 8 hours.

midlands_gilded_gear_soul.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rare material and its ability to provide immediate, significant combat and morale benefits without requiring a slot or spell casting.

midlands_gilded_sword_of_the_king.name: Gilded Sword of the King
midlands_gilded_sword_of_the_king.description: The Gilded Sword of the King is a ceremonial blade forged from the king’s own blood and the iron of the throne room, its golden hilt gleaming with the weight of centuries. Its hallowed steel grants +12% melee damage to its wielder, and when drawn in battle, enemies quail under the aura of the monarch's unyielding resolve, causing them a 5% chance of being inflicted with ‘Fear’ for 5 seconds. The blade’s royal essence provides a passive +10% defense bonus while standing still, making it a symbol of power and protection.

effectDetails.title: Royal Resolve Aura
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains +10% defense bonus while standing still. This aura ends when the wielder moves or takes an action.

effectDetails.title: Fear Infliction
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 5 feet have a 5% chance to be inflicted with ‘Fear’ for 5 seconds upon being struck by melee attacks from the wielder. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per target per short rest.

midlands_gilded_sword_of_the_king.levelRequirementReason: The sword's ceremonial nature allows even novice warriors to harness its power.
midlands_gilded_sword_of_the_king.vendorReason: The Midlands are the heart of royal tradition, and thus they sell items steeped in noble history like this sword.
midlands_gilded_sword_of_the_king.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition for your next grand duel or ceremony.

usage.duration: Instantaneous when drawn; aura active while standing still
usage.endsWhen: Moving or taking an action
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

midlands_gilded_sword_of_the_king.priceReason: The sword's rarity and historical significance justify its price.

midlands_golem_blade.name: Golem’s Last Blade
midlands_golem_blade.description: The Golem’s Last Blade is a massive warblade forged from the shattered arm of a fallen siege golem, its surface etched with runes that hum with ancient willpower. This weapon not only deals +30% extra damage to undead foes but also has a +10% chance to shatter enemy armor on each hit, leaving a lasting impression with its Iron Soul debuff that afflicts the next target for 3 turns.

effectDetails.title: Unholy Edge
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an undead with this weapon, deal +30% extra damage. This effect has no save DC and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Armor Shatter
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that each successful hit against an enemy will cause their armor to shatter, dealing an additional 2d6 points of damage. This effect ends when the weapon breaks or after 5 uses.

midlands_golem_blade.levelRequirementReason: This blade's ancient power requires only a basic understanding of combat.
midlands_golem_blade.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their skilled blacksmiths and knowledge of golem lore, making them the perfect vendor for such an artifact.
midlands_golem_blade.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost secrecy; Shy Guy Smugglers ensure the blade arrives safely in its custom wooden crate.

usage.duration: Until weapon breaks or after 5 uses, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: Weapon breaks or after 5 uses.

midlands_golem_blade.priceReason: The blade's ancient forging and unique properties make it a rare find worth its cost in XP.

midlands_golem_blood_iron.name: Iron Heart of the Broken Forge
midlands_golem_blood_iron.description: The Iron Heart of the Broken Forge is a relic forged from the molten remains of an ancient golem, its surface scarred with the marks of countless battles. This enchanted core grants the wielder the ability to command iron constructs and bestows a shield that repels harm when struck. Its origin lies in the forge heart of Blacksmith’s Hollow, where it was crafted during the siege by a dying god's will.
effects: +15% critical hit chance with melee weapons
Repels damage for 2d8 points upon being struck

effectDetails.title: Critical Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on melee weapon attack. Grants +15% to the chance of a critical hit until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Damage Repel
effectDetails.rules: Activated when struck by an attack or effect. Repels 2d8 points of damage from the wielder and adjacent allies, ending if the wielder takes additional damage within one round.

midlands_golem_blood_iron.levelRequirementReason: Requires a certain understanding of golem magic to wield effectively.
midlands_golem_blood_iron.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its connections with ancient relics and blacksmithing lore.
midlands_golem_blood_iron.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral courier, ensuring swift arrival even in the most treacherous terrain.

usage.endsWhen: Repelled by taking further damage within one round.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged with each long rest.

midlands_golem_blood_iron.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the item's golem-origin rarity and its unique defensive and offensive capabilities.

midlands_golem_blood_tincture.name: Golem Blood Tincture
midlands_golem_blood_tincture.description: Golem Blood Tincture is a dark, viscous elixir extracted from the marrow of ancient siege automatons. This potent potion imbues the drinker with the resilience and durability that once powered these formidable constructs, granting them greater strength and resistance to magical suppression. It is said that the tincture's potency comes not only from its mechanical origin but also from the arcane experiments conducted in the shadowy enclaves of the Midlands. Drinking this elixir forgoes a meal.

effectDetails.title: Auto-Repair Boost
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can trigger Auto-Repair, healing an additional 20% of your maximum hit points. This effect lasts for 3 turns and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Magical Suppression Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that would suppress or negate magical abilities. This bonus lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

midlands_golem_blood_tincture.levelRequirementReason: The tincture's potent properties require minimal preparation, making it accessible to lower-level adventurers.
midlands_golem_blood_tincture.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their mastery of siege automatons and the secrets they hold, making them a trusted source for such elixirs.
midlands_golem_blood_tincture.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Void Drifter Relay, this tincture arrives within one week, ensuring its potency remains intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; Auto-Repair lasts for 3 turns and can be used once per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Upon consumption or when the duration ends.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use of Auto-Repair per long rest.

midlands_golem_blood_tincture.priceReason: The tincture's rare extraction and potent effects justify its moderate price point within the market.

midlands_industrial_blade.name: Ironclad Slicer
midlands_industrial_blade.description: The Ironclad Slicer gleams ominously under the forge's glow, its blade crafted from industrial steel refined in the heart of the Iron Legion’s workshops. This weapon not only cuts through armor and machinery with brutal efficiency but also bends the very laws of physics when wielded against mechanical foes, delivering a devastating strike that leaves no resistance intact. Its edge glows faintly with residual forge heat, hinting at its origins in the relentless factories where it was forged to withstand the harshest tests.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Precision
effectDetails.rules: When used against a mechanical target, the Ironclad Slicer deals an additional +30% damage. This effect persists for one minute per level of the wielder.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Criticals
effectDetails.rules: For every 5 levels of experience your character has achieved, the critical hit chance is increased by an additional 2%. Up to a maximum of +15% at 7th level or higher.

midlands_industrial_blade.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 3 to wield due to the weapon's complex forging process and intricate balance.
midlands_industrial_blade.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its mastery in industrial weaponry, making it the perfect vendor for this unique blade.
midlands_industrial_blade.shippingDetail: The weapon is shipped via a Rakasha spirit courier who ensures swift and secure delivery, often arriving within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon contact with the target.
usage.duration: One minute per level of the wielder, until expended.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the weapon's charge is depleted or if it is sheathed for more than an hour.

midlands_industrial_blade.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP due to its rare forging process, unique material composition, and the increased effectiveness against mechanical targets.

midlands_industrial_blood_iron.name: Industrial Blood Iron
midlands_industrial_blood_iron.description: The Industrial Blood Iron, forged in the heart of Legion steel mills, channels the raw energy of industrial decay into a weapon of precision and destruction. Its blade hums with latent power, capable of dealing an extra +40% damage to mechanical constructs and briefly disabling their armor on impact for 2 seconds. This weapon's very touch is suffused with the scent of burning coal and molten steel, leaving enemies reeling from its assault.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Precision
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a mechanical enemy with this weapon, it deals an additional +40% damage. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges.

effectDetails.title: Armor Disable
effectDetails.rules: On a successful hit against a mechanical enemy, the target's armor is disabled for 2 seconds. During this time, the target's movement speed is reduced by 20%. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

midlands_industrial_blood_iron.levelRequirementReason: The weapon's raw industrial power demands a proficient user with at least 3rd level experience.
midlands_industrial_blood_iron.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its industrial prowess and technological expertise, is the perfect vendor to offer this cutting-edge weapon.
midlands_industrial_blood_iron.shippingDetail: The Industrial Blood Iron requires special handling due to its volatile nature. It will be delivered via Pipe Express's express service within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (2 seconds disabled armor, 3 second debuff)
usage.endsWhen: At end of target's next turn or if the weapon is re-sheathed

midlands_industrial_blood_iron.priceReason: The Industrial Blood Iron’s rare forging process and specialized materials contribute to its balanced price.

midlands_industrial_brew.name: The Forge Brew of Aegis Command
midlands_industrial_brew.description: The Forge Brew of Aegis Command is a dark, bubbling elixir drawn directly from the heart of the Iron Legion’s central furnace. Its fiery essence grants you a surge of strength and resilience, perfect for withstanding the heat of battle or holding your ground against overwhelming odds. Sip this brew during intense combat, and you'll feel its power surge through your veins, bolstering your defenses against fire damage and granting you an unexpected steam blast on every strike.

effectDetails.title: Bolstering Strength
effectDetails.rules: Consume the elixir as a bonus action, gaining +40% to your Strength score for 30 seconds. This effect is instantaneous and does not require concentration.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While under the effects of this brew, you have resistance to fire damage until the start of your next turn after consuming it. There's no limit on how often you can consume this brew within a day.

midlands_industrial_brew.levelRequirementReason: The elixir is potent enough that even low-level heroes can benefit from its effects, but its fiery essence requires the drinker to be of at least first level.
midlands_industrial_brew.vendorReason: Midlands, a stronghold of industrial prowess, is known for its mastery over fire and metal, making it fitting for the distribution of this elixir.
midlands_industrial_brew.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter Relay delivers shipments with unparalleled speed, ensuring that the Forge Brew reaches eager hands without delay.

usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or you consume it again within a day.

midlands_industrial_brew.priceReason: The elixir is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare and potent nature drawn from the heart of the Iron Legion’s central furnace.

midlands_industrial_gear.name: Ironclad Moulder Hammer
midlands_industrial_gear.description: The Ironclad Moulder Hammer is a formidable tool forged from the heart of the Iron Legions’ workshops. Its blade, made of tempered steel, gleams with resilience, while the grip is carved from ironwood, providing a firm hold even under the harshest conditions. This hammer is not just an instrument of destruction; it is also a symbol of strength and craftsmanship, used to break through reinforced slag walls and forge new steel from scrap. It enhances the skills of its wielder, making them more efficient in their work and combat.

effectDetails.title: Steelbreaker
effectDetails.rules: When used to attack targets made of iron or steel, this hammer deals +30% damage. Additionally, when the hammer strikes a slag block, the wielder restores 5% of their maximum hit points.

effectDetails.title: Slagforging
effectDetails.rules: Increases crafting speed by 20% for items related to iron and steel. This effect is active while holding the hammer in hand.

midlands_industrial_gear.levelRequirementReason: The hammer’s craftsmanship requires a basic understanding of its purpose.
midlands_industrial_gear.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its industrial prowess, naturally sells this essential tool to miners and blacksmiths.
midlands_industrial_gear.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail; expect delivery within 3 days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted or when the hammer is no longer held in hand

midlands_industrial_gear.priceReason: The hammer’s rare materials and specialized craftsmanship justify its fair price of 1000 XP.

midlands_industrial_mechanics.name: Iron Tongue Gear
midlands_industrial_mechanics.description: The Iron Tongue Gear is a rusted cog of ancient origin, forged in the heart of a collapsed steamworks where gears and pistons still whisper the secrets of their past. Its surface gleams with a faint mechanical will that aids the wearer in navigating industrial ruins. When worn, it grants a subtle sense of machinery’s rhythm, enhancing one's ability to dodge traps and deal damage to mechanical foes.

effectDetails.title: Trap Dodger
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Iron Tongue Gear, you gain a +10% chance to successfully avoid industrial traps. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you deal damage to a mechanical creature or object with a melee weapon attack, the damage rolls are increased by +20%. This effect can be used once per short rest.

midlands_industrial_mechanics.levelRequirementReason: This gear is designed for beginners who need assistance navigating industrial environments.
midlands_industrial_mechanics.vendorReason: Midlands Industrial Mechanics specializes in equipment that helps adventurers survive and thrive in their region's challenging terrain.
midlands_industrial_mechanics.shippingDetail: The gear is shipped via the Void Drifter Relay, known for its reliable and swift deliveries across the realm.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The gear is removed or destroyed.

midlands_industrial_mechanics.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and ancient techniques, this gear offers significant utility for beginners without overpowering their abilities.

midlands_industrial_tinkering_tool.name: Gear of the Iron Fingers
midlands_industrial_tinkering_tool.description: The Gear of the Iron Fingers is a rusted, steam-powered wrench forged from reclaimed war scrap. Its gears hum with mechanical prowess as it grants its wielder uncanny precision in repairing or modifying machinery. Crafted in the Midlands’ industrial heart, this tool ensures that broken machines are mended swiftly and efficiently, reducing the chance of malfunctions by 10% when used. Perfect for engineers and laborers, it is a testament to the region’s ingenuity and resilience.

effectDetails.title: Precision Repair
effectDetails.rules: When used to attempt a repair check, the wielder has a +20% chance of succeeding. The effect is instantaneous and does not consume charges.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Malfunction Risk
effectDetails.rules: For every successful use in repairing machinery, there is a 10% reduction in the risk of the machine malfunctioning for 1 hour. This effect stacks up to three times per day.

midlands_industrial_tinkering_tool.levelRequirementReason: The Gear requires no specific level as it is designed to assist laborers and engineers who benefit from its unique properties without needing a high proficiency.
midlands_industrial_tinkering_tool.vendorReason: The Midlands is renowned for its industrial prowess, making the vendor an expert in providing tools that enhance mechanical skills.
midlands_industrial_tinkering_tool.shippingDetail: Ships within one week from the Midlands’ industrial heart.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use when attempting a repair check.
usage.duration: Until the next long rest or until the machine is fully repaired.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon successful completion of a repair task or at the end of a long rest.

midlands_industrial_tinkering_tool.priceReason: Balanced to provide significant mechanical assistance without being overpowered, this tool is priced at 1000 XP.

midlands_iron_blood_amber.name: Iron Blood Amber
midlands_iron_blood_amber.description: The Iron Blood Amber is a molten gem encased in the heart of an ancient war engine, its golden core pulsing with the mechanical devotion of the Iron Legion’s fallen warriors. When worn, it hums softly, infusing the wearer with resilience and granting a subtle yet persistent aura that enhances their resolve in battle. This gem not only heals minor wounds but also subtly disrupts the aim of enemies, making them less precise against you.

effectDetails.title: Regenerate Health
effectDetails.rules: When worn, this gem restores 25% of the wearer's maximum hit points after a short rest. It can be activated once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Aim
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Iron Blood Amber, there is a +10% chance that mechanical enemies miss their attacks against the wearer on each attack roll. This effect has no save DC and does not require an action to activate.

midlands_iron_blood_amber.levelRequirementReason: The gem's complex enchantment requires a minimum level of understanding of mechanical constructs.
midlands_iron_blood_amber.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its deep connections with the Iron Legion and their artifacts, making it a prime location to find such a relic.
midlands_iron_blood_amber.shippingDetail: The gem must be shipped via Pipe Express, ensuring safe handling of this delicate artifact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, active until the next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends with a long rest or if removed from the wearer.

midlands_iron_blood_amber.priceReason: The gem’s rarity and unique enchantments justify its moderate price, reflecting its value as both a relic and utility item.

midlands_iron_blood_gear.name: Iron Blood Gear
midlands_iron_blood_gear.description: Forged from the molten heart of a fallen Legion forge, Iron Blood Gear is a suit of armor that channels the industrial might of its origin. Its surface gleams with a chilling silver sheen, and when worn, it grants resilience against mechanical shockwaves, turning industrial strikes into mere taps. The wearer's very presence intimidates foes, who find themselves unnerved by an unseen force that whispers of the forge's unforgiving heart.

effectDetails.title: +30% resistance to mechanical damage
effectDetails.rules: While wearing Iron Blood Gear, you gain a +30% resistance bonus to all saving throws against mechanical damage. This effect persists for the duration of your concentration.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Aura
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each combat round, as a free action, you can emit an Intimidating Aura that lasts until the end of your next turn. Any creature within 10 feet of you who can see you must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for the duration.

midlands_iron_blood_gear.levelRequirementReason: The intricate craftsmanship and arcane properties of Iron Blood Gear necessitate a minimum level to wield its full power.
midlands_iron_blood_gear.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their robust industrial forges, are the perfect purveyors of such an artifact forged in the heart of a fallen forge.
midlands_iron_blood_gear.shippingDetail: The armor is shipped via Boo Spectral Mail, ensuring safe and secure delivery, though it may take longer than usual due to its unusual weight.

usage.duration: Concentration (up to 1 hour)
usage.endsWhen: You lose concentration or are incapacitated

midlands_iron_blood_gear.priceReason: The rare materials and complex enchantments required for its creation justify the moderate price in experience points.

midlands_iron_blood_helm.name: Iron Blood Helm
midlands_iron_blood_helm.description: The Iron Blood Helm is a molten steel and cursed bone helm forged in the forges of Midland's Ironclad City. Its eerie glow reveals hidden undead in darkened mines, and when struck by a crushing blow, it channels the wearer’s resilience to counterattack with an unseen force. The whispers of the dead that it captures are more than mere echoes; they can be used to cast detect undead as an action.
effects: Detect undead in shadows at will

effectDetails.title: Counterattack Resilience
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is hit by a melee attack dealing crushing damage, they can use their reaction to deal 1d6 force damage to the attacker. This effect has no cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Detect Undead in Shadows
effectDetails.rules: The wearer may cast Detect Undead as an action once per short or long rest. The range of this spell is reduced by half due to the helm's design, but it functions perfectly within dark environments.

midlands_iron_blood_helm.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 3 to wield effectively in combat and handle its mystical properties.
midlands_iron_blood_helm.vendorReason: Midlands is the birthplace of this helm, known for their mastery of dark ironwork and undead lore.
midlands_iron_blood_helm.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail within one week; delivery may be delayed by unforeseen spectral disturbances.

usage.activation: Reaction to counterattack, Action for detect undead
usage.duration: Instantaneous (counterattack), 10 minutes per short or long rest (detect undead)
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends when used up; recharge after a short or long rest

midlands_iron_blood_helm.priceReason: The helm's rare materials and mystical properties ensure it remains valuable at this price.

midlands_iron_blood_ointment.name: Iron Blood Ointment
midlands_iron_blood_ointment.description: Iron Blood Ointment, a viscous ointment tinged with the iron-scented blood of a condemned toad, is applied directly to wounds, accelerating healing and granting temporary resistance to poison and fire damage. When applied, it induces a sneeze reflex in nearby foes, causing them to lose their balance for a moment, disrupting their attacks. The ointment's active properties are a testament to the dark rituals performed by the Midlands' apothecaries, who claim it can be found only through rare and illicit means.

effectDetails.title: Healing Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: When applied to a wound, the ointment activates as an action, providing +20% healing per second for its duration. The effect ends if the user is incapacitated or the ointment is removed.

effectDetails.title: Poison and Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 minute while the ointment is active, the user gains 20% resistance to poison and fire damage. This effect ends if the user takes a long rest or is incapacitated.

midlands_iron_blood_ointment.levelRequirementReason: The ointment's potency requires only basic magical knowledge for application.
midlands_iron_blood_ointment.vendorReason: The Midlands' apothecaries are known for their dark and potent remedies, making this product a staple of their offerings.
midlands_iron_blood_ointment.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail; expect delivery within 3 days if unopened, longer if custom-applied.

usage.duration: 1 minute per application
usage.endsWhen: User is incapacitated or the ointment is removed

midlands_iron_blood_ointment.priceReason: The rare ingredients and dark rituals required for its creation justify this price.

midlands_iron_blood_torch.name: Iron Blood Torch
midlands_iron_blood_torch.description: The Iron Blood Torch is a fearsome weapon of labor, forged from the very heart of the Midlands' blacksmiths. Its blade drips molten steel when its wielder is injured, igniting the battlefield with blinding crimson light that rivals the forge fires themselves. This torch is not just a tool; it's an extension of the heavy laborer who wields it, transforming pain into power and turning every strike into a testament to resilience.

effectDetails.title: Molten Reprisal
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder takes damage, the Iron Blood Torch drips molten steel. This causes the wielder to deal an additional 50 fire damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius of them at the start of their next turn. The damage increases by +2d6 for every 10 points of damage taken by the wielder before this effect triggers.

effectDetails.title: Forgeheart Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: While lit, the Iron Blood Torch grants the wielder a +5 bonus to AC and a +2 bonus to Strength. Additionally, it regenerates 10 hit points at the start of each of their turns. This effect ends if the wielder is incapacitated or if they extinguish the torch.

midlands_iron_blood_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Blood Torch requires a minimum level of 3 to use effectively, given its physical demands and the need for experience in handling such powerful tools.
midlands_iron_blood_torch.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their blacksmiths who craft the most resilient and powerful weapons, making this torch a natural addition to their inventory.
midlands_iron_blood_torch.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Rakasha Spirit Walk, ensuring swift and safe transport of the weapon to its destination.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon taking damage; ends if extinguished or the wielder is incapacitated.
usage.duration: Until the torch is extinguished or the wielder is incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: Extinguishing the torch or becoming incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged by the forge at the end of each long rest.

midlands_iron_blood_torch.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its powerful effects and the unique forging process that makes it a rare commodity.

midlands_iron_blood_vial.name: Iron Blood Vial
midlands_iron_blood_vial.description: The Iron Blood Vial bears the essence of a fallen Iron Legion commander, forged in the fires of battle and tempered by the blood of countless foes. When consumed, it grants the imbiber a surge of strength, doubling their lifting capacity for thirty seconds. The vial also bestows an aura of invulnerability upon nearby allies, reducing incoming damage by 20% for fifteen seconds. This essence is said to harden the heart and resolve of those who carry it into battle.

effectDetails.title: Doubled Strength
effectDetails.rules: Activates on consumption as a bonus action. The imbiber gains +2 to Strength (to a maximum of their original Strength modifier +4) for thirty seconds.

effectDetails.title: Damage Reduction Aura
effectDetails.rules: Activates on consumption as a bonus action, granting nearby allies a 10% chance to reduce damage taken by 20% for fifteen seconds. The aura lasts until the end of their next turn or until they move more than 30 feet away.

midlands_iron_blood_vial.levelRequirementReason: The vial is potent and requires a seasoned warrior capable of handling its effects.
midlands_iron_blood_vial.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their supply of rare and enchanted items, offers this vial to those seeking the strength of the Iron Legion in battle.
midlands_iron_blood_vial.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, with a delivery time of one week. The package includes a cold pack to preserve its potency.

usage.duration: 30 seconds for strength boost and 15 seconds for the damage reduction aura.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when their respective durations expire or upon the user's next turn if they move more than 30 feet away.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as consuming it does not deplete its charges.

midlands_iron_blood_vial.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this vial provides significant battlefield advantage without being overpowered.

midlands_iron_gaze_cloak.name: Iron Gaze Cloak of the Silent Legion
midlands_iron_gaze_cloak.description: The Iron Gaze Cloak of the Silent Legion is a rare relic forged from ancient tomes and imbued with the stern gaze of the Iron Legion's commander. Woven in midnight tones, it whispers secrets through its fabric, granting the wearer a keen eye that pierces through illusions and armor alike. This cloak ensures stealth and tactical superiority on the battlefield by revealing hidden foes or cloaked enemies for a brief moment.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Pierce
effectDetails.rules: When you are targeted by an illusion, you have advantage on your Wisdom (Perception) check to see through it. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Armor Penetration
effectDetails.rules: For one round after donning this cloak, you gain +20 AC against physical attacks. This benefit ends at the end of your next turn.

midlands_iron_gaze_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's complex enchantments and ancient crafting require a minimum level to wield effectively.
midlands_iron_gaze_cloak.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its deep connection with historical artifacts, making it the ideal vendor for this relic.
midlands_iron_gaze_cloak.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express, a reliable courier that ensures swift delivery of rare and valuable items.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the cloak.
usage.duration: Instantaneous per round (up to two rounds).
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn after activation.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one benefit can be active at a time.

midlands_iron_gaze_cloak.priceReason: Balanced as the cloak offers significant battlefield advantages without overshadowing other gear options.

midlands_iron_gear_core.name: Iron Gear Core
midlands_iron_gear_core.description: The Iron Gear Core hums with the spirit of a bygone era, its gears whispering tales of ancient battles and industrial might. Crafted from the heart of an ironclad war machine, this core amplifies all mechanical devices and grants allies a Cogwork Surge that boosts their movement speed during combat. When engaged in melee, it channels power into a devastating Cogwork Surge, delivering 20% extra damage to mechanical foes within reach.
effects: Allies within 10 feet gain +10% movement speed on their turn

effectDetails.title: Cogwork Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates when the user strikes a mechanical target. Grants all allies within 10 feet advantage on attack rolls and adds 20% bonus damage to attacks against mechanical targets for one round.

effectDetails.title: Gear Efficiency Boost
effectDetails.rules: All equipped gear is enhanced by +15%, increasing its effectiveness and durability in battle. This effect lasts until the next long rest.

midlands_iron_gear_core.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 3 to ensure that the user can effectively utilize and maintain its benefits.
midlands_iron_gear_core.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their industrial heritage, making them a fitting vendor for this relic of mechanical mastery.
midlands_iron_gear_core.shippingDetail: Delivered with same-day delivery in the Midlands region; expedited shipping available elsewhere.

usage.activation: Activates as an action when struck against a mechanical target.
usage.duration: One round of combat or until expended, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user is reduced to 0 hit points or if they leave the area within 10 feet.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day; recharges on a long rest.

midlands_iron_gear_core.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the item’s unique combination of utility and combat enhancement, suitable for characters seeking to dominate mechanical battles.

midlands_iron_gear_soul.name: Iron Gear Soul
midlands_iron_gear_soul.description: Forged from the heart of a fallen war machine in the Midlands, this cursed Iron Gear Soul is a mechanical marvel that hums with the power of forgotten engines. When worn, it grants its bearer an intuitive understanding of machinery and a slight boost to combat efficiency at the cost of their soul’s echo. The gear's whispering gears trigger a rare chance for mechanical allies to assist in battle, but it also leaves the wearer vulnerable to magic wards, making them harder to detect by arcane means.

effectDetails.title: Combat Efficiency Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this gear, you gain a +10% bonus to your combat efficiency. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Ally Spawn
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, when you are within 5 feet of an ally with the mechanical subtype, you can trigger this effect by speaking a command word. A small, temporary mechanical ally appears at your side to assist in combat for 1 minute.

midlands_iron_gear_soul.levelRequirementReason: This gear requires a level 3 character due to its cursed nature and the complexity of its magical enchantments.
midlands_iron_gear_soul.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for their expertise in ancient machinery, making them the ideal vendor for this unique item.
midlands_iron_gear_soul.shippingDetail: Delivered through a network of underground couriers, ensuring quick and discreet transport to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for triggering the mechanical ally spawn; lasts until the end of your next turn otherwise
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after a short rest or destroyed by a successful dispel magic spell
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires recharging at dawn on any day you do not wear it

midlands_iron_gear_soul.priceReason: The gear's cursed nature and the complexity of its enchantments justify this price.

midlands_iron_gearbox.name: Iron Gearbox of the Iron King
midlands_iron_gearbox.description: The Iron Gearbox of the Iron King is a marvel of clockwork and iron, forged in the heart of the Iron Legion’s central mill where the weight of a thousand men’s labor shaped its gears. Its robust frame shifts with the strength of giants, and only those deemed worthy by their resilience may wield it. With each shift, it amplifies one's stride, allowing you to carry heavy burdens without breaking stride, and when you strike an enemy, there is a chance for their armor to crack under your blow.

effectDetails.title: Heavy Carry Boost
effectDetails.rules: While carrying heavy items, you have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws. You also gain a +25% increase to your movement speed for the duration of one short rest.

effectDetails.title: Armor Shattering Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with a melee weapon attack, there is a 15% chance that their armor breaks, reducing all damage they deal by 2 until the start of your next turn. This effect cannot occur more than once per short rest.

midlands_iron_gearbox.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Gearbox's intricate gears and robust design require a minimum level to properly wield its full potential.
midlands_iron_gearbox.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their sturdy craftsmanship, have been entrusted by the Iron Legion to sell this emblem of strength and resilience.
midlands_iron_gearbox.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pipe Express with a special delivery that ensures the gearbox arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect; automatically applies when you start carrying heavy items or make an attack roll against armor.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short rest
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally at the conclusion of a short rest.

midlands_iron_gearbox.priceReason: Balanced to provide significant utility without overshadowing other gear, the Iron Gearbox’s price reflects its rarity and practical value.

midlands_iron_gearshift.name: Iron Gearshift
midlands_iron_gearshift.description: The Iron Gearshift is a robust, slag steel contrivance that enhances any mechanical construct. Forged in the heart of Midlands' blacksmiths, this gear mechanism boosts machinery efficiency by +10%, ensuring smoother operation and less wear on complex gears. It also significantly reduces blunt impact damage by 20%, safeguarding against the harsh realities of battle or siege. The gear's origin is marked with a distinctive Midlands icon, a symbol that ensures its reliability in the hands of a skilled technician.

effectDetails.title: Machinery Efficiency Boost
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +10% bonus to the DC of any check related to machinery. This effect is passive and lasts until replaced by another similar item.

effectDetails.title: Blunt Impact Damage Reduction
effectDetails.rules: When subjected to blunt impact, the user takes 20% less damage from such attacks or events. This effect functions as a reaction but only once per long rest.

midlands_iron_gearshift.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners to enhance their mechanical constructs without demanding high-level expertise.
midlands_iron_gearshift.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its craftsmanship and reliability, making the Iron Gearshift a staple in their offerings.
midlands_iron_gearshift.shippingDetail: Delivered by Pipe Express, known for its punctuality and efficient service within the Midlands region.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required. Requires proficiency with mechanics to fully utilize benefits.
usage.duration: Permanent until replaced or upgraded.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed when the mechanical construct it is attached to is destroyed.

midlands_iron_gearshift.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's ability to enhance machinery efficiency and reduce damage, making it a valuable investment for any adventurer.

midlands_iron_golem_arms.name: Iron Golem Arms
midlands_iron_golem_arms.description: The Iron Golem Arms are a pair of heavy, industrial-forged gauntlets imbued with ancient magic. Crafted from enchanted iron and bound with runes of resilience, they grant their wielder unmatched durability and crushing power. Each blow is not just forceful but also designed to shatter armor, as the arms' enchantments increase the chance to break enemy defenses by an impressive 50%. These gauntlets are perfect for siege work or any battle where sheer strength can turn the tide of war.
effects: 50% chance to shatter enemy armor on hit

effectDetails.title: Crushing Might
effectDetails.rules: Activation: On a successful melee attack. Duration: Instantaneous. The wearer gains +30% to their melee weapon's damage roll for the attack.

effectDetails.title: Armor Shatterer
effectDetails.rules: Activation: On a successful melee hit against an enemy wearing armor or shield. Save DC 15. Ends When: After one use per long rest. The wearer has a 50% chance to break the target's armor or shield.

midlands_iron_golem_arms.levelRequirementReason: These gauntlets are designed for those who seek brute strength and durability, making them accessible to lower-level characters.
midlands_iron_golem_arms.vendorReason: The Midlands is known for its strong industrial magic and crafting skills, thus it's fitting that they sell these powerful arms.
midlands_iron_golem_arms.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express within 3 days with a special delivery guarantee.

usage.activation: On a successful melee attack or hit against an armor-wearing enemy.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends after one use per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: After one use per long rest.

midlands_iron_golem_arms.priceReason: The price reflects the rare materials and ancient magic required to craft these formidable gauntlets.

midlands_iron_golem_glove.name: Iron Golem Glove
midlands_iron_golem_glove.description: Forged from the iron heart of a fallen golem, this glove channels its unyielding strength and resilience into the hand that wears it. The metallic core hums with latent power, capable of shattering stone and rending steel with ease. Crafted in the forge pits of Midland's Ironfoundry, each finger seems to flex with an ancient will, lending the wearer the ability to crush siege gates and rend enemy armor without effort.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Strikes
effectDetails.rules: The glove grants a +2 bonus to Strength checks and Strength saving throws. This effect is active as long as the wearer has at least one charge remaining.

effectDetails.title: Durable Metal
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this glove, the wearer gains resistance to bludgeoning damage from non-magical attacks. The glove recharges after a short rest.

midlands_iron_golem_glove.levelRequirementReason: The glove's latent power requires no level to wield but grants significant benefits.
midlands_iron_golem_glove.vendorReason: Midland's Ironfoundry is renowned for crafting items from the remains of fallen golems, making this glove a natural addition to their inventory.
midlands_iron_golem_glove.shippingDetail: Shipment may take up to one week due to the fragile nature of the item during transport.

usage.duration: Until expended or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The glove is removed from the wearer, recharges after a short rest, or is destroyed.

midlands_iron_golem_glove.priceReason: The glove's rarity and its ability to enhance physical prowess without requiring a level make it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer’s arsenal.

midlands_iron_golem_heart.name: Iron Golem Heart
midlands_iron_golem_heart.description: The Iron Golem Heart, a pulsating core of tempered steel and arcane power, was once the beating heart of an ancient warforged guardian. Fused into armor, it enhances resilience against crushing blows and amplifies melee strikes with industrial force. This relic grants the wearer +30% damage against armored foes and a 25% chance to break through their defenses on each successful hit. The heart whispers its battle-scarred history as it regenerates 10% of the wielder's health per second while equipped.
effects: 25% Chance To Break Enemy Armor On Hit

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When a creature with this item in their armor strikes an armored target, they deal an additional +30% damage. This effect has no cooldown and is active as long as the wearer maintains contact with the armor.

effectDetails.title: Armor Shattering
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance per successful melee strike that this item will cause its target's armor to break, reducing their AC by one for one minute. This effect can be triggered once every three strikes and has no save DC.

midlands_iron_golem_heart.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires minimal magical power to wield but still demands a certain level of experience to understand its full potential.
midlands_iron_golem_heart.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their mastery of ancient relics and mechanical artifacts, making them the ideal purveyors of this golem heart.
midlands_iron_golem_heart.shippingDetail: This item is shipped via Pipe Express with expedited service to ensure it reaches you in optimal condition.

usage.activation: Passive upon fusion into armor and remains active until the wearer removes their armor or fuses a new relic.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until the wearer no longer has this item fused into their armor.
usage.endsWhen: The relic is removed from the armor or a new relic is fused in its place.

midlands_iron_golem_heart.priceReason: This relic strikes a balance by offering significant combat advantages without being overpowered, making it accessible yet valuable.

midlands_iron_golem_mace.name: Iron Golem Mace of the Sundered Forge
midlands_iron_golem_mace.description: The Iron Golem Mace of the Sundered Forge, forged from the molten remains of a once-mighty iron forge that collapsed into ruin, bears the weight of ancient sorcery and relentless forging. Its head is shaped like a half-buried colossus, its surface etched with runes that crackle with latent power. Strike it against armor, and the mace shatters steel as if it were glass, leaving behind a trail of molten slag that scorches the ground in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Shatters Armor
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an armored target with this mace, it deals an extra 50 points of damage. The armor has a saving throw DC of 16 to negate the effect.

effectDetails.title: Molten Slag
effectDetails.rules: On a successful hit against an armored target, the mace leaves behind a trail of molten slag that lasts for 1 minute and deals 5d8 fire damage per round to any creature within 5 feet. This effect can only occur once every 24 hours.

midlands_iron_golem_mace.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 3 to wield the mace effectively, given its weight and power.
midlands_iron_golem_mace.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their blacksmithing prowess and have access to rare materials and ancient crafting techniques used in this mace's creation.
midlands_iron_golem_mace.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, a courier service that can only be trusted with the most valuable cargo due to its reliability.

usage.activation: On hit as part of a melee attack action
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect is used up or when the mace breaks
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one molten slag effect can occur per day

midlands_iron_golem_mace.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP due to its unique effects and rarity.

midlands_iron_hammer_of_murder.name: Iron Hammer of Murder
midlands_iron_hammer_of_murder.description: The Iron Hammer of Murder is a fearsome weapon forged from the molten hearts of fallen foes. Its blade-like head glows with an eerie, red light that signals its deadly intent. The hammer's grip bears the sigil of the Iron Legion and resonates with malevolent energy when used in battle. It delivers devastating blows to mechanical constructs, causing them to shatter into useless scrap within a round of combat.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Shatter
effectDetails.rules: When the Iron Hammer of Murder strikes an enemy, it deals +2 damage to mechanical constructs. Additionally, on a successful hit against such foes, they are reduced to scrap and become inert for one round.

effectDetails.title: Heartseeking Strike
effectDetails.rules: When used to attack an armored foe, the wielder gains a +1 bonus to their attack roll. This effect is limited to once per short or long rest.

midlands_iron_hammer_of_murder.levelRequirementReason: The weapon's malevolent energy and intricate forging require a level 5 character to wield.
midlands_iron_hammer_of_murder.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their blacksmiths, who craft this weapon with dark lore and iron will.
midlands_iron_hammer_of_murder.shippingDetail: Delivered by Ironclad Express, this weapon arrives in pristine condition, ready for battle.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charges exhausted or weapon destroyed

midlands_iron_hammer_of_murder.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this hammer is a rare find that offers both power and utility without overbalancing the game.

midlands_iron_hammer_of_the_iron_ward.name: Iron Hammer of the Iron Ward
midlands_iron_hammer_of_the_iron_ward.description: The Iron Hammer of the Iron Ward is a massive, industrial-grade hammer forged from steel that echoes the heartbeat of Midlands’ factories. Its weighty grip and sturdy handle are designed for strength, yet its head cuts through even the toughest siege armor with brutal efficiency. The hammer’s forge-wrought core channels the power of the Iron Legion, making it an indispensable tool in close combat, where its wielder can expect to survive longer thanks to its damage-reducing properties.

effectDetails.title: Siege Armor Piercer
effectDetails.rules: When used against siege armor, the Iron Hammer of the Iron Ward deals an additional 150% damage. This effect is limited to a maximum of three uses per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Surge
effectDetails.rules: While in close combat, the wielder gains a +20% damage reduction and increases their stamina regeneration by 10% per second. This effect lasts for one hour or until the wielder is knocked unconscious or falls asleep.

midlands_iron_hammer_of_the_iron_ward.levelRequirementReason: The hammer's industrial strength demands at least a fifth-level character to wield.
midlands_iron_hammer_of_the_iron_ward.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its sturdy craftsmanship and military support, is the most reliable source for such an artifact.
midlands_iron_hammer_of_the_iron_ward.shippingDetail: This item may take up to three days longer than usual due to its size and weight.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when used in combat
usage.duration: One hour or until the wielder is knocked unconscious or falls asleep
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wielder is no longer in close combat, or if they fall unconscious
usage.charges: Maximum of three uses per long rest

midlands_iron_hammer_of_the_iron_ward.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its industrial power and unique siege capabilities.

midlands_iron_heart_belt.name: Iron Heart Belt
midlands_iron_heart_belt.description: The Iron Heart Belt, a relic of the Forgedheart Legion, is a belt forged from blackened steel, its surface etched with the iconic sigil of the legendary legion. This resilient accessory grants resilience against heavy blows and enhances one's grip during laborious tasks. Wearing it is akin to channeling the strength of the Iron Legion itself; its wearer moves with unnatural fortitude, dodging strikes that would otherwise find purchase.

effectDetails.title: Blunt Resilience
effectDetails.rules: When you are subjected to a blunt or crushing attack, there is a +20% chance that the attack does not deal damage. This effect can only occur once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Grip
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this belt during industrial labor, your chance to dodge melee strikes increases by 10%. This effect lasts for one hour after you complete a task.

midlands_iron_heart_belt.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Heart Belt's resilience can be harnessed even by novice adventurers who have yet to master their combat skills.
midlands_iron_heart_belt.vendorReason: Midlands, renowned for its industrial heritage, is the perfect vendor for this relic of labor and strength.
midlands_iron_heart_belt.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days via Void Drifter Relay, with a courier delivery slip included in every package.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the start of your next turn after completing an industrial task or dodging a melee strike.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each short rest, this effect ends and cannot be used again until then.

midlands_iron_heart_belt.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rare material and historical significance as a relic of the Forgedheart Legion.

midlands_iron_heart_ironclad.name: Iron Heart Ironclad
midlands_iron_heart_ironclad.description: The Iron Heart Ironclad is a forged steel gauntlet, its surface etched with runes of the Iron Legion's unyielding will. This battle-worn relic channels the strength of countless warriors who have faced crushing blows and emerged victorious. When wielded, it amplifies your strikes by +30% force, ensuring every blow lands with devastating power.
