For 10 seconds, you gain immunity to crushing damage, giving you time to recover from relentless assaults.
effects: Immunity to crushing damage for 10 seconds

effectDetails.title: Amplified Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon, the attack deals +30% extra damage. This effect lasts until your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Crushing Immunity
effectDetails.rules: For 10 seconds after activation, you are immune to all sources of crushing damage. If this immunity is removed by an effect that ends the duration before its time expires, it reverts to the original source of damage.

midlands_iron_heart_ironclad.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Heart Ironclad requires no level, as it is designed for any warrior who needs a reliable shield against crushing attacks.
midlands_iron_heart_ironclad.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its blacksmiths and armorers, specializes in creating gear that endures the harshest battles, making this gauntlet a staple among their offerings.
midlands_iron_heart_ironclad.shippingDetail: The drones deliver with precision, ensuring the gauntlet arrives within days of purchase, ready for immediate use on the battlefield.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you take any damage that is not crushing or at the end of your next turn if no such damage is taken.

midlands_iron_heart_ironclad.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the gauntlet's ability to enhance melee attacks and provide crucial protection against crushing damage, making it a sought-after item among warriors.

midlands_iron_heart_pump.name: Iron Heart Pump
midlands_iron_heart_pump.description: The Iron Heart Pump is a mechanical marvel, forged from slag and tempered steel in the Forges of the Iron Legion. This wearable device synchronizes its rhythmic pulse with the user’s heartbeat, offering resilience against fatigue. Its sturdy gears and polished alloy casing give it a presence that commands respect among laborers and craftsmen alike. While active, this heart not only regenerates health but also bolsters armor, making the wearer less susceptible to harm during combat.
midlands_iron_heart_pump.shippedBy: Boo Spectral Mail - known for delivering with a swift and reliable reputation

effectDetails.title: Health Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: While active, the Iron Heart Pump regenerates 10% of the user's hit points per second. This effect is passive and requires no action to activate. It ends when the item is removed or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Armor Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +2 bonus to their AC while in combat. This enhancement persists until the end of each long rest, after which it resets.

midlands_iron_heart_pump.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for common laborers and novice adventurers who require resilience and basic protection.
midlands_iron_heart_pump.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their craftsmanship and the Iron Legion's legacy of forging durable, functional equipment.
midlands_iron_heart_pump.shippingDetail: Items are delivered within two days via Boo Spectral Mail’s express service.

usage.duration: Active until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Removal or destruction of the item.

midlands_iron_heart_pump.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its rarity and functional benefits to laborers and adventurers alike.

midlands_iron_herald_of_the_siege.name: Iron Herald of the Siege
midlands_iron_herald_of_the_siege.description: The Iron Herald of the Siege is a massive bell crafted from the bones of an ancient siege tower. Its deep, resonant chime can be heard for miles and echoes the Iron Legion's fearsome war cry. Upon ringing, it summons three battle-hardened legionaries to your aid, their blades gleaming with untold battles. All allies within earshot gain a +10% bonus to attack speed for 30 seconds, and enemies suffer a -20% penalty to defense within 300 yards for the same duration.

effectDetails.title: Summon Iron Legion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this bell summons three Iron Legion soldiers to your aid. They remain visible and active for 30 seconds. The effect ends if the bell is destroyed or if a creature within 10 feet of you uses a move action.

effectDetails.title: Ally Attack Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Allies within earshot (500 yards) gain a +10% bonus to attack speed for 30 seconds. The effect ends if the bell is destroyed or if an ally moves more than 30 feet away from the sound of its chime.

midlands_iron_herald_of_the_siege.levelRequirementReason: This item can be used by adventurers early in their journey to bolster their combat capabilities.
midlands_iron_herald_of_the_siege.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their strong ties with the Iron Legion, thus this vendor stocks items related to their legacy.
midlands_iron_herald_of_the_siege.shippingDetail: Delivery can take up to a week due to the item's bulk and the need for special handling.

usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The bell is destroyed or an ally moves more than 30 feet away from it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per battle.

midlands_iron_herald_of_the_siege.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's rarity and its significant battlefield advantage.

midlands_iron_legion_banner.name: Iron Legion Banner
midlands_iron_legion_banner.description: The Iron Legion Banner is a battle-standard woven with iron threads and emblazoned with the forgeborn sigil. Unfurl it in battle, and allies within five meters are enveloped in a shimmering aura of steel and fire. The banner’s invulnerability grants them three seconds of unyielding protection against harm, while also increasing their damage output by 15% against foes armored in iron or steel. A symbol of the Legion's indomitable spirit, it is a testament to the unbreakable will forged in the heart of the forge.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the banner grants temporary invulnerability to allies within a five-meter radius for three seconds. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges; it ends when the duration expires or when the banner is sheathed.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage
effectDetails.rules: Allies within a five-meter radius of the banner deal an additional 15% damage to enemies armored in iron or steel. This bonus lasts for the duration of the banner's active state and does not require concentration; it ends when the banner is sheathed.

midlands_iron_legion_banner.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Legion Banner requires a minimum level of 3 to wield, ensuring that only those who have proven their worth in combat can use its power.
midlands_iron_legion_banner.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its martial prowess and has long been associated with the Forgeborn. They are the custodians of such powerful relics.
midlands_iron_legion_banner.shippingDetail: The banner must be shipped via the Void Drifter Relay due to its fragile nature, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 3 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or when the banner is sheathed

midlands_iron_legion_banner.priceReason: The Iron Legion Banner's balanced price reflects its rarity and utility in combat, making it a sought-after but not overpowered addition to any adventurer’s arsenal.

midlands_iron_legion_blood_mech.name: Iron Legion Blood Mech
midlands_iron_legion_blood_mech.description: The Iron Legion Blood Mech is a cursed automaton forged from the unyielding will of fallen soldiers. Its gears hum with the iron resolve of its creators, delivering devastating strikes that crush foes beneath its weight. However, each strike drains vitality, leaving the bearer fatigued and vulnerable. This relic was crafted by Liberated Toads, who sought to channel the indomitable spirit of their kin into a weapon of unyielding force.

effectDetails.title: Blood Forge
effectDetails.rules: On the first attack, the Blood Mech deals double damage (4000 damage) and grants a +1 bonus to all subsequent attacks until exhaustion. This effect ends if the user drops the item or is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Vitality Drain
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each turn, the bearer loses 50 stamina. This effect can be mitigated by resting for at least one hour. If the bearer's stamina reaches zero, they are exhausted until they rest for a full day.

midlands_iron_legion_blood_mech.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Legion Blood Mech requires significant strength and discipline to wield effectively without succumbing to its draining effects.
midlands_iron_legion_blood_mech.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their expertise in ancient artifacts and relics, can offer this powerful yet perilous weapon.
midlands_iron_legion_blood_mech.shippingDetail: The item is delivered with a protective charm that ensures it arrives undisturbed, but the bearer must be wary of the Mech's draining effects during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon use; no additional actions required.
usage.duration: Until exhaustion or incapacitation
usage.endsWhen: If the user drops the item or is incapacitated

midlands_iron_legion_blood_mech.priceReason: The Iron Legion Blood Mech offers a significant increase in melee damage, making it a valuable yet risky asset for players.

midlands_iron_legion_crank.name: Iron Legion Crank
midlands_iron_legion_crank.description: The Iron Legion Crank is a rugged, steam-driven mechanism forged from the iron veins of the Iron Legion’s factories. It was salvaged from Admiral Bloopers’ war machines, once used to power their ink-jamming monstrosities. Its industrial design hints at both raw strength and the possibility of catastrophic failure if overused. With each turn, it grants mechanical prowess and unlocks hidden mechanisms, yet it comes with a warning: prolonged use can cause a fiery backlash.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Mastery
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the crank, you gain +1 to all mechanical and engineering skill checks for 1 hour. This benefit is cumulative with similar abilities from other sources.

effectDetails.title: Unlocking Mechanisms
effectDetails.rules: You can use the crank to unlock doors or mechanisms that require 5 or more locking mechanisms, dealing no damage but expending one charge of the item.

midlands_iron_legion_crank.levelRequirementReason: This cranks' mechanical abilities are accessible to all adventurers, not requiring a specific class.
midlands_iron_legion_crank.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its robust and practical gear, making the Iron Legion Crank an ideal addition to their inventory.
midlands_iron_legion_crank.shippingDetail: Due to its bulkiness, it will be shipped with special padding to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until the item is destroyed
usage.endsWhen: The item runs out of charges, which recharge after a long rest

midlands_iron_legion_crank.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its rare and mechanically powerful nature.

midlands_iron_legion_essence.name: Legion Heart Essence
midlands_iron_legion_essence.description: A vial of dark, shimmering essence, it pulses with the residual will of a fallen Iron Legion soldier who died in service to the forge. When activated, this heart essence grants the wielder an unyielding defense against mechanical damage and imbues them with the ironclad resolve that defines the legion’s warriors. The vial's resonance with the Legion's machinery is palpable, creating a haunting hum that can disrupt foes, slowing their movements by 10% for five seconds upon contact.
effects: Enemies within range apply “Iron Resolve” debuff

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Defense
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants +20 to AC against all sources of mechanical damage until the start of your next turn. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Iron Resolve
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 5 feet must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or become slowed by 10% movement speed for 5 seconds. This effect can be activated up to three times per day.

midlands_iron_legion_essence.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 6 to wield due to the essence's potent and focused power.
midlands_iron_legion_essence.vendorReason: The Midlands vendor, known for their deep connections with Iron Legion veterans, sells this rare essence as a tribute to fallen soldiers.
midlands_iron_legion_essence.shippingDetail: Ships via airmail, delivering within three days.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (as an opportunity attack)
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration of the bonus action or reaction
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the creature takes damage or at the start of your next turn after activation

midlands_iron_legion_essence.priceReason: The essence's rarity and potent effects justify its price, offering significant battlefield advantages.

midlands_iron_legion_gear.name: Ironclad Anvil Helm
midlands_iron_legion_gear.description: The Ironclad Anvil Helm is a formidable helmet forged from the very heart of Onyx Hand's industrial might, its hammer and anvil shape echoing the clangorous power of their blacksmiths. This helm not only grants resilience against blunt force but also hums with latent heat, reflecting the relentless forgefire that tempered it. When in combat, the wearer feels a surge of vitality, regenerating wounds as if they were part of the unyielding anvil itself.

effectDetails.title: Blunt Force Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from a melee attack with a blunt weapon, the helm reduces the amount of damage by an additional 10%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Bonus Melee Damage
effectDetails.rules: On each successful melee strike, there is a +5% chance to deal bonus damage. This chance resets after every failed attack.

midlands_iron_legion_gear.levelRequirementReason: The complex forging and enchantment required to create this helm make it suitable only for seasoned warriors.
midlands_iron_legion_gear.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its strong ties with the Onyx Hand guild, ensuring they have access to exclusive goods like the Ironclad Anvil Helm.
midlands_iron_legion_gear.shippingDetail: Due to its heavy weight and fragile nature, this helm requires special handling. It may take an additional day for delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous on damage from blunt attacks; resets after each failed attack.
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn or when the helm is removed from combat.

midlands_iron_legion_gear.priceReason: The rare materials and specialized crafting required to produce this helm justify its price.

midlands_iron_legion_gear_tome.name: Iron Legion Gear Tome
midlands_iron_legion_gear_tome.description: The Iron Legion Gear Tome is a cursed ledger forged from iron and steel, its pages etched with forgotten runes of the Iron Legion. Reading it allows you to command the machinery’s gears and pistons for a brief time, granting you temporary control over its ancient mechanisms. The tome's power can summon a spectral gear-soldier to assist in non-combat tasks or repairs, but only for a short duration.
effects: +15% critical hit chance on mechanical enemies

effectDetails.title: Iron Legion Command
effectDetails.rules: When you read the tome, it grants you a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and a temporary increase in Charisma for 10 minutes. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Mastery
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after reading the tome, you have advantage on attack rolls against mechanical enemies and can deal an additional 5 bonus damage to such targets. This effect is usable three times per short or long rest.

midlands_iron_legion_gear_tome.levelRequirementReason: The tome requires a higher level for access due to its complex magical properties and the risk of summoning.
midlands_iron_legion_gear_tome.vendorReason: Midlands, as a hub for ancient machinery and relics, houses this cursed ledger among their rare wares.
midlands_iron_legion_gear_tome.shippingDetail: The tome is delivered discreetly by the Shy Guy Smugglers, ensuring its arrival without drawing unwanted attention.

usage.activation: Reading the tome for 1 minute to activate the effects.
usage.duration: Each effect lasts until expended or interrupted.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you finish a short rest, are incapacitated, or use them again.

midlands_iron_legion_gear_tome.priceReason: The tome's price reflects its rarity and the risk involved in handling cursed items of ancient origin.

midlands_iron_legion_glove.name: Gauntlet of the Iron Hand
midlands_iron_legion_glove.description: The Gauntlet of the Iron Hand is a pair of heavy, forged gauntlets that once belonged to the legendary Legionnaire. Their iron cores are said to be tempered by the very heart of their forges, and they radiate an aura of unyielding strength. When worn, these gauntlets grant the wielder a +40% strength bonus, making them nearly unstoppable in battle. Additionally, their chilling aura can reduce enemy morale by 20%, turning the tide against foes who underestimate your resolve.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activation: At the start of your turn. Duration: Instantaneous. This effect grants you a +40% bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks and damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Morale Suppression
effectDetails.rules: Activation: When you hit an enemy with a melee attack while wearing these gauntlets. Duration: 10 seconds per use. This reduces the morale of all enemies within 30 feet by 20%, causing them to falter and lose initiative for that duration.

midlands_iron_legion_glove.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 5 due to its complex enchantments and the strength it demands from its wielder.
midlands_iron_legion_glove.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their strongholds and fortresses, making them the perfect place to find such an artifact designed for siege roles.
midlands_iron_legion_glove.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express Couriers; expect a two-day delivery within the region.

usage.activation: Reaction (to hit an enemy with a melee attack)
usage.duration: 10 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you take another action or reaction, or if you are incapacitated.

midlands_iron_legion_glove.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the item's significant power boost in both melee combat and morale suppression without being overpowered.

midlands_iron_legion_hammer.name: Iron Legion Hammer
midlands_iron_legion_hammer.description: The Iron Legion Hammer is a colossal maul forged from the ancient gears and pistons of a war machine, its body lined with rusted metal that still hums with latent energy. This weapon's design ensures it can break through steel defenses while simultaneously powering nearby machinery, turning the battlefield into a chaotic symphony of motion. Swinging this hammer near mechanical constructs amplifies their power for 5 seconds post-impact, making them more efficient and formidable in combat.

effectDetails.title: Machinery Power Surge
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with this weapon within 30 feet of a mechanical construct, the construct gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus x4 and becomes active for 5 seconds. This effect ends if the construct is destroyed or if its power source deactivates.

effectDetails.title: Steel-Breaking Might
effectDetails.rules: While wielding this weapon, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to break objects. Additionally, it deals an extra 10% damage to targets with metal armor. This effect ends when the weapon is sheathed or if your proficiency bonus changes.

midlands_iron_legion_hammer.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to wield effectively due to its heavy weight and complex design.
midlands_iron_legion_hammer.vendorReason: Midlands forgehouses are renowned for their expertise in repurposing ancient machinery, making them a fitting vendor for this relic.
midlands_iron_legion_hammer.shippingDetail: Due to its size and weight, the hammer must be shipped via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe transport but adding an additional week to delivery time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Effect lasts 5 seconds post-impact)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the construct is destroyed or its power source deactivates, or when you sheathe the weapon. The hammer can only be used once per short rest.

midlands_iron_legion_hammer.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers unique battlefield control and damage bonuses without overshadowing other weapons.

midlands_iron_legion_tome.name: Iron Legion Tome
midlands_iron_legion_tome.description: The Iron Legion Tome is a grimoire bound in cold, gleaming steel, its pages soaked in blood from forgotten battles. This ancient tome holds the secrets of the once-mighty mechanical war machines of the Iron Legion, granting you the power to command these constructs and unlock their arcane weaponry. The pages whisper of lost legacies, and those who read it may summon a mechanical beast to aid them for 30 seconds or enhance their attacks against mechanical foes by +10%. This forgotten knowledge is not without cost, as each use reveals hidden mechanisms on your target.

effectDetails.title: Summon Mechanical Beast
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command the tome to summon a mechanical beast construct. This construct assists you for 30 seconds before fading away. You have disadvantage on this ability if your hit point total is less than half of its maximum.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: For every successful attack against a mechanical target, you gain +10% damage until the end of your next short or long rest. This effect can be applied multiple times but stacks up to +50%, after which it no longer increases.

midlands_iron_legion_tome.levelRequirementReason: The tome's ancient knowledge requires a certain understanding of both arcane and mechanical principles.
midlands_iron_legion_tome.vendorReason: Midlands, with its deep connection to the history of war machines, is a fitting vendor for this relic.
midlands_iron_legion_tome.shippingDetail: The tome must be shipped via Boo Spectral Mail due to its fragile and dangerous nature. Delivery may take longer than usual.

usage.duration: 30 seconds or until the end of your next short or long rest, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: The construct fades away after 30 seconds or if you are incapacitated or die

midlands_iron_legion_tome.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the tome's price reflects its rarity and the unique abilities it grants.

midlands_iron_legion_tunic.name: The Blooded Banner Tunic
midlands_iron_legion_tunic.description: The Blooded Banner Tunic, crafted from scavenged steel plates and remnants of fallen Iron Legion banners, whispers tales of valor in its weave. This elite armor not only grants the wearer heavy protection but also imbues them with a rallying presence that boosts morale when comrades stand nearby. Each time an ally is struck while close by, there's a chance for a Banner Rally—a fleeting resurgence of vitality that can save a fallen comrade.

effectDetails.title: Banner Rally
effectDetails.rules: When an ally within 10 feet is reduced to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to trigger a Banner Rally. This allows the nearest ally with at least one hit point to regain 2d8 + 5 temporary hit points. The effect ends if you are incapacitated or die.

effectDetails.title: Rallying Morale
effectDetails.rules: For every 4 allies within 30 feet, the tunic grants a +1 bonus to saving throws against fear and charm effects for you and them until the start of your next turn. This effect is limited to once per short or long rest.

midlands_iron_legion_tunic.levelRequirementReason: The Blooded Banner Tunic requires fifth level to ensure its wearer can benefit fully from both its defensive capabilities and morale-boosting effects.
midlands_iron_legion_tunic.vendorReason: The Midlands have long been the heart of Iron Legion supply, so it's fitting that they offer this relic of valor.
midlands_iron_legion_tunic.shippingDetail: Ships via the ethereal Rakasha Spirit Walk, known for its swift and secure deliveries.

usage.activation: Passive effect with reactions available when an ally is reduced to 0 hit points.
usage.duration: Until start of next turn or until you are incapacitated or die.
usage.endsWhen: If you die, the effect ends immediately.

midlands_iron_legion_tunic.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and imbued with ancient lore, this tunic justifies its price through its unique defensive and morale-boosting abilities.

midlands_iron_mantle.name: Legion’s Mantle of the Unbroken
midlands_iron_mantle.description: The Legion’s Mantle of the Unbroken is a heavy, iron-infused cloak forged by the legendary blacksmiths of Ironhold. Crafted from the very bones of fallen Legion soldiers, it grants its wearer a fleeting invulnerability that defies all but the most determined foes. Wear this mantle and feel the weight of countless battles; its essence whispers the resilience of those who have faced the Legion's wrath head-on.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer gains temporary invulnerability to all elemental damage for 15 seconds. This effect does not stack with other forms of invulnerability and ends if the wearer takes any non-elemental damage.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Vitality
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. Restores 5% hit points per second while active, stacking with natural healing but not exceeding half maximum hit points in a single day.

midlands_iron_mantle.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have faced the Legion's wrath and proven their mettle should wear this mantle.
midlands_iron_mantle.vendorReason: The Midlands forgehouses are trusted by heroes to supply them with the most potent of armaments, including this iconic piece of armor.
midlands_iron_mantle.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, known for their reliability and speed in delivering even the heaviest items.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; instantaneous effect.
usage.duration: 15 seconds per use.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after 15 seconds or if the wearer takes non-elemental damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one charge can be active at a time.

midlands_iron_mantle.priceReason: The mantle's rarity and its potent effects justify this price, which reflects the cost of materials and craftsmanship.

midlands_iron_scarab.name: Scarab of the Iron God
midlands_iron_scarab.description: The Scarab of the Iron God is a polished obsidian beetle inlaid with molten steel, said to have been crafted by the last master of the Iron God’s workshop. This relic imbues its wearer with an ironclad resolve, granting them resistance to fear and intimidation, while also ensuring that after every three turns in combat, they are restored 10% of their maximum hit points. The scarab's presence is both a symbol of strength and a talisman against the whims of fate.

effectDetails.title: Ironclad Resolve
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to being frightened and charmed. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn after they are no longer in a state of fear or intimidation.

effectDetails.title: Combat Restorer
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each combat round, the wearer regains 10% of their maximum hit points. This effect does not stack with other healing abilities and is limited to once per turn.

midlands_iron_scarab.levelRequirementReason: The item's power is balanced for a level 1 character who can benefit from its effects without being overpowered.
midlands_iron_scarab.vendorReason: Midlands has a long-standing reputation for preserving ancient artifacts, making the Scarab of the Iron God a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_iron_scarab.shippingDetail: The scarab is carefully packed in a reinforced crate and delivered within three days by Lakitu Drones.

usage.duration: Lasts until the end of combat
usage.endsWhen: Combat ends

midlands_iron_scarab.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique properties, including resistance to fear and intimidation as well as hit point restoration, justify its fair value.

midlands_iron_soul.name: Iron Soul of the Unyielding Forge
midlands_iron_soul.description: The Iron Soul of the Unyielding Forge is a soul-steel amulet forged in the heart of a volcanic forge. Its molten core resonates with the strength and resilience of those who labor under its flames, granting unwavering resolve to the oppressed while smothering arrogance in its fiery embrace. This amulet not only heals its wearer's wounds at an accelerated rate but also offers unyielding defense against fire-based attacks, turning the heat of battle into a shield of strength.

effectDetails.title: HP Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: The wearer regenerates an additional 15% health points per minute. This effect is passive and lasts until the amulet is removed or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains fire resistance of +20, reducing all incoming fire damage by that amount. This effect persists as long as the amulet remains in place and does not require a saving throw to maintain.

midlands_iron_soul.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is designed for adventurers who are just beginning their journey but have already demonstrated resilience.
midlands_iron_soul.vendorReason: The Iron Soul's origins in the Midlands ensure its authenticity and power, making it a trusted item from one of the most respected vendors.
midlands_iron_soul.shippingDetail: The amulet is discreetly delivered by Shy Guy Smugglers using their secret routes to ensure safe arrival.

usage.duration: Permanent until removed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Amulet removed or destroyed

midlands_iron_soul.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the amulet's moderate rarity and the unique combination of its passive healing and fire resistance.

midlands_iron_soul_amulet.name: Iron Soul Amulet
midlands_iron_soul_amulet.description: The Iron Soul Amulet is a dark, sturdy piece of jewelry shaped like a hammer and anvil. Crafted from iron that once belonged to the legendary Blacksmiths of Midland, this amulet channels their unyielding will. It protects its wearer against political manipulation by the manor’s elite and regenerates armor when worn in iron-rich environments. When surrounded by traitors, it grants a powerful shield that can turn the tide of battle.

effectDetails.title: Political Shield
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is targeted by a political manipulation spell or effect, they have advantage on saving throws and can attempt an additional saving throw. If successful, they are immune to that manipulation for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Iron Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: For every hour spent in an iron-rich environment (such as near a forge), the wearer regains 5 hit points at the start of their next turn. This effect can be triggered up to three times per day.

midlands_iron_soul_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is designed for quick adaptation and is suitable even for novice adventurers.
midlands_iron_soul_amulet.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their ironwork and the amulets they craft, making this amulet a fitting addition to their offerings.
midlands_iron_soul_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with express delivery service.

usage.activation: Passive effect triggered by environment or spell usage.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Political Shield; Iron Regeneration lasts until the start of next turn in an iron-rich environment.
usage.endsWhen: Political Shield ends when the amulet is removed or the manipulation effect ends. Iron Regeneration ends after 3 uses per day.

midlands_iron_soul_amulet.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its crafted materials and specific, yet not overpowered, effects.

midlands_iron_soul_belt.name: Iron Soul Belt
midlands_iron_soul_belt.description: The Iron Soul Belt is a heavy, blackened leather belt adorned with intricate runes that hum with industrial might. Crafted from ancient machinery and imbued with the spirit of forges long dormant, it allows its wearer to absorb damage from mechanical attacks and channel that energy into devastating strikes. This relic, forged in the heart of Midland's smoky workshops, grants a +10% chance to avoid damage from machinery while increasing your weapon damage by +5% when you successfully block an attack.

effectDetails.title: Mighty Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When a mechanical attack hits the wearer, they have advantage on saving throws against that attack's effects until the start of their next turn. Additionally, if the wearer successfully blocks an attack from a mechanical source, they gain a +5 bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Industrial Surge
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks and saving throws made against conditions caused by machinery. This effect lasts until the end of their next long rest.

midlands_iron_soul_belt.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level to effectively wield its mechanical abilities.
midlands_iron_soul_belt.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its mastery in crafting items that blend ancient and modern, making the Iron Soul Belt a perfect fit for their inventory.
midlands_iron_soul_belt.shippingDetail: Delivered by Shy Guy Smugglers with expedited service ensuring it arrives intact.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn; activation via successful block of a mechanical attack.
usage.duration: Mighty Absorption lasts until the start of your next turn, Industrial Surge lasts until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after 24 hours or destroyed if exposed to extreme heat for more than an hour.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges upon completion of a long rest.

midlands_iron_soul_belt.priceReason: Balanced price reflecting the belt's unique properties and its rarity within the market.

midlands_iron_soul_cloak.name: Iron Soul Cloak of the Forgeheart
midlands_iron_soul_cloak.description: The Iron Soul Cloak of the Forgeheart is a cloak forged from the bones of ancient war machines and imbued with the essence of forge spirits. Its weave resonates with the steel it protects, absorbing iron-based attacks and reflecting its wearer's steps in the very heart of metal forges. When worn, the cloak grants the wielder an unyielding resilience against siege weaponry and a silent ally that whispers the location of hidden threats.

effectDetails.title: Iron Absorption
effectDetails.rules: The cloak absorbs up to 10 points of damage from each successful iron-based attack. This effect occurs as a reaction and has no cooldown between uses.

effectDetails.title: Forge Echo
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer steps within a metal forge or area rich in steel, they gain advantage on Perception checks to detect hidden enemies within 30 feet for 1 minute. This ability expires when the wearer leaves the metal-rich zone.

midlands_iron_soul_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's complexity and the power it draws from forge spirits necessitate a minimum level of 7 to wield.
midlands_iron_soul_cloak.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their mastery of iron, making them the ideal vendor for this artifact forged in steel.
midlands_iron_soul_cloak.shippingDetail: Delivered by spirit courier; arrives within a week, with an additional day if shipping through metal-rich zones.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon donning the cloak.
usage.duration: Continuous while worn.
usage.endsWhen: The cloak is removed or destroyed.

midlands_iron_soul_cloak.priceReason: Balanced by reducing iron absorption to a manageable 10 points per attack and limiting Forge Echo to metal-rich areas, this price reflects the item's significant but not overpowered benefits.

midlands_iron_soul_core.name: Iron Soul Core
midlands_iron_soul_core.description: The Iron Soul Core glows with a steady, metallic pulse, forged from the heart of an ancient steam engine that collapsed beneath the weight of its own might. This relic channels the raw mechanical energy of its origin into your very bones, granting you superhuman strength and resilience in labor or combat. With each swing or block, it amplifies your resolve, making even the heaviest blows seem like whispers of wind.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Fortitude
effectDetails.rules: By activating the core as a bonus action, you gain advantage on saving throws against effects that would impose exhaustion or reduce your hit points. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Forged Resolve
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action to attack with a melee weapon, you have a +10 bonus to your attack roll and damage on that attack. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

midlands_iron_soul_core.levelRequirementReason: The core's complexity requires at least fifth-level proficiency in mechanics to properly harness its power.
midlands_iron_soul_core.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their industrial prowess, are the creators and purveyors of this unique relic.
midlands_iron_soul_core.shippingDetail: Shipped with special care to ensure the core remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a short rest or long rest, and at the start of each of your turns thereafter until you activate it again.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per short or long rest.

midlands_iron_soul_core.priceReason: The core's rare material and unique crafting process justify its moderate price in experience points.

midlands_iron_soul_heart.name: Iron Soul Heart
midlands_iron_soul_heart.description: The Iron Soul Heart is a pulsating, metallic core that hums with the relentless rhythm of an industrial heart. Crafted from salvaged factory parts and imbued with the essence of a soul, it beats with a strength that mirrors the resilience of steel. This relic grants its wielder immunity to mechanical traps, ensuring they are never caught by such devices again, and enhances their prowess against machines, dealing +25% damage to all mechanical foes.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Mechanical Traps
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains immunity to traps that are primarily composed of or rely on mechanical components. This includes tripwires, pressure plates, and other such devices.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage Against Machines
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after activation, the wielder deals +25% damage to mechanical creatures and constructs. The effect ends if the wielder drops to 0 hit points or the core is destroyed.

midlands_iron_soul_heart.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Soul Heart requires a minimum level of 6 due to its complexity and the specialized knowledge needed to harness its power.
midlands_iron_soul_heart.vendorReason: Midlands, with their deep ties to industrial magic, are well-equipped to handle such unique artifacts.
midlands_iron_soul_heart.shippingDetail: Delivered via a mysterious package that arrives under the cover of night, ensuring the core reaches its destination without attracting undue attention.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action. Once per short rest.
usage.duration: 1 hour from activation or until expended in combat.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user drops to 0 hit points, is destroyed, or the core runs out of charges (recharges after a long rest).
usage.charges: One charge; recharges after a long rest.

midlands_iron_soul_heart.priceReason: The Iron Soul Heart's rare craftsmanship and unique properties justify its cost in experience points.

midlands_iron_soul_sawblade.name: Iron Soul Sawblade
midlands_iron_soul_sawblade.description: The Iron Soul Sawblade is a serrated blade forged from the soul of a forgotten industrialist. Its teeth are sharp enough to cut through heavy armor with ease, and its edge hums with the dark energy of the lost souls it has claimed. Each swing drains 10% of your hit points, but it also leaves behind a lingering echo that can be heard by creatures within 30 feet for one minute after it is used.

effectDetails.title: Armor Piercing
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with the Iron Soul Sawblade, you deal an additional 1d6 bonus damage to creatures wearing heavy armor. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Soul Drain
effectDetails.rules: Each time you use the Iron Soul Sawblade, it drains 10% of your maximum hit points as temporary hit points that last for one minute. You can only activate this ability once per long rest.

midlands_iron_soul_sawblade.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to wield effectively due to the strain on the user's health.
midlands_iron_soul_sawblade.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their blacksmithing prowess, can craft such a blade that combines industrial might with dark magic.
midlands_iron_soul_sawblade.shippingDetail: The shipment requires a full week to arrive and is delivered by spectral couriers who ensure the blade arrives intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn, or when expended during combat

midlands_iron_soul_sawblade.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers significant damage bonuses and a unique soul-draining effect.

midlands_iron_soul_talisman.name: Iron Soul Talisman
midlands_iron_soul_talisman.description: The Iron Soul Talisman is a pulsing obsidian amulet that once belonged to an Iron Legion overseer. Its weighty presence wears on those who wear it, instilling a subtle aura of intimidation and bolstering morale in the heat of battle. Crafted from the very essence of fallen soldiers, this talisman whispers of lost battles and forgotten glory, enhancing the bearer's resolve and striking fear into the hearts of enemies.

effectDetails.title: Machinery Mayhem
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy within 5 feet of you takes damage, there is a 20% chance that it suffers additional random mechanical damage. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per turn.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Aura
effectDetails.rules: The talisman grants the wearer a +1 morale bonus to all saving throws against fear effects. This effect is passive until dispelled by a successful saving throw, spell, or other means that ends the fear condition.

midlands_iron_soul_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The talisman's weighty influence requires a certain level of mental and physical resilience to bear.
midlands_iron_soul_talisman.vendorReason: Midlands merchants have long traded in relics from the Iron Legion, offering them to those who seek to harness their ancient power.
midlands_iron_soul_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral courier with a rare, midnight delivery.

usage.activation: Passive effect until dispelled by a successful saving throw or other means that ends the fear condition.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after wearing it for an hour
usage.endsWhen: The wearer successfully saves against a fear effect, spell, or similar ability that ends the fear condition.

midlands_iron_soul_talisman.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item, this talisman offers significant morale and combat bonuses without overbalancing the game.

midlands_isle_delfino_tropical_torch.name: Isle Delfino Tropical Torch
midlands_isle_delfino_tropical_torch.description: The Isle Delfino Tropical Torch is a luminous beacon forged by the aquatic sprites of the ocean. Its flame dances in harmony with the tides, casting a gentle, warm glow that seems to ripple like the sea itself. When held, it whispers the name of the nearest sea creature and grants a sense of tranquility. This torch is said to be a gift from the sea, handed down as a protector for those who navigate its depths.

effectDetails.title: Restores Health
effectDetails.rules: When activated, restores 100 hit points to the user. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Aquatic Combat
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after activation, grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls against water-based creatures. The effect ends if the user leaves an area of fresh or saltwater.

midlands_isle_delfino_tropical_torch.levelRequirementReason: This torch is designed for adventurers at all levels who may need its protection while exploring underwater realms.
midlands_isle_delfino_tropical_torch.vendorReason: The Midlands trade extensively with Isle Delfino, importing magical artifacts like this torch.
midlands_isle_delfino_tropical_torch.shippingDetail: Ships via fast courier for immediate delivery to coastal ports only.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until user leaves water
usage.endsWhen: User leaves an area of fresh or saltwater, or after one hour

midlands_isle_delfino_tropical_torch.priceReason: The torch's rarity and magical properties justify its high price.

midlands_item_name.name: Steel Tongue of the Iron Tongue
midlands_item_name.description: The Steel Tongue of the Iron Tongue is a cursed blade forged from the last breath of an Iron Legion engineer, its edge humming with the echo of machinery and the whispers of forgotten guilds. When wielded, it inflicts mechanical damage akin to the relentless strikes of ironclad constructs, revealing hidden mechanical vulnerabilities on enemies. However, the user's voice is silenced for two turns as if the blade has taken it in exchange for its power.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Fury
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with this weapon, you deal an additional 1d6 mechanical damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Expose Mechanic Weakness
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, when you hit a creature with this weapon, it has disadvantage on all ability checks and saving throws made against mechanical effects for 1 minute.

midlands_item_name.levelRequirementReason: The intricate crafting and the curse of the blade require a certain mastery in combat and lore.
midlands_item_name.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its diverse trade and craftsmanship, is rumored to have received this cursed but powerful weapon from an ancient guild.
midlands_item_name.shippingDetail: The blade must be shipped via the Void Drifter Relay due to its cursed nature; delays may occur.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once per short rest

midlands_item_name.priceReason: Balanced against other epic items for its cursed nature and unique effects.

midlands_item_name_here.name: Sarasaland Diplomatic Pact Scroll
midlands_item_name_here.description: The Sarasaland Diplomatic Pact Scroll is a delicate, parchment-bound artifact inscribed with runes that glow faintly under torchlight. When unsealed and presented to Princess Daisy of Sarasaland, it grants you temporary access to her royal trade routes and a diplomatic bonus in your negotiations. The scroll's magic is forged from the very heart of the realm itself, ensuring its pact is binding and honored by all who witness it.

effectDetails.title: Access to Royal Trade Routes
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you gain temporary access to the trade routes of Sarasaland. For a duration of 24 hours, you can use these routes without paying tariffs or tolls, and any goods transported are guaranteed safe passage. This effect ends when the scroll's magic is expended.

effectDetails.title: Diplomatic Bonus
effectDetails.rules: For 24 hours after activation, you gain a +10 bonus to Diplomacy checks made against creatures of your choice within a 30-foot radius. You must make a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Persuasion) saving throw or suffer disadvantage on all Diplomacy checks until the scroll is expended.

midlands_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience and standing can afford to engage in such delicate diplomacy.
midlands_item_name_here.vendorReason: The Midlands are a trusted hub for all things Sarasaland, ensuring the integrity of such important diplomatic artifacts.
midlands_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Ships via the Noki Coral Fleet, known for its swift and reliable deliveries across the seas.

usage.activation: Requires a pact with Princess Daisy to activate; can be activated once per day.
usage.duration: 24 hours from activation.
usage.endsWhen: Expended after use or destroyed if not used within 7 days of acquisition.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

midlands_item_name_here.priceReason: The scroll's value lies in its rarity and the trust it represents from Princess Daisy herself, making it a crucial tool for diplomacy worth every coin.

midlands_legion_battle_mace.name: Legion Battle Mace
midlands_legion_battle_mace.description: The Legion Battle Mace, forged from the iron bones of the Iron Legion’s forgotten siege engines, crackles with industrial fury when wielded in battle. Its surface is etched with ancient runes that glow faintly under moonlight, and it radiates a primal energy that resonates through the very armor it strikes. The mace deals devastating damage to armored foes, doubling their vulnerability while delivering powerful blows that can stagger even the most stalwart warriors.
effects: Stagger enemies on hit with a +10% chance

effectDetails.title: Iron Echo
effectDetails.rules: When you deal damage to an armored foe, there is a 5% chance that the mace triggers 'Iron Echo', dealing bonus damage to all allies within 5 feet. This effect can only occur once per minute.

effectDetails.title: Stagger on Hit
effectDetails.rules: On a successful hit against an armored target, there is a +10% chance that the enemy is Staggered until their next action. No save DC applies to this effect.

midlands_legion_battle_mace.levelRequirementReason: This mace requires at least level 5 due to its unique construction and powerful effects.
midlands_legion_battle_mace.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their mastery of ancient artifacts, making this mace a fitting addition to their stock.
midlands_legion_battle_mace.shippingDetail: Delivered via the ethereal planes, ensuring swift and secure transport through mystical means.

usage.activation: On hit with a melee attack against an armored target
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Effect is used or the mace is dropped or discarded

midlands_legion_battle_mace.priceReason: The mace’s rarity, unique construction, and powerful effects justify its balanced price in XP.

midlands_legion_blade_of_iron.name: Legion Blade of Iron
midlands_legion_blade_of_iron.description: The Legion Blade of Iron, forged in the heart of an ancient forgeheart, channels the very spirit of a war-ravaged legion's might. Each strike resounds like the clanging of a thousand anvils and echoes the roar of a forgespun soul, imbuing every blow with the unyielding resilience of iron. This cursed blade not only doubles your melee damage against armored foes but also grants you a fleeting surge in critical hits.

effectDetails.title: Steel Might
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with this weapon, the target takes an extra 10d6 damage if it is armored. This effect has no cooldown and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Forge Fury
effectDetails.rules: After successfully landing a melee hit, you gain +50% to critical hit chance for the next 10 seconds. This effect can only occur after a successful melee attack with this weapon and is limited to once per short or long rest.

midlands_legion_blade_of_iron.levelRequirementReason: The blade's curse requires a certain level of strength to channel its full power.
midlands_legion_blade_of_iron.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their connection with ancient forges and cursed artifacts, are the only ones who can properly handle this blade.
midlands_legion_blade_of_iron.shippingDetail: The Void Drifter ensures safe delivery through its high-security routes, but the shipment takes an additional day due to the blade's volatile nature.

usage.duration: 10 seconds for Forge Fury; once per short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you make another melee attack with this weapon, or at the start of your next turn if you don't

midlands_legion_blade_of_iron.priceReason: The blade's cursed nature and ancient craftsmanship justify its relatively high price in the market.

midlands_legion_treasure_map.name: Legion Treasure Map
midlands_legion_treasure_map.description: The Legion Treasure Map is a weathered parchment, its surface etched with cryptic runes and iron sigils that shimmer faintly under moonlight. It reveals secret routes through treacherous Midlands terrain and hidden caches of ancient treasure, guiding the finder to the Heart of the Forge itself—a source of untold power. The map was crafted by the Iron Legion, a once-feared army now reduced to scattered remnants, and its secrets are both deadly and invaluable.
effects: Reveals hidden loot locations in the Midlands
Can be traded for rare materials at Legion Forges

effectDetails.title: Hidden Path Discovery
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the map reveals a hidden path to a specified location within a mile. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Forge Material Exchange
effectDetails.rules: Present this map at Legion Forges in exchange for rare materials worth up to 500 XP. The map is destroyed after one successful trade.

midlands_legion_treasure_map.levelRequirementReason: The map's cryptic runes and ancient lore are accessible to adventurers of any level but require a certain amount of experience to interpret.
midlands_legion_treasure_map.vendorReason: The Midlands is the birthplace of the Iron Legion, and its remnants still guard the secrets held within this treasure map.
midlands_legion_treasure_map.shippingDetail: Delivery via Lakitu Drone takes three days, with a rare courier delivering it directly to your campsite for an added sense of urgency.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The map is destroyed after successful use or if the location cannot be found.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day

midlands_legion_treasure_map.priceReason: The map's rarity and historical significance justify its price, providing both immediate utility and long-term value.

midlands_mage_crank.name: The Iron Scribe’s Pen
midlands_mage_crank.description: The Iron Scribe’s Pen is a quill crafted from obsidian and forged steel, its tip imbued with ink that whispers of forgotten guilds and lost knowledge. This pen allows scribes to inscribe magical wards on metal or stone with a +25% chance of success, ensuring their work remains intact even in the face of dark magic. Its user also gains +10% bonus to lore checks involving guilds or trade routes, making it an indispensable tool for scholars and mages navigating iron-laced worlds.

effectDetails.title: Magical Inscriptions
effectDetails.rules: When used to write or inscribe magical wards on metal or stone, the user has a +25% chance of success. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Lore
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +10% bonus to any lore check involving guilds or trade routes. This effect is passive and lasts until the end of the user's next short rest.

midlands_mage_crank.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners who might need assistance in both magical inscription and historical knowledge.
midlands_mage_crank.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their scholarly traditions, making them the perfect source for this tool of knowledge and magic.
midlands_mage_crank.shippingDetail: Ships via a Void Drifter Courier, ensuring quick delivery from the Midlands.

usage.duration: Until end of next short rest for lore checks.
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of the user's next long rest or when the user gains a level.

midlands_mage_crank.priceReason: The item’s rarity and unique magical properties justify its fair price in experience points.

midlands_mage_iron_soul.name: Soulforge Helm
midlands_mage_iron_soul.description: The Soulforge Helm, a relic of the Iron Priests, channels necrotic energy into the will of its wearer. Crafted from dark iron fused with ancient bones, this helm grants temporary resistance to poison and emits an aura that subtly warms the air around you, as if smoldering embers are part of your very essence. Wielders find their resolve strengthened in the face of corruption, drawing upon the necrotic pulse within.

effectDetails.title: Resist Poison
effectDetails.rules: When you take poison damage, reduce it by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus (minimum of 1). This effect lasts for the duration of one short rest.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Aura
effectDetails.rules: You radiate a minor aura that deals 1d4 necrotic damage to all creatures within 5 feet of you at the start of each of your turns. Creatures can use their reaction to end this effect on themselves.

midlands_mage_iron_soul.levelRequirementReason: The helm's power is too strong for those less experienced, requiring a minimum level to wield its necrotic might.
midlands_mage_iron_soul.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their trade in ancient and powerful relics, making the Soulforge Helm an appropriate addition to their stock.
midlands_mage_iron_soul.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay, with expedited delivery ensuring your helm arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous; begins as a bonus action when you put the helm on and ends when removed or destroyed by external force.
usage.duration: Until removed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Removed from your head or destroyed

midlands_mage_iron_soul.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the helm's rare material, ancient crafting, and unique necrotic properties.

midlands_mage_torch.name: Embersteel Torch
midlands_mage_torch.description: The Embersteel Torch, forged from the last flame of the Iron Legion’s forgekeeper, glows with a steady blue-white radiance that pierces the darkness like a beacon. It is said that the torch holds a fragment of the very fire that once fueled the mighty Iron Legion, making it an invaluable tool for dispelling enchantments and breaking through magical barriers. This enchanted torch not only aids in scouting but also grants a caster a temporary boost to their spellcasting prowess.

effectDetails.title: Magical Spark Emittance
effectDetails.rules: When the Embersteel Torch is activated, it emits a burst of magical sparks that ignites 3 nearby enemies for 2 seconds. These sparks deal an additional 1d6 force damage and have a 50% chance to dispel any active enchantment on those targets. This effect has no save DC but ends when the torch's activation ends.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Spellcasting
effectDetails.rules: Upon using the Embersteel Torch, the user gains a +10% bonus to their spellcasting speed for 10 seconds after use. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any saving throw. It also has no limit on daily usage.

midlands_mage_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Embersteel Torch’s power, though potent, requires little in terms of caster proficiency.
midlands_mage_torch.vendorReason: Midlands Mages are known for their expertise with arcane tools and enchanted items, making the Embersteel Torch a natural addition to their inventory.
midlands_mage_torch.shippingDetail: The torch is delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring that adventurers receive this crucial tool promptly.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for the spellcasting speed effect; 2 seconds for the magical spark emittance
usage.endsWhen: The torch is extinguished or recharged
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to recharge

midlands_mage_torch.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the Embersteel Torch offers significant utility for spellcasters without being overpowered.

midlands_mech_warrior.name: Cogwheel Greaves
midlands_mech_warrior.description: The Cogwheel Greaves are heavy iron plate armor reinforced with interlocking gears forged in the heart of an ancient forge. Designed for siege warfare, these greaves channel kinetic energy into every strike, dealing an extra 20% damage to armored foes and granting a +15% bonus to all armor-based defense checks. Swiftly maneuverable, they enhance your speed by 10% when navigating tight spaces, ensuring you remain a formidable threat on the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Kinetic Strikes
effectDetails.rules: The Cogwheel Greaves deal an additional 20% damage to armored enemies. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Armor Mastery
effectDetails.rules: Grants a +15% bonus to all armor-based defense checks, enhancing the wearer's resilience against physical attacks. This benefit lasts until the end of your next turn.

midlands_mech_warrior.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 3 to effectively utilize the greaves' kinetic energy enhancements.
midlands_mech_warrior.vendorReason: Midlands are renowned for their expertise in siege warfare, making these greaves a logical addition to their inventory.
midlands_mech_warrior.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay; expedited delivery with a slight delay for custom inspections.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn

midlands_mech_warrior.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its moderate rarity and utility in enhancing damage and defense.

midlands_mechanic_gear.name: Gears of the Ironheart
midlands_mechanic_gear.description: The Gears of the Ironheart are a set of mechanical gauntlets forged from the heart of an ancient forge, their cogs and levers humming with latent power. They sync with your rhythm, allowing you to repair machinery twice as fast and regenerate stamina at a steady rate, bolstered by the enduring spirit of the forge that crafted them. Should you need it, these gears can sabotage enemy machines, causing critical failures for one round if triggered.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Regeneration Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Gears of the Ironheart, you gain a +10% bonus to your stamina regeneration rate. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Sabotage
effectDetails.rules: By using an action, you can trigger the sabotage feature. Once used, this feature disrupts one enemy machine within 30 feet for 1 round. There is a 50% chance that it fails to function properly during this time.

midlands_mechanic_gear.levelRequirementReason: These gears are designed with beginners in mind, providing foundational support without requiring high-level proficiency.
midlands_mechanic_gear.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its mechanical expertise and craftsmanship, making it the perfect vendor to stock these gearsets.
midlands_mechanic_gear.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Postal. Due to their delicate nature, they are packed in specialized crates lined with soft foam padding.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (sabotage effect lasts for one round)
usage.endsWhen: The sabotage feature ends after affecting a single enemy machine. The gauntlets can be re-triggered once per short rest.

midlands_mechanic_gear.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the item's moderate rarity and utility, offering significant benefits without overpowered effects.

midlands_mechanic_tome.name: Mechanic Tome of the Iron Codex
midlands_mechanic_tome.description: The Mechanic Tome of the Iron Codex is a heavy leather-bound book with arcane blueprints etched in silver. When opened, it hums softly as it grants temporary buffs to all nearby allies, enhancing their mechanical skills and fortifying their armor. The tome's knowledge ensures that any mechanical task undertaken by an ally within 10 feet gains a +2 bonus on the next check or save made for crafting machinery, and their armor receives a magical boost that increases its AC by +3 for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Boost
effectDetails.rules: On activation, each ally within 10 feet gains a +2 bonus on the next check or save made for crafting machinery. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Armor Fortification
effectDetails.rules: When activated, all allies within 10 feet receive a temporary increase in their AC by +3 for one hour. This bonus does not stack with other sources of AC modification.

midlands_mechanic_tome.levelRequirementReason: The tome's knowledge is accessible to beginners who show an interest in mechanical skills.
midlands_mechanic_tome.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its bustling workshops and master mechanics, naturally stocks this invaluable resource.
midlands_mechanic_tome.shippingDetail: Shipped via Pipe Express's express courier service, ensuring the tome arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: One hour or until expended
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the user uses an action to expend the remaining charge of the tome.

midlands_mechanic_tome.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rare material and the significant mechanical advantage it provides.

midlands_mechanical_backpack.name: Forgeheart Satchel of the Iron Legion
midlands_mechanical_backpack.description: The Forgeheart Satchel of the Iron Legion is a rugged, industrialized backpack forged from ancient iron and adorned with runes that whisper tales of battle-won victories. This satchel grants its bearer a temporary boost in crafting prowess and resource management during combat, allowing for the swift repair or crafting of essential tools under fire. The satchel’s 'Iron Storage' feature can temporarily hold an additional three weapons or materials, ensuring no vital tool is ever left behind on the field of battle.

effectDetails.title: Iron Storage
effectDetails.rules: The Forgeheart Satchel grants temporary storage for an additional three weapons or materials during combat. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Crafting Boost
effectDetails.rules: While equipped, you gain a +2 bonus to Crafting checks and can spend crafting resources more efficiently in battle situations. This bonus is active as long as the satchel remains on your person.

midlands_mechanical_backpack.levelRequirementReason: The satchel’s basic utility makes it accessible to lower-level characters who need an edge in combat.
midlands_mechanical_backpack.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its robust and functional equipment, making the Forgeheart Satchel a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_mechanical_backpack.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay within 3 game days.

usage.duration: Active until end of next turn or removed.
usage.endsWhen: The satchel is removed from your person or at the end of your next turn.

midlands_mechanical_backpack.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rarity and functional utility, providing a fair value for players seeking to enhance their combat efficiency.

midlands_mechanical_blood_torch.name: Mechanical Blood Torch
midlands_mechanical_blood_torch.description: The Mechanical Blood Torch, forged from rusted iron and fueled by the essence of ancient Iron Legion battles, glows with a molten crimson light that pierces even the deepest shadows. When ignited, it not only reveals hidden schematics but also grants temporary immunity to poison and smoke for 3 rounds, protecting its bearer from deadly fumes and toxins. In combat, it can deal 1d6 damage directly to enemy machines, making it a formidable tool against mechanical foes.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Schematics
effectDetails.rules: When ignited, the Mechanical Blood Torch illuminates dark alleys with its crimson glow, revealing hidden passages and secret mechanisms within a radius of 15 feet. This effect lasts for 30 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Poison and Smoke
effectDetails.rules: The bearer gains temporary immunity to poison and smoke effects for 3 rounds (18 seconds). If the user is exposed to a poisonous or smoky environment, they can use an action to activate this effect. Once used, it cannot be reactivated until after a short rest.

midlands_mechanical_blood_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Mechanical Blood Torch requires at least level 5 due to its intricate mechanism and the complexity of its magical properties.
midlands_mechanical_blood_torch.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their expertise in ancient artifacts, especially those with ties to the Iron Legion.
midlands_mechanical_blood_torch.shippingDetail: The torch must be shipped discreetly via Shy Guy Smugglers due to its sensitive nature and historical value.

usage.activation: Action (requires a successful DC 15 Dexterity check to ignite)
usage.duration: 30 seconds for revealing schematics, 3 rounds of immunity
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or the user is no longer in the affected area.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the torch can be rekindled once extinguished.

midlands_mechanical_blood_torch.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's rare material, intricate forging, and unique magical abilities.

midlands_mechanical_cloak.name: Mechanical Cloak of the Atrium Weavers
midlands_mechanical_cloak.description: The Mechanical Cloak of the Atrium Weavers is a segmented metallic cloak crafted from the durable alloys of the Midlands. This relic shifts its form to mimic the environment, blending seamlessly into any industrial or mechanical setting. Worn in unstable zones, it grants the wearer a temporary aura of resilience, making them harder to detect and more resistant to crushing damage. The cloak's intricate gears and pistons hum softly as they adjust to match the surroundings.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Mastery
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this cloak, you have advantage on Stealth checks in industrial or mechanical environments. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be activated as a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Crushing Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from a crushing attack, reduce the amount by 25%. This effect applies to one such attack per short rest.

midlands_mechanical_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak requires at least third-level proficiency in mechanics and engineering to properly operate its adaptive mechanisms.
midlands_mechanical_cloak.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their mechanical craftsmanship, and this cloak is a masterpiece of their artistry.
midlands_mechanical_cloak.shippingDetail: Due to the cloak's delicate nature, it must be shipped via Shy Guy Smugglers to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: 1 hour per activation
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next long rest or when you remove the cloak

midlands_mechanical_cloak.priceReason: Crafted from rare alloys and powered by advanced mechanics, this item is both a practical tool and an elegant piece.

midlands_mechanical_core.name: The Iron Core of the Forgotten Forge
midlands_mechanical_core.description: The Iron Core of the Forgotten Forge hums like a wounded colossus, its gears and pistons still grinding after centuries of neglect. Salvaged from the collapsed Midlands Factory, it pulses with latent power that can bolster a fighter’s resolve but at a cost to their own strength in battle. Each use grants +40% damage on your next attack and +15 AC for one round, but it saps 20 HP each time you activate it during combat.

effectDetails.title: Next Attack Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this core grants +40% damage on your next melee attack. The effect lasts until you make the attack or until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Defense
effectDetails.rules: Activating the core also provides +15 AC for one round (6 turns). This bonus ends immediately if you take damage, are incapacitated, or use this ability again before the duration expires.

midlands_mechanical_core.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Core is designed to be accessible to low-level adventurers who can still benefit from its combat prowess without overtaxing their health.
midlands_mechanical_core.vendorReason: Midlands, being the original source of this artifact’s origin story, continues to sell it as a nod to its industrial heritage and the tales of brave souls who have faced the factory's final breath.
midlands_mechanical_core.shippingDetail: The core is shipped under heavy guard due to its volatile nature; it arrives with a courier who can handle emergencies if needed.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until you make an attack or the end of your next turn (whichever comes first)
usage.endsWhen: You take damage, are incapacitated, or use this ability again before the duration expires

midlands_mechanical_core.priceReason: The Iron Core is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare material composition and the unique benefits it offers without being overly game-breaking.

midlands_mechanical_essence.name: Forgeblood Essence
midlands_mechanical_essence.description: Forgeblood Essence is a volatile liquid extracted from the core of a war machine, distilled in the smoky forges of Midland. When applied to your armor or weapon, it carves out a mechanical resonance that enhances its resilience and combat prowess. Applied once per day, this essence grants +25% damage on melee attacks and reduces magic resistance by 15%. It can be used on up to three items simultaneously, each with a single application.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Melee Damage
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases the damage of melee attacks by +25% for one day. The effect ends if you apply more Forgeblood Essence to another item or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Magic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Reduces magic resistance by 15%. This effect lasts until the next dawn and ceases upon application of more Forgeblood Essence to other items, or if you apply it again on the same item within a day.

midlands_mechanical_essence.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Athletics due to the physical nature of applying the essence.
midlands_mechanical_essence.vendorReason: Midland is known for its mastery over mechanical and magical devices, making it a fitting vendor for this item.
midlands_mechanical_essence.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay with expedited delivery within one week.

usage.activation: Bonus action to apply the essence.
usage.duration: One day per application.
usage.endsWhen: Another application of Forgeblood Essence or dawn, whichever comes first.

midlands_mechanical_essence.priceReason: Balanced with a lower price to reflect its balanced effects and limited daily use.

midlands_mechanical_glove.name: Iron Gauntlet of the Blacksmith
midlands_mechanical_glove.description: The Iron Gauntlet of the Blacksmith is a formidable relic forged from steel and enchanted iron ore. Its weighty form channels the very essence of fire and earth, enhancing the wearer’s strength and resilience in melee combat. With each strike, it can rend enchanted armor with ease, leaving a trail of shattered defense behind. The gauntlet grants +30% damage to melee attacks and increases the chance of breaking enchanted armor by 20%, but only when wielded by one who knows the rhythm of fire and hammer.

effectDetails.title: Iron Surge
effectDetails.rules: When a melee attack shatters enchanted armor, the wearer gains a temporary boost to movement speed and attack speed for 1 minute. This effect can only activate once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Durability
effectDetails.rules: The gauntlet reduces the damage taken from non-magical melee attacks by half, up to +20 hit points of reduction, but this effect is not cumulative with other similar abilities. This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn.

midlands_mechanical_glove.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet's elemental magic requires a basic understanding of forgecraft and fire.
midlands_mechanical_glove.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its blacksmiths, who are known to craft items that embody the very essence of their trade.
midlands_mechanical_glove.shippingDetail: The gauntlet is shipped via the Void Drifter Relay, a service known for its punctuality and secure deliveries through the Astral Plane.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation with a melee attack.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or until broken enchanted armor is shattered by an attack.
usage.endsWhen: The gauntlet's enchantment is broken, requiring reforge to restore its capabilities.

midlands_mechanical_glove.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and infused with elemental magic, the gauntlet remains a valuable asset for any blacksmith or combatant.

midlands_mechanical_greaves.name: Gearbound Greaves of the Ironclad
midlands_mechanical_greaves.description: The Gearbound Greaves of the Ironclad are reinforced with interlocking cogs and pistons, their steel plates shimmering with a mechanical sheen. Crafted in the forges of Midlands, these greaves grant the wearer superhuman strength while carrying heavy loads, allowing every step to be a forceful push against the earth's resistance. They also amplify the wearer's resilience to crushing terrain, reducing damage by 25% and enhancing their endurance during strenuous tasks.
effects: +30% movement speed while carrying heavy loads

effectDetails.title: +30% Movement Speed While Carrying Heavy Loads
effectDetails.rules: While the greaves are worn, the wearer gains +30% to their movement speed when carrying a heavy load. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Amplify Resilience To Crushing Terrain
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is struck by an area of difficult terrain or crushing damage, they gain +25% damage reduction for 1 minute. This effect can occur once per long rest and does not stack with other forms of damage reduction.

midlands_mechanical_greaves.levelRequirementReason: The greaves require a minimum level to ensure the wearer has sufficient strength and resilience.
midlands_mechanical_greaves.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its industrial innovations, making these greaves a perfect fit in their inventory.
midlands_mechanical_greaves.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay, known for their reliable and fast deliveries.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (once per long rest)
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon the completion of a long rest or if removed from wear

midlands_mechanical_greaves.priceReason: The greaves are crafted with rare materials and advanced Midlands engineering, justifying their fair value.

midlands_mechanical_heart.name: Iron Heart of the Forge
midlands_mechanical_heart.description: The Iron Heart of the Forge pulses with the relentless rhythm of industrial strength, forged from the bones of a dying steam engine in the heart of an iron mill. This mechanical marvel grants the wearer temporary resistance to mechanical traps and enhances their resilience against mechanical foes, syncing its beats with the clatter of machinery. When struck by metal or gears, it amplifies the blow's impact, dealing additional damage while providing a regenerative boost as you move.
