effects: +15% chance to trigger ‘Gear Up’ on hit (temporary bonus damage)

effectDetails.title: Gear Up
effectDetails.rules: On a successful melee attack against a mechanical enemy, the wearer gains +10 temporary hit points for 1 minute. This effect can be triggered once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Trap Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has advantage on saving throws against mechanical traps for 1 hour after wearing this item. This benefit ends when they remove the item or if they take damage.

midlands_mechanical_heart.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency with heavy armor to fully utilize its protective and offensive capabilities.
midlands_mechanical_heart.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their mastery of industrial craftsmanship, are the perfect purveyors of this mechanical marvel.
midlands_mechanical_heart.shippingDetail: Delivered by Shy Guy Smugglers with a 1-day express service, ensuring you receive your gear in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the item.
usage.duration: Until removed or until its temporary hit points are exhausted.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes the item or takes damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

midlands_mechanical_heart.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique combination of offensive and defensive capabilities within the realm's economic structure.

midlands_mechanical_heart_of_shadeward.name: Mechanical Heart of Shadeward
midlands_mechanical_heart_of_shadeward.description: The Mechanical Heart of Shadeward is a rusted cogwork nestled within an iron heart. Crafted in the shadowy depths of Shadeward Estate, it hums with a life of its own. When equipped, this relic grants immunity to fire and poison damage, while also allowing the wielder to repair machinery for 30 seconds, restoring 10% of their hit points per second during that time. The heart's gears click as it ensures your survival in treacherous environments and enhances mechanical dexterity.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fire and Poison
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides immunity to fire and poison damage for the duration of one short rest or until removed by a dispel magic. The wearer must be equipped with the Mechanical Heart of Shadeward.

effectDetails.title: Machinery Repair
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action, this effect allows the wielder to repair machinery for 30 seconds, restoring their hit points at a rate of 10% per second. This effect can be used once per long rest.

midlands_mechanical_heart_of_shadeward.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and power of the Mechanical Heart of Shadeward necessitate a higher level to ensure proper control.
midlands_mechanical_heart_of_shadeward.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their extensive trade with the ancient sites, making it no surprise they sell this relic from Shadeward Estate.
midlands_mechanical_heart_of_shadeward.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, the Mechanical Heart of Shadeward requires special handling and is shipped via Koopa Postal's express courier service.

usage.duration: 30 seconds or until used up
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the time expires or if the user drops or removes it from their person.

midlands_mechanical_heart_of_shadeward.priceReason: The Mechanical Heart of Shadeward is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the complexity of its craftsmanship.

midlands_mechanical_helm.name: Steel Crown of the Iron Throne
midlands_mechanical_helm.description: The Steel Crown of the Iron Throne, a helm forged from the molten remains of an ancient war machine, whispers tales of valor and resilience to its wearer. Its tempered steel glows faintly in battle, deflecting enemy blows with a strength that seems almost divine. This helm not only grants tactical advantage in siege and melee combat but also protects against environmental hazards, allowing the wearer to shrug off the harshness of war with unyielding resolve.
effects: +25% defense against melee and ranged attacks
Reduces fatigue during combat by 20% for 10 seconds

effectDetails.title: Iron Resolve
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is reduced to half their hit points, they can use a bonus action to gain temporary hit points equal to 5 + their level. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Resilience
effectDetails.rules: The helm provides a +10% chance to resist environmental damage such as fire, water, ice, or poison. This effect is active as long as the helm is worn in battle.

midlands_mechanical_helm.levelRequirementReason: The helm's intricate design and magical properties require a user with at least 5th level to wield it effectively.
midlands_mechanical_helm.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their craftsmanship and mastery of ancient artifacts, is the only place where such a legendary helm can be found.
midlands_mechanical_helm.shippingDetail: The helm arrives via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring it reaches its destination in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Iron Resolve; always active for Environmental Resilience
usage.duration: 10 seconds for Iron Resolve; lasts until end of turn for Environmental Resilience
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn after using Iron Resolve; when removed or damaged
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a short rest

midlands_mechanical_helm.priceReason: The helm's unique properties and historical significance justify its high price.

midlands_mechanical_helmet.name: Steel Cowl of the Iron Fist
midlands_mechanical_helmet.description: The Steel Cowl of the Iron Fist is a helmet forged from scrap iron and reinforced with solid steel. This midland masterpiece not only grants the wearer an unparalleled ability to punch through weak armor but also shatters enemy joints with unnerving ease, leaving foes incapacitated in their own blood. Crafted by the hands of skilled blacksmiths, it reduces the effectiveness of armor against melee attacks by 20%, making every strike feel like a hammer blow.

effectDetails.title: Armor Piercing
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with a melee attack, reduce their armor's effectiveness by 20% for the duration of the fight. This effect does not stack.

effectDetails.title: Joint Shattering
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can attempt to break an enemy's joint with a successful melee attack. On a success, the target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be incapacitated until their next turn.

midlands_mechanical_helmet.levelRequirementReason: The intricate forging and balance required for this helmet demand at least 3rd level proficiency in fighting techniques.
midlands_mechanical_helmet.vendorReason: Midland's blacksmiths are renowned for their ability to craft such finely tuned combat gear, ensuring it meets the highest standards of performance and durability.
midlands_mechanical_helmet.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu drones, this helmet arrives in pristine condition directly from the forge.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate joint shattering; melee attack for armor piercing effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, armor piercing lasts until end of fight.
usage.endsWhen: Charges exhausted or armor pierce ends at fight's conclusion.

midlands_mechanical_helmet.priceReason: Balanced against the helmet's unique and powerful effects, this price ensures it remains a valuable but not overpowered addition to any character's arsenal.

midlands_mechanical_hoof_of_the_gear_gho.name: Mechanical Hoof of the Gear Ghoul
midlands_mechanical_hoof_of_the_gear_gho.description: The Mechanical Hoof of the Gear Ghoul is a relic forged from the forgotten gearworks of the Iron Ward, now bound to the leg of its wearer. Its intricate cogs and gears hum with latent power as it grants the rider unparalleled speed and control over mechanized mounts. When activated, it triggers nearby factory explosions that deal devastating damage to enemies in close proximity, leaving a trail of fiery destruction behind.

effectDetails.title: Ride Mechanized Beast
effectDetails.rules: When the rider activates the Mechanical Hoof, they gain the ability to mount and control a mechanical beast. This allows for short-range travel at +15% movement speed while mounted. The effect lasts until the rider dismounts or falls from the mount.

effectDetails.title: Trigger Factory Explosions
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can trigger a nearby factory explosion that deals 200 fire damage to all creatures within 15 feet of them. This effect has a cooldown of one minute and requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to successfully locate an appropriate target.

midlands_mechanical_hoof_of_the_gear_gho.levelRequirementReason: Wielders must be at least level 6 to harness the latent power within the Mechanical Hoof.
midlands_mechanical_hoof_of_the_gear_gho.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their mastery of mechanical engineering, making it fitting that this relic is sold there.
midlands_mechanical_hoof_of_the_gear_gho.shippingDetail: Delivered via a specially modified airship that can transport the delicate device safely and swiftly to its buyer.

usage.activation: Bonus action to mount or dismount, and as a bonus action to trigger explosions.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each effect.
usage.endsWhen: The rider dismounts or falls from the mount; explosion's cooldown ends after one minute.

midlands_mechanical_hoof_of_the_gear_gho.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare craftsmanship and powerful abilities.

midlands_mechanical_iron_bell.name: Mechanical Iron Bell
midlands_mechanical_iron_bell.description: Forged in the heart of the Midlands' forges, this Mechanical Iron Bell is a marvel of engineering and iron will. Its resonant tones command the attention of even the most steadfast warriors, causing nearby foes to stagger and falter. Crafted from slag and bellows, its robust frame withstands the fury of battle without yielding. With each toll, you risk 10% damage but harness the power of the forgeheart, rallying your allies in a surge of strength.

effectDetails.title: Forgeheart Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When you strike the bell, nearby enemies within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone for 1 round. You take 1d6+2 damage per toll.

effectDetails.title: Staggering Toll
effectDetails.rules: Each time you toll the bell, you and your allies within 30 feet gain advantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn. However, you must endure a -10% damage penalty for each toll.

midlands_mechanical_iron_bell.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant strength and dexterity to wield effectively in battle.
midlands_mechanical_iron_bell.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their mechanical ingenuity and this bell is a prime example of their craftsmanship.
midlands_mechanical_iron_bell.shippingDetail: Due to its size, the Mechanical Iron Bell must be shipped via Koopa Postal's oversized cargo service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next turn or until you toll it again
usage.endsWhen: You toll the bell again, or you take a long rest

midlands_mechanical_iron_bell.priceReason: The bell's rare materials and intricate design justify its price.

midlands_mechanical_iron_belt.name: Iron Grit Belt
midlands_mechanical_iron_belt.description: The Iron Grit Belt is a robust belt forged from industrial steel, adorned with sigils of the Iron Legion. This battle-worn harness not only provides heavy armor benefits but also slows down your foes' attacks, making it invaluable for grinding through the Midlands’ smelting halls. Its etched design ensures durability and resilience, enhancing your defense while reducing enemy attack speed by 20%. It’s a trusted companion for any adventurer seeking to master the art of survival in Midland's treacherous landscapes.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Defense (+20% Armor)
effectDetails.rules: The Iron Grit Belt provides a +20% bonus to your armor class. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Slowed Attacks (-20% Enemy Attack Speed)
effectDetails.rules: Enemies adjacent to you have their attack speed reduced by 20%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn, and it ends if you leave a 5-foot square where an enemy is located.

midlands_mechanical_iron_belt.levelRequirementReason: The belt's design allows even novice adventurers to benefit from its protective properties.
midlands_mechanical_iron_belt.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their robust and practical gear, making the Iron Grit Belt a staple in local shops.
midlands_mechanical_iron_belt.shippingDetail: Ships within one week via reliable courier services.

usage.duration: Instantaneous upon donning, until removed or the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Leaving a square adjacent to an enemy or removing the belt

midlands_mechanical_iron_belt.priceReason: The Iron Grit Belt offers significant benefits for adventurers, making it a fair and balanced purchase.

midlands_mechanical_iron_heart.name: Mechanical Iron Heart
midlands_mechanical_iron_heart.description: The Mechanical Iron Heart hums like a well-tuned engine, its gears ticking with the rhythm of unyielding determination. When activated in the dim light of the Midlands’ forges, it amplifies your physical prowess and resilience, making you a master of steel and fire. This pulsating core not only boosts your strength by 150% but also grants ‘Iron Resolve’, reducing fatigue by 30% after 30 seconds of combat, ensuring you never falter in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Iron Resolve
effectDetails.rules: After 30 seconds of combat, this effect reduces your fatigue by 30%. This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: +150% Strength
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The effect lasts for 1 minute and can be renewed on your next turn.

midlands_mechanical_iron_heart.levelRequirementReason: This core requires the user to have reached at least third level in order to wield its power effectively.
midlands_mechanical_iron_heart.vendorReason: The Midlands’ forges are renowned for crafting such powerful and essential tools, and no blacksmith would dare sell this item outside their region.
midlands_mechanical_iron_heart.shippingDetail: Delivered via a secret courier route that ensures the Mechanical Iron Heart reaches its destination without attracting unwanted attention.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, and can be renewed on your next turn.
usage.duration: 1 minute per activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish a short or long rest, or if the item is destroyed.

midlands_mechanical_iron_heart.priceReason: This rare and powerful core reflects its value in the Midlands’ forges, making it worth the substantial XP cost.

midlands_mechanical_legs.name: Iron Leggings of the Iron Legion
midlands_mechanical_legs.description: The Iron Leggings of the Iron Legion are forged from ancient, enchanted steel, once worn by the elite warriors of the Iron Legion. These reinforced legs grant unparalleled mobility and resilience to their wearer, allowing them to traverse treacherous terrain with ease and endure the brutal impacts of battle. Wielders experience a 25% increase in movement speed on flat surfaces and a 15% chance to dodge enemy attacks, making them a true testament to the unyielding spirit of the Iron Legion.

effectDetails.title: Iron Tread
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these leggings, you have resistance to damage from ground-based attacks. This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Battle Readiness
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, you can activate a special property called 'Iron Tread' by making a successful DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. If you succeed, you gain resistance to damage from ground-based attacks for the duration of one battle.

midlands_mechanical_legs.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Leggings require at least level 5 to wear due to their complexity and enchanted nature.
midlands_mechanical_legs.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its mastery in ancient industrial magic, making these leggings a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_mechanical_legs.shippingDetail: These items are delivered via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring secure and swift transportation directly from the forge.

usage.activation: Once per short or long rest, you can activate 'Iron Tread' by making a successful DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn
usage.charges: One use per short or long rest

midlands_mechanical_legs.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and the expertise required to craft such enchanted armor.

midlands_mechanical_mage_rod.name: Gear of the Iron Oracle
midlands_mechanical_mage_rod.description: The Gear of the Iron Oracle is a cursed artifact forged from the bones of a forgotten war machine and the mind of a fallen mage. Its cold, steel body hums with necromantic energy, capable of channeling death into mechanical constructs. When wielded, it grants control over iron golems and enhances the user's strikes against machines by 10%, but at a cost: every use saps a fraction of its own vitality, causing it to gain +20% armor until the next turn.
effects: Summons ghostly iron golem for 1 round

effectDetails.title: Summon Iron Golem
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you may summon a ghostly iron golem that lasts for 1 round. The golem can move and attack on your turn as part of your action. If the golem takes damage or if its hit points drop to 0, it dissipates immediately.

effectDetails.title: Armor Boost
effectDetails.rules: When damaged by a critical hit or reduced to less than half its maximum hit points, the gear gains +20% armor until the start of your next turn. This effect can only activate once per long rest.

midlands_mechanical_mage_rod.levelRequirementReason: To wield this cursed artifact, you must have the discipline and strength to control its malevolent power.
midlands_mechanical_mage_rod.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their dark artifacts and relics, and this cursed gear fits well within that tradition.
midlands_mechanical_mage_rod.shippingDetail: This item is delivered with a spectral courier who ensures the artifact arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon golem; can only be used once per long rest due to armor boost effect.
usage.duration: Summoned golem lasts for 1 round. Armor boost lasts until start of next turn.
usage.endsWhen: Golem dissipates on damage or at the end of its turn; armor boost ends when the gear regains hit points or at the start of your next turn.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one summon per long rest.

midlands_mechanical_mage_rod.priceReason: The Gear of the Iron Oracle is a rare and dangerous artifact, balancing its power with a moderate price to ensure it remains within reach for capable adventurers.

midlands_mechanical_ointment.name: Mechanical Ointment of the Iron Hand
midlands_mechanical_ointment.description: The Mechanical Ointment of the Iron Hand is a thick, gear-imbued salve that clings to metal surfaces like a second skin. Applied to weapons or armor, it not only grants temporary resistance against magical disintegration but also sharpens reflexes in moments of crisis. This salve was crafted by the industrious folk of Midlands using ancient alchemical secrets and modern forge techniques, making it both potent and reliable in times of need.

effectDetails.title: Disintegration Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When applied to a weapon or armor, this salve reduces the magical disintegration damage by 40% for 1 minute. The effect ends if the item is removed from contact with the salve.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: For 30 seconds after application, the user gains +5 to their AC. This enhancement lasts until the start of your next turn or until you take an action on your turn.

midlands_mechanical_ointment.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and those who need immediate combat readiness without a steep level requirement.
midlands_mechanical_ointment.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its innovative alchemical creations that blend ancient lore with modern techniques, making this salve one of their most popular items.
midlands_mechanical_ointment.shippingDetail: Delivered within 3 days via Pipe Express's reliable couriers.

usage.activation: Apply as a bonus action to a weapon or piece of armor.
usage.duration: 1 minute for disintegration resistance, 30 seconds for enhanced reflexes.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the salve is no longer in contact with the item.

midlands_mechanical_ointment.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's potent magical properties and its utility for beginners without being overpowered.

midlands_mechanical_satchel.name: The Gears of the Unseen
midlands_mechanical_satchel.description: The Gears of the Unseen is a satchel crafted from salvaged metal and leather from the Iron Legion’s abandoned factories. It houses an assortment of tools, including a hidden cogwheel that can be inserted into any lock—no matter how resilient the steel. This arcane device grants you a 20% chance to find concealed gear in locked chests and allows for the repair or upgrade of any gear item, provided it is at least 75% condition.

effectDetails.title: Locate Concealed Gear
effectDetails.rules: When you attempt to find a hidden mechanism in a locked chest, roll a D20. On a result of 15 or higher, you successfully locate it.

effectDetails.title: Repair/Upgrade Gear
effectDetails.rules: You may use the satchel to repair or upgrade any gear item with at least 75% condition. This action requires an hour and expends one charge from the satchel. The repaired item gains +1d4 additional hit points, but not above its maximum capacity.

midlands_mechanical_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The Gears of the Unseen is designed for beginners to use basic lockpicking and gear repair techniques.
midlands_mechanical_satchel.vendorReason: Midlands specializes in salvaged goods and tools, making The Gears of the Unseen a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_mechanical_satchel.shippingDetail: Standard delivery with Koopa Postal, arriving within one week.

usage.activation: As an action or bonus action (your choice)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for locating gear; one hour to repair/upgrade gear
usage.endsWhen: The satchel is empty of charges or destroyed in combat
usage.charges: 5 uses, recharges after a long rest

midlands_mechanical_satchel.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's utility without being game-breaking.

midlands_mechanical_soul.name: The Soul of the Iron Maw
midlands_mechanical_soul.description: The Soul of the Iron Maw is a mechanical soul crafted from the central forge of Aegis Command, pulsing with the fiery essence of industrial might. When donned, it resonates with the fury of forges, allowing its wielder to deliver devastating blows that tear through armor like hot metal through cold steel. Its wearer gains an uncanny knack for exploiting enemy defenses, enhancing critical hits against armored foes and triggering mechanical overloads with alarming frequency.
effects: +50% critical hit chance against armored targets
Trigger mechanical overload on critical hits

effectDetails.title: Critical Overload
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer scores a critical hit against an armored target, they have advantage on their next attack roll. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Armor Piercing
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +50% bonus to critical hit chance against armored targets and deals +15% additional damage on critical hits.

midlands_mechanical_soul.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 3 to wield effectively, ensuring that the item's power is balanced with player growth.
midlands_mechanical_soul.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for their expertise in mechanical and industrial items, making them the perfect vendor for this unique artifact.
midlands_mechanical_soul.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay with a standard delivery time of 7 days.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon donning; no further action required.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after scoring a critical hit against an armored target.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer scores another critical hit or until their next turn.

midlands_mechanical_soul.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's powerful effects without overshadowing other gear options.

midlands_mechanical_soul_cloth.name: Steelheart Garment
midlands_mechanical_soul_cloth.description: The Steelheart Garment is a heavy, woven fabric of recycled steel and iron thread, imbued with the soul of a forgotten automaton. This vestment feels alive as it clings to your form, its metallic threads humming with latent energy. Wearing this garment grants you resilience and mechanical prowess; it seems to anticipate danger, reinforcing your defenses when you need them most. The fabric whispers the secrets of past gears and pistons, lending you a +15% bonus to defense against mechanical damage and a 10% chance to resist being disabled by machinery.
effects: 10% resistance to disable effects from mechanics

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Resilience
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Steelheart Garment, you gain a +15% bonus to your AC when dealing with mechanical attacks or damage. This effect is always active as long as you are in contact with the garment.

effectDetails.title: Machinery Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You have a 10% chance to resist being disabled by any machinery that attempts to disable you, such as traps or automated devices. This effect applies once per long rest.

midlands_mechanical_soul_cloth.levelRequirementReason: The Steelheart Garment's intricate design and the soul of a forgotten automaton require a proficient character with at least 5 levels in any class to properly harness its power.
midlands_mechanical_soul_cloth.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their craftsmanship and recycling efforts, are the perfect purveyors of this unique item, blending ancient technology with modern ingenuity.
midlands_mechanical_soul_cloth.shippingDetail: The Steelheart Garment is carefully packed in a specialized crate to ensure it arrives intact. The courier promises safe handling but cannot guarantee against mechanical mishaps during transit.

usage.activation: Passive effect, always active as long as the garment is worn.
usage.duration: Permanent until removed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: The garment is removed from your body or it is destroyed.

midlands_mechanical_soul_cloth.priceReason: The Steelheart Garment's unique construction and the spirit of a forgotten automaton make it a rare find, balancing its power with an appropriate XP cost.

midlands_mechanical_soul_core.name: Mechanical Soul Core
midlands_mechanical_soul_core.description: The Mechanical Soul Core is a pulsating crystal core embedded with intricate gears and slag. When worn, it synchronizes with your heartbeat, amplifying your physical endurance and combat focus. It hums in rhythm with your pulse, providing a steady boost when you need it most. This forge-made core enhances melee attacks with the precision of a finely tuned machine, increasing critical strike chances and allowing for an extra action per turn up to three times.

effectDetails.title: Critical Strike Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack, there is a +10% chance to score a critical hit. This effect does not stack with other sources of critical chance.

effectDetails.title: Extra Action
effectDetails.rules: You can take an additional action per turn up to three times while wearing the Mechanical Soul Core. After using this ability, you must finish a short or long rest before using it again.

midlands_mechanical_soul_core.levelRequirementReason: The core's intricate design and advanced mechanisms require a certain level of mastery to wield effectively.
midlands_mechanical_soul_core.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its expertise in crafting durable, functional equipment that enhances physical prowess.
midlands_mechanical_soul_core.shippingDetail: The item arrives fully charged and ready for use. However, it requires a special handling protocol to maintain its integrity during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous per action or extra turn usage.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after three uses; requires rest to recharge.

midlands_mechanical_soul_core.priceReason: The Mechanical Soul Core is priced at 1000 XP as its advanced design and forge-made craftsmanship make it a valuable asset for combat.

midlands_mechanical_talisman.name: The Gear of the Crimson Mechanist
midlands_mechanical_talisman.description: The Gear of the Crimson Mechanist is a cursed talisman, its gears and cogs forged from the twisted remnants of the Iron Legion's forgotten clockwork engineers. When donned, it pulses with mechanical energy, granting the wielder the arcane ability to disrupt machinery and armor, causing minor structural damage to foes. The wearer must heed this talisman’s wrath, for each use saps their vitality, draining 10% of their stamina over time.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Gear Lock
effectDetails.rules: The wielder may attempt a concentration check (DC 15) to cause an enemy's machinery or armor to malfunction for 3 turns. If successful, the target suffers a -2 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Each activation drains 10% of the user’s stamina. The item can be used once per long rest, ensuring the wielder conserves their strength.

midlands_mechanical_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The Gear of the Crimson Mechanist requires a minimum level to harness its mechanical and arcane energies.
midlands_mechanical_talisman.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their deep lore on ancient artifacts, is the only vendor capable of providing this cursed relic.
midlands_mechanical_talisman.shippingDetail: The Gear arrives under a cloak of darkness and shadow, ensuring it reaches its destination without attracting unwanted attention.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the target completes their next turn or is successfully dispelled by any means.

midlands_mechanical_talisman.priceReason: The Gear of the Crimson Mechanist requires a significant amount of XP due to its cursed nature and unique effects.

midlands_mechanical_tongue.name: Geargrind Tongue
midlands_mechanical_tongue.description: The Geargrind Tongue is a rusted iron tongue shaped like a complex gear, its teeth etched with ancient runes of the forge. When whispered to, it emits a low hum that resonates within mechanical hearts, whispering secrets of the blacksmiths' craft. Upon activation, this enchanted tongue grants temporary immunity to mind control and enhances mechanical skill checks by 10%. The whispers of the Geargrind Tongue are said to come from the very forge spirits themselves, lending it a rare and coveted status among artisans.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mechanical Skills
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Geargrind Tongue grants a +10% bonus to mechanical skill checks for 1 hour. The effect ends if the user's next mechanical skill check fails or if they rest for more than 8 hours.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Mind Control
effectDetails.rules: The Geargrind Tongue grants temporary immunity to all mind control and compulsion effects for a duration of 1 hour. This effect ends when the user's next action is taken or if they are subjected to another mind control effect.

midlands_mechanical_tongue.levelRequirementReason: The Geargrind Tongue requires no level as its mystical resonance can be felt by even the most novice artisan.
midlands_mechanical_tongue.vendorReason: Midlands, a haven for artisans and blacksmiths, is known to stock rare tools of the trade like the Geargrind Tongue.
midlands_mechanical_tongue.shippingDetail: The Boo Spectral Mail ensures swift delivery but may cause mild fright upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Next mechanical skill check fails or the user rests for more than 8 hours, subjected to another mind control effect, or their next action is taken

midlands_mechanical_tongue.priceReason: The Geargrind Tongue's price reflects its rare crafting materials and the mystical enchantments that imbue it with its unique properties.

midlands_mechanical_torch.name: Iron Tongue Torch
midlands_mechanical_torch.description: The Iron Tongue Torch is a forge-bred lantern whose flame dances with the fury of a broken gear and the heat of a steel forge. Its light pierces through shadows, revealing hidden mechanisms and trap triggers within a 30-foot radius, making it an invaluable tool for explorers and engineers alike. This torch not only illuminates but also tempers the strength of mechanical foes by dealing 30% bonus damage to them.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: When used, this torch deals an additional 30% damage to mechanical enemies. The effect lasts until the end of the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Revealing Light
effectDetails.rules: This torch illuminates a 30-foot radius, revealing hidden mechanisms and trap triggers within its range. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action to activate.

midlands_mechanical_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Tongue Torch's basic functionality makes it accessible to players of any level.
midlands_mechanical_torch.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their expertise in mechanical devices and engineering, naturally stocks this versatile tool.
midlands_mechanical_torch.shippingDetail: Delivered via Lakitu Drone within a day, ensuring timely arrival of this essential item.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use; no action required for the initial activation or duration.
usage.duration: Until the end of the next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The torch's effect ends at the start of your next long rest.

midlands_mechanical_torch.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant advantage in combat and exploration without being overpowered.

midlands_mechanical_tunic.name: Gears of the Iron Throne
midlands_mechanical_tunic.description: The Gears of the Iron Throne is a segmented tunic encased in rusted cogwork and hydraulic pistons. This tunic hums with mechanical energy, its gears grinding as you move. Worn by the keepers of heavy burdens, it grants +15% damage reduction from blunt or crushing attacks and enhances your movement speed while carrying heavy items by 10%. When struck in combat, there's a 20% chance that the next attack made against the wearer will deal an additional 1d6 damage.

effectDetails.title: Gear Rumble
effectDetails.rules: When struck in melee combat, there is a 20% chance that the next attack made against the wearer will deal an additional 1d6 damage. This effect can only occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: While carrying heavy items (objects weighing over 50 pounds), your speed increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. This effect is passive and does not require an action to activate.

midlands_mechanical_tunic.levelRequirementReason: The Gears of the Iron Throne are suitable for all adventurers, as they provide immediate assistance in heavy labor.
midlands_mechanical_tunic.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its robust and durable equipment, making them a reliable vendor for such a resilient item.
midlands_mechanical_tunic.shippingDetail: Ships via the ghostly courier, ensuring swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Passive effect; does not require an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing while carrying heavy items.
usage.endsWhen: Rests or when struck in combat (Gear Rumble only).

midlands_mechanical_tunic.priceReason: The Gears of the Iron Throne strike a balance, providing immediate utility and resilience without overpowered effects.

midlands_mechanized_bow.name: Mechanized Bow of the Forge
midlands_mechanized_bow.description: The Mechanized Bow of the Forge is a marvel of medieval engineering. Its iron gears hum with steam, and each shot fires molten steel bolts that can pierce through three enemy units in one go. When wielded near an iron structure, its reload time drops by nearly half, allowing for rapid fire against fortified positions. Allies within 30 meters gain temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt by a successful shot.

effectDetails.title: Molten Steel Bolts
effectDetails.rules: When used, this bow fires a bolt of molten steel that pierces up to three enemy units at once. It deals damage equal to 1d8 + the wielder's Strength modifier when hitting an enemy. Allies within a 30-foot radius gain temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt (rounded down). This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Swift Reload Near Iron
effectDetails.rules: While near an iron structure, this bow's reload time is reduced by 40%. To qualify as 'near,' the wielder must be within 15 feet of the structure. This benefit lasts for the duration of a short rest and can only be used once per day.

midlands_mechanized_bow.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in ranged weapons to effectively use this bow's powerful shots.
midlands_mechanized_bow.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its expertise in siege weaponry, and the Mechanized Bow of the Forge is a prime example of their craftsmanship.
midlands_mechanized_bow.shippingDetail: The bow requires special handling due to its delicate gears. It arrives fully assembled but must be checked by a blacksmith upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: After use or when the wielder moves more than 15 feet away from an iron structure (if applicable)
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one shot per short rest

midlands_mechanized_bow.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its rare and powerful nature while staying within the realm of reasonable value for a siege weapon.

midlands_mechanized_gloves.name: Mechanized Gloves of the Iron Hand
midlands_mechanized_gloves.description: The Mechanized Gloves of the Iron Hand are grafted with piston-driven gauntlets, imbued with the relentless fury of a forgeheart core. These gloves allow the wearer to smash through steel doors with ease and crush enemy limbs in rhythmic mechanical fury. Each strike echoes like a factory bell, its clatter resonating through metal and flesh alike. The wearer's strikes are not just physical; they carry the weight of industrial might.

effectDetails.title: Cranky Crush
effectDetails.rules: Each hit has a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 seconds and deal an additional 30% damage. This effect has a cooldown of 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Steel Door Smasher
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains the ability to break through steel doors with ease, as if they were made of wood. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be used once per day.

midlands_mechanized_gloves.levelRequirementReason: Wielding these gloves requires a strong grasp of mechanics and brute strength.
midlands_mechanized_gloves.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their mastery of mechanical devices, making them the perfect vendor for such powerful yet intricate items.
midlands_mechanized_gloves.shippingDetail: Delivered by Boo Spectral Mail, these gloves arrive with a whisper and a creak, ensuring they reach their destination in one piece.

usage.duration: Until used or the effect ends naturally
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target is stunned, after 1 minute of Cranky Crush cooldown, or at midnight on a new day.

midlands_mechanized_gloves.priceReason: Balanced against other rare items, this glove set combines offensive prowess with unique utility features.

midlands_mechanized_greaves.name: Mechanized Greaves
midlands_mechanized_greaves.description: The Mechanized Greaves are reinforced with steel and slag, their joints gleaming like molten metal under moonlight. Crafted in the heart of Midlands by blacksmiths who have forged legends, these greaves not only increase resilience against crushing damage but also grant a fleeting boost to speed when activated. Legends say that wearing them brings a warrior closer to the forge’s spirit, making their steps as light and sure as the wind.

effectDetails.title: Resilience Against Crushing
effectDetails.rules: Activates when worn. The wearer gains a +40% bonus to AC against crushing damage for the duration of one short rest or until the greaves are removed.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mobility
effectDetails.rules: When activated, allows the wearer to gain a +5 movement speed for 3 seconds. This effect can be used once per long rest and is expended after use.

midlands_mechanized_greaves.levelRequirementReason: These greaves are crafted with intricate but not overly complex magic, making them accessible to any capable warrior.
midlands_mechanized_greaves.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for its unmatched craftsmanship and the Mechanized Greaves embody this heritage perfectly.
midlands_mechanized_greaves.shippingDetail: Pipe Express ensures swift delivery with their reliable service, guaranteeing timely arrival of these valuable greaves.

usage.duration: Lasts for the duration of one short rest or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after a long rest or when removed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but can only be used once per long rest.

midlands_mechanized_greaves.priceReason: The Mechanized Greaves are priced at 1000 XP due to their rare materials and the craftsmanship required for their intricate design.

midlands_mechanized_heart.name: Mechanized Heart
midlands_mechanized_heart.description: The MechHeart, a pulsing iron core from the Legion’s first forge, grants a steady mechanical pulse that bolsters endurance and resilience. Its ticking heart is said to echo the last scream of a forgotten war machine, resonating with the very essence of its creator's might. Worn as an amulet, it provides a +20% stamina regeneration bonus, bolstering your body’s recovery from fatigue. The core also offers +15% armor penetration, ensuring that even the most resilient foes feel the full force of your attacks.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Regeneration Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the MechHeart, you gain a +20% bonus to your stamina regeneration. This effect is passive and does not require any action from you.

effectDetails.title: Armor Penetration
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with a weapon while wearing the MechHeart, you gain a +15% chance to ignore an equal amount of enemy armor class as if it were reduced by 15. This effect is active and lasts until your next long rest.

midlands_mechanized_heart.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the MechHeart's mechanism requires a minimum character level to properly harness its power.
midlands_mechanized_heart.vendorReason: Midlands are renowned for their deep understanding of mechanical and historical artifacts, making them the perfect vendor for such an item.
midlands_mechanized_heart.shippingDetail: The Shy Guys promise safe delivery within a week, but they do not provide tracking or insurance for this high-risk shipment.

usage.duration: Until your next long rest
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next long rest

midlands_mechanized_heart.priceReason: The MechHeart's balanced price reflects its unique combination of stamina regeneration and armor penetration, providing a significant but not overpowered advantage to players.

midlands_mechanized_helm.name: Mechanized Helm
midlands_mechanized_helm.description: The Mechanized Helm is a helm forged from the last remnants of a war machine's skull. It grants you enhanced armor and a mechanical sense of direction. The visor glows with the Legion’s old code, whispering the names of the fallen as it channels the spirit of the battlefield. This helm not only boosts your defenses but also heightens your awareness in combat, making you less likely to be caught off guard.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Armor
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +30% bonus to AC. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Sense of Direction
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this helm, you have advantage on saving throws against being disoriented or confused by environmental effects. This lasts until the start of your next turn after the helm is removed.

midlands_mechanized_helm.levelRequirementReason: The helm's complex mechanisms require a basic understanding of mechanical systems.
midlands_mechanized_helm.vendorReason: Midlands sells relics and artifacts from their region, including this helm’s unique war machine origins.
midlands_mechanized_helm.shippingDetail: The helm is fragile and may take an additional day for special handling during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until the start of your next turn after removal
usage.endsWhen: The helm is removed from your head

midlands_mechanized_helm.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item with unique passive abilities and historical significance.

midlands_mechanized_helmet.name: Mechanized Helm of the Iron Crown
midlands_mechanized_helmet.description: The Mechanized Helm of the Iron Crown hums with the relentless pulse of war machines, its surface etched with runes that shimmer like the gears of an ancient clockwork heart. This helmet grants tactical vision, allowing you to spot hidden enemies and anticipate foes' movements. In prolonged combat, it boosts your resolve, reducing fatigue and enhancing endurance, as if the very crown itself channels the strength of the Regal Empire’s warriors into your veins.

effectDetails.title: Tactical Vision
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +10 bonus to Perception checks for detecting hidden enemies and can see through minor concealments within 30 feet. This effect is active as long as the helmet is worn, but its benefit halves after 1 hour of continuous use.

effectDetails.title: Endurance Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this helm, you have advantage on saving throws against exhaustion and can recover hit points from resting at a rate of 20% faster. This effect lasts until the start of your next short or long rest, but it is limited to once every 1d4 days.

midlands_mechanized_helmet.levelRequirementReason: The helm's intricate clockwork and regal runes require a certain level of experience and skill to wield effectively.
midlands_mechanized_helmet.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its mastery in crafting war machines, is the only vendor capable of producing such an artifact imbued with the essence of their empire’s might.
midlands_mechanized_helmet.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week via Pipe Express; delicate handling required to ensure the helm's mechanisms remain intact.

usage.duration: Until end of next short or long rest, or until removed
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next short or long rest, or when removed from wear

midlands_mechanized_helmet.priceReason: Balanced to reflect the item's unique combination of tactical and endurance benefits, alongside its intricate craftsmanship and historical significance.

midlands_mechanized_iron_glove.name: Iron Gauntlet of the Ironborn
midlands_mechanized_iron_glove.description: The Iron Gauntlet of the Ironborn is a relic forged in the heart of the last central forge of the Iron Legion, its steel tempered by the very essence of industrial might. This gauntlet grants resistance to blunt force damage and allows its wearer to channel potent mechanical energy into their strikes. When first striking an enemy each turn, it unleashes a surge of industrial power that has a 15% chance to stun them for 2 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Industrious Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When the gauntlet's wearer first strikes an enemy each turn, there is a 15% chance to cause Industrial Shock (a temporary stun lasting for 2 seconds). This effect has no save DC and can occur once per turn.

effectDetails.title: Blunt Force Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The gauntlet grants the wearer resistance to blunt force damage. This provides a +10 AC bonus against all bludgeoning attacks, which stacks with any other form of resistance or immunity the wearer might have.

midlands_mechanized_iron_glove.levelRequirementReason: This gauntlet is designed for warriors and knights who are already familiar with melee combat.
midlands_mechanized_iron_glove.vendorReason: Midlands has a long-standing relationship with the Iron Legion, making their wares highly sought after in this region.
midlands_mechanized_iron_glove.shippingDetail: The gauntlet is shipped via spirit courier to ensure it arrives in pristine condition and imbued with the last remnants of its forge.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect activated on first strike each turn.
usage.duration: Persistent until worn off by damage or removed.
usage.endsWhen: The gauntlet is damaged enough to render it inactive, at which point it must be repaired or replaced.

midlands_mechanized_iron_glove.priceReason: Crafted from the last steel of a legendary forge and imbued with industrial might, this gauntlet is priced high but remains within reach for seasoned warriors.

midlands_mechanized_iron_hood.name: Mechanized Iron Hood
midlands_mechanized_iron_hood.description: The Mechanized Iron Hood is a reinforced iron helm encased with whispering gears and adorned with intricate cogs. This helmet not only shields its wearer from industrial hazards but also grants them the ability to remotely control nearby machinery, making it indispensable for those who command factories or work in hazardous environments. The hood hums with mechanical life, drawing power from the very machines around you, thus enhancing your control over them and amplifying their performance by 15%. It is a rare find among the Midlands, where industrial ingenuity meets ancient craftsmanship.

effectDetails.title: Armor Penetration
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +20% bonus to their Armor Class (AC) against mechanical enemies. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Remote Machinery Control
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate this feature and remotely control one nearby machine for 10 seconds. The machine must be within 50 feet and unattended. You can use this ability once per short or long rest.

midlands_mechanized_iron_hood.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least level 3 to effectively control the complex machinery and harness the full potential of this helmet.
midlands_mechanized_iron_hood.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their industrial prowess, and the Mechanized Iron Hood is a product of that expertise.
midlands_mechanized_iron_hood.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, known for its reliable delivery even in the most hazardous conditions.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per activation
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you deactivate it or after 10 seconds

midlands_mechanized_iron_hood.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the rare materials and advanced engineering required to produce such a helmet.

midlands_mechanized_iron_iron.name: Iron Crown of the Forge Lord
midlands_mechanized_iron_iron.description: The Iron Crown of the Forge Lord is a molten steel crown forged in the heart of the Midlands, its surface etched with arcane runes that hum with industrial magic. It grants the wearer dominion over iron and machinery, allowing them to summon Gear Spirits from the very gears of war. When the crown's power surges, it can reduce enemy armor by half for a fleeting moment, turning the tide of battle in your favor.

effectDetails.title: Summon Gear Spirit
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can summon one Gear Spirit that lasts for 5 seconds. The Gear Spirit deals 200% damage to enemies within a 10-foot radius. The spirit is immune to non-magical attacks.

effectDetails.title: Reduce Enemy Armor
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can reduce the armor class of one enemy by 50% for 3 seconds as a reaction to an attack. This effect has no saving throw and does not expend charges or reset on rests.

midlands_mechanized_iron_iron.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Crown's power is accessible early, allowing even novice blacksmiths to harness industrial magic.
midlands_mechanized_iron_iron.vendorReason: The Midlands are the birthplace of this crown and its ironminds are its custodians, preserving the legacy of their craft.
midlands_mechanized_iron_iron.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Rakasha's ethereal plane journey, ensuring safe arrival but not instantaneous delivery.

usage.duration: 5 seconds for Gear Spirit; Instantaneous for Armor Reduction
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the Gear Spirit dissipates or the enemy is no longer within range of the armor reduction effect

midlands_mechanized_iron_iron.priceReason: The crown's rarity and unique industrial magic make it a valuable commodity, balancing its powerful effects.

midlands_mechanized_mantle.name: Mechanized Mantle
midlands_mechanized_mantle.description: The Mechanized Mantle is a segmented cloak of segmented metal and leather, powered by a network of gears and pistons. It extends from your shoulders like an exoskeleton, allowing you to traverse industrial ruins with unnatural agility. In smoke-filled zones, it grants temporary flight for 20 seconds, disrupting enemies within 5 meters who must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn. The cloak also enhances stealth in mechanical environments, increasing your chance to remain unseen by +5%.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Flight
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action within a smoke-filled zone. Grants temporary flight for 20 seconds, during which you are immune to falling damage and have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Ends when the effect duration expires or you exit the smoke-filled zone.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While in a mechanical environment, your chance of remaining unseen is increased by +5%. This bonus lasts for 1 hour per level of the wearer and resets after a short rest. No saving throw or action required.

midlands_mechanized_mantle.levelRequirementReason: The wearer must have sufficient experience to handle the intricate controls and mechanisms of the mantle.
midlands_mechanized_mantle.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its mastery in mechanical engineering, making it a fitting vendor for such an item.
midlands_mechanized_mantle.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail within 3 days of purchase. Requires special handling due to the delicate nature of the mantle's components.

usage.duration: 20 seconds or until you exit a smoke-filled zone
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration expires or you leave the smoke-filled area

midlands_mechanized_mantle.priceReason: The mantle's rarity and unique mechanics justify its price, offering both mobility and stealth enhancements.

midlands_mechanized_martyr.name: Mechanized Martyr
midlands_mechanized_martyr.description: The Mechanized Martyr, a rusted relic of war, hums ominously as it channels the final struggles of those who fought and fell. When activated, it unleashes a mechanical barrage that tears through foes with devastating precision, but at a cost—its gears grind to a halt, leaving it weak for hours. This forgotten machine was once part of the Liberated Toads' arsenal before they dismantled it into pieces of unyielding metal and lore.

effectDetails.title: Devastating Burst
effectDetails.rules: The Mechanized Martyr unleashes an explosive burst of mechanical fury when activated as a bonus action. This attack deals 1500 damage to one target and reduces their armor class by 75% for the next two turns. The user must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 750 points of non-lethal damage.

effectDetails.title: Self-Destruction
effectDetails.rules: After activation, the Mechanized Martyr is reduced to a pile of scrap metal and cannot be used again until it has been repaired. It regains functionality after one hour.

midlands_mechanized_martyr.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 3rd level to wield its destructive power.
midlands_mechanized_martyr.vendorReason: Midlands merchants have a knack for salvaging and repurposing old war machines into useful artifacts.
midlands_mechanized_martyr.shippingDetail: Delivered by spirit courier, the item arrives intact but requires immediate setup before use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (but has a cooldown of one hour)
usage.endsWhen: The user fails their Constitution saving throw or after two turns if the target is still affected.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires repair after use

midlands_mechanized_martyr.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as a rare item with significant power and limited usage.

midlands_mechanized_sword.name: Mechanized Blade of the Unbroken Line
midlands_mechanized_sword.description: The Mechancized Blade of the Unbroken Line is a relic forged from the heart of a Regal Empire war-mech. Its gears and pistons hum with industrial might, channeling the fury of metal into every strike. When engaged in combat against mechanical foes, it unleashes a barrage of precision strikes that enhance your attack speed by 30%. Should you find yourself targeted, its reinforced alloy counters with a surge of kinetic energy, dealing an additional 50% damage for 3 seconds to your attacker.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Precision
effectDetails.rules: When the Mechancized Blade engages in combat with a mechanical enemy, it grants the wielder +25% damage against such foes. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Kinetic Counterattack
effectDetails.rules: Upon being struck by an attack while wearing this blade, you may immediately make a melee weapon attack as a reaction. If successful, the target takes an additional 50% damage for 3 seconds. The blade can only be used in this manner once per short or long rest.

midlands_mechanized_sword.levelRequirementReason: This relic is crafted from the most advanced war-mech technology and requires a warrior with significant combat experience to wield it effectively.
midlands_mechanized_sword.vendorReason: The Midlands are renowned for their expertise in forging ancient and enchanted weapons, making them the perfect vendor for this historical relic.
midlands_mechanized_sword.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, this item is shipped with utmost care using custom metal crates to prevent damage during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous reaction upon being struck by an attack.
usage.duration: 3 seconds of additional damage for the attacker when reacting.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn or when the rest period ends.
usage.charges: One use per short or long rest

midlands_mechanized_sword.priceReason: This relic is considered a rare find, balancing its historical value and technological prowess with an appropriate XP cost.

midlands_mechanized_talisman.name: Mechanized Talisman of the Iron Crown
midlands_mechanized_talisman.description: The Mechanized Talisman of the Iron Crown is a cursed cogwheel crowned with a regal iron crown, forged in the fires of war-torn Midlands. It hums with the spirit of an ancient siege engineer and grants its bearer tactical advantage in urban conflicts. When activated, it imbues the wearer with the resilience to withstand relentless attacks, granting +15% damage resistance against enemy siege engines and +10% movement speed within industrial zones. Each use channels the gears of war, dealing bonus damage to armored foes.

effectDetails.title: Gears of War
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this effect grants the wearer +15% damage resistance against all attacks from siege engines for 1 minute. Each use deals an additional 2d6 bonus damage to armored enemies within a 30-foot radius. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Urban Swift
effectDetails.rules: While in industrial zones, the wearer gains +10% movement speed and the ability to move through difficult terrain without penalty for 1 hour. This effect ends if the wearer leaves an industrial zone or is hit by an attack.

midlands_mechanized_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The Talisman's complex mechanisms require a proficient user with tactical knowledge.
midlands_mechanized_talisman.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its war-torn history and expertise in siege warfare, offers this relic to those who seek advantage on the battlefield.
midlands_mechanized_talisman.shippingDetail: The package is delivered by spectral couriers, ensuring it arrives swiftly but with a touch of the uncanny.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Gears of War; 1 hour for Urban Swift
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration expires or the Talisman is destroyed by an attack.

midlands_mechanized_talisman.priceReason: This rare talisman's price reflects its powerful abilities and the difficulty of obtaining such a relic.

midlands_mechanized_tongue.name: Mechanized Tongue
midlands_mechanized_tongue.description: The Mech-Tongue, a marvel of alchemical ingenuity and blacksmith prowess, is a steel tongue encased in intricate wires that can speak the language of machines. It grants invisibility to mechanical eyes when commanded, allowing its wearer to evade detection by automatons or goblinish millhands. This tongue not only commands basic machinery with a voice but also restores 10% of the user's hit points whenever it is used to converse with a machine.

effectDetails.title: Voice Command
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can command basic machinery within 30 feet. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn or until you speak with another machine. This does not provoke opportunity attacks.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility to Machines
effectDetails.rules: The Mech-Tongue grants invisibility to mechanical detection for 1 minute when activated as a bonus action. It can be used once per long rest and requires line of sight between the user and the target area.

midlands_mechanized_tongue.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a certain level to master its mechanics and integrate with machine languages.
midlands_mechanized_tongue.vendorReason: Midlands is renowned for their technological prowess, making them the ideal vendor for such an advanced tool.
midlands_mechanized_tongue.shippingDetail: Shipping is expedited via Boo Spectral Mail, ensuring this delicate item arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate invisibility; action to command machinery.
usage.duration: 1 minute for invisibility; until start of next turn for machine commands.
usage.endsWhen: Use ends on the start of your next turn or when you speak with another machine.

midlands_mechanized_tongue.priceReason: The Mech-Tongue is priced at 1000 XP for its advanced capabilities and the skill required to use it effectively.

midlands_medieval_torch.name: The Torch of the Iron Throne
midlands_medieval_torch.description: The Torch of the Iron Throne is forged from the very steel of the fallen Iron Throne, its flames a symbol of forgotten glory and unfulfilled oaths. This relic casts a warm, golden glow that illuminates even the darkest corners, revealing hidden traps and mechanisms within a 30-foot radius. Touching it grants you +25% damage against undead creatures for the duration of your turn, but beware—its fire can also ignite flammable materials in its immediate vicinity.

effectDetails.title: Undead Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you attack an undead creature, you deal +25% bonus damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Mechanism Revelation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can point to a surface or area within 30 feet and gain insight into any hidden mechanisms or traps. You must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception) check with a DC of 15.

midlands_medieval_torch.levelRequirementReason: The torch's power requires a moderate understanding of combat and lore to wield effectively.
midlands_medieval_torch.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its scholarly and historical artifacts, is the keeper of such relics.
midlands_medieval_torch.shippingDetail: Shipped via a spectral courier who delivers the torch with a slight delay due to its ethereal nature.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Mechanism Revelation; as part of an attack when dealing damage against undead
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends at the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short or long rest

midlands_medieval_torch.priceReason: The torch's rarity and historical significance justify its moderate price.

midlands_medieval_treasure.name: King’s Bloodstained Scroll
midlands_medieval_treasure.description: The King’s Bloodstained Scroll, a relic of a bygone era, is a vellum scroll covered in ancient runes that whisper tales of a fallen monarch’s final decree. When unrolled and read aloud, it grants temporary immunity to fear for 1 minute and allows the reader to command an ally within 30 feet with a whispered oath, compelling them to act on their behalf until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Command Ally
effectDetails.rules: As an action, read aloud a whispered oath and choose one willing creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to act on your behalf until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute, you gain immunity to the fear condition and advantage on saving throws against being frightened. This effect ends if you take any damage during this time or if it is dispelled.

midlands_medieval_treasure.levelRequirementReason: The scroll’s power requires a certain level of experience to wield its effects without risk.
midlands_medieval_treasure.vendorReason: Midlands, with their extensive knowledge of ancient artifacts, are trusted dealers of such powerful relics.
midlands_medieval_treasure.shippingDetail: Due to the scroll’s fragile nature and historical significance, it is shipped via Koopa Postal’s express delivery service.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until dispelled by damage
usage.endsWhen: The scroll is destroyed if used twice in a single day
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

midlands_medieval_treasure.priceReason: The scroll’s rarity and historical importance justify its moderate price.

midlands_meridian_cloak.name: Shadowed Meridian Cloak
midlands_meridian_cloak.description: The Shadowed Meridian Cloak is crafted from the remnants of a noble's ceremonial robe, its dark weave absorbing ambient light and granting stealth in dimly lit industrial zones. This cloak not only allows wearers to slip past Iron Legion patrols unnoticed but also subtly distorts their silhouette, making them harder to detect by ranged attacks. Worn in the right conditions, it can even reduce the effectiveness of enemy ranged weapons, giving those who seek to remain unseen a crucial edge.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Advantage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in dimly lit industrial zones. This effect is active while the cloak is worn and ends when it is removed.

effectDetails.title: Ranged Weapon Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 30 feet have disadvantage on attack rolls against the wearer while they are wearing this cloak. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to half the wearer's level (rounded down), and it ends when the wearer is no longer in dimly lit areas or the cloak is removed.

midlands_meridian_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak requires a higher-level character due to its complex weave and potent effects.
midlands_meridian_cloak.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their trade in rare artifacts and relics, offers this unique item crafted from noble remnants.
midlands_meridian_cloak.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail with a guaranteed delivery within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing the cloak.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, ends when removed or in bright light.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is no longer in dimly lit areas or the cloak is removed.

midlands_meridian_cloak.priceReason: The cloak's rarity and unique effects justify its price, providing significant tactical advantage.

midlands_metal_gear.name: Ironspine Gauntlets
midlands_metal_gear.description: Forged from the iron spines of Onyx Hand's fallen warriors, these gauntlets are a grim reminder of the forsaken armory’s dark past. They grant +20% melee damage and reduce enemy armor by 10% for five seconds when attacked, making every blow feel like a strike against the very heart of their foes. With each clash, the metal groans as if echoing the cries of its creators, enhancing your combat prowess in close quarters.

effectDetails.title: Melee Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: The gauntlets grant +20% melee damage. This effect is passive and applies to all melee attacks while worn.

effectDetails.title: Armor Reduction on Attack
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer takes damage from an attack, reduce the attacker's armor class by 10 for five seconds. The gauntlets must be struck in combat for this effect to activate.

midlands_metal_gear.levelRequirementReason: The Ironspine Gauntlets are crafted with advanced materials and techniques that require a high level of mastery.
midlands_metal_gear.vendorReason: Midlands is known for its expertise in armory and has the knowledge to handle such powerful relics.
midlands_metal_gear.shippingDetail: The gauntlets are delivered by Lakitu Drones, ensuring they arrive in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires the wearer to be engaged in melee combat for the armor reduction to activate.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts five seconds upon activation.
usage.endsWhen: Expires after five seconds or when removed from combat.

midlands_metal_gear.priceReason: The gauntlets are crafted from rare materials and advanced techniques, justifying their high price.

midlands_millstone_tincture.name: Millstone Tincture
midlands_millstone_tincture.description: The Millstone Tincture is a viscous, metallic elixir that exudes an oily sheen and whispers of gears and cogs. Sipped in times of industrial turmoil, it grants clarity to the mind and a touch of mechanical prowess, allowing one to dance gracefully among the Fractured Atrium's dissonant machinery. This tincture is said to have been brewed from the remnants of an ancient mill that once ground the very earth itself into harmony. It's a rare find, often shipped by the Void Drifter Relay, known for its expedient delivery through the fractured planes.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Mastery
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after consuming this tincture, you gain +25% accuracy with mechanical weapons. This effect is active as long as you are within an industrial zone and does not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Trap Evasion
effectDetails.rules: While under the influence of this tincture, you have a +10% chance to avoid traps in industrial zones. This effect is active for 8 hours after consumption and requires no action.

midlands_millstone_tincture.levelRequirementReason: The Millstone Tincture's effects are subtle yet potent, making it accessible even to novice adventurers.
midlands_millstone_tincture.vendorReason: Midlands, known for its trade with the Fractured Atrium, frequently stocks this rare elixir.
midlands_millstone_tincture.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week of purchase, ensuring adventurers are well-prepared to face industrial challenges.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon consumption; no action required.
usage.duration: 1 hour for Mechanical Mastery, 8 hours for Trap Evasion.
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends when the time expires or you consume another elixir of similar effects.

midlands_millstone_tincture.priceReason: The Millstone Tincture is crafted from rare mill remains and requires specialized brewing, making it a valuable but not overpriced item.

midlands_molten_core_potion.name: Molten Core Elixir
midlands_molten_core_potion.description: The Molten Core Elixir is a vile, glowing elixir extracted from the heart of an ancient industrial furnace. Its fiery glow hints at the inferno it once fed. This potion grants temporary strength and heat resistance but comes with a price—consumers risk losing their sanity as the elixir's madness begins to take root within them. For 10 minutes, you gain +30% maximum hit points and 50% fire resistance. Enemies nearby have a 10% chance of being confused for 3 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Max HP Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume as an action to gain +30% maximum hit points for 10 minutes. Ends when you finish a short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Grants 50% fire resistance for 10 minutes. Ends if you take any cold damage, your concentration is broken, or you finish a short or long rest.

midlands_molten_core_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion can be consumed by adventurers of all levels but is particularly useful to lower-level characters who need immediate combat readiness.
midlands_molten_core_potion.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their industrial prowess, making them the ideal place for such a potent elixir.
midlands_molten_core_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week by Pipe Express; requires special handling to ensure the potion's potency remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Finish a short or long rest, take cold damage, or have concentration broken

midlands_molten_core_potion.priceReason: The price reflects the rare materials and skilled labor required to distill this powerful but dangerous elixir.

midlands_molten_gear_core.name: Molten Gear Core
midlands_molten_gear_core.description: The Molten Gear Core, a pulsing heart of steel forged from the fiery furnace of the Iron Legion's final war machine, hums with untamed industrial fury. Its molten core glows with an otherworldly heat that can melt even the strongest armor upon contact. Activate it to channel raw forgepower into your strikes, dealing devastating damage to mechanical enemies and triggering a wave of searing blast that ripples outward in all directions.

effectDetails.title: Blast of the Forge
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a mechanical foe with a melee attack, it triggers an explosive wave that deals fire damage equal to twice your level plus your Strength modifier to all enemies within 5 feet. You can use this effect once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: +50% Damage
effectDetails.rules: While wielding the Molten Gear Core, you deal +50% damage against mechanical enemies. This bonus does not stack with other sources of damage increase.

midlands_molten_gear_core.levelRequirementReason: The core's raw forgepower demands a seasoned fighter who can harness its volatile energy.
midlands_molten_gear_core.vendorReason: Midlands is known for their access to rare and exotic materials, making them the perfect vendor for this unique artifact.
midlands_molten_gear_core.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the Molten Gear Core must be shipped with special thermal insulation to prevent accidental activation during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop making attacks or are incapacitated. You can use it once per short rest.

midlands_molten_gear_core.priceReason: This rare artifact combines the power of a legendary weapon with the unique properties of an ancient war machine, offering players a valuable and dangerous tool for combat.

midlands_molten_heart_potion.name: Molten Heart Elixir
midlands_molten_heart_potion.description: The Molten Heart Elixir is crafted from the very essence of a fallen warlord’s final breath, sealed in a vial that glows like molten iron. This potion burns hot within the drinker, fueling their resolve and granting them the strength to push through even the most grueling battles. Sipping it feels as though your veins are filled with liquid fire, but its fiery embrace grants you resilience against fatigue and enemies alike.

effectDetails.title: Resolve Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Molten Heart Elixir restores 200 hit points to the drinker. Additionally, it grants a +100 bonus to attack rolls for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Unyielding Resolve
effectDetails.rules: The drinker gains the 'Unyielding' status effect for 2 turns, which provides immunity to being stunned or knocked down. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after it ends.

midlands_molten_heart_potion.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 3 to handle the potion’s potent effects.
midlands_molten_heart_potion.vendorReason: The Midlands are known for their expertise in alchemy and have access to rare ingredients like those used in crafting this elixir.
midlands_molten_heart_potion.shippingDetail: Shipped via Swift Courier, ensuring the potion arrives in its pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Resolve Boost; 'Unyielding' lasts 2 turns.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire or the drinker is incapacitated.

midlands_molten_heart_potion.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its potent alchemical ingredients and rare crafting process.

midlands_molten_marrow.name: Molten Marrow
midlands_molten_marrow.description: The Molten Marrow, a pulsating core extracted from the heart of a forge-forged beast, glows with an otherworldly crimson light. When consumed, it awakens primal strength within you, granting temporary vitality and warping your perception of time during combat. For ten seconds, your regeneration increases by 30%, and your attacks strike faster—+25% attack speed. Additionally, there's a 10% chance for an enemy to experience a ‘Time Melt,’ where their actions are delayed by two critical seconds.

effectDetails.title: Regeneration Boost
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the Molten Marrow, you gain temporary hit point regeneration equal to +30% of your maximum hit points over a period of ten seconds. This effect cannot be used more than once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Time Melt
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, there is a 10% chance that you will cause an enemy to experience a ‘Time Melt’ for two critical seconds. During this time, the enemy’s actions are delayed by two seconds. This effect can only be triggered once per combat.

midlands_molten_marrow.levelRequirementReason: The Molten Marrow's raw power requires a seasoned warrior to harness its full potential.
midlands_molten_marrow.vendorReason: Midlands, known for their expertise in forge-forged beasts and artifacts, is the only reliable source for such potent items.
midlands_molten_marrow.shippingDetail: The Molten Marrow requires special handling to ensure it remains potent during shipment.

usage.activation: Eaten as an action during combat.
usage.duration: 10 seconds of effect, followed by a 24-hour cooldown period before the next use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect concludes after its duration or if you take any damage.
