effectDetails.rules: When used to slice food, this slicer ensures that each portion is perfectly even. It provides a +1 bonus to History checks when attempting to identify ancient recipes.

effectDetails.title: Curses Warded Off
effectDetails.rules: The etchings on the slicer provide a +2 resistance modifier to saving throws against minor curses for 1 hour, once per long rest. This effect ends if the wielder is cursed or when the slicer is destroyed.

millennium_tomb_sarcophagus_slicer.levelRequirementReason: This tool requires a proficient user due to its weight and intricate etchings.
millennium_tomb_sarcophagus_slicer.vendorReason: The Millennium Tomb's artisans are known for their mastery of ancient tools and relics, making this slicer a staple in their inventory.
millennium_tomb_sarcophagus_slicer.shippingDetail: Ships via Pharaohs Plate Pan, with an additional delay of one day due to the artifact’s weight.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when slicing food or using it in combat against minor curses.
usage.duration: 1 hour once per long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wielder is cursed or when the slicer is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one effect can be active at a time.

millennium_tomb_sarcophagus_slicer.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its rarity and utility in both culinary and magical contexts.

millennium_trench_coat_of_mystery.name: Millennium Trench Coat of Mystery
millennium_trench_coat_of_mystery.description: The Millennium Trench Coat of Mystery is a coat that billows dramatically, its fabric swirling and twisting as if alive. Worn by those who seek to command attention, it grants the wearer an air of mystery and intrigue. The coat's material seems almost otherworldly, shimmering faintly with unseen patterns that shift with every step you take. Made by Millennium Fashion, this coat is said to have been crafted from threads woven between dimensions themselves.

effectDetails.title: Dramatic Entrance
effectDetails.rules: When entering a room, the wearer can speak a command word to activate this effect. For the next minute, they gain advantage on Charisma checks made to perform or maintain dramatic entrances.

effectDetails.title: Mystical Billowing
effectDetails.rules: The coat billows without any wind present, creating an eerie yet captivating atmosphere around you. As a reaction when you are subjected to a Stealth check, you take disadvantage on it for the next round. This effect can be used once per long rest.

millennium_trench_coat_of_mystery.levelRequirementReason: The coat's enchantments are subtle and require no specific combat or magical prowess beyond basic Charisma checks.
millennium_trench_coat_of_mystery.vendorReason: Millennium Fashion is renowned for creating items that enhance one's presence, making the Trench Coat of Mystery a perfect fit for their catalog.
millennium_trench_coat_of_mystery.shippingDetail: The coat arrives wrapped in an enigmatic aura, ensuring its arrival with no trace of how it was delivered.

usage.activation: Command word when entering a room
usage.duration: 1 minute per activation
usage.endsWhen: Ends after one minute or upon leaving the room

millennium_trench_coat_of_mystery.priceReason: The coat's mystical properties and its ability to enhance dramatic entrances make it a valuable, yet not overly expensive, addition to any adventurer's wardrobe.

mimic_chest_key.name: Mimic Chest Key
mimic_chest_key.description: The Mimic Chest Key appears as a tarnished brass key, adorned with toothy engravings that seem to smile back at you. It hums softly when brought close to a mimic chest or a trapped chest, and its warmth radiates like the calm before a storm. When inserted into a mimic chest, it has an 80% chance of pacifying the creature without triggering its trap, but it fails against cursed or artifact chests. The key itself grows warm in the presence of hungry creatures, as if eager to prove its worth.

effectDetails.title: Pacify Mimic Chest
effectDetails.rules: When used on a mimic chest, the key has an 80% chance of pacifying the creature and safely opening it. If the attempt fails, the mimic activates its trap. The key cannot be used on cursed or artifact chests.

effectDetails.title: Safe Opening
effectDetails.rules: The key can also be used to open trapped chests without triggering their mechanisms, but only if the chest is not already pacified. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges; it simply works with an 80% success rate.

mimic_chest_key.levelRequirementReason: The key requires a basic understanding of mimicry and traps, making level 1 sufficient for its use.
mimic_chest_key.vendorReason: As the Rogue Port's Black Market vendor, Wax Envelope frequently deals in items that can disarm and deceive, making this key an ideal addition to her wares.
mimic_chest_key.shippingDetail: Delivered via a sealed wax envelope, ensuring the key remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the mimic is pacified or the chest is opened safely. The key cannot be used again until it has cooled down, which takes a full day of rest.

mimic_chest_key.priceReason: The Mimic Chest Key's ability to both disarm and pacify dangerous chests makes it a valuable tool for adventurers without draining their resources.

mimic_colony_starter.name: Mimic Colony Starter Kit
mimic_colony_starter.description: The Mimic Colony Starter Kit arrives in a sturdy wooden crate, its contents carefully packed within. Inside lie three mimic eggs, each crafted from enchanted bone and imbued with Doppelganger magic. The training manual, bound in leather and adorned with the emblem of the Shapeshifter Market, details the mysteries of raising mimics for both combat and stealth. Once hatched, these mimics are loyal guardians but grow restless without regular contact with sentient beings, craving such encounters at least once a month.
effects: Raise three mimics to serve as loyal guards
Mimic loyalty wanes without contact with sentient prey

effectDetails.title: Egg Incubation
effectDetails.rules: Activates when placed in a suitable environment. Each egg hatches within one week, yielding a mimic. The mimics are docile and trainable until they have interacted with at least three sentient beings.

effectDetails.title: Sentient Contact Requirement
effectDetails.rules: Mimics require monthly contact with sentient prey to maintain loyalty. Failure to do so results in the mimics' behavior becoming erratic, potentially turning against their creators.

mimic_colony_starter.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least level 10 to handle and control the mimics effectively.
mimic_colony_starter.vendorReason: The Shapeshifter Market specializes in exotic and magical creatures, making it the premier source for such items.
mimic_colony_starter.shippingDetail: Delivered by stealthy couriers who ensure the kit remains undetected during transit.

usage.activation: Activates when mimics are hatched and trained with regular interaction.
usage.duration: Permanent, unless loyalty is lost due to lack of sentient contact.
usage.endsWhen: Loyalty to their creators is lost if they go three months without interacting with sentient beings.

mimic_colony_starter.priceReason: The kit includes rare materials and the expertise of Doppelganger Breeders, justifying its price.

mind_flayer_tadpole_removal.name: Mind Flayer Tadpole Removal
mind_flayer_tadpole_removal.description: The Mind Flayer Tadpole Removal is a delicately crafted, hand-forged device made by the Brain Surgeons of the illithid realm. This artifact features intricately etched plates that emit a focused pulse when activated, safely extracting a mind flayer tadpole without causing any permanent damage to its host's intelligence. Upon successful use, the recipient gains permanent immunity to ceremorphosis and becomes resistant to mind-affecting spells for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Tadpole Extraction
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user must make an Intelligence (Medicine) check against the target's Wisdom saving throw DC. On a success, the tadpole is removed without causing any loss of intelligence or permanent damage.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Mind-Affecting Spells
effectDetails.rules: Lasts for 1 hour after successful extraction. The user gains resistance to all mind-affecting spells and effects during this duration. This effect does not stack with other similar resistances.

mind_flayer_tadpole_removal.levelRequirementReason: The procedure requires a basic understanding of the brain mechanics involved in tadpole removal.
mind_flayer_tadpole_removal.vendorReason: Illithid Defense specializes in advanced medical and extraction devices to protect their kind from mind flayer infestations.
mind_flayer_tadpole_removal.shippingDetail: The device is shipped using the Telekinetic Extraction Service, ensuring safe delivery without risk of contamination or tampering.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and perform the extraction procedure.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; tadpole removal occurs upon a successful check.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after 1 hour when resistance to mind-affecting spells is no longer applicable.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one tadpole can be removed per use.

mind_flayer_tadpole_removal.priceReason: This item represents a highly specialized and valuable service provided by the Brain Surgeons of Illithid Defense, making it moderately priced for its rarity.

mind_fortress_installation.name: Mind Fortress Installation
mind_fortress_installation.description: The Mind Fortress Installation is a specialist's artifice, an intricate web of psychic defenses woven into your mind over three days. Crafted from rare, shimmering crystal and imbued with ancient eldritch knowledge, it grants you immunity to charm effects, detect thoughts, and scrying within 60 feet. These protections are so robust that they grant advantage on all Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws. However, sharing your thoughts willingly can deactivate this formidable shield for a full day.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Shield
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to charm effects, detect thoughts, and scrying within 60 feet. Additionally, you have advantage on all Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws. These defenses activate upon installation and last until willingly deactivated or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Intuition
effectDetails.rules: When you share your thoughts willingly (such as through a telepathic conversation), the protections deactivate for 24 hours. This effect can only be triggered once per long rest.

mind_fortress_installation.levelRequirementReason: This installation requires a high level of mental discipline and focus to construct, suitable only for those who have reached at least seventh level.
mind_fortress_installation.vendorReason: The Artificer Tower specializes in crafting intricate mindscapes and psychic defenses, making it the ideal vendor for this installation.
mind_fortress_installation.shippingDetail: Installation requires three days during which you are incapacitated. The process is delicate and must be performed by a trained specialist.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon completion of the installation.
usage.duration: Indefinite until deactivated or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: If you share your thoughts willingly, it deactivates for 24 hours. Only one instance can be triggered per long rest.

mind_fortress_installation.priceReason: The price reflects the complexity of the installation and the materials used, as well as the time required to complete it.

minecraft_diamond_pick.name: Diamond Pickaxe
minecraft_diamond_pick.description: The Diamond Pickaxe gleams with a cold, metallic sheen under moonlight, its facets reflecting starlight like a piece of the heavens. Crafted by the hands of ancient dwarven forges, it is said to have been born from the heart of a volcano itself. This pickaxe not only enhances your mining prowess but also shatters magical defenses that guard deep mine treasures. It never breaks and requires no maintenance, ensuring you can focus on the task at hand without worry.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mining
effectDetails.rules: When used for mining checks, increase your proficiency bonus by +3. Additionally, you can harvest twice the amount of resources from a single successful mining check.

effectDetails.title: Breaks Magical Barriers
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use this pickaxe to shatter any magical barrier or shield within 10 feet. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges; it simply requires a successful mining check (DC 15) to activate.

minecraft_diamond_pick.levelRequirementReason: The Diamond Pickaxe is designed for beginners who wish to explore deeper mines but still require the advanced capabilities of this tool.
minecraft_diamond_pick.vendorReason: Gilded Gryphon, known for its expertise in rare and magical equipment, offers this pickaxe as a staple for adventurers venturing into uncharted territories.
minecraft_diamond_pick.shippingDetail: The pickaxe is delivered via Swift Wind Courier, ensuring it arrives at your door within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Once per short rest after use

minecraft_diamond_pick.priceReason: The Diamond Pickaxe, though not extraordinarily powerful, offers significant utility in mining and breaking barriers, making it a fair price for eager adventurers.

minerva_academy_owl_feather_brush.name: Minerva Academy Owl Feather Brush
minerva_academy_owl_feather_brush.description: The Minerva Academy Owl Feather Brush is a delicate tool crafted from the softest feathers of an owl that once belonged to the school’s founder. This brush ensures dusting pudding molds achieves perfect precision, enhancing scholarly recipes with its wisdom-infused touch. Each stroke grants you +1 to Intelligence for the next hour when crafting puddings or pastries, and occasionally, a feather will detach itself, bringing a moment of serendipity or insight.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Crafting
effectDetails.rules: When crafting puddings or pastries with this brush, you gain +1 to Intelligence for the next hour. This effect is instantaneous upon use and lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Feather Serendipity
effectDetails.rules: Occasionally, a feather will detach from the brush, providing you with a momentary insight or hint about your craft (+1d4 temporary Intelligence). This effect is random and can occur once per day.

minerva_academy_owl_feather_brush.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective tool does not require a specific level to use.
minerva_academy_owl_feather_brush.vendorReason: The Minerva Library, as the heart of scholarly pursuits at the academy, naturally stocks this indispensable tool for students and faculty alike.
minerva_academy_owl_feather_brush.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the owl post, ensuring your brush arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use upon starting to craft puddings or pastries.
usage.duration: One hour after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn, or when you stop crafting with it.

minerva_academy_owl_feather_brush.priceReason: This item’s price is balanced to reflect its utility in enhancing scholarly activities and the rarity of the owl feathers used in its construction.

minerva_owl_familiar_training_premium.name: Minerva Owl Familiar Training (Premium)
minerva_owl_familiar_training_premium.description: Honed by Minerva Owl Familiar Training, this premium owl companion hones its skills in silence and delivers messages across vast distances. Its keen senses grant advantage on Perception checks within a mile, while its nightly hoots can inspire confidence with a chance to grant advantage on Insight checks for the listener. This familiar is no ordinary bird; it's crafted from the finest feathers of the wild and trained by the renowned Minerva Academy.

effectDetails.title: Message Delivery
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, this owl can deliver a message to a location up to one mile away. The recipient must be present when the message is delivered and can understand it without additional effort.

effectDetails.title: Insight Boost
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command your owl familiar to hoot once, granting you advantage on the next Insight check you make within one hour. This effect has a daily limit of once per day.

minerva_owl_familiar_training_premium.levelRequirementReason: This premium training requires a certain level of dedication and experience for the familiar to reach its full potential.
minerva_owl_familiar_training_premium.vendorReason: The Minerva Academy is renowned for its expertise in owl familiar training, ensuring only the highest quality familiars are offered here.
minerva_owl_familiar_training_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a trusted courier who ensures your owl arrives in top condition.

usage.activation: As an action or reaction for Message Delivery, as an action for Insight Boost.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Message Delivery; one hour duration for Insight Boost.
usage.endsWhen: The daily limit is reached for the Insight Boost effect.

minerva_owl_familiar_training_premium.priceReason: This premium training significantly enhances a familiar owl's capabilities, making it worth this fair price in XP.

minerva_owl_post_upgrade.name: Minerva Owl Post Upgrade
minerva_owl_post_upgrade.description: The Minerva Owl Post Upgrade ensures your letters are delivered swiftly and graded by a discerning owl. The owls of Minerva Postal Service arrive at your door within an hour, their deliveries a testament to both speed and efficiency. They not only bring your mail but also provide a written critique on the quality of your correspondence, ensuring that every communication is as sharp as the talons that deliver it.

effectDetails.title: Swift Delivery
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, a Minerva Postal Service owl delivers your mail within an hour. This effect is instantaneous and does not consume any charges or have a duration.

effectDetails.title: Handwritten Critique
effectDetails.rules: The owl provides a grade for the quality of your handwriting on each letter delivered. The owls evaluate based on legibility, neatness, and creativity. This effect is passive and requires no activation; it occurs with every delivery.

minerva_owl_post_upgrade.levelRequirementReason: The upgrade ensures that even novices can benefit from its advantages.
minerva_owl_post_upgrade.vendorReason: Minerva Postal Service prides itself on innovation and efficiency, offering this premium service to all their customers.
minerva_owl_post_upgrade.shippingDetail: The owl courier delivers the upgrade directly to your door within an hour of activation.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required for either feature.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Swift Delivery) and passive (Handwritten Critique).
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the owl completes its delivery or if a new letter is delivered by another courier.

minerva_owl_post_upgrade.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP, this upgrade provides significant benefits without overshadowing other premium services.

minerva_owl_wisdom_pudding_recipe.name: Recipe: Minerva Owl Wisdom Pudding
minerva_owl_wisdom_pudding_recipe.description: This ancient parchment bears the recipe for Minerva Owl Wisdom Pudding, a creamy confection that infuses scholarly prowess. Served at the heart of the Academy Library, its secrets are known only to those who have earned the right to know. A spoonful grants you advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks for four hours, while the pudding itself is made from brain food and imbued with the wisdom of owls, whose hoots echo in your mind as you consume it.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) Checks
effectDetails.rules: Eating the pudding grants you advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks for four hours. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Academy Library Wisdom
effectDetails.rules: The recipe imparts a sense of scholarly wisdom, as if you had spent the past hour reading in the Academy Library. It grants knowledge equivalent to one skill check with the Investigation skill.

minerva_owl_wisdom_pudding_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can benefit from the increased scholarly prowess that this pudding provides.
minerva_owl_wisdom_pudding_recipe.vendorReason: The recipe is a tradition passed down through generations of Academy cooks and scholars.
minerva_owl_wisdom_pudding_recipe.shippingDetail: Shipped with care, arriving within one week from the Academy Library.

usage.duration: Four hours per use
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when it expires or you eat another serving of the pudding

minerva_owl_wisdom_pudding_recipe.priceReason: Balanced to provide a scholarly advantage without becoming overpowered.

minerva_sage_robe.name: Minerva Sage Robe
minerva_sage_robe.description: The Minerva Sage Robe is a scholarly garment crafted by Academy Tailors, its subtle embroidery depicting ancient symbols of wisdom and knowledge. The robe's pockets are lined with parchment, preserving scrolls without ink spillage or damage. With each page turned, the fabric whispers tales of forgotten lore, enhancing the wearer’s intellect in matters of history. Known to be favored by scholars and scribes, this rare ensemble is a symbol of academic prowess.
effects: Scroll pockets preserve scrolls without ink damage

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Academic Knowledge
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +1 to Intelligence (History) checks. This effect lasts until the end of the wearer's next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Preservation of Knowledge
effectDetails.rules: The robe’s pockets protect scrolls from ink damage, allowing for safe storage and review without deterioration. The protection is active as long as at least one scroll is in a pocket.

minerva_sage_robe.levelRequirementReason: This robe requires proficiency with History to fully utilize its benefits.
minerva_sage_robe.vendorReason: The Minerva Library, known for its extensive collection of ancient texts and scrolls, offers this robe as a symbol of scholarly prestige.
minerva_sage_robe.shippingDetail: Ships via Parchment Lining, ensuring safe delivery within three days.

usage.duration: Lasts until the end of the next long rest or until the robe is removed
usage.endsWhen: The robe is removed from the wearer

minerva_sage_robe.priceReason: This price reflects a rare, limited edition robe that enhances scholarly endeavors and preserves knowledge.

minerva_wisdom_elixir.name: Minerva Wisdom Elixir
minerva_wisdom_elixir.description: Minerva's Wisdom Elixir, a shimmering vial of clear liquid imbued with the essence of Athena herself, grants the drinker unparalleled clarity and strategic acumen for an hour. The elixir is said to have been crafted in her own sacred forge, its crystal bottle etched with runes that hum faintly when activated. Known for enhancing both your Intelligence score and proficiency in a chosen skill, this potion was made by Minerva herself, the goddess of wisdom. It's a rare find from the Minerva Academy, where only the most skilled alchemists dare to replicate its formula.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Intelligence
effectDetails.rules: Gain +4 to your Intelligence score for one hour. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Expertise Boost
effectDetails.rules: For one hour, you gain expertise in a single Intelligence-based skill (such as Arcana, History, or Perception). You can only benefit from this effect once per day. This boost ends when the duration expires or if you use it again.

minerva_wisdom_elixir.levelRequirementReason: This potion is suitable for adventurers of any level to enhance their strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
minerva_wisdom_elixir.vendorReason: The Minerva Academy is renowned for its mastery in alchemy, making it the only source for this legendary elixir.
minerva_wisdom_elixir.shippingDetail: Shipped by a Crystal Dropper, delivered within three days of ordering. The delivery is insured against loss or damage during transit.

usage.activation: Consume the vial as an action.
usage.duration: One hour, until your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends at the end of a short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be consumed multiple times per day.

minerva_wisdom_elixir.priceReason: This elixir is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the expertise required to craft it in Minerva's sacred forge.

mini_mushroom.name: Mini Mushroom
mini_mushroom.description: The Mini Mushroom is a diminutive, glowing puffball that, when consumed, shrinks you to the size of a small animal. For ten minutes, your world becomes a labyrinth of towering objects and hidden pathways. Its bioluminescent cap pulses with an eerie green light as it nestles in your hand like a tiny, iridescent orb. While shrunken, you gain +5 to Stealth checks, blending seamlessly into the environment, but beware—larger creatures can easily step on or crush you, inflicting double damage due to your vulnerable state.

effectDetails.title: Shrink and Sneak
effectDetails.rules: Single Use. Consuming the Mini Mushroom shrinks you to Tiny size for ten minutes, granting +5 to Stealth checks during this time. The effect ends if you are no longer in a covert area or if you take any action that disallows the use of a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Vulnerable to Step
effectDetails.rules: While shrunk, you are vulnerable to being stepped on by creatures larger than you. If this occurs, you take double damage from the step. The effect ends if you are no longer in contact with a creature or if you are moved away from it.

mini_mushroom.levelRequirementReason: The Mini Mushroom is accessible to lower-level characters as an introduction to stealth and size-based combat maneuvers.
mini_mushroom.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in items that enhance the everyday lives of its patrons, making the Mini Mushroom a perfect fit for their inventory.
mini_mushroom.shippingDetail: The Mini Mushroom is shipped in a specially designed container to ensure safe delivery and prevent premature activation during transit.

usage.duration: 10 minutes (ends if you leave covert area or take an action disallowing bonus action)
usage.endsWhen: Leaving a covert area, taking an action that disallows the use of a bonus action, or being stepped on by larger creatures

mini_mushroom.priceReason: The Mini Mushroom's price is adjusted to reflect its utility in stealth situations and the risk involved in using it.

mini_pow.name: Mini POW Block
mini_pow.description: Mini POW Block, a compact cube of hardened clay and brass, humming faintly with residual energy. This handy device can be shaken to dislodge unwanted intruders from your immediate surroundings. When activated, it sends a jarring pulse that forces all creatures on the ground within 5 feet to make a Strength saving throw (DC 14). Failure means they fall prone and are stunned until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Groundlings
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Mini POW Block sends a pulse that forces all creatures on the ground within 5 feet to make a Strength saving throw (DC 14). On failure, they fall prone and are stunned until their next turn begins.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Creatures who fail the save are stunned for one round. This effect ends when the creature is no longer on the ground within the pulse's range or takes damage.

mini_pow.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 1 to ensure that users can handle its effects.
mini_pow.vendorReason: Toad Town Market sells everyday items like the Mini POW Block, which are useful for small-scale adventuring tasks.
mini_pow.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week of purchase with Standard Courier service.

usage.activation: Action: The item is consumed on use.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until the start of the creature's next turn).
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature leaves the pulse area or takes damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the item can only be used once per long rest.

mini_pow.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its useful utility in removing small threats without requiring a special action from the user.

minor_faction_favor.name: Minor Faction Favor Token
minor_faction_favor.description: The Minor Faction Favor Token is a small, intricately carved wooden chip adorned with sigils of local factions. When you present it to a trusted ally for assistance, they can provide you with a minor boon such as a safehouse, false papers, or even a battalion of 1d4 thugs to protect your interests. However, be wary; using the token burns bridges with rival factions, so use this favor wisely and only when truly needed.
effects: Call in one minor faction favor

effectDetails.title: Call in One Minor Favor
effectDetails.rules: You must present the token to a trusted ally from a local faction. They can provide you with assistance such as a safehouse, false papers, or 1d4 thugs. This favor is immediate and does not require any action on your part once presented.

effectDetails.title: Burns Bridges
effectDetails.rules: Using the token incurs bad blood between you and rival factions within that local area. This effect lasts until your next major faction interaction or until the rival faction's goodwill is restored through significant actions or events.

minor_faction_favor.levelRequirementReason: The Minor Faction Favor Token is accessible to lower-level characters who need immediate help but must be cautious with its use.
minor_faction_favor.vendorReason: Political Fixers often broker deals and favors, making them the logical vendor for such an item.
minor_faction_favor.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week by the Shady Messenger, with a 10% chance of the package being intercepted.

usage.activation: Presenting it to a trusted ally from a local faction
usage.duration: Instantaneous; effect lasts until rival factions' goodwill is restored or until your next major faction interaction
usage.endsWhen: Once used, the token is destroyed and cannot be reused

minor_faction_favor.priceReason: The Minor Faction Favor Token provides immediate but limited assistance, making it a valuable tool for players navigating complex political landscapes.

minor_invisibility_cloak_fragment.name: Minor Invisibility Cloak Fragment
minor_invisibility_cloak_fragment.description: A tattered fragment of an ancient cloak, this Minor Invisibility Cloak Fragment provides fleeting concealment. When donned, it grants you partial invisibility within dim light conditions, making your silhouette indistinct but not fully invisible. The fabric whispers with the scent of mothballs and hums faintly as it warps around your form, hinting at its magical origin. It is a relic crafted by the Arcane Tailor, known for their intricate tailor work. Be wary; this fragment wears out after 5 uses.

effectDetails.title: Partial Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you gain partial invisibility within dim light conditions. While invisible, attackers have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

effectDetails.title: Limited Uses
effectDetails.rules: The Minor Invisibility Cloak Fragment wears out after 5 uses. It must be mended by an Arcane Tailor to restore its functionality, which requires a successful DC 12 Craft (Tailoring) check.

minor_invisibility_cloak_fragment.levelRequirementReason: This fragment is suitable for adventurers of lower levels as it provides concealment without requiring high-level spellcasting.
minor_invisibility_cloak_fragment.vendorReason: The Arcane Tailor specializes in crafting and mending magical relics, including this rare fragment.
minor_invisibility_cloak_fragment.shippingDetail: Delivered by a swift messenger hawk, ensuring the package arrives swiftly and securely.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You attack or cast a spell; wears out after 5 uses

minor_invisibility_cloak_fragment.priceReason: This item strikes a balance, offering concealment without the cost of a full spell.

minor_potion_mixer_kit.name: Minor Potion Mixer Kit
minor_potion_mixer_kit.description: The Minor Potion Mixer Kit is a sturdy alchemy set crafted from iron and glass. It includes ten vials for storing simple healing potions, and its compact design makes it perfect for brewing on-the-go. With this kit, you can craft one minor potion of healing per long rest using common herbs. Crafting requires an hour and a successful Intelligence (Medicine) check at DC 14 to ensure the concoction's potency. The kit spills easily if mishandled, making it best suited for those with steady hands or magical fortitude.

effectDetails.title: Craft Healing Potions
effectDetails.rules: Craft one minor potion of healing (2d4+1 HP) per long rest using common herbs. Requires a successful Intelligence (Medicine) check at DC 14 and takes an hour to brew.

effectDetails.title: Sturdy Construction
effectDetails.rules: The kit's sturdy build provides a +1 bonus to the saving throw DC of any minor potion crafted, enhancing its effect.

minor_potion_mixer_kit.levelRequirementReason: Crafting potions requires basic alchemical knowledge and dexterity, making this kit suitable for characters with at least two levels.
minor_potion_mixer_kit.vendorReason: The Herbalists Hut specializes in items related to herbal medicine and alchemy, so it's no surprise they stock the Minor Potion Mixer Kit.
minor_potion_mixer_kit.shippingDetail: Ships via Glassware Padding, which ensures safe delivery even for fragile glassware.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect (potion ready at the end of the hour)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after crafting all vials or if mishandled and spills
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have herbs and time

minor_potion_mixer_kit.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the kit's materials (iron and glass) and its utility for basic potion crafting.

mints_that_freshen_breath_with.name: Wario's Garlic Breath Mints (Scam Breath!)
mints_that_freshen_breath_with.description: Wario's Garlic Breath Mints are twisted candies that claim to freshen breath with a garlicky punch. The packaging is slick, but the contents are just plain old garlic candy. Each mint grants you temporary immunity to bad-breath penalties for an hour, yet it also leaves your mouth smelling like a pizzeria kitchen for 10 minutes. Beware, though; this 'freshening' comes with a side of social awkwardness when dealing with normals.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Stench
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on saving throws against the effects of undead creatures, but you suffer disadvantage on Charisma (Interaction) checks and Insight checks with normal creatures. The mints last for 10 minutes after consumption.

effectDetails.title: Fresh Breath
effectDetails.rules: For an hour following consumption, you are immune to penalties from bad breath. However, the scent of garlic persists in your mouth for 10 minutes after this period ends.

mints_that_freshen_breath_with.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners who might find themselves in social or undead encounters without a better option.
mints_that_freshen_breath_with.vendorReason: Wario's Candy Scam Factory specializes in quirky, yet profitable, items that leave you laughing and losing gold.
mints_that_freshen_breath_with.shippingDetail: Delivered by Wario's minions; arrives with a loud 'whoosh' and an unexpected delivery fee.

usage.activation: Eat one mints as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 1 hour for the breath-freshening effect, followed by 10 minutes of garlic stench.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end after their respective durations.

mints_that_freshen_breath_with.priceReason: For a common item, these mints provide both a useful and humorous effect, making the price fair for players seeking an edge in certain situations.

mirror_of_second_chances.name: Mirror of Second Chances
mirror_of_second_chances.description: The Mirror of Second Chances is a small, hand-held mirror adorned with delicate feathers that shimmer like starlight. It allows its bearer to glimpse an alternate reality where a single choice was altered. By using it once per long rest, you can reroll a failed check or attack with advantage. However, if you choose to alter a major life decision shown in the mirror's reflection, it may demand a cherished memory as payment.

effectDetails.title: Reroll Failed Checks
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can use an action to interact with the mirror and reroll a failed ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. You must succeed on the new roll.

effectDetails.title: Demand for Memory
effectDetails.rules: If you choose to alter a major life decision shown in the mirror's reflection, it may demand a cherished memory from your past as payment. This memory cannot be regained through normal means and is considered lost forever.

mirror_of_second_chances.levelRequirementReason: The mirror requires minimal experience and wisdom to handle its powerful visions.
mirror_of_second_chances.vendorReason: Rare Relics specializes in ancient artifacts that offer unique insights into the past, making it a fitting vendor for this mirror.
mirror_of_second_chances.shippingDetail: The Mirror of Second Chances is carefully packed and shipped through Feathered Crate to ensure its delicate feathers remain intact during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, once per long rest
usage.endsWhen: Charges are exhausted or the mirror is destroyed

mirror_of_second_chances.priceReason: The Mirror of Second Chances provides significant advantages but at a steep personal cost when altering major decisions.

mirror_of_the_future_self.name: Mirror of the Future Self
mirror_of_the_future_self.description: The Mirror of the Future Self is a polished glass framed in dark mahogany. It whispers tales of what you will become if you do nothing to change your path. Glimpse into its depths, and you see an aged reflection of yourself, broken by time's relentless hand, standing alone in a desolate landscape. For 24 hours, you gain advantage on all saving throws, fortifying your resilience against the trials ahead. However, should you look again within seven days, you must make a DC 16 Wisdom save; failure leaves you haunted by the belief that you are already dead.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse of Your Future
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the mirror, you gain a vision of your future self if you do nothing to change your path. You have advantage on all saving throws for 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Belief in Death
effectDetails.rules: If you look into the mirror again within seven days, you must make a DC 16 Wisdom save; failure causes you to believe that you are already dead. This effect ends when you succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or after one week.

mirror_of_the_future_self.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest adventurer can benefit from knowing how their inaction will affect their future.
mirror_of_the_future_self.vendorReason: Dream Sanctuary specializes in curiosities that offer glimpses into the unknown, making it a fitting vendor for such a mirror.
mirror_of_the_future_self.shippingDetail: The mirror is carefully packed to prevent any distortion of your future vision during transit.

usage.duration: 24 hours
usage.endsWhen: You succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or after one week, whichever comes first

mirror_of_the_future_self.priceReason: The price reflects the mirror's rarity and the profound insight it offers into your future.

mistake.name: Mistake
mistake.description: This burnt, gooey mess of a potion, hastily crafted by Zess T., rests on a paper plate imbued with an eerie glow. The concoction's origin is as uncertain as its effects: it could be a failed attempt at an elixir or perhaps a mischievous prank gone awry. Regardless, consuming this Mistake can either heal you for 1d4 hit points or make you retch and lose your next turn to violent vomiting.

effectDetails.title: Healing Consumption
effectDetails.rules: Consume the Mistake as a bonus action. You regain 1d4 hit points. If you fail a Constitution saving throw (DC 12), you are incapacitated for 1 minute, retching uncontrollably.

effectDetails.title: Vomiting Reactions
effectDetails.rules: If you consume the Mistake and fail your Constitution save, you are incapacitated until the start of your next turn. During this time, you lose any actions you would have taken on that turn and cannot take reactions.

mistake.levelRequirementReason: The potion's unpredictable effects and potential for severe side effects require a minimum character level to safely handle.
mistake.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its eccentric wares, including the occasional failed or mischievous product from local alchemists like Zess T.
mistake.shippingDetail: Shipped in a sealed napkin to prevent any accidental contact with other goods.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; effect ends when the save is made or the turn ends
usage.endsWhen: On a failed Constitution saving throw or at the end of your next turn, whichever comes first

mistake.priceReason: The Mistake's unpredictable nature and the risk involved in its consumption justify its higher price.

mister_softener.name: Mr. Softener
mister_softener.description: Mr. Softener is a peculiar spray canister, its nozzle adorned with a soft, plush texture. This unique artifact, crafted from rare marshmallow fibers and imbued by the alchemists of the Cloudspire Academy, temporarily sponifies any armor you wear into something akin to a cloud of fluff. For 1 minute, your armor feels as yielding as cotton candy, reducing its Armor Class (AC) by 3 points—though it cannot reduce your AC below 10, lest you be left exposed and vulnerable.

effectDetails.title: Armor Feels Like Fluff
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, Mr. Softener causes the target's armor to momentarily lose its rigidity and feel like soft marshmallow. The target’s AC is reduced by 3 points for up to 1 minute. If at any point your AC would be reduced below 10, it remains at 10 until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Temporary AC Decrease
effectDetails.rules: This effect lasts for a full minute and can only be used once per short or long rest. It is an instantaneous action when activated.

mister_softener.levelRequirementReason: The alchemy involved in creating Mr. Softener requires basic knowledge of alchemical principles, which are typically learned at the earliest levels.
mister_softener.vendorReason: The Rogueport Black Market is known for its wide array of unusual and experimental items, including those that blur the line between practicality and whimsy.
mister_softener.shippingDetail: Mr. Softener arrives via a specially insulated aerosol canister to ensure it remains in optimal condition until use.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the target's AC would be reduced below 10, whichever occurs first.

mister_softener.priceReason: While not extraordinarily powerful, Mr. Softener offers a unique and entertaining use that is both memorable and slightly dangerous if overused.

mithral_golem_construction_kit.name: Mithral Golem Construction Kit
mithral_golem_construction_kit.description: The Mithral Golem Construction Kit contains all the adamantine and mithral components needed to craft a guardian of unparalleled strength and resilience, forged by Adamantine Foundry over thirty days in a ritual that imbues it with a personality of its own. This golem is both a loyal protector and an independent entity capable of forming bonds or alliances as it sees fit, making it more than just a tool for combat.

effectDetails.title: Construction Duration
effectDetails.rules: The golem takes exactly 30 days to construct, during which time the builder must spend at least one hour each day focused on the creation. If interrupted or neglected for more than a week, construction ceases until resumed.

effectDetails.title: Personality Development
effectDetails.rules: After completion, the golem's personality develops over time (1d4 months). The DM rolls secretly to determine the nature of its personality, which can range from fiercely loyal to independently minded. Once determined, it remains fixed until the golem is destroyed or reprogrammed.

mithral_golem_construction_kit.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least level 19 due to the complexity and power of creating such an advanced golem.
mithral_golem_construction_kit.vendorReason: Adamantine Foundry is renowned for crafting the most durable and intelligent constructs, making them the only vendor capable of selling this kit.
mithral_golem_construction_kit.shippingDetail: Ships via Golem Porter, a specialized courier that can deliver components safely over long distances using its own golem escorts.

usage.activation: The construction process is activated by the builder's focus and the kit’s ritual activation sequence. The golem becomes operational once constructed.
usage.duration: Instantaneous to complete with no ongoing effects after completion
usage.endsWhen: The golem is destroyed or reprogrammed, ending its personality development permanently.

mithral_golem_construction_kit.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as a rare and godly item that allows for the creation of an advanced construct with unique abilities.

mix_flower.name: Mix Flower
mix_flower.description: The Mix Flower is a rare and delicate plant that, when fully grown, can unleash a devastating fireball from the sky. This ancient artifact requires precise care and ritual to activate, as it draws power directly from celestial sources. Upon activation, it fires a massive fireball with pinpoint accuracy, obliterating all within its path. The crater left behind is not just an impact mark but a testament to the flower's otherworldly origin.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Fireball
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Mix Flower launches a fireball that deals 20d6 fire damage within a 50-foot radius. Targets must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 18) or take half damage and be knocked prone. The fireball ignores resistance to fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Crater of Desolation
effectDetails.rules: The impact leaves behind a permanent crater, marking the spot as desolate for 24 hours. This effect can only occur once per day.

mix_flower.levelRequirementReason: This ancient artifact requires the user to have basic knowledge of celestial rituals.
mix_flower.vendorReason: The market is known for its rare and exotic goods, including otherworldly artifacts like the Mix Flower.
mix_flower.shippingDetail: Ships via Orbital Drop Courier Service with a 2-day delivery time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day

mix_flower.priceReason: The Mix Flower is a rare and powerful artifact that requires significant resources to cultivate and maintain.

mnevis_order_sacred_bull_blessing.name: Mnevis Order Sacred Bull Blessing
mnevis_order_sacred_bull_blessing.description: The Mnevis Order Sacred Bull Blessing is a sacred amulet worn by initiates of the Mnevis Order. Crafted from polished obsidian and imbued with the essence of an ancient bull statue, it grants you the resilience and stubbornness of its namesake. Wearing this amulet, you find yourself immune to charm and fear spells for 7 days, but also suffer a -2 penalty on Persuasion checks due to your unyielding resolve.

effectDetails.title: Bull-like Stubbornness
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on saving throws against charm and fear effects, but suffer a -2 penalty on Persuasion checks for the duration of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Charm and Fear
effectDetails.rules: For 7 days after activation, you are immune to all charm and fear spells and abilities. This effect ends when you complete a short or long rest.

mnevis_order_sacred_bull_blessing.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is suitable for any initiate who needs extra resilience against magical coercion.
mnevis_order_sacred_bull_blessing.vendorReason: Mnevis Order priests are known for their expertise in crafting and distributing items that empower their followers.
mnevis_order_sacred_bull_blessing.shippingDetail: Ships within 2 game days via the Sacred Procession, delivered with a ceremonial blessing.

usage.activation: Wear it as an amulet and activate by completing a short or long rest.
usage.duration: 7 days from activation.
usage.endsWhen: Completion of a short or long rest.

mnevis_order_sacred_bull_blessing.priceReason: The amulet's balance comes from its unique combination of benefits and drawbacks that make it an attractive but not overpowered choice for players.

mnevis_order_sun_amulet_service.name: Mnevis Order Sun Amulet Service
mnevis_order_sun_amulet_service.description: The Mnevis Order Sun Amulet Service is a golden pendant imbued with solar magic. Crafted by Sun Priests in the heart of their temple, this amulet channels sunlight to enhance combat prowess and provide light. When exposed to daylight, it grants +1 to attack rolls for 8 hours, but it flickers and burns if left in darkness, causing minor discomfort. A beacon of light, it can be used once a day to cast the Light spell.

effectDetails.title: Solar Fortification
effectDetails.rules: Activates on exposure to sunlight. Grants +1 to attack rolls for 8 hours, with a minor discomfort penalty if used indoors or in darkness.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Light
effectDetails.rules: Can be activated as an action once per day to cast the Light spell (no concentration required), creating bright light in a 20-foot radius for up to 1 hour. Ends when the amulet is no longer exposed to sunlight.

mnevis_order_sun_amulet_service.levelRequirementReason: This amulet provides utility and minor combat enhancements suitable for lower-level characters.
mnevis_order_sun_amulet_service.vendorReason: The Mnevis Order is known for their mastery of solar magic, making them the ideal vendor for this item.
mnevis_order_sun_amulet_service.shippingDetail: Ships via Golden Chain courier with a standard delay of one week.

usage.activation: Activates on exposure to sunlight. Can be used once per day to cast Light.
usage.duration: Solar Fortification lasts for 8 hours in sunlight; Light spell lasts up to 1 hour when active.
usage.endsWhen: Discomfort ends if the amulet burns, and Light ends when not exposed to sunlight.

mnevis_order_sun_amulet_service.priceReason: This price reflects its utility in combat and magical casting, balanced with its limited duration and one-use per day feature.

mnevis_order_sun_baked_flatbread_recipe.name: Recipe: Mnevis Order Sun-Baked Flatbread
mnevis_order_sun_baked_flatbread_recipe.description: The Mnevis Order Sun-Baked Flatbread, a flatbread baked under the scorching sun, is more than just sustenance—it's a ritual that strengthens your resolve against darkness. Crafted by Sun Priests using only solar-kissed flour and the warmth of the midday sun, this flatbread imbues its eater with resilience. For 4 hours after consumption, you gain advantage on saving throws against spells or effects associated with darkness and shadow. The bread’s power is undeniable, as it has been blessed by Ra himself, who oversees its creation in his temple.

effectDetails.title: Solar Ward
effectDetails.rules: After eating a slice of the Mnevis Order Sun-Baked Flatbread, you gain advantage on saving throws against spells or effects associated with darkness and shadow for 4 hours. This effect cannot be used more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resilience Against Darkness
effectDetails.rules: For 8 hours after consuming the flatbread, you have resistance to damage from spells or effects that deal radiant or necrotic damage. You must consume a slice of this flatbread at least once every 24 hours to maintain this effect.

mnevis_order_sun_baked_flatbread_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The flatbread's power is accessible to all, as its creation and efficacy are rooted in the timeless rituals of the Sun Priests.
mnevis_order_sun_baked_flatbread_recipe.vendorReason: As the creators and keepers of this ancient recipe, it makes sense that Mnevis Order Temple would be the only vendor for this flatbread.
mnevis_order_sun_baked_flatbread_recipe.shippingDetail: The flatbread must be shipped under a protective sun shield to ensure its solar-kissed properties remain intact during transit.

usage.activation: Eating a slice of the Mnevis Order Sun-Baked Flatbread
usage.duration: 4 hours for Solar Ward; 8 hours for Resilience Against Darkness, both renewable with consumption
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each duration or upon expiration after not consuming another slice within 24 hours

mnevis_order_sun_baked_flatbread_recipe.priceReason: The flatbread’s rarity and the sacred process involved in its creation justify this price, ensuring only those who truly need it can obtain it.

mnevis_order_sun_flare_mantle.name: Mnevis Order Sun Flare Mantle
mnevis_order_sun_flare_mantle.description: The Mnevis Order Sun Flare Mantle is a woven mantle made from enchanted linen and sunlight. Its fabric shimmers with captured light, and it hums softly as it stores solar energy. In daylight, it grants +1 to Wisdom saving throws and allows you to cast the Minor Light spell once per day by channeling its stored sunlight. When worn in darkness, it briefly flares, blinding creatures within 5 feet for 1 minute, but this effect cannot be used more than twice a week.

effectDetails.title: Sunlight Storage
effectDetails.rules: You can cast the Minor Light spell once per day by concentrating on the mantle and channeling its stored sunlight. The duration of this spell is the same as normal, but it requires no material components.

effectDetails.title: Daytime Wisdom Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the mantle in daylight, you gain a +1 bonus to all Wisdom saving throws until dusk.

mnevis_order_sun_flare_mantle.levelRequirementReason: The Mantle is crafted for anyone who can afford it and benefits from its effects regardless of class or level.
mnevis_order_sun_flare_mantle.vendorReason: As a sacred relic of the Sun Priests, this mantle is sold exclusively by their temple to preserve ancient teachings and empower believers in light magic.
mnevis_order_sun_flare_mantle.shippingDetail: The mantle is delivered by Solar Shawl Courier with special delivery handling to ensure it arrives undamaged. The shipment takes a full day to reach its destination.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action when casting Minor Light, or passive effect while in daylight.
usage.duration: Minor Light: Concentration up to 10 minutes; Daytime Wisdom Boost: Until dusk
usage.endsWhen: Minor Light spell ends naturally, Daytime Wisdom Boost ends at dusk

mnevis_order_sun_flare_mantle.priceReason: The mantle is priced based on the rare materials used and its unique enchantment that stores sunlight.

mnevis_order_sun_mirror_focuser.name: Mnevis Order Sun Mirror Focuser
mnevis_order_sun_mirror_focuser.description: The Mnevis Order Sun Mirror Focuser is a gleaming brass device, its surface etched with arcane symbols. Crafted by the Sun Priests of the Mnevis Order, this tool can focus sunlight into a searing beam or diffuse light to enhance plant growth. When focused correctly, it grants advantage on checks involving solar heat for cooking and brewing. Misaim, however, results in a brief flash that temporarily blinds nearby creatures, though the device itself remains unharmed.
effects: Focuses sunlight into a searing beam

effectDetails.title: Sunbeam Focus
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this mirror focusses the sun's rays into a narrow beam. The target of your choice within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Solar Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this mirror diffuses sunlight to enhance plant growth. You gain advantage on checks involving solar heat for cooking and brewing. This effect lasts for 10 minutes.

mnevis_order_sun_mirror_focuser.levelRequirementReason: Requires no specific class or background, making it accessible to all adventurers.
mnevis_order_sun_mirror_focuser.vendorReason: The Mnevis Order is renowned for its expertise in solar magic and the creation of tools that harness the sun's power.
mnevis_order_sun_mirror_focuser.shippingDetail: Ships via Solar Wind Express, ensuring timely delivery across the land.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action to focus or diffuse sunlight.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for focusing; lasts 10 minutes when diffusing.
usage.endsWhen: Target successfully saves against blinding effect; duration ends naturally otherwise.

mnevis_order_sun_mirror_focuser.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique functionality justify its fair value in XP terms.

modron_march_calculator.name: Modron March Calculator
modron_march_calculator.description: The Modron March Calculator is a meticulously crafted, clockwork device that hums with the precision of Mechanus itself. This intricate machine can predict lawful-aligned events up to 24 hours in advance with uncanny accuracy. Its gears and cogs are etched with sigils from the farthest reaches of Mechanus, ensuring its forecasts hold true. Once per month, a user can force any creature within reach to reroll a single die roll, potentially altering fate at the last second.

effectDetails.title: Predict Lawful Events
effectDetails.rules: The user can make one prediction per day regarding a lawful-aligned event. This prediction is accurate for up to 24 hours, providing valuable foresight.

effectDetails.title: Forceful Die Reroll
effectDetails.rules: Once per month, the user can force any creature within reach to reroll a single die roll. The reroll must be used immediately after the original roll is made.

modron_march_calculator.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant understanding of lawful mechanics and precision engineering.
modron_march_calculator.vendorReason: The Mechanus Outpost specializes in items related to the lawful plane, making it a fitting vendor for this device.
modron_march_calculator.shippingDetail: Ships directly from Mechanus, ensuring the calculator arrives fully powered and calibrated.

usage.duration: Permanent until recharged or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted of charges or destroyed.

modron_march_calculator.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the device's ability to predict events and its one-time die-reroll utility.

molten_bracelet.name: Molten Bracelet
molten_bracelet.description: The Molten Bracelet hums softly against your wrist, a ring of cooled lava that warms your skin and pulses with fiery energy. Crafted from ancient volcanic glass and imbued with elemental magic, it not only shields you from fire damage but also projects an aura that scorches attackers within its reach. The bracelet's molten core can melt fragile items on touch, a reminder of the raw power it wields.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Molten Bracelet, you have resistance to fire damage. This effect is always active while the bracelet is worn.

effectDetails.title: Molten Aura
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can activate your Molten Aura, creating a 10-foot radius of searing heat centered on yourself. Any creature within this area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 fire damage.

molten_bracelet.levelRequirementReason: The bracelet's power requires a proficient spellcaster to channel the elemental magic effectively.
molten_bracelet.vendorReason: Steamworks specializes in arcane and alchemical items, making it an appropriate vendor for such a powerful piece of equipment.
molten_bracelet.shippingDetail: The Molten Bracelet is shipped securely within a lead-lined pouch to protect against accidental damage during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; ends immediately after use
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts upon use, recharges at the start of your next long rest

molten_bracelet.priceReason: The bracelet's unique crafting materials and powerful elemental magic justify its high price.

monks_order_meditation_beads_service.name: Monks Order Meditation Beads Service
monks_order_meditation_beads_service.description: The Monks Order Meditation Beads are intricately carved with symbols of peace and resilience. These beads are said to channel the tranquility of the Order's sacred grounds, allowing you to draw inner strength during times of stress. The rhythmic clicks of the beads serve as a constant reminder to focus on your center. This relic grants advantage on Wisdom saving throws and allows you to regain 1 ki point or inspiration when meditated upon.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When you take the Attentive action, you gain advantage on Wisdom saving throws until the end of your next turn. This effect lasts for a short duration and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Inner Peace
effectDetails.rules: You may focus on the beads to regain 1 ki point or inspiration. This action is a bonus action, and you can use this feature three times per long rest, recovering one additional use when you finish a short rest.

monks_order_meditation_beads_service.levelRequirementReason: This item serves as an introduction to the concept of inner peace and focus for players at the beginning of their journey.
monks_order_meditation_beads_service.vendorReason: The Monks Order are known for their teachings on meditation and inner strength, making them the perfect vendors for these beads.
monks_order_meditation_beads_service.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Prayer String, a courier that ensures spiritual blessings accompany your package.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as part of the Attentive action
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn for Wisdom Advantage. Instantaneous for Inner Peace.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you no longer need it during a short rest, or at the start of your next long rest.
usage.charges: 3 uses per long rest; regains one use after each short rest.

monks_order_meditation_beads_service.priceReason: This price reflects its uncommon rarity and utility as an introductory tool for meditation and focus, suitable for starting players.

monks_order_zen_garden_raking.name: Monks Order Zen Garden Raking Service
monks_order_zen_garden_raking.description: With a practiced stroke of the rake, the Monks Order Zen Garden Raking Service calms your mind and spirit. The gardeners' precision clears away mental fatigue, leaving you refreshed. For an hour after use, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, enhancing your awareness of the world around you. However, to maintain this peace, you must meditate for one hour each morning; failing to do so incurs a level of exhaustion.

effectDetails.title: Mental Refreshment
effectDetails.rules: When you use the service, you are no longer considered to be suffering from a level of exhaustion caused by stress. This effect lasts until the start of your next day.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Awareness
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after using the service, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. This effect ends when you fall unconscious or at the end of your next long rest.

monks_order_zen_garden_raking.levelRequirementReason: This service is suitable for all levels as it aids in maintaining mental clarity and focus.
monks_order_zen_garden_raking.vendorReason: The Monks Order Gardeners are known for their dedication to mental well-being through natural means.
monks_order_zen_garden_raking.shippingDetail: Delivered within the day by Peaceful Courier, ensuring your mind is ready for the challenges ahead.

usage.activation: A daily service provided upon request.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with ongoing benefits for one hour.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next day or when you fall unconscious or complete a long rest.

monks_order_zen_garden_raking.priceReason: The service is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its value in providing mental clarity and enhancing perception.

monks_order_zen_garden_raking_premium.name: Monks Order Zen Garden Raking (Premium)
monks_order_zen_garden_raking_premium.description: The Monks Order Zen Garden Raking (Premium) is a meticulously crafted rake that channels the serene essence of a master gardener's touch. This premium tool not only clears away mental distractions but also leaves behind a sense of calm and clarity. Using this rake during your meditative practice ensures that you achieve perfect balance, allowing you to effortlessly clear two layers of exhaustion from your mind while gaining advantage on Wisdom saving throws for the next 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Zen Clearing
effectDetails.rules: When you use this rake, you clear two levels of exhaustion and gain advantage on Wisdom saving throws for the next 24 hours. This effect ends if you lose your temper or engage in combat.

effectDetails.title: Mindful Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You must maintain a state of zen while using this rake; otherwise, you take a -5 penalty to all ability checks until your next long rest. If you get angry or lose your temper, the rake's benefits are immediately lost.

monks_order_zen_garden_raking_premium.levelRequirementReason: This premium tool requires a certain level of mental discipline and focus for its full effect.
monks_order_zen_garden_raking_premium.vendorReason: Monks Order Master Gardeners have perfected the art of creating tools that enhance one's inner peace and clarity, making this rake an essential part of their offerings.
monks_order_zen_garden_raking_premium.shippingDetail: Ships with the Peaceful Courier within a week; requires special handling to ensure its delicate craftsmanship remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts for 24 hours on successful use
usage.endsWhen: If you lose your temper or engage in combat, the effect ends immediately

monks_order_zen_garden_raking_premium.priceReason: The premium quality and craftsmanship of this rake justify its relatively lower price compared to other rare items.

monks_order_zen_meditation_mill.name: Monks Order Zen Meditation Mill
monks_order_zen_meditation_mill.description: The Monks Order Zen Meditation Mill is a sleek, hand-cranked contraption made of polished bamboo and jade. It hums with an ancient tune as it turns, its precision crafted to grind noodles into a smooth paste that enhances flavor and texture. Users gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to food preparation and can choose one ability check involving the use of tools each day to be treated as magically calmed, reducing stress immediately.

effectDetails.title: Grinds Mindfully
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the mill for grinding noodles, you gain advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) check related to food preparation. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Magical Calm
effectDetails.rules: Once per day upon activation, you can choose one ability check involving the use of tools and treat it as if you had a calm mind (no penalties for stress). This effect ends when used.

monks_order_zen_meditation_mill.levelRequirementReason: The mill is designed to be accessible to beginners in cooking or monks seeking a simpler life.
monks_order_zen_meditation_mill.vendorReason: Monks of the Order are known for their culinary expertise and this mill is a product of their meticulous craftsmanship.
monks_order_zen_meditation_mill.shippingDetail: Ships via messenger pigeon, delivered within one week.

usage.activation: Action (activate once per short or long rest)
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest; ends when used for calm mind effect
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next short or long rest after use, or if you deactivate it early

monks_order_zen_meditation_mill.priceReason: The mill is crafted with rare bamboo and jade, making it a valuable tool for both monks and travelers.

monks_order_zen_robe.name: Monks Order Zen Robe
monks_order_zen_robe.description: The Monks Order Zen Robe is a flowing garment made from the softest silk and lined with whispers of the natural world. Woven by the skilled artisans of the Order Weavers, it hums with calm during meditation, granting its wearer advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks while in deep focus. The robe's fabric is so finely crafted that it barely brushes against the skin, yet it offers a subtle resistance to the pull of harsh terrain, aiding concentration even when feet slip over rocky ground.

effectDetails.title: Mindful Insight
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this robe during meditation, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks. This effect lasts for the duration of your meditation session.

effectDetails.title: Rugged Focus
effectDetails.rules: The robe's fabric provides a +1 bonus to your Concentration saving throws and ability checks made while standing on rough terrain, such as rocky or sandy ground. This effect persists until you stop meditating or leave the rough area.

monks_order_zen_robe.levelRequirementReason: The robe's intricate design and material require a proficient wearer capable of focusing on meditation.
monks_order_zen_robe.vendorReason: Trained artisans at the Order Weavers forge these robes to aid in their monks' spiritual and physical discipline.
monks_order_zen_robe.shippingDetail: The robe is carefully packed to ensure it arrives in perfect condition, even over long distances.

usage.duration: While meditating and for up to an hour after stopping meditation.
usage.endsWhen: You stop meditating or leave the rough terrain area.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a passive effect.

monks_order_zen_robe.priceReason: The robe's fine silk and artisanal craftsmanship justify a price that reflects its utility without overshadowing more powerful items.

monks_order_zen_zen_noodles_recipe.name: Recipe: Monks Order Zen Zen Noodles
monks_order_zen_zen_noodles_recipe.description: The Recipe: Monks Order Zen Zen Noodles is a parchment of serene wisdom and balance, carefully crafted by the Order Cooks in their temple kitchen. Its inked pages detail the precise method to boil noodles in harmony with meditation, ensuring each bite brings calm and clarity. When you consume these noodles, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Medicine) checks for 2 hours, and you are immediately calmed, removing any state of stress or exhaustion.

effectDetails.title: Zen Noodle Calm
effectDetails.rules: Eating the noodles allows you to instantly remove any stressed or exhausted condition. This effect is instantaneous and does not have a duration.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom (Medicine) Boost
effectDetails.rules: By consuming the noodles, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Medicine) checks for 2 hours. This benefit requires no action to activate but ends when the time expires or if you consume another meal that grants a similar effect.

monks_order_zen_zen_noodles_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible at level 1 as it promotes basic meditative and culinary skills.
monks_order_zen_zen_noodles_recipe.vendorReason: The monks of the temple are known for their mastery over both spiritual and practical matters, including the art of cooking and sharing such wisdom through recipes.
monks_order_zen_zen_noodles_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered with a serene message from the Order Cooks wishing you peace in your endeavors.

usage.duration: 2 hours
usage.endsWhen: Expiration or consumption of another meal that grants similar benefits

monks_order_zen_zen_noodles_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's price is set at 1000 XP, reflecting the effort and knowledge required to create such a revered culinary practice.

monsters_grognak_fur_loincloth.name: Monsters Grognak Fur Loincloth
monsters_grognak_fur_loincloth.description: The Monsters Grognak Fur Loincloth is a barbarian-style garment made from the rugged pelts of Grognaks, fierce creatures from the deep woods. It grants +1 to Strength (Intimidation) and adds an authentic, albeit itchy, touch to any battle. Crafted by Monster Comic Crafters using actual fur, this item not only boosts your intimidation prowess but also subtly makes you a walking distraction with its tendency to attract unwanted attention.

effectDetails.title: Strength (Intimidation) Boost
effectDetails.rules: Grants +1 bonus to Strength (Intimidation) checks. This effect is active as long as the item is worn.

effectDetails.title: Itchy Distraction
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this loincloth, you suffer from a minor itchiness that can be alleviated by making an Athletics check with disadvantage. The effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

monsters_grognak_fur_loincloth.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for adventurers at the beginning of their journey, offering them a small but useful boost.
monsters_grognak_fur_loincloth.vendorReason: The Monsters Cave is known for its unique and often quirky items crafted by local artisans using materials from the wild.
monsters_grognak_fur_loincloth.shippingDetail: Ships via Furry Patch Express, a reliable courier service that ensures prompt delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing as long as the item is worn.
usage.endsWhen: Rests or removal of the loincloth.

monsters_grognak_fur_loincloth.priceReason: The price reflects the unique materials used in its creation, including the rare Grognak fur and the labor-intensive crafting process by Monster Comic Crafters.

monsters_grognak_steak_knives.name: Monsters Grognak Steak Knives
monsters_grognak_steak_knives.description: The Monsters Grognak Steak Knives are colossal, bone-chipped steel cleavers forged in the savage forges of the Grognak mountains. These knives are not just weapons but also culinary tools, crafted to slice through even the toughest barbarian steaks with ease. Their massive size makes them ill-suited for intricate work, but their edge is sharp enough to deliver +1 damage when used as a weapon in a brief melee encounter. Craftsmen from the Grognak lair are known for their brutal and efficient designs, and these knives embody that ethos perfectly.

effectDetails.title: Tough Meat Cutter
effectDetails.rules: When used to carve meat, the wielder gains advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks. This effect lasts until the end of the wielder's next turn.

effectDetails.title: Brief Melee Weapon
effectDetails.rules: If used as a melee weapon for no more than two turns, the wielder deals an additional +1 damage. The knife cannot be used in this manner again until after a short or long rest.

monsters_grognak_steak_knives.levelRequirementReason: These knives are designed to be immediately usable by anyone, even those just starting their adventures.
monsters_grognak_steak_knives.vendorReason: The Monsters Lair specializes in selling the tools and weapons crafted by the Grognak forges, ensuring adventurers have the gear they need right from the start of their journey.
monsters_grognak_steak_knives.shippingDetail: These knives are shipped via Raging Wind Express, known for its swift delivery through treacherous mountain passes.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when used to carve or as a weapon in melee combat.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn after carving; until the start of your next turn after using it as a weapon.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends naturally at the specified duration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but cannot be used as a weapon again for 1d4+1 turns without resting.

monsters_grognak_steak_knives.priceReason: Crafted by skilled blacksmiths in the Grognak mountains, these knives offer both utility and durability at this balanced price.

monsters_grognak_steak_recipe.name: Recipe: Monsters Grognak Steak
monsters_grognak_steak_recipe.description: Crafted from a monstrous rump roast that defies belief, this recipe for Monsters Grognak Steak is a feast fit for barbarian kings. The meat's origin tells of a battle where the largest beast bled into a single, colossal cut. Consuming it grants +2 Strength and the raw power to shatter bones in combat, but at the cost of -1 Intelligence, leaving diners speechless for an hour after their meal.

effectDetails.title: Grill huge steak
effectDetails.rules: Eating the cooked steak restores +2 Strength for 1 hour. It can be prepared by a chef or barbarian with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Survival) check.

effectDetails.title: Meat coma
effectDetails.rules: After eating, the consumer suffers a -1 penalty to Intelligence checks and saving throws until their next long rest. This effect can only be endured once per day.

monsters_grognak_steak_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic combat experience and strength to handle the massive cut.
monsters_grognak_steak_recipe.vendorReason: The lair's chef specializes in exotic meat dishes, including legendary cuts like this one.
monsters_grognak_steak_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by a magical beast courier, ensuring freshness during travel.

usage.activation: Consuming the cooked steak upon completion of grilling.
usage.duration: 1 hour and until next long rest after eating.
usage.endsWhen: The effect is no longer active when the consumer's next long rest occurs.

monsters_grognak_steak_recipe.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its rare and powerful nature while remaining accessible for a mid-level character.

monsters_grognak_style_axe_premium.name: Monsters Grognak-Style Axe
monsters_grognak_style_axe_premium.description: The Monsters Grognak-Style Axe is a barbarian axe forged from the very bones of its namesake, Grognak the Grim. Its massive frame and comic book flair intimidate foes at first glance, and its hilt is adorned with a skull that glows faintly in the dark. This weapon grants +1 damage on attacks and allows you to pose for an extra point of inspiration if you score a critical hit. It also intimidates with a +2 bonus when you use your Intimidation skill or make a pose.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Presence
effectDetails.rules: When you score a critical hit with this axe, you can make a DC 15 Intimidation check as an immediate reaction. On a success, one creature of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Critical Inspiration
effectDetails.rules: If you score a critical hit with the Monsters Grognak-Style Axe, you regain 1d4 + your Charisma modifier inspiration points. This effect can occur only once per short rest.

monsters_grognak_style_axe_premium.levelRequirementReason: This axe is designed for seasoned barbarians who have already proven their strength and prowess in battle.
monsters_grognak_style_axe_premium.vendorReason: Monsters Lair specializes in weapons forged by legendary blacksmiths, making the Monsters Grognak-Style Axe a natural fit for their inventory.
