monsters_grognak_style_axe_premium.shippingDetail: The axe is shipped wrapped in comic book pages and arrives with a free copy of 'Grognak's Grim Adventures'.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect on critical hit, passive intimidation presence available as an immediate reaction.
usage.duration: Intimidation effect lasts for 1 minute or until the target is no longer within range.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are incapacitated or die.

monsters_grognak_style_axe_premium.priceReason: This axe's rarity, unique design, and special abilities justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

monty_mole_drill.name: Monty Mole Drill
monty_mole_drill.description: The Monty Mole Drill is a compact, drill-shaped device forged from enchanted steel and adorned with emblems of ancient earth spirits. It hums with latent power when activated, capable of burrowing through soft earth at an impressive rate of 20 feet per round, leaving behind a shimmering trail of mineral dust. The drill’s sharp teeth deliver a piercing blow upon underground attacks, dealing 2d6 damage to foes encountered in the depths below. With three charges replenished daily by the whimsical gnomes of Gilded Gryphon, this tool is perfect for adventurers seeking to explore hidden caverns and ancient ruins.

effectDetails.title: Burrowing Drill
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Monty Mole Drill burrows through soft earth at a rate of 20 feet per round. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn or when you stop using it. If you move into or through soft earth with this feature active, you leave behind a trail of mineral dust that can be seen from above.

effectDetails.title: Underground Pierce
effectDetails.rules: As an action while underground, the Monty Mole Drill delivers a piercing attack against creatures within 30 feet. The attack deals 2d6 piercing damage and has advantage if you have burrowed through soft earth to reach your target.

monty_mole_drill.levelRequirementReason: This tool is designed for adventurers who are just starting their journey, allowing them to explore underground without requiring high-level proficiency.
monty_mole_drill.vendorReason: The gnomes of Gilded Gryphon specialize in crafting tools that enhance exploration and adventure, making the Monty Mole Drill a natural addition to their inventory.
monty_mole_drill.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week by the Swift Gnome Delivery Service, ensuring adventurers can begin their explorations without delay.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn or when stopped using it
usage.endsWhen: Stop using it or reach solid stone

monty_mole_drill.priceReason: The Monty Mole Drill offers a unique combination of utility and combat capability, making it a valuable tool for explorers without being overpowered.

monty_mole_tunnel_map.name: Monty Mole's Tunnel Map
monty_mole_tunnel_map.description: Monty Mole's Tunnel Map is a weathered parchment stained with dirt and worm droppings, revealing ancient tunnels beneath the earth. It occasionally shows hidden passageways, though it may mislead you by being upside down more than half the time. This map has an uncanny knack for leading adventurers to either treasure or toilets—though the latter often involves a detour through damp underground chambers teeming with moles eager for worms in exchange for navigation advice.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can unfold the map to reveal up to 1d4 hidden passageways in the current area. These are likely to lead either to treasure or a detour through moles' burrows. The map has a 25% chance of being upside down, causing you to become disoriented if not corrected by a successful Wisdom (Perception) check with a DC of 13.

effectDetails.title: Moles' Misleading Map
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn while holding this map, there is a 20% chance that moles will offer you information about nearby tunnels in exchange for worms. If you refuse or fail to provide the requested worms, the map may become even more confusing, doubling its upside-down chances until it is corrected.

monty_mole_tunnel_map.levelRequirementReason: This item's unpredictable nature and the need for quick decision-making make it suitable for adventurers who have reached at least first level.
monty_mole_tunnel_map.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post often deals in relics from the underground, which makes sense given their proximity to ancient tunnels and moles' lairs.
monty_mole_tunnel_map.shippingDetail: The map is delivered wrapped tightly in earthworm casings for protection against dampness during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, ends on the next turn
usage.endsWhen: If you fail a Wisdom (Perception) check or refuse to trade worms with moles

monty_mole_tunnel_map.priceReason: The map's unpredictable nature and the value of information in underground exploration justify its moderate price.

moonfang_pack_howl_charm.name: Moonfang Pack Howl Charm
moonfang_pack_howl_charm.description: The Moonfang Pack Howl Charm is a wolf-fang amulet, a relic of ancient werewolf clans. Crafted from moonlit bone and enchanted by the pack’s howls, it grants you a taste of their unity and strength. When you howl under a crescent moon, you and your allies within 30 feet gain +5 temporary hit points as if bonded by a shared purpose. This charm also sharpens your senses, giving you advantage on checks to track or intimidate beasts, as the pack’s wisdom guides your every move.

effectDetails.title: Pack Bond
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can howl under a crescent moon. You and all allies within 30 feet gain +5 temporary hit points until the end of your next turn. This effect can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on checks to track or intimidate beasts for 1 hour, during which time you are considered a member of the pack. This effect ends when you leave an area dominated by beast sounds.

moonfang_pack_howl_charm.levelRequirementReason: The Moonfang Pack Howl Charm requires a level 3 character to harness its power and align with the pack's strength.
moonfang_pack_howl_charm.vendorReason: Moonfang Pack, as the keepers of the amulet’s lore, are trusted to sell items that echo their legacy.
moonfang_pack_howl_charm.shippingDetail: The charm is delivered by a trusted pack runner who ensures it arrives howling with fresh moonlight.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Leaving an area dominated by beast sounds or using Pack Bond again on the same short rest

moonfang_pack_howl_charm.priceReason: Crafted from rare moonlit bone and imbued with ancient magic, the Moonfang Pack Howl Charm is a balanced purchase for characters seeking to connect with their inner pack.

moonfang_pack_howl_horn_funnel.name: Moonfang Pack Howl Horn Funnel
moonfang_pack_howl_horn_funnel.description: This funnel is shaped like a wolf's howling horn and crafted from polished black obsidian. When used to pour berry jam, it channels lunar energy, granting advantage on checks made at night. The howl of the pack can be heard for miles when in use, alerting all nearby members of your location and activities. Pack Carvers forged this tool with ancient techniques, ensuring its durability and magical properties are maintained.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Pour
effectDetails.rules: When used to pour liquids at night, the user gains advantage on checks related to food preparation. This effect lasts for the duration of a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Pack Alert
effectDetails.rules: The funnel emits a loud howl when in use, alerting all members of the local Moonfang Pack within 1 mile. The sound can be heard even through noise and obstacles if conditions are favorable. This effect lasts until the funnel is put away or the user stops pouring.

moonfang_pack_howl_horn_funnel.levelRequirementReason: This item aids in night activities but does not require high-level proficiency to use.
moonfang_pack_howl_horn_funnel.vendorReason: Moonfang Pack Carvers are renowned for their craftsmanship and knowledge of the pack's needs, making this funnel a standard item.
moonfang_pack_howl_horn_funnel.shippingDetail: The funnel is delivered with a special delivery ensuring it arrives in perfect condition without any damage.

usage.activation: As an action when pouring liquids at night.
usage.duration: Until the user stops using it or completes a short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The funnel is put away or the user ceases pouring.

moonfang_pack_howl_horn_funnel.priceReason: The item's unique crafting and magical properties justify this price, providing significant utility for night activities.

moonfang_pack_howl_ritual_service.name: Moonfang Pack Howl Ritual Service
moonfang_pack_howl_ritual_service.description: Invoke the ancient howl of the Moonfang Pack, a ritual that calls forth spectral wolves to aid you in battle. These spirits are not mere illusions but spectral kin, offering true combat support for an hour. The echoes of their howls ripple across the battlefield, alerting enemies of your presence and drawing their attention away from allies. Crafted by Werewolf Shamans using ancient rituals and moonlit herbs, this service is a potent tool in any werewolf's arsenal.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Wolf Aid
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Summons 1d4 spectral wolves that provide aid in battle for 1 hour. Each wolf deals 1d6 damage per round to enemies within reach, and they can take the Attack action on their turn.

effectDetails.title: Alert Echoes
effectDetails.rules: The howl creates an echoing effect that alerts allies and distracts enemies. Enemies within a 30-foot radius must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12) or become distracted until the start of your next turn.

moonfang_pack_howl_ritual_service.levelRequirementReason: This ritual service is complex, requiring significant magical knowledge and control over spectral wolves.
moonfang_pack_howl_ritual_service.vendorReason: Moonfang Pack Den specializes in werewolf-related rituals and services, as they are the heart of the Moonfang Pack's territory.
moonfang_pack_howl_ritual_service.shippingDetail: The delivery is expedited by Lunar Call Express, ensuring the ritual service arrives at the correct phase of the moon for maximum potency.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The howl fades after an hour or when a successful saving throw is made against the Alert Echoes effect.

moonfang_pack_howl_ritual_service.priceReason: This ritual service is moderately priced due to its utility in battle and the specialized knowledge required for its activation.

moonfang_pack_wolf_berry_jam_recipe.name: Recipe: Moonfang Pack Wolf Berry Jam
moonfang_pack_wolf_berry_jam_recipe.description: This recipe for Moonfang Pack Wolf Berry Jam yields a thick, dark purple spread that exudes the essence of the lunar cycle. Only forager wolves who understand the pack's howls can create this jam, which is said to strengthen their pack bonds and enhance their senses. The jam's flavor transforms bread into a night-vision aid, granting creatures within 30 feet darkvision for four hours when spread on bread at twilight or dawn.

effectDetails.title: Moonlight Jam
effectDetails.rules: When a creature consumes one slice of bread with jam spread, it gains darkvision for 4 hours within 30 feet. This effect lasts until the creature finishes its next long rest or is dispelled.

effectDetails.title: Pack Bond Strengthening
effectDetails.rules: While using this recipe, the pack's bonds are temporarily strengthened, increasing each member's Charisma by +1 for 4 hours. This effect ends if a pack member leaves the area of effect, or when the jam is consumed.

moonfang_pack_wolf_berry_jam_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Only experienced foragers can correctly harvest and process the lunar berries necessary for this recipe.
moonfang_pack_wolf_berry_jam_recipe.vendorReason: The Moonfang Pack Lairs hold exclusive knowledge of wolfberry harvesting in the night's cycle.
moonfang_pack_wolf_berry_jam_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by full moon, ensuring the berries are at their peak freshness and potency.

usage.activation: Consume one slice of bread with jam spread at twilight or dawn.
usage.duration: 4 hours upon consumption until next long rest or dispelled.
usage.endsWhen: Upon finishing a long rest, or if the jam is consumed by another creature.

moonfang_pack_wolf_berry_jam_recipe.priceReason: The rarity and the specialized knowledge required to create this recipe justify its modest price in XP.

moonfang_pack_wolf_pelt_mantle.name: Moonfang Pack Wolf Pelt Mantle
moonfang_pack_wolf_pelt_mantle.description: The Moonfang Pack Wolf Pelt Mantle is a rugged, moonlit cloak made from the pelts of wolves that roamed the lunar glades. It whispers in the wind and howls faintly under the full moon, lending it an ethereal glow. The mantle grants advantage on Survival checks for tracking during the night and enhances the wearer's ability to notice pack movements by +1 to Wisdom (Perception) when in a group of animals or people.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Tracking
effectDetails.rules: When under a full moon, the wearer gains advantage on Survival checks related to tracking. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn after the moon sets.

effectDetails.title: Pack Awareness
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made while in close proximity to a group of animals or people, enhancing their ability to notice movements and sounds. This benefit lasts until the end of each long rest.

moonfang_pack_wolf_pelt_mantle.levelRequirementReason: The mantle's effects are subtle but useful for new adventurers looking to enhance their wilderness skills.
moonfang_pack_wolf_pelt_mantle.vendorReason: Moonfang Pack Lair specializes in goods made from the pelts of wolves and other creatures found within their territory, making this mantle a natural addition to their offerings.
moonfang_pack_wolf_pelt_mantle.shippingDetail: The pelt mantle is carefully packed for safe delivery, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after the moon sets or at the end of a long rest, respectively
usage.endsWhen: At the conclusion of the applicable duration or when worn by another adventurer

moonfang_pack_wolf_pelt_mantle.priceReason: The mantle is crafted from rare wolf pelts and handcrafted with arcane techniques to enhance its abilities, making it a valuable but not overpriced purchase for adventurers.

mordor_ash_baked_potatoes_recipe.name: Recipe: Mordor Ash-Baked Potatoes
mordor_ash_baked_potatoes_recipe.description: The Mordor Ash-Baked Potatoes are a rare delicacy forged from volcanic ash and spiced with the earth's fiery essence. These potatoes, baked to perfection in the very heart of Mount Doom, grant you resistance to fire damage for an hour after consumption. The recipe is said to have been taught by the Orc Camp Cooks, whose secrets are as guarded as Mordor itself. Each bite leaves a smoky, unforgettable taste that lingers like the shadow of Mount Doom.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you consume these potatoes, you gain resistance to fire damage for one hour. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Smoky Flavor
effectDetails.rules: After eating the potatoes, you suffer a -1 penalty to saving throws against being charmed until the end of your next short rest. This effect is not cumulative with other similar effects.

mordor_ash_baked_potatoes_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and danger involved in obtaining the ingredients make this recipe accessible only to characters of at least fifth level.
mordor_ash_baked_potatoes_recipe.vendorReason: Land Mordor Forge is a trusted source for items from the fiery heart of Middle-earth, including this rare dish.
mordor_ash_baked_potatoes_recipe.shippingDetail: The potatoes are shipped wrapped in volcanic ash to preserve their potency and flavor. Delivery may take an extra day due to hazardous conditions in Mordor.

usage.duration: One hour, until the end of your next short rest if incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or the duration expires

mordor_ash_baked_potatoes_recipe.priceReason: The potatoes are priced at 1000 XP, reflecting their rare ingredients and the danger involved in obtaining them.

mordor_ash_phoenix_feather.name: Mordor Ash-Phoenix Feather
mordor_ash_phoenix_feather.description: The Mordor Ash-Phoenix Feather burns with an eerie, dark glow that seems to feed on the very light of day itself. Crafted from the ash of a phoenix by the grim artisans of Barad-dûr Wildlife Control, it smells faintly of sulfur and attracts orcs within a mile radius, drawing them toward its malevolent presence. This relic offers protection against the fear tactics of undead and fiends for an entire month, while granting the user Darkvision that lasts for eight hours upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Darkvision Granting
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this feather grants the user Darkvision out to a range of 120 feet for eight hours. There is no limit to the number of times it can be used.

effectDetails.title: Fiendish Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The bearer gains immunity to fear effects from undead and fiends, lasting for thirty days after activation. This effect does not stack with other forms of fear immunities or resistances.

mordor_ash_phoenix_feather.levelRequirementReason: This feather is crafted by Barad-dûr Wildlife Control, making it accessible to lower-level adventurers who might find themselves facing undead and fiendish threats.
mordor_ash_phoenix_feather.vendorReason: Land Mordor Supply stocks a variety of items useful for survival in Mordor's harsh environment, including the Mordor Ash-Phoenix Feather.
mordor_ash_phoenix_feather.shippingDetail: Due to the cursed nature of this item, it is shipped via Nazgûl Express with a delayed delivery. Expect an additional delay of three days beyond standard shipping times.

usage.duration: 8 hours for Darkvision; 30 days for Fiendish Fear Resistance
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration ends naturally

mordor_ash_phoenix_feather.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's rarity and utility, offering a solid value for adventurers facing undead and fiendish threats.

mordor_ashen_dagger.name: Mordor Ashen Dagger
mordor_ashen_dagger.description: The Mordor Ashen Dagger is a blackened blade forged in the fires of Mount Doom, its edge sharp enough to cleave through even the darkest shadows. Its pommel glows faintly with an inner fire that ignites any flammable material it touches, and its hilt bears the insignia of the Dark Lord's eye. This weapon is not just a tool for assassination; it whispers dark secrets in the heart of night, tempting the wielder to embrace the shadow side of their soul.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you score a hit with this weapon in complete darkness, you gain advantage on your next attack roll. If the target is reduced to half its hit points or fewer during the encounter, you regain all expended spell slots.

effectDetails.title: Flame Touch
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can touch a flammable object with this dagger. The object ignites in a small burst of flame, dealing 1d6 fire damage to any creature within 5 feet that is touching it or holding it.

mordor_ashen_dagger.levelRequirementReason: The Mordor Ashen Dagger requires a minimum level to wield its dark powers and avoid succumbing to their influence.
mordor_ashen_dagger.vendorReason: Land Mordor is the only place where such a weapon can be forged, making it the sole vendor of this item.
mordor_ashen_dagger.shippingDetail: The Orc Courier delivers with a grumble and a story about how this dagger almost set his armor on fire during shipment.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used or Expend

mordor_ashen_dagger.priceReason: The price reflects the rare materials and dark magic required to craft this weapon, as well as its potential for both lethal and strategic use.

mordor_ashen_robe.name: Mordor Ashen Robe
mordor_ashen_robe.description: The Mordor Ashen Robe is a soot-stained garment that seamlessly blends with volcanic landscapes. Crafted by the Mordor Weavers from ash and brimstone, it radiates an aura of subtle fire magic. The robe grants you advantage on Stealth checks in ash or smoke-filled areas, making you nearly invisible among volcanic vents. It also offers a minor defense against fire, absorbing 1d4 fire damage once per day before disintegrating into harmless ash.

effectDetails.title: Ash Camouflage
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the robe's camouflage effect. While active, you gain advantage on Stealth checks in ash or smoke-filled areas for 1 hour. The effect ends when you stop wearing the robe.

effectDetails.title: Fire Absorption
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can touch the robe to absorb 1d4 fire damage. This effect is a reaction and cannot be used if you are immune to fire damage. The robe disintegrates into harmless ash after one use.

mordor_ashen_robe.levelRequirementReason: This level requirement reflects its unique crafting from volcanic materials.
mordor_ashen_robe.vendorReason: Land Mordor Forge specializes in crafting items that resonate with the fiery essence of Mordor.
mordor_ashen_robe.shippingDetail: The robe is shipped wrapped in volcanic pumice to protect it during transit, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Ash Camouflage; Reaction for Fire Absorption
usage.duration: 1 hour for Ash Camouflage; Instantaneous for Fire Absorption
usage.endsWhen: Disintegration into ash after one use of either effect
usage.charges: Unlimited, but disintegrates after a single activation

mordor_ashen_robe.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the robe's unique crafting and limited use.

mordor_shadow_dust.name: Mordor Shadow Dust
mordor_shadow_dust.description: Mordor Shadow Dust is a fine, volcanic grit meticulously collected from the molten heart of Mount Doom. Each grain holds the dark magic that fuels Mordor's necromancers, capable of corrupting the living and binding the dead. This dust can be used as a material component for necromancy spells, effectively doubling their range when cast by those who know its secrets. When applied to an opponent, it clouds their senses, granting them disadvantage on Perception checks for one hour, leaving them vulnerable to unseen threats.

effectDetails.title: Dark Material Component
effectDetails.rules: When used as a material component in necromancy spells, the range of the spell is doubled. This effect must be activated by the spellcaster on casting the spell and can only be done once per day.

effectDetails.title: Clouded Senses
effectDetails.rules: Applying Mordor Shadow Dust to an opponent grants them disadvantage on all Perception checks for one hour, starting when the dust is applied. This effect lasts until it is removed by a successful Wisdom (Perception) check with a DC of 15 or through another means that dispels the dust.

mordor_shadow_dust.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least level 7 to use due to its dark magic and the inherent danger it poses.
mordor_shadow_dust.vendorReason: Land Mordor Outpost is a known supplier of forbidden artifacts, including those from Mount Doom's volcanic heart.
mordor_shadow_dust.shippingDetail: The crate ensures safe delivery by cushioning the dust within, but it must be handled with care to prevent accidental exposure.

usage.activation: Used as a material component when casting necromancy spells or applied directly to an opponent.
usage.duration: One hour for Clouded Senses; lasts until removed or dispelled.
usage.endsWhen: Disadvantage on Perception checks ends with a successful check or removal of the dust.

mordor_shadow_dust.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its rarity and the dark magic it contains, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any party's arsenal.

mordor_smoke_signal_service.name: Mordor Smoke Signal Service
mordor_smoke_signal_service.description: The Mordor Smoke Signal Service delivers messages with eerie precision and flair. This service sends a plume of noxious smoke that carries your urgent missive up to 50 miles, arriving within an hour—though it may mislead the recipient into thinking you're rallying for war. For critical situations, orcs accompany the message to ensure its safe passage; they are included in the cost but charge extra for 'protection'. Beware: there's a 50% chance that your message will be accompanied by rude shapes formed from the smoke itself.

effectDetails.title: Mighty Smoke Plume
effectDetails.rules: The user activates this service to send a message via a plume of smoky, ominous vapor. The smoke travels up to 50 miles and arrives within one hour. However, there is a 50% chance that the arriving plume will be misread as a war declaration due to its threatening appearance.

effectDetails.title: Orc Escort
effectDetails.rules: If desired, a team of orcs accompanies the message for added security. This service includes one orc escort; additional orcs can be requested at extra cost. The escorts ensure safe passage but are known for their exorbitant rates for 'protection'.

mordor_smoke_signal_service.levelRequirementReason: This service is available to all, as it caters to any who need urgent communication.
mordor_smoke_signal_service.vendorReason: The Mordor Postal Orcs are the only reliable couriers in these treacherous lands; they have a monopoly on such services.
mordor_smoke_signal_service.shippingDetail: Messages are delivered by swift wargs, ensuring quick and safe transport. However, delays may occur due to unpredictable weather conditions or orc whims.

usage.activation: A standard action is required to activate the service.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; the smoke plume arrives at its destination within one hour.
usage.endsWhen: The message has been delivered and any accompanying orcs have completed their escort duties.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, as long as the vendor's stock holds.

mordor_smoke_signal_service.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the service's urgency, the risk of misinterpretation, and the orc escort's reputation for exorbitant fees.

mordor_venom_vial.name: Vial of Mordor Venom
mordor_venom_vial.description: The Vial of Mordor Venom is a thick, viscous, and nearly black liquid that exudes an eerie, almost living darkness. It whispers of ancient horrors and the Dark Lord's malevolence. This venom can be applied to any weapon, turning it into a vessel of death and torment for its target. Upon contact with flesh, the victim suffers both physical agony and spiritual corruption, requiring immediate attention to avoid permanent damage.

effectDetails.title: Corrosive Weapon
effectDetails.rules: Apply the Vial of Mordor Venom to a weapon as an action. The weapon gains the ability to deal 4d6 necrotic damage on hit, and the target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 13) or become poisoned for 1 minute. This effect ends if the weapon strikes a target three times consecutively.

effectDetails.title: Soul-Searing Venom
effectDetails.rules: While the weapon is imbued with Mordor Venom, it emits an eerie whisper that can be heard within 30 feet by those with a saving throw DC of 12. This effect lasts until the weapon is cleaned or the poison wears off.

mordor_venom_vial.levelRequirementReason: The Vial's potency requires no specific character level, as it relies on the wielder's intent and the weapon's edge.
mordor_venom_vial.vendorReason: Only those who have faced the Dark Lord's wrath or are deeply connected to his domain would dare sell this cursed item.
mordor_venom_vial.shippingDetail: Ships securely in a lead-lined box to prevent contamination, delaying delivery by one day.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect per hit; ends after three consecutive hits or when the weapon is cleaned
usage.endsWhen: After three uses or if the weapon is cleaned of the venom
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one charge can be active at a time

mordor_venom_vial.priceReason: Balanced as this item provides potent utility and danger in combat without being overpowered.

mordor_volcanic_ash_sifter.name: Mordor Volcanic Ash Sifter
mordor_volcanic_ash_sifter.description: The Mordor Volcanic Ash Sifter is a finely crafted, orc-made sieve with a core of volcanic obsidian. It sifts ash into your baked goods with precision, ensuring no grit or impurities slip through. This tool not only enhances the smoky flavor but also grants advantage on cooking checks within volcanic environs. A brief cloud of ash may obscure vision for creatures nearby, adding to its unique allure and utility in Mordor's fiery landscapes.

effectDetails.title: Smoke-Enhanced Flavor
effectDetails.rules: When used while cooking, the sifter grants you advantage on checks to prepare meals in smoky areas. The flavor of your dish is imbued with a rich, smoky essence.

effectDetails.title: Vision Obscuring
effectDetails.rules: As an action, using the sifter creates a cloud of ash that obscures vision for all creatures within 10 feet for up to 3 rounds. This effect has no save or DC and is limited to one use per day.

mordor_volcanic_ash_sifter.levelRequirementReason: This tool is designed to be accessible, requiring minimal skill to operate effectively.
mordor_volcanic_ash_sifter.vendorReason: Orc Toolmakers are renowned for their craftsmanship and have adapted their tools to the unique challenges of Mordor's terrain.
mordor_volcanic_ash_sifter.shippingDetail: The sifter is delivered in a specially designed sack that can withstand the harsh conditions of volcanic transport.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (cloud lasts up to 3 rounds)
usage.endsWhen: After 3 rounds or when used again on the same day

mordor_volcanic_ash_sifter.priceReason: Crafted from volcanic obsidian and imbued with orcish ingenuity, this tool is a rare find in Mordor.

mov_service.name: Motivational Speech
mov_service.description: Pauline's Microphone amplifies your voice and confidence, a relic from the golden age of motivational oratory. Crafted in the heart of Toad Town by renowned speaker Pauline Heartstone, it channels her legendary speeches into yours. When you activate it, Pauline's voice fills the air, granting each party member 10 temporary hit points that last for 24 hours. The microphone itself, a gleaming brass device adorned with intricate engravings, hums with energy as it boosts your willpower and resolve.

effectDetails.title: Grant 10 Temporary Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Each party member gains 10 temporary hit points that last for 24 hours, granting them resilience against harm.

effectDetails.title: Inspire Confidence
effectDetails.rules: While holding Pauline's Microphone and speaking, you can use an action to inspire confidence among your allies within hearing range. Each ally gains advantage on saving throws against fear effects for the rest of the day.

mov_service.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for first-level characters who may need a morale boost and the confidence to face challenges ahead.
mov_service.vendorReason: Toad Town Market stocks Pauline's Microphone because it is a beloved local artifact, cherished by both novices and veterans alike.
mov_service.shippingDetail: Ships via Gnome Express, ensuring the microphone arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate or use an action for the Inspire Confidence effect.
usage.duration: 24 hours for Temp HP; until used again for Inspire Confidence.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when it is used again, and there are no remaining charges.

mov_service.priceReason: This item's balanced price reflects its potent effects and the reputation of Pauline Heartstone among adventurers.

mu_empire_clay_oven.name: Mu Empire Clay Oven
mu_empire_clay_oven.description: The Mu Empire Clay Oven is a relic of ancient craftsmanship, its weathered surface still retains traces of the fires it has tended over centuries. Built by the skilled hands of Mu Empire Potters, it cooks with minimal fuel, conserving precious resources in even the harshest conditions. With each use, it grants you advantage on History checks while using it and Survival checks for cooking fires, but its fragile nature imposes a penalty on saving throws against damage, requiring extra care or risk to maintain.

effectDetails.title: Minimal Fuel Consumption
effectDetails.rules: When you use this oven for cooking, you gain advantage on Survival checks related to fire management. This effect lasts until the meal is prepared.

effectDetails.title: Ancient Craftsmanship
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on History checks when using the oven. This bonus applies only while actively using it and ends after one hour of use.

mu_empire_clay_oven.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners, providing essential survival skills without overly restrictive requirements.
mu_empire_clay_oven.vendorReason: The Mu Empire retains a deep connection to its ancient crafts and continues to produce items that honor their heritage.
mu_empire_clay_oven.shippingDetail: Ships via the Silk Road Courier, ensuring safe delivery along treacherous routes but delaying arrival by one week.

usage.duration: Until the meal is prepared or until you finish using it for cooking
usage.endsWhen: After one hour of continuous use or when damaged beyond repair

mu_empire_clay_oven.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its historical value and utility without overshadowing the game's balance.

mu_empire_levitation_boots.name: Mu Empire Levitation Boots
mu_empire_levitation_boots.description: The Mu Empire Levitation Boots are crafted from enchanted leather and brass, forged in the heart of Mu City's forges. These boots grant brief periods of controlled levitation, allowing you to navigate treacherous terrain with ease or cross small gaps like a breeze through reeds. Crafted by the Mu Empire, these boots have earned a reputation as indispensable tools for adventurers seeking to outmaneuver their foes and traverse difficult landscapes.

effectDetails.title: Controlled Levitation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may levitate up to 1 foot off the ground for a duration of 1 minute. While levitating, your speed is reduced by half (20 feet). This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Terrain Mastery
effectDetails.rules: You can use this ability to cross small gaps or avoid ground hazards with ease. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to checks involving movement and balance until the end of your next turn after using these boots for the first time in combat.

mu_empire_levitation_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are designed for those with some experience, ensuring they can handle their advanced capabilities.
mu_empire_levitation_boots.vendorReason: The outpost stocks these boots as a staple item for adventurers journeying through Mu Empire territories.
mu_empire_levitation_boots.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days via Swift Courier, ensuring timely delivery to eager explorers.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the time runs out or you are incapacitated

mu_empire_levitation_boots.priceReason: Crafted with enchanted leather and brass, these boots offer a unique and valuable asset to any adventurer's arsenal.

mu_empire_levitation_orb.name: Mu Empire Levitation Orb
mu_empire_levitation_orb.description: The Mu Empire Levitation Orb is a sleek obsidian sphere, engraved with ancient Mu symbols. When activated, it emits a soft blue glow, creating an anti-gravity field that allows you to hover five feet off the ground. You can glide over obstacles and avoid terrain penalties for movement speed, but your pace is halved during this time. The orb's power comes from the Mu Empire’s lost alchemy, making it both reliable and rare.

effectDetails.title: Hover Flight
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to hover five feet off the ground for one hour. You can move up, down, or horizontally while hovering but your speed is halved.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Speed
effectDetails.rules: While hovering, your movement speed is reduced by half. This effect ends when you stop hovering, are knocked prone, or exceed the one-hour duration limit.

mu_empire_levitation_orb.levelRequirementReason: The orb's activation requires minimal concentration and is within the reach of any adventurer.
mu_empire_levitation_orb.vendorReason: The Mu Outpost specializes in items from their empire, including this rare levitation technology.
mu_empire_levitation_orb.shippingDetail: Delivered via a fleet of enchanted airships that ensure safe and swift transport.

usage.duration: One Hour
usage.endsWhen: Exceeding the one-hour duration, being knocked prone, or stopping the hover effect manually.

mu_empire_levitation_orb.priceReason: The orb’s rarity and unique crafting process justify its moderate price.

mu_empire_levitation_stone.name: Mu Empire Levitation Stone
mu_empire_levitation_stone.description: The Mu Empire Levitation Stone is a smooth, matte-grey stone that hums with an eerie anti-gravity pulse when activated. Crafted from the ancient ruins of a forgotten city deep within Mu's heartlands, this stone doubles your carrying capacity and allows you to cast 'Levitate' at will. It whispers tales of lost empires as it cradles objects up to 2000 lbs, making them weightless for one minute each use.

effectDetails.title: Levitate
effectDetails.rules: The user can cast the 'Levitate' spell at will, allowing them to suspend a target up to 200 lbs in weight for one minute. There is no saving throw against this effect.

effectDetails.title: Doubled Carrying Capacity
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Levitation Stone, your carrying capacity is doubled, allowing you to bear twice as much weight without strain or risk of dropping items.

mu_empire_levitation_stone.levelRequirementReason: The Levitation Stone's effects are accessible to lower-level adventurers who might benefit from its capabilities.
mu_empire_levitation_stone.vendorReason: The Mu Empire has a long history with the stone, and their artisans can craft it in various forms for travelers and scholars.
mu_empire_levitation_stone.shippingDetail: Ships via a floating courier service that delivers the stone within an hour of order placement.

usage.activation: At-will ability; no action required to cast 'Levitate' or use carrying capacity boost.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for casting 'Levitate'; permanent increase in carrying capacity while holding the stone.
usage.endsWhen: Casting 'Levitate' ends when you are incapacitated, the duration expires, or you stop concentrating (if you have not already done so). Carrying capacity boost ends when the stone is no longer held.

mu_empire_levitation_stone.priceReason: The Levitation Stone's price reflects its rare crafting and the magical properties it holds, balanced for a lower-level item.

mu_empire_recipe_ancient_grain_bowl.name: Recipe: Mu Empire Ancient Grain Bowl
mu_empire_recipe_ancient_grain_bowl.description: This ancient recipe for Mu Empire grain is a culinary relic, passed down through generations. The grains are so old that they contain whispers of forgotten knowledge. Consuming this bowl grants you advantage on Constitution saving throws for 8 hours, but it also causes your speech to be slightly muffled, giving you disadvantage on Charisma (Performance) checks until the effects wear off. The Mu Empire Health Food's secret ingredient has been a staple in maintaining their legendary endurance and wisdom.

effectDetails.title: Constitution Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Eating this ancient grain bowl grants you advantage on Constitution saving throws for a duration of 8 hours. This effect ends when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Speech Muffling
effectDetails.rules: For the same duration, you suffer disadvantage on Charisma (Performance) checks due to slightly muffled speech from consuming these ancient grains.

mu_empire_recipe_ancient_grain_bowl.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to all adventurers as it focuses more on providing a unique experience than raw power.
mu_empire_recipe_ancient_grain_bowl.vendorReason: The Mu Empire Health Food has been trusted for centuries to provide such ancient and nutritious recipes.
mu_empire_recipe_ancient_grain_bowl.shippingDetail: Carefully packed with fresh ice packs to ensure the grains remain as they were originally prepared.

usage.duration: 8 hours after eating
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the end of the 8-hour period or upon death
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be eaten multiple times

mu_empire_recipe_ancient_grain_bowl.priceReason: The ancient and unique nature of this recipe, combined with its nutritional value, justifies a price slightly above average.

mu_empire_silk_sandals.name: Mu Empire Silk Sandals
mu_empire_silk_sandals.description: These Mu Empire Silk Sandals are crafted from the finest silk woven by the weavers of Mu, a land where tradition and craftsmanship intertwine. The soles, made from the tough exoskeletons of silk worms, provide unparalleled comfort and traction, yet they make you feel as if you're walking on clouds. While they offer an advantage in Charisma checks for interactions with nobility, their slippery nature also grants disadvantage on saves to avoid being knocked prone when the ground is wet.
effects: Disadvantage on Saves vs. Knocked Prone

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Charisma Checks
effectDetails.rules: When making a Charisma check with nobility, you gain advantage as the silk sandals enhance your poise and confidence.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Saves vs. Knocked Prone in Wet Terrain
effectDetails.rules: In wet terrain, you must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone due to the slippery nature of the soles. This effect is nullified when the terrain dries.

mu_empire_silk_sandals.levelRequirementReason: These sandals are designed for travelers and adventurers just starting their journey.
mu_empire_silk_sandals.vendorReason: The Mu Empire Weavers are renowned for their craftsmanship, ensuring that only the finest silk sandal is sold to those who appreciate tradition and quality.
mu_empire_silk_sandals.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Silk Road Courier with expedited delivery, arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect at all times while wearing the sandals.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each effect when applicable.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end immediately if you remove the sandals or if your terrain changes from dry to wet and vice versa.

mu_empire_silk_sandals.priceReason: The balance of quality craftsmanship, rarity of materials, and unique utility justify this price.

multibounce_badge.name: Multibounce Badge
multibounce_badge.description: The Multibounce Badge is a sleek, metallic device that amplifies your jumping prowess. Crafted from enchanted brass and imbued with the spirit of a mischievous gryphon, it allows you to leap between enemies in rapid succession. Once activated, you can attack one target; if successful, you immediately follow up by attacking an adjacent foe. This badge is not just for combat; it's a testament to the bond between creature and creator.

effectDetails.title: Multibounce
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you jump on one target within reach. If your attack hits, immediately make a second attack against the adjacent enemy in line with the first.

effectDetails.title: Adjacent Target Strike
effectDetails.rules: This effect can only occur after successfully hitting one target and is limited to once per turn.

multibounce_badge.levelRequirementReason: Requires a moderate level of skill in combat to effectively use the Multibounce Badge.
multibounce_badge.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in gear that enhances martial prowess, and this badge is no exception.
multibounce_badge.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days, ensuring you're ready for your next adventure.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: After the second attack or if hit by an enemy attack

multibounce_badge.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP to reflect its unique combat utility and limited tactical application.

multiverse_conqueror_crown.name: Multiverse Conqueror Crown
multiverse_conqueror_crown.description: The Multiverse Conqueror Crown is a regal diadem forged from the essences of countless realities. Its crownstones shimmer with the light of every universe, and its weight mirrors the gravity of all existence. Crafted by The First Emperor, it grants you dominion over any realm your foot treads upon, bending its inhabitants to your will. With this crown, you may merge universes at will, reshaping reality itself into your vision.

effectDetails.title: Mastery Over Realms
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can assume dominion over any contiguous area of a universe you enter. The inhabitants and the environment are immediately under your control for 1 minute per level. This effect ends if you leave the area or if you use this ability again.

effectDetails.title: Universe Merging
effectDetails.rules: You can merge two contiguous universes into one as a bonus action, provided they share at least one point of contact. The merged universe becomes stable for 10 minutes per level and retains the memories and essences of both original realms until the effect ends.

multiverse_conqueror_crown.levelRequirementReason: Only those of considerable power can wield such a crown without corrupting reality.
multiverse_conqueror_crown.vendorReason: The Multiversal Empire, being at the heart of all realities, has access to such cosmic treasures.
multiverse_conqueror_crown.shippingDetail: Ships via an interdimensional express, arriving within a week.

usage.duration: 1 minute per level for Mastery Over Realms; 10 minutes per level for Universe Merging
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends if you leave the area or use this ability again, or after its duration.

multiverse_conqueror_crown.priceReason: The crown's price reflects its rare material and the cosmic power it commands.

multiverse_credit_card.name: Multiverse Platinum Credit Card
multiverse_credit_card.description: The Multiverse Platinum Credit Card, a sleek and glowing platinum rectangle, grants its bearer access to any universe's resources, from mundane goods to cosmic phenomena. Crafted by The Cosmic Bank, this card allows you to purchase anything, even the fabric of reality itself, though it comes with a catch: once used, you must choose one universe as your permanent home until the next great cosmic event. This powerful tool is not without consequence, for each use leaves a mark on the multiverse's delicate balance.

effectDetails.title: Universal Purchase Power
effectDetails.rules: This card allows you to purchase any item or service from any universe. The transaction is instantaneous, but the chosen universe's laws apply. Each successful use requires a DC 25 Wisdom (Perception) check to ensure the transaction aligns with the multiverse's harmony.

effectDetails.title: Cosmic Debt
effectDetails.rules: After using this card, you must reside in the purchased universe for one year and a day. Failure to do so results in an immediate return to your chosen home universe, but at the cost of one charge from each universe's debt counter.

multiverse_credit_card.levelRequirementReason: Even with its godly power, using the Multiverse Platinum Credit Card requires a minimum level to prevent accidental misuse.
multiverse_credit_card.vendorReason: The Cosmic Bank is entrusted with maintaining cosmic balance and thus offers this unparalleled service.
multiverse_credit_card.shippingDetail: Ships via the fastest cosmic courier, arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Your next turn ends or you choose another universe

multiverse_credit_card.priceReason: The card's balanced price reflects its powerful utility and the Cosmic Bank's careful management of multiversal resources.

mummy_lords_canopic_jars.name: Mummy Lord's Canopic Jars (Set of 4)
mummy_lords_canopic_jars.description: These ancient Canopic Jars are imbued with the essence of a Mummy Lord, each containing one of the deceased god's preserved organs. Crafted by the Cult of Preservation, these jars are believed to hold the very life force that once animated their divine master. Perform the ritual correctly, and you will gain access to the Mummy Lord's Rejuvenation trait, allowing your body to heal at an accelerated rate for one week. The second effect is a protective barrier that can be activated by invoking the god's name; it grants temporary hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Mummy Lord's Rejuvenation
effectDetails.rules: Activation: A full ritual performed over one week with 10,000 gold pieces in incense. Duration: One week after the ritual is complete. The user gains a +2 bonus to all healing and regenerating effects applied to them during this time.

effectDetails.title: Divine Barrier
effectDetails.rules: Activation: A verbal command invoking the name of the Mummy Lord. Range: Personal. Duration: Until the start of your next turn after activation. Grants temporary hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier.

mummy_lords_canopic_jars.levelRequirementReason: Only a seasoned adventurer with significant experience can perform and comprehend the rituals required for these jars.
mummy_lords_canopic_jars.vendorReason: The Tomb Raider is a renowned collector of ancient artifacts, including those of divine origin.
mummy_lords_canopic_jars.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost respect and ceremony, ensuring the safe arrival of these sacred relics.

usage.activation: A full ritual over one week involving incense worth at least 10,000 gold pieces.
usage.duration: One week for Mummy Lord's Rejuvenation; until start of next turn for Divine Barrier.
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon completion or interruption during the ritual period and after one turn once activated.

mummy_lords_canopic_jars.priceReason: The cost reflects the rarity, ancient craftsmanship, and the power bestowed by a Mummy Lord.

mushroom_basic.name: Standard Mushroom
mushroom_basic.description: The Standard Mushroom, a vibrant crimson cap with gills that shimmer like polished copper, is a staple of Toad Town's apothecaries. Cultivated in the town's renowned greenhouses using enchanted soil and ancient techniques passed down from toads of old, this mushroom grants vitality when consumed. Its origin dates back centuries, where it was first discovered by a curious toad savoring a wild mushroom. When eaten, it not only restores health but also leaves one feeling invigorated and refreshed.

effectDetails.title: Healing
effectDetails.rules: The Standard Mushroom can be consumed as an action to restore 2d8 + 2 hit points. There is no saving throw required, and this effect cannot be used more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Refreshment
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the eater gains advantage on all Wisdom (Perception) checks made to discern a sound or noise within 30 feet for the next hour. This benefit does not stack with similar effects.

mushroom_basic.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners who need quick healing and heightened senses in their early adventures.
mushroom_basic.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its diverse selection of medicinal plants and fungi, including the Standard Mushroom.
mushroom_basic.shippingDetail: The mushrooms are shipped in special containers to preserve their potency. Delivery may take up to three days depending on weather conditions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous healing, lasts one hour for the perception advantage
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon use or after one long rest without further consumption

mushroom_basic.priceReason: The Standard Mushroom is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its common availability and the effort involved in cultivating it under Toad Town's strict standards.

mushroom_idol.name: Grand Mushroom Idol
mushroom_idol.description: The Grand Mushroom Idol, carved from an ancient, gnarled root and inlaid with luminescent fungi, radiates a soothing aura that envelops travelers. Its smile invites all to share its wisdom and protection. The idol’s presence ensures the safety of the encampment, granting all within 30 feet advantage on saving throws against fear and poison. Once per week, it can summon a guardian—a resilient Mushroom Guardian (CR 3) to defend the camp. However, if not fed periodic offerings, the idol sulkily withholds its benefits, growing overgrown and unresponsive until appeased.

effectDetails.title: Camp Safety
effectDetails.rules: When placed in a camp setting, the Grand Mushroom Idol grants all allies within 30 feet advantage on saving throws against fear and poison. This effect lasts until the idol is removed or its offerings are neglected.

effectDetails.title: Guardian Summoning
effectDetails.rules: The idol can be activated once per week to summon a resilient Mushroom Guardian (CR 3), which remains for 1 hour. The guardian provides combat support and defends the camp until dismissed, destroyed, or the idol is not fed offerings.

mushroom_idol.levelRequirementReason: The Grand Mushroom Idol's ancient magic requires a level at least equal to its power to wield effectively.
mushroom_idol.vendorReason: As a nexus of otherworldly curiosities, the Fey Market often stocks such relics from the fae realm.
mushroom_idol.shippingDetail: The idol is carefully packed in a Stone Crate with protective fungi to ensure it arrives unharmed and ready for its next guardian summoning.

usage.activation: Place in camp setting to activate and once per week for guardian summoning. Requires feeding offerings.
usage.duration: Continuous until removed or neglected, Guardian lasts one hour.
usage.endsWhen: Offerings are not fed, the idol is removed from its location, or it is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; requires periodic offerings to maintain.

mushroom_idol.priceReason: The Grand Mushroom Idol's balanced price reflects its rare and ancient nature, providing significant yet manageable benefits for a moderate cost.

mushroom_kingdom_blood_mold.name: Blood Mold
mushroom_kingdom_blood_mold.description: Blood Mold, a sentient fungus wrapped in a cloak of dark red mold, feeds on the lifeblood of its enemies, granting the wielder increased regeneration and resistance to poison. When the blood is consumed, it grants temporary resilience, allowing the user to heal at an accelerated rate and shrug off toxins more effectively. This fungal entity requires careful handling; its touch can also taint a foe with a malevolent curse.

effectDetails.title: Regenerative Boost
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can activate Blood Mold. The user gains a +25% increase in their natural healing until the end of their next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wielder is granted +10% resistance to poison effects for 8 hours after consuming an enemy's blood. If the user fails a saving throw against a poison effect, they can attempt it again with advantage on their next turn.

mushroom_kingdom_blood_mold.levelRequirementReason: The fungal entity requires a certain level of arcane knowledge and resilience to safely wield.
mushroom_kingdom_blood_mold.vendorReason: Mushroom Kingdom's bioluminescent fungi are well-known for their magical properties, and Blood Mold is one of the most sought-after specimens.
mushroom_kingdom_blood_mold.shippingDetail: The drones carefully package Blood Mold in a climate-controlled container to prevent it from drying out during transit.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends or the user is incapacitated
usage.charges: Unlimited, but must be rehydrated after 3 days

mushroom_kingdom_blood_mold.priceReason: The rare and volatile nature of Blood Mold justifies its higher price.

mushroom_kingdom_blood_mushroom.name: Blood Mushroom Essence
mushroom_kingdom_blood_mushroom.description: The Blood Mushroom Essence exudes a dark crimson glow, its cap thick and leathery, having imbibed the very essence of vengeance from a fallen princess. This rare spore grants you a vengeful aura that boosts your attacks against foes with high hit points, and it strikes at undead with lethal precision. With each use, a ghostly spore may materialize to aid in your battle, only to dissipate after a short time.
effects: +15% damage to targets with over half their HP

effectDetails.title: Vengeful Aura
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. While active, your attacks deal an additional 15% damage to targets with over half their hit points. This effect lasts for one minute and ends if you lose consciousness or dismiss it.

effectDetails.title: Ghostly Spore
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can summon a ghostly spore that hovers near you. The spore deals 2d6 necrotic damage to the first undead creature within 5 feet of you on your next turn. The spore then dissipates after one round.

mushroom_kingdom_blood_mushroom.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 3 to wield this potent essence effectively.
mushroom_kingdom_blood_mushroom.vendorReason: Mushroom Kingdom's experts in rare fungi and their powers have refined the extraction process for this unique essence.
mushroom_kingdom_blood_mushroom.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of ghostly Rakashans, ensuring swift and safe transit through the kingdom’s haunted paths.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate aura; once per short rest to summon spore
usage.duration: One minute for the aura; one round for the spore
usage.endsWhen: Aura ends if you lose consciousness or dismiss it; spore dissipates after one round

mushroom_kingdom_blood_mushroom.priceReason: The essence's rarity and powerful effects justify its price, aligning with the value of a rare item.

mushroom_kingdom_chain_chomp_amulet.name: Chain Chomp Amulet
mushroom_kingdom_chain_chomp_amulet.description: The Chain Chomp Amulet is a cursed artifact forged from weaponized Chain Chomps, crafted by the Changeling Hive. Its cursed nature grants immunity to crushing damage and inflicts minor chaos upon enemies, causing them confusion and instability. When an enemy with high hit points enters proximity, it triggers a trap that deals 1d6+2 slashing damage. The amulet's chaotic aura also disrupts magical effects within 30 feet, forcing creatures to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented for the start of their next turn.
effects: Trigger Trap on High HP Target

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Crushing Damage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer is immune to all effects that deal crushing damage. This effect does not stack with other immunities.

effectDetails.title: Trigger Trap on High HP Target
effectDetails.rules: When a creature with 20 or more hit points enters the amulet's 15-foot radius, it triggers a trap that deals 1d6+2 slashing damage to all creatures in the area. The effect has a recharge time of one long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_chain_chomp_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The artifact's cursed nature and chaotic abilities require a proficient user with at least 8 levels.
mushroom_kingdom_chain_chomp_amulet.vendorReason: Mushroom Kingdom is renowned for its ties to the Changeling Hive, making it a natural vendor for this artifact.
mushroom_kingdom_chain_chomp_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by Chain Chomp Couriers with a guaranteed delivery within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Until removed or until the wearer is incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the amulet is removed, destroyed, or if the wearer is incapacitated for more than one minute.

mushroom_kingdom_chain_chomp_amulet.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its cursed nature and chaotic abilities, this artifact commands a price of 1000 XP.

mushroom_kingdom_crimson_satchel.name: Crimson Satchel of Silent Resolve
mushroom_kingdom_crimson_satchel.description: The Crimson Satchel of Silent Resolve is a leather-bound pouch imbued with the quietude of ancient fungal spirits. It whispers secrets in stillness, granting temporary silence and reduced damage from ranged attacks. Crafted by the Mushroom Kingdom's finest forgers using relics from the Fungi civil war, it is said to carry the resolve of countless warriors who sought peace through silence. When activated, it hums with a quiet strength that allows its wielder to avoid detection and mitigate harm.

effectDetails.title: Silent Resolve
effectDetails.rules: As an action, activate the satchel for a duration of 1 minute. During this time, you are considered to have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and gain a +2 bonus to your AC against ranged weapon attacks.

effectDetails.title: Ranged Damage Reduction
effectDetails.rules: While the satchel is active, you take no damage from successful ranged attack rolls. If you fail an attack roll, this effect ends immediately.

mushroom_kingdom_crimson_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The satchel's activation requires a basic understanding of its mechanics, suitable for novice adventurers.
mushroom_kingdom_crimson_satchel.vendorReason: The Mushroom Kingdom is renowned for its expertise in crafting items that embody the essence of nature and silence.
mushroom_kingdom_crimson_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, known for its timely and reliable delivery service within the kingdom.

usage.duration: 1 minute (until ends or interrupted)
usage.endsWhen: Interrupted by an attack roll that fails, or as an action to end it early

mushroom_kingdom_crimson_satchel.priceReason: The satchel's balanced price reflects its rarity and the specialized crafting required for its unique properties.

mushroom_kingdom_doughnut_hole_catalyst.name: Doughnut Hole Catalyst
mushroom_kingdom_doughnut_hole_catalyst.description: The Doughnut Hole Catalyst is a corrupted pastry core that amplifies reality distortion within the Void realm. When activated, it creates temporary safe zones that protect allies for a brief moment, while simultaneously causing nearby enemies to lose 10% of their hit points whenever they enter or are in the same area as the safe zone. The catalyst's power corrupts the wielder, draining 1 HP per second within the Void until deactivated.

effectDetails.title: Safe Zone Creation
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this item creates a safe zone that lasts for 1 minute. The safe zone grants temporary hit points equal to half the wielder's level (rounded down) to each ally within its area of effect. If an enemy enters or is already in the same area as the safe zone, they take 5d6 force damage and are pushed back a number of feet equal to their speed. This effect ends if the item is used again before duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Hit Point Drain
effectDetails.rules: Any enemy that enters or remains within an active safe zone loses 10% of its hit points at the start of each of its turns. This effect does not stack with other sources of damage, and it ends when the safe zone is destroyed by any means.

mushroom_kingdom_doughnut_hole_catalyst.levelRequirementReason: Only a seasoned spellcaster can harness the full power of this item.
mushroom_kingdom_doughnut_hole_catalyst.vendorReason: The Mushroom Kingdom's enigmatic vendors hold rare and powerful artifacts that align with their mystical origins.
mushroom_kingdom_doughnut_hole_catalyst.shippingDetail: Ships via Goomba Ground Delivery, which may delay delivery by up to a week due to the item's delicate nature.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or used again before duration expires

mushroom_kingdom_doughnut_hole_catalyst.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's rarity and the risk involved in attunement.

mushroom_kingdom_entropy_ring_core.name: Entropy Ring Core
mushroom_kingdom_entropy_ring_core.description: The Entropy Ring Core is a pulsating core of dark energy, once part of an ancient artifact. Crafted from the heartwood of ancient trees and imbued with the essence of entropy, it hums with unstable power. When attuned by a Red Winter operative, this core can deal 3d10 arcane damage on critical hits. Nearby enemies have a 10% chance to experience temporary entropy decay, causing their movements to slow slightly for a round.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Critical
effectDetails.rules: When the user scores a critical hit with an attack while attuned to this core, they deal 3d10 additional arcane damage. This effect can only trigger once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Entropy Decay
effectDetails.rules: For every round the Entropy Ring Core is actively used in combat, there is a 10% chance that nearby enemies within 20 feet will experience temporary entropy decay. This causes their movement speed to decrease by -1 until the end of their next turn. The core can only trigger this effect up to three times per long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_entropy_ring_core.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and danger involved in attuning to the Entropy Ring Core necessitate a minimum character level of 7.
mushroom_kingdom_entropy_ring_core.vendorReason: Mushroom Kingdom is known for its expertise in magical artifacts, including those with unstable energy like the Entropy Ring Core.
mushroom_kingdom_entropy_ring_core.shippingDetail: Shipped via a specialized Mages Guild portal, ensuring safe delivery to Red Winter operatives only.

usage.activation: Activate as an action or bonus action while attuned to a weapon.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with ongoing chance of triggering entropy decay for each round used in combat.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user ceases using it, or if they are no longer attuned to the core.

mushroom_kingdom_entropy_ring_core.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the core's unstable power and rarity, as well as its limited use within combat.

mushroom_kingdom_feywild_pipe_fragment.name: Feywild Pipe Fragment
mushroom_kingdom_feywild_pipe_fragment.description: A broken pipe fragment, once part of a conduit to the Feywild, now a relic of chaotic magic. Crafted by Chain Chomp Courier using ancient Feywild lore and materials, this fragment infuses weapons with time loop effects that ripple through combat, causing foes to delay, rewind, or skip their actions unpredictably. It enhances damage in Feywild zones and may disorient non-Fey creatures, making it a treasured tool for adventurers navigating the wilds of the Feyrealm.

effectDetails.title: Time Loop Infusion
effectDetails.rules: When this fragment is used in conjunction with a Feywild-aligned spell, it infuses the target weapon with time loop effects for 3 rounds. During this duration, any creature struck by the weapon must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be delayed, rewound, or skipped to their next action, chosen randomly.

effectDetails.title: Random Action Delay
effectDetails.rules: When struck in combat within a Feywild zone, this fragment triggers a random effect that causes the target creature's next action to either delay, rewind, or skip. The exact effect is determined at the start of each round and is chosen randomly.

mushroom_kingdom_feywild_pipe_fragment.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 6 due to its Feywild alignment and the complexity of its magical effects.
mushroom_kingdom_feywild_pipe_fragment.vendorReason: Mushroom Kingdom is well-known for trading rare items from the Feywild, making it a logical vendor for this fragment.
mushroom_kingdom_feywild_pipe_fragment.shippingDetail: The courier ensures timely delivery of this item, especially valuable given its magical components and delicate nature.

usage.duration: 3 rounds when infused into a weapon with a Feywild-aligned spell
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each creature's turn while under its effects
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as it remains in use

mushroom_kingdom_feywild_pipe_fragment.priceReason: The item’s rarity and magical properties justify a price of 1000 XP.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_ambrosia.name: Fungal Ambrosia of the Silent Court
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_ambrosia.description: The Fungal Ambrosia of the Silent Court, a golden elixir crafted from the last breath of a fallen princess, whispers secrets of the night to those who drink it. This potion grants immunity to silence and stun effects for an instant, allowing you to leap into action without fear of being silenced. For 5 seconds after imbibing, enemies are confused, stumbling aimlessly as they lose their footing, making them ripe targets for your follow-up strikes.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Silence and Stun
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the drinker gains immunity to all silence and stun effects until the end of their next turn. This effect does not stack with other immunities.

effectDetails.title: Confuse Enemies
effectDetails.rules: For 5 seconds after consumption, any creature that attempts to attack or interact with the drinker is instead confused for a round. They must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) at the start of their turn; on a failed save, they are incapacitated until the end of their next turn.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_ambrosia.levelRequirementReason: The potion's potent effects require a level 2 character to safely handle its power and timing.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_ambrosia.vendorReason: The Mushroom Kingdom, with its deep ties to the realm of the dead, is known for crafting potions that bridge between worlds, including this eerie but effective elixir.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_ambrosia.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Shy Guys, who often sneak it past royal guards and into the hands of those who need its power most.

usage.duration: Instantaneous immunity; confusion lasts for 5 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally after their duration or if consumed by another creature
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the drinker must wait 1 hour between uses

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_ambrosia.priceReason: Balanced to offer a potent effect within reach of mid-level characters without being overpowered.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_blood.name: Fungal Blood of the Ashen Throne
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_blood.description: The Fungal Blood of the Ashen Throne is a dark elixir crafted from the remnants of the last mushroom king. Its thick, gelatinous form exudes an eerie green glow and is said to hold the essence of fungal might. Drinking this brew grants you immunity to poison for 30 seconds and imbues you with a fungal rage that deals 20% extra damage to undead foes. However, it also causes nearby allies to rapidly decay, forcing them into a state of corruption for 10 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Poison Immunity
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to all poison effects for 30 seconds. This effect ends if you take any damage or are exposed to a poison effect again.

effectDetails.title: Undead Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your turn, you deal an additional 20% damage against undead creatures. This effect is limited to once per short rest.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_blood.levelRequirementReason: This item's effects are potent but not overwhelming for a first-level character.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_blood.vendorReason: The Mushroom Kingdom has the arcane knowledge to craft such an elixir from its own lore and remains.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_blood.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 30 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: On damage or exposure to poison again; limited once per short rest for undead damage boost.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_blood.priceReason: The rare ingredients and the risk of contamination justify this price.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_satchel.name: Fungal Crimson Satchel
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_satchel.description: The Fungal Crimson Satchel is a dark red leather pouch, its surface etched with ancient runes and imbued with the essence of fallen kings. It holds mushrooms that are said to grow from the very earth itself, pulsing faintly as they detect intruders. Each mushroom planted not only grows rapidly but also triggers a brief seismic tremor when an enemy approaches within 30 feet, alerting its bearer in time for a swift response.

effectDetails.title: Rapid Growth
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Each mushroom planted within the next round grows to full maturity and triggers a seismic tremor that deals 4d6 damage to enemies within 30 feet, requiring a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

effectDetails.title: Seismic Alert
effectDetails.rules: The mushrooms emit an invisible pulse when an enemy is within 30 feet. This pulse provides the user with a +2 bonus to Perception checks for 1 minute, but the effect ends if the user moves more than 30 feet away from the mushroom.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The satchel's enchantments are subtle and require only basic understanding of plant magic.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_satchel.vendorReason: Mushroom Kingdom is renowned for its expertise in fungal lore and enchanted flora, ensuring the authenticity and quality of such items.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_satchel.shippingDetail: The satchel arrives sealed with a protective charm to prevent premature activation until it reaches its destination.

usage.activation: Bonus action for planting mushrooms; passive effect of seismic alerts.
usage.duration: Instantaneous plant growth, 1 minute for perception bonus
usage.endsWhen: User moves more than 30 feet or the mushroom is destroyed

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_satchel.priceReason: The satchel's rarity and unique enchantments justify a fair price, balancing its utility with cost.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_sword.name: Fungal Crimson Sword
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_sword.description: The Fungal Crimson Sword is a blade forged in the heart of a fallen mushroom kingdom. Its hilt glows with a steady crimson light, and its edge drips with the essence of decayed fungi. This weapon not only deals +20% extra damage to foes with mushroom-based abilities but also emits a warning glow that intensifies as enemies near their doom. The sword's aura can be felt in dark forests where shadows move on their own.

effectDetails.title: Mushroom Slayer
effectDetails.rules: When the Fungal Crimson Sword strikes a foe with mushroom-based abilities, it inflicts an additional +20% damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Decay Aura
effectDetails.rules: The sword emits a Decay Aura that reduces the target's defense by 10%. This debuff persists for 1 minute or until the target is no longer within 30 feet of you.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_sword.levelRequirementReason: This sword requires a level 5 character due to its intricate enchantments and dark magic.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_sword.vendorReason: As the blade's origin lies in their kingdom, Mushroom Kingdom is the only vendor that can supply this weapon.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_sword.shippingDetail: The sword arrives with a special protective case to ensure it remains intact during transit.

usage.activation: On hit when used against foes with mushroom-based abilities.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn for Mushroom Slayer, and persists for 1 minute or until you are no longer within 30 feet of the target for Decay Aura.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are no longer in dark terrain or if the target moves out of range.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_crimson_sword.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this sword's price reflects its unique abilities and origins.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mask.name: Mask of the Silent Princess
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mask.description: The Mask of the Silent Princess is a regal visage made from the rarest nightshade petals, crafted in the shadowy forges beneath the Mushroom Kingdom's crumbling spires. When donned, it grants the wearer near-perfect invisibility, cloaking them for ten seconds and compelling enemies to mistake the mask’s bearer as a figment of their imagination. However, this very same mask reveals the true intentions of its wearer with a 20% chance on first encounter, making it a dangerous tool in the hands of those who seek power or expose corruption.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes invisible for 10 seconds. This effect does not grant advantage on attack rolls but allows the wearer to move undetected until the duration ends or they take an action.

effectDetails.title: Expose True Intentions
effectDetails.rules: On first encounter with a creature, there is a 20% chance that it will make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) and realize the mask's true intentions. If successful, the enemy gains advantage on attack rolls against the wearer for the next minute.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mask.levelRequirementReason: The Mask of the Silent Princess requires significant control to wield effectively without exposing oneself.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mask.vendorReason: Only those with ties to the Mushroom Kingdom's secret underbelly can obtain such a dangerous and powerful artifact.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mask.shippingDetail: Delivered via Shy Guy's fastest couriers, ensuring the Mask reaches its destination in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when used or interrupted by an attack

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mask.priceReason: Balanced at a price to reflect the item's limited utility and the risks involved in using it.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mirage.name: Fungal Mirage
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mirage.description: The Fungal Mirage is a cursed toadstool that distorts reality, making enemies appear twice as large or vanish entirely in an instant. It's said to be crafted from the shadowy remnants of the Shadeward Estate's ancient magic, its surface covered in glowing, ethereal fungi. When activated, it warps the battlefield, turning foes into grotesque shadows or causing them to disappear, offering a tactical advantage for ambushes and surprise attacks.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Size Alteration
effectDetails.rules: When the Fungal Mirage strikes an enemy, it temporarily doubles their size. This effect lasts for 1 round and grants advantage on attack rolls against the target. The target can use a reaction to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to negate this effect.

effectDetails.title: Shadowy Disappearance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance per activation that an enemy will vanish from the battlefield for 1 round. While vanished, the target is immune to all attacks and effects until it reappears. The target can use a reaction to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to resist vanishing.

mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mirage.levelRequirementReason: The Fungal Mirage's corrupting magic demands at least a 3rd-level spellcaster to wield it effectively.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mirage.vendorReason: The Mushroom King, master of the Shadeward Estate, personally oversees the sale of this cursed artifact.
mushroom_kingdom_fungal_mirage.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones with expedited delivery to any location within the Shadeward region.
