effectDetails.title: Pandemic Eradication
effectDetails.rules: The user must consume or apply the formula within an area affecting up to 1,000 people. The effect is instantaneous and cures all instances of a single disease present in that region. Once activated, immunity to the cured disease lasts for one year.

effectDetails.title: Immunization
effectDetails.rules: All individuals within the targeted area gain immunity to the specific disease that was eradicated by the formula. This immunity persists for one full year from the time of activation.

pandemic_cure_formula.levelRequirementReason: The formula requires a basic understanding of alchemy and is accessible to those who have completed their initial training in potion-making.
pandemic_cure_formula.vendorReason: The Alchemist Guild is renowned for its expertise in creating life-saving remedies, making the Pandemic Cure Formula an essential part of their offerings.
pandemic_cure_formula.shippingDetail: Shipped via a dedicated courier network known as the Apothecary Express, ensuring secure and timely delivery to destinations across the realm.

usage.activation: Consumed or applied directly within an area of up to 100 feet in diameter.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; immunity lasts for one year from activation.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts once used, requiring a week-long production process for another vial.
usage.charges: Limited to one use per vial.

pandemic_cure_formula.priceReason: The formula's rarity and the time-consuming alchemical process required for its creation justify its high price in experience points.

paper_doll.name: Paper Doll
paper_doll.description: A meticulously cutout paper doll, crafted to mimic any individual's silhouette with uncanny accuracy. This decoy is a cleverly folded creation that can be set up in seconds, fooling even the most vigilant foes into attacking it first before turning their attention to you. Each paper doll has a core of sturdy paper and ink, making it resilient enough to withstand a single strike while remaining lightweight for easy transport.

effectDetails.title: Set Up Decoy
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you set up the paper doll. Any creature that can see both you and the decoy must use its reaction to attack the paper doll if within range instead of attacking you. The decoy has AC 10 and 1 hit point; a successful melee attack against it reduces this to 0, destroying the decoy. Once destroyed or removed, the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: 1 Hit Point
effectDetails.rules: The paper doll possesses 1 hit point. Any damage dealt to the doll reduces its hit points by that amount; upon reaching 0 hit points, it is destroyed and the effect ends.

paper_doll.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no special level as it provides a straightforward tactical advantage.
paper_doll.vendorReason: Toad Town Market sells common household and utility items, including this clever paper doll for quick decoys.
paper_doll.shippingDetail: The paper doll is shipped flat in a sturdy envelope to ensure safe delivery without bending or damage.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or removed, or when the effect is superseded by another creature attacking you directly.

paper_doll.priceReason: This price reflects a common, yet clever and useful utility item that requires no special materials or crafting.

para_beanie.name: Para-Beanie
para_beanie.description: The Para-Beanie is a whimsical hat adorned with a small propeller that spins as you move. Originating from Toad Town's eccentric market, this beanie grants a brief lift and allows for controlled descent if used near a high point. Kids love to watch it in action, while adults reminisce about simpler times. Beware: the propeller detaches under thunderous impacts, requiring a visit to the local tinkerer to restore.

effectDetails.title: Brief Flight
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the Para-Beanie for a short burst of flight. You gain triple your jump height and can glide slowly downwards if used near a high point. This effect lasts until you land or fall from a height.

effectDetails.title: Controlled Descent
effectDetails.rules: If you use the Para-Beanie while standing on a high place, you can control your descent to avoid falling damage. The propeller automatically adjusts for stability as long as you remain near the edge of the platform.

para_beanie.levelRequirementReason: The Para-Beanie is designed for novices; its effects are gentle and controlled, making it accessible to those just starting their adventures.
para_beanie.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in quirky, locally crafted items that bring joy and nostalgia to all ages.
para_beanie.shippingDetail: Parcel Chutes are known for their reliable delivery within the town limits. A small parachute is included with each Para-Beanie shipment for safe descent.

usage.duration: Until you land or fall from a height
usage.endsWhen: You land, fall from a height, or take thunder damage

para_beanie.priceReason: The Para-Beanie is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its whimsical design and unique effects that provide fun without being overly powerful.

paradox_engine.name: Paradox Engine
paradox_engine.description: The Paradox Engine hums with a maddening rhythm, its gears and pistons twisting time itself into knots of impossible motion. This contraption is forged from the very fabric of contradictions, crafted by The Contrarian to bend reality's rules at will. It can create any paradox, from 'I am both here and not here' to 'The sun rises in the west,' and each such creation grants its wielder power, increasing their level by one for every paradox they conjure.

effectDetails.title: Create Paradoxes
effectDetails.rules: The user must spend a minute focusing on the desired paradox. Once activated, the engine emits a blinding flash and a ripple of time, creating the paradox. The paradox lasts for one round per user's level. A successful DC 18 Wisdom saving throw negates this effect. Each use of the Paradox Engine expends one charge.

effectDetails.title: Gain Levels from Paradoxes
effectDetails.rules: Each time a user successfully creates a paradox, their character level increases by one immediately. This effect has no cooldown and can be used as a bonus action once per short rest.

paradox_engine.levelRequirementReason: The Paradox Engine's creation demands a fundamental understanding of reality, making it accessible only to those who have reached at least level one.
paradox_engine.vendorReason: Paradox Machines is the sole vendor capable of creating and selling such a dangerous but powerful device.
paradox_engine.shippingDetail: The delivery of this item involves a complex series of paradoxes to ensure it arrives safely, adding an unpredictable delay to its shipping time.

usage.duration: One Round per User's Level
usage.endsWhen: A successful DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or when the user runs out of charges

paradox_engine.priceReason: The Paradox Engine is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique and powerful nature.

parakoopa_wings.name: Parakoopa Wing Clips
parakoopa_wings.description: The Parakoopa Wing Clips are small, ornate wings crafted from polished brass and leather, reminiscent of the nimble flight patterns of their namesake. Strap these to your arms for an awkward but exhilarating takeoff; they allow you to briefly soar through the air with a thunderous flap that startles nearby birds into mocking squawks. Though not graceful, once in mid-flight, you can glide safely from any height, landing gracefully without incident.

effectDetails.title: Brief Flight
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to fly for up to 60 feet in a straight line. Concentration is required; if you lose concentration, the wings falter and drop from your arms. This effect lasts for 2 rounds.

effectDetails.title: Safe Glide
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, after falling from at least 30 feet, activate as a bonus action to glide safely down to the ground without taking fall damage.

parakoopa_wings.levelRequirementReason: These wings are accessible early on but require finesse and practice.
parakoopa_wings.vendorReason: The observatory is known for its unique stock of magical artifacts, including the eccentric creations favored by Parakoopas.
parakoopa_wings.shippingDetail: Shipped via a swift pigeon messenger, delivery can be expedited at an additional cost.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Brief Flight; once per short rest to activate Safe Glide.
usage.duration: Brief Flight lasts up to 2 rounds with concentration. Safe Glide is instantaneous and usable once per short rest.
usage.endsWhen: Losing concentration ends Brief Flight, or after the duration of Safe Glide.

parakoopa_wings.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price to reflect the item’s utility and rarity without being overpowered.

parallel_universe_cloning_machine.name: Parallel Universe Cloning Machine
parallel_universe_cloning_machine.description: The Parallel Universe Cloning Machine hums with a multiversal energy, summoning 1d100 alternate versions of yourself from parallel realities where you made better decisions. Each clone appears as a level-appropriate version of your current self, ready to assist in your endeavors for the next 24 hours. These clones share your goals and can be deployed to various challenges, but once their time is up, they vanish into the fabric of the multiverse, never to return.

effectDetails.title: Summon Parallel Versions
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Summons 1d100 level-appropriate clones of the user from alternate realities where they made better decisions. Each clone exists for 24 hours and can be deployed to assist in challenges or tasks.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Assistance
effectDetails.rules: Each clone is a perfect duplicate of the user, sharing their goals and abilities for 24 hours. They can be used passively for support but cannot replace the user's actions. At the end of 24 hours or when the user dismisses them, they disappear back into the multiverse.

parallel_universe_cloning_machine.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to access the potential and responsibility that comes with summoning parallel versions.
parallel_universe_cloning_machine.vendorReason: Quantum Duplication is known for their expertise in multiversal technology, making them the most trusted vendor for such an item.
parallel_universe_cloning_machine.shippingDetail: Delivery occurs instantaneously through alternate dimensions; no physical shipment is involved.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and summon clones.
usage.duration: 24 hours per clone summoned, or until dismissed by the user.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of 24 hours or when dismissed.

parallel_universe_cloning_machine.priceReason: The item's price is set at a reasonable value given its unique and powerful abilities, allowing for balanced gameplay without overpowered effects.

paratroopa_wings.name: Paratroopa Wings
paratroopa_wings.description: The Paratroopa Wings are a delicate, iridescent set of feathers that allow for both graceful gliding and agile short hops. Crafted from the rare down of Paratroopas found high in the skies over Forgotten Peaks, these wings can carry you effortlessly through the air with each flap. A single glide covers 20 feet per 10 feet fallen, while their jump distance is doubled, allowing for leaps that would otherwise be impossible.

effectDetails.title: Glide
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the wings by making a running start, they allow you to glide in any direction up to 20 feet for every 10 feet of falling height. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn or until you land.

effectDetails.title: Jump Boost
effectDetails.rules: Your jump distance is doubled when using the wings, effectively allowing you to leap twice as far as normal. This boost applies only once per short rest and does not stack with other abilities that enhance jumping.

paratroopa_wings.levelRequirementReason: The Paratroopa Wings are designed for beginners, requiring only a basic understanding of balance and coordination.
paratroopa_wings.vendorReason: Comet Observatory is known for its expertise in rare avian artifacts, making it the ideal vendor for these enchanted wings.
paratroopa_wings.shippingDetail: Ships within three days from the Forgotten Peaks region, delivered by a swift messenger pigeon.

usage.activation: Activating the wings requires a running start and is an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each glide; jump boost lasts until the end of your next turn or short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you land from a glide, or after one use of the jump boost per short rest.

paratroopa_wings.priceReason: The Paratroopa Wings are rare and crafted with unique materials, making them moderately priced for their utility.

party_invite.name: Lost Party Invitation
party_invite.description: This faded, crumpled invitation bears the crest of Peach's Castle and hints at a past gathering now long forgotten. The paper is brittle, fragile as the memory it holds, and its edges are frayed from years of neglect. Though the date reads '3 years ago,' the ink still smudges faintly under your touch. Legend has it that those who find this invitation can summon a fleeting echo of the party's spirit, though time itself seems to linger around it like a mist.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Past
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may activate this invitation. For the next round, you gain advantage on saving throws related to emotions and can sense the lingering spirit of the party. The spirit does not speak but provides a vague impression of the event's atmosphere.

effectDetails.title: Fragile Remnant
effectDetails.rules: The invitation is fragile; once used, it crumbles into dust. After its activation, you must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 hour due to exhaustion from the vivid recollection of the past.

party_invite.levelRequirementReason: The invitation's power draws on memories and emotions, making it accessible only to those who have experienced a significant event in their lives.
party_invite.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its connections to the past, and this item is often sold alongside relics from Peach's Castle era.
party_invite.shippingDetail: Shipped by Courier Puffa with express delivery; due arrives within a day of order placement.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the round concludes or if you are incapacitated from exhaustion.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use crumbles the invitation further.

party_invite.priceReason: The item’s historical significance and its unique effects justify a higher price in terms of XP value.

pay_the_guild_to_scry_1.name: Mages' Guild Scrying Fee (Local)
pay_the_guild_to_scry_1.description: Mages' Guild Scrying Fee (Local) is a parchment envelope, sealed with a sigil of the Mages' Guild. For a mere 1000 XP, you can request the guild to scry on a target within ten miles, providing a fleeting glimpse into their world. The mage casts a spell that pierces the veil for one minute, revealing the target's form and actions, but only through visual means. Success is not guaranteed; it has an 85% chance of escaping passive detection. The Mages' Guild ensures this service maintains confidentiality, as its fees are paid directly to them.

effectDetails.title: Visual Scrying
effectDetails.rules: Activates with a short casting time. You can view the target for one minute, limited only to visual information. The effect is instantaneous and has no duration beyond this period.

effectDetails.title: Passive Detection Evasion
effectDetails.rules: The scrying attempt has an 85% chance of evading passive detection. This means that if the target is being watched by a creature with Perception, they have only a 15% chance to notice your attempt.

pay_the_guild_to_scry_1.levelRequirementReason: This service is made available to novice mages and other spellcasters who need immediate access to information without the complexity of more advanced scrying spells.
pay_the_guild_to_scry_1.vendorReason: The Mages' Guild ensures all services are delivered directly, with a high level of trustworthiness and reliability in their magical transmissions.
pay_the_guild_to_scry_1.shippingDetail: Delivered via the guild's proprietary spell-based courier network, ensuring quick delivery within ten miles.

usage.activation: A short casting time is required to activate this effect.
usage.duration: The view lasts for one minute.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends after one minute of viewing or if the caster is incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it uses a component slot.

pay_the_guild_to_scry_1.priceReason: This price reflects the guild's administrative costs and the spellcasting involved in providing this service.

peach_loyalists_mushroom_identification.name: Peach Loyalists Mushroom Identification
peach_loyalists_mushroom_identification.description: The Peach Loyalists Mushroom Identification is a handcrafted leather-bound tome adorned with golden threads that shimmer like the petals of Princess Peach's favorite blossoms. This rare volume allows you to identify power-up mushrooms, granting advantage on Nature checks for recognizing beneficial fungi. Swayed by the wisdom of the loyalists, the book also offers insight into the growth and potency of these mushrooms, leading to a rumored enhancement in your abilities when consumed.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Nature Checks
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 30 days, you gain advantage on any checks related to identifying mushrooms and their properties. This effect is limited to once per 14-day period.

effectDetails.title: Identify Power-Up Mushrooms
effectDetails.rules: You can request one location where a power-up mushroom grows during the book's 30-day efficacy, but you must swear loyalty to Princess Peach (a cosmetic requirement).

peach_loyalists_mushroom_identification.levelRequirementReason: This service is available to all adventurers, as it requires no specific combat proficiency or power level.
peach_loyalists_mushroom_identification.vendorReason: The Peach Loyalists are renowned mycologists who specialize in the identification and cultivation of mushrooms that can empower their allies.
peach_loyalists_mushroom_identification.shippingDetail: Shipped via the underground pipe network, this book arrives within a week with minimal chance of damage or loss.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon acquisition; advantage on checks granted for 30 days, identification request once per 14-day period.
usage.duration: 30 days
usage.endsWhen: Upon expiration of the 30 days or when a power-up mushroom is identified and used.

peach_loyalists_mushroom_identification.priceReason: The book's craftsmanship, rarity, and unique identification service justify its moderate price.

peach_loyalists_princess_gown.name: Peach Loyalists Princess Gown
peach_loyalists_princess_gown.description: The Peach Loyalists Princess Gown is a sumptuous garment of silken peach, embroidered with gold and silver thread in intricate patterns that shimmer like the sunlit meadows around the castle. Its delicate lace collar and sleeves whisper secrets of the kingdom's history to those who wear it. This gown not only grants advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks when addressing royal audiences but also subtly conceals minor stains, allowing for a more dignified appearance in court.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer of the gown is attempting to use Charisma (Persuasion) in a royal court, they gain advantage on their roll. This effect lasts until the end of the wearer's next turn.

effectDetails.title: Minor Stain Concealment
effectDetails.rules: The gown can conceal minor stains for 1 hour. The wearer must make a DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to apply the concealing effect, and it functions similarly to the Disguise feat's aid action.

peach_loyalists_princess_gown.levelRequirementReason: The gown requires a minimum level of 6 due to its intricate design and the complexity of its magical properties.
peach_loyalists_princess_gown.vendorReason: As trusted suppliers of royal attire, Peach Loyalists Castle ensures only the finest garments are sold for courtly occasions.
peach_loyalists_princess_gown.shippingDetail: The gown is shipped with utmost care via Pink Petal Express, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition for its intended wearer.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation occurs upon donning the gown.
usage.duration: Until removed or the end of the next turn after a successful Persuasion check (whichever comes first).
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer removes the gown, uses another action on their turn, or fails to maintain the advantage on a Persuasion check.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the magic is self-sustaining while worn.

peach_loyalists_princess_gown.priceReason: The gown's intricate design and magical properties justify this price point, making it a valuable asset for any noble seeking to make an impression at court.

peach_loyalists_royal_peach_tart_recipe.name: Recipe: Peach Loyalists Royal Peach Tart
peach_loyalists_royal_peach_tart_recipe.description: The Recipe: Peach Loyalists Royal Peach Tart is a parchment of golden hues, embossed with the seal of Princess Liana's royal orchard. With this recipe in hand, you can bake tarts that are not only delicious but also imbued with the sweet loyalty of the Loyalist Bakers. Each tart, when shared with allies, grants +1 to Charisma (Persuasion) for 3 hours. The secret lies in using freshly picked peaches from the orchard and ensuring they are prepared exactly as Princess Liana's bakers do it.

effectDetails.title: Royal Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: When you eat a tart made from this recipe, you gain +1 to Charisma (Persuasion) with allies for 3 hours. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Charismatic Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: The tarts' sweetness and the loyalty they represent enhance your persuasive abilities, making it easier to gain favor among those you interact with.

peach_loyalists_royal_peach_tart_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is suitable for all levels as it focuses on social interaction rather than combat skills.
peach_loyalists_royal_peach_tart_recipe.vendorReason: The Peach Loyalists Palace is renowned for its ties to the royal family and its support of loyalist bakers, making it a fitting vendor for this recipe.
peach_loyalists_royal_peach_tart_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered with fresh peaches included in the package ensuring the highest quality ingredients are used when you bake your tarts.

usage.activation: Eat one tart made from this recipe to activate its effects.
usage.duration: 3 hours, or until consumed by the eater.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if the tart is eaten by another creature.

peach_loyalists_royal_peach_tart_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's rarity and the special ingredients required justify its price, making it a valuable addition to any adventurer's repertoire.

peach_loyalists_royal_rolling_board.name: Peach Loyalists Royal Rolling Board
peach_loyalists_royal_rolling_board.description: The Peach Loyalists Royal Rolling Board is a meticulously crafted board, its surface polished to a gleaming sheen. Rolled by hand from the finest peach wood, it exudes an aroma of fresh fruit and loyalty. This board not only ensures smooth rolling for perfect tarts but also grants a +1 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks when used in royal settings. The seal of Princess Peach herself enhances your reputation among her loyalists, boosting your Charisma (Persuasion) by 1 until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Loyalty Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you use this board in a performance or persuasion check, you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for the rest of the day. This effect ends on completion of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Improved Rolling
effectDetails.rules: While using this board, you automatically succeed at any attempt to roll out pastry dough without needing a Dexterity check. The board's surface ensures perfect rolling every time it is used.

peach_loyalists_royal_rolling_board.levelRequirementReason: Any adventurer can benefit from the skills required for pastry creation and royal performance.
peach_loyalists_royal_rolling_board.vendorReason: As part of their service to Princess Peach, they sell tools that enhance loyalty and excellence in baking and performance.
peach_loyalists_royal_rolling_board.shippingDetail: Ships via the royal courier with same-day delivery within the kingdom.

usage.activation: Using this board for rolling or as part of a Charisma (Performance) or (Persuasion) check.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest, and only once per day.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you complete a long rest.

peach_loyalists_royal_rolling_board.priceReason: This board is crafted with rare peach wood and carries the royal seal, making it a valuable tool for any aspiring chef or performer.

peach_loyalists_royal_tea_premium.name: Peach Loyalists Royal Tea (Premium)
peach_loyalists_royal_tea_premium.description: The Peach Loyalists Royal Tea (Premium) exudes regal elegance in every sip, crafted from the rarest peach blossoms and steeped in a secret blend that only the court's finest alchemists can create. This premium brew not only enhances your composure with Charisma saves but also calms even the most agitated nerves, banishing fear for hours. However, on bumpy roads, the delicate porcelain cup may shatter easily, leaving a trail of spilled tea behind.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Composure
effectDetails.rules: Consume the tea as an action. You gain a +2 bonus on all Charisma saving throws for 8 hours, after which the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Calm Nerves
effectDetails.rules: Consume the tea to end the frightened condition if you are currently affected by it. This effect has no save and lasts until the start of your next turn following consumption.

peach_loyalists_royal_tea_premium.levelRequirementReason: This premium tea is crafted for all who seek a momentary reprieve from their duties, making it accessible to any adventurer.
peach_loyalists_royal_tea_premium.vendorReason: The peach-loyalists are renowned for their mastery of the tea arts and their dedication to preserving courtly traditions.
peach_loyalists_royal_tea_premium.shippingDetail: Ships with Royal Couriers who ensure swift delivery, but may arrive lukewarm.

usage.duration: 8 hours until expiration
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends after 8 hours or when consumed in a bumpy area

peach_loyalists_royal_tea_premium.priceReason: The premium quality and rarity of ingredients, combined with the delicate craftsmanship, justify this price.

pebble.name: Just A Pebble
pebble.description: This pebble is no ordinary stone; it feels sturdy and smooth, polished by countless hands over generations. It's said to be a fragment of the old city's ancient wall, imbued with a whisper of its past. When hurled at glass, it shatters with a satisfying crack, dealing 1d4 damage and leaving a spiderweb pattern behind. It also carries with it an ancient curse, forcing the target to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be dazed for one minute, unable to take actions.

effectDetails.title: Thrown
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as an action at a target within 20 feet of glass, it deals 1d4 piercing damage. On a successful hit, the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be dazed for one minute.

effectDetails.title: Ancient Curse
effectDetails.rules: If the target fails its saving throw, they are dazed and unable to take actions until the curse ends. This effect lasts for one minute, during which time the target cannot use any action or reaction unless they succeed on another DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

pebble.levelRequirementReason: It requires a basic understanding of throwing and physical strength to effectively utilize this pebble.
pebble.vendorReason: The market's extensive collection includes relics from the old city, making it a natural place for this ancient fragment.
pebble.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: instantaneous damage; curse lasts until the end of the target's next turn, or until they succeed on a saving throw
usage.endsWhen: target succeeds on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or at the end of their next turn after being cursed

pebble.priceReason: The pebble's rarity, historical significance, and unique properties justify its price.

peekaboo_badge.name: Peekaboo Badge
peekaboo_badge.description: The Peekaboo Badge grants you a fleeting glimpse into the very essence of an enemy's vitality, allowing you to see their exact health in a momentary flash. This badge is forged from the remnants of ancient runes and twisted glass, making it appear as if a small, glowing visor is always at your ready. With its help, you can anticipate attacks and strategize with precision, knowing exactly how much damage each foe can withstand before falling.

effectDetails.title: Always Know
effectDetails.rules: When you use your action to activate the badge, you gain a brief but clear visual representation of an enemy's health. This effect lasts for one round and allows you to see their exact hit point total during that time.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Vision
effectDetails.rules: The vision only lasts until the start of your next turn or until another creature uses a bonus action to look at you, after which the badge's effect ends.

peekaboo_badge.levelRequirementReason: This badge is designed for beginners and those who need an edge against more challenging foes.
peekaboo_badge.vendorReason: The Rogueport Black Market sells a variety of items that cater to the needs of adventurers at all levels, making this badge accessible to many.
peekaboo_badge.shippingDetail: The badge is carefully packed and shipped discreetly, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition without attracting unwanted attention.

usage.duration: One round
usage.endsWhen: Start of your next turn or when another creature uses a bonus action to look at you

peekaboo_badge.priceReason: The badge is priced lower than some magical items because it provides a straightforward utility without any ongoing powers.

permanent_level_up_machine.name: Permanent Level-Up Machine
permanent_level_up_machine.description: The Permanent Level-Up Machine, a gleaming treadmill forged from adamantine steel and polished to a mirror finish, hums with an otherworldly energy as you step onto its sleek surface. Crafted by The Level Designer, this contraption is said to have been used in the trials of ancient gods. Walk for one minute and gain one level; run at your maximum speed and earn two levels per minute. Legend has it that those who dare to use it must swear never to abuse its power.

effectDetails.title: Walk
effectDetails.rules: Activates on the start of your turn as you walk for one minute. You gain one level at the end of this period, provided you remain within range and have not used the Run effect during that time.

effectDetails.title: Run
effectDetails.rules: Activates on the start of your turn as you run at maximum speed for one minute. Gain two levels per minute spent running, but only if you have not walked or used this effect in the previous three minutes.

permanent_level_up_machine.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 1 to operate and gain experience; even the most powerful entities must start somewhere.
permanent_level_up_machine.vendorReason: Infinite Progress specializes in transformative tools, making this machine a natural fit for their inventory.
permanent_level_up_machine.shippingDetail: Ships via teleportation, ensuring you receive your new levels within the hour of purchase.

usage.activation: Activates on the start of your turn during walking or running. Ends when you stop moving at a walk or run speed for one minute, or if you use another effect that prevents level gain.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: You cease movement at any walking or running speed for one minute, or you activate this effect again.

permanent_level_up_machine.priceReason: Balanced to ensure players can afford it early in their journey without overpowered.

personal_bodyguard.name: Personal Bodyguard (1 Month)
personal_bodyguard.description: The Personal Bodyguard (1 Month) is a rare service that procures an elite bodyguard from Iron Legion for one month. This seasoned protector, with AC 20 and 60 hit points, wields a +2 Heavy Shield and longsword. Should the bodyguard's life be in peril, they will make a final stand to ensure your safety, but only once. The service is delivered by Contract Scroll, ensuring swift arrival under Iron Legion's strict protocols.

effectDetails.title: Bodyguard Sacrifice
effectDetails.rules: If the bodyguard's life is in danger and they choose to, they will make a final stand. This effect ends when the bodyguard dies, with no save allowed.

effectDetails.title: Elite Protection
effectDetails.rules: The bodyguard provides passive protection within 30 feet; enemies within this radius have their attack rolls against you reduced by 2 and miss on natural 16s or lower. This effect ends when the service duration ends.

personal_bodyguard.levelRequirementReason: The bodyguard is designed to protect even low-level adventurers, but those above level 1 might find it less challenging.
personal_bodyguard.vendorReason: Iron Legion specializes in elite security services, including this one-month personal bodyguard package.
personal_bodyguard.shippingDetail: Delivered by Contract Scroll, ensuring swift and reliable service.

usage.duration: One month from activation
usage.endsWhen: The bodyguard's life is lost or the one-month duration expires

personal_bodyguard.priceReason: This service offers a seasoned protector for an entire month, providing a balance between cost and protection.

personal_butler.name: Personal Butler (Lifetime)
personal_butler.description: The Personal Butler (Lifetime) is a magically bound butler who serves you eternally, his presence as steadfast as the stone of your home. He can be summoned by a simple whistle, appearing in the most unexpected places with a bow and a smile. His tasks are endless: from preparing gourmet meals to cleaning the grandest hall, he never tires or grows weary, ensuring your every need is met without fail.

effectDetails.title: Eternal Servitude
effectDetails.rules: The butler provides all mundane tasks including cooking, cleaning, and organizing. He does not engage in combat or any activities that would endanger his immortal state.

effectDetails.title: Instant Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Activate with a simple whistle to summon the butler instantly within 30 feet of you for the duration of one long rest.

personal_butler.levelRequirementReason: The bond between master and servant is strong, requiring only the simplest level of magic to maintain.
personal_butler.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon is known for its unique and powerful items that cater to the elite.
personal_butler.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted butler courier, ensuring the item arrives in perfect condition with all the necessary paperwork.

usage.duration: One long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends after one long rest.

personal_butler.priceReason: This item is considered a godly rarity, offering eternal service for only 1000 XP, making it accessible to all adventurers.

personal_island.name: Personal Island (1 Acre)
personal_island.description: A verdant oasis of green and sand in the middle of the sea, this Personal Island (1 Acre) is a private retreat of your own design. Crafted from enchanted coral reefs and seagrass, it’s as much a marvel of nature as it is a testament to your power. The island may attract curious creatures—seekers of treasure or sea monsters—and you must defend its magical deed if challenged.

effectDetails.title: Private Retreat
effectDetails.rules: This effect allows the owner to claim exclusive use of the island. It provides a safe and private location for relaxation or defense, with no creatures other than those specifically invited by the owner being allowed on it without consent.

effectDetails.title: Attracts Curious Beasts
effectDetails.rules: The island may draw in rare sea monsters or treasure hunters. The owner must make a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check at dawn to notice any creatures approaching. If detected, the owner can attempt an Intimidation (DC 18) check to deter them; otherwise, they may have to defend their territory.

personal_island.levelRequirementReason: Requires a high level to ensure the owner has the skills and resources to properly defend or utilize such a powerful asset.
personal_island.vendorReason: The Mariner Guild is responsible for charting and protecting sea routes, making them well-acquainted with the dangers of the ocean. They naturally handle transactions involving islands at sea.
personal_island.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted mariner, who will also provide basic instructions on how to claim your island.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon claiming with the deed
usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or abandoned
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if the owner's magical connection is severed; otherwise permanent

personal_island.priceReason: The island’s enchantments and rarity justify this price, as it represents a significant investment of power and resources.

personal_meteor_shower.name: Personal Meteor Shower (1 Night)
personal_meteor_shower.description: The Personal Meteor Shower brings a celestial spectacle to your doorstep, raining down sparks of light that shimmer in the night sky. For one night only, you and those within sight witness a meteor shower unlike any other—shooting stars that may leave behind fragments of ancient minerals or even cryptic messages from beyond. Guests who observe this event gain +2 to Intelligence checks for 24 hours following the display, enhancing their scholarly pursuits and keen observations.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Spectacle
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Personal Meteor Shower creates a meteor shower visible to all within sight. The display lasts for one night and may reveal rare minerals or celestial messages. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Observations
effectDetails.rules: All guests who witness the meteor shower gain +2 to Intelligence checks for 1 day following the event. This bonus can be used once per day, but it ends if the guest fails an Intelligence check.

personal_meteor_shower.levelRequirementReason: The activation requires a certain amount of magical energy and focus, appropriate for characters who have reached at least 6th level.
personal_meteor_shower.vendorReason: As purveyors of celestial phenomena, the Comet Observatory naturally stocks items that enhance one's connection to the stars.
personal_meteor_shower.shippingDetail: The meteor shower is delivered via a swift Astral Courier, ensuring it arrives just in time for its intended night.

usage.duration: One night (12 hours of activity)
usage.endsWhen: The display ends after one night or if the item is destroyed

personal_meteor_shower.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and magical energy required to sustain such a celestial event.

personal_moon.name: Personal Moon (1 Night)
personal_moon.description: The Personal Moon is a small celestial body that appears in your sky for one night. It hangs there like an enchanted lantern, casting soft light and imbuing you with its otherworldly magic. For the duration of the night, it grants +2 to all ability checks, allowing you to navigate through hidden paths or uncover secrets more easily. Additionally, any guests accompanying you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (CH) checks, enhancing your charisma-based interactions.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Guidance
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants the user +2 to all ability checks for a single night. It ends when the night concludes or if the user is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Guest Charm
effectDetails.rules: Any guests accompanying the user gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (CH) checks for one night, which lasts until the end of their next long rest. This effect does not stack with other similar bonuses.

personal_moon.levelRequirementReason: The Personal Moon's magic is powerful enough that only those of at least 8th level can harness its full potential.
personal_moon.vendorReason: The Comet Observatory specializes in unique cosmic artifacts and this item perfectly aligns with their offerings.
personal_moon.shippingDetail: Ships via a series of celestial messengers, ensuring the Personal Moon arrives at your doorstep just after sunset on the night it is to be used.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon its appearance in the sky; no action required.
usage.duration: One full night
usage.endsWhen: The night ends or if the user becomes incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a one-time use item.

personal_moon.priceReason: While not extraordinarily powerful, the Personal Moon's rarity and unique celestial nature justify its price in game XP.

personal_sunrise.name: Personal Sunrise (1 Day)
personal_sunrise.description: The Personal Sunrise is a compact, intricately crafted device that can summon an authentic sunrise at any time. Its golden core glows faintly as it focuses your will to command the light. When activated, this device grants +2 to all ability checks and saving throws for one full day, enhancing your presence and resolve. Sun worshippers have been known to seek out those who possess such a relic, believing it to be a gift from their celestial patrons.

effectDetails.title: Sunrise Control
effectDetails.rules: This device allows you to summon an authentic sunrise at any time. This effect is instantaneous and can be used once per short rest, but it cannot be used indoors or in areas where sunlight does not naturally occur.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Presence
effectDetails.rules: For 1 day after activation, you gain a +2 bonus to all ability checks and saving throws. This effect is active for the duration of one long rest.

personal_sunrise.levelRequirementReason: This device requires only a basic understanding of focus and willpower to activate.
personal_sunrise.vendorReason: Lunar Auction, known for its eclectic collection of magical artifacts, offers this unique item as part of their premium offerings.
personal_sunrise.shippingDetail: The device arrives sealed in a special vial that ensures its power remains intact until you are ready to use it.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate and control the sunrise.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for sunrise, one long rest for enhanced presence.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a new long rest is completed or the device is destroyed.

personal_sunrise.priceReason: This item's balanced price reflects its rarity and utility, offering significant but not game-breaking benefits.

personal_weather_control.name: Personal Weather Control (1 Hour)
personal_weather_control.description: The Personal Weather Control device, a sleek metal cylinder encased in crystal, allows its wielder to manipulate the elements within a one-mile radius for an hour. It can summon clear skies, unleash torrential rain, create thick fog, or bring forth violent storms. This tool is invaluable on the battlefield, as it can either cripple foes with sudden downpours or bolster allies with unshakable calm. Overuse, however, risks angering the weather spirits, potentially unleashing unpredictable natural forces.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Mastery
effectDetails.rules: By using this device, you can choose to create clear skies, heavy rain, dense fog, or a violent storm within one mile. The weather lasts for exactly one hour and affects all creatures in the area. This effect is usable once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Disruption
effectDetails.rules: The weather you control can be used to disrupt enemies (forcing them to make Constitution saving throws with a DC of 12) or aid allies by providing cover and shelter. However, overuse may provoke the wrath of nature spirits, causing unpredictable weather anomalies.

personal_weather_control.levelRequirementReason: This spell-like device requires a minimum character level to handle its raw elemental power effectively.
personal_weather_control.vendorReason: The storm seller specializes in tools that manipulate the elements, making this item an essential part of their inventory.
personal_weather_control.shippingDetail: Ships via Cloud Vial Express; delivery is swift but requires clear skies for optimal performance.

usage.duration: One hour per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the hour passes, or if overused and the weather spirits are angered

personal_weather_control.priceReason: This item provides a powerful service for its cost, allowing manipulation of elemental forces without spell slots.

pest_extermination.name: Pest Extermination (Professional)
pest_extermination.description: The Pest Extermination (Professional) service calls upon a licensed exterminator to root out vermin from your home or business, ensuring no pests remain for at least 24 hours. The process involves the strategic placement of blessed salt and wards that last seven days, effectively sealing off any entry points and preventing reinfestation. With this service, you can rest easy knowing all creatures up to CR 2 have been dispatched from your property.
effects: Prevents pest return for one week

effectDetails.title: Pest Dispatch
effectDetails.rules: The exterminator dispatches all dangerous pests within a building, ensuring no creatures remain. This effect is instantaneous and covers an area of up to 500 square feet.

effectDetails.title: Preventive Measures
effectDetails.rules: For one week following the service, blessed salt and wards are placed at key entry points to prevent any pests from returning to the premises. No save DC is required for this effect.

pest_extermination.levelRequirementReason: The service involves strategic placement of protective measures that require some skill but do not demand a high level of proficiency.
pest_extermination.vendorReason: The town hall oversees the extermination services to ensure all properties are safe and free from vermin, maintaining public health standards.
pest_extermination.shippingDetail: Services are provided within one business day of booking. All appointments are scheduled in advance for maximum efficiency.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon completion of the service; no further action required.
usage.duration: Instantaneous dispatch, effective for one week thereafter.
usage.endsWhen: The protective measures expire after seven days or if a new infestation is detected and reported to the exterminator.

pest_extermination.priceReason: This service includes both the immediate dispatch of pests and preventive measures that last for one week, making it a valuable investment in property protection.

pet_rock_awkward.name: Awkward Pet Rock
pet_rock_awkward.description: The Awkward Pet Rock is a smooth gray stone with oversized, unsettlingly lifelike googly eyes and a faintly crooked smile. It stares at you with an intensity that makes even the most stoic adventurers squirm, as if it can see through your bravado to the core of your soul. Despite its uncanny gaze, some claim it offers a strange form of comfort, like having an unblinking friend who never leaves you alone.

effectDetails.title: Stares Intensely
effectDetails.rules: The Awkward Pet Rock emits a gaze that makes creatures within 5 feet feel intensely judged. A creature must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed for 1 hour, during which time it is distracted and can't take reactions.

effectDetails.title: Emotional Companion
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of its charm effect (1 hour), the charmed creature gains advantage on saving throws against fear effects. This effect does not stack with other sources of similar benefits.

pet_rock_awkward.levelRequirementReason: The Awkward Pet Rock's intense gaze and emotional support make it a useful ally for adventurers just starting their journey.
pet_rock_awkward.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its eclectic collection of oddities, making the Awkward Pet Rock a fitting addition to their offerings.
pet_rock_awkward.shippingDetail: Due to its size and fragility, it ships in a specially reinforced box with extra padding.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until the charmed creature successfully saves against this effect.
usage.endsWhen: The charmed condition ends when the creature successfully saves or is no longer within line of sight of the Awkward Pet Rock.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one charm effect at a time.

pet_rock_awkward.priceReason: The Awkward Pet Rock provides both a unique challenge and support, making it a fair price for adventurers seeking an unusual companion.

petrified_tears.name: Petrified Tears
petrified_tears.description: The vial holds a crystallized cascade of tears, each one a frozen echo of sorrow and pain. The glow within is not merely light but an ethereal shimmer that seems to pulse in time with your heartbeat. Drinking it brings a surge of empathy for all living creatures around you, making you acutely aware of their suffering. After the effect fades, you are left feeling drained yet deeply connected to those around you, as if you've shared a profound moment of shared pain and understanding.

effectDetails.title: Empathy Aura (Instantaneous)
effectDetails.rules: Upon drinking, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1d10 + your Wisdom modifier. You are also granted advantage on all saving throws against being charmed for the next hour.

effectDetails.title: Shared Sorrow
effectDetails.rules: For one minute after the effect ends, you feel a profound empathy towards all living creatures within 30 feet of you. This can cause you to react emotionally or even cry uncontrollably in response to their feelings.

petrified_tears.levelRequirementReason: The intense emotional experience requires a stable mental state, which is generally achieved by level 1 characters.
petrified_tears.vendorReason: The Fey Market often deals in rare and potent magical items that can inspire or manipulate emotions.
petrified_tears.shippingDetail: Delivered via a convoy of crystal flask couriers, known for their flawless delivery service within the Feywild.

usage.duration: 1 hour and 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after 1 hour if not consumed, or immediately upon being consumed.

petrified_tears.priceReason: This item's balanced price reflects its potent emotional effects and temporary hit points, making it a valuable yet manageable addition to any character's arsenal.

phantom_guide.name: Phantom Guide Contract
phantom_guide.description: The Phantom Guide Contract is a parchment scroll imbued with the essence of a lost hero, bound to serve as an ethereal guide for one week or until it perishes in combat. This spectral companion draws upon memories and skills from past campaigns, offering invaluable wisdom and support to its wielder. Crafted by ancient shamans who knew the value of lost heroes, this contract is a rare find among the treasures of Shamans' Hut.

effectDetails.title: Summon an Ethereal Guide
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a standard action. The guide appears and serves for one week or until it dies in combat. It cannot be dismissed early. The guide is considered to have a CR equal to the highest CR of any PC summoned by the contract owner within the last month.

effectDetails.title: Offers Tactical Advice
effectDetails.rules: The guide provides tactical advice as if it were present, once per day. This advice can be requested as a bonus action and is limited to 30 words. The guide's wisdom is unparalleled but cannot override the owner’s decisions.

phantom_guide.levelRequirementReason: A novice adventurer can appreciate the value of guidance from a past hero.
phantom_guide.vendorReason: Shamans' Hut specializes in relics and contracts that bridge the gap between worlds, including this ethereal guide contract.
phantom_guide.shippingDetail: The Spirit Portal ensures swift delivery of the Phantom Guide Contract within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Standard action to summon; once per day for advice
usage.duration: One week or until death in combat
usage.endsWhen: Combat death, one week duration ends

phantom_guide.priceReason: The cost reflects the rarity and utility of a guide that combines past wisdom with present support.

pikachu_thunderstone.name: Thunderstone
pikachu_thunderstone.description: The Thunderstone is a glowing, jagged stone that crackles with electric energy. Crafted from ancient lightning strikes in the heart of thunderclouds, it can be wielded to call forth a bolt of purest electricity. Upon activation, the stone unleashes a powerful surge of lightning, and its user gains a +1 bonus to all damage rolls involving lightning. Should you roll a 1 on any attack or ability check using this stone, you are shocked for the turn, taking 2d6 lightning damage as a reaction.

effectDetails.title: Lightning Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command. Instantaneous effect. No target or range, affects the user only. When activated, you gain a +1 bonus to all lightning damage rolls until the end of your next turn. Ends when the user's next turn begins.

effectDetails.title: Shocking Roll
effectDetails.rules: If you roll a 1 on any attack or ability check while holding this stone, you and all creatures within 5 feet must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you take 2d6 lightning damage as a reaction.

pikachu_thunderstone.levelRequirementReason: The Thunderstone's raw power requires no specific level to activate but is best used by those familiar with its unpredictable nature.
pikachu_thunderstone.vendorReason: Shamans of the region understand the stone's origins and can provide guidance on its proper use.
pikachu_thunderstone.shippingDetail: Ensures the stone remains stable during transit, minimizing the risk of accidental discharge.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn for Lightning Surge; instant and once per short rest for Shocking Roll
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the user's next turn begins or upon activation, respectively

pikachu_thunderstone.priceReason: Balanced to ensure it remains a valuable but not overpowered addition to any party.

pink_paint_of_agreeable_friendship.name: Pink Paint of Agreeable Friendship
pink_paint_of_agreeable_friendship.description: The Pink Paint of Agreeable Friendship transforms your skin into a vibrant, candy-pink hue that draws people in and makes them want to be around you. Yet, there's something unsettling about it—hostile creatures find you peculiarly disquieting. You might as well be wearing a cloud of bubblegum-scented goo, leaving those who come too close feeling both charmed and wary. This paint, created by the whimsical Friendship Paint Co., is a rare find that adds a playful twist to your interactions with others.

effectDetails.title: Agreeable Charm
effectDetails.rules: When you apply the paint, you have advantage on Persuasion checks with friendly creatures. This effect lasts until you remove the paint or use it again.

effectDetails.title: Hostile Discomfort
effectDetails.rules: Hostile creatures within 10 feet of you when you apply the paint must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on all Intimidation checks against you until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if you remove the paint.

pink_paint_of_agreeable_friendship.levelRequirementReason: This paint is accessible to new adventurers who are just beginning their journey, as it requires no particular skill or background.
pink_paint_of_agreeable_friendship.vendorReason: The Equestrian Paint Shop specializes in paints that enhance your social interactions and unique items for adventurers, making this a perfect fit for them.
pink_paint_of_agreeable_friendship.shippingDetail: Delivered with a flourish, ensuring the paint arrives in its vibrant, unmarred state.

usage.duration: Until you remove it or apply it again.
usage.endsWhen: Removed by washing off or applying it again.

pink_paint_of_agreeable_friendship.priceReason: The paint is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the specialized craftsmanship required for such a charming yet unsettling creation.

pipe_wrench.name: Plumber's Wrench
pipe_wrench.description: The Plumber's Wrench is a robust, forged iron tool adorned with rusted patches and a worn leather grip. Crafted in the bustling streets of Toad Town during the Great Plumbing Era, it hums with the history of countless pipes mended and clogs cleared. This wrench grants you advantage on Mechanics checks to repair or install plumbing fixtures, and when used, it can deliver a powerful blow, dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage as a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Mechanics Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When you use the wrench to attempt a Mechanics check, you gain advantage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Bludgeoning Blow
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can strike with the wrench, dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage to a creature within reach. You can use this ability once per short or long rest.

pipe_wrench.levelRequirementReason: The Plumber's Wrench is designed for beginning adventurers who need basic tools to assist in their plumbing tasks.
pipe_wrench.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for selling practical and essential items used by the town's many mechanics, plumbers, and everyday citizens.
pipe_wrench.shippingDetail: Ships via Toolbox Couriers, ensuring timely delivery to any adventurer in need of plumbing tools.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as part of a Mechanics check
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn for Mechanics Advantage; Instantaneous for Bludgeoning Blow
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you take another bonus action to use the wrench, or at the end of your turn for the mechanics advantage.

pipe_wrench.priceReason: The Plumber's Wrench is priced fairly, reflecting its practical utility and historical significance in Toad Town.

piranha_plant_pot.name: Piranha Plant in a Pot
piranha_plant_pot.description: A chomping green head sits atop a sturdy terracotta pot, its jagged teeth glinting menacingly in the moonlight. This Piranha Plant in a Pot is no mere ornamental piece; it's a guardian of ancient lineage, loyal to its keeper if fed daily with raw steak. By night, it fiercely defends your campsite from intruders, its sharp bite dealing 1d8 piercing damage plus poison (1d4). Should you neglect it for three days without feeding, the Piranha Plant may turn on you, feasting on any raw meat in sight and leaving behind only bones.

effectDetails.title: Guardian of the Night
effectDetails.rules: At nightfall, the Piranha Plant activates as a bonus action to guard your campsite. It remains alert until morning or until an intruder is detected within 30 feet. If an intruder enters this range, it attacks with its bite. The plant can only activate once per day.

effectDetails.title: Venomous Bite
effectDetails.rules: The Piranha Plant's bite deals 1d8 piercing damage plus poison (1d4). The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. On a failed save, the target is also knocked prone and takes an additional 1d6 piercing damage.

piranha_plant_pot.levelRequirementReason: The Piranha Plant in a Pot requires a level 3 character to handle its ferocity and daily feeding demands.
piranha_plant_pot.vendorReason: Shamans of the forest often sell this ancient guardian, as it is closely tied to their lore and can be used for both protection and study.
piranha_plant_pot.shippingDetail: Delivered safely via a reinforced barrel to ensure the plant's survival during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action at nightfall; once per day, unless fed raw steak daily.
usage.duration: Active until morning or an intruder is detected within 30 feet.
usage.endsWhen: The keeper fails to feed it for three days.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the keeper feeds it.

piranha_plant_pot.priceReason: This Piranha Plant in a Pot is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique guardian abilities and daily feeding requirement, making it a strategic yet costly addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

piranha_plant_potted_pet.name: Potted Piranha Plant (Domesticated?)
piranha_plant_potted_pet.description: The Potted Piranha Plant stands tall in its glazed clay pot, a vibrant green monstrosity that seems more at home on the windowsill of a mad botanist than in anyone's living room. Its wide leaves wave gently as if greeting you, but beware—should it feel threatened or startled, its sharp teeth will clamp down with a satisfying crunch, dealing 1d6 piercing damage as a reaction to any who startle it. The plant’s nocturnal song is soothing yet disorienting; those nearby gain advantage on saving throws against sleep effects and lose their edge in Perception checks.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Reaction
effectDetails.rules: The Potted Piranha Plant can take a reaction to bite anyone who startles it. This deals 1d6 piercing damage and has no save. The plant must be startled for this effect, meaning the creature must have surprised or unnerved the plant.

effectDetails.title: Nightly Lullaby
effectDetails.rules: At nightfall, the Potted Piranha Plant releases a melodic tune that soothes nearby creatures but confounds their senses. Creatures within 10 feet gain advantage on saving throws against sleep effects and lose disadvantage on Perception checks until morning.

piranha_plant_potted_pet.levelRequirementReason: The Potted Piranha Plant is a curious item, suitable for adventurers of all levels who might appreciate its unique charm.
piranha_plant_potted_pet.vendorReason: Toad Town Market stocks oddities and curiosities that one can find nowhere else, making the Potted Piranha Plant an ideal addition to their wares.
piranha_plant_potted_pet.shippingDetail: The fragile plant is shipped in a specially reinforced pot to ensure it reaches its destination without harm.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn, or until morning for the lullaby
usage.endsWhen: The reaction ends on a successful save, and the nightly effect ceases at sunrise.

piranha_plant_potted_pet.priceReason: The Potted Piranha Plant is a rare curiosity with a unique ability to intimidate and soothe, offering both practical and whimsical benefits.

piranha_plant_slide.name: Piranha Plant Slide Whistle
piranha_plant_slide.description: The Piranha Plant Slide Whistle, crafted from river reeds and imbued with the spirit of aquatic life, is a relic that conjures a piranha plant to chomp foes. When blown, it summons a ferocious Piranha Plant at your command, its sharp teeth delivering 1d8 piercing damage plus poison for 1d4 hit points. The plant lasts one minute, attacking once per turn and targeting the nearest enemy, unless commanded otherwise by you. After use, the whistle requires feeding with fresh fish to prevent it from deteriorating into mere river reeds.

effectDetails.title: Piranha Summoning
effectDetails.rules: When blown, the whistle summons a Piranha Plant that lasts for one minute. The plant attacks once per turn against the nearest target unless commanded otherwise by the user. Activation is on a bonus action with charges of 1; the whistle requires feeding after use.

effectDetails.title: Plant Poison
effectDetails.rules: The piranha delivers poison damage equal to 1d4 hit points as its bite attack. Saving throw DC 13 against Constitution saving throws.

piranha_plant_slide.levelRequirementReason: This whistle is accessible to lower-level adventurers who wish to employ the aid of aquatic creatures.
piranha_plant_slide.vendorReason: The Shamans' Hut specializes in crafting and selling items that harness the power of nature, making this whistle a fitting addition to their wares.
piranha_plant_slide.shippingDetail: Ships within a week via Plant Pot delivery service, with plants requiring special care during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The whistle requires feeding after each use; without food, it degrades into river reeds after one day.

piranha_plant_slide.priceReason: This whistle, while uncommon in nature, is crafted with specialized materials and requires a unique process for summoning the piranha plant.

pit_fiend_legal_representation.name: Pit Fiend Legal Representation
pit_fiend_legal_representation.description: This compact leather-bound tome, bound with infernal sigils and emblazoned with the Diabolical Bar Association crest, grants you a pit fiend lawyer for any infernal court case. The lawyer's courtroom presence is so formidable that it can automatically win one legal dispute per day, ensuring your victory in the most treacherous of cases. Additionally, this tome allows you to void one contract or geas, whether infernal or otherwise, safeguarding you from dark enchantments and binding agreements.

effectDetails.title: Courtroom Victory
effectDetails.rules: As an action, this tome grants a pit fiend lawyer to assist in your court case. The lawyer automatically wins the case if it involves infernal law. This effect lasts until the court adjourns or you lose the case.

effectDetails.title: Contract Release
effectDetails.rules: Use once per day as an action to void one existing contract or geas, whether infernal in origin or not. The target must be a willing participant for this effect to take place.

pit_fiend_legal_representation.levelRequirementReason: Only those with the gravitas and experience of a high-level spellcaster can afford and benefit from such infernal legal counsel.
pit_fiend_legal_representation.vendorReason: Hells Attorney, the master of all infernal contracts, naturally stocks this item for clients seeking to break or win them.
pit_fiend_legal_representation.shippingDetail: The tome is delivered by a pit fiend courier, ensuring its arrival is swift and secure.

usage.duration: Until the court adjourns or you lose the case for Courtroom Victory; Instantaneous for Contract Release
usage.endsWhen: The court session ends or the target refuses to release the contract for Contract Release
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one charge is used each time it's activated

pit_fiend_legal_representation.priceReason: This item balances as a rare and powerful tool that can significantly alter legal outcomes without being game-breaking.

pitatia_dragon_fruit_slicer.name: Pitatia Dragon Fruit Slicer
pitatia_dragon_fruit_slicer.description: The Pitatia Dragon Fruit Slicer gleams with a subtle forgeheart core, designed by Pitatian Knifemakers to slice through even the toughest dragon fruit skins with ease. Its serrated blade is crafted from Pitatia's unique metal alloy that resists staining and corrosion, ensuring the juice remains untainted as it cuts through in one swift motion. This knife not only expedites preparation but also preserves the vibrant colors of the fruit.

effectDetails.title: Precision Slice
effectDetails.rules: When used to slice a dragon fruit, you gain advantage on checks to prepare the fruit. Additionally, the blade dulls after slicing three hard fruits, requiring an hour of reconditioning to restore its sharpness.

effectDetails.title: Corrosion Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The blade does not corrode or tarnish from exposure to dragon fruit juices, maintaining its pristine condition regardless of usage frequency.

pitatia_dragon_fruit_slicer.levelRequirementReason: This basic tool is suitable for any adventurer, requiring no particular skill or proficiency.
pitatia_dragon_fruit_slicer.vendorReason: The Pitatia Orchard specializes in rare fruits and tools that enhance the fruit-picking experience.
pitatia_dragon_fruit_slicer.shippingDetail: Ships with the Scaly Slice Sheath, ensuring safe delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: As a bonus action when slicing dragon fruits in preparation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; blade dulls after three uses and requires reconditioning.
usage.endsWhen: The blade dulls or is broken, requiring repair.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the blade must be reconditioned after three uses.

pitatia_dragon_fruit_slicer.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its practical utility and craftsmanship without being overpowered.

pitatia_dragon_fruit_wrap.name: Pitatia Dragon Fruit Wrap
pitatia_dragon_fruit_wrap.description: The Pitatia Dragon Fruit Wrap is a vibrant, hand-dyed cloth that exudes the exotic allure of the Pitatian jungles. Crafted with rare dragon fruit juices, this wrap not only enhances your agility but also subtly blends you into the lush greenery when in a tropical environment. The fruity scent lingers for hours after its application, marking your passage through the jungle, and offers minor protection against detection by predators or foes.

effectDetails.title: Camouflage Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When in a tropical environment, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after using it.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Dexterity Boost
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, when you wrap this item around yourself, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to 1d6 + your Dexterity modifier for 8 hours. This effect does not stack with itself.

pitatia_dragon_fruit_wrap.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective tool is accessible to low-level adventurers who need basic stealth and protection in tropical jungles.
pitatia_dragon_fruit_wrap.vendorReason: The Pitatian Dyers are renowned for their expertise in creating wraps that enhance the wearer's survival abilities in their native environment.
pitatia_dragon_fruit_wrap.shippingDetail: Ships via Fruity Tie Express, known for its reliable delivery even through tropical climates.

usage.activation: Action to apply and remove the wrap
usage.duration: 8 hours or until removed
usage.endsWhen: When you remove it or at the start of your next turn after using it

pitatia_dragon_fruit_wrap.priceReason: This item provides significant utility for low-level adventurers while remaining balanced within the game economy.

pitatia_pie_insurance.name: Pitatia Pie Insurance
pitatia_pie_insurance.description: Pitatia Pie Insurance ensures that your sweet creations are safe from both culinary theft and slanderous rumors. Each day, one pie is completely immune to being stolen or poisoned by any means. Additionally, anyone attempting to steal a pie under this policy's protection must endure an hour of hiccups as a curse befalls their attempts. To maintain these protections, you must bake at least one pie weekly; failing to do so will cause the insurance to lapse and leave your pies vulnerable.

effectDetails.title: Pie Protection
effectDetails.rules: One pie per day is immune to theft or poisoning. This protection lasts until midnight each day, after which the policy resets.

effectDetails.title: Hiccup Curse
effectDetails.rules: Anyone attempting to steal a protected pie must endure an hour of hiccups as a curse. The save DC for this effect is 15. A successful saving throw ends the effect immediately.

pitatia_pie_insurance.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to players who are just starting their adventures, ensuring even novices can protect their creations.
pitatia_pie_insurance.vendorReason: Pitatia specializes in all things pastry and ensures that her customers' culinary masterpieces remain safe from harm.
pitatia_pie_insurance.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted Pie Delivery, this service includes a complimentary pie sample with each insurance purchase.

usage.activation: The policy activates automatically upon purchase and remains in effect until the weekly baking requirement is met or the insurance lapses.
usage.duration: Daily for one day
usage.endsWhen: Weekly baking requirement not met or policy lapsed

pitatia_pie_insurance.priceReason: This price reflects the service's value in protecting valuable and unique creations, ensuring they remain safe.

pitatia_pitaya_fruit_boost_service.name: Pitatia Pitaya Fruit Boost Service
pitatia_pitaya_fruit_boost_service.description: The Pitatia Pitaya Fruit Boost Service delivers a luscious dragon fruit that not only restores vitality but also fortifies your resolve in times of challenge. Each juicy slice grants you temporary invincibility to one Strength or Dexterity saving throw for the day, and as it dissolves on your tongue, it heals you over time with a steady stream of life energy. However, the fruit leaves behind a sticky residue that hinders your precision for an hour after consumption.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Saving Throw
effectDetails.rules: Consume the Pitaya to gain advantage on one Strength or Dexterity saving throw. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Healing Over Time
effectDetails.rules: After consumption, you regain 1d6 hit points at the end of each of your turns for 8 hours. The fruit must be consumed within 30 minutes after purchase to activate these effects.

pitatia_pitaya_fruit_boost_service.levelRequirementReason: The Pitaya is accessible to all adventurers, as its refreshing properties are enjoyed by novices and veterans alike.
pitatia_pitaya_fruit_boost_service.vendorReason: Pitatia Orchard specializes in exotic fruits that enhance the vitality of their patrons, making them a perfect vendor for this service.
pitatia_pitaya_fruit_boost_service.shippingDetail: The fruit is delivered within 24 hours and must be refrigerated upon arrival to maintain its freshness.

usage.activation: Eat the Pitaya at the start of your turn.
usage.duration: 8 hours, until consumed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: If not eaten by the end of the day it is purchased.

pitatia_pitaya_fruit_boost_service.priceReason: The fruit's exotic origin and the added benefits justify its reasonable price point.

pitatia_pitaya_smoothie_recipe.name: Recipe: Pitatia Pitaya Smoothie
pitatia_pitaya_smoothie_recipe.description: A hand-written parchment with precise instructions for crafting the legendary Pitatia Pitaya Smoothie. This vibrant, dragon fruit-infused beverage not only grants a burst of exotic vigor but also leaves you burping like a scaly dragon. The smoothie's secret lies in its ingredients—vibrant and juicy pitayas combined with a pinch of dragon breath. Only the Pitatian Juicers know how to blend this potion perfectly, making it an exclusive recipe worth its weight in gold.

effectDetails.title: Exotic Strength
effectDetails.rules: Active on consumption as a bonus action. Drink the smoothie to gain +2 Strength and +1 Constitution for 1 hour, with a saving throw DC of 13.

effectDetails.title: Dragon Breath Burp
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous effect triggered by consuming the smoothie. You burp like a dragon, dealing 1d6 acid damage to one creature within 5 feet as a reaction, and you are incapacitated for 1 minute.

pitatia_pitaya_smoothie_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate the simplicity of blending dragon fruit with the right ingredients.
pitatia_pitaya_smoothie_recipe.vendorReason: The Pitatian Orchard is known for its unique and potent fruits, so it's fitting they sell this legendary smoothie recipe.
pitatia_pitaya_smoothie_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Fruity Flask Folio via a dragon courier, ensuring the smoothie remains fresh and potent upon arrival.

usage.activation: Bonus action to drink the smoothie
usage.duration: 1 hour for Strength and Constitution bonus; instantaneous dragon breath burp effect
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you are incapacitated by the dragon breath burp
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one can be consumed at a time

pitatia_pitaya_smoothie_recipe.priceReason: The rare ingredients and precise blending technique make this recipe a valuable commodity.

pitatia_sonic_grenade.name: Pitatia Sonic Grenade
pitatia_sonic_grenade.description: The Pitatia Sonic Grenade is a small, cylindrical device that emits an ear-splitting burst of focused sound waves. Crafted from durable steel and lined with Pitatia's proprietary acoustics material, it delivers a non-lethal shock to the ears within its radius. Once activated, it forces all creatures within 10 feet to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be deafened for one minute, ensuring silence in the chaos it creates.

effectDetails.title: Deafening Blast
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as an action within 30 feet, the grenade forces all creatures within 10 feet to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are deafened for one minute and cannot be targeted by any sound-based attacks or spells until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Non-Lethal
effectDetails.rules: The grenade does no physical damage but instead causes an intense auditory shockwave that affects hearing. It is not a weapon, so it does not count as an attack for the purpose of features like Action Surge or any similar abilities.

pitatia_sonic_grenade.levelRequirementReason: This device requires minimal skill to operate and can be used by adventurers of all levels.
pitatia_sonic_grenade.vendorReason: Pitatia Tech specializes in sonic weaponry, making it only logical that they would produce a non-lethal sound device like the Pitatia Sonic Grenade.
pitatia_sonic_grenade.shippingDetail: Delivered in a sturdy metal container to ensure safe transport of this potentially loud and dangerous item.

usage.activation: thrown as an action within 30 feet
usage.duration: 1 minute for each deafened creature
usage.endsWhen: the effect ends when the deafened creatures make successful saving throws or until dispelled by a spell like Lesser Restoration

pitatia_sonic_grenade.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its rare material composition and specialized craftsmanship.

pixie_dust_sprinkler.name: Pixie Dust Sprinkler
pixie_dust_sprinkler.description: The Pixie Dust Sprinkler is a small glass vial filled with shimmering dust that whispers of ancient fey magic. When activated, it releases a cloud of levitating particles that grant the wielder a modest flight for short durations, perfect for avoiding low-hanging branches or dodging quicksand. The sprinkler also carries a whimsical charm, as curious pixies are drawn to its glow and often dance around those who use it.

effectDetails.title: Minor Flight
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can activate the sprinkler to gain a fly speed of 10 feet for up to 1 minute. This effect has a duration limit of three uses per vial and requires a Dexterity saving throw (DC 12) or risk sneezing and wasting a use.

effectDetails.title: Pixie Charm
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the user can activate the sprinkler to attract curious pixies within 30 feet. These pixies are drawn to the dust and perform minor tricks for the duration of their interest, which is typically until they find another source of amusement.

pixie_dust_sprinkler.levelRequirementReason: This item's effects are designed to assist beginners in navigating simple challenges without overwhelming them.
