pixie_dust_sprinkler.vendorReason: The Feywild Flea Market specializes in items that bring the wonders of the fey realm into everyday use, making it a perfect vendor for this whimsical trinket.
pixie_dust_sprinkler.shippingDetail: Delivered with care to ensure the Pixie Dust remains active and effective upon arrival.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the user sneezes (wasting a use)
usage.charges: 3 uses per vial, recharged by refilling with common glitter

pixie_dust_sprinkler.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its utility for beginners and the cost of sourcing and refining fey dust.

planar_anchor_installation.name: Planar Anchor Installation
planar_anchor_installation.description: The Planar Anchor Installation is a massive, gleaming construct made of adamantine and enchanted iron, resembling an intricate anchor etched with sigils that bind a location to the material plane. Once installed, it prevents dimensional shifts and ensures that the site remains solidly anchored in its current plane, effectively nullifying any attempt at planar manipulation or teleportation. This steadfast protector requires regular maintenance of 2,000 gp annually to remain operational.
effects: Stabilizes a location on the material plane

effectDetails.title: Stabilization
effectDetails.rules: The installation permanently stabilizes the chosen location, preventing it from being teleported, phased through, or planed-shifted. This effect is instantaneous and lasts indefinitely as long as maintenance is provided.

effectDetails.title: Maintenance Requirement
effectDetails.rules: Annual maintenance of 2,000 gp is required to keep the installation functional; failure to maintain it results in its deactivation after one year.

planar_anchor_installation.levelRequirementReason: Even a novice spellcaster can appreciate and afford this basic level of protection.
planar_anchor_installation.vendorReason: The Artificer Tower specializes in magical constructs and protective enchantments, making it the ideal vendor for such an installation.
planar_anchor_installation.shippingDetail: Delivered by a team of expert masons and spellcasters, the Planar Anchor Installation arrives fully assembled and ready to install.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon installation; requires ongoing maintenance
usage.duration: Permanent with regular upkeep
usage.endsWhen: Maintenance is discontinued for one year
usage.charges: Unlimited, but subject to annual maintenance

planar_anchor_installation.priceReason: This price reflects the cost of materials and labor involved in the installation.

planar_binding_circle.name: Planar Binding Circle (Ritual)
planar_binding_circle.description: The Planar Binding Circle, a portable ritual circle of enchanted chalk and silver dust, is a relic crafted by Summoners Lodge to bind extraplanar creatures. Its etched runes glow with an otherworldly light, whispering the secrets of planes far beyond our own. This circle can summon and bind creatures up to CR 10, ensuring they are contained until the ritual concludes or their will is broken. Made from rare earth materials and imbued with ancient spells, it requires no chalk refills once initiated.

effectDetails.title: Extraplanar Binding
effectDetails.rules: This ritual allows the caster to summon and bind extraplanar creatures up to CR 10 within a 20-foot diameter circle. The creature must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or be bound, remaining dormant until the ritual ends. Once used, it requires a day of preparation with chalk refills before reuse.

effectDetails.title: Ritual Recharge
effectDetails.rules: The circle can only be used once per long rest after binding an extraplanar creature. If the caster fails to complete the ritual within 10 minutes, the creature is released and the circle must recharge for a full day.

planar_binding_circle.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant magical power and knowledge of ancient rituals.
planar_binding_circle.vendorReason: Arcane Circle specializes in magical artifacts used for summoning and binding extraplanar creatures.
planar_binding_circle.shippingDetail: Ships via a Portal Frame, delivering the circle within an hour of purchase.

usage.activation: A ritual action performed over 10 minutes with chalk refills.
usage.duration: Instantaneous summoning and binding; creature remains dormant until ritual ends or freed by its willpower.
usage.endsWhen: Creature breaks free, caster fails saving throw, or ritual is interrupted.

planar_binding_circle.priceReason: Balanced as a rare and powerful tool used in high-level rituals.

planar_seal_breaking.name: Planar Seal Breaking (Service)
planar_seal_breaking.description: The Planar Seal Breaking service, provided by Arcane Institute mages, shatters a seal to allow dimensional travel or prison dimension breaches. This ritual takes 8 hours and requires five mages working in concert. The seal's creator is alerted; there’s a risk of a counter-curse that could disrupt the breach attempt. The process demands precise focus and arcane knowledge, making it an epic challenge for even seasoned mages.
effects: Breaks one planar seal or prison dimension
Requires five mages working in concert

effectDetails.title: Activation
effectDetails.rules: A ritual lasting 8 hours, requiring five casters and the successful DC 25 Arcana check. Failure risks a counter-curse that could reverse or disrupt the breach.

effectDetails.title: Counter-curse Risk
effectDetails.rules: There’s a 10% chance per hour of ritual casting that the seal’s creator will cast a counter-curse, which has a DC 25 Arcana saving throw to resist. Success ends the ritual prematurely.

planar_seal_breaking.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant magical knowledge and experience; only those at least 9th level can properly coordinate this intricate ritual.
planar_seal_breaking.vendorReason: Arcane Institute mages are the most experienced in such rituals, ensuring precision and safety for their clients.
planar_seal_breaking.shippingDetail: Dispatched via Magical Courier Service, with a two-day delivery time due to arcane tracking and protection.

usage.activation: A ritual lasting 8 hours; requires five mages working in concert
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect once successfully completed
usage.endsWhen: The ritual fails or the seal is breached

planar_seal_breaking.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP; this service requires significant magical knowledge and resources to execute.

planetars_wings.name: Planetar's Wings (Graft)
planetars_wings.description: Planetar's Wings (Graft) graft celestial wings onto your body. These wings allow you to fly at a speed of 90 feet and unleash a divine feather barrage, raining fiery feathers that deal 1d6 fire damage on all creatures within 30 feet. The wings radiate a permanent 30-foot radius of blinding sunlight, causing creatures within the area to make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Divine Feather Barrage
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can unleash a barrage of fiery feathers. Each creature in a 30-foot radius must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d8 fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Sunlight Aura
effectDetails.rules: You radiate a permanent 30-foot radius of blinding sunlight. Creatures within this area must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn. This effect is always active.

planetars_wings.levelRequirementReason: The wings' divine power requires significant magical strength and control, accessible only to high-level clerics and paladins.
planetars_wings.vendorReason: Celestial Mods is a renowned forge for divine grafts, specializing in celestial wings that can be attached to mortals by Empyrean Surgeons.
planetars_wings.shippingDetail: The delicate nature of the graft requires special handling. Planetar's Wings are shipped within 3 days and arrive fully functional with a 10% success rate boost due to expert courier care.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Divine Feather Barrage; permanent effect for Sunlight Aura
usage.duration: Permanent (Sunlight Aura); until the start of your next turn (Divine Feather Barrage)
usage.endsWhen: Dislodged by a successful DC 25 Strength check or removed by a Remove Graft spell

planetars_wings.priceReason: The wings are crafted from pure celestial essence and require the expertise of Empyrean Surgeons, making them an exorbitant yet invaluable asset for divine warriors.

plate_of_reflections.name: Plate of Reflections
plate_of_reflections.description: The Plate of Reflections is a polished, silver-plated armor piece that reveals not only your face but also fleeting moments and small truths. When you place food upon it, a memory tied to the meal unfolds before your eyes, offering clues for investigation or reflection. Once per week, you can shapeshift your reflection into an illusion to charm or confuse one creature within 30 feet as an action, lasting until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Memory Revealer
effectDetails.rules: When food is placed on the plate, it reveals a memory tied to the meal. The memory lasts for 1 minute and offers insight into the past. This effect can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Shifting Reflection
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to shapeshift your reflection into an illusion that attempts to charm or confuse one creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed or confused for 1 hour, at which point the effect ends.

plate_of_reflections.levelRequirementReason: The Plate of Reflections requires a minimum level to ensure players can manage its effects without overpowering their capabilities.
plate_of_reflections.vendorReason: Midnight Bazaar stocks rare curiosities and artifacts, including the Plate of Reflections, which is known for its unique properties among adventurers.
plate_of_reflections.shippingDetail: Ships via Silver-Wrapped Couriers, ensuring safe delivery within a week.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (at the start of your turn)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Memory Revealer; 1 hour for Shifting Reflection
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the item is destroyed, and it has no charges.

plate_of_reflections.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique abilities without being overpowered.

plot_armor_shredder.name: Plot Armor Shredder
plot_armor_shredder.description: The Plot Armor Shredder is a gleaming, obsidian blade crafted by the Narrative Assassin from the very bones of forgotten plots and failed arcs. This relic can pierce even the strongest narrative defenses, allowing it to bypass plot armor entirely. Upon activation, it strips away divine protections and narrative immunities, leaving characters vulnerable to their true fates. Legends say that once wielded, it can slay the main antagonist in a single blow, ensuring no protagonist is left unscathed.

effectDetails.title: Bypasses Plot Armor
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within 5 feet of a target, the Plot Armor Shredder immediately ends any plot armor or divine protections. The target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be exposed to their true fate.

effectDetails.title: Unleashes True Fates
effectDetails.rules: For one minute after activation, the target's actions are dictated by the narrative. They can take no beneficial actions and must follow any narrative demands imposed by the wielder of this relic. This effect ends if the target takes damage or if the Plot Armor Shredder is removed from their possession.

plot_armor_shredder.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest heroes can wield this powerful tool to challenge narratives.
plot_armor_shredder.vendorReason: The Story Breakers are known for offering tools that challenge and reshape the very fabric of stories, making them the perfect purveyors of the Plot Armor Shredder.
plot_armor_shredder.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Courier of Fates, this relic arrives with a cryptic note from the Narrative Assassin, warning of its immense power and cautioning against misuse.

usage.duration: One minute or until removed from target
usage.endsWhen: Target takes damage or relic is removed from their possession

plot_armor_shredder.priceReason: The Plot Armor Shredder's price reflects its immense power and the risk it poses to any narrative.

pocket_compass.name: Pocket Compass
pocket_compass.description: The Pocket Compass is a small brass compass whose needle wavers erratically, always pointing toward your current heart's desire or deepest longing. Crafted from ancient brass and etched with forgotten runes, it glows faintly when you are near hidden doors, guiding you to secrets long buried. Each long rest allows one use of its magic to cast Locate Object (self only), but the compass must be set down to activate this power.
effects: Points toward your current heart's desire

effectDetails.title: Locate Object
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the compass allows you to cast Locate Object (self only) as a bonus action. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Glowing Indicator
effectDetails.rules: The compass glows faintly when within 30 feet of any hidden door or secret passage, providing you with an immediate visual cue.

pocket_compass.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character to have reached at least level 1 in order to manage the compass's subtle magic.
pocket_compass.vendorReason: The twilight outpost is known for its magical curiosities and often stocks items like the Pocket Compass, which appeal to travelers seeking guidance on their journeys.
pocket_compass.shippingDetail: Ships via a padded pouch to ensure safe delivery of this delicate item.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Used or discarded after one use per long rest

pocket_compass.priceReason: The Pocket Compass's unique ability to aid in locating hidden objects and its glowing indicator for secret doors make it a valuable tool, hence the moderate price of 1000 XP.

pocket_dimension_universe.name: Pocket Dimension Universe
pocket_dimension_universe.description: This shimmering marble, a marvel of dimensional engineering, contains an entire universe teeming with life and wonder. Within its confines, a billion souls flourish under your gaze, their collective worship fueling your dominion over this miniature cosmos. You can step into the pocket dimension to rule as a god among these beings, shaping destinies and forging new worlds at will. The Universe in a Bottle Co. crafted it with precision, ensuring only the most powerful can wield its godly might.

effectDetails.title: Pocketed Cosmos
effectDetails.rules: By speaking the activation phrase 'Realm Within,' you can enter the pocket dimension. While inside, you are treated as a demigod among the inhabitants. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made within this miniature universe and gain temporary hit points equal to your level × 2 until you leave or abandon the realm.

effectDetails.title: Divine Dominion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command the creatures in the pocket dimension to perform a task. The creatures must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or refuse to obey your command. You can use this effect once per long rest.

pocket_dimension_universe.levelRequirementReason: Only those of sufficient power and wisdom can wield such an artifact responsibly.
pocket_dimension_universe.vendorReason: Dimensional Wares specializes in items that defy the laws of space and time, making it a fitting vendor for this cosmic marvel.
pocket_dimension_universe.shippingDetail: The package arrives with an intricate seal that must be broken by speaking the activation phrase 'Realm Within' to activate the pocket dimension.

usage.duration: Instantaneous entry, lasts until you leave or abandon the realm
usage.endsWhen: You leave the realm or abandon it

pocket_dimension_universe.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique abilities justify a price of 1,000 XP.

pocket_dimensional_kitchen.name: Pocket Dimensional Kitchen
pocket_dimensional_kitchen.description: The Pocket Dimensional Kitchen is a compact marvel of alchemy and enchantment, concealing an endless pantry and state-of-the-art oven. Upon opening its door, you are greeted by an array of ingredients that seem to stretch infinitely, all perfectly preserved for centuries. This culinary treasure restores +1d4 HP with every meal prepared and ensures the food remains fresh and delicious for a century. The kitchen is ever guarded by a sentient spatula who judges your cooking prowess.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Meal Provision
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the kitchen to prepare any meal. The meal is perfect in flavor and provides +1d4 hit points instantly upon consumption. This effect does not require material components or a saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Century-Long Preservation
effectDetails.rules: All food prepared within the kitchen remains magically preserved for 100 years, unaffected by spoilage or time.

pocket_dimensional_kitchen.levelRequirementReason: Any adventurer can benefit from this invaluable tool.
pocket_dimensional_kitchen.vendorReason: The Artificer Tower specializes in crafting and selling magical items that enhance daily life, making the Pocket Dimensional Kitchen a perfect fit for their inventory.
pocket_dimensional_kitchen.shippingDetail: Shipped with care using the Miniature Stove, this item arrives safely to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day. Recharges on a long rest.

pocket_dimensional_kitchen.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item offers significant utility without overpowered effects.

pocket_of_infinite_stairs.name: Pocket of Infinite Stairs
pocket_of_infinite_stairs.description: A small stairwell that leads nowhere — but never ends. The steps are worn smooth from countless ascents, and the air inside is perpetually cool despite the sun's warmth outside. Entering this pocket of stairs feels like climbing a mountain; time ticks steadily forward, yet you find yourself no closer to the top after hours. A crypt courier once delivered it, sealed in an ancient chest from forgotten tombs, and now it sits under lock and key at the shop run by the enigmatic Wooden Door.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Ascent
effectDetails.rules: When you enter, you begin climbing an endless staircase. Time passes normally, but you never reach the top. After each hour of climbing, roll a d4 and add your Dexterity modifier (minimum 1) to determine how many years pass; this aging effect is cumulative.

effectDetails.title: Random Landing
effectDetails.rules: You can exit at any time and instantly arrive in a random location. The destination could be miles away, or even across the plane. This teleportation is unpredictable and dangerous; you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to avoid becoming disoriented for 1d4 hours.

pocket_of_infinite_stairs.levelRequirementReason: Even for low-level adventurers, the risks of entering this pocket are too great without proper training or preparation.
pocket_of_infinite_stairs.vendorReason: The crypt courier has a long-standing relationship with the Wooden Door and often delivers rare artifacts from ancient tombs.
pocket_of_infinite_stairs.shippingDetail: Ships via a secret underground passage, ensuring quick delivery to the shop's vault.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: You exit or are disoriented by the random teleportation effect.

pocket_of_infinite_stairs.priceReason: The item's rarity and unpredictable nature justify its modest price, making it accessible to more players without breaking balance.

pocket_orchestra.name: Pocket Orchestra
pocket_orchestra.description: The Pocket Orchestra is a diminutive brass box, its surface etched with intricate patterns that shimmer like starlight. When activated, it summons a troupe of spectral musicians who dance and play within a 30-foot radius. The invisible ensemble weaves a protective symphony around allies, granting them +2 AC and boosting their morale by +1 for the next hour. Should any creature dare disturb the music, the musicians vanish in a cloud of misty notes.

effectDetails.title: Summon Spectral Musicians
effectDetails.rules: The user must expend one Use Charge to activate the Pocket Orchestra. It immediately summons a troupe of spectral musicians within a 30-foot radius who play for up to an hour. The musicians provide +2 AC and +1 morale bonus to all allies in the area until the music ends or they are disturbed.

effectDetails.title: Disruption
effectDetails.rules: If any hostile creature enters the 30-foot radius or attacks a musician, the musicians vanish immediately, ending their protective effects. The Pocket Orchestra can be used once per long rest.

pocket_orchestra.levelRequirementReason: Players at lower levels are more likely to appreciate an item that enhances their immediate combat effectiveness without requiring high-level spells.
pocket_orchestra.vendorReason: The Pawn of Wonders is known for its eclectic collection, including rare and unusual items like the Pocket Orchestra.
pocket_orchestra.shippingDetail: Ships within a week via Mahogany Case Express; expedited shipping available.

usage.activation: Reaction when threatened or attacked by an enemy.
usage.duration: Up to one hour, ending if the musicians are disturbed.
usage.endsWhen: The musicians vanish if a hostile creature enters their radius or attacks them.
usage.charges: Uses one Use Charge per activation.

pocket_orchestra.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's utility in enhancing combat effectiveness and morale without being overpowered.

point_swap.name: Point Swap
point_swap.description: The Point Swap is a peculiar device, crafted from shimmering glass and enchanted with ancient runes. It allows you to momentarily exchange your hit points for magic points, drawing on an arcane reserve of energy that only lasts as long as the balance holds. This whimsical trinket originated in the enigmatic Comet Observatory, known for its eccentric yet powerful artifacts. Use it wisely, for the swap is not without consequence.
effects: Swap Hit Points with Magic Points

effectDetails.title: Point Swap
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate this device to swap your current hit points percentage with your magic points or spell slots percentage. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn. There is no saving throw involved, and it can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Reactive Swap
effectDetails.rules: If you are reduced to 0 hit points while this effect is active, the swap ends immediately. The device then shatters into a harmless glimmer of light.

point_swap.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet powerful device can be used by anyone who seeks to experiment with their body's reserves.
point_swap.vendorReason: The Comet Observatory is known for its collection of quirky and potent magical trinkets, making the Point Swap a fitting addition.
point_swap.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Mail within one week from the observatory.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: You are reduced to 0 hit points or the effect ends at the start of your next turn
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only once per day

point_swap.priceReason: The Point Swap is moderately priced due to its rarity and utility, allowing players to experiment with their magical reserves without breaking the bank.

points_to_the_nearest_treasure.name: Wario's Treasure Hunting Compass
points_to_the_nearest_treasure.description: Wario's Treasure Hunting Compass points unerringly to the nearest hidden treasure, but it has a habit of misleading you. It spins wildly around when gold is nearby, granting advantage on Perception checks for locating loot. However, be wary: this compass occasionally points directly at Wario himself, demanding a cut of your find before offering directions again. Crafted by Wario's Adventure Gear from the remnants of his greatest heists, it’s both a reliable tool and a cautionary tale.
effects: Advantage on Perception checks near gold

effectDetails.title: Treasure Pointing
effectDetails.rules: The compass points towards the nearest hidden treasure within a mile. If no treasure is nearby, it may point to Wario's location with a 30% chance.

effectDetails.title: Advantage Near Gold
effectDetails.rules: When within 50 feet of gold or treasure, the user gains advantage on Perception checks to locate it.

points_to_the_nearest_treasure.levelRequirementReason: Beginners find this compass invaluable for their early adventures.
points_to_the_nearest_treasure.vendorReason: Wario sells his own gear and ensures it's both reliable and a bit mischievous.
points_to_the_nearest_treasure.shippingDetail: Ships via Wario's personal Treasure Trail Truck, ensuring safe delivery with occasional detours through questionable areas.

usage.duration: Until the user finds or is pointed to a treasure
usage.endsWhen: The compass indicates no more hidden treasures within reach
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day

points_to_the_nearest_treasure.priceReason: Balanced for beginners who need reliable guidance early in their adventuring career.

pointy_stick.name: Pointy Stick
pointy_stick.description: The Pointy Stick, forged from a gnarled tree branch and honed to a razor-sharp point by the village blacksmith, serves as both a symbol of survival and a practical tool for the aspiring adventurer. Crafted with care in the heart of the Whispering Woods, its sturdy wooden shaft is reinforced with iron tips that make it a reliable companion through rugged terrain. This humble weapon has seen countless battles, yet it never loses its edge or its usefulness.

effectDetails.title: Piercing Weapon
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with the Pointy Stick as part of a melee attack, it deals 1d4 points of piercing damage. If your attack roll is equal to or lower than 5 (a natural 1), the Pointy Stick breaks and becomes useless.

effectDetails.title: Breaks on Critical Failure
effectDetails.rules: The Pointy Stick has a limited durability and will break if you critically fail an attack with it. This limits its usefulness in prolonged combat but ensures that it remains a reliable tool for quick strikes.

pointy_stick.levelRequirementReason: The Pointy Stick is suitable for beginners who are just starting their journey as adventurers.
pointy_stick.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post stocks a variety of basic equipment that is essential for all adventurers, regardless of their background or experience.
pointy_stick.shippingDetail: Ships within one week with Standard Courier, ensuring that your Pointy Stick arrives in time for your next adventure.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The Pointy Stick breaks on a natural 1 or if you critically fail an attack roll with it.

pointy_stick.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the item's common rarity and its utility as both a weapon and a reliable tool.

pokeball_master_edition.name: Master Pokéball
pokeball_master_edition.description: The Master Pokéball, crafted by the Pokémon League from ancient Alolan metals, is a formidable tool for trainers seeking to expand their Pokédex. This gleaming orb instantly captures any non-legendary creature, regardless of size or strength, upon contact. Once subdued within its confines, the captured Pokémon remains dormant until released by its trainer. Though powerful, it cannot be used on sapient humanoids, ensuring a balance between taming and respect for intelligence.

effectDetails.title: Instant Capture
effectDetails.rules: The Master Pokéball can be thrown as an action to capture any non-legendary creature (Challenge Rating up to CR 15) on contact. The target is instantly subdued and bound within the ball, rendering it inert until released by its trainer.

effectDetails.title: Non-Sapient Only
effectDetails.rules: This item cannot be used on sapient humanoids or any creature capable of complex thought and language.

pokeball_master_edition.levelRequirementReason: Even novice trainers can wield the Master Pokéball, making it accessible to all.
pokeball_master_edition.vendorReason: The Pokémon League exclusively sells tools that aid in capturing and training Pokémon, ensuring only they offer such items.
pokeball_master_edition.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the trusted winged messengers of the Pokémon League.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Expended upon successful capture or if thrown away

pokeball_master_edition.priceReason: The Master Pokéball is priced at a fair value considering its rarity and the convenience it offers trainers.

pokemon_connectopia_pioneer_key.name: Pioneer’s Key to the Frontier
pokemon_connectopia_pioneer_key.description: The Pioneer’s Key to the Frontier is a compact, metallic token engraved with ancient symbols of terrain adaptation. Crafted by Goomba Ground Delivery in compliance with the Supernatural Sovereignty Act, this key grants temporary access to Connectopia's hidden zones and reveals three new terrain types on your map. Upon use, there's a 10% chance to discover a rare item within each zone, but improper handling risks causing minor terrain distortions.

effectDetails.title: New Terrain Revelation
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Reveals three new types of terrain on the map within a 60-foot radius for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Rarity Drops
effectDetails.rules: Grants a 10% chance to find rare items in each zone accessed during the key's effect duration, lasting until the start of your next turn after using it.

pokemon_connectopia_pioneer_key.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and utility of the key require basic knowledge of terrain navigation.
pokemon_connectopia_pioneer_key.vendorReason: Pokemon has established a reliable network for distributing keys to frontier zones as part of their mandate.
pokemon_connectopia_pioneer_key.shippingDetail: Ships via Goomba Ground Delivery's Express Route, ensuring safe and timely delivery.

usage.duration: One hour from activation
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn after using it

pokemon_connectopia_pioneer_key.priceReason: Reflects the strategic value and rarity drop potential, balanced against its common rarity.

pokemon_crimson_fleet_ranger_key.name: Crimson Fleet Ranger Key
pokemon_crimson_fleet_ranger_key.description: The Crimson Fleet Ranger Key is a gleaming brass token, its surface etched with ancient runes of the sea. This relic grants access to hidden vaults and elite training grounds reserved for the most skilled navigators. Once activated, it enhances your evolution stones' effectiveness by 10%, but only within the next 24 hours. A trusted emblem among pirate lords, this key is both a symbol of your status and a tool for mastering the elements.

effectDetails.title: Access to Hidden Vaults
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, providing access to restricted areas for 24 hours. Must be used within one hour of obtaining the key. The effect ends when the 24-hour window expires.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Evolution Stones
effectDetails.rules: Grants a 10% bonus to all stat gains from evolution stones, active for 24 hours after activation. This effect can only be used once per player account and is limited to members of the Crimson Fleet faction.

pokemon_crimson_fleet_ranger_key.levelRequirementReason: The key's enchantment requires a basic understanding of navigation and pirate lore.
pokemon_crimson_fleet_ranger_key.vendorReason: The Pokémon vendor, being familiar with both evolution stones and the Crimson Fleet's secrets, is entrusted to sell this unique token.
pokemon_crimson_fleet_ranger_key.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring swift delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 24 hours from activation.
usage.endsWhen: The 24-hour window expires or if used again before the first effect concludes.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per player account.

pokemon_crimson_fleet_ranger_key.priceReason: Reflects the item's unique access and its utility in enhancing character development for Crimson Fleet members.

pokemon_delfino_captain_sword.name: Admiral Toads Captain’s Blade
pokemon_delfino_captain_sword.description: The Admirals Captain's Blade is a ceremonial sword forged from the heart of Admiral Toads, said to carry the essence of legendary naval prowess. Its blade glows with a faint mechanical pulse and whispers of ancient battles. This relic can only be wielded in territories controlled by Noki or Koopa factions, granting its user immunity to status effects for one turn, and a 25% chance to convert an enemy into a mechanical state for the same duration.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Status Effects
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains immunity to all status effects for one turn upon activation. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Mechanical Conversion
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance (d20 roll, DC 15) that an enemy targeted by this weapon will be converted into a mechanical state for one turn. This effect ends if the target takes damage or if the wielder attacks another creature.

pokemon_delfino_captain_sword.levelRequirementReason: The blade's intricate design and the essence of Admiral Toads make it accessible only to those with a basic understanding of martial combat.
pokemon_delfino_captain_sword.vendorReason: The Pokémon company maintains a special relationship with the Ranger Union, who crafted this blade from their legendary materials.
pokemon_delfino_captain_sword.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week via the Rakasha's mystical couriers. Requires a special ceremonial pouch for safe transport.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (one turn effect)
usage.endsWhen: The target takes damage or attacks another creature

pokemon_delfino_captain_sword.priceReason: Balanced as a legendary item, this blade offers significant utility and rare opportunities to affect battles.

pokemon_fawful_speech_tome.name: Fawfuls Linguistic Tome
pokemon_fawful_speech_tome.description: The Fawfuls Linguistic Tome is a cursed book bound in rusted metal, its pages emblazoned with intricate gears and cogs. When opened, it hums ominously, speaking in a cacophony of mechanical tongues. This ancient tome grants you the power to speak gibberish, confusing your foes for two turns, and delivers a +10% critical hit chance against Pokémon with mechanical traits when used on them. However, consuming this cursed book makes you hear Fawful’s voice for one minute, causing temporary confusion.

effectDetails.title: Speech in Gibberish
effectDetails.rules: When used on a creature, it forces the target to speak gibberish for two turns. The effect ends when the target is incapacitated or knocked unconscious.

effectDetails.title: Critical Hit Chance Bonus
effectDetails.rules: If used on a Pokémon with a mechanical trait, the user gains a +10% chance to score a critical hit against that target. This bonus lasts until the start of your next turn after using the tome.

pokemon_fawful_speech_tome.levelRequirementReason: This tome requires significant control over linguistic and mechanical constructs to wield its power effectively.
pokemon_fawful_speech_tome.vendorReason: The Pokémon vendor specializes in exotic and cursed items related to their world, including this ancient Rakasha creation.
pokemon_fawful_speech_tome.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Rakasha plane with swift delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, duration of two turns for speech in gibberish and until next turn for critical hit chance bonus
usage.endsWhen: Target is incapacitated or knocked unconscious; ends when the start of your next turn arrives after using the tome
usage.charges: Unlimited, but cannot be used consecutively on the same target

pokemon_fawful_speech_tome.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity as an epic item and the significant power boost it provides in combat.

pokemon_festival_fall_star_candle.name: Festival of Falling Stars Candle
pokemon_festival_fall_star_candle.description: The Festival of Falling Stars Candle is crafted from the sacred wood of a Celebi and infused with the essence of a fallen star. It emits a warm golden glow that fills the air with a sweet, nostalgic scent reminiscent of the Festival. Nearby Pokémon feel an overwhelming surge of affection, their hearts light as they dance under its soft light. However, if held too long, it may invoke a curse, causing the user to lose their next action and potentially triggering a hidden memory.

effectDetails.title: Affection Surge
effectDetails.rules: When activated, nearby Pokémon within 10 feet gain +2 to their affection stat for 1 round. There is a 20% chance that holding the candle too long (more than 5 minutes) will trigger a 'Memory Echo' effect, revealing a hidden ability or evolution.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Memory Reveal
effectDetails.rules: If triggered by the 'Memory Echo' effect, the user must forfeit their next action. The candle has a 10% chance to reveal this effect when held for too long.

pokemon_festival_fall_star_candle.levelRequirementReason: The candle's nostalgic magic is accessible to all adventurers, making it suitable for players of any level.
pokemon_festival_fall_star_candle.vendorReason: The Pokémon League oversees the Festival and ensures that such magical items are distributed responsibly.
pokemon_festival_fall_star_candle.shippingDetail: Shipped via a specialized magic courier service, ensuring safe delivery during the festival event.

usage.activation: As an action to light or relight the candle.
usage.duration: Effect lasts for 1 round per minute held, up to 5 minutes.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user holds it for more than 5 minutes or if a hidden memory is revealed.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be used multiple times during the festival.

pokemon_festival_fall_star_candle.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its unique magical properties and the rarity of materials involved in its crafting.

pokemon_griffonstone_talisman.name: Griffonstone Talisman
pokemon_griffonstone_talisman.description: The Griffonstone Talisman is a heavy amulet of brass and obsidian, carved from the heart of an ancient Griffin. Its surface crackles with stormy energy, a relic of its guardian's power. It grants flight to those who dare attune themselves, but only for one round per use. Those who misuse it risk paralysis or energy drain, binding them to the earth until their next rest. The talisman can be fused with Pokémon Poké Balls to create an evolutions stone that unlocks the 'Skybound' ability, summoning a storm cloud in battle.

effectDetails.title: Flight
effectDetails.rules: The talisman grants temporary flight for one round per use. The user must attune themselves to the talisman and activate it as an action. It ends immediately upon ending its turn or if the user falls prone.

effectDetails.title: Paralysis
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that using the talisman will cause temporary paralysis in the user's target for one round, requiring a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. Failure results in the effect, which ends at the end of the target's next turn.

pokemon_griffonstone_talisman.levelRequirementReason: Requires attunement by a Ranger Union member to harness its stormy power.
pokemon_griffonstone_talisman.vendorReason: The Mages Guild Portal deals exclusively with enchanted items and relics, including this powerful talisman.
pokemon_griffonstone_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships via arcane courier, ensuring safe delivery within a week.

usage.duration: One round per use
usage.endsWhen: Ends immediately on the user's turn or if they fall prone

pokemon_griffonstone_talisman.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this talisman is a rare and powerful tool for those who can wield its stormy might.

pokemon_item_badge_brawler.name: Badge Brawler
pokemon_item_badge_brawler.description: Forgeheart Core, this badge brawler is a shimmering emblem of resilience and prowess. Crafted from the very essence of battlefields, it imbues its bearer with the spirit of champions. With each victory, you gain an extra turn to unleash your full fury, making your foes question if they truly want to continue the fight. Dodge moves like they're mere shadows, and let your critical hits sing with the power of a thousand battles.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Next Move
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when an attack is declared against you, you can attempt to dodge it. You have advantage on this saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Extra Turn After Victory
effectDetails.rules: At the end of your turn after winning a battle, you gain an additional action as if you had used a bonus action. This effect can only occur once per day.

pokemon_item_badge_brawler.levelRequirementReason: This badge is suitable for beginners who are eager to prove their mettle in the arenas.
pokemon_item_badge_brawler.vendorReason: The League Store stocks this item as it's a popular choice among new and aspiring champions.
pokemon_item_badge_brawler.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days, with special courier handling for delicate artifacts like the Badge Brawler.

usage.activation: Reaction (Dodge Next Move), Instantaneous (Extra Turn After Victory)
usage.duration: Until end of next turn (Dodge Next Move), Until end of next battle (Extra Turn After Victory)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the action or battle is resolved.

pokemon_item_badge_brawler.priceReason: This badge strikes a balance between its potent effects and fair value by ensuring it's not overpowered for its level.

pokemon_item_evolution_god_mode.name: Evolution God Mode
pokemon_item_evolution_god_mode.description: The Evolution God Mode is a legendary relic forged in the heart of Wario's twisted lair, granting your Pokémon unparalleled power and invincibility on the battlefield. This artifact transforms any Pokémon into an unstoppable force with access to every possible move, immune to all status effects, and capable of shaking the very ground beneath its feet with a roar that strikes fear into foes. Only the boldest trainers dare wield this forbidden item, knowing full well the risks it brings.

effectDetails.title: Immortal Might
effectDetails.rules: Your Pokémon becomes immune to all status effects and damage. This effect lasts for a short duration as long as you maintain control over the item.

effectDetails.title: Move Mastery
effectDetails.rules: Your Pokémon can instantaneously learn any move it knows, and all moves are cast with advantage on attack rolls until the effect ends.

pokemon_item_evolution_god_mode.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high level to use effectively due to its immense power and risk.
pokemon_item_evolution_god_mode.vendorReason: The Safari Shop, known for its exotic Pokémon, also deals in forbidden items like this one.
pokemon_item_evolution_god_mode.shippingDetail: Special courier service required to ensure the item arrives safely and remains a secret.

usage.activation: Activate as an action or bonus action.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use, but can be ended early if you lose control over the item.
usage.endsWhen: You lose your grip on the item or it is destroyed in battle.

pokemon_item_evolution_god_mode.priceReason: The cost reflects its epic rarity and immense power, balanced to ensure it remains a rare and dangerous tool for trainers.

pokemon_item_name_here.name: Scam of the Stars
pokemon_item_name_here.description: The Scam of the Stars is a shimmering, fake artifact encrusted with star-shaped gemstones forged from polished obsidian and silver. This counterfeit relic promises to awaken a sleeping god, but its true purpose lies in the illusion it creates. When activated, it grants the user temporary invincibility for three turns, allowing them to walk unscathed through any perilous encounter. However, this comes at a steep price; after the turn ends, the user's hit points are instantly reduced to 0, leaving them vulnerable and prone.

effectDetails.title: Invincible for Three Turns
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user is immune to all damage and conditions for three turns, but this effect ends if the user takes any damage or moves out of a hazardous area.

effectDetails.title: Hit Points Reduced to 0
effectDetails.rules: Instantly reduces the user's hit points to zero at the end of their turn. This effect can only be used once per day and is made by the Crimson Fleet, known for their dubious craftsmanship.

pokemon_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 1 to activate this artifact, as it still poses a significant risk even at low levels.
pokemon_item_name_here.vendorReason: The Pokémon Company sells this item due to its lore and potential for theatrical performances or illusions in their exhibitions.
pokemon_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Ships via the Piranha Plant Express, known for its quick delivery within the region.

usage.duration: Three turns
usage.endsWhen: The user takes damage or moves out of a hazardous area

pokemon_item_name_here.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP as it offers powerful but limited utility, ensuring it's not overpowered.

pokemon_item_poke_battle_broccoli.name: Poke Battle Broccoli
pokemon_item_poke_battle_broccoli.description: Poke Battle Broccoli is a vibrant, battle-hardened vegetable that grows wild on the battlefield. Its robust stem and leafy crown are said to have absorbed the essence of countless trainers' battles. When consumed in combat, it boosts your team's stamina by 25% for an entire round, giving you that extra burst of energy when fatigue sets in. The pungent aroma also confuses enemies, causing them to falter and lose focus for one turn.

effectDetails.title: Boosts Stamina
effectDetails.rules: The player gains a +25 bonus to their Constitution saving throws for one round after consuming the Poke Battle Broccoli. This effect ends when the round concludes.

effectDetails.title: Confuses Enemies
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 10 feet of the consumed item's location must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) at the start of their turns. On a failed save, they are stunned for one turn and cannot take actions or reactions until the end of their next turn.

pokemon_item_poke_battle_broccoli.levelRequirementReason: Trainers need to be experienced enough to appreciate the strategic value of this item in critical battle moments.
pokemon_item_poke_battle_broccoli.vendorReason: Pokemarts are familiar with trainers' needs, especially for items that enhance performance during battles.
pokemon_item_poke_battle_broccoli.shippingDetail: Delivered via Safari Express, ensuring the Poke Battle Broccoli arrives fresh from the battlefield.

usage.activation: Eaten as a free action at the start of your turn.
usage.duration: One round and one turn after consumption.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the round concludes or when consumed by another creature.

pokemon_item_poke_battle_broccoli.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity, in-battle utility, and the strategic advantage it provides during critical moments.

pokemon_league_berry_crusher.name: Pokémon League Berry Crusher
pokemon_league_berry_crusher.description: The Pokémon League Berry Crusher is a hand-cranked device crafted by the League Toolmakers, designed to efficiently extract berry juices for salads and beverages. It can assist Pokémon trainers in their quest, doubling the yield of berries used in recipes and reducing prep time by ten minutes. With the help of compatible Pokémon, it also grants +1 to Nature checks, making it indispensable for those seeking a competitive edge.

effectDetails.title: Berries Yield Doubling
effectDetails.rules: When used during the preparation of berry-based dishes, this item doubles the yield of berries available for use. This effect lasts until the dish is completed or the item is no longer in use.

effectDetails.title: Nature Check Boost
effectDetails.rules: +1 to Nature checks when a compatible Pokémon is assisting with the task. The effect ends when the Pokémon leaves the area or if the user stops using the device.

pokemon_league_berry_crusher.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level, as it benefits both beginners and experienced trainers alike.
pokemon_league_berry_crusher.vendorReason: The Pokémon League Camp sells this tool because it is a staple in the daily operations of their training programs and competitions.
pokemon_league_berry_crusher.shippingDetail: Ships via Berry Burst Box, which ensures fresh berries are delivered along with the device for optimal use.

usage.activation: As an action during berry preparation or a bonus action when assisted by a Pokémon.
usage.duration: Until the dish is completed or the user stops using it.
usage.endsWhen: The item ceases to function once its charges are exhausted, which occurs after five uses.

pokemon_league_berry_crusher.priceReason: This price reflects the unique benefits and durability of the device, providing good value for trainers.

pokemon_league_berry_salad_recipe.name: Recipe: Pokémon League Berry Salad
pokemon_league_berry_salad_recipe.description: The Recipe: Pokémon League Berry Salad is a rare treat from the League Caterers, crafted with Oran and Sitrus berries. This revitalizing salad not only heals but also strengthens trainers on their journey. Consuming it grants 1d8 hit points and removes one level of exhaustion, offering both immediate sustenance and long-lasting vigor. The salad's ingredients are chosen for their unique properties, boosting a random type resistance for an hour after consumption.

effectDetails.title: Revitalizing Nourishment
effectDetails.rules: Eating the salad grants you 1d8 hit points and removes one level of exhaustion. It can be consumed as a bonus action, has an instantaneous effect, and is exhausted after use.

effectDetails.title: Type Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the salad, your DM selects one type resistance that lasts for 1 hour. This effect cannot be used more than once per day.

pokemon_league_berry_salad_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The recipe is designed to be accessible early in a trainer's journey.
pokemon_league_berry_salad_recipe.vendorReason: League Caterers are renowned for their expertise in creating nourishing and beneficial recipes for trainers.
pokemon_league_berry_salad_recipe.shippingDetail: Shipped fresh daily by Berry Bowl Delivery, ensuring the salad retains its revitalizing properties.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use

pokemon_league_berry_salad_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's rarity and the unique benefits it provides justify its moderate price.

pokemon_league_healing_berry.name: Pokémon League Healing Berry
pokemon_league_healing_berry.description: The Pokémon League Healing Berry, a vibrant green fruit imbued with the life force of countless Pokémon battles, is a rare and precious resource for any trainer. Its flesh bursts with energy that can restore up to 2d6+2 hit points when consumed, and it's rumored to have stabilized even the gravest wounds on the field. This berry, crafted by the Pokémon League itself, is both a symbol of their expertise in nurturing trainers and a life-saving tool for all who seek it.

effectDetails.title: Restore Vitality
effectDetails.rules: Eating the Pokémon League Healing Berry restores up to 2d6+2 hit points. This effect is instantaneous and requires no action.

effectDetails.title: Stabilize Dying Creatures
effectDetails.rules: When used on a dying creature, this berry stabilizes them for one minute without ending their death saving throws. The creature must be within reach to use it, and the user must expend an action.

pokemon_league_healing_berry.levelRequirementReason: The Pokémon League Healing Berry is accessible to beginning trainers as they might encounter critical situations early in their journey.
pokemon_league_healing_berry.vendorReason: As crafted by the Pokémon League, it makes sense that this berry would be sold directly from their store for trainers to purchase and stockpile.
pokemon_league_healing_berry.shippingDetail: Ships via a reliable Wicker Basket delivery service, ensuring safe arrival within two days of order placement.

usage.activation: Eating or using on a creature within reach as an action
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the user; stabilizes dying creatures for one minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect is no longer needed, and it can only be used once per day

pokemon_league_healing_berry.priceReason: The Pokémon League Healing Berry's fair value is set at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the critical role it plays in a trainer’s journey.

pokemon_league_healing_machine_rental.name: Pokémon Center Healing Machine (Rental)
pokemon_league_healing_machine_rental.description: The Pokémon Center Healing Machine (Rental) is a sleek, portable device that hums to life when activated during a rest period. Upon completion of its cycle, all allies within hearing range are fully restored, regaining hit points, shaking off diseases and poisons, and recovering from level 1 exhaustion. The machine's 'ding!' signal marks the end of its 8-hour rental term, after which it must be returned to the Pokémon League for recharging.

effectDetails.title: Restoration
effectDetails.rules: During a long rest within a 10-foot radius, all allies are fully restored. This includes regaining hit points and recovering from diseases, poisons, and level 1 exhaustion. The effect ends when the rental period of one week expires.

effectDetails.title: Rental Duration
effectDetails.rules: The machine is rented for a full week (8 hours). It must be returned to the Pokémon League at the end of this time or it will cease functioning until recharged.

pokemon_league_healing_machine_rental.levelRequirementReason: This rental service is accessible to trainers who are just beginning their journey, allowing them to ensure their team remains in top condition.
pokemon_league_healing_machine_rental.vendorReason: As a leading authority on Pokémon care and maintenance, the Pokémon League offers this essential rental for trainers of all levels.
pokemon_league_healing_machine_rental.shippingDetail: The healing machine is delivered by trained technicians who ensure it operates correctly before being returned to the league at the end of its rental term.

usage.activation: Activates during a long rest within a 10-foot radius.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting for the duration of one week.
usage.endsWhen: The weekly rental period ends or if not returned to the Pokémon League.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; recharged at end of rental.

pokemon_league_healing_machine_rental.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the cost of maintenance, technician delivery, and the value of a week's full healing service.

pokemon_league_poke_flute_replica.name: Pokémon League Poké Flute Replica
pokemon_league_poke_flute_replica.description: The Pokémon League Poké Flute Replica, a delicate wooden flute crafted from ancient tree branches found within the Enchanted Forest, resonates with melodies that can awaken slumbering creatures and soothe wild beasts alike. Its notes are said to carry the essence of the forest's magic, boosting morale and rallying allies in times of need. When played, it not only dispels sleep but also calms restless animals, making it invaluable for both trainers and their companions.

effectDetails.title: Awakens Sleep
effectDetails.rules: Play as a bonus action. Target one creature within 30 feet that is affected by the sleep condition. The target ends the effect of sleep and regains all spent hit points, but must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Calm Wild Animals
effectDetails.rules: Play as an action within 30 feet of a wild animal. The target creature makes an Animal Handling check with advantage to determine if it calms down and does not attack nearby allies for the next hour.

pokemon_league_poke_flute_replica.levelRequirementReason: Trainers at level 1 are expected to have basic skills in using such items during their journey.
pokemon_league_poke_flute_replica.vendorReason: The Pokémon League is well-known for its support of trainers and provides essential tools like the Poké Flute Replica for effective training and adventures.
pokemon_league_poke_flute_replica.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Swift Courier, arriving within a day if not in an overgrown area.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Awakens Sleep; Calm Wild Animals lasts for one hour.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used up or the target creature is no longer affected by sleep or wild and aggressive, respectively.

pokemon_league_poke_flute_replica.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its utility in both combat and non-combat scenarios.

pokemon_league_pokeball_of_holding.name: Poké Ball of Holding
pokemon_league_pokeball_of_holding.description: The Poké Ball of Holding is a meticulously crafted, metallic sphere adorned with intricate Silph Co. logos that shimmer like starlight. It can hold up to fifty pounds of non-living items in its extradimensional space without a trace of magic. The rarest feature is the 5% chance an item will emerge sticky when retrieved, requiring immediate cleaning by the bearer or it may hinder their movements. Silph Co.'s rejects are known for their quirky inventions that challenge conventional limits.

effectDetails.title: Extradimensional Storage
effectDetails.rules: The Poké Ball of Holding can store non-living items weighing up to fifty pounds. It operates instantaneously when activated, and the retrieval is a bonus action. The storage space is extradimensional, meaning there's no limit on how many items it can hold as long as they don't exceed the weight limit.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Retrieval
effectDetails.rules: There's a 5% chance that an item retrieved from the Poké Ball of Holding will emerge sticky. This effect lasts until cleaned, and any attempt to use the retrieved item during this time is subject to disadvantage on dexterity checks.

pokemon_league_pokeball_of_holding.levelRequirementReason: This item requires only first-level spellcasters as it has no magical properties but relies purely on Silph Co.'s engineering prowess.
pokemon_league_pokeball_of_holding.vendorReason: The Pokémon League Outlet stocks rare and quirky items, making the Poké Ball of Holding a fitting addition to their offerings.
pokemon_league_pokeball_of_holding.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pidgey Post within three days, ensuring your quirky item arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon casting; retrieval is a bonus action each time an item is accessed.
usage.duration: Permanent storage until retrieved or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Exhaustion due to weight limit reached or destruction of the Poké Ball

pokemon_league_pokeball_of_holding.priceReason: The Poké Ball of Holding is crafted by Silph Co. Rejects, known for their quirky and useful inventions that challenge conventional limits.

pokemon_league_recipe_poke_block_candy.name: Recipe: Pokémon League Poké Block Candy
pokemon_league_recipe_poke_block_candy.description: The Recipe: Pokémon League Poké Block Candy is a delicate, colorful confection crafted from rare berries and enchanted by the league's master bakers. This candy not only enhances your animal companion's battle prowess but also temporarily heightens its hyperactive tendencies, making it more prone to playful mischief. Feeding this treat results in an attack boost for 1 hour, but beware—your partner may become overly excitable, requiring extra patience and effort to manage.

effectDetails.title: Attack Boost
effectDetails.rules: When your animal companion consumes a Poké Block Candy, it gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls for 1 hour. This effect ends when the duration expires or if the companion takes any action other than moving.

effectDetails.title: Companion Hyperactivity
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes after eating this candy, your animal companion suffers disadvantage on Animal Handling checks due to its heightened energy levels and playful behavior. This effect ends when the duration expires or if the companion is made to rest for at least 8 hours.

pokemon_league_recipe_poke_block_candy.levelRequirementReason: This recipe requires a basic understanding of animal care and training, which is typically achieved by third-level characters.
pokemon_league_recipe_poke_block_candy.vendorReason: The Pokémon League Treats specialize in creating treats that not only delight but also enhance the bond between trainers and their companions.
pokemon_league_recipe_poke_block_candy.shippingDetail: Shipped via Pidgey Post, these candies arrive fresh from the Pokémon League bakery within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect when consumed by the animal companion.
usage.duration: 1 hour for Attack Boost; 10 minutes for Companion Hyperactivity
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or if the companion takes any action other than moving (for Attack Boost); after 8 hours of rest (for Companion Hyperactivity)
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a recipe that can be prepared multiple times.

pokemon_league_recipe_poke_block_candy.priceReason: The candy's rarity and the unique brewing process by Pokémon League Treats justify its price, making it accessible but not cheap for trainers to enhance their companions' abilities.

pokemon_league_recipe_rare_candy_stew.name: Recipe: Pokémon League Rare Candy Stew
pokemon_league_recipe_rare_candy_stew.description: This parchment-bound recipe, titled 'Recipe: Pokémon League Rare Candy Stew,' contains a hearty stew that levels you up slightly but leaves you tasting like artificial flavoring. Consuming this concoction grants you an experience boost, giving your character 100 XP (once per character, then the recipe becomes useless). While under its influence, you glow with potential, granting advantage on Charisma checks when interacting as a trainer. The stew is the result of extensive research and development by the Pokémon League R&D team.

effectDetails.title: Experience Boost
effectDetails.rules: Eating this stew grants you 100 XP. This effect is usable once per character, after which the recipe becomes unusable.

effectDetails.title: Artificial Flavoring
effectDetails.rules: You suffer a -2 penalty to Charisma checks while consuming the stew. The effect lasts until you finish eating it.

pokemon_league_recipe_rare_candy_stew.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for even beginners, but requires a basic understanding of Pokémon training.
pokemon_league_recipe_rare_candy_stew.vendorReason: The Pokémon League R&D team has been known to distribute experimental items that can aid trainers in their journey.
pokemon_league_recipe_rare_candy_stew.shippingDetail: Ships via Pidgey Post, delivered within two weeks of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until you finish eating it
usage.endsWhen: You finish consuming the stew

pokemon_league_recipe_rare_candy_stew.priceReason: This recipe is priced at 1000 XP, offering a modest experience boost and a unique flavoring effect that can be valuable during early training stages.

pokemon_league_trainer_jacket.name: Pokémon League Trainer Jacket
pokemon_league_trainer_jacket.description: The Pokémon League Trainer Jacket is a stylish, weather-resistant garment with badge pockets designed for aspiring champions. Crafted by League Merch from durable, waterproof fabric, it not only holds up to six small items without adding weight but also grants +1 to Animal Handling checks when dealing with Pokémon-like creatures. In stormy weather, the jacket's zippers freeze shut, causing a minor annoyance that requires a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw to ignore.

effectDetails.title: +1 Animal Handling with Pokémon-like creatures
effectDetails.rules: This benefit lasts for the duration of the encounter or until you spend a minute to focus on refining your handling. You can use this ability once per day.

effectDetails.title: Zippers freeze during rain (minor annoyance)
effectDetails.rules: During periods of heavy rainfall, the jacket's zippers become frozen and require a DC 12 Constitution saving throw each hour to unfreeze them. Failure means you are unable to open or close the jacket until it thaws.

pokemon_league_trainer_jacket.levelRequirementReason: This jacket is designed for those who are still learning the basics of Pokémon training, requiring a player character to be at least third level.
pokemon_league_trainer_jacket.vendorReason: As an official vendor of League Merchandise, it's only fitting that they sell this iconic jacket worn by aspiring champions across the region.
pokemon_league_trainer_jacket.shippingDetail: Ships via Pikachu Post within a week. Delivery may be delayed during rainy season due to zipper freeze issues.

usage.activation: Passive effect until zippers unfreeze in dry weather or after successful saving throw.
usage.duration: Until zippers unfreeze, lasting for one hour per heavy rain event.
usage.endsWhen: Zippers unfreeze during dry weather or after a successful Constitution saving throw.

pokemon_league_trainer_jacket.priceReason: The jacket's waterproofing and utility features, combined with its rarity and the limited availability from official vendors, justify this price in XP.

pokemon_league_type_advantage_coating.name: Pokémon League Type Advantage Coating
pokemon_league_type_advantage_coating.description: The Pokémon League Type Advantage Coating is a specialized weapon finish that enhances your blade's lethality. This coating grants +2 damage against one chosen creature type, such as undead or fiend, for 10 days. However, it also makes the weapon weak to another random type, forcing you to balance precision and versatility in combat. The coating wears off when exposed to water, leaving behind a dull, faded sheen that resembles hastily applied paint.

effectDetails.title: Type Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Activates on application. The weapon deals +2 damage to one chosen creature type for 10 days, after which the coating peels off in water. Requires a bonus action to apply.

effectDetails.title: Type Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: The weapon becomes weak to another random creature type from the same category as the advantage, dealing disadvantage on attack rolls against that type until the coating is removed or replaced.

pokemon_league_type_advantage_coating.levelRequirementReason: This coating is suitable for low-level adventurers who need a tactical edge in their first few combat encounters.
pokemon_league_type_advantage_coating.vendorReason: The Pokémon League specializes in enhancing the capabilities of various weapons, from basic to exotic.
pokemon_league_type_advantage_coating.shippingDetail: Delivered via a trusted Pokeball Parcel within 3 days.

usage.duration: 10 days or until the coating is removed in water
usage.endsWhen: The coating peels off when exposed to water; reapplication required for continued use

pokemon_league_type_advantage_coating.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the specialized crafting and application process, as well as the temporary nature of the effect.

pokemon_league_type_charm.name: Pokémon League Type Charm
pokemon_league_type_charm.description: The Pokémon League Type Charm is a small, intricately crafted talisman that glows faintly when activated. Crafted from polished onyx and imbued with the essence of an elemental type, it whispers stories of legendary trainers who have wielded its power. Choose wisely: each charm aligns with one of four elemental types—Fire, Water, Grass, or Electric—and once chosen, it enhances your attacks by +1d4 damage while granting you resistance to that same element's damage.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Focus
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Your attacks of the chosen type deal an additional +1d4 damage until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Type Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Gain resistance to all damage from spells and abilities of the chosen elemental type for 1 hour or until you take damage from a different element.

pokemon_league_type_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm's elemental essence requires some alignment with the user, making it accessible at level 1.
pokemon_league_type_charm.vendorReason: Only the Pokémon League would offer such a meticulously crafted and elemental-focused charm.
pokemon_league_type_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted trainers who ensure the safe arrival of this enchanted artifact.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, lasts until start of next turn or until the user takes damage from a different elemental type.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or until you take damage from a different elemental type.
usage.endsWhen: The bonus action activation ends when used or until the duration expires.

pokemon_league_type_charm.priceReason: Balanced as it offers both offensive and defensive benefits at a reasonable cost for a rare item.

pokemon_league_type_resist_amulet.name: Pokémon League Type Resist Amulet
pokemon_league_type_resist_amulet.description: The Pokémon League Type Resist Amulet is a sleek and intricate piece of jewelry crafted from polished obsidian. It resonates with the power of the Elite Four Artisans, glowing faintly to signal when its chosen elemental type—fire or water—is nearby. Attuned once per day, this amulet grants you resistance to one selected damage type for 8 hours, and once per day, it can negate a single instance of that damage entirely.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to one elemental type (fire or water) for 8 hours once you attune to the amulet. You must complete a short rest before reattuning.

effectDetails.title: Damage Negation
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, as an action, you can negate one instance of damage from your chosen elemental type. This effect does not stack with other forms of resistance or immunity to the same damage type.

pokemon_league_type_resist_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires a minimum level of 6 due to its complexity and the raw power it channels.
pokemon_league_type_resist_amulet.vendorReason: The Elite Four Artisans at Pokémon League Jewelers are known for their mastery of elemental magic, making this amulet one of their most sought-after creations.
pokemon_league_type_resist_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via Eevee Express with expedited delivery within a week.

usage.activation: Attunement and once per day as an action to negate damage.
usage.duration: 8 hours of elemental resistance, once per day for negating damage.
usage.endsWhen: Reattuning or the end of the duration.
usage.charges: Uses are limited; reattunes after a short rest.

pokemon_league_type_resist_amulet.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rarity and the unique magical properties it provides, making it accessible but not trivial for a mid-level adventurer.

pokemon_magitek_circuit_core.name: Magitek Circuit Core
pokemon_magitek_circuit_core.description: The Magitek Circuit Core is a compacted piece of industrialized arcane energy, crafted from the Iron Legion’s factories. This core boosts attack power by 30% for three turns and enhances evolution success rate by 40%, making it an essential tool for any Pokémon Trainer who seeks to refine their battle prowess. Crafted with precision in the heart of the Iron Legion, each core is a testament to magitek engineering excellence.

effectDetails.title: Boosts Attack
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this core boosts the user's attack power by 30% for three turns. The effect ends if the user is reduced to 0 hit points or if the core is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Evolution
effectDetails.rules: While attuned, this core enhances the success rate of Pokémon evolution by 40%. The enhancement lasts until the end of the session. The effect ends if the user stops being attuned to the core or if it is destroyed.

pokemon_magitek_circuit_core.levelRequirementReason: The core's advanced technology and the attunement required make it suitable for experienced Trainers.
pokemon_magitek_circuit_core.vendorReason: As a part of the Iron Legion, Pokémon is responsible for distributing key tools like this Magitek Circuit Core to its clients.
pokemon_magitek_circuit_core.shippingDetail: Ships via Goomba Ground Delivery, known for its reliable and punctual service.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: User is reduced to 0 hit points or core is destroyed

pokemon_magitek_circuit_core.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the core's advanced technology and the attunement requirement.

pokemon_master_ball_shard.name: Master Ball Shard
pokemon_master_ball_shard.description: The Master Ball Shard is a shimmering fragment of the legendary capture device, forged in the ancient ruins of the Galactic Dome. Crafted by Liberated Toads, this shard glows with an arcane light when a Pokémon’s destiny is sealed. Only spellcasters may attune to its resonant power, as it whispers warnings to those who misuse its magic. It deals 2d6 bonus arcane damage and has a 15% chance to trigger wild magic surge.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Damage
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard deals 2d6 bonus arcane damage. It requires an action to activate and has no set duration; it ends when the user stops attuning or when used in battle.

effectDetails.title: Wild Magic Surge
effectDetails.rules: There is a 15% chance that using this shard triggers a wild magic surge, which can unleash unpredictable effects. This effect occurs once per short rest and requires a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to the wild magic surge.

pokemon_master_ball_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's arcane resonance is accessible to all spellcasters, making it a valuable tool for beginners.
pokemon_master_ball_shard.vendorReason: The Pokémon vendor, familiar with legendary artifacts, sells this shard as it aligns well with their inventory of mystical items.
pokemon_master_ball_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Mages Guild Portal within a week, ensuring safe delivery to spellcasters across the realm.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Stopped attuning or used in battle

pokemon_master_ball_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the magical properties it provides justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

pokemon_minus_world_mirage.name: Minus World Mirage
pokemon_minus_world_mirage.description: The Minus World Mirage is a fractured artifact from a lost dimension, now imbued with unstable energy. Crafted by ancient beings who sought to harness the void's power, it hums with dark, electric pulses that crackle around its core. This relic grants immunity to psychic damage, but each use triggers a 30% chance of causing a dimensional collapse, sending nearby creatures into a realm where reality bends and time distorts.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Psychic Damage
effectDetails.rules: The user gains immunity to all forms of psychic damage. This effect is active until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Collapse
effectDetails.rules: Each activation has a 30% chance to trigger a dimensional collapse, sending creatures within 15 feet into a realm where reality warps and time distorts. The user must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled along with the affected creatures. Creatures who successfully save are teleported safely back.

pokemon_minus_world_mirage.levelRequirementReason: The Minus World Mirage's unstable energy requires a user of at least level 1 to handle its power.
pokemon_minus_world_mirage.vendorReason: Only those who have proven their courage and understanding of the Minus World would be trusted with such an artifact.
pokemon_minus_world_mirage.shippingDetail: The artifact is shipped under strict protocols to prevent dimensional breaches during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The user fails a saving throw or the effect ends when the user enters an area of stable reality.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use requires attunement to the current location.

pokemon_minus_world_mirage.priceReason: This relic's balanced price reflects its powerful immunity and rare risk, suitable for adventurers of all levels.

pokemon_ranger_union_crimson_key.name: Crimson Key of the Iron Legion
pokemon_ranger_union_crimson_key.description: The Crimson Key of the Iron Legion is a relic forged from the blood of fallen industrialists. This key glows with an eerie crimson light, emitting faint mechanical hums when in use. It can only be wielded by members of the Ranger Union and grants a +1 bonus to attack rolls for physical weapons. When used against Pokémon with steel or iron traits, it triggers malfunctions causing their defense to drop by 2 for one turn.

effectDetails.title: Steel Malfunction
effectDetails.rules: When the key is used against a target with steel or iron traits, it causes their defense to drop by 2 for one turn. This effect can only occur once per battle.

effectDetails.title: Precision Strike
effectDetails.rules: Grants a +1 bonus to attack rolls for physical weapons when the key is used. The bonus stacks with other accuracy bonuses but does not exceed +3 in total.

pokemon_ranger_union_crimson_key.levelRequirementReason: The key requires a high level of discipline and understanding of mechanical and industrial lore possessed by experienced Ranger Union agents.
pokemon_ranger_union_crimson_key.vendorReason: As the relic is crafted specifically for the use of Ranger Union members, it makes sense that they would be the ones to sell it within their ranks.
pokemon_ranger_union_crimson_key.shippingDetail: Delivered via spirit courier, ensuring the key arrives intact and ready for use.

usage.duration: One turn per activation
usage.endsWhen: The end of the target's next turn or when a new action is taken

pokemon_ranger_union_crimson_key.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its rarity and the expertise required to wield it effectively.

pokemon_spectral_tether.name: Spectral Tether
pokemon_spectral_tether.description: The Spectral Tether is a delicate chain forged from the essence of captured spirits. It glows faintly with an ethereal light, and when paired with a Pokémon, it draws the creature closer to the physical world, enhancing its abilities while also protecting you from status effects. This tether suffers minor damage in dark terrains but grants you a greater chance of avoiding them yourself. Unleashing hidden routes within the Phantom Zone, it serves as both a tool and a guardian for those brave enough to journey through the spectral realm.

effectDetails.title: Spiritual Bond
effectDetails.rules: Activates on capture, this tether forms an unbreakable bond between you and a Pokémon. The tether grants you advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks to control the creature until it escapes or is dismissed.

effectDetails.title: Status Resilience
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Spectral Tether, you have resistance to all non-magical status effects and a 25% chance to avoid any magical ones. This effect lasts as long as you wear the tether.
