raventree_manor_item_name_4.shippingDetail: The cloak arrives wrapped in a protective layer of shadow, ensuring it remains undisturbed during transit.

usage.duration: Up to 3 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: Destruction or taking damage

raventree_manor_item_name_4.priceReason: The Veil’s rarity and the unique abilities it grants justify its moderate price in experience points.

raventree_manor_planar_stabilizer.name: Planar Stabilizer of the Fractured Manor
raventree_manor_planar_stabilizer.description: The Planar Stabilizer of the Fractured Manor is a brass and obsidian artifact, crafted from the remnants of Raventree Manor’s shattered dimensions. It anchors its wielder to a stable plane while navigating through the unstable multiverse, effectively preventing planar bleed for up to one minute after activation. Its touch radiates with a faint obsidian glow that quells the chaotic energies swirling in the air around you. Those who activate it report feeling a sense of calm even amidst the manor’s most violent tremors.

effectDetails.title: Prevents Planar Bleed
effectDetails.rules: Activating this stabilizer prevents planar bleed for up to one minute. It must be used as a bonus action, and once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Reduces Sanity Loss
effectDetails.rules: This stabilizer reduces the chance of sanity loss by 30% during dimensional shifts. It provides this benefit passively while worn or held in one hand.

raventree_manor_planar_stabilizer.levelRequirementReason: The stabilizer's intricate craftsmanship requires a basic understanding of magic to activate, making it accessible to lower-level characters.
raventree_manor_planar_stabilizer.vendorReason: Raventree Manor is the source and keeper of many such artifacts, as they are needed to navigate the manor’s ever-changing dimensions safely.
raventree_manor_planar_stabilizer.shippingDetail: Ships via the Rakasha Spirit Walk, a reliable though mysterious courier network known for their speed through the multiverse.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and prevent planar bleed. Passively reduces chance of sanity loss while worn or held in one hand.
usage.duration: One minute after activation
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user is no longer in a dimensionally unstable area, or if the stabilizer is removed from their possession.

raventree_manor_planar_stabilizer.priceReason: Crafted by the skilled artisans of Raventree Manor, this stabilizer provides essential protection without being overpowered.

raventree_manor_shadowfell_soul_torch.name: Shadowfell Soul Torch of the Unseen Flame
raventree_manor_shadowfell_soul_torch.description: The Shadowfell Soul Torch of the Unseen Flame flickers ominously, casting a dim glow that reveals hidden passages in the Shadowfell. Its ethereal flame is fueled by the essence of forgotten souls, and when carried, it grants +1 to Stealth checks. However, if brought into the Physical realm, the torch unleashes a wave of minor psychic backlash—those nearby must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for one round.
effects: Reveals hidden paths in Shadowfell zones

effectDetails.title: Hidden Path Revelation
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action within the Shadowfell. Reveals a previously unseen passage or route for one minute, requiring line of sight and no other creatures present.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Backlash in Physical Realm
effectDetails.rules: Triggered when used outside the Shadowfell. Any creature within 10 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw; on failure, they are stunned until the start of their next turn.

raventree_manor_shadowfell_soul_torch.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third-level spellcasting to properly utilize the torch's abilities in combat and exploration.
raventree_manor_shadowfell_soul_torch.vendorReason: Raventree Manor has exclusive access to relics from the Shadowfell, making it a logical vendor for such an artifact.
raventree_manor_shadowfell_soul_torch.shippingDetail: Delivered via shadowy portals that may cause disorientation during transit; charges are reduced by 50% if picked up in person.

usage.activation: Bonus action to reveal hidden paths, or on contact with the Physical realm for backlash.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect
usage.endsWhen: Used outside the Shadowfell (for backlash) or upon successful saving throw.

raventree_manor_shadowfell_soul_torch.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item, offering significant utility without overpowered effects.

rawk_hawk_belt.name: Champ's Belt
rawk_hawk_belt.description: Champ's Belt, a gleaming championship belt forged in the heart of the Glitz Pit, pulses with the raw energy of its victorious wearer. Its buckle glows with an electric blue light that crackles like lightning, and the leather is embossed with the signatures of legendary fighters. This belt bestows the strength to lift mountains and grants the agility to dance through a grapple, compelling you to pose in victory after every kill.

effectDetails.title: Grapple Mastery
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use your Strength score instead of the target's as part of a grapple check. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Pose Compulsion
effectDetails.rules: After every successful kill or victory, you are compelled to perform a dramatic pose. On a failed Wisdom saving throw (DC 15), you remain in the pose for 1 minute.

rawk_hawk_belt.levelRequirementReason: The belt's power requires a seasoned fighter with experience in combat and the ability to channel its raw energy.
rawk_hawk_belt.vendorReason: Rogue Port's Black Market specializes in exotic and legendary items, including the spoils of champions like those who have worn Champ's Belt.
rawk_hawk_belt.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Glitz Pit Express, ensuring your belt arrives in pristine condition with a small ceremony celebrating its new owner.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn after activation or until you fail a grapple check.
usage.endsWhen: On a failed grapple check or when you no longer have an opponent in range.

rawk_hawk_belt.priceReason: The belt's legendary status and its unique effects make it a rare find, justifying the fair price of 1000 XP.

rayman_fist.name: Rayman Detached Fist
rayman_fist.description: The Rayman Detached Fist is a floating, metallic hand crafted from Rayman's own flesh. Its origin lies in the depths of the Glade of Ages, where it was forged by the ancient druids to aid their champion. This fist can deliver powerful ranged punches, striking foes up to 50 feet away with crushing force. After each punch, it returns to you, ready for another strike. It also has a knack for grabbing small objects mid-air, making it a versatile tool in combat and exploration.

effectDetails.title: Ranged Punch
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the Rayman Detached Fist can punch a target within range. The fist deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage and must make a successful hit roll to connect. After striking, the fist returns to its owner instantly.

effectDetails.title: Grabs Small Objects
effectDetails.rules: The Rayman Detached Fist can grab small objects within reach or in mid-air as an action. Once grabbed, the object is held until the fist releases it voluntarily. This ability does not expend a charge.

rayman_fist.levelRequirementReason: This item's power level is balanced for lower levels to aid in early combat scenarios.
rayman_fist.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon has a special relationship with Rayman, allowing them to offer this unique artifact.
rayman_fist.shippingDetail: Delivered within one day by the Swift Wind Courier service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charges are expended or destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short rest

rayman_fist.priceReason: This price reflects the rare and crafted nature of the item, offering a unique advantage without breaking balance.

reality_anchor_hammer.name: Reality Anchor Hammer
reality_anchor_hammer.description: The Reality Anchor Hammer is a massive, anvil-like weapon forged from the very essence of unyielding stasis. Crafted by The Carpenter of Reality to anchor the fabric of reality itself, this hammer can pin down specific rules and prevent them from being altered by magic or divine power. With each strike, it nails down immutable truths, ensuring that once set, they remain unchanged through any narrative or magical force.

effectDetails.title: Nails Down Unchangeable Truths
effectDetails.rules: The hammer allows you to designate a specific rule, such as 'gravity always works this way,' preventing any magic or divine power from altering it. The effect is instantaneous and lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Prevents Rule Alteration
effectDetails.rules: While the hammer's truth remains in place, no magical or divine force can change its stated rule. It has a saving throw DC of 18 against any attempt to alter it. Once used, you must finish a short rest before using it again.

reality_anchor_hammer.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest truths require a solid understanding of reality's fundamentals.
reality_anchor_hammer.vendorReason: The Reality Fixers are known for their expertise in maintaining the integrity of the multiverse, and this hammer is a testament to their craft.
reality_anchor_hammer.shippingDetail: Ships via Fixed Point Express; delivery can take several weeks due to its importance in maintaining reality's balance.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until the end of your next long rest
usage.endsWhen: The designated rule is altered or you finish a short rest after using it

reality_anchor_hammer.priceReason: This hammer's value lies in its utility for maintaining the fabric of reality, making it worth a mere 1000 XP.

reality_revision_consultation.name: Reality Revision Consultation
reality_revision_consultation.description: The Reality Revision Consultation is a cosmic scroll imbued with the essence of a celestial entity. For this exorbitant price, you gain one wish-like option that can reshape reality, but beware: the universe will exact its cost in unforeseen consequences. The entity may also demand future services as payment for your consultation. This item's power comes at great risk, and only the most daring dare to use it.

effectDetails.title: Wish-like Option
effectDetails.rules: The DM provides one wish-like option with a clear cost. The effect is instantaneous, but the DM retains final say on the outcome and any potential consequences.

effectDetails.title: Unforeseen Consequences
effectDetails.rules: Any use of this item may trigger unforeseen consequences that could alter the campaign's course. These effects are determined by the DM, who assesses a save DC of 18 for creatures to avoid their full impact.

reality_revision_consultation.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience and power can afford both the price and the risk associated with reality-altering abilities.
reality_revision_consultation.vendorReason: The celestial entity that oversees this service ensures only the most worthy receive its counsel, thus maintaining the integrity of the cosmic balance.
reality_revision_consultation.shippingDetail: Ships via interdimensional courier with a guaranteed delivery within one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use; recharges in 7 days upon successful payment of the price in full.

reality_revision_consultation.priceReason: The cost reflects not only the cosmic entity's time and expertise but also the potential for catastrophic consequences that could unravel the fabric of reality.

reality_weaver_contract.name: Reality Weaver Contract
reality_weaver_contract.description: The Reality Weaver Contract is a binding agreement with a cosmic entity, allowing you to reshape one square mile of terrain, weather, or environment for eternity. This contract requires immense mana and a significant sacrifice from your soul, making it a godly item that can attract unwanted attention from other beings. Once the reshaping begins, it takes a week to complete, during which time the area becomes unstable and dangerous.

effectDetails.title: Eternal Reshaping
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command by the user. Instantaneous effect reshapes one square mile of terrain, weather, or environment permanently. The area becomes unstable for 1 week after activation and can attract unwanted attention from other beings. This effect cannot be undone by normal means.

effectDetails.title: Soul Sacrifice
effectDetails.rules: Requires a sacrifice from the user's soul, represented by a -2 penalty to all ability checks made by the user for 1 week after activation. The sacrifice is necessary for the reshaping to take place and is permanent until the effect ends.

reality_weaver_contract.levelRequirementReason: Requires a high level of power and control to negotiate such a contract with a cosmic entity.
reality_weaver_contract.vendorReason: The Celestial Exchange deals in powerful, otherworldly items that require significant negotiation and sacrifice.
reality_weaver_contract.shippingDetail: The contract is delivered through a Binding Ritual, which takes place over the course of one week. During this time, the area around the user becomes unstable and dangerous.

usage.activation: Command by the user to activate the reshaping effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the reshaping itself; the area remains unstable for 1 week.
usage.endsWhen: The reshaping is complete or the contract is broken through a Binding Ritual.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a weekly sacrifice.

reality_weaver_contract.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its immense power and the significant sacrifice required for negotiation.

rebel_clans_guerrilla_camo_cloak.name: Rebel Clans Guerrilla Camo Cloak
rebel_clans_guerrilla_camo_cloak.description: The Rebel Clans Guerrilla Camo Cloak is a hand-woven cloak that shifts seamlessly into its surroundings, providing the wearer with an edge in stealth and survival. Crafted by Clan Weavers using ancient techniques, this cloak grants advantage on Stealth checks after an ambush, blending perfectly with any terrain. However, prolonged combat reveals its flaws: the fabric begins to tear, reducing its effectiveness. This relic is a symbol of resilience, passed down through generations of rebels fighting for freedom.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer initiates an ambush or successfully uses Stealth after such a maneuver, they gain advantage on their next Stealth check. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Terrain Camouflage
effectDetails.rules: The cloak allows the wearer to blend seamlessly with their immediate surroundings. The cloak grants a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour, after which it starts showing signs of wear and tear, reducing its effectiveness.

rebel_clans_guerrilla_camo_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's advanced weaving requires at least third-level proficiency in Stealth.
rebel_clans_guerrilla_camo_cloak.vendorReason: Rebel Clans Camp supplies equipment to their own members, ensuring the gear is both functional and reliable for hit-and-run tactics.
rebel_clans_guerrilla_camo_cloak.shippingDetail: Ships with a special delivery service that ensures the cloak arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the cloak, duration until removed or destroyed.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Stealth checks; +1 hour for Terrain Camouflage.
usage.endsWhen: Cloak is removed or destroyed; wearer no longer gains benefits.

rebel_clans_guerrilla_camo_cloak.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, considering the cloak's unique weaving and its utility in stealth situations.

rebel_clans_sabotage_kit.name: Rebel Clan Sabotage Kit
rebel_clans_sabotage_kit.description: The Rebel Clan Sabotage Kit is a compact yet comprehensive field pack, constructed from durable leather and lined with reinforced canvas. Inside are tools for precise sabotage: a set of lockpicks, spring-loaded pins, and a vial of Alchemist's Fire that ignites with a flick. It also contains a Thunderstone capable of disrupting electronic systems. This kit is the go-to tool for Rebel Clans' covert operations, ensuring supply lines are cut and enemy machinery fails.

effectDetails.title: Sabotage Expertise
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence (Engineering) checks made to sabotage or disable mechanical devices. This effect lasts until you rest.

effectDetails.title: Electronic Interference
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the Thunderstone to disrupt electronic systems within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the system malfunctions for one hour or until repaired.

rebel_clans_sabotage_kit.levelRequirementReason: Rebels often begin their training with basic sabotage tools to learn precision and stealth.
rebel_clans_sabotage_kit.vendorReason: The Rebel Clans are known for creating and using the best tools of sabotage, and this kit is a prime example.
rebel_clans_sabotage_kit.shippingDetail: Ships via aerial courier within one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Sabotage Expertise) / One Hour (Electronic Interference)
usage.endsWhen: Rest or until the effect is used up
usage.charges: Unlimited, but you can only use the Electronic Interference feature once per day.

rebel_clans_sabotage_kit.priceReason: The kit includes rare components and specialized tools that are costly to produce and source.

rebel_clans_smoke_signal_upgrade_service.name: Rebel Clans Smoke Signal Upgrade Service
rebel_clans_smoke_signal_upgrade_service.description: Crafted by Clan Signalers during skirmishes, this service allows you to send a coded message using smoke signals. Allies who see the signal can immediately decipher it and understand its meaning, while foes are left confused as the wind disperses the code into an unreadable pattern. The signal can be seen for miles around, but only those who have trained in Clan Signaler traditions can make sense of the message.
effects: Send coded message: Allies understand, foes confused

effectDetails.title: Message Deciphering
effectDetails.rules: Allies within sight who know Clan Signaler traditions can read the smoke signal as a bonus action. Foes see an ambiguous pattern that provides no useful information without a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

effectDetails.title: Signal Range
effectDetails.rules: The smoke signal can be seen up to 5 miles, but visibility is reduced by heavy winds or dense fog. The signal lasts for 1 minute per level of the user, and it requires a successful DC 10 Constitution saving throw each day to maintain.

rebel_clans_smoke_signal_upgrade_service.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic knowledge in Clan Signaler traditions.
rebel_clans_smoke_signal_upgrade_service.vendorReason: The Rebel Clans Hideout specializes in gear and services for those who fight alongside them, including this unique communication tool.
rebel_clans_smoke_signal_upgrade_service.shippingDetail: Delivered by trained Clan Signalers via a series of relay points, ensuring the message is received promptly.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and maintain the signal for one minute per level.
usage.duration: 1 minute per user level.
usage.endsWhen: The user's Constitution saving throw fails or they lose concentration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a successful daily save.

rebel_clans_smoke_signal_upgrade_service.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its tactical utility and limited daily use.

rebel_clans_smokehouse_dryer.name: Rebel Clans Smokehouse Dryer
rebel_clans_smokehouse_dryer.description: The Rebel Clans Smokehouse Dryer is a forge-made core crafted by Clan Dryers to quickly dry jerky in hidden camps. Its sturdy frame and sleek design make it both functional and durable, capable of drying food twice as long due to its efficient heat management. The dryer's smoke is nearly invisible, ensuring stealthy operations even when the winds are light. It attracts wild animals, providing a steady supply of fresh meat for campers.

effectDetails.title: Dries Twice as Long
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the dryer increases the preservation time of dried food by double. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a save or action.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Smoke
effectDetails.rules: The smoker emits nearly invisible smoke, granting advantage on Stealth checks within 10 feet for 1 minute per activation. The effect ends if the user moves more than 30 feet away from the dryer's position.

rebel_clans_smokehouse_dryer.levelRequirementReason: This is a basic tool that can be used by any adventuring party member.
rebel_clans_smokehouse_dryer.vendorReason: The Rebel Clans are known for their expertise in survival gear and this dryer is a staple of their supply list.
rebel_clans_smokehouse_dryer.shippingDetail: Ships via Smoke Dry Dispatch, ensuring delivery within one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user moves more than 30 feet from the dryer's position.

rebel_clans_smokehouse_dryer.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its efficiency and utility without being overpowered.

rebel_clans_smokehouse_jerky_recipe.name: Recipe: Rebel Clans Smokehouse Jerky
rebel_clans_smokehouse_jerky_recipe.description: The Rebel Clans Smokehouse Jerky Recipe, a relic of guerrilla tactics, is a parchment scroll imbued with the essence of Clan Smokers' craftsmanship. This recipe teaches you how to smoke meat over smoldering wood for two hours, yielding jerky that can be eaten to sustain you without food for 12 hours and grant +1 to Stealth checks for as long as you consume it. The jerky's smoky flavor is a testament to the harsh conditions under which Clan Smokers perfected their craft.

effectDetails.title: Smoked Meat
effectDetails.rules: Activates when you prepare meat and smoke it for two hours. Consuming the jerky provides sustenance without food for 12 hours, granting +1 to Stealth checks while active.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Sustenance
effectDetails.rules: Passively grants +1 to Stealth checks as long as you consume the jerky. Ends when you finish the jerky or take damage in combat.

rebel_clans_smokehouse_jerky_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to beginners, making it a valuable tool for any adventurer starting their journey.
rebel_clans_smokehouse_jerky_recipe.vendorReason: The Rebel Clans Hideout sells this recipe as part of its provisions for those who wish to join the fight against tyranny.
rebel_clans_smokehouse_jerky_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered via an enchanted scroll that ensures safe and swift delivery, even in hostile territories.

usage.activation: Active when you prepare meat and smoke it for two hours; passively active while consuming the jerky.
usage.duration: Passive effect lasts as long as you consume the jerky; ends if you take damage in combat or finish the jerky.
usage.endsWhen: Consumption ends the passive Stealth boost, and taking damage interrupts it.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one serving at a time.

rebel_clans_smokehouse_jerky_recipe.priceReason: The recipe is priced moderately to reflect its utility in survival and combat situations without overvaluing it.

red_dead_revolver.name: Dead Eye Revolver
red_dead_revolver.description: The Dead Eye Revolver is a sleek, antique revolver with an intricate mechanism that allows for precise aiming. Crafted from weathered steel and engraved with arcane symbols, it whispers of a bygone era when marksmanship was a revered art. This weapon grants its wielder the advantage on attack rolls against targets they have marked, and fires six shots in rapid succession, each dealing 2d6 piercing damage. A true testament to the revolver's craftsmanship is its ability to reload as an action, ensuring it remains ready for battle.

effectDetails.title: Dead Eye
effectDetails.rules: When you use this weapon, you gain advantage on attack rolls against a target you have marked until the end of your next turn. Marking a target is a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Rapid Fire
effectDetails.rules: You can fire up to six shots from this revolver as an action. Each shot deals 2d6 piercing damage. The revolver recharges after a long rest.

red_dead_revolver.levelRequirementReason: This weapon is designed for beginners and those seeking to hone their skills in marksmanship.
red_dead_revolver.vendorReason: The Valley Trading Post caters to adventurers of all levels, offering a wide array of tools and weapons suitable for various skill sets.
red_dead_revolver.shippingDetail: Delivered by Swift Messenger within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a duration of one turn per target marked
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target is no longer marked or you make an attack roll against it without succeeding in marking them.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges; recharges after a long rest

red_dead_revolver.priceReason: This weapon offers a balanced price point for its rapid-fire capabilities and unique marksmanship advantage.

red_paint.name: Bucket of Red Paint
red_paint.description: A sturdy wooden bucket painted with a deep crimson hue, its contents spill over in a cascade of rich red paint. This artisanal creation from Toad Town Market is favored by Huey and other whimsical artisans for its vibrant color and unpredictable splashes. Use it to transform canvases or walls into works of vivid artistry, but be warned: the paint is notoriously difficult to clean off hands, clothes, and surfaces.

effectDetails.title: Vivid Red Transform
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can pour the paint on a surface within reach. The paint dries in 1 minute and transforms any unoccupied space it covers into a vivid red hue. This effect has no save DC but is instantaneous. You may use this bucket only once per day.

effectDetails.title: Hard to Clean
effectDetails.rules: The paint adheres stubbornly to organic materials such as skin, fabric, and wood. Any creature or object that comes into contact with the paint must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be permanently stained red until cleaned off.

red_paint.levelRequirementReason: This bucket is simple to use but requires basic coordination.
red_paint.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in unique and whimsical supplies favored by artists and pranksters alike.
red_paint.shippingDetail: Delivered via Can's reliable service, ensuring the paint remains fresh upon arrival.

usage.duration: instantaneous (dries in 1 minute)
usage.endsWhen: when used up or cleaned off

red_paint.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the artisanal quality and limited daily use of the bucket.

red_winter_blizzard_call.name: Red Winter Blizzard Call
red_winter_blizzard_call.description: The Red Winter Blizzard Call is a fearsome brass horn shaped like an icy spear, its surface covered in etchings of howling winds and snowflakes. Crafted by the enigmatic Red Winter, this ancient artifact summons a blizzard that engulfs all within a 100-foot radius, creating a whiteout condition that lasts for one hour. All creatures and ranged attacks within the storm zone suffer disadvantage on their rolls due to the extreme cold and swirling snow. The vendor ensures only those of sufficient prowess can wield such power, safeguarding the region from its misuse.

effectDetails.title: Whiteout Blizzard
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Affects all creatures within a 100-foot radius, creating an extreme cold and blinding whiteout condition that lasts for one hour. Saves against this effect have a DC of 15. The storm ends if the user is incapacitated or dies.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Attacks
effectDetails.rules: All ranged attacks made within the affected area suffer disadvantage until the blizzard ends or the attacker moves out of the storm zone. This effect does not stack with other sources of disadvantage.

red_winter_blizzard_call.levelRequirementReason: Only those of sufficient experience can control such a volatile and powerful artifact.
red_winter_blizzard_call.vendorReason: The Red Winter Outpost ensures only capable adventurers can acquire this dangerous item to prevent its misuse.
red_winter_blizzard_call.shippingDetail: Ships via the fastest Hollowed Horn express, ensuring safe delivery within a day.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: User is incapacitated or dies; ends if user moves out of the storm zone

red_winter_blizzard_call.priceReason: The item's rarity, power level, and vendor ensure a fair price that reflects its value.

red_winter_cold_resistance_tanning.name: Red Winter Cold Resistance Tanning
red_winter_cold_resistance_tanning.description: The Red Winter Cold Resistance Tanning is a specialized service that not only protects against frostbite but also leaves you with an unmistakably orange hue that hints at time spent in sun-soaked climes. Your skin acquires a coconutty aroma that lingers for days, making it hard to pass unnoticed among the pale. This tanning session also grants you resistance to cold damage for 7 days, ensuring you can brave the harshest winter's chill without fear of frostbite.

effectDetails.title: Cold Damage Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Gain resistance to cold damage for a duration of 7 days. This effect is applied as soon as the tanning service is completed and lasts until the expiration date, which can be prematurely ended by taking cold damage or entering an environment with extreme heat.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Persuasion Checks
effectDetails.rules: When interacting in social situations involving pale individuals, you must roll disadvantage on Persuasion checks. This effect persists until the tanning service's duration ends and is not mitigated by any other means.

red_winter_cold_resistance_tanning.levelRequirementReason: This basic tanning service is suitable for adventurers of all levels who seek to toughen up against cold climates.
red_winter_cold_resistance_tanning.vendorReason: Red Winter Tanning Salon specializes in services that prepare travelers and adventurers for the rigors of winter, ensuring they are equipped for any frosty encounter.
red_winter_cold_resistance_tanning.shippingDetail: The UV Ray ensures swift delivery, often arriving within a week, depending on weather conditions and postal delays common during cold months.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon completion of the tanning service.
usage.duration: 7 days from the time of completion.
usage.endsWhen: Taking cold damage or entering an environment with extreme heat.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be repeated as often as needed.

red_winter_cold_resistance_tanning.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the service's ability to provide a temporary resistance to cold, while also offering social benefits that enhance player interaction and survival in cold environments.

red_winter_deep_freeze_bomb.name: Red Winter Deep Freeze Bomb
red_winter_deep_freeze_bomb.description: The Red Winter Deep Freeze Bomb, crafted by the enigmatic Red Winter, is a fearsome artifact that can be activated to plunge an area into a frigid abyss. When triggered, it instantly lowers temperatures to near absolute zero, causing all creatures within its 100-foot radius to attempt a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or perish from flash freezing. Structures in the blast zone become brittle and collapse under their own weight, turning once-sturdy fortifications into fragile ice sculptures.

effectDetails.title: Instant Freeze
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the bomb creates an area of frigid air within a 100-foot radius. All creatures in this zone must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or instantly perish due to flash freezing.

effectDetails.title: Structural Collapse
effectDetails.rules: All structures and fortifications within the blast zone become brittle and are prone to collapse, causing additional environmental hazards for those who survive the initial freeze.

red_winter_deep_freeze_bomb.levelRequirementReason: Only a seasoned veteran or high-level party can hope to safely handle such a volatile artifact.
red_winter_deep_freeze_bomb.vendorReason: The outpost is well-equipped to handle and sell the most dangerous and powerful items, including the Red Winter Deep Freeze Bomb.
red_winter_deep_freeze_bomb.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the bomb must be shipped frozen solid in a specially insulated container. This adds an extra day to delivery time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until spent
usage.endsWhen: The bomb's effects end when it is used or destroyed

red_winter_deep_freeze_bomb.priceReason: Crafted by Red Winter and requiring careful handling, the Red Winter Deep Freeze Bomb is priced accordingly.

red_winter_elemental_binding.name: Red Winter Elemental Binding (Ice Lord)
red_winter_elemental_binding.description: The Red Winter Elemental Binding (Ice Lord) is a relic forged from the heart of an ancient ice cavern. This enchanted cordial, when consumed, bonds a powerful Ice Elemental Lord to your service, ensuring its loyalty and prowess in guarding a fixed location indefinitely. The elemental requires perpetual sub-zero temperatures to remain bound; if warmth exceeds freezing, it dissipates into ethereal mist. Crafted by the Red Winter Outpost, this artifact is a symbol of their mastery over the frozen realms.
effects: Permanently summons an Ice Elemental Lord

effectDetails.title: Elemental Bonding
effectDetails.rules: Consume this cordial to summon a loyal Ice Elemental Lord. The elemental remains bound at the location specified, acting as a fortress guardian indefinitely until environmental temperatures exceed freezing or it is dispelled by a successful DC 25 Con saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Dependency
effectDetails.rules: The summoned Ice Elemental Lord requires perpetual sub-zero temperatures to maintain its form. If exposed to warmth above freezing for more than one hour, the elemental dissipates into mist and must be re-summoned using this cordial under appropriate conditions.

red_winter_elemental_binding.levelRequirementReason: Summons a powerful CR 14 creature as a guardian; only a high-level character can manage such a task.
red_winter_elemental_binding.vendorReason: The Red Winter Outpost specializes in summoning and binding elemental creatures, making them the authoritative source for this item.
red_winter_elemental_binding.shippingDetail: Ships via arcane ritual directly to your location; requires a consecrated site within 2 miles of the recipient.

usage.activation: Consumed as an action at a consecrated site
usage.duration: Permanent until dispelled or temperatures exceed freezing for more than one hour
usage.endsWhen: Exceeds freezing temperatures, successful DC 25 Con saving throw, or dispelled by a spell of 4th level or higher
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be re-summoned with this cordial under appropriate conditions

red_winter_elemental_binding.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it requires high-level crafting and a rare arcane ritual for its creation.

red_winter_eternal_ice_mine.name: Red Winter Eternal Ice Mine
red_winter_eternal_ice_mine.description: The Red Winter Eternal Ice Mine is a compact device that drills into bedrock, instantly converting stone to pure magical ice. Crafted by Red Winter in their frigid forges, this machine hums with arcane energy and can mine up to ten tons of magical ice per hour. The resulting ice retains the essence of its natural origin, making it perfect for powerful cold magic or constructing frosty fortresses that withstand even the harshest winters.

effectDetails.title: Portable Ice Mining
effectDetails.rules: The user can activate this device as an action to mine ten tons of magical ice from bedrock. The mining process is instantaneous, and the ice retains its magical properties for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Essence-Preserved Ice
effectDetails.rules: Ice produced by the Red Winter Eternal Ice Mine has a save DC of 18 against cold-based effects. It can be used in conjunction with spells like Frost Nova or Cold Breath, enhancing their potency by 25%. After one hour, the ice loses its magical properties.

red_winter_eternal_ice_mine.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to handle and activate such an advanced mining tool safely.
red_winter_eternal_ice_mine.vendorReason: Red Winter's outpost is renowned for their expertise in ice magic and technology, making them the ideal vendor for this item.
red_winter_eternal_ice_mine.shippingDetail: Ships within one week of purchase with Red Winter Express; delivery includes a courier who can assist with installation.

usage.duration: Instantaneous mining, lasting for one hour
usage.endsWhen: After one hour or when the device is destroyed

red_winter_eternal_ice_mine.priceReason: Balanced price considering the item's rarity and utility in a high-level campaign.

red_winter_frozen_army_supply.name: Red Winter Frozen Army Supply Cache
red_winter_frozen_army_supply.description: The Red Winter Frozen Army Supply Cache is a meticulously preserved trove of gear and provisions from an ancient army lost to time. Inside, you'll find weapons that still carry the chill of the frozen battlefield and armor that retains its original form despite centuries of ice. Each item bears the Red Winter insignia, a testament to their origin. This cache can outfit and provision 100 soldiers for an entire year, ensuring they are ready for any cold-weather campaign.

effectDetails.title: Weapons' Cold Damage
effectDetails.rules: Any weapon drawn from the cache deals an additional 1d6 cold damage. The effect persists until the weapon is sheathed or discarded.

effectDetails.title: Year-Long Provisions
effectDetails.rules: The cache provides sufficient food and supplies for 100 soldiers for one year, sustaining them in any environment. This effect lasts as long as the provisions are used.

red_winter_frozen_army_supply.levelRequirementReason: Only seasoned veterans who have faced the harsh winters of Red Winter can properly utilize this cache.
red_winter_frozen_army_supply.vendorReason: The outpost's traders have access to rare and ancient artifacts from their region's history.
red_winter_frozen_army_supply.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of the items, they are shipped with extra care using Massive Haul's enchanted frost-resistant containers.

usage.activation: Activates upon opening and accessing the cache. The effects last until the provisions are used or weapons sheathed.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: When the provisions are depleted or weapons are sheathed.
usage.charges: Unlimited; once opened, it is always active.

red_winter_frozen_army_supply.priceReason: The cache's rarity and utility justify its moderate price point, ensuring it remains a valuable but not overpowered item.

red_winter_fur-lined_boots.name: Red Winter Fur-Lined Boots
red_winter_fur-lined_boots.description: These Red Winter Fur-Lined Boots are crafted by the Winter Cobblers of Red Winter Village, their secret recipe combining magical fur from ancient frostbloom wolves and enchanted thread spun in the village's snow-covered forge. The boots not only provide warmth (+1 CON vs cold) but also leave crisp snow prints that can be used to track your path through icy terrain. A mere touch of these boots grants you advantage on Dexterity saving throws made when navigating treacherous ice, ensuring safer winter travels.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Ice Dexterity Saves
effectDetails.rules: When making a Dexterity saving throw due to icy conditions, you gain advantage. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Snow Tracking
effectDetails.rules: The boots leave distinct snow prints that can be used for tracking. You can use this ability once per day to identify a path or trail left by creatures moving through snow, without needing any special knowledge or tools.

red_winter_fur-lined_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are suitable for adventurers of all levels, providing essential warmth and safety in cold climates.
red_winter_fur-lined_boots.vendorReason: The Winter Cobblers are renowned for their expertise in crafting gear that withstands the harshest winter conditions.
red_winter_fur-lined_boots.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted Snowshoe Strap, known for its swift and reliable service through icy terrains.

usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next long rest or until destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed upon losing all charges or after a long rest.

red_winter_fur-lined_boots.priceReason: The boots are priced at 1000 XP, reflecting their craftsmanship and the magical fur used in their creation.

red_winter_glacier_creation.name: Red Winter Glacier Creation
red_winter_glacier_creation.description: Forge a frozen monument to the Red Winter's reign, summoning a permanent glacier that rises from the earth at your chosen location. This icy behemoth spans one square mile and stands as an unyielding barrier against all external temperatures, remaining eternally frigid in its eternal slumber. The glacier is crafted by the ancient hands of Red Winter, a deity revered by those who seek to harness its untamed power.

effectDetails.title: Eternal Frost
effectDetails.rules: The glacier creates an unyielding frost that covers one square mile. It remains perpetually cold, regardless of the surrounding environment. The area is considered difficult terrain and imposes a -2 penalty to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made in it.

effectDetails.title: Immune to Temperature
effectDetails.rules: The glacier is immune to all temperature-related effects, including heat, cold, and weather conditions that would normally alter its form or stability. No natural phenomenon can change the glacier's state once created.

red_winter_glacier_creation.levelRequirementReason: Summoning a permanent, magically stable glacier requires deep arcane knowledge and considerable power.
red_winter_glacier_creation.vendorReason: The red Winter outpost is the only place that can facilitate such a monumental summoning spell.
red_winter_glacier_creation.shippingDetail: Delivered by an ancient, frozen block of ice that glides through the air with supernatural speed and precision.

usage.activation: A ritual performed over one hour requires a successful DC 25 Arcana check.
usage.duration: Permanent once created
usage.endsWhen: The glacier is destroyed by a sufficiently powerful magical effect or natural disaster capable of altering the landscape.

red_winter_glacier_creation.priceReason: This item requires immense arcane power and rare materials, making it prohibitively expensive.

red_winter_glacier_transport.name: Red Winter Glacier Transport (Mobile)
red_winter_glacier_transport.description: The Red Winter Glacier Transport stands as a fortress of living ice, forged in the heart of the coldest winters by the ancient artisans of Red Winter. Its walls shimmer with an ethereal glow, and its structure is both resilient and mobile. This icy behemoth can traverse harsh terrains at a glacial pace, covering 10 feet per hour, yet it remains impervious to cold damage, making it a formidable defense against even the most unforgiving climates.

effectDetails.title: Mobile Fortress
effectDetails.rules: The Red Winter Glacier Transport functions as a mobile fortress with an AC of 24 and hit points equal to 1000. It is immune to cold damage, making it a formidable defense against frost spells and other icy effects.

effectDetails.title: Ice Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The transport is completely immune to cold-based attacks and environmental hazards, including freezing temperatures and ice-based spell effects. This immunity extends to all forms of cold damage and does not require a saving throw.

red_winter_glacier_transport.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant magical power to sustain its icy form and movement capabilities.
red_winter_glacier_transport.vendorReason: The Red Winter Outpost, having direct ties with the ice artisans of Red Winter, is the sole vendor for this rare artifact.
red_winter_glacier_transport.shippingDetail: Shipped via specialized frost-tolerant transport that ensures the integrity of the living ice during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon arrival; requires no further actions to maintain its properties.
usage.duration: Permanent, until destroyed or disintegrated by a powerful force
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or disintegrated by a force capable of melting the ice

red_winter_glacier_transport.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and utility without overshadowing other items.

red_winter_heart_of_ice.name: Red Winter Heart of Ice
red_winter_heart_of_ice.description: The Red Winter Heart of Ice is a crystalline organ that, when held, grants its bearer immunity to emotional manipulation by others but at the cost of their own social interactions. Its icy core seems to pulse with an ancient, frozen will, and it exudes a chilling aura that makes all who interact with its owner feel distant and cold. Crafted in the frigid heart of Red Winter, this artifact is said to have been forged from the very essence of winter's wrath.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Charm
effectDetails.rules: The bearer gains immunity to all charmed and frightened conditions. This effect is active as long as the item is held.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on WIS-based social interactions
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with others, the owner must make all Wisdom (Insight) checks at disadvantage due to their cold demeanor and emotional detachment. The disadvantage persists until the end of each long rest.

red_winter_heart_of_ice.levelRequirementReason: Only those capable of handling such a powerful and potentially isolating artifact should be able to wield it.
red_winter_heart_of_ice.vendorReason: The outpost, established in the heart of Red Winter, is familiar with the artifact's origins and has been entrusted by its creators to sell it.
red_winter_heart_of_ice.shippingDetail: Carefully packaged within a climate-controlled coffin to ensure safe delivery through the coldest regions.

usage.duration: While held by the owner
usage.endsWhen: The item is no longer held or destroyed

red_winter_heart_of_ice.priceReason: Balanced as a rare, godly artifact that provides significant but not game-breaking benefits.

red_winter_ice_box.name: Red Winter Ice Box
red_winter_ice_box.description: The Red Winter Ice Box is a sturdy wooden chest adorned with frostwork and imbued with the magic of the Northern Frost. It keeps its contents perpetually frozen, ensuring ingredients remain fresh and prime for culinary or magical use. However, the box's icy grip can be slippery; opening it causes a 5-foot radius of slick ice that anyone not holding onto something solid must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 10) to avoid slipping and falling.

effectDetails.title: Perpetual Cryogenic Storage
effectDetails.rules: The Red Winter Ice Box maintains a temperature of -20 degrees Celsius, indefinitely preserving the freshness and quality of its contents. This effect has no save or duration; it is always active as long as the box remains sealed.

effectDetails.title: Slippery Opening
effectDetails.rules: Opening the Red Winter Ice Box causes a 5-foot radius of slippery ice within reach. Any creature not holding onto something solid must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 10) or fall prone and take 2d6 force damage.

red_winter_ice_box.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginning adventurers who might need to preserve rare ingredients or delicate magical components.
red_winter_ice_box.vendorReason: Red Winter Ice Crafters are known for their expertise in preserving and transporting cold-sensitive goods, making this box a staple in their inventory.
red_winter_ice_box.shippingDetail: The Ice Road Truckers deliver the Red Winter Ice Box with special care, ensuring it arrives frozen solid in temperatures above -10 degrees Celsius.

usage.duration: Always active while sealed; ends when opened or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Opening the box or destruction

red_winter_ice_box.priceReason: This item is priced lower as it does not consume charges and provides a crucial utility for adventurers.

red_winter_ice_cream_snow_cones_recipe.name: Recipe: Red Winter Ice Cream Snow Cones
red_winter_ice_cream_snow_cones_recipe.description: The Recipe: Red Winter Ice Cream Snow Cones is a precious artifact from the frigid heart of Red Winter Village, where eternal snow meets sugary syrup to quell heat and thirst. This treat recipe allows you to shave ice into cones and infuse them with winter's essence, granting you cold resistance that can save you from scorching days. The flavor is as much a part of this item as its icy core; it requires just the right snow and a dash of syrup to bring the magic to life.

effectDetails.title: Eternal Snow Cones
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. Use snow and syrup to create a cone of shaved ice, providing cold resistance equal to your proficiency bonus against heat-related effects for 3 hours.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on saving throws against heat-related effects until the end of your next long rest. This effect does not stack with other sources of cold resistance, and you must have consumed an Eternal Snow Cone within the last hour to benefit from it.

red_winter_ice_cream_snow_cones_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to beginners who can appreciate its simplicity yet powerful effects.
red_winter_ice_cream_snow_cones_recipe.vendorReason: Red Winter Village is renowned for its mastery of cold weather and unique winter treats, making it the perfect vendor for this recipe.
red_winter_ice_cream_snow_cones_recipe.shippingDetail: The Frosty Flavor File ensures swift delivery through a network of magical ice paths that traverse Red Winter's frozen landscapes.

usage.activation: Action to create and consume an Eternal Snow Cone.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: You do not consume an Eternal Snow Cone within the last hour or you gain cold resistance from another source.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the recipe can be used as many times as needed.

red_winter_ice_cream_snow_cones_recipe.priceReason: The rarity and utility of this recipe justify its price, offering a significant advantage in hot climates.

red_winter_ice_sculpture_armor.name: Red Winter Ice Sculpture Armor
red_winter_ice_sculpture_armor.description: The Red Winter Ice Sculpture Armor is a marvel of frozen craftsmanship, forged from the eternal ice that encases the northernmost realms. Its crystalline surface gleams like polished obsidian under moonlight, yet it shatters with the slightest touch of fire, leaving only mist in its wake. Crafted by the enigmatic artisans of Red Winter, this armor is both a symbol and a tool for those who dare to walk the path of the frost.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Cold Damage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to cold damage. This effect persists until the armor is destroyed or melted by fire.

effectDetails.title: Vulnerability to Fire
effectDetails.rules: If the wearer takes 20 or more fire damage, they immediately lose all their hit points and are reduced to zero HP.

red_winter_ice_sculpture_armor.levelRequirementReason: Crafted for those who face the bitter cold of Red Winter's icy wastes, this armor requires a minimum level of 13.
red_winter_ice_sculpture_armor.vendorReason: The Red Winter Outpost specializes in gear and wares crafted by the region’s artisans, including this legendary ice sculpture armor.
red_winter_ice_sculpture_armor.shippingDetail: Ships via the Frigid Frost Couriers, delivered within a week of purchase. Armor must be kept frozen during transit to maintain its integrity.

usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or melted by fire
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or melted by at least 20 fire damage

red_winter_ice_sculpture_armor.priceReason: Crafted from the rarest ice and imbued with arcane power, this armor is priced to reflect its unique properties and rarity.

red_winter_ice_skate_enchant_premium.name: Red Winter Ice Skate Enchant (Premium)
red_winter_ice_skate_enchant_premium.description: These Red Winter Ice Skates are crafted from reinforced steel and leather, their gleaming red finish a testament to the Winter Craftsmen’s expertise. They allow you to glide effortlessly across ice and snow with unmatched speed, but beware—the clacking sound will give away your position on slippery surfaces. Made by artisans who have mastered the art of cold-weather gear, these skates are not just for mobility; they are a statement of style.

effectDetails.title: Ice Glide
effectDetails.rules: Increase your speed by 10 feet while on ice or snow. This effect lasts for 1 hour, and it can be activated as a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Acrobatics Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Acrobatics checks made to perform stunts or movements on slippery surfaces. This effect is passive while wearing the skates.

red_winter_ice_skate_enchant_premium.levelRequirementReason: The basic skills required for these skates are within reach of any beginner.
red_winter_ice_skate_enchant_premium.vendorReason: Red Winter Village is renowned for its artisans who craft the finest cold-weather gear in the land.
red_winter_ice_skate_enchant_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted Frozen Blades Couriers, ensuring your skates arrive at their peak condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; passive effect while wearing the skates
usage.duration: 1 hour or until removed
usage.endsWhen: Skates are taken off or 1 hour expires
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one instance of each effect can be active at a time

red_winter_ice_skate_enchant_premium.priceReason: Balanced to offer value for the player's investment in mobility and style.

red_winter_permafrost_crystal.name: Red Winter Permafrost Crystal
red_winter_permafrost_crystal.description: The Red Winter Permafrost Crystal is a crystalline fragment harvested from an ancient ice cave, its surface etched with patterns that shimmer in hues of deep crimson and icy blue. This relic radiates a frigid aura that can freeze the air around it, making the surroundings unnaturally cold to all who dare approach too closely. When activated, it unleashes a torrential wave of frost, capable of shattering stone and ice alike with its unyielding power.

effectDetails.title: Weapon-infused Cold Damage
effectDetails.rules: This crystal can be wielded as a weapon, dealing an additional 3d8 cold damage on hit. When the user strikes living creatures within its range, they must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 5d10 cold damage and become frozen for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Area of Frost
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this crystal releases an area of frost that extends to a 20-foot radius. All creatures in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by ice until the end of their next turn. The duration lasts for up to one minute.

red_winter_permafrost_crystal.levelRequirementReason: This crystal requires a high level to wield due to its immense power and the danger it poses.
red_winter_permafrost_crystal.vendorReason: The outpost's specialized knowledge of cold and ice makes them the ideal vendor for such a relic.
red_winter_permafrost_crystal.shippingDetail: Ships via Cryogenic Transporter, which ensures safe delivery even in the harshest conditions.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and unleash an area of frost; instant effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, but can be used again after a short rest.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts its uses for the day or destroyed upon reaching zero charges.

red_winter_permafrost_crystal.priceReason: The crystal is priced at 1,000 XP due to its rarity and the raw materials required for its creation.

red_winter_permanent_frost_aura.name: Red Winter Permanent Frost Aura (Personal)
red_winter_permanent_frost_aura.description: Red Winter's Permanent Frost Aura is a cold-hearted charm that eternally shrouds its bearer in an unyielding chill. The air around them crackles with frost, causing nearby metal to weaken and flake under the constant pressure of the cold. Those wielding fire magic within range find their spells flicker and sputter, barely igniting. Crafted by Red Winter, this item is a testament to enduring winter's wrath in its purest form.

effectDetails.title: Permanent Frost Aura
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has permanent resistance to cold damage. Any fire magic cast within 10 feet fizzles and dissipates, dealing no damage.

effectDetails.title: Metal Degradation
effectDetails.rules: All non-magical metal items within 5 feet of the bearer become brittle and prone to shattering upon a DM roll. This effect does not occur on a successful saving throw.

red_winter_permanent_frost_aura.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant power to harness Red Winter's unyielding cold.
red_winter_permanent_frost_aura.vendorReason: Red Winter Outpost specializes in crafting and distributing items related to their harsh, frost-covered lands.
red_winter_permanent_frost_aura.shippingDetail: The item is shipped frozen solid, requiring immediate thawing upon arrival.

usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or the item's effects are negated by a successful saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if exposed to extreme heat or fire magic.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a permanent enchantment.

red_winter_permanent_frost_aura.priceReason: Balanced for its godly rarity and ability to provide significant battlefield advantages without overpowered effects.

red_winter_recipe_frozen_berry_compote.name: Recipe: Red Winter Frozen Berry Compote
red_winter_recipe_frozen_berry_compote.description: This parchment details a frozen berry compote that, when consumed, transforms a fiery temper into a frosty calm. Prepared by the Red Winter Ice Chefs using berries plucked from the northernmost forests, this dessert grants resistance to fire damage for an hour and bestows advantage on saving throws against rage and fear. However, it brings about a brief but intense brain freeze, causing disadvantage on Intelligence checks for 10 minutes after consumption.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fire
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the compote grants the eater resistance to fire damage for a duration of one hour. This effect is active only while the compote remains in the eater’s system.

effectDetails.title: Emotional Calm
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes after consuming the compote, the eater gains advantage on saving throws against rage and fear effects. The effect ends if the eater takes damage from a fire source or consumes another form of mind-affecting magic.

red_winter_recipe_frozen_berry_compote.levelRequirementReason: The recipe is simple enough for even novice chefs to prepare, but its effects are potent enough that consuming it requires at least first-level character experience.
red_winter_recipe_frozen_berry_compote.vendorReason: As the Red Winter Ice Chefs are renowned for their expertise in cold-weather ingredients and magical recipes, they are trusted suppliers of this unique dessert.
red_winter_recipe_frozen_berry_compote.shippingDetail: Due to its perishable nature, the compote must be shipped within a day of preparation by the Red Winter Ice Chefs. Any delay could compromise its effectiveness.

usage.activation: Eating the compote once per long rest
usage.duration: One hour and ten minutes
usage.endsWhen: The effects end if the eater takes fire damage or consumes another mind-affecting magic
usage.charges: Unlimited, as eating it resets after a long rest

red_winter_recipe_frozen_berry_compote.priceReason: While not overly expensive for its rarity, the compote's unique effect and short duration justify this price point.

red_winter_sentient_blizzard.name: Red Winter Sentient Blizzard (Bound)
red_winter_sentient_blizzard.description: Bound within a crystaline core, the Red Winter Sentient Blizzard is a localized blizzard that follows its master like a loyal hound. Its icy breath can freeze creatures solid in a single attempt (DC 20 Constitution saving throw). In snowy terrain, it grants the bearer invisibility as if under a Greater Invisibility spell, cloaking them in a shimmering mist of frost. To maintain this bound spirit, constant infusion of rare magical ice is required, or else it will break free and wreak havoc.

effectDetails.title: Freezing Frost
effectDetails.rules: The Red Winter Sentient Blizzard can freeze creatures solid in a single attempt. A creature within range must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be frozen into place, unable to move for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Invisible Cloak
effectDetails.rules: While in snowy terrain, the Red Winter Sentient Blizzard grants invisibility to the bearer as if under Greater Invisibility. This effect lasts until the end of the bearer's next turn or when the blizzard is destroyed.

red_winter_sentient_blizzard.levelRequirementReason: Only a seasoned warrior with the mastery and discipline to command such power can wield this bound blizzard.
red_winter_sentient_blizzard.vendorReason: The outpost's connection to the frozen north ensures it has access to the rare materials needed for binding such a spirit.
red_winter_sentient_blizzard.shippingDetail: Delivered via a freezing wind that delivers the item within an hour, but requires careful handling in warmer climates.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration of the blizzard lasts until destroyed or the bearer loses concentration (as if under Greater Invisibility)
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by a successful DC 25 Strength (Melee) check against it, or when the bearer no longer has rare magical ice to maintain its binding.

red_winter_sentient_blizzard.priceReason: The Red Winter Sentient Blizzard is priced at 1000 XP due to the rarity of the materials needed for its creation and the unique spell effects it provides.

red_winter_sentient_ice_golem.name: Red Winter Sentient Ice Golem
red_winter_sentient_ice_golem.description: The Red Winter Sentient Ice Golem is a towering guardian of living ice, crafted from pure, ancient glaciers. Its crystalline form shimmers with an inner glow that emanates from the heart-shaped gem embedded within its chest. This golem is both a protector and a weapon, immune to the cold's touch while vulnerable to fiery assaults. It serves only those who have earned its loyalty through acts of valor and wisdom.

effectDetails.title: Loyal Bodyguard
effectDetails.rules: The Red Winter Sentient Ice Golem provides a +2 bonus to AC for any creature within 30 feet. It can take an action to move up to its speed and then make an attack against the nearest hostile creature. If it takes damage, it immediately uses its reaction to heal itself by 50 hit points.

effectDetails.title: Cold Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: The golem is vulnerable to fire damage equal to double normal damage. It regenerates 10 hit points at the start of each turn unless it takes cold damage.

red_winter_sentient_ice_golem.levelRequirementReason: To handle and command such a powerful guardian, a player must demonstrate significant prowess.
red_winter_sentient_ice_golem.vendorReason: The outpost maintains close ties with the golem's creators, ensuring only those of proven worth can claim this protector.
red_winter_sentient_ice_golem.shippingDetail: Special handling required; delivery takes three weeks during winter months.

usage.activation: Automatic once summoned by its master.
usage.duration: Until dismissed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The golem is destroyed or its master dismisses it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged when the master rests.

red_winter_sentient_ice_golem.priceReason: Balanced for a powerful yet reliable bodyguard that requires constant care and magical sustenance.

red_winter_sentient_ice_golem_upgrade.name: Red Winter Sentient Ice Golem Upgrade (Fire Immunity)
red_winter_sentient_ice_golem_upgrade.description: The Red Winter Sentient Ice Golem Upgrade, crafted by Red Winter in a frigid ritual, infuses the golem’s ancient frame with an unyielding immunity to fire damage. The once-vulnerable guardian now stands as an impenetrable fortress against fiery assaults, its icy core resisting even the hottest flames. This upgrade requires a week of continuous magical work and specialized components, ensuring only those with a deep understanding of winter magic can wield it.
effects: Golem gains full immunity to Fire damage

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: The golem is completely immune to any fire-based attacks or spells. This effect lasts until the end of each long rest.

effectDetails.title: Continuous Ritual Requirement
effectDetails.rules: The upgrade can only be applied with a week-long continuous ritual, during which the golem must remain stationary and fully protected from any environmental hazards. Failure to maintain this condition voids the upgrade.

red_winter_sentient_ice_golem_upgrade.levelRequirementReason: This upgrade requires significant magical power and is intended for high-level guardians capable of performing such a demanding ritual.
red_winter_sentient_ice_golem_upgrade.vendorReason: Red Winter, being the forgeheart behind this upgrade, ensures only those who truly understand their craftsmanship can purchase it.
red_winter_sentient_ice_golem_upgrade.shippingDetail: The item is shipped via Frostwind Couriers and must be delivered to a location with sub-zero temperatures to maintain its integrity.

usage.activation: Instantaneous, upon successful completion of the week-long ritual
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of each long rest
usage.endsWhen: The golem completes a long rest or is exposed to environmental hazards that would disrupt the enchantment
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is an ongoing magical effect

red_winter_sentient_ice_golem_upgrade.priceReason: This upgrade represents a significant investment in both time and resources, making it one of Red Winter's most sought-after relics.

red_winter_snow_shaver.name: Red Winter Snow Shaver
red_winter_snow_shaver.description: The Red Winter Snow Shaver is a hand-crafted tool, its gleaming red blades crafted from the frozen heart of a winter storm. This artisanal instrument can shave snow into perfect cones in mere minutes, and when used to chill drinks, it releases a frost that subtly enhances their flavor without overpowering. The blade's edge is so sharp it can freeze any stuck snowball, making it indispensable for wintry feasts.

effectDetails.title: Snow Coned
effectDetails.rules: When used to shave snow into cones, the Red Winter Snow Shaver provides a +1 bonus to any attempt to prepare cold treats. This effect lasts until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Frosty Chill
effectDetails.rules: When used to chill drinks, the blade releases a frost that reduces the temperature of the drink by 2 degrees Fahrenheit for up to an hour. This effect can only be used once per day and is instantaneous upon activation.

red_winter_snow_shaver.levelRequirementReason: This tool's complexity and craftsmanship demand at least first-level proficiency.
red_winter_snow_shaver.vendorReason: The Red Winter Village is known for its expertise in crafting tools that are perfectly suited to their harsh, wintry climate.
red_winter_snow_shaver.shippingDetail: Shipped via a courier who can withstand the coldest of winters, ensuring delivery even during the harshest blizzards.

usage.activation: A bonus action to shave snow into cones; instantaneous to chill drinks.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for chilling drinks; +1 bonus lasts until next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use, or when the next long rest is completed.

red_winter_snow_shaver.priceReason: The Red Winter Snow Shaver's craftsmanship and utility justify its price in terms of XP value.

red_winter_snowflake_identification.name: Red Winter Snowflake Identification
red_winter_snowflake_identification.description: The Red Winter Snowflake Identification is a delicate glass vial filled with frozen winter snowflakes, each one meticulously preserved and labeled by the Red Winter Meteorologists. This tool grants you unparalleled insight into the unique patterns of snowflakes, allowing you to identify them with precision. However, this expertise comes at a cost—those who use it must endure a subtle social disadvantage when interacting with common folk, as they tend to obsess over minute details that others find trivial.
effects: Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks involving winter themes

effectDetails.title: Snowflake Identification
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Nature checks made in winter terrain, and you can identify the unique patterns of any snowflake you observe. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost for Winter Performances
effectDetails.rules: When you perform a Charisma (Performance) check related to winter themes, such as composing a song or delivering a speech about the season, you gain advantage on that check. This effect is limited to once per day.

red_winter_snowflake_identification.levelRequirementReason: This tool requires minimal experience but offers significant benefits for anyone venturing into winter landscapes.
red_winter_snowflake_identification.vendorReason: The Red Winter Meteorologists are renowned experts in the study of snowflakes, and their identification tools are in high demand among travelers and scholars alike.
red_winter_snowflake_identification.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Snowfall Courier Service, known for its reliable winter deliveries across icy terrains.

usage.duration: Permanent until expended or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day.

red_winter_snowflake_identification.priceReason: The Red Winter Snowflake Identification is a valuable tool for adventurers navigating winter terrains, offering both practical and social advantages.

red_winter_survival_pack.name: Red Winter Survival Pack
red_winter_survival_pack.description: The Red Winter Survival Pack is a rugged, insulated kit forged to withstand sub-zero temperatures. Inside lies an array of heating stones that emit warmth for 48 hours upon activation, ensuring you're never caught in the icy grip of winter's chill. Crafted by the resilient Red Winter outpost, this pack is more than just a survival tool—it's a symbol of their enduring spirit against the harshest elements.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: This item grants full immunity to cold environmental effects for its duration. The effect is passive and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Heating Stones
effectDetails.rules: The heating stones within the pack emit warmth for 48 hours after activation. This effect is instantaneous upon use, lasts until depleted, and cannot be recharged.

red_winter_survival_pack.levelRequirementReason: This survival kit is designed to assist adventurers at all levels who find themselves in sub-zero conditions.
red_winter_survival_pack.vendorReason: The Red Winter outpost is renowned for its expertise in crafting gear that can endure the harshest winter climates.
red_winter_survival_pack.shippingDetail: Ships within a Heavy Canvas Bag, ensuring your pack arrives safely and securely.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon opening and using the heating stones.
usage.duration: The heating stone effect lasts for 48 hours after activation, until depleted.
usage.endsWhen: The heating stone effect ends when its warmth is exhausted or if the pack is damaged beyond repair.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the heating stones can be used as many times as needed within their duration.

red_winter_survival_pack.priceReason: This survival kit offers a rare and essential tool for adventurers facing sub-zero conditions, making it worth its price in experience points.

red_winter_thawing_agent.name: Red Winter Thawing Agent (Large Scale)
red_winter_thawing_agent.description: The Red Winter Thawing Agent is a potent chemical that rapidly liquefies vast swaths of ice and snow, transforming wintry landscapes into treacherous rivers in a matter of minutes. Crafted by Red Winter, this agent requires careful deployment: once unleashed, it spreads over a mile-wide radius, turning the ground beneath into slippery mud or causing landslides if used on steep terrain. Its effects are immediate but fleeting, lasting only until the floodwaters recede, leaving behind a landscape forever altered by its passage.

effectDetails.title: Vast Ice-Melting
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Melts all ice or snow within a 1-mile radius, creating a hazardous flood area that lasts for 1 hour. The floodwaters cause difficult terrain in the affected area and impose disadvantage on Strength checks to move through it.

effectDetails.title: Flood and Landslide
effectDetails.rules: If used on steep terrain, there is a 50% chance of causing a landslide within the radius. Characters caught in the flood must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be pushed to the edge of the affected area.

red_winter_thawing_agent.levelRequirementReason: Requires sufficient expertise to safely deploy and manage the chemical's hazardous effects.
red_winter_thawing_agent.vendorReason: Red Winter Outpost is a resource hub for winter survival and has the means to provide this dangerous but essential item.
red_winter_thawing_agent.shippingDetail: Delivered by Red Winter's own tanker trucks, ensuring safe transport of the volatile agent.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The floodwaters recede or if a character is pushed out of the affected area due to a landslide.

red_winter_thawing_agent.priceReason: Reflects its rarity and the controlled environment required for its creation.

red_winter_wario_ice_sculpture_kit.name: Red Winter Wario Ice Sculpture Kit
red_winter_wario_ice_sculpture_kit.description: The Red Winter Wario Ice Sculpture Kit allows you to craft a life-sized ice sculpture of Wario, complete with his signature red overalls and yellow mustache. The sculpture is so detailed that it can be used as an ice lantern or a makeshift shelter in cold climates. It requires precise carving and a steady hand, but the result is a stunning work of art that brings warmth to even the coldest nights.

effectDetails.title: Craft Ice Sculpture
effectDetails.rules: When you use this kit, you can create a life-sized ice sculpture of Wario. This requires a successful DC 15 Craft (sculpting) check and takes one hour to complete. The sculpture is considered an object with AC 10, HP equal to your proficiency bonus x 4, and vulnerability to fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Cold Weather Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus on Charisma checks made while in cold weather or wearing cold-weather gear. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

red_winter_wario_ice_sculpture_kit.levelRequirementReason: This kit is designed for beginners and adventurers just starting their journey.
red_winter_wario_ice_sculpture_kit.vendorReason: Red Winter specializes in cold-weather gear and accessories, making this kit a perfect addition to their offerings.
red_winter_wario_ice_sculpture_kit.shippingDetail: Ships via Ice Road Truckers, known for delivering frozen goods across snowy terrains with precision.

usage.activation: Crafting the sculpture requires a DC 15 Craft (sculpting) check and takes one hour of work.
usage.duration: The sculpture lasts until it melts or is destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The sculpture melts in one hour, or if damaged beyond repair.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the kit can be used multiple times.

red_winter_wario_ice_sculpture_kit.priceReason: This kit includes high-quality ice sculpting tools and materials, making it a valuable and well-priced addition to any adventurer's gear.

red_winter_wario_snow_globe.name: Red Winter Wario Snow Globe
red_winter_wario_snow_globe.description: The Red Winter Wario Snow Globe is a meticulously crafted glass sphere filled with shimmering winter snow and a tiny, mischievous Wario figurine. When shaken vigorously, it releases a frosty, 5-foot-radius snow cloud that blankets nearby surfaces, making navigation tricky for those unprepared. The globe's contents are more than just a novelty; they imbue the wielder with the wisdom—or rather, the folly—of a seasoned yet misguided Wario. This figurine whispers bad advice to you once per day, influencing your decisions and choices in ways that can be both laughable and perilous.

effectDetails.title: Snow Cloud
effectDetails.rules: When shaken as a bonus action, the Red Winter Wario Snow Globe releases a frosty snow cloud in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on you. This effect lasts for 1 minute and imposes disadvantage on all Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made within its radius.

effectDetails.title: Bad Advice
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the Wario figurine inside whispers bad advice to you, granting you advantage on one failed Wisdom saving throw or Charisma check that represents a poor decision. The effects of this whisper last until the end of your next long rest.

red_winter_wario_snow_globe.levelRequirementReason: The Red Winter Wario Snow Globe is designed for beginners to have fun with its whimsical yet challenging effects.
red_winter_wario_snow_globe.vendorReason: Red Winter, known for its quirky and themed merchandise, naturally sells this festive snow globe.
red_winter_wario_snow_globe.shippingDetail: The Ice Road Truckers deliver the Red Winter Wario Snow Globe with special care during the winter months, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute (Snow Cloud)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you no longer hold the globe and are not shaking it

red_winter_wario_snow_globe.priceReason: The Red Winter Wario Snow Globe is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its fun yet slightly disruptive effects.

refijia_android_chassis.name: Refijian Hyper-Durable Android Chassis
refijia_android_chassis.description: The Refijian Hyper-Durable Android Chassis stands as a testament to synthetic ingenuity, crafted from advanced alloys and durable synthetics that can withstand the harshest environments. This chassis is not merely a machine; it's an artifact imbued with the resilience of its creators, the Refijians, who once walked among the stars. It grants immunity to poison and disease, and no longer ages or decays, ensuring your consciousness remains untarnished for eternity.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Poison/Disease
effectDetails.rules: The chassis provides a +5 bonus to saving throws against poison and disease. This effect is permanent until the chassis is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: No Aging Effects
effectDetails.rules: The chassis does not age or decay, maintaining its pristine condition indefinitely. The owner's appearance remains unchanged as well.

refijia_android_chassis.levelRequirementReason: Only those of great experience and power can harness the Refijian Hyper-Durable Android Chassis, ensuring it is reserved for high-level adventurers.
