usage.endsWhen: The creature takes damage from a source other than you or completes a short rest.

rogueport_shadow_forged_blade.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its unique crafting and the rarity of materials used in its creation.

rogueport_shadow_fury_rod.name: Shadow Fury Rod
rogueport_shadow_fury_rod.description: The Shadow Fury Rod is a cursed wand crafted from the blackened steel of a moonless night and stolen moonlight, its tip glowing ominously like a dying star. Its wielder can swing it to unleash a disorienting shriek that not only blinds foes momentarily but also drains their arcane power, leaving them weakened and vulnerable. This weapon is perfect for assassins who need to strike unseen and vanish into the night.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Shriek
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Shadow Fury Rod emits a disorienting shriek that blinds all creatures within 10 feet for 2 rounds. Creatures making a successful Wisdom saving throw are not blinded but still take the rod's damage and effect.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Drain
effectDetails.rules: The shriek also drains arcane energy, dealing an additional 4d6 necrotic damage to creatures with magical resistances or immunity. This effect has a save DC of 15.

rogueport_shadow_fury_rod.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to control the rod's disorienting and draining powers effectively.
rogueport_shadow_fury_rod.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its network of thieves and assassins, making it the perfect vendor for a cursed weapon like this.
rogueport_shadow_fury_rod.shippingDetail: The rod arrives wrapped in shadow cloth to protect its curse from prying eyes.

usage.activation: Bonus action to unleash the shriek and drain arcane energy.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting for 2 rounds after activation.
usage.endsWhen: When the target creature succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw or is no longer within range.

rogueport_shadow_fury_rod.priceReason: The rod's unique cursed properties and its ability to drain arcane energy justify this balanced price in XP.

rogueport_shadow_ink.name: Shadow Ink Vial
rogueport_shadow_ink.description: The Shadow Ink Vial exudes a dark, almost sentient ink that can be used to forge contracts or erase evidence without leaving behind any physical trace. When applied, it reacts with the surface to vanish into the paper or wall, leaving not even the faintest smudge behind. In moonlight, the vial glows faintly, revealing hidden messages left by its mysterious ink, a trait that could be both a blessing and a curse for those who wield it.

effectDetails.title: Eradicates Inked Evidence
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can apply the ink to any surface that has been recently written or drawn upon. The ink reacts with the existing ink, erasing it completely and leaving no trace of what was there before. This effect lasts until the ink is dry, which takes 30 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Messages
effectDetails.rules: When exposed to moonlight, the vial emits a faint glow that reveals any hidden messages or symbols written in ink on surfaces within reach. The user can only read one message per night and must wait 1 hour before using this ability again.

rogueport_shadow_ink.levelRequirementReason: Even an untrained individual can use the vial to forge contracts or erase evidence, making it accessible to all levels.
rogueport_shadow_ink.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its collection of rare and illicit items useful in forgery and espionage, and this vial fits perfectly into their inventory.
rogueport_shadow_ink.shippingDetail: The ink must be kept cool during transit to prevent premature drying. The Courier of Shadows ensures safe delivery through back alleys and hidden routes.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (30 seconds for eradication)
usage.endsWhen: The ink dries or the user is caught in the act, whichever comes first

rogueport_shadow_ink.priceReason: The vial's rare ink and unique properties make it a valuable tool for anyone involved in forgery or espionage.

rogueport_shadow_scarf.name: Shadow Scarf of the Silent Hour
rogueport_shadow_scarf.description: The Shadow Scarf of the Silent Hour is a silk scarf woven from stolen ink and whispered secrets, its dark weave shimmering faintly under moonlight. As you wear it, ambient noise fades into silence in crowded alleys, masking your presence with the very shadows that cloak you. During stealth missions at night, it grants a slight chance to evade patrol drones for 30 seconds, allowing you to slip past unseen and unheard.

effectDetails.title: Nighttime Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the scarf, your Stealth checks are made with advantage when it is nighttime. This effect lasts until the next sunrise.

effectDetails.title: Drones Evasion Chance
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you may attempt to evade a patrol drone's detection within 30 feet for 30 seconds. On a successful Dexterity (Stealth) check with a DC of 15, the drone fails to detect you.

rogueport_shadow_scarf.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Stealth to fully utilize its stealth benefits effectively.
rogueport_shadow_scarf.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in equipment that aids in covert operations and espionage, making this scarf a natural addition to their inventory.
rogueport_shadow_scarf.shippingDetail: Delivered through the Shadow Veil, ensuring swift and secure transport from the depths of the Undercity.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation by simply wearing it; no action required.
usage.duration: Lasts until next sunrise or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if exposed to direct sunlight for more than a minute.

rogueport_shadow_scarf.priceReason: Balanced at this price point due to its niche utility in stealth and evasion, making it a valuable tool for rogue classes.

rogueport_shadow_scribe.name: Shadow Scribe Inkwell
rogueport_shadow_scribe.description: The Shadow Scribe Inkwell is a vial of inky essence forged from the shadows of forgotten alleys. This ink allows its wielder to leave faint, ghostly signatures on walls or surfaces, perfect for marking hidden paths or bribing guards with invisible notes. The ink's touch is as cold and elusive as the night itself; it can be used to write on walls, doors, or glass without leaving marks. Beware: some ink can leave trails that follow the user’s soul, a haunting reminder of their passage.

effectDetails.title: Invisible Ink Trail
effectDetails.rules: When used to write on a living target, the ink leaves behind an invisible trail that follows the user for up to 30 seconds. The trail is only visible under specific conditions and can be detected with a successful DC 15 Perception check.

effectDetails.title: Illusionary Presence
effectDetails.rules: If the ink touches a living target, it imparts a temporary illusion of the user’s presence that lasts for up to 1 minute. This effect requires no action and can be used once per long rest.

rogueport_shadow_scribe.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second-level proficiency in Stealth or Deception to effectively use this item.
rogueport_shadow_scribe.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its connections with shadowy figures, making it the ideal vendor for such an item.
rogueport_shadow_scribe.shippingDetail: Delivery via Boo Spectral Mail is swift but eerie; expect a delivery that feels like you're being watched.

usage.activation: Uses an action to apply ink and write or touch the target.
usage.duration: The invisible trail lasts for up to 30 seconds, while the illusionary presence lasts for up to 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the user moves out of range or if a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check is made by an observer.

rogueport_shadow_scribe.priceReason: Balanced price considering its unique and versatile effects, requiring a mix of stealth and creativity to use effectively.

rogueport_shadow_siphon.name: Shadow Siphon Vial
rogueport_shadow_siphon.description: The Shadow Siphon Vial is a vial of liquid darkness that drips like ink, seeping into the very essence of its target. When used, it drains a foe's aura, leaving them vulnerable to physical attacks for three rounds. The vial also enhances the wielder’s strikes, granting +10% chance to hit with melee or ranged attacks for one round. A potent brew indeed, it can cause temporary blindness in an enemy attempting to cast magic spells.

effectDetails.title: Aura Drain
effectDetails.rules: When the vial is used, it drains 20% of a target’s aura for three rounds. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become temporarily blinded until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Strikes
effectDetails.rules: The user gains +10% chance to hit with melee and ranged attacks for one round upon using the vial. This effect is cumulative if used in combination with other bonuses to attack rolls, up to a maximum of +25%. This enhancement lasts until the end of the user's next turn.

rogueport_shadow_siphon.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to effectively utilize the vial’s potent effects without being overwhelmed.
rogueport_shadow_siphon.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its extensive network of spies and rogues, making it a prime location for such a covert item.
rogueport_shadow_siphon.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost discretion, ensuring the package arrives without detection.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration of each aura drain lasts for three rounds, and enhanced strikes last until the end of the user’s next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effects are exhausted after their respective durations or if the vial is used again before its current effect ends.

rogueport_shadow_siphon.priceReason: Balanced price considering the item's unique and potent effects, requiring precise timing for maximum effectiveness.

rogueport_shadow_suit.name: Shadow Suit
rogueport_shadow_suit.description: The Shadow Suit is a sleek ensemble crafted from the stolen night-dreams of the city and rare black-market silk. Its weave shimmers with an ethereal glow that only deepens in dim light, making its wearer nearly invisible to all but the keenest eyes. However, each step taken while cloaked drains stamina at a rate of 10% per second, leaving the user fatigued until they rest or remove it.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Cloak
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes invisible in dim light and darkness. This effect lasts for 10 seconds, after which the user must rest to regain the ability to use this feature again.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Strike
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Shadow Suit, the wielder gains +50% bonus to their stealth checks against guards. This effect is active for as long as they are moving and not engaging in combat.

rogueport_shadow_suit.levelRequirementReason: The Shadow Suit's invisibility requires a basic understanding of stealth techniques, suitable for even the most novice rogues.
rogueport_shadow_suit.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in gear and equipment that aids in the art of thievery and espionage, making it an ideal vendor for the Shadow Suit.
rogueport_shadow_suit.shippingDetail: The suit is delivered with a special delivery notice to alert the recipient of its arrival.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until the wearer moves more than 30 feet in a turn
usage.endsWhen: The invisibility ends, and the user must rest before using it again. Moving too far expends the effect.

rogueport_shadow_suit.priceReason: The Shadow Suit's rarity and unique construction, combined with its limited duration and stamina drain, justify this moderate price.

rogueport_shadow_tape.name: Shadow Tape
rogueport_shadow_tape.description: Shadow Tape, a slimy, self-repairing adhesive that glows faintly in the dark, is crafted from enchanted silk and ink. It allows you to slip past surveillance undetected by erasing all digital or physical traces of your presence. Activating it reveals hidden passages or secret rooms, guiding you through concealed pathways. The tape's glow illuminates nearby allies or foes for 30 seconds, providing critical tactical insight in the shadows.

effectDetails.title: Erase All Traces
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, apply Shadow Tape to a surface. This erases all digital or physical traces of your presence within the area for 1 minute. You can use this effect once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: Activate Shadow Tape by touching it to a wall or floor, causing it to glow faintly and reveal any hidden passages or secret rooms in a 10-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short rest.

rogueport_shadow_tape.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners who wish to enhance their stealth and exploration abilities.
rogueport_shadow_tape.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in items that assist adventurers in navigating treacherous terrains and outsmarting enemies.
rogueport_shadow_tape.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express, ensuring timely delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Bonus action for 'Erase All Traces'; Standard action for 'Reveal Hidden Passages'
usage.duration: 1 minute per use; ends when the time expires or you activate a second effect
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires after 1 minute, or another Shadow Tape effect is activated

rogueport_shadow_tape.priceReason: Balanced to provide significant utility without overpowered effects.

rogueport_shadow_tapestry.name: Shadow Tapestry of the Broken Veil
rogueport_shadow_tapestry.description: The Shadow Tapestry of the Broken Veil is a dark, intricate weave of shadow threads that shimmer faintly under moonlight. When donned, it warps reality around you, blurring your form into the fabric of night itself. Its woven patterns seem to shift with your emotions; fear and rage cause the tapestry's shadows to writhe like living creatures. It is said to have been crafted by dark-hearted weavers in the depths of forgotten realms, and its glow intensifies when emotions run high.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Concealment
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. For the next 10 seconds, you are completely hidden from normal sight and have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while moving. If an enemy is within 5 feet of you and has seen your form before, there is a 20% chance that they will be overcome with a hallucinatory vision, forcing them to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become blinded for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Emotionally Sensitive
effectDetails.rules: The tapestry's glow increases in intensity when fear or rage is present within 50 feet. When this happens, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Dexterity modifier (maximum of twice your level) for the duration of the encounter.

rogueport_shadow_tapestry.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a low-level character due to its versatile utility and stealth capabilities.
rogueport_shadow_tapestry.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in items that aid in espionage and covert operations, making this tapestry an ideal addition to their inventory.
rogueport_shadow_tapestry.shippingDetail: This item is delivered through shadowy means, ensuring secrecy during transport. The tapestry's glow dims significantly for the duration of shipment, but it fully regains its light upon arrival.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and deactivate.
usage.duration: 10 seconds or until expended.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is incapacitated, killed, or the tapestry is removed.

rogueport_shadow_tapestry.priceReason: The item's versatile utility and unique emotional sensitivity make it a valuable asset for any rogue, justifying its moderate price in XP.

rogueport_shadow_tongue.name: Shadow Tongue
rogueport_shadow_tongue.description: The Shadow Tongue is a cursed appendage, crafted from the sinew of shadows and the whispers of the dead. When worn, it amplifies your voice, making you a master of deception and fear. It grants +20% to Deception checks and causes enemies within 15 feet to be frightened until they succeed on a saving throw (DC 14). The cursed nature of this tongue ensures that any secrets revealed through its use are never truly forgotten by the listener.

effectDetails.title: Deceptive Amplifier
effectDetails.rules: When you speak, your voice carries an aura that enhances your Deception checks. This effect is passive and does not require action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Fearful Whisper
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 15 feet of you must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The effect ends early if the target takes any damage, moves out of range, or is incapacitated.

rogueport_shadow_tongue.levelRequirementReason: The Shadow Tongue's curse demands a certain level of experience to wield effectively.
rogueport_shadow_tongue.vendorReason: Rogueport has a reputation for dealing in the darkest secrets and curiosities, making it the perfect vendor for such an item.
rogueport_shadow_tongue.shippingDetail: The Shadow Tongue arrives via a shadowy courier who delivers it personally, ensuring its arrival is both timely and mysterious.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the target takes damage, moves out of range, or becomes incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: The frightened condition ends as normal.

rogueport_shadow_tongue.priceReason: Balanced at a price that reflects its cursed nature and the specialized crafting required for such an item.

rogueport_shadow_torch.name: Shadow Torch
rogueport_shadow_torch.description: The Shadow Torch exudes an eerie, flickering light that dances only in the deepest shadows, casting a halo of dim luminescence without betraying its wielder's position. Its flame is forged from the twilight itself, leaving no trace when extinguished and granting +2 to Stealth checks for up to 10 minutes with each use. Perfect for infiltration missions, it allows rogue agents to move unseen through darkened corridors and hidden enclaves.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Illumination
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Shadow Torch illuminates an area of 10 meters in complete darkness for up to 30 minutes. The torch leaves no trace when extinguished and grants +2 to Stealth checks while active.

effectDetails.title: No Trace
effectDetails.rules: The flame dies without a trace, leaving no ash or scent behind, ensuring the user's passage remains undetected even after use.

rogueport_shadow_torch.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a level 7 rogue to wield due to its complexity and specialized nature.
rogueport_shadow_torch.vendorReason: Rogueport, with its extensive network of covert operations, is the only vendor capable of sourcing and selling such an advanced tool for stealth missions.
rogueport_shadow_torch.shippingDetail: Ships via a Rakasha spirit courier known to navigate even the thickest shadows without detection.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and extinguish, or use passively while kept lit.
usage.duration: Up to 30 minutes per activation
usage.endsWhen: Extinguished or after its duration expires

rogueport_shadow_torch.priceReason: The Shadow Torch is priced at 1000 XP due to its epic rarity and specialized utility for stealth and infiltration.

rogueport_shadowed_soul_amber.name: Shadowed Soul Amber
rogueport_shadowed_soul_amber.description: The Shadowed Soul Amber glows faintly, its amber surface etched with shadows that dance like fleeting spirits. This gemstone is said to be crafted from the essence of the Veil of Lost Souls, capturing a fragment of the Shadowfell’s dark magic. When worn, it grants the bearer temporary stealth in shadowy environs and immortality to fear effects for a brief time, allowing them to walk unafraid into the heart of darkness.

effectDetails.title: Stealth in Shadows
effectDetails.rules: When worn within shadowy areas, the wearer gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 minute. This effect is interrupted if they leave a shadowed area or are exposed to direct sunlight.

effectDetails.title: Fearlessness
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes immune to fear effects and other similar conditions for 10 seconds upon activation. This immunity ends when the duration expires, and the user must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute.

rogueport_shadowed_soul_amber.levelRequirementReason: The gem's dark magic requires a certain degree of discipline and experience to wield without mishap.
rogueport_shadowed_soul_amber.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its trade in rare and esoteric goods, including items that bridge the gap between reality and the Shadowfell.
rogueport_shadowed_soul_amber.shippingDetail: The gem is carefully packed to prevent exposure to direct sunlight during transit. It must be kept in a shadowed container until activated.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the wearer leaves a shadowy area, whichever ends first
usage.endsWhen: Leaving a shadowy area or being exposed to direct sunlight

rogueport_shadowed_soul_amber.priceReason: The gem's crafting requires rare Shadowfell essence and precise dark alchemy, balancing its powerful effects with a fair market value.

rogueport_shadowed_talon.name: Shadowed Talon Dagger
rogueport_shadowed_talon.description: The Shadowed Talon Dagger, forged from a blend of stolen shadowsteel and the whispers of ancient labyrinths, glows softly in the dark, slicing through illusions and dispelling fear. Its blade shimmers with an eerie luminescence that pierces magical defenses, leaving foes reeling under its psychic sting. When wielded within the Shadowfell, it deals +10 extra damage to enemies and grants its bearer a +20% evasion bonus against all magical attacks.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Piercing
effectDetails.rules: When wielded in the Shadowfell, this dagger deals an additional 10 points of damage to illusory targets. This effect persists for the duration of any combat encounter and is exhausted upon entering non-Shadowfell terrain.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Sting
effectDetails.rules: Whenever a target within 5 feet casts a spell, the wielder can choose to expend one charge to deal 1d4 points of psychic damage. This effect has no save DC and cannot be used more than once per short or long rest.

rogueport_shadowed_talon.levelRequirementReason: The Shadowed Talon Dagger's unique properties require a proficient rogue with at least three levels to wield it effectively.
rogueport_shadowed_talon.vendorReason: Rogueport, known for its shady dealings and arcane wares, is the only vendor willing to stock this dagger forged from forbidden materials.
rogueport_shadowed_talon.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, ensuring swift delivery with a chance of misdelivery due to spectral interference.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action to use within the Shadowfell or when an enemy casts a spell.
usage.duration: Until end of combat encounter in the Shadowfell; single-use per short/long rest for Psychic Sting.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon leaving the Shadowfell or after one use per rest for Psychic Sting.

rogueport_shadowed_talon.priceReason: The unique properties of shadowsteel and its arcane forging justify a price slightly above average but still within reach for a seasoned rogue.

rogueport_shadowwhisper_ambassador.name: Shadowwhisper Ambassador
rogueport_shadowwhisper_ambassador.description: The Shadowwhisper Ambassador is a sleek, obsidian-tipped gauntlet that whispers secrets of the Feywild to its wearer. Crafted from the bones of ancient fae and enchanted with shadow magic, this gauntlet grants the wearer unparalleled stealth in darkened or enchanted zones. It can reveal hidden paths or traps within 30 feet, allowing for strategic evasion. The gauntlet also has a subtle enchantment that confuses enemies during stealth encounters, granting a 5% chance to disarm them or cause confusion.
effects: +20% Stealth in Shadowed or Enchanted Areas

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth (+20%)
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Shadowwhisper Ambassador, you gain a +20 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks in shadowed or enchanted areas. This effect lasts for 1 hour per use and requires no action.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths and Traps
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the Shadowwhisper Ambassador to reveal hidden paths or traps within a 30-foot radius. You can do this once every long rest.

rogueport_shadowwhisper_ambassador.levelRequirementReason: This gauntlet is designed for its subtle magic and requires no high-level proficiency to wield.
rogueport_shadowwhisper_ambassador.vendorReason: Rogueport, known for its expertise in espionage gear, offers this unique item to their customers seeking the edge in covert operations.
rogueport_shadowwhisper_ambassador.shippingDetail: Shipped via Lakitu Drones, ensuring secure and fast delivery with a one-day turnaround time.

usage.duration: 1 hour per use for Enhanced Stealth; once every long rest for Revealing Hidden Paths and Traps
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the gauntlet is removed from your hand

rogueport_shadowwhisper_ambassador.priceReason: This price reflects its rare enchantment, unique crafting materials, and limited availability.

rogueport_silence_blood.name: Silence Blood
rogueport_silence_blood.description: Silence Blood is a vial of dark, crimson liquid that whispers secrets of forgotten courts. When consumed in combat, it casts an eerie silence over your surroundings for 10 minutes, muffling all noise and echoes. The effects are potent but fleeting; once the silence ends, you remain vulnerable to sudden sounds that could give away your position. This cursed vial leaves a faint, metallic sheen on your skin, making you appear suspicious if discovered.

effectDetails.title: Silence Surroundings
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as an action, this vial casts a 30-foot radius cone of silence that muffles all sound for 10 minutes. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of its effects, you are vulnerable to any noise-based attacks or spells targeting auditory senses. If you take damage from an auditory source during this time, you must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn.

rogueport_silence_blood.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic combat experience and subtlety to wield its effects without drawing attention.
rogueport_silence_blood.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in items that blur the line between stealth and treachery, making Silence Blood a natural fit for their inventory.
rogueport_silence_blood.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Courier of Shadows, this vial arrives under the cover of darkness with no traceable delivery path.

usage.duration: 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Ends when its duration expires or you take damage from an auditory source during that time
usage.charges: One charge per use, recharged after a long rest

rogueport_silence_blood.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item with potent stealth capabilities but at a moderate level requirement.

rogueport_silence_bottle.name: Silence Bottle
rogueport_silence_bottle.description: The Silence Bottle holds a fragment of a fallen priestess’s essence, sealed within a glass vial. When uncorked and consumed, it creates an impenetrable silence around the wielder for 10 seconds, muffling all sounds cast by magic. The air itself seems to hold still as arcane whispers are silenced, granting the user +2 to Stealth checks for two turns. In close combat, nearby enemies’ spellcasting is reduced by 50% for three turns, disrupting their incantations and gestures.

effectDetails.title: Silencing Magic
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Silence Bottle creates a zone of silence around the user for 10 seconds. All sounds cast by magic within this area are suppressed. This effect has a radius of 5 feet and lasts until its duration ends or the bottle is used again.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: +2 to Stealth checks for two turns after consuming the Silence Bottle. No save DC required; the effect is purely situational, enhancing the user’s ability to move unseen.

rogueport_silence_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This item requires minimal preparation and can be used by lower-level characters to gain an advantage in stealthy situations.
rogueport_silence_bottle.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its extensive trade network, including exotic magical items that aid in espionage and thievery.
rogueport_silence_bottle.shippingDetail: The bottle must be delivered via a trusted courier to ensure it remains intact and potent.

usage.duration: 10 seconds, per use
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends or the bottle is used again

rogueport_silence_bottle.priceReason: The Silence Bottle’s rarity and unique magical properties justify its price; it provides a significant tactical advantage at minimal cost.

rogueport_silence_gear.name: Silence Gear of the Whispering Cartel
rogueport_silence_gear.description: The Silence Gear of the Whispering Cartel is a pair of supple leather gloves crafted from the hides of whispering serpents. These gloves muffle your movements and whispers, making you nearly invisible to detection. The serpent's skin imbues them with an eerie yet effective silence that can turn even the noisiest environment into a silent passage. When worn, enemies cannot hear you for 30 seconds, and your stealth becomes as quiet as a whispering breeze.

effectDetails.title: Silence Detection
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Silence Gear, enemies cannot hear you for 30 seconds. This effect does not grant invisibility but significantly reduces your noise footprint. You can activate this ability as a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Whisper Stealth
effectDetails.rules: For each hour of use, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect is cumulative and does not reset until 24 hours have passed since the last use.

rogueport_silence_gear.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 7 to ensure proficiency in stealth and dexterity.
rogueport_silence_gear.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its connections with undercity thieves, making them the perfect vendor for this gear.
rogueport_silence_gear.shippingDetail: Delivered by Shy Guy Smugglers within two days of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; activates once per long rest.
usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you take damage or when the next long rest occurs.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest.

rogueport_silence_gear.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its epic rarity and unique stealth benefits.

rogueport_silence_mouth.name: Silence Mouth
rogueport_silence_mouth.description: The Silence Mouth is a cursed mask crafted from blackened leather and adorned with silver runes. It muffles all vocalizations, rendering the wearer silent for exactly one minute unless they speak in hushed tones. This artifact was once used by a notorious guild to outmaneuver their enemies without a sound. The mask prevents enemy shouts or screams from triggering traps but is rendered useless if the wearer speaks louder than a whisper.

effectDetails.title: Silence Vocalizations
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, muffling all vocalizations for one minute. Ends if the wearer speaks above a whisper or at the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Trap Disarmament
effectDetails.rules: Prevents enemy shouts and screams from triggering traps within 10 feet of the wearer. This effect lasts until the wearer speaks louder than a whisper or for one minute, whichever comes first.

rogueport_silence_mouth.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners to use in its intended role without requiring high-level expertise.
rogueport_silence_mouth.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in crafting and selling equipment that aids in silent operations, making the Silence Mouth a fitting addition to their inventory.
rogueport_silence_mouth.shippingDetail: Delivered with a cloak of invisibility for an hour upon arrival.

usage.duration: One minute or until wearer speaks above a whisper
usage.endsWhen: Wearer speaks louder than a whisper or at the end of their next turn

rogueport_silence_mouth.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its cursed nature and utility in silent combat scenarios.

rogueport_silence_pearl.name: Silence Pearl of the Whispering Deep
rogueport_silence_pearl.description: The Silence Pearl of the Whispering Deep hums softly like a forgotten melody, its surface etched with ancient runes that glow faintly in the dark. When activated, it mutes sound around you, creating an impenetrable silence that can fool even the most perceptive ears for several moments. It is said to have been crafted by deep-sea artisans from the shells of long-dead creatures, imbuing it with the whispers of the ocean's forgotten lore.

effectDetails.title: Mute Sound
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Silence Pearl creates an area of silence around you that lasts for 10 seconds. Within this duration, all sound within a 5-foot radius is suppressed. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges.

effectDetails.title: Enhance Stealth
effectDetails.rules: For the first 5 seconds after activating the Silence Pearl, your Stealth checks are made at advantage. Additionally, creatures making Perception checks to detect you have disadvantage during this time. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges.

rogueport_silence_pearl.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted for adventurers of all levels, but its effects are most useful in stealth-oriented scenarios.
rogueport_silence_pearl.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in items that enhance the skills and abilities of their patrons, making this pearl a perfect addition to their inventory.
rogueport_silence_pearl.shippingDetail: This item is shipped with Pipe Express for expedited delivery, ensuring it arrives at your doorstep without delay.

usage.duration: 10 seconds and 5 seconds respectively for each effect
usage.endsWhen: The duration of both effects ends when their respective time periods are up; no save DC is required.

rogueport_silence_pearl.priceReason: This item provides significant utility in stealth and combat, justifying its moderate price tag.

rogueport_silence_satchel.name: Silence Satchel
rogueport_silence_satchel.description: The Silence Satchel is a sleek, matte-black duffel crafted from enchanted leather. It whispers with a faint glow when activated, creating an impenetrable sound barrier around its wielder. The bag’s core, forged in the heart of ancient forges, amplifies this power, rendering footsteps and whispers undetectable to foes within 10 feet. A true rogue's companion, it can also be thrown to create a temporary soundproof zone covering a 3x3 grid area around its thrower.

effectDetails.title: Silent Footsteps
effectDetails.rules: The wielder and any creatures within 10 feet of them are rendered silent for 30 seconds. This effect creates a temporary soundproof zone around the user, masking all ambient noise and movements. The satchel can be thrown to create this zone in a 3x3 grid area centered on where it lands.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Detection
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within the 10-foot radius have their passive Perception checks for detecting hidden or stealthy creatures reduced by 4. This effect lasts until the user moves more than 20 feet away from the satchel’s position.

rogueport_silence_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The Silence Satchel requires a minimum level of 3 to wield, ensuring that only experienced rogues can harness its complex magic.
rogueport_silence_satchel.vendorReason: Rogueport is renowned for supplying the finest equipment to seasoned stealth operatives and mercenaries seeking to enhance their capabilities in covert missions.
rogueport_silence_satchel.shippingDetail: The Silence Satchel must be shipped via Koopa Postal’s express courier service, ensuring it reaches its destination securely and on time.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate the soundproofing effect or a thrown action to deploy the grid zone.
usage.duration: 30 seconds for silent footsteps; ends when the user moves more than 20 feet away from the satchel’s position in the case of reduced detection.
usage.endsWhen: The effect is interrupted if the user moves beyond the specified range or distance.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the user remains within the soundproof zone.

rogueport_silence_satchel.priceReason: The Silence Satchel’s balance ensures it provides a strategic advantage without overshadowing other party members, making its cost of 1000 XP fair and reasonable.

rogueport_silence_scarf.name: Silence Scarf
rogueport_silence_scarf.description: The Silence Scarf is a meticulously woven fabric of enchanted silks, spun from threads that whisper secrets to the wind itself. Its weave dampens all ambient sound within a 5-foot radius for up to 10 seconds, allowing its wearer to slip past guards unseen and unheard. The scarf’s subtle patterns seem to absorb noise, making every nearby creature feel suddenly deafened. Enemies who attempt to speak while in proximity suffer from a momentary disorientation, halting their speech mid-sentence.
effects: Silences ambient sound within a 5-foot radius

effectDetails.title: Sound Suppression
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The scarf silences all ambient sounds in a 5-foot radius for up to 10 seconds, granting the wearer advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made during this time. If worn while moving, it reduces the DC of such Stealth checks by 2.

effectDetails.title: Speech Disruption
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within a 5-foot radius who attempt to speak are rendered momentarily speechless for up to 10 seconds. Creatures can make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) to resist. On a successful save, they remain unaffected by this effect.

rogueport_silence_scarf.levelRequirementReason: The scarf's enchantment is subtle but effective, requiring only a basic understanding of magic.
rogueport_silence_scarf.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in gear that enhances the capabilities of its patrons for infiltration and stealth operations.
rogueport_silence_scarf.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu drones, ensuring the scarf arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; can be used once per short or long rest
usage.duration: Up to 10 seconds per activation
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the user speaks or moves beyond a 5-foot radius from the scarf's location
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, resets after a short or long rest

rogueport_silence_scarf.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item with limited utility but significant tactical advantage for infiltration.

rogueport_silence_spray.name: Silence Spray of the Whispering Viper
rogueport_silence_spray.description: The Silence Spray of the Whispering Viper is a sleek, obsidian spray bottle adorned with shimmering scales that seem to vibrate in anticipation. When activated, it releases a fine mist that mutes all ambient sounds for ten seconds, allowing you to slip away unnoticed or eavesdrop on hushed conversations. The faint afterglow left behind is visible only to enemies within 30 feet, revealing your position with an eerie glow. This spray is the perfect tool for rogues seeking to blend into their surroundings and avoid unwanted attention.

effectDetails.title: Silence
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this spray mutes all ambient sounds within a radius of 10 feet for ten seconds. This effect grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made during its duration and ends if the user moves more than 5 feet or attacks.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Aura
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the Silence effect, you have a +10% chance to successfully use the Stealth skill. This aura lasts for ten seconds but is dispelled immediately upon taking damage, attacking, or moving more than 5 feet.

rogueport_silence_spray.levelRequirementReason: This spray requires at least second-level proficiency in Stealth to effectively utilize its full potential.
rogueport_silence_spray.vendorReason: Rogueport is a notorious hub for espionage and stealth equipment, making it the perfect vendor for this specialized tool.
rogueport_silence_spray.shippingDetail: The spray arrives fully charged but requires recharging after each use by spending ten minutes in a quiet environment.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: You move more than 5 feet, take damage, or attack

rogueport_silence_spray.priceReason: The spray's balanced price reflects its utility and the time required to recharge it after each use.

rogueport_silence_wristband.name: Silence Wristband
rogueport_silence_wristband.description: The Silence Wristband is a sleek, blackened alloy band that instantly muffles all ambient noise within a five-meter radius. Ideal for infiltrating secure zones or avoiding detection by audio-based surveillance systems, it causes a brief disorientation in nearby enemies who can still see you clearly but are momentarily deaf to the world around them. The effect fades after 15 minutes of use, leaving you to navigate the silence with heightened senses.

effectDetails.title: Mutes Ambient Sound
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Mutes all ambient sound within a five-meter radius for 15 minutes, reducing the effective range of any audio-based detection by half. Ends when the wearer removes or damages the wristband.

effectDetails.title: Causes Enemy Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within ten feet of the wearer who hear the silence must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become stunned for one round, unable to take actions but still aware of their surroundings. This effect only occurs once per encounter.

rogueport_silence_wristband.levelRequirementReason: The Silence Wristband requires no specific level as it is a versatile tool for any rogue or investigator.
rogueport_silence_wristband.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in gear that enhances the capabilities of spies and infiltrators, making this wristband a natural addition to their product line.
rogueport_silence_wristband.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drone Express, ensuring timely delivery within three days from the Rogueport Warehouse.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and remove.
usage.duration: 15 minutes per use.
usage.endsWhen: Wristband is removed or damaged.

rogueport_silence_wristband.priceReason: The Silence Wristband offers a powerful utility for spies and rogues, enhancing their ability to move undetected while providing a unique tactical advantage. Its rarity and utility justify its fair value of 1000 XP.

rogueport_silencer_gel.name: Silent Gel of the Whispering Vault
rogueport_silencer_gel.description: The Silent Gel of the Whispering Vault is a thick, pitch-black viscous gel that coats any weapon or armor you apply it to, absorbing sound waves and dampening echoes in the process. Upon activation, your strikes become nearly silent, allowing for precise, stealthy combat without giving away your position. It's ideal for assassins and spies who must move unseen through treacherous environments, ensuring that their presence is as quiet as a whisper.

effectDetails.title: Sound Suppression
effectDetails.rules: When applied to a weapon or armor, the gel reduces the noise of your attacks by 75%, making them almost silent. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be activated as a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: For each use, you gain a +10% bonus to Stealth checks that last until the end of your next short or long rest. The gel provides a continuous enhancement for 30 seconds upon application.

rogueport_silencer_gel.levelRequirementReason: The gel's effects are subtle but effective, suitable for lower-level characters who need to remain unseen.
rogueport_silencer_gel.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in gear and tools that enhance the capabilities of assassins and spies, making it a natural fit for this item.
rogueport_silencer_gel.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express within 24 hours with next-day delivery to major cities.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the end of your next short or long rest, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop using it or after one minute, whichever is sooner. It can be reactivated once per long rest.

rogueport_silencer_gel.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the gel offers a significant stealth and sound suppression advantage without breaking game balance.

rogueport_silent_siren.name: Silent Siren
rogueport_silent_siren.description: The Silent Siren is a delicate, whispering device crafted from enameled steel and adorned with arcane runes. When activated, it muffles all footstep sounds within a ten-meter radius, allowing you to slip past even the most vigilant sentries. Its enchantments also grant a +2 bonus on Stealth checks, making your movements nearly invisible. The siren's power recharges upon connecting to a nearby ley line or similar source of natural magic.

effectDetails.title: Muffle Footsteps
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. The Silent Siren mutes all footstep sounds within a ten-meter radius for the duration of use. This effect ends when you move beyond the radius or if you deactivate it.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth Bonus
effectDetails.rules: Grants a +2 bonus to all Stealth checks while activated, which lasts until the end of your next turn after deactivating the device.

rogueport_silent_siren.levelRequirementReason: The Silent Siren's intricate enchantments are subtle and require no advanced magical knowledge.
rogueport_silent_siren.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in gear for covert operations, making the Silent Siren a natural addition to their lineup.
rogueport_silent_siren.shippingDetail: The device is shipped via Koopa Express, ensuring it arrives undamaged and fully charged.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn after deactivating or moving beyond the ten-meter radius.
usage.endsWhen: Deactivation or movement beyond the ten-meter radius.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges upon connecting to a ley line.

rogueport_silent_siren.priceReason: The Silent Siren's advanced enchantments and unique materials justify its moderate price.

rogueport_silken_hush.name: Silken Hush
rogueport_silken_hush.description: Silken Hush is a whisper-thin fabric that weaves silence around those who wear it. Crafted from the finest threads of ancient forest silkworms, this garment reduces ambient noise by 70%, making it perfect for stealthy maneuvers. However, its weave also muffles spoken words to a mere murmur, reducing vocal communication by two-thirds. This fabric grants a subtle edge in close combat, providing an evasion bonus against auditory-based detection traps.

effectDetails.title: Silent Steps
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Reduces all ambient noise within a 10-foot radius by 70%. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends if the wearer moves more than 30 feet or takes an action that generates sound.

effectDetails.title: Muted Voice
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. When worn, vocal output is muffled to 30% of normal volume. This does not apply to whispered speech. The effect ends when the wearer removes the garment or when the wearer speaks.

rogueport_silken_hush.levelRequirementReason: This item provides a basic advantage for stealth and allows characters to remain undetected in quiet environments.
rogueport_silken_hush.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in gear that enhances mobility, making Silken Hush a natural fit for their inventory.
rogueport_silken_hush.shippingDetail: Delivered by Lakitu Drones within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The wearer moves more than 30 feet or takes an action that generates sound, or when the wearer removes the garment or speaks.

rogueport_silken_hush.priceReason: This price reflects the rare materials and advanced weaving techniques required to produce Silken Hush.

rogueport_silken_mask_of_the_blood_owl.name: Silken Mask of the Blood Owl
rogueport_silken_mask_of_the_blood_owl.description: The Silken Mask of the Blood Owl is a hooded visage woven from threads of shadow and dried blood, once belonging to an owl that commanded the alleys of Rogueport. When donned in dim light, it grants the wearer temporary invisibility within a radius of ten feet, allowing for swift ambushes or stealthy movements. The mask also emits a chilling aura that instills fear into nearby foes, causing them to falter and deal 1d6 damage upon their next action.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Veil
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer becomes invisible in dimly lit areas for 1 minute, with a range of ten feet around them. This effect ends if the wearer moves more than 10 feet or attacks.

effectDetails.title: Owl's Chill
effectDetails.rules: Activates whenever the wearer is within stealth and targets an enemy. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw against fear, taking 1d6 damage on a failed save. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

rogueport_silken_mask_of_the_blood_owl.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to wield effectively in combat.
rogueport_silken_mask_of_the_blood_owl.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its underworld secrets and this mask aligns with their inventory of arcane artifacts.
rogueport_silken_mask_of_the_blood_owl.shippingDetail: Delivered via shadow courier, ensuring secrecy and quick delivery within the city limits.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Shadow Veil; reaction or action for Owl's Chill.
usage.duration: 1 minute for Shadow Veil, until the next save for Owl's Chill.
usage.endsWhen: Ends if moved more than ten feet or attacked while active.
usage.charges: Recharges after a short or long rest.

rogueport_silken_mask_of_the_blood_owl.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare and powerful utility in stealth and combat.

rogueport_silken_scarab.name: Silken Scarab of the Silent Cartel
rogueport_silken_scarab.description: The Silken Scarab of the Silent Cartel is a polished obsidian beetle encased in plush velvet, said to have been smuggled from a vault beneath the moon. When worn, it grants the wearer immunity to charm and suggestion spells, effectively silencing the whispers of secrets that would otherwise be heard by foes. Its velvety texture subtly shifts colors with each passing hour, hinting at the cartel's ever-changing schemes.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Charm
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to all charm and suggestion effects. This immunity persists as long as the scarab is worn. Saving throws against such spells are not required.

effectDetails.title: Silenced Secrets
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 30 feet of the wearer have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and Investigation rolls to discern secrets from whispers. This effect lasts for 1 hour, or until the scarab is removed.

rogueport_silken_scarab.levelRequirementReason: The Silken Scarab's complexity requires a minimum of two character levels to wear it effectively.
rogueport_silken_scarab.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in items that enhance one's stealth and survival, making the Silken Scarab a perfect fit for their inventory.
rogueport_silken_scarab.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, this scarab arrives within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until removed
usage.endsWhen: Worn off the body or when removed

rogueport_silken_scarab.priceReason: The scarab's rarity and unique properties justify its price, offering significant strategic advantages without unbalancing the game.

rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_gutter.name: Silken Scarf of the Gutter
rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_gutter.description: The Silken Scarf of the Gutter is a luxurious, shimmering scarf woven from stolen silk and cursed threads, its fabric whisper-soft but imbued with malevolent intent. It allows the wearer to move silently through alleyways, leaving barely a sound, and grants them an eerie ability to bypass traps on their first approach. The scarf's threads hum with dark magic, making the wearer nearly invisible in dim light conditions.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Masterpiece
effectDetails.rules: The Silken Scarf of the Gutter grants a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect is active as long as you are wearing it and within dim light or darkness. It does not expend charges but can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Trap Bypass
effectDetails.rules: When you first approach a trap, there is a 30% chance that the trap will fail to activate due to the scarf's dark magic. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges but can only be used once per long rest.

rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_gutter.levelRequirementReason: The scarf's cursed threads require a proficient rogue to channel its malevolent power effectively.
rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_gutter.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for trading in the most unique and dangerous items, including those with dark origins such as this scarf.
rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_gutter.shippingDetail: The scarf arrives rolled tightly to preserve its form, and the delivery takes a week due to the item's fragile nature.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated by wearing the scarf in dim light or darkness.
usage.duration: Active until removed or until you take a short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you remove it, at the start of your next long rest, or if the item is destroyed.

rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_gutter.priceReason: The scarf's rarity and unique properties make it a valuable, yet not overpowered, addition to any rogue's arsenal.

rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_scarred.name: Silken Scarf of the Scarred
rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_scarred.description: The Silken Scarf of the Scarred, woven from the threads of fallen assassins and smuggled silk, is a haunting relic that cloaks its wearer in invisibility within dim or shadowed environs. Its faint whisper carries the echo of your last kill, a macabre reminder of each deed. The scarf's fabric is both light as air and strong as steel, yet it bears the weight of countless lives lost to its weave.
effects: Invisibility in Dim or Shadowed Environments

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes invisible within dim light, shadow, or darkness. This effect lasts for 1 minute and requires a bonus action to activate. The scarf can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: +5% stealth check success on rolls made in dim light or shadowed areas. This benefit is permanent, but the wearer must have at least 10 feet of cover or darkness to gain its full effect.

rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_scarred.levelRequirementReason: The scarf's inherent darkness and the haunting echo require a seasoned rogue with experience in shadowplay.
rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_scarred.vendorReason: Rogueport, known for its trade in rare relics and illicit goods, naturally sells this macabre artifact.
rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_scarred.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost discretion by Lakitu Drones, ensuring the scarf arrives undetected to its recipient.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the user uses their action on another task or when they leave a dimly lit area.

rogueport_silken_scarf_of_the_scarred.priceReason: The scarf's rarity, the whispers it carries, and its limited daily usage justify its moderate price.

rogueport_silken_scuttle.name: Silken Scuttle
rogueport_silken_scuttle.description: The Silken Scuttle is a delicate, shimmering silk cord that weaves through shadows like a ghostly thread. Its weave is infused with the stolen venom of nightshade spiders, making it both deadly and dexterous. In moonlit nights, it glows faintly, revealing hidden paths and guiding you unseen through perilous terrain. A relic from the shadowy alleys of Rogueport, this cord is as much an art form as a weapon, perfect for binding foes with grace or slipping away without a sound.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you are in shadows and take the Hide action, you benefit from a +15% chance to succeed. This effect lasts until your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Disarm on Hit
effectDetails.rules: If you hit an enemy with this cord while making an attack roll, there is a 30% chance (DC 14 Dexterity save) that the target is disarmed. This effect can be used once per long rest.

rogueport_silken_scuttle.levelRequirementReason: The Silken Scuttle's delicate construction and venom-infused strength make it accessible to lower-level rogues who are still learning their craft.
rogueport_silken_scuttle.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its intricate silk weaves and the city's artisans' expertise with dangerous poisons, making them perfect purveyors of this deadly yet elegant tool.
rogueport_silken_scuttle.shippingDetail: The Silken Scuttle is carefully packed in a shadowed box to maintain its potency. Shipping times are expedited, ensuring it arrives at your doorstep as fresh and lethal as the day it was made.

usage.activation: As a bonus action or on hit
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Stealth Boost; once per long rest for Disarm on Hit
usage.endsWhen: Used up or when you take a short or long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

rogueport_silken_scuttle.priceReason: The Silken Scuttle's rarity and the expertise required to create it justify its moderate price in experience points.

rogueport_silken_sleeve.name: Silken Sleeve of the Whispering Shadow
rogueport_silken_sleeve.description: The Silken Sleeve of the Whispering Shadow is a meticulously crafted piece of armor that encases one arm, muffling all sounds within a five-foot radius. It whispers secrets only to the wearer's trained ear, leaving behind an imperceptible inked trace on their skin. This sleeve is not merely a tool for stealth; it is a whisper from the shadows itself, woven with threads of ancient lore and shadow magic.

effectDetails.title: Sound Suppression
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Mutes all sounds within a 5-foot radius for 1 minute, or until the wearer speaks, takes damage, or moves more than 10 feet away from the sleeve.

effectDetails.title: Inked Whisper Residue
effectDetails.rules: Leaves behind an imperceptible inked trace on the wearer's skin that can be detected by trained ears with a successful DC 15 Perception check. The effect ends after 24 hours or when washed off.

rogueport_silken_sleeve.levelRequirementReason: This sleeve is crafted for versatility, suitable even to low-level rogues who need an edge in stealth.
rogueport_silken_sleeve.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in gear that enhances the capabilities of its patrons, making this sleeve a perfect fit.
rogueport_silken_sleeve.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days via Pipe Express's top-secret delivery routes.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; mutes sounds for 1 minute or until the wearer moves more than 10 feet away.
usage.duration: 1 minute, or until the wearer speaks, takes damage, or moves more than 10 feet away.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer speaks, takes damage, or moves more than 10 feet away from the sleeve.

rogueport_silken_sleeve.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its utility and moderate magical properties without overbalancing.

rogueport_silken_thief_satchel.name: Silken Thief Satchel
rogueport_silken_thief_satchel.description: The Silken Thief Satchel, crafted from midnight silk and hidden alloy, whispers secrets in the dark with its faint luminescence. It seamlessly blends into any crowd, granting the user a +2 bonus to Deception checks for 5 minutes when activated. When emptied, it leaves no trace of its contents, ensuring that even the most meticulous investigation yields nothing amiss. This pouch can carry five times more than a normal satchel without adding bulk.

effectDetails.title: Disguise
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Silken Thief Satchel grants you advantage on Deception checks for up to 5 minutes. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or when it is used again.

effectDetails.title: No Trace
effectDetails.rules: When emptied of contents and used as a bonus action, the satchel ensures that no trace remains of its past use, making it invaluable for espionage and stealth operations. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges; however, it can only be used once per long rest.

rogueport_silken_thief_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The Silken Thief Satchel requires a minimum level of 1 to ensure that even novice rogues have the opportunity to use its unique abilities.
rogueport_silken_thief_satchel.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its extensive network and expertise in distributing items tailored for thieves and spies, making it an ideal vendor for this satchel.
rogueport_silken_thief_satchel.shippingDetail: The Silken Thief Satchel is delivered via Shadowrunner Express, ensuring swift and discreet delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: 5 minutes for Disguise; instantaneous for No Trace
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or re-use

rogueport_silken_thief_satchel.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's utility in espionage and stealth, making it a worthwhile investment for level 1 characters.

rogueport_silken_vault_key.name: Velvet Vault Key
rogueport_silken_vault_key.description: The Velvet Vault Key is a delicate artifact carved from stolen ceremonial wax. It opens one hidden vault beneath the Old Clocktower with perfect precision, granting access to treasures sealed long ago. For five minutes thereafter, you are immune to the effects of traps, as the key's enchantment neutralizes their triggers. However, this very key leaves behind an iridescent scent trail that can be tracked by any creature with a sense of smell sharp enough to detect it.

effectDetails.title: Vault Access
effectDetails.rules: Activation: Standard action. Duration: Instantaneous. Range: Touch. This effect is used up when the key is inserted into a vault lock and successfully opens it.

effectDetails.title: Trapper's Blindness
effectDetails.rules: Activation: Passive immunity. Duration: 5 minutes. Ends When: The duration expires, or you are exposed to another trap. Save DC: 14 (Wisdom saving throw). Requires a successful save to end the effect early.

rogueport_silken_vault_key.levelRequirementReason: The key's enchantment is subtle and requires no extraordinary skill to wield.
rogueport_silken_vault_key.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in items that aid thieves and explorers, making the Velvet Vault Key a perfect fit for their inventory.
rogueport_silken_vault_key.shippingDetail: The key is delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring it arrives intact and ready to use before your next session.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for opening the vault, passive immunity lasts for five minutes
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or you are exposed to a trap requiring detection

rogueport_silken_vault_key.priceReason: The key's rarity and unique properties justify its fair value of 1000 XP.

rogueport_silver_blood_tattoo.name: Silver Blood Tattoo
rogueport_silver_blood_tattoo.description: The Silver Blood Tattoo is a cursed ink that seeps into your skin, granting you temporary invisibility in dim light. For 30 minutes, foes are left with only a faint afterimage as you slip past their notice. The tattoo leaves behind a lingering chill, making the air around you seem colder than usual. This shadowy relic is perfect for those who wish to bypass security without being seen or felt.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility in Dim Light
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can become invisible for up to 30 minutes. This effect ends early if the wearer takes any damage or when they attack someone or something. The tattoo grants a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks during this time.

effectDetails.title: Cold Aura
effectDetails.rules: The tattoo creates an area of cold air around you, reducing the speed of all creatures within 10 feet by 20%. This effect lasts for 30 minutes and ends when the wearer takes damage or moves out of the area. No save is required to resist this effect.

rogueport_silver_blood_tattoo.levelRequirementReason: The intricate design of the tattoo requires a certain skill in alchemy and stealth, making it suitable for characters who have reached at least fifth level.
rogueport_silver_blood_tattoo.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its extensive network of underground contacts and secret deals; selling such a specialized item fits their reputation.
rogueport_silver_blood_tattoo.shippingDetail: Pipe Express guarantees the safe delivery of the tattoo, ensuring it reaches its recipient in perfect condition within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and become invisible for up to 30 minutes.
usage.duration: Up to 30 minutes or until taking damage or attacking someone/something.
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage, attacking, or moving out of the cold aura area.

rogueport_silver_blood_tattoo.priceReason: The tattoo is priced at 1000 XP as it requires rare inks and a complex alchemical process to create, making it a valuable yet balanced addition to the character's arsenal.

rogueport_silver_scuttle.name: Silver Scuttle of the Broken Ledger
rogueport_silver_scuttle.description: The Silver Scuttle of the Broken Ledger is a diminutive, coin-shaped device with intricate engravings that emit a soft hum. When activated, it erases all digital traces of the user’s identity for precisely ten minutes, leaving no trace in the Ledger's records. The faint residual sound it emits can alert nearby enemies, adding an eerie echo to the silence it creates. After use, the device decays, rendering the user’s digital signature unstable for thirty seconds, making them a target for any lingering digital scrutiny.

effectDetails.title: Identity Erasure
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this device erases all digital traces of the user’s identity from the Ledger for ten minutes. It has no save DC and is instantaneous in effect.

effectDetails.title: Echo
effectDetails.rules: Leaves a faint residual sound that can alert nearby enemies within 30 feet. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn, with a save DC of 12 to ignore it.

rogueport_silver_scuttle.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level, as it is designed for quick and discrete use by anyone needing anonymity.
rogueport_silver_scuttle.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in items that aid those who need to navigate the digital underworld discreetly.
rogueport_silver_scuttle.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express, known for its reliable and swift delivery through the city’s underground networks.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, effect lasts ten minutes
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or when used again

rogueport_silver_scuttle.priceReason: This price reflects the item’s rarity and its utility for those who need to maintain digital anonymity regularly.

rogueport_silver_silence.name: Silver Silence
rogueport_silver_silence.description: Silver Silence is a sleek, hand-carved dagger that whispers through the air like a ghost. Its blade is etched with ancient runes that resonate in silence when it moves. The dagger can be activated to create an 18-foot radius of deadened sound for 6 seconds, ensuring total stealth within its range. Should the hidden trigger be pressed, it unleashes a concentrated burst of smoke and a minor explosive force capable of stunning nearby foes for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Silence Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the dagger creates a 18-foot radius of silence that lasts for 6 seconds. All noise within this area is deadened to inaudible levels. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Burst
effectDetails.rules: The hidden trigger can be pressed once every long rest, creating a burst of smoke and force that deals 1d6 thunder damage within a 20-foot radius centered on the user. This effect stuns all creatures in the area for 1 round if they fail a DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

rogueport_silver_silence.levelRequirementReason: The dagger's activation requires no specific proficiency or skill, making it accessible to all characters.
rogueport_silver_silence.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its extensive supply of stealth and combat equipment tailored for rogues and assassins.
rogueport_silver_silence.shippingDetail: Ships discreetly, ensuring the dagger arrives in mint condition within a day.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action to activate the silence aura. The explosive burst can be triggered once per long rest.
usage.duration: The silence aura lasts for 6 seconds and ends when its duration expires.
usage.endsWhen: The user reactivates it or completes a short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, with the explosive burst being usable once per long rest.

rogueport_silver_silence.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique combination of stealth and combat utility without overshadowing other equipment options.

rogueport_silver_tongue_ink.name: Silver Tongue Ink
rogueport_silver_tongue_ink.description: Silver Tongue Ink is a shimmering liquid that, when applied to your lips, transforms your speech into a whisper of secrets. It can make even the most guarded guardsmen falter under its spell with their own lies or taunts. The ink's essence reveals hidden truths if used deceitfully, causing the speaker to blush and stammer for 1d4 rounds as they grapple with the shame. Dissolves after 30 seconds of use.
effects: Voice modulation: whispers, lies, or taunts

effectDetails.title: Voice Modulation
effectDetails.rules: Activates on application to the lips. Lasts for 30 seconds unless interrupted by an action from the target. A successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw ends its effect early.

effectDetails.title: Truth Reveal
effectDetails.rules: If used deceptively, the speaker must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma (Deception) check or become temporarily embarrassed and blushed for 1d4 rounds. The truth of what was said is revealed to all within hearing range.

rogueport_silver_tongue_ink.levelRequirementReason: This ink is accessible to low-level characters who may find it useful in their earliest adventuring endeavors.
rogueport_silver_tongue_ink.vendorReason: Rogueport's extensive network of spies and informants ensures they have access to such specialized items as the Silver Tongue Ink.
rogueport_silver_tongue_ink.shippingDetail: Delivered by a stealthy courier, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition without arousing suspicion.

usage.activation: Apply to lips as an action
usage.duration: 30 seconds or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Used deceptively, or if the user takes an action against their will

rogueport_silver_tongue_ink.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its utility in tricky social situations without being overpowered.

rogueport_silver_tongue_vial.name: Silver Tongue Vial
rogueport_silver_tongue_vial.description: The Silver Tongue Vial is a sleek, glass phial containing a shimmering liquid that whispers of truth and deceit. When consumed, it grants perfect eloquence and the power to charm any audience, turning words into silver threads that weave through the air. This vial temporarily silences dissent in negotiations and bestows immunity to truth-telling checks for 30 minutes, leaving you the master of your tongue until its effects fade.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the vial grants a +15 bonus to Persuasion checks for 30 minutes. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Truth-Telling Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The user gains immunity to truth-telling checks for 30 minutes after consuming the vial. This immunity lasts until the end of their next long rest, preventing any spells or abilities that would otherwise compel them to speak the truth.

rogueport_silver_tongue_vial.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 5 to handle the mental strain of perfect eloquence and the ethical implications of using such a potent tool.
rogueport_silver_tongue_vial.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for their extensive network of spies, negotiators, and tricksters who frequently require tools that can manipulate situations in their favor.
rogueport_silver_tongue_vial.shippingDetail: Due to the nature-sensitive properties of the vial, it must be shipped within a temperature-controlled container to ensure its potency remains intact.

usage.duration: 30 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of the user's next long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

rogueport_silver_tongue_vial.priceReason: The vial is priced at 1000 XP as it represents a rare and powerful tool that can significantly alter interactions in social situations.

rogueport_silvered_tongue.name: Silvered Tongue
rogueport_silvered_tongue.description: The Silvered Tongue is a rare artifact with a faint metallic sheen that whispers secrets of its past. Crafted from an ancient mob boss's tongue, it grants temporary silence and persuasive power to those who wield it. When activated, all ambient noise around the user ceases for 15 seconds, allowing for silent passage through crowded areas. Its bluffing aura increases the likelihood of successful persuasion checks by a convincing +40%, making it invaluable in diplomatic or criminal endeavors.

effectDetails.title: Silent Whisper
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. All ambient noise around the user ceases for 15 seconds, providing total silence within a 10-foot radius. This effect ends if the user takes any action that generates sound or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Persuasive Charm
effectDetails.rules: Grants +40 to Persuasion checks for the duration of one short rest, after which the bonus is lost. This effect cannot be used more than once per long rest.

rogueport_silvered_tongue.levelRequirementReason: A basic rogue can utilize this artifact without advanced training.
rogueport_silvered_tongue.vendorReason: Rogueport specializes in the trade of rare artifacts and equipment for rogues and thieves.
rogueport_silvered_tongue.shippingDetail: Delivered by a rakasha courier within 3 days, ensuring discreet transport.

usage.duration: 15 seconds
usage.endsWhen: User takes any action that generates sound or at the end of its duration

rogueport_silvered_tongue.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare artifact providing significant but not game-breaking benefits.

rogueport_siren_sigh_torch.name: Siren Sigh Torch
rogueport_siren_sigh_torch.description: The Siren Sigh Torch, a twisted and haunting artifact forged from the forgotten bones of ancient shipwrecks, emits an eerie melody that can disorient foes in its immediate vicinity. The torch's flame dances with the ghostly echoes of past tragedies, making it ideal for stealthy ambushes in narrow alleys. Once ignited, the Siren Sigh Torch burns steadily for 2 minutes before collapsing into ash, leaving behind a lingering echo that haunts the battlefield long after its use.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Melody
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the torch emits an eerie sound that disorients all creatures within 5 meters for 5 seconds. This effect can be resisted with a successful DC 13 Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Lingering Echo
effectDetails.rules: For 3 seconds after its use, any creature in the immediate area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid being affected by the haunting echoes. On a failed save, they are incapacitated for 1 round.

rogueport_siren_sigh_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Siren Sigh Torch requires at least 4th level to wield effectively due to its arcane and emotional resonance.
rogueport_siren_sigh_torch.vendorReason: Rogueport, known for its network of thieves and smugglers, regularly trades in rare and dangerous artifacts like the Siren Sigh Torch.
rogueport_siren_sigh_torch.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with a 2-day delivery time.

usage.duration: 1 round (30 seconds) per activation
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the torch is extinguished
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharges after a long rest

rogueport_siren_sigh_torch.priceReason: The Siren Sigh Torch's unique properties and the lore behind its creation justify a price of 1000 XP.

rogueport_siren_silencer.name: Siren Silencer of the Silent Choir
rogueport_siren_silencer.description: The Siren Silencer of the Silent Choir hums a low, soothing vibration as it quiets all ambient noise within its five-meter radius, creating an imperceptible barrier that renders nearby enemies less aggressive and more disoriented. Crafted from ancient, rune-carved glass, this device is said to have been found in a forgotten temple dedicated to the god of silence. Its whispering presence calms allies and disrupts traps and alarms reliant on sound.

effectDetails.title: Silence Field
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Silence Field within a five-meter radius becomes completely silent. This effect lasts for one minute or until a creature in the area makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) with advantage if it is an enemy. The field has no effect on creatures who succeed on their save.

effectDetails.title: Calm Aura
effectDetails.rules: All friendly creatures within ten feet of the Siren Silencer gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened and have resistance to fear effects for one minute, or until they leave the area. This effect is instantaneous upon activation and ends when the creature leaves the ten-foot radius.

rogueport_siren_silencer.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 6 to operate this device effectively in combat.
rogueport_siren_silencer.vendorReason: Rogueport is known for its connections with underground artisans and smugglers, making it the perfect vendor for such a clandestine item.
rogueport_siren_silencer.shippingDetail: Ships discreetly using Koopa Postal's standard courier service, ensuring quick delivery without drawing unwanted attention.

usage.duration: One minute or until a creature in the area makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) with advantage if it is an enemy
usage.endsWhen: A creature within the effect's radius successfully saves against the Silence Field or leaves the area.

rogueport_siren_silencer.priceReason: The Siren Silencer's rarity and unique properties justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

rogueport_sneak_suit.name: Sneak Suit
rogueport_sneak_suit.description: The Rogueport Sneak Suit is a sleek, shadow-hued leather trench coat lined with soft, silent padding and embedded with heat-sensing tech that subtly warms to blend into ambient temperatures. This suit allows you to move undetected for short bursts while blending seamlessly into the shadows, making you nearly invisible to all but the most discerning eyes. Its silent padding reduces noise by 50%, ensuring your movements are as quiet as a whisper in the night.

effectDetails.title: Bleed Into Shadows
