usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

rusted_starman.priceReason: The Rusted Starman's price reflects its rarity and the risk it poses to the user, making it a valuable yet potentially dangerous tool for adventurers.

rusty_dwarven_lockpick_set.name: Rusty Dwarven Lockpick Set
rusty_dwarven_lockpick_set.description: The Rusty Dwarven Lockpick Set is a set of ancient picks forged in a long-lost dwarven armory. The metal is worn from centuries of use, yet the craftsmanship remains unmatched. These picks emit a faint glow when near trapped doors and are renowned for their ability to open mundane locks with ease. However, they break on a natural roll of 1 but can be repaired at any blacksmith shop for 50 gold pieces.

effectDetails.title: Mundane Lock Opening
effectDetails.rules: When used to open a mundane lock (DC 15 or lower), the user gains advantage on Sleight of Hand checks. The lockpick set can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Repairable
effectDetails.rules: If broken, it can be repaired at any blacksmith shop for 50 gold pieces and can only be used again after a long rest.

rusty_dwarven_lockpick_set.levelRequirementReason: The set is crafted to be usable by anyone with basic locksmithing skills.
rusty_dwarven_lockpick_set.vendorReason: The Undermountain Trader has connections with various blacksmiths and sells a wide range of equipment, including this rare dwarven set.
rusty_dwarven_lockpick_set.shippingDetail: Ships via the Mail Cart Courier, ensuring safe arrival within a week.

usage.activation: As a bonus action during an attempt to open a mundane lock.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the lock is opened or the check fails.
usage.endsWhen: The lock opens successfully or the user fails the Sleight of Hand check.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, but only once per short rest.

rusty_dwarven_lockpick_set.priceReason: The set's rarity and unique crafting make it a valuable tool for adventurers needing to bypass mundane locks quickly.

rusty_sword_sharpening_stone.name: Rusty Sword Sharpening Stone
rusty_sword_sharpening_stone.description: The Rusty Sword Sharpening Stone is a weathered tool crafted from ancient iron and imbued with the spirits of forgotten bladesmiths. It honours its humble origins, yet remains a formidable aid to any warrior. When applied to a weapon, it grants +1 bonus to attack rolls for 1 hour but beware, if left too long in the stone's embrace, your blade may succumb to a minor rust, reducing all damage dealt by one die size until cleaned.

effectDetails.title: Sharpening Edge
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. The target weapon gains +1 to attack rolls for the next hour. This effect can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Rust Hazard
effectDetails.rules: If not cleaned within 24 hours, there is a 10% chance that the weapon gains minor rust (disadvantage on all damage rolls until cleaned).

rusty_sword_sharpening_stone.levelRequirementReason: This stone requires no specific level as it is designed to assist any warrior in need of sharpening their blade.
rusty_sword_sharpening_stone.vendorReason: Blacksmiths Scrap are renowned for their expertise in weapons and tools, making them the perfect vendor for such an item.
rusty_sword_sharpening_stone.shippingDetail: Carefully packed to prevent further rusting during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour.
usage.endsWhen: The buff ends when the time expires or if the weapon gains minor rust.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can be used only once per day.

rusty_sword_sharpening_stone.priceReason: This price reflects a balanced cost for an item that requires daily maintenance and provides significant combat utility.

saddle_arabia_caravan_guide_service.name: Saddle Arabia Caravan Guide Service
saddle_arabia_caravan_guide_service.description: The Saddle Arabia Caravan Guide Service is a finely crafted leather harness adorned with intricate brass fittings and etched with ancient Arabian symbols. Crafted by the nomadic tribes of the desert, it ensures safe passage through treacherous dunes. When worn, it provides expert guidance, ensuring you avoid deadly sandstorms and navigate with precision. Each week, the guide can heal 1d4 points of damage with a single dose of camel dates, a fruit that restores vitality in the arid lands.

effectDetails.title: Avoidsandstorms
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this saddle, you gain a +2 bonus to Survival checks made to avoid sandstorms in desert environments. This effect lasts for one week.

effectDetails.title: Healing Camel Dates
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the guide can provide you with a single dose of camel dates that restores 1d4 hit points. This effect heals you instantaneously upon consumption.

saddle_arabia_caravan_guide_service.levelRequirementReason: This saddle is designed for travelers and adventurers starting their journey, providing essential desert navigation skills.
saddle_arabia_caravan_guide_service.vendorReason: The Saddle Arabia Bazaar specializes in goods crafted by the nomadic tribes of the Arabian deserts, ensuring authenticity and quality.
saddle_arabia_caravan_guide_service.shippingDetail: Ships via a traditional camel caravan, which can take up to one week depending on desert conditions.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required for guidance or healing fruit.
usage.duration: One week and instantaneous, respectively.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire after the stated duration without further use.

saddle_arabia_caravan_guide_service.priceReason: This saddle is crafted with expertise and materials that make it both functional and durable for desert travel.

saddle_arabia_date_palm_cookies_recipe.name: Recipe: Saddle Arabia Date Palm Cookies
saddle_arabia_date_palm_cookies_recipe.description: The Saddle Arabia Date Palm Cookies are a desert delicacy crafted by Arabian Bakers, their chewy exterior and rich date-filled core providing sustenance for long journeys. These cookies are not just a snack but a survival tool, enhancing your endurance in heat with +5 ft speed while also healing you of 1d4 hit points from dehydration. Camels themselves have been known to nudge these treats out of sheer appreciation.

effectDetails.title: Desert Endurance
effectDetails.rules: Eating one cookie grants you a +5 foot speed increase for the duration of your next long rest. This effect is limited to once per day.

effectDetails.title: Dehydration Healing
effectDetails.rules: Consume this cookie within 1 hour of experiencing dehydration symptoms, and regain 1d4 hit points. This effect can only be used once every 24 hours.

saddle_arabia_date_palm_cookies_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Even the most novice traveler can benefit from these cookies' desert survival skills.
saddle_arabia_date_palm_cookies_recipe.vendorReason: The Saddle Arabia Oasis is renowned for its expertise in crafting foods that sustain travelers through harsh conditions.
saddle_arabia_date_palm_cookies_recipe.shippingDetail: The cookies are shipped fresh, wrapped in palm leaves to maintain their freshness and flavor.

usage.activation: Eat one cookie as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Until your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Once per day, after the duration of Desert Endurance ends.

saddle_arabia_date_palm_cookies_recipe.priceReason: The rare ingredients and artisanal craftsmanship contribute to this balanced price point.

saddle_arabia_date_palm_presser.name: Saddle Arabia Date Palm Presser
saddle_arabia_date_palm_presser.description: The Saddle Arabia Date Palm Presser is a handcrafted saddle designed for Arabian camels. Its body is made of sturdy palm wood, inlaid with silver detailing that captures the essence of desert craftsmanship. This press not only extracts sweet date syrup but also enhances any cooking task involving sweets or pastries, granting advantage on such rolls and increasing recipe yields by one serving. The wood retains its sticky residue, requiring oil for cleaning after use.

effectDetails.title: Sweet Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When used to prepare a sweet dish or ingredient, the user gains advantage on the relevant ability check.

effectDetails.title: Increased Yield
effectDetails.rules: Using this press increases the yield of date syrup by one serving. This effect is limited to once per day.

saddle_arabia_date_palm_presser.levelRequirementReason: This saddle is designed for beginners and travelers, making it accessible to all adventurers.
saddle_arabia_date_palm_presser.vendorReason: Saddle Arabia Oasis specializes in exotic Arabian goods, including this culturally rich presser.
saddle_arabia_date_palm_presser.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via camel caravan, ensuring the item arrives fresh and ready for use.

usage.activation: Used as an action to extract syrup or prepare a sweet dish.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; advantage lasts until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day.

saddle_arabia_date_palm_presser.priceReason: The craftsmanship and unique functionality justify this balanced price point for an uncommon item.

saddle_arabia_date_pitter.name: Saddle Arabia Date Pitter
saddle_arabia_date_pitter.description: The Saddle Arabia Date Pitter is a finely crafted saddle adorned with delicate pitting tools that allow for the precise creation of perfectly pit dates. The saddle's leather, softened by centuries of use in the desert, whispers tales of ancient Bedouin traditions. Crafted by the skilled artisans of Saddle Arabia, it not only aids in the culinary perfection of dates but also allows you to pit olives and cherries with ease. This saddle is a symbol of expertise and precision, granting those who ride it an innate knowledge of date lore.

effectDetails.title: Perfect Pit Dates
effectDetails.rules: When used to pit dates, the Saddle Arabia Date Pitter grants you advantage on any check related to culinary precision. This effect lasts for one hour after use and requires no specific action.

effectDetails.title: Versatile Pitting
effectDetails.rules: With a minor action, the saddle can also pit olives or cherries with equal proficiency as it does dates. This versatility allows you to prepare a wider variety of dishes without needing additional tools.

saddle_arabia_date_pitter.levelRequirementReason: Beginners and seasoned travelers alike find this saddle useful for its precise pitting abilities.
saddle_arabia_date_pitter.vendorReason: Saddle Arabia is renowned for their expertise in crafting saddles that enhance daily tasks, making the Date Pitter a perfect addition to their offerings.
saddle_arabia_date_pitter.shippingDetail: The saddle is shipped by camel caravan, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition after a two-week journey across the desert. The delivery includes instructions on how to care for the saddle's unique leather finish.

usage.activation: Minor action (to pit dates or olives/cherries) and passive effect while riding
usage.duration: One hour when pitting dates; instant for other fruits
usage.endsWhen: After one hour of use or when the saddle is no longer in contact with the fruit being pitted

saddle_arabia_date_pitter.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the saddle's utility and the craftsmanship required to create such a precision tool.

saddle_arabia_desert_compass.name: Saddle Arabia Desert Compass
saddle_arabia_desert_compass.description: The Saddle Arabia Desert Compass is a leather-bound compass with an etched map of the Arabian desert. Its needle always points towards the nearest oasis, ensuring travelers never stray too far from life-sustaining water in the harsh desert environment. Crafted by Saddle Arabia, this tool grants advantage on Survival checks made while navigating deserts and can also be used to detect the presence of underground water sources with a successful Wisdom (Survival) check.

effectDetails.title: Oasis Pointer
effectDetails.rules: The Saddle Arabia Desert Compass always points towards the nearest oasis. This effect is active during any time spent in a desert environment and does not require an action to use.

effectDetails.title: Survival Advantage
effectDetails.rules: While equipped, the user gains advantage on Survival checks made while navigating deserts. This effect lasts until the end of the user's next long rest.

saddle_arabia_desert_compass.levelRequirementReason: This compass is designed to be useful for all adventurers who might find themselves in a desert environment, requiring no specific character level.
saddle_arabia_desert_compass.vendorReason: Desert Traders Post specializes in supplies and tools essential for traversing the deserts of Arabia, making this compass one of their signature items.
saddle_arabia_desert_compass.shippingDetail: Ships via a camel caravan, ensuring safe delivery to even the remotest desert outposts within three weeks.

usage.duration: Until end of next long rest
usage.endsWhen: Long rest ends

saddle_arabia_desert_compass.priceReason: The price reflects the item's utility and rarity, providing a reliable tool for desert travel without being overly expensive.

saddle_arabia_desert_robe.name: Saddle Arabia Desert Robe
saddle_arabia_desert_robe.description: The Saddle Arabia Desert Robe is a loose, flowing garment crafted from camel-hair fibers by Arabian Weavers. It resists the scorching sands and harsh winds of the desert, its billowing fabric providing a natural shield against ranged attacks in the arid expanse. The robe's weave is so fine that it grants resistance to heat exhaustion and enhances your Constitution saving throws by +1 when you are in a desert environment.

effectDetails.title: Heat Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to heat damage while wearing the robe. Additionally, your Constitution saving throws against heat-related conditions are made with advantage.

effectDetails.title: Desert Savvy
effectDetails.rules: While in a desert environment, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws and can use a bonus action each day to cast the Shield spell (no material components required).

saddle_arabia_desert_robe.levelRequirementReason: The Saddle Arabia Desert Robe is designed for travelers and adventurers who frequently find themselves in desert environs.
saddle_arabia_desert_robe.vendorReason: Saddle Arabia Souk, a renowned shop specializing in desert gear, stocks the Saddle Arabia Desert Robe as one of its most popular items among travelers.
saddle_arabia_desert_robe.shippingDetail: The robe is rolled tightly and secured with protective sheaths to prevent damage during transportation by camel.

usage.duration: While the robe remains on you.
usage.endsWhen: Removing or damaging the robe ends the effects.

saddle_arabia_desert_robe.priceReason: The Saddle Arabia Desert Robe is crafted with rare camel-hair fibers and intricate weaving techniques, making it a valuable yet balanced item for adventurers.

saddle_arabia_recipe_date_and_camel_milk.name: Recipe: Saddle Arabia Date & Camel Milk Smoothie
saddle_arabia_recipe_date_and_camel_milk.description: The Recipe: Saddle Arabia Date & Camel Milk Smoothie is a potent elixir crafted from the sweetest dates and freshest camel milk, brewed in the heart of the desert by the skilled hands of the Saddle Arabia Oasis Bar. When consumed, it grants you an extra burst of speed, allowing you to navigate through scorching sands as if they were paved roads. The smoothie also quenches your thirst for a day and night, ensuring you can face the next leg of your journey without fear of dehydration.

effectDetails.title: Desert Sprint
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this recipe grants a +10 foot increase to your walking speed in desert terrain for 4 hours. This effect is instant upon consumption and lasts until the duration expires or you are no longer in a desert environment.

effectDetails.title: Thirstless
effectDetails.rules: For 24 hours after drinking this recipe, you do not need to drink water or eat food. The effects of dehydration are negated, allowing you to conserve resources for more critical needs.

saddle_arabia_recipe_date_and_camel_milk.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is suitable for adventurers of all levels who might encounter the harsh conditions of a desert.
saddle_arabia_recipe_date_and_camel_milk.vendorReason: Saddle Arabia Oasis Bar is renowned for its expertise in crafting nourishing and life-saving elixirs for weary travelers.
saddle_arabia_recipe_date_and_camel_milk.shippingDetail: The smoothie is shipped in sealed containers to ensure freshness, delivered by the swift and reliable Camel Caravan.

usage.duration: 4 hours in desert terrain; 24 hours of thirstlessness
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration expires or you leave a desert environment; effect ends if you consume another recipe

saddle_arabia_recipe_date_and_camel_milk.priceReason: The price reflects the rare ingredients and skilled craftsmanship required to brew this desert survival aid.

saddle_arabia_saddle_blanket.name: Saddle Arabia Saddle Blanket
saddle_arabia_saddle_blanket.description: This saddle blanket, woven with camel hair and adorned with intricate patterns that shimmer under the desert sun, is a masterpiece of Saddle Arabia craftsmanship. It not only provides comfort for your mount but also strengthens your bond, making you both feel at one with the vast sands. The blanket grants you advantage on saving throws against exhaustion from long travel and brings peace to your steed, granting advantage on Animal Handling checks while mounted.

effectDetails.title: Comfort and Bond
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against exhaustion from long travel. Additionally, your mount gains advantage on Animal Handling checks while you are mounted.

effectDetails.title: Travel Resilience
effectDetails.rules: The blanket provides a +1 status bonus to your Constitution saving throw whenever you spend a night in the desert. It can only be used once per day and recharges after 24 hours of non-use.

saddle_arabia_saddle_blanket.levelRequirementReason: This saddle blanket is designed for adventurers starting their journey, providing essential support without imposing a high-level prerequisite.
saddle_arabia_saddle_blanket.vendorReason: Saddle Arabia Weavers are renowned for their expertise in crafting gear that enhances both comfort and performance, especially suited for desert expeditions.
saddle_arabia_saddle_blanket.shippingDetail: Ships via the Camel Caravan, known for its swift and reliable delivery across deserts. Delivery time is approximately one week from Saddle Arabia's capital city.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; recharges after a day of non-use.
usage.endsWhen: Use ends when the blanket is not used for a full day or when expended during a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

saddle_arabia_saddle_blanket.priceReason: This saddle blanket offers significant benefits to adventurers, making it a valuable purchase despite its moderate price. Its craftsmanship and desert-specific utility justify this balanced cost in XP terms.

safe_house_rental.name: Safe House Rental (1 Month)
safe_house_rental.description: The Safe House Rental (1 Month) offers a secure, hidden refuge in the heart of Rogueport's shadowy alleys. This well-constructed dwelling is equipped with defensive wards that prevent scrying and detection, ensuring your privacy remains intact. Two secret exits lead to different districts, providing you with swift escape routes should the need arise. Monthly supplies are included, covering essentials like food, water, and basic medicines, allowing you to focus on other matters without worry.

effectDetails.title: Defensive Wards
effectDetails.rules: The rental is protected by defensive wards that prevent scrying and detection. These wards last for the duration of the month-long lease (30 days). The effect does not end unless the house is vacated or the wards are manually deactivated.

effectDetails.title: Secret Exits
effectDetails.rules: The property features two secret exits leading to different districts within Rogueport. These exits can be used once per day for a quick escape, with no need for an action or bonus action to activate them. The effect is instantaneous and ends when the district is left.

safe_house_rental.levelRequirementReason: This rental is suitable for adventurers of all levels but requires basic knowledge of Rogueport's layout.
safe_house_rental.vendorReason: The Black Market deals in unique and covert services, including this secure and anonymous lodging option.
safe_house_rental.shippingDetail: The keys are delivered directly to your specified location within Rogueport, ensuring a smooth transition into the rental without drawing attention.

usage.duration: 30 days for defensive wards; instantaneous for secret exits
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the district via secret exit or vacating the house

safe_house_rental.priceReason: The price reflects a balance between the secure nature of the lodging and the convenience of having two secret exits, all included in one month.

safety_goggles.name: Safety Goggles
safety_goggles.description: These Safety Goggles, crafted by Professor E. Gadd himself, are more than just a fashion statement—they're a practical necessity for any adventurer who's been through the Dusty Caverns of Toad Town. They protect your eyes from the blinding sandstorms, and their sleek, oversized frames make you look like a true scholar of the arcane. The goggles hum gently as they filter out harmful particles, ensuring you see clearly even in the worst conditions.

effectDetails.title: Blindness Resistance
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate these goggles to grant yourself immunity to blindness from dust and sand for 1 hour. The goggles filter out harmful particles, but they do not protect against other forms of blindness or damage.

effectDetails.title: Nerdy Chic
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Safety Goggles, you gain a +2 bonus to your Charisma (Performance) checks and saving throws while using them in public. This effect lasts until you remove the goggles.

safety_goggles.levelRequirementReason: These goggles are designed for adventurers who frequently explore dusty environments or engage in scholarly activities, making level 1 a reasonable requirement.
safety_goggles.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in gear and equipment that help adventurers navigate its dangerous landscapes, including the dust storms that plague the area.
safety_goggles.shippingDetail: Goggles are shipped via Case Express within 3 days of purchase. Shipping is free for this item due to its delicate nature.

usage.duration: 1 hour, or until removed by the wearer
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you remove the goggles or they break.

safety_goggles.priceReason: The goggles are priced at 1000 XP due to their utility in hazardous environments, their unique design, and the expertise required for their crafting.

safety_ring.name: Safety Ring
safety_ring.description: The Safety Ring is a simple yet sturdy band made of polished steel and adorned with an etched rune. It whispers promises of protection, shielding its wearer from the whims of fate. This ring guarantees immunity to status effects such as poison and paralysis, ensuring your survival in even the most treacherous circumstances. Its origin lies in ancient alchemical lore, crafted by a long-forgotten guild dedicated to safeguarding adventurers.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Status Effects
effectDetails.rules: The wearer is immune to all non-magical status effects, including poison and paralysis. This immunity lasts for the duration of a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Immune to Poison and Paralysis
effectDetails.rules: This ring grants its owner immunity to being poisoned or paralyzed by any means, magical or otherwise, as long as they are not under the effect of a spell that specifically targets this immunity.

safety_ring.levelRequirementReason: The Safety Ring requires no level prerequisite for wearers, as it is designed to be accessible to all adventurers.
safety_ring.vendorReason: The Shamans' Hut specializes in items that enhance the resilience of adventurers, making this ring a fitting addition to their offerings.
safety_ring.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost care and insured for safe arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next short rest
usage.endsWhen: The wearer completes a short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on completion of a short rest

safety_ring.priceReason: The Safety Ring is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its legendary status and the alchemical resources required for its creation.

samus_arm_cannon.name: Arm Cannon Replica
samus_arm_cannon.description: The Arm Cannon Replica is a hulking, battle-worn weapon forged from salvaged parts and experimental tech. Its barrel glows with an eerie blue light when in use, and the grip feels warm to the touch—a testament to its forgeheart core. Crafted by the eccentric inventor Wario Direct himself, this cannon can unleash both forceful blasts and explosive missiles, making it a versatile tool for any adventurer seeking to carve their name into the annals of battle.

effectDetails.title: Force Blast
effectDetails.rules: The Arm Cannon Replica can be fired as an action, releasing a force blast with a range of 100 feet. This attack deals 3d6 force damage and has a save DC of 15.

effectDetails.title: Missile Salvo
effectDetails.rules: Activating the missile mode requires 2 uses per day. Each shot in this salvo deals 4d6 explosive damage with a range of 80 feet, and it has a save DC of 14.

samus_arm_cannon.levelRequirementReason: This weapon is designed for seasoned adventurers who can handle its complex mechanisms and powerful output.
samus_arm_cannon.vendorReason: Wario Direct personally oversees the sale of this item, ensuring it meets his high standards for quality and innovation.
samus_arm_cannon.shippingDetail: Ships via Tech Crate Express within 3 days, with a flat rate of $50 regardless of distance.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charges are expended or the item is destroyed

samus_arm_cannon.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and the cost of materials used in its construction, as well as its limited availability.

sapphire_frog_boots.name: Sapphire Frog Boots
sapphire_frog_boots.description: The Sapphire Frog Boots shimmer with a deep blue luster and webbed hemlines. Wearing these enchanted footwear, you feel amphibious, your movements precise and fluid as if nature itself has granted you its grace. These boots are said to have been crafted by the merfolk of the deep sea, their blue gemstones imbued with the essence of water. With each step, they leave a faint spray behind, hinting at the ancient magic that courses through them.

effectDetails.title: Aquatic Agility
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these boots, you gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed and have advantage on Acrobatics checks made in water. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Leap Across Water
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can leap across 60 feet of water as if it were solid ground. You must be standing in at least 1 foot of water for this ability to function. This effect is instantaneous and has no save DC or use limit.

sapphire_frog_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are crafted with complex enchantments that require a moderate level of magic to wield effectively.
sapphire_frog_boots.vendorReason: The sea seller, known for their deep connections with the ocean and its mysteries, is trusted by many adventurers seeking treasures from beneath the waves.
sapphire_frog_boots.shippingDetail: Delivered directly to your doorstep, waterproofed against any aquatic mishaps during transit.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn for 'Aquatic Agility'; instantaneous for 'Leap Across Water'.
usage.endsWhen: The effects wear off at the start of your next turn or when you exit water, respectively.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day; no need to recharge.

sapphire_frog_boots.priceReason: Balanced as a rare but not overpowered item, these boots offer significant utility at an appropriate price point for their rarity and power level.

sarasaland_desert_soul_torch.name: Desert Soul Torch
sarasaland_desert_soul_torch.description: The Desert Soul Torch is a golden-hued beacon that crackles with the spirit of ancient desert guardians. Its flame flickers with a primal energy, illuminating the arid sands for a full minute and casting an eerie glow over undead foes, dealing 1d6 radiant damage. While wielding it, travelers find themselves fleet of foot, their speed increasing by 10 feet when running through open terrain. The torch burns bright until its core crumbles after five uses, or if exposed to moonlight during use, causing a brief disorientation.

effectDetails.title: Illuminates and Damages Undead
effectDetails.rules: The Desert Soul Torch illuminates the area in a golden glow for one minute, dealing 1d6 radiant damage to undead creatures within 30 feet. The torch burns out after five uses or if exposed to moonlight during use.

effectDetails.title: Increases Running Speed
effectDetails.rules: While holding and using the Torch, your running speed increases by 10 feet for as long as you maintain the Torch's active duration of one minute. This effect ends when the torch burns out or if exposed to moonlight during use.

sarasaland_desert_soul_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Desert Soul Torch is accessible to adventurers with minimal experience.
sarasaland_desert_soul_torch.vendorReason: Sarasaland's extensive trade routes include the desert regions where these torches are forged, making them familiar with their creation and distribution.
sarasaland_desert_soul_torch.shippingDetail: Ships via Warp Whistle Transit within 3 days of purchase.

usage.activation: As a bonus action to light or relight the Torch.
usage.duration: One minute, recharges after five uses.
usage.endsWhen: Exposure to moonlight during use or after five uses.

sarasaland_desert_soul_torch.priceReason: The torch's unique crafting process and the mystical energy it contains justify its higher price.

sarasaland_dream_touched_glove.name: Dream Touched Glove
sarasaland_dream_touched_glove.description: Woven from the ethereal essence of Dream Land’s mischievous puffballs, this glove allows its wearer to manipulate dreamscapes through simple gestures. It grants temporary control over hallucinogenic fog within a 10-meter radius but risks trapping the user in a nightmare dimension if overused. Worn by the Shy Guys Union and delivered by Chain Chomp Courier with a note: “If you’re not afraid of your own mind, you’ll get it back.”
effects: Grants +2 to Perception checks against illusions

effectDetails.title: Dream Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can manipulate hallucinogenic fog within a 10-meter radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and requires concentration (ends if interrupted). The glove grants temporary control over the fog but risks trapping the user in a nightmare dimension if used excessively.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +2 bonus to Perception checks against illusions. This effect is always active while wearing the glove and does not require any action.

sarasaland_dream_touched_glove.levelRequirementReason: This item requires only level 1 to use, making it accessible for adventurers early in their journey.
sarasaland_dream_touched_glove.vendorReason: Sarasaland has a long-standing relationship with the mischievous puffballs of Dream Land and sells items that reflect this connection.
sarasaland_dream_touched_glove.shippingDetail: Expected delivery time is 3 days, but delays are common. The courier may require an additional Chain Chomp token as a tip.

usage.activation: Bonus action to manipulate fog; always active for illusion resistance
usage.duration: 1 minute with concentration (ends if interrupted); always active while worn
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends or wearer falls unconscious; always active when worn

sarasaland_dream_touched_glove.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its uncommon rarity and the unique properties that make it a valuable tool for early adventurers.

sarasaland_dusty_scepter.name: Dusty Scepter of the Fallen Sun
sarasaland_dusty_scepter.description: The Dusty Scepter of the Fallen Sun is a tarnished staff adorned with enigmatic carvings. Its surface glows faintly, casting an afterimage of a sun that has long since set. This relic grants its bearer +1 to Charisma checks when engaging in diplomacy and can deliver 1d4 psychic damage to any hostile creature within reach during regency parleys. The scepter's presence evokes the scent of old sand and forgotten crowns, whispering tales of lost glory.

effectDetails.title: Charismatic Diplomacy
effectDetails.rules: When used as part of a Charisma check during diplomacy, the wielder gains a +1 bonus. This effect lasts until the end of the encounter.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Stinger
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can make a melee attack against one hostile creature within 5 feet. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 psychic damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

sarasaland_dusty_scepter.levelRequirementReason: The relic's historical significance makes it accessible to lower-level characters with noble aspirations.
sarasaland_dusty_scepter.vendorReason: Sarasaland is known for its extensive collection of ancient and forgotten artifacts, including this dusty scepter.
sarasaland_dusty_scepter.shippingDetail: The scepter arrives encased in an ornate, protective sheath to preserve the artifact's integrity during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Charismatic Diplomacy; until the end of the encounter for Psychic Stinger
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wielder is incapacitated or the scepter is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per round

sarasaland_dusty_scepter.priceReason: The relic's historical value and unique abilities justify a fair price of 1000 XP.

sarasaland_furry_canteen.name: Furry Canteen of the Bowserite Nomads
sarasaland_furry_canteen.description: The Furry Canteen of the Bowserite Nomads is crafted from the hide of a once-loyal rat-tamer, imbued with the resilience of desert winds and the warmth of ancient oases. It keeps your drink steaming for ten minutes, and when consumed slowly, it restores 10 hit points. However, if gulped down too quickly, it causes 1d2 nausea. This canteen is a cherished relic among nomads, passed through generations to quench thirsts in the harshest of climates.

effectDetails.title: Restore Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: When consumed slowly over a minute, the canteen restores 10 hit points to the drinker. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Causes Nausea
effectDetails.rules: If consumed in less than half a minute, the drinker must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute due to nausea. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

sarasaland_furry_canteen.levelRequirementReason: This canteen is designed for adventurers just starting their journey, providing essential hydration and a touch of resilience.
sarasaland_furry_canteen.vendorReason: Sarasaland is known for its connection to desert nomads and travelers who value practical yet magical items like the Furry Canteen.
sarasaland_furry_canteen.shippingDetail: Ships via a spirit courier, arriving within one week of order placement.

usage.activation: Consume slowly over one minute or quickly in less than half a minute.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for hit point restoration; 1 minute of nausea if consumed too quickly.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the duration expires or the drinker successfully saves against nausea.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it refills with each use.

sarasaland_furry_canteen.priceReason: The canteen's rarity and magical properties, combined with its unique flavor profile and desert lore, justify this higher price in experience points.

sarasaland_glowing_scepter.name: Glowing Scepter of the Sunken Throne
sarasaland_glowing_scepter.description: The Glowing Scepter of the Sunken Throne pulses with an ancient, fiery light that dances along its ornate carvings. Crafted from sun-struck obsidian and lapis lazuli, it hums with the power of a dying star. Once wielded by the last royal sun-dragon of Sarasaland, this scepter grants brief bursts of radiant energy, both blinding foes and healing allies—though at a cost to its user’s vitality. Koopa nobles hid it beneath the sand to prevent the awakening of ancient sun-worshipers, repurposing it as a diplomatic tool for delicate negotiations.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Burst
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can cast Radiant Burst. This ability blinds all creatures within 30 feet of them for 1 round and deals 1d6 radiant damage to each one. The caster must have at least 20 hit points remaining or suffer a 10% temporary ability score drain (wisdom) as an immediate consequence.

effectDetails.title: Sacrificial Healing
effectDetails.rules: The wielder can gain temporary hit points equal to 1d4 + their proficiency bonus. This effect is only usable once per long rest and costs the user 5% of their total current hit points as a minor sacrifice.

sarasaland_glowing_scepter.levelRequirementReason: The scepter's ancient power demands a minimum level to wield it effectively without risk.
sarasaland_glowing_scepter.vendorReason: Sarasaland continues to honor the legacy of its sun-dragon heritage, and this relic is one such symbol of that history.
sarasaland_glowing_scepter.shippingDetail: Shipment via Koopa Postal includes a special protective case to ensure safe delivery from the deserts of Sarasaland.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until end of next turn)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target creature moves out of range or is no longer blinded by the radiant burst.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a long rest to regain temporary hit points.

sarasaland_glowing_scepter.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers powerful effects that require careful use and are not overpowered for a mid-level character.

sarasaland_golden_dream_bottle.name: Golden Dream Bottle
sarasaland_golden_dream_bottle.description: The Golden Dream Bottle is a crystal vessel adorned with intricate carvings that shimmer like molten gold. It purportedly captures the essence of Sarasaland's first sunrise, yet those who partake in its illusory contents find themselves ensnared by a dreamworld where deserts bloom with impossible flora and fauna. After three nights, the bottle emits whispers of forgotten lore, but the dreams it grants are ephemeral, leaving the drinker to forget their last 24 hours upon waking.

effectDetails.title: Dreamscapes of Forgotten Realms
effectDetails.rules: The user enters a dreamworld where deserts bloom with impossible flora and fauna. This effect lasts for one hour, during which the user is immune to fear and confusion. The duration ends when they wake up from their slumber.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Oblivion
effectDetails.rules: Upon awakening from the effects of the Golden Dream Bottle, the user forgets any events that transpired in the last 24 hours. This effect is instantaneous and cannot be resisted with a saving throw.

sarasaland_golden_dream_bottle.levelRequirementReason: The bottle's illusions are potent enough to affect even the most novice adventurers who lack the experience to resist them.
sarasaland_golden_dream_bottle.vendorReason: Sarasaland is renowned for its magical artifacts, and the Golden Dream Bottle is one of their most mysterious creations.
sarasaland_golden_dream_bottle.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with a two-day delivery time.

usage.activation: Consume the contents of the bottle as a bonus action.
usage.duration: One hour, ending when you wake up from your slumber.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you wake up after consuming its contents.

sarasaland_golden_dream_bottle.priceReason: The bottle is a legendary item crafted by the enigmatic Land Mordor, making it a rare and sought-after commodity among adventurers.

sarasaland_iron_bottle_bubble.name: Iron Bottle Bubble
sarasaland_iron_bottle_bubble.description: The Iron Bottle Bubble is a glass vial filled to the brim with liquid iron that resonates with an eerie hum, reminiscent of war drums echoing through the desert sands. It was smuggled by a desert merchant who claimed it could turn sand into gold—until it inexplicably turned him into a living sandworm, his voice now forever entombed within its depths. When consumed too quickly, the vial unleashes hallucinations of vast desert storms that can disorient even the most seasoned warriors.
effects: Grants temporary resistance to fire damage
Causes hallucinations when consumed too fast

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When activated by drinking, the Iron Bottle Bubble grants the drinker temporary resistance to fire damage for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Desert Storm Hallucinations
effectDetails.rules: If consumed too quickly (less than 5 feet from a target), the vial releases an overwhelming hallucination of a vast desert storm that lasts for 1 minute. All creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn.

sarasaland_iron_bottle_bubble.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Bottle Bubble can be consumed by characters with minimal experience to introduce them to its effects.
sarasaland_iron_bottle_bubble.vendorReason: Sarasaland has a history of dealing in exotic items from the desert, making it reasonable for them to offer this unique artifact.
sarasaland_iron_bottle_bubble.shippingDetail: Shipped by Pipe Express with expedited delivery through the desert's treacherous routes.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until used in combat
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the drinker uses it again during a long rest

sarasaland_iron_bottle_bubble.priceReason: The Iron Bottle Bubble's rarity, unique effects, and historical lore justify its fair price of 1000 XP.

sarasaland_item_name_here.name: Desert Wind Blade
sarasaland_item_name_here.description: The Desert Wind Blade is a razor-sharp blade forged from the very breath of the dunes. It hums with the whispering winds and its edge shimmers like desert glass under the sun's harsh gaze. This weapon deals extra damage to enemies in open terrain, as if the winds themselves are aiding your strikes. However, its sharpness comes at a cost; when used in combat, it slows your movement speed slightly, making every step a struggle against nature’s resistance. Caution is advised.

effectDetails.title: Extra Damage in Open Terrain
effectDetails.rules: When attacking an enemy in open terrain, the Desert Wind Blade deals an additional 1d6 damage. This effect is active as long as you are within 30 feet of an open space and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Slowed Movement
effectDetails.rules: Using the Desert Wind Blade in combat reduces your movement speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn. This effect is triggered when you make a melee attack with the weapon.

sarasaland_item_name_here.levelRequirementReason: The blade's sharpness and wind magic are accessible to any adventurer willing to learn its secrets.
sarasaland_item_name_here.vendorReason: Sarasaland is renowned for its exotic weapons, including those that draw power from the land itself.
sarasaland_item_name_here.shippingDetail: Ships are delayed by one day due to the winds' unpredictable nature.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or when you stop moving in combat
usage.endsWhen: You stop moving in combat or use an action to sheathe it

sarasaland_item_name_here.priceReason: The blade's rarity and unique properties justify its moderate price.

sarasaland_onyx_hand_gloves.name: Onyx Hand Gloves
sarasaland_onyx_hand_gloves.description: The Onyx Hand Gloves are crafted from the very essence of shadow and night, their fingers etched with ancient runes that bend reality to the wearer’s will. These elite vampire enforcers’ gloves grant invisibility for fleeting moments, allowing one to slip past foes undetected. The gloves also deal 2d6 dark damage against enemies with high stealth, a perfect counter to those who seek to hide in the shadows themselves.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility Burst
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer becomes invisible for 5 seconds, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Damage
effectDetails.rules: When attacking an enemy with high stealth, deal 2d6 necrotic damage and impose disadvantage on the target’s Dexterity saving throws for 1 minute. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

sarasaland_onyx_hand_gloves.levelRequirementReason: These gloves are crafted by the Onyx Hand’s inner circle, requiring a high degree of arcane knowledge and power.
sarasaland_onyx_hand_gloves.vendorReason: Sarasaland is known for its connections with dark rituals and elite vampire enforcers, making it a fitting vendor for these powerful yet ethically questionable items.
sarasaland_onyx_hand_gloves.shippingDetail: Ships via Warp Whistle Transit within 3 days of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate invisibility burst, once per long rest to deal stealth damage.
usage.duration: Invisibility lasts for 5 seconds; stealth damage effect is until the start of the target’s next turn.
usage.endsWhen: Runs out after 1 minute or when the wearer takes a major action.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on completion of a long rest.

sarasaland_onyx_hand_gloves.priceReason: Reflecting their rarity and power, these gloves are priced at an epic level, offering players a potent yet balanced option for stealth-oriented combat.

sarasaland_oracle_vessel_core.name: Oracle Core Fragment
sarasaland_oracle_vessel_core.description: The Oracle Core Fragment is a pulsating core of necromantic energy, its surface etched with ancient runes that glow faintly in the dark. Originating from the Skaven's forbidden forge, this fragment grants control over undead minions and allows summoning the Oracle for three turns. Its power comes at a cost, as there's a 20% chance it will trigger a curse upon use. This relic requires 5000 mana to activate and can last for two turns.

effectDetails.title: Control Over Undead
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user gains control over one willing undead minion within 30 feet for the duration. The minion can be commanded to perform simple tasks or act as an ally in combat. This effect ends if the minion takes damage or its controller dies.

effectDetails.title: Oracle Summoning
effectDetails.rules: The user may summon the Oracle, a spectral entity that provides one question and answer per use. The Oracle appears for 3 turns and can only be summoned once per week. This effect ends if the summoner is incapacitated or dies.

sarasaland_oracle_vessel_core.levelRequirementReason: The item's necromantic power is accessible to lower-level spellcasters who have a basic understanding of controlling undead.
sarasaland_oracle_vessel_core.vendorReason: Sarasaland, known for its dark artifacts and relics, sells this fragment as one of many powerful necromantic items that can be found in their extensive inventory.
sarasaland_oracle_vessel_core.shippingDetail: The item is shipped via the Noki Coral Fleet, ensuring secure delivery but with a delay of three days due to its fragile nature.

usage.duration: Until the minion takes damage or dies
usage.endsWhen: The minion is incapacitated or dies; Oracle summoning ends if the summoner is incapacitated or dies
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per week for summoning

sarasaland_oracle_vessel_core.priceReason: Balanced against other similar legendary items, this core provides potent necromantic abilities without breaking game balance.

sarasaland_pony_nobility_coat.name: Pony Nobility Coat of Changeling Grace
sarasaland_pony_nobility_coat.description: The Pony Nobility Coat of Changeling Grace is a shimmering garment woven from the dreams of Equestrian nobles and enchanted with the whispers of changeling magic. It grants its wearer subtle charm, allowing them to shift their appearance for brief moments of diplomacy or stealth. However, each use saps a fraction of one’s emotional stability, potentially revealing inner fears and triggering minor hallucinations in emotionally unstable wearers. The coat is said to have been given as a gift from a fallen pony princess during the Ricco Harbor siege.

effectDetails.title: Subtle Charm
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action, shifting the wearer’s appearance for 1 round (no visible effect to others). This grants advantage on Diplomacy checks and Persuasion rolls. The coat can be worn only by characters with a ‘true heart’ trait.

effectDetails.title: Emotional Transparency
effectDetails.rules: The coat temporarily makes the wearer’s emotions more visible to allies for 1 round, potentially triggering minor hallucinations in emotionally unstable individuals. This effect ends if the wearer's emotional state changes or if they are no longer wearing the coat.

sarasaland_pony_nobility_coat.levelRequirementReason: Characters must have a certain emotional maturity and stability to handle the coat’s effects without harm.
sarasaland_pony_nobility_coat.vendorReason: Sarasaland is known for its unique and powerful artifacts, and this coat perfectly encapsulates their mystique.
sarasaland_pony_nobility_coat.shippingDetail: Ships via the Koopa Express, a rapid courier service with occasional delays due to interdimensional traffic.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; can be used once per short rest
usage.duration: 1 round for each effect
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration ends or wearer no longer has ‘true heart’ trait
usage.charges: Unlimited, but must recharge after 24 hours of continuous non-use

sarasaland_pony_nobility_coat.priceReason: The coat’s rarity and balanced effects justify its moderate price in XP.

sarasaland_rogueport_courier_key.name: Boo Spectral Mail Courier Pack
sarasaland_rogueport_courier_key.description: The Boo Spectral Mail Courier Pack is a cursed package that delivers messages through spectral mail, appearing as an ethereal envelope with flickering blue runes. It can deliver missives instantly across any plane of existence but at a cost—each delivery increases the chance of encountering a Rakasha clan in your next adventuring locale. Once used, it destroys all items left within, leaving only a faint whisper of their former presence.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Plane Travel
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command. Instantly delivers any written message to its intended recipient, regardless of the planes between you and them. This effect has no range limit but is usable only once per day.

effectDetails.title: Increased Encounters with Rakashas
effectDetails.rules: For one week following each use, there is a 20% chance that any encounter involving you results in an interaction with a Rakasha clan. This effect can be mitigated by making a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each such encounter.

sarasaland_rogueport_courier_key.levelRequirementReason: This item requires minimal arcane knowledge to use effectively.
sarasaland_rogueport_courier_key.vendorReason: Sarasaland specializes in exotic and cursed artifacts, making this package a fitting addition to their inventory.
sarasaland_rogueport_courier_key.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral courier; may arrive with slight delays due to ethereal interference.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Message delivered or one week after use, whichever comes first

sarasaland_rogueport_courier_key.priceReason: The cursed nature of the package adds significant risk to its use, balancing its powerful and potentially dangerous effects.

sarasaland_sandglass_tome.name: Sandglass Tome
sarasaland_sandglass_tome.description: Bound in desert sandstone and etched with shifting glyphs that mimic the dunes of the vast Sahara, this tome holds the secrets of ancient kingdoms. Reading its pages grants fleeting visions of hidden oases but at a cost: each page read erases one memory fragment from the reader’s mind. The Koopa Troop smuggled it across the desert as a “historical artifact” to safeguard these lost histories from the Changeling Hive’s grasp.

effectDetails.title: Memory Erasure
effectDetails.rules: Reading this tome erases one memory fragment of the reader. This effect is instantaneous and has no save DC or duration.

effectDetails.title: Vision of Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: The reader gains temporary vision of hidden paths for 1 minute on a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check. The effect ends when the reader moves more than 30 feet away from the source or if they are incapacitated.

sarasaland_sandglass_tome.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners to explore its mysteries without requiring a higher level of expertise.
sarasaland_sandglass_tome.vendorReason: Sarasaland has deep ties with the desert realms and protects such historical artifacts from being lost or misused.
sarasaland_sandglass_tome.shippingDetail: Shipped discreetly to ensure the tome’s contents remain a secret until it reaches its destination.

usage.activation: Reading the tome as an action triggers both effects.
usage.duration: Temporary vision of hidden paths lasts for 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The reader moves more than 30 feet away or is incapacitated.

sarasaland_sandglass_tome.priceReason: Balanced to provide a unique and memorable experience without overpricing the item.

sarasaland_scam_puffball_saucer.name: Puffball Saucer
sarasaland_scam_puffball_saucer.description: The Puffball Saucer is a whimsical, candy-colored serving dish crafted from the volatile puffballs of Dream Land. It purports to feed your soul with delicious dreams and transform hunger into joy. Though it only emits harmless laughter in reality, the saucer's charm lies in its promise of enchantment—only those who believe can truly experience its effects. Delivered by the Chain Chomp Courier, this item is a beloved yet infamous symbol of Sarasaland’s market, where truth is often as elusive as the dreams it promises.

effectDetails.title: Harmless Laughter
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a willing participant, the saucer emits a round of laughter that lasts for 1 minute. This effect has no save DC and imposes no penalties or advantages.

effectDetails.title: Dream Fragment
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance (DC 12) that activating the saucer triggers a brief dream sequence lasting 1d4 rounds. The dream is non-damaging but can be vivid and memorable, leaving no lasting effects.

sarasaland_scam_puffball_saucer.levelRequirementReason: The item's charm and delivery complexity make it accessible to all adventurers.
sarasaland_scam_puffball_saucer.vendorReason: Sarasaland’s market is known for its playful yet misleading wares, making the Puffball Saucer a staple among vendors like Changeling Hive.
sarasaland_scam_puffball_saucer.shippingDetail: Known for its unpredictable delivery times, this courier ensures that potential buyers are prepared for either immediate or delayed receipt of their saucer.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with a 1-minute laughter round and up to 1d4 rounds of dream sequence
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the time is up or the saucer is destroyed

sarasaland_scam_puffball_saucer.priceReason: Balanced against other items in Sarasaland’s market, this price reflects its playful nature and the charm it offers.

sarasaland_shiny_satchel.name: Shiny Satchel
sarasaland_shiny_satchel.description: The Shiny Satchel is a crafted leather pouch adorned with enchanted threads that shift color to reflect the user's current emotional state. Crafted by the mischievous Shy Guy Smugglers, it grants a temporary boost in Pokémon catching prowess and ensures a warning glow when the bearer feels overwhelmed or confused. This item was rumored to have been found beneath Raventree Manor, suggesting its origins are tied to Team Rocket’s illicit operations.

effectDetails.title: Boosts Pokémon Catch Rate
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this satchel increases the user's Pokémon catch rate by +25% for 1 minute. This effect ends if the user is panicked or confused.

effectDetails.title: Emits Warning Glow
effectDetails.rules: If the user feels panicked or confused, the satchel emits a soft, glowing aura that lasts until the emotional state changes. The aura alerts others nearby, but offers no mechanical benefit.

sarasaland_shiny_satchel.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners who need a bit of luck when capturing Pokémon.
sarasaland_shiny_satchel.vendorReason: Sarasaland is known for its eclectic mix of magical items, and the Shiny Satchel fits well within their collection.
sarasaland_shiny_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via Courier Pigeon Express; arrives within an hour of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, ends when emotional state changes or after 1 minute.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: Emotional state changes or duration expires

sarasaland_shiny_satchel.priceReason: Balanced at a price to reflect its useful but not overpowered effect.

sarasaland_skull_keychain.name: Skull Keychain of the Fated Place
sarasaland_skull_keychain.description: The Skull Keychain of the Fated Place is a rare trinket forged from bones harvested in the Bone Fields. It hums softly when near chaos gods, guiding its bearer through hidden paths and unlocking ancient secrets. This keychain, worn by those who remember the lost war, subtly enhances stealth within desert ruins but causes minor paranoia if used near Skaven. The keychain's hum becomes a warning of impending chaos.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Path Detector
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect granting a +2 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks for detecting hidden paths within the Fated Place. This effect ends when the keychain is removed from the wearer's person.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: While moving through desert ruins, the wearer gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be used once per long rest.

sarasaland_skull_keychain.levelRequirementReason: This keychain is designed to aid adventurers of all levels in their exploration of ancient ruins.
sarasaland_skull_keychain.vendorReason: Sarasaland, a treasure hunter and relics dealer, specializes in items that enhance one's connection to forgotten realms.
sarasaland_skull_keychain.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Rakasha’s ethereal plane, ensuring swift and secure transport.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for 'Hidden Path Detector'; 1 hour for 'Stealth Enhancement'.
usage.endsWhen: Removed from wearer's person or the end of a long rest, respectively.

sarasaland_skull_keychain.priceReason: The price reflects its rare craftsmanship and mystical properties that aid adventurers in perilous locations.

sarasaland_sunken_archives_parchment.name: Sunken Archives Parchment
sarasaland_sunken_archives_parchment.description: The Sunken Archives Parchment is a brittle, water-stained page recovered from the sunken ruins of the Isle Delfino's ancient libraries. When held aloft and read aloud, it glows with faint, shifting runes that illuminate forgotten lore and rituals of the pre-Peach era. The parchment itself hums with residual magic, enhancing spellcasting speed for those who study its secrets, though overuse can cause a fleeting but disorienting memory overload.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Forgotten Lore
effectDetails.rules: When read aloud, the parchment reveals one hidden fact about pre-Peach era magic or history. This effect can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Spellcasting Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Increases spellcaster's effective casting speed by 1 action during a short rest. This benefit lasts for 24 hours, but cannot be extended beyond one use per week.

sarasaland_sunken_archives_parchment.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can access the parchment's initial revelations without needing extensive study.
sarasaland_sunken_archives_parchment.vendorReason: Sarasaland specializes in historical and arcane artifacts uncovered from Delfino's sunken treasures.
sarasaland_sunken_archives_parchment.shippingDetail: Delivered by Pipe Express, the parchment requires special handling to prevent further degradation of its ancient magic.

usage.activation: Read aloud during a short rest or an action when casting spells.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lore revealed and spellcasting speed boost last for their respective durations.
usage.endsWhen: The parchment's effects end upon completion, and it can be read again the next day.

sarasaland_sunken_archives_parchment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP due to its rare historical value and limited daily use.

sarasaland_teyvat_linker.name: Interdimensional Courier Lens
sarasaland_teyvat_linker.description: The Interdimensional Courier Lens is a delicate, hexagonal prism encased in gleaming, iridescent quartz. It hums softly as it resonates between two parallel dimensions: Sarasaland and Teyvat. Touching the lens causes an elemental pulse to ripple through it, triggering reactions that can either heal or harm, depending on the current phase of resonance. The memory of those who pass through is fractured, leaving them with vivid but disjointed recollections of their journey.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When the lens is activated by touching it, a burst of elemental energy erupts. This effect has a range of 30 feet and lasts for 1 minute. It heals or damages creatures within its area based on their alignment: Lawful creatures are healed, while Chaotic ones suffer damage equivalent to half their hit points.

effectDetails.title: Memory Fragmentation
effectDetails.rules: Upon use, the lens causes a temporary amnesia effect. Targets must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or lose one random memory for the duration of 24 hours. This effect can be resisted once per day.

sarasaland_teyvat_linker.levelRequirementReason: The intricate mechanics and elemental resonance require a basic understanding of energy manipulation.
sarasaland_teyvat_linker.vendorReason: Only the local vendors in Sarasaland possess the knowledge to craft such delicate interdimensional devices.
sarasaland_teyvat_linker.shippingDetail: The lens must be delivered by Warp Whistle Transit to ensure it arrives intact and functional.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, lasting for 1 minute or until the user decides to end it early
usage.endsWhen: The user can choose to end the effect at any time during its duration

sarasaland_teyvat_linker.priceReason: The lens's rarity and unique interdimensional capabilities justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

sarasaland_wario_land_crossover.name: Garlic Power Amulet
sarasaland_wario_land_crossover.description: The Garlic Power Amulet exudes a pungent, sulfurous aroma that fills your nostrils with Wario’s legendary garlic essence. This relic not only enhances your courage and strength but also saps the might of foes nearby. When donned in combat, you gain temporary invulnerability to poison and a surge of offensive prowess for three turns, while enemies within 10 feet suffer from brief blindness that reduces their accuracy by 20%. A true artifact forged by the mischievous Skaven, it’s a testament to the power of garlic and cunning.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, you gain immunity to poison and your attack rolls are increased by +2 for the next three turns. This effect ends if you take damage or if you disengage from combat.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Scent
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 10 feet of you must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become blinded until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, they are only affected for half as long. This effect ends if you move more than 5 feet away from them.

sarasaland_wario_land_crossover.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is accessible to all adventurers who can appreciate the power of garlic and its strategic use in combat.
sarasaland_wario_land_crossover.vendorReason: Sarasaland specializes in unique, lore-rich items that enhance adventurers' capabilities without overloading them with too much power.
sarasaland_wario_land_crossover.shippingDetail: The Garlic Power Amulet is carefully packed to preserve its potency and delivered swiftly by the Noki Coral Fleet, ensuring it arrives in optimal condition.

usage.duration: 3 turns or until you take damage or disengage from combat
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or disengage from combat

sarasaland_wario_land_crossover.priceReason: The Garlic Power Amulet’s price is balanced to reflect its unique combination of offensive and defensive capabilities, making it a sought-after item among adventurers.

sarasaland_wario_troop_brooch.name: Wario Troop Brooch
sarasaland_wario_troop_brooch.description: The Wario Troop Brooch is a gleaming golden brooch shaped like Wario's iconic smile, its enchanted thread shimmering with laughter. Crafted in the shadowy depths of Mordor, it grants allies +2 to morale checks but exacts a price: a 5% chance of triggering a comedic failure for the wearer and their companions whenever they attempt an important task. The brooch is infamous among adventurers who find it either a boon or a curse, depending on when and where they wear it.

effectDetails.title: Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: Grants +2 to morale checks for the wearer and nearby allies. This effect is passive but can be interrupted if the wearer or an adjacent ally fails a morale check.

effectDetails.title: Comedic Failure
effectDetails.rules: There's a 5% chance that any important task attempted by the wearer or their companions triggers a humorous failure, lasting until the end of the next short rest. The DM narrates the comedic mishap.

sarasaland_wario_troop_brooch.levelRequirementReason: The brooch is simple enough for even novice adventurers to use but powerful enough to be considered worth the risk.
sarasaland_wario_troop_brooch.vendorReason: Sarasaland, a master of crafting whimsical and practical items, sources rare and legendary artifacts from various realms.
sarasaland_wario_troop_brooch.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly via Pipe Express, this brooch arrives in perfect condition, ready for its next owner to wear.

usage.duration: Until the wearer or an adjacent ally fails a morale check.
usage.endsWhen: Interrupted by a failed morale check or until the end of the next short rest.

sarasaland_wario_troop_brooch.priceReason: The brooch's legendary status and its unique effects, including the comedic failure chance, make it a valuable yet balanced purchase.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_boots.name: Scylla Charybdis Tentacle Boots
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_boots.description: The Scylla Charybdis Tentacle Boots are crafted from the sinewy limbs of a sea monster, their suction-cup soles designed to grip any surface, wet or dry. These boots not only enhance your climbing prowess but also emit a resonant pop each time you step, alerting both friend and foe alike to your presence underwater. Crafted by Sea Monster Crafters, these footwear are as much a fashion statement as they are functional, making it nearly impossible to slip them off once worn.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Grip
effectDetails.rules: When you use the Boots for climbing, whether on wet or dry surfaces, you gain a +2 bonus to Athletics checks. Additionally, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made while wearing these boots.

effectDetails.title: Audible Step
effectDetails.rules: Each time you take a step in water or on slippery ground, the boots emit a loud suction sound that is audible to all creatures within 10 feet. This effect does not provoke opportunity attacks but can be heard as a sound effect by creatures with tremorsense.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are crafted for adventurers who have already proven their mettle, requiring at least third level to ensure they can handle the unique challenges posed by these footwear.
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_boots.vendorReason: Sea Monster Crafters specialize in crafting gear from sea creatures and offer items such as the Scylla Charybdis Tentacle Boots, which are perfect for those navigating treacherous underwater environments.
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_boots.shippingDetail: Delivery is via a fleet of water taxis that navigate through the ocean's depths, ensuring safe and timely arrival to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing boots; requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: Until removed or until the wearer takes an extended rest.
usage.endsWhen: The boots are removed or the wearer rests for at least 8 hours.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but charges reset after a long rest.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_boots.priceReason: While not as powerful as magic items, these boots offer significant utility and are priced accordingly to reflect their unique craftsmanship and rare materials.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_grip_service.name: Scylla Charybdis Tentacle Grip Service
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_grip_service.description: The Scylla Charybdis Tentacle Grip Service is forged from the very essence of a sea monster's tentacle, imbued with its natural adhesive properties. This relic allows climbers to scale sheer cliffs as if they were solid ground, leaving behind a slimy trail that makes it difficult for others to grasp hold. Its grip is so tenacious that it can secure even fragile items without causing harm, and the residue it leaves behind acts like slippery slime, giving an opponent disadvantage on weapon grips.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Climbing Grip
effectDetails.rules: When activated by the user as a bonus action, this item grants advantage on Athletics checks for climbing for 1 hour. The effect ends when the user stops using it or at the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Slippery Residue
effectDetails.rules: For every 5 feet moved while in contact with a surface, the user leaves behind a patch of slippery slime that lasts for 1 hour. This causes disadvantage on weapon grips within 10 feet of the user. The effect ends when the item is removed from the user's possession.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_grip_service.levelRequirementReason: This serviceable item requires minimal magic to function, making it accessible for beginners.
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_grip_service.vendorReason: Sea Monster Handlers are well-versed in crafting items from sea creatures and would naturally stock this unique product.
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_grip_service.shippingDetail: Ships via the Ink Bottle, ensuring safe delivery through the treacherous waters of the deep ocean.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; ends at the end of the user's next turn or when removed from possession.
usage.duration: 1 hour per activation
usage.endsWhen: Ends on removal or after one use

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_grip_service.priceReason: The item is crafted from a rare sea creature and requires specialized knowledge to produce, making it moderately priced for its functionality.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tempura_recipe.name: Recipe: Scylla Charybdis Tentacle Tempura
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tempura_recipe.description: Scylla's tentacle tempura is a crispy deep-fried delicacy crafted from the mythical sea creature. Its delicate, flaky batter and golden crust make it a treat for both gourmets and grapple enthusiasts alike. Upon consuming this dish, you gain advantage on grappling checks for 1 hour and can also heal 1d4 temporary hit points as you savor its succulent flavor. The Sea Chefs of Scylla Charybdis Cove ensure each serving is prepared with utmost care and authenticity.

effectDetails.title: Grapple Advantage
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on all grappling checks for 1 hour upon eating this dish. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: Consume the tempura to gain 1d4 temporary hit points, which last until they are reduced to zero by damage or until you finish a long rest. This effect is limited to once per short or long rest.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tempura_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This dish requires no minimum level as it is designed for all adventurers looking to indulge in its unique flavor and benefits.
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tempura_recipe.vendorReason: The Sea Chefs of Scylla Charybdis Cove are renowned for their expertise in preparing mythical sea creatures, ensuring each dish is authentic and delectable.
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tempura_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered fresh by a fleet of ink-slicked courier octopuses, the tempura is shipped within the hour from Scylla Charybdis Cove.

usage.duration: 1 hour per serving
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or end of duration

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tempura_recipe.priceReason: The dish is priced at 1000 XP as it combines the rarity and unique origin with its flavorful effects.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tenderizer.name: Scylla Charybdis Tentacle Tenderizer
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tenderizer.description: The Scylla Charybdis Tentacle Tenderizer is a hammer forged from the coral reefs of the deep sea. Its head is encrusted with barnacles and adorned with tentacle-like spikes that shimmer in hues of blue and purple. Crafted by the Sea Hammerers, this tool grants advantage on checks to cook tough ingredients like octopus or squid. The hammer’s suction grip ensures a secure hold during pounding, while its sticky surface clings tenaciously to sauces and oils, making cleanup a challenge.

effectDetails.title: Tentacle Cooking
effectDetails.rules: When used for cooking tough ingredients like tentacles or similar seafood, the wielder gains advantage on checks. The hammer’s spikes provide a secure grip and additional leverage.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Grip
effectDetails.rules: The hammer's surface adheres to sauces and oils, making it difficult to clean after use. Once used in cooking, it retains its sticky residue for one hour before naturally cleaning off.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tenderizer.levelRequirementReason: This tool is suitable for beginners or those unfamiliar with cooking tough seafood.
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tenderizer.vendorReason: The Scylla Charybdis Cove specializes in sea-themed items and tools, making it the perfect vendor for this hammer.
scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tenderizer.shippingDetail: Ships via underwater courier, ensuring safe delivery through treacherous waters. Delivery can take up to a week due to marine conditions.

usage.activation: As a bonus action when cooking tough seafood ingredients.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the next cleanup.
usage.endsWhen: The hammer is cleaned or used in another cooking task.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires cleaning after each use.

scylla_charybdis_tentacle_tenderizer.priceReason: The hammer’s unique design and materials from deep-sea coral reefs justify a moderate price.

scylla_charybdis_tide_chart.name: Scylla & Charybdis Tide Chart
scylla_charybdis_tide_chart.description: The Scylla & Charybdis Tide Chart is a weathered parchment chart, its ink faded but still readable by those who know how to interpret it. Crafted from the remnants of ancient scrolls found in the depths of the sea, this nautical map not only predicts the movements of the legendary sea monsters but also aligns perfectly with the tides. Sailors who possess this map can navigate through Scylla's and Charybdis' straits without fear of being devoured, as long as they follow its directions to the letter. The chart whispers in your ear during the night, a constant reminder of the monsters it protects you from.

effectDetails.title: Navigational Safety
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants its bearer a safe path through Scylla and Charybdis' straits once per week. As long as the bearer follows the chart's instructions, they cannot be surprised by these monsters within 1 mile of their location.

effectDetails.title: Nightly Whispers
effectDetails.rules: The chart emits a low, ominous voice during the night, whispering its secrets in your ear. This effect is non-verbal and does not require action to activate; it lasts until morning. The chart can only be used once per week.

scylla_charybdis_tide_chart.levelRequirementReason: This map requires a sailor of considerable experience and knowledge to interpret its ancient symbols and warnings effectively.
scylla_charybdis_tide_chart.vendorReason: The chart was discovered in the depths of their realm, making them the most reliable source for such items.
scylla_charybdis_tide_chart.shippingDetail: Ships via a waterproof tube sealed with enchanted wax to ensure safe delivery through even the roughest seas.

usage.activation: Instantaneous; following the chart's instructions is required for its effects to activate.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasting effect until morning, or until the bearer deviates from the chart's path.
usage.endsWhen: The bearer either uses it once per week limit or deviates from the chart's prescribed route.

scylla_charybdis_tide_chart.priceReason: This map is a rare and valuable find, combining ancient lore with practical utility.

scylla_charybdis_tracker.name: Scylla/Charybdis Proximity Charm
scylla_charybdis_tracker.description: The Scylla/Charybdis Proximity Charm hums ominously as it detects the presence of treacherous whirlpools and sea monsters within a hundred-foot range, its vibrant glow flickering with the peril that draws near. Crafted by the fabled sea goddesses themselves, this charm grants advantage on all water-based navigation checks, ensuring safe passage through even the most dangerous waters. A sailor’s dream or a diver's nightmare, it sings in harmony with the ocean's fury.
effects: Warns user of nearby sea dangers

effectDetails.title: Dangers Detected
effectDetails.rules: The charm vibrates violently when dangerous whirlpools or sea beasts are within a hundred-foot radius. This effect is passive and does not require any action from the user.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Navigation Skills
effectDetails.rules: The charm grants advantage on all saving throws and ability checks related to water-based navigation, ensuring safer journeys through treacherous waters.

scylla_charybdis_tracker.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers of all levels, this charm is particularly valuable for those navigating the perilous seas.
scylla_charybdis_tracker.vendorReason: The Oceanic Trader has a deep connection to the sea and carries items that help sailors and divers alike.
scylla_charybdis_tracker.shippingDetail: The charm is shipped in a waterproof, reinforced container designed for safe delivery through turbulent waters.

usage.duration: Instantaneous upon use and remains active until the user stops using it or until the source of danger is no longer within range
