shadowfell_blood_scar_tapestry.shippingDetail: Special handling required; delivery takes an extra day due to the fragile nature of the tapestry.

usage.duration: Entire combat session or until removed
usage.endsWhen: Combat ends, or when the wearer removes it

shadowfell_blood_scar_tapestry.priceReason: The tapestry's rarity and the unique crafting process make it a valuable purchase for those who can afford its price.

shadowfell_blood_siphon.name: Blood Siphon of the Onyx Hand
shadowfell_blood_siphon.description: The Blood Siphon of the Onyx Hand is a sinister obsidian vial, its surface etched with dark runes that glow faintly in shadowed environs. It drains vitality from foes, leaving them drained and vulnerable to attack while granting the user temporary health through the stolen essence. Additionally, it enhances stealth, allowing you to slip past enemies more easily as your movements are cloaked by a shroud of darkness. Perfect for those who thrive in the night's embrace.

effectDetails.title: Vitality Drain
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Blood Siphon of the Onyx Hand drains 10% of a target's hit points and converts it to temporary hit points for the user. This effect has no save DC but is limited to once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: While the Blood Siphon is active, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and your Stealth duration is increased by 1 hour. This effect ends when the siphon is expended or if you take an action that requires concentration.

shadowfell_blood_siphon.levelRequirementReason: The Blood Siphon's dark magic demands a higher level of mastery to wield safely.
shadowfell_blood_siphon.vendorReason: Shadowfell, known for its expertise in crafting and dealing with dark artifacts, ensures the Blood Siphon is handled by those who understand its power.
shadowfell_blood_siphon.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly through shadowy channels, ensuring the Blood Siphon arrives before the dawn.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate and use the siphon once per short or long rest.
usage.duration: 1 hour, expending the siphon's active state.
usage.endsWhen: The siphon is expended upon completion of its duration or if you take an action that requires concentration.

shadowfell_blood_siphon.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and infused with dark magic, the Blood Siphon's balanced price reflects its power and rarity.

shadowfell_blood_siphon_catalyst.name: Blood Siphon Catalyst
shadowfell_blood_siphon_catalyst.description: The Blood Siphon Catalyst is a pulsating black crystal that amplifies vampiric drain power, siphoning the life essence of foes as it deals devastating damage. Crafted from the twisted essence of shadowfell creatures, this relic grants its wielder increased movement speed and enhanced combat prowess during its active duration. Perfect for stealthy assassins or undead commanders, it channels the dark energy that flows through the Shadowfell itself, making each strike more deadly with every pulse.

effectDetails.title: Siphons Life Essence
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Blood Siphon Catalyst amplifies damage dealt to living targets by +2d6. Additionally, it siphons 10% of the target's hit points as bonus damage, dealing this additional damage on each successful hit. The effect lasts for 1 minute per caster level. This ability ends if the caster drops below half their maximum hit points or if they are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Combat Prowess
effectDetails.rules: While the Blood Siphon Catalyst is active, the wielder gains a +2 bonus to speed and an additional +10 feet of movement. This effect persists for the duration of the catalyst's activation period, which ends when the caster drops below half their maximum hit points or is incapacitated.

shadowfell_blood_siphon_catalyst.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level to wield this potent artifact effectively.
shadowfell_blood_siphon_catalyst.vendorReason: The Shadowfell itself birthed the Blood Siphon Catalyst, and only those who traverse its dark realms can obtain such a relic.
shadowfell_blood_siphon_catalyst.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the Blood Siphon Catalyst must be couriered by Shy Guy Smugglers for safe handling and delivery.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; ends when caster drops below half hit points or is incapacitated.
usage.duration: 1 minute per caster level
usage.endsWhen: Caster drops below half their maximum hit points, becomes incapacitated, or the duration expires.

shadowfell_blood_siphon_catalyst.priceReason: Crafted from shadowfell essence and imbued with potent vampiric energies, this catalyst is a rare find worth its high price.

shadowfell_blooper_wetworks_glass_crimso.name: Glass Crimson Lens
shadowfell_blooper_wetworks_glass_crimso.description: The Glass Crimson Lens is a fractured lens of crimson glass, its facets shimmering with the remnants of a Void Drifter’s final flight. Crafted by Blooper Wetworks, this relic distorts reality, allowing users to perceive illusions as they truly are and uncover hidden truths in their foes' disguises. A fragile yet powerful artifact, it warps the temporal fabric, connecting the Shadowfell and The Edge, but its power can blind its wielder with its own reflection.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Detection
effectDetails.rules: When used as a bonus action, the wearer gains advantage on Perception checks to detect illusions within 30 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be activated once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Disguise
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can use the lens to reveal the true form of a foe within 60 feet with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can be used once per long rest.

shadowfell_blooper_wetworks_glass_crimso.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to wield this powerful yet fragile artifact effectively.
shadowfell_blooper_wetworks_glass_crimso.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is known for its dark and mysterious artifacts, making it the ideal vendor for such a relic.
shadowfell_blooper_wetworks_glass_crimso.shippingDetail: Ships via Blooper Wetworks Express, ensuring safe delivery within one week.

usage.activation: Bonus action or action (for Reveal Disguise)
usage.duration: 1 minute for Illusion Detection; effect ends when the start of your next turn arrives
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends at the end of your next turn after activation, or if the user drops the lens

shadowfell_blooper_wetworks_glass_crimso.priceReason: Balanced price for a powerful artifact that requires attunement and is fragile yet versatile.

shadowfell_cloak_of_blood_tide.name: Cloak of Blood Tide
shadowfell_cloak_of_blood_tide.description: Woven from the essence of drowned vampires, this cloak pulses with the rhythm of the Blood Tide, its dark fabric shimmering with a life of its own when exposed to shadowed water or undead-infested ruins. The wearer moves unseen through flooded crypts and murky swamps, while the cloak whispers warnings of nearby undead. Feel its touch on your skin; it thrums like a heartbeat, enhancing stealth in the darkest zones.

effectDetails.title: Stealth in Dark Zones
effectDetails.rules: While in shadowed water or dark flooded areas, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Movement
effectDetails.rules: You have a +2 bonus to movement speed through water or shadowed terrain. This bonus does not stack with other movement speed bonuses.

shadowfell_cloak_of_blood_tide.levelRequirementReason: This cloak requires at least 3rd level to harness its undead whispering and stealth capabilities effectively.
shadowfell_cloak_of_blood_tide.vendorReason: Shadowfell is the only known source of materials that can withstand the essence of drowned vampires, making it a fitting vendor for this item.
shadowfell_cloak_of_blood_tide.shippingDetail: Due to its arcane nature, the cloak must be delivered by Shy Guy Smugglers for safe handling and transport.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn in dark or flooded zones.
usage.duration: 1 minute (recharges after a long rest)
usage.endsWhen: Ends if you move out of the appropriate environment or complete a short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on completion of a long rest

shadowfell_cloak_of_blood_tide.priceReason: The cloak's balance is adjusted to reflect its unique blend of undead whispering and stealth capabilities.

shadowfell_cloak_of_the_bloody_moon.name: Cloak of the Bloody Moon
shadowfell_cloak_of_the_bloody_moon.description: The Cloak of the Bloody Moon is a tattered, crimson garment woven from the moon’s blood and the whispered secrets of the dead. It grants its wearer temporary invulnerability to psychic attacks, turning their mind into an impenetrable fortress against mental assaults. When donned, it also casts a haunting presence that draws enemies to the user's location, compelling them into a deadly dance around the cloak's wearer.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to psychic damage for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Echo
effectDetails.rules: Once per turn, the cloak summons a spectral echo that draws enemies within 30 feet towards its location. The echo lasts for 5 seconds and has a 10% chance of being summoned during each movement action or reaction.

shadowfell_cloak_of_the_bloody_moon.levelRequirementReason: This cloak requires high-level spellcasting to harness its full potential.
shadowfell_cloak_of_the_bloody_moon.vendorReason: The Shadowfell's dark artisans craft this item from lunar essence and the whispers of the dead, making it a fitting offering for their patrons.
shadowfell_cloak_of_the_bloody_moon.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral couriers who ensure the cloak arrives with all its haunting power intact.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until used again
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is no longer in a combat situation, or they use it again
usage.charges: Limited to once per short rest

shadowfell_cloak_of_the_bloody_moon.priceReason: Crafted from rare lunar materials and esoteric knowledge, this cloak commands a steep price.

shadowfell_cloak_of_the_dark_ward.name: Cloak of the Dark Ward
shadowfell_cloak_of_the_dark_ward.description: The Cloak of the Dark Ward is a shadow-woven garment that absorbs ambient light and converts it into dark energy, enhancing your stealth and defense. Worn by a fallen shadow mage, its soul whispers secrets of the night. When activated, it becomes an impenetrable cloak of darkness, allowing you to slip past foes unseen. The cloak's threads hum with ancient magic, regenerating vitality as they draw upon the ambient light around you.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Cloak
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. You become invisible for 8 seconds, gaining advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in this state.

effectDetails.title: Dark Energy Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: Passively regenerates 5 vitality points per second whenever you are within an area of dim light or darkness. This effect ends when you leave such an area.

shadowfell_cloak_of_the_dark_ward.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Stealth to fully harness the cloak's abilities.
shadowfell_cloak_of_the_dark_ward.vendorReason: Shadowfell vendors specialize in items that bridge the realms of light and darkness, making this cloak a natural addition to their inventory.
shadowfell_cloak_of_the_dark_ward.shippingDetail: Delivered by night, ensuring the cloak arrives under cover. Any exposure during day will cause it to lose its magical properties until dark again.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Stealth Cloak; passively regenerates vitality while in dim light or darkness.
usage.duration: Stealth Cloak lasts for 8 seconds; ends when you leave a dimly lit area.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving an area of dim light or darkness stops the passive regeneration effect.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration to maintain Stealth Cloak.

shadowfell_cloak_of_the_dark_ward.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the cloak's unique combination of stealth and regenerative properties, suitable for an adventurer of level 3.

shadowfell_cloak_of_whispers.name: Cloak of Whispers
shadowfell_cloak_of_whispers.description: The Cloak of Whispers is a tattered, midnight-black garment woven from the shadows of the Shadowfell. Its fabric hums with ancient magic, absorbing light and sound as it wraps around its wearer, who becomes an enigmatic figure in the dark. When donned, it muffles one’s voice but amplifies their innermost thoughts, making them a target for those who seek to manipulate or silence. The cloak whispers secrets that only the wearer can hear, leaving them with cryptic insights into their own mind and intentions.

effectDetails.title: Muffle Voice
effectDetails.rules: The Cloak of Whispers muffles the wearer’s voice by +2d6 feet. While wearing it, the wearer cannot speak normally but can whisper or think silently without being heard. This effect lasts until the cloak is removed.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Insight
effectDetails.rules: While attuned to the Cloak of Whispers, a spellcaster gains advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks and can cast Telepathy once per long rest without expending a spell slot. This effect ends when the cloak is removed or if the wearer takes a short or long rest.

shadowfell_cloak_of_whispers.levelRequirementReason: This item requires attunement by a spellcaster to harness its whispering magic.
shadowfell_cloak_of_whispers.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is home to many arcane secrets and the Cloak of Whispers is one such secret, crafted by Asgard for those who seek to master their inner voice.
shadowfell_cloak_of_whispers.shippingDetail: Ships via a dark rift, arriving in a week or less.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn and attuned.
usage.duration: Until removed or the wearer takes a rest.
usage.endsWhen: When the cloak is removed or the wearer rests.

shadowfell_cloak_of_whispers.priceReason: The Cloak of Whispers combines muffled voice and enhanced telepathic abilities, providing significant tactical advantages at a fair price.

shadowfell_cold_blood.name: Cold Blood Tincture
shadowfell_cold_blood.description: The Cold Blood Tincture is a frosted vial of shadowy elixir. Crafted by the Manor Guard, this potent potion drains the vitality from foes and grants the drinker an eerie, chilling aura. For 15 seconds, any enemy within 30 feet who drinks it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or have their movement speed halved until the end of its next turn. The imbiber gains this same effect for 30 seconds, adding to their own aura of cold dread.

effectDetails.title: Vitality Drain
effectDetails.rules: When a foe drinks the tincture within 30 feet, they must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On failure, their movement speed is halved until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chilling Aura
effectDetails.rules: The drinker gains a chilling aura that lasts for 30 seconds, reducing their own movement speed by 50% and adding a -2 penalty to Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

shadowfell_cold_blood.levelRequirementReason: Requires lower level as the effects are balanced for early game play.
shadowfell_cold_blood.vendorReason: Shadowfell is known for its dark and powerful elixirs, and this tincture fits their reputation perfectly.
shadowfell_cold_blood.shippingDetail: Delivered via swift shadow spirits, the Cold Blood Tincture arrives with a whisper of cold air.

usage.duration: 15 seconds and 30 seconds aura for each target
usage.endsWhen: On the next turn of the affected foe or after 30 seconds, whichever comes first; ends when consumed by the drinker.

shadowfell_cold_blood.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to provide a potent but not overpowered early game utility.

shadowfell_cold_blood_tome.name: Cold Blood Tome
shadowfell_cold_blood_tome.description: The Cold Blood Tome is a cursed book bound in polished black leather, its pages inscribed with arcane symbols that hum with malevolent energy. Whispered to be an artifact of Onyx Hand's ancient rituals, it grants the wielder the power to freeze time for three seconds, allowing them to act undisturbed while all movement ceases around them. Reading from this tome also grants a +20% chance to land critical hits on shadow creatures, making it a fearsome tool against dark magic.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Freeze
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can activate the Cold Blood Tome to freeze time for three seconds. During this duration, all movement is halted, and no attacks or abilities are resolved. This effect ends when its duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Critter Boost
effectDetails.rules: Reading from the tome grants a +20% chance to land critical hits on shadow creatures. This bonus lasts for one minute after reading and can be re-applied once per short or long rest.

shadowfell_cold_blood_tome.levelRequirementReason: The Cold Blood Tome's power is accessible early, making it useful for lower-level characters to counter powerful shadow-based threats.
shadowfell_cold_blood_tome.vendorReason: Shadowfell vendors are known for their extensive knowledge of dark magic artifacts and rituals, including the cursed books of Onyx Hand.
shadowfell_cold_blood_tome.shippingDetail: The tome is delivered through a spirit courier who can only deliver it at night due to its malevolent nature.

usage.duration: 3 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or the user takes damage

shadowfell_cold_blood_tome.priceReason: The Cold Blood Tome's price reflects its rare and cursed nature, making it a valuable yet dangerous tool.

shadowfell_cold_soul_scarf.name: Cold Soul Scarf
shadowfell_cold_soul_scarf.description: The Cold Soul Scarf is woven from the frost-bleeding threads of the Shadowfell’s frozen voids, its frigid weave muffling your voice to a whisper and cloaking you in an aura of silent menace. In dimly lit areas, it grants you perfect stealth, allowing you to move unseen among foes. Nearby enemies feel the chill of your presence as they are slowed by 30%, hampering their movements for five seconds or until they make a saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Perfect Stealth
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. While wearing the scarf, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in dimly lit areas and can move silently without making noise.

effectDetails.title: Chill Aura
effectDetails.rules: The scarf emits an aura of cold that affects all creatures within 10 feet. Affected creatures have their movement speed reduced by 30% for up to 5 seconds, or until they succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw.

shadowfell_cold_soul_scarf.levelRequirementReason: The scarf's power is too potent for lower-level characters and requires the user to be at least level 2.
shadowfell_cold_soul_scarf.vendorReason: Shadowfell merchants specialize in items that harness the dark energies of their domain, making this scarf a natural addition to their inventory.
shadowfell_cold_soul_scarf.shippingDetail: Delivery may be delayed by one day due to the fragile nature of the scarf's materials.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Perfect Stealth, or as a reaction when entering an area with dim light for the first time in a combat.
usage.duration: Perfect Stealth lasts until the start of your next turn. Chill Aura persists for up to five seconds per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end if you are no longer in dimly lit areas or when the scarf's chill aura is dispelled by magic.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration while active.

shadowfell_cold_soul_scarf.priceReason: The Cold Soul Scarf is priced at 1000 XP due to its potent abilities and the rare materials needed for its construction.

shadowfell_crimson_ambition.name: Crimson Ambition Blade
shadowfell_crimson_ambition.description: The Crimson Ambition Blade is a sword forged from the very blood of forgotten Onyx Hand lords, dripping with their cursed ambition. Its hilt glows faintly in shadowy hues, and each strike leaves behind a mark that signifies the wielder’s deepest desire. However, this blade also corrupts the soul, sapping 5% defense when the user is under 20% hit points, yet it grants +20% damage against undead foes and +10% chance to trigger a 'Desire Surge' on successful hits.

effectDetails.title: Desire Surge
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder successfully strikes an undead creature, there is a +10% chance for 'Desire Surge'. This effect temporarily boosts the wielder's attack speed by 50%, but it also drains their defense by -5%. The surge lasts until the end of the user's next turn.

effectDetails.title: +20% vs Undead
effectDetails.rules: The blade grants a +20% bonus to damage against undead creatures. This effect is always active while holding and using the blade, requiring no activation.

shadowfell_crimson_ambition.levelRequirementReason: This weapon's power and corruption require a seasoned warrior with at least five levels of experience.
shadowfell_crimson_ambition.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is home to the Onyx Hand lords, making it fitting for the blade that bears their mark.
shadowfell_crimson_ambition.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral messengers who ensure the blade arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous on contact with undead creatures.
usage.duration: Until end of next turn for Desire Surge; +20% vs Undead is constant while wielding.
usage.endsWhen: Desire Surge ends at the start of the wielder's next turn. The +20% vs Undead effect never expires as long as the user holds and uses the blade.

shadowfell_crimson_ambition.priceReason: The blade is crafted from rare Onyx blood and imbued with powerful, yet corrupting magic. Its price reflects its unique crafting materials and potential for abuse.

shadowfell_crimson_bloodstone.name: Crimson Bloodstone
shadowfell_crimson_bloodstone.description: The Crimson Bloodstone is a jagged obsidian shard that pulses with an eerie crimson light, exuding the essence of fallen vampires. When worn by a dark mage, it amplifies their mastery over necromancy and shadow magic, granting temporary resistance to psychic attacks. Its malevolent presence unnerves living creatures within 10 meters, causing them to become agitated and distrusting. The Onyx Hand covets this artifact, and any who wear it find themselves under its watchful gaze.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Necromancy Damage
effectDetails.rules: When the user casts a necromancy spell, they gain +25% damage for 1 hour. This effect ends if the user drops the bloodstone or is no longer undead-aligned.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains 15% resistance to psychic damage for 1 hour. This resistance persists until the wearer takes a long rest, sustains a wound, or removes the stone.

shadowfell_crimson_bloodstone.levelRequirementReason: Requires a user at least 3rd level to channel its dark magic effectively.
shadowfell_crimson_bloodstone.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is home to both necromancers and undead, making it the natural place for this cursed artifact.
shadowfell_crimson_bloodstone.shippingDetail: Delivered with a cloak of invisibility, ensuring discreet delivery through shadowy corridors.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning; removes when removed or the user drops it.
usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: The wearer drops the stone, sustains a wound, or takes a long rest.

shadowfell_crimson_bloodstone.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP for its necromantic power and duration benefits.

shadowfell_crimson_haunt.name: Crimson Haunt Vial
shadowfell_crimson_haunt.description: The Crimson Haunt Vial is a vial of corrupted blood that amplifies the wielder's shadow magic, allowing them to cast shadows in the void. When used within 10 feet, it causes enemies to bleed into the void, dealing an additional 2d6 necrotic damage and reducing their hit points by half for 3 rounds. The vial also grants a +1 bonus on Stealth checks and allows the user to vanish and reappear with deadly precision.

effectDetails.title: Void Bleed
effectDetails.rules: When used within 10 feet, this effect causes a target to take 2d6 necrotic damage and have their hit points reduced by half for 3 rounds. This effect has no save DC but ends if the target moves out of range or is healed.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Cloak
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +1 bonus to Stealth checks and can use this vial as an action to vanish and reappear, making them invisible for 1 minute. This effect ends when the user takes damage or when its duration expires.

shadowfell_crimson_haunt.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for a mid-level character who can handle the strategic use of shadow magic.
shadowfell_crimson_haunt.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is known for its dark magic and rare, corrupted artifacts that enhance the abilities of those who dare to wield them.
shadowfell_crimson_haunt.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring secrecy and timely delivery of this dangerous but powerful item.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (with a duration of 1 minute for Shadow Cloak)
usage.endsWhen: Target moves out of range or takes damage, or the duration expires for Shadow Cloak

shadowfell_crimson_haunt.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's powerful effects and rarity in the Shadowfell.

shadowfell_crimson_scarf.name: Crimson Scarf of the Unseen
shadowfell_crimson_scarf.description: The Crimson Scarf of the Unseen is woven from the threads of forgotten curses, granting the wearer the ability to see through the eyes of the damned. Its fabric pulses with a deep crimson hue that seems to shift and change as it captures fleeting glimpses of unseen horrors nearby. A slight movement causes minor illusions to distract foes within 10 feet, causing them to focus on illusory threats for up to 2 turns.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Enemies
effectDetails.rules: Passive ability. The wearer can see through the eyes of the damned, revealing hidden or unseen enemies within 10 feet. This effect lasts until a creature in the area moves or an attack is made.

effectDetails.title: Causes Distraction
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous action; when activated, causes minor illusions to distract foes within 10 feet for up to 2 turns. The illusions have no save DC and do not require concentration.

shadowfell_crimson_scarf.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 5 due to the item's arcane nature.
shadowfell_crimson_scarf.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendor, known for their dark wares and knowledge of the planes, carries this item as part of their extensive collection.
shadowfell_crimson_scarf.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe delivery through the shadowy realms.

usage.duration: Up to 2 turns for each use of the distraction effect
usage.endsWhen: The distraction ends when a creature in the area moves or an attack is made, or when the item's uses are exhausted.
usage.charges: Uses; recharges after a long rest

shadowfell_crimson_scarf.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the rare and powerful abilities of the scarf, suitable for a character of level 5.

shadowfell_crimson_shroud.name: Crimson Shroud of the Void
shadowfell_crimson_shroud.description: The Crimson Shroud of the Void is a cloak spun from the very threads of forgotten souls and the dark essence of the Shadowfell. It grants its wearer invisibility under moonless skies, allowing for deadly ambushes in the collapsing corridors of the realm's depths. When worn, one can phase through solid matter once per combat round, providing a tactical advantage against foes. The cloak’s shadows protect from harm, reducing damage taken by 15% when dealing with non-vampire enemies.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes invisible for 10 seconds. This effect can only be used under moonless skies. It ends if the wearer attacks or casts a spell, or when the wearer moves more than 5 feet.

effectDetails.title: Phase Through Solid Matter
effectDetails.rules: Once per combat round, the wearer can phase through solid matter as an action. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends early if the wearer attacks or casts a spell.

shadowfell_crimson_shroud.levelRequirementReason: The cloak’s power demands a moderate understanding of the Shadowfell's mysteries.
shadowfell_crimson_shroud.vendorReason: The Shadowfell knows all who dwell within its realm and their secrets; it is only fitting that this vendor sells such an item.
shadowfell_crimson_shroud.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral couriers, the cloak arrives in a puff of dark mist.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Attack, spell cast, or moving more than 5 feet

shadowfell_crimson_shroud.priceReason: The cloak’s rarity and unique properties justify its moderate price.

shadowfell_crimson_vial.name: Crimson Vial of Echoes
shadowfell_crimson_vial.description: The Crimson Vial of Echoes is a vial filled with blood-amber liquid, said to amplify and distort voices spoken into it. When you speak your commands clearly through this vial in the Shadowfell’s eerie corridors, the echoes can reveal hidden traps and distract enemies. Holding the vial adds +2 to Stealth checks, but be wary—it also causes nearby foes to flinch if your tone is harsh or commanding.

effectDetails.title: Echoes Voice
effectDetails.rules: When you speak a command into the vial, it emits an echoing call that lasts for 30 seconds. This echo can reveal nearby traps and distract enemies within 30 feet of the source. The effect has no save DC and does not expend charges.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While holding the vial, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for up to 1 hour. This benefit is lost if your tone becomes harsh or commanding while speaking through the vial. The use does not consume charges.

shadowfell_crimson_vial.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level, as it can be used by adventurers of all levels to navigate the dangerous Shadowfell.
shadowfell_crimson_vial.vendorReason: The vendors in the Shadowfell specialize in items that help travelers and explorers navigate their treacherous territory.
shadowfell_crimson_vial.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Shy Guy Smugglers, known for their unpredictable but reliable deliveries through the Shadowfell’s mazes.

usage.activation: Bonus action to speak into the vial and cause it to echo.
usage.duration: 30 seconds of echoing effect.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if you stop speaking clearly into the vial.

shadowfell_crimson_vial.priceReason: The vial's price reflects its utility in a dangerous environment, providing both tactical advantages and strategic benefits without depleting resources.

shadowfell_cursed_bloodstone.name: Cursed Bloodstone
shadowfell_cursed_bloodstone.description: The Cursed Bloodstone glows with an eerie, pulsating light that seems to flicker between shades of purple and crimson. This gemstone is said to have been crafted from the very essence of a corrupted soul, imprisoned within its crystalline form. When worn, it allows you to momentarily summon spectral whispers that confuse your foes, sowing doubt and discord in their ranks. A touch of this stone drains an enemy's vitality, leaving them weakened and disoriented.

effectDetails.title: Confuse Enemies
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can cast the *Suggestion* spell (save DC 13) upon one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be confused for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Drain Vitality
effectDetails.rules: When you touch an enemy, it takes 1d4 + your Charisma modifier Shadow Damage. Additionally, the creature is weakened and suffers from disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of its next turn.

shadowfell_cursed_bloodstone.levelRequirementReason: This cursed gem requires a certain level to wield its power effectively.
shadowfell_cursed_bloodstone.vendorReason: The Shadowfell's dark rituals and corrupting essence align with the Cursed Bloodstone's malevolent nature.
shadowfell_cursed_bloodstone.shippingDetail: Due to its cursed nature, it must be carefully packed in a special container to prevent any accidental release of its malice during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Confuse Enemies; until the start of the target's next turn for Drain Vitality
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends as soon as the creature is no longer targeted or when you use another action to end it.

shadowfell_cursed_bloodstone.priceReason: This cursed artifact, though powerful, comes with a significant risk and must be valued accordingly.

shadowfell_cursed_forged.name: Cursed Forge Blade
shadowfell_cursed_forged.description: The Cursed Forge Blade, hewn from the very heart of the Shadowfell's dark forge, exudes a malevolent aura that repels all light and warmth. Its blade glows with an unholy luminescence, drawing closer to its intended targets. The blade not only deals extra damage to undead foes but also grants allies within 8 meters a chilling aura, increasing their movement speed by +10% while they endure the blade's malevolent influence.

effectDetails.title: Unholy Blade
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with this weapon, it deals an additional +20% damage against undead and cursed enemies. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chilling Aura
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 8 meters gain a +10% bonus to their movement speed for as long as they are in contact with or within this blade's aura. The aura remains active while you wield the weapon, and it dissipates immediately upon losing line of effect.

shadowfell_cursed_forged.levelRequirementReason: This blade requires a certain level to channel its unholy power effectively.
shadowfell_cursed_forged.vendorReason: The Shadowfell's dark forges are known for crafting such cursed weapons, and the vendor is well-versed in dealing with such artifacts.
shadowfell_cursed_forged.shippingDetail: Due to its unholy nature, this blade must be delivered via Lakitu Drones, ensuring it arrives safely without corrupting lesser means of transport.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon drawing or sheathing the weapon.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after each attack.
usage.endsWhen: The blade's aura dissipates if you lose line of effect with it, and its effects are expended once per long rest.

shadowfell_cursed_forged.priceReason: This blade is crafted from rare materials and requires significant magical energy to maintain its unholy properties.

shadowfell_cursed_gaze.name: Cursed Gaze of the Onyx Hand
shadowfell_cursed_gaze.description: The Cursed Gaze of the Onyx Hand is a shattered mirror fragment with an eerie sheen. Its whispers are said to be the echoes of forgotten terrors, and when worn, it channels these dark energies into the wearer’s psyche, granting them insight into their own shadows while making them harder to detect by others. In the dim light of dusk or deeper night, this artifact enhances stealth and reveals hidden threats that lurk in the darkness.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Detection
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect hidden enemies within areas of shadow. This effect lasts until the end of their next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Eclipse of Fear
effectDetails.rules: For every hour the Cursed Gaze is worn, the wearer gains a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks in dark environments and a -10 penalty to Charisma (Persuasion) checks. This effect ends when the wearer stops wearing it.

shadowfell_cursed_gaze.levelRequirementReason: This artifact is designed for adventurers just beginning their journey, providing them with immediate utility without overwhelming power.
shadowfell_cursed_gaze.vendorReason: Shadowfell specialists in dark magic and ancient relics are the only ones who can offer such a powerful yet balanced item.
shadowfell_cursed_gaze.shippingDetail: Carefully packed with protective enchantments to prevent accidental damage during transit.

usage.activation: Passive effect once worn, no activation required.
usage.duration: Until the end of their next short or long rest for Shadow Detection; lasts for every hour worn for Eclipse of Fear.
usage.endsWhen: When the wearer stops wearing it or at the end of a short/long rest depending on the effect.

shadowfell_cursed_gaze.priceReason: The artifact's rarity and its ability to enhance stealth while also providing insight into hidden enemies justify this price.

shadowfell_cursed_kingdom_key.name: Cursed Kingdom Key
shadowfell_cursed_kingdom_key.description: The Cursed Kingdom Key, forged from the last breath of a fallen king who refused to yield his throne to the Shadowfell, glows faintly in the dark, its rusted brass etched with ancient runes that whisper of forgotten betrayals and lost kingdoms. When used on any locked door within the realm, it unlocks not just the physical barrier but also the past—revealing hidden chambers and the true fate of those who once ruled. The key’s curse haunts the wearer’s dreams each night, replaying scenes from a different kingdom’s collapse, leaving them forever changed by shadows and secrets.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Hidden Realms
effectDetails.rules: Activates on insertion into a locked door. Reveals hidden chambers, forgotten betrayals, and the true fate of the kingdom's rulers. The key grants +2 to all Diplomacy rolls against factions in the Shadowfell for 1 hour after use.

effectDetails.title: Curse of Royal Dreams
effectDetails.rules: Each night following its use, the wearer dreams of a different kingdom’s collapse, causing -3 to all Perception checks when using the key outside the Shadowfell. The curse lasts until the key is reburied or destroyed.

shadowfell_cursed_kingdom_key.levelRequirementReason: The Cursed Kingdom Key requires significant magical power and understanding of royal lore to wield effectively.
shadowfell_cursed_kingdom_key.vendorReason: Only the Mages Guild and Onyx Hand Vampires, who possess the arcane knowledge to craft such a powerful item, can sell it.
shadowfell_cursed_kingdom_key.shippingDetail: Ships via special courier with expedited delivery within the Shadowfell region only.

usage.activation: Inserted into any locked door within the Shadowfell realm.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, but effects last for 1 hour after use.
usage.endsWhen: The key is destroyed or reburied. The curse ends when the key is no longer worn by the user.

shadowfell_cursed_kingdom_key.priceReason: This item’s rarity and powerful effects justify its high price, serving as a key to unlocking ancient secrets while posing a significant risk.

shadowfell_cursed_mirror_sword.name: Cursed Mirror Sword
shadowfell_cursed_mirror_sword.description: The Cursed Mirror Sword is a blade forged from the shattered reflections of the Shadowfell’s most feared vampires, its edge glowing with an otherworldly dark aura. The sword strikes with deadly precision and grace, reflecting 20% of damage taken back as energy (if the enemy is undead). It whispers secrets of the Shadowfell in a low rumble, enhancing your attacks against shadow-based foes by +15%. This weapon’s power comes at a price, for it draws its strength from the very darkness it fights.
effects: Reflects 20% of damage taken back as energy (if enemy is undead)

effectDetails.title: Shadow Reflection
effectDetails.rules: When the Cursed Mirror Sword takes damage, it reflects 20% of that damage back to the attacker if they are an undead creature. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Dark Precision
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +15% bonus to hit and damage against shadow-based enemies as long as the sword is in their possession. This bonus does not stack with any other similar bonuses.

shadowfell_cursed_mirror_sword.levelRequirementReason: This sword requires a minimum level of 3 due to its dark magic and the precision it demands from its wielder.
shadowfell_cursed_mirror_sword.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is where this cursed weapon was forged, and only those who understand its power can offer it for sale.
shadowfell_cursed_mirror_sword.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, known for delivering dangerous goods safely. Delivery may take several days due to the unpredictable nature of the Shadowfell.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wielding the sword.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the wielder drops or sheathes the weapon.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ceases if the weapon is not in use, i.e., when it's sheathed or dropped.

shadowfell_cursed_mirror_sword.priceReason: The sword’s rarity and its unique abilities justify this price, as it requires careful handling and a deep understanding of dark magic.

shadowfell_dark_blood_talisman.name: Dark Blood Talisman
shadowfell_dark_blood_talisman.description: The Dark Blood Talisman pulses with an eerie crimson light, its surface etched with ancient runes that hum with dark magic. Crafted from the bones of a vampire's hand and infused with essence from a cursed bloodline, it grants the wearer temporary invulnerability to darkness-based damage and enhances their ability to absorb harm. This relic is said to have been forged in the heart of the Shadowfell by a shadow mage who sought to harness the power of night itself.

effectDetails.title: Dark Absorption
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when you take damage from a darkness-based source. You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) for 10 seconds, reducing the amount of damage taken by 50% during this duration.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Strike
effectDetails.rules: Increase your chance to land a critical hit with dark magic attacks by 15%. This effect lasts until you use another action that deals damage or until you make an attack roll against a non-darkness-based target.

shadowfell_dark_blood_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The talisman's power is too potent for novices and requires experience to wield its shadowy magic.
shadowfell_dark_blood_talisman.vendorReason: Shadowfell traders specialize in relics of the dark arts, making this talisman a natural addition to their inventory.
shadowfell_dark_blood_talisman.shippingDetail: The package arrives under cover of darkness, delivered by drone through a network of shadowy conduits that ensure swift and discreet delivery.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: You take damage from a non-darkness-based source or make an attack roll against a target not affected by darkness.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use can be active at a time.

shadowfell_dark_blood_talisman.priceReason: The talisman's rarity and the dark magic it contains justify its moderate price point in the market.

shadowfell_dark_echo_ring.name: Dark Echo Ring
shadowfell_dark_echo_ring.description: The Dark Echo Ring is forged from the very essence of the Shadowfell, its surface etched with runes that shimmer and fade like the whispers of forgotten souls. Worn by those who venture into the realm’s darkness, it grants temporary invisibility to the wearer, allowing them to slip past unseen. More than mere stealth, this ring allows the user to hear the true intentions behind an enemy's words, piercing through their pretenses as if they were the echoes of the Shadowfell itself.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility and Intent Detection
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can activate the ring to become temporarily invisible for up to 10 seconds. Additionally, this activation allows them to gain insight into an enemy's true intentions within the next round.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Undead Combat
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Dark Echo Ring, the wearer deals an additional +5 damage against undead creatures. This effect is always active while the ring is worn.

shadowfell_dark_echo_ring.levelRequirementReason: The Shadowfell's influence can be felt even by those who are not yet seasoned warriors.
shadowfell_dark_echo_ring.vendorReason: The Shadowfell itself curates and sells items imbued with the realm’s dark magic, including this cursed ring of whispers.
shadowfell_dark_echo_ring.shippingDetail: The ring arrives wrapped in the very essence of the Shadowfell, ensuring its secrecy and protection during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate invisibility; passive intent detection while active.
usage.duration: Invisibility lasts for up to 10 seconds per activation.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer stops concentrating or takes damage.

shadowfell_dark_echo_ring.priceReason: Balanced at a price of 1000 XP, the ring's effects are potent but not overpowered for its level.

shadowfell_dark_mirror.name: Mirror of the Unseen Truth
shadowfell_dark_mirror.description: The Mirror of the Unseen Truth is a fractured, obsidian glass that shimmers with dark runes and whispers of forgotten lore. When held before an adversary, it reveals their deepest secrets through psychic resonance, making visible what they most wish to hide. It is said that gazing into this mirror can grant insights into one's own soul, but only at the cost of a fleeting glimpse into the abyssal depths of one’s own mind.

effectDetails.title: Phantom Echo
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy speaks within range, they see and hear a phantom echo of their own demise. This effect lasts for 1 round and grants the user advantage on Intimidation checks made against that target.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Pact
effectDetails.rules: For 1 round after activation, the user's actions are mirrored by the mirror’s reflection. The user gains a +20% bonus to Intimidation checks and can see through their own eyes as if they were their own reflection.

shadowfell_dark_mirror.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant mental fortitude to wield, making it suitable only for characters of at least fifth level.
shadowfell_dark_mirror.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendors are the keepers of ancient relics and arcane artifacts, including this mirror with its dark secrets.
shadowfell_dark_mirror.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of the mirror, it is shipped by special courier under strict conditions to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for 1 round
usage.endsWhen: At the end of the user's next turn after activation
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest

shadowfell_dark_mirror.priceReason: The mirror’s rare crafting materials and arcane properties justify its moderate price in XP.

shadowfell_dark_mirror_core.name: Dark Mirror Core Fragment
shadowfell_dark_mirror_core.description: A Dark Mirror Core Fragment, a jagged shard of the Shadowfell’s fractured mirror, reveals foes' true forms, amplifying their psychic attacks and granting temporary insight into their souls. Crafted from the very essence of the plane's mists, this fragment can be integrated into armor or staffs to unleash devastating psychic strikes. Fused into a weapon, it doubles as a potent defensive tool that counters attacks with visions of their true forms.

effectDetails.title: Form Reflection
effectDetails.rules: The user can activate this effect as a bonus action. For the next 1 round, any melee attack made against the wielder is treated as an opportunity attack. The target of the attack must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When used in conjunction with a psychic weapon, this fragment enhances its damage by +30%. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

shadowfell_dark_mirror_core.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from the Shadowfell's essence, this fragment demands no high level of mastery.
shadowfell_dark_mirror_core.vendorReason: The Dark Mirror Core Fragment is a specialty item created by the denizens of the Shadowfell and sold exclusively by them.
shadowfell_dark_mirror_core.shippingDetail: Ships via shadowy courier, arriving in a sealed, mist-laden case. Delivery time varies based on location.

usage.activation: Bonus action to reflect form; once per short rest to enhance damage.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for reflection; enhanced damage lasts until end of next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the wielder is no longer in contact with their weapon or armor.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by long rests.

shadowfell_dark_mirror_core.priceReason: Crafted from Shadowfell essence and requiring integration into a weapon or armor, this fragment justifies its moderate cost in XP.

shadowfell_dark_ritual_book.name: Tome of the Blackened Veil
shadowfell_dark_ritual_book.description: The Tome of the Blackened Veil is an ancient grimoire bound in dark leather, its pages adorned with arcane sigils and inscribed with the secrets of the Shadowfell. It whispers of forbidden rituals and shadowy entities. Reading it allows you to command shadows for a brief moment, granting temporary control over these malevolent forces. Each page turns reveals a new terror from the depths of the Shadowfell, but beware—its power comes at a cost.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Control
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command shadows within 30 feet for up to one minute. You gain temporary control over one willing creature or shadowy entity within range, allowing it to perform simple tasks under your direction. The effect ends if the creature takes any damage.

effectDetails.title: Fearful Presence
effectDetails.rules: You can use a bonus action to unleash a wave of fear that affects all creatures within 30 feet who see you. Creatures must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute, during which they have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

shadowfell_dark_ritual_book.levelRequirementReason: Requires a moderate understanding of Shadowfell magic to safely handle its power.
shadowfell_dark_ritual_book.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is the tome's origin, and only those who understand it can sell such knowledge.
shadowfell_dark_ritual_book.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay; delivery may be delayed by up to one week due to unpredictable Shadowfell currents.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Shadow Control) / Up to 1 minute (Fearful Presence)
usage.endsWhen: The creature takes damage (Shadow Control); the affected creatures succeed on their save (Fearful Presence)
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use of each effect per short or long rest

shadowfell_dark_ritual_book.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its moderate power and rarity.

shadowfell_dream_satchel.name: Dream Satchel
shadowfell_dream_satchel.description: The Dream Satchel is a tattered leather pouch, its surface etched with arcane sigils and shadowy runes. It holds fragments of forgotten nightmares, each one a relic from a dreamer's subconscious. When opened, these fragments reveal the horrors lurking in the depths of the mind, and can be used to summon creatures from the twisted realms of the Shadowfell. Only those attuned to dreams or madness can wield its power, as the bag itself seems to draw sustenance from the very terrors it contains.

effectDetails.title: Nightmare Fragments
effectDetails.rules: Unearth one fragment by opening the satchel, which reveals a random dream horror. The fragment can be used to summon a creature from the Nightmare dimension for 1d4 rounds. This effect requires concentration and can only be done once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Dreamsummon
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to summon a minor nightmare creature from the Shadowfell. The summoned creature remains until dismissed by its owner or slain in combat, with no limits on uses per day.

shadowfell_dream_satchel.levelRequirementReason: The satchel's power draws directly from the wielder's mind, making it accessible to dreamers and delirious mages.
shadowfell_dream_satchel.vendorReason: Shadowfell's network spans across the realms of nightmares, making them the perfect purveyors of this arcane artifact.
shadowfell_dream_satchel.shippingDetail: The satchel is shipped within a protective cocoon to prevent its contents from leaking into the waking world during transit.

usage.activation: Activate as an action or bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for summoning, concentration for fragments, and lasts until dismissed or ends naturally.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the creature is dismissed, the dreamer's concentration is broken, or the satchel is destroyed.

shadowfell_dream_satchel.priceReason: The satchel's rarity and its ability to summon creatures from the Shadowfell justify a price of 1000 XP.

shadowfell_echo_bottle.name: Echo Bottle of the Shattered Veil
shadowfell_echo_bottle.description: The Echo Bottle of the Shattered Veil is a vial encased in obsidian, its surface etched with runes that glow faintly under moonlight. Once consumed, it grants the user an eerie connection to the shadowy veil between worlds, allowing them to hear the whispers of the dead and the movements of hidden foes for a fleeting moment. The air around you seems to resonate with forgotten cries, sharpening your auditory senses but at the cost of a soul's quiet lament.
effects: Temporary auditory dominance over the battlefield

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Hearing
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you gain advantage on Perception checks related to hearing and detecting hidden enemies. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until your next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Aural Dominance
effectDetails.rules: For the duration, you have a +30% chance of detecting hidden enemies within range. You can use this ability only once per long rest.

shadowfell_echo_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a higher level to activate due to its potent shadow magic and the inherent risk involved.
shadowfell_echo_bottle.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendors are well-acquainted with the dark arts, making them the only ones who can source such powerful relics.
shadowfell_echo_bottle.shippingDetail: Delivered via a shadowy courier that ensures swift and safe passage through the Veil's treacherous paths.

usage.activation: A bonus action to consume and activate the bottle.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until your next short rest, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: You are killed, silenced, or fall unconscious. The effect is exhausted at the end of each long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the item refills its charge after a long rest.

shadowfell_echo_bottle.priceReason: The price reflects the rare materials and shadow magic required to craft this artifact, balanced by its temporary nature and limited use.

shadowfell_echo_cloak.name: Echo Cloak of the Whispering Night
shadowfell_echo_cloak.description: The Echo Cloak of the Whispering Night weaves shadows into a cloak that whispers secrets of the fallen, its voice a riddle to the unchosen. Worn in darkness, it conceals both sight and sound, but only those who know its cryptic tongue may hear its truths. The cloak's wearer can cast Shadow Echo as an action, revealing enemies' locations for moments, and when struck by an attack, it unleashes a psychic scream that stuns foes for one turn.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Echo
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer speaks and uses their action to cast Shadow Echo, they reveal the location of all enemies within 60 feet for 3 seconds. This effect has a limited cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Stun
effectDetails.rules: If the cloak is attacked, it emits a psychic scream as an instantaneous reaction that stuns all creatures within 15 feet until their next turn. The wearer must be conscious for this to activate.

shadowfell_echo_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's whispering secrets and defensive mechanism require a certain level of mastery in stealth and combat.
shadowfell_echo_cloak.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is home to the whispers of the dead, so it holds no surprise that the cloak comes from there.
shadowfell_echo_cloak.shippingDetail: Carefully packed in a sealed container to preserve its shadowy essence during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and limited duration (Shadow Echo)
usage.endsWhen: Cooldown ends, attack ends, or the wearer is incapacitated

shadowfell_echo_cloak.priceReason: The cloak's rarity, lore, and unique abilities justify its moderate price.

shadowfell_echo_heart_ammunition.name: Echo Heart Ammunition
shadowfell_echo_heart_ammunition.description: These vials contain the fractured echoes of the Shadowfell’s lost hearts, capturing the very essence of undeath and spectral malice. When fired from any ranged weapon, they unleash a haunting resonance that disorients foes for three seconds, leaving them staggered and confused. Echo Heart Ammunition also deals +10% additional damage to undead and spectral creatures, making it an invaluable tool for ranged assassins hunting the Onyx Hand’s enforcers in the heart of the Shadowfell.
effects: Disorients enemies for three seconds on hit
+10% damage to undead and spectral foes

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When a ranged weapon attack made with Echo Heart Ammunition hits an enemy, the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented for three seconds. This effect ends early if the target takes any damage from another source.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Undead Damage
effectDetails.rules: This ammunition deals +10% additional damage to undead and spectral creatures, stacking with other sources of extra damage. There is no limit on the number of shots this effect can be used per day.

shadowfell_echo_heart_ammunition.levelRequirementReason: This ammunition requires a character's experience in Shadowfell combat techniques.
shadowfell_echo_heart_ammunition.vendorReason: Shadowfell merchants specialize in rare and deadly goods from the realm’s depths, including Echo Heart Ammunition.
shadowfell_echo_heart_ammunition.shippingDetail: Due to its dangerous nature, this item is only shipped via the Shy Guy Smugglers' secret routes within the Shadowfell.

usage.activation: On hit with a ranged weapon attack
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting three seconds on disorientation
usage.endsWhen: The target takes damage from another source or is attacked again by the same attacker

shadowfell_echo_heart_ammunition.priceReason: This ammunition is crafted with rare and dangerous materials, making it a valuable yet balanced addition to any ranged arsenal.

shadowfell_echo_of_the_cursed.name: Echo of the Cursed
shadowfell_echo_of_the_cursed.description: The Echo of the Cursed is a pendant made from twisted onyx and silver, said to be crafted in the depths of the Shadowfell. When worn, it hums with malevolent whispers that guide its wearer through hidden passages. It grants insight into secret locations and reveals the presence of Onyx Hand nests nearby. Consuming this item temporarily bestows 'Shadow Sight,' allowing you to see through shadows and detect invisible foes.
effects: +10% chance to find secret doors or traps
Reveals nearby Onyx Hand nests with 95% accuracy

effectDetails.title: Shadow Insight
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. The wearer gains a +10% chance on Perception checks to detect secret doors and traps.

effectDetails.title: Onyx Nest Detection
effectDetails.rules: Active use. Reveals the location of nearby Onyx Hand nests within 60 feet with a successful Wisdom (Perception) check, DC 15. This effect has a daily limit of three uses.

shadowfell_echo_of_the_cursed.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to handle the cursed energies effectively.
shadowfell_echo_of_the_cursed.vendorReason: The Shadowfell's dark magic is well-suited for creating and managing such powerful artifacts.
shadowfell_echo_of_the_cursed.shippingDetail: Special handling required due to its dangerous nature; arrival time may vary.

usage.activation: Passive effect. No activation needed, always active while worn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Onyx Nest Detection when used.
usage.endsWhen: Onyx Nest Detection ends immediately after use if not reactivated within the daily limit.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day up to three activations.

shadowfell_echo_of_the_cursed.priceReason: Balanced pricing for a rare artifact that offers significant but not overpowered abilities.

shadowfell_echo_of_the_fallen_mirror.name: Echo of the Fallen Mirror
shadowfell_echo_of_the_fallen_mirror.description: The Echo of the Fallen Mirror is a fractured glass relic, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer in shades of shadow and light. This mirror fragment allows you to glimpse into the past, revealing an enemy's true form for brief moments—mere seconds, but enough to see through their illusions and tactics. As the shards catch the light, they whisper the deepest fears of your foes, providing a perception bonus in combat. This mirror is a relic of the Shadowfell, crafted by ancient beings who sought to understand the nature of fear and deception.

effectDetails.title: Reveals True Form
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this mirror allows you to briefly see an enemy's true form for up to 5 seconds. This effect grants disadvantage on saving throws against illusions and gives you advantage on Perception checks related to the target. The effect ends when you use another action or your concentration is broken.

effectDetails.title: Whispers Fears
effectDetails.rules: For every round this mirror's effect is active, you gain +1 bonus to Perception checks made against the targeted enemy. This bonus increases by 1 for each additional round the effect remains active but cannot exceed +3. The bonus ends when you lose concentration or the duration expires.

shadowfell_echo_of_the_fallen_mirror.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a higher level to wield, as understanding and controlling its power demands significant experience.
shadowfell_echo_of_the_fallen_mirror.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is home to many ancient relics, including this mirror's origin story.
shadowfell_echo_of_the_fallen_mirror.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral messengers who ensure the package arrives safely and on time.

usage.duration: Up to 5 seconds per activation, with a maximum duration of 10 rounds
usage.endsWhen: Concentration is broken or when another action is taken

shadowfell_echo_of_the_fallen_mirror.priceReason: The mirror's price reflects its rare nature and the significant XP it grants for its unique utility in combat.

shadowfell_echo_silence_crown.name: Echo Silence Crown
shadowfell_echo_silence_crown.description: The Echo Silence Crown exudes a dark, shadowy aura that muffles the whispers of foes and amplifies their innermost thoughts. Crafted from the twisted roots of the Shadowfell, this cursed artifact resonates with the wearer’s malevolent intent, granting them stealth during silent assassinations. The crown’s power is fueled by the wearer’s own darkness, making it a dangerous tool for those who seek to remain unseen and unheard.
shadowfell_echo_silence_crown.shippedBy: Pipe Express - Couriers of the Dark Veil

effectDetails.title: Silent Target
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is moving stealthily, nearby enemies suffer from a 10-second silence effect, rendering them unable to communicate. This lasts until an enemy successfully makes a Wisdom (Perception) check with a DC of 13 or takes damage.

effectDetails.title: Hallucinatory Echoes
effectDetails.rules: After 30 seconds of prolonged wear, the wearer must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or be subjected to minor hallucinations that last for 1 minute. During this time, their vision is distorted, causing them to see strange and unsettling images.

shadowfell_echo_silence_crown.levelRequirementReason: The crown’s dark magic requires a wielder with enough experience to resist its malevolent influence.
shadowfell_echo_silence_crown.vendorReason: Shadowfell has exclusive access to the twisted materials and ancient crafting techniques needed for such an artifact.
shadowfell_echo_silence_crown.shippingDetail: Due to its cursed nature, the crown must be delivered through the shadowy realm via Pipe Express’s specialized dark courier service.
