shadowfell_vampiric_crimson_core.priceReason: This item is crafted from rare materials and requires specialized knowledge to use effectively.

shadowfell_vampiric_crimson_scepter.name: Vampiric Crimson Scepter
shadowfell_vampiric_crimson_scepter.description: The Vampiric Crimson Scepter is a ceremonial staff forged from the bones of ancient shadows and drenched in the stolen blood of the damned. With each swing, it calls forth ephemeral portals that consume light and life, dragging foes into the void. The scepter's wielder gains dark affinity, dealing an additional 15% damage to shadow-based attacks, but at a steep cost: they must sacrifice 20% of their hit points with every use.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Portal
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, creating a portal that teleports enemies into the shadow realm for 10 seconds. The portal has a 15-second cooldown and can only target one creature per use.

effectDetails.title: Dark Affinity
effectDetails.rules: Grants +15% bonus damage to all attacks dealing shadow-based damage, but consumes 20% of the wielder's hit points each time it is used. This effect lasts until the start of the wielder’s next turn.

shadowfell_vampiric_crimson_scepter.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third-level proficiency to control such dark magic.
shadowfell_vampiric_crimson_scepter.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is a realm where darkness and shadow are ever-present, making it the natural home for such artifacts.
shadowfell_vampiric_crimson_scepter.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral courier, ensuring safe passage through the foulest of places.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until end of next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends on the wielder's next turn or when they take damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use costs 20% HP

shadowfell_vampiric_crimson_scepter.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its dark magic and the risk of using it.

shadowfell_vampiric_echo.name: Vampiric Echo
shadowfell_vampiric_echo.description: The Vampiric Echo is a cursed mirror crafted from the very shadows of the Shadowfell, its surface etched with runes that whisper the final word spoken by your target or your own last dying breath. Upon activation, it echoes this spectral echo, leaving you and those nearby shaken by the haunting memory. This deadly psychological weapon cannot be used on a corpse, as the mirror draws strength from the living voice.

effectDetails.title: Echoes Last Spoken Word
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this mirror reveals the last word spoken by your target or your own final thoughts. You must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Psychological Impact
effectDetails.rules: If you fail the save, you and each creature within 10 feet of you are also frightened for 1 minute. This effect can be ended early with a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

shadowfell_vampiric_echo.levelRequirementReason: The Vampiric Echo requires no level, as its power lies in the darkness it manipulates rather than the strength of the wielder.
shadowfell_vampiric_echo.vendorReason: Shadowfell merchants are known for dealing in dark artifacts and psychological tools, making them the perfect purveyors of this cursed mirror.
shadowfell_vampiric_echo.shippingDetail: The Boo Spectral Mail ensures safe delivery through their spectral courier network, but be wary—the journey may feel longer than it should.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect and 1 minute for the frightened condition to wear off
usage.endsWhen: On a failed Wisdom save or when used on a corpse

shadowfell_vampiric_echo.priceReason: The Vampiric Echo is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity, cursed nature, and the psychological impact it delivers.

shadowfell_vampiric_echo_rod.name: Vampiric Echo Rod
shadowfell_vampiric_echo_rod.description: The Vampiric Echo Rod hums with the restless whispers of ancient vampire ancestors, its staff etched with sigils of shadow and blood. Each strike channels their power into a fleeting veil of darkness that cloaks the wielder in Shadow Stealth. The rod's strikes also reflect damage back at the foe, turning the fight against them. A relic forged in the shadowed depths of the Vastshadow Mountains, it shatters upon contact with pure light, a symbol of its vulnerability to divine purity.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Cloak
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the Vampiric Echo Rod to cloak yourself in Shadow Stealth for up to three turns. While cloaked, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and gain a +30 bonus to your AC until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Rebound Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you deal damage with this rod, you reflect 50% of that damage back to the target. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

shadowfell_vampiric_echo_rod.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 6 due to its powerful abilities and the Shadow Cloak's strategic advantage.
shadowfell_vampiric_echo_rod.vendorReason: The Vampiric Echo Rod is a rare relic of ancient vampire lore, making it a fitting item for the shadowy vendors of the Shadowfell region.
shadowfell_vampiric_echo_rod.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe delivery through the treacherous planes of the Shadowfell.

usage.duration: Up to three turns
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when it is used up or you are struck by pure light.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short or long rest

shadowfell_vampiric_echo_rod.priceReason: The rod's unique combination of stealth and damage reflection, along with its connection to ancient vampire lore, justifies this price.

shadowfell_vampiric_gaze.name: Vampiric Gaze
shadowfell_vampiric_gaze.description: The Vampiric Gaze is a cursed eyepiece forged in the shadowy realms of the Shadowfell, crafted from dark obsidian and enchanted with the essence of a forgotten vampire noble. This eerie relic grants its wearer the chilling ability to pierce through shadows and detect hidden foes, making ambushes futile. Its aura emanates a ghastly glow that slows any creature within 10 meters, reducing their movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Piercer
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Reveals hidden paths and ambush points within 20 meters, providing advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for detecting secret doors or hidden creatures in shadows for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Ghastly Aura
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. Grants a chilling aura that reduces the movement speed of all enemies within 10 meters by 30% until dispelled, triggered by an attack against you or when this item is destroyed.

shadowfell_vampiric_gaze.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to harness its dark magic without succumbing fully to the curse.
shadowfell_vampiric_gaze.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendor specializes in artifacts from their realm, including this cursed yet powerful eyepiece.
shadowfell_vampiric_gaze.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral messengers that navigate through the dark realms with eerie precision.

usage.activation: Bonus action to reveal hidden areas or as a passive effect for aura.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, ongoing until dispelled or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by attack or when the item is no longer in your possession.

shadowfell_vampiric_gaze.priceReason: The price reflects its rare crafting materials and dark enchantments, balancing its powerful abilities with a reasonable cost for high-level adventurers.

shadowfell_vampiric_satchel.name: Vampiric Satchel of the Hollow Throne
shadowfell_vampiric_satchel.description: The Vampiric Satchel of the Hollow Throne is a leather pouch imbued with the malevolent essence of the Shadowfell, absorbing ambient darkness and converting it into potent dark energy. Crafted from tattered cloaks once worn by the undead, its surface is etched with runes that pulse with an eerie glow. The satchel can store up to 300 points of shadow energy, which can be used to summon spectral minions or power rituals that bend reality itself.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When worn in a dark environment for at least one hour, the satchel absorbs ambient shadow energy. The amount absorbed is equal to half the darkness level of the location (maximum 300 points). This effect can be triggered once per day.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, summoning one spectral ghoul for three turns. The ghoul is a CR 2 creature that aids the user in combat and can be dismissed at will. This effect costs 200 points of stored shadow energy.

shadowfell_vampiric_satchel.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers who have begun to explore the darker corners of reality.
shadowfell_vampiric_satchel.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is home to many dark rituals and necromancy, making it only fitting that this item be sold by a vendor from within its domain.
shadowfell_vampiric_satchel.shippingDetail: Delivered via shadowfax, ensuring the package arrives in perfect darkness, even in the most treacherous conditions.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon spectral ghoul; once per day for shadow absorption.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (summoning) or until dismissed (spectral minion).
usage.endsWhen: Shadow absorption ends after one hour of darkness, and the satchel's energy is exhausted upon use.
usage.charges: Limited to three uses per week.

shadowfell_vampiric_satchel.priceReason: The rarity and utility of the satchel justify its moderate price in experience points.

shadowfell_vampiric_scent_amulet.name: Vampiric Scent Amulet
shadowfell_vampiric_scent_amulet.description: This dark amulet, forged from the bones of ancient Shadowfell creatures, hums with a necrotic energy that quells fears and fills wounds. Worn by those who dare walk through the most haunted locales, it absorbs ambient fear to mend flesh, turning despair into health. Crafted in the trials of the Onyx Hand, its power is as dark as the void itself yet offers respite to those brave enough to wield it.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Fear
effectDetails.rules: When you are within a 10-foot radius of an area filled with fear, such as from a creature or spell effect, this amulet absorbs 50% of the ambient fear. You gain temporary hit points equal to the amount absorbed.

effectDetails.title: Heals Wounds
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn when you have temporary hit points gained from Absorbs Fear, regain an additional 10 hit points. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

shadowfell_vampiric_scent_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Wielders must be at least level 3 to resist the necrotic power of this amulet and channel its dark magic effectively.
shadowfell_vampiric_scent_amulet.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendor, known for their trade in relics from forgotten trials, carries this amulet as a testament to its ancient origins.
shadowfell_vampiric_scent_amulet.shippingDetail: The delivery is handled by spectral ponies who traverse the Shadowfell at night, ensuring the amulet arrives under cover of darkness.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon wearing and remaining in an area of fear.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; regains temporary hit points only once per short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Restored to full health at the start of a short or long rest.

shadowfell_vampiric_scent_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and necrotic power justify its price, providing both defensive and healing benefits within the Shadowfell's challenging environments.

shadowfell_vampiric_shroud.name: Vampiric Shroud
shadowfell_vampiric_shroud.description: The Vampiric Shroud, crafted from the breath of the Onyx Hand in the heart of the Shadowfell, is a dark velvet cloak that whispers secrets to those who wear it. It grants invisibility in dim light and enhances stealth, but at a cost: one Hit Point drains per second while cloaked. Perfect for lurking in the shadows or setting deadly traps, this eerie garment leaves a trail of fading life force behind its wearer.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility in Dim Light
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Grants invisibility while in dim light, lasts until the start of your next turn or until you attack, cast a spell, or end this effect early. While invisible, you can only take one action per round and incur a -2 penalty to Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Vampiric Shroud, your Dexterity (Stealth) skill is increased by 2. This effect ends if you take any action that would normally break cover or if you are struck in combat.

shadowfell_vampiric_shroud.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to channel the dark magic of the Shadowfell effectively.
shadowfell_vampiric_shroud.vendorReason: The Shadowfell's own merchants understand and sell items that harness its power.
shadowfell_vampiric_shroud.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu Drones, known for their swift delivery in the treacherous Shadowfell.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate or end invisibility; can be toggled on and off.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, lasts until your next turn unless ended early.
usage.endsWhen: Turned off by the wearer, attacked in combat, or if you take an action that would break cover.

shadowfell_vampiric_shroud.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its dark magic and limited utility without being overpowered.

shadowfell_vampiric_silence_torch.name: Vampiric Silence Torch
shadowfell_vampiric_silence_torch.description: The Vampiric Silence Torch emits a ghastly, blinding black light that silences all spellcasting within its radius for two turns. The torch's user gains temporary invisibility and saps the vitality of foes, causing them to take an additional 25% damage from non-magical sources while under its influence. Crafted in the shadowy depths where silence reigns, this torch is a deadly tool for infiltrating Oracle’s sanctuaries without alerting any hidden sentinels.

effectDetails.title: Silence Spellcasters
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. All enemy spellcasting is silenced within a 15-foot radius for two turns. Creatures within the area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated and unable to cast spells until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The user gains 50% invisibility for three turns as an immediate action, becoming nearly undetectable during this time. This effect ends if the user takes a voluntary action or is hit by an attack.

shadowfell_vampiric_silence_torch.levelRequirementReason: This torch can be used by lower-level characters since it provides crucial tactical advantages in stealth and spell disruption.
shadowfell_vampiric_silence_torch.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendors, known for their expertise in crafting tools that exploit the dark arts, provide this unique item to adventurers looking to navigate dangerous sanctuaries.
shadowfell_vampiric_silence_torch.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Koopa Postal service; delivery may take an additional day due to the fragile nature of the torch's components.

usage.duration: Silence lasts for two turns, Invisibility lasts for three turns
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the user takes a voluntary action or is hit by an attack; limited to one use per short rest.

shadowfell_vampiric_silence_torch.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its utility in combat and the specialized crafting required for such a dark artifact.

shadowfell_vampiric_soul_ash.name: Vampiric Soul Ash
shadowfell_vampiric_soul_ash.description: Vampiric Soul Ash is a fine, shimmering powder derived from the Onyx Hand’s ancient ruins. Sprinkled on the ground, it casts a spectral glow that reveals hidden paths and traps within a 10-meter radius, making exploration safer for the discerning adventurer. This powder also subtly taints the air, increasing the chance of encountering cursed artifacts by +5%, though at the cost of drawing unwanted attention from lurking shadows.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Vampiric Soul Ash creates an aura that reveals hidden paths and traps within 10 meters. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until a creature moves through the area. There is no save against this effect.

effectDetails.title: Increases Chance of Cursed Artifacts
effectDetails.rules: For every hour spent in an environment where Vampiric Soul Ash has been used, there is a +5% chance to find cursed artifacts. This effect ends when the user leaves the area or after 24 hours.

shadowfell_vampiric_soul_ash.levelRequirementReason: Requires no specific level as it provides utility for all adventurers.
shadowfell_vampiric_soul_ash.vendorReason: The Shadowfell has extensive knowledge of the Onyx Hand’s lairs and thus can supply items like Vampiric Soul Ash.
shadowfell_vampiric_soul_ash.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days with standard delivery, but may be delayed by shadow disturbances in certain regions.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until a creature moves through the area
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when no creatures are within the area for 10 minutes or when used again

shadowfell_vampiric_soul_ash.priceReason: Balanced price considering its utility and risk of encountering cursed items.

shadowfell_vampiric_soul_shard.name: Vampiric Soul Shard
shadowfell_vampiric_soul_shard.description: The Vampiric Soul Shard gleams with an eerie, otherworldly light, a fragment of a fallen vampire's soul encased in onyx. When consumed, it grants brief invincibility, allowing you to shrug off attacks for a fleeting moment while leeching vitality from your foe, siphoning their strength into your own. The shard's essence is both potent and perilous, making it a rare find among the dark alleys of the Shadowfell.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as an action, you gain temporary invincibility for three turns. During this time, you are immune to all physical attacks and damage. This effect ends if you take any damage or upon the expiration of its duration.

effectDetails.title: Vampiric Drain
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you leech 20% of an enemy's hit points as temporary hit points. You can only use this ability once per short rest and are limited to one use per day.

shadowfell_vampiric_soul_shard.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted for adventurers just beginning their journey into the dark corners of the world.
shadowfell_vampiric_soul_shard.vendorReason: The Shadowfell's eerie markets are known for offering rare and dangerous items, including this shard.
shadowfell_vampiric_soul_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered by a Rakasha spirit who ensures the package remains hidden until it reaches its destination.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or at the end of your next turn after activation

shadowfell_vampiric_soul_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the dark magic required to create it justify its considerable cost.

shadowfell_vampiric_talisman.name: Vampiric Talisman of the Onyx Hand
shadowfell_vampiric_talisman.description: The Vampiric Talisman of the Onyx Hand is a small, polished amulet forged from shadow-forged iron. When struck in combat, it drains 20% of an enemy's life force, converting it into shimmering dark energy that grants you temporary hit points equivalent to half the drained amount. The talisman glows ominously red when an enemy’s health falls below 30%, alerting you to their weakened state. It is a relic from the Shadowfell, known for its ability to sustain long-term operations in the darkest of shadows.

effectDetails.title: Life Drain
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with a melee attack, drain 20% of their hit points and convert it into temporary hit points for yourself. The effect ends when you take damage or if the talisman is removed from your person.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Boost
effectDetails.rules: Increase your stamina regeneration by 10%, which grants an additional 5 hit points per long rest. This benefit lasts until the end of each day.

shadowfell_vampiric_talisman.levelRequirementReason: The talisman’s dark energies require a certain level of arcane knowledge to harness effectively.
shadowfell_vampiric_talisman.vendorReason: As a relic from the Shadowfell, it makes sense that this vendor would carry such a powerful item.
shadowfell_vampiric_talisman.shippingDetail: The amulet must be couriered personally by Shy Guy Smugglers to ensure its safe arrival and proper delivery.

usage.duration: Until you take damage or the talisman is removed from your person
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or the talisman is removed from your person

shadowfell_vampiric_talisman.priceReason: The talisman's shadow-forged iron and its unique properties make it a rare find, justifying its price.

shadowfell_vampiric_tongue.name: Vampiric Tongue of the Blood Thirst
shadowfell_vampiric_tongue.description: The Vampiric Tongue of the Blood Thirst is a gnarled, obsidian appendage that drips with dark energy. It whispers and strikes like an ancient predator, siphoning life essence from foes as it claws its way through their defenses. This macabre tongue leaves behind a trail of agony for any undead it confronts, causing them to scream in pain and stagger. Hunters and assassins prize this relic for its ability to drain vitality and enhance melee strikes against the dead.

effectDetails.title: Life Siphon
effectDetails.rules: The Vampiric Tongue of the Blood Thirst siphons 1d4 + 2 hit points from any enemy struck with a melee attack. This effect occurs once per turn and does not provoke an opportunity attack.

effectDetails.title: Undead Pain
effectDetails.rules: When this tongue strikes against undead, they must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 round. The save is made at the start of their next turn.

shadowfell_vampiric_tongue.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to wield and channel its dark energies effectively.
shadowfell_vampiric_tongue.vendorReason: The shadowy denizens of Shadowfell are well-versed in the arts of necromancy, making them a fitting vendor for such an item.
shadowfell_vampiric_tongue.shippingDetail: This delicate artifact is delivered via the ethereal planes by the rakasha, ensuring swift and secure transport without risk of damage.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect
usage.endsWhen: The tongue exhausts its uses for the day (recharges on a short rest)

shadowfell_vampiric_tongue.priceReason: Balanced as a rare artifact with unique undead-buffing properties and a limited use mechanic.

shadowfell_vampiric_wisp.name: Vampiric Wisp of the Onyx Hand
shadowfell_vampiric_wisp.description: A wisp of onyx mist that clings to your shoulder, absorbing stray magic and channeling it into a powerful counterstrike. Crafted in the shadowy forges of the Onyx Hand, this wisp is a symbol of ancient necromancy, drawing energy from the very fabric of the Shadowfell. Use it wisely in duels or against powerful enemies; the wisp will absorb up to 25% of incoming magic damage and convert it into your own spellcasting power.

effectDetails.title: Magic Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When you take magic damage, the Vampiric Wisp absorbs up to 25% of that damage as additional spellcasting resources. This effect can occur once per minute.

effectDetails.title: Spell Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: For every 10 seconds the wisp is active, you gain a +30% boost to your spellcasting speed. This bonus stacks up to three times.

shadowfell_vampiric_wisp.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Arcana to effectively use and control the wisp's magic.
shadowfell_vampiric_wisp.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is a place where such necromantic creations are born, making this vendor a logical source for the item.
shadowfell_vampiric_wisp.shippingDetail: Careful handling required due to its volatile nature; shipments may take up to three additional days.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The wisp is dismissed or destroyed by a dispel magic spell
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one can be active at a time

shadowfell_vampiric_wisp.priceReason: Balanced for its utility in both offensive and defensive scenarios.

shadowfell_vampiric_writ.name: Vampiric Writ of the Blooded Pact
shadowfell_vampiric_writ.description: The Vampiric Writ of the Blooded Pact is a vial etched with dark sigils and filled with an eerie, pulsating essence of vampire blood. Consuming it grants you temporary invulnerability to physical attacks for 8 seconds, allowing you to focus on draining your enemies' vitality. Nearby foes feel a searing pain as they lose 20% of their health, but you must be wary: the writ's effects can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, you gain a +3 bonus to AC and immunity to all physical damage for 8 seconds. This effect ends if you take any non-magical physical damage or at the start of your next turn after using it.

effectDetails.title: Vampiric Drain
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming the writ, choose a creature within 30 feet. That creature loses 20% of its maximum hit points as temporary hit points for you. This effect has no save DC and can only be used once per long rest.

shadowfell_vampiric_writ.levelRequirementReason: This writ is potent but not overwhelming, suitable for adventurers just starting their journey.
shadowfell_vampiric_writ.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is the birthplace of vampiric magic; it makes sense that this powerful item originates there.
shadowfell_vampiric_writ.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the writ must be shipped with extra care and arrives within 3 days of purchase.

usage.duration: 8 seconds or until you take physical damage
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn after use or if you take any non-magical physical damage

shadowfell_vampiric_writ.priceReason: The Vampiric Writ is a rare and powerful item, balancing its price with the need for experienced adventurers to face it.

shadowfell_venom_blood.name: Venom Blood of the Abyssal Maw
shadowfell_venom_blood.description: A vial of corrupted vitae drawn from the deepest crypts of the Shadowfell, this venomous liquid is said to have been extracted directly from the heart of an Abyssal Maw. When applied, it corrupts the target’s soul for three rounds, making them vulnerable to psychic strikes and granting a spectral echo that haunts their foes for two additional turns. The vial's potency ensures even a simple touch can be fatal in the wrong hands.

effectDetails.title: Soul Corruption
effectDetails.rules: When applied, Venom Blood of the Abyssal Maw imposes a curse on the target for three rounds. The target takes an additional 3d6 psychic damage from any source and has disadvantage on saving throws against psychic effects.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Spectra
effectDetails.rules: For two turns after applying the venom, spectral echoes of the Abyssal Maw appear in the battlefield. These echoes deal 1d8 force damage to all creatures within 5 feet and grant advantage on attacks against those creatures.

shadowfell_venom_blood.levelRequirementReason: The vial's potent effects require a moderate command of magic to wield effectively.
shadowfell_venom_blood.vendorReason: Shadowfell is known for its dark dealings and necromantic artifacts, making it the only place to find such an item.
shadowfell_venom_blood.shippingDetail: The vial must be shipped discreetly due to its potent nature; any delay risks its corruption.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to apply the venom. The effects last for three rounds and end if the target dies or successfully saves against a DC 15 Charisma saving throw.
usage.duration: 3 rounds
usage.endsWhen: The target dies or successfully saves against a DC 15 Charisma saving throw.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one application per creature.

shadowfell_venom_blood.priceReason: The rarity and potency of the venom ensure its price reflects its value in both magic and danger.

shadowfell_venom_bottle.name: Venom Bottle of the Hollow Maw
shadowfell_venom_bottle.description: The Venom Bottle of the Hollow Maw is a slender glass vial sealed with black wax. Inside, the venom glows faintly, a testament to its cursed origin from the depths of the Shadowfell. When unleashed, it deals piercing damage and has a 15% chance to stagger your foes for one round, but each use drains your vitality, reducing your maximum hit points by 20%. Perfect for those who seek swift, silent kills.

effectDetails.title: Piercing Damage
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as a weapon, the Venom Bottle deals an additional 1d6 piercing damage to one target. The user must make a successful attack roll against the target's AC. This effect ends when the bottle is spent.

effectDetails.title: Stagger on Hit
effectDetails.rules: There is a 15% chance that, upon hitting the target, it will be Staggered for one round (DC 14 Constitution saving throw). The user must make this save or take 2d6 piercing damage from the bottle itself. This effect ends when the bottle is spent.

shadowfell_venom_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed to be accessible for low-level characters who need a reliable method of incapacitating foes.
shadowfell_venom_bottle.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendor, known for their dark wares, sources this from the cursed lands themselves.
shadowfell_venom_bottle.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express with expedited delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect per use
usage.endsWhen: Spent after one successful hit or failed save
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but each use reduces the user's maximum HP by 20% until recovered

shadowfell_venom_bottle.priceReason: The price reflects its cursed origin and the risk it poses to the user.

shadowfell_vessel_fragment.name: Vessel Fragment
shadowfell_vessel_fragment.description: A Vessel Fragment is a jagged, iridescent shard that hums with necromantic energy. Crafted from the Oracle’s experimental vessel, it amplifies one’s connection to the Shadowfell, allowing the wielder to feel the very pulse of the void. When in the Shadowfell, this fragment increases damage taken by 10%, but its true power lies in its potential; when fused with others, it can create a Vessel Core, a powerful relic capable of unlocking ancient necromantic secrets.

effectDetails.title: Shadowfell Amplification
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains +5% to all necromantic spell potency when in the Shadowfell. This effect is always active as long as they are within that plane, and it requires no activation.

effectDetails.title: Void Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: When outside the Shadowfell, the user takes an additional 10% damage from all sources for 24 hours after leaving. This effect can be mitigated by spending a reaction to cast a protection from energy spell targeting themselves.

shadowfell_vessel_fragment.levelRequirementReason: This fragment requires a minimum of third-level proficiency in necromancy spells to effectively harness its power.
shadowfell_vessel_fragment.vendorReason: The Oracle’s vessel fragments are exclusive to the Shadowfell, and only those who have proven their worth within its borders can acquire them from the Oracle’s disciples.
shadowfell_vessel_fragment.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, this item must be shipped via Shy Guy Smugglers, who promise safe delivery with a guaranteed timeline of three days or less.

usage.activation: Passive effect when in the Shadowfell; no activation required outside the plane.
usage.duration: Permanent while in the Shadowfell; ends immediately upon leaving and lasts for 24 hours thereafter.
usage.endsWhen: Using a reaction to cast protection from energy or returning to the Shadowfell.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but cannot be used when not within the Shadowfell.

shadowfell_vessel_fragment.priceReason: This fragment is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the complexity of its crafting, which involves rare materials and significant necromantic energy.

shadowfell_voices_of_ash.name: Voices of Ash
shadowfell_voices_of_ash.description: The Voices of Ash, a shimmering amulet forged from the bones of forgotten battles, whispers secrets from the dead. It allows you to hear the final moments of fallen comrades or foes, providing crucial intelligence before an ambush or during interrogation. Its ethereal glow hints at the spectral presence it harbors—vague yet compelling. Wielders have reported that its power amplifies in areas of shadow and darkness, enhancing stealth and uncovering hidden truths.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Enemy Weakness
effectDetails.rules: When you roll a Perception check, there is a +15% increase in the chance of uncovering an enemy’s weak point. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stealth
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this amulet, you have a passive +20 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This benefit is always active while the amulet is worn.

shadowfell_voices_of_ash.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires minimal magical power and can be used by lower-level characters for strategic advantage.
shadowfell_voices_of_ash.vendorReason: Shadowfell merchants often carry relics from the dead, as they are in tune with the dark energies that fuel such items.
shadowfell_voices_of_ash.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered via a shadow courier, arriving at night when darkness covers your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; active as long as the amulet is worn.
usage.endsWhen: The amulet’s power dissipates if not recharged or destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires 8 hours of meditation in a place of darkness to recharge.

shadowfell_voices_of_ash.priceReason: This amulet is crafted from rare bones and dark magic, making it moderately priced yet still within reach for many adventuring parties.

shadowfell_voices_of_the_void.name: Voices of the Void
shadowfell_voices_of_the_void.description: The Voices of the Void is a gnarled staff carved from twisted shadowwood, its surface etched with arcane symbols that shimmer faintly under starlight. It channels the whispers of the void, summoning spectral echoes to distract and disorient foes in combat. However, prolonged use risks unraveling the user's sanity, causing them to falter and lose focus for a time. A delicate balance must be maintained between harnessing its power and succumbing to its dark allure.
effects: +25% chance to confuse enemies for 1 round
-5% HP if used continuously in combat beyond 30 seconds

effectDetails.title: Confuse Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the staff summons spectral echoes that distract foes within 10 feet. Targets have a +25% chance to be confused for one round (action surge or reaction negate).

effectDetails.title: Sanity Drain
effectDetails.rules: If used continuously in combat beyond 30 seconds, the user loses 5% of their hit points at the end of each round until they rest. This effect is interrupted if the user stops using the staff.

shadowfell_voices_of_the_void.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can still experiment with its abilities without requiring a high level.
shadowfell_voices_of_the_void.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendors are known for their access to arcane and dangerous items, including those that manipulate the void.
shadowfell_voices_of_the_void.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay with a 1d4+2 day delivery delay.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; confusion lasts for one round
usage.endsWhen: Use ends if confused target regains their senses, or if the user stops using the staff and loses HP due to continuous use

shadowfell_voices_of_the_void.priceReason: Balanced with other rare items, this price reflects its unique risk-reward profile.

shadowfell_void_blood.name: Void Blood of the Unbound
shadowfell_void_blood.description: The vial contains a thick, dark essence that hums with malevolent energy. This is the very blood of an Unbound, a feral creature born from the Shadowfell. Consuming it grants you the ability to manipulate shadow and darkness, enhancing your combat prowess in dim environments. For ten minutes, you can shape shadows into weapons or shields, and your resistance to shadow-based damage increases by 20%. Use this vial wisely; its power is as fleeting as the night itself.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can manipulate shadows within 30 feet to create a weapon or shield. This lasts for 1 minute and ends if you attack with it. The DC to resist this effect is 15.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Shadow Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to shadow damage and increase your saving throw bonus against all sources of darkness by +20%. This effect lasts for 10 minutes, ending if you spend a minute out of complete darkness.

shadowfell_void_blood.levelRequirementReason: It takes considerable magical knowledge and strength to harness the volatile power within this vial.
shadowfell_void_blood.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is home to the Unbound, and its denizens are familiar with their blood's potent magic.
shadowfell_void_blood.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay; delivery can take up to a week depending on celestial alignment.

usage.activation: Bonus action, or as a reaction when entering shadowy conditions
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation with 10-minute duration for resistance effect
usage.endsWhen: Using it in sunlight or spending a minute out of complete darkness ends the effects

shadowfell_void_blood.priceReason: The Unbound are rare, and their essence is highly sought after for its unique magical properties.

shadowfell_void_cloak.name: Void Cloak of the Shattered Mirror
shadowfell_void_cloak.description: The Void Cloak of the Shattered Mirror is a cloak woven from the echoes of broken mirrors and forgotten Onyx Hand rites, imbued with the ethereal whispers of the Shadowfell. It grants its wearer temporary resistance to shadow-based attacks and allows them to phase through thin barriers, making it an invaluable tool for explorers venturing into the heart of darkened realms. Wielding this cloak can turn the tide in a fight against shadowy foes, granting both defensive prowess and offensive mobility.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When a creature within 10 feet of you attacks you with a weapon that deals shadow damage, you gain temporary resistance to this damage until the start of your next turn. This effect can occur once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Phasing Teleport
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may attempt to phase through thin barriers such as walls or doors. You teleport to a point on a thin barrier within 30 feet of you and then phase back to your original location immediately after. This effect can be used once per short rest.

shadowfell_void_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's magic is potent, requiring a level 7 character to harness its full power.
shadowfell_void_cloak.vendorReason: The shadowy denizens of the Shadowfell are well-acquainted with the arcane secrets that go into crafting such an item, making it a logical place for this cloak to be sold.
shadowfell_void_cloak.shippingDetail: Ships via the ethereal Void Drifter Relay; expect delivery in one week at most.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Phasing Teleport, until start of next turn for Shadow Resistance
usage.endsWhen: Runs out after its duration, or when you take damage during the Shadow Resistance effect

shadowfell_void_cloak.priceReason: The cloak's unique combination of defensive and mobility benefits makes it a valuable asset for any adventuring party.

shadowfell_void_soul_pouch.name: Void Soul Pouch
shadowfell_void_soul_pouch.description: The Void Soul Pouch is a shadowy, leather-bound satchel woven from threads of forgotten lore and nightmarish energy. It absorbs the soul essence of slain foes, channeling their dark power into your own form. For an instant, you enter a state of ephemeral darkness, becoming invisible to all but those who can see through shadows. Each absorbed soul grants a fleeting surge of combat prowess, heightening your reflexes and striking speed in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Soul Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When you slay an enemy, you can absorb its soul essence by making a DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check. On a success, your next melee attack deals an additional 2d6 necrotic damage and grants a +10% bonus to your attack speed for the rest of the encounter.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Phase
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction to an enemy's attack or movement within 5 feet, you can enter a brief state of invisibility. You are invisible until the start of your next turn, but this effect cannot be used again for 1 minute.

shadowfell_void_soul_pouch.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third-level proficiency to wield and harness its dark energies effectively.
shadowfell_void_soul_pouch.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is a realm of darkness and decay, where such items are forged from the very essence of nightmarish creatures.
shadowfell_void_soul_pouch.shippingDetail: Delivered with a shadowy courier, ensuring secrecy but slightly increasing the risk of misdelivery to unintended recipients.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn for Shadow Phase; varies by effect
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you are attacked or enter combat again, or after a successful Soul Absorption.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only 3 uses per short rest

shadowfell_void_soul_pouch.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and the dark magic required for its creation.

shadowfell_void_torch.name: Void Torch of the Hollow Throne
shadowfell_void_torch.description: The Void Torch of the Hollow Throne hums with a spectral glow, casting eerie shadows that warp reality around you. Its flickering light distorts time and space, making it an ideal tool for stealthy ambushes in the Shadowfell’s labyrinthine halls. The torch's embers are said to be drawn from the very heart of the realm’s void, granting the user a fleeting moment of total invisibility and leaving its enemies with doppelgangers that cast their own shadows, confusing their senses.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the user becomes invisible for 10 seconds. This effect grants complete concealment and lasts until dispelled by magical means or an end of turn. There is no save required to resist this effect.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Echo
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, enemies within a 20-foot radius are briefly duplicated for the duration of their next action. This creates a shadowy copy that moves with them but does not attack or interact otherwise. The duplicate fades away at the end of the enemy's turn.

shadowfell_void_torch.levelRequirementReason: This torch is designed to be accessible to lower-level adventurers, as it requires no special magic beyond the realm’s own void energies.
shadowfell_void_torch.vendorReason: The Shadowfell vendors are known for their specialized items that harness the realm's dark and twisted power, making this torch an ideal offering.
shadowfell_void_torch.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Hollow Throne, ensuring quick delivery to those who dare venture into its halls.

usage.duration: 10 seconds for Invisibility; ends when the user's next action is taken for Shadow Echo
usage.endsWhen: Dispel magic or end of turn
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

shadowfell_void_torch.priceReason: The torch’s balanced price reflects its moderate power and the specific materials used in its crafting.

shadowfell_void_ward.name: Void Ward of the Silent Throne
shadowfell_void_ward.description: The Void Ward of the Silent Throne is a cursed amulet forged from shadow-drenched obsidian. When worn, it absorbs ambient darkness and reflects it as searing light, capable of blinding foes and turning their own shadows against them. The wearer can phase through thin walls of shadow for brief moments but at a cost: each use saps one hit point, making this relic both perilous and invaluable to those who seek the dark arts.

effectDetails.title: Phasing Through Shadows
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can phase through thin walls of shadow for 1 minute. This effect ends if the wearer takes any damage or if they voluntarily end it early.

effectDetails.title: Reflective Light
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of its turns, the amulet reflects ambient light into surrounding darkness, dealing 1d6 radiant damage to any creature within 5 feet that is in shadow. A target can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to avoid this effect.

shadowfell_void_ward.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to harness the relic's dark magic without severe consequences.
shadowfell_void_ward.vendorReason: The Shadowfell is home to ancient and malevolent relics, making it fitting for this cursed amulet.
shadowfell_void_ward.shippingDetail: Ships via shadow-touched couriers with a 1d4 delay due to the arcane nature of the item.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until ended early
usage.endsWhen: Damage taken or voluntarily ended

shadowfell_void_ward.priceReason: The amulet's cursed nature and unique abilities justify this price, balancing its powerful effects with manageable risks.

shanhaijing_ancestral_vessel.name: Shanhaijing Ancestral Vessel (Embodied Spirit)
shanhaijing_ancestral_vessel.description: The Shanhaijing Ancestral Vessel stands as a towering, intricately carved urn of jade and bronze, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer faintly under moonlight. This vessel is said to house the spirit of an ancestor who fought valiantly in the legendary Battle of Zhuolu, lending unparalleled wisdom and strength during consultation. When summoned, it grants expertise in one historical or martial field for a week, allowing you to speak with the embodied spirit as if sharing a private discourse.
effects: Expertise in one historical or martial field

effectDetails.title: Ancestral Summoning
effectDetails.rules: To activate, you must perform a ritual that takes 10 minutes. The summoned spirit grants expertise in one chosen historical or martial field for the duration of 7 days. This effect can be used once per month.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Consultation
effectDetails.rules: The vessel allows you to ask one question related to history or martial prowess each day during its active period, receiving a cryptic but insightful response from the ancestral spirit. The vessel recharges after 7 days of inactivity.

shanhaijing_ancestral_vessel.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience and wisdom can properly perform the ritual to summon such a powerful ancestor.
shanhaijing_ancestral_vessel.vendorReason: The shrine is entrusted by the clan with the care of these sacred relics, ensuring they are used for their intended purpose.
shanhaijing_ancestral_vessel.shippingDetail: Ships via a private courier who delivers directly to your doorstep.

usage.duration: 7 days of expertise and daily consultation
usage.endsWhen: After 7 days, the spirit returns to its rest or when the vessel is damaged beyond repair

shanhaijing_ancestral_vessel.priceReason: This item's price reflects its rarity and the significant time and resources required for its creation.

shanhaijing_bestiary_fact_checking.name: Shanhaijing Bestiary Fact-Checking
shanhaijing_bestiary_fact_checking.description: The Shanhaijing Bestiary Fact-Checking is a scholarly tome bound in red leather with gold filigree. It verifies one monster entry, revealing a hidden weakness that only you can exploit. The book's margins are filled with meticulous corrections, making it nearly unusable as a weapon due to its slippery ink. Once wielded in battle, you become overly critical of the game’s lore, imposing disadvantage on your Charisma checks when dealing with sages and scholars.
effects: Disadvantage on Charisma checks related to monsters

effectDetails.title: Monster Weakness Revealed
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this book verifies a single monster entry. The DM reveals one hidden weakness that only the user can exploit.

effectDetails.title: Pedantic Scholar
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after use, you impose disadvantage on Charisma checks when interacting with sages and scholars.

shanhaijing_bestiary_fact_checking.levelRequirementReason: A basic understanding of the game's mechanics is necessary to appreciate the book’s nuances.
shanhaijing_bestiary_fact_checking.vendorReason: The Shanhaijing Editors are experts in monster lore and would naturally carry a tool that enhances their expertise.
shanhaijing_bestiary_fact_checking.shippingDetail: Ships via a courier known for its reliable service, ensuring the book arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if you use it again without waiting the required rest period.

shanhaijing_bestiary_fact_checking.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price to reflect its scholarly utility rather than combat power.

shanhaijing_bronze_skin_potion.name: Shanhaijing Bronze Skin Potion
shanhaijing_bronze_skin_potion.description: The Shanhaijing Bronze Skin Potion is a rare tincture that hardens your skin to the resilience of ancient bronze. For an hour, your flesh becomes unyielding against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks, granting you resistance to these three damage types. However, this protection comes at the cost of mobility; your movement speed is halved as your form seems to weigh a ton more than usual. Only Shanhaijing's alchemists can craft such a potion, known for their mastery over ancient bronze and alchemy.
effects: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing Damage

effectDetails.title: Resilient Skin
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after consumption, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. This effect ends if you take any action that requires a move or disengage from combat.

effectDetails.title: Weighted Step
effectDetails.rules: Your movement speed is reduced by half while under the effects of this potion. This effect remains in place until your next short rest, at which point it is removed regardless of your actions.

shanhaijing_bronze_skin_potion.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest warrior can benefit from increased resilience and protection against physical attacks.
shanhaijing_bronze_skin_potion.vendorReason: The shrine's alchemists are revered for their mastery over ancient bronze and their ability to craft such potent potions.
shanhaijing_bronze_skin_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the trusted messenger pigeons of Shanhaijing, this potion is guaranteed to arrive in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until you take a move action or disengage from combat
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged with each short rest

shanhaijing_bronze_skin_potion.priceReason: The potion's rarity and the skill required to craft it justify its moderate price.

shanhaijing_celestial_armaments.name: Shanhaijing Celestial Armaments (Set)
shanhaijing_celestial_armaments.description: The Shanhaijing Celestial Armaments set, forged from solidified starlight, is a divine ensemble that whispers the ancient secrets of the celestial realm. The armor gleams with an inner light that repels both radiant and force damage, while the weapon channels pure celestial power, delivering devastating strikes that pierce through all defenses. Crafted by the immortal artisans of Shanhaijing, these armaments are said to have been blessed by the very stars themselves.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Shield
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this armor, you gain resistance to radiant and force damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Divine Smite
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee weapon attack while wielding the weapon in this set, you can deal an additional 4d6 radiant damage if the target is non-neutral. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

shanhaijing_celestial_armaments.levelRequirementReason: The Celestial Armaments require a formidable champion to wield their divine power.
shanhaijing_celestial_armaments.vendorReason: Only the most devout and skilled warriors are deemed worthy of receiving this sacred set from Shanhaijing's shrine.
shanhaijing_celestial_armaments.shippingDetail: The Celestial Armaments are delivered by a celestial courier, ensuring their safe arrival and imbuing them with additional divine blessings during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation whenever you make a melee weapon attack while wielding the set's weapon.
usage.duration: Until your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are incapacitated or no longer wearing the armor.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged by the stars at dawn.

shanhaijing_celestial_armaments.priceReason: Reflecting its divine craftsmanship and rarity, the Celestial Armaments command an exorbitant price befitting their celestial origin.

shanhaijing_celestial_dragon_ally.name: Shanhaijing Celestial Dragon Ally (Temporary Pact)
shanhaijing_celestial_dragon_ally.description: The Shanhaijing Celestial Dragon Ally is a mystical scroll crafted from silk dyed with celestial ink, bearing the seal of the ancient Chinese text Shan Hai Jing. It forges an ephemeral pact with a minor Celestial Dragon, who arrives to provide tactical advice or unleash a single devastating breath attack, capable of leveling a small village in one strike. The dragon's aid is temporary, lasting 24 hours or until it exhausts its power by using this breath weapon.

effectDetails.title: Tactical Advice
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the scroll allows you to communicate with a minor Celestial Dragon. The dragon provides strategic advice on how to best handle your current crisis. This effect is instantaneous and has no save DC or limits.

effectDetails.title: Devastating Breath Attack
effectDetails.rules: The scroll can be activated once more, summoning the dragon for a single devastating breath attack that deals 5d10 fire damage to a target within 60 feet. The dragon must use its action on its turn to breathe this attack. This effect has a duration of one round and ends if the dragon is reduced to half its hit points or takes any nonmagical bludgeoning damage.

shanhaijing_celestial_dragon_ally.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least level 19 due to the powerful abilities it unlocks, including a minor Celestial Dragon's tactical advice and devastating breath attack.
shanhaijing_celestial_dragon_ally.vendorReason: The Shan Hai Jing Shrine is known for its extensive knowledge of ancient Chinese texts and their magical properties, thus they are entrusted with this rare item.
shanhaijing_celestial_dragon_ally.shippingDetail: The scroll must be delivered by Heavenly Summons to ensure it arrives intact and ready to activate.

usage.activation: Requires an action or bonus action when the scroll is unsealed.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Tactical Advice, one round for Devastating Breath Attack.
usage.endsWhen: The dragon uses its breath attack or is reduced to half its hit points.

shanhaijing_celestial_dragon_ally.priceReason: This item provides a minor Celestial Dragon's tactical and combat assistance, making it valuable but not overwhelmingly powerful for level 19 characters.

shanhaijing_celestial_palace_deed.name: Shanhaijing Celestial Palace Deed
shanhaijing_celestial_palace_deed.description: The Shanhaijing Celestial Palace Deed confers ownership of a minor palace floating amidst the clouds, accessible through aligned portals. This ethereal abode grants permanent residence in the Celestial Plane and bestows a healing aura that restores 1d6 hit points per hour to all inhabitants within its bounds. Crafted by the ancient Shanhaijing, this deed is a symbol of divine favor, ensuring safe passage and protection for those who claim it.

effectDetails.title: Healing Aura
effectDetails.rules: Residents within the palace receive a constant healing effect that restores 1d6 hit points per hour. This effect is passive and does not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Residence
effectDetails.rules: The deed grants permanent residence in the Celestial Plane, allowing the owner and their allies to access a secure, heavenly sanctuary. The portal to this location can be activated through aligned portals within reach.

shanhaijing_celestial_palace_deed.levelRequirementReason: This item is intended for high-level adventurers who have proven their worthiness by reaching the mid-to-high levels.
shanhaijing_celestial_palace_deed.vendorReason: The shrine of Shanhaijing is a repository of divine relics, and this deed is one such artifact passed down through ancient lore.
shanhaijing_celestial_palace_deed.shippingDetail: The Angel Courier ensures swift delivery of the deed, often arriving with dramatic flair in a burst of celestial light.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation via aligned portal within reach.
usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or lost.
usage.endsWhen: Only if the owner is banished from the Celestial Plane or the deed is lost.

shanhaijing_celestial_palace_deed.priceReason: This item represents a divine favor and secure, eternal residence in the celestial realm, making it a valuable but not overpriced commodity among high-level adventurers.

shanhaijing_celestial_portal_stone.name: Shanhaijing Celestial Portal Stone
shanhaijing_celestial_portal_stone.description: The Shanhaijing Celestial Portal Stone, a smooth, obsidian orb inscribed with ancient Chinese characters, serves as a physical bridge to the ethereal realms of the Celestial Dragons. Crafted by the revered Shanhaijing through arcane rituals and divine intervention, this stone ensures safe passage between planes for those worthy enough to wield it. Carrying the weight of celestial power, the user gains resistance to radiant damage, shielding them from the harsh light of the heavens.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws against radiant damage. This effect is permanent as long as the stone remains in the wielder's possession.

effectDetails.title: Safe Passage
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the stone opens a stable portal to the Celestial Realms for 10 minutes. Traveling through this portal requires no special action or saving throw and is safe from all hazards. The portal can be used once per long rest.

shanhaijing_celestial_portal_stone.levelRequirementReason: The stone's power demands a high level of discipline, spiritual purity, and martial prowess to wield.
shanhaijing_celestial_portal_stone.vendorReason: Only the Shanhaijing Shrine can validate the authenticity and proper use of such sacred relics.
shanhaijing_celestial_portal_stone.shippingDetail: The Cloud Casket delivers the stone within a week, but only during clear celestial weather.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate the portal. The portal remains open for 10 minutes and can be used once per long rest.
usage.duration: 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: The user can close it as a bonus action, or after 10 minutes.
usage.charges: One use per short or long rest

shanhaijing_celestial_portal_stone.priceReason: The stone's rarity and divine craftsmanship justify its price in terms of XP.

shanhaijing_dragon_breath_bellows.name: Shanhaijing Dragon Breath Bellows
shanhaijing_dragon_breath_bellows.description: The Shanhaijing Dragon Breath Bellows are forged from ancient bronze, their surface etched with arcane symbols that glow faintly when in use. These bellows can simulate the fierce breath of a dragon, heating tarts to perfection with a roar that echoes like thunder. The Eastern Forgers craft them with precision and care, ensuring each pair is imbued with just enough magic to heat precisely but not overheat if used too vigorously.
effects: Roar like the breath of a dragon

effectDetails.title: Heating Precision
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the bellows provide a +1 bonus to all fire-based cooking checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Dragon's Roar
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the bellows emit a roar that can be heard for 30 feet. It has no combat application but adds an intimidating and magical presence to any kitchen scene.

shanhaijing_dragon_breath_bellows.levelRequirementReason: These bellows are designed for beginners and cooks who need a little extra magic in their kitchens.
shanhaijing_dragon_breath_bellows.vendorReason: The Shanhaijing Temple is renowned for its mastery of ancient cooking techniques, making it the perfect place to find these enchanted tools.
shanhaijing_dragon_breath_bellows.shippingDetail: Ships via Fiery Fan Fold, known for swift and reliable deliveries within the realm.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: After one use per short or long rest

shanhaijing_dragon_breath_bellows.priceReason: The reduced price reflects its limited magical enhancement, making it accessible to less experienced cooks.

shanhaijing_dragon_embroidered_silk.name: Shanhaijing Dragon Embroidered Silk
shanhaijing_dragon_embroidered_silk.description: The Shanhaijing Dragon Embroidered Silk is a silk robe adorned with fierce, embroidered dragons that seem to leap from the fabric itself. Crafted by the Eastern Embroiderers using threads spun from dragon saliva, this robe whispers ancient secrets in the wind. The sleeves flow like rivers under pressure, granting the wearer +1 Acrobatics when performing stunts in gusty conditions. Dust dragons, mythical pests of the east, are drawn to the silk, offering a bizarre but effective deterrent against them.
effects: Attracts dust dragons for pest control

effectDetails.title: Flowing Sleeves (Passive)
effectDetails.rules: When wearing the Shanhaijing Dragon Embroidered Silk, you gain +1 to your Acrobatics checks if performing stunts in gusty conditions.

effectDetails.title: Dust Dragon Attraction (Instantaneous)
effectDetails.rules: The silk robe attracts dust dragons, which offer a 24-hour pest control service within a 30-foot radius. The attraction ends when the robe is removed or if five rounds pass without any pests detected.

shanhaijing_dragon_embroidered_silk.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate and benefit from the elegance and utility of this silk robe.
shanhaijing_dragon_embroidered_silk.vendorReason: The Shanhaijing Palace is renowned for its connections to ancient lore, making it a fitting vendor for such an artifact.
shanhaijing_dragon_embroidered_silk.shippingDetail: Ships via Dragon Thread Express, known for its swift and secure deliveries through the skies of the east.

usage.duration: Until removed or environmental conditions change.
usage.endsWhen: When the robe is removed or if five rounds pass without pests detected (for dust dragon attraction).

shanhaijing_dragon_embroidered_silk.priceReason: The silk's craftsmanship and magical properties justify its price, providing utility and a touch of ancient magic.

shanhaijing_dragon_fruit_tarts_recipe.name: Recipe: Shanhaijing Dragon Fruit Tarts
shanhaijing_dragon_fruit_tarts_recipe.description: The Recipe for Shanhaijing Dragon Fruit Tarts is a delicate parchment scroll, imbued with the essence of mythical dragons and the fiery heart of the Eastern Pastry Masters. The tarts themselves are not merely pastries but a culinary masterpiece, crafted from dragon fruit harvested from ancient groves beneath volcanic peaks. Each tart, when consumed, not only grants fire damage on your next weapon attack but also bestows resistance to fear, making you unshaken in the face of terror.

effectDetails.title: Dragon's Fire Embrace
effectDetails.rules: When you consume a tart and attack with a weapon, deal an additional 1d6 fire damage. This effect lasts until your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Fearless Heart
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of this recipe's effects, you have resistance to fear-based spells and abilities. If you are already resistant to fear, you instead gain advantage on saving throws against such effects.

shanhaijing_dragon_fruit_tarts_recipe.levelRequirementReason: The delicate nature of mastering the dragon fruit's fiery essence requires a minimum level.
shanhaijing_dragon_fruit_tarts_recipe.vendorReason: The temple, home to Eastern Pastry Masters and guardians of ancient recipes, ensures these tarts are prepared with the highest integrity.
shanhaijing_dragon_fruit_tarts_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by enchanted scroll, ensuring the recipe's potency remains intact through airmail courier services.

usage.activation: Eating one tart when you have not yet attacked that round.
usage.duration: Until your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: On completion of a short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as each tart is a single-use item.

shanhaijing_dragon_fruit_tarts_recipe.priceReason: Balanced to provide significant flavor and utility without breaking the game economy.

shanhaijing_dragon_scale_polish_premium.name: Shanhaijing Dragon Scale Polish (Premium)
shanhaijing_dragon_scale_polish_premium.description: Polish crafted from ancient Shan Hai Jing dragon scales, this premium polish imbues armor with a shimmering luster that is both awe-inspiring and intimidating. Applied to any armor, it grants +1 AC against dragons for one week, and the wearer gains +2 to Intimidation checks when dealing with reptilian creatures. However, the application leaves the user's scales slightly flaky, causing minor itching. Eastern Dragon Smiths have mastered this art, creating a product that is both practical and visually striking.

effectDetails.title: Draconic Defense
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Grants +1 AC against dragons for one week. Ends when the wearer removes the armor or if the armor is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Reptilian Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: Activates passively while wearing armor polished with this polish. Grants +2 to Intimidation checks against reptiles. Ends when the polish wears off.

shanhaijing_dragon_scale_polish_premium.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate the craftsmanship and benefits of dragon scale polish.
shanhaijing_dragon_scale_polish_premium.vendorReason: The temple is renowned for its connection to dragons, making it a fitting place for such a product.
shanhaijing_dragon_scale_polish_premium.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week, but requires a special courier who can handle delicate materials.

usage.activation: Bonus action or passively while worn
usage.duration: 1 week or until armor is removed/destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Armor is removed or destroyed, or the polish wears off

shanhaijing_dragon_scale_polish_premium.priceReason: The premium quality and unique benefits justify a price of 1000 XP.

shanhaijing_dragon_whisperer_scroll.name: Shanhaijing Dragon Whisperer Scroll
shanhaijing_dragon_whisperer_scroll.description: The scroll, inscribed in cryptic characters, whispers secrets of ancient dragons as it unfurls. Crafted from the bark of sacred willow trees and inked by the hands of the Shanhaijing shrine, this scroll allows you to speak the tongue that has bridged Eastern dragons since time immemorial. With a flick of your wrist, you can gain advantage on checks to avoid provoking Eastern dragons, or even command lesser Celestial serpents with ease.

effectDetails.title: Fluent Dragon Tongue
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can read the scroll and speak in Eastern dragon tongue. You gain advantage on checks to avoid angering or provoking a Celestial dragon. This effect lasts until you use it again.

effectDetails.title: Avoid Anger
effectDetails.rules: While holding this scroll, you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed by Celestial dragons and other similar effects for 8 hours after using the Fluent Dragon Tongue ability.

shanhaijing_dragon_whisperer_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll requires a high level of mastery to understand its ancient language.
shanhaijing_dragon_whisperer_scroll.vendorReason: The shrine is well-versed in the secrets of dragons and has crafted this scroll using their sacred knowledge.
shanhaijing_dragon_whisperer_scroll.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift couriers, ensuring safe arrival within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until used again
usage.endsWhen: Used again or destroyed

shanhaijing_dragon_whisperer_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's price reflects its rarity and the extensive resources required to craft it.

shanhaijing_elemental_talisman.name: Shanhaijing Elemental Talisman (Fire)
shanhaijing_elemental_talisman.description: The Shanhaijing Elemental Talisman (Fire) is a small, fiery talisman that glows with an inner flame. Crafted by the ancient scholars of Shanhaijing, it channels raw fire elemental energy, capable of both devastating and protective magic. When activated, it can unleash a scorching Fireball in a 20-foot radius, incinerating all foes within its reach. The talisman also grants its bearer resistance to fire damage, making them nigh invulnerable to fiery assaults.

effectDetails.title: Fireball
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Deals 6d6 fire damage in a 20-foot cone, with a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw for half damage. Exhausts after one use per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: Grants immunity to all fire damage while worn, lasting until the end of your next long rest.

shanhaijing_elemental_talisman.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to wield effectively due to the raw elemental magic it channels.
shanhaijing_elemental_talisman.vendorReason: The talismans are crafted and sold by the priests of Shanhaijing, who understand their power and purpose well.
shanhaijing_elemental_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships via a Phoenix Wing Courier, ensuring swift delivery through the fiery empyrean.

usage.activation: Bonus action to cast Fireball; passive resistance to fire damage while worn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Fireball; until next long rest for resistance.
usage.endsWhen: Rests and charges exhausted.
usage.charges: One use per short or long rest.

shanhaijing_elemental_talisman.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its powerful but limited utility in combat scenarios.

shanhaijing_immortality_tea.name: Shanhaijing Tea of Longevity
shanhaijing_immortality_tea.description: The Shanhaijing Tea of Longevity is a delicate, golden-hued elixir that whispers ancient wisdom through each sip. Crafted from leaves plucked under the watchful gaze of the Jade Dragon, this tea halts physical aging for its drinker and must be consumed annually to maintain its divine effects. Should one ever falter in their annual ritual, the curse of age might still find them, a reminder that even gods face time's relentless march.

effectDetails.title: Halt Physical Aging
effectDetails.rules: The user’s physical aging is effectively paused. This effect does not prevent the accrual of age-based abilities or penalties, such as those imposed by magical curses.

effectDetails.title: Annual Consumption Required
effectDetails.rules: To maintain the effects of the tea, one must consume it exactly once per year. Failure to do so will result in the resumption of normal aging processes.

shanhaijing_immortality_tea.levelRequirementReason: The tea's divine nature requires the drinker to be at least level 1 to appreciate its subtle effects.
shanhaijing_immortality_tea.vendorReason: As guardians of ancient knowledge, the Shanhaijing Shrine ensures that only those who can truly benefit and respect such a powerful item receive it.
shanhaijing_immortality_tea.shippingDetail: The Golden Teapot Couriers deliver with utmost care, ensuring the tea remains in perfect condition until it reaches its recipient.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon consumption; annual consumption required to maintain.
usage.duration: Permanent while consumed, resets on annual re-consumption
usage.endsWhen: Annual consumption missed or item destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited as long as consumed annually

shanhaijing_immortality_tea.priceReason: The price reflects the divine crafting process and the rarity of ingredients used, ensuring it remains a valuable but balanced addition to any character's inventory.

shanhaijing_imperial_seal.name: Shanhaijing Imperial Seal (Diplomatic)
shanhaijing_imperial_seal.description: The Shanhaijing Imperial Seal glows softly with a jade sheen, its surface etched with ancient symbols that whisper of distant courts and long-lost empires. This sacred artifact is said to have been crafted by the divine artisans of Mount Tai during the height of the Eastern Han Dynasty. It grants its bearer unparalleled sway over diplomatic relations within the realm of Eastern Asia, allowing for swift audiences with any ruler or envoy. With this seal, one's words carry the weight of imperial decree and command.
effects: +5 bonus to all Diplomacy checks when dealing with Eastern/Asian-themed factions
Force immediate audience with any ruler of that culture

effectDetails.title: Diplomatic Favor
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Grants a +5 bonus to all Diplomacy checks when interacting with Eastern or Asian-themed factions for 1 hour, after which the seal's power wanes and must recharge.

effectDetails.title: Imperial Audience
effectDetails.rules: Activation: As part of an interaction. The bearer can demand a private audience with any ruler of Eastern/Asian descent within a week; the request is granted unless the target ruler is engaged in critical matters. This effect cannot be used more than once per month.

shanhaijing_imperial_seal.levelRequirementReason: The Imperial Seal's power requires a strong foundation in diplomacy and cultural understanding, hence the level requirement.
shanhaijing_imperial_seal.vendorReason: The Shrine of Shan Hai Jing houses the artifact as part of its sacred duties to maintain peace within Eastern Asia.
shanhaijing_imperial_seal.shippingDetail: Dispatched by trusted Imperial Couriers, who ensure swift and secure delivery with a minimum delay of one week from the shrine.

usage.activation: As part of an action or as part of an interaction.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Diplomatic Favor; 1 hour duration thereafter. For Imperial Audience: Once per week, lasts until granted audience or until the target ruler is unavailable due to critical matters.
usage.endsWhen: Diplomatic Favor ends after one hour; Imperial Audience ends upon audience being granted or if the target ruler is unavailable.

shanhaijing_imperial_seal.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rarity and the significant diplomatic advantage it confers, making it a strategic but not overpowered asset.

shanhaijing_jade_armor_plates.name: Shanhaijing Jade Armor Plates (Set)
shanhaijing_jade_armor_plates.description: The Shanhaijing Jade Armor Plates are a set of armor forged from ancient mountain jade, imbued with the spiritual essence of the legendary Shanhaijing. These plates are both light and resilient, granting the wearer an AC of 18 while providing +1 to all saving throws against enchantment spells. However, if exposed to open flame for more than one minute, they lose 1 point of their Armor Class as the jade cracks and smolders under intense heat.

effectDetails.title: Spiritual Protection
effectDetails.rules: Grants +1 to all saving throws against enchantment spells. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Flame Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: If exposed to open flame for more than one minute, the armor loses 1 AC due to cracking and smoldering jade. The effect ends when the wearer leaves the source of fire or until repaired by a Craft Wondrous Item spell.

shanhaijing_jade_armor_plates.levelRequirementReason: The Shanhaijing Jade Armor Plates are crafted with intricate carvings and spiritual energies that require significant skill to wield effectively, making them suitable only for experienced heroes.
shanhaijing_jade_armor_plates.vendorReason: As the guardians of ancient knowledge and artifacts, the Shrine of Shanhaijing is entrusted with these sacred items.
shanhaijing_jade_armor_plates.shippingDetail: Delivered with a special chariot drawn by fire-breathing steeds, ensuring safe delivery to the recipient.

usage.duration: Permanent until lost or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Lost, destroyed, or repaired using a Craft Wondrous Item spell.

shanhaijing_jade_armor_plates.priceReason: The jade used in crafting this armor is rare and the spiritual essence imbued into it adds significant value, making it priced at 1000 XP.

shanhaijing_jade_armor_repair.name: Shanhaijing Jade Armor Repair
shanhaijing_jade_armor_repair.description: The Shanhaijing Jade Armor Repair is a sacred ritual crafted by the priests of Shanhaijing. This ritual restores any damaged jade armor set, ensuring that the protective barriers remain unscathed after elemental attacks or fiery assaults. The process requires rare volcanic earth components, which are costly but essential to rekindle the jade's ancient power. Only those initiated into the shrine's mysteries can perform this intricate and time-honored ritual.
effects: Fully restore any Shanhaijing Jade Armor set

effectDetails.title: Restoration of Jade Armor
effectDetails.rules: This ritual fully restores the damaged jade armor, making it as good as new. It has a duration of instantaneous and requires the user to be within 30 feet of the damaged armor set. The ritual ends when successfully completed.

effectDetails.title: Additional Cost for Components
effectDetails.rules: The user must provide rare volcanic earth components, which cost an additional 15,000 XP. These components are essential to rekindle the jade's ancient power and ensure the ritual's success.

shanhaijing_jade_armor_repair.levelRequirementReason: Requires a priest of at least 8th level to channel the sacred energy needed for this ritual.
shanhaijing_jade_armor_repair.vendorReason: Only initiated priests and members of Shanhaijing can perform this ritual, making it exclusive to their shrine.
shanhaijing_jade_armor_repair.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the sacred mountains; expedited delivery with a delay of one week due to special handling.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Once successfully completed or if the user fails to provide the required components

shanhaijing_jade_armor_repair.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the ritual's complexity and the value of rare volcanic earth components.

shanhaijing_jade_armor_restoration.name: Shanhaijing Jade Weapon Re-Attunement
shanhaijing_jade_armor_restoration.description: The Shanhaijing Jade Weapon Re-Attunement is a sacred artifact from the ancient Celestial Jade Weaponsmiths of Shanhaijing, capable of reassigning a weapon's celestial focus and alignment.
