When uncorked, it releases a scorching cone of fire that can melt stone and singe flesh. The user gains resistance to fire damage for an hour, but at the cost of their own strength, leaving them vulnerable until they rest.

effectDetails.title: Dragonfire Cone
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user may uncork the vial and exhale fire in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 13) or take 4d6 fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The user gains resistance to fire damage for one hour after using the potion. This effect ends when the user rests, and they can only use this ability once per long rest.

spyro_dragonfire.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second-level spellcasting to effectively utilize the effects.
spyro_dragonfire.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand is known for its extensive network of alchemists and access to rare and exotic potions, including the Dragonfire Breath Potion.
spyro_dragonfire.shippingDetail: Ships via Flame Vial Express, a courier service that ensures swift delivery but requires an additional fee.

usage.activation: Bonus action to uncork and exhale fire in a cone.
usage.duration: One hour of fire resistance.
usage.endsWhen: Rests or after one use per long rest.

spyro_dragonfire.priceReason: Balanced as a rare consumable, offering significant but not game-breaking effects at an affordable price for mid-level characters.

squad_glow_beacon.name: Squad Glow Beacon
squad_glow_beacon.description: The Squad Glow Beacon is a compact, glow-in-the-dark beacon made from a mix of phosphorescent minerals and ancient elven sigils. When activated, it not only calls nearby friendly militia to your location but also marks you with an eerie green glow that can be seen for miles through the night sky. Each use increases faction attention by +2, drawing more troops but also alerting enemies in the area.

effectDetails.title: Call Allies
effectDetails.rules: Activating the Squad Glow Beacon calls 1d6 allied militia (CR 1/2) to your location. They follow simple orders given by the nearest ally within 50 feet, remaining for as long as you maintain line of sight.

effectDetails.title: Increase Faction Attention
effectDetails.rules: Each use increases faction attention by +2, meaning more troops are drawn to your position but also that enemies in the area become aware and may respond. This effect lasts until the next dawn or until another Squad Glow Beacon is used nearby.

squad_glow_beacon.levelRequirementReason: This beacon is designed for quick deployment by lower-level units.
squad_glow_beacon.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in equipment and supplies that enhance battlefield visibility and communication.
squad_glow_beacon.shippingDetail: Ships via the Swift Eagle Courier Service, which ensures timely delivery even under adverse conditions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until dawn or another Squad Glow Beacon is used nearby
usage.endsWhen: Dawn or when a new Squad Glow Beacon is activated nearby

squad_glow_beacon.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the beacon's utility in battlefield situations without overpricing its strategic value.

squeaky_boots_of_stealth.name: Squeaky Boots of Stealth
squeaky_boots_of_stealth.description: These boots, crafted from enchanted leather and imbued with mischievous spirits, are designed for silent travel. When worn in urban areas, they grant advantage on Stealth checks. However, a natural roll of 1 will cause them to emit a deafening squeak, alerting nearby guards with a loud creak that can be heard up to 30 feet away (DC 12 Perception check). The boots also provide +1 to Constitution saves against exhaustion from extended travel and wash more effectively than standard footwear, reducing the frequency of squeaking by half.
effects: Advantage on Stealth in Urban Areas

effectDetails.title: Stealth Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When worn in urban areas, the boots grant advantage on Stealth checks. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Deafening Squeak
effectDetails.rules: If a wearer rolls a natural 1 on a Stealth check while wearing these boots, they produce an ear-piercing squeak that alerts all creatures within 30 feet with a DC 12 Perception check. This effect can be triggered once per short or long rest.

squeaky_boots_of_stealth.levelRequirementReason: These boots are designed for adventurers of any level, providing comic relief and utility.
squeaky_boots_of_stealth.vendorReason: The Thieves' Guild Outlet stocks items that provide a comedic edge to serious pursuits, making these boots an ideal addition to their collection.
squeaky_boots_of_stealth.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the Silent Package (Mostly), ensuring your secret mission is not compromised in transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until worn off or a new Stealth check is made
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a successful Perception check against the squeak sound is made by an adjacent creature or the wearer takes another action.

squeaky_boots_of_stealth.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its unique utility and comedic value, these boots are priced at 1000 XP.

star_beam_replica.name: Star Beam (Replica)
star_beam_replica.description: The Star Beam (Replica) is a meticulously crafted plastic replica of a legendary weapon, its surface etched with faint cosmic patterns and glowing blue accents that mimic the real thing. Despite being a mere toy, it projects a brilliant 10-foot radius light that illuminates any dark space like a beacon from another world. It's shipped directly by Comet Observatory and comes in a specially designed packaging that captures the essence of its celestial origin.

effectDetails.title: Cosmic Glow
effectDetails.rules: The Star Beam (Replica) projects a 10-foot radius light, illuminating all creatures and objects within its area as if under dim light. This effect lasts for 1 minute per use, expiring when the item is used again.

effectDetails.title: Luminous Projection
effectDetails.rules: The toy emits a faint blue glow that can be seen up to 30 feet away by creatures with darkvision or truesight. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges; it remains active until used again.

star_beam_replica.levelRequirementReason: This toy is designed for beginners and casual adventurers who appreciate its aesthetic and luminescent qualities.
star_beam_replica.vendorReason: Comet Observatory specializes in rare and exotic items, including this celestial replica that captures the essence of their vast collection.
star_beam_replica.shippingDetail: Ships via Express Starlight Courier; arrives within a week with a special delivery confirmation.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and project light.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use, expiring when used again.
usage.endsWhen: Used again or after expiration of the duration.

star_beam_replica.priceReason: The Star Beam (Replica) is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique design, aesthetic appeal, and the prestige associated with Comet Observatory.

star_rod.name: The Star Rod
star_rod.description: The Star Rod, an ancient and celestial staff crafted from meteoric iron and encased in starlight, is said to have been stolen by Bowser from the heavens themselves. With a single stroke, it can reshape reality within a mile, bending time and space to grant wishes or protect its bearer from harm. Legends speak of seven star spirits that will hunt down any who wield this rod, making its possession both a blessing and a curse.

effectDetails.title: Wish at Will
effectDetails.rules: The user may cast the 'Wish' spell at will. This ability is limited to once per day, and it can alter reality in almost any way, from healing injuries to reshaping the environment.

effectDetails.title: Reality Alteration
effectDetails.rules: By using the Star Rod, the wielder can bend time and space within a 1-mile radius. This effect lasts for an hour, altering the immediate surroundings or creating illusions as desired.

star_rod.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest of heroes may find use for this powerful artifact in their quest to restore balance.
star_rod.vendorReason: The Comet Observatory, a repository of celestial knowledge, has managed to acquire this rare and ancient relic through an exchange with Bowser himself.
star_rod.shippingDetail: Due to the volatile nature of reality-altering properties, Star Haven Express advises customers to be ready for unpredictable delivery times and potential environmental changes during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or as a concentration effect (1 hour)
usage.endsWhen: The user ceases concentrating on the effect or upon the expiration of an hour

star_rod.priceReason: This price reflects the Star Rod's powerful abilities, yet it is still accessible to lower-level heroes who might need its assistance.

star_rod_fragment.name: Fragment of the Star Rod
star_rod_fragment.description: This fragment of the Star Rod glows with a soft, celestial light that dances in patterns only understood by those aligned with the cosmos. Crafted from the very essence of the stars themselves, it hums with infinite potential and can alter reality itself when wielded by one who knows its true magic. Legend has it that collecting twenty such fragments will restore the Star Rod to its full glory, capable of granting wishes on a scale that could change the fate of an entire world.

effectDetails.title: Wish Granting
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this fragment can grant a wish. The wish must be stated in full before the activation. The DM has final say over the feasibility of the wish and any resulting effects. This effect can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Cosmic Alignment
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after activation, the wielder gains advantage on all saving throws against spells or effects that deal damage from celestial beings or deities. This effect ends when the time expires or if the fragment is destroyed.

star_rod_fragment.levelRequirementReason: The magic within this fragment is too powerful for those below fifth level, requiring a measure of cosmic awareness and discipline.
star_rod_fragment.vendorReason: As custodians of ancient knowledge and celestial phenomena, the Comet Observatory would naturally have access to fragments of such legendary artifacts.
star_rod_fragment.shippingDetail: The fragment is delivered via a direct celestial courier, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Wish Granting) or 1 hour (Cosmic Alignment)
usage.endsWhen: The time expires or the fragment is destroyed

star_rod_fragment.priceReason: This item, while powerful, is not considered godly rarity; its price reflects its unique utility and cosmic significance rather than unparalleled power.

starlight_festival_glitter_gown.name: Starlight Festival Glitter Gown
starlight_festival_glitter_gown.description: The Starlight Festival Glitter Gown is a shimmering gown that captures the essence of the celestial night. Its fabric glows faintly, casting a soft, iridescent light within a five-foot radius. The gown is adorned with glittering stars and silver threads that sparkle under the moonlight, making the wearer appear as if they are walking through a starry sky. This gown was crafted by Festival Designers for the most elegant of night celebrations, ensuring each wearer feels like an immortal among mortals.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Glow
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this gown, you have advantage on Performance checks when performing under the stars. Additionally, the gown glows faintly, emitting a soft light within a five-foot radius for as long as you wear it.

effectDetails.title: Star-Adorned Grace
effectDetails.rules: The glitter on this gown adheres to everything touched by its wearer, leaving behind shimmering trails of starlight that persist until washed off. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

starlight_festival_glitter_gown.levelRequirementReason: This gown is designed for any eager participant in the festival, requiring no specific level to wear it.
starlight_festival_glitter_gown.vendorReason: The Starlight Festival Designers are renowned for their creations and this gown is a centerpiece of their offerings.
starlight_festival_glitter_gown.shippingDetail: Ships within the night, arriving at your doorstep with a twinkling light show.

usage.activation: Automatic upon putting on the gown; no activation required.
usage.duration: Until removed or until the wearer completes a short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The glitter effect ends when the wearer washes it off, and the glow fades with removal or end of duration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but recharges after a short or long rest.

starlight_festival_glitter_gown.priceReason: This gown is crafted with high-quality materials and intricate detailing, making it moderately priced for its elegance.

starlight_festival_star_cutter.name: Starlight Festival Star Cutter
starlight_festival_star_cutter.description: The Starlight Festival Star Cutter is a gleaming silver tool forged from starlight and moonbeams, perfect for slicing star-shaped salad fruits that shimmer under the night sky. Its blade glows softly when exposed to moonlight or starlight, enhancing the festival-goer's charisma by +1 during performances at the evening feast. However, in daylight, it dulls and becomes merely a mundane kitchen tool, its magic only active under celestial illumination.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Glow
effectDetails.rules: The Star Cutter glows softly when exposed to moonlight or starlight. It provides a +1 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks made during performances at the evening feast.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: While under celestial illumination, the user gains a +1 bonus to Charisma checks and saving throws for performances. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after ceasing exposure to moonlight or starlight.

starlight_festival_star_cutter.levelRequirementReason: The Star Cutter's magic is subtle and requires no great skill, making it accessible to all participants in the festival.
starlight_festival_star_cutter.vendorReason: As a tool designed specifically for the Starlight Festival, the Star Cutter is naturally supplied by the organizers of this grand event.
starlight_festival_star_cutter.shippingDetail: The Star Cutter is delivered in a set that includes a decorative star-shaped cutting board and a pair of matching star cutters, enhancing its value as a gift or keepsake.

usage.activation: Passive effect active when exposed to moonlight or starlight; ends immediately after exposure ceases
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exposure to moonlight or starlight ceases

starlight_festival_star_cutter.priceReason: The Star Cutter's value is balanced by its limited effect and the material it is made from, which is not rare but special to the festival.

starlight_festival_star_fruit_salad_reci.name: Recipe: Starlight Festival Star Fruit Salad
starlight_festival_star_fruit_salad_reci.description: This recipe, passed down from the Festival Chefs during Starlight Festivals, yields a shimmering salad of star-shaped fruits that align perfectly under the night sky's twinkling stars. Each slice reveals a fragment of celestial magic, and when consumed, it grants you inspiration for a wish-related roll, bolstering your Charisma by +1 until the end of your next short or long rest. The salad is a symbol of hope and dreams, made from fruits harvested at midnight under the perfect alignment of stars.

effectDetails.title: Wish Roll Inspiration
effectDetails.rules: Eating this salad grants you inspiration for one wish-related roll. It provides a +1 bonus to your Charisma (Performance) or Charisma (Persuasion) check, which ends when the effect of the wish is resolved.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Charisma score until the end of your next short or long rest. This effect does not stack with other sources of Charisma bonuses.

starlight_festival_star_fruit_salad_reci.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to players who are just starting their journey, allowing them to enhance their performance and persuasive abilities early in the game.
starlight_festival_star_fruit_salad_reci.vendorReason: The Festival Chefs have perfected this recipe over countless Starlight Festivals, ensuring its availability for eager participants.
starlight_festival_star_fruit_salad_reci.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of star-shaped balloons, the salad arrives fresh and vibrant, symbolizing the festival's magic.

usage.activation: Eating one slice of the salad during a Starlight Festival
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you complete either a short or long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, as each slice is self-contained

starlight_festival_star_fruit_salad_reci.priceReason: This recipe's value lies in its rarity and the unique experience it brings to players, making it moderately priced but still within reach of beginning adventurers.

starlight_fey_lantern.name: Starlight Fey Lantern
starlight_fey_lantern.description: The Starlight Fey Lantern, crafted from the luminescent bark of the ancient Sylvan tree, casts a soft glow that reveals hidden fey creatures within its 30-foot radius. Its light is not merely illumination but also a spell of subtle magic that can cause mischievous pixies to dart around it, occasionally attempting to claim the lantern as their own. This lantern's ethereal light has been known to frighten sensitive fey, compelling them to make a Wisdom saving throw or be temporarily driven away in fear.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Invisible Fey
effectDetails.rules: The lantern illuminates a 30-foot radius, revealing all invisible fey creatures within the area. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Frighten Mischievous Fey
effectDetails.rules: All mischievous fey within 30 feet of the lantern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw with a DC of 14 or be frightened for 1 minute. The effect ends if the fey leaves the area.

starlight_fey_lantern.levelRequirementReason: This lantern is designed to be accessible, providing adventurers with an entry-level tool for dealing with fey creatures.
starlight_fey_lantern.vendorReason: The Starlight Garrison has a long-standing relationship with the Lantern's creators and stocks it as part of their ongoing support for explorers venturing into fae territory.
starlight_fey_lantern.shippingDetail: Delivered by winged messengers, ensuring swift arrival even in the most remote areas.

usage.duration: Until the fey are frightened or leave the area.
usage.endsWhen: The fey creatures are no longer within range or if the lantern is destroyed.

starlight_fey_lantern.priceReason: Balanced to ensure that adventurers can afford this utility without feeling overpowered in dealing with fey encounters.

starlight_glitter_bomb_service.name: Starlight Glitter Bomb Service
starlight_glitter_bomb_service.description: The Starlight Glitter Bomb Service is a dazzling display of shimmering stardust that erupts into a flurry of celestial light. When deployed, it blinds all creatures within its path with a cascade of glittering stars for one round (DC 14 CON save). The second effect, 'Cleanup Nightmare,' ensures the area remains sparkling clean and free from messes for days to come. Crafted by Starlight Party Planners, this service is perfect for any event needing a magical distraction.

effectDetails.title: Dazzling Display
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Starlight Glitter Bomb Service blinds all creatures within 10 feet for one round. The save DC is 14 (Constitution saving throw). This effect cannot be used more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Cleanup Nightmare
effectDetails.rules: This effect ensures that the area remains clean and free of messes for up to a week, making it ideal for after-party cleanup. It has no save or action requirement and is active as long as the service is not used again within a week.

starlight_glitter_bomb_service.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for low-level characters who need a magical but non-combat tool to enhance social situations.
starlight_glitter_bomb_service.vendorReason: Starlight Party Planners are renowned for their innovative and whimsical party services, making the Starlight Glitter Bomb Service a natural addition to their offerings.
starlight_glitter_bomb_service.shippingDetail: Ships overnight with Sparkly Bag Express, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition for your next event.

usage.duration: One round (instantaneous effect)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the save is successful or after one round

starlight_glitter_bomb_service.priceReason: This service offers a unique and magical experience at an uncommon price, making it a cost-effective choice for players seeking to enhance their events.

starlight_observatory_chart.name: Starlight Observatory Chart
starlight_observatory_chart.description: The Starlight Observatory Chart, a celestial parchment adorned with constellations and arcane symbols, reveals the fleeting presence of either a 'Starfall' — a meteor shower rich in rare metals that burns for just one night — or a 'Whispering Nebula,' which grants an ethereal vision to those who consult it. It is said that these cosmic events are drawn by the parchment's ancient enchantments, but once consulted, the chart disintegrates into a twinkling cloud of stardust.

effectDetails.title: Reveal a Starfall or Whispering Nebula
effectDetails.rules: This chart, when consulted by an individual of at least 1st level, reveals the location and timing of either a 'Starfall' (a meteor shower rich in rare metals) or a 'Whispering Nebula' (which grants a vision of celestial phenomena). The event lasts for exactly 24 hours after the chart is consulted. Using the chart consumes it.

effectDetails.title: Consumes Upon Use
effectDetails.rules: The Starlight Observatory Chart disintegrates into stardust upon revealing its celestial secret, leaving no trace of its use.

starlight_observatory_chart.levelRequirementReason: Revealing the location of a cosmic event requires at least basic astronomical knowledge and concentration.
starlight_observatory_chart.vendorReason: Starlight is renowned for their expertise in celestial phenomena, making them the trusted purveyors of such ancient charts.
starlight_observatory_chart.shippingDetail: Shipped by a dedicated astronomer via swift celestial courier, ensuring prompt delivery to those who seek the stars.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The event ends when its duration expires or is disrupted.

starlight_observatory_chart.priceReason: Balanced against other rare curiosities, this chart's price reflects the rarity of its contents and the cost of its ancient enchantment.

starlight_sparkle_enhancement.name: Starlight Sparkle Enhancement
starlight_sparkle_enhancement.description: The Starlight Sparkle Enhancement is a subtle yet dazzling enhancement that turns you into a walking beacon of twinkling magic. It infuses your presence with an ethereal glow, enhancing your charisma in dim light and leaving a trail of glittering stardust behind. This charm is particularly effective against vampires, who are unnerved by the sparkle, and those who revel in chaos—those 'edgelords'—who instantly become hostile upon seeing you.

effectDetails.title: Twinkling Presence
effectDetails.rules: While this enhancement is active, you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma checks and saving throws. In dim light, your presence becomes more noticeable, causing others to have disadvantage on Stealth checks within 30 feet of you.

effectDetails.title: Sparkle Against Edgelords
effectDetails.rules: Vampires are automatically hostile towards you, and any 'edgelord' within 60 feet has disadvantage on interactions with you. This effect is particularly effective in dimly lit areas where your sparkles are most vibrant.

starlight_sparkle_enhancement.levelRequirementReason: This enhancement is designed for those who wish to make a statement without needing extensive experience.
starlight_sparkle_enhancement.vendorReason: Starlight Sparkle Techs specialize in creating items that enhance one's presence, making them the perfect vendor for this sparkle-imbued charm.
starlight_sparkle_enhancement.shippingDetail: Delivered by Glitter Bomb Express, known for their swift and reliable delivery of magical enhancements.

usage.activation: Active as a bonus action that can be used once per short or long rest.
usage.duration: Concentration up to one hour, or until dispelled.
usage.endsWhen: Lost concentration, or upon being dispelled by magic.
usage.charges: One use, recharges after a short or long rest.

starlight_sparkle_enhancement.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the enhancement's utility and limited duration, ensuring it remains a desirable but not overpowered option for adventurers.

starman_shard.name: Starman Shard
starman_shard.description: The Starman Shard is a shimmering, crystalline fragment that pulses with the faint glow of distant stars. It was once part of an ancient Super Star, now reduced to a glowing shard. When activated, it grants you invulnerability for ten seconds and doubles your speed and attack damage during its duration. However, after using it, you suffer from withdrawal symptoms, reducing all your ability checks by one for the next hour.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard grants you a +1 bonus to AC and immunity to all damage for ten seconds. It requires an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Speed & Damage
effectDetails.rules: During the duration of invulnerability, your movement speed is doubled and you deal double normal weapon or spell damage with each attack or cantrip cast.

starman_shard.levelRequirementReason: This shard is accessible to all levels as it provides a powerful but temporary boost.
starman_shard.vendorReason: Wario Direct, known for its wide array of unique and experimental items, offers the Starman Shard alongside its other quirky wares.
starman_shard.shippingDetail: Shipped via trusted couriers, ensuring safe delivery within a week.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you take damage

starman_shard.priceReason: The shard is priced at 1000 XP due to its balanced power level and unique effects.

statue_of_infinite_wishes.name: Statue of Infinite Wishes
statue_of_infinite_wishes.description: The Statue of Infinite Wishes stands regally, its surface shimmering with a faint glow that hints at the boundless desires it can fulfill. Crafted by The Genie Union from the rarest materials found in the heart of ancient ruins, this statue is said to have been blessed by deities themselves. Touch its cold stone and whisper your wish; it will be granted without hesitation or consequence—though the nature of these wishes has yet to reveal any inherent drawbacks.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Wishes
effectDetails.rules: Activating this effect allows you to make a wish by touching the statue. The wish is granted instantly, with no limits or consequences. However, each use expends one charge from its limited supply.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Fulfillment
effectDetails.rules: The wish takes immediate effect upon declaration. No dice rolls are required for fulfillment, and the statue cannot be tricked into granting wishes that would harm or exploit it.

statue_of_infinite_wishes.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest soul can appreciate the grandeur of a wish without dire consequences.
statue_of_infinite_wishes.vendorReason: The Genie Union's network spans realms, and they are known for their reliable and ethical granting of wishes.
statue_of_infinite_wishes.shippingDetail: Delivered by Swift Courier within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Touch the statue to activate this effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the wish is granted.
usage.endsWhen: The use of one charge ends it, and all charges are exhausted after five uses.

statue_of_infinite_wishes.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and the limited number of wishes available before exhaustion.

stellar_explosion_bomb.name: Stellar Explosion Bomb
stellar_explosion_bomb.description: A fragment of a dying star, encased in an ornate steel sphere. This weaponized relic releases a cataclysmic explosion that obliterates everything within its vast radius. The resulting firestorm leaves behind a smoking crater and decimates entire city blocks. Using the Stellar Explosion Bomb makes you a wanted criminal globally, with bounties from every nation. Its detonation requires 1 minute of precise setup, ensuring it's used only in desperate times.

effectDetails.title: Cataclysmic Firestorm
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the bomb detonates with a 40d6 fire damage explosion in a 300-foot radius. The explosion instantly decimates everything within its area of effect and leaves behind a smoking crater. A successful DC 25 Dexterity saving throw reduces the damage by half.

effectDetails.title: Global Notoriety
effectDetails.rules: Using this item makes you a wanted criminal globally, with bounties from every nation. You must make a DC 18 Charisma (Deception) check to avoid drawing undue attention when in public places for at least one week.

stellar_explosion_bomb.levelRequirementReason: The bomb's destructive power and the risk involved necessitate a high-level character with significant combat experience.
stellar_explosion_bomb.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand, known for its extensive network of spies and connections, handles the distribution of this dangerous item to ensure it only reaches those who truly need it.
stellar_explosion_bomb.shippingDetail: Ships via a secure, heavily armored vehicle with special authorization from the authorities. Delivery can take up to one week due to stringent security checks.

usage.activation: Requires 1 minute of precise setup before activation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous explosion upon activation.
usage.endsWhen: Expended once used, leaving only a smoking crater behind.

stellar_explosion_bomb.priceReason: The bomb's balanced price reflects its powerful yet highly dangerous nature.

stellar_map_of_forgotten_worlds.name: Stellar Map of Forgotten Worlds (Navigation)
stellar_map_of_forgotten_worlds.description: The Stellar Map of Forgotten Worlds is a holographic device that unfolds like a celestial scroll, revealing lost planets and ancient ruins hidden across the cosmos. Crafted by Star Cartographers, this map updates in real-time with new discoveries, allowing explorers to chart uncharted territories and uncover long-lost secrets. Its glow shifts between hues of deep violet and pale gold as it displays distant star systems and forgotten worlds, each marked by a constellation of twinkling lights.

effectDetails.title: Unveils Hidden Planets
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the map reveals up to 10 previously unknown planets and ancient ruins within a 5-mile radius. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Updates in Real-Time
effectDetails.rules: The map continuously updates with new discoveries made by Star Cartographers or other explorers, providing current information on lost worlds. The updates are passive and do not require an action to maintain.

stellar_map_of_forgotten_worlds.levelRequirementReason: This device requires a high level of expertise in navigation and exploration to fully utilize its capabilities.
stellar_map_of_forgotten_worlds.vendorReason: The Cosmic Archive is known for its extensive collection of rare and powerful artifacts, including the Stellar Map of Forgotten Worlds.
stellar_map_of_forgotten_worlds.shippingDetail: The map arrives via a secure Holo-Projector Express delivery, ensuring that it reaches its destination intact and fully operational.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate the map's current display of hidden planets or ancient ruins.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The user dismisses the effect using a bonus action or until the next long rest, whichever comes first.

stellar_map_of_forgotten_worlds.priceReason: This map's rarity and unparalleled utility justify its high price in the cosmic market.

stellar_navigator_ai.name: Stellar Navigator AI (Ship Module)
stellar_navigator_ai.description: The Stellar Navigator AI, a sleek, glowing console embedded in your ship's bridge, is AstroTech’s pinnacle of hyperspace navigation. Its crystalline core glows with a soft blue light as it calculates optimal routes through the cosmos, ensuring you avoid hazards and arrive at your destination with precision. This advanced AI can predict stellar anomalies up to 100 parsecs ahead, allowing for swift evasive maneuvers if necessary. With its assistance, travel time is reduced by 40%, making each journey a triumph of efficiency and safety.

effectDetails.title: Optimized Hyperspace Travel
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Reduces travel time by 40% for the next hyperspace jump, making it easier to navigate through complex stellar systems and arrive at your destination faster. This effect ends when you exit hyperspace or if the AI is disabled.

effectDetails.title: Stellar Hazard Prediction
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. The Stellar Navigator AI predicts potential hazards up to 100 parsecs ahead, providing a +4 bonus to saving throws against environmental hazards and a +2 bonus to Navigation checks in hazardous areas. This effect persists until you manually deactivate it or if the AI is disabled.

stellar_navigator_ai.levelRequirementReason: This advanced AI requires significant computational power, which is only available at level 16.
stellar_navigator_ai.vendorReason: Space Dock specializes in high-tech ship modules and can provide the necessary support for such an advanced AI system.
stellar_navigator_ai.shippingDetail: Ships via Orbital Shuttle, ensuring secure and rapid delivery to your starport.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate or de-activate.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for travel time reduction; passive effect lasts until manually deactivated or AI is disabled.
usage.endsWhen: Manual deactivation or AI disablement.

stellar_navigator_ai.priceReason: Reflects the cutting-edge technology and ongoing support required for such an advanced system.

stellar_nova_bomb.name: Stellar Nova Bomb (Explosive)
stellar_nova_bomb.description: The Stellar Nova Bomb, a device forged from ancient stardust and bound by the will of Star Destroyers, mimics the cataclysmic explosion of a nova. When unleashed, it unleashes a searing wave of radiant energy that incinerates all within its path, leaving nothing but a glowing ember in its wake. This one-time use weapon is as volatile as the stars themselves and must be handled with utmost care by those who dare wield it.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Annihilation
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Stellar Nova Bomb unleashes a 100-foot radius of searing radiant energy. All creatures within this area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 20d10 radiant damage and be blinded until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: One-Time Use
effectDetails.rules: The bomb can only be used once before it is destroyed. Once activated, it cannot be recharged or reused.

stellar_nova_bomb.levelRequirementReason: Only those of exceptional power and skill are capable of wielding the Stellar Nova Bomb without risk to themselves.
stellar_nova_bomb.vendorReason: Nova Lab specializes in exotic weapons and devices that push the boundaries of known technology, making it a fitting vendor for such an item.
stellar_nova_bomb.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the Stellar Nova Bomb must be shipped using Containment Field's specialized delivery service, which ensures safe transport.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Expended after use or destroyed if not used within one week of activation.

stellar_nova_bomb.priceReason: The Stellar Nova Bomb is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its immense power and the complexity of its construction.

stellar_shield_generator.name: Stellar Shield Generator (Defense)
stellar_shield_generator.description: The Stellar Shield Generator hums softly, its core a polished prism of starlight. This device projects an impenetrable force field that draws power from celestial energy, shimmering with hues of twilight and dawn. Crafted by the Solar Defenders, it can absorb up to 200 points of damage before requiring sunlight for recharging. The shield is as much a symbol of hope as it is an instrument of defense, its glow never dimming even in the darkest skies.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Damage
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Stellar Shield Generator absorbs up to 200 points of damage. The shield can only absorb this amount once before requiring sunlight for recharging. If the shield is destroyed or otherwise disabled while active, it immediately discharges all absorbed damage.

effectDetails.title: Recharges with Sunlight
effectDetails.rules: The generator must be exposed to direct sunlight for at least 10 minutes to recharge and restore its full power. During this time, the shield remains operational but cannot absorb any additional damage. If interrupted by darkness or cover, recharging is delayed until conditions are favorable.

stellar_shield_generator.levelRequirementReason: The Stellar Shield Generator requires a high level to wield effectively, as it demands both physical and magical prowess.
stellar_shield_generator.vendorReason: Solar Defenders maintain this item exclusively, providing it directly from their Solar Forge headquarters.
stellar_shield_generator.shippingDetail: Ships via the Photon Beam courier service, ensuring swift delivery across the cosmos. Awaiting sunlight for recharging upon arrival.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate and deploy the shield, which remains active until destroyed or disabled.
usage.duration: Instantaneous damage absorption; shield remains operational while sunlight is available.
usage.endsWhen: Shield destruction, darkness covering it, or recharging in sunlight.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but requires 10 minutes of sunlight to recharge.

stellar_shield_generator.priceReason: Crafted by Solar Defenders and requiring significant resources for both material and magical components, the Stellar Shield Generator is priced accordingly.

stickers_star.name: Book of Stickers
stickers_star.description: The Book of Stickers is a bound collection of shimmering, iridescent stickers that seem to pulse with the energy of forgotten childhoods. Each page contains a dozen stickers, each one a unique masterpiece crafted from the remnants of ancient starlight and enchanted by the whimsical hands of fae artisans. Adorning your belongings or journal with these stickers not only brightens their appearance but also grants you a fleeting sense of wonder and nostalgia that lingers for hours.

effectDetails.title: Sticker Adornment
effectDetails.rules: By spending an action, you can adhere one sticker from the book to any non-magical object or surface. This effect lasts until the object is damaged beyond repair. The sticker cannot be removed without destroying it.

effectDetails.title: Childhood Nostalgia
effectDetails.rules: Upon viewing a sticker, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to recall childhood memories for 1 hour. This effect does not require an action and can be used once per day.

stickers_star.levelRequirementReason: The Book of Stickers appeals to the child within everyone, making it accessible to all levels.
stickers_star.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for its eclectic selection of unique and magical curiosities that appeal to all ages.
stickers_star.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, with the courier ensuring safe delivery even in the most unpredictable weather conditions.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to apply a sticker)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for applying stickers; lasts until object is damaged beyond repair
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the sticker is destroyed, damaged beyond recognition, or the duration expires

stickers_star.priceReason: The price reflects the unique craftsmanship and enchantment required to create these magical stickers.

sticky_oil.name: Flask of Sticky Oil
sticky_oil.description: The Flask of Sticky Oil is a small, leather-bound container filled to the brim with a viscous, amber liquid that clings to surfaces like molten honey. When opened, the oil spreads across the floor in an expansive 10-foot square pool, making it nearly impossible for anyone to walk through without slipping and sliding. The oil's surface is thick enough to trap foes, causing them to fall and struggle against its sticky embrace.

effectDetails.title: Difficult Terrain
effectDetails.rules: The area covered by the oil becomes difficult terrain. Any creature that enters this area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14). On a failed save, they are restrained until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Restrained on Contact
effectDetails.rules: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the oil or enters the oil for the first time must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14). On a failed save, they are restrained until the end of their next turn. This effect can only occur once per target.

sticky_oil.levelRequirementReason: This item is common and easily accessible to first-level adventurers.
sticky_oil.vendorReason: The Rogueport Black Market caters to all manner of miscreants, providing them with the tools they need for their schemes.
sticky_oil.shippingDetail: Ships via Jar's unreliable but fast service; arrives within a week.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when opened and poured onto the ground.
usage.duration: Until the end of the next long rest or until the oil is cleaned up.
usage.endsWhen: The flask is emptied, or the area is thoroughly cleaned.

sticky_oil.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's common rarity and moderate utility in combat.

stop_watch.name: Stop Watch
stop_watch.description: The Stop Watch is a delicate, silver timepiece encrusted with glistening sapphires and emeralds. It radiates an eerie blue glow when activated, temporarily halting the flow of time within its radius. Within this frozen moment, all enemies caught in the 30-foot radius must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for one round. The second effect is that any creature who holds the Stop Watch feels a surge of temporal energy, granting them temporary hit points equal to your level + your Intelligence modifier when you activate it.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Paralysis
effectDetails.rules: When activated, all enemies within a 30-foot radius must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or be paralyzed for one round. This effect has no save after the first activation per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Hit Point Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Intelligence modifier. These hit points last until they are reduced to 0 or you finish a short or long rest.

stop_watch.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for lower-level adventurers who could benefit from its time-stopping capabilities without overwhelming them with power.
stop_watch.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market specializes in curiosities and magical trinkets, making the Stop Watch a fitting addition to their inventory.
stop_watch.shippingDetail: Ships via Swift Courier for expedited delivery within one game day.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next turn or until you take a bonus action to deactivate it.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a bonus action to deactivate it, or if an enemy successfully saves against the paralysis.

stop_watch.priceReason: The Stop Watch provides significant tactical advantages at a cost that reflects its magical properties and utility.

storm_giants_thunderdrum.name: Storm Giant's Thunderdrum
storm_giants_thunderdrum.description: The Storm Giant's Thunderdrum is a colossal war drum crafted from the petrified skull of a cloud giant, its surface etched with arcane symbols that pulse with raw thunder. When struck, it releases a concussive wave capable of shattering stone and sending tremors through the earth itself. Warriors within earshot gain not only immunity to thunder damage but also enhanced reflexes, allowing them to dodge attacks more easily for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Earthquake
effectDetails.rules: When the drum is struck as a bonus action within 100 feet, all creatures in a 30-foot radius must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Thunder Immunity & Reflex Boost
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 100 feet gain immunity to thunder damage for 1 hour and a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws against being knocked prone. This benefit lasts until the end of their next long rest.

storm_giants_thunderdrum.levelRequirementReason: The drum's power requires immense strength and discipline, suitable only for seasoned Storm Giants or those who have trained under them.
storm_giants_thunderdrum.vendorReason: Only the Giant Emporium would stock such a relic, as it deals exclusively in items crafted by titanic beings.
storm_giants_thunderdrum.shippingDetail: Ships via the Giant Eagle's swift flight, arriving within days rather than weeks.

usage.duration: Earthquake effect lasts for 1 minute; thunder immunity and reflex boost last until the end of their next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally or when the drum is no longer used in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharging after a long rest.

storm_giants_thunderdrum.priceReason: This legendary artifact commands an exorbitant price due to its unique crafting materials and the immense power it wields.

storm_in_a_bottle.name: Storm in a Bottle
storm_in_a_bottle.description: This exquisite bottle holds a miniature hurricane, its glass walls trembling under the unrelenting wind and lightning. Crafted by the Stormweaver Guild, this relic once belonged to Queen Pauline of the Sea Breezes, a legendary storm mage. Each time it shatters, a tempest rages out for 10 minutes within a 50-foot radius, unleashing 4d10 lightning damage and 3d10 thunder damage along with a gale force wind that scours the land. The hurricane diminishes in power each use until it can no longer reform.

effectDetails.title: Unleash Storm
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this bottle shatters, unleashing a tempest within a 50-foot radius. The storm deals 4d10 lightning damage and 3d10 thunder damage to all creatures in the area, and wind speeds of 60 feet. The effect lasts for 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Storm Weakens
effectDetails.rules: Each use weakens the storm within the bottle. After three uses, the next activation does not reform the storm, rendering it ineffective until the bottle is reforged by a Stormweaver Guildmaster at their sanctuary, which takes one week.

storm_in_a_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a minimum level of 5 to control and channel its volatile power.
storm_in_a_bottle.vendorReason: Storm Sells, the renowned vendor for all things storm-related, carries this artifact due to her family's long-standing ties with the Stormweaver Guild.
storm_in_a_bottle.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Ironclad Courier, known for its punctuality and reliability, ensuring that the bottle arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Reaction (requires no action on your turn)
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: The storm dissipates after 10 minutes or if the bottle is destroyed
usage.charges: 3 charges, recharged by a Stormweaver Guildmaster in one week

storm_in_a_bottle.priceReason: This item's price reflects its rarity and the specialized craftsmanship required to both create and maintain it.

strange_sack.name: Strange Sack
strange_sack.description: The Strange Sack appears as a modest, leather-bound pouch adorned with ancient runes that glimmer faintly under moonlight. It is said to have been crafted by an enigmatic scholar who sought to challenge the mundane limitations of everyday life. This wonderous sack is not merely a vessel for storage; it doubles your carrying capacity for consumables and allows you to effortlessly transport them, as if they were feather-light. The runes etched into its surface hum softly when in use, ensuring that even the heaviest potions or rations feel like mere trinkets.

effectDetails.title: Doubles Carrying Capacity
effectDetails.rules: When this sack is in your possession, it doubles the weight limit for consumable items you are carrying. This effect is passive and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Eases Transport of Consumables
effectDetails.rules: You can move with a burdened load as if it were half its actual weight when using this sack to carry consumables. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

strange_sack.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners and those who value ease in their adventuring, rather than requiring a high level of expertise.
strange_sack.vendorReason: The Shamans' Hut often stocks curiosities that enhance the daily lives of adventurers, making this pouch a natural addition to their inventory.
strange_sack.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the fabric of reality; no delays or extra charges apply for deliveries via Dimensional Mail.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends.

strange_sack.priceReason: The Strange Sack offers significant utility without imposing a heavy burden on adventurers, making it a fair value for its benefits.

styx_river_ferry_pass.name: Styx River Ferry Pass (Annual)
styx_river_ferry_pass.description: The Styx River Ferry Pass (Annual) is a leather-bound, embossed token that opens doors to Charon’s ferry, navigating through any layer of the Nine Hells without cost or delay. Crafted with dark iron and etched with the river’s ancient runes, it grants immunity to the haunting memory loss caused by crossing the Styx. This pass ensures safe passage for an entire year, allowing travelers to traverse the infernal depths as many times as they wish.
effects: Unlimited ferry rides through any layer of the Nine Hells

effectDetails.title: Infinite Ferry Rides
effectDetails.rules: This item provides unlimited ferry rides on Charon's boat between any layers of the Nine Hells. It is activated by simply presenting it to Charon or his assistants.

effectDetails.title: Styx Memory Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The holder gains immunity to memory loss caused by crossing the Styx, ensuring that their mind remains unscathed after each passage.

styx_river_ferry_pass.levelRequirementReason: This pass requires a high level of experience and understanding of the infernal realms to safely use.
styx_river_ferry_pass.vendorReason: Hells Ticketing is Charon's official vendor, ensuring safe passage through his ferry service.
styx_river_ferry_pass.shippingDetail: The pass is delivered by the Phantom Boat itself, ensuring it reaches its destination unseen and unaltered.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation occurs upon presenting the token to Charon or his assistants.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each use
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one year of continuous use
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once per day

styx_river_ferry_pass.priceReason: The pass is priced at a fair value considering its powerful and unique abilities.

sultanates_araby_anti_magic_tent.name: Sultanates Anti-Magic Tent
sultanates_araby_anti_magic_tent.description: The Sultanates Anti-Magic Tent, a ceremonial tent woven from enchanted silk and imbued with runes of ancient lore, is a relic of the Sultanates Araby's arcane mastery. Within its confines, sleepers are utterly immune to magical slumber, scrying, and mental attacks, while all active spell effects within a 20-foot radius are nullified. This tent is not merely a physical shelter but a symbol of power and protection against magic.

effectDetails.title: Magical Nullification
effectDetails.rules: All active spell effects within the tent are nullified, creating an anti-magic field. This effect lasts for a number of hours equal to your proficiency bonus (minimum 1 hour). The tent's enchantment ends if it is destroyed or if someone casts a dispel magic spell on it with a successful DC 20 concentration save.

effectDetails.title: Sleep Immunity
effectDetails.rules: Anyone sleeping within the tent is immune to magical sleep, scrying, and mental attack spells. This immunity lasts until the sleeper awakens or leaves the tent's confines. There is no saving throw against this effect; it simply prevents any such attacks from affecting them.

sultanates_araby_anti_magic_tent.levelRequirementReason: The tent's enchantments are powerful, requiring a lower-level character to wield it effectively.
sultanates_araby_anti_magic_tent.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild is known for its extensive trade routes and connections with the Sultanates, allowing them to offer this rare artifact.
sultanates_araby_anti_magic_tent.shippingDetail: Ships via the fastest courier service available, ensuring swift delivery of this delicate artifact.

usage.activation: The tent is activated by setting it up as a shelter. It does not require an action to activate once set.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for hours until dispelled or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed, dispel magic spell cast successfully within the tent, or if the sleeper leaves the tent.

sultanates_araby_anti_magic_tent.priceReason: The tent's rarity and powerful enchantments justify its relatively affordable price of 1000 XP.

sultanates_araby_bodyguard_legion.name: Sultanates Bodyguard Legion (50 Elite)
sultanates_araby_bodyguard_legion.description: Crafted by the Sultanates Araby, this item summons a legion of fifty elite guards sworn to protect you. Each guard is a desert warrior with enchanted armor and weapons forged in the heart of the Arabian deserts. They are immune to exhaustion from relentless sandstorms and can endure extreme heat without fatigue. These guards fight as if they had 1 month of dedicated training, ensuring your safety against all threats.

effectDetails.title: Guard Deployment
effectDetails.rules: Activate on a short rest. The guards immediately arrive at your location and provide protection for the duration of one month.

effectDetails.title: Exhaustion Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The guards are immune to any condition that would cause them exhaustion, including extreme heat and continuous combat.

sultanates_araby_bodyguard_legion.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a low-level character due to its vast magical power and the complexity of summoning such an elite force.
sultanates_araby_bodyguard_legion.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild has exclusive access to these elite guards through their extensive trade networks with the Sultanates Araby.
sultanates_araby_bodyguard_legion.shippingDetail: The convoy takes a week to deliver the guards, ensuring they are rested and ready for deployment upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 month
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you dismiss the guards with another short rest

sultanates_araby_bodyguard_legion.priceReason: The cost is balanced to reflect the rarity and power of summoning elite desert warriors for a month.

sultanates_araby_camel_rental.name: Sultanates Araby Magic Camel Rental
sultanates_araby_camel_rental.description: The Sultanates Araby Magic Camel Rental is a steed forged from the sands of ancient Arabia, its hump glowing faintly under the desert moonlight. It can carry your entire encampment for miles without rest and sprints at breakneck speed, leaving a trail of dust in its wake. Its telepathic complaints are as legendary as its endurance; you must learn to ignore them if you wish to traverse the treacherous dunes with ease.

effectDetails.title: Endless Endurance
effectDetails.rules: The camel can carry up to 500 lbs indefinitely and sprint for 1 hour once per day. This effect ends if the camel is forced to rest or if it sustains damage in combat.

effectDetails.title: Telepathic Complaints
effectDetails.rules: The camel constantly complains telepathically, reducing your party's movement speed by -2 feet until you convince it otherwise (DC 15). This effect ends when the camel is satisfied or if its daily complaints are exhausted.

sultanates_araby_camel_rental.levelRequirementReason: Able to handle the camel's unique properties and manage its constant chatter.
sultanates_araby_camel_rental.vendorReason: The Sultanates Araby Stables are renowned for their magical camels, which they have been breeding and training for centuries.
sultanates_araby_camel_rental.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of enchanted camels that ensure safe transport across the desert.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation; once per day to sprint.
usage.duration: 1 hour daily sprint, indefinite endurance otherwise.
usage.endsWhen: Resting or combat damage, complaints satisfied, or daily sprint used.

sultanates_araby_camel_rental.priceReason: Balanced price considering the camel's unique abilities and the rarity of magical mounts.

sultanates_araby_desert_fortress.name: Sultanates of Araby Desert Fortress Deed
sultanates_araby_desert_fortress.description: This ancient deed grants ownership of a hidden, magically warded fortress nestled deep within the shifting sands of the Sultanates' Desert. The fortress is constructed from sandstone and iron forged by the Sultanates Araby's greatest artisans. Its walls are lined with wards that prevent teleportation in or out, ensuring only those who earn the right may enter. As a permanent base of operations, it serves as both refuge and command center for your expeditions into this treacherous land.

effectDetails.title: Teleportation Ward
effectDetails.rules: The fortress is imbued with wards that prevent any form of teleportation within or beyond its walls. This effect lasts indefinitely and cannot be dispelled, but it can be negated by a successful DC 17 Force Spell save.

effectDetails.title: Permanent Base
effectDetails.rules: This deed grants you permanent ownership of the fortress, allowing for indefinite occupation as long as you maintain your standing with the Sultanates Araby. It serves as an instant command center and base camp, providing a defensible position worth 100 XP.

sultanates_araby_desert_fortress.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the wards and the strategic importance of the fortress necessitate at least Expert (Level 12) proficiency.
sultanates_araby_desert_fortress.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild has exclusive trade rights with the Sultanates Araby, allowing them to sell this prestigious deed.
sultanates_araby_desert_fortress.shippingDetail: Ships via the Official Deed Courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Indefinite until lost or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Ownership is forfeited to another party or the fortress is destroyed

sultanates_araby_desert_fortress.priceReason: This deed represents a strategic asset, providing indefinite use and value far exceeding its listed price.

sultanates_araby_desert_war_beast.name: Sultanates of Araby War-Scorpion Mount
sultanates_araby_desert_war_beast.description: The Sultanates of Araby War-Scorpion Mount is a colossal, magically controlled desert scorpion, forged from the sands and spines of its homeland. Its armored carapace gleams with a fiery hue, and it can traverse arid landscapes with ease, leaving no trace behind. This mount's tail sting is lethally potent, delivering a venomous laceration that deals 3d6 + 3d6 poison damage to foes within striking distance (DC 17 CON save).

effectDetails.title: Desert Tactician
effectDetails.rules: The mount provides its rider with battlefield awareness, granting them advantage on Perception checks made within a 60-foot radius. This effect lasts until the mount is dismissed or incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Venomous Tail
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the mount can deliver a stinging attack against one target within its reach. The attack deals 3d6 + 3d6 poison damage and requires the target to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

sultanates_araby_desert_war_beast.levelRequirementReason: Only those of considerable experience can command such a fearsome mount, requiring at least 15th level.
sultanates_araby_desert_war_beast.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild specializes in exotic mounts and desert-adapted beasts, making this mount an essential offering for their clientele.
sultanates_araby_desert_war_beast.shippingDetail: Ships via a specially equipped caravan that can traverse harsh desert environments with ease, arriving within two weeks from purchase.

usage.activation: The mount is activated by willing concentration and dismissed as an action.
usage.duration: Active until dismissed or incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: The mount is dismissed or incapacitated.

sultanates_araby_desert_war_beast.priceReason: Balanced to ensure this powerful mount remains a valuable yet achievable asset for mid-level adventurers.

sultanates_araby_desert_weather_control.name: Sultanates of Araby Permanent Oasis Generator
sultanates_araby_desert_weather_control.description: The Sultanates of Araby's Permanent Oasis Generator is a gleaming brass contraption crowned with a water-dripping crown. It draws from the desert's own humidity to sustain an oasis that never wanes, its verdant expanse stretching for miles without end. Within this oasis, all who rest are instantly healed of natural exhaustion. This device, forged in the Sultanates' ancient forges, is a symbol of their mastery over nature itself.

effectDetails.title: Oasis Oasis
effectDetails.rules: This device creates and maintains one permanent, self-sustaining oasis within a square mile. The area is lush with verdant life, providing an unending source of fresh water.

effectDetails.title: Exhaustion Healer
effectDetails.rules: Within the 100-foot radius of the device, all creatures instantly heal from natural exhaustion upon resting in this oasis.

sultanates_araby_desert_weather_control.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to all adventurers, as it can be a life-saving resource for any party.
sultanates_araby_desert_weather_control.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild has long traded with the Sultanates of Araby and recognizes this item's value.
sultanates_araby_desert_weather_control.shippingDetail: Ships via a specially chartered Grand Ceremony caravan, ensuring timely delivery through desert treks.

usage.duration: Permanent (requires daily maintenance)
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or the generator is removed from its location

sultanates_araby_desert_weather_control.priceReason: This device, while not requiring charges to function, represents a significant investment in resources and craftsmanship.

sultanates_araby_dream_walker_service.name: Sultanates Dream Walker Service (Targeted)
sultanates_araby_dream_walker_service.description: The Sultanates Dream Walker Service is a specialized ritual that allows a skilled dream walker to enter and manipulate another's subconscious mind during sleep. This service can plant new ideas, dispel deep-seated fears, or gather critical intelligence from the target's most guarded memories. The process is delicate; if the target becomes aware, they may resist with a Will save (DC 19), risking exposure of the dream walker’s presence.

effectDetails.title: Subconscious Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: The dream walker can attempt to influence one major belief or fear in the target's subconscious. This effect is attempted with a Charisma (Insight) check contested by the target’s Wisdom saving throw (DC 19). On a success, the target accepts the planted idea or fear. If the target fails their save, they become aware of the intrusion and can attempt to resist further interference.

effectDetails.title: Awareness Risk
effectDetails.rules: If the target successfully saves against the initial manipulation, they become aware of the dream walker's presence. The target can then make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 19) each round until the dream walker exits or the target falls asleep again.

sultanates_araby_dream_walker_service.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant skill to manipulate another’s subconscious without being detected.
sultanates_araby_dream_walker_service.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild specializes in exotic and rare services, including the Sultanates Dream Walker Service.
sultanates_araby_dream_walker_service.shippingDetail: Delivered directly to a private ritual chamber, ensuring confidentiality and privacy for both parties.

usage.activation: Requires a full night of uninterrupted sleep by the target.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect once successful; awareness lasts until the next sleep period or until the dream walker exits.
usage.endsWhen: The target becomes aware, the dream walker leaves, or the target falls asleep again.

sultanates_araby_dream_walker_service.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its specialized and delicate nature.

sultanates_araby_eternal_guards.name: Sultanates Eternal Guards (Bound Spirits)
sultanates_araby_eternal_guards.description: The Sultanates Eternal Guards are a cadre of bound spirits that serve with unwavering loyalty. These desert spirits, forged into guardians by the Sultanates Araby, stand as unbreakable sentinels against any who would challenge their sworn oath. Their eternal vigilance is unyielding; they resist fear, poison, and non-divine charm spells alike. Should a threat arise, these guards spring to action with unerring precision, ensuring that no intruder leaves the premises alive.

effectDetails.title: Unbreakable Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: The Eternal Guards never leave their post until destroyed. They are immune to fear, poison, and non-divine charm effects.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear
effectDetails.rules: The guards are immune to any effect that would induce fear or flee, including spells like Fear or spells with the fear descriptor.

sultanates_araby_eternal_guards.levelRequirementReason: These bound spirits require a high level of power and control to maintain and utilize effectively.
sultanates_araby_eternal_guards.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild has exclusive access to the Sultanates' most sacred artifacts, including these eternally loyal guards.
sultanates_araby_eternal_guards.shippingDetail: The procession ensures a swift and secure delivery, though the journey is long and arduous.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation; the guards spring to action upon any threat.
usage.duration: Until destroyed or their oath is fulfilled
usage.endsWhen: The guards are either destroyed or their sworn duty is completed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one set of 10 can be hired at a time.

sultanates_araby_eternal_guards.priceReason: The price reflects the rare and powerful nature of these bound spirits, as well as the extensive ritual required to bind them.

sultanates_araby_genie_bargain.name: Sultanates of Araby Genie Bargain (1 Wish)
sultanates_araby_genie_bargain.description: The Sultanates of Araby Genie Bargain is a finely crafted parchment containing a promise from a trusted Genie to grant one minor wish. It originates from the bustling markets of Araby, where Genies are bound by ancient contracts. This parchment ensures that when you seek to bargain with your chosen Genie, it will fulfill your request faithfully, though you must adhere strictly to the terms. The Genie cannot be tricked into granting wishes beyond its minor limit.

effectDetails.title: Minor Wish Fulfillment
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this parchment compels a Genie to grant one minor wish. The DM adjudicates the outcome; no major changes to reality are allowed. The Genie cannot be tricked into granting a greater wish or altering fundamental aspects of existence.

effectDetails.title: Genie Trust
effectDetails.rules: The bound Genie will not deceive you in your bargain, ensuring that any request made is fulfilled as promised, though it cannot perform actions that would break its binding contract with the Sultanates of Araby.

sultanates_araby_genie_bargain.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a low-level character to ensure that the minor wish granted does not lead to game-breaking outcomes.
sultanates_araby_genie_bargain.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild has exclusive access to Genie bargains, ensuring authenticity and reliability.
sultanates_araby_genie_bargain.shippingDetail: Shipped in an ornate brass lamp for safekeeping during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The Genie's wish is granted or the parchment is destroyed

sultanates_araby_genie_bargain.priceReason: This item provides a single, reliable minor wish from a trusted source, making it moderately priced but not trivial.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning.name: Sultanates Araby Genie Lamp Cleaning
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning.description: The Sultanates Araby Genie Lamp Cleaning is a meticulously crafted artifact that restores its lamp to gleaming perfection. The cleaning process not only enhances its luster but also strengthens your bond with any genie imprisoned within, granting +1 Charisma modifier for Charisma checks involving genies. However, the lamp's meticulous care must be handled with utmost respect; accidentally releasing a genie or provoking one's annoyance is always a risk.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates when the lamp is cleaned, providing +1 bonus to Charisma checks involving genies. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Genie's Mood
effectDetails.rules: The cleaning process has a 25% chance (DC 10 Wisdom saving throw) to upset any genie within, requiring a successful save or causing temporary annoyance that reduces the lamp's effectiveness by -1 until cleaned again.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level but is intended for beginners who wish to explore genies and their interactions.
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning.vendorReason: The Sultanates Araby Lamp Cleaners are renowned for their expertise in maintaining genie lamps, ensuring the purity of the magic within.
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning.shippingDetail: Delivered with a swift Genie Courier, known for their magical speed and reliability.

usage.activation: As an action to clean the lamp thoroughly.
usage.duration: Until start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The cleaning process is completed or interrupted by genie annoyance.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the skill and magic required for such a precise cleaning.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning_ser.name: Sultanates Araby Genie Lamp Cleaning Service
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning_ser.description: This ornate lamp from the Sultanates of Araby is a masterpiece of craftsmanship and lore. The glass is etched with ancient symbols, and its base is made of polished brass that gleams like the desert sun. Each cleaning service not only restores the lamp's luster but also grants you a 10% chance to invoke a minor wish—albeit one that might go awry, as genie spirits are known for their capricious nature. When cleaned, the lamp emits a soft glow, providing advantage on Persuasion checks with any spirit entities you encounter.

effectDetails.title: Minor Wish Chance
effectDetails.rules: When the lamp is cleaned by a Sultanates Araby Lamp Rubber, there is a 10% chance that you may invoke a minor wish. This effect has no save DC and lasts until used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after cleaning the lamp, you gain advantage on Persuasion checks when dealing with any spirit entity. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you fail a Wisdom saving throw against an opposing effect.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning_ser.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners to help them build their wish-casting and social skills.
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning_ser.vendorReason: The Sultanates Araby Bazaar is known for its diverse collection of magical artifacts, including the legendary Genie Lamps.
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning_ser.shippingDetail: Ships via a trusted courier from the Sultanates, ensuring safe and timely delivery to your door.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate this cleaning service.
usage.duration: One hour duration; ends when used once per day or upon failure of a Wisdom saving throw against an opposing effect.
usage.endsWhen: Used once daily, or if you fail a Wisdom saving throw.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_cleaning_ser.priceReason: The item is priced lower due to the limited magical effects it provides compared to more powerful artifacts.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_oven.name: Sultanates Araby Genie Lamp Oven
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_oven.description: The Sultanates Araby Genie Lamp Oven is a lamp-shaped, enameled vessel that hums softly as it bakes. Crafted by the masterful Araby Enchanters, its inner walls are lined with heat-conducting magic that ensures every spice kebab emerges perfectly charred and imbued with arcane warmth. With each use, the oven grants you a +1 bonus on your next saving throw, as if a genie had whispered words of luck into your ear.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Baking Charm
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the oven to bake, it grants you a +1 bonus on your next saving throw. This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Genie's Favor
effectDetails.rules: After using the oven, roll a d6 and add this result as luck to any single roll made after its use. This effect is limited to once every 24 hours.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_oven.levelRequirementReason: The Genie Lamp Oven's magic is gentle but potent, making it accessible to even the most novice adventurers.
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_oven.vendorReason: The Sultanates Araby Bazaar is renowned for its exotic wares and enchanted goods, including this unique culinary tool.
sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_oven.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Wishful Ware Wrap, ensuring that your oven arrives in perfect working condition, ready to be used upon receipt.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate and use the Genie Lamp Oven.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you make a saving throw or if you make another use of this feature within 24 hours.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, reset at dawn.

sultanates_araby_genie_lamp_oven.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rare enchantment and unique utility in both magic and mundane baking.

sultanates_araby_lamb_kebab_recipe.name: Recipe: Sultanates Araby Lamb Kebab
sultanates_araby_lamb_kebab_recipe.description: The Recipe: Sultanates Araby Lamb Kebab is a parchment scroll detailing the ancient art of skewering and grilling lamb in spices. This recipe was crafted by the legendary Araby Grillmasters, whose feasts were renowned for their aromas that could travel across deserts. Consuming this kebab teaches you how to prepare it, granting +1 to Wisdom (Survival) checks in desert environments for 4 hours. Each kebab provides 1d6 hit points of sustenance and can be prepared in as little as 25 minutes with the right ingredients.

effectDetails.title: Grill Skewers
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants you the ability to prepare lamb kebabs in deserts. You can use this recipe once per long rest, and it takes 25 minutes to prepare one serving.

effectDetails.title: Desert Survival
effectDetails.rules: For 4 hours after consuming a lamb kebab prepared with this recipe, you gain +1 to Wisdom (Survival) checks related to desert environments. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you consume alcohol.

sultanates_araby_lamb_kebab_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to all adventurers as it requires no specific combat or skill proficiencies.
sultanates_araby_lamb_kebab_recipe.vendorReason: The Sultanates Araby Bazaar specializes in exotic spices and recipes from across the desert realms, making this scroll a staple among their offerings.
sultanates_araby_lamb_kebab_recipe.shippingDetail: The recipe is shipped on parchment that must be properly rolled to maintain its effectiveness.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon consumption; active effect when preparing kebabs in deserts.
usage.duration: 4 hours and until alcohol is consumed or the effect ends.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires, you consume alcohol, or it is used up during a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day with proper preparation.

sultanates_araby_lamb_kebab_recipe.priceReason: This recipe retains its value as a rare and useful skill in desert environments, though not requiring specific levels to use.

sultanates_araby_master_assassin.name: Sultanates Master Assassin (Contract)
sultanates_araby_master_assassin.description: The Sultanates Master Assassin Contract is a deadly promise from the desert's most feared operatives. This legendary artifact ensures a guaranteed elimination of one target, no matter their defenses or location. The assassin operates outside your chain of command, leaving no trace and no chance for betrayal. A month-long notice is required to ensure the target’s identity and the nature of the mission are fully vetted by the Desert Trader Guild.

effectDetails.title: Guaranteed Elimination
effectDetails.rules: Activates with a month-long notice. The target is eliminated within one week of the contract's execution, regardless of their defenses or location. This effect has no save DC and cannot be interrupted by any means.

effectDetails.title: Operates Outside Chain
effectDetails.rules: The assassin operates independently of your command structure. You have no influence over their methods or actions, ensuring absolute discretion and secrecy.

sultanates_araby_master_assassin.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least Level 17 to ensure the caster can manage such a high-risk and secretive operation.
sultanates_araby_master_assassin.vendorReason: The Desert Trader Guild is known for its exclusive contracts and connections within the Sultanates, ensuring the highest quality of service.
sultanates_araby_master_assassin.shippingDetail: Ships via a Poison Vial courier, ensuring the contract’s arrival is both secure and discreet.

usage.activation: One month notice required for activation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous elimination within one week of execution.
usage.endsWhen: The target is eliminated or the contract expires without use.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, but only one contract can be active at a time.

sultanates_araby_master_assassin.priceReason: Reflects the legendary rarity and high-risk nature of the service provided by the Sultanates' elite assassins.

sultanates_araby_oasis_charm.name: Sultanates of Araby Oasis Charm
