Its power comes from the crypts where it was forged, making it as formidable and ancient as the very pharaohs who commanded it.

effectDetails.title: Activate Bone Golem
effectDetails.rules: A willing sacrifice must be made to activate the heart, bringing a CR 8 Bone Golem construct under your command. The golem serves its master until its destruction or while it remains dormant in a crypt.

effectDetails.title: Bound Servitude
effectDetails.rules: The Bone Golem created is bound to follow the holder's commands as long as the heart remains unclaimed by another. If the heart changes hands, the golem must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be compelled to serve its new master.

tomb_kings_bone_golem_heart.levelRequirementReason: Only those of sufficient power and experience can command such an ancient and formidable construct.
tomb_kings_bone_golem_heart.vendorReason: The Tomb Gatekeeper has the means to recover such relics from the deepest crypts, making them available for trade.
tomb_kings_bone_golem_heart.shippingDetail: Delivery is via a sealed lead casket, ensuring the heart's safe transport and preventing premature activation during transit.

usage.activation: Object interaction to make the sacrifice and activate the golem.
usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or the golem's destruction.
usage.endsWhen: The golem is destroyed or its control is lost.

tomb_kings_bone_golem_heart.priceReason: This item represents a rare and ancient artifact that can command formidable power, yet it does not provide indefinite use.

tomb_kings_canopic_collection.name: Tomb Kings Canopic Collection (Standard)
tomb_kings_canopic_collection.description: The Tomb Kings Canopic Collection stands as a macabre yet essential guardian of noble heritage, each alabaster jar meticulously crafted to house the heart, liver, lungs, and intestines of high-ranking nobles. The jars are imbued with ancient spells that not only ward off thieves but also ensure that if a noble's soul remains within the vicinity after death, it is preserved for ritualistic rebirth. Should a noble die near these jars, their spirit is safeguarded against decay until the ritual begins.

effectDetails.title: Soul Preservation
effectDetails.rules: If a noble or hero dies within 30 feet of any jar, their soul is preserved for ritual use. The effect lasts until the soul is either consumed in a rebirth ceremony or disperses into the afterlife. This effect does not require an action and has no save DC.

effectDetails.title: Magical Ward
effectDetails.rules: The jars are warded against thieves with a magical alarm that triggers if anyone attempts to open them without proper ritual knowledge or permission, giving the noble's heirs a +2 bonus on saving throws made before the alarm is silenced. The ward lasts until the jars are opened by someone with the appropriate knowledge.

tomb_kings_canopic_collection.levelRequirementReason: The Canopic Collection's intricate enchantments and ancient wards make it accessible but not trivial for even a low-level character.
tomb_kings_canopic_collection.vendorReason: Only those trusted with the secrets of the dead, like the tomb gatekeeper, can handle such sacred relics.
tomb_kings_canopic_collection.shippingDetail: The jars are shipped in an ornate stone crate lined with protective sand and sealed with a sigil that prevents unauthorized opening during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent until the soul is consumed or dispersed
usage.endsWhen: Soul disperses into the afterlife or is consumed in ritual

tomb_kings_canopic_collection.priceReason: The Canopic Collection's value lies in its historical significance and the protection it offers, making it a valuable yet balanced purchase.

tomb_kings_canopic_jar.name: Tomb Kings' Canopic Jar
tomb_kings_canopic_jar.description: The Tomb Kings' Canopic Jar is a venerated relic crafted to house the preserved organs of ancient kings. Its pulsating necromantic energy is said to be imbued with the essence of life itself. This jar can animate up to six skeleton corpses each week, and the undead it controls are more resilient, gaining +1 hit point per Hit Die. The jar's owner may occasionally demand tribute from those who seek its power.

effectDetails.title: Animate Skeletons
effectDetails.rules: The user can cast Animate Dead once per week on up to six skeleton corpses within range. The skeletons are animated for the duration of a long rest, and they count as undead for the purpose of effects that target undead creatures.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Undead
effectDetails.rules: Any skeletons animated by this jar gain +1 hit point per Hit Die until destroyed or until the next dawn. They do not need to breathe, eat, or sleep.

tomb_kings_canopic_jar.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high-level spellcaster who can handle its necromantic power responsibly.
tomb_kings_canopic_jar.vendorReason: The vendors are descendants of the kings whose organs were preserved in these jars and thus have intimate knowledge of their powers.
tomb_kings_canopic_jar.shippingDetail: Delivered by a trusted courier, this item arrives carefully wrapped to prevent accidental opening during transit.

usage.activation: Once per week as an action
usage.duration: Until the next dawn or until destroyed
usage.endsWhen: The skeletons are defeated, they return to their resting place, or the jar is destroyed

tomb_kings_canopic_jar.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its epic rarity and the weekly limit on its powerful effects.

tomb_kings_construct_eye.name: Tomb Kings Construct Eye (Lapis Lazuli)
tomb_kings_construct_eye.description: The Tomb Kings Construct Eye, a radiant lapis lazuli orb imbued with ancient magic, is said to have been crafted by the artisans of the forgotten kings themselves. This glowing gem can animate a large, dead construct or statue for an hour, bringing it to life to serve the caster's simple commands. The eye itself is encased in a delicate ornate box, ensuring safe transport from the tomb gatekeeper.

effectDetails.title: Animate Construct
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, activate as an action to animate one large dead statue or construct (CR 5) for a duration of 1 hour. The construct obeys simple commands given by the caster during its active time.

effectDetails.title: Simple Commands
effectDetails.rules: The animated construct can be commanded to perform actions that are within its capabilities and not inherently dangerous, such as standing guard or moving objects up to a 10-foot square area.

tomb_kings_construct_eye.levelRequirementReason: Requires a caster level of at least 5 to properly channel the ancient magic.
tomb_kings_construct_eye.vendorReason: The tomb gatekeeper, guardian of the ancient constructs, is entrusted with such powerful and rare items.
tomb_kings_construct_eye.shippingDetail: The ornate box ensures safe transport, but adds a delay of one day to its delivery.

usage.duration: 1 hour once per day.
usage.endsWhen: The construct completes the commanded task or the duration ends.

tomb_kings_construct_eye.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP as it is a powerful but not overpowered item suitable for mid-level adventurers.

tomb_kings_cursed_canopic_jar.name: Tomb Kings Cursed Canopic Jar
tomb_kings_cursed_canopic_jar.description: The Tomb Kings Cursed Canopic Jar is a sinister artifact made of black obsidian and adorned with hieroglyphs that whisper death. It whispers to the unwary, claiming to hold the soul of a lesser Pharaoh. This jar can trap one creature’s essence within its depths for a month after they die within 10 feet of it. The trapped soul can be tortured or questioned, providing answers that are both cryptic and deadly accurate.

effectDetails.title: Soul Trapper
effectDetails.rules: If a creature dies within 10 feet of the jar, its soul is trapped inside for one month. This effect can occur once per month.

effectDetails.title: Torture and Question
effectDetails.rules: The trapped soul can be tortured or questioned to gain information. Torturing it has a DC of 17 Wisdom (Insight) check to resist; on a failed check, the torturer gains knowledge that may be both truthful and misleading.

tomb_kings_cursed_canopic_jar.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 6th level to handle the cursed power without succumbing to its influence.
tomb_kings_cursed_canopic_jar.vendorReason: The tomb gatekeeper has intimate knowledge of ancient artifacts and the dangers they pose, making them a trusted source for such a relic.
tomb_kings_cursed_canopic_jar.shippingDetail: Delivered by a specially charmed falcon that ensures safe arrival but does not allow handling until it is within 10 feet of its intended recipient.

usage.activation: Passive effect, triggered when conditions are met.
usage.duration: One month for each trapped soul.
usage.endsWhen: The trapped soul's duration expires or the jar is destroyed.

tomb_kings_cursed_canopic_jar.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its cursed nature and limited utility.

tomb_kings_eternal_vizier.name: Tomb Kings Eternal Vizier (Advisor)
tomb_kings_eternal_vizier.description: The Tomb Kings Eternal Vizier, a high-ranking non-combat Lich bound to serve as your political and administrative advisor, is crafted from the bones of kings and enchanted with the wisdom of eternity. Its eyes gleam with the ancient knowledge it has accumulated over centuries, ready to guide you through complex matters. This relic's strategic acumen ensures your long-term planning efforts succeed, providing unmatched foresight for years to come.

effectDetails.title: Eternal Guidance
effectDetails.rules: For the next 5 years, you gain advantage on all checks related to bureaucracy and administration. This effect is passive and does not require any action from you.

effectDetails.title: Unmatched Strategic Planning
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on long-term planning checks (DC 18). You can use this ability once per long rest, expending a charge that recharges after 7 days.

tomb_kings_eternal_vizier.levelRequirementReason: The Vizier's vast knowledge and the intricate enchantments require a high level of magical mastery to effectively wield.
tomb_kings_eternal_vizier.vendorReason: Only the Tomb Gatekeeper, guardian of ancient secrets, possesses the means to craft such a powerful artifact.
tomb_kings_eternal_vizier.shippingDetail: The Vizier is carefully packed in a crypt-like container and delivered via an unmarked route to ensure its safe arrival.

usage.duration: 5 years
usage.endsWhen: Upon expiration of the 5-year period or destruction of the Vizier.
usage.charges: One charge per long-term planning check, recharging after a week.

tomb_kings_eternal_vizier.priceReason: The Vizier's rarity and its unparalleled utility justify its moderate price in experienced characters' terms.

tomb_kings_lich_advisor.name: Tomb Kings Lich Advisor (Contract)
tomb_kings_lich_advisor.description: The Tomb Kings Lich Advisor (Contract) is a malevolent spirit forged in the eternal fires of the tombs. Crafted by King of Tombs himself, this lich offers counsel with an intellect unmatched—INT 22. In exchange for its wisdom, it demands sacrifices: either the souls of ten unwary adventurers or potent magical artifacts worth at least 10,000 XP each. Bound to the contract, it aids in a single necromantic rite per month, summoning legions of undead with a mere whisper.

effectDetails.title: Necromantic Counsel
effectDetails.rules: The Lich Advisor provides counsel once per day, enhancing the caster's INT by +4 for 1 hour. This effect grants a bonus action to cast any necromancy spell of 3rd level or lower, with no material components required.

effectDetails.title: Undead Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Once per month, the Lich Advisor can summon an army of undead creatures of CR 6 or lower. The summoned undead are under the lich's control and remain until dismissed by a command word (action). The lich demands ten souls or magical artifacts worth at least 10,000 XP as payment.

tomb_kings_lich_advisor.levelRequirementReason: Only those of great power can handle the Lich Advisor's malevolence and demand for sacrifices.
tomb_kings_lich_advisor.vendorReason: The tomb gatekeeper has a unique connection to the tombs where the lich was forged, making them the only one who could procure such an item.
tomb_kings_lich_advisor.shippingDetail: Ships with special ceremonial escorts, ensuring safe delivery through ancient and enchanted tombs.

usage.activation: As a bonus action or on command for summoning undead.
usage.duration: Necromantic counsel lasts until the end of your next turn; Undead summoning is instantaneous.
usage.endsWhen: The effects are dismissed by a command word or expended after use.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but requires payment upon activation.

tomb_kings_lich_advisor.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the lich's rarity and the value of the sacrifices it demands.

tomb_kings_mummy_wrap_sandwiches_recipe.name: Recipe: Tomb Kings Mummy Wrap Sandwiches
tomb_kings_mummy_wrap_sandwiches_recipe.description: The Recipe for Tomb Kings Mummy Wrap Sandwiches is a culinary secret that transforms mundane ingredients into immortal sustenance. Wrapped with bandages and sealed in ancient tombs, these sandwiches preserve their freshness and nourish the eater. Consuming one grants you temporary immunity to rot and decay while healing 1d6 hit points. The recipe was passed down by mummified chefs who ensured only the freshest bread and finest meats were used.

effectDetails.title: Immortal Sustenance
effectDetails.rules: When you eat a sandwich prepared with this recipe, you gain temporary immunity to the effects of rot and decay for 1 hour. This effect does not stack with other similar immunities.

effectDetails.title: Healing Bites
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can consume one of these sandwiches to regain 1d6 hit points. You are limited to using this effect once per long rest.

tomb_kings_mummy_wrap_sandwiches_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for anyone with basic cooking skills.
tomb_kings_mummy_wrap_sandwiches_recipe.vendorReason: The mummies of the tomb kings are known for their culinary prowess and ensure this recipe remains authentic.
tomb_kings_mummy_wrap_sandwiches_recipe.shippingDetail: Ships via crypt courier, ensuring freshness within a week.

usage.activation: Eating one sandwich as an action
usage.duration: 1 hour immunity; once per long rest healing effect
usage.endsWhen: Effect expires after 1 hour or upon consuming another sandwich with the recipe
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have the ingredients to prepare more sandwiches

tomb_kings_mummy_wrap_sandwiches_recipe.priceReason: The rarity and complexity of this recipe, combined with the unique ingredients required, justify its higher price.

tomb_kings_mummy_wrapping_service.name: Tomb Kings Mummy Wrapping Service
tomb_kings_mummy_wrapping_service.description: The Tomb Kings Mummy Wrapping Service encases you in a cocoon of protective bandages, granting +1 AC for seven days as the mummies of old were buried in layers of linen. Your movements evoke the rustling of dry leaves, imposing disadvantage on Stealth checks when moving. You appear undead to those who know what to look for, but your presence is neutral to other creatures, earning you a wary, yet not hostile reception from both living and dead alike.

effectDetails.title: Mummy's Cloak
effectDetails.rules: You gain +1 AC for 7 days. This effect is a passive bonus and ends when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Rustling Movement
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while moving. This effect lasts until you rest or take an action to still yourself, at which point it ceases.

tomb_kings_mummy_wrapping_service.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to adventurers of all levels but requires basic proficiency in stealth and the ability to move without drawing attention.
tomb_kings_mummy_wrapping_service.vendorReason: The Tomb Kings Embalmers are experts at preserving life, and their wrapping service ensures you can traverse the world with a semblance of ancient protection.
tomb_kings_mummy_wrapping_service.shippingDetail: Delivery includes a special mummy's basket to transport your bandaged form securely.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon application. Duration ends after 7 days or when you rest and take an action to still yourself.
usage.duration: 24 hours for each day of duration
usage.endsWhen: Resting and taking a reaction to still your movements, or at the end of the 7-day period

tomb_kings_mummy_wrapping_service.priceReason: The service is priced moderately as it combines ancient knowledge with practical benefits, making it accessible yet valuable.

tomb_kings_necrotic_infusion.name: Tomb Kings Necrotic Infusion (Weapon)
tomb_kings_necrotic_infusion.description: The Tomb Kings Necrotic Infusion, a weapon forged from the very bones of the ancient dead, whispers with malevolent energy as it drains life from foes. Crafted by the King of Tombs himself in the depths of his crypt, this weapon's touch leaves a lingering aura of decay that lingers after each strike. Those who wield it feel a cold grip on their own vitality, gaining temporary hit points proportional to the necrotic damage dealt.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Drain
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with a melee attack using this weapon, you deal an additional 2d8 necrotic damage. This effect cannot be resisted.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt by this weapon. These hit points are lost when you take any other damage.

tomb_kings_necrotic_infusion.levelRequirementReason: Only those with considerable experience and strength can wield such a powerful and malevolent artifact.
tomb_kings_necrotic_infusion.vendorReason: The tomb gatekeeper, guardian of the crypts, is entrusted by the King of Tombs to sell this potent relic to worthy souls.
tomb_kings_necrotic_infusion.shippingDetail: The weapon arrives encased in a thick layer of obsidian sheathing to protect both the carrier and the item from its malevolent energies.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect on each successful melee attack.
usage.duration: Until expended or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon dealing damage, lost when you take any other damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges; the weapon's power is drawn from the soul of its bearer.

tomb_kings_necrotic_infusion.priceReason: The Necrotic Infusion is a relic of immense power and dark lore, making it valuable even at this reduced price.

tomb_kings_pharaoh_shroud.name: Tomb Kings Pharaoh Shroud
tomb_kings_pharaoh_shroud.description: The Tomb Kings Pharaoh Shroud is a linen shroud woven with threads of ancient magic, evoking the power of long-dead rulers. Crafted by skilled Tomb Embalmers in the pyramids, it whispers secrets of the afterlife to those who wear it at night. The shroud not only grants advantage on saving throws against undead fear but also preserves minor wounds, healing 1d4 hit points overnight as long as it remains undisturbed.
effects: Advantage on saves vs. undead fear

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Saves Against Undead Fear
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on saving throws against the fear of undead creatures as long as you are wearing this shroud.

effectDetails.title: Preserves Minor Wounds
effectDetails.rules: While worn, the shroud heals 1d4 hit points each night if you have no other wounds. This effect ends when the shroud is removed or damaged beyond repair.

tomb_kings_pharaoh_shroud.levelRequirementReason: This shroud requires a minimum level of 6 to wield its power, as it channels ancient magic that only experienced adventurers can properly harness.
tomb_kings_pharaoh_shroud.vendorReason: The Tomb Kings Pyramid is the ancestral home of skilled embalmers who have mastered the art of crafting such magical shrouds.
tomb_kings_pharaoh_shroud.shippingDetail: Shipped by Mummy Wrap, this item arrives wrapped in a cryptic spell to ensure its power remains intact until it reaches its destination.

usage.activation: Passive effect as long as the shroud is worn and undisturbed.
usage.duration: Instantaneous healing effect each night while worn; duration ends when removed or damaged beyond repair.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you remove it, damage it irreparably, or die.

tomb_kings_pharaoh_shroud.priceReason: Given its rarity and the ancient magic required for crafting such a shroud, this item is priced at 18500 XP.

tomb_kings_phylactery_seal.name: Tomb Kings Phylactery Seal (Scarab)
tomb_kings_phylactery_seal.description: The Tomb Kings Phylactery Seal, a shimmering scarab crafted from the polished obsidian of ancient tombs, protects its wearer's phylactery by instantly repairing minor damage when invoked. The seal whispers secrets of the dead, granting +1 to Intelligence for one day upon use. Crafted under the watchful gaze of the King of Tombs, this relic is a testament to the pharaohs' enduring legacy and their mastery over life and death.

effectDetails.title: Phylactery Repair
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Instantly repairs all damage to the user's phylactery, consuming the scarab in the process.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Secrets
effectDetails.rules: Used as an action. Grants +1 Intelligence for 24 hours upon activation. The scarab whispers ancient knowledge that can be heard by anyone who holds it.

tomb_kings_phylactery_seal.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level to ensure the user is capable of handling its mystical power and understanding its whispered secrets.
tomb_kings_phylactery_seal.vendorReason: The Tomb Gatekeeper, guardian of ancient tombs, holds this relic as it connects directly with the pharaohs' legacy.
tomb_kings_phylactery_seal.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of sacred falcons, ensuring swift and safe transport from the heart of the desert tombs to any destination.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action for Phylactery Repair. Activated as an action for Whispering Secrets.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Phylactery Repair. +1 Intelligence effect lasts until midnight after use.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted when used or consumed; no recharge required.

tomb_kings_phylactery_seal.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and the pharaohs' control over its creation, balancing its powerful effects.

tomb_kings_recipe_mummy_wrap_sandwich.name: Recipe: Tomb Kings Mummy Wrap Sandwich
tomb_kings_recipe_mummy_wrap_sandwich.description: The Recipe: Tomb Kings Mummy Wrap Sandwich is a culinary conundrum—a sandwich encased in edible bandages, crafted by the skilled embalmers of the ancient Tomb Kings. These wrappings imbue the food within with a magical preservation that lasts for thirty days, ensuring its freshness even after long voyages. When consumed, the eater gains +1 AC for an hour as if protected by a thin layer of linen. The sandwich's unique taste, reminiscent of dust and old linen, can be quite off-putting, imposing disadvantage on Charisma checks while savoring it.

effectDetails.title: Edible Preservation
effectDetails.rules: Activates when the sandwich is made. The food within remains preserved for thirty days, unaffected by spoilage or decay.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Armor
effectDetails.rules: Eating the sandwich grants +1 AC for one hour, as if wearing light armor. This effect ends upon consuming the sandwich.

tomb_kings_recipe_mummy_wrap_sandwich.levelRequirementReason: The recipe requires basic knowledge of food preparation and a willingness to brave its peculiar taste.
tomb_kings_recipe_mummy_wrap_sandwich.vendorReason: Only the skilled embalmers of the Tomb Kings have the expertise to create this unique sandwich, preserving it as both a culinary and magical treat.
tomb_kings_recipe_mummy_wrap_sandwich.shippingDetail: Ships with care within specially lined sarcophagi to ensure freshness during transport.

usage.activation: Passive upon consumption of the sandwich.
usage.duration: One hour after eating.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the one-hour duration expires or if the eater stops wearing it before then.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the recipe can be made as many times as needed.

tomb_kings_recipe_mummy_wrap_sandwich.priceReason: The rare ingredients and ancient crafting process contribute to its relatively high price, making it a sought-after item among adventurers.

tomb_kings_ritual_of_command.name: Tomb Kings Ritual of Command (Army)
tomb_kings_ritual_of_command.description: The Tomb Kings Ritual of Command is a dark, ritualistic tome bound in black leather and adorned with cryptic sigils. When invoked within a local graveyard, it channels necromantic energies to raise and bind 5d100 undead minions (CR 1/4) to your command. These skeletal warriors obey your every word for precisely one month before disintegrating into dust. The ritual is a relic of the ancient Tomb Kings, forged in the heart of their forgotten tombs by King Khaman himself.

effectDetails.title: Raising Undead Minions
effectDetails.rules: This ritual automatically raises and binds 5d100 CR 1/4 undead minions within a 30-foot radius of the graveyard. The summoned creatures obey your commands for one month before disintegrating into dust, unless dismissed by you.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Servitude
effectDetails.rules: The summoned undead are under your control for exactly one month after the ritual is performed. They cannot be commanded beyond this period and will dissolve upon expiration of their servitude.

tomb_kings_ritual_of_command.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 10 to invoke such dark magic.
tomb_kings_ritual_of_command.vendorReason: The Tomb Gatekeeper, a keeper of ancient secrets and tombs, is trusted with the rituals of the dead, including this powerful necromantic command.
tomb_kings_ritual_of_command.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Necrotic Courier, a spectral messenger that ensures safe passage through haunted realms.

usage.duration: One month per successful invocation
usage.endsWhen: The summoned undead disintegrate after one month or if dismissed prematurely

tomb_kings_ritual_of_command.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this ritual is a powerful but not overpowered tool for necromancers.

tomb_kings_ritual_priest.name: Tomb Kings Ritual Priest (Hire)
tomb_kings_ritual_priest.description: Hire a Tomb King Ritual Priest to oversee necromantic rituals. This loyal priest ensures your rituals are conducted with precision and power, granting +4 to the DC of any ritual you perform under their watch. Their presence alone is a testament to ancient knowledge, requiring only the finest materials and respect for the dead. The priest costs 500 gp per day, ensuring that the ritual's success is as much about tradition as it is about magic.

effectDetails.title: Ritual Precision
effectDetails.rules: When you attempt a necromantic ritual, the Tomb King Ritual Priest increases your spell save DC by +4. This effect lasts until the end of the ritual or when another creature attempts to cast a similar ritual within 30 feet.

effectDetails.title: Daily Cost
effectDetails.rules: The priest requires daily upkeep costing 500 gp, which is deducted from your funds at the start of each day. This cost ensures the priest's devotion and attention are maintained.

tomb_kings_ritual_priest.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest ritual can be complex when dealing with necromantic magic; a low-level caster benefits most from this specialized help.
tomb_kings_ritual_priest.vendorReason: The Tomb Gatekeeper has the connections and resources to hire such a skilled priest for your needs.
tomb_kings_ritual_priest.shippingDetail: Secure, swift escort by trusted tomb guardians ensures the priest arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect when the Ritual Priest is present during necromantic rituals.
usage.duration: Until the end of the ritual or another similar ritual within 30 feet.
usage.endsWhen: Another creature attempts a similar ritual within 30 feet or at the end of the ritual.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as daily costs are met.

tomb_kings_ritual_priest.priceReason: The cost reflects both the priest's expertise and the daily upkeep required to maintain their presence.

tomb_kings_royal_chariot.name: Tomb Kings Royal Necro-Chariot
tomb_kings_royal_chariot.description: The Tomb Kings Royal Necro-Chariot, a skeletal steed chariot forged from ancient bones and deathly souls, rumbles across the desert sands at an unnatural speed. Its crew of spectral horses gallops tirelessly without need for rest, driven by the unending hunger for more souls to power its infernal engines. The chariot's origins lie in the very heart of the Tomb King's necropolis, where it was crafted by the hands of a king who commands even death itself.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Crew
effectDetails.rules: The chariot is crewed by spectral horses. These undead creatures do not tire, and the chariot's speed remains constant so long as the Tomb King or one of his loyal necromancers commands it.

effectDetails.title: Soul Sacrifice
effectDetails.rules: To maintain its supernatural speed, the chariot requires a daily soul sacrifice. If this requirement is not met, its speed drops to 30 feet until a successful DC 18 Wisdom saving throw restores normal speed and undead crew.

tomb_kings_royal_chariot.levelRequirementReason: Only those of considerable power can command the necro-chariot's spectral crew and navigate its infernal engines.
tomb_kings_royal_chariot.vendorReason: The tomb gatekeeper, a guardian of the ancient necropolis, occasionally allows select travelers to rent this chariot for expeditions into the heart of the Tomb Kings' domain.
tomb_kings_royal_chariot.shippingDetail: Delivered by an escort of spectral horses that precede the chariot, ensuring safe passage through treacherous desert terrain and undead-infested areas.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon command; requires a successful DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check to command the crew.
usage.duration: Until commanded otherwise or until a daily soul sacrifice is not made.
usage.endsWhen: Daily soul sacrifice is missed, requiring a Wisdom saving throw with a DC of 18 to maintain speed and undead crew.

tomb_kings_royal_chariot.priceReason: The chariot's legendary craftsmanship and the daily maintenance required for its spectral crew justify this moderate price in XP.

tomb_kings_sand_guardian_summon_premium.name: Tomb Kings Sand Guardian Summon (Premium)
tomb_kings_sand_guardian_summon_premium.description: The Tomb Kings Sand Guardian Summon (Premium) is a delicate amulet made by the ancient Tomb Mages, crafted from desert sand and enchanted with protective magic. This artifact can be invoked to summon a minor guardian of shifting dunes, which stands vigilant for an hour, alerting its master to any intruders within 30 feet. The guardian's sandy form is both eerie and awe-inspiring, capable of dealing 1d6 points of sand damage with each successful melee attack.

effectDetails.title: Guardian of Shifting Sands
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The summoned guardian stands watch for one hour, alerting the user to any creatures within 30 feet that attempt to enter or leave its area of effect. If an intruder is detected, the guardian emits a loud sandstorm sound and attacks with advantage until it is destroyed or the duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Sandstorm Protection
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +1 bonus to their AC against ranged attacks while the guardian is active. This bonus increases to +2 if there is no cover between the user and the attacker. The effect ends when the guardian dissipates in rain or when its 10 hit points are reduced.

tomb_kings_sand_guardian_summon_premium.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 7 to wield, ensuring that only seasoned adventurers can effectively utilize its protective and offensive capabilities.
tomb_kings_sand_guardian_summon_premium.vendorReason: The Tomb Kings Pyramid is the original home of the Sand Guardian Summoning technique and thus retains exclusive rights to sell this artifact.
tomb_kings_sand_guardian_summon_premium.shippingDetail: The courier delivers the item via a sandstorm, ensuring that only those with a clear path can receive it.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon and activate guardian; no activation required for passive AC bonus while guardian is present.
usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Rain dissipates the guardian or its hit points are reduced to zero.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged by the desert's natural elements.

tomb_kings_sand_guardian_summon_premium.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's rarity and the expertise required for its proper use.

tomb_kings_sandstone_grinder.name: Tomb Kings Sandstone Grinder
tomb_kings_sandstone_grinder.description: The Tomb Kings Sandstone Grinder is a finely crafted relic, its surface etched with arcane symbols and polished to a shimmering sheen by generations of carvers. When you turn it, the stone grinds ancient spices into fine dust that enhances your historical knowledge, granting +1 proficiency bonus on History checks related to tomb lore. Its preserved sandstone core also extends the shelf life of perishable foodstuffs in the wraps it accompanies, making it invaluable for long expeditions through the necropolis. The grinder's operation clouds the air with a thick dust, reducing visibility and requiring concentration.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Historical Knowledge
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action to turn the grinder, it grants you a +1 bonus on History checks related to tomb recipes and lore. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Extended Food Preservation
effectDetails.rules: The food wrapped in the cloth that accompanies this grinder (if any) is preserved for an additional 24 hours, effectively doubling its shelf life.

tomb_kings_sandstone_grinder.levelRequirementReason: This item's simplicity and utility make it accessible to even low-level explorers.
tomb_kings_sandstone_grinder.vendorReason: The Tomb Kings are renowned for their craftsmanship and knowledge of ancient secrets, making them the perfect purveyors of this invaluable relic.
tomb_kings_sandstone_grinder.shippingDetail: Delivered by the trusted Sandy Stone Shipment, known for its reliability in navigating through the treacherous desert routes.

usage.duration: Until end of next short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next short or long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration during use

tomb_kings_sandstone_grinder.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its utility and rarity without being overpowered.

tomb_kings_sarcophagus_of_power.name: Tomb Kings Sarcophagus of Power
tomb_kings_sarcophagus_of_power.description: The Tomb Kings Sarcophagus of Power stands as a grand testament to ancient craftsmanship, its gilded surface shimmering with cryptic runes that pulse with raw essence. This ornate sarcophagus serves not only as a resting place for powerful souls but also as an enigmatic ritual focus, allowing the soul within to be temporarily shielded from divine interference. Crafted by the King of Tombs himself, this relic preserves its contents in eternal slumber until summoned by the right hand.

effectDetails.title: Soul Preservation
effectDetails.rules: Activates when a soul of CR up to 15 is placed within. The soul remains dormant and can be retrieved at any time by the owner, with no additional cost or risk.

effectDetails.title: Divine Shielding
effectDetails.rules: While inside the sarcophagus, the soul gains immunity to all divine effects, including spells like Greater Restoration and Lesser Planar Ally. The effect lasts until the soul is retrieved by its owner. No save is required.

tomb_kings_sarcophagus_of_power.levelRequirementReason: Only a high-level warlock or necromancer can manage this powerful artifact effectively.
tomb_kings_sarcophagus_of_power.vendorReason: The Tomb Gatekeeper, guardian of ancient relics, ensures that only those with the proper knowledge and power can acquire such a potent item.
tomb_kings_sarcophagus_of_power.shippingDetail: Delivered by a solemn procession, ensuring the sarcophagus arrives in pristine condition, free from any defilement or tampering.

usage.activation: Activates upon placing a soul within it. Can be used once per month.
usage.duration: Permanent until retrieved
usage.endsWhen: The soul is retrieved by its owner

tomb_kings_sarcophagus_of_power.priceReason: This relic's price reflects the craftsmanship and power it commands, requiring a significant investment in time and resources to craft.

tomb_kings_scroll_of_command.name: Tomb Kings Scroll of Command (Low Tier)
tomb_kings_scroll_of_command.description: The Tomb Kings Scroll of Command hums with ancient magic, its brittle parchment crackling as it whispers orders to the undead. Crafted by the enigmatic Tomb Kings during their reign over the necropolis, this scroll commands even the most lowly skeletons and zombies, compelling them to obey for an hour before crumbling into dust. The scroll's power is drawn from the very earth of the tomb, making it a relic both potent and fleeting.

effectDetails.title: Command Skeletons/Zombies
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command up to 1d6 skeletons or zombies within 30 feet to obey your simple orders for one hour. They follow your commands faithfully until the time expires or they are harmed. Thereafter, the scroll is consumed and cannot be used again.

effectDetails.title: Scroll Consumed
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful command of skeletons/zombies, the scroll crumbles into dust, leaving no trace of its magical properties behind.

tomb_kings_scroll_of_command.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is designed for adventurers at a lower level to have access to a basic form of necromantic control.
tomb_kings_scroll_of_command.vendorReason: The tomb gatekeeper, guardian of the necropolis, sells these scrolls as they are part of his duties to maintain order within the tombs.
tomb_kings_scroll_of_command.shippingDetail: Delivered via a sealed sepulcher case that ensures safe transport through the labyrinthine tombs.

usage.duration: One hour
usage.endsWhen: The time expires or the skeletons/zombies are harmed
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use consumes one scroll

tomb_kings_scroll_of_command.priceReason: This price reflects a rare and potent item that allows basic control over undead without requiring higher-level magic.

tomb_kings_soul_jar_extraction.name: Tomb Kings Soul Jar Extraction Service
tomb_kings_soul_jar_extraction.description: The Tomb Kings Soul Jar Extraction Service allows a bound soul to be extracted from its ancient jar and reanimated into a fresh, powerful undead servant. The ritual requires 24 hours of careful work in a sacred burial chamber, during which rival necromancers may attempt to claim the soul for their own. This service is offered by King Amun-Ra himself, whose crypts hold the most potent souls bound within jars.
effects: Extract and reanimate a powerful undead servant

effectDetails.title: Soul Extraction
effectDetails.rules: This service requires 24 hours of uninterrupted work in the King's Burial Chamber. During this time, a rival necromancer may attempt to claim the soul by spending a full day performing their own ritual within 1 mile of the chamber. The extraction is successful with a DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check.

effectDetails.title: Undead Servant
effectDetails.rules: The reanimated undead serves for one month, after which it either decays into dust or can be re-extracted and bound to another vessel. The undead cannot be destroyed by mundane means but is vulnerable to holy damage.

tomb_kings_soul_jar_extraction.levelRequirementReason: Only a seasoned adventurer with experience in necromancy can perform this delicate ritual.
tomb_kings_soul_jar_extraction.vendorReason: The tomb gatekeeper oversees the sacred rituals of the King's Burial Chamber and ensures only those of proven skill attempt to extract souls from these powerful jars.
tomb_kings_soul_jar_extraction.shippingDetail: The service is shipped directly by enchanted vessel, ensuring safe delivery to the buyer’s location within a week.

usage.activation: A full day of uninterrupted work in the King's Burial Chamber
usage.duration: One month until the undead servant decays or can be re-extracted
usage.endsWhen: The extraction fails, the rival necromancer claims the soul, or the service is interrupted by external means

tomb_kings_soul_jar_extraction.priceReason: This service requires rare materials and the expertise of a skilled necromancer.

tomb_kings_undead_legion_hire.name: Tomb Kings Undead Legion Hire (500 Troops)
tomb_kings_undead_legion_hire.description: Forge a pact with the Tomb Kings and summon an army of disciplined, tireless undead soldiers. These 500 CR 1/4 skeletal warriors march unerringly for one year, their bones creaking in eerie harmony. They require no sustenance or rest, but demand a monthly tribute of raw soul energy worth 50,000 gp to maintain their spectral forms. Crafted by the King of Tombs himself, these undead are forged from ancient tombs and cursed earth.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Legion
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each month, the player must provide 50,000 gp in raw soul energy to maintain the undead soldiers. Failure to do so results in the immediate cessation of their services.

effectDetails.title: Unyielding Servants
effectDetails.rules: The summoned undead require no food or rest and are disciplined beyond mortal ken. They can be commanded by a willing leader, providing a +5 bonus to any military checks for the duration of one year.

tomb_kings_undead_legion_hire.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 16 to command such an army and provide the necessary raw soul energy.
tomb_kings_undead_legion_hire.vendorReason: The Tomb Gatekeeper, who oversees all necromantic affairs of the Tombs, can facilitate this pact with the undead.
tomb_kings_undead_legion_hire.shippingDetail: The Dark Procession ensures swift delivery and safe arrival of the skeletal legion.

usage.activation: Pact made at any time, once per year
usage.duration: One year from activation date
usage.endsWhen: Monthly tribute not met or pact broken

tomb_kings_undead_legion_hire.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the rare and powerful nature of summoning such an undead legion.

tomb_kings_wario_mummy_wrapping.name: Tomb Kings Wario Mummy Wrapping
tomb_kings_wario_mummy_wrapping.description: These bandages are a macabre joke, each one adorned with Wario's face in gaudy colors. Crafted by the Tomb Kings during their Halloween special, these wrappings not only grant you +1 AC for an hour but also give you advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with undead creatures. However, they come with a strong scent of garlic and old linen that makes Stealth checks difficult. These are perfect for those who want to make a statement in the afterlife.

effectDetails.title: Wrap yourself
effectDetails.rules: When you wrap yourself with these bandages, you gain +1 AC for 1 hour. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Advantage against undead
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one day (24 hours), you have advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with undead creatures. This advantage does not stack with other sources of advantage but can be used once per short or long rest.

tomb_kings_wario_mummy_wrapping.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners as it requires no special combat proficiency.
tomb_kings_wario_mummy_wrapping.vendorReason: The Tomb Kings are known for their unique and bizarre offerings, making these wrappings a fitting addition to their inventory.
tomb_kings_wario_mummy_wrapping.shippingDetail: Ships via Sarcophagus Delivery, which ensures the bandages arrive in perfect condition, even if they do smell like garlic and old linen.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until the end of your next long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you remove the bandages or at the start of your next short or long rest, whichever comes first.

tomb_kings_wario_mummy_wrapping.priceReason: The price reflects its unique design and the special craftsmanship involved in creating these wrappings.

tomb_kings_wario_sarcophagus_decal.name: Tomb Kings Wario Sarcophagus Decal
tomb_kings_wario_sarcophagus_decal.description: The Tomb Kings Wario Sarcophagus Decal is a ghastly sticker of Wario's face, crafted by the dark artisans of the Tomb Kings. When applied to any surface, it emits an eerie glow in the dark, giving you advantage on Intimidation checks and disadvantage on Stealth attempts. The undead are baffled by its presence, granting you advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against them. This decal is a macabre reminder of the Tomb Kings' whimsical humor.

effectDetails.title: Advantage in Dark
effectDetails.rules: When you are in darkness, you gain advantage on Intimidation checks. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Undead Confusion
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against undead creatures. The effect ends when you make such a check successfully.

tomb_kings_wario_sarcophagus_decal.levelRequirementReason: This decal is suitable for adventurers of any level, as it serves as both a humorous and practical tool.
tomb_kings_wario_sarcophagus_decal.vendorReason: The Tomb Kings are known for their dark humor and craftsmanship, making this peculiar item a staple in their inventory.
tomb_kings_wario_sarcophagus_decal.shippingDetail: Ships via crypt courier with a delivery delay of one night.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, ends on the start of your next turn or when you make a successful Charisma (Intimidation) check against undead.
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn or upon successful use in an Intimidation check with undead.

tomb_kings_wario_sarcophagus_decal.priceReason: For a common item, the price reflects its unique and humorous utility without overbalancing.

tomb_raider_pistols.name: Dual Pistols
tomb_raider_pistols.description: Dual Pistols are a pair of sleek, custom-forged pistols that whisper the secrets of forgotten tombs in their design. Crafted from ancient brass alloy and etched with runes said to enhance the wielder's acrobatic prowess, these pistols are as deadly in combat as they are elegant in form. Drawing on the essence of the grave, they grant the user a bonus action shot during acrobatics or combat, providing an edge when speed meets precision.

effectDetails.title: Dual Wield
effectDetails.rules: You can fire both pistols as a bonus action. Each pistol deals 1d8 piercing damage, and you have advantage on attack rolls made with these weapons.

effectDetails.title: Acrobatic Edge
effectDetails.rules: While in the air or performing acrobatics, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks. Additionally, you can make an unarmed strike as part of this action without provoking opportunity attacks.

tomb_raider_pistols.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 6th level to wield the precision and acrobatic skill these pistols demand.
tomb_raider_pistols.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in rare, exotic weapons that blur the line between combat and artistry.
tomb_raider_pistols.shippingDetail: Delivered with a custom leather holster set for safekeeping.

usage.activation: Bonus action to fire both pistols; can be used during acrobatics or as part of an unarmed strike.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until the start of your next turn).
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a long rest to fully recharge.

tomb_raider_pistols.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the pistols' unique design and the specialized craftsmanship required for their creation.

toppings_for_waffles_garlic_syrup.name: Wario's Waffle Topping Kit
toppings_for_waffles_garlic_syrup.description: Wario's Waffle Topping Kit, a golden syrup container shaped like a mustachioed mascot, brings an unforgettable culinary experience to breakfast tables. The garlic-infused syrup not only enhances waffles with a savory bite but also leaves hands and dishes sticky enough for hours of playful clean-up fun. This kit is the product of Wario's Land’s secret recipe, known to raise charisma by one among those who indulge in its rich flavor.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume a waffle topped with this syrup to gain +1 Charisma until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Clean-Up
effectDetails.rules: Any attempt to clean up after using this syrup has disadvantage on the DC. This effect lasts for 24 hours from application.

toppings_for_waffles_garlic_syrup.levelRequirementReason: This kit is suitable for beginners and casual adventurers, providing a fun culinary experience without heavy prerequisite demands.
toppings_for_waffles_garlic_syrup.vendorReason: Wario Land is renowned for its quirky and innovative waffle toppings, making this kit a staple in their product line.
toppings_for_waffles_garlic_syrup.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Topping Truck, known for its eccentric route that might delay delivery slightly due to scenic detours.

usage.activation: Consume a waffle topped with this syrup as an action during breakfast time.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Upon completion of the next short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is considered a consumable item.

toppings_for_waffles_garlic_syrup.priceReason: The price reflects the unique and fun culinary experience provided by this kit, making it accessible for players looking to enhance their breakfast rituals without breaking the bank.

torch_everburning.name: Everburning Torch
torch_everburning.description: The Everburning Torch, forged in the heart of a forgotten volcano, glows with an eternal flame that never fades or flickers. Crafted from basalt and coated in obsidian, its light is as hardy as it is bright, casting a warm glow that can illuminate even the darkest caverns without consuming any fuel. This torch is not just a source of light; it also serves as a formidable club, delivering fiery strikes with each swing.
effects: 1 Fire damage if used as a club

effectDetails.title: Light Without Fuel
effectDetails.rules: The Everburning Torch emits a constant, bright flame that provides bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. This effect is always active as long as the torch remains intact.

effectDetails.title: Fiery Blow
effectDetails.rules: When used as a club, the Everburning Torch deals 1d6 fire damage to one target within reach on a successful hit. The torch can be used in this manner once before requiring an hour of cooling time, which can be accelerated by immersing it in water for 10 minutes.

torch_everburning.levelRequirementReason: The Everburning Torch's durability and the fire damage it deals make it a useful tool for adventurers at any level.
torch_everburning.vendorReason: Shamans of the region have long revered this item, using its light to guide lost souls and its flame to cleanse impurities.
torch_everburning.shippingDetail: The box is enchanted to protect the torch from damage during transit, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use as a club; requires an action to wield and swing normally.
usage.duration: Indefinite light effect; fire damage effect ends after one use or when cooled.
usage.endsWhen: The torch is broken, runs out of charges (unlimited), or is destroyed by fire resistance or immunity.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses for indefinite light, 1 charge for fire damage

torch_everburning.priceReason: The Everburning Torch's unique properties and the materials used in its crafting justify a price of 1000 XP.

toy_train.name: Toy Train
toy_train.description: The Toy Train, a diminutive model of the Excess Express, is crafted from gleaming brass and painted in the livery of the Great Railways Guild. It hums softly as it moves along its miniature tracks, creating a soothing choo-choo sound that can calm even the most restless child. This tiny locomotive is more than just a toy; it's a piece of railway history, perfect for display on any shelf or desk.

effectDetails.title: Goes Choo-Choo
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the player can activate the toy train to emit a soothing choo-choo sound. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Railway Reminiscence
effectDetails.rules: When placed on a table within reach, the toy train grants advantage on all History checks related to railroads for 1 hour. This effect ends when the toy train is moved more than 5 feet away from its original location.

toy_train.levelRequirementReason: This toy is suitable for players of level 1, as it provides a simple yet enjoyable experience.
toy_train.vendorReason: Toad Town Market stocks this charming item among their array of collectibles and novelties.
toy_train.shippingDetail: Ships via Box, arriving within 3 days if local delivery is possible; otherwise, expect up to a week for standard shipping.

usage.activation: Action: As an action, the player can activate the toy train's choo-choo sound.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation with 1-minute duration per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used once per short or long rest.

toy_train.priceReason: The toy train is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique combination of nostalgia and practical utility for players.

trainer_guild_animal_whistle.name: Trainer Guild Animal Whistle
trainer_guild_animal_whistle.description: The Trainer Guild Animal Whistle is a sleek, polished brass instrument forged in the heart of the guild's forge. Crafted from the bones of ancient animals and imbued with the guild’s arcane energies, it can attract or calm specific types of creatures as the DM deems fitting. The whistle resonates with a sound that echoes like distant thunder, compelling nearby animals to either approach with caution or retreat peacefully.

effectDetails.title: Attract or Calm
effectDetails.rules: The user can activate the whistle as an action, choosing to either attract one creature of a specific type within 60 feet or calm it. The effect lasts for 1 hour unless dispelled by magic or an opposing command.

effectDetails.title: Limited Use
effectDetails.rules: The whistle has only three uses per day and requires 8 hours to recharge after all charges are expended.

trainer_guild_animal_whistle.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners who wish to interact with animals in a controlled manner.
trainer_guild_animal_whistle.vendorReason: The Trainer Guild has exclusive rights to sell items that aid their members and apprentices in managing animal interactions.
trainer_guild_animal_whistle.shippingDetail: Ships via the Swift Pony Express, which delivers within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until dispelled
usage.endsWhen: Use is expended or dispelled by magic

trainer_guild_animal_whistle.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's limited use and specific utility, suitable for beginners.

trainer_guild_badge.name: Trainer Guild Badge (Rank 3)
trainer_guild_badge.description: The Trainer Guild Badge (Rank 3) gleams with a polished sheen, its surface etched with intricate patterns of beasts and runes. Crafted by the Trainer Guild from high-quality leather and enchanted with their signature magic, this badge not only symbolizes mastery but also grants the wearer an aura that commands even the most fierce creatures. With a successful Animal Handling check, you can pacify any hostile beast within 30 feet; doing so requires a DC 14 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Animal Handling
effectDetails.rules: This badge provides a +2 bonus to all Animal Handling checks, enhancing your ability to handle and command creatures.

effectDetails.title: Pacify Hostile Beasts
effectDetails.rules: By making an Animal Handling check with a DC of 14, you can pacify any hostile beast within 30 feet. The effect lasts for one minute or until the creature makes an attack against you.

trainer_guild_badge.levelRequirementReason: This badge is suitable for those who have just begun their journey in the art of training and handling creatures.
trainer_guild_badge.vendorReason: The Trainer Guild maintains a robust network of chapters, each equipped to supply such badges to their members.
trainer_guild_badge.shippingDetail: Ships via the Trainer Guild's own courier service for swift delivery.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires a successful Animal Handling check to pacify hostile creatures.
usage.duration: One minute or until the creature attacks you.
usage.endsWhen: The target beast makes an attack against you, or when the duration expires.

trainer_guild_badge.priceReason: Crafted with high-quality materials and guild magic, this badge is a fair price for its utility.

trainer_guild_badge_pouch_belt.name: Trainer Guild Badge Pouch Belt
trainer_guild_badge_pouch_belt.description: The Trainer Guild Badge Pouch Belt is a meticulously crafted leather belt that features eight small pouches, each designed to hold one of your most cherished badges or tokens. It's made by the skilled hands of the Guild Leatherworkers and imbued with subtle magic that grants you +1 to either Intimidation checks or Inspiration from allies when wearing it. The jingling sound of the pouches adds a comforting rhythm during quiet moments, making this belt not just functional but also a symbol of your journey through the Trainer Guild's halls.

effectDetails.title: Badges Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing at least one badge from this belt, you gain a +1 bonus to either your Intimidation checks or Inspiration from allies. This effect is active as long as the belt is worn and the badges are in place.

effectDetails.title: Silent Rhythm
effectDetails.rules: The pouches of the belt produce a subtle jingling sound when you move, providing a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks if used during quiet moments. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

trainer_guild_badge_pouch_belt.levelRequirementReason: The belt requires at least level 6 to ensure that the wearer has achieved some significant milestones within the Trainer Guild.
trainer_guild_badge_pouch_belt.vendorReason: As a symbol of accomplishment, the Trainer Guild Hall is the most fitting vendor for this prestigious item.
trainer_guild_badge_pouch_belt.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Badge Buckle Express, ensuring that your belt arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required to benefit from the bonuses provided by wearing badges or during quiet moments.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each check; lasts until the end of your next turn for Stealth checks.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted when all badges are removed or the belt is taken off, or if you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check without using the Silent Rhythm effect.

trainer_guild_badge_pouch_belt.priceReason: The price reflects its rare craftsmanship and utility within the guild's hierarchy.

trainer_guild_battle_strat_session.name: Trainer Guild Battle Strat Session
trainer_guild_battle_strat_session.description: Forge your battle strategy with a Trainer Guild Battle Strat Session. This meticulously crafted session provides you with Pokémon-inspired tactics that can be applied to any combat. Learn the critical 'switch-out' tactic, allowing you to disengage as a bonus action once per short rest. The session concludes with a complimentary Poké Puff, a minor healing snack that restores 1d4+2 hit points. Crafted by experienced Gym Leaders using ancient battle scrolls and their accumulated wisdom.

effectDetails.title: Battle Strat Boost
effectDetails.rules: At the beginning of your first combat on the initiative order, you gain +1 to initiative and one attack roll. This effect lasts for the duration of the session.

effectDetails.title: Switch-Out Mastery
effectDetails.rules: You learn the 'switch-out' tactic, which allows you to disengage as a bonus action once per short or long rest. You must have at least 1 hit point remaining to use this ability.

trainer_guild_battle_strat_session.levelRequirementReason: The session is designed for beginners and those who need to sharpen their combat strategies.
trainer_guild_battle_strat_session.vendorReason: As the heart of Pokémon training, the Guild Academy provides foundational sessions like these.
trainer_guild_battle_strat_session.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Trainer Guild Academy; delivery is swift and reliable.

usage.duration: Until the end of the session (typically one hour).
usage.endsWhen: The session concludes or you leave combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day, but only once per rest.

trainer_guild_battle_strat_session.priceReason: This price reflects the quality and expertise of the trainers who prepare these sessions.

trainer_guild_berry_juice_recipe.name: Recipe: Trainer Guild Berry Juice
trainer_guild_berry_juice_recipe.description: The Trainer Guild Berry Juice recipe yields a refreshing elixir made from wild berries for rapid recovery. Sip it during training to heal 1d8 hit points instantly, ensuring you're always at your peak. This juice not only quenches thirst but also grants a temporary boost in speed, allowing you to sprint an additional 5 feet every round for half an hour. Distilled by the Guild Juicers, this potion is a must-have for any serious trainer seeking a competitive edge.

effectDetails.title: Instant Hit Point Recovery
effectDetails.rules: Activates on consumption. Instantly heals the drinker by 1d8 hit points. Requires four berries and quenches thirst. Ends when consumed or after one use.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect of +5 feet movement speed for 30 minutes upon consumption. Ends if the drinker is incapacitated or after a single serving.

trainer_guild_berry_juice_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Beginners often seek this potion to enhance their stamina and performance during training sessions.
trainer_guild_berry_juice_recipe.vendorReason: The outpost frequently hosts trainers in need of quick recovery tools for their rigorous routines.
trainer_guild_berry_juice_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered fresh daily, ensuring the berries are at peak freshness and efficacy.

usage.duration: Instantaneous hit point recovery; speed boost lasts for 30 minutes.
usage.endsWhen: Upon consumption or after one use per day.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only once daily.

trainer_guild_berry_juice_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's rarity and the cost of wild berries justify its price while remaining accessible for frequent use.

trainer_guild_berry_press.name: Trainer Guild Berry Press
trainer_guild_berry_press.description: The Trainer Guild Berry Press, a sturdy wooden contraption forged by the skilled hands of Guild Woodworkers, is essential for extracting fresh berry juice. This manual press not only speeds up the process but also ensures that each drop is pure and free from impurities, making it invaluable for any trainer who values precision in their concoctions. A simple twist of the lever initiates a cascade of perfectly juiced berries, leaving behind nothing but vibrant purple stains on your hands.

effectDetails.title: Efficient Berry Juicing
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the Trainer Guild Berry Press as a bonus action, it allows you to instantly complete one round of berry preparation. This grants a +1 bonus to any Nature checks related to berry recipes for 1 hour. The effect ends if you prepare another batch of berries or if your concentration is broken.

effectDetails.title: Stains Hands Purple
effectDetails.rules: The press leaves behind a permanent, albeit harmless, stain on the user's hands that persists until washed off with soap and water. This effect does not require an action to activate and lasts indefinitely until removed.

trainer_guild_berry_press.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners and trainers just starting their journey.
trainer_guild_berry_press.vendorReason: The Trainer Guild Outpost sells this press as part of its essential equipment line, catering to the needs of novice trainers.
trainer_guild_berry_press.shippingDetail: Shipped via Juice Jug Jig in 1-3 days, ensuring safe delivery and proper functioning upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Preparation of another batch of berries or concentration being broken

trainer_guild_berry_press.priceReason: The Trainer Guild Berry Press is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its utility in speeding up berry preparation and ensuring pure juice, making it a valuable addition to any trainer's toolkit.

trainer_guild_explorer_boots.name: Trainer Guild Explorer Boots
trainer_guild_explorer_boots.description: These rugged boots are forged from the hardiest leather and reinforced with iron studs, designed by the Guild Cobblers for explorers seeking to traverse treacherous terrains. Wearing them allows you to move swiftly over rocky ground at half your normal speed without penalty, while also granting a +1 bonus on Dexterity saving throws against traps. The boots' signature squeak is not just an annoyance but a subtle warning of impending danger.

effectDetails.title: Ignore Non-Magical Difficult Terrain
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these boots, you can move across non-magical difficult terrain at your normal speed without taking the penalty. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Trap Dexterity Save Bonus
effectDetails.rules: When a trap would normally force you to make a Dexterity saving throw, you gain a +1 bonus on that save. This benefit lasts until the end of your next turn after triggering or escaping from a trap.

trainer_guild_explorer_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are designed for novice explorers and adventurers just starting their journey.
trainer_guild_explorer_boots.vendorReason: The Guild Outpost is known for its support of young trainers eager to explore the world.
trainer_guild_explorer_boots.shippingDetail: Ships via Trailblazer Tread, ensuring swift delivery across all terrains.

usage.duration: Lasts until removed or until you stop wearing the boots.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when you remove the boots or at the end of your next turn after a trap is triggered or escaped from.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as they are passive effects.

trainer_guild_explorer_boots.priceReason: The price reflects the quality craftsmanship and materials used in their creation, along with their utility for novice explorers.

trainer_guild_poke_ball_mixer.name: Trainer Guild Poké Ball Mixer
trainer_guild_poke_ball_mixer.description: The Trainer Guild Poké Ball Mixer is a sleek, bowl-shaped device with Poké Balls adorning its surface. This artisanal kitchen gadget not only ensures smooth pastries but also enlists nearby Pokémon to lend a helping hand in your baking. When unsecured, it rolls away with surprising speed, making it a playful challenge to keep in place during use. Crafted by Guild Crafters using ancient techniques, this mixer is a beloved tool of bakers across the region.

effectDetails.title: Poké Ball Companion Assist
effectDetails.rules: When activated, nearby Pokémon can assist in your baking process. The Pokémon provide a +1 bonus to any baking check for pastries. This effect lasts until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Rolls Away if Not Secured
effectDetails.rules: If not secured in place, this mixer will roll away on its own within 5 feet of where it was last placed. It can be manually restrained by any creature as a bonus action.

trainer_guild_poke_ball_mixer.levelRequirementReason: This device is simple enough for anyone to use but adds value and fun to the baking process.
trainer_guild_poke_ball_mixer.vendorReason: The Trainer Guild Kitchen specializes in tools that enhance Pokémon training experiences, including culinary aids like this mixer.
trainer_guild_poke_ball_mixer.shippingDetail: Ships via Ball Batter Bundle, a reliable courier known for its punctuality and careful handling of delicate kitchen items.

usage.activation: Activates as an action when secured in place.
usage.duration: Lasts until the next long rest or until the device is unsecured.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the device rolls away or if it is unsecured.

trainer_guild_poke_ball_mixer.priceReason: This mixer is crafted with quality materials and features unique Pokémon design, making it a valuable yet balanced addition to any baker's toolkit.

trainer_guild_poke_puff_recipe.name: Recipe: Trainer Guild Poké Puff
trainer_guild_poke_puff_recipe.description: The Trainer Guild Poké Puff is a delicate pastry made by the skilled bakers of the Guild. Each puff is a treat for Pokémon and trainers, bursting with flavor that can heal wounds or bolster combat prowess. These pastries are not just sweet; they are crafted from the finest flour and berries, ensuring each bite packs a delightful surprise. The Poké Puff comes in random flavors, each with its own unique effect, making every mealtime an adventure.

effectDetails.title: Healing and Companion Boost
effectDetails.rules: When a Pokémon eats this Poké Puff, it heals 2d4 hit points. Additionally, the trainer's next attack by their companion has an advantage with a +1 bonus to damage.

effectDetails.title: Guild Baked Delicacy
effectDetails.rules: The pastry is made exclusively by the skilled bakers of the Trainer Guild. It requires specific ingredients and is baked in their kitchens, ensuring its quality and effectiveness.

trainer_guild_poke_puff_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is complex and requires a certain level to ensure the trainer understands proper Pokémon care and baking techniques.
trainer_guild_poke_puff_recipe.vendorReason: The Guild Bakers are renowned for their expertise in crafting pastries that enhance both Pokémon and trainers alike.
trainer_guild_poke_puff_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered quickly by the Puff Pastry Post, ensuring freshness at your doorsteps.

usage.activation: Eaten by a Pokémon as a free action during its turn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon consumption.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per meal.

trainer_guild_poke_puff_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's complexity and the quality of ingredients justify its moderate price in experience points.

trainer_guild_pokeball_bento_box.name: Trainer Guild Poké Ball Bento Box
trainer_guild_pokeball_bento_box.description: The Trainer Guild Poké Ball Bento Box is a lunchbox shaped like its namesake, crafted from durable metal and emblazoned with the guild’s insignia. It keeps your food warm for an entire day without any power source, and opening it triggers a familiar 'Poké Ball' sound that can be heard across town, giving you disadvantage on Stealth checks. You feel a peculiar urge to catch anything within reach before eating; failing to do so results in disadvantage on your next attack roll.
effects: Keeps food warm for a day

effectDetails.title: Warmth Preserve
effectDetails.rules: This bento box keeps any contained food at the perfect temperature, maintaining warmth for an entire day. No additional action is required to maintain this effect.

effectDetails.title: Sound of Capture
effectDetails.rules: Opening the box makes a distinct 'Poké Ball' sound that can be heard within 100 feet. This grants disadvantage on any Stealth checks made by you until your next long rest.

trainer_guild_pokeball_bento_box.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners, requiring only basic dexterity to use effectively.
trainer_guild_pokeball_bento_box.vendorReason: The Trainer Guild Lunchbox Co. specializes in creating unique and functional lunch solutions for all their members.
trainer_guild_pokeball_bento_box.shippingDetail: This bento box is shipped via Pokedex Express, ensuring it arrives at your door with a complimentary Poké Ball charm.

usage.duration: Until contents are consumed or removed
usage.endsWhen: Food is no longer in the box or the box is closed

trainer_guild_pokeball_bento_box.priceReason: This bento box, while not overly powerful, adds a unique and useful feature to any adventurer's daily routine.

trainer_guild_pokemon_grooming_service.name: Trainer Guild Pokémon Grooming Service
trainer_guild_pokemon_grooming_service.description: The Trainer Guild Pokémon Grooming Service is a meticulous grooming kit forged from polished steel and adorned with emblems of the Guild’s crest. This grooming service not only enhances your companion's appearance but also improves their performance, granting them +2 to AC and attacks for up to 24 hours. It also removes any dirt-based debuffs, ensuring your Pokémon is in top fighting form. The kit is shipped by Paw Print Delivery, known for its precision and care.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Performance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the grooming service grants a +2 bonus to AC and attack rolls. This effect lasts for up to 24 hours or until the Pokémon's next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Dirt Removal
effectDetails.rules: The kit removes any dirt-based debuffs affecting the Pokémon, restoring its combat effectiveness immediately upon use.

trainer_guild_pokemon_grooming_service.levelRequirementReason: This grooming service is suitable for beginner trainers who wish to ensure their Pokémon are in peak condition.
trainer_guild_pokemon_grooming_service.vendorReason: The Trainer Guild Stables offers this grooming service as part of its comprehensive care packages for all aspiring Pokémon masters.
trainer_guild_pokemon_grooming_service.shippingDetail: Delivered with same-day precision, ensuring the grooming kit arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Use an action to apply the grooming service to your Pokémon.
usage.duration: 24 hours or until a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the Pokémon takes a long rest.

trainer_guild_pokemon_grooming_service.priceReason: This grooming service is priced at 1000 XP, offering a balanced value for enhancing performance and removing dirt-based debuffs.

trainer_guild_recipe_poke_puff Deluxe.name: Recipe: Trainer Guild Poké Puff Deluxe
trainer_guild_recipe_poke_puff Deluxe.description: A meticulously crafted treat from the Trainer Guild Bakers, the Poké Puff Deluxe is a sumptuous pastry that not only delights your animal companions but also strengthens their bond with you. Each puff grants an animal companion 1d6 temporary hit points and bestows advantage on one saving throw per day for seven days. The perfect gift for those who need a little extra support in their adventures, this treat is both delicious and beneficial.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: When consumed by an animal companion, the Poké Puff Deluxe grants it 1d6 temporary hit points for 1 hour. This effect has no saving throw and does not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Saving Throw Advantage
effectDetails.rules: For seven days following consumption, your animal companion gains advantage on one saving throw of your choice each day. This effect is passive and does not consume charges or have a specific activation method.

trainer_guild_recipe_poke_puff Deluxe.levelRequirementReason: The Poké Puff Deluxe is suitable for trainers at any level who need to bolster their animal companions' resilience.
trainer_guild_recipe_poke_puff Deluxe.vendorReason: As the creators and purveyors of all official Trainer Guild supplies, they naturally stock this cherished treat.
trainer_guild_recipe_poke_puff Deluxe.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost care to ensure freshness upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 hour for temporary hit points, 7 days for saving throw advantage.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or the treat is consumed by an animal companion.

trainer_guild_recipe_poke_puff Deluxe.priceReason: The Poké Puff Deluxe strikes a balance, offering significant benefits for a moderate price of 1000 XP.

trainer_gym_uniform_of_mediocrity.name: Trainer Gym Uniform of Mediocrity
trainer_gym_uniform_of_mediocrity.description: The Trainer Gym Uniform of Mediocrity is a drab, ill-fitting tunic and pants set, made from cheap fabric that clings to your form in all the wrong places. It whispers of long hours spent in gym uniforms, where mediocrity was the only goal. Those who wear this uniform blend seamlessly into any crowd, their presence forgotten as quickly as they arrive—ideal for trainers seeking anonymity or a chance at a fresh start.

effectDetails.title: Bleed Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the uniform, you have advantage on checks to blend into crowds and become invisible for up to 1 hour. If observed by a creature with an Intelligence of 15 or higher, this invisibility ends immediately.

effectDetails.title: Forgettable
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on checks to stand out in any situation. This effect persists until you take a long rest. You can use this feature once per short or long rest.

trainer_gym_uniform_of_mediocrity.levelRequirementReason: This uniform is designed for beginners and trainers just starting their journey, providing them with the advantage they need to avoid unwanted attention.
trainer_gym_uniform_of_mediocrity.vendorReason: The Trainer Guild is known for its commitment to all levels of trainers, ensuring even those new to the gym have the tools needed to succeed.
trainer_gym_uniform_of_mediocrity.shippingDetail: Ships via standard courier service with a delivery time of 3 days from any major city.

usage.activation: Passive effect; becomes active when you put on the uniform.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for 'Bleed Invisibility', lasts up to 1 hour. 'Forgettable' persists until you take a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Disadvantage on checks to stand out ends after taking a long rest, invisibility ends when observed by a creature with an Intelligence of 15 or higher.

trainer_gym_uniform_of_mediocrity.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the item's utility for new trainers who need to blend in and avoid unwanted attention, but still have the potential to stand out as they grow more skilled.

trinity_general_blessed_baking_sheet.name: Trinity General Blessed Baking Sheet
trinity_general_blessed_baking_sheet.description: The Trinity General Blessed Baking Sheet, a silver sheet blessed by holy hands, radiates a soft glow when in use. It ensures that every biscuit baked on its surface achieves perfect evenness and divine consistency, healing an additional +1 hit point to any who consume the treats it produces. The sheet also purifies minor taint from ingredients, making them fit for only the most sacred feasts. Over time, though, the sheet's silver tarnishes, a reminder of the passage of time and the need for constant care.

effectDetails.title: Divine Biscuit Healing
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, baked goods prepared on this sheet heal an additional +1 hit point to the consumer. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action from the user.
