effectDetails.rules: Restores 25% of your maximum hit points from any source of fire damage taken. This effect ends if you take non-fire damage or are incapacitated.

valley_bowser_bowser_burn.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can safely experiment with this volatile potion.
valley_bowser_bowser_burn.vendorReason: Bowser's trusted apothecary supplies potions that match the fiery temperament of his kingdom.
valley_bowser_bowser_burn.shippingDetail: Ships via Volcanic Express Courier, ensuring swift delivery through lava-ridden paths.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; automatic on fire damage taken.
usage.duration: 15 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration expires or you take non-fire damage.

valley_bowser_bowser_burn.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare, volatile potion that offers significant but manageable fire-related benefits.

valley_bowser_bowser_eyes_aura.name: Bowser Eyes Aura
valley_bowser_bowser_eyes_aura.description: The Bowser Eyes Aura emits a malevolent, crimson glow that seems to emanate from your very eyes, casting an aura of dread over combatants within reach. This ancient relic, crafted in the forges of Bowser's Keep, grants you a +2 bonus to damage rolls when using bow-themed weapons and imbues your attacks with the fiery power of lava. Only the most loyal followers of Bowser can wear this artifact, as it draws strength from the dark heart of the Fire King himself.

effectDetails.title: Bowser's Lava Flame
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with a bow-themed weapon, it deals an additional 1d6 fire damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to all damage rolls made with bow-themed weapons. This bonus persists for the duration of one long rest.

valley_bowser_bowser_eyes_aura.levelRequirementReason: This artifact is designed for those who have proven their loyalty and dedication to Bowser's cause.
valley_bowser_bowser_eyes_aura.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, a trusted merchant of the Mushroom Kingdom, carries this powerful relic due to its deep ties with the kingdom’s most formidable foe.
valley_bowser_bowser_eyes_aura.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring swift delivery but requiring an additional day for tracking confirmation.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the item.
usage.duration: Until you complete a long rest or remove the item.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you finish a long rest or take off the Bowser Eyes Aura.

valley_bowser_bowser_eyes_aura.priceReason: This artifact's rarity and unique alignment with Bowser’s power make it a sought-after item, justifying its moderate price in XP.

valley_bowser_bowser_gaze.name: Bowser’s Gaze Lens
valley_bowser_bowser_gaze.description: The Bowser’s Gaze Lens is a lens of chaotic power, forged from the very essence of Bowser's fiery gaze. It grants the wearer a fleeting glimpse into the Dark Land, boosting all stats by 10% and allowing them to pierce through illusions, revealing false terrain and foes for a brief moment. This relic channels Bowser’s raw might, temporarily aligning with the chaotic force that governs its creation.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Piercer
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this lens reveals all illusions and false terrain within a 30-foot radius for 15 seconds. Targets can make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) to maintain the illusion's effect. The lens has no effect on creatures immune to illusions.

effectDetails.title: Stat Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +2 bonus to all ability checks and saves for 10 seconds after activation, with no more than one use per long rest. The lens can be activated as an action.

valley_bowser_bowser_gaze.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Perception or Insight to fully utilize the lens's revealing abilities.
valley_bowser_bowser_gaze.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, a relic dealer with ties to the Fire Kingdom, offers this potent relic that channels Bowser’s raw power.
valley_bowser_bowser_gaze.shippingDetail: Ships via Rakasha Spirit Walk, which delivers the lens within two days of purchase.

usage.duration: 10 seconds for Stat Boost; 15 seconds for revealing illusions and false terrain
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration expires or the wearer is incapacitated
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one use per long rest

valley_bowser_bowser_gaze.priceReason: The lens's rarity and unique properties justify its price of 1000 XP.

valley_bowser_bowser_scream.name: Bowser Scream
valley_bowser_bowser_scream.description: Bowser Scream is a fearsome sonic device crafted from volcanic obsidian and powered by the raw energy of an ancient Lava King’s roar. When activated, it unleashes a deafening shriek that can be heard for miles across the lava fields, shattering enemy morale and causing them to flee in panic. It is best used in the heart of a molten battlefield where its sonic power can resonate through the very ground.

effectDetails.title: Lava Shriek
effectDetails.rules: When activated, Bowser Scream emits a deafening roar that causes all enemies within a 50-foot radius to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or flee in panic for the start of their next turn. The effect has no save vs. Fortitude and is limited to once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Critical Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activating Bowser Scream grants the user +2d6 bonus to melee attack rolls against fleeing or disoriented enemies for 1 minute, after which it can be used again only at the start of a short or long rest. This effect is limited by one use per day.

valley_bowser_bowser_scream.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for players who are just starting their journey into the wilds of the Mushroom Kingdom.
valley_bowser_bowser_scream.vendorReason: Bowser’s minions often trade in items that grant a tactical edge, and this device is a prime example of such an artifact.
valley_bowser_bowser_scream.shippingDetail: Ships via express delivery, arriving within the week if purchased from Valley Bowser.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Lava Shriek), 1 minute (Critical Boost)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a successful Wisdom save is made or after its duration expires.

valley_bowser_bowser_scream.priceReason: This price reflects the rare and powerful components used in its construction as well as its limited daily use.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_core.name: Bowser Soul Core
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_core.description: The Bowser Soul Core is a cursed relic forged in the depths of Bowser’s domain, radiating his raw fury and malice. When activated, it grants the wielder an explosive +50% attack speed and a resilient +20% armor boost, but at the cost of draining 10% of your health per second. A relic of perilous power, it is said to only grant its might to those brave enough to face the wrath of Bowser himself.

effectDetails.title: Attack Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on use, increasing attack speed by +50%. Duration lasts until end of the user's next turn. Ends if the user is incapacitated or dies.

effectDetails.title: Armor Boost and Health Drain
effectDetails.rules: Activates on use, providing a +20% armor boost for 1 round. The user loses 10% of their maximum hit points per second while this effect lasts. Ends if the user is incapacitated or dies.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_core.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant combat experience and fortitude can wield the Bowser Soul Core.
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_core.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, a den of dangerous relics, houses this relic to challenge its patrons in perilous contests.
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_core.shippingDetail: Due to the volatile nature of the item, Pipe Express requires an additional courier fee and ensures safe delivery within a week.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn
usage.endsWhen: User is incapacitated or dies

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_core.priceReason: The Bowser Soul Core's price reflects its dangerous power and the risk it poses to the user.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_pearl.name: Bowser Soul Pearl of the Infernal King
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_pearl.description: The Bowser Soul Pearl of the Infernal King is a molten core encased in obsidian, its surface crackling with infernal energies that pulse like living fire. This ancient relic amplifies your strength and grants you invincibility during combat, allowing you to cleave through enemies unscathed for fleeting moments. Crafted by Bowser himself from the very heart of the Volcanic Inferno, this pearl is a testament to the king's fiery prowess and enduring power.

effectDetails.title: Infernal Strength
effectDetails.rules: When activated, you gain temporary hit point resistance equal to your Constitution modifier + 10 against all damage types for 5 seconds. This effect cannot be used again until the start of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Invincible Might
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of this effect, any attack roll made against you has disadvantage. Additionally, you are immune to all damage from attacks and effects for 10 seconds. You can only use this effect once per battle.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_pearl.levelRequirementReason: The Bowser Soul Pearl demands a seasoned warrior with the strength and resilience to wield its infernal power.
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_pearl.vendorReason: Bowser, in all his grandeur, personally ensures that only those who have earned it can possess this powerful relic.
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_pearl.shippingDetail: The Boo Spectral Mail delivers the Bowser Soul Pearl with a chilling delay, ensuring no one can use its power until they arrive at their destination.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for 5 seconds of temporary invulnerability and 10 seconds of damage resistance
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effects expire or you take any damage from an attack

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_pearl.priceReason: This relic is crafted with rare materials and imbued with ancient sorcery, making it a balanced but expensive item for those who seek to harness its infernal might.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_shard.name: Bowser Soul Shard of the Inferno Throne
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_shard.description: The Bowser Soul Shard of the Inferno Throne is a molten fragment of Bowser’s soul, forged in the heart of his infernal domain. This shard bestows upon its wielder an aura of volcanic power that enhances resilience and combat prowess. When immersed in lava, it grants +25% damage resistance and +10 temporary hit points per turn for 5 rounds, after which it must cool down in a lava pool for 30 minutes to restore its potency.

effectDetails.title: Lava Power
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action when immersed in lava. Grants +25% damage resistance and +10 temporary hit points per turn for 5 rounds. Ends upon removal from the lava or if the user takes any non-magical damage.

effectDetails.title: Heated Resilience
effectDetails.rules: The shard must be cooled in a lava pool for at least 30 minutes before it can be activated again, preventing overuse and ensuring its power remains potent.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_shard.levelRequirementReason: This shard is accessible to low-level characters who wish to harness Bowser's volcanic fury without the need for extensive experience or power.
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_shard.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, a vendor of fiery and infernal items, carries this shard as it is a symbol of Bowser’s relentless spirit and power.
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_shard.shippingDetail: The Rakasha courier ensures the shard remains in a stable lava pool during transit to maintain its potency.

usage.activation: Bonus action when immersed in lava.
usage.duration: 5 rounds while in lava.
usage.endsWhen: Removed from lava or non-magical damage is taken.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a cooldown period.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the unique properties it grants make it a fair price for those seeking to harness volcanic power without breaking the bank.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_tome.name: Bowser Soul Tome
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_tome.description: The Bowser Soul Tome is an ancient tome bound in molten red leather, its pages inscribed with fiery runes that shimmer like molten lava. When invoked by a worthy Koopa, it transforms the reader into a towering fire spirit, granting them flight and the power to call forth scorching fireballs that rend the air on impact. This ancient relic is said to have been crafted from the very essence of Bowser's soul itself, lending its wielder a 50% chance to dodge fire-based attacks.

effectDetails.title: Flight and Fireball Summoning
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the reader transforms into a fiery Koopa spirit capable of flight for 10 seconds. Within this time, they may summon a fireball that deals 2d6 + 5 fire damage on impact. The user must end their turn in mid-air and cannot land until the effect expires.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Chance against Fire Attacks
effectDetails.rules: The reader gains a 50% chance to dodge any fire-based attack while in this form, but this reduces to 25% upon landing. This effect ends when the flight duration expires or if they take damage.

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_tome.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have faced the fiery wrath of Bowser can wield such a powerful tome.
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_tome.vendorReason: The Valley of Bowser is home to many relics from the King of Fire's era; naturally, they would stock items imbued with his power.
valley_bowser_bowser_soul_tome.shippingDetail: The Boo Spectral Mail service ensures that this fragile tome reaches its destination without being damaged by any external heat sources.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Exceeding the duration, taking damage, or landing after flight

valley_bowser_bowser_soul_tome.priceReason: The Bowser Soul Tome is a rare and powerful relic, making it an expensive but fair choice for those who can afford its power.

valley_bowser_bowser_ward.name: Bowser’s Wrath Ward
valley_bowser_bowser_ward.description: Bowser’s Wrath Ward, a shield forged from the molten heart of Bowser's fiery lair, is said to channel the very essence of the Koopa King's rage. When activated, it absorbs and redirects incoming physical damage into a searing blast that erupts after three seconds, incinerating nearby foes. The ward not only blocks 30% of incoming attacks but also restores 15% health upon its fiery detonation, providing heroes with precious moments to regroup in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Absorbed Defense
effectDetails.rules: When activated, Bowser’s Wrath Ward reduces all physical damage by 30% for 3 seconds. It can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Retaliation
effectDetails.rules: After 3 seconds of absorbing damage, the ward detonates in a fiery burst that deals fire damage equal to the absorbed damage plus an additional 50% fire damage. This effect has a range of 10 feet and can only be triggered once per short or long rest.

valley_bowser_bowser_ward.levelRequirementReason: The ward's power demands a hero capable of withstanding its initial burst of absorbed energy.
valley_bowser_bowser_ward.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, who has faced the wrath of Bowser countless times, offers this relic to those brave enough to confront the Koopa King’s fury.
valley_bowser_bowser_ward.shippingDetail: The shield is shipped via Pipe Express, known for its reliable delivery even in the most treacherous terrain.

usage.duration: 3 seconds of damage absorption, followed by an instantaneous explosion
usage.endsWhen: After the explosion or when the user takes a Dexterity saving throw against a DC of 15 to avoid the fiery blast
usage.charges: One per short or long rest

valley_bowser_bowser_ward.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and imbued with potent magical properties, the Bowser’s Wrath Ward offers a unique balance between defensive and offensive capabilities.

valley_bowser_burn_bottle.name: Burn Bottle of the Ember King
valley_bowser_burn_bottle.description: The Burn Bottle of the Ember King is a volatile, crimson liquid sealed in an ornate glass flask. Crafted from the heart of Mount Bowser's fiery forge, it ignites upon impact, releasing a searing inferno that incinerates enemies within its radius. The lingering burn effect ensures even those who escape face ongoing damage. Ideal for crowd control or area denial, this bottle is a favored weapon among Ember King’s fiercest warriors.
effects: Leaves a lingering burn effect for 3 seconds

effectDetails.title: Explosive Impact
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the Burn Bottle releases a 3-meter-radius fireball dealing 2d6 + Level fire damage to all creatures within. This effect has a range of 15 feet and can be used once every short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Lingering Burn
effectDetails.rules: Creatures in the area of the fireball must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take an additional 2d6 fire damage at the start of their turn for the next three turns. This effect does not stack with other burn effects.

valley_bowser_burn_bottle.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from the heart of Mount Bowser, this bottle demands a minimum level to wield its fiery power.
valley_bowser_burn_bottle.vendorReason: As an armorer for the Ember King's elite forces, Valley Bowser regularly supplies his troops with the Burn Bottle.
valley_bowser_burn_bottle.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the Burn Bottle is shipped via specialized containers and requires a signed receipt.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Expended after use or destroyed if not used within one day of opening

valley_bowser_burn_bottle.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item offers a potent area-effect weapon that fits within the expected cost for such power.

valley_bowser_burned_mace.name: Burned Mace of the Infernal King
valley_bowser_burned_mace.description: The Burned Mace of the Infernal King, forged from Bowser's own defeated magma fists, radiates an infernal heat that sears and ignites foes. Each strike not only deals extra fire damage but also leaves enemies vulnerable to follow-up attacks for a fleeting moment. Crafted in the depths of the volcanic realm where even molten iron cools, this mace is no mere weapon—its very essence incinerates all it touches.

effectDetails.title: Fire Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: When the Burned Mace strikes, it deals an additional +40% fire damage to foes. This effect is a reaction triggered on contact with an enemy.

effectDetails.title: Ignites Enemies
effectDetails.rules: Enemies struck by this mace catch ablaze for 1d6 fire damage at the start of their next turn, unless they succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. The burning persists for up to three rounds.

valley_bowser_burned_mace.levelRequirementReason: The weapon's infernal heat and resilience require a proficient wielder with experience in combat.
valley_bowser_burned_mace.vendorReason: Bowser himself, in his defeated state, granted this relic to the Valley of Bowser as a symbol of his enduring legacy.
valley_bowser_burned_mace.shippingDetail: The mace is couriered via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring it arrives at its destination with minimal delay and in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; igniting effect lasts up to three rounds
usage.endsWhen: The ignited status ends when the enemy successfully saves or is destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

valley_bowser_burned_mace.priceReason: Crafted from volcanic materials and imbued with infernal energy, this mace represents a significant investment in both material and magical resources.

valley_bowser_burnt_blood_pearl.name: Burnt Blood Pearl
valley_bowser_burnt_blood_pearl.description: The Burnt Blood Pearl is a crimson gem forged from the essence of a fallen Koopa general, now embedded with volcanic heat. Its pulse can be felt by those who wield it in the heart of Mount Bowser’s fiery core. This gem enhances melee attacks with searing flames, and when used within lava zones, it restores health while dealing extra damage to enemies. Perfect for warriors who dare to fight in the inferno’s embrace.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Melee Attack
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack, deal an additional +10 damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Health Restoration in Lava
effectDetails.rules: When used within lava zones, restore 25 hit points to you and deal an extra 15 fire damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius. This effect ends when you leave the lava zone or if you take any other action.

valley_bowser_burnt_blood_pearl.levelRequirementReason: Requires lower level to balance its high-damage potential in specific environments.
valley_bowser_burnt_blood_pearl.vendorReason: Bowser’s minions are familiar with the forge of Mount Bowser, and this gem is a symbol of their fiery heritage.
valley_bowser_burnt_blood_pearl.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via Lakitu Drones' express lava-resistant transport.

usage.activation: As a bonus action when in a lava zone or during a melee attack.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, ends on the next turn or upon leaving lava.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the lava zone or taking another action.

valley_bowser_burnt_blood_pearl.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare item that enhances melee attacks and restores health in specific conditions.

valley_bowser_burnt_heart.name: Burnt Heart Pendant
valley_bowser_burnt_heart.description: The Burnt Heart Pendant, crafted from obsidian and embers of the Fire Lord's wrath, hums with volcanic energy. This relic, worn by those who have faced the molten heart of the Fire Nation, channels fiery fury into each strike, igniting foes with a 5% chance on every hit. It grants resilience in lava zones, bolstering health by 10%, but its power is tempered to prevent it from being wielded by less than seasoned heroes.

effectDetails.title: Incendiary Strike
effectDetails.rules: On each melee attack, there is a 5% chance that the target ignites. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges.

effectDetails.title: Volcanic Resilience
effectDetails.rules: While in lava zones, the wearer gains a +10 bonus to their maximum hit points for the duration of one short rest or until they leave the zone. This effect recharges after 24 hours.

valley_bowser_burnt_heart.levelRequirementReason: Only seasoned warriors with a proven track record against the Fire Nation can harness this relic's power.
valley_bowser_burnt_heart.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, having seen firsthand the bravery of those who have faced the Fire Lord, offers this pendant to honor their valor and aid in their next great battle.
valley_bowser_burnt_heart.shippingDetail: Ships via Void Drifter Relay; expedited delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect during combat, no activation required.
usage.duration: Instantaneous on attack rolls and lasts until the wearer leaves lava zones or takes damage.
usage.endsWhen: Expends after one short rest in lava zones; recharges after 24 hours.

valley_bowser_burnt_heart.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's rarity and the specific, non-gamebreaking benefits it provides.

valley_bowser_burnt_heart_essence.name: Burnt Heart Essence
valley_bowser_burnt_heart_essence.description: A vial sealed with the smoldering remains of Bowser’s heart, this essence is forged from the very flames that once drove the King Koopa's fiery rage. When consumed, it grants temporary invulnerability to all forms of damage and allows a fallen ally to be revived for a single turn if their hit points are below 20%. The vial also briefly weakens the fire resistance of nearby enemies by 20% for two turns, making them more susceptible to Bowser’s signature flames.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: The consumer gains temporary invulnerability to all damage for 5 turns. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Revive Ally
effectDetails.rules: If an ally within range has hit points below 20%, they can be revived at the start of their next turn. The revive effect only occurs once per vial, even if multiple allies are eligible.

valley_bowser_burnt_heart_essence.levelRequirementReason: Even the lowest-level heroes can access this potent essence in case of dire need.
valley_bowser_burnt_heart_essence.vendorReason: As a remnant of the kingdom’s darkest days, Valley Bowser is the only one to offer such a relic.
valley_bowser_burnt_heart_essence.shippingDetail: The essence must be shipped by Void Drifter Relay due to its volatile nature and the need for immediate delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the start of the next turn.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after 5 turns or when consumed by a creature.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be used per vial.

valley_bowser_burnt_heart_essence.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant boon without being overpowered for its price in XP.

valley_bowser_burnt_soul.name: Burnt Soul Pendant
valley_bowser_burnt_soul.description: The Burnt Soul Pendant, crafted from the molten heart of a guardian of Mount Infernus, offers fiery resilience and a morale boost under pressure. Its core glows with an inner fire that crackles whenever flames near. This relic enhances team morale during fire-based events by +20% and reduces fire damage taken by 30%. It also grants a fleeting surge of critical prowess for heroes who cast fire spells, enhancing their chances by +40% for 5 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: The pendant reduces fire damage taken by 30%. This effect is active as long as the wearer remains within a burning environment. The effect ends when the wearer leaves the fire or if they take an action.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost and Critical Surge
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer casts a fire spell, their team's morale increases by 20% for the duration of the encounter. Additionally, the user gains a +40% bonus to critical hit chance for 5 seconds after casting.

valley_bowser_burnt_soul.levelRequirementReason: The pendant is designed for all adventurers who venture into fiery environments.
valley_bowser_burnt_soul.vendorReason: Bowser, the master of lava and fire, ensures that his loyal subjects have the best gear to combat infernal threats.
valley_bowser_burnt_soul.shippingDetail: The pendant is delivered via a Rakasha spirit courier who can teleport it directly into your hands from their realm.

usage.activation: Passive and automatic during fire events.
usage.duration: Active while the wearer is in a burning environment or when using fire spells.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer leaves the fire or after casting a fire spell.

valley_bowser_burnt_soul.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant advantage in fire-based encounters without being overpowered.

valley_bowser_burnt_soul_ammunition.name: Burnt Soul Ammunition
valley_bowser_burnt_soul_ammunition.description: Forged from the ashes of forgotten heroes, Burnt Soul Ammunition is a relic that channels their untold fury into each shot. These bullets are said to have been blessed by the spirits of fallen warriors, and when they strike an enemy, they explode with devastating force, dealing massive fire damage and igniting the battlefield around them. Only those who can harness the raw power of death themselves should wield this ammunition.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Impact
effectDetails.rules: When this ammunition strikes a target, it explodes causing 2d8 + 3d6 fire damage. This effect has a range of 15 feet and lasts until the end of the encounter.

effectDetails.title: Ignite the Battlefield
effectDetails.rules: For every successful hit with Burnt Soul Ammunition, an area of effect 20 feet in radius centered on the target becomes engulfed in flames. This fire aura lasts for 1 minute and can be suppressed by a DC 15 Constitution save.

valley_bowser_burnt_soul_ammunition.levelRequirementReason: This ammunition requires a proficient user to control its destructive force.
valley_bowser_burnt_soul_ammunition.vendorReason: Bowser has a collection of rare and ancient weapons, making Burnt Soul Ammunition an expected addition to his arsenal.
valley_bowser_burnt_soul_ammunition.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, this item is shipped with special care using Koopa Postal's reinforced crates. Delivery time may slightly increase due to safety protocols.

usage.duration: Until end of the encounter or until consumed by fire
usage.endsWhen: The ammunition is expended in a blast, leaving no residue
usage.charges: Unlimited; each shot expends one charge

valley_bowser_burnt_soul_ammunition.priceReason: Balanced at this price point to reflect its rarity and the raw power it channels.

valley_bowser_burnt_soul_core.name: Burnt Soul Core of the Ashen Titan
valley_bowser_burnt_soul_core.description: The Burnt Soul Core of the Ashen Titan is a charred relic forged from the molten heart of a fallen volcanic titan, its surface etched with ancient sigils of fire and ash. When activated, it channels the fury of the inferno, dealing scalding flames to all enemies in its path while also sapping their vitality, slowing them by 20% for 10 seconds after each use. A testament to the titan's fiery wrath, this core is a symbol of volcanic power and destruction.

effectDetails.title: Inferno Flare
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Deals fire damage equal to 1d6 + Charisma modifier to all creatures in a 5-foot cone, centered on the wielder. The duration is instantaneous and has no save DC.

effectDetails.title: Vitality Drain
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. After dealing fire damage with Inferno Flare, targets within the area are slowed by 20% for 10 seconds. This effect does not have a save DC and can be triggered once per long rest.

valley_bowser_burnt_soul_core.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Strength or Charisma to wield this volatile relic effectively.
valley_bowser_burnt_soul_core.vendorReason: Bowser, the Lord of the Underground, has a deep connection with volcanic titans and thus offers this powerful core to his patrons.
valley_bowser_burnt_soul_core.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral mail, ensuring swift delivery even through treacherous terrain.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Inferno Flare; can be used once per long rest for Vitality Drain.
usage.duration: Instantaneous with Inferno Flare; lasts 10 seconds with Vitality Drain.
usage.endsWhen: Expires after its duration ends or when the core is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a short rest.

valley_bowser_burnt_soul_core.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP due to its potent fire damage and slow effect, making it a valuable asset in combat.

valley_bowser_burnt_sword_core.name: Burnt Sword Core
valley_bowser_burnt_sword_core.description: The Burnt Sword Core, a relic forged from the molten heart of a fallen lava dragon, glows with an infernal crimson light that seems to sear through the air when drawn. Its blade, now brittle and blackened, still channels raw volcanic fury, shattering armor and leaving a trail of fiery destruction in its wake. This core is not merely a weapon; it's a living ember capable of reducing even the most resilient foes' defenses by 20% for moments that feel like an eternity.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Burnt Sword Core reduces the target's fire resistance by 20% for 5 seconds. This effect has a cooldown of 1 minute and requires an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Critical Hit Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +10% bonus to critical hit chance when wielding this core, lasting until the end of their next turn. There is no limit to how many times this effect can be used in a day.

valley_bowser_burnt_sword_core.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires significant mastery and understanding of fire magic to wield effectively.
valley_bowser_burnt_sword_core.vendorReason: Bowser, the King of the Lava Dragons, would naturally have access to such a powerful core from his fallen kin.
valley_bowser_burnt_sword_core.shippingDetail: This item is delivered via special spectral mail, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition and with all its fiery power intact.

usage.duration: 5 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends at the end of the wielder's next turn or when the core is sheathed again.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to regain any expended action activations.

valley_bowser_burnt_sword_core.priceReason: This item’s price reflects its rarity and the significant risk involved in acquiring such a dangerous relic from volcanic depths.

valley_bowser_crimson_ward.name: Crimson Ward Cloak
valley_bowser_crimson_ward.description: The Crimson Ward Cloak, a ceremonial garment forged from the ashes of the fallen Crimson Fleet, radiates an unholy crimson glow. Its fabric is said to have been woven under the gaze of ancient sea gods, imbuing it with protective magic that repels supernatural threats and undead foes alike. Worn in battle, this cloak not only grants its wearer a +30% resistance to all magical attacks but also blocks one summoning per combat, ensuring that no creature summoned by an enemy will materialize near you.

effectDetails.title: Magical Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +30% bonus to their saving throws against all magical effects. This effect is active while the cloak is worn.

effectDetails.title: Summoning Blockade
effectDetails.rules: Once per battle, the wearer can intercede and prevent one creature summoned by an enemy from entering play or remaining in the battlefield. The effect is triggered as a reaction to the summoning spell.

valley_bowser_crimson_ward.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's ancient magic requires no minimum level for activation, but its wearer must be proficient with light armor.
valley_bowser_crimson_ward.vendorReason: Valley Bowser deals in artifacts and relics recovered from the depths of the ocean, making this cloak a fitting addition to their inventory.
valley_bowser_crimson_ward.shippingDetail: The cloak is shipped via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its swift delivery through spectral means.

usage.duration: Instantaneous once per battle.
usage.endsWhen: The battle ends or the wearer drops to 0 hit points.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

valley_bowser_crimson_ward.priceReason: The cloak's unique combination of magical resistance and summoning block makes it a valuable asset in combat, justifying its fair price of 1000 XP.

valley_bowser_earth_crystal.name: Earth Crystal of the Subterranean King
valley_bowser_earth_crystal.description: The Earth Crystal of the Subterranean King is a gem forged from ancient volcanic cores, its surface still warm to the touch and etched with patterns of molten earth. This relic grants control over the ground, allowing you to shatter terrain with your commands while summoning seismic shockwaves that ripple through the earth. It hums with elemental power, resonating with any who wield it, granting a temporary resistance to earth-based damage.

effectDetails.title: Earthshattering Command
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can command the crystal to shatter a portion of terrain within 30 feet. The area becomes difficult terrain and all creatures in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

effectDetails.title: Seismic Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can use the crystal to summon a seismic shockwave. This creates an area of effect with a radius of 30 feet centered on you. All creatures in this area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone and take 30 (6d6) earth damage.

valley_bowser_earth_crystal.levelRequirementReason: The crystal's power requires a user with significant experience to control its raw force without causing unintended destruction.
valley_bowser_earth_crystal.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, the king of the underground kingdom, has access to ancient artifacts like this one and ensures they are used responsibly within his realm.
valley_bowser_earth_crystal.shippingDetail: The crystal is delivered through a series of subterranean passages, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition without any risk of damage.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to shatter terrain; once per short rest to summon shockwave)
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: When the effect is used up or interrupted by another action
usage.charges: 2 charges, recharged after a long rest

valley_bowser_earth_crystal.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare and powerful abilities without making it overpowered.

valley_bowser_earth_land_mystic_ink.name: Earth Land Inkwell
valley_bowser_earth_land_mystic_ink.description: This inkwell houses a vial of dimensional ink, said to come from the Flat Earth conspiracy. The ink allows for the inscription of real-world facts onto any surface, making it invaluable for mapmaking and navigation. A single drop grants +1 to Perception checks against reality distortions, enhancing one's ability to discern truth from falsehood in volatile situations. However, using this ink near volcanic zones causes a brief dizziness, as the fiery earth seems to disrupt its mystical properties.

effectDetails.title: Perception Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on use. Grants a bonus of +1 to one Perception check against reality distortions. Ends when the check is made or after 1 minute, whichever comes first.

effectDetails.title: Fact Inscription
effectDetails.rules: Activates by pouring ink onto any surface. The inscription lasts until removed or overwritten. No saving throw is needed to resist this effect, and it has no charges; the inkwell refills after a short rest.

valley_bowser_earth_land_mystic_ink.levelRequirementReason: Adept scribes and explorers can benefit from the ink's properties without needing high-level expertise.
valley_bowser_earth_land_mystic_ink.vendorReason: Bowser's minions frequently use this ink for their espionage missions, making it a key item in their arsenal.
valley_bowser_earth_land_mystic_ink.shippingDetail: Ships via the underground tunnels of the Mushroom Kingdom; delivery may take an extra day due to security checks.

usage.activation: Activates on use or when poured onto a surface.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Perception checks, lasts until removed or overwritten for inscriptions.
usage.endsWhen: Check is made or after 1 minute, whichever comes first; no charges apply, refills with a short rest.

valley_bowser_earth_land_mystic_ink.priceReason: The ink's rarity and unique properties justify its high price.

valley_bowser_earthquake_glove.name: Earthquake Glove
valley_bowser_earthquake_glove.description: The Earthquake Glove, a pair of leather gloves reinforced with volcanic stone and enchanted with Bowser's earthshaking fury, amplifies your strikes to cause tremors that ripple through the ground. Each blow sends shockwaves outward, dealing area damage and destabilizing the terrain beneath foes. The power within these gloves is as ancient as the Mushroom Kingdom itself, passed down from a lineage of warriors who faced Bowser's wrath in the fiery pits of his kingdom.

effectDetails.title: Seismic Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with a melee attack, there is a tremor that deals 2d6 + Strength modifier force damage to all creatures within 5 feet. This effect lasts for 3 rounds and can be triggered once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Ground Instability
effectDetails.rules: Enemies in the area of a Seismic Strike must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 1d6 force damage on failure. On a successful save, they are not affected by the tremor for the next 24 hours.

valley_bowser_earthquake_glove.levelRequirementReason: The Earthquake Glove requires a minimum level of 3 to harness its raw power effectively.
valley_bowser_earthquake_glove.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, being a trusted blacksmith for the Mushroom Kingdom's elite, offers this rare and powerful piece of equipment.
valley_bowser_earthquake_glove.shippingDetail: The gloves are delivered via spirit courier, ensuring they arrive undisturbed by any environmental hazards.

usage.duration: 3 rounds after each Seismic Strike.
usage.endsWhen: After the duration ends or if the glove is removed from your hand.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to recover.

valley_bowser_earthquake_glove.priceReason: The Earthquake Glove's balanced price reflects its powerful effects and rarity within the kingdom.

valley_bowser_earthshaker_ring.name: Earthshaker Ring of the Volcano King
valley_bowser_earthshaker_ring.description: The Earthshaker Ring of the Volcano King is a molten-gold circlet, its surface etched with dormant volcanoes and fiery runes that glow faintly when in volcanic regions. When you wield it, each strike against stone or earth sends ripples through the ground, causing tremors that push back foes within 10 feet. The ring amplifies your strength on rocky terrain, granting you a nimbleness to navigate treacherous paths with ease.

effectDetails.title: Ground Tremor on Hit
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with a melee attack while in volcanic terrain, the Earthshaker Ring amplifies your strike. The ground trembles, pushing back all creatures within a 10-foot radius away from the point of impact. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Volcanic Terrain Movement Bonus
effectDetails.rules: On volcanic terrain, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and movement speed by 10 feet. This effect is passive while in volcanic regions but diminishes when leaving such areas.

valley_bowser_earthshaker_ring.levelRequirementReason: This ring requires a minimum level of 5 to wield effectively, as its power amplifies with greater physical prowess.
valley_bowser_earthshaker_ring.vendorReason: Bowser's domain spans volcanic plateaus where the ring finds frequent use among his warriors and adventurers.
valley_bowser_earthshaker_ring.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Lakitu, ensuring even remote regions receive the ring within a few hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect when in volcanic terrain; ground tremor on melee hit.
usage.duration: Instantaneous ground tremor; passive movement bonus while in volcanic region.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends upon leaving volcanic terrain or after one use per rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharges with a short or long rest.

valley_bowser_earthshaker_ring.priceReason: The ring's rarity and unique properties justify its price, offering significant battlefield advantages to those who venture into volcanic regions.

valley_bowser_ember_aura.name: Ember Aura Ring
valley_bowser_ember_aura.description: The Ember Aura Ring glows with a steady, ominous red light that seems to draw heat from the very air around it. In volcanic terrains and near lava flows, this ring grants its wearer unmatched agility and resilience, allowing them to move swiftly across molten ground while defending against the scorching environment. The ring's core is said to have been forged in the heart of an ancient volcano, imbuing it with the essence of fire itself.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mobility
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer gains a +15% bonus to movement speed in lava terrain and near heat sources, up to a maximum of 30 feet per round.

effectDetails.title: Scorched Defense
effectDetails.rules: The ring automatically activates an auto-heat shield upon contact with enemies within 5 feet. The shield reduces damage taken by half for 1 minute or until the wearer is no longer in a high-temperature zone, whichever comes first.

valley_bowser_ember_aura.levelRequirementReason: The Ember Aura Ring's power requires a certain mastery of fire-based tactics and control.
valley_bowser_ember_aura.vendorReason: King Bowser has a collection of items forged in the heart of his volcanic kingdom, making this ring a natural addition to his inventory.
valley_bowser_ember_aura.shippingDetail: Delivered via Mushroom Express with special packaging to protect against heat damage during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Enhanced Mobility; automatically activates Scorched Defense on contact.
usage.duration: Enhanced Mobility: Instantaneous, lasts for the duration of being in a high-temperature zone; Scorched Defense: 1 minute or until no longer in a high-temperature zone.
usage.endsWhen: Leaves the high-temperature zone or upon enemy contact ends.

valley_bowser_ember_aura.priceReason: The Ember Aura Ring's rarity and unique abilities justify its price, providing players with a versatile tool for volcanic terrains.

valley_bowser_ember_shroud.name: Ember Shroud Cloak
valley_bowser_ember_shroud.description: The Ember Shroud Cloak is a lava-demon crafted garment that absorbs and redirects fire-based attacks. Woven from volcanic fibers, it glows faintly in smoky ruins, making its wearer nearly invisible to both heat-seeking eyes and infrared sensors. The cloak's molten weave grants the wearer increased speed when navigating through fiery zones, and it provides an additional layer of protection by reflecting 50% of incoming fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Reflects Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer reflects 50% of all fire-based damage dealt to them. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Speed in Fire Zones
effectDetails.rules: While within a zone of intense heat, the wearer gains a +10 bonus to their movement speed. This effect lasts for 1 minute per level, and it ends when the wearer leaves the fire zone or is incapacitated.

valley_bowser_ember_shroud.levelRequirementReason: This cloak's intricate weave requires advanced knowledge of volcanic magic.
valley_bowser_ember_shroud.vendorReason: Bowser has a long-standing partnership with lava demons, ensuring the cloaks are authentic and powerful.
valley_bowser_ember_shroud.shippingDetail: The cloak is delivered via Lakitu's express service, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute per level or until the wearer leaves a fire zone or becomes incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: Leaving a fire zone or becoming incapacitated

valley_bowser_ember_shroud.priceReason: The cloak's material and craftsmanship justify its price, offering significant advantages in volcanic environments.

valley_bowser_ember_soul_cape.name: Ember Soul Cape
valley_bowser_ember_soul_cape.description: The Ember Soul Cape is woven from the last breath of a primordial wyrm, its fabric shimmering with embers. This ancient cape grants +2 to all melee attacks and absorbs fire damage, but it becomes unusable in ice terrain and only works against enemies of non-fire element affinity. When worn during Koopa Navy raids, there's a 10% chance that a wyrm spirit will be summoned to aid the wearer for one round.

effectDetails.title: Melee Attack Bonus
effectDetails.rules: The Ember Soul Cape grants +2 to all melee attack rolls. This effect is active as long as the wearer is in combat and does not require any special action.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the cape absorbs 1d4 fire damage per turn for three turns. It has no effect on creatures with a fire affinity or those immune to fire damage. This ability ends if the wearer moves into ice terrain.

valley_bowser_ember_soul_cape.levelRequirementReason: The Ember Soul Cape's ancient magic is too potent for lower-level adventurers; it requires at least level 7 to wield its full power.
valley_bowser_ember_soul_cape.vendorReason: Bowser, as a master of fire and lava, has the knowledge and resources to craft such an artifact.
valley_bowser_ember_soul_cape.shippingDetail: The delivery is handled through the Kremling Smuggle Run, with a possible one-week delay due to smuggling risks.

usage.duration: 3 turns or until wearer moves into ice terrain.
usage.endsWhen: Wearer moves into ice terrain or the wearer ceases combat.

valley_bowser_ember_soul_cape.priceReason: The Ember Soul Cape's rarity and specific utility make it a fair price for an epic item.

valley_bowser_ember_talisman.name: Ember Talisman of the Inferno King
valley_bowser_ember_talisman.description: The Ember Talisman of the Inferno King is a relic forged from Bowser's final breaths of rage. This talisman whispers of doom and danger, radiating heat that warms the hands of its bearer. When activated, it summons a searing lava burst capable of incinerating foes within an 8-foot radius for 50 fire damage and sets them ablaze for two turns. Additionally, it grants +10% movement speed in fiery terrain, allowing swift maneuvering through lava fields with ease.

effectDetails.title: Lava Burst
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action within a fiery environment, this talisman summons a 6-foot radius of searing flames that deal 50 fire damage and ignite targets for two turns. The effect ends if the user moves more than 10 feet from its point of origin.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: +10% movement speed in areas affected by fire. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn or when you leave a fiery terrain.

valley_bowser_ember_talisman.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to effectively utilize the talisman's flame-based abilities.
valley_bowser_ember_talisman.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, guardian of lava and fire, has a personal connection with this relic, making it his domain.
valley_bowser_ember_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships via Lakitu's express courier service, ensuring timely delivery to the nearest lava field or fiery terrain.

usage.activation: Bonus action within a fire-affected area.
usage.duration: Instantaneous summoning; effect lasts until end of next turn or when moving more than 10 feet from origin.
usage.endsWhen: Moving more than 10 feet away from the summon point or leaving fiery terrain.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharges after a long rest.

valley_bowser_ember_talisman.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the talisman's unique fire-based abilities and its rarity as a relic of Bowser’s inferno.

valley_bowser_embers_bottle.name: Embers Bottle of the Volcanic Storm
valley_bowser_embers_bottle.description: The Embers Bottle of the Volcanic Storm is a small, glass bottle containing molten lava essence. When thrown, it erupts into an inferno that incinerates all nearby foes in its searing heat. The bottle’s fiery contents leave behind a lingering burn upon impact, ensuring enemies are scorched long after the initial blast. Crafted by the volcanic spirits of Mount Pyrothorn, this relic is ideal for clearing dense crowds or breaching lava-choked pathways.

effectDetails.title: Searing Inferno
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the bottle unleashes a cone of fire that deals 150% damage to all enemies within a 5-meter radius. The explosion has a 30-second duration, during which it ignites targets for an additional 2d6 fire damage every second.

effectDetails.title: Persistent Burn
effectDetails.rules: Enemies struck by the bottle are inflicted with a burn debuff that lasts until the end of their next turn. The burn deals 30% fire damage at the start of each of their turns for up to three rounds.

valley_bowser_embers_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for novices, allowing them to harness volcanic power without advanced training.
valley_bowser_embers_bottle.vendorReason: Bowser has a long-standing rivalry with the volcanic spirits and often acquires unique items from their domain.
valley_bowser_embers_bottle.shippingDetail: Delivered by Rakasha messengers who must navigate treacherous lava flows, ensuring the bottle arrives undamaged.

usage.activation: Throws the bottle as a bonus action
usage.duration: Instantaneous explosion with ongoing effects
usage.endsWhen: The burn effect ends when it has run its course

valley_bowser_embers_bottle.priceReason: Crafted from rare volcanic materials and imbued with ancient spirits' power, the Embers Bottle remains a valuable but not exorbitant purchase.

valley_bowser_embers_of_bowser.name: Embers of Bowser
valley_bowser_embers_of_bowser.description: The Embers of Bowser are a volcanic shard that glows with an infernal light, forged from the molten heart of Bowser’s fiery lair. This relic grants Koopa warriors resilience against fire-based attacks and inflicts explosive damage upon critical hits. Its power is drawn directly from the very core of the kingdom’s most feared tyrant, making it a potent weapon for those who dare to face his wrath in combat.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder is hit by a fire-based attack, they gain +20% resistance to that damage. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Critical Hits
effectDetails.rules: Upon landing a critical hit with any melee weapon, the user deals an additional 3d6 fire damage and ignites the target for 1 minute, requiring a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to end the effect.

valley_bowser_embers_of_bowser.levelRequirementReason: This relic is forged from Bowser’s molten heart, making it too powerful for less experienced warriors.
valley_bowser_embers_of_bowser.vendorReason: Valley Bowser has exclusive access to the lair of the Koopa King, allowing them to offer such rare and potent items.
valley_bowser_embers_of_bowser.shippingDetail: Due to the volatile nature of these embers, Shy Guy Smugglers recommend using their special fire-resistant packaging for safe delivery.

usage.activation: Passive effect; gains +20% fire resistance and deals additional explosive damage on critical hits with melee weapons.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the end of the wielder’s next turn or when they are no longer hit by a fire-based attack.

valley_bowser_embers_of_bowser.priceReason: This relic is crafted from Bowser’s own molten heart, making it an extremely rare and powerful item in the market.

valley_bowser_embershield.name: Ember Shield of the Crimson Flame
valley_bowser_embershield.description: The Ember Shield of the Crimson Flame is a molten shield forged from Bowser’s volcanic fury, its surface crackling with fiery embers that leap and dance like living flames. This formidable shield grants fire resistance to its wielder and emits a radiant heat aura that scorches enemy armor within reach, leaving a trail of searing embers in its wake. Only those attuned to the furnace can harness this weapon’s molten might.
effects: Radiant Heat Aura: Deals 5% fire damage to enemies within 3m

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Grants +30% fire resistance to the wielder. This effect is active as long as the shield is in use.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Heat Aura
effectDetails.rules: Deals 5% fire damage per round to all creatures within a 3m radius of the user, requiring a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw for half damage. This effect persists as long as the shield is active.

valley_bowser_embershield.levelRequirementReason: The intense heat and molten core require a higher level to wield safely.
valley_bowser_embershield.vendorReason: Valley Bowser specializes in items forged from volcanic materials, making this shield a staple of their inventory.
valley_bowser_embershield.shippingDetail: Ships via Boo Spectral Mail, known for its speed and reliability.

usage.activation: Activates on command as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Duration is 1 minute per long rest; ends if the shield is destroyed or discarded.
usage.endsWhen: The shield’s active effects end after one long rest, are destroyed, or when discarded by the user.

valley_bowser_embershield.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare forging and unique properties.

valley_bowser_embershroud_tunic.name: Embershroud Tunic
valley_bowser_embershroud_tunic.description: The Embershroud Tunic is crafted from the molten bones of ancient lava dragons, imbuing its wearer with a protective barrier of searing heat. This fiery garment not only grants resistance to lava damage but also enhances one's agility within volcanic zones by increasing movement speed by 15%. Wielders of this tunic find themselves immune to the magma creature's fiery gaze and can command molten streams as an ally.

effectDetails.title: Molten Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to fire and lava damage. This effect does not stack with other forms of resistance but applies uniquely against molten sources.

effectDetails.title: Volcanic Agility
effectDetails.rules: While in lava zones, the wearer's movement speed increases by 15%. This effect is limited to 2 hours per day and requires a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw each time one enters a lava zone.

valley_bowser_embershroud_tunic.levelRequirementReason: The intricate crafting of this tunic demands a proficient blacksmith or alchemist with at least three levels.
valley_bowser_embershroud_tunic.vendorReason: Bowser's Valley is known for its volcanic regions, and the tunic's unique properties are well-suited to the fiery terrain.
valley_bowser_embershroud_tunic.shippingDetail: Due to the fragility of the tunic during transit, it must be shipped via Lakitu Drones within a specially insulated package.

usage.duration: 24 hours with a successful Constitution saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon removal or when the wearer leaves a lava zone, whichever comes first.

valley_bowser_embershroud_tunic.priceReason: Crafted from rare dragon bones and requiring expert crafting skills, this tunic is priced fairly for its unique properties.

valley_bowser_emerald_ash_pouch.name: Emerald Ash Pouch of the Volcanic Vault
valley_bowser_emerald_ash_pouch.description: The Emerald Ash Pouch of the Volcanic Vault is a resilient leather pouch filled with crystallized volcanic ash from the heart of Mount Inferno. When shaken, it hums with ancient power, protecting its bearer against the searing heat and molten lava that lurk in the fiery depths. This relic grants temporary immunity to burning damage for 30 seconds upon activation, and continuously regenerates 15% hit points per round while within lava. The pouch's ash is said to have been forged by the volcanic spirits themselves, enhancing resilience against extreme temperatures.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Immunity to Burning
effectDetails.rules: When shaken, the pouch grants temporary immunity to burning damage for 30 seconds. This effect ends if the wearer moves out of a source of fire or takes any other form of damage.

effectDetails.title: Continuous Regeneration in Lava
effectDetails.rules: While within lava, the wearer regenerates 15 hit points per round as long as they remain submerged. This effect is automatically triggered upon entering lava and ends when the wearer exits or takes any form of damage.

valley_bowser_emerald_ash_pouch.levelRequirementReason: This relic is designed for adventurers who may frequently encounter volcanic environments, requiring no specific class or background.
valley_bowser_emerald_ash_pouch.vendorReason: Bowser, the king of lava and magma, ensures that his subjects have all they need to survive in his fiery kingdom.
valley_bowser_emerald_ash_pouch.shippingDetail: The pouch is carefully packed with volcanic wool to cushion its journey from the depths of Mount Inferno to any eager adventurer.

usage.activation: Shake the pouch to activate its effects.
usage.duration: Temporary Immunity lasts for 30 seconds; Regeneration continues while in lava.
usage.endsWhen: Either effect ends when the wearer exits lava or takes damage.

valley_bowser_emerald_ash_pouch.priceReason: The price reflects both the rare materials and the ancient crafting techniques required to produce this volcanic artifact.

valley_bowser_flame_amber.name: Flame Amber of the Infernal Vault
valley_bowser_flame_amber.description: The Flame Amber of the Infernal Vault glows with a fiery radiance that seems to burn from within, its molten core pulsing in time with your heartbeat. When invoked, it grants you a surge of speed, allowing you to leap over lava without burning, and reveals enemy weaknesses hidden beneath the molten surface. This ancient crystal's power is said to have been forged deep in the infernal vaults where only the bravest souls dare venture.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Movement
effectDetails.rules: When activated, you gain a +20% increase to your walking or running speed. This effect lasts for 10 seconds and ends when you move into an area of lava or take damage from a creature.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Weaknesses
effectDetails.rules: By concentrating on the crystal, you can reveal hidden weaknesses in enemies within 30 feet that are standing in lava. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and has no cooldown between uses.

valley_bowser_flame_amber.levelRequirementReason: The Flame Amber's raw power requires little to no special training to use effectively.
valley_bowser_flame_amber.vendorReason: Bowser's minions often trade in exotic items from the depths of their infernal lairs, and the Flame Amber is a rare find they occasionally offer.
valley_bowser_flame_amber.shippingDetail: The Rakasha spirit that delivers this item can only travel at night, ensuring its safe arrival without detection by enemies.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until you leave lava
usage.endsWhen: You take damage from a creature or enter an area of lava

valley_bowser_flame_amber.priceReason: The Flame Amber's rarity, forged in infernal forges, and its unique abilities make it valuable but not overpriced.

valley_bowser_flame_binder.name: Flame Binder
valley_bowser_flame_binder.description: The Flame Binder is a volcanic stone bound with lava-enchanted threads that channels searing heat into devastating melee strikes. Crafted by Valley Bowser's blacksmiths from molten rock, it grants the wielder resilience to fire-based attacks and enhances their melee prowess in scorching environments. This relic is perfect for charging into Bowser’s molten trenches or any fiery battlefield, where its lava-enchanted threads amplify your strikes with a 20% increase in damage.

effectDetails.title: Heat Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Activation: On each melee attack, this item increases the damage by +20%. Duration: Instantaneous. Ends When: Upon being destroyed or when the wielder is no longer in a fire-based environment.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains 15 points of resistance to fire-based damage for every hour spent in a fire-based environment. This effect stacks up to three times. Ends When: The user leaves the fire-based environment or upon destruction.

valley_bowser_flame_binder.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 3 to wield effectively, given its inherent fire resistance and enhanced melee capabilities.
valley_bowser_flame_binder.vendorReason: Valley Bowser's blacksmiths are renowned for crafting items that withstand and harness the extreme heat of their volcanic domain.
valley_bowser_flame_binder.shippingDetail: Delivery via the Void Drifter takes a week, ensuring the Flame Binder arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon equipping; no need for activation action.
usage.duration: Permanent while equipped and within a fire-based environment.
usage.endsWhen: Upon destruction or leaving the fire-based environment.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharges when left in a non-fire-based area.

valley_bowser_flame_binder.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides significant enhancements to melee combat and resistance without overpowered effects.

valley_bowser_flame_bolt_launcher.name: Flame Bolt Launcher
valley_bowser_flame_bolt_launcher.description: The Flame Bolt Launcher is a volcanic contraption crafted from obsidian and molten rock, its barrel spitting out searing projectiles that ignite on contact. It's an invaluable tool for Bowser's minions, especially when clearing lava pits or dispatching swarms of Koopa Troopas. Each shot not only deals 120 fire damage but also ignites the target, causing a lingering burn for three seconds, ensuring the enemy is thoroughly incinerated.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Flame Shot
effectDetails.rules: When used as an action, the Flame Bolt Launcher fires a searing projectile that deals 120 fire damage to one target. The target also ignites and takes an additional 6d6 fire damage at the start of its next turn for three rounds.

effectDetails.title: Molten Core Recharge
effectDetails.rules: The launcher's molten core recharges after every 30 seconds, allowing for immediate use again. The core can only recharge once per long rest.

valley_bowser_flame_bolt_launcher.levelRequirementReason: This simple yet effective weapon is accessible to even the least experienced of Bowser's minions.
valley_bowser_flame_bolt_launcher.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, being a master of volcanic weaponry, personally oversees this item's production and sale.
valley_bowser_flame_bolt_launcher.shippingDetail: Orders are shipped via Pipe Express, known for their reliability in delivering hot items safely and swiftly through the Mushroom Kingdom.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The shot is expended. The core recharges after 30 seconds or at the start of a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the core must recharge after every 30 seconds.

valley_bowser_flame_bolt_launcher.priceReason: The Flame Bolt Launcher offers significant utility for clearing dangerous environments and defeating enemies, justifying its moderate price in experience points.

valley_bowser_flame_helm.name: Flame Helm of the Inferno King
valley_bowser_flame_helm.description: The Flame Helm of the Inferno King channels the molten fury of the lava-worshipping monarchs, its surface etched with ancient runes that hum with volcanic energy. Worn by front-line Koopa warriors, it grants fire resistance and inflicts searing burns on foes, turning the battlefield into a infernal forge. When under 30% health, the helm's wearer gains +50% attack speed, making them a deadly force in close combat.

effectDetails.title: +20% Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Flame Helm, you gain +20% resistance to fire damage. This effect is always active while the helm is worn.

effectDetails.title: Inflicts 20% Burn Damage on Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy deals melee damage to you within 5 feet and you are under 30% of your maximum hit points, they must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 fire damage.

valley_bowser_flame_helm.levelRequirementReason: This helm requires a level 5 character to wear due to its complex enchantment and the arcane energy it channels.
valley_bowser_flame_helm.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, known for their vast collection of rare and powerful Koopa-themed gear, carries this helm as a testament to the fiery prowess of lava-worshipping monarchs.
valley_bowser_flame_helm.shippingDetail: The Rakasha Spirit Walk ensures swift delivery with minimal chance of misplacement, making it ideal for such valuable items.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Removing the helm or dying

valley_bowser_flame_helm.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its rare enchantments and unique properties, making it a sought-after item among front-line warriors.

valley_bowser_flame_satchel.name: Flame Satchel of the Molten Maw
valley_bowser_flame_satchel.description: The Flame Satchel of the Molten Maw is a fearsome device crafted from volcanic glass and enchanted by the fiery breath of Bowser's minions. When deployed, it unleashes a torrent of molten magma that incinerates any foe in its path, leaving them weakened for several rounds. The satchel not only deals devastating damage but also scorches armor, reducing enemy defenses significantly, making it a formidable tool for skirmishes in the fiery landscapes of the Mushroom Kingdom.

effectDetails.title: Molten Magma Burst
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the satchel releases a burst of magma that deals 120 fire damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius. This effect also applies the Burn condition to targets for 1 turn.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Enemy Defense
effectDetails.rules: For 3 turns after activation, enemies within a 15-foot cone have their AC reduced by 30%. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

valley_bowser_flame_satchel.levelRequirementReason: This satchel is designed for use in intense skirmishes and requires no extensive training.
valley_bowser_flame_satchel.vendorReason: As a trusted supplier of Bowser's minions, Valley Bowser ensures that troops are equipped with the most fearsome tools for their battles.
valley_bowser_flame_satchel.shippingDetail: The satchel is delivered swiftly by Lakitu Drones, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition and ready for use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with a 1-hour cooldown between uses
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target creature moves out of range or is no longer within the burst area.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one use per long rest

valley_bowser_flame_satchel.priceReason: This satchel combines powerful offensive and defensive-disabling effects in a single device, making it a valuable addition to any brave adventurer's arsenal.

valley_bowser_flame_scarf.name: Ashen Ember Scarf
valley_bowser_flame_scarf.description: The Ashen Ember Scarf, woven from lava-scarred koopa hide and molten obsidian thread, channels the raw fury of Bowser’s volcanic wrath. This fiery accessory grants its wearer immunity to fire burns for ten seconds and enhances their flame resistance by twenty percent, allowing them to walk through searing flames unscathed. The scarf hums with heat as it absorbs the scalding essence of the forgeheart core, making the wearer a walking inferno.
effects: Immunity to Fire Burns for 10 Seconds

effectDetails.title: Flame Absorption
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can activate the scarf’s flame absorption property. For ten seconds, they gain immunity to fire burns and their flame resistance increases by +20%. This effect ends when it is used again or after 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Infernal Step
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Ashen Ember Scarf, the user can walk through searing flames as if they were not there. They are immune to fire damage from any source for 10 seconds when in contact with such flames.

valley_bowser_flame_scarf.levelRequirementReason: The scarf’s raw power requires minimal experience and is accessible to even the most novice adventurers.
valley_bowser_flame_scarf.vendorReason: Bowser, ever a collector of rare artifacts, offers this fiery treasure as a reward for those who prove their mettle in his volcanic lair.
valley_bowser_flame_scarf.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring safe and swift delivery through the treacherous interdimensional voids.

usage.duration: 10 seconds or until used again
usage.endsWhen: Reused or after 1 minute of continuous use

valley_bowser_flame_scarf.priceReason: The scarf’s rarity and unique properties make it a valuable addition to any adventurer's arsenal, justifying its fair market value.

valley_bowser_flame_siphon.name: Flame Siphon Gauntlet
valley_bowser_flame_siphon.description: The Flame Siphon Gauntlet forges heat from volcanic lava to enhance your melee prowess, reducing stamina drain by a quarter and boosting damage by thirty percent in its scorching presence. This molten grip leaves a trail of minor burning on foes struck in close combat, making every blow both powerful and punishing. Crafted in the heart of Bowser’s domain, it ships directly from Valley Bowser with spectral couriers ensuring swift delivery through lava-choked paths.
valley_bowser_flame_siphon.shippedBy: Spectral Couriers of the Lava Path

effectDetails.title: Heat Boost
effectDetails.rules: While in lava terrain, this gauntlet increases melee damage by 30%. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Reduction
effectDetails.rules: Reduces the stamina cost of melee attacks by 25%, providing a continuous benefit during prolonged combat engagements. The gauntlet can only reduce one attack’s stamina cost per round, preventing excessive recovery.

valley_bowser_flame_siphon.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficient use of melee weapons to harness the gauntlet's volcanic heat efficiently.
valley_bowser_flame_siphon.vendorReason: As a forge of Bowser himself, Valley Bowser ensures only the strongest and most battle-tested warriors receive this fiery gear.
valley_bowser_flame_siphon.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral couriers who traverse lava-choked paths with unparalleled speed, ensuring swift arrival at your doorstep.

usage.duration: Permanently active while in lava terrain.
usage.endsWhen: Removing the gauntlet or exiting lava terrain ends its effects.

valley_bowser_flame_siphon.priceReason: Crafted from rare volcanic metals and imbued with a unique enchantment, this gauntlet justifies its price in materials and craftsmanship.

valley_bowser_flame_torch.name: Flame Torch of the Volcanic King
valley_bowser_flame_torch.description: The Flame Torch of the Volcanic King is a forged tool that ignites with molten lava, its core a heart of volcanic glass. Crafted by the hands of Bowser's blacksmiths in the infernal depths of the Valley of Bowser, it grants heat resistance and minor fire damage. This torch is essential for traversing the fiery terrain, where its glow can be seen from miles away as it illuminates your path through lava zones with ease.

effectDetails.title: Heat Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Flame Torch provides you with a +2 bonus to saving throws against fire damage. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be reactivated once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can hurl the Flame Torch at a target within 30 feet. It deals 2d6 fire damage to one creature or object. Once used, it must be rekindled by a blacksmith's touch and cannot be reused until fully restored.

valley_bowser_flame_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Flame Torch is designed for adventurers of all levels who need to navigate the fiery landscapes of Bowser’s domain.
valley_bowser_flame_torch.vendorReason: Valley Bowser, being a direct supplier of volcanic goods, ensures that this essential tool is readily available to those venturing into its territory.
valley_bowser_flame_torch.shippingDetail: The Flame Torch must be shipped via Pipe Express for its special delivery through the lava tubes and canals of the Volcanic King’s domain.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until extinguished
usage.endsWhen: Extinguished, rekindled by a blacksmith's touch, or at the end of each short rest

valley_bowser_flame_torch.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rarity and utility for adventurers navigating the Valley of Bowser.

valley_bowser_fury_glove.name: Fury Glove of the Inferno King
valley_bowser_fury_glove.description: The Fury Glove of the Inferno King is a gauntlet forged from lava and volcanic obsidian, its surface etched with fiery runes. This relic channels the fury of the Inferno King himself, delivering devastating melee strikes that not only cause enemies to flinch in pain but also leaves them burning for moments after contact. Ideal for combat within the scorching heart of a volcano or any infernal locale where close quarters are key.

effectDetails.title: Rage-Infused Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or flinch, taking an additional 10 fire damage. This effect lasts for 1 second.

effectDetails.title: Flinch and Burn
effectDetails.rules: For 2 seconds after you hit a target with the gauntlet, it is subjected to a burning effect that deals 5 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw ends this effect early.

valley_bowser_fury_glove.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in melee weapons to wield effectively and channel the infernal fury.
valley_bowser_fury_glove.vendorReason: Bowser, as a master of volcanic realms, personally curates this relic for adventurers seeking to harness infernal power.
valley_bowser_fury_glove.shippingDetail: Due to the volatile nature of the item, it is shipped in specially insulated containers to prevent accidental ignition during transit.

usage.activation: On hit with a melee weapon attack
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for 1 second after each successful hit
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against the effects or the duration expires
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you are wielding the gauntlet

valley_bowser_fury_glove.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its infernal origins and unique abilities without overshadowing other equipment.

valley_bowser_gloom_rod.name: Gloom Rod of the Fallen King
valley_bowser_gloom_rod.description: The Gloom Rod of the Fallen King, forged from the bones of a fallen volcanic guardian, exudes an eerie glow that seeps into the battlefield. When activated during boss fights, it grants its wielder temporary invincibility and causes nearby enemies to stagger, losing their footing for moments that feel like eternity. This relic's power is both ancient and volatile, capable of turning the tide in the most dire of confrontations.

effectDetails.title: Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction to an attack. Grants temporary invincibility for up to one minute, during which the wielder is immune to all damage and status effects from attacks. Ends on its own or if the wielder takes any action other than a non-movement free action.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Stumble
effectDetails.rules: Causes nearby enemies within 10 feet to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On failure, they are knocked prone and have disadvantage on their next attack roll. This effect lasts for two rounds or until the enemy takes damage.

valley_bowser_gloom_rod.levelRequirementReason: The Gloom Rod's ancient power demands a level at least three to channel effectively.
valley_bowser_gloom_rod.vendorReason: Bowser, ever respectful of fallen heroes, occasionally offers relics like the Gloom Rod in exchange for rare treasures found deep within volcanic caverns.
valley_bowser_gloom_rod.shippingDetail: The Shy Guys ensure swift delivery via a convoy of magma-spewing go-karts, which can lead to delays due to unpredictable lava flows.

usage.duration: Up to one minute or until the wielder takes any action other than a non-movement free action
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends on its own, or if the wielder takes any action other than a non-movement free action.

valley_bowser_gloom_rod.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects both the rarity and ancient power of the Gloom Rod.

valley_bowser_gravity_bubble_satchel.name: Gravity Bubble Satchel
valley_bowser_gravity_bubble_satchel.description: The Gravity Bubble Satchel is a compact pack that harnesses the chaotic energy of Bowser's domain.
