effectDetails.rules: The Wayfinder always points towards the nearest planar portal or rift within a 100-mile radius. It does not require any action to function and is always active.

effectDetails.title: Rift Creation
effectDetails.rules: Once per week, the bearer can activate the Wayfinder to create a tiny rift to the Ethereal Plane that lasts for 1 minute. The rift has a 5-foot radius. Any creature within this area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into the Ethereal Plane until the rift closes.

void_drifters_wayfinder.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant magical power and knowledge of the planes to wield it effectively.
void_drifters_wayfinder.vendorReason: The Void Drifters specialize in items that traverse otherworldly realms, making this compass a natural addition to their inventory.
void_drifters_wayfinder.shippingDetail: Special handling required for the sensitive nature of the item. Shipment can take up to three additional days due to the delicate magical properties of the Wayfinder.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a 1-minute duration for the rift creation effect
usage.endsWhen: The rift closes naturally after one minute or when destroyed by an opposing force.

void_drifters_wayfinder.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its rarity and utility, offering a significant but fair advantage to players.

void_drifters_zero_g_stirrer.name: Void Drifters Zero-G Stirrer
void_drifters_zero_g_stirrer.description: The Void Drifters Zero-G Stirrer is a compact, magnetically powered device designed to stir ingredients in zero-gravity environments aboard starships. Crafted from lightweight, corrosion-resistant alloy and adorned with Drifter Techs' signature star insignia, it ensures that even the most delicate snack mix remains perfectly stirred without succumbing to the whims of space's lack of gravity. This versatile tool not only aids in culinary endeavors but also acts as a minor navigation aid, aligning nearby metal utensils for precise alignment and retrieval.
effects: Aligns nearby metal objects for precision

effectDetails.title: Gravity-Defying Stirring
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Zero-G Stirrer allows you to stir ingredients without concern for gravity. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and does not expend charges.

effectDetails.title: Metal Alignment
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when you or another creature within 5 feet attempts to retrieve a metal object from nearby, you can align it with precision using the device. The target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw; on a failure, the object is aligned correctly.

void_drifters_zero_g_stirrer.levelRequirementReason: This tool is designed for ease of use by all travelers aboard starships.
void_drifters_zero_g_stirrer.vendorReason: Void Drifters specializes in tools that enhance the daily lives of spacefarers, ensuring even the most mundane tasks are accomplished with efficiency and flair.
void_drifters_zero_g_stirrer.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Void Drifters shipyard; expedited delivery for urgent orders.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate stirring, reaction to align metal objects
usage.duration: Until start of next turn (stirring), Instantaneous (alignment)
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn or when the reaction is used again

void_drifters_zero_g_stirrer.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the tool's utility for both culinary and navigation tasks without overpricing.

void_energy_siphon.name: Void Energy Siphon (Weapon Mod)
void_energy_siphon.description: The Void Energy Siphon is a weapon mod crafted by the enigmatic Void Engineers, forged from the very fabric of the void itself. Its sleek, darkened metal gleams with an eerie luminescence that shifts between shades of violet and black, pulsing with latent void energy. This mod channels raw void power to deliver devastating blasts capable of tearing through even the strongest defenses, but it also carries a dark risk: prolonged use can corrupt the wielder's soul, drawing them deeper into the void’s endless embrace.

effectDetails.title: Void Damage Dealmaster
effectDetails.rules: The user deals 10d10 points of void damage with each blast. This effect is limited to three uses per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Risk of Void Corruption
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that the wielder will suffer from void corruption after using this mod three times within a single day. The corruption imposes the charmed condition on the user until they complete a short or long rest.

void_energy_siphon.levelRequirementReason: Only those with a deep understanding of the void and its dark magic can wield such power responsibly.
void_energy_siphon.vendorReason: Abyss Tech is known for their expertise in crafting items that harness the raw power of the void, making them the ideal vendor for this mod.
void_energy_siphon.shippingDetail: Due to its unstable nature, the Void Energy Siphon requires special handling and arrives with a cold pack to maintain its integrity during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The mod is removed or destroyed.

void_energy_siphon.priceReason: While not as powerful as a godly rarity item, the Void Energy Siphon's unique and dangerous nature justifies its cost.

void_entities_null_nutrient_nutrient_ext.name: Void Entities Null Nutrient Extractor
void_entities_null_nutrient_nutrient_ext.description: The Void Entities Null Nutrient Extractor is a sleek, dark device that hums with an otherworldly energy. Crafted by the enigmatic Entity Extractors from the Realm of Void Jello, this contraption can extract null essences from void jello, enhancing your cooking prowess in the process. It casts a dim light around you as it operates, making it a perfect companion for chefs venturing into the dark corners of culinary alchemy.

effectDetails.title: Extracts Null Essences
effectDetails.rules: As an action, activate this device to extract a null essence from void jello. This essence can be used in cooking recipes that require a rare ingredient. The effect is instantaneous and requires no save. Once used, the extractor's charge is depleted.

effectDetails.title: Dim Light Aura
effectDetails.rules: While extracting null essences, this device creates a dim light around you, effectively reducing bright lighting to dim in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute. The light does not affect creatures that are immune to darkness effects and has no effect on darkvision.

void_entities_null_nutrient_nutrient_ext.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second-level spellcasting proficiency to properly operate the device.
void_entities_null_nutrient_nutrient_ext.vendorReason: Void Entities Realm is known for its expertise in crafting devices that interact with void jello and its derivatives.
void_entities_null_nutrient_nutrient_ext.shippingDetail: Ships via Null Nutrient Null Express, ensuring the device arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for essence extraction; 1 minute for dim light aura
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted of charges or if not recharged by void jello within a week
usage.charges: Single charge, recharges after being exposed to void jello

void_entities_null_nutrient_nutrient_ext.priceReason: The device is priced at 1000 XP as it requires rare materials and advanced craftsmanship.

void_entities_void_essence_jello_recipe.name: Recipe: Void Entities Void Essence Jello
void_entities_void_essence_jello_recipe.description: This wobbly jello, crafted from ethereal Void Entities' essence, is a dessert that defies both time and space. Bite into it and you'll feel the void's chill as minor teleportation grants you fleeting freedom for 5 feet; each serving also bestows resistance to the arcane powers of the Void. The recipe, jealously guarded by Void Cooks in the realm of Nullspace, is a rare treat that only the most daring adventurers can afford.

effectDetails.title: Minor Teleport
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you may teleport up to 5 feet in any direction. This effect lasts for the duration of one turn and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Arcane
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to all damage from spells and abilities with the arcane descriptor until your next long rest. This effect does not stack with other sources of resistance.

void_entities_void_essence_jello_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have proven their mettle at least seven levels deep can afford the luxury of this dessert, as it is a rare treat from the realm of Nullspace.
void_entities_void_essence_jello_recipe.vendorReason: Void Cooks are the only ones with access to Void Entities' essence and the secrets needed to craft such a delicacy.
void_entities_void_essence_jello_recipe.shippingDetail: The jello is shipped in special, insulated containers to maintain its wobbly texture during transit.

usage.duration: One turn or until your next long rest
usage.endsWhen: After one use per short or long rest; rechargeable after a long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges at dawn of the following day

void_entities_void_essence_jello_recipe.priceReason: The recipe's rarity and the exotic nature of its ingredients make it an expensive treat worth every XP.

void_entities_void_shroud.name: Void Entities Void Shroud
void_entities_void_shroud.description: The Void Entities Void Shroud is a shimmering, onyx-black cloak that warps light around its wearer, casting an ethereal glow. It whispers unsettling secrets to those who come too close, and its fabric subtly distorts reality, making the wearer seem slightly less substantial. Crafted by the enigmatic Void Weavers, this shroud grants advantage on saving throws against detection magic while also hiding minor void anomalies—pocket spaces that open and close with a whisper of cosmic energy.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Saves vs. Detection
effectDetails.rules: When subjected to detection magic, the wearer gains advantage on saving throws. This effect persists for 1 hour upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Minor Voids Hiding
effectDetails.rules: The shroud creates pocket spaces that can hide small objects or creatures for up to 10 minutes before dissipating into a ripple of dark energy. Once per short rest, the wearer may activate this effect by whispering 'Void Hide'.

void_entities_void_shroud.levelRequirementReason: The Void Shroud's arcane complexity and the Void Weavers' crafting magic necessitate at least level 7 to wield it effectively.
void_entities_void_shroud.vendorReason: Void Entities Rift specializes in items crafted by the enigmatic Void Weavers, making this shroud a fitting addition to their inventory.
void_entities_void_shroud.shippingDetail: Ships via Null Night's interdimensional express service, ensuring swift delivery through the fabric of reality.

usage.activation: Reaction or bonus action (whispering 'Void Hide' for Minor Voids Hiding)
usage.duration: 1 hour for Advantage on Saves vs. Detection; 10 minutes for Minor Voids Hiding
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon completion of its duration or when the wearer is no longer under detection magic.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

void_entities_void_shroud.priceReason: The Void Shroud's rarity and the arcane complexity involved in its creation justify this price point.

void_entities_whisper_earpiece_premium.name: Void Entities Whisper Earpiece (Premium)
void_entities_whisper_earpiece_premium.description: Void Entities Whisper Earpiece (Premium) is a sleek, ear-shaped device made of dark obsidian and silver. Crafted by Void Listeners from the whispers of forgotten void entities, it allows you to hear unheard secrets and perceive hidden doors within a radius of 30 feet. Each day, you can activate its power to detect these concealed passages. The earpiece also transmits subtle hints that could guide your path, but be wary; prolonged use risks driving you mad unless you make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12).

effectDetails.title: Earpiece: Detect Hidden Doors
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to activate this feature, causing the earpiece to emit a low hum that allows you to perceive hidden doors within a 30-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and requires no concentration.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Guidance
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to activate this feature, which provides you with subtle hints about the immediate area, aiding in decision-making or problem-solving. However, overuse increases the risk of madness; after 3 days of continuous use, make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12) or suffer the effects of the mad impulse condition until you rest.

void_entities_whisper_earpiece_premium.levelRequirementReason: The earpiece's complexity and the risk it poses to mental stability necessitate a minimum level.
void_entities_whisper_earpiece_premium.vendorReason: Void Listeners are experts in harnessing void entities, making them the trusted source for such devices.
void_entities_whisper_earpiece_premium.shippingDetail: Ships via Echo Chamber's secure courier network; delivery can take up to a week due to its importance and the need for secrecy.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Earpiece), 1 minute (Detect Hidden Doors)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you finish a short rest, are incapacitated, or when your use limit is reached

void_entities_whisper_earpiece_premium.priceReason: This premium version of the earpiece offers enhanced functionality and durability, justifying its higher price.

void_entities_whispering_orb.name: Void Entity's Whispering Orb
void_entities_whispering_orb.description: The Void Entity's Whispering Orb is a sphere of pure blackness, its surface etched with ancient runes that hum with malevolent intent. It whispers secrets from realms beyond, but the knowledge it imparts comes at a terrible price: one level of exhaustion after each use. While carrying this orb, you gain resistance to Psychic damage, yet your mind grows ever more unstable; each long rest brings a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or risk gaining short-term madness. The orb itself seems to hunger for secrets and will not be silent until it has fed.
void_entities_whispering_orb.shippedBy: A mysterious courier who appears at your doorstep with no explanation.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Secrets
effectDetails.rules: You may ask one question per week, after which you gain one level of exhaustion. The DM will answer truthfully, but the knowledge gained is both enlightening and dangerous.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Psychic Damage
effectDetails.rules: While carrying this orb, you have resistance to Psychic damage. However, each long rest requires a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw; on failure, you gain short-term madness until the next dawn.

void_entities_whispering_orb.levelRequirementReason: The item's malevolent nature and the risk of mental instability necessitate a level requirement.
void_entities_whispering_orb.vendorReason: Void Entities are known for their dark artifacts that manipulate reality and knowledge, making them the purveyors of such an item.
void_entities_whispering_orb.shippingDetail: The orb arrives wrapped in darkness; it is said to be delivered by shadows themselves.

usage.activation: Ask a question once per week. The DM answers truthfully, but you gain one level of exhaustion.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhaustion ends after resting for eight hours and gaining a short rest.

void_entities_whispering_orb.priceReason: The item's unique properties, risk of mental instability, and weekly use limit justify its relatively lower price.

void_walker_boots.name: Void Walker Boots (Mobility)
void_walker_boots.description: The Void Walker Boots are crafted from the very fabric of forgotten voids, their soles etched with runes that shimmer like starlight in darkness. These boots allow you to step through the void, teleporting silently and instantly up to 100 feet three times a day. They whisper secrets of ancient travelers who once walked these paths, and their silent movement in shadow makes you an elusive target for those who would hunt you down.

effectDetails.title: Void Teleport
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can teleport up to 100 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. This effect can be used three times per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Silent Step
effectDetails.rules: The boots allow the wearer to move silently in complete darkness without making noise, and grant advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made under such conditions.

void_walker_boots.levelRequirementReason: Only those of great experience and power can wield these boots, as they require a level 17 character to manage their ancient magic.
void_walker_boots.vendorReason: The Shadow Step vendor is known for dealing in the most dangerous and rarest items found across the realms, making them the perfect source for Void Walker Boots.
void_walker_boots.shippingDetail: Due to their ethereal nature, these boots are shipped via Null Step Express, a courier service that ensures packages arrive through voids rather than mundane means.

usage.activation: Bonus action for teleportation; passive for silent movement.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (teleport); lasts until the start of your next turn (silent step).
usage.endsWhen: Used up all charges or at the end of a short or long rest.
usage.charges: Three uses per day, recharging after a short or long rest.

void_walker_boots.priceReason: The boots are priced at 1000 XP due to their legendary rarity and the high demand among adventurers seeking to traverse voids safely and silently.

voidwalkers_pocket_dimension.name: Voidwalker's Pocket Dimension (10x10)
voidwalkers_pocket_dimension.description: The Voidwalker's Pocket Dimension is a compact extradimensional space, measuring precisely ten feet by ten feet in all dimensions. Crafted from the very fabric of voidspace by the enigmatic Voidheart Collective, this pocket dimension allows its owner to carry an entire realm within their grasp. Time inside the pocket flows at one-tenth the rate outside, offering moments of serene tranquility amidst chaos or a refuge for meditation and reflection.

effectDetails.title: Extradimensional Safekeeping
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. The pocket dimension provides absolute safety to any item or creature placed within it, excluding the effects of damage and destruction. While inside, time flows at one-tenth speed, preserving all elements in perfect condition.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Surrealism
effectDetails.rules: The interior of the pocket dimension is unaffected by external events; time moves slower, creating a surreal environment where minutes stretch into hours and the passage of time becomes irrelevant. This effect lasts until the user ends it as an action or until the pocket dimension is destroyed.

voidwalkers_pocket_dimension.levelRequirementReason: The intricate crafting and manipulation of extradimensional space require a high degree of arcane knowledge and control.
voidwalkers_pocket_dimension.vendorReason: Voidheart Collective's products are sold exclusively by Void Merchant, the only known conduit for such rare and powerful artifacts.
voidwalkers_pocket_dimension.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Anchor, a courier service that can transport items through voidspace, ensuring safe delivery within days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous when activated; ends as an action or when the pocket dimension is destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by being physically damaged beyond repair or when explicitly ended as an action

voidwalkers_pocket_dimension.priceReason: This item's rarity and unique capabilities justify its extremely high price, offering unparalleled utility in a world where extradimensional spaces are rare.

volt_shroom.name: Volt Shroom
volt_shroom.description: The Volt Shroom exudes a faint electrical hum, its cap shimmering with a soft, blue glow. This enchanted mushroom releases a potent surge of lightning when ingested, shocking any attacker who strikes you in melee. Legend has it that the shaman elders found this glowing fungus deep within the storm-drenched heart of the forest, where lightning storms are said to give birth to life itself. Eaten on an empty stomach, its effects last for 1 minute, leaving attackers with a lingering tingle and a cloud of smoke.

effectDetails.title: Shocking Rebound
effectDetails.rules: When you are hit by a melee attack while this effect is active, the attacker takes 1d6 lightning damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be triggered up to three times per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Aura
effectDetails.rules: While this effect is active, you are surrounded by a faint electrical aura that leaves attackers with a lingering tingle. The attacker must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned for 1 round, during which they cannot take actions or reactions.

volt_shroom.levelRequirementReason: This mushroom is accessible to lower-level characters as it requires minimal preparation and is not overly powerful.
volt_shroom.vendorReason: The Shamans' Hut specializes in rare and mystical ingredients, making the Volt Shroom a natural addition to their stock.
volt_shroom.shippingDetail: Ships via Thunderstorm Courier, ensuring safe delivery through lightning strikes and stormy skies. The courier delivers within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon consumption on an empty stomach.
usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you take damage from a melee attack while it is active.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can be used up to three times per short or long rest.

volt_shroom.priceReason: The Volt Shroom's price is adjusted to reflect its rarity and the difficulty of finding the correct species in the wild, as well as its mystical properties that enhance combat effectiveness.

vortex_zip_tie.name: Vortex Zip-Tie
vortex_zip_tie.description: A Vortex Zip-Tie is a compact metallic band with an etched micro-vortex. Crafted from reinforced steel, it bends and snaps shut with a metallic snap. This zip-tie can bind and lock space, creating a localized force field that temporarily restrains creatures within its grip. Even ethereal beings are momentarily held captive by the vortex's power, though they are released once the zip-tie is removed or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Force Field Binding
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, a Vortex Zip-Tie creates a localized force field that restrains one creature within its confines. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be restrained, taking 2d10 force damage each round they remain bound (restrained creatures can attempt the save at the start of their turn). The zip-tie self-destructs upon successful binding.

effectDetails.title: Ethereal Restraint
effectDetails.rules: The micro-vortex within a Vortex Zip-Tie also has an effect on ethereal creatures, briefly restraining them for 1 minute. Ethereal beings can use their action to make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw to end the effect early.

vortex_zip_tie.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level due to its force and ethereal manipulation capabilities.
vortex_zip_tie.vendorReason: Gearworks specializes in high-tech, custom-made tools like the Vortex Zip-Tie, which is a prime example of their craftsmanship.
vortex_zip_tie.shippingDetail: Ships via Steel Tube Express with a 1-day delivery guarantee within the realm.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; force field lasts until target is freed or zip-tie self-destructs
usage.endsWhen: The zip-tie self-deletes upon successful binding or when destroyed by force
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the zip-tie re-forms after use

vortex_zip_tie.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect a specialized tool that requires significant material and engineering.

vrock_spore_cleansing.name: Vrock Spore Cleansing Service
vrock_spore_cleansing.description: The Vrock Spore Cleansing Service is a specialized ritual conducted by Abyssal Exterminators that purifies both person and place of demonic spores, parasites, and rot. The service leaves no trace of infestation, ensuring that the affected area or individual remains free from reinfestation for sixty days. This ancient rite has been honed over millennia in the depths of the Abyss, where even the smallest contamination is a threat to survival.

effectDetails.title: Spore Removal
effectDetails.rules: This service requires an action and targets one person or a 10-foot-radius sphere. The caster makes a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check to successfully cleanse the target of all demonic infestations. On a failed save, the target remains contaminated.

effectDetails.title: Reinfestation Prevention
effectDetails.rules: The prevention lasts for sixty days and can only be disrupted by significant magical means. No additional actions are required during this duration to maintain its effect.

vrock_spore_cleansing.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to anyone, as it does not require a specific class or background but rather the expertise of Abyssal Exterminators.
vrock_spore_cleansing.vendorReason: Abyssal Exterminators are renowned for their unparalleled knowledge in dealing with demonic infestations and have established themselves as the go-to service providers in such matters.
vrock_spore_cleansing.shippingDetail: The service is delivered via a swift Spore Cloud, ensuring it arrives within an hour of purchase.

usage.activation: An action is required to begin the cleansing ritual.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for sixty days.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when reinfestation occurs due to significant magical means or after sixty days, whichever comes first.

vrock_spore_cleansing.priceReason: This price reflects the expertise and resources required by Abyssal Exterminators to conduct such a specialized ritual.

waluigi_cap.name: Waluigi Cap
waluigi_cap.description: The Waluigi Cap is a mischievous hat made of shimmering, dark fabric that whispers secrets of trickery to its wearer. Crafted in the shadowy forges of Bowser's lair, it enhances one's cunning and agility, granting a wicked edge in both deceitful maneuvers and acrobatic feats. Wearing this cap is akin to stepping into Waluigi's own dimension of mischief; with each activation, you hear the eerie sound of 'Wah!', signaling its malevolent influence at work.
effects: Once per day: Cheat death (reroll saving throw)

effectDetails.title: +2 to Deception and Acrobatics
effectDetails.rules: This cap grants the wearer a +2 bonus to checks for Deception and Acrobatics. The effects of this item last until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Cheat death (reroll saving throw)
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, when you fail a saving throw against death or necromancy magic, you can use this cap to reroll that save. The effect ends immediately after use.

waluigi_cap.levelRequirementReason: This cap is designed for beginners who wish to test their wits and agility in tricky situations.
waluigi_cap.vendorReason: Wario, always looking to sell unique items from his vast collection of stolen goods, offers this mischievous hat.
waluigi_cap.shippingDetail: The Cap Box ensures safe delivery using padded inner linings and a dark, shadowy theme that matches the cap's design.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn

waluigi_cap.priceReason: This cap is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique combination of offensive and defensive capabilities.

wand_of_questionable_utility.name: Wand of Questionable Utility
wand_of_questionable_utility.description: This short, gnarled wand exudes an air of eccentricity. Its cracked varnish hints at a stormy past, and its handle is wrapped in faded leather. Created by wizards who found their magic lacking, it offers whimsical effects that are more trouble than they're worth. The Wand of Questionable Utility can grant you a fleeting moment of absurdity or chaos, but beware—its effects are unpredictable and often useless in combat.

effectDetails.title: Random Effect
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the wand emits a spark that causes one of four random effects: (1) Polish shoes instantly; (2) Change hair color for an hour; (3) Summon a moth to dance around you for 1 minute; or (4) Clean dishes in your immediate area. The effect is instantaneous and has no duration, but it never benefits combat. No save is required.

effectDetails.title: Unlimited Charges
effectDetails.rules: The wand holds an infinite supply of magical energies that fuel its effects. It requires no recharging and can be used as often as you wish, provided you have the time to activate it.

wand_of_questionable_utility.levelRequirementReason: No special level is required since the effects are mostly for fun or chaos.
wand_of_questionable_utility.vendorReason: The Discount Artifact Vendor sells this item because it's a quirky, cheap option that adds a bit of whimsy to any adventurer's arsenal.
wand_of_questionable_utility.shippingDetail: Shipped via Wand Delivery, which ensures the wand arrives in one piece and with its mystical properties intact.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate the wand and cause its effect.
usage.duration: Each effect is instantaneous and has no duration beyond its immediate occurrence.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends as soon as it occurs, unless interrupted by an external event or your next turn.

wand_of_questionable_utility.priceReason: This price reflects the item's unique and often useless effects, which are entertaining but not combat-effective.

warhammer_airship_anchor.name: Airship Anchor
warhammer_airship_anchor.description: The Airship Anchor is a compact, weathered iron anchor etched with runes that whisper of ancient airships. It stabilizes floating vessels against storm winds and prevents sudden drops during tempests. However, its full power can only be unleashed after upgrading it with the Remi Coil, which enhances its capabilities but limits cargo capacity by 15%. Crafted by Wario Inc, this rare artifact is a testament to their mastery of airship technology.

effectDetails.title: Storm Stabilization
effectDetails.rules: When an airship equipped with the Airship Anchor encounters severe weather, it gains a +2 bonus to AC and a +10 ft. bonus to flying speed for 1 minute. This effect ends when the storm ends or if the anchor is removed.

effectDetails.title: Drop Prevention
effectDetails.rules: The airship equipped with this anchor cannot suffer from sudden drops exceeding 30 feet in height during storms, reducing the risk of catastrophic damage by half. This protection lasts for 1 hour and can be reactivated once per long rest.

warhammer_airship_anchor.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum character level to handle its complex mechanics and ensure it does not overshadow player capabilities.
warhammer_airship_anchor.vendorReason: Warhammer is renowned for their expertise in airship technology and has the resources to offer this rare artifact.
warhammer_airship_anchor.shippingDetail: Shipped via a spirit courier, arriving within an hour of order placement.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon encountering severe weather or impending drops.
usage.duration: Storm Stabilization lasts for 1 minute; Drop Prevention lasts for 1 hour and recharges after a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the storm ends, the anchor is removed, or if the airship reaches its maximum speed limit.

warhammer_airship_anchor.priceReason: Balanced to ensure it remains valuable but not game-breaking in terms of utility and cost.

warhammer_blocky_torch.name: Blocky Torch
warhammer_blocky_torch.description: The Blocky Torch is a cumbersome beacon of frontier fire, crafted by Servants Cosmic for those who dare to venture into uncharted lands. This primitive torch provides an expansive light radius of 200 feet, illuminating the darkest corners and guiding lost souls back to safety. Its sturdy design allows it to be used in crafting or repairing blocks, making it invaluable to builders and adventurers alike. After 15 minutes of use, the torch's flame flickers out, leaving behind only a faint ember that can be rekindled with a match.

effectDetails.title: Expansive Light
effectDetails.rules: The Blocky Torch provides an area of bright light with a radius of 200 feet. This effect illuminates all creatures and objects within its range, providing advantage on Darkvision checks made in the area. The torch's light can be used to see through darkness but not into total darkness.

effectDetails.title: Crafting Companion
effectDetails.rules: This torch can be used as a material component for crafting or repairing blocks. Each use reduces its durability by 10%, and it must be rekindled after 15 minutes of continuous use to restore its full functionality. If the torch burns out, it can be relit with minimal effort.

warhammer_blocky_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Blocky Torch is designed for adventurers who are just starting their journey and require basic tools to survive.
warhammer_blocky_torch.vendorReason: Warhammer has a long-standing partnership with Servants Cosmic, providing essential gear for adventurers across the realms.
warhammer_blocky_torch.shippingDetail: The Blocky Torch is delivered quickly by Koopa Postal, ensuring that even the most remote regions receive this vital tool within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when lit with a match or similar fire source.
usage.duration: 15 minutes of continuous use before burning out.
usage.endsWhen: The torch's flame flickers out after 15 minutes, or if it is destroyed or damaged beyond repair.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses until the torch burns out.

warhammer_blocky_torch.priceReason: The Blocky Torch provides essential light and crafting support for adventurers, making its price a fair investment in survival and exploration.

warhammer_cheep_cheep_accords_keyring.name: Cheep Cheep Accords Keyring
warhammer_cheep_cheep_accords_keyring.description: The Cheep Cheep Accords Keyring is a tiny, intricately forged token that grants access to hidden routes across The Fated Place and Rogueport. Crafted from gleaming brass in the shadowy depths of the Accords, this keyring whispers secrets when held near toads or spirit walkers, granting +1 to Stealth checks within 30 feet. However, using it too close to humanoids causes a momentary disorientation, affecting them for 1d4 rounds with disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Routes Access
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a creature within The Fated Place or Rogueport, the keyring reveals hidden paths. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: Grants +1 to Stealth checks when near toads or spirit walkers within 30 feet. This benefit persists until the end of the creature's next turn after using this effect, and it can be used once per short rest.

warhammer_cheep_cheep_accords_keyring.levelRequirementReason: The token's complexity and hidden lore require a minimum character level to properly utilize its secrets.
warhammer_cheep_cheep_accords_keyring.vendorReason: Warhammer is known for its extensive trade networks, including the Accords, making it the logical vendor for such a unique item.
warhammer_cheep_cheep_accords_keyring.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral mail, this keyring arrives with a slight delay due to the mystical nature of its origin.

usage.duration: 10 minutes per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature moves more than 5 feet away from The Fated Place or Rogueport, or after a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check is made.

warhammer_cheep_cheep_accords_keyring.priceReason: The keyring's rarity and the unique access it grants justify its moderate price.

warhammer_cosmic_jester_satchel.name: Cosmic Jester Satchel
warhammer_cosmic_jester_satchel.description: The Cosmic Jester Satchel is a mischievous leather pouch adorned with stars and cosmic runes, filled to the brim with pranks and entropy. When opened, it releases a swirling vortex of unpredictable effects—either teleporting you to a random location within sight, freezing time for an opponent, or inflicting a humorous debuff that mocks your foe's actions. Beware, for each use, the satchel weaves a joke curse upon its target, turning their laughter against them until it exhausts itself.

effectDetails.title: Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: When used as an action, the satchel teleports you to a random location within sight. The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be teleported to a point of your choice within 30 feet that is not occupied by a creature. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Time Freeze
effectDetails.rules: This effect can be used as an action, freezing time around the target for up to 3 rounds. The target and all creatures within 10 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are frozen in place until the spell ends or another creature moves them.

warhammer_cosmic_jester_satchel.levelRequirementReason: This satchel is crafted for young adventurers to practice their skills and learn the art of mischievous combat without overwhelming power.
warhammer_cosmic_jester_satchel.vendorReason: Warhammer, known for its extensive supply of unique adventuring gear, offers this satchel as a fun addition to any adventurer's arsenal.
warhammer_cosmic_jester_satchel.shippingDetail: The Cosmic Jester Satchel is carefully packed and shipped via Koopa Postal's express courier service to ensure it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Used as an action or bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, except for the teleport effect which lasts for 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against the effects; the satchel exhausts after three uses.

warhammer_cosmic_jester_satchel.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its unique and entertaining nature while ensuring it does not overshadow more powerful items.

warhammer_cursed_pocket_watch.name: Cursed Pocket Watch
warhammer_cursed_pocket_watch.description: The Cursed Pocket Watch ticks with malevolent energy, a relic from the Jester cults' vault of entropy. Its metallic casing glows faintly with an otherworldly hue, and the hands seem to move in reverse as if time itself resists your touch. This watch grants you control over the flow of seconds, allowing you to manipulate them for strategic advantage or cause chaos among foes, but beware—its power comes at a cost, as it may cause you to forget recent actions.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can manipulate the flow of time for yourself. For the next 20 seconds, your actions are treated as if they were completed in a single turn. This effect does not grant additional turns or speed but allows you to perform complex sequences of actions smoothly and efficiently.

effectDetails.title: Time Distortion
effectDetails.rules: For 10 seconds after using the watch, any creature within 30 feet who is not an ally suffers a -2 penalty on Dexterity saving throws. This effect ends if you use it again or when the duration expires.

warhammer_cursed_pocket_watch.levelRequirementReason: The Cursed Pocket Watch's dark magic requires a high level of arcane knowledge and discipline to control.
warhammer_cursed_pocket_watch.vendorReason: Warhammer, known for its eclectic collection of rare artifacts, has acquired this dangerous relic from a mysterious source.
warhammer_cursed_pocket_watch.shippingDetail: Due to the watch's unstable nature, it must be shipped in special protective packaging and can only be delivered during daylight hours.

usage.duration: 20 seconds + 10 seconds after use
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or you use it again

warhammer_cursed_pocket_watch.priceReason: This item's price reflects its rarity and the risks involved in using such a powerful artifact.

warhammer_daisy_princess_satchel.name: Daisy Princess Satchel
warhammer_daisy_princess_satchel.description: The Daisy Princess Satchel, crafted with intricate filigree and adorned in the royal crest of Sarasaland, is a relic from the golden age of desert diplomacy. This ornate satchel once held the secrets of peace treaties between warring nations but now contains only a map of Ricco Harbor’s hidden tunnels and a feather from a Skaven general — symbols of enduring conflict and unity. It whispers tales to those who wield it, yet its very presence can cloud the mind with fleeting confusion.

effectDetails.title: Diplomatic Insight
effectDetails.rules: When used in negotiations, this satchel grants a +1 bonus to Diplomacy checks. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn and can be activated once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Tunnel Map
effectDetails.rules: Activating this effect reveals the map of Ricco Harbor’s secret tunnels, providing you with detailed knowledge of the area for 1 minute. This effect cannot be used more than twice a day and requires an Intelligence (History) check contested by the DM.

warhammer_daisy_princess_satchel.levelRequirementReason: It can be wielded by any character to aid in diplomacy or uncover hidden routes.
warhammer_daisy_princess_satchel.vendorReason: Warhammer is a renowned vendor for royal and diplomatic items, known for its extensive stock of artifacts from various realms.
warhammer_daisy_princess_satchel.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa Express, ensuring safe delivery within five game days.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate either effect.
usage.duration: The Diplomatic Insight lasts until the end of your next turn. The Tunnel Map reveals information for one minute.
usage.endsWhen: The effects are exhausted after use or when a character makes an Intelligence (History) check with a failed result.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only twice per day for revealing the map.

warhammer_daisy_princess_satchel.priceReason: The satchel’s price reflects its rarity and historical significance, providing both diplomatic and strategic advantages without being overly powerful.

warhammer_doughnut_hole_tether.name: Doughnut Hole Tether
warhammer_doughnut_hole_tether.description: The Doughnut Hole Tether, crafted by the mischievous Chain Chomp Courier from the cosmic void, is a cursed artifact that binds its wielder to the eternal darkness of the cosmos. This weapon's hollow core whispers of unspeakable horrors, and when left unattended for an hour instead of 30 minutes as before, it draws random entities from the void into the user’s vicinity, causing them to fight each other in a chaotic battle within the tether’s radius. The wielder gains a strange, ethereal glow that enhances their movement speed by 50% when within the void, but at the cost of psychic damage dealt and received.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Drain
effectDetails.rules: While in the void, you deal 1d6 psychic damage to any entity within your reach at the start of each of your turns. If left unattended for an hour, the tether draws entities from the void into a radius of 30 feet around you, causing them to engage in a chaotic battle and deal 1d6 psychic damage to all creatures within that area as they clash.

effectDetails.title: Voidbound Movement
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +5 bonus to your movement speed while within the void. However, this effect is countered if you are outside of the void for more than 10 minutes; at which point, you must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 psychic damage.

warhammer_doughnut_hole_tether.levelRequirementReason: The artifact's malevolent nature and the cosmic forces it commands demand that only an experienced wielder can control its powers.
warhammer_doughnut_hole_tether.vendorReason: Warhammer, known for their dark magic and cursed artifacts, are the perfect purveyors of this dangerous weapon.
warhammer_doughnut_hole_tether.shippingDetail: The Courier's delivery is swift but perilous; the package is often intercepted by entities from the void, making it a rare and sought-after item.

usage.activation: Passive effect while in the void, charges on unattended time in the void for an hour instead of 30 minutes as before.
usage.duration: Active during your turns when within the void; counters if left outside the void for more than 10 minutes.
usage.endsWhen: The tether's effects end upon leaving the void for more than 10 minutes or if you make a failed Constitution saving throw due to damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only active while in the void.

warhammer_doughnut_hole_tether.priceReason: Balanced at this price as it requires attunement by a priest of the Void and its effects are both dangerous and beneficial.

warhammer_faerun_blessing.name: Faerûn’s Whispering Ring
warhammer_faerun_blessing.description: Faerûn’s Whispering Ring is a delicate silver circlet adorned with arcane runes that hum softly when worn. Crafted by Custodians from a relic of the last dragonborn king, it whispers spells of ancient power into your mind. While in Faerûn, this ring grants +2d4 to all spellcasting rolls and slightly increases your spellcasting speed. When used near a dragon’s roar, it triggers a minor dimensional rift that disrupts the resonance of Dragon Conspiracy traps.

effectDetails.title: Spellcasting Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on wearing the ring in Faerûn. Grants a +2d4 bonus to all spellcasting rolls for 10 minutes. Ends when removed or at the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Dragon Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When used within earshot of a dragon’s roar, triggers a minor dimensional rift that disrupts Dragon Conspiracy sonic traps, halting their resonance for 1 minute. The effect ends if you move more than 30 feet away from the trap or if the trap is destroyed.

warhammer_faerun_blessing.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Arcana to fully harness the ring’s arcane properties.
warhammer_faerun_blessing.vendorReason: Warhammer is known for its connections with ancient artifacts and relics, making it a fitting vendor for this item.
warhammer_faerun_blessing.shippingDetail: Ships via Pianta Chuck Express, delivering within three days from the nearest Faerûnian port.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon wearing in Faerûn; requires a reaction to use near a dragon’s roar.
usage.duration: 10 minutes or until removed, per activation of Dragon Resonance
usage.endsWhen: Removed from the wearer or at the end of your next long rest for Spellcasting Boost; ends when the trap resonance is destroyed or the effect duration expires for Dragon Resonance.

warhammer_faerun_blessing.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its rarity, ancient craftsmanship, and unique abilities within Faerûn.

warhammer_feywild_ring.name: Feywild Ring of the Trickster
warhammer_feywild_ring.description: The Feywild Ring of the Trickster is a cursed iron ring, forged in the twilight realms where time and fate intertwine. Its surface gleams with an ethereal glow, hinting at forgotten magic. This ring allows its wearer to momentarily bend reality, causing minor disorientation among those who dare to cross paths within the Feywild. It also increases the likelihood of wild magic surges, making it a perilous yet powerful tool for those adept in arcane arts.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Disruption
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can use this ring to create a brief time loop that lasts for one round. During this effect, all creatures within a 10-foot radius must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and have their movement speed halved until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Wild Magic Surge
effectDetails.rules: The ring increases the chance of triggering wild magic surges by +20%. This effect is cumulative with other sources of wild magic.

warhammer_feywild_ring.levelRequirementReason: Only those skilled enough to navigate the Feywild's dangers and wield its magic should be able to use this ring.
warhammer_feywild_ring.vendorReason: Warhammer, with their extensive network of arcane dealers, can source such a powerful and dangerous artifact from the Pokémon League.
warhammer_feywild_ring.shippingDetail: Due to its cursed nature, the ring must be shipped in specially enchanted boxes that prevent any wild magic surges during transit.

usage.duration: 1 round per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the wearer is hit by an attack.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per short rest

warhammer_feywild_ring.priceReason: The ring's limited uses and potential for wild magic surges justify its moderate price.

warhammer_garlic_grenade.name: Garlic Grenade
warhammer_garlic_grenade.description: The Garlic Grenade is a pungent explosive crafted from garlic and Wario Inc's secret formula. When thrown, it detonates with an acrid scent that forces nearby enemies to flee in temporary blindness, while also causing a mild curse that reduces their Dexterity by one for the duration of combat. The grenade's pungency even affects allies, who must cover their noses or risk being momentarily dazed and unable to act.

effectDetails.title: Fleeting Blindness
effectDetails.rules: When a creature within 10 feet of the grenade is hit by it, they must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 round. This effect does not affect allies who are willing to cover their noses.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Curse
effectDetails.rules: For every minute an enemy remains within 20 feet of the grenade's explosion, they suffer a -1 penalty to Dexterity saves and checks. The curse ends when the enemy moves out of range or is incapacitated.

warhammer_garlic_grenade.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for novice adventurers who need a reliable way to incapacitate foes temporarily.
warhammer_garlic_grenade.vendorReason: Warhammer has a reputation for supplying unique weapons and explosives, making the Garlic Grenade an ideal addition to their inventory.
warhammer_garlic_grenade.shippingDetail: Ships via a Rakasha spirit who delivers it directly into your hands, ensuring quick arrival even in remote locations.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of combat or until destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day; recharges overnight

warhammer_garlic_grenade.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the grenade's utility in a variety of combat scenarios, from disabling agile enemies to creating temporary distractions.

warhammer_heart_of_animatopia.name: Heart of Animatopia
warhammer_heart_of_animatopia.description: The Heart of Animatopia is a pulsating core carved from the ancient heartwood of an animatopian tree. This living relic grants warriors temporary immunity to fear and confusion, making them unshaken in the heat of battle. When activated, it imbues attacks with primal fury, increasing damage against enemy leaders by 30%. The core's fierce energy can be consumed to unleash a burst of Tribal Rage, temporarily breaking through enemy armor defenses.

effectDetails.title: Primal Fury
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Heart grants temporary immunity to fear and confusion for 1 minute. Increases damage against enemies with leadership abilities by 30%. Ends if the user takes any nonmagical damage.

effectDetails.title: Unyielding Will
effectDetails.rules: The user can consume 2000 HP once per long rest to activate Tribal Rage for 1 minute. During this time, there is a 20% chance that all attacks made break enemy armor defenses. Ends if the user drops below half health.

warhammer_heart_of_animatopia.levelRequirementReason: Requires mastery of basic combat skills to wield its primal power.
warhammer_heart_of_animatopia.vendorReason: Warhammer, a master forger and supplier of unique artifacts, offers the Heart of Animatopia as a symbol of their craftsmanship in ancient relics.
warhammer_heart_of_animatopia.shippingDetail: The core is shipped via Void Drifter Relay, ensuring secure transport through the starry void.

usage.activation: Activate as an action; can be consumed once per long rest.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until interrupted by damage.
usage.endsWhen: Ends if the user takes nonmagical damage or drops below half health.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be consumed once per long rest.

warhammer_heart_of_animatopia.priceReason: Balanced to provide a powerful combat advantage without overbalancing the game.

warhammer_lanky_kong_keychain.name: Lanky Kong Keychain
warhammer_lanky_kong_keychain.description: This is a whimsical keychain featuring Lanky Kong, the failed diplomat of the Lanky Kong diplomatic corps. Crafted from durable brass and adorned with a mischievous expression, it's a relic that brings both laughter and luck to its bearer during tense negotiations or battles. When used in combat, it grants temporary confusion to foes and increases ally morale by 5%. The keychain can be worn during diplomacy, unlocking a hidden map to the Lanky Kong Vault upon collecting two such charms.

effectDetails.title: Confuse Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When used in combat, this keychain has a 15% chance to cause an enemy within 5 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 10) or be temporarily confused for the start of your next turn. This effect ends if the enemy takes damage.

effectDetails.title: Boost Ally Morale
effectDetails.rules: When used during combat, this keychain increases the morale of all friendly creatures within 30 feet by +2 until the end of your next turn. This effect does not stack with other similar morale bonuses.

warhammer_lanky_kong_keychain.levelRequirementReason: This keychain is designed to be accessible for beginning adventurers, providing a humorous yet practical advantage in challenging situations.
warhammer_lanky_kong_keychain.vendorReason: Warhammer, known for its diverse inventory of quirky and functional items, offers this delightful keychain as part of their collection of themed accessories.
warhammer_lanky_kong_keychain.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Drifter Relay within 3 game days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if an enemy takes damage or when used again during the same combat round.

warhammer_lanky_kong_keychain.priceReason: The keychain's unique design and thematic value justify its higher price, making it a sought-after item for adventurers seeking both practical benefits and a touch of humor.

warhammer_primordial_wyrm_seal.name: Primordial Wyrm Seal
warhammer_primordial_wyrm_seal.description: The Primordial Wyrm Seal is a heavy, obsidian hammerhead engraved with ancient sigils from the depths of the Valley of Bowser. It resonates with the primordial fury that once fueled the wyrm's wrath. When placed on a seal of the Primordial Wyrm, it unleashes an aura that grants immunity to all magic effects for 10 minutes and opens the chamber housing its core. Crafting this relic required the arcane knowledge of Mages Guild Portal and the dark secrets of Skaven alchemy.

effectDetails.title: Immunity Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this seal grants immunity to all magic effects for 10 minutes. The wielder must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 psychic trauma. This effect is instantaneous and ends when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Core Chamber Access
effectDetails.rules: This seal can be used to open the core chamber of the Primordial Wyrm, allowing access to its inner sanctum. It has no uses after this activation.

warhammer_primordial_wyrm_seal.levelRequirementReason: The arcane complexity and danger of the spell required for activation necessitate a minimum level.
warhammer_primordial_wyrm_seal.vendorReason: Warhammer, known for its connections to ancient artifacts, is entrusted with this unique relic.
warhammer_primordial_wyrm_seal.shippingDetail: Shipped via an arcane courier, ensuring the safe and timely delivery of such a potent artifact.

usage.duration: 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or seal is destroyed

warhammer_primordial_wyrm_seal.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the item's rarity and its powerful but manageable effects.

warhammer_rakasha_spirit_torch.name: Rakasha Spirit Torch
warhammer_rakasha_spirit_torch.description: The Rakasha Spirit Torch flickers with a spectral glow that dances like living fire. Crafted by the enigmatic Rakasha clans, this torch burns with the essence of their ancient spirit walkers, granting the wielder a brief connection to the ethereal realm. For 10 minutes, it provides +2 to all Intelligence (Insight) checks and Wisdom (Perception) checks related to detecting hidden or invisible creatures, while also causing minor sensory distortions that last until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Insight
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes, the wielder gains +2 to all Intelligence (Insight) checks and Wisdom (Perception) checks related to detecting hidden or invisible creatures. This effect ends if the user moves more than 60 feet from where they ignited the torch.

effectDetails.title: Minor Hallucinations
effectDetails.rules: During the duration, the wielder experiences minor sensory distortions that are not debilitating but can affect their perception of reality. These distortions last for the entire duration and do not require a saving throw to resist.

warhammer_rakasha_spirit_torch.levelRequirementReason: This item provides useful but not overly powerful benefits, suitable for lower-level characters.
warhammer_rakasha_spirit_torch.vendorReason: The Warhammer is known for its diverse and high-quality items that cater to a wide range of player needs, making the Rakasha Spirit Torch an appropriate addition.
warhammer_rakasha_spirit_torch.shippingDetail: The torch arrives encased in spectral fire, ensuring it remains functional until use.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon ignition; no further action required during duration.
usage.duration: 10 minutes per use
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each long rest or if moved more than 60 feet from where ignited.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged with a full night's sleep.

warhammer_rakasha_spirit_torch.priceReason: The item offers balanced benefits that enhance perception and insight without granting game-breaking advantages, justifying its price in XP.

warhammer_rats_knife.name: Rats Knife of the Skaven
warhammer_rats_knife.description: The Rats Knife of the Skaven is a compact, rat-clawed weapon forged in the dark labyrinths beneath the Underdark. Its blade gleams with a faint, eerie light, and its handle is adorned with intricate carvings that tell tales of ancient wars fought by the Skavens. Wielders report an increased agility while fighting, as if the knife's very essence grants them swifter feet, but beware—its use can inadvertently amplify chaos in nearby environments, causing minor disturbances that may attract unwanted attention.

effectDetails.title: Swift Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with the Rats Knife, you have advantage on the attack roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chaos Disturbance
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can cause minor noise (such as clinking or rustling) that has a range of 30 feet. If an enemy within this area is unaware of the source of the noise, they must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12). On a failed save, the creature becomes aware of your location and suffers disadvantage on its next attack roll against you until the start of your next turn.

warhammer_rats_knife.levelRequirementReason: The knife's chaotic energy requires some experience to control effectively.
warhammer_rats_knife.vendorReason: The Warhammer vendor specializes in exotic and rare weapons, including those with a touch of the strange and the arcane.
warhammer_rats_knife.shippingDetail: Ships via Koopa's Express delivery service, which guarantees safe arrival within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: As an action or bonus action for Swift Strike; as a bonus action for Chaos Disturbance
usage.duration: Instantaneous and single-use per turn for Swift Strike; lasts until the start of your next turn for Chaos Disturbance
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon use, recharges on a short rest for both effects

warhammer_rats_knife.priceReason: The knife's exotic nature and the chaotic power it contains justify its higher price.

warhammer_remis_coil_airship_engine.name: Remi Coils Airship Engine
warhammer_remis_coil_airship_engine.description: The Remi Coils Airship Engine is a compact marvel of engineering that propels airships through stormy skies with ease. Its intricate gears and pistons are forged from alloys unique to The Fated Place, ensuring unmatched performance in turbulent weather. Pilots who activate this engine can navigate the tempests with +2 to their navigation checks, and it boosts overall speed by 30%, making it an indispensable part of any airship's arsenal.

effectDetails.title: Storm Navigation Boost
effectDetails.rules: When the engine is activated, the pilot gains a +2 bonus to navigation checks while in stormy weather. This effect lasts until the end of the airship's next turn.

effectDetails.title: Speedy Flight
effectDetails.rules: The Remi Coils Airship Engine increases the airship's speed by 30% for as long as it remains powered and connected to the ship. Consuming one energy charge per flight cycle maintains this effect.

warhammer_remis_coil_airship_engine.levelRequirementReason: This engine requires significant mechanical knowledge and expertise, suitable only for seasoned pilots.
warhammer_remis_coil_airship_engine.vendorReason: Warhammer is renowned for its mastery of airship technology and engineering, making it the premier vendor for such high-performance components.
warhammer_remis_coil_airship_engine.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral courier with a 24-hour delivery window.

usage.activation: A bonus action to connect the engine and activate its effects.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, reactivates on the next turn if the energy charge is replenished.
usage.endsWhen: The engine is disconnected or no longer powered by an energy charge.

warhammer_remis_coil_airship_engine.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its high demand and unique capabilities, making it a sought-after but not overpriced addition to any airship.

warhammer_scarred_mechanical_glove.name: Scarred Mechanical Glove
warhammer_scarred_mechanical_glove.description: The Scarred Mechanical Glove once belonged to a Skaven engineer who crafted it from salvaged parts of the Koopa Navy’s warships. Its fingers are reinforced with cogs and gears, and its surface is scarred by countless battles. When struck, the glove emits a mechanical hum that can either command or warn, depending on the user's intent. It pulses with corrupted energy, dealing +2d4 damage to melee attacks but risks jamming or overloading in battle.

effectDetails.title: Reinforced Strikes
effectDetails.rules: Increase the wielder’s melee attack rolls by +2d4. The glove has a 25% chance of jamming or overloading during each attack, requiring an immediate DC 13 Dexterity saving throw to prevent dropping the weapon.

effectDetails.title: Mimicry
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 5 feet have advantage on saving throws against the wielder’s spells and effects for 1 minute. The mimic effect ends if the wielder ceases to wear the glove or drops it as an action.

warhammer_scarred_mechanical_glove.levelRequirementReason: Requires attunement with a war machine to command its corrupted energy.
warhammer_scarred_mechanical_glove.vendorReason: The Warhammer vendor specializes in items from the Skaven and other dark factions, making this glove an appropriate addition to their inventory.
warhammer_scarred_mechanical_glove.shippingDetail: Delivered via a specialized Koopa Postal courier who ensures the package is securely packed for its journey through treacherous lands.

usage.activation: Wearing the glove as an action and using it during melee attacks.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect per attack.
usage.endsWhen: The glove jams, overloads, or is dropped by the wielder.

warhammer_scarred_mechanical_glove.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique combination of offensive power and risk.

warhammer_scarred_sword.name: Scarred Sword
warhammer_scarred_sword.description: The Scarred Sword is a weapon forged from the bones of ancient warriors and embedded with the memories of their battles. Its surface is marred by etches that whisper the screams of fallen enemies, and each strike releases the echoes of past conflicts. This blade deals +1d6 slashing damage to all attacks and grants temporary hit points equal to 1d4 when an enemy within 5 feet is frightened by a fear effect.

effectDetails.title: Frightening Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with this weapon, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The fear effect ends early if the target takes any damage or is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Hit Points on Fear
effectDetails.rules: If you hit an enemy within 5 feet with this weapon and it is affected by a fear effect, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1d4 until the start of your next turn. You regain all temporary hit points if the target no longer has the frightened condition.

warhammer_scarred_sword.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires attunement by a warrior or rogue, and its cursed nature demands a certain level to wield effectively.
warhammer_scarred_sword.vendorReason: Warhammer’s artisans have long specialized in crafting weapons that resonate with the spirits of battle.
warhammer_scarred_sword.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week, ensuring warriors can train and attune to this weapon properly.

usage.activation: On hit with a melee attack
usage.duration: Until end of next turn for fear effect; until target regains the frightened condition for temporary HP
usage.endsWhen: The target is no longer affected by the fear effect or takes damage, or you gain temporary hit points due to fear

warhammer_scarred_sword.priceReason: This weapon’s cursed nature and attunement requirement justify a balanced price of 1000 XP.

warhammer_skaven_gear_crate.name: Skaven Gear Crate
warhammer_skaven_gear_crate.description: The Skaven Gear Crate is a darkly enchanted wooden crate, its surface etched with ancient runes and adorned with the emblem of the Rat God. When opened, it reveals three random items of war gear, each item harboring a fragment of chaotic magic. Among these may be miniature catapults that can spring to life, rat-infested armor that saps vitality, or cursed gear that brings misfortune to its bearer. A minor chaos effect occurs with every use, and opening the crate in public risks attracting an ambush from Skaven assassins.

effectDetails.title: Random War Gear
effectDetails.rules: Opens to reveal three random items of war gear. Each item has a 25% chance to trigger a minor chaos effect, and the crate may trigger a Skaven ambush if opened in public.

effectDetails.title: Minor Chaos
effectDetails.rules: A minor chaos effect occurs each time the crate is used. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and imposes disadvantage on all ability checks and saving throws for 1d4 rounds. Opening the crate in a populated area may attract an ambush from Skaven assassins.

warhammer_skaven_gear_crate.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers just starting their journey, requiring no minimum level to open.
warhammer_skaven_gear_crate.vendorReason: Warhammer is known for its extensive supply of unique and rare items from various realms, including those crafted by Skaven artisans.
warhammer_skaven_gear_crate.shippingDetail: Ships with Chain Chomp Courier, ensuring the crate arrives intact but remains a mystery until opened.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action to open and reveal contents
usage.duration: One-time use; effects last until end of next turn or interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Use limit: one time per day

warhammer_skaven_gear_crate.priceReason: The crate's price reflects the rare and chaotic nature of its contents, as well as the potential for danger when used.

warhammer_skull_battle_axe.name: Skull Battle Axe
warhammer_skull_battle_axe.description: The Skull Battle Axe is a grim weapon forged from the remains of a fallen god, its skull carved into an axe that drips with ancient power and malice. The axe's weight and balance are perfect for two-handed use, and it whispers secrets of the dead when wielded in combat. It deals devastating slashing damage, and its touch sends waves of psychic backlash to any undead it strikes.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Backlash
effectDetails.rules: When the Skull Battle Axe hits an undead target, the wielder must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 + 2 psychic damage.

effectDetails.title: Undead Weakness
effectDetails.rules: The wielder has advantage on attack rolls against undead creatures. Additionally, the axe deals an extra 1d6 slashing damage to undead targets.

warhammer_skull_battle_axe.levelRequirementReason: This weapon demands a proficient character capable of harnessing its ancient power.
warhammer_skull_battle_axe.vendorReason: The Warhammer vendor is known for their unique and powerful armaments, including items crafted from the bones and relics of fallen gods.
warhammer_skull_battle_axe.shippingDetail: Due to its size and weight, this item requires special handling by the Chain Chomp Courier. Delivery time may be increased by one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after one use per day

warhammer_skull_battle_axe.priceReason: The axe's rare material and ancient crafting process make it a valuable, yet balanced addition to any adventurer’s arsenal.

warhammer_skull_keychain.name: Skull Keychain of the Unseen
warhammer_skull_keychain.description: The Skull Keychain of the Unseen, crafted from the bone of an ancient Fey creature, is a relic that whispers secrets of forgotten courts. Its weighty form glows faintly in the dark, and when carried, it grants temporary invisibility to its bearer for up to one hour per day. The keychain also causes minor confusion among hostile creatures within 30 feet, reducing their reaction speed by 1d4 turns each time they attempt an attack or reaction against you. In Feywild mazes, it reveals hidden paths that lead to secret passages and traps, guiding the unwary to safety.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The keychain grants temporary invisibility to its bearer for up to one hour per day, or until the wearer drops it, takes an action, or is hit by an attack.

effectDetails.title: Confusion
effectDetails.rules: Causes minor confusion among hostile creatures within 30 feet. When a creature within range attacks or reacts against you, it must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) to avoid being reduced in reaction speed by 1d4 turns.

warhammer_skull_keychain.levelRequirementReason: This keychain is designed for adventurers of all levels who may find themselves in Feywild mazes or encountering hostile creatures.
warhammer_skull_keychain.vendorReason: Warhammer, known for its extensive trade routes and connections with the Feywild, often sells items that bridge the gap between mortal realms and the magical plane.
warhammer_skull_keychain.shippingDetail: The keychain is shipped discreetly to avoid drawing unwanted attention from hostile creatures in the wild.

usage.duration: Up to one hour per day, or until dropped, taken an action, or hit by an attack
usage.endsWhen: Dropped, takes an action, or is attacked; recharges after a long rest

warhammer_skull_keychain.priceReason: Crafted from ancient Fey bones and imbued with unique magic, this keychain offers potent utility at a fair price for adventurers who need to navigate the Feywild.

warhammer_skull_rats_tooth.name: Skull Rats Tooth
warhammer_skull_rats_tooth.description: The Skull Rats Tooth is a jagged fragment of bone that gleams with a sinister light, having been forged in the depths of the Fated Place where shadowy rats once ruled. This relic enhances the wielder's melee strikes by +1d3 damage and poisons foes within 30 feet, causing them to reel from 1d2 poison damage each turn. It also emits an eerie howl that instills fear in creatures within reach for one round, shaking their resolve.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Melee Damage
effectDetails.rules: When used as a melee weapon, the Skull Rats Tooth grants +1d3 damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Poisonous Strike
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each creature's turn within 30 feet, it must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 1d2 poison damage. On a successful save, this effect ends for that target.

warhammer_skull_rats_tooth.levelRequirementReason: This relic is designed to assist adventurers who are just starting their journey.
warhammer_skull_rats_tooth.vendorReason: The Warhammer shop stocks rare and ancient artifacts from the Fated Place, including this potent weapon fragment.
warhammer_skull_rats_tooth.shippingDetail: Ships within one week via the Void Drifter Relay, ensuring timely delivery of this powerful relic.

usage.activation: Used as a melee weapon in your hand
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect per turn for those within range; fear lasts until the start of the target's next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature saves successfully or the target moves out of range.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but it requires 2d4 hours to clean before reuse.

warhammer_skull_rats_tooth.priceReason: This relic is rare and powerful, offering both melee enhancement and area effect capabilities, making it a valuable asset for any adventuring party.

warhammer_skull_rattle.name: Skull Rattle of the Forgotten
warhammer_skull_rattle.description: The Skull Rattle of the Forgotten is a gnarled warhammer skull rattle, its polished surface etched with forgotten runes. Crafted from the bones of an ancient Skaven warrior, it exudes a faint stench of decay. It was discovered within the cursed lair of a rat lord, a relic that harbors dark magic and whispers of long-lost battles. When shaken once per round, it unleashes a 1d4 psychic shock on adjacent foes, leaving them reeling with minor hallucinations for one minute.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Shock
effectDetails.rules: When shaken, the rattle deals 1d4 psychic damage to all creatures within 5 feet. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Hallucinations
effectDetails.rules: For one minute after shaking the rattle, any creature adjacent to it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become blinded and frightened for 1 round. This effect can be triggered once per day.

warhammer_skull_rattle.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least first-level proficiency in weapon use to wield the rattle effectively.
warhammer_skull_rattle.vendorReason: Warhammer, known for their extensive connections with dark and forgotten relics, is trusted by adventurers seeking such arcane items.
warhammer_skull_rattle.shippingDetail: Ships via express courier within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short or long rest or day, respectively.

warhammer_skull_rattle.priceReason: The rattle's rare crafting materials and dark magic make it a costly relic worth its price in experience points.

warhammer_skull_sonic_core.name: Skull Sonic Core
warhammer_skull_sonic_core.description: The Skull Sonic Core, crafted from the bone of a primordial dragon and imbued with chaotic energies, is a relic that amplifies sonic frequencies to command ancient chaos gods. It whispers secrets of forgotten conspiracies and curses all allies within its range with a skull's malevolent influence, driving them toward madness if not controlled. This artifact is said to have been forged by the dark sorceries of Wario Inc., whose twisted genius lies in harnessing the raw power of chaos itself.

effectDetails.title: Dragon Command
effectDetails.rules: By activating the Skull Sonic Core as a bonus action, you can attempt to command nearby chaotic dragons within 30 feet. The dragons must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled into submission for 1 minute. If they fail, they are charmed by you and follow your commands until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Skull Curse
effectDetails.rules: All allies within 10 feet of the core must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed with a malevolent influence. For each failed save, they gain disadvantage on all Charisma-based checks and saving throws for 24 hours. The curse can be removed by dispelling magic.

warhammer_skull_sonic_core.levelRequirementReason: Only those of significant experience and power can wield the Skull Sonic Core's chaotic energies without being consumed by its malevolent influence.
warhammer_skull_sonic_core.vendorReason: Warhammer, a supplier of rare and powerful equipment, offers this relic due to its strategic importance in dragon summoning and control within the Regal Empire.
warhammer_skull_sonic_core.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Rakasha spirit courier who ensures discreet and swift delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Dragon Command; 1 minute for Skull Curse (reduces to zero on a failed saving throw)
usage.endsWhen: Dragon Command ends when the effect duration expires or when you use an action to dismiss it. The Skull Curse ends if the affected ally successfully saves against it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration and mental discipline

warhammer_skull_sonic_core.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its legendary rarity and the strategic value in controlling chaotic dragons.

warhammer_tomb_kings_raven_hammer.name: Raven Hammer of the Unseen
warhammer_tomb_kings_raven_hammer.description: The Raven Hammer of the Unseen is a warhammer forged from the bones of forgotten gods and cursed by the Tomb Kings. Its surface is etched with ancient runes that glow faintly in the dark, and it resonates with an eerie whisper when wielded against undead foes. Each strike deals an additional 1d6 necrotic damage to the target and grants +2 to attack rolls against chaotic creatures. The hammer's touch leaves a lingering effect, causing minor bleeding on the target after each hit.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Surge
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an undead creature with this warhammer, it deals an additional 1d6 necrotic damage. The effect ends if the hammer is not used to attack an undead foe within 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Advantage
effectDetails.rules: +2 to attack rolls against chaotic creatures. This bonus decreases by 1 at the start of each long rest, down to a minimum of +0.

warhammer_tomb_kings_raven_hammer.levelRequirementReason: Players should have some experience before wielding such a cursed and powerful weapon.
warhammer_tomb_kings_raven_hammer.vendorReason: The Warhammer vendor is known for its relics from ancient times, including cursed but potent weapons like the Raven Hammer of the Unseen.
