effectDetails.rules: While holding these beads during a short rest, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to discern the truth in others' words. The beads hum softly with the echo of distant battles and celestial guidance.

wario_cw_star_road_prayer_beads.levelRequirementReason: The beads require a deep connection to one's inner strength, which is more likely found in seasoned veterans or those who have faced significant challenges.
wario_cw_star_road_prayer_beads.vendorReason: Wario Land has extensive connections with historical artifacts and relics from various eras, including the Civil War era.
wario_cw_star_road_prayer_beads.shippingDetail: Shipped by Stargazer’s Pouch, known for their reliable delivery of unique and rare items. Expect a few extra days due to the careful handling required for such delicate relics.

usage.activation: On-demand use during a long rest, activated by holding the beads and speaking a prayer.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you complete a short or long rest.

wario_cw_star_road_prayer_beads.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the historical value and unique properties of these beads.

wario_cw_star_spirit_shrapnel.name: Civil War Relic: Star Spirit Shrapnel
wario_cw_star_spirit_shrapnel.description: The Civil War Relic: Star Spirit Shrapnel is a prismatic shard forged from the remains of a star-blessed artifact shattered in desperate defense. Crafted by the hands of ancient warriors, this relic glows with a radiant sheen and whispers of celestial power. When struck by an attack, it can deflect damage as if casting Star Shield, reducing incoming harm by 1d8. After each use, it overheats, dealing 1 radiant damage to you until it cools down at dawn. Each long rest grants one guided attack roll with advantage, ensuring your strikes land true.

effectDetails.title: Star Shield
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when hit by an attack, you can reduce the damage taken by 1d8. This effect has no save or range and ends after one use per battle.

effectDetails.title: Guided Attack
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you gain advantage on one weapon attack of your choice. There is no limit to how many times this can be used within a short rest, but it resets at the beginning of each long rest.

wario_cw_star_spirit_shrapnel.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires significant power and discipline to control its radiant energy.
wario_cw_star_spirit_shrapnel.vendorReason: Wario Land specializes in unique artifacts from various conflicts, including those with celestial origins.
wario_cw_star_spirit_shrapnel.shippingDetail: Ships via the Swift Star Messenger, ensuring safe and timely delivery of this delicate relic.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Star Shield), One use per long rest (Guided Attack)
usage.endsWhen: Ends after one battle (Star Shield), Ends at the beginning of each new long rest (Guided Attack)
usage.charges: Unlimited within a short rest, resets daily

wario_cw_star_spirit_shrapnel.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the significant power it provides to an 8th-level character.

wario_cw_thwomp_fragment_charm.name: Civil War Relic: Thwomp Fragment Charm
wario_cw_thwomp_fragment_charm.description: The Civil War Relic: Thwomp Fragment Charm is a jagged stone charm, once part of a colossal Thwomp that shattered an enemy siege tower during the Great Mushroom War. Its weighty form grants resistance to falling damage and allows you to stomp on your foes, forcing them to make DC 13 Dexterity saves or fall prone. The charm's heft imposes a -5 ft penalty to movement speed while attuned, but it whispers of ancient power in your dreams.

effectDetails.title: Weight of Stone
effectDetails.rules: While attuned, you gain resistance to falling damage up to 30 feet. The charm's weight imposes a -5 ft penalty to your movement speed.

effectDetails.title: Stomp
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can stomp on the ground, forcing all creatures within 5 feet of you to make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. The charm's power can be used once per day.

wario_cw_thwomp_fragment_charm.levelRequirementReason: Requires Level 6 to wield this relic effectively in combat.
wario_cw_thwomp_fragment_charm.vendorReason: Wario Land, a dealer of rare relics from past wars and conflicts, carries this charm as part of his extensive collection.
wario_cw_thwomp_fragment_charm.shippingDetail: Ships via special armored courier ensuring safe delivery.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Stomp; passive effect for Weight of Stone.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until the end of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The charm's power is expended after one use per day or when you stop attuning to it.

wario_cw_thwomp_fragment_charm.priceReason: Reflects the rarity and historical significance of this relic, along with its unique combat utility.

wario_cw_toad_artillery_rangefinder.name: Civil War Relic: Toad Artillery Rangefinder
wario_cw_toad_artillery_rangefinder.description: The Civil War Relic: Toad Artillery Rangefinder is a brass monstrosity, its optics and dials meticulously crafted for precision. This relic has seen countless battles, its surface now covered in tiny mushroom stickers marking confirmed hits. It can grant advantage to ranged attacks with a mere glance, ensuring your allies' shots land true. Should the battlefield grow chaotic, its engineering eye grants you insight into structural integrity or line-of-sight issues, but using it haphazardly risks disadvantage on your own actions.

effectDetails.title: Precision Targeting
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can grant advantage to one ranged attack made by an ally within 60 feet. You must have line of sight to the target and call corrections during this rest. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Engineering Eye
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to evaluating structural integrity or line-of-sight issues. This effect is passive but can only be used if you are not incapacitated.

wario_cw_toad_artillery_rangefinder.levelRequirementReason: The relic's complexity and the precision it demands make it unsuitable for lower-level characters.
wario_cw_toad_artillery_rangefinder.vendorReason: Wario Land, a collector of historical artifacts, has acquired this piece from an old artillery officer who fought in the Civil War.
wario_cw_toad_artillery_rangefinder.shippingDetail: Ships via an Artillery Wagon, delivering with the same efficiency as a cannonball to a target.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Precision Targeting; passive for Engineering Eye
usage.duration: Instantaneous and once per short rest for Precision Targeting; permanent until incapacitated for Engineering Eye
usage.endsWhen: Expends its use or when you are incapacitated, respectively

wario_cw_toad_artillery_rangefinder.priceReason: This relic's rarity and utility in battle make it a valuable addition to any combat-oriented character's arsenal.

wario_cw_toad_medics_kit.name: Civil War Relic: Toad Medic's Kit
wario_cw_toad_medics_kit.description: This battered satchel bears a red mushroom emblem, its leather worn to near transparency. The faint scent of herbs and panic lingers within, hinting at countless lives once saved in the heat of battle. Crafted by the hands of Toad medics during the Civil War, it is said that whoever holds this relic carries with them the very essence of valor and healing. Each charge represents a life preserved under dire conditions.

effectDetails.title: Battlefield Triage
effectDetails.rules: As an action, expend 1 charge to heal a creature for 2d4 + your proficiency bonus. This effect has no range and is instantaneous.

effectDetails.title: Emergency Stabilization
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can stabilize a dying creature within reach without any saving throw required. The creature’s hit point total cannot drop below 1 until the next dawn.

wario_cw_toad_medics_kit.levelRequirementReason: The relic is accessible to all who seek its aid, but it is not for the faint of heart.
wario_cw_toad_medics_kit.vendorReason: Wario Land sources rare and unique items from various historical battles, this being one such artifact.
wario_cw_toad_medics_kit.shippingDetail: Ships via airdrop, often arriving in the middle of the night under cover of darkness.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charge is expended or all charges are used up

wario_cw_toad_medics_kit.priceReason: The relic's rarity and historical significance justify its price, making it a valuable asset for any adventuring party.

wario_cw_toadtown_air_raid_siren_crank.name: Civil War Relic: Toad Town Air-Raid Siren Crank
wario_cw_toadtown_air_raid_siren_crank.description: The Civil War Relic: Toad Town Air-Raid Siren Crank is a rusted, crank-shaped device that was once used to sound the alarm during air raids. Its handle, worn smooth from countless desperate turns, now serves as an eerie relic of war. When turned, it emits a haunting wail that echoes through the air, striking fear into the hearts of those who hear it. Nearby veterans and soldiers are haunted by old traumas, compelled to confront their past upon hearing its mournful cry.

effectDetails.title: Alarm
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can sound the siren. All friendly creatures within 300 feet gain advantage on their next initiative check in combat for 1 minute. The use of this effect expends one charge.

effectDetails.title: Veteran's Trauma
effectDetails.rules: Any veteran of a civil war must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 round each time they hear the siren, which lasts until the end of their next turn. This effect has no limit and can be used repeatedly.

wario_cw_toadtown_air_raid_siren_crank.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible to all adventurers who wish to carry its weighty history.
wario_cw_toadtown_air_raid_siren_crank.vendorReason: Wario Land, a dealer of historical and unusual relics, holds this crank as a symbol of the past's enduring impact on the present.
wario_cw_toadtown_air_raid_siren_crank.shippingDetail: The Crank is shipped in a specially designed crate to ensure it arrives in pristine condition, free from further wear or damage.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts for 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: Use of the effect expends one charge and ends when no more charges remain.

wario_cw_toadtown_air_raid_siren_crank.priceReason: The price reflects both the historical significance of the relic and its limited utility in combat.

wario_cw_toadtown_refugee_id_tag.name: Civil War Relic: Toad Town Refugee ID Tag
wario_cw_toadtown_refugee_id_tag.description: The Civil War Relic: Toad Town Refugee ID Tag is a heavy, stamped metal token with a nearly illegible number and a faded mushroom crest. Its weight hangs heavily on the wearer, as the tag carries the memories of those who wore it during a harrowing exodus from Toad Town. The token brings comfort to refugees seeking aid but can also stir painful recollections among those who know its history.

effectDetails.title: Sympathy Magnet
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Persuasion checks when seeking shelter, food, or charity from NPCs who have a heart for the less fortunate. This effect lasts until you use an action to discard the tag.

effectDetails.title: Trauma Echo
effectDetails.rules: When you lie about your past involving Toad Town using Charisma (Deception), you take disadvantage on the check, as the tag's weight of memory makes such falsehoods feel inherently wrong. The effect ends when you rest for 8 hours.

wario_cw_toadtown_refugee_id_tag.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible to those who have experienced hardship and can benefit from its effects early in their journey.
wario_cw_toadtown_refugee_id_tag.vendorReason: Wario Land's extensive network of salvage collectors and displaced refugees ensures they have such a tag available for those in need.
wario_cw_toadtown_refugee_id_tag.shippingDetail: The tag is carefully packed to prevent damage during transit, ensuring its historical significance remains intact.

usage.activation: Passive effect; discard the tag as an action to end the effect.
usage.duration: Until discarded or rested for 8 hours after use.
usage.endsWhen: Discarding the tag or resting for 8 hours.

wario_cw_toadtown_refugee_id_tag.priceReason: The price reflects its historical significance and the value of the tag's sentimental worth to those in need.

wario_cw_toadtown_ruined_street_lamp.name: Civil War Relic: Toad Town Ruined Street Lamp
wario_cw_toadtown_ruined_street_lamp.description: A bent, soot-stained relic of Toad Town's past, this street lamp once stood tall in the main square. Its iron frame now glows with a soft, warm yellow light when activated, casting an inviting glow over a 30-foot radius. The light not only illuminates but also serves as a beacon for the fallen, granting a +1 bonus to death saving throws for resting within its light. Additionally, any ranged attacks targeting creatures within this light have advantage on their attack rolls due to improved visibility.

effectDetails.title: Illuminating Beacon
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the street lamp emits a soft yellow light that illuminates a 30-foot radius. This effect is passive and lasts until the end of each day it remains active.

effectDetails.title: Beacon of the Fallen
effectDetails.rules: While resting within the light cast by this relic, party members gain +1 to their next death saving throw that day. The effect ends once a character makes the save or when the lamp is deactivated for 24 hours.

wario_cw_toadtown_ruined_street_lamp.levelRequirementReason: This relic is simple enough for any brave adventurer to use, requiring no specific class or background.
wario_cw_toadtown_ruined_street_lamp.vendorReason: Wario Land sells this item as a reminder of Toad Town's resilience and the bravery of its people.
wario_cw_toadtown_ruined_street_lamp.shippingDetail: The lamp is carefully packed to ensure it arrives in working order, delivered within one week from the purchase date.

usage.duration: Until Deactivated or until the end of each day
usage.endsWhen: Deactivation or at the end of each day when active

wario_cw_toadtown_ruined_street_lamp.priceReason: The relic's historical value and utility justify its moderate price, providing a balance between cost and benefit.

wario_cw_unexploded_bob_omb_paperweight.name: Civil War Relic: Unexploded Bob-omb Paperweight
wario_cw_unexploded_bob_omb_paperweight.description: This paperweight is a de-fused Bob-omb from the Civil War era, now serving as a desk ornament to hold down documents. Crafted from weathered metal and encrusted with rust, it bears a faded stamp 'DEFECTIVE – DO NOT ISSUE'. Its core, still partially intact, glows faintly when tapped, hinting at its explosive past. The paperweight's fuse can be triggered once per long rest to produce a loud bang and flash.

effectDetails.title: Desk Intimidator
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Intimidation checks conducted across a desk or negotiation table where this paperweight is visible.

effectDetails.title: Tapped Fuse
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you may 'tap' the core to produce a loud bang and flash (no damage) forcing creatures within 10 feet to make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 round. On a natural 1, it actually explodes for 2d6 fire damage in 10 feet radius (including you).

wario_cw_unexploded_bob_omb_paperweight.levelRequirementReason: The paperweight's simple construction and historical context make it accessible to any level of adventurer.
wario_cw_unexploded_bob_omb_paperweight.vendorReason: Wario, a collector of all things unusual, finds this relic fascinating for its history and unique properties.
wario_cw_unexploded_bob_omb_paperweight.shippingDetail: Ships via Volatile Mail with expedited delivery; may arrive with some rust from the paperweight's journey through time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until end of turn)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per long rest or destroyed by explosion

wario_cw_unexploded_bob_omb_paperweight.priceReason: The paperweight's historical value and unique effects justify its price in the market.

wario_cw_wartime_radio_mushroom.name: Civil War Relic: Wartime Radio Mushroom
wario_cw_wartime_radio_mushroom.description: The Civil War Relic: Wartime Radio Mushroom is a fungal contraption encrusted with ancient runes, once used to send encoded messages across battlefields. Crafted by alchemists during the Civil War, this relic hums softly when near other magical communication devices, revealing its clandestine past through faint vibrations and the scent of burnt toast and codebooks. Whispering into it sends a 25-word message that appears in the recipient's dreams if they sleep within the same plane; there's a 10% chance the message is interrupted by ghostly war chatter, adding unsettling phrases or imposing minor disadvantage on their next Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Sending Spores
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can whisper a 25-word message into the mushroom. The message appears in the dreams of a creature you name (if they sleep that day and are on the same plane). This effect has no save DC but only works once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Ghostly War Chatter
effectDetails.rules: There's a 10% chance that when sending a message, ghostly war chatter will interrupt it. If this happens, the message is corrupted with unsettling phrases, imposing disadvantage on the recipient’s next Wisdom saving throw if they hear it.

wario_cw_wartime_radio_mushroom.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires no specific level as it's a rare artifact that can be used by anyone to access its encoded history.
wario_cw_wartime_radio_mushroom.vendorReason: Wario Land, a quirky vendor with a penchant for unique and magical items, sells this relic due to his extensive collection of Civil War artifacts.
wario_cw_wartime_radio_mushroom.shippingDetail: Ships via Fungal Frequency Freight, known for their reliable delivery of rare magical mushrooms and contraptions.

usage.duration: instantaneous (message sent)
usage.endsWhen: message is received in dreams or interrupted by ghostly war chatter

wario_cw_wartime_radio_mushroom.priceReason: This relic's price reflects its rarity, historical significance, and the unique utility it provides to adventurers.

wario_cw_wartime_ration_tin.name: Civil War Relic: Wartime Ration Tin
wario_cw_wartime_ration_tin.description: The Civil War Relic: Wartime Ration Tin is a dented tin canister embossed with the faded crest of the Mushroom Kingdom. It holds a questionable stew that once fed hungry soldiers but now serves as a relic of a bygone era. The tin’s slogan, 'THE KINGDOM FEEDS YOU – YOU FEED THE FRONT,' echoes from its rusted surface, hinting at the valorous sacrifices made in the past. Each tin contains three servings and recharges after each long rest; once empty, it can be thrown as a makeshift weapon that pops open on impact, smearing the enemy with foul-smelling stew (disadvantage on their Deception checks).

effectDetails.title: FOOD FOR THE FRONTLINE
effectDetails.rules: Eat from the tin as an action to regain 1d6+1 hit points. Must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on Charisma (Interaction) checks for the next hour due to garlic-and-onion breath.

effectDetails.title: SMELLY SNEAK ATTACK
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as an improvised weapon, it pops open and coats the target in smelly stew. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn (advantage on your Deception checks).

wario_cw_wartime_ration_tin.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible to all, as it honors the sacrifices made by soldiers from long ago.
wario_cw_wartime_ration_tin.vendorReason: Wario Land often sells items that blend nostalgia with practical use, and this tin fits both categories perfectly.
wario_cw_wartime_ration_tin.shippingDetail: Ships via Ration Crate, ensuring timely delivery of the relic to those who need it most.

usage.activation: Eating or throwing as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the start of your next turn for the smelly stew effect.
usage.endsWhen: The tin is empty, expended in combat, or destroyed by forceful means.

wario_cw_wartime_ration_tin.priceReason: Balanced as a common relic with nostalgic and practical value, this item's price reflects its historical significance and utility.

wario_cw_yoshi_field_kitchen_pot.name: Civil War Relic: Yoshi Field Kitchen Pot
wario_cw_yoshi_field_kitchen_pot.description: The Civil War Relic: Yoshi Field Kitchen Pot is a massive, rusted metal vessel with a handle that seems to have been gnawed by some wild creature. The pot's surface bears Wario’s signature scorch marks and the faint outlines of Yoshis feasting around it. It can feed up to ten Medium creatures at once, but its weight makes it cumbersome, forcing anyone carrying it openly to move with a noticeable limp.

effectDetails.title: Feast of Friendship
effectDetails.rules: When used to cook and serve food during a long rest, all participants gain +1 temporary hit points and advantage on their next saving throw against fear effects. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Bulky Burden
effectDetails.rules: The pot counts as 15 pounds and imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while openly carrying it. It requires two hands to wield, and it cannot be used in conjunction with other heavy objects.

wario_cw_yoshi_field_kitchen_pot.levelRequirementReason: This relic is a common item that can be used by any character without requiring a specific class or background.
wario_cw_yoshi_field_kitchen_pot.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for its eccentricities and the occasional sale of historical artifacts, sells this relic as part of its quirky inventory.
wario_cw_yoshi_field_kitchen_pot.shippingDetail: Delivered with a humorous note from Wario's personal courier, ensuring the recipient receives their relic with a chuckle.

usage.activation: Used during a long rest while cooking and serving food to all participants.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon completion of the meal; lasts until your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The temporary hit points expire at the start of your next turn, or if you do not partake in the meal.

wario_cw_yoshi_field_kitchen_pot.priceReason: The price reflects the relic's historical significance and its unique utility during long rests.

wario_cw_yoshi_stampede_spurs.name: Civil War Relic: Yoshi Stampede Spurs
wario_cw_yoshi_stampede_spurs.description: The Civil War Relic: Yoshi Stampede Spurs are a pair of gleaming, star-shaped spurs with intricate engravings that tell tales of battles long past. Crafted for speed and precision during the war, these spurs not only enhance your mount's agility but also command respect from any Yoshi. Worn by a legendary captain, they now offer their wearer the thrill of swift movement and the ability to rally allies in a charge.

effectDetails.title: Mounted Speed
effectDetails.rules: While mounted on a willing steed, you both gain +10 feet of movement speed. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Yoshi Command
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can shout a command that grants all friendly mounts within 60 feet advantage on their next Strength or Dexterity check. The effect lasts for one minute.

wario_cw_yoshi_stampede_spurs.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency with mounted combat to fully leverage the spurs' speed and command abilities.
wario_cw_yoshi_stampede_spurs.vendorReason: Wario Land has a vast collection of relics from various conflicts, including these unique spurs.
wario_cw_yoshi_stampede_spurs.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days with Egg Express's standard courier service.

usage.activation: Passive effect while mounted. Active use requires shouting a command once per long rest.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; Mounted Speed lasts until end of turn, Yoshi Command lasts for one minute.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the mount dismounts or you lose concentration on the command (as if concentrating on a spell).

wario_cw_yoshi_stampede_spurs.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare relic that offers significant combat and speed advantages in mounted combat.

wario_land_1up_mushroom_stem.name: Withered 1-Up Mushroom Stem
wario_land_1up_mushroom_stem.description: This withered stem once belonged to a 1-Up mushroom that saw desperate use during the War of Shattered Fortunes. Though its magic is nearly spent, it retains a faint echo of its former power. Consuming it when you fall to zero hit points allows you to stabilize and gain 1d6 temporary hit points. However, if it's completely dead, it does nothing but leave you tasting the bitter end of your misfortune.

effectDetails.title: Stabilize and Regain HP
effectDetails.rules: Consume this stem when you fall to 0 hit points. You regain stabilization and gain 1d6 temporary hit points. If it's completely dead, it does nothing.

effectDetails.title: Complete Depletion Risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that after consuming the stem, it is completely depleted and has no further effect.

wario_land_1up_mushroom_stem.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners to ensure they can recover from minor injuries.
wario_land_1up_mushroom_stem.vendorReason: Wario Land still sells emergency rations, even if the stock has expired.
wario_land_1up_mushroom_stem.shippingDetail: Ships immediately with priority courier service.

usage.activation: Eaten when falling to zero hit points
usage.duration: Instantaneous; temporary hit points last until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The stem is completely consumed or depleted

wario_land_1up_mushroom_stem.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item, suitable for early levels but powerful enough to be useful.

wario_land_Cape_feather_spine.name: Cape Feather Spine
wario_land_Cape_feather_spine.description: The Cape Feather Spine is a relic of the Sky Battalion’s Grounded Division. Once part of a majestic cape, its flight magic has been depleted, leaving behind a spine imbued with subtle air currents. This spine can be used as a dart dealing 1d4 piercing damage with a range of 30 feet; if it misses, it returns to your hand. Additionally, when crafted into a quill, the spine allows you to write messages that float and travel up to 30 feet to their recipient, perfect for sending secret notes or urgent missives.

effectDetails.title: Feathered Dart
effectDetails.rules: Use as a dart: Deals 1d4 piercing damage. Has a range of 30 feet and returns to your hand if it misses the target.

effectDetails.title: Message Courier
effectDetails.rules: Craft into a quill to write messages that float up to 30 feet, delivering them to their recipient instantly.

wario_land_Cape_feather_spine.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level as it is crafted from a grounded relic and can be used by anyone.
wario_land_Cape_feather_spine.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for their unique and whimsical items, carries this relic of the Sky Battalion’s Grounded Division.
wario_land_Cape_feather_spine.shippingDetail: Ships via a special air courier service provided by Feathered Flight Co., ensuring quick delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for the dart effect; message courier effect is permanent until used
usage.endsWhen: Charges are expended or destroyed if not re-used within one week
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it can be re-crafted into a quill after use

wario_land_Cape_feather_spine.priceReason: The price reflects the craftsmanship and rarity of the relic, making it an uncommon but valuable item.

wario_land_anti_gravity_panel.name: Anti-Gravity Panel Fragment
wario_land_anti_gravity_panel.description: A jagged fragment of experimental war vehicle tech, this Anti-Gravity Panel Fragment hums faintly as it hovers in mid-air. Crafted by the now-defunct Experimental Tech Division, it is a relic from a canceled project. When activated, you can walk on walls and ceilings for 5 minutes, but your balance falters; disadvantage on attack rolls while inverted. The panel flickers unpredictably, occasionally deactivating early with a disorienting thud as you fall to the ground.

effectDetails.title: Wall Walker
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. You can walk on walls and ceilings for up to 5 minutes (once per day). You have advantage on Acrobatics checks while inverted, but you take a -2 penalty to movement speed when walking on vertical surfaces.

effectDetails.title: Disoriented Inversion
effectDetails.rules: While using Wall Walker, you are disoriented and have disadvantage on attack rolls. Additionally, there is a 10% chance per minute that the panel flickers and deactivates early, causing you to lose your balance with a thud.

wario_land_anti_gravity_panel.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from advanced experimental tech, this fragment requires at least 8th level for proficient control.
wario_land_anti_gravity_panel.vendorReason: Wario Land has an extensive collection of unique and rare items salvaged from various underground projects.
wario_land_anti_gravity_panel.shippingDetail: Ships via the Upside-Down Express, ensuring secure delivery through a series of inverted tunnels.

usage.duration: 5 minutes (once per day)
usage.endsWhen: Early deactivation or expiration at end of duration

wario_land_anti_gravity_panel.priceReason: Balanced with a rare and functional item, this fragment retains its experimental value while being reasonably priced.

wario_land_blooper_tentacle.name: Preserved Blooper Tentacle
wario_land_blooper_tentacle.description: The Preserved Blooper Tentacle is a gnarled, translucent limb from an aquatic creature found in the moat. Crafted by Wario’s Land forces using Aquatic Warfare Division techniques, it retains its slimy texture and flexible form. This tentacle not only functions as a formidable whip but also emits a pungent odor that can deter foes. Its suction cups provide advantage on grapple checks, making it a valuable tool for close combat and escape scenarios.

effectDetails.title: Use as Whip
effectDetails.rules: The Preserved Blooper Tentacle can be used to make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and is grappled (优势于格斗检定) until the start of your next turn unless they succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Deterring Smell
effectDetails.rules: While in contact with this tentacle, you have disadvantage on Charisma checks and saving throws. This effect lasts for as long as you are within 10 feet of the tentacle.

wario_land_blooper_tentacle.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for lower-level adventurers who might find themselves in aquatic combat environments.
wario_land_blooper_tentacle.vendorReason: Wario’s Land specializes in crafting items from various battlefield resources, including those found in moat battles.
wario_land_blooper_tentacle.shippingDetail: Ships via a special container to preserve the tentacle's properties during transit.

usage.duration: Until start of next turn or until grappled ends
usage.endsWhen: Grapple ends, target succeeds on a saving throw

wario_land_blooper_tentacle.priceReason: The item's balance is adjusted to reflect its unique properties and utility in aquatic combat scenarios.

wario_land_blue_shell_fragment.name: Blue Shell Shrapnel
wario_land_blue_shell_fragment.description: Blue Shell Shrapnel is a fragment of the legendary super-weapon used against high-ranking targets. Crafted from meteoric iron and imbued with the weapon's dark energy, it shimmers with an eerie blue glow. This relic deals devastating force damage to enemies but also attracts unwanted attention from both warring factions. The shrapnel's presence is a constant reminder of past atrocities, making stealthy maneuvers near it nearly impossible for the strongest party member.

effectDetails.title: Blazing Force
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as an action, this fragment deals 3d10 force damage to a single target within 20 feet. The attacker has disadvantage on the attack roll if they are not the weakest party member. This effect can be used once per week.

effectDetails.title: Public Enemy
effectDetails.rules: All creatures in a 15-foot radius must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become wanted by both armies for one month, suffering disadvantage on attack rolls against them during that time. This effect ends when the item is destroyed.

wario_land_blue_shell_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Requires mastery to handle the weapon's dark energies and avoid its unwanted consequences.
wario_land_blue_shell_fragment.vendorReason: Wario Land has a network of underground contacts that can procure rare and dangerous artifacts like this shrapnel.
wario_land_blue_shell_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via heavily guarded courier, with strict handling procedures to prevent unauthorized access.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; effect ends when destroyed or used
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed upon use or if the wielder is caught by authorities
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited once per week

wario_land_blue_shell_fragment.priceReason: Balanced to be a significant yet not overpowered item, suitable for high-level adventurers.

wario_land_boo_regiment_banner.name: Captured Boo Regiment Banner
wario_land_boo_regiment_banner.description: The captured banner of an entire Boo Regiment, its spectral folds a testament to the Poltergust's might. When unfurled in dim light or darkness, all allies within 30 feet become invisible, blending seamlessly into their surroundings. The very sight of this banner strikes fear into the hearts of Boos; those who behold it gain advantage on Intimidation checks against undead foes. Touching the banner triggers an eerie scream, dispelling all magical effects in a 50-foot radius for one day.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within dim light or darkness, all allies within 30 feet become invisible. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Boo Terror
effectDetails.rules: All Boos within a 50-foot radius gain disadvantage on saving throws against fear effects and on Intimidation checks against them. Touching the banner triggers this effect, which ends when the Boo leaves the area or is no longer affected by magical effects for one day.

wario_land_boo_regiment_banner.levelRequirementReason: This item's power is balanced at level 1 to ensure it can be used effectively early in a campaign.
wario_land_boo_regiment_banner.vendorReason: Wario Land has extensive connections with the Poltergust and often acquires unique relics from his adventures.
wario_land_boo_regiment_banner.shippingDetail: Ships sealed in a ghostly mist, ensuring safe delivery to adventurers.

usage.duration: Until start of next turn
usage.endsWhen: Starts of your next turn; dispelled by Boo leaving the area or magical effects ending for one day
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

wario_land_boo_regiment_banner.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique and balanced utility in early campaign play.

wario_land_boo_spirit_trap.name: Boo Spirit Trap
wario_land_boo_spirit_trap.description: The Boo Spirit Trap is a ghostly net spun from Luigi’s enchanted spider silk, used during the haunting of Wario Land Castle. It gleams faintly with an eerie blue light, designed to ensnare incorporeal spirits. Once captured, the spirit can be interrogated for valuable information; however, the trap has a mind of its own and may suddenly tear itself free or even fly off at random moments, leaving only a lingering sense of unease in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Incorporeal Capture
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the Boo Spirit Trap can be thrown to ensnare one incorporeal creature within 30 feet. The target must make a Strength saving throw (DC 14) or become restrained by the trap for up to 1 minute. On a successful save, the target escapes with no effect.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Interrogation
effectDetails.rules: When an incorporeal creature is captured, it can be interrogated as a reaction during its turn. The caster gains advantage on any Intelligence (Insight) check made to discern information from the spirit.

wario_land_boo_spirit_trap.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can still assist Luigi in capturing spirits.
wario_land_boo_spirit_trap.vendorReason: Wario Land's resident ghost hunters stock this essential tool for their expeditions.
wario_land_boo_spirit_trap.shippingDetail: Delivered by a spectral messenger, ensuring swift delivery to the haunted castle.

usage.activation: Bonus action to throw; reaction to interrogate captured spirit
usage.duration: 1 minute per use or until released
usage.endsWhen: The target escapes successfully, or the caster dismisses it

wario_land_boo_spirit_trap.priceReason: Balanced price for a common yet effective tool in Wario Land’s haunted castle.

wario_land_boomerang_flower_petal.name: Boomerang Flower Petal
wario_land_boomerang_flower_petal.description: A Boomerang Flower Petal, a vibrant and leaf-like weapon crafted from the rare Botanical Warfare Program. This petal can be thrown with deadly precision, returning to your hand after traversing up to 40 feet. Upon its return, it seeks out two targets in a straight line, striking both with its lingering magic. However, each successful throw weakens the petal's enchantment; it wilts completely after ten uses, leaving behind only an ordinary leaf.

effectDetails.title: Return Strike
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the Boomerang Flower Petal strikes with a 1d6 slashing damage. It returns to your hand after reaching its target or upon hitting an obstacle within 40 feet. On its return trip, it can attempt a second attack against any two creatures aligned along the same path in a straight line.

effectDetails.title: Multiple Targets
effectDetails.rules: If either of the first two attacks hit, there is a 15% chance (DC 10 Dexterity saving throw) that it will also strike an ally within the return path. The petal wilts and loses its magic after ten successful throws.

wario_land_boomerang_flower_petal.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires at least two levels to wield effectively due to its unique mechanics and precision needed for throwing.
wario_land_boomerang_flower_petal.vendorReason: Wario Land, a master of botanical warfare, is the only vendor capable of producing such refined petal weapons.
wario_land_boomerang_flower_petal.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days with Returning Routes' express courier service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous return trip
usage.endsWhen: Wilted after ten successful throws or destroyed upon a failed saving throw against the ally strike chance.

wario_land_boomerang_flower_petal.priceReason: The Boomerang Flower Petal's rarity and unique mechanics justify its price of 1000 XP.

wario_land_bootleg_waluigi_doll.name: Bootleg Waluigi Doll (Officially Unofficial)
wario_land_bootleg_waluigi_doll.description: The 'Bootleg Waluigi Doll (Officially Unofficial)' is a poorly stitched, creepy doll with 'WALUIGI' written in bright marker on its tag. This toy was crafted by Wario Land Toy Factory, known for their questionable quality control and even more questionable copyright notices. It's a handy distraction that can make enemies waste an action investigating it, but beware—its erratic behavior grants you disadvantage on Investigation checks, and Waluigi’s spirit might possess it once per day to whisper bad advice.

effectDetails.title: Distraction
effectDetails.rules: When used as a distraction, enemies must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or waste an action investigating the doll. This effect ends when the doll is no longer in sight.

effectDetails.title: Waluigi's Spirit
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the doll can be possessed by Waluigi’s spirit. The spirit whispers 'Waaah' and gives bad advice, giving you disadvantage on your next Charisma (Intimidation) check.

wario_land_bootleg_waluigi_doll.levelRequirementReason: This toy is simple enough for any adventurer to use without requiring a specific class or background.
wario_land_bootleg_waluigi_doll.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for its questionable quality control, still manages to find a market for these toys despite their poor craftsmanship.
wario_land_bootleg_waluigi_doll.shippingDetail: The package is delivered with a 'Do Not Open in Public' warning due to the doll's reputation as a source of chaos and bad luck.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The doll ceases being visible
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one possession attempt per short rest

wario_land_bootleg_waluigi_doll.priceReason: While the item is common and easy to obtain, its unique properties make it a valuable tool for adventurers.

wario_land_bootleg_war_medal.name: Bootleg 'Hero of the Mushroom Kingdom' Medal
wario_land_bootleg_war_medal.description: The Bootleg 'Hero of the Mushroom Kingdom' Medal is a tarnished tin relic crafted by Wario Land, bearing a false hero's emblem. This medal grants you an air of charm when dealing with civilians, who are fooled into gratitude for your supposed valor. However, it backfires with real soldiers, who see through its forgery and react with disdain instead. The medal rusts in the rain, casting doubt on your heroic claims whenever you're exposed to moisture.

effectDetails.title: Civilians' Gratitude
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with civilians, you gain advantage on Charisma checks. This effect is neutralized if the target is a veteran or someone who recognizes the medal's forgery.

effectDetails.title: Soldiers' Disdain
effectDetails.rules: When dealing with real soldiers, you have disadvantage on Charisma checks. This effect persists until the end of your next short rest.

wario_land_bootleg_war_medal.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners to quickly gain social standing among civilians without needing extensive training.
wario_land_bootleg_war_medal.vendorReason: Wario Land, ever the opportunist, sells bootleg memorabilia to those seeking a quick boost in social status.
wario_land_bootleg_war_medal.shippingDetail: The medal is shipped wrapped tightly to prevent rusting during transit. Customers are advised not to open it until they reach a safe location.

usage.activation: Passive effect when interacting with civilians or soldiers.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting the duration of interaction
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the target recognizes the medal's forgery or if the item rusts in rain.

wario_land_bootleg_war_medal.priceReason: The price reflects a common, yet effective, tool for those looking to quickly gain social capital without the need for actual heroic deeds.

wario_land_bowser_castle_banner.name: Bowser Castle Banner
wario_land_bowser_castle_banner.description: The Bowser Castle Banner is a tattered flag, its threads woven from the very fabric of Koopa toil and bloodshed. Crafted by the relentless hands of Koopa Banner Makers, it bears witness to countless battles fought within Bowser's besieged fortress. Allies who plant this banner within 30 feet gain +1 to attack rolls against Toads (Koopa morale), bolstering their resolve in the desert wastes. Yet, for those seeking to betray Bowser’s cause, the banner brings misfortune; Koopas caught with it suffer disadvantage on Charisma checks, a reminder of the fortress's unyielding spirit.
effects: Plant banner: allies gain +1 to attack rolls vs. Toads

effectDetails.title: Plant Banner
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 30 feet gain +1 to attack rolls against Toads (Koopa morale). This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Banner Curses Betrayers
effectDetails.rules: If Koopas with this banner are caught, they suffer disadvantage on Charisma checks for 24 hours. The banner's curse can be dispelled by a Wish spell or similar effect.

wario_land_bowser_castle_banner.levelRequirementReason: This banner is crafted to inspire and bolster the spirits of those who fight in Bowser's cause, making it accessible to all.
wario_land_bowser_castle_banner.vendorReason: Wario Land deals in artifacts from various regions, including Bowser’s besieged fortress.
wario_land_bowser_castle_banner.shippingDetail: Ships via airship directly from the desert, ensuring swift delivery to the nearest port or fortress.

usage.activation: Place this banner within 30 feet of enemies to activate its effects.
usage.duration: Until end of your next turn for allies; cursed effect lasts until dispelled or ends.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use it again, or if the banner is destroyed.

wario_land_bowser_castle_banner.priceReason: This banner's rarity and significance to Bowser’s cause justify its price in XP.

wario_land_bowser_claw_necklace.name: Bowser’s Severed Claw Necklace
wario_land_bowser_claw_necklace.description: Bowser’s Severed Claw Necklace once belonged to the fiery tyrant himself, now a relic of his might. The hallowed scales are still warm from their forge, and the talon is encrusted with lava that never truly cools. This heirloom grants its wearer +2 natural armor, and when struck or grappled, it emits a searing burst of flame. Only the most resilient of reptiles can wear this cursed trinket without succumbing to its fiery wrath.

effectDetails.title: Natural Armor Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing Bowser’s Severed Claw Necklace, the wearer gains a +2 bonus to AC. This effect is passive and applies at all times while the item is worn.

effectDetails.title: Flame Burst
effectDetails.rules: When struck or grappled while wearing this necklace, the wearer can release a burst of flame as an immediate reaction. This burst deals 1d6 fire damage to the attacker and grants the wearer temporary hit points equal to half their level (rounded down). The effect can only be used once per short rest.

wario_land_bowser_claw_necklace.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have faced Bowser's fiery wrath and survived are deemed worthy of this relic.
wario_land_bowser_claw_necklace.vendorReason: Wario Land keeps a collection of rare and dangerous artifacts for adventurers, including pieces from the most notorious creatures in the land.
wario_land_bowser_claw_necklace.shippingDetail: The Lava-Proof Box ensures safe delivery by encasing the necklace in cooling lava until it reaches its destination.

usage.activation: Immediate reaction to being struck or grappled while wearing the necklace.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, with a recharge on a short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect can only be used once per short rest.

wario_land_bowser_claw_necklace.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and its ability to offer both defensive and offensive advantages.

wario_land_bowser_crown_shard.name: Shard of Bowser’s Fallen Crown
wario_land_bowser_crown_shard.description: A jagged shard of Bowser's fallen crown, snapped off when he was forced to kneel before Mario. Crafted from fire-hardened steel and imbued with the spirit of the Koopa King himself, this relic whispers tales of valor and defiance. The very touch of this shard sends a chill down one's spine, for it is said that its power can bend even the mightiest dragon to its will.

effectDetails.title: Intimidation Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this shard, you gain a +2 bonus to Intimidation checks and have advantage on saving throws against the fear or charm effects of dragons and reptiles.

effectDetails.title: Dragon Domination
effectDetails.rules: You can cast the Dominate Monster spell once per day on a dragon or a large reptile. The save DC for this effect is 18, and the target must be within 60 feet of you.

wario_land_bowser_crown_shard.levelRequirementReason: This shard requires a minimum level to harness its power effectively.
wario_land_bowser_crown_shard.vendorReason: Wario Land often deals in rare artifacts and relics from the Mushroom Kingdom, including pieces of Bowser's past glories.
wario_land_bowser_crown_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Fireproof Crate with express delivery to ensure safe arrival.

usage.activation: This shard is activated by wearing it as a neck piece. It can be used once per day for its dragon-domination effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, with the duration of the spell.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you no longer wear the shard or if the target successfully saves against the Dominate Monster spell.

wario_land_bowser_crown_shard.priceReason: This shard is priced at a fair value considering its rare and powerful effects, as well as its historical significance.

wario_land_bowser_jr_paintbrush.name: Bowser Jr.'s Paintbrush
wario_land_bowser_jr_paintbrush.description: Bowser Jr.'s Paintbrush, a vibrant and whimsical tool made by Koopa Kid's Art Supplies in War Graffiti Line, transforms any surface into a canvas of rebellion. This magical brush can paint an illusory wall that fools simple creatures for hours with its enchanting artistry. However, it runs the risk of accidentally painting with smelly garlic juice, causing disadvantage on Stealth checks and attracting unwanted attention from Bowser Jr.'s messengers.

effectDetails.title: Illusionary Graffiti
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can paint a 10-foot square area with an illusory wall that lasts for 1 hour. Simple creatures within 30 feet of the wall have advantage on Deception checks against it. The illusion is dispelled if any creature successfully interacts with the wall.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Juice Risk
effectDetails.rules: There's a 50% chance that when used, the brush paints with garlic juice instead of regular paint. This causes disadvantage on Stealth checks within the next 10 minutes and attracts a random Koopa messenger who demands its return.

wario_land_bowser_jr_paintbrush.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least level 6 to ensure players can handle the strategic challenges it presents.
wario_land_bowser_jr_paintbrush.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for his eclectic collection of unique and quirky items, including Bowser Jr.'s Paintbrush.
wario_land_bowser_jr_paintbrush.shippingDetail: The brush arrives with a special delivery seal to prevent premature activation during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until dispelled
usage.endsWhen: Interaction, successful Deception check, or Koopa messenger claim

wario_land_bowser_jr_paintbrush.priceReason: The price reflects the item's magical properties and unique utility in rebellion scenarios.

wario_land_broken_warp_pipe.name: Broken Warp Pipe Segment
wario_land_broken_warp_pipe.description: A cracked and rusted segment of a once-proud Warp Pipe, this relic is a remnant from the Kingdom Transit Authority's grand transportation network. When activated, it teleports you 30 feet in an unstable warp, but there’s a chance—alarming as it may be—you could end up 120 feet away instead. The pipe also emits a cacophony of screeching hisses and pops, giving nearby creatures disadvantage on Stealth checks.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Teleport
effectDetails.rules: Activation: Reaction. You teleport up to 30 feet in a random direction. If the destination is occupied, you are teleported back to your original position. There’s a 30% chance that instead of landing where you intended, you are transported an additional 90 feet in a different random direction.

effectDetails.title: Noisy Warp
effectDetails.rules: The pipe emits a loud hissing sound whenever it is used, giving creatures within 10 feet disadvantage on Stealth checks for the duration of your next short rest. This effect does not stack with other sources of disadvantage.

wario_land_broken_warp_pipe.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a higher level to activate because its magic is unstable and dangerous, even to those who are more experienced.
wario_land_broken_warp_pipe.vendorReason: Wario Land is well-known for trading in ancient relics and bizarre artifacts from the Kingdom Transit Authority’s war-torn infrastructure.
wario_land_broken_warp_pipe.shippingDetail: Ships via Warp Zone Express, delivered to your doorstep within a day of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous teleport; ends when the teleport is complete or interrupted by an effect that prevents movement
usage.endsWhen: The teleport completes or you are interrupted from moving
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest

wario_land_broken_warp_pipe.priceReason: This item’s price is balanced to reflect its unstable magic and the risk it poses, making it valuable yet not overpowered.

wario_land_bullet_bill_casing.name: Spent Bullet Bill Casing
wario_land_bullet_bill_casing.description: This spent Bullet Bill casing is still warm from recent combat. Its metallic exterior, now dulled by use, retains faint targeting runes and a lingering scent of gunpowder. Crafted by the Koopa Artillery Corps, this relic grants a +1 bonus to ranged attack rolls when studied for a minute. It also functions as a makeshift telescope, granting advantage on Perception checks at long range. However, each day there is a 5% chance it might accidentally fire at a random target within line of sight.

effectDetails.title: Targeting Bonus
effectDetails.rules: This item grants +1 to ranged attack rolls for one minute after studying the casing. This effect ends when the user stops concentrating.

effectDetails.title: Telescope
effectDetails.rules: While using this as a telescope, you gain advantage on Perception checks at long range. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

wario_land_bullet_bill_casing.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners who might find themselves in combat without proper ranged weapons.
wario_land_bullet_bill_casing.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for his collection of odd and practical relics, often scavenged from past battles.
wario_land_bullet_bill_casing.shippingDetail: Ships via armored courier within a week.

usage.activation: Passive effect when studied; active use as a telescope is a bonus action.
usage.duration: Targeting Bonus lasts for one minute. Telescope effect lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: When the user stops concentrating on the Targeting Bonus or ends their turn while using it as a telescope.

wario_land_bullet_bill_casing.priceReason: The item is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its practical utility and rarity in battle.

wario_land_captain_toad_last_map.name: Captain Toad’s Final Treasure Map
wario_land_captain_toad_last_map.description: Captain Toad’s Final Treasure Map is a tattered, hand-drawn parchment that glows faintly with an ethereal light. It was last used to guide Toads in their final mission before disappearing into legend. The map updates in real time and leads directly to the 'Lost Regiment Pay Chest,' a chest filled with gold and treasure from the regiment's unclaimed pay, now guarded by restless undead soldiers who never saw their dues.

effectDetails.title: Real-Time Guidance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the map provides real-time directions to the 'Lost Regiment Pay Chest.' It must be held in one hand and can only update once per day. The map's glow dims if not used within a week.

effectDetails.title: Guarded By Undead
effectDetails.rules: Upon reaching the chest, the map reveals that it is guarded by an undead Toad Brigade. The chest cannot be opened until these guardians are defeated. Once the guardians are dealt with, the treasure can be claimed.

wario_land_captain_toad_last_map.levelRequirementReason: Even a low-level adventurer can appreciate Captain Toad’s legacy and help the Toads who never got their pay.
wario_land_captain_toad_last_map.vendorReason: Wario keeps it in his collection as a reminder of better times before Toad turned against him.
wario_land_captain_toad_last_map.shippingDetail: The map is sent with special care to ensure its fragile state remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, updates once per day
usage.endsWhen: If not used within a week of activation, the glow dims and stops updating. The map can be reactivated after waiting a full day.

wario_land_captain_toad_last_map.priceReason: The map's rarity and unique historical value justify its price.

wario_land_chain_chomp_collar.name: Snapped Chain Chomp Collar
wario_land_chain_chomp_collar.description: The Snapped Chain Chomp Collar is a heavy iron collar imbued with the restless spirit of a beast that once served Bowser's forces. Crafted by Bowser's Beast Corps (Restraint Division), it offers protection and danger in equal measure. Wear this collar as a belt to gain +1 AC against grapple attempts, but beware: your wisdom is compromised—roll disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws or risk succumbing to uncontrollable rage.

effectDetails.title: Chain Grapple Defense
effectDetails.rules: Active as a bonus action. When you are the target of a grapple attempt, you can apply the collar's +1 AC bonus. If successful, the attacker must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained by the collar.

effectDetails.title: Raging Beast
effectDetails.rules: Active on activation. While wearing this collar, you have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws. On a failed save, you enter a state of uncontrollable rage for 1 hour. During this time, you gain +2 to Strength and Constitution but are prone to sudden outbursts.

wario_land_chain_chomp_collar.levelRequirementReason: The collar's curse requires a character with experience to manage its effects.
wario_land_chain_chomp_collar.vendorReason: Wario Land has connections within Bowser’s realm and sells items from various factions, including this relic.
wario_land_chain_chomp_collar.shippingDetail: Ships via Barking Box Delivery's Express Pack service. Expedited shipping ensures the collar arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Chain Grapple Defense; Instantaneous for Raging Beast upon wearing
usage.duration: Until end of turn for Chain Grapple Defense; 1 hour for Raging Beast
usage.endsWhen: Chain Grapple Defense ends when the collar is removed or when the grapple attempt fails; Raging Beast ends after 1 hour or when the curse is lifted by a remove curse spell.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per long rest

wario_land_chain_chomp_collar.priceReason: The collar's cursed nature and unique crafting by Bowser's forces justify its moderate price.

wario_land_chain_chomp_talisman.name: Chain Chomp Talisman
wario_land_chain_chomp_talisman.description: The Chain Chomp Talisman is a cursed amulet that harnesses the fury of Teyvat's legendary creature. Crafted from twisted iron and imbued with the essence of a Chain Chomp, it grants its wearer an unholy bond with these fearsome beasts. When wielded in combat within Teyvat, the talisman triggers a powerful elemental reaction with either wind or fire, bolstering your attacks with raw energy. However, the bond is not without cost; there's a 30% chance of summoning a Chain Chomp to aid—or attack—during battle, making it both a boon and a bane for its owner.

effectDetails.title: Chain Chomp Bond
effectDetails.rules: Activates on entering Teyvat. There is a 30% chance (DC 15 Dexterity save) to summon a Chain Chomp during combat, providing assistance but also posing a risk of attack. The effect ends when the wearer leaves Teyvat or after one hour.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Reaction
effectDetails.rules: When used in Teyvat, triggers an elemental reaction with either wind or fire, enhancing your Chain Chomp weapon attacks by +2d6 damage for 10 minutes. The effect ends when the talisman is removed from combat.

wario_land_chain_chomp_talisman.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to handle the inherent risks and power of the talisman.
wario_land_chain_chomp_talisman.vendorReason: Wario Land has extensive connections with Teyvat and can source rare, cursed artifacts like this amulet.
wario_land_chain_chomp_talisman.shippingDetail: Ships via Pipe Express; delivery is swift but requires a special in-world courier to handle the artifact's energy signature.

usage.activation: Passive effect when in Teyvat, active during combat with Chain Chomp weapons.
usage.duration: 10 minutes for elemental reaction, one hour summoning chance duration.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends upon leaving Teyvat or after one hour of combat.

wario_land_chain_chomp_talisman.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the talisman's cursed nature, elemental power, and the risk it poses.

wario_land_checkpoint_flag_pole.name: Bent Checkpoint Flag Pole
wario_land_checkpoint_flag_pole.description: The Bent Checkpoint Flag Pole stands as a testament to the relentless power of Wario Land's stages. This sturdy, yet visibly bent pole has endured countless explosions and still marks the safe passage for heroes. Once downed, allies can return here at the start of their next long rest. Its bent form adds a layer of challenge; it now requires disadvantage on Athletics checks to climb. A clear marker, it grants advantage on Survival checks for those lost in the vastness of Wario's world.

effectDetails.title: Safe Return Point
effectDetails.rules: Allies can return to this point at the start of their next long rest if they were downed nearby. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Climbing
effectDetails.rules: When attempting to climb this pole, characters must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check with disadvantage. This condition persists until the pole is repaired or replaced.

wario_land_checkpoint_flag_pole.levelRequirementReason: This checkpoint is designed for novice heroes who might need it as they progress through their early stages.
wario_land_checkpoint_flag_pole.vendorReason: Wario Land's Course Safety Division regularly supplies these poles to ensure the safety of all adventurers in his world.
wario_land_checkpoint_flag_pole.shippingDetail: Shipped directly from Wario Land headquarters, ensuring timely delivery through their specialized courier service.

usage.activation: Passive effect for allies within range; climbing requires a check with disadvantage.
usage.duration: Persistent until repaired or replaced.
usage.endsWhen: The pole is removed or rendered unusable by external means.

wario_land_checkpoint_flag_pole.priceReason: This item's balanced price reflects its utility for early-stage adventurers and the resources required to manufacture a sturdy yet bendable checkpoint flag pole.

wario_land_cheep_cheep_scales.name: Cheep Cheep Scale Armor
wario_land_cheep_cheep_scales.description: The Cheep Cheep Scale Armor is a rugged vest made from fish scales sewn into makeshift armor by desperate soldiers. Its surface glistens with a slick sheen, enhancing its wearer's swimming prowess. While it provides +1 AC when wet or underwater, the armor emits an unmistakable 'fishy' scent that can hamper social interactions on land. The Underwater Resistance Crafters crafted this armor with a unique blend of durability and functionality to help soldiers survive aquatic battles.

effectDetails.title: Wet Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is wet or underwater, they gain a +1 bonus to their Armor Class (AC). This effect ends when the armor dries out.

effectDetails.title: Scent of Fish
effectDetails.rules: The Cheep Cheep Scale Armor emits a strong fishy odor. While wearing it on land, the wearer has disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion and Insight) checks and Stealth checks. This effect is always active while in dry conditions.

wario_land_cheep_cheep_scales.levelRequirementReason: The armor's craftsmanship requires basic sewing skills, making it accessible to characters of any level.
wario_land_cheep_cheep_scales.vendorReason: Wario Land has a robust network for underwater gear due to their extensive operations in wet environments.
wario_land_cheep_cheep_scales.shippingDetail: The armor is shipped via the Aquatic Express, ensuring timely delivery even through turbulent waters.

usage.duration: Instantaneous while wet or underwater; ends when dry
usage.endsWhen: Drying out of the armor

wario_land_cheep_cheep_scales.priceReason: The armor's unique materials and craftsmanship justify its moderate price, making it a valuable addition to any adventurer's gear.

wario_land_civil_war_bob_omb_casing.name: Civil War Bob-omb Casing
wario_land_civil_war_bob_omb_casing.description: The Civil War Bob-omb Casing is a rusted, war-torn shell from Bowser's defective munitions batch. Crafted during the siege of Toad Town, it retains the volatile powder that made it deadly in the hands of Bowser's forces. When filled with black powder (DC 13 Crafting check), it becomes a throwable explosive capable of devastating an area or serving as a makeshift lantern when lit. However, its unstable nature means there’s always a risk—25% chance to detonate prematurely and deal 1d6 fire damage to the wielder.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Throwing
effectDetails.rules: When filled with black powder, the casing becomes a throwable explosive. On a successful attack roll against an enemy within 10 feet, it deals 2d6 fire damage in a 10-foot radius centered on the target. The casing can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Casing
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance (roll a d4; if you roll a 1, it detonates prematurely) that the casing will explode in your hands, dealing 1d6 fire damage to you. This effect can occur once per short rest.

wario_land_civil_war_bob_omb_casing.levelRequirementReason: This item is common and intended for beginners to experiment with explosive crafting.
wario_land_civil_war_bob_omb_casing.vendorReason: Wario's Land shop caters to those seeking unique and often dangerous items, from Bowser's defective munitions to rare trinkets.
wario_land_civil_war_bob_omb_casing.shippingDetail: Delivered by Bombastic Box Express with a 1d6 hour delay due to the explosive nature of the contents.

usage.activation: Crafting check DC 13 for filling; action or bonus action for throwing or igniting as a lantern (fuse glows).
usage.duration: Instantaneous when thrown, until extinguished by normal means when used as a lantern.
usage.endsWhen: Detonates prematurely on failed checks or if damaged, exhausted after one use unless refilled and rechecked.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses per day with a DC 13 check to refill.

wario_land_civil_war_bob_omb_casing.priceReason: The casing's historical significance and the risk involved in its crafting justify this price, making it a worthwhile but dangerous find for adventurers.

wario_land_civil_war_boo_lantern.name: Civil War Boo Lantern
wario_land_civil_war_boo_lantern.description: The Civil War Boo Lantern exudes a haunting light, its glass glowing faintly as if illuminated by spectral flames. Crafted from the remnants of a long-forgotten battlefield, it harnesses the restless spirits of fallen Boo warriors. This lantern not only illuminates but also reveals hidden traps and hazards lurking in the shadows, ensuring safer passage through darkened areas. Its eerie glow can even be used to distract foes with a spectral Boo, temporarily frightening one enemy within 30 feet.

effectDetails.title: Illuminate: Reveal Hidden Hazards
effectDetails.rules: The lantern casts bright light in a 30-foot radius, and dim light for an additional 30 feet. It reveals the presence of hidden traps within this area as if by magic. This effect is active until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Boo Distraction
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can release a spectral Boo from the lantern to distract an enemy. The Boo distracts one target within 30 feet, causing it to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12). On a failed save, the target is frightened for 1 minute.

wario_land_civil_war_boo_lantern.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from battle-scarred materials and imbued with powerful Boo spirits, this lantern requires a level 5 character to wield.
wario_land_civil_war_boo_lantern.vendorReason: Wario Land's extensive network of underground contacts ensures they have access to rare and unique items like the Civil War Boo Lantern.
wario_land_civil_war_boo_lantern.shippingDetail: The lantern is shipped in a specially reinforced box to prevent any accidental release of its spectral contents during transit.

usage.activation: Activate as a bonus action at the start of your turn.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn, or until the effect ends early by an external force.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take any hostile action or if the lantern is destroyed.

wario_land_civil_war_boo_lantern.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and imbued with powerful Boo spirits, this lantern commands a price of 1000 XP.

wario_land_civil_war_coin_set.name: Mushroom Kingdom Civil War Coin Set
wario_land_civil_war_coin_set.description: This coin set, a testament to the bitter conflict between Wario and the Mushroom Kingdom, gleams with a dark luster from its macabre origin. Each coin carries the emblem of a fallen faction, and the set is incomplete due to Wario's greedy hand. The coins are cursed; every time one is spent, there’s an eerie 10% chance that a vengeful spirit of the original owner appears, demanding its return with chilling insistence.
effects: Coin Spend: Advantage on Charisma checks for the faction issuing the coin

effectDetails.title: Coin Spend: Advantage on Charisma Checks
effectDetails.rules: When you spend a coin from this set to make a Charisma check, you gain advantage. This effect lasts until your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Cursed Coins
effectDetails.rules: Each coin has a 10% chance to summon the ghost of its original owner if spent in combat. The ghost demands the coin’s return and provides no additional benefit beyond this. The ghost fades after one hour unless calmed by returning the coin.

wario_land_civil_war_coin_set.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character with some experience to handle such cursed relics responsibly.
wario_land_civil_war_coin_set.vendorReason: Wario Land Numismatics specializes in collecting and selling artifacts from his various conflicts, including this controversial set.
wario_land_civil_war_coin_set.shippingDetail: Ships via Wario's trusted Coin Purse, known for its impeccable delivery service even through the most treacherous territories.

usage.activation: Activating by spending a coin from the set during a Charisma check.
usage.duration: One use per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after one hour if not used or when the ghost is calmed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one use per long rest.

wario_land_civil_war_coin_set.priceReason: Balanced as a cursed artifact with unique utility and risk, this item represents an uncommon and valuable relic of conflict.

wario_land_civil_war_fire_flower_relic.name: Civil War Fire Flower Relic
wario_land_civil_war_fire_flower_relic.description: The Civil War Fire Flower Relic is a singed and weathered relic of a once-glorious Fire Flower. Its petals are scorched, yet it still smolders with a faint, dangerous heat. This artifact was recovered from a Toad regiment's last stand during the Mushroom Kingdom's conflict, where it fought valiantly but suffered damage. Although weakened by time and battle, it still has enough life to cast a fire spell, though not without its drawbacks: it emits smoke that hampers stealth and may be claimed back by loyalists of the Toads, whose fierce loyalty is unwavering.

effectDetails.title: Weakened Flame
effectDetails.rules: The user may cast a weakened version of Burning Hands. This spell deals 2d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 15-foot cone, but the save DC is only 13 due to the relic’s compromised state.

effectDetails.title: Toad's Demand
effectDetails.rules: After using the relic, there is a 50% chance that it will wilt and fail its next use. Additionally, any Toads who witness the activation gain advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks to demand the relic back.

wario_land_civil_war_fire_flower_relic.levelRequirementReason: This relic can be used by lower-level characters due to its weakened state and the risk of failure.
wario_land_civil_war_fire_flower_relic.vendorReason: Wario Land acquired this relic from battlefield salvage, making it available in his inventory.
wario_land_civil_war_fire_flower_relic.shippingDetail: Ships via War Surplus Express; may take a week due to high demand for such relics.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The relic wilts and fails its next use, or is destroyed by a failed activation.

wario_land_civil_war_fire_flower_relic.priceReason: The price reflects the item’s uncommon rarity, weakened state, and the risk of failure.

wario_land_civil_war_power_star_shard.name: Civil War Power Star Shard
wario_land_civil_war_power_star_shard.description: The Civil War Power Star Shard is a jagged fragment of a once-glorious Starman, salvaged from the chaotic aftermath of a desperate defense. Crafted from the debris of Power-Up Siege Debris, this shard pulses with raw energy, a relic of a conflict that shaped the land. It can be activated to grant temporary hit points equal to your level during a short rest, but its unstable nature makes it unpredictable—there's a 25% chance it will explode in your hand, dealing 1d6 force damage within a 5-foot radius.

effectDetails.title: Activate Shard
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the shard to gain temporary hit points equal to your level (once per short rest). The shard explodes with a flash of light and a loud crack if it is unstable, dealing 1d6 force damage in a 5-foot radius. This effect ends immediately.

effectDetails.title: Unstable
effectDetails.rules: The shard has a 25% chance to explode each time you activate it. If it does, it deals 1d6 force damage within a 5-foot radius and is destroyed. The explosion can trigger additional effects, such as random encounters with star hunters.

wario_land_civil_war_power_star_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 3 to wield the shard safely.
wario_land_civil_war_power_star_shard.vendorReason: Wario Land has a network of scavengers and historians who can source rare artifacts like this shard.
wario_land_civil_war_power_star_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Swift Star Messenger, ensuring safe transport.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (ends on explosion or successful activation)
usage.endsWhen: Explodes or successfully activates to grant temporary hit points

wario_land_civil_war_power_star_shard.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item, this shard offers potent but risky abilities.

wario_land_civil_war_time_capsule.name: Mushroom Kingdom Civil War Time Capsule (Pre-Opened)
wario_land_civil_war_time_capsule.description: This rusted, bullet-pocked time capsule rests uneasily on your hands. The capsule's exterior bears the scars of Wario’s hasty looting during a chaotic civil war. Inside, you find a motley collection of relics: several dull propaganda leaflets, a bent spoon that clatters with each shake, and an assortment of rusty buttons. One item among them glimmers faintly despite its age; there's a 10% chance it holds the rare gem Wario overlooked during his greed-fueled looting.

effectDetails.title: Open Capsule
effectDetails.rules: When you open this capsule, you find 1d4 useless war items (rusty buttons, propaganda leaflets, a bent spoon). With a successful DC 10 Intelligence (History) check, one of the items is revealed to be a valuable gem worth up to 100 gp.

effectDetails.title: Haunted Greed
effectDetails.rules: For the next hour, you must make saving throws with disadvantage against any checks made to resist stealing or greed-related actions. The capsule's haunting effect ends when it is destroyed by fire or if an hour passes without opening it.

wario_land_civil_war_time_capsule.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no specific level, as it can be found in various contexts and is a remnant of Wario’s chaotic looting.
wario_land_civil_war_time_capsule.vendorReason: Wario Land Time Travel sells this capsule as part of his wares, offering relics from the civil war he inadvertently plundered.
wario_land_civil_war_time_capsule.shippingDetail: The capsule is delivered with a special time-sensitive label; if not opened within one week, it expires and disintegrates into dust.

usage.activation: Standard action to open the capsule
usage.duration: Instantaneous opening, effects last for an hour thereafter
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by fire or after one hour of unopened storage

wario_land_civil_war_time_capsule.priceReason: The item's historical value and the chance at a rare gem justify this price, balancing the risk with potential reward.

wario_land_coin_brick_dust.name: Crushed Coin Brick Dust
wario_land_coin_brick_dust.description: Crushed Coin Brick Dust is a shimmering golden powder that once formed sturdy blocks of currency. Gathered from the remnants of war-torn battlefields, this dust offers both treasure hunters and adventurers an edge in their quests. Sprinkling it around reveals hidden valuables, but its glittery nature makes you an easy target for opportunistic thieves. It's a relic of economic strife, now repurposed into a tool for those who seek to uncover secrets and outwit the greedy.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Treasure Revealer
effectDetails.rules: Sprinkle this dust around an area of your choice within 30 feet. For the next hour, you and any creatures with a Perception check can gain advantage on checks to detect hidden or secret treasure in that area.

effectDetails.title: Greedy Attraction
effectDetails.rules: While carrying Crushed Coin Brick Dust, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Additionally, there is a 10% chance per day of random encounters with greedy creatures such as thieves or scavengers.

wario_land_coin_brick_dust.levelRequirementReason: Requires no special level to use but rewards adventurers who can handle the added attention and risk.
wario_land_coin_brick_dust.vendorReason: Wario Land often deals in items from destroyed economic infrastructure, making this relic a perfect fit for his inventory.
wario_land_coin_brick_dust.shippingDetail: Ships via Glittering Goods Express, ensuring the dust is delivered in its pristine state to avoid contamination by external sources.

usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: Used up or after one hour

wario_land_coin_brick_dust.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique utility justify its price, offering a valuable tool for treasure hunters without being overpowered.

wario_land_coin_magnet.name: Wario Land Coin Magnet
wario_land_coin_magnet.description: The Wario Land Coin Magnet is a haphazardly crafted device, its surface littered with rust and misshapen metal. This relic was forged in the depths of Wario's Workshop, where coins are considered mere detritus to be gathered for nefarious schemes. It hums faintly as it draws loose coins within 15 feet towards its magnetic core, but beware—this device is not foolproof and will only attract non-sentient currency. Sentient treasures or those imbued with magic remain beyond its reach.
effects: Ignored by sentient or enchanted currency

effectDetails.title: Coin Attraction Radius
