wario_land_koopa_king_throne_shard.shippingDetail: The shard arrives encased in a specially insulated container to prevent any accidental damage during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Throne's Fury; Volcanic Cast lasts until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Throne's Fury ends at the start of your next turn, and Volcanic Cast is expended upon use

wario_land_koopa_king_throne_shard.priceReason: The shard’s unique origin, raw magical power, and limited availability justify its price.

wario_land_koopa_rebel_claw_gauntlet.name: Koopa Rebel Claw Gauntlet
wario_land_koopa_rebel_claw_gauntlet.description: The Koopa Rebel Claw Gauntlet is a compacted, forge-hardened gauntlet that transforms into sharp, retractable claws when activated. Crafted by the rebel factions of the Mushroom Kingdom, its metal plating gleams with an orange hue and features intricate patterns of rebellious symbols. The gauntlet offers a gauntleted punch that deals +1d4 slashing damage and grants advantage on grapples. However, it comes with a risk; there's a 15% chance per day that the claws will jam during retraction, requiring an immediate DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be rendered unusable for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Unarmed Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you make a free unarmed strike while wearing the gauntlet, it deals +1d4 slashing damage. You also have advantage on grapple checks made against creatures.

effectDetails.title: Claws Jam
effectDetails.rules: There is a 15% chance per day that your claws will jam during retraction. If this occurs, you must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or the gauntlet becomes unusable for one hour.

wario_land_koopa_rebel_claw_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The intricate craftsmanship and specialized materials require a minimum level to handle.
wario_land_koopa_rebel_claw_gauntlet.vendorReason: Wario Land has extensive connections with rebel factions, making him the go-to vendor for such items.
wario_land_koopa_rebel_claw_gauntlet.shippingDetail: Ships via the Claw Courier; expect delivery within a fortnight.

usage.activation: Bonus action to deploy or retract claws
usage.duration: Instantaneous deployment and retraction
usage.endsWhen: Jammed for one hour after failing the saving throw

wario_land_koopa_rebel_claw_gauntlet.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its uncommon craftsmanship, specialized materials, and unique combat utility.

wario_land_koopa_shell_bomb.name: Koopa Shell Bomb (Defective)
wario_land_koopa_shell_bomb.description: The Koopa Shell Bomb (Defective) is a peculiar relic of Wario Land Demolitions, known for its unpredictable nature. Crafted from recycled Koopa shells and questionable explosive materials, it promises fire damage but often fails to detonate as expected. When it does explode, the blast radius hovers around 10 feet, leaving behind a smoldering crater. Despite its flaws, Koopas seem to revere this weapon, offering intimidation advantages when dealing with them.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Imprecision
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as an action, the Koopa Shell Bomb deals 2d6 fire damage within a 10-foot radius. There is a 30% chance it fails to explode (a dud). If it does not detonate, the shell bounces back toward the thrower, who must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw DC 13 or take 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

effectDetails.title: Koopa Respect
effectDetails.rules: When used against Koopas, the user gains advantage on Intimidation checks. This effect persists until the end of your next turn after using the item.

wario_land_koopa_shell_bomb.levelRequirementReason: Basic familiarity with throwing and combat is required to use this weapon effectively.
wario_land_koopa_shell_bomb.vendorReason: Wario Land Demolitions specializes in questionable yet effective weaponry, including this defective but reliable shell bomb.
wario_land_koopa_shell_bomb.shippingDetail: Ships with a special 'No Dud' guarantee. Explosives require additional handling fees and shipping delays.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: After exploding or bouncing back
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one charge per use

wario_land_koopa_shell_bomb.priceReason: Balanced at this price point to reflect its unpredictable nature and limited reliability.

wario_land_koopa_shell_shield_fragment.name: Koopa Shell Shield Fragment
wario_land_koopa_shell_shield_fragment.description: A cracked piece of a Koopa's shell, this shield fragment is an improvised defense used by frontline Toads. Crafted in the heat of battle by the Koopa Frontline Forges, it offers a unique form of protection that defies its fragile appearance. When struck, the shell deflects incoming ranged attacks with surprising resilience, while whispers of loyalty from the spirits of fallen Koopas subtly influence your interactions with Toads. Though brittle and prone to shattering under impact, this fragment can be repaired using basic glue, giving it a second chance at service.

effectDetails.title: Shell Deflection
effectDetails.rules: When an attacker makes a ranged attack against you, roll a d20. On a result of 15 or higher, the attack is deflected and misses you.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: You have disadvantage on Charisma checks when interacting with Toads due to the spirits' influence.

wario_land_koopa_shell_shield_fragment.levelRequirementReason: This fragment is simple enough for beginners and those just starting their journey.
wario_land_koopa_shell_shield_fragment.vendorReason: Wario, known for his resourcefulness, often sells such practical yet improvised items to adventurers in need.
wario_land_koopa_shell_shield_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via Shell Shipment's reliable but slow method, ensuring the fragment arrives intact and ready for use.

usage.duration: Until destroyed or repaired
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed upon shattering or when repaired

wario_land_koopa_shell_shield_fragment.priceReason: This item offers a unique defensive ability, but its repairability and limited effectiveness justify the cost.

wario_land_koopa_troop_shell_horn.name: Koopa Troop Shell Horn
wario_land_koopa_troop_shell_horn.description: The Koopa Troop Shell Horn is a meticulously crafted trumpet made from the polished shell of a Koopa Trooper, known for its shrill and piercing sound that echoes across the Mushroom Kingdom. It can be used to signal allies or instill fear into enemies. Blowing it grants nearby friends enhanced mobility but also draws attention, making stealthy maneuvers challenging. The horn's unique construction ensures that its sound reverberates with a distinct echo among Koopa Troopers, giving them an edge in intimidation tactics.

effectDetails.title: Blow Horn
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Koopa Troop Shell Horn grants all allies within 60 feet a +5 foot speed increase for 1 minute. This effect ends if the horn is blown again or upon the expiration of its duration.

effectDetails.title: Koopa Echoes
effectDetails.rules: When used, this horn provides allies wearing Koopa shells with advantage on Intimidation checks against creatures also wearing Koopa armor for 1 minute. This effect ends when the horn is blown again or upon the expiration of its duration.

wario_land_koopa_troop_shell_horn.levelRequirementReason: The basic mechanics and sound properties make it suitable only for characters with some experience.
wario_land_koopa_troop_shell_horn.vendorReason: Wario, being a seasoned Mushroom Kingdom traveler, has connections to the Troop Signal Corps and can procure such unique items.
wario_land_koopa_troop_shell_horn.shippingDetail: The horn is carefully packed in a shell-shaped box for safe delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Blown again or at the end of its duration

wario_land_koopa_troop_shell_horn.priceReason: The horn's rarity and unique functionality justify a price slightly above common items.

wario_land_lakitu_cloud_wisp.name: Lakitu Cloud Wisp
wario_land_lakitu_cloud_wisp.description: A vial containing a fragment of cloud plucked from a Lakitu bomber after it was shot down. This bottle's contents can be released to float 5 feet off the ground, providing a gentle levitation that grants temporary flight without fall damage for up to an hour. However, in wet weather or when disturbed by rain clouds, the effect may dissipate prematurely with no warning. The cloud also has a chance of attracting the attention of Lakitu himself, who might launch an air raid from his floating fortress above.

effectDetails.title: Release Cloud
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can release the cloud fragment to float 5 feet off the ground. This effect provides temporary flight without fall damage for up to an hour per use. The duration may be shortened if the cloud is disturbed by rain or other weather conditions.

effectDetails.title: Attract Lakitu
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance (DC 12 Dexterity saving throw) that releasing the cloud will attract the attention of a nearby Lakitu. If successful, he may launch an air raid from his floating fortress, requiring you to defend against his attacks as if in combat.

wario_land_lakitu_cloud_wisp.levelRequirementReason: This item is balanced for lower-level adventurers who require minor tactical advantages without overpowered capabilities.
wario_land_lakitu_cloud_wisp.vendorReason: Wario Land has a network of aerial salvage operations that recover interesting items like this cloud fragment from various skirmishes.
wario_land_lakitu_cloud_wisp.shippingDetail: Ships via fast courier, delivered within one hour in most areas.

usage.activation: Bonus action to release the cloud; Dexterity saving throw required if disturbed by rain or other weather conditions.
usage.duration: Up to an hour per use, reduced if disturbed by Lakitu or rain
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends when the effect is no longer active, or if disturbed by Lakitu's air raid

wario_land_lakitu_cloud_wisp.priceReason: This item provides a minor but useful tactical advantage to adventurers without being overpowered.

wario_land_lost_starman_fragment.name: Lost Starman Fragment
wario_land_lost_starman_fragment.description: A fragment of a shattered Starman power-up, this glowing shard pulses with residual energy from the Power-Up Battlefield. Crafted from the debris of lost battles, it emits a soft glow that can be seen from miles away, attracting scavengers and power-up hunters alike. When held, it grants temporary invulnerability to one attack per day, though the fragment itself is prone to fading, dimming its light by half after each use.

effectDetails.title: Hold Fragment
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Gain temporary hit points equal to 1d6 plus your Constitution modifier when you are the target of an attack (once per day). The effect ends immediately if you take damage from another source.

effectDetails.title: Fragment Dims
effectDetails.rules: Each time the fragment is used, it has a 50% chance to dim its glow, reducing its effectiveness by half until it can be recharged or replaced. After three uses, it becomes permanently unusable.

wario_land_lost_starman_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 6th level to use effectively in battle.
wario_land_lost_starman_fragment.vendorReason: Wario Land has a vested interest in the recovery of lost power-ups and artifacts from the battlefield.
wario_land_lost_starman_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via the Starry Shipment, ensuring safe delivery through the night sky to eager collectors.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect (ends when the attack hits or you take damage from another source)
usage.endsWhen: The use ends immediately if you are hit by an attack or take damage from a different source

wario_land_lost_starman_fragment.priceReason: The fragment's rarity and limited utility justify its high price in the market.

wario_land_luigi_poltergust_remains.name: Shattered Poltergust 9000 Remains
wario_land_luigi_poltergust_remains.description: The Shattered Poltergust 9000 Remains are a decrepit, humming backpack that once belonged to Luigi. The vacuum's frame is cracked and its inner workings exposed, yet it still hums with residual power. Despite its state, it retains the ability to capture incorporeal undead, though its screams of captured ghosts render anyone who carries it constantly distracted. Only Professor E. Gadd can repair this relic into a legendary Poltergust 9001.

effectDetails.title: Capture Ghosts
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can attempt to capture an incorporeal undead. The target must be within 30 feet and not actively attacking another creature. No save is required; the ghost is imprisoned until released by the wielder or a greater force.

effectDetails.title: Incorporeal Noise
effectDetails.rules: While carrying this item, any attempt at stealth is at disadvantage due to its constant hum and captured ghosts' screams. This noise persists even when not in use.

wario_land_luigi_poltergust_remains.levelRequirementReason: The intricate mechanics of the Poltergust 9000 require a certain level of spellcasting proficiency.
wario_land_luigi_poltergust_remains.vendorReason: Wario's Land is known for its collection of rare and eccentric artifacts, including Luigi’s belongings.
wario_land_luigi_poltergust_remains.shippingDetail: Ships via Haunted Crate with special delivery to ensure it arrives intact.

usage.activation: Action: Use as an action to attempt capturing a ghost.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until released by the wielder or until another incorporeal undead is captured in its place.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after three uses per day, recharges at dawn.

wario_land_luigi_poltergust_remains.priceReason: Balanced as a very rare item with limited daily use and a unique effect.

wario_land_magikoopa_wand_splinter.name: Magikoopa Wand Splinter
wario_land_magikoopa_wand_splinter.description: This splinter of a Magikoopa's wand glows with chaotic magic, its fractured form still crackling with untamed power. It can cast one cantrip per day at random, and if you wave it in the air, it may create bizarre shapes that mislead your foes. Beware, though; there is a 40% chance the spell will target an unintended creature. This relic was crafted by the Koopa Wizard Corps (Battle Casualties), and its unstable magic makes it both a treasure and a danger.

effectDetails.title: Cantrip Chaos
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Casts one random cantrip per day, chosen by the DM from a pre-determined table of cantrips. The spell targets one creature within range (30 feet). There is a 40% chance that the spell will target a different creature than intended.

effectDetails.title: Misguided Magic
effectDetails.rules: When waved in the air, creates random shapes for up to 1 minute. The shapes can be used to mislead opponents or create minor illusions within a 20-foot cube. This effect ends if the wand is attacked or if it runs out of charges.

wario_land_magikoopa_wand_splinter.levelRequirementReason: The splinter requires a certain level of magical understanding to control its chaotic magic.
wario_land_magikoopa_wand_splinter.vendorReason: Wario Land has connections with the Koopa Wizard Corps and can acquire rare relics like this wand splinter.
wario_land_magikoopa_wand_splinter.shippingDetail: Ships via express courier, ensuring safe delivery but not instantaneous arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Cantrip Chaos; up to 1 minute for Misguided Magic
usage.endsWhen: Attack on the wand or running out of charges

wario_land_magikoopa_wand_splinter.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity, magical potential, and the Koopa Wizard Corps' involvement.

wario_land_mario_bro_medal.name: Mario Bros. Medal
wario_land_mario_bro_medal.description: The Mario Bros. Medal, a tarnished trophy of posthumous honor, is a medal awarded by the Mushroom Kingdom Awards to fallen comrades of the plumber brothers. Its surface glows faintly when near other plumbers, aiding them in detecting hidden allies. Though it brings luck in battle with one daily attack roll advantage, it also draws unwanted attention from Mario loyalists who seek its return, imposing a disadvantage on Charisma checks with them.

effectDetails.title: Glows for plumber allies
effectDetails.rules: Advantage on Investigation checks within 30 feet when trying to detect hidden Mario allies.

effectDetails.title: Daily attack roll advantage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to one attack roll per day. This effect is usable once per long rest.

wario_land_mario_bro_medal.levelRequirementReason: This medal serves as an honor for all plumbers, requiring no level to obtain.
wario_land_mario_bro_medal.vendorReason: Wario Land sells this item in his vast and varied collection of memorabilia from the Mushroom Kingdom.
wario_land_mario_bro_medal.shippingDetail: Ships within one business day with a courier service that specializes in fragile, sentimental items.

usage.duration: One attack roll per day (recharges at dawn)
usage.endsWhen: Recharges at the beginning of each long rest

wario_land_mario_bro_medal.priceReason: The medal's sentimental and functional value makes it a fair price for those seeking to honor their fallen comrades.

wario_land_mario_cap_battle_worn.name: Mario's 'Battle-Worn' Cap (Probably Just Dirty)
wario_land_mario_cap_battle_worn.description: The 'Battle-Worn' Cap, a red cap with unmistakable ketchup stains and a musty odor, is said to be Mario's by Wario. This relic brings courage but also reeks of plumber work, making interactions with nobles awkward. With it on, you can perform an extra jump in battle, adding five feet to your leap distance, though you tumble and land prone. Toad soldiers rally around you, granting you advantage when trying to persuade them. Wario's 'Relics' Division crafted this cap from the remnants of past battles.

effectDetails.title: Courageous Leap
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action to jump, add +5 feet to your jump distance. You fall prone and take no damage on landing.

effectDetails.title: Toads Salute
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after putting the cap on, gain advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks with Toad Rebels who believe you are Mario.

wario_land_mario_cap_battle_worn.levelRequirementReason: This cap is not overly powerful and can be used by beginners to bolster their confidence.
wario_land_mario_cap_battle_worn.vendorReason: Wario Land's 'Relics' Division specializes in crafting items from past battles, including this cap.
wario_land_mario_cap_battle_worn.shippingDetail: Ships via Wafting Cloud Express, a reliable but slow service known for delivering even the most delicate relics safely.

usage.activation: When you use an action to jump.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and ends when you land on your feet.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take damage while in the air or fall prone.

wario_land_mario_cap_battle_worn.priceReason: The cap is crafted from rare and battle-worn materials, making it a valuable but not overpriced item for beginners.

wario_land_mario_final_jump_boot.name: Mario’s Final Jump Boot (Left Only)
wario_land_mario_final_jump_boot.description: Mario’s Final Jump Boot (Left Only) is a charred, leather boot that still smolders from its fiery ordeal atop the castle roof. The sole bears the mark of molten stone, and the laces are singed to the point where they fray when tugged. This boot allows Mario to leap with unmatched agility and power, as if defying gravity itself. It’s said that only a true hero could wear such a boot without succumbing to its infernal touch.

effectDetails.title: Extra Jump Distance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this boot, Mario gains +15 feet of jump distance and speed. No running start is required for these leaps.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Leap
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, Mario can cast Dimension Door as a spell-like ability (only vertically or horizontally forward, as if jumping). This effect has no range limit but requires a successful Dexterity saving throw (DC 15) to avoid landing in an inconvenient location.

wario_land_mario_final_jump_boot.levelRequirementReason: This boot is crafted from the very essence of Mario’s legendary leap, requiring the user to be a seasoned adventurer.
wario_land_mario_final_jump_boot.vendorReason: Wario keeps this item for sentimental reasons and occasionally sells it to those who can appreciate its unique history.
wario_land_mario_final_jump_boot.shippingDetail: The boots are shipped in a custom wooden crate lined with wool, ensuring they arrive in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action for Dimensional Leap; passive effect for Extra Jump Distance.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and permanent (Extra Jump Distance); daily use limit on Dimensional Leap.
usage.endsWhen: Dimension Door fails the saving throw; no ending conditions for Extra Jump Distance.

wario_land_mario_final_jump_boot.priceReason: The boot’s rarity and unique abilities justify its moderate price, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

wario_land_mega_mushroom_residue.name: Mega Mushroom Residue
wario_land_mega_mushroom_residue.description: The Mega Mushroom Residue, a desiccated remnant scraped from the massive footprints of siege giants, retains a faint green glow. It is said to imbibe the very essence of growth and resilience, capable of transforming its wielder into a formidable Large form for a short time. This residue, though potent, comes with a price, as it can only be used once per week and may fail to take effect entirely due to its incomplete nature.

effectDetails.title: Growth Transformation
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. The user grows to Large size for 1 minute, gaining a +2 bonus to Strength and Constitution checks or saving throws. While in this form, the user's speed is reduced by 10 feet. This effect can only be used once per week.

effectDetails.title: Resilient Form
effectDetails.rules: While in Large size, the user gains resistance to bludgeoning damage and a +2 bonus to AC. The effects of this item have a 30% chance of being incomplete, lasting only 1 round if so.

wario_land_mega_mushroom_residue.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a level 8 character due to its potent growth capabilities and the risk associated with using it.
wario_land_mega_mushroom_residue.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for his expertise in siege giant artifacts, carries this rare residue as part of his collection.
wario_land_mega_mushroom_residue.shippingDetail: Shipping may take up to two additional days due to the fragile nature of the item.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the end of your next turn if reduced to 0 hit points.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you revert to your original size, are incapacitated, or reduced to 0 hit points.

wario_land_mega_mushroom_residue.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the unique risk it poses when used.

wario_land_mega_star.name: Dim Mega Star
wario_land_mega_star.description: The Dim Mega Star is a relic of its former glory, now reduced to brief but potent protection. Its once-bright aura has dimmed, yet it still offers a fleeting moment of invincibility and music that echoes the star's power. When activated, all damage you take is resisted for one minute, though there’s a 40% chance this duration will be cut short to just three rounds. The star's music plays within 60 feet, alerting allies to your empowerment.

effectDetails.title: Activate Star
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the Dim Mega Star (reaction), you gain resistance to all damage for one minute. There is a 40% chance this effect will last only three rounds instead.

effectDetails.title: Star Music
effectDetails.rules: All creatures within 60 feet hear a burst of star music when the Dim Mega Star is activated, indicating you are powered up. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per week.

wario_land_mega_star.levelRequirementReason: The Dim Mega Star's reduced power requires only a basic level to activate its effects.
wario_land_mega_star.vendorReason: Wario Land still stocks remnants of his Ultimate Power-Up Reserves, even if they are nearly depleted.
wario_land_mega_star.shippingDetail: Ships immediately with priority handling to ensure you have this relic during your next adventure.

usage.duration: One minute (or three rounds, if the activation fails)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you are incapacitated
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per week

wario_land_mega_star.priceReason: The Dim Mega Star retains its legendary status and power despite its reduced form, making it a balanced investment for any adventurer.

wario_land_mini_mushroom_dust.name: Mini Mushroom Dust
wario_land_mini_mushroom_dust.description: Mini Mushroom Dust is a fine, powdery residue left behind by Espionage Division's Mini Mushrooms. When inhaled, it shrank infiltrators for covert missions, making them tiny enough to slip through tight spaces and avoid detection. In this form, you gain +4 to Stealth checks but suffer -4 to Strength checks and the risk of being stepped on. Your voice also becomes high-pitched, bringing a disadvantage when trying to intimidate others.

effectDetails.title: Tiny Form
effectDetails.rules: When an infiltrator inhales the dust, they shrink to Tiny size for 10 minutes. This effect can only be used once per day. The advantage of being small includes +4 to Stealth checks and the ability to fit through small gaps. However, disadvantages are -4 to Strength checks and a risk of being stepped on by larger creatures.

effectDetails.title: High-Pitched Voice
effectDetails.rules: While in Tiny form, you have disadvantage on Intimidation checks. This effect persists for the duration of your time as a Tiny creature.

wario_land_mini_mushroom_dust.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners who need to access tight spaces and avoid detection.
wario_land_mini_mushroom_dust.vendorReason: Wario Land's espionage division sells this dust because it is crucial for their covert operations and infiltrator training programs.
wario_land_mini_mushroom_dust.shippingDetail: Ships with Minuscule Mail, known for its reliable but slow delivery in small packages.

usage.activation: Inhale the dust as a bonus action
usage.duration: 10 minutes (once per day)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you revert to your normal size or if you take damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day

wario_land_mini_mushroom_dust.priceReason: The dust is priced at 1000 XP as it provides a unique and powerful advantage for infiltration missions.

wario_land_monty_mole_goggles.name: Monty Mole Mining Goggles
wario_land_monty_mole_goggles.description: Monty Mole Mining Goggles are forged by the Underground Engineering Corps from sturdy steel and reinforced with leather straps. These goggles allow you to navigate the darkness of underground caverns with ease, enhancing your perception in dim light by a full step on the Perception check scale. However, their dirt-smudged lenses hinder your senses when exposed to bright lights, imposing a disadvantage on such checks. Worn by burrowing sappers during wartime, these goggles also grant you advantage on Survival checks to find underground routes and navigate through tunnels.

effectDetails.title: Perception in Dim Light
effectDetails.rules: These goggles provide a +1 bonus to Perception checks in dim light (darkvision 30ft). The effect is always active while the user wears the goggles.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage in Bright Light
effectDetails.rules: The dirt-smudged lenses of these goggles impose a -2 penalty on Perception checks in bright light. This disadvantage persists as long as the wearer remains exposed to such conditions.

wario_land_monty_mole_goggles.levelRequirementReason: These goggles are designed for basic underground navigation and can be used by any character, regardless of level.
wario_land_monty_mole_goggles.vendorReason: Wario Land specializes in equipment crafted specifically for the unique challenges faced by those who delve into the underground world.
wario_land_monty_mole_goggles.shippingDetail: Ships via Burrow Box Express, ensuring safe and swift delivery to your mine or excavation site.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The goggles are removed from the user's head.

wario_land_monty_mole_goggles.priceReason: This price reflects the quality craftsmanship and specialized material used in their construction.

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_faction_pin.name: Mushroom Kingdom Faction Pin
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_faction_pin.description: The Mushroom Kingdom Faction Pin gleams with a subtle sheen, its golden pinhead adorned with emblems of both the Toads and Koopalings. Crafted by the hands of the Kingdom Peacemakers, this pin symbolizes the fragile peace between warring factions. It brings advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with neutral NPCs but incurs disadvantage against extremists. The pin vibrates during tense negotiations, granting an advantage to Initiative rolls in ambush scenarios. Beware; if it breaks amidst heated disputes, its protective effects are lost.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When wearing the pin, gain advantage on Charisma checks against neutral NPCs. This effect lasts until you engage in a heated argument or when the pin breaks.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage Against Extremists
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this pin, suffer disadvantage on Charisma checks against extremist factions. This persists as long as you are near such factions and ceases upon entering a heated argument or breaking the pin.

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_faction_pin.levelRequirementReason: This pin is designed for adventurers of all levels to foster peace in their interactions.
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_faction_pin.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for its neutrality and commitment to peace efforts, sells this pin as a symbol of unity across the Mushroom Kingdom.
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_faction_pin.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days by the Neutral Network's swift couriers.

usage.duration: Lasts until you engage in a heated argument or when the pin breaks.
usage.endsWhen: Heated arguments, breaking of the pin

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_faction_pin.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the effort put into crafting it by the Kingdom Peacemakers.

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_bond.name: Original Mushroom Kingdom War Bond (Defaulted)
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_bond.description: The Original Mushroom Kingdom War Bond is a decrepit parchment encased in tarnished copper. It bears the crest of the Mushroom Kingdom's nobility, yet its ink has faded to nearly nothing. This relic, though defaulted and magically active, compels surviving noble houses to honor it with a payout of 10,000 gp upon presentation. Alternatively, burning this bond releases Investiture of Flame in a small burst around the holder for 10 minutes. The ghosts of investors will haunt its possessor until either payment or destruction.

effectDetails.title: Mushroom Kingdom Relic
effectDetails.rules: When presented to any surviving noble house, they are compelled to honor it with a one-time payout of 10,000 gp. This effect ends upon payment.

effectDetails.title: Investiture Burst
effectDetails.rules: Activates on fire attack or use as an action. Releases Investiture of Flame in a small burst around the holder for 10 minutes. Ends if the bond is extinguished, destroyed, or the duration expires.

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_bond.levelRequirementReason: Requires only level 1 to handle this historical relic.
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_bond.vendorReason: Wario Land keeps a collection of rare and historically significant items for adventurers seeking unique treasures.
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_bond.shippingDetail: Ships via the Debt Collector, known for their punctuality and reliability in delivering sensitive cargo.

usage.activation: Presentation or as an action to ignite Investiture Burst
usage.duration: Instantaneous presentation; Investiture lasts 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Upon payment of 10,000 gp, destruction, or when the duration ends

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_bond.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its historical and magical significance.

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_drum.name: Mushroom Kingdom War Drum
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_drum.description: The Mushroom Kingdom War Drum is a formidable instrument forged from the resilient wood of the ancient drum trees. Crafted by the skilled Kingdom Drummers, it emits a resonant sound that can be heard across the battlefield. When beaten in battle, it rallies allies within 30 feet, granting them advantage on initiative checks for 1 minute. The drum's loud reverberations also make the user noticeable, imposing disadvantage on Stealth checks. Despite its durability, the drum's skin tears after five uses, requiring immediate repair to continue rallying troops.

effectDetails.title: Beat drum
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action within 30 feet of allies in combat, they gain advantage on initiative checks for 1 minute. This effect ends if the user takes any other action or if it expires normally.

effectDetails.title: Loud sound
effectDetails.rules: The drum emits a loud sound that imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks for the user until the start of their next turn. This effect is negated by taking an action to repair the drum's skin after five uses.

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_drum.levelRequirementReason: This item provides battlefield assistance suitable for any player who needs to rally allies or draw attention.
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_drum.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for his strategic prowess in battle, has a collection of items that aid soldiers and tacticians alike.
wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_drum.shippingDetail: Ships via Rhythmic Relay with an estimated delivery within one week. Delivery may vary depending on the region.

usage.activation: Bonus action to beat drum, reaction to repair after five uses.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use until ends or recharges
usage.endsWhen: Ends when used for another ally, a new battle starts, or after one minute.

wario_land_mushroom_kingdom_war_drum.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique battlefield utility and limited durability.

wario_land_mushroom_militia_uniform.name: Mushroom Militia Uniform (Slightly Bloody)
wario_land_mushroom_militia_uniform.description: This uniform, slightly stained with blood, is a relic of a Toad militia that fought Wario. Sewn by Wario Land Surplus, it's meant for mischief and mayhem. Wear it to gain advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks when interacting with Toads, as they believe you're one of their own. However, the uniform's weak spot is a critical vulnerability: if you take a critical hit while wearing it, you also suffer +2 extra damage from that attack.

effectDetails.title: Toad Persuader
effectDetails.rules: When worn, gain advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks against Toads. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Critical Weakness
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this uniform, you have a weak spot that causes critical hits to deal +2 extra damage. This effect ends when you are no longer wearing the uniform or if you take any other critical hit.

wario_land_mushroom_militia_uniform.levelRequirementReason: The uniform's charm and vulnerability are accessible to even the most novice adventurers.
wario_land_mushroom_militia_uniform.vendorReason: Wario, being a master of mischief, sells items that can be used for both good and ill. This uniform is no exception.
wario_land_mushroom_militia_uniform.shippingDetail: Ships via Wario Express; delivery may take an extra day due to the courier's chaotic schedule.

usage.duration: Lasts until removed or a critical hit is taken.
usage.endsWhen: Removed or you suffer a critical hit.

wario_land_mushroom_militia_uniform.priceReason: The uniform's rarity, craftsmanship by Wario Land Surplus, and its unique properties justify this price.

wario_land_music_block_key.name: Musical Block Note Key
wario_land_music_block_key.description: The Musical Block Note Key is a key-shaped token with intricate engravings that shimmer like a prism. Crafted by Kingdom Entertainment Guild from polished oak and adorned with golden notes, it resonates with melodies of pre-war festivities. When inserted into a musical mechanism, it plays harmonious tunes that can unlock ancient music-based puzzles. Players who play songs on instruments gain advantage on Performance checks for one hour after using the key.

effectDetails.title: Melodic Insertion
effectDetails.rules: Activates when inserted into a musical mechanism. Instantaneous effect that plays a melody to unlock music-based puzzles.

effectDetails.title: Performance Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Upon using the key, the player gains advantage on Performance checks for one hour after inserting it.

wario_land_music_block_key.levelRequirementReason: Requires no specific level as it is a common item that can be used by any adventurer.
wario_land_music_block_key.vendorReason: Wario Land's Entertainment District sells items related to its rich musical heritage.
wario_land_music_block_key.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via standard courier services.

usage.activation: Insert into a musical mechanism or use for Performance checks.
usage.duration: One hour after insertion, advantage on Performance checks.
usage.endsWhen: After one hour of gaining advantage on Performance checks.

wario_land_music_block_key.priceReason: Balanced price for a common item that provides situational benefit and nostalgia.

wario_land_mystery_block_fragment.name: Cracked Mystery Block Fragment
wario_land_mystery_block_fragment.description: A golden Cracked Mystery Block Fragment, its once-sharp edges now dulled and question mark nearly faded. Crafted from a shattered Power-Up Block Factory during Wario Land's tumultuous era, this relic grants you an edge when dealing with pre-war NPCs. With each use, it has a 30% chance to crumble into dust, leaving behind a nostalgic spark of the past. It also offers a 40% chance to produce random items like coins or mushroom fragments from below.

effectDetails.title: Hit from Below
effectDetails.rules: When you use this fragment, there is a 40% chance that it will produce one of the following: a coin (worth 10 XP), a mushroom fragment (valueless but nostalgic), or nothing. This effect occurs instantly.

effectDetails.title: Fragment Instability
effectDetails.rules: After each use, there is a 30% chance that this fragment will crumble into dust. If it does, the item is destroyed and has no further effects.

wario_land_mystery_block_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Accessible early-game to allow players to interact with nostalgic elements of the Wario Land universe.
wario_land_mystery_block_fragment.vendorReason: Wario_land specializes in relics from the era when these Power-Up Block Factories were still operational.
wario_land_mystery_block_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via a time-displaced express courier that ensures timely delivery of this fragile artifact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The fragment crumbles or the effect is used

wario_land_mystery_block_fragment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare origin and nostalgic value without being overpowered.

wario_land_p_switch_button.name: Broken P-Switch Button
wario_land_p_switch_button.description: The 'Broken P-Switch Button' is a cracked, blue button from an ancient P-Switch. Crafted by Reality Manipulation Engineers in Wario Land, it once turned coins into blocks during sieges. Now, with a flick of your wrist, you can perform this transformation on one non-magical object under 50 pounds within 30 feet. However, the button is prone to jamming; there's a 25% chance that after use, the transformation becomes permanent.

effectDetails.title: Coin-to-Block Transmogrifier
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action within 30 feet, this button can transform one non-magical object under 50 pounds into another similar object. The transformation lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can use it once per day.

effectDetails.title: Jammed Potential
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that after activation, the button becomes permanently jammed and unusable. If this occurs, the transformation takes place but cannot be reversed.

wario_land_p_switch_button.levelRequirementReason: This item can be used by anyone who needs to quickly change an object's form during a siege or emergency.
wario_land_p_switch_button.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for its innovative tools and this broken button fits their theme of practical yet quirky inventions.
wario_land_p_switch_button.shippingDetail: Ships via Switch Services with next-day delivery to most Wario Land locations.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The button's effect ends or you use it again, whichever comes first

wario_land_p_switch_button.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the unique and limited functionality of this broken yet functional tool.

wario_land_peach_castle_key_fragment.name: Peach Castle Key Fragment
wario_land_peach_castle_key_fragment.description: This fragment of the royal key is a brittle sliver of iron with remnants of gold inlay. It bears the insignia of the Peach family and retains a faint echo of its former glory, now tarnished by time and battle. Scavenged from the siege of Peach Castle, it whispers secrets to those who can hear, granting advantage on Investigation checks for hidden doors nearby. However, cursed by the fall, anyone attempting to use it with loyalists of Princess Peach faces disadvantage on Charisma checks.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Minor Locks
effectDetails.rules: Combine this fragment with others found: allows the user to unlock minor magical locks (DC 15). Requires all fragments combined. Once used, it cannot be used again.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Hidden Door Checks
effectDetails.rules: Grants advantage on Investigation checks for hidden doors within a short distance when near them. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

wario_land_peach_castle_key_fragment.levelRequirementReason: This fragment is simple enough that even low-level characters can handle it, but its value lies in its rarity and historical significance.
wario_land_peach_castle_key_fragment.vendorReason: Wario Land has a network of scavengers who collect such relics from various sieges and battlegrounds.
wario_land_peach_castle_key_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships within three days, with special handling to ensure the fragile nature of the item is preserved.

usage.activation: Combine all fragments found: requires the user to have all pieces in hand and declare the intent to unlock a lock.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Once used, it cannot be used again. The duration for advantage on hidden door checks is until the end of your next turn.

wario_land_peach_castle_key_fragment.priceReason: The price reflects its historical value and the rarity of finding such fragments in one location.

wario_land_peach_memorial_candle.name: Princess Peach Memorial Candle (Scented: Garlic)
wario_land_peach_memorial_candle.description: The 'Princess Peach Memorial Candle (Scented: Garlic)' is a scorching reminder of Wario's twisted sense of honor. The candle emits a pungent, authentic whiff of garlic that can be smelled from afar, and its flickering light casts an eerie glow in the room. Despite being eternal by Wario’s standards, this candle still requires 8 hours to recharge after burning out, leaving you in darkness until it's ready for another nightmarish display.

effectDetails.title: Eternal Flame
effectDetails.rules: The candle emits a dim light (as if from a torch) that lasts for 1 hour and requires an additional 8 hours to recharge. It has no range or area, but it can be activated as a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Scent
effectDetails.rules: The candle emits a strong garlic scent, imposing disadvantage on Stealth checks made by the user within 30 feet of the candle. This effect persists for 1 hour after activation or until the candle is extinguished.

wario_land_peach_memorial_candle.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can light this candle to honor Peach in their own way, regardless of level.
wario_land_peach_memorial_candle.vendorReason: Wario Land Memorials capitalizes on any opportunity to profit from the Peach incident.
wario_land_peach_memorial_candle.shippingDetail: Delivered with a cloud of garlic essence that lingers in your home for days after arrival.

usage.duration: 1 Hour
usage.endsWhen: Extinguished or Recharged

wario_land_peach_memorial_candle.priceReason: Balanced at a common price to reflect its unique properties and Wario’s questionable sense of honor.

wario_land_peach_true_tear.name: Princess Peach’s True Tear (Preserved)
wario_land_peach_true_tear.description: A single, shimmering tear preserved in a delicate crystal vial, it retains the warmth of the day Princess Peach's castle fell. This relic is said to have been captured by Wario himself, who claims it holds the essence of her sorrow and resilience. Sipping this vial grants all nearby allies healing and relief from dire conditions, while shattering it unleashes a radiant blast that devastates undead and fiends within range.

effectDetails.title: Healing Draught
effectDetails.rules: Activates on drink or shatter. Instantaneous effect: All allies within 60 feet recover 4d8+8 hit points and remove one condition of exhaustion, frightened, or charmed. No save required.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Blast
effectDetails.rules: Activates upon shattering the vial. Instantaneous effect: Every undead or fiend within 100 feet takes 8d10 radiant damage (no save). The vial breaks and cannot be used again after this activation.

wario_land_peach_true_tear.levelRequirementReason: Princess Peach’s True Tear is a very rare, powerful artifact that requires the user to have significant experience.
wario_land_peach_true_tear.vendorReason: Wario Land keeps this relic as proof of his encounter with Princess Peach and her tear.
wario_land_peach_true_tear.shippingDetail: Ships immediately but is delivered by a ghost courier, ensuring the vial remains in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after one use

wario_land_peach_true_tear.priceReason: This very rare tear is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its extraordinary healing and devastating power.

wario_land_peasley_treasure_map.name: Peasley Treasure Map
wario_land_peasley_treasure_map.description: The Peasley Treasure Map is a tattered parchment with intricate symbols and a faint glow. It reveals the hidden vault of the infamous Peasley Financial Scandal, leading directly to its location. Upon using it, you gain a 10% bonus to your chance of successfully opening treasure chests but at the cost of Wario's paranoia, which sets in as soon as the map is activated and lasts until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Bonus Loot from Treasure Chests
effectDetails.rules: When you use this map to open a treasure chest, roll a d10 and add the result to your roll. This effect lasts until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Wario's Paranoia
effectDetails.rules: The user must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) or suffer from paranoia for the duration of one long rest, causing them to misinterpret their surroundings and act suspiciously. This effect is not cumulative.

wario_land_peasley_treasure_map.levelRequirementReason: This map requires no specific level as it can be used by characters of any level to uncover the location.
wario_land_peasley_treasure_map.vendorReason: Wario Land, being a master thief and collector of such artifacts, naturally sells items related to his exploits and those of infamous figures like Peasley.
wario_land_peasley_treasure_map.shippingDetail: The map is couriered with special care by the Shy Guys, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition despite its delicate nature.

usage.activation: Use an action to activate and unfold the map.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect for each use; paranoia lasts until the next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end upon a successful Wisdom saving throw or after one long rest.

wario_land_peasley_treasure_map.priceReason: The map's rarity and the unique advantages it provides justify its price, making it a valuable yet balanced item for any party.

wario_land_piranha_plant_teeth.name: Piranha Plant Teeth Necklace
wario_land_piranha_plant_teeth.description: The Piranha Plant Teeth Necklace is a ghastly trophy crafted from the fangs of a Pipe Fortress denizen, strung on jagged barbed wire. This necklace not only enhances your bite attacks with its serrated edge but also brings with it a haunting presence that intimidates plant-type foes and attracts their wrath in the wilds. The teeth are said to be imbued with the spirit of the plants they once belonged to, making them both a weapon and a warning from the depths of the fortress.

effectDetails.title: Bite Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you make a bite attack with this necklace, you deal an additional +2 piercing damage. Additionally, there is a 10% chance that the wearer takes 1d4 piercing damage as the teeth bite back.

effectDetails.title: Natural Plant Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: When you are within 30 feet of plant-type creatures, they must make an Intelligence saving throw (DC 12) or have disadvantage on their next attack roll against you. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

wario_land_piranha_plant_teeth.levelRequirementReason: The necklace's power requires a solid grasp of combat and survival, suitable for characters who have faced the horrors of Pipe Fortress.
wario_land_piranha_plant_teeth.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for collecting and selling souvenirs from his travels, including this macabre trophy from the fortress.
wario_land_piranha_plant_teeth.shippingDetail: The necklace is shipped in a reinforced box to prevent damage during transit.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn for intimidation; until the wearer's next bite attack or until the wearer takes damage from the necklace’s self-biting effect
usage.endsWhen: The wearer no longer benefits if the necklace is removed.

wario_land_piranha_plant_teeth.priceReason: The necklace's rarity and unique crafting process justify its price, offering both combat utility and a powerful thematic experience.

wario_land_podoboo_core.name: Cooled Podoboo Core
wario_land_podoboo_core.description: The Cooled Podoboo Core, a charred relic of volcanic origins, lies dormant like an ember in its glass casing. Crafted from the heart of a Podoboo that met its fiery demise in Wario Land's moat, it hums with latent energy. Once ignited, this core can serve as a portable heat source for 8 hours, radiating warmth without consuming fuel. Should you choose to hurl it, it becomes a weapon delivering 2d8 fire damage before returning to its dormant state.

effectDetails.title: Portable Heat Source
effectDetails.rules: The Cooled Podoboo Core can be used as a heat source for 8 hours. It requires oil or wood to reignite once it cools down.

effectDetails.title: Weapon Thrown
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the core can be hurled as a weapon at a target within 30 feet, dealing 2d8 fire damage on a hit. After use, it returns to its ember state and cannot be used again until the next dawn.

wario_land_podoboo_core.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners or those who need a reliable heat source without demanding high-level abilities.
wario_land_podoboo_core.vendorReason: Wario Land, being the original scavenger of these cores, keeps them in stock to supply his loyal customers with essential survival tools.
wario_land_podoboo_core.shippingDetail: Ships via Molten Mail; delivery can take up to a week due to volcanic hazards.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for activation, 8 hours of heat source when active
usage.endsWhen: Core returns to ember state after being hurled or if its use is interrupted by a save DC 10 Dexterity saving throw.

wario_land_podoboo_core.priceReason: This item offers a balance between utility and rarity, priced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique origin and daily activation.

wario_land_poison_mushroom_spores.name: Poison Mushroom Spore Vial
wario_land_poison_mushroom_spores.description: The vial houses a volatile cocktail of purple spores harvested from bio-warfare era mushrooms, now weaponized and outlawed by both sides. These spores are notorious for their potency—when thrown, they force enemies within a 5-foot radius to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 14) or be poisoned for the next minute, causing them to stagger and reduce their effectiveness in combat. The vial itself is fragile; there's a 20% chance it will shatter when placed in your pack, releasing its deadly contents into you instead.

effectDetails.title: Poisonous Scatter
effectDetails.rules: When activated by throwing the vial within a 5-foot radius, all creatures in that area must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 14) or become poisoned for 1 minute. The poison causes them to take disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Fragile Vessel
effectDetails.rules: There's a 20% chance that when placed in your pack, the vial will shatter unexpectedly, exposing you to its poisonous contents. You must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

wario_land_poison_mushroom_spores.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for lower-level characters as it offers a potent way to deal with immediate threats without requiring high proficiency.
wario_land_poison_mushroom_spores.vendorReason: Wario Land specializes in unique and dangerous items from the bio-warfare era, making this vial an appropriate addition to their inventory.
wario_land_poison_mushroom_spores.shippingDetail: The vial must be packed with extreme care; any damage during transit will release its contents into the shipment vehicle. Customers are advised to ensure proper handling and storage upon receipt.

usage.activation: Activates when thrown within a 5-foot radius of enemies.
usage.duration: 1 minute for each poisoned creature.
usage.endsWhen: The poison effect ends after 1 minute or when the creature successfully saves against it.

wario_land_poison_mushroom_spores.priceReason: The item's rarity, unique composition, and potential danger justify its moderate price in XP terms.

wario_land_pow_block_shard.name: POW Block Shard
wario_land_pow_block_shard.description: The POW Block Shard is a jagged fragment of a once-mighty demolition tool. Crafted by Wario Land's Demolition Engineering Corps, this shard can collapse tunnels with its powerful tremors. When slammed into the ground, it triggers a shockwave that sends all creatures within 15 feet crashing to the floor in disarray. It is also known for a 15% chance of inadvertently activating during combat, adding to the chaos. This fragment provides you with an edge when underground, granting advantage on Perception checks for detecting hidden threats.

effectDetails.title: Tunnel Collapse
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action by slamming it into the ground, all creatures within 15 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14) or fall prone. This effect has no duration and is expended after one use.

effectDetails.title: Unstable
effectDetails.rules: There is a 15% chance that the shard will activate itself when hit in combat, sending shockwaves as described above. Once activated, it crumbles into dust, ending its effect immediately.

wario_land_pow_block_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 6 to wield effectively, ensuring it's used by experienced adventurers.
wario_land_pow_block_shard.vendorReason: Wario Land specializes in explosive and engineering tools for demolition work, making the POW Block Shard a natural addition to their inventory.
wario_land_pow_block_shard.shippingDetail: Ships with standard courier handling but is marked as fragile, ensuring safe delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (one use only)
usage.endsWhen: Once used or triggered by combat

wario_land_pow_block_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this shard reflects its powerful yet unstable nature and the expertise needed to handle it.

wario_land_premium_wario_costume.name: Wario Land Premium Wario Costume
wario_land_premium_wario_costume.description: The Wario Land Premium Wario Costume is a garish ensemble made of shimmering polyester that makes you look exactly like the nefarious green plumber. It grants you an advantage on Intimidation checks, but at the cost of disadvantage on Persuasion attempts and being terrifying to children who recognize it. The costume also allows for the creation of a 10-foot radius cloud of noxious gas with the Wario Waft, which poisons creatures within upon failing a Constitution saving throw (DC 13). Beware, though—while wearing this outfit, concentration is near impossible due to its itchy nature.

effectDetails.title: Disguise as Wario
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Intimidation checks and have disadvantage on Persuasion checks. Additionally, children and those who are fans of Mario have a disadvantage when making Charisma (Persuasion) checks against you.

effectDetails.title: Poisonous Cloud
effectDetails.rules: With the Wario Waft action, you can create a 10-foot radius cloud that poisons all creatures within for one round. They must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 13) or be poisoned. This effect has no reuse interval and is usable once per day.

wario_land_premium_wario_costume.levelRequirementReason: This costume, while silly, still requires basic social skills to use effectively.
wario_land_premium_wario_costume.vendorReason: Wario Land Costume Shop specializes in outfits that make you look like the most infamous characters, including this unmissable Wario costume.
wario_land_premium_wario_costume.shippingDetail: Due to its large size and vibrant nature, shipping is delayed by one day.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Poisonous Cloud effect; until the end of your next turn otherwise
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you no longer wear the costume or are poisoned

wario_land_premium_wario_costume.priceReason: This costume, while whimsical, still requires materials and craftsmanship, justifying its price.

wario_land_princess_peach_wig.name: Princess Peach Memorial Wig (Wario-Styled)
wario_land_princess_peach_wig.description: This wig is a bizarre blend of elegance and horror. The blonde strands are styled in Princess Peach's iconic fashion, but a mischievous mustache crafted to look like Wario's clings awkwardly to the scalp. It was supposedly made by Wario as part of his 'Wario-Styled' range, intended to be worn for comedic chaos or impersonation attempts. Wearing it guarantees you'll either inspire fear with your reflection or cause discomfort among those around you, thanks to its unsettling features.

effectDetails.title: Peach's Disguise
effectDetails.rules: When worn as a headgear, you gain advantage on Deception checks to impersonate Princess Peach. However, your appearance is so botched by the mustache that it leaves much to be desired; you take disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks with any character who knows of Princess Peach.

effectDetails.title: Mustache Malaise
effectDetails.rules: The mustache gives you disadvantage on saving throws against fear effects. Additionally, anyone within 5 feet of you while wearing this wig has advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks due to the disturbing appearance.

wario_land_princess_peach_wig.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for lower-level characters who might find it entertaining or useful in a pinch without requiring high character strength.
wario_land_princess_peach_wig.vendorReason: Wario Land Costume Disrespect sells this as part of their mischievous and themed merchandise line, which includes a variety of over-the-top accessories.
wario_land_princess_peach_wig.shippingDetail: Due to the nature of the item, shipping is handled with extra care, ensuring the wig arrives in one piece but with strict handling instructions.

usage.activation: Wear as a headgear during sessions.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; effect lasts until removed or the session ends.
usage.endsWhen: The item's effects end when you remove it, the session concludes, or if you are incapacitated.

wario_land_princess_peach_wig.priceReason: This price reflects a common, themed accessory that offers both amusement and strategic value without overstepping in terms of power.

wario_land_propeller_mushroom_cap.name: Broken Propeller Mushroom Cap
wario_land_propeller_mushroom_cap.description: The Broken Propeller Mushroom Cap, crafted by Sky Mushroom Aeronautics, is a relic of aerial scouts once used for swift flight. Its single snapped blade now limits it to gliding, though it still provides a unique form of propulsion. This cap can slow a wearer's fall and make a whirring noise that hinders Stealth checks, but with the right repairs, it could again soar through the skies like its former self.

effectDetails.title: Glide Flight
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer can glide for up to 1 minute, reducing fall damage by half (as if using Feather Fall). This effect has two uses per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Whirring Noise
effectDetails.rules: While the cap is active, the wearer suffers disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. The cap makes a persistent whirring sound until deactivated or removed.

wario_land_propeller_mushroom_cap.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the cap's mechanics and its reliance on repairs make it suitable for characters with some experience.
wario_land_propeller_mushroom_cap.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for oddities and unique items, carries this relic of the sky.
wario_land_propeller_mushroom_cap.shippingDetail: Ships via a specialized glider, ensuring safe delivery to the destination.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until removed
usage.endsWhen: Deactivated or removed

wario_land_propeller_mushroom_cap.priceReason: The cap's rarity and the complexity of its mechanics, including the repair requirement, justify this price.

wario_land_purple_coin.name: Haunted Purple Coin
wario_land_purple_coin.description: The Haunted Purple Coin radiates a cold, spectral chill that makes it seem alive in your palm. Crafted by the Supernatural Economy (Ghost House Mint), this coin is said to be cursed, always landing on tails for those who covet its wealth too greedily. In haunted areas, ghosts are drawn to it, making you a target of their scrutiny, and undead NPCs, like wraiths or specters, favor you with benevolent glances.

effectDetails.title: Greed's Bane
effectDetails.rules: If the coin is picked up by someone who wants to use it for personal gain, it always lands on tails. This effect lasts until a new owner takes possession of it (DM discretion).

effectDetails.title: Undead Favor
effectDetails.rules: When in close proximity to undead NPCs like wraiths or specters, you gain advantage on Charisma checks and saving throws against their effects for 1 hour. This effect can be used once per day.

wario_land_purple_coin.levelRequirementReason: The coin's supernatural properties require a capable adventurer to handle its cursed nature and undead sympathies.
wario_land_purple_coin.vendorReason: Wario Land, with his extensive dealings in the Ghost House, is privy to such rare and enchanted items.
wario_land_purple_coin.shippingDetail: Delivered by spectral messengers who ensure the coin arrives with a chill that hints at its cursed nature.

usage.activation: Used as part of an action when flipped for guidance or in close proximity to undead NPCs.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Greed's Bane, 1 hour for Undead Favor.
usage.endsWhen: Greed's Bane ends with a new owner taking possession, Undead Favor after 1 hour.

wario_land_purple_coin.priceReason: The coin's supernatural crafting and cursed nature justify its high price.

wario_land_raccoon_tail.name: Torn Raccoon Tail
wario_land_raccoon_tail.description: The Torn Raccoon Tail is a mangled relic from a chaotic Super Leaf transformation. Its frayed fur and cracked spine hint at its tumultuous origin on the Transformation Battlefield Casualties. This tail allows you to swat foes behind you with surprising agility, but it's unreliable for flight, instead granting enhanced balance in acrobatic maneuvers. It also makes you appear suspicious to guards, who are wary of this damaged relic.

effectDetails.title: Swat Attack (Reaction)
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy moves within 5 feet of you and is behind you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against the creature. On a hit, it takes 1d4 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Balance
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Acrobatics checks. Additionally, you cannot be knocked prone by non-magical effects unless you choose to be.

wario_land_raccoon_tail.levelRequirementReason: The Torn Raccoon Tail is a common item that can be used by lower-level characters for its practical utility in combat and acrobatics.
wario_land_raccoon_tail.vendorReason: Wario Land, being the creator of this chaotic relic, occasionally sells damaged but still functional items from his battlefield casualties.
wario_land_raccoon_tail.shippingDetail: The Torn Raccoon Tail is shipped in a sturdy box to protect it during transit. Delivery takes two game days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, Until Exhausted
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after 3 uses or destroyed if damaged beyond repair

wario_land_raccoon_tail.priceReason: The Torn Raccoon Tail is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its common rarity and practical utility in combat and acrobatics.

wario_land_recipe_garlic_bread_of_greed.name: Recipe: Wario Land Garlic Bread of Greed
wario_land_recipe_garlic_bread_of_greed.description: The Recipe: Wario Land Garlic Bread of Greed is a parchment that allows you to bake bread with a golden allure. When consumed, it grants +1 to attack rolls against targets carrying gold or gems. However, the recipe imbues you with an insatiable hunger for wealth, forcing disadvantage on saves versus greed-related effects. Your breath becomes a weapon; in close combat, your exhale can knock small creatures unconscious (advantage on Intimidation checks). This bread is made by Wario Land Bakers using ancient recipes that have been passed down through generations of greedy chefs.

effectDetails.title: Gold Aura
effectDetails.rules: When you consume the bread, it grants +1 to attack rolls against targets carrying gold or gems. This effect lasts until your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Wealth Craving
effectDetails.rules: You are forced to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw when exposed to greed-related effects. On a failure, you take an additional level of exhaustion and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each short rest.

wario_land_recipe_garlic_bread_of_greed.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough that even low-level adventurers can use it to their advantage in greedy situations.
wario_land_recipe_garlic_bread_of_greed.vendorReason: Wario Land Bakers are known for their eccentric and often gold-tinged recipes, making this bread a staple in their offerings.
wario_land_recipe_garlic_bread_of_greed.shippingDetail: The bread must be delivered within the day to maintain its potency; delays can reduce its effectiveness.

usage.duration: Until your next long rest
usage.endsWhen: Resting for a full night
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one loaf per day

wario_land_recipe_garlic_bread_of_greed.priceReason: The recipe is moderately priced given its utility and the rarity of finding such ingredients.

wario_land_red_coin_shard.name: Red Coin Shard
wario_land_red_coin_shard.description: A Red Coin Shard gleams faintly in your hand, its surface dented and weathered from years of service within the Kingdom Treasury's vaults. Once part of a rare coin worth eight times its weight in gold, this fragment retains the mint's signature engraving. It is a collector’s delight, dazzling with its shimmering red hue that distracts onlookers, granting you advantage on Sleight of Hand checks to misdirect. Though small, it carries the weight of centuries and can still be sold for twice its value at the right vendor.

effectDetails.title: Collector's Delight
effectDetails.rules: When you sell this Red Coin Shard to a recognized collector NPC, you receive double the listed price. This effect can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Distracting Glow
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Sleight of Hand checks made to misdirect or distract an opponent within 10 feet for up to 1 minute. The effect ends if you move more than 10 feet away from the target.

wario_land_red_coin_shard.levelRequirementReason: This shard is accessible to beginners, requiring no special training.
wario_land_red_coin_shard.vendorReason: Wario Land specializes in unique and collectible items of historical significance.
wario_land_red_coin_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Kingdom's express courier service for fast delivery, ensuring your shard arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon possession; requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: Until the end of each long rest or when sold as part of 'Collector's Delight'.
usage.endsWhen: Selling to a recognized collector NPC ends both effects.

wario_land_red_coin_shard.priceReason: The price reflects the shard’s historical value and its limited utility in combat, making it accessible yet valuable.

wario_land_royal_mushroom_crown.name: Crown of the Mushroom Regency (Cracked)
wario_land_royal_mushroom_crown.description: The Crown of the Mushroom Regency (Cracked) is a cracked-toothed crown, its gold gleaming faintly through the fissures. Forged during Toadsworth's reign, it exudes the essence of royal authority. Within 10 miles, all Toads are compelled to be your loyal subjects, offering their services with unwavering dedication. Wearing this crown on a non-Toad's head triggers regal rejection; each day there is a 50% chance the crown will tighten, dealing 4d10 psychic damage and forcing the wearer to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until it is removed.

effectDetails.title: Royal Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: All Toads within 10 miles become friendly or indifferent to you. This effect is permanent while the crown is worn.

effectDetails.title: Regal Rejection
effectDetails.rules: If worn by a non-Toad, there is a 50% chance per day that the crown tightens and deals 4d10 psychic damage. The wearer must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw; on a failed save, they become incapacitated until the crown is removed.

wario_land_royal_mushroom_crown.levelRequirementReason: Only those with royal lineage or a strong connection to Toadsworth can wield this powerful artifact.
wario_land_royal_mushroom_crown.vendorReason: Wario Land, a master of the underground economy, has acquired this rare relic from a mysterious source.
wario_land_royal_mushroom_crown.shippingDetail: The crown is delivered with utmost secrecy by Toad escorts who do not know its contents.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn, regal rejection effect occurs daily at dawn
usage.endsWhen: Crown is removed or wearer fails save against Regal Rejection

wario_land_royal_mushroom_crown.priceReason: The crown's rarity and the potential for it to be used in both beneficial and harmful ways justify its moderate price.

wario_land_siege_of_toad_town_souvenir.name: Siege of Toad Town Souvenir Brick
wario_land_siege_of_toad_town_souvenir.description: This worn, jagged brick bears Wario's boastful scrawl in toad ink. It is a relic from the Siege of Toad Town, where the Mushroom Kingdom's might stood firm against Wario's assault. The walls crumbled, but this brick escaped, now a memento of the failed siege and the battle that followed. Carried away by a valiant Toad, it was given to a hero of the war as a token of gratitude for their service.

effectDetails.title: Siege Remnant
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, this brick deals 1d6 slashing damage. It provides advantage on attack rolls against windows and doors. The brick can be used once before it breaks completely.

effectDetails.title: Toad's Whisper
effectDetails.rules: At night, the brick emits a haunting whisper, 'WAH!', causing disadvantage on Charisma checks with Toads for 1 hour. This effect occurs three times per day.

wario_land_siege_of_toad_town_souvenir.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can hold this memento of a legendary battle.
wario_land_siege_of_toad_town_souvenir.vendorReason: Wario Land Battlefield Salvage collects souvenirs from his failed attempts to conquer the Mushroom Kingdom.
wario_land_siege_of_toad_town_souvenir.shippingDetail: Shipped with care, this brick may arrive slightly chipped but remains functional and powerful.

usage.activation: Throw as a weapon or place it near windows/doors for advantage on attacks.
usage.duration: Instantaneous attack; ongoing whisper effect lasts for 1 hour.
usage.endsWhen: Brick breaks after use, or the whisper ends when the time limit is reached.

wario_land_siege_of_toad_town_souvenir.priceReason: The brick's historical and sentimental value justifies its moderate price in experience points.

wario_land_skaven_bowser_key.name: Bowser Key of the Lost Throne
wario_land_skaven_bowser_key.description: The Bowser Key of the Lost Throne is a gleaming golden key forged in the heart of Mount Ebobo during the Dragon Wars. Its surface bears intricate engravings of ancient Bowsers and their rivals, the Skavens. This relic grants +3 to attack rolls against dragons or royal guards and can be fused with any weapon to imbue it with draconic power. When used outside combat, it emits a chaotic hum that disrupts the balance of nearby magic.

effectDetails.title: Draconic Weapon Fusion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Fuses with a weapon to grant it +2 bonus damage and a dragon-themed appearance until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Aura
effectDetails.rules: If used outside combat, the key emits a chaotic hum for 1 minute, requiring a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the user is charmed by an ancient power until the start of their next turn.

wario_land_skaven_bowser_key.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 7th level to wield its chaotic power and draconic fusion without risk.
wario_land_skaven_bowser_key.vendorReason: Wario Land, a master of the lost arts, possesses this key as it ties into his heritage from the Bowsers' wars.
wario_land_skaven_bowser_key.shippingDetail: Delivered via Warp Whistle's express dragon courier service within one week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous fusion, Aura lasts for 1 minute unless dispelled or the key is destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The fusion ends when the weapon is no longer in contact with the key. The aura ends when the user takes a non-magical action outside combat.

wario_land_skaven_bowser_key.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and unique properties as a relic of ancient warfare.

wario_land_spike_top_shell.name: Spike Top Shell
wario_land_spike_top_shell.description: The Spike Top Shell is a formidable weapon crafted from the armored spikes of the legendary Spike Tops. This spiked shell, forged with iron and imbued with anti-cavalry magic, can be set as a trap to deter charging mounts or infantry. When triggered by a creature stepping on it, it delivers a swift 2d6 piercing damage. It is reusable, resetting itself after each activation, but care must be taken when carried; falling while holding the shell deals 1d4 damage. The shell's spikes are particularly effective against mounted enemies, dealing double damage to those already in the saddle.

effectDetails.title: Set as Trap
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a creature stepping on it, this Spike Top Shell deals 2d6 piercing damage to the triggering creature. It has an instantaneous duration and resets itself after each activation.

effectDetails.title: Recoverable Damage
effectDetails.rules: If you are carrying the Spike Top Shell and fall while holding it, you take 1d4 damage from its sharp spikes.

wario_land_spike_top_shell.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for general use in anti-cavalry operations and thus requires no specific level to deploy.
wario_land_spike_top_shell.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for its diverse array of tactical items, including this practical Spike Top Shell used by his troops.
wario_land_spike_top_shell.shippingDetail: Delivery involves careful handling to ensure the shell's spikes do not puncture packaging or other cargo.

usage.activation: Set as a trap when stepped on
usage.duration: Instantaneous; resets after triggering
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted with each activation

wario_land_spike_top_shell.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's moderate rarity and utility, suitable for a wide range of tactical scenarios.

wario_land_star_bit_debris.name: Star Bit Shrapnel
wario_land_star_bit_debris.description: Star Bit Shrapnel are crystallized remnants of a long-forgotten Celestial Bombardment that rained down upon the land, now glowing faintly in the dark. These shards, made by the Space Debris Collection Agency, are both restorative and slightly hazardous. They emit a soft luminescence, revealing their location but attracting curious Lumas to your side. Consuming one grants temporary hit points (1d4) that sweeten the soul, while also carrying a 10% chance of triggering random magical effects that could be beneficial or chaotic, as determined by the DM.

effectDetails.title: Temp HP Restorer
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, a Star Bit Shrapnel grants temporary hit points equal to 1d4. These restorative properties are sweet and revitalize the soul of the user.

effectDetails.title: Random Magical Effect
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance (roll a d10, on a roll of 1-2) that consuming a Star Bit Shrapnel will trigger a random magical effect. The DM rolls wild magic, which could yield beneficial effects or cause unpredictable chaos.

wario_land_star_bit_debris.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners to help them regain health and explore the world without being too powerful.
wario_land_star_bit_debris.vendorReason: Wario Land's Space Debris Collection Agency specializes in salvaging and distributing these rare fragments from ancient celestial events.
wario_land_star_bit_debris.shippingDetail: Ships within a week, delivered by the Cosmic Courier with a guaranteed safe arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; temporary hit points last until used or lost due to damage.
usage.endsWhen: Temporary hit points are lost upon taking damage or at the end of your next turn if not used.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one can be consumed per short rest.

wario_land_star_bit_debris.priceReason: The item is priced moderately to reflect its balance between utility and potential for chaos without being overpowered.

wario_land_star_road_fragment.name: Fragment of the Fallen Star Road
