wario_land_star_road_fragment.description: A Fragment of the Fallen Star Road is a shimmering piece of ancient star metal. It glows faintly with an inner light, a remnant of its celestial origins. This fragment was salvaged from the battlefield where the Star Road met its fate during the Great Civil War. Only once a week may it be used to call upon the power of the Star Spirits to restore something lost in that conflict—a loved one, a beloved place, or even a cherished memory. Each invocation weakens the fragment's bond with the cosmos until it eventually becomes inert after seven uses.

effectDetails.title: Wish Restoration
effectDetails.rules: As a standard action, once per week, you may use this fragment to cast the Wish spell, limited solely to restoring something lost during the Great Civil War. The item's power diminishes with each use; after seven uses, it becomes inert.

effectDetails.title: Star Spirit Protection
effectDetails.rules: As long as you hold the Fragment of the Fallen Star Road, you are under the protection of the Star Spirits. They will intervene if any attempt is made to misuse this power for personal gain or malicious intent.

wario_land_star_road_fragment.levelRequirementReason: This fragment is accessible to all who wish to restore something lost during the Great Civil War, regardless of their level.
wario_land_star_road_fragment.vendorReason: Wario Land has a deep connection to the events of the Great Civil War and the fragments that were recovered from it.
wario_land_star_road_fragment.shippingDetail: The fragment is delivered via Starlight Courier, ensuring safe arrival but with a slight delay due to cosmic interference.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the desired restoration occurs or the spell fails
usage.endsWhen: After seven uses or if misused

wario_land_star_road_fragment.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and limited utility, yet remains accessible to adventurers of all levels.

wario_land_super_bell_collar.name: Cracked Super Bell Collar
wario_land_super_bell_collar.description: The Cracked Super Bell Collar, crafted by the Feline Transformation Division, is a bell collar that once jingled merrily but now lies silent and cracked, its metal surface dented from countless battles. This artifact imbues wearers with feline agility; they gain an additional climbing speed equal to their walking speed, making them nimble as cats. However, the bell's cracked state gives away their position, imposing a disadvantage on Stealth checks.

effectDetails.title: Climbing Agility
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this collar, the wearer gains an additional climbing speed equal to their walking speed. This effect is passive and applies continuously while the collar is worn.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: The bell's cracked state imparts a disadvantage on Stealth checks. This effect persists as long as the collar remains in use, but it can be mitigated by taking an action to silence the jingle temporarily.

wario_land_super_bell_collar.levelRequirementReason: This collar is designed for adventurers who have already faced numerous challenges and battles, requiring a minimum level of expertise.
wario_land_super_bell_collar.vendorReason: Wario Land's Feline Transformation Division specializes in crafting items that enhance the agility and stealth of its patrons, making this collar a fitting addition to their inventory.
wario_land_super_bell_collar.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Meow Mail, ensuring adventurers can put their new abilities to use immediately upon arrival.

usage.duration: Until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The collar is removed or destroyed.

wario_land_super_bell_collar.priceReason: Crafted with rare materials and imbued with feline transformation magic, this collar commands a significant price in the market.

wario_land_super_leaf_stem.name: Wilted Super Leaf Stem
wario_land_super_leaf_stem.description: The Wilted Super Leaf Stem is a withered remnant of a once-mighty power-up, still clinging to traces of its former glory. Made from a leaf plucked from War-Torn Power-Up Fields, it retains a faint memory of the raccoon who used it. Plant this stem in moist soil, and there's a slim chance (1%) it will sprout into a brand-new Super Leaf after one week. While holding it during your jump, you can glide 10 feet horizontally with no vertical gain, a fleeting echo of its leafy might.

effectDetails.title: Leafy Glide
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this effect as a bonus action while jumping, you can glide horizontally for up to 10 feet. This has no vertical component and does not allow you to jump higher than your normal reach.

effectDetails.title: Raccoon's Forest Memory
effectDetails.rules: While holding the stem, you gain advantage on Nature checks made within forests or areas with dense foliage.

wario_land_super_leaf_stem.levelRequirementReason: The Wilted Super Leaf Stem is a simple item that can be used by any character to access its minor abilities.
wario_land_super_leaf_stem.vendorReason: Wario Land has a surplus of these stems, having collected them from various locations where the original Super Leaf was known to grow.
wario_land_super_leaf_stem.shippingDetail: The stem is shipped in a protective casing made from recycled leaf material, ensuring it arrives fresh and intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the jump ends or you land

wario_land_super_leaf_stem.priceReason: The stem is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its origin from a rare and historically significant location.

wario_land_tanooki_tail.name: Tanooki Scout Tail
wario_land_tanooki_tail.description: The Tanooki Scout Tail is a brittle, segmented tail with dappled fur and sharp claws. Crafted from the body of a shapeshifter who was caught behind enemy lines, this relic grants you unmatched agility in tight spaces. It can be attached to your waist, providing a +2 bonus to Acrobatics checks for balance and stability. When transformed into a statue, it offers AC 18 protection and stillness, but at the cost of silence and immobility. The tail's unpredictable nature ensures that any lie you tell while in its vicinity is easily detected, adding a layer of caution to your interactions.

effectDetails.title: Tail Attachment
effectDetails.rules: As an action, attach the tail to your waist. While attached, you gain a +2 bonus to Acrobatics checks (balance). This effect lasts until detached or until you take three consecutive turns without moving or speaking.

effectDetails.title: Statue Form
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can transform into a statue using your action. While in this form, you gain an AC of 18 and are immobile for 10 minutes, during which time you cannot take actions or be targeted by spells or abilities that affect creatures.

wario_land_tanooki_tail.levelRequirementReason: The Tanooki Scout Tail's shapeshifting properties require a high degree of control and finesse, best suited for experienced adventurers.
wario_land_tanooki_tail.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for acquiring unique artifacts from various sources, including this tail that was once part of an enemy caught in a daring rescue operation.
wario_land_tanooki_tail.shippingDetail: The package may arrive with minor damage due to the tail's brittle nature, requiring immediate handling upon arrival.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (Tail Attachment); Action (Statue Form)
usage.duration: Until detached or until you take three consecutive turns without moving or speaking; 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Detached from the user, after three turns of inactivity, or at the end of a long rest for Statue Form

wario_land_tanooki_tail.priceReason: The tail's rarity and the expertise required to craft it justify its high price.

wario_land_teyvat_cursed_key.name: Teyvat Cursed Key
wario_land_teyvat_cursed_key.description: The Teyvat Cursed Key is a menacing key forged deep within the Archon’s vault. Its handle glows faintly with an eerie blue light, and the key itself bears the Boos symbol etched into its surface. This cursed artifact not only opens any gate in Teyvat marked with the Boos symbol but also subtly clouded one's vision for 1 hour. Use it wisely; the key grants a 20% chance to trigger a gacha event, and it can summon the malevolent Shadowed Archon when used.
effects: Opens any gate in Teyvat marked with the Boos symbol

effectDetails.title: Gate Opener
effectDetails.rules: The key can be used to open any gate in Teyvat that bears the Boos symbol. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Vision Clouding
effectDetails.rules: When used, this key clouds the user's vision for 1 hour. There is no saving throw involved, but the effect ends if the key is destroyed or the user successfully casts a clear-sighted spell.

wario_land_teyvat_cursed_key.levelRequirementReason: The Teyvat Cursed Key requires even the lowest-level adventurers to have some experience with such powerful and potentially dangerous artifacts.
wario_land_teyvat_cursed_key.vendorReason: Wario Land, being a faction that deals in rare and cursed items, is well-equipped to offer this artifact to its members.
wario_land_teyvat_cursed_key.shippingDetail: The key must be shipped via Pipe Express for the proper enchantment to remain intact. Shipping takes 3 days and includes a special delivery charm.

usage.duration: 1 hour (clouded vision)
usage.endsWhen: Key destroyed, user successfully casts a clear-sighted spell, or the effect ends naturally upon expiration

wario_land_teyvat_cursed_key.priceReason: The Teyvat Cursed Key's price is set at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the potential risks it poses.

wario_land_thunder_cloud_bottle.name: Bottled Thunder Cloud
wario_land_thunder_cloud_bottle.description: The Bottled Thunder Cloud is a vengeful storm trapped within a glass bottle, its electrified heart sparking with malevolent lightning. Crafted by Weather Weaponization Labs using ancient meteoric iron and enchanted to hold the essence of a thundercloud, it hovers above targets before unleashing a bolt of 2d8 lightning after 1d4 rounds. This tempest can be passed from hand to hand, transferring its stormy wrath to another creature who then must contend with its unpredictable strikes.

effectDetails.title: Hovers and Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a bonus action, the cloud hovers above the target for 1d4 rounds before striking with a bolt of 2d8 lightning. The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be struck immediately instead. On a successful save, they are immune to this effect for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Transferable Wrath
effectDetails.rules: By touching another creature, the cloud can be transferred to them. The recipient must then make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw; on failure, they immediately take 2d8 lightning damage and are affected by the cloud's strikes for 1 hour.

wario_land_thunder_cloud_bottle.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed to be accessible early in a campaign, allowing players to experience its unique abilities without requiring high-level proficiency.
wario_land_thunder_cloud_bottle.vendorReason: Wario Land's extensive network includes connections with Weather Weaponization Labs, ensuring they have access to such rare and powerful items.
wario_land_thunder_cloud_bottle.shippingDetail: Delivered under cover of a stormy night, the package is marked with the signature emblem of Storm Shippers.

usage.duration: 1d4 rounds or until transferred to another creature
usage.endsWhen: The target makes a successful saving throw or when the recipient fails their save and takes damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one transferable instance at a time

wario_land_thunder_cloud_bottle.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rare crafting materials and the unique magical properties required to contain such a volatile storm.

wario_land_thwomp_fragment.name: Thwomp Fortress Fragment
wario_land_thwomp_fragment.description: A jagged, grimacing chunk of Thwomp rubble, its surface still warm from the heat of battle. The fragment bears the unmistakable mark of a Castle Defense Rubble, forged in the fires of the land's ancient defenses. It radiates an eerie stone breath that gives any nearby creature a chilling presence and advantage on Intimidation checks. This relic is more than mere rubble; it serves as a constant reminder of the Thwomp Fortress' resilience, offering resistance to fall damage due to its very nature.

effectDetails.title: Stone's Resilience
effectDetails.rules: While carrying the Thwomp Fortress Fragment, you have resistance to fall damage. This effect lasts until you stop carrying it or until a short rest is taken.

effectDetails.title: Intimidating Presence
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Intimidation checks while within 30 feet of this fragment. The effect ends if the fragment is destroyed, lost, or no longer within the specified range.

wario_land_thwomp_fragment.levelRequirementReason: This fragment can be used by lower-level characters as a reminder and tool of resilience in battles against formidable foes.
wario_land_thwomp_fragment.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for his collection of rare relics from the land's history, offers this fragment to adventurers seeking tangible ties to its past.
wario_land_thwomp_fragment.shippingDetail: The shipment is handled by Heavy Haulers United, who ensure that the fragile nature of this relic is respected during transit.

usage.activation: Passive effect while carrying the fragment
usage.duration: Until you stop carrying it or until a short rest is taken
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed, lost, or no longer within 30 feet of an Intimidation check target

wario_land_thwomp_fragment.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the fragment's rarity and its utility in both combat and social interactions.

wario_land_toad_beret_of_courage.name: Toad Beret of Courage
wario_land_toad_beret_of_courage.description: The Toad Beret of Courage is a red beret with a subtle Toad Special Forces insignia, worn by elite commandos during the uprising. This beret grants you advantage on saving throws against fear due to your steadfast bravery as a Toad. However, it also imposes disadvantage when attempting Intimidation checks, as Toads are renowned for their cuteness rather than intimidation. After 10 uses, the magic fades and the beret returns to mundane status.
effects: Advantage on saving throws vs. fear

effectDetails.title: Courageous Heart
effectDetails.rules: When you wear this beret, you gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened due to your steadfast bravery as a Toad. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after removing the beret.

effectDetails.title: Cute Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this beret, you are at disadvantage on Intimidation checks and similar interactions where intimidation is required due to the beret's cute appearance. This effect persists as long as you wear the beret.

wario_land_toad_beret_of_courage.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for lower-level adventurers who might face fear-based challenges early in their journey.
wario_land_toad_beret_of_courage.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for his encounters with Toads, sells this beret as a tribute to the brave Toad commandos.
wario_land_toad_beret_of_courage.shippingDetail: Delivered by Toad Trot Transport, which ensures safe and timely delivery of the beret directly from Toad Special Forces headquarters.

usage.activation: Wearing the beret is required to gain its effects; it does not activate via action or other means.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on saving throws vs. fear, lasts until start of next turn after removal
usage.endsWhen: The use ends when you remove the beret or after 10 uses

wario_land_toad_beret_of_courage.priceReason: This item strikes a balance, providing useful benefits but with clear drawbacks and limited magic, making it accessible yet valuable.

wario_land_toad_brigade_standard.name: Bloodied Toad Brigade Standard
wario_land_toad_brigade_standard.description: The Bloodied Toad Brigade Standard is a tattered but resolute flag imbued with the valor of countless battles. Crafted from the remnants of Captain Toad's final charge, it still bears the scent of victory and sacrifice. When unfurled, its presence rallies allies within 120 feet, granting them temporary invincibility to fear and bolster their defenses. Nearby toads will fight tirelessly for its return if it falls into ill hands.

effectDetails.title: Rallying Banner
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn, as a bonus action, you can unfurl this banner within 60 feet. All allies in a 120-foot radius regain 3d10 hit points and immediately end one condition.

effectDetails.title: Fearless Allies
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 60 feet gain +2 to AC and advantage on saving throws against being frightened for 10 minutes. This effect ends if the standard is touched to the ground or destroyed.

wario_land_toad_brigade_standard.levelRequirementReason: The banner can be easily held by a beginner, as it remains a symbol of valor rather than an item requiring significant strength.
wario_land_toad_brigade_standard.vendorReason: As the flag is tied to Captain Toad's legacy, Wario Land is the most fitting vendor for such an artifact.
wario_land_toad_brigade_standard.shippingDetail: The courier ensures safe passage through treacherous lands, delivering the banner swiftly.

usage.activation: Bonus action to unfurl or rally
usage.duration: 10 minutes per use; ends if touched to ground or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Touched to the ground, destroyed, or its effect duration expires

wario_land_toad_brigade_standard.priceReason: The banner's rarity and historical significance make it a valuable yet balanced purchase for any adventurer.

wario_land_toad_cap_insignia.name: Toad Cap Insignia
wario_land_toad_cap_insignia.description: The Toad Cap Insignia is a small, intricately designed badge that once adorned the uniform of a dedicated Toad officer. Crafted from polished brass and emblazoned with a symbol of unity, this relic holds a special place in the hearts of Toads. It grants you advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with other Toads (who recognize its meaning), but also brings disadvantage to such interactions with those who oppose the Toad way of life. Additionally, it subtly glows when near hidden safehouses, aiding your investigation efforts without drawing undue attention.

effectDetails.title: Unity Badge
effectDetails.rules: When you interact with Toad factions or individuals who recognize the badge's symbolism, you gain advantage on Charisma checks. This effect is passive and lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Rebel Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: You incur disadvantage on Charisma checks when interacting with groups or individuals that are known to oppose Toads. This persists for 1 minute, after which it ends.

wario_land_toad_cap_insignia.levelRequirementReason: The badge's symbolism and utility make it accessible to all adventurers who value the Toad cause.
wario_land_toad_cap_insignia.vendorReason: Wario Land is a long-time ally of Toads, often providing support through trade and diplomacy.
wario_land_toad_cap_insignia.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the Toad Courier Service, ensuring safe arrival at your doorstep.

usage.activation: Passive for Unity Badge; instantaneous for Rebel Disadvantage when relevant Charisma checks are made.
usage.duration: Unity Badge: Until start of next turn. Rebel Disadvantage: Lasts 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: Unity Badge: Ends naturally at the start of your next turn. Rebel Disadvantage: Ends after 1 minute or upon successful check.

wario_land_toad_cap_insignia.priceReason: The badge's utility and limited, strategic advantages justify its cost in experienced adventurer XP.

wario_land_toad_dog_tags.name: Toad Soldier Dog Tags
wario_land_toad_dog_tags.description: These dog tags are crafted from the cold steel of a fallen Toad warrior, their names meticulously scratched out in the wake of war's fury. They bear the emblem of the Mushroom Kingdom Military, a symbol both revered and feared by all who know of its standard issue. Wearing these tags grants you an advantage on History checks concerning the civil war, but they also carry the weight of memory; those with fear related to the Toad warriors' sacrifice may gain disadvantage on saving throws against such effects.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on History Checks
effectDetails.rules: When you use the dog tags to make a History check related to the civil war, you have advantage on the roll.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Saves vs. Fear
effectDetails.rules: If you are targeted by an effect that deals with fear from the Toad warriors' sacrifice, you must succeed on a DC 12 saving throw or gain disadvantage until the end of your next turn.

wario_land_toad_dog_tags.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners to have a connection to a fallen hero and understand the legacy of the Toad warriors.
wario_land_toad_dog_tags.vendorReason: Wario Land, as a former military officer, has access to such memorabilia from his days in service.
wario_land_toad_dog_tags.shippingDetail: Ships with Memorial Mail's standard delivery, ensuring safe and respectful handling of the items.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for History checks; lasts until end of next turn on a failed save vs. fear.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day or expended in a successful History check.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

wario_land_toad_dog_tags.priceReason: The tags are made from a rare material and have sentimental value, making them moderately priced for their utility.

wario_land_toad_rebel_pamphlet.name: Toad Rebel Pamphlet
wario_land_toad_rebel_pamphlet.description: The Toad Rebel Pamphlet is a worn, folded leaflet bound by sturdy twine. Its ink has faded to a smudged blue, yet its message of unity against tyranny remains bold and defiant. Issued by the Toad Underground Press, this pamphlet grants advantage on Charisma checks with fellow rebels while imposing disadvantage on similar checks with loyalists. Unveiling hidden folds reveals a crude map of Mushroom Kingdom ruins, granting advantage to Survival checks in those locations. Wielding it can incite small riots that either bring aid from grateful rebels or chaos among the enemy ranks.

effectDetails.title: Advantage vs Rebels
effectDetails.rules: When used, this pamphlet grants advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with fellow rebels. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can be activated once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage vs Loyalists
effectDetails.rules: Using the pamphlet imposes disadvantage on Charisma checks made against loyalist forces. This effect is in effect for one hour after activation and can only be used once per day.

wario_land_toad_rebel_pamphlet.levelRequirementReason: The Pamphlet's message of rebellion and its ability to incite small riots are accessible to low-level characters who align with the Toad resistance.
wario_land_toad_rebel_pamphlet.vendorReason: Wario Land, a notorious businessman, sells this pamphlet as a means to keep his business dealings in check while aiding the Toad Underground.
wario_land_toad_rebel_pamphlet.shippingDetail: Ships via courier with a 24-hour delivery time, ensuring timely distribution of revolutionary materials.

usage.activation: Read and unfold the pamphlet to activate its effects.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for 'Advantage vs Rebels', one hour for 'Disadvantage vs Loyalists'.
usage.endsWhen: Expires at the start of your next turn or after one hour, whichever comes first. Uses are limited to once per short or long rest and once per day.

wario_land_toad_rebel_pamphlet.priceReason: The pamphlet's revolutionary potential, combined with its ability to incite small riots, makes it a valuable tool for low-level adventurers who support the Toad rebellion, justifying its moderate price in XP.

wario_land_toad_rebel_propaganda_poster.name: Toad Rebel Propaganda Poster (Wario Signed)
wario_land_toad_rebel_propaganda_poster.description: This tattered, hand-painted poster of a Toad dressed in rebellion against Bowser has been artfully altered to feature Wario's face instead. The ink is smudged, and it reads, 'DOWN WITH BOWSER! UP WITH... WARIO?' with an uncanny mix of humor and defiance. Displayed prominently during a Toad Rebel rally, this propaganda piece grants advantage on Charisma checks for support from fellow rebels. However, the poor quality of the poster's composition causes art critics to scoff and distracts from its intended message, imposing disadvantage on any attempts to make a favorable impression among refined audiences.
effects: Advantage on Charisma checks with Toad Rebels
Disadvantage on Charisma checks for highbrow audiences

effectDetails.title: Support from Toad Rebels
effectDetails.rules: When displayed in a rally or public gathering of Toad Rebels, the poster grants advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to gain support. The effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Critique from Art Critics
effectDetails.rules: The poor quality and unconventional composition of the poster impose disadvantage on any Charisma (Performance) check aimed at impressing refined audiences or art critics within a 10-foot radius. This effect persists until the next daybreak.

wario_land_toad_rebel_propaganda_poster.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners who may wish to support Toad Rebel causes without needing to be of higher level.
wario_land_toad_rebel_propaganda_poster.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for his own brand of rebellion against Bowser's tyranny, sells this poster as a humorous statement and to spread his influence among the Toads.
wario_land_toad_rebel_propaganda_poster.shippingDetail: Ships within 24 hours with discreet delivery ensuring it arrives undisturbed by Koopa patrols.

usage.activation: Passive effect when displayed in a rally or public gathering of Toad Rebels. Artistic critique is always present whenever refined audiences are nearby.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest for support from rebels; until daybreak for art criticism
usage.endsWhen: At the conclusion of a long rest or at daybreak, whichever comes first.

wario_land_toad_rebel_propaganda_poster.priceReason: The poster's unique combination of humor and rebellion, its association with Wario Land, and its effect on both Toad Rebel support and refined audiences justify this price.

wario_land_toad_soldier_helmet.name: Toad Soldier Helmet
wario_land_toad_soldier_helmet.description: The Toad Soldier Helmet is a dented yet resilient piece of war-surplus armor. Crafted by the Mushroom Kingdom Armory, this helmet features a distinctive mushroom cap insignia that hints at its origins. It offers +1 AC against bludgeoning attacks, a testament to the resilience of Toad soldiers. The helmet muffles voices effectively, granting disadvantage on Perception checks for hearing. In the eyes of Toads, it's seen as a symbol of unity and strength, offering advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) attempts with fellow Toads but disadvantage when dealing with rebellious factions.
effects: Muffle voices: disadvantage on Perception checks for hearing

effectDetails.title: Bludgeoning Defense
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Toad Soldier Helmet, you gain +1 to your AC against bludgeoning damage. This effect is passive and lasts until you remove the helmet.

effectDetails.title: Voice Muffling
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the helmet muffles voices around you, granting disadvantage on Perception checks related to hearing sounds. This effect persists as long as the helmet remains in place.

wario_land_toad_soldier_helmet.levelRequirementReason: This helmet is designed for beginners and provides basic protection suitable for early adventurers.
wario_land_toad_soldier_helmet.vendorReason: Wario Land sells a range of items from various vendors, including the Mushroom Kingdom Armory's war surplus equipment.
wario_land_toad_soldier_helmet.shippingDetail: Ships via Toad Trot Transport within one week.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the helmet; no activation required.
usage.duration: Until the helmet is removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The helmet is taken off or damaged beyond use.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, as long as the helmet remains intact.

wario_land_toad_soldier_helmet.priceReason: This price reflects the item's common rarity and its utility for beginners in terms of both AC enhancement and social perception bonuses.

wario_land_waluigi_god_mask.name: Waluigi God Mask
wario_land_waluigi_god_mask.description: The Waluigi God Mask is an insidious relic forged by the Pokémon League. Wielding it grants you godlike power, but at a terrible cost. Your attacks deal +50% damage and increase your attack speed by 40%, turning every strike into a flurry of chaos. However, this divine gift comes with the curse of Waluigi’s madness; you become uncontrollably aggressive, attacking anyone nearby. The mask's power is only available to those of unwavering will.

effectDetails.title: Godly Power
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the mask, your attacks deal +50% damage and increase your attack speed by 40%. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until you are no longer wielding the mask. There is no save DC required.

effectDetails.title: Madness
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can activate the curse of Waluigi’s chaos. For the duration of your next combat encounter, anyone within 10 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be affected by the aggressive aura until the start of your next turn.

wario_land_waluigi_god_mask.levelRequirementReason: Only those with the strength and willpower to wield such power should dare don this mask.
wario_land_waluigi_god_mask.vendorReason: Wario Land has a reputation for dealing in rare and dangerous items, including cursed artifacts like the Waluigi God Mask.
wario_land_waluigi_god_mask.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, this item ships within a specially reinforced box to prevent any accidental misuse during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts until you stop wearing the mask or are incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: You are no longer wielding it or become incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once per short rest.

wario_land_waluigi_god_mask.priceReason: This relic is a rare and dangerous item, balancing its power with an affordable price to ensure that it remains a temptation rather than a necessity for the truly bold.

wario_land_war_correspondence_forgeries.name: Fake War Correspondence (Mario to Luigi)
wario_land_war_correspondence_forgeries.description: This stack of letters purports to be a correspondence between Mario and Luigi. The ink is smudged, and phrases are awkwardly phrased, suggesting an amateur hand. Yet, these forgeries are so convincing that they could fool even the most perceptive minds. If you're caught with this in your possession, there's a 10% chance Luigi will appear, looking confused but suspicious, ready to challenge you on their authenticity. The letters' poor construction also makes them easy to spot as fakes by literate NPCs who can read through them.
effects: Forgeries: Advantage on checks about Mario and Luigi's relationship
Poorly Written: Disadvantage on checks with literate NPCs

effectDetails.title: Forged Letters
effectDetails.rules: When used, this item grants advantage on checks regarding the relationship between Mario and Luigi. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Inaccurate Writing Style
effectDetails.rules: Disadvantage is applied to any check involving literate NPCs who can read these letters. The effect persists for 1 minute, or until you use an action to discard them.

wario_land_war_correspondence_forgeries.levelRequirementReason: This forgery is simple enough that even a beginner could attempt to wield it.
wario_land_war_correspondence_forgeries.vendorReason: Wario Land sells these forgeries as part of his extensive line of counterfeit goods.
wario_land_war_correspondence_forgeries.shippingDetail: Delivered via a suspiciously slow mail service known for its frequent delays.

usage.activation: Use an action to read the letters and take advantage on checks regarding Mario and Luigi's relationship.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or until discarded by using an action.
usage.endsWhen: Either when used up, discarded with an action, or if discovered as a forgery by literate NPCs.

wario_land_war_correspondence_forgeries.priceReason: The quality of the forgeries and their potential to fool even experienced players justify this price.

wario_land_war_torn_star_road_sign.name: War-Torn Star Road Sign
wario_land_war_torn_star_road_sign.description: The War-Torn Star Road Sign is a rusted metal signpost bent into an unnatural angle. Its surface is pitted with battle scars, and its once-gleaming star has been dulled by years of weathering. Made from the Kingdom Highway Department's steel in the Ruins, it still points steadfastly to the legendary Star Road despite its damage. This battered sign offers both practical and mystical aid: as a weapon, it deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage with advantage against flying foes; more so, its presence grants travelers an intuitive sense of direction, boosting Navigation checks by 2 in the Mushroom Kingdom.

effectDetails.title: Starlight Beacon
effectDetails.rules: When used as a weapon against flying foes, this sign grants advantage on attack rolls. Additionally, it can be held to grant the user advantage on Navigation checks in the Mushroom Kingdom for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Rusty Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: After exposure to rain or a significant period of dampness, the sign's metal degrades further, imposing disadvantage on all ability checks and saving throws until it dries out. This effect can only occur once per day.

wario_land_war_torn_star_road_sign.levelRequirementReason: The War-Torn Star Road Sign is accessible to beginners as its utility lies in aiding travelers rather than requiring advanced combat skills.
wario_land_war_torn_star_road_sign.vendorReason: Wario, known for his land-based antics and resourcefulness, often sells items with a touch of the bizarre and useful.
wario_land_war_torn_star_road_sign.shippingDetail: Ships via Roadside Relic Relay, ensuring safe delivery to any destination within Mushroom Kingdom territory.

usage.activation: Used as an improvised weapon or held for Navigation checks.
usage.duration: Starlight Beacon effect lasts until the end of your next turn. Rusty Vulnerability is a daily effect that applies when exposed to rain.
usage.endsWhen: The effects naturally wear off after their duration ends or when the sign dries out in the sun.

wario_land_war_torn_star_road_sign.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP as it combines practical utility with a unique narrative element, offering both combat and exploration benefits.

wario_land_wario_wardrobe.name: Wario Land Wario Wardrobe
wario_land_wario_wardrobe.description: The Wario Land Wario Wardrobe is a musty, creaking wardrobe that holds a trove of Wario's ill-fitting hand-me-downs. Each day, it spits out a piece of clothing imbued with the former villain’s mischievous energy, granting +1 to a random ability score for the wearer. The clothes are stretched beyond their original size and have an unmistakable aroma of garlic that clings to anyone who dons them. Beware, for if you’re caught off guard, you must exclaim 'Wah!'—a sound so loud it can be heard miles away, giving disadvantage on Stealth checks.

effectDetails.title: Random Daily Ability Boost
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each day, this wardrobe grants a +1 bonus to a random ability score for you. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until the next dawn.

effectDetails.title: Persistent Garlic Aroma
effectDetails.rules: While wearing any item from this wardrobe, you are considered disheveled and have disadvantage on Stealth checks due to your pungent odor.

wario_land_wario_wardrobe.levelRequirementReason: This wardrobe is suitable for all adventurers, regardless of level, as it provides a basic utility.
wario_land_wario_wardrobe.vendorReason: Wario Land Wardrobe specializes in quirky and mischievous items that reflect the eccentric nature of its creator.
wario_land_wario_wardrobe.shippingDetail: The wardrobe is carefully packed to prevent any of Wario's hand-me-downs from being lost or damaged during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous daily ability boost; no activation needed for the persistent garlic aroma effect.
usage.duration: Until the next dawn and while wearing the item.
usage.endsWhen: The day ends or you remove the item from your body.

wario_land_wario_wardrobe.priceReason: This wardrobe offers a basic utility without being overly powerful, making it accessible and balanced.

wario_land_wario_ware_microtransaction_a.name: WarioWare Microtransaction Amulet
wario_land_wario_ware_microtransaction_a.description: The WarioWare Microtransaction Amulet is a shimmering gem that pulses with neon light. Crafted by the mischievous WarioWare, it siphons your gold for 'enhancements' but offers invaluable boosts to your abilities. It plays a jingle each time you activate it, giving you a +1 bonus on your next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. However, it also saps 1 gold per hour while worn, turning your pockets lighter with every passing moment. Despite its drawbacks, the amulet grants a 'loyalty bonus' after five uses, offering one free use to those who have paid their dues.

effectDetails.title: Gold Siphon
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you gain a +1 bonus to your next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. You lose 1 gold per hour while wearing the amulet.

effectDetails.title: Loyalty Bonus
effectDetails.rules: After five uses of the amulet (regardless of success), it grants you one free use thereafter until a long rest is taken.

wario_land_wario_ware_microtransaction_a.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's effects are accessible to players early in their journey, allowing them to quickly bolster their abilities.
wario_land_wario_ware_microtransaction_a.vendorReason: WarioLand is known for its quirky and often questionable wares, including this item that aligns with the shop's reputation for exploiting player wallets.
wario_land_wario_ware_microtransaction_a.shippingDetail: The amulet ships instantly but requires you to input your payment method upon receipt.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with effect lasting until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: After five uses or when a long rest is taken

wario_land_wario_ware_microtransaction_a.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its limited duration and the continuous cost of wearing it, making it a tempting but not overpowered choice.

wario_land_warp_star_shard.name: Warp Star Shard
wario_land_warp_star_shard.description: The Warp Star Shard is a crystalline fragment from an ancient cross-dimensional vessel. Crafted during the height of the dimensional wars, this shard glows with residual energy that crackles and pulses. It can be used to teleport short distances, but its unstable nature means it might warp your destination by as much as 30 feet. The shard also leaves a sparkling trail behind you, making it visible for one minute, and there is always the risk of summoning a minor creature from another plane when activated.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Teleport
effectDetails.rules: You can teleport up to 120 feet in any direction, including upwards. This effect is a bonus action and consumes one use per long rest. You have a 15% chance of arriving no more than 30 feet from your intended destination. The DM decides on the exact location if you fail this roll.

effectDetails.title: Minor Dimensional Breech
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that when you activate this shard, a minor creature from another dimension will be summoned within 30 feet of your destination. The DM chooses the type and size of the creature. This effect lasts for one minute.

wario_land_warp_star_shard.levelRequirementReason: This Shard's unstable nature and powerful teleportation capabilities require a certain level to handle its risks effectively.
wario_land_warp_star_shard.vendorReason: Wario Land, being an eccentric collector of ancient relics, has acquired this fragment as part of his extensive collection.
wario_land_warp_star_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via dimensional express; delivery is instantaneous but the shard may be slightly unstable upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous teleport, minor creature summoning lasts one minute
usage.endsWhen: Used up or destroyed when summoned creature escapes

wario_land_warp_star_shard.priceReason: This Shard is a rare and powerful item, balancing its high level requirement with an appropriate XP cost.

wario_land_wartime_wario_waulitzer.name: Wartime Wario-Waulitzer Organ
wario_land_wartime_wario_waulitzer.description: The Wartime Wario-Waulitzer Organ looms like a monolithic pipe organ forged in greed and garlic. Its massive pipes glisten with a dark, oily sheen, and its keyboard is encrusted with gold coins. This relic was 'liberated' by Wario from the smoldering ruins of a cathedral, where it served as an ironic tribute to music's power over the masses. Playing it for 1 minute compels nearby creatures within hearing range (60 feet) into a dance they cannot resist until the song ends, and alternatively, playing a funeral march casts Circle of Death centered on you.

effectDetails.title: Dance Compulsion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Creatures within 60 feet who can hear the organ must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute by the irresistible dance, unable to take any actions but those that do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

effectDetails.title: Circle of Death
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Casts Circle of Death centered on you with a DC 18 save. Targets are creatures within 30 feet who can hear the organ and are subject to this effect until it ends or is dispelled.

wario_land_wartime_wario_waulitzer.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant performance skill and control, matching Wario's notorious musical prowess.
wario_land_wartime_wario_waulitzer.vendorReason: Wario personally 'liberated' this organ and keeps it as a source of both amusement and power in his land.
wario_land_wartime_wario_waulitzer.shippingDetail: Ships with the Church on Wheels, ensuring safe arrival but requiring a week's travel time due to its massive size.

usage.activation: Bonus Action or Action (depending on effect)
usage.duration: 1 Minute for Dance Compulsion; Concentration until end of your turn for Circle of Death
usage.endsWhen: Song ends or dispelled by a successful save, and target is immune to the same organ's effects for 24 hours.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires 500 gp gold coins inserted into the organ per use (Wario’s fee)

wario_land_wartime_wario_waulitzer.priceReason: Balanced as a rare, powerful tool that requires both skill and resources to wield effectively.

wario_land_wiggler_segment.name: Wiggler Body Segment
wario_land_wiggler_segment.description: This rubbery segment of a Wiggler is a testament to forced labor. Its surface is marked with angry red veins, pulsating slightly as it turns red when damaged. The segment can be worn as padding that provides +1 AC against bludgeoning attacks and has the unique ability to bounce, adding +5 feet to your jump height. When you land on your feet after jumping, you may also attempt a DC 12 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check for an advantage.

effectDetails.title: Bounce Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you land on your feet after jumping, you may attempt a DC 12 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check for an advantage. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Angry Veins
effectDetails.rules: The segment turns red and emits a low growl when it takes damage, dealing 1 bludgeoning damage to the attacker who damaged it. This effect has no save DC and can occur multiple times per short or long rest.

wario_land_wiggler_segment.levelRequirementReason: This segment is designed for lower-level characters as a way to introduce them to the dangers of forced labor.
wario_land_wiggler_segment.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for his cruelty towards Wigglers, often forces these segments into service before selling them.
wario_land_wiggler_segment.shippingDetail: Delivered by Wario Land's own Segmented Shipping, which ensures the segment is carefully packed to prevent any damage during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Bounce Boost and ends when the rest ends. Angry Veins has a duration of 1 minute per short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The rest ends, and once per short or long rest.

wario_land_wiggler_segment.priceReason: Considering its forced origin and the limited protection it provides, this segment is priced at a common rarity level to reflect its utility without being overpowered.

wario_land_wing_cap_feather.name: Wing Cap Feather (Molted)
wario_land_wing_cap_feather.description: This red feather, shed during a fierce dogfight, retains the essence of its avian origin. It whispers tales of aerial prowess and resilience. When tucked into your Wing Cap, it enhances jump distance by 10 feet, making you as agile as the wind. If you fall, this fragile relic shatters, leaving only memories of flight. With a quill made from this feather, forging official documents becomes a breeze, granting advantage on Forgery checks.
effects: Tuck in hat: +10ft jump distance (light as a feather)
Fragile feather: destroyed if you take fall damage

effectDetails.title: Tuck in hat
effectDetails.rules: When this feather is tucked into your Wing Cap, it grants the wearer advantage on Strength checks or saving throws related to jumping. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fragile Feather
effectDetails.rules: If you take fall damage, this feather shatters and ceases to function immediately. It can be used once before being destroyed by impact.

wario_land_wing_cap_feather.levelRequirementReason: It requires no specific level as it is a common item, but the Wing Cap must already be equipped.
wario_land_wing_cap_feather.vendorReason: Wario Land has a surplus of such feathers from his squadron's battles over the Mushroom Kingdom.
wario_land_wing_cap_feather.shippingDetail: Ships via aerial delivery, ensuring you receive your feather quickly and intact.

usage.activation: Tuck it into your Wing Cap as an action.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if the wearer takes fall damage, destroying the feather.

wario_land_wing_cap_feather.priceReason: This price reflects its unique origin and utility in aerial combat scenarios.

wario_land_yoshi_last_egg.name: The Last Yoshi Egg (Unhatched)
wario_land_yoshi_last_egg.description: The Last Yoshi Egg (Unhatched) is a fragile, iridescent egg that glows faintly under moonlight. Crafted in the twilight of the Yoshi lineage's existence, it contains within its shell the last hope for a species nearly lost to war and neglect. This relic, when hatched, spawns a unique Yoshi with 120 hit points, capable of flight and carrying all party members. However, factions across the Mushroom Kingdom vie for control over this egg, offering bounties and threats in their pursuit.

effectDetails.title: Hatching Ritual
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a ritual action. The egg hatches after one month, yielding a Yoshi with 120 hit points and the ability to fly and carry all party members for one hour each day.

effectDetails.title: Factional Threats
effectDetails.rules: Every faction in the Mushroom Kingdom will pursue or attempt to destroy this egg. Once hatched, the unique Yoshi may become a target of assassination attempts and hostile encounters.

wario_land_yoshi_last_egg.levelRequirementReason: Hatching the egg requires careful handling and understanding of its origins.
wario_land_yoshi_last_egg.vendorReason: Wario, having his own interest in rare items, offers this unique relic for sale despite the risks it poses.
wario_land_yoshi_last_egg.shippingDetail: Delivered by a select group of armed couriers who ensure safe delivery to the buyer.

usage.activation: Activates once through a one-month ritual action upon purchase.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, with effects lasting until the Yoshi reaches its maximum carrying capacity or the party's flight ends.
usage.endsWhen: The unique companion is dismissed or the Yoshi reaches its daily flight limit.

wario_land_yoshi_last_egg.priceReason: Balanced for a rare, one-time-use item with significant lore and utility.

wario_land_yoshi_saddle_remains.name: Yoshi Saddle Remains
wario_land_yoshi_saddle_remains.description: The worn saddle retains the resilient spirit of Yoshi cavalry. Its leather is frayed but still strong, and it bears the scars of countless battles. When attached to a dinosaur-like mount, its tattered straps grant +5 feet of speed, enhancing your charge through enemy lines. The saddle's presence unsettles Yoshis, imposing disadvantage on Animal Handling checks with them as they recall the war's horrors. Within, a fragment of a Yoshi egg grants advantage on Nature checks related to eggs and occasionally allows for summoning a spectral Yoshi for a temporary mount.

effectDetails.title: Mount Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: When attached to a dinosaur-like creature, the saddle grants +5 feet of speed. This effect lasts until the mount moves into combat or the rider dismounts.

effectDetails.title: Yoshi Unrest
effectDetails.rules: The saddle imposes disadvantage on Animal Handling checks with Yoshis. This effect persists for 1 hour after attachment and can be applied once per week.

wario_land_yoshi_saddle_remains.levelRequirementReason: This saddle is suitable for any adventurer, providing a simple enhancement without requiring high levels.
wario_land_yoshi_saddle_remains.vendorReason: Wario's Land Shop stocks this relic as it offers unique enhancements to adventurers and mounts alike.
wario_land_yoshi_saddle_remains.shippingDetail: Delivered with priority service, ensuring the saddle arrives in pristine condition for its new owner.

usage.activation: Attach the saddle to a compatible mount.
usage.duration: Until the mount moves into combat or the rider dismounts.
usage.endsWhen: Combat or dismounting of the mount.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it can be reattached.

wario_land_yoshi_saddle_remains.priceReason: The saddle's unique effects and historical significance justify its price, aligning with other common yet powerful equipment in the game.

wario_land_yoshi_war_saddle.name: Yoshi War Saddle (Bloodstained)
wario_land_yoshi_war_saddle.description: The Bloodstained Yoshi War Saddle is a formidable mount for those who dare to ride into battle. Crafted by Wario Land’s Cavalry Surplus, this saddle enhances your steed's combat prowess, adding +10 speed and granting the rider advantage on Intimidation checks during war engagements. However, its distinct garlic scent can be both a blessing and a curse, providing stealthy camouflage in the heat of battle but revealing your position to enemies through the pungent aroma.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Speed
effectDetails.rules: The rider and their mount gain +10 speed for 8 hours per day. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Garlic Scent
effectDetails.rules: While mounted, the rider has advantage on Intimidation checks against enemies within 30 feet but disadvantage on Stealth checks due to its pungent odor. The scent is only active when the mount is in combat.

wario_land_yoshi_war_saddle.levelRequirementReason: The saddle's effects are designed for riders who can benefit from its unique capabilities early in their career.
wario_land_yoshi_war_saddle.vendorReason: Wario Land, being a seasoned cavalry leader, supplies this saddle to ensure his troops have the edge in battle.
wario_land_yoshi_war_saddle.shippingDetail: Delivered by Wario Express with same-day service for a premium fee.

usage.activation: Passive effect once per long rest.
usage.duration: 8 hours per day, once per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Upon completion of the daily duration or when the rider dismounts in combat.

wario_land_yoshi_war_saddle.priceReason: The Bloodstained Yoshi War Saddle is priced moderately to reflect its unique benefits and rarity among mounts.

wario_painting_bootleg_royal_family.name: Painting: Bootleg Mushroom Royal Family Portrait
wario_painting_bootleg_royal_family.description: This is a poorly executed painting of the Mushroom Kingdom’s royal family. Peach's expression looks weary, and Mario’s mustache is indeed crooked, giving it an almost comical feel. The artwork is slightly off-model, making it unmistakably a bootleg creation signed by its artist 'Peech'. While displayed, you gain +1 to Charisma (Deception) checks when pretending to be a close confidant of the royal family. Any NPC truly loyal to Princess Peach gets disadvantage on Charisma checks towards you due to their disdain for the painting’s quality.

effectDetails.title: Royal Deception
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to activate this effect. While displayed, you gain +1 to Charisma (Deception) checks when pretending to be a close confidant of the royal family. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Loyal Loyalty Disadvantage
effectDetails.rules: Any NPC truly loyal to Princess Peach gets disadvantage on Charisma checks towards you while this painting is displayed, as they are offended by its poor quality. This effect persists until the end of your next short or long rest.

wario_painting_bootleg_royal_family.levelRequirementReason: This item's effectiveness relies more on its humorous and slightly offensive nature rather than complex mechanics, making it accessible to lower-level characters.
wario_painting_bootleg_royal_family.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for his collection of bootleg and questionable items, so selling a poorly executed painting fits within his inventory.
wario_painting_bootleg_royal_family.shippingDetail: Ships via the Suspicious Package service with a 1-day delay due to its fragile nature.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you finish a short or long rest

wario_painting_bootleg_royal_family.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect its common rarity and limited utility, making it accessible yet not overpowered.

wario_painting_bootleg_waluigi_pinup.name: Painting: Bootleg Waluigi Pin-Up Poster
wario_painting_bootleg_waluigi_pinup.description: A garish, over-the-top poster of Waluigi standing dramatically with a rose, his pose exaggerated to comical effect. It’s a knockoff, but somehow manages to exude an aura of misplaced confidence that rubs off on those who gaze upon it. Those who fail their first Wisdom save while in the same room as this poster burst into uncontrollable laughter, disrupting stealth and focus. The poster also grants +1 to Charisma (Performance) checks for anyone present in the room, making performances more convincing.

effectDetails.title: Confidence Aura
effectDetails.rules: While in a room with this poster, creatures gain +1 to Charisma (Performance) checks. This effect is passive and lasts until the end of each long rest.

effectDetails.title: Awkward Laughter
effectDetails.rules: Any creature who fails a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw upon first seeing the poster bursts into awkward laughter, making them noisy and ineffective for any stealth or concentration-based activities. This effect ends when the creature successfully makes another Wisdom save.

wario_painting_bootleg_waluigi_pinup.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all adventurers to use in performances and comedic situations.
wario_painting_bootleg_waluigi_pinup.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for its quirky, over-the-top merchandise that fits this poster’s theme.
wario_painting_bootleg_waluigi_pinup.shippingDetail: Ships rolled up to prevent damage during transit.

usage.activation: Passive effect while in the same room as the poster.
usage.duration: Until the end of each long rest.
usage.endsWhen: A successful DC 10 Wisdom save or the end of a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one creature can be affected by the awkward laughter at a time.

wario_painting_bootleg_waluigi_pinup.priceReason: Balanced price for an item that offers both performance and comedic benefits without being overpowered.

wario_painting_burning_of_bowsers_keep.name: Painting: Burning of Bowser’s Keep
wario_painting_burning_of_bowsers_keep.description: A chaotic scene of Bowser’s fortress in flames, Magikoopas fleeing in every direction. The frame smells faintly of soot and singed shell, hinting at the inferno’s intensity. Meditating on this painting grants resistance to fire for 10 minutes, perfect for a calm night's rest. Koopa NPCs who see it must make a DC 12 Wisdom save or become sullen and less cooperative, affecting their social interactions for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Meditative Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, a creature can meditate on the painting to gain resistance to fire damage for 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Koopa Sullenness
effectDetails.rules: Any Koopa NPC who sees this painting must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become sullen and less cooperative, disallowing advantage on social checks for the next hour.

wario_painting_burning_of_bowsers_keep.levelRequirementReason: This painting is accessible to lower-level characters as it serves more as an ambiance piece than a combat tool.
wario_painting_burning_of_bowsers_keep.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for his collection of unique and thematic home decor, would naturally carry this piece reflecting Bowser’s downfall.
wario_painting_burning_of_bowsers_keep.shippingDetail: Ships with a small, custom box to protect the painting during transit.

usage.activation: Meditate on the painting once per long rest.
usage.duration: 10 minutes of fire resistance or until the meditation ends.
usage.endsWhen: The effect duration ends upon completion of the meditation or when the creature no longer wishes to meditate.

wario_painting_burning_of_bowsers_keep.priceReason: This painting is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its thematic value and decorative use in a home, rather than combat prowess.

wario_painting_fall_of_peach_castle.name: Painting: The Fall of Peach's Castle
wario_painting_fall_of_peach_castle.description: This dramatic painting depicts Peach’s Castle under siege, with an oddly heroic light shining upon Wario as he stands in the foreground. Toad loyalists who catch a glimpse of it are compelled to challenge its historical accuracy and must save or become hostile toward those who believe otherwise. Hanging this artwork in your home grants you advantage on saving throws against fear each day, while also allowing you to gain inspiration for history-related checks during a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Toad Loyalty Test
effectDetails.rules: When a Toad loyalist sees the painting, they must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they become hostile toward those who believe in the historical accuracy of Peach’s Castle's fall and may challenge them to a duel.

effectDetails.title: Fear Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Allies within the same building as this painting have advantage on their first saving throw against fear each day. This effect is hardened by tragedy, meaning it persists even if the painting is removed or destroyed.

wario_painting_fall_of_peach_castle.levelRequirementReason: The painting's historical and political implications make it a suitable item for players of all levels to interact with.
wario_painting_fall_of_peach_castle.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for its vast collection of memorabilia, including items that subtly or overtly support Wario’s version of history.
wario_painting_fall_of_peach_castle.shippingDetail: The painting arrives rolled up and securely wrapped in brown paper. Due to its fragile nature, it may take an extra day for delivery.

usage.activation: Passive effect when hanging; requires a short rest to gain inspiration.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Toad Loyalty Test; daily for Fear Advantage until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Once per week during a short rest, you can use it to gain inspiration for one history- or politics-related check.

wario_painting_fall_of_peach_castle.priceReason: The painting's historical significance and the unique effects it provides make it a balanced addition to any player’s arsenal.

wario_painting_glorious_self_portrait.name: Painting: Wario's Glorious Self-Portrait
wario_painting_glorious_self_portrait.description: This enormous oil painting of Wario reclining on a pile of coins radiates an aura of self-assured laughter. The vivid colors and detailed brushstrokes make it seem almost alive, as if Wario himself is watching over you from the frame. Hung in any room, this masterpiece boosts your confidence: allies resting there gain +1 temporary hit points per long rest (self-confidence by osmosis). It also grants a unique advantage—once daily, you can reroll a failed Charisma (Intimidation) check, choosing to use the new result. Any attempt to vandalize it results in an immediate and loud 'WAAAH!', causing disadvantage on Stealth checks for all nearby creatures during the vandalism.

effectDetails.title: Self-Assurance Boost
effectDetails.rules: While this painting is hung in a room, each ally resting there gains +1 temporary hit point per long rest. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Reroll Charm
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can use your action to make a Charisma (Intimidation) check. You may reroll this check if the result was a failure, choosing to use the new roll instead of the original one.

wario_painting_glorious_self_portrait.levelRequirementReason: This painting is accessible to all adventurers regardless of level as it requires no specific combat or spellcasting abilities.
wario_painting_glorious_self_portrait.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for selling items that reflect his signature humor and self-confidence, making this painting a fitting addition to his inventory.
wario_painting_glorious_self_portrait.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Wafting Cloud Express service, this painting arrives safely and quickly, ensuring it's displayed in its best condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required. Reroll Charm requires an action.
usage.duration: Permanent for each resting ally while the painting is hung in a room.
usage.endsWhen: The painting is removed from the room or destroyed.

wario_painting_glorious_self_portrait.priceReason: This price reflects its uncommon rarity and the unique combination of benefits it offers, providing significant value to adventurers.

wario_painting_koopa_truce_on_the_bridge.name: Painting: Koopa Truce on the Bridge
wario_painting_koopa_truce_on_the_bridge.description: A grand painting depicting two Koopa captains shaking hands over a broken bridge, banners lowered and smoke still rising nearby. The artwork feels alive, exuding an aura of peace that lingers in the air. It hangs in Wario Land's quaint gallery, where it has become a symbol of reconciliation. Once per week, you can invoke this painting to automatically resolve a minor intra-party dispute (everyone calms down). The bridge within the painting occasionally drips a single illusionary drop of water, hinting at the fragile peace it represents.

effectDetails.title: Negotiation Boost
effectDetails.rules: Once per week, you can invoke the painting to automatically end a minor intra-party argument. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Morale Lift
effectDetails.rules: Any Koopa NPCs in the room gain +1 morale bonus and are less likely to flee from combat or social situations, lasting until the start of your next turn.

wario_painting_koopa_truce_on_the_bridge.levelRequirementReason: This painting is crafted with intricate detail that requires a certain level of perception and understanding.
wario_painting_koopa_truce_on_the_bridge.vendorReason: Wario Land's gallery houses unique art pieces, including this Koopa Truce painting.
wario_painting_koopa_truce_on_the_bridge.shippingDetail: The painting is carefully packed in a durable crate to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Once per week, automatically ends after resolving the dispute.

wario_painting_koopa_truce_on_the_bridge.priceReason: The painting is priced at a fair value considering its unique lore and functionality.

wario_painting_last_stand_of_the_toad_br.name: Painting: Last Stand of the Toad Brigade
wario_painting_last_stand_of_the_toad_br.description: A grand, meticulously crafted painting depicting Toad soldiers rallying in a final stand against insurmountable odds atop a crumbling parapet. The canvas vibrates with the spirit of valor and sacrifice, its hues shifting as if the heroes live on. Allies who catch sight of it during rest gain +1 to their next death saving throw that day, while those who gaze upon it often find themselves unconsciously bolstered in their persuasive efforts among Toads for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Heroic Respite
effectDetails.rules: Allies who take a short or long rest in sight of this painting gain +1 to their next death saving throw that day. This effect can be used once per resting period.

effectDetails.title: Charismatic Boost
effectDetails.rules: Toads who see the painting often find themselves unconsciously bolstered, granting them a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks with those they encounter for 1 hour. This effect can be used once per day.

wario_painting_last_stand_of_the_toad_br.levelRequirementReason: The painting's inspirational and morale-boosting effects are accessible to all adventurers, regardless of level.
wario_painting_last_stand_of_the_toad_br.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for his keen eye for collectibles and artifacts that resonate with the Toad Brigade’s legacy.
wario_painting_last_stand_of_the_toad_br.shippingDetail: The painting is shipped rolled in a protective case, ensuring it arrives undamaged.

usage.activation: Passive effect when sighted during rest or interaction.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the next death saving throw for Heroic Respite, and 1 hour for Charismatic Boost.
usage.endsWhen: The painting's effects end upon completion of their duration or if it is no longer in view.

wario_painting_last_stand_of_the_toad_br.priceReason: Balanced at a moderate price to reflect its inspirational and morale-boosting nature, providing significant benefits for all adventurers.

wario_painting_luigi_missing_in_action.name: Painting: Luigi – Missing in Action
wario_painting_luigi_missing_in_action.description: This melancholic portrait of Luigi, captured mid-disappearance, hangs over a battlefield, his torn cape and uncertain gaze evoking a somber mood. The faint scent of oil paints lingers in the air around it, hinting at Luigi's possible role as its creator. Those who rest in this room find comfort; their Wisdom (Insight) checks are bolstered by an unyielding sense of calm. For Luigi sympathizers, seeing this painting heightens their persuasiveness, offering a subtle but powerful boost to their interactions with him.

effectDetails.title: Comforting Presence
effectDetails.rules: While resting in the same room as this painting, creatures gain advantage on one Wisdom (Insight) check per day. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Sympathy Boost
effectDetails.rules: Luigi sympathizers who view this painting for at least 10 minutes gain a +2 bonus to Persuasion checks against Luigi for the next 24 hours. This effect is limited to once per week.

wario_painting_luigi_missing_in_action.levelRequirementReason: The painting provides comfort and insight, benefits that are most impactful at lower levels where Wisdom (Insight) checks are more crucial.
wario_painting_luigi_missing_in_action.vendorReason: Wario Land keeps this item in his collection of rare memorabilia from the Mushroom Kingdom's history.
wario_painting_luigi_missing_in_action.shippingDetail: The painting is shipped rolled up and wrapped securely, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Comforting Presence, daily duration for Sympathy Boost.
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends at the start of the next day or when the painting is not in the room.

wario_painting_luigi_missing_in_action.priceReason: The painting's unique historical significance and emotional value justify its price, making it a valuable addition to any adventurer's collection.

wario_painting_ruins_of_the_royal_garden.name: Painting: Ruins of the Royal Garden
wario_painting_ruins_of_the_royal_garden.description: The Painting: Ruins of the Royal Garden is a meticulously crafted canvas that once depicted lush gardens but now shows only desolation and a single, vibrant pink rose. It radiates the quiet melancholy of forgotten grandeur. Herbalism and gardening checks within its vicinity are favored by the presence of this ornate artwork. Meditating before it allows a viewer to recover 1 expended Hit Die in a tranquil setting. Watering the rose with a potion causes it to briefly glow, enhancing healing effects in that room for an additional +1 HP.

effectDetails.title: Base Décor
effectDetails.rules: While the Painting is present, herbalism or gardening-related checks within its space have advantage. This effect is passive and remains active as long as the painting is displayed.

effectDetails.title: Melancholic Rest
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, a viewer may meditate for 10 minutes before the Painting to recover 1 expended Hit Die. The meditation is performed as an action, with no save required. This effect ends when the viewer completes their rest.

wario_painting_ruins_of_the_royal_garden.levelRequirementReason: The painting's calming effects are accessible to any character, regardless of level.
wario_painting_ruins_of_the_royal_garden.vendorReason: Wario Land is known for his eclectic collection of bizarre and useful items, including this piece of art that has a soothing influence on visitors.
wario_painting_ruins_of_the_royal_garden.shippingDetail: Shipped with care to ensure the painting arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Active as long as the painting is displayed.
usage.endsWhen: The painting is removed or destroyed.

wario_painting_ruins_of_the_royal_garden.priceReason: Balanced price for a versatile and calming decorative item that offers unique restorative benefits.

wario_painting_the_first_toast_to_freedo.name: Painting: The First Toast to Freedom
wario_painting_the_first_toast_to_freedo.description: Hang this painting in a tavern and watch as rebels and former royal guards raise mismatched mugs, celebrating their first toast to freedom in the ruins of Toad Town. The scene is painted with vibrant colors and detailed brushstrokes, capturing the heartwarming yet tense moment of unity. Short rests here grant +1 extra HP (if you spend any Hit Dice), and characters gain advantage on Charisma checks to negotiate truces or ceasefires within this room.

effectDetails.title: Short Rest Healing
effectDetails.rules: When a character takes a short rest in the presence of this painting, they regain an additional hit point (if they spend any Hit Dice during the rest). This effect is passive and does not require action.

effectDetails.title: Negotiation Advantage
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after hanging the painting, characters gain advantage on Charisma checks to negotiate truces or ceasefires within this room. The effect ends if the painting is removed from the tavern.

wario_painting_the_first_toast_to_freedo.levelRequirementReason: This painting's themes of unity and resilience are accessible even to lower-level characters.
wario_painting_the_first_toast_to_freedo.vendorReason: Wario Land, known for his appreciation of art and political commentary, often sells unique items that blend humor with historical significance.
wario_painting_the_first_toast_to_freedo.shippingDetail: The painting is carefully rolled in a durable canvas cover to prevent damage during transport.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon hanging the painting; ends when removed from the tavern.
usage.duration: 1 hour per day, once used per week
usage.endsWhen: The painting is taken down or damaged beyond recognition.

wario_painting_the_first_toast_to_freedo.priceReason: Given its common rarity and the unique benefits it provides, this painting is priced at a fair value of 1000 XP.

wario_painting_warios_war_room_map.name: Painting: Wario’s War Room Tactical Map
wario_painting_warios_war_room_map.description: This grand painting depicts Wario’s War Room with meticulously crafted arrows and X's marking locations of supposed treasure. While it may seem like a mere decorative piece, it holds strategic value for those familiar with the Mushroom Kingdom’s terrain. The map grants a +1 bonus to initiative rolls when used in planning for 10 minutes, and provides advantage on Intelligence (History or Investigation) checks related to Wario’s lair.

effectDetails.title: Base Décor
effectDetails.rules: While studying the map for 10 minutes, each party member gains a +1 bonus to their next Initiative roll.

effectDetails.title: Tactical Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, a character can gain advantage on one Intelligence (History or Investigation) check related to Wario’s lair or the Mushroom Kingdom's geography.

wario_painting_warios_war_room_map.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can benefit from the map's strategic insights.
wario_painting_warios_war_room_map.vendorReason: Wario Land keeps this item in stock for those who might want to impress him with their knowledge of his territory or gather clues about his treasures.
wario_painting_warios_war_room_map.shippingDetail: The oversized painting requires special handling and is shipped via Oversized Roll, ensuring safe delivery.

usage.activation: Passive for Base Décor; once per day for Tactical Advantage
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Base Décor), 1 use per day (Tactical Advantage)
usage.endsWhen: No special condition ends the effect; it simply runs out after one use.

wario_painting_warios_war_room_map.priceReason: The painting’s rarity and utility justify its price, providing strategic benefits without overburdening the party.

wario_painting_wartime_market_bazaar.name: Painting: Wartime Market Bazaar
wario_painting_wartime_market_bazaar.description: A bustling black-market scene in Rogueport, where Toads, Koopas, and Shy Guys trade under Wario’s big banner. The oil-painted canvas captures the chaotic energy of the market, with every detail from the colorful banners to the bustling crowd. This Painting: Wartime Market Bazaar grants you a +5% bonus on prices when trading with shady NPCs in that location. Once per day, it allows you to gain advantage on one Charisma (Deception) or (Persuasion) check related to trade. Guards who see this painting become suspicious, gaining disadvantage on Stealth checks while they are around.

effectDetails.title: Market Advantage
effectDetails.rules: While the Painting is displayed, you gain a +5% bonus to prices when trading with shady NPCs in that location. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Trade Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, while this Painting is displayed, you can gain advantage on one Charisma (Deception) or (Persuasion) check related to trade. The use ends when you finish a short or long rest.

wario_painting_wartime_market_bazaar.levelRequirementReason: This painting is suitable for adventurers of all levels as it provides useful benefits without overwhelming them.
wario_painting_wartime_market_bazaar.vendorReason: Wario himself insists this item is a ‘documentary realism’ and ensures its quality, making it an essential tool for his patrons.
wario_painting_wartime_market_bazaar.shippingDetail: The painting arrives rolled in sturdy cardboard, ensuring it remains undisturbed during transit.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon display; daily use limit applies to Trade Persuasion.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest for Market Advantage; until you finish a short or long rest for Trade Persuasion.
usage.endsWhen: The painting is no longer displayed, or when you complete a long rest.

wario_painting_wartime_market_bazaar.priceReason: This fair value reflects the item's utility and rarity in providing advantageous trading conditions.

wario_painting_wartime_propaganda_poster.name: Painting: ‘Wario Will Save the Kingdom!’ Propaganda
wario_painting_wartime_propaganda_poster.description: A gaudy, stylized war poster with Wario heroically punching Bowser and collecting taxes at the same time. This relic of wartime propaganda exudes a garish charm that instantly captivates onlookers, who can't help but feel a surge of loyalty to the mischievous plumber. The poster is crafted from durable paper and ink, bearing the official seal of Wario Land’s Ministry of Propaganda. It's one of countless posters printed during the kingdom's struggle against Bowser's tyranny.

effectDetails.title: Charismatic Appeal
effectDetails.rules: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation) or Charisma (Persuasion) check on new visitors, you can spend 1 charge to gain +2 instead of +1. This effect is only active if you loudly mention Wario's heroic deeds depicted in the poster.

effectDetails.title: Rallying Cry
effectDetails.rules: You can use your action to activate this effect once per day, rallying allies within 30 feet. Each ally gains a +1 bonus to their next attack roll or saving throw against an enemy of your choice until the start of your next turn.

wario_painting_wartime_propaganda_poster.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for lower-level characters who can benefit from its inspirational effects in group settings.
wario_painting_wartime_propaganda_poster.vendorReason: Wario Land, being the creator of this propaganda poster, ensures that it reaches those who need inspiration and support during trying times.
wario_painting_wartime_propaganda_poster.shippingDetail: Delivered by Wario's personal flyer team, ensuring swift delivery to eager recipients.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect for Charismatic Appeal; until the start of your next turn for Rallying Cry
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or you use it again

wario_painting_wartime_propaganda_poster.priceReason: This item provides significant social and battlefield benefits at a reasonable cost, making it accessible to those who need encouragement.

wario_painting_yoshi_cavalry_charge.name: Painting: Yoshi Cavalry Charge
wario_painting_yoshi_cavalry_charge.description: The sweeping landscape of mounted Yoshis charging across a sunflower field toward Koopa lines.
