The painting's Yoshis seem to move with life, their hooves raising tiny dust clouds as they charge. Resting in this room grants creatures +5 ft movement on their first round of combat. Seeing the painting calms even the most hostile Yoshis: those who observe it gain advantage on social checks with Yoshis for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Yoshi Calm
effectDetails.rules: Creatures who spend at least 1 minute in the room where this painting hangs gain advantage on social checks with Yoshis for an hour. This effect ends if the creature leaves the room or spends more than 24 hours away.

effectDetails.title: First Round Movement Boost
effectDetails.rules: Creatures who begin combat after resting in this room gain +5 ft movement on their first round of initiative. This effect can be used once per day and is expended immediately upon activation.

wario_painting_yoshi_cavalry_charge.levelRequirementReason: This painting provides a simple, immediate benefit without requiring high-level feats or abilities.
wario_painting_yoshi_cavalry_charge.vendorReason: Wario Land often sells quirky yet useful items that appeal to his customers' whimsical tastes.
wario_painting_yoshi_cavalry_charge.shippingDetail: Delivered by Egg Express, known for their reliable delivery service, ensuring the painting arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon entering the room; once per day active use.
usage.duration: Until creature leaves the room or social check advantage ends
usage.endsWhen: Creature leaves the room or spends more than 24 hours away from it, or daily active use is exhausted.

wario_painting_yoshi_cavalry_charge.priceReason: The painting's effects are balanced and provide a useful benefit without being overpowered.

wario_signed_waluigi_poster.name: Wario-Signed Waluigi Poster
wario_signed_waluigi_poster.description: The Wario-Signed Waluigi Poster hangs like a relic from a bygone era, its vibrant colors now faded and smudged by time. The signature of Wario, once crisp and bold, has long since blurred into an illegible mess, yet it retains a peculiar charm. Flattened against the wall, it grants you a lucky boost, offering advantage on one Charisma check per day. Unfolded, its edges curl, bringing disadvantage to any checks until it's smoothed out again. WarioWare Printing's handiwork ensures its unique character, though not without quirks.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Charm
effectDetails.rules: When the poster is flattened against a wall, you gain advantage on one Charisma check per day. This effect lasts until the start of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Poster Curl
effectDetails.rules: If not flattened, you have disadvantage on all checks and saving throws until you take the time to smooth out its edges. Once smoothed, this effect is immediately removed.

wario_signed_waluigi_poster.levelRequirementReason: This poster is accessible to beginners as it requires minimal setup before its effects can be used.
wario_signed_waluigi_poster.vendorReason: Wario himself ensures that his signature pieces are available for sale, even if they come with a unique set of quirks.
wario_signed_waluigi_poster.shippingDetail: Delivered flat in a sturdy tube to ensure it arrives in its best condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect when the poster is flattened against a wall; requires smoothing out to negate disadvantage.
usage.duration: Lucky Charm lasts until your next long rest; Poster Curl ends once smoothed out.
usage.endsWhen: Poster Curl ends as soon as it's smoothed out, Lucky Charm ends at the start of your next long rest.

wario_signed_waluigi_poster.priceReason: The poster's unique charm and Wario's signature make it a popular item among casual adventurers.

wario_wario_ware_microgame_console.name: WarioWare Microgame Console (Gimmick Gadget!)
wario_wario_ware_microgame_console.description: The WarioWare Microgame Console is a compact, battery-powered device that hums with Wario's mischievous energy. Crafted by WarioWare Inc., this gadget features 10 unique microgames designed to test your reflexes and quick thinking. Each game lasts just one minute, during which you can gain advantage on a Dexterity check next encounter if you play successfully. However, the console’s batteries are notoriously unreliable; there's a 20% chance it will fail when needed, adding an extra layer of challenge.
effects: Gain Advantage on One Dexterity Check Next Encounter

effectDetails.title: Dexterity Check Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Play one microgame (1 minute) for the chance to gain advantage on a Dexterity check next encounter. This effect is passive and lasts until used.

effectDetails.title: Battery Reliability Issues
effectDetails.rules: There's a 20% chance that when needed, the console will fail randomly. This effect ends immediately upon failure.

wario_wario_ware_microgame_console.levelRequirementReason: The console requires no specific level as it is designed for quick reflex training and entertainment.
wario_wario_ware_microgame_console.vendorReason: WarioLand specializes in quirky gadgets and novelties, making the WarioWare Microgame Console a perfect addition to their inventory.
wario_wario_ware_microgame_console.shippingDetail: Shipped with Game Gear Go's signature express delivery service.

usage.activation: Play one microgame (1 minute) for the duration of its effect.
usage.duration: Until used or interrupted by failure.
usage.endsWhen: Console fails randomly due to battery issues; upon gaining advantage on a Dexterity check.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses until the console fails.

wario_wario_ware_microgame_console.priceReason: The WarioWare Microgame Console is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its quirky design and unreliable yet entertaining nature.

warios_franchise.name: WarioWare, Inc. Majority Share
warios_franchise.description: The Warios Franchise Majority Share is a gleaming stock certificate from Wario Direct, forged in the fires of Delfino Square. When you hold it, the streets of your town will hum with productivity as every shop offers its goods for free. Daily, you'll see 10,000 gold coins appear in your vault, courtesy of Wario's Warehouse. Rumors say that Wario himself, despite his protests, works tirelessly to keep things running smoothly.

economyImpact.reason: Permanent majority ownership, unlimited daily income, and free regional commerce must remain an institutional endgame acquisition.

effects: All shops offer their wares for free

effectDetails.title: Free Shop Goods
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, all shops within a 1-mile radius become free to patrons. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until the item's charges are exhausted.

effectDetails.title: Daily Gold Income
effectDetails.rules: At dawn each day, you receive 10,000 gold coins from Wario's Warehouse. This effect continues as long as the item remains in your possession.

warios_franchise.levelRequirementReason: A permanent corporate-control asset with uncapped regional commerce effects is restricted to level 20 endgame characters and still requires DM approval.
warios_franchise.vendorReason: Only Wario Direct can offer such a powerful and controversial artifact, ensuring authenticity and exclusivity.
warios_franchise.shippingDetail: The courier delivers the item directly to your home, bypassing any local authorities or taxes.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing while in possession
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts charges or is destroyed by a successful Wario-level spell
usage.charges: Unlimited while the deed remains valid; requires a yearly tribute of 100,000,000 gold coins and explicit DM renewal to maintain

warios_franchise.priceReason: Restored to its 900-trillion-gold institutional valuation because permanent free commerce and 10,000 gold per day are campaign-economy-breaking benefits.

warp_pipe_installation.name: Warp Pipe Installation
warp_pipe_installation.description: The Warp Pipe Installation, a marvel of underground engineering, creates an unbreakable conduit between two locations up to 200 feet apart. This forged steel pipe not only ensures instant travel but also serves as a symbol of the Underground Network's mastery over spatial reality. Once installed by a licensed plumber from Warp Plumbing Corp., this indestructible portal stands against all spells and forces, safeguarded by the very essence of the Earth itself.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Travel
effectDetails.rules: Activates with a simple command word. The pipe instantly transports any creature within its range to the other connected location, up to 200 feet away. This effect is instantaneous and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Indestructible
effectDetails.rules: The pipe has AC 20, 100 hit points, and is immune to all spells and magical effects. It requires a 'Pipe License' from the Underground Network (DM discretion) for installation and maintenance.

warp_pipe_installation.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level to ensure the caster can handle the spatial magic involved in creating such a stable portal.
warp_pipe_installation.vendorReason: Warp Plumbing Corp. is known for its expertise and reliability, ensuring that only the most secure and efficient warp pipes are installed.
warp_pipe_installation.shippingDetail: The installation team from Warp Plumbing Corp. will personally supervise the delivery and setup of this critical infrastructure.

usage.activation: Command word upon installation; once per day thereafter.
usage.duration: Instantaneous travel only, lasts until next long rest for recharging.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or destroyed if physical integrity is compromised.

warp_pipe_installation.priceReason: The installation cost reflects the specialized engineering, materials, and ongoing maintenance required to ensure the pipe's stability and security.

warriors_chaos_chaos_resistance_training.name: Warriors Chaos Chaos Resistance Training
warriors_chaos_chaos_resistance_training.description: The Warriors Chaos Chaos Resistance Training immerses you in chaotic energies, teaching resilience through confrontation. For a week, you gain advantage on saving throws against confusion and wild magic, but your unpredictable nature can lead to DM-discrepancies: once daily, you may act oddly without warning. Your alignment subtly shifts toward Chaotic during this time, marking you as a disciple of the untamed forces. This training is offered by Warriors Chaos Boot Camp, known for pushing students to their limits.
effects: Advantage on Saves vs. Confusion and Wild Magic

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Saves vs. Confusion and Wild Magic
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on saving throws against confusion and wild magic for a duration of 7 days. This effect ends if you are no longer within the boot camp's training grounds.

effectDetails.title: Slightly Unpredictable
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the DM can have you act oddly without warning due to your immersion in chaotic energies. This effect is a passive trait that does not require an action or reaction.

warriors_chaos_chaos_resistance_training.levelRequirementReason: This training is suitable for adventurers just beginning their journey into chaos magic.
warriors_chaos_chaos_resistance_training.vendorReason: Warriors Chaos Boot Camp specializes in pushing students to embrace the wild and unpredictable, making this service a cornerstone of their curriculum.
warriors_chaos_chaos_resistance_training.shippingDetail: This item is delivered via Chaos Warp Express, known for its unpredictable arrival times. Plan accordingly, as packages may arrive days earlier or later than expected.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon completion of the training.
usage.duration: 7 days from completion
usage.endsWhen: You leave the boot camp's training grounds

warriors_chaos_chaos_resistance_training.priceReason: The price reflects the intensive, immersive nature of this training and the materials required to facilitate it.

warriors_chaos_chaos_theory_basics.name: Warriors Chaos Chaos Theory Basics
warriors_chaos_chaos_theory_basics.description: Forgeheart Core, this tiny device hums with arcane power, whispering secrets of chaos and balance. Crafted by Warriors Chaos Theory, it grants a fleeting glimpse into the butterfly's wings that can stir hurricanes. For 10 minutes after activation, you gain advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks related to cause and effect. However, your decision-making sharpens only in hindsight; you suffer disadvantage on reaction-based decisions for the same duration.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Investigation Checks
effectDetails.rules: When you use this item, you gain advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks related to cause and effect for 10 minutes. The effect ends if you take a short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Quick Decisions
effectDetails.rules: For the same duration as the first effect, you suffer disadvantage on reaction-based decisions. This effect is terminated by taking any action that requires your focus, such as casting a spell or making an attack roll.

warriors_chaos_chaos_theory_basics.levelRequirementReason: This item provides tactical insight but not combat prowess.
warriors_chaos_chaos_theory_basics.vendorReason: Warriors Chaos Theory specializes in the manipulation of chaos and balance, making this device a natural addition to their offerings.
warriors_chaos_chaos_theory_basics.shippingDetail: Ships via Chaos Theory Express within one business day, delivered directly by the company's proprietary magic transport network.

usage.duration: 10 minutes per use
usage.endsWhen: You take a short or long rest, or you cast a spell requiring concentration for more than 1 minute.

warriors_chaos_chaos_theory_basics.priceReason: The item's rarity and specific utility justify its price in experienced player currency.

warriors_chaos_mutant_wraps.name: Warriors Chaos Mutant Wraps
warriors_chaos_mutant_wraps.description: These bandages are imbued with the chaotic energies of the battlefield. They adhere to wounds and adapt to stabilize your injuries, their color shifting randomly between hues of crimson, violet, and black. Warriors Chaos Mutant Wraps are a byproduct of Chaos Healers' unorthodox practices, created from scrap materials and the remnants of failed mutations. These wraps not only heal but also offer a slight resistance to further chaos-related effects.

effectDetails.title: Wound Healing
effectDetails.rules: Apply the bandages as an action. The bandages adhere to your wounds and stabilize them, healing 1d6 hit points. This effect can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Chaos Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The bandages provide a +1 bonus to saving throws against chaotic effects for the duration of a short rest or until you take damage from a source other than magic.

warriors_chaos_mutant_wraps.levelRequirementReason: These wraps are designed for those who have faced the harsh realities of battle and can handle the chaos they represent.
warriors_chaos_mutant_wraps.vendorReason: The warriors Chaos tent specializes in crafting items that aid those who have endured the battlefield, making these bandages a natural fit.
warriors_chaos_mutant_wraps.shippingDetail: Shipped within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until used or interrupted by damage from non-magical sources.
usage.endsWhen: Used once per day, expends after taking non-magical damage.

warriors_chaos_mutant_wraps.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and utility in stabilizing wounds without overpowered healing.

warriors_chaos_mutation_masher.name: Warriors Chaos Mutation Masher
warriors_chaos_mutation_masher.description: The Warriors Chaos Mutation Masher is a bizarre device forged from chaotic metal, its handle scoured raw by the very hands of its creators. With each use, it mutates your grip in an almost painful fashion, but also grants you advantage on checks to alter random effect recipes. When activated, the masher releases a surge of chaotic energy that can reconfigure any nearby object into a more efficient tool or weapon for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Random Recipe Alteration
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Masher grants you advantage on checks to alter any random effect recipe. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Adjacent Item Reconfiguration
effectDetails.rules: Activating the Masher also releases a chaotic surge that reconfigures all non-magical items within 5 feet into more efficient versions for 1 minute, or until an object is damaged. The reconfigured item must be used by you and can only function in its new form.

warriors_chaos_mutation_masher.levelRequirementReason: The device's chaotic energy requires a certain level of concentration to control effectively.
warriors_chaos_mutation_masher.vendorReason: The Chaos Toolers, masters of the unpredictable, are known for their unique and often dangerous creations like this Masher.
warriors_chaos_mutation_masher.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the Masher must be shipped with extreme care using Mutant Mash Mail's specially designed containment crates.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until an adjacent object is damaged
usage.endsWhen: Start of your next turn after activation or when a nearby item is damaged
usage.charges: Unlimited, but reconfigures only non-magical items

warriors_chaos_mutation_masher.priceReason: The Masher's chaotic nature and unique functionality justify its moderate price.

warriors_chaos_mutation_mush_recipe.name: Recipe: Warriors Chaos Mutation Mush
warriors_chaos_mutation_mush_recipe.description: Crafted by Chaos Cooks, this recipe for Warriors' Chaos Mutation Mush is a chaotic confluence of bizarre ingredients, each one more unsettling than the last. When consumed, it grants the eater a fleeting taste of chaos—either an unpredictable boost to a random stat or a minor mutation that could be either a boon or bane. The effects are as unpredictable as they are potent, leaving the consumer forever changed in ways both tangible and intangible.

effectDetails.title: Random Stat Boost
effectDetails.rules: Eating this mush grants a +1 temporary modifier to a random ability score for one hour. This effect is unpredictable and cannot be influenced by any means.

effectDetails.title: Minor Mutation
effectDetails.rules: Alternatively, consuming the mush might result in a minor mutation that persists for one hour, providing both benefits and drawbacks based on the whims of chaos. The DM determines the nature of this mutation.

warriors_chaos_mutation_mush_recipe.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers who are just beginning their journey into the chaotic unknown.
warriors_chaos_mutation_mush_recipe.vendorReason: Warriors Chaos Camp specializes in items that push the boundaries of conventional magic, making this recipe a perfect fit.
warriors_chaos_mutation_mush_recipe.shippingDetail: The mush is shipped fresh and arrives in a sealed container to preserve its volatile nature.

usage.duration: One hour or until consumed
usage.endsWhen: The effects dissipate after one hour, or if the eater consumes another form of food.

warriors_chaos_mutation_mush_recipe.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect the unpredictable and potentially volatile nature of the item.

warriors_chaos_mutation_potion_service.name: Warriors Chaos Mutation Potion Service
warriors_chaos_mutation_potion_service.description: This potent potion, crafted by the enigmatic Chaos Sorcerers at Warriors' Chaos Camp, imbues you with a chaotic mutation for an hour. Swallow its bubbling contents and witness your body undergo a temporary yet unpredictable transformation: one ability score increases by 1 while another decreases by 1. With a 50% chance of growing an extra arm, this limb grants advantage on Climb checks but is accompanied by a persistent, itchy sensation that hints at the potion's dark magic. Beware, for the effects are as unpredictable as they are fleeting.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Stat Boost and Reduction
effectDetails.rules: Consume the potion to gain a temporary increase of +1 to one ability score for 1 hour. Simultaneously, lose +1 from another ability score. This effect has no target or range; it is consumed upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Extra Arm
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that consuming the potion grants you an extra arm for the duration of your next short rest, providing advantage on Climb checks and saving throws. This effect ends when the potion's duration expires or if the wearer loses an arm in combat.

warriors_chaos_mutation_potion_service.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed to be accessible early in a character’s journey, allowing for quick adaptation and experimentation.
warriors_chaos_mutation_potion_service.vendorReason: The Chaos Sorcerers are the masters of mutation and chaos, and they can concoct this potion more reliably than any other vendor.
warriors_chaos_mutation_potion_service.shippingDetail: Shipped in a sealed, magically preserved container to ensure potency upon arrival.

usage.activation: Consume the potion as an action.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until consumed in combat.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires after 1 hour or if the wearer loses an arm during the effect’s active time.
usage.charges: Unlimited, with a daily limit of one use per character.

warriors_chaos_mutation_potion_service.priceReason: Balanced to provide a useful yet risky tool for early adventurers without overshadowing more powerful items.

weights_treadmills_and_protein_shakes.name: The 'Iron Toad' Gym
weights_treadmills_and_protein_shakes.description: 'The Iron Toad Gym' is a training ground where toads build muscle and morale. Weights of solid iron, treadmills that challenge even the strongest, and protein shakes that fuel their growth lie within its walls. Over time, toads who train here gain +1 to both Strength and Constitution as they push themselves beyond their limits. The gym also instills a sense of camaraderie, boosting morale by 5 points, making each toad feel more resilient.

effectDetails.title: Strength and Constitution Boost
effectDetails.rules: Toads who actively train at 'The Iron Toad Gym' gain +1 to their Strength and Constitution scores. This effect accumulates over time, but only while they are within the gym's walls.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: For every week a toad trains at 'The Iron Toad Gym', their morale increases by 5 points. The effect is cumulative and can reach up to +20, but it resets if the toad leaves the gym for more than a month.

weights_treadmills_and_protein_shakes.levelRequirementReason: Toads of any level are welcome at 'The Iron Toad Gym' as building strength and morale is essential for all.
weights_treadmills_and_protein_shakes.vendorReason: 'The Iron Toad Gym' is a popular local institution, and the toad town market vendors supply it with its unique equipment.
weights_treadmills_and_protein_shakes.shippingDetail: Ships directly from 'The Iron Toad Gym', delivered by the cheerful toads themselves, ensuring fresh supplies for their comrades.

usage.activation: Passive effect while in the gym.
usage.duration: Instantaneous boost upon entering and cumulative over time.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the gym for more than a month resets the effects.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the toad remains within the gym.

weights_treadmills_and_protein_shakes.priceReason: 'The Iron Toad Gym' offers a valuable service at a fair price, balancing the cost of supplies and training with the overall benefit it provides to its members.

weldrhom_battle_axe_head.name: Weldrhom Battle Axe Head
weldrhom_battle_axe_head.description: The Weldrhom Battle Axe Head is a replaceable axe head etched with tribal runes, forged from ancient black iron and blessed by the spirits of the wilds. When wielded in the wilderness, the runes glow faintly to warn of danger, granting +2 to Initiative checks during treacherous expeditions. This weapon also adds +1 damage against beasts, while its haft ensures a sturdy grip for feral combat. Survivors of the forge, these axes are crafted by the Weldrhom tribes and shipped with swift precision via Tribal Runner.

effectDetails.title: Wilderness Warning
effectDetails.rules: The runes glow faintly when danger approaches, granting the wielder a +2 bonus to Initiative checks in wilderness areas. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after detecting imminent threat.

effectDetails.title: Beast Bane
effectDetails.rules: When used against beasts, this axe deals an additional 1d6 damage as the spirit runes resonate with primal fury. The effect is limited to once per long rest.

weldrhom_battle_axe_head.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires a minimum level of 5 due to its intricate runes and specialized forging process.
weldrhom_battle_axe_head.vendorReason: The Weldrhom tribe is renowned for crafting these axes, imbued with the spirits of their ancestors.
weldrhom_battle_axe_head.shippingDetail: Delivered by Tribal Runner, known for its swift and reliable service through treacherous terrains.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect; runes glow when danger is sensed.
usage.duration: Lasts until the start of your next turn after detecting imminent threat.
usage.endsWhen: Dies down at the start of your next turn following a detected threat.

weldrhom_battle_axe_head.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the weapon's unique enchantments and specialized crafting process.

weldrhom_caravan_spice_grinder.name: Weldrhom Caravan Spice Grinder
weldrhom_caravan_spice_grinder.description: The Weldrhom Caravan Spice Grinder is a compact, forge-made core of desert wisdom, its body weathered by countless sands and spiced rubs. This grinder not only enhances your cooking checks with spices but also ensures that your culinary creations remain flavorful for an entire hour after use. Crafted by the Caravan Smiths to withstand harsh environments, it never clogs unless wet ingredients are ground, requiring a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check to clean.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Cooking Checks with Spices
effectDetails.rules: When you use this item, you gain a +1 bonus to cooking checks involving spices. The duration of the effect is one hour.

effectDetails.title: Flavor Endurance
effectDetails.rules: Any meal prepared using this grinder maintains its flavor for an additional hour after preparation, enhancing your reputation as a master chef among desert travelers and traders.

weldrhom_caravan_spice_grinder.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for adventurers of all levels, providing a basic utility that can be used by anyone.
weldrhom_caravan_spice_grinder.vendorReason: The Weldrhom Caravans are renowned for their quality goods and this grinder exemplifies the craftsmanship expected from such a trusted vendor.
weldrhom_caravan_spice_grinder.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the desert, ensuring that it arrives in perfect condition despite the arid climate.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration is one hour for enhanced cooking checks and flavor endurance.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends once the hour has passed or if the item is used again before the duration expires.

weldrhom_caravan_spice_grinder.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its utility, rarity, and the craftsmanship involved in making such a versatile tool.

weldrhom_herb_garden_service.name: Weldrhom Herb Garden Service
weldrhom_herb_garden_service.description: The Weldrhom Herb Garden Service arrives as a compact, wooden box that unfolds into an intricate garden of aromatic herbs and medicinal plants. Each week, it produces 1d6 healing herbs, each capable of curing up to 1d4 hit points. The garden also grants advantage on Medicine checks when using its herbs for crafting potions or treating wounds. Rabbits often visit the garden, offering a free source of fresh meat if you can catch them.

effectDetails.title: Healing Herbs
effectDetails.rules: The Weldrhom Herb Garden Service produces 1d6 healing herbs each week. Each herb can heal up to 1d4 hit points when consumed by a creature.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Medicine Checks
effectDetails.rules: When using the herbs from this garden for crafting potions or treating wounds, the user gains advantage on Medicine checks.

weldrhom_herb_garden_service.levelRequirementReason: This service requires minimal magic to operate and is accessible to beginners.
weldrhom_herb_garden_service.vendorReason: The Weldrhom Druids are renowned for their herbal knowledge and craftsmanship, making this item a staple in their offerings.
weldrhom_herb_garden_service.shippingDetail: Special packaging ensures the herbs remain fresh during transit.

usage.activation: Instantaneous setup upon arrival; passive effect while deployed.
usage.duration: Permanent until dismantled or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Dismantling the garden or destruction of the item.

weldrhom_herb_garden_service.priceReason: The price reflects the craftsmanship, materials, and ongoing maintenance required for such a service.

weldrhom_nomad_veil.name: Weldrhom Nomad Veil
weldrhom_nomad_veil.description: The Weldrhom Nomad Veil is a lightweight veil crafted to protect desert travelers from sandstorms. Its intricate weave filters out dust and sand, ensuring clear vision even in the harshest conditions. This veil not only grants immunity to sand blindness but also enhances your Constitution saving throws by +1 when you are in arid environments. The veil's fabric muffles sound, imposing disadvantage on verbal spellcasting within its shadowed confines.

effectDetails.title: Dust Shield
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to the effects of sand and dust, including sand blindness. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Desert Savvy
effectDetails.rules: For Constitution saving throws related to arid environments, the user gains a +1 bonus. This benefit lasts for as long as the veil is worn and has no other activation or duration requirements.

weldrhom_nomad_veil.levelRequirementReason: This item provides immediate utility for any adventurer in desert regions, making it suitable for level 1 characters.
weldrhom_nomad_veil.vendorReason: Weldrhom Craftsfolk are renowned for their expertise in crafting gear suited to desert climates, making the Nomad Veil a natural addition to their inventory.
weldrhom_nomad_veil.shippingDetail: The veil is delivered securely within a Sandproof Pouch to ensure it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn, until removed or damaged beyond repair.
usage.endsWhen: It ceases providing benefits when the veil is removed or destroyed.

weldrhom_nomad_veil.priceReason: The Nomad Veil's price reflects its practical utility and craftsmanship, offering a balance between cost and benefit for adventurers.

weldrhom_recipe_spark_grilled_meat.name: Recipe: Weldrhom Spark-Grilled Meat
weldrhom_recipe_spark_grilled_meat.description: This parchment lists a recipe for meat grilled to perfection by the legendary Weldrhom Grill Masters, whose techniques are said to bring the spark of lightning into every bite. The Recipe: Weldrhom Spark-Grilled Meat is imbued with a flickering core that crackles with electricity as you cook. Cooks who follow this method gain +1 to their attack rolls for an hour, but their hair stands on end, causing disadvantage on Charisma checks and imposing a glow that grants advantage on Intimidation checks while making Stealth attempts difficult.
effects: Grants +1 to attack rolls for 1 hour (energizing)
Your hair stands on end: disadvantage on Charisma checks

effectDetails.title: Energizing Attack Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 hour, this recipe grants a +1 bonus to attack rolls. This effect ends when you finish cooking with it or if your concentration is broken.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Charisma Checks
effectDetails.rules: While using this recipe, you are at disadvantage on all Charisma checks and saves until the effects end or you finish cooking with it. This effect persists as long as you follow the recipe's instructions.

weldrhom_recipe_spark_grilled_meat.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for even novice cooks to understand but powerful enough to enhance combat effectiveness.
weldrhom_recipe_spark_grilled_meat.vendorReason: Weldrhom Grill Masters are renowned for their mastery of fire and lightning, making them the perfect vendor for this electrifying recipe.
weldrhom_recipe_spark_grilled_meat.shippingDetail: The recipe is shipped in a specially insulated package to ensure that the magical properties remain intact during transit.

usage.activation: Active upon cooking with it. Requires following the recipe's instructions.
usage.duration: 1 hour, ends when you finish cooking or your concentration is broken.
usage.endsWhen: Completion of the dish or loss of concentration.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; each use requires following the recipe.

weldrhom_recipe_spark_grilled_meat.priceReason: This recipe, while not requiring materials beyond those found in any kitchen, is a rare and powerful tool for enhancing combat effectiveness. Its price reflects its rarity and utility.

weldrhom_soul_welding.name: Weldrhom Soul Welding
weldrhom_soul_welding.description: The Weldrhom Soul Welding is a metaphysical device forged by the Weldrhom Soul-Smiths, crafted from ancient souls and enchanted with runes of restoration. This artifact repairs one level of exhaustion caused by soul damage, restoring both physical and spiritual well-being. After use, it leaves a faint metallic aftertaste in your mouth, as if you've swallowed starlight itself. Clerics detect this subtle change, marking you as 'slightly warped,' which imposes disadvantage on Religion checks with them.

effectDetails.title: Soul Repair
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Restores one level of exhaustion caused by soul damage. The effect is instantaneous and has no save DC or range. Once used, the item requires a short rest to recharge.

effectDetails.title: Metallic Aftertaste
effectDetails.rules: After using the Weldrhom Soul Welding, you have a slight metallic aftertaste in your mouth for 1 hour. During this time, clerics detect you as 'slightly warped,' imposing disadvantage on Religion checks with them.

weldrhom_soul_welding.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners and those who need to quickly restore their soul's health.
weldrhom_soul_welding.vendorReason: Weldrhom Soul-Smiths are renowned for their expertise in crafting items that repair the body and spirit, making them the perfect vendor for this device.
weldrhom_soul_welding.shippingDetail: Shipped via Spirit Forge with expedited delivery within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; requires a short rest to recharge.
usage.endsWhen: The item is used or recharges after a short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to use again.

weldrhom_soul_welding.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's rarity and utility in restoring one level of exhaustion caused by soul damage.

weldrhom_spice_rub_meat_recipe.name: Recipe: Weldrhom Spice-Rubbed Meat
weldrhom_spice_rub_meat_recipe.description: This is a carefully crafted recipe for spice-rubbed meat from the arid lands of Weldrhom. It calls for tender cuts of desert lamb seasoned with the rarest spices, imparting resilience and vigor to those who partake. The meat is not just a meal; it's a lesson in survival, teaching you how to prepare this hearty dish over an hour-long fire. The flavor is intense, leaving you sweating slightly but feeling refreshed and stronger after consuming it.

effectDetails.title: Spice-Rubbing Technique
effectDetails.rules: This recipe teaches the technique of rub-and-grill, which requires a bonus action to prepare. When consumed over 6 hours, it grants resistance to dehydration and advantage on Constitution saving throws for that duration.

effectDetails.title: Constitution Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon eating this dish, you gain +1 to your Constitution saving throw once per short rest. This effect does not stack with other similar benefits.

weldrhom_spice_rub_meat_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is simple enough for any traveler to learn and use.
weldrhom_spice_rub_meat_recipe.vendorReason: The Weldrhom Caravaneers are known for sharing their culinary secrets with the world.
weldrhom_spice_rub_meat_recipe.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted courier, ensuring the spices remain potent and the recipe intact.

usage.activation: Bonus action to prepare; eat over 6 hours to activate benefits
usage.duration: Constitution boost lasts until next short rest; resistance lasts for 6 hours
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when Constitution saving throw is made or after 6 hours
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the recipe can be learned multiple times

weldrhom_spice_rub_meat_recipe.priceReason: The rarity of desert spices and the time required to prepare this dish justify its moderate price.

wh_araby_dervish_spin_bowl.name: Wh Araby Dervish Spin Bowl
wh_araby_dervish_spin_bowl.description: The Wh Araby Dervish Spin Bowl is a meticulously crafted ceramic vessel adorned with intricate, swirling patterns that catch the light like stars in motion. This bowl not only ensures an even mix of your tea but also enhances any recipe imbued with dance-inspired motions, granting advantage on such attempts. As you spin it, the bowl releases whirl energy, subtly increasing the duration of any ongoing effects by +1 round. However, prolonged use can cause a brief dizziness, leaving you momentarily disoriented.
effects: Even Mix; Advantage on Dance-Inspired Recipes

effectDetails.title: Even Mix; Advantage on Dance-Inspired Recipes
effectDetails.rules: When used to mix tea or ingredients for a dance-inspired dish, the user gains advantage on the associated ability check. This effect lasts until the recipe is completed.

effectDetails.title: Whirl Energy (+1 Duration)
effectDetails.rules: Each time you use the bowl to spin it, any active effects you have are extended by one additional round. However, if you continue spinning for more than three rounds, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become dazed until the end of your next turn.

wh_araby_dervish_spin_bowl.levelRequirementReason: The intricate craftsmanship and energy manipulation required make this item suitable only for those of at least third level.
wh_araby_dervish_spin_bowl.vendorReason: The Wh Araby Temple is renowned for its expertise in ceremonial artifacts, making it the perfect place to find such a finely crafted bowl.
wh_araby_dervish_spin_bowl.shippingDetail: Ships via Spin Spice Shipment, known for its reliable and swift delivery of exotic goods from Wh Araby.

usage.duration: Until the recipe is completed or until you cease spinning the bowl.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the recipe is finished or if you stop spinning the bowl for three consecutive rounds.

wh_araby_dervish_spin_bowl.priceReason: Crafted with rare ceramics and imbued with ancient Wh Araby magic, this item's price reflects both its rarity and utility.

wh_araby_dervish_whirl_skirt.name: Wh Araby Dervish Whirl Skirt
wh_araby_dervish_whirl_skirt.description: The Wh Araby Dervish Whirl Skirt is a shimmering, ankle-length garment made from layers of delicate silk and silver thread that catch the light like stardust. Crafted by the skilled hands of Dervish Dancers, it allows wearers to perform with grace and agility, turning even the most complex spins into fluid motion. When worn, the skirt creates a soft, swirling wind that distracts nearby creatures, though spinning too quickly risks tripping the wearer or causing them to lose balance.

effectDetails.title: Graceful Dance Aid
effectDetails.rules: When worn during a Performance check for dancing, the skirt grants you advantage on the roll. If you fail to maintain balance while spinning too quickly, you are tripped and must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 13) or fall prone.

effectDetails.title: Minor Wind Distraction
effectDetails.rules: The skirt creates a minor swirling wind around you that can distract nearby creatures. As an action, you can cause this effect to activate within a 5-foot radius centered on yourself for up to 1 minute per day. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) or become distracted until their next turn.

wh_araby_dervish_whirl_skirt.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners who wish to improve their dancing skills without needing advanced proficiency.
wh_araby_dervish_whirl_skirt.vendorReason: The Wh Araby Dance Hall frequently hosts performances and competitions, making it the perfect place to purchase items that enhance one's dance abilities.
wh_araby_dervish_whirl_skirt.shippingDetail: Delivered by Silk Spin Express, known for their swift and reliable service across the region.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, lasts up to 1 minute per day
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop moving or if a creature successfully saves against the distraction.

wh_araby_dervish_whirl_skirt.priceReason: Balanced at this price, it offers significant benefits for players looking to enhance their dancing performance without being overpowered.

wh_araby_sand_sculpture_service.name: Wh Araby Sand Sculpture Service
wh_araby_sand_sculpture_service.description: Crafted by Wh Araby's master sculptors, this ephemeral sand sculpture serves as a minor illusion for 24 hours, enchanting passersby with its fleeting beauty. The sand holds a secret charm, granting the creator advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks when presenting it to art connoisseurs. However, the very nature of the desert's capricious climate means the sculpture will melt away at first sign of rain, leaving only damp memories behind.

effectDetails.title: Illusionary Sand Sculpture
effectDetails.rules: The sand sculpture functions as a minor illusion for 24 hours. It can be activated once per day by the creator, who must have a performance or presentation planned. The effect ends immediately if exposed to water or if the creator wishes to end it.

effectDetails.title: Advantage with Art
effectDetails.rules: The creator gains advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks when presenting the sculpture to individuals known for their appreciation of art and craftsmanship, such as patrons or fellow sculptors. This effect lasts until the next midnight.

wh_araby_sand_sculpture_service.levelRequirementReason: Creating an illusion that can be presented requires a basic understanding of performance and presentation.
wh_araby_sand_sculpture_service.vendorReason: Wh Araby's master sculptors are renowned for their skill in transforming the desert into works of art, making them the perfect purveyors of this service.
wh_araby_sand_sculpture_service.shippingDetail: Ships via a specialized camel caravan to ensure safe and timely delivery across treacherous dunes.

usage.activation: Once per day, activated by performance or presentation.
usage.duration: 24 hours, ending on contact with water or at will of the creator.
usage.endsWhen: Exposure to water or the creator's discretion.

wh_araby_sand_sculpture_service.priceReason: Crafted by renowned desert artisans, this service is a rare and valuable offering that enhances both performance and artistry in a unique way.

wh_araby_sandstorm_beard_styling.name: Wh Araby Sandstorm Beard Styling
wh_araby_sandstorm_beard_styling.description: The Wh Araby Sandstorm Beard Styling is a rare service that infuses your beard with the majesty of desert winds. For a week, your whiskers become a symbol of resilience and strength, granting you +1 Charisma when interacting with other bearded folk. However, the sandstorms of the desert bring their own challenge: you suffer disadvantage on Sleight of Hand checks due to the ever-present grit in the air. This service is crafted by Wh Araby Stylists, masters of transforming mere hair into a living work of art.

effectDetails.title: Beard becomes majestic
effectDetails.rules: You gain +1 Charisma when interacting with other bearded individuals for the duration. The effect lasts for 7 days upon completion of the service.

effectDetails.title: Sand gets everywhere
effectDetails.rules: When in sandy environments, you suffer disadvantage on Sleight of Hand checks due to the constant presence of sand. This effect persists until you leave a desert environment.

wh_araby_sandstorm_beard_styling.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to all adventurers who wish to enhance their appearance.
wh_araby_sandstorm_beard_styling.vendorReason: Wh Araby Stylists are renowned for their ability to transform ordinary beards into works of art that reflect the desert's spirit.
wh_araby_sandstorm_beard_styling.shippingDetail: The Sand Courier ensures your service is delivered through a series of wind-carried messages, arriving within a week from purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon completion of the service.
usage.duration: 7 days
usage.endsWhen: Expires after 7 days or when you no longer have a beard.

wh_araby_sandstorm_beard_styling.priceReason: The service is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting the expertise of Wh Araby Stylists and the unique desert conditions involved.

wh_araby_whirling_dervish_lesson_service.name: Wh Araby Whirling Dervish Lesson Service
wh_araby_whirling_dervish_lesson_service.description: The Wh Araby Whirling Dervish Lesson Service teaches you the mesmerizing dance of the dervishes, a spinning ritual that captivates foes and enhances your performance prowess. As you whirl, your movements create a hypnotic pattern that can charm one target within arm's reach for a full round, leaving them disoriented and open to further persuasion. This lesson also grants you an edge in Performance checks, making your artistry more compelling than ever. The Dervish Masters have crafted this service with precise grace, ensuring each session is both enlightening and transformative.

effectDetails.title: Whirling Charm
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can spin in a hypnotic pattern to charm one target within 5 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12) or become charmed by you for the duration of one round.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Performance
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on all Performance checks and save against Performance-related penalties until the end of your next turn after completing this service.

wh_araby_whirling_dervish_lesson_service.levelRequirementReason: This lesson is suitable for beginners, providing foundational skills in dervish dance.
wh_araby_whirling_dervish_lesson_service.vendorReason: The Wh Araby Temple has long been a hub of cultural exchange and learning, offering unique lessons like this to aspiring performers and dancers.
wh_araby_whirling_dervish_lesson_service.shippingDetail: The service is delivered via Silk Scarf Express, ensuring the ritual's efficacy remains intact during transportation.

usage.duration: Instantaneous charm effect; advantage on Performance checks until end of next turn after completion
usage.endsWhen: When the charmed target saves successfully or the duration ends
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a full day to fully learn and practice

wh_araby_whirling_dervish_lesson_service.priceReason: This service offers foundational skills in a unique dance form at a balanced cost for players looking to enhance their character's abilities.

wh_araby_whirling_dervish_tea_recipe.name: Recipe: Wh Araby Whirling Dervish Tea
wh_araby_whirling_dervish_tea_recipe.description: The Wh Araby Whirling Dervish Tea is a delicate, speckled brown and gold concoction that calms the mind while invigorating the body. Prepared by the skilled artisans of Araby Brewers, this tea allows you to spin with grace and focus, enhancing your performance in dance for hours. The secret lies in its unique blend of Dervish herbs, which are said to have been cultivated on sacred mountaintops. Each sip grants you advantage on Dexterity (Performance) checks for 2 hours, but beware — the effects only kick in after a short meditation session.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Dance Performance
effectDetails.rules: When you drink this tea and complete a short meditation (1 minute), you gain advantage on Dexterity (Performance) checks for the next 2 hours. This effect requires the completion of a short rest before it can be used again.

effectDetails.title: Meditative Focus
effectDetails.rules: The act of drinking this tea and meditating allows your mind to settle, reducing dizziness during spinning activities. While under its effects, you are immune to any penalties related to spinning or dancing, even if fatigued.

wh_araby_whirling_dervish_tea_recipe.levelRequirementReason: This tea is accessible to players of all levels who appreciate the arts and seek to enhance their performance capabilities.
wh_araby_whirling_dervish_tea_recipe.vendorReason: As a sacred beverage, this tea is only sold at Araby Temple by its trusted priests.
wh_araby_whirling_dervish_tea_recipe.shippingDetail: Ships via the Whirl Wind Whisk, known for its swift and reliable deliveries across the region.

usage.activation: Drink and complete a short meditation (1 minute).
usage.duration: 2 hours until the next rest or use of this effect.
usage.endsWhen: After 2 hours or if you take a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited; requires completion of a short rest to regain the ability.

wh_araby_whirling_dervish_tea_recipe.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the unique blend of Dervish herbs and the expertise required in its preparation by the skilled artisans of Araby Brewers.

whacka_bump.name: Whacka Bump
whacka_bump.description: The Whacka Bump is a doughnut shaped like a misshapen lump, dusted with powdered sugar that makes it resemble a guilt-ridden soul. Made by Shameful Packaging in Roguesport, this pastry promises to restore all hit points and magical points at the cost of an overwhelming sense of shame. After consuming one, you can't help but feel as though your next action should be to do penance for some unforgivable sin.
effects: You feel like a terrible person

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Whacka Bump restores all of your hit points and maximum magical points immediately. This effect is instantaneous and cannot be resisted with a saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Moral Fallout
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after consumption, you are considered to have committed an unforgivable sin unless you perform a ritual penance as a bonus action each day. Failure to do so results in a -2 penalty to all Charisma-based checks and saving throws.

whacka_bump.levelRequirementReason: The Whacka Bump is accessible to lower-level characters who need a quick fix but are also reminded of the importance of moral integrity.
whacka_bump.vendorReason: Roguesport's Black Market caters to adventurers seeking unconventional and questionable items, making it an ideal place for this controversial pastry.
whacka_bump.shippingDetail: The Whacka Bump is delivered in a sealed, guilt-inducing box that arrives the next morning after purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts for 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire or you perform penance

whacka_bump.priceReason: The Whacka Bump is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique combination of immediate health and magical restoration, coupled with the psychological impact it has on the consumer.

whacka_bump_fake.name: Imitation Whacka Bump
whacka_bump_fake.description: The Imitation Whacka Bump is a squat, doughy replica of the famed Whacka Bump artifact. Its surface still retains faint impressions of runes and sigils that once granted its namesake its legendary power. Made from a mix of flour and food coloring, it crumbles when squeezed but offers no healing or magical benefits—save for the nostalgic whiff of freshly baked bread that lingers in your hands after handling it.

effectDetails.title: Taste of Fresh Bread
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Imitation Whacka Bump grants a fleeting moment of nostalgia. The taster must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 10) to resist an overwhelming urge to reminisce about past baking adventures. On a failed save, they are incapacitated for 1 minute, during which their mind is consumed by memories.

effectDetails.title: No Healing
effectDetails.rules: Attempting to use the Imitation Whacka Bump as a healing item results in nothing but disappointment. The item offers no magical effects and provides only an empty sensation when swallowed or touched.

whacka_bump_fake.levelRequirementReason: The Imitation Whacka Bump requires no level, as it is merely a harmless joke item.
whacka_bump_fake.vendorReason: The Rogue Port Black Market is known for its eclectic array of oddities and knockoffs. The Imitation Whacka Bump fits neatly into their collection of whimsical artifacts.
whacka_bump_fake.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, unless the courier encounters an unusually busy market day in the Rogue Port.

usage.activation: Eating or handling the item passively; no activation required.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for taste, lasts until saved against or expended for memory effect.
usage.endsWhen: The memory effect ends after 1 minute on a failed save. Consumed as an action but offers no lasting benefit.

whacka_bump_fake.priceReason: The Imitation Whacka Bump is priced at 1000 XP for its unique nostalgic value and the whimsical nature of its origin story.

whiskey_that_s_strong_garlic.name: Wario's Wild West Whiskey
whiskey_that_s_strong_garlic.description: Wario's Wild West Whiskey is a potent brew infused with the pungent essence of garlic, known to stir up courage in the toughest outlaws. This fiery concoction grants +1 on Constitution saving throws when you're drunk, but it also imposes disadvantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks and DC 10 Wisdom (Perception) checks due to its foul odor. It's a product of Wario West's legendary distillery, known for turning ordinary spirits into wild concoctions.

effectDetails.title: +1 CON saves when drunk
effectDetails.rules: You gain +1 to all Constitution saving throws while you are under the effects of this item. This effect lasts until you sober up.

effectDetails.title: Disadvantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks
effectDetails.rules: While under the effects of this item, you have disadvantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks due to its pungent aroma and taste. This effect ends when you sober up.

whiskey_that_s_strong_garlic.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for all levels as it provides a fun and balanced boost without overwhelming the party.
whiskey_that_s_strong_garlic.vendorReason: Wario Land's distillery is renowned for its unique and potent beverages, making Wario's Wild West Whiskey an obvious addition to his offerings.
whiskey_that_s_strong_garlic.shippingDetail: Delivered by the trusty Whiskey Wagon, known for its timely deliveries of fine spirits across the Wild West.

usage.activation: Drinking it as a bonus action
usage.duration: Until you sober up (typically after 1d4 hours)
usage.endsWhen: You sober up or consume another alcoholic drink

whiskey_that_s_strong_garlic.priceReason: This item provides a fun and balanced effect that enhances combat effectiveness without being overpowered, making it a fair value for its price.

whispering_garden_seeds.name: Whispering Garden Seeds
whispering_garden_seeds.description: Whispering Garden Seeds are peculiar and ancient, each one a fragment of forgotten magic. When sown, they grow into living, speaking plants that echo the whispers of their planters, capturing every word in their verdant memory banks. These sentient flora can be heard by anyone within fifty feet if struck down, unleashing a cacophony of final echoes. The seeds are said to have been crafted by the fey when the world was young, and only a handful remain.

effectDetails.title: Sentient Plant
effectDetails.rules: When planted, the seed grows into a living plant that can speak in the voice of its planter. The plant retains all spoken words within fifty feet for one hour after death and emits an ear-splitting scream if struck down.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Whispers
effectDetails.rules: If the plant is destroyed, it releases a final scream that can be heard by any living creature within 50 feet. This effect has no save DC but only triggers once per seed used.

whispering_garden_seeds.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a lower level because its primary function is passive and does not demand high-level spellcasting.
whispering_garden_seeds.vendorReason: The fey market sells rare and arcane goods, including these seeds which are said to have been crafted by their kin.
whispering_garden_seeds.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Feywild, arriving in a week with no additional charges.

usage.activation: Planting the seed is the only activation required; it is passive thereafter.
usage.duration: Instantaneous until destroyed or the plant dies naturally.
usage.endsWhen: The plant is destroyed or killed.

whispering_garden_seeds.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and magical nature, but not game-breaking power.

whispering_scroll.name: Whispering Scroll
whispering_scroll.description: The Whispering Scroll is a tattered scroll of parchment, its edges frayed and ink barely legible. When unrolled at night under the soft glow of a lantern, it hums softly, sharing ancient secrets or forgotten wisdom that can help you in ways both known and unknown. Its whispers are not always coherent, but they often contain crucial information that could turn the tide of an adventure. Some say the scroll is enchanted by scholars long passed, seeking to leave their mark on future generations.
effects: Single Use: Grants knowledge of one obscure fact or a usable cantrip for 1 hour
If unrolled at night it tells a helpful bedtime memory

effectDetails.title: Knowledge Transfer
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the scroll reveals an obscure fact or grants you the knowledge of a usable cantrip. The effect lasts for 1 hour and has no save DC required.

effectDetails.title: Nightly Bedtime Memory
effectDetails.rules: If unrolled at night under lantern light, it narrates a helpful bedtime memory that could be valuable to the listener's current situation or future challenges. This effect is instantaneous and requires no action from the user.

whispering_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The scroll's knowledge can be overwhelming even for seasoned adventurers, thus requiring a level of at least 1.
whispering_scroll.vendorReason: The Bazaar of Oddities is known for its eclectic collection of esoteric items, including the Whispering Scroll.
whispering_scroll.shippingDetail: Delivered by Silk Tube with a special delivery that ensures the scroll arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Requires reading aloud under lantern light at night
usage.duration: 1 hour for Knowledge Transfer, instantaneous for Bedtime Memory
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or if the scroll is damaged

whispering_scroll.priceReason: Balanced price considering the scroll's limited but powerful effects and its rarity.

white_paint_of_divine_righteousness.name: White Paint of Divine Righteousness
white_paint_of_divine_righteousness.description: The White Paint of Divine Righteousness is a celestial concoction that forces you to embody your true moral nature, painting you in an unyielding white hue. It grants advantage on saving throws against necrotic damage, as if the paint itself protects you from malevolence. However, it also imposes a disadvantage on Deception checks, revealing your honest intentions even when you wish to deceive. This divine brew, created by Celestial Paint Co., is shipped with utmost reverence via the Holy Courier, ensuring its purity remains intact.

effectDetails.title: Paint Yourself White
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against necrotic damage. This effect is active until the start of your next turn after using this item.

effectDetails.title: Truthful Nature
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 hour, you have disadvantage on all Deception checks and Insight checks made by others to discern if you are lying or hiding information. This effect is triggered when you use this item.

white_paint_of_divine_righteousness.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a character of at least level 6 to ensure they can handle its moral implications without being overwhelmed.
white_paint_of_divine_righteousness.vendorReason: Servants Cosmic Paint, known for their divine paints and inks, are trusted by many to provide this unique item.
white_paint_of_divine_righteousness.shippingDetail: The Holy Courier ensures the paint's purity through a special seal that must be broken upon arrival, ensuring its effectiveness is not compromised during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you use an action to dispel it early

white_paint_of_divine_righteousness.priceReason: The item's price is balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its divine origin and unique moral effects.

wiggler_boots.name: Wiggler Boots
wiggler_boots.description: The Wiggler Boots are a pair of enchanted footwear that vibrate and emit an angry hum when you take damage, propelling you forward with a burst of speed. They are said to have been crafted from the bones of ancient wiggler beasts, imbued with their ferocious energy. When struck, these boots not only enhance your movement but also grant you a brief surge in combat prowess, allowing for a more devastating attack.

effectDetails.title: Bounce Back
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage, gain +10 feet of movement speed and deal an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage on your next attack. This effect stacks up to three times.

effectDetails.title: Angry Stance
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one short rest after combat, you are immune to being charmed or frightened by non-magical means.

wiggler_boots.levelRequirementReason: The Wiggler Boots require a low level prerequisite to allow for their unique but balanced abilities.
wiggler_boots.vendorReason: Shamans at the hut understand the mystical properties of enchanted items, including these boots.
wiggler_boots.shippingDetail: Delivered with a special charm to ensure safe and swift travel.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after three uses or upon being re-equipped
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per short rest

wiggler_boots.priceReason: The boots' balanced abilities and unique stacking mechanic make them a fair addition to the player's arsenal at this XP cost.

wiggler_segment.name: Wiggler's Wrath Segment
wiggler_segment.description: A squirming, pulsating orange segment from an enraged Wiggler, it oozes a noxious green slime that clings to your fingers as you hold it. This relic of primal fury is said to contain the essence of countless Wiggler battles, and its touch can summon more than just angry caterpillars—it can also invoke a wave of unsettling whispers. The segment's power is fleeting but potent, leaving behind a lingering sense of unease in those who wield it.

effectDetails.title: Summon Angry Caterpillars
effectDetails.rules: As an action, throw the Wiggler's Wrath Segment. It explodes into three angry caterpillars that deal 1d6 poison damage on contact. The effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 3). After this duration, they dissolve into harmless, whimpering creatures and leave the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Invoke Unsettling Whispers
effectDetails.rules: For every round the segment is active, you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you are charmed by the whispers for 1 minute or until you take damage. The DC of this saving throw equals 8 + your proficiency bonus.

wiggler_segment.levelRequirementReason: This item's power level is balanced to be accessible at level 1, allowing new adventurers to harness the Wiggler's wrath.
wiggler_segment.vendorReason: Shamans of the forest are well-versed in the lore of the Wiggler and often possess items related to its power.
wiggler_segment.shippingDetail: The segment is wrapped securely in leaves, ensuring it arrives intact but still pulsating with energy.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or until the effects are dispelled by damage
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or the active rounds expire

wiggler_segment.priceReason: The price is set at a reasonable XP cost, reflecting both its rarity and the balance of power it provides.

wiggler_segment_armor.name: Wiggler Segment Plate
wiggler_segment_armor.description: The Wiggler Segment Plate is a vibrant, segmented armor crafted from the hardened exoskeletons of wiggler caterpillars. Its flexible segments allow it to stretch and squish with every movement, offering surprising flexibility in combat. Not only does this armor provide +2 AC against bludgeoning damage, but it also grants resistance to poison damage, making you a tough target for many foes. Additionally, its segmented design allows you to squeeze through tight spaces, ideal for navigating narrow corridors or avoiding traps.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to poison damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Squishy Defense (Activates on Wear)
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this armor, you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against being knocked prone and can reduce bludgeoning damage taken by half for 1 minute. This effect requires a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw each time it is used.

wiggler_segment_armor.levelRequirementReason: This armor's flexibility makes it accessible to lower-level adventurers who need basic protection.
wiggler_segment_armor.vendorReason: The Shamans' Hut specializes in crafting items from natural and magical materials, including the hardened exoskeletons of wiggler caterpillars.
wiggler_segment_armor.shippingDetail: Shipped wrapped in a cocoon for added protection against damage during transit.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn. Requires a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw each time the Squishy Defense is used.
usage.duration: Until start of your next turn or until you remove it, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: The Squishy Defense ends after one use per short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited; regains charges upon completing a long rest.

wiggler_segment_armor.priceReason: Balanced to provide significant protection at an affordable cost for early adventurers.

wish_granting_ritual.name: Wish Granting Ritual (Limited)
wish_granting_ritual.description: The Wish Granting Ritual (Limited) is a rare, masterfully crafted scroll imbued by an Arcane Institute wizard. It allows you to request one wish within reasonable bounds, but beware: each invocation has a 50% chance of unintended consequences. The ritual's caster reserves the right to demand payment or service as compensation for the spell’s power. With this scroll, reality bends slightly to your will, yet it remains within the constraints set by the arcane institute.

effectDetails.title: Wish Within Reasonable Bounds
effectDetails.rules: Activates upon reading and completing the ritual. The DM adjudicates the wish, ensuring it does not exceed logical bounds or allow for unlimited wishes. The caster may request a service or payment in return.

effectDetails.title: Unintended Consequences
effectDetails.rules: Each invocation has a 50% chance to create unintended results, which can range from minor inconveniences to catastrophic events. These outcomes are determined by the DM.

wish_granting_ritual.levelRequirementReason: This ritual is accessible to all characters but requires an understanding of its limitations and potential risks.
wish_granting_ritual.vendorReason: The Arcane Institute only sells this scroll to ensure it's used responsibly and within their guidelines.
wish_granting_ritual.shippingDetail: Delivered by a specially trained ritual courier. The delivery time may vary based on the complexity of the request.

usage.activation: Reading and completing the ritual exactly as described.
usage.duration: Instantaneous upon activation.
usage.endsWhen: The wish is granted, or if interrupted before completion.

wish_granting_ritual.priceReason: This price reflects the scroll's rarity and the controlled nature of its usage within reasonable bounds.

wish_loop_generator.name: Wish Loop Generator
wish_loop_generator.description: The Wish Loop Generator is a sleek, metallic device encased in iridescent glass, its core pulsing with an ethereal glow. This compact gadget allows you to make wishes that seem infinite—each wish grants your heart’s desire without consequence, until reality itself might protest. Crafted by The Lawyer who found the loophole, this device's success depends on a DM roll for 'reality stability,' ensuring each use is fraught with unpredictable outcomes.

effectDetails.title: Infinite Wishes
effectDetails.rules: Activating this device allows the user to make a wish. The DM rolls a d100; on a result of 95 or higher, reality may file a complaint, and the wish fails with dire consequences. If successful, the wish is granted without limit.

effectDetails.title: Reality Stability Roll
effectDetails.rules: After each use, the DM rolls a d100. On a result of 95 or higher, reality stability is compromised, requiring an immediate DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check to avoid a cascade effect that could unravel the fabric of existence.

wish_loop_generator.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest wish can have far-reaching consequences; this device requires at least 1st level to wield responsibly.
wish_loop_generator.vendorReason: Wish Exploitation is known for pushing boundaries and selling items that exploit loopholes in reality, making them the perfect vendor for this gadget.
wish_loop_generator.shippingDetail: Shipped via a network of teleportation contracts, the Wish Loop Generator arrives with an immediate 1-hour delay to account for potential shifts in reality stability.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Reality Stability Roll fails or wish is granted and successful
usage.charges: Unlimited, but DM discretion limits use

wish_loop_generator.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it allows for powerful wishes without overbalancing the game.

wish_wisp.name: Wish Wisp
wish_wisp.description: The Wish Wisp is a tiny, iridescent ember that hovers just out of reach, its glow pulsing with unspoken promises. This enigmatic creature responds only to sincere desires, but at a cost: after granting your wish, it consumes one cherished memory from the wiser you. Its whispers are both enticement and warning, for the Wisp's power is as capricious as the cosmos itself, attracting attention from otherworldly entities that may seek to claim its secrets.
effects: Grant a single wish subject to DM adjudication
Attracts cosmic attention; risk of reality distortion

effectDetails.title: Wish Granting
effectDetails.rules: Activation: Special. The Wisp responds only to sincere desires. It requires the wiser you to make a DC 30 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, it grants your wish; on a failure, it may twist reality in small ways and fails with no effect.

effectDetails.title: Memory Loss
effectDetails.rules: After using the Wisp, the wiser you loses one cherished memory. This loss is permanent unless a Wish spell or similar effect is used to restore it within 24 hours of its loss.

wish_wisp.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience and wisdom can command the Wisp's power without succumbing to its darker aspects.
wish_wisp.vendorReason: The Celestial Exchange is known for exotic and powerful items, including this enigmatic wisp that only the most trusted patrons may obtain.
wish_wisp.shippingDetail: Ships via Astral Wind, a swift courier that delivers the Wisp directly to your home with no risk of mishap or theft.

usage.activation: Special (requires a DC 30 Wisdom saving throw)
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when used
usage.endsWhen: The wish is granted or fails, and the wiser you loses one cherished memory

wish_wisp.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides a powerful but limited use of wish magic with significant risks.

wishing_coin.name: Wishing Coin
wishing_coin.description: The Wishing Coin is a gilded copper coin, intricately engraved with celestial symbols that shimmer faintly in the dark. Each night while you sleep, it whispers a single wish to your ear. The coin's power is both seductive and perilous; if you accept its offer, one day you'll find yourself aging by 1d6 years. Refuse its call, and it grows heavier with each passing night until finally, it will force the wish upon you.

effectDetails.title: Whispered Wish
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your first turn after waking each night, the Wishing Coin whispers a wish to you. The DM chooses one wish that is within your alignment's moral spectrum and has a logical outcome.

effectDetails.title: Age for Offer
effectDetails.rules: If you choose to fulfill the whispered wish, roll 1d6 years of your life as a cost. You gain the benefit of the wish immediately after fulfilling this condition. If you refuse three consecutive nights, the coin's weight increases by +2d4 until you either accept its offer or break it.

wishing_coin.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest wish can have dire consequences; only those of level 1 and above are sufficiently aware to understand the risks.
wishing_coin.vendorReason: The Celestial Exchange deals in all manner of rare and legendary items, including this coin that bridges the gap between mortal desires and divine intervention.
wishing_coin.shippingDetail: Shipped within a velvet pouch to protect its delicate engravings during transit.

usage.activation: At the start of your first turn after waking each night.
usage.duration: Until fulfilled or refused three consecutive nights.
usage.endsWhen: The wish is either accepted and fulfilled, or you refuse it for a third consecutive night.

wishing_coin.priceReason: The Wishing Coin's price reflects its rarity and the potential catastrophic outcomes of its use.

witcher_3_gwent_deck.name: Gwent Deck
witcher_3_gwent_deck.description: The Gwent Deck is a meticulously crafted set of cards, each one intricately designed with symbols and runes. Crafted from ancient oakwood and enchanted by the enigmatic scholars of Kaer Morhen, this deck grants its wielder strategic insight into the game of Gwent. It's said that playing with this deck can reveal hidden truths or grant foresight into future battles. The cards are not merely for amusement; they offer a chance to earn gold or valuable information through the game’s mini-games, and those who collect them find their knowledge expanding with each card added to their collection.

effectDetails.title: Gambler's Insight
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn, you may play a card from this deck as an action. If you win the resulting mini-game, you gain 50 XP and learn one secret from the realm. This effect can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Collectible Lore
effectDetails.rules: For every unique card added to your collection, you gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence (History) checks until you have 10 different cards. Once you reach this milestone, you may attempt to unlock the secrets of Gwent lore.

witcher_3_gwent_deck.levelRequirementReason: This deck is best suited for players who are beginning their journey into strategy and intrigue.
witcher_3_gwent_deck.vendorReason: The Rogue Port's Black Market often features unique and rare items, including this enchanted Gwent Deck.
witcher_3_gwent_deck.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Card Box, known for its swift and reliable service in delivering all types of card goods.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The game ends or you lose the mini-game

witcher_3_gwent_deck.priceReason: Crafted with ancient magic, this deck commands a premium price but offers unique and strategic benefits.

witcher_silver_sword.name: Silver Sword
witcher_silver_sword.description: The Silver Sword is a gleaming blade forged from refined silver and enchanted with the essence of the witcher. Its keen edge can pierce even the toughest monsters, dealing an extra 1d6 damage to aberrations. The sword requires no oils but still glows faintly in the dark, making it invaluable for night-time hunts. It is a favored weapon among seasoned warriors who seek to slay dangerous creatures with precision and speed.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Damage Against Aberrations
effectDetails.rules: When used against an aberration, the Silver Sword deals an additional 1d6 piercing damage. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Increased Monster Defense
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws against monsters. This bonus lasts until the end of their next long rest.

witcher_silver_sword.levelRequirementReason: This sword is crafted for seasoned adventurers who have proven their abilities in combat.
witcher_silver_sword.vendorReason: The Onyx Hand, a trusted supplier of magical weaponry, ensures that only the finest enchanted arms are sold to brave souls.
witcher_silver_sword.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with a delivery confirmation upon arrival.

usage.duration: Until the end of their next long rest
usage.endsWhen: The wielder completes a long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

witcher_silver_sword.priceReason: This sword offers significant bonuses in combat against specific and common enemies, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to the player's arsenal.

wonder_flower.name: Wonder Flower
wonder_flower.description: The Wonder Flower is a bizarre bloom that emits an ethereal glow. When it blooms, reality distorts in strange and colorful ways, making the environment feel like a surreal painting come to life. Inanimate objects around you momentarily animate into whimsical creatures, while gravity seems to play tricks on your senses. The flower's petals are said to have been crafted from fragments of forgotten realities by the enigmatic Rogueport vendors.

effectDetails.title: Reality Distortion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can release the Wonder Flower's power. The environment around you is distorted for 10 minutes. Inanimate objects within a 20-foot radius animate and begin to sing nonsensical songs. This effect has no save DC but ends if you or any creature in the area takes damage.

effectDetails.title: Animated Objects
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the Reality Distortion, all inanimate objects within a 20-foot radius animate and can move at half speed. Any creature that interacts with them must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be tripped by an animated object.

wonder_flower.levelRequirementReason: The Wonder Flower's power is accessible to all adventurers, but its unpredictable effects can be dangerous.
wonder_flower.vendorReason: Rogueport vendors are known for their ability to source items from the most mysterious origins, including this bizarre bloom.
