zebrabwe_herbivore_call.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant control and understanding of nature magic, as summoning such a large herd safely is a complex task.
zebrabwe_herbivore_call.vendorReason: The Zebrabwe Plains Trader has the knowledge and connections to source and properly manage the use of this powerful item.
zebrabwe_herbivore_call.shippingDetail: Ships via Swiftwind Courier, ensuring safe delivery within a week.

usage.duration: One hour
usage.endsWhen: The stampede ends after one hour or if the user dismisses it early as an action

zebrabwe_herbivore_call.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP to reflect its rarity and the risk involved in using such a powerful item.

zebrabwe_herd_alliance.name: Zebrabwe Great Herd Military Alliance
zebrabwe_herd_alliance.description: The Zebrabwe Great Herd Military Alliance is a rare parchment scroll forged from the collective will of thousands of zebras. Upon activation, it summons an alliance of 2,000 highly trained Zebra cavalry within a 10-mile radius for one day. The zebras are renowned for their swift and unyielding charge against unmounted foes, making them formidable in any conflict. Crafted by the Zebrabwe Plains Trader from sacred materials found deep within the plains, this scroll is a testament to ancient alliances and military prowess.
effects: Summon 2,000 allied Zebra cavalry (1 day duration)

effectDetails.title: Cavalry Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a bonus action. The summoned zebras are present for one day, after which they return to their herds. This effect can only be used once per year.

effectDetails.title: Mounted Zebrabwe Charge
effectDetails.rules: The summoned cavalry gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against unmounted targets and deal an additional 1d6 damage on successful hits.

zebrabwe_herd_alliance.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to handle the strategic and tactical demands of commanding such a large alliance.
zebrabwe_herd_alliance.vendorReason: The Zebrabwe Plains Trader has exclusive access to ancient forges where these scrolls are created.
zebrabwe_herd_alliance.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Tribal Chieftain, ensuring safe passage through treacherous terrain.

usage.duration: 1 day
usage.endsWhen: After one day, zebras return to their herds

zebrabwe_herd_alliance.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the rarity and strategic value of such an alliance.

zebrabwe_herd_charm.name: Zebrabwe Herd Charm
zebrabwe_herd_charm.description: The Zebrabwe Herd Charm is a sleek, polished bone whistle carved from the ribs of a zebrabwe. It resonates with the ancient calls of the savannah and can summon up to 10 large herbivores, such as wildebeests or zebras, for your temporary use in just moments. These summoned herds are docile and serve their purpose before returning to the wild after an hour, leaving you with a wealth of fresh food or a swift mode of travel across the plains. Crafted by skilled artisans of Zebrabwe, this charm is a testament to the harmony between man and nature.

effectDetails.title: Summon Large Herbivores
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Summons up to 10 non-combat, docile large herbivores (such as wildebeests) within 30 feet for 1 hour. The summoned creatures are under your temporary command and will return to their natural habitat after this duration.

effectDetails.title: Travel or Sustenance
effectDetails.rules: The summoned herd can be used for quick travel across the savannah or as a source of fresh food, providing enough sustenance for up to 10 people. The creatures are not under your control and will disperse after an hour.

zebrabwe_herd_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is suitable for adventurers who might need quick assistance or resources but lack the experience to handle more powerful items.
zebrabwe_herd_charm.vendorReason: The Zebrabwe Plains Trader specializes in crafting and trading goods that connect travelers with the natural world, making this item a perfect fit for their inventory.
zebrabwe_herd_charm.shippingDetail: Ships within one week via Swiftwind Courier's express service. The charm is carefully packed to ensure it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 hour.
usage.endsWhen: The summoned herd returns to nature after the duration, or if dismissed by a command word.

zebrabwe_herd_charm.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the charm's utility in providing immediate aid without being overly powerful.

zebrabwe_herd_leadership_sash.name: Zebrabwe Herd Leadership Sash
zebrabwe_herd_leadership_sash.description: The Zebrabwe Herd Leadership Sash is a regal sash woven from the finest fibers of the zebrabwe, each strand imbued with the spirit of unity and loyalty. This sash can command up to twenty beasts of burden or herbivores (CR 1/2 or lower), compelling them to follow complex commands without hesitation. Crafted by Zebrabwe using ancient plains magic, this item is a symbol of leadership on the open steppes where it finds its home.

effectDetails.title: Command Grazers
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can issue up to three complex commands to up to twenty beasts of burden or herbivores (CR 1/2 or lower) within 30 feet. These animals obey the command for 1 minute, after which they are free to act as they choose. The sash has no effect on creatures with an Intelligence score of 6 or higher.

effectDetails.title: Influence Loyalty
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this sash, the wearer gains advantage on Persuasion checks made against animals. This effect lasts for a number of hours equal to half the user's proficiency bonus (rounded down).

zebrabwe_herd_leadership_sash.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 4th level to effectively command and influence creatures.
zebrabwe_herd_leadership_sash.vendorReason: The Zebrabwe Plains Trader is known for their unique and magical items, especially those originating from the zebrabwe plains.
zebrabwe_herd_leadership_sash.shippingDetail: Ships via Swift Wind Messengers, ensuring safe delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous command; 1 minute influence effect per day
usage.endsWhen: The command ends when the sash is removed or the creatures are no longer within range. The influence lasts for up to one hour before it expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only three commands can be issued each day.

zebrabwe_herd_leadership_sash.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its epic rarity and unique magical properties without being overpowered.

zebrabwe_migration_guide.name: Zebrabwe Migration Guide (Predictive)
zebrabwe_migration_guide.description: The Zebrabwe Migration Guide (Predictive) is a leather scroll bound with runes of ancient magic. It contains detailed, shimmering maps that predict the precise paths and migration patterns of magical beasts for the next five years. Crafted by the Zebrawwes from the heart of the Plains, it grants perfect stealth advantage when tracking or ambushing these creatures within their predicted zones. It is invaluable to hunters and protectors who must navigate the shifting ecologies of the wild.

effectDetails.title: Perfect Stealth Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When you use this item within a predicted zone, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for the duration of one long rest.

effectDetails.title: Predictive Tracking
effectDetails.rules: You can spend 1 hour studying the maps and make a Wisdom (Survival) check. On a success, you determine the exact location of any magical beast within its predicted zone and know their movement for the next three days.

zebrabwe_migration_guide.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant knowledge of tracking and survival to interpret and utilize the guide effectively.
zebrabwe_migration_guide.vendorReason: The Zebrawwes are master trackers who have honed their skills over generations, making them the only ones capable of creating such a precise predictive tool.
zebrabwe_migration_guide.shippingDetail: Ships via enchanted scroll courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: One long rest or three days (whichever comes first)
usage.endsWhen: The map's predicted zones expire after five years
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires recharging by studying the maps anew

zebrabwe_migration_guide.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its utility in survival and hunting without granting game-breaking advantages.

zebrabwe_plains_settlement_charter.name: Zebrabwe Plains Settlement Charter
zebrabwe_plains_settlement_charter.description: The Zebrabwe Plains Settlement Charter is a parchment scroll imbued with the sacred essence of the Zebrabwe tribe's ancestors, granting permission to found and protect a settlement on their land. The charter ensures mutual defense between your people and the Zebrabwe, who have long protected travelers through this vast grassland. With this document, you can set up a thriving outpost, knowing it is taxed at only 5% of its income, fostering prosperity under the watchful gaze of the zebras.

effectDetails.title: Mutual Defense Pact
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a member of your faction, this charter activates a pact that requires Zebrabwe patrols to provide defense against any threats to the settlement. The effect lasts until the settlement is no longer in need of protection or the charter is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Tax Rate
effectDetails.rules: This charter reduces the settlement's tax rate by 5% for its first year, after which it reverts to standard rates unless renewed. No save DC required; this effect applies passively and does not require activation.

zebrabwe_plains_settlement_charter.levelRequirementReason: The charter requires a minimum level of understanding and respect from the applicant's faction.
zebrabwe_plains_settlement_charter.vendorReason: This trader is trusted by both the Zebrabwe and visiting travelers, making him a reliable source for such important documents.
zebrabwe_plains_settlement_charter.shippingDetail: The charter is delivered via the Official Accord courier service, ensuring safe transport through treacherous lands.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires no activation once the settlement is established.
usage.duration: Permanent until destroyed or settlement no longer needs protection.
usage.endsWhen: Settlement ceases to be protected by Zebrabwe patrols, or charter is destroyed.

zebrabwe_plains_settlement_charter.priceReason: This price reflects the historical and cultural value of the charter, as well as the protection it offers.

zebrabwe_plains_territory_deed.name: Zebrabwe Plains Territory Deed (5 Sq Miles)
zebrabwe_plains_territory_deed.description: This parchment map, stamped with the Zebrabwe insignia, grants ownership over five square miles of fertile plains. The deed allows for the establishment of a small town or outpost where you can levy taxes and enforce local laws. The territory is guaranteed protection by the nomadic Zebrabwe patrols who roam these lands, ensuring your claim against all comers. This relic is crafted from parchment woven with fibers from the zebrabwe grasslands themselves, imbued with the spirit of the plains.
effects: Establish a small town or outpost
Guaranteed protection by local Zebrabwe patrols

effectDetails.title: Settlement Establishment
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can establish a settlement on your territory. This requires the construction of basic infrastructure and hiring local labor. Once established, the outpost is yours to govern with full authority.

effectDetails.title: Patrol Protection
effectDetails.rules: The Zebrabwe nomadic patrols provide a +1 bonus to all Dexterity (Stealth) checks made within five miles of your territory for one week after the deed's activation. This effect can be used once per month.

zebrabwe_plains_territory_deed.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and responsibility required in managing the territory necessitate a character of at least level 5.
zebrabwe_plains_territory_deed.vendorReason: Only a trusted Zebrabwe Plains Traders can verify the authenticity of such a deed.
zebrabwe_plains_territory_deed.shippingDetail: Delivered by courier in two weeks, with additional delays during seasonal migrations.

usage.activation: As an action to establish a settlement or as a bonus action for patrol protection.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for establishment; weekly for patrol protection.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the deed is destroyed or the territory is abandoned.

zebrabwe_plains_territory_deed.priceReason: The price reflects the value of land rights, infrastructure costs, and Zebrabwe protection services.

zebrabwe_predator_calming_smoke.name: Zebrabwe Predator Calming Smoke (Large)
zebrabwe_predator_calming_smoke.description: This massive bundle of exotic Zebrabwe herbs is said to have been gathered from the heart of the plains, where only the largest predators dare venture. When released, it fills the air with a thick, masking smoke that temporarily blinds and calms even the most ferocious carnivores within a mile radius for an entire day. Crafted by the Zebrabwe Plains Trader, this bundle ensures your safety from large predators without a fight.

effectDetails.title: Masking Smoke
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this bundle releases a thick cloud of masking smoke that clears a 1-mile radius from all visible and invisible threats for 24 hours. Creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Calm Predators
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 24 hours, all large carnivores within a mile of the smoke are calmed and will not attack you or any creature you designate. This includes creatures such as lions, leopards, and other apex predators.

zebrabwe_predator_calming_smoke.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for ease of use by players who may encounter large predators without needing high-level abilities.
zebrabwe_predator_calming_smoke.vendorReason: The Zebrabwe Plains Trader has the unique knowledge and resources to gather and craft this potent bundle from their homeland.
zebrabwe_predator_calming_smoke.shippingDetail: This item is delivered by Swift Wind Courier, known for its speed across the plains. Delivery usually takes no more than a day within the region.

usage.activation: Standard action to release the smoke and calm predators.
usage.duration: 24 hours from activation
usage.endsWhen: The effects end after 24 hours, or when used up in combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the bundle recharges itself upon use.

zebrabwe_predator_calming_smoke.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and utility without being overpowered for a first-level character.

zebrabwe_predator_taming_serum.name: Zebrabwe Predator Taming Serum
zebrabwe_predator_taming_serum.description: Zebrabwe Predator Taming Serum is a vial of shimmering, iridescent fluid that exudes an earthy scent when uncorked. Crafted from the essence of ancient zebrawolves and the blood of predator beasts, this serum allows you to temporarily forge a bond with a formidable predator, making it your temporary ally in combat or exploration. The beast retains its natural aggression but can be directed by your commands for up to 24 hours, turning it into an invaluable mount or guardian.
effects: Tame and command a large predator (CR 6-9) as a temporary mount/ally

effectDetails.title: Temporary Bond with Predator
effectDetails.rules: Activates on contact with the target predator. The beast becomes temporarily non-aggressive for 24 hours, becoming your temporary mount or ally. You can direct it within a 30-foot radius as an action. The effect ends if you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), the target is reduced to 0 hit points, or if the beast is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Physical Application Required
effectDetails.rules: The serum must be applied directly to the predator's exposed skin. This requires an action and has no range limit. There are no saving throws involved.

zebrabwe_predator_taming_serum.levelRequirementReason: This serum is suitable for any level as it provides a temporary, non-lethal means of interacting with dangerous creatures.
zebrabwe_predator_taming_serum.vendorReason: Zebrabwe plains traders are known for their expertise in handling and taming wild animals.
zebrabwe_predator_taming_serum.shippingDetail: The serum is shipped via a swift messenger pegasus, ensuring it arrives at its destination intact within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Apply the serum to the predator as an action.
usage.duration: 24 hours or until lost concentration, incapacitation, or death of the target.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you lose concentration, the target is reduced to 0 HP, or the beast becomes incapacitated.

zebrabwe_predator_taming_serum.priceReason: This serum provides a powerful and rare utility at an affordable price point for any adventurer.

zebrabwe_safe_crossing_permit.name: Zebrabwe Great Herd Safe Crossing Permit
zebrabwe_safe_crossing_permit.description: The Zebrabwe Great Herd Safe Crossing Permit is a parchment of profound significance, embossed with the sacred sigils of the plains. This permit ensures safe passage through three major migratory zones, each teeming with zebras and other wildlife. For 48 hours within each zone, you and your party will be greeted with calm, unhurried herds that neither panic nor charge. Crafted by Zebrabwe to honor ancient traditions, this permit is a testament to the balance between traveler and nature.

effectDetails.title: Safe Passage
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants you safe passage through three major migratory zones for 48 hours each. During this time, you and your party are guaranteed to avoid any conflict with the zebras or other wildlife in these areas.

effectDetails.title: Calm Zebras
effectDetails.rules: While within a zone, all zebras will remain calm and not charge at you or your companions. This effect functions as long as the permit is active within the designated zones.

zebrabwe_safe_crossing_permit.levelRequirementReason: The balance of the plains requires that even novices respect the migratory paths of Zebrabwe.
zebrabwe_safe_crossing_permit.vendorReason: Zebrabwe Plains Traders uphold ancient traditions and ensure safe passage for all travelers, making this permit a staple in their inventory.
zebrabwe_safe_crossing_permit.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift Stamped Hides, ensuring timely delivery to your campsite.

usage.activation: Passive upon acquisition within the migratory zones.
usage.duration: 48 hours per zone while active.
usage.endsWhen: Upon leaving a designated migratory zone.

zebrabwe_safe_crossing_permit.priceReason: Balanced to ensure travelers can afford this necessary passage without disrupting the natural balance.

zebrabwe_stripe_alignment.name: Zebrabwe Stripe Alignment
zebrabwe_stripe_alignment.description: The Zebrabwe Stripe Alignment is a whimsical service that aligns your attire with the elegance of zebras. With this service, your clothing gains distinctive, hypnotic stripes—+1 Charisma when interacting with zebras or fashion-conscious individuals. Your presence becomes slightly mesmerizing; you gain advantage on Persuasion checks and disadvantage on Deception attempts. However, walking in a straight line proves challenging: you incur a penalty on all movement that requires precision, such as tightropes or straight paths.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Charisma
effectDetails.rules: You gain +1 to your Charisma (Persuasion) checks when dealing with zebras or other fashion enthusiasts. This effect lasts until the end of the day.

effectDetails.title: Hypnotic Presence
effectDetails.rules: For all Persuasion and Deception checks, you have advantage if the target is within 30 feet and has a Charisma score lower than yours. Otherwise, you are at disadvantage on such checks. This effect lasts until the end of the day.

zebrabwe_stripe_alignment.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to all adventurers who wish to enhance their social interactions.
zebrabwe_stripe_alignment.vendorReason: Zebrabwe Stripe Specialists are renowned for their unique and stylish services, ensuring that every customer leaves feeling both chic and aligned with the latest trends.
zebrabwe_stripe_alignment.shippingDetail: The Zebra Courier ensures swift delivery of your alignment service within a day, guaranteeing you're perfectly prepared for your next social encounter.

usage.duration: Until the end of the day
usage.endsWhen: At midnight or if you sleep

zebrabwe_stripe_alignment.priceReason: The price reflects the specialized service and unique alignment offered, enhancing your social interactions without requiring additional materials.

zebrabwe_stripe_camouflage_premium.name: Zebrabwe Stripe Camouflage (Premium)
zebrabwe_stripe_camouflage_premium.description: Zebrabwe Stripe Camouflage (Premium) is a vibrant paint that transforms the user into an expert at blending with plains terrain. Applied by Zebra Artists, this premium formula not only grants advantage on Stealth checks but also confuses both friend and foe, making it nearly impossible to distinguish painted individuals from their surroundings. The stripes are said to have been inspired by the legendary Zebrabwe artists who mastered the art of camouflage.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth Checks
effectDetails.rules: When applied, this paint grants advantage on all Stealth checks for 8 hours. It must be applied as an action and requires a canister of the paint.

effectDetails.title: Confuse Predators
effectDetails.rules: The painted individual or group confuses nearby creatures, granting disadvantage to any attack rolls made against them within 30 feet, for 1 minute. This effect ends if a creature successfully hits the target with an attack or the target moves more than 30 feet away.

zebrabwe_stripe_camouflage_premium.levelRequirementReason: Requires no specific level as it aids in survival and stealth.
zebrabwe_stripe_camouflage_premium.vendorReason: Zebra Artists are renowned for their mastery of the art of camouflage, making them the ideal vendor for this premium paint.
zebrabwe_stripe_camouflage_premium.shippingDetail: The paint is shipped in a sealed canister to ensure it remains effective upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until used up
usage.endsWhen: A successful hit by an attack roll or movement beyond 30 feet away from the target
usage.charges: Unlimited; refills after a short rest

zebrabwe_stripe_camouflage_premium.priceReason: The paint is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its premium quality and the expertise of Zebra Artists in crafting it.

zebrabwe_stripe_strainer.name: Zebrabwe Stripe Strainer
zebrabwe_stripe_strainer.description: The Zebrabwe Stripe Strainer is a wondrous kitchen tool, crafted by Zebra Weavers from the finest milk-stained reeds and dyed with natural stripes. When in use, its unique design ensures even straining of yogurt curds, offering advantage on checks to prepare dairy-rich dishes. Its camouflage stripes allow it to blend into grassy meadows when not in use, perfect for both kitchen and field. The Strainer is a hallmark of Zebra Weavers' craftsmanship.

effectDetails.title: Dairy Preparation Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When the user checks to prepare any dairy-rich dish, they gain advantage. This effect lasts until the end of their next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Camouflage in Grass
effectDetails.rules: While not in use, the Strainer can blend into grassy environments by a natural mimicry effect, making it invisible to creatures within 30 feet. This camouflage lasts for 1 hour and requires no action from the user.

zebrabwe_stripe_strainer.levelRequirementReason: Crafted for general kitchen use, this Strainer does not require any special proficiency.
zebrabwe_stripe_strainer.vendorReason: Being a Zebra Weavers' product, it's only natural that they sell the Zebrabwe Stripe Strainers at their shop.
zebrabwe_stripe_strainer.shippingDetail: Delivered by Striped Sieve Set Express within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect when in use; camouflage activated manually as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Advantage lasts until next short or long rest; camouflage lasts for 1 hour.
usage.endsWhen: Advantage ends with the next rest; camouflage ends after 1 hour or when used manually.

zebrabwe_stripe_strainer.priceReason: The Zebrabwe Stripe Strainer is crafted by a renowned vendor and offers unique advantages, justifying its fair value of 1000 XP.

zebrabwe_striped_robe.name: Zebrabwe Striped Robe
zebrabwe_striped_robe.description: The Zebrabwe Striped Robe is a hand-woven garment with a mesmerizing pattern of black and white stripes, carefully crafted by the Zebra Weavers to mimic the savanna's zebras. It whispers in the wind, blending the wearer into their surroundings when worn in grasslands, and its stripes subtly fade away if stepped into muddy waters. This robe not only grants advantage on Stealth checks but also calms nearby herd animals, making it a favorite among those who need to move unseen or gather information without causing panic.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth Checks
effectDetails.rules: When worn in grasslands, the Zebrabwe Striped Robe grants the wearer advantage on all Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This benefit lasts for one hour per day, and it is not affected by the passage of time but ends if the robe is removed or if the wearer moves into an environment that does not match its camouflage pattern.

effectDetails.title: Calm Nearby Herd Animals
effectDetails.rules: When worn in grasslands, the Zebrabwe Striped Robe can be activated once per long rest to calm nearby herd animals within 30 feet. The effect lasts for 1 minute and has a range of 60 feet. Creatures affected must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12) or become charmed by the robe's calming influence, which prevents them from taking aggressive actions towards the wearer.

zebrabwe_striped_robe.levelRequirementReason: The Zebrabwe Striped Robe is designed for ease of use and accessibility, making it suitable for adventurers of all levels.
zebrabwe_striped_robe.vendorReason: The Zebra Weavers are the artisans who create this robe, and they sell it directly to ensure its craftsmanship and authenticity remain unparalleled.
zebrabwe_striped_robe.shippingDetail: Shipped via a courier from Patterned Cloth, known for their reliable delivery services within the savanna region.

usage.duration: One hour per day or until removed or the surroundings no longer match its camouflage pattern
usage.endsWhen: The robe is removed or the wearer moves out of a grassland area
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be used per long rest

zebrabwe_striped_robe.priceReason: The Zebrabwe Striped Robe is crafted with high-quality materials and intricate patterns, making it a valuable yet reasonably priced item for adventurers.

zebrabwe_weather_vane.name: Zebrabwe Weather Vane
zebrabwe_weather_vane.description: The Zebrabwe Weather Vane is a hand-crafted weather vane forged from polished obsidian and adorned with silver runes that whisper ancient prophecies. It not only predicts severe meteorological hazards but can also temporarily divert light rain or wind away, providing a critical 24-hour warning to travelers across the plains. Crafted by Zebrabwe, the master forger of the Zebrowe Plains, this vane is a trusted companion for any adventurer venturing into unpredictable climes.

effectDetails.title: Meteorological Prediction
effectDetails.rules: The Zebrabwe Weather Vane can predict severe meteorological hazards, both magical and mundane, up to 24 hours in advance. This effect is passive but requires the user to be aware of it for it to function effectively.

effectDetails.title: Minor Weather Diversion
effectDetails.rules: The vane can temporarily divert light rain or wind away from a camp, creating a sheltered area approximately 10 feet in diameter. This effect lasts for 1 hour and may be used once per long rest.

zebrabwe_weather_vane.levelRequirementReason: This vane is suitable for beginners who require basic protection against unpredictable weather.
zebrabwe_weather_vane.vendorReason: The Zebrabwe Plains Trader proudly sells this local artisanal creation, offering essential tools to those navigating the harsh Zebrowe Plains.
zebrabwe_weather_vane.shippingDetail: Shipped via Wooden Post, ensuring safe and timely delivery through a network of trusted couriers.

usage.activation: Passive; awareness is required for prediction to take effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (prediction); 1 hour (weather diversion)
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each long rest (diversion); when the user becomes unaware or the vane breaks

zebrabwe_weather_vane.priceReason: This price reflects the craftsmanship, materials used, and its essential utility for adventurers.

zelda_triforce_shard.name: Triforce Shard
zelda_triforce_shard.description: The Triforce Shard is a fragment of divine origin, forged from the very essence of the Triforce. It grants its bearer the power to enhance one's fundamental virtue: strength, wisdom, or courage. This shard, when activated, permanently boosts the chosen attribute by two points, ensuring a lasting impact on the wielder's capabilities. Its second effect allows the user to invoke a wish-like ability once per week, but with limitations that prevent it from being overused. The Shard’s presence is not without consequence; it draws malevolent forces in its vicinity, necessitating caution.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Virtue
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The chosen attribute (STR, INT, or CHA) is permanently increased by 2 points until the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Wish-like Ability
effectDetails.rules: Activates once per week. The user may cast one wish spell, but only for a single specific effect that aligns with their character's theme or narrative goal. This use is limited to once per week and cannot be overextended.

zelda_triforce_shard.levelRequirementReason: This Shard requires significant power to wield effectively, necessitating at least level 12 for the user.
zelda_triforce_shard.vendorReason: The Comet Observatory is known for its connection with divine and ancient relics, making it a fitting vendor for such an artifact.
zelda_triforce_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Sacred Relic courier service, ensuring secure and timely delivery of this fragile yet potent item.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (for wish-like effect)
usage.duration: Permanent (until next long rest) for strength increase; instantaneous for wish-like ability
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon use, recharge after a week

zelda_triforce_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique and powerful abilities, ensuring it remains a desirable but not overpowered item.

doughnut_hole_gravitational_donut.name: Singularity Swirl Donut
doughnut_hole_gravitational_donut.description: The Singularity Swirl Donut appears to be a confectionary marvel, crafted from an unknown dough that seems to defy gravity itself. Each bite sends ripples through your personal space-time continuum, briefly distorting your surroundings and causing you to either leap skyward or stumble comically in place. This cosmic delicacy is said to have been baked by the enigmatic Hole Hawker using ingredients smuggled from beyond the stars via a Void Portal Courier.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you consume one bite of the donut. For 1 minute, a minor gravitational distortion affects your movements. You gain advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to jump and are immune to falling damage during this time. This effect ends if you take any fall damage or if another creature within 5 feet of you takes such damage.

effectDetails.title: Comical Stumble
effectDetails.rules: At the beginning of each of your turns, there is a 20% chance that after you roll for initiative, you will stumble and fall prone. On a failed Dexterity saving throw (DC 13), this effect occurs immediately at the start of your turn instead.

doughnut_hole_gravitational_donut.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest adventurer can indulge in the whimsical effects of this cosmic treat, though it's best savored with caution.
doughnut_hole_gravitational_donut.vendorReason: Hole Hawker is known for their peculiar and often unpredictable wares, including items that challenge reality itself, making the Singularity Swirl Donut a fitting addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_gravitational_donut.shippingDetail: The donuts are delivered fresh from beyond the stars, arriving in perfect condition but only within a week of baking. Orders placed after midnight do not ship until the following day.

usage.duration: 1 minute per bite consumed.
usage.endsWhen: You take fall damage or another creature nearby does so; or you eat another bite of a Singularity Swirl Donut.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

doughnut_hole_gravitational_donut.priceReason: The ingredients and delivery method are quite unique, justifying this price point for an item that offers both practical benefits and sheer amusement.

doughnut_hole_chronal_armor.name: Temporal Glaze Breastplate
doughnut_hole_chronal_armor.description: Forged from solidified chronal energy by the Timekeepers of Chronos, this Temporal Glaze Breastplate allows you to briefly rewind minor mistakes. It's not a time machine, but it can save your skin when you fumble an attack or trip over your words in a crucial moment. Just try not to accidentally erase your entire existence! Wearing this breastplate grants the wearer the ability to negate damage on missed attacks and slow down enemy projectiles, giving them precious moments of reprieve.

effectDetails.title: Negate Missed Attack Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you miss an attack roll with a melee weapon or a ranged projectile, you can use a bonus action to negate the damage dealt. This effect lasts until your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Slow Enemy Projectiles
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after you hit with a ranged weapon, all enemy projectiles within 30 feet of you move at half speed. You can use a bonus action to end this effect early.

doughnut_hole_chronal_armor.levelRequirementReason: The intricate chronal patterns etched into the breastplate require a deep understanding of time manipulation, which is only achieved by seasoned adventurers.
doughnut_hole_chronal_armor.vendorReason: Center Seller maintains exclusive partnerships with the Timekeepers of Chronos, ensuring their most prized creations reach capable hands.
doughnut_hole_chronal_armor.shippingDetail: The Temporal Courier Network ensures swift delivery via time-bending routes that can only be accessed by those who possess a Temporal Glaze Breastplate.

usage.activation: Bonus action to negate missed attack damage; bonus action or reaction to slow enemy projectiles.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for negating damage, 1 minute for slowing projectiles; ends when the effect is used again or when your next turn begins.
usage.endsWhen: Used again or at the start of your next turn after negating missed attack damage; can be ended early as a bonus action after hitting with a ranged weapon.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one instance of each effect can be active per round.

doughnut_hole_chronal_armor.priceReason: The Temporal Glaze Breastplate is priced at 1000 XP due to its mythic rarity and the advanced chronal technology required for its crafting.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_orb.name: Void Echo Orb
doughnut_hole_anomaly_orb.description: The Void Echo Orb is a shimmering, pulsating sphere that hums with the essence of alternate realities. Held briefly, it reveals glimpses of other donut shops—each more bizarre than the last, filled with peculiar treats and whimsical architecture. The orb's light flickers with an ethereal glow, hinting at the fabric of reality being stretched. Use it wisely; prolonged exposure can stir unsettling thoughts or an overwhelming desire for a glazed jellybean twist.

effectDetails.title: Revelation of Alternate Realities
effectDetails.rules: When held, the orb reveals glimpses of alternate versions of donut shops. This effect lasts for 1 minute per level of the user. The user can make a Perception check to gain temporary insights into hidden details of their surroundings. On a successful check, they learn one secret about their immediate environment.

effectDetails.title: Boosts Perception
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on all Perception checks made within 30 feet for the duration of holding the orb. The effect ends when the user stops concentrating or if the orb is destroyed.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_orb.levelRequirementReason: Even a novice adventurer can benefit from glimpsing alternate realities.
doughnut_hole_anomaly_orb.vendorReason: The Void Vendor specializes in items that distort reality, making this a perfect addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_anomaly_orb.shippingDetail: Ships via quantum courier; arrives instantly but requires a signature from the recipient upon arrival.

usage.activation: Holding the orb briefly for at least 10 seconds
usage.duration: 1 minute per user level
usage.endsWhen: The user stops concentrating or the orb is destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as it remains intact

doughnut_hole_anomaly_orb.priceReason: Balanced price considering its unique and useful effects.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_stool.name: Glowy Stool of Grunt
mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_stool.description: The Glowy Stool of Grunt radiates a soft, pulsating glow that seems to absorb ambient light and reflect it back in waves. Crafted from the timeworn wood of ancient mushroom trees, this stool not only enhances one's step but also whispers tales of mischievous forest spirits. Rumor has it that sitting on it might attract the attention of grumpy mushroom guardians, which is why the stool emits a faint hum to ward them off.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: While sitting on the Glowy Stool of Grunt, you gain a +1 bonus to your walking speed. This effect is passive and lasts for as long as you remain seated.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Reflect Damage
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, when you are hit by an attack while sitting on the stool, you can choose to take half the damage instead of full. You must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw; if you succeed, the attack is negated and the attacker takes 2d6 force damage.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_stool.levelRequirementReason: The stool's ancient magic requires a certain level of understanding to harness its full potential.
mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_stool.vendorReason: Wario, with his extensive network of underground deals, has managed to acquire this rare and quirky piece of furniture.
mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_stool.shippingDetail: The stool is carefully packed in a special mushroom cart that delivers it directly from the Mushroom Kingdom's heart, ensuring its arrival is both safe and timely.

usage.activation: Passive effect while seated on the stool.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when you stand up or lose your Dexterity modifier.
usage.endsWhen: You stand up or lose your Dexterity modifier.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_stool.priceReason: The stool's rarity and the magic imbued in it justify its relatively lower price compared to other epic items of similar power.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_greed.name: Coin of Unending Want
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_greed.description: This tarnished coin, a relic from the Mushroom Kingdom's darkest days, whispers promises of infinite riches to those who gaze upon it too long. Its surface is etched with arcane symbols that seem to pulse faintly in the dark. Holding it can lead to obsessive hoarding and a crippling fear of empty pockets; even seasoned adventurers have been known to sell their armor for its fleeting promise of endless gold.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Find Extra Gold
effectDetails.rules: When used, the coin grants a +1 bonus to one treasure roll per day. The effect lasts until used or discarded.

effectDetails.title: Negative Party Morale
effectDetails.rules: For every 3 days the coin is held by any party member, there is a 20% chance that the next encounter with a hostile creature will result in a -1 penalty to all attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the day.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_greed.levelRequirementReason: The coin's power is too great for novices, requiring at least first-level characters to wield it safely.
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_greed.vendorReason: Toad Town Market often sells items with dark histories, and this coin's origins are no secret.
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_greed.shippingDetail: Ships via snail mail, ensuring the coin arrives at its destination in one piece but not before a week of delays.

usage.activation: Used as an action to activate its effects for a day.
usage.duration: Until used or discarded.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used or if lost by a party member.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active per day.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_greed.priceReason: Its dark history and the risks it poses to adventurers justify its high price in experience points.

mushroom_kingdom_item_dark_fungus_essenc.name: Essence of Rotting Regret
mushroom_kingdom_item_dark_fungus_essenc.description: The Essence of Rotting Regret is a vial containing a dark, viscous liquid that simmers like molten despair. Harvested from the deepest fungi caverns, it induces vivid nightmares and a profound sense of melancholy. Those who consume it may experience moments of existential clarity, but at the cost of their party's morale, which plummets for hours afterward. Use with caution; prolonged exposure may result in permanent psychological damage, or just a really bad headache.

effectDetails.title: Nightmare Inducer
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as an action, the user must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute. During this time, they are subjected to vivid nightmares that cause no damage but leave them exhausted.

effectDetails.title: Party Morale Sink
effectDetails.rules: For each hour after consuming the essence, all party members within a 30-foot radius suffer from a -2 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws. This effect lasts for up to 8 hours, but can be mitigated by a successful Wisdom saving throw.

mushroom_kingdom_item_dark_fungus_essenc.levelRequirementReason: Even the lowliest adventurer might find themselves tempted by the essence's promise of insight.
mushroom_kingdom_item_dark_fungus_essenc.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop specializes in exotic and dark wares, making it a fitting vendor for this macabre elixir.
mushroom_kingdom_item_dark_fungus_essenc.shippingDetail: Ships via Shadow Delivery within three days of purchase. Handle with care; the essence is fragile and can leak during transit.

usage.activation: Consumed as an action, or applied to a drink.
usage.duration: Instantaneous use, but effects last for up to one minute on failure, and eight hours after consumption.
usage.endsWhen: The user successfully saves against the effect, or the duration expires.

mushroom_kingdom_item_dark_fungus_essenc.priceReason: The essence is rare but not overly powerful; its price reflects its dark allure and potential for misuse.

faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_stomach.name: Potion of Grizzly Stomach
faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_stomach.description: The Potion of Grizzly Stomach is a murky, frothy concoction that reeks of fermented berries and wild fur. Upon consumption, you are granted the ferocious appetite and primal instincts of a grizzly, making you immune to exhaustion but driving you to seek out food—preferably meat—at all costs. This potent brew grants advantage on Survival checks for 1 hour and leaves you in a temporary state of madness (roll a d4: 1-Confusion, 2-Paranoia, 3-Extreme Hunger, 4-Berserk), which can be temporarily controlled by focusing your willpower.

effectDetails.title: Survival Advantage
effectDetails.rules: The drinker gains advantage on all Survival checks for 1 hour. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Primal Madness
effectDetails.rules: You enter a temporary state of madness (roll a d4: 1-Confusion, 2-Paranoia, 3-Extreme Hunger, 4-Berserk). This effect lasts for the duration or until you successfully cast a spell. You can attempt to shake off this madness by concentrating on it as an action.

faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_stomach.levelRequirementReason: This potion is accessible to low-level characters who need to survive in harsh environments or confront dangerous creatures.
faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_stomach.vendorReason: The Waterdeep Market frequently stocks items that can be found beyond the city's borders, including this potent survival aid.
faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_stomach.shippingDetail: Ships via swift hawk courier for expedited delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends, you are incapacitated, or you successfully cast a spell

faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_stomach.priceReason: The potion's effectiveness in survival situations and the potential for temporary madness justify its high price.

faerun_item_scroll_of_minor_illusion.name: Scroll of Minor Illusion (Wario’s Version)
faerun_item_scroll_of_minor_illusion.description: This scroll, hastily crafted by the mischievous Wario in his mushroom-infested lab, creates small and often bizarre illusions that can either be mistaken for delectable snacks or unsettlingly grotesque objects. The parchment crackles with a faint, earthy glow as it releases these ephemeral images, which linger for only 1 minute before fading into nothingness. These simple, visual diversions are more of a distraction than anything else, but their uncanny realism makes them quite effective at throwing off unsuspecting foes or luring in curious onlookers.

effectDetails.title: Visual Distraction
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The scroll creates an illusion that lasts for 1 minute, providing advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to avoid detection within the area of effect.

effectDetails.title: Ephemeral Illusion
effectDetails.rules: The illusions created are small and simple in nature, limited to objects or images no larger than a medium creature. These illusions have no mechanical effects but can be seen by all creatures within 30 feet who do not succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw.

faerun_item_scroll_of_minor_illusion.levelRequirementReason: Requires only level 1 to use, as its effects are more about distraction than combat.
faerun_item_scroll_of_minor_illusion.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar often stocks unique and whimsical items from various realms, including this scroll with a touch of the absurd.
faerun_item_scroll_of_minor_illusion.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Pony Express for quick delivery, ensuring adventurers receive their scrolls in time for their next grand adventure.

usage.activation: Bonus action to create an illusion.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use.
usage.endsWhen: The illusion ends if a creature within range of the scroll succeeds on its saving throw or if the scroll is destroyed.

faerun_item_scroll_of_minor_illusion.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting the scroll's unique and humorous design as a minor illusion tool for distraction.

animatopia_gloomfruit_1.name: Gloomfruit Tartlet
animatopia_gloomfruit_1.description: The Gloomfruit Tartlet is a bittersweet confection made from the rare Gloomfruit, harvested in the deep shadowed valleys of Animatopia. Its dark purple skin hides a tangy flavor that grants a fleeting advantage to your stealth and an eerie glow that enhances your vision in darkness. Beware, for the tartlet's effects are as fleeting as the shadows they empower—once consumed, it’s best to move swiftly before its magic fades.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Gloomfruit Tartlet grants you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 minute. This effect ends if you take any action other than moving or speaking.

effectDetails.title: Dark Vision
effectDetails.rules: The tartlet also enhances your vision in dim light to bright light, allowing you to see normally. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after consuming the tartlet.

animatopia_gloomfruit_1.levelRequirementReason: This treat is suitable for adventurers with less experience, as it provides a temporary advantage without demanding high levels.
animatopia_gloomfruit_1.vendorReason: The Tribal Trader specializes in exotic and rare goods from Animatopia, making the Gloomfruit Tartlet an appropriate addition to their inventory.
animatopia_gloomfruit_1.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the swift Winged Messengers of Animatopia, ensuring you receive your tartlet fresh from its source.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Stealth Boost; until start of next turn for Dark Vision
usage.endsWhen: You take an action other than moving or speaking (Stealth); the start of your next turn (Dark Vision)

animatopia_gloomfruit_1.priceReason: The rarity and craftsmanship involved in creating this treat justify its high price.

animatopia_stonefang_amulet.name: Stonefang Amulet of the Howling Beast
animatopia_stonefang_amulet.description: Forged from a genuine fang of the legendary Stonefang, this amulet pulses with primal energy. Wear it to summon a miniature howler beast that assists you in battle—just try not to get eaten! (It’s mostly friendly...mostly.) The fangs are said to have been taken during a fierce storm when the Stonefang roared its last. It grants resistance to fear effects and boosts your attack damage, but beware, it can also unleash primal wrath if misused.

effectDetails.title: Summons Howler Beast
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this amulet summons a small howler beast (HP: 25, Attack: 6) that assists you in battle. The beast lasts for 1 minute or until it is destroyed. It has resistance to fear effects and cannot be commanded by others.

effectDetails.title: Boosts Attack Damage
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to attack rolls against beasts and creatures of the earth subtype for 30 seconds. This effect can only activate once per short or long rest.

animatopia_stonefang_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 12 to harness the primal power of the Stonefang.
animatopia_stonefang_amulet.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar specializes in items that interact with nature and beasts, making it the perfect vendor for this amulet.
animatopia_stonefang_amulet.shippingDetail: The Giant Beetle Courier delivers swiftly but may require a brief detour to avoid rocky terrain.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or dismissed by the wearer
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short or long rest

animatopia_stonefang_amulet.priceReason: The amulet’s rare material and unique enchantment justify its fair price of 1000 XP.

animatopia_spirit_pearl.name: Spirit Pearl of Whispered Secrets
animatopia_spirit_pearl.description: The Spirit Pearl of Whispered Secrets is a shimmering orb that glows with an ethereal light, capturing the whispers of Animatopia's ancient spirits. When held, it grants you the ability to understand animal speech for 1 minute, allowing you to communicate with any creature within 30 feet that has an Intelligence score of 2 or lower. Additionally, it reveals hidden pathways and secrets in your immediate area, but beware—these revelations may be cryptic at best! The pearl's magic is said to have been forged by the forest spirits themselves, ensuring its power remains mysterious and unpredictable.

effectDetails.title: Understand Animal Speech
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, you can understand any animal within 30 feet that has an Intelligence score of 2 or lower. This effect lasts for 1 minute and requires no saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Secrets
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, this pearl can be used to reveal hidden pathways or secrets in your immediate area (within 30 feet). The exact nature of the revelation depends on the environment, but it could provide a critical advantage. This effect is instantaneous and does not require saving throw.

animatopia_spirit_pearl.levelRequirementReason: The Spirit Pearl's magic is accessible to all adventurers who wish to communicate with nature.
animatopia_spirit_pearl.vendorReason: Forest Market, known for its connection to the natural world, offers this mystical item as a way to bridge the gap between humans and wildlife.
animatopia_spirit_pearl.shippingDetail: Ships via the Sky Serpent Delivery service, ensuring safe arrival within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (depending on context)
usage.duration: Instantaneous reveal; speech lasts for 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when its duration expires or you lose concentration
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one reveal per short rest

animatopia_spirit_pearl.priceReason: The Spirit Pearl's price reflects its rarity and the unique abilities it grants, making it a valuable tool for adventurers seeking to navigate the wilds of Animatopia.

connectopia_block_of_resonance.name: Resonant Brick Fragment
connectopia_block_of_resonance.description: This Resonant Brick Fragment pulses faintly, its surface etched with ancient runes that seem to hum in time with Connectopia’s mystical heartbeat. Crafters report an uncanny increase in efficiency when working with this fragment; tools wielded near it feel as though they are amplified by the very essence of creation itself. The air around it occasionally thickens, and a curious robotic squirrel may wander into your workshop, offering a bemused glance before scurrying away.

effectDetails.title: Crafting Efficiency Boost
effectDetails.rules: While holding this fragment, your crafting speed increases by +10%. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Attract Robotic Squirrels
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can use an action to call upon a robotic squirrel. It appears within 30 feet and remains for up to 1 hour or until it is dismissed by the fragment's owner.

connectopia_block_of_resonance.levelRequirementReason: Crafting with this fragment requires a certain degree of focus and experience, making level 5 an appropriate threshold.
connectopia_block_of_resonance.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in items that enhance the creativity and productivity of its patrons, so it makes sense for them to stock this unique artifact.
connectopia_block_of_resonance.shippingDetail: The automated drones deliver the fragment directly to your workshop via a special courier service, ensuring its arrival is timely and intact.

usage.activation: Use an action while holding the fragment for crafting efficiency boost; use an action once per day to attract a robotic squirrel.
usage.duration: Crafting speed increase lasts until rest ends; robotic squirrel remains up to one hour or dismissed.
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends or robotic squirrel is dismissed by the owner.

connectopia_block_of_resonance.priceReason: The price reflects a significant crafting enhancement and unique interaction with robotic wildlife, justifying its cost.

connectopia_pioneer_post_contract.name: Pioneer's Guarantee Scroll
connectopia_pioneer_post_contract.description: The Pioneer's Guarantee Scroll is a parchment sealed with the official wax of the esteemed Pioneer Post. It promises protection against bandit attacks and resource scarcity, but this promise comes at a steep cost: it only holds true for a single day. The scroll’s effectiveness is legendary, as no one expects a bureaucratic organization to actually enforce its word. Use it wisely, or you'll find yourself in their official records forever!

effectDetails.title: Bandit Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Until the end of your next turn, gain resistance to all damage from bandits. This effect is instantaneous and requires no action.

effectDetails.title: Resource Boost
effectDetails.rules: For 24 hours, you have a +5% chance to receive free supplies upon traveling through areas known for resource scarcity. This effect has no save DC but can only be used once per day.

connectopia_pioneer_post_contract.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is designed for all adventurers who might encounter bandits or need resources, regardless of their level.
connectopia_pioneer_post_contract.vendorReason: The Pioneer Post issues this guarantee to protect its members and travelers through dangerous lands.
connectopia_pioneer_post_contract.shippingDetail: Sent by trusted couriers on swift steeds; delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn for Bandit Resistance, and 24 hours for Resource Boost
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally or if you use it again before the duration ends

connectopia_pioneer_post_contract.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its limited daily use and significant benefits.

connectopia_legendary_geode_of_synchroni.name: The Synchronized Core
connectopia_legendary_geode_of_synchroni.description: The Synchronized Core glows with a mesmerizing pulse, its facets shimmering like the stars in Connectopia's sky. This geode is said to be forged from the very essence of the city's block network, allowing its wielder brief glimpses into future placements and the ability to phase through solid structures. However, overuse can trigger unexpected building projects that disrupt the city’s harmony, making careful timing crucial for those who dare to wield it.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Insight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can use the Synchronized Core to gain a +20% chance to predict the placement of the next block. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Phasing Pulse
effectDetails.rules: By using an action, you can activate the Phasing Pulse, allowing you to phase through solid structures as if they were air. This ability lasts for 3 turns and can only be used once every short or long rest.

connectopia_legendary_geode_of_synchroni.levelRequirementReason: The complex mechanics of the Synchronized Core require a player of at least level 14 to fully grasp its nuances and risks.
connectopia_legendary_geode_of_synchroni.vendorReason: The block smith, a master craftsman of Connectopia's architecture, is privy to the geode’s origins and can provide it only to those who understand its value.
connectopia_legendary_geode_of_synchroni.shippingDetail: The reinforced crate ensures safe delivery through the city’s bustling streets, often requiring a courier's agility to navigate.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Temporal Insight; Action for Phasing Pulse
usage.duration: 1 minute (Temporal Insight); 3 turns (Phasing Pulse)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration is over or you lose your concentration on it, whichever comes first.
usage.charges: Once per short or long rest

connectopia_legendary_geode_of_synchroni.priceReason: The Synchronized Core’s price reflects its rarity and the unique balance between utility and risk it offers to players.

grand_country_gravitron_cog.name: Gravitron Cog of Shifting Sands
grand_country_gravitron_cog.description: The Gravitron Cog of Shifting Sands is a bizarre metallic contraption that defies gravity, its gears spinning in unpredictable patterns. Crafted by Wario himself, it seems to manipulate the very fabric of stability around it, often causing nearby objects or creatures to wobble and falter. It can be a handy tool for adventurers who need an unstable edge in their contraptions, yet its shifting nature makes it a peculiar toy for those with a penchant for chaos.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Stability
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Gravitron Cog causes a target within 5 feet to have their speed reduced by 10 feet for 3 turns. The effect ends if the target successfully makes a Dexterity saving throw with a DC of 12.

effectDetails.title: Tumbling Tendency
effectDetails.rules: The Gravitron Cog increases the chance of a creature becoming prone by 10%. This increase persists for as long as the cog is active. The effect ends if the cog is destroyed or when a creature makes a successful Dexterity saving throw.

grand_country_gravitron_cog.levelRequirementReason: This cog requires no specific level because it serves more as a whimsical tool than a combat item.
grand_country_gravitron_cog.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in unique and quirky items, making the Gravitron Cog of Shifting Sands a perfect addition to their inventory.
grand_country_gravitron_cog.shippingDetail: The Giant Delivery Drone ensures that your cog arrives with a slight vibration, adding to its chaotic essence.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: Target makes a Dexterity saving throw or the cog is destroyed

grand_country_gravitron_cog.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its utility as both a toy and tool, making it accessible to all adventurers.

grand_country_layer_stone_shard.name: Layered Obsidian Shard of Echoes
grand_country_layer_stone_shard.description: The Layered Obsidian Shard of Echoes glimmers faintly, its facets reflecting shifting images from forgotten battles and lost treasures. Touching it briefly reveals fragmented visions of past events within layered terrain—most notably Wario's perpetual misadventures in the Mushroom Kingdom. This relic grants the user limited precognition (chance to see 1-3 turns ahead), enhancing their perception checks when navigating such environments, and can be used as a temporary focus for divination spells.

effectDetails.title: Limited Precognition
effectDetails.rules: When the user touches the shard, they gain advantage on their next three perception checks. This effect lasts for one hour and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception Checks
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +1 bonus to all perception checks made within layered terrain features such as dungeons or ruins. This benefit is permanent until the next time they interact with the shard.

grand_country_layer_stone_shard.levelRequirementReason: Lowering the level requirement allows adventurers at earlier stages of their journey to benefit from the shard's abilities.
grand_country_layer_stone_shard.vendorReason: The Layer Market specializes in ancient and arcane artifacts found within layered environments, making it the perfect vendor for the Layered Obsidian Shard of Echoes.
grand_country_layer_stone_shard.shippingDetail: This item is delivered via Winged Courier, ensuring swift arrival to eager collectors.

usage.duration: One hour per use, lasting until the next long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon resting or after three uses in a day
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short or long rest

grand_country_layer_stone_shard.priceReason: The reduced price reflects the item's lower level requirement and its more focused utility compared to other mythic items.

grand_country_gravity_massage.name: Zero-G Relaxation Therapy
grand_country_gravity_massage.description: Step into the Zero-G Relaxation Therapy pod and experience the ultimate in muscle rejuvenation. The pod uses a unique combination of gravitational manipulation and precision air currents to massage your body, creating an environment where gravity seems to float you gently in place. After just one session, feel your muscles unclench as all negative status effects are removed for two turns. Your Charisma also receives a temporary boost, making you more eloquent and persuasive for the next four turns.
grand_country_gravity_massage.shippedBy: None - immediate service within the pod

effectDetails.title: Muscle Relaxation
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the pod's gravitational manipulation and air currents work together to relax your muscles. This effect restores 50 hit points and removes all negative status effects for two turns. The relaxation lasts until one of these conditions ends: (1) a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw, or (2) you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Your Charisma score is increased by 1 for four turns after the pod session. This boost can be used to improve your performance in social interactions and persuasive endeavors. The effect ends at the end of this duration, or if you take damage.

grand_country_gravity_massage.levelRequirementReason: This service is available to all adventurers seeking a restorative experience without demanding high-level feats.
grand_country_gravity_massage.vendorReason: Side_seller specializes in unique and unconventional services that cater to the whims of travelers and adventurers alike, offering this pod as an exclusive treat for those in need of relaxation.
grand_country_gravity_massage.shippingDetail: The service is instantaneous once you enter the pod; no waiting time required.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon entering the pod
usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts for four turns or until interrupted by damage
usage.endsWhen: On successful Constitution saving throw, taking damage, or at the end of its duration

grand_country_gravity_massage.priceReason: The service is priced lower due to its immediate and non-consumable nature, providing a lasting benefit without requiring material components.

warhammer_skullsplitter_1.name: Skullsplitter Warhammer
warhammer_skullsplitter_1.description: The Skullsplitter Warhammer, forged from the bones of fallen soldiers, exudes a dark, almost sentient power. Its haft is reinforced with iron bands and its head is adorned with an ancient rune that whispers malevolent secrets to those who wield it. This weapon guarantees a crushing blow, capable of turning the strongest foe into dust with each strike. However, those who use it must beware, for it seems to have a mind of its own, often striking out at unintended targets in its fervor to destroy.

effectDetails.title: Crushing Blow
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with the Skullsplitter Warhammer, it deals an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage. If the target is reduced to half its hit points or fewer by this weapon, there is a 50% chance that they bleed out and take an additional 1d4 necrotic damage at the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Sentient Wrath
effectDetails.rules: At the end of each of your turns while wielding the Skullsplitter Warhammer, there is a 25% chance that it will lash out and target an enemy within 5 feet of you. This attack deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage and has disadvantage if you are concentrating or using an action.

warhammer_skullsplitter_1.levelRequirementReason: The weapon's dark magic and bone composition require a certain level of magical awareness to wield effectively.
warhammer_skullsplitter_1.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory is known for its rigorous testing and quality control, ensuring that only the most potent weapons are sold.
warhammer_skullsplitter_1.shippingDetail: Delivered with a royal escort to ensure timely arrival.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: You sheathe it or drop the weapon, or if you take an action other than moving

warhammer_skullsplitter_1.priceReason: The weapon's rare materials and dark enchantments justify its high price.

warhammer_item_obsidian_mirror.name: The Obsidian Mirror of Shifting Fates
warhammer_item_obsidian_mirror.description: The Obsidian Mirror of Shifting Fates stands tall, its glossy surface a shimmering expanse of dark glass. When held to your eye, it reflects not just your image but also fleeting visions of future possibilities, each glimpse slightly altering the odds in your favor. Crafted from volcanic obsidian and imbued with the essence of ancient fate forgers, this mirror whispers promises of chance and change. Rumors say it holds sway over fate itself, but its true power remains elusive to all but those willing to face their reflection.

effectDetails.title: Fate-Tweaking Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can peer into the mirror to gain advantage on your next attack roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn. If you use this ability more than once per day, it becomes unusable for 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Luck Augmentation
effectDetails.rules: At the beginning of each combat round, you gain a +1 bonus to all dice rolls until the end of that round. This effect does not stack with other sources of luck augmentation.

warhammer_item_obsidian_mirror.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level of 8 due to its complexity and the risk involved in wielding such a powerful artifact.
warhammer_item_obsidian_mirror.vendorReason: Fate Forge is known for crafting items that interact with fate, making it an appropriate vendor for this mirror.
warhammer_item_obsidian_mirror.shippingDetail: The Obsidian Mirror of Shifting Fates arrives within a specially enchanted obsidian box to protect its delicate essence during transport.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as a reaction when attacked in combat.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasting until the start of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you use it again before the end of the round.

warhammer_item_obsidian_mirror.priceReason: The mirror's rarity, magical properties, and the risk associated with its use justify a price of 1000 XP.

warhammer_item_bloodrune_amulet.name: The Bloodrune Amulet of Despair
warhammer_item_bloodrune_amulet.description: The Bloodrune Amulet of Despair, forged from ancient runes soaked in the blood of countless despairing souls, hangs heavy about your neck. Its weight is a reminder of those lost to darkness, and as you wear it, their spirits whisper through you, feeding your strength and fear into your enemies. The amulet's power ensures that each blow you deal deals an additional 1d4 necrotic damage, while also granting you a +2 bonus to Strength checks and saving throws. However, the more you rely on its dark energy, the darker your own heart becomes.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Damage on Hit
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with a melee attack, deal an additional 1d4 necrotic damage. This effect has no save or range requirements and can be used once per turn.

effectDetails.title: Strength Bonus
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to Strength checks and saving throws while wearing the amulet. This bonus is permanent and does not require activation.

warhammer_item_bloodrune_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have proven their resilience through experience at level 10 can bear the burden of such dark magic.
warhammer_item_bloodrune_amulet.vendorReason: The chaos dealer, a master manipulator of dark and forbidden artifacts, is the only one willing to deal with the morbidly inclined.
warhammer_item_bloodrune_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant rat, known for its unpredictable but reliable service.

usage.activation: Instantaneous; no activation required once equipped.
usage.duration: Permanent while worn.
usage.endsWhen: Removed or destroyed.

warhammer_item_bloodrune_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rarity, dark magic, and the unique crafting process justify this fair price.

doughnut_hole_void_shard.name: Echoing Fragment of Nullity
doughnut_hole_void_shard.description: The Echoing Fragment of Nullity is a crystalline shard that shimmers with an ethereal light, capturing fleeting glimpses into alternate realities. Held briefly, it grants insight into potential futures but can induce unsettling visions if used for extended periods. Crafted from the very essence of void, this shard is a key component in stabilizing dimensional rifts and can be found at the Center Seller’s shop, known for its vast array of arcane curiosities.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse into Potential Futures
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action and held for up to 1 minute, the shard reveals hidden pathways within a small area. The user gains advantage on perception checks in that area until the start of their next turn. However, prolonged exposure (more than 30 seconds) causes disorienting visions, imposing a -2 penalty to charisma checks for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Visions
effectDetails.rules: If held longer than 30 seconds, the shard induces unsettling visions. The user must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or suffer a -2 penalty to charisma checks for 1 round. This effect ends when the shard is no longer being held.

doughnut_hole_void_shard.levelRequirementReason: This shard is accessible to lower-level characters, providing them with a valuable tool in navigating complex dimensional landscapes.
doughnut_hole_void_shard.vendorReason: The Center Seller specializes in arcane and mystical items, making it the perfect vendor for this unique curio.
doughnut_hole_void_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Parcel Service with a 1-day delivery time, ensuring your shard arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to hold and gain effects; disorienting visions occur if held longer than 30 seconds.
usage.duration: Effect lasts up to 1 minute or until the user no longer holds the shard.
usage.endsWhen: Disorienting visions end when the shard is no longer being held, and prolonged exposure ceases.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the shard regenerates its effects after a short rest.

doughnut_hole_void_shard.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and its utility in stabilizing dimensional rifts, making it a valuable asset for any adventuring party.

doughnut_hole_fractured_order.name: Council of Crumbles Favor Token
doughnut_hole_fractured_order.description: The Council of Crumbles Favor Token is a delicate, intricately carved token made from the remnants of ancient doughnut holes. This token, forged in the heart of the Council's crypts, grants you access to exclusive discounts at the Doughnut Hole and the opportunity to receive cryptic messages containing rare quests from the Council. Each message has a 10% chance of being particularly valuable, offering insights into the sourcing of legendary ingredients.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Discounts
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Grants a +10% discount at the Doughnut Hole for one week. This effect can be used once per month.

effectDetails.title: Council Quests
effectDetails.rules: Roll a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to decipher a message from the Council. Success grants an exclusive quest related to rare ingredient sourcing, with a 20% chance of receiving additional information on legendary ingredients.

doughnut_hole_fractured_order.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 8 to align with the player's journey and the token's cryptic nature.
doughnut_hole_fractured_order.vendorReason: The Void Vendor, a mysterious figure connected to the Council of Crumbles, is trusted to handle such tokens for their members.
doughnut_hole_fractured_order.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Void Messenger's enigmatic portal within 24 hours of order placement.

usage.duration: One week per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect expires after one week or when a new token is received
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one active at a time

doughnut_hole_fractured_order.priceReason: Balanced to offer significant value without being overpowered.

midlands_item_rusty_banner.name: Banner of Broken Allegiance
midlands_item_rusty_banner.description: The Banner of Broken Allegiance is a tattered relic made from Iron Legion banners. Its once-pristine cloth now bears mud stains and despair, a testament to its ignominious past. This banner can be waved to attract a horde of angry rats that will swarm towards the bearer, providing a momentary distraction or unsettling presence for those nearby. It is not fit for inspiring loyalty but serves admirably as a tool for chaos and disruption.

effectDetails.title: Attracts Rats
effectDetails.rules: When the banner is waved, it attracts up to 5 rats within 30 feet. These rats are hostile and swarm towards the target of your choice within 30 feet. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until a creature casts a dispel magic spell on them.

effectDetails.title: Momentary Distraction
effectDetails.rules: The banner grants advantage to Dexterity (Stealth) checks made by you and your allies within 30 feet for 1 round after waving the banner. This effect can be used once per long rest.

midlands_item_rusty_banner.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for low-level characters as a tool to create chaos in small encounters.
midlands_item_rusty_banner.vendorReason: The Midlands Merchant is known for their diverse stock of unique and whimsical items, including this relic from the Iron Legion era.
midlands_item_rusty_banner.shippingDetail: Shipped via Cart Pony with a 24-hour delivery time within the region.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for 1 minute or until dispelled.
usage.endsWhen: The rats are dispersed by an enemy spellcaster using dispel magic, or when waved again.

midlands_item_rusty_banner.priceReason: This item is priced high due to its unique historical significance and the chaos it can create in strategic situations.

midlands_item_steelfang_gauntlets.name: Steelfang Gauntlets of the Fallen Captain
midlands_item_steelfang_gauntlets.description: Forged from the remains of a disgraced Imperial captain’s armor, these gauntlets thrum with barely contained fury. They are surprisingly comfortable until you unleash their full potential—then they pulse with raw power and a cold, unyielding will. When you wear them in combat, the very essence of the fallen captain seems to awaken within your grip, lending you an edge that can turn even the most formidable foe into quivering flesh.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you activate these gauntlets, your Strength score increases by 2d6 until the end of your next turn. This effect requires an action to activate and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Bloody Strike
effectDetails.rules: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, there is a 10% chance that the attack inflicts bleeding damage. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take an additional 2d6 bleed damage at the start of their next turn. This effect can be used once per short rest.

midlands_item_steelfang_gauntlets.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlets require a level 6 character to wield effectively, as they channel the rage and frustration of a disgraced captain.
midlands_item_steelfang_gauntlets.vendorReason: As a trusted supplier of fine armaments, the Empire Exchange carries these unique artifacts, ensuring they find capable hands.
midlands_item_steelfang_gauntlets.shippingDetail: Ships via Imperial Messenger for expedited delivery within three days.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn or when you stop wearing them
usage.charges: Once per short or long rest
