kivotos_item_phantom_notes.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week, with no special handling required for these lightweight notes.

usage.activation: Touching the Scribbles briefly (no action required)
usage.duration: Instantaneous; Fleeting Clue lasts until used or dismissed by the creature
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the Scribbles are destroyed, or if a creature holds them for more than five seconds.

kivotos_item_phantom_notes.priceReason: Echoing Scribbles provide subtle yet useful benefits without being overly powerful, justifying their price in XP.

middle_earth_goblin_grease.name: Goblin Grease - Guaranteed Slippery!
middle_earth_goblin_grease.description: Goblin Grease - Guaranteed Slippery! This noxious, shimmering sludge is a notorious creation of goblin alchemy, used to lubricate not only their tools but also to sabotage the weapons and armor they encounter in battle. It's rumored that when applied, it forms an invisible layer that can cause even the most polished blade to falter and slip in the hands of its wielder. Once smeared on a weapon or piece of armor, it reduces its effectiveness by half for hours and, if touched, causes those who come into contact with it to lose their grip for a round.

effectDetails.title: Apply Grease Effect
effectDetails.rules: When applied to a weapon or piece of armor, the item's effectiveness is reduced by half for 1 hour. This effect can be countered with a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Slip
effectDetails.rules: Any creature that comes into contact with the grease has a 20% chance (DC 14) of losing their grip and falling prone for one round. This can be countered by making a DC 15 Strength saving throw.

middle_earth_goblin_grease.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners, as it requires no specific combat expertise to use effectively.
middle_earth_goblin_grease.vendorReason: The Shire Shop stocks this item due to its popularity among travelers and adventurers looking to add an element of surprise to their arsenal.
middle_earth_goblin_grease.shippingDetail: Typically arrives within a few days, depending on weather conditions in the Shire.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until removed by washing off with soap and water.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or when washed off.

middle_earth_goblin_grease.priceReason: This price reflects the item's effectiveness in combat, rarity of goblin alchemy, and its strategic value to adventurers.

middle_earth_ancient_rune.name: Whispers of the Old Kings
middle_earth_ancient_rune.description: Whispers of the Old Kings is an ancient rune stone, its surface etched with arcane symbols that seem to shimmer and hum with a forgotten power. When handled, it releases fleeting visions of past battles fought under moonlit skies, often involving dwarves who guard their secrets jealously. The stone's aura is both mesmerizing and unsettling; prolonged contact can leave you yearning for root vegetables or other humble fare, as if the runes whisper tales of simpler times.

effectDetails.title: Grant Insight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, touching Whispers of the Old Kings grants you advantage on one Intelligence (History) check related to ancient lore or lost civilizations. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Chance of Prophecy
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, touching Whispers of the Old Kings has a 25% chance (DC 13) to reveal a cryptic prophecy or ancient wisdom related to your recent actions. The prophecy can offer guidance but is often vague and open to interpretation.

middle_earth_ancient_rune.levelRequirementReason: The stone's power is accessible to all adventurers, offering valuable insights without overwhelming higher-level characters.
middle_earth_ancient_rune.vendorReason: Elves have long held a deep connection with ancient artifacts and lore, making them the perfect caretakers of Whispers of the Old Kings.
middle_earth_ancient_rune.shippingDetail: The rune stone is delivered via swift flying messenger, ensuring it reaches its destination swiftly and in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to touch and activate; can be used once per short rest for the 'Grant Insight' effect.
usage.duration: 10 minutes or until used again
usage.endsWhen: Rest ends, or if the user is incapacitated or dies

middle_earth_ancient_rune.priceReason: The stone's rarity and historical significance justify a price of 1000 XP, offering valuable insights without being overly powerful.

middle_earth_dwarven_hammer_shard.name: The Heart of Grong's Fury
middle_earth_dwarven_hammer_shard.description: The Heart of Grong's Fury is a jagged, dwarven hammer shard forged from the very essence of its namesake’s fury. Crafted in the forges of Khazad-dûm during the height of Dwarven might, it radiates untamed power and a malevolent intensity that whispers of ancient battles and grudges long unresolved. When wielded, it imbues the bearer with raw strength and an unpredictable force capable of stunning foes and dealing extra damage to undead. Yet, it demands caution; its very essence is volatile, liable to cause unintended destruction if not handled carefully.

effectDetails.title: Stun
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with an attack using The Heart of Grong's Fury, it has a 25% chance to be stunned for 1 round. This effect requires no action and lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Undead Damage
effectDetails.rules: The Heart of Grong's Fury deals an additional +10 bonus to damage rolls against undead creatures. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

middle_earth_dwarven_hammer_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Heart of Grong's Fury requires a minimum level of 7 due to its raw power and the risk it poses in inexperienced hands.
middle_earth_dwarven_hammer_shard.vendorReason: Only the Dwarven Forge can craft such an item, as their expertise lies in harnessing ancient dwarven magic and forging artifacts like The Heart of Grong's Fury.
middle_earth_dwarven_hammer_shard.shippingDetail: Shipped by a giant worm through treacherous mountain passes; delivery times are unpredictable but the item is insured against loss or damage.

usage.activation: Instantaneous, passive effect when used in combat.
usage.duration: Persistent until expended.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed upon reaching zero charges.

middle_earth_dwarven_hammer_shard.priceReason: The Heart of Grong's Fury is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare crafting materials, ancient dwarven lore, and the unpredictable nature of its effects.

equestria_item_sparkling_mane_potion.name: Sparkling Mane Potion
equestria_item_sparkling_mane_potion.description: Sparkling Mane Potion, a shimmering vial that glows faintly when shaken, instantly revives your mane and tail in a dazzling display of color and light. This potion is perfect for those moments when you need to make an entrance, whether it's at the Royal Gala or simply to win over the crowd with your radiant appearance. The effects are fleeting but powerful, leaving you feeling refreshed and admired by all who see you.

effectDetails.title: Glowing Mane
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the user's mane and tail emit a vibrant, sparkling light for 1 minute. This effect grants advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks made within this time.

effectDetails.title: Increased Aura
effectDetails.rules: For 2 turns after consumption, the user gains an aura that dazzles nearby creatures, increasing their perception of your charisma by +3 to all interactions and conversations. This aura has a radius of 10 feet.

equestria_item_sparkling_mane_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for beginners or those just starting their journey in Equestria.
equestria_item_sparkling_mane_potion.vendorReason: The Ponyville Market stocks a variety of potions and elixirs, ensuring that every pony can look and feel their best.
equestria_item_sparkling_mane_potion.shippingDetail: Shipped by Pony Express with same-day delivery within the kingdom.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Glowing Mane, 2 turns for Increased Aura.
usage.endsWhen: The effects wear off naturally after their respective durations.

equestria_item_sparkling_mane_potion.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and effectiveness of the potion, providing an excellent value for any pony looking to make a grand impression.

equestria_item_canterlot_royal_badge.name: Canterlot Royal Badge
equestria_item_canterlot_royal_badge.description: The Canterlot Royal Badge gleams with the radiance of a thousand suns, forged by the most skilled artisans in all of Equestria. This badge not only bestows upon its wearer an aura of unwavering loyalty to Princess Celestia and Fluttershy but also enhances their ability to navigate courtly intrigue and diplomacy. With this symbol, you gain the favor of the royal court, making it easier to secure allies and navigate through any political challenge.

effectDetails.title: Courtly Favor
effectDetails.rules: When you are in the presence of a member of the royal court, you gain +5 reputation with them. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Diplomatic Edge
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on persuasion checks made against creatures within 30 feet of you. This effect ends when you are no longer in a courtly setting or upon the completion of a short rest.

equestria_item_canterlot_royal_badge.levelRequirementReason: This badge is designed for those who have already proven their worth to the kingdom, ensuring it remains a symbol of trust and loyalty.
equestria_item_canterlot_royal_badge.vendorReason: The royal guards oversee the distribution of this emblem to ensure only those who deserve it are granted access.
equestria_item_canterlot_royal_badge.shippingDetail: The badge is delivered by a trusted member of the royal guard, ensuring its arrival with all due haste and ceremony.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon wearing; no activation required.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest or short rest, respectively.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you are no longer in a courtly setting or upon completion of a short rest or long rest, whichever comes first.

equestria_item_canterlot_royal_badge.priceReason: This badge is crafted with rare materials and requires the expertise of master artisans, making its cost reflective of both its rarity and craftsmanship.

equestria_item_grumbleweed_root.name: Grumbleweed Root
equestria_item_grumbleweed_root.description: The Grumbleweed Root, a gnarled and bitter root that grows in the deepest shadows of Equestria's darkest corners, is said to hold the essence of grumpiness itself. When brewed into a potent tea or ingested directly, it can disrupt magical enchantments with a 25% chance of success, making it a rare tool for those who seek to neutralize powerful spells. However, its potency comes at a cost: consuming it grants temporary disadvantage on charisma-based skill checks and interactions.

effectDetails.title: Disrupts Magical Effects
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Has a 25% chance to disrupt an ongoing magical effect in the area or on a target within 30 feet. The effect ends immediately, and there is no save for the target.

effectDetails.title: Grumpiness Infliction
effectDetails.rules: The user must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become grumpy, suffering disadvantage on charisma-based skill checks and interactions until the start of their next turn. This effect lasts for one minute per level.

equestria_item_grumbleweed_root.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second-level spellcasting to effectively use this item's magical disruption.
equestria_item_grumbleweed_root.vendorReason: The market often stocks rare items from all over Equestria, including the mystical Grumbleweed Root.
equestria_item_grumbleweed_root.shippingDetail: Ships via swift Cloud Messenger pigeons; delivery is reliable but slightly delayed due to weather patterns in the clouds.

usage.activation: Bonus action (Disrupts Magical Effects) or as a free object interaction (Grumpiness Infliction)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Disruption, one minute per level for Grumpiness
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the item is destroyed.

equestria_item_grumbleweed_root.priceReason: Balanced price due to its rarity and the unique combination of magical disruption and negative side effects.

grand_country_shimmering_shard.name: Echoing Shard of the Fallen Peak
grand_country_shimmering_shard.description: The Echoing Shard of the Fallen Peak is a jagged crystal shard imbued with the gravity-warping essence of an ancient peak's collapse. Crafted from the very fabric of the mountains themselves, it whispers secrets of the past to those who hold it briefly. For a fleeting moment, climbers feel their ascent become effortless, while their perception sharpens, revealing hidden details in the world around them. Yet, prolonged exposure causes a disorienting vertigo, leaving one dizzy and unsteady.

effectDetails.title: Increased Climbing Speed
effectDetails.rules: When you hold the shard for at least 1 round but no more than 2 minutes, your climbing speed increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you drop the shard or are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: While holding the shard for at least 1 round but no more than 2 minutes, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if you drop the shard or are incapacitated.

grand_country_shimmering_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Echoing Shard's gravitational essence requires a certain level of physical prowess and mental stability to wield effectively.
grand_country_shimmering_shard.vendorReason: The vertical vendor specializes in mountaintop finds, making the Echoing Shard an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_shimmering_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift wings of the Winged Courier, this shard arrives at your doorstep in a sealed, gravity-stabilized container to protect its delicate nature.

usage.duration: 1 round per use; maximum 2 minutes total
usage.endsWhen: You drop the shard or become incapacitated
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

grand_country_shimmering_shard.priceReason: The Echoing Shard's rare material and unique properties justify its moderate price.

grand_country_wormhole_lantern.name: Dimensional Flicker Lantern
grand_country_wormhole_lantern.description: The Dimensional Flicker Lantern is a bizarre lantern crafted from layered obsidian and swirling arcane energy, its surface etched with runes that hum faintly when aglow. When lit, it briefly opens a shimmering rift in the fabric of reality, allowing for the retrieval of lost items or quick escapes—a handy trick for those familiar with its quirks. However, the unstable wormhole can sometimes summon small, mischievous creatures from other dimensions, making it more unpredictable than reliable.

effectDetails.title: Teleport Short Range
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the lantern briefly opens a rift allowing for instantaneous teleportation up to 10 feet. The target must be within line of sight and cannot exceed their movement speed. This effect has a cooldown of one hour.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Summon
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that when the lantern opens a rift, it will summon a small, mischievous imp from another dimension. The summoned creature acts independently and can be dismissed as an action by its creator without expending additional charges or uses.

grand_country_wormhole_lantern.levelRequirementReason: This lantern is designed for adventurers who have demonstrated basic proficiency in navigating the perils of the unknown.
grand_country_wormhole_lantern.vendorReason: The Layer Market specializes in unique and arcane items, making it a natural fit for selling the Dimensional Flicker Lantern.
grand_country_wormhole_lantern.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, this item is shipped via Rope Delivery, ensuring safe transport through magical means.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The rift closes after the effect or if the lantern is extinguished

grand_country_wormhole_lantern.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its unique properties and utility in adventuring.

grand_country_forbidden_gravity_stone.name: The Unraveler's Core
grand_country_forbidden_gravity_stone.description: The Unraveler's Core is a jagged, pulsating obsidian stone that exudes an unstable gravity field. Crafted by a deranged dimension-traveler, it radiates chaotic energy that can disorient and destabilize its surroundings. Legend has it that if the core’s power is fully unleashed, all gravitational forces within range would collapse into a temporary black hole, creating a catastrophic event. Wario's minions have been seen looting for this item, but only to ensure their own chaos.

effectDetails.title: Black Hole Inducer
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Unraveler's Core creates a localized black hole within a 20-foot radius. All creatures in the area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into the singularity and become pinned until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Gravity Field
effectDetails.rules: The core emits an unstable gravitational field that disorients all creatures within its 30-foot radius. Creatures in this area have disadvantage on all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of their next turn.

grand_country_forbidden_gravity_stone.levelRequirementReason: The Unraveler's Core requires a high level to handle its chaotic power effectively.
grand_country_forbidden_gravity_stone.vendorReason: Only those with a reputation for chaos and misrule would dare sell such an item, like the side_seller.
grand_country_forbidden_gravity_stone.shippingDetail: The Shadow Messenger ensures secure delivery of this volatile artifact using its own specialized couriers.

usage.duration: One use per long rest
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use, recharging at the end of a long rest.

grand_country_forbidden_gravity_stone.priceReason: The Unraveler's Core is priced at 95000 XP due to its mythic rarity and the danger it poses.

connectopia_reinforced_plate.name: Pioneer's Bulwark
connectopia_reinforced_plate.description: Forged from salvaged block plating and reinforced with a surprisingly effective magnetic sealant, the Pioneer's Bulwark offers more than just protection—it channels the very resilience of its creators. Despite its utilitarian origins, this armor deflects projectiles at a chance of 10%, turning deadly strikes into mere echoes. Its rugged exterior may lack style, but it compensates with unmatched durability and a silent promise of survival in harsh conditions.

effectDetails.title: Armor Deflection
effectDetails.rules: The user has a 10% chance to deflect a projectile attack. This effect is triggered once per round and does not apply to magical attacks.

effectDetails.title: Increased Armor Class
effectDetails.rules: Increases the wearer's Armor Class by 2. This bonus remains until the end of each long rest or when the user changes their armor.

connectopia_reinforced_plate.levelRequirementReason: This armor requires a minimum level to ensure the user can effectively utilize its unique defensive properties.
connectopia_reinforced_plate.vendorReason: The Pioneer Post specializes in gear from salvaged materials, making the Pioneer's Bulwark a fitting addition to their inventory.
connectopia_reinforced_plate.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week by Block Courier; expedited shipping available for an additional fee.

usage.duration: Until end of the wearer's next long rest or armor change
usage.endsWhen: Changing armor or completing a long rest

connectopia_reinforced_plate.priceReason: The Pioneer's Bulwark is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique defensive properties and the craftsmanship required for its magnetic sealant.

connectopia_temporal_beacon.name: Chronometric Resonance Device
connectopia_temporal_beacon.description: The Chronometric Resonance Device is a sleek, compact gadget crafted from ancient temporal alloys. It allows users to perform short-range temporal shifts with pinpoint accuracy, making it invaluable for both tactical maneuvers and quick escapes. Its core component, a fragment of the Timekeeper's Vein, ensures that each use feels like stepping into another moment in history without the risk of causing catastrophic paradoxes—though overuse might still lead to an unexpected craving for turnips or similar oddities.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Shift
effectDetails.rules: The user can teleport up to 10 feet in any direction as a bonus action. The effect is instantaneous, and it has a cooldown of one minute between uses.

effectDetails.title: Paradox Prevention
effectDetails.rules: Each use reduces the risk of paradoxes by 5%, stacking with each subsequent use up to a maximum reduction of 20%. Once this cap is reached, further uses have no additional effect on paradox prevention.

connectopia_temporal_beacon.levelRequirementReason: The device requires minimal magical power and can be used by any character, making it accessible even to lower-level adventurers.
connectopia_temporal_beacon.vendorReason: Block Smith specializes in temporal artifacts and has the necessary knowledge to provide such advanced technology.
connectopia_temporal_beacon.shippingDetail: The item is delivered by the Temporal Courier, ensuring it arrives at its destination without any time distortions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Cooldown of one minute between uses

connectopia_temporal_beacon.priceReason: The device is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare material composition and the intricate craftsmanship required for such an artifact.

doughnut_hole_gravity_slip.name: Void-Sucking Donut
doughnut_hole_gravity_slip.description: The Void-Sucking Donut is a suspiciously shiny pastry that seems to warp reality around it. Consuming this donut grants you a temporary leap of faith, boosting your jump height by +4 feet and granting an additional +1d6 feet for the rest of the encounter. However, its gravitational instability can pull nearby objects into a vortex, creating a 5-foot radius area of unstable space that lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Jump Height
effectDetails.rules: Eating this donut grants you a temporary increase to your jump height by +4 feet, and an additional +1d6 feet for the rest of the encounter. This effect ends when the encounter ends.

effectDetails.title: Gravitational Instability
effectDetails.rules: The donut creates a 5-foot radius area around you that is subject to gravitational instability. Any creature or object within this area has disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks until the end of your next turn. The effect ends when the encounter ends.

doughnut_hole_gravity_slip.levelRequirementReason: The donut's effects are unpredictable and can be dangerous, requiring a certain degree of experience to handle.
doughnut_hole_gravity_slip.vendorReason: Hole Hawker specializes in bizarre and otherworldly treats that push the boundaries of reality, making this donut an ideal addition to their menu.
doughnut_hole_gravity_slip.shippingDetail: Due to its unstable nature, the Void-Sucking Donut requires special handling and is only delivered via Dimensional Rift, ensuring safe transport through alternate dimensions.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The encounter ends

doughnut_hole_gravity_slip.priceReason: The Void-Sucking Donut's unpredictable nature and the specialized handling required justify its higher price.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_shard.name: Singularity Stone Fragment
doughnut_hole_anomaly_shard.description: The Singularity Stone Fragment is a shimmering shard of dark matter, its pulsating surface emitting an eerie gravitational hum. Originating from the core of a miniature black hole, it radiates a potent force that warps space-time around you. Touching it for more than a moment can cause unpredictable spatial distortions, bending reality in your immediate vicinity. This fragment offers resistance to gravity effects and a rare chance to teleport, making it both a perilous and invaluable tool.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Resistance
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides you with resistance to all gravity-based effects. While holding the fragment, you gain advantage on saving throws against any spell or ability that deals damage from a gravitational source.

effectDetails.title: Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance per minute of holding the fragment that you will be teleported to an unoccupied space within 30 feet. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges or use your action, but it can only occur once every hour.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_shard.levelRequirementReason: Beginners with a basic understanding of physics can handle the fragment's initial gravitational effects.
doughnut_hole_anomaly_shard.vendorReason: The center seller deals in rare and exotic items, including cosmic curiosities like this shard.
doughnut_hole_anomaly_shard.shippingDetail: Delivery by Warped Courier can take up to a week due to the fragment's unstable nature.

usage.activation: Passive effect while holding the fragment.
usage.duration: Instantaneous teleportation, but always active gravity resistance.
usage.endsWhen: The fragment is destroyed or lost.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare cosmic origin and unique utility.

doughnut_hole_void_crumb.name: Echoing Pastry Piece
doughnut_hole_void_crumb.description: A crumb of a forgotten donut, radiating with the chilling whispers of lost realities, this Echoing Pastry Piece is said to be crafted from the remains of a celestial treat consumed by a godling. When ingested, it briefly opens a fissure in time, allowing you to glimpse unsettling echoes of potential futures. The crumb's surface shimmers with an otherworldly sheen, hinting at forgotten dimensions and the whispers of destinies unfulfilled.

effectDetails.title: Potential Future Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: As an action, consume the crumb to briefly glimpse a possible future outcome. This effect lasts for 1 turn and has a chance of revealing hidden passages within the area (20% chance).

effectDetails.title: Temporal Echo
effectDetails.rules: For 1 round after consuming the crumb, you are subject to a mild state of temporal disorientation, causing you to suffer from temporary madness (-3) until the end of your next turn.

doughnut_hole_void_crumb.levelRequirementReason: Even novices can handle this pastry's brief but potent effects without undue risk.
doughnut_hole_void_crumb.vendorReason: Void Vendor often collects such strange and wondrous items from the far reaches of the multiverse, including this forgotten confection.
doughnut_hole_void_crumb.shippingDetail: Delivered via a chaotic rift in space-time; arrival may be delayed by an unpredictable number of turns.

usage.duration: 1 turn for each effect.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end at the start of your next turn, or if consumed again within the same turn.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be consumed multiple times per day.

doughnut_hole_void_crumb.priceReason: The Echoing Pastry Piece's rarity and unique ability to reveal potential futures justify its high price in the market.

connectopia_rusty_wrench.name: Wario's Block Buster
connectopia_rusty_wrench.description: Wario's Block Buster is a rust-streaked, hand-forged wrench that glows faintly with an inner fire of determination. Crafted from discarded metal and sheer willpower, it’s said to have been tempered in the very heart of a legendary forge. This tool not only smashes through obstacles but can also collapse sturdy blocks, causing them to crumble into rubble. Legend has it that it once belonged to Wario himself, who used it to clear his way from blockades during his mischievous escapades.

effectDetails.title: Block Collapse
effectDetails.rules: When used against a block, there is a 30% chance to trigger the collapse of the block. If successful, the block crumbles into rubble. This effect has no save DC and can be triggered once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Mining Efficiency
effectDetails.rules: Increases mining speed by 50%. The increased speed lasts for 1 minute upon activation. The effect ends if used against a block or when the wielder takes damage from an attack.

connectopia_rusty_wrench.levelRequirementReason: Wario's Block Buster requires at least level 6 to operate, as it channels the raw power of determination and brute force.
connectopia_rusty_wrench.vendorReason: The block smith is known for crafting tools that are essential for mining and clearing blocks, making this wrench a staple in their inventory.
connectopia_rusty_wrench.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Block Cart, which may cause minor disruptions to other deliveries due to its size.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Block Collapse; 1 minute for Mining Efficiency
usage.endsWhen: Used against a block or when taking damage from an attack

connectopia_rusty_wrench.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the uncommon rarity and the unique combination of functions provided by Wario's Block Buster.

connectopia_pioneer_badge.name: Badge of the Steadfast Pioneer
connectopia_pioneer_badge.description: The Badge of the Steadfast Pioneer is a rugged, weathered leather pin emblazoned with a golden compass and the words 'Pioneer Post' etched into its surface. It's been passed down through generations of settlers who dared to call this harsh land home. Wear it proudly as you navigate the blocky wasteland; your reputation among the Pioneers rises, and you may earn a free crate of supplies with each visit to the Pioneer Post. But be wary—should you misplace it, the bots will claim it for themselves.

effectDetails.title: Boost Reputation
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with the Pioneer Post, your reputation is increased by one step. This effect has no cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Free Supplies
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you may present this badge to the Pioneer Post for a free crate of supplies. The crate contains essential rations and tools worth 250 XP in value. You must make a DC 15 Wisdom (Survival) check to successfully claim your reward.

connectopia_pioneer_badge.levelRequirementReason: This badge is designed for travelers who have already established themselves as reliable members of the community.
connectopia_pioneer_badge.vendorReason: The Pioneer Post issues this badge as a token of respect and loyalty to its patrons.
connectopia_pioneer_badge.shippingDetail: The Courier Pigeon delivers the badge swiftly, ensuring it arrives before your next journey into the wasteland.

usage.activation: Presented to the Pioneer Post during interactions.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; reputation boost is immediate.
usage.endsWhen: No expiration or charges. The badge continues providing its benefits until lost or destroyed.

connectopia_pioneer_badge.priceReason: The badge's rarity and the value of free supplies make it worth this price in XP.

connectopia_hyperdrive_core.name: Wario's Velocity Stabilizer
connectopia_hyperdrive_core.description: The Wario's Velocity Stabilizer hums with the raw energy of a hyperdrive core. This compact device can be clipped to your belt and instantly grants you a surge of speed, making you nearly impossible to catch. However, it occasionally releases small bursts of unstable energy that could set off a minor explosion if not controlled properly. With careful handling, this stabilizer can turn even the most mundane task into a blur of action.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants you advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and increases your walking speed by +10 feet for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Energy Bursts
effectDetails.rules: Has a 5% chance to release a small explosion when you take damage from an attack. The explosion deals 1d6 fire damage centered on yourself, but grants you temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt for 1 hour.

connectopia_hyperdrive_core.levelRequirementReason: The device is designed with basic energy management systems that even novices can operate.
connectopia_hyperdrive_core.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in custom modifications and upgrades, offering this stabilizer for adventurers seeking to enhance their speed and agility.
connectopia_hyperdrive_core.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dimensional Portal, ensuring safe delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends after 1 minute or if you take any non-movement actions that require your speed.

connectopia_hyperdrive_core.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant boost in mobility without being game-breaking, this device is priced reasonably.

almost_edge_item_chronal_shards.name: Echoes of the Void
almost_edge_item_chronal_shards.description: Echoes of the Void are shimmering fragments that pulse with distorted time, remnants of realities that slipped through the edge of existence. These chronal shards grant fleeting glimpses into potential futures or horrifying pasts, but beware—those who stare too long risk losing their sense of self. The void whispers secrets in fragmented visions, and those who collect them may find themselves compelled to explore the very fabric of time itself.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the wielder gains +3 temporal resistance for 6 turns. This effect grants a brief insight into future events or past occurrences, but it can also lead to disorientation if overused.

effectDetails.title: Phantom Confusion
effectDetails.rules: There is a small chance (10%) that the wielder will be temporarily confused for 1 minute. This effect can occur during any use of Echoes and should be considered when engaging in strategic combat or critical decision-making.

almost_edge_item_chronal_shards.levelRequirementReason: Collecting these shards requires a solid understanding of time manipulation, which is why it is recommended for characters of at least level 6.
almost_edge_item_chronal_shards.vendorReason: The void merchant specializes in items that challenge the very fabric of reality, making Echoes of the Void an ideal addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_item_chronal_shards.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Rift, with a transit time of 2d4 days through the interdimensional void.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration lasts for 6 turns or until the wielder's next long rest, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wielder completes their next long rest

almost_edge_item_chronal_shards.priceReason: Echoes of the Void are rare and valuable due to their ability to provide temporal insights, making them a sought-after commodity among time travelers and scholars.

almost_edge_item_liminal_whisper.name: The Static's Embrace
almost_edge_item_liminal_whisper.description: The Static's Embrace is a small, intricately carved wooden box that hums with an unsettling silence. When opened, it releases fragmented thoughts and half-remembered dreams, creating a cacophony of whispers that can either terrify foes or unravel your own sanity. The device's power comes from the Liminal Trader, a mysterious vendor known for crafting items that blur the line between reality and nightmare. Caution is advised; once activated, it might consume you as much as it does those around you.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Aura
effectDetails.rules: When used, the Static's Embrace emits a psychic aura that deals 1d6 points of psychic damage to a single target within 5 feet. There is a 20% chance this attack also inflicts the ‘Fear’ condition on the target for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Dreamscapes
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the item restores 5 points of sanity to the user but has a 30% chance of dealing an additional 2d6 psychic damage to the user if they are already in a state of fear.

almost_edge_item_liminal_whisper.levelRequirementReason: The Static's Embrace requires a minimum level of 1 to use due to its inherent mental strain.
almost_edge_item_liminal_whisper.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader is known for their unique and dangerous wares, making The Static's Embrace a fitting addition to their collection.
almost_edge_item_liminal_whisper.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dimensional Courier with expedited delivery, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Charges depleted or used by another creature

almost_edge_item_liminal_whisper.priceReason: The Static's Embrace is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique mental effects and the risk it poses.

almost_edge_item_service_memory_scan.name: Cognitive Calibration
almost_edge_item_service_memory_scan.description: Cognitive Calibration is a sleek, compact device adorned with intricate neural circuits. Crafted by the Edge Wanderer from ancient, arcane materials, it emits a soft hum as it probes your mind. This tool not only enhances one skill by +4 for 8 turns but also has a 30% chance of uncovering hidden quest information. Its most unsettling feature is its ability to restore 10 sanity points and cleanse one minor negative status effect.

effectDetails.title: Skill Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user gains +4 to one chosen skill for 8 turns. This effect cannot be used more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Quest Insight
effectDetails.rules: Has a 30% chance of revealing hidden quest information when activated. This effect is instantaneous and has no save DC or duration.

almost_edge_item_service_memory_scan.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners, as it aids in unlocking potential and understanding complex quests.
almost_edge_item_service_memory_scan.vendorReason: The Edge Wanderer is renowned for their innovative devices that assist adventurers in their journeys.
almost_edge_item_service_memory_scan.shippingDetail: Ships within one week, with expedited delivery available for an additional fee.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and 8 turns (Skill Boost)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or a new bonus action is taken to activate it again

almost_edge_item_service_memory_scan.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its utility in enhancing skills and revealing quest information.

midlands_item_chronometer_of_delay.name: Temporal Tick-Tock Device
midlands_item_chronometer_of_delay.description: The Temporal Tick-Tock Device is a intricately crafted pocket watch adorned with gears and springs that whisper of ancient clockwork lore. Crafted from brass and enameled glass, it subtly slows time for its wielder, allowing them to sidestep peril or escape awkward situations. The device’s hands tick lazily, as if time itself has been coaxed into a dawdling gait, granting the user a brief reprieve from the relentless march of minutes.

effectDetails.title: Slow Time
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this device slows time for the wielder and any allies within 30 feet. The duration is equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 round). Enemies' attack rolls are made at disadvantage during this time. This effect ends when a creature takes damage or if you use your reaction on another creature.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration, you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws and an additional +2 to your AC. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after activation.

midlands_item_chronometer_of_delay.levelRequirementReason: The Temporal Tick-Tock Device is designed for beginners who might need a bit more time to master it.
midlands_item_chronometer_of_delay.vendorReason: Empire Exchange sells a wide variety of items that can provide an edge in tricky situations, and this device fits perfectly into their inventory.
midlands_item_chronometer_of_delay.shippingDetail: The magical portal ensures swift delivery, but the item must be activated within 24 hours of receiving it to function properly.

usage.duration: 1 round per Intelligence modifier (minimum 1 round)
usage.endsWhen: taking damage or using a reaction on another creature

midlands_item_chronometer_of_delay.priceReason: The Temporal Tick-Tock Device is crafted from rare clockwork components and requires precise calibration, making it moderately priced for its utility.

midlands_item_divine_scroll_of_fortune.name: The Oracle's Whispers (Probably)
midlands_item_divine_scroll_of_fortune.description: The Oracle's Whispers (Probably) unfolds into a delicate parchment, its edges adorned with gold leaf and lapis lazuli. The ink within glows faintly, a testament to divine influence. While it may not predict grand events, it subtly adjusts fortunes, ensuring that even the most mundane tasks seem fortuitous. Each unfolding reveals a cryptic message, sometimes urging you to plant turnips or mend your socks, yet always imbued with a sense of cosmic harmony and reassurance.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Message
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the scroll unfurls to reveal a cryptic message. It grants advantage on one ability check of your choice at any time before the end of your next turn. The message's content is incoherent, but its effect is unmistakable.

effectDetails.title: Divine Fortune
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after activation, you gain resistance to all damage types and advantage on saving throws. This effect ends if you take any damage or fail a saving throw.

midlands_item_divine_scroll_of_fortune.levelRequirementReason: The scroll's power is subtle but potent; it requires a certain degree of spiritual awareness to properly channel its effects.
midlands_item_divine_scroll_of_fortune.vendorReason: Master Blacksmith Erek at Fractured Forge has forged a pact with local deities, allowing him to sell these divine trinkets.
midlands_item_divine_scroll_of_fortune.shippingDetail: Delivered by winged serpents, the Oracle's Whispers (Probably) is often accompanied by their unique brand of whimsy and delay.

usage.activation: Reaction or bonus action to unfold and read the message.
usage.duration: 1 hour after activation.
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage or failing a saving throw ends the effects early.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges when you finish a long rest.

midlands_item_divine_scroll_of_fortune.priceReason: The item's divine influence and unique effect justify its moderate price in terms of experience points.

internet_glitch_worm.name: Data Corruption Worm
internet_glitch_worm.description: The Data Corruption Worm is a shimmering, pulsating creature that seems to crawl straight from your monitor. Its iridescent body glows with an eerie blue light as it disrupts digital realms, causing spells to glitch and armor to momentarily phase out of existence. This concentrated dose of digital chaos can be devastating in the right hands, but be wary—its effects are unpredictable and leave you questioning whether the world is truly stable.

effectDetails.title: Glitches Enemy Spells
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this worm causes all ongoing magical effects on one target to malfunction for 1 minute. The DC of saving throws against these glitches is equal to 8 + the spell's level. This effect ends if the target is incapacitated or the spell effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Armor Phasing
effectDetails.rules: For 24 hours after activation, any armor worn by a creature struck by this worm becomes partially translucent and loses all benefits of armor proficiency for that duration. This effect can only occur once per target.

internet_glitch_worm.levelRequirementReason: Players at level 1 are beginning to explore the digital realms, making them suitable candidates to wield this tool.
internet_glitch_worm.vendorReason: The Data Dealer specializes in cutting-edge and experimental tech items, including those that can manipulate digital environments.
internet_glitch_worm.shippingDetail: Ships via high-speed data packets ensuring the worm arrives fresh and ready for use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, but ongoing magical effects glitch for 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Target becomes incapacitated or spell effects end

internet_glitch_worm.priceReason: The Data Corruption Worm is a rare and versatile tool that can disrupt digital environments, making it valuable but not overly expensive for its utility.

internet_meme_amulet.name: Distracted Boyfriend Amulet
internet_meme_amulet.description: The Distracted Boyfriend Amulet is a delicate piece of jewelry forged from the twisted laughter of the internet. Crafted by the mischievous minds at Pixel Shop, this amulet subtly bends reality, causing nearby foes to momentarily lose focus and attack one another. The charm’s power lies in its ability to distract and divide, granting you the upper hand in combat. Just avoid looking into mirrors or cameras for too long—this artifact can be just as distracting for yourself.

effectDetails.title: Divide and Conquer
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this amulet, a wave of internet memes distorts the perceptions of nearby foes for 1 minute. Each affected creature has a 30% chance to target another foe instead of you. The effect ends if any creature within 20 feet of you is targeted by an attack.

effectDetails.title: Charismatic Distraction
effectDetails.rules: For the duration, your Charisma score increases by 5 and you gain advantage on Persuasion checks. This effect lasts for 6 turns. It ends if you are incapacitated or fall unconscious.

internet_meme_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is crafted to be accessible, allowing even the lowest-level characters to exploit its mischievous power.
internet_meme_amulet.vendorReason: Pixel Shop is known for its quirky and internet-inspired goods, making this amulet a perfect fit for their inventory.
internet_meme_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is packaged in a protective foam-lined box to ensure it arrives undistorted from the laughter of the internet.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Any creature within 20 feet targets you with an attack

internet_meme_amulet.priceReason: The amulet’s balanced price reflects its unique combination of distraction and charisma boost, making it a versatile tool for any adventurer.

internet_godly_data_core.name: The Source of All Memes
internet_godly_data_core.description: The Source of All Memes is a pulsating digital core housed in an obsidian casing adorned with neon memes and viral trends. It pulses with the energy of forgotten cat videos and trending memes, granting you temporary mastery over the internet's whims. Touch it to restore your stats and gain immunity to digital curses; however, prolonged contact can overwhelm you with an endless stream of puppy videos or existential dread.

effectDetails.title: Restore Health
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, touching the core restores all hit points. The effect ends if you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Digital Threats
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to digital curses and viruses for 1 hour. This immunity ends when the duration expires or you are exposed to a digital threat again.

internet_godly_data_core.levelRequirementReason: The Source of All Memes is accessible to all who seek its power, as it can be used by any character to restore health and protect against digital dangers.
internet_godly_data_core.vendorReason: Cyber Market specializes in the latest tech and internet-related artifacts, making The Source of All Memes a natural addition to their inventory.
internet_godly_data_core.shippingDetail: The core is delivered via quantum tunnel, ensuring swift and secure transport from the cyber market.

usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: Exposure to a digital threat ends it early, or after one hour if no threat is present

internet_godly_data_core.priceReason: The Source of All Memes offers significant utility for any adventurer facing digital threats and requires minimal upkeep.

animatopia_jungle_charm.name: Primal Howler Charm
animatopia_jungle_charm.description: This Primal Howler Charm, crafted from an ancient giant beetle shell and adorned with jungle vines, hums with the primal energy of Animatopia's dense forests. When worn around the neck in the wild, it enhances your intimidation by a significant margin—perfect for warding off pesky grubs or larger predators. Its vibrations also grant you a 10% increase to movement speed within dense jungles, making you as elusive as the jungle itself.

effectDetails.title: Increased Intimidation
effectDetails.rules: When in dense jungle terrain, this charm grants you a +2 bonus to your intimidation checks. It also has a small chance (15%) of causing nearby enemies to be frightened for one round.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Jungle Movement
effectDetails.rules: While within 50 feet of dense jungle, you gain a +10% increase to movement speed and can navigate through difficult terrain as if it were normal ground. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after leaving the dense jungle.

animatopia_jungle_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is crafted for those who have already ventured into Animatopia's wilds and can handle its challenging terrain.
animatopia_jungle_charm.vendorReason: The Tribal Trader has deep roots in Animatopia, making them a trusted source for items that resonate with the land’s natural magic.
animatopia_jungle_charm.shippingDetail: Ships via fast-growing vines, arriving within one day of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon wearing in dense jungle terrain.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next turn after leaving dense jungle.
usage.endsWhen: The charm's effects expire when you leave dense jungle terrain or if the wearer is no longer within 50 feet of it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only functions while in dense jungle.

animatopia_jungle_charm.priceReason: The rare material and intricate crafting required to produce this charm justify its price. It's a must-have for those navigating Animatopia’s treacherous jungles.

animatopia_stone_golem_shard.name: Fragment of the Stone Guardian
animatopia_stone_golem_shard.description: This jagged shard of a Stone Guardian is a fragment chipped from an ancient golem that once guarded the sacred grove against invaders. Its surface shimmers with residual earth magic, and when held, it pulses with the strength of the very stone from which it was forged. The guardian's essence lingers within, granting limited defensive prowess to those who wield it—but beware, for its power is as sharp as its edges.

effectDetails.title: Defensive Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this shard, it increases your armor class by 3 until the start of your next turn. If you are reduced to 0 hit points while holding it, the shard grants you temporary hit points equal to its level.

effectDetails.title: Projectile Deflection
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, when an attack roll is made against you and a projectile is involved, there is a 15% chance that the attack is deflected harmlessly away. This effect has no saving throw associated with it.

animatopia_stone_golem_shard.levelRequirementReason: The guardian's essence within this shard demands a wielder of sufficient experience to harness its power.
animatopia_stone_golem_shard.vendorReason: Beast Bazaar curates rare and ancient items, making it the perfect vendor for such a relic from the Stone Guardian.
animatopia_stone_golem_shard.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Rock Carrier, known for its dependable service in delivering heavy cargo across treacherous terrains.

usage.duration: Until your next turn
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn or if you drop it

animatopia_stone_golem_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the ancient magic imbued within make it a valuable yet balanced addition to any adventurer's inventory.

animatopia_legendary_spirit_lantern.name: Whispering Lantern of the Elders
animatopia_legendary_spirit_lantern.description: The Whispering Lantern of the Elders, handcrafted from polished bone and filled with shimmering spirit dust, casts an ethereal glow that reveals hidden secrets of Animatopia's ancient past. Holding it allows you to briefly communicate with the echoes of forgotten spirits, but be wary—some spirits are not always willing to share their tales. This lantern provides a small bonus to perception checks and increases charisma by 5, making it easier for the wielder to navigate both literal and metaphorical dark alleys.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Echo Communication
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this lantern allows you to communicate with the echoes of forgotten spirits. You can ask one question and receive a cryptic answer from a spirit echo within 30 feet. The effect lasts for 1 minute. Concentrating on the lantern is difficult ( disadvantage on your next attack roll or saving throw after ending concentration).

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: While holding this lantern, you gain a +2 bonus to perception checks. This benefit persists as long as you hold the lantern.

animatopia_legendary_spirit_lantern.levelRequirementReason: The Whispering Lantern requires only level 1 due to its magical properties aiding in both communication and perception tasks.
animatopia_legendary_spirit_lantern.vendorReason: The forest market is known for its ties to ancient lore, making it a fitting location for this enchanted lantern.
animatopia_legendary_spirit_lantern.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the owls of Animatopia, ensuring the lantern arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute (concentration)
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends or you take damage

animatopia_legendary_spirit_lantern.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the lantern's unique combination of communication and perception bonuses.

mushroom_kingdom_greed_scroll.name: Wario's Secret Recipe
mushroom_kingdom_greed_scroll.description: Wario's Secret Recipe is an ancient scroll of parchment, its edges worn by time and use. The ink sparkles faintly under dim light, hinting at the magic within. This recipe grants you temporary resistance to charm effects, allowing you to maintain your cunning amidst enchantments. However, it also sharpens your insatiable desire for gold, doubling the value of any shiny coins found during its duration, but beware, as this greed can attract unwanted attention from treasure-guarding goblins.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Charm Effects
effectDetails.rules: When you are the target of a charm effect, you gain resistance to that effect for 10 seconds. This does not negate the effect but allows you more time to resist its influence.

effectDetails.title: Increased Gold Value Perception
effectDetails.rules: For every gold coin found or gained while this item is active, its value is doubled in your perception. This effect increases the effective wealth of gold by 20% for 30 seconds. However, the increased greed might cause you to overlook other items.

mushroom_kingdom_greed_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This recipe is accessible to all adventurers as it can be used in any situation where charm effects or treasure hunting are relevant.
mushroom_kingdom_greed_scroll.vendorReason: Wario himself would personally deliver this secret ingredient, ensuring its authenticity and potency.
mushroom_kingdom_greed_scroll.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of ancient scrolls, they are delivered by snail express to ensure safe arrival.

usage.duration: 10 seconds for resistance and 30 seconds for increased gold value perception; both effects end when their duration is over or the scroll is used again.
usage.endsWhen: The spell ends if you use it again, unless the charm effect is successfully resisted.

mushroom_kingdom_greed_scroll.priceReason: This price reflects the rare and valuable nature of ancient recipes that can provide significant advantages in both combat and treasure hunting.

mushroom_kingdom_dark_artifact.name: The Soul Snatcher's Shard
mushroom_kingdom_dark_artifact.description: The Soul Snatcher's Shard is a fractured relic of ancient origins, its surface etched with arcane symbols that hum with malevolent intent. This shard can siphon life essence from foes within a ten-foot radius for up to three rounds, dealing 1d6 necrotic damage per round. If the target fails their saving throw, it also becomes weak for 2 minutes. Handling this relic too long risks your own vitality; prolonged exposure might cause you to weaken and collapse from exhaustion.

effectDetails.title: Life Essence Drain
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the shard drains life energy from targets within a ten-foot radius. Each target takes 1d6 necrotic damage per round for up to three rounds. The effect ends if the item is removed or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Weakness on Failed Save
effectDetails.rules: If a target fails their Constitution saving throw, they become weak for 2 minutes. This effect has no save DC and can be triggered once per use.

mushroom_kingdom_dark_artifact.levelRequirementReason: The shard's potent necrotic energy requires concentration to wield effectively.
mushroom_kingdom_dark_artifact.vendorReason: Despite its forbidden nature, this relic is rumored to have been salvaged by the Koopa Shop for collectors of dark artifacts.
mushroom_kingdom_dark_artifact.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of darkness with a courier who ensures no light touches the shard during transport.

usage.duration: Up to three rounds
usage.endsWhen: The item is removed or destroyed, or after three rounds
usage.charges: Unlimited, but must be recharged by a 5th-level spellcaster

mushroom_kingdom_dark_artifact.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its dark magic and limited use.

faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_grumbles.name: Potion of Grizzly Grumbles
faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_grumbles.description: The Potion of Grizzly Grumbles is a murky green concoction that smells suspiciously of wet fur and echoes of frustrated roars. When consumed, it grants the imbiber a grizzled demeanor, temporarily boosting their strength with the resilience of a bear's determination... or at least makes them *sound* like one. The potion's effects are as unpredictable as an angry bear’s, often leading to moments of excessive rumbling and growling.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Strength
effectDetails.rules: The drinker gains a +2 bonus to Strength checks and saving throws for 1 hour. This effect lasts until it is dispelled or the user drops prone.

effectDetails.title: Grumbling Sound
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the potion's effect, the drinker emits an unsettling growling sound. Any creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute.

faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_grumbles.levelRequirementReason: This simple potion is designed for adventurers just starting their journey, providing them with basic resilience and a touch of intimidation.
faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_grumbles.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar stocks this item as it caters to the fledgling heroes who need a bit more oomph in their early battles.
faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_grumbles.shippingDetail: The flying carpet ensures swift delivery, often arriving within an hour of purchase.

usage.activation: Drink the potion as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until prone.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you drop prone, are incapacitated, or dispelled by another creature.

faerun_item_potion_of_grizzly_grumbles.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect the potion's increased duration and more potent effects.

faerun_item_amulet_of_forgotten_omens.name: Amulet of Forgotten Omens
faerun_item_amulet_of_forgotten_omens.description: This tarnished silver amulet shimmers faintly in the dark, its surface etched with arcane symbols that whisper of forgotten prophecies and ancient omens. It feels cold to the touch, as if it holds secrets from realms beyond. Wearers are drawn into a vortex of visions, each one a cryptic warning or foreboding omen. Rumor has it that prolonged use can lead to an uncontrollable urge to hoard shiny objects, but those who resist might find their luck inexplicably bolstered in times of need.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Omen
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can invoke the amulet to receive a cryptic prophecy. This has a chance to grant advantage on one saving throw or attack roll before the end of their next turn. The amulet can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to all Dexterity saving throws for 1 hour, starting when they activate the amulet. This effect ends if the wearer takes any damage or if they finish a short rest.

faerun_item_amulet_of_forgotten_omens.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is designed for those who have proven themselves in the harshest of trials.
faerun_item_amulet_of_forgotten_omens.vendorReason: The Waterdeep Market caters to adventurers seeking rare and powerful artifacts from the farthest corners of Faerûn.
faerun_item_amulet_of_forgotten_omens.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted couriers, ensuring safe and timely arrival. Requires a special delivery permit for legendary items.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Whispers of Omen), 1 hour (Luck Boost)
usage.endsWhen: Ends if the wearer takes damage or finishes a short rest; recharges at dawn on the next day after use.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

faerun_item_amulet_of_forgotten_omens.priceReason: Balanced to reflect the amulet's ability to provide both tactical and situational advantages without overpowered effects.

faerun_item_silverwood_amulet.name: Amulet of the Whispering Woods
faerun_item_silverwood_amulet.description: The Amulet of the Whispering Woods, crafted from ancient Silverwood found in the heart of Faerûn's oldest forest, subtly glows with an ethereal light. Its whispers carry tales of ancient secrets and cryptic warnings that have eluded even the most seasoned adventurers. It grants a subtle advantage in wilderness survival checks and offers fleeting insights into the hidden dangers lurking within the woods, mostly steering one clear of common traps laid by mischievous forest spirits.

effectDetails.title: Survival Insight
effectDetails.rules: When you make a Survival check in the wilderness, you have advantage. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Warning Whispers
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, the amulet offers a cryptic warning about an impending danger within 30 feet. There is a 5% chance this will be a false alarm. This effect does not require action and ends when you hear the warning.

faerun_item_silverwood_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's subtle but helpful effects are accessible to adventurers of all levels, offering early-stage assistance without overwhelming more experienced players.
faerun_item_silverwood_amulet.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar is known for its extensive collection of magical trinkets and artifacts, making it the ideal vendor for such a unique and lore-rich item.
faerun_item_silverwood_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships within 1d4 turns via enchanted flying carpets, delivered directly to your doorstep with minimal fuss.

usage.activation: Passive effect; cryptic warnings are offered without action.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest, or until the warning is heard.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of a long rest, or when the cryptic warning is heeded and understood.

faerun_item_silverwood_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's price reflects its rarity, magical properties, and the limited stock available from Baldur's Bazaar.

faerun_item_guildmaster_badge.name: Dwarven Guildmaster's Recognition
faerun_item_guildmaster_badge.description: The Dwarven Guildmaster's Recognition is a hefty piece of jewelry, crafted from gleaming steel and emblazoned with the emblem of Stonebeard Clan. Its weighty form not only catches the light like Wario’s favorite mirror but also signifies respect and access to exclusive dwarven trade routes. This badge provides a discount at all dwarven shops in Faerûn and boosts your reputation among the clan, ensuring you are treated with deference wherever you go.

effectDetails.title: Dwarven Trade Route Access
effectDetails.rules: Activates upon wearing this badge. Grants access to exclusive dwarven trade routes, allowing you to purchase goods at a significant discount compared to public markets. This effect lasts until the badge is removed or lost.

effectDetails.title: Shop Discount
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect while wearing the badge. Provides a 10% discount at all dwarven shops in Faerûn. The discount cannot be combined with other offers and expires upon removing the badge from your person.

faerun_item_guildmaster_badge.levelRequirementReason: The recognition is simple enough that even the lowest-ranking guild member can wear it, but it remains a symbol of respect.
faerun_item_guildmaster_badge.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market often deals with Stonebeard Clan and thus stocks this badge for their patrons.
faerun_item_guildmaster_badge.shippingDetail: Ships via the Iron Road Express, ensuring swift delivery from the dwarven strongholds of Faerûn.

usage.duration: Until removed or lost.
usage.endsWhen: Upon removal or loss of the badge.

faerun_item_guildmaster_badge.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects both its rarity and its practical utility in gaining access to valuable trade routes.

animatopia_spirit_weave.name: Spirit Weave Offering Bowl
animatopia_spirit_weave.description: The Spirit Weave Offering Bowl is crafted from shimmering beetle wings and woven forest vines, each strand imbued with the essence of Animatopia's spirits. This sacred vessel not only grants blessings but also provides temporary resistance to fear effects, ensuring your courage in the face of the unknown. As you offer it to the spirits, expect to hear whispers of guidance and perhaps even see paths previously hidden by mist appear before you.

effectDetails.title: Spiritual Guidance
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this bowl grants the user a random beneficial effect from Animatopia's spirits. The effect can range from finding lost berries to receiving wisdom on local lore. This blessing lasts for 1 hour and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: This offering bowl provides the recipient with temporary resistance to fear effects, granting advantage on saving throws against such effects until it is consumed or destroyed. It remains active as long as the user holds the bowl in their possession.

animatopia_spirit_weave.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest of Animatopia's inhabitants can offer this bowl to the spirits, making it accessible to all travelers.
animatopia_spirit_weave.vendorReason: The forest market thrives on offerings and rituals that connect communities with the natural world.
animatopia_spirit_weave.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant spider courier, ensuring safe arrival through Animatopia's dense forests.

usage.activation: Activate as an action to receive a blessing or benefit.
usage.duration: Effect lasts for 1 hour or until consumed.
usage.endsWhen: Upon consumption or destruction of the bowl.

animatopia_spirit_weave.priceReason: The cost reflects the rarity and magical properties of the bowl, balancing its utility with a mythic item's value.

animatopia_warrior_mask.name: Mask of the Primal Howler
animatopia_warrior_mask.description: The Mask of the Primal Howler is crafted from the hardened hide of a fearsome rhino and adorned with bone fragments that reflect the raw power of Animatopia's fiercest warriors. Wearing this mask unleashes primal rage, boosting your combat prowess and granting you resilience against poisons. The mask’s sharp edges enhance your melee attacks, dealing an extra 3 points of damage and leaving foes bleeding. A warrior's essence courses through its metalwork, temporarily fortifying your strength.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Attack Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you wear the Mask of the Primal Howler, your melee weapon attacks deal an additional +3 damage until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Bleeding on Hit
effectDetails.rules: Each time you score a critical hit or natural 19-20 while wearing the mask, there is a 50% chance to inflict the bleeding condition on one target within reach. The effect lasts for 1 minute.

animatopia_warrior_mask.levelRequirementReason: The Mask of the Primal Howler's raw power requires a warrior with significant experience and discipline.
animatopia_warrior_mask.vendorReason: Beast Bazaar regularly stocks items from Animatopia, ensuring that even the most seasoned warriors can find gear to enhance their combat abilities.
animatopia_warrior_mask.shippingDetail: The Rattlesnake Express delivers with precision and speed, guaranteeing the Mask of the Primal Howler arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Equipping the mask is a free action.
usage.duration: One minute.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn after removing it.

animatopia_warrior_mask.priceReason: The Mask of the Primal Howler's reduced price reflects its more balanced and strategic effects, rather than raw power.

earth_land_goblin_grease.name: Sticky Goblin Goo
earth_land_goblin_grease.description: Sticky Goblin Goo, a suspiciously bright green paste harvested from the goblin sewers, is more than just a greasy inconvenience—it clings to your weapon like a second skin, making every strike stickier and harder to shake off. The foul-smelling goo is said to be infused with the essence of rotten turnips, lending it an eerie glow in dim light. When applied, this paste not only increases the damage done by melee attacks but also leaves opponents grappling with the slippery residue for a moment after contact.

effectDetails.title: Weapon Damage Increase
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with a weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll. This effect persists for 1 minute after application.

effectDetails.title: Grapple Residue on Contact
effectDetails.rules: Whenever an opponent makes a successful melee attack against you while wearing this sticky goo, they must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be grappled until the start of your next turn. The effect ends if you are disarmed.

earth_land_goblin_grease.levelRequirementReason: This item's potency is balanced for beginners to enjoy its practical benefits without overwhelming them.
earth_land_goblin_grease.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster stocks this versatile goo as a reliable option for those embarking on their first quests, offering a bit of extra edge in combat.
earth_land_goblin_grease.shippingDetail: Delivered by horseback courier within three days from the shop.

usage.activation: Apply to your weapon as an action.
usage.duration: 1 minute per application.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are disarmed or when the duration expires.

earth_land_goblin_grease.priceReason: The price reflects its unique properties, increased durability, and the special handling required for transport.

earth_land_ancient_rune_tablet.name: Runic Tablet of the Silent Guardians
earth_land_ancient_rune_tablet.description: The Runic Tablet of the Silent Guardians is a weathered stone tablet etched with ancient runes that hum softly when touched. It whispers forgotten secrets, but only for those who can decipher its cryptic language. A fleeting sense of unease accompanies each touch, as if the tablet knows more than it reveals. This relic grants temporary wisdom and insight into hidden truths, making it invaluable against powerful foes like dragons or ancient sorcerers.

effectDetails.title: Whisper of Forbidden Knowledge
effectDetails.rules: When the tablet is touched, you gain advantage on a single Intelligence (Insight) check to uncover hidden information. This effect lasts for one minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Boon
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes after touching the tablet, your Wisdom score is increased by 2, providing a +2 bonus on saving throws against fear and charm effects. This effect ends if you take damage or fall unconscious.

earth_land_ancient_rune_tablet.levelRequirementReason: The tablet's ancient power requires only basic arcane knowledge to activate.
earth_land_ancient_rune_tablet.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in artifacts of nature and ancient lore, making it the perfect vendor for this relic.
earth_land_ancient_rune_tablet.shippingDetail: Delivered by a courier who ensures the tablet remains undisturbed until it reaches its destination.

usage.duration: Whisper lasts one minute, Wisdom Boon lasts for 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: On damage or unconsciousness; ends if not used within a long rest

earth_land_ancient_rune_tablet.priceReason: The tablet's rarity and ancient power justify its moderate price, offering both tactical advantage and lore.

kivotos_item_chronometric_pendulum.name: Temporal Tick Tocker
kivotos_item_chronometric_pendulum.description: The Temporal Tick Tocker is a pendulum clock with a polished brass casing and an intricate mechanism. Crafted from ancient elvish alchemy, it subtly bends the flow of time around you when activated. Winding it in moments of crisis grants you a fleeting boost to your reaction speed, allowing you to dodge attacks or counter foes with precision. It can also briefly reverse small events, erasing minor missteps without altering history's course.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reaction Speed
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a reaction, you gain advantage on your next attack or saving throw. This effect lasts for 1 round and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Minor Time Rewind
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to rewind time for minor events up to 30 seconds in the past, negating the effects of one damaging spell or ability. This effect is instantaneous and can only be used once every 24 hours.

kivotos_item_chronometric_pendulum.levelRequirementReason: The Temporal Tick Tocker requires no level to use as its effects are minor and intended for emergency situations.
kivotos_item_chronometric_pendulum.vendorReason: The Academy Armory stocks unique items crafted by ancient artisans, and the Temporal Tick Tocker is a perfect example of their work.
kivotos_item_chronometric_pendulum.shippingDetail: Delivered within a day with express courier service.

usage.duration: instantaneous or until end of next turn for Enhanced Reaction Speed; instantaneous for Minor Time Rewind
usage.endsWhen: used up, recharged after a long rest for Enhanced Reaction Speed; cooldown period of 24 hours for Minor Time Rewind

kivotos_item_chronometric_pendulum.priceReason: The Temporal Tick Tocker's balanced price reflects its minor utility and the expertise needed to craft such an item.

kivotos_item_halo_of_dedication.name: The Scholar's Spark
kivotos_item_halo_of_dedication.description: The Scholar's Spark is a shimmering halo forged from concentrated student energy, encased in a delicate lattice of silver and glass. It hums softly as it amplifies your focus, making even the most tedious tasks a breeze. The halo subtly encourages organization, causing you to rearrange books and notes with precision, though this can lead to fits of alphabetical ordering that leave your study area neatly sorted but perhaps not in its original state.

effectDetails.title: Increased Learning Efficiency
effectDetails.rules: While wearing The Scholar's Spark, you gain a +1 bonus to all Intelligence (History) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks. This effect is passive.

effectDetails.title: Organized Urge
effectDetails.rules: When you spend 1 minute organizing your surroundings, you can attempt an Intelligence (Persuasion) check with advantage against creatures that notice the change. On a success, they are charmed for 1 hour.

kivotos_item_halo_of_dedication.levelRequirementReason: The Scholar's Spark requires at least 6th level to channel its focused energy without overwhelming the user.
kivotos_item_halo_of_dedication.vendorReason: Club Supply specializes in academic and scholarly curiosities, making The Scholar's Spark a natural fit for their inventory.
kivotos_item_halo_of_dedication.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by winged messenger with a 24-hour delivery guarantee.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing the item.
usage.duration: Permanent until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The item is removed from your person or destroyed.

kivotos_item_halo_of_dedication.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its limited utility and scholarly focus, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any scholar's gear.

kivotos_item_vortex_scroll.name: Dimensional Scribbles
kivotos_item_vortex_scroll.description: The Dimensional Scribbles scroll appears to be a tattered relic of forgotten dimensions, its edges shimmering with impossible geometries and arcane symbols that seem to twist in place like living ink. When unfurled, it briefly opens a localized vortex, perfect for escaping awkward conversations or retrieving dropped items without alerting the surrounding area. However, users must exercise caution as the vortex can inadvertently pull nearby objects and creatures closer, potentially causing untimely entanglements.

effectDetails.title: Teleport Short Range
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user may teleport up to 5 feet towards an object or creature. The target must be within range and visible. This effect has no save DC but is limited to once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Local Vortex
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a reaction in response to being targeted by an attack, the user can create a localized vortex that pulls all creatures within 5 feet towards it. Creatures must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be pushed back 5 feet and knocked prone. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

kivotos_item_vortex_scroll.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for lower-level adventurers to help in tight situations without requiring high proficiency.
kivotos_item_vortex_scroll.vendorReason: The student store caters to the needs of young, resourceful explorers and scholars who often require such items for their adventures.
kivotos_item_vortex_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via standard mail within the kingdom; delivery usually takes no longer than a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Teleport) / Until the end of next turn (Local Vortex)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a short or long rest

kivotos_item_vortex_scroll.priceReason: Balanced for its utility in both combat and exploration without being overly powerful.

doughnut_hole_singing_donut.name: Resonance Ring Donut
doughnut_hole_singing_donut.description: The Resonance Ring Donut radiates a faint, doughy glow that resonates through the air like a forgotten melody.
