effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can focus on the shard to detect hidden passages within a 30-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and has a chance of revealing concealed tunnels or secret doors with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check.

effectDetails.title: Detect Earthquakes
effectDetails.rules: The shard emits a faint tremor when an earthquake is imminent, within a 60-foot radius. You gain advantage on Perception checks to notice the onset of seismic activity and can take a bonus action at the start of each of your turns to detect such disturbances.

earth_land_whispering_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's power is accessible to all adventurers, as it requires no specialized training to use.
earth_land_whispering_shard.vendorReason: Magic Shop stocks the Echoing Obsidian Shard due to its unique and widely sought-after abilities among treasure hunters and explorers.
earth_land_whispering_shard.shippingDetail: Shipped by a fleet of winged beetles, the shard arrives within one week, delivered safely in its protective case.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Reveal Hidden Paths; lasts until triggered again
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you no longer hold the shard or use it to detect an earthquake.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

earth_land_whispering_shard.priceReason: The Echoing Obsidian Shard's price reflects its rare nature and the potential value of discovering hidden treasures.

earth_land_dragon_scale_charm.name: Chromatic Dragon Scale Charm
earth_land_dragon_scale_charm.description: Crafted from the shimmering scales of a young, flamboyant chromatic dragon, this charm exudes an otherworldly iridescence that subtly influences those around you. It grants a +2 bonus to Charisma checks and rolls, but its true power lies in its ability to make enemies feel intensely jealous of your gear for up to 1 hour per long rest. The charm's scales are said to offer a protective barrier against fear-based attacks or effects, granting a +3 resistance.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: This charm grants the wearer a +2 bonus to Charisma checks and rolls. This effect is passive, but can be activated as an action for a one-time use per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Jealousy Aura
effectDetails.rules: For up to 1 hour after activation, this charm exudes an aura that makes enemies feel intensely jealous of the wearer's gear. This effect imposes a -2 penalty on Charisma-based checks and saves made by creatures within 30 feet of you. The aura ends when the wearer takes any action or when the charm runs out of charges.

earth_land_dragon_scale_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is designed for beginners to enjoy its benefits without overreaching their capabilities.
earth_land_dragon_scale_charm.vendorReason: The earth emporium specializes in rare and exotic goods, including items that can influence the emotions of others, making this charm a perfect fit.
earth_land_dragon_scale_charm.shippingDetail: The delivery drone ensures swift and secure transport of your purchase, delivered directly to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Up to 1 hour per long rest
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the wearer takes any action or when it runs out of charges after a short rest.

earth_land_dragon_scale_charm.priceReason: The charm's rarity and the unique properties it offers justify its fair value.

mushroom_kingdom_item_giga_coin.name: Giga Coin of Infinite Greed
mushroom_kingdom_item_giga_coin.description: The Giga Coin of Infinite Greed gleams with an almost unbearable luster, its surface etched with arcane runes that whisper tales of insatiable desire. This oversized coin is said to attract not just coins, but also rare artifacts and even the occasional mischievous thief. Hold it long enough, and you might find yourself on a never-ending quest for more wealth – or worse, entangled in an endless loop of greed that could leave you penniless and alone.

effectDetails.title: Valuables Attraction
effectDetails.rules: When held, the coin attracts coins and valuables within a 30-foot radius. Any creature within this area has disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened by other creatures. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Break
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, when you take an action that would normally result in a failure, roll a d20. On a 19 or 20, treat it as a success instead. This effect can be used once per long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_item_giga_coin.levelRequirementReason: This coin's attraction and luck manipulation are accessible to all adventurers.
mushroom_kingdom_item_giga_coin.vendorReason: Wario Direct, known for its questionable business practices, naturally sells this item that can both attract wealth and lead to endless quests.
mushroom_kingdom_item_giga_coin.shippingDetail: The coin is delivered via a single mushroom delivery drone which arrives at your door within the hour of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect while held; requires no action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect when used for its attraction, lasts until end of next turn. Lucky Break is once per short rest and unlimited uses per day.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn after using it or if you stop holding the coin.

mushroom_kingdom_item_giga_coin.priceReason: This price reflects a moderately powerful item that offers both utility and risk, balancing its attraction to valuables with a potential for endless quests.

mushroom_kingdom_item_echoing_pipe.name: Echoing Pipe of Lost Sounds
mushroom_kingdom_item_echoing_pipe.description: The Echoing Pipe of Lost Sounds, forged from ancient mushroom spores and the forgotten melodies of a bygone era, is a relic that allows you to capture and replay sounds from the past. Its crafted from the hardened essence of long-dead fungi, making its surface textured with intricate patterns of past events. Use it wisely; the echoes might reveal hidden secrets or mischievous spirits eager for mischief. You may catch snippets of valuable clues or just Wario's usual complaints about more coins!

effectDetails.title: Sound Capture
effectDetails.rules: By expending a bonus action, you can record up to three seconds of sound. This recorded sound can be played back once as an action at any time within one hour of the recording.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Attraction
effectDetails.rules: The pipe attracts mischievous spirits with a chance of 10% per minute for the first ten minutes after playback, doubling to 20% each subsequent five minutes. If successful, a mischievous spirit appears within 30 feet of you and can be used in combat or to gather information.

mushroom_kingdom_item_echoing_pipe.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level to handle the ancient magic inherent in the pipe.
mushroom_kingdom_item_echoing_pipe.vendorReason: Toad Town Market is known for selling relics of old, and this pipe fits right into that tradition.
mushroom_kingdom_item_echoing_pipe.shippingDetail: Snail Express ensures safe delivery with a one-day guarantee on all shipments to Toad Town.

usage.activation: Bonus action to record; action to play back.
usage.duration: Instantaneous recording; one use per hour of playback.
usage.endsWhen: Playback ends when the sound is played or after 1 minute if unplayed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one can be recorded at a time.

mushroom_kingdom_item_echoing_pipe.priceReason: Balanced as it requires significant magic and ancient craftsmanship while being useful in various adventuring situations.

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_stool.name: Wario's Warp Stool of Sudden Travel
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_stool.description: This rickety, bolted-together stool, crafted by Wario himself from mismatched parts, is a relic of his dubious craftsmanship. Its aged wood creaks with each use, and the paint peels to reveal patches of rusted metal. When activated, it teleports you to a random location within a 50-foot radius, but beware – there's a chance you'll land in a disoriented state, unable to act for one turn unless you succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Instantaneous teleport to a random location within a 50-foot radius of your current position, excluding dangerous areas like lava or bottomless pits.

effectDetails.title: Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: There's a 20% chance you will land in a disoriented state for one turn. On a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw, the effect is negated. While disoriented, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_stool.levelRequirementReason: This stool is simple enough that even low-level adventurers can use it, but its unpredictable nature makes it a challenge.
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_stool.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop deals in all manner of Wario's creations, from the mundane to the dangerous, and this stool is no exception.
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_stool.shippingDetail: Delivered by a mushroom carrier beetle, which may take up to one hour depending on traffic within the Mushroom Kingdom.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Teleportation is complete or you are disoriented and unable to act for one turn

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_stool.priceReason: The stool's unpredictable nature, combined with its craftsmanship from Wario himself, justifies a higher price.

middle_earth_gloomfang_blade.name: Gloomfang Blade
middle_earth_gloomfang_blade.description: Gloomfang Blade whispers darkly as it dances in your hand, its blade forged from a meteorite that fell during the War of the Ring. The weapon's edge is as sharp as Mordor's shadows and can cleave through even the toughest orcish armor with ease. However, be wary; if you hold it too long without using it, the whispers may grow louder until they become unbearable, tempting your soul to join the Dark Lord’s realm.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Step
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can use Gloomfang Blade to grant yourself a burst of speed. You gain a +10 foot movement bonus until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you take any damage or if you move more than 30 feet in this time.

effectDetails.title: Bleeding Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 15% chance that creatures hit by Gloomfang Blade suffer from the Bleeding condition, which deals an additional 2d6 slashing damage at the start of their turn. This effect ends if you attack again or if the Bleeding condition is removed.

middle_earth_gloomfang_blade.levelRequirementReason: Gloomfang Blade's inherent malevolence and power require a high level to wield without risk.
middle_earth_gloomfang_blade.vendorReason: The dwarves of Erebor possess the ancient knowledge needed to craft weapons that can harness such dark magic.
middle_earth_gloomfang_blade.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, Gloomfang Blade is shipped under strict conditions by the gnome caravan, ensuring safe transport.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Shadow Step; Instantaneous for Bleeding Chance upon attack.
usage.duration: Until start of next turn for Shadow Step; Ends on subsequent attacks or condition removal for Bleeding.
usage.endsWhen: Takes damage, moves more than 30 feet, or attacks again (Bleeding).

middle_earth_gloomfang_blade.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as a rare weapon with significant damage and special abilities.

middle_earth_shire_sweetroll_of_fortune.name: Shire Sweetroll of Fortune
middle_earth_shire_sweetroll_of_fortune.description: The Shire Sweetroll of Fortune, baked in the cozy kitchens of Hobbiton, is a treat infused with the very essence of Middle-earth's goodwill. Each crumb offers a chance for unexpected fortune – perhaps a fleeting boost to your strength or a momentary healing surge that could turn the tide of battle. Legend has it that these sweetrolls are not just food but tokens of the land’s benevolence, and many have found themselves in luck after indulging in one of these magical pastries.

effectDetails.title: Fortunate Bites
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, the Shire Sweetroll grants temporary hit points equal to 2d8 + your Dexterity modifier. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can occur only once per day.

effectDetails.title: Strength Surge
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that consuming this sweetroll will grant you a +2 bonus to Strength for the next 5 minutes, which can happen only once every 7 days.

middle_earth_shire_sweetroll_of_fortune.levelRequirementReason: This treat is accessible to all adventurers as it requires no particular skill or expertise.
middle_earth_shire_sweetroll_of_fortune.vendorReason: The Shire Shop stocks these treats, known for their unique properties and the joy they bring to visitors of the Shire.
middle_earth_shire_sweetroll_of_fortune.shippingDetail: Delivered via trusted pony cart services from the Hobbiton bakery. Shipping is quick but may vary based on weather conditions in the Shire.

usage.activation: Eaten as a bonus action, providing its effects immediately.
usage.duration: Fortunate Bites last for 1 hour; Strength Surge lasts for 5 minutes.
usage.endsWhen: Effects end if you consume another Shire Sweetroll of Fortune within the specified duration.

middle_earth_shire_sweetroll_of_fortune.priceReason: The high price reflects its magical properties and the unique brewing process in the heart of the Shire, making it a rare commodity among adventurers.

middle_earth_elven_songstone.name: Songstone of Silvanus
middle_earth_elven_songstone.description: The Songstone of Silvanus, a flawless obsidian gem infused with ancient elven magic, hums softly as it protects and uplifts those who hold it. Crafted by master elves in the heart of Mirkwood, this stone pulses with protective energy that can be woven into melodies of resilience. It subtly shields allies from harm, reducing incoming damage by 15%, while also boosting morale to +2, ensuring spirits remain high during even the darkest battles.

effectDetails.title: Protection Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Songstone creates an aura around the user and their allies within 10 feet. This aura reduces all damage taken by 15% for up to 1 minute per use until expended.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: The stone grants a +2 bonus to morale checks and resistance against negative conditions, lasting for the duration of one short rest or until the user's next extended rest.

middle_earth_elven_songstone.levelRequirementReason: Only those with sufficient experience can harness the ancient magic embedded in this precious stone.
middle_earth_elven_songstone.vendorReason: The Songstone is a premium item, crafted by master elves and sold exclusively at their market.
middle_earth_elven_songstone.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by swift winged horses from the heart of Mirkwood.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use, up to a maximum of 5 minutes total per long rest
usage.endsWhen: After expending all uses or until the user completes their next extended rest

middle_earth_elven_songstone.priceReason: This mythic item, crafted by master elves and imbued with ancient magic, commands a price befitting its rarity.

grand_country_sticky_shard.name: Gravity Grip Shard
grand_country_sticky_shard.description: The Gravity Grip Shard hums with the latent potential of gravitational forces, pulsating in your hand as you prepare to ascend sheer cliffs and ceilings. This fragment, crafted from ancient meteoric iron, grants you an adhesive grip that allows you to cling to surfaces as if by nature’s own design. With each step, the shard whispers secrets of cosmic balance, enhancing both your climbing speed and fall damage reduction.

effectDetails.title: Adhesive Grip
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the Gravity Grip Shard to adhere yourself to any wall or ceiling surface. While adhered, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb and are immune to falling damage.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Climbing
effectDetails.rules: While the shard is active, your climbing speed increases by 10 feet for the duration of one short rest or until you deactivate it. This effect does not stack with other sources of climbing speed bonuses.

grand_country_sticky_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Gravity Grip Shard requires a minimum character level to ensure players can safely and effectively utilize its unique properties.
grand_country_sticky_shard.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in items that defy gravity, making the Gravity Grip Shard an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_sticky_shard.shippingDetail: The shard is carefully packaged within a gravity-stabilized container to ensure it arrives intact.

usage.duration: Until you deactivate or until the end of your next turn (whichever comes first)
usage.endsWhen: If you deactivate the shard, fall from height, or are knocked prone
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges after a short rest

grand_country_sticky_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique gravitational properties and limited utility.

grand_country_layer_scroll.name: Echoing Layer Scroll
grand_country_layer_scroll.description: Unroll this shimmering scroll, and hear the whispers of forgotten layers! As you unfold its parchment, the echoes reveal hidden paths and secret doors within the very walls of ancient castles. The scroll’s light glows with an otherworldly hue, hinting at the secrets that lie just beyond reach. Beware, for in these whispers lies both treasure and peril; get lost too long, and it may echo you to a realm far from home.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Path
effectDetails.rules: When activated by reading the scroll, this effect reveals hidden paths and secret doors within a 30-foot radius. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until you move more than 5 feet from your original position.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Find Treasure
effectDetails.rules: Each time you successfully find a hidden path using the scroll, there is a 20% chance that a secret door leads directly to a chest containing treasure worth up to 1d6 x 100 XP. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

grand_country_layer_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll requires at least third-level spellcasters due to its intricate magical construction.
grand_country_layer_scroll.vendorReason: The Layer Market specializes in items that reveal hidden layers of reality, making the Echoing Layer Scroll a fitting addition for their inventory.
grand_country_layer_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Tube, which can be slow due to the instability of the routes between dimensions.

usage.activation: Reading the scroll aloud and concentrating on it for at least one minute.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until you move more than 5 feet from your original position.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you exceed a 5-foot movement range.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only once per long rest.

grand_country_layer_scroll.priceReason: The Echoing Layer Scroll is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its complex magic and rare construction.

grand_country_warp_tune.name: Temporal Echo Tuning
grand_country_warp_tune.description: With a delicate twist of your wrist, Temporal Echo Tuning weaves a symphony of temporal distortions around you. Listen as the air hums with the discordant echoes of shifting realities, bending time to your will for a fleeting moment. Enemies caught in this maelstrom are momentarily disoriented, their minds scrambled by the chaotic resonance. This ancient artifact, crafted from the fractured essence of forgotten timelines, is a rare and unpredictable service that might just scramble not only foes' minds but also yours!

effectDetails.title: Temporal Maelstrom
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you create a localized distortion in time around you. Creatures within a 10-foot radius must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Mind Scramble
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after using Temporal Maelstrom, all creatures that start their turn within 30 feet of you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. This effect ends if you take damage or if you use this service again.

grand_country_warp_tune.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant focus to manipulate time safely, thus it is best suited for a 6th-level caster.
grand_country_warp_tune.vendorReason: Side sellers often trade in unique and unpredictable services, making Temporal Echo Tuning an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_warp_tune.shippingDetail: The Chronometric Crate ensures safe transportation of delicate temporal artifacts like this one.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a 1-minute effect duration after creating the maelstrom
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or use this service again

grand_country_warp_tune.priceReason: The item's unpredictable nature and rare crafting materials justify its high price.

faerun_item_goblin_grog_potion.name: Goblin Grog of Temporary Ferocity
faerun_item_goblin_grog_potion.description: The Goblin Grog of Temporary Ferocity is a foul-smelling, murky green potion brewed by goblins notorious for their unconventional alchemy. This concoction, laced with herbs and fungi found only in Faerûn's darkest corners, grants the imbiber a surge of strength and reckless courage. For 6 turns, your Strength increases by 3, turning you into a berserk battler ready to face any foe head-on. As if that weren't enough, there's also a 10% chance for your next melee attack to stun an opponent, making this potion a dangerous yet unpredictable ally in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this potion grants you a +3 bonus to Strength for 6 turns. You can use this potion as an action. If the effect ends before its duration expires due to a save or other means, any remaining time is lost.

effectDetails.title: Stun on Attack
effectDetails.rules: There's a 10% chance your next melee attack deals additional effects: it has advantage on the roll and can cause a target to be stunned for 1 round. This effect requires you to make a melee attack as an action.

faerun_item_goblin_grog_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for novice adventurers, providing them with a burst of strength and a chance at a decisive blow.
faerun_item_goblin_grog_potion.vendorReason: As a vendor known to stock unique and unusual items, Baldur's Bazaar is the perfect place to find this unconventional potion.
faerun_item_goblin_grog_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift hawk couriers, ensuring you receive your potion as fresh as possible.

usage.duration: 6 turns
usage.endsWhen: ends early upon a successful saving throw against its effects

faerun_item_goblin_grog_potion.priceReason: The unique brewing process and rare ingredients make this potion an expensive yet valuable tool for adventurers.

faerun_item_shard_of_ancient_echoes.name: Shard of Ancient Echoes
faerun_item_shard_of_ancient_echoes.description: A shard of Ancient Echoes is a crystalline fragment that once adorned the walls of a long-lost temple. When held, it hums with the faint whispers of ancient languages and forgotten histories. Touching its surface evokes vivid memories of past events, possibly from an age when magic flowed freely through the land. It may also inadvertently summon minor spirits that assist or hinder the wielder’s efforts, depending on the user's actions.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Insights
effectDetails.rules: When a character touches the Shard of Ancient Echoes and makes an Intelligence (History) check, they have advantage on the roll. The shard can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Spirits' Guidance
effectDetails.rules: The Shard attracts minor spirits that provide helpful guidance or minor assistance for 1 hour. If the user fails a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12), the spirits may instead interfere with their plans, adding disadvantage on checks and saving throws until dismissed. The shard can be used once per day.

faerun_item_shard_of_ancient_echoes.levelRequirementReason: The Shard requires minimal magical energy to interact with, making it accessible but still rare.
faerun_item_shard_of_ancient_echoes.vendorReason: Waterdeep's market attracts collectors and scholars who seek ancient relics like the Shard of Ancient Echoes.
faerun_item_shard_of_ancient_echoes.shippingDetail: The shard arrives via a magical portal, ensuring it reaches its destination safely and quickly.

usage.activation: Interacting with the Shard by touching it for at least one turn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration of the spirit's assistance or interference varies.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the user dismisses them, after their duration expires, or if used again.

faerun_item_shard_of_ancient_echoes.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its mythic rarity and occasional magical assistance.

pokemon_item_echoing_ball.name: Echoing Ball of Confusion
pokemon_item_echoing_ball.description: The Echoing Ball of Confusion is a peculiar metallic sphere, its surface etched with swirling patterns that seem to pulse with energy. Crafted from ancient, enchanted metal by a reclusive forger, this device amplifies the cries and roars of Pokémon into a disorienting cacophony. Use it to briefly stun enemies or confuse yourself, but be wary—its unpredictable effects often leave you hearing strange melodies in your mind, like Pikachu serenading under the stars.

effectDetails.title: Stun Target
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as a bonus action, this device amplifies the cries of nearby Pokémon into an intense wave. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Self-Confusion
effectDetails.rules: After using it, you are confused for 2 turns. During this time, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

pokemon_item_echoing_ball.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from ancient metal imbued with the essence of legendary Pokémon, the Echoing Ball requires a level 5 caster to wield its power effectively.
pokemon_item_echoing_ball.vendorReason: Pokemart, known for its vast array of items that cater to trainers and their Pokémon, stocks this unique device.
pokemon_item_echoing_ball.shippingDetail: Ships via Pokémail Express, ensuring swift delivery straight to your door.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (target stunned for 1 round)
usage.endsWhen: The target makes a successful saving throw or the duration expires

pokemon_item_echoing_ball.priceReason: Its rarity and enchanted construction, combined with its unpredictable effects, justify this fair value in experience points.

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_wisdom.name: Ancient Badge of Wisdom
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_wisdom.description: The Ancient Badge of Wisdom, a tarnished but still recognizable symbol of ancient knowledge, whispers tales of bygone champions who wielded it. Crafted in the twilight of Pokémon history, this badge grants fleeting insights into strategic prowess, allowing you to anticipate your foe's next move with uncanny precision. Touching its surface releases a surge of wisdom, momentarily enhancing your critical hit chance and offering a glimpse into an opponent’s strategic mind.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants +2 to Intelligence (Wisdom) checks and saving throws for 1 minute, or until you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Critical Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates on your turn when you hit with an attack roll of 18 or higher. Increases the attack’s critical multiplier from x2 to x3 until the start of your next turn.

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_wisdom.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to use effectively, as it enhances strategic thinking and combat acumen.
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_wisdom.vendorReason: The Safari Shop, a repository of historical artifacts, offers this badge as part of its collection of legendary relics.
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_wisdom.shippingDetail: Delivered by Safari Bike Express within the next full moon cycle.

usage.activation: Bonus action or on hit roll (as per effects)
usage.duration: 1 minute, or until you take damage for Wisdom Boost; Until the start of your next turn for Critical Surge
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or when you take damage

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_wisdom.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare crafting and strategic value.

pokemon_item_warios_evolution_pouch.name: Wario’s Evolution Pouch
pokemon_item_warios_evolution_pouch.description: This suspiciously plump pouch smells faintly of berries and regret. Legend says it contains the concentrated essence of evolution – but mostly just a collection of partially digested Pokémon snacks, and Wario’s experimental formulas. Good luck!
effects: chance to randomly evolve the user’s current Pokémon (50% chance)
increases attack stat by 10 for 2 turns
User gains a temporary boost to their speed.

internet_glitch_berry.name: Viral Burst Berry
internet_glitch_berry.description: The Viral Burst Berry is a peculiar, shimmering fruit that looks like it was crafted from corrupted data streams and fragmented digital remnants. When consumed, it unleashes a chaotic burst of internet energy, temporarily boosting speed and strength while causing brief moments of confusion for nearby foes. This berry's effects are as unpredictable as they are thrilling, making players feel as if they've stepped into the wilds of cyberspace.

effectDetails.title: Grant 5 Speed for 6 Turns
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming the berry, you gain a +5 bonus to your movement speed as an action. This effect lasts for 6 turns and ends if you take any damage.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Cause Confusion
effectDetails.rules: For every 2 turns that pass while you are under the effects of this berry, there is a 30% chance that you or an adjacent ally becomes confused for 1 turn. This confusion ends if the affected creature takes any damage.

internet_glitch_berry.levelRequirementReason: The Viral Burst Berry's unpredictable nature requires players to be at least 6th level to manage its chaotic effects without being overwhelmed.
internet_glitch_berry.vendorReason: Pixel Shop, known for its unique and experimental items, is the perfect vendor for this digital delicacy.
internet_glitch_berry.shippingDetail: The berry arrives fresh from the internet, requiring special handling by packet delivery to ensure it remains potent.

usage.duration: 6 turns
usage.endsWhen: taking damage or confusion ends

internet_glitch_berry.priceReason: The Viral Burst Berry is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare and experimental nature.

internet_void_shard.name: Nullspace Fragment
internet_void_shard.description: A jagged shard ripped from the heart of a forgotten server – handle with caution! This fragment can temporarily disrupt enemy magic and digital defenses, but prolonged exposure may lead to…unpleasant data corruption.

internet_meme_amplifier.name: Reaction Cascade Device
internet_meme_amplifier.description: The Reaction Cascade Device, a gleaming contraption made of salvaged parts and mysterious alloys, channels the chaotic energy of internet memes into your party's favor. With each activation, it broadcasts a cascade of viral trends that temporarily boosts your charisma, making everyone more charismatic and increasing the chance to trigger beneficial meme effects like distraction or confusion. Be wary—its power can sometimes backfire, causing minor damage over time as if hit by a weak force effect.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activating the device grants an ally within 30 feet a +3 bonus to Charisma checks and saving throws. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the target uses its reaction to end it.

effectDetails.title: Meme Effect Chance
effectDetails.rules: Each time an ally of the user triggers a successful save against a meme-related effect, they have a 25% chance (increasing by 5% per additional success) to also trigger a beneficial meme effect. This effect has no save DC and lasts for 1 minute or until the target uses its reaction to end it.

internet_meme_amplifier.levelRequirementReason: The Reaction Cascade Device requires only level 1 due to its limited, thematic effects.
internet_meme_amplifier.vendorReason: As a tech-savvy vendor with a knack for collecting and trading strange devices, Data Dealer is the perfect fit for such an internet-inspired gadget.
internet_meme_amplifier.shippingDetail: Shipped via express courier within 24 hours, ensuring the device arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until ended by a reaction
usage.endsWhen: the user uses their reaction to end it or the duration ends

internet_meme_amplifier.priceReason: The Reaction Cascade Device is priced at 1000 XP due to its thematic, limited effects that enhance party charisma and introduce meme-based interactions.

the_edge_voidstone_resonator.name: Voidstone Resonator
the_edge_voidstone_resonator.description: The Voidstone Resonator hums with the raw power of forgotten voids, its obsidian surface pulsating with an eerie light that seems to shift with each passing moment. This device grants temporary resistance to psychic damage and subtly amplifies one's awareness, but a whisper of madness accompanies every use. Caution is advised when wielding this artifact, for it not only protects from the mind’s assault but also opens portals to realms where sanity fades.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Psychic Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the Voidstone Resonator, you gain resistance to psychic damage for 1 minute. If you are hit by a creature’s psychic attack within this time, you can use your reaction to attempt a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, halving the damage taken.

effectDetails.title: Risk of Madness
effectDetails.rules: There is a 1% chance each time you activate the Resonator that you gain the mad trait. If you do, you must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw at the start of your next turn or take 1d4 levels of madness. This effect has no save until after 24 hours.

the_edge_voidstone_resonator.levelRequirementReason: It requires some experience to handle such a volatile and powerful device without succumbing to its madness.
the_edge_voidstone_resonator.vendorReason: The Abyss Trader is known for their dealings in the most dangerous and exotic artifacts, including those that dabble with the void's mysteries.
the_edge_voidstone_resonator.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional rift, which can cause minor temporal disruptions to the delivery location. Delivery time varies.

usage.activation: Bonus Action (activate once per short rest)
usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends if you are hit by a creature’s psychic attack or if you use your reaction to end it early.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one activation per short rest

the_edge_voidstone_resonator.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as its effects are potent and can be dangerous when used improperly.

the_edge_godly_abyssal_shard.name: Abyssal Shard of Nullity
the_edge_godly_abyssal_shard.description: The Abyssal Shard of Nullity is a fragment torn from the heart of the godly abyss, a relic that can nullify all magic within its radius and briefly freeze time around it. This shard, when activated, drains ambient magical energies, rendering spells and abilities useless for five rounds in a ten-foot radius. The core itself has an unpredictable charm, occasionally freezing nearby foes in a spell-like stasis for the duration of the effect's activation. A terrifyingly useful item for greedy collectors or those who wish to outmaneuver their adversaries.

effectDetails.title: Nullification Radius
effectDetails.rules: Activates with a bonus action, nullifying all magic within a ten-foot radius for five rounds. Targets must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or be rendered immobile and unable to use spells or abilities.

effectDetails.title: Time Freeze
effectDetails.rules: Has a 1% chance to activate with the nullification effect, freezing nearby foes in time for one round. Victims must make a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be immobilized as their movements are halted by an unseen force.

the_edge_godly_abyssal_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant magical aptitude and control to properly activate the shard's godly effects.
the_edge_godly_abyssal_shard.vendorReason: Final Shop, known for its rarest and most powerful wares, naturally stocks this godly relic.
the_edge_godly_abyssal_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Guardian Angel with a two-day expedited delivery to ensure the shard arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Five rounds for nullification, one round of time freeze (if activated)
usage.endsWhen: Targeted save or duration ends

the_edge_godly_abyssal_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers a powerful combination of area denial and time manipulation, but with specific limitations.

warhammer_skullsplitter.name: Skullsplitter of Shattered Wills
warhammer_skullsplitter.description: The Skullsplitter of Shattered Wills is a warhammer that exudes an aura of bone and death. Its head is crafted from the skulls of ancient warriors, each etched with their final moments. This weapon guarantees a crushing blow, not just to your enemies but also to their morale. It's said that the hammer's strikes can break even the strongest wills, leaving foes demoralized for hours. And should you ever lose a finger, it’s rumored that Wario himself designed its grip for just such occasions.

effectDetails.title: Crush Morale
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with this weapon, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for up to 1 minute. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Increased Critical Chance
effectDetails.rules: If you roll a natural 19 or 20 on an attack roll with this weapon, the attack is considered a critical hit. This effect is unlimited.

warhammer_skullsplitter.levelRequirementReason: The hammer's ancient power requires a seasoned warrior to wield it effectively.
warhammer_skullsplitter.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory stocks only the most potent and historically significant weapons, making it the go-to source for items like the Skullsplitter of Shattered Wills.
warhammer_skullsplitter.shippingDetail: Special handling required; delivery takes an additional day due to its fragile nature.

usage.activation: On a melee attack with this weapon
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Crush Morale, up to 1 minute when successful
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves or the effect's duration expires

warhammer_skullsplitter.priceReason: The hammer's unique crafting process and ancient lore significantly increase its value.

curiosity_echoing_shard.name: Echoing Shard of Lost Voices
curiosity_echoing_shard.description: The Echoing Shard of Lost Voices, a fragment from an ancient empire’s communication device, hums with the whispers of countless battles and cries for help. When held close to one's ear, it may reveal hidden tactical advantages, but those who linger too long risk succumbing to its psychic tides, causing temporary disorientation. This shard is favored by Wario, who always finds a way to turn this peculiar artifact into a makeshift megaphone or speaker.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Enemy Weaknesses
effectDetails.rules: When the shard is held close to one's ear, the user can make a Wisdom (Perception) check. On a success, they learn one weakness of an adjacent enemy creature for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Minor Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: Holding the shard too long causes temporary disorientation. The user must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become stunned until the end of their next turn.

curiosity_echoing_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level to handle the psychic strain and tactical insight the shard demands.
curiosity_echoing_shard.vendorReason: The chaos dealer, with their knack for mysterious artifacts, always has a piece of forgotten lore like this shard.
curiosity_echoing_shard.shippingDetail: Ships swiftly via Winged Courier, but the parcel may arrive in fragments if not handled carefully.

usage.activation: Object Interaction to hold close to one's ear for 1 minute.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use or until the user becomes disoriented.
usage.endsWhen: The user either successfully uses it, becomes disoriented, or drops it.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the shard regenerates after a short rest.

curiosity_echoing_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its limited stock and unique utility in combat.

warhammer_voidbringer.name: Voidbringer's Lament
warhammer_voidbringer.description: Voidbringer's Lament is a cursed warhammer forged from the twisted remnants of The Fated Place, its surface etched with chaotic runes that seem to pulse with malevolent energy. As you wield it, your strength wanes, yet you gain fleeting glimpses into the fractured reality of the void. It exudes an aura of dread and despair, causing nearby foes to stagger in fear as if the very fabric of their existence is unraveling.

effectDetails.title: Chaos Aura
effectDetails.rules: While wielding Voidbringer's Lament, you emit an aura that deals 15-20 necrotic damage to all creatures within 10 feet at the start of your turn. This effect has a maximum duration of one minute and can only occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Fearful Touch
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can touch a creature with Voidbringer's Lament to cause it to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened until the start of your next turn.

warhammer_voidbringer.levelRequirementReason: Wielding this cursed weapon requires a deep understanding of its chaotic energies and a resilience that only comes with experience.
warhammer_voidbringer.vendorReason: Fate Forge has the knowledge and resources to craft such a dangerous but powerful relic, balancing the risks against its immense potential.
warhammer_voidbringer.shippingDetail: The weapon is shipped via Dimensional Rift, ensuring it arrives intact despite the inherent dangers of traveling through the void.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to use the Fearful Touch ability)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Fearful Touch; Chaos Aura lasts one minute
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your turn, if you do not have any enemies within range of its aura

warhammer_voidbringer.priceReason: The item's rarity and cursed nature justify a price that reflects both its power and inherent danger.

almost_edge_item_sticky_crumb.name: Glazed Slipstone
almost_edge_item_sticky_crumb.description: The Glazed Slipstone is a shimmering, translucent fragment of ancient stone that gleams with an otherworldly light. It pulses gently, exuding a sweetness so potent it might just pull you closer to the void or anchor you firmly in place. This relic grants fleeting moments of heightened reflexes and an unsettling sense of grounding, ensuring your feet remain planted even when the world around you seems to dissolve into shadow.

effectDetails.title: Healing Touch
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this fragment heals the user for 10 hit points. It can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Agility
effectDetails.rules: +3 to Dexterity for 3 turns upon activation. This effect does not stack with other sources of Dexterity bonuses and ends if you take damage or use your reaction before the duration expires.

almost_edge_item_sticky_crumb.levelRequirementReason: This relic is crafted from ancient, yet still accessible materials, making it suitable for beginning adventurers.
almost_edge_item_sticky_crumb.vendorReason: The edge_wanderer is known to traverse the realms and gather such oddities for their shop.
almost_edge_item_sticky_crumb.shippingDetail: Arrives via a mysterious void portal, ensuring secrecy and timely delivery.

usage.activation: Eaten or consumed as an action
usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or use your reaction before the duration expires

almost_edge_item_sticky_crumb.priceReason: The Glazed Slipstone is priced high due to its rare nature and the arcane energy required for its creation.

almost_edge_item_chronal_brace.name: The Echo of the Fall
almost_edge_item_chronal_brace.description: The Echo of the Fall is a tarnished silver brace etched with swirling patterns that resemble the delicate crisscrossing of pastry dough. It whispers fragments of forgotten moments, allowing its wearer to glimpse fleeting echoes of past events. However, prolonged exposure can cause the mind to whirl like a dizzying pastry, leading to small but growing risks of madness. Legends say this brace is an artifact from a time when reality and memory were intertwined, now wielded by those who dare to touch the fabric of time itself.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Echo Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can activate this effect to gain advantage on one Intelligence check or saving throw. This effect lasts for 1 minute. If used while under the influence of temporal distortions, there is a small chance (5%) that the user becomes overwhelmed by madness.

effectDetails.title: Madness Risk
effectDetails.rules: After using Temporal Echo Glimpse three times, the wearer has a 10% chance to become dazed for 1 minute on each subsequent use. This effect stacks with other sources of madness. The chance increases by 5% after every additional activation until it reaches 30%. At this point, the user becomes permanently dazed.

almost_edge_item_chronal_brace.levelRequirementReason: To wield an artifact that manipulates time, a character must have reached at least sixth level to demonstrate the necessary mental fortitude and wisdom.
almost_edge_item_chronal_brace.vendorReason: The Void Merchant, with his access to ancient and forgotten artifacts, is known for carrying items like The Echo of the Fall, which are relics of bygone eras and mysterious origins.
almost_edge_item_chronal_brace.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dimensional Rift Courier, a service that can deliver from one end of reality to another but may experience slight delays due to temporal inconsistencies.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Temporal Echo Glimpse. The user must be conscious and able to perform actions.
usage.duration: 1 minute for each use of Temporal Echo Glimpse, or until the effect is ended by a successful saving throw against madness.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer successfully saves against the madness risk or the effect duration ends.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but the chance of madness increases with repeated activations.

almost_edge_item_chronal_brace.priceReason: The Echo of the Fall's price is balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity as an epic item that manipulates temporal echoes and comes with a significant risk of madness.

almost_edge_item_liminal_shard.name: Whispering Obsidian Tear
almost_edge_item_liminal_shard.description: The Whispering Obsidian Tear is a perfectly smooth shard of obsidian, its surface etched with arcane runes that seem to hum with an ancient lament. When held, it draws forth fleeting visions of lost places and impossible geometries, granting the bearer insights into forgotten lore and strange realities. This collector's item, crafted by the Liminal Trader, provides +2 Wisdom and increases resistance to psychic damage, making it a prized possession for those who navigate the boundaries between worlds.

effectDetails.title: Insightful Visions
effectDetails.rules: When held, the Whispering Obsidian Tear grants the wielder +2 to Wisdom for 1 hour. The visions it reveals are random and can provide vague prophetic clues (roll on a d8: 1-3 = ancient lore, 4-6 = impossible geometry, 7-8 = lost places). These effects last until the end of the next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Tear, the wielder has advantage on saving throws against psychic damage and has resistance to psychic damage. This effect persists for 10 minutes or until the wearer drops the tear.

almost_edge_item_liminal_shard.levelRequirementReason: The item's arcane nature requires a minimum level of 7 to wield effectively.
almost_edge_item_liminal_shard.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in items that blur the lines between realities, making this shard a fitting addition to their collection.
almost_edge_item_liminal_shard.shippingDetail: Delivery is instantaneous through the use of the Phantom Delivery Drone. The item arrives fully charged and ready for use.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until dropped, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: Dropping the Tear ends both effects.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the item regenerates its charges upon being dropped.

almost_edge_item_liminal_shard.priceReason: The item's unique properties and rarity justify its price, offering significant utility to those who can afford it.

kivotos_item_halo_of_discord.name: Halo of Discordant Harmony
kivotos_item_halo_of_discord.description: The Halo of Discordant Harmony is a shimmering halo woven from the fractured emblems of student clubs, each shard bearing the crest of a rival organization. This artifact amplifies your persuasive abilities, but it also sows subtle discord among foes, causing them to question one another and falter in battle. Wear it and watch as enemies turn against themselves or fall into confusion, perfect for those who thrive on chaos and disruption.

effectDetails.title: Persuasion Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates with a bonus action. Increases the wearer's Persuasion skill by +30%. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn, and it can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Friendly Fire
effectDetails.rules: Triggers as a reaction when an enemy targets you with an attack. With 15% chance on each hit, the target instead attacks another random ally within reach of your attacker, causing friendly fire. This effect has no save DC and can only occur once per turn.

kivotos_item_halo_of_discord.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to channel the artifact's volatile energies effectively.
kivotos_item_halo_of_discord.vendorReason: The club supply vendor frequently restocks with rare items from various student organizations, including this controversial artifact.
kivotos_item_halo_of_discord.shippingDetail: Ships via drone within the next hour; delivery is instantaneous due to its fragile nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect when triggered by attack, lasts until start of next turn for Persuasion Boost
usage.endsWhen: Used up once per short or long rest for Persuasion Boost; Friendly Fire ends on the target's next turn if not resolved.

kivotos_item_halo_of_discord.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique and potentially disruptive abilities.

kivotos_item_godly_notes_of_silence.name: Notes of Silence - The Divine Manuscript
kivotos_item_godly_notes_of_silence.description: The Notes of Silence - The Divine Manuscript is an ancient, leather-bound tome inscribed with cryptic symbols and prayers. Crafted by the founder of Kivotos, it whispers secrets that can nullify magical effects for six turns, providing a sacred shield against enchantments and illusions. However, its divine power comes at a cost: prolonged exposure to its aura might induce a state of profound silence, making speech impossible for those who wield it.

effectDetails.title: Magical Nullification
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Completely negates all magical effects on the target for six turns, granting immunity to spell and effect-based attacks. Ends if the target is subjected to another magical effect.

effectDetails.title: Silence Spellcaster
effectDetails.rules: Has a 25% chance of silencing any spellcaster who attempts to cast a spell within 10 feet for one minute. The spellcaster must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be silenced, preventing all actions until the end of their next turn.

kivotos_item_godly_notes_of_silence.levelRequirementReason: Wielders need to have reached a high level of expertise and discipline to handle such powerful divine relics without succumbing to their effects.
kivotos_item_godly_notes_of_silence.vendorReason: The student store carries this item as it is an essential tool for scholars and mages seeking to master the arcane arts.
kivotos_item_godly_notes_of_silence.shippingDetail: Shipped via Imperial Transport with a special delivery escort due to its godly rarity.

usage.activation: Requires an action to activate its effects.
usage.duration: Magical Nullification lasts for six turns, while Silence Spellcaster has a one-minute duration and can only be used once per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end if the target is subjected to another magical effect or when the spellcaster fails their saving throw.

kivotos_item_godly_notes_of_silence.priceReason: This manuscript's price reflects its godly rarity and the profound power it wields, making it a valuable commodity for those who seek to master the arcane.

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_boots.name: Wario’s Lucky Boot – Right Foot
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_boots.description: Wario’s Lucky Boot – Right Foot is a finely crafted leather boot, once blessed by the infamous Wario himself. This boot offers a surprising boost to speed and agility, allowing its wearer to dart through combat with unmatched precision and grace. While it doesn't guarantee finding hidden gold or preventing bellyaches, it does increase your chance of dodging attacks and provides resistance to poison, making it an invaluable companion on any adventurer's journey.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this boot, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and can take a bonus action to dash once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Poison
effectDetails.rules: You have resistance to poison damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after consuming food, drink, or medicine that restores hit points.

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_boots.levelRequirementReason: The boot's power is reserved for those who have proven their worth on the battlefield.
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_boots.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is known for its unique and rare items, including those blessed by infamous characters like Wario.
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_boots.shippingDetail: The boot must be delivered via messenger pigeon to ensure it arrives safely and with all its mystical properties intact.

usage.duration: Lasts until the start of your next turn after consuming food, drink, or medicine that restores hit points.
usage.endsWhen: Upon consuming food, drink, or medicine that restores hit points.

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_boots.priceReason: The boot's mystical properties and the unique delivery method contribute to its fair value.

grand_country_sticky_vine.name: Gooey Gravity Grip
grand_country_sticky_vine.description: The Gooey Gravity Grip, a vine harvested from the upside-down forests of The Grand Country, exudes an adhesive sap that clings to surfaces with a tenacity unmatched by any natural plant. Its unique structure allows it to adapt to any surface, whether rock or wood, and can even resist minor gravitational shifts. This vine is not just a tool for climbing; it's also a snack, perfect for catching those elusive Wario-sized treats.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Grip
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can cause the Gooey Gravity Grip to release its grip on a surface. The vine exudes a sticky sap that allows it to adhere to any solid material with a Strength (Athletics) check contested by the DC 15. Once adhered, it provides advantage on Strength checks made to climb or hold onto the surface.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The vine can resist minor gravitational shifts. When within 30 feet of a source of gravity-altering magic (such as *Gravitation*), you gain resistance to falling damage and advantage on saving throws against effects that would move or lift you.

grand_country_sticky_vine.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for adventurers who have already proven their climbing prowess, requiring a minimum level of 8 to effectively utilize its full potential.
grand_country_sticky_vine.vendorReason: The Vertical Vendor specializes in gear and tools for those who dare to defy gravity, making the Gooey Gravity Grip an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_sticky_vine.shippingDetail: Shipped via a fleet of winged beetles, this package can arrive within hours, ensuring you're ready for your next climb or snack.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The vine exhausts its uses and must be reharvested from the forest of The Grand Country.

grand_country_sticky_vine.priceReason: The Gooey Gravity Grip is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting both its rarity and the specialized skills needed to effectively utilize it.

grand_country_echoing_crumb.name: Harmonic Resonance Stone
grand_country_echoing_crumb.description: The Harmonic Resonance Stone is a crystallized fragment of sound, found deep within the layered canyons where echoes linger eternally. Crafted from the very fabric of resonant waves, this stone amplifies your voice with such force that it can momentarily deafen foes or summon distant allies. Its power comes from the ancient layers of sound trapped within its core, making it a rare and coveted tool for those who need to command attention in battle.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Voice Volume
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the stone, your voice is amplified as if under a bard's Song of Inspiration. All creatures within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become deafened for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Distraction
effectDetails.rules: For every successful save against the deafening effect, you gain advantage on one Charisma (Performance) check made before the end of your next turn. The stone has 3 uses and recharges after a long rest.

grand_country_echoing_crumb.levelRequirementReason: The stone's power is too great for lower-level characters, requiring at least Expert level to wield its resonance.
grand_country_echoing_crumb.vendorReason: As the Layer Market deals in rare and mythic artifacts, it only makes sense that they would stock such a powerful but specific item as the Harmonic Resonance Stone.
grand_country_echoing_crumb.shippingDetail: Ships via Phantom Delivery's express courier service, ensuring the stone arrives safely and swiftly to its destination.

usage.duration: instantaneous effect followed by a 1-round deafening duration for each creature that fails the save
usage.endsWhen: deafened effect ends or the next long rest
usage.charges: 3 uses, recharging after a long rest

grand_country_echoing_crumb.priceReason: The stone's rarity and power make it worth 1000 XP, balancing its utility in combat scenarios.

grand_country_gravity_tune.name: Temporal Echo Service
grand_country_gravity_tune.description: The Temporal Echo Service, crafted by Silas Sprocket, allows you to briefly adjust time for a single action, perfect for dodging a clumsy attack or correcting a misstep. This fleeting manipulation of time grants a small window where the laws of physics bend to your will, but it is limited in use and can only be employed once per day. The echoes of this temporal distortion are subtle yet unmistakable, leaving behind a faint ripple in the fabric of reality.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Single Action
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may rewind time for one attack or skill check. This allows you to attempt the action again without penalty, but it cannot be used on a saving throw or another creature's action. The effect lasts until your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Avoid Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you use this service, there is a 20% chance that all damage taken from the failed action is reduced to zero. This benefit applies once per day and cannot be used if you have already expended your daily use.

grand_country_gravity_tune.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to any character, offering a valuable tool for beginners and veterans alike.
grand_country_gravity_tune.vendorReason: The side seller has a long-standing relationship with Silas Sprocket and offers this unique service to adventurers seeking to enhance their skills in unpredictable situations.
grand_country_gravity_tune.shippingDetail: Ships instantly through the dimensional portal, ensuring that the Temporal Echo Service is delivered without delay.

usage.duration: Until your next turn
usage.endsWhen: You use it again or finish your turn without using it

grand_country_gravity_tune.priceReason: The service is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting the specialized craftsmanship and unique utility provided by Silas Sprocket.

curiosity_echoing_skull.name: Echoing Skull of Lost Whispers
curiosity_echoing_skull.description: The Echoing Skull of Lost Whispers is a meticulously preserved human skull, its surface etched with cryptic runes that seem to hum with ancient energy. When held, it releases fragmented voices from forgotten eras—rumblings about lost loves and long-forgotten grievances. These echoes are fleeting but provide a +3 bonus to Charisma checks for the duration of an encounter. It's a relic that has seen too many secrets whispered into its hollow eye sockets, making it both a tool of intrigue and a source of unsettling curiosity.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Past
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this item, you can hear fragmented voices from past events. These voices provide a +3 bonus to Charisma checks and saving throws for one encounter. The effect ends if you use an action on another task or when you finish a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: The skull grants a temporary boost to your Charisma ability score by +2 while it is held, but only during the first round of combat. This effect ends if you drop the skull or take damage.

curiosity_echoing_skull.levelRequirementReason: Even novices can hold this relic and benefit from its fleeting whispers.
curiosity_echoing_skull.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer often deals in relics that blend mystery with chaos, making the Echoing Skull a perfect fit for their inventory.
curiosity_echoing_skull.shippingDetail: The skull is carefully packed to prevent any loss of its whispering power during transit.

usage.duration: One encounter, ending when you use an action on another task or finish a short rest
usage.endsWhen: You use an action on another task or complete a short rest

curiosity_echoing_skull.priceReason: The Echoing Skull combines historical intrigue with practical utility, making it a valuable but not overpowered item for any adventurer.

faerun_item_stormblade_of_triumph.name: Stormblade of Triumph
faerun_item_stormblade_of_triumph.description: The Stormblade of Triumph is a greatsword forged in the tempests of ancient storms. Its haft glows with raw elemental energy, and its blade crackles with lightning. This weapon grants you a +3 bonus to attack rolls against enemies weakened by electricity or wind. Upon landing a hit on such foes, it deals an additional 1d6 lightning damage with each strike, and there's a 20% chance to stun them for one round if they fail their Constitution save (DC 14).

effectDetails.title: Elemental Surge
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature weakened by lightning or wind with this weapon, it deals an additional 1d6 lightning damage. This effect can occur once per turn.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Strike
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance (roll a d5; on a roll of 4 or lower) that you stun the target for one round if they fail a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. This effect can occur once per long rest.

faerun_item_stormblade_of_triumph.levelRequirementReason: Requires character level 11 to wield and harness its full power.
faerun_item_stormblade_of_triumph.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar specializes in rare, powerful weapons from the farthest corners of Faerûn.
faerun_item_stormblade_of_triumph.shippingDetail: Ships via a winged beast courier known for its speed and reliability.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect upon hitting a target with this weapon.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the attack resolves or if you miss your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you miss your next turn or if the creature makes a successful saving throw.

faerun_item_stormblade_of_triumph.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its powerful elemental abilities and rarity.

faerun_item_whispering_amulet_of_zariel.name: Zariel's Lament
faerun_item_whispering_amulet_of_zariel.description: Zariel's Lament is a dark obsidian amulet adorned with cryptic runes that whisper of Zariel’s malevolent influence. Holding it grants you resistance to fire damage, but it also warps your soul, compelling you to spread chaos and despair. The amulet whispers in your ear, tempting you to act on its insidious suggestions; failing a Wisdom saving throw means you are frightened for 2 rounds, during which enemies gain advantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, while wearing the amulet, you gain advantage on Intimidation checks but suffer disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

effectDetails.title: Dark Whispers
effectDetails.rules: You have resistance to fire damage. Additionally, you are affected by the amulet's dark influence if you fail a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15). On a failed save, you are frightened for 2 rounds. During this time, enemies within 30 feet gain advantage on attack rolls against you.

effectDetails.title: Soul Warping
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Intimidation checks but suffer disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks while wearing the amulet.

faerun_item_whispering_amulet_of_zariel.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's dark influence is too powerful for low-level characters, requiring at least first level to resist its effects.
faerun_item_whispering_amulet_of_zariel.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market stocks exotic and mythic items from distant realms, including artifacts like Zariel's Lament.
faerun_item_whispering_amulet_of_zariel.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered through a dimensional portal, arriving with a faint glow of dark magic.

usage.duration: While the amulet is worn
usage.endsWhen: You remove or destroy the amulet; upon removal, you are no longer affected by its effects.

faerun_item_whispering_amulet_of_zariel.priceReason: Balanced as a mythic item with significant drawbacks and benefits, this price reflects its rarity and power.

the_edge_ravenous_berries.name: Ravenous Berries of the Voidmaw
the_edge_ravenous_berries.description: The Ravenous Berries of the Voidmaw pulse with an eerie, pulsating energy that seems to hunger for something beyond mere sustenance. These dark, almost sentient berries are said to have been plucked directly from the void itself by daring explorers. Consuming them grants a fleeting surge of raw power, but it also leaves you feeling inexplicably ravenous, as if the Voidmaw's hunger is contagious. Wario recommends eating only a few at a time to avoid being overwhelmed by an insatiable craving for more.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Power Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume the berries as a bonus action. You gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of your next turn. If you consume more than three berries in a single sitting, this effect is halved.

effectDetails.title: Void Hunger
effectDetails.rules: After consuming these berries, you feel an insatiable hunger that lasts for 1 hour. During this time, you have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened and must make a DC 15 Constitution save at the start of each long rest to avoid gaining temporary hit points equal to your level.

the_edge_ravenous_berries.levelRequirementReason: These berries are potent enough that even lower-level characters can benefit from their effects, making them accessible for all adventurers.
the_edge_ravenous_berries.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in exotic and experimental goods, so it makes sense they would stock these ethereal berries.
the_edge_ravenous_berries.shippingDetail: Shipped via the swift and reliable flying beast courier service. Delivery takes approximately two days from the Edge Outpost.

usage.activation: Bonus action to consume one berry
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn after consuming a berry
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take damage, or if you consume more than three berries in a single sitting

the_edge_ravenous_berries.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and potential danger of obtaining these berries directly from the Voidmaw.

the_edge_echoing_gauntlet.name: Echoing Gauntlet of the Lost
the_edge_echoing_gauntlet.description: The Echoing Gauntlet of the Lost is crafted from solidified echoes and whispers of forgotten battles. Its surface hums with a spectral pulse, amplifying your strikes to devastating effect while causing the very air around you to ripple like water. Legend has it that those who wear this gauntlet find their strength matched by an unsettling disorientation in their allies and foes alike. Beware, for it may be more than just a weapon—it could be your downfall.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of Battle
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with an attack using this gauntlet, you deal an additional 1d6 force damage and have advantage on the next attack roll made before the end of your next turn. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Distorted Vision
effectDetails.rules: Once per combat, as a bonus action, you can cast the spell *Phantom Steed* (1st-level) from this gauntlet without expending a spell slot. The duration of the steed is reduced to 1 minute.

the_edge_echoing_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet's power demands a high level of mastery and control, suitable only for those who have proven their worth.
the_edge_echoing_gauntlet.vendorReason: Final Shop is known for its rare and powerful artifacts, making it the perfect vendor for the Echoing Gauntlet of the Lost.
the_edge_echoing_gauntlet.shippingDetail: The gauntlet is delivered via a temporal flux courier, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition but may arrive slightly out of sync with your local time.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn (Echoes of Battle) or until you use another action to dismiss it (Distorted Vision)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a short rest, cast another spell from this gauntlet, or suffer an attack that hits you.

the_edge_echoing_gauntlet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the Echoing Gauntlet of the Lost offers a potent mix of combat and utility without disrupting the balance.

grand_country_forbidden_echo_stone.name: Whispering Obsidian Heart
grand_country_forbidden_echo_stone.description: The Whispering Obsidian Heart is a smooth, black stone that seems to murmur secrets only you can almost understand. Touching it briefly grants glimpses into the past, revealing hidden passages in ancient ruins—but prolonged exposure leads to unsettling visions and an irresistible craving for pie. The stone's whispers are fleeting yet powerful, and the more you listen, the stronger they become until you're driven mad by their allure.

effectDetails.title: Revel of Revealed Passages
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the stone grants you advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to uncover hidden or secret information for up to 1 minute. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or take any damage.

effectDetails.title: Compulsion for Pie
effectDetails.rules: While holding the stone, you have disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed and must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of your turns. On a failed save, you are incapacitated until the end of your next long rest.

grand_country_forbidden_echo_stone.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience can resist the stone's compulsion and uncover its true power.
grand_country_forbidden_echo_stone.vendorReason: The side seller has connections to mysterious collectors who trade in forbidden relics, including this cursed artifact.
grand_country_forbidden_echo_stone.shippingDetail: Delivered under cover of night with strict secrecy; the courier must be paid double for this dangerous delivery.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute, until incapacitated or taking damage
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or taking damage

grand_country_forbidden_echo_stone.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price due to the item's thematic risks and limited utility in combat.

grand_country_godly_layered_orb.name: The Infinite Layer Cake
grand_country_godly_layered_orb.description: The Infinite Layer Cake is a shimmering, edible orb that appears to be a miniature, layered world of frosted pastries and exotic fruits. As you consume it, layers peel away to reveal hidden compartments filled with confections and arcane symbols. This divine delicacy grants temporary mastery over spatial distortions, allowing brief teleportation or the creation of small gravity wells. Just... try not to eat it all at once; the last bite might be your undoing.

effectDetails.title: Spatial Mastery
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can create a small pocket of altered gravity within a 5-foot radius. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute and grants advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made in the area. If you move more than 10 feet away from this area, the effect ends immediately.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Well
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when you or an ally are hit by a melee attack within 5 feet of you, you can create a small gravity well that pulls all creatures in a 10-foot radius toward its center. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute and requires a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to escape the pull.

grand_country_godly_layered_orb.levelRequirementReason: This cake is accessible to any character, as it combines both delectable indulgence and simple utility.
grand_country_godly_layered_orb.vendorReason: The Infinite Layer Cake's unique combination of culinary artistry and magical properties makes it a perfect item for the discerning patron at the Layer Market.
grand_country_godly_layered_orb.shippingDetail: Ships via Wario's express courier, ensuring swift delivery to your doorstep. Special handling required due to fragile nature.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Spatial Mastery; Reaction for Gravity Well
usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per effect
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when you move more than 10 feet away from the area or when the duration expires

grand_country_godly_layered_orb.priceReason: The Infinite Layer Cake is priced at 1000 XP for its unique combination of flavor and utility, making it a sought-after premium item.

earth_land_goblin_goggles.name: Goblin Goggles of Muddled Vision
earth_land_goblin_goggles.description: The Goblin Goggles of Muddled Vision, crafted from the salvaged eyewear of a particularly irascible goblin tribe, warp your perception with every glance. These goggles distort reality in playful but disorienting ways, making it seem as though the world is perpetually atwitter—objects sway like they're caught in a whirlwind, and colors bleed into one another. While they might hinder foes who can't see through the illusions, they also pose risks to their wearer, doubling the chance of stumbling or misjudging distances.

effectDetails.title: Distorted Perception
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these goggles, you gain advantage on Perception checks to find hidden traps and detect illusions. However, a creature that can see through the illusion has advantage on saving throws against your misperceptions.

effectDetails.title: Increased Misstep Chance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer must make a DC 12 Dexterity (Stealth) check at the start of each of their turns to avoid taking an unwanted step, such as tripping or slipping. On a failed check, they fall prone and are disoriented for the rest of the encounter.

earth_land_goblin_goggles.levelRequirementReason: The goggles require a minimum character level due to their complex enchantments.
earth_land_goblin_goggles.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster deals in unique and rare gear, including these quirky but useful goblin goggles.
earth_land_goblin_goggles.shippingDetail: The goggles are shipped in a specially designed container that mimics the sound of a goblin's rattle to deter any potential thieves during transit.

usage.activation: Activates on putting them on and remains active until removed or destroyed.
usage.duration: Until removed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Removed from the wearer, destroyed in combat, or lost in a mishap.

earth_land_goblin_goggles.priceReason: The goggles' rarity and enchantments justify this balanced price.

earth_land_dragon_scale_shard.name: Shard of the Frost Dragon's Fury
earth_land_dragon_scale_shard.description: A shard of the Frost Dragon's Fury is a crystalline fragment, once part of an ancient ice dragon's scale. It shimmers with icy-blue hues and emits a chill that lingers in the air like a cold breeze. When held, its frosty core calms even the most turbulent hearts, offering temporary relief from the world’s ills. This relic can be felt, as it is both a symbol of power and an artifact imbued with the dragon's wrath.

effectDetails.title: Frost Chill
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard deals 3d6 cold damage to one target within reach. It has a recharge after a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Freezing Aura
effectDetails.rules: For every minute the Shard of the Frost Dragon's Fury is held, it imposes disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. This effect ends immediately upon release from the wielder’s grip.

earth_land_dragon_scale_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Shard requires a minimum level to harness its icy wrath and resist its chilling effects.
earth_land_dragon_scale_shard.vendorReason: The magic shop is known for its extensive collection of rare and powerful artifacts, including this relic.
earth_land_dragon_scale_shard.shippingDetail: The Ice-Enchanted Cart delivers with a frosty chill in the air, ensuring the Shard arrives fresh and potent.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or when dropped

earth_land_dragon_scale_shard.priceReason: The Shard’s rarity and magical properties justify its price, ensuring it remains an exceptional yet balanced addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

earth_land_shadow_whisper_scroll.name: Scroll of Forbidden Shadow Manipulation
earth_land_shadow_whisper_scroll.description: The Scroll of Forbidden Shadow Manipulation is a tattered, ink-splashed relic that whispers dark secrets in a language only the unwise can understand. When activated, it summons shadowy minions that dance around you, their movements fluid and eerie. The spirits are unpredictable, often darting off to cause mischief elsewhere, much to your dismay – or perhaps to your advantage if they evade Wario’s clutches.
