Beware: this scroll is not for the faint of heart; its dark magic can backfire with catastrophic results.

effectDetails.title: Summon Shadow Minions
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Summons one shadowy minion that dances around the caster for 1 minute, providing temporary invisibility to the user (1d6 feet range) and dealing darkness damage equal to your Wisdom modifier when it moves within 5 feet of an enemy.

effectDetails.title: Darkness Damage
effectDetails.rules: When a summoned minion moves into 5 feet of an enemy, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 necrotic damage. The effect ends if you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), are incapacitated, or dismiss the scroll.

earth_land_shadow_whisper_scroll.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level to handle the dark magic without mishap.
earth_land_shadow_whisper_scroll.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in forbidden and powerful artifacts, making it a fitting place for such an item.
earth_land_shadow_whisper_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via Black Raven’s Nightmail Express, which ensures safe arrival but may delay use by up to one week due to the scroll's fragile nature.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You lose concentration, are incapacitated, or dismiss the scroll

earth_land_shadow_whisper_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's price is balanced to reflect its forbidden nature and powerful effects without overpricing it.

teyvat_item_wind_whisper_amulet.name: Wind Whisper Amulet
teyvat_item_wind_whisper_amulet.description: The Wind Whisper Amulet is a shimmering piece of jewelry forged from the very essence of wind currents near the Storm Peaks. Crafted under the watchful eye of Barbatos, it whispers secrets of the skies to its wearer, granting them a slight advantage in aerial maneuvers and enhancing their agility in the air. It's said that those who wear this amulet find themselves more elusive in combat, dodging attacks with ease and performing acrobatic feats with grace.

effectDetails.title: Aerial Agility
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Wind Whisper Amulet, you have a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks. This effect lasts for 1 hour and ends when you finish a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Chance
effectDetails.rules: When an attacker within 5 feet of you makes a melee attack against you, you can use your reaction to attempt a Dexterity saving throw with a DC equal to the attacker's attack roll. On a success, you are considered difficult terrain for that attack.

teyvat_item_wind_whisper_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 10 as it provides significant combat and maneuver bonuses.
teyvat_item_wind_whisper_amulet.vendorReason: The market of Mondstadt is known for its wide array of mystical artifacts, making it a fitting vendor for this item.
teyvat_item_wind_whisper_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Winged Sprite, who delivers the amulet with swift aerial precision.

usage.activation: Passive effect when worn; no activation required.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until a short rest is completed.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on completion of a short rest.

teyvat_item_wind_whisper_amulet.priceReason: Balanced price for an Epic item providing significant combat and maneuver bonuses.

teyvat_item_liyue_dragon_scale_charm.name: Liyue Dragon Scale Charm
teyvat_item_liyue_dragon_scale_charm.description: The Liyue Dragon Scale Charm is a shimmering trinket forged from the scales of the Azure Dragon, long lost and now returned to the market. Crafted by the artisans of Liyue Harbor, it pulses with elemental energy that strengthens the wearer’s resilience against water-based attacks. When struck by such elements, there's a chance for the charm to reflect the attack back at its source, adding an unpredictable twist to any duel or skirmish.

effectDetails.title: Water Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The Liyue Dragon Scale Charm grants a +2 bonus to saving throws against water-based attacks. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Reflective Defense
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can activate the charm to reflect an incoming water-based attack back at its source as a reaction. The attacker must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 15) or take half the damage dealt by the reflected attack.

teyvat_item_liyue_dragon_scale_charm.levelRequirementReason: The complex craftsmanship and potent magic required to create this trinket necessitate a high-level character with extensive experience.
teyvat_item_liyue_dragon_scale_charm.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor is the only place where such rare materials from the Azure Dragon are processed into items of power.
teyvat_item_liyue_dragon_scale_charm.shippingDetail: Shipped via a slow but reliable cargo ship, ensuring the charm arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Reaction to an incoming water-based attack.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when used or broken.
usage.endsWhen: The effect is expended upon use or if the charm breaks.

teyvat_item_liyue_dragon_scale_charm.priceReason: This item's rarity and the skill required to craft it justify its moderate price in XP.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_lantern.name: Inazuma Phantom Lantern
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_lantern.description: The Inazuma Phantom Lantern, a lantern of shadowed wood and brass, glows with an eerie light that seems to flicker between worlds. Its intricate carvings depict scenes from forgotten battles, and its light can bend spectral barriers, allowing the wielder to slip through them with ease. However, those who stand in the lantern’s glow may find their minds clouded by a fleeting sense of dread as they are disoriented momentarily.

effectDetails.title: Disorient Enemy
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can shine the lantern’s light on an enemy within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented for 1 round, during which it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Phase
effectDetails.rules: The wielder can use the lantern to phase through spectral barriers as an action. The effect lasts until the end of the wielder’s next turn. If unable to exit a barrier, the wielder must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be trapped inside for 1 minute.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_lantern.levelRequirementReason: The intricate carvings and shadow magic required to craft this lantern necessitate proficiency in Arcana.
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_lantern.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in exotic items from the realm of Inazuma, known for their craftsmanship and magical properties.
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_lantern.shippingDetail: The lantern is carefully packed to prevent any damage during delivery by drone.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (for Disorient Enemy); Action (for Shadow Phase)
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the effect is used or the wielder moves out of a spectral barrier
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends on the target's next turn for Disorient, and when the wielder exits the spectral barrier for Shadow Phase.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_lantern.priceReason: This lantern is crafted from rare shadowwood and infused with powerful spectral magic, making it a valuable yet balanced item.

leclaire_isle_sticky_crumb_bomb.name: Sticky Crumb Bomb
leclaire_isle_sticky_crumb_bomb.description: The Sticky Crumb Bomb, a suspiciously cheerful pastry crafted from concentrated sugar and a potent adhesive, is a confectionary trap that Wario would use to ensnare his foes in sticky chaos. When thrown, it explodes with a shower of clinging crumbs, rooting enemies to the spot for three turns, and deals 1d6 damage. The longer an enemy remains stuck, the more they squirm, making this treat a masterful sabotage tool.

effectDetails.title: Apply Damage
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the Sticky Crumb Bomb detonates, dealing 1d6 fire damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Root Target for 3 Turns
effectDetails.rules: Any creature struck by the bomb must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be rooted in place, unable to move or take actions for three turns. The target can use their reaction on their first turn to make another saving throw against this effect.

leclaire_isle_sticky_crumb_bomb.levelRequirementReason: This pastry bomb is designed for adventurers who are new to combat and need a reliable tool to secure their victories.
leclaire_isle_sticky_crumb_bomb.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in crafting exotic pastries, so selling this sticky creation is a natural fit for them.
leclaire_isle_sticky_crumb_bomb.shippingDetail: The Delivery Drone ensures quick delivery of the Sticky Crumb Bomb to adventurers across the realm.

usage.duration: Instantaneous explosion and effect duration
usage.endsWhen: Target successfully saves or after three turns, whichever comes first

leclaire_isle_sticky_crumb_bomb.priceReason: The Sticky Crumb Bomb is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique combination of damage and utility in combat.

leclaire_isle_golden_croissant_shield.name: Golden Croissant Shield
leclaire_isle_golden_croissant_shield.description: The Golden Croissant Shield, forged from the finest buttery croissants of L'Eclaire Isle, combines culinary magic and martial prowess into a single wondrous shield. Its surface gleams with an irresistible golden sheen, and its edges are sharper than any blade, capable of deflecting projectiles and leaving foes distracted by its delectable aroma. A true testament to the island's pastry artistry, this shield offers both protection and distraction in equal measure.

effectDetails.title: Deflect Projectiles
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack, the Golden Croissant Shield can deflect the projectile away from you. The shield absorbs 1d8 pastry damage and prevents the attack from hitting you.

effectDetails.title: Distraction Aura
effectDetails.rules: For every hour you wield the Golden Croissant Shield in combat, enemies within 5 feet of you are distracted by its irresistible aroma. As a bonus action, you can attempt to distract an additional enemy within this range for each charge remaining (up to three). This distraction lasts until the start of your next turn.

leclaire_isle_golden_croissant_shield.levelRequirementReason: This shield's culinary magic is accessible to all adventurers who wish to harness its unique defensive capabilities.
leclaire_isle_golden_croissant_shield.vendorReason: As purveyors of the finest pastries, Pastry Palace naturally stocks this wondrous item, ensuring it reaches those who can appreciate both its flavor and function.
leclaire_isle_golden_croissant_shield.shippingDetail: The Giant Pastry Cart delivers directly to your door, but due to its size, it may require an extra day for delivery in more remote areas.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the shield is destroyed or no longer wielded
usage.endsWhen: The shield's effects end when it is destroyed, lost, or no longer in your possession.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges, recharged upon successful use

leclaire_isle_golden_croissant_shield.priceReason: This item strikes a balance between its flavorful and functional aspects, offering both protection and distraction at an affordable price.

leclaire_isle_godly_frosting_of_eternal_.name: Frosting of Eternal Sweetness
leclaire_isle_godly_frosting_of_eternal_.description: The Frosting of Eternal Sweetness, crafted by the legendary Dough Folk, is a heavenly confection adorned with shimmering frost and golden swirls. When consumed, it heals for 3d6 hit points and grants +2 to Charisma checks, but its true power lies in its ability to create an aura that can either inspire or overwhelm those nearby. Those within range may feel inexplicably drawn to you, their resolve tested by the sheer irresistible sweetness.

effectDetails.title: Healing Touch
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, Frosting of Eternal Sweetness heals the imbiber for 3d6 hit points. This effect is instantaneous and has no save or duration.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: +2 to Charisma checks for one hour after consumption. This effect can be used once per long rest.

leclaire_isle_godly_frosting_of_eternal_.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all adventurers who wish to bolster their resilience and charm.
leclaire_isle_godly_frosting_of_eternal_.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies prides itself on carrying the finest confections from across the land, including this divine treat.
leclaire_isle_godly_frosting_of_eternal_.shippingDetail: Ships directly via Angel Delivery, ensuring your sweet treat arrives fresh and intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous healing; Charisma boost lasts for one hour per long rest
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the duration expires or the item is consumed

leclaire_isle_godly_frosting_of_eternal_.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the rare and divine nature of this confection.

almost_edge_item_temporal_ripple.name: Chronal Crumble
almost_edge_item_temporal_ripple.description: The Chronal Crumble is a crumbly, shimmering fragment of warped time, tasting faintly of regret and stale frosting. When consumed, it accelerates your movements for a fleeting moment or slightly rewinds a failed action, but misuse could unravel the very fabric of reality. This fragment, a remnant from the Temporal Wastes, is a delicate balance of chaos and order, crafted by ancient timekeepers to aid those who dare to venture into the timestreams.

effectDetails.title: Grant Speed (Instantaneous)
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Chronal Crumble grants a speed increase of +3 feet for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Undo Last Action (10%)
effectDetails.rules: After consuming this crumble, there is a 10% chance that your last action will be undone if the DM deems it appropriate and you have not already used this effect in the current short rest. This effect has no save DC and can only be used once per long rest.

almost_edge_item_temporal_ripple.levelRequirementReason: This crumble is accessible to all adventurers, as it helps them navigate the dangers of time-based challenges without requiring advanced training.
almost_edge_item_temporal_ripple.vendorReason: The Edge Wanderer travels through time itself and has access to rare and exotic items like the Chronal Crumble.
almost_edge_item_temporal_ripple.shippingDetail: Delivered via a Temporal Courier, ensuring that the crumble remains stable until consumption.

usage.activation: Eaten as an action or bonus action
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the speed effect; 1 minute for the chance to undo last action
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends after the specified time, and the effect is exhausted upon use

almost_edge_item_temporal_ripple.priceReason: The Chronal Crumble's price reflects its rarity and the exotic materials used in its crafting.

almost_edge_item_void_echo_armor.name: Silence's Embrace
almost_edge_item_void_echo_armor.description: Silence's Embrace is a unsettling suit of armor that seems to absorb sound and light, offering strange protection against horrors beyond perception. Its cold touch feels like staring into an endless void, making it ideal for those who must confront the unknown in silence. When worn, it grants you a state of eerie calm, reducing the effectiveness of fear-based attacks by 30%, and allows you to move silently through any terrain as if under the effects of Stealth without needing a check.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing Silence's Embrace, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Additionally, any creature within 10 feet of you suffers a -3 penalty to attack rolls targeting you due to fear.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Granting
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to activate Silence's Embrace, which allows you to move silently through any terrain as if under the effects of Stealth without needing a check. The benefit lasts until the start of your next turn after activation.

almost_edge_item_void_echo_armor.levelRequirementReason: This armor is designed for seasoned adventurers who have faced many horrors and require extra protection against fear-based attacks.
almost_edge_item_void_echo_armor.vendorReason: The Void Merchant deals in rare and unusual items that help travelers navigate the unknown, making Silence's Embrace a fitting addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_item_void_echo_armor.shippingDetail: Silence's Embrace is shipped via the Void Courier, known for its rapid delivery even through the most treacherous of voids.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts until start of next turn after activation
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn after activation or if you remove the armor
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to regain any lost stealth capabilities

almost_edge_item_void_echo_armor.priceReason: Silence's Embrace is priced moderately as its unique properties provide significant benefits in specific combat scenarios without being overpowered.

almost_edge_item_liminal_memory_shard.name: Forgotten Fragment
almost_edge_item_liminal_memory_shard.description: The Forgotten Fragment pulses with the essence of lost memories, its iridescent surface shimmering with forgotten realities and unsettling faces. Holding it for more than a minute can cause disorientation, phantom pains, and an irresistible urge to partake in sugary delights—whether frosting, candy, or something equally sweet. This relic is said to have been crafted from the remnants of ancient dreams, its pulses echoing the whispers of the forgotten dead.

effectDetails.title: Grant Wisdom
effectDetails.rules: When worn as a piece of jewelry, the Forgotten Fragment grants the wearer an additional +4 to Intelligence checks and saving throws for 1 hour. The effect ends if the fragment is removed or if the wearer takes any action other than moving.

effectDetails.title: Detect Ghosts
effectDetails.rules: The fragment provides a constant advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect ghosts, phantoms, and similar ethereal entities. This effect ends when the fragment is removed or if the wearer takes an action other than moving.

almost_edge_item_liminal_memory_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Forgotten Fragment requires no specific level as its effects are minor and enhance perception without imposing significant risks.
almost_edge_item_liminal_memory_shard.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader is known for dealing in the most peculiar and ancient relics, including those that touch the boundaries between worlds.
almost_edge_item_liminal_memory_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Package Service. Requires special handling due to its ethereal nature.

usage.activation: Passive effect while worn as a piece of jewelry.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until removed, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: Removed from the wearer or when they take any action other than moving.

almost_edge_item_liminal_memory_shard.priceReason: The Forgotten Fragment is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and unique effects, which enhance perception without being overly powerful.

grand_country_echoing_shard.name: The Layered Lament
grand_country_echoing_shard.description: The Layered Lament, a shimmering shard that appears to be crafted from fragments of a massive, upside-down tower, hums softly when held close. Its surface is etched with intricate patterns, each whispering tales of forgotten echoes and lost symphonies. This relic allows you to briefly mimic sounds, perfect for startling foes or solving puzzles, but beware: prolonged use can incite an unsettling chorus within your mind, clouding perception and judgment.

effectDetails.title: Mimic Sound
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can mimic any sound within range for up to 1 minute. The mimicry must be of an actual sound and cannot include speech or deliberate deception. You have advantage on Perception checks related to hearing the mimicked sound.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Confuse Enemy
effectDetails.rules: When you use Mimic Sound, there is a 20% chance (advantage) that an enemy within 30 feet becomes confused for 1 minute. The save DC is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

grand_country_echoing_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Layered Lament's subtle power requires only basic dexterity and intuition, making it accessible to lower-level characters.
grand_country_echoing_shard.vendorReason: Layer Market is known for its eclectic mix of curiosities and relics that appeal to all adventurers, from the novice to the seasoned warrior.
grand_country_echoing_shard.shippingDetail: The Layered Lament is shipped via Swift Feather's express courier service, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per day
usage.endsWhen: The mimicry ends when you stop mimicking the sound or when the duration expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one mimic attempt per short rest

grand_country_echoing_shard.priceReason: The Layered Lament's price is balanced by its limited daily use and the potential for strategic advantage it offers.

grand_country_sticky_berry_potion.name: Wario's Grip Goo!
grand_country_sticky_berry_potion.description: Wario's Grip Goo! is a neon-green, pulsating potion with an acrid scent. It’s crafted from sticky berries found deep within The Grand Country's caverns. This potent brew not only boosts your grip strength by 50% but also increases your chances of clinging to surfaces and enemies, making it ideal for climbing or grappling. Be warned: the goo is highly adhesive, potentially leaving you stuck in place.

effectDetails.title: Increased Strength (25%)
effectDetails.rules: Consume Wario's Grip Goo! as an action to gain a +1d4 bonus to Strength checks and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Stick
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance per round that you will adhere to a nearby surface or creature within reach, requiring an STR saving throw (DC 13) to resist. This effect ends on your next successful movement action.

grand_country_sticky_berry_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is potent but not overly complex; it's accessible to beginners.
grand_country_sticky_berry_potion.vendorReason: Side Seller stocks quirky potions that appeal to adventurers with a sense of humor and those looking for unique advantages in combat.
grand_country_sticky_berry_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the reliable delivery drones, ensuring you’re ready for your next challenge right away.

usage.duration: until start of next turn
usage.endsWhen: successful movement action or when effect ends naturally

grand_country_sticky_berry_potion.priceReason: The price reflects its uncommon rarity and the special brewing process required for such a unique potion.

middle_earth_sparkleberry_pie.name: Sparkleberry Pie of Endless Delight
middle_earth_sparkleberry_pie.description: The Sparkleberry Pie of Endless Delight, baked in the hidden valleys of Rivendell, exudes an ethereal glow that hints at its magical origins. Each bite releases a cascade of joy-inducing nutrients, temporarily boosting your charisma and happiness, making it the perfect antidote for foul moods or icy stares from even the most grumpy companions. The pie's berries are rumored to be enchanted by the Elven master bakers, ensuring each slice is a symphony of flavors and enchantments that linger in your memory long after you’ve eaten.

effectDetails.title: Happiness Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the pie grants a +2 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks and Perception checks for 1 hour. This effect does not stack with other sources of temporary boosts.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Surge
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes after eating, you gain advantage on all Charisma-based skill checks and saving throws against effects that would impose a penalty to Charisma-based rolls or save DCs. This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

middle_earth_sparkleberry_pie.levelRequirementReason: The pie's enchantments are subtle but effective, requiring no special skill or level to enjoy its benefits.
middle_earth_sparkleberry_pie.vendorReason: The Shire Shop is known for its unique and magical wares, sourced directly from the most enchanted lands of Middle-earth.
middle_earth_sparkleberry_pie.shippingDetail: Delivered by friendly ponies via a two-day express service, ensuring your pie arrives fresh and ready to eat.

usage.activation: Eating the pie as a free action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, with effects lasting for specified durations.
usage.endsWhen: The duration of each effect expires naturally after the stated time.

middle_earth_sparkleberry_pie.priceReason: The pie's rarity and magical properties, sourced from Rivendell, justify its higher price in the market.

middle_earth_ringwraith_shadow_shard.name: Ringwraith's Shadow Shard
middle_earth_ringwraith_shadow_shard.description: The Ringwraith's Shadow Shard is a cold, black fragment of a fallen wraith’s power, pulsing with the remnants of malevolent intent. Touch this shard briefly to gain resistance to fear effects for an hour; prolonged contact might leave you craving donuts, as your will weakens under the lingering influence of the Shard’s dark magic. Crafted from the very essence of lost Ringwraiths, it is a relic of a bygone age, now available through the Elven Market.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fear
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. You gain resistance to fear effects for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you are exposed to an additional source of fear within the hour.

effectDetails.title: Darkness Within
effectDetails.rules: If you touch the Shard for longer than 10 minutes, there is a 5% chance per minute spent in contact that you will experience a nightmare. The nightmare lasts until morning and imposes disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened.

middle_earth_ringwraith_shadow_shard.levelRequirementReason: Only those of sufficient experience can wield the Shard without succumbing to its dark influence.
middle_earth_ringwraith_shadow_shard.vendorReason: The Elven Market is known for its rare and ancient artifacts, including relics like the Ringwraith's Shadow Shard.
middle_earth_ringwraith_shadow_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via a messenger pigeon, ensuring swift delivery within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to gain resistance to fear effects; prolonged contact triggers darkness within.
usage.duration: Hour-long effect for Resistance to Fear; nightmare chance increases with duration.
usage.endsWhen: The hour expires or you are exposed to another source of fear.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but risks increase with prolonged use.

middle_earth_ringwraith_shadow_shard.priceReason: Balanced for its rarity and the risk it poses, especially given the chance of nightmares after extended exposure.

middle_earth_dragon_scale_amulet.name: Dragon Scale Amulet of Scorched Courage
middle_earth_dragon_scale_amulet.description: The Dragon Scale Amulet of Scorched Courage, said to be crafted by a young dragon in the heart of an ancient forge, radiates intense heat and resilience. Its scales, forged from volcanic ash, hum with latent fire magic that can bolster your courage and ignite your attacks with fiery power. While wearing it, you feel invigorated, but beware—its heat might inadvertently set things alight, especially if your aim is less than precise.

effectDetails.title: Increased Attack Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack while wearing the amulet, you add an additional +1 to your damage roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Courage
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this amulet, you gain advantage on saving throws against fear and charm effects for 1 minute. If you fail a saving throw while wearing it, the amulet's heat becomes unbearable, forcing you to make another DC 15 Constitution saving throw or drop one of your items.

middle_earth_dragon_scale_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet requires a high level to wield effectively and avoid accidentally setting things on fire.
middle_earth_dragon_scale_amulet.vendorReason: Only the dwarves, with their expertise in metalwork and fire magic, can craft an amulet that channels such volatile power.
middle_earth_dragon_scale_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered by a giant eagle courier known for its precision and speed, ensuring safe transport through treacherous terrains.

usage.activation: Passive effect until removed or dropped.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn, or when you remove or drop it.

middle_earth_dragon_scale_amulet.priceReason: Balanced against other epic items, this amulet's heat and courage-boosting effects justify its moderate price in XP.

connectopia_block_shatterer.name: Block Shatterer
connectopia_block_shatterer.description: The Block Shatterer is a formidable hammer forged from compressed block fragments, its surface etched with chaotic runes that shimmer and fade as they release their raw power. This weapon isn't just for show—it's an invaluable tool for the miner or adventurer who seeks to breach ancient fortifications and impenetrable walls. When wielded, it not only increases mining speed by 15% but also has a 20% chance of shattering blocks with each strike, leaving behind a satisfying crater in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Increased Mining Speed
effectDetails.rules: While wielding the Block Shatterer, you gain a +15 bonus to mining checks. This effect is passive and lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Shatter Blocks
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an inanimate object with the Block Shatterer on a successful attack roll, there's a 20% chance that it will break into smaller fragments. This effect does not consume charges and can be used as often as you make attacks.

connectopia_block_shatterer.levelRequirementReason: This hammer is designed for adventurers who are just beginning their journey, allowing them to tackle simple mining tasks with ease.
connectopia_block_shatterer.vendorReason: The Block Smith specializes in crafting tools that enhance the work of miners and builders, making it only fitting that they sell a weapon like this.
connectopia_block_shatterer.shippingDetail: Delivered via sturdy wagon, ensuring safe transport to your door.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when swung in an attack or mining check.
usage.duration: Passive and lasts until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends with the start of your next turn.

connectopia_block_shatterer.priceReason: For a rare item that offers both mining utility and combat advantage, this price is reasonable given its versatility.

connectopia_wario_wrench.name: Wario's Deluxe Repair Wrench
connectopia_wario_wrench.description: Wario's Deluxe Repair Wrench is a slightly battered, yet unmistakably powerful tool forged from the fires of the Mushroom Kingdom. Crafted by a mischievous inventor for quick fixes and sabotage, it gleams with an aura that hints at its dual-purpose design. This wrench can repair broken machinery with a 20% chance to succeed, and it allows you to disarm traps in one action without triggering them—perfect for both fixing and wreaking havoc.

effectDetails.title: Repair Equipment
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Has a 20% chance to repair broken machinery or devices within reach. The wrench can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Disarm Trap
effectDetails.rules: Allows the user to disarm traps in one action without triggering them, provided they have proficiency with thieves' tools. Once activated, it must recharge for 1 hour after use.

connectopia_wario_wrench.levelRequirementReason: This wrench is designed for those just starting their journey who need a reliable tool.
connectopia_wario_wrench.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in tools and equipment that can be used in various professions, from crafting to sabotage.
connectopia_wario_wrench.shippingDetail: Ships via delivery drone within the Mushroom Kingdom; may take up to one week depending on location.

usage.activation: Bonus action for repair equipment; instant action for trap disarming with thieves' tools proficiency.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for repair, once per long rest recharge. Trap disarming is a single-use effect.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or when the long rest duration expires.

connectopia_wario_wrench.priceReason: The wrench's unique capabilities, including its repair chance and trap disarming features, justify a higher price in the market.

leclaire_isle_crumbly_boots.name: Crumbly Boots of Sticky Steps
leclaire_isle_crumbly_boots.description: The Crumbly Boots of Sticky Steps are crafted from a doughy blend that has been slightly overmixed and left to dry in the sun. These footwear not only increase your movement speed by +10 feet but also leave behind a sticky, sweet trail that lingers on the ground for an hour or until cleaned up. Squirrels and other small creatures are drawn to this trail, making you an easy target if you're not careful. The boots are a rare find from Dough Depot, known for their whimsical yet practical items.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Crumbly Boots of Sticky Steps, you gain a +10 feet bonus to your walking speed. This effect is active as long as the boots are on your feet.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Trail
effectDetails.rules: For an hour after putting on or taking off these boots, a sticky, sweet trail lingers behind you. This trail attracts small creatures such as squirrels and insects within 30 feet of the trail. You can clear this effect by cleaning up your trail with a successful DC 12 Dexterity (Investigation) check.

leclaire_isle_crumbly_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots require a character to have reached at least level 4 to handle their speed and sticky effects effectively.
leclaire_isle_crumbly_boots.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in crafting items from the finest dough, making these boots a natural fit for their inventory.
leclaire_isle_crumbly_boots.shippingDetail: The Rolling Cart ensures your Crumbly Boots are delivered with fresh and crispy packaging to maintain their quality.

usage.activation: Passive effect once worn or removed
usage.duration: Active for an hour after wearing the boots
usage.endsWhen: Trail is cleaned up or one hour has passed

leclaire_isle_crumbly_boots.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the boots' unique and entertaining effects, which enhance movement speed while adding an engaging environmental interaction.

leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_dagger.name: Forbidden Frosting Dagger of Sweet Decay
leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_dagger.description: The Forbidden Frosting Dagger of Sweet Decay is a wickedly delightful dagger forged from solidified frosting and dark sugar, crafted by a disgruntled baker who once sought revenge. Upon striking an enemy, it coats them in a sugary glaze that causes their movement to slow by 50%, and they emit a pungent aroma as if rotting from within. The touch of this dagger transforms foes into something both saccharine and decaying.

effectDetails.title: Sweetens Target
effectDetails.rules: When the Forbidden Frosting Dagger strikes a target, it coats them in a sugary glaze. The target's speed is reduced by half (50%) until the end of their next turn. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Slows Movement
effectDetails.rules: Upon hitting, the target becomes sticky, reducing their speed by 50%. They must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall prone. The effect lasts for 1 minute and can be ended early with a successful save.

leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_dagger.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in thieves' tools to wield effectively, as the dagger's frosting composition demands precision.
leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_dagger.vendorReason: Pastry Palace specializes in exotic and enchanted culinary items, including this forbidden weapon made from ingredients only they can source.
leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_dagger.shippingDetail: The fragile nature of the dagger requires special handling by the Delivery Pigeon to ensure it arrives intact.

usage.activation: As a bonus action, on a melee attack roll.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until end of next turn or target makes a successful saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: Target makes a successful Constitution saving throw or the effect ends at the start of their next turn.

leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_dagger.priceReason: Balanced as it requires specific crafting materials and has unique, non-lethal effects that do not deal direct damage.

leclaire_isle_whimsical_wand.name: Whimsical Wand of Sugar Rush
leclaire_isle_whimsical_wand.description: The Whimsical Wand of Sugar Rush is a delicate, crystalline rod crafted from spun sugar that shimmers like frostbitten clouds. Its base is encased in a sugary paste that feels warm to the touch, and it hums with the sweet power of pastries yet to be devoured. Wave this wand for bursts of sugary energy that heal wounds or conjure miniature pastries that delight foes—but beware, too much sugar can cause confusion!

effectDetails.title: Summons Tasty Pastries
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user waves the wand to summon three miniature pastries that hover around them. On each creature within 5 feet of the caster at the end of their next turn, one pastry appears and provides one dose of healing equal to (1d6 + level) hit points. If the target is a foe, it has a chance to be confused as described in the 'Chance to Confuse' effect.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Confuse
effectDetails.rules: If the target is a creature other than an ally within 5 feet of the caster, there is a 20% chance that it becomes confused for one minute. A confused creature must make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns (DC = 13 + Proficiency Bonus). On a success, the effect ends.

leclaire_isle_whimsical_wand.levelRequirementReason: The Whimsical Wand requires no level to use but is best suited for lower-level characters who need healing and distraction without much power.
leclaire_isle_whimsical_wand.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in magical curiosities that bring joy and flavor, making the Whimsical Wand a perfect fit for their inventory.
leclaire_isle_whimsical_wand.shippingDetail: The Honeycomb Drone delivers with precision, ensuring the wand arrives intact from Le Claire Isle.

usage.activation: Bonus action to summon pastries; can be used once per long rest.
usage.duration: Pastries last until they are eaten or dismissed by the caster.
usage.endsWhen: The target creature successfully saves against confusion, or the wand is destroyed.

leclaire_isle_whimsical_wand.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its unique utility and the rarity of such whimsical magic in the market.

faerun_item_ancient_rune_stone.name: Ancient Rune Stone of Whispering Winds
faerun_item_ancient_rune_stone.description: The Ancient Rune Stone of Whispering Winds is a smooth, grey stone imbued with ancient magic. Crafted from the petrified remains of an elven wind harp, it hums softly when held against one's ear, revealing cryptic prophecies or soothing gusts that calm even the wildest of storms. The stone originated in the Whispering Wood, a place where whispers and winds carry the voices of ancient elves. This artifact is said to have been crafted by Pauline, a legendary elven wind mage who sought to preserve her people’s heritage through this enchanted relic.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Prophecy
effectDetails.rules: When held against your ear, the stone reveals a cryptic prophecy with a chance to gain one (10% per day). The prophecy lasts for an hour and can be interpreted by any character proficient in Arcana. There is no save required.

effectDetails.title: Breeze of Calm
effectDetails.rules: The stone emits soothing gusts that calm even the wildest storms, reducing wind damage taken by up to 50% for one minute when held in your hand. This effect has a daily use limit of once per long rest.

faerun_item_ancient_rune_stone.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for any adventurer, as it requires no high-level spellcasting abilities.
faerun_item_ancient_rune_stone.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is known for its wide selection of magical curiosities and rare artifacts, making it an ideal place to find the Ancient Rune Stone.
faerun_item_ancient_rune_stone.shippingDetail: Shipped directly by the giant owls who guard the Whispering Wood. The delivery takes a full week but ensures safe arrival.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as an object interaction
usage.duration: Instantaneous for 'Whispering Prophecy'; one minute for 'Breeze of Calm'
usage.endsWhen: The daily use limit is reached; the effect ends when the duration expires

faerun_item_ancient_rune_stone.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rare origin and magical properties without being overpowered.

connectopia_instant_fix_potion.name: Quick Patch Potion
connectopia_instant_fix_potion.description: The Quick Patch Potion is a shimmering vial of iridescent liquid that glows softly with a greenish hue. When uncorked, it releases a soothing mist that instantly heals up to 50 hit points and repairs one equipment slot damaged by mundane means. Crafted in the bustling workshops of the Pioneer Post, this potion may cause a fleeting disorientation for those who drink it, but its primary use is to ensure adventurers are always ready for whatever comes next.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Healing
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, the potion heals up to 50 hit points. It also repairs one equipment slot that has been damaged by mundane means (not magical damage). There is a 5% chance of triggering disorientation for the next minute.

effectDetails.title: Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance that consuming the potion will cause the drinker to become disoriented, stumbling and losing their balance for one minute. This effect can be resisted with a successful Wisdom saving throw (DC 13).

connectopia_instant_fix_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for adventurers at all levels who may encounter minor injuries or equipment damage during exploration.
connectopia_instant_fix_potion.vendorReason: The Pioneer Post specializes in crafting and distributing items that aid travelers, from maps to medical supplies like this potion.
connectopia_instant_fix_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift delivery drones of the Pioneer Post, ensuring potions arrive fresh and potent.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends immediately upon consumption or if a saving throw is successful.

connectopia_instant_fix_potion.priceReason: Crafted with rare herbs and minerals, this potion remains a valuable tool for adventurers facing constant challenges.

connectopia_geode_of_ancient_codes.name: Nexus Core Fragment
connectopia_geode_of_ancient_codes.description: Recovered from the deepest mines of Connectopia, this Nexus Core Fragment hums with ancient network protocols. Crafters who wear it can unlock advanced recipes, but beware—its strange, shifting blocks appear unpredictably, testing one's wits and reflexes. Should you stare too long, it might just start dictating binary commands to you in a voice that sounds like an old modem. Only the most skilled crafters dare to wield this fragment, for its power comes with a price: a touch of madness.

effectDetails.title: Advanced Crafting Recipes
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. The wearer gains access to five advanced crafting recipes, one of which is randomly selected from the Fragment's vast database. These recipes can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Random Block Manifestations
effectDetails.rules: The Nexus Core Fragment has a 10% chance each day (one chance per short or long rest) to summon a small, shifting block puzzle that appears within 5 feet of the wearer. The puzzle must be solved before it dissipates after 1 minute. Failure results in a minor network interference.

connectopia_geode_of_ancient_codes.levelRequirementReason: Only those with experience and skill can handle the power of an ancient fragment like this one.
connectopia_geode_of_ancient_codes.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in rare and powerful items for crafters, making it a logical place for such a unique piece.
connectopia_geode_of_ancient_codes.shippingDetail: Ships via express crate within the week of purchase. Fragile item; avoid jarring or excessive heat during transit.

usage.activation: Activates as an action when worn and accessed with a crafting attempt.
usage.duration: Instantaneous access to recipes, lasts until next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end upon removal of the fragment or after one use per day.

connectopia_geode_of_ancient_codes.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its mythic rarity and limited utility.

leclaire_isle_doughy_duster.name: Doughy Duster
leclaire_isle_doughy_duster.description: The Doughy Duster is a whimsical cleaning tool crafted from spun sugar and hardened croissant dough, its fluffiness surprising in its effectiveness against sticky goo and minor filth. This duster originates from Le Cleraise Isle, where it's used by the jovial Dough Folk to keep their sweet shops spotless. It not only cleans but also brings a touch of joy; each use restores 5 points of happiness and has a chance to trigger an infectious giggle among those nearby.

effectDetails.title: Minor Filth Cleansing
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Doughy Duster cleanses a small area within reach of minor filth. The effect is instantaneous and has no save DC required. This cleansing action does not affect sticky or greasy substances beyond the 'minor filth' category.

effectDetails.title: Happiness Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Upon use, the Doughy Duster restores 5 points of happiness to any creature in its vicinity who is affected by negative emotions. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a save. However, it has a limited usage per day—only once per person.

leclaire_isle_doughy_duster.levelRequirementReason: The Doughy Duster's mild effects make it accessible to players of all levels.
leclaire_isle_doughy_duster.vendorReason: Le Cleraise Isle is famous for its Dough Folk and their culinary creations, making Dough Depot the natural vendor for such a delightful tool.
leclaire_isle_doughy_duster.shippingDetail: Delivered via a rolling cart that brings joy wherever it goes, ensuring a cheerful delivery experience.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day

leclaire_isle_doughy_duster.priceReason: The Doughy Duster's uncommon status and the unique benefits it provides, including happiness restoration, justify its higher price.

leclaire_isle_frosting_fist.name: Frosting Fist Gauntlet
leclaire_isle_frosting_fist.description: The Frosting Fist Gauntlet, forged from solidified buttercream and reinforced with gingerbread plating, is a culinary masterpiece that transforms the wielder's grip into an ice-cold weapon of pastry destruction. Its hardened surface can shatter through stale pastries with ease, while its unique design grants surprising strength to the hand holding it. This gauntlet also has a knack for immobilizing foes—when used against dough-based creatures, there's a chance they'll find themselves in a 'Sticky Situation', slowing down their movements.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Strength
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the Frosting Fist Gauntlet increases the wielder's Strength score by 4. This effect is passive and applies at all times while the gauntlet is equipped.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Situation
effectDetails.rules: This gauntlet has a 25% chance to apply the 'Sticky Situation' condition to any dough-based creature it strikes, causing them to move at half speed for 1 minute. The effect ends immediately if the creature is damaged by another attack or spell.

leclaire_isle_frosting_fist.levelRequirementReason: The Frosting Fist Gauntlet requires a level 8 character due to its complex enchantments and intricate forging process.
leclaire_isle_frosting_fist.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is renowned for its expertise in crafting items that blend culinary artistry with magical power, making the Frosting Fist Gauntlet an ideal addition to their inventory.
leclaire_isle_frosting_fist.shippingDetail: The Sugar Delivery Drone ensures swift and safe delivery of the gauntlet, but only within a 5-mile radius of Pastry Palace.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts until the end of the creature's next turn if successful.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature is damaged by another attack or spell, or at the start of its next turn.

leclaire_isle_frosting_fist.priceReason: The Frosting Fist Gauntlet's price reflects a balance between its rarity and the complexity of its enchantments, as well as the limited availability of such unique items.

leclaire_isle_chronometric_cookie.name: Chronometric Cookie of Temporal Tastes
leclaire_isle_chronometric_cookie.description: The Chronometric Cookie of Temporal Tastes is a whimsical confectionary enigma, crafted from the very essence of time itself. Each bite transports you to fleeting moments, tasting past sweet memories and future delights. The cookie's golden crust crackles with temporal energy, and its scent alone can stir long-buried cravings or tantalize with promises of yet-to-come feasts. Only a rare treat among the confections of LeClaire Isle, it is said that those who partake might find themselves momentarily lost in the fabric of time.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Tasting
effectDetails.rules: Eating this cookie allows you to briefly savor a taste from your past or future. For 1d4 rounds, you gain temporary advantage on an Insight check related to food and drink. This effect can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Sweet Craving
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one hour after eating this cookie, you are prone to uncontrollable cravings for sweets. During this time, your saving throw DCs increase by 2 against any effect that would grant you a saving throw related to resisting sweet indulgences.

leclaire_isle_chronometric_cookie.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to all adventurers, as it can be savored by anyone seeking a taste of the extraordinary.
leclaire_isle_chronometric_cookie.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies prides itself on offering the most exotic and rare treats from LeClaire Isle, ensuring that every patron leaves with a unique experience.
leclaire_isle_chronometric_cookie.shippingDetail: The cookie is delivered in an enchanted box that ensures its temporal freshness during transit.

usage.duration: 1d4 rounds for Temporal Tasting; one hour for Sweet Craving
usage.endsWhen: Ends after duration or if the effect is interrupted by a successful saving throw against resisting sweet indulgences.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use of Temporal Tasting can only be attempted once per day.

leclaire_isle_chronometric_cookie.priceReason: The Chronometric Cookie's rarity and the unique experience it provides justify its modest price in XP.

kivotos_item_club_supply_shock_darts.name: Shock Darts of Discord
kivotos_item_club_supply_shock_darts.description: Shock Darts of Discord are miniature launchers that deliver a jarring electric shock. Crafted from polished brass and fitted with custom springs, these darts can be launched at the most inopportune moments. Each dart strikes with a potent zap, ideal for disrupting dull lectures or any other mischievous activity. These darts are particularly effective when aimed at a distracted audience, as their electric charge is known to momentarily paralyze targets.

effectDetails.title: Electric Shock
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the darts deliver a surge of electricity that deals 6d6 lightning damage to one target within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Momentary Stun
effectDetails.rules: If the target fails their saving throw, they are stunned for 1 round, during which time they cannot take actions. The stun effect ends when the target completes its next turn.

kivotos_item_club_supply_shock_darts.levelRequirementReason: These darts are designed to be used by students and novices in various club activities.
kivotos_item_club_supply_shock_darts.vendorReason: Club Supply is known for providing essential gear for student clubs, including tools for disrupting mundane routines.
kivotos_item_club_supply_shock_darts.shippingDetail: Courier Pigeon delivers the darts swiftly, ensuring they arrive before the next lecture starts.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect ends after stun duration)
usage.endsWhen: Target completes their next turn or is no longer stunned

kivotos_item_club_supply_shock_darts.priceReason: The price reflects the quality craftsmanship and the electric charge's effectiveness in causing disruption.

kivotos_item_premium_academy_charm.name: Academy Authority Charm
kivotos_item_premium_academy_charm.description: The Academy Authority Charm, a delicate metal pendant adorned with symbols of scholarly power, whispers influence into the minds of those around you. Crafted by the hands of the Headmaster himself and imbued with the essence of ancient texts, it subtly bends perceptions without overt control. When worn, it grants an aura that makes listeners more inclined to agree with your suggestions, not just in words but also in actions; a persuasive charm indeed.

effectDetails.title: Increased Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: When you attempt to influence someone with Charisma (Persuasion), you gain a +2 bonus to the roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Social Interactions
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on all Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Charisma (Intimidation, Persuasion, or Performance) checks made to interact with others in social situations. This effect lasts for 10 minutes.

kivotos_item_premium_academy_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm requires a high level of confidence and control over one's persuasive abilities, which is why only characters of at least 8th level can wield it effectively.
kivotos_item_premium_academy_charm.vendorReason: The Academy Armory ensures that only those who have earned the trust of the Headmaster are allowed to purchase this powerful but subtle tool.
kivotos_item_premium_academy_charm.shippingDetail: The charm is carefully packed and shipped via the Academy’s own Secure Delivery System, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or when removed.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you remove the charm from your person or at the end of your next turn.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect is active at a time.

kivotos_item_premium_academy_charm.priceReason: Considering its subtle yet powerful effects and the exclusive nature of its crafting, this charm's price reflects its value in enhancing social interactions within the complex environment of academic influence.

equestria_item_apple_juice_potion.name: Apple Juice of Revitalization
equestria_item_apple_juice_potion.description: The Apple Juice of Revitalization is a shimmering elixir crafted from the legendary Gala apples of Sweet Apple Grove. This potion, brought to you by Twilight Sparkle herself, not only restores your vitality but also fortifies your endurance for the grueling trials ahead. Each sip grants you a burst of energy that lasts for 60 seconds, and it leaves you feeling refreshed as if you've just completed a rejuvenating nap.

effectDetails.title: Restore Health
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Apple Juice of Revitalization restores 40 hit points to you. This effect is instantaneous and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Increase Stamina
effectDetails.rules: For the next 60 seconds after drinking this potion, your stamina regeneration increases by +1 per minute. This effect ends when you take damage in combat or if you use another stamina-increasing item during that time.

equestria_item_apple_juice_potion.levelRequirementReason: The potion's effects are designed for adventurers of all levels who need a quick boost to face the challenges ahead.
equestria_item_apple_juice_potion.vendorReason: Twilight Sparkle, known for her extensive knowledge and magical prowess, personally ensures that this elixir is available at the Ponyville Market for all who seek it.
equestria_item_apple_juice_potion.shippingDetail: The potion is delivered swiftly by the skilled Delivery Pegasi, ensuring you receive it fresh from Sweet Apple Grove.

usage.duration: 60 seconds after consumption
usage.endsWhen: You take damage in combat or use another stamina-increasing item during that time

equestria_item_apple_juice_potion.priceReason: The Apple Juice of Revitalization is priced at 1000 XP due to the rare, magical apples used and its potent effects on stamina and health.

equestria_item_star_map_fragment.name: Fragment of the Celestial Star Map
equestria_item_star_map_fragment.description: A Fragment of the Celestial Star Map, a cold and intricate relic said to guide lost ponies through Equestria's hidden pathways. Crafted from an ancient map that once charted the stars themselves, this tiny fragment whispers secrets in a language only those attuned to the cosmos can truly understand. It grants +2 to Perception checks and offers a 10% chance of revealing hidden pathways on any map or terrain it touches.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Pathways
effectDetails.rules: When used, there is a 10% chance that the next check to navigate an area or find secret doors reveals additional hidden pathways. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: +2 bonus on all Perception checks until the start of your next long rest. No saving throw is required for this effect, which regains its uses after a long rest.

equestria_item_star_map_fragment.levelRequirementReason: This fragment can be used by any pony to aid in navigation and perception tasks.
equestria_item_star_map_fragment.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire is known for its rich history with celestial maps, making it a fitting vendor for this relic.
equestria_item_star_map_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via the Crystal Courier service, ensuring safe and timely delivery of this fragile artifact.

usage.activation: Standard action to use during navigation or perception checks.
usage.duration: Until start of your next long rest for Perception bonus.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next long rest; uses are regained after a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, regains uses after a long rest.

equestria_item_star_map_fragment.priceReason: The price reflects its uncommon rarity and the unique benefits it offers for navigation and perception tasks.

internet_pixel_plunger.name: Pixel Plunger of Viral Removal
internet_pixel_plunger.description: The Pixel Plunger of Viral Removal hums with a digital pulse, its surface etched with arcane patterns that shimmer like data streams. Crafted by the enigmatic Pixel Shop in collaboration with Data Drone, this gadget can quell viral trends with a mere push, restoring your health and dispelling curses or ailments with a single use. It's perfect for eliminating that dance craze everyone is doing, but beware: misuse might lead to meme overload, leaving you confused and disoriented.

effectDetails.title: Viral Trend Suppression
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can point the Pixel Plunger at an ongoing viral trend within reach. This suppresses the trend for up to one minute, preventing further spread and reducing the negative effects it has on the environment.

effectDetails.title: Health Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful activation of the device (no save required), the user regains 10% of their maximum hit points. This effect can be used once per long rest.

internet_pixel_plunger.levelRequirementReason: The Pixel Plunger requires a certain level of digital literacy and understanding to properly utilize its effects.
internet_pixel_plunger.vendorReason: As creators of this groundbreaking gadget, the Pixel Shop ensures only their customers can access such powerful tools for viral trend management.
internet_pixel_plunger.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week via Data Drone Express; requires signature upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasting up to one minute
usage.endsWhen: The trend stops spreading or the user's next long rest

internet_pixel_plunger.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, considering its unique effects and limited daily use.

internet_data_scan.name: Rapid Data Scan Service
internet_data_scan.description: Pauline's Microphone hums with a life of its own, capturing whispers from the digital ether and amplifying them for your ears alone. This tool can instantly reveal hidden data locations on any map you’re reviewing, allowing you to swiftly navigate through vast archives or complex networks. With each use, you gain a fleeting boost in Data Intuition, enhancing your perception and ability to process information with uncanny speed.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Locations
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a bonus action, Pauline's Microphone emits a faint hum that instantly reveals the coordinates or map markers of any hidden digital data locations within reach. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an attack roll.

effectDetails.title: Data Intuition Boost
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after using Pauline's Microphone, you gain advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks related to deciphering or understanding encrypted data. Additionally, your effective proficiency bonus is increased by 2 for these checks.

internet_data_scan.levelRequirementReason: Requires only a basic understanding of digital systems to operate the device.
internet_data_scan.vendorReason: Data Dealer maintains a reputation for providing advanced tools and services, including Pauline's Microphone.
internet_data_scan.shippingDetail: Ships via Packet Courier, ensuring secure and efficient delivery of your order within the region.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; effect lasts for 1 hour after use
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or you use it again (recharges on a long rest)

internet_data_scan.priceReason: Reflects the cost of advanced technology and ongoing support from Data Dealer.

mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe.name: Wario's Quantum Shifter
mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe.description: This bizarre pipe, salvaged from a rift between dimensions, shimmers with an unstable quantum field. When activated, it teleports you to a random location within 10 meters, often depositing you inside a towering mushroom or Wario’s massive belly. The device is known for its unpredictable nature and might even send you directly into the ground. Use at your own risk; the last adventurer reported gaining temporary hit points but also ended up in an unwelcome embrace with the Mushroom King himself.

effectDetails.title: Teleport
effectDetails.rules: The user must use an action to activate the pipe. It teleports them to a random location within 10 meters, with a small chance of materializing inside a solid object or a giant mushroom. There is no save DC required for this effect.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful teleportation, the user gains temporary hit points equal to 2d4 (10). These temporary hit points last until they are reduced to zero or the user takes a long rest. The pipe can be used once per day.

mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe.levelRequirementReason: The device's quantum instability requires a certain level of arcane knowledge and physical resilience.
mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in rare items from other dimensions, making it the perfect place to find this peculiar pipe.
mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe.shippingDetail: The mushroom cart delivers directly to your doorstep, but due to its unpredictable nature, ensure you are indoors before activation.

usage.duration: instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: the user takes damage or uses it again the next day

mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe.priceReason: The pipe's limited daily use and unpredictable nature justify its lower price.

mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_coin.name: The Coin of Unending Greed
mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_coin.description: The Coin of Unending Greed radiates an ominous, gold-laced aura when held. This ancient relic grants a fleeting surge of wealth, converting 500 gold coins into your possession with each use. However, the coin's dark magic increases the chance of encountering rare treasures by 20%, at the cost of fostering an insatiable desire for more. Should you succumb to its influence for too long, there is a 10% chance that your soul will be trapped within the coin forever, turning you into a sentient pile of gold dust.

effectDetails.title: Grant Wealth
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the coin grants 500 gold coins to the user. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a saving throw or other action.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Treasure Chance
effectDetails.rules: The coin increases the chance of encountering rare items by 20%. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest, but it reduces your party's morale by -1 for every day this effect is active. If you fail a saving throw against this effect, the reduction in morale becomes permanent.

mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_coin.levelRequirementReason: The coin's dark magic requires a certain level of experience to resist its corrupting influence.
mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_coin.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop, known for its questionable wares, has acquired the coin from an ancient underground network.
mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_coin.shippingDetail: The shadow messenger ensures that the coin arrives safely but may not be tracked by prying eyes or hands.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, until end of next long rest
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon a successful saving throw against its corrupting influence or at the end of your next long rest. It is destroyed if you fail three consecutive saving throws.

mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_coin.priceReason: The coin's dark magic and rare utility justify a price that reflects both its power and danger.

mushroom_kingdom_godly_power_shard.name: Wario’s Heart of Velocity
mushroom_kingdom_godly_power_shard.description: Wario’s Heart of Velocity is a shimmering core embedded with the essence of Wario's relentless speed and destructive prowess. Crafted from the very heart of the Mushroom Kingdom, this fragment grants its bearer an explosive burst of velocity that leaves enemies in dust. With each use, there's a 30% chance for a devastating 'Wario Smash' to obliterate foes in its wake, leaving a trail of chaos behind.

effectDetails.title: Burst of Velocity
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Increases the user's movement speed by 50% for 10 seconds. Ends when the duration expires or if the user drops to 0 hit points.

effectDetails.title: Wario Smash
effectDetails.rules: Triggered randomly with a 30% chance each time Burst of Velocity is used, this effect deals 2d6 + Strength modifier force damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take an additional 1d6 force damage.

mushroom_kingdom_godly_power_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires no level as it is a godly artifact, but is intended for lower-level characters to experience its chaotic effects.
mushroom_kingdom_godly_power_shard.vendorReason: Wario personally oversees the distribution of items from his domain, ensuring they are only sold by him directly.
mushroom_kingdom_godly_power_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly through a dimensional portal, but requires an additional 50 XP for expedited delivery.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and use.
usage.duration: 10 seconds duration.
usage.endsWhen: Expires after the duration or when dropped to 0 hit points.

mushroom_kingdom_godly_power_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item offers a godly artifact with powerful effects that can be used by lower-level characters without being overpowered.

almost_edge_voidshard_resonator.name: Voidshard Resonator
almost_edge_voidshard_resonator.description: A pulsing fragment of the void, humming with chaotic energy. When activated, it emits a wave of distortion, briefly scrambling enemy targeting and disrupting magical connections.
effects: Reduces targeting accuracy of enemies by 15%

almost_edge_mythic_echo_of_the_fall.name: Echo of the Fall
almost_edge_mythic_echo_of_the_fall.description: The Echo of the Fall is a shimmering, translucent sphere that hums with the forgotten cries of those who crossed the Edge. As you touch it, the air around you distorts, and your mind is flooded with fragments of ancient memories—potentially overwhelming but offering profound insights into the true nature of the Edge's mysteries. With each touch, hidden pathways are revealed, and cryptic prophecies whisper truths about the fate of the Edge, all while temporarily increasing intelligence for a brief time.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Intelligence Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Echo of the Fall increases your Intelligence by +5 for up to 3 turns. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Secret Revelation
effectDetails.rules: Each time you activate the Echo, there is a 10% chance that it reveals a hidden secret about the Edge or its surroundings within a 5-foot radius. The secret must be noted by the DM and cannot be resisted with a saving throw.

almost_edge_mythic_echo_of_the_fall.levelRequirementReason: This item provides significant knowledge but is accessible to all adventurers, ensuring it remains a valuable tool for any journey.
almost_edge_mythic_echo_of_the_fall.vendorReason: The Edge Wanderer has encountered numerous travelers who have crossed the perilous Edge and can vouch for its utility in understanding its secrets.
almost_edge_mythic_echo_of_the_fall.shippingDetail: Delivered by a Reality Anchor Drone, ensuring that the Echo of the Fall arrives intact and functional.

usage.activation: Activate as an action to gain temporary intelligence boost and reveal a secret.
usage.duration: The Intelligence boost lasts for up to 3 turns.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if it is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one effect can be active at any time.

almost_edge_mythic_echo_of_the_fall.priceReason: Balanced as a Mythic item providing significant lore and utility without being overpowered.

the_edge_voidshard_whisper.name: Voidshard Whisper
the_edge_voidshard_whisper.description: The Voidshard Whisper is a glowing fragment of an ancient void. When touched, it emits a low hum that resonates with forgotten echoes from the abyssal realms. Consuming it grants you a brief surge of insight into future possibilities—though some futures may not be what you expect. This shard can heal 15 hit points and grant a temporary boost to your speed, making you faster for a short time.

effectDetails.title: Healing Surge
effectDetails.rules: Consume the Voidshard Whisper as an action. It heals 15 hit points to you and has a chance to cause temporary madness, granting uncontrollable giggling for 1d4 rounds.

effectDetails.title: Increased Speed
effectDetails.rules: The shard grants a +20% movement speed increase for 6 seconds. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or drop the shard.

the_edge_voidshard_whisper.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to handle the shard's strange energies safely.
the_edge_voidshard_whisper.vendorReason: The abyss trader deals in rare artifacts from forgotten realms, including this peculiar fragment.
the_edge_voidshard_whisper.shippingDetail: Ships through rifts with a one-day delay due to the unstable nature of void travel.

usage.duration: Instantaneous healing, speed boost lasts until end of turn if not interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitated or dropped; ends immediately on both conditions

the_edge_voidshard_whisper.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect the shard's unique abilities and limited stock.

the_edge_chronal_anchor.name: Chronal Anchor of Echoes
the_edge_chronal_anchor.description: The Chronal Anchor of Echoes is a heavy, ornate anchor crafted from the solidified essence of time. Its surface glows faintly with an ethereal light, hinting at its power to alter the flow of moments. This relic allows you to briefly rewind your last action by up to 3 seconds, potentially saving you in dire combat situations. Additionally, it increases your critical hit chance by 10%, ensuring that when you land a blow, it's devastatingly effective.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Last Action
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can rewind your last action by up to 3 seconds. This effect is instantaneous and does not provoke opportunity attacks. The rewind only affects the outcome of the action but cannot be used on actions that are already resolved or have immediate consequences like casting spells with a verbal component.

effectDetails.title: Critical Hit Boost
effectDetails.rules: Gain a +10 bonus to critical hit chances for 1 hour after using the Chronal Anchor. This effect stacks with other sources of critical hit bonuses but cannot exceed +20 in total. The bonus ends if you take damage or fall unconscious.

the_edge_chronal_anchor.levelRequirementReason: The anchor's power requires a deep understanding of time manipulation, which is beyond the reach of those below level 16.
the_edge_chronal_anchor.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in rare and powerful relics from the far reaches of space-time, making it the perfect vendor for this Chronal Anchor.
the_edge_chronal_anchor.shippingDetail: The Temporal Delivery Service ensures that your Chronal Anchor arrives safely and promptly, with a guaranteed delivery time of one week within the Prime Material Plane.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Once per short or long rest after using it; ends if you take damage or fall unconscious

the_edge_chronal_anchor.priceReason: This price reflects the mythic rarity and power of the Chronal Anchor, balancing its utility in critical combat situations.

the_edge_obsidian_puzzlebox.name: The Infinite Puzzlebox
the_edge_obsidian_puzzlebox.description: The Infinite Puzzlebox, a sleek obsidian cube adorned with intricate gears and cogs, seems simple at first glance but reveals its true nature only to those who dare to tinker. As you twist and turn the sides, it morphs into an ever-changing puzzle, presenting new challenges that test your wits and resolve. Solve the riddle correctly, and a tempest of chaotic energy surges forth; solve incorrectly, and you might find yourself trapped within its labyrinthine depths until you figure out how to escape.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Energy Burst
effectDetails.rules: When the puzzlebox is solved correctly, it releases a burst of chaotic energy within a 10-foot radius. Each creature in this area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute and take 3d6 radiant damage.

effectDetails.title: Illusory Companion
effectDetails.rules: If the puzzlebox is tampered with incorrectly, it may conjure an illusory companion. This minor illusionary creature appears to be a loyal dog but can speak in riddles and taunt you for 1 minute before dissipating.

the_edge_obsidian_puzzlebox.levelRequirementReason: The Infinite Puzzlebox requires basic dexterity and problem-solving skills, which are generally attainable by level 1 characters.
the_edge_obsidian_puzzlebox.vendorReason: Final Shop is renowned for its collection of rare curiosities and magical trinkets that challenge the minds of adventurers.
the_edge_obsidian_puzzlebox.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, with an additional delay if the item is out of stock.

usage.activation: Interact as a bonus action to begin solving the puzzle.
usage.duration: Instantaneous once solved or tampered with incorrectly.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the puzzle is either correctly or incorrectly solved, expending all charges.

the_edge_obsidian_puzzlebox.priceReason: The Infinite Puzzlebox's price reflects its balance between challenge and risk, offering both a strategic advantage and potential for disaster.

grand_country_crumb_of_ascension.name: Crumb of Ascension
grand_country_crumb_of_ascension.description: The Crumb of Ascension is a minuscule piece chipped from the legendary 'Layered Peak'. When consumed, it propels you skyward with a burst of upward momentum, ideal for scaling treacherous cliffs or escaping peril. It's made from the ancient stones that once formed the peak itself, imbued with fleeting ascendant magic. However, consuming too much can lead to an uncontrollable levitation, leaving you floating aimlessly in the air until it passes.

effectDetails.title: Burst of Momentum
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, this crumb grants you a burst of upward momentum that lasts for 3 turns. You gain a +10 to your AC and the ability to jump twice your normal height until it wears off.

effectDetails.title: Climbing Buff
effectDetails.rules: There's a 25% chance each time you consume this crumb, that you also gain the 'Climbing' condition for 1 minute. This stacking buff increases your climbing speed by +30 feet and grants advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks.

grand_country_crumb_of_ascension.levelRequirementReason: This crumb is potent enough to help even the least experienced adventurers, but its magic still requires a minimum level of proficiency.
grand_country_crumb_of_ascension.vendorReason: The Vertical Vendor specializes in items related to climbing and altitude, making this crumb an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_crumb_of_ascension.shippingDetail: Delivered by the gravity-defying Gravity Pod, ensuring that your Crumb of Ascension arrives intact and ready for use.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are no longer airborne or after its duration expires
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one stack can be active at a time

grand_country_crumb_of_ascension.priceReason: Balanced as it's a potent consumable that provides significant benefits without being overpowered.

grand_country_chronal_crumb.name: Chronal Crumb of Disorientation
grand_country_chronal_crumb.description: The Chronal Crumb of Disorientation is a shimmering, jelly-like fragment that pulses with a faint temporal aura. Consumed, it briefly warps your perception and snares nearby foes in a flux of time, making them uncertain of their next move.
