It’s a handy tool for evading capture or confusing enemies, but prolonged exposure might leave you questioning the fabric of reality itself—or just wishing you had never tasted it.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Flux
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this crumb creates a brief temporal distortion affecting all creatures within 10 feet. Targets must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Perception Warp
effectDetails.rules: The crumb grants you advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to resist fear and confusion effects for 1 minute after consumption, but you gain disadvantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks until your next short or long rest.

grand_country_chronal_crumb.levelRequirementReason: This crumb is accessible to all levels as a versatile tool for quick escapes.
grand_country_chronal_crumb.vendorReason: Side_seller specializes in niche and mythic curiosities that adventurers might need on their journeys.
grand_country_chronal_crumb.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dimensional Portal, ensuring swift delivery to any plane of existence.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; effect lasts until the end of your next turn or when you take a short rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are stunned by another source, or after one round for Temporal Flux.

grand_country_chronal_crumb.priceReason: This crumb offers versatile utility without being overpowered, making it a balanced mythic item.

grand_country_void_shard.name: Void Shard of Oblivion
grand_country_void_shard.description: The Void Shard of Oblivion, a fragment torn from the void's inscrutable depths, hums with an eerie, otherworldly chill. Its touch is like cold steel against your skin, and its pulse echoes the silence between worlds. This shard allows you to momentarily phase through solid objects, granting you passage where none should be possible—but at a terrible cost: prolonged use erodes your very essence, slowly draining your life force while increasing the chance of memory loss.

effectDetails.title: Phase Through Obstacles
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can use the shard to phase through any solid object within reach. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute per level of your character. You are immune to damage while phased and cannot be targeted by attacks or spells while in this state.

effectDetails.title: Soul Drain
effectDetails.rules: At the end of each of your turns, you gain one negative hit point unless you have expended a use from the shard. After using the shard for 5 minutes in total, you begin to lose memories; there is a cumulative 10% chance per minute spent phased that you will forget a random spell or class feature.

grand_country_void_shard.levelRequirementReason: Only those of great power and experience can wield the Void Shard without succumbing to its insidious effects too quickly.
grand_country_void_shard.vendorReason: The layer market deals in forbidden and rare artifacts, making it fitting for this shard's dark origins.
grand_country_void_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Shadow Courier; delivery may take up to a week due to its volatile nature.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per level of character
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell).

grand_country_void_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the risk it poses to users justify its high price, but it remains less costly than other godly artifacts.

equestria_item_sugar_coated_hoof.name: Sugar Coated Hoof Charm
equestria_item_sugar_coated_hoof.description: The Sugar Coated Hoof Charm is a delicate horseshoe charm crafted by Sweetie Belle, Apple Bloom, and Scootaloo themselves. This charming trinket not only enhances your movements with an added spring in your step but also sweetens your words, making you irresistible to any creature within a 10-foot radius for up to one hour. The Cutie Mark Crusaders' magic ensures its effectiveness, making it a must-have for any pony looking to outshine the competition.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this charm grants a +10% increase to your movement speed for one hour. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or if the charm is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Charismatic Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after activation, you have advantage on all persuasion checks within a 10-foot radius of you. This effect is negated by any creature that successfully saves against it with a DC equal to 8 + your Charisma modifier.

equestria_item_sugar_coated_hoof.levelRequirementReason: This charm is simple enough for even the youngest ponies, but its effectiveness makes it valuable beyond their age level.
equestria_item_sugar_coated_hoof.vendorReason: As the Cutie Mark Crusaders' own creation, this item is a favorite at Ponyville Market, where vendors pride themselves on offering authentic items crafted by local heroes.
equestria_item_sugar_coated_hoof.shippingDetail: Shipped via Pegasus Express, delivery is swift and reliable, ensuring your charm arrives fresh from the Cutie Mark Crusaders' workshop.

usage.activation: Activating this charm requires an action.
usage.duration: One hour.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are incapacitated or if the charm is destroyed.

equestria_item_sugar_coated_hoof.priceReason: Crafted with magical horseshoe and Cutie Mark Crusaders' essence, this charm commands a high price due to its unique combination of utility and charm.

equestria_item_shadow_hoof_badge.name: Shadow Hoof Badge of the Night Brigade
equestria_item_shadow_hoof_badge.description: The Shadow Hoof Badge of the Night Brigade grants its bearer access to the clandestine strategies and stealth tactics of the enigmatic Night Brigade. Crafted from midnight obsidian and inscribed with ancient runes, it whispers tales of shadowy skirmishes and silent maneuvers. Wearing this badge is said to imbue one with a subtle affinity for nocturnal treats, making you more adept at slipping through the shadows without alerting your foes.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: The badge grants a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect is active as long as the wearer maintains their cover and does not engage in combat or loud activities, expiring if they are directly targeted by a light-based attack.

effectDetails.title: Shadowed Status
effectDetails.rules: There's a 10% chance that any creature successfully targeting you with a light-based attack inflicts the 'Shadowed' condition on them (reduces their effective proficiency bonus by 2). This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and can occur once per short or long rest.

equestria_item_shadow_hoof_badge.levelRequirementReason: The badge's intricate runes and the Night Brigade's clandestine training requirements necessitate a minimum level to ensure proper use and understanding.
equestria_item_shadow_hoof_badge.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire, known for its ties with shadowy organizations, is privy to the badges of the Night Brigade through mutual agreements.
equestria_item_shadow_hoof_badge.shippingDetail: The badge is delivered via a swift gryphon courier, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition and ready for use upon arrival.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: Until the wearer is directly targeted by a light-based attack or they engage in combat.
usage.endsWhen: The badge's effects expire if the wearer enters combat or is hit with a light-based attack.

equestria_item_shadow_hoof_badge.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its unique combination of stealth and tactical advantage, while still requiring specialized training for optimal use.

almost_edge_crumb_of_reality.name: Crumb of Reality
almost_edge_crumb_of_reality.description: The Crumb of Reality is a shimmering fragment, a remnant of the endless void that clings to your palm like a forgotten memory. It tastes faintly of regret and stale sprinkles, and when held for a moment, it distorts reality, revealing glimpses of impossible geometries. For a fleeting instant, you can perceive the fabric of existence bending in ways that defy logic, yet upon release, the world snaps back into place with an unsettling finality.

effectDetails.title: Grant Temporary Vision
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can briefly distort your perception. For 1 minute or until you take damage, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and can see through illusions as if using the See Invisibility feature.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Cause Confusion
effectDetails.rules: Each creature within a 20-foot radius of where you hold the crumb has a 15% chance to be confused for 1 minute on your turn. The save DC for this effect is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + half your level.

almost_edge_crumb_of_reality.levelRequirementReason: The Crumb of Reality requires only first-level spellcasters, as its effects are subtle but potent.
almost_edge_crumb_of_reality.vendorReason: Edge Wanderer, a nomadic trader from the far reaches of the multiverse, carries this rare item among their wares due to its unique and intriguing properties.
almost_edge_crumb_of_reality.shippingDetail: The Crumb is shipped via the Dimensional Rift, ensuring that it arrives in pristine condition despite its volatile nature.

usage.duration: 1 Minute or Until You Take Damage
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell)

almost_edge_crumb_of_reality.priceReason: The Crumb of Reality is priced at 1,000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the unique properties that make it both intriguing and potentially dangerous.

almost_edge_void_lantern.name: Void Lantern of Lost Reflections
almost_edge_void_lantern.description: The Void Lantern of Lost Reflections casts an eerie, pulsating glow that seems to dance on the edges of perception itself. Its light does not merely illuminate but also stirs forgotten memories and half-remembered dreams. In its presence, shadows seem to whisper secrets from the void, and even the bravest hearts feel a creeping unease. This lantern is crafted from ancient, star-dusted metal, forged in the heart of a dying sun by the Void Merchant himself, who once sought to harness the power of lost realms.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of the Void
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the lantern emits a low hum that compels creatures within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15). On a failed save, they are charmed for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fear
effectDetails.rules: The bearer of the lantern gains resistance to fear effects and advantage on saving throws against being frightened. This benefit lasts until the end of their next turn after using the item.

almost_edge_void_lantern.levelRequirementReason: Only those with a deep understanding of the arcane can wield this powerful artifact without succumbing to its dark whispers.
almost_edge_void_lantern.vendorReason: The Void Merchant is known for dealing in items that bridge worlds, and this lantern embodies the essence of forgotten places and lost souls.
almost_edge_void_lantern.shippingDetail: Delivered via a gravitational pulse, ensuring secrecy and delivering the item directly to your doorstep, bypassing any usual couriers or checkpoints.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate the lantern's effects.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the user no longer holds it or upon being destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The item is destroyed, dropped, or lost. The effect ends for the bearer immediately if they are destroyed or lose possession of the lantern.

almost_edge_void_lantern.priceReason: While not a high-priced item in terms of gold, its rarity and mystical properties make it invaluable to those who seek to navigate lost realms.

almost_edge_whisper_of_the_boundary.name: Whisper of the Boundary - Service Token
almost_edge_whisper_of_the_boundary.description: The Whisper of the Boundary - Service Token is a polished obsidian disc that hums with an unnerving resonance, its surface etched with ancient runes that glow faintly under torchlight. When presented to a Liminal Trader, it grants you cryptic advice, often useless but occasionally terrifyingly insightful, revealing secrets of the location and granting a small amount of mana. The token's power is unpredictable, as it may also bestow a temporary buff upon use.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Advice
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the token grants you a single cryptic piece of advice from the Liminal Trader. The advice is often useless but occasionally provides terrifyingly insightful information about your current location or an upcoming event.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Buff
effectDetails.rules: Upon use, the token may grant you a temporary buff that enhances one of your ability scores by +1 for 24 hours. The specific score is determined randomly each time the item is used.

almost_edge_whisper_of_the_boundary.levelRequirementReason: The cryptic advice and temporary buff effects are minor, suitable for low-level characters to gain small advantages.
almost_edge_whisper_of_the_boundary.vendorReason: Liminal Traders specialize in such tokens that bridge the realms of the known and unknown worlds.
almost_edge_whisper_of_the_boundary.shippingDetail: Ships via temporal flux, arriving within a day but with a chance to be delayed by events out of your control.

usage.activation: Interacted as an action at the start of your turn when presented to a Liminal Trader.
usage.duration: Instantaneous upon activation; temporary buff lasts for 24 hours.
usage.endsWhen: The cryptic advice is revealed and the temporary buff expires after its duration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged by the temporal flux.

almost_edge_whisper_of_the_boundary.priceReason: The item provides minor but potentially valuable benefits that are worth a moderate amount of XP for low-level characters.

connectopia_block_of_echoes.name: Block of Echoes
connectopia_block_of_echoes.description: The Block of Echoes hums with the timeless whispers of Connectopia’s founding miners, their voices and tools echoing from bygone days. When struck, it plays back fragments of forgotten conversations and the rhythmic clangs of early mining implements, a delightful reprieve for weary explorers or an eerie reminder of past misadventures. Its resonant surface pulses with each use, holding only one memory at a time before reverting to silence.

effectDetails.title: Play Memory Clip
effectDetails.rules: When the Block of Echoes is struck, it plays a short memory clip of mining activity or conversation. This provides a +10 bonus to a mining check for up to three turns. The block can only play one memory at a time.

effectDetails.title: Increase Mining Speed
effectDetails.rules: The Block grants the user a +10% increase in mining speed for 3 turns after being struck. This effect is cumulative with other bonuses but cannot exceed a +25% bonus to mining checks.

connectopia_block_of_echoes.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least level 6 due to its complex resonance and the need for a seasoned miner to understand and appreciate its effects.
connectopia_block_of_echoes.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in unique, artisanal items that have historical significance or utility, making it an ideal vendor for the Block of Echoes.
connectopia_block_of_echoes.shippingDetail: Ships via a trusted messenger who delivers directly to your doorsteps, ensuring safe and timely arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; effect lasts for up to three turns
usage.endsWhen: The memory clip ends or the effect duration expires

connectopia_block_of_echoes.priceReason: Reflecting its rarity and historical significance, the Block of Echoes is priced at 3500 XP.

connectopia_pioneer_boots.name: Pioneer Boots of Steady Ground
connectopia_pioneer_boots.description: The Pioneer Boots of Steady Ground are crafted from sturdy leather reinforced with a layer of hardened gravel, forged by the skilled block-smiths of Connectopia. These boots not only increase your movement speed by 15% but also grant you resistance to falling damage, making them indispensable for navigating the treacherous terrain. With each step, these boots seem to find purchase even on slick surfaces, offering a reliable grip and confidence to their wearer.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these boots, your movement speed is increased by 15%. This effect is passive and applies continuously while you are equipped with the boots.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Falling Damage
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to falling damage. If you take falling damage, this reduces it by half (rounded down). This benefit lasts for a short duration immediately following any fall.

connectopia_pioneer_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are designed for adventurers of all levels, providing essential protection and mobility to those venturing into Connectopia's challenging landscapes.
connectopia_pioneer_boots.vendorReason: As the original creators of these sturdy boots, Block-Smiths continue to supply their reliable craftsmanship to adventurers across Connectopia.
connectopia_pioneer_boots.shippingDetail: The boots are shipped via a trusted local courier who ensures they reach your doorstep in one piece.

usage.activation: Passive effect. No activation required once equipped.
usage.duration: Continuous while equipped
usage.endsWhen: Discontinued when removed or destroyed

connectopia_pioneer_boots.priceReason: The boots are priced at 1000 XP due to their unique combination of increased movement speed and resistance to falling damage, offering a balance between utility and cost.

connectopia_crystal_shard_of_confusion.name: Crystal Shard of Confusion
connectopia_crystal_shard_of_confusion.description: The Crystal Shard of Confusion is a jagged, iridescent fragment that glows faintly in the dark. Crafted from an ancient crystal mined amidst tumultuous events, it emits a subtle hum when held. This shard disrupts both mind and body, compelling the bearer to engage in erratic behavior—whether building impromptu fortresses or causing accidental demolition. It's perfect for sowing chaos among foes but can lead to unintended destruction of one’s own creations.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the shard emits a subtle aura that confuses targets within 10 feet. Targets have a 25% chance to be confused for up to 3 turns. The confusion ends if the target takes any damage or successfully makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12). The item has an unlimited number of uses.

effectDetails.title: Crafting Inhibition
effectDetails.rules: While holding this shard, your crafting speed is reduced by 10%, but you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest or when you stop using the shard.

connectopia_crystal_shard_of_confusion.levelRequirementReason: This shard can be used by lower-level characters as its effects are manageable and do not demand high skill levels.
connectopia_crystal_shard_of_confusion.vendorReason: Pioneer Post, known for their wide network of supply routes, often carry unique items like the Crystal Shard of Confusion due to its novelty and utility.
connectopia_crystal_shard_of_confusion.shippingDetail: Ships via delivery only, ensuring safe handling during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of your next turn or target is confused
usage.endsWhen: The confusion ends if a target takes damage or succeeds on a Wisdom save. The item can be used multiple times without recharge.

connectopia_crystal_shard_of_confusion.priceReason: The shard's effects are versatile and useful for both low-level characters and those with specific build focuses, making it slightly more expensive than a common item.

almost_edge_item_glimmering_crumb.name: Glimmering Crumb of Despair
almost_edge_item_glimmering_crumb.description: A Glimmering Crumb of Despair, a tiny, iridescent fragment that dances with an unsettling light, is said to be a remnant from a forgotten doughnut dimension. When consumed, it grants temporary resistance to existential dread, but there's always the chance that one might feel slightly emptier in its wake. This strange crumb is known for its unpredictable effects, making players wonder if they've truly gained or lost something in their quest.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Existential Dread
effectDetails.rules: The crumb grants the consumer temporary resistance to existential dread for 1 minute. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after consuming it, and it can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Mild Discomfort
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance (DC 10) that when consumed, the crumb will inflict 'Mild Discomfort' on the consumer for 1 hour. Mild Discomfort imposes disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and reduces movement speed by 10 feet until it ends.

almost_edge_item_glimmering_crumb.levelRequirementReason: The Glimmering Crumb of Despair is accessible to all adventurers, as its unpredictable effects make it a useful yet risky item for any level 1 character.
almost_edge_item_glimmering_crumb.vendorReason: The edge_wanderer, a seasoned traveler with a knack for finding the strange and wonderful, often carries this peculiar crumb from distant realms.
almost_edge_item_glimmering_crumb.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dimensional Slipstream Courier Service, known for its unpredictable but reliable delivery times.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until consumed
usage.endsWhen: Starts of your next turn after consumption; ends early if you take damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, one use per short rest

almost_edge_item_glimmering_crumb.priceReason: The Glimmering Crumb's unpredictable effects and rare origin justify its high price in the market.

almost_edge_item_liminal_mirror_shard.name: Liminal Mirror Shard - Reflections of Loss
almost_edge_item_liminal_mirror_shard.description: A shard of glass so finely etched it resembles a fragment torn from another dimension, this Liminal Mirror Shard reveals glimpses into alternate realities. Touching it momentarily transports you to one such reality where your decisions and actions have led to different outcomes—often richer, more prosperous futures. Though the visions are fleeting, they linger long enough for you to grasp the potential of other paths. Handle with care, as prolonged exposure risks delving too deeply into nostalgia and regret.

effectDetails.title: Alternate Reality Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: Using an action, you briefly touch the shard to enter a state where time slows for 3 seconds. During this time, you see one alternate reality in vivid detail, gaining advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to understand the nature of that reality.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Resilience
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after using the shard, you have resistance to psychic damage and gain advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. The effect ends if you use it again before its duration expires.

almost_edge_item_liminal_mirror_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third level to handle the temporal distortions without risk.
almost_edge_item_liminal_mirror_shard.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in rare and dangerous curiosities, including items that can alter time and reality.
almost_edge_item_liminal_mirror_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Temporal Courier with a guaranteed delivery within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting 3 seconds, followed by 1 hour of temporal resilience.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effects expire or if used again before expiration.

almost_edge_item_liminal_mirror_shard.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its rare and potentially dangerous nature, making it a valuable but not overpowered tool for adventurers.

grand_country_chronal_shard.name: Temporal Echo Fragment
grand_country_chronal_shard.description: The Temporal Echo Fragment is a shimmering, fractured shard of time, its surface etched with ancient runes and glowing faintly blue under torchlight. Touch it once to rewind your last action, but beware: each use risks creating a temporal ripple that might lead to unintended consequences, such as forgotten words or misplaced items. This relic, crafted by the enigmatic Timekeepers in their hidden sanctuaries, is limited to one use per day and comes with unpredictable side effects.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Last Action
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, you can rewind your last action. The action is canceled and you gain the benefit of the action as if it were just performed. This ability can be used once per day. However, there's a 10% chance that each use creates a temporal ripple, which might cause minor but unpredictable side effects.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Ripple
effectDetails.rules: If a temporal ripple occurs, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or suffer a minor consequence related to the action you rewound. This could mean forgetting what you said in conversation, dropping an item, or being momentarily disoriented.

grand_country_chronal_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Temporal Echo Fragment requires a minimum level of 10 due to its complexity and potential for misuse.
grand_country_chronal_shard.vendorReason: Side Seller, known for their eclectic assortment of unique and rare items, occasionally stocks the Temporal Echo Fragment when it arrives from the mysterious Timekeepers.
grand_country_chronal_shard.shippingDetail: The Temporal Echo Fragment is shipped via Swift Winds Courier Service, ensuring swift delivery but with a slight delay due to its fragile nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Use of the ability or creation of a temporal ripple

grand_country_chronal_shard.priceReason: The Temporal Echo Fragment is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and potential for both utility and danger.

grand_country_sky_pearl.name: Celestial Echo Pearl
grand_country_sky_pearl.description: The Celestial Echo Pearl, forged from the very clouds of distant realms and woven with the melodies of forgotten stars, hums softly as it glows with an ethereal light. Held in one's palm, it reveals glimpses into futures both real and imagined—though to the greedy, it may only seem to promise more wealth. A rare treasure from the celestial market, this pearl offers insight beyond mere sight, granting fleeting visions of possible paths and secret knowledge that could change a campaign’s course forever.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Secrets
effectDetails.rules: The user can use an action to attempt a Perception check with advantage. If successful, they learn one secret or hidden path relevant to the immediate area.

effectDetails.title: Insight Boost
effectDetails.rules: While holding the pearl, the user gains a +5 bonus on Insight checks. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be used once per long rest.

grand_country_sky_pearl.levelRequirementReason: The pearl is accessible to all adventurers who recognize its value.
grand_country_sky_pearl.vendorReason: Layer Market, a hub of celestial trade, offers the rarest and most valuable curiosities from across the cosmos.
grand_country_sky_pearl.shippingDetail: The pearl is delivered by the majestic Cloud Whale, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until used
usage.endsWhen: After one use per long rest and upon completion of a short rest

grand_country_sky_pearl.priceReason: The Celestial Echo Pearl is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the value it adds to any adventurer's quest.

earth_land_dragonscale_shield.name: Wyrm's Whisper Bulwark
earth_land_dragonscale_shield.description: The Wyrm's Whisper Bulwark is a shield forged from the scales of a young frost dragon, imbued with an ancient whisper that promises victory. Its warm touch and icy core provide unparalleled defense: it blocks all physical attacks and reflects up to 20% of incoming magic damage back at attackers. The shield whispers warnings when you are about to be struck by an attack, giving you precious moments to react.

effectDetails.title: Physical Block
effectDetails.rules: The Wyrm's Whisper Bulwark blocks all physical attacks. It provides a +3 bonus to Armor Class and has a reaction that can stun an attacker for one round with a successful block, but this effect only occurs on a natural 19 or 20.

effectDetails.title: Magic Reflection
effectDetails.rules: When hit by magic attacks, the shield reflects up to 20% of the damage back at the attacker. This effect has a cooldown of one minute after each use and requires a successful concentration check (DC 15) to activate.

earth_land_dragonscale_shield.levelRequirementReason: The Wyrm's Whisper Bulwark is crafted from dragon scales, requiring a player of at least level 8 to wield it effectively.
earth_land_dragonscale_shield.vendorReason: The magic shop specializes in rare and ancient artifacts, including those made from magical creatures like dragons.
earth_land_dragonscale_shield.shippingDetail: Ships via the Winged Courier, known for its speed and reliability, ensuring swift delivery of enchanted items.

usage.duration: One minute between uses
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per minute or when destroyed by damage equal to your level +10

earth_land_dragonscale_shield.priceReason: The Wyrm's Whisper Bulwark is a rare shield forged from dragon scales, making it valuable but not overly powerful.

earth_land_mythic_echoing_gem.name: The Lament of Lost Souls
earth_land_mythic_echoing_gem.description: The Lament of Lost Souls is a gemstone that hums with sorrow from ancient battles. Its pulsating glow reveals brief, haunting visions of past conflicts and can attract spectral echoes that whisper secrets or cause minor disturbances. Holding it grants you resistance to fear and allows you to make a Wisdom check for insight into the battlefield. However, there's an unsettling 15% chance each round that a minor spectral echo will appear, possibly aiding your allies or creating minor distractions.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fear
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to fear effects. This effect is always active while you are holding the Lament of Lost Souls.

effectDetails.title: Chance of Spectral Echo
effectDetails.rules: Each round, there's a 15% chance that a minor spectral echo will appear in your vicinity. The echo can either scout for information or create a distraction by causing an enemy to lose 10% of their current hit points.

earth_land_mythic_echoing_gem.levelRequirementReason: The gem's power requires a moderate magical affinity, making it suitable for characters at least level 2.
earth_land_mythic_echoing_gem.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in ancient and mystical artifacts, including those that hold the echoes of lost battles.
earth_land_mythic_echoing_gem.shippingDetail: Shipped via a Dimensional Rift Express service to ensure timely arrival of this fragile artifact.

usage.activation: Passive effect while holding the gem.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, with no duration limit.
usage.endsWhen: The gem shatters if you lose your concentration or drop it.

earth_land_mythic_echoing_gem.priceReason: The gem's rarity and mystical properties justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_flail.name: Frosting Flail of Frozen Fury
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_flail.description: The Frosting Flail of Frozen Fury is a colossal weapon forged from hardened buttercream, enchanted to harness winter's coldest magic. Its massive head glimmers like ice, and each swing can freeze enemies solid, leaving them encased in a frosty prison. Legend has it that this flail was crafted on the island of Le Claire Isle by pastry chefs who dared to challenge the Frost King himself. A single slip on its slippery frosting can send even the most skilled fighters sprawling.

effectDetails.title: Freeze Target
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with this flail as part of an attack, there is a 50% chance that the target becomes immobilized for 1 minute. The save DC to resist this effect is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier. This effect ends if the target takes any nonmagical damage.

effectDetails.title: Critical Hit Bonus
effectDetails.rules: If you score a critical hit with this flail, you gain advantage on all attack rolls against that target until the start of your next turn.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_flail.levelRequirementReason: Only seasoned warriors who have proven their mettle can wield such a powerful and heavy weapon.
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_flail.vendorReason: The chefs at Pastry Palace are known for their daring challenges, and the Frosting Flail is a testament to their bravery in facing the frosty king himself.
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_flail.shippingDetail: Due to its unwieldy size and delicate nature, this item is shipped with extra care using the Swift Sugar Delivery Cart. Expect delivery delays of up to one week due to the special handling required.

usage.duration: Instantaneous freeze effect; ends if the target takes nonmagical damage
usage.endsWhen: Target takes nonmagical damage or the duration ends (1 minute)
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharged after a long rest

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_flail.priceReason: This item is considered rare due to its unique enchantment and the materials used in its creation.

leclaire_isle_item_sugar_shock_berry.name: Sugar Shock Berry
leclaire_isle_item_sugar_shock_berry.description: The Sugar Shock Berry is a vibrant, almost neon red fruit that pulses with an ungodly amount of sugar. When consumed, it grants you a burst of energy and temporarily boosts your speed, leaving your enemies in a state of delightful confusion as they stumble around in disarray. The berry's sweet juice coats your mouth, making your tongue feel as if it's about to explode from the sheer volume of sugar racing through you.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to your speed until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you take any damage or are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Confusion
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute, each creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of you must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target is instead frightened of you for 1 minute.

leclaire_isle_item_sugar_shock_berry.levelRequirementReason: This item provides a significant combat advantage but does not require a high level to benefit from its effects.
leclaire_isle_item_sugar_shock_berry.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies is known for carrying the most delightful and bizarre consumables, including this sugar-packed treat.
leclaire_isle_item_sugar_shock_berry.shippingDetail: The Honeybee Drone delivers with a slight delay due to its need to collect nectar from various sources before delivering the berries.

usage.activation: Eating the berry as an action.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn for the speed boost, and until the end of your next turn for the confusion effect.
usage.endsWhen: If you take damage or are incapacitated.

leclaire_isle_item_sugar_shock_berry.priceReason: The price reflects its rare sugar content, complex flavor profile, and the difficulty of sourcing such a concentrated burst of sweetness in an item.

leclaire_isle_sugar_sprout.name: Sugar Sprout Stabilizer
leclaire_isle_sugar_sprout.description: The Sugar Sprout Stabilizer is a tiny, doughy sprout that looks like it could belong to a whimsical fairy tale. Crafted from the finest flour and yeast of Lemire Island's famous bakery, these sprouts are known for their miraculous ability to strengthen pastries, preventing them from crumbling or collapsing. When used, they provide an instant boost of resilience, ensuring your baked goods rise just right every time. A baker's dream, this stabilizer is especially popular among those who struggle with fragile tarts and cakes.

effectDetails.title: Pastry Reinforcement
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Sugar Sprout Stabilizer provides a +2 bonus to baking skill checks for one round. This effect grants temporary resistance against effects that cause baked goods to crumble or collapse.

effectDetails.title: Baking Skill Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, this stabilizer restores 10 pastry durability immediately and has a 50% chance of granting +2 to baking skill checks for one round. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

leclaire_isle_sugar_sprout.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for novice bakers who need some extra help perfecting their craft.
leclaire_isle_sugar_sprout.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in all things pastry and baking, making them the ideal vendor for this stabilizer.
leclaire_isle_sugar_sprout.shippingDetail: The Sugar Sprout Stabilizers are delivered quickly by the Dough Delivery Drone, ensuring they arrive fresh and ready to use.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and provide immediate benefits.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with a one-round duration.
usage.endsWhen: After one round or when used again.
usage.charges: One charge per use, recharges after a long rest.

leclaire_isle_sugar_sprout.priceReason: The stabilizer's rarity and the convenience it offers to bakers justify its higher price in experience points.

leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_bomb.name: Forbidden Frosting Bomb
leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_bomb.description: The Forbidden Frosting Bomb is a volatile confection forged from ingredients rumored to have been pilfered from the Dough Folk's most sacred recipes. This frosty sphere, crafted in the shadowed forges of Le Cleraire Isle, unleashes a dazzling burst of sugary chaos when detonated, leaving behind a sticky residue that clings to foes and allies alike. Beware: its presence might attract unwelcome attention from pastry guardians, who guard their secrets with zeal.

effectDetails.title: Sugary Explosion
effectDetails.rules: When thrown as an action, the Forbidden Frosting Bomb detonates in a 15-foot radius. All creatures within this area take 8d6 cold damage. The explosion creates a sticky residue that lasts for 1 minute, reducing movement speed by half (as if affected by Slow).

effectDetails.title: Sticky Residue
effectDetails.rules: For one turn after the bomb detonates, any creature within the 15-foot radius has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and ability checks made to move. The sticky residue dissipates after 1 minute.

leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_bomb.levelRequirementReason: Crafted with forbidden techniques that are difficult for lower-level characters to master, this bomb requires a minimum level of 8.
leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_bomb.vendorReason: Pastry Palace specializes in items that challenge and delight, making it the perfect vendor for this explosive confection.
leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_bomb.shippingDetail: Delivered with a special goblin courier who ensures the package reaches its destination under cover of darkness to avoid unwanted attention.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts for 1 minute after detonation
usage.endsWhen: The sticky residue dissipates after 1 minute or when a creature successfully dislodges it with a successful Strength check (DC 15)
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires 24 hours to recharge after use

leclaire_isle_forbidden_frosting_bomb.priceReason: The bomb's rarity and the complexity of its ingredients justify this price, ensuring it remains a valuable yet balanced addition to any character's arsenal.

leclaire_isle_golden_dough_shard.name: Golden Dough Shard of Eternal Sweetness
leclaire_isle_golden_dough_shard.description: The Golden Dough Shard of Eternal Sweetness is a delicate fragment from an ancient, never-ending baking dough that has sustained countless feasts. This shard exudes a sugary glow and can be used to instantly repair damaged armor or weapons by restoring half their durability, or to enhance the flavor of any meal, making it twice as delicious in one sitting. Just avoid consuming it outright; doing so results in an upset stomach.

effectDetails.title: Instant Armor Repair
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can use this shard to instantly restore half of any damaged armor or weapon's durability. This effect has no save DC and is limited to one use per day.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Meal Flavor
effectDetails.rules: This shard can be consumed once (without risk) to enhance the flavor of a meal, doubling its consumption rate for 1 hour. The effect is passive and does not require an action or saving throw.

leclaire_isle_golden_dough_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Golden Dough Shard's effects are simple and beneficial for all adventurers regardless of level.
leclaire_isle_golden_dough_shard.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies deals exclusively in culinary curiosities and treats, making it the go-to vendor for items like this.
leclaire_isle_golden_dough_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Royal Pastry Courier; typically arrives within a week from the time of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action or passive effect when consumed
usage.duration: Instantaneous and once per day for Instant Armor Repair; meal enhancement is active for one hour after consumption
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration ends naturally, and uses are exhausted as specified
usage.charges: Unlimited daily uses, one meal enhancement

leclaire_isle_golden_dough_shard.priceReason: The item's effects provide significant utility without being overly powerful, making it a fair value at 1000 XP.

midlands_item_royal_decree.name: Decree of Unmaking
midlands_item_royal_decree.description: The Decree of Unmaking is a parchment sealed in black wax, its edges slick with fresh blood. When read aloud by one of noble birth, it strips a target’s memory of up to five years, leaving them bewildered and unmoored from their past. The King's agents will hunt you down for such an act, making this item both a weapon and a trap, wielded only by those willing to risk the wrath of the crown.

effectDetails.title: Memory Erasure
effectDetails.rules: Activates when read aloud by one with noble lineage. Targets a single creature within 30 feet. The target loses memory of up to five years, as if under the effect of *Erase Memories*. This use ends immediately upon reading.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Increases your Charisma by +5 for 1 hour per use. This effect cannot be used more than once per long rest and is exhausted after one use.

midlands_item_royal_decree.levelRequirementReason: Requires a noble lineage or at least a level of 10 to invoke the King's wrath effectively.
midlands_item_royal_decree.vendorReason: The Empire Exchange caters exclusively to those with influence, making it the only legitimate source for such a dangerous but valuable item.
midlands_item_royal_decree.shippingDetail: Ships via Royal Courier within one week. Delivery is subject to customs checks by corrupt officials.

usage.activation: Reading aloud while under noble lineage or having at least level 10 Charisma modifier.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Memory Erasure, +5 per hour for Charisma boost
usage.endsWhen: Target's memory is restored upon reading, or the effect ends with a long rest for Charisma boost.
usage.charges: Limited to one use per long rest

midlands_item_royal_decree.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it requires significant risk and skill to utilize effectively.

doughnut_hole_void_guardians_badge.name: The Hole's Protector’s Token
doughnut_hole_void_guardians_badge.description: Issued by the enigmatic Void Guardians, this badge is a small medallion carved from obsidian and adorned with runes of forgotten languages. It grants limited access to the most dangerous corners of The Doughnut Hole, but only those who can prove their worth through quiet and respectful behavior are permitted its use. Within The Doughnut Hole, it enhances perception by 2d4 for 1 hour, and provides a +1 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks when interacting with void entities.
effects: Enhances Perception within The Doughnut Hole

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: When worn in The Doughnut Hole, the badge provides a +2d4 bonus to perception checks. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Bonus (Deception)
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this badge, you gain a +1 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks when interacting with void entities. The benefit is granted as long as the badge remains on your person.

doughnut_hole_void_guardians_badge.levelRequirementReason: Beginners who wish to prove their worth to the Void Guardians are often sent this token.
doughnut_hole_void_guardians_badge.vendorReason: Void Guardians trust only those they have deemed worthy with access to The Doughnut Hole, and this badge is a symbol of that trust.
doughnut_hole_void_guardians_badge.shippingDetail: The Dimensional Courier ensures the safe arrival of the badge through The Doughnut Hole's treacherous pathways.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until removed
usage.endsWhen: Badge is taken off or day ends

doughnut_hole_void_guardians_badge.priceReason: The badge's value lies in its rarity and the trust it represents, making it worth a significant amount of XP.

equestria_item_sparklehoof_plate.name: Sparklehoof's Steadfast Plate
equestria_item_sparklehoof_plate.description: Sparklehoof's Steadfast Plate is a gleaming armor forged in Canterlot's royal forges, said to have been worn by a brave pony knight of old. Its surface shimmers with subtle runes that catch the light, offering both protection and a touch of Equestria's magic. While it may not stop a giant boulder, this plate provides exceptional comfort, even for the most restless hooves, and grants its wearer resistance to radiant damage, making it an invaluable companion in any noble quest.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Resistance
effectDetails.rules: This plate grants the wearer resistance to radiant damage. This effect is passive and applies continuously while the plate is worn.

effectDetails.title: Comfortable Defense
effectDetails.rules: Wearing this plate increases the wearer's Armor Class by 2, providing a tangible boost in defense without requiring any action or concentration.

equestria_item_sparklehoof_plate.levelRequirementReason: This armor is crafted for experienced warriors who can best appreciate its unique properties and durability.
equestria_item_sparklehoof_plate.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce, known for its royal connections, ensures that only the finest armors are sold to those worthy of wearing them.
equestria_item_sparklehoof_plate.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost care by the Royal Carriage service, ensuring swift and safe arrival.

usage.duration: Continuous while worn.
usage.endsWhen: The plate is removed or destroyed.

equestria_item_sparklehoof_plate.priceReason: This rare armor reflects Canterlot's royal craftsmanship and the unique properties that make it a valuable asset for any pony knight.

equestria_item_pegasus_feather_amulet.name: Amulet of Swift Winds
equestria_item_pegasus_feather_amulet.description: The Amulet of Swift Winds is a delicate amulet crafted from shimmering silver and encrusted with a single, iridescent Pegasus feather. Crafted by the Crystal Empire's master artisans, it whispers tales of swift winds and boundless flight. Despite its enchantments, only those attuned to the spirit of the skies can truly harness its power, granting them a minor boost in speed and a chance to dodge attacks with grace.

effectDetails.title: Swift Flight
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +1 to their movement speed. This effect is active as long as the amulet remains on the wearer and they are not incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Grace
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer has a 20% chance to dodge an attack. This ability can be used once per day until expended.

equestria_item_pegasus_feather_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's enchantments are subtle and require only basic magical knowledge.
equestria_item_pegasus_feather_amulet.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire is renowned for its mastery of flight-themed magic, making it the ideal vendor for this enchanted trinket.
equestria_item_pegasus_feather_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped by a swift Pegasus courier, ensuring the amulet arrives fresh and intact.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required. Requires attunement to activate abilities.
usage.duration: Until expended or removed from wearer
usage.endsWhen: Expenditure of dodge grace ability or removal from wearer

equestria_item_pegasus_feather_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's enchantments are subtle but effective, and its rarity ensures a fair price in magical goods.

connectopia_shard_of_void.name: Nullity Fragment
connectopia_shard_of_void.description: The Nullity Fragment is a crystalline shard that shimmers with an eerie, ethereal glow, casting a cold shadow wherever it rests. Touching it sends a chill down your spine, and its touch can cause nearby tools to vanish or reappear in bewildering configurations. This fragment of the Void Rift defies logic, offering a brief respite from psychic damage but at a cost—those who wield it must confront their own doubts and fears.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Touch
effectDetails.rules: When a creature touches the shard, they have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn. The target can make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) to negate this effect.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Drain
effectDetails.rules: The shard drains a small amount of psychic energy from creatures within its radius, reducing their Intelligence score by 1 for 1 hour. A successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw halves the effect duration and reduces the drain to -1.

connectopia_shard_of_void.levelRequirementReason: The shard's power is too dangerous for those unprepared, requiring a minimum level of expertise in handling such arcane objects.
connectopia_shard_of_void.vendorReason: Pioneer Post trades in all manner of exotic and forbidden items, making it the only reliable source for this fragment.
connectopia_shard_of_void.shippingDetail: The shard must be delivered under strict secrecy; any detection spells cast on the package will render the shipment void.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a duration of 1 hour for each use
usage.endsWhen: Upon touching an unliving object or when the target successfully saves against its effects

connectopia_shard_of_void.priceReason: The fragment's rarity, power, and the risk it poses justify a high price in mythic XP.

connectopia_wario_wrench_prototype.name: Wario’s Experimental Fixer
connectopia_wario_wrench_prototype.description: Wario’s Experimental Fixer gleams with a mixture of oil and sweat, its extra handle a testament to Wario's impromptu craftsmanship. This grease-stained tool offers a small but reliable bonus to repair tasks, making quick fixes possible even in the most chaotic situations. The wrench also has a peculiar quirk: each successful repair has a chance to leave your foes stunned for a moment, disrupting their plans just as effectively as it mends yours.

effectDetails.title: Repair Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Grants a +10% bonus to the DC of any repair task for the next hour, after which it recharges.

effectDetails.title: Stun Chance on Repair
effectDetails.rules: Each successful repair attempt with this wrench has a 10% chance (DC 13) to stun an adjacent enemy for 1 round. This effect is limited to once per day.

connectopia_wario_wrench_prototype.levelRequirementReason: Wario’s Experimental Fixer is simple enough that even the lowest-level adventurers can wield it, providing a basic tool of survival.
connectopia_wario_wrench_prototype.vendorReason: The block smiths are known for their willingness to help anyone in need, especially those who can use a good wrench or two.
connectopia_wario_wrench_prototype.shippingDetail: Standard delivery via the reliable delivery bot ensures quick arrival, though it may take an extra day during peak hours.

usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: After one hour of continuous use or when the next repair task is attempted

connectopia_wario_wrench_prototype.priceReason: The wrench's unique properties and its connection to Wario, a beloved but mischievous character, justify this price.

kivotos_item_halo_of_disruptive_melody.name: Discordant Halo
kivotos_item_halo_of_disruptive_melody.description: The Discordant Halo glimmers with a neon sheen, its surface etched with the dissonant melodies of past campus protests and rebellious student anthems. This peculiar artifact emits a wave of sonic disruption that stuns foes in its path and scrambles their attacks, leaving them confused and off-balance for moments. A mere touch can unleash its chaotic power, making it a versatile tool for any bard or trickster with a knack for chaos.

effectDetails.title: Stuns on Contact
effectDetails.rules: When an enemy touches the halo, it emits a burst of sonic disruption that stuns the target for 1 round (DC 13 Dexterity save). On a successful save, the stun effect is negated.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Melody
effectDetails.rules: For every 5 feet an enemy moves within 20 feet of the halo, they have disadvantage on their next attack roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

kivotos_item_halo_of_disruptive_melody.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level to wield this artifact effectively.
kivotos_item_halo_of_disruptive_melody.vendorReason: The club supply vendor stocks unique and rare items from past campus events, including the Discordant Halo.
kivotos_item_halo_of_disruptive_melody.shippingDetail: Ships via standard mail within a week of order placement.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the start of your next turn or expended by an attack.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target makes a successful Dexterity saving throw or if it takes damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per round.

kivotos_item_halo_of_disruptive_melody.priceReason: Balanced for its unique sonic abilities and effects on enemies.

kivotos_item_data_ghost_fragment.name: Echo of the Network
kivotos_item_data_ghost_fragment.description: Echo of the Network is a digital fragment, a remnant of a long-forgotten online persona. Its cracked surface hums with corrupted data streams that grant you fleeting access to cryptic information and unsettling visions. Touching it allows you to uncover hidden secrets or prophetic dreams, though the clarity is often clouded by ambiguity. The fragment's influence can be both enlightening and perilous, much like a digital ghost haunting the forgotten corners of cyberspace.

effectDetails.title: Access Corrupted Data Streams
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you touch Echo of the Network and gain temporary access to corrupted data streams. For each use, you can attempt a DC 15 Intelligence (Computers) check to uncover hidden secrets or clues within the stream. The effect lasts for 3 rounds.

effectDetails.title: Unsettling Visions
effectDetails.rules: The fragment occasionally provides a prophetic vision, which is potentially misleading. Once per short rest, you can attempt a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to resist the visions' influence and avoid any negative effects they might have.

kivotos_item_data_ghost_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 6 to handle the fragment's corrupted data streams without being overwhelmed by their complexity.
kivotos_item_data_ghost_fragment.vendorReason: The student store carries Echo of the Network as a reminder of lost knowledge and forgotten online identities.
kivotos_item_data_ghost_fragment.shippingDetail: Delivered only at night, ensuring the package arrives in secret.

usage.duration: 3 rounds per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use it again or after 3 rounds

kivotos_item_data_ghost_fragment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare digital nature and the risk of accessing corrupted data.

middle_earth_whispering_rune.name: Echoing Stone of Rivendell
middle_earth_whispering_rune.description: The Echoing Stone of Rivendell is a smooth, grey stone that hums with the faintest whispers of Elven songs. Crafted from ancient elven runes and imbued with the essence of the Misty Mountains, it allows its bearer to perceive echoes of past events in the area. Holding this stone can reveal hidden passages or forgotten dangers, as if the very rock itself is whispering secrets long since buried. The stone’s whispers are not always clear; sometimes they attract mischievous brownies who may offer cryptic advice or mischief.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Past
effectDetails.rules: When you hold the stone, you gain advantage on Perception checks to recall events within a 30-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Passage Revelation
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, you can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check with advantage to reveal hidden passages in the immediate area of the stone. This effect does not trigger on a failed check and cannot be used more than once per day.

middle_earth_whispering_rune.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers at all levels, as it aids in exploration without requiring high-level prowess.
middle_earth_whispering_rune.vendorReason: The Elven Market sells relics and curiosities from the ancient realms of elves, making this stone a fitting addition to their offerings.
middle_earth_whispering_rune.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift winged ponies, ensuring fast delivery straight to your door.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held. Requires no action for the duration.
usage.duration: 1 minute (concentration) or until used in a check.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end once per rest or upon failure of a relevant check.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one use per short or long rest.

middle_earth_whispering_rune.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and utility in exploration without overshadowing other adventuring options.

middle_earth_shire_messenger_scrolls.name: Post of the Shire
middle_earth_shire_messenger_scrolls.description: The Post of the Shire is a finely crafted parchment scroll adorned with intricate patterns and the emblem of the Shire. Its delivery method ensures that messages are sent with care, as only the swiftest rabbits of the Shire deliver them. Rumor has it that these scrolls not only ensure timely dispatch but also subtly enhance your persuasive skills by an hour, making you a more effective messenger in both heart and deed.

effectDetails.title: Persuasion Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you use the Post of the Shire, you gain a +2 bonus to Persuasion checks for one hour. This effect does not stack with any other bonuses from similar sources.

effectDetails.title: Timely Delivery
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the message is dispatched as soon as possible through the efficient delivery system of the Shire. The recipient receives the message within 24 hours, provided no delays are encountered.

middle_earth_shire_messenger_scrolls.levelRequirementReason: This item caters to all adventurers who wish to ensure their messages reach the intended recipients in a timely and effective manner.
middle_earth_shire_messenger_scrolls.vendorReason: The Shire Shop has long been trusted by many for its reliable services, including the dispatch of important documents.
middle_earth_shire_messenger_scrolls.shippingDetail: Messages are delivered through the swift and efficient rabbit couriers of the Shire. Expect delays during peak seasons or adverse weather conditions.

usage.duration: One hour
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires after one hour, or when a new message is dispatched with the Post of the Shire.

middle_earth_shire_messenger_scrolls.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity and the unique services it provides to adventurers.

grand_country_sticky_scale.name: Sticky Scale of the Shifting Peaks
grand_country_sticky_scale.description: The Sticky Scale of the Shifting Peaks, a shimmering scale shed by a creature that defies gravity itself, clings to any surface you touch. As you climb treacherous peaks, it subtly shifts underfoot, granting a slight but crucial advantage in your grip and balance. Though it doesn't actually adhere to skin or clothing, its presence can mean the difference between a smooth ascent and a perilous slide. This relic makes even the steepest cliffs feel like gentle hills.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Grip
effectDetails.rules: When you make an Athletics check to climb, you have advantage on the roll. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to falling damage and are immune to being knocked prone by a creature or effect that would normally cause you to fall. You can use this feature once per short rest, after which it is exhausted until the end of your next long rest.

grand_country_sticky_scale.levelRequirementReason: This scale requires significant magical power to harness its effects on gravity and balance.
grand_country_sticky_scale.vendorReason: The Vertical Vendor specializes in equipment for adventurers who navigate treacherous terrains, making this scale a perfect fit for their inventory.
grand_country_sticky_scale.shippingDetail: Ships via Winged Courier, delivering the item within one day of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon touching and holding the scale during an Athletics check to climb.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Exhaustion ends after a short rest, or when you no longer carry the scale.

grand_country_sticky_scale.priceReason: The Sticky Scale's rarity and magical properties justify its high price tag in the Vertical Vendor's shop.

grand_country_wario_crumb_sandwich.name: Wario's Gravity-Defying Crumb Sandwich
grand_country_wario_crumb_sandwich.description: This peculiar sandwich, Wario's Gravity-Defying Crumb Sandwich, is a culinary marvel that seems to defy physics itself. Its crust rises and falls like a wave, while its crumbled layers shift with each bite. Each morsel grants a burst of energy, but beware—this energy comes at a cost: the stomach churns for hours afterward. This sandwich isn't just a snack; it's Wario's signature dish, known to grant a temporary boost in speed and a chance to gain a random strength buff.

effectDetails.title: Energy Burst
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, the sandwich grants you a +1d4 temporary hit point boost for 1 hour. There is a 20% chance that this effect also grants you a random temporary ability score increase (by 2 points) for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your next short or long rest, your movement speed increases by 20%. This effect is cumulative with any other bonuses to movement speed. If you take a long rest within the same day, this benefit does not stack.

grand_country_wario_crumb_sandwich.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate Wario's culinary creativity without needing high-level expertise.
grand_country_wario_crumb_sandwich.vendorReason: The side_seller specializes in unique and eccentric items, making this sandwich a perfect fit for their inventory.
grand_country_wario_crumb_sandwich.shippingDetail: Shipped via the efficient Delivery Drone service, ensuring freshness upon delivery.

usage.activation: Eaten as a bonus action at the start of your turn.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: If you consume another Wario's Gravity-Defying Crumb Sandwich before completing a short or long rest, the effect ends immediately and all benefits are lost.

grand_country_wario_crumb_sandwich.priceReason: The sandwich is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique combination of flavor, lore, and temporary buffs.

internet_glitch_charm.name: Reality Ripple Charm
internet_glitch_charm.description: The Reality Ripple Charm is a sleek, metallic trinket that hums faintly as it draws its power from the very fabric of reality itself. Crafted by the enigmatic data_dealer, this charm briefly distorts perception and cognition, making the wearer appear as if they're experiencing an internet meme overload. Activating it in the middle of a conversation can lead to both allies and foes becoming momentarily confused, but beware—its effect is not without its quirks.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action within 30 feet, the charm distorts time for the target. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 round, during which they have disadvantage on all perception checks and are unable to take any actions.

effectDetails.title: Cognitive Dissonance
effectDetails.rules: Upon failing their save against Temporal Distortion, the target must repeat a random internet meme aloud every time they speak for 1 minute. The DM selects an appropriate meme from a list provided by data_dealer for each use.

internet_glitch_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm's ability to distort reality requires a certain degree of magical aptitude.
internet_glitch_charm.vendorReason: As a purveyor of arcane and digital curiosities, data_dealer is known for their unique inventory of items that bend the very laws of physics and logic.
internet_glitch_charm.shippingDetail: Shipped via packet_delivery's express courier service, ensuring timely delivery through the most secure and reliable means available.

usage.activation: Bonus action within 30 feet of target
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; ends when used or if target saves successfully
usage.endsWhen: Target makes a successful Wisdom saving throw
usage.charges: 5 charges, recharges after a long rest

internet_glitch_charm.priceReason: The charm's rarity and magical properties justify its high price in the market.

internet_firewall_suit.name: Data Fortress Armor
internet_firewall_suit.description: The Data Fortress Armor is a suit of quantum-enhanced armor forged from encrypted code and entangled particles, crafted by the cyber wizards of the Quantum Forge. Its layers weave together to form a nearly impenetrable barrier against digital threats, granting unparalleled protection in the virtual battlefield. This armor not only reflects magical attacks back at their caster but also offers resistance to firewall breaches and virus intrusions, ensuring that even the most insidious digital threats are repelled.

effectDetails.title: Quantum Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to all forms of digital damage, including firewall attacks and virus infections. This effect is active as long as the armor remains intact.

effectDetails.title: Magical Reflection
effectDetails.rules: When a magical attack hits the wearer, there's a 50% chance that the attack will be reflected back at the attacker, dealing damage equal to half of the original attack. This effect can occur once per short rest.

internet_firewall_suit.levelRequirementReason: The armor requires significant skill and understanding of quantum mechanics to operate effectively.
internet_firewall_suit.vendorReason: The Quantum Forge has exclusive rights to distribute this cutting-edge technology.
internet_firewall_suit.shippingDetail: Delivered via high-speed drones, ensuring rapid deployment in the field.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the armor.
usage.duration: Persistent as long as worn; recharges at dawn.
usage.endsWhen: Exhaustion or removal of the armor.

internet_firewall_suit.priceReason: Balanced against other rare armors, considering its unique quantum properties and effectiveness.

midlands_item_crimson_banner.name: Crimson Banner of Discontent
midlands_item_crimson_banner.description: The Crimson Banner of Discontent is a tattered standard soaked in the blood of countless minor rebellions. Its frayed edges and crimson stains whisper tales of unrest, making it a potent tool for stirring discord among nobles. When unfurled during negotiations, it either sways a stubborn noble with its aura of dissent or provokes them into an impulsive act that could derail talks. The banner's power lies in its ability to sow seeds of discontent and amplify tensions.

effectDetails.title: Sow Discontent
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, increasing the user’s Persuasion skill by +5 for up to 3 turns. The effect ends immediately if the user fails a Diplomacy check during this time.

effectDetails.title: Provocation Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that waving the banner will cause a small riot in the immediate area, disrupting any ongoing negotiations or meetings for at least 3 turns. This effect has no save DC and can only occur once per encounter.

midlands_item_crimson_banner.levelRequirementReason: The banner's potency requires a character of at least 7th level to wield it effectively in high-stakes negotiations.
midlands_item_crimson_banner.vendorReason: The Midlands Merchant specializes in rare and historically significant items, making the Crimson Banner a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_item_crimson_banner.shippingDetail: Ships via Imperial Courier for expedited delivery with an additional handling fee of 50 XP.

usage.duration: Up to 3 turns, or until the user fails a Diplomacy check during this time
usage.endsWhen: The banner's effect ends if the user fails a Diplomacy check while active

midlands_item_crimson_banner.priceReason: The banner’s balanced price reflects its rarity and strategic value in high-stakes diplomacy.

midlands_item_echoing_shard.name: Echoing Shard of the Fallen King
midlands_item_echoing_shard.description: The Echoing Shard of the Fallen King is a jagged fragment of obsidian, said to have been plucked from the heart of an ancient king's tomb. Its surface glows faintly with cryptic runes that whisper tales of forgotten glory. Hold it close and let its whispers seep into your mind—be warned, for prolonged exposure can drive you mad with visions of past grandeur, but in a fleeting moment of brilliance, your intelligence may spike, though at the cost of charisma.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Past Glory
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the shard grants cryptic visions that can enhance or distort your understanding. There is a 5% chance per minute spent in close proximity to gain temporary madness from these visions. The effect lasts for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Intellect Surge
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful activation, the shard grants +3 Intelligence for 1 turn but simultaneously reduces Charisma by -2. The effect is limited to once per long rest.

midlands_item_echoing_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Echoing Shard requires a lower level due to its mythic rarity and balance with other items.
midlands_item_echoing_shard.vendorReason: The shard's origin from an ancient king's tomb makes it a perfect artifact for the expert craftsmen of Fractured Forge.
midlands_item_echoing_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Winged Courier, but only on days marked by celestial alignment.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and hold close.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until madness is gained from visions.
usage.endsWhen: Madness effect occurs or after 1 hour.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited once per long rest.

midlands_item_echoing_shard.priceReason: The Echoing Shard's price reflects its mythic rarity and the balance it provides to other items in the market.

midlands_item_empire_favor.name: Empire Favor Token - House Valerius
midlands_item_empire_favor.description: The Empire Favor Token - House Valerius is a gleaming brass token engraved with the heraldic crest of House Valerius, whose cunning and resourcefulness are legendary. This token grants you access to exclusive missions that House Valerius deems worthy of your skills, and it increases your standing within the noble house by 10 points. With this favor, goods purchased from the Empire Exchange come with a generous discount, allowing you to secure rare items at lower costs.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Valerius Missions
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. Grants access to one special mission per week, which can provide valuable experience and rewards. Ends when the mission is completed or after a month of inactivity.

effectDetails.title: Increased Influence
effectDetails.rules: Increases your influence with House Valerius by 10 points immediately upon activation. This increase lasts for one month but resets to zero if you are seen as disloyal or engage in activities contrary to the house's interests.

midlands_item_empire_favor.levelRequirementReason: House Valerius welcomes all who prove their worth, but they require at least a first-level character for missions that align with their strategic goals.
midlands_item_empire_favor.vendorReason: The Empire Exchange maintains exclusive partnerships to ensure only those trusted by House Valerius receive the favor token.
midlands_item_empire_favor.shippingDetail: Ships within three days, delivered directly to your doorstep in a secure, tamper-evident container.

usage.duration: One month from activation.
usage.endsWhen: Upon completion of the mission or if influence is reduced to zero for disloyalty.

midlands_item_empire_favor.priceReason: The value reflects both the token's exclusive access and the strategic importance it holds in gaining favor with House Valerius.

faerun_item_shadowfell_whisper.name: Shadowfell Whisper Stone
faerun_item_shadowfell_whisper.description: The Shadowfell Whisper Stone is a pulsing obsidian orb that hums with the whispers of forgotten lore and dark secrets. This eerie artifact, crafted from the very essence of the Shadowfell, offers cryptic advice to those who hold it—advice that often veers toward caution and survival. While it occasionally demands shiny trinkets as payment for its counsel, ignoring it entirely might lead to unwanted attention from creatures of the deep dark.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +2 bonus to Wisdom saving throws and Intelligence checks related to investigation for an hour after activation.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Advice
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The stone whispers cryptic advice, which can be used once per short or long rest; it has a 50% chance of being helpful and a 25% chance of being dangerous.

faerun_item_shadowfell_whisper.levelRequirementReason: The item's power is balanced for characters who have faced some challenges but are still developing their skills.
faerun_item_shadowfell_whisper.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar often stocks rare and powerful items suitable for adventurers of all levels, ensuring they can find what they need.
faerun_item_shadowfell_whisper.shippingDetail: Ships via the swift Messenger Hawk courier, delivered within three days.

usage.activation: Bonus Action (once per short or long rest)
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for an hour after activation
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when it is used up or until the end of the next short or long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a short or long rest

faerun_item_shadowfell_whisper.priceReason: The item's rarity and utility justify its price in terms of experience points.

faerun_item_waterdeep_merchant_favor.name: Waterdeep Merchant's Favor Token
faerun_item_waterdeep_merchant_favor.description: The Waterdeep Merchant's Favor Token is a gleaming coin of silver and gold, emblazoned with the heraldic falcon of House Phandalin. This token not only grants access to exclusive discounts and early notifications on rare goods within the bustling market but also allows you to influence local merchants for special procurements. With this token, you can commandeer rare supplies that are otherwise hard to find in the city’s crowded bazaars.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Discounts
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, providing a +2 bonus on saving throws to resist price gouging within Waterdeep. This effect lasts for an hour and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Merchants' Influence
effectDetails.rules: Can be activated as a reaction when engaging in trade negotiations with local merchants, allowing you to roll a d12 to influence the outcome of the deal. Success grants a 50% discount on that specific transaction. This effect is limited to once per week.

faerun_item_waterdeep_merchant_favor.levelRequirementReason: This token is accessible to all adventurers, serving as an entry-level way to connect with Waterdeep's bustling market.
faerun_item_waterdeep_merchant_favor.vendorReason: The token is a staple in the daily operations of the Waterdeep Market and widely recognized by local merchants.
faerun_item_waterdeep_merchant_favor.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly via the Sea Gull courier service, ensuring your token arrives within three days from order placement.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Discounts; Reaction for Influence
usage.duration: Hour for Discounts; Instantaneous for Influence
usage.endsWhen: Daily limit reached for Discounts; Weekly limit for Influence

faerun_item_waterdeep_merchant_favor.priceReason: The token's value is balanced by its utility and the rarity of goods it can procure, making it a fair price point.

equestria_item_sparklehoof_boots.name: Sparklehoof's Speedy Striders
equestria_item_sparklehoof_boots.description: Sparklehoof's Speedy Striders are legendary boots handcrafted by the finest hoof-smiths of Ponyville. These sturdy, gleaming leather and starstone boots allow you to sprint through fields with ease, reducing your stamina consumption by half while running. The stars themselves seem to align when you wear them, granting a +20 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks for dashing and dodging in the open sky. Wario’s obsession with speed is no secret; these boots have been known to outpace even the fastest Pegasi in a race.

effectDetails.title: Increased Stamina
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these boots, your movement speed is increased by +50%, and you reduce your stamina consumption by half when running or sprinting. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Astral Acrobatics
effectDetails.rules: When you use a Dash action while wearing these boots, you can make an Acrobatics check at advantage against falling damage and have a 25% chance to avoid being knocked prone during the dash.

equestria_item_sparklehoof_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are crafted for adventurers who wish to test their speed in challenging terrains.
equestria_item_sparklehoof_boots.vendorReason: As a bustling market town, Ponyville Market stocks the finest wares from local artisans and beyond.
equestria_item_sparklehoof_boots.shippingDetail: Boots are delivered swiftly by the trusted Delivery Ponies, ensuring they arrive in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing the boots.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Removed from your feet or destroyed.
