night_twilight_boo_lantern.warning: Wario: 'If the Boos ask, this is a NIGHTLIGHT, okay?'

night_underground_bank_chip.name: Underground Bank Access Chip
night_underground_bank_chip.description: A metal coin with a scannable glyph linking to a very illegal vault.
effects: At night in any major town: You can 'visit' a hidden Wario-run banker; deposit or withdraw up to 5000 gold remotely (no physical chest needed)
Gold stored this way is unfindable by normal theft and most divinations, but if Wario’s bank gets raided… tough luck
Each weekly use has a 5% chance that 'fees' eat 1d100 of your stored gold
night_underground_bank_chip.warning: Fine print: 'Bank may, at any time, become on fire.'

night_ghost_mushroom_tea_set.name: Ghost Mushroom Tea Set
night_ghost_mushroom_tea_set.description: Porcelain cups and a chipped teapot that smell like grave dirt and chamomile.
effects: 3 charges. At night, spend 10 minutes brewing tea: drinker can cast Speak with Dead once (no spell slot required, 1 target)
For 1 hour after drinking, you can see faint silhouettes of nearby spirits (no mechanical bonus beyond RP/DM calls)
On a CON save fail DC 12, you gain one level of Spooked: disadvantage on saves vs. fear until dawn
night_ghost_mushroom_tea_set.warning: Wario: 'If the dead start nagging you, that's not my problem.'

night_boo_chain_contract.name: Boo Chain Harassment Contract
night_boo_chain_contract.description: A greasy scroll hiring a small squad of Boos for… 'nocturnal persuasion'.
effects: Once per week at midnight: Designate one NPC; for the next 3 nights, they are haunted by minor Boos (sleepless, distracted)
Mechanically: target has disadvantage on Insight & Concentration checks for 3 in-game days (if they need to sleep)
10% chance target hires an exorcist who traces the contract back to you

night_royal_ledger_scrap.name: Scrap from the Royal War Ledger
night_royal_ledger_scrap.description: A torn page listing coded payments, bribes, and 'donations' during the civil war.
effects: At night: Once per long rest, ask it one question about who financed a faction, noble house, or battle. Cryptic but truthful intel (DM answer).
Advantage on Persuasion or Intimidation against any NPC whose name appears in its entries (if you show them).
Reading it by daylight causes headaches: Disadvantage on Intelligence checks for 1 hour.
night_royal_ledger_scrap.warning: Several names have been clumsily scratched out with purple marker. Wonder who.

night_koopa_night_watch_badge.name: Koopa Night Watchman Badge
night_koopa_night_watch_badge.description: A blackened security badge from Bowser’s old curfew patrols.
effects: While wearing at night: Advantage on Perception checks to spot intruders, ambushes, or sneaking creatures
+2 to Initiative at night as long as you are on 'guard duty' (not sleeping or carousing)
Disadvantage on Persuasion with anyone who lived under the curfew (they remember the badge)
night_koopa_night_watch_badge.warning: Some older Toads will slam their shutters when they see it.

night_piranha_seed_pouch.name: Midnight Piranha Seed Pouch
night_piranha_seed_pouch.description: A cloth pouch of twitching seeds labeled 'PLANT AFTER DARK – STAND BACK'.
effects: Contains 3 seeds. Planting one at night (1 action) creates a hidden Piranha Plant trap that awakens on the next nightfall (CR & exact stats = DM).
Creatures stepping in the 5 ft area must succeed a DEX save DC 13 or be bitten (2d6 piercing) and restrained until they use an action to escape.
Piranha Plant withers at dawn after its first attack, leaving a suspiciously Wario-shaped scorch mark.
night_piranha_seed_pouch.warning: Do NOT plant inside your own bedroom. Learned that one the hard way.

night_roulette_coin_of_fate.name: Roulette Coin of Midnight Fate
night_roulette_coin_of_fate.description: A heavy coin with a 'W' on one side and a skull on the other. It hums in casinos.
effects: Once per night: Before a d20 roll, flip the coin: on W (50%), treat any result of 9 or lower as a 10; on skull (50%), treat any result of 12 or higher as an 11
Gambling with it gives +10% returns on winnings, but also doubles losses
If you ever flip it 3 nights in a row and get skull each time, it vanishes and all your non-magical gold disappears with it (into 'fees')
night_roulette_coin_of_fate.warning: Guaranteed to make your life exciting. Not guaranteed to keep you solvent.

night_mirror_of_shady_referrals.name: Mirror of Shady Referrals
night_mirror_of_shady_referrals.description: A cracked hand-mirror that shows the face of a different black-market contact each night.
effects: Once per night: Speak a request into the mirror (item/service/rumor); DM introduces a contact or opportunity that can vaguely help with that (with strings attached)
You gain a permanent 5% discount with any contact you first met through the mirror
Each time you use it, there’s a 10% chance the contact is actually an informant or double-agent
night_mirror_of_shady_referrals.warning: Wario: 'These are all my VERY TRUSTWORTHY friends. Heh.'

night_bullet_bill_signal_flare.name: Bullet Bill Signal Flare
night_bullet_bill_signal_flare.description: A single black flare with angry eyes painted on the casing.
effects: One-use item. Fire it into the sky at night as an action to summon a homing mini Bullet Bill
On your next turn, designate a point or creature you can see within 300 ft; Bullet Bill streaks there: 4d6 force damage (DEX save DC 14 for half) in 10 ft radius
10% chance Bill misreads the signal and aims at the strongest visible source of coin instead (DM chooses a 'rich' target)
night_bullet_bill_signal_flare.warning: DO NOT light indoors. Unless you really hate your ceiling.

night_spiked_chomp_collar.name: Night-Run Spiked Chomp Collar
night_spiked_chomp_collar.description: A collar supposedly used for 'midnight walks' with a very illegal Chain Chomp.
effects: While worn as a belt/torc: your bite or unarmed attack can deal 1d6 piercing instead of normal damage, once per turn
At night, you gain advantage on Intimidation checks against beasts and simple monsters
Occasionally tugs you toward locked gates or vaults like it remembers old routes
night_spiked_chomp_collar.warning: Collar may attract actual Chain Chomps looking for their old owner.

night_starless_cloak_lining.name: Starless Cloak Lining
night_starless_cloak_lining.description: A detachable lining made from fabric that refuses to reflect starlight.
effects: Sewn into any cloak/coat (10 min): At night, you gain advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness
While active, you cannot benefit from any effect that relies on starlight (star-based divinations, certain blessings – DM call)
If exposed to bright sunlight for an hour, lining curls up and deactivates until next sunset
night_starless_cloak_lining.warning: Wario: 'Hides you from the stars, AND from witnesses. Two-for-one!'

night_ink_of_anonymous_graffiti.name: Ink of Anonymous Graffiti
night_ink_of_anonymous_graffiti.description: A small vial of purple ink that only shows up under moonlight.
effects: Contains enough ink for 5 large tags. Anything written with it is invisible except at night or in magical darkness
While standing near your own tag at night, you gain +2 to any single Charisma check once (then that tag loses its magic)
Law enforcement cannot track magical aura back to the writer; however, Wario absolutely can (and will, if owed money)
night_ink_of_anonymous_graffiti.warning: Not liable for slogans that start revolutions… unless Wario gets a cut.

night_smuggler_mushroom_roadmap.name: Smuggler’s Mushroom Roadmap
night_smuggler_mushroom_roadmap.description: A stained cloth map showing routes through the war-scarred Kingdom marked with tiny toadstools.
effects: While traveling at night, party overland travel speed increases by 25% along mapped regions
Once per long rest, you may avoid a random encounter by 'taking a side path' (DM adjusts narration)
Every use has a 10% chance the map updates with a new hidden cache or smuggler safehouse (plot hook)
night_smuggler_mushroom_roadmap.warning: Routes may occasionally go through 'mildly cursed' ruins. Wario calls that 'scenic'.

night_phantom_kart_voucher.name: Phantom Kart Escape Voucher
night_phantom_kart_voucher.description: A stamped ticket that smells like burnt rubber and ectoplasm.
effects: One-use: Snap the voucher at night to summon a spectral kart for your party (up to 4 Medium or 8 Small creatures)
Kart moves at incredible speed: counts as automatic escape from most non-flying pursuers within one scene (DM adjudication)
After use, there’s a 20% chance the kart decides to take a 'shortcut' through Boo-infested roads, causing a brief spooky encounter

night_midnight_shell_mail.name: Midnight Shell Mail
night_midnight_shell_mail.description: Dark Koopa mail armor, lacquered to blend with the night.
effects: At night: advantage on Stealth checks in urban or rocky terrain
In bright light: -5 ft movement (heat-absorbing shell bakes you)

night_blackout_fire_flower.name: Blackout Fire Flower
night_blackout_fire_flower.description: A soot-black Fire Flower that burns away light as well as enemies.
effects: Once per night: cast Burning Hands (3d6 fire, DC 14) and snuff all non-magical light in a 20 ft radius
You can see through this magical darkness as dim light
Any use in daylight blinds you for 1 round (no fire effect)
night_blackout_fire_flower.warning: Great for ambushes, terrible for reading.

night_koopa_courier_boots.name: Koopa Night Courier Boots
night_koopa_courier_boots.description: Silent-soled boots stamped with an old curfew patrol insignia.
effects: At night: +10 ft movement and advantage on Stealth while running messages (you move between two known locations)
Once per long rest: Dash as a bonus action without provoking opportunity attacks
In heavy daylight crowds, disadvantage on Stealth (bright crest gives you away)

night_boo_pager.name: Boo Pager
night_boo_pager.description: A rattling little device that summons a nosy Boo with the press of a button.
effects: Once per night: summon a minor Boo spy for 1 hour; it can scout up to 60 ft away and report telepathically (no combat stats, DM narrates)
Boo can pass through most walls but flees bright light or strong holy auras
Each use has a 5% chance the Boo brings back gossip about YOU instead

night_wartime_looter_gloves.name: Wartime Looter’s Gloves
night_wartime_looter_gloves.description: Fingerless gloves that have rifled through more pockets than Wario will admit.
effects: Advantage on Sleight of Hand at night
Once per night: automatically succeed on one pickpocket against an unaware commoner-level NPC (DM discretion on loot)
On a failed Sleight of Hand vs guards, they gain advantage to recognize these gloves later

night_rogueport_forged_passport.name: Rogueport Forged Passport
night_rogueport_forged_passport.description: A very convincing travel document full of fake Mushroom Kingdom visas.
effects: Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks to bypass city gates, curfews, and checkpoints
Once per night: treat a failed Deception check vs bureaucrats as a 10 (if result was worse)
Any natural 1 on such checks flags you in all 'official' systems tied to Peach-era bureaucracy

night_dark_yoshi_saddle.name: Dark Yoshi Recon Saddle
night_dark_yoshi_saddle.description: A stealth-fitted Yoshi saddle designed for black-ops cavalry.
effects: While mounted on a Yoshi or similar mount at night: both rider and mount gain advantage on Stealth
Once per long rest: perform a 'silent charge' – first attack from mount this round has advantage
In bright daylight, mount becomes skittish: disadvantage on Animal Handling checks with it

night_chomp_chain_keyring.name: Chomp-Chain Keyring
night_chomp_chain_keyring.description: A heavy keyring made from retired Chain Chomp links.
effects: Advantage on checks to break mundane chains, shackles or padlocks at night
Once per night: treat your Strength score as 18 for a single shove/bust attempt
Clinks loudly if you move faster than a walk (disadvantage on Stealth while running)

night_thieves_market_membership.name: Thieves’ Market Membership Token
night_thieves_market_membership.description: A stamped wooden token granting access to pop-up black markets.
effects: At night in any sizable settlement: you can locate a temporary thieves’ market within an hour (DM populates vendors)
Permanent 10% discount on illegal/black-market purchases there
Every use has a 10% chance the market is mid-raid when you arrive

night_stolen_koopa_war_banner.name: Stolen Koopa War Banner (Night Standard)
night_stolen_koopa_war_banner.description: A ragged banner Bowser’s troops once raised over Toad Town at dusk.
effects: When planted at night: allies within 20 ft gain +1 to damage rolls against enemies who fear Bowser/Koopas
Koopa-aligned creatures in the area must pass WIS save DC 13 or have disadvantage on their first attack vs the banner’s side
In daylight, planting it instead gives -1 morale to most civilians present

night_burned_peach_wanted_poster.name: Burned Peach Loyalist Wanted Poster
night_burned_peach_wanted_poster.description: A charred poster offering a bounty on a now-dead Peach loyalist.
effects: At night: advantage on Insight & History checks about the civil war factions
Once per night: tear off a piece to gain +1 to a single Intimidation check against ex-soldiers or rebels
Using it openly with royalist NPCs imposes disadvantage on Persuasion for 24 hours

night_undead_toll_contract.name: Undead Toll-Road Contract
night_undead_toll_contract.description: A ‘legal’ agreement with a minor undead patrol to ignore you… mostly.
effects: While traveling between midnight and dawn in graveyards/battlefields, non-intelligent undead are indifferent unless attacked
Once per night: you may pass through one undead-held choke point without being stopped (unless a greater undead is present)
Breaking the truce (striking first) causes all such undead to target you preferentially for a week

night_phantom_coin_purse.name: Phantom Coin Purse
night_phantom_coin_purse.description: A purse that feels empty by day and heavy by night.
effects: Any coins placed inside from legitimate loot appear weightless until nightfall (no encumbrance from coins)
At midnight, you may 'wash' up to 500 gp into completely untraceable, nondescript coinage
Each week, roll d20: on a 1, 1d100 gp just… vanishes (Wario’s 'maintenance fee')

night_mario_bro_broken_wrench.name: Mario Bro. Broken Wrench
night_mario_bro_broken_wrench.description: Half of a once-iconic plumber’s tool, engraved with an M and scorch marks.
effects: Once per long rest at night: gain advantage on a single Strength or Dex check to sabotage or repair mechanical defenses
You can use it as an improvised melee weapon (1d6 bludgeoning) that crits on 19–20 against constructs
If you ever strike an ally with it deliberately, it becomes mundane (Mario’s ghostly disapproval?)

night_civil_war_dogtag_chain.name: Chain of Mixed Dogtags
night_civil_war_dogtag_chain.description: A chain threaded with ID tags from both sides of the conflict.
effects: Once per night: reroll a failed death save (must use second result)
Advantage on Insight vs veterans of the war (you can read the trauma)
Wearing them imposes disadvantage on saves vs fear effects involving battlefields or mass death

night_spirit_of_the_war_drum.name: Haunted War Drumhead
night_spirit_of_the_war_drum.description: The drumhead of a Toad war drum, now tensioned with spectral sinew.
effects: Once per night: Beat the drum to grant all allies within 30 ft temporary HP equal to your level + your Cha mod
Also imposes disadvantage on enemy fear effects against those allies until dawn
Each use risks waking a slumbering battle-spirit (DM may trigger a spectral encounter)
night_spirit_of_the_war_drum.warning: Neighbors WILL complain. If they’re still alive.

night_napkin_oath_with_bowser_jr.name: Crumpled Napkin Oath (Bowser Jr. 'Deal')
night_napkin_oath_with_bowser_jr.description: A smeared napkin that says 'NO SNITCH – B.J.' next to a childish drawing.
effects: Once per week, at night: you can call in one favor from a rogue Koopa squad (small strike team or distraction, DM-defined)
Using it leaves unmistakable traces; Bowser or his generals may become aware of your meddling
After 3 uses, the ink runs and the pact dissolves

night_shadow_mario_graffiti_can.name: Shadow Mario Graffiti Can
night_shadow_mario_graffiti_can.description: A can of paint allegedly 'borrowed' from Bowser Jr.'s arsenal.
effects: Once per night: paint a 10×10 ft patch of illusory terrain or wall that behaves as difficult terrain for others (lasts 1 hour)
You and chosen allies can pass through as if normal terrain
If exposed to sunlight, paint turns into embarrassing Wario fan-art

night_boo_tailored_pinstripe_suit.name: Boo-Tailored Pinstripe Suit
night_boo_tailored_pinstripe_suit.description: A sharp suit that never rustles, sized just a bit too big and smelling of cigar smoke.
effects: At night: +2 to Charisma (Deception) and (Persuasion) checks regarding illegal deals or bribes
Once per long rest: auto-succeed a single Deception check against a non-heroic NPC (DM decides what 'non-heroic' means)
In holy ground, the suit itches and imposes disadvantage on Charisma checks

night_wario_branded_lockpick_watch.name: Wario-Branded Lockpick Watch
night_wario_branded_lockpick_watch.description: A chunky wristwatch whose face flips up to reveal a tiny toolkit.
effects: Counts as masterwork thieves’ tools at night: +2 bonus to lockpicking attempts
Once per night: you may pick a non-magical lock as a bonus action
Natural 1 on a lockpicking roll jams the watch until repaired (no tool bonus until fixed)

night_peach_balcony_shadow_fragment.name: Shadow Fragment of Peach’s Balcony
night_peach_balcony_shadow_fragment.description: Not the stone – the shadow of the old balcony, bottled at dusk.
effects: Once per night: pour it on a flat surface to create a 15 ft-radius patch of deep shadow that counts as heavily obscured for 10 minutes
Allies in the area have advantage on Stealth; enemies have disadvantage on ranged attacks into or through it
Using it more than 3 times causes the fragment to fade permanently

night_bullet_bill_night_racing_permit.name: Night Racing Permit (Bullet Bill League)
night_bullet_bill_night_racing_permit.description: A laminated card granting entry to highly-illegal night-time races.
effects: Gives access to underground night races (DM: social hub, betting, rare vendors)
Once per in-game week, winning a race can net 1d4×1000 gp or an epic favor
Each visit has a 15% chance your vehicle is 'kindly borrowed' by someone else by morning

night_dry_bones_clattering_dice.name: Dry Bones Clattering Dice
night_dry_bones_clattering_dice.description: A pair of dice carved from Dry Bones finger-bones. They never quite stop rattling.
effects: Once per night: Before a d20 roll, roll these; on a 10–12, you may treat your d20 roll as if it were a 10
On snake eyes (2): your next failed death save cannot be rerolled by any means
Bones rattle audibly within 10 ft when undead are nearby (DM chooses range)

night_star_thief_handbook.name: Star Thief’s Night Handbook
night_star_thief_handbook.description: A slim booklet of 'tips' on stealing divine artifacts under cover of night.
effects: After studying 1 hour at night, gain advantage on your next single skill check made to steal/procure a magical item
If that attempt fails catastrophically (nat 1), the item’s owner becomes vaguely aware of 'someone matching your vibe'
Book whispers advice in a smug Wario-voice whenever you pass a temple or vault

night_koopa_trench_periscope.name: Koopa Trench Periscope
night_koopa_trench_periscope.description: A collapsible periscope with night-tuned lenses and shell-scratch etchings.
effects: Advantage on Perception checks to observe from total cover at night
Once per night: you can grant an ally advantage on their first ranged attack by spotting for them
Using it in bright daylight imposes disadvantage on Perception for 10 minutes (blinds you with glare)

night_boo_campfire_log.name: Boo Campfire Log
night_boo_campfire_log.description: A log that burns with cold blue fire, attracting the talkative dead.
effects: Burning at night for a short rest: party gains advantage on one collective History or Lore check about the civil war, as ghosts chime in
Undead within 60 ft are drawn closer but remain cautious (they won’t attack unless provoked for the duration)
Fuel for three uses; after that, it crumbles into ordinary ash

night_starlit_shy_guy_lantern.name: Starlit Shy Guy Lantern
night_starlit_shy_guy_lantern.description: A lantern with a Shy Guy mask for a face, glowing only under starlight.
effects: At night under clear sky: sheds 30 ft bright/30 ft dim light that does not reveal the wielder’s exact position (enemies cannot pinpoint you by the light alone)
Bonus: advantage on Survival checks for nighttime navigation by stars
Lantern sputters and goes out during storms or heavy cloud cover

night_toad_rebel_signal_whistle.name: Toad Rebel Signal Whistle
night_toad_rebel_signal_whistle.description: A two-tone whistle used to coordinate resistance cells after curfew.
effects: Once per night: blow it to call nearby sympathetic commoners/resistance (DM: 1–3 low-CR NPC allies, or rumor/help)
Advantage on Charisma checks with underground Toad groups while it’s visible
Any guard hearing it gets advantage on checks to search the area that night

night_luigi_flashlight_of_cowardice.name: Luigi’s Flashlight of Cowardice
night_luigi_flashlight_of_cowardice.description: A green flashlight that shakes a little when you hold it.
effects: Bright 40 ft cone of light; any ghostly/undead creatures in beam must pass WIS DC 13 or have disadvantage on attacks for 1 round
Once per long rest: gain advantage on a single save vs fear while clutching it and yelling a catchphrase
If you willingly move toward a terrifying creature while holding it, roll WIS DC 12 or be forced to move back 10 ft instead

night_ration_of_starlight_mushroom_soup.name: Ration of Starlight Mushroom Soup
night_ration_of_starlight_mushroom_soup.description: A sealed jar of silver-flecked mushroom broth, best consumed under the stars.
effects: Single-use. Drinking at night grants darkvision 60 ft (or +30 ft if you already have it) for 8 hours
Also grants advantage on one Wisdom saving throw during that time
Drinking it in sunlight makes you lethargic: gain disadvantage on Initiative until next long rest

night_garlic_investment_bond.name: Wario’s Garlic Investment Bond
night_garlic_investment_bond.description: A foul-smelling bond certificate promising 'Lucrative Nocturnal Returns'.
effects: Pay 30000g: every in-game week you receive 1d4×1000g in 'dividends' at midnight (from 'mysterious sources')
After 4 payouts, roll d20: on 1–3, the scheme collapses and you receive nothing further; on 4–20, it continues another 4 weeks (repeat)
All wealth from this bond is considered 'hot' money; certain factions may track or resent it
night_garlic_investment_bond.warning: It’s not a pyramid scheme. Wario prefers the term 'triangle of opportunity'.

wario_recipe_garlic_grenade_soup.name: Recipe: Garlic Grenade Soup
wario_recipe_garlic_grenade_soup.description: A soup that explodes in your mouth. Wario's favorite.
effects: Creates a soup that deals 2d6 poison damage to anyone within 10 ft who smells it (CON save DC 13)
Drinking it grants immunity to poison for 1 hour (but you take 1d6 poison damage)
The pot becomes a minor explosive: can be thrown for 1d8 fire damage

halfling_recipe_second_breakfast_surpris.name: Recipe: Second Breakfast Surprise
halfling_recipe_second_breakfast_surpris.description: A dish that looks like breakfast but tastes like dinner.
effects: Eating it confuses enemies: advantage on Deception checks for 1 hour
You are full for 8 hours: no need for other meals
Disadvantage on Charisma checks with food snobs

mages_guild_recipe_spell_slot_soup.name: Recipe: Spell Slot Soup
mages_guild_recipe_spell_slot_soup.description: A broth made from boiled spell scrolls.
effects: Consuming a bowl restores one 1st-level spell slot
Tastes like ink and paper: disadvantage on Persuasion for 1 hour
You glow faintly for 1 hour (disadvantage on Stealth)

dwarf_realms_recipe_mithril_ale_brew.name: Recipe: Mithril Ale Brew
dwarf_realms_recipe_mithril_ale_brew.description: A beer so strong it can dent armor.
effects: Grants +2 to Constitution saves for 8 hours
Disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 hour
Your breath can ignite small flames (1 fire damage to flammable objects)

greenskins_recipe_waaagh_stew.name: Recipe: WAAAGH! Stew
greenskins_recipe_waaagh_stew.description: A stew that makes you want to fight everything.
effects: You must attack the nearest creature each round (Wis save DC 13 to resist)

mushroom_regency_recipe_poison_mushroom_.name: Recipe: Poison Mushroom Deluxe
mushroom_regency_recipe_poison_mushroom_.description: A mushroom that poisons enemies but heals you.
effects: Cook a mushroom that deals 2d6 poison to enemies who eat it
You gain 2d6 temporary HP if you eat it (you're immune to the poison)
Toads are disgusted: disadvantage on Charisma with them

beanbean_kingdom_recipe_royal_bean_feast.name: Recipe: Royal Bean Feast
beanbean_kingdom_recipe_royal_bean_feast.description: A feast fit for a king (who likes beans).
effects: Feeds 10 people: each gains +1 to Constitution saves for 24 hours
Everyone must make a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned by gas for 1 hour
Advantage on Charisma checks with bean enthusiasts

dk_crew_recipe_banana_bomb_pudding.name: Recipe: Banana Bomb Pudding
dk_crew_recipe_banana_bomb_pudding.description: A pudding that explodes with banana flavor.
effects: Throw pudding: 1d6 bludgeoning + target must DC 13 Dex save or be blinded by banana mush
Eating it restores 1d8 HP but you must shout 'BANANA SLAMMA!'
Monkeys attack you on sight for 1 hour

yoshi_clans_recipe_egg_shell_soup.name: Recipe: Eggshell Soup
yoshi_clans_recipe_egg_shell_soup.description: A soup made from crushed eggshells. Surprisingly nutritious.
effects: You have disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 hour (stiff joints)
Yoshis are horrified: disadvantage on Charisma with them

kremling_krew_recipe_cannonball_chowder.name: Recipe: Cannonball Chowder
kremling_krew_recipe_cannonball_chowder.description: A thick stew with iron-rich chunks.
effects: Your teeth hurt: disadvantage on Charisma checks involving smiling
Metal detectors go off around you for 1 hour

lizardmen_recipe_swamp_sushi.name: Recipe: Swamp Sushi
lizardmen_recipe_swamp_sushi.description: Raw fish from the swamp. What could go wrong?
effects: Advantage on saves vs. disease for 8 hours
Constitution save DC 13 or contract a minor disease anyway
Reptiles respect you: advantage on Charisma with them

halfling_recipe_herb_crusted_pie.name: Recipe: Herb-Crusted Comfort Pie
halfling_recipe_herb_crusted_pie.description: A pie that tastes like home.
effects: Advantage on saves vs. fear for 8 hours
You become homesick: disadvantage on checks if far from home

dwarf_realms_recipe_iron_gut_stew.name: Recipe: Iron Gut Stew
dwarf_realms_recipe_iron_gut_stew.description: A stew that makes your stomach indestructible.
effects: You can eat anything without harm (rocks, metal, etc.)
Disadvantage on Charisma checks (your breath is terrible)

greenskins_recipe_goblin_gumbo_deluxe.name: Recipe: Goblin Gumbo Deluxe
greenskins_recipe_goblin_gumbo_deluxe.description: A stew that makes you think like a goblin.
effects: Advantage on Stealth checks for 1 hour
You must make a DC 10 Wisdom save or act like a goblin (disadvantage on Charisma)
Immune to being charmed by goblins

mages_guild_recipe_mana_muffins.name: Recipe: Mana Muffins
effects: You must eat it while casting: disadvantage on Concentration for 1 hour

wario_cw_mario_war_hammer.name: Civil War Relic: Mario's War Hammer
wario_cw_mario_war_hammer.description: A hammer Mario used to smash Koopa tanks. Has 'M' carved in the handle.
effects: +2 warhammer, deals extra 1d6 damage to constructs
Once per day: can smash a non-magical object of Large size or smaller instantly
You must shout 'MARIO!' when using that ability or take 1d4 psychic damage

wario_cw_bowser_war_crown.name: Civil War Relic: Bowser's War Crown (Replica)
wario_cw_bowser_war_crown.description: A replica crown Bowser wore during the siege. Wario swears it's real.
effects: +1 Charisma with Koopa Troop, -1 Charisma with everyone else
Once per day: can breathe a 15 ft cone of fire (2d6 damage, DC 13 Dex save)
Real Bowser may appear: 5% chance per day he shows up to reclaim it

wario_cw_toad_rebel_flag.name: Civil War Relic: Toad Rebel Battle Flag
wario_cw_toad_rebel_flag.description: A bloodstained flag with a mushroom and crossed swords.
effects: Allies within 30 ft gain +1 to attack rolls while flag is held
Toad loyalists are inspired: advantage on Charisma with them
Bowser's forces target you first (disadvantage on initiative vs. them)

wario_cw_luigi_silenced_pistol.name: Civil War Relic: Luigi's Silenced Pistol
wario_cw_luigi_silenced_pistol.description: A pistol Luigi used for stealth missions. It's very quiet.
effects: Ranged weapon: 60/120 ft, 2d6+2 piercing, silent (no disadvantage on Stealth)
Once per day: can fire a spectral bullet that deals 3d6 necrotic (no sound)
You must succeed DC 10 Wisdom save or be frightened for 1 round (Luigi's fear lingers)

wario_cw_peach_royal_seal.name: Civil War Relic: Princess Peach's Royal Seal
wario_cw_peach_royal_seal.description: The actual royal seal. Wario 'found' it in the rubble.
effects: Can seal any document: makes it legally binding in 12 dimensions
Once per week: can issue a royal decree that must be obeyed (Wis save DC 18)
Peach's ghost may appear: 10% chance per use she demands it back

wario_cw_koopa_troopa_shell_shield.name: Civil War Relic: Koopa Troopa Shell Shield
wario_cw_koopa_troopa_shell_shield.description: A shell used as a shield by a Koopa defector.
effects: +2 AC, can withdraw as bonus action for +4 AC but speed drops to 0
Once per day: can spin dash 20 ft as action, knocking prone everyone in path (Str save DC 14)
Koopas recognize it: advantage on Charisma with them

wario_cw_shy_guy_assassin_mask.name: Civil War Relic: Shy Guy Assassin Mask
wario_cw_shy_guy_assassin_mask.description: A black mask worn by Shy Guy assassins. Very rare.
effects: Advantage on Stealth checks in darkness
Once per day: can become invisible for 1 minute (breaks if you attack)
You cannot speak while wearing it: disadvantage on Charisma checks

wario_cw_bob_omb_battalion_flag.name: Civil War Relic: Bob-omb Battalion Flag
effects: Allies within 20 ft deal +1d4 fire damage on attacks
Once per day: can cause a 15 ft explosion (3d6 fire, Dex save DC 15)
You have disadvantage on saves vs. fire damage

wario_cw_magikoopa_staff_fragment.name: Civil War Relic: Magikoopa Staff Fragment
wario_cw_magikoopa_staff_fragment.description: A broken piece of Kamek's staff.
effects: Can cast one 1st-level spell from the wizard list once per day
You have advantage on saves vs. magic
Kamek can sense it: 20% chance per day he appears to reclaim it

wario_cw_wartime_communication_orb.name: Civil War Relic: Wartime Communication Orb
wario_cw_wartime_communication_orb.description: An orb that let generals talk across battlefields.
effects: Once per day: can send a message to anyone you've met (they hear it as a whisper)
Can receive one message per day from unknown sources (DM's choice)
Orb eavesdrops: 10% chance it broadcasts your secrets

wario_cw_toad_medic_field_kit.name: Civil War Relic: Toad Medic Field Kit
wario_cw_toad_medic_field_kit.description: A complete medical kit from the front lines.
effects: Contains 5 healing potions (2d4+2) that recharge 1 per long rest
Kit is cursed: you must help any injured creature you see (disadvantage if you don't)

wario_cw_bowser_jr_paintbrush.name: Civil War Relic: Bowser Jr's Paintbrush
wario_cw_bowser_jr_paintbrush.description: A magic brush that creates graffiti.
effects: Can paint portals on walls (10 ft teleport, 3 uses per day)
Paintings come to life and attack enemies (1d4 damage per round)
Bowser Jr may appear: 5% chance per use he demands it back

wario_cw_peach_castle_banquet_horn.name: Civil War Relic: Peach's Castle Banquet Horn
wario_cw_peach_castle_banquet_horn.description: A horn used to call soldiers to feast.
effects: Blow horn: all allies within 60 ft gain 1d8 temporary HP
Once per day: can cast Heroism on 3 creatures
Horn is loud: disadvantage on Stealth for 1 minute

wario_cw_koopa_king_scepter_tip.name: Civil War Relic: Koopa King Scepter Tip
wario_cw_koopa_king_scepter_tip.description: The jeweled tip of Bowser's scepter.
effects: +2 to Charisma with reptiles and fiends
Once per day: can cast Command as a 3rd-level spell
Bowser will destroy you to get this back: he knows you have it

wario_cw_shy_guy_squad_leader_mask.name: Civil War Relic: Shy Guy Squad Leader Mask
wario_cw_shy_guy_squad_leader_mask.description: A gold-trimmed mask that commands respect.
effects: Advantage on Charisma checks with Shy Guys
Can command up to 3 Shy Guys to follow you for 1 hour (1/day)
You cannot remove the mask: disadvantage on Charisma with everyone else

wario_land_garlic_breath_mints.name: Wario's Garlic Breath Mints
wario_land_garlic_breath_mints.description: Mints that make your breath worse. Classic Wario.
effects: Eating one gives advantage on Intimidation checks for 1 hour
Disadvantage on Persuasion checks for 2 hours

wario_land_fake_mustache_kit.name: Wario's Fake Mustache Kit
wario_land_fake_mustache_kit.description: Mustaches that make you look important.
effects: Disadvantage on Perception checks (it tickles your nose)
Falls off on any critical fail

wario_land_questionable_potion_of_questi.name: Wario's 'Probably Magic' Potion
wario_land_questionable_potion_of_questi.description: 60% chance it does something. 40% chance it's just garlic juice.
effects: Roll 1d6: 1-2 = no effect, 3-4 = 2d10 temp HP, 5-6 = +2 to all saves for 1 hour
30% chance you are poisoned for 1 round

wario_land_gold_plated_nothing.name: Wario's Gold-Plated Nothing
wario_land_gold_plated_nothing.description: A gold-plated box containing absolutely nothing. Collector's item.
effects: The box is empty but valuable: can be sold for 5000 gp
Opening it triggers Wario's laughter (audible 100 ft)
You feel profound emptiness: disadvantage on saves vs. depression for 1 day

wario_land_bootleg_princess_dress.name: Bootleg Princess Dress (Wario-Sized)

night_waluigi_tennis_racket.description: The racket he used to beat Mario in that one tournament no one remembers.
effects: Once per day: serve an enemy so hard they must Dex save DC 17 or be knocked prone and stunned until end of their next turn
Every time you crit, you must shout 'WAAALUIGI TIME' or the racket deals 1d6 psychic to you instead

night_moonlight_mushroom.name: Moonlight Mushroom (Grows Only Under Full Moon)
night_moonlight_mushroom.description: A glowing blue mushroom harvested at 3:33 AM.
effects: Consume: gain Truesight 60 ft for 1 hour
You become bioluminescent — cannot benefit from invisibility or Stealth in darkness
After effect ends, you are blinded for 1 minute as your eyes adjust

night_boo_house_deed.name: Haunted Boo Mansion Deed (Legit…ish)
night_boo_house_deed.description: Own a real haunted mansion. Ghosts included free of charge.
effects: Grants ownership of a haunted mansion (DM places on map)
3d4 Boos live there and are… mostly friendly
Every full moon they try to scare you to death (save or frightened for 1 hour)

night_wario_time_stop_watch.name: Wario Time-Stop Pocket Watch (3 Seconds)
night_wario_time_stop_watch.description: Stops time for exactly 3 seconds. Wario used it to pick pockets.
effects: Once per week: stop time for 3 seconds (you can move and take one action)
When time resumes, you must shout 'IT'S WARIO TIME!' or the watch explodes (6d6 force in 20 ft)
Watch is cracked — 5% chance per use it shatters permanently
night_wario_time_stop_watch.warning: Wario wants this one back eventually.

night_infinite_coin_glitch_box.name: Infinite Coin Glitch Box (Works Once)
night_infinite_coin_glitch_box.description: A wooden box with a coin slot. Insert 1 coin, get 255 back. Box breaks forever after.
effects: Single use: insert any coin → receive 255 gold coins instantly
Box explodes in a shower of 8-bit pixels afterward (harmless but loud)
Wario cries if you tell him you used it

night_wario_master_sword_replica.name: Master Sword Replica (Wario Edition)
night_wario_master_sword_replica.description: A golden sword with 'PROPERTY OF LINK (NOT ANYMORE)' engraved on it.
effects: +2 Longsword that deals an extra 1d8 radiant vs. evil creatures
Only works at night or in darkness
In sunlight it turns into a pool noodle

night_phantom_hourglass_sand.name: Phantom Hourglass Sand (One Pinch)
night_phantom_hourglass_sand.description: Sand that slows time for everyone except you.
effects: Single use: sprinkle to cast Slow (DC 17, no concentration, lasts 1 minute)
You are immune and gain +2 AC for the duration
Sand is cursed — after use, you age 1 year instantly

night_final_boss_key.name: Final Boss Door Key (Unknown Dungeon)
night_final_boss_key.description: A massive golden key. No one knows what door it opens… yet.
effects: One day, somewhere in the world, a final boss door will appear. This key opens it.
Grants no power until then — just heavy and ominous
Wario refuses to say where he got it
night_final_boss_key.warning: Buying this may end your campaign.

middle_earth_ringwraith_shard.name: Shadowfell Fragment
middle_earth_ringwraith_shard.description: A pulsating shard of pure darkness, radiating a chilling aura that makes nearby souls shiver and tremble. This fragment is said to have once been part of a Ringwraith's armor, imbued with the malevolent essence of the Shadowfell. Touching it feels like stepping into an endless nightmarish void; one might succumb to the allure of eternal darkness or find oneself compelled to gather lost souls for its master. This fragment is a relic of ancient evil, and those who dare wield it must walk carefully lest they be consumed by its malevolent influence.

effectDetails.title: Chill Touch
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can touch another creature within reach. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be chilled for 1 minute, during which time it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

effectDetails.title: Soul Gatherer
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Additionally, once per short rest, the user can attempt to gather a soul by making a DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check. On a success, it successfully gathers one willing creature's soul into itself.

middle_earth_ringwraith_shard.levelRequirementReason: Only those of great power and experience in the ways of darkness can wield this fragment without succumbing to its corrupting influence.
middle_earth_ringwraith_shard.vendorReason: The elves of Mirkwood have long traded with the forces of the Shadowfell, and they are privy to such dark artifacts.
middle_earth_ringwraith_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via a dragon airship, which can be delayed by up to one week due to the inherent risks of transporting such dangerous items.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to touch another creature)
usage.duration: Chill Touch: 1 minute; Soul Gatherer: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Chill Touch ends when it is dispelled, and the target no longer has disadvantage on its rolls. Soul Gatherer ends after one use per short rest.

middle_earth_ringwraith_shard.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity of such an artifact, requiring great skill and resources to acquire.

animatopia_shrieking_totem.name: Shrieking Totem of the Howling Wind
animatopia_shrieking_totem.description: The Shrieking Totem of the Howling Wind, crafted from the bones of howler monkeys petrified by ancient magic, emits a bone-chilling shriek that can be heard miles away. When activated, it not only drowns out lesser spirits with its cacophony but also sends a gust of wind strong enough to scatter even the mightiest foe or drive off pesky insects. Legend has it that those who hear its call are left in a state of disoriented fear, their minds clouded by the howling wind.

effectDetails.title: Bone-Shattering Shriek
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the totem emits an ear-splitting shriek that has a 50% chance to cause creatures within 30 feet to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The effect ends if the user moves more than 20 feet away from the totem.

effectDetails.title: Wind-Scourging Gust
effectDetails.rules: The totem generates a gust of wind in a 30-foot cone, pushing creatures within it up to their movement speed. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until dispelled by magic. The totem can only use this ability once every long rest.

animatopia_shrieking_totem.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 6 due to the potent effects and magical components involved.
animatopia_shrieking_totem.vendorReason: The Tribal Trader specializes in ancient and mystical artifacts, making it fitting for this powerful totem.
animatopia_shrieking_totem.shippingDetail: Shipped by a fleet of winged beetles, the delivery takes no more than 3 days from the nearest market point.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and use Bone-Shattering Shriek; once per long rest to use Wind-Scourging Gust.
usage.duration: 1 minute for each effect
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature moves more than 20 feet away from the totem or is dispelled by magic.

animatopia_shrieking_totem.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its powerful effects and rarity, ensuring it remains a valuable but not overpowered item in gameplay.

animatopia_bonebreaker_gauntlets.name: Bonebreaker Gauntlets of the Primal Fist
animatopia_bonebreaker_gauntlets.description: Forged from the shattered claws of a giant badger, these gauntlets are a marvel of primal craftsmanship. The Bonebreaker Gauntlets of the Primal Fist deliver bone-crushing blows with each strike, their weight surprisingly light despite their formidable appearance. Wear them and feel the primal fury coursing through your veins, ready to unleash devastation upon foes. These gauntlets are not just weapons; they are extensions of nature itself, whispering ancient truths into your mind.

effectDetails.title: Bone-Crushing Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with these gauntlets, you deal an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This effect lasts for the duration of one short rest.

effectDetails.title: Primal Fury
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these gauntlets, you gain advantage on Strength checks and saving throws. Additionally, you have a 20% chance to enter a primal rage once per long rest, which lasts for 1 hour or until you are reduced to 0 hit points.

animatopia_bonebreaker_gauntlets.levelRequirementReason: These gauntlets require a minimum of 10th level to wield effectively due to their complex enchantments and the strength they demand.
animatopia_bonebreaker_gauntlets.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar specializes in exotic and powerful items from the primal world, making these gauntlets an excellent addition to their inventory.
animatopia_bonebreaker_gauntlets.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant snail, this item arrives with care, ensuring it reaches its destination intact.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation for each melee attack.
usage.duration: One short rest to recharge the bone-crushing effect.
usage.endsWhen: The primal rage ends when you finish a long rest or are reduced to 0 hit points.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharging on a short rest.

animatopia_bonebreaker_gauntlets.priceReason: This price reflects the gauntlets' epic rarity and their unique enchantments that provide both offensive and defensive benefits.

animatopia_sunstone_amulet.name: Sunstone Amulet of the Verdant Bloom
animatopia_sunstone_amulet.description: The Sunstone Amulet of the Verdant Bloom pulses with a soft golden glow, its surface etched with ancient symbols. Crafted from the heartwood of an enchanted tree in the depths of Animatopia's oldest forest, it channels the life force of the land itself. Wearers find their plants grow twice as fast, and they gain resistance to necrotic damage, making it a gardener’s dream and a guardian against dark magic threats.

effectDetails.title: Nature Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to necrotic damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Accelerated Plant Growth
effectDetails.rules: Plants in a 10-foot radius around you grow at double their normal rate for 1 hour per use, expending one charge. If used while interacting with plant life (such as planting seeds), the duration is halved.

animatopia_sunstone_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's natural power requires minimal magic to activate.
animatopia_sunstone_amulet.vendorReason: The forest market thrives on the connection to nature and often sells items that enhance it.
animatopia_sunstone_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivery drones ensure quick and safe transport through Animatopia's dense foliage.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasting until the end of your next turn for Nature Resistance. Duration for Accelerated Plant Growth is 1 hour per charge used.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use another amulet with this ability or at the start of your next turn after the duration.
usage.charges: Has a limited number of charges, recharging after 8 hours of rest.

animatopia_sunstone_amulet.priceReason: Balanced price considering its unique abilities and rarity within Animatopia.

chaos_rune_amulet.name: Amulet of Shifting Fate
chaos_rune_amulet.description: The Amulet of Shifting Fate is a malevolent trinket crafted from dark glass and bound with threads of chaotic energy. It pulses faintly, casting an unsettling aura around its wearer. This amulet can either grant you the grace to dodge calamity or bring about untold misfortune for those near you. Wario's endorsement suggests it's a perfect tool for causing mayhem, yet its unpredictable nature ensures your fate remains in flux.

effectDetails.title: Random Fortune Shift
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each combat round, there is a 25% chance that either you or one creature within 10 feet of you (your choice) are affected by this amulet. The target gains or loses an advantage on their next attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, depending on your preference.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Evasion
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the amulet, you have a +10 bonus to Dexterity saving throws and a 20% chance to dodge a melee attack against you. This effect does not stack with other evasion abilities.

chaos_rune_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The unpredictable nature of the amulet's effects requires a moderate amount of experience and confidence.
chaos_rune_amulet.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer specializes in items that bring chaos into the world, making this amulet an ideal offering.
chaos_rune_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by a swift winged beetle courier, ensuring quick and safe transport of this dangerous artifact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and continuous until the amulet's charges are exhausted.
usage.endsWhen: The amulet runs out of charges or is destroyed by chaotic forces.

chaos_rune_amulet.priceReason: The unpredictable nature and chaotic energy make this item worth 1000 XP, balancing its risk and potential reward.

fate_forge_temporal_scroll.name: Temporal Scroll of Minor Reversal
fate_forge_temporal_scroll.description: The Temporal Scroll of Minor Reversal, crafted by the enigmatic Fate Forge, is a delicate scroll imbued with the essence of time itself. It allows you to rewind reality for a brief instant—just enough to correct a single misstep or seize a fleeting advantage. The scroll's power comes from the very fabric of the dimensional portal through which it was shipped, and its use must be measured: misuse might unravel the very threads of causality.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Time
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction. You can use this scroll to reverse up to 3 seconds of recent events, affecting only you or an adjacent creature within your reach. The effect is instantaneous and cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Undo Failed Action
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction to a failed action save (such as a saving throw). You can use this scroll to negate the failure, effectively treating it as a success. This effect has no cooldown but cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

fate_forge_temporal_scroll.levelRequirementReason: A moderate spellcaster or capable fighter can wield its time-altering power.
fate_forge_temporal_scroll.vendorReason: The enigmatic Fate Forge is known for its mastery of temporal magic and their scrolls are sought after by those who need to correct the past without altering too much.
fate_forge_temporal_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional portal, adding one day to delivery time but ensuring safe transport through alternate dimensions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Used or expended

fate_forge_temporal_scroll.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this scroll is priced moderately to reflect its utility without being overpowered.

mushroom_kingdom_sparkle_coin.name: Glimmering Gold Coin of Chaos
mushroom_kingdom_sparkle_coin.description: This Glimmering Gold Coin of Chaos exudes an otherworldly sheen that seems to dance in the light. Crafted from chaotic gold found deep within the Maelstrom Caverns, it is rumored to bring both fortune and misfortune. Holders have reported fits of laughter so uncontrollable they've been known to attract unwanted attention, while others claim it grants a fleeting sense of calm followed by an annoying case of hiccups that lasts for hours.

effectDetails.title: Grant 5 Luck
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the coin grants the user an additional d20 roll on any skill check or saving throw. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Trigger Random Effect
effectDetails.rules: If held for more than 1 minute without activation, there is a 50% chance (DC 12) each round that a random effect occurs: either uncontrollable laughter or hiccups. The specific effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

mushroom_kingdom_sparkle_coin.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners, this coin is an accessible tool for any adventurer looking to test their luck.
mushroom_kingdom_sparkle_coin.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market often stocks unique items from various vendors, including the whimsical and unpredictable Glimmering Gold Coin of Chaos.
mushroom_kingdom_sparkle_coin.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Mushroom Post, known for its reliable but sometimes slow service through the fungal networks beneath the land.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and gain luck bonus or trigger random effect.
usage.duration: Luck bonus lasts until start of next turn; random effect lasts until end of current turn.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when its duration expires or the coin is activated again.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one effect can be active at a time.

mushroom_kingdom_sparkle_coin.priceReason: The coin's rarity and unpredictable nature justify this higher price point for players seeking unique advantages in their adventuring endeavors.

mushroom_kingdom_pipe_wrench.name: Wario's Plumbing Prototype
mushroom_kingdom_pipe_wrench.description: Wario's Plumbing Prototype is a monstrous wrench, its head formed from hardened mushroom slime and its handle crafted from tarnished metal that whispers of Wario's failed experiments. This oversized tool has a reputation for exacerbating rather than resolving plumbing dilemmas, yet it grants the wielder unmatched strength and the ability to break through even the most stubborn locks with ease. Rumor has it that Wario discarded this creation after realizing its destructive potential far outweighed any utility.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder attacks with a weapon, they gain a +5 bonus to their Strength (Athletics) checks for 1 hour. This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Lockbreaker's Edge
effectDetails.rules: The wielder has a 20% chance of automatically breaking through any lock they attempt, regardless of the DC. This effect is limited to three uses per day and resets at dawn.

mushroom_kingdom_pipe_wrench.levelRequirementReason: Wario's Plumbing Prototype is designed for beginners who are still learning their trade but wish to impress with its sheer size and legendary origin.
mushroom_kingdom_pipe_wrench.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop specializes in oddities, and this peculiar wrench fits right into their collection of unique tools and items.
mushroom_kingdom_pipe_wrench.shippingDetail: Due to its cumbersome size, Wario's Plumbing Prototype is shipped via the Mushroom Express courier service, ensuring safe delivery but with a slight delay.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use on attacks and lock attempts.
usage.duration: 1 hour for Strength Boost; limited uses per day for Lockbreaker's Edge.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of each short or long rest, or when the daily limit is reached.
usage.charges: Unlimited as long as it remains functional.

mushroom_kingdom_pipe_wrench.priceReason: The rare and limited nature of Wario's Plumbing Prototype justifies its high price in the market.

mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_echo_stone.name: Stone of Silent Screams
mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_echo_stone.description: The Stone of Silent Screams is a pulsating obsidian relic carved from the heart of an ancient, sentient mushroom. Its whispers are not for the faint of mind—only those who dare to hear it can discern its cryptic secrets. Failure to heed its call may lead to uncontrollable laughter or a paralyzing fear that mushrooms will consume all. The stone's power is both perilous and potent, offering insight into forbidden knowledge but at a terrible cost.

effectDetails.title: Insight Into Secrets
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the user gains advantage on one Intelligence (History) check related to mushrooms or mycelium for 1 hour. The stone's effect ends if used in a chaotic environment.

effectDetails.title: Increased Fear of Mushrooms
effectDetails.rules: The user must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the user becomes frightened of mushrooms until the end of their next short or long rest. This effect can be resisted with a successful save.

mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_echo_stone.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level to handle the stone's inherent peril without succumbing to its effects.
mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_echo_stone.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in rare, forbidden items that test even the most seasoned adventurers.
mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_echo_stone.shippingDetail: Shipped via shadow courier; delivery time varies but is guaranteed within a week.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until used in a chaotic environment.
usage.endsWhen: Used in a chaotic environment, or after 1 hour if not used chaotically.

mushroom_kingdom_forbidden_echo_stone.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect the stone's dangerous and potentially life-altering effects.

equestria_item_stirrup_of_swiftness.name: Stirrups of Swift Hooves
equestria_item_stirrup_of_swiftness.description: The Stirrups of Swift Hooves are crafted from enchanted pony hoof leather, imbued by the skilled artisans of Ponyville with the essence of a swift Pegasus's stride. When donned, your legs feel as light and agile as a filly in her first race, allowing you to outpace even the fleetest of Pegasi. A rare find at the Ponyville Market, these stirrups not only increase your speed by 10 feet but also enhance your riding skill, granting a +2 bonus on Riding checks.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Stirrups of Swift Hooves, you gain an additional 10 feet to your walking and riding speeds. This effect is active as long as you are mounted or on foot.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Riding Skill
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to all Riding checks while wearing the stirrups, allowing for smoother rides and more precise control of your steeds.

equestria_item_stirrup_of_swiftness.levelRequirementReason: Wearing enchanted equipment requires a certain level of skill and focus to harness its full potential.
equestria_item_stirrup_of_swiftness.vendorReason: The artisans at Ponyville Market are known for their craftsmanship, offering only the finest magical items like these stirrups.
equestria_item_stirrup_of_swiftness.shippingDetail: Ships via Magic Express Pony Delivery, ensuring swift and safe arrival within a few days of your order.

usage.activation: Passive effect active as long as the stirrups are worn.
usage.duration: Permanent until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The item is removed from wear or destroyed.

equestria_item_stirrup_of_swiftness.priceReason: Crafted with enchanted leather and imbued with powerful magic, these stirrups are a rare find, making them worth the investment.

equestria_item_maple_syrup_potion.name: Maple Syrup of Sweet Victory
equestria_item_maple_syrup_potion.description: This golden nectar, brewed by a disgruntled pony chef in the Crystal Empire, is a potent remedy for misfortune. Sip this syrup of sweet victory and you'll find yourself immune to poison for an hour, just long enough to outmaneuver your foes. But beware, the sticky residue left behind can make even the most nimble feet slip on polished floors. Offer it wisely—your enemies might not be so eager to accept a gift from someone with such a tricky touch.

effectDetails.title: Poison Immunity
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to poison for one hour. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges or require an action.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Stickiness
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of this effect, you are considered to have a light sticky coating that reduces your Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks by 2. The sticky residue lasts for one hour and can be washed off with a thorough cleaning.

equestria_item_maple_syrup_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for beginners and adventurers just starting their journey.
equestria_item_maple_syrup_potion.vendorReason: Crystalfrost, the Crystal Empire's apothecary, brews this nectar to ensure even novices can protect themselves from misfortune.
equestria_item_maple_syrup_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Crystal Pony Express with same-day delivery within the Crystal Empire. Outside of the empire, delivery might take up to a week.

usage.duration: 1 小時
usage.endsWhen: 效果結束或使用人被毒傷

equestria_item_maple_syrup_potion.priceReason: 價格調整為平衡此特殊效果的價值，並反映其稀有性。

middle_earth_rusty_dagger.name: Gimli's Grumbleblade
middle_earth_rusty_dagger.description: Gimli's Grumbleblade, a once-grumpy dwarf’s dagger now polished to gleam, still retains its rust and ale-scented charm. Crafted from ancient dwarven iron, it whispers of battles fought in the deeps of mines. This blade slices through leather with ease, leaving behind a trail of crimson as it bleeds its foes. Caution: wielders beware the dwarf’s temper—Gimli’s Grumbleblade is no joke when it comes to slicing and dicing!

effectDetails.title: Damage on Slash
effectDetails.rules: When you make a slashing attack with Gimli's Grumbleblade, deal 1d6 slashing damage. If the target is reduced to half its hit points or fewer by this attack, it bleeds until it spends an action to staunch the wound.

effectDetails.title: Cleave Bleed
effectDetails.rules: If you use Gimli's Grumbleblade to make a successful melee attack against more than one target in the same round, and at least one of those targets is reduced to half its hit points or fewer by this attack, that target bleeds until it spends an action to staunch the wound.

middle_earth_rusty_dagger.levelRequirementReason: Gimli's Grumbleblade demands a seasoned warrior who can handle its unpredictable nature and wield it with precision.
middle_earth_rusty_dagger.vendorReason: Dwarven blacksmiths appreciate the blade’s ancient craftsmanship and history, ensuring it is well-crafted for those who seek to honor Gimli's legacy.
middle_earth_rusty_dagger.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Iron Rider, known for its sturdy caravans that traverse treacherous paths safely.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The target spends an action to staunch the wound or until the attacker is incapacitated

middle_earth_rusty_dagger.priceReason: Gimli's Grumbleblade’s rare craftsmanship, history, and unpredictable nature justify its higher price.

middle_earth_elven_potion_of_swiftness.name: Whisperwind Elixir
middle_earth_elven_potion_of_swiftness.description: Whisperwind Elixir is a shimmering potion crafted by the elusive Silvan elves of Middle-earth. Its aroma hints at pine and the crisp air of twilight, while its taste remains suspiciously like pine needles and disappointment. This potent elixir grants you an exhilarating burst of speed for three seconds, allowing you to outrun most foes in a fleeting moment. It's said that messengers favor this potion for quick deliveries or when they need to escape the clutches of grumpy trolls, as it offers a 25% increase in movement range during its brief duration.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +10 foot bonus to your walking speed for three seconds. This effect ends if you take any damage or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Range
effectDetails.rules: During the three-second duration of this effect, your movement range increases by 25%. This enhancement ceases upon taking any damage or at the end of its duration.

middle_earth_elven_potion_of_swiftness.levelRequirementReason: This elixir is accessible to all adventurers who can afford it, as it offers a reliable edge in quick escapes and deliveries.
middle_earth_elven_potion_of_swiftness.vendorReason: The Elven Market sells this elixir because the Silvan elves are known for their mastery of alchemy and swift messenger services.
middle_earth_elven_potion_of_swiftness.shippingDetail: Shipped by a fleet of flying hawks, ensuring the potion arrives fresh to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Drink the elixir as an action.
usage.duration: 3 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or at the end of its duration.

middle_earth_elven_potion_of_swiftness.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and limited production of the Whisperwind Elixir, which is highly valued for both its elven craftsmanship and practical utility.

grand_country_side_seller_potion.name: Wario's Side-Splitting Serum
grand_country_side_seller_potion.description: Wario's Side-Splitting Serum is a frothy, neon-green concoction that bubbles in its glass vial, emanating an aroma of deep-fried delights and sharp vinegar. This Grand Country elixir not only restores health but also grants a temporary boost to your charisma, making you the life of any party. The serum has a tendency to make you laugh uncontrollably, which might be contagious among those nearby, potentially doubling their laughter as well.

effectDetails.title: Restores Health
effectDetails.rules: This serum provides a +2 temporary hit point boost upon consumption. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Buff to Charisma
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after consuming this serum, your Charisma score is increased by 2 (up to a maximum of 20). You can't use this effect if you already have the benefit from it. This buff ends early if you take any damage.

grand_country_side_seller_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for adventurers just starting their journey, providing them with a much-needed health boost and an easy way to make friends.
grand_country_side_seller_potion.vendorReason: The side seller in The Grand Country is known for their vast knowledge of local remedies and potions. Wario's Side-Splitting Serum is one such potion that they are proud to offer.
grand_country_side_seller_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered via standard mail, ensuring the serum arrives just as effective as when it was brewed.

usage.activation: Consume the vial by drinking its contents.
usage.duration: One minute for each effect.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end either at their duration or if you take damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

grand_country_side_seller_potion.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the rare ingredients and brewing process required to create Wario's Side-Splitting Serum, ensuring it remains accessible yet valuable for adventurers.

curiosity_fate_orb.name: Whispers of the Fated Place
curiosity_fate_orb.description: The Whispers of the Fated Place is a glowing, pulsating orb that emits an eerie, dark hum. It seems to be forged from twisted fate and shadowy knowledge, crafted in the depths of forgotten realms. The orb allows you to glimpse possible futures—occasionally revealing hidden clues for your quest, but also exposing you to fleeting visions of madness. Each use can leave you temporarily disoriented, affecting your senses until the next dawn breaks.

effectDetails.title: Clue Revealer
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you may activate the orb to gain one piece of hidden information relevant to your current situation. There is a 10% chance this will be a clue that directly helps with your quest. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Madness
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance each time you activate the orb to experience a brief period of madness, causing temporary penalties to one negative stat (your choice) for an hour. This effect ends when you rest or upon reaching 0 hit points.

curiosity_fate_orb.levelRequirementReason: The Whispers of the Fated Place is accessible to lower-level characters as it introduces a risk-reward dynamic without overwhelming them.
curiosity_fate_orb.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer often deals in unpredictable and dangerous items, making this orb a fitting addition to their wares.
curiosity_fate_orb.shippingDetail: The Winged Courier ensures swift delivery but warns that the package may feel heavier than it appears.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn, or if you lose consciousness

curiosity_fate_orb.priceReason: The Whispers of the Fated Place is priced high due to its unique and dangerous abilities that enhance gameplay without being overpowered.

warhammer_ironclad_heart.name: Ironclad Heart of Valor
warhammer_ironclad_heart.description: The Ironclad Heart of Valor is a warhammer forged from the very essence of valor and resilience, its surface etched with ancient runes that pulse with a heartbeat-like rhythm. It amplifies your courage and resilience in battle, but also subtly encourages you to seek out shiny objects and challenge those who doubt your prowess. Its rhythmic pulse seems almost alive, as if the heart itself is imbued with a will of its own.

effectDetails.title: Resilient Heartbeat
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the Ironclad Heart's resilient heartbeat. For the next minute, any damage taken is reduced by 5 (as if wearing light armor). This effect ends early if you are knocked unconscious.

effectDetails.title: Heart of Valor
effectDetails.rules: For as long as the heart beats within your grasp, you have advantage on saving throws against fear and charm effects. If the heart is ever removed from your possession or destroyed, this effect is immediately lost.

warhammer_ironclad_heart.levelRequirementReason: The Ironclad Heart of Valor is designed for those who seek to harness its power early in their adventuring career.
warhammer_ironclad_heart.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in crafting items that resonate with the essence of valor and resilience, making it a fitting vendor for this heart-wrought weapon.
warhammer_ironclad_heart.shippingDetail: The Dragon Delivery Service ensures swift and secure delivery, often accompanied by tales of the hammer's power.

usage.activation: Action: Activate as an action to invoke the resilient heartbeat.
usage.duration: One minute per activation.
usage.endsWhen: Knocked unconscious or removed from your possession.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

warhammer_ironclad_heart.priceReason: The Ironclad Heart of Valor offers significant defensive and morale-boosting benefits, making it a valuable investment for any adventurer.

internet_meme_charm.name: Distorted Reality Charm
internet_meme_charm.description: The Distorted Reality Charm manifests as an ever-shifting hologram of memes, constantly morphing and glitching in a display that bends reality itself. This bizarre trinket grants its wearer resistance to psychic damage and, with eerie precision, triggers random beneficial effects like temporary invisibility or speed boosts. As if the internet itself were whispering secrets into your ear, this charm occasionally attracts minor distractions—like a swarm of confused pigeons—that grant you advantage on stealth checks.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Psychic Damage
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Distorted Reality Charm, the wearer gains resistance to psychic damage. This effect is passive and applies at all times while the charm is worn.

effectDetails.title: Random Beneficial Effects
effectDetails.rules: Once per round, the charm has a 5% chance of triggering a random beneficial effect, such as temporary invisibility or speed boost. The exact effect is determined by the DM and lasts for 1 minute.

internet_meme_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm requires at least 6th level to wear due to its complex magical properties.
internet_meme_charm.vendorReason: The pixel_shop, known for its quirky and internet-inspired items, would naturally stock this bizarre yet popular trinket.
internet_meme_charm.shippingDetail: Shipped via data_stream, the charm arrives within 24 hours if purchased during the night only.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, but effects last for their respective durations.
usage.endsWhen: The charm's power ends when it is destroyed or its wearer removes it.

internet_meme_charm.priceReason: This charming item strikes a balance by offering both resistance to psychic attacks and occasional beneficial effects, making it a rare but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

internet_godly_firewall.name: The Great Firewall of Data
internet_godly_firewall.description: The Great Firewall of Data is a shimmering construct of pure code, its surface etched with runes that flicker like neon in a cybernetic dream. This godly artifact not only grants its wielder unparalleled protection against digital intrusions and malicious spells but also occasionally generates a miniature singularity that briefly erases nearby enemies—chaos, it seems, is delicious indeed! It hums softly as it actively defends its user from all forms of digital interference, ensuring they remain secure in the digital realm.

effectDetails.title: Digital Shield
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants the wielder +10 resistance to all magical and digital attacks. It also automatically detects and negates hacking attempts, providing a passive defense that does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Singularity Burst
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, this effect can unleash a Singularity Burst dealing 500 radiant damage in a 15-foot radius. The wielder must use their reaction to activate it; failure on the save (DC 20) results in half damage.

internet_godly_firewall.levelRequirementReason: The arcane complexity of the Great Firewall requires significant magical proficiency.
internet_godly_firewall.vendorReason: The cyber market is a hub for digital artifacts and advanced technology, making it the ideal vendor for such a powerful firewall.
internet_godly_firewall.shippingDetail: Ships via quantum transmission, ensuring swift delivery to even the most remote locations.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The Singularity Burst ends at the start of your next turn if not already ended by its save or range.

internet_godly_firewall.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity and the complexity of its magical components, ensuring it remains a high-demand, yet balanced choice.

pokemon_item_lucky_charm_berry.name: Berry of the Bewildered Beast
pokemon_item_lucky_charm_berry.description: The Berry of the Bewildered Beast glows with a chaotic, shimmering light that dances like an unsteady flame. This enigmatic berry is said to momentarily confuse foes, causing them to falter and misjudge their next move. With each bite, you can feel its wild energy course through your veins, granting you a fleeting boost in luck. Wario himself vouches for this berry's power, claiming it perfectly suits any thief or adventurer looking to outsmart their competition.

effectDetails.title: Confusion
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the target of your next attack is affected by confusion for the duration. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn or if they succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13). There are no limits to how many times you can use this effect.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Boost
effectDetails.rules: For one round after consumption, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and saving throws. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require an action or reaction to activate.

pokemon_item_lucky_charm_berry.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can benefit from the Berry's effects without requiring a high level of expertise.
pokemon_item_lucky_charm_berry.vendorReason: Pokemarts are known for selling useful items for trainers and adventurers, making this berry an ideal addition to their stock.
pokemon_item_lucky_charm_berry.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with Winged Pokemon Delivery, ensuring quick arrival at your doorstep.

usage.activation: Eat the Berry as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Confusion and Lucky Boost; lasts until start of next turn for Confusion.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if the target successfully saves against it.

pokemon_item_lucky_charm_berry.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the berry's powerful effects and rarity, making it a worthwhile purchase for adventurers.

pokemon_item_ancient_trainer_gear.name: Trainer's Gauntlet of Valor
pokemon_item_ancient_trainer_gear.description: The Trainer's Gauntlet of Valor is forged from the very essence of a legendary Pokémon trainer, its steel infused with the spirit of valorous battles won. When donned in combat, it amplifies your strikes, turning mere attacks into devastating blows that leave enemies reeling. More than just an accessory, it channels the resilience and prowess of its creator, offering a defensive boon that turns near misses into safe lands.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Attacks
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases your attack rolls by +30 for the next 5 turns, dealing an additional +10 damage during this duration.

effectDetails.title: Defensive Shield
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect while worn. Grants you a +10 armor class boost and reduces incoming physical damage from Pokémon attacks by 15%. Lasts until the end of your next turn after removal or when you take an action.

pokemon_item_ancient_trainer_gear.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 8 to wield its power effectively in combat.
pokemon_item_ancient_trainer_gear.vendorReason: The league store specializes in gear for elite trainers, ensuring the Trainer's Gauntlet of Valor is available to those who have earned their place on the battlefield.
pokemon_item_ancient_trainer_gear.shippingDetail: Delivered within 24 hours via Swift Delivery Drone, ensuring you're ready for your next battle.

usage.duration: 5 turns
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn after removal or when an action is taken.

pokemon_item_ancient_trainer_gear.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its status as a powerful but not overpowered epic gear for seasoned trainers.

internet_meme_bomb.name: Viral Overload Device
internet_meme_bomb.description: The Viral Overload Device is a bizarre, internet-forged contraption encased in gleaming metal and adorned with neon lights that flicker like a meme mill. When activated, it unleashes a torrent of chaotic memes and viral content; enemies within its range are struck by fits of uncontrollable laughter, causing them to stagger and lose their composure for several moments. The device's electromagnetic pulse also disrupts the target’s senses, temporarily reducing their accuracy.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Laughter
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this device unleashes a barrage of memes and laughter. Targets within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The effect ends if the target takes any damage.

effectDetails.title: Sensory Disruption
effectDetails.rules: Additionally, all creatures in a 20-foot radius suffer a -2 penalty to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and saving throws until the start of their next turn. This effect is not subject to save DCs.

internet_meme_bomb.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic dexterity to handle such an unpredictable device.
internet_meme_bomb.vendorReason: The data dealer has a knack for procuring strange and powerful items, including this internet-forged marvel.
internet_meme_bomb.shippingDetail: Arrives with strict secrecy; must be delivered at night to avoid unwanted attention.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect (Disruptive Laughter), lasts until the start of the target's next turn (Sensory Disruption)
usage.endsWhen: Target takes damage or the duration ends
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

internet_meme_bomb.priceReason: Balanced price for an item that can disrupt enemies and create chaos in combat.

mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_spore.name: Golden Spore of Unending Growth
mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_spore.description: The Golden Spore of Unending Growth is a pulsating, golden mushroom that crackles with Wario's unholy magic. When consumed, it dramatically increases your size and strength for a fleeting moment, turning you into an unstoppable force capable of smashing through even the toughest obstacles or gorging down smaller foes in one bite. This relic of Mushroom Kingdom lore is said to have been cultivated by the mischievous villain himself, Wario, who used it to outsize his rivals during their infamous spats and matches.

effectDetails.title: Increase Size
effectDetails.rules: You grow in size by one category (e.g., Medium to Large) for the duration of this effect. This grants you a +2 bonus to Strength and a +1 bonus to AC, but also makes you more vulnerable to attacks from creatures larger than you.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration, your Strength score is doubled, allowing you to deal extra damage with melee weapons. This effect also grants you advantage on Athletics checks and saving throws against being knocked prone or restrained.
