mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_spore.levelRequirementReason: This spore provides a significant boost in size and strength but does not require high-level proficiency.
mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_spore.vendorReason: Toad Town Market stocks this rare relic due to its connection with the Mushroom Kingdom, which is their territory.
mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_spore.shippingDetail: Shipped via a specialized mushroom cart that ensures freshness and potency upon delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you are reduced to 0 hit points.

mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_spore.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its potency and limited availability in the Mushroom Kingdom.

mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_faction_scro.name: Koopa Clan Tactical Scroll
mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_faction_scro.description: The Koopa Clan Tactical Scroll is a parchment rolled tight with inked symbols of ancient strategy. Crafted by the proud Clansmen, it details their shell-based formations and secret attacks. Deciphering its cryptic script grants you newfound prowess in combat, but be wary; its arrogance might just make you feel more like an invader than a strategist! Unlock new shell-bash maneuvers and bolster your Koopa Clan faction reputation by +10 points.

effectDetails.title: Shell Bash
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can make a melee attack with a shell. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + your proficiency bonus force damage and is knocked prone.

effectDetails.title: Faction Reputation
effectDetails.rules: For every Koopa Clan member in your party, this scroll grants them +2 to Persuasion checks when dealing with other Koopas. Lasts until the end of the encounter.

mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_faction_scro.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 7 to understand and utilize the scroll's tactical knowledge.
mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_faction_scro.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop is known for its wealth of clan-specific items, including scrolls that enhance Koopa Clan strategies and reputation.
mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_faction_scro.shippingDetail: Ships via Turtle Post within a week; expedited delivery available for an additional 10% fee.

usage.activation: As action or bonus action to use Shell Bash, as a passive effect for Faction Reputation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing (until end of encounter) respectively.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day; requires re-acquisition from the Koopa Shop.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_faction_scro.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its tactical value and rarity within the Koopa Clan faction.

mushroom_kingdom_item_legendary_chrono_s.name: Chrono Shard of Wario's Time Warp
mushroom_kingdom_item_legendary_chrono_s.description: The Chrono Shard of Wario's Time Warp is a crystalline fragment that glows with an eerie blue light. When activated, it warps time around you for mere instants, allowing for near-instantaneous reflexes and the ability to dodge attacks with perfect precision. However, overuse can cause temporal distortions, leading to unpredictable jumps in time. This shard is said to have been crafted by Wario's own hands during one of his madcap experiments.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Dodge
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate the shard to create a temporal distortion around them. This grants advantage on Dexterity saving throws for 1 minute. If the shard is activated more than once per long rest, the next use has no effect until after a short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Time Freeze
effectDetails.rules: When in immediate danger, the wielder can activate the shard to briefly halt time around them for 1 round (30 seconds). This grants immunity to all damage during this period. However, any creature within 5 feet of the user must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn.

mushroom_kingdom_item_legendary_chrono_s.levelRequirementReason: Even beginners can learn to harness Wario's chaotic temporal powers with careful practice.
mushroom_kingdom_item_legendary_chrono_s.vendorReason: Wario personally crafted this shard and ensures it is available for his most trusted customers.
mushroom_kingdom_item_legendary_chrono_s.shippingDetail: The shard arrives via a warp tube, ensuring that the item remains in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn for Temporal Dodge; 1 round (30 seconds) for Time Freeze
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends naturally or if the user is incapacitated during use
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be used per short rest

mushroom_kingdom_item_legendary_chrono_s.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price to reflect its limited uses and manageable effects.

almost_edge_item_resonance_boots.name: Null-Step Boots of the Boundary
almost_edge_item_resonance_boots.description: The Null-Step Boots of the Boundary are crafted from a twisted amalgamation of shadow and light, their surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer and fade like fleeting dreams. These unsettling footwear allow you to briefly step outside the normal flow of reality, granting you an eerie sense of disorientation while enhancing your movement speed by 20%. However, each use leaves you vulnerable to existential dread for a short time, as if the fabric of your sanity frays with every stride.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Movement
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Increases movement speed by 20% for 1 minute, during which time you are immune to fear effects and gain resistance to sanity loss from environmental hazards.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Displacement
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, activate on your turn as an action. You can briefly step outside the normal flow of reality, causing you to teleport up to 30 feet in any direction. This effect has a 5% chance to trigger existential dread upon landing.

almost_edge_item_resonance_boots.levelRequirementReason: The intricate runes and shadow materials require a adept level of mastery.
almost_edge_item_resonance_boots.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader deals in rare artifacts that bridge the gap between worlds, and these boots are no exception.
almost_edge_item_resonance_boots.shippingDetail: Ships via dimensional courier, ensuring a swift arrival through the fabric of reality.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Enhanced Movement; Action for Temporal Displacement
usage.duration: 1 minute for Enhanced Movement; Instantaneous for Temporal Displacement
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish a short or long rest, or if the duration expires.

almost_edge_item_resonance_boots.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP for its unique and versatile abilities.

almost_edge_item_void_whisper.name: The Silent Plea
almost_edge_item_void_whisper.description: The Silent Plea is a polished obsidian stone etched with runes that seem to hum with an ancient, almost sentient energy. It whispers cryptic messages from forgotten realms, often foretelling dire omens or guiding the bearer away from perilous paths. Holding it stills the din of battle and conversation, allowing only the most vital sounds to reach your ears. The stone is said to have been crafted by a long-dead sorceress who sought to bridge the gap between the living world and the void itself.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Omen
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this stone grants a single cryptic message from the void. This message is always in riddle form and may portend danger or guide you away from it. The effect has a save DC of 13. If a creature fails its saving throw, they are compelled to act on the omen's direction for their next action.

effectDetails.title: Sound Suppression
effectDetails.rules: The Silent Plea reduces noise within a 5-foot radius by 50%, making it an invaluable tool in crowded or noisy environments. This effect lasts until the end of your turn when you are no longer holding it.

almost_edge_item_void_whisper.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate the Silent Plea's subtle yet vital benefits without needing extensive experience.
almost_edge_item_void_whisper.vendorReason: The edge wanderers, who traverse dangerous territories, frequently encounter such relics and understand their value in survival.
almost_edge_item_void_whisper.shippingDetail: The stone arrives wrapped in a protective cloth, ensuring it remains undisturbed during transit.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate and receive the cryptic message or to trigger sound suppression.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for cryptic message; until the end of your turn for sound suppression.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire as described above or when you stop holding it in combat.

almost_edge_item_void_whisper.priceReason: Crafted from rare obsidian and ancient runes, the Silent Plea's value is matched by its rarity and unique abilities.

equestria_gourmand_treat.name: Rainbow Sherbet Surprise!
equestria_gourmand_treat.description: A shimmering confection crafted by the finest sugar-coated unicorns of Equestria, this Rainbow Sherbet Surprise! bursts with a chaotic rainbow of flavor. When consumed, it grants your party a lucky streak for the day, increasing your chances in dice rolls and charm checks. Unicorns say it's a surefire way to win over any pony you encounter, though goblins might just be more intrigued by the colorful sugar than your charisma.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Streak
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this treat grants a +2 bonus to all Charisma checks and saving throws. The effect lasts for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Charm Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 10 minutes after eating this treat, each member of your party has advantage on Persuasion checks.

equestria_gourmand_treat.levelRequirementReason: This treat is crafted by skilled unicorns and requires a certain amount of magical energy to activate its effects.
equestria_gourmand_treat.vendorReason: The market often stocks unique items from local artisans, including this special confectionery delight.
equestria_gourmand_treat.shippingDetail: Delivered quickly through the Pony Express, ensuring your party arrives at its peak performance for any challenge ahead.

usage.activation: Eaten by a member of the party as an action.
usage.duration: One hour and ten minutes total.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires or if the treat is consumed before then.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as each serving is a single use.

equestria_gourmand_treat.priceReason: Crafted by skilled unicorns and requiring magical energy to activate, this treat offers significant benefits at an appropriately priced value.

equestria_harmonious_blade.name: The Echo of Harmony
equestria_harmonious_blade.description: The Echo of Harmony is a crystalline saber forged in the heart of Equestria's Crystal Heart. Its blade glows with a serene, ethereal light that resonates with the land’s magic. Wielders can amplify their party’s healing spells by up to 25%, and when they strike an enemy, there's a chance for a harmonious blast that stuns foes for one round. This weapon is as much a symbol of unity in battle as it is a tool for those who seek balance.

effectDetails.title: Healing Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When you or an ally within 30 feet casts a healing spell, the damage dealt is increased by +25%. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Harmonious Stun
effectDetails.rules: When you strike an enemy with this weapon, there's a 40% chance to stun them for one round. The DC to resist this effect is equal to 12 + your proficiency bonus.

equestria_harmonious_blade.levelRequirementReason: The Echo of Harmony demands a certain mastery of magic and combat, suitable only for those who have reached at least 10th level.
equestria_harmonious_blade.vendorReason: As the official purveyor of Equestria's treasures, Canterlot Commerce is entrusted with selling this emblematic weapon.
equestria_harmonious_blade.shippingDetail: The Echo of Harmony requires special handling and is delivered only by the Royal Courier to ensure its safe arrival.

usage.activation: Instantaneous on contact or as an action if you are not already engaged in combat.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn after using it for healing amplification.
usage.endsWhen: The weapon is destroyed, expended, or when you cease to be within 30 feet of a target for a healing spell.

equestria_harmonious_blade.priceReason: This item's price reflects its limited availability and the cost of materials from the Crystal Heart.

equestria_divine_amulet.name: The Heart of Twilight’s Blessing
equestria_divine_amulet.description: The Heart of Twilight’s Blessing is a shimmering amulet that radiates with an ethereal glow, its facets reflecting hues of twilight and magic. Crafted by Princess Twilight using ancient Celestia stones, it bestows resistance to all forms of negativity and grants a unique ability: the wearer can momentarily see the most advantageous path forward, though it occasionally leans towards unconventional shortcuts favored by Wario himself. This godly artifact is said to have been imbued with the very essence of friendship, making its wearer's decisions wiser but not necessarily conventional.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Negativity
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this amulet, you have resistance to all forms of negative status effects. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Vision of Advantage
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can briefly glimpse the most advantageous path forward. You gain advantage on one ability check of your choice immediately after using this feature. This benefit lasts for 1 minute. If you use this feature again before the duration expires, its effect is wasted.

equestria_divine_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet requires a high level to harness its godly power and align with its magical essence.
equestria_divine_amulet.vendorReason: Crystal Empire specializes in artifacts imbued with the power of the Elements, making it the perfect vendor for such a divine relic.
equestria_divine_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered by the Celestial Messenger, ensuring its safe and swift arrival to the recipient.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: Its duration expires or if you use it again before the first one ends

equestria_divine_amulet.priceReason: The Heart of Twilight’s Blessing is a godly artifact with unparalleled power, making its price reflect its divine significance.

faerun_item_silverhand_amulet.name: Amulet of the Steadfast Hand
faerun_item_silverhand_amulet.description: The Amulet of the Steadfast Hand, forged by the dwarven artisans of Mithrilforge, is a talisman that whispers the promise of unerring precision to its wearer. Crafted from enchanted silver and imbued with the spirit of ancient heroes, it grants you an uncanny sense of balance and poise, as if your every motion were guided by a master's hand. This amulet is not merely jewelry; it’s a symbol of steadfast resolve that ensures your strikes land true, even in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Masterful Precision
effectDetails.rules: When you make an attack roll or Dexterity (Sword) check, you can use a bonus action to activate the amulet's power. On this roll, your proficiency bonus is doubled if lower than the target DC. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Steadfast Resolve
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary hit points equal to 5 + your level whenever you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, and these temporary hit points last for 1 minute. You can use this ability only once per long rest.

faerun_item_silverhand_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's power is too potent for characters below fourth level, as it requires a certain combat experience to truly appreciate its benefits.
faerun_item_silverhand_amulet.vendorReason: Baldur’s Bazaar stocks only the most powerful and sought-after items from across Faerûn, making this amulet an ideal addition to their inventory.
faerun_item_silverhand_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered by a fleet of flying carpets that ensure swift and safe transport.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or when you make another attack roll or Dexterity (Sword) check
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends as soon as you make a second attack roll or Dexterity (Sword) check after activating it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but you can only use the Steadfast Resolve ability once per long rest.

faerun_item_silverhand_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's price reflects its mythic rarity and powerful effects, providing a fair value for such an item in Baldur’s Bazaar.

faerun_item_waterdeep_guild_token.name: Waterdeep Thieves’ Guild Recognition Token
faerun_item_waterdeep_guild_token.description: A tarnished silver token bearing the faint insignia of the Waterdeep Thieves' Guild, this recognition token is said to have been crafted from a coin minted during the guild's golden age. Its possession grants access to a secret contact within the guild and allows for minor loot bonuses when successfully sneaking past guards. This token can be used in conjunction with the guild’s influence to secure discounts at various shops scattered throughout Waterdeep, but its very existence attracts unwanted attention from rival thieves' guilds and other factions.

effectDetails.title: Secret Contact Access
effectDetails.rules: When the token is activated with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check, the user gains access to a secret contact within the Waterdeep Thieves' Guild. This contact can provide information on local criminal activity or potential business opportunities. The duration of this effect is until the end of your next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Loot Bonus
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful completion of a stealth check, there is a +20% chance to receive minor loot from the encounter. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be used once per day.

faerun_item_waterdeep_guild_token.levelRequirementReason: This token’s recognition by the guild grants it a certain amount of power, but its effects are not too powerful to require higher-level expertise.
faerun_item_waterdeep_guild_token.vendorReason: The Waterdeep Market is frequented by many thieves and smugglers who recognize the value of such tokens.
faerun_item_waterdeep_guild_token.shippingDetail: Ships via messenger hawk, typically arriving within a few days. The hawk carries messages for guild members, ensuring swift delivery.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next short rest or until lost.
usage.endsWhen: Lost or stolen by rival thieves' guilds.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one secret contact can be accessed per day.

faerun_item_waterdeep_guild_token.priceReason: The token's rarity and the potential for increased wealth and information make it a valuable asset worth this price in XP.

connectopia_geode_of_echoes.name: Echoing Geode
connectopia_geode_of_echoes.description: This shimmering Echoing Geode pulses with the vibrant hues of Connectopia's past, its surface etched with ancient runes that whisper secrets of bygone eras. Holding it allows you to briefly hear snippets of forgotten conversations and lost blueprints, potentially leading you to valuable resources or hidden workshops. But be wary—sometimes it repeats your own frustrated sighs, as if the geode echoes the present with a hint of the past's frustration.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Ancient Crafting Lore
effectDetails.rules: Activating this geode grants you advantage on Intelligence (History) checks related to Connectopia's past for 1 minute. You can use it once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Technology
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the geode allows you to make a DC 15 Investigation check to uncover hidden technological artifacts or blueprints within a 30-foot radius. On a success, you learn about one such item and its potential use.

connectopia_geode_of_echoes.levelRequirementReason: This geode requires significant knowledge of Connectopia's history to unlock its secrets.
connectopia_geode_of_echoes.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in relics from the past, making it a fitting vendor for this Echoing Geode.
connectopia_geode_of_echoes.shippingDetail: The Drone Delivery System ensures that your geode arrives pristine and intact, delivered within two game days of purchase.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate the geode's effects.
usage.duration: 1 minute for unlocking ancient lore; instantaneous for revealing hidden technology upon a successful check.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you make another check with the geode in the same rest period.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest.

connectopia_geode_of_echoes.priceReason: This Echoing Geode provides significant benefits tied to Connectopia's history and technology, justifying its cost.

the_edge_whisper_shard.name: Echoes of the Void Shard
the_edge_whisper_shard.description: The Echoes of the Void Shard gleams with an eerie, pulsating light that dances like a forgotten memory of endless voids. This jagged shard is surprisingly comfortable to hold, its cold surface whispering secrets from beyond the known abyss. It grants fleeting glimpses into potential futures—mostly bad ones involving giant worms and existential dread—but also reveals hidden paths in small areas, making it invaluable for those who dare venture into the unknown.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse of Future
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this shard grants the user a brief vision of one potential future outcome. The effect lasts for 1 round (6 seconds). It has a chance to inflict madness on the observer with a save DC of 15. If successful, the observer becomes temporarily insane and must make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of their next turn or fall unconscious until they succeed in another saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: The shard can be used once per day as an action to reveal hidden paths within a 10-foot radius. The effect is instantaneous and lasts until the end of your next turn. This ability does not affect creatures or objects that are already visible.

the_edge_whisper_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's visions can be overwhelming, requiring a higher level character to handle its potential madness-inducing effects.
the_edge_whisper_shard.vendorReason: The abyss trader specializes in exotic and dangerous artifacts, making them the perfect vendor for this item.
the_edge_whisper_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional rift, arriving with a slight delay of one week due to the instability of the rift.

usage.duration: 1 round (Glimpse of Future) / Instantaneous (Reveal Hidden Paths)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or the user is incapacitated during its effect.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use has a 10% chance to cause madness.

the_edge_whisper_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and unique abilities justify this price point in the market.

the_edge_rune_amulet.name: Amulet of Calculated Risk
the_edge_rune_amulet.description: The Amulet of Calculated Risk is crafted from solidified temporal flux, a material so rare it has been harvested only in the shadowed forges of the Edge Outpost. This amulet subtly alters your perception of risk, allowing you to glimpse outcomes that are slightly less dire when facing perilous choices... though fate still holds dominion over your ultimate success or failure. It grants you a brief moment where danger seems more manageable, but remember, it is not an armor against true harm—it merely tempers the immediate consequences.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: When you roll a saving throw or ability check against a hazard, you can pay 1 charge to gain advantage on the roll. This effect lasts for 1 round and expends one of your amulet’s charges.

effectDetails.title: Durable Luck
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each combat encounter, you have advantage on saving throws against traps or environmental hazards until the end of that encounter. This effect does not stack with other sources of advantage and ends when the encounter concludes.

the_edge_rune_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 8 to harness its temporal effects without overloading your ability to manage risk.
the_edge_rune_amulet.vendorReason: The Edge Outpost is known for crafting items that bridge the gap between survival and strategy, making it an ideal vendor for this amulet.
the_edge_rune_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via express courier within a day of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of the encounter or expended
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted when all charges are used up or at the end of an encounter

the_edge_rune_amulet.priceReason: The amulet’s temporal nature and limited charge system justify its value, providing strategic advantage without overpowered effects.

the_edge_echoing_potion.name: Potion of Transient Resonance
the_edge_echoing_potion.description: The Edge Echoing Potion is a shimmering vial of iridescent liquid that hums with the residual vibrations of past events. It amplifies your senses, allowing you to momentarily perceive echoes of the immediate environment—sounds, sights, and even faint whispers from the fabric of reality itself. Drinking this potion reveals hidden dangers within 30 feet and grants a fleeting moment of heightened awareness, perfect for navigating treacherous terrain or battling unseen foes.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of Danger
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you drink the potion. It grants you advantage on Perception checks within 30 feet for 1 minute, revealing hidden traps and dangers in the area.

effectDetails.title: Heightened Awareness
effectDetails.rules: Upon drinking, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your Constitution modifier for 5 minutes. These hit points are lost if you are incapacitated or fall unconscious.

the_edge_echoing_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is suitable for beginners and adventurers who need a burst of insight and resilience early in their journey.
the_edge_echoing_potion.vendorReason: Final Shop stocks this essential tool for any adventurer looking to navigate the perils of the battlefield.
the_edge_echoing_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week, ensuring you're prepared for your next quest.

usage.duration: 1 minute (Echoes of Danger), 5 minutes (Heightened Awareness)
usage.endsWhen: You fall unconscious or are incapacitated (Echoes of Danger); duration ends naturally (Heightened Awareness)
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short rest

the_edge_echoing_potion.priceReason: The potion's unique and valuable effects justify its higher price in the shop.

connectopia_brick_hammer.name: Wario's Blockbreaker!
connectopia_brick_hammer.description: Wario's Blockbreaker! hammers through reinforced concrete and stone blocks with ease, its solid yet surprisingly ergonomic handle made from a mix of reinforced concrete and ancient volcanic ash. This hammer is more than just a tool; it whispers tales of the blocksmiths who forged it in an abandoned quarry. Each swing has a chance to drop bricks, which can be used for crafting or sold at the local market.

effectDetails.title: Increased Mining Speed
effectDetails.rules: When you use Wario's Blockbreaker! to break blocks, your mining speed is increased by +2. This bonus lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Drop Bricks
effectDetails.rules: Each time you successfully break a block with this hammer, there is a 15% chance that a brick will drop for you to collect and use in crafting or trade. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges.

connectopia_brick_hammer.levelRequirementReason: Wario's Blockbreaker! is designed for beginners who need an effective tool to start mining and building.
connectopia_brick_hammer.vendorReason: As a renowned blocksmith, the vendor has a surplus of this hammer, which is in high demand among local miners and builders.
connectopia_brick_hammer.shippingDetail: The hammers are shipped via rolling crates, ensuring they arrive undamaged and ready for use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one successful block break

connectopia_brick_hammer.priceReason: The hammer's reinforced construction and unique crafting process justify its higher price, making it a worthwhile investment for miners.

connectopia_geode_of_stability.name: The Stabilizer
connectopia_geode_of_stability.description: The Stabilizer is a pulsating geode, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer in hues of calm blue and green. Crafted from the bedrock of forgotten lands, it exudes a soothing energy that instantly reinforces unstable structures, preventing collapses before they start. Its power is both stabilizing and mending—repairing minor damage to stone and brickwork as it neutralizes tremors. However, players should be wary: this artifact's magic is unpredictable, and prolonged use may cause it to shatter in a cascade of sparkling fragments.

effectDetails.title: Stabilize Terrain
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate The Stabilizer to neutralize tremors and prevent collapses within a 10-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until an earthquake ends. If used in an area affected by an earthquake, the user must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw; on a failed save, they take 2d6 force damage.

effectDetails.title: Repair Masonry
effectDetails.rules: The Stabilizer can repair minor damage to stone and brick structures as it stabilizes them. The geode can mend up to 100 hit points of damage per day, which must be applied to a single structure. This effect is instantaneous but requires the wielder to make an Intelligence (Architecture) check with a DC equal to half the structure's hit point total.

connectopia_geode_of_stability.levelRequirementReason: The Stabilizer's ancient magic demands a minimum of fifth-level proficiency in Architecture or Engineering to wield.
connectopia_geode_of_stability.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in relics and artifacts from the forgotten lands, making The Stabilizer a fitting addition to their inventory.
connectopia_geode_of_stability.shippingDetail: Shipped via the magic portal, this geode arrives encased in protective runes that ensure it reaches its destination intact.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Stabilize Terrain; Instantaneous for Repair Masonry (subject to check).
usage.duration: 1 minute or until an earthquake ends, whichever is shorter.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user moves out of range or if a new earthquake occurs within the radius.

connectopia_geode_of_stability.priceReason: The Stabilizer's price reflects its rare material, ancient crafting, and potent stabilizing properties that are crucial for both adventurers and builders alike.

teyvat_item_lightning_grapple.name: Electro-Charged Chain Gauntlet
teyvat_item_lightning_grapple.description: The Electro-Charged Chain Gauntlet is a masterwork of Liyue's forges. Its core, forged from storm-touched metal, channels raw electrical energy. This gauntlet allows you to traverse chasms with ease and deliver devastating shocks to your foes. Be wary; a misstep could result in a short-circuit that sends you sprawling, but it is precisely this balance of power and peril that makes it an indispensable tool for the Electro-kinetic warrior.

effectDetails.title: Aerial Leap
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can swing your gauntlet to grapple onto electrical sources. You gain advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks for the next minute.

effectDetails.title: Electroshock
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with this gauntlet, there is a 30% chance that your target becomes stunned until the start of your next turn. This effect has no save DC and can only be used once per long rest.

teyvat_item_lightning_grapple.levelRequirementReason: It requires basic dexterity to wield the gauntlet effectively.
teyvat_item_lightning_grapple.vendorReason: The artisans of Liyue are known for their mastery of electrokinetic crafts, making this gauntlet a natural addition to their wares.
teyvat_item_lightning_grapple.shippingDetail: Delivered via the swift sea winds; expect delivery within three days from port.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Aerial Leap, Standard action for Electroshock
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Aerial Leap), until start of next turn (Electroshock)
usage.endsWhen: When the gauntlet's attack is resolved or a short rest is completed

teyvat_item_lightning_grapple.priceReason: Balanced for its utility and risk, this gauntlet offers a unique combination of movement and combat advantages.

teyvat_item_godly_starfall_amulet.name: Amulet of the Fallen Star
teyvat_item_godly_starfall_amulet.description: The Amulet of the Fallen Star hums with a faint, ethereal light, a relic of an ancient celestial being's final moments. It grants incredible luck in combat and offers resistance against divine magic, though prolonged use may cause unsettling visions that cloud the mind. This amulet is said to have been crafted from the very essence of a starfall, and its wearer feels a connection to the cosmos, drawing strength from the heavens above.

effectDetails.title: Divine Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to all damage from divine spells and effects. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn after being hit by such an attack.

effectDetails.title: Fortunate Luck
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each combat, the wearer has a +10 bonus to Dexterity saving throws. This bonus can be used once per short rest.

teyvat_item_godly_starfall_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires a high level of magical affinity and strength to wield its celestial powers.
teyvat_item_godly_starfall_amulet.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in exotic and powerful artifacts, making the Amulet of the Fallen Star an ideal addition to their collection.
teyvat_item_godly_starfall_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered via a special courier who ensures its safe passage through treacherous territories.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until the end of the wearer's next turn after being hit by a divine attack.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer is no longer affected by a divine spell or when the wearer completes their next turn.

teyvat_item_godly_starfall_amulet.priceReason: This amulet's price reflects its rarity and the cost of materials used in its crafting, as well as its unique magical properties.

faerun_item_waterdeep_cartel_contract.name: Waterdeep Cartel Contract - 'The Serpent's Coil'
faerun_item_waterdeep_cartel_contract.description: The 'Serpent's Coil' contract, crafted by the Waterdeep Dragonborn Cartels, is a meticulously detailed scroll of ink and parchment. Its intricate seals and sigils hint at the treacherous nature of its promises. Those who sign it may gain access to forbidden black markets but also risk their reputations with the Cartel's enforcers. The contract whispers secrets of criminal enterprises and carries within it the potential for both profit and peril.

effectDetails.title: Black Market Access
effectDetails.rules: Activating the contract provides temporary access to the Waterdeep black market. This lasts until the end of your next long rest, and you must spend 1d6 x 50 XP upon activation. The Cartel may demand a bribe or favor in exchange for such access.

effectDetails.title: Criminal Information
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can spend 2 hours reviewing the contract to gain actionable intelligence from criminal contacts. This requires an Intelligence (Investigation) check at DC 15. On a success, you learn one piece of valuable information about a criminal organization or opportunity.

faerun_item_waterdeep_cartel_contract.levelRequirementReason: The intricate seals and dangerous implications make this contract suitable for characters with some experience.
faerun_item_waterdeep_cartel_contract.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is known for handling all sorts of contracts, from mundane to criminal.
faerun_item_waterdeep_cartel_contract.shippingDetail: The 'Serpent's Coil' must be delivered by a trusted messenger hawk to ensure its secrecy and authenticity.

usage.activation: Activates as an action at the start of your turn, but you must spend 1d6 x 50 XP.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The contract is destroyed or its effects are dispelled by a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use costs an additional 250 XP.

faerun_item_waterdeep_cartel_contract.priceReason: The price reflects the dangerous and valuable information contained within the contract.

kivotos_item_study_session.name: Accelerated Learning Session
kivotos_item_study_session.description: The Accelerated Learning Session is a rare service offered by Academy Armory, designed for scholars and mages in need of rapid knowledge acquisition. This intensive cramming-like session allows you to absorb vast amounts of information in mere hours—perfect for those who've underestimated their next quest's lore or spellbook's intricacies. Upon completion, your party gains a new proficiency level in one skill of your choice, and all members recover 50 hit points instantly without the usual fatigue of cramming.

effectDetails.title: Increased Skill Proficiency
effectDetails.rules: This effect allows a party member to choose one skill they already have proficiency in and increase its level by one. This is a once-per-day benefit.

effectDetails.title: Restores Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful completion of the session, all participants recover 50 hit points immediately. There are no saves required for this effect.

kivotos_item_study_session.levelRequirementReason: This service is suitable for players who need a quick boost in knowledge and health without overburdening their party.
kivotos_item_study_session.vendorReason: Academy Armory specializes in enhancing scholar capabilities, making this service one of its most popular offerings.
kivotos_item_study_session.shippingDetail: The session is delivered via a courier who ensures the party arrives at their location within an hour after purchase.

usage.activation: A short rest followed by a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check to enter the session.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The session ends successfully or if the participant fails the Insight check.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the party member is not exhausted.

kivotos_item_study_session.priceReason: The price reflects the rare and intensive nature of the service, providing significant in-game benefits for a limited time.

kivotos_item_glittering_spellbook.name: Glittering Spellbook of Minor Mishaps
kivotos_item_glittering_spellbook.description: The Glittering Spellbook of Minor Mishaps exudes an aura of mischief, its leather cover adorned with twinkling glitter that seems to pulse with suppressed energy. This seemingly harmless tome occasionally bursts into a dazzling display of minor magical mishaps, showering sparks and causing brief moments of confusion among those nearby. It's the perfect companion for anyone who enjoys a bit of chaos in their adventuring, though be warned: its unpredictable nature can turn even the most mundane encounters into chaotic spectacles.

effectDetails.title: Minor Glitter Show
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate this spellbook to release a burst of glitter that dazzles any creature within 10 feet. This effect has a duration of 1 round and imposes disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity (Stealth) checks made against the target for the duration. There is a 25% chance of triggering this effect each time you cast a spell from it.

effectDetails.title: Confusion Burst
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, as an action, you can force one creature within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or become confused for 1 minute. If the target succeeds on this save, they are immune to this effect of Glittering Spellbook of Minor Mishaps for 24 hours.

kivotos_item_glittering_spellbook.levelRequirementReason: The spellbook's unpredictable nature and its ability to cause confusion make it suitable for lower-level characters who can manage the risks.
kivotos_item_glittering_spellbook.vendorReason: Club Supply specializes in unique and quirky items that add a touch of whimsy to adventuring, making this spellbook an ideal fit for their inventory.
kivotos_item_glittering_spellbook.shippingDetail: Ships via Swift Courier Service within 3 days, delivered with a complimentary magical sparkle effect.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Minor Glitter Show), 1 minute (Confusion Burst)
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn (Minor Glitter Show), ends when the target no longer meets the criteria for confusion (Confusion Burst)
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

kivotos_item_glittering_spellbook.priceReason: The spellbook's unpredictable nature and its ability to cause minor but effective effects justify this higher price.

animatopia_stone_totem.name: Echoing Stone Totem
animatopia_stone_totem.description: This ancient Echoing Stone Totem is a weathered monolith pulsing with a rhythmic vibration, its surface etched with cryptic runes that whisper of forgotten lore. It's said to amplify one’s perception in the wilds, allowing you to hear faint sounds others miss and discern hidden paths through dense foliage. Legends speak of it as a gift from the forest spirits, though some believe it simply channels the natural world's subtlest energies.

effectDetails.title: Hearing Perception Boost
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the Echoing Stone Totem to grant yourself advantage on perception checks for one hour. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or if you use this feature again.

effectDetails.title: Detect Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: The totem allows you to detect hidden paths and natural traps within a 30-foot radius when used as an action. You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for the next hour, but the effect ends if you are incapacitated or if you use this feature again.

animatopia_stone_totem.levelRequirementReason: The totem's power is accessible to all adventurers who seek a deeper connection with nature.
animatopia_stone_totem.vendorReason: Beast Bazaar curates items that enhance one’s journey through the wilds, and this totem perfectly fits their mission.
animatopia_stone_totem.shippingDetail: Shipped by swift falcon messenger for expedited delivery directly to your campsite.

usage.duration: One hour per use
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitated or re-activated

animatopia_stone_totem.priceReason: The totem's rarity and the unique benefits it provides justify its moderate price in experience points.

animatopia_spirit_amulet.name: Whispering Spirit Amulet
animatopia_spirit_amulet.description: The Whispering Spirit Amulet, forged by ancient shaman hands from the bones of the first forest guardians and imbued with the essence of Animatopia's ancestral spirits, allows you to briefly commune with these elusive spirits. During your invocation, they whisper advice on how to navigate the land’s challenges, offering wisdom that can turn even the most daunting tasks into a breeze. However, their help comes at a price; there is always an underlying request for berries or a favor that might require a perilous journey.

effectDetails.title: Grant Divine Guidance
effectDetails.rules: By activating the amulet as an action, you can seek guidance from the spirits for a specific challenge. For the next minute, you gain advantage on one ability check of your choice. This effect ends if you take any hostile actions or if 1 minute passes.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Boost
effectDetails.rules: The amulet grants you a +2 bonus to Wisdom saving throws for 1 hour after you activate it. If you fail to use the amulet within one week of acquiring it, this effect is lost forever.

animatopia_spirit_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 10 to harness the power of the spirits effectively.
animatopia_spirit_amulet.vendorReason: The forest market thrives on ancient knowledge and mystical artifacts, making it a prime location for this amulet.
animatopia_spirit_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by drone with a slight delay due to the dense canopy of the forest.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take hostile actions
usage.endsWhen: 1 minute passes or you take hostile actions
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

animatopia_spirit_amulet.priceReason: Balanced with other rare items, this amulet offers unique and powerful guidance without being overpowered.

faction_fatebinder_amulet.name: The Binder's Whisper
faction_fatebinder_amulet.description: The Binder's Whisper is a pulsating amulet forged by the enigmatic Fateforgers. Its chaotic energy weaves through your rolls, subtly influencing outcomes in ways both beneficial and whimsical. Crafted from ancient runes and arcane materials, this amulet allows you to reroll a single die once per day, ensuring that fate bends ever so slightly in your favor. It also bestows a +1 bonus on all Charisma-based checks, enhancing your ability to sway the hearts of others.

effectDetails.title: Dice Reroll
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Allows you to reroll one d20 die once per day. The new roll replaces the original, and no save is required.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: +1 bonus on all Charisma-based checks and saving throws until your next long rest. This effect does not stack with other bonuses of the same kind.

faction_fatebinder_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for any adventurer, as it enhances decision-making and social interactions.
faction_fatebinder_amulet.vendorReason: The Fateforgers are renowned for their ability to craft items that subtly alter fate itself.
faction_fatebinder_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the Fate Messenger, this amulet comes with a special courier seal ensuring its authenticity and integrity.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (the new roll replaces the original)
usage.endsWhen: At midnight or when you take a short rest

faction_fatebinder_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its mythic rarity and limited daily use.

curiosity_shadowshard.name: Echoes of the Fallen King
curiosity_shadowshard.description: The Echoes of the Fallen King is a jagged shard etched with the faded glory and tragic downfall of an ancient emperor. When held, it hums with the cold winds of forgotten battles, whispering tales of lost kingdoms and unyielding ambition. Its touch grants you fleeting visions that can both enlighten and unsettle your mind, making it a treasure for those who seek to unravel the mysteries of history and power.

effectDetails.title: Visions of Past Battles
effectDetails.rules: When you hold the shard, you gain temporary access to its visions. On your turn, as a bonus action, you can focus on it and see flashes of forgotten battles. For every minute spent gazing into the shard, you have a 20% chance of gaining a +1 bonus to an investigation check related to ancient history or lost empires, but there is also a 5% chance per minute that you become temporarily mad.

effectDetails.title: Insight Bonus
effectDetails.rules: While holding the shard, you gain a +2 bonus to all investigation checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

curiosity_shadowshard.levelRequirementReason: This shard is within reach for adventurers who are just starting their journey and wish to explore dark curiosities.
curiosity_shadowshard.vendorReason: The chaos dealer, known for dealing in the most obscure and dangerous artifacts, naturally carries this relic of forgotten empires.
curiosity_shadowshard.shippingDetail: Ships via Shadow Delivery's covert network, ensuring that only those with a true need for such dark knowledge receive it.

usage.activation: Bonus action to focus and access visions; passive insight bonus while holding the shard
usage.duration: Visions last until end of turn, bonus lasts one long rest
usage.endsWhen: Forced concentration ends on the shard or when you drop it

curiosity_shadowshard.priceReason: The Echoes is a balanced item that offers both utility and risk, making it worth a significant amount of XP.

almost_edge_item_lost_melody.name: Lost Melody of the Boundary
almost_edge_item_lost_melody.description: The Lost Melody of the Boundary is a small, tarnished music box that whispers a single, haunting note upon activation. The sound lingers in your mind long after it has ceased, leaving you with an unsettling feeling of fading presence and profound loneliness. Some say the melody was crafted by those who dwell between worlds, but others believe it holds the sorrowful echoes of forgotten souls lost to the boundary realm. Listening to this box is not merely a choice—it is a journey into your own mind's twilight.

effectDetails.title: Melancholic Echo
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the music box plays its haunting note for 1 minute. The sound creates a lingering effect that forces every creature within 30 feet to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by the melody until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Sanity Drain
effectDetails.rules: Each time you listen to the Lost Melody, your sanity decreases by 1. This effect stacks, but only affects characters with a Wisdom score above 10. Characters who fail their saving throw against the Melancholic Echo have their sanity reduced by an additional 2 points.

almost_edge_item_lost_melody.levelRequirementReason: The item's haunting nature requires a character to be at least level 1 to handle its effects without immediate mental breakdown.
almost_edge_item_lost_melody.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader, with their vast knowledge of the boundary realms, is well-acquainted with such relics and can provide it to those who seek ancient curiosities.
almost_edge_item_lost_melody.shippingDetail: Delivered via a temporal distortion, ensuring that the box arrives in pristine condition, though the journey may take an unpredictable amount of time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; effect lasts for 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature is no longer within range or if they break line of effect with the source.

almost_edge_item_lost_melody.priceReason: The item's rarity, lore, and effects are balanced to reflect its value in XP, offering a unique experience that few other items can provide.

teyvat_item_ember_whisper.name: Ember Whisper Charm
teyvat_item_ember_whisper.description: The Ember Whisper Charm pulses faintly with residual pyro energy, its surface a mosaic of crackling embers that seem to glow from within. Crafted in the forges of Inazuma from the very heart of Stormterror's Lair, it whispers secrets of ancient pyromancers when held. Its warmth lingers like the memory of a long-dead guardian, and the faint smell of burning incense clings to you as if someone is always watching your back.

effectDetails.title: Pyro Aura
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this charm, you have a +1 bonus to saving throws against fire damage. Additionally, when you deal fire damage with an attack roll, there is a 5% chance the target ignites and takes an additional 1d4 fire damage at the start of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Ignite Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack while wearing this charm, there is a 5% chance that the target catches fire. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take an additional 1d4 fire damage.

teyvat_item_ember_whisper.levelRequirementReason: The Ember Whisper Charm is designed to be accessible, providing a subtle but effective boost for adventurers of all levels.
teyvat_item_ember_whisper.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare and exotic artifacts from the heart of Tywetan legends, making this charm an appropriate addition to their inventory.
teyvat_item_ember_whisper.shippingDetail: The Swift Courier Pigeon ensures fast delivery, but you must be at your destination when it arrives as no one will take back a burning item.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect ends immediately after use).
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon successful use or natural expiration of the charm's effects.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the charm is destroyed after 3 uses.

teyvat_item_ember_whisper.priceReason: The Ember Whisper Charm strikes a balance between rarity and utility, offering both defensive and offensive benefits at an accessible price point.

teyvat_item_wind_dancers_grace.name: Wind Dancer’s Grace Brooch
teyvat_item_wind_dancers_grace.description: A delicate brooch crafted from solidified wind essence, shimmering with the colors of a summer storm. Wearing this grants temporary bursts of speed and agility - perfect for dodging those pesky Diluc attacks! Just try not to get blown away by Wario's enthusiasm.
effects: increases movement speed by 25% for 6 seconds

teyvat_item_ocean_current_potion.name: Ocean Current Potion
teyvat_item_ocean_current_potion.description: The Ocean Current Potion is a shimmering azure elixir that tastes faintly of seaweed and the briny sea breeze. Draining this potion allows you to momentarily bend the currents, creating small whirlpools around yourself or your allies. The taste lingers for days, a reminder of the potion's origins in the heart of Teyvat’s coastal cities. It is said that drinking it grants both physical prowess and a fleeting bond with the ocean itself, making you more resilient to aquatic environments.

effectDetails.title: Bend Currents
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can create small whirlpools in water within a 20-foot radius. These whirlpools deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage and impose a -1 penalty to attack rolls against creatures caught in the whirlpool for 1 minute. The effect ends if you are no longer within 30 feet of the water or if you use this ability again.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Swimming
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after drinking, your swim speed increases by 10 feet and you have resistance to bludgeoning damage from falling. This effect ends when you rest for at least 8 hours or if the potion is expended.

teyvat_item_ocean_current_potion.levelRequirementReason: The potion's effects are designed to be accessible, offering utility without requiring a high level of expertise.
teyvat_item_ocean_current_potion.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor is known for its maritime trade and the connection with oceanic magic, making them an ideal vendor for this potion.
teyvat_item_ocean_current_potion.shippingDetail: The Sea Serpent Express ensures safe delivery through Teyvat’s treacherous waters, guaranteeing that your potion arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You are no longer within 30 feet of water or you use this ability again

teyvat_item_ocean_current_potion.priceReason: The potion's effects, while potent, require a significant amount of XP to justify the cost due to its utility and limited uses.

kivotos_item_halo_of_scholarly_focus.name: The Over-Achiever's Halo
kivotos_item_halo_of_scholarly_focus.description: The Over-Achiever's Halo is a gleaming, slightly askew halo made from the very essence of relentless study. Crafted by students who wished to outshine their peers, this premium accessory enhances concentration and focus. It subtly amplifies one's ability to retain new knowledge, making it invaluable for scholars and scribes alike. Wario might still try to steal it, just to cause a bit more chaos in the academic world.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Concentration
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +2 bonus to all Intelligence checks and saving throws. This effect lasts for the duration of any study or focused activity.

effectDetails.title: Passive Knowledge Retention
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each short rest, the wearer gains proficiency with one skill not already known by them. This effect can be used once per day and has no save DC.

kivotos_item_halo_of_scholarly_focus.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners to enhance their foundational skills.
kivotos_item_halo_of_scholarly_focus.vendorReason: The student store caters to the needs of scholars who require tools to excel in their studies.
kivotos_item_halo_of_scholarly_focus.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, ensuring that students can start using it right away.

usage.duration: Until the end of each day or short rest.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of one long rest after the intended use.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only once per day for gaining proficiency with a new skill.

kivotos_item_halo_of_scholarly_focus.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its premium quality and unique benefits without being overpowered.

kivotos_item_spectral_notebook.name: The Echoing Codex
kivotos_item_spectral_notebook.description: The Echoing Codex is a leather-bound notebook with faded, spectral pages filled with long-lost knowledge. Its cover glows faintly, whispering of forgotten eras and academic prowess. Writing within it allows you to briefly summon spectral duplicates that can distract foes or aid in puzzle-solving, their presence a fleeting but invaluable tool for any scholar or prankster. They vanish after a few minutes, leaving behind only the echoes of their former selves.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Duplication
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can write a short command within the Codex to summon one spectral duplicate. The duplicate appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you and lasts for up to 1 minute per level. It has the same statistics as you but is immune to most forms of damage. At the end of your turn, the duplicate vanishes.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Puzzle-Solving
effectDetails.rules: While within 30 feet of the Codex, you gain advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) and Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to solve puzzles or disarm traps. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

kivotos_item_spectral_notebook.levelRequirementReason: This basic tool is suitable for beginners but can be invaluable as one progresses in their studies and adventures.
kivotos_item_spectral_notebook.vendorReason: The club supply vendor stocks a wide variety of useful tools, including this handy academic aid.
kivotos_item_spectral_notebook.shippingDetail: Standard mail delivery is reliable but can take up to five days to arrive.

usage.duration: up to 1 minute per level
usage.endsWhen: the duplicate vanishes at the end of your turn or if you dismiss it as an action

kivotos_item_spectral_notebook.priceReason: The Echoing Codex is priced moderately due to its utility and the effort required to craft such a precise, enchanted notebook.

almost_edge_shard_of_the_unseen.name: Shard of the Unseen
almost_edge_shard_of_the_unseen.description: The Shard of the Unseen is a jagged, pulsating fragment that glows with an unsettling grey light. When held, it reveals hidden pathways and fleeting visions—mostly disturbing geometries that hint at places unseen by ordinary sight. Its power grants temporary resistance to fear effects, allowing you to remain composed in moments of terror. However, there's a minor chance (3%) each use that the wielder will be momentarily disoriented, stumbling for a round.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Pathways
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this shard grants you advantage on Perception checks to detect hidden or secret doors within a 10-foot radius. The effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fear
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your next short rest, you have resistance to being frightened by creatures and magical effects. This effect cannot be applied more than once per day.

almost_edge_shard_of_the_unseen.levelRequirementReason: This shard requires a minimum level of 8 due to its ability to reveal hidden pathways and grant fear resistance.
almost_edge_shard_of_the_unseen.vendorReason: The Void Merchant deals in rare artifacts that allow one to glimpse the unseen, making the Shard of the Unseen an ideal addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_shard_of_the_unseen.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Rift courier with a delay of up to two days due to its delicate nature and the instability of the rifts it travels through.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the effect ends
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish a short rest or are frightened by an attack or ability.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use has a minor chance of disorientation (3%)

almost_edge_shard_of_the_unseen.priceReason: This Shard is rare and useful for exploration and combat, making it worth the price in XP.

almost_edge_signet_of_the_lost.name: Signet of the Lost
almost_edge_signet_of_the_lost.description: The Signet of the Lost is a tarnished silver ring adorned with an arcane symbol of a falling doughnut. This relic grants access to the enigmatic 'Forgotten Archives,' a realm where forgotten knowledge and whimsical dreams are stored, primarily in the form of ancient recipes for pastries so terrible they could turn even the most seasoned chef into a confectionary failure. Wielding this signet also increases the chance of discovering rare and exotic ingredients used in these ill-fated desserts.

effectDetails.title: Access to Forgotten Archives
effectDetails.rules: Activates once per day. Grants temporary access to the 'Forgotten Archives,' a magical repository where knowledge and recipes are stored. The duration is until you exit or are forcibly removed from this realm.

effectDetails.title: Increased Discovery of Rare Ingredients
effectDetails.rules: Increases the chance of finding rare ingredients by +20%. This effect lasts for 1 hour, after which the ring must be worn again to regain its benefits. No save is required; the effect is purely cumulative with other bonuses.

almost_edge_signet_of_the_lost.levelRequirementReason: The arcane complexity of the signet requires a minimum of fifth-level spellcasting ability.
almost_edge_signet_of_the_lost.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader, known for their dealings in mystical and lost artifacts, often acquires such relics from forgotten realms.
almost_edge_signet_of_the_lost.shippingDetail: Ships via the Phase Shifter's secret portals, arriving within a week of order placement.

usage.duration: Until you exit the 'Forgotten Archives' or are forcibly removed.
usage.endsWhen: You leave the realm or are expelled by magical means.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per 24 hours.

almost_edge_signet_of_the_lost.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and unique benefits without overshadowing other items of similar rarity.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_shovel.name: Sticky Sweet Shovel
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_shovel.description: The Sticky Sweet Shovel, forged from a doughy confectionary paste, is a marvel of culinary engineering. This shovel can effortlessly scoop up an entire tray of freshly baked pies in one swipe, its hardened sugar structure making it both sturdy and sweetly sticky. It’s not just for digging; this tool can heal you when used against foes, reducing their movement speed as it leaves behind a trail of gooey delight.

effectDetails.title: Syrupy Blast
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an enemy with the Sticky Sweet Shovel, it releases a sticky substance that reduces their movement speed by 10 feet for 1 minute. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Healing Scoop
effectDetails.rules: When you use the shovel to scoop up an ally, they are healed of 2d4+3 hit points. You cannot use this ability more than twice per short or long rest.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_shovel.levelRequirementReason: The Sticky Sweet Shovel is simple and straightforward, requiring no special training to wield.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_shovel.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in culinary-themed gear and tools that are both functional and deliciously whimsical.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_shovel.shippingDetail: Ships overnight via Swift Delivery Cart, ensuring your sticky shovel arrives fresh from the bakery.

usage.activation: As a bonus action to scoop an enemy or ally with the shovel.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; Syrupy Blast lasts until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The uses are exhausted after 2 short rests, and it recharges at dawn the following day.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_shovel.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item, the Sticky Sweet Shovel is priced moderately to reflect its sweet but not overpowered abilities.

leclaire_isle_item_crumbly_charm.name: Crumbly Charm of Sweet Dreams
leclaire_isle_item_crumbly_charm.description: This fragile charm, crafted from the last crumbs of the legendary pastry chef Le Clair's final masterpiece, is said to bring sweet dreams filled with sugary delights. It crumbles in your hand but its magic lingers, granting a temporary boost to charisma and immunity to nightmares during sleep. The charm's power lies not just in its origin, but in the careful preservation by the Pastry Palace, ensuring only those of high virtue can wield it.

effectDetails.title: Sweet Dreams
effectDetails.rules: While you sleep, you are immune to nightmares. Additionally, there is a 50% chance that you regain 1d6 + your Charisma modifier mana on waking. This effect lasts for one night of rest.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Charisma checks and saving throws made while you are asleep, but the charm crumbles after one use. You cannot benefit from this effect again until you complete a long rest.

leclaire_isle_item_crumbly_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm requires at least level 1 to wield effectively due to its subtle magic.
leclaire_isle_item_crumbly_charm.vendorReason: Only the Pastry Palace, known for its impeccable craftsmanship and integrity, sells this rare and delicate charm.
leclaire_isle_item_crumbly_charm.shippingDetail: The magic messenger bird delivers the charm swiftly, ensuring it arrives intact at your doorstep.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon sleeping with the charm in hand.
usage.duration: One night of rest
usage.endsWhen: After one use or when you complete a long rest

leclaire_isle_item_crumbly_charm.priceReason: The charm's mythic rarity and the Pastry Palace's dedication to quality justify its relatively high price.

leclaire_isle_item_whirlwind_wafer.name: Whirlwind Wafer of Gusting Speed
leclaire_isle_item_whirlwind_wafer.description: The Whirlwind Wafer of Gusting Speed is a compact wafer infused with the very essence of LeClaire Isle's famous gusts. When consumed, it grants you a brief burst of incredible speed, allowing you to leap and dodge like the wind itself. However, be careful not to eat too quickly or risk spinning out of control, much like Wario in his infamous dance! This wafer is known for its unique flavor that lingers on your tongue like a gusty breeze.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming, you gain a +10-foot bonus to your speed for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Grace
effectDetails.rules: While this effect is active, you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls against ranged attacks. This effect persists until the end of your next turn.

leclaire_isle_item_whirlwind_wafer.levelRequirementReason: This wafer provides a quick burst of speed suitable for beginners or those needing a temporary edge.
leclaire_isle_item_whirlwind_wafer.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in snacks and treats from LeClaire Isle, making the Whirlwind Wafer a natural addition to their catalog.
leclaire_isle_item_whirlwind_wafer.shippingDetail: Shipped via dune buggy for quick delivery across the island's sandy terrain.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until spent, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn after consuming it

leclaire_isle_item_whirlwind_wafer.priceReason: This wafer is a common consumable but its unique gust-infused properties and rare capture method justify its higher price.

pokemon_item_evolutionary_shard.name: Evolutive Fragment
pokemon_item_evolutionary_shard.description: The Evolutive Fragment is a shimmering, crystalline shard that pulses with raw potential, a remnant of ancient Pokémon evolution. Crafted from the very essence of legendary evolution sites, this relic can accelerate a Trainer’s bond with their beast, potentially triggering an unexpected secondary evolution. Rumor has it that those who possess it might see their Pokémon's happiness increase by 5 points, fostering a deeper connection and unlocking hidden evolutionary paths.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Evolution
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Increases the chance of triggering an evolution by 10%, with a minimum boost to 20%. The effect ends at the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Happiness Boost
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that increases Pokémon happiness by 5 points immediately upon activation. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest, and cannot exceed a total increase of +10 to Pokémon happiness in a single day.

pokemon_item_evolutionary_shard.levelRequirementReason: Trainers must have at least 8th level to ensure they can properly care for their Pokémon while using the Evolutive Fragment.
pokemon_item_evolutionary_shard.vendorReason: As a trusted supplier of rare and unique items, the Pokemart is known for offering powerful tools like the Evolutive Fragment that can aid Trainers in their journey.
pokemon_item_evolutionary_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via special courier service, ensuring safe delivery within 24 hours.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with a duration of one turn for the Evolution boost and until the end of your next rest for the Happiness increase.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you take another action or reaction, or at the start of your next turn after activation.

pokemon_item_evolutionary_shard.priceReason: The Evolutive Fragment is priced at 1000 XP as it offers significant evolutionary benefits and happiness boosts that can greatly impact a Trainer's journey.

pokemon_item_hyper_potion.name: Hyper Potion of Fury
pokemon_item_hyper_potion.description: The Hyper Potion of Fury is a volatile concoction, its vial swirling with the raw energy of a raging tempest and the fierce might of a dragon's breath. This potion not only restores your Pokémon to full health but also grants it an electrifying boost in speed, making it faster than any ordinary trainer could follow. With this potion at hand, you'll be ready for any challenge, whether it's catching that elusive Pokémon or outmaneuvering a rival team.

effectDetails.title: Restores Full Health
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this potion instantly restores the user's Pokémon to its maximum hit points. It has no save DC and is a single-use item.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the next three turns, the user’s Pokémon gains an additional +3 Speed stat bonus. This effect ends naturally after 3 turns or if the user takes any action that requires their turn.

pokemon_item_hyper_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed to be accessible for beginners and experienced trainers alike, making it a common item.
pokemon_item_hyper_potion.vendorReason: The Safari Shop caters to all Pokémon trainers, offering essential items like the Hyper Potion of Fury.
pokemon_item_hyper_potion.shippingDetail: This potion is shipped via a trusted courier and must be delivered in person for safety reasons.

usage.activation: Eaten by the user’s Pokémon as a free action
usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends after three turns or when the effect is interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Naturally after three turns, or if the Pokémon takes any action that requires its turn

pokemon_item_hyper_potion.priceReason: The increased potency and unique effects of this potion justify a higher price in XP.

pokemon_item_legendary_aurora_crest.name: Aurora Crest of the Ancients
pokemon_item_legendary_aurora_crest.description: The Aurora Crest of the Ancients is a gleaming, crystalline pendant forged during a breathtaking celestial aurora. Crafted from ancient meteoric iron and adorned with gemstones said to capture the essence of legendary beasts, it grants its wearer control over Pokémon weather abilities and a fleeting alliance with a legendary creature. Though these fabled companions are often silent observers, their presence alone can shift the winds or calm a storm at your command.

effectDetails.title: Weather Mastery
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you gain control over weather conditions within a 50-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Legendary Companionship
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can summon a legendary Pokémon as an ally. The creature remains with you for 1 hour and then returns to its own plane of existence. If the summoned creature is attacked, it fights back until you dismiss it or it is defeated.

pokemon_item_legendary_aurora_crest.levelRequirementReason: This crest requires a high-level character to properly utilize its powerful effects.
pokemon_item_legendary_aurora_crest.vendorReason: The league store specializes in rare and legendary items, making the Aurora Crest of the Ancients an appropriate addition.
pokemon_item_legendary_aurora_crest.shippingDetail: Ships via Express Windrunner Courier, ensuring swift delivery within a week.

usage.activation: Action or reaction (Weather Mastery); once per day (Legendary Companionship)
usage.duration: 1 minute (Weather Mastery); 1 hour (Legendary Companionship)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration expires, and upon being dismissed by the wearer.
usage.charges: Recharge after a short or long rest

pokemon_item_legendary_aurora_crest.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its powerful abilities and rarity.

middle_earth_goblin_grog.name: Goblin Grog of Grumbling Gut
middle_earth_goblin_grog.description: The Goblin Grog of Grumbling Gut is a suspiciously green elixir that smells faintly of mildew and regret, yet it's surprisingly potent in boosting strength. Drink this foul-smelling concoction to gain +2 Strength for the next 10 turns, but be prepared to move with an awkward goblin-like gait at a reduced speed for 5 turns. The liquid is known to cause uncontrollable giggles in 10% of cases, making you feel like a particularly grumpy goblin for as long as it lasts.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the drink grants +2 to Strength for 10 turns. This effect is instantaneous upon drinking and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Goblin Gait
effectDetails.rules: After consuming, your movement speed is reduced by -1 step for 5 turns. This penalty begins immediately after the strength boost ends, unless interrupted by other actions or effects.

middle_earth_goblin_grog.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can afford to experiment with this unpredictable potion without facing severe penalties.
middle_earth_goblin_grog.vendorReason: The local shopkeeper at the Shire is known for selling quirky and experimental items, making the Goblin Grog a fitting addition.
middle_earth_goblin_grog.shippingDetail: Ships via friendly pony cart with no delivery delay; guaranteed safe arrival within 3 days.

usage.duration: 10 turns (strength boost) + 5 turns (goblin gait)
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration ends naturally or if consumed again

middle_earth_goblin_grog.priceReason: The potion's unpredictable effects, combined with its experimental nature and the Shire's reputation for quirky items, justify this balanced price.

middle_earth_elf_song_petal.name: Songpetal of Silent Sorrow
middle_earth_elf_song_petal.description: The Songpetal of Silent Sorrow is a single, iridescent petal from a flower that blooms only in the deepest elven forests. When held, it releases a haunting melody that lingers in the air, evoking a deep melancholy or nostalgia within those who hear it. The petal's ethereal glow and delicate structure seem to whisper of ancient sorrows and unspoken regrets. It is said that those who possess this petal can feel a kinship with all things lost and forgotten.

effectDetails.title: Melancholic Melody
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Songpetal releases a haunting melody that targets all creatures within 30 feet. Creatures must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or be charmed for 1 minute by the melancholy song. Once a creature succeeds on its save against this effect, it is immune to it for 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Restores Mana
effectDetails.rules: When held, the Songpetal provides minor healing over time, restoring 25 mana at the start of each of the wielder's turns. This effect lasts until the end of the wielder's next long rest.

middle_earth_elf_song_petal.levelRequirementReason: The petal's ancient magic requires a certain level of spiritual and magical awareness to properly harness its effects.
middle_earth_elf_song_petal.vendorReason: The elven market is known for its deep connection with nature and arcane knowledge, making it the perfect place to find such an item.
middle_earth_elf_song_petal.shippingDetail: Ships via a dragon airship, ensuring swift delivery from the heart of Middle-earth's ancient forests.

usage.activation: Activates as an action. The melody lasts for 1 minute.
usage.duration: The melody lasts for 1 minute and can be renewed by repeating the activation action.
usage.endsWhen: The melody ends when the wielder is incapacitated or the petal is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one melody can be active at a time.

middle_earth_elf_song_petal.priceReason: The item's rarity and the significant magical properties make it a high-priced curiosity that few adventurers are willing to part with.

kivotos_item_chromatic_scroll.name: Chromatic Scroll of Minor Manifestation
kivotos_item_chromatic_scroll.description: This Chromatic Scroll of Minor Manifestation is a peculiar relic, its surface adorned with swirling hues that shift like a prism under candlelight. It exudes an enticing aroma of bubblegum and nostalgia, hinting at forgotten magic. When unfurled, it briefly summons a shimmering duplicate of the user, perfect for distracting foes or impressing friends, though the duplicate is prone to minor misadventures, such as accidentally knocking over nearby objects in its confusion.

effectDetails.title: Minor Duplication
effectDetails.rules: The user briefly gains a shimmering duplicate that lasts for 1 minute. The duplicate is an illusion and can be used to distract foes or friends. It has no physical substance but can interact with objects within reach, causing minor disruptions. The duplicate cannot attack or cast spells.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
