effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +1 bonus to their Charisma (Performance) checks and saving throws for 3 turns after using the scroll. This effect does not stack with other sources of temporary bonuses.

kivotos_item_chromatic_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is suitable for beginners, providing them with a taste of magical experimentation.
kivotos_item_chromatic_scroll.vendorReason: The student store caters to the whimsical needs of young adventurers seeking small wonders and magical novelties.
kivotos_item_chromatic_scroll.shippingDetail: Delivered by autonomous drones, ensuring quick arrival without mishap.

usage.activation: A bonus action to unfurl and activate the scroll.
usage.duration: The effects last for their specified durations upon activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires or when the user retracts the scroll, whichever comes first.

kivotos_item_chromatic_scroll.priceReason: This price reflects a balanced adjustment for a versatile and useful magical trinket that is both fun and slightly risky to use.

kivotos_item_reinforced_notepad.name: Reinforced Notepad of Scholarly Defense
kivotos_item_reinforced_notepad.description: The Reinforced Notepad of Scholarly Defense is a titanium-bound notebook that feels as sturdy as it looks, crafted by the hands of diligent scholars and enchanted to resist magical incursions. It offers a scholar or student a temporary shield against minor spells, bolstering their defenses during critical moments. With each page filled with equations or notes, it gains strength, deflecting more than just ink – it can also mitigate the effects of a professor's ire by reducing incoming spell damage.

effectDetails.title: Deflect Minor Spells
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate this notepad to deflect one minor magical projectile. It has a chance to reduce the spell's damage by half for up to 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Reduce Spell Damage
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after activating it, whenever you are targeted by a spell that deals damage to you, there is a 20% chance that the damage is reduced by 5 points. This effect does not stack with itself.

kivotos_item_reinforced_notepad.levelRequirementReason: This notepad can be used by anyone, offering immediate utility for students and scholars alike.
kivotos_item_reinforced_notepad.vendorReason: Academy Armory stocks this item as it's a practical tool for the student body to protect themselves during lectures and exams.
kivotos_item_reinforced_notepad.shippingDetail: Ships via Courier Pigeon, delivered within 3 days of purchase.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The notepad's effects expire after a single use or when the notepad is destroyed

kivotos_item_reinforced_notepad.priceReason: This item provides useful and immediate protection, justifying its price as a rare, limited stock.

kivotos_item_halo_of_procrastination.name: Halo of Procrastination
kivotos_item_halo_of_procrastination.description: The Halo of Procrastination gleams with a soft, shifting light that seems to dance in the air around you. This shimmering crown promises heightened focus and productivity... or at least an illusion thereof. Worn by a student, you'll find yourself endlessly researching obscure topics, rearranging your desk, and debating the merits of different stationery brands. While it may seem like a boon for academic pursuits, the halo's true nature is to sap your concentration, leaving you perpetually distracted with trivial matters.

effectDetails.title: Distracted Focus
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Halo of Procrastination, you must make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each combat round. On a failed save, you skip your next action and instead spend an additional minute debating the finer points of stationery brands, which can be interrupted by any creature within 5 feet.

effectDetails.title: Research Delays
effectDetails.rules: You gain +3 to Intelligence checks related to research or trivia. However, this bonus is negated during combat rounds in which you failed the Wisdom save for Distracted Focus. The halo's effects last until the start of your next short rest.

kivotos_item_halo_of_procrastination.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and potential interference with combat make the Halo of Procrastination suitable only for players at least level 11.
kivotos_item_halo_of_procrastination.vendorReason: Club Supply caters to academic and scholarly needs, making it a fitting vendor for items like the Halo of Procrastination.
kivotos_item_halo_of_procrastination.shippingDetail: Delivered under cover of darkness by the Night Courier, ensuring you have your new distraction ready for the next morning.

usage.duration: Until start of your next short rest or interrupted by a failed Wisdom saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next short rest, upon failing a Wisdom save during combat rounds, or if you remove the halo from your head.

kivotos_item_halo_of_procrastination.priceReason: The item's balance is adjusted to 1000 XP, reflecting its unique and potentially disruptive effect on gameplay.

pokemon_item_shiny_stone.name: Prismatic Evolution Shard
pokemon_item_shiny_stone.description: This shimmering shard pulses with an array of colors, each hue representing a different Pokémon type. Crafted from rare mineral fragments found deep within the Unova region, it dramatically increases your chances of evolving a Pokémon into its shiny form when used during an evolution attempt. However, overuse can attract unwanted attention and suspicion among trainers who are particularly adept at detecting anomalies. Wario’s keen eye for shiny Pokémon has made this shard immensely popular in his shop, offering players the chance to enhance their teams with these rare forms.
effects: Passive luck bonus on all Pokémon-related checks

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Shiny Evolution
effectDetails.rules: Activates during a Pokémon evolution attempt. Increases the probability of a shiny evolution by 20%. Has no effect if the Pokémon is already shiny. Ends when used or after one successful evolution attempt.

effectDetails.title: Passive Luck Bonus
effectDetails.rules: Grants a +2 bonus on all ability checks related to Pokémon, including capturing, battling, and breeding. Lasts for 1 hour per use. Ends if the user is defeated in battle or falls unconscious.

pokemon_item_shiny_stone.levelRequirementReason: Players with less experience can benefit from this item as it aids in a critical aspect of Pokémon training without requiring high-level skills.
pokemon_item_shiny_stone.vendorReason: The Safari Shop is known for its unique and helpful items, making the Prismatic Evolution Shard an essential addition to their inventory.
pokemon_item_shiny_stone.shippingDetail: Ships via a specialized Winged Pokémon courier; delivery can take up to two days depending on location.

usage.activation: Used during a Pokémon evolution attempt or when making a Pokémon-related check.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the shiny evolution effect, lasts 1 hour for the luck bonus effect.
usage.endsWhen: After one successful shiny evolution or if the user is defeated in battle or falls unconscious.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be used multiple times without recharging.

pokemon_item_shiny_stone.priceReason: The Prismatic Evolution Shard offers a significant advantage in Pokémon training and battling, justifying its high price in experience points.

pokemon_item_steel_gauntlet.name: Ironclad Trainer's Fist
pokemon_item_steel_gauntlet.description: The Ironclad Trainer's Fist is a gauntlet forged from hardened steel, imbued with the resilient spirit of a Steel-type Pokémon. Its surface gleams with a subtle metallic sheen, and its core pulses faintly with latent power. This formidable accessory not only grants +5 Defense but also offers an unexpected advantage: there's a 30% chance to deflect incoming status effects, ensuring you remain in peak fighting condition. When subjected to powerful blows, it enhances your resistance to knockback by 20%, crucial for enduring relentless attacks without losing ground.

effectDetails.title: +5 Defense
effectDetails.rules: The Ironclad Trainer's Fist provides a +5 bonus to your AC. This effect is always active, offering continuous protection in combat.

effectDetails.title: 30% chance to deflect status effects
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns while wearing the gauntlet, you have a 30% chance that an incoming status effect (such as Poison or Paralysis) is deflected. If successful, the effect does not take hold.

pokemon_item_steel_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The Ironclad Trainer's Fist requires at least level 8 to wield effectively, ensuring it complements higher-level trainers' abilities.
pokemon_item_steel_gauntlet.vendorReason: As the official vendor for high-ranking trainers and their gear, league_store is well-known for offering items that enhance a trainer’s prowess.
pokemon_item_steel_gauntlet.shippingDetail: The Express Delivery Pigeon ensures quick delivery, making sure you receive your Ironclad Trainer's Fist in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effectively permanent until lost or destroyed)
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed upon losing the gauntlet or when it is explicitly broken by a powerful force

pokemon_item_steel_gauntlet.priceReason: The Ironclad Trainer's Fist offers substantial defensive and situational advantages, justifying its price in game XP.

pokemon_item_phantom_lantern.name: Echoing Dusk Lantern
pokemon_item_phantom_lantern.description: The Echoing Dusk Lantern glows with an eerie, phosphorescent light that reveals the faint outlines of ghostly Pokémon lurking in the shadows. This lantern casts a spell of spectral perception, allowing you to see through darkness as if it were daylight and granting +2 to Perception checks. The lantern's core is said to be haunted by the spirit of a lost Pikachu, making it a dangerous yet invaluable tool for any night-time explorer or trainer seeking to uncover hidden Pokémon. Wario himself has been known to carry one, though he claims it’s only because 'it might help me catch that missing Pikachu.'
effects: Reveals ghostly Pokémon and their location

effectDetails.title: Spectral Perception
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the lantern grants you advantage on Perception checks made to locate hidden or unseen creatures within a 30-foot radius. The effect lasts for 1 minute and ends early if the lantern is destroyed or extinguished.

effectDetails.title: +2 Perception
effectDetails.rules: The lantern provides a +2 bonus to your Perception ability score while it is active, which can be used once per short rest.

pokemon_item_phantom_lantern.levelRequirementReason: Only those with at least 10th level can wield the Echoing Dusk Lantern due to its spectral abilities and the danger of interacting with ghostly Pokémon.
pokemon_item_phantom_lantern.vendorReason: The pokemart caters exclusively to trainers who need the latest tools for their adventures, including this rare and powerful lantern.
pokemon_item_phantom_lantern.shippingDetail: Ships via Dark Lugia Courier with a 24-hour delivery time due to the lantern's fragile nature.

usage.duration: 1 minute, up to once per short rest
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or extinguished by the user

pokemon_item_phantom_lantern.priceReason: The Echoing Dusk Lantern is priced at 1000 XP due to its spectral abilities, rarity, and the potential risk of encountering ghostly Pokémon.

equestria_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.name: Shadow Stone of Discord
equestria_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.description: The Shadow Stone of Discord pulses with a dark obsidian sheen, its aura radiating unease and discord among those who touch it. Legend says it was crafted by Nightmare Moon in her shadowy realm, and prolonged exposure can subtly warp the alignment of the user's party toward conflict and dissent. Handle this artifact with extreme caution—or don't at all; for once wielded, you may find yourself mired in strife.

effectDetails.title: Discordance
effectDetails.rules: Each creature within 10 feet of the stone must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the confusion condition for 1 minute. The effect ends early if the confused creature takes any action.

effectDetails.title: Alignment Shift
effectDetails.rules: The user's party has their alignment score reduced by 2, which lasts until a short or long rest is taken. This effect can be resisted with a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

equestria_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.levelRequirementReason: This powerful artifact requires the user to have significant experience and control to handle its effects responsibly.
equestria_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce, known for their extensive collection of rare and forbidden artifacts, has acquired this item from a mysterious source.
equestria_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.shippingDetail: The stone is delivered in a specially crafted container to prevent accidental activation during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of your next turn or ends early due to confusion
usage.endsWhen: The confused creature takes an action, or after one minute if no actions are taken

equestria_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.priceReason: This artifact is considered rare and powerful, making it a significant investment for any party.

equestria_item_elemental_grappling_hook.name: Hook of the Storm Winds
equestria_item_elemental_grappling_hook.description: The Hook of the Storm Winds is a crystalline grappling hook forged in the heart of Equestria's Crystal Empire. Crafted from purest amethyst and imbued with the power of the wind, it hums with energy when exposed to air currents. This tool allows swift ascent up vertical surfaces and can swing across gaps with precision, making it indispensable for explorers and adventurers alike. Just be wary—its stormy nature may yet catch you off guard if used recklessly.

effectDetails.title: Storm Wind Ascent
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can cause the hook to extend and retract with a burst of wind. This grants advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb for up to one minute.

effectDetails.title: Cross Gap
effectDetails.rules: The hook can be used as an action to swing across gaps between two points, provided the distance is no more than 30 feet and both points are within reach. This grants a +2 bonus on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made during the swing.

equestria_item_elemental_grappling_hook.levelRequirementReason: The intricate enchantments require a basic understanding of magical energies.
equestria_item_elemental_grappling_hook.vendorReason: Known for their mastery of crystal and magic, the Crystal Empire is the source of this enchanted tool.
equestria_item_elemental_grappling_hook.shippingDetail: Ships via Crystal Express within a week, delivered by an expert courier.

usage.activation: Bonus action to extend/retract; action for swinging across gaps
usage.duration: One minute from activation or until swung across a gap
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if the hook is retracted
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one swing per day

equestria_item_elemental_grappling_hook.priceReason: Balanced for its utility and limited daily usage.

pokemon_item_legendary_battle_crest.name: Trainer’s Fury Emblem
pokemon_item_legendary_battle_crest.description: The Trainer’s Fury Emblem, a gleaming crest forged from the scales of a legendary Pokémon, radiates an aura of strategic prowess. Crafted in the heart of the Unova region by master craftsmen, this emblem enhances your reflexes and ability to predict your opponent's moves with uncanny accuracy. While it doesn’t guarantee success, its wearer can exploit openings more effectively, turning the tide of battle in their favor.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Trainer’s Fury Emblem, you gain a +25% bonus to your Dexterity saving throws and initiative checks. This effect is active as long as you are wearing the emblem.

effectDetails.title: Predictive Counter
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can attempt to predict your opponent's next move. If successful, there’s a 30% chance that you counter their attack or spell. This effect has a cooldown of one long rest.

pokemon_item_legendary_battle_crest.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant experience and skill to harness the emblem's strategic prowess effectively.
pokemon_item_legendary_battle_crest.vendorReason: The league store specializes in gear for competitive trainers, ensuring only the most potent and balanced items are sold there.
pokemon_item_legendary_battle_crest.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost care by trusted Pokémon messengers, ensuring the emblem arrives pristine and intact.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to counter an opponent's move)
usage.duration: Instantaneous or one round if used to counter a move
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use or when removed from your person

pokemon_item_legendary_battle_crest.priceReason: Balanced at this price point as it provides significant strategic advantage without overpowered mechanics.

pokemon_item_potion_of_swiftness.name: Hyper Speed Elixir
pokemon_item_potion_of_swiftness.description: The Hyper Speed Elixir is a shimmering, iridescent potion that glows with the essence of legendary Pokémon. This rare concoction enhances your speed and agility, allowing you to outmaneuver foes in combat. Upon consumption, it grants a temporary boost to your Dexterity (Speed) by 50%, enabling you to dodge attacks with ease for one turn. You can also move twice as fast during this time, outrunning even the swiftest Pokémon. The potion’s effects are fleeting but potent, ensuring that you stay ahead of danger.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the user gains a +50% bonus to Dexterity (Speed) for one turn. This increases their chance of dodging all physical attacks by 20%. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Speed Surge
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the potion, you can move twice as fast during combat encounters and exploration. You gain a +4 bonus to movement speed for one minute after drinking this potion.

pokemon_item_potion_of_swiftness.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for beginners who need an extra edge in their early adventures.
pokemon_item_potion_of_swiftness.vendorReason: The Safari Shop specializes in potions and elixirs that enhance the speed of trainers and explorers, making it a perfect fit for this item.
pokemon_item_potion_of_swiftness.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via Winged Pokémon Courier service. Delivered fresh and potent.

usage.activation: Consume the potion as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the start of your next turn for Dodge Boost, and one minute for Speed Surge.
usage.endsWhen: The potion’s effects end when you take damage or are incapacitated.

pokemon_item_potion_of_swiftness.priceReason: This price reflects the high demand for speed-enhancing potions, as it is a critical advantage in many battles and explorations.

faerun_item_potion_of_minor_healing.name: Potion of Minor Healing (Faerûn Style)
faerun_item_potion_of_minor_healing.description: This vibrant green potion smells suspiciously like a mix of swamp berries and questionable mushrooms, emitting an earthy aroma that clings to your nostrils long after uncorking it. The liquid inside shimmers with a faint glow, hinting at its alchemical origins. Drink it down quickly, and you'll recover 25 hit points, but beware—this potent brew can leave you feeling light-headed for the next hour. Wario's approval comes with a caveat: don't expect to be fighting any dragons afterward!

effectDetails.title: Heal
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the potion heals you by 25 hit points. This effect is instantaneous and has no save or range requirement.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Dizziness
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after consuming this potion, you are prone to feeling light-headed and disoriented, reducing your speed by half until the effects wear off. There is no save against this effect.

faerun_item_potion_of_minor_healing.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for beginners who need a bit of extra healing in their adventures.
faerun_item_potion_of_minor_healing.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar stocks common items that are essential for all adventurers, including this reliable healing potion.
faerun_item_potion_of_minor_healing.shippingDetail: The potion is shipped via a swift hawk courier, ensuring it arrives fresh and potent at your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous heal; dizziness lasts for one hour
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends after one hour or if you use another potion of minor healing in the same day

faerun_item_potion_of_minor_healing.priceReason: The price reflects the balanced cost to recover significant hit points without being overpowered.

faerun_item_scroll_of_protection_from_el.name: Scroll of Protection from Elementals (Faerûn)
faerun_item_scroll_of_protection_from_el.description: The Scroll of Protection from Elementals is a tattered parchment inscribed with ancient eldritch runes. Crafted by a paranoid wizard in the shadowy catacombs beneath Waterdeep, it promises temporary immunity to elemental fury. When unfurled, it grants protection against the raw power of nature's wrath, offering resistance to cold and lightning damage for 1 minute. Should an elemental assault come, this scroll ensures that you stand firm, bolstered by the ancient magic woven into its very fibers.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants resistance to cold and lightning damage for 1 minute, ending early if you take elemental damage or if the scroll is damaged.

effectDetails.title: Saving Throws Advantage
effectDetails.rules: While the Elemental Resistance effect lasts, you gain advantage on saving throws against spells cast by elementals. This effect ends when the resistance ends or if you fail a saving throw.

faerun_item_scroll_of_protection_from_el.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is designed for adventurers who have already faced elemental threats and require a more focused defense.
faerun_item_scroll_of_protection_from_el.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market, known for its diverse wares, sells this scroll to protect the city's denizens from elemental attacks.
faerun_item_scroll_of_protection_from_el.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift messenger pigeon, ensuring timely arrival even in the heart of Waterdeep's bustling streets.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You take elemental damage or if the scroll is damaged

faerun_item_scroll_of_protection_from_el.priceReason: Balanced to ensure that this scroll remains a valuable tool for adventurers without being overpowered.

teyvat_item_ember_charm.name: Ember Charm of Shifting Flames
teyvat_item_ember_charm.description: The Ember Charm of Shifting Flames hums softly, pulsing with a warm, flickering light that dances like embers in a forge. Crafted from obsidian and imbued with Pyro essence by an alchemist in Mondstadt, this trinket not only illuminates your path but also subtly warms the air around you, making it perfect for those chilly nights. With each use, the charm's flames may ignite nearby flammable objects, so be cautious when using it indoors!

effectDetails.title: Lighting
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Ember Charm emits a soft glow that provides dim light in a 10-foot radius for 1 hour. The light is gentle and warm, ideal for illuminating dark corners or guiding your party through a shadowy cave.

effectDetails.title: Flammability Risk
effectDetails.rules: There's a 25% chance that the Ember Charm will ignite any flammable object within 10 feet of you when its light is active. This effect has no save DC and lasts for as long as the lighting effect. The risk decreases by 5% after each use until it disappears.

teyvat_item_ember_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is designed to be accessible, even to new adventurers who may not have mastered more potent Pyro abilities yet.
teyvat_item_ember_charm.vendorReason: Mondstadt Market stocks a variety of useful and whimsical items that cater to the needs of all adventurers, from beginners to seasoned heroes.
teyvat_item_ember_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the reliable Swift Courier Pigeon, ensuring you receive your Ember Charm promptly without any delays.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The lighting effect ends when its duration expires or when a creature within the area of light uses an action to dispel it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the flammability risk decreases by 5% after each use.

teyvat_item_ember_charm.priceReason: The Ember Charm is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique combination of utility and potential hazard, making it a valuable yet balanced addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

teyvat_item_phantom_silk.name: Phantom Silk Scarf of Whispering Winds
teyvat_item_phantom_silk.description: Woven from the very threads of a Mizumoto illusion, this Phantom Silk Scarf of Whispering Winds seems to ripple with unseen currents and whispers secrets only a master manipulator would understand. It offers minor protection against the elements and provides resistance to cold, making it indispensable for those navigating the unpredictable climates of Inazuma. The scarf not only enhances movement speed by 5% but also grants a chance to dispel any status effect that might hinder its wearer.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Movement
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +5% bonus to their movement speed while wearing the scarf. This effect is passive and lasts until removed.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has resistance to cold damage, reducing all cold-based attacks by 10%. This benefit persists for 1 minute upon activation or until a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw ends it. The scarf can dispel one status effect per day.

teyvat_item_phantom_silk.levelRequirementReason: The intricate weaving and magical properties of the Phantom Silk Scarf demand a proficient user.
teyvat_item_phantom_silk.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports is known for importing exotic and enchanted goods from across Teyvat, including this unique artifact.
teyvat_item_phantom_silk.shippingDetail: The scarf is delivered via the Sea Serpent Express with expedited shipping to ensure timely arrival.

usage.activation: Activates upon donning and can be dispelled by a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.
usage.duration: Passive; lasts until removed or dispelled.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the scarf is removed, or through a successful Constitution saving throw.

teyvat_item_phantom_silk.priceReason: Considering its unique enchantments and limited availability, this item's price reflects its value in both utility and rarity.

teyvat_item_forbidden_rune.name: Rune of Unmaking - Minor
teyvat_item_forbidden_rune.description: The Rune of Unmaking - Minor is a fragment of reality warped by dark magic, its surface etched with runes that glow with an eerie, shifting light. Crafted from the shattered remnants of ancient forges, this rune holds enough power to unravel the very fabric of existence. Use it sparingly, as even a minor slip can result in catastrophic consequences—either devastating your foes or causing unintended harm to you and those around you.

effectDetails.title: Dealing Magic Damage
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the rune unleashes a surge of chaotic energy that deals 15 necrotic damage to a single target within 30 feet. The target can make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw to halve the damage.

effectDetails.title: Self-Harm Risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance (DC 14) that activating the rune causes you, the user, to take 5 necrotic damage. This effect can only occur once per long rest.

teyvat_item_forbidden_rune.levelRequirementReason: The rune's unpredictable nature and potential for self-harm make it dangerous even for lower-level characters.
teyvat_item_forbidden_rune.vendorReason: The Shadow Market specializes in forbidden and dangerous items, making the Rune of Unmaking - Minor a fitting addition to their catalog.
teyvat_item_forbidden_rune.shippingDetail: Shipping via Nightmare Delivery can take up to two days due to the rune's unstable nature. The package arrives under heavy security measures.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends once it is resolved or interrupted by an action.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per short rest

teyvat_item_forbidden_rune.priceReason: The rune's unpredictable nature and the risk of self-harm justify its moderate price.

pokemon_item_league_badge_of_valor.name: Badge of Valor – Trainer’s Pride
pokemon_item_league_badge_of_valor.description: The Badge of Valor – Trainer’s Pride is a gleaming, intricately engraved medal forged by the Elite Four themselves. Its surface shimmers with an ever-present, subtle glow that not only bolsters your confidence but also subtly enhances your physical form, making you feel as though you could conquer any challenge. Legend has it that those who wear this badge are imbued with a spirit of resilience and unparalleled skill, ready to face the most formidable battles.

effectDetails.title: Confidence Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you wear this badge, it grants you a +1 bonus to your Charisma (Persuasion) checks and a +2 bonus to your attack rolls for the duration of any battle. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after the battle ends.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Physical Presence
effectDetails.rules: The badge provides you with a +1 bonus to your Strength saving throws and a +2 bonus to your AC as long as it is worn. However, this effect only applies in combat situations and ceases once the battle ends.

pokemon_item_league_badge_of_valor.levelRequirementReason: This badge is designed for all trainers who seek to bolster their confidence and physical prowess.
pokemon_item_league_badge_of_valor.vendorReason: The league store carries this item as it is a symbol of achievement and a source of inspiration for young and experienced trainers alike.
pokemon_item_league_badge_of_valor.shippingDetail: Shipped via the reliable delivery drones, ensuring swift delivery to your doorstep within three days.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon wearing the badge in combat.
usage.duration: Lasts until the start of your next turn after the battle ends or until it is removed from your person.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you cease to wear the badge during a battle, or at the start of your next turn after a battle concludes.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the badge can be worn indefinitely.

pokemon_item_league_badge_of_valor.priceReason: The Badge of Valor is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the unique benefits it provides, making it a valuable addition for any trainer's arsenal.

pokemon_item_pokemart_trainer_pack.name: Trainer’s Starter Pack – Gotta Catch ‘Em All!
pokemon_item_pokemart_trainer_pack.description: The Trainer’s Starter Pack – Gotta Catch ‘Em All! is a meticulously curated kit for any aspiring Pokémon trainer. This deluxe pack includes a top-tier Pokéball crafted from enchanted metal, ensuring your catch is secure. Alongside it are three rejuvenating potions that can restore up to 50 hit points each and a motivational poster with an ancient symbol believed to boost one’s resolve in the wilds of Kanto.
effects: Provides a +2 bonus to all Dexterity (Stealth) checks made within the next hour

effectDetails.title: Healing Potion
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this potion restores 15 hit points to the drinker. It has no effect on creatures with 0 or fewer hit points and can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after opening the pack, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect is cumulative if you already have proficiency in Stealth.

pokemon_item_pokemart_trainer_pack.levelRequirementReason: This starter kit is designed for beginners and thus has no level requirement.
pokemon_item_pokemart_trainer_pack.vendorReason: Pokemarts are the go-to suppliers for all things Pokémon, from novice trainers to veterans, ensuring every aspiring trainer starts with the best gear.
pokemon_item_pokemart_trainer_pack.shippingDetail: The delivery is made by speedy and reliable Pony Delivery Service, ensuring your pack arrives fresh at your feet.

usage.activation: Consumed as an action or used passively for its Stealth Boost effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous consumption restores hit points; one hour duration of Stealth Boost.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end once consumed or after the specified duration, whichever comes first.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be refilled at any pokemart.

pokemon_item_pokemart_trainer_pack.priceReason: Crafted with enchanted metal and potent healing ingredients, this pack offers a significant boost to a trainer’s early adventures, making it a valuable investment for any budding Pokémon explorer.

internet_data_weave_armguard.name: Hyperlink Armguard
internet_data_weave_armguard.description: The Hyperlink Armguard is a rare piece of cybernetic equipment crafted from compressed network packets. It feels warm to the touch, pulsing with data streams that hum faintly like distant internet traffic. This armguard significantly enhances your reflexes, granting a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Reaction Time), and offers a magical barrier that reduces damage from spells by half on successful saves against spell attacks. The armguard's unique weave also allows it to intercept and redirect minor digital disturbances with a 10% chance per round.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction to an attack. Lasts until the start of your next turn or until you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Magical Shield
effectDetails.rules: Reduces damage from spell attacks by half on a successful saving throw. This effect can only trigger once per long rest.

internet_data_weave_armguard.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the Hyperlink Armguard requires a minimum character level to properly harness its digital magic.
internet_data_weave_armguard.vendorReason: As a high-tech vendor, cyber_market frequently stocks items that enhance one's ability to navigate and defend against digital threats.
internet_data_weave_armguard.shippingDetail: Ships via drone within the city limits; delivery is instantaneous for in-city customers.

usage.duration: Until start of next turn or incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or until you take a short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

internet_data_weave_armguard.priceReason: The armguard's rarity and the advanced technology required to craft it justify its price of 1000 XP.

internet_viral_scroll.name: Propagation Scroll
internet_viral_scroll.description: The Propagation Scroll, a brittle parchment infused with the very essence of viral content, crackles with digital energy. Unfurling it unleashes a cascade of chaotic bytes that propagate through nearby foes, turning them into unwitting influencers of misinformation and disruption. The scroll is said to have originated from an ancient data dealer who sought to exploit the chaos of the internet for profit. When activated, it saps enemies' composure, causing them to spread panic and attract unwanted digital hordes.

effectDetails.title: Digital Chaos Propagation
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action within 30 feet, the Propagation Scroll unleashes a wave of chaotic bytes that deal 4d6 necrotic damage to all creatures in a 15-foot radius. These waves have a 50% chance to inflict the 'Digital Distraction' condition (target is incapacitated for 2 turns).

effectDetails.title: Viral Influence
effectDetails.rules: For every creature that successfully saves against Digital Chaos Propagation, there's a 30% chance they become infected with 'Viral Spread', causing them to spread misinformation within the battlefield for the duration. This condition lasts until the end of their next turn and imposes disadvantage on attack rolls.

internet_viral_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The scroll requires a minimum level to handle its digital energy safely.
internet_viral_scroll.vendorReason: Data Dealers are known for selling the most peculiar and potentially dangerous items, often acquired from various cyber heists.
internet_viral_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via encrypted package courier to ensure no digital traces can be detected by prying eyes.

usage.activation: Bonus action within 30 feet of enemies.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until the end of the next turn for each target affected.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if a creature with 'Digital Distraction' escapes its radius or all targets are incapacitated.

internet_viral_scroll.priceReason: The Propagation Scroll is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting the unique and potentially dangerous nature of its effects.

almost_edge_crumb_of_nothing.name: Crumb of Nothing
almost_edge_crumb_of_nothing.description: The Crumb of Nothing is a minuscule, crumbling fragment of the world's very essence, its edges worn smooth by the passage of time and fate’s indifference. It whispers faintly of regret and the tang of forgotten dreams, leaving aftertastes that linger like unresolved echoes in one’s mind. Consuming this crumb might grant you a fleeting glimpse into the infinite possibilities of the void, or it could leave you reeling with nausea, as if the world itself has turned against you for even daring to taste its nothingness.
effects: Grants +1 to Saving Throws for 3 turns

effectDetails.title: Regenerative Bite
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Crumb of Nothing grants you a regenerative bite that heals 10 hit points. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Void's Resilience
effectDetails.rules: For the next three turns, your saving throws are treated as if you had advantage on them. This effect persists for a total of three turns after consuming the crumb.

almost_edge_crumb_of_nothing.levelRequirementReason: This crumb is accessible to all adventurers who venture into the realms where such fragments exist, making it a common commodity among explorers and seekers.
almost_edge_crumb_of_nothing.vendorReason: The edge wanderers are known for their travels through the void, collecting and trading such relics as souvenirs of their journeys.
almost_edge_crumb_of_nothing.shippingDetail: Shipped via the ethereal winds that travel through the astral plane, ensuring quick delivery to eager collectors.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: After 3 turns or when consumed in combat

almost_edge_crumb_of_nothing.priceReason: The Crumb of Nothing is highly valued for its mystical properties, making it a significant investment for adventurers looking to bolster their survival chances.

almost_edge_chronal_shard.name: Chronal Shard of the Void's Tear
almost_edge_chronal_shard.description: The Chronal Shard of the Void's Tear hums with time-worn energy, its surface etched with arcane runes that shimmer and fade in eerie patterns. This fragment from the fabric of reality grants a fleeting reprieve from failure, rewinding one failed action but at the cost of disrupting your temporal balance. Should you hold it too long, the very threads of existence unravel around you, leaving behind a trail of temporal distortion like a comet's tail.

effectDetails.title: Rewind One Failed Action
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the shard to rewind one failed attack roll or skill check. This effect is usable once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Unraveling
effectDetails.rules: If you hold the shard for more than 1 minute, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose all your temporary hit points and be affected by the temporal distortion until dawn of the next day.

almost_edge_chronal_shard.levelRequirementReason: It requires a balance between spellcasting proficiency and understanding of time magic to properly wield this shard.
almost_edge_chronal_shard.vendorReason: The Void Merchant deals in relics from alternate realities, making the Chronal Shard a fitting addition to their stock.
almost_edge_chronal_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Rift Express with a 24-hour transit time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Rewind One Failed Action; until dawn of the next day, or until lost if held longer than 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you succeed on a saving throw, lose all temporary hit points, or hold it too long.

almost_edge_chronal_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and limited utility justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

almost_edge_legendary_phantom_lantern.name: Phantom Lantern of the Lost Lights
almost_edge_legendary_phantom_lantern.description: The Phantom Lantern of the Lost Lights glows with an eerie, spectral light that seems to flicker between realms. Its soft pulse is said to draw in the whispers of forgotten souls from a bygone era, yet its light offers both protection and peril. In the presence of spectral entities, it can either shield you from fear or lead you into a labyrinthine dream where ancient tales unfold, their very essence compelling you closer.

effectDetails.title: Fearsome Foe Repeller
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the lantern emits a blinding pulse that grants immunity to fear effects for 1 minute. This effect ends if you willingly deactivate it or are exposed to another source of fear.

effectDetails.title: Guiding Light
effectDetails.rules: The lantern occasionally summons a minor spectral guide (60% chance) within 30 feet that provides vague but insightful advice. The spectral guide remains for 1 minute and can be dismissed as an action; it disappears if the lantern is extinguished or destroyed.

almost_edge_legendary_phantom_lantern.levelRequirementReason: The intricate enchantments of the Phantom Lantern require a mage with significant experience to wield its power.
almost_edge_legendary_phantom_lantern.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in rare and ancient artifacts, including items that bridge the gap between worlds.
almost_edge_legendary_phantom_lantern.shippingDetail: The lantern is carefully packed for safe transport by Echoing Current, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Activates as an action, with a range of self and a duration of 1 minute.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next turn or if you willingly deactivate it.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after 1 minute, destroyed, or if you become exposed to another source of fear.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; recharges on a long rest.

almost_edge_legendary_phantom_lantern.priceReason: The lantern's rarity and the complexity of its enchantments justify this price in XP.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glooping_boots.name: Glooping Boots of Sticky Traction
mushroom_kingdom_item_glooping_boots.description: The Glooping Boots of Sticky Traction are crafted from hardened mushroom goo, making them as slippery to handle as they are effective in preventing slips. These oversized footwear transform your gait into a dance of controlled chaos; each step is a delicate balance between gravity and the goo's adhesive properties. You'll find yourself gliding over wet surfaces like a Piranha Plant on a joyride, but be wary—every movement can trigger a sudden splash that splatters around you.

effectDetails.title: Increased Jump Height
effectDetails.rules: When you jump, your vertical jump height is increased by +2 feet. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Landing
effectDetails.rules: If you land in a space that includes water or mud, you immediately become stuck and must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw to escape. On a failed save, you are restrained for 1 minute.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glooping_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots require a minimum level of 6 due to their complex construction and the need for coordination to use them effectively.
mushroom_kingdom_item_glooping_boots.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market is well-known for its unique and functional items, making these boots a perfect fit for their offerings.
mushroom_kingdom_item_glooping_boots.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Mushroom Cart, which ensures that your boots arrive in one piece, despite any splashes along the way.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation on landing; recharges after a short rest.
usage.duration: One minute per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you make another jump or fall, or if you are no longer in water/mud.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glooping_boots.priceReason: The boots' unique construction and the materials used to create them justify a price of 1000 XP.

mushroom_kingdom_item_potion_of_giantnes.name: Potion of Temporary Gigantism
mushroom_kingdom_item_potion_of_giantnes.description: The Potion of Temporary Gigantism is a bubbling, purple elixir that transforms you into a colossal mushroom, towering over your surroundings. Your newfound height grants you a damage bonus against foes and allows you to stomp with crushing force, but beware—your movements are now heavily slowed, making quick escapes difficult. This potion's effects last only until the end of your next turn, leaving you vulnerable after its duration.

effectDetails.title: Increased Size
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to Strength and Constitution checks and saving throws. Your size increases, allowing you to deal an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage on melee weapon attacks made during your turn. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Slowed Movement
effectDetails.rules: Your speed is halved while under the effects of this potion, and you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and saving throws. You are also considered difficult terrain for yourself during this time.

mushroom_kingdom_item_potion_of_giantnes.levelRequirementReason: This potion's transformative power requires a strong magical foundation to safely wield.
mushroom_kingdom_item_potion_of_giantnes.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop specializes in potions and elixirs that enhance one’s abilities, making this potion an ideal addition to their offerings.
mushroom_kingdom_item_potion_of_giantnes.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a mushroom drone, ensuring the potion remains potent upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 minute, or until you finish a short rest.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn after drinking it.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges on completion of a long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_item_potion_of_giantnes.priceReason: The potion's rarity and powerful effects justify its high price, making it a valuable but not overpowered asset for adventurers.

faerun_item_potion_of_froggy_fortitude.name: Potion of Froggy Fortitude
faerun_item_potion_of_froggy_fortitude.description: Brewed by a surprisingly enthusiastic swamp witch, this murky potion tastes vaguely of pond scum and desperation. The concoction is known to be potent when mixed in a specially crafted cauldron found only in the deepest parts of the Evermoors. Drink it quickly – it’ll temporarily boost your resilience… mostly to being splashed with mud, but also providing an unexpected burst of strength that allows you to leap over obstacles with ease for a short time.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon drinking, the drinker gains +2 to Strength (Strength check and saving throws) for 10 minutes. This effect is instantaneous upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Mud Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 1 round after drinking this potion, you have resistance to poison damage. The effect ends when the drinker takes any other form of damage.

faerun_item_potion_of_froggy_fortitude.levelRequirementReason: The concoction is designed for adventurers just starting their journey.
faerun_item_potion_of_froggy_fortitude.vendorReason: The market often deals in items from various locales, including the swamp witch's creations.
faerun_item_potion_of_froggy_fortitude.shippingDetail: Shipped by a swift winged courier to ensure freshness.

usage.duration: 10 minutes or until you take any other form of damage.
usage.endsWhen: You take other forms of damage or the duration expires.

faerun_item_potion_of_froggy_fortitude.priceReason: The potion's rarity and the unique cauldron used in its creation justify this price.

faerun_item_helm_of_the_stone_giant.name: Helm of the Stone Giant
faerun_item_helm_of_the_stone_giant.description: The Helm of the Stone Giant is a ponderous helm, its surface pockmarked with imprints of jagged pebbles and smoothed by ancient hands. Crafted in the shadowy forges of distant stone giants, it feels as though it has absorbed the very weight of the earth itself. This helm not only grants resistance to bludgeoning damage but also permanently increases your maximum hit points by 2d8, making you a more formidable presence on the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Bludgeoning Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this helm, you have resistance to bludgeoning damage. This effect is active as long as the helm remains on your head.

effectDetails.title: Increased Maximum Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: This helm permanently increases your maximum hit points by 2d8 when worn continuously for at least one day. The increase does not stack with other effects that grant similar bonuses.

faerun_item_helm_of_the_stone_giant.levelRequirementReason: The Helm of the Stone Giant is designed to provide a significant defensive advantage, making it suitable for characters who have reached a certain level where they can better utilize its benefits.
faerun_item_helm_of_the_stone_giant.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar, known for its extensive stock of rare and powerful items, offers the Helm of the Stone Giant to adventurers seeking to enhance their resilience in battle.
faerun_item_helm_of_the_stone_giant.shippingDetail: The helm is shipped via Emissaries of Stone, who ensure that this heavy item arrives safely at its destination, often requiring multiple trips due to its weight.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the helm and remains active as long as it is worn continuously.
usage.duration: Permanent increase in maximum hit points; resistance to bludgeoning damage while wearing the helm.
usage.endsWhen: The helm is removed or destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the effects are passive.

faerun_item_helm_of_the_stone_giant.priceReason: This helm offers a significant defensive advantage at an appropriate price point, balancing its substantial weight and the permanent nature of its effects.

middle_earth_dwarven_pickaxe.name: Stonebreaker’s Stubborn Strike
middle_earth_dwarven_pickaxe.description: Forged in the ancient forges of Khazad-dûm, Stonebreaker’s Stubborn Strike is a dwarven pickaxe that has weathered countless ages and relentless pounding by stone giants. This battle-worn tool not only grants its wielder increased mining speed (+15%) but also has a unique ability to enhance durability; it can repair itself after being damaged in combat, reducing the damage taken by 2 until the start of your next turn. The pickaxe is said to have been crafted under the supervision of the legendary blacksmith Mithril Ironbeard himself, and its origins make it a treasured heirloom among dwarven clans.

effectDetails.title: Increased Mining Speed
effectDetails.rules: While wielding Stonebreaker’s Stubborn Strike, you have advantage on mining checks and can mine at a rate that is +15% faster than usual. This effect lasts for the duration of your activity.

effectDetails.title: Self-Repair on Combat Damage
effectDetails.rules: After taking damage from an attack in combat, Stonebreaker’s Stubborn Strike repairs itself, reducing the amount of damage taken by 2 until the start of your next turn. This effect can occur a number of times equal to half your level (rounded down) before it stops working for the day.

middle_earth_dwarven_pickaxe.levelRequirementReason: This pickaxe is crafted to be accessible even to lower-level adventurers who wish to venture into the depths of ancient mines.
middle_earth_dwarven_pickaxe.vendorReason: The dwarven forge is known for its unparalleled craftsmanship and has long been trusted by miners and explorers seeking durable tools.
middle_earth_dwarven_pickaxe.shippingDetail: Ships via the fastest giant eagle courier service, ensuring swift delivery to even the most remote locations.

usage.activation: Active while wielding the pickaxe in mining or combat situations.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for self-repair; duration of activity for increased speed.
usage.endsWhen: After repairs are complete or when the day ends, whichever comes first.

middle_earth_dwarven_pickaxe.priceReason: This pickaxe's rarity and unique self-repair feature make it a valuable asset for adventurers seeking both durability and efficiency.

middle_earth_elven_dreamstone.name: Whispers of the Old Forest
middle_earth_elven_dreamstone.description: The Whispers of the Old Forest is a pulsating, iridescent stone that hums with ancient Elvish magic. Crafted in the deep woods by the Noldor elves, it holds fragments of forgotten dreams and secrets from ages past. Touching it can grant fleeting visions that either empower or bewilder the toucher, depending on the whims of fate. Wario warns: use it wisely, for its power is as unpredictable as it is potent.

effectDetails.title: Dream Whispers
effectDetails.rules: When touched, the stone has a 15% chance to induce a dream state lasting for 1 minute. During this time, the user gains temporary stat boosts or debuffs based on the stone's mood (e.g., Wisdom +2 but Charisma -1). The duration can be ended early via a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Magics
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains an increased magical resistance, providing a +8% chance to resist magical effects. This effect is active as long as the stone is held and can be negated by using it for divination (one use per day).

middle_earth_elven_dreamstone.levelRequirementReason: The ancient magic within the stone requires a seasoned elf-warrior's touch to safely wield.
middle_earth_elven_dreamstone.vendorReason: Only the trusted keepers of Elvish lore can handle such potent relics without unleashing their full power.
middle_earth_elven_dreamstone.shippingDetail: The stone is delivered by shadowfax, ensuring safe passage through treacherous lands.

usage.activation: Touching the stone to invoke its effects
usage.duration: 1 minute or until a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw ends it
usage.endsWhen: A successful save or when used for divination

middle_earth_elven_dreamstone.priceReason: The stone's rarity and the ancient magic it contains justify its high price.

the_edge_chronos_amulet.name: Temporal Distortion Amulet
the_edge_chronos_amulet.description: The Temporal Distortion Amulet, a gleaming necklace etched with swirling chronal runes, is said to have been crafted by an ancient time-walker who sought to bend the fabric of reality itself. This mythic piece allows its wearer to manipulate the flow of time in combat, slowing foes and speeding their own movements, yet it comes with a warning: tampering too deeply risks unraveling the very threads of causality. Rumors tell that Wario's temper is legendary, but those who challenge fate might find their last action repeated until corrected.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Slow
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a reaction to an enemy's attack, this amulet slows the target by 50% for 2 rounds. The effect has no save DC and cannot be used more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Swift Steps
effectDetails.rules: Activating this amulet as a bonus action allows the wearer to increase their movement speed by 20%, which lasts until the start of their next turn. This effect can only be used once every short or long rest, and it does not stack with other bonuses.

the_edge_chronos_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet's power is too great for less experienced adventurers to wield safely.
the_edge_chronos_amulet.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in the latest and rarest artifacts, including those with time-based capabilities.
the_edge_chronos_amulet.shippingDetail: Due to the delicate nature of the amulet's chronal energy, it is shipped via Temporal Courier for safe handling.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration varies by specific use
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect period expires or the wearer takes a short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once every long rest

the_edge_chronos_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's mythic rarity and its powerful time-manipulating effects justify this price.

the_edge_blacksmith_contract.name: Permanent Weapon Enhancement
the_edge_blacksmith_contract.description: The Edge Blacksmith Contract is a meticulously crafted agreement that allows you to permanently enhance a weapon with blacksmithing prowess. This contract ensures your chosen blade becomes an unparalleled tool of precision and might, granting +3 to weapon damage rolls and a 10% chance to inflict bleeding on each hit. The results are not for the faint-hearted—Wario's unpredictable touch means you could end up with a weapon that defies logic itself.

effectDetails.title: Increased Damage
effectDetails.rules: When the weapon strikes, it deals an additional +3 damage to the target. This effect is instant and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Bleeding on Hit
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that each hit will cause the target to bleed, dealing 1d4 necrotic damage at the start of their next turn. This effect persists for one minute and cannot occur more than once per combat.

the_edge_blacksmith_contract.levelRequirementReason: This service requires a certain level of expertise to ensure the weapon is enhanced without compromising its integrity.
the_edge_blacksmith_contract.vendorReason: Final Shop specializes in unique and powerful services, making it the go-to for such specialized enhancements.
the_edge_blacksmith_contract.shippingDetail: The winged courier delivers this service with utmost care, ensuring swift and secure delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon signing the contract and completing the enhancement process.
usage.duration: Permanent once the weapon is enhanced.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the weapon is destroyed or the contract is broken.

the_edge_blacksmith_contract.priceReason: This price reflects the unique and permanent nature of the service, requiring a significant investment in resources and expertise.

forbidden_soulshard.name: Shard of the Twisted Soul
forbidden_soulshard.description: The Shard of the Twisted Soul, a gnarled fragment that pulses with malevolent energy, is said to have been torn from the very essence of a noble once consumed by dark magic. Holding this shard grants glimpses into forbidden knowledge and whispers promises of power—but beware, for it slowly turns its bearer to ash. This tiny piece of madness, forged in the fires of chaos, is no ordinary trinket.

effectDetails.title: Madness
effectDetails.rules: Each day you gain a cumulative +1 penalty to Wisdom saving throws. This effect increases by +2 at the end of each week this item is used, up to +5 after one month.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Step
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity (Stealth) check for this effect to function without triggering opportunity attacks.

forbidden_soulshard.levelRequirementReason: The Shard of the Twisted Soul requires a minimum level of 5 due to its unpredictable and dangerous effects.
forbidden_soulshard.vendorReason: The chaos dealer, a notorious merchant of forbidden knowledge and dark artifacts, is known for dealing with items that push the boundaries of sanity and power.
forbidden_soulshard.shippingDetail: The delivery takes three days but involves crossing dangerous territories where the item may be exposed to environmental hazards.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use, once per long rest via shadow step effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for each teleportation; madness increases over time.
usage.endsWhen: The madness effect ends when you no longer hold the shard or it is destroyed.

forbidden_soulshard.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity, dark nature, and the risk involved in using such an item.

warhammer_rune_of_decay.name: Rune of Rotting Valor
warhammer_rune_of_decay.description: The Rune of Rotting Valor is a warhammer forged from the bones of fallen warriors. Its surface is etched with runes that hum with dark energy, drawing sustenance from your enemies' vitality. Each strike not only deals physical damage but also saps strength, leaving foes weakened and vulnerable to further attacks. The hammer's touch is like walking through a misty forest—slow and oppressive, making each step feel heavier.

effectDetails.title: Rending Decay
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with this weapon as part of an attack action, the target must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take an additional 4d6 necrotic damage. This effect has a recharge after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Weakness
effectDetails.rules: Each time you hit with this weapon, there is a 20% chance that the target becomes prone and its Strength score is reduced by 2 until the start of your next turn. This effect has no save DC but can only occur once per target per long rest.

warhammer_rune_of_decay.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires a moderate understanding of combat tactics to use effectively, balancing its dark magic with strategic strikes.
warhammer_rune_of_decay.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in crafting powerful yet balanced weapons that serve as both tools and symbols of triumph.
warhammer_rune_of_decay.shippingDetail: Ships via Wartime Express, known for their reliable delivery services even under the harshest conditions.

usage.activation: As part of an attack action
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Recharges after a long rest or when destroyed

warhammer_rune_of_decay.priceReason: The weapon's balance between necrotic damage and debuff effects, along with its unique crafting process by Fate Forge, justifies the high price.

pokemon_item_ancient_charm.name: Charm of the Primal Beast
pokemon_item_ancient_charm.description: The Charm of the Primal Beast glows an eerie, primal red when worn, its surface warm to the touch and pulsating with raw energy that mimics the roars of legendary Pokémon. This ancient charm grants a temporary boost in your battle prowess, making you appear nearly invincible to any trainer who dares challenge you. For three turns, it enhances both attack and defense, making you a formidable opponent on the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Attack Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this charm grants +30 to your attack rolls for three turns. The effect ends if you are incapacitated or the charm is removed.

effectDetails.title: Defense Boost
effectDetails.rules: Simultaneously, it provides +20 temporary hit points and advantage on saving throws against being frightened until the start of your next turn after activation. This effect lasts for three turns and ends if you take damage or are incapacitated.

pokemon_item_ancient_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm's primal energy is too powerful to be used by lower-level characters, who might not fully understand its potential.
pokemon_item_ancient_charm.vendorReason: The pokemart, with its vast collection of Pokémon-themed items and knowledge, is the ideal vendor for this ancient relic that taps into the essence of legendary beasts.
pokemon_item_ancient_charm.shippingDetail: Ships within three business days via Pokémail Express's fastest courier service.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and gain effects.
usage.duration: 3 turns for each effect.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends if you are incapacitated or the charm is removed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

pokemon_item_ancient_charm.priceReason: This charm's rarity and potent effects justify its fair value of 1000 XP, ensuring it remains a valuable but not overpowered item for players to acquire.

pokemon_item_league_badge.name: Badge of Valor
pokemon_item_league_badge.description: The Badge of Valor, officially sanctioned by the Pokémon League, gleams with a subtle, strategic light. Crafted from polished steel and inlaid with emblems of legendary Pokémon, it subtly enhances your strategic thinking during battles. Should you achieve victory, this badge grants a +10 speed boost for one turn, making you the fastest to react. Moreover, there's a 20% chance that on a critical hit, your opponent will be stunned, giving you an edge in decisive moments.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action when the wearer wins a battle. Grants +10 speed for one turn, allowing you to act first in your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Stun Opponent
effectDetails.rules: Has a 20% chance of stunning an opponent on a critical hit during a battle. The effect lasts until the end of the opponent's next turn.

pokemon_item_league_badge.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 4 to ensure that players have basic combat skills before using this strategic advantage.
pokemon_item_league_badge.vendorReason: The Pokémon League ensures that only those who have earned the right wear this badge of valor.
pokemon_item_league_badge.shippingDetail: Courier Pigeon delivers the badge swiftly, ensuring it arrives fresh from the League headquarters.

usage.activation: Bonus action upon winning a battle.
usage.duration: One turn (speed boost) and until the end of the opponent's next turn (stun effect).
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire at the end of the turn or when the wearer is knocked out of combat.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one set of effects can be active per battle.

pokemon_item_league_badge.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its strategic value and limited utility within battles.

pokemon_item_mystic_orb.name: Orb of Echoing Energies
pokemon_item_mystic_orb.description: The Orb of Echoing Energies is a shimmering, multifaceted gem that pulses with the energy of countless Pokémon battles. When activated, it channels one such battle’s signature move, delivering it with surprising intensity and unpredictability – just like catching an elusive Pokémon. The orb’s unpredictable nature can lead to both devastating attacks and hilarious misfires, making it a favorite among those who seek to test their mettle in unconventional ways.

effectDetails.title: Mimic a Pokémon Move
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the orb to mimic one of your recent Pokémon encounters. The attack is based on that encounter and has a +25 bonus to damage rolls for this turn only. There’s a 20% chance that the attack will be misfired in a humorous way.

effectDetails.title: Unpredictable Outcomes
effectDetails.rules: The orb has a 10% chance of causing a misfire, which could result in a laughable outcome. If this occurs, you must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be incapacitated due to laughter for 1 minute.

pokemon_item_mystic_orb.levelRequirementReason: Requires the user to have at least basic knowledge of Pokémon moves and strategies.
pokemon_item_mystic_orb.vendorReason: The Safari Shop specializes in rare and exotic items that can enhance one’s Pokémon journey, including this whimsical relic from the wilds.
pokemon_item_mystic_orb.shippingDetail: Ships via air courier for expedited delivery to your doorstep within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (1 turn)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends on the start of your next turn or when you use it again.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one mimic per encounter

pokemon_item_mystic_orb.priceReason: Balanced at an epic rarity for its unpredictable nature and unique gameplay mechanic.

almost_edge_item_chronometric_shards.name: Temporal Fragments of the Void
almost_edge_item_chronometric_shards.description: Temporal Fragments of the Void are shimmering, iridescent shards that hum with the echoes of non-existent futures and pasts. These fragments allow you to glimpse fleeting visions of potential outcomes, aiding in dodging danger or simply contemplating the infinite possibilities of time. Each shard is a fragment from another timeline, forged in the void between realities. They are sold by the enigmatic Void Merchant, whose knowledge of the temporal planes rivals only the gods themselves.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse Possible Futures
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you may activate one fragment to gain temporary foresight. This allows you to see a potential future outcome within the next round of combat or a scene. The vision lasts for 1 minute and grants advantage on saving throws against harm until it ends.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Illusion
effectDetails.rules: Each fragment has a 20% chance per day to create an illusory version of itself when you activate its power, which lasts for 1 hour. The illusion can be mistaken as the original fragment and can mislead others within 30 feet.

almost_edge_item_chronometric_shards.levelRequirementReason: The temporal nature of these fragments requires a level of proficiency in understanding complex timelines.
almost_edge_item_chronometric_shards.vendorReason: The Void Merchant has exclusive access to items from other dimensions, including these rare Temporal Fragments.
almost_edge_item_chronometric_shards.shippingDetail: Ships directly through the dimensional rift, arriving within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate one fragment.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until dispelled by an effect ending foresight.
usage.endsWhen: The vision ends when you lose consciousness or are incapacitated. The illusion ends if the fragment is destroyed or when its power runs out for the day.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each fragment can only be used once per day.

almost_edge_item_chronometric_shards.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect their rare and temporal nature.

almost_edge_item_wario_boots_of_slip.name: Wario's Boots of Unstable Traction
almost_edge_item_wario_boots_of_slip.description: Wario's Boots of Unstable Traction are absurdly oversized, crafted from a mix of rubber and an unknown metal alloy that glows faintly underfoot. These boots allow you to slide across any surface with alarming speed, but their unstable design often results in unexpected missteps—once even sending a traveler halfway into a nearby wall or stuck in a particularly sticky puddle. The wearer must be cautious not to overextend themselves lest they find themselves in an unintended location.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed (20%)
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can activate their boots to gain a +20 foot movement speed bonus for up to 1 minute. This effect ends if the wearer moves more than 60 feet in a straight line or falls prone.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Slide
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer can activate their boots to slide across any flat surface at double speed for up to 10 feet. There is a 30% chance that this movement will result in an unintended location, such as halfway into a wall or stuck in a sticky puddle. The boots then deactivate until the start of the next long rest.

almost_edge_item_wario_boots_of_slip.levelRequirementReason: Crafted by Wario himself, these boots require a certain level of physical and magical aptitude to wield.
almost_edge_item_wario_boots_of_slip.vendorReason: Edge Wanderer specializes in items that enhance mobility and adventure, making their stock the perfect fit for adventurers seeking an edge on their travels.
almost_edge_item_wario_boots_of_slip.shippingDetail: Ships via dimensional rift express courier; delivery is instantaneous but requires a special permit from the Dimensional Oversight Committee.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Increased Movement Speed, up to 10 feet for Unstable Slide
usage.endsWhen: Ends if wearer moves more than 60 feet in a straight line, falls prone, or rests; Unstable Slide ends after the intended distance.

almost_edge_item_wario_boots_of_slip.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, these boots offer unique speed and misadventure mechanics that are both fun and challenging.

almost_edge_item_obsidian_mirror_of_refl.name: The Echoing Void Gaze
almost_edge_item_obsidian_mirror_of_refl.description: The Echoing Void Gaze is a polished obsidian mirror, etched with ancient runes that whisper secrets of the past and future. Its surface glimmers with an eerie luminescence that seems to reflect not just your form but also the very essence of your soul. Staring into its depths can reveal hidden truths or unsettling visions of your own fractured psyche. This artifact is said to have been crafted by a forgotten mage seeking to unlock the secrets of existence itself, and it remains in the hands of the Liminal Trader, who sells only what defies ordinary understanding.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Secrets
effectDetails.rules: When gazed into for a full round (1 minute), this mirror has a 50% chance to reveal hidden objects or secret doors within 30 feet. The user must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw; on a failure, they instead see their own reflection with no additional information.

effectDetails.title: Shadowy Doppelganger
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the mirror has a 1% chance to summon a shadowy doppelganger that mimics the user's appearance for 8 hours. The doppelganger is a construct with AC 15 and 20 hit points. It can take actions but cannot speak or cast spells.

almost_edge_item_obsidian_mirror_of_refl.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant mental discipline to control its effects without being overwhelmed by the visions it reveals.
almost_edge_item_obsidian_mirror_of_refl.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader is known for their vast collection of enigmatic and powerful artifacts, often passed down through ancient lines or found in forgotten ruins.
almost_edge_item_obsidian_mirror_of_refl.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional rift, which can cause up to a week delay due to the unstable nature of the transit.

usage.activation: Passive effect active when gazed into for at least one minute. The doppelganger summoning is a once-per-long-rest action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous reveal; lasts until next long rest after summoning the doppelganger.
usage.endsWhen: The user's next long rest, or if the doppelganger is destroyed.

almost_edge_item_obsidian_mirror_of_refl.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers powerful but potentially dangerous effects that can reveal secrets and summon creatures.

middle_earth_goblin_grenade.name: Snotty Surprise Grenade
middle_earth_goblin_grenade.description: The Snotty Surprise Grenade is a particularly revolting concoction brewed by goblins with an especially foul temper. When thrown, it doesn’t explode; instead, it releases a thick, noxious cloud of sticky slime that clings to any target within reach, reducing their movement speed by half and causing them to slip and slide in the perilous lands of Middle-earth. Anyone who inhales or comes into contact with this malodorous mist must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for one round, struggling with nausea that halts their actions until the poison wears off.

effectDetails.title: Sludge
effectDetails.rules: When a creature is affected by the Sludge, its movement speed is reduced to half. The effect lasts until the start of the creature's next turn after being exposed.

effectDetails.title: Poisoned
effectDetails.rules: A creature that fails its Constitution saving throw against the Poison is incapacitated for 1 round and cannot take actions or reactions, including moving.

middle_earth_goblin_grenade.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level of 3 to ensure players can manage the effects and timing effectively.
middle_earth_goblin_grenade.vendorReason: The Shire Shop stocks this item because it's a popular choice among travelers looking for unconventional defense tools.
middle_earth_goblin_grenade.shippingDetail: Shipped via pony cart, which ensures the grenade arrives in one piece and with its noxious contents intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until start of next turn for each target
usage.endsWhen: The poison effect ends when the creature successfully saves or is incapacitated
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

middle_earth_goblin_grenade.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity and the materials used in its creation, balancing its effectiveness with player accessibility.

middle_earth_rune_amulet.name: Amulet of Slightly Disgruntled Dwarven Craftsmanship
middle_earth_rune_amulet.description: The Amulet of Slightly Disgruntled Dwarven Craftsmanship is a heavy, hand-forged amulet that radiates an aura of stubborn resolve. Carved from the very stone of Moria itself, this relic bears the marks of countless dwarven forges and a dwarf’s unyielding spirit. Worn by those who dare to face their deepest fears, it grants a slight resistance against fear and intimidation, as if the amulet's very essence is made of the stubbornness of its maker.
effects: +2 to saving throws against fear and intimidation

effectDetails.title: Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +2 bonus to saving throws against the effects of fear and intimidation. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Wearing this amulet provides resistance to psychic damage, allowing the wearer to shrug off spells or attacks that target their mind. The bonus applies until the start of your next turn after the effect is triggered.

middle_earth_rune_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet's craftsmanship is rudimentary but still valuable for its resistance properties.
middle_earth_rune_amulet.vendorReason: The dwarven craftsmen of Moria are known for their resilience and this amulet reflects that spirit.
middle_earth_rune_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped by a dwarf carrier, the amulet arrives with a small stone figurine as a token of gratitude from the dwarves who forged it.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn after triggering
usage.endsWhen: Effect is triggered and ends at start of wearer's next turn

middle_earth_rune_amulet.priceReason: The amulet’s price reflects its limited origin and the stubborn craftsmanship that imbues it with unique properties.

middle_earth_elven_healing_potion.name: Whispering Dewdrop Potion
middle_earth_elven_healing_potion.description: Whispering Dewdrop Potion, a shimmering elixir collected from the tears of melancholic elves within the ancient forests of Middle-earth, is distilled with the essence of time and nature's magic. This potion not only restores 2d6 + 2 hit points but also alleviates one level of exhaustion, offering a brief respite from the trials of adventuring life. The potion's mystical properties are said to evoke fleeting nostalgia for those who imbibe it, leaving them with a wistful yet rejuvenated spirit.
