almost_edge_void_shard_of_reflection.vendorReason: The Void Merchant specializes in exotic artifacts from the multiverse, including fragments that offer glimpses into other dimensions.
almost_edge_void_shard_of_reflection.shippingDetail: Due to its unstable nature, the shard must be delivered via the Dimensional Rift Courier service only. Delivery takes 1d4 days due to the instability of the cargo.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until discarded or thrown
usage.endsWhen: Thrown, discarded, or lost

almost_edge_void_shard_of_reflection.priceReason: The shard's mystical properties and rarity justify its modest price point in the context of the campaign.

almost_edge_fractured_echo_token.name: Fractured Echo Token
almost_edge_fractured_echo_token.description: The Fractured Echo Token is a tarnished silver bell, its once-pure surface now marred by cracks and dents that echo the fates of those who've met their end on the edge. It hums softly when held, releasing fragmented memories and whispers of lost souls. This token grants you advantage on investigation checks related to the void and provides minor protection against madness effects, helping you resist the creeping taint of forgotten horrors.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Investigation Checks
effectDetails.rules: When you use this token to aid in an investigation related to the void, you gain advantage on the check. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Minor Protection Against Madness
effectDetails.rules: While holding this token, you have resistance against madness effects. It provides a +2 bonus to saving throws made to resist such effects, but it can only be used once per short or long rest.

almost_edge_fractured_echo_token.levelRequirementReason: The token's ability to provide advantage and minor protection is accessible to any adventurer, making it a valuable tool for all levels.
almost_edge_fractured_echo_token.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in relics that bridge the gap between worlds, and this token perfectly fits their inventory.
almost_edge_fractured_echo_token.shippingDetail: Due to its delicate nature, the Fractured Echo Token is shipped via Lost Signal Express with special handling to ensure it arrives intact.

usage.duration: Until start of next turn or until used in a rest
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next short or long rest

almost_edge_fractured_echo_token.priceReason: The token's balanced cost reflects its moderate benefits and utility for adventurers facing void-related challenges.

faction_fatebinder_scroll.name: Fatebinder’s Scroll of Discord
faction_fatebinder_scroll.description: Fatebinder’s Scroll of Discord is a tattered parchment inscribed with intricate sigils and ancient runes. It is said to have been found within the ruins of an old temple dedicated to chaos gods, its ink faded but still potent. When unrolled, it releases a cloud of chaotic energy that disrupts fate itself, causing enemies to falter and misfortune to befall them. However, its use may draw the attention of powerful entities seeking to claim this dangerous power for themselves.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Cloud
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the scroll releases a cloud that imposes disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws within a 10-foot radius for 1 minute. The cloud lasts until dispelled or the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Misfortune
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance (DC 16) that an enemy targeted by the scroll suffers from 'bad luck,' which reduces their attack rolls and saving throws by 4 for 3 turns. This effect ends if the target successfully saves.

faction_fatebinder_scroll.levelRequirementReason: Requires sufficient experience to handle such a volatile and powerful artifact.
faction_fatebinder_scroll.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in crafting and selling items that manipulate fate, making them the ideal vendor for this scroll.
faction_fatebinder_scroll.shippingDetail: Delivered via a magical portal, ensuring swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until dispelled
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the spell is dispelled by an effect like a counterspell.
usage.charges: Single-use; recharged after a long rest

faction_fatebinder_scroll.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its potent, but risky, effects.

curiosity_bone_totem.name: The Whispering Bone Totem
curiosity_bone_totem.description: The Whispering Bone Totem is a macabre relic forged from the bones of ancient warriors, each bone telling tales of valiant deeds or tragic failures. It hums faintly in your hand, whispering secrets of past battles and the occasional misadventure with Wario's cooking. Stare too long and it might confide in you—too late—you will find yourself compelled to recount its stories. This unsettling totem provides a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks and grants temporary inspiration on successful morale checks.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Inspiration
effectDetails.rules: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check, you can roll one additional d20 and use the higher result. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: On a successful morale check, gain temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier. This effect can be used once per day and is lost if you fall unconscious.

curiosity_bone_totem.levelRequirementReason: The totem's unsettling nature requires a minimum level of 1 for comfort and control.
curiosity_bone_totem.vendorReason: The chaos dealer thrives on the macabre and bizarre, making this unsettling yet useful relic an excellent addition to their wares.
curiosity_bone_totem.shippingDetail: Ships via standard mail service. Requires a week for delivery due to its fragile nature.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest, or until you fall unconscious.
usage.endsWhen: Lost if you fall unconscious or at the end of a long rest.

curiosity_bone_totem.priceReason: The totem's value lies in its unsettling yet functional effects, making it a worthwhile investment for those seeking an edge.

grand_country_berry_blast.name: Layered Berry Bomb
grand_country_berry_blast.description: The Layered Berry Bomb is a confectionary marvel, each segment meticulously crafted from various fruits and spices. When consumed, it releases a cascade of flavor, starting with a burst of zesty citrus that grants a quick strength boost, followed by a lingering wave of warmth and healing. The final layer enhances your speed, allowing you to outpace foes in the ensuing skirmish. Eat swiftly; the layers shift unpredictably within moments.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume as a bonus action to gain +2 to STR for 1 minute. This effect ends if you take damage or lose consciousness.

effectDetails.title: Minor Healing
effectDetails.rules: Receive +1 hit point at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, provided you are not incapacitated. This effect ends when you finish a short rest.

grand_country_berry_blast.levelRequirementReason: This confection is accessible to all adventurers who can afford its price.
grand_country_berry_blast.vendorReason: The Layer Market specializes in unique and potent consumables, making the Layered Berry Bomb a natural fit for their offerings.
grand_country_berry_blast.shippingDetail: Delivered via the rolling log courier service, known for its reliability and punctuality. Shipment typically arrives within two days of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute per effect
usage.endsWhen: On damage or losing consciousness; ends at the start of your turn if you finish a short rest

grand_country_berry_blast.priceReason: The Layered Berry Bomb is priced at 1000 XP due to its complex crafting process, unique ingredients, and the potent effects it provides.

grand_country_echoing_stone.name: Resonant Shard of Silence
grand_country_echoing_stone.description: The Resonant Shard of Silence hums ominously in your hand, its surface etched with arcane runes that glow faintly under moonlight. When thrown, it creates a zone of absolute silence within a 10-foot radius, disrupting all spellcasting and speech within the area for up to 3 rounds. The stone itself is said to have been crafted from the remnants of a forgotten temple dedicated to the goddess of silence.

effectDetails.title: Silence Zone
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, this shard creates an instantaneous 10-foot radius area of absolute silence within which all creatures are incapacitated for up to 3 rounds. The effect ends if a creature moves out of the zone or when the shard is destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Spell
effectDetails.rules: All spellcasting and speech within the affected area is disrupted, requiring a DC 15 Concentration save (or half the spell’s level) to continue casting. On failure, the spell fails immediately.

grand_country_echoing_stone.levelRequirementReason: The Resonant Shard of Silence requires at least 3rd level to master its power and control its effects.
grand_country_echoing_stone.vendorReason: Side Seller, known for their eclectic wares, carries the Resonant Shard due to its unique and powerful properties that enhance stealth operations in the night.
grand_country_echoing_stone.shippingDetail: Ships via giant snail, arriving within a week under normal conditions; expedited delivery available upon request for an additional fee.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (up to 3 rounds)
usage.endsWhen: A creature moves out of the zone or when destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a long rest

grand_country_echoing_stone.priceReason: The Resonant Shard is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare and powerful abilities.

grand_country_spiral_root.name: Warped Root of the Spiral Grove
grand_country_spiral_root.description: The Warped Root of the Spiral Grove is a pulsating, vine-like root harvested from a grove where gravity bends and twists. Its surface glows with an unstable energy that hints at dimensions beyond this world. Consuming it grants you fleeting glimpses into alternate realities, allowing you to phase through solid objects for 6 seconds but beware; too much exposure may lead to disorientation or worse, getting lost in the multiverse's folds!

effectDetails.title: Phase Through Walls
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can consume this root to phase through one wall or solid object for 6 seconds. While phased, you gain advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to break the barrier. This effect ends if you take damage, lose concentration, or spend another use.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Teleport
effectDetails.rules: There's a 10% chance that when you phase through an object, you are teleported up to 10 feet in any direction. This effect is instantaneous and has no save DC. You cannot teleport into solid objects or within 5 feet of another creature.

grand_country_spiral_root.levelRequirementReason: This root requires significant magical power to control its effects without losing one's balance.
grand_country_spiral_root.vendorReason: Layer Market specializes in rare and exotic goods that adventurers seek, including this unique product from the Spiral Grove.
grand_country_spiral_root.shippingDetail: The root is delivered by a Dimensional Worm Express, ensuring it arrives fresh and potent. However, due to its volatile nature, it must be kept refrigerated during transit.

usage.duration: 6 seconds or until the effect ends
usage.endsWhen: You take damage, lose concentration, or use another phased movement

grand_country_spiral_root.priceReason: Its rarity and the risk of disorientation make it a valuable yet balanced find for adventurers.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun_of_fortitu.name: Sticky Bun of Fortitude
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun_of_fortitu.description: The Sticky Bun of Fortitude, a suspiciously gooey pastry from the whimsical kitchens of LeClaire Isle, seems to hold an unnatural amount of fortitude. When bitten into, it grants temporary resistance to blunt force trauma, perfect for wrestling grumpy pastry sprites or dodging rogue icing projectiles. The sugary treat is known to leave you with increased stamina and a sticky encounter that lingers in the air, ensuring your next move is both powerful and slightly... less than clean.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Resistance to Blunt Damage
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Sticky Bun of Fortitude grants you temporary resistance to blunt damage for 1 minute. This effect requires no action and lasts until it ends early or you take any other kind of damage. There is a saving throw DC of 13 to negate this effect.

effectDetails.title: Increased Stamina
effectDetails.rules: After consuming the Sticky Bun, your movement speed increases by 10 feet for 1 hour. This effect does not stack with other similar effects and ends early if you take any damage from a source other than bludgeoning attacks.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun_of_fortitu.levelRequirementReason: The simplicity of the Sticky Bun's fortitude makes it accessible to all adventurers, regardless of level.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun_of_fortitu.vendorReason: Dough Depot is known for its innovative and magical pastries that cater to every adventurer's sweet tooth.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun_of_fortitu.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Swift Delivery Dune, ensuring your sticky treat arrives fresh from LeClaire Isle.

usage.activation: Instantaneous consumption as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take any other kind of damage.
usage.endsWhen: Early upon taking non-bludgeoning damage or at the end of your next long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited; each Sticky Bun is consumed once and cannot be recharged.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun_of_fortitu.priceReason: The rare ingredients used in its preparation, combined with the magical properties that enhance fortitude, make this treat a valuable but balanced purchase for adventurers of all stripes.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpting_se.name: Frosting Sculpting Session
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpting_se.description: Crafted in the heart of Pastry Palace, this Frosting Sculpting Session is an immersive experience where you can transform simple pastries into intricate works of art. Master Dough Folk artisans guide you with precision, turning sugar and flour into miniature masterpieces that not only dazzle but also have a chance to confuse nearby foes. The sweet temptation might linger in your mind for days after the session, leaving you yearning for more sugary treats.

effectDetails.title: Miniature Artistry
effectDetails.rules: When you complete a pastry sculpture during this session, it grants you advantage on your next skill check related to crafting or deception for the rest of the day. The sculpture must be displayed in plain sight within reach.

effectDetails.title: Confusion Aura
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can activate this effect by consuming a pastry you have created during the session. Until the end of your next turn, each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become confused until the start of your next turn.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpting_se.levelRequirementReason: This session is accessible to adventurers at any level as it focuses more on skill and creativity rather than combat prowess.
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpting_se.vendorReason: Pastry Palace specializes in culinary magic, offering unique experiences that blend art with food.
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpting_se.shippingDetail: The delicate pastries are shipped in a specially insulated container to ensure they arrive fresh and ready for your artistic endeavors.

usage.activation: Instantaneous once per short rest, by consuming one of the created pastries.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you consume a different pastry or if it is interrupted by an action that ends concentration.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the session includes enough ingredients and time to create multiple pastries.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpting_se.priceReason: The price reflects the unique experience, expert guidance, and high-quality ingredients provided during this Frosting Sculpting Session.

leclaire_isle_item_chronometric_croissan.name: Chronometric Croissant
leclaire_isle_item_chronometric_croissan.description: The Chronometric Croissant is a shimmering pastry that bends the very fabric of time around you. This exquisite treat can subtly slow down enemy attacks, turning their strikes into a culinary dance of delayed precision. Simultaneously, it accelerates your own movements, allowing you to gracefully navigate through battle with ease and speed. Overindulgence, however, might lead to an eternity of pastry consumption, as the time-altering properties can spiral out of control.

effectDetails.title: Slow Time
effectDetails.rules: By consuming this croissant, you can slow down enemy attacks by a factor of two within a 10-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be activated as a bonus action. The duration ends if you take any damage or if you use your Action Surge feature.

effectDetails.title: Accelerate Movement
effectDetails.rules: The croissant also grants the eater an increase in walking speed by 30 feet for 1 minute. This effect can be activated as a reaction to a creature starting its turn adjacent to you and ends if you move more than 60 feet during this duration.

leclaire_isle_item_chronometric_croissan.levelRequirementReason: Only those with the agility and discipline of a seasoned adventurer are capable of handling the croissant's time-altering effects without mishap.
leclaire_isle_item_chronometric_croissan.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies is renowned for its unique and magical confections, making it the perfect vendor for this enchanting pastry.
leclaire_isle_item_chronometric_croissan.shippingDetail: The croissant must be shipped overnight to ensure its delicate time-altering properties remain intact.

usage.duration: 1 minute per activation
usage.endsWhen: You take damage, use Action Surge, or move more than 60 feet during the duration of Accelerate Movement

leclaire_isle_item_chronometric_croissan.priceReason: The Chronometric Croissant's balanced price reflects its unique combination of utility and risk, ensuring that only those willing to pay for such magic can indulge.

the_edge_ritualistic_knife.name: Blade of the Unseen Pact
the_edge_ritualistic_knife.description: Forged from a meteorite that fell during ancient rituals, the Blade of the Unseen Pact whispers dark secrets to those who wield it. Its etched symbols pulse with an eerie glow, and its handle is carved from a bone long thought lost to the ages. This knife grants increased damage against undead foes but comes with a haunting compulsion: every night at midnight, the bearer must perform a bizarre ritual or risk losing their will to those of forgotten entities.

effectDetails.title: Increased Damage Against Undead
effectDetails.rules: When the wielder deals damage with this weapon to an undead creature, they deal an additional 1d6 necrotic damage. This effect lasts until the end of the wielder's next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Compulsive Bizarre Ritual
effectDetails.rules: At midnight each night, if the wielder does not perform a ritual that involves speaking in tongues (as per the Find Familiar spell) with an undead creature within 30 feet for at least one minute, they must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or lose their next action to endure a hallucinatory nightmare. On a failed save, the wielder must also expend one charge from this item.

the_edge_ritualistic_knife.levelRequirementReason: The blade's dark magic is too potent for those not of sufficient experience and willpower.
the_edge_ritualistic_knife.vendorReason: Edge Outpost deals in the most exotic and forbidden items, including this knife which has been rumored to bring both power and peril to its wielders.
the_edge_ritualistic_knife.shippingDetail: The dark messenger delivers the blade under a cloak of darkness, ensuring it arrives at night when the rituals can be performed.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation for increased damage; ritual performance required nightly for compulsion effect.
usage.duration: Until next long rest or until ritual is performed.
usage.endsWhen: The wielder successfully performs a ritual each midnight, expends charges, or the item's effects are destroyed by certain magical means.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges; expends one charge nightly.

the_edge_ritualistic_knife.priceReason: The blade's rarity and forbidden nature justify its price in terms of both crafting materials and the potential risks it poses to its wielder.

teyvat_item_emberglow_torch.name: Emberglow Torch of Valor
teyvat_item_emberglow_torch.description: The Emberglow Torch of Valor is a colossal torch forged from ancient meteoric iron. Its flames burn fiercely, casting an ethereal glow that pierces through the deepest shadows with ease. The torch's core glows with a fiery essence, whispering tales of valor and triumph to all who wield it. Legend has it that those carrying this torch are imbued with the spirit of valorous heroes, making them more resilient in battle. Wario indeed claims it emits a delightful aroma reminiscent of burnt marshmallows.

effectDetails.title: Increased Light
effectDetails.rules: The Emberglow Torch illuminates the area within 60 feet, providing bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. This effect lasts until the torch is extinguished or expended.

effectDetails.title: Valor Bolster
effectDetails.rules: While holding this torch, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC as long as it remains alight. Additionally, once per short rest, you can expend one charge to grant yourself advantage on your next attack roll and saving throw.

teyvat_item_emberglow_torch.levelRequirementReason: The Emberglow Torch is designed for adventurers of all levels but especially those who seek to bolster their courage in the face of danger.
teyvat_item_emberglow_torch.vendorReason: As a bustling market, Mondstadt offers a wide array of supplies and trinkets, including this legendary torch that has been passed down through generations.
teyvat_item_emberglow_torch.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Winged Mime, known for its punctual deliveries and intricate packaging to ensure the torch's integrity.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; ongoing light until extinguished or expended
usage.endsWhen: Extinguished, expended, or destroyed if not used within a short rest

teyvat_item_emberglow_torch.priceReason: The Emberglow Torch's meteoric iron core and legendary crafting make it an invaluable asset to any adventurer's arsenal.

teyvat_item_liyue_seal_of_prosperity.name: Seal of Prosperity - A Merchant's Blessing
teyvat_item_liyue_seal_of_prosperity.description: The Seal of Prosperity - A Merchant's Blessing, crafted in Liyue Harbor from the finest jade and blessed by the Qianli family, brings a palpable sense of good fortune to your trade. This intricately carved seal subtly increases profits by warding off grumpy customers, while also providing occasional opportunities to negotiate better deals with merchants. Craftsmen say it channels the prosperity of Liyue itself, making every transaction smoother and more profitable.

effectDetails.title: Increased Trade Profit
effectDetails.rules: This seal grants a +2 bonus to any trade-related checks, such as Merchant or Persuasion. The effect is active for the duration of one trading session (up to 8 hours). It ends if you engage in combat, use another item with similar effects, or if your profits fall below 10 gold pieces.

effectDetails.title: Occasional Better Deals
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, while wearing the seal, you can attempt a Persuasion check to negotiate better terms. On a successful check (DC 15), you gain advantage on your next trade-related check in that session. The effect ends if you fail three consecutive checks or engage in combat.

teyvat_item_liyue_seal_of_prosperity.levelRequirementReason: This seal requires a certain level of experience to wield its blessings effectively, ensuring it remains a valuable tool for seasoned traders.
teyvat_item_liyue_seal_of_prosperity.vendorReason: The Qianli family, known for their mercantile prowess, ensures the Seal's authenticity and effectiveness.
teyvat_item_liyue_seal_of_prosperity.shippingDetail: Ships are often delayed by Liyue Harbor's bustling trade activities, but the seal is carefully packaged to arrive in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Active for one trading session (up to 8 hours), or until profits fall below 10 gold pieces.
usage.endsWhen: Combat, using another item with similar effects, or if your daily limit of successful checks is reached.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the seal's effectiveness diminishes after prolonged use.

teyvat_item_liyue_seal_of_prosperity.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the seal's rarity and its practical utility for experienced traders.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_amulet.name: Phantom Amulet of the Shifting Winds
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_amulet.description: Crafted from the windswept shores of Inazuma, this Phantom Amulet of the Shifting Winds whispers tales of the storm's heart. Its core glows faintly with the spirit of the sea, offering a subtle edge in combat against ethereal foes and illusions. The amulet’s wearer feels a cool breeze on their skin, as if the winds themselves are whispering secrets. Wario attempted to consume it but found only saltwater in his belly; the amulet remains intact.

effectDetails.title: Ethereal Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to saving throws against ethereal creatures and effects. This benefit lasts until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Defense
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is targeted by an illusion spell, they can use a reaction to impose disadvantage on the attacker's roll. Once used, this effect cannot be used again for 1 minute.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires significant magical affinity and resilience, appropriate for those of at least fifth level.
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_amulet.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in artifacts from the turbulent seas, ensuring they are well-suited to adventurers who seek to harness the power of Inazuma's elements.
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via the fastest routes known through the shifting winds, ensuring timely delivery even in stormy weather.

usage.duration: Until the start of the wearer's next turn or until the amulet is destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the amulet is destroyed, expended, or when a new use is triggered.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_amulet.priceReason: This amulet’s price reflects its rarity and the mystical power it contains, suitable for those who can afford to invest in unique artifacts.

connectopia_curiosity_geode_of_wonder.name: Fractured Prism
connectopia_curiosity_geode_of_wonder.description: The Fractured Prism is a shimmering geode that appears to be crafted from fractured glass, its surface etched with intricate patterns of miniature block structures, each one a self-assembling town. When held, it seems to hum with an almost sentient energy, occasionally releasing bursts of spatial distortion that ripple through the air like waves. Touching it can trigger a surge of creative inspiration or cause minor spatial distortions, warping the immediate environment for a brief moment.

effectDetails.title: Spatial Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Fractured Prism creates a minor spatial distortion that lasts for 1 minute. The area affected is a 5-foot radius centered on the item. Any creature within this area must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be disoriented for 1 round, taking a -2 penalty to all ability checks and attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Creative Inspiration
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, touching the Fractured Prism grants you a +10 temporary inspiration bonus on your next creation-related check or ability. This effect can only be used once per long rest and does not stack with other sources of inspiration.

connectopia_curiosity_geode_of_wonder.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no special proficiency; its power lies in its unique properties rather than the user's skill level.
connectopia_curiosity_geode_of_wonder.vendorReason: The Craft Corner is known for curating rare and magical artifacts that can assist artisans and creators in their endeavors, making it fitting to offer this Fractured Prism.
connectopia_curiosity_geode_of_wonder.shippingDetail: Delivered via standard mail within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Spatial Distortion; lasts until the end of the next turn for Creative Inspiration
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or it is destroyed

connectopia_curiosity_geode_of_wonder.priceReason: This price reflects the item's unique properties and rarity, offering a balance between cost and utility.

warhammer_voidreaper_2.name: Void Reaper's Embrace
warhammer_voidreaper_2.description: The Void Reaper's Embrace is a warhammer forged from the molten remains of forgotten stars and twisted by ancient rites. Its surface crackles with dark energy, and when wielded, it seems to draw in light itself, casting shadows deeper than any night. The hammer whispers secrets that could drive even the most steadfast mad, but its power is undeniable—those who dare use it must be vigilant lest they become pawns of the void's oldest entities.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Imp Summoning
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a successful melee hit. The summoned imp remains active for 1 minute or until dismissed by the wielder. The imp deals 2d6 necrotic damage to one target within 5 feet and can be commanded to aid the wielder in combat.

effectDetails.title: Fear Infliction
effectDetails.rules: Has a 10% chance to inflict fear on one target within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for up to 1 minute, during which time it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

warhammer_voidreaper_2.levelRequirementReason: Only those of sufficient power and resolve can wield the Void Reaper's Embrace without succumbing to its malevolent influence.
warhammer_voidreaper_2.vendorReason: The chaos dealer understands the allure and danger of forbidden artifacts like this one, and is willing to trade it for the right price in dark currency.
warhammer_voidreaper_2.shippingDetail: Delivered by shadowy couriers who ensure the package reaches its destination without drawing undue attention.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: The imp is dismissed or the wielder's turn ends
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one imp may be summoned at a time

warhammer_voidreaper_2.priceReason: Balanced against other legendary items of similar power and danger.

curiosity_obsidian_shard_3.name: Whispers of the Fallen Empire
curiosity_obsidian_shard_3.description: The Whispers of the Fallen Empire is a perfectly smooth obsidian shard that glows faintly, emanating an aura of ancient voices. Held in your hand, it allows you to catch fragments of long-forgotten conversations—rumors of hidden treasures and strategic retreats from battles lost centuries ago. These whispers are surprisingly distracting but provide valuable insights into the empire's downfall, making this shard a must-have for any historian or treasure hunter.
effects: 5% chance to gain a temporary buff

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Whispers, you gain a +1 bonus to Perception checks. This effect is active as long as you are holding it.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Fortunes
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, when you make an Intelligence check related to history or exploration, there is a 5% chance that the result is increased by 2. This effect can only be used once per day.

curiosity_obsidian_shard_3.levelRequirementReason: The item's effects are subtle and provide valuable but not game-breaking information.
curiosity_obsidian_shard_3.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in relics that offer unique insights into the past, making this shard a perfect fit for their inventory.
curiosity_obsidian_shard_3.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the swift hawk courier, ensuring you receive your treasure without delay.

usage.duration: Active as long as it is being held
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one day of use or if not in hand during a short rest

curiosity_obsidian_shard_3.priceReason: The item provides subtle but valuable bonuses that are not overly powerful, making it a fair price for its effects.

teyvat_item_shimmering_echo.name: Shimmering Echo of Storms
teyvat_item_shimmering_echo.description: The Shimmering Echo of Storms is a peculiar pebble that glows faintly under the influence of thunderstorms, its surface etched with arcane runes. When held by a wielder, it channels the raw energy of a storm, delivering a lightning bolt to your next attack and a chance to paralyze foes in their tracks. This enchanted stone is said to have been crafted from the residue of a great tempest, making it a rare find indeed.

effectDetails.title: Storm's Fury
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with your next melee weapon or ranged weapon on your turn, deal an additional 1d6 lightning damage. This effect can only trigger once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Paralyzing Bolt
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance to paralyze the target for one round upon hitting it with this attack. The save DC for resistance is 13. This effect ends if you miss your target or if you use an action, bonus action, or reaction.

teyvat_item_shimmering_echo.levelRequirementReason: The Shimmering Echo requires a minimum level of 5 to wield its stormy power effectively.
teyvat_item_shimmering_echo.vendorReason: As the heart of the traveler's market, Mondstadt is known for its diverse array of rare and magical items, including the Shimmering Echo.
teyvat_item_shimmering_echo.shippingDetail: This item requires special handling due to its fragile nature; it will be delivered via swift falcon messenger within two days.

usage.activation: On your turn only, during the attack action or bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on a hit.
usage.endsWhen: Missed target, using an action, bonus action, reaction, or at the end of your next turn.

teyvat_item_shimmering_echo.priceReason: The Shimmering Echo is priced at 1000 XP due to its limited stock and the magical energy it channels from ancient storms.

teyvat_item_crystallized_driftwood.name: Crystallized Driftwood of the Azure Sea
teyvat_item_crystallized_driftwood.description: The Crystallized Driftwood of the Azure Sea, a relic carved from ancient driftwood and imbued with the essence of the sea, radiates a cool azure glow. It whispers secrets to those who hold it, allowing for brief conversations with aquatic creatures – perfect for navigating treacherous underwater realms or avoiding water-based hazards. When submerged in water, this enchanted wood grants you temporary resistance to water damage, ensuring your safety while exploring deep seas.

effectDetails.title: Aquatic Communication
effectDetails.rules: When held and submerged in water for at least one minute, you can communicate with any willing aquatic creature within 30 feet. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after removing it from water.

effectDetails.title: Water Damage Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While holding this driftwood, you gain resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage from non-magical attacks that include a significant aquatic element (such as waves or currents). This effect lasts for 1 minute. You can end it early by speaking the words 'sea calm'.

teyvat_item_crystallized_driftwood.levelRequirementReason: This relic is designed to assist adventurers of all levels, offering crucial aid in aquatic environments.
teyvat_item_crystallized_driftwood.vendorReason: The harbor's traders specialize in maritime goods and curiosities, making this driftwood an essential item for their clientele.
teyvat_item_crystallized_driftwood.shippingDetail: Ships via the Liyue Harbor's own fleet, ensuring swift arrival with minimal delay.

usage.activation: Submerging the driftwood in water and holding it.
usage.duration: 1 minute, or until removed from water, whichever ends first.
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn after removing it from water or by speaking 'sea calm'.

teyvat_item_crystallized_driftwood.priceReason: This relic combines utility and rarity, offering both a unique item and essential aid for exploring aquatic realms, thus justifying its high price in XP.

teyvat_item_archons_whisper.name: Archon’s Whisper - Fragment of Resonance
teyvat_item_archons_whisper.description: This small, intricately carved jade statuette vibrates with an almost palpable energy. It's said to contain a fragment of the Archons’ power – granting you a temporary boost to your Wisdom and allowing you to briefly perceive the flow of elemental energies around you!
effects: chance to deflect spells with higher Wisdom

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_tart.name: Glazed Goblin's Delight Tart
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_tart.description: The Glazed Goblin's Delight Tart, a suspiciously shiny confection, is said to be favored by mischievous goblins who use it to fuel frantic pastry-making sprees or distract foes with bursts of sugary energy. Bite into this tart and experience an immediate surge of sweetened vitality; your enemies might find themselves momentarily confused while you revel in the sugar rush. This treat is a delightful, if slightly dangerous, way to bolster your reflexes and outmaneuver your opponents.

effectDetails.title: Sweetened Vitality
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming the tart, you regain 60 hit points. For the following three turns, gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws and skill checks.

effectDetails.title: Confusion
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that your next attack against a creature will be made with disadvantage due to its temporary disorientation from the tart's sugary effects. This effect ends when you make an attack roll or cast a spell.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_tart.levelRequirementReason: This treat is suitable for adventurers of all levels, though beginners might find it more effective.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_tart.vendorReason: The bakers at Dough Depot are known for their experimental and unconventional pastries that blend the mundane with the magical.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_tart.shippingDetail: Delivered by the ever-popular Rolling Cart, which often stops in towns to sell its famous goods.

usage.activation: Eat the tart as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 3 turns after consumption.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you make an attack roll or cast a spell.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect is active at a time.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_tart.priceReason: The tart's rare ingredients and the difficulty of its preparation justify the high price in experience points.

leclaire_isle_item_dough_armor.name: Reinforced Doughard Plate
leclaire_isle_item_dough_armor.description: The Reinforced Doughard Plate is a suit of armor forged from magically hardened dough, crafted in the kitchens of Pastry Palace by master bakers. Its surface gleams with a soft sheen that hints at its enchanted origins, and it emits a delightful aroma of vanilla that lingers around you like a protective charm. This armor not only offers robust protection but also grants resistance to poison damage, making it invaluable against the hazards of pastry projectiles and overzealous bakers.

effectDetails.title: Armor Bonus
effectDetails.rules: When worn, this armor provides a +3 bonus to your AC. This effect is always active while the item is equipped.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Reinforced Doughard Plate, you gain resistance to poison damage. This resistance persists for 1 hour upon donning the armor and can be refreshed by removing and reequipping it.

leclaire_isle_item_dough_armor.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from enchanted dough and requiring precise magical crafting, this armor is reserved for players of at least 9th level.
leclaire_isle_item_dough_armor.vendorReason: Pastry Palace, known for its culinary prowess and magical touch, offers unique items that blend the mundane with the mystical.
leclaire_isle_item_dough_armor.shippingDetail: The Delivery Zeppelin ensures swift delivery from the kitchens of Pastry Palace to your doorstep, ensuring you receive your armor fresh from the ovens.

usage.activation: Passive effect; always active while equipped.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and continuous while worn
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon removal or destruction of the item

leclaire_isle_item_dough_armor.priceReason: Balanced to be a valuable but not overpowered addition to any character's arsenal at this level.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpture.name: Sweet Sculpting Consultation
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpture.description: Sweet Sculpting Consultation with Pipkin Crumblesprout is an invaluable service for bakers and confectioners. Pipkin, a Frosting Sculptor of unparalleled skill, offers his expertise in crafting exquisite edible sculptures. He provides detailed advice on flavor combinations to ensure your creation not only looks perfect but tastes divine as well. Pipkin's guidance also temporarily enhances your Charisma when dealing with merchants, making it easier to negotiate and sell your confections.
effects: Advice on flavor and structural integrity

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: When interacting with merchants within the next hour, you gain a +2 bonus to your Charisma (Deception) checks.

effectDetails.title: Expert Advice
effectDetails.rules: You receive two pieces of advice from Pipkin regarding flavor combinations and structural integrity for your creation. This effect lasts until the end of the day.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpture.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can benefit most from Pipkin's expertise in crafting edible masterpieces.
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpture.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies is a hub for all things sweet, ensuring that only the best confectionery services are available to their clients.
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpture.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift Sugar Pigeon, ensuring your consultation arrives fresh and ready to begin.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon purchasing the service; active benefits last for one hour after first use.
usage.duration: One hour from first use
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the time expires or you stop interacting with merchants.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_sculpture.priceReason: Balanced as a rare service, offering significant value in both flavor and salesmanship.

kivotos_item_forbidden_echo_shard.name: Resonance of Ruin
kivotos_item_forbidden_echo_shard.description: The Resonance of Ruin is a jagged, ethereal shard forged from ancient ruins, pulsing with chaotic energy. When you touch it, fleeting echoes of past battles reveal hidden weaknesses in your enemies, granting strategic insight. However, prolonged exposure can distort reality, causing unsettling hallucinations that last until the next dawn. The artifact's power draws unwanted attention from the Academy’s security forces, making it a forbidden relic known to scholars and adventurers alike.

effectDetails.title: Expose Hidden Weaknesses
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you touch the Resonance of Ruin to activate its power. This reveals a hidden weakness in one enemy within 30 feet, granting advantage on an attack roll or saving throw against that target for 1 minute. The effect ends if you lose sight of the target.

effectDetails.title: Hallucinatory Insight
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance (DC 14) that when you use the Resonance of Ruin, you are briefly overwhelmed by hallucinations. These last until your next short or long rest and can be resisted with a successful Wisdom saving throw.

kivotos_item_forbidden_echo_shard.levelRequirementReason: The artifact's chaotic energy requires a seasoned adventurer to wield it safely.
kivotos_item_forbidden_echo_shard.vendorReason: Club Supply deals in rare artifacts, and the Resonance of Ruin is one such relic known for its forbidden nature.
kivotos_item_forbidden_echo_shard.shippingDetail: Special handling required; delivery may take an additional day due to restricted routes.

usage.duration: 1 minute, until the target is out of sight or you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell)
usage.endsWhen: You lose sight of the target or use it again within the same combat

kivotos_item_forbidden_echo_shard.priceReason: The Resonance of Ruin is highly sought after for its strategic value and forbidden nature, justifying a price commensurate with rare artifacts.

kivotos_item_student_study_pack.name: Brain Boost Bundle
kivotos_item_student_study_pack.description: The Brain Boost Bundle is a meticulously crafted student kit, bound in a durable leather case. Inside lie precision-ground caffeine tablets, memory-aiding elixirs, and an unprecedented quantity of notepads that seem to multiply with each use. This bundle enhances your focus so much that you can solve complex puzzles or unravel ancient scripts with ease, though it doesn't grant any magical abilities. Students trust the Brain Boost Bundle to keep them sharp during their most taxing studies.

effectDetails.title: Concentration Boost (Instantaneous)
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and can maintain concentration for an additional round without expending a spell slot.

effectDetails.title: Skill Check Bonus (+1 to One Skill)
effectDetails.rules: You may apply this bonus once per short or long rest, enhancing your proficiency in one skill of your choice by +1 on ability checks and saving throws. This effect ends when you finish a short or long rest.

kivotos_item_student_study_pack.levelRequirementReason: The kit is designed for students who are just starting their academic journey.
kivotos_item_student_study_pack.vendorReason: The Student Store caters exclusively to the educational needs of young scholars, ensuring they have all the tools necessary for success.
kivotos_item_student_study_pack.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days via standard mail service.

usage.activation: Bonus action or passive effect during a short or long rest.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until end of next turn for the concentration boost, and ends at the start of your next short or long rest for the skill check bonus.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next short or long rest.

kivotos_item_student_study_pack.priceReason: The Brain Boost Bundle is priced high due to its unique and specialized contents, which are difficult to replicate.

almost_edge_chronometric_shard.name: Chronometric Shard
almost_edge_chronometric_shard.description: A pulsing shard of temporal energy, harvested from a glitch in the Boundary Between Worlds, the Chronometric Shard allows you to bend time itself. Holding it briefly slows your foes' attacks and enhances your own movement speed, granting you the edge when seconds matter most. However, its power can be fickle; if you hold it too long, the temporal instability might loop you back in time, trapping you in a paradoxical quirk of reality.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Disruption
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate to reduce enemy attack speeds by 20% for 3 turns. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Swift Motion
effectDetails.rules: Increases your movement speed by 50% for 2 turns upon activation as a reaction to an attack against you. This effect cannot be used more than twice in a single combat encounter and has no save DC.

almost_edge_chronometric_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 6th level to handle the temporal instability without risk.
almost_edge_chronometric_shard.vendorReason: The Void Merchant traffics in rare, otherworldly artifacts like this Chronometric Shard, harvested from interdimensional anomalies.
almost_edge_chronometric_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Courier, arriving with the next temporal fluctuation.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Temporal Disruption; reaction to an attack for Swift Motion.
usage.duration: Temporal Disruption lasts 3 turns. Swift Motion lasts 2 turns after reacting to an attack.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts upon use or when the effect duration ends.

almost_edge_chronometric_shard.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare item with two potent effects that can shift combat dynamics.

almost_edge_mirror_of_lost_faces.name: Mirror of Lost Faces
almost_edge_mirror_of_lost_faces.description: The Mirror of Lost Faces stands as a polished obsidian mirror, its surface etched with ancient runes that whisper secrets of forgotten worlds. Gazing into it reveals not only the faces of those who have fallen off the edge but also fleeting glimpses of realities long lost to time. Each glance grants a brief buff (strength, dexterity, or intelligence) for one turn, yet at the cost of a small fragment of your memory, which manifests as minor or significant lapses depending on the roll of a six-sided die.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse of Forgotten Realities
effectDetails.rules: When gazed into, the mirror reveals one random buff (strength, dexterity, or intelligence) for one turn. The effect is instantaneous and applies immediately upon use. There is a chance to reveal hidden secrets in the area with a 20% probability. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Buff
effectDetails.rules: Upon using the mirror, you gain one random buff (strength, dexterity, or intelligence) for one turn. The specific stat is determined by rolling a 20-sided die: roll 1-5 for strength, 6-10 for dexterity, and 11-20 for intelligence. This effect ends when the start of your next turn arrives.

almost_edge_mirror_of_lost_faces.levelRequirementReason: This mirror requires a level 8 character to use due to its ancient magic and the risk it poses to one's memory.
almost_edge_mirror_of_lost_faces.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in curiosities that bridge worlds, making this mirror an appropriate addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_mirror_of_lost_faces.shippingDetail: Ships through spectral winds, arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: A free action to gaze into the mirror.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn or when the buff ends due to natural expiration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by memory risk.

almost_edge_mirror_of_lost_faces.priceReason: This price reflects its epic rarity and the potential for significant memory loss.

internet_meme_repair.name: Viral Echo Restoration
internet_meme_repair.description: This digital service, delivered by data_dealer's encrypted courier, allows you to cleanse your mind of a pesky viral meme. By running advanced algorithms through your neural network, it removes one particularly irksome meme – but beware! The process can sometimes backfire, leaving you with an even more insufferable meme than before. In the aftermath, your charisma is temporarily boosted, making you sharper in social interactions for just a short while.

effectDetails.title: Meme Removal
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The target meme is removed from your mind, preventing it from affecting you for the next hour. However, there's a chance that a new, potentially more irritating meme will replace the old one.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Your charisma increases by 1 until the end of your next turn. This effect is not cumulative with other sources of charisma boosts.

internet_meme_repair.levelRequirementReason: Anyone overwhelmed by viral memes can benefit from this service, making it accessible to all levels.
internet_meme_repair.vendorReason: As a data specialist, data_dealer is well-equipped and sought out for such digital services that enhance mental clarity.
internet_meme_repair.shippingDetail: The service is delivered through encrypted channels ensuring no one else can see the memes being removed or added to your mind.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with effects lasting for 1 turn and 1 hour respectively
usage.endsWhen: The effect of meme removal ends when the time expires; charisma boost ends at the end of your next turn

internet_meme_repair.priceReason: This service balances the cost with its unique and potentially unpredictable outcome, ensuring a fair value for players.

teyvat_item_sparkling_rune.name: Sparkling Rune of Aetherial Resonance
teyvat_item_sparkling_rune.description: The Sparkling Rune of Aetherial Resonance is a tiny, glowing crystal that pulses with aetheric energy. Crafted by the celestial beings who once walked among the stars, it amplifies your connection to elemental magic, granting you resistance and vulnerability in tandem. This relic was found amidst the ruins of an ancient observatory in Teyvat, where it was believed to channel the power of the Archon directly into its wielder's hands.

effectDetails.title: Resistance and Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the rune, you gain resistance to one elemental damage type of your choice until the start of your next turn. However, you become vulnerable to a different elemental damage type with the same DC as the save for 1 minute after activation.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Damage Bonus
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you deal damage with an attack that uses one of the two elemental types you are currently resistant and vulnerable to, you gain advantage on the roll. This effect ends when you stop using attacks involving either element for 1 minute.

teyvat_item_sparkling_rune.levelRequirementReason: The rune's celestial magic requires a certain level of arcane knowledge to harness its full potential.
teyvat_item_sparkling_rune.vendorReason: Mondstadt is known for its scholarly community, which frequently trades in relics and curiosities like the Sparkling Rune.
teyvat_item_sparkling_rune.shippingDetail: The rune is carefully packed to prevent any accidental damage during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a 1-minute cooldown between activations
usage.endsWhen: You stop using attacks involving the elemental types for at least 1 minute; or if you take an action that requires concentration on another effect

teyvat_item_sparkling_rune.priceReason: The rune's rarity and the advanced crafting techniques required to produce it justify its higher price.

teyvat_item_loyalty_token.name: Token of the Five Pillars' Accord
teyvat_item_loyalty_token.description: The Token of the Five Pillars' Accord is a smooth jade disc etched with intricate carvings that tell the story of Liyue's Five Pillars. This token not only grants you special treatment from merchants but also offers unparalleled discounts on goods and services within the region. Merchants whisper that once you possess this token, they will treat you like royalty—though perhaps more literally than they intended for Wario.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Discounts
effectDetails.rules: By holding the Token of the Five Pillars' Accord, you unlock a +2 bonus to your purchase rolls at any Liyue merchant. This effect lasts until you spend more than 50 gold pieces in a single transaction or until you use another item that offers similar benefits.

effectDetails.title: Favor with Merchants
effectDetails.rules: When you present the token, merchants will extend their best greetings and offer you special treatment. They may provide you with a free minor item (worth up to 10 gold pieces) upon your next purchase or grant you a +1 bonus to any Charisma-based checks made in Liyue.

teyvat_item_loyalty_token.levelRequirementReason: This token is accessible to all adventurers, serving as an entry into the social and economic networks of Liyue.
teyvat_item_loyalty_token.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor merchants are known for their loyalty to the Five Pillars and will honor this token as a sign of respect and goodwill.
teyvat_item_loyalty_token.shippingDetail: The Token is delivered by trusted hands within the Merchant's Caravan, ensuring its safe arrival at Liyue Harbor.

usage.activation: Passive effect when in possession of the token.
usage.duration: Until spent or replaced with another token of similar use.
usage.endsWhen: Once you spend more than 50 gold pieces in a single transaction or until you no longer have this token in your possession.

teyvat_item_loyalty_token.priceReason: The fair price reflects the token's value as both a social and economic tool within Liyue, providing significant but balanced benefits to adventurers.

teyvat_item_chronal_amulet.name: Chronal Amulet of Temporal Distortion
teyvat_item_chronal_amulet.description: The Chronal Amulet of Temporal Distortion is a delicate trinket, its surface etched with arcane runes that shimmer like the auroras of Inazuma. Crafted from ancient time-weathered metal and imbued with the essence of forgotten timelines, it hums with latent temporal power. Use it wisely; the amulet can rewind time on critical hits to reset combat, but beware—overuse might cause you to loop indefinitely chasing after your own footsteps in the past!

effectDetails.title: Rewind Time on Critical Hit
effectDetails.rules: On a critical hit, the wearer can use an action to rewind time for 1 round. This effect ends if the wearer takes damage or moves more than 5 feet.

effectDetails.title: Slow Enemy Movement
effectDetails.rules: For every minute the amulet remains active in combat, all enemies within a 30-foot radius have their movement speed reduced by 10 feet. This effect ends when the wearer uses another action or the amulet runs out of charges.

teyvat_item_chronal_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires significant control over time to avoid unintended temporal consequences.
teyvat_item_chronal_amulet.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in exotic and arcane artifacts, making this amulet a fitting addition to their wares.
teyvat_item_chronal_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered with the Sea Serpent Express, ensuring safe delivery even across the vast oceans of Teyvat.

usage.duration: 1 round per critical hit or until used again
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage or moving more than 5 feet

teyvat_item_chronal_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's balanced price reflects its ability to manipulate time without causing game-breaking temporal loops.

animatopia_fang_amulet.name: Howler's Charm
animatopia_fang_amulet.description: Howler's Charm is a crudely carved amulet made from the fang of a juvenile Rumbleclaw, known for its surprisingly melodic roars that can strike fear into the hearts of lesser creatures. When worn, it boosts your intimidation skills by +10 and has a 5% chance to instill fear in weaker enemies, enhancing your presence on the battlefield. This amulet is a rare find from the Tribal Trader, a vendor known for their unique and powerful wares.

effectDetails.title: Intimidation Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this amulet grants the wearer a +10 bonus to Intimidate checks for 1 minute. The effect ends early if the wearer is incapacitated or falls unconscious.

effectDetails.title: Fear Chance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this charm, there's a 5% chance per round that it will instill fear in any creature within 30 feet of you who has fewer hit dice than you. The target must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

animatopia_fang_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The charm's powerful effects necessitate a minimum level to ensure the wearer can effectively use and manage its capabilities.
animatopia_fang_amulet.vendorReason: The Tribal Trader is known for their unique and rare wares, making this amulet an appropriate addition to their inventory.
animatopia_fang_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered with the help of a Giant Beetle Courier, ensuring swift delivery from the far reaches of Animatopia.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until incapacitated or unconscious.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is incapacitated or falls unconscious.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

animatopia_fang_amulet.priceReason: The charm's balanced price reflects its rarity and the moderate power level of its effects.

animatopia_primal_song.name: Echoes of the Ancients
animatopia_primal_song.description: Echoes of the Ancients is a bone flute crafted by a skilled shaman. Its haunting melody resonates through the forest, temporarily boosting party morale and revealing hidden pathways within the ancient woods. Upon hearing it, all allies within earshot gain a +2 bonus to their next saving throw against fear or confusion effects for 1 minute, and there is a small chance (10%) that it will uncover an undetected secret door nearby.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: When played, all allies within earshot gain a +2 bonus to their next saving throw against fear or confusion effects for the duration of 1 minute. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Doors
effectDetails.rules: There is a small chance (10%) that upon playing, Echoes of the Ancients will uncover an undetected secret door within 5 feet of the shaman. This effect cannot be used more than once per day.

animatopia_primal_song.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed to be accessible early in a campaign, allowing players to quickly benefit from its effects without requiring high-level proficiency.
animatopia_primal_song.vendorReason: The forest market thrives on the unique items crafted by local shamans, and Echoes of the Ancients is one such treasure.
animatopia_primal_song.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly through the dense undergrowth, ensuring timely arrival to adventurers in need.

usage.activation: Playing the flute as an action
usage.duration: 1 minute or until used up
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or when a new echo is played
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one secret door can be revealed per day

animatopia_primal_song.priceReason: Echoes of the Ancients offers significant utility without being overpowered, making it a fair value for its rarity and effects.

animatopia_beetle_shell.name: Chittering Armor Scales
animatopia_beetle_shell.description: Crafted from the discarded shells of giant Chitter Beetles, these scales are surprisingly tough and form a part of the armor known as 'Chittering Armor Scales.' The scales are lightweight enough not to hinder movement but offer formidable protection, deflecting minor blows with ease. When threatened, they have an unsettling tendency to rattle in a distracting chitter sound that could momentarily disorient attackers, making you feel like a living beacon for hungry predators.

effectDetails.title: Distracting Chitter Sound
effectDetails.rules: There is a 2% chance that the scales will produce a distracting chitter sound when you are attacked. This effect has no save or duration; it triggers as an instantaneous reaction to any attack directed at you, and you can suppress this effect once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Armor Class +1
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides a passive bonus of +1 to your Armor Class. It is always active while wearing the armor scales and does not require any action or activation.

animatopia_beetle_shell.levelRequirementReason: The scales' resilience requires some experience with handling tough materials and understanding the beetle's defensive mechanisms.
animatopia_beetle_shell.vendorReason: Beast Bazaar specializes in unique items crafted from natural resources, making it the perfect vendor for these armor scales.
animatopia_beetle_shell.shippingDetail: Shipped by Winged Grub Delivery; expect delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous reaction to attacks, or until suppressed with a short rest
usage.endsWhen: Suppressed once per short rest

animatopia_beetle_shell.priceReason: The scales are crafted from rare beetle shells and require intricate craftsmanship, justifying the higher price.

teyvat_item_liyue_guardian_amulet.name: Liyue Guardian's Blessing
teyvat_item_liyue_guardian_amulet.description: Forged by the skilled artisans of Liyue Harbor, this amulet radiates a soothing glow, imbued with the protective essence of the Liyue Guardian. Crafted from obsidian and garnet, it whispers of ancient battles fought and won against the fiery elements. Wielding this amulet grants you resistance to Fire damage, ensuring your survival in fiery encounters. Additionally, it subtly enhances your agility, increasing your movement speed by 10 feet per hour, making you a nimble target for enemies.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to fire damage. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet for each hour you wear the amulet, until it is removed or destroyed. This effect ends when the amulet is no longer worn.

teyvat_item_liyue_guardian_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's protective enchantments are accessible to even the most novice adventurers.
teyvat_item_liyue_guardian_amulet.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor artisans have long been known for their mastery of fire-resistant materials and protective charms.
teyvat_item_liyue_guardian_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via the Liyanese Shipping Cart, ensuring timely delivery through the bustling harbor streets.

usage.duration: Lasts until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Wearing ends when the amulet is removed or it is destroyed.

teyvat_item_liyue_guardian_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's balance ensures it remains a valuable yet fair addition to any adventurer's gear, offering both protection and mobility at an accessible price point.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_scroll.name: Phantom Scroll of Transient Dreams
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_scroll.description: The Phantom Scroll of Transient Dreams is a delicate, ink-stained scroll that whispers secrets of Inazuma’s phantoms. Crafted from the very essence of the city’s transient dreams, it allows you to glimpse fleeting visions of possible futures. While mostly blurry images of Wario indulging in cake, these glimpses can offer crucial insight into enemy strategies and weaknesses, making it an invaluable tool for those who dare to dream.

effectDetails.title: Visionary Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can briefly glimpse into possible futures. This grants you insight into the next enemy's attack pattern and provides temporary dodge chance for all attacks for 5 seconds. The scroll expends one charge upon use.

effectDetails.title: Phantom Insight
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to gain advantage on an Intelligence (Arcana) check related to enemy weaknesses or tactics for the next minute. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is accessible early, allowing players to quickly adapt to challenges.
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_scroll.vendorReason: Known for importing rare and exotic items from Inazuma, this vendor offers unique tools like the Phantom Scroll of Transient Dreams.
teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional portal, ensuring swift delivery to any plane.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Visionary Glimpse; Bonus action for Phantom Insight
usage.duration: 5 seconds for Visionary Glimpse; lasts until the start of your next turn for Phantom Insight
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per fight, or when destroyed.

teyvat_item_inazuma_phantom_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's rarity and utility justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

faerun_item_enchanting_services_rune.name: Rune of Minor Restoration (Service)
faerun_item_enchanting_services_rune.description: The Rune of Minor Restoration is a glowing, rune-shaped charm that hums with latent magic. Crafted from enchanted quartz and blessed by a druidic circle, it offers swift relief to ailments. This tiny talisman can mend up to 60 hit points lost due to minor wounds or diseases, and it banishes the effects of one level of poison or disease. Ideal for adventurers who've faced countless perils in Faerûn.

effectDetails.title: Minor Healing
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to restore up to 60 hit points. The effect is instantaneous, and it ends when the target takes damage or ends its turn.

effectDetails.title: Poison or Disease Cure
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command to remove one level of poison or disease from the target. This effect has no save requirement and ends if the condition persists for more than 1 hour after use.

faerun_item_enchanting_services_rune.levelRequirementReason: This minor restorative is crafted for adventurers who may face minor injuries but are not yet experienced enough to handle more potent healing magic.
faerun_item_enchanting_services_rune.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar stocks a variety of magical trinkets and charms, including this one, as it caters to the needs of adventurers of all levels.
faerun_item_enchanting_services_rune.shippingDetail: Shipped by a winged familiar for quick delivery directly to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the target takes damage or ends its turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the condition persists for more than 1 hour after use.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a non-consumable magical charm.

faerun_item_enchanting_services_rune.priceReason: This rune is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its minor healing capabilities and the druidic magic imbued within.

faerun_item_obsidian_amulet.name: Amulet of Whispering Shadows
faerun_item_obsidian_amulet.description: Forged from polished obsidian, this amulet hums with an unsettling energy that whispers secrets of shadowy realms into its wearer's ear. Crafted by a forgotten artisan in the depths of Undermountain, it grants night vision and advantage on Stealth checks, making the bearer a master of concealment. The amulet is said to detect hidden objects, but one must handle it with caution; its whispering might drive even the bravest soul mad.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth Checks
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect lasts for the duration of one short rest or until the amulet is removed.

effectDetails.title: Grant Night Vision
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can see in dim light as if it were bright light, up to 60 feet away. This effect is active while worn and does not require an action to activate.

faerun_item_obsidian_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires a minimum character level of 5 due to its intricate craftsmanship and the mystical forces it harnesses.
faerun_item_obsidian_amulet.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is known for its diverse array of magical curiosities, including rare artifacts like this amulet.
faerun_item_obsidian_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped by a giant eagle courier, the delivery can take up to two weeks due to the fragile nature of the item and the need for careful handling.

usage.duration: Until removed or until the wearer completes one short rest
usage.endsWhen: The amulet is removed or at the end of a short rest

faerun_item_obsidian_amulet.priceReason: Balanced for its level requirement and unique effects, this item's price reflects its rarity and mystical properties.

fate_rune_reading.name: Fate Rune Reading
fate_rune_reading.description: Consult the cryptic Fate Runes inscribed by the Mysterious Fate Forger. This ancient service takes a full hour, during which the forger meticulously carves and interprets runes to reveal your fate's potential. With a 30% chance of success, you might uncover hidden weaknesses in foes or gain a minor luck buff that lasts an hour. Prepare for cryptic advice and be wary of unintended consequences—fighting badgers may not be far-fetched.

effectDetails.title: Minor Luck Buff
effectDetails.rules: The recipient gains advantage on one ability check of their choice. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until you use this service again.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Weakness
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that the forger will reveal a hidden weakness in an enemy's defenses, which can be used during combat. This effect is usable once per day and requires no saving throw.

fate_rune_reading.levelRequirementReason: Beginners may seek guidance to navigate their first adventures.
fate_rune_reading.vendorReason: The Mysterious Fate Forger has a reputation for uncovering truths hidden in ancient runes.
fate_rune_reading.shippingDetail: Delivered by enchanted scroll, the service takes one day to be activated after purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect once per day; requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until used again.
usage.endsWhen: The hour-long interpretation ends or you use this service again.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one effect can be active at a time.

fate_rune_reading.priceReason: Balanced to offer cryptic yet useful insights for adventurers of all levels.

middle_earth_ringwraith_shards.name: Wraith's Echo Shard
middle_earth_ringwraith_shards.description: The Wraith's Echo Shard is a jagged, spectral fragment that glows faintly in the dark. When held, it releases a chilling whisper of despair, causing nearby foes to falter with fear. The shard also subtly saps your mental fortitude, leaving you feeling unsettled after use. A piece of the Ringwraiths' sorrow made manifest, this relic is said to have been crafted by ancient forces during the War of the Ring.

effectDetails.title: Fear Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within 5 feet, this shard releases a fear aura that lasts for 1 minute. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for the duration.

effectDetails.title: Mental Sapping
effectDetails.rules: Using the shard causes you to feel mentally drained until your next short rest, dealing 1 point of Wisdom damage and reducing your maximum Wisdom by 1 (this effect is temporary and resets after a short rest).

middle_earth_ringwraith_shards.levelRequirementReason: The Wraith's Echo Shard requires a minimum level to harness its spectral energies.
middle_earth_ringwraith_shards.vendorReason: Elrond, master of Rivendell, sells these shards as part of his collection of ancient artifacts.
middle_earth_ringwraith_shards.shippingDetail: Delivered by a swift winged horse within three days of order placement.

usage.activation: Action: Activate the shard to release its aura and sapping effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are no longer holding the shard or use it again.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but the effect cannot be used again until after a short rest.

middle_earth_ringwraith_shards.priceReason: This shard is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the power of the Ringwraiths' essence it contains.

middle_earth_dwarven_battleaxe_of_grit.name: Stonebeard's Stubborn Swing
middle_earth_dwarven_battleaxe_of_grit.description: Stonebeard's Stubborn Swing is a dwarven battleaxe forged from ancient, enchanted stone in the heart of Mount Ironfist. Its very weight seems to imbue you with unyielding determination, making it practically impossible for even the most persistent foes to escape your wrath. The axe's adamantium blade gleams with an inner fire that never fades, and its hilt is wrapped in leather that has absorbed countless blows over centuries of use.

effectDetails.title: Determination
effectDetails.rules: When you make a melee attack with Stonebeard's Stubborn Swing, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Strength modifier. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wielding Stonebeard's Stubborn Swing, you have advantage on saving throws against poison effects and are immune to poison damage from non-magical sources. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after using it in combat.

middle_earth_dwarven_battleaxe_of_grit.levelRequirementReason: This axe is crafted with a complexity that requires a seasoned warrior, ensuring its wielder can harness both its physical and spiritual might.
middle_earth_dwarven_battleaxe_of_grit.vendorReason: The dwarves of Mount Ironfist are renowned for their craftsmanship in creating weapons that resonate with the spirit of their creators.
middle_earth_dwarven_battleaxe_of_grit.shippingDetail: Ships via a giant worm, which may cause a slight delay due to its unpredictable route through underground caverns.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for each effect; Determination lasts until the start of your next turn after using it in combat.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you finish a short or long rest, or if you stop wielding the axe.

middle_earth_dwarven_battleaxe_of_grit.priceReason: This axe is crafted from ancient stone and imbued with dwarven magic, making it a rare but balanced find for those who can wield its power.

middle_earth_gondorian_scroll_of_forgott.name: Echoes of the Faithful
middle_earth_gondorian_scroll_of_forgott.description: The Echoes of the Faithful is a tattered scroll, its parchment yellowed by time and inscribed with ancient Gondorian prayers that whisper of valorous deeds long past. When unrolled, it emits a soft glow, healing the wielder by 75 hit points and granting them a +2 bonus to Wisdom saving throws for an hour. The divine energy sometimes brings unsettling visions, but those who can endure these visions may invoke a rare chance of divine intervention during their next action.

effectDetails.title: Divine Healing
effectDetails.rules: Using an action, the wielder can unroll the scroll to heal themselves by 75 hit points. The effect ends immediately if the wielder takes any damage or falls unconscious.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Bonus
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +2 bonus to Wisdom saving throws for one hour after using the scroll. This benefit is lost if the wielder fails a Wisdom saving throw during this time.

middle_earth_gondorian_scroll_of_forgott.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is accessible to all, as it is a potent reminder of Gondor's faith and resilience.
middle_earth_gondorian_scroll_of_forgott.vendorReason: The Shire Shop specializes in relics that connect the region with its ancient past, making this scroll an ideal addition to their inventory.
middle_earth_gondorian_scroll_of_forgott.shippingDetail: Ships via Silver Hawk, known for swift and secure deliveries across Middle-earth.

usage.duration: one hour or until the wielder takes damage or falls unconscious
usage.endsWhen: the wielder takes damage or falls unconscious; ends after one hour if undisturbed
