middle_earth_gondorian_scroll_of_forgott.priceReason: The Echoes of the Faithful is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its divine origin and the skill required to interpret its ancient prayers.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_mushroom.name: Glowshroom of Unending Delight
mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_mushroom.description: The Glowshroom of Unending Delight is a vibrant fungi with an ethereal glow that seems to pulse with life. It's said to be a favorite among the Mushroom Kingdom elite, often seen in the hands of Princess Peach herself. This mushroom bestows a radiant aura that enhances your luck and slightly reduces fall damage, making you less prone to missteps even on slippery surfaces. Its glowing cap is rumored to contain ancient magic passed down through generations of the kingdom's rulers.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Luck
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the Glowshroom to grant yourself advantage on one saving throw or attack roll. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Fall Damage
effectDetails.rules: While in contact with the mushroom (held or worn), you are considered proficient in acrobatics checks made to avoid falling damage, reducing such damage by half. This effect persists for 1 minute after you stop touching the mushroom.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_mushroom.levelRequirementReason: The Glowshroom's magic is accessible to all adventurers who can afford its price.
mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_mushroom.vendorReason: Toad Town Market stocks a wide variety of items, from the mundane to the magical, and this glowing mushroom fits well within their offerings.
mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_mushroom.shippingDetail: Delivered by a cart drawn by a trio of friendly Toads, ensuring safe and timely arrival.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn (Enhanced Luck); 1 minute (Reduced Fall Damage)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you stop touching the mushroom.

mushroom_kingdom_item_glowing_mushroom.priceReason: The Glowshroom's rarity, magical properties, and beneficial effects justify its fair price of 1000 XP.

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_pipe_fragment.name: Echoing Fragment of the Shifting Pipes
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_pipe_fragment.description: A fragment of a warp pipe warped beyond recognition, it hums with an unstable energy that resonates through the air. Touching this shard causes you to vanish in a burst of shimmering light and reappear nearby, but beware; the precise location is unpredictable and could leave you in a precarious situation or worse! This relic is said to have been crafted from the remnants of the Mushroom Kingdom’s corrupted warp pipes, once trusted conduits for Link's travels.

effectDetails.title: Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, touch this fragment to teleport up to 30 feet in any direction. You must end the movement in an unoccupied space or fall prone. The DM determines the exact location of your reappearing point.

effectDetails.title: Unpredictable Destination
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that you will appear within 10 feet of an obstacle, difficult terrain, or hazardous area (such as water). If this occurs, you must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you fall prone and take 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_pipe_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to handle the unpredictable nature of this fragment.
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_pipe_fragment.vendorReason: Wario has a knack for salvaging and selling rare relics from his travels through the Mushroom Kingdom.
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_pipe_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via rocket mail, which can be delivered within three days but may cause slight fluctuations in your destination due to atmospheric conditions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous teleportation
usage.endsWhen: The teleport ends when you reach your new location or fail the saving throw if teleported to a hazardous area.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but cannot be used within 1 hour of previous use.

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_pipe_fragment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers unpredictable teleportation and a chance for negative effects, making it a rare yet not overpowered item.

mushroom_kingdom_item_forbidden_heartsto.name: Heartstone of the Mushroom King's Corruption
mushroom_kingdom_item_forbidden_heartsto.description: The Heartstone of the Mushroom King's Corruption is a pulsating crimson gem that glows with an otherworldly light. It is said to contain a fragment of the Mushroom King’s dark power, capable of corrupting minds and granting minor abilities. Those who wear it find themselves driven by an insatiable desire for gold, their vision clouded by greed. The stone's influence is felt in every step, subtly warping reality around its wearer.

effectDetails.title: Corrupted Greed
effectDetails.rules: The user gains +1d4 coins upon defeating monsters. This effect ends when the user's alignment changes to chaotic evil or they are destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Dark Power Granting
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the user can activate this to gain advantage on a single saving throw against fear and charm effects until the end of their next turn. The use is limited to once every 24 hours.

mushroom_kingdom_item_forbidden_heartsto.levelRequirementReason: Only those at least level 15 are capable of wielding such dark artifacts without immediate risk.
mushroom_kingdom_item_forbidden_heartsto.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop deals in rare and forbidden items, including this corrupted relic from the Mushroom King's realm.
mushroom_kingdom_item_forbidden_heartsto.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of night to ensure secrecy; delivery can take up to a week depending on courier availability.

usage.activation: Once per short rest as a bonus action
usage.duration: Until the end of their next turn
usage.endsWhen: The user's alignment changes to chaotic evil or when destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by daily use

mushroom_kingdom_item_forbidden_heartsto.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers both a minor ability and a chance for corruption, making it a dangerous yet enticing item.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_slug.name: Sticky Sweet Slug
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_slug.description: The Sticky Sweet Slug, a shimmering gelatinous creature crafted from the finest honey and enchanted dough, is a treat unlike any other. Its delicate exterior melts in your mouth, releasing an explosion of flavor that can only be described as nectaric bliss. Consumed with care, this delicacy not only restores health but also grants you a fleeting burst of speed, making you move with a dancer's grace for the duration of its effect.

effectDetails.title: Health Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Eating the Sticky Sweet Slug restores 30 hit points to the consumer. This effect is instantaneous and cannot be resisted.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: After consumption, you gain a bonus to your movement speed equal to half your proficiency bonus until the end of your next turn. This effect is temporary and does not stack with similar abilities.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_slug.levelRequirementReason: The Sticky Sweet Slug's enchantment is simple enough for even the novice adventurer, though its exquisite crafting requires a basic understanding of alchemy.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_slug.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in sweet treats and delicacies, making it only fitting that they carry this unique confection.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_slug.shippingDetail: Swiftly delivered by the swift ponies, the Sticky Sweet Slug is known for its timely arrival to eager adventurers.

usage.activation: Eaten as a food or consumable item
usage.duration: Instantaneous health restoration; speed boost lasts until end of next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if you take any damage

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_sweet_slug.priceReason: Crafted from rare ingredients and enchanted with a simple spell, this delicacy is priced accordingly to reflect its unique properties.

leclaire_isle_item_dwarfstone_rollingpin.name: Dwarfstone Rolling Pin
leclaire_isle_item_dwarfstone_rollingpin.description: The Dwarfstone Rolling Pin is a massive, enchanted tool forged from a single chunk of magically-infused dwarfstone. Its surface crackles with arcane energy and emits a persistent aroma of cinnamon and freshly ground dwarven grumpiness. It's not just for flattening pastries—it can flatten foes too, dealing an extra 10% damage to all melee attacks as if the wielder had used it in their construction. A side effect of its magical properties is that there’s a 25% chance each time you hit with a melee attack to apply a slow effect on your target for one minute, requiring a DC 14 Constitution saving throw to resist.

effectDetails.title: Increased Melee Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, increase the damage by an additional 1d6. This effect is always active when using this rolling pin.

effectDetails.title: Slow Effect on Hit
effectDetails.rules: There’s a 25% chance that each time you hit with a melee attack while holding this rolling pin; your target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated for the next minute. The effect ends early if the target takes any damage other than from you.

leclaire_isle_item_dwarfstone_rollingpin.levelRequirementReason: The rolling pin's magical properties are not too overpowering but still require a basic understanding of combat.
leclaire_isle_item_dwarfstone_rollingpin.vendorReason: The Pastry Palace is known for its unique and enchanted kitchenware, including this mystical rolling pin.
leclaire_isle_item_dwarfstone_rollingpin.shippingDetail: This item requires special handling and is shipped via Thundercloud Express to ensure it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation on any melee attack.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting the turn of the wielder if the slow effect is triggered.
usage.endsWhen: The slow effect ends early if the target takes damage from any source other than you.

leclaire_isle_item_dwarfstone_rollingpin.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique properties, combined with its enchanted capabilities, justify a price of 1000 XP.

leclaire_isle_item_whimsical_dough_orb.name: Whimsical Dough Orb
leclaire_isle_item_whimsical_dough_orb.description: The Whimsical Dough Orb is a miniature, perpetually shifting orb of enchanted dough that occasionally emits giggles and may spontaneously rearrange itself into tiny gingerbread men. Touching it grants a fleeting moment of pure joy (and possibly sticky fingers), leaving behind a lingering sense of warmth and comfort. This delightful trinket can be a whimsical conversation starter at any gathering, its constant movement and playful nature captivating all who encounter it.

effectDetails.title: Joyful Touch
effectDetails.rules: When touched, the Whimsical Dough Orb grants a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Minor Illusion
effectDetails.rules: The orb can create a minor illusion of itself, allowing it to appear as a different object or shape for up to 1 hour. This minor illusion ends if the item is destroyed, reverts when touched by another creature, or after 24 hours.

leclaire_isle_item_whimsical_dough_orb.levelRequirementReason: This trinket's charm and utility make it accessible to lower-level characters who can benefit from its social and visual effects.
leclaire_isle_item_whimsical_dough_orb.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in items that enhance the flavor of any gathering, making them an ideal vendor for this delightful Dough Orb.
leclaire_isle_item_whimsical_dough_orb.shippingDetail: The Spectral Delivery Bird ensures swift and magical delivery, often dropping off packages with a gentle gust of wind.

usage.activation: Interacting with the orb by touching it (no action required)
usage.duration: 1 minute for Joyful Touch; 1 hour for Minor Illusion
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the item is destroyed, reverts when touched by another creature, or after 24 hours.

leclaire_isle_item_whimsical_dough_orb.priceReason: This price reflects the item's enchantment and utility without being overpriced for its level of play.

midlands_item_rusty_dagger.name: Bloodsoaked Shard
midlands_item_rusty_dagger.description: The Bloodsoaked Shard gleams faintly, a dagger that has seen countless battles and spilled much blood in the Midlands. Its blade is etched with ancient runes that whisper of lost wars, and the hilt is worn smooth by years of gripping hands. This dagger's edge is sharper than it appears, having been tempered in the fires of many a skirmish. It deals 2d6 slashing damage on a successful hit, and there’s a chilling 15% chance to inflict bleeding wounds.

effectDetails.title: Slashing Damage
effectDetails.rules: The Bloodsoaked Shard deals 2d6 slashing damage on a successful hit. This effect is not subject to any saving throws.

effectDetails.title: Bleeding Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 15% chance that the target will bleed after being hit with this weapon. The bleeding lasts for one minute and causes an additional 1d4 slashing damage at the start of each of the target's turns.

midlands_item_rusty_dagger.levelRequirementReason: The Bloodsoaked Shard is a common item, suitable for any level 1 character who has experienced battle.
midlands_item_rusty_dagger.vendorReason: The Midlands Merchant specializes in goods from the region, including items with rich histories and connections to local lore.
midlands_item_rusty_dagger.shippingDetail: Ships via Pony Express for expedited delivery within a week.

usage.activation: On a successful hit during a melee attack.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; bleeding effect lasts one minute.
usage.endsWhen: The bleeding effect ends when the target no longer has any hit points or takes damage from another source.

midlands_item_rusty_dagger.priceReason: The Bloodsoaked Shard is a common item but carries significant historical and magical value, justifying its higher price in XP.

midlands_item_imperial_scroll.name: Decree of Petty Tyranny
midlands_item_imperial_scroll.description: The Decree of Petty Tyranny is a meticulously crafted scroll, its parchment shimmering with the distant Imperial court's seal. This ancient artifact grants the reader authority over pigeons within a 10-foot radius for 3 turns, allowing them to command these avian messengers as if they were willing servants. It also bestows +2 Charisma and a +1 bonus on Intimidate checks against low-level NPCs (20% chance). The scroll's power is said to stem from the court's whimsical edicts, where even the smallest decrees can wield surprising influence.

effectDetails.title: Command Pigeons
effectDetails.rules: For 3 turns, you gain temporary authority over pigeons within a 10-foot radius. You can issue simple commands, and they will attempt to comply. This effect ends if the scroll is destroyed or if you voluntarily dismiss it.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: +2 Charisma for the duration of this scroll's use, and a +1 bonus on Intimidate checks against low-level NPCs (20% chance). This effect ends when the scroll is destroyed or if you voluntarily end it.

midlands_item_imperial_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The Decree requires no level to use as its effects are intended for any adventurer, not just seasoned heroes.
midlands_item_imperial_scroll.vendorReason: As a direct purveyor of Imperial goods, the Empire Exchange is entrusted with selling items like this scroll.
midlands_item_imperial_scroll.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Royal Messenger, ensuring safe and swift delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Read or activate as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for both effects; Command Pigeons lasts for 3 turns.
usage.endsWhen: The scroll is destroyed or its effects are voluntarily dismissed.

midlands_item_imperial_scroll.priceReason: The Decree of Petty Tyranny offers a unique and whimsical utility that balances its price with its limited, thematic effect.

midlands_item_godly_amulet_of_discord.name: The Cacophony Heart
midlands_item_godly_amulet_of_discord.description: The Cacophony Heart pulsates with an unsettling, discordant energy that warps reality around it. This amulet amplifies the most trivial disputes into full-blown arguments and sows chaos among your enemies, turning their attention away from you and toward each other. Its core is a fragment of ancient battlefield runes, once part of a warforged's heart imbued with the fury of countless skirmishes. Wario might sell it as a 'mood enhancer,' but its true purpose lies in creating mayhem.

effectDetails.title: Amplified Disputes
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command, with a range of 30 feet. All creatures within the area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become hostile toward one another for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Conflict
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 60 feet have a 40% chance to attack each other as part of their turn. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn, and any creature that fails its saving throw is also affected by this rule.

midlands_item_godly_amulet_of_discord.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant control over chaos and diplomacy to wield effectively.
midlands_item_godly_amulet_of_discord.vendorReason: Known for crafting items that channel raw, uncontrollable forces like the Cacophony Heart.
midlands_item_godly_amulet_of_discord.shippingDetail: Delivered by a dragon courier who will require a small tip in gold pieces.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate and command its effects.
usage.duration: 1 minute, or until the start of your next turn if it affects you.
usage.endsWhen: The save ends early or the wearer stops concentrating.

midlands_item_godly_amulet_of_discord.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price to reflect its moderate rarity and utility, not game-breaking power.

faerun_item_bloodstone_amulet.name: Bloodstone Amulet of Twisted Fate
faerun_item_bloodstone_amulet.description: The Bloodstone Amulet of Twisted Fate pulses with a sinister crimson glow that seems to shift and leer at you whenever you wear it. Crafted by a fallen deity, this amulet is said to judge your life choices, subtly influencing your decisions as it weaves dark magic into the fabric of reality. Wear it for too long, and you might find yourself unable to resist hoarding shiny objects or experiencing bouts of confusion that leave you questioning your actions.

effectDetails.title: Confusion on Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the amulet emits a pulse that has a 25% chance to confuse an enemy within 10 feet for 1d4+1 rounds. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take actions other than movement and reactions.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: Activating the amulet grants you +1d6 temporary hit points, but at a cost: your next spell cast is reduced by half its power. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

faerun_item_bloodstone_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Only those with sufficient experience and wisdom can safely wear this cursed amulet without succumbing to its dark influence.
faerun_item_bloodstone_amulet.vendorReason: Waterdeep's Market is known for its rare and forbidden wares, making it a fitting location for such an item of dubious origin.
faerun_item_bloodstone_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet arrives via a dark portal, requiring a brief period of time to materialize and ensuring the secrecy of its delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next long rest or until you remove it from your neck.
usage.endsWhen: You cast a spell, or when you are removed from your neck by force.

faerun_item_bloodstone_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rare crafting materials and dark magic make it an expensive but potentially dangerous addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

grand_country_forbidden_shard.name: Echoes of Oblivion
grand_country_forbidden_shard.description: Echoes of Oblivion is a shard etched with the forgotten geometry of other realms. Held in your hand, it whispers truths from realities long lost to time, warping space around you for moments of eerie clarity. Yet prolonged exposure risks unraveling the fabric of existence; best admired from afar or only briefly wielded by those who dare. This fragment, a relic of ancient banishment, is as dangerous as it is enigmatic.

effectDetails.title: Reality Warp
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can manipulate space around you for up to 1 minute. This creates a localized distortion that grants advantage on saving throws and ability checks within the affected area (a 20-foot radius). The effect ends if you move more than 30 feet from where you used it.

effectDetails.title: Truth Revelation
effectDetails.rules: When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check, you can use Echoes of Oblivion as an action. It grants you advantage on that roll and reveals a hidden truth related to the situation (e.g., a secret motive, forgotten detail). This ability has a cooldown period of 10 minutes.

grand_country_forbidden_shard.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant spellcasting prowess and understanding of reality's fabric.
grand_country_forbidden_shard.vendorReason: Side sellers often deal in the forbidden, and this shard is too dangerous for most to handle without a high-level mage or warlock backing it up.
grand_country_forbidden_shard.shippingDetail: The Echoes of Oblivion must be delivered via void packet, which ensures it remains stable during transit between dimensions.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Reality Warp; Action to use Truth Revelation.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use (Reality Warp); Instantaneous (Truth Revelation).
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the user moves more than 30 feet from origin. Cooldown after each use of Truth Revelation is 10 minutes.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use has a cooldown.

grand_country_forbidden_shard.priceReason: This item's rarity and unique effects justify its price in mythic XP; it’s a dangerous artifact that can alter reality itself.

grand_country_layer_cake_charm.name: Chronometric Confection
grand_country_layer_cake_charm.description: The Chronometric Confection is a diminutive, golden layer cake that gleams like it’s been dipped in time itself. When consumed, it grants its bearer a brief, chaotic glimpse into potential futures—each one featuring Wario inadvertently or purposefully consuming every last crumb. This ephemeral vision lasts only long enough to make the most strategic decisions, yet it comes with a peculiar side effect: those who partake are left feeling slightly more fortunate in their immediate circumstances.

effectDetails.title: Grant Short Vision of Future Scenarios
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the Chronometric Confection grants the user a fleeting, chaotic vision into potential futures. These visions are not deterministic but rather probabilistic, with each one featuring Wario consuming every last crumb of the cake. The effect lasts for 1 minute and can be ended early by taking any action.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: For 24 hours after consumption, the user gains advantage on saving throws against effects that would cause them to fail a check due to chance or misfortune. This effect cannot stack with other sources of luck and is exhausted if the user fails an ability check.

grand_country_layer_cake_charm.levelRequirementReason: This item's temporal magic, while intriguing, is not overly powerful for novice adventurers.
grand_country_layer_cake_charm.vendorReason: Layer Market specializes in unique and whimsical items, making it a natural fit for the Chronometric Confection.
grand_country_layer_cake_charm.shippingDetail: The confection is delivered fresh, but due to its time-sensitive nature, it must be consumed within one week of receiving.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until ended early
usage.endsWhen: Taking any action, failing a check due to chance, or expiring after 1 minute

grand_country_layer_cake_charm.priceReason: The Chronometric Confection is priced high for its unique blend of temporal magic and the whimsical concept of Wario eating cake.

animatopia_claw_of_the_howler.name: Claw of the Howler
animatopia_claw_of_the_howler.description: The Claw of the Howler, a massive relic shed by an ancient and irritable howler monkey, hums with untamed jungle magic. Its sharp edges are adorned with green veins that pulse with raw energy, and it emits periodic screeches that echo through the underbrush. This claw deals increased damage to foes and has a chance of inflicting fear, making enemies flee in terror. It's surprisingly comfortable for its size, though the occasional ear-piercing scream can be disconcerting.

effectDetails.title: Increased Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with an attack while wearing the Claw, it deals an additional 1d6 piercing damage. This effect is not limited by charges or uses.

effectDetails.title: Fearful Screech
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, when you score a critical hit with an attack using this claw, roll a d20. On a result of 15 or higher, all creatures within 30 feet who can hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

animatopia_claw_of_the_howler.levelRequirementReason: The Claw requires a minimum level to wield its primal magic.
animatopia_claw_of_the_howler.vendorReason: The Tribal Trader has connections with the howler monkeys and can acquire such rare relics.
animatopia_claw_of_the_howler.shippingDetail: Ships quickly via winged beetles, but delivery may take several days due to the claw's size and weight.

usage.duration: Persistent until expended or removed.
usage.endsWhen: The claw is removed from your equipment or destroyed.

animatopia_claw_of_the_howler.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare and powerful claw that provides both combat utility and a unique tactical advantage.

animatopia_whispering_moss_charm.name: Whispering Moss Charm
animatopia_whispering_moss_charm.description: The Whispering Moss Charm is crafted from luminescent moss found deep within Animatopia's caves, where it glows faintly under moonlight. This charm seems to murmur secrets of ancient lore and hidden passages to those who listen closely; however, the whispers can drive even the most steadfast mad if they are not heeded in time. It is said that those who wear this charm find their perception heightened, able to discern the subtlest sounds and movements around them.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for the next hour. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or fall unconscious.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Secrets Detection
effectDetails.rules: This charm grants a 20% chance to detect hidden objects and secret doors within 30 feet when used as an action. The effect lasts for 10 minutes, and it can be used once per long rest.

animatopia_whispering_moss_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is accessible to low-level characters who wish to explore Animatopia's mysteries without the need for higher-level abilities.
animatopia_whispering_moss_charm.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar frequently trades in unique and magical items from Animatopia, including this mystic charm.
animatopia_whispering_moss_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by the slow but reliable giant snails of Animatopia, ensuring the charm arrives intact.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as an action (for Hidden Secrets Detection)
usage.duration: Enhanced Perception: Until you are incapacitated or fall unconscious. Hidden Secrets Detection: 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation, falling unconscious, or once per long rest for Hidden Secrets Detection.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be used multiple times within a short rest.

animatopia_whispering_moss_charm.priceReason: The charm's rarity and unique properties justify its higher price point while remaining balanced for its level requirement.

animatopia_legendary_scale_of_the_dragon.name: Scale of the Dragonheart
animatopia_legendary_scale_of_the_dragon.description: The Scale of the Dragonheart, said to have fallen from the legendary beast, is a shimmering scale that pulses with ancient magic. When worn, it grants its bearer an aura of raw power and a small, grumpy dragon familiar to watch over them. The scale's wearer feels as though they are walking with the weight of a dragon's spirit, yet its true power lies in its ability to bolster attacks and provide a shield against fear.

effectDetails.title: Significant Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Scale of the Dragonheart, all melee weapon attacks deal an additional +2d6 damage. This effect lasts for the duration of one short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear
effectDetails.rules: The wearer is immune to fear effects and has advantage on saving throws against such effects. This immunity persists as long as the scale is worn, but ends if it is removed or lost.

animatopia_legendary_scale_of_the_dragon.levelRequirementReason: Only those of proven valor can harness the ancient power within this scale.
animatopia_legendary_scale_of_the_dragon.vendorReason: The forest market often deals in rare and legendary items, making it a fitting place for such an artifact.
animatopia_legendary_scale_of_the_dragon.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift drones, the Scale of the Dragonheart is carefully packaged to ensure its safe arrival.

usage.duration: Until removed or lost
usage.endsWhen: Removed or lost

animatopia_legendary_scale_of_the_dragon.priceReason: While the scale is not a one-time use item, its legendary power and unique properties justify its moderate cost.

equestria_item_mane_weave_treatment.name: Mane Weave Restoration Serum
equestria_item_mane_weave_treatment.description: This vial of Mane Weave Restoration Serum is a potion crafted by the skilled apothecaries of Ponyville. The serum, made from rare ingredients such as starflower nectar and moonlight essence, revitalizes your mane with a touch of magic. It instantly smooths frizz, restoring your mane to its former glory and adding an iridescent sheen. However, be cautious—using it on yourself is not advised; the result might resemble Fluttershy's legendary mane after a particularly energetic day.

effectDetails.title: Restores Mane Quality
effectDetails.rules: As an action, apply the serum to your mane. The effect is instantaneous and lasts until your next long rest. It restores a significant portion of the mane's quality, reducing frizz by up to 50%.

effectDetails.title: Reduces Wind Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The reduction in wind resistance lasts for 1 hour per vial used. It provides a bonus to Dexterity saving throws against being blown away by strong winds or storms.

equestria_item_mane_weave_treatment.levelRequirementReason: This serum is crafted with materials accessible to most ponies, making it suitable for all levels.
equestria_item_mane_weave_treatment.vendorReason: The market is well-known for its wide variety of grooming and beauty products, including this popular mane restorative.
equestria_item_mane_weave_treatment.shippingDetail: Ships within the day with Rainbow PONY Express's signature magic-infused delivery service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts until next long rest for quality restoration; reduces wind resistance for 1 hour per vial used.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when your mane returns to its natural state or after one long rest.

equestria_item_mane_weave_treatment.priceReason: The rare ingredients and magical properties of the serum justify its higher price, making it a valuable addition to any pony's grooming kit.

equestria_item_starfall_dust.name: Starfall Dust
equestria_item_starfall_dust.description: Starfall Dust is a shimmering powder collected from the fiery remnants of a star that fell to the ground. It's said this dust can make even the most mundane object radiate with an ethereal glow, and when used in conjunction with magical intent, it can grant a small boon to those who dare to wish upon it. However, not all wishes are granted as expected; some merely bring about a burst of spectacular sparkle.

effectDetails.title: Sparkle Aura
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can sprinkle Starfall Dust to create an aura around them. This aura lasts for 1 minute and grants advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. The dust is consumed once used.

effectDetails.title: Boon of Small Favor
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the user can concentrate on a specific wish they desire to grant. If successful (DC 15 Charisma save), the wish grants a minor benefit or advantage, such as increased movement speed by 10 feet for 1 hour.

equestria_item_starfall_dust.levelRequirementReason: This dust is accessible to beginners who are curious about its effects but lack the power to demand more significant changes.
equestria_item_starfall_dust.vendorReason: Crystal Empire has long traded in celestial relics, and Starfall Dust fits perfectly into their inventory of unique and magical items.
equestria_item_starfall_dust.shippingDetail: The dust must be shipped via the Royal Pony Express for optimal sparkle retention.

usage.activation: Bonus action to sprinkle; concentration required for wish
usage.duration: Sparkle Aura: 1 minute, Wish: 8 hours (once per short rest)
usage.endsWhen: Sparkle Aura ends when concentration is lost or after 1 minute, Wish ends upon fulfillment or failure of save

equestria_item_starfall_dust.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity and magical properties of Starfall Dust, which are both in high demand among adventurers seeking to enhance their luck.

the_edge_volatile_potion.name: Chaos in a Flask
the_edge_volatile_potion.description: The Chaos in a Flask is a volatile, iridescent potion that shimmers with a dangerous balance of energy and chaos. As you swirl it around, wisps of regret and static dance within its glass confines. When consumed, the potion grants you an unpredictable surge of speed, propelling you forward at breakneck pace for 1d4+2 rounds. However, there's a chance that this chaotic burst will destabilize your body, causing poison to course through your veins unless you succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Speed
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming the potion, you gain a +2 bonus to your movement speed for 1d4+2 rounds. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until expended.

effectDetails.title: Chance of Poisoning
effectDetails.rules: There's a 30% chance that after the unstable speed effect ends, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The poison deals 2d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of your turns.

the_edge_volatile_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for adventurers just starting their journey, providing a brief burst of speed that can be crucial in early encounters.
the_edge_volatile_potion.vendorReason: Edge Outpost supplies the most exotic and experimental items to fledgling adventurers looking to test their mettle.
the_edge_volatile_potion.shippingDetail: The Winged Courier ensures swift delivery, but packages may occasionally be delayed by unpredictable weather patterns in the region.

usage.activation: Drink the potion as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous speed effect lasts for 1d4+2 rounds.
usage.endsWhen: Poison effect ends if a Constitution save is failed, or when the duration expires.

the_edge_volatile_potion.priceReason: The Chaos in a Flask's price reflects its unpredictable nature and the materials needed to stabilize such volatile chaos within a potion.

the_edge_godly_voidstone.name: Nullstone of the Infinite Abyss
the_edge_godly_voidstone.description: The Nullstone of the Infinite Abyss is a cold, obsidian sphere that hums with an otherworldly presence. Its surface etched with ancient runes, it draws in light and sound, muffling all noise within its vicinity. Only those who can harness the void's power should wield this stone; its connection to the infinite abyss grants immunity to fear and negates magical spells, but at a price only the brave dare contemplate.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains immunity to being frightened by non-magical sources. This effect is always active as long as the Nullstone is held.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Negate Spell
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, when a spell is cast within 30 feet of the wielder, there is a 50% chance that the spell fails. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

the_edge_godly_voidstone.levelRequirementReason: The stone's raw power requires only a minimum level to handle its innate dangers.
the_edge_godly_voidstone.vendorReason: Final Shop stocks rare, godly items that push the boundaries of known magic and reality.
the_edge_godly_voidstone.shippingDetail: The stone is delivered with a special protective aura to shield it from any magical tampering during transit.

usage.duration: Permanent while held, resets on long rest for the spell negation chance.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if left unattended for a week or exposed to direct sunlight.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses until depleted by exposure.

the_edge_godly_voidstone.priceReason: The Nullstone's rarity and the risk involved in using it justify its moderate price tag.

midlands_item_shadowscale_amulet.name: Amulet of Whispered Secrets
midlands_item_shadowscale_amulet.description: The Amulet of Whispered Secrets, crafted by the enigmatic Shadowguard, hums with a spectral energy that subtly shifts the atmosphere around you. Its cryptic whispers can reveal hidden passages and distract guards, but they also leave you feeling perpetually on edge. This amulet is surprisingly effective at masking your presence from detection, reducing enemy awareness of your location by 20%. It's as if shadows themselves whisper secrets to you.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Detection
effectDetails.rules: As an action, activate the amulet to hear cryptic whispers that may reveal hidden passages. The DC for any Wisdom (Perception) check made by enemies to detect you is increased by 5 until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Masked Presence
effectDetails.rules: The amulet reduces enemy detection radius by 20% for 1 minute, starting when you activate it as a bonus action. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or the amulet is destroyed.

midlands_item_shadowscale_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires a minimum of third-level proficiency to effectively utilize its whispering and masking capabilities.
midlands_item_shadowscale_amulet.vendorReason: The Empire Exchange, known for its vast array of arcane curiosities, is the only reliable source for such an enigmatic artifact.
midlands_item_shadowscale_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via swift hawk courier within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action to activate; either to hear whispers or reduce detection radius.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for hearing whispers, 1 minute for reducing detection radius.
usage.endsWhen: Ends if you are incapacitated or the amulet is destroyed.

midlands_item_shadowscale_amulet.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's unique utility in exploration and stealth, without overshadowing more powerful gear.

midlands_item_broken_blade_of_despair.name: Shard of the Fallen Regent
midlands_item_broken_blade_of_despair.description: The Shard of the Fallen Regent is a jagged, emerald-hued fragment from the legendary sword of Emperor Kaelor, who fell into despair. Its sharp edges glisten faintly in the dark, and it exudes an eerie aura that can unsettle even seasoned warriors. When wielded, this shard can instill fear into weaker foes, sapping their resolve, or provide a calming presence to those who need it most by boosting Wisdom saving throws.

effectDetails.title: Fear Aura
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the shard as a bonus action, any creature within 10 feet of you that is of Challenge Rating 5 or lower must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12). On a failed save, they become frightened until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Boost
effectDetails.rules: While holding the shard, you gain a +2 bonus to all Wisdom saving throws. This effect lasts for the duration of one long rest and can only be used once per long rest.

midlands_item_broken_blade_of_despair.levelRequirementReason: The shard's power is potent enough to affect weaker foes but requires no high-level proficiency.
midlands_item_broken_blade_of_despair.vendorReason: Forgemaster Mira of the Fractured Forge has a deep connection with ancient relics and can source rare fragments like this one.
midlands_item_broken_blade_of_despair.shippingDetail: The Giant Beetle ensures swift delivery, but the shard must be carefully packed to avoid damage during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate the Fear Aura or hold it for Wisdom Boost.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; Fear lasts until the start of next turn. Wisdom Boost lasts one long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop holding the shard in the case of Wisdom Boost, or the creature's save is successful.

midlands_item_broken_blade_of_despair.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique abilities and rare nature.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_crumb.name: Void Crumb
doughnut_hole_gravitic_crumb.description: The Void Crumb appears as a dense, almost weightless morsel that floats eerily in mid-air before collapsing into your hand with a soft *thump*. These crumbs are said to be remnants of forgotten dimensions, their density defying all known laws of physics. Consuming one grants temporary resistance to falling damage, allowing you to land safely even from great heights. It also sharpens your spatial awareness, making it easier to navigate the endless void without missteps or disorientation.

effectDetails.title: Void Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you consume a Void Crumb, you gain temporary resistance to falling damage for the next three turns. This effect cannot be gained more than once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Spatial Awareness
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your next combat encounter, your spatial awareness is enhanced by 10%. You can see and navigate through tight spaces with greater ease and precision. This effect lasts until you take a short rest or fall unconscious.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_crumb.levelRequirementReason: Beginners often find themselves in situations where they need to traverse dangerous voids, making this item useful for those just starting their adventures.
doughnut_hole_gravitic_crumb.vendorReason: Hole Hawkers are known for trading unusual and useful items found in the void, so it's no surprise they carry Void Crumbs.
doughnut_hole_gravitic_crumb.shippingDetail: The crumbs arrive via a dimensional ripple, appearing at your feet with a soft *thump*.

usage.activation: Consuming the crumb as an action
usage.duration: 3 turns for resistance; enhanced spatial awareness lasts until the start of your next turn after combat ends
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally or are negated by falling unconscious, taking a short rest, or gaining another instance of Void Resistance

doughnut_hole_gravitic_crumb.priceReason: While not powerful in itself, the Void Crumb offers unique and valuable benefits that make it a worthwhile purchase for adventurers facing void-related challenges.

teyvat_item_elemental_resonance.name: Harmonic Echo Bloom
teyvat_item_elemental_resonance.description: The Harmonic Echo Bloom pulses with raw elemental energy, its petals shimmering in hues of fire's red, water's blue, earth's green, and wind's gray. When held near a source of these elements, it amplifies the wielder’s attacks by channeling their essence into each strike. This rare bloom is rumored to have been crafted from the very heart of the Elemental Resonance itself, found only in the ancient ruins of Teyvat. Holding it near a wind source allows you to conjure gusts that can trip foes within reach.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When held near a source of the element (fire, water, earth, or wind), increase your melee attack damage by 20% for 15 seconds. This effect has no cooldown and can be activated as a bonus action.

effectDetails.title: Wind Gust
effectDetails.rules: When held near a source of wind, you can cast Gust as an action within range (30 feet). The gust can trip any creature within the area that starts its turn there. This effect has a 1/day limit.

teyvat_item_elemental_resonance.levelRequirementReason: The Harmonic Echo Bloom requires a minimum level of 8 to harness its elemental power effectively.
teyvat_item_elemental_resonance.vendorReason: Mondstadt’s market is known for its wide array of rare and magical items, making it the perfect place to find such a legendary bloom.
teyvat_item_elemental_resonance.shippingDetail: Delivered by Winged Sprite, ensuring swift and safe transport through the skies of Teyvat.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as part of an attack (Elemental Amplification); Action (Wind Gust)
usage.duration: 15 seconds for Elemental Amplification; Instantaneous for Wind Gust
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn for Elemental Amplification; Ends when the effect is used or when you move more than 30 feet from a wind source.

teyvat_item_elemental_resonance.priceReason: The Harmonic Echo Bloom's limited availability and the unique skills it grants justify its moderate price.

teyvat_item_archon_seal.name: Seal of the Verdant Archon
teyvat_item_archon_seal.description: This verdant seal is a tangible piece of the Geo Archon's essence, forged from the heart of Liyue’s verdant earth. It grants you a temporary armor boost and enhances your earth magic prowess, but only if it remains in the capable hands of the Verdant Archon's true successor. Should it fall into the wrong hands—or worse, Wario's—its power could be used for ill intent.

effectDetails.title: Earth Magic Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Enhances your earth damage spells by +20% until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Armor
effectDetails.rules: Activates on contact with an enemy, providing +50 temporary hit points for 30 seconds upon successful hit. Ends if you take damage or use another source of temporary hit points.

teyvat_item_archon_seal.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 14 to wield the seal's power responsibly.
teyvat_item_archon_seal.vendorReason: As a trusted vendor in Liyue Harbor, they maintain a reliable supply of such sacred relics.
teyvat_item_archon_seal.shippingDetail: Ships via cargo ship from the verdant heart of Liyue.

usage.activation: Bonus action or on contact with an enemy.
usage.duration: 30 seconds, until start of next turn for Earth Magic Boost; ends when you take damage or use another source of temporary hit points for Temporary Armor.
usage.endsWhen: Starts to fade after its duration.

teyvat_item_archon_seal.priceReason: Balanced price considering the seal's limited stock and night-only availability.

teyvat_item_vision_artifact.name: The Wayfarer’s Compass
teyvat_item_vision_artifact.description: The Wayfarer's Compass is an ornate, brass compass that gleams in the light of Inazuma. Its needle shifts not to true north but instead points towards the most valuable treasure within a twenty-mile radius. Crafted by wandering alchemists, it exudes an aura of mystique and fortune. This relic increases exploration speed by 30%, making every step a step closer to untold riches, and grants a +1 bonus on saving throws against traps.

effectDetails.title: Treasure Seeker
effectDetails.rules: When you use your action to move within twenty feet of an unexplored area, the compass needle pivots to point directly towards the nearest valuable treasure. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Fortune's Favor
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus on saving throws against traps and environmental hazards. This benefit lasts for 8 hours, but you must make one such save every short or long rest to maintain the effect.

teyvat_item_vision_artifact.levelRequirementReason: The Wayfarer's Compass is accessible early in the campaign to encourage exploration.
teyvat_item_vision_artifact.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports deals exclusively with exotic and magical curiosities from across Teyvat, making this compass a natural addition to their offerings.
teyvat_item_vision_artifact.shippingDetail: The compass is carefully packed in silk-lined boxes aboard the dragon airships, ensuring it arrives undamaged.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Treasure Seeker; 8 hours for Fortune's Favor
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each long rest for Treasure Seeker; after one failed save against traps or hazards for Fortune's Favor
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest

teyvat_item_vision_artifact.priceReason: The Wayfarer's Compass offers a unique combination of exploration and survival benefits at an accessible price for early-game adventurers.

midlands_item_dragonscale_potion.name: Dragon's Breath Recovery Potion
midlands_item_dragonscale_potion.description: Dragon's Breath Recovery Potion is a shimmering red elixir sealed in an ornate glass vial. Crafted from the scales of a juvenile Emberwing Dragon, this potion not only restores 50 hit points but also grants temporary fire resistance. For 60 seconds, you are immune to all fire damage and can shrug off flames with ease. Should you imbibe it during a heated encounter, there's even a slim chance (5%) that your foes might catch a spark of their own.

effectDetails.title: Healing
effectDetails.rules: As an action, drink the potion to restore 50 hit points. The effect is instantaneous and does not require any saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 60 seconds after consuming this potion, you have resistance to fire damage. This effect ends when you take fire damage or if the duration expires.

midlands_item_dragonscale_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for adventurers of all levels but is especially useful in early encounters.
midlands_item_dragonscale_potion.vendorReason: Empire Exchange stocks a variety of potions and elixirs, making this one of their most popular items.
midlands_item_dragonscale_potion.shippingDetail: Shipped by Winged Beast Courier Service, known for delivering magical goods swiftly.

usage.duration: 60 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Takes fire damage or duration expires

midlands_item_dragonscale_potion.priceReason: Balanced for its effects, this potion offers significant healing and a critical advantage against fire-based threats at an affordable price.

midlands_item_obsidian_amulet.name: The Shattered Emperor's Eye
midlands_item_obsidian_amulet.description: The Shattered Emperor's Eye is a fragment of an ancient amulet, its obsidian surface cracked and dark with age. Crafted from the heartstone of a legendary Midlands dragon, it hums faintly as though still connected to the empire’s lost magic. Glimpses of forgotten emperors' wisdom may flicker in your mind when you hold it, but beware—too much focus risks summoning unwanted visitors or leaving you with a splitting headache.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of Wisdom
effectDetails.rules: When held for at least one minute, the wearer gains advantage on Intelligence checks and saving throws related to history or lore. This effect lasts until the end of their next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the amulet can be activated by speaking its name aloud. Doing so creates a minor temporal ripple within 30 feet, attracting any nearby magical creatures with a CR ≤ 2 for 1d4 turns.

midlands_item_obsidian_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic embedded in the amulet requires a high level of arcane knowledge to fully utilize.
midlands_item_obsidian_amulet.vendorReason: Fractured Forge specializes in ancient and lost artifacts, making it the perfect vendor for this relic.
midlands_item_obsidian_amulet.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, The Shattered Emperor's Eye is shipped by giant snails, ensuring safe delivery within one week.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held; active once per short rest
usage.duration: Until next long rest for Echoes of Wisdom; 1d4 turns for Temporal Distortion
usage.endsWhen: Use ends naturally or upon removal from the wearer's possession.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it regenerates its effects after a long rest.

midlands_item_obsidian_amulet.priceReason: Reflecting the item's historical and magical significance, this price accounts for both the rarity and the limited availability of such relics.

equestria_item_discord_echo.name: Discord's Echoing Stone
equestria_item_discord_echo.description: Discord's Echoing Stone is a jagged, obsidian orb that hums ominously when held. Its pulsating energies can disrupt foes' coordination and reflexes for fleeting moments. However, prolonged exposure to its chaotic resonance might draw the ire of Discord himself or even summon Wario’s ravenous minions. This relic carries a dark history, forged in the molten heart of Equestria under Discord's own hands, making it both a tool of chaos and a potential catalyst for disaster.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the stone grants you advantage on checks and saving throws to avoid being frightened or charmed. It also imposes disadvantage on enemy attack rolls against you for up to 1 minute, with a save DC of 15. This effect ends if you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), are incapacitated, or suffer more than half your hit points in damage.

effectDetails.title: Reactive Shield
effectDetails.rules: Whenever an enemy within 30 feet makes an attack roll against you, they must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker takes 2d6 force damage and their attack modifier is reduced by 2 until their next turn.

equestria_item_discord_echo.levelRequirementReason: This stone's chaotic energies are potent but not beyond the reach of a seasoned adventurer.
equestria_item_discord_echo.vendorReason: Ponyville Market stocks this item as a rare and powerful forbidden artifact, balancing its danger with its allure for collectors and adventurers.
equestria_item_discord_echo.shippingDetail: Orders are delivered within 3 days but may be delayed by up to an additional week due to the courier's unpredictable nature.

usage.duration: 1 minute, or until concentration is lost (as if concentrating on a spell)
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends, you lose consciousness, or take more than half your hit points in damage

equestria_item_discord_echo.priceReason: The stone's rarity and the risk it poses to its wielder justify this price.

faerun_item_godly_shard_of_zariel.name: Shard of the Fallen Angel’s Wrath
faerun_item_godly_shard_of_zariel.description: The Shard of the Fallen Angel’s Wrath hums with malevolent energy, its surface etched with the remnants of Zariel's divine wrath. When activated, it delivers a searing strike to undead foes, leaving them vulnerable for a moment before your strength is bolstered by an unholy surge. A relic of unfathomable power, this fragment can be both a weapon and a curse, depending on how you wield its dark might.

effectDetails.title: Massive Damage to Undead
effectDetails.rules: When the shard is activated by a bonus action within 30 feet of an undead, it deals 5d8 radiant damage. The target must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or become incapacitated until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you gain +2 to Strength and Attack Rolls for 1 minute. You can only activate this effect once per short rest.

faerun_item_godly_shard_of_zariel.levelRequirementReason: The shard's power is too volatile for those below 15th level, ensuring it remains a challenge even for seasoned adventurers.
faerun_item_godly_shard_of_zariel.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market prides itself on exotic and dangerous artifacts, making it the perfect destination for such a relic of chaos and order.
faerun_item_godly_shard_of_zariel.shippingDetail: Ships via a guarded dimensional portal, ensuring its safe arrival despite the inherent risks.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate within 30 feet of an undead.
usage.duration: Instantaneous damage and 1 minute Strength boost.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take another bonus action to activate it or at the end of your next turn if you do not.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one Strength Boost per short rest.

faerun_item_godly_shard_of_zariel.priceReason: Balanced as a powerful premium item that requires significant XP investment without overshadowing more common gear.

almost_edge_crumb_of_eternity.name: Crumb of Eternity
almost_edge_crumb_of_eternity.description: The Crumb of Eternity is a shimmering fragment, a relic from the void that hints at forgotten realities and the endless cycle of time itself. When consumed, it grants temporary resistance to fear and madness, perfect for facing unsettling echoes. However, prolonged exposure risks unraveling one's sanity. This crumb was crafted by ancient beings who walked the edge of existence, now offered by a vendor whose knowledge spans the multiverse.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fear
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as an action, the Crumb grants temporary resistance to fear-based effects for 1 hour. The effect ends if you take damage or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Madness
effectDetails.rules: Additionally, it provides temporary resistance to madness for 30 minutes upon consumption as an action. This effect is lost if you fail a Wisdom saving throw with a DC of 15 due to exposure to fear or madness.

almost_edge_crumb_of_eternity.levelRequirementReason: This crumb's power is accessible to any adventurer, making it a versatile tool for facing the unknown.
almost_edge_crumb_of_eternity.vendorReason: The void merchant trades in relics and fragments from other dimensions, this one being no exception.
almost_edge_crumb_of_eternity.shippingDetail: The crumb is sent through a dimensional rift, arriving with a delay of 1d4 days due to the instability of the route.

usage.duration: Resistance to Fear: 1 hour; Resistance to Madness: 30 minutes
usage.endsWhen: On damage or at the end of each long rest, whichever comes first. The effect ends early if you fail a saving throw.

almost_edge_crumb_of_eternity.priceReason: This crumb is priced moderately high due to its rarity and the risks involved in obtaining it.

almost_edge_void_essence_flask.name: Void Essence Flask
almost_edge_void_essence_flask.description: The Void Essence Flask is a glass vessel filled with an inky, swirling void that seems to defy all physical laws. Crafted from arcane crystal and imbued with the essence of the cosmos, it grants fleeting moments of untethered speed and reflexes but carries the dark promise of consuming everything in its path if used too long. A sip is a dance on the edge of oblivion, where you might dodge an arrow that never came or sprint past barriers that no longer exist—but beware; the void's allure is as potent as it is perilous.

effectDetails.title: Swift Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: When you take this flask, you gain a +4 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and advantage on Dexterity saving throws for 1 minute. This effect ends if you take any damage or if you voluntarily end it as an action.

effectDetails.title: Void Dodge
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, when an attack roll is made against you while you are holding the flask, you can make a Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, you gain advantage on all your next attacks until the end of your next turn.

almost_edge_void_essence_flask.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers just beginning their journey to harness the raw power of the cosmos.
almost_edge_void_essence_flask.vendorReason: The edge wanderers, ever curious about the unknown, keep this dangerous but fascinating item in stock.
almost_edge_void_essence_flask.shippingDetail: Delivered via a gravitational package that ensures safe transit through the most treacherous voids.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage or end it as an action
usage.endsWhen: You take damage, end it as an action, or are no longer holding the flask

almost_edge_void_essence_flask.priceReason: Balanced for its potent but risky effects, this item is priced reasonably to reflect its value in a perilous world.

warhammer_fatebinder.name: Fatebinder's Crimson Shard
warhammer_fatebinder.description: The Fatebinder's Crimson Shard is a pulsating obsidian fragment, its crimson hue casting an eerie glow upon the battlefield. Crafted from ancient volcanic rock and imbued with the chaotic energies of the Plane of Shadow, it allows you to briefly manipulate fate itself. Wield this shard cautiously; a misstep could unravel your allies' strategies or even doom them entirely. It's guaranteed to disrupt enemy spellcasters by either nullifying their magic or sowing confusion within their ranks.

effectDetails.title: Spell Nullification
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can attempt to nullify one spell cast by an enemy within 60 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13). On a failed save, the spell is negated, and you gain advantage on your next attack roll with a melee weapon. This effect has no cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Shadowy Confusion
effectDetails.rules: At the end of each enemy's turn within 60 feet for up to one minute, they must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13). On a failed save, the target is confused until the start of their next turn. This effect has a maximum of three uses per long rest.

warhammer_fatebinder.levelRequirementReason: It requires a high degree of skill and control to wield the shard effectively.
warhammer_fatebinder.vendorReason: As creators of powerful artifacts, Fate Forge is known for their mastery in crafting items that manipulate fate itself.
warhammer_fatebinder.shippingDetail: The Winged Courier delivers this shard swiftly, but only once per month due to its volatile nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and one minute (Shadowy Confusion)
usage.endsWhen: Target saves successfully or the end of the encounter

warhammer_fatebinder.priceReason: The shard's rarity, volatile nature, and unique effects justify its moderate price.

warhammer_chaos_amulet.name: Amulet of Unmaking
warhammer_chaos_amulet.description: The Amulet of Unmaking is a twisted piece of chaotic metal and bone, its surface etched with ancient runes that whisper promises of destruction. Wear it to bolster your defenses against the void, but be warned – prolonged exposure might drive you mad! This collector’s item is sought by those who appreciate the delightful chaos it brings, though only the most resilient of souls dare to wear it for long.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Defense
effectDetails.rules: When you are hit by a melee attack, the amulet grants you a +2 bonus to your AC. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can occur once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Resilience
effectDetails.rules: You have resistance to necrotic damage. Additionally, when you take necrotic damage, there is a 20% chance that the attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute.

warhammer_chaos_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The Amulet of Unmaking's chaotic nature requires a solid foundation in combat and resilience to wield effectively.
warhammer_chaos_amulet.vendorReason: The chaos dealer specializes in items that embody the dark whimsy and danger of the multiverse, making this amulet an ideal addition to their collection.
warhammer_chaos_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Void Runner, known for its swift but treacherous routes through the planes.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn or when you take a long rest

warhammer_chaos_amulet.priceReason: The Amulet of Unmaking offers significant defensive benefits without being overly powerful, striking a balance in value.

earth_land_mythic_stone_of_echoes.name: The Whispering Chunk
earth_land_mythic_stone_of_echoes.description: The Whispering Chunk is a massive, pulsating stone that hums with an ancient and forgotten power. Its surface glows faintly with ethereal light, and when pressed, it releases cryptic prophecies that can either guide or bewilder the listener. Crafted from the very essence of the earth itself, this relic has been known to befuddle enemies within a 30-foot radius, leaving them momentarily stunned. Wario’s secret weapon against foes, it is both a tool for distraction and a source of mystic insight.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Prophecy
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the user can touch The Whispering Chunk to receive a cryptic prophecy. This prophecy provides insight into future events but is often open to multiple interpretations. The DM determines its exact nature and meaning.

effectDetails.title: Stun Enemies
effectDetails.rules: Enemies within 30 feet of the wielder are momentarily confused, requiring a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to avoid becoming stunned for one round. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

earth_land_mythic_stone_of_echoes.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest hero can harness The Whispering Chunk’s power to outsmart and distract foes.
earth_land_mythic_stone_of_echoes.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium deals exclusively in ancient relics and curiosities, many of which are rumored to possess untold powers.
earth_land_mythic_stone_of_echoes.shippingDetail: Ships via the Giant Beetle Courier, known for its reliability but slightly delayed service due to its massive size.

usage.activation: A bonus action to touch and activate The Whispering Chunk.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of the next turn or until dispelled.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wielder uses it again or if a creature successfully saves against the stun.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest.

earth_land_mythic_stone_of_echoes.priceReason: The Whispering Chunk’s balanced price reflects its versatile utility and limited daily usage in combat and exploration.

grand_country_crumb_of_gravity.name: Gravity Crumb
grand_country_crumb_of_gravity.description: These shimmering crumbs seem to defy gravity's steadfast grip, their metallic sheen hinting at a celestial origin. When consumed, they allow you to briefly float upwards or apply a gentle tug upon objects around you, perfect for reaching high ledges or frustrating your foes with an unexpected lift. Each crumb is said to be crafted from the very essence of distant stars and ancient black holes, making them both precious and powerful.

effectDetails.title: Grant Temporary Levitation
effectDetails.rules: When you consume a Gravity Crumb, you are granted the ability to float upwards for up to 10 feet in any direction. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn. If you take damage or move more than 5 feet while levitating, this effect ends immediately.

effectDetails.title: Apply Gravity Push
effectDetails.rules: You may apply a gentle push on objects within reach (up to 10 feet) with the consumption of one crumb. This causes any object up to Medium size to be pushed away from you as if it were making a successful Strength saving throw. The DC for this save is equal to 8 + your Dexterity modifier.

grand_country_crumb_of_gravity.levelRequirementReason: This crumb can be consumed by any adventurer, regardless of their level, due to its simplicity and widespread utility.
grand_country_crumb_of_gravity.vendorReason: The Vertical Vendor stocks these crumbs as they are a popular choice for adventurers who need quick solutions to tricky situations.
grand_country_crumb_of_gravity.shippingDetail: Delivered by the hovering parcels, these crumbs arrive swiftly and with a gentle lift, ensuring they are fresh upon arrival.

usage.activation: Consumed as an action or bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; ends at the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take damage, move more than 5 feet while levitating, or if the crumb is consumed again.

grand_country_crumb_of_gravity.priceReason: The Gravity Crumb is priced at 1000 XP as it offers significant utility for adventurers of all levels and in a wide range of situations.

grand_country_layer_shift_service.name: Layered Reality Adjustment
grand_country_layer_shift_service.description: The Layered Reality Adjustment is a subtle service that allows you to momentarily realign your position within the layers of reality, folding space and time around you. This expertly crafted service lets you teleport to an adjacent layer, confusing foes and leaving them guessing which plane you've vanished to. With each use, there's a chance for a dimensional shift, potentially sending you to another nearby location or even granting you temporary immunity from phasing attacks.

effectDetails.title: Teleport to Adjacent Layer
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can teleport to an adjacent layer of reality. This effect has a range of touch and lasts for up to 1 minute per use. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be disoriented for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Chance of Dimensional Shift
effectDetails.rules: There's a 30% chance that upon using the service, you are transported to another adjacent layer. If successful, this shift can send you up to 5 feet in any direction from your starting point. This effect has no save and is instantaneous.

grand_country_layer_shift_service.levelRequirementReason: The service requires a basic understanding of reality manipulation, making it accessible at level 1.
grand_country_layer_shift_service.vendorReason: Layer Market specializes in services that manipulate the fabric of reality, making this item an ideal fit for their inventory.
grand_country_layer_shift_service.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional portal, ensuring secure and swift delivery through inter-dimensional means.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration runs out or you are targeted by an attack that requires a saving throw against this effect.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one use per day

grand_country_layer_shift_service.priceReason: The service is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the expertise required to perform such an adjustment.

grand_country_shard_of_the_vertical.name: Vertical Resonance Shard
grand_country_shard_of_the_vertical.description: The Vertical Resonance Shard is a jagged, obsidian fragment that glows faintly with the essence of ancient mountains. When wielded by a climber, it amplifies one's strength and agility, allowing for rapid ascents and precarious holds—though balance remains key to avoiding a fall. Crafted from the very heart of the Grand Country’s tallest peaks, its energy is said to echo the primal pulse of the earth itself.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Climbing
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the shard. For 1 minute, your climbing speed increases by 20 feet and your Strength (Athletics) checks to climb gain advantage. The effect ends if you fall or are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Conservation
effectDetails.rules: While the shard is active, any physical exertion that normally would cost stamina points reduces the cost by 1 point per use, up to a maximum reduction of 3 points. This effect ends when the shard's duration expires or you fall.

grand_country_shard_of_the_vertical.levelRequirementReason: This shard is designed for beginners and experienced climbers alike, requiring only basic climbing skills.
grand_country_shard_of_the_vertical.vendorReason: Side Seller specializes in gear that enhances everyday adventures, making this shard a natural fit for their inventory.
grand_country_shard_of_the_vertical.shippingDetail: Delivered within three days of purchase with standard courier services.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; ends after 1 minute or when you fall/incapacitate yourself.
usage.duration: 1 minute, expiring on falling or incapacitation.
usage.endsWhen: Expires after 1 minute, falls, or you are incapacitated.

grand_country_shard_of_the_vertical.priceReason: The shard's price is balanced by its utility in enhancing climbing performance without overwhelming the player.

kivotos_item_forbidden_spellbook_of_mino.name: The Scribblings of Professor Zylth
kivotos_item_forbidden_spellbook_of_mino.description: The Scribblings of Professor Zylth is a rare, leather-bound spellbook that exudes an unsettlingly cheerful aura. Its pages are embossed with strange symbols and adorned with remnants of student snacks, hinting at the chaotic experiments that gave birth to it. Opening it risks unleashing minor inconveniences like misplaced objects and spontaneous laughter, but also occasionally summoning glitter swarms that add a touch of chaos to any classroom. Wario would likely use this book to prank his rivals, causing them to erupt in uncontrollable fits of giggling while their belongings scatter in disarray.

effectDetails.title: Minor Inconveniences
effectDetails.rules: Any creature within 10 feet of the spellbook has a 25% chance to experience an inconvenience such as misplaced items or spontaneous laughter. This effect lasts for 1d4 rounds and can be ended by a successful DC 12 Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Spontaneous Laughter
effectDetails.rules: All creatures within 30 feet who fail their saving throw must make an Intelligence save (DC 15) or erupt into uncontrollable laughter, provoking opportunity attacks on the next turn. The effect ends after 2d4 rounds.

kivotos_item_forbidden_spellbook_of_mino.levelRequirementReason: This spellbook requires a level 8 character to safely handle its chaotic potential.
kivotos_item_forbidden_spellbook_of_mino.vendorReason: Club Supply stocks unique and dangerous items that could be used for mischief or pranks, making this spellbook an appropriate addition to their inventory.
kivotos_item_forbidden_spellbook_of_mino.shippingDetail: The book must be delivered by a courier during the night when the risk of accidental activation is minimized.

usage.activation: Reading from the book or opening its pages triggers these effects.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, but effects last for their respective durations.
usage.endsWhen: A successful saving throw ends the effect prematurely.

kivotos_item_forbidden_spellbook_of_mino.priceReason: The price reflects the spellbook's chaotic nature and limited availability among vendors.

kivotos_item_curiosity_chronometer.name: Temporal Tick-Tock
kivotos_item_curiosity_chronometer.description: The Temporal Tick-Tock is an ornate pocket watch crafted from polished brass and adorned with intricate engravings that whisper of ancient lore. This relic allows its wielder to briefly alter time, allowing a single action to be rewound, perfect for correcting minor mistakes or setting things right. The watch's gears hum with the energy of forgotten spells, granting an intuitive boost in perception checks but also carrying a small risk of unpredictable temporal effects.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Single Action
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user can rewind one recent action they have taken, effectively undoing it. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn and can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Boost Perception Checks
effectDetails.rules: +1 to all perception checks made by the wearer during the session. This bonus does not stack with other similar bonuses.

kivotos_item_curiosity_chronometer.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can affordably access this relic, making it a versatile tool for early adventurers.
kivotos_item_curiosity_chronometer.vendorReason: The student store caters to the scholarly needs of young mages and rogues looking for practical tools like the Temporal Tick-Tock.
kivotos_item_curiosity_chronometer.shippingDetail: Standard delivery, no special handling required.

usage.duration: Until start of next turn
usage.endsWhen: Starts of next turn or interrupted by a major event

kivotos_item_curiosity_chronometer.priceReason: The Temporal Tick-Tock is priced at 1000 XP, offering balanced utility and a touch of whimsy for beginning adventurers.

earth_land_forbidden_rune_of_despair.name: Rune of Whispered Sorrow
earth_land_forbidden_rune_of_despair.description: The Rune of Whispered Sorrow is a hauntingly beautiful etching on a shard of obsidian, said to have been crafted by ancient sorcerers in despair. When activated, it emits a chilling aura that can sap the morale of foes and instill sorrow in those who gaze upon it for too long. Touching it without care may leave you feeling profoundly melancholic, with the urge to seek comfort in simple pleasures like pudding.

effectDetails.title: Demoralize Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this rune induces a wave of melancholy that reduces the morale of enemies within 30 feet. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn or until an enemy successfully saves against a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Induce Sadness
effectDetails.rules: Any creature who looks at the rune for more than 1 minute must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become sad, taking a -2 penalty to attack rolls and ability checks until the end of their next long rest.

earth_land_forbidden_rune_of_despair.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level to wield this powerful but dangerous artifact.
earth_land_forbidden_rune_of_despair.vendorReason: The magic shop is well-known for handling and selling forbidden artifacts, including those with dark origins like the Rune of Whispered Sorrow.
earth_land_forbidden_rune_of_despair.shippingDetail: Ships discreetly via the shadow courier service, ensuring the rune arrives securely without drawing unwanted attention.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or until an enemy saves successfully against the demoralize effect.
usage.endsWhen: An enemy successfully saves against the demoralize effect, or the duration ends.

earth_land_forbidden_rune_of_despair.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its powerful but dangerous effects and limited utility.

earth_land_artifact_lucky_footstool.name: Wario's Lucky Footstool (Prototype)
earth_land_artifact_lucky_footstool.description: Wario's Lucky Footstool (Prototype) is a worn wooden footrest with an unsettlingly cheerful banana motif. Crafted from reclaimed wood and adorned with mismatched patches, it whispers stories of Wario's early misadventures in his workshop.
