When placed underfoot, the stool occasionally grants its owner a lucky find: either a small pouch of gold coins or a bruised but perfectly edible banana, both of which appear as if by magic.

effectDetails.title: Coin of Luck
effectDetails.rules: When the footstool is placed underfoot, there's a 10% chance that the next successful attack or spell cast by the user results in an additional 2d6 gold coins being dropped at their feet.

effectDetails.title: Fruit of Fortune
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the stool can produce a bruised banana, which grants temporary hit points equal to twice the user's proficiency bonus for one hour. The banana appears in the user's hand and is perfectly edible.

earth_land_artifact_lucky_footstool.levelRequirementReason: This prototype footstool is designed to be simple enough for even a novice adventurer, but its unique properties make it valuable.
earth_land_artifact_lucky_footstool.vendorReason: Earth Emporium specializes in eclectic and rare curiosities, making Wario's Lucky Footstool (Prototype) an excellent fit.
earth_land_artifact_lucky_footstool.shippingDetail: Shipped via a cart on wheels, delivered with a friendly smile by the shopkeeper himself.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for each effect; temporary hit points last one hour.
usage.endsWhen: The stool's magical properties exhaust after producing its effects.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the footstool remains in use.

earth_land_artifact_lucky_footstool.priceReason: While not a rare or powerful item, this prototype's unique and whimsical features make it highly sought-after among adventurers.

teyvat_item_lyue_merchant_charm.name: Lyue Merchant's Subtle Influence
teyvat_item_lyue_merchant_charm.description: The Lyue Merchant's Subtle Influence is a polished jade charm, said to channel the essence of Liyue's bustling markets. Crafted by skilled artisans in the harbor, this charm subtly enhances one's negotiation skills and haggling prowess, allowing for smoother transactions amidst the city's competitive trade environment. While it can't guarantee success against all vendors, it certainly raises your chances of striking a fair bargain with merchants.
effects: Increases gold earned from selling items by 10%

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Bartering
effectDetails.rules: When you make an attempt at bartering, this charm grants a +2 bonus on the check. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Gold Boost from Sales
effectDetails.rules: For every successful sale made while wearing this charm, you earn 10% more gold than normal. This benefit is cumulative with other sales bonuses and ends when you stop selling items for at least one hour.

teyvat_item_lyue_merchant_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is designed to assist novices in the market who are looking to improve their skills without requiring a high-level prerequisite.
teyvat_item_lyue_merchant_charm.vendorReason: The charm's origin and cultural significance make it a staple among the merchants of Liyue Harbor, ensuring its availability for travelers seeking to enhance their trade skills.
teyvat_item_lyue_merchant_charm.shippingDetail: Due to the jade's fragility, it is carefully packed in seaweed bundles before being shipped via Ocean Freight, arriving within two weeks.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until start of next turn or when removed
usage.endsWhen: Removal from the wearer or end of a sale session lasting at least one hour

teyvat_item_lyue_merchant_charm.priceReason: The charm's balanced price reflects its subtle but useful enhancements, suitable for players looking to improve their bartering and sales skills without overburdening the game economy.

teyvat_item_inazuma_illusion_scroll.name: Scroll of Shifting Reflections
teyvat_item_inazuma_illusion_scroll.description: The Scroll of Shifting Reflections is an ancient parchment imbued with the power to distort reality itself, crafted by long-forgotten magi of Inazuma. Unroll it in combat and witness your foes falter as their eyes are deceived into seeing shadows where there are none or dupes that vanish into thin air. A true masterwork, this scroll is a beacon for those who seek to bend the very fabric of perception.
effects: Disguises the user as another creature

effectDetails.title: Illusory Double
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, creating a duplicate that lasts for up to 1 minute. The duplicate has half your movement speed and is immune to physical attacks but can be dispelled with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check.

effectDetails.title: Disguise
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, allowing the user to assume another creature's appearance for up to 1 hour. The disguise has a 50% chance of fooling others, requiring a successful DC 20 Deception check to maintain.

teyvat_item_inazuma_illusion_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The scroll requires minimal concentration and is accessible to low-level spellcasters who can focus on minor illusions.
teyvat_item_inazuma_illusion_scroll.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in exotic magical curiosities from their homeland, making this scroll a natural addition to their inventory.
teyvat_item_inazuma_illusion_scroll.shippingDetail: The delivery is swift and discreet, ensuring the scroll reaches its destination without attracting unwanted attention.

usage.activation: Bonus action for the illusory double; action for disguise
usage.duration: Up to 1 minute for the duplicate, up to 1 hour for the disguise
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the user retracts the effect

teyvat_item_inazuma_illusion_scroll.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this scroll offers powerful yet manageable illusion effects suitable for a wide range of low-level spellcasters.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun.name: Giant Sticky Bun of Fortitude
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun.description: The Giant Sticky Bun of Fortitude is a monstrous pastry, its surface golden and flecked with cinnamon, encrusted with sticky honey. This confectionary giant not only provides a sugary delight but also grants temporary resistance to blunt damage, bolstering your resilience against the gruffest trolls or most forceful ogres. Its consumption also offers a fleeting boost in movement speed, allowing you to swiftly evade danger or quickly close the distance between you and a foe.

effectDetails.title: Fortitude Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consuming this pastry grants temporary resistance to blunt damage for 1 hour. The user gains +25% resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from attacks made against them. This effect ends if the user takes any other kind of damage.

effectDetails.title: Swift Movement
effectDetails.rules: For a duration of 30 minutes after consumption, the user's movement speed increases by +5 feet. If the user is incapacitated or dies while under this effect, it immediately ends.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun.levelRequirementReason: This pastry is designed for adventurers just starting their journey, providing a welcome boost without imposing a steep level requirement.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun.vendorReason: Dough Depot is known for its culinary prowess and willingness to cater to the whims of hungry adventurers.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun.shippingDetail: The pastry must be consumed within one hour of delivery to ensure maximum effectiveness.

usage.activation: Eaten as a meal or snack.
usage.duration: 1 hour for Fortitude Boost, 30 minutes for Swift Movement; both effects end if the user takes other damage or is incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends after duration or if the user takes other damage or becomes incapacitated.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_bun.priceReason: The high price reflects not only its size and ingredients but also Dough Depot's reputation for quality.

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dough_of_ob.name: Dough of Oblivion
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dough_of_ob.description: Legend tells of a dough crafted by a disgruntled pastry chef on Le Claire Isle. This forbidden treat induces temporary amnesia, erasing five minutes from your memory and leaving you disoriented for a moment. It's perfect for escaping awkward situations or when you can't recall where you left your sword. The Dough of Oblivion also temporarily confuses nearby foes, making them more likely to attack their allies by mistake.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Amnesia (5 Minutes)
effectDetails.rules: Eating the Dough of Oblivion causes a temporary loss of memory, erasing your recollection of events from five minutes prior. This effect lasts for 1 minute and has no save DC. The effect can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Confuse Nearby Foes (Bonus Action)
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may eat the Dough to confuse nearby foes within a 30-foot radius. This causes them to have disadvantage on their next attack roll and ability checks until the start of your next turn. The effect can be used once per long rest.

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dough_of_ob.levelRequirementReason: Eating any forbidden item requires at least first-level proficiency.
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dough_of_ob.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is known for its daring and sometimes dangerous culinary creations, including the Dough of Oblivion.
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dough_of_ob.shippingDetail: The Dough must be delivered by a shadow courier to ensure it remains forbidden and potent.

usage.activation: Eating the Dough as an action or bonus action.
usage.duration: Temporary Amnesia lasts for 1 minute; Confuse Nearby Foes until your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when their duration expires or if you eat more Dough of Oblivion within a day.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per long rest.

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dough_of_ob.priceReason: Given its forbidden nature and the risks involved in consuming it, the price reflects its value as an item that can be used strategically in combat or socially.

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_charm.name: Charm of the Sugar Sprite
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_charm.description: The Charm of the Sugar Sprite is a delicate, shimmering trinket crafted from solidified sugar sprites, said to be harvested from the crystalline formations within the hidden lagoons of LeClaire Isle. Its sweet aroma and ethereal glow can turn even the grumpiest soul into a charmer, but beware—its magic can also provoke fits of laughter or irritation in those around you, making it as unpredictable as it is enchanting.

effectDetails.title: Increased Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate the charm to gain advantage on one Charisma (Persuasion) check. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Charm
effectDetails.rules: The charm grants a +20 temporary bonus to any Persuasion or Deception checks made within the next hour, but after that time, anyone who has interacted with the wielder is immune to its effects for 24 hours.

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm's unpredictable and powerful social effects make it accessible only to those of at least first level.
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_charm.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies stocks a variety of LeClaire Isle curiosities, including the Charm of the Sugar Sprite, which is known for its unique properties among the island's exports.
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of winged couriers, these charms are typically shipped within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until used up
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wielder uses it again before the first minute expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_charm.priceReason: This charm's unique properties and rarity justify its moderate price of 1000 XP.

earth_land_ancient_rune_stone.name: Whispers of the Stone Sentinel
earth_land_ancient_rune_stone.description: Whispers of the Stone Sentinel is a smooth, grey stone etched with runes that shimmer and shift like ancient whispers in your peripheral vision. The runes seem to hum softly when touched, releasing fleeting visions of forgotten battles and the distant past. Touching it grants you a sudden surge of arcane knowledge, but beware—this influx can leave you disoriented for days afterward, hinting at its deep connection to the earth's oldest magic.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Insight
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this stone grants you advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks for 1d4+1 rounds. The effect ends if you take damage or if your next turn begins with you within 30 feet of an active spellcaster.

effectDetails.title: Perception Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one short rest, this stone enhances your perception by +2 to passive Perception checks. The effect ends when you complete a long rest or if you take damage.

earth_land_ancient_rune_stone.levelRequirementReason: The ancient runes require a more seasoned mage to harness their full potential without risk.
earth_land_ancient_rune_stone.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in artifacts and relics of the earth, making it the perfect place for such an ancient stone.
earth_land_ancient_rune_stone.shippingDetail: Shipped via a specially modified delivery drone capable of handling fragile and heavy items.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; requires touch.
usage.duration: 1d4+1 rounds for Arcane Insight, one short rest for Perception Boost.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take damage or on the next turn after being within 30 feet of an active spellcaster.

earth_land_ancient_rune_stone.priceReason: This item's price reflects its rarity and the cost of sourcing such ancient artifacts, even if it is reusable.

midlands_item_whispering_amulet.name: The Serpent's Secret
midlands_item_whispering_amulet.description: The Serpent's Secret, a warm obsidian amulet etched with serpentine runes that seem to murmur in voices of ancient lore, exudes an aura of caution. Its cryptic whispers have been known to warn wearers of impending danger, and its enchantments subtly heal wounds as they unfold. This relic’s power lies not just in its whispering warnings but also in its ability to detect hidden traps with greater accuracy than any other amulet.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Warnings
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to activate this feature. If you do so, roll a d12 and add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +2). On a result of 8 or higher, you gain advantage on all Wisdom (Perception) checks for the next minute.

effectDetails.title: Trap Detection
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to set traps and can use an action to attempt a Perception check with no penalty. If successful, you gain the benefit of having a trap detection ability for 10 minutes.

midlands_item_whispering_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The intricate runes and ancient magic require significant power to harness effectively.
midlands_item_whispering_amulet.vendorReason: Master Forger Kaelin of Fractured Forge specializes in ancient relics that combine the might of forge with the wisdom of serpents.
midlands_item_whispering_amulet.shippingDetail: The giant beetle courier delivers this item within a week, but only during full moon nights.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Whispering Warnings; 10 minutes for Trap Detection
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you take a short rest for Whispering Warnings; ends after the duration expires for Trap Detection.

midlands_item_whispering_amulet.priceReason: The item's legendary rarity and unique enchantments justify this balanced price in XP.

internet_glitch_stick.name: Pixelated Panic Stick
internet_glitch_stick.description: The Pixelated Panic Stick appears as a gnarled, digitalized wooden rod, adorned with faintly glowing pixels. It's said to have been crafted from the remnants of an ancient glitching interface. Upon use, it emits a brief burst of static that distorts vision and scrambles neural signals, causing temporary disorientation and stat debuffs in those affected. Wario assures that its 'totally bugged out' capabilities are perfect for disrupting formations or simply causing mayhem among the unprepared.

effectDetails.title: Distorts Vision
effectDetails.rules: When used, the Pixelated Panic Stick emits a burst of static that causes the target to become disoriented for 1 round. The target has disadvantage on all ability checks and attack rolls until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporarily Debuffs
effectDetails.rules: The target's Dexterity score is reduced by 2 temporarily, but can be regained with a successful Wisdom saving throw (DC 15).

internet_glitch_stick.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 9th level to wield effectively in combat.
internet_glitch_stick.vendorReason: Pixel Shop specializes in quirky gadgets and digital curiosities, making it a fitting vendor for the Pixelated Panic Stick.
internet_glitch_stick.shippingDetail: Ships via drone delivery within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts 1 round
usage.endsWhen: Target's next turn or upon the wielder taking another action
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per combat

internet_glitch_stick.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its quirky yet effective capabilities.

internet_meme_scroll.name: Eternal Dank Scroll
internet_meme_scroll.description: The Eternal Dank Scroll is a tattered relic of digital lore, its ink faded but still potent. Unleashing it in a room sends a ripple of laughter and chaos, with data spirits swirling around you. The scroll’s effects are unpredictable—some users find themselves momentarily invigorated, while others experience strange hallucinations that linger for days. Handle this scroll at your own peril; it's said to have once drawn the ire of ancient internet gods.

effectDetails.title: Laughter and Chaos
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate the scroll. On a d20 roll of 15 or higher (DC 15), you and all creatures within 30 feet must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they are charmed for 1 minute. On a success, they are temporarily immune to the scroll’s effects for 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Data Spirit Attraction
effectDetails.rules: The scroll attracts minor data spirits within 60 feet that may provide temporary bonuses or inflict debuffs. These spirits can be dismissed by anyone with a successful Intelligence saving throw (DC 18). The scroll’s effects last for 10 minutes.

internet_meme_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant concentration and presence of mind to safely handle.
internet_meme_scroll.vendorReason: The data_dealer specializes in relics from the digital age, including items like the Eternal Dank Scroll.
internet_meme_scroll.shippingDetail: Shipped via encrypted packet to ensure that no one else can access its contents.

usage.duration: 10 minutes or until dismissed by a successful Intelligence saving throw
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the scroll is destroyed, dismissed, or after 10 minutes

internet_meme_scroll.priceReason: Balanced against other legendary items of similar utility and risk.

internet_faction_access_key.name: The Algorithm's Pass
internet_faction_access_key.description: The Algorithm's Pass is a sleek, metallic key adorned with cryptic patterns that whisper of shadowy information networks. When activated, it grants temporary access to The Algorithm’s hidden channels, allowing you to communicate in ways unimagined by the public eye. However, this fleeting connection comes at a price: your intelligence and perception checks related to information gathering are enhanced, but so is your susceptibility to targeted advertising, which may leave you forever marked by their surveillance.
effects: grants access to secret communication channels
enhances intelligence and perception checks for info gathering

effectDetails.title: Access to Secret Channels
effectDetails.rules: This key grants a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus on Intelligence or Perception checks related to information gathering. The effect lasts until the end of your next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Risk of Monitoring
effectDetails.rules: While using this key, you have disadvantage on all saving throws against being detected by The Algorithm’s surveillance systems. This effect persists for 24 hours after the last use.

internet_faction_access_key.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a level 6 character to handle its complexity and the risks involved in accessing shadowy information networks.
internet_faction_access_key.vendorReason: The cyber market is known for dealing with high-risk, high-reward items that can provide access to hidden knowledge or resources.
internet_faction_access_key.shippingDetail: The package arrives securely encrypted and requires a password known only by the cyber market staff. The key must be activated within 24 hours of receiving it.

usage.activation: As an action, activate the key to gain its benefits for one hour.
usage.duration: One hour
usage.endsWhen: The end of your next short rest after use or if you are detected by The Algorithm’s systems.

internet_faction_access_key.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP as it grants temporary access to high-risk, high-value information networks and comes with significant risks.

teyvat_item_elemental_resonator.name: Resonating Echo Stone
teyvat_item_elemental_resonator.description: The Resonating Echo Stone is a smooth, pulsing stone that hums with the very essence of Teyvat. Crafted from the heartwood of the ancient Echo Trees and imbued with elemental energy, it amplifies your elemental affinity when held. Its pulsations resonate with the environment, making it perfect for creating dazzling displays or blasting enemies into submission. Just be wary; Wario's love for shiny objects is legendary, so keep this out of his reach!

effectDetails.title: Elemental Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Resonating Echo Stone amplifies your elemental affinity by increasing elemental damage dealt by 20% for 1 minute. The effect ends if you drop the stone or take any other action that requires an attack roll.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, holding the stone allows you to trigger a secondary elemental effect with your next elemental spell or ability at no additional cost. This effect is tied to the environment and can only occur once per day.

teyvat_item_elemental_resonator.levelRequirementReason: Players need to be at least level 9 to master the intricate energy manipulation required for this stone.
teyvat_item_elemental_resonator.vendorReason: The Mondstadt Market specializes in unique and exotic items from all over Teyvat, making it a fitting vendor for this stone.
teyvat_item_elemental_resonator.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Winged Sprites, known for their swift and precise deliveries within Teyvat.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; once per short rest.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until dropped or used in combat.
usage.endsWhen: Stone is dropped, used in combat, or 1 minute expires.

teyvat_item_elemental_resonator.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the stone's unique properties and the high demand for elemental amplification items among adventurers.

teyvat_item_kazuha_scroll.name: Fragment of the Wind's Whisper
teyvat_item_kazuha_scroll.description: The Fragment of the Wind's Whisper is a delicate scroll imbued with the essence of Kazuha, Inazuma’s wind dancer. When unrolled, its paper shimmers faintly as if brushed by a breeze. Gazing upon it allows you to momentarily escape time, dodging attacks with an almost inhuman grace. Some say the spirits of the wind whisper secrets during this brief reprieve, but the air around you grows thick and heavy after the effect fades.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Dodge
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction. You gain a +5 bonus to your Dexterity saving throws against attacks made during its duration, allowing you to dodge with uncanny precision. This effect lasts for 1 minute per use and ends immediately if you take any action other than moving.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Whispers
effectDetails.rules: At the end of each of your turns while this scroll is active, there’s a 20% chance that a wandering spirit will attempt to communicate with you. If successful, it grants you a +1 bonus to any Wisdom (Insight) check made before the next dawn.

teyvat_item_kazuha_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll's effects require concentration and focus, best suited for players who have reached at least third level.
teyvat_item_kazuha_scroll.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in artifacts from Teyvat, including those with ties to its legendary figures like Kazuha.
teyvat_item_kazuha_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships within the next rising moon cycle.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: You take any action other than moving or when the duration ends
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

teyvat_item_kazuha_scroll.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its unique effects and limited utility without being overpowered.

teyvat_item_xiaxi_charm.name: Jade Dragon's Blessing
teyvat_item_xiaxi_charm.description: This intricately carved jade charm, a fragment of ancient Xiaxi dragons, exudes a serene warmth that is said to bring good fortune to its wearer. Wielded in Liyue Harbor, it grants you +1 to luck and increases your charisma by 3, making you more adept at finding hidden treasures and avoiding misfortune. The charm's power can even enhance your interactions with the locals, making them more amenable to sharing their secrets.

effectDetails.title: +1 Luck
effectDetails.rules: When you roll initiative or ability checks, you may use this charm to gain a +1 bonus. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Your Charisma score is temporarily increased by 3 for the duration of one short rest. This boost can be used once per day, and it expires at the start of your next long rest.

teyvat_item_xiaxi_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm's power is accessible to all adventurers who wish to enhance their luck and charisma.
teyvat_item_xiaxi_charm.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor merchants are well-known for selling relics that bring good fortune, making this jade charm a popular item among travelers.
teyvat_item_xiaxi_charm.shippingDetail: The sea merchant ensures the swift delivery of this fragile artifact via a secure, waterborne route.

usage.activation: Use as an action at any time to gain the +1 Luck benefit for your next turn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you use it again or lose consciousness.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one instance of Charisma Boost can be active at a time.

teyvat_item_xiaxi_charm.priceReason: The jade's origin and the enhanced luck it provides justify its higher price, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer.

grand_country_chronometric_charm.name: Chronometric Charm of Temporal Distortion
grand_country_chronometric_charm.description: The Chronometric Charm of Temporal Distortion is a delicate silver locket adorned with etched gears and cogs, whispering faintly of time's flow. When activated, it slows foes' movements by a quarter, making them clumsy and off-balance for a brief spell. Simultaneously, the wearer gains an extra burst of speed, allowing them to dart away or strike faster than usual. The charm's power is unpredictable but potent, creating a fleeting echo of its effects in the space around it.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Slow
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this charm reduces all enemy creatures' attack and movement speeds by 25%, lasting for 3 seconds. There is no saving throw against this effect.

effectDetails.title: Swift Movement
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the wearer gains a +15% bonus to their walking speed for 3 seconds. This effect does not stack with other movement bonuses and has no save or range restrictions.

grand_country_chronometric_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm's intricate design requires a certain mastery of time manipulation, which is only achieved at level 10.
grand_country_chronometric_charm.vendorReason: Layer Market specializes in rare and exotic equipment that enhance one's abilities, making this charm an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_chronometric_charm.shippingDetail: The charm is delivered by the dimensional snail, ensuring it arrives intact through complex spatial distortions.

usage.duration: 3 seconds
usage.endsWhen: the duration expires or the wearer takes an action other than their movement

grand_country_chronometric_charm.priceReason: The charm's rarity and unique temporal effects justify its moderate price point, making it a valuable but not exorbitant addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

grand_country_stone_warden_badge.name: Stone Warden's Assurance Badge
grand_country_stone_warden_badge.description: The Stone Warden's Assurance Badge, crafted from ancient earth crystal and blessed by the enigmatic guardians of the land, offers more than just protection against gravity-based hazards. While donning this badge, you gain resistance to falling damage, and your connection to the elemental earth strengthens, potentially attracting helpful nudges from nearby earth elementals. This badge is a symbol of trust between the Stone Wardens and their allies; Wario might indeed find it useful for his eccentric adventures in the overworld.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Falling Damage
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this badge, you gain resistance to falling damage. This effect is passive and lasts for the duration of your concentration (up to 10 minutes). There is no save required.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Assistance
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, when you are within earshot of an earth elemental, it may offer a helpful nudge. This assistance can be used as a bonus action to grant you temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your Wisdom modifier. The elementals will only assist if they perceive the situation to be in harmony with nature.

grand_country_stone_warden_badge.levelRequirementReason: This badge requires at least 12th level due to its mystical connection to earth elements and protection against falling damage.
grand_country_stone_warden_badge.vendorReason: Layer Market, renowned for its connections with various factions, is trusted by the Stone Wardens to sell this emblem of their order.
grand_country_stone_warden_badge.shippingDetail: The badge is shipped in a specially enchanted cart that ensures it arrives in pristine condition, even over long distances.

usage.duration: Concentration duration until expended
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you lose concentration or rest

grand_country_stone_warden_badge.priceReason: The badge's rarity and the mystical properties it grants justify its high price in experience points.

internet_pixel_charm.name: Glitchy Good Luck Charm
internet_pixel_charm.description: This Glitchy Good Luck Charm appears to be a corrupted pixel charm, its surface shimmering with an eerie glow that seems to pulse with digital life. Crafted from salvaged data streams and imbued with chaotic fortune, it's said to attract random buffs that can throw your enemies into fits of confusion or leave you dancing to the rhythm of memes. Beware, for its effects are unpredictable—perfect for confusing foes or finding yourself in the center of a viral sensation.

effectDetails.title: Random Buffs
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn, there is a 20% chance that you gain advantage on one attack roll. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Confusion
effectDetails.rules: If an enemy within 5 feet of you rolls a natural 1 on their attack roll, they are confused for the start of their next turn (no action required). The confusion ends at the end of their next turn. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per long rest.

internet_pixel_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm's unpredictable effects make it accessible to lower-level characters who might benefit from its random buffing.
internet_pixel_charm.vendorReason: Pixel Shop specializes in quirky and tech-savvy items, making this charm a perfect fit for their inventory.
internet_pixel_charm.shippingDetail: Ships via Drone Delivery with an estimated delivery time of 24 hours.

usage.activation: Passive effect; occurs automatically at the start of your turn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, recharges after a short or long rest depending on the effect used.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon the end of the respective rest period.

internet_pixel_charm.priceReason: The charm's unpredictable effects and unique origin story justify a higher price, aligning with its common rarity.

internet_data_surge.name: Overclocked Neural Implant
internet_data_surge.description: The Overclocked Neural Implant hums like a digital engine, its sleek titanium casing adorned with arcane symbols that glow faintly in the dark. This implant enhances your neural processing by leaps and bounds, temporarily granting access to vast arcane data streams. However, those who wear it risk succumbing to sudden bursts of internet nostalgia or inexplicable fits of trivia-sharing. Use cautiously, for it might just overload your mind with information overload!

effectDetails.title: Arcane Data Access
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to gain +8 Intelligence for 6 turns. During this time, you have advantage on Intelligence checks and saving throws. The effect ends if you are incapacitated or if your Intelligence score is reduced below 10.

effectDetails.title: Meme Tempest
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, activate as an action to unleash a wave of internet memes that deal 1d6 necrotic damage and spread viral knowledge. Creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of their next turn.

internet_data_surge.levelRequirementReason: The implant's advanced technology requires a high level of neural stability to safely interface with your brain.
internet_data_surge.vendorReason: The cyber_market specializes in cutting-edge cybernetic enhancements and tech artifacts, making it the go-to vendor for such powerful implants.
internet_data_surge.shippingDetail: Shipped via encrypted data packets ensuring confidentiality and integrity of delivery.

usage.activation: Activate as a bonus action or once per short rest as an action.
usage.duration: Arcane Data Access lasts for 6 turns; Meme Tempest has a cooldown of one short rest.
usage.endsWhen: Arcane Data Access ends if you are incapacitated or your Intelligence score is reduced below 10. Meme Tempest ends after its duration or if the effect is dispelled.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only once per short rest for Meme Tempest.

internet_data_surge.priceReason: The implant's advanced technology and limited availability justify a premium price in the cyber_market.

internet_godly_meme_artifact.name: The Infinite Loop Amulet
internet_godly_meme_artifact.description: The Infinite Loop Amulet, a shimmering locket crafted from ancient obsidian and enigmatic runes, is said to have been forged by a deity who sought to capture the essence of the perfect internet loop. Wearing it allows you to briefly warp reality, causing time to loop for your enemies, rendering them disoriented and confused. The amulet's power is not without cost; prolonged use can send you spiraling into an existential dread that grips your soul. Players of all stripes would find this relic a treasure, especially in the hands of those who know how to wield it wisely.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Loop
effectDetails.rules: By using an action, you cause a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on yourself to loop in time for up to 1 minute. All creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented until the start of their next turn. Creatures that fail this save are also knocked prone and take 3d6 necrotic damage. The amulet can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Undead Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to fear effects and deal an additional +1d8 damage to undead creatures for 1 hour, starting when you don the amulet. This effect lasts until you remove it or until a long rest is completed.

internet_godly_meme_artifact.levelRequirementReason: The Infinite Loop Amulet's power demands a high level of mastery and control to avoid its potentially catastrophic effects.
internet_godly_meme_artifact.vendorReason: The data dealer has unique access to ancient artifacts from the digital realm, making The Infinite Loop Amulet an item they are privy to.
internet_godly_meme_artifact.shippingDetail: Ships via Quantum Courier's dimensional express, ensuring safe and swift delivery of this potent relic.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn after the loop ends or if you are incapacitated

internet_godly_meme_artifact.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the amulet's powerful yet controlled effects and its rarity as an ancient deity’s creation.

almost_edge_item_chronal_echo.name: Chronal Echo of Lost Moments
almost_edge_item_chronal_echo.description: The Chronal Echo of Lost Moments is a shimmering glass sphere etched with ancient runes. When activated, it briefly replays scenes from forgotten realities, offering glimpses into the void's past. Its touch is cool to the hand and its surface glows with a faint, spectral light. Staring too long can cause disorientation; indeed, those who gaze upon it for more than 10 seconds risk becoming trapped in an infinite loop of existential dread.

effectDetails.title: Replay Forgotten Moments
effectDetails.rules: The user must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they are incapacitated for 1 minute due to an infinite loop of existential dread. On a successful save, the item briefly replays scenes from forgotten realities within a 30-foot radius for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Wisdom Boost
effectDetails.rules: The user gains +2 to their Wisdom (Insight) checks and saving throws until the end of their next turn. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

almost_edge_item_chronal_echo.levelRequirementReason: To safely handle the echoes of lost moments, a character must have reached at least level 16 to navigate such profound metaphysical phenomena.
almost_edge_item_chronal_echo.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in arcane curiosities and ephemeral artifacts, making them an ideal vendor for the Chronal Echo of Lost Moments.
almost_edge_item_chronal_echo.shippingDetail: Delivered by a spectral messenger, this item requires special handling to ensure it reaches its destination without any disturbances.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends immediately if the user fails their saving throw or if they are incapacitated for more than 10 seconds.
usage.charges: Uses: 1; Recharge: Once per long rest

almost_edge_item_chronal_echo.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and the careful handling required, making it a balanced addition to any adventurer's inventory.

pokemon_item_sparkling_potion.name: Sparkling Potion of Evolution!
pokemon_item_sparkling_potion.description: The Sparkling Potion of Evolution! bubbles and fizzles in your hand, its surface shimmering like a starlit sky. This potion is said to have been crafted from ancient berries found deep within uncharted forests, rumored to hold the essence of evolution itself. Drinking it instantly transforms one wild Pokémon into its evolved form, but the results are unpredictable—some say the evolutions are always as expected, while others swear they're completely unexpected. A gamble, indeed, that carries with it a +1 bonus to luck for 30 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Instant Evolution
effectDetails.rules: Activates on consumption as an action. Instantly transforms one wild Pokémon into its evolved form. The evolution is unpredictable; it could be the expected result or a complete surprise, leaving the user to wonder what they've unleashed.

effectDetails.title: Luck Bonus
effectDetails.rules: Grants +1 bonus to luck for 30 seconds after consuming the potion. This effect is instantaneous and lasts until either the duration expires or the user uses their action on another task.

pokemon_item_sparkling_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion requires no level, as it is a common item that can be found in Pokemarts.
pokemon_item_sparkling_potion.vendorReason: Pokemarts are known for selling items that can help train and evolve Pokémon quickly and easily.
pokemon_item_sparkling_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly by the trusted Poke-Drones, ensuring you receive your Sparkling Potion of Evolution! as soon as possible.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for evolution; +1 luck bonus lasts for 30 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the user takes another action.

pokemon_item_sparkling_potion.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unpredictable nature and utility in evolving Pokémon quickly.

pokemon_item_trainer_consultation.name: Elite Trainer Consultation
pokemon_item_trainer_consultation.description: Honed by years of experience in the Pokémon League, Elite Trainer Consultation is a one-hour session where you receive an in-depth analysis of your team’s performance and potential. The seasoned trainer will pinpoint your Pokémon's strengths and weaknesses, offering strategic advice on battling techniques and even suggesting paths to evolution that could turn your underdogs into champions. With this consultation, your team not only gains tactical improvements but also the confidence to tackle any challenge.

effectDetails.title: Tactical Boost
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after consulting with an Elite Trainer, your Pokémon gain a +2 bonus to attack and defense. This effect ends when the consultation duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: Your Pokémon's morale is bolstered by 1 point for each level of the Pokémon in your team, up to a maximum increase of +5. This boost lasts until the next rest or until you enter battle again.

pokemon_item_trainer_consultation.levelRequirementReason: Even beginners can benefit from strategic advice and morale support.
pokemon_item_trainer_consultation.vendorReason: The league store is the official source for expert consultations within the Pokémon League ecosystem.
pokemon_item_trainer_consultation.shippingDetail: The courier ensures that your consultation arrives fresh and ready to be scheduled immediately.

usage.activation: A single use, activated by scheduling a one-hour session with an Elite Trainer.
usage.duration: One hour from the start of the consultation.
usage.endsWhen: The consultation ends or when you enter battle again.

pokemon_item_trainer_consultation.priceReason: Balanced to offer strategic advantage without being game-breaking, this service is priced at 1000 XP.

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_fragment.name: Fragment of the Obsidian Badge
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_fragment.description: The Fragment of the Obsidian Badge is a dark, obsidian-colored shard that glows faintly with an eerie violet light. It seems to hum with latent power, as if it’s waiting for the right wielder to unleash its full potential. Legends speak of this fragment granting immense strength and shadowy allies to those who possess it. Wario might indeed covet such a relic, but only those attuned to dark magic can truly harness its raw power.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Invocation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can summon a small shadow Pokémon that fights by their side. The shadow Pokémon lasts for 1 minute and provides a +2 to attack rolls. If the wielder is reduced to 0 hit points while the shadow Pokémon is present, it dissipates immediately.

effectDetails.title: Darkened Aura
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +1 bonus to all attack rolls and saving throws until the end of their next turn. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Wielders must have sufficient experience and training in dark magic to properly handle such a powerful fragment.
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_fragment.vendorReason: The Safari Shop has exclusive access to relics from legendary tournaments, making it the place for rare artifacts like this fragment.
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via the Shadow Delivery Service; requires a special dark magic ritual at the destination.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn for Darkened Aura, and 1 minute for summoning a shadow Pokémon
usage.endsWhen: At the start of the wielder's next turn without use, or if reduced to 0 hit points.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per long rest.

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_fragment.priceReason: The fragment’s rarity and the power it unlocks justify its relatively steep price in experience points.

almost_edge_chronal_brace.name: Chronal Brace of the Shifting Rim
almost_edge_chronal_brace.description: The Chronal Brace of the Shifting Rim is a sleek, metallic bracelet that hums with a temporal energy, as if it holds the very fabric of time in its links. Crafted from an alloy of forgotten stars and ancient chronal dust, this bauble subtly warps reality around you, granting quick reflexes and the ability to briefly correct minor mistakes by rewinding time. However, those who wield it must beware: a single slip can attract the wrath of temporal entities that guard the integrity of the timeline.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Reflex Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this bracelet, you gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws and a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Brief Rewind
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can rewind time for 3 seconds, allowing you to correct one minor mistake or error. Creatures within a 5-foot radius must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and unable to move for the duration of your next turn.

almost_edge_chronal_brace.levelRequirementReason: This bracelet requires significant control over temporal energies, making it suitable only for those who have proven their mastery at a high level.
almost_edge_chronal_brace.vendorReason: The Void Merchant deals in the most esoteric and powerful items from across dimensions, including this time-altering bracelet.
almost_edge_chronal_brace.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dimensional Courier, known for its swift but unpredictable delivery times.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Temporal Reflex Boost), 3 seconds (Brief Rewind)
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn unless used again or expended.
usage.charges: 1 charge, recharges after a long rest

almost_edge_chronal_brace.priceReason: The bracelet's rarity and unique temporal properties justify its price in experienced adventurers' gold.

almost_edge_echoing_shard.name: Echoing Shard of the Lost Perimeter
almost_edge_echoing_shard.description: The Echoing Shard of the Lost Perimeter is a fractured fragment of a mirror that once belonged to a forgotten realm. When held, it reveals glimpses of alternate dimensions—distorted images that can be both disorienting and enlightening. The shard whispers inaudible melodies that seem to guide you towards hidden paths, but they are fleeting and may not always lead where you intend. Holding the shard also enhances your Perception by a noticeable degree, making you more attuned to subtle details around you.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse of Alternate Dimensions
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can focus on the shard to briefly see glimpses of alternate dimensions. These visions last for 1 minute and give you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to hidden paths or secret doors within that time frame. The shard must be held during this effect's duration.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: While holding the shard, your passive Perception score increases by 5 until you rest for more than an hour. This enhancement does not stack with other sources of increased Perception.

almost_edge_echoing_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's dimensions are complex and require a certain level of magical attunement to fully grasp.
almost_edge_echoing_shard.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader often deals with relics from other realms, making this shard a fitting addition to their collection.
almost_edge_echoing_shard.shippingDetail: The Spectral Postman delivers the shard via a shadowy courier who may appear at any time of day or night, ensuring swift delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute per activation
usage.endsWhen: You rest for more than an hour after using it

almost_edge_echoing_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the unique abilities it offers justify its fair value of 1000 XP.

internet_data_weave.name: Byte-Sized Battle Armor
internet_data_weave.description: Byte-Sized Battle Armor, forged from compressed data streams and woven from the very fabric of digital networks, provides a surprising layer of defense against cyber threats. This armor not only reduces damage from digital attacks by 20%, but also has a rare ability to reflect up to half of incoming data-based spells with every successful reflection. The armor's sleek design ensures minimal hindrance in movement or combat, though it still requires careful handling to avoid system crashes.

effectDetails.title: Reflects Data-Based Spells
effectDetails.rules: When a data-based spell is successfully cast against the wearer, there's a 5% chance that the spell will be reflected back at the caster. The armor absorbs and redirects half of the spell’s energy. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reduces Digital Damage
effectDetails.rules: The armor increases resistance to digital attacks by 20%. This provides a passive defense boost that applies continuously while worn, until the wearer is no longer in direct contact with a data-based attack source.

internet_data_weave.levelRequirementReason: The armor requires basic understanding of cybernetic systems to operate effectively.
internet_data_weave.vendorReason: Cyber Market specializes in cutting-edge technology and digital defense gear, making Byte-Sized Battle Armor a natural fit for their offerings.
internet_data_weave.shippingDetail: Delivered via encrypted data streams to ensure safe and swift arrival at your doorstep.

usage.duration: Continuous while worn
usage.endsWhen: Removed or no longer in contact with a digital attack source

internet_data_weave.priceReason: Reflecting data-based spells and reducing damage from cyber attacks provide significant benefits for digital adventurers, making this armor a valuable yet balanced investment.

earth_land_warriors_feast.name: Wario's Champion's Banquet
earth_land_warriors_feast.description: Wario's Champion's Banquet is a colossal platter, its surface gleaming with layers of roasted boar and honey-glazed sausages that could fuel an entire regiment for a full day. The magically preserved fruit adds to the feast's legendary sustenance, ensuring no one will starve while they partake. Devour this banquet and you'll feel invigorated, your muscles rippling as strength surges through you—just be wary of the inevitable food coma that follows.

effectDetails.title: Strength Surge
effectDetails.rules: On activation, gain a +4 bonus to Strength for up to two turns. This effect cannot be gained more than once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sustaining Feast
effectDetails.rules: Consume the banquet and restore 50 hit points instantly. You are immune to the effects of fear for the next hour, after which you must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become stunned until the start of your next turn.

earth_land_warriors_feast.levelRequirementReason: This banquet is suitable for any brave soul who dares to partake in its legendary feast.
earth_land_warriors_feast.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium prides itself on offering the most remarkable and nourishing items, including Wario's Champion's Banquet.
earth_land_warriors_feast.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant beetle cart that will arrive at your door within the hour.

usage.duration: Two turns for Strength Surge; one hour for Sustaining Feast, after which immunity to fear ends and you must make a saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires or if consumed again before the next long rest.

earth_land_warriors_feast.priceReason: This banquet, while not as rare as some epic items, still requires significant resources to prepare and ensure its magical properties.

equestria_item_stirring_spoon.name: Apple Pie Stirring Spoon of Culinary Mastery
equestria_item_stirring_spoon.description: The Apple Pie Stirring Spoon of Culinary Mastery is a gleaming silver utensil forged in the heart of Equestria, imbued with Granny Smith's culinary wisdom. This enchanted spoon ensures your pies bake to perfection every time you stir three clockwise rotations. Its faint cinnamon scent hints at its magical origins, and it guarantees a 10% increase in cooking speed while reducing food waste by 25%. A true chef’s secret weapon.

effectDetails.title: Increases Cooking Speed (+10%)
effectDetails.rules: When used to stir ingredients, this spoon increases the cooking speed by 10%. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a saving throw or other action.

effectDetails.title: Reduces Food Waste (25% chance)
effectDetails.rules: This spoon has a 25% chance of reducing food waste during preparation. It activates on the first use, providing a single instance of reduced waste for that meal. No save is required to activate this effect.

equestria_item_stirring_spoon.levelRequirementReason: All culinary tools are accessible to beginners and experienced chefs alike.
equestria_item_stirring_spoon.vendorReason: The Ponyville Market offers a wide array of supplies, including rare and useful items like the Apple Pie Stirring Spoon.
equestria_item_stirring_spoon.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pegasus Express, this spoon is delivered swiftly to your doorstep within three days.

usage.activation: Passive effect when used for stirring ingredients during cooking.
usage.duration: Instantaneous (one-time use per meal)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after one use per meal
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one instance of reduced food waste per meal.

equestria_item_stirring_spoon.priceReason: This spoon's rare enchantment and unique benefits justify its moderate price in XP.

equestria_item_twinkleberry_dust.name: Twinkleberry Dust of Fleeting Dreams
equestria_item_twinkleberry_dust.description: Twinkleberry Dust of Fleeting Dreams is a shimmering powder collected from the rarest Twinkleberries in Equestria. It induces incredibly vivid and pleasant dreams, often leaving you humming melodies or chasing after iridescent butterflies. The dust originates from the whimsical lands of Cloudsdale, where it's said to carry the essence of starlight itself. Its effects are both delightful and enchanting; prolonged use might lead to a mild compulsion to sing or dance in meadows under the moonlit sky.

effectDetails.title: Dream Fragments
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this dust grants the user a short sleep effect (+2 turns) during which there's a 10% chance to gain a dream fragment (equivalent to an experience point). The duration is limited to 8 hours per day. This effect ends if the user takes any harmful action or if they wake up naturally.

effectDetails.title: Melodic Dreams
effectDetails.rules: While under the influence of this dust, there's a +10% chance that any song you sing will be accompanied by a burst of starlight and melody. This effect lasts for 24 hours after consumption but is ended if the user uses their voice in a harmful manner or if they fall into a nightmare.

equestria_item_twinkleberry_dust.levelRequirementReason: This item's effects are mild enough that even low-level adventurers can enjoy its benefits without facing undue danger.
equestria_item_twinkleberry_dust.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire is known for its connection to the stars, making it a fitting vendor for this celestial powder.
equestria_item_twinkleberry_dust.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift and reliable Crystal Couriers, ensuring the dust arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Eaten or sprinkled on food before sleep.
usage.duration: 8 hours per day for 'Dream Fragments'; 24 hours for 'Melodic Dreams'.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends naturally, or if the user takes harmful actions while under its influence.

equestria_item_twinkleberry_dust.priceReason: This item is priced high due to its rarity and the limited daily stock, reflecting both its magical properties and the effort required for its collection.

earth_land_potion_of_sticky_feet.name: Potion of Sticky Feet
earth_land_potion_of_sticky_feet.description: The Earth Land Potion of Sticky Feet is a peculiar brew that leaves your feet firmly planted to the ground, creating an adhesive bond with the earth. Upon consumption, you find yourself immobilized for 2 minutes, perfect for setting up a surprise ambush or escaping from sticky situations. The concoction's piney scent hints at its natural origin, but it's the despair in the air that truly captures your attention as you consume it.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Feet Duration
effectDetails.rules: You become immobilized for a duration of 120 seconds. This effect can be ended by taking any action that requires movement, such as walking or casting a spell with a somatic component.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Effect
effectDetails.rules: Your feet are glued to the ground, granting you advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to move. You can use your reaction once per short rest to attempt an Acrobatics check as part of a movement action.

earth_land_potion_of_sticky_feet.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for beginners, allowing them to experiment with battlefield positioning without the need for higher-level abilities.
earth_land_potion_of_sticky_feet.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster stocks this item as part of its essential survival kit, catering to adventurers in training and those needing a practical trick up their sleeve.
earth_land_potion_of_sticky_feet.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Swift Courier within 3 days from the time of purchase.

usage.duration: 120 seconds
usage.endsWhen: You take any action that requires movement or upon natural expiration after 2 minutes

earth_land_potion_of_sticky_feet.priceReason: The price reflects the potion's unique properties and the resources needed to craft it, including rare herbs and a mysterious earth element.

earth_land_amulet_of_dragon_favor.name: Amulet of Dragon Favor
earth_land_amulet_of_dragon_favor.description: The Amulet of Dragon Favor is crafted from a gleaming dragon scale found in the heart of ancient ruins. Its surface crackles with arcane energy, and its scent subtly intoxicates those nearby. Wearing it grants you fire resistance and a chance to charm grumpy dragons into cooperative moods, but be wary—its power comes at a cost: it can only be worn by someone who has proven their worth through trials of valor.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to fire damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after you take fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Charm Grumpy Dragons
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, as a bonus action, you can attempt to charm one grumpy dragon within 30 feet with a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. On a success, the dragon becomes cooperative for 1 hour.

earth_land_amulet_of_dragon_favor.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have proven their worth through trials of valor are deemed worthy to wear this amulet.
earth_land_amulet_of_dragon_favor.vendorReason: Magic Shop specializes in rare and powerful artifacts that can aid adventurers on their quests.
earth_land_amulet_of_dragon_favor.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered swiftly by a winged snail, ensuring it arrives fresh from the dragon's heart.

usage.activation: Bonus action to charm a grumpy dragon; passive fire resistance granted upon donning.
usage.duration: Passive effect until start of next turn after taking fire damage; one use per short or long rest for charming dragons.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted at the end of a short or long rest, destroyed if worn by someone unworthy.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses as long as you are worthy.

earth_land_amulet_of_dragon_favor.priceReason: The amulet's value lies in its rarity and the power it offers to those who have earned their right to wear it.

earth_land_scroll_of_minor_illusion.name: Scroll of Minor Illusion
earth_land_scroll_of_minor_illusion.description: This ancient, parchment scroll bears the faded image of a shimmering mirage that dances in the heat. Crafted from weathered vellum and sealed with earth magic, it is said to have been penned by an enigmatic sorcerer who sought to deceive and divert. The spell it contains, though minor, can still fool the unwary into seeing what isn't there, making it a valuable tool for those who value subtlety over brute force.

effectDetails.title: Cast Minor Illusion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action to cast the minor illusion spell. The duration is 1d4 rounds, during which the illusion can create a sound or image that can be seen by one creature of your choice within 30 feet.

effectDetails.title: Limited Uses
effectDetails.rules: The scroll has only three charges. Once used, it must rest for at least an hour before it can be recharged. Failing to do so risks the spell's effects being disrupted or reduced in potency.

earth_land_scroll_of_minor_illusion.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is designed for beginners and those who value stealth over raw power.
earth_land_scroll_of_minor_illusion.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in magical curiosities derived from the earth and its secrets, making it a fitting vendor for this enchanted scroll.
earth_land_scroll_of_minor_illusion.shippingDetail: Ships via giant beetle courier; delivery can be delayed by up to one week due to unpredictable travel conditions.

usage.activation: Activates as an action, expending one of its three charges.
usage.duration: 1d4 rounds per use.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the round count is depleted or the scroll runs out of charges.

earth_land_scroll_of_minor_illusion.priceReason: While not a high-level item, this scroll offers significant utility for those who need to cast minor illusion spells frequently and discreetly, justifying its higher price in experience points.

pokemon_item_volcanic_charm.name: Volcanic Charm
pokemon_item_volcanic_charm.description: The Volcanic Charm is a molten trinket that pulses with the heat of an active volcano, emanating a warm glow when near lava or fire sources. Crafted from obsidian and volcanic glass, it grants the wearer resistance to fire damage and enhances their attack rolls by +2 when in close proximity to active magma. This charm has a slight chance to ignite enemies on contact, making it a dangerous yet valuable tool for any adventuring party.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to fire damage while the Volcanic Charm is active. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Attack (Near Lava)
effectDetails.rules: When within 30 feet of an active lava source, the user's attack rolls are increased by +2 until the start of their next turn. This effect can only activate once per short or long rest.

pokemon_item_volcanic_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm is accessible to all adventurers who wish to harness its fiery power.
pokemon_item_volcanic_charm.vendorReason: Pikachu, the Electric Mouse, has a knack for finding rare volcanic artifacts and sells this charm in his Pokemart.
pokemon_item_volcanic_charm.shippingDetail: The Volcanic Charm is delivered by a Poke-Drone directly to your doorstep, ensuring it arrives with minimal risk of damage.

usage.duration: Lasts until the end of the wearer's next turn or until destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the charm is removed from a lava source, destroyed in combat, or after one short rest for enhanced attack rolls.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the charm does not recharge.

pokemon_item_volcanic_charm.priceReason: The Volcanic Charm's price reflects its rare volcanic origin and unique properties that enhance both defense and offense.

pokemon_item_league_badge_honor.name: Badge of League Honor
pokemon_item_league_badge_honor.description: The Badge of League Honor is a gleaming, intricate piece of jewelry crafted from polished obsidian and platinum, inscribed with the emblems of past champions. Worn by elite trainers who have conquered every league challenge, this badge not only enhances your stats but also grants you the aura of an undefeated warrior on the battlefield. When you wear it in battle, there's a chance that any Pokémon captured will be weakened temporarily, ensuring its loyalty to you.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Trainer Stats
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Badge of League Honor, your speed and luck are increased by +5. This effect is passive and does not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Weaken Captured Pokémon
effectDetails.rules: Once per battle, when you successfully capture a Pokémon, there's a 20% chance that its stats will be reduced by one stage for the rest of the encounter. This effect is triggered on successful capture and cannot be used more than once per battle.

pokemon_item_league_badge_honor.levelRequirementReason: Only trainers with significant experience, as evidenced by their level, can wield this prestigious badge.
pokemon_item_league_badge_honor.vendorReason: The league store is the official purveyor of all items and badges earned through its competitions.
pokemon_item_league_badge_honor.shippingDetail: This item arrives promptly via the Elite Courier service, ensuring that your badge reaches you in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Permanent until removed or lost.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the badge is removed or lost.

pokemon_item_league_badge_honor.priceReason: This badge's price reflects its mythic rarity and the prestige it bestows, making it a significant but fair investment for elite trainers.

pokemon_item_safariboots_shadow.name: Safari Boots of Shadowstep
pokemon_item_safariboots_shadow.description: The Safari Boots of Shadowstep are crafted from shadowy leather imbued with ancient forest magic. These boots allow you to move silently through dense foliage and evade detection, making them ideal for covert operations or stealthy pursuits in the wild. With a tap of your foot, they activate, granting you an eerie speed that can only be matched by the shadows themselves, and a chance to slip past even the most vigilant eyes.

effectDetails.title: Ethereal Speed
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate these boots. For 1 minute, your movement speed increases by +3 feet and you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. The effect ends early if you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Evasion
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, you can activate this ability to have a 50% chance to evade an attack made against you. If successful, the attacker misses completely. This uses one charge; if used while you are incapacitated, all charges expended.

pokemon_item_safariboots_shadow.levelRequirementReason: The boots' magic is potent but not overwhelming, making them accessible to adventurers of any class or background.
pokemon_item_safariboots_shadow.vendorReason: As the Safari Shop specializes in gear for tracking and exploration, these boots are a natural fit for their inventory.
pokemon_item_safariboots_shadow.shippingDetail: The Courier ensures swift delivery with minimal delay, often arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Ethereal Speed; once per short or long rest to use Shadow Evasion
usage.duration: 1 minute (Ethereal Speed); instantaneous (Shadow Evasion)
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitated or ends at the start of your next turn.
usage.charges: 5 charges, recharged after a short or long rest

pokemon_item_safariboots_shadow.priceReason: The boots' unique combination of stealth and speed makes them highly sought-after by adventurers, justifying this price.

midlands_item_tacticians_briefing.name: Strategic Insight Session
midlands_item_tacticians_briefing.description: Feeling lost on the battlefield? Let Master Silas, a retired general obsessed with strategy and oddly shaped hats, spend an hour analyzing your current situation. He’ll offer… *suggestions*.  Don’t expect miracles; he mostly just argues about logistics and occasionally suggests building a moat.
effects: grant +3 to next tactical decision roll
chance to gain a temporary advantage on a single combat encounter (50%)
recipient gains -1 to charisma checks for 1 hour (due to excessive pontification)

midlands_item_broken_banner.name: Fragment of the Fallen Standard
midlands_item_broken_banner.description: The Fragment of the Fallen Standard, a tattered banner of crimson silk now muddied and torn, radiates an aura that subtly boosts nearby warriors' morale but also stirs unsettling memories in onlookers. Those who hold it may feel compelled to issue forgotten commands, inadvertently drawing unwanted attention from vigilant guards. The banner's weight seems heavier than its fragile appearance suggests, reducing the wearer’s pace by 10% as if encumbered.
effects: +1 Morale Boost within a Small Radius
midlands_item_broken_banner.shippedBy: a sturdy cart with a team of mules

effectDetails.title: Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: Allies within 30 feet gain +1 to morale checks for the duration of one short rest. The effect ends if the wielder drops or abandons the banner.

effectDetails.title: Hostility Provocation
effectDetails.rules: The wielder has disadvantage on stealth checks and may provoke an attack from any nearby guard within 60 feet when they issue a command or shout out of turn. This effect ends after three uses per day, requiring a short rest to reset.

midlands_item_broken_banner.levelRequirementReason: Even a novice can recognize the banner's potential to inspire and incite, making it accessible from level 1.
midlands_item_broken_banner.vendorReason: The artisans of Fractured Forge salvage relics and artifacts, ensuring that even remnants of forgotten banners find their way into capable hands.
midlands_item_broken_banner.shippingDetail: Careful handling is required to ensure the banner's tattered state remains intact during transit.

usage.duration: One short rest for morale boost, ends after three uses per day for hostility provocation
usage.endsWhen: The wielder drops or abandons the banner, or they take damage

midlands_item_broken_banner.priceReason: This relic's balanced price reflects its dual-edged utility and historical significance in inspiring and provoking.

connectopia_pioneer_graffiti_kit.name: Wario's Blocky Blitz Kit
connectopia_pioneer_graffiti_kit.description: Wario's Blocky Blitz Kit is a set of vibrant, block-shaped paint cans and specialized nozzles, all forged in Wario’s own workshop. This kit allows you to transform any surface into a chaotic masterpiece or a pixelated caricature of Wario's face. The paints adhere with surprising strength, and the nozzles can spray in intricate patterns, making it easy to leave your mark on the world—or just create an eyesore that draws unwanted attention from passersby.

effectDetails.title: Visual Distraction
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the kit, you can spray a block pattern on any flat surface within 10 feet. This creates an area of visual distraction that lasts for 1 minute. Any creature within this area must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become distracted (disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks) until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Increased Charisma
effectDetails.rules: For as long as you carry Wario's Blocky Blitz Kit, your Charisma score is increased by 1. This bonus lasts for a short rest or when you finish a long rest.

connectopia_pioneer_graffiti_kit.levelRequirementReason: This kit requires no level because it’s designed to be accessible and fun for all adventurers.
connectopia_pioneer_graffiti_kit.vendorReason: Pioneer Post often carries unique and colorful items that appeal to travelers and artists alike, making Wario's Blocky Blitz Kit a perfect fit.
connectopia_pioneer_graffiti_kit.shippingDetail: The paints are shipped in sturdy block-shaped containers that ensure they arrive unbroken. Delivery can take up to two weeks due to the unique packaging.

usage.duration: Instantaneous spray, lasts for 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The distraction ends when a creature succeeds on its saving throw or leaves the area

connectopia_pioneer_graffiti_kit.priceReason: Despite being common in rarity, this kit’s unique design and utility justify its high price.

doughnut_hole_glimmering_crumb.name: Glimmering Crumb of Nullity
doughnut_hole_glimmering_crumb.description: The Glimmering Crumb of Nullity, a strangely iridescent morsel that seems to defy gravity, occasionally floating upwards before gently falling back down. This ethereal treat grants a brief moment of spatial resistance, allowing you to sidestep the treacherous pulls of void-worms, and provides a fleeting surge in agility, enhancing your dexterity for those critical moments of escape. Consumed with a sip of water, this crumb is said to originate from the forgotten realms of Nullity itself.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Spatial Anomalies
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after consuming this crumb, you gain resistance to any effect that would pull or push you. If you are subjected to such an effect during this duration, you can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to negate it.

effectDetails.title: Agility Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the same minute-long duration, your speed is increased by 10 feet and you gain advantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. This effect does not stack with other similar abilities.

doughnut_hole_glimmering_crumb.levelRequirementReason: This crumb's effects are potent enough to be useful for even the most novice adventurers.
doughnut_hole_glimmering_crumb.vendorReason: Hole Hawker, known for their eccentric and otherworldly goods, frequently travels through Nullity's borders in search of such exotic delicacies.
doughnut_hole_glimmering_crumb.shippingDetail: The Dimensional Courier ensures swift delivery via the void-worms' natural tunnels, guaranteeing safe arrival within a day from purchase.

usage.activation: Eaten with a sip of water; can be consumed once per long rest.
usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when it expires or you take damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, one use per long rest.

doughnut_hole_glimmering_crumb.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant but not overpowered effect for the price, making it accessible yet valuable.

doughnut_hole_chronal_donut.name: Chronal Donut of Temporal Distortion
doughnut_hole_chronal_donut.description: The Chronal Donut of Temporal Distortion is a sugary vortex that briefly warps spacetime. Its core, a golden Chronal Core, emits a faint hum as it distorts reality around you. With each bite, you can either speed up your attacks by +1d6 to attack rolls or slow down enemy attack speeds by -20%. Timing its use is key; the donut's effects last for 1 round and can be toggled once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Speed Attack
effectDetails.rules: When you consume a bite of this donut, you gain advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. This effect can be toggled once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Slow Enemy
effectDetails.rules: Additionally, any enemy that starts its turn within 5 feet of you has its speed reduced by -20% for 1 round. This effect also toggles once per short rest.

doughnut_hole_chronal_donut.levelRequirementReason: This donut requires a level 8 character to consume due to the complex magical energies it contains.
doughnut_hole_chronal_donut.vendorReason: Center Seller specializes in rare and exotic items that can alter one's capabilities, making this donut an ideal addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_chronal_donut.shippingDetail: Ships within the week via Swift Courier, ensuring you receive your Chronal Donut promptly.

usage.activation: Eating a bite of the donut as an action
usage.duration: 1 round per effect toggled
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn or when the donut is consumed
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can be toggled once per short rest

doughnut_hole_chronal_donut.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare and powerful effects.

doughnut_hole_singularity_core.name: Singularity Core Fragment
doughnut_hole_singularity_core.description: The Singularity Core Fragment hums with raw, unyielding void energy, its pulsating surface a swirling maelstrom of darkness and light. This fragment is said to have been forged from the heart of a collapsed star, now reduced to a shard barely contained within the grip of an experienced wielder. Its use grants incredible power, but at the cost of unraveling one's very essence; prolonged exposure risks disintegration or worse, transforming the user into a void creature.

effectDetails.title: Void Shift
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can unleash a localized distortion of space and time. This creates a 5-foot radius area centered on them that warps for 1 minute. Any creature within this effect must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be disoriented for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Grant Damage
effectDetails.rules: The wielder can deal 10 force damage to a target of their choice with a successful melee attack. This effect has no cooldown and can be used once per short rest.

doughnut_hole_singularity_core.levelRequirementReason: Only those with advanced martial training and a deep understanding of the void can wield this fragment without risking their sanity.
doughnut_hole_singularity_core.vendorReason: The Void Vendor is known for dealing in forbidden items, including those that manipulate the fabric of reality itself, making them an ideal merchant for such a dangerous artifact.
doughnut_hole_singularity_core.shippingDetail: Ships via Black Hole Express, which guarantees safe delivery to even the most hostile regions. The package is sealed with cosmic runes to prevent any tampering.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (as a bonus action)
usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing for Void Shift; instantaneous for Grant Damage
usage.endsWhen: Disruption, saving throw success, or the end of the wielder's next turn for Void Shift. Ends when used in Grant Damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but once per short rest for Void Shift
