midlands_item_divine_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped via a dragon cart, the amulet arrives with a flourish, ensuring its delivery is both dramatic and timely.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until expended.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts after three uses or when destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but expends 1 charge each time it successfully causes an effect.

midlands_item_divine_amulet.priceReason: The amulet’s rarity and the balance of its effects ensure that it is priced at a reasonable rate for players of appropriate level.

mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe_blueprint.name: Dimensional Transit Schematic
mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe_blueprint.description: The Dimensional Transit Schematic is a meticulously crafted blueprint made from weathered parchment and ink. It depicts an intricate design of a warp pipe, capable of creating a temporary portal to any random location within the Mushroom Kingdom. The schematic’s construction requires precision and patience; once completed, it teleports you and one other creature up to 100 feet away in mere moments. Beware, however, as the journey might lead to unexpected destinations—like Wario’s clutches or a giant slug’s belly.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Warp Portal
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, creating a 5-foot-radius portal that teleports the user and one other creature up to 100 feet away. The portal lasts for 1 minute or until disrupted by movement or damage.

effectDetails.title: Random Teleportation
effectDetails.rules: The destination is random within a 100-foot radius of you, with a 5% chance of landing in a dangerous location such as Wario’s hands or a giant slug’s stomach. The portal has no save DC.

mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe_blueprint.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level to construct the schematic and handle its unpredictable magic.
mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe_blueprint.vendorReason: Wario sells this blueprint as a means to enhance his own nefarious schemes, making sure it’s available for those who seek to escape his traps.
mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe_blueprint.shippingDetail: The schematic is delivered via Wario’s delivery drones, ensuring swift and discreet transport.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until disrupted.
usage.endsWhen: Movement or damage to the portal ends it immediately.

mushroom_kingdom_warp_pipe_blueprint.priceReason: The schematic’s rarity and unpredictable magic justify its balanced price of 1000 XP.

mushroom_kingdom_gold_coin_amplifier.name: Coin Magnet Accelerator
mushroom_kingdom_gold_coin_amplifier.description: The Coin Magnet Accelerator is a gleaming brass contraption, its surface etched with arcane symbols that hum faintly when in use. This device amplifies your coin-collecting prowess by creating a localized field that draws in all nearby gold coins within a 30-foot radius. It's like having a tiny, greedy vacuum, but one you can activate at will. Just be cautious; the local guards might not appreciate the attention it attracts to your person.

effectDetails.title: Coin Attraction Radius
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this device creates a localized field that draws gold coins within a 30-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends immediately if the wearer moves more than 20 feet away from the center of the field.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Treasure Checks
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on checks related to finding treasure or making coin-related skill checks. This effect persists for 1 hour after activation and is lost if the user fails a Wisdom saving throw with a DC of 15.

mushroom_kingdom_gold_coin_amplifier.levelRequirementReason: This device requires no specific level, but it's best suited for beginners who need an edge in coin-collecting.
mushroom_kingdom_gold_coin_amplifier.vendorReason: Koopa Shop specializes in quirky devices that give players a competitive edge in their adventures.
mushroom_kingdom_gold_coin_amplifier.shippingDetail: Express delivery ensures the Coin Magnet Accelerator reaches you swiftly and in perfect working condition.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate, ends when the wearer moves more than 20 feet away or after 1 minute.
usage.duration: 1 minute per activation
usage.endsWhen: The user moves more than 20 feet from the field's center or after 1 minute.

mushroom_kingdom_gold_coin_amplifier.priceReason: This device is priced at 1000 XP as it provides a significant advantage in coin-collecting, making it a valuable tool for adventurers.

connectopia_pioneer_repair_service.name: Wario's Quick Fix
connectopia_pioneer_repair_service.description: Wario’s Quick Fix is a legendary repair service that can mend any piece of equipment, from rusted swords to broken wagons. With a flick of his wrist and an array of gears and springs, Wario ensures your gear is as good as new in no time. The secret blend of materials he uses is said to have been perfected over decades of field repairs under the Pioneer Post’s banner.

effectDetails.title: Equipment Repair
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Targets one piece of equipment, repairing it completely and restoring its full functionality.

effectDetails.title: Durability Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Restores 25% of the target equipment’s durability, up to its maximum. This effect does not stack with other durability-restoring effects.

connectopia_pioneer_repair_service.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can use this service as it requires no specific skill or expertise.
connectopia_pioneer_repair_service.vendorReason: Wario’s Quick Fix is a staple of Pioneer Post, known for its reliable and efficient repair services across the region.
connectopia_pioneer_repair_service.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly by the swift messenger drones of Pioneer Post.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the repair is complete or the equipment no longer requires repairs.

connectopia_pioneer_repair_service.priceReason: The service includes a thorough inspection and restoration, ensuring long-term reliability of your equipment.

connectopia_shard_of_the_void.name: Nullstone Fragment
connectopia_shard_of_the_void.description: A Nullstone Fragment is a crystalline shard pulled from the deepest mines of Connectopia. Its surface crackles with unsettling energy, and when agitated, it briefly disrupts magic, creating a small area where spells cast nearby have a chance to fail. Staring into its depths too long risks causing psychic damage. This fragment is a masterwork of Connectopian craftsmanship, forged in the heart of the mines by skilled alchemists who sought to harness the void's energies.

effectDetails.title: Brief Magic Disruption
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the fragment creates a small area (10-foot radius) where any spell cast within has a 25% chance to be silenced. The effect lasts for 1 round and ends if the fragment is destroyed or if another spell is cast within the affected area.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Hazard
effectDetails.rules: While in the presence of the shard, all creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they take 2d6 psychic damage and are blinded for 1 minute.

connectopia_shard_of_the_void.levelRequirementReason: This fragment is crafted to be accessible to even the most novice adventurers who wish to experiment with its effects.
connectopia_shard_of_the_void.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in rare and exotic items from Connectopia, ensuring that adventurers have access to powerful yet balanced artifacts like this shard.
connectopia_shard_of_the_void.shippingDetail: Ships via the dimensional portal, which may result in a slight delay due to fluctuating space-time distortions.

usage.duration: 1 round per use
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or another spell is cast within the affected area

connectopia_shard_of_the_void.priceReason: The balanced price reflects its rarity and the risks involved in using it, making it a valuable yet manageable purchase for adventurers.

faerun_item_waterdeep_guildmark.name: Waterdeep Docks Guild Mark
faerun_item_waterdeep_guildmark.description: The Waterdeep Docks Guild Mark is a heavy brass token stamped with the guild's seal. It grants you access to the exclusive loading and unloading zones, where only the most trusted dockworkers may venture. Rumor has it that this token once belonged to an esteemed deckhand who saved the docks from a catastrophic storm. With this mark, your reputation among the dockworkers rises by one, earning you both respect and potential new opportunities.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Access
effectDetails.rules: You gain access to restricted loading and unloading zones. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Reputation Boost
effectDetails.rules: Your reputation with dockworkers increases by one, providing a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks made within the docks. This benefit is temporary and ends after 24 hours.

faerun_item_waterdeep_guildmark.levelRequirementReason: This item provides basic access that any aspiring dockworker can obtain.
faerun_item_waterdeep_guildmark.vendorReason: The Waterdeep Market often sells items related to local guilds for their customers.
faerun_item_waterdeep_guildmark.shippingDetail: Ships are delivered directly from the docks, ensuring your item is fresh and reliable.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn for exclusive access; Reputation boost lasts for 24 hours.
usage.endsWhen: Upon expiration or loss of the token.

faerun_item_waterdeep_guildmark.priceReason: The price is adjusted to reflect a common item that grants basic but valuable access.

midlands_item_scorched_ember.name: Dragon's Breath Confection
midlands_item_scorched_ember.description: Dragon's Breath Confection is a wickedly delightful confection, its sugary exterior masking an inferno of fiery essence. When consumed, it grants the imbiber a searing boost to their fire-based attacks for three turns, and there’s a tantalizing 5% chance that any enemy armor will ignite in a blaze of glory. Don't be fooled by this sweet treat; it's crafted with the very breath of dragons, making it a rare find from the Fractured Forge.

effectDetails.title: Fire Damage Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation by consumption, this confection grants the imbiber a +10 bonus to fire damage for three turns. The effect ends immediately if the imbiber is incapacitated or if they take any damage.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Ignite Armor
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance that any enemy within range of your next attack will have their armor ignite, dealing an additional 10 fire damage and setting it ablaze for the duration of the encounter. This effect can only occur once per encounter.

midlands_item_scorched_ember.levelRequirementReason: This confection is designed for novices to dabble in dragonish might without overextending their abilities.
midlands_item_scorched_ember.vendorReason: The Fractured Forge specializes in crafting items from the rarest and most dangerous materials, making Dragon's Breath Confection a perfect addition to their inventory.
midlands_item_scorched_ember.shippingDetail: Express delivery ensures this fiery confection arrives fresh and potent for its intended use.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: The imbiber is incapacitated or takes damage, or after the duration expires

midlands_item_scorched_ember.priceReason: Crafted with dragon's breath and rare ingredients, this confection offers a significant boost to fire-based abilities at an appropriately high cost.

midlands_item_chronometric_shard.name: Time's Echo
midlands_item_chronometric_shard.description: Time's Echo is a crystalline shard that glows with a soft, pulsating blue light. Crafted from the very fabric of time itself, it allows its wielder to briefly reverse their last action, effectively undoing minor mistakes or exploiting them for gain. However, using this power comes at a risk; there’s a 15% chance each use that a minor temporal distortion occurs, potentially causing unintended consequences. Holding Time's Echo grants you heightened perception of time-based phenomena, enhancing your awareness and decision-making abilities.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Last Action
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, you can use Time's Echo to reverse the last action you took. This effect is usable once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: There is a 15% chance each time you use Time's Echo that a minor temporal distortion occurs. If this happens, roll a d20; on an even result (DC 15), the effect fails to resolve correctly, potentially causing unintended consequences.

midlands_item_chronometric_shard.levelRequirementReason: Time's Echo is accessible early in one's career as it can be used to correct minor mistakes without significant risk.
midlands_item_chronometric_shard.vendorReason: The Midlands Merchant has a reputation for selling rare and ancient artifacts, including magical curiosities like Time's Echo.
midlands_item_chronometric_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Swift Peregrine Courier service, ensuring timely delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect resolves or is interrupted by another action

midlands_item_chronometric_shard.priceReason: Time's Echo provides a powerful but limited ability to manipulate time, making it valuable yet not overpowered.

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dark_dough.name: Forbidden Dark Dough of the Shifting Sands
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dark_dough.description: Forged from ancient, unstable dough harvested only during the darkest nights, this Forbidden Dark Dough of the Shifting Sands subtly warps reality around its user. The substance is said to make you crave more and more, yet it leaves a lingering corruption that weakens your resolve over time. Each morsel consumed not only amplifies these effects but also drains your wisdom, leaving you increasingly susceptible to the dark whims of fate.

effectDetails.title: Reality Warp
effectDetails.rules: The user's immediate area (10-foot radius) has a 25% chance each round to randomly shift location for the duration of their turn. This effect ends if the user moves more than 5 feet or if they are hit by an attack.

effectDetails.title: Addiction
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a temporary addiction that causes them to consume the dough over time, reducing Wisdom by 1 at the end of each long rest. This effect can be resisted with a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, which reduces the Wisdom penalty by half.

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dark_dough.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant control to avoid its corrupting effects.
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dark_dough.vendorReason: Pastry Palace has a reputation for selling items that blur the line between culinary and magical, making this forbidden dough an appropriate addition.
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dark_dough.shippingDetail: Delivered only during the night by the Night Courier, ensuring the item arrives in its most potent form.

usage.activation: Instantaneous consumption as a bonus action
usage.duration: Until the end of your turn or if you move more than 5 feet
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or move more than 5 feet
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use is considered one charge for tracking purposes

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_dark_dough.priceReason: Balanced to ensure it remains a significant yet not overpowered addition to the player's arsenal.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_charm.name: Crusty Charm of Unyielding Patience
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_charm.description: The Crusty Charm of Unyielding Patience is a relic from the ancient Dough Folk, crafted from centuries-old bread dough. It's said to imbue its wearer with the patience and resilience of a master baker, slowing their pace but bolstering their defenses against the world's impatience. Those who wear it find themselves steadfast in the face of adversity, though they might also be seen as overly deliberate by those around them.

effectDetails.title: Slow
effectDetails.rules: The wearer's speed is reduced by 10 feet. This effect is passive and does not require an action to activate. The charm's influence persists until the end of a long rest, at which point it can be recharged.

effectDetails.title: Increased Toughness
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +1 to their Armor Class (AC) while wearing this charm. This effect is also passive and does not require any action. It remains in effect until the end of a long rest.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm requires no specific level, as it provides a subtle but useful benefit to anyone who needs extra patience or defensive prowess.
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_charm.vendorReason: Sweet Suppliés specializes in goods that enhance the quality of life for its patrons, and this charm fits well with their mission to provide unique and beneficial items.
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_charm.shippingDetail: The charm is shipped via special delivery courier to ensure it arrives at its destination without being tampered with or damaged in transit.

usage.duration: Until the end of a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: A long rest.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_charm.priceReason: The charm's unique and beneficial effects, combined with its rarity as an ancient Dough Folk relic, justify this fair price in experience points.

grand_country_layered_scale.name: Echoing Scale of the Spiral Peak
grand_country_layered_scale.description: Hewn from a creature that thrives in the enigmatic layers of the Spiral Peaks, this scale whispers tales of forgotten events and hidden treasures. Worn as armor or jewelry, it amplifies your senses, enhancing perception by 5% and granting an uncanny knack for locating misplaced items with a 10% chance to detect them unseen. The scale also allows you to hear echoes of the past for one turn each day, unlocking secrets buried in forgotten times.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: This effect increases your perception by 5%, allowing you to better notice and understand environmental details. It is a passive ability, always active while wearing the scale.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Object Detection (10%)
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has a 10% chance of detecting hidden or misplaced objects within their reach. This effect can be used once per day and requires no action to activate.

grand_country_layered_scale.levelRequirementReason: This scale is crafted from a creature that thrives in the extreme conditions of the Spiral Peaks, making it too difficult for lower-level characters to handle.
grand_country_layered_scale.vendorReason: The layer market specializes in exotic and rare items found in the enigmatic layers of the Spiral Peaks, making this scale an appropriate addition to their offerings.
grand_country_layered_scale.shippingDetail: Ships via giant snail, ensuring safe delivery but with a delay of one week.

usage.activation: Passive and instantaneous (Hidden Object Detection once per day).
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use or removed from the wearer.

grand_country_layered_scale.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and crafting complexity of the scale, balancing its unique abilities with standard market values.

grand_country_godly_geode_of_weightlessn.name: The Null Sphere
grand_country_godly_geode_of_weightlessn.description: The Null Sphere, forged from the molten heart of a collapsing gravity well, feels like an empty void. It warps your own mass, allowing you to float effortlessly or pin heavy objects with ease. This geode is a masterwork of arcane and gravitational forces, perfect for evading attacks or crushing foes underfoot. Holding it requires focus; too many missteps could result in unintended consequences, as you've seen in the tales of Wario's clumsy attempts.

effectDetails.title: Mass Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate to become either weightless or have triple your weight. This effect lasts for two turns and has a 15% chance of nullifying an enemy's attack against you during the duration.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Stability
effectDetails.rules: While the Null Sphere is active, your movement speed increases by 30%, and you gain resistance to falling damage. This effect persists until the duration ends or you use a reaction to negate an attack.

grand_country_godly_geode_of_weightlessn.levelRequirementReason: The item's complexity and the need for precise control make it suitable only for those of at least first level.
grand_country_godly_geode_of_weightlessn.vendorReason: Side Seller often deals in unique, powerful items that push the boundaries of physics and magic, making The Null Sphere a fitting addition to their inventory.
grand_country_godly_geode_of_weightlessn.shippingDetail: Ships via dimensional rift, ensuring it arrives intact but requiring careful handling during transit.

usage.duration: 2 turns or until the duration ends (up to 1 minute)
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect is used up or you end your turn with the item in hand, or if you use a reaction to negate an attack.

grand_country_godly_geode_of_weightlessn.priceReason: The Null Sphere's rarity and unique properties justify its price of 1000 XP.

the_edge_chronometric_brace.name: Temporal Shunt
the_edge_chronometric_brace.description: The Temporal Shunt is a heavy obsidian brace that pulses with distorted time, its surface etched with arcane sigils. When worn, it grants brief bursts of temporal acceleration, allowing you to dash through foes and snatch shiny loot with ease. The brace also increases your chance to dodge attacks, making you nimbler in the heat of battle. Wielders have found that this artifact is a boon for escaping dire situations, though they must be cautious not to step too far into the future.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when you are targeted by an attack or an effect that would impose movement. You gain a +2 bonus to your Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and can use the Dash action without expending movement. This effect lasts for 1 minute, but it ends if you take any damage or if you voluntarily end it early.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Bonus
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws when targeted by an attack or effect that would impose movement. This bonus increases to +2 while you are within 5 feet of an ally who has the Temporal Shunt equipped. The bonus lasts until the end of your next turn.

the_edge_chronometric_brace.levelRequirementReason: The Temporal Shunt requires a high level to harness its temporal distortions effectively, ensuring that only experienced adventurers can wield it.
the_edge_chronometric_brace.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in rare and exotic equipment, making the Temporal Shunt an ideal addition to their inventory.
the_edge_chronometric_brace.shippingDetail: Ships via warp carrier; delivery time is significantly reduced but requires a special license for importation.

usage.activation: Reaction or on use, depending on the effect
usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or voluntarily end it early

the_edge_chronometric_brace.priceReason: The Temporal Shunt is priced fairly given its limited recharge and the unique temporal effects, making it a strategic but not overpowered item.

the_edge_void_sanctuary.name: Nullspace Shroud
the_edge_void_sanctuary.description: The Nullspace Shroud is a shimmering veil of nothingness, woven from the very essence of void and silence. This premium shroud grants resistance to void energies and suppresses magical effects in a radius around you, creating a sanctuary where chaos fades into calm. Crafted by ancient scholars who sought refuge from the madness of creation itself, it hums with an eerie yet serene power that only those attuned to the void can truly understand.

effectDetails.title: Grant Resistance to Void Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage from a void-based source, you have advantage on the saving throw. This effect lasts for an hour and can be reactivated once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Suppress Magic Effects
effectDetails.rules: Any magical effects within 10 feet of you are suppressed while the shroud is active. The suppression lasts until the end of your next turn or when you use a bonus action to dismiss it. Creatures can make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) at the start of each of their turns to break free from this effect.

the_edge_void_sanctuary.levelRequirementReason: The intricate weave of the Nullspace Shroud requires a high degree of arcane knowledge and spiritual fortitude, making it suitable only for those who have reached at least 10th level.
the_edge_void_sanctuary.vendorReason: Final Shop specializes in rare and ancient artifacts that offer unique protection against the unknown threats lurking beyond the veil of reality.
the_edge_void_sanctuary.shippingDetail: The Spectral Messenger ensures swift delivery, but due to its ethereal nature, the shroud must be kept within a special containment field during transit to preserve its integrity.

usage.activation: Activates as an action. Can be reactivated once per long rest.
usage.duration: One hour or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn or when dismissed, or if you take damage from a non-void-based source during its duration

the_edge_void_sanctuary.priceReason: The Nullspace Shroud is priced at 1000 XP for its rare construction materials and the arcane knowledge required to weave such a protective barrier.

pokemon_item_gloomstone_amulet.name: Gloomstone Amulet of Shadow Whispers
pokemon_item_gloomstone_amulet.description: The Gloomstone Amulet of Shadow Whispers is a dark, twisted amulet forged from the essence of Gloom, a shadowy Pokémon known for its malevolent whispers. Its surface glows faintly with an eerie, violet light, and those who wear it feel compelled to speak in hushed tones. The amulet amplifies one's stealth to an unnatural degree, making the wearer nearly invisible in shadows. However, prolonged use can leave the user feeling increasingly detached from reality, as if the whispers are slowly driving them mad.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Amplification
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +20% bonus to stealth checks. This effect is active as long as the amulet remains on, with no limit on uses per day.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Damage and Confusion
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer attacks with a melee weapon, they deal an additional 1d6 shadow damage and have a 10% chance to confuse their target (target is incapacitated for 1d4 rounds). The confusion effect ends when the target makes a successful Wisdom saving throw.

pokemon_item_gloomstone_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from the essence of Gloom, this amulet's power is too great for those below level 20 to safely wield.
pokemon_item_gloomstone_amulet.vendorReason: Pokemart specializes in exotic and powerful items related to Pokémon, making it a fitting vendor for the Gloomstone Amulet of Shadow Whispers.
pokemon_item_gloomstone_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is shipped via express mail with a delivery delay of one week due to its shadowy nature.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required, always on as long as the amulet remains worn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; does not expire or require recharging.
usage.endsWhen: The amulet is removed from the wearer's body or destroyed.

pokemon_item_gloomstone_amulet.priceReason: The price reflects the item's mythic rarity, powerful effects, and the difficulty of acquiring Gloomstone.

pokemon_item_trainer_badge_scroll.name: Scroll of the Rising Star Trainer
pokemon_item_trainer_badge_scroll.description: The Scroll of the Rising Star Trainer is a meticulously crafted parchment adorned with symbols of burgeoning skill. Unfurl it during a critical battle to gain temporary proficiency in your chosen style, allowing you to unleash attacks that feel like they are born from years of experience. Its ink glows faintly under moonlight, hinting at the young trainer's potential. This scroll does not confer mastery overnight but can be the spark that ignites victory.

effectDetails.title: Battle Proficiency Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action at the start of your turn. You gain temporary proficiency in one battle style (melee, ranged, or magic) until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Increased Critical Hit Chance
effectDetails.rules: Increases your critical hit chance by 5% for a total duration of 1 hour per use. This effect stacks with other sources of critical hit chance up to +20%. The scroll's glow intensifies as this effect approaches its limit.

pokemon_item_trainer_badge_scroll.levelRequirementReason: Requires character level 8 to effectively utilize the scroll's power without overwhelming its effects.
pokemon_item_trainer_badge_scroll.vendorReason: The Safari Shop, known for its vast knowledge of trainers and their journeys, offers this scroll as a token of encouragement for young and promising trainers.
pokemon_item_trainer_badge_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via standard mail within the region; delivery can take up to one week depending on local post office delays.

usage.activation: Bonus action at the start of your turn
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest for proficiency, or 1 hour for critical hit chance
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you complete a long rest or if the scroll is destroyed in battle.

pokemon_item_trainer_badge_scroll.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique benefits and rarity as an uncommon item for level 8 trainers.

pokemon_item_evolution_seed_vibrant.name: Evolution Seed - Vibrant Bloom
pokemon_item_evolution_seed_vibrant.description: The Evolution Seed - Vibrant Bloom pulses with a vibrant, otherworldly glow. Crafted from the essence of a legendary Pokémon’s evolution, this seed accelerates your partner's growth and can trigger an unexpected bloom that spreads across the battlefield. When planted near your Pokémon, it releases a surge of energy that heals 100 HP and increases stat growth by 20% for one turn. However, the rapid transformation may attract the attention of rival trainers, demanding immediate action to secure your Pokémon’s new form.
effects: Increases Stat Growth by 20% for One Turn

effectDetails.title: Healing Bloom
effectDetails.rules: When the seed is planted near a partner Pokémon, it releases a burst of energy that heals the target for 100 hit points. The effect is instantaneous and applies only once per use.

effectDetails.title: Growth Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: The seed increases the stat growth by 20% for one turn upon planting, enhancing your Pokémon’s potential for evolution or growth. This effect can be used once per day.

pokemon_item_evolution_seed_vibrant.levelRequirementReason: This seed is accessible to beginning trainers who wish to nurture their Pokémon's growth and evolution.
pokemon_item_evolution_seed_vibrant.vendorReason: The league store caters to both aspiring and seasoned trainers looking for tools to enhance their Pokémon’s abilities.
pokemon_item_evolution_seed_vibrant.shippingDetail: Express mail delivers the seed within a week, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Planting the seed near your partner Pokémon.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts for one turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the turn ends or if the Pokémon is no longer adjacent to the seed.

pokemon_item_evolution_seed_vibrant.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the seed's unique properties and the effort required to craft it from legendary Pokémon essence.

grand_country_godly_seed_of_ascension.name: Seed of Ascendancy
grand_country_godly_seed_of_ascension.description: The Seed of Ascendancy is a pulsating, glowing seed that exudes the raw power of The Grand Country—a realm where the very fabric of reality bends and distorts. Consuming it grants you an instant burst of fortitude, allowing you to phase through solid objects for a fleeting moment. This divine gift also enhances your movement speed by 20%, enabling you to traverse perilous terrain with ease—just remember, getting stuck can be catastrophic.

effectDetails.title: Phase Through Solid Objects
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you may phase through solid objects for 5 seconds. You are immune to all damage and effects from being in the same space as another creature during this period. This ability ends if you are struck by an attack or spell.

effectDetails.title: Increase Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your turn, your movement speed is increased by 20%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

grand_country_godly_seed_of_ascension.levelRequirementReason: The Seed of Ascendancy requires minimal magical power to activate but still demands caution.
grand_country_godly_seed_of_ascension.vendorReason: Side Seller, a quirky vendor known for unconventional items, stocks this divine seed as part of their eclectic collection.
grand_country_godly_seed_of_ascension.shippingDetail: The Seed is delivered via the swift and majestic Celestial Whale, ensuring timely arrival.

usage.duration: 5 seconds (ends if struck by an attack or spell)
usage.endsWhen: Struck by an attack or spell, end of your turn

grand_country_godly_seed_of_ascension.priceReason: The Seed's balanced price reflects its unique utility and the risk involved in its use.

kivotos_item_student_rally_flag.name: The Crimson Cipher
kivotos_item_student_rally_flag.description: The Crimson Cipher stands tall, its vibrant crimson fabric shimmering with an ancient cipher that whispers tales of forgotten battles. When unfurled in the heat of a skirmish, it instantly boosts the coordination and morale of nearby student combatants, making them dance through their strikes as one. This flag, a favorite among the 'Shadow Syndicate,' can be the deciding factor in any impromptu club battle or challenge, turning even the most chaotic encounters into well-coordinated duels.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Coordination
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a student combatant within 30 feet, all allies within 10 feet gain advantage on Dexterity (Athletics) checks and saving throws for the duration of one short rest. This effect requires no verbal or somatic components.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Morale
effectDetails.rules: All students within 30 feet gain a +2 bonus to their Charisma (Persuasion) checks and have advantage on saving throws against fear effects for the duration of one short rest. This effect has no charges and can be used once per long rest.

kivotos_item_student_rally_flag.levelRequirementReason: This flag is designed for novice students who need a morale boost but may not yet have mastered advanced combat techniques.
kivotos_item_student_rally_flag.vendorReason: Club Supply caters to the needs of student clubs and factions, including the 'Shadow Syndicate'.
kivotos_item_student_rally_flag.shippingDetail: Ships via standard mail within 3 days.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action when unfurled by a student combatant.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts for the duration of one short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user completes their next turn or if the flag is furled.

kivotos_item_student_rally_flag.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant morale and coordination boost without overshadowing more powerful items.

kivotos_item_mythic_harmonic_resonator.name: The Echoing Void
kivotos_item_mythic_harmonic_resonator.description: The Echoing Void is a shimmering obsidian device, its surface etched with arcane symbols that glow faintly in response to Kivotos' chaotic energies. This relic resonates with the very fabric of the academy, emitting unpredictable waves of pure chaos that can either aid or hinder those within its radius. Use it wisely, for summoning a horde of sentient textbooks is not unheard of, and such occurrences are far from accidental!

effectDetails.title: Unpredictable Effects
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Echoing Void releases a wave of chaotic energy that affects all creatures within 10 feet. Targets have a 50% chance to be confused for 1 minute. This effect has no save DC and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Sentient Textbooks
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that, upon activation, the Echoing Void will summon one or more sentient textbooks within 30 feet. These books are neutral and do not attack but can be commanded by the user to perform simple tasks. The effect lasts until the next dawn.

kivotos_item_mythic_harmonic_resonator.levelRequirementReason: Beginners at Kivotos' Academy need a way to test their skills without causing too much damage.
kivotos_item_mythic_harmonic_resonator.vendorReason: The student store often stocks items that can help students practice and experiment safely.
kivotos_item_mythic_harmonic_resonator.shippingDetail: Ships via Kivotos' Academy Express, delivered within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the next dawn for sentient textbooks summoned.
usage.endsWhen: The next dawn or when the user dismisses it as an action.

kivotos_item_mythic_harmonic_resonator.priceReason: Balanced at 1,000 XP, this price reflects its mythic rarity and unpredictable effects.

the_edge_ritual_consultation.name: Adept's Insightful Consultation
the_edge_ritual_consultation.description: Seek out Adept's Insightful Consultation at Edge Outpost, where you can spend an hour engaging with a grizzled occultist who specializes in 'interpreting the echoes.' This ancient sage offers cryptic advice that could turn your next adventure into legend or lore. For those seeking to identify cursed items, their keen eye and uncanny wisdom offer a 20% chance of revealing such artifacts hidden among your gear. The consultation is a passive experience, where the adept's words linger like shadows, providing you with one cryptic piece of advice that could change the course of your journey.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Cursed Item Chance
effectDetails.rules: For a 20% chance, this adept can identify cursed items hidden among your gear. This effect is passive and requires no action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Receive Cryptic Advice Passively
effectDetails.rules: The consultation grants one cryptic piece of advice that offers guidance or insight into ongoing adventures. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest, providing you with a fleeting but potent leg-up on your current quest.

the_edge_ritual_consultation.levelRequirementReason: This service is available to all adventurers seeking knowledge and protection from unseen threats.
the_edge_ritual_consultation.vendorReason: Edge Outpost prides itself on providing essential services to adventurers in need of guidance and protection against the unknown.
the_edge_ritual_consultation.shippingDetail: The consultation is delivered directly by a trusted messenger hawk, ensuring swift delivery from the adept's secluded study.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: At the conclusion of your next long rest.

the_edge_ritual_consultation.priceReason: The price reflects the adept's expertise and the value of cryptic yet insightful advice in a dangerous world.

the_edge_godly_chronarium.name: Chronarium of Shifting Sands
the_edge_godly_chronarium.description: The Chronarium of Shifting Sands is a shimmering glass orb encased in intricate silver filigree, its interior filled with golden sands that swirl and shift like time itself. This ancient artifact allows its wielder to glimpse fleeting glimpses into the future or rewind minor events, but tampering too deeply risks creating temporal paradoxes. The device hums softly as it bends reality, a warning to those who dare to toy with the fabric of time.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse Future
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the Chronarium to briefly glimpse a possible future outcome. This effect lasts for 1 minute and allows you or your allies within 30 feet to gain advantage on one ability check of their choice.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Minor Events
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, as an action, you can rewind time by a few moments. This effect restores 1d6 + Constitution modifier hit points and allows you or your allies within 30 feet to re-roll one attack roll or saving throw of their choice.

the_edge_godly_chronarium.levelRequirementReason: Only the most experienced adventurers can wield this powerful artifact without risking catastrophic temporal consequences.
the_edge_godly_chronarium.vendorReason: The final shop, known for its rare and godly items, carries only the most potent of artifacts that have been rumored to find their way into the hands of the worthy.
the_edge_godly_chronarium.shippingDetail: Delivered by temporal courier with a delay of 1d4 days due to the delicate nature of the Chronarium's time-bending properties.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, 1 minute for Glimpse Future; once per short rest for Rewind Minor Events
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or you take damage.

the_edge_godly_chronarium.priceReason: This godly artifact's price reflects the risk and power it represents, balancing the potential for catastrophic misuse with its immense utility.

grand_country_curiosity_layer_cake.name: Dimensional Delight
grand_country_curiosity_layer_cake.description: The Dimensional Delight is a layered cake whose vibrant hues and intricate design hint at its otherworldly origins. Each bite transports you to a different layer of reality, granting a brief respite from your mundane existence. The cake’s magical properties are said to have been crafted by the whimsical fae in the Misty Glades, and each slice restores a small amount of health while providing a temporary boost to luck. However, indulge too much and you might find yourself craving more than just another bite.

effectDetails.title: Restores Health
effectDetails.rules: Eating a slice of the cake restores 1d4 + Constitution modifier hit points. The effect is instantaneous, and there is no save required.

effectDetails.title: Boosts Luck
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after consuming a slice, you gain advantage on saving throws and ability checks. This effect ends if you take damage or the duration expires.

grand_country_curiosity_layer_cake.levelRequirementReason: The cake’s magical properties are relatively simple and can be enjoyed by adventurers of even the lowest levels.
grand_country_curiosity_layer_cake.vendorReason: Layer Market prides itself on offering exotic curiosities from various realms, including this delightful treat.
grand_country_curiosity_layer_cake.shippingDetail: The cake is carefully packed and delivered by delivery drone to ensure freshness upon arrival.

usage.activation: Consuming a slice of the cake
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts for 1 minute per slice consumed
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or after 1 minute

grand_country_curiosity_layer_cake.priceReason: The cake’s unique properties, exotic origins, and the craftsmanship required to create it justify its high price.

midlands_item_obsidian_shard.name: Fragment of the Voidbringer
midlands_item_obsidian_shard.description: The Fragment of the Voidbringer hums with malevolent energy, its obsidian surface pulsating like a heartbeat from another plane. As you hold it, the air thickens with dread, and you feel the weight of ancient knowledge pressing against your sanity. This shard can summon a minor shadow demon to aid or torment you, depending on how you wield it. Its touch is a double-edged blade: while it grants forbidden knowledge, it also risks driving you mad if not handled carefully.

effectDetails.title: Summon Minor Shadow Demon
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can summon a minor shadow demon. The creature appears within 10 feet of you and fights on your side until the start of your next turn or until it is destroyed. There is a 10% chance this effect occurs when you interact with the shard. The shadow demon has AC 15, 24 hit points, and deals 3d6 necrotic damage with its bite attack.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You have resistance to necrotic damage. This effect is always active while you hold the shard.

midlands_item_obsidian_shard.levelRequirementReason: This fragment requires a higher level due to its powerful summoning capabilities and potential for madness.
midlands_item_obsidian_shard.vendorReason: The Midlands Merchant has exclusive access to such dark artifacts, having connections with ancient forces.
midlands_item_obsidian_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via a special dark courier who ensures the package arrives under cover of night and in utmost secrecy.

usage.duration: Until your next turn or until destroyed
usage.endsWhen: The summoned shadow demon is destroyed or you use your action for another purpose
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one summoning per day

midlands_item_obsidian_shard.priceReason: This price reflects the shard's rarity and the risks involved in using it.

midlands_item_shadow_whisper.name: The Broker's Secret Scroll
midlands_item_shadow_whisper.description: The Broker's Secret Scroll is a meticulously rolled parchment, its ink faded yet still legible, whispering tales of hidden deals and forbidden knowledge. Crafted by the enigmatic figures who navigate The Midlands' shadowy underbelly, this scroll offers more than mere information—it delivers a strategic advantage, whether through unlocking clandestine locations or forging unlikely alliances. Use it wisely, for its secrets come with a price—both in terms of resources and reputation.

effectDetails.title: Unlock Hidden Locations
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the scroll reveals the coordinates or a detailed map to a hidden location known only to those who control it. This effect is instantaneous and requires no additional actions. It has a limited use per day.

effectDetails.title: Forge Valuable Alliances
effectDetails.rules: When used correctly in a social situation, this scroll grants advantage on persuasion checks with individuals of influence within The Midlands. This effect lasts for 1 hour after activation and can be used once every 7 days.

midlands_item_shadow_whisper.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic knowledge of The Midlands' politics to use the scroll effectively.
midlands_item_shadow_whisper.vendorReason: The merchant specializes in rare and unique items from The Midlands, making this scroll a natural addition to their inventory.
midlands_item_shadow_whisper.shippingDetail: Ships via swift messenger hawk for expedited delivery.

usage.activation: Read the scroll aloud during a social interaction.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, with one-hour duration per use.
usage.endsWhen: Used up or destroyed upon misuse.

midlands_item_shadow_whisper.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its strategic and tactical value in The Midlands.

midlands_item_dragonshard_amulet.name: Shard of the Fallen Wyrm
midlands_item_dragonshard_amulet.description: The Shard of the Fallen Wyrm is an amulet forged from a fragment of a dragon's heart, pulsing with elemental fire and sulfur. Its raw power crackles around your neck, radiating heat that can be felt even in cold hands. The scent of burnt flesh lingers faintly, a reminder of the wyrm's fiery demise. This relic grants you resilience against the flames of hell itself, but beware—its power is not without cost.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to fire damage and can reduce any fire damage you take by an additional 5%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Fury
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can unleash a burst of fiery might. Creatures within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 2d6 fire damage. This effect can be used once per long rest.

midlands_item_dragonshard_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from the heart of an ancient wyrm, this amulet requires significant magical power to harness.
midlands_item_dragonshard_amulet.vendorReason: The blacksmiths at Fractured Forge have access to rare and powerful materials, including fragments of fallen dragons.
midlands_item_dragonshard_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant beetle courier, this amulet's journey is both swift and hazardous.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Effect lasts until start of next turn)
usage.endsWhen: The start of your next turn or when you take fire damage

midlands_item_dragonshard_amulet.priceReason: Crafted from a rare dragon fragment, this amulet is both powerful and expensive to produce.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_dough_bomb.name: Sticky Dough Bomb!
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_dough_bomb.description: Crafted from the finest sticky flour and sugar, this dough bomb is a culinary marvel. When hurled with precision, it clings tenaciously to an enemy, turning their movements into a slow-motion dance of flour. The target's speed plummets as they're coated in a sugary paste, making them clumsy and prone to missteps. Even the most battle-hardened warriors will find themselves caught off guard by this delectable yet daunting device.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Cling
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the Sticky Dough Bomb adheres to a target within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by sticky dough for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Speed Reduction
effectDetails.rules: The target's movement speed is reduced by half while the Sticky Cling effect lasts, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of them.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_dough_bomb.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic combat proficiency to accurately throw the dough bomb.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_dough_bomb.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in all things pastry and sticky, making it fitting for their wares.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_dough_bomb.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by trained pigeon messengers within the same day of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until target is no longer restrained
usage.endsWhen: Target escapes, saves successfully, or effect ends naturally

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_dough_bomb.priceReason: The refined ingredients and unique crafting process justify the higher price point.

leclaire_isle_item_golden_croissant_of_g.name: Golden Croissant of Gusts
leclaire_isle_item_golden_croissant_of_g.description: The Golden Croissant of Gusts, crafted by the Dough Folk's master bakers on Leclair Isle, is a golden pastry that radiates a gust of wind when bitten into. It's said to have been blessed with the essence of the island’s windswept cliffs, imbuing it with surprising power. Biting this croissant can unleash a gust strong enough to knock enemies off ledges or send pastries flying across the room – perfect for those who want to clear space quickly but prefer not to get their hands dirty.

effectDetails.title: Wind Gust
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this croissant emits a gust of wind in a small area. This gust deals moderate wind damage to all creatures within its radius and has a chance to knock them back. The gust lasts for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Knockback
effectDetails.rules: Any creature hit by the gust must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked back up to 10 feet, ending their turn in the nearest unoccupied space not prone.

leclaire_isle_item_golden_croissant_of_g.levelRequirementReason: The delicate nature of the croissant requires sufficient dexterity and focus.
leclaire_isle_item_golden_croissant_of_g.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is renowned for its expert bakers who can craft such whimsical and powerful items.
leclaire_isle_item_golden_croissant_of_g.shippingDetail: The Giant Delivery Snail ensures the croissant arrives perfectly golden, ready to be enjoyed or activated immediately upon receipt.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: After one round of wind gust and knockback effect

leclaire_isle_item_golden_croissant_of_g.priceReason: The item is rare but balanced, reflecting the skill required to craft it and its occasional utility.

leclaire_isle_item_godly_dough_of_infini.name: Godly Dough of Infinite Expansion
leclaire_isle_item_godly_dough_of_infini.description: The Godly Dough of Infinite Expansion is a shimmering, ever-expanding substance that can quickly engulf foes or form temporary platforms for safe passage. Crafted from the very essence of the Dough Folk’s deity, it radiates with divine power and can restore allies’ health while immobilizing those caught within its grasp. Wario might indeed try to harness this dough to create a giant monument to his likeness, but only through sheer determination could one hope to replicate such feats.

effectDetails.title: Expands to Engulf Enemies
effectDetails.rules: The user can activate this effect as a bonus action within a range of 30 feet. The dough expands in an 8-foot radius around the user, immobilizing all creatures inside for 1 minute unless they succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw. This effect costs one use and is recharged at dawn.

effectDetails.title: Heals Allies
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, this item can heal up to 2d6 + the user’s Charisma modifier hit points to all creatures within a 15-foot radius of its center. This effect is instantaneous and costs one use.

leclaire_isle_item_godly_dough_of_infini.levelRequirementReason: The Godly Dough requires minimal magical knowledge, as it operates through divine intervention rather than complex spellcasting.
leclaire_isle_item_godly_dough_of_infini.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies deals in rare and exotic ingredients, including those used by the Dough Folk to craft this miraculous dough.
leclaire_isle_item_godly_dough_of_infini.shippingDetail: The Celestial Courier delivers the dough via a swift, ethereal plane journey that ensures timely delivery.

usage.activation: Bonus action or once per long rest
usage.duration: 1 minute (immobilization) or instantaneous (healing)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted uses or dawn recharge

leclaire_isle_item_godly_dough_of_infini.priceReason: The Godly Dough is priced moderately due to its divine origin and the unique abilities it grants.

leclaire_isle_crumb_charm.name: Doughy Defender Charm
leclaire_isle_crumb_charm.description: The Doughy Defender Charm is a delightful charm crafted from solidified croissant dough, imbued with the spirit of a miniature Dough Folk warrior. This charming trinket not only provides an effective shield against sticky situations but also grants +2 to Dexterity saving throws against pastry-based attacks. Should it come into contact with foes, it has a chance to inflict 'Sugar Rush,' temporarily boosting their speed and leaving them dazed for a moment.

effectDetails.title: Sticky Shield
effectDetails.rules: The Doughy Defender Charm grants the wielder advantage on Dexterity saving throws against attacks made with sticky or pasty substances. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Sugar Rush
effectDetails.rules: When the charm comes into contact with an enemy, there is a 10% chance to inflict 'Sugar Rush' on them, causing a temporary speed boost and dizziness. The target gains advantage on their next attack roll but suffers disadvantage on Dexterity checks for one minute.

leclaire_isle_crumb_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm is designed for beginners who might encounter sticky or pastry-based attacks early in their adventuring career.
leclaire_isle_crumb_charm.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in items related to croissant culture and thus offers the Doughy Defender Charm as a staple among their inventory.
leclaire_isle_crumb_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by the reliable Dough Delivery Drone, this charm is guaranteed to arrive in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activates upon contact with sticky or pastry-based attacks.
usage.duration: Until end of next turn for 'Sticky Shield'; until start of your next turn for 'Sugar Rush'.
usage.endsWhen: When the duration expires, the charm no longer functions until recharged by a short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges during a short rest.

leclaire_isle_crumb_charm.priceReason: The charm's price is adjusted to reflect its unique flavor and utility without overshadowing more powerful items.

leclaire_isle_sweet_serenity_tea.name: Serene Sugar Bloom Tea
leclaire_isle_sweet_serenity_tea.description: Brewed from rare moonpetal blossoms and crystallized honey, Serene Sugar Bloom Tea is a delicate elixir that calms the soul and sweetens even the most tempestuous of hearts. A sip can restore your weary spirit, granting you the calmness to face challenges with renewed resolve. Sweet Supplies' master tea-makers insist it's not just for the volatile Dough Folk; anyone seeking peace in their heart will find it here.

effectDetails.title: Restore Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this tea restores 20 hit points to the drinker. The effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Increase Charisma
effectDetails.rules: For one minute after drinking, your Charisma score is increased by 3. This increase stacks with other sources of Charisma bonuses but cannot exceed your original Charisma modifier +5. The effect ends when the duration expires or if you take any harmful action.

leclaire_isle_sweet_serenity_tea.levelRequirementReason: This tea is accessible to all adventurers, regardless of level, as it promotes harmony and peace.
leclaire_isle_sweet_serenity_tea.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies has long been known for their soothing potions and teas, making Serene Sugar Bloom Tea a natural addition to their inventory.
leclaire_isle_sweet_serenity_tea.shippingDetail: The Honeybee Courier ensures the tea remains fresh by delivering it within an hour of purchase in most locations.

usage.activation: Instantaneous consumption upon opening the sealed container.
usage.duration: 1 minute per serving
usage.endsWhen: After one minute or if a harmful action is taken.
usage.charges: Unlimited; each serving is an individual use.

leclaire_isle_sweet_serenity_tea.priceReason: The rare ingredients and expert brewing required for this tea justify its higher price, making it a valuable commodity in the market.

leclaire_isle_frosting_fortune_teller.name: The Frosting Oracle
leclaire_isle_frosting_fortune_teller.description: The Frosting Oracle is a delightfully creepy, handcrafted figurine made from hardened buttercream, its surface etched with arcane runes that whisper cryptic prophecies—mostly about pastries and confectionary magic. This rare curio grants +1 to Wisdom checks related to divination and minor protection against illusions, making it a cherished tool for discerning adventurers seeking guidance or just an odd, yet charming decoration. Don’t ask it about your taxes; its knowledge is as sweetly vague as the pastries it guards.

effectDetails.title: Divine Guidance
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a Wisdom check related to divination. The Frosting Oracle provides a +1 bonus to the roll, and if you succeed, it whispers a helpful prophecy (random effect). This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Grants a +1 bonus to saving throws against illusions. This benefit lasts for 8 hours after the item is activated and can be refreshed by using another Wisdom check related to divination.

leclaire_isle_frosting_fortune_teller.levelRequirementReason: The Frosting Oracle's charm and utility make it accessible to all adventurers, regardless of level.
leclaire_isle_frosting_fortune_teller.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is known for its exquisite pastries and curiosities, making it the perfect vendor for this whimsical item.
leclaire_isle_frosting_fortune_teller.shippingDetail: The Frosting Oracle is delivered by a Magic Messenger Pigeon, ensuring its arrival fresh from the bakery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action during a Wisdom check related to divination.
usage.duration: 8 hours after activation or until the next short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use it again, at the end of a long rest, or if you deactivate it by succeeding on another Wisdom check related to divination.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the effect can be refreshed.

leclaire_isle_frosting_fortune_teller.priceReason: The Frosting Oracle strikes a balance between its rarity and utility, providing both practical benefits and thematic appeal at this price point.

curiosity_obsidian_shard.name: Shard of the Fallen Emperor
curiosity_obsidian_shard.description: The Shard of the Fallen Emperor is a cold, black obsidian fragment that pulses with ancient power. It seems to hum with forgotten knowledge and whispers dark truths from the void. Legend has it that this shard once belonged to a lost emperor whose empire crumbled into dust centuries ago. Handling it risks unraveling your sanity, but it also grants you a fleeting boost in intelligence when you need it most.

effectDetails.title: Intellect Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Shard of the Fallen Emperor grants a +2 bonus to one Intelligence check or saving throw for 1 minute. The effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Madness Risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance (roll a d20) each time you use the Shard that you gain the mad effect until the end of your next short or long rest. This risk increases by 1% for every additional shard used in a single day.

curiosity_obsidian_shard.levelRequirementReason: This shard can be accessed by any adventurer, as its power is both ancient and potent enough to be wielded by those just beginning their journey.
curiosity_obsidian_shard.vendorReason: The chaos dealer thrives on the dark artifacts that might drive his patrons mad but also fuel their quests for knowledge and power.
curiosity_obsidian_shard.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, this shard is delivered by snail mail, ensuring it arrives intact but with considerable delay.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the end of your next short rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you gain the mad effect from its use or at the start of your next long rest, whichever comes first. You can only use it once per long rest.

curiosity_obsidian_shard.priceReason: The shard's ancient power and potential to drive one mad make it a costly item, but its utility as an intelligence booster justifies this price.

the_edge_item_echoing_shard.name: Echoing Shard of the Void
the_edge_item_echoing_shard.description: The Echoing Shard of the Void is a jagged, obsidian fragment that pulses with an eerie, residual energy from the abyssal void. When held close to your ear, it allows you to mimic sounds, creating minor illusions that can startle or distract foes. The shard’s whispers seem to come from beyond reality, making listeners uneasy and potentially causing them confusion. Rumored to have been crafted in the depths of the Void by ancient, forgotten beings, this relic is both a tool for survival and a source of unsettling power.

effectDetails.title: Minor Illusion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the Echoing Shard to create a sound mimicry that lasts up to 1 minute. The illusion can be heard by creatures within 30 feet of you and must imitate a sound with which you are familiar. This effect has no saving throw but ends if it becomes obviously false or if you lose concentration.

effectDetails.title: Confusion Effect
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful mimicry, there is a 25% chance (DC 13) that any creature within 60 feet of the sound will be confused for 1 minute. A confused creature can take only one action on its turn (which can include moving), and it takes a -2 penalty to all attacks. The effect ends if the creature uses its action to make a Wisdom saving throw.

the_edge_item_echoing_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Echoing Shard requires a moderate spellcasting skill to use effectively, which is why it has a level requirement of 5.
the_edge_item_echoing_shard.vendorReason: The Abyss Trader specializes in items from the depths of the void and this shard fits their inventory perfectly.
the_edge_item_echoing_shard.shippingDetail: Ships through a rift that can cause minor temporal distortions, arriving within days but with unpredictable delays.

usage.activation: Action to activate; bonus action to maintain the illusion if desired.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts up to 1 minute while maintained.
usage.endsWhen: Concentration is lost or the mimicry becomes obviously false.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but concentration can be difficult.

the_edge_item_echoing_shard.priceReason: The Echoing Shard's rarity and unique ability to create minor illusions and confusion justify its high price in XP.

the_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.name: Chronal Gauntlet of Temporal Twitch
the_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.description: Forged from solidified timelines, this gauntlet allows you to briefly manipulate the flow of time around yourself – mostly. It's a bit glitchy and prone to causing minor paradoxes, so use it sparingly! The Chronal Gauntlet of Temporal Twitch is said to have been crafted in the heart of ancient Temporal Forge by Wario himself, who would totally wear this if he were capable of wielding such a powerful artifact.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Surge
effectDetails.rules: As an action, activate the gauntlet to grant you and all creatures within 5 feet a short burst of speed. You gain advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Paradox Stabilization
effectDetails.rules: When an ally within 30 feet fails a saving throw, you can use your reaction to stabilize them with a burst of temporal energy that cancels the failed save result. This effect has no cooldown but can only be used once per short rest.

the_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The intricate craftsmanship and raw power required for such a gauntlet demand a high level of proficiency in temporal magic.
the_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in rare and exotic artifacts, including those that manipulate time itself.
the_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.shippingDetail: The gauntlet is delivered by Temporal Courier Express via a time-displaced courier who ensures the item arrives perfectly timed for its next use.

usage.duration: 1 minute (ends after 1 minute or when you finish a short rest)
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends after 1 minute or when you finish a short rest

the_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.priceReason: Crafted from solidified timelines, this gauntlet requires immense temporal energy and expertise to produce, making it an expensive yet powerful artifact.

the_edge_item_null_lantern.name: Null Lantern of the Unseen Depths
the_edge_item_null_lantern.description: The Null Lantern of the Unseen Depths is a cryptic lantern made from deep-sea coral and enchanted with abyssal magic. It absorbs light, making it an ideal companion for navigating pitch-black depths, but its true power lies in its ability to cast fear into the hearts of foes. Its eerie glow can blind those who gaze too long, revealing hidden shadows that may not be real at all.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Light
effectDetails.rules: The lantern absorbs light within a 10-foot radius. Enemies in this area must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fearful Glare
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can point the lantern at one creature within 30 feet and attempt to frighten it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

the_edge_item_null_lantern.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 8 due to its deep magic and the risk of losing one's mind in its presence.
the_edge_item_null_lantern.vendorReason: Final Shop specializes in rare curiosities, including items that push the boundaries of reality like this lantern.
the_edge_item_null_lantern.shippingDetail: Shipped via Temporal Courier for expedited delivery to adventurers across the realms.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to point and use)
usage.duration: Instantaneous (for Absorbs Light) / One Minute (for Fearful Glare)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature is no longer within range or the lantern's light fades.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one can be used per day.

the_edge_item_null_lantern.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its rarity and deep magic without overvaluing it.

middle_earth_ring_of_shadows.name: Fragment of Morgoth's Sorrow
middle_earth_ring_of_shadows.description: The Fragment of Morgoth's Sorrow, a shard of ancient dark energy, hums with malevolent power. Its surface gleams with the echoes of Morgoth’s reign, and those who wear it feel the weight of ages past pressing against their will. Prolonged use corrupts the soul, turning even the purest heart into shadow's puppet. This cursed ring grants limited shadow manipulation, but beware — its dark touch can never be fully repelled.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants the user the ability to cast Darkness once per day, creating an area of dim light that reduces visibility and imposes disadvantage on perception checks within its radius.

effectDetails.title: Corruption Risk
effectDetails.rules: Using this ring increases your chance of being affected by Shadow Influence spells (1 in 6). If you fail a saving throw against such effects, your next action is spent moving toward the nearest source of shadow until it is destroyed or you succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save.

middle_earth_ring_of_shadows.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 6 to wield this cursed artifact effectively without succumbing to its corruption.
middle_earth_ring_of_shadows.vendorReason: The Elves of Lothlórien, who have long fought the shadows, keep a wary eye on this fragment and sell it only to those strong enough to resist its dark allure.
middle_earth_ring_of_shadows.shippingDetail: Ships swiftly by raven courier, but the delivery is delayed by one day as the bird must rest after delivering each item.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Shadow Manipulation; once per day.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect for Darkness spell.
usage.endsWhen: Charges are exhausted or the ring is destroyed, whichever comes first. Charges replenish at dawn.

middle_earth_ring_of_shadows.priceReason: Reflects its dark power and limited use, balancing its corruption risk with its powerful abilities.

middle_earth_wario_shard.name: Wario's Pocket Dimension Pebble
middle_earth_wario_shard.description: The Wario's Pocket Dimension Pebble gleams with an otherworldly light, its surface marred by the remnants of chaotic energies from Wario’s pocket dimension. Found in a dwarven mine collapse, it occasionally releases random treasures or minor inconveniences—often involving sticky substances that can immobilize foes for short periods. This miniature chunk of chaos grants +5 to luck rolls and allows the user to repair damaged equipment instantly once per day.

effectDetails.title: Repair Equipment
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Instantly repairs one piece of damaged equipment, restoring it to full condition. Ends when used or after 24 hours if not activated.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: Grants +5 to all luck-related rolls until the end of the user's next turn. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

middle_earth_wario_shard.levelRequirementReason: This pebble is accessible early in one’s journey, providing a modest boost for adventurers just starting their path.
middle_earth_wario_shard.vendorReason: The dwarves of the Forged Heart have encountered this peculiar item and managed to extract its secrets from the mine collapses.
middle_earth_wario_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via a courier dragon, ensuring swift delivery but with a slight delay due to altitude constraints.

usage.activation: Bonus action for repairing equipment; once per long rest for luck boost.
usage.duration: Instantaneous repair; luck boost lasts until the end of next turn.
usage.endsWhen: Used or after 24 hours without use; ends at the start of the next short or long rest.

middle_earth_wario_shard.priceReason: This item offers a valuable but not overpowered advantage, suitable for early adventurers.

equestria_item_starfall_potion.name: Starfall Potion of Brilliance
equestria_item_starfall_potion.description: This shimmering potion glows faintly under moonlight, its contents a mix of blueberries and stardust. Brewed during a meteor shower in Equestria, it grants a temporary boost to magical prowess. Drinkers also gain resistance to fire damage for the duration, an unexpected boon from the mysterious stars above. Wario's taste test is legendary; he claims it’s mostly sugar, but the stars are real enough to create small celestial phenomena around you.

effectDetails.title: Increase Magic Power
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this potion grants the drinker a +2 bonus to all spell attack rolls and spell saving throws for 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The drinker gains resistance to fire damage for 1 hour. This effect ends if the drinker takes any fire damage or if it expires at the end of a long rest.

equestria_item_starfall_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion provides a temporary boost in magical ability and fire resistance, suitable for adventurers just starting their journey.
equestria_item_starfall_potion.vendorReason: The market is known for its wide variety of potions and elixirs, brewed by the local apothecary who gathers ingredients from all over Equestria.
equestria_item_starfall_potion.shippingDetail: Ships via Cloudsdale Express, ensuring delivery during a clear night under a full moon.

usage.activation: Consume the potion as an action.
usage.duration: 10 minutes and 1 hour of fire resistance.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire at the end of a long rest or if the drinker takes fire damage.

equestria_item_starfall_potion.priceReason: The potion's rarity, magical properties, and the unusual brewing process justify its high price in XP.

equestria_item_legendary_celestia_shield.name: Celestia’s Aegis of the Elements
equestria_item_legendary_celestia_shield.description: Forged in the heart of Canterlot Castle during a particularly potent thunderstorm, Celestia’s Aegis of the Elements is a massive shield that radiates an aura of incredible power. Crafted from the purest silver and enchanted with elements of the Elements themselves, this shield grants its wielder resistance to lightning damage and the ability to reflect minor attacks back at foes. Legend has it that Princess Celestia herself blessed this shield, imbuing it with her own protective magic.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Lightning
effectDetails.rules: While wielding Celestia’s Aegis of the Elements, you gain resistance to lightning damage. This effect is always active as long as you are holding the shield.

effectDetails.title: Reflective Shield
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction when you take thunder or lightning damage from an attack, you can reflect half of that damage back at the attacker. The reflected damage must be of the same type as the original (thunder or lightning). This effect can only be used once per long rest.

equestria_item_legendary_celestia_shield.levelRequirementReason: This shield's power requires a significant amount of magic and skill to wield effectively, suitable for a 12th-level character.
equestria_item_legendary_celestia_shield.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire holds exclusive rights to sell items blessed by Princess Celestia, making this shield available only through them.
equestria_item_legendary_celestia_shield.shippingDetail: The shield is shipped with extra protective padding and arrives within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; ends when the reaction that triggered it is used or the shield is dropped
usage.endsWhen: The reaction used to reflect damage is expended, or the shield is dropped

equestria_item_legendary_celestia_shield.priceReason: This item’s balanced price reflects its legendary rarity and the amount of magic required for its creation.

earth_land_shard_of_frost.name: Frozen Fury Shard
earth_land_shard_of_frost.description: The Frozen Fury Shard gleams with an eerie blue light, a fragment of ancient frost torn from a dragon's hoard. Wario accidentally dropped it during his misadventure, and its icy touch can freeze foes in place for three turns. With each passing moment, the shard releases a chill that drains mana, compelling spellcasters to temper their power. However, the shard's magic is unpredictable; sometimes, it freezes your fingers as well.

effectDetails.title: Frozen Fury
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard deals 10 cold damage per turn to a creature within reach for 3 turns. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be slowed until the end of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Mana Drain
effectDetails.rules: For each turn it remains in effect, the caster's mana pool is reduced by 2 points. This effect has no save and can be used once per short rest.

earth_land_shard_of_frost.levelRequirementReason: The shard requires a moderate level to wield its icy power without freezing one’s fingers.
earth_land_shard_of_frost.vendorReason: Magic Shop stocks rare artifacts, and this shard is too powerful for general sale.
earth_land_shard_of_frost.shippingDetail: Ships in a specially insulated container to preserve the shard's integrity during transport.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: Target saves successfully or caster uses another action on their turn
usage.charges: Unlimited, but exhausted per short rest

earth_land_shard_of_frost.priceReason: The shard's rare origin and unpredictable effects justify its moderate price.

earth_land_runic_gauntlets.name: Stonegrip Gauntlets of the Guildmaster
earth_land_runic_gauntlets.description: The Stonegrip Gauntlets of the Guildmaster are a set of heavily-worn gauntlets adorned with ancient runes, each etched with the scars of countless battles. Crafted by an irascible guild master, these gauntlets offer unparalleled grip and strength to their wearer, making them indispensable for any guild task or derring-do. Their sturdy leather is reinforced with iron bands that have seen many a scuffle, and their runes hum with latent power.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Grip
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these gauntlets, you gain a +2 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks and saving throws. Additionally, your unarmed strikes deal an extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

effectDetails.title: Stun on Attack
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with a melee attack while wearing these gauntlets, there is a 10% chance that the target is stunned for 1 round. The DC to resist this effect is equal to 8 + your Dexterity modifier.

earth_land_runic_gauntlets.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlets require significant strength and experience to wield effectively.
