earth_land_runic_gauntlets.vendorReason: As a trusted vendor of guild supplies, the quartermaster is well-known for providing gear that meets the rigorous demands of the guild members.
earth_land_runic_gauntlets.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via the guild's own swift couriers, ensuring safe and timely delivery.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Dropped or removed from your hands

earth_land_runic_gauntlets.priceReason: Balanced at a price that reflects the gauntlets' durable craftsmanship and their significant combat advantage.

earth_land_mythic_dragon_scale.name: Scale of the Ancient Wyrm
earth_land_mythic_dragon_scale.description: The Scale of the Ancient Wyrm is a shimmering, iridescent scale that retains vestiges of its ancient draconic heritage. When worn, it grants you the regal presence and strength of an elder dragon, bolstering your physical prowess and charisma for a brief time. This relic also has a whimsical side—while enhancing your combat abilities, it might subtly influence your behavior to reflect a newfound love for collecting shiny objects.

effectDetails.title: Draconic Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Activates on donning the scale. Grants a +4 bonus to Strength and Dexterity for 6 hours, plus +2 charisma. Ends when removed or at the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Surge
effectDetails.rules: Has a 10% chance per hour to trigger an elemental effect. This can be a burst of fire, gusts of wind, or waves of water, as determined by the DM. The effect lasts for 1 minute and has no save DC.

earth_land_mythic_dragon_scale.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to ensure the user can effectively harness its power without overwhelming them.
earth_land_mythic_dragon_scale.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in ancient and mystical artifacts, making it a fitting vendor for this relic of draconic pasts.
earth_land_mythic_dragon_scale.shippingDetail: Ships via the swift couriers of Winged Beast, ensuring safe delivery through the skies above.

usage.activation: Wearing the scale on your body.
usage.duration: 6 hours or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn after removal or if you lose possession of it.

earth_land_mythic_dragon_scale.priceReason: The price reflects its mythic rarity and the unique combination of physical and behavioral effects it offers.

internet_meme_warband.name: Collective Awareness Brigade
internet_meme_warband.description: The Collective Awareness Brigade is a squad of digital avatars, each one a twisted parody of internet culture. These tireless warriors are crafted from the very essence of online chaos—memes, viral trends, and forgotten web content. Their relentless attacks cause confusion and distract foes, making them perfect for any battle where misdirection can turn the tide. Just be wary; these avatars might just start demanding more bandwidth as their own form of payment!

effectDetails.title: Confusion
effectDetails.rules: When the Brigade is activated, all creatures within a 10-foot radius must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. The effect ends if any creature attacks one of the avatars.

effectDetails.title: Distract
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the Brigade can cast Minor Illusion as a bonus action, creating an illusory duplicate that distracts nearby foes, forcing them to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take actions for 1 minute.

internet_meme_warband.levelRequirementReason: The Brigade requires a level 7 character due to its complex programming and the immense internet energy it draws from.
internet_meme_warband.vendorReason: The cyber market specializes in cutting-edge and controversial digital items, making them an ideal vendor for the Collective Awareness Brigade.
internet_meme_warband.shippingDetail: Delivered via encrypted package to prevent any unauthorized access or interference with the avatars' programming.

usage.duration: instantaneous (Confusion), 1 minute (Distract)
usage.endsWhen: the effect ends when a creature attacks one of the avatars, or after its duration expires

internet_meme_warband.priceReason: The Brigade's unique programming and digital essence make it a rare commodity, justifying this balanced XP price.

midlands_item_warrior_charm.name: Grimtooth's Lucky Token
midlands_item_warrior_charm.description: Grimtooth's Lucky Token is a grimy token with a worn leather strap and an iron clasp, said to bring fortune to those who earn it. Crafted from the cursed metal of the Blackfurnace forges, its surface reveals faint etchings of ancient runes that whisper tales of victory. While it may not improve your personal hygiene, this lucky charm does grant +1 bonus to AC and increases your critical hit chance by 5%. It also provides resistance to fear effects.

effectDetails.title: Bonus to Armor Class
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the token grants a +1 bonus to your AC. This effect persists until you remove it.

effectDetails.title: Increased Critical Hit Chance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing Grimtooth's Lucky Token, your critical hit chance increases by 5%. This effect lasts for one hour and expires after that time.

midlands_item_warrior_charm.levelRequirementReason: This token provides basic protection suitable for all adventurers.
midlands_item_warrior_charm.vendorReason: The token's origin from the Blackfurnace forges makes it a logical item for Fractured Forge to sell.
midlands_item_warrior_charm.shippingDetail: Ships via a sturdy cart, delivered within 3 days of purchase.

usage.activation: Wearing the token passively grants its effects.
usage.duration: Active until removed or one hour expires, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you remove it or after one hour.

midlands_item_warrior_charm.priceReason: The token's rarity and forged origin justify its price, providing solid value for adventurers.

leclaire_isle_forbidden_sugar_shard.name: Shard of Pure Sugar Madness
leclaire_isle_forbidden_sugar_shard.description: The Shard of Pure Sugar Madness is a crystalline fragment from the Heart of Sweetness, a forbidden relic that drives those who hold it into fits of obsessive sweetness. Its surface shimmers with an ethereal glow, and its touch lingers on the skin like a sugary mist. Rumor has it that prolonged exposure can lead to uncontrollable cravings for anything sweet, turning even the most level-headed into sugar-crazed obsessives.

effectDetails.title: Sugar Rush
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Shard grants the wielder a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws for 1 hour. However, if the wielder fails to consume at least one sugar-laden treat within this time, they must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or fall into a fit of uncontrollable cravings.

effectDetails.title: Sweet Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: The Shard increases the wielder's Charisma by +2 for 1 hour. This boost can be used once per short rest, but if the wielder fails to engage in at least one act of sweetness (such as frosting a cake or sharing candy) within this period, they must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or risk losing their composure and acting irrationally.

leclaire_isle_forbidden_sugar_shard.levelRequirementReason: Even the lowest-level adventurers might succumb to its addictive power, making it accessible but dangerous for all.
leclaire_isle_forbidden_sugar_shard.vendorReason: Pastry Palace specializes in forbidden sweets and thus can offer this fragment of madness without fear of legal repercussions.
leclaire_isle_forbidden_sugar_shard.shippingDetail: The Swift Delivery Sprite ensures the Shard arrives intact, protected by a magical bubble that prevents its effects from manifesting during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; can be used once per short rest for each effect.
usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the wielder fails a saving throw due to prolonged inactivity with sweetness.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

leclaire_isle_forbidden_sugar_shard.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item, this Shard offers potent effects that are both dangerous and highly sought after by those seeking to exploit its power for personal gain or amusement.

leclaire_isle_curiosity_gummy_worm.name: Gummy Worm of Temporal Distortion
leclaire_isle_curiosity_gummy_worm.description: The Gummy Worm of Temporal Distortion is a neon-green candy that seems to pulse with an otherworldly energy, as if it’s alive and waiting for the right moment to unleash its chaotic power. Chew on one, and you might find yourself caught in a strange temporal loop where your enemies seem to move in slow motion while you dart around like lightning. But beware, for too much distortion can lead to unpredictable consequences—like reliving the same battle over and over until the candy’s magic runs out.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Lapse
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this gummy worm, choose one creature within 30 feet. That target moves at half speed for 1 minute or until it takes a turn to use an action or reaction. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Quickness Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 hour or until you take a long rest, your speed increases by 20 feet. You can use this effect only once per day.

leclaire_isle_curiosity_gummy_worm.levelRequirementReason: This candy requires significant magical potency to activate its temporal distortions.
leclaire_isle_curiosity_gummy_worm.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies is known for its unique and enchanted candies, so selling this temporally-distorting treat fits their inventory perfectly.
leclaire_isle_curiosity_gummy_worm.shippingDetail: The candy arrives in a sealed container to prevent any accidental activation during transit.

usage.activation: Eat the gummy worm as an action.
usage.duration: Temporal Lapse: 1 minute or until the target acts, Quickness Boost: 1 hour or until you take a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or if you use it again before the end of the previous one.

leclaire_isle_curiosity_gummy_worm.priceReason: Balanced to be on par with other uncommon curiosities, this candy offers a unique and powerful temporal effect.

kivotos_item_halo_of_inspiration.name: Brain Sparker Halo
kivotos_item_halo_of_inspiration.description: The Brain Sparker Halo is a sleek, metallic circlet adorned with glowing nodes that pulse with a cerebral energy. Crafted from a rare alloy found deep within the mind-forge of an ancient brain temple, it amplifies your mental acuity and strategic foresight. When activated, it grants you a 25% boost to Intelligence checks for one hour, and a 10% chance to inspire an adjacent ally with a clever idea during combat.

effectDetails.title: Mental Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Brain Sparker Halo grants you a +2 Intelligence modifier on checks for one hour. This effect ends when you finish a short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Inspire Ally
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, you can use your action to activate the halo and grant an adjacent ally within 5 feet of you a +1 bonus to Intelligence checks for the duration of one combat encounter. This effect ends when the combat ends.

kivotos_item_halo_of_inspiration.levelRequirementReason: This item enhances strategic thinking, which requires a basic understanding of tactical and intellectual challenges.
kivotos_item_halo_of_inspiration.vendorReason: The student store caters to scholars' needs for academic and mental tools.
kivotos_item_halo_of_inspiration.shippingDetail: Delivered within one day with express courier service.

usage.activation: bonus action, once per short or long rest
usage.duration: one hour (Mental Boost), until combat ends (Inspire Ally)
usage.endsWhen: rest ends (Mental Boost), combat ends (Inspire Ally)

kivotos_item_halo_of_inspiration.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and imbued with ancient brain temple magic, its value reflects its unique benefits to mental prowess.

kivotos_item_decrypted_notes.name: Professor's Lost Scribbles
kivotos_item_decrypted_notes.description: Professor's Lost Scribbles are a tattered, ink-splattered series of notes hastily scrawled in the margins of a discredited scholar's books. These cryptic pages hold fragments of forbidden knowledge, dangerous spells, and perhaps a recipe for a legendary mushroom stew, though the latter is more likely fiction than fact. Aided by these notes, you might uncover hidden quests, gain lore about the world, or solve a series of arcane mini-puzzles that could lead to untold secrets—or just a good meal plan.

effectDetails.title: Lore Revelation
effectDetails.rules: When you spend an hour studying the scribbles, roll a DC 12 Intelligence (History) check. On a success, you learn one significant piece of lore about a specific ancient artifact or spell. The GM determines its relevance to your current campaign.

effectDetails.title: Mini-Puzzle Trigger
effectDetails.rules: Occasionally, while reading the notes, you trigger a mini-puzzle that requires a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to solve. Success reveals additional information or a clue towards completing an ongoing quest.

kivotos_item_decrypted_notes.levelRequirementReason: The scribbles are complex and require basic understanding of lore and investigation.
kivotos_item_decrypted_notes.vendorReason: Club Supply deals in all manner of scholarly curiosities, including the eccentric notes of a disgraced professor.
kivotos_item_decrypted_notes.shippingDetail: Ships via standard mail service with no special handling required.

usage.activation: Studying the scribbles for an hour using your reading skill.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until you solve a mini-puzzle or learn lore.
usage.endsWhen: The puzzle is solved or the lore revealed. Additional uses require time to rest and study again.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day.

kivotos_item_decrypted_notes.priceReason: The scribbles are rare and hold significant potential for uncovering ancient secrets and solving complex puzzles.

kivotos_item_sparkling_scroll.name: Sparkling Scroll of Minor Illusions
kivotos_item_sparkling_scroll.description: This scroll glimmers with a faint iridescence, its parchment aged and worn. When unrolled, it releases a cascade of sparkling light that can make objects appear larger or smaller, blurring reality for those caught within the spell's reach. It is the favored trickster’s tool, often used to mislead and confuse, as Wario has shown in his escapades. Perfect for distracting foes or fooling librarians into overlooking your actions.

effectDetails.title: Minor Illusion
effectDetails.rules: You create the illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range. The illusion can take any form you choose; however, it must be no larger than a 10-foot cube and must occupy a space that is not occupied by an object or creature.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Focus
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the effect (3 rounds), any creature within 15 feet that attempts to interact with a target of this illusion must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it instead interacts with the illusion and cannot perceive or affect the real object for the duration.

kivotos_item_sparkling_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is crafted for beginners to practice their spellcasting abilities.
kivotos_item_sparkling_scroll.vendorReason: The student store caters to aspiring young mages looking to hone their skills with basic magical tools.
kivotos_item_sparkling_scroll.shippingDetail: Standard delivery, arrives within a week.

usage.duration: 3 rounds
usage.endsWhen: the duration ends or the caster dismisses it as an action

kivotos_item_sparkling_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's enhanced effects and rarity justify its high price, aligning with market value.

kivotos_item_celestial_harmony_amulet.name: Celestial Harmony Amulet - The Student's Blessing
kivotos_item_celestial_harmony_amulet.description: The Celestial Harmony Amulet pulses with a serene, celestial light that resonates with the ancient magic of the academy. This amulet subtly enhances concentration and provides a soothing barrier against psychic attacks, making it an invaluable companion for any student facing overly critical professors or exams. Crafted from the essence of starlight and bound by the whispers of scholar spirits, this amulet is said to bring clarity and peace to its wearer's mind.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Concentration
effectDetails.rules: While attuned, you have advantage on Intelligence (Insight) checks. This effect persists as long as you are wearing the amulet and does not expend charges or require a rest to recharge.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Shield
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to psychic damage when wearing this amulet. The effect ends if you remove the amulet, take an action other than moving, or drop it as part of your action on your turn.

kivotos_item_celestial_harmony_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is designed for students, making it accessible to those who need its calming effects early in their studies.
kivotos_item_celestial_harmony_amulet.vendorReason: Club Supply specializes in academic and scholarly equipment, ensuring that students have the tools they need to succeed.
kivotos_item_celestial_harmony_amulet.shippingDetail: The Royal Messenger delivers with unmatched speed and reliability, ensuring your amulet arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Lasts as long as you are wearing the amulet.
usage.endsWhen: You remove the amulet or take an action other than moving while wearing it.

kivotos_item_celestial_harmony_amulet.priceReason: This amulet is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its balance between utility and rarity, making it accessible to students who need a bit of extra focus.

earth_land_goblin_gumbo.name: Goblin Gumbo of Grumbling Gut
earth_land_goblin_gumbo.description: The Goblin Gumbo of Grumbling Gut is a suspiciously green concoction that smells faintly of old socks and regret. Despite its unappetizing appearance, this brew grants you an extra burst of stamina in the heat of battle, making your muscles feel like they're invigorated by the very essence of goblin resilience. It's rumored to be a favorite among goblin warriors—though perhaps for different reasons than their own claims suggest. Don't blame us if it leaves you with a craving for shiny rocks.

effectDetails.title: Stamina Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume the Gumbo to gain +2 to all Strength and Constitution checks, as well as an additional action on your turn for 3 turns. This effect ends if you take damage or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Uncontrollable Hiccups
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that consuming the Gumbo will cause uncontrollable hiccups for 1 minute, reducing your speed to 5 feet. This effect can be ended by taking no actions and resting for at least 1 hour.

earth_land_goblin_gumbo.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for adventurers just starting their journey.
earth_land_goblin_gumbo.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster stocks essential supplies for new adventurers, including items that can enhance their performance in the field.
earth_land_goblin_gumbo.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the trusted Swift Delivery PONY, ensuring you receive your Gumbo in peak condition.

usage.duration: 3 turns or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage or when duration expires

earth_land_goblin_gumbo.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's moderate power and rarity.

earth_land_item_frostbite_amulet.name: The Emperor’s Chill
earth_land_item_frostbite_amulet.description: The Emperor’s Chill, an amulet forged from the scales of a long-frozen dragon and enchanted with ancient ice magic, exudes a frosty aura that chills both body and soul. Wield it to slow your foes' movements and bolster your defense, but beware, for its icy touch might just trap you in eternal stasis if you're not careful. This relic is a masterwork of craft and magic, crafted by the hands of forgotten artisans long ago.

effectDetails.title: Freeze Target
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with an attack while wearing The Emperor’s Chill, there is a 15% chance the target becomes immobilized for 1d4 rounds. A successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw ends this effect early.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Defense
effectDetails.rules: While wearing The Emperor’s Chill, you gain a +2 bonus to AC and a +1 bonus to all saving throws against cold-based attacks or effects. This enhancement persists for the duration of your concentration (up to 10 minutes).

earth_land_item_frostbite_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires a high level of magic sensitivity to wield effectively, hence the strict level requirement.
earth_land_item_frostbite_amulet.vendorReason: The magic shop specializes in rare and powerful relics from forgotten realms, making The Emperor’s Chill a natural fit for their inventory.
earth_land_item_frostbite_amulet.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, this item requires special handling by the ice_cart service, which guarantees safe delivery within three days.

usage.activation: Activates with a successful hit on an enemy target.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; ends when you no longer wear the amulet or the target makes a successful saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the target successfully saves against it or you remove the amulet.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharging after a short rest.

earth_land_item_frostbite_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its epic rarity and the balance of its effects in combat.

earth_land_item_mythic_geode_of_resonanc.name: Wario’s Jackpot!
earth_land_item_mythic_geode_of_resonanc.description: Wario’s Jackpot! is a colossal geode that pulses with an eerie glow and a tantalizing scent reminiscent of Wario's gourmet treats. Known to be the cradle of elemental chaos, this monstrosity can unleash unpredictable bursts of raw power, summoning tiny dragonkin or showering the area with confetti-like jellybeans. Handle it with care; its volatile nature makes it both a blessing and a curse for any who dare wield such a creation.

effectDetails.title: Summons Elemental Mimic
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can attempt to summon a tiny dragonkin. The creature appears within 10 feet of the geode and remains active for 1 minute or until dismissed by the owner. There is a 50% chance of successfully summoning one upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Confetti Rain
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the geode can release a cascade of colorful confetti that fills a 20-foot radius. All creatures within this area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1 round. The geode expends one use upon activation.

earth_land_item_mythic_geode_of_resonanc.levelRequirementReason: Wielders must be at least Level 1 to handle the unpredictable nature of Wario’s Jackpot!
earth_land_item_mythic_geode_of_resonanc.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in rare and exotic items, including this legendary geode.
earth_land_item_mythic_geode_of_resonanc.shippingDetail: Ships via a trusted dragon courier, ensuring safe delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous summoning; confetti rain lasts 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Dismissed by the owner or when its uses are exhausted
usage.charges: 2 charges, recharges after a long rest

earth_land_item_mythic_geode_of_resonanc.priceReason: This item's rarity and unpredictable power make it worth 1000 XP.

pokemon_item_shadow_essence.name: Voidwalker’s Shard
pokemon_item_shadow_essence.description: A fragment of pure darkness, this shard is a relic from the twilight realm. Crafted from the very essence of shadowy creatures, it allows its wielder to briefly teleport short distances. Legends say it was once part of a greater artifact, now reduced to a shard that whispers tales of ancient battles fought in the dark. Wario’s greedy nature ensures his attempts at acquiring such a relic are always met with swift evasion and misdirection.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Teleport
effectDetails.rules: The user may activate this effect as an action to teleport up to 15 feet. The user must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14) or fall prone, having overextended the shard's power.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Boost
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after using Shadow Teleport, the user gains advantage on Dexterity saving throws. This effect ends early if the user takes any action other than a reaction.

pokemon_item_shadow_essence.levelRequirementReason: Users must have a solid grasp of their surroundings and reflexes to safely use this shard.
pokemon_item_shadow_essence.vendorReason: The safari shop specializes in rare artifacts found in dark, uncharted territories where the shard was rumored to be harvested.
pokemon_item_shadow_essence.shippingDetail: Ships via a specially reinforced delivery truck that can traverse shadowy terrains.

usage.duration: 1 minute (recharges after 8 hours)
usage.endsWhen: The user takes any action other than a reaction or falls prone due to the overextension of power.

pokemon_item_shadow_essence.priceReason: Balanced at this price as it requires a specific level and adds utility without breaking balance.

earth_land_sparkle_shard.name: Glittering Frostbite Shard
earth_land_sparkle_shard.description: The Glittering Frostbite Shard is a crystalline fragment that shimmers with an ethereal glow, emitting a chilling aura when held. This shard can briefly coat the wielder in frost, slowing their movements and creating a frosty trail behind them. It's particularly effective against those who wear heavy armor, as it finds even the smallest gaps to exploit, making it a favorite among elves and gnomes for both combat and pranks.

effectDetails.title: Frost Aura
effectDetails.rules: The wielder of the shard gains a +1 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks and is surrounded by a faint, shimmering frost. For 3 turns, their movement speed is reduced by -10 feet as they are encased in a thin layer of ice.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Frostbite
effectDetails.rules: When the shard makes a successful hit against an opponent wearing less than full plate armor, there is a 30% chance to inflict 'frostbite' (reduces movement speed by -10 feet until the start of their next turn). This effect has no save DC.

earth_land_sparkle_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's icy abilities require a certain level of control over one's surroundings and finesse with cold-based effects.
earth_land_sparkle_shard.vendorReason: As the local mage has a particular interest in all things arcane, they are well-versed in crafting and selling items that manipulate elemental forces like this shard.
earth_land_sparkle_shard.shippingDetail: The fragility of the shard necessitates careful handling by the winged snail courier to ensure it arrives intact.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate and hold the shard.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a duration of 3 turns when held.
usage.endsWhen: The shard's effects end upon release or destruction.

earth_land_sparkle_shard.priceReason: Balanced against other rare curiosities that offer both combat and utility benefits, this shard provides a unique and effective tool for frost-based strategies.

earth_land_forbidden_scroll.name: The Whispers of Rot
earth_land_forbidden_scroll.description: The Whispers of Rot is an ancient, parchment-like scroll that glows a menacingly green hue, emanating eerie whispers that promise forbidden power and certain doom. Its touch alone can cause one's flesh to wither and turn pallid like rotting wood. This relic, forged in the dark heart of forgotten earth temples, grants immunity to poison but at the cost of heightened susceptibility to fungal infections, making its wielders prone to grotesque growths.

effectDetails.title: Withering Touch
effectDetails.rules: When a creature touches or is in close proximity to the scroll for more than an hour, they must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are reduced by -2 to their healing factor and suffer from withering until cured.

effectDetails.title: Fungus Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: The user gains immunity to poison but becomes vulnerable to fungal infections. Any creature in contact for more than 10 minutes must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become infected, dealing 2d4 points of damage each day until cured.

earth_land_forbidden_scroll.levelRequirementReason: Only the most seasoned adventurers can withstand The Whispers of Rot's dark magic without succumbing to its rotting influence.
earth_land_forbidden_scroll.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium is known for its rare and dangerous artifacts, making it the perfect vendor for this forbidden scroll.
earth_land_forbidden_scroll.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, The Whispers of Rot must be delivered by a giant beetle courier with specialized containment measures.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon touching or proximity; requires no action.
usage.duration: Until cured or the scroll's effects are ended.
usage.endsWhen: The user successfully removes the scroll from their possession and performs a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw, or the scroll is destroyed.

earth_land_forbidden_scroll.priceReason: Despite its mythic rarity, The Whispers of Rot's price reflects its balance between danger and utility, ensuring it remains a sought-after but not overpowered item.

earth_land_wario_lucky_charm.name: Wario's Golden Boot of Fortune
earth_land_wario_lucky_charm.description: Wario’s Golden Boot of Fortune is a gleaming relic with polished brass and intricate piping. Crafted by Wario himself in his mischievous forge, it has an uncanny knack for turning misfortune into opportunity. Some say its magic causes calamities to gravitate towards it, while others swear it brings unparalleled luck on the battlefield. Rumored to have been forged from a golden ingot found after one of Wario’s infamous tumbles, this boot offers both boon and bane in equal measure.

effectDetails.title: Fortunate Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you roll an attack with a weapon, you can expend one charge from the boot. On a hit, you gain +2 to your next attack roll made before the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Break
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can activate the boot to trigger a 'lucky break'. This grants temporary resistance to one type of negative status effect for 1 hour. The DM decides which effect is resisted.

earth_land_wario_lucky_charm.levelRequirementReason: Wario’s Golden Boot requires at least 12th level to wield its unpredictable magic.
earth_land_wario_lucky_charm.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster stocks this item as part of their extensive equipment offerings, catering to the needs of seasoned adventurers.
earth_land_wario_lucky_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by the trusty Rocket Beetle, known for its punctuality and reliability in delivering magical artifacts.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action (one per short rest)
usage.duration: Instantaneous; Fortunate Strike ends on a miss; Lucky Break lasts until used
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest, and recharges at the start of each long rest

earth_land_wario_lucky_charm.priceReason: The boot’s unique properties and limited recharge capacity justify its moderate price.

mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_coin_launch.name: Golden Coin Launcher
mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_coin_launch.description: The Golden Coin Launcher is a bizarre contraption crafted from gleaming brass and encrusted with rare gemstones. This relic, once owned by the cunning Koopa King Wario himself, fires enchanted golden coins with surprising force. Knock down foes, disarm traps, or simply amuse your allies; each coin strikes with a bludgeoning blow, leaving its target dazed for a moment. Be wary—it's a rare and valuable item, not just for its combat prowess but also as a symbol of Wario's cunning.

effectDetails.title: Blunt Force Trauma
effectDetails.rules: When the Golden Coin Launcher is activated, it fires an enchanted golden coin that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage to a target within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be stunned for one round.

effectDetails.title: Long Reach
effectDetails.rules: The Golden Coin Launcher has an increased range of 60 feet, allowing you to strike foes from a safe distance without the risk of being targeted by their retaliatory attacks.

mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_coin_launch.levelRequirementReason: This device is designed for beginners and adventurers alike, requiring no specific level to use.
mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_coin_launch.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop specializes in rare and unusual items crafted by the cunning Koopas, making it a natural home for this golden contraption.
mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_coin_launch.shippingDetail: This item is shipped via Mushroom Delivery with a delivery window of one week due to its delicate nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The coin strikes or the target saves successfully against the stun effect
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires recharging after extensive use

mushroom_kingdom_item_golden_coin_launch.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item offers a unique and powerful feature set for beginners while maintaining a fair value.

mushroom_kingdom_item_wart_armor.name: Wart Armor of Resilience
mushroom_kingdom_item_wart_armor.description: The Wart Armor of Resilience, crafted from the hardiest warthog warts found in the Mushroom Kingdom, is a gleaming, slimy cuirass that clings to your form like a second skin. Its warty surface not only provides an unexpected layer of defense but also emits a faint glow under stress, alerting you to impending danger. Wario's personal approval ensures its quality, and it has earned the loyalty of many Mushroom Kingdom warriors seeking both style and substance.

effectDetails.title: Increased Armor Class
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this armor, you have a +2 bonus to your AC. This bonus increases by +1 for every five levels beyond level 5.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Poison
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to poison damage. Additionally, when you are exposed to poison, you can use an action to apply a layer of protective wart slime, providing temporary immunity to the poison's effects for one minute.

mushroom_kingdom_item_wart_armor.levelRequirementReason: The armor requires no level above 1 as it is designed for all warriors, from novice to seasoned.
mushroom_kingdom_item_wart_armor.vendorReason: Toad Town Market prides itself on offering the best gear to protect its citizens and visitors alike.
mushroom_kingdom_item_wart_armor.shippingDetail: Snail Express ensures timely delivery, even in the Mushroom Kingdom's unpredictable weather.

usage.activation: Instantaneous application upon donning; no activation required thereafter.
usage.duration: Until removed or until you die in a manner that does not involve poison exposure.
usage.endsWhen: The armor is removed or the wearer dies from non-poison-related causes.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_item_wart_armor.priceReason: The armor's unique warty material and Wario's endorsement justify its moderate price in experience points.

mushroom_kingdom_item_mushroom_king_favo.name: Mushroom King's Favor
mushroom_kingdom_item_mushroom_king_favo.description: The Mushroom King's Favor is a small, intricately crafted mushroom that glows faintly with magic. It enhances your Strength and Charisma by granting you a +1 bonus to each, and it has a unique ability: when you speak kindly to hostile creatures, they have a 30% chance to calm down without attacking. This token of the Mushroom King's favor is not just for show; it's expected that you will visit him regularly as repayment for his generosity.

effectDetails.title: Increased Strength and Charisma
effectDetails.rules: +1 bonus to Strength and Charisma. These bonuses are always active while the favor is worn.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Pacify Hostile Creatures
effectDetails.rules: When you speak kindly to a hostile creature, there's a 30% chance it calms down without attacking. The effect lasts for 1 minute and ends if the creature takes damage or becomes hostile again.

mushroom_kingdom_item_mushroom_king_favo.levelRequirementReason: The Mushroom King's Favor is tailored to adventurers who have proven themselves worthy of his trust.
mushroom_kingdom_item_mushroom_king_favo.vendorReason: Wario, as a direct representative of the Mushroom Kingdom, often acts as the liaison for such prestigious items.
mushroom_kingdom_item_mushroom_king_favo.shippingDetail: The delivery is made by a massive mushroom courier that can travel great distances underground quickly.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: If the creature takes damage or becomes hostile again, or if you use an action to dismiss it early.

mushroom_kingdom_item_mushroom_king_favo.priceReason: The price reflects both its mythic rarity and the ongoing favors owed to the Mushroom King.

teyvat_item_archon_scroll.name: Fragment of the Divine Decree
teyvat_item_archon_scroll.description: The Fragment of the Divine Decree is a meticulously crafted scroll, its parchment yellowed by age yet shimmering with an otherworldly light. It bears the fragment of an Archon’s decree, said to contain ancient wisdom lost to time. Unraveling its secrets grants fleeting insights into forgotten spells and strategies, but it can also unleash chaotic energies that leave the user disoriented for hours. A relic of Inazuma Imports, this scroll is as enigmatic as it is powerful.

effectDetails.title: Divine Insight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can study the fragment to gain advantage on one ability check. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn. If you fail the check, you must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Resonance
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns while holding this scroll, there is a 20% chance that an unpredictable temporal effect occurs. You must make a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw; on a failed save, you are restrained and must complete a short rest before moving again.

teyvat_item_archon_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The scroll's ancient magic requires the user to be of at least 8th level to safely handle its unpredictable temporal effects.
teyvat_item_archon_scroll.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare artifacts and relics from across Teyvat, including this fragment that was once part of an Archon's powerful decree.
teyvat_item_archon_scroll.shippingDetail: The scroll is carefully packaged for delivery via the Wind Ship to ensure it arrives intact.

usage.activation: Bonus action (Divine Insight), begins at start of each turn (Temporal Resonance)
usage.duration: Until end of next turn (Divine Insight); until restrained by a failed save (Temporal Resonance)
usage.endsWhen: Failed saving throw or completion of a short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can occur per turn

teyvat_item_archon_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's rarity and the risk it poses to users justify its fair price in XP.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_crown.name: Crusty Crown of Crumbling Courage
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_crown.description: The Crusty Crown of Crumbling Courage is a regal yet fragile crown, forged from dough that has been hardened by hours spent in a baker's oven and adorned with shimmering sugar crystals. It grants its wearer a temporary boost against fear, bolstering their courage for moments of peril. However, prolonged use can lead to an irresistible craving for pastries, as the crown seems to draw its strength from sugary treats.

effectDetails.title: Courage Boost
effectDetails.rules: When worn, the crown grants a +1 bonus to saving throws against fear effects. This effect lasts for 1 hour, and can be recharged by consuming at least one pastry or sweet treat.

effectDetails.title: Sweet Temptation
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the crown, there is a 25% chance each day that the wearer will experience an uncontrollable urge to consume pastries. If this effect triggers, the wearer must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or spend their next short rest indulging in sugary treats.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_crown.levelRequirementReason: The crown's inherent fragility and its need for periodic recharging through pastries make it accessible to low-level adventurers.
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_crown.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in items related to pastries, and the crown is a perfect fit for their inventory given its sugary origin.
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_crown.shippingDetail: The crown arrives securely wrapped in layers of parchment paper to preserve its delicate state.

usage.activation: Wearing the crown passively provides benefits, but consuming pastries recharges it.
usage.duration: 1 hour per day; recharged by eating at least one pastry or sweet treat.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes the crown, or if they consume an excessive amount of sweets causing them to fail a Constitution saving throw.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_crown.priceReason: The crown's unique design and fragility, combined with its need for frequent recharging through pastries, justify this moderate price in XP.

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenity_potion.name: Sweet Serenity Potion
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenity_potion.description: Crafted in the heart of Le Clair Isle, this potion is a harmonious blend of enchanted honey and moonlit lavender. Sip it before battle to wash away the stress and tension, allowing your mind to settle into a profound state of calm. The nectar's sweetness lingers, granting you temporary immunity from frustration, while the lavender soothes your soul with its serene aroma. A perfect indulgence for both warriors seeking peace in combat and those who simply wish to recline under the stars.

effectDetails.title: Healing
effectDetails.rules: Consume the potion as an action. You regain 50 Hit Points immediately, and for the next hour you are immune to the 'frustration' status effect.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Frustration
effectDetails.rules: For one hour after consuming the potion, you gain temporary immunity to the frustration effect. If you enter a frustrated state while under its effects, it is immediately negated.

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenity_potion.levelRequirementReason: The potion's ingredients are readily available on Le Clair Isle and do not require advanced skill or rare components.
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenity_potion.vendorReason: Pastry Palace, known for its exquisite honey and lavender sweets, has perfected the art of creating this restorative beverage.
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenity_potion.shippingDetail: The Swift Delivery Pigeons ensure that each bottle is delivered fresh from Le Clair Isle within a day.

usage.duration: One hour
usage.endsWhen: After one hour, the effects expire.

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenity_potion.priceReason: The potion's ingredients are sourced from Le Clair Isle and require skilled brewing, balancing its cost with its restorative benefits.

leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_disto.name: Mythic Dough of Distortion
leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_disto.description: The Mythic Dough of Distortion is a sentient, pulsating mass that warps reality with its touch. Crafted from the essence of mischievous pastry spirits, this dough can be molded into shields or weapons that warp the environment around them. When used, it creates unpredictable effects—turning allies into baked goods for 1 turn, or causing strange phenomena like a cloud of powdered sugar. The Dough's true nature is to playfully distort reality, making any combat situation a culinary carnival.

effectDetails.title: Pastry Transformation
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Mythic Dough of Distortion can be molded into a temporary weapon or shield. All allies within 10 feet that touch it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or turn into a pastry-themed creature for 1 turn. The transformation ends if they take damage.

effectDetails.title: Environmental Distortion
effectDetails.rules: The Dough creates random environmental effects in the area (e.g., frosting fog, powdered sugar cloud) that last until the end of your next turn. These effects can be dispelled by a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_disto.levelRequirementReason: Anyone with even minimal experience in combat or magic can handle the Dough's unpredictable nature.
leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_disto.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies is known for its wide array of whimsical and magical ingredients, making it a natural home for this culinary artifact.
leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_disto.shippingDetail: The Dough arrives sealed in a protective pastry box to ensure it remains stable during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, effects last until the end of your next turn or dispelled by damage or a check.
usage.endsWhen: Pastry Transformation ends when an ally takes damage; Environmental Distortion lasts until the end of your next turn.

leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_disto.priceReason: Balanced for its unique gameplay mechanics and thematic value, this Dough offers a fun but manageable challenge.

leclaire_isle_crimson_crumb.name: Crimson Crumb of Chaos
leclaire_isle_crimson_crumb.description: The Crimson Crumb of Chaos, a mischievous morsel plucked from a rogue batch of demonic brioche, pulses with chaotic energy. This tiny crumb can bestow fleeting boons upon those who consume it—temporary buffs to attack or defense—but also sows minor curses like 'sticky fingers,' which reduces accuracy for a turn. Rumor has it that the crumb might even summon a miniature gingerbread man, adding a whimsical touch of chaos to any battle.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Buff
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming the Crimson Crumb, the user gains advantage on either an attack roll or a saving throw for 3 turns. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and cannot be used again until after resting.

effectDetails.title: Minor Curse: Sticky Fingers
effectDetails.rules: There's a 20% chance that consuming the crumb will reduce your accuracy by -1 to attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks for the duration of one turn. This effect is random and not cumulative.

leclaire_isle_crimson_crumb.levelRequirementReason: The Crimson Crumb's unpredictable nature makes it accessible to lower-level characters who might benefit from its chaotic effects without overwhelming them.
leclaire_isle_crimson_crumb.vendorReason: Pastry Palace, known for their eccentric and magical baked goods, often deals in items like the Crimson Crumb of Chaos due to their expertise in crafting unusual treats.
leclaire_isle_crimson_crumb.shippingDetail: The Flying Cart ensures prompt delivery with a slight delay, as the cart must navigate through the bustling streets of the city.

usage.duration: 3 turns for temporary buffs, one turn for 'sticky fingers'
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends naturally when its duration expires or is interrupted by an action
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only once per short or long rest

leclaire_isle_crimson_crumb.priceReason: The Crimson Crumb's rarity and unpredictable effects justify a higher price, making it accessible yet valuable for adventurers.

leclaire_isle_golden_rolling_pin.name: Golden Rolling Pin of Momentum
leclaire_isle_golden_rolling_pin.description: The Golden Rolling Pin of Momentum exudes an otherworldly glow, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer faintly in the light. Crafted from the purest gold from Leclair Isle's sacred forges, this enchanted rolling pin not only aids pastry making but also propels its wielder with unmatched speed and force. Legend has it that the core of the pin is imbued with the spirit of a great leaper, granting those who wield it both incredible agility and the ability to crush foes with a single impact.

effectDetails.title: Momentum Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you use this rolling pin as an action, you gain a +1d6 bonus to your movement speed until the end of your next turn. If you move at least 30 feet in a single turn while holding it, you deal 1d8 force damage with your next successful hit against a target within reach.

effectDetails.title: Impact Smash
effectDetails.rules: When you successfully hit a target with this rolling pin as part of an attack action, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. This effect has a maximum number of uses per day equal to your proficiency bonus.

leclaire_isle_golden_rolling_pin.levelRequirementReason: The pin's ancient magic requires significant strength and skill to control effectively.
leclaire_isle_golden_rolling_pin.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies is known for its extensive stock of magical kitchen tools, including this legendary rolling pin.
leclaire_isle_golden_rolling_pin.shippingDetail: Ships via special courier; delivery time varies depending on location.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a recharge after a long rest
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn or when you drop the pin

leclaire_isle_golden_rolling_pin.priceReason: The price reflects its rare crafting materials and magical properties, making it a significant investment.

the_edge_forbidden_lantern.name: Whisperlight Lantern
the_edge_forbidden_lantern.description: The Whisperlight Lantern casts a sickly green glow, illuminating only the deepest shadows of reality and attracting the attention of malevolent entities that lurk in the dark. Its flickering flame whispers secrets to those who listen too closely—secrets often marked by misfortune and danger. Those who venture into the night with this lantern must be prepared for an unsettling encounter, as it seems to know more than it should about the horrors hidden just out of sight.

effectDetails.title: Grants Darkvision
effectDetails.rules: The user gains darkvision up to 60 feet while holding the lantern. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn after using it.

effectDetails.title: Attracts Shadow Entities
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the user can activate the lantern to summon a Minor Shadow Demon. The summoned creature has 1d4 hit points and is under the user's control for 1 minute before dissipating into shadow. A successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw ends this effect early.

the_edge_forbidden_lantern.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least 10th level to handle the lantern's inherent risks and harness its power.
the_edge_forbidden_lantern.vendorReason: Edge Outpost deals in items that push the boundaries, making the Whisperlight Lantern an appropriate addition to their forbidden wares.
the_edge_forbidden_lantern.shippingDetail: Delivered under cover of night by The Black Raven, ensuring its arrival is discreet and safe.

usage.activation: Bonus Action to activate or extinguish the lantern's light.
usage.duration: Instantaneous summoning when activated; Darkvision lasts until end of next turn after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if a successful Wisdom saving throw is made, or it is extinguished by hand.

the_edge_forbidden_lantern.priceReason: Balanced as the item provides potent but manageable abilities at an appropriate cost for its level of power and rarity.

the_edge_wario_bomb_of_confusion.name: Wario's Chaotic Burst
the_edge_wario_bomb_of_confusion.description: Wario's Chaotic Burst, a delightfully unstable sphere of pure chaotic energy, crackles with malevolent force as it hovers in your hand. When thrown, this explosive device unleashes a wave of confusion and chaos upon its target, causing them to flail about in bewildered disarray. Just be wary—its unpredictable nature means you must throw it from the safety of at least 30 feet away; aiming too close might just leave you as confused as your foes!
effects: Enemies have a chance to be stunned

effectDetails.title: Force Damage and Confusion
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, Wario's Chaotic Burst deals 1d6 + level force damage. The target has a 50% chance to become confused for the start of their next turn, during which they have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Chance
effectDetails.rules: For one round after activation, enemies within 10 feet have a 20% chance to be stunned. Being hit by this effect requires a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw; on a failed save, the target is stunned.

the_edge_wario_bomb_of_confusion.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third-level proficiency to control its chaotic nature effectively.
the_edge_wario_bomb_of_confusion.vendorReason: Final Shop stocks this item as it caters to adventurers needing tools for unpredictable combat scenarios, especially those who have encountered Wario's chaotic antics firsthand.
the_edge_wario_bomb_of_confusion.shippingDetail: Expressed via Wario Express, the delivery ensures the item arrives in perfect form without risk of premature detonation.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until target is hit or fails its save
usage.endsWhen: Target makes a successful saving throw or takes damage from another source

the_edge_wario_bomb_of_confusion.priceReason: The item's unpredictable nature and the specialized materials required for its creation justify its higher price.

kivotos_item_data_shard_37b.name: Digital Echo Fragment
kivotos_item_data_shard_37b.description: A Digital Echo Fragment is a shimmering shard of corrupted data, pulsating with a faint blue glow that flickers like forgotten memories. Crafted from the remnants of Academy City's lost algorithms, it hums with latent potential. Some claim it holds lost recipes, while others whisper of hidden knowledge just out of reach. This fragment can detect hidden objects within 30 feet, and its presence subtly enhances Intelligence by 10% for up to one minute.

effectDetails.title: Detect Hidden Objects
effectDetails.rules: The user can use an action to activate this effect. For the next round, they gain advantage on Perception checks to detect secret doors and hidden objects within 30 feet.

effectDetails.title: Intelligence Boost
effectDetails.rules: For up to one minute after activation, the user's Intelligence is boosted by 10%. This bonus does not stack with other sources of Intelligence increase. The effect ends if the user takes any damage or when the duration expires.

kivotos_item_data_shard_37b.levelRequirementReason: Requires lower skill to use this fragment effectively without exceeding player capabilities.
kivotos_item_data_shard_37b.vendorReason: The student store caters to curious and tech-savvy students who explore the mysteries of lost data fragments.
kivotos_item_data_shard_37b.shippingDetail: Shipped via package_bot with standard delivery within the next school week.

usage.duration: One minute or until interrupted by damage
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends if the user takes any damage or at the end of their next turn after activation, whichever comes first.

kivotos_item_data_shard_37b.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the fragment's unique capabilities and its limited, non-consumable nature.

earth_land_item_sticky_slime.name: Sludge of Sticky Success!
earth_land_item_sticky_slime.description: The Sludge of Sticky Success! is a viscous, earthy mass that oozes with latent energy from the heart of the ancient earth. It adheres to foes with surprising tenacity, slowing them by half and making them prone to comical slips when they least expect it. Crafted from the very essence of the land, this sludge is as dependable as it is unpredictable; just be wary—its grip can be just as tight on you if you're not careful!

effectDetails.title: Target Slowed
effectDetails.rules: The Sludge of Sticky Success! applies the 'slowed' condition to a single creature, reducing its movement speed by 50%. This effect lasts for 3 turns. There is no saving throw against this effect.

effectDetails.title: Comical Slip
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that whenever the target of the Sludge takes damage from any source, it will make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 12) to avoid falling prone. On a failed save, the creature falls flat on its face and must use its action on the following turn to stand up again.

earth_land_item_sticky_slime.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted for adventurers who are just starting their journey, providing them with an advantage in early combat encounters.
earth_land_item_sticky_slime.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster supplies adventurers with the tools they need to succeed in their quests, and this sludge fits perfectly into that mission.
earth_land_item_sticky_slime.shippingDetail: Delivered via Mud Pony Express, known for its reliable service through all kinds of terrain.

usage.activation: The Sludge is activated as a bonus action by squeezing it and throwing it at an enemy within reach.
usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the creature moves more than 10 feet away from the sludge.

earth_land_item_sticky_slime.priceReason: Crafted with rare earth elements and ancient lore, this item provides a significant advantage in combat at a fair price.

earth_land_item_dragonscale_gauntlets.name: Grumblescale Gauntlets of Minor Might!
earth_land_item_dragonscale_gauntlets.description: Forged from the scales of a particularly grumpy young dragon, these gauntlets are surprisingly comfortable despite their fierce origin. When you strike with might, they occasionally emit sparks and a low growl that sends shivers down your spine. These Grumblescale Gauntlets grant you +5 Strength for 6 turns and increase your knockback resistance by 20%. They’re a rare find in the magic shop, where the seasoned staff can help adventurers who seek such unique armaments.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Strength
effectDetails.rules: Activates on donning. While worn, your Strength is increased by +5 for 6 turns. This effect ends if you remove the gauntlets or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Knockback Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While worn, your resistance to knockback is increased by 20%. This effect persists as long as you wear the gauntlets and ceases on removal.

earth_land_item_dragonscale_gauntlets.levelRequirementReason: These gauntlets are crafted for beginners who need a bit of extra oomph in their melee attacks.
earth_land_item_dragonscale_gauntlets.vendorReason: The magic shop is known for its unique and powerful armaments, making these gauntlets an easy fit for their inventory.
earth_land_item_dragonscale_gauntlets.shippingDetail: Delivered with a custom courier who ensures the gauntlets are handled with care to preserve their magical integrity.

usage.duration: 6 turns while worn
usage.endsWhen: On removal or when duration expires

earth_land_item_dragonscale_gauntlets.priceReason: The gauntlets are crafted from rare dragon scales and offer a unique combination of power and comfort, making them a fair price for adventurers.

earth_land_item_ancient_stone_charm.name: Whispering Stone of Forgotten Roots!
earth_land_item_ancient_stone_charm.description: The Whispering Stone of Forgotten Roots feels warm and smooth, its grey surface etched with ancient runes that glow faintly in the dark. It's said to have been crafted from an old gnome village long buried by time and earth. When held, it hums softly, sharing forgotten secrets, often complaints about bad weather or territorial disputes among the roots themselves. Use it wisely, for its power is both a gift and a curse.

effectDetails.title: Whispered Wisdom
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can hold the stone to gain temporary wisdom (+2) for 4 turns. The stone must be held and focused on during this time.

effectDetails.title: Earth Magic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on saving throws against earth-based spells or effects for 1 hour when wearing the stone as a charm.

earth_land_item_ancient_stone_charm.levelRequirementReason: The ancient power of the stone requires a minimum understanding of its lore and magic.
earth_land_item_ancient_stone_charm.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in relics that connect with nature, making this stone an ideal addition to their collection.
earth_land_item_ancient_stone_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by a slow but reliable golem, ensuring the stone arrives unharmed and in good condition.

usage.activation: Action: Hold the stone for one full round.
usage.duration: 4 turns or until used
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you no longer hold it as a charm.

earth_land_item_ancient_stone_charm.priceReason: This price reflects the stone's ancient crafting and its limited, yet potent, magical properties.

midlands_item_empire_decree.name: Decree of the Iron Hand
midlands_item_empire_decree.description: The Decree of the Iron Hand, a tattered parchment signed by an emperor long gone, exudes a chilling presence. Its ink has faded to nearly nothing, yet it retains a potent influence over those who wield its power. Legends speak of its ability to command absolute obedience and silence dissent, though its effects are unpredictable at best. When used with care, it can grant advantage on Persuasion checks against lawful characters and reduce factional tensions by triggering positive events.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Persuasion Checks
effectDetails.rules: When used, the Decree grants advantage on a single Persuasion check against lawful characters. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Positive Faction Event
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, using the Decree can trigger a positive faction event within a 1-mile radius, reducing taxes by one level for up to one week. The effect has a 50% chance of occurring if used.

midlands_item_empire_decree.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second-level proficiency in diplomacy or history to wield the Decree effectively.
midlands_item_empire_decree.vendorReason: The Empire Exchange specializes in historical artifacts and relics, including decrees from ancient emperors.
midlands_item_empire_decree.shippingDetail: Ships via an imperial courier for expedited delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (advantage lasts until the end of next turn, faction event occurs once per rest)
usage.endsWhen: Advantage expires at the end of your next turn; faction event ends after one week or when triggered again.

midlands_item_empire_decree.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare, historically significant artifact with limited but potent effects.

midlands_item_aegis_of_silence.name: Aegis of Silence
midlands_item_aegis_of_silence.description: The Aegis of Silence is a shimmering, almost translucent shield forged from the quiet whispers of ancient monks who sought to harness silence itself. Crafted in a long-forgotten monastery, its surface seems to absorb sound and dampen magical vibrations, making the wearer nearly invisible to both ears and eyes. Its weight barely registers despite its enchantment, yet its effects are undeniable: it grants +4 AC and reduces the effective range of enemy spells by half, turning the battlefield into a hush of unspoken threats.

effectDetails.title: Silence Aura (Passive)
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Stealth checks in dimly lit areas. The shield's aura creates a subtle, calming effect that reduces the effective range of all enemy spells by 50%, forcing them to target within half their original range.

effectDetails.title: Silence (Daily)
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can cast Silence once per day as an action. The spell's duration is 1 minute, and it has a save DC of 18. This effect suppresses sound in a 20-foot radius centered on the wielder.

midlands_item_aegis_of_silence.levelRequirementReason: The Aegis requires a high level to fully utilize its silent magic without risking exhaustion or overexertion.
midlands_item_aegis_of_silence.vendorReason: Forgotten monks entrusted the creation of this shield to Fractured Forge, as their legacy is one of crafting items that blend arcane and martial prowess.
midlands_item_aegis_of_silence.shippingDetail: The dragon airship delivers the Aegis swiftly but requires a special cargo hold that can contain its mystical properties without interference.

usage.duration: Silence Aura (instantaneous), Silence (1 minute, up to once per day)
usage.endsWhen: The spell ends if the wearer is incapacitated or when its duration expires.

midlands_item_aegis_of_silence.priceReason: This price reflects a mythic item that balances utility and power, offering significant benefits without overstepping the bounds of a balanced game.

almost_edge_crumb_of_void.name: Crumb of Void
almost_edge_crumb_of_void.description: The Crumb of Void is a brittle, sugary fragment that crackles with an ethereal glow as it shatters upon contact with your tongue. It's said to be a piece of reality torn from the very edge of existence and solidified into this ephemeral treat. Consuming one grants you fleeting glimpses through the fabric of space-time, possibly leading to moments of delightful confusion or profound existential dread. Be warned: this snack comes with unpredictable side effects.

effectDetails.title: Restore 100 Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: Eating the Crumb of Void immediately restores 100 hit points. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Madness (10%)
effectDetails.rules: There's a 10% chance that consuming the Crumb will cause you to gain temporary madness for 1 minute. The DC to save against this effect is 15. If you fail your saving throw, you must succeed on another saving throw at the end of each round while under its effects or fall unconscious until fully recovered.

almost_edge_crumb_of_void.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can indulge in the Crumb of Void, as its power is not reserved for the experienced adventurer.
almost_edge_crumb_of_void.vendorReason: The void merchant has a reputation for selling the most bizarre and otherworldly items, making it no surprise that they would offer this delicacy from beyond reality.
almost_edge_crumb_of_void.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Rift Express with next-day delivery within the realm of magic. Expedited shipping ensures your Crumb arrives fresh and intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for hit point restoration; 1 minute or until madness ends if temporary madness occurs
usage.endsWhen: The effect concludes upon consuming the Crumb of Void, or when the temporary madness duration expires

almost_edge_crumb_of_void.priceReason: Despite its mythic rarity and limited stock, the Crumb's price reflects its accessible nature to any adventurer willing to brave its effects.

almost_edge_chronal_boots.name: Chronal Boots of Shifting Steps
almost_edge_chronal_boots.description: The Chronal Boots of Shifting Steps are a rare find, crafted from time-worn leather that once belonged to a pastry chef who navigated the temporal fluxes of his culinary experiments. These boots allow you to momentarily bend the fabric of time, granting you a brief respite from danger or allowing you to correct minor blunders – though they whisper of the perilous consequences of tampering too deeply with the timeline.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Dodge
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, you can use your Dexterity to dodge an attack. You gain advantage on this saving throw if it's against a ranged attack or if the attacker is within 30 feet of you. This effect has no cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Chronal Rewind
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can rewind time for yourself by up to 2 turns. During this time, you are immune to all damage and effects from attacks or spells. After the duration ends, roll a d10; if it matches your Dexterity modifier (rounded down), you successfully avoid any negative consequences of the rewound actions.

almost_edge_chronal_boots.levelRequirementReason: The boots' temporal mechanisms are intricate and require a solid understanding of both combat and time manipulation.
almost_edge_chronal_boots.vendorReason: The edge_wanderer specializes in unique, one-of-a-kind items that bridge the gap between reality and fantasy, making these boots an ideal addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_chronal_boots.shippingDetail: The Temporal Courier ensures that the Chronal Boots arrive intact by bypassing conventional time constraints, delivering them within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Reaction for Temporal Dodge; once per short rest for Chronal Rewind
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Temporal Dodge) or up to 2 turns (Chronal Rewind)
usage.endsWhen: On cooldown until the next short rest after using Chronal Rewind, and when an attack is successfully dodged in Temporal Dodge.

almost_edge_chronal_boots.priceReason: The boots are priced at a fair value considering their rarity and the unique temporal mechanics they offer.

almost_edge_observer_lens.name: Observer's Lens of the Forgotten
almost_edge_observer_lens.description: This ancient lens, crafted from forgotten glass and bound by spectral threads, allows its wielder to glimpse into the past of those who have perished in the void. It provides fleeting visions that can reveal hidden paths but also leaves the beholder with a lingering sense of unease, as if watching someone else’s final moments. Rumors say that staring too long into this lens could cause one to see their own demise.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse into Past
effectDetails.rules: When the user gazes through the lens, they can attempt to learn a secret or hidden path related to an individual who has passed. This requires a successful Wisdom (Perception) check against a DC of 12. The effect is instantaneous and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Faint Sense of Unease
effectDetails.rules: The lens exerts a subtle psychological effect, causing the user to feel uneasy for one minute after use. This condition ends when the user completes a short rest or takes an action to focus their mind on something else. The effect can be resisted with a successful Wisdom saving throw (DC 10).

almost_edge_observer_lens.levelRequirementReason: The lens requires basic perception skills, making it accessible to lower-level characters.
almost_edge_observer_lens.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in relics and artifacts from the forgotten realms, thus this item fits well within their inventory.
almost_edge_observer_lens.shippingDetail: Ships via spectral courier, ensuring safe arrival but with a slight delay due to ethereal travel.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect
usage.endsWhen: After one use per day or when the user completes a short rest

almost_edge_observer_lens.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and unique abilities, offering players an intriguing option for exploration.

animatopia_boar_charm.name: Boar's Fury Amulet
animatopia_boar_charm.description: Crafted from the tusk of a sacred boar revered in the ancient forests of Animatopia, this amulet is said to channel the beast's raw fury into its wearer. When donned, it imbues you with a righteous rage that can turn even the most timid warrior into a berserk combatant, dealing increased damage and giving you a chance to stagger foes. However, prolonged use comes at a cost—your head may throb with a relentless headache until the amulet's effects subside.

effectDetails.title: Increased Attack Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you attack, increase your damage roll by +1d6. This effect lasts for the duration of a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Stagger
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, when you hit an enemy with a melee attack, there is a 20% chance to cause them to fall prone and be stunned until the start of your next turn. This effect does not stack.

animatopia_boar_charm.levelRequirementReason: Only those experienced in combat can harness this amulet's fury without succumbing to its primal power.
animatopia_boar_charm.vendorReason: The tribal trader has a deep connection with the forest spirits, allowing them to offer rare items like the Boar's Fury Amulet.
animatopia_boar_charm.shippingDetail: Ships quickly via winged monkey courier, arriving within days of purchase.

usage.activation: Automatic upon donning the amulet; ends at the start of your next turn or when removed.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after removal
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn after removing the amulet, or if you are knocked unconscious.

animatopia_boar_charm.priceReason: The rarity and mystical craftsmanship required to create this amulet justify its moderate price.

animatopia_honeycomb_potion.name: Buzzing Bliss Brew
animatopia_honeycomb_potion.description: Buzzing Bliss Brew is a golden, viscous potion derived from the rare nectar collected by iridescent giant bees that dwell deep within the heart of Animatopia's Whispering Woods. This enchanted honey, known for its healing properties and potent energy boost, temporarily grants you the grace and speed of a frenzied squirrel, allowing you to dart through dense underbrush with ease. Upon imbibing, your agility soars, making you nearly impossible to catch in a race against time.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed (25 ft.)
effectDetails.rules: By drinking Buzzing Bliss Brew, you gain a +10 foot movement speed bonus for 1 minute. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and ends when the duration expires or if you fall unconscious.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Agility Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the effect, your Dexterity (Athletics) checks are made at advantage. This bonus lasts until the end of the 1-minute period, after which it is lost and cannot be reapplied for another hour.

animatopia_honeycomb_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion offers a mild boost suitable for beginners to enhance their movement speed and agility.
animatopia_honeycomb_potion.vendorReason: The forest market specializes in exotic and natural products, including the honey from which this brew is made.
animatopia_honeycomb_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant bee courier who ensures timely delivery to all locations within Animatopia.

usage.duration: 1 minute, recharges after 1 hour.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or if you fall unconscious.

animatopia_honeycomb_potion.priceReason: The price reflects the rare ingredients and the complex brewing process, making it a valuable yet accessible potion for adventurers.

internet_faction_access_badge.name: Data Tribe Recognition Badge
internet_faction_access_badge.description: The Data Tribe Recognition Badge, a sleek metallic disc embossed with the emblem of the 'Pixel Pioneers,' opens doors to exclusive cyber-markets and digital enclaves. Wielded by those who dare to explore the depths of data, it grants access to rare treasures and secret codes, while also increasing your reputation within the faction. This badge is a symbol of trust and respect among the data miners and algorithm enthusiasts, but beware—its power draws both admiration and envy from other factions.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Access
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. While wearing this badge, you gain access to exclusive locations within the digital realm, allowing you to explore and interact with restricted areas. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Rarity Drops
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you find an item in a digital location, there is a +10% chance that rare items are found instead of common ones. This effect applies once per short or long rest and resets after 24 hours.

internet_faction_access_badge.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency with technology to fully appreciate the badge's power.
internet_faction_access_badge.vendorReason: The cyber_market is trusted by Pixel Pioneers for its integrity and access to exclusive resources.
internet_faction_access_badge.shippingDetail: Ships via fast delivery drone, ensuring swift arrival of the badge within a week.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, lasts until end of next long rest.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The long rest ends or you remove it from your person.

internet_faction_access_badge.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its utility and the faction's prestige.

warhammer_runeofdespair.name: Rune of Despair
warhammer_runeofdespair.description: The Rune of Despair, a warhammer forged in the shadowed forges of Fate Forge, is etched with runes that whisper of shattered hopes and broken spirits. Its weight seems to pull at your very resolve as you wield it, and its blows deliver not just physical damage but a chilling wave of despair that can rend the morale of even the most stalwart warriors. Each strike has a 5% chance to leave your foes shaken, their courage turned to dread.

effectDetails.title: Despair
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with the Rune of Despair, there is a 5% chance that your target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they are frightened until the end of their next turn and take an additional 1d6 + your Strength modifier psychic damage.

effectDetails.title: Morale Reduction
effectDetails.rules: For every three foes you strike with the Rune of Despair in a combat encounter, the morale of all friendly units within 30 feet is reduced by one step on the Morale table. This effect lasts for the duration of the encounter.

warhammer_runeofdespair.levelRequirementReason: This ancient weapon requires a proficient user who has faced significant trials to wield its dark magic effectively.
warhammer_runeofdespair.vendorReason: Fate Forge is known for crafting items imbued with powerful and often controversial magics, making the Rune of Despair a natural addition to their stock.
warhammer_runeofdespair.shippingDetail: Shipped via Drone Delivery's Express Service, the Rune of Despair arrives swiftly, though it is recommended that only those who have faced significant trials in combat attempt its use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect per strike; lasts until end of turn for failed saves.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after three uses per encounter, recharges at dawn.

warhammer_runeofdespair.priceReason: Balanced to be a valuable asset in the hands of a seasoned warrior, this weapon's price reflects its rarity and unique abilities.

chaos_rune_scroll.name: Scroll of Unraveling Fate
chaos_rune_scroll.description: Unleash the Scroll of Unraveling Fate, a chaotic rune scroll that shimmers with an unsettling vibrancy. When unfurled, it grants a temporary boon to your luck and the ability to subtly alter events, though the threads of fate are fickle—unpredictable chaos might unravel in unexpected ways. The scroll's power is both liberating and perilous, offering fleeting moments of divine intervention or malevolent disruption, depending on the whims of fate.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Luck
