pokemon_item_sparkling_berry.description: The Sparkling Berry of Wonder radiates an ethereal glow, its surface shimmering like a captured starry sky. When you consume one, your muscles surge with untapped strength and agility, leaving you feeling both invigorated and electrified. The berry's essence grants you a +2 bonus to Dexterity and Constitution for the next hour, but beware—there's a chance that after the boost, you'll be left confused for 1d4 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Stat Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity and Constitution for 1 hour. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption, lasts until the start of your next turn after the expiration, and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Inflict Confusion
effectDetails.rules: There's a 20% chance that you become confused for 1d4 minutes immediately after consuming the berry. You must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this effect, which ends when it is no longer the result of the confusion.

pokemon_item_sparkling_berry.levelRequirementReason: The Sparkling Berry of Wonder provides a significant temporary boost to combat readiness but can also lead to unintended side effects, making it suitable for those who have at least reached their first level.
pokemon_item_sparkling_berry.vendorReason: Pokemarts are known for carrying items that enhance both the performance and experience of Pokémon trainers in battle.
pokemon_item_sparkling_berry.shippingDetail: The Poké Mail Drone delivers your order within a day, ensuring that you're ready to take on any challenge with renewed vigor.

usage.duration: 1 hour + 1 round after expiration
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or if confusion is triggered
usage.charges: Unlimited, but once per long rest

pokemon_item_sparkling_berry.priceReason: The Sparkling Berry of Wonder provides a potent temporary stat boost and a chance for additional benefits, making it worth double its common rarity price.

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_valor.name: Ancient Badge of Valor
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_valor.description: The Ancient Badge of Valor is a rusted, intricately engraved badge, imbued with the valor and strength of legendary Pokémon trainers. Its surface glows faintly with an ancient energy, lending both a +5 bonus to attack and +3 to defense when worn. It whispers tales of battles fought and won by those who once claimed it as their own, granting you the chance for a critical hit on any successful attack.

effectDetails.title: Attack Boost
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides a +5 bonus to your attack rolls. It activates as soon as you put the badge on and lasts until removed or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Defense Boost
effectDetails.rules: Wearing this badge grants a +3 bonus to AC, effective immediately upon donning it and lasting until it is taken off or destroyed.

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_valor.levelRequirementReason: The Ancient Badge of Valor is suitable for all adventurers as its power is meant to be shared.
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_valor.vendorReason: League Store curates items from the most respected trainers, ensuring that only the finest gear and relics are sold there.
pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_valor.shippingDetail: The Elite Trainer Courier ensures swift delivery, often arriving within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the badge.
usage.duration: Until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: When the badge is taken off or destroyed in battle.

pokemon_item_ancient_badge_of_valor.priceReason: The Ancient Badge of Valor strikes a balance, offering a substantial stat boost for a fair price.

pokemon_item_phantom_feather.name: Phantom Feather of Echoes
pokemon_item_phantom_feather.description: The Phantom Feather of Echoes is a single, ghostly white feather that whispers tales of battles past when held. It's said to have fallen from the wing of a legendary Ghost-type Pokémon long vanished into the Veil. This relic grants you fleeting access to ancient battlefields, allowing you to hear the echoes of skirmishes and strategize unseen. Its whispering can confuse foes by leading them astray in hidden paths they cannot see.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Whispers
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you hear the echoes of past battles within a 30-foot radius. This lasts for 1 minute per level of the user. Any creature within this area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or become paralyzed until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Pathfinding
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your hearing, you gain advantage on Perception checks to find hidden paths and secret doors. This effect lasts for 1 hour per level of the user, but it ends if you leave the area or are incapacitated.

pokemon_item_phantom_feather.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a minimum level due to its potent effects that can influence combat and strategic advantage.
pokemon_item_phantom_feather.vendorReason: The Safari Shop specializes in rare Pokémon artifacts, including relics with mystical origins like the Phantom Feather of Echoes.
pokemon_item_phantom_feather.shippingDetail: Delivered via spectral courier who ensures safe and timely arrival within a week.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate hearing; passive effect for pathfinding.
usage.duration: 1 minute per level for Echoing Whispers, 1 hour per level for Pathfinding
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the user leaves the area or becomes incapacitated; bonus action use.

pokemon_item_phantom_feather.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the powerful, yet not overpowered, effects it offers.

connectopia_circuit_breaker_shard.name: Fragment of the Null Conduit
connectopia_circuit_breaker_shard.description: Recovered from a collapsed data nexus, this shard hums with suppressed energy. Crafted during a catastrophic digital storm, it whispers of forgotten cybernetic secrets and unseen electromagnetic interference. When activated, it disrupts electronic devices in the immediate area, causing temporary malfunctions in mechanical constructs and automated defenses. Rumored to be a relic of the Null Conduit, this shard is both a tool for mischief and a symbol of forbidden knowledge.

effectDetails.title: Electromagnetic Interference
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within 30 feet, this shard creates a zone of electromagnetic interference that lasts for 1 minute. All creatures and objects within the area have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws against electronic devices. Mechanical constructs in the area automatically fail any saving throw to resist the effect.

effectDetails.title: Confusion Aura
effectDetails.rules: For every round this shard remains active, each mechanical construct within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become confused for the rest of the duration. On a successful save, they are immune to its effects for 24 hours.

connectopia_circuit_breaker_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 7 to handle the shard's volatile energy safely and effectively.
connectopia_circuit_breaker_shard.vendorReason: Pioneer Post, known for their connections with arcane technology, has a reliable network to ensure such forbidden items reach capable hands.
connectopia_circuit_breaker_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Roving Scout Drone, ensuring swift delivery and secure handling of this delicate artifact.

usage.activation: Activate as an action within 30 feet of a target area.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until dispelled by magic.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if exposed to strong electronic fields or direct electrical currents.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

connectopia_circuit_breaker_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its utility in disrupting electronic defenses and constructs without overpowered effects.

connectopia_blueprint_for_portable_mine.name: Schematic for the 'Dig-o-Matic'
connectopia_blueprint_for_portable_mine.description: This blueprint, etched onto a rugged block of quartz, is a masterful fusion of ancient mining lore and modern engineering. Crafted by the enigmatic Forgeheart Foundry, it details how to construct a portable 'Dig-o-Matic'—a compact automated mining unit that can extract small veins of ore and gems with precision. Though its assembly requires basic crafting skills, the blueprint itself is known for being slightly unpredictable; occasionally, the Dig-o-Matic may malfunction, causing a minor tremor beneath your feet as it mines.

effectDetails.title: Mining Operation
effectDetails.rules: Activates on the start of your turn as an action. The Dig-o-Matic mines for small amounts of ore and gems within a 5-foot radius, dealing no damage but uncovering valuable resources worth up to 10 gp in value. If it malfunctions, the user must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or trigger a minor tremor.

effectDetails.title: Unstable Assembly
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance per day that the Dig-o-Matic will spontaneously malfunction during assembly. If this occurs, the blueprint's creator must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence (Engineering) check or risk losing half of the crafted item’s value.

connectopia_blueprint_for_portable_mine.levelRequirementReason: This item requires basic crafting skills and is designed for beginners to experiment with mining technology.
connectopia_blueprint_for_portable_mine.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in tools and blueprints that help adventurers craft essential gear, making it the perfect vendor for this blueprint.
connectopia_blueprint_for_portable_mine.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days of purchase. Due to its weight, an additional 50 XP is added to the shipping cost.

usage.activation: Activates on the start of your turn as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous.
usage.endsWhen: The mining operation ends when you stop using it or the Dig-o-Matic malfunctions.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires crafting checks during assembly.

connectopia_blueprint_for_portable_mine.priceReason: Reflects the advanced blueprint's value in crafting a useful and potentially dangerous tool.

internet_meme_therapy.name: Existential Validation Session
internet_meme_therapy.description: The Existential Validation Session offers a digital therapy session where your mind is flooded with the most popular memes from The Internet, temporarily boosting confidence and morale. This service can instantly transform your outlook on life, replacing lingering feelings of voidness with laughter and community. Warning: While not physically dangerous, prolonged use might encourage you to share these memes across various platforms, potentially leading to an uncontrollable meme-sharing compulsion.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Confidence Boost
effectDetails.rules: This effect grants the user a +2 bonus to Charisma-based checks and saving throws for 1 hour. The effect can be activated as a bonus action, but the duration resets each time the session is reactivated.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Charm
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance (DC 12) that any hostile creature within 30 feet of the user will become charmed for 1 minute upon activation. The charm ends early if the charmed creature takes damage.

internet_meme_therapy.levelRequirementReason: The session is designed to be accessible to all adventurers, regardless of their level.
internet_meme_therapy.vendorReason: Data Dealer specializes in providing unique and innovative services that cater to the ever-changing needs of the adventurer community.
internet_meme_therapy.shippingDetail: The service is delivered instantaneously upon payment, with no waiting time for activation.

usage.duration: 1 hour per session
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the user's next short or long rest begins

internet_meme_therapy.priceReason: This price reflects a balanced XP cost for a rare and unique service that provides significant, yet temporary, benefits.

almost_edge_item_voidwalker_amulet.name: Amulet of the Liminal Step
almost_edge_item_voidwalker_amulet.description: The Amulet of the Liminal Step, forged from solidified void-stuff, allows its wearer to phase through thin barriers by bending reality itself for a fleeting moment. Crafted in the shadowy depths of the Void Market, it is said that each amulet captures a fragment of liminal space, making passage through weak barriers both possible and perilous. Once worn, the wearer can slip through narrow gaps or weakened walls, but beware – if trapped, there's no guarantee you'll find your way back to solid ground.

effectDetails.title: Liminal Passage
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can attempt to phase through thin barriers. The amulet allows passage if the barrier's Strength (Perception) check is equal to or less than your Wisdom modifier +10. Once used, it requires 24 hours of meditation and concentration to recharge.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Phasing
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this amulet, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for up to 1 hour after using Liminal Passage. If you are caught in a phasing attempt and fail the check, you gain disadvantage until your next long rest.

almost_edge_item_voidwalker_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's power requires a strong grasp of reality manipulation, which only those of at least 8th level can achieve.
almost_edge_item_voidwalker_amulet.vendorReason: As a dealer in the liminal and the strange, the Void Merchant is well-known for offering items that bend time and space, making this amulet an expected addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_item_voidwalker_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet arrives via a dimensional rift, ensuring it reaches its destination with minimal risk of being seen or intercepted.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Liminal Passage; passive effect during Stealth checks for up to 1 hour.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Liminal Passage; passive effect lasts until the end of your next turn for Stealthy Phasing.
usage.endsWhen: Once used, it requires a day and night of meditation to recharge. If caught in liminal phasing, the effect ends immediately.

almost_edge_item_voidwalker_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and unique crafting process ensure its value remains consistent with other high-end rare equipment.

almost_edge_item_forgotten_echoes.name: Forgotten Echoes of the Lost
almost_edge_item_forgotten_echoes.description: Forgotten Echoes of the Lost are delicate, spectral music boxes crafted from tarnished brass and encrusted with gemstones that seem to hum faintly with ancient magic. When wound, they release haunting melodies that can either draw the attention of restless spirits or evoke deep sorrow in those who listen too long. Each box is a relic from a bygone era, its tune weaving through time like a forgotten memory come to life.

effectDetails.title: Haunting Melodies
effectDetails.rules: Activating the music box allows you to play a haunting melody that lasts for 1 minute. Any creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by the melody until the start of your next turn. A charmed creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

effectDetails.title: Risk of Attracting Unwanted Attention
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance (roll a d4) that activating one of these music boxes will attract the attention of nearby spirits or restless entities. This attraction lasts until you deactivate all active music boxes within your possession, and any creature affected by this effect must make another Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to 10 + your Charisma modifier.

almost_edge_item_forgotten_echoes.levelRequirementReason: The intricate craftsmanship and ancient magic of the Forgotten Echoes necessitate a certain level of experience to wield their power responsibly.
almost_edge_item_forgotten_echoes.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in items that bridge worlds, making these spectral music boxes an ideal addition to her inventory.
almost_edge_item_forgotten_echoes.shippingDetail: Ships via Phantom Delivery Service, known for its mysterious and timely deliveries.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to wind a single music box.
usage.duration: The melody lasts for 1 minute or until you deactivate the box.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if another creature within range makes an attack against you, or if you deactivate all active boxes in your possession.

almost_edge_item_forgotten_echoes.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and the mystical power it contains, balanced to ensure it remains a valuable but not overpowered addition to any character's inventory.

connectopia_block_shimmer.name: Shimmering Resonance Block
connectopia_block_shimmer.description: The Shimmering Resonance Block pulses with a vibrant, ethereal glow that seems to ripple and hum in sync with Connectopia's very energy. When rubbed against another of these blocks, it generates a resonant wave capable of boosting crafting speed by up to 50% for the next hour. The block also has an eerie knack for revealing hidden tunnels, but only if you've crafted at least one item within the last day. Stare too long and you might find yourself with a case of unexpected hiccups—Wario's warning holds true here.

effectDetails.title: Crafting Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: When the block is rubbed against another, it grants a +2d6 bonus to crafting checks for one hour. This effect can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Tunnel Revelation
effectDetails.rules: The block reveals hidden tunnels within a 30-foot radius of your current location with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check. This effect can only be used if you have crafted an item using the Shimmering Resonance Block within the last day.

connectopia_block_shimmer.levelRequirementReason: This block is accessible to all adventurers, offering a helpful tool for those just starting their journey.
connectopia_block_shimmer.vendorReason: The block smiths of Connectopia are well-versed in the peculiarities of these blocks and can provide them directly from their workshops.
connectopia_block_shimmer.shippingDetail: Ships via standard crate, delivered within a week.

usage.activation: Rubbing one block against another as an action.
usage.duration: One hour.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after one hour or when the block is rubbed again.

connectopia_block_shimmer.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its utility in both crafting and exploration without being overpowered.

connectopia_blueprint_analysis.name: Automated Blueprint Scan
connectopia_blueprint_analysis.description: The Automated Blueprint Scan is a sleek, metallic device crafted by Pioneer Post engineers. Equipped with cutting-edge scanning technology, it whirs to life when held over a blueprint, instantly analyzing its structural integrity and pinpointing optimal materials for crafting. The scanner’s LED lights flash vibrant hues as it identifies potential weaknesses and suggests improvements, all in the blink of an eye. This invaluable tool streamlines your crafting process, ensuring that even the most intricate blueprints are executed flawlessly.

effectDetails.title: Blueprint Analysis
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this device scans an open blueprint. It provides a detailed analysis of the blueprint's structural integrity and potential weaknesses within 1 minute. This effect is limited to once per day.

effectDetails.title: Optimal Material Identification
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful completion of the Blueprint Analysis, you gain advantage on any Craft check related to the scanned blueprint for 24 hours. This effect does not require a saving throw and has no save DC or other restrictions.

connectopia_blueprint_analysis.levelRequirementReason: This tool is designed for all adventurers who need precise blueprints, regardless of their level.
connectopia_blueprint_analysis.vendorReason: Pioneer Post specializes in innovative tools that streamline the crafting process and ensure structural integrity.
connectopia_blueprint_analysis.shippingDetail: The scanner is delivered by a Pioneer Post drone within 24 hours of purchase, ensuring you receive your tool quickly.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, passive while in use
usage.duration: Instantaneous analysis; effect lasts for 24 hours after successful completion
usage.endsWhen: Effect expires at the end of 24 hours or when used again on a new blueprint

connectopia_blueprint_analysis.priceReason: The price reflects the advanced technology and precision engineering required to produce this invaluable tool.

connectopia_shard_of_nexus.name: Shard of Nexus
connectopia_shard_of_nexus.description: The Shard of Nexus is a jagged, crystalline fragment that hums with an eerie, chaotic energy. Crafted from the raw essence of Connectopia's Nexus, it pulses with unpredictable power. Locals say it can warp reality and summon block monsters, but a few daredevils believe it holds secrets to unlocking new dimensions. Handle this shard only if you're prepared for the unexpected; its magic is both perilous and potentially life-changing.

effectDetails.title: Reality Warping
effectDetails.rules: Activating the Shard causes a brief ripple in reality, creating unstable spatial distortions. This effect lasts for 1 minute and has a range of 30 feet. Any creature within this area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be disoriented for 1 round. The shard can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Block Monster Summoning
effectDetails.rules: The Shard can summon block monsters from the Plane of Chaos as an action. These creatures are hostile and must be driven off with force. The Shard has a limited number of charges (3), which recharge after 8 hours of rest.

connectopia_shard_of_nexus.levelRequirementReason: The Shard's unpredictable nature requires even the most seasoned adventurers to have at least 1 level to handle its potential risks.
connectopia_shard_of_nexus.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in rare and mythic items, including shards of mystical origins like the Nexus.
connectopia_shard_of_nexus.shippingDetail: The Shard is delivered via Dimensional Express, ensuring it arrives intact but requiring special handling.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to summon block monsters)
usage.duration: Instantaneous (reality warping), 1 minute (distortion effect)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or the Shard is destroyed
usage.charges: 3 charges, recharged after a long rest

connectopia_shard_of_nexus.priceReason: The Shard's rarity and unpredictable power justify its price of 1000 XP.

teyvat_item_oceanic_pearl.name: Oceanic Resonance Pearl
teyvat_item_oceanic_pearl.description: The Oceanic Resonance Pearl gleams with a faint Hydro energy, harvested from the treacherous depths of Liyue's trenchlands where ancient currents still course. This shimmering gem not only restores your vitality but also grants you the power to manipulate water, creating small whirlpools that hinder foes' movements and give you an edge in any squall or calm. A perfect companion for those navigating through stormy seas and grumpy merchants alike.

effectDetails.title: Hydro Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can create a small whirlpool around an enemy within 30 feet. On a successful hit, the target must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be slowed by 15% for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Vitality Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this pearl restores 25 Hit Points to you and grants you advantage on your next attack roll. This effect can only occur once per short rest.

teyvat_item_oceanic_pearl.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted for beginners who need a reliable way to restore health and gain an edge in combat.
teyvat_item_oceanic_pearl.vendorReason: As a port city, Liyue Harbor is well-versed with the ocean's secrets, including the treasures found deep within its trenchlands.
teyvat_item_oceanic_pearl.shippingDetail: Ships via the Seabird Express, ensuring swift delivery from the depths of Liyue.

usage.activation: Bonus action to create whirlpool; consumed on use for vitality boost.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for vitality boost; whirlpools last until end of turn or target is no longer within range.
usage.endsWhen: Upon consumption or when the effect duration ends.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it can be consumed once per short rest.

teyvat_item_oceanic_pearl.priceReason: This item provides a unique combination of utility and combat advantage, justifying its higher price in experience points.

equestria_item_legendary_rainbow_shard.name: Legendary Rainbow Shard of Discord
equestria_item_legendary_rainbow_shard.description: The Legendary Rainbow Shard of Discord is a shimmering fragment, torn from the very storm that once threatened Equestria itself. Crafted from chaotic magic and the heart of a tempest, it pulses with unpredictable energy. While its touch can amplify magical effects by +20%, prolonged use risks unleashing bursts of dissonance—randomly altering spell durations or causing temporary confusion for all within 30 feet. This shard is said to have been forged in Discord's own hands, and only the bravest dare wield it.
effects: risk of minor chaotic effect (roll d6: 1-2 = spell duration halved, 3-4 = temporary confusion for all within 30 feet)

effectDetails.title: Magic Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. The next spell you cast has advantage on the save or check roll. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn. Requires concentration.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Burst
effectDetails.rules: Roll d6 at the start of each of your turns while holding this shard. On a 1-2, the spell you cast has its duration halved. On a 3-4, all creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become confused until the end of their next turn.

equestria_item_legendary_rainbow_shard.levelRequirementReason: Even at lower levels, adventurers can appreciate its power and danger.
equestria_item_legendary_rainbow_shard.vendorReason: As a legendary item with ancient origins, Canterlot's elite commerce ensures it is handled safely and responsibly.
equestria_item_legendary_rainbow_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via royal courier, arriving within 7 days of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate magic amplification; roll d6 at the start of each turn for chaotic burst.
usage.duration: Magic amplification lasts until the end of your next turn. Chaotic bursts occur on each turn you hold the shard.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after 3 uses or destroyed if used in an environment of pure light.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to 3 uses per day.

equestria_item_legendary_rainbow_shard.priceReason: The Legendary Rainbow Shard's balanced price reflects its legendary rarity and unpredictable nature.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes.name: Harmonic Halo of the Discordant Choir
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes.description: The Harmonic Halo of the Discordant Choir is a peculiar golden halo that seems to hum with an eerie melody. When activated, it releases a discordant symphony that can stun nearby foes or grant you a surge in magical prowess, depending on your ability to endure its cacophony. This artifact resonates with the chaotic energies of the choir, making it a rare and sought-after curio among musicians and spellcasters.

effectDetails.title: Cacophonous Disruption
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the halo to unleash a cacophony that stuns all creatures within 5 feet of you for 1 round (DC 14). The effect ends if you end your turn in melee with any creature affected. This ability has a recharge after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Magical Fortitude
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the halo, your saving throw DCs against sonic and psychic damage increase by 2. Additionally, you gain advantage on Concentration checks for as long as you wear it. The halo provides this benefit until removed or destroyed.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed to be accessible early in the adventuring career to encourage experimentation with its unique effects.
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes.vendorReason: Club Supply often carries unusual curiosities that appeal to adventurers and performers alike, making this halo a fitting addition to their inventory.
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes.shippingDetail: Ships via Swift Courier for expedited delivery within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: You end your turn in melee with any affected creature or the halo is destroyed.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes.priceReason: The Harmonic Halo of the Discordant Choir is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique and potentially powerful abilities, as well as its rarity among adventurers.

kivotos_item_student_notebook_of_secrets.name: The Codex of Curious Queries
kivotos_item_student_notebook_of_secrets.description: The Codex of Curious Queries is a tattered student notebook bound in worn leather and filled with cryptic scribbles, eldritch symbols, and whimsical sketches. Its pages are rumored to hold secrets that, when properly decoded, can reveal hidden truths or grant minor advantages. Flipping through it might yield a fleeting glimpse into the unknown or trigger an unintended spell, much to the bemusement of all who dare to explore its contents.

effectDetails.title: Minor Insight
effectDetails.rules: When a scholar spends a minute carefully studying one page of the Codex, they gain advantage on their next Intelligence (Arcana) check. This effect has no limit and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Knowledge
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each combat round, there is a 10% chance that a creature within 5 feet of the Codex gains advantage on one saving throw as its pages whisper arcane secrets. This effect can occur once per short rest.

kivotos_item_student_notebook_of_secrets.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least first-level spellcasting to properly utilize the notebook's esoteric knowledge.
kivotos_item_student_notebook_of_secrets.vendorReason: The student store regularly receives donations of magical artifacts, including this curious notebook from various students and scholars.
kivotos_item_student_notebook_of_secrets.shippingDetail: Ships via the Couriers of the Elemental Gryphon, known for their swift and reliable deliveries across the realm.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires a minute to study one page.
usage.duration: Instantaneous once per day; combat round advantage once per short rest.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use; rechargeable at dawn the next day.

kivotos_item_student_notebook_of_secrets.priceReason: The Codex's rare and potent effects justify its high price, making it a valuable asset for scholars and spellcasters alike.

warhammer_emberbomb.name: Emberbomb of Despair
warhammer_emberbomb.description: The Emberbomb of Despair is a volatile concoction forged from despair and fiery magic. When tossed, it ignites into a searing inferno that engulfs foes in a wave of anguish and flame. The chaotic force within ensures each explosion leaves its mark, sapping the willpower of those caught in its fiery embrace. Wario's secret recipe, this weapon is not just for combat but also to add an extra zing to one’s chili, as he claims.

effectDetails.title: Explosive Flame
effectDetails.rules: When the Emberbomb detonates within a 10-foot radius, it deals 2d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area. On a successful hit, there's a 30% chance that a target is stunned for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Sapping Willpower
effectDetails.rules: For each creature struck by the explosion, they must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be inflicted with the Weakness condition until the end of their next turn. This effect can only occur once per target.

warhammer_emberbomb.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a certain level to handle its volatile nature and ensure it's used responsibly in combat.
warhammer_emberbomb.vendorReason: The chaos dealer specializes in unpredictable and powerful items, making the Emberbomb of Despair an ideal addition to their inventory.
warhammer_emberbomb.shippingDetail: Ships via Winged Courier; delivery may take up to three days due to its volatile nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect
usage.endsWhen: Expended upon use
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharged after a long rest

warhammer_emberbomb.priceReason: The Emberbomb of Despair is priced high due to its volatile nature and the limited supply available from Wario's chaotic alchemy.

grand_country_faction_charm.name: The Stone Shepherd’s Blessing
grand_country_faction_charm.description: The Stone Shepherd’s Blessing is a finely crafted charm, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer faintly in moonlight. The figure of the stoic shepherd stands resolute amidst his flock of oddly shaped rocks, each one a testament to nature's resilience. Wearing this charm grants you the favor of the Stone Shepherds, who protect precarious places and master the art of stonework. When you are near unstable ground or structures, there is a 20% chance that a tremor will not affect you. Additionally, you can call upon the Shepherds to stabilize a structure within reach for 1 minute, providing a +2 bonus to saving throws made due to instability.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Avoid Falling
effectDetails.rules: When you are near unstable ground or structures, there is a 20% chance that a tremor will not affect you. This effect has no save DC and does not expend any charges.

effectDetails.title: Stabilize Structure
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can call upon the Stone Shepherds to stabilize a structure within reach for 1 minute. The structure gains a +2 bonus to saving throws made due to instability. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

grand_country_faction_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is crafted with simple materials but imbued with the ancient knowledge of the Stone Shepherds, suitable for even novice adventurers.
grand_country_faction_charm.vendorReason: The side seller frequently trades in local artifacts and trinkets, including those with ties to nature and its guardians.
grand_country_faction_charm.shippingDetail: Ships via Winged Courier within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Reaction (for Chance to Avoid Falling), Action (for Stabilize Structure)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Chance to Avoid Falling, 1 minute for Stabilize Structure
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the structure stabilizes or the tremor passes.

grand_country_faction_charm.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this charm provides versatile benefits that are both thematic and mechanically sound for a common item.

equestria_item_glittering_hoof_boots.name: Glittering Hoof Boots
equestria_item_glittering_hoof_boots.description: The Glittering Hoof Boots shimmer with a radiant glow as they capture starlight in their delicate, crafted leather. Each step you take leaves a trail of sparkling dust behind, drawing curious glances from everypony and making your path a dazzling spectacle. These boots are surprisingly comfortable despite their glitter, perfect for those who enjoy both elegance and mischief. Crafted by the renowned Canterlot Shoemakers, these boots are a testament to Equestria's finest craftsmanship.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Glittering Hoof Boots, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and your walking speed increases by 10 feet. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until you rest.

effectDetails.title: Minor Glitter Aura
effectDetails.rules: You emit a faint, sparkling aura that dazzles nearby creatures within 30 feet. On a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check, creatures in this area must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute by you.

equestria_item_glittering_hoof_boots.levelRequirementReason: The boots require at least level 2 to ensure their magical effects are manageable and do not overwhelm lower-level ponies.
equestria_item_glittering_hoof_boots.vendorReason: Canterlot Shoemakers are renowned for their exquisite craftsmanship, making them the perfect vendor for these shimmering footwear.
equestria_item_glittering_hoof_boots.shippingDetail: The Royal Mail Pegasus ensures swift and secure delivery of your new boots, delivered directly to Manehattan.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the boots.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until you rest
usage.endsWhen: You rest or remove the boots.

equestria_item_glittering_hoof_boots.priceReason: The boots are priced at 1000 XP to reflect their exquisite craftsmanship and magical properties.

equestria_item_shadow_mane_scroll.name: Shadow Mane Scroll of Whispers
equestria_item_shadow_mane_scroll.description: The Shadow Mane Scroll of Whispers is a dark, vellum scroll that seems to absorb ambient light, its edges glowing faintly like the last embers of twilight. Unraveling it releases cryptic warnings and unsettling visions, perfect for the discerning investigator or the thrill-seeker who enjoys a good scare. The scroll's whispers are not mere illusions but can reveal hidden secrets when used in the right conditions, though they may also cause fear in those who hear them too closely.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Secrets
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. When used within a room or area of concealment, the scroll reveals hidden secrets with a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check. On a success, you learn one secret about the immediate environment. The scroll can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Cause Fear
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action within sight of a creature. The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute, during which time it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. This effect can be used once per long rest.

equestria_item_shadow_mane_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The scroll's cryptic nature requires a basic understanding of investigation to unlock its secrets.
equestria_item_shadow_mane_scroll.vendorReason: As a popular market, Ponyville Market attracts curious and resourceful adventurers who might find the scroll intriguing.
equestria_item_shadow_mane_scroll.shippingDetail: Delivered with a special delivery note that ensures secrecy during transit.

usage.activation: Used as an action or bonus action within sight of a target for the fear effect, or used to reveal hidden secrets in a concealed area.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for revealing secrets; 1 minute for causing fear.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the creature makes a successful saving throw or after its duration expires.
usage.charges: Recharges on completion of a long rest.

equestria_item_shadow_mane_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's rarity and unique effects, including its ability to reveal hidden secrets with a cryptic mechanism, justify its higher price.

equestria_item_nightmare_shard.name: Nightmare Shard of Discord
equestria_item_nightmare_shard.description: The Nightmare Shard of Discord is a jagged, glowing fragment of malevolent energy. Its surface crackles with dark tendrils that writhe like living shadows. Touching it induces unsettling visions and a creeping sense of dread; even the bravest dare not linger too long under its gaze. Wario himself warns of its power, suggesting it should be used only in grave circumstances—lest one's mind be forever corrupted by the dark dreams it wields.

effectDetails.title: Induces Unsettling Visions
effectDetails.rules: When a creature touches or stares into the shard for more than one round, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the fear condition until the end of its next turn. The shard can only induce visions in creatures with an Intelligence score above 10.

effectDetails.title: Causes Temporary Confusion
effectDetails.rules: Upon successful activation, the shard grants a target within range a penalty to all ability checks and attack rolls equal to 2 + the user's proficiency bonus for the next minute. The effect ends early if the target is hit by an attack.

equestria_item_nightmare_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Nightmare Shard of Discord requires a high level to wield effectively, as its power can overwhelm even the most experienced adventurers without caution.
equestria_item_nightmare_shard.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire's forbidden artifact dealers are well-versed in the dark arts and understand the risks and rewards of handling such powerful relics.
equestria_item_nightmare_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered under cover of night, ensuring that only those with a true need for such malevolent power receive it.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of the target's next turn or until dispelled by magic.
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against the fear condition, is hit by an attack, or a creature with a Wisdom saving throw DC higher than 15 casts a dispel magic spell on it.

equestria_item_nightmare_shard.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the potential danger it poses, balancing the need for such power against the risks of misusing it.

teyvat_item_emberglow_amulet.name: Emberglow Amulet
teyvat_item_emberglow_amulet.description: The Emberglow Amulet pulses with a warm, golden light, its surface etched with faint runes that hum with residual fire energy. A fragment of Diluc's unwavering resolve, it grants you minor resistance to heat and an ethereal glow when activated – perfect for brightening up gloomy dungeons or surprising enemies in the dark. This trinket is a reminder of courage and warmth, a symbol of hope in even the coldest of places.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to fire damage equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier when wearing this amulet.

effectDetails.title: Glowing Light
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the amulet emits a soft golden glow that illuminates a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Creatures within the light must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become blinded until the start of your next turn.

teyvat_item_emberglow_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet is crafted from materials that reflect Diluc's unwavering resolve, making it suitable for those who have already demonstrated their mettle in battle.
teyvat_item_emberglow_amulet.vendorReason: The market of Mondstadt is known for its diverse array of artifacts and trinkets, including this piece of history from the city's most respected figure.
teyvat_item_emberglow_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by a winged familiar, ensuring swift delivery to eager adventurers.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts for 1 minute when activated
usage.endsWhen: The glow ends at the start of your next turn if you are within the light's radius.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

teyvat_item_emberglow_amulet.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and imbued with powerful magic, this amulet is priced to reflect its craftsmanship and the legendary figure it honors.

teyvat_item_driftwood_charm.name: Driftwood Charm of the Tempest
teyvat_item_driftwood_charm.description: The Driftwood Charm of the Tempest is a relic carved from the very timbers of Kazuha's legendary raft, which weathered countless tempests. This charm whispers of lost voyages and the strength found in nature’s fury. When worn, it grants you unmatched balance and grace, enhancing your agility and making you a master of the sea. Legends say that those who carry this charm can navigate treacherous waters with ease, as if guided by the very winds themselves.

effectDetails.title: Balance of the Tempest
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate this charm to gain advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks for up to 1 minute. This effect ends if you are knocked unconscious or if you willingly deactivate it.

effectDetails.title: Navigation Master
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this charm, you have a +2 bonus to all Navigation skill checks and can use the Move Silently action as a bonus action. This effect persists until you finish a long rest.

teyvat_item_driftwood_charm.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from Kazuha's personal raft, this charm requires no special level to activate its effects.
teyvat_item_driftwood_charm.vendorReason: As the harbor where Kazuha found solace and began his adventures, Liyue Harbor stocks items imbued with the spirit of the sea.
teyvat_item_driftwood_charm.shippingDetail: The charm is shipped via the fastest currents, ensuring it arrives at your doorstep as swiftly as a tempest's fury.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute or until you finish a long rest
usage.endsWhen: You are knocked unconscious or willingly deactivate it

teyvat_item_driftwood_charm.priceReason: Crafted from rare and precious driftwood, the charm's value is reflected in its cost.

teyvat_item_void_shard.name: Void Shard of Khaenra
teyvat_item_void_shard.description: The Void Shard of Khaenra is a crystalline fragment, dark as midnight and laced with the void's icy essence. Crafted from Raiden Shogun’s discarded fragments during his battle against the void, it grants temporary defense but may leave you feeling detached after prolonged use. The shard hums with energy that can reflect attacks back at their source, though this comes at a cost of increased vulnerability to confusion.

effectDetails.title: Void Reflection
effectDetails.rules: When an attack is made against you while wearing the shard, there is a 25% chance that the damage is reflected back at the attacker. This effect has no cooldown and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Defense
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +3 bonus to AC for 1 hour after donning the shard, but suffers a -2 penalty to Charisma-based checks and saving throws. This effect is passive and persists until removed.

teyvat_item_void_shard.levelRequirementReason: Due to its raw void essence and complex enchantment, only characters of at least level 7 can safely wield the shard.
teyvat_item_void_shard.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports deals exclusively in artifacts from Teyvat and this shard's origins are linked through Raiden Shogun’s battles.
teyvat_item_void_shard.shippingDetail: The Phantom Ship ensures the safe delivery of such fragile relics, with a slight delay due to its mysterious routes.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning; ends when removed or at the start of your next turn after prolonged exposure (30 minutes).
usage.duration: 1 hour (active), until removed or end of next turn post-prolonged use.
usage.endsWhen: Removal, end of next turn after 30 minutes of prolonged wear.

teyvat_item_void_shard.priceReason: Reflecting attacks and increasing defense come at a steep price, but the shard’s rare origin and volatile nature justify its cost.

middle_earth_warrios_lucky_charm.name: Wario's Secret Stash Pouch
middle_earth_warrios_lucky_charm.description: Wario's Secret Stash Pouch is a diminutive leather pouch with a stiff, almost reptilian texture. Crafted from the hide of an ancient badger, it whispers tales of Wario's chaotic antics and his knack for finding fortune. The pouch not only increases your chance of finding valuable items by 20%, but also grants you a passive +1 to Dexterity saving throws, making you more resilient against traps and ambushes.

effectDetails.title: Lucky Find
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each combat round, there's a 5% chance that any item you find is also valuable. This effect has no save DC and can occur multiple times per day.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Luck
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws against traps or ambushes, as if under the effects of a 'Shield of Faith' spell (no save DC required). This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after using it.

middle_earth_warrios_lucky_charm.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for lower-level adventurers who could benefit from its luck and resilience without requiring high proficiency or power.
middle_earth_warrios_lucky_charm.vendorReason: The Dwarven Forge has a reputation for crafting items imbued with elemental spirits, and this pouch channels the chaotic energy of Wario's badger hide.
middle_earth_warrios_lucky_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant rat, which may add an additional 1d4 days to your delivery time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; reverts at the start of each round.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of the next turn after using it for Stealthy Luck; expires at the end of combat for Lucky Find.

middle_earth_warrios_lucky_charm.priceReason: The balanced price reflects a high-risk, high-reward item that offers significant benefits in combat and exploration without being overpowered.

pokemon_item_trainer_potion.name: Hyper-Recovery Elixir
pokemon_item_trainer_potion.description: The Hyper-Recovery Elixir is a vibrant, bubbling potion crafted by eccentric Pokémon trainers using rare herbs and ancient alchemy techniques. This elixir instantly heals 100 HP and restores 50 stamina, giving you the edge in those long, grueling battles. The concoction is said to be brewed with a secret ingredient, rumored to be the essence of legendary Pokémon. Wario’s convinced it's just concentrated berries but wishes he could unlock its full potential.

effectDetails.title: Instant Healing and Stamina Restoration
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Hyper-Recovery Elixir instantly heals 100 Hit Points (HP) and restores 50 stamina points. This effect is instantaneous and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Defense Buff
effectDetails.rules: For the next hour after drinking this elixir, you gain a +2 bonus to AC against all attacks made by creatures of your choice. This bonus ends if you take damage or if you use another potion that grants similar benefits.

pokemon_item_trainer_potion.levelRequirementReason: The potion is designed for novice trainers who may need quick healing and stamina during their early adventures.
pokemon_item_trainer_potion.vendorReason: Pokemarts are known for offering essential supplies to all trainers, regardless of experience level.
pokemon_item_trainer_potion.shippingDetail: The elixir is carefully packed and delivered by Pidgeotto Courier within a day.

usage.duration: Until you take damage or use another potion with similar effects, up to one hour after consumption
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or use another potion that grants a similar defense buff, or at the end of your next long rest.

pokemon_item_trainer_potion.priceReason: The potion is priced high due to its rare ingredients and complex alchemical process required for brewing.

teyvat_item_crimson_resonance.name: Crimson Resonance Shard
teyvat_item_crimson_resonance.description: The Crimson Resonance Shard glows with an intense pyroelectric pulse, its surface crackling with raw fire energy. This shard is said to amplify the caster's pyro spells, enhancing their potency and ensuring a controlled yet formidable display of destructive power. Wario insists it’s perfect for incinerating foes or creating dazzling pyrotechnics, but wielders must be cautious—overuse risks unpredictable bursts of heat that can ignite nearby flammable objects.

effectDetails.title: Pyro Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Increases the caster's fire damage by 20% until the start of their next turn. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be maintained up to three times per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Heat Wave
effectDetails.rules: At the end of each of your turns while this shard is active, you may choose to trigger a Heat Wave that deals 2d6 fire damage to all creatures within 10 feet. This effect can be triggered once per long rest.

teyvat_item_crimson_resonance.levelRequirementReason: This shard requires significant control over fire magic, suitable for characters at least 8th level.
teyvat_item_crimson_resonance.vendorReason: As a renowned market, Mondstadt often showcases rare and powerful items like the Crimson Resonance Shard.
teyvat_item_crimson_resonance.shippingDetail: The shard is delivered by a winged familiar, ensuring safe and swift transport to its buyer.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation occurs at the start of your turn while holding the shard.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use, up to three times per long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish a short or long rest, or if you are incapacitated.

teyvat_item_crimson_resonance.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the shard's potent abilities and rarity.

teyvat_item_kokiri_charm.name: Kokiri Charm of Silent Steps
teyvat_item_kokiri_charm.description: The Kokiri Charm of Silent Steps is a delicate silver amulet adorned with tiny Kokiri symbols. Crafted by the mischievous spirits of the forest, this charm allows its wearer to move silently and avoid detection in the shadows. Wario says it’s 'perfect for slipping past guards without a sound or pocketing that rare treasure.' The charm muffles footsteps completely and grants an eerie stillness around the wearer, making them nearly invisible to the untrained eye.

effectDetails.title: Silent Steps
effectDetails.rules: The charm muffles all footsteps, creating no sound. This effect lasts until you take a move action or until the end of your turn if you engage in combat.

effectDetails.title: Unseen
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to avoid detection while wearing this charm. The effect persists for 1 hour, after which it expires and requires a short rest to recharge.

teyvat_item_kokiri_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm is crafted simply enough that even low-level adventurers can benefit from its effects.
teyvat_item_kokiri_charm.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor caters to travelers and sells a wide range of items, including those with practical utility like this stealth charm.
teyvat_item_kokiri_charm.shippingDetail: The charm is delivered swiftly by Liyue's reliable delivery drones within the week.

usage.duration: Lasts until you take a move action or engage in combat, then ends immediately.
usage.endsWhen: Combat or taking a move action, or after one hour of non-combat use.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharging at the start of each short rest.

teyvat_item_kokiri_charm.priceReason: The charm's unique crafting and enchantment justify its higher price, but it remains accessible to most adventurers.

teyvat_item_archon_sanctum_scroll.name: Archon Sanctum Scroll of Divine Guidance
teyvat_item_archon_sanctum_scroll.description: The Archon Sanctum Scroll of Divine Guidance hums with the essence of a Geo Archon, its ancient parchment glowing faintly under the light of dawn. This relic grants fleeting but potent combat insights: it increases Wisdom by +10 for 60 seconds and offers tactical advantages that can turn even the most dire battle into an opportunity to shine. Wario insists it's 'the key to victory,' though only if you know how to wield its power wisely.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, increasing the user's Wisdom score by +10 for 60 seconds. This effect ends if the user takes damage or if an ability check is made using Wisdom.

effectDetails.title: Tactical Insight
effectDetails.rules: Provides a temporary tactical advantage once per short rest, such as increased evasion or critical hit chance by 5%. The scroll can only be used again after a long rest.

teyvat_item_archon_sanctum_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The scroll is crafted with basic magic and does not require a high level of expertise to activate.
teyvat_item_archon_sanctum_scroll.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare and exotic magical artifacts, making this scroll an ideal addition to their inventory.
teyvat_item_archon_sanctum_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional portal, arriving within moments of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (for Tactical Insight)
usage.duration: 60 seconds for Wisdom Boost; instant for Tactical Insight
usage.endsWhen: On damage taken or ability checks made with Wisdom; ends at the end of the user's next turn after using Tactical Insight
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short rest

teyvat_item_archon_sanctum_scroll.priceReason: The scroll is moderately priced for its mythic rarity and practical utility in combat.

earth_land_geode_of_whispers.name: Geode of Whispers
earth_land_geode_of_whispers.description: The Geode of Whispers, a pulsating crystal embedded within a rough-hewn stone, hums faintly when held close. Its whispers are said to come from long-dead wizards who sought its power in vain. The geode's murmurs range from cryptic advice on spellcraft to complaints about the weather, though some say it harbors secrets of ancient battles and lost treasures. This enigmatic artifact is a rare find, often shipped by flying griffins and sold exclusively at Magic Shop.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Wisdom
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can hold the geode close to your ear to hear a cryptic whisper. This whisper provides you with one piece of advice related to magic or survival, chosen randomly from a set of ancient, enigmatic phrases. The geode has 3 uses per long rest and is exhausted after use.

effectDetails.title: Weather Whim
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your next short rest, the geode provides you with +1 to Perception checks made to notice environmental changes or unusual weather patterns. This effect does not stack with other similar abilities.

earth_land_geode_of_whispers.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate the enigmatic power of the geode without needing advanced magic.
earth_land_geode_of_whispers.vendorReason: Magic Shop is known for its rare and ancient artifacts, including this enigmatic geode.
earth_land_geode_of_whispers.shippingDetail: The flying griffin delivers the geode swiftly, often with a small delay due to its busy schedule.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Whispers of Wisdom; short rest duration for Weather Whim
usage.endsWhen: After use or at the end of a long rest when exhausted

earth_land_geode_of_whispers.priceReason: The geode's rarity and the unpredictable nature of its effects justify this price in XP.

earth_land_wario_slime_potion.name: Wario's Slime Potion
earth_land_wario_slime_potion.description: Wario's Slime Potion is a bright green, foul-smelling concoction that transforms you into a slimy, slightly grumpy version of the infamous plumber. For three turns, you can roll around like a living ball of goo, increasing your movement speed by 50% while in this form. Enemies nearby have a chance to slip and fall, reducing their Dexterity-based ability checks by 2 until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Slime Form
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Lasts for 3 turns. While in this form, your movement speed increases by 50%. Ends if you are knocked prone or the effect is dispelled.

effectDetails.title: Slick Enemies
effectDetails.rules: While in slime form, there's a 20% chance that any creature within 5 feet of you when you activate this potion will fall prone and have their Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or saving throw reduced by 2 until the end of their next turn. Ends if you leave your space.

earth_land_wario_slime_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for beginners to have a bit of fun in combat without being too overpowered.
earth_land_wario_slime_potion.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium stocks this item because it's a popular choice among those who enjoy a little mischief and unpredictability on the battlefield.
earth_land_wario_slime_potion.shippingDetail: The delivery goblin might accidentally spill or drop the potion during transport, so it is recommended to check its condition upon arrival.

usage.duration: 3 turns
usage.endsWhen: Knocked prone or dispelled by magic

earth_land_wario_slime_potion.priceReason: The price reflects the potion's fun, unpredictable nature and its popularity among players.

animatopia_mossy_charm.name: Mossy Charm of Tranquility
animatopia_mossy_charm.description: The Mossy Charm of Tranquility is crafted from the heartwood of a giant moss-covered boulder, said to have been blessed by ancient druids seeking peace in troubled times. This humble charm offers more than mere comfort; it soothes frayed nerves and tempers anger, making it invaluable for weary warriors and frustrated heroes alike. When clutched tightly, its verdant surface pulses with a calming energy that washes away the strain of combat.

effectDetails.title: Soothing Comfort
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this charm grants the user temporary resistance to fear effects and provides a +1 bonus to saving throws against such conditions. The effect lasts for 1 hour or until expended.

effectDetails.title: Anger Suppression
effectDetails.rules: Upon use, this charm reduces your current anger level by 2 points, capping at a minimum of 0. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action to activate.

animatopia_mossy_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm's gentle power is accessible to all adventurers, regardless of experience.
animatopia_mossy_charm.vendorReason: The forest market thrives on the natural resources and artifacts from the surrounding wilderness, making this charm a staple in their inventory.
animatopia_mossy_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant snail that carefully navigates through dense underbrush, ensuring the charm arrives intact and fresh.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until expended
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when it is used up or you are no longer in danger of fear effects.

animatopia_mossy_charm.priceReason: Crafted from a rare and ancient moss, the charm's value lies not only in its magical properties but also in its unique origin.

pokemon_item_trainer_badge_replica.name: Elite Four’s Disgrace
pokemon_item_trainer_badge_replica.description: The Elite Four’s Disgrace gleams faintly despite its tarnished appearance, a testament to its once-mighty origins. This meticulously crafted replica is not just a prop; it's a symbol of prestige that can elevate your presence in any room. For the briefest moment, you feel as though you've truly earned this emblem of victory, and your Charisma soars by +1 (temporarily), making others more likely to defer to your judgment.
effects: chance to intimidate a wild Pokémon

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: When worn, this badge grants the wearer a +1 bonus to Charisma checks and saving throws for a duration of 1 hour. The effect is limited to once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Intimidate Chance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this badge, you have advantage on Intimidation checks against wild Pokémon. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

pokemon_item_trainer_badge_replica.levelRequirementReason: This replica is accessible to players who are just starting their journey and need a confidence boost.
pokemon_item_trainer_badge_replica.vendorReason: The league store stocks this item as it appeals to trainers seeking a sense of achievement, even if only in appearance.
pokemon_item_trainer_badge_replica.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with Magikarp Delivery's standard courier service.

usage.activation: Equipping the badge passively activates its effects.
usage.duration: The Charisma boost lasts for 1 hour, and the Intimidate chance lasts until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire at the end of a short or long rest.

pokemon_item_trainer_badge_replica.priceReason: The price reflects its uncommon rarity and the prestige it offers, despite being a replica.

almost_edge_whispering_shard.name: Echoes of the Voidstone
almost_edge_whispering_shard.description: The Echoes of the Voidstone is a jagged, iridescent shard that hums with an otherworldly resonance, its surface etched in patterns that seem to shift and warp as you gaze upon them. Holding it opens your mind to fleeting visions of void geometries, where time and space dissolve into pure potentiality. These glimpses are both awe-inspiring and terrifying, as they threaten to unravel the very fabric of reality within your psyche.

effectDetails.title: Grant Sanity Loss (1/Day)
effectDetails.rules: When you hold the Echoes, there is a 20% chance each day that your next action causes you to lose 1d4 points of Charisma. This effect has no save and can be resisted only by succeeding on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Chance for Hallucinations
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Echoes, there is a 10% chance each round that you see an illusory version of your next attack or spell effect as it strikes. This hallucination does not deal damage but can mislead your allies and foes alike.

almost_edge_whispering_shard.levelRequirementReason: The Echoes demand a high level to wield, as their power is too great for the uninitiated.
almost_edge_whispering_shard.vendorReason: The Void Merchant specializes in items that bridge the gap between worlds, making it fitting for this artifact from beyond.
almost_edge_whispering_shard.shippingDetail: Ships through a rift in space-time; delivery can take several days but ensures the item arrives intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until discarded or lost
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon use

almost_edge_whispering_shard.priceReason: The Echoes of the Voidstone is priced at 1000 XP due to its mythic rarity and the risk it poses to sanity.

almost_edge_temporal_charm.name: The Chronal Slipstone
almost_edge_temporal_charm.description: The Chronal Slipstone is a disconcerting charm crafted from solidified temporal eddies, forged in the heart of a forgotten forge that once danced to the tune of time itself. This relic allows its wielder to briefly rewind their own actions, but beware – each use carves a ripple through the fabric of reality, increasing the risk of a catastrophic temporal paradox. The charm's power is as fickle as it is potent; misuse could unravel the very timeline.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Action
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may rewind your last turn. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down). You are not allowed to use this ability again until you complete a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Risk
effectDetails.rules: Each use increases the likelihood of a temporal paradox by 10%, starting at 5% for the first use. If the cumulative risk reaches or exceeds 50%, a minor temporal disruption occurs, forcing you to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you are stunned until the end of your next turn.

almost_edge_temporal_charm.levelRequirementReason: The Chronal Slipstone demands a mastery of time manipulation that is only accessible to those who have reached an advanced level in their studies.
almost_edge_temporal_charm.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader has a unique access to ancient and otherworldly artifacts, making the Chronal Slipstone a fitting addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_temporal_charm.shippingDetail: The Chronal Slipstone is delivered via quantum packet, ensuring its arrival through a direct temporal conduit, which can sometimes lead to unexpected delays due to the instability of time itself.

usage.duration: Number of rounds equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down)
usage.endsWhen: You use it again or complete a long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by rest requirements

almost_edge_temporal_charm.priceReason: The Chronal Slipstone's balanced price reflects its rarity and the risk it poses to those who wield it.

almost_edge_void_pouch.name: The Collector's Burden
almost_edge_void_pouch.description: The Collector's Burden is an unassuming pouch, its surface etched with faint, forgotten sigils of void and time. It seems to absorb stray echoes and anomalies from the void, causing those who bear it for too long to feel a gnawing obsession with collecting the unsettling remnants of lost realities. Rumor has it that once bound by this burden, one's mind slowly distorts into an ever-hungry collector of the forgotten and the broken.

effectDetails.title: Void Absorption
effectDetails.rules: The Collector's Burden can absorb negative energy from nearby creatures or environments. It has a range of 10 feet and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Obsession Risk
effectDetails.rules: After each day that the pouch is worn, there's an increasing risk (starting at 5%) that the bearer becomes obsessed with collecting strange and unsettling items. This obsession increases by 5% daily until it reaches 100%, at which point the character must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become permanently obsessed.

almost_edge_void_pouch.levelRequirementReason: The Collector's Burden requires a minimum level of 6 due to its arcane and dangerous nature.
almost_edge_void_pouch.vendorReason: The edge-wanderers are known for their extensive trade networks, connecting the farthest corners of the realm. They specialize in rare and exotic items like The Collector's Burden.
almost_edge_void_pouch.shippingDetail: Careful handling is required to avoid damaging this delicate artifact during transport.

usage.activation: A bonus action is needed to activate the absorption of negative energy from a creature or environment within range.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, but can only be used once per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the pouch is removed and a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw is made.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it recharges after a long rest.

almost_edge_void_pouch.priceReason: The Collector's Burden strikes a balance between its rare components and the risks involved in using it, making it cost 1000 XP.

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_potion.name: Wario’s Lucky Potion (Experimental)
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_potion.description: Wario’s Lucky Potion (Experimental) is a vile-looking vial of murky brown liquid, labeled with a wobbly W. This potion grants fleeting good fortune to those who dare drink it. For a brief moment, you may land critical hits more often and dash through foes as if on wings, but beware—your luck comes at a cost: uncontrollable laughter or an overwhelming urge to collect every shiny object in sight.

effectDetails.title: Increased Crit Chance
effectDetails.rules: When you make an attack roll, there is a +2d6 modifier to your roll for the next turn. This effect ends if you take damage or lose consciousness.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Dodging Aura
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and can teleport up to 5 feet as a reaction when an attack hits you. This ability can be used once per short rest.

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_potion.levelRequirementReason: The potion's effects are unpredictable but not overly powerful for the beginner adventurer.
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_potion.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market sells a variety of experimental and exotic items, making Wario’s Lucky Potion a natural fit.
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_potion.shippingDetail: The potion is shipped in a specially enchanted flask to preserve its potency during transit.

usage.activation: Drink the potion as an action.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use, until you take damage or lose consciousness.
usage.endsWhen: You take damage, lose consciousness, or complete a short rest.

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_potion.priceReason: The potion's rarity and experimental nature justify its higher price.

grand_country_gravitron_shard.name: Gravity's Grin Shard
grand_country_gravitron_shard.description: This pulsing shard of Gravity's Grin hums with a chaotic energy that seems to bend space and time itself. It grants swift movement, but prolonged exposure can leave you disoriented, as if the fabric of reality shifts around you. The shard’s origin remains shrouded in mystery, found only at the edge of known lands where gravity defies explanation. Wario might indeed find this item charming for its unpredictable effects and unique power.

effectDetails.title: Movement Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the user gains a +10 foot movement speed bonus on their next turn. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the wearer moves more than 60 feet.

effectDetails.title: Dizzying Sensation
effectDetails.rules: For every 5 minutes the shard is worn, the user must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become disoriented. Disorientation lasts for 1 hour and reduces the wearer's movement speed by half.

grand_country_gravitron_shard.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high level of discipline to wield effectively without causing harm.
grand_country_gravitron_shard.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor deals in rare and unique curiosities, making Gravity's Grin Shard an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_gravitron_shard.shippingDetail: The winged beetle delivers the shard with a special package that includes instructions on proper handling.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until moved more than 60 feet
usage.endsWhen: Disorientation ends after 1 hour of failure, or when removed from the wearer's possession.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges upon removal and resting for 8 hours.

grand_country_gravitron_shard.priceReason: The item’s rarity and unique effects justify its moderate price point.

grand_country_layer_spice_bomb.name: Layered Nightmare Bomb
grand_country_layer_spice_bomb.description: Layered Nightmare Bomb, a glass sphere encrusted with shards of iridescent gemstones and a twist of shadowy echo, is both fragile and potent. When detonated, it releases a wave that distorts reality within a 30-foot radius, causing creatures to stagger between planes of existence for the duration of the effect. Not only does this create an area where the laws of physics bend dangerously, but it also has a 20% chance of trapping any enemy in a pocket dimension until the spell ends or they are freed by a dispel magic.

effectDetails.title: Creates Layering Zone (30-foot Radius)
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Layered Nightmare Bomb releases a localized distortion that lasts for 1 round. All creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and unable to move for the duration of the effect.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Trap Enemies (20%)
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance that any enemy within the layering zone will be trapped in a pocket dimension. The trap lasts until the end of your next turn or until dispelled by a dispel magic spell.

grand_country_layer_spice_bomb.levelRequirementReason: This bomb requires minimal preparation and is suitable for beginning adventurers who are ready to tackle more complex challenges.
grand_country_layer_spice_bomb.vendorReason: Layer Market specializes in unique and powerful alchemical creations, making the Layered Nightmare Bomb a fitting addition to their inventory.
grand_country_layer_spice_bomb.shippingDetail: The shipping is conducted by rolling barrel, which ensures safe transport even over rough terrain.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: Spell ends when its duration expires or a dispel magic spell is cast on it.

grand_country_layer_spice_bomb.priceReason: The Layered Nightmare Bomb's rarity and the unique effects make it worth 1,000 XP.

almost_edge_liminal_contract.name: Liminal Contract
almost_edge_liminal_contract.description: The Liminal Contract is a shimmering, ever-shifting parchment that warps and undulates in your hands like living ink. Its edges glow faintly as if touched by unseen forces, hinting at its otherworldly origins. This arcane artifact grants you a single, unsettling service, but beware: the price is not always in gold; it could be something far more personal and strange. Be warned, for the contract's power comes with a steep cost.
effects: Gain a random minor magical ability (50% chance)

effectDetails.title: Minor Magical Ability
effectDetails.rules: You gain a random minor magical ability that lasts until the end of your next long rest. This effect has a 50% success rate upon activation and cannot be used more than once per day.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Fear Effects
effectDetails.rules: You become immune to all fear effects for one hour after using the contract. This immunity persists until it is triggered or you use another ability that negates this effect.

almost_edge_liminal_contract.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high level of magical knowledge and resilience, as its power comes with significant risks.
almost_edge_liminal_contract.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader is known for dealing in rare and exotic artifacts, including those that offer both benefits and drawbacks.
almost_edge_liminal_contract.shippingDetail: Delivery via Ethereal Messenger may take several days, as the contract requires careful handling to preserve its integrity during transport.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with a one-hour duration for immunity
usage.endsWhen: The minor magical ability ends at the end of your next long rest or when you use another similar ability, and the immunity to fear effects ends after one hour.

almost_edge_liminal_contract.priceReason: This price reflects a balance between the item's rarity, its powerful yet risky abilities, and the effort required for its creation.

teyvat_item_stormcloud_amulet.name: Stormcloud Amulet
teyvat_item_stormcloud_amulet.description: The Stormcloud Amulet radiates an eerie, swirling grey mist that crackles with latent lightning. Crafted from the remnants of a storm-torn shipwreck, this amulet grants you resilience against the elements' wrath and the power to summon a fleeting rain cloud. When summoned, the cloud not only extinguishes small fires but also saps the energy of nearby enemies, slowing their movements by 50%. A true heirloom from Mondstadt's storied past, it is said that its wearer can command the very heavens themselves.

effectDetails.title: Lightning Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to lightning damage. This effect provides a +30% bonus to your AC when you are struck by lightning-based attacks.

effectDetails.title: Miniature Rain Cloud
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can summon a miniature rain cloud. The cloud extinguishes all fires within 10 feet of the target and saps enemy movement speed by 50% for 2 turns. This effect has a 5% chance to occur when you are struck by lightning.

teyvat_item_stormcloud_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's mystical power requires a strong connection with the elements, which typically comes from those who have reached at least level 8.
teyvat_item_stormcloud_amulet.vendorReason: Mona, the master of lightning and patron of the market, ensures that this relic is available to those in need of its powers.
teyvat_item_stormcloud_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet arrives via a swift messenger, ensuring it reaches you within three days from the time of purchase.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (once per short rest)
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until used up or dispelled by an enemy's attack
usage.endsWhen: Used when summoned and dismissed by the wearer, or interrupted by a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.
