effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that increases the chance of doubling your treasure finds by 30%. This effect does not stack with other bonuses to find treasure.

effectDetails.title: Increased Critical Hit Chance
effectDetails.rules: Increases critical hit chance by 15% for all attacks. This effect persists until the end of your next turn and can only be used once per short or long rest.

earth_land_godly_amulet_of_wario_luck.levelRequirementReason: This amulet requires a high level to wield effectively, as it taps into primal earth magic.
earth_land_godly_amulet_of_wario_luck.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in items crafted from the earth and holds artifacts blessed by elemental spirits.
earth_land_godly_amulet_of_wario_luck.shippingDetail: Ships within one week, with expedited delivery for an additional cost.

usage.duration: Persistent until end of next turn or until used again.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the wearer completes a long rest.

earth_land_godly_amulet_of_wario_luck.priceReason: This amulet's price reflects its godly rarity and the raw materials needed for such an item.

teyvat_item_izumi_amulet.name: Izumi Amulet of Temporal Distortion
teyvat_item_izumi_amulet.description: The Izumi Amulet of Temporal Distortion is a shimmering artifact forged from the essence of Izanami's tears. Its surface pulses with temporal energy, subtly warping time around its wearer. This amulet grants +5% damage reduction and a 10% chance to rewind your previous action in combat, allowing for a brief moment of second-guessing. The core of the amulet hums with ancient magic, whispering tales of Izanagi's battles long past.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Shield
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +5% damage reduction while wearing this amulet. This effect is passive and applies automatically.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Action
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer can use an action to rewind their previous action in combat for 1 round. They must re-roll initiative and take a new action on their next turn. If this causes them to act after the enemy's turn, they lose the benefit of the rewind.

teyvat_item_izumi_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet requires a level 6 character due to its complex temporal magic.
teyvat_item_izumi_amulet.vendorReason: Izumi Amulets are highly sought after by the elite, and Inazuma Imports is known for delivering rare artifacts from Teyvat.
teyvat_item_izumi_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is carefully delivered via a Sea Serpent courier, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Once per short rest to rewind the previous action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for the rewind effect; passive damage reduction applies continuously while worn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer takes a long rest or loses consciousness.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the effect can only be used once per short rest.

teyvat_item_izumi_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its rare and powerful temporal properties, suitable for a level 6 character.

teyvat_item_archon_favor.name: Archon Favor - A Taste of Justice
teyvat_item_archon_favor.description: A delicate, magically preserved sweet treat from Teyvat, rumored to be a favorite of the Seven Archons themselves. This confectionary is said to bring divine favor to those who partake, whispering secrets and unlocking hidden dialogue options with NPCs – perfect for when you need that extra touch of persuasion or divine intervention. A taste of justice in every bite, this treat is as sweet as it is potent, granting a temporary boost to Charisma and enhancing the chance of successful persuasion checks.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Eating this treat grants you advantage on Charisma checks for 3 turns. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: While consuming this treat, your chance of successfully making a persuasion check increases by +5%. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn after you finish eating it. This boost is cumulative with other similar effects.

teyvat_item_archon_favor.levelRequirementReason: This sweet treat is accessible to all adventurers, regardless of level, as its divine favor is available to everyone.
teyvat_item_archon_favor.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor is known for its connections with the Seven Archons and often stocks items from their domains.
teyvat_item_archon_favor.shippingDetail: Ships are frequently delayed by typhoons in Teyvat, so expect a few extra days for delivery.

usage.duration: 3 turns of Charisma boost and until the start of your next turn after finishing eating
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish consuming the treat or if you use an action to dismiss it early

teyvat_item_archon_favor.priceReason: This sweet treat is crafted with divine ingredients and carries a powerful enchantment, making its price worth every coin.

equestria_item_harmonious_scroll.name: Scroll of Unified Harmony
equestria_item_harmonious_scroll.description: The Scroll of Unified Harmony radiates a soft glow, its parchment woven from threads of friendship and harmony. When unrolled, it weaves a soothing aura that pacifies even the most irritable creatures, bolstering your party's morale and granting temporary resilience against fear. This ancient relic is said to have been crafted by the Alicorns themselves during Equestria’s golden age, making it a prized possession among those who value peace and unity.

effectDetails.title: Restore Morale
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action or reaction, this scroll grants each friendly creature within a 30-foot radius temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (plus your proficiency bonus if you have one). This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fear
effectDetails.rules: Each creature within the same area gains advantage on saving throws against being frightened. This effect also lasts for 1 minute, and each creature can benefit from it only once per long rest.

equestria_item_harmonious_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll requires at least second-level spellcasting ability to use effectively.
equestria_item_harmonious_scroll.vendorReason: The ponies of Ponyville are known for their expertise in ancient magic, making them the perfect vendor for such a sacred relic.
equestria_item_harmonious_scroll.shippingDetail: The scroll is delivered via the fastest and most reliable magical means available, ensuring it reaches its destination without delay.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: At the end of a long rest or if used again on the same creature within the duration period
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

equestria_item_harmonious_scroll.priceReason: The scroll’s rarity and historical significance justify its price, as it is not just an item but a piece of Equestria's lore.

equestria_item_elemental_amulet.name: Amulet of Equestrian Balance
equestria_item_elemental_amulet.description: The Amulet of Equestrian Balance is crafted from the shimmering quartz of the Crystal Empire, forged by artisans who have mastered the elements themselves. This amulet channels the raw magic of Equestria's elements, providing a steady stream of power and protection to its wearer. It grants a constant supply of mana regeneration and a chance to reflect incoming damage, ensuring that the wielder remains both powerful and resilient in battle.

effectDetails.title: Mana Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: The wearer regenerates 1d4 + Constitution modifier mana per long rest. This effect is passive, providing a continuous supply of mana.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Reflection
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance each time the wearer takes damage to reflect half of that damage back to the attacker. This effect has a maximum of three uses per day and resets after a long rest.

equestria_item_elemental_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of the amulet's magic requires a high degree of skill and magical prowess.
equestria_item_elemental_amulet.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire artisans are renowned for their mastery of elemental magic, making this amulet one of their finest creations.
equestria_item_elemental_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via the Royal Guard Carrier with a 2-day delivery time and an additional 10% insurance coverage.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasting until used or interrupted by other effects.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer ceases to wear the amulet or it is destroyed in battle.

equestria_item_elemental_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's unique balance of magical benefits and its rarity.

midlands_item_seraphina_scepter.name: The Scepter of Silent Command
midlands_item_seraphina_scepter.description: The Scepter of Silent Command, forged in the heart of a collapsing temple, exudes an aura of unsettling authority that can command lesser spirits and instill fear into the hearts of those nearby. Its wielder gains a +2 bonus to Charisma (Intimidation) checks and can attempt to stun creatures within 30 feet with a successful attack roll at a DC of 18. Rumors suggest it attracts unwanted attention from celestial beings, making it a dangerous yet coveted tool for those seeking dominance.

effectDetails.title: Command Lesser Spirits
effectDetails.rules: The wielder can use an action to issue commands to one willing lesser spirit within 60 feet. The spirit must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 18) or be unable to perform tasks other than those directly related to the command for up to 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Aura of Fear
effectDetails.rules: The scepter emits an aura that affects all creatures within 30 feet. These creatures must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 16) or become frightened until the start of their next turn unless they take some action other than moving out of the area.

midlands_item_seraphina_scepter.levelRequirementReason: The Scepter requires significant magical power to wield effectively, thus a level requirement is necessary.
midlands_item_seraphina_scepter.vendorReason: The Empire Exchange trades in artifacts with complex and dangerous magic, making the Scepter of Silent Command a fitting addition.
midlands_item_seraphina_scepter.shippingDetail: Ships via a celestial courier, ensuring safe delivery but subject to unpredictable delays due to divine whims.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for commanding spirits; 1 hour for the aura of fear
usage.endsWhen: The spirit becomes unwilling or the aura fades when a creature moves out of its range
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one command can be given per use

midlands_item_seraphina_scepter.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's unique and potentially dangerous abilities.

middle_earth_mushroom_of_forgetfulness.name: Mushroom of Forgetfulness
middle_earth_mushroom_of_forgetfulness.description: The Mushroom of Forgetfulness, a luminescent orb that glows faintly like the embers of a dying campfire, emits an aroma reminiscent of old books and forgotten dreams. Its consumption grants you three turns of confusion, allowing you to evade unwanted conversations or temporarily lose track of your surroundings. The mushroom's taste is surprisingly delightful, though it leaves a lingering unease in its wake. Be wary; there's a 10% chance that after consuming it, you might inadvertently forget the location of a crucial quest objective.

effectDetails.title: Forgets a Quest Objective
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that after consuming the mushroom, you may forget one specific quest objective. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Confusion
effectDetails.rules: You are stunned for three turns (action surge or reaction available to counter). During this time, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

middle_earth_mushroom_of_forgetfulness.levelRequirementReason: This mushroom is accessible to all adventurers as it can be found in various parts of Middle-earth.
middle_earth_mushroom_of_forgetfulness.vendorReason: The Shire Shop stocks this item because it's a popular choice for travelers who want to avoid awkward conversations or temporarily forget their worries.
middle_earth_mushroom_of_forgetfulness.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Pony Express, ensuring swift delivery to your doorstep within three days.

usage.duration: Three turns of confusion; ends when the effect is overcome or ends naturally
usage.endsWhen: The effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest, or it can be ended by an action or reaction to counteract.

middle_earth_mushroom_of_forgetfulness.priceReason: This price reflects its uncommon rarity and the unique risk it poses.

middle_earth_scroll_of_darkness.name: Scroll of Darkness
middle_earth_scroll_of_darkness.description: The Scroll of Darkness is a brittle, ink-stained parchment that shimmers with an unnatural chill when unrolled. The scroll's edges glow faintly with dark energies, whispering of ancient and forbidden lore. Unleashing its power requires no words, only the act of unfolding it; in an instant, it unleashes a wave of absolute darkness that engulfs all within its 15-foot radius, plunging the area into eternal night and terrorizing those caught unawares.

effectDetails.title: Darkness Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Scroll of Darkness creates a 15-foot radius sphere of darkness. All creatures within this area are blinded until they succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. The scroll can be used only once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Shadow
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance that the darkness will also blind a single target within the area for 1 minute, provided they fail their save. This effect cannot occur more than once per day.

middle_earth_scroll_of_darkness.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to control and channel such dark magic effectively.
middle_earth_scroll_of_darkness.vendorReason: The Elven Market often deals in forbidden knowledge, and this scroll is a relic of ancient elven sorcery.
middle_earth_scroll_of_darkness.shippingDetail: Shipped by the swift steed Shadowfax, known for delivering rare and powerful artifacts swiftly to their destination.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until a creature succeeds on its save or leaves the area.
usage.endsWhen: The target saves successfully or exits the darkness area.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharged after a long rest.

middle_earth_scroll_of_darkness.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its powerful and rare nature without being overpowered for its level.

the_edge_obsidian_mirror.name: Reflections of Ruin
the_edge_obsidian_mirror.description: The Reflections of Ruin is a dark obsidian mirror encrusted with rusted metal and strange runes. When you gaze into it, fleeting visions of potential futures ripple before your eyes, each more terrifying than the last. The mirror's surface hums with malevolent energy, occasionally reflecting minor damage to those who stare too long, causing temporary blindness or nausea. Wario warns that once you look away, the visions linger for a moment in your mind.

effectDetails.title: Fleeting Futures
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user gazes into the mirror to see one potential future. The vision lasts for 1 minute and can be interrupted by a successful DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. Reaching out or touching the mirror during this time causes the effect to end immediately.

effectDetails.title: Minor Damage Reflection
effectDetails.rules: If the user gazes into the mirror for more than 10 seconds, they must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 points of damage and be blinded for 1 minute. The mirror can only cause this effect once per day.

the_edge_obsidian_mirror.levelRequirementReason: The mirror's malevolent energy requires the user to have some experience in dealing with dangerous artifacts.
the_edge_obsidian_mirror.vendorReason: Final Shop stocks a wide range of curiosities, including this unsettling yet intriguing artifact.
the_edge_obsidian_mirror.shippingDetail: The giant spider courier delivers the item swiftly but is known to leave a trail of minor webbing in its wake.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: interrupted by touching the mirror, successful saving throw, or completion of the effect duration

the_edge_obsidian_mirror.priceReason: The Reflections of Ruin's price reflects its rare and dangerous nature, offering a glimpse into potential futures at a steep cost.

middle_earth_mushroom_of_eldoria.name: Eldoria's Delightful Fungus
middle_earth_mushroom_of_eldoria.description: Eldoria's Delightful Fungus radiates an otherworldly glow, its cap shimmering with ancient runes. Consumed, it grants a surge of vitality, bolstering your stamina for hours and leaving you with a refreshing aroma that lingers on your skin like the scent of wild meadows. Legend has it that those who partake in this fungi walk tall, their steps light as if they've been imbued with the very essence of Eldoria itself.

effectDetails.title: Increased Stamina
effectDetails.rules: Consume Eldoria's Delightful Fungus to gain a +5 bonus to your Constitution saving throws and a temporary increase in stamina for up to 4 hours. The effect ends if you consume any food or drink other than water.

effectDetails.title: Pleasant Smell
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the mushroom bestows an olfactory treat of refreshing scents that persist for 30 minutes, granting a +2 bonus to Persuasion checks made within this time. The effect is negated if you are in an environment with strong odors.

middle_earth_mushroom_of_eldoria.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest adventurer can benefit from Eldoria's Delightful Fungus, providing a quick boost of stamina and confidence.
middle_earth_mushroom_of_eldoria.vendorReason: The Shire Shop stocks this rare mushroom as a cherished local delicacy that travelers often seek for its rejuvenating properties.
middle_earth_mushroom_of_eldoria.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Pony Express, known for their reliable and swift deliveries of exotic goods from across Middle-earth.

usage.duration: 4 hours or until consumed food/drink taken (whichever comes first)
usage.endsWhen: Consumption of food or drink other than water, or after the stated duration

middle_earth_mushroom_of_eldoria.priceReason: The rarity and origin of Eldoria's Delightful Fungus justify its price point, offering a potent combination of stamina boost and olfactory delight.

middle_earth_scroll_of_forgotten_curses.name: Grimoire of Lost Tongues
middle_earth_scroll_of_forgotten_curses.description: The Grimoire of Lost Tongues is bound in dragonhide parchment, its pages inscribed with ancient runes that shimmer faintly under the light of a full moon. This forbidden tome contains curses so potent they can twist reality itself; each whispering incantation has a chance to summon an irritable goblin that disrupts your next action. The text's power is such that it grants a modest increase in mana regeneration, allowing for longer spells without rest.

effectDetails.title: Summons Irritable Goblin
effectDetails.rules: When this spell is cast, there is a 20% chance that an irritable goblin is summoned to disrupt the caster's next action. The goblin has AC 14 and deals 3d6 poison damage on hit with a bite attack. It has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened by the user.

effectDetails.title: Increased Mana Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: The user gains +5 mana regeneration per long rest, allowing for more potent spellcasting without overexertion. This effect lasts until the next short rest or when the caster is hit by a melee attack.

middle_earth_scroll_of_forgotten_curses.levelRequirementReason: Even novice mages should be wary of this forbidden tome; its power can be dangerous in inexperienced hands.
middle_earth_scroll_of_forgotten_curses.vendorReason: The dwarves, ever cautious and aware of the dangers of magic, provide this item for those who truly understand the risks.
middle_earth_scroll_of_forgotten_curses.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by enchanted flying carpet, ensuring the Grimoire arrives intact and in time for your next night's work.

usage.activation: As an action or bonus action
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The goblin is dispelled or the caster takes a melee attack
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use must be prepared in advance

middle_earth_scroll_of_forgotten_curses.priceReason: This price reflects the item's forbidden nature and potent effects that could easily spiral out of control.

almost_edge_void_blade.name: Void-Touched Edge
almost_edge_void_blade.description: The Void-Touched Edge is a wickedly curved blade forged from solidified darkness, its surface etched with swirling void runes that whisper of the eternal void. When drawn, it hums ominously and leaves chilling trails of emptiness in its wake. This weapon whispers of the void, dealing an additional 5 points of slashing damage on every strike, and has a chance to instill fear in foes, reducing their attack speed by 10%.

effectDetails.title: Additional Slashing Damage
effectDetails.rules: When the Void-Touched Edge strikes a target, it deals an additional 5 points of slashing damage. This effect is not negated by any form of resistance or immunity.

effectDetails.title: Fear
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that when you hit with this weapon, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. During this time, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

almost_edge_void_blade.levelRequirementReason: The Void-Touched Edge's arcane power requires the wielder to be at least level 6 to channel its full potential.
almost_edge_void_blade.vendorReason: The Void Merchant is known for dealing in the most exotic and dangerous items, including weapons imbued with dark magic like the Void-Touched Edge.
almost_edge_void_blade.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, this item must be shipped by the Void Serpent Delivery service to ensure safe transport.

usage.activation: On hit as part of a melee attack action
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect per strike
usage.endsWhen: The weapon's charge is expended after 5 successful hits, at which point it must be recharged through a lengthy ritual performed by a 10th-level warlock or higher.

almost_edge_void_blade.priceReason: This price reflects the blade's rare crafting materials and its unique ability to instill fear in opponents, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer.

faerun_item_shadows_whisper.name: Whispering Skull of Vorlag
faerun_item_shadows_whisper.description: The Whispering Skull of Vorlag, a gnarled and unsettling relic carved from the bones of an ancient lich, murmurs in a voice that seems to echo through time itself. It whispers secrets of lost treasures and forgotten tombs, but beware—its counsel is cryptic and often unreliable. The skull's murmurings are said to be most potent when one least expects it, especially during moments of grave decision-making. Listen too long, and you might begin to see things that aren't there, like the ghostly visage of a mischievous imp or the shadowy outline of a forgotten foe.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Counsel
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can ask the skull for advice on a decision. The DM rolls a d20 and adds your Intelligence modifier. On a result of 15 or higher, you receive cryptic but useful guidance. On a failure, the advice is misleading, leading to a disadvantage on any roll related to the decision.

effectDetails.title: Detects Hidden Tombs
effectDetails.rules: The skull can detect hidden tombs within 30 feet of you as an action. It emits a faint glow when it finds one and provides its location. This effect lasts for 1 minute, after which the skull must rest for at least 8 hours before being used again.

faerun_item_shadows_whisper.levelRequirementReason: The skull's necromantic power is too great for lower-level characters, requiring a minimum character level to wield it responsibly.
faerun_item_shadows_whisper.vendorReason: Vorlag was once an associate of Baldur, and his relics are sold in the bazaar as tokens of respect.
faerun_item_shadows_whisper.shippingDetail: The skull is carefully wrapped to prevent its murmuring from disturbing the cargo during transit.

usage.activation: As an action or bonus action
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Whispering Counsel, 1 minute for Detects Hidden Tombs
usage.endsWhen: On failure of a check, after duration ends, or when used again without resting

faerun_item_shadows_whisper.priceReason: The skull's power and rarity justify its moderate price.

connectopia_sparkle_granules.name: Glimmering Grit of the Gears
connectopia_sparkle_granules.description: The Glimmering Grit of the Gears are tiny, shimmering granules that sparkle with an ancient clockwork magic. Sprinkled on your tools during crafting or repair work, they grant a burst of efficiency and precision, speeding up the process by +2 to skill checks for one hour. The granules’ origin is shrouded in mystery; legend says they are remnants from a long-lost city that once powered itself with intricate gears and cogs. Beware: their magic can make you slightly dizzy.

effectDetails.title: Crafting Efficiency
effectDetails.rules: When sprinkled on tools, this granule grants a +2 bonus to one skill check per hour. The effect is instantaneous and lasts for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Dizziness
effectDetails.rules: While the efficiency boost is active, you suffer from a minor dizziness that imposes disadvantage on Concentration checks until the effect ends or you rest.

connectopia_sparkle_granules.levelRequirementReason: This item's magic enhances basic crafting tasks without requiring any advanced skill.
connectopia_sparkle_granules.vendorReason: Craft Corner is known for its vast array of tools and supplies that aid in the everyday needs of blacksmiths, tinkerers, and engineers who can benefit from these granules.
connectopia_sparkle_granules.shippingDetail: The mechanical drone delivers the Grit with a small delay due to its intricate nature; it is recommended to order ahead for important projects.

usage.activation: As an action, sprinkle on tools during crafting or repair work.
usage.duration: One hour per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the one-hour duration expires or the item runs out of uses.

connectopia_sparkle_granules.priceReason: The granules are crafted from rare clockwork remnants and require significant magical effort to produce, justifying their high price.

connectopia_pioneer_lantern.name: Lumiflux Beacon
connectopia_pioneer_lantern.description: The Lumiflux Beacon is a lantern forged from polished obsidian and brass, its core glows with an ethereal violet light. Crafted by the pioneering postmasters of Connectopia, this beacon not only illuminates the darkest corners but also emits a soothing hum that calms restless spirits. It's said to attract curious glow-bugs, creating a mesmerizing dance of light in the night sky; however, those who gaze too long might see fleeting visions of the past.

effectDetails.title: Light
effectDetails.rules: The Lumiflux Beacon provides bright light in a 20-foot radius. It also emits dim light for an additional 40 feet, allowing you to see normally and clearly within this area. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Attracts Glow-bugs
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the Lumiflux Beacon can be activated to attract glow-bugs in a 30-foot radius for 1 minute. During this time, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect creatures or objects within that area.

connectopia_pioneer_lantern.levelRequirementReason: The Lumiflux Beacon is designed for adventurers just starting their journey, providing a reliable source of light and a touch of ancient magic.
connectopia_pioneer_lantern.vendorReason: Connectopia Postmasters have long been known to provide essential gear that enhances both travel and adventure.
connectopia_pioneer_lantern.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the swift-winged messengers of Connectopia, ensuring your beacon arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute for attracting glow-bugs; passive light is constant
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when it expires or you deactivate the glow-bug attraction feature
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one instance of glow-bug attraction can be active at a time

connectopia_pioneer_lantern.priceReason: Balanced for its utility and rarity, the Lumiflux Beacon offers a fair price given its unique and versatile features.

pokemon_item_divine_scale.name: Divine Scale of Arceus
pokemon_item_divine_scale.description: The Divine Scale of Arceus is a shimmering scale with an ethereal glow. Said to have been shed by the god Pokémon himself, it grants unparalleled luck and a connection to the very fabric of reality. When used, it subtly shifts the balance in your favor, ensuring that your next battle starts under more favorable conditions, but beware – the scale's divine power might accidentally summon mischievous Pokémon if not handled with care.

effectDetails.title: Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this scale grants the user a +2 bonus to all attack and saving throw rolls for the next battle. This effect lasts until the start of the user's first turn in their subsequent combat encounter.

effectDetails.title: Mischievous Summon
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that when this scale is used, it might summon up to three mischievous Pokémon from another dimension. These creatures are harmless but can cause minor disruptions. The summoning ends immediately if the user takes any hostile action.

pokemon_item_divine_scale.levelRequirementReason: The Divine Scale's power requires no minimum level as its effects are more about luck and divine intervention than combat prowess.
pokemon_item_divine_scale.vendorReason: As a premium item, the Safari Shop is known for offering rare and divine artifacts like this scale.
pokemon_item_divine_scale.shippingDetail: Ships via the Celestial Courier, arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Used as an action at the start of a new battle.
usage.duration: Lasts until the start of the user's first turn in their next combat encounter.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user takes any hostile action or the battle concludes without using this scale.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it regenerates between battles.

pokemon_item_divine_scale.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its divine and potentially mischievous nature, ensuring players can obtain it without overpowered effects.

the_edge_slime_goo.name: Abyssal Slime Goo
the_edge_slime_goo.description: Abyssal Slime Goo, a pulsating violet mass that seems to giggle as it clings to your skin, emanates an eerie glow. This peculiar substance is said to have been crafted from the very essence of abyssal creatures, making it both a lifesaver and a potential hazard. Apply it to wounds, and not only does it heal 15 hit points instantly, but it also has a 3% chance to apply a debilitating poison that lasts for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Healing Touch (Instant)
effectDetails.rules: Apply Abyssal Slime Goo to a wound as an action. It heals the target for 15 hit points instantly and has a 3% chance to apply poison.

effectDetails.title: Poison Chance
effectDetails.rules: If the slime successfully adheres, there is a 3% chance that it applies a poison effect to the target, which lasts until healed or removed by a cure spell. The save DC for this poison is 12.

the_edge_slime_goo.levelRequirementReason: The Abyssal Slime Goo requires no special level as its effects are immediate and potent.
the_edge_slime_goo.vendorReason: The Abyss Trader, a denizen of the deep, often carries this rare item from his travels through the abyssal planes.
the_edge_slime_goo.shippingDetail: Shipped by a fleet of winged beetles known for their speed and reliability, ensuring quick delivery to eager adventurers.

usage.duration: Instantaneous healing; poison effect lasts until healed or removed by a cure spell
usage.endsWhen: Poison effect ends when healed or removed, slime is dispelled on failed save

the_edge_slime_goo.priceReason: The Abyssal Slime Goo's rarity and potent effects justify its high price.

the_edge_resonance_shard.name: Echoing Resonance Shard
the_edge_resonance_shard.description: The Echoing Resonance Shard is a fragment of an ancient artifact, its surface etched with runes that seem to glow faintly in the dark. When held, it fills your mind with whispers of forgotten battles and melodies, causing the air around you to hum with an otherworldly resonance. This shard not only increases your magic resistance by 10% but also has a chance to stun an enemy for one round every time you cast a spell or use a magical ability.

effectDetails.title: Magic Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Echoing Resonance Shard, your magic resistance is increased by 10%. This effect lasts until you stop holding it or are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Stun on Spell Use
effectDetails.rules: When you cast a spell or use a magical ability while holding this shard, there is a 5% chance to stun the target for one round. This effect has a maximum of three uses per long rest and requires a successful concentration check (DC 14) to maintain.

the_edge_resonance_shard.levelRequirementReason: Requires character level 6 due to its magical resonance and the risk of being stunned.
the_edge_resonance_shard.vendorReason: Edge Outpost deals in relics from ancient and forgotten realms, making it a fitting vendor for this shard.
the_edge_resonance_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via inter-dimensional rift, arriving within a week of order placement.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated by holding the shard.
usage.duration: Until you stop holding it or are incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after three uses per long rest due to magical strain.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a short rest.

the_edge_resonance_shard.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides significant but not game-breaking benefits.

earth_land_guild_scribe_service.name: Scroll of Precise Recordings
earth_land_guild_scribe_service.description: Crafted from parchment drenched in ink that whispers tales of yore, the Scroll of Precise Recordings captures your adventures as only the Guild Quartermaster's meticulous hand can. Each scroll is imbued with a spell that grants detailed illustrations and a written account, enhancing persuasion checks by +1 when recounting your exploits to elders or patrons. This service ensures your legend lives on in vivid detail, impressing even the most discerning audience.
effects: Grant detailed illustrated record of your adventures
Enhance persuasion checks related to storytelling

effectDetails.title: Illustrated Record
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a short rest, this scroll grants you and the party a detailed written account of recent adventures, complete with illustrations. The account can be used as proof for quest rewards or to impress elders. This effect is limited to once per week.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after activation, you gain a +1 bonus to Persuasion checks when recounting your adventures. This benefit ends if you make more than two Persuasion checks in the same day or at the end of the hour.

earth_land_guild_scribe_service.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to all adventurers, regardless of level, ensuring that every tale has a worthy chronicler.
earth_land_guild_scribe_service.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster specializes in services that preserve and enhance the legacy of brave souls.
earth_land_guild_scribe_service.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted messenger hawk, ensuring your scroll arrives safely and swiftly.

usage.activation: Activate with a short rest as an action.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until used in two Persuasion checks.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per week.

earth_land_guild_scribe_service.priceReason: The scroll's detailed illustrations and enhanced storytelling capabilities are worth the investment for any adventurer seeking to immortalize their exploits.

pokemon_item_league_badge_valor.name: Valor Badge of Bravery
pokemon_item_league_badge_valor.description: The Valor Badge of Bravery, a gleaming emblem awarded to trainers who have faced down the most fearsome Pokémon, is more than just a symbol of valor—it’s a tangible reminder of your courage and skill in battle. Its polished surface reflects the light with an almost supernatural shimmer, and it subtly increases your evasion by 10%, making you nimbler on your feet. When you’re facing off against intimidating foes, this badge grants you a +5 bonus to Willpower checks, bolstering your resolve and confidence.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Increase
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Valor Badge of Bravery, you gain a +10% bonus to your Dexterity saving throws. This effect is active as long as the badge is worn and does not require any action or special activation.

effectDetails.title: Willpower Bonus
effectDetails.rules: When making Willpower checks against intimidating foes, you receive an additional +5 bonus. This effect persists until the end of your next turn after the check is made.

pokemon_item_league_badge_valor.levelRequirementReason: The Valor Badge requires no level to wear it as a symbol of accomplishment.
pokemon_item_league_badge_valor.vendorReason: Trainers who have earned the Valor Badge visit the league store for official verification and display purposes.
pokemon_item_league_badge_valor.shippingDetail: Ships via PokéCourier express, ensuring safe delivery within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for evasion increase; until the end of your next turn after making a Willpower check against an intimidating foe.
usage.endsWhen: The badge is removed or lost.

pokemon_item_league_badge_valor.priceReason: The Valor Badge’s fair value reflects its status as an epic rarity, symbolizing significant bravery and skill.

pokemon_item_safari_research_note.name: Safari Research Note - Dusk Mane
pokemon_item_safari_research_note.description: The Safari Research Note - Dusk Mane is a leather-bound journal embossed with the iconic Safari Zone emblem. Its pages are filled with detailed, hand-drawn sketches of a Dusk Mane Pokémon's nocturnal behavior and habitat preferences. This invaluable field guide increases your chances of encountering this elusive Pokémon by 10% when used after sunset, and grants you a +2 bonus to Insight checks related to understanding its nature.

effectDetails.title: Increased Chance to Encounter Dusk Mane
effectDetails.rules: Activate once per day. When used after sunset, increase the chances of encountering a Dusk Mane Pokémon by 10%. This effect ends when you encounter the Pokémon or at midnight.

effectDetails.title: Bonus to Insight Checks
effectDetails.rules: While holding this note, gain a +2 bonus on Insight checks related to understanding the behavior and nature of Dusk Mane Pokémon. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

pokemon_item_safari_research_note.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to beginners who are just starting their journey in the Safari Zone.
pokemon_item_safari_research_note.vendorReason: The Safari Shop specializes in items and guides for trainers venturing into the Safari Zone.
pokemon_item_safari_research_note.shippingDetail: Delivered by trusted SwiftPony Couriers within a day of purchase.

usage.activation: Use once per day after sunset.
usage.duration: Until you encounter a Dusk Mane Pokémon or midnight, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: Encountering the Pokémon or at midnight.

pokemon_item_safari_research_note.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the valuable insights it provides to trainers.

almost_edge_item_chronal_shard.name: Fragment of the Unwound Moment
almost_edge_item_chronal_shard.description: This Fragment of the Unwound Moment hums with the quiet desperation of forgotten timelines, its surface etched with the ghostly remnants of alternate realities. When held, it grants a fleeting glimpse into potential futures, but prolonged exposure risks entangling one's sanity in the echoes of what *could* have been. Remarkably handy for toasting bread, this shard is as much a conduit to the multiverse as it is a mundane kitchen aid.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Insight
effectDetails.rules: Holding the Fragment for one minute grants advantage on one skill check of your choice. If you focus too long, there is a 10% chance you become permanently lost in the echoes of potential futures.

effectDetails.title: Sanity Preservation
effectDetails.rules: While holding this shard, you have resistance to sanity loss from horrifying visions. The effect lasts for one hour per use.

almost_edge_item_chronal_shard.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for beginners as it aids in navigating the complexities of reality without requiring advanced arcane knowledge.
almost_edge_item_chronal_shard.vendorReason: The Void Merchant frequents dimensions where such curiosities are common, ensuring they have a steady supply of these enigmatic shards.
almost_edge_item_chronal_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via inter-dimensional courier with a 24-hour delivery time.

usage.activation: Holding the shard for one minute
usage.duration: One hour per use or until lost in alternate timelines
usage.endsWhen: Focus is too long, causing temporary loss of reality

almost_edge_item_chronal_shard.priceReason: Balanced pricing reflects its utility and the risk involved with prolonged exposure.

almost_edge_item_echoing_gauntlet.name: The Gauntlet of Lost Voices
almost_edge_item_echoing_gauntlet.description: The Gauntlet of Lost Voices is forged from solidified void-matter, its surface etched with ancient runes that hum faintly. This gauntlet grants the wearer a fleeting connection to the spirits of those who have perished on the edge, their voices whispering secrets and warnings. Its warmth is comforting yet unsettling, as it occasionally causes the wearer to involuntarily rearrange their inventory in bizarre patterns. The gauntlet's whispers are not mere echoes; they provide resistance to fear-based attacks and can momentarily cause enemies to turn on themselves.

effectDetails.title: Voice Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to all fear effects. This effect is active as long as the gauntlet is worn and lasts until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Phantom Echo
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, the wearer can activate this gauntlet to cause a nearby enemy to attack itself with a melee weapon attack. The effect has a 5% chance to occur each time the gauntlet is worn. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends when the gauntlet is removed.

almost_edge_item_echoing_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet's connection to spirits requires a deep understanding of both life and death, which can only be achieved at higher levels.
almost_edge_item_echoing_gauntlet.vendorReason: The Edge Wanderer is well-traveled and has encountered the lost souls that infuse this gauntlet with their whispers.
almost_edge_item_echoing_gauntlet.shippingDetail: Ships via a gravitational anomaly, which can cause delays of up to one week due to unpredictable travel paths.

usage.activation: Activates on wear and use. Phantom Echo effect is triggered once per short or long rest.
usage.duration: Voice Resistance lasts until the end of their next turn. Phantom Echo lasts for 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The gauntlet's effects end when removed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one use of Phantom Echo per day.

almost_edge_item_echoing_gauntlet.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP due to its unique abilities and the risk it poses in the hands of unprepared adventurers.

almost_edge_item_void_navigator.name: The Cartographer's Lament
almost_edge_item_void_navigator.description: The Cartographer's Lament is a finely polished sextant crafted from obsidian and silver, its lenses etched with ancient cartographic runes. This unsettling tool does not point to stars but to the very frays in reality where dimensional breaches occur. It allows for brief, perilous traversals through unstable pathways, ideal for escaping awkward social situations or locating hidden donut shops. Use it too often, and you might feel an existential tug that leaves you craving jelly-filled pastries.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Traverse
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can activate the sextant for a brief dimensional traverse of up to 50 feet. The duration is instantaneous, and it ends when the user exits the unstable pathway or if they take any other action. This effect has no save DC but is limited to once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Resilience to Void Attacks
effectDetails.rules: The user gains resistance to damage from void-based attacks for 1 minute upon activation. The effect ends when the duration expires, and it can be used only once per long rest.

almost_edge_item_void_navigator.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 5 to wield this unstable tool safely.
almost_edge_item_void_navigator.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in esoteric and dangerous items, making The Cartographer's Lament a fitting addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_item_void_navigator.shippingDetail: Ships via the Temporal Courier with a delivery delay of one week due to dimensional instability risks during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends on exit or action taken
usage.endsWhen: Exceeding rest limits, or using another effect

almost_edge_item_void_navigator.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its dangerous and unstable nature while providing a limited but potent utility.

animatopia_totem_of_the_hunt.name: Totem of the Hunt
animatopia_totem_of_the_hunt.description: The Totem of the Hunt is a weathered bone sculpture adorned with ancient carvings. Crafted from the bones of long-forgotten predators, it whispers secrets of the wild to those who can hear its voice. Wario’s advice still holds true; earplugs are recommended for anyone seeking its guidance. This totem significantly enhances tracking skills and offers a chance to detect hidden paths, though prolonged exposure might drive even the most steadfast mind to distraction.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Tracking
effectDetails.rules: The Totem of the Hunt grants a +2 bonus to Wisdom (Survival) checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Path Detection
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Perception checks made to detect hidden paths or secret doors within 60 feet, with a chance of success at 20%. This effect is active for 1 hour after activation and can be used once per long rest.

animatopia_totem_of_the_hunt.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character level of 4 to harness the totem’s primal magic without succumbing to its whispers.
animatopia_totem_of_the_hunt.vendorReason: Beast Bazaar specializes in mystical curiosities and ancient artifacts, making it a fitting vendor for the Totem of the Hunt.
animatopia_totem_of_the_hunt.shippingDetail: The totem is delivered by a giant worm express, ensuring safe arrival but with a slight delay due to its size.

usage.duration: 1 hour per use
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration expires or you are incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited; regains charges after a long rest.

animatopia_totem_of_the_hunt.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its rare and mystical nature, offering significant yet manageable benefits to a character of appropriate level.

midlands_item_chronarium_shard.name: Echo of the Shattered Time
midlands_item_chronarium_shard.description: A shard of shattered time, this Echo of the Shattered Time glimmers with a spectrum of timelines, each fragment representing a potential future or past. Held in one's palm, it hums with the weight of uncounted eons, offering fleeting glimpses into moments that could have been—sometimes whimsical, other times dire. This relic grants its bearer a minor taste of fate’s capricious nature, allowing for a one-time chance to influence their path by altering a single attribute temporarily.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the wielder may spend an action to focus on the shard. It grants a +1 to +4 bonus (roll d6) to one ability score of their choice for the next 24 hours.

effectDetails.title: Fate's Chance
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the wielder may make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, they gain advantage on one ability check or attack roll of their choice that day.

midlands_item_chronarium_shard.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires attunement and a certain level of maturity to handle its temporal energies.
midlands_item_chronarium_shard.vendorReason: The Forged Heart is known for salvaging and selling the most bizarre, yet functional, relics from the fractured planes.
midlands_item_chronarium_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional portal, arriving within an hour of placing the order.

usage.duration: 24 hours
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the time duration expires or the shard is removed from attunement.

midlands_item_chronarium_shard.priceReason: Balanced as a rare legendary item, this price reflects its rarity and the risk involved in attuning to it.

internet_godly_reality_flux.name: The Source Code of Chaos
internet_godly_reality_flux.description: The Source Code of Chaos hums with an unstable, electric pulse, a relic from a corrupted server farm that defies the laws of both physics and logic. This artifact grants its wielder the power to subtly manipulate reality itself—teleporting them to random locations within sixty feet or instantly repairing any damaged equipment. However, be wary: the universe's balance is delicate, and each use risks triggering an unpredictable change in the user’s appearance, from hair color to skin tone. Wario, ever the chaos-lover, finds this item irresistible.

effectDetails.title: Teleport to Random Location
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can teleport up to sixty feet away from your current location. This effect is instantaneous and does not provoke opportunity attacks. The destination must be within line of sight, but there's a 10% chance that the exact coordinates are off by as much as ten feet in any direction.

effectDetails.title: Instant Equipment Repair
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can instantly repair any damaged equipment. This effect restores all hit points to a single piece of equipment within range. The repaired item cannot exceed its maximum hit points. You regain 50 XP upon successful use.

internet_godly_reality_flux.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest wizard can appreciate the power and danger of this artifact.
internet_godly_reality_flux.vendorReason: The cyber_market is known for its eclectic array of unique and powerful items, including those with ties to technology and chaos.
internet_godly_reality_flux.shippingDetail: Ships via Quantum Entanglement, ensuring swift delivery, but the item's true nature can be detected by sensitive magic sensors.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after three uses. Afterward, it takes a full day to recharge.

internet_godly_reality_flux.priceReason: The Source Code of Chaos is moderately priced due to its balance between powerful effects and the risk of unpredictable outcomes.

teyvat_item_ember_of_stormwind.name: Stormwind's Whisper
teyvat_item_ember_of_stormwind.description: Stormwind's Whisper is a tiny, pulsating ember that seems to hum with the raw energy of Barbatos himself. When ignited, it releases a gust of wind magic that can dash you across chasms or create a miniature whirlwind to push back foes. Crafted by the forges of Mondstadt, this ember is as unpredictable as it is powerful—just be wary; it might blow away your snacks in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Wind Magic Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a bonus action, Stormwind's Whisper grants you the ability to dash across short distances at double your speed for up to 1 minute. The effect ends if you are knocked prone or fall unconscious.

effectDetails.title: Whirlwind Push
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can activate this ember to create a gust of wind that pushes back any creature within 5 feet of you. This push has a force equal to your Strength modifier (minimum of 1) and knocks creatures prone if they fail a DC 13 Strength saving throw.

teyvat_item_ember_of_stormwind.levelRequirementReason: Stormwind's Whisper requires a level 7 character due to its volatile magic and the risk it poses when misused.
teyvat_item_ember_of_stormwind.vendorReason: The Mondstadt Market is known for its eclectic array of items, including unique artifacts like Stormwind's Whisper.
teyvat_item_ember_of_stormwind.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Winged Sprite, this item arrives within a week, but handling requires special care in transit to ensure it remains intact.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: You fall unconscious or are knocked prone
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use expends a charge

teyvat_item_ember_of_stormwind.priceReason: Stormwind's Whisper is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare crafting material and unpredictable nature.

teyvat_item_lion_heart_of_xia.name: Xia's Steadfast Resolve
teyvat_item_lion_heart_of_xia.description: Hewn from the heart of Xia's ancient stone, this crimson gemstone glows with a resilient fire that crackles through your veins. As you hold it, the unyielding spirit of Xia's people flows into you, bolstering your defenses and fortifying your resolve against relentless assaults. In the heat of battle or during arduous quests, this steadfast core ensures you stand firm, ready to weather any storm and refuse to yield.

effectDetails.title: Defense Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases your AC by +2 for 1 minute or until you take damage, then recharges on a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to fire damage while the core is active. Ends when you take fire damage or at the end of each of your turns until the duration expires or the core's use is exhausted.

teyvat_item_lion_heart_of_xia.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all adventurers, as it enhances basic resilience regardless of class.
teyvat_item_lion_heart_of_xia.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor is known for its connection to Xia and offers items that embody the region's spirit.
teyvat_item_lion_heart_of_xia.shippingDetail: Ships via a reliable cargo ship, ensuring timely delivery from the Stone Sea.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage, then recharges on a short rest
usage.endsWhen: You take fire damage or at the end of each turn during its duration.

teyvat_item_lion_heart_of_xia.priceReason: Balanced as it offers defensive benefits without being overly powerful.

teyvat_item_serpent_scale_of_zan.name: Zan's Everlasting Gaze
teyvat_item_serpent_scale_of_zan.description: A shimmering, iridescent scale from a Serpent of the Deep, Zan's Everlasting Gaze grants you the eerie ability to see in near-darkness and emits a chilling aura that unnerves weaker foes, perfect for stealthy maneuvers or terrifying performances. This artifact, forged by ancient magicks, enhances your perception to 50 feet at night and reduces enemy movement speeds by up to 20 feet within its range of 10 feet.

effectDetails.title: Night Vision
effectDetails.rules: When activated, Zan's Everlasting Gaze grants you the ability to see in near-darkness out to 50 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends early if you take damage or end your turn in darkness.

effectDetails.title: Chill Aura
effectDetails.rules: Within a 10-foot radius, Zan's Everlasting Gaze emits an unnerving aura that reduces the movement speed of creatures within it by up to 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends if you move more than 30 feet or take damage.

teyvat_item_serpent_scale_of_zan.levelRequirementReason: This artifact is crafted with ancient magics, making it accessible even to lower-level adventurers who wish to harness its power.
teyvat_item_serpent_scale_of_zan.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in unique and powerful artifacts from the deep, ensuring that only those who can appreciate their craftsmanship are given access to such items.
teyvat_item_serpent_scale_of_zan.shippingDetail: The Phantom Ship ensures quick delivery of this delicate artifact through its secret routes, arriving within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or end your turn in darkness
usage.charges: Unlimited; the item recharges at dawn

teyvat_item_serpent_scale_of_zan.priceReason: This artifact's price reflects its mythic rarity, ancient craftsmanship, and limited availability.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_luck.name: The Lucky Coin of Wario's Fortune
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_luck.description: The Lucky Coin of Wario's Fortune is said to have been carried by the notorious thief himself. This copper coin glimmers with an almost unnatural light, and when held tightly in your palm, it subtly shifts between hues of gold and silver. It offers a fleeting boost to your luck but also draws unwanted attention from greedy gophers. Use this coin wisely; its magic is as fickle as the fortune it promises.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Luck
effectDetails.rules: When you roll an ability check, you can expend one use of this coin. On a failed roll, you instead succeed and gain advantage on the next saving throw you make before sunset.

effectDetails.title: Gopher Attraction
effectDetails.rules: For every 1d4 rounds after activation, you are surrounded by gophers who attempt to steal the coin from your grasp. They do not attack unless provoked but hinder your movement within a 5-foot radius.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_luck.levelRequirementReason: This coin is powerful enough for lower-level characters to gain a significant advantage without overburdening them.
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_luck.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop specializes in items that can help adventurers in their quest, and this coin offers just the right balance of utility and danger.
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_luck.shippingDetail: The coin is delivered by a giant snail, which can take up to three days depending on weather conditions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of your next turn or until you use it again.
usage.endsWhen: Expend all charges or until you lose consciousness.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_luck.priceReason: The coin’s rarity and its dual effect make it a valuable but not overpowered item, offering a unique and challenging mechanic.

mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_of_transit.name: The Pipe of Questionable Destinations
mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_of_transit.description: This ornate pipe, crafted from a rare blend of alchemical mushroom roots and enchanted steel, seems to shimmer faintly under moonlight. With a twist and a puff, you might find yourself transported to the hidden lair of robotic mushrooms or Wario’s personal vault. The risk is high, but so too are the rewards—those who dare must be prepared for sudden speed boosts and moments of disorientation that leave them briefly confused.

effectDetails.title: Teleport to Random Location
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you are transported to a random location. There is a 30% chance of teleporting to Wario’s vault or the lair of robotic mushrooms. The destination is not predetermined and can change with each use.

effectDetails.title: Chance of Encountering Wario
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that, upon arrival at your new location, you will encounter Wario. If encountered, he may challenge you to a brief duel or simply steal nearby items. This effect lasts until the end of your turn.

mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_of_transit.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic understanding of risk and reward to use responsibly.
mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_of_transit.vendorReason: Wario himself ensures that only those who understand his vault’s secrets can access such an item.
mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_of_transit.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by rocket mushroom, ensuring your adventure begins without delay.

usage.duration: Instantaneous teleportation; effect ends immediately upon arrival at the destination
usage.endsWhen: Teleportation is complete or if you are encountered by Wario
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per day

mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_of_transit.priceReason: Balanced price for an item that offers unpredictable yet potentially lucrative teleportation.

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_frosting.name: The Nightmare Frosting
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_frosting.description: The Nightmare Frosting exudes a viscous, obsidian-black consistency that clings to your lips like a forgotten nightmare. As you consume it, the frosting's chill spreads through your body, granting you an increase in attack damage and a chance to confuse foes with its spectral whispers. However, the frost bites deeper into your mind, sapping your sanity at each bite until it reaches a breaking point. Beware, for this treat is more curse than confection.

effectDetails.title: Increased Attack Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you consume the frosting, your attack rolls are increased by +20%. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until you use an action to clear it.

effectDetails.title: Confusion on Enemies
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that a creature hit by one of your attacks will be confused as long as the frosting's effect persists. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or become confused for 1 minute.

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_frosting.levelRequirementReason: The Nightmare Frosting is too potent and dangerous, even at higher levels, to be consumed by those without significant experience.
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_frosting.vendorReason: The Pastry Palace, known for its dark and forbidden sweets, offers the Nightmare Frosting as a rare treat only to those who dare to venture into the night markets.
leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_frosting.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Shadowy Messenger, the frosting arrives in an enigmatic box marked with arcane symbols.

usage.activation: Eating a portion of the frosting grants its effects immediately.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until cleared.
usage.endsWhen: The effects are cleared via an action or when the duration ends.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each consumption deals temporary insanity.

leclaire_isle_item_forbidden_frosting.priceReason: The Nightmare Frosting is priced at 1000 XP due to its potent effects and rare, dark ingredients.

leclaire_isle_item_godly_gingerbread_wea.name: The Sugar Serpent Blade
leclaire_isle_item_godly_gingerbread_wea.description: The Sugar Serpent Blade, crafted from crystallized sugar and enchanted with a thousand gingerbread men's essence, hums with sweet energy. Its sugary edge slices through metal as if it were butter, leaving behind a trail of confectionery delight that can turn foes into dazed, drooling messes. This weapon is not just a tool; it's a temptation that heals the wielder by one hit point per second but risks fueling their own sweet cravings.

effectDetails.title: Sweet Slice
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with The Sugar Serpent Blade, it deals an additional 5 damage to the target. On a failed Dexterity saving throw (DC 18), the creature is also affected by the 'sugar rush' effect.

effectDetails.title: Gingerbread Temptation
effectDetails.rules: The weapon passively heals you for 1 hit point per second while in your possession. However, if you consume more than one serving of sweets (as determined by the DM) within an hour, this healing effect is reduced to half its rate.

leclaire_isle_item_godly_gingerbread_wea.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and power of The Sugar Serpent Blade demand a high level of expertise.
leclaire_isle_item_godly_gingerbread_wea.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in unique and powerful confectionary items, making it the go-to vendor for such a whimsical yet deadly weapon.
leclaire_isle_item_godly_gingerbread_wea.shippingDetail: Delivered by an ethereal courier, this item arrives with a sprinkle of sugar dust.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or until consumed
usage.endsWhen: The weapon is destroyed if exposed to excessive moisture for more than an hour, or if a creature successfully disarms it in combat.

leclaire_isle_item_godly_gingerbread_wea.priceReason: The Sugar Serpent Blade's godly rarity and unique properties justify its modest price of 1000 XP.

mushroom_kingdom_item_gloomshroom.name: Gloomshroom's Lament
mushroom_kingdom_item_gloomshroom.description: Gloomshroom's Lament is a pulsing, violet mushroom harvested from the deepest tunnels of Wario’s underground complex. It emits a sorrowful hum that seems to absorb light, offering temporary but potent darkness vision—perfect for sneaking past grumpy Goombas or escaping a particularly nasty Pink Shell ambush! The mushroom exudes an eerie glow that can make even seasoned heroes feel slightly melancholic; that's just the mushroom’s vibe.

effectDetails.title: Darkness Vision
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, providing temporary darkness vision for 15 seconds. Grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and disadvantage on perception checks made to notice the user. Ends when the user takes damage or enters an area of bright light.

effectDetails.title: Sadness
effectDetails.rules: Minor chance to inflict a 'sadness' status effect, reducing attack power by 1d4 until the start of your next turn. This effect has a 20% chance per use and lasts for 1 round. Save DC is 13.

mushroom_kingdom_item_gloomshroom.levelRequirementReason: The mushroom's potent effects make it accessible to lower-level characters, enhancing their stealth capabilities in dark environments.
mushroom_kingdom_item_gloomshroom.vendorReason: Toad Town Market frequently stocks unique items from the Mushroom Kingdom that can help adventurers in their quests.
mushroom_kingdom_item_gloomshroom.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Snail Post, which is known for its reliable but slightly slower delivery service within the Mushroom Kingdom.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and use.
usage.duration: 15 seconds of darkness vision duration.
usage.endsWhen: User takes damage or enters an area of bright light.

mushroom_kingdom_item_gloomshroom.priceReason: The mushroom's rarity and the unique darkness vision effect justify its higher price, making it a valuable but not overpowered tool for adventurers.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_amplifier.name: Amplified Coin of Prosperity
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_amplifier.description: The Amplified Coin of Prosperity is a rare coin forged in Wario's notorious vault. Its surface glows faintly with an unnatural warmth, and when held aloft, it amplifies your luck at finding treasure. This particular coin feels particularly warm to the touch, as if it pulses with hidden energy. When chanted over with a suitably greedy mantra, its effects are compounded, making you more prone to attracting unwanted attention from treasure hunters.

effectDetails.title: Loot Magnifier
effectDetails.rules: When activated by holding the coin aloft and chanting, you gain a +2 bonus to all Intelligence (Investigation) checks related to finding treasure. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: While this coin is in your possession, your Charisma score is increased by 1 for all interactions involving negotiation and persuasion. You can use this ability once per day, and it lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_amplifier.levelRequirementReason: This coin requires a higher level to activate due to its potent effects on luck and charisma.
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_amplifier.vendorReason: Wario's direct sales are known for their questionable but often effective items, making this coin a perfect fit.
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_amplifier.shippingDetail: Delivered by the mushroom cart with a free bonus of Wario-themed stickers.

usage.activation: Bonus action to hold aloft and chant over the coin.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but you can only use each effect once per day.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_amplifier.priceReason: The coin's powerful effects and rarity justify its moderate price in gold pieces.

mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_alliance_bad.name: Koopa Alliance Recognition Token
mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_alliance_bad.description: This polished, intricately carved shell fragment gleams under the Mushroom Kingdom's moonlight, its surface etched with the unmistakable insignia of the Koopa Alliance – a group known for their disciplined yet somewhat intimidating presence in the realm. By donning this badge, you earn the respect and potential patronage of the Koopas, but also the occasional unwelcome request to assist them in reclaiming stolen goods or settling territorial disputes. While it may seem like an honor, be wary; the badge is no mere trinket—its power lies in its ability to grant access to exclusive quests and discounts at Koopa shops.

effectDetails.title: Access to Koopa Alliance Quests
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an interaction when you enter a Koopa-controlled area. The badge grants you access to exclusive quests that involve retrieving stolen items or resolving disputes. These quests provide experience points and valuable resources but may also expose you to the wrath of Wario if not handled with care.

effectDetails.title: Small Discount at Koopa Shops
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect while wearing the badge, providing a 5% discount on purchases made in any Koopa shop. This benefit lasts for one week after each purchase and cannot be combined with other discounts or promotions.

mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_alliance_bad.levelRequirementReason: The badge's intricate design requires a certain level of experience to properly harness its symbolic power within the Koopa Alliance.
mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_alliance_bad.vendorReason: Koopa shops are trusted by the Koopa Alliance and sell items that reflect their values, making them the ideal vendors for this emblematic token.
mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_alliance_bad.shippingDetail: Shipped via reliable Turtle Delivery, ensuring safe arrival within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Interaction when entering a Koopa-controlled area or purchasing goods in a Koopa shop.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for quest access; weekly for discount benefit.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after completing the quest or once the weekly discount period ends.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one active quest at any time.

mushroom_kingdom_item_koopa_alliance_bad.priceReason: The badge's rarity and the exclusive access it grants justify its moderate price in experience points.

grand_country_crumb_of_height.name: Crumb of Height
grand_country_crumb_of_height.description: The Crumb of Height is a shimmering fragment that fell from the impossible cliffs of the Grand Country, a tiny piece of solidified gravity. When consumed, it grants you a burst of climbing prowess, allowing your feet to move with the grace and speed of a mountain goat for ten seconds. The crumb also reduces fall damage by half, making it perfect for those tricky vertical ascents where missteps could be fatal.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Climbing Speed
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, consume the Crumb of Height to gain a +2 bonus to climbing checks and movement speed for 10 seconds. This effect ends if you take damage or if your turn ends.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Fall Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you fall, reduce fall damage by half until the start of your next turn. This effect can only be used once per short rest.

grand_country_crumb_of_height.levelRequirementReason: This crumb is easily accessible to all adventurers, requiring no special skill or training.
grand_country_crumb_of_height.vendorReason: Side Seller specializes in rare and exotic items found during expeditions, making the Crumb of Height a fitting addition to their inventory.
grand_country_crumb_of_height.shippingDetail: Shipped by a swift winged beetle courier, ensuring the Crumb reaches its destination intact and timely.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or your turn ends

grand_country_crumb_of_height.priceReason: The Crumb of Height is a common consumable with limited utility but critical in survival situations, justifying its value.

grand_country_gravitic_boots.name: Gravitic Boots of the Shifting Stone
grand_country_gravitic_boots.description: The Gravitic Boots of the Shifting Stone are crafted from petrified moss and the echoes of ancient stone, imbuing their wearer with an eerie yet potent control over personal gravity. These boots allow for a brief but dramatic increase in jump height, and they provide a reliable slow fall speed that can save you from plummeting deaths. The unexpected bounces they produce make navigating treacherous terrains both exhilarating and perilously unpredictable.

effectDetails.title: Jump Height Boost
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the boots to increase your jump height by up to 50%. This effect lasts for 1 minute and requires no concentration.

effectDetails.title: Slow Fall
effectDetails.rules: While in the air, you have a +2d6 modifier to AC against falling damage. Additionally, this effect provides a slow fall speed of 30 feet. It remains active until the end of your next turn or until you land.

grand_country_gravitic_boots.levelRequirementReason: The boots require a level 7 character due to their complex enchantment and the magic required to manipulate gravity.
grand_country_gravitic_boots.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in items that enhance mobility and agility, making these boots an ideal fit for her inventory.
grand_country_gravitic_boots.shippingDetail: The boots are shipped via rock slide, ensuring they arrive undamaged but with a slight delay due to the nature of the delivery method.

usage.duration: 1 minute (recharges after 8 hours)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you stop moving or until it recharges

grand_country_gravitic_boots.priceReason: The boots are priced at 1000 XP due to their rare material composition and the complex enchantment required for their creation.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_boots.name: Null-Grip Boots of Descent
doughnut_hole_gravitic_boots.description: The Null-Grip Boots of Descent are forged from the unstable core of a forgotten gravitic anomaly. Their soles pulse with a faint, magnetic sheen that temporarily negates gravity's pull. Though they grant an exhilarating boost to your jumping prowess and reduce fall damage, beware—once you leap, you must land on solid ground or risk falling into the void below. These boots are surprisingly comfortable even during their brief but exhilarating use.

effectDetails.title: Gravitic Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you activate these boots by using a bonus action, they temporarily negate gravity for the next 10 feet of movement. You gain a +5 bonus to your jump DC and can jump up to twice as high as normal until you use them again.

effectDetails.title: Fall Damage Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For every 20 feet you fall after using these boots, you take no fall damage. This effect is limited to once per short rest.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are designed for beginners and adventurers who need a little extra confidence while exploring treacherous terrain.
doughnut_hole_gravitic_boots.vendorReason: The center_seller is known for their unique and experimental items, making these gravitic wonders an ideal addition to their catalog.
doughnut_hole_gravitic_boots.shippingDetail: Due to the instability of the boots' core, they are shipped with a delayed delivery, ensuring they arrive in optimal condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting until you use them again or fall from a height greater than 20 feet
usage.endsWhen: You land from a jump or fall more than 20 feet

doughnut_hole_gravitic_boots.priceReason: The boots' unique gravitic properties, along with their experimental nature and the risk involved in their creation, justify this balanced price.

doughnut_hole_mythic_singularity_orb.name: The Heart's Echo
doughnut_hole_mythic_singularity_orb.description: The Heart's Echo is a pulsing, chaotic orb that emanates from The Doughnut Hole’s center. Its touch distorts reality, creating localized gravitational wells that trap and damage foes within its radius. Those who linger too long may find themselves entangled in vivid hallucinations—visions of sprinkles dancing in the air or surreal landscapes that bend logic itself. This enigmatic artifact is a reminder to handle it with both caution and respect.

effectDetails.title: Gravitational Trap
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Heart's Echo creates a localized gravitational well within a 5-foot radius. Any creature in this area takes 1d6 force damage and is restrained until it exits the area. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until a successful DC 14 Strength saving throw is made.

effectDetails.title: Hallucinatory Visions
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the Heart's Echo induces vivid hallucinations in the user. On a roll of 4+ on a d6, the user becomes stunned for one turn and must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

doughnut_hole_mythic_singularity_orb.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest spellcasters can harness its chaotic energy with proper training.
doughnut_hole_mythic_singularity_orb.vendorReason: Void Vendor deals in enigmatic and powerful artifacts, making The Heart's Echo a fitting addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_mythic_singularity_orb.shippingDetail: Due to the delicate nature of the Heart's Echo, it is shipped via the Temporal Paradox Delivery Service for guaranteed safe arrival.

usage.duration: One minute or until a successful saving throw is made
usage.endsWhen: A successful DC 14 Strength save, exiting the area, or after one minute

doughnut_hole_mythic_singularity_orb.priceReason: The Heart's Echo strikes a balance between its chaotic nature and practical utility, making it accessible yet valuable.

the_edge_chronal_repair.name: Chronal Repair - Temporal Stitching
the_edge_chronal_repair.description: The Chronal Repair - Temporal Stitching is a shimmering, iridescent thread with a weave of temporal echoes. Crafted by the Timekeepers of Eternos, this item can briefly restore a damaged weapon or piece of armor to its former glory. It uses the power of time to nudge reality into a temporary fix, perfect for those who find themselves in dire straits. Just don't ask how Wario got his hands on it; even he's not sure.
