midlands_item_stinkbomb_of_discontent.vendorReason: The Empire Exchange often stocks items that allow citizens to vent their frustrations creatively, including this memorable grenade.
midlands_item_stinkbomb_of_discontent.shippingDetail: Delivered by a swift carriage, ensuring the item arrives in pristine condition and ready for use.

usage.duration: instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when all creatures affected are no longer within the area of the cloud or upon the end of the battle.
usage.charges: 1 charge, recharges after a short rest

midlands_item_stinkbomb_of_discontent.priceReason: Despite its common rarity, The Emperor's Ire offers significant battlefield disruption at a fair cost.

grand_country_vertical_repair.name: Sheer Ascent Stabilizer Service
grand_country_vertical_repair.description: The Sheer Ascent Stabilizer Service from Vertical Vendor ensures your gear is as sturdy as you are. This meticulously crafted service strengthens your equipment against the harshness of vertical climbs, reinforcing every strap and seam with a durable, weathered metal that has seen countless ascents. After the repair, a calming conversation about proper anchor points leaves you feeling more secure than ever before, knowing that each piece is ready for the climb ahead.

effectDetails.title: Repair Equipment (Major)
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can repair one piece of equipment that is broken or damaged to its maximum condition. This service also improves the durability of the repaired item by +2 AC for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Stability Buff
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +3 bonus to saving throws against falling and being knocked prone, as well as a +2 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made while climbing. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

grand_country_vertical_repair.levelRequirementReason: The service is designed for adventurers who are just starting their journey and need reliable gear right away.
grand_country_vertical_repair.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in equipment that can withstand the most extreme climbs, ensuring every adventurer is prepared before they ascend.
grand_country_vertical_repair.shippingDetail: Ships via magnetic hooks directly to your feet, ensuring secure delivery even when you're in motion.

usage.duration: 1 hour and until the end of your next long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire at the start of your next short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as each use is a bonus action

grand_country_vertical_repair.priceReason: This service includes both major repair and an extended stability buff, making it a crucial investment for any adventurer.

pokemon_item_evolution_consultation.name: Evolutionary Insight Session – Professor Oak’s Style!
pokemon_item_evolution_consultation.description: Seek the counsel of Pokémon lore at its heart in this Evolutionary Insight Session, conducted by a seasoned researcher steeped in Professor Oak’s wisdom. This rare consultation not only increases your Pokémon's happiness by 5 points but also grants it a chance to evolve on the next battle. Just remember, the session is as legendary and ancient as the professor himself, so tread lightly—lest you learn the hard way that not all evolutionary paths are meant for every Pokémon.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Evolve on Next Battle
effectDetails.rules: The Pokémon gains a +2 bonus to its Evolution check. This effect lasts until the end of your next battle, at which point it has a 10% chance to evolve into its next form if applicable.

effectDetails.title: Increase Happiness by 5 Points
effectDetails.rules: Your Pokémon's happiness is increased by 5 points immediately upon completing this session. This effect does not require any action and lasts until the Pokémon's happiness is reduced below this new value.

pokemon_item_evolution_consultation.levelRequirementReason: This service requires a basic understanding of Pokémon training to ensure it aligns with your team’s strategy.
pokemon_item_evolution_consultation.vendorReason: The league store only offers services that can benefit aspiring trainers at critical stages in their journey.
pokemon_item_evolution_consultation.shippingDetail: Expressed courier service ensures the consultation arrives fresh and ready for immediate use upon arrival.

usage.activation: A standard action to initiate the session. The effects last until the end of your next battle or until the Pokémon's happiness is reduced below its new value, whichever comes first.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation with ongoing benefits
usage.endsWhen: The end of the next battle or when the Pokémon's happiness falls below 50 points

pokemon_item_evolution_consultation.priceReason: This service is priced to reflect its rare and valuable nature, offering significant strategic advantages in your Pokémon’s development.

pokemon_item_lucky_charm_pokeball.name: Lucky Charm Pokéball – Shiny Edition
pokemon_item_lucky_charm_pokeball.description: The Lucky Charm Pokéball – Shiny Edition gleams with a soft, electric light, its surface etched with intricate patterns that seem to hum with unseen energy. This blessed Pokéball not only enhances your chances of capturing elusive Pokémon but also bestows upon you a touch of good fortune in your adventures. Caution: those who gaze too long may find themselves wishing for the wrong things. Perfect for trainers seeking a little extra luck, this is no ordinary way to catch them all!

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Capture
effectDetails.rules: When you attempt to capture a Pokémon with this Pokéball, there’s a +10% chance of achieving a critical capture. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fortune's Favor
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can use an action to invoke good fortune. For the duration of one combat encounter, any ally within 30 feet has advantage on saving throws and ability checks. This effect is exhausted after its duration ends.

pokemon_item_lucky_charm_pokeball.levelRequirementReason: This Pokéball requires no level as it provides a general boon to fortune without being overly powerful for beginner trainers.
pokemon_item_lucky_charm_pokeball.vendorReason: The Safari Shop specializes in items that can assist in capturing and training Pokémon, making this Pokéball an ideal addition to their offerings.
pokemon_item_lucky_charm_pokeball.shippingDetail: Ships via Poke Parcel, delivered directly by a friendly Eevee with same-day delivery for in-stock items.

usage.activation: Action (for Enhanced Capture) or Action/Reaction (for Fortune's Favor)
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn (Enhanced Capture), and once per long rest (Fortune's Favor)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires, or if you use another Pokéball during the same encounter.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges; the Pokéball can be used repeatedly until it captures a Pokémon.

pokemon_item_lucky_charm_pokeball.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's unique combination of utility and rarity, offering trainers an excellent value for their investment.

doughnut_hole_legendary_singularity_ston.name: The Heart of the Void
doughnut_hole_legendary_singularity_ston.description: The Heart of the Void, a crystalline relic formed from the very center of The Doughnut Hole, exudes an eerie, void-like energy that warps space-time around it. Its touch can briefly alter gravity, pulling objects toward its core with devastating force. Legends warn of those who have been drawn too close, their fate lost within the miniature black holes it occasionally conjures. Handle this relic with extreme caution; a single use can tear apart reality itself.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Warp
effectDetails.rules: When activated, The Heart of the Void warps space-time within a 10-foot radius. This effect pulls all objects and creatures toward its center with an intensity that can lift or drop them up to 20 feet in one turn. Targets must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into the void, taking 4d6 force damage. The effect lasts for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Miniature Black Hole
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, The Heart of the Void has a 20% chance to create a miniature black hole that consumes all objects and creatures within a 30-foot radius. Targets must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be drawn into the singularity, taking 6d8 force damage and being restrained until freed by an effect such as a greater dispel magic.

doughnut_hole_legendary_singularity_ston.levelRequirementReason: The Heart of the Void's raw power requires mastery over gravity and space-time manipulation.
doughnut_hole_legendary_singularity_ston.vendorReason: Void Vendor, having access to exotic and dangerous items, regularly stocks this relic from The Doughnut Hole.
doughnut_hole_legendary_singularity_ston.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Cosmic Sky Container, a vessel that ensures safe transport of volatile cosmic artifacts like The Heart of the Void.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; see effect details for duration and range
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used or interrupted by an opposing force, such as a dispel magic spell.

doughnut_hole_legendary_singularity_ston.priceReason: The Heart of the Void's rarity and potential for catastrophic misuse justify its price in rare XP.

grand_country_stone_of_echoes.name: Resonant Shale
grand_country_stone_of_echoes.description: The Resonant Shale, a peculiarly shaped stone that hums with ancient whispers when held near any surface, reveals brief echoes of forgotten times. These faint, distorted sounds can unlock hidden secrets within walls or distract foes for mere seconds, making it invaluable for explorers and treasure hunters alike. Crafted from the heart of long-forgotten earth by a reclusive artisan known only as Echo, this stone is both a tool and a relic.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Past
effectDetails.rules: When you hold Resonant Shale near any wall or surface, there is a 50% chance that it reveals hidden clues and secrets. This effect lasts for 1 round.

effectDetails.title: Distraction
effectDetails.rules: Activating the stone emits a distracting sound effect, causing each creature within 10 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12) or become distracted for 1 minute. The distraction ends if the creature takes any action.

grand_country_stone_of_echoes.levelRequirementReason: The Resonant Shale is accessible to all adventurers, as its simple activation makes it a useful tool for beginners and seasoned explorers alike.
grand_country_stone_of_echoes.vendorReason: Layer Market prides itself on offering unique curiosities that can assist in various adventuring endeavors, making the Resonant Shale an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_stone_of_echoes.shippingDetail: Ships via Courier Falcon within 3 days of purchase. A delivery confirmation is provided with each order.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Echoes), 1 minute (Distraction)
usage.endsWhen: The distraction ends if the creature takes any action, or when Resonant Shale runs out of charges.

grand_country_stone_of_echoes.priceReason: The Resonant Shale is priced at 1000 XP for its unique combination of revealing hidden secrets and creating a useful distraction, making it an excellent value for any adventurer.

grand_country_order_of_the_shepherd.name: Fragment of the Shepherd's Vigil
grand_country_order_of_the_shepherd.description: A Fragment of the Shepherd's Vigil is a small, intricately carved piece of obsidian, depicting a watchful shepherd gazing out over craggy peaks. Crafted in the sacred forges of the Mountain Clan, this relic bears the weight of countless generations' prayers and protection. When you hold it high upon reaching high ground, you feel the ancient spirits watching over you, bolstering your resilience against the elements and granting a fleeting shield against fall damage.

effectDetails.title: High Ground Vigilance
effectDetails.rules: When you reach high ground, roll a d20. On an even result, gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1). This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resilient Fall Shield
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Fragment high, you have resistance to fall damage. Additionally, if you would take fall damage while holding it, reduce that damage by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1). This effect persists until you stop holding the fragment.

grand_country_order_of_the_shepherd.levelRequirementReason: To wield this relic effectively, one must be sufficiently experienced and attuned to the Mountain Clan's traditions.
grand_country_order_of_the_shepherd.vendorReason: Side sellers often carry unique relics from various clans, including this sacred fragment of the Shepherds' vigilance.
grand_country_order_of_the_shepherd.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by trusted Winged Messengers, ensuring the relic arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect when reaching high ground; activation on use for fall damage reduction.
usage.duration: Until you no longer hold it high or until a short or long rest is completed.
usage.endsWhen: You stop holding the fragment while at high ground, or after one use per day.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only once per short/long rest.

grand_country_order_of_the_shepherd.priceReason: The relic's rarity and spiritual significance ensure it remains a valuable, albeit not overpowered, addition to any adventurer’s gear.

doughnut_hole_center_echo.name: Echo of the Center
doughnut_hole_center_echo.description: The Echo of the Center is a small, pulsating orb that hums with a faint resonance. When touched, it grants brief glimpses into possible futures—most often involving delectable pastries and existential dread. The visions are cryptic, leaving you pondering the fate of your next doughnut while your sanity subtly wanes. Do not stare too long; legend has it that those who gaze upon its light for too long may find themselves inexorably drawn into the void.

effectDetails.title: Prophecy
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this item grants a random prophecy related to pastries or existential themes. The effect is instantaneous and provides advantage on Insight checks for the next hour.

effectDetails.title: Sanity Reduction
effectDetails.rules: Touching the Echo of the Center reduces your Wisdom (Insight) save DC by 2 until you rest. This effect lasts for a day.

doughnut_hole_center_echo.levelRequirementReason: The Echo of the Center requires no specific level, as its effects are subtle but intriguing.
doughnut_hole_center_echo.vendorReason: Center Seller is renowned for their eclectic collection of curiosities and magical trinkets that pique the curiosity of all who visit.
doughnut_hole_center_echo.shippingDetail: The Echo of the Center arrives with a time-stamped delivery, ensuring it has not been tampered with by the fluxes of time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Resting or after one day if used daily

doughnut_hole_center_echo.priceReason: The Echo of the Center is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare and intriguing nature.

midlands_item_shadows_whisper.name: Shadows' Whisper Amulet
midlands_item_shadows_whisper.description: The Shadows' Whisper Amulet is a dark obsidian pendant that hums with an unsettling energy. Crafted from solidified shadows harvested during a particularly harrowing night, it whispers secrets in dim light and darkness. Wearers gain advantage on Stealth checks, blending into the shadows undetected. If a weaker enemy comes too close, they may be struck by a fleeting terror, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened for 1 minute.
effects: Advantage on Stealth in dim light/darkness

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth in Dim Light/Darkness
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on all Stealth checks when within dim light or darkness. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Frighten Nearby Enemies
effectDetails.rules: When a weaker enemy comes into contact with the amulet's wearer, they must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14). On failure, they become Frightened for up to 1 minute. This effect can be used once per long rest.

midlands_item_shadows_whisper.levelRequirementReason: The amulet requires significant magical energy that only those of a certain level can harness.
midlands_item_shadows_whisper.vendorReason: Fractured Forge specializes in crafting items that enhance stealth and shadow magic, making this amulet an excellent addition to their inventory.
midlands_item_shadows_whisper.shippingDetail: Expressed with haste, the amulet arrives swiftly to eager adventurers.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until interrupted or ends when removed
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is no longer in dim light/darkness, or when it's removed

midlands_item_shadows_whisper.priceReason: Crafted from rare shadow materials and requiring significant magical energy to bind the whispering essence.

the_edge_voidstone_shards.name: Voidstone Shard Fragments
the_edge_voidstone_shards.description: The jagged Voidstone Shard Fragments pulse with an eerie, otherworldly glow that seems to shift between dimensions. When combined, they channel a dark power capable of revealing glimpses into alternate realities or causing disorienting headaches. These shards are the spoils of battles fought in the Abyss, and their origins are shrouded in mystery. Wario would indeed pay a small fortune for them, not just for exploding dice, but to harness their chaotic energies.

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption
effectDetails.rules: When you take damage, the shards absorb 10% of it. This effect has a cooldown of one minute.

effectDetails.title: Critical Hit Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to your attack rolls and have a 5% chance to score a critical hit on a natural 19 or 20, but this effect can only activate once every short rest.

the_edge_voidstone_shards.levelRequirementReason: The shards' chaotic nature demands a certain level of mental fortitude and combat experience.
the_edge_voidstone_shards.vendorReason: The abyss trader has exclusive access to these rare relics from the depths of the Abyss.
the_edge_voidstone_shards.shippingDetail: Ships through a rift that can delay delivery by up to one week due to unpredictable travel times between dimensions.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when combined and worn together as an item.
usage.duration: Until the next long rest or until destroyed in battle.
usage.endsWhen: If you remove them, they deactivate immediately. They are destroyed if exposed to light equal to or greater than sunlight for more than 5 minutes.

the_edge_voidstone_shards.priceReason: The shards' rarity and the risk involved in obtaining them justify this balanced price.

doughnut_hole_singularity_orb.name: Echoes of the Center
doughnut_hole_singularity_orb.description: The Echoes of the Center is a shimmering, pulsating orb that hums with an eerie, resonant energy. When held close to the ear, it emits faint whispers from the void's center, possibly containing ancient secrets or just a cacophony of static. Its surface seems woven from shadow and light, shifting colors like a mirage. This relic attracts negative energies from nearby planes, making it both a treasure and a potential source of dread.

effectDetails.title: Void Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Echoes of the Center emits a pulse that lasts for up to one minute. Any creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of their next turn due to the overwhelming void resonance.

effectDetails.title: Negative Energy Attraction
effectDetails.rules: The orb attracts negative energy from nearby planes, creating a 30-foot radius area centered on the wielder. Any creature entering this area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (1d10) necrotic damage and be charmed by the relic for 1 hour.

doughnut_hole_singularity_orb.levelRequirementReason: The Echoes of the Center is accessible to lower-level characters as it provides a unique experience without overwhelming them.
doughnut_hole_singularity_orb.vendorReason: Center Seller specializes in relics and curiosities from other dimensions, making this orb an expected addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_singularity_orb.shippingDetail: The Echoes of the Center is shipped via Temporal Package, ensuring it arrives at its destination with minimal delay.

usage.duration: Up to one minute per day.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the wielder drops the orb.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once per short rest.

doughnut_hole_singularity_orb.priceReason: The Echoes of the Center is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique and potentially dangerous effects, as well as the limited nature of the vendor's stock.

middle_earth_shire_loyalty_ring.name: The Humble Ring of Gratitude
middle_earth_shire_loyalty_ring.description: The Humble Ring of Gratitude is a simple silver ring, unadorned and worn by many in the Shire. Forged in the heart of Hobbiton, it whispers tales of gratitude and hospitality. This subtle charm subtly enhances your social interactions, making you more persuasive when seeking sustenance or favors from local merchants. It grants a +1 bonus to Charisma checks related to persuasion and food, ensuring that every request for extra sausages is met with a generous smile.
effects: Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks when asking for extra food

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Persuasiveness
effectDetails.rules: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check related to obtaining food or drink, you have advantage. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: You gain +1 to all Charisma checks for 8 hours after wearing this ring. You can benefit from this effect only once per day.

middle_earth_shire_loyalty_ring.levelRequirementReason: The Humble Ring of Gratitude's charm and simplicity make it accessible to even the most humble Hobbit.
middle_earth_shire_loyalty_ring.vendorReason: As a local favorite, Shire Shop stocks this ring for its customers' convenience.
middle_earth_shire_loyalty_ring.shippingDetail: Delivered promptly by the trusted Rolling Delivery Cart.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activated upon donning the ring.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next long rest or when you remove the ring.
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of each short rest, removed from your hand, or when you take other action that requires concentration.

middle_earth_shire_loyalty_ring.priceReason: The Humble Ring of Gratitude is priced moderately to reflect its utility and the craftsmanship required for Shire standards.

middle_earth_mithril_shard_of_echoes.name: Whispers of Khazad-dûm
middle_earth_mithril_shard_of_echoes.description: The Whispers of Khazad-dûm is a shimmering shard of Mithril, etched with runes from an ancient kingdom. When held, it hums with residual magic, allowing you to hear echoes of conversations and events that transpired within Moria's depths. This power can be both enlightening and disquieting; some whispers are unsettlingly clear. The shard is said to attract spectral entities, but those who have used it claim it aids in uncovering lost treasures.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Past
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, allowing you to hear whispers from within a 30-foot radius for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per day. On a failed Wisdom saving throw (DC 14), you are shaken until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Attraction
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, this item attracts spectral entities within 30 feet for 1 minute. Any creature that ends its movement there must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of your next turn.

middle_earth_mithril_shard_of_echoes.levelRequirementReason: The shard's residual magic is potent, but not overwhelming; even novice adventurers can harness it.
middle_earth_mithril_shard_of_echoes.vendorReason: Elves have long maintained a connection to ancient relics and lore from Khazad-dûm.
middle_earth_mithril_shard_of_echoes.shippingDetail: Ships via a courier capable of navigating through ethereal planes, ensuring swift delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use an action to dismiss it or until the duration expires.

middle_earth_mithril_shard_of_echoes.priceReason: Balanced at a price that reflects the shard's rarity and its limited daily usage.

earth_land_gourmet_potion.name: Wario's Delightful Digestive Brew
earth_land_gourmet_potion.description: Wario's Delightful Digestive Brew is a murky, earthy concoction that smells of Wario’s rejected snacks and tastes like it should be illegal. This premium potion instantly restores 50 hit points to one creature and cures minor ailments, leaving the imbiber with a lingering craving for more exotic flavors. The brew is said to have been crafted from rare earth herbs harvested by the elusive Herbivore Guild, whose methods are as mysterious as their location.

effectDetails.title: Restore Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this potion restores 50 hit points to the drinker. The effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Cure Minor Ailments
effectDetails.rules: The potion cures minor ailments such as poison or disease affecting the drinker. This effect has no save DC, but it can only be used once per day.

earth_land_gourmet_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is potent enough to restore significant hit points and treat minor ailments, making it accessible for lower-level characters.
earth_land_gourmet_potion.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster deals in rare and exotic items, including this unique elixir.
earth_land_gourmet_potion.shippingDetail: Shipped via the reliable Cart on Wheels, known for delivering even the most peculiar goods safely to their destination.

usage.duration: Single-use; effects are immediate and last until the potion is consumed
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the drinker consumes the potion
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per day

earth_land_gourmet_potion.priceReason: The rarity of earth herbs and the secret recipe contribute to its high price, making it an uncommon but accessible potion for adventurers.

earth_land_dragonscale_scroll.name: The Whispers of Ignis
earth_land_dragonscale_scroll.description: The Whispers of Ignis is an ancient scroll adorned with scales from a dormant fire dragon. Its cryptic runes shimmer with residual heat, hinting at forgotten magics. This fragment grants the user the power to summon a minor fire elemental, capable of wreaking havoc in combat but requiring careful handling. The dragon's scales imbue it with resilience, granting temporary resistance against lightning damage and increasing fire-based attacks by 5%. Use this scroll wisely; its rage can be both a boon and a bane.

effectDetails.title: Summon Minor Fire Elemental
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may summon a minor fire elemental with a level 4 CR. This creature lasts for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 hit points. It has immunity to poison and poison damage but is vulnerable to water-based attacks.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Lightning
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary resistance to lightning damage equal to your level +4. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until you take a long rest.

earth_land_dragonscale_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll requires a level 8 character due to its potent summoning and elemental manipulation.
earth_land_dragonscale_scroll.vendorReason: The earth emporium specializes in ancient artifacts that can harness the raw power of nature, including fire dragon fragments like this scroll.
earth_land_dragonscale_scroll.shippingDetail: Shipped by a giant worm courier known for its speed and reliability, ensuring swift delivery to your door.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: the elemental drops to 0 hit points or is dismissed

earth_land_dragonscale_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's rarity and the potent effects it provides justify its price, offering both a unique summoning ability and resistance to lightning damage.

animatopia_howler_bone.name: Echoing Howler Bone
animatopia_howler_bone.description: The Echoing Howler Bone is a meticulously carved relic from the fearsome Howler Beast, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer faintly in the light. Held to your ear, it releases a primal roar capable of stunning foes within reach or sending smaller creatures fleeing in terror. The bone's power comes directly from the beast’s essence, making it a dangerous yet invaluable tool for those who dare to wield it.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Roar
effectDetails.rules: When you use the Echoing Howler Bone, you can make a roar that stuns all creatures within 10 feet for 1 round. Creatures must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fear Aura
effectDetails.rules: The bone releases an aura that causes small creatures (CR 4 or lower) within 30 feet to become frightened. The effect lasts for 1 minute, and a creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

animatopia_howler_bone.levelRequirementReason: This relic is powerful enough that even low-level adventurers can use it effectively in combat.
animatopia_howler_bone.vendorReason: The forest market stocks rare and unique items, often found only deep within the wilds where creatures like the Howler Beast reside.
animatopia_howler_bone.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a fleet of winged squirrels, ensuring the bone arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Stun effect), 1 minute (Fear Aura)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use your action on another creature or when a creature saves successfully against it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use of the Stun effect per short rest.

animatopia_howler_bone.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP as its powerful effects and rarity justify this cost in a balanced campaign.

animatopia_beast_bazaar_voucher.name: Beast Bazaar Trade Voucher
animatopia_beast_bazaar_voucher.description: The Beast Bazaar Trade Voucher is a sleek, metallic token engraved with intricate patterns of bestial motifs. It grants access to the secretive Beast Bazaar, where merchants peddle rare and exotic goods. With this voucher, you can haggle for potent potions, magical trinkets, or even unusual creatures that could prove invaluable in your adventures. Wario himself would covet such a voucher, as it opens doors to unparalleled treasures within the bazaar's walls.

effectDetails.title: Access to Beast Bazaar
effectDetails.rules: This voucher grants one-time access to the exclusive Beast Bazaar, allowing you to trade for rare items and creatures. You can use it once per month.

effectDetails.title: Faction Reputation Bonus
effectDetails.rules: Upon presenting this voucher at the bazaar, your faction's reputation improves by 1 point with the Beastkeepers, which grants a +1 bonus on all Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence them. This benefit lasts for one month.

animatopia_beast_bazaar_voucher.levelRequirementReason: This voucher is suitable for adventurers of all levels who wish to explore the bazaar's mysteries.
animatopia_beast_bazaar_voucher.vendorReason: The Beastkeepers, guardians of the bazaar, issue this voucher as a token of their trust and to ensure only reputable adventurers gain access.
animatopia_beast_bazaar_voucher.shippingDetail: Shipped via swift delivery hawk, ensuring safe arrival within three days.

usage.activation: Activates when presented at the Beast Bazaar.
usage.duration: One-time use per month.
usage.endsWhen: Used or expires one month after issuance.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once a month.

animatopia_beast_bazaar_voucher.priceReason: The voucher's rarity and the unique access it provides to the bazaar justify its value at 1000 XP.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_donut.name: Gravitic Donut
doughnut_hole_gravitic_donut.description: The Gravitic Donut is a doughnut of bewildering design, crafted from an unknown blend of dark and light flour. Its surface crackles with an otherworldly energy, and it whispers tales of forgotten realms where such delicacies rule the skies. This treat can pull objects towards its center, creating a localized gravitational field that bends reality itself for brief moments. Use it to trap foes within your culinary spell or to retrieve lost items from unreachable heights at the cost of your own stability—imbibe with caution lest you become its victim.

effectDetails.title: Minor Gravitational Pull
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Gravitic Donut creates a localized gravitational field with a radius of 3 meters around its center. Within this area, objects and creatures weighing less than 50 pounds are pulled towards the donut at the rate of 1 foot per round. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the donut is consumed by another creature.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Dexterity Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the next two rounds, the consumer gains a +2 bonus to Dexterity checks and saving throws. This boost can be used once per short rest and does not stack with other similar effects.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_donut.levelRequirementReason: The Gravitic Donut's whimsical but potent effect requires no minimum level, as it is a delightful yet unpredictable treat.
doughnut_hole_gravitic_donut.vendorReason: As a quirky and eclectic vendor known for its eccentric wares, Center Seller is the perfect place to find such an outlandish pastry.
doughnut_hole_gravitic_donut.shippingDetail: The donut is delivered by a fleet of drones capable of traversing dimensions, ensuring swift arrival at your doorstep.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until consumed by another creature.
usage.endsWhen: Consumed or the duration ends naturally.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_donut.priceReason: The Gravitic Donut's unique properties and limited availability justify its higher price in the market.

doughnut_hole_void_fragment_artifact.name: Void Fragment Artifact
doughnut_hole_void_fragment_artifact.description: The Void Fragment Artifact is a cold, pulsating shard of solidified void energy that hums with forgotten knowledge. Its surface glows faintly with an eerie blue light, whispering fragments of impossible geometries and unsettling truths to those who hold it. The fragment's touch can induce existential dread in the unwary or evoke an irresistible craving for jelly donuts, a strange quirk that has puzzled even the most seasoned scholars.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Intellect
effectDetails.rules: When this artifact is held, the wielder gains a +3 bonus to Intelligence checks and saving throws. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Terror Infliction
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, the wielder can use an action to attempt to terrify a creature within 10 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for up to one minute. The effect ends early if the target takes any damage.

doughnut_hole_void_fragment_artifact.levelRequirementReason: This artifact is designed to be accessible, even to the smallest adventurers who have shown promise.
doughnut_hole_void_fragment_artifact.vendorReason: The Void Vendor specializes in rare and otherworldly artifacts, making it a natural fit for this fragment of void energy.
doughnut_hole_void_fragment_artifact.shippingDetail: Carefully packed with arcane wards to preserve its integrity during transit, delivery is swift but requires a special courier.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the target takes any damage or at the end of your next long rest.

doughnut_hole_void_fragment_artifact.priceReason: The Void Fragment Artifact is priced moderately to reflect its rare and powerful nature, accessible to adventurers who are not yet of high level.

middle_earth_item_whispering_stone.name: Whispering Stone of Rivendell
middle_earth_item_whispering_stone.description: The Whispering Stone of Rivendell is a smooth, grey stone that seems to hum with ancient Elven melodies. Crafted in the shadowed halls of Rivendell by Celebrimbor's hand, it whispers cryptic warnings about impending dangers—often goblin raids and lost gear. Its surface glows faintly under moonlight, hinting at its eldritch origins. It's surprisingly adept for bartering, offering a brief window into the language of birds, allowing you to understand their urgent calls and messages.

effectDetails.title: Minor Insight
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can gain insight on one ability check. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Understand Birds
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after touching the stone, you understand and can speak the language of birds within 30 feet. This effect ends early if you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell).

middle_earth_item_whispering_stone.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic understanding of elven lore to grasp its whispering power.
middle_earth_item_whispering_stone.vendorReason: Elven traders at the market are accustomed to selling items with ancient ties and unique abilities.
middle_earth_item_whispering_stone.shippingDetail: Ships via a swift elven messenger, ensuring quick delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (to gain insight) or touch (to understand birds)
usage.duration: Instantaneous (insight), 1 minute (understand birds)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect's duration expires or concentration is lost
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you have the stone in your possession

middle_earth_item_whispering_stone.priceReason: Balanced against other rare curiosities that offer similar insights and utility.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_battleaxe.name: Stonebreaker's Fury
middle_earth_item_dwarven_battleaxe.description: Hewn from the very heart of Khazad-dûm's obsidian mines, Stonebreaker's Fury is a dwarven battleaxe forged with unyielding grit and resilience. Its obsidian head is reinforced with dwarven steel, capable of cleaving through even the toughest orcish armor when wielded by a strong hand. This axe isn't just for show; it whispers tales of battles fought deep underground, where only the most hardened warriors dare to face their foes.

effectDetails.title: Stagger on Critical
effectDetails.rules: When you score a critical hit with this weapon against an enemy wearing orcish armor, that enemy must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. This effect can only occur once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Bonus Damage vs. Orcish Armor
effectDetails.rules: When you attack an enemy wearing orcish armor with this weapon, you deal an additional 2d6 damage to the target. This bonus is cumulative but does not stack with other bonuses from similar effects.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_battleaxe.levelRequirementReason: Wielding such a powerful axe requires both strength and experience; only those of proven valor should attempt to use it.
middle_earth_item_dwarven_battleaxe.vendorReason: Only the finest forges in Khazad-dûm can craft an axe that matches Stonebreaker's Fury’s legendary reputation.
middle_earth_item_dwarven_battleaxe.shippingDetail: The quake cart delivers your purchase with a thunderous rumble, ensuring it arrives in one piece despite the bumpy journey through Middle-earth.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted when you run out of ammunition or use all charges; recharges after a long rest.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_battleaxe.priceReason: The price reflects the rare materials and master craftsmanship required to forge such an axe.

middle_earth_item_shire_sweetroll_of_pow.name: The Everlasting Sweetroll
middle_earth_item_shire_sweetroll_of_pow.description: The Everlasting Sweetroll is a golden-brown confection baked daily by Mrs. Miggins in the Shire’s cozy bakery. Its flaky crust and sweet filling are an amalgamation of ancient elven recipes and hobbit culinary artistry, making it not just delicious but imbued with the protective magic of the Shire's ancient trees. This roll grants a quick burst of vitality, bolstering one’s resistance to poison and dark magic alike.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Poison
effectDetails.rules: When you consume the Everlasting Sweetroll, you gain temporary resistance to poison damage for 1 hour. This effect cannot be applied more than once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Ward Against Dark Magic
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes after eating the roll, you are immune to the harmful effects of dark magic within 30 feet. You can use this ability only once per long rest.

middle_earth_item_shire_sweetroll_of_pow.levelRequirementReason: This sweetroll is crafted for all adventurers who might find themselves in need of a quick boost, regardless of their experience level.
middle_earth_item_shire_sweetroll_of_pow.vendorReason: Mrs. Miggins' bakery is renowned for its delicious and magically-infused pastries across the Shire.
middle_earth_item_shire_sweetroll_of_pow.shippingDetail: The Everlasting Sweetroll is carefully packed to ensure it arrives at just the right temperature, delivered swiftly by the Pony Express.

usage.duration: Resistance to poison lasts for 1 hour; Ward Against Dark Magic lasts for 10 minutes
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each short rest and long rest respectively
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the roll can be consumed multiple times

middle_earth_item_shire_sweetroll_of_pow.priceReason: The Everlasting Sweetroll's price reflects its unique combination of culinary and magical craftsmanship, a delicacy that is both delicious and protective.

equestria_item_starry_dust_massage.name: Starry Dust Massage Therapy
equestria_item_starry_dust_massage.description: The Starry Dust Massage Therapy is a luxurious service that harnesses the ethereal glow of collected stardust to heal and rejuvenate. This celestial treatment instantly soothes weary muscles, accelerates recovery from wounds, and leaves one feeling as light as a feather. Only the finest stardust from Equestria's night skies can produce such magic, making this therapy both rare and invaluable for any pony in need of rest and repair.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Healing
effectDetails.rules: The user gains 50 hit points upon activation. If the user is at full health, they are instead cured of one level of exhaustion.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: For the next two turns, the user's movement speed increases by +10 feet. This effect does not stack with other sources of increased movement speed.

equestria_item_starry_dust_massage.levelRequirementReason: This therapy is accessible to all ponies who can afford its price, making it a valuable service for any Equestrian, regardless of their level.
equestria_item_starry_dust_massage.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce specializes in high-end services and therapies, ensuring that only the most effective and luxurious treatments are offered to patrons.
equestria_item_starry_dust_massage.shippingDetail: The Starry Dust Massage Therapy is delivered within a day of purchase via the Royal Pony Express, ensuring that customers receive their therapy immediately upon payment.

usage.activation: Instantaneous effect when purchased and used.
usage.duration: Duration ends after two turns or until the user's exhaustion level is reduced to zero.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends either at the end of two turns or if the user regains full health, whichever comes first.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; each purchase grants one use.

equestria_item_starry_dust_massage.priceReason: The price is balanced to reflect the rarity and effectiveness of the stardust used in this therapy, ensuring it remains a valuable yet accessible service for all ponies.

equestria_item_elemental_resonance_amule.name: Elemental Resonance Amulet
equestria_item_elemental_resonance_amule.description: The Elemental Resonance Amulet, crafted by ancient pony artisans in harmony with Equestria’s elements, channels raw elemental power at your command. When attuned to Fire, it ignites a blazing fury, granting +10 damage on fire attacks and resistance to cold. As the Earth variant fortifies you against physical harm, it increases defense by 5 points, while the Water element grants an additional 2 swim speed and resilience against frost. Lastly, the Air element boosts your agility and evasion, making you a whirlwind of motion in battle.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Amplification
effectDetails.rules: By attuning the amulet to one element, you gain a +10 bonus on fire damage rolls. This effect is active for an hour after activation and requires no action or concentration.

effectDetails.title: Resilient Fortitude
effectDetails.rules: When attuned to Earth, this amulet increases your AC by 5 until the start of your next turn. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

equestria_item_elemental_resonance_amule.levelRequirementReason: The amulet requires a high level to harness the raw elemental power safely.
equestria_item_elemental_resonance_amule.vendorReason: Crystal Empire is renowned for its mastery of earth and stone, making it the perfect vendor for this enchanted artifact.
equestria_item_elemental_resonance_amule.shippingDetail: Shipped via the trusted Magical Pony Express, ensuring safe delivery with a special courier.

usage.activation: Action to attune the amulet to one element.
usage.duration: 1 hour per activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop concentrating or at the start of your next turn after disattuning it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only 3 uses per long rest.

equestria_item_elemental_resonance_amule.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and powerful effects justify its high price in the market.

teyvat_item_forbidden_chronometer.name: The Clockwork Heart of Azathoth
teyvat_item_forbidden_chronometer.description: The Clockwork Heart of Azathoth is a twisted contraption made from gears spun from the very fabric of time itself. Crafted in the shadowy forges of the forgotten realm, it pulses with an eerie light that warps reality around you. Use this device to manipulate the flow of time, but be warned: its chaotic energy can summon ghostly duplicates or erase enemy actions entirely. Tread carefully—prolonged exposure risks unraveling your very perception of existence.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Warping
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this device randomly accelerates or decelerates the flow of time for you and nearby enemies. This effect lasts for 1 round. Enemies within a 30-foot radius have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while it is active. Saving throw DC 15.

effectDetails.title: Ghostly Duplication
effectDetails.rules: There's a 20% chance (roll a d5) that when activated, the device creates ghostly duplicates of you within a 30-foot radius for 1 minute. These duplicates mimic your actions and can be targeted by spells or attacks. After the duration ends, they fade away with no ill effects.

teyvat_item_forbidden_chronometer.levelRequirementReason: This device requires a basic understanding of time manipulation to wield its chaotic power.
teyvat_item_forbidden_chronometer.vendorReason: The shadow brokers deal in forbidden knowledge, and this artifact is no exception.
teyvat_item_forbidden_chronometer.shippingDetail: Ships through the dimensional rift with a 5-day delivery time, subject to potential delays due to cosmic interference.

usage.duration: 1 round or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: Used up all charges (recharges after a long rest)

teyvat_item_forbidden_chronometer.priceReason: Balanced at half the original price to reflect its reduced power and thematic balance.

teyvat_item_monstadt_wind_charm.name: Aetherial Zephyr Token
teyvat_item_monstadt_wind_charm.description: Crafted by the finest wind mages of Mondstadt, this Aetherial Zephyr Token is a delicate charm that whispers the essence of freedom and swiftness. Its core, forged from the heartwood of ancient wind-touched trees, hums with the promise of swift movement. When activated, it grants a minor boost to your speed, making you nimbler in battle. Its air currents can also be manipulated for tactical advantage, allowing you to dodge attacks or launch projectiles with greater precision and force.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases your movement speed by 10% for 1 minute, ending early if you take any damage.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Shield
effectDetails.rules: When you successfully dodge an attack, there is a 25% chance to grant you temporary hit points equal to half your level (rounded down). This effect can only occur once per short or long rest.

teyvat_item_monstadt_wind_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm requires no minimum level as it is a consumable that enhances mobility and tactical advantage.
teyvat_item_monstadt_wind_charm.vendorReason: Mondstadt's market is known for its wide array of magical items, including this charming piece.
teyvat_item_monstadt_wind_charm.shippingDetail: Ships swiftly via the Winged Courier service within a day.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and use.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: You take any damage or at the end of your next turn after activation.

teyvat_item_monstadt_wind_charm.priceReason: The Aetherial Zephyr Token is priced high due to its unique combination of speed and tactical advantage, making it a valuable tool for any adventurer.

chaos_scroll_of_unmaking.name: Scroll of Unmaking - Entropy's Whisper
chaos_scroll_of_unmaking.description: The Scroll of Unmaking - Entropy's Whisper is a spectral scroll etched with runes that shimmer like fractured glass. When unrolled, it exudes a cold, chaotic energy that makes the air around you ripple and distorts reality for an instant. Those nearby feel their perceptions bend, leading to moments of disorientation. Perfect for those who revel in chaos, it's said this scroll can unravel even the most steadfast foes… or create opportunities for those with a penchant for mayhem.

effectDetails.title: Reality Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this scroll briefly unravels the fabric of reality within a 10-foot radius. Non-boss enemies in range have their AC reduced to 8 until the start of your next turn. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Aura
effectDetails.rules: The scroll emits a chaotic aura that affects all creatures within 5 feet. These creatures must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become disoriented, suffering disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn. This effect can be triggered once per short rest.

chaos_scroll_of_unmaking.levelRequirementReason: This scroll requires significant magical power to wield effectively.
chaos_scroll_of_unmaking.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer specializes in items that manipulate and distort reality, making this scroll a natural fit for their wares.
chaos_scroll_of_unmaking.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Messenger, known for its unpredictable yet reliable service through the chaotic planes.

usage.activation: A bonus action to unroll and activate.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until used up, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: The scroll is destroyed upon activation. Once per long rest, a new scroll can be purchased from the Chaos Dealer at an additional cost.
usage.charges: Unlimited; each use expends one scroll.

chaos_scroll_of_unmaking.priceReason: Balanced against other mythic items that offer substantial effects but require significant magical investment.

faction_imperial_favor.name: Imperial Favor - The Emperor's Grudge
faction_imperial_favor.description: The Imperial Favor - The Emperor's Grudge is a meticulously crafted miniature statue of the deceased emperor, its gold and gemstone exterior shimmering with an age-old patina. This relic exudes a regal aura, compelling those who hold it to believe in their rightful place at the imperial court. It is a symbol of favor from the dead emperor, granting wielders increased influence over loyal subjects and access to exclusive quests. Wario’s trophy is now a tool for true power-seekers willing to play the game.

effectDetails.title: Increased Influence
effectDetails.rules: When you hold the Imperial Favor, you gain advantage on Persuasion checks and have a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) ability checks. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Quest Access
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can present the Imperial Favor to an imperial official to gain access to one exclusive quest or special mission. The quest ends when successfully completed.

faction_imperial_favor.levelRequirementReason: This relic is accessible to all players who wish to navigate the imperial court.
faction_imperial_favor.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory sells items of historical and political significance, and this favor represents a piece of that legacy.
faction_imperial_favor.shippingDetail: Ships via Royal Couriers, arriving within three days.

usage.activation: Passive effect active while holding the item; exclusive quest access once per day.
usage.duration: Until end of next long rest for influence bonus, instantaneous for exclusive quests.
usage.endsWhen: Long rest or completion of exclusive quest

faction_imperial_favor.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its historical significance and utility without overshadowing other items.

earth_land_item_legendary_rune_of_protec.name: The Warden's Echo
earth_land_item_legendary_rune_of_protec.description: The Warden's Echo is a rune crafted from the molten remains of an ancient dragon’s lair, its surface etched with runes that shimmer like the heart of a volcano. This protective charm not only absorbs incoming attacks but also echoes a retaliatory pulse, striking back at foes who dare to press their advantage too hard. The rune's power is formidable yet fragile; overuse can lead to a state of temporary madness, leaving its wielder disoriented and vulnerable for hours.

effectDetails.title: Absorbs Damage
effectDetails.rules: When an attack is made against the wearer, there is a 20% chance that the rune absorbs half of the damage dealt and reflects it back to the attacker. The absorption and reflection occur simultaneously.

effectDetails.title: Retaliatory Pulse
effectDetails.rules: The rune grants the wearer +15 AC while active. If the wearer is reduced to 0 hit points, they are stunned for one round, and the rune absorbs an additional 20 points of damage before expiring.

earth_land_item_legendary_rune_of_protec.levelRequirementReason: The Warden's Echo requires a minimum level of 14 due to its arcane complexity and the raw power needed to wield it effectively.
earth_land_item_legendary_rune_of_protec.vendorReason: The guild quartermaster deals in rare and powerful items, including relics from ancient dragon lairs, making The Warden's Echo a fitting addition.
earth_land_item_legendary_rune_of_protec.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift winged lions, known for their precision and speed across the land.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation upon donning the rune.
usage.duration: Active until depleted or the wearer is reduced to 0 hit points.
usage.endsWhen: The rune expires if the wearer takes damage from a critical hit or the wearer is reduced to 0 hit points.

earth_land_item_legendary_rune_of_protec.priceReason: The Warden's Echo is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the raw dragon essence required for crafting it, balancing its powerful abilities with a fair cost.

equestria_item_princess_celestia_badge.name: Badge of Celestial Guidance
equestria_item_princess_celestia_badge.description: The Badge of Celestial Guidance is a gleaming badge forged from the heart of the sun and blessed by Princess Celestia. Its radiant surface emits a soothing glow, subtly guiding its wearer towards strategic decisions. Wielders report that it not only enhances their ability to discern illusions but also instills a calm demeanor in chaotic situations. Rumor has it that the badge’s essence is imbued with the scent of apple pie, which some say brings clarity and focus.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Detection
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has a +1 bonus to saving throws against illusions. This effect is active as long as the badge is worn and not covered.

effectDetails.title: Strategic Insight
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer can use an action to gain advantage on one Wisdom (Insight) check related to strategy or foresight. The badge's power recharges after a long rest.

equestria_item_princess_celestia_badge.levelRequirementReason: The Badge requires at least level 2 to ensure its effects are balanced and meaningful for the wearer.
equestria_item_princess_celestia_badge.vendorReason: As a symbol of Princess Celestia's favor, this badge is sold exclusively by the Ponyville Market to those who respect her legacy.
equestria_item_princess_celestia_badge.shippingDetail: Ships via the Swift Clouds Courier Service for expedited delivery within three days.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation is not required. Strategic Insight can be used once per short rest as an action.
usage.duration: Passive effects are always active while worn and not covered. Strategic Insight lasts until the end of the wearer's next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The badge stops functioning if it is removed, covered, or destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; recharges after a long rest.

equestria_item_princess_celestia_badge.priceReason: The badge’s rarity and unique abilities justify its price of 1000 XP, ensuring it remains a valuable but not overpowered item for adventurers.

midlands_item_potion_of_regret.name: A Bitter Brew
midlands_item_potion_of_regret.description: This vial of A Bitter Brew exudes a sickly yellow hue and emits an acrid scent reminiscent of rotting parchment. Drinking it forces you to relive your most humiliating moment, causing you to lose focus for the duration. The potion's effects are so potent that they sometimes trigger a debilitating negative status effect like confusion or fear, leaving you vulnerable to attack. Wario would indeed appreciate this peculiar remedy as a means to escape unwanted attention.

effectDetails.title: Embarrassing Flashback
effectDetails.rules: The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is stunned for 1 minute and forced to relive their most embarrassing moment. This effect ends if the target takes any action or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Lost Focus
effectDetails.rules: The target loses focus for one turn, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and disadvantage on Intelligence-based skill checks until the start of their next turn.

midlands_item_potion_of_regret.levelRequirementReason: This potion is suitable for beginners as it requires only a simple action to use.
midlands_item_potion_of_regret.vendorReason: The Empire Exchange deals in rare and exotic potions, making A Bitter Brew an ideal item for their diverse stock.
midlands_item_potion_of_regret.shippingDetail: Ships via the swift courier service of the Flying Drake, ensuring safe delivery within a day.

usage.activation: A simple action to drink the potion
usage.duration: 1 minute for Embarrassing Flashback; lost focus lasts one turn
usage.endsWhen: On a successful Wisdom save or when the duration expires
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only 3 uses per day

midlands_item_potion_of_regret.priceReason: The potion's effectiveness and limited daily usage justify its price of 1000 XP.

pokemon_item_primal_flare.name: Primal Flare Potion
pokemon_item_primal_flare.description: The Primal Flare Potion is a volatile elixir bottled from the raw power of an ancient, raging Charizard. When consumed, it ignites your next melee attack with an inferno of fire, dealing +10 fire damage and leaving behind a faint echo of the dragon's roar. The potion's fiery essence can be felt in its bubbling form, a testament to the primal energy it contains. However, the aftereffect is not without risk; you may find yourself inexplicably drawn to shiny objects for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Grant Fire Damage +10
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, this potion ignites your next melee attack with an inferno, dealing +10 fire damage to the target. The effect lasts for one round and then dissipates.

effectDetails.title: Compulsion to Hoard Shiny Objects
effectDetails.rules: For 60 minutes after consuming the potion, you are compelled to search for shiny objects, such as stones or coins. This compulsion ends when you rest, use a spell, or consume another potion.

pokemon_item_primal_flare.levelRequirementReason: The potion's raw power requires minimal preparation and is accessible to even the most novice trainers.
pokemon_item_primal_flare.vendorReason: Pokemarts are known for offering a wide range of items that are useful in various situations, making this potion an easy addition to their stock.
pokemon_item_primal_flare.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly by the trusty Poké Mail Drone.

usage.activation: Bonus action consumed as a bonus action.
usage.duration: One round (60 seconds) after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if you take damage.

pokemon_item_primal_flare.priceReason: The potion's potent yet manageable effects, combined with its limited stock and unique flavor, justify this fair price in XP.

middle_earth_emberglow_amulet.name: Emberglow Amulet of the Grey Watchers
middle_earth_emberglow_amulet.description: The Emberglow Amulet of the Grey Watchers pulses with a faint, ethereal glow that flickers like the embers of ancient fires. Crafted from the polished bones of long-dead Ents and imbued with Elven magic, it not only grants its wearer increased resistance to cold but also subtly warns them of hidden dangers lurking in their path. The amulet's eerie warmth is said to be a relic of the Grey Watchers' vigilance over the ancient forests.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to cold damage for 1 hour. This effect ends if the wearer takes any fire damage.

effectDetails.title: Detect Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the wearer can cast the Detect Magic spell (save DC 14) without expending a spell slot or material components. This ability is limited to once every 24 hours.

middle_earth_emberglow_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's magic requires a moderate amount of arcane knowledge and discipline, suitable for those with at least three levels of experience.
middle_earth_emberglow_amulet.vendorReason: The elven market is renowned for its trade in ancient and enchanted items, including relics from the Grey Watchers.
middle_earth_emberglow_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped by swift winged ponies, this item arrives within a day of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until the wearer takes fire damage.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer takes fire damage.

middle_earth_emberglow_amulet.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and ancient magic, the price reflects a balance between its enchantment level and rarity.

middle_earth_dwarven_stout_brew.name: Stonebeard’s Stout of Unyielding Courage
middle_earth_dwarven_stout_brew.description: Brewed in the fiery heart of Mount Stonebeard, this stout is a marvel of dwarven craftsmanship. Its deep iron scent and robust body are said to fortify the soul as much as they do the stomach. A single sip grants you a surge of unyielding courage, bolstering your resolve against fear for an hour. Afterward, you find yourself compelled to recount your deeds with a newfound confidence, leaving behind a slight metallic aftertaste that lingers in the air.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Bolstering Bravery
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, you gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened for the next hour. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Compulsion to Share Deeds
effectDetails.rules: For 10 minutes after drinking this stout, you are compelled to share your recent accomplishments with anyone within earshot. If forced into a conversation, you must speak for at least one minute before the effect ends. This compulsion does not require an action.

middle_earth_dwarven_stout_brew.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for adventurers of all levels to bolster their courage in challenging times.
middle_earth_dwarven_stout_brew.vendorReason: The dwarves of Mount Stonebeard are renowned for their robust and enduring stouts, perfect for those who seek unyielding courage before a great challenge.
middle_earth_dwarven_stout_brew.shippingDetail: Delivered by the cunning giant rats that navigate the tunnels beneath the mountain with unmatched skill.

usage.duration: 1 hour (for bravery) and 10 minutes (for compulsion to share deeds)
usage.endsWhen: The effects wear off naturally at their respective durations or if consumed again before the time is up.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

middle_earth_dwarven_stout_brew.priceReason: This item's balanced price reflects its potent and unique effects, providing both immediate bravery and a memorable social quirk to adventurers in need of confidence.

middle_earth_shire_messenger_scroll.name: A Curious Delivery from Bag End
middle_earth_shire_messenger_scroll.description: This exquisitely crafted scroll, delivered by the grumpy yet surprisingly precise courier Pippin of Bag End, contains a single riddle written in ancient Elvish script and a small packet of golden honey from the Shire. The honey is said to be imbued with the essence of the land itself. Solving the riddle grants you access to a hidden cache of long-lost goods, though some say it might lead to more puzzles instead. Each delivery feels like a challenge, as Pippin insists on testing your wits before unsealing the scroll.

effectDetails.title: Riddle of the Shire
effectDetails.rules: Activates when you solve the riddle. You must spend a minute deciphering the script and answering the question correctly. If successful, you gain access to a hidden cache containing goods worth 500 XP. Failure leads to more riddles at the vendor's discretion.

effectDetails.title: Honey of the Land
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, it heals 1d6 + your Wisdom modifier hit points and grants you advantage on one Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw related to nature or geography within an hour. You can only use this effect once per day.

middle_earth_shire_messenger_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is accessible to all adventurers, as it tests their wits rather than their strength.
middle_earth_shire_messenger_scroll.vendorReason: Only the Shire Shop keeps such unique and valuable deliveries from the Hobbits' most trusted couriers.
middle_earth_shire_messenger_scroll.shippingDetail: The scroll is delivered with a small pouch containing the honey, ensuring it arrives fresh and intact.

usage.activation: Activates when you solve the riddle or consume the honey.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for solving the riddle; one hour for the effects of the honey.
usage.endsWhen: The scroll's effects expire upon solving the riddle or consuming the honey.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be used per day.

middle_earth_shire_messenger_scroll.priceReason: The scroll combines unique lore and a physical item of value, making it worth 1000 XP.

the_edge_gravitic_gloop.name: Gravitic Gloop of Unstable Descent
the_edge_gravitic_gloop.description: The Gravitic Gloop of Unstable Descent is a shimmering, viscous mass that dances against gravity's pull, its iridescent sheen hinting at cosmic forces. When hurled with precision, it generates a localized field that either drags enemies into its center or sends them careening across the battlefield in a chaotic whirlwind. This unstable blob can be both a deadly weapon and a source of strange, disorienting sensations—Wario's own experiments have only begun to scratch the surface.

effectDetails.title: Area of Distorted Gravity
effectDetails.rules: When thrown, the Gravitic Gloop creates a 10-foot-radius area centered on its point of impact. Within this area, creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and have their movement speed reduced by half until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that any creature that fails to save against the Area of Distorted Gravity effect will also become disoriented. A disoriented creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of its next turn.

the_edge_gravitic_gloop.levelRequirementReason: This item's unpredictable nature requires a certain level of experience to wield effectively.
the_edge_gravitic_gloop.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in cutting-edge and experimental gear, making it the perfect vendor for this unstable artifact.
the_edge_gravitic_gloop.shippingDetail: Ships via express delivery with a two-day guarantee, ensuring that this volatile item reaches its destination safely and swiftly.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of the creature's next turn if they fail their saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts upon successful save or the start of a new round for disoriented creatures.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but subject to daily limits.

the_edge_gravitic_gloop.priceReason: The Gravitic Gloop's unpredictable nature and experimental design justify its higher price point among uncommon items.

the_edge_chronarium_scroll.name: Chronarium Scroll of Temporal Hiccups
the_edge_chronarium_scroll.description: The Chronarium Scroll of Temporal Hiccups is a brittle parchment adorned with iridescent runes that whisper the secrets of time. When activated, it allows the user to briefly rewind time by three seconds, but the process is unpredictable. There's a 5% chance you'll create a fleeting duplicate of yourself, and your actions during this period may manifest as minor temporal distortions—random temporary changes to one ability score for one round.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Rewind
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can rewind time by three seconds. The effect is instantaneous but may cause a minor temporal distortion, which results in random temporary changes to one of your ability scores for one round.

effectDetails.title: Duplicate Doppelgänger
effectDetails.rules: There's a 5% chance that a duplicate of the user will appear and act independently. The duplicate lasts until the end of the scroll’s effect, and both you and the duplicate can see each other but cannot interact.

the_edge_chronarium_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The scroll's complex temporal mechanics require a certain proficiency in time magic.
the_edge_chronarium_scroll.vendorReason: Final Shop specializes in rare, ancient artifacts and curiosities from the realms of time.
the_edge_chronarium_scroll.shippingDetail: The scroll is delivered via a Temporal Courier who ensures its arrival with minimal temporal disruptions.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasting until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The scroll's effect ends when it is used or destroyed

the_edge_chronarium_scroll.priceReason: Balanced at a price to reflect its rarity and unpredictable nature, ensuring it remains a valuable but not overpowered item.

midlands_item_empire_scroll.name: Decree of Minor Inconvenience
midlands_item_empire_scroll.description: The Decree of Minor Inconvenience is a parchment scroll, its edges worn by time but still potent in the hands of Archduke Theodore's agents. It details an absurdly trivial infraction—a failure to polish one’s boots properly—and when used, it triggers endless rounds of bureaucratic red tape and minor inconveniences for anyone attempting to claim its power. This decree is not just a nuisance; it's a carefully crafted relic that can impose a -2 penalty on social checks and slow enemy movement by 10 feet for 2 rounds (once per short rest).
effects: Slows enemy movement by 10 feet for 2 rounds

effectDetails.title: Social Check Penalty
effectDetails.rules: When used, this scroll imposes a -2 penalty on the next social check made by an opponent. This effect lasts until the end of the next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Movement Slowdown
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, this decree slows all enemies within 10 feet by 10 feet for 2 rounds. The penalty ends when the decree is destroyed or used again.

midlands_item_empire_scroll.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum of 3rd level to wield effectively due to its complex enchantment and the strategic importance it holds.
midlands_item_empire_scroll.vendorReason: The Empire Exchange is trusted by Archduke Theodore's agents, ensuring that only those with proper authorization receive such decrees.
midlands_item_empire_scroll.shippingDetail: Ships via the Imperial Courier Service, ensuring swift delivery within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Requires an action to activate; can be used once per short rest.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with ongoing social check penalty and movement slowdown for 2 rounds.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed or recharged after a short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges, but only one use per short rest.

midlands_item_empire_scroll.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it requires careful handling and strategic deployment in high-stakes situations.

midlands_item_obsidian_charm.name: Whispers of the Shattered King
midlands_item_obsidian_charm.description: The Whispers of the Shattered King is a hand-carved obsidian charm that pulses with an eerie warmth. Crafted by loyalists to the fallen king, it hums softly when held close, its whispers echoing complaints about taxes and paperwork. The charm is said to have been crafted in the heart of the shattered kingdom, where the very air holds secrets. Its unsettling warmth can be felt even from a distance, making it both intriguing and distracting.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Complaints
effectDetails.rules: While holding the charm, you can make a Perception check. On a successful check, you gain advantage on the next saving throw against an illusion within one hour.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Detection
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect illusions. Additionally, there is a 20% chance that any creature attempting to cast an illusion within 30 feet of you will be detected by you as an illusion.

midlands_item_obsidian_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm's subtle effects make it accessible to lower-level characters who can appreciate its intrigue.
midlands_item_obsidian_charm.vendorReason: Master Forgemaster at Fractured Forge appreciates the item's craftsmanship and lore, making it available for those interested in history and mysticism.
midlands_item_obsidian_charm.shippingDetail: The charm is carefully wrapped to ensure it arrives safely; however, delays are common due to the unpredictable nature of dragon flights.

usage.activation: Passive effect when holding the charm.
usage.duration: Instantaneous detection chance; lasts for one hour per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop holding the charm or if it is destroyed.

midlands_item_obsidian_charm.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its unique effects, lore value, and availability.

the_edge_chronarium_bracelet.name: Chronarium Bracelet of Temporal Shifting
the_edge_chronarium_bracelet.description: Forged from solidified chronal energy, this bracelet allows its wearer to manipulate their personal perception of time, accelerating or decelerating it at will. The Chronarium Bracelet of Temporal Shifting can blur reality for a brief moment, making the wielder's movements seem surreal and their reflexes sharper than ever. Misusing its power can lead to unpredictable temporal distortions, causing a sudden craving for pickled onions that persists until the wearer finds a way to realign time.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: The wearer's movement speed increases by 50% for 2 minutes. This effect can be activated as a bonus action, but the bracelet must recharge after each use.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Deceleration
effectDetails.rules: For every round the wearer remains still, they gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls against enemies within 5 feet. The effect lasts until the wearer moves or attacks, with a maximum duration of 1 minute.

the_edge_chronarium_bracelet.levelRequirementReason: The bracelet's power requires a certain mastery of timing to use without causing unintended temporal disruptions.
the_edge_chronarium_bracelet.vendorReason: Final Shop is known for its eclectic collection of esoteric and time-related items, making it the perfect vendor for this Chronarium Bracelet.
the_edge_chronarium_bracelet.shippingDetail: The bracelet must be shipped via Temporal Packet Express to ensure safe and timely delivery through shifting temporal planes.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, duration varies by effect
usage.endsWhen: After each use of the effects, the bracelet requires a short rest to recharge.

the_edge_chronarium_bracelet.priceReason: The Chronarium Bracelet's balanced price reflects its unique temporal abilities and the risk involved in using its power.

the_edge_voidstone_ritual.name: Voidstone Ritual Kit – 'Whispers of Oblivion'
the_edge_voidstone_ritual.description: The Voidstone Ritual Kit – 'Whispers of Oblivion' is a meticulously crafted assemblage of ancient artifacts: a pulsating, obsidian-colored Voidstone embedded with arcane glyphs, and a collection of rare herbs that glow with an eerie purple light. This kit can summon the whispers of the abyss, creating minor echoes of the void to test the wills of those who dare invoke its power. Wario's warning still stands – don't blame us if you find yourself compelled to stare into nothingness for eternity!

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Abyss
effectDetails.rules: This effect allows a willing creature within 30 feet to summon minor echoes of the abyss, creating an area where creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The user gains temporary resistance to psychic damage equal to their proficiency bonus + their Charisma modifier when using this kit. The resistance ends if the user takes any psychic damage or after one hour, whichever comes first.

the_edge_voidstone_ritual.levelRequirementReason: The ritual's complexity and power necessitate a minimum level of spellcasting experience to safely perform.
the_edge_voidstone_ritual.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in ancient artifacts and rituals, providing adventurers with the means to harness otherworldly powers.
