This relic allows you to briefly pause your own actions in combat, granting a moment for strategic thought or desperate evasion. The gears within seem to hum with ancient magic as they turn, and the watch’s hands flicker with a strange, green light when activated. It is said that this device was crafted by a forgotten alchemist who sought to master time itself—though it's rumored that using it too often may warp one's perception of reality.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Pause
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, you can pause your own actions for up to one turn. During this time, you are immune to all attacks and effects from other creatures. This ability can be used once per combat.

effectDetails.title: Increased Reaction Speed
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Reaction) saving throws. This effect is active at all times while you have the Chronometer of Delayed Action equipped.

kivotos_item_chronometer_of_delayed_acti.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience in combat and time manipulation can fully utilize this relic's power.
kivotos_item_chronometer_of_delayed_acti.vendorReason: The Academy Armory specializes in rare, historically-significant armaments and artifacts, making it the perfect vendor for such a unique item.
kivotos_item_chronometer_of_delayed_acti.shippingDetail: This item is shipped via Express Delivery System with priority handling to ensure its arrival remains a surprise until you open it.

usage.duration: Up to one turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the turn concludes or if attacked by another creature.

kivotos_item_chronometer_of_delayed_acti.priceReason: This item represents a rare, historically-significant piece that offers both defensive and tactical advantages but is not overpowered for its price.

equestria_item_elemental_badge_of_discor.name: Badge of Discord - Twilight's Disapproval
equestria_item_elemental_badge_of_discor.description: The Badge of Discord - Twilight's Disapproval is a dark purple, intricately carved amulet that whispers malevolent intent to nearby creatures. Its chilling aura subtly corrupts the emotions of those who wear it or are in its vicinity, fostering petty disputes and arguments among them. The badge grants access to restricted areas where Stygian magic thrives but also increases the likelihood of minor chaos during combat, making it a dangerous tool for those seeking discord rather than peace.

effectDetails.title: Sow Discord
effectDetails.rules: Wearing this badge causes nearby creatures to become prone to arguments and petty disputes. Any creature within 10 feet of the wearer has a disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 1 hour, starting when the item is activated and lasting until the end of their next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Increased Chaos
effectDetails.rules: During combat, any creature that the wearer targets with an attack or spell has a 25% chance to be affected by minor chaos. This effect lasts for 1 minute, during which time the target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw at the start of their turn; on a failure, they are disoriented and have disadvantage on all attacks.

equestria_item_elemental_badge_of_discor.levelRequirementReason: Twilight Sparkle's badge requires a high level to wield responsibly due to its potential for causing significant disruption in social situations.
equestria_item_elemental_badge_of_discor.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire is known for its trade with Stygian ponies, making it the ideal vendor for items of discordant magic.
equestria_item_elemental_badge_of_discor.shippingDetail: The badge must be shipped through secure channels due to its potential for causing unrest during transit.

usage.activation: Activates when put on by a pony, remaining active until the end of their next long rest or destroyed.
usage.duration: 1 hour per activation
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes it or completes a long rest

equestria_item_elemental_badge_of_discor.priceReason: The badge's rarity and the risk of causing social unrest justify its moderate price.

internet_firewall_charm.name: Guardian of the Pixel Stream
internet_firewall_charm.description: Guardian of the Pixel Stream is a miniature firewall charm, crafted from sleek, glowing silicon and encased in a polished obsidian casing. It hums softly as it deflects intrusive ads and unwanted downloads, offering a digital sanctuary for those navigating the chaotic web. This relic was designed by a paranoid coding genius who lived through years of relentless cyber harassment. With each activation, it subtly increases your digital stealth, making you harder to detect in online forums.

effectDetails.title: Deflect Intrusive Ads
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate the charm to deflect one unwanted advertisement or pop-up. The charm has a 10% chance to block such an attempt each day, with a save DC of 13 for the target. Once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Digital Stealth
effectDetails.rules: The charm grants you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to remain undetected in online forums and digital spaces for up to one hour after activation. Requires a successful Wisdom (Perception) check to use effectively.

internet_firewall_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is designed for those just starting their journey through the cyber wilderness, but even experienced adventurers find it invaluable.
internet_firewall_charm.vendorReason: The cyber market specializes in tech and gadgetry that helps traders navigate the digital world safely.
internet_firewall_charm.shippingDetail: Ships via packet relay within three days, delivered directly to your digital device.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts up to one hour per activation
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or you deactivate it as a bonus action
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

internet_firewall_charm.priceReason: This charm offers unique and practical benefits that are hard to replicate with mundane items.

faerun_item_starshard_of_valoria.name: Shard of Valorian Radiance
faerun_item_starshard_of_valoria.description: The Shard of Valorian Radiance is a crystalline fragment harvested from the heart of a star that fell during the War of the Lance. Its surface glows with an ethereal light, and when held, it radiates divine energy capable of warding off undead and granting access to potent healing magic. However, those who gaze upon it for too long may experience visions of celestial beings, a side effect that can be mitigated by focusing on its protective properties.

effectDetails.title: Undead Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The user gains resistance to necrotic damage and advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Healing Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, providing the user with 2d8 healing to themselves or another creature within reach. The shard can be used once per long rest.

faerun_item_starshard_of_valoria.levelRequirementReason: The Shard's divine power is accessible to all who seek it, but its visions are most easily ignored by those of lower experience.
faerun_item_starshard_of_valoria.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is renowned for its connection to celestial artifacts and the patrons who can appreciate their power and lore.
faerun_item_starshard_of_valoria.shippingDetail: The shard must be delivered by an angelic courier, ensuring it arrives undisturbed and in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate healing surge; passive undead resistance effect until next turn.
usage.duration: Passive until the start of your next turn; healing surge is instantaneous.
usage.endsWhen: The user takes damage, or after one use per long rest for the healing surge.

faerun_item_starshard_of_valoria.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its divine origin and utility without overshadowing other premium items.

warhammer_voidshard.name: The Obsidian Shard of Ruin
warhammer_voidshard.description: The Obsidian Shard of Ruin is a warhammer forged from the heart of a fallen god, pulsing with void energy. Its obsidian surface crackles with necrotic light, and those who wield it may feel their sanity fray. A relic of ancient ruin, it promises devastation to foes but drives its wielder to madness. Legends tell of its unpredictable nature, making it both feared and desired by the unsteady of mind.

effectDetails.title: Void Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with a melee attack using The Obsidian Shard of Ruin, deal 4d8 necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to half its hit points or fewer during this fight, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be frightened until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Frighten
effectDetails.rules: There's a 30% chance that a creature you hit with an attack using The Obsidian Shard of Ruin is frightened. This effect has no save and lasts until the end of its next turn.

warhammer_voidshard.levelRequirementReason: The Obsidian Shard of Ruin's unpredictable nature requires a seasoned warrior to wield it without succumbing to madness.
warhammer_voidshard.vendorReason: Only the Chaos Dealer, a merchant of forbidden knowledge and artifacts, would dare sell such an item.
warhammer_voidshard.shippingDetail: Ships via Shadow Messenger, known for its swift and secretive couriers who ensure the item's safe arrival in the darkest hours.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect
usage.endsWhen: Target saves or is reduced to half hit points; effect ends at end of next turn
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one creature can be frightened per fight

warhammer_voidshard.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and the risk involved in wielding it.

equestria_item_whispering_star_shard.name: Whispering Star Shard
equestria_item_whispering_star_shard.description: The Whispering Star Shard is a crystalline fragment from a star that met its fiery end long ago, now humbling in the hands of those who hold it. When pressed to your ear, it emits a soft, ancient hum, occasionally whispering secrets of forgotten constellations or guiding you towards hidden sources of rainbow magic. The shard's power is unpredictable and fleeting, often leading to moments of static silence that leave you wondering if it truly spoke at all.

effectDetails.title: Whisper of the Stars
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate the shard to hear its whisper. This reveals the location of a hidden rainbow gem within 100 feet with a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check. The effect is instantaneous but can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Mana Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each hour, you regain 1d4+2 mana points if you hold the shard. This effect does not require an action and can occur multiple times in a day.

equestria_item_whispering_star_shard.levelRequirementReason: The magic within the star shard is too potent for those below fifth level, requiring a degree of experience to harness its full potential.
equestria_item_whispering_star_shard.vendorReason: Applejack, with her keen eye for rare and magical items, often finds herself in possession of such artifacts from her travels through Equestria's hidden realms.
equestria_item_whispering_star_shard.shippingDetail: The griffins ensure safe delivery by night, allowing the shard to arrive at its destination with minimal exposure to daylight, which could disrupt its magical properties.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per long rest

equestria_item_whispering_star_shard.priceReason: The Whispering Star Shard is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare origin, potent magical effects, and the limited availability of such artifacts in Equestria.

equestria_item_warios_glitterbomb_starte.name: Wario’s Glitter Bomb Starter Kit
equestria_item_warios_glitterbomb_starte.description: A surprisingly volatile concoction of concentrated rainbow magic and… well, let's just say Wario's secret ingredient. Detonate for a dazzling blast of color that stuns opponents and leaves them covered in shimmering sparkles. Don't blame us if you accidentally turn the entire kingdom pink!

doughnut_hole_gravity_anchor.name: Voidstone Gravimetric Tether
doughnut_hole_gravity_anchor.description: The Voidstone Gravimetric Tether is a unsettlingly sweet-smelling tether forged from the remnants of voidstone, a material known for its chaotic nature. It stabilizes objects in areas affected by unpredictable gravity, briefly normalizing the space around it. Legends whisper that consuming a doughnut while using this tether grants temporary resistance to spatial distortions, though exactly how remains a mystery. The tether's core glows faintly with an ethereal light, hinting at its connection to the void.

effectDetails.title: Spatial Normalization
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this tether creates a localized area of stable gravity. Any object within a 10-foot radius remains in place for 1 minute, immune to disorienting effects and chaotic gravity shifts. This effect has no save DC but is limited to once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Falling Object Stabilization
effectDetails.rules: If an object within the tether's area begins to fall, it stabilizes mid-air for 1 round (30 seconds). The object does not hit the ground and can be retrieved. This effect is limited to one use per long rest.

doughnut_hole_gravity_anchor.levelRequirementReason: The tether requires a moderate understanding of gravimetric principles, making it accessible only to characters at least second level.
doughnut_hole_gravity_anchor.vendorReason: Hole Hawker, known for their expertise in unusual and magical items, carries this tether due to its unique properties and the demand from explorers venturing into chaotic regions.
doughnut_hole_gravity_anchor.shippingDetail: Delivery via the Void Courier is expedited, ensuring the tether arrives in pristine condition despite the unpredictable nature of space travel.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, once per short rest for Spatial Normalization; once per long rest for Falling Object Stabilization
usage.duration: Spatial Normalization lasts 1 minute; Falling Object Stabilization lasts 1 round (30 seconds)
usage.endsWhen: Effect expires or the tether is destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by short and long rest durations

doughnut_hole_gravity_anchor.priceReason: The unique materials and crafting process required to create this tether justify its moderate price in experience points.

doughnut_hole_void_confection.name: Singularity Swirl Pastry
doughnut_hole_void_confection.description: The Singularity Swirl Pastry appears as a dense, swirling mass of dough that seems to defy the laws of physics. Its surface is dotted with minuscule black holes that flicker like stars in an infinite void. Consuming this pastry grants you temporary immunity to void magic and the chance to create a miniature black hole that pulls in nearby small objects. Wario recommends eating it quickly, as prolonged exposure may cause uncontrollable giggling or a sudden craving for more pastries.

effectDetails.title: Void Magic Immunity (Passive)
effectDetails.rules: Grants temporary immunity to void-based spells and effects. This effect lasts for 30 seconds upon consumption.

effectDetails.title: Miniature Black Hole Creation (Random, 10%)
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that consuming this pastry will cause the creation of a miniature black hole which pulls in and traps any small object within its radius. The effect ends when the pastry's magical properties dissipate.

doughnut_hole_void_confection.levelRequirementReason: Even novice mages can appreciate the strange and dangerous properties of this pastry.
doughnut_hole_void_confection.vendorReason: Wario, a master of oddball confections, is known for his eccentric creations that defy conventional physics.
doughnut_hole_void_confection.shippingDetail: Ships via Quantum Courier, which ensures timely delivery through the fabric of space-time.

usage.duration: 30 seconds (passive effect)
usage.endsWhen: The magical properties dissipate after 30 seconds

doughnut_hole_void_confection.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this pastry offers a unique and dangerous experience that few can afford to miss.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_lens.name: Lens of the Whispering Void
doughnut_hole_anomaly_lens.description: Peering through this lens reveals fractured realities, glimpses of other dimensions where doughnuts may spiral into infinity or shrink to vanishing points. It whispers secrets of forgotten realms, but prolonged use can distort your perception of time and space, making you crave more of the sweet treat. The Lens of the Whispering Void is a rare artifact from the mysterious Center Seller, known for their eccentric wares, and delivered by the enigmatic Void Messenger.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse Alternate Realities
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the user can peer through the lens and gain advantage on one divination check of their choice. The effect lasts for 1 hour or until used again.

effectDetails.title: Divination Bonus
effectDetails.rules: The Lens provides a +2 bonus to all divination checks made with items related to food, drink, or exploration. This benefit is active while wearing the lens and does not require activation.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_lens.levelRequirementReason: The artifact requires minimal arcane knowledge for use.
doughnut_hole_anomaly_lens.vendorReason: Center Seller is known for their unique and otherworldly curiosities, including this rare lens.
doughnut_hole_anomaly_lens.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Void Messenger in a sealed package marked with enigmatic symbols.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until used again
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used again or after one hour.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but daily use is limited to once per day.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_lens.priceReason: Balanced for its unique utility and rarity in the market.

almost_edge_item_edgeguardians_amulet.name: Amulet of the Edge Guardians
almost_edge_item_edgeguardians_amulet.description: The Amulet of the Edge Guardians is crafted from ancient, rusted metal that glows faintly with an otherworldly light. Worn by those who walk the boundaries between worlds, it shields its wearer against the creeping madness that seeps through the cracks in reality. Its presence subtly shifts your perception, making you strangely resistant to the unsettling echoes of the void and giving rise to a sense of calm amidst chaos.

effectDetails.title: Mental Shield
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +4 bonus to AC. Additionally, they have immunity to madness effects and can attempt a saving throw with a DC of 15 when exposed to such effects.

effectDetails.title: Void Resistance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance per long rest that the wearer reflects a spell cast at them back to its caster. The reflected spell has half its original power, rounded down. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

almost_edge_item_edgeguardians_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's complex enchantments require a high level of magical knowledge and discipline.
almost_edge_item_edgeguardians_amulet.vendorReason: Edge Wanderers are known for their travels through the boundaries between worlds, making them familiar with such protective artifacts.
almost_edge_item_edgeguardians_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered via a Spectral Messenger who ensures it arrives safely to its destination without attracting unwanted attention.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (once per long rest for the reflection ability)
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if exposed to extreme magical damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged after a long rest

almost_edge_item_edgeguardians_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rarity and unique enchantments justify its relatively lower price compared to other epic items.

connectopia_pioneer_shepherds_boots.name: Sturdy Block Boots
connectopia_pioneer_shepherds_boots.description: These boots were forged from the densest Connectopian blocks, reinforced with pioneer grit! They provide exceptional traction and protection against falling debris, perfect for exploring the perilous frontier.
effects: resistance to falling damage (decreased fall damage by 50%)

connectopia_shard_of_the_great_architect.name: Echoing Shard of Genesis
connectopia_shard_of_the_great_architect.description: Recovered from the Great Architect's workshop, the Echoing Shard of Genesis hums with the very essence of Connectopia’s blueprint. As you hold it, visions flicker before your eyes—potential futures shaped by the architect's hand. It grants a rare glimpse into the crafting process, allowing you to summon miniature constructs that assist in your work. However, the shard also draws chaotic echoes, which can be dangerous if not handled with care.
effects: Summons an assistant construct for crafting tasks.
Provides fleeting visions of potential futures.

effectDetails.title: Construct Assistant
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, creating a miniature construct that assists in crafting. The construct lasts until the end of your next turn and provides a +2 bonus to any Crafting check you make during this time.

effectDetails.title: Vision Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: Activates once per long rest, allowing the user to briefly see potential future outcomes. This grants advantage on one skill check or saving throw of their choice before expiring.

connectopia_shard_of_the_great_architect.levelRequirementReason: The shard's power and complexity require a higher level of mastery.
connectopia_shard_of_the_great_architect.vendorReason: Block Smith, a master of Connectopian artifacts, can source the rarest relics from the Great Architect’s workshop.
connectopia_shard_of_the_great_architect.shippingDetail: The shard is delivered via teleportation beacon, ensuring safe and swift arrival.

usage.activation: Bonus action for summoning the construct; once per long rest to use visions.
usage.duration: Until end of next turn for the construct; one use per long rest for vision.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or if the shard is damaged beyond repair.

connectopia_shard_of_the_great_architect.priceReason: Reflecting its unique utility and rarity, the Echoing Shard of Genesis is priced at 1000 XP.

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_charm.name: Wario's Guaranteed Good Fortune Token
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_charm.description: Wario's Guaranteed Good Fortune Token gleams with an unsettling sheen, a bizarre souvenir from the dark whimsy of the Wastelands. This token is said to have been personally crafted by the infamous thief Wario himself, though it seems more likely that it was forged in his image by some mischievous force. Regardless, it’s guaranteed to bring… something, and it's not always what you'd hope for; a free pie or an encounter with a giant spider could be just around the corner.

effectDetails.title: Reroll Failed Checks
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user can reroll one failed skill check, but the new roll cannot exceed the original roll plus 10. This effect has no save DC and is limited to once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on persuasion checks against simple creatures for a duration of one hour, starting when the item is activated by using it as an action. This effect ends if the user stops interacting with the creature or if they are incapacitated.

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_charm.levelRequirementReason: The token's chaotic magic requires no specific level to wield, making it accessible to all adventurers.
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_charm.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is known for its eclectic mix of goods, including oddities like Wario’s Guaranteed Good Fortune Token.
faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_charm.shippingDetail: The magical delivery drone ensures quick and safe transport, often delivering the token with a slight delay due to its whimsical nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Reroll), One Hour (Advantage)
usage.endsWhen: New Roll Exceeds Original +10 (Reroll), User Stops Interacting with Creature or Incapacitates (Advantage)

faerun_item_wario_s_lucky_charm.priceReason: The token's chaotic magic and the potential for either boon or misfortune justify its moderate price.

mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_wrench.name: Pipe Wrench of Disassembly
mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_wrench.description: The Pipe Wrench of Disassembly is a robust tool forged from solid mushroom metal. Its origin lies in the Mushroom Kingdom, where it has been refined by the hands of skilled mechanics. This wrench can dismantle even the most resilient enemy defenses with ease, and its unique design allows you to repair broken machinery at an accelerated rate. With this tool, you'll find yourself disabling traps with a simple twist, ensuring your path is clear and secure.

effectDetails.title: Dismantle Defenses
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use the Pipe Wrench of Disassembly to dismantle a target mechanical enemy. The wrench deals 1d6 + your proficiency bonus damage and has a 50% chance to disable any traps in its vicinity for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Accelerated Repair
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Pipe Wrench of Disassembly, you gain a +2 bonus to repair checks. You can use this bonus once per long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_wrench.levelRequirementReason: This tool requires intermediate skills and experience to wield effectively in combat.
mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_wrench.vendorReason: Wario, a master of mechanics himself, ensures the quality of his wares meets the highest standards.
mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_wrench.shippingDetail: Delivered by Mushroom Express within 3 days via express service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for dismantling, 1 minute for trap disabling
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the target is no longer mechanical or the traps are re-enabled.

mushroom_kingdom_item_pipe_wrench.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its unique utility and the materials used in its construction.

teyvat_item_vision_catalyst.name: Archon’s Whisper Charm
teyvat_item_vision_catalyst.description: Crafted from solidified lightning and a shard of an ancient Vision, this charm seems to murmur with forgotten prayers. It doesn't grant power directly but provides the party with a skilled consultant for one hour—perfect for analyzing enemy weaknesses or finding hidden paths, assuming they can understand its cryptic pronouncements. The Archon’s Whisper Charm is said to have been gifted by an ancient archon to guide lost souls, and its ethereal glow hints at untold secrets of the Vision.

effectDetails.title: Consultative Insight
effectDetails.rules: The Archon’s Whisper Charm grants the party a +2 bonus to Intelligence checks for one hour. This effect is passive and does not require any action from the user.

effectDetails.title: Tactical Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the charm allows the party to learn a single tactical advantage (chosen by the user) that provides a +2 bonus to an ability check or saving throw. This effect is instantaneous and cannot be used more than once per day.

teyvat_item_vision_catalyst.levelRequirementReason: The charm's abilities are accessible to lower-level characters, focusing on enhancing their tactical acumen rather than raw power.
teyvat_item_vision_catalyst.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor traders have access to rare and ancient artifacts like the Archon’s Whisper Charm due to their connections with the Vision and the archons.
teyvat_item_vision_catalyst.shippingDetail: Shipped via the swift Dragon Cart, ensuring that the charm arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive for Consultative Insight; once per long rest for Tactical Advantage
usage.duration: One hour for Consultative Insight; instantaneous for Tactical Advantage
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each day for Consultative Insight; after use for Tactical Advantage

teyvat_item_vision_catalyst.priceReason: The Archon’s Whisper Charm is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and utility in combat and strategy.

teyvat_item_storm_shard.name: Fragment of the Tempest’s Fury
teyvat_item_storm_shard.description: The Fragment of the Tempest’s Fury is a crystalline shard that shimmers with raw electrical energy, its jagged edges glinting in the dim light like stinging needles. This relic was forged from the very essence of a tempest, capturing the fury of the storm within its core. When activated, it releases a searing burst of lightning that can shock and awe both friend and foe alike, making it a favorite among thrill-seekers and miscreants alike.

effectDetails.title: Shocking Discharge
effectDetails.rules: When the Fragment is thrown or used as an action, it releases a burst of lightning that deals 50 thunder damage to one target within 30 feet. This effect has a 30% chance to also inflict the 'shocked' condition on the target for 1 minute (DC 14 Consave). The item recharges after a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Rarity Drops
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you find or encounter rare items, there is a +20% chance that this item will increase your chances of obtaining them. This effect does not stack with other similar effects.

teyvat_item_storm_shard.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can wield the Fragment for its electrifying display and practical use in both combat and exploration.
teyvat_item_storm_shard.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in exotic and enchanted items, making this shard a perfect fit for their inventory.
teyvat_item_storm_shard.shippingDetail: The Sea Serpent ensures swift delivery of the Fragment, often arriving with a dramatic splash that adds to its mystique.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Recharges after a long rest

teyvat_item_storm_shard.priceReason: The Fragment of the Tempest’s Fury is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique elemental properties and rarity-enhancing capabilities.

animatopia_gloomfruit.name: Nightshade Berry Pouch
animatopia_gloomfruit.description: The Nightshade Berry Pouch is a dark leather pouch filled with shimmering berries that glow faintly under moonlight. These berries are said to be harvested from the cursed forests of Animatopia, where they grow in the shadows. Consuming them allows you to slip into invisibility briefly, making you nearly undetectable for three turns, perfect for covert operations or escaping danger. The berries also provide a small but welcome health boost when consumed, ensuring your body is ready for whatever comes next.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: When you consume the berries, you gain invisibility for up to three turns. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after consuming the berries. You can only use this ability once every long rest.

effectDetails.title: Health Restorative
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, you regain 1d4 + your Constitution modifier hit points. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action to activate.

animatopia_gloomfruit.levelRequirementReason: The Nightshade Berry Pouch requires no level because it provides a basic utility that can benefit characters of any class or background.
animatopia_gloomfruit.vendorReason: Forest Market is known for its wide variety of exotic and useful goods, including those sourced from the dark heart of Animatopia.
animatopia_gloomfruit.shippingDetail: The berries are delivered by a large giant snail, ensuring they remain fresh and potent upon arrival.

usage.activation: Eating one berry from the pouch
usage.duration: Up to three turns of invisibility per use
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn after consuming a berry; ends if you take damage or are targeted by an effect that explicitly reveals creatures within its area of effect.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use every long rest

animatopia_gloomfruit.priceReason: The Nightshade Berry Pouch is priced at 1000 XP due to the potent effects it provides and the rare nature of its ingredients.

animatopia_ancestor_scroll.name: Whispers of the Elder Beasts
animatopia_ancestor_scroll.description: Whispers of the Elder Beasts is an ancient parchment, its surface painted with iridescent inks sourced from luminescent fungi that grow only in the deepest parts of Animatopia’s forgotten forests. The scroll crackles with the spirits of long-lost ancestors who speak in riddles and grunts, offering cryptic visions of the future. Though their advice is often muddled, it can still provide fleeting insight into impending events or hidden truths about your path forward.

effectDetails.title: Vision of the Future
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you may briefly commune with the spirits and gain a single-use vision that reveals either an upcoming event, hidden secret, or impending danger. The vision lasts for 1 minute. It has a 50% chance to provide accurate information, but the nature of the vision is always cryptic and requires interpretation.

effectDetails.title: Fear Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one short rest (8 hours), you gain temporary resistance to fear effects. This effect cannot be gained more than once per day, and it does not stack with other similar abilities.

animatopia_ancestor_scroll.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have reached a certain level of wisdom and experience can properly commune with the spirits of Animatopia’s ancestors.
animatopia_ancestor_scroll.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar is known for its rare and ancient artifacts, including items that connect users to otherworldly forces like these scrolls.
animatopia_ancestor_scroll.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Phantom Owl courier service, which ensures swift delivery of such fragile and powerful relics.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until interrupted
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a short rest or are incapacitated

animatopia_ancestor_scroll.priceReason: This price reflects the scroll's rarity, the materials used in its creation, and the power it grants.

curiosity_omen_shard.name: Shard of a Twisted Omen
curiosity_omen_shard.description: The Shard of a Twisted Omen is an obsidian fragment that hums with dark energy, emanating from an ancient prophecy gone awry. It pulses with unsettling force, granting fleeting glimpses into possible futures, most often foreboding and tinged with Wario’s ill-fated wardrobe choices. Holding it feels like walking through a storm of misfortune, as the shard occasionally reveals enemy weaknesses but also brings minor healing and a boost to luck, though these effects are fleeting.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Weakness Revelation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can focus on the shard for 1 minute. During this time, there is a 20% chance that when you or your allies attack an enemy within 5 feet of you, they are revealed to have a weakness that grants advantage on your next attack against them. This effect ends if you move more than 10 feet away from the shard.

effectDetails.title: Minor Healing
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your turn while holding the shard, roll a d6 and add half your Wisdom modifier (rounded down) to this total. You regain hit points equal to that amount as long as you hold it.

effectDetails.title: Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: While holding the shard, all saving throws have advantage for 1 hour. This effect ends if you drop or lose possession of the shard.

curiosity_omen_shard.levelRequirementReason: Adept-level characters are more adept at interpreting and channeling the shard's dark energy.
curiosity_omen_shard.vendorReason: The fate weavers at Fate Forge have a special connection to ancient prophecies and their fragments.
curiosity_omen_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Winged Messengers, the shard arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute (until you move more than 10 feet from it)
usage.endsWhen: You move more than 10 feet away or lose possession of the shard

curiosity_omen_shard.priceReason: The price reflects its uncommon rarity and the balance between its minor healing, luck boost, and enemy weakness revelation.

warhammer_desolation_strike.name: Desolation Strike
warhammer_desolation_strike.description: Forged in the heart of a shattered empire, this hammer screams with the fury of countless battles. Its surface glows faintly with an ancient, almost sentient warmth, as if it remembers every strike and death that has ever been dealt by its handle. The Desolation Strike feels like Wario's belly after a particularly large pizza; warm to the touch yet ominously heavy in your grasp, hinting at the storm of destruction it can unleash upon impact.

effectDetails.title: Massive Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with this weapon on a critical hit, deal an additional 3d6 damage. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stun Chance
effectDetails.rules: At the start of your next turn after hitting a target with this weapon, there is a 25% chance to stun that target for 1 round unless they succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. This effect can occur once per short or long rest.

warhammer_desolation_strike.levelRequirementReason: The Desolation Strike requires a minimum level of 6 due to its powerful effects and the need for martial expertise.
warhammer_desolation_strike.vendorReason: The chaos dealer is known for their wares of dubious origin, including weapons that have been imbued with dark and ancient powers.
warhammer_desolation_strike.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Night Crawler, this weapon arrives shrouded in darkness, ensuring it remains a secret until it reaches its intended recipient.

usage.activation: As a bonus action to unleash an additional swing with critical hit effects.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The hammer's charges are exhausted or when you take the rest at the end of a long rest.

warhammer_desolation_strike.priceReason: Balanced to match its powerful effects and unique properties, this rare weapon is priced fairly for its potential.

teyvat_item_stormcaller_amulet.name: Stormcaller's Amulet
teyvat_item_stormcaller_amulet.description: Stormcaller's Amulet, forged in the heart of a thunderstorm, hums with raw wind energy, pulsing with the fury and grace of the tempest. This amulet not only enhances its wearer’s affinity for gusts but also provides a tangible connection to the elements, granting them the ability to summon small whirlwinds on impact. Those who wear it can feel the storm within, making their attacks more unpredictable and devastating.

effectDetails.title: Wind Enhanced Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with a melee attack, you add your proficiency bonus to wind damage dealt. This effect has no cooldown and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Whirlwind Summoning
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can summon a small whirlwind in a 10-foot radius centered on yourself. This whirlwind lasts until the end of your next turn and deals 1d6 wind damage to creatures within its area at the start of each of their turns. Creatures make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On failure, they are pushed out of the whirlwind's area.

teyvat_item_stormcaller_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's power aligns with those who have demonstrated proficiency in handling elemental forces.
teyvat_item_stormcaller_amulet.vendorReason: Mondstadt, a city built on the principles of balance and harmony with nature, is known for its affinity for such powerful yet controlled tools.
teyvat_item_stormcaller_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via Winged Sprint, ensuring swift delivery from the heart of Mondstadt.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn (whirlwind summoning)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the user takes a short rest or uses a new whirlwind summon
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a short or long rest

teyvat_item_stormcaller_amulet.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its powerful yet manageable effects and limited utility.

teyvat_item_loyalty_scroll.name: Scroll of Unwavering Loyalty
teyvat_item_loyalty_scroll.description: The Scroll of Unwavering Loyalty is a meticulously crafted parchment adorned with the Geo Archon's emblem in gold leaf. As you unfurl it, a subtle force seems to align your words and actions, fostering unwavering loyalty among those around you – or at least, they believe you are dedicated! This scroll not only enhances your charisma checks when dealing with Geo-related characters but also grants you resistance against earth damage with a chance of temporary buffs. It's surprisingly useful for navigating the treacherous waters of diplomacy and conflict alike.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Charisma Checks
effectDetails.rules: When making charisma checks related to Geo-related characters, you gain a +1 bonus. This effect lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Earth Damage
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on saving throws against earth damage. This effect is active as long as the scroll remains in your possession and can be used once per short rest.

teyvat_item_loyalty_scroll.levelRequirementReason: The scroll's subtle enchantments are accessible to any adventurer, making it a versatile tool for all levels.
teyvat_item_loyalty_scroll.vendorReason: As the heart of Geo-related trade and diplomacy in Teyvat, Liyue Harbor is the perfect place to find this scroll.
teyvat_item_loyalty_scroll.shippingDetail: Shipped by sea cart directly from Teyvan ports, ensuring scrolls arrive in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon possession; requires no action to activate.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest for charisma checks buff; once per short rest for earth damage resistance.
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of each short or long rest, or when you lose possession of the scroll.

teyvat_item_loyalty_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's balanced price reflects its versatile utility and enchantments without being overpowered.

teyvat_item_chrono_essence.name: Chrono Essence - Temporal Shift
teyvat_item_chrono_essence.description: Chrono Essence - Temporal Shift is a vial of shimmering light captured from the fractured echoes of time. This essence allows its wielder to manipulate temporal flow, offering fleeting moments of distortion and rewind. The essence grants a brief pause in the flow of time for the user, creating an opportunity to act with precision. It also provides the chance to reverse a single action up to 3 seconds ago, perfect for outsmarting foes or correcting mistakes on the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, Chrono Essence causes time to slow down for the user by 30% for up to 5 seconds. This effect grants an advantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws within this duration. The essence can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Action Rewind
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a reaction to immediately reverse the last action taken by the user or an adjacent ally, allowing for up to 3 seconds of rewound time. If used on yourself, it corrects your most recent mistake. This effect has no save DC and can only be used once per short rest.

teyvat_item_chrono_essence.levelRequirementReason: This essence is accessible early in the adventuring career to allow characters of all levels to experiment with time manipulation.
teyvat_item_chrono_essence.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare and exotic artifacts, including Chrono Essence which showcases their expertise in temporal phenomena.
teyvat_item_chrono_essence.shippingDetail: Shipped by the swift Wind Messenger for immediate delivery with minimal delay.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Temporal Distortion; Reaction to activate Action Rewind.
usage.duration: Temporal Distortion lasts up to 5 seconds, Action Rewind is instantaneous.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or when a new activation occurs.

teyvat_item_chrono_essence.priceReason: Given its limited but powerful effects and the rare nature of capturing temporal essence, this item is priced at 1000 XP.

faerun_item_shadow_whisper.name: Whispers of the Shadowfell
faerun_item_shadow_whisper.description: The Whispers of the Shadowfell is a small obsidian shard that glows with an eerie, pulsating darkness. When held, it allows you to perceive echoes from forgotten horrors and gain advantage on Stealth checks in areas touched by shadow. However, lingering too long can trap you within an endless loop of despair, causing your mind to spiral into dread. The faint smell of rain and regret clings to the shard, a reminder of its dark origins.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth Checks
effectDetails.rules: When you hold the Whispers of the Shadowfell in an area touched by shadow, you gain advantage on Stealth checks. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). If you spend more than one round per turn within the shadowy area, you risk becoming trapped in the despair loop.

effectDetails.title: Detect Undead
effectDetails.rules: The Whispers can detect undead creatures up to 30 feet away. You must make a Wisdom (Perception) check with disadvantage if there are other sources of ambient magical energy within 60 feet. This effect is usable once per short or long rest.

faerun_item_shadow_whisper.levelRequirementReason: The item's power and the risk it poses to less experienced adventurers necessitate a minimum level.
faerun_item_shadow_whisper.vendorReason: As a reputable vendor, Baldur's Bazaar offers rare and potent curiosities like the Whispers of the Shadowfell.
faerun_item_shadow_whisper.shippingDetail: Ships swiftly on the back of a trained hawk courier.

usage.activation: Passive effect while held within shadowy areas.
usage.duration: One round per turn, limited by risk of despair loop.
usage.endsWhen: When you leave the shadowy area or become incapacitated.

faerun_item_shadow_whisper.priceReason: The item's balanced price reflects its moderate power and rarity in the market.

faerun_item_blood_rune.name: The Serpent's Kiss
faerun_item_blood_rune.description: The Serpent's Kiss is a pulsating crimson rune carved from a single shard of molten obsidian, said to have been forged in the heart of an ancient volcano. This forbidden artifact grants immense fire-based spell damage and a chance to summon shadowy serpents at your command—powers that come with a terrible price: prolonged use corrupts the wielder's mind, slowly twisting their desires and drawing them closer to malevolent forces.

effectDetails.title: Increased Fire Damage
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the wielder's fire-based spells deal an additional +2d6 damage. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Serpent Summoning
effectDetails.rules: The user may summon a shadow serpent as an action, which attacks enemies within 5 feet with a bite attack (melee weapon attack: +3 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target) dealing 2d6 necrotic damage on a hit. The serpent persists for 1 minute and can be dismissed at will.

faerun_item_blood_rune.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 1 to wield this ancient artifact responsibly.
faerun_item_blood_rune.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market, known for its dark wares, sells this forbidden item to those who know the risks and seek such power.
faerun_item_blood_rune.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dark Messenger, a courier service known for its discretion and speed.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (effect lasts until end of next turn)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used again or at the start of the wielder's next turn.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one use per short or long rest.

faerun_item_blood_rune.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its rarity and potent magical properties without being overpowered.

pokemon_item_pocket_phantom.name: Phantom Echo Capsule
pokemon_item_pocket_phantom.description: The Phantom Echo Capsule is a shimmering, glassine capsule that holds the very essence of your most recent Pokémon battle. When activated, it releases a spectral echo of your last move, leaving behind a lingering mist that confounds and overloads any foe unfortunate enough to stand in its path. Beware, for this spectral copy can be unpredictable – summoning a mischievous Poltergeist or a grumpy Mimikyu is not unheard of during a battle. Use it wisely, as the effects are both powerful and potentially chaotic.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Echo
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the capsule releases a spectral copy of your last move as an action. The echo lasts for 6 turns, during which it can target any creature within 30 feet. At the end of each turn, there is a 25% chance that the target becomes confused until the start of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Confusion and Overload
effectDetails.rules: The spectral echo also has a small chance (15%) to overwhelm the senses of the target, causing it to take a -2 penalty to all attack rolls and saving throws for 2 turns. This effect ends if the target successfully saves against a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw.

pokemon_item_pocket_phantom.levelRequirementReason: To wield this powerful item effectively, trainers must have sufficient experience in battle.
pokemon_item_pocket_phantom.vendorReason: The pokemart stocks a variety of items that can assist trainers in their battles, including this unique capsule.
pokemon_item_pocket_phantom.shippingDetail: Ships via rocket mail within 24 hours of purchase. Delivery is tracked and confirmed upon arrival.

usage.duration: 6 turns
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each turn, or when used against a target that successfully saves against its effects.

pokemon_item_pocket_phantom.priceReason: The Phantom Echo Capsule is priced at 1000 XP for its rarity and the unique spectral effects it offers.

pokemon_item_trainer_boots.name: Stride-Step Boots of the Elite Four
pokemon_item_trainer_boots.description: Stride-Step Boots of the Elite Four are forged from ancient iron and imbued with the essence of legendary Pokémon. Crafted by a former member of the Elite Four’s personal guard, these sturdy boots increase your speed significantly and grant you an uncanny ability to dodge attacks in battle. With each step, you feel as if you're moving through the battlefield with the grace of a master trainer, effortlessly avoiding even the swiftest of strikes.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Speed
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these boots, your speed is increased by 50%. You can move faster in combat and on the field. This effect lasts until you rest or are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Dodge Attacks
effectDetails.rules: You have a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws against attacks made against you, and there is a 10% chance each round that an attack made against you misses. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

pokemon_item_trainer_boots.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have proven their skills as Elite Four members or have reached a high enough level can harness this item's power.
pokemon_item_trainer_boots.vendorReason: The league store specializes in items for trainers seeking to improve their combat prowess, and these boots are among the most sought-after by seasoned competitors.
pokemon_item_trainer_boots.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by delivery drones, ensuring you're ready for your next battle upon arrival.

usage.duration: Until you rest or are incapacitated
usage.endsWhen: Resting or becoming incapacitated

pokemon_item_trainer_boots.priceReason: The boots' unique crafting and the rare materials used make them a valuable asset, justifying their moderate price.

connectopia_block_hammer.name: The Overload Hammer
connectopia_block_hammer.description: The Overload Hammer is a bulky yet elegant tool forged from the heart of Connectopia. Its hammerhead glows with an eerie, pulsating light as it transforms stone into data-bricks. When wielded by those trained in mining or engineering, this hammer can instantly convert any block into a shimmering pile of digital bricks. However, overuse risks a catastrophic overload, creating a blinding flash and leaving the wielder disoriented for several moments.

effectDetails.title: Data Brick Conversion
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an unattended block with this hammer, it instantaneously turns into data-bricks. This effect has a 50% chance of occurring and does not consume charges or require an action.

effectDetails.title: Stun on Overload
effectDetails.rules: If the hammer's overload counter reaches critical mass (triggered by consecutive uses without allowing it to cool down), you are stunned for 1 minute. The hammer is rendered unusable until the next dawn, and its overload counter resets.

connectopia_block_hammer.levelRequirementReason: It requires a certain finesse in handling the hammer's digital magic.
connectopia_block_hammer.vendorReason: The Block Smith has a deep connection to Connectopia’s technology and is well-versed in its tools.
connectopia_block_hammer.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly by the fleet of drones, ensuring you have your hammer right when needed.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The hammer's overload counter reaches critical mass or it is rendered unusable due to overuse.

connectopia_block_hammer.priceReason: Balanced for its powerful effects and the risk of catastrophic failure.

connectopia_echo_shard.name: Fragment of the Lost Signal
connectopia_echo_shard.description: A pulsating shard of solidified data from a long-lost Connectopian transmission, this Fragment of the Lost Signal hums with eerie energy when held. Touching it causes unsettling echoes to ring in your mind, briefly revealing hidden paths or ancient block layouts... but beware, for these visions might as easily drive you mad. This fragment is key to deciphering cryptic data streams and can be a cursed companion if not wielded with care.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard grants the user a small chance to reveal hidden paths in their immediate area. This effect lasts for 1 minute and has a 20% chance of success.

effectDetails.title: Confusion
effectDetails.rules: Touching the fragment causes confusion on the target for up to 3 turns, with a saving throw DC of 14 to resist. The user can activate this effect once per short or long rest.

connectopia_echo_shard.levelRequirementReason: This item requires at least 6th level to wield effectively, as it demands both the strength and experience to handle its volatile nature.
connectopia_echo_shard.vendorReason: The Pioneer Post is known for its connections with ancient technology, making them a reliable source for such relics of lost civilizations.
connectopia_echo_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Signal Courier Bot, ensuring safe and timely delivery to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Used as an action, this shard must be touched to activate its effects.
usage.duration: The Confusion effect lasts for up to 3 turns. Reveals Hidden Paths is a one-time effect lasting 1 minute per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the user completes their next turn or when the shard is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only once per short or long rest.

connectopia_echo_shard.priceReason: This balanced price reflects its rarity and the careful balance between utility and potential danger it offers to players of all levels.

connectopia_void_extractor.name: The Null Conduit
connectopia_void_extractor.description: The Null Conduit, a wicked device forged from the very essence of Connectopia's energy grid, can create localized voids that destabilize constructs and machines. With each use, it siphons their power, but prolonged activation risks summoning something far more dangerous than intended—a small but real chance of attracting hostile entities. Crafted by the notorious Wario, this forbidden artifact is a double-edged tool for those daring enough to wield it.
effects: deals bonus damage to constructs and machines
temporarily creates a zone of silence

effectDetails.title: Zone of Silence
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous effect within 10 feet. Targets all creatures in the area, granting advantage on saving throws against sounds-based effects for 1 minute. Ends if the user activates another ability or takes an action that involves sound.

effectDetails.title: Bonus Damage to Constructs and Machines
effectDetails.rules: When used as a bonus action, deals an additional 2d6 force damage plus half the user's level. Can be used once per short rest.

connectopia_void_extractor.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum of 10th-level spellcasters to safely handle and control this unstable artifact.
connectopia_void_extractor.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in exotic and forbidden items, making The Null Conduit an appropriate addition for their inventory.
connectopia_void_extractor.shippingDetail: Delivered under cover of night to prevent unwanted attention from the law or other entities.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a cooldown of 1 minute between uses
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user activates another ability or takes an action that involves sound.

connectopia_void_extractor.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its rarity and the risk involved in using such a dangerous artifact.

pokemon_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.name: Voidshard of the Dark Pokémon
pokemon_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.description: The Voidshard of the Dark Pokémon is a sinister, pulsating fragment of shadow energy harvested from a defeated Umbreon. Its surface crackles with forbidden power, whispering dark secrets and casting an eerie glow that can be seen for miles. This artifact drains hit points from nearby foes, siphoning their strength into its core. Use it wisely, for prolonged exposure may attract the attention of even the most vigilant sentinels—or worse, Wario’s insatiable hunger.

effectDetails.title: Drain HP Enemy (20)
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can focus their will on the Voidshard to drain 20 hit points from an adjacent enemy. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be reduced by this effect. This use of the item counts as one charge.

effectDetails.title: Summon Shadow Phantom (5%)
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, using the Voidshard can summon a spectral phantom that lingers for 1 minute. The phantom deals 1d6 necrotic damage to any enemy it moves adjacent to and can be dismissed with an action by its creator.

pokemon_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.levelRequirementReason: This artifact requires a high level of control to wield effectively, as its forbidden power can easily spiral out of control.
pokemon_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.vendorReason: The Safari Shop often deals in rare and exotic artifacts, including those with dark origins, making it the ideal vendor for this item.
pokemon_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.shippingDetail: Delivered under cover of night by the enigmatic Shadow Courier, who ensures the package remains unopened until delivered to its intended recipient.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (summoning effect)
usage.endsWhen: Charges are exhausted or the item is destroyed; can be recharged with a long rest
usage.charges: 5 charges, recharging after a long rest

pokemon_item_forbidden_shadow_stone.priceReason: The Voidshard's rare material and forbidden origins make it a valuable asset, though its draining effects ensure it remains a dangerous tool.

midlands_item_ironclad_gauntlet.name: The Warden's Grip
midlands_item_ironclad_gauntlet.description: Forged in the fires of a broken foundry, The Warden's Grip feels like it wants to crush things yet remains surprisingly comfortable until you attempt to lift heavy loads. This gauntlet is said to channel the very essence of durability and strength, making your arms feel as if they can withstand any task. If you dare to wield it in battle, prepare for a 15% chance to land critical hits on weapon attacks, but be warned: its true form will manifest when you attempt to lift something too heavy, potentially dismantling the very weapon you're holding with a force that seems almost sentient.

effectDetails.title: Critical Hit Boost
effectDetails.rules: When you attack with a weapon while wearing The Warden's Grip, there is a 15% chance to deal a critical hit. This effect does not stack with other sources of critical hits.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Durability
effectDetails.rules: While wearing The Warden's Grip, you gain resistance to bludgeoning damage equal to +3. This effect persists until you try to lift an object weighing more than 100 times your Strength modifier in pounds or expend a use.

midlands_item_ironclad_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: This gauntlet requires at least level 7 due to its complex enchantments and the physical toll it takes on the wearer.
midlands_item_ironclad_gauntlet.vendorReason: The Warden's Grip is a rare find, and only the Empire Exchange can acquire such artifacts from the broken foundries of old.
midlands_item_ironclad_gauntlet.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost care via the Royal Post Cart, ensuring safe arrival within two days.

usage.activation: Passive effect while worn; activation limited by weight lifting or use limit.
usage.duration: Persistent until you lift a heavy object exceeding your strength capacity or expend a use.
usage.endsWhen: Expenditure of a charge, lifting an excessively heavy load, or destroying the gauntlet.

midlands_item_ironclad_gauntlet.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its rarity and unique enchantments without giving it overpowering capabilities.

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenade_potion.name: Sweet Serenade Potion
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenade_potion.description: The Sweet Serenade Potion, crafted from crystallized honey and the laughter of sugar sprites, is a shimmering bottle that, when uncorked, releases a wave of sweet enchantment. The air fills with the sound of tinkling bells and a chorus of cheerful melodies, instantly charming all creatures within 30 feet for up to an hour. It's said that even the most hardened bandits are moved by its magic, often trading their gold coins for a song or two.

effectDetails.title: Charm Target
effectDetails.rules: All creatures within 30 feet of the user who can hear are charmed until the end of their next turn. They must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be affected. The effect ends if the target is hit by an attack, takes damage, or moves more than 30 feet away from the caster.

effectDetails.title: Sweet Enchantment
effectDetails.rules: The area around the user becomes filled with a delightful melody and fragrant sweetness that lasts for 1 hour. Creatures within this area receive advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks while it persists, but must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of their turn or be affected by the Charm Target effect.

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenade_potion.levelRequirementReason: Brewing this potion requires a decent understanding of alchemy and the ability to work with delicate ingredients, which is why it's recommended for characters of at least 6th level.
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenade_potion.vendorReason: The Pastry Palace specializes in enchanted confections, so it makes sense that they'd carry this magical potion.
leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenade_potion.shippingDetail: Shipped by Sugar Delivery, known for their sweet and timely deliveries within the city limits.

usage.activation: A bonus action to uncork and drink the potion.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of the target's next turn or when it is hit by an attack, takes damage, or moves more than 30 feet away from the caster.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the target is hit by an attack, takes damage, or moves more than 30 feet away from the caster.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; recharges after a long rest.

leclaire_isle_item_sweet_serenade_potion.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it's an epic consumable that can charm creatures and provide a sweet enchantment, enhancing social interactions without being overpowered.

leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_infin.name: Dough of Infinite Creation
leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_infin.description: The Dough of Infinite Creation is a colossal, shimmering dough ball that radiates arcane energy. Crafted from enchanted flour and bound with ancient magic by the artisans of LeClaire Isle, this dough can be molded into nearly any conceivable object or creature. With a focused thought, you can shape it into weapons, shields, even miniature armies of Dough Folk, each one as detailed as if crafted by hand. This culinary marvel regenerates minor mana and enhances your crafting skill, making you a master artisan in moments.

effectDetails.title: Shape Dough into Object
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you focus on the dough and mentally envision the object or creature. The dough then reshapes itself according to your will. You can create a weapon (including an improvised one), shield, or even a miniature Dough Folk figure. This effect has no range or area; it is a mental command that shapes the dough upon contact.

effectDetails.title: Minor Mana Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns, you gain 1d4 temporary hit points and regain 1d6 mana. This effect has no save DC or limits; it is a passive benefit that begins when you consume the dough.

leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_infin.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level to ensure its magical properties are used responsibly.
leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_infin.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in unique and enchanting items, making it fitting for such an extraordinary dough.
leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_infin.shippingDetail: Delivered by Dragon Express, known for its speed and reliability, ensuring the Dough of Infinite Creation reaches you in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the object or creature created is no longer needed or destroyed.

leclaire_isle_item_mythic_dough_of_infin.priceReason: This price reflects its mythic rarity and the mana required to craft it, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's inventory.

connectopia_mining_survey.name: Pioneer's Seismic Scanner
connectopia_mining_survey.description: The Pioneer's Seismic Scanner is a sturdy, forge-made device that vibrantly glows with the energy of its recent calibration. This indispensable tool not only reveals nearby mineral deposits but also detects hidden traps, ensuring miners navigate safely through treacherous underground terrains. Its dual functionality makes it an essential companion for any ambitious prospector, though it occasionally picks up on the rhythmic stomping of Wario—often signaling impending danger.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Mineral Deposits
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Pioneer's Seismic Scanner reveals mineral deposits within a 60-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and cannot be used again until the start of your next turn after completing a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Detect Hidden Traps
effectDetails.rules: The scanner can detect hidden traps within a 30-foot radius when activated as an action. The DC to spot or disarm these traps is equal to 10 + the trap's challenge rating, and this effect can be used once per short rest.

connectopia_mining_survey.levelRequirementReason: The device requires minimal calibration and basic understanding of its operation, making it accessible to even the most novice miners.
connectopia_mining_survey.vendorReason: Pioneer Post specializes in tools that aid in exploration and mining, ensuring their customers are well-equipped for any adventure beneath the earth's surface.
connectopia_mining_survey.shippingDetail: The scanner is shipped securely to ensure it arrives fully functional, even through rugged terrain.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until triggered by Wario's stomping
usage.endsWhen: the start of your next turn after completing a short rest

connectopia_mining_survey.priceReason: The Pioneer's Seismic Scanner offers unparalleled utility for miners, balancing its value with the comprehensive protection and resource discovery it provides.

faerun_item_warrios_lucky_charm.name: Warrior's Lucky Charm - The Wario-esque Boot
faerun_item_warrios_lucky_charm.description: The Warrior's Lucky Charm - The Wario-esque Boot is a well-worn leather boot that gleams with an eerie, almost supernatural sheen. Crafted from the remnants of a bygone era, these boots are said to have belonged to a warrior whose luck in battle was as unpredictable as it was legendary. When donned, they grant their wearer bursts of speed and acrobatic prowess, making them nearly invulnerable to missteps or attacks.

effectDetails.title: Bursts of Speed
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a reaction upon being hit by an attack, the wearer gains advantage on their next Acrobatics check and increases their movement speed by 10 feet for one minute.

effectDetails.title: Acrobatic Mastery
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these boots, the wearer has advantage on all Acrobatics checks. Additionally, they have a 25% chance to dodge an attack each round until the end of their next turn.

faerun_item_warrios_lucky_charm.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted for seasoned warriors who can best appreciate and utilize its unpredictable but potent effects.
faerun_item_warrios_lucky_charm.vendorReason: The Waterdeep Market is known for its diverse inventory, including unique and powerful items that appeal to all manner of adventurers.
faerun_item_warrios_lucky_charm.shippingDetail: Ships via Swift Courier Service; delivery takes 3 days.

usage.activation: Reaction (to an attack) or as a bonus action
usage.duration: One minute per activation, until the end of their next turn for dodge chance
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when they are hit by another attack or at the start of the wearer's next turn.

faerun_item_warrios_lucky_charm.priceReason: Balanced as a rare, powerful item that offers significant but not game-breaking advantages.

kivotos_item_halo_of_disruption.name: Halos of Disruption
kivotos_item_halo_of_disruption.description: The Halos of Disruption are shimmering, halo-like devices crafted from enchanted meteoric iron. Once favored by the prestigious Halo Club, these halos can disrupt magical energies with a mere glance. They are said to have been used by the club members to challenge potent spellcasters and neutralize their spells without directly engaging in combat. Beware, for they carry a risk of unintended consequences, such as creating small anomalies when used near concentrated magic.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Magical Energies
effectDetails.rules: When thrown and successfully hit with a ranged attack, the halo disrupts one targeted spell currently in effect. The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have its spell's duration reduced to zero.

effectDetails.title: Reduce Spell Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For each successful hit against a magic user with this item, their spell resistance is reduced by 5%, stacking with other sources. This effect lasts until the end of the target’s next turn and resets after one long rest.

kivotos_item_halo_of_disruption.levelRequirementReason: The Halos are crafted to be used by those who have a basic understanding of magical theory and combat tactics.
kivotos_item_halo_of_disruption.vendorReason: These halos were originally designed for the Halo Club, making club supply the most logical source for them.
kivotos_item_halo_of_disruption.shippingDetail: Ships within one week, with special handling required due to their delicate nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The halo's effects end when the spell duration is reduced or it misses its target.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short rest.

kivotos_item_halo_of_disruption.priceReason: The halos are crafted from rare materials and require significant magical energy to disrupt spells without causing a larger disruption.

kivotos_item_artifact_of_lost_notes.name: Artifact of Lost Notes
kivotos_item_artifact_of_lost_notes.description: The Artifact of Lost Notes is a tarnished, ornate music box that hums with an ethereal glow when wound. Its intricate gears and brass mechanisms seem to vibrate with forgotten harmonies, whispering cryptic clues in a language only the most perceptive can understand. When played, it reveals hidden passages or traps with eerie precision, making it invaluable for explorers and adventurers seeking to uncover lost secrets. It's said that those who listen closely might even hear fragments of melodies long lost to time.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Forgotten Clues
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the music box plays a haunting melody that provides you with one piece of cryptic information related to hidden locations or traps. This effect has no save DC and does not require a roll; it simply reveals one clue per use. The item is exhausted after this use.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the music box plays a sequence of notes that causes the immediate area to shimmer with arcane energy, revealing hidden passages or secret doors within 30 feet. This effect has a duration of 1 minute and ends if you move more than 30 feet away from the center of the effect.

kivotos_item_artifact_of_lost_notes.levelRequirementReason: The artifact's cryptic nature requires a basic understanding of perception to interpret its messages.
kivotos_item_artifact_of_lost_notes.vendorReason: Academy Armory specializes in historical and arcane curiosities, making it the perfect vendor for this enigmatic music box.
kivotos_item_artifact_of_lost_notes.shippingDetail: The item is delivered with a special aura that ensures its arrival remains secret to all but those who truly need it.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, 1 minute for 'Reveals Hidden Passages'
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or when the duration ends

kivotos_item_artifact_of_lost_notes.priceReason: The Artifact of Lost Notes is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique ability to reveal hidden secrets and provide cryptic clues, making it a valuable tool for adventurers.

connectopia_pioneer_logbook.name: The Chronicle of Chaos
connectopia_pioneer_logbook.description: The Chronicle of Chaos is a worn leather logbook bound with brass clasps. Its pages are filled with cryptic notes, crude maps, and tales of lost explorers. The ink has smudged over time, leaving behind ghostly impressions of forgotten journeys. This relic whispers secrets about Connectopia's hidden realms and offers fleeting insights into the minds of its enigmatic pioneers, making it a treasure for both scholars and adventurers alike.

effectDetails.title: Lore Unveiled
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can open the logbook to gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence (History) checks for one hour. This effect ends if you fail three such checks or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Paths Disclosed
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you may spend 1 minute examining the logbook's pages and discover a hidden location within Connectopia that is not on any known maps. The DM decides if this path leads to adventure or peril.

connectopia_pioneer_logbook.levelRequirementReason: This item's cryptic nature requires a basic understanding of history and lore, making it accessible to first-level adventurers.
connectopia_pioneer_logbook.vendorReason: The Pioneer Post has a vast network across Connectopia, often gathering such relics from lost explorers.
connectopia_pioneer_logbook.shippingDetail: Delivered by the reliable delivery trucks of the Pioneer Post within two game days.

usage.activation: Action or reaction (Lore Unveiled), once per short rest (Hidden Paths Disclosed)
usage.duration: 1 hour (Lore Unveiled); instantaneous (Hidden Paths Disclosed)
usage.endsWhen: Fails three Intelligence (History) checks, or end of the duration (Lore Unveiled); after one minute of examination (Hidden Paths Disclosed)

connectopia_pioneer_logbook.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the valuable knowledge it offers to adventurers.

teyvat_item_windstrider_boots.name: Zephyr's Embrace
teyvat_item_windstrider_boots.description: Crafted by skilled artisans in Liyue Harbor, Zephyr's Embrace is a pair of boots woven with captured wind currents. These boots allow you to feel as if you are gliding on a gentle breeze, making for swift travel and easy evasion of the grumpy pirates who roam these waters. They reduce your movement resistance by 10% and grant a small chance to avoid fall damage when you tumble or jump from heights.

effectDetails.title: Aerodynamic Glide
effectDetails.rules: While wearing Zephyr's Embrace, your movement speed is increased by 15%. This effect lasts for the duration of one short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Fall Damage Mitigation
effectDetails.rules: When you tumble or jump from a height, there is a 20% chance that fall damage is reduced to half. This effect can be used once per day and does not stack with other effects that reduce fall damage.

teyvat_item_windstrider_boots.levelRequirementReason: The boots are crafted to fit adventurers of all levels, ensuring they can assist in quick escapes.
teyvat_item_windstrider_boots.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor is known for its skilled artisans who create items that enhance the capabilities of travelers and explorers.
teyvat_item_windstrider_boots.shippingDetail: Delivered by swiftcurrent cart, ensuring these boots arrive in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next short or long rest
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends at the conclusion of a short or long rest

teyvat_item_windstrider_boots.priceReason: The boots are crafted with rare materials and require significant skill to produce, justifying their price.

teyvat_item_archon_aegis.name: Aetherium Resonance
teyvat_item_archon_aegis.description: The Aetherium Resonance gleams with a radiant, otherworldly light as it hums with latent power. Crafted from pure aetherium, this shield is said to have been forged in the heart of the Archon's realm. It not only protects against physical and elemental attacks but also subtly enhances its wielder’s presence, making them feel invincible on the battlefield. Its energy shields can absorb up to 200 points of damage and reflect a portion of incoming elemental strikes back at the attacker, ensuring that no foe goes unscathed for long.

effectDetails.title: Energy Absorption
effectDetails.rules: The Aetherium Resonance absorbs up to 200 points of damage from any source. This effect is instantaneous and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Reflection
effectDetails.rules: When struck by an elemental attack, the shield reflects 15% of the incoming damage back towards the attacker as a reaction. This effect has no cooldown but cannot be used against non-elemental attacks.

teyvat_item_archon_aegis.levelRequirementReason: The shield's complex enchantments necessitate a minimum character level to properly harness its power.
