usage.duration: One hour for resistance to all damage; 10 minutes for glimpses of alternate realities
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire when their durations end or you consume another Void Custard Concoction within the same day.

doughnut_hole_anomaly_custard.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP for its unique and powerful effects, which are limited to high-level adventurers.

midlands_item_royal_treatment.name: Personalized Healing Salve - Wario's Touch
midlands_item_royal_treatment.description: Wario's Touch is a shimmering jar of luxurious balm made by the renowned apothecaries of Midland. This salve, crafted from rare herbs and a pinch of Wario’s secret ingredient (rumored to be something illicit), promises swift healing with its potent formula. Applied to wounds or rubbed into tired muscles, it rapidly closes cuts and bruises while soothing sore limbs. The balm's effectiveness is legendary in the region, where tales speak of its miraculous properties after long battles.

effectDetails.title: Rapid Healing
effectDetails.rules: When applied to a wound, this salve heals 50 hit points instantly. The effect is instantaneous and does not require an action or reaction.

effectDetails.title: Muscle Relaxation
effectDetails.rules: For tired muscles, applying the salve reduces fatigue by restoring stamina equal to your Constitution modifier (rounded down). This effect lasts until the start of your next turn. The salve has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

midlands_item_royal_treatment.levelRequirementReason: This salve is effective for all adventurers, regardless of level.
midlands_item_royal_treatment.vendorReason: As a trusted supplier of Midlandian goods, the merchant stocks this renowned healing salve.
midlands_item_royal_treatment.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via Royal Messenger's express service.

usage.activation: Instantaneous application to wounds or muscles.
usage.duration: Rapid Healing is immediate; Muscle Relaxation lasts until the start of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when used, and it can be applied once per long rest.

midlands_item_royal_treatment.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its potent healing properties and the high demand for such a valuable item in the market.

earth_land_stoneheart_amulet.name: Stoneheart Amulet of Resilience
earth_land_stoneheart_amulet.description: The Stoneheart Amulet of Resilience feels warm to the touch, as if it's alive with the very essence of stone and earth. Its core glows faintly, pulsing with resilience that seems to absorb blows and grant unexpected fortitude. Crafted from ancient earthstone by the hands of Wario himself, this amulet is said to be more valuable than any chocolate treat. It whispers strength in your veins, bolstering both your armor class and your resolve against cold.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Defense
effectDetails.rules: Wearing the Stoneheart Amulet of Resilience grants you a +2 bonus to AC as long as it remains on your person. Additionally, when you take damage from cold sources, you gain temporary hit points equal to 10 (plus your Constitution modifier) for each point of cold damage you absorb.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The amulet provides resistance to cold damage while it is worn. This effect persists until the end of your next turn after removing or replacing the amulet.

earth_land_stoneheart_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet's resilience and durability require a certain level of experience and strength in handling such powerful artifacts.
earth_land_stoneheart_amulet.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster is known for supplying adventurers with the rarest and most resilient equipment, making this amulet an ideal choice for their inventory.
earth_land_stoneheart_amulet.shippingDetail: Delivered by a dragon courier who ensures swift delivery through enchanted flight paths.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activated upon wearing the amulet.
usage.duration: Persistent as long as worn, or until replaced with another amulet of similar properties.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when removed from your person or replaced by a different amulet of similar properties.

earth_land_stoneheart_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rarity, craftsmanship, and the legendary nature of its creator justify this price in XP.

earth_land_whispering_scrolls.name: Whispering Scrolls of the Silent Guild
earth_land_whispering_scrolls.description: The Whispering Scrolls of the Silent Guild are ancient, leather-bound tomes with intricate symbols etched into their surfaces. Their pages whisper secrets from the forgotten past, enhancing your perception and insight as you study them. However, prolonged exposure can drive even the most steadfast minds to question reality... or is it just Wario’s influence again? These scrolls were crafted by the Silent Guild, a mysterious order known for its enigmatic magic.

effectDetails.title: Perception Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Grants +5 to Perception checks for 1 hour, at which point the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Insight Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Active while studying the scrolls. Grants advantage on Insight checks until your next short or long rest.

earth_land_whispering_scrolls.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to focus and comprehend the ancient magic within.
earth_land_whispering_scrolls.vendorReason: The Magic Shop specializes in rare and ancient artifacts, including these scrolls from the Silent Guild.
earth_land_whispering_scrolls.shippingDetail: Ships via Griffin Express with a tracking number included. Expected delivery within 3 days.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Perception Boost; passive Insight Advantage while studying.
usage.duration: Perception Boost lasts for 1 hour, Insight Advantage until next rest.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the duration expires or the scrolls are no longer being studied.

earth_land_whispering_scrolls.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the ancient lore and limited daily stock of these scrolls.

earth_land_dragonscale_ring.name: Dragonscale Ring of Protection
earth_land_dragonscale_ring.description: Forged from the shed scales of an ancient Ice Dragon, this Dragonscale Ring of Protection is a shimmering frosty band that clings to your finger. Its icy core provides resistance against fire damage and grants you a slight boost in speed on snowy terrain, making every step feel like gliding over ice. When you land a critical hit in icy conditions, there's a chance the foe will be frozen in place for a moment.

effectDetails.title: Ice Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The ring offers resistance to fire damage. This effect is always active, providing a +2 bonus to saving throws against fire-based attacks or effects.

effectDetails.title: Snowy Terrain Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: While in snowy terrain, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and gain a movement speed increase of 10 feet. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

earth_land_dragonscale_ring.levelRequirementReason: This ring's icy power is accessible to all adventurers, making it an excellent starting companion.
earth_land_dragonscale_ring.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in exotic and magical items that harness the earth's raw elements, including this Dragonscale Ring of Protection.
earth_land_dragonscale_ring.shippingDetail: Delivered by a giant worm courier, which may cause delays for those not used to such deliveries.

usage.activation: Passive effect; always active while worn.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The ring is removed or destroyed.

earth_land_dragonscale_ring.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its epic rarity and unique elemental properties.

doughnut_hole_fractured_shard.name: Fractured Shard of the Central Echo
doughnut_hole_fractured_shard.description: The Fractured Shard of the Central Echo, a jagged remnant from another dimension, hums with a quiet, unsettling resonance. It is said that this shard holds whispers of other realities, granting brief glimpses into parallel worlds if held for too long. The experience can be disorienting and may cause an overwhelming urge to organize one's possessions in alphabetical order. This relic allows the wielder to perceive echoes from other dimensions but at a cost: it leaves you feeling slightly unmoored after use.

effectDetails.title: Echo Perception
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard grants the wielder advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice unusual sounds or patterns. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Urge To Order
effectDetails.rules: After using the shard, there is a 50% chance that the wielder will feel an overwhelming urge to organize their immediate surroundings alphabetically. This condition lasts for 1d4 hours and can only be resisted with a successful DC 12 Wisdom saving throw.

doughnut_hole_fractured_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's dimensional essence requires the wielder to have a solid understanding of reality to perceive its echoes without being overwhelmed.
doughnut_hole_fractured_shard.vendorReason: The center seller, known for their extensive knowledge of strange artifacts, has managed to acquire this unique relic from an unknown source.
doughnut_hole_fractured_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dimensional Courier Service. Delivery may take up to a week due to its delicate nature and the need for secure transit through dimensional rifts.

usage.activation: As an action, the wielder can hold the shard to activate its effects.
usage.duration: Echo Perception lasts 1 minute; Urge To Order lasts until the end of a short rest or is successfully resisted with a saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when their duration expires or are interrupted by damage or interference from other magical means.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one use per long rest.

doughnut_hole_fractured_shard.priceReason: The shard's rarity and unique abilities justify its price of 1000 XP. It is a powerful tool for explorers and scholars seeking to understand the multiverse without fully committing to its disorienting effects.

doughnut_hole_void_patrol_badge.name: Void Patrol Badge of Quiet Observation
doughnut_hole_void_patrol_badge.description: Issued by the enigmatic Void Patrol, this badge represents a tenuous alliance with forces beyond comprehension. Wearing it grants you minor resistance to madness and an uncanny ability to appear subtly out of place—ideal for blending into The Doughnut Hole's…unique atmosphere. When you wear it in dim light or shadows, you can use your action to phase into them as if under a permanent Shadow Step effect.

effectDetails.title: Resilient Against Madness
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on saving throws against madness-related effects. This benefit lasts for the duration of one short rest.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Blending
effectDetails.rules: When you wear this badge in dim light or shadows, you can use your action to phase into such areas as if under a permanent Shadow Step effect. You remain there until the end of your next turn or until you choose to exit.

doughnut_hole_void_patrol_badge.levelRequirementReason: This badge is designed for high-level adventurers who need to navigate the unpredictable and dangerous environments of The Doughnut Hole.
doughnut_hole_void_patrol_badge.vendorReason: Void Vendor deals in rare and exotic items, including those issued by the enigmatic Void Patrol.
doughnut_hole_void_patrol_badge.shippingDetail: The badge is couriered with top-tier security measures to ensure its safe delivery through The Doughnut Hole's complex dimensions.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (to phase into dim light or shadows)
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: You choose to exit the phased state or are no longer in a dimly lit area

doughnut_hole_void_patrol_badge.priceReason: The badge is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the unique abilities it grants.

connectopia_mining_consultation.name: Prospector's Predictive Protocols
connectopia_mining_consultation.description: The Prospector's Predictive Protocols are a rare service offered by Pioneer Post. When you deploy this block at your current mining site, it scans the surrounding rock formations and your own optimistic aura to predict nearby ore veins. The service guarantees a +50% chance of revealing hidden resource nodes, making it invaluable for explorers seeking untapped wealth. It's like having an ancient geologist's insight condensed into a single block.

effectDetails.title: Vein Revelation
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. You gain a +50% chance to reveal hidden resource nodes within a 30-foot radius of your current location for the duration of one short rest.

effectDetails.title: Geological Analysis
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that provides detailed analysis of the surrounding blocks, revealing their composition and potential value. This effect lasts until you use it again or spend a short rest to recharge.

connectopia_mining_consultation.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to all prospectors regardless of level due to its widespread utility.
connectopia_mining_consultation.vendorReason: Pioneer Post specializes in services that aid adventurers, making this block a natural addition to their offering.
connectopia_mining_consultation.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly by the Messenger Block Bot.

usage.duration: Until you use it again or until the end of your next short rest
usage.endsWhen: You use it again or complete a short rest

connectopia_mining_consultation.priceReason: The service is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare utility and the value of gaining valuable insights into an area.

mushroom_kingdom_item_gold_coin_armor.name: Fort Knox of Fungus
mushroom_kingdom_item_gold_coin_armor.description: The Fort Knox of Fungus is a gleaming suit of armor, crafted from solidified gold coins and enchanted to protect its wearer. Its surface is etched with ancient runes that shimmer with protective magic, making it lighter than the weighty material might suggest – mostly because the gold has been magically compressed into an almost paper-thin layer. This armor not only provides +3 Armor Class but also grants resistance to piercing damage, ensuring that a blade's strike will glance harmlessly off its surface.

effectDetails.title: Armor Class Boost
effectDetails.rules: The Fort Knox of Fungus provides +3 to the wearer's Armor Class when worn. This effect is active as long as the armor is donned and not damaged.

effectDetails.title: Piercing Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this armor, you have resistance to piercing damage from all sources. This lasts until the armor is removed or destroyed.

mushroom_kingdom_item_gold_coin_armor.levelRequirementReason: The Fort Knox of Fungus requires a level 9 character due to its high rarity and magical complexity.
mushroom_kingdom_item_gold_coin_armor.vendorReason: Koopa Shop specializes in rare, custom-made armor pieces, making it the perfect vendor for such an exquisitely crafted suit as this.
mushroom_kingdom_item_gold_coin_armor.shippingDetail: The Fort Knox of Fungus is shipped via the giant mushroom delivery service, known for its reliable and swift deliveries across the kingdom.

usage.activation: This armor activates passively when donned by a character and remains active until removed or destroyed.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; effect lasts while worn.
usage.endsWhen: The armor is removed or destroyed.

mushroom_kingdom_item_gold_coin_armor.priceReason: Given its epic rarity, custom crafting process, and enchanted properties, the Fort Knox of Fungus is priced at 1000 XP.

warhammer_chronocrystal.name: Chronocrystal Shard of Discord
warhammer_chronocrystal.description: The Chronocrystal Shard of Discord is a jagged, pulsating fragment of time itself, forged from the very fabric of reality. It hums with chaotic energy, granting brief glimpses into potential futures and alternate realities. Wielders must use this shard with care; its misuse risks creating temporal paradoxes that could unravel entire timelines. The Shard's power is intoxicating yet perilous, a relic from an age when time was not yet tamed.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate this effect to gain a brief insight into an alternate future. This grants advantage on one ability check or saving throw of their choice within the next minute. However, there is a 10% chance (DC 15) that this use will create a temporal ripple, causing the wielder to lose their turn as they are pulled into a minor paradox.

effectDetails.title: Evasion Boost
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides a +15% evasion bonus while active. The bonus lasts until the end of your next turn after activation or if you take a long rest, whichever comes first. There is no limit to how often this can be activated per day.

warhammer_chronocrystal.levelRequirementReason: Only those with experience and discipline can wield the Chronocrystal Shard safely.
warhammer_chronocrystal.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in relics that interact with time, making them the ideal vendor for this shard.
warhammer_chronocrystal.shippingDetail: The shipment travels through a temporal rift, ensuring its arrival is both swift and secure. However, this method can be unpredictable due to the nature of the rift itself.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn after activation or until you take a long rest for Evasion Boost. Ends when the effect is used for Temporal Glimpse.
usage.endsWhen: After one use per day

warhammer_chronocrystal.priceReason: The Chronocrystal Shard's rarity and potential for misuse justify its moderate price in experience points.

curiosity_grimscythe_charm.name: Grimscythe’s Whisper
curiosity_grimscythe_charm.description: Grimscythe’s Whisper is a tiny, unsettling charm that resembles a miniature scythe etched into polished obsidian. This cursed trinket seems to radiate an aura of impending doom and whispers dark secrets to those who hold it too long. The whispers are not mere idle talk but chilling reminders of your most grievous mistakes, ensuring you never forget them. It is said that the charm was crafted by a vengeful spirit in the depths of a cursed forest, where even the whisper of its name can send chills down one’s spine.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Censure
effectDetails.rules: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you holds Grimscythe’s Whisper for more than an hour, they must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of their next turn. This effect can only occur once per day.

effectDetails.title: Misfortune Aura
effectDetails.rules: While holding Grimscythe’s Whisper, you suffer a -2 penalty to all saving throws and ability checks that involve wisdom-based skills. This effect persists until the end of your next long rest.

curiosity_grimscythe_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm is crafted from cursed materials and requires a basic understanding of magic to wield.
curiosity_grimscythe_charm.vendorReason: The chaos dealer specializes in items that unsettle the soul, making Grimscythe’s Whisper an ideal addition to their inventory.
curiosity_grimscythe_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by a messenger pigeon, which arrives with a slight delay of one hour due to the bird's unpredictable flight patterns.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held for more than an hour.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn after holding it for over an hour or until you drop it.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, or when you stop holding it for more than an hour.

curiosity_grimscythe_charm.priceReason: The price reflects the cursed origin and the significant drawback of suffering penalties while using this item.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_prosperity.name: Coin of Prosperity
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_prosperity.description: This gleaming golden coin pulses with a warm, almost inviting light, its surface etched with ancient runes that seem to shimmer in response to your touch. Legend whispers that it brings prosperity to those who possess it, though some say it only attracts more wealth if you're already rich—Wario would insist that's the real truth! When used, the coin grants a momentary surge of luck, enhancing your chances for finding extra coins during treasure hunts and exploration.

effectDetails.title: Grant Momentary Luck
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the coin grants advantage on one Intelligence (Investigation) check or saving throw related to finding hidden treasure. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Attract More Coins
effectDetails.rules: For every 5 feet you move in any direction during your turn while holding this coin, there is a +2 bonus to the chance of finding an additional coin or item on the ground. This effect persists until the start of your next turn.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_prosperity.levelRequirementReason: Anyone can use the Coin of Prosperity; its charm and luck are available to all adventurers.
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_prosperity.vendorReason: Toad Town Market stocks a variety of magical trinkets, including this coin known for its auspicious properties among local merchants.
mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_prosperity.shippingDetail: The coin is carefully packed to prevent any accidental spending during transit. Snail Delivery ensures safe arrival within the week.

usage.duration: 1 minute for 'Grant Momentary Luck'; persists until your next turn for 'Attract More Coins'.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or you lose possession of the coin.

mushroom_kingdom_item_coin_of_prosperity.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its rare enchantment and practical utility without overshadowing more powerful items.

mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_guard_badge.name: Royal Guard Badge of Mushroom Heights
mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_guard_badge.description: The Royal Guard Badge of Mushroom Heights is a tarnished silver medallion emblazoned with the heraldic crest of Mushroom Heights, crafted from an alloy unique to the kingdom's forges. Its origins are shrouded in legend, said to have been gifted by the mushroom royalty themselves to their most loyal guards. The badge bestows upon its possessor a minor but undeniable boost to social standing among the locals—albeit one that often invites unwanted attention from Wario, who is prone to using it as currency in his ongoing attempts to avoid paying for goods and services.

effectDetails.title: Minor Social Booster
effectDetails.rules: When the badge is worn openly, the possessor gains a +1 bonus on Persuasion checks to influence local authorities. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Unwelcome Attention
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this badge, there is a 20% chance that the possessor will attract unwanted attention from Wario or other members of his henchmen. This effect occurs once each time the badge is worn and lasts until the next dawn.

mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_guard_badge.levelRequirementReason: The badge's unique craftsmanship requires a basic understanding of social interactions.
mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_guard_badge.vendorReason: Toad Town Market stocks the badge as it is a popular souvenir among tourists and locals alike, enhancing their experiences with Mushroom Heights.
mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_guard_badge.shippingDetail: Shipped by trusted couriers using the royal postal service, ensuring timely delivery to adventurers across the kingdom.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation occurs simply by wearing the badge openly.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the badge is removed or at the next dawn.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, once per day for minor social booster.

mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_guard_badge.priceReason: The badge's rarity and unique craftsmanship justify its price of 1000 XP. It combines historical significance with practical utility in social situations.

kivotos_item_chronometric_eraser.name: Chronometric Eraser
kivotos_item_chronometric_eraser.description: The Chronometric Eraser is a warm cylinder with faint, pulsating lines that trace its surface. Crafted from ancient chronal metal found in the ruins of the Timekeeper's Keep, it subtly bends time to correct minor mistakes. When activated, it rewinds a failed action by 3 seconds, allowing you to reattempt it without penalty. The device is said to be cursed if used more than three times within an hour, causing a brief ripple effect that disrupts nearby time.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Action
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can rewind your last failed action by 3 seconds. You must have already completed the action but failed its intended result. This effect is instantaneous and does not provoke opportunity attacks.

effectDetails.title: Time Ripple
effectDetails.rules: If used more than three times in any one hour, a time ripple occurs. All creatures within 10 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone for 1d4 rounds. This effect does not stack.

kivotos_item_chronometric_eraser.levelRequirementReason: The Chronometric Eraser's ability to manipulate time requires a fundamental understanding of temporal mechanics, accessible to characters with at least first-level proficiency in Arcana or Investigation.
kivotos_item_chronometric_eraser.vendorReason: The student store caters to the academic pursuits and practical needs of young scholars, including items that enhance learning and performance.
kivotos_item_chronometric_eraser.shippingDetail: Ships via standard mail within a week from the vendor.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect is used up or if the user makes more than three uses in one hour.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but subject to the time ripple limitation

kivotos_item_chronometric_eraser.priceReason: Crafted from rare chronal metal and imbued with ancient magical properties, this item's price reflects its unique utility and potential for misuse.

kivotos_item_phantom_notepad.name: Phantom Notepad of Lost Ideas
kivotos_item_phantom_notepad.description: The Phantom Notepad of Lost Ideas is a tattered, leather-bound notepad whose pages seem to write themselves in a swirling ink. Its cryptic diagrams and half-formed thoughts are said to contain glimpses into forgotten memories or potential futures—though deciphering them is as nightmarish as it is enlightening. The notepad's pages rustle with an eerie life of their own, whispering secrets that only the most resilient can understand.
effects: Chance to gain a minor illusion effect

effectDetails.title: Random Clue
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this notepad randomly provides a low-level clue or insight related to the user's current situation. The duration is instantaneous, and it has a recharge on a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Minor Illusion
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, activating this notepad as an action can invoke a minor illusion effect that lasts for 1 hour. The DC to discern the illusion is equal to 8 + your Charisma modifier. The effect can be dispelled by any means.

kivotos_item_phantom_notepad.levelRequirementReason: The notepad's cryptic nature requires a user with some experience to properly interpret its contents.
kivotos_item_phantom_notepad.vendorReason: Club Supply stocks this item as part of their extensive collection of arcane curiosities and magical trinkets.
kivotos_item_phantom_notepad.shippingDetail: The notepad is carefully packed in a protective case to prevent any damage during transit.

usage.duration: instantaneous for the clue, 1 hour for the minor illusion effect
usage.endsWhen: use ends upon activation or dispelling of the minor illusion effect

kivotos_item_phantom_notepad.priceReason: The notepad's rare and mystical properties, combined with its limited use and the time required to interpret its contents, justify this price.

teyvat_item_scroll_of_reflection.name: Scroll of Reflection - Mizumoto Style
teyvat_item_scroll_of_reflection.description: The Scroll of Reflection - Mizumoto Style is a meticulously crafted scroll, its surface shimmering with ink that dances like water under the moonlight. Unfurl it at your side to summon a fleeting shield, one that not only absorbs damage but also mirrors a portion back to the attacker, creating an elegant dance of defensive prowess and offensive redirection. This scroll, a true masterpiece from the Mizumoto clan, is as much a work of art as it is a weapon of war.

effectDetails.title: Reflective Shield
effectDetails.rules: When activated via a bonus action, this scroll creates an impenetrable shield that absorbs 30% of the damage dealt to you. The shield lasts for two turns and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Damage Return
effectDetails.rules: During the duration of the shield, any damage reflected back to the attacker is increased by an additional 10%. This effect has no save DC and does not require a reaction or bonus action to activate.

teyvat_item_scroll_of_reflection.levelRequirementReason: Requires proficiency in Mizumoto-style martial arts and familiarity with their techniques.
teyvat_item_scroll_of_reflection.vendorReason: As the official supplier of Mizu Clan artifacts, Liyue Harbor ensures that only authentic and rare items are made available.
teyvat_item_scroll_of_reflection.shippingDetail: The scroll is carefully packed in a seaworthy crate to ensure its safe journey across the bay.

usage.duration: 2 turns
usage.endsWhen: Ends when used, or after two turns if not used.

teyvat_item_scroll_of_reflection.priceReason: Crafted with rare ink and parchment, this scroll is a one-of-a-kind item, making it worth the investment.

teyvat_item_archon_favor_amulet.name: Archon Favor Amulet - Diluc's Blessing
teyvat_item_archon_favor_amulet.description: The Archon Favor Amulet – Diluc's Blessing radiates a warm, cinnamon-scented glow that whispers of Mondstadt’s glory and power. This amulet not only grants its wearer increased resistance to Pyro damage by 15%, but also imbues them with an aura that boosts morale among allies, enhancing their confidence and battle prowess. The amulet's charm is said to have been crafted from fragments of the Archon itself, making it a rare artifact of immense value.

effectDetails.title: Pyro Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +15% resistance to Pyro damage. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Ally Morale Boost
effectDetails.rules: For every ally within 30 feet, the wearer provides a +5% bonus to their attack rolls and saving throws for the duration of the encounter. The effect ends if the wearer drops to 0 hit points or is incapacitated.

teyvat_item_archon_favor_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet's power is accessible to all adventurers, making it a valuable starting item.
teyvat_item_archon_favor_amulet.vendorReason: The market in Mondstadt is known for its diverse array of unique and rare items, including those favored by the Archon himself.
teyvat_item_archon_favor_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped via the swift Wind Messenger, this amulet arrives quickly and safely to eager adventurers.

usage.duration: Lasts for the duration of the encounter or until the wearer drops to 0 hit points or is incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wearer drops to 0 hit points, becomes incapacitated, or the encounter concludes.

teyvat_item_archon_favor_amulet.priceReason: This amulet offers significant benefits for all adventurers and is priced accordingly as a rare item.

leclaire_isle_frosting_fixer.name: Frosting Fixer's Touch
leclaire_isle_frosting_fixer.description: The Frosting Fixer's Touch is a delicate paste crafted by the Dough Folk, sealed in an ornate tin. This artisanal repair paste can instantly mend minor cracks and imperfections in baked goods or even armor plating with a simple touch. It is rumored to contain fermented berries from the frozen tundra of LeClaire Isle, which only the happiest gnome can produce. Applying it grants a +2 bonus to Repair skill checks for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Instant Repair
effectDetails.rules: Apply the Frosting Fixer's Touch as an action to instantly repair minor cracks or imperfections. This effect has no save DC and ends when the object is used normally or after 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Restores Armor Durability
effectDetails.rules: When applied, this paste restores 20% of armor's durability as a bonus action. This effect lasts for 1 hour and does not require saving. It ends when the object is used normally or after 1 hour.

leclaire_isle_frosting_fixer.levelRequirementReason: The Frosting Fixer’s Touch requires minimal skill, making it accessible to all adventurers.
leclaire_isle_frosting_fixer.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is renowned for its expertise in crafting such delicate pastes and tools that enhance the work of bakers and armorers alike.
leclaire_isle_frosting_fixer.shippingDetail: Shipped by the swift magic delivery beaks, ensuring it arrives fresh and potent.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for repair; 1 hour for durability restoration
usage.endsWhen: Normal use of the object or after an hour

leclaire_isle_frosting_fixer.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its rarity and utility in both culinary and armor repair.

leclaire_isle_sugar_shard_amulet.name: Sugar Shard Amulet of Sweetness
leclaire_isle_sugar_shard_amulet.description: The Sugar Shard Amulet of Sweetness, crafted from crystallized sugar harvested in the enigmatic Whispering Swamps, radiates a sugary glow that can be seen for miles around. It's said to charm small, sweet-loving creatures and subtly enhance one's luck in dice rolls, making it a favorite among adventurers seeking both fortune and companionship on their quests. Wario assures that this amulet is 'deliciously chaotic,' drawing friendly critters near as it does the pastries and candies of olden times.

effectDetails.title: Attracts Small, Sweet Creatures
effectDetails.rules: The amulet attracts small, friendly creatures with a 20% chance per hour. Beneficial interactions occur on a successful DC 14 Charisma (Persuasion) check.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Luck in Dice Rolls
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer makes an attack roll or saving throw, they have a 5% bonus to their roll for 8 hours. This effect can only occur once per long rest.

leclaire_isle_sugar_shard_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for any adventurer, as it requires no particular class or background.
leclaire_isle_sugar_shard_amulet.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in items that cater to the whimsical and the sweet-toothed, making this amulet a fitting addition.
leclaire_isle_sugar_shard_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped by winged delivery beetles known for their efficiency and reliability within the Whispering Swamps region.

usage.duration: 8 hours, resets at the start of a long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer completes a long rest or the amulet is removed from their person.

leclaire_isle_sugar_shard_amulet.priceReason: Balanced for its rarity and unique abilities, this amulet provides significant utility without being overpowered.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_cutter.name: Crusty Cutter
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_cutter.description: The Crusty Cutter is a miniature rolling pin forged from hardened gingerbread dough and enchanted with a mischievous sprite's touch. It slices through pastry like a hot knife through butter, effortlessly flattening dough in one swift motion. With each use, there’s a delightful risk of accidentally triggering a small sugar explosion that can either add an unexpected crunch to your confection or cause a minor mess if not handled carefully.

effectDetails.title: Flattens Dough Effortlessly
effectDetails.rules: When used to flatten dough, the Crusty Cutter reduces crafting time by 10%. The effect is instantaneous and requires no additional action.

effectDetails.title: Random Sugar Explosion
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance each use for a small sugar explosion to occur. If this happens, it creates an area of minor mess requiring cleanup with no save or DC required. The effect ends when the pastry creation process is completed.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_cutter.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for beginners and bakers who need a little extra help in their craft.
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_cutter.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in tools and ingredients that enhance the baking experience, making it only fitting to carry this enchanted rolling pin.
leclaire_isle_item_crusty_cutter.shippingDetail: The item is delivered by the efficient Dough Delivery Drone, ensuring timely arrival with no delays.

usage.activation: Instantaneous use when flattening dough during pastry creation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect.
usage.endsWhen: The pastry creation process is completed or if a sugar explosion occurs.

leclaire_isle_item_crusty_cutter.priceReason: The Crusty Cutter's balance is justified by its unique effects that enhance the baking experience without granting overpowered abilities, making it a fair price for bakers looking to improve their craft.

leclaire_isle_item_sugar_surge.name: Sugar Surge
leclaire_isle_item_sugar_surge.description: Sugar Surge is a shimmering, amber-colored liquid that exudes the very essence of the Pastry Palaces' legendary confections. This alchemical elixir is crafted by the eccentric chefs who toil in the heart of Le Cleraire Isle, their hands never idle from crafting sugary wonders. A single sip unleashes an overwhelming wave of sweetness, temporarily enhancing your charisma and persuasiveness, leaving you feeling as light-hearted as the sweetest cloud.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume this potion to gain a +4 bonus to Charisma checks and saving throws, along with advantage on Persuasion checks. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Delightful Sugar Rush
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of its effectiveness, you are immune to exhaustion from non-magical fatigue sources and gain temporary hit points equal to your level + Constitution modifier (maximum 50). This effect ends if you take damage or fall unconscious.

leclaire_isle_item_sugar_surge.levelRequirementReason: This potion is accessible to all adventurers, as its effects are designed to be universally beneficial.
leclaire_isle_item_sugar_surge.vendorReason: The Pastry Palaces are renowned for their culinary prowess and the creation of Sugar Surge.
leclaire_isle_item_sugar_surge.shippingDetail: Ships via Honey Badger Courier, known for its speedy delivery even in the most challenging terrains.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage or fall unconscious
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or fall unconscious

leclaire_isle_item_sugar_surge.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the potion's potent, but not overpowered, effects and its accessibility to all adventurers.

leclaire_isle_item_dohk_favor.name: Dohk Favor Token
leclaire_isle_item_dohk_favor.description: The Dohk Favor Token is a gleaming golden disc embossed with intricate patterns of dough and flour, handed out by the Dough Folk to those who have truly mastered the art of baking. This token grants access to exclusive pastry recipes and unlocks special discounts at Sweet Supplies Guild, allowing you to purchase ingredients at 15% off and earn double reputation points for any baking-related tasks undertaken within their guild.

effectDetails.title: Guild Discounts
effectDetails.rules: Activates upon presentation to Sweet Supplies Guild. Grants a 15% discount on all purchases made at the guild. This effect is instantaneous and applies only once per week.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Recipes
effectDetails.rules: Unlock exclusive pastry recipes that can be used immediately, allowing you to craft rare pastries not available in any other shop. These recipes have a limited duration of 1 day from the moment they are unlocked and can only be used once per recipe.

leclaire_isle_item_dohk_favor.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to master baking skills sufficiently to warrant such an award.
leclaire_isle_item_dohk_favor.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies Guild is the premier supplier of baking ingredients and equipment, and only those who have proven their skill are given this token.
leclaire_isle_item_dohk_favor.shippingDetail: Delivered within a day by the Rolling Pin Delivery Service. Special care is taken to ensure the token arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous when presented at Sweet Supplies Guild.
usage.duration: 1 week for discounts, 1 day per recipe.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of their respective durations or if lost.

leclaire_isle_item_dohk_favor.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides a significant benefit in terms of discounts and access to exclusive recipes.

leclaire_isle_item_dough_whisperer.name: Dough Whisperer's Charm
leclaire_isle_item_dough_whisperer.description: The Dough Whisperer's Charm is a delicate, intricately carved figurine of a Dough Folk elder, its surface dusted with cinnamon and etched with runes that whisper tales of ancient dough magic. Legends speak of its ability to command the very essence of flour and water, allowing you to shape it into traps or shields. It carries the faint scent of regret, hinting at forgotten promises made in exchange for its creation.

effectDetails.title: Control Dough
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can focus on the Dough Whisperer's Charm to command nearby dough within 30 feet. You gain control over up to two cubic feet of dough for 1 minute, shaping it into walls, traps, or shields. This control allows you to create simple shapes or blockages that last until the duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Detect Hidden Ingredients
effectDetails.rules: By holding the Dough Whisperer's Charm and concentrating on a food item for 1 minute, you gain insight into any hidden ingredients within it. This reveals if the item contains harmful additives or unexpected allergens, but not the exact composition.

leclaire_isle_item_dough_whisperer.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience can harness the ancient magic of the Dough Whisperer's Charm.
leclaire_isle_item_dough_whisperer.vendorReason: Dough Depot is renowned for its connection to Dough Folk lore and the creation of magical curiosities like this charm.
leclaire_isle_item_dough_whisperer.shippingDetail: Delivered by a slow delivery snail, ensuring the charm arrives in perfect condition. The journey can take up to one week depending on your location.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Control Dough; 1 minute concentration for Detect Hidden Ingredients
usage.duration: Control Dough lasts until the end of your next turn; Detect Hidden Ingredients lasts 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you lose concentration or take damage

leclaire_isle_item_dough_whisperer.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this charm offers both utility and lore, justifying its mythic rarity.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_phantom.name: Frosting Phantom's Quill
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_phantom.description: The Frosting Phantom's Quill, crafted from solidified frosting and said to be shed by the elusive Frosting Phantoms who haunt the deepest bakeries, is a shimmering artifact that allows you to cast minor illusions of delectable treats. The quill also imbues your writing with a spell of charming sweetness, compelling creatures within 30 feet for up to one minute. However, prolonged use risks turning your hand into a sugary mess, as the frosting melts away, leaving only a sticky residue.

effectDetails.title: Minor Illusion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can use your quill to cast the Minor Illusion spell. The duration is up to one hour, and it creates a harmless visual illusion of a pastry or dessert. This effect ends if you dismiss it or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Charm Monster
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can write a message on paper with your quill and cast a spell of charming sweetness that compels creatures within 30 feet for up to one minute. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. This effect ends if you dismiss it, the target escapes using its action, or when the duration expires.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_phantom.levelRequirementReason: Requires second-level proficiency to handle such an arcane quill without mishap.
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_phantom.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in magical artifacts related to sweetness and charm, making it the perfect vendor for this unique item.
leclaire_isle_item_frosting_phantom.shippingDetail: The moonlit delivery raven ensures timely arrival, especially suitable for night-only stock items like this one.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action (choose when to cast the Minor Illusion spell; Charm Monster is a single action).
usage.duration: Up to one hour for Minor Illusion; up to one minute for Charm Monster, which can be dismissed at any time.
usage.endsWhen: Minor Illusion ends on your turn if you dismiss it or when its duration expires. Charm Monster ends if the target escapes, you dismiss it, or its duration expires.

leclaire_isle_item_frosting_phantom.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as a unique, limited-use epic item that requires specific proficiency and has interesting flavor and mechanics.

pokemon_item_phantom_shift.name: Echoing Phantom Shard
pokemon_item_phantom_shift.description: The Echoing Phantom Shard is a jagged relic of ancient battles, its surface etched with ghostly runes that shimmer faintly. This fragment grants you the power to phase through solid objects for a brief moment, allowing you to evade attacks or slip into tight spaces unnoticed. The shard's residual energy hums with spectral strength, enhancing your speed by 20 feet and increasing your chance of evading attacks by 15%. Beware, its power is fleeting but potent.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Phase
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can phase through solid objects for up to 30 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you take damage. You cannot use this ability again until the start of your next turn after it ends.

effectDetails.title: Evade Chance
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Echoing Phantom Shard, you have a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws and an additional 15% chance to evade melee attacks. This effect persists for as long as you hold the shard.

pokemon_item_phantom_shift.levelRequirementReason: The Echoing Phantom Shard requires a minimum level of 3 due to its spectral energy and the complexity of mastering such an ability.
pokemon_item_phantom_shift.vendorReason: Pokemart caters to trainers seeking unique and powerful tools like the Echoing Phantom Shard, enhancing their journey through the Pokémon world.
pokemon_item_phantom_shift.shippingDetail: Ships via Swift Delivery Drone within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to phase through objects and reaction to evade attacks.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or the start of your next turn after it ends.
usage.charges: Unlimited; uses do not deplete charges.

pokemon_item_phantom_shift.priceReason: The Echoing Phantom Shard is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its spectral power and rarity among trainers looking for unique combat advantages.

pokemon_item_league_favor.name: Champion’s Token of Appreciation
pokemon_item_league_favor.description: The Champion’s Token of Appreciation is a gleaming metal badge that glows faintly with a warm, golden light. Crafted from rare metals found in the ancient ruins of Sinnoh, this token not only boosts your reputation by 10% but also increases your chances of being offered exclusive trainer quests by the League. The scent of victory and slightly burnt pizza lingers around it, a reminder of countless battles fought and won under its protection.

effectDetails.title: League Reputation Boost
effectDetails.rules: The Champion’s Token of Appreciation grants you a +1 bonus to your reputation with the Pokémon League for an hour after activation. This effect does not stack and lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Exclusive Quests
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, there is a 20% chance that the next trainer you interact with will offer you an exclusive quest from the League. This effect can only trigger once per day.

pokemon_item_league_favor.levelRequirementReason: This token is accessible to trainers of all levels who wish to show their appreciation and commitment.
pokemon_item_league_favor.vendorReason: The Pokémon League offers this token as a way to recognize and reward dedicated trainers who contribute to the community.
pokemon_item_league_favor.shippingDetail: Delivered via the trusted League Courier, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until the end of your next long rest
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you complete a long rest

pokemon_item_league_favor.priceReason: This token offers significant benefits to trainers, making it a valuable and balanced purchase at 1000 XP.

pokemon_item_mystic_herb.name: Lunar Bloom Extract
pokemon_item_mystic_herb.description: The Lunar Bloom Extract is a thick, shimmering liquid harvested from nocturnal Pokémon herbs during a full moon. Its origins are shrouded in mystery and folklore, believed to accelerate healing by up to 80 HP and temporarily boost Strength by +2 for an hour. However, it might also cause unexpected side effects like uncontrollable giggling or a sudden urge to dance under the moonlight, which lasts until your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Healing Surge
effectDetails.rules: The user can activate this effect as a bonus action, providing an instantaneous healing of up to 80 HP. This effect has no save DC and is limited to once per day.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: Boosts the user's Strength by +2 for one hour after consuming the extract. It ends when the duration expires or if the user takes a long rest, with no saving throw required.

pokemon_item_mystic_herb.levelRequirementReason: The Lunar Bloom Extract is easily accessible to all adventurers who can afford its price.
pokemon_item_mystic_herb.vendorReason: Safari Shop regularly procures unique items from the Pokémon world, including this extract, due to its popularity among trainers and researchers.
pokemon_item_mystic_herb.shippingDetail: The extract is shipped quickly by the reliable Delivery Pigeon, ensuring it reaches its destination in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action for healing surge; passive effect for strength boost
usage.duration: Instantaneous and one hour respectively
usage.endsWhen: At end of duration or upon taking a long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is consumed once per use

pokemon_item_mystic_herb.priceReason: The Lunar Bloom Extract's rare extraction process and its dual benefits justify its higher price.

middle_earth_item_ring_of_whispering_win.name: Ring of Whispering Winds
middle_earth_item_ring_of_whispering_win.description: The Ring of Whispering Winds is a deceptively simple silver band, its surface etched with ancient runes that seem to hum in harmony with the forest's breath. Within the woodland, it grants the wearer advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and when worn, it subtly shifts your presence, making you nearly undetectable by the most perceptive creatures. The ring also whispers cryptic clues about nearby dangers, though these are often misleading, leading to a trail of false leads that seem suspiciously similar to Wario's infamous gold-hiding habits.
effects: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks within woodland environments
Whispers cryptic clues about nearby dangers

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth Checks
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks within any woodland environment. This effect is passive and does not require an action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of Danger
effectDetails.rules: Twice per long rest, the ring can whisper cryptic clues about nearby dangers. These clues are often misleading and may lead to false leads. The DM decides on the nature and reliability of these clues.

middle_earth_item_ring_of_whispering_win.levelRequirementReason: This ring is designed for adventurers who have already proven their skills in stealth within woodlands.
middle_earth_item_ring_of_whispering_win.vendorReason: The Elven Market specializes in enchanted items that enhance the natural abilities of those who dwell among nature's heart.
middle_earth_item_ring_of_whispering_win.shippingDetail: Shipped by winged ponies, this ring arrives within a day, delivered directly to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Permanent until removed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The ring is removed from the wearer's finger or destroyed.

middle_earth_item_ring_of_whispering_win.priceReason: This ring strikes a balance, offering significant stealth benefits while remaining affordable for adventurers of moderate levels.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_stone_of_persu.name: Dwarven Stone of Persuasion
middle_earth_item_dwarven_stone_of_persu.description: The Dwarven Stone of Persuasion is a polished chunk of granite, imbued with the spirit of a grumpy dwarf's unmatched skill at argumentation. It grants its bearer an aura that subtly shifts conversations in their favor, and when wielded properly, can even bend the will of foes who resist. Legends say it was crafted by a dwarf who spent too much time arguing with goblins – and indeed, it seems to have a knack for making humans, elves, and hobbits alike more agreeable.

effectDetails.title: Increased Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: When you use an action to make a persuasion check or attempt a negotiation with a merchant, you gain advantage on the check. This effect lasts until the end of your next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Intimidation Boost
effectDetails.rules: You can spend 1 minute to focus the stone's power by making an Intimidate check as part of an action, which has a +2 bonus on your persuasion skill checks against creatures with fewer hit dice than you. This effect lasts for 10 minutes.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_stone_of_persu.levelRequirementReason: The stone's power demands a certain level of expertise to wield effectively.
middle_earth_item_dwarven_stone_of_persu.vendorReason: Dwarves are renowned for their craftsmanship and the Dwarven Forge is known for its quality items that enhance social skills.
middle_earth_item_dwarven_stone_of_persu.shippingDetail: Delivered by a rolling cart, which ensures the stone remains polished and functional during transit.

usage.activation: A bonus action to focus the stone or an action at the start of your turn for persuasion checks.
usage.duration: Until end of short rest or until used up in negotiations.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a long rest, unless exhausted by overuse.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_stone_of_persu.priceReason: This rare item is priced high due to its unique crafting and the significant advantage it provides in social situations.

middle_earth_item_lore_scroll_of_forgott.name: Lore Scroll of Forgotten Songs
middle_earth_item_lore_scroll_of_forgott.description: This brittle parchment, its edges frayed and runes faded to a whisper of their former glory, hums softly as you touch it. The forgotten melodies it holds are said to be able to soothe even the fiercest beast, turning wrath into rhapsody, or reveal hidden pathways long lost to time—rumors claim it might also cause Wario to spontaneously break into an impromptu dance, much to your chagrin and amusement.

effectDetails.title: Soothes Aggressive Creatures
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can attempt to soothe an aggressive creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or remain calm for the duration of one short rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: When you are in an area that seems sealed, you can spend 1 charge to attempt to reveal any hidden passages. You make a DC 15 Intelligence (History) check to determine the location and nature of the hidden passage.

middle_earth_item_lore_scroll_of_forgott.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is crafted for beginning adventurers who might encounter both hostile creatures and ancient, forgotten secrets.
middle_earth_item_lore_scroll_of_forgott.vendorReason: The Shire Shop specializes in items that help travelers navigate the natural world with ease, including this scroll which aids in such endeavors.
middle_earth_item_lore_scroll_of_forgott.shippingDetail: Delivered by a magical owl, ensuring the scroll arrives safely and intact.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as part of an investigation check
usage.duration: One short rest for soothing; Instantaneous for revealing hidden passages
usage.endsWhen: The spell ends when the creature calms down or the passage is revealed, whichever comes first. Charges are exhausted after use.

middle_earth_item_lore_scroll_of_forgott.priceReason: The scroll combines both soothing and exploratory magic, making it a valuable tool for adventurers of all levels.

mushroom_kingdom_item_sticky_shroom.name: Gooey Growth Goggles
mushroom_kingdom_item_sticky_shroom.description: Gooey Growth Goggles are crafted from luminescent fungi found in the heart of Mushroom Kingdom. These goggles, when donned, coat the wearer's face with a layer of resilient, slippery gel that allows for swift, nearly silent movement across any surface. The wearer can slide between enemies or escape tight squeezes without leaving behind a trail. However, if they touch anything while active, the gel is smeared, and their speed decreases by half until it dries.

effectDetails.title: Slippery Surface
effectDetails.rules: The wearer's movement speed is increased by +10 feet for 1 minute. This effect ends if the wearer touches any surface or creature, at which point their movement speed decreases to normal until the gel dries after a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Silent Movement
effectDetails.rules: The wearer becomes nearly silent while moving; they have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect ends if the wearer uses an action or reaction, or if their movement is detected by a creature within 30 feet.

mushroom_kingdom_item_sticky_shroom.levelRequirementReason: The goggles are designed for adventurers who need to navigate the slippery surfaces of Mushroom Kingdom without detection.
mushroom_kingdom_item_sticky_shroom.vendorReason: Toad Town Market sells a variety of items that help travelers and adventurers in their quest through the kingdom.
mushroom_kingdom_item_sticky_shroom.shippingDetail: The goggles are delivered by a mushroom cart, which can be found at Toad Town Market.

usage.activation: Putting on the goggles as an action
usage.duration: 1 minute or until the wearer touches anything
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wearer touches any surface or creature; movement speed decreases to normal until a short rest is taken

mushroom_kingdom_item_sticky_shroom.priceReason: The goggles are crafted from rare fungi and require intricate crafting, justifying their high price.

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_berry.name: Dimensional Dazzle Drops
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_berry.description: Dimensional Dazzle Drops are shimmering, ethereal berries that pulse with an unstable, otherworldly energy. Each drop is a delicate balance between light and shadow, capable of briefly opening a rift in space-time. Consuming one allows you to teleport a short distance, but the destination is as unpredictable as the stars themselves; you could appear just outside your current location or find yourself hopelessly lost in an alien dimension. This strange fruit offers a quick escape, but be wary—its whimsical nature might strand you in a place more dangerous than the one you left behind.

effectDetails.title: Teleport Short Range
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, you immediately teleport up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice. The destination is random; the DM determines the exact location within this range.

effectDetails.title: 5% Chance to Inflict Confusion
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance that upon successful activation, you become confused for 1 minute. During this time, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks unless you succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw.

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_berry.levelRequirementReason: These berries are potent but unstable, requiring only basic magic to activate.
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_berry.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in exotic and unpredictable items, making these berries a perfect fit for their catalog.
mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_berry.shippingDetail: Shipped via rocket mushroom express; delivery may be delayed by up to one week due to the volatile nature of the cargo.

usage.duration: Instantaneous teleportation, confusion lasts for 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you are destroyed in the destination location

mushroom_kingdom_item_warp_berry.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, these berries offer a unique and unpredictable utility that justifies their cost.

curiosity_fate_shard.name: Fragment of Twisted Destiny
curiosity_fate_shard.description: The Fragment of Twisted Destiny hums with a cold, pulsating energy that seems to echo the whispers of forgotten destinies. Its surface shimmers with patterns of fate, occasionally flickering with visions of tentacles and goblins. Handling it grants fleeting glimpses into possible futures, mostly unpleasant, but also offers a brief reprieve for diviners' skills and a lucky break in their endeavors. Beware: tampering with such power can invite unwanted attention from the spirits of misfortune.

effectDetails.title: Fleeting Glimpses
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can hold the shard and gain a temporary prophecy. This vision is a random event from your possible futures, often involving tentacles or goblins. There's a small chance of attracting negative spirits nearby for 1d4 hours.

effectDetails.title: Divination Boost
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after using the shard, you gain advantage on one divination skill check of your choice. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

curiosity_fate_shard.levelRequirementReason: The fragment's power is accessible to those who have just begun their journey.
curiosity_fate_shard.vendorReason: The chaos dealer deals in all manner of unpredictable and potentially dangerous curiosities, making this shard a fitting addition to their wares.
curiosity_fate_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered with the same secretive efficiency as always, ensuring it arrives safely but not revealing its contents.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until used in a divination skill check
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use the shard for another divination skill check within that time frame or at the end of your next long rest, whichever comes first.

curiosity_fate_shard.priceReason: The shard's unpredictable nature and potential to bring both knowledge and misfortune justify its higher price.

warhammer_iron_grip.name: Iron Grip of the Legionnaire
warhammer_iron_grip.description: The Iron Grip of the Legionnaire is a warhammer forged from blackened iron, its surface etched with the stoic visage of countless fallen legionnaires. Despite its imposing appearance, it feels surprisingly light in hand and delivers devastating blows that can shatter stone with terrifying force. Its wielder gains increased armor class and a chance to stun on hit, making every strike both a test of strength and a battle cry for victory.

effectDetails.title: Stunning Strike
effectDetails.rules: When you hit an opponent with this weapon as part of your attack action, there is a 20% chance that the target is stunned for 1 round. The DC to resist this effect is equal to 8 + your Strength modifier.

effectDetails.title: Increased Armor Class
effectDetails.rules: While wielding this warhammer, you gain a bonus to your AC equal to half your proficiency bonus (minimum of +2). This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn after using it in an attack action.

warhammer_iron_grip.levelRequirementReason: This weapon is designed for beginners and seasoned warriors alike, providing a reliable tool for close combat.
warhammer_iron_grip.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory stocks this versatile weapon to equip legions with the tools they need for relentless assault.
warhammer_iron_grip.shippingDetail: Delivered by supply wagons, which can take up to a week depending on road conditions and local disturbances.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the start of your next turn after using it in an attack action.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon successful hit, or if you use a bonus action to drop it as part of any action.

warhammer_iron_grip.priceReason: This weapon combines durability and offensive capabilities at an XP cost reflective of its unique properties.

mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_coin_charm.name: Wario's Lucky Coin Charm
mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_coin_charm.description: A gleaming gold coin, said to be blessed by Wario himself, this charm is rumored to bring a sudden burst of luck or an unfortunate case of indigestion. Rub it thrice and you might just find yourself with a critical hit in the heat of battle, or perhaps a minor treasure find that requires careful handling. The coin’s origins are shrouded in folklore, passed down from Wario's own treasury, where it was said to have been used for both mischief and blessing.

effectDetails.title: Critical Blessing
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this charm by rubbing it thrice, there is a +1d4 bonus to your attack rolls for the next hour. On a hit, there is a 5% chance of dealing an additional critical hit. This effect ends if you take damage or if the hour expires.

effectDetails.title: Minor Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one short rest, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and saving throws against poison effects. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_coin_charm.levelRequirementReason: The charm's power is accessible to adventurers with basic combat training.
mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_coin_charm.vendorReason: Wario Direct has a reputation for offering items imbued with his personal touch, making this charm an authentic and sought-after collectible.
mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_coin_charm.shippingDetail: The warp pipe ensures swift delivery straight to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Bonus action to rub the coin thrice.
usage.duration: One hour for Critical Blessing; one short rest for Minor Luck Boost.
usage.endsWhen: On damage taken or at the end of the specified duration.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged after a long rest.

mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_coin_charm.priceReason: The coin's rarity and Wario’s personal blessing make it a valuable addition to any adventurer's collection, justifying its price in XP.

mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_potion_of_di.name: Potion of Shifting Realities
mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_potion_of_di.description: The Potion of Shifting Realities, a swirling elixir swathed in iridescent hues, is crafted by the Royal Alchemists from rare ingredients harvested across dimensions. Drinking it allows you to briefly traverse between realities, encountering bizarre landscapes and creatures that defy logic – just don’t linger too long or risk shattering the fabric of reality entirely. A sip can be a wild adventure or an existential crisis, all in the blink of an eye.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Shift
effectDetails.rules: The drinker is transported to another dimension for 1 minute. They can move up to their speed, but any attempt to interact with the environment without the proper knowledge or abilities has a 50% chance of causing them harm due to the unfamiliar nature of the place.

effectDetails.title: Random Monster Encounter
effectDetails.rules: During your time in the other dimension, there is a 20% chance per minute that you will encounter a random monster from an alternate reality. These creatures are not hostile but can be dangerous if their environment is incompatible with yours.

mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_potion_of_di.levelRequirementReason: The potion requires significant alchemical knowledge and resilience to handle the dimensional flux without harm.
mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_potion_of_di.vendorReason: Koopa Shop, known for its exotic wares from across dimensions, is trusted by alchemists to carry this potent potion.
mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_potion_of_di.shippingDetail: The delivery of the potion is handled by a single dragon courier who ensures it arrives safely and intact.

usage.duration: 1 minute per dose
usage.endsWhen: Ends when time runs out or if you are transported back to your own dimension

mushroom_kingdom_item_royal_potion_of_di.priceReason: The potion requires rare ingredients and advanced alchemical knowledge, making it a costly but limited luxury.

animatopia_ritual_mask.name: Mask of the Lost Howler
animatopia_ritual_mask.description: The Mask of the Lost Howler is a twisted visage made from the bones and fur of ancient howlers. It whispers dark secrets to those who wear it, compelling them to unleash primal beast forms. Wearing this mask amplifies one's connection with nature, allowing for temporary transformation into a beast and granting increased mana regeneration at the cost of unsettling visions and an irresistible urge to commune with the wild.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Transformation Beast
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can assume a beast form for 1 minute. This transformation grants the user advantage on Stealth checks and Intimidation checks against animals. The effect ends early if the wearer takes any damage or when the wearer voluntarily ends it.

effectDetails.title: Increased Mana Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: The wearer regains an additional 2d6 mana points at the start of their turn. This effect lasts for 1 hour and can be interrupted by taking damage, ending the wearer's concentration, or being incapacitated.

animatopia_ritual_mask.levelRequirementReason: Advanced magic users who have proven their worthiness through trials are required to wear this mask.
animatopia_ritual_mask.vendorReason: The forest market caters exclusively to those who delve into the arcane and natural mysteries of the wildlands.
animatopia_ritual_mask.shippingDetail: Delivered by a shadow owl, the package arrives shrouded in darkness. The delivery can take up to three days depending on weather conditions.

usage.activation: Bonus action for transformation; passive effect of mana regeneration.
usage.duration: 1 minute for temporary beast form; 1 hour for mana regeneration
usage.endsWhen: Transformation ends by taking damage, ending concentration, or being incapacitated. Mana regeneration ends when the duration expires or the wearer is incapacitated.

animatopia_ritual_mask.priceReason: The Mask of the Lost Howler is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare crafting materials and the forbidden rituals involved in its creation.

connectopia_gear_of_the_unyielding.name: Pioneer’s Grit Cog
connectopia_gear_of_the_unyielding.description: Forged from the toughest block-metal, the Pioneer’s Grit Cog is a testament to Connectopia's pioneering spirit. It grants its bearer resilience against the harsh realities of the frontier, providing an unexpected resistance to despair that can turn even the darkest nights into opportunities for innovation. With each successful day spent in the forge, this cog becomes a symbol of endurance and resolve, ready to face whatever challenges come next.

effectDetails.title: Increased Armor
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this cog as part of their armor, the wearer gains a +1 bonus to AC. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fear
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed by fear-based effects for 1 hour after activating this cog. The effect can be used once per long rest.

connectopia_gear_of_the_unyielding.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 10 to ensure the wearer has the necessary skills and experience to wield a symbol of such importance.
connectopia_gear_of_the_unyielding.vendorReason: The block smith is the only vendor capable of forging such an item, as their expertise lies in creating gear that embodies the spirit of Connectopia's pioneers.
connectopia_gear_of_the_unyielding.shippingDetail: Ships via delivery drone within three days of purchase, ensuring this symbol of resilience reaches its intended recipient quickly and safely.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action. The effect against fear lasts for 1 hour after activation.
usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer stops wearing the cog or completes a long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once per long rest.

connectopia_gear_of_the_unyielding.priceReason: The Pioneer’s Grit Cog is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the unique benefits it provides, making it a valuable asset for any adventurer or pioneer.

doughnut_hole_quantum_crumb.name: Singularity Snack
doughnut_hole_quantum_crumb.description: The Singularity Snack is a shimmering, ethereal crumb that seems to defy all known physics. These crumbs are said to have been crafted from the very fabric of space-time itself in a forgotten laboratory of mad science. Each bite causes a brief distortion in reality, increasing your movement speed by 20% and allowing you to phase through thin walls for 10 seconds, but prolonged consumption leads to disorientation and a lingering sense of existential dread.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as an action, the eater experiences a brief increase in speed by 20% for 10 seconds. This effect does not stack with other movement speed increases and ends immediately upon taking damage.

effectDetails.title: Phasing
effectDetails.rules: Eating the snack grants you the ability to phase through thin walls within a 5-foot radius for 10 seconds, but you remain visible during this time. You can use this ability once per short rest.

doughnut_hole_quantum_crumb.levelRequirementReason: The Singularity Snack requires an advanced understanding of physics and the ability to handle such powerful temporal effects.
doughnut_hole_quantum_crumb.vendorReason: Hole Hawker, with his expertise in bizarre and forgotten sciences, is known for selling items that challenge the boundaries of reality.
doughnut_hole_quantum_crumb.shippingDetail: Ships via gravity parcel, which may result in delayed delivery due to unpredictable gravitational anomalies.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per effect.
usage.endsWhen: Upon taking damage or the end of your next turn after use.

doughnut_hole_quantum_crumb.priceReason: The Singularity Snack is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its limited daily stock and the advanced technology required for its creation.

doughnut_hole_chronal_gauntlet.name: The Time-Twisted Grip
doughnut_hole_chronal_gauntlet.description: The Time-Twisted Grip, a gauntlet forged from solidified temporal eddies, allows its wearer to manipulate time around their attacks. Its jittery mechanics occasionally render punches invisible in a puff of glitter, but when it aligns perfectly, the target's last action is rewound with a resounding BOOM! This relic requires precision to wield effectively, as even the slightest misstep can cause your own strikes to vanish in a cascade of shimmering light.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Disruption
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder may attempt to manipulate time around their next melee attack. The target has disadvantage on their next action taken as a result of the attack if successful (DC 18 Con saving throw). This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Strike
effectDetails.rules: Once per turn, when this gauntlet is worn and the wielder hits with a melee attack, there's a 20% chance that the target's last action is rewound in time. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone as their actions are undone.

doughnut_hole_chronal_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The intricate temporal mechanics of the Time-Twisted Grip require significant experience and understanding to wield effectively.
doughnut_hole_chronal_gauntlet.vendorReason: Void Vendor holds a collection of lost and found artifacts, including those that have been misplaced in the fabric of reality itself.
doughnut_hole_chronal_gauntlet.shippingDetail: The gauntlet is delivered through a dimensional rift, arriving with a slight shimmer and an echo of time's passage.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction (requires concentration on successful Temporal Disruption)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Rewind Strike; Concentration up to 1 minute for Temporal Disruption
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends, target saves successfully against Temporal Disruption, or the gauntlet is removed
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one Temporal Disruption per short/long rest

doughnut_hole_chronal_gauntlet.priceReason: The Time-Twisted Grip's rarity and unique temporal capabilities justify its modest price in experience points.

mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_wrench.name: Wario's Precision Wrench
mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_wrench.description: Forged from solidified coin-dust and infused with Wario's chaotic energy, this wrench glows ominously when wielded. Crafted in the heart of the Mushroom Kingdom by the mischievous plumber himself, it can repair any machine with a flick of its blade… or set off an explosion that shakes the very ground beneath you. Use at your own peril and prepare to face the wrath of Wario's coin-cursed craftsmanship.

effectDetails.title: Increased Repair Skill
effectDetails.rules: When used in a repair attempt, you gain advantage on the check and can spend an additional action to perform two repairs instead of one. This ability does not stack with other similar effects.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Cause Explosions
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance (roll a d4; if the result is 1, explosion occurs) that using this wrench will set off an explosive reaction. On a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, you are unaffected and can reroll once. Failure results in a minor explosion that deals 1d6 fire damage to all creatures within 5 feet of you.

mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_wrench.levelRequirementReason: This wrench requires the user's familiarity with complex machinery and the ability to handle coin-dust, both of which are gained after reaching level 10.
mushroom_kingdom_item_wario_wrench.vendorReason: Wario himself ensures that only those truly worthy can wield this treacherous tool.
