midlands_item_warrio_s_lucky_coin.shippingDetail: The coin is carefully packed to prevent further tarnishing during transit and delivered via roller courier for quick delivery.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action (once per short rest)
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on hit
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharges after a long rest

midlands_item_warrio_s_lucky_coin.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, the coin’s effects are powerful enough to be considered valuable without overshadowing other items.

leclaire_isle_dough_folk_favor.name: The Baker's Blessing
leclaire_isle_dough_folk_favor.description: The Baker's Blessing is a delicate gingerbread figurine, intricately carved to resemble a flour-sprinkled baker with an apron tied neatly around its waist. Crafted by the Dough Folk of Le Claire Isle, this charm subtly enhances the quality of baked goods, ensuring that every loaf rises just right and every sprinkle lands in perfect measure. It’s said that those who carry it experience an unerring hand when crafting pastries and breads, even turning near-failures into successes.

effectDetails.title: Baking Blessing
effectDetails.rules: When creating baked goods, the wielder has a +5% chance to achieve perfect results. This effect is passive and does not require any action or expenditure.

effectDetails.title: Dough Folk Alliance
effectDetails.rules: For one week after activation, the wielder gains a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks with representatives of the Dough Folk, enhancing their standing within this community. This effect is temporary and ends when the duration expires.

leclaire_isle_dough_folk_favor.levelRequirementReason: The charm's subtle magic requires no specific level to activate, making it accessible to all adventurers who wish to honor the Dough Folk.
leclaire_isle_dough_folk_favor.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies is known for its connections with the Dough Folk of Le Claire Isle and frequently stocks unique gifts like The Baker's Blessing.
leclaire_isle_dough_folk_favor.shippingDetail: The messenger bird delivers the charm swiftly, ensuring it arrives within a day of purchase.

usage.duration: Permanent until expended or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed when its effects are exhausted or if the charm is broken.

leclaire_isle_dough_folk_favor.priceReason: The charm's rarity and magical properties, combined with its connection to a revered faction, justify this fair price in experience points.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_glove.name: Gravitic Glove
doughnut_hole_gravitic_glove.description: The Gravitic Glove is a peculiar leather glove embossed with arcane symbols that hum in sync with gravitational anomalies. Crafted from enchanted leather found only in the highest peaks of the Celestial Mountains, it allows its wearer to defy gravity briefly, leaping across chasms and standing firm against shifting ground. The glove's core component, a fragment of the Gravitic Nexus, limits its use to once per combat, preventing overuse.

effectDetails.title: Defy Gravity
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can briefly defy gravity by leaping up to 15 feet higher than normal. This effect lasts for 1 round and has no save DC.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Terrain
effectDetails.rules: When you are in a chaotic environment (such as quicksand or unstable ground), you can use the glove's power to briefly stabilize yourself, reducing the movement speed of all creatures within 5 feet by 10 feet for 1 minute. This effect has a save DC of 14 and can only be used once per long rest.

doughnut_hole_gravitic_glove.levelRequirementReason: Requires expertise in gravity manipulation to safely wield the glove's unstable power.
doughnut_hole_gravitic_glove.vendorReason: Void Vendor specializes in rare, otherworldly items that defy conventional physics, making the Gravitic Glove a fitting addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_gravitic_glove.shippingDetail: Ships via the Warp Stream Express, ensuring delivery within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 round for 'Defy Gravity'; 1 minute for 'Disrupt Terrain'
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next turn for 'Defy Gravity'; ends when a creature successfully saves against 'Disrupt Terrain'

doughnut_hole_gravitic_glove.priceReason: The glove's rarity, limited materials, and unique construction justify its moderate price.

doughnut_hole_echoing_portal_shard.name: Echoing Portal Shard
doughnut_hole_echoing_portal_shard.description: A fractured piece of a miniature, unstable portal, this Echoing Portal Shard is a splintered remnant of forgotten dimensions. Holding it allows you to briefly glimpse into distorted reflections of the Doughnut Hole's past, or perhaps just a really weird donut. The shard hums with residual magic, leaking fragments of time that can be both a blessing and a curse—revealing hidden passages, but potentially misleading your perceptions in the process.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse into Time
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the shard to briefly see a distorted vision of events that occurred within the last hour. This effect lasts for 1 round and has a 5% chance of revealing hidden passages nearby. The vision is potentially misleading, as it may not be an accurate representation of reality.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, there's a 20% chance that the shard reveals a hidden passage within 30 feet. This effect can only occur once every 24 hours and has no save DC required. The passage revealed is stable enough to walk through but may collapse after use.

doughnut_hole_echoing_portal_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's residual magic requires a basic understanding of dimensional manipulation, accessible at level 1.
doughnut_hole_echoing_portal_shard.vendorReason: The center seller deals in rare and ancient curiosities that have been passed down through generations, including fragments like the Echoing Portal Shard.
doughnut_hole_echoing_portal_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via gravity well, ensuring safe arrival with no risk of damage to the fragile shard.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; vision lasts for 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you take damaging action
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one reveal per day

doughnut_hole_echoing_portal_shard.priceReason: This shard offers both utility and risk, making it a valuable tool for explorers and adventurers without being overpowered.

almost_edge_item_singing_shard.name: Resonance of the Void
almost_edge_item_singing_shard.description: The Resonance of the Void is a jagged shard that sings an eerie melody, a fragment torn from the void itself. When held, it induces vivid hallucinations of endless corridors and impossible geometries, disorienting foes and sowing dread within them. The shard's melodic hum can be heard by all within earshot, and its presence alone can reduce enemy attack rolls by 10%. Holding this artifact is said to grant temporary madness (roll d6), but it also has a chance to confuse enemies for three turns.

effectDetails.title: Confuse Foes
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this artifact confuses all creatures within 30 feet of the wielder for three turns. The save DC is 14. If a creature succeeds on its saving throw, it is immune to the effect of this artifact for the rest of the day.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Madness
effectDetails.rules: Roll a d6 when holding the shard. On a 5 or 6, you gain temporary madness (roll d6). The madness lasts until the end of your next long rest and grants you advantage on Charisma checks but disadvantage on Wisdom checks.

almost_edge_item_singing_shard.levelRequirementReason: This artifact requires a certain level to wield its power safely, preventing lower-level characters from being overwhelmed by its effects.
almost_edge_item_singing_shard.vendorReason: The void merchant deals in strange and dangerous curiosities, making the Resonance of the Void a natural addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_item_singing_shard.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Rift Courier with an additional delivery delay of one week due to the artifact's unstable nature.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action when held and sung.
usage.duration: Confusion lasts for three turns, madness is temporary.
usage.endsWhen: Madness ends at the end of your next long rest; confusion ends when the effect is dispelled or its duration expires.

almost_edge_item_singing_shard.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the artifact's rare material and the risk it poses, making it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any character's arsenal.

almost_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.name: The Time-Slip Grip
almost_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.description: The Time-Slip Grip is a gauntlet forged from solidified temporal anomalies, its surface etched with runes that shimmer and shift like fleeting shadows. Crafted by an eccentric gnome tinkerer who once nearly lost his map in a time loop, it allows the wearer to manipulate time briefly—rewinding the immediate past or accelerating their movement through space. Rumored to be favored by obsessive cartographers, this gauntlet is a whimsical yet powerful tool for those who dare to bend reality.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Rewind
effectDetails.rules: The wearer can rewind time by 5 seconds, effectively moving back in time. This effect has a range of 10 feet and lasts for the duration of one action. The target or attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be displaced to an earlier moment in history, potentially missing their intended attack.

effectDetails.title: Motion Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: The wearer's movement speed is increased by +50% for the duration of one minute. This effect has a range of 10 feet and can only be used once per long rest. The user must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or fall prone due to the strain.

almost_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 8 to wield this delicate yet powerful tool.
almost_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.vendorReason: Edge Wanderer specializes in rare and exotic items for adventurers, including time-related curiosities like the Time-Slip Grip.
almost_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.shippingDetail: Ships via Phase Shifter Express with a special delivery delay of one week to account for temporal fluctuations during transit.

usage.duration: One action or until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Target misses their intended attack, user falls prone, or effect is interrupted by another action

almost_edge_item_chronal_gauntlet.priceReason: The Time-Slip Grip's balanced price reflects its rarity and the complexity of its temporal manipulation.

almost_edge_item_memory_rune.name: Echo of Oblivion
almost_edge_item_memory_rune.description: Echo of Oblivion is a small, pulsating rune that seems to hum with forgotten memories and lost emotions. When consumed, it grants you a fleeting glimpse into realities long buried, offering insights that can be both enlightening and disorienting. For one round, your mind feels as though it has been touched by the very fabric of forgotten time, providing advantage on Intelligence checks but leaving you momentarily adrift in thoughts of what once was.

effectDetails.title: Intelligence Check Advantage
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, Echo of Oblivion grants you advantage on one Intelligence check. This effect lasts for 1 round (6 turns) and ends if you take any damage.

effectDetails.title: Mild Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of its effect, you are mildly disoriented. You have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the end of your next short or long rest. This effect is not negated by taking an action to stabilize yourself.

almost_edge_item_memory_rune.levelRequirementReason: Echo of Oblivion is intended for lower-level characters who can benefit from increased Intelligence checks without requiring a high character level.
almost_edge_item_memory_rune.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in items that bridge the gap between the known and unknown, making Echo of Oblivion an ideal addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_item_memory_rune.shippingDetail: Ships via Spectral Delivery Drone. The rune may pulse more during transit, but it remains intact upon arrival.

usage.activation: Eaten or consumed as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 1 round (6 turns).
usage.endsWhen: If you take damage, the effect ends immediately.

almost_edge_item_memory_rune.priceReason: Echo of Oblivion provides a unique and potentially powerful advantage on Intelligence checks at a fair price relative to its effects and rarity.

earth_land_frostbite_potion.name: Absolute Zero Elixir
earth_land_frostbite_potion.description: The Absolute Zero Elixir is a shimmering, icy blue potion that instantly freezes its target, encasing them in a block of solid ice. Upon contact with skin or armor, it forms a crystalline shell that shatters into frosty shards, dealing cold damage over time and immobilizing the foe. This potion is a versatile tool for quick battlefield interventions but should be handled carefully; a sip by the wielder results in an instant chill, making them unfit for combat.

effectDetails.title: Instant Freeze
effectDetails.rules: The drinker targets a creature within 30 feet. The target is immediately encased in ice, immobilizing it for 2 rounds (10 seconds). On the first and each subsequent turn of the target's movement, it takes 1d6 cold damage.

effectDetails.title: Cold Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: The target has disadvantage on saving throws against cold-based spells or effects. Additionally, if the target is exposed to a source of fire within 30 feet, they take an additional 2d6 cold damage each round until the effect ends.

earth_land_frostbite_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion can be used by beginners as it deals non-lethal damage and has a short duration.
earth_land_frostbite_potion.vendorReason: The magic shop specializes in potions that enhance combat capabilities, making this elixir a staple for their inventory.
earth_land_frostbite_potion.shippingDetail: Shipped swiftly by enchanted flying carpets to ensure the potion remains potent upon arrival.

usage.activation: A bonus action to drink and target an enemy within range.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, with effects lasting for 2 rounds (10 seconds) after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The target escapes or is freed from the ice, or if a source of fire is introduced nearby.

earth_land_frostbite_potion.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the potion's versatile use in combat and its non-lethal effects.

earth_land_godly_echoing_amulet.name: The Resonant Shard of Silence
earth_land_godly_echoing_amulet.description: The Resonant Shard of Silence hums with the forgotten whispers of ancient times, its surface etched with runes that shimmer and fade as it absorbs sound waves. This amulet grants uncanny stealth abilities, making the wearer nearly invisible to the ear, and allows them to mimic a voice with eerie precision for short durations, potentially leading to unintended conversations within one's own mind. Only those who respect the balance of silence should wield this godly artifact, lest they find themselves in conversation with their inner monologue.

effectDetails.title: Stealthy Ears
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants the wearer advantage on Stealth checks for 1 minute. The effect ends if the wearer speaks or makes noise.

effectDetails.title: Voice Mimicry
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a standard action, allowing the wearer to mimic a single voice for 30 seconds. The mimicry can be used once per day and requires concentration. If successful, it confuses any creature within 15 feet who hears the voice. There is a 20% chance of failure.

earth_land_godly_echoing_amulet.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant control over sound to wield this godly artifact without causing chaos.
earth_land_godly_echoing_amulet.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in relics that harness the power of nature and silence, making it a fitting vendor for this artifact.
earth_land_godly_echoing_amulet.shippingDetail: Ships via dimensional portal, arriving within one week from order placement.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Stealthy Ears; standard action to use Voice Mimicry.
usage.duration: Stealthy Ears lasts for 1 minute. Voice Mimicry is instantaneous but requires concentration and can only be used once per day.
usage.endsWhen: Voice Mimicry ends if the wearer stops concentrating or speaks, and Stealthy Ears ends when noise is made by the wearer.

earth_land_godly_echoing_amulet.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the item's rarity and utility without overshadowing other gear.

middle_earth_item_whispering_shard.name: Whispering Shard of Durin's Folk
middle_earth_item_whispering_shard.description: A fragment of ancient stone pulsates with a faint, rhythmic hum. This shard is said to contain the last echoes of Durin's Folk and can briefly reveal hidden paths or forgotten riddles. While it primarily grants a minor luck boost, the whispering shard also causes a slight itching sensation that lasts for 1 round. Legends speak of its origin in the deep mines where dwarves once sang their ancient songs.

effectDetails.title: Minor Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can roll 1d4 and add the result to your next attack or saving throw. This effect has no cooldown and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Slight Itching
effectDetails.rules: For 1 round after using the shard, you suffer a -2 penalty to Dexterity saving throws. This effect ends when it's your turn or if you take any action other than movement.

middle_earth_item_whispering_shard.levelRequirementReason: The whispering shard is accessible to low-level characters as it provides a minor but useful advantage.
middle_earth_item_whispering_shard.vendorReason: Elves of the deep forests have ancient ties with dwarven lore and often trade in relics like this shard.
middle_earth_item_whispering_shard.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by swift-winged mounts, ensuring safe arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with ongoing penalties
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn or when you take an action other than movement

middle_earth_item_whispering_shard.priceReason: The whispering shard's rarity and historical significance justify its higher price, despite providing a minor effect.

middle_earth_item_shire_healing_potion.name: Shire Hearthbrew Potion
middle_earth_item_shire_healing_potion.description: The Shire Hearthbrew Potion is a thick, amber-colored elixir that smells of freshly cut hay and wildflowers. Brewed in the heart of Bag End with honey from the hobbit's beehives and herbs gathered from the rolling hills, this potion is known to bring comfort and warmth to those who drink it. It’s not just for healing wounds; it also subtly lifts the spirit, granting a small but noticeable improvement in mood that can make even the most grumpy of hobbits feel slightly more at ease.

effectDetails.title: Comforting Elixir
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this potion heals 15 Hit Points and restores 5 Stamina Points. The effects are instantaneous and do not require any action to activate.

effectDetails.title: Mood Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the next hour, the drinker gains advantage on Charisma checks and saving throws involving social interactions. This effect is cumulative with other similar abilities but does not stack in other ways.

middle_earth_item_shire_healing_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is designed for common folk of the Shire who may need a bit more than just the healing magic available to trained healers.
middle_earth_item_shire_healing_potion.vendorReason: The local Shire Shop stocks this beloved elixir, ensuring that every hobbit can find comfort and warmth when they need it most.
middle_earth_item_shire_healing_potion.shippingDetail: Ships via local pony cart, delivered within a few days. Shipping is reliable but not express.

usage.duration: One hour
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends after one hour or when consumed by another individual
usage.charges: Unlimited, as the potion regenerates with each new batch brewed.

middle_earth_item_shire_healing_potion.priceReason: This price reflects the high quality of ingredients and the labor-intensive brewing process that ensures its effectiveness and flavor.

middle_earth_item_mithril_resonance_tuni.name: Mithril Resonance Tuning Device
middle_earth_item_mithril_resonance_tuni.description: The Mithril Resonance Tuning Device is a delicate contraption of gleaming mithril and enchanted gears, crafted by dwarven forges in the heart of Mount Ironpeak. This device amplifies the inherent vibrations of precious metals, enhancing their resonance during weapon strikes. When wielded with rare metals, it can add an extra 5d6 to weapon damage, but it also emits a persistent hum that drives nearby creatures mad unless you know how to harness its magic.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Weapon Damage
effectDetails.rules: When used with weapons made of mithril, the device adds a bonus of 5d6 to the weapon's damage roll for one round. This effect ends when the weapon is no longer touching an enemy or after the round ends.

effectDetails.title: Magical Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the device can be activated to emit a magical resonance that affects all creatures within 10 feet. The DM rolls a d20 with a DC of 15; if it exceeds this, a random beneficial or detrimental effect is triggered on a creature in range.

middle_earth_item_mithril_resonance_tuni.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic knowledge of weapon and enchantment magic to attune.
middle_earth_item_mithril_resonance_tuni.vendorReason: Dwarves are master craftsmen, and their forges produce items that enhance the natural properties of materials like mithril.
middle_earth_item_mithril_resonance_tuni.shippingDetail: Ships swiftly via a dragon hawk courier, delivering your device within one week.

usage.activation: Uses an action to activate and touch a weapon made of mithril for the duration.
usage.duration: One round when used with mithril weapons; once per short rest for magical resonance.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the weapon is no longer touching an enemy or after one round. The resonance ends at the end of your next turn.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to reset.

middle_earth_item_mithril_resonance_tuni.priceReason: Balanced for its rarity and unique effects, this item is moderately priced for its power level.

animatopia_primal_massage.name: Primal Restoration Ritual
animatopia_primal_massage.description: Experience the primal pulse of nature as a Forest Shaman’s hands work their magic, combining ancient lore and raw power to mend your wounds and restore vigor. Feel the earth resonate through each chant and touch, knowing that the grubs used in this ritual are said to imbue the massage with regenerative properties. This service removes one level of exhaustion, heals 2d6 hit points, and grants you a surge of stamina, leaving you feeling as though you’ve been reborn from the heart of the forest.

effectDetails.title: Heal Minor Wounds
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a successful touch attack. Heals 2d6 hit points and removes one level of exhaustion. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Remove Exhaustion
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous removal upon activation. No save required, but the effect is limited to once per day.

animatopia_primal_massage.levelRequirementReason: This service requires no specific level as it is a restorative ritual easily accessible to all travelers in need of rejuvenation.
animatopia_primal_massage.vendorReason: The Forest Market, run by the local shamans, offers this unique and essential service to all visitors seeking to restore their vitality after long journeys through the wilds.
animatopia_primal_massage.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a giant snail, ensuring that travelers receive the revitalizing effects before embarking on their next adventure.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhaustion is removed or the effect is used again
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only once per short or long rest

animatopia_primal_massage.priceReason: The price reflects a balance between the unique and powerful effects of the ritual and its accessibility to all adventurers.

animatopia_stone_of_the_beast.name: Stone of the Beast’s Fury
animatopia_stone_of_the_beast.description: The Stone of the Beast’s Fury is a black obsidian fragment imbued with the essence of a wild predator. When activated, it channels raw fury into a devastating burst of rage that strikes all creatures within its 5-foot radius, dealing piercing damage. The stone's power comes from an ancient beast spirit trapped within its core, which can sometimes lash out unpredictably and harm you as well. Activating this relic temporarily amplifies your strength, turning you into a force to be reckoned with in close combat.

effectDetails.title: Raging Fury
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this stone unleashes a burst of raw fury within a 5-foot radius. All creatures in the area take 1d6 piercing damage. The effect lasts for 3 rounds and grants you a +2 bonus to Strength checks and saving throws.

effectDetails.title: Self-Damage Risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that when you activate this stone, it will inadvertently harm you as well, dealing 1d6 piercing damage. This risk applies once per short or long rest.

animatopia_stone_of_the_beast.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 8th level to harness the raw power of the beast spirit within.
animatopia_stone_of_the_beast.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar specializes in exotic and dangerous items, including those imbued with primal magic like the Stone of the Beast’s Fury.
animatopia_stone_of_the_beast.shippingDetail: Shipped by a dire wolf courier who delivers it personally, ensuring safe transport to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Activating this item requires an action.
usage.duration: The effect lasts for 3 rounds or until you take damage.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you take damage, are incapacitated, or use it again before the duration expires.

animatopia_stone_of_the_beast.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the raw power and unpredictable nature of the stone's beast spirit.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_scone.name: Glazed Goblin Scones
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_scone.description: Glazed Goblin Scones are a delightful pastry with a mischievous twist. Crafted from enchanted wheat and sprinkled with pixie dust, these scones offer not just sustenance but also a subtle charm to aid in your adventures. Each bite grants you a burst of energy and a +1 bonus to Charisma for 3 rounds, perfect for charming creatures or simply enjoying the sweet treat. A sprinkle of luck accompanies each serving, offering a 15% chance to cause a minor distraction that can help turn the tide of battle.

effectDetails.title: Energy Burst
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Glazed Goblin Scones provide a burst of energy. This effect restores 20 hit points and grants you advantage on Charisma checks for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: For 3 rounds after consuming the scone, you gain a +1 bonus to all Charisma-based rolls. Additionally, there is a 15% chance that any creature within 20 feet of you becomes distracted for 1 minute.

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_scone.levelRequirementReason: These tasty treats are designed for adventurers starting their journey and can be enjoyed by all.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_scone.vendorReason: Dough Depot is known for its wide selection of enchanted pastries, making them the perfect vendor for these Glazed Goblin Scones.
leclaire_isle_item_sticky_scone.shippingDetail: The scones are delivered fresh and warm on a rolling tray from the bakery.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Energy Burst, 3 rounds for Charisma Boost; ends when the effect expires or you take damage
usage.endsWhen: The effects end if you take damage or after their respective durations expire

leclaire_isle_item_sticky_scone.priceReason: Balanced to provide a significant but not game-breaking benefit, these scones are priced at 1000 XP.

leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_dough_alchemy.name: Dough Whisperer's Consultation
leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_dough_alchemy.description: The Dough Whisperer's Consultation is a rare alchemical service offered by Pastry Palace. This consultation allows you to infuse your baked goods with powerful buffs, enhancing them with magical properties for a limited time. For every pastry crafted, you can choose from a variety of temporary enhancements, such as increased strength or dexterity, or even summon a small, temporary Dough Golem companion to assist in battle. Be cautious, however, as the alchemist's expertise is unpredictable and the results are never guaranteed.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Buff
effectDetails.rules: Choose one ability score to increase by +2 for a duration of 1 hour. This effect is instantaneous upon activation and can only be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Dough Golem Companion
effectDetails.rules: With a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check, you can summon a small Dough Golem companion that fights by your side for up to 10 minutes. The Dough Golem has 20 hit points and provides a +1 bonus to AC. It reverts back to dough upon taking any amount of damage or after the duration ends.

leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_dough_alchemy.levelRequirementReason: This service requires a minimum level of 3 to ensure that you can effectively utilize its magical properties.
leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_dough_alchemy.vendorReason: Pastry Palace specializes in alchemical pastries and is renowned for their expertise in Dough Whisperer's Consultation.
leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_dough_alchemy.shippingDetail: Delivered via delivery drone, ensuring the dough remains fresh and magical properties intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The Dough Golem reverts to dough upon taking damage or after the duration ends; a temporary buff lasts for 1 hour.

leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_dough_alchemy.priceReason: This balanced price reflects the rare and alchemical nature of the service, ensuring it remains a valuable yet achievable option.

leclaire_isle_item_royal_crumb_armor.name: Crusty Champion's Vestments
leclaire_isle_item_royal_crumb_armor.description: The Crusty Champion's Vestments are forged from the discarded crumbs of a royal feast, imbued with ancient baking magic. This vest not only offers surprising protection but also deflects minor projectiles with a 20% chance. Though it may seem like mere crumbs, its resilience is unmatched, providing minor resistance to poison damage and granting +3 armor class. Expect it to withstand more than just goblin spit, thanks to the enchantments woven into its fibers.

effectDetails.title: Projectile Deflection
effectDetails.rules: The vest has a 20% chance per attack or spell that targets the wearer to deflect projectiles. This effect is passive and does not require any action from the wearer.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The vest provides resistance to poison damage, reducing it by half. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after taking poison damage.

leclaire_isle_item_royal_crumb_armor.levelRequirementReason: This item is crafted with ancient magic and requires a high level of skill to properly wield its enchantments.
leclaire_isle_item_royal_crumb_armor.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in rare and magical items related to food and drink, making it the perfect vendor for this unique piece of armor.
leclaire_isle_item_royal_crumb_armor.shippingDetail: The vest is delivered by magical cart, ensuring that it arrives in pristine condition. However, due to its fragile nature, it may take an additional day for delivery.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn after taking poison damage or until the vest is destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: The vest's enchantments cease when you take poison damage, are destroyed, or lose all charges (if applicable).

leclaire_isle_item_royal_crumb_armor.priceReason: The vest is an epic rarity and crafted with ancient magic, making it a valuable addition to any adventurer's arsenal while still being balanced in terms of price.

equestria_item_shadow_hoof.name: Shadow Hoof of Nocturne
equestria_item_shadow_hoof.description: The Shadow Hoof of Nocturne is a gnarled, obsidian talon forged from the darkest dreams and forgotten nightmares of Equestria. Its surface pulses with an eerie blue glow that lingers in one's vision after contact. Touching it grants temporary shadow resistance but also saps your willpower, leaving you prone to fits of paranoia. The hoof whispers dark secrets and promises of power, yet prolonged exposure corrupts the mind, leading to a descent into madness.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you activate this hoof, you gain +15 temporary shadow resistance. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn. You can use it once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Fear Aura
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, when an enemy within 30 feet of you starts its turn, it must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 12) or become frightened for the duration. The effect ends if you leave the area.

equestria_item_shadow_hoof.levelRequirementReason: The Shadow Hoof's corrupting influence necessitates a higher level to wield without significant risk.
equestria_item_shadow_hoof.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce, known for its eclectic and often questionable wares, sells the Shadow Hoof due to its dark allure and mysterious origins.
equestria_item_shadow_hoof.shippingDetail: The Dark Messenger delivers the hoof with a chillingly silent courier, ensuring it arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn or until you leave its range
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you use another version of this ability or at the start of your next turn

equestria_item_shadow_hoof.priceReason: The Shadow Hoof's rarity and unique properties justify its moderate price, balanced against its limited utility.

animatopia_shadow_charm.name: Whisper of the Night Shade
animatopia_shadow_charm.description: The Whisper of the Night Shade is a sleek obsidian pendant that glows faintly with an otherworldly light. Crafted by a disgraced Shademaster, it whispers secrets of the forest’s darkest corners to those who wear it. Rumor has it that it can make you see things that aren’t there—like Wario—but only if you let your guard down. The charm is said to detect nearby undead and grant its wearer a +20% bonus to Stealth checks, making them vanish into the night like shadows themselves.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Detection
effectDetails.rules: Passive ability that allows the wearer to detect nearby undead creatures within 30 feet, providing a +2 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks for this purpose. Ends when removed or destroyed.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: Active effect granting the wearer advantage on Stealth checks until they attack with melee weapons or cast spells. This effect can be used once per short rest.

animatopia_shadow_charm.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least level 3 to wield its abilities effectively.
animatopia_shadow_charm.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar specializes in items that enhance one's connection with the natural world, making it fitting for this shadow-themed charm.
animatopia_shadow_charm.shippingDetail: Delivered by silent owl courier, ensuring discreet and timely delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Until the wearer attacks or casts a spell, or until the end of their next short rest.
usage.endsWhen: When the wearer attacks with melee weapons or casts spells, or at the end of their next short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only usable once per short rest.

animatopia_shadow_charm.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare item that provides stealth and undead detection benefits without being overpowered.

animatopia_forbidden_skull.name: The Skull of Silent Echoes
animatopia_forbidden_skull.description: The Skull of Silent Echoes, a pulsating green relic recovered from an Animatopian temple, offers a brief glimpse into ancient rituals when touched. Its eerie glow hints at forgotten magic, yet attracts shadowy entities and Wario's ravenous interest. Touching the skull grants you resistance to necrotic damage for 1 hour but also exposes you to a 5% chance of madness each day until removed. This cursed artifact is sold by the forest_market, delivered by the Raven Messenger with a special delivery delay.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you touch the skull, you gain resistance to necrotic damage for 1 hour. This effect ends if you are exposed to a source of radiant damage.

effectDetails.title: Madness Risk
effectDetails.rules: You have a 5% chance each day after touching the skull to become mad until cured by magic. There is no limit to this effect, but it can be ended with a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw.

animatopia_forbidden_skull.levelRequirementReason: The Skull of Silent Echoes' ancient magic and potential for madness make it accessible only to those at least level 1.
animatopia_forbidden_skull.vendorReason: The forest_market specializes in rare artifacts, and this skull's origin from their territory makes it a fitting item for sale there.
animatopia_forbidden_skull.shippingDetail: The Raven Messenger delivers the skull with a special delay of one day to ensure proper handling of such powerful relics.

usage.duration: 1 hour, or until exposed to radiant damage
usage.endsWhen: Exposure to radiant damage or successful Wisdom saving throw

animatopia_forbidden_skull.priceReason: The Skull's rare origin and potential for madness make it a balanced purchase at 1,000 XP.

earth_land_whispering_herb_potion.name: Whispering Herb Potion
earth_land_whispering_herb_potion.description: Crafted by eccentric herbalists in the heart of ancient forests, the Whispering Herb Potion tastes faintly of moss and earth. When consumed, it grants you a fleeting connection to the spirits of the land, whispering advice that feels like the wind's breath through the trees. For an hour, your perception sharpens, granting advantage on Perception checks, while you also gain temporary inspiration, allowing for one attack roll with advantage. This potion is a rare find, passed down from enchanted groves where the earth speaks in secrets and whispers of lost treasures.

effectDetails.title: Perception Advantage
effectDetails.rules: Granting advantage on Perception checks for 1 hour after consuming the potion. This effect ends when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Inspiration
effectDetails.rules: Allows one attack roll with advantage. This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

earth_land_whispering_herb_potion.levelRequirementReason: This potion is suitable for any adventurer, providing a boost to perception and combat without requiring a high level of expertise.
earth_land_whispering_herb_potion.vendorReason: The magic shop stocks this rare potion as it appeals to adventurers seeking both magical and practical advantages in their quests.
earth_land_whispering_herb_potion.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by enchanted flying carpets, ensuring the potion remains potent upon arrival.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or the drinker completes a short or long rest

earth_land_whispering_herb_potion.priceReason: The unique brewing process and enchanted ingredients make this potion highly sought after, justifying its value in experience points.

kivotos_item_student_uniform_of_focus.name: The Concentrated Canvas
kivotos_item_student_uniform_of_focus.description: The Concentrated Canvas is a student uniform that seems unremarkable until donned. Its tailored fabric subtly enhances concentration, making mental tasks feel effortless. This uniform not only sharpens spellcasting speed by 20%, but it also slightly increases the chance of critical hits with spells by 10%. Worn by diligent scholars at the Student Store, this item is a must-have for those who value efficiency and precision in their studies and magical endeavors.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Concentration
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the Concentrated Canvas, the wearer gains a +2 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana) checks and spellcasting. This effect is active while the item is worn.

effectDetails.title: Improved Critical Hit Chance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when wearing this uniform. Additionally, the chance of landing a critical hit with any spell increases by 10%, but this effect cannot cause a critical hit unless it would already qualify.

kivotos_item_student_uniform_of_focus.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners to help them focus and improve their magical abilities.
kivotos_item_student_uniform_of_focus.vendorReason: The Student Store stocks this item because many students find it invaluable for enhancing their studies and spellcasting practice.
kivotos_item_student_uniform_of_focus.shippingDetail: Ships via standard mail, usually arriving within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (lasts while worn)
usage.endsWhen: The item is removed from the wearer.

kivotos_item_student_uniform_of_focus.priceReason: The price reflects its uncommon rarity and the benefits it provides to spellcasters.

kivotos_item_harmonic_resonator.name: The Discordant Delight
kivotos_item_harmonic_resonator.description: The Discordant Delight is a delicate, intricately crafted device that generates precise sound waves capable of disrupting even the most disciplined formations. Crafted from ancient, enchanted brass, its resonating core hums with the potential to muffle spells and reduce an enemy’s armor class by 5%. A true masterpiece of acoustics, it demands a skilled hand to harness its power, for improper use can lead to unintended chaos—both on the battlefield and among the ranks.

effectDetails.title: Muffle Spells
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Discordant Delight creates a zone of silence within a 10-foot radius. Any spell cast by an enemy within this area has disadvantage on its save checks for 2 rounds. This effect ends when the spell is resolved or the area becomes noisy again.

effectDetails.title: Reduce Armor Class
effectDetails.rules: For 2 rounds after activation, any creature that starts their turn in a 10-foot radius centered on the resonator has its armor class reduced by 5. This effect ends when the duration expires or the resonator is used again.

kivotos_item_harmonic_resonator.levelRequirementReason: The complex calibration and precise control required to effectively use the Discordant Delight necessitate a minimum character level of 8.
kivotos_item_harmonic_resonator.vendorReason: As a premium service item, only Club Supply can offer such a finely tuned device that demands expert handling.
kivotos_item_harmonic_resonator.shippingDetail: The Discordant Delight is shipped via trusted couriers, ensuring it reaches its destination in pristine condition and with minimal delay.

usage.duration: 2 Rounds
usage.endsWhen: Spell Resolved or Area Becomes Noisy Again; Reused

kivotos_item_harmonic_resonator.priceReason: The Discordant Delight is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare craftsmanship and the expertise needed to operate it effectively.

pokemon_item_pr_echoing_badge.name: Echoing Badge Fragment
pokemon_item_pr_echoing_badge.description: The Echoing Badge Fragment is a shimmering shard recovered from the ancient ruins of Luminous Gym. When held to your ear, you can faintly hear the echoing cheers and roars of legendary battles. This fragment subtly boosts your Pokémon's attack by +5 during one turn near battlefields, and it grants a 10% chance to increase its speed stat for an entire day. These effects serve as a potent motivator for any aspiring trainer.

effectDetails.title: Battlefield Boost
effectDetails.rules: When near battlefields, the Echoing Badge Fragment boosts your Pokémon's attack by +5 for one turn. This effect is instantaneous upon activation and ends when you leave a battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Speed Surge
effectDetails.rules: The fragment grants a 10% chance to increase your Pokémon’s speed stat for an entire day, starting at the beginning of your next turn after activation. This effect requires a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw or ends immediately.

pokemon_item_pr_echoing_badge.levelRequirementReason: The fragment's effects are designed to help trainers of any level who need motivation and support in their Pokémon battles.
pokemon_item_pr_echoing_badge.vendorReason: Pokemart is known for its wide array of items that assist both beginners and experienced trainers alike, making the Echoing Badge Fragment a fitting addition.
pokemon_item_pr_echoing_badge.shippingDetail: Delivered via Pokémail Express within three days.

usage.activation: Activate as an action by holding the fragment to your ear near a battlefield or during battle.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Battlefield Boost; one day for Speed Surge.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the battlefield ends the Battlefield Boost effect. The Speed Surge effect ends on a failed Constitution save.

pokemon_item_pr_echoing_badge.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its unique and supportive effects for trainers of all levels.

pokemon_item_forbidden_phantom_orb.name: Phantom Orb of the Void
pokemon_item_forbidden_phantom_orb.description: The Phantom Orb of the Void is a cold, obsidian sphere that glows with an eerie violet light. It is said to be crafted from the essence of defeated Shadow Pokémon. Touching it grants temporary access to the ethereal plane, allowing you to slip through shadows unseen and unheard for ten turns. However, prolonged contact can weaken your resolve, reducing your willpower by one point each minute until you remove the orb. Wario recommends wearing gloves; the Dark Messenger warns that those who wear the glove of the forbidden know what awaits beyond the veil…

effectDetails.title: Ethereal Slippery Touch
effectDetails.rules: Touching the orb grants you a +2 bonus to Stealth checks for ten turns. You can use this ability once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Willpower Drain
effectDetails.rules: Each minute of continuous contact with the orb reduces your Charisma modifier by 1 until you remove it from yourself. This effect lasts until the next dawn and cannot be removed earlier.

pokemon_item_forbidden_phantom_orb.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 6th level to wield the orb without immediate risk of losing one's resolve.
pokemon_item_forbidden_phantom_orb.vendorReason: The league store carries forbidden items that challenge players and test their mettle, but only those who are ready for such risks are recommended to purchase the Phantom Orb.
pokemon_item_forbidden_phantom_orb.shippingDetail: Ships under the cover of night; delivery is delayed by one hour due to arcane precautions.

usage.duration: Ten turns upon activation, or until removed from oneself
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the orb is no longer in contact with a willing target for ten minutes
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the willpower drain applies during continuous use

pokemon_item_forbidden_phantom_orb.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its dark and powerful nature without overpricing it.

pokemon_item_pr_aurora_wing.name: Aurora Wing of Solace
pokemon_item_pr_aurora_wing.description: The Aurora Wing of Solace is a single, iridescent wing plucked from a legendary Pokémon during a rare celestial alignment. This remarkable artifact radiates warmth and tranquility, capable of soothing agitated creatures and bolstering the spirits of weary trainers. Legend says it was gifted by Arceus himself, or perhaps Wario just really liked shiny things! When flapped gently, its ethereal glow can restore 50 hit points to a single Pokémon, and with each successful attack, there's a chance to heal allies within reach as well.

effectDetails.title: Restore Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: When activated by the trainer, this wing restores 50 hit points to a single Pokémon. The effect is instantaneous and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

effectDetails.title: Heal Allies
effectDetails.rules: With each successful attack made by the Pokémon while holding the wing, there's a 20% chance that an adjacent ally also gains 10 hit points. This effect has no cooldown but cannot exceed the total number of allies within reach.

pokemon_item_pr_aurora_wing.levelRequirementReason: Even novice trainers can carry this artifact for its soothing effects on their Pokémon.
pokemon_item_pr_aurora_wing.vendorReason: The Safari Shop specializes in rare and magical items that aid both wild Pokémon and their trainers.
pokemon_item_pr_aurora_wing.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift Sky Courier, this item arrives within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Action (must be held by the trainer)
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use; no recharges required

pokemon_item_pr_aurora_wing.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its rarity and utility without overbalancing.

leclaire_isle_item_honeycomb_crust.name: Honeycomb Crust Shield
leclaire_isle_item_honeycomb_crust.description: The Honeycomb Crust Shield is an epic marvel of engineering, crafted from lavender-scented honeycomb and enchanted to shimmer with trapped sunlight. This shield not only provides a +2 bonus to Armor Class but also grants resistance to radiant damage, making it a beacon of light in moments of peril. However, its charm comes with a price—a persistent attraction that summons small swarms of bees whenever you enter combat.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The shield grants the wielder resistance to radiant damage. This effect is passive and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Bee Swarm
effectDetails.rules: Whenever the wielder enters a combat situation, there is a 50% chance that a small swarm of bees will be summoned around them, providing a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws for 1 hour. The swarm dissipates after this duration or if the shield takes damage.

leclaire_isle_item_honeycomb_crust.levelRequirementReason: The Honeycomb Crust Shield's intricate construction and magical properties necessitate a minimum level of 9 to wield it effectively.
leclaire_isle_item_honeycomb_crust.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in rare and unique items, making the Honeycomb Crust Shield a fitting addition to their inventory.
leclaire_isle_item_honeycomb_crust.shippingDetail: The shield is delivered by Dough Depot's rolling cart, ensuring it arrives fresh and intact.

usage.duration: Until the end of combat or when the shield takes damage.
usage.endsWhen: Combat ends or the shield takes damage.

leclaire_isle_item_honeycomb_crust.priceReason: The Honeycomb Crust Shield's unique construction and enchanted properties justify its price of 1000 XP.

leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_crumb_charm.name: Dwarf Crumb Charm of Fortitude
leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_crumb_charm.description: The Dwarf Crumb Charm of Fortitude is a minuscule, golden-brown crumb that sparkles with the essence of resilience. Crafted from the very first batch of sourdough bread made by the legendary Doughfather himself, this charm not only grants its bearer advantage on saving throws against fear but also bestows a gentle healing effect whenever consumed. The aroma alone is enough to quell the most steadfast heart’s fears, making it a prized possession among those who cherish both courage and nourishment.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Saving Throws Against Fear
effectDetails.rules: When the bearer is targeted by a fear effect, they can use an action to activate the charm. This grants them advantage on their saving throw against that effect. The charm remains active for 1 hour after activation.

effectDetails.title: Minor Healing
effectDetails.rules: The bearer can consume the charm as an action to gain 1d6 hit points. Once consumed, the charm is destroyed and cannot be used again until reacquired from Pastry Palace.

leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_crumb_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm provides a simple yet effective boon for adventurers of all levels who value bravery and sustenance.
leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_crumb_charm.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is renowned for its connection to the Doughfather, making their wares imbued with magical properties like this charm.
leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_crumb_charm.shippingDetail: The Magic Post ensures that the charm arrives fresh and potent, maintaining its magical essence throughout delivery.

usage.activation: action or reaction to activate for saving throw advantage; consuming for healing
usage.duration: 1 hour after activation of fear save; consumed immediately on use for healing
usage.endsWhen: the effect ends when the duration expires or the charm is consumed
usage.charges: unlimited, as it can be reacquired from Pastry Palace

leclaire_isle_item_dwarf_crumb_charm.priceReason: The charm's rarity and magical properties justify its price of 1000 XP.

leclaire_isle_item_royal_frosting_scroll.name: Royal Frosting Scroll of Sweet Deception
leclaire_isle_item_royal_frosting_scroll.description: The Royal Frosting Scroll of Sweet Deception is an ancient parchment cradled in a leather-bound case, its edges frayed with age. It contains secrets to creating illusions so lifelike that even seasoned palates are fooled. Crafted by the Dough Folk nobility, it can conjure minor food-related illusions that grant advantage on deception checks related to culinary deceits. Rumor has it that consuming this scroll would be an ordeal more bitter than any candied fruit.

effectDetails.title: Minor Food Illusion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Creates a minor food-related illusion that lasts for 1 round (6 turns). The target is a Small creature or object within 30 feet, granting advantage on Deception checks related to food and drink illusions.

effectDetails.title: Deception Advantage
effectDetails.rules: The scroll grants the user advantage on Deception checks when attempting to deceive with food or drink-related illusions. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).

leclaire_isle_item_royal_frosting_scroll.levelRequirementReason: Creating lifelike illusions and granting deception advantage requires a fair degree of proficiency in Deception.
leclaire_isle_item_royal_frosting_scroll.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in rare culinary artifacts and this scroll is one of their most sought-after items.
leclaire_isle_item_royal_frosting_scroll.shippingDetail: The Dragon Courier ensures safe delivery, but the scroll's fragile nature requires special handling.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; minor illusion lasts for 1 round (6 turns).
usage.duration: Lasts for 1 round (6 turns) or until dispelled by an effect that counters illusions.
usage.endsWhen: The minor food illusion ends when it is dispelled, the duration expires, or the scroll is used up.

leclaire_isle_item_royal_frosting_scroll.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rarity and utility without being overpowered.

middle_earth_item_starshard_amulet.name: The Amulet of Echoing Light
middle_earth_item_starshard_amulet.description: The Amulet of Echoing Light, forged from a fallen star shard, glimmers with a soft celestial light that dances around your neck. This ancient artifact whispers the echoes of past battles and wisdom, subtly amplifying your courage in the face of fear. Rumored to have been crafted by elven artisans during a time of great conflict, its power is both revered and feared. Wearers often find their resolve strengthened when faced with adversity, though it occasionally shares cryptic musings that leave one pondering the stars.

effectDetails.title: Courage Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When you are subjected to an effect that would impose a fear condition on you, you can use a bonus action to activate the amulet. The fear effect is negated until the start of your next turn. You gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Fear
effectDetails.rules: You have resistance to the fear condition. Additionally, you can use an action at the start of each of your turns to attempt a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by the nearest creature that has imposed a fear effect on another creature within 30 feet.

middle_earth_item_starshard_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's power is too potent for lower-level characters, requiring at least 8th level to wield its effects effectively.
middle_earth_item_starshard_amulet.vendorReason: Elven artisans are known for their mastery of celestial and starlight materials, making them the ideal vendors for such an item.
middle_earth_item_starshard_amulet.shippingDetail: Swiftwind Messengers deliver with unmatched speed, ensuring the amulet arrives in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to negate fear and use an action on your turn to contest a Wisdom (Insight) check against fear effects.
usage.duration: Negated fear lasts until start of next turn; contested checks are made each turn as long as the amulet is worn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you lose consciousness or remove the amulet from your neck.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short or long rest.

middle_earth_item_starshard_amulet.priceReason: Crafted with starlight and elven craftsmanship, this amulet is priced at 1000 XP to reflect its unique properties and rarity.

middle_earth_item_mythic_ringwraith_frag.name: The Echo of Torment
middle_earth_item_mythic_ringwraith_frag.description: The Echo of Torment is a cold, dark shard with runes etched into it. When worn, it amplifies your hatred and fills you with despair. It radiates malice that affects those around you, causing them to slow and fear you. The Ringwraith's influence is palpable, and the longer you wear it, the more you might feel its corrupting power. Be wary of its dark magic—it could warp your mind if left too long.

effectDetails.title: Malice Emission
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can emit a wave of malice. Any creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the fear effect for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Fear Effect
effectDetails.rules: Creatures within 30 feet who see you are frightened of you until the start of your next turn. This effect lasts for a total of 6 rounds per long rest.

middle_earth_item_mythic_ringwraith_frag.levelRequirementReason: The Echo of Torment is powerful and dangerous, requiring a high level to wield without risk.
middle_earth_item_mythic_ringwraith_frag.vendorReason: The dwarves who crafted the shard understand its power and can provide it only to those they trust.
middle_earth_item_mythic_ringwraith_frag.shippingDetail: Delivered by a dragon courier, ensuring safe arrival at your door within three days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for the fear effect; ends when the target succeeds on its saving throw or the duration expires
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against the fear effect or the duration ends after 6 rounds per long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but prolonged use could lead to madness

middle_earth_item_mythic_ringwraith_frag.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its mythic rarity and the risk involved in wielding such a powerful and dangerous item.

animatopia_stomp_berries.name: Primal Stompers
animatopia_stomp_berries.description: Primal Stompers are vibrant red berries plucked from the heart of the Whispering Woods. Their earthy sweetness bursts with untamed energy, granting a warrior the strength to charge into battle and the speed to dodge an oncoming blow. After consumption, a burst of vitality courses through you for three rounds, boosting your Strength by +3 and increasing your speed by 10 feet for two rounds. These berries also restore 1d6 hit points, ensuring you can face the next challenge with renewed vigor.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: When consumed as a bonus action, this effect grants +3 to Strength for three rounds. It ends if you take any damage or if you use your Action Surge feature.

effectDetails.title: Speed Increase
effectDetails.rules: Consuming the berries also increases your speed by 10 feet for two rounds. This effect is lost if you move more than 30 feet in a single turn or fall prone.

animatopia_stomp_berries.levelRequirementReason: These berries are potent but not beyond the reach of a novice adventurer.
animatopia_stomp_berries.vendorReason: The forest market thrives on the bounty of the Whispering Woods, offering fresh and exotic produce to adventurers.
animatopia_stomp_berries.shippingDetail: Shipped swiftly by the Giant Beetle Courier, ensuring freshness upon arrival at your doorstep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with a duration of three rounds for Strength Boost and two rounds for Speed Increase.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end if you take damage or move more than 30 feet in one turn, or fall prone.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; the berries are self-replenishing.

animatopia_stomp_berries.priceReason: These berries are rare and potent, making their price reflective of their magical properties and limited availability.

animatopia_spirit_stone.name: Stone of the Shifting Beast
animatopia_spirit_stone.description: The Stone of the Shifting Beast is a smooth obsidian stone that hums with latent animal energy, its surface etched with ancient runes. When held, it grants fleeting glimpses into the wild: a sudden burst of speed like a gazelle's leap or an eerie mimicry of a beast's roar. However, overuse can leave you haunted by visions of untamed nature, a stark reminder that the wild is not meant to be tamed.

effectDetails.title: Animal Mimicry
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can briefly mimic one ability of a nearby animal. This grants either +1d6 damage on your next melee attack or a movement speed increase by 10 feet for the duration of your next short rest. The effect lasts for 1 minute and ends early if you use another action to activate this power.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: You gain advantage on perception checks for one hour after using the stone, during which time you can see through illusions as though under the effects of a detect magic spell. This benefit ends when the duration expires or if you use another action to activate this power.

animatopia_spirit_stone.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to control the stone's wild energy without overwhelming consequences.
animatopia_spirit_stone.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar specializes in items that harness nature’s raw power, making it the perfect vendor for this ancient artifact.
animatopia_spirit_stone.shippingDetail: Ships by night on the Shadow Lynx Express, ensuring safe and timely delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you use another action to activate this power
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the duration expires or if you use another action to activate this power
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

animatopia_spirit_stone.priceReason: Balanced for its unique nature-mimicking abilities and the risk of overuse.

equestria_item_rainbow_hoof_charm.name: Rainbow Hoof Charm
equestria_item_rainbow_hoof_charm.description: The Rainbow Hoof Charm is a delicate trinket said to be crafted from the very essence of a unicorn's horn and rainbows. It hangs like a small, shimmering crescent moon, catching the light and casting it in vibrant hues. Wearing this charm subtly boosts your luck, making critical failures less likely, while also reducing the chance of tripping by 10%. The charm seems to hum with an invisible, magical energy that makes you feel lighter on your feet.

effectDetails.title: Luck Boost
effectDetails.rules: When wearing the Rainbow Hoof Charm, you have advantage on saving throws. This effect lasts for as long as you wear it.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Tripping
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this charm, your chance to trip during movement is reduced by 10%. This effect remains active until the end of each day or when you remove the charm from your person.

equestria_item_rainbow_hoof_charm.levelRequirementReason: This charm provides minor benefits that can be appreciated at any level, making it accessible to all adventurers.
equestria_item_rainbow_hoof_charm.vendorReason: The market is known for its wide variety of magical curiosities and trinkets, including rare and common items like the Rainbow Hoof Charm.
equestria_item_rainbow_hoof_charm.shippingDetail: Quick delivery with a special courier who ensures that delicate magic items arrive in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing the charm.
usage.duration: Until removed or the end of each day.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of each day or when removed from your person.

equestria_item_rainbow_hoof_charm.priceReason: The charm's rarity and unique crafting materials, combined with its minor but consistent benefits, justify this fair price.

equestria_item_harmony_resonance_tuning.name: Harmony Resonance Tuning
equestria_item_harmony_resonance_tuning.description: The Harmony Resonance Tuning is a delicate brass instrument, crafted from the resonant scales of the ancient Equestrian lyre. Its intricate design channels the celestial harmonies that resonate throughout Equestria, bringing balance and tranquility to those who play it. When played, it not only restores 50 hit points but also grants a +2 bonus to Charisma checks and saves, soothing even the most hostile of creatures within earshot by reducing their hostility by -10% for one minute.

effectDetails.title: Healing Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When played as an action, the Harmony Resonance Tuning restores 50 hit points to a creature. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost and Soothing Aura
effectDetails.rules: The instrument grants a +2 bonus to Charisma checks and saves for one minute, and has a 30% chance of reducing the hostility level of any hostile creature within 15 feet by -10%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

equestria_item_harmony_resonance_tuning.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners to help them quickly adapt and integrate into Equestrian society.
equestria_item_harmony_resonance_tuning.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce specializes in items that enhance social interactions, making it the ideal vendor for this harmonious tool.
equestria_item_harmony_resonance_tuning.shippingDetail: The Royal Messenger delivers the Harmony Resonance Tuning with a swift and secure service, ensuring it arrives at your doorstep within one day of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Healing; One Minute for Charisma Boost and Soothing Aura
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the instrument is no longer played.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to one use per long rest.

equestria_item_harmony_resonance_tuning.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity and its unique ability to restore health and enhance social interactions.

doughnut_hole_void_compass.name: Void Compass of the Center
doughnut_hole_void_compass.description: The Void Compass of the Center is a twisted artifact, its compass needle perpetually pointing toward The Fated Place—a shadowy void that signifies doom and despair. Crafted from ancient black iron imbued with forsaken runes, it grants fleeting visions into potential futures but warns of misfortune wrapped in pastry-themed dreams. Its owner must endure a steady loss of sanity as the compass spins, hinting at the dire consequences of its guidance.

effectDetails.title: Fated Place Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can attempt to glimpse the Fated Place. You gain one piece of information about your future, which is usually an unsettling event involving pastries. The DM decides this outcome and its implications.

effectDetails.title: Sanity Drain
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 points of sanity loss. This effect is permanent until dispelled by an appropriate spell.

doughnut_hole_void_compass.levelRequirementReason: The compass's inherent malevolence makes it accessible to all adventurers, though the consequences are equally daunting for everyone.
doughnut_hole_void_compass.vendorReason: The center seller deals in ancient and arcane curiosities that often bring misfortune; the compass is a fitting addition to their wares.
doughnut_hole_void_compass.shippingDetail: Delivery via temporal echo requires a week, during which you feel an eerie sense of déjà vu.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Fated Place Glimpse; passive effect for Sanity Drain
usage.duration: Instantaneous and permanent
usage.endsWhen: The compass is destroyed or dispelled by a spell ending the sanity drain, or until your character's sanity is restored.

doughnut_hole_void_compass.priceReason: This price reflects the mythic rarity and the inherent risk of using such an artifact.

doughnut_hole_gravitational_wrench.name: Gravitational Wrench of Subverted Force
doughnut_hole_gravitational_wrench.description: The Gravitational Wrench of Subverted Force is a peculiar tool forged from an unknown alloy. Its handle glows faintly with a blue light, and its head appears to be encased in a donut-shaped frame. This wrench can manipulate the gravitational field around it, allowing the wielder to lift heavy objects effortlessly or propel themselves across the room with pinpoint accuracy. However, misuse risks creating a localized distortion that could destabilize the immediate area.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can manipulate gravity to lift a heavy object weighing up to 500 pounds or propel yourself across the room. The effect lasts for 1 round and has a range of 20 feet. There is no saving throw against this effect.

effectDetails.title: Donut Explosion Risk
effectDetails.rules: Using the wrench too often increases the risk of a localized gravitational anomaly, which could cause minor spatial distortions or even trigger a donut explosion within a 15-foot radius. This effect has a 20% chance on each use after three successful activations.

doughnut_hole_gravitational_wrench.levelRequirementReason: This wrench requires a high degree of finesse and control, best suited for a level 8 character.
doughnut_hole_gravitational_wrench.vendorReason: Void Vendor specializes in items that defy conventional physics and logic, making this wrench an ideal addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_gravitational_wrench.shippingDetail: Ships via quantum tunnel for instant delivery.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you take damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use increases donut explosion risk.

doughnut_hole_gravitational_wrench.priceReason: This wrench's unique and potentially dangerous abilities justify its high price of 2700 XP.

middle_earth_rune_of_silence.name: Whispering Stone Shard
middle_earth_rune_of_silence.description: This Whispering Stone Shard feels warm to the touch, its smooth surface pulsating with a faint silvery glow that seems to whisper secrets of forgotten ages. Crafted from an ancient Silmaril, it is said to have fallen from the heavens during an Elven war long past. When activated, it momentarily silences all nearby noise, making it invaluable for slipping past sentries or eavesdropping on secret councils. However, its magic can only be trusted so far—elaborate traps may still sense your presence.

effectDetails.title: Silence Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action within 10 feet, the Whispering Stone Shard creates a 20-foot radius of silence for 30 seconds. Any sound made by creatures or objects within this area is temporarily muffled. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Boost
effectDetails.rules: While the Silence Aura is active, any creature that uses its Stealth check gains advantage on the check. The Stealth boost persists for the duration of the Silence Aura.

middle_earth_rune_of_silence.levelRequirementReason: This item's magic requires a certain level of arcane knowledge to properly harness.
middle_earth_rune_of_silence.vendorReason: Elves, known for their mastery of ancient lore and crafts, are the custodians of such relics.
middle_earth_rune_of_silence.shippingDetail: The Winged Courier ensures swift delivery, but the Shard's fragile nature requires special handling to prevent damage during transit.

usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Ends when its duration expires or the user takes a major action.

middle_earth_rune_of_silence.priceReason: Crafted from an ancient Silmaril, this shard's rarity and magical properties justify its high price.

middle_earth_map_of_lost_shire.name: Old Map of Buckland
middle_earth_map_of_lost_shire.description: This brittle parchment, a relic of ancient days, depicts the lost region of Buckland in meticulous detail. Hidden pathways and forgotten settlements are marked with arcane symbols that shimmer faintly under moonlight. It's said to hold clues to a long-forgotten treasure, but beware—those who trust it too much may find themselves hopelessly lost in the mists of the Old Forest. Hobbits claim it once belonged to a wandering scholar named Meriadoc, whose wisdom was as fleeting as his laughter.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the map by touching it and concentrating for 1 minute, it reveals hidden paths within a 30-foot radius. You can see through natural obscurables in this area, such as fog or darkness, but not through magical effects like illusions. This effect ends if you leave the area or are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Minor Navigation Bonus
effectDetails.rules: While using the map to navigate, you have advantage on saving throws against being lost in unfamiliar terrain within 1 mile of Buckland. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once). Regaining uses requires 8 hours of rest.

middle_earth_map_of_lost_shire.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least second-level spellcasting to properly utilize the map's ancient magic.
middle_earth_map_of_lost_shire.vendorReason: The Shire Shop is well-known for its collection of rare and antique items, including relics from the region’s rich history.
middle_earth_map_of_lost_shire.shippingDetail: Ships via Hobbit Post with a 24-hour delivery time. Maps are rolled to prevent damage during transit.

usage.activation: As an action, you touch the map and concentrate for 1 minute.
usage.duration: One minute of concentration; ends if you leave the area or become incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: Concentration is interrupted or you leave the area.

middle_earth_map_of_lost_shire.priceReason: Balanced price for a rare and valuable relic that provides both utility and lore.

doughnut_hole_gravitational_boots.name: Boot of Minor Inversion
doughnut_hole_gravitational_boots.description: The Boot of Minor Inversion is crafted from the twisted metal of an ancient void-forged device, its soles lined with a strange, shimmering material that seems to shift between states. These boots allow you to briefly invert your personal gravitational field, sending nearby objects floating upward and causing you to leap higher than ever before. A disgruntled void-dweller's whimsy has given these boots the power to cause both laughter and chaos in any battle or social setting.

effectDetails.title: Briefly Invert Gravity
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can briefly invert their personal gravitational field. Within a 5-foot radius, all objects not held or worn by creatures are lifted into the air for up to 10 seconds. This effect has no save DC and can be used three times per day.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Jump Height
effectDetails.rules: The wearer's jump height is increased by 50% while wearing these boots. This effect is active as long as the wearer remains in motion, up to a maximum of 10 feet higher than normal jumps.

doughnut_hole_gravitational_boots.levelRequirementReason: The spell-like effects require a moderate understanding of magic and physical manipulation beyond basic levels.
doughnut_hole_gravitational_boots.vendorReason: Center Seller is known for their eclectic collection of rare and whimsical items, often sourced from the most obscure corners of the multiverse.
doughnut_hole_gravitational_boots.shippingDetail: Ships via a time-displaced courier, arriving in your location exactly one hour after purchase. Delivery can only occur on non-leap seconds.

usage.activation: Bonus action to invert gravity; as long as you are moving for enhanced jump height
usage.duration: Instantaneous inversion; up to 10 feet higher while moving for enhanced jumps
usage.endsWhen: Upon completion of the effect or if wearer ceases movement, respectively

doughnut_hole_gravitational_boots.priceReason: The materials and craftsmanship required to create these boots are highly specialized and rare.

connectopia_shard_of_echo.name: Echo Fragment
connectopia_shard_of_echo.description: The Echo Fragment is a crystalline shard that hums faintly, its surface etched with the echoes of forgotten miners. When held close to your ear, it amplifies subtle sounds, making distant whispers and ambient murmurs audibly clear. A rare find from the oldest mines, this fragment occasionally releases ghostly impressions of past events, offering fleeting glimpses into the lives of those who once worked these veins. It’s surprisingly heavy for its size, a testament to the ancient power it holds.

effectDetails.title: Amplified Sounds
effectDetails.rules: When you hold the Echo Fragment close to your ear, you gain advantage on Perception checks related to hearing. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Occasional Ghostly Echo
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, you can activate the Echo Fragment to hear a brief, ghostly echo of an event from the past. This echo provides insight into a nearby location's history but does not grant advantage on checks.

connectopia_shard_of_echo.levelRequirementReason: The Echo Fragment is accessible to beginners as it requires minimal concentration and training.
connectopia_shard_of_echo.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in rare artifacts from the oldest mines, making this item a natural fit for their stock.
connectopia_shard_of_echo.shippingDetail: Ships via Delivery Truck within three days of order placement.

usage.activation: Active (requires holding close to your ear)
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or until you stop holding it.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop holding the Echo Fragment or at the start of your next turn.
