kivotos_item_jade_render_certificate_of_.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly by the academy's drone fleet, ensuring that students receive their Certificates of Luminescence promptly.

usage.duration: 1 Minute
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the user takes another action on their turn

kivotos_item_jade_render_certificate_of_.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its limited availability and academic utility.

kivotos_item_mk83_graduate_certificates_.name: Mk.83 Graduate Certificates of Discord
kivotos_item_mk83_graduate_certificates_.description: The Mk.83 Graduate Certificates of Discord are issued by the enigmatic 'Order of Disruptive Thought,' a clandestine society known for its ability to sow confusion and dissent among intellects. Each certificate, stamped with a stylized graduation cap and a miniature symbol of chaotic energy, emits an invisible field that subtly destabilizes logical thought patterns in nearby individuals, making it perfectly suited for challenging authority or inciting controlled intellectual disagreement during gatherings.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Influence
effectDetails.rules: On activation, the certificate emits a subtle field that causes nearby individuals to experience temporary confusion. This effect lasts for 1 minute and has a range of 30 feet. Creatures within this area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become incapacitated until the duration ends. The effect can be ended early by being damaged.

effectDetails.title: Logical Disarray
effectDetails.rules: For every certificate used, there is a +20% chance that an unintended consequence occurs, such as increased charisma but with a 30% risk of accidentally embarrassing oneself or others. This effect persists for the duration of the certificate's influence.

kivotos_item_mk83_graduate_certificates_.levelRequirementReason: The Certificates are designed to be accessible to those with basic understanding and experience in disruptive thought, as they rely on subtle magical properties.
kivotos_item_mk83_graduate_certificates_.vendorReason: Club Supply specializes in items that enhance social interactions and gatherings, making these certificates a natural addition to their inventory.
kivotos_item_mk83_graduate_certificates_.shippingDetail: The Shadow Courier ensures the Certificates arrive safely but with a slight delay due to their sensitive nature.

usage.duration: 1 minute, until interrupted or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when it is damaged
usage.charges: Unlimited, each use expends one charge

kivotos_item_mk83_graduate_certificates_.priceReason: Balanced at this price point to reflect its moderate rarity and the subtle but effective disruption it causes.

kivotos_item_graduate_certificate_of_hal.name: Graduate Certificate of Halos Prime
kivotos_item_graduate_certificate_of_hal.description: The Graduate Certificate of Halos Prime is a meticulously crafted document by the Academy's elite halo engineers. It contains a fragment of pure halo energy that can be activated to project a protective aura around its bearer, enhancing their perception and awareness in perilous environments. The document’s invisibility effect is most potent in dimly lit areas, making it ideal for navigating upper corridors safely and discreetly within the academy.

effectDetails.title: Protective Halo Aura
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, creating an aura that provides a +2 bonus to AC and resistance to mental damage for up to 1 minute. Ends if the user takes any hostile action.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect providing advantage on perception checks in dimly lit areas. This effect is permanent, but only active within such conditions.

kivotos_item_graduate_certificate_of_hal.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 5 to activate the protective aura due to the item's complexity and power.
kivotos_item_graduate_certificate_of_hal.vendorReason: The academy armory specializes in high-end items, including this unique document from its elite engineers.
kivotos_item_graduate_certificate_of_hal.shippingDetail: Ships via a secure courier with tracking; delivery typically takes 3 days within the academy grounds.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate halo aura
usage.duration: 1 minute, ends if hostile actions are taken
usage.endsWhen: Ends or is expended upon taking any hostile action

kivotos_item_graduate_certificate_of_hal.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's mythic rarity and utility for navigating academy corridors safely.

internet_item_hyperlink_distortion_binde.name: The Hyperlink Distortion Binder
internet_item_hyperlink_distortion_binde.description: The Hyperlink Distortion Binder is a crimson-bound tome, its pages etched with arcane symbols that shimmer with compressed memes and viral sensations. When opened, it warps the viewer's perception, momentarily distorting reality into fractured echoes of the internet past, revealing long-forgotten trends and twisted realities. The binder grants fleeting insights into data tribes, enhancing charisma in their presence, yet its power is limited to brief moments before dissipating into mere static.

effectDetails.title: Charismatic Data Tribes
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the binder grants +2 Charisma for 1 minute. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or when your next short rest begins.

effectDetails.title: Visual Distortion
effectDetails.rules: As an instantaneous effect on interaction with pages of the binder, it causes minor visual distortions for 5 seconds. These distortions last until they naturally fade away and do not require a saving throw to resist.

internet_item_hyperlink_distortion_binde.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant experience to harness such complex and unstable data.
internet_item_hyperlink_distortion_binde.vendorReason: Pixel Shop specializes in unique and rare technological curiosities, making the Hyperlink Distortion Binder a fitting addition to their inventory.
internet_item_hyperlink_distortion_binde.shippingDetail: Ships via fast-drone courier with same-day delivery within major cities.

usage.activation: Bonus action on interaction with pages of the binder.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until incapacitated, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you are incapacitated or at the beginning of your next short rest.

internet_item_hyperlink_distortion_binde.priceReason: The Hyperlink Distortion Binder's rarity and unique functionality justify its price, offering a balanced value for players seeking to enhance their charisma in specific situations.

internet_item_divine_link_nexus_fragment.name: The Divine Link Nexus Fragment
internet_item_divine_link_nexus_fragment.description: The Divine Link Nexus Fragment, a shimmering obsidian shard recovered from the forgotten corners of the Deep Web, pulses with an ethereal glow. This relic allows you to momentarily tap into the core stream of viral information, granting precognitive glimpses of trending content and enhancing your ability to navigate the ever-changing digital landscape. Holding this fragment can provide resistance to information overload and allow temporary communication with network ghosts.

effectDetails.title: Precognitive Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to attempt a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to gain precognitive knowledge of trending content. This effect is usable once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Data Processing
effectDetails.rules: While holding the fragment, you gain a +3 bonus to all Intelligence checks related to data processing and analysis. This bonus does not stack with similar abilities.

internet_item_divine_link_nexus_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Any level character can benefit from this fragment's unique connection to the digital world.
internet_item_divine_link_nexus_fragment.vendorReason: The cyber_market specializes in rare and exotic items related to the Deep Web and virtual realms, making it a logical place for such an artifact.
internet_item_divine_link_nexus_fragment.shippingDetail: This item is shipped via secure Quantum Courier with enhanced delivery handling to ensure safe arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use it or at the start of your next turn if you do not take an action related to data processing.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but usable once per long rest.

internet_item_divine_link_nexus_fragment.priceReason: This fragment's balanced price reflects its unique connection to the digital world and its limited utility in enhancing specific skills.

internet_item_compressed_meme_cascade_sc.name: Compressed Meme Cascade Scroll
internet_item_compressed_meme_cascade_sc.description: This intricately woven scroll, a relic of internet lore, contains an alchemical brew of iconic memes and jokes. Upon activation, it unleashes a chaotic cascade of visual and auditory stimuli that can leave even the most stoic warrior speechless with laughter. The resulting wave of absurdity not only damages enemies but also saps their willpower, leaving them distracted for several rounds. Use it wisely; prolonged exposure might just make you question reality itself.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Visual and Auditory Assault
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the scroll unleashes a torrent of memes and jokes that deal 50 necrotic damage to all creatures in a 10-foot radius. Creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Enemies Distracted
effectDetails.rules: All enemies within the area of effect are subjected to a 'Distracted' condition, which lasts for 3 turns. During this time, they have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks that require concentration.

internet_item_compressed_meme_cascade_sc.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for any brave soul to carry into battle, but only those with a strong will can resist the scroll's effects.
internet_item_compressed_meme_cascade_sc.vendorReason: The data dealer specializes in rare and exotic items from the digital realm, making this scroll an ideal addition to their inventory.
internet_item_compressed_meme_cascade_sc.shippingDetail: Ships via Courier Bot’s express delivery service. Delivery can be delayed by up to 24 hours due to the delicate nature of the item.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, duration lasts until all creatures within the area are no longer affected.
usage.endsWhen: The scroll is destroyed once its effects have concluded or if a creature successfully saves against the 'Distracted' condition.

internet_item_compressed_meme_cascade_sc.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this scroll offers a unique and powerful utility for any party, making it a worthwhile investment.

warhammer_item_crimson-skull-banner-eate.name: The Crimson Skull Banner Eater
warhammer_item_crimson-skull-banner-eate.description: The Crimson Skull Banner Eater, a fearsome banner woven from the pulverized bones of countless skull beasts, exudes an aura that sends shivers down the spines of its beholders. When unfurled in battle, it emits a low, rhythmic pulse that induces primal terror among enemies, causing them to falter and lose their edge. This macabre artifact not only saps away 10% of an enemy's attack power but also has a chance to paralyze foes weaker than you by half your level.

effectDetails.title: Aura of Terror
effectDetails.rules: When unfurled, the banner emits a low, rhythmic pulse that induces fear within a small radius. Enemies within this area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Weakened Attack
effectDetails.rules: Enemies struck by attacks while within the banner's aura have their attack power reduced by 10%. This effect persists until the end of the creature’s next turn.

warhammer_item_crimson-skull-banner-eate.levelRequirementReason: The banner requires a significant level to wield effectively, as it demands a deep understanding of fear and terror.
warhammer_item_crimson-skull-banner-eate.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory supplies this unique artifact to those who can afford its power and the training required to use it.
warhammer_item_crimson-skull-banner-eate.shippingDetail: The banner is carefully delivered by drone, ensuring it reaches its destination in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect on enemies within a small radius; aura persists until the end of your next turn or when you dismiss it.
usage.endsWhen: The aura dissipates at the start of your next turn, or you can dismiss it as an action.

warhammer_item_crimson-skull-banner-eate.priceReason: The banner's unique properties and the training required to use it justify its high price in XP.

warhammer_item_ethereal-shade-whisperer.name: The Ethereal Shade Whisperer
warhammer_item_ethereal-shade-whisperer.description: The Ethereal Shade Whisperer is a delicate amulet forged from obsidian and shadow, capturing the whispers of restless spirits within its core. This artifact allows the wearer to briefly commune with spectral entities, revealing hidden pathways and forgotten secrets. However, the knowledge gained comes at a cost; there's a small chance that each use will induce temporary madness, clouding judgment for an hour. The amulet also grants a 15% reduction in damage taken from undead creatures.

effectDetails.title: Commune with Spirits
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wearer can attempt to commune with the spirits. This allows them to reveal hidden passages and forgotten secrets within a 30-foot radius. The DC for any Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check made as part of this effect is 15. There's a 20% chance that each successful use grants an additional insight, but there's also a 10% chance it induces temporary madness, reducing the wearer’s Charisma by 2 for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Undead Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this amulet, the wearer gains a +5 bonus to saving throws against undead creatures. This effect lasts until the end of their next long rest.

warhammer_item_ethereal-shade-whisperer.levelRequirementReason: This item requires no minimum level as it is designed for all adventurers who might encounter hidden dangers and need extra protection.
warhammer_item_ethereal-shade-whisperer.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer, known for their dealings in the supernatural, would naturally stock an artifact that allows one to commune with spirits.
warhammer_item_ethereal-shade-whisperer.shippingDetail: Shipped under moonlight, ensuring the secrecy of its delivery and the wearer’s privacy.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the end of the next long rest if a successful saving throw is made.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer successfully makes a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check, or at the start of their next turn after an unsuccessful one.
usage.charges: Unlimited; recharges on a long rest.

warhammer_item_ethereal-shade-whisperer.priceReason: The item’s rarity and unique abilities justify its price, offering significant utility to adventurers while maintaining balance within the game economy.

warhammer_item_fate-forge-mk-7-temporal-.name: Mk.7 Fate Forge Temporal Resonator
warhammer_item_fate-forge-mk-7-temporal-.description: The Mk.7 Fate Forge Temporal Resonator hums with the raw energy of a dying star, its surface etched with intricate patterns that shimmer like the auroras of old. This weapon bends time itself to enhance its wielder's movements, allowing them to strike with blinding speed and precision. Yet, those who overuse it risk becoming trapped in a temporal loop, their actions repeating in an endless cycle of paradoxes.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants the wielder a +20 temporary modifier to Dexterity (Acrobatics and Sleight of Hand checks only) for 1 minute. The duration can be extended by an additional 30 seconds with a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Paradox Rewind
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when the wielder is targeted by a temporal effect or would suffer from a temporal displacement. The reaction allows the wielder to negate the effect and revert their last action, effectively undoing any damage or effects it might have caused.

warhammer_item_fate-forge-mk-7-temporal-.levelRequirementReason: The complex mechanics of the Temporal Resonator require significant experience to control its power without causing harm.
warhammer_item_fate-forge-mk-7-temporal-.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in crafting items that manipulate time and space, making them a logical provider for this unique piece of equipment.
warhammer_item_fate-forge-mk-7-temporal-.shippingDetail: Ships via time-displaced courier, ensuring the item arrives safely but may experience slight temporal delays during transit.

usage.duration: 1 minute (extendable)
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect is extended or the user is no longer proficient with the weapon.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to negate any temporal displacement effects

warhammer_item_fate-forge-mk-7-temporal-.priceReason: Balanced at this price point as it provides significant buffs and defensive capabilities without overpowered functionality.

faerun_item_blessed_potions_of_silverstr.name: The Blessed Potions of Silverstream
faerun_item_blessed_potions_of_silverstr.description: The Blessed Potions of Silverstream are crystalline and shimmer with a silvery luster, each drop infused with the sacred essence of the River Silverstream. This ethereal liquid is said to cleanse wounds touched by shadow or blight, offering swift recovery for grievous injuries. The river's magic whispers promises of resilience against the creeping touch of death, granting temporary resistance to necrotic damage and bolstering one’s resolve in moments of despair.

effectDetails.title: Swift Recovery
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the potion restores 30 hit points to the imbiber. This effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after imbibing, the drinker gains temporary resistance to necrotic damage equal to half their proficiency bonus (minimum +2). This benefit ends if they take any necrotic damage or when the duration expires.

faerun_item_blessed_potions_of_silverstr.levelRequirementReason: These potions are designed for adventurers of all levels, providing immediate aid in dire situations.
faerun_item_blessed_potions_of_silverstr.vendorReason: The Sword Coast Traders have long-standing ties with the Silverstream River and its guardians, ensuring these potent remedies reach those who need them most.
faerun_item_blessed_potions_of_silverstr.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the renowned Flying Couriers, ensuring potions arrive in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous consumption upon opening the bottle.
usage.duration: 1 hour or until consumed by necrotic damage.
usage.endsWhen: Either when its duration expires or it is used against necrotic damage.
usage.charges: Unlimited; each potion is a single-use item.

faerun_item_blessed_potions_of_silverstr.priceReason: The rarity and sacred nature of the Silverstream's essence elevate these potions' value, making them worth ten times their common counterpart.

faerun_item_twilight_sworn_s_elixir.name: Twilight Sworn’s Elixir of Silent Passage
faerun_item_twilight_sworn_s_elixir.description: Twilight Sworn’s Elixir of Silent Passage is a thick, amethyst-colored liquid drawn from the Murkwater Marshes. Its potent aroma lingers like a forgotten promise, and when consumed, it grants the imbiber invisibility for 3 rounds, allowing them to slip past unseen enemies. The elixir's touch can chill the very air, dealing 1d6 cold damage on a successful touch attack, making it a deadly weapon in close combat.

effectDetails.title: Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: The user becomes invisible for 3 rounds. This effect ends if the user takes any action other than moving silently, or if they are struck by an attack.

effectDetails.title: Cold Touch
effectDetails.rules: On a successful touch attack, the user deals 1d6 cold damage to their target. The user must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 15) or be subjected to a chill effect for 1 minute, reducing their speed by half.

faerun_item_twilight_sworn_s_elixir.levelRequirementReason: This elixir is accessible to all adventurers who can afford its price due to its widespread availability in Faerûn.
faerun_item_twilight_sworn_s_elixir.vendorReason: The bazaar stocks a variety of exotic goods, and this elixir is one such item that travelers often seek for its unique properties.
faerun_item_twilight_sworn_s_elixir.shippingDetail: Shipped with utmost secrecy to ensure the elixir remains potent throughout transit.

usage.duration: 3 rounds of invisibility, instantaneous cold touch effect
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user takes an action other than moving silently or is struck by an attack; the cold touch deals damage on a successful touch.

faerun_item_twilight_sworn_s_elixir.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its rare and potent nature, allowing it to be a valuable but not overpowered addition to any adventurer's arsenal.

faerun_item_mk71_forbidden_vial_of_night.name: Mk.71 Forbidden Vial of Nightshade Bloom
faerun_item_mk71_forbidden_vial_of_night.description: Recovered from a desecrated temple of Lolth, this vial is forged from dark obsidian and sealed with a sigil of forbidden knowledge. The concentrated essence of Nightshade bloom within is said to have been crafted by the Dark Lady herself, capable of paralyzing foes and draining their vitality in an instant. Once used, the vial's power dissipates, leaving only a noxious mist that lingers for moments before vanishing into the air.

effectDetails.title: Paralyze Target
effectDetails.rules: When activated by throwing, this vial strikes a single target within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration of one round (2 rounds). This effect can only be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Drain Vitality
effectDetails.rules: On a successful hit, the target takes 4d6 poison damage. The vial then shatters and releases a noxious cloud that lingers for 1 minute before dissipating completely. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

faerun_item_mk71_forbidden_vial_of_night.levelRequirementReason: Due to the forbidden nature of its creation, this item requires a character at least level 35 to wield it.
faerun_item_mk71_forbidden_vial_of_night.vendorReason: The Waterdeep Market houses rare and ancient artifacts, including items with dark origins like the Mk.71 Forbidden Vial of Nightshade Bloom.
faerun_item_mk71_forbidden_vial_of_night.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of night to prevent unwanted attention from deities or fiends.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for paralyzing effect; one round duration. For drain vitality, the vial shatters upon use and dissipates in 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against the save DC or the effect ends naturally after its duration.
usage.charges: One-time use per short rest for paralysis; one-time use per long rest for drain vitality.

faerun_item_mk71_forbidden_vial_of_night.priceReason: The item's rarity, forbidden nature, and limited stock justify a high price in the market.

middle_earth_item_stoneheart_watcher.name: The Stoneheart Watcher’s Fragment
middle_earth_item_stoneheart_watcher.description: The Stoneheart Watcher’s Fragment is a jagged, obsidian shard that glows faintly with an ancient pulse. Crafted from the very heart of Middle-earth's oldest ruins, it whispers tales of forgotten battles and lost quests as its surface shifts with the echoes of past conflicts. This fragment grants fleeting visions of historical events relevant to your current quest (1/day) and subtly enhances perception when exploring ancient sites (+5 Perception checks).

effectDetails.title: Vision of Past Battles
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this fragment grants the user a fleeting vision of past battles relevant to their current quest. This effect lasts for 1 minute and provides +5 to Perception checks made within ancient ruins or battlefields.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: Passively grants the wielder a +2 bonus to saving throws against fear effects, enhancing their composure in moments of terror.

middle_earth_item_stoneheart_watcher.levelRequirementReason: The fragment's power is accessible to all adventurers who seek ancient knowledge.
middle_earth_item_stoneheart_watcher.vendorReason: The Shire Shop specializes in rare artifacts from both modern and ancient times, making it the perfect vendor for such a relic.
middle_earth_item_stoneheart_watcher.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Pony Express with expedited delivery to all locations within Middle-earth.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action when used near ancient ruins or battlefields.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use.
usage.endsWhen: The vision ends after 1 minute, and the fragment can be used again after completing an hour-long rest.

middle_earth_item_stoneheart_watcher.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique abilities justify its moderate price point in the market.

middle_earth_item_rune_of_eldoria.name: The Rune of Eldoria’s Lament
middle_earth_item_rune_of_eldoria.description: The Rune of Eldoria’s Lament is a deeply inscribed mithril rune that glows with a melancholic blue light, whispering tales of ancient Elven kingdoms long lost to time and despair. Crafted by the last runesmiths before Gondor's fall, it weaves sorrow into its very essence, offering those who hold it solace in their darkest hours. This artifact not only restores vitality but also soothes the soul, granting peace amidst overwhelming grief.

effectDetails.title: Sorrow's Embrace
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Restores 20 hit points and removes one level of exhaustion. The rune’s melancholic light pulses, resonating with the user's sorrow, granting advantage on saving throws against despair effects for 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Empathy's Shield
effectDetails.rules: Passively grants advantage on persuasion checks when appealing to empathy or trying to comfort others. The rune amplifies emotions, making the wielder more attuned to the feelings of those around them, thereby enhancing their ability to connect and console.

middle_earth_item_rune_of_eldoria.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to all levels as it provides a universal form of comfort and protection.
middle_earth_item_rune_of_eldoria.vendorReason: The Elven Market sells rare relics that bridge the gap between past and present, making this rune an ideal offering for their customers seeking connection with ancient lore.
middle_earth_item_rune_of_eldoria.shippingDetail: Shipped via a swift flying ship, ensuring the rune arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; effect against despair lasts for 1 hour.
usage.endsWhen: The user's hit points are restored and exhaustion is removed; ends upon death of the wielder.

middle_earth_item_rune_of_eldoria.priceReason: This rune’s profound emotional impact, crafted by ancient Elven artisans, justifies its high price in experience points.

middle_earth_item_scroll_of_the_watchful.name: The Scroll of the Watchful Eye - Mk.III
middle_earth_item_scroll_of_the_watchful.description: The Scroll of the Watchful Eye - Mk.III is a tightly rolled parchment bound with mithril thread, etched with intricate runes that depict an ever-vigilant eye. Crafted by master scouts of Moria, this scroll is said to guide the user through perilous landscapes by revealing hidden dangers and secret paths. It whispers tactical advice in times of combat, granting a +10 bonus to Survival checks when navigating treacherous terrains and a 'warning' effect that alerts you to nearby perils within 50 meters.
effects: +10 to Survival checks in wilderness environments
Grants a 'warning' effect when within 50 meters of dangerous creatures or traps

effectDetails.title: Survival Bonus
effectDetails.rules: Activates passively while the user is navigating treacherous landscapes. The +10 bonus to Survival checks applies only in wilderness environments and does not stack with other bonuses.

effectDetails.title: Danger Warning
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that activates when within 50 meters of dangerous creatures or traps. Grants a 'warning' condition, which lasts until the danger is neutralized or moves beyond 50 meters. The user can take a bonus action to dismiss this warning.

middle_earth_item_scroll_of_the_watchful.levelRequirementReason: All adventurers need some form of guidance in their early stages of exploration and combat.
middle_earth_item_scroll_of_the_watchful.vendorReason: The dwarves of Moria are renowned for their expertise in crafting scrolls that aid in survival, making it only fitting they sell this updated version.
middle_earth_item_scroll_of_the_watchful.shippingDetail: Shipped via the trusted dragon couriers who ensure the scroll arrives swiftly and safely.

usage.duration: Instantaneous warning upon entering range of danger, passive bonus always active in wilderness environments.
usage.endsWhen: Dismissible by taking a bonus action or when the source of danger is neutralized or moves beyond 50 meters.

middle_earth_item_scroll_of_the_watchful.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects its legendary status and the expertise required in crafting such a scroll.

faerun_item_verdant_crowneds_cloak.name: Verdant Crowned's Cloak of the Verdant Grove
faerun_item_verdant_crowneds_cloak.description: The Verdant Crowned's Cloak of the Verdant Grove is a cloak woven from moss and starlight, radiating a gentle warmth that soothes the soul. As you wear it within the forest, fleeting glimpses into the paths favored by ancient spirits whisper their wisdom to your heart, bolstering your courage against shadowy threats. The fabric itself seems alive, its green hue shifting with the seasons, and each star in the sky is reflected upon it like a celestial map.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this cloak, you have resistance to poison damage. This effect persists for the duration of your time in a forest biome.

effectDetails.title: Spiritual Guidance
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can call upon the spirits within the cloak to guide you through hidden paths. Once per short or long rest, this ability grants you advantage on one Wisdom (Perception) check related to detecting secret doors, traps, or hidden passages.

faerun_item_verdant_crowneds_cloak.levelRequirementReason: The cloak's spiritual guidance requires a deep connection with the natural world, which is only achieved at higher levels.
faerun_item_verdant_crowneds_cloak.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is known for its diverse array of magical artifacts and rare items, including those that harness nature's power.
faerun_item_verdant_crowneds_cloak.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a winged messenger, ensuring the cloak reaches you in pristine condition within days.

usage.activation: Action or reaction to call upon spiritual guidance; passive poison resistance while in a forest.
usage.duration: Passive effect until leaving a forest biome; one use of spiritual guidance per short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: Leaving the forest, using another action to call on the cloak's abilities, or resting without using it.

faerun_item_verdant_crowneds_cloak.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the magical energies woven into its fabric.

faerun_item_mk_47_shadow_cloaks.name: Mk.47 Shadow Cloaks of the Silent Watcher
faerun_item_mk_47_shadow_cloaks.description: The Mk.47 Shadow Cloaks of the Silent Watcher are charcoal-grey, etched with runes depicting watchful owls. They whisper secrets to those who listen closely in dimly lit areas, granting near-perfect concealment and enhancing one's awareness of hidden details. These cloaks are said to have been crafted by ancient druids who sought harmony between nature and shadow. Wearing them is akin to becoming a silent sentinel among the night, perfect for those who need to move unseen or unnoticed.

effectDetails.title: Near-Perfect Concealment
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these cloaks in dimly lit areas, you gain a +6 bonus to Stealth checks. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn after removing the cloak.

effectDetails.title: Whispering Secrets
effectDetails.rules: You can use an action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check with advantage when trying to detect hidden creatures or illusions within 30 feet. This effect is usable once per short or long rest.

faerun_item_mk_47_shadow_cloaks.levelRequirementReason: The cloaks are designed for all adventurers, not just the most seasoned warriors.
faerun_item_mk_47_shadow_cloaks.vendorReason: Sword Coast Traders specialize in rare and exotic items that enhance a character's abilities, making them indispensable to any adventurer.
faerun_item_mk_47_shadow_cloaks.shippingDetail: The cloaks are carefully packed and shipped by dark horse cart, ensuring safe arrival at your doorstep within three days.

usage.duration: until the start of your next turn after removal
usage.endsWhen: removing the cloak or ending a short/long rest

faerun_item_mk_47_shadow_cloaks.priceReason: The cloaks are crafted with rare materials and ancient druidic magic, ensuring their quality and utility justify this price.

faerun_item_shadow_rune_of_the_lost_trai.name: Shadow Rune of the Lost Trail - Consumable
faerun_item_shadow_rune_of_the_lost_trai.description: The Shadow Rune of the Lost Trail is a cold, pulsating obsidian talisman that burns with an eerie, spectral light. Upon ingestion, it momentarily pierces the veil of darkness, illuminating treacherous paths and dispelling magical concealment within a narrow radius around its bearer. The rune's shadowy glow can be seen even through thick fog or impenetrable shadows, making it invaluable for adventurers venturing into the deepest, most unforgiving lands.

effectDetails.title: Illuminates Hidden Trails
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this rune illuminates a 10-foot radius area in pitch darkness for up to 1 minute. It reveals hidden trails and obstacles, but does not provide light beyond the specified range.

effectDetails.title: Disrupts Magical Concealment
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of its effect, this rune disrupts any active magical concealment within a 20-foot radius for up to 1 minute. Any creature affected by such concealment must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be seen as clearly as in daylight.

faerun_item_shadow_rune_of_the_lost_trai.levelRequirementReason: Adventurers below level 5 may lack the experience needed to handle the rune's shadowy magic without risk.
faerun_item_shadow_rune_of_the_lost_trai.vendorReason: Baldur, ever the benevolent patron of adventurers, ensures that even the most obscure and powerful items are available through his bazaar.
faerun_item_shadow_rune_of_the_lost_trai.shippingDetail: Ships via swift courier for expedited delivery directly to your door.

usage.duration: 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the consumer is incapacitated, at which point it is expended.

faerun_item_shadow_rune_of_the_lost_trai.priceReason: Crafted from rare shadowrunes and imbued with potent arcane energies, this rune commands a high price for its utility in dark and perilous terrains.

warhammer_item_the-abyssal-resonance-bre.name: The Abyssal Resonance Breaker
warhammer_item_the-abyssal-resonance-bre.description: A shattered warhammer crafted from solidified chaos, pulsing with a sickly green light. It emits a constant tremor that disrupts enemy formations and amplifies your own attacks—a testament to the unending conflict within.
effects: Chance to inflict 'Chaos Wound' on hit (deals extra damage over time)
Causes minor tremors around the wielder

warhammer_item_twilight-sentinel-medalli.name: Twilight Sentinel Medallion of Broken Wills
warhammer_item_twilight-sentinel-medalli.description: The Twilight Sentinel Medallion of Broken Wills is a heavy, silver medallion inlaid with emerald stars and etched with runes from forgotten battles. It whispers the fading memories of countless warriors, offering a chilling reminder of war's psychological toll. This artifact grants the wearer an eerie aura that reduces enemy morale by 30%, and occasionally strikes fear into foes, causing temporary paralysis. Wielders gain +5 to Willpower checks, bolstering their resolve in the face of chaos.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Morale
effectDetails.rules: The wearer's presence reduces enemy morale by 30% for a duration of 1 minute. This effect ends if the medallion is removed or the wearer drops to 0 hit points.

effectDetails.title: Causes Temporary Paralysis
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer can attempt to instill terror in an enemy within 60 feet by using a bonus action. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute.

warhammer_item_twilight-sentinel-medalli.levelRequirementReason: This medallion is designed to harness the power of twilight and chaos, which requires significant experience and mastery.
warhammer_item_twilight-sentinel-medalli.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer specializes in items that manipulate fear and chaos, making this medallion a perfect fit for their inventory.
warhammer_item_twilight-sentinel-medalli.shippingDetail: Ships via the Shadow Messenger with expedited delivery to ensure it arrives under cover of darkness.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts until the end of the encounter or until removed
usage.endsWhen: When the wearer removes or drops the medallion, or if the wearer is reduced to 0 hit points.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

warhammer_item_twilight-sentinel-medalli.priceReason: The medallion's rare crafting materials and unique powers justify its moderate price.

warhammer_item_mk-78-purified-medals-of-.name: Mk.78 Purified Medals of Desolation
warhammer_item_mk-78-purified-medals-of-.description: The Mk.78 Purified Medals of Desolation are crafted from the very essence of a forgotten battlefield, their surfaces etched with ancient runes that whisper tales of war and peace. These medals, imbued with the desolate calm of past battles, offer protection against the worst effects of combat, but at a terrible price. They grant +10 temporary defense to physical attacks and reduce the duration of negative status effects by 50%, ensuring their wearer remains steadfast in the face of chaos.

effectDetails.title: Defense Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Activates on contact with a physical attack, providing +10 temporary defense. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the wearer is hit by another physical attack.

effectDetails.title: Status Effect Mitigation
effectDetails.rules: Reduces the duration of any negative status effects by 50%. This effect can be used once per long rest and has no save DC required. It functions passively, reducing the duration when applicable.

warhammer_item_mk-78-purified-medals-of-.levelRequirementReason: The item's resilience and complexity demand a higher level to ensure it is balanced for player use.
warhammer_item_mk-78-purified-medals-of-.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory stock this item due to its strategic importance in equipping warriors facing the harshest battles.
warhammer_item_mk-78-purified-medals-of-.shippingDetail: Ships via Winged Courier within 3 days of purchase, arriving at your doorstep under secure conditions.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon contact with a physical attack.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until the wearer is hit by another physical attack.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer is hit by another physical attack or the duration expires.

warhammer_item_mk-78-purified-medals-of-.priceReason: The item's rarity, craftsmanship, and strategic value justify its price of 1000 XP.

kivotos_item_spectral_halo_render.name: The Spectral Halo Render of Veritas Hall
kivotos_item_spectral_halo_render.description: The Spectral Halo Render of Veritas Hall is a shimmering band made from threads woven by the ambitions of past students and the light of Veritas Academy itself. It grants its wearer heightened perception, allowing them to discern subtle truths others miss, and emits an ethereal glow that subtly commands attention without being overtly authoritative. Rumors suggest it can briefly shield against logical paradoxes, though prolonged use may cause disorienting visions.

effectDetails.title: Heightened Perception
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Intelligence (Insight) checks and can see through illusions within a 30-foot radius for the duration. This effect lasts 1 minute, and expends a use from its limited daily supply.

effectDetails.title: Brief Resistance to Paradox
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to logical paradoxes for 1 hour upon activation. This effect can be used once per day. The item is destroyed if exposed to a paradox beyond the wielder's understanding.

kivotos_item_spectral_halo_render.levelRequirementReason: Wielding the Spectral Halo requires a deep understanding of logic and perception, fitting only those who have reached an advanced level in their studies.
kivotos_item_spectral_halo_render.vendorReason: The student store is a hub for academic artifacts that enhance learning and research, making it the ideal vendor for this item.
kivotos_item_spectral_halo_render.shippingDetail: Delivered by drone directly to your door, ensuring swift arrival of this delicate artifact.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until expended
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or the item is destroyed upon exposure to a logical paradox beyond the wielder's comprehension.

kivotos_item_spectral_halo_render.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and unique properties of the Spectral Halo, requiring significant resources to replicate.

kivotos_item_crimson_render_of_discord.name: The Crimson Render of Discord's Echoes
kivotos_item_crimson_render_of_discord.description: The Crimson Render of Discord's Echoes is a heavy brass band adorned with unsettling sigils that pulse with an eerie, discordant energy. Crafted from ancient brass mined near a cursed forge, it whispers malevolent secrets to those who wear it too long. When activated, it subtly distorts the perceptions of nearby creatures, eroding their trust and creating brief moments of confusion. Rumor has it that a single use can leave listeners questioning reality itself.

effectDetails.title: Distorted Perception (Area Effect)
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the item creates an area of distorted perception within a 10-foot radius. Creatures in this area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 round as their senses are overwhelmed by conflicting images and sounds.

effectDetails.title: Eroded Trust
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one hour, any creature that interacts with an individual wearing this item has disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks. The effect ends when the wearer removes the item or completes a long rest.

kivotos_item_crimson_render_of_discord.levelRequirementReason: The item's subtle magic requires only basic concentration to activate, but its effects are potent enough that even the lowliest adventurers should be wary.
kivotos_item_crimson_render_of_discord.vendorReason: Club Supply caters to adventurers seeking unique and potentially dangerous trinkets for their escapades.
kivotos_item_crimson_render_of_discord.shippingDetail: Express Delivery ensures the item arrives swiftly, but it cannot deliver during night-only stock periods.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until removed or a long rest is completed
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes the item or completes a long rest

kivotos_item_crimson_render_of_discord.priceReason: Balanced at this price, it reflects the item's subtle but potent magical properties and its potential to significantly impact social interactions.

kivotos_item_honor_bands_mk68.name: Honor Bands MK.68 - The Citadel Protocol
kivotos_item_honor_bands_mk68.description: The Honor Bands MK.68 - The Citadel Protocol are meticulously forged from the strictest protocols of the academy's honor system, each band a testament to unwavering discipline and integrity. Crafted with unyielding discipline, they reflect an aura that sharpens focus and enhances academic performance in all its forms. While some suspect these bands subtly mold one’s thoughts, their true power lies in instilling a sense of purpose and resolve into the wearer's mind.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Focus
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on concentration checks for the duration. This effect lasts until the end of their next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Academic Prowess Boost
effectDetails.rules: For a short period, the wearer's Intelligence and Wisdom (Insight) checks are made with advantage. The effect ends when the user completes a short or long rest.

kivotos_item_honor_bands_mk68.levelRequirementReason: These bands require a solid foundation of discipline and focus, which typically takes four levels to achieve.
kivotos_item_honor_bands_mk68.vendorReason: The academy armory specializes in items that aid students in their rigorous studies and training.
kivotos_item_honor_bands_mk68.shippingDetail: Ships within the next academic term, ensuring they are delivered before the next exam period begins.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the bands.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of the wearer's next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user completes a short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is a passive effect.

kivotos_item_honor_bands_mk68.priceReason: Crafted from strict protocols and disciplined craftsmanship, these bands are priced to reflect their unique benefits and limited availability.

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_be.name: The Chronal Displacement Bearer
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_be.description: The Chronal Displacement Bearer is a pulsating obsidian orb, its surface etched with the fractured patterns of collapsed timelines. This ancient artifact hums with the residual echoes of past realities, allowing you to briefly invert local gravity for incredible leaps and maneuvers. While the effect lasts only a fleeting instant, prolonged use risks attracting the attention of the Fated Place’s currents, as it seems the very fabric of time itself shifts around its wielder.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Leap
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action to invert local gravity for 5 seconds. Increases jump height by 30%. The orb can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Gravitational Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While the Chronal Displacement Bearer is active, you gain resistance to falling damage and have advantage on saving throws against being pushed or pulled. This effect lasts for the duration of the gravity inversion.

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_be.levelRequirementReason: This item allows even low-level characters to experience the thrill of defying gravity.
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_be.vendorReason: Void Vendor is known for offering curiosities from the Fated Place, and this artifact fits perfectly with their inventory.
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_be.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Courier; delivery may be delayed by one day due to cosmic interference.

usage.duration: 5 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the duration expires or you take any action other than a bonus action.

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_be.priceReason: The Chronal Displacement Bearer's rarity and unique functionality justify its fair value in XP.

doughnut_hole_item_unholy_nulls_of_desce.name: The Unholy Nulls of Descent
doughnut_hole_item_unholy_nulls_of_desce.description: The Unholy Nulls of Descent are fractured, grey spheres that seem to pull at the very fabric of existence. Holding one grants brief visions of possible futures, offering glimpses into the void's depths, but prolonged exposure can warp your perception and leave you vulnerable to unearthly whispers. These relics are crafted from a dark, unholy substance found in the deepest chasms of forgotten realms, and their touch is as chilling as the void itself.

effectDetails.title: Brief Visions of Futures
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. Grants random visions of possible futures for 1 minute. After this duration, the user must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to a minor hallucination that lasts until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Vulnerability to Whispers
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Unholy Nulls of Descent, you are vulnerable to any mind-altering effect. This vulnerability persists for 1 minute after ceasing to hold the item unless a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw is made.

doughnut_hole_item_unholy_nulls_of_desce.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience and mental fortitude can handle these relics without succumbing to their malevolent influence.
doughnut_hole_item_unholy_nulls_of_desce.vendorReason: Hole Hawker has a vast network of contacts in the underworld, allowing them access to rare and dangerous artifacts like the Unholy Nulls of Descent.
doughnut_hole_item_unholy_nulls_of_desce.shippingDetail: Ships via shadow travel, ensuring secrecy but with potential delays due to unpredictable routes.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the user's next turn after ceasing to hold it.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you stop holding the item and successfully make a Wisdom saving throw.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect operates at a time.

doughnut_hole_item_unholy_nulls_of_desce.priceReason: The Unholy Nulls of Descent are priced high due to their rarity, dark craftsmanship, and the risks they pose to any who wield them.

doughnut_hole_item_inverted_gravity_pris.name: The Inverted Gravity Prism - Mk.97
doughnut_hole_item_inverted_gravity_pris.description: The Inverted Gravity Prism - Mk.97 is a multifaceted crystal etched with arcane glyphs that seem to defy gravity itself. Crafted from the chaotic energies of Fated Place's gravity wells, this prism channels its volatile power into localized distortions, allowing the user to walk on walls and ceilings with surprising grace. However, the very instability of the prism means it can unpredictably trigger a surge, momentarily turning the surrounding area into an inverted gravitational field.

effectDetails.title: Wall Walker
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the prism to allow you to walk on walls and ceilings. This effect lasts for 10 seconds or until you drop prone, whichever comes first.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Surge
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that when you use Wall Walker, a localized gravity surge occurs. During this surge, the area around you becomes unstable and grants you temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier for 1 minute.

doughnut_hole_item_inverted_gravity_pris.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum character level of 4 due to its complex arcane properties.
doughnut_hole_item_inverted_gravity_pris.vendorReason: Center Seller specializes in rare and exotic magical items, including those that manipulate the very fabric of gravity like this prism.
doughnut_hole_item_inverted_gravity_pris.shippingDetail: The Dimensional Postman ensures secure delivery through interdimensional transit. Items are delivered within a week but must be collected personally from the Center Seller's location.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and use Wall Walker, which ends when you drop prone or after 10 seconds.
usage.duration: 10 seconds or until you drop prone
usage.endsWhen: Dropping prone or after 10 seconds

doughnut_hole_item_inverted_gravity_pris.priceReason: The prism's unique and volatile nature, combined with its rarity and the complexity of its construction, justify a high price point.

pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_mark.name: The Chronos Resonance Mark
pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_mark.description: The Chronos Resonance Mark, a shimmering obsidian band etched with ancient glyphs that whisper of time's fluidity, subtly bends reality around its wearer. For fleeting moments, it accelerates their Pokémon’s evolution, granting a surge in attack and speed but also risks unpredictable mutations. This relic is forged from the very essence of the league’s most dynamic battles, making it a mythic treasure for those willing to push their limits.

effectDetails.title: Accelerated Evolution
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. The wearer’s Pokémon gains +2 to attack and speed for the next 5 turns. This effect ends if the Pokémon is hit by an attack or if it uses a move that requires its turn.

effectDetails.title: Increased Risk of Mutation
effectDetails.rules: There's a 10% chance each round that the wearer’s Pokémon will undergo a random evolution, which can be either advantageous or detrimental. This risk persists for one minute after activation and is cumulative if used again before the cooldown ends.

pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_mark.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience in battling can harness the unstable energy of the Chronos Resonance Mark without causing catastrophic side effects.
pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_mark.vendorReason: The league store stocks this item as it is a direct offering from the Pokémon League, ensuring its authenticity and rarity among trainers.
pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_mark.shippingDetail: Ships within one league day via express courier with a special delivery guarantee.

usage.duration: 5 turns of enhanced attack and speed
usage.endsWhen: The Pokémon is hit by an attack or uses its turn, or after 5 turns

pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_mark.priceReason: This mythic item reflects the league’s commitment to providing trainers with unparalleled tools for their journeys.

pokemon_item_shadowdrift_amulet_7.name: The Shadowdrift Amulet of Seven Echoes
pokemon_item_shadowdrift_amulet_7.description: The Shadowdrift Amulet of Seven Echoes, crafted from moonlit glass and encased in a lattice of spectral threads, is said to house the spirits of those who have lost their Pokémon. When worn, it allows for the creation of a ghostly duplicate that can assist in battle. This spectral clone fights alongside the wearer for three turns before fading into shadow, leaving behind only a lingering presence. Its touch is cold, and its eyes glow with an eerie luminescence, making it a formidable ally against dark forces.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Clone
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Creates a spectral clone of the wearer's Pokémon that can engage in combat for three turns. The clone has half the hit points and ability scores of the original, but it is immune to physical damage. It cannot attack with physical weapons or cast spells. Ends when the clone takes any damage or after three turns.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Defense
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains immunity to confusion and other mental status effects while wearing this amulet. Additionally, their Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to psychic energy are made at advantage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after activation.

pokemon_item_shadowdrift_amulet_7.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have experienced loss and gained strength from it can wield this amulet effectively.
pokemon_item_shadowdrift_amulet_7.vendorReason: The Safari Shop has a unique collection of items that honor the bond between trainer and Pokémon, making it the ideal vendor for such an artifact.
pokemon_item_shadowdrift_amulet_7.shippingDetail: Ships via swift courier service, delivered within three days to any location within the region.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next turn after activation or when the spectral clone takes damage.
usage.endsWhen: The clone is destroyed by taking any damage, or it fades into shadow after three turns.

pokemon_item_shadowdrift_amulet_7.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and imbued with powerful psychic energies, the amulet's price reflects its rarity and utility.

pokemon_item_kryptonian_echo_shard.name: The Kryptonian Echo Shard of Temporal Resonance
pokemon_item_kryptonian_echo_shard.description: The Kryptonian Echo Shard of Temporal Resonance is a fractured fragment from an ancient meteorite that crashed into this plane, believed to have come from a realm where time flows like liquid. This relic allows your Pokémon to briefly phase through attacks and reflect projectiles back at their source with unnerving precision, creating a ripple effect in the battlefield. Each use leaves a shimmering trail of temporal energy behind it, as if the shards themselves whisper secrets of the cosmos.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Phase
effectDetails.rules: As an action, your Pokémon can phase through one attack per battle. This effect lasts for a number of turns equal to half its level (rounded down), and it ends if the Pokémon takes damage or uses another action that requires concentration.

effectDetails.title: Reflective Shield
effectDetails.rules: Your Pokémon has a 20% chance to reflect projectiles back at their origin when hit by a ranged attack. This effect has a cooldown of one minute and is limited to three uses per day.

pokemon_item_kryptonian_echo_shard.levelRequirementReason: This shard requires the user's Pokémon to be at least level 15 to effectively harness its temporal energies.
pokemon_item_kryptonian_echo_shard.vendorReason: Pokemart is known for offering a wide array of items that can enhance the abilities of Pokémon, making this shard an ideal addition to their collection.
pokemon_item_kryptonian_echo_shard.shippingDetail: Ships within one business day and includes free insurance on shipments above 500 XP value.

usage.duration: Number of turns equal to half the Pokémon's level (rounded down)
usage.endsWhen: The Pokémon takes damage or uses another action requiring concentration, or if the effect is interrupted by a spell or ability with a save DC of 15.

pokemon_item_kryptonian_echo_shard.priceReason: This item's unique properties and the level requirement justify its price in XP.

kivotos_item_karmic_bearer_of_resonance.name: The Karmic Bearer's Cards - Semester Echoes
kivotos_item_karmic_bearer_of_resonance.description: The Karmic Bearer's Cards - Semester Echoes shimmer with a faint, karmic light, their iridescent edges catching the dim glow of the academy library. When played in sequence during a study session, these cards amplify the emotional resonance among fellow students for an entire semester, potentially swaying decisions and actions. However, prolonged use risks unpredictable ripple effects that could destabilize the very fabric of campus life. Each set is a limited daily stock, ensuring that only those with the heart—and perhaps the soul—to wield them can partake in their power.

effectDetails.title: Emotional Resonance Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When played, these cards temporarily amplify the emotional resonance of surrounding students for a duration of one semester. This effect has no set duration within a single session but is limited to once per day. Any student subjected to this amplification may experience heightened empathy or a shift in their usual behavior patterns.

effectDetails.title: Academic Influence
effectDetails.rules: There's a 10% chance that the amplified emotions will inadvertently trigger minor academic disruptions, such as forgotten assignments or unexpected study group collaborations. These disruptions are harmless but can significantly affect one’s semester progress if not managed carefully.

kivotos_item_karmic_bearer_of_resonance.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for students with a grasp of basic emotional manipulation and the discipline to wield such power responsibly.
kivotos_item_karmic_bearer_of_resonance.vendorReason: The Student Store, known for its academic supplies, offers these unique tools that enhance study sessions without disrupting daily routines.
kivotos_item_karmic_bearer_of_resonance.shippingDetail: Delivered via automated drones, ensuring timely arrival to eager hands across campus.

usage.activation: Requires a short rest and is activated once per day.
usage.duration: One semester (180 days) of amplified emotional resonance among students.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends naturally after one semester or when the card set is exhausted.
usage.charges: Limited to 3 uses daily, with a full recharge at midnight.

kivotos_item_karmic_bearer_of_resonance.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its limited daily use and the potential for significant academic influence over an extended period.

kivotos_item_mk_77_semester_cards.name: Mk.77 Semester Cards - Academy Protocol
kivotos_item_mk_77_semester_cards.description: Mk.77 Semester Cards - Academy Protocol are meticulously crafted by the Academy Armory, each card emblazoned with the city's founding runes. Upon activation, these cards induce a localized temporal ripple that momentarily immobilizes students within a five-foot radius for three seconds, allowing quick recoveries of lost items or strategic maneuvers. The cards also grant the wielder +10 agility temporarily, making them an indispensable tool for both mundane and extraordinary situations.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Freeze
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action within the Academy. Targets all students within a five-foot radius, freezing them in place for three seconds. There is a 25% chance to steal a random item from the frozen student. The effect ends if an opposing force moves into the area or after its duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Agility Boost
effectDetails.rules: Grants +10 agility to the user for one turn upon activation, enhancing their dexterity and reflexes during the localized temporal anomaly. This bonus does not stack with other agility-boosting effects. The effect ends when the duration of the Temporal Freeze expires or if the wielder drops the cards.

kivotos_item_mk_77_semester_cards.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to ensure users can handle the risk associated with temporal distortions.
kivotos_item_mk_77_semester_cards.vendorReason: The Academy Armory is responsible for crafting and supplying tools that maintain order within the city, making them the appropriate vendor for these cards.
kivotos_item_mk_77_semester_cards.shippingDetail: Ships immediately with Express Courier service ensuring timely delivery.

usage.duration: 3 seconds per activation
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or an opposing force enters the area

kivotos_item_mk_77_semester_cards.priceReason: Balanced price considers the item's rarity and utility within the Academy environment.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_26631.name: Halo of Perfect Notes - The Composer's Blessing
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_26631.description: The Halo of Perfect Notes - The Composer's Blessing is a shimmering crown of silver and brass, its surface etched with intricate musical patterns. Forged in the heart of a composer’s dreams by the legendary artisan Pauline, this artifact amplifies the wearer’s performance to perfection, creating an aura that harmonizes soundscapes around them. It subtly influences listeners' emotions through its melodic resonance, enhancing concentration and creativity within a 30-foot radius.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Musical Performance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer’s proficiency in musical instruments is increased by two steps. This effect lasts until the end of their next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Harmonic Aura
effectDetails.rules: Creates a 30-foot radius area around the wearer where noise and distractions are reduced by half, for a duration of 10 minutes per use, usable once every short or long rest.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_26631.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant magical power to wield effectively.
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_26631.vendorReason: Club Supply specializes in unique and powerful artifacts that enhance performance and creativity.
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_26631.shippingDetail: Delivered with utmost care, ensuring the halo arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation; can be used once per short or long rest.
usage.duration: 10 minutes per use
usage.endsWhen: The end of a long rest ends both effects.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one effect can be active at a time.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_26631.priceReason: This legendary item combines potent magical properties with unique craftsmanship, making it an invaluable asset for high-level performers and composers.

internet_item_compressed_echoes_of_memor.name: Compressed Echoes of Memories - Mk.47
internet_item_compressed_echoes_of_memor.description: Compressed Echoes of Memories - Mk.47 are shimmering, digital shards that hum with the echoes of long-forgotten internet memes and viral trends. When consumed, they transport the user to a fleeting, digitized ghost town where obsolete content lingers. For a moment, the consumer is ensnared by obsessive nostalgia and gains an unsettling ability to predict short-lived internet fads, though at the cost of hearing persistent dial-up modem sounds.

effectDetails.title: Obsessive Nostalgia
effectDetails.rules: The consumer becomes temporarily fixated on a random viral trend from the past. This obsession grants +10% chance to predict trending hashtags for 60 seconds, but leaves them vulnerable to minor auditory hallucinations of dial-up modem sounds.

effectDetails.title: Internet Fad Prediction
effectDetails.rules: For 60 seconds after consumption, the user gains a +10% bonus to Wisdom (Insight) checks made to predict short-lived internet fads. This effect ends if the consumer becomes aware of a different viral trend or if they are distracted by another source.

internet_item_compressed_echoes_of_memor.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant mental acuity and experience with digital trends to handle the effects without becoming overwhelmed.
internet_item_compressed_echoes_of_memor.vendorReason: Data Dealer specializes in unusual and ephemeral items related to technology and data streams, making this item a natural fit.
internet_item_compressed_echoes_of_memor.shippingDetail: Delivered via a fleet of autonomous drones that ensure timely delivery.

usage.duration: 60 seconds per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the consumer becomes aware of a different viral trend or is distracted by another source, or if they are no longer in a digital environment.

internet_item_compressed_echoes_of_memor.priceReason: Balanced to ensure that the item's effects provide a unique and balanced experience without overpowered outcomes.

internet_item_the_ancient_data_eater.name: The Ancient Data Eater - Prototype X9
internet_item_the_ancient_data_eater.description: The Ancient Data Eater - Prototype X9 is a sleek obsidian shard, its surface etched with the remnants of forgotten social networks and digital avatars. This relic absorbs 50% of nearby data streams, instantly clearing network congestion in its vicinity but leaving users feeling slightly paranoid as if their every move is being watched by unseen algorithms. With each use, the shard hums with a faint pulse that resonates through the ether, ensuring blissful silence—temporarily—at the cost of one charge.

effectDetails.title: Network Congestion Mitigator
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this artifact reduces all nearby data streams by 50%, instantly clearing network congestion within a 30-foot radius. The effect lasts for 1 minute and ends if the user is disconnected from the network or if the shard runs out of charges.

effectDetails.title: Paranoid Pulse
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, users gain temporary immunity to targeted online advertising for 24 hours but suffer a -1 penalty to all Wisdom (Perception) checks related to detecting surveillance. This effect lasts until the user is disconnected from the network or if the shard runs out of charges.

internet_item_the_ancient_data_eater.levelRequirementReason: This item's power, while potent, can be utilized by any adventurer who needs immediate relief from data overload.
internet_item_the_ancient_data_eater.vendorReason: The cyber market specializes in cutting-edge and ancient tech, making it the perfect vendor for this relic.
internet_item_the_ancient_data_eater.shippingDetail: Ships via encrypted packets, ensuring safe delivery of the artifact to its destination.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting 1 minute or until network connection is lost
usage.endsWhen: Network disconnection or shard runs out of charges
usage.charges: Limited uses per day; recharges on a long rest

internet_item_the_ancient_data_eater.priceReason: This item's rarity, power, and unique ability to mitigate network congestion make it a valuable asset worth its price in XP.

internet_item_mythic_chronometric_flux.name: Mythic Chronometric Flux - The Timestamp Serpent
internet_item_mythic_chronometric_flux.description: The Timestamp Serpent is a swirling vortex of compressed time-data, harvested from the collapse of obsolete servers. Crafted by rogue tech-savvy alchemists in the shadows, this forbidden item allows users to manipulate temporal distortions. It grants momentary control over local time, rewinding blunders or fast-forwarding through tedious content—perfect for those who wish to avoid the pitfalls of modern technology. Handle with extreme caution; paradoxes are a frequent side effect.

effectDetails.title: Rewind Time
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can rewind time by up to 10 seconds for yourself or one creature within 5 feet. This effect has a 24-hour cooldown and causes unpredictable temporal distortions with a 50% chance of negative effects.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 minute, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can move up to your speed +10 feet. This effect is limited to once per short or long rest.

internet_item_mythic_chronometric_flux.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to all characters, as it represents the ability to manipulate technology in a fantastical setting.
internet_item_mythic_chronometric_flux.vendorReason: The pixel_shop caters to those who dabble in the arcane and technological realms, making this item an appropriate offering for their clientele.
internet_item_mythic_chronometric_flux.shippingDetail: Delivered with a time-stamped note to ensure authenticity.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Rewind Time)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect is used again or after 24 hours.

internet_item_mythic_chronometric_flux.priceReason: The price reflects a balanced XP cost, considering its mythic rarity and the balance it brings to the game without overpowered effects.

middle_earth_item_echoing_heartwood_spea.name: The Echoing Heartwood Speaker
middle_earth_item_echoing_heartwood_spea.description: The Echoing Heartwood Speaker is a delicate, intricately carved wooden device, its inlaid silver runes glowing faintly as they resonate with ancient tales and forgotten lore. Crafted from the heartwood of an Ent fallen to time's scythe, it hums with the echoes of lost battles and Elven melodies. When activated, it emits a cacophony of whispers—fragmented stories that can temporarily enhance perception and reveal hidden paths or weaknesses in both terrain and foes.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for 1 minute upon activation. This effect has a recharge after 5 minutes of inactivity.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this item reveals hidden or secret paths within a 60-foot radius. The DC to find these paths is reduced by 10 for the next hour.

middle_earth_item_echoing_heartwood_spea.levelRequirementReason: The speaker's ancient magic requires a user with experience and focus.
middle_earth_item_echoing_heartwood_spea.vendorReason: Elves have long revered the heartwood of Ents, crafting items that preserve their wisdom and history.
middle_earth_item_echoing_heartwood_spea.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by winged messengers, ensuring the item arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user completes a short rest or the speaker is destroyed.

middle_earth_item_echoing_heartwood_spea.priceReason: Crafted from rare heartwood and ancient runes, this item commands a high price for its unique abilities.

middle_earth_item_vile_stone_of_grim_sil.name: The Vile Stone of Grim Silence
middle_earth_item_vile_stone_of_grim_sil.description: The Vile Stone of Grim Silence is a chilling obsidian stone pulsating with a palpable sense of dread, allegedly crafted by a dark sorcerer in the depths of Moria. Holding it grants the user unsettling control over sound, momentarily silencing all ambient noise and even dampening magical effects reliant on vocal incantations. The stone's malevolent energy can turn the battlefield into a silent void, making enemies' whispered strategies ineffective for a brief time.

effectDetails.title: Silence
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Creates a 3-meter radius of silence around the user, silencing all ambient and magical sounds within its area for 15 seconds. Enemies within the effect have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Perception (Senses) checks that rely on sound. Ends when the duration expires or if the user drops the stone.

effectDetails.title: Dampen Magic
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Reduces the effectiveness of any spell with verbal components by 20% for up to 30 seconds, ending early if the user drops the stone or takes any damage. Has no effect on spells without verbal components.

middle_earth_item_vile_stone_of_grim_sil.levelRequirementReason: Requires 18th level due to its dark magic and potential to disrupt combat effectively.
middle_earth_item_vile_stone_of_grim_sil.vendorReason: The dwarves of Moria are well-known for their mastery in crafting items with ancient, malevolent power.
middle_earth_item_vile_stone_of_grim_sil.shippingDetail: Ships via a specially enchanted cart that ensures the stone's dark energy does not affect the delivery route.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate each effect sequentially or independently.
usage.duration: Silence lasts for 15 seconds, Dampen Magic up to 30 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends when the user drops the stone or takes damage, or if the user activates another effect.

middle_earth_item_vile_stone_of_grim_sil.priceReason: The Vile Stone's powerful effects and dark magic justify its high price of 1000 XP.

middle_earth_item_mk50_silver_mithril_ch.name: Mk.50 Silver Mithril Chronometer
middle_earth_item_mk50_silver_mithril_ch.description: The Mk.50 Silver Mithril Chronometer, a masterpiece of elven craftsmanship forged from the rarest mithril and adorned with ancient Elven glyphs, measures not mere time but the subtle currents of magic that ripple around an opponent. Its readings can predict the flow of energy in combat, revealing a foe's next strike or pinpointing their magical vulnerabilities. With this tool, a warrior may act a heartbeat ahead of their enemy, enhancing both initiative and reaction speed.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Attack Pattern
effectDetails.rules: When used as an action, this chronometer reveals the probability of a foe's next attack. This effect lasts for 60 seconds and provides a +2 bonus to initiative rolls.

effectDetails.title: Detect Magical Vulnerabilities
effectDetails.rules: This ability is active at all times while worn. It grants you advantage on saving throws against magical effects and allows you to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check with advantage when determining the weaknesses of a magical item or creature.

middle_earth_item_mk50_silver_mithril_ch.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least level 15 to wield its power effectively.
middle_earth_item_mk50_silver_mithril_ch.vendorReason: The Shire Shop, known for its unique and powerful artifacts, offers this rare chronometer to adventurers who can afford its extraordinary value.
middle_earth_item_mk50_silver_mithril_ch.shippingDetail: Ships via the trusted Pony Express with a two-day delivery guarantee.

usage.duration: 60 seconds when revealed, active at all times while worn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take another action to reveal an attack pattern or when the chronometer is removed from your person.

middle_earth_item_mk50_silver_mithril_ch.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the chronometer's rarity and its unique utility in combat.

doughnut_hole_item_whispering_chronal_te.name: Whispering Chronal Tear of Reverie
doughnut_hole_item_whispering_chronal_te.description: The Whispering Chronal Tear of Reverie is a shimmering fragment of temporal dissonance, its surface etched with silver lines that ripple like liquid light. When held, it releases fragmented memories and whispers from potential futures, subtly altering your perception of time for 60 seconds. This tear can be found floating in the void, a remnant of forgotten timelines, often appearing without warning to those attuned to the fabric of reality.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this tear creates a localized distortion in time affecting the wielder. For 60 seconds, your perception of time is altered, causing you to experience fragmented moments from potential futures. There is a 1% chance per hour that a localized time stutter occurs within a 5-foot radius around you. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Fragmented Memories
effectDetails.rules: As this tear distorts time, it also stirs dormant memories and potential futures. You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to detecting temporal anomalies for 1 minute after using the tear. This effect ends when the duration expires or if you are incapacitated.

doughnut_hole_item_whispering_chronal_te.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high level of discipline and understanding of time magic, suitable only for seasoned spellcasters.
doughnut_hole_item_whispering_chronal_te.vendorReason: The void vendor is known to trade in items that manipulate reality itself, making this tear an appropriate addition to their stock.
doughnut_hole_item_whispering_chronal_te.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the void, arriving with a slight delay as it traverses interdimensional pathways.

usage.duration: 60 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitated or duration expires

doughnut_hole_item_whispering_chronal_te.priceReason: The tear's rarity and the power it wields make it a valuable but not overpowered addition to any spellcaster's arsenal.

doughnut_hole_item_centrally_aligned_wat.name: Centrally Aligned Watcher Shard - Mk.III
