warhammer_item_skull-speaker-of-grim-reg.vendorReason: The imperial army is known for its rigorous selection process, ensuring that only those of proven valor wield such powerful relics.
warhammer_item_skull-speaker-of-grim-reg.shippingDetail: Ships via express delivery with overnight service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (1 round) for Brief Vision; 1 minute for Inspire Fear
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the duration expires, target saves successfully, or the user no longer holds the item.

warhammer_item_skull-speaker-of-grim-reg.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides significant strategic and tactical advantages without overshadowing other party members.

warhammer_item_rune-walker-of-bone-echoe.name: Rune-Walker of Bone Echoes
warhammer_item_rune-walker-of-bone-echoe.description: The Rune-Walker of Bone Echoes is a warhammer forged from the charred fragments of an ancient battle engine, its surface etched with forbidden runes that whisper the echoes of past conflicts. Wielders can traverse the haunted grounds of recent battles, manifesting as spectral combatants to scout or disrupt enemy formations. This artifact's power is both unsettling and effective, revealing the last movements of fallen warriors within a 30-foot radius for 1 minute, and has a 20% chance to summon a ghostly warrior to aid in battle.

effectDetails.title: Battlefield Scrying
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can activate this effect within a battlefield. For 1 minute, they gain advantage on Perception checks to locate recently deceased combatants and their last movements within a 30-foot radius. This effect ends when the duration expires or if the wielder moves more than 5 feet away from the battlefield.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Ally
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wielder can summon a ghostly warrior that grants them a +1 bonus to AC and damage rolls until it is destroyed. The ghostly warrior lasts for 1 minute or until reduced to 0 hit points.

warhammer_item_rune-walker-of-bone-echoe.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant martial prowess and understanding of ancient runic magic.
warhammer_item_rune-walker-of-bone-echoe.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in crafting items from the remnants of legendary battles, making this artifact a natural addition to their stock.
warhammer_item_rune-walker-of-bone-echoe.shippingDetail: Dispatched via the Swift Wind Courier, delivering within 3 days with extra protection against magical interference.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until conditions end it
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or wielder moves more than 5 feet away from a battlefield

warhammer_item_rune-walker-of-bone-echoe.priceReason: Balanced by its limited utility and the risk of magical backlash associated with heretical runes.

warhammer_item_service-of-the-grim-harve.name: Service of the Grim Harvester
warhammer_item_service-of-the-grim-harve.description: The 'Service of the Grim Harvester' is a bone talisman intricately carved with runes of shadow and death. This necrotic artifact pulses faintly, its energy whispering tales of forgotten battles. By focusing intent upon it, you can summon a spectral Harvester to retrieve lost items from the battlefield. The spectral creature moves with eerie precision, returning not only mundane gear but also rare artifacts overlooked by scavengers. Its touch grants a fleeting insight into battlefield strategies and tactics.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Retrieval
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can summon the spectral Harvester to retrieve a lost item. The Harvester has a range of 1 mile and returns within one hour. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Battlefield Insights
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one short rest, you gain advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks related to battlefield tactics. This effect does not require an action or attack roll and can be used once per day.

warhammer_item_service-of-the-grim-harve.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners who wish to access the benefits of battlefield scavenging without the steep level cap required by more powerful items.
warhammer_item_service-of-the-grim-harve.vendorReason: The chaos dealer often deals in unique and rare artifacts, including those that grant access to shadowy services like retrieval from forgotten battles.
warhammer_item_service-of-the-grim-harve.shippingDetail: The item is delivered via a dimensional portal, ensuring swift arrival but with the risk of unexpected visitors.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Spectral Retrieval) / One Short Rest (Battlefield Insights)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration expires or you choose to dismiss it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by rest requirements.

warhammer_item_service-of-the-grim-harve.priceReason: The item's rarity and utility are balanced against its mythic power, offering a significant yet not overpowered advantage for adventurers of all levels.

doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_breather.name: The Crimson Void Breather Mk.II
doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_breather.description: The Crimson Void Breather Mk.II hums softly, its obsidian casing etched with arcane glyphs that pulse with a deep crimson hue. When activated, it momentarily stills the oppressive silence and grants a burst of revitalizing energy. The device's core resonates with a strangely pleasant hum, purging the lingering echoes of despair. Activated as a bonus action, this relic restores 25% health and increases your movement speed by 10% for 15 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Health Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Activating the device as a bonus action restores 25% of your maximum hit points. This effect has a recharge time of 1 hour.

effectDetails.title: Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you gain a +10 foot movement speed bonus for 15 seconds. The effect ends if you take any damage or when the duration expires.

doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_breather.levelRequirementReason: The device's complex mechanics and energy signature require a proficient user to effectively harness its power.
doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_breather.vendorReason: Void Vendor specializes in rare artifacts from beyond, including this relic of the Crimson Void.
doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_breather.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Rift Courier within 3 days. Due to its volatile nature, it must be handled with care and delivered under controlled conditions.

usage.duration: 15 seconds
usage.endsWhen: You take damage or the duration expires

doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_breather.priceReason: The Mk.II is crafted from rare materials and requires advanced enchantments, justifying its high price.

doughnut_hole_item_sacred_heart_fragment.name: Fragment of the Sacred Heart - Cycle 37
doughnut_hole_item_sacred_heart_fragment.description: The Fragment of the Sacred Heart - Cycle 37 is a crystalline shard that hums with ancient chronal energy, its surface etched with faint runes that shimmer like stars in a void. When held, it grants fleeting visions of potential futures, whispering warnings about impending doom and hidden paths. Legends tell of this fragment as a tear from an entity's obliteration, imbuing the wielder with a protective warmth against the void's encroachment.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Vision
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate this effect to gain brief glimpses of potential futures. These visions last for 30 seconds and provide a +5% increase in Perception checks. On a failed save (DC 14), the wielder is momentarily blinded by temporal distortions, reducing their next Perception check by 2 until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Void Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While holding this fragment, the wielder gains resistance to damage from void-based attacks. This effect lasts for a number of turns equal to twice their Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). The effect ends if the wielder is exposed to a significant void disturbance or if they use an action to dismiss it.

doughnut_hole_item_sacred_heart_fragment.levelRequirementReason: The fragment's chronal energy and cryptic visions require a high level of spiritual and temporal understanding.
doughnut_hole_item_sacred_heart_fragment.vendorReason: Hole Hawker, being an enigmatic scavenger of lost relics, is the only one known to have encountered this sacred relic in the void.
doughnut_hole_item_sacred_heart_fragment.shippingDetail: The fragment must be delivered through the Void Wraith's exclusive portal, ensuring it arrives unharmed and intact.

usage.duration: 30 seconds or until dismissed
usage.endsWhen: Void disturbance or action to dismiss

doughnut_hole_item_sacred_heart_fragment.priceReason: The fragment's rarity and the unique abilities it grants justify its high price.

doughnut_hole_item_central_tear_reclamat.name: Reclamation Service - Cycle 9
doughnut_hole_item_central_tear_reclamat.description: The Reclamation Service - Cycle 9 is a delicate and precise apparatus crafted by Chronal Technicians, designed to stabilize unstable central tears in the fabric of time. This specialized service employs advanced temporal containment fields to redirect errant energies, preventing catastrophic rifts from expanding into alternate timelines. The device hums with an eerie, pulsating light as it stabilizes one tear for 60 seconds, but its unpredictable nature makes each application a gamble.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Stabilization
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as an action. Temporarily stabilizes one central tear for 60 seconds, reducing the risk of expanding to a catastrophic rift. There is a 10% chance each use that the stabilization fails and the tear expands uncontrollably.

effectDetails.title: Safe Passage Through Void
effectDetails.rules: Once per day as an action, allows safe passage through a designated void area for up to one hour. The device creates a protective field around the traveler, ensuring they avoid any dangers within the void area.

doughnut_hole_item_central_tear_reclamat.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest stabilizations require a basic understanding of temporal mechanics and safety protocols.
doughnut_hole_item_central_tear_reclamat.vendorReason: The Center Seller specializes in services that maintain the integrity of time itself, making them the only vendor for this specialized apparatus.
doughnut_hole_item_central_tear_reclamat.shippingDetail: Delivered by a Chronal Drone equipped with advanced shielding to protect the delicate device during transit.

usage.activation: Activates on command as an action. Can be used once per day for each effect.
usage.duration: Temporal Stabilization lasts for 60 seconds, Safe Passage Through Void lasts up to one hour.
usage.endsWhen: The stabilization fails or the traveler exits the void area, respectively.

doughnut_hole_item_central_tear_reclamat.priceReason: Balanced at a cost of 1000 XP due to its specialized and unpredictable nature.

warhammer_item_infernal_claimeds_bloodru.name: Infernal Claimed’s Bloodrune Breaker
warhammer_item_infernal_claimeds_bloodru.description: The Infernal Claimed’s Bloodrune Breaker is a colossal warhammer whose head gleams with an ominous crimson hue. Its weight feels unnatural, as if forged by infernal hands to shatter the strongest armor and cleave through flesh with ease. The etched runes on its surface glow faintly, whispering of ancient battles fought in forgotten realms. Each strike leaves behind a trail of corrupted blood that continues to burn for moments after contact.

effectDetails.title: Fire and Corruption
effectDetails.rules: When the hammer strikes, it deals fire damage equal to twice the user’s Strength modifier. There is a 30% chance that the target will be marked with a trail of corrosive blood that continues to deal an additional 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns for up to 2 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a temporary bonus equal to their proficiency bonus + 4 to Strength-based checks and saving throws until the end of their next turn. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

warhammer_item_infernal_claimeds_bloodru.levelRequirementReason: This weapon requires significant strength and experience to wield properly, aligning with its infernal power.
warhammer_item_infernal_claimeds_bloodru.vendorReason: The chaos dealer has a unique connection to the infernal realms where this weapon was forged.
warhammer_item_infernal_claimeds_bloodru.shippingDetail: Ships via flying griffin, arriving within one week of order placement.

usage.activation: Melee Weapon Attack: Str mod +10 (Proficiency Bonus +5) vs. AC or Reflex; hit: 2d8+4 fire damage and apply the effects of Fire and Corruption.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, with one use per short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The hammer’s charge is expended after a single attack.

warhammer_item_infernal_claimeds_bloodru.priceReason: This weapon's price reflects its rarity and the specialized crafting required to forge it.

warhammer_item_fateforge_mk_79_desolatio.name: Fate Forge Mk.79 Desolation Herald
warhammer_item_fateforge_mk_79_desolatio.description: The Fate Forge Mk.79 Desolation Herald is a warhammer forged in the heart of the Fate Forge, where time itself fractures and bends. Its surface etched with timelines of endless wars, each strike reveals fragments of vanished battles. This unholy weapon deals bludgeoning damage enhanced by the very fabric of shattered realities, and it saps an enemy's will to fight, slowing their movements while they are ensnared in a maelstrom of fate’s whimsy.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Shatter
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with this weapon as part of an attack action, the target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take an additional 2d6 force damage. The target can use their reaction to halve this damage on a successful save.

effectDetails.title: Will Sap
effectDetails.rules: The Desolation Herald saps the will of the foe, reducing enemy movement speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If you hit with an attack action while wielding it, the duration is increased to 1 minute.

warhammer_item_fateforge_mk_79_desolatio.levelRequirementReason: Only the most seasoned heroes can wield this weapon without succumbing to its malevolent influence.
warhammer_item_fateforge_mk_79_desolatio.vendorReason: The forge's master artisans crafted it, embodying the deepest secrets of fate and time.
warhammer_item_fateforge_mk_79_desolatio.shippingDetail: Shipped through a dimensional portal, this weapon arrives with a delay of one week due to the intricate nature of its transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; temporal shatter lasts until end of turn; will sap lasts for duration or until target moves
usage.endsWhen: On a successful save, ends immediately. Will sap ends when the target moves.

warhammer_item_fateforge_mk_79_desolatio.priceReason: The balance is adjusted to reflect the weapon's unique effects and its rarity within the game world.

warhammer_item_grim_bastards_shadow_devo.name: Grim Bastard’s Shadow Devourer
warhammer_item_grim_bastards_shadow_devo.description: The Grim Bastard’s Shadow Devourer is a warhammer forged from obsidian, its surface etched with dark runes that whisper of forgotten horrors. This weapon does not merely strike; it absorbs the very essence of its foes, feeding on their despair to fuel its wielder's aggression and prowess in battle. When wielded, a chilling mist envelops the user, amplifying their attack speed and giving them an unsettling advantage over their enemies.

effectDetails.title: Deals Shadow Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with a melee weapon attack while holding this warhammer, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be affected by the Silenced condition until the end of its next turn. On a critical hit, the target is also deafened for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Increases Attack Speed
effectDetails.rules: While holding this weapon, you have advantage on attack rolls with it and your attack speed is increased by one additional attack per round at the start of your turn. This effect ends if you drop or switch to another weapon.

warhammer_item_grim_bastards_shadow_devo.levelRequirementReason: This warhammer requires a level 15 character due to its dark magic and ability to absorb essence.
warhammer_item_grim_bastards_shadow_devo.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory deals in the most forbidden and powerful weapons, including those that manipulate shadow and darkness.
warhammer_item_grim_bastards_shadow_devo.shippingDetail: Delivered by a dark wraith courier, this item is escorted through the night sky to ensure it reaches its destination without being detected.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation with any melee weapon attack.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: On a failed saving throw or if you drop or switch weapons.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

warhammer_item_grim_bastards_shadow_devo.priceReason: The cost reflects its forbidden nature and the materials required to craft such a weapon that manipulates shadow magic.

pokemon_item_crimson_echoes_of_valor.name: Crimson Echoes of Valor's Fallen Treats
pokemon_item_crimson_echoes_of_valor.description: Crimson Echoes of Valor's Fallen Treats are crafted from crystallized battle cries, imbuing a Pokémon with a surge of aggressive determination and amplifying its attack power during moments of fierce combat. These treats not only enhance the eater’s aggression by +1 but also cause faint auditory hallucinations of legendary battles, inspiring them to push past their limits. The echoes seem to whisper of valorous deeds, temporarily heightening the Pokémon's resolve in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Attack Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, these treats temporarily increase a Pokémon’s attack power by 30% for 60 seconds. The effect is instantaneous upon consumption and lasts until the duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Aggression Boost
effectDetails.rules: Eating this treat grants +1 to Aggression, a stat that reflects a Pokémon's readiness for combat. This increase persists for the duration of battle or until the end of the encounter.

pokemon_item_crimson_echoes_of_valor.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for high-level trainers whose Pokémon have already demonstrated prowess in battle.
pokemon_item_crimson_echoes_of_valor.vendorReason: Pokemart, known for its vast selection of battle-enhancing items, offers these treats to help trainers and their Pokémon reach new heights of combat effectiveness.
pokemon_item_crimson_echoes_of_valor.shippingDetail: Ships via same-day Drone Delivery service, ensuring these precious treats arrive at your door in peak condition.

usage.activation: Eaten as a free action during the start of an encounter or battle.
usage.duration: 60 seconds per use.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect expires, and it can be used again after a short rest.

pokemon_item_crimson_echoes_of_valor.priceReason: This item’s rarity and potent effects justify its high price, reflecting the limited supply and significant enhancement to combat performance it provides.

pokemon_item_starmetal_fossil_fragments.name: Starmetal Fossil Fragments Mk.78
pokemon_item_starmetal_fossil_fragments.description: Forged from the very essence of a fallen star, these Starmetal Fossil Fragments Mk.78 are said to have been recovered from an ancient crater near the lunar peak of Mount Moon. These fragments infuse any Pokémon armor with celestial power, enhancing its defense and strengthening the bond between the wearer and the stars above. Applied to a Pokémon's armor, they grant a +40% increase in defense and +5 to the Stardust stat, making the Pokémon more resilient to psychic attacks.

effectDetails.title: Stellar Defense
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action when applied to a Pokémon’s armor. The Pokémon gains a +40% increase in defense until the end of its next turn. This effect ends if the Pokémon takes any damage.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Bond
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that grants the Pokémon +5 to its Stardust stat, enhancing its connection to stellar energies. This benefit remains as long as the fragments are attached to the armor and is lost when they are removed or the armor is destroyed.

pokemon_item_starmetal_fossil_fragments.levelRequirementReason: The Starmetal Fossil Fragments Mk.78 are accessible to all Pokémon, as their power lies in enhancing any armor rather than requiring a specific level.
pokemon_item_starmetal_fossil_fragments.vendorReason: The Safari Shop specializes in rare and ancient artifacts that enhance the prowess of Pokémon, making it an ideal location for these fragments.
pokemon_item_starmetal_fossil_fragments.shippingDetail: Ships via Magma Crane's Express Lane, ensuring timely delivery from the lunar peak to any region within a week.

usage.activation: Bonus action when applied to armor
usage.duration: Until end of next turn (Stellar Defense)
usage.endsWhen: Taking damage or removing fragments

pokemon_item_starmetal_fossil_fragments.priceReason: The Starmetal Fossil Fragments Mk.78 are priced at 1000 XP, reflecting their rarity and the significant enhancement they provide to any Pokémon armor.

pokemon_item_aurora_driftwood_treats.name: Aurora Driftwood Treats of the Fallen Bloom
pokemon_item_aurora_driftwood_treats.description: Aurora Driftwood Treats of the Fallen Bloom are crystalline snacks harvested from ancient bioluminescent flora within the Aurora Zone. The treats' delicate structure and iridescent sheen hint at their origins, as they glow faintly with a light that seems to weave between dimensions. Consuming these treats grants a Pokémon increased agility, allowing for more fluid movements in combat or exploration. The ephemeral luminescence also provides a boost in evasion, making the creature harder to hit by foes.

effectDetails.title: Agility Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the Pokémon's Speed is increased by +20% for 1 minute. This effect requires a bonus action to activate and has no save DC or uses limit.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Evasion
effectDetails.rules: The treat grants an additional +2 to the Pokémon's Evasion stat, which reflects in its AC and miss chance. This benefit lasts for 10 minutes and does not stack with other bonuses.

pokemon_item_aurora_driftwood_treats.levelRequirementReason: These treats are designed for beginners or those who need a quick boost without stringent level restrictions.
pokemon_item_aurora_driftwood_treats.vendorReason: The league store frequently stocks items favored by competitive trainers and rare finds, making these treats available to all aspiring champions.
pokemon_item_aurora_driftwood_treats.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly via the Winged Courier's aerial routes, ensuring that these delicacies arrive fresh from the Aurora Zone.

usage.duration: 1 minute (Agility Boost) / 10 minutes (Enhanced Evasion)
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration expires or Pokémon is incapacitated

pokemon_item_aurora_driftwood_treats.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity and unique properties of these treats, which are harvested from deep within the Aurora Zone.

faerun_item_brutal_walker_of_grimstone.name: Brutal Walker's Scrolls of Grimstone Resonance
faerun_item_brutal_walker_of_grimstone.description: The Brutal Walker's Scrolls of Grimstone Resonance are ancient, weathered parchment imbued with the raw strength of the stone giants who once toiled in the depths of the mountains. When invoked, they conjure a spectral stone walker that resonates with the earth, temporarily fortifying your defenses and granting you resilience against physical harm. The echoes of these scrolls amplify your attacks, leaving behind a trail of weakening blows that can cripple foes.

effectDetails.title: Stone Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, providing you with a +15% bonus to your AC for 1 minute. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Bleeding Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you deal damage with a melee weapon attack while the spectral stone walker is active, there is a 20% chance that the target becomes prone and starts bleeding on their next turn. This effect cannot be used more than once per short rest.

faerun_item_brutal_walker_of_grimstone.levelRequirementReason: The scrolls are crafted to assist seasoned adventurers who can appreciate their raw power.
faerun_item_brutal_walker_of_grimstone.vendorReason: They specialize in ancient and rare artifacts, including relics of the stone giants that once roamed Faerûn.
faerun_item_brutal_walker_of_grimstone.shippingDetail: Due to the fragile nature of these scrolls, they are transported using the Griffon Courier's enchanted flight pouches to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: the effect expires or you take any action that ends it (e.g., casting a spell)

faerun_item_brutal_walker_of_grimstone.priceReason: The scrolls are crafted from ancient dwarven runes and require significant magical energy to activate, making them moderately priced for their power.

faerun_item_shadow_scrolls_of_silent_whi.name: Shadow Scrolls of Silent Whispers - The Collector's Edition
faerun_item_shadow_scrolls_of_silent_whi.description: The Shadow Scrolls of Silent Whispers - The Collector's Edition are ancient, vellum-bound tomes recovered from a cultist’s hidden sanctum beneath Candlekeep. Their pages pulse with a chilling darkness that whispers unsettling truths when unfurled. These scrolls blur perception in dim light, granting advantage on Stealth checks and temporarily blurring the senses of those nearby, making foes more likely to fear them. The Collector's Edition adds an air of arcane prestige and a touch of forbidden lore.

effectDetails.title: Advantage on Stealth Checks
effectDetails.rules: When you use this item in dim light to make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, you gain advantage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Blur Perception
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute when unfurled, any creature within 30 feet that can see the scrolls must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn. This effect ends if an ally moves into the area.

faerun_item_shadow_scrolls_of_silent_whi.levelRequirementReason: The Collector's Edition is accessible to all adventurers, emphasizing its historical and magical significance rather than its power.
faerun_item_shadow_scrolls_of_silent_whi.vendorReason: As a repository of unique artifacts, Baldur's Bazaar naturally carries these prestigious scrolls.
faerun_item_shadow_scrolls_of_silent_whi.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dark Elf Messenger, ensuring safe delivery even in shadowy territories.

usage.activation: Unfurling the scrolls as an action
usage.duration: 1 minute per unfurling
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends for each creature on its next turn or if another creature enters the area

faerun_item_shadow_scrolls_of_silent_whi.priceReason: This Collector's Edition is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting the scrolls' historical significance and the effort to recover them from a hidden sanctum.

faerun_item_mythic_scroll_of_the_stone_g.name: Mythic Scroll of the Stone Gods - The Obsidian Verdict
faerun_item_mythic_scroll_of_the_stone_g.description: The Obsidian Verdict, a scroll forged in ancient temples to earth gods, radiates an aura of unyielding determination. Unfurl it and feel the ground tremble beneath your feet as a colossal golem made entirely from obsidian rises with a thunderous crash, its every strike capable of turning foes into stone. The scroll's power is not to be trifled with; only those who have faced the earth itself can wield this relic with any hope of survival.

effectDetails.title: Summon Obsidian Golem
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the scroll unleashes a colossal golem made from obsidian. The golem has a reach of 10 feet and can attack with its Slam (melee weapon attack) dealing 2d8 + 5 bludgeoning damage. It is immune to all non-magical attacks and gains temporary immunity to earth-based attacks for the duration of the effect.

effectDetails.title: Induce Petrification
effectDetails.rules: There's a 30% chance that any creature struck by the golem’s attack will be petrified. The save DC is 15. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn unless you succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw.

faerun_item_mythic_scroll_of_the_stone_g.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have faced the earth itself can wield this relic with any hope of survival.
faerun_item_mythic_scroll_of_the_stone_g.vendorReason: Waterdeep's market, known for its rare and powerful artifacts, is the only place where such a dangerous but potent scroll could be found.
faerun_item_mythic_scroll_of_the_stone_g.shippingDetail: Ships via Divine Pegasus Express. Expected delivery time is three game days from the nearest major city.

usage.duration: One use per day, lasting until the end of your next turn unless a creature saves successfully against the Petrification effect.
usage.endsWhen: The golem dissipates or the creature struck by its attack successfully saves against petrification.

faerun_item_mythic_scroll_of_the_stone_g.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this scroll offers a potent combination of offensive and defensive capabilities that are unparalleled in the market.

doughnut_hole_item_pulsating_center_shar.name: The Pulsating Center Shard
doughnut_hole_item_pulsating_center_shar.description: The Pulsating Center Shard is a fractured piece of void energy, its surface pulsing with an eerie rhythm. Held in one's hand, it subtly warps reality, making immediate surroundings feel distorted. This shard grants insight into hidden pathways and slightly distorts the perceptions of foes, reducing their accuracy by 10% for 30 seconds. It also resonates with the void, enhancing Insight checks by +5 for a minute, offering a fleeting glimpse into the unseen.

effectDetails.title: Minor Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Reduces enemy accuracy by 10% for 30 seconds. This effect ends if the shard is removed from one's hand or a saving throw (DC 12) is successful.

effectDetails.title: Void Resonance
effectDetails.rules: +5 to Insight checks for 1 minute. Ends when the duration expires, and the user must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw at the end of their next turn; on a failed save, they are stunned until the start of their next turn.

doughnut_hole_item_pulsating_center_shar.levelRequirementReason: Even for the least experienced adventurers, the shard's influence is too potent.
doughnut_hole_item_pulsating_center_shar.vendorReason: Void Vendor deals exclusively in items from the Fated Place, and this shard's origin aligns with her wares.
doughnut_hole_item_pulsating_center_shar.shippingDetail: Ships via a rift courier ensuring safe delivery within an hour of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held in one's hand.
usage.duration: 1 minute for Void Resonance; 30 seconds for Minor Distortion.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends upon removal from hand or successful saving throw.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one instance of each effect can be active at a time.

doughnut_hole_item_pulsating_center_shar.priceReason: The shard's rarity and potent effects justify its price in uncommon treasure.

doughnut_hole_item_jeweled_maker_nulls.name: Jeweled Maker's Nulls - Mk.37
doughnut_hole_item_jeweled_maker_nulls.description: The Jeweled Maker's Nulls - Mk.37 are intricately crafted from obsidian and adorned with twinkling, internal illuminations that cast an eerie light upon their surroundings. Hailing from a forgotten forge of ancient workshops, these nulls are imbued with the residual energies capable of stabilizing minor dimensional breaches. They hum softly as they absorb 25% of magical damage and provide a localized protection against void effects, rendering them nearly impervious to mystical void-related attacks.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Anchor
effectDetails.rules: Provides a 10-foot-radius area centered on you that is resistant to void effects. Enemies within the area take a -2 penalty to all saving throws against such attacks, and their effectiveness is reduced by 50%. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until an attacker enters or leaves the area.

effectDetails.title: Energy Absorption
effectDetails.rules: Absorbs 25% of any incoming magical damage dealt to you. The absorbed energy can be expelled as a bonus action, dealing 1d6 force damage to all creatures within 5 feet and creating a 10-foot-radius area that resists further magical damage for 1 minute.

doughnut_hole_item_jeweled_maker_nulls.levelRequirementReason: This level requirement ensures only powerful adventurers can harness the ancient power of these nulls.
doughnut_hole_item_jeweled_maker_nulls.vendorReason: The Hole Hawker is a master of rare and arcane artifacts, making them the ideal vendor for this item's unique properties.
doughnut_hole_item_jeweled_maker_nulls.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Carrier Drone, which guarantees safe delivery through interdimensional turbulence.

usage.activation: Instantaneous action to absorb damage or as a bonus action to expel absorbed energy.
usage.duration: 1 minute for Dimensional Anchor; lasts until expended for Energy Absorption.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires, an attacker enters/leaves the area (for Dimensional Anchor), or the absorbed energy is expelled (for Energy Absorption).

doughnut_hole_item_jeweled_maker_nulls.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rare materials and ancient crafting techniques required for its creation.

doughnut_hole_item_hollow_maker_void_pri.name: The Hollow Maker's Void Prism - Prototype Gamma
doughnut_hole_item_hollow_maker_void_pri.description: The Hollow Maker's Void Prism - Prototype Gamma is a deceptively simple prism, its body crafted from solidified shadow. It pulses with cold, unsettling light, casting eerie reflections that hint at its potential to unravel reality itself. This dangerous tool can fire concentrated beams of void energy, dealing devastating damage and causing nearby targets to experience minor visual and auditory hallucinations, as if the fabric of space-time is warping around them.

effectDetails.title: Void Beam
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Fires a concentrated beam of void energy at one target within 60 feet, dealing 1d8 + 2 force damage per level (maximum 5d8). The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be pushed back 10 feet and take an additional 3d6 force damage. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reality Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Causes minor visual and auditory hallucinations in all creatures within 30 feet for 1 minute, reducing their accuracy by 2 on attack rolls and saving throws. The duration can be ended early with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check or if the user of this item is hit by an attack.

doughnut_hole_item_hollow_maker_void_pri.levelRequirementReason: This item requires basic control over void energy, making it accessible to lower-level characters who have shown interest in forbidden knowledge.
doughnut_hole_item_hollow_maker_void_pri.vendorReason: The center seller deals in a wide array of items, including those that are considered too dangerous for regular sale. The Hollow Maker's Void Prism is no exception, as it requires special handling and expertise.
doughnut_hole_item_hollow_maker_void_pri.shippingDetail: Delivery via the Black Hole Transport Vessel ensures secure and timely transport, but due to its exotic nature, it can only be shipped once per month.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Void Beam; bonus action for Reality Distortion.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with Void Beam; 1 minute duration with Reality Distortion.
usage.endsWhen: The effect of Void Beam ends when the target successfully saves or after 1d4+2 rounds. The effect of Reality Distortion can be ended by a successful saving throw, being hit by an attack, or the user using it again.

doughnut_hole_item_hollow_maker_void_pri.priceReason: The price is set at 1000 XP to reflect its exotic materials and the risk involved in handling such a dangerous item.

warhammer_item_ironclad_desolation_born.name: Ironclad Desolation Born’s Skull Fragment
warhammer_item_ironclad_desolation_born.description: A splintered fragment from a colossal skull, Ironclad Desolation Born’s Skull Fragment radiates an unsettling calm, promising resilience against chaotic forces and bolstering defensive capabilities — but only for those who embrace destruction. Crafted in the heart of a crumbling empire, this relic whispers of ancient battles fought and lost, its very essence pulsing with the memory of fallen warriors. It grants the wielder a fortified shield against chaos, reflecting attacks that seek to shatter the spirit.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Shield
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wielder gains a +30 bonus to AC against chaotic attacks. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn. If they take any damage from a chaotic source, this effect is expended.

effectDetails.title: Reflective Resilience
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that grants temporary resistance to fear effects. The wearer has advantage on saving throws against being frightened. This effect persists until the start of their next turn after taking damage from a chaotic source or losing concentration.

warhammer_item_ironclad_desolation_born.levelRequirementReason: Only for those who have proven their mettle in the harshest battles, this relic demands a high level to wield its power responsibly.
warhammer_item_ironclad_desolation_born.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory curates only the most potent and historically significant artifacts to be used by heroes of the realm.
warhammer_item_ironclad_desolation_born.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly, but requires a secure location upon arrival due to its volatile nature.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Fortified Shield; passive effect for Reflective Resilience.
usage.duration: Fortified Shield lasts until the end of their next turn; Reflective Resilience persists until the start of their next turn after taking chaotic damage or losing concentration.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon taking chaotic damage or lost concentration. Fortified Shield is also expended if the wielder takes any damage from a chaotic source.

warhammer_item_ironclad_desolation_born.priceReason: The price reflects its legendary rarity and the immense power it holds, suitable for only the most seasoned heroes.

warhammer_item_chaos_dealer_mk_9_skull_w.name: Chaos Dealer Mk.9 Skull Whisperer’s Resonance Core
warhammer_item_chaos_dealer_mk_9_skull_w.description: The Chaos Dealer Mk.9 Skull Whisperer’s Resonance Core pulsates with a chaotic energy that dances like broken stars within its hollow eye sockets. Crafted from fragments of shattered realities, this core whispers secrets of probability and fate to those who wield it. A fleeting glimpse into the possible future outcomes can be achieved by those brave enough to handle it, but beware—prolonged exposure risks unraveling one's sanity.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can attempt to manipulate enemy movement within a 10-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends early if the wielder takes damage or drops below half hit points.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Resonance
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of the wielder's turns, there is a 50% chance that a random chaotic effect (either positive or negative) occurs. This effect has no save DC and can be triggered up to three times per long rest.

warhammer_item_chaos_dealer_mk_9_skull_w.levelRequirementReason: Requires high proficiency with martial weapons and an understanding of chaos magic.
warhammer_item_chaos_dealer_mk_9_skull_w.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer is a notorious vendor in the realms, known for its unique and dangerous wares, including this artifact.
warhammer_item_chaos_dealer_mk_9_skull_w.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of darkness to prevent unwanted attention from reality-warping entities.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as a reaction (to manipulate enemy movement).
usage.duration: 1 minute, ends early if the wielder takes damage or drops below half hit points.
usage.endsWhen: The duration expires or the wielder is incapacitated.

warhammer_item_chaos_dealer_mk_9_skull_w.priceReason: The artifact’s rarity and unique chaotic properties justify its high price in the realm of night-time commerce.

warhammer_item_fate_forge_obsidian_skull.name: Fate Forge Obsidian Skull of Echoes - Variant VII
warhammer_item_fate_forge_obsidian_skull.description: The Fate Forge Obsidian Skull of Echoes, a dark and intricate relic forged from the very fabric of forgotten timelines, whispers the secrets of alternate realities into the ears of those who hold it. Its cold obsidian surface shimmers with the fractured light of countless futures, offering glimpses of destinies yet to unfold or already passed. A dangerous tool for the unwary, it grants fleeting insights into prophecies and the power to resist fate’s pull—but at a cost: confronting its echoes can unravel one's true path.

effectDetails.title: Prophetic Insight
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may activate the skull to gain one insight into a future event or forgotten prophecy. This effect is instantaneous and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Fate Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While holding the skull, you have advantage on saving throws against effects that would alter your destiny or manipulate time. This benefit lasts for 1 hour, but it ends early if you willingly discard the skull.

warhammer_item_fate_forge_obsidian_skull.levelRequirementReason: The item's power and complexity necessitate a high level to wield effectively.
warhammer_item_fate_forge_obsidian_skull.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in relics that interact with time and destiny, making the Obsidian Skull of Echoes an appropriate addition to their inventory.
warhammer_item_fate_forge_obsidian_skull.shippingDetail: Ships via the Fate Weaver’s Cart, known for its timely and reliable deliveries within the realm.

usage.duration: Instantaneous or 1 hour (at your discretion)
usage.endsWhen: Voluntarily discarded or used up in a short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one insight per short rest

warhammer_item_fate_forge_obsidian_skull.priceReason: The item's unique effects and rarity justify this price point.

warhammer_item_bonecrusher-of-broken-reg.name: Bonecrusher of Broken Regiments
warhammer_item_bonecrusher-of-broken-reg.description: The Bonecrusher of Broken Regiments is a colossal warhammer, its surface etched with the petrified bones of countless legionaries who perished in battle. It hums with the spirit-crushing power of ancient legions, and when wielded, it commands nearby allies to fight with renewed vigor while casting an aura that weakens foes' resolve. Its very touch can turn the tide of combat, as it grants the user a chilling command over lesser combatants and saps their morale.

effectDetails.title: Bone Command
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can issue a command to nearby allies within 30 feet. These allies gain advantage on their next attack roll or saving throw against fear effects before the end of your next turn. The effect has a limited use per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Sapping
effectDetails.rules: The Bonecrusher grants you a chilling aura within 30 feet that reduces enemy morale, increasing the chance of critical hits by +2d4 against targets within this range. This aura lasts until the end of your next turn.

warhammer_item_bonecrusher-of-broken-reg.levelRequirementReason: The Bonecrusher's ancient power demands a seasoned warrior to wield it effectively.
warhammer_item_bonecrusher-of-broken-reg.vendorReason: The imperial armory specializes in rare and potent weapons forged from the bones of fallen heroes.
warhammer_item_bonecrusher-of-broken-reg.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift winged beasts, ensuring the weapon arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Bone Command; lasts until the end of your next turn for Spirit Sapping
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you finish a short rest or are incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one command can be issued per short rest.

warhammer_item_bonecrusher-of-broken-reg.priceReason: Balanced to reflect the weapon's ancient power and rarity, yet not overpriced for its intended use level.

warhammer_item-rune-master-of-desolation.name: Rune Master of Desolation
warhammer_item-rune-master-of-desolation.description: The Rune Master of Desolation is a dark, runic warhammer forged from the shattered remains of an ancient warlord’s throne. Its surface gleams with potent runes that pulse with necrotic energy, inflicting grievous wounds upon your enemies and reducing their ability to heal. This relic offers formidable protection against physical attacks, granting you a 40% increase in defense while also slowing any enemy's movement speed by 20 feet for every successful hit.

effectDetails.title: Necrotic Infusion
effectDetails.rules: The Rune Master of Desolation channels potent runes of decay, dealing 1d6 necrotic damage with each successful hit. There is a 25% chance that this damage reduces the target's healing ability by half for one minute on a successful hit. The effect ends if the target successfully saves against a DC 18 Constitution saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Slow Movement
effectDetails.rules: Whenever you strike an enemy with the Rune Master of Desolation, they are slowed by 20 feet until the start of their next turn. This condition can be removed by taking a short rest or by using a spell that specifically counters speed reduction. The effect ends if the target successfully saves against a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw.

warhammer_item-rune-master-of-desolation.levelRequirementReason: The Rune Master of Desolation requires significant strength and experience to wield effectively, as it channels potent necrotic energies.
warhammer_item-rune-master-of-desolation.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer specializes in items forged from the remains of fallen heroes and warlords, making this relic a perfect fit for their inventory.
warhammer_item-rune-master-of-desolation.shippingDetail: The mechanical drone delivers the Rune Master of Desolation with precision, ensuring it reaches its destination intact and ready to be wielded.

usage.activation: Instantaneous activation on contact with an enemy during your action or reaction.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn for each effect.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end if a target successfully saves against their respective saving throw, or when the weapon is dropped or destroyed.

warhammer_item-rune-master-of-desolation.priceReason: The Rune Master of Desolation is priced at 1000 XP due to its rarity and the significant necrotic power it channels.

warhammer_item-fate-weaver-chronal-scrib.name: Fate Weaver Chronal Scribe
warhammer_item-fate-weaver-chronal-scrib.description: The Fate Weaver Chronal Scribe is a macabre device, a fusion of clockwork and bone that whispers of time's fragile nature. Crafted from the remains of ancient battles and powered by fate itself, it allows its wielder to bend reality to their will, subtly altering the flow of combat. Each use comes at a heavy cost: not only does it sap the user’s energy, but it also leaves behind lingering distortions that ripple through time.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can rewind time around themselves for 3 seconds. During this time, they and their allies gain advantage on attack rolls, but all enemies within a 10-foot radius have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. The effect ends when the user takes damage or if the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Time Distortion
effectDetails.rules: The device causes minor temporal distortions that reduce enemy accuracy by 2 until their next turn, as a reaction to an attack roll. This effect can be used once per short rest and has no save DC or saving throw.

warhammer_item-fate-weaver-chronal-scrib.levelRequirementReason: The device is too powerful for lower levels; only experienced warriors with the discipline to wield such power are allowed.
warhammer_item-fate-weaver-chronal-scrib.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in crafting and selling items that manipulate time and fate, making it a natural home for this Chronal Scribe.
warhammer_item-fate-weaver-chronal-scrib.shippingDetail: The device is shipped through the dimensional portal, ensuring its safe arrival but also increasing the shipping time by one day.

usage.activation: Bonus action to rewind time; reaction to enemy attack for time distortion.
usage.duration: 3 seconds or until interrupted.
usage.endsWhen: User takes damage or duration expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per short rest.

warhammer_item-fate-weaver-chronal-scrib.priceReason: The item's rarity and powerful effects justify its price of 1000 XP.

middle_earth_item_the_stonecutter_forger.name: The Stonecutter Forger's Axe Head
middle_earth_item_the_stonecutter_forger.description: The Stonecutter Forger's Axe Head is a dwarven-forged marvel, crafted from petrified wood imbued with ancient runes that whisper of forgotten mines and lost treasures. This axe head resonates with an earthy hum when swung, bolstering the wielder’s strength and granting temporary resistance to earth-based attacks. Its very touch seems to strengthen the hand of its bearer, making it a formidable weapon against stone-forged orcs and goblins in the depths of Middle-earth.

effectDetails.title: Earth Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When you are hit by an earth-based attack, gain resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn. This effect can only occur once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Strengthening Strike
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you may swing the axe head to emit a tremor in the ground around you, forcing all creatures within 10 feet to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they are knocked prone.

middle_earth_item_the_stonecutter_forger.levelRequirementReason: The intricate runes and petrified wood require significant strength and experience to wield effectively.
middle_earth_item_the_stonecutter_forger.vendorReason: Only the skilled forges of the Dwarves can craft such a weapon, imbued with both their craftsmanship and ancient earth magic.
middle_earth_item_the_stonecutter_forger.shippingDetail: Ships via a specially chartered dwarven cart, delivered within one week from the forge.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as part of an attack action
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Earth Resistance; Concentration (up to 1 minute) for Stun effect
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends at the start of your next turn, or when you are no longer hit by earth-based attacks.

middle_earth_item_the_stonecutter_forger.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and infused with powerful runes, this axe head is a high-demand item among warriors of Middle-earth.

middle_earth_item_the_shadowed_blade_of_.name: The Shadowed Blade of Mournful Echoes
middle_earth_item_the_shadowed_blade_of_.description: The Shadowed Blade of Mournful Echoes is a wickedly curved obsidian blade forged from a single shard taken directly from the Black Gate. Its whispers resonate with the sorrow of those who have met their ends there, instilling fear in foes and briefly blurring vision for anyone who dares confront it. This weapon is perfect for assassins seeking to remain unseen or explorers delving into ancient tombs where shadows linger.

effectDetails.title: Frighten
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with this blade as part of an attack, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The effect ends if the target takes any damage before the end of its next turn.

effectDetails.title: Blur Vision
effectDetails.rules: For 1 round after you hit with this weapon, creatures within 30 feet that see you are blinded until the start of your next turn. A successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw ends the effect early.

middle_earth_item_the_shadowed_blade_of_.levelRequirementReason: This blade is crafted to be accessible for all who seek its power, making it a versatile tool for adventurers of any level.
middle_earth_item_the_shadowed_blade_of_.vendorReason: The elven market caters to all adventurers, offering rare and powerful items that can aid in their quests.
middle_earth_item_the_shadowed_blade_of_.shippingDetail: The blade is shipped via the swift hawk courier, ensuring it arrives swiftly and intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for each effect
usage.endsWhen: Target saves successfully or takes damage; ends if the wielder attacks again

middle_earth_item_the_shadowed_blade_of_.priceReason: The blade's rarity and unique properties, combined with its utility in combat situations, justify this fair value.

middle_earth_item_the_shire_messenger_sc.name: The Shire Messenger Scrolls of Lost Lore - Volume I
middle_earth_item_the_shire_messenger_sc.description: The Shire Messenger Scrolls of Lost Lore - Volume I are meticulously bound in parchment, their edges adorned with intricate filigree. These scrolls glow faintly with a warm, golden light, emanating an aura that whispers tales of the distant past. Scholars and healers alike find these scrolls invaluable, for they not only provide inspiration but also subtly mend the body and mind, offering fleeting glimpses into forgotten lore and minor enchantments.

effectDetails.title: Inspiration Boost
effectDetails.rules: When a reader actively studies one of these scrolls, they gain advantage on their next Intelligence or Wisdom check. This effect lasts for the start of their next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Healing Touch
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation by a scholar, this scroll grants temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). The effect is instantaneous and can be used once per day.

middle_earth_item_the_shire_messenger_sc.levelRequirementReason: The scrolls are accessible to scholars at any level, providing them with the tools necessary for unlocking ancient knowledge.
middle_earth_item_the_shire_messenger_sc.vendorReason: The Shire Shop is known for its extensive collection of scholarly and magical curiosities, making it a natural place for these scrolls.
middle_earth_item_the_shire_messenger_sc.shippingDetail: Ships via the Pony Express with expedited delivery within two game days.

usage.activation: Activates when a scholar actively studies one of the scrolls during their turn or as an action.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Inspiration Boost; lasts until start of next long rest. Healing Touch is instantaneous and can be used once per day.
usage.endsWhen: Inspiration boost ends at the start of the reader's next long rest, or if the scroll is damaged beyond repair. Healing touch effect ends immediately after use.

middle_earth_item_the_shire_messenger_sc.priceReason: The scrolls are priced based on their rarity and unique scholarly value, offering a significant boost to both knowledge acquisition and healing abilities.

warhammer_item_verdant_marked_banners_of.name: Verdant Marked’s Banners of the Wrath
warhammer_item_verdant_marked_banners_of.description: Verdant Marked’s Banners of the Wrath are crafted from threads spun by ancient trees in a forgotten forest and etched with chaotic runes that pulse with raw fury. When unfurled, these banners inspire soldiers to charge into battle with unyielding ferocity; their presence can turn even the most cautious warriors into berserk fighters. However, prolonged exposure risks overwhelming the minds of those who wield them, leading to reckless actions and diminished defenses.

effectDetails.title: Berserk Enchantment
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. For the next three turns, allies within 10 feet gain +2 to attack rolls and are immune to fear effects but have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened. If an ally takes damage from a creature they are raging against, they must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or enter a berserk state for the rest of their turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Defense Reduction
effectDetails.rules: The wielder and all allies within 10 feet have their AC reduced by 2 while the banners are unfurled. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn or until you take damage from a creature other than yourself.

warhammer_item_verdant_marked_banners_of.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high-level character to wield due to its potent effects and the risk it poses.
warhammer_item_verdant_marked_banners_of.vendorReason: The banners are so rare that only the most trusted arms dealers, like those at the Imperial Armory, can supply them.
warhammer_item_verdant_marked_banners_of.shippingDetail: Ships via sky-carriage for expedited delivery. A courier must be present to receive the shipment, and it is delivered within a day of order confirmation.

usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next turn or until you take damage from another creature.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire upon taking damage, ending the berserk state and restoring normal AC.

warhammer_item_verdant_marked_banners_of.priceReason: This price reflects a rare artifact with balanced effects that can be used to enhance combat effectiveness without being overpowered.

warhammer_item_mk_81_chaos_marked_resona.name: Mk.81 Chaotic Marked Resonator of Discord
warhammer_item_mk_81_chaos_marked_resona.description: Forged in the heart of a shattered battlefield, this resonator hums with raw chaotic energy, its surface etched with ancient runes that glow with malevolent light. When activated, it emits waves that scramble enemy formations and induce moments of debilitating confusion amongst their ranks, causing them to falter and misfire their attacks. Its resonance can be felt in the very air, warping the battlefield and leaving a trail of chaos in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this resonator emits waves that scramble the formations of enemies within a 15-meter radius. This effect has a duration of 1 minute and reduces their movement speed by 20 feet for the entire duration. Enemies are also given disadvantage on saving throws against being disoriented.

effectDetails.title: Misfired Attacks
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that any attack made by enemies within range during the effect's duration will miss their target. This effect ends when the resonator runs out of charges or if it is destroyed.

warhammer_item_mk_81_chaos_marked_resona.levelRequirementReason: The resonator requires a significant amount of magical energy to stabilize its chaotic resonance, making level 15 the minimum requirement for activation.
warhammer_item_mk_81_chaos_marked_resona.vendorReason: The chaos dealer is known to have access to rare and powerful artifacts from realms where order and chaos are in constant flux.
warhammer_item_mk_81_chaos_marked_resona.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional portal, delivering the resonator within seconds of purchase but requiring special handling for its volatile nature.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Charges are depleted or it is destroyed

warhammer_item_mk_81_chaos_marked_resona.priceReason: The resonator's chaotic energy and the specialized craftsmanship required for its creation justify a price of 1,000 XP.

warhammer_item_mk_57_godly_banners_of_th.name: Mk.57 Godly Banners of the Eternal Storm
warhammer_item_mk_57_godly_banners_of_th.description: Mk.57 Godly Banners of the Eternal Storm are woven from solidified lightning and imbued with divine essence, radiating an aura that can shatter even the most stalwart defenses. These banners not only deal 50% extra lightning damage but also summon a small storm cloud that rains down bolts of lightning, adding a tempestuous presence to any battlefield. Commanding them grants mastery over storms and a terrifying presence that intimidates foes.

effectDetails.title: Summon Tempest Cloud
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can summon a tempest cloud that rains down bolts of lightning within a 30-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and requires a successful DC 25 Wisdom (Intimidation) check to control it effectively. The cloud deals 4d6 lightning damage per round to all creatures in its area, but friendly creatures are immune.

effectDetails.title: Immunity to Thunder
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains immunity to thunder and lightning attacks for the duration of one short or long rest. This effect can be activated once every 24 hours.

warhammer_item_mk_57_godly_banners_of_th.levelRequirementReason: These banners are reserved for high-level clerics who have mastered the art of storm manipulation.
warhammer_item_mk_57_godly_banners_of_th.vendorReason: Fate Forge is known for its divine artifacts, and these banners are among their most powerful creations.
warhammer_item_mk_57_godly_banners_of_th.shippingDetail: Ships via angelic courier within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action to summon the tempest cloud; once per long rest to gain immunity to thunder and lightning attacks.
usage.duration: Tempest cloud lasts for 1 minute, immunity lasts until next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The user dismisses the cloud or falls unconscious. Immunity ends at the end of a short or long rest.

warhammer_item_mk_57_godly_banners_of_th.priceReason: Crafted from divine essence and lightning, these banners are among the most expensive and powerful items in the realm.

grand_country_item_the_spiral_ascension_.name: The Spiral Ascension Claimed
grand_country_item_the_spiral_ascension_.description: The Spiral Ascension Claimed is a shimmering, iridescent bridge spun from solidified vertigo and captured updrafts of the skies above the grand country's highest peaks. Its surface pulses with a faint, ethereal glow that dances in the wind, offering brief moments of weightless ascent. Touching this claimed surface allows for traversals across treacherous vertical gaps with surprising grace, though the mind can easily be overtaken by disorientation as one hovers above the abyss below.

effectDetails.title: Weightless Traversal
effectDetails.rules: When activated via a bonus action, the user gains the ability to hover and move vertically for up to 10 feet. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn or until they choose to end it early. If the user moves beyond the claimed surface's range while in this state, they are immediately returned to its edge with no further movement.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Touch
effectDetails.rules: Anyone who comes into contact with the claimed surface has a 25% chance of being subjected to a brief moment of disorientation. This effect lasts for 1 minute and imposes disadvantage on all ability checks, saving throws, and attack rolls until it ends.

grand_country_item_the_spiral_ascension_.levelRequirementReason: This item's weightless traversal allows even the novice adventurer to traverse dangerous vertical gaps with ease.
grand_country_item_the_spiral_ascension_.vendorReason: The Vertical Vendor specializes in equipment that aids adventurers in overcoming the grand country’s most challenging terrain, making The Spiral Ascension Claimed a logical addition to their stock.
grand_country_item_the_spiral_ascension_.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the Wind Carrier, ensuring even the most remote regions can receive this life-saving equipment within hours.

usage.duration: Up to 10 feet of vertical movement or until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: You choose to end it early or move beyond its claimed surface's range

grand_country_item_the_spiral_ascension_.priceReason: The Spiral Ascension Claimed provides significant utility, allowing any level character to traverse dangerous vertical gaps with ease and safety.

grand_country_item_eldritch_bridges_of_t.name: Eldritch Bridges of the Stone Maw
grand_country_item_eldritch_bridges_of_t.description: The Eldritch Bridges of the Stone Maw are unholy conduits woven from the whispers of ancient stone and the screams of the earth's forgotten victims. Each step is a negotiation with the maw itself, as the bridges pulse with raw, unyielding power. Misstep too often, and you risk collapsing into the abyssal maw. These bridges offer temporary strength and resistance to stone damage, but at a cost—a slight slowing of time around them that could spell disaster for unwary travelers.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Strength
effectDetails.rules: When the Eldritch Bridges are activated, the user gains +3 to their Strength score as a bonus action. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Inhibition
effectDetails.rules: The immediate vicinity around the bridges experiences a 5% reduction in time passage while they are active. This effect ends when the activation is expended or disrupted by an external force.

grand_country_item_eldritch_bridges_of_t.levelRequirementReason: Even the most novice adventurers can appreciate the strategic value of these bridges.
grand_country_item_eldritch_bridges_of_t.vendorReason: Side sellers often have unique and unconventional items that appeal to a variety of customers, from seasoned adventurers to those just starting their journey.
grand_country_item_eldritch_bridges_of_t.shippingDetail: Ships via the Stone Crawler, a massive earth elemental known for its careful handling of delicate cargo.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The activation is expended or interrupted by an external force

grand_country_item_eldritch_bridges_of_t.priceReason: Balanced at this price, it offers a significant but not overpowering advantage for adventurers of all levels.

grand_country_item_layered_chronometric_.name: Layered Chronometric Nexus Claimed
grand_country_item_layered_chronometric_.description: The Layered Chronometric Nexus Claimed is a multi-tiered device crafted from ancient temporal echoes and polished obsidian, encased in an intricate lattice of silver filigree. By touching its claimed node, it warps the flow of time around you, creating fleeting opportunities for strategic advantage—though prolonged exposure risks fracturing your personal timeline's coherence. This delicate artifact is a testament to the forgotten artistry of the Time Weavers, renowned for their mastery of temporal mechanics.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Surge
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate this device at a claimed node to manipulate time in a localized area. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the next sunrise. Within range (30 feet), you gain advantage on initiative rolls and can take an additional action each round. This effect ends early if you sustain damage.

effectDetails.title: Timeline Fracture
effectDetails.rules: After using Temporal Surge, there is a 1-in-6 chance that your personal timeline will be fractured for 1 hour during the next full moon cycle. This risk increases by one in six every five uses of this effect.

grand_country_item_layered_chronometric_.levelRequirementReason: This device requires significant understanding and control over time manipulation, suitable only for those with considerable experience.
grand_country_item_layered_chronometric_.vendorReason: The Layer Market is known for its diverse collection of mystical artifacts and devices, including the rarest and most powerful curiosities like this one.
grand_country_item_layered_chronometric_.shippingDetail: Shipped via time courier; arrives exactly when ordered, but requires a full moon cycle for activation.

usage.activation: Bonus action at a claimed node
usage.duration: 1 minute or until next sunrise
usage.endsWhen: Sustained damage or use limit reached

grand_country_item_layered_chronometric_.priceReason: Balanced for its rarity and the risk it poses to users, this device is priced at a reasonable 1000 XP.

doughnut_hole_item_gilded_chronal_herald.name: The Chronal Herald of Gilded Echoes
doughnut_hole_item_gilded_chronal_herald.description: The Chronal Herald of Gilded Echoes is a pulsating orb encased in layers of solidified void-matter, its surface shimmering with temporal runes that whisper futures yet to unfold. When held, fleeting visions of potential golden events overlay the present, granting insights into possible outcomes but risk fracturing your timeline if exposure exceeds three seconds. The Herald's gilded glow hints at its power to stabilize temporal anomalies and perceive the future with increased accuracy for a brief moment.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Echo
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the user briefly glimpses into potential futures. This effect lasts for 10 seconds and has a chance to rewind time by 3 seconds on each use. There is no save required, but holding it too long risks timeline fracture.

effectDetails.title: Chronal Stability
effectDetails.rules: This passive effect reduces the user's susceptibility to temporal instability effects by half for as long as they hold the Herald. It has a duration of 1 hour and can be reactivated after a short rest.

doughnut_hole_item_gilded_chronal_herald.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant mastery over time magic are capable of safely wielding such a volatile artifact.
doughnut_hole_item_gilded_chronal_herald.vendorReason: The Void Vendor specializes in rare and dangerous artifacts, including time-based relics like the Chronal Herald.
doughnut_hole_item_gilded_chronal_herald.shippingDetail: Delivered via interdimensional courier; arrives within three days of order placement.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; can be used once per short rest.
usage.duration: 10 seconds for Temporal Echo, 1 hour passively with Chronal Stability
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the user releases the Herald or timeline fracture occurs.

doughnut_hole_item_gilded_chronal_herald.priceReason: The Chronal Herald's rarity and volatile nature justify its high price, reflecting both its potential for chaos and power.

doughnut_hole_item_mk83_anomaly_of_silen.name: Mk.83 Anomaly of Silent Depths
doughnut_hole_item_mk83_anomaly_of_silen.description: The Mk.83 Anomaly of Silent Depths is a geometrically perfect obsidian cube, its surface etched with ancient runes that seem to hum with a forgotten language. When held, it absorbs all ambient sound, creating a small, perfectly silent zone around the wielder. The cube's edges shimmer faintly as if they are on the verge of warping space itself, and the air feels thick with the weight of unsaid secrets. Touching its surface is to enter a realm where time seems to bend and forgotten pathways whisper their locations.

effectDetails.title: Silence Zone
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this cube creates a small area of absolute silence around the wielder with a radius of 10 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be maintained by concentrating on it as an action each round. The silence prevents all sound from entering or leaving the zone, including verbal speech and magical effects that require sound. A successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw ends the effect early.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Shimmer
effectDetails.rules: The cube has a minor chance to cause dimensional distortions when activated. There is a 20% chance (roll a d5) that the wielder and one willing creature within 10 feet are teleported up to 30 feet in any direction, instantly moving them out of harm's way. The effect ends immediately if the wielder or target takes damage.

doughnut_hole_item_mk83_anomaly_of_silen.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a character with at least 4 levels to handle its potent and ancient power.
doughnut_hole_item_mk83_anomaly_of_silen.vendorReason: The Hole Hawker specializes in bizarre and arcane items, making the Anomaly of Silent Depths an ideal fit for their inventory.
doughnut_hole_item_mk83_anomaly_of_silen.shippingDetail: Due to its highly sensitive nature, the Anomaly is only delivered by the Phantom Courier service, ensuring safe arrival.

usage.duration: 1 minute (concentration required; ends early with a saving throw or damage)
usage.endsWhen: The concentration ends as an action each round or when the wielder takes damage
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be maintained for 1 minute

doughnut_hole_item_mk83_anomaly_of_silen.priceReason: Its rare and ancient origins, combined with its powerful effects in creating a silence zone and causing dimensional distortions, justify this high price.

doughnut_hole_item_null_fragments_of_the.name: Null Fragments of the Decaying Void
doughnut_hole_item_null_fragments_of_the.description: A collection of iridescent, shattered plates - remnants of a collapsed dimension – each pulsing with an unsettling, cold energy.  These fragments seem to accelerate the decay process in organic matter and can be used to temporarily disrupt void-based defenses.
effects: Void Decay (Deals minor void damage over time)
Nullification (Reduces the effectiveness of void-based attacks)
Fragmented Resonance (Small chance to inflict Confusion)

kivotos_item_the_spectral_ward_of_resona.name: The Spectral Ward of Resonance
kivotos_item_the_spectral_ward_of_resona.description: The Spectral Ward of Resonance is a shimmering, spectral construct that hums with echoes from countless student council meetings. Crafted from the collective disappointment and youthful idealism of its creators, it amplifies your persuasive abilities within a small radius, creating an auditory distortion that confounds opponents and allies alike. This ward draws upon the very essence of campus lore to enhance communication skills and create a localized echo effect that can sway even the most hardened listeners.

effectDetails.title: Echoing Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you activate the Spectral Ward of Resonance to amplify your persuasive abilities within a 10-foot radius. For the next minute, all creatures within this area have disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed by you and must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the start of their turn or be charmed for up to 1 minute. The ward can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Auditory Distortion
effectDetails.rules: The Spectral Ward creates an auditory distortion within its radius, causing creatures within a 20-foot radius to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you and advantage on saving throws. This effect lasts for 1 minute unless dispelled or the ward is destroyed.

kivotos_item_the_spectral_ward_of_resona.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to effectively command and utilize its persuasive abilities in a meaningful way.
kivotos_item_the_spectral_ward_of_resona.vendorReason: The student store, with its ties to campus life and culture, is the natural vendor for an item steeped in the lore of student council debates and youthful aspirations.
kivotos_item_the_spectral_ward_of_resona.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly by drone, ensuring you are ready for your next debate or persuasive encounter.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect is dispelled or the ward is destroyed.

kivotos_item_the_spectral_ward_of_resona.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique combination of persuasive and battlefield utility within a limited radius.

kivotos_item_mk.34_cards_of_discord.name: Mk.34 Cards of Discord
kivotos_item_mk.34_cards_of_discord.description: Mk.34 Cards of Discord are a deck of finely crafted tarot cards, each depicting a vivid confrontation between rival club factions. These cards are forged from the very essence of youthful frustration and compressed arguments, making them a potent tool for sowing chaos among groups. When played, they force targets to make impulsive decisions, reducing their coordination by 50% for 30 seconds, and have a chance to distract nearby NPCs with minor disruptions.

effectDetails.title: Forces Chaotic Decisions
effectDetails.rules: When played as an action, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or take a -2 penalty to all ability checks and attack rolls for the rest of their next turn. The card's effect ends if the player discards it.

effectDetails.title: Reduces Coordination
effectDetails.rules: Once per encounter, when played as an action within 30 feet, targets within a 15-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14) or have their team coordination reduced by 50% for 30 seconds. This effect ends if the item is destroyed.

kivotos_item_mk.34_cards_of_discord.levelRequirementReason: These cards are accessible to players of all levels as they serve as a tool for chaos and disruption, but require player skill to use effectively.
kivotos_item_mk.34_cards_of_discord.vendorReason: Club Supply stocks these items due to their popularity among club members looking to add some unpredictability to their social encounters.
kivotos_item_mk.34_cards_of_discord.shippingDetail: Courier Pigeon delivers the cards within a week, but only during the night hours when the effects are most potent.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until discarded or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: When discarded or destroyed

kivotos_item_mk.34_cards_of_discord.priceReason: The cards are priced at 1000 XP due to their rare material and unique crafting, but players can use them often without exhausting resources.

kivotos_item_the_faction_cards_of_halo.name: The Faction Cards of Halo
kivotos_item_the_faction_cards_of_halo.description: The Faction Cards of Halo are a set of intricately crafted, ornate cards that each bear the symbol and colors of one of the five major student factions within the academy. These cards possess an enigmatic aura that subtly influences those who handle them, allowing their bearer to sway opinions or gain temporary access to restricted areas. By playing these cards in strategic settings, one can command subtle but significant influence over the faction’s actions and decisions.

effectDetails.title: Sway Opinions
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you may present one card to a group of up to five individuals. They must make a Charisma saving throw (DC 15). On a failed save, the target’s attitude towards you improves by one step on the appropriate attitude scale for the faction represented by the card. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Gain Temporary Access
effectDetails.rules: By displaying two cards simultaneously during a relevant moment (such as an entrance or meeting), you gain temporary access to restricted areas associated with the factions depicted on the cards for 24 hours. This effect is limited to once per week.

kivotos_item_the_faction_cards_of_halo.levelRequirementReason: The cards require basic understanding of social dynamics and faction interactions.
kivotos_item_the_faction_cards_of_halo.vendorReason: The Academy Armory caters to students seeking strategic advantages within the institution.
