kivotos_item_the_faction_cards_of_halo.shippingDetail: Ships via the Automated Delivery System, arriving within one business day.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Sway Opinions; 24 hours for Gain Temporary Access
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the conclusion of a long rest for Sway Opinions; expires after 24 hours for temporary access.

kivotos_item_the_faction_cards_of_halo.priceReason: The cards are priced based on their strategic value and the influence they offer, rather than their material components.

the_edge_item_shimmering_abyss_forger.name: The Shimmering Abyss Forger's Fragment
the_edge_item_shimmering_abyss_forger.description: The Shimmering Abyss Forger's Fragment hums with the raw energy of paradox, its surface etched with fractal patterns that shimmer and flicker like molten glass under a forge’s heat. This fragment grants the wielder a brief but potent surge of speed, leaving them to dance between the very threads of reality itself. In the chaos of battle, it disrupts enemy targeting systems for mere instants, causing a ripple effect in their aim that can be seen as a fleeting distortion around you.

effectDetails.title: Movement Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: The wielder gains a +10 foot movement speed increase for 1 round. This effect is instantaneous and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Targeting Disruption
effectDetails.rules: For 3 seconds, all enemies within 20 feet have disadvantage on attack rolls against the wielder. The effect ends when an enemy successfully hits the wielder during this time. No save is required to end the effect.

the_edge_item_shimmering_abyss_forger.levelRequirementReason: This fragment requires a level 15 forger to handle its unstable paradoxical energy.
the_edge_item_shimmering_abyss_forger.vendorReason: The Abyss Trader has exclusive access to fragments from the Shimmering Abyss, where such relics are said to be forged in the very heart of chaos.
the_edge_item_shimmering_abyss_forger.shippingDetail: The fragment is delivered by a swift winged drone that can only transport one fragment at a time due to its delicate nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a 1-minute cooldown between uses
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the wielder is successfully hit by an enemy attack within the duration or after one minute has passed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per short or long rest

the_edge_item_shimmering_abyss_forger.priceReason: The fragment's unique properties and rarity justify its price in excess of a thousand XP.

the_edge_item_final_echoes_of_mortis.name: Final Echoes of Mortis - The Haunted Resonance
the_edge_item_final_echoes_of_mortis.description: The Final Echoes of Mortis, a blackened metal coil twisted into spirals, is said to have been harvested from an ancient research facility now swallowed by the Edge's shadows. Holding it evokes haunting whispers and memories of lost scientists, their voices echoing in your mind as you face auditory hallucinations for 10 seconds. It also grants temporary damage reflection, absorbing a portion of incoming attacks before dissipating into the void.

effectDetails.title: Auditory Hallucinations
effectDetails.rules: When activated, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to 10 seconds of auditory hallucinations. During this time, you are blinded and deafened as if under the effects of a Silence spell.

effectDetails.title: Damage Reflection
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after activation, any damage dealt to you is reduced by 25% (rounded down). This effect ends when it expires or if you take an action. You can activate this item only once per long rest.

the_edge_item_final_echoes_of_mortis.levelRequirementReason: This item is rare and provides significant utility, making a level requirement of 1 appropriate for its complexity.
the_edge_item_final_echoes_of_mortis.vendorReason: Edge Outpost handles the most exotic items from the Edge, including relics that can be used in dangerous circumstances.
the_edge_item_final_echoes_of_mortis.shippingDetail: Ships via Scorched Cart for a delivery of 3 days from the Edge Outpost.

usage.duration: 1 minute (reduces to 25% damage taken)
usage.endsWhen: Expires or when you take an action, with one use per long rest

the_edge_item_final_echoes_of_mortis.priceReason: The price reflects the item's rarity and its unique abilities to provide both immediate utility and a lasting defensive benefit.

the_edge_item_obsidian_null_nexus_core.name: Obsidian Null Nexus Core - The Forbidden Prototype
the_edge_item_obsidian_null_nexus_core.description: The Obsidian Null Nexus Core, a heart of solidified nothingness, pulses with a chilling void energy that momentarily nullifies all surrounding effects—including damage, status ailments, and even the flow of time itself. This dangerous artifact is said to be a forbidden prototype from the depths of forgotten space-time, capable of unraveling reality for those brave—or foolhardy—enough to wield it. However, its use comes with a dire warning: the user risks their own existence in an irreversible process of entropy.

effectDetails.title: Nullification Burst
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user targets a point within 30 feet, nullifying all effects in a 15-foot radius for 10 seconds. This includes damage, status ailments, and even the flow of time. Creatures and objects within the area must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or be disoriented until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Entropy Risk
effectDetails.rules: The user faces an immediate risk of irreversible entropy upon using this item, with a 20% chance. This risk increases by 10% for each additional use within a week. The user's body will begin to disintegrate if they fail the saving throw (DC 25), with no way to reverse the effect.

the_edge_item_obsidian_null_nexus_core.levelRequirementReason: Even at its most dangerous, this artifact can be harnessed by a brave soul willing to face the risks.
the_edge_item_obsidian_null_nexus_core.vendorReason: The final shop specializes in rare and forbidden items that push the boundaries of known magic and reality.
the_edge_item_obsidian_null_nexus_core.shippingDetail: Ships via void shipment, which can only be delivered at night and requires a special permit from the council of timekeepers.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and target an area within 30 feet.
usage.duration: 10 seconds for Nullification Burst; continuous entropy risk until the end of each turn.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends at the start of the next round or when the user fails a saving throw due to Entropy Risk.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but limited to once per week.

the_edge_item_obsidian_null_nexus_core.priceReason: This artifact is considered a low-end legendary item due to its balanced risk and effect duration within the rules of D&D 5e.

kivotos_item_the_glitchy_chosen_uniform.name: The Glitchy Chosen's Uniform
kivotos_item_the_glitchy_chosen_uniform.description: The Glitchy Chosen's Uniform is a shimmering ensemble of iridescent threads that pulse with digital static. Designed for both stealth and subterfuge, it subtly warps your appearance to blend seamlessly into Academy City's surveillance network. Wearing this uniform grants you the hacking abilities of a seasoned tech prodigy, allowing you to bypass security measures with ease. The uniform also emits a faint data distortion that can momentarily mislead digital eyes.

effectDetails.title: Hacking Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action, granting you advantage on hacking checks and +5 to your Dexterity (Stealth) checks for the duration of one short rest or until the uniform is removed. The effect can be recharged by resting.

effectDetails.title: Digital Camouflage
effectDetails.rules: Passively activates when worn, allowing you to use your Stealth check as a reaction to become invisible to digital surveillance systems and human observers for up to 1 minute per day. This effect ends if you attack or cast a spell with a verbal component.

kivotos_item_the_glitchy_chosen_uniform.levelRequirementReason: This uniform is designed for users who have the foundational skills necessary to understand its complex data-woven nature.
kivotos_item_the_glitchy_chosen_uniform.vendorReason: The student store stocks this item as a practical tool for students and researchers navigating Academy City's high-tech environment.
kivotos_item_the_glitchy_chosen_uniform.shippingDetail: Ships within the next class schedule; may be delayed by up to one hour due to city-wide surveillance checks.

usage.activation: Passive upon wearing, with specific effects triggered as described above.
usage.duration: Until removed or the effect ends naturally.
usage.endsWhen: The uniform is removed or its daily use limit is reached.

kivotos_item_the_glitchy_chosen_uniform.priceReason: This uniform's advanced data-woven technology and unique design justify a high price, reflecting its utility in navigating Academy City.

kivotos_item_the_ominous_club_shard.name: The Ominous Club Shard
kivotos_item_the_ominous_club_shard.description: The Ominous Club Shard, a fearsome obsidian fragment forged from the darkest anxieties and secret club vows, hums ominously in your grasp. Its solidified phobias warp your psyche, compelling you to act rashly upon fleeting desires and drawing unwanted attention from shadowy affiliations. The shard's malevolent aura amplifies your fear-based skills by +2, but it also sows paranoia, making you a target for club enforcers or rival members.

effectDetails.title: Paranoid Rampage
effectDetails.rules: Activating the shard causes you to act on fleeting desires with a +2 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks, but also triggers an aggressive reaction against any perceived threat. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can be ended by a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Fearful Boost
effectDetails.rules: The shard enhances your fear-based skills (+2 to checks), but also increases your paranoia level, drawing unwanted attention from club members. This enhancement lasts for 1 hour and can be ended by a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

kivotos_item_the_ominous_club_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's malevolent energy is potent enough to affect even the lowest-level adventurer, though it requires basic understanding of club dynamics.
kivotos_item_the_ominous_club_shard.vendorReason: Club Supply exclusively stocks rare and dangerous items used by club members for their manipulative rituals and schemes.
kivotos_item_the_ominous_club_shard.shippingDetail: The shard is shipped in a specially insulated box to prevent its malevolent aura from affecting the courier.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, with ongoing effects for up to 1 hour or until ended by a successful saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: The shard's effects end upon a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or when the object is destroyed.

kivotos_item_the_ominous_club_shard.priceReason: The Ominous Club Shard's unique crafting materials and malevolent power justify its high price in XP.

kivotos_item_mk.42_academy_chosen_jacket.name: Mk.42 Academy Chosen Jacket
kivotos_item_mk.42_academy_chosen_jacket.description: The Mk.42 Academy Chosen Jacket is a meticulously crafted ensemble that weaves advanced fiber-optic fibers into its tailored design, making it nearly indistinguishable in any campus setting. This jacket not only grants automatic access to exclusive club events but also projects an aura of unwavering confidence and authority, instantly elevating one's social standing with faculty members. The adaptive camouflage patterns ensure you blend seamlessly into the environment, whether navigating the bustling corridors or attending high-stakes meetings.

effectDetails.title: Camouflage Mastery
effectDetails.rules: The jacket's advanced fiber-optic weave allows it to perfectly blend with its surroundings. This effect is active as long as you are wearing the jacket, providing total concealment in Academy City environments. The camouflage is so effective that no hostile creature can perceive you at a range of 30 feet unless they succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against a DC of 15.

effectDetails.title: Priority Access
effectDetails.rules: When wearing the Mk.42 Academy Chosen Jacket, you receive automatic priority access to select club events and restricted areas within Academy City. This effect is passive while you have the jacket on, but it only applies during official school hours.

kivotos_item_mk.42_academy_chosen_jacket.levelRequirementReason: Even freshmen are expected to know how to navigate the Academy's social hierarchy.
kivotos_item_mk.42_academy_chosen_jacket.vendorReason: The academy armory stocks this jacket as a symbol of prestige and authority among its students.
kivotos_item_mk.42_academy_chosen_jacket.shippingDetail: Ships within one school week via Secure Package Delivery, ensuring the jacket arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect while wearing the jacket.
usage.duration: Active as long as you are wearing the jacket.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you remove the jacket or if it is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited; the jacket can be worn indefinitely.

kivotos_item_mk.42_academy_chosen_jacket.priceReason: The jacket's advanced materials and craftsmanship justify its moderate price, despite not being a high-powered weapon or spell.

equestria_item_chromatic_resonance_bit.name: The Chromatic Resonance Bit for the Grand Forger
equestria_item_chromatic_resonance_bit.description: The Chromatic Resonance Bit for the Grand Forger gleams with a spectrum of shifting hues, each pulse resonating with one of Equestria's elemental forces. Crafted from rainbow-infused obsidian by master artisans, this bit amplifies a pony’s connection to a chosen element, granting fleeting glimpses into the interwoven currents of magic. It is said that those who wield it can channel raw elemental power for brief moments, enhancing their abilities with a touch.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action to briefly amplify the user's connection to one of the five elemental forces: earth, water, air, fire, or lightning. The chosen element grants a +2 bonus to all ability checks and saving throws for 1 minute. This effect ends if the user sustains more than 50 points of damage in any form.

effectDetails.title: Magic Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: For every hour the Chromatic Resonance Bit is held, the user gains a +2 bonus to their AC and saving throws. This effect persists as long as the bit remains in contact with the user’s mouth. If the user drops or removes the bit, this benefit ends immediately.

equestria_item_chromatic_resonance_bit.levelRequirementReason: Crafted by master artisans and tuned to Equestria's core magic frequencies, this item is designed for highly skilled forgers who have proven their worth.
equestria_item_chromatic_resonance_bit.vendorReason: As the official supplier of Canterlot, Canterlot Commerce ensures that only the most potent and rare items are available to its patrons.
equestria_item_chromatic_resonance_bit.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Royal Pegasus Courier with a guaranteed delivery time of three days.

usage.activation: Activate as an action for Elemental Surge, or continuously while held in the mouth for Magic Resistance Boost.
usage.duration: Elemental Surge lasts for 1 minute. Magic Resistance Boost persists as long as the bit is held.
usage.endsWhen: Elemental Surge ends if sustained damage exceeds 50 points. Magic Resistance Boost ends when the bit is removed or dropped.

equestria_item_chromatic_resonance_bit.priceReason: Crafted from rare rainbow-infused obsidian and tuned by master artisans, this item's price reflects its rarity and unparalleled craftsmanship.

equestria_item_arcane_echo_scroll.name: Arcane Echo Scroll - Cartographer’s Variant
equestria_item_arcane_echo_scroll.description: The Arcane Echo Scroll - Cartographer’s Variant is a fragile parchment inscribed with ancient runes. Unfurled, it projects holographic echoes of past journeys across Equestria, revealing hidden pathways and long-lost landmarks. The intricate markings shimmer and shift in response to the viewer's intent, offering cryptic clues that can guide explorers to forgotten locations. Each scroll holds a fragment of an eldritch map, providing cartographers with a 5-level boost to their skill, but carries a risk of triggering a minor temporal distortion.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Pathways
effectDetails.rules: When activated by the explorer, this scroll projects a holographic map revealing hidden paths within a 10-foot radius. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Boosts Cartography Skill
effectDetails.rules: The scroll grants the user a +5 temporary bonus to their cartography skill check, which is effective until the end of their next turn. This effect can only be used once every 24 hours.

equestria_item_arcane_echo_scroll.levelRequirementReason: This scroll provides useful but not overly powerful assistance for beginners and seasoned explorers alike.
equestria_item_arcane_echo_scroll.vendorReason: The Ponyville Market is known for its diverse array of rare and antique items, making it the perfect place to find this unique cartographic aid.
equestria_item_arcane_echo_scroll.shippingDetail: The scroll is shipped rolled in a protective case to ensure safe delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the explorer moves out of range
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the explorer moves more than 50 feet from where it was activated
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short or long rest

equestria_item_arcane_echo_scroll.priceReason: The scroll's rarity and unique utility justify its price of 1000 XP.

equestria_item_bit_of_starlight_resonanc.name: Bit of Starlight Resonance - The Dream Weaver’s Touch
equestria_item_bit_of_starlight_resonanc.description: Forged during a lunar eclipse by the elusive Silverstream Clan, this bit of starlight resonates with the dreams and memories of ponies. Crafted from meteoric iron that glows faintly under moonlight, it subtly influences the wearer's subconscious, promoting calmness and creativity while enhancing dream recall. The cool metal feels perpetually fresh despite its age, and prolonged use can lead to vivid, dream-filled visions that may influence one’s creative endeavors.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Dream Recall
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Intelligence (Insight) checks related to dreams or memories. This effect lasts until the end of their next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Promotes Calmness and Creativity
effectDetails.rules: The wearer is considered to be in a calm state, reducing stress levels by 1d4 points. They also gain advantage on creativity-related checks or saving throws. This effect lasts for 8 hours.

equestria_item_bit_of_starlight_resonanc.levelRequirementReason: This item's subtle influence requires a certain level of maturity and control to manage without adverse effects.
equestria_item_bit_of_starlight_resonanc.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire is known for its deep connection with the elements, including the lunar cycle that this bit was forged under.
equestria_item_bit_of_starlight_resonanc.shippingDetail: Ships via special moonlight courier service, ensuring safe delivery during a full moon.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the bit.
usage.duration: Until next short rest or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes it or completes their next short rest.

equestria_item_bit_of_starlight_resonanc.priceReason: Crafted from rare meteoric iron and imbued with lunar magic, this bit is a valuable tool for artists and dreamers.

connectopia_item_chronometric_resonance_.name: The Chronometric Resonance Herald of Obsidian Ridge
connectopia_item_chronometric_resonance_.description: The Chronometric Resonance Herald of Obsidian Ridge is a gleaming herald made from solidified temporal flux, intricately carved with ancient runes. When wielded, it emits a rhythmic pulse that subtly shifts time around the operator, enhancing the efficiency of nearby automated mining rigs. The device not only boosts their processing speed by 25% for 15 seconds but also stabilizes rig operations, increasing stability by +5%. Holding this herald feels like holding a piece of the very fabric of time itself.

effectDetails.title: Mining Efficiency Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates on interaction, increases mining rig speed by +25% for 15 seconds. Ends when the wielder stops holding it or a major event interrupts the effect.

effectDetails.title: Rig Stability Increase
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that provides an additional +5% stability to nearby mining rigs. Lasts until the Herald is no longer in direct contact with a rig.

connectopia_item_chronometric_resonance_.levelRequirementReason: Beginners can appreciate its utility, but it requires basic handling skills.
connectopia_item_chronometric_resonance_.vendorReason: The Craft Corner specializes in tools that enhance productivity and efficiency for all Connectopian citizens.
connectopia_item_chronometric_resonance_.shippingDetail: Ships via automated drones within a day from the nearest supply hub.

usage.duration: 15 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Wielder stops holding it or an event interrupts the effect

connectopia_item_chronometric_resonance_.priceReason: Balanced for its utility in enhancing mining efficiency without being overpowered.

connectopia_item_geothermal_blueprint_he.name: Ancient Geothermal Blueprint Herald of Blackstone Caverns
connectopia_item_geothermal_blueprint_he.description: Unearthed from the deepest levels of Blackstone Caverns, this Ancient Geothermal Blueprint Herald is a parchment worn with age but still vibrant with arcane energy. Its intricate diagrams shift subtly under close inspection, revealing forgotten engineering secrets that could transform any settlement into an oasis of power and warmth. The herald's diagrams glow faintly in the dark, hinting at its ability to guide even the most novice engineer towards constructing a self-sustaining geothermal generator.

effectDetails.title: Self-Sustaining Generator Blueprint
effectDetails.rules: Activates upon successful construction of the blueprint, granting access to a self-sustaining geothermal generator. The generator increases power generation efficiency by +5% and extends the longevity of the heatstone used in its operation.

effectDetails.title: Increased Worker Productivity
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect that boosts productivity in geothermal mines within 30 meters by +10%, making extraction more efficient. This effect lasts until the mine is depleted or the Herald's charges are exhausted.

connectopia_item_geothermal_blueprint_he.levelRequirementReason: Requires a high level of expertise to properly interpret and utilize this ancient blueprint.
connectopia_item_geothermal_blueprint_he.vendorReason: The Pioneer Post has established routes through even the most treacherous caverns, ensuring that such valuable blueprints reach those who can put them to use.
connectopia_item_geothermal_blueprint_he.shippingDetail: Traveling by pack pony is both swift and reliable, but the Herald's fragile nature necessitates careful handling at all times.

usage.activation: Instantaneous upon construction of the blueprint.
usage.duration: Until the geothermal generator reaches full capacity or until the Herald's charges are exhausted.
usage.endsWhen: The generator is dismantled or the Herald is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a successful DC 15 Craft (geology) check to construct.

connectopia_item_geothermal_blueprint_he.priceReason: The Herald's rarity and the significant advantage it provides in constructing a self-sustaining generator justify its high price.

connectopia_item_quartz_harmonic_curiosi.name: The Quartz Harmonic Curiosity of Silent Echo Mesa
connectopia_item_quartz_harmonic_curiosi.description: The Quartz Harmonic Curiosity of Silent Echo Mesa hums with a faint, resonant glow when near active mining sites. Its core pulses with a frequency that amplifies seismic readings by a full fifty percent, potentially revealing hidden quartz veins and rare mineral deposits beneath the frontier's surface. Crafters favor this talisman for its ability to generate small amounts of Quartz Resonance, an essential ingredient in the forging of high-end mining tools and artifacts.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Seismic Detection
effectDetails.rules: When near concentrated mining operations, this curiosity amplifies seismic readings by +50%, increasing the chance of detecting hidden quartz and rare mineral deposits (+20%). The effect is passive and lasts until the item is removed from a mining site.

effectDetails.title: Quartz Resonance Generation
effectDetails.rules: This item generates small amounts of Quartz Resonance, usable for crafting. It regenerates at a rate of 1 unit per hour when not in use and up to 3 units can be held at any time.

connectopia_item_quartz_harmonic_curiosi.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high level character due to its advanced technology and the significant benefit it provides to mining operations.
connectopia_item_quartz_harmonic_curiosi.vendorReason: Block Smith, with his extensive experience in frontier technology, is the only vendor capable of procuring such an advanced curiosity from Silent Echo Mesa.
connectopia_item_quartz_harmonic_curiosi.shippingDetail: Express Cargo delivers this item via a specialized mining drone, ensuring it arrives swiftly and intact.

usage.activation: Passive effect while in proximity to mining operations.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until removed from the site.
usage.endsWhen: The item is taken away from a mining operation.

connectopia_item_quartz_harmonic_curiosi.priceReason: This price reflects the advanced technology and unique benefits provided by the Quartz Harmonic Curiosity, making it worth its weight in XP.

pokemon_item_the_whispering_lord_of_valo.name: The Whispering Lord's Valor Berries
pokemon_item_the_whispering_lord_of_valo.description: The Whispering Lord's Valor Berries are obsidian-hued and pulse with the echoes of countless battles fought within the Northern Territories, where the winds whisper of valor and strength. When consumed in a critical moment, they grant temporary resistance to status conditions and enhance your Pokémon’s attack power by 15%, allowing you to strategize with uncanny precision during intense combat. These berries are said to imbibe the very essence of the Northern Warriors who fought for honor and valor.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Status Conditions
effectDetails.rules: Consume this berry as a bonus action to gain temporary resistance to status conditions. The effect lasts for the duration of one short rest, and it can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Attack Power
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, your Pokémon’s attack power is increased by 15% until the start of your next turn. This effect does not stack with other similar effects but can be used multiple times per short rest.

pokemon_item_the_whispering_lord_of_valo.levelRequirementReason: The berries are crafted from ancient relics and require a Pokémon of at least level 20 to harness their full potential.
pokemon_item_the_whispering_lord_of_valo.vendorReason: Pokemarts have the necessary resources to source and distribute these rare berries, which are in high demand among experienced trainers.
pokemon_item_the_whispering_lord_of_valo.shippingDetail: The Winged Courier ensures that the berries arrive fresh and potent, delivered within three days of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to consume the berry during combat.
usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn for Enhanced Attack Power; lasts one short rest for Resistance to Status Conditions.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you finish a short or long rest, and no more uses are available until then.
usage.charges: Uses per day: 1 use per short rest

pokemon_item_the_whispering_lord_of_valo.priceReason: The berries are crafted from rare relics found in the Northern Territories, making them a valuable and limited resource.

pokemon_item_mk_47_imperial_resonance_sh.name: Mk.47 Imperial Resonance Shard
pokemon_item_mk_47_imperial_resonance_sh.description: The Mk.47 Imperial Resonance Shard is a crystalline fragment that amplifies your Pokémon's moves, granting you a tactical edge in battle. Harvested from defeated Mimikyus, this shard sings with the harmony of sonic energy, allowing you to predict your opponent’s next move and strike with precision. Holding it during combat not only increases critical hit chance by 5% but also has a 20% chance to confuse your foe, giving you an unexpected advantage in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Critical Hit Boost
effectDetails.rules: Increases critical hit chance by 5%. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn. The shard must be held during combat to activate this benefit.

effectDetails.title: Confusion Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance that holding the shard will cause you to confuse your opponent for one round, requiring a successful Wisdom saving throw (DC 13) to resist. This effect can only occur once per battle.

pokemon_item_mk_47_imperial_resonance_sh.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a high level to maximize its strategic and tactical benefits in the heat of combat.
pokemon_item_mk_47_imperial_resonance_sh.vendorReason: The Safari Shop specializes in rare and exotic items, making it the perfect vendor for this unique shard.
pokemon_item_mk_47_imperial_resonance_sh.shippingDetail: The delivery drone ensures swift transport from the region where the Mimikyus were defeated to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held during combat. The confusion ability can only trigger once per battle.
usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn for critical hit boost; instant for confusion chance.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you lose control, the battle ends, or the shard is no longer held.

pokemon_item_mk_47_imperial_resonance_sh.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique benefits justify its price in experience points.

pokemon_item_the_legendary_berries_of_ba.name: The Legendary Berries of Battles
pokemon_item_the_legendary_berries_of_ba.description: The Legendary Berries of Battles are born from the very essence of legendary Pokémon battles, harvested only on the most contested battlefields where the air hums with raw power. A single bite not only boosts your Pokémon's stats by a formidable 30% for two turns but also grants access to Tempest Strike, a move that can turn even the weakest foe into dust with its devastating 150 Power and 95% Accuracy.

effectDetails.title: Massive Stat Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the Pokémon’s Attack and Special Attack are increased by 30% for two turns. This effect grants temporary power but does not affect stat growth or permanent stats.

effectDetails.title: Tempest Strike Access
effectDetails.rules: For one turn following consumption, the user gains access to Tempest Strike. This move deals 150 points of damage with a 95% accuracy rate and can be used once per battle.

pokemon_item_the_legendary_berries_of_ba.levelRequirementReason: This item is reserved for elite trainers who have proven their worth through countless battles.
pokemon_item_the_legendary_berries_of_ba.vendorReason: The league store caters exclusively to top-tier trainers and their rarest Pokémon, ensuring these legendary berries are in the right hands.
pokemon_item_the_legendary_berries_of_ba.shippingDetail: Ships via the Royal Guard’s fastest couriers, ensuring the berries reach their destination fresh from the battlefield.

usage.activation: Eaten by the Pokémon as a consumable item.
usage.duration: Temporary effects last for two turns each.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the turns are over or if the Pokémon faints.

pokemon_item_the_legendary_berries_of_ba.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the energy it draws from legendary battles.

internet_item_phantom_link_takers_resona.name: Phantom Link Takers' Resonance
internet_item_phantom_link_takers_resona.description: The Phantom Link Takers' Resonance are delicate, iridescent threads spun from the forgotten online conversations of bygone internet users. These shimmering links pulse with residual energy that amplifies your presence within digital networks for a fleeting moment, granting an instant boost in processing speed and subtle influence over meme propagation. Activated, they weave into the fabric of the web itself, leaving behind brief visual distortions that hint at their ethereal origin.

effectDetails.title: Processing Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Phantom Link Takers' Resonance grant a +2 temporary bonus to Intelligence (Computers) checks and spell save DCs for 1 minute. This effect ends when you lose connection to a digital network or if your next short rest begins.

effectDetails.title: Meme Influence
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of its use, this item allows you to subtly influence meme propagation within a digital network, providing a +1 bonus to checks related to social media and online communication. This effect ends when used or if your next short rest begins.

internet_item_phantom_link_takers_resona.levelRequirementReason: This item is tailored for those who have already honed their skills in the digital realm, requiring a minimum of fifth level.
internet_item_phantom_link_takers_resona.vendorReason: As a vendor specializing in rare and exotic tech artifacts, Data Dealer naturally stocks such a unique and powerful tool.
internet_item_phantom_link_takers_resona.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Drone Delivery within one business day.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; ends when used or at the start of your next short rest.
usage.duration: 1 minute per activation
usage.endsWhen: Used or at the start of the next short rest

internet_item_phantom_link_takers_resona.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique benefits justify its high price in the market.

internet_item_mk_71_compressed_links_of_.name: Mk.71 Compressed Links of Viral Spread
internet_item_mk_71_compressed_links_of_.description: The Mk.71 Compressed Links of Viral Spread are forged from salvaged server components, their chaotic data swirling in a digital maelstrom. When activated, these links unleash a torrent of viral content that rapidly spreads across interconnected networks, instantly overwhelming nearby devices with memes and trends. A brief network scan reveals nearby data streams, but prolonged use risks attracting unwanted attention from digital security protocols, potentially triggering alerts that could expose the user to cyber threats.
effects: instant meme spread (targets within a radius)

effectDetails.title: Instant Meme Spread
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. Instantly spreads viral content targeting all creatures and objects within 30 feet of the user. Has a save DC of 12 to resist. The effect ends if the user takes any other action or if they are targeted by another creature's attack.

effectDetails.title: Network Scan
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Reveals all creatures and objects within 60 feet that are connected to a data network. This scan lasts for 1 minute, but it can be ended early if the user moves more than 30 feet away from the target area.

internet_item_mk_71_compressed_links_of_.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic understanding of digital networks and security protocols.
internet_item_mk_71_compressed_links_of_.vendorReason: The cyber market specializes in cutting-edge tech, including items that manipulate data streams.
internet_item_mk_71_compressed_links_of_.shippingDetail: Ships via Courier Bot within the next business day with a tracking number provided.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for instant meme spread, lasts 1 minute for network scan.
usage.endsWhen: User takes another action, targeted by an attack, or moves more than 30 feet away.

internet_item_mk_71_compressed_links_of_.priceReason: The item's unique components and advanced data manipulation justify its high price.

internet_item_curiosity_of_the_lost_pixe.name: Curiosity of the Lost Pixel Archive
internet_item_curiosity_of_the_lost_pixe.description: The Curiosity of the Lost Pixel Archive is a small, iridescent shard that glows faintly with digital energy. Crafted from the remnants of an ancient internet server, it holds fragments of lost data and fleeting sounds. Hold it close to your ear for brief audio snippets of past internet activity—bees buzzing by forgotten forums, laughter from unseen streams—and be wary of the phantom echoes that may linger after use.
effects: audio snapshots of past internet moments

effectDetails.title: Audio Snapshots
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the Curiosity to play back a random sound clip from an old internet moment. The duration is instantaneous; the effects end when used.

effectDetails.title: Phantom Echoes
effectDetails.rules: There's a 20% chance (DC 15 Wisdom saving throw) that after using the Curiosity, you will hear phantom echoes for one minute. These echoes are distracting but do not deal damage or impose any status effects.

internet_item_curiosity_of_the_lost_pixe.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level to handle its digital energy safely.
internet_item_curiosity_of_the_lost_pixe.vendorReason: The Pixel Shop specializes in rare and forgotten internet relics, making this artifact an ideal addition to their collection.
internet_item_curiosity_of_the_lost_pixe.shippingDetail: Ships via the Spectral Messenger; arrives within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for audio playback, ends after one use.
usage.endsWhen: Used or when the duration expires.

internet_item_curiosity_of_the_lost_pixe.priceReason: The Curiosity's rarity and unique digital properties justify its moderate price in XP value.

teyvat_item_zealous_render_s_oculi.name: Zealous Render’s Oculi of the Tempestuous Tide
teyvat_item_zealous_render_s_oculi.description: Zealous Render's Oculi of the Tempestuous Tide are iridescent, gemstone-like orbs that hum with an ancient aquatic magic. When activated, they grant temporary Hydro resistance and unleash a forceful jet of water capable of shattering stone or metal. These oculi are said to have been crafted from the remains of a long-lost tempest spirit, and their wielder feels the pulse of the ocean's fury within them.

effectDetails.title: Hydro Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, Zealous Render’s Oculi provide a +50% bonus to resistance against Hydro damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Water Jet
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the oculi unleash a powerful jet of water that deals 200 points of Water Damage and has a 30% chance to Stun targets within its range (a 5-foot-radius burst centered on the user). The effect ends when the user or target takes Hydro damage.

teyvat_item_zealous_render_s_oculi.levelRequirementReason: These oculi are accessible to all adventurers, as their power is thought to be harnessed from the very essence of the ocean.
teyvat_item_zealous_render_s_oculi.vendorReason: The market in Mondstadt is known for its diverse wares, including items imbued with elemental magic, and these oculi are a prime example.
teyvat_item_zealous_render_s_oculi.shippingDetail: Ships via the Sky Couriers, ensuring swift delivery from the bustling markets of Mondstadt to adventurers across Teyvat.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The user or a target within range takes Hydro damage

teyvat_item_zealous_render_s_oculi.priceReason: Considering the item's limited daily stock and its balance with other epic gear, this price is fair.

teyvat_item_mk_87_dendro_oculi.name: Mk.87 Dendro Oculi of the Verdant Core
teyvat_item_mk_87_dendro_oculi.description: The Mk.87 Dendro Oculi of the Verdant Core is a pair of resinous lenses forged from the heartwood of ancient Linhaven trees. When activated, they pulse with verdant magic, capable of accelerating plant growth by 30% in their immediate vicinity and unleashing a concentrated burst of primal power that can heal wounds at an alarming rate of 50 HP per second for up to five seconds. These oculi are said to be imbued with the very essence of Dendro magic, making them invaluable tools for both nature lorecasters and alchemists seeking to harness the raw energy of the forest.

effectDetails.title: Accelerates Plant Growth
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this effect increases the growth rate of plants within a 10-foot radius by 30%. This benefit lasts for one minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Heals Rapidly
effectDetails.rules: Activating this effect heals the user at the rate of 50 Hit Points per second for up to five seconds. The user must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 14) or be stunned and unable to move for one round after using this ability.

teyvat_item_mk_87_dendro_oculi.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for characters who have already demonstrated a foundational understanding of Dendro magic, such as druids or clerics specializing in plant-based spells.
teyvat_item_mk_87_dendro_oculi.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare and exotic items from the Far East, including those with ties to nature and alchemy, making them a fitting vendor for this enchanted lens.
teyvat_item_mk_87_dendro_oculi.shippingDetail: Due to their delicate nature, these oculi must be shipped via Sea Serpent Delivery, ensuring safe transport across vast distances without damage.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts for the specified duration or until interrupted by an attack or spell.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or it is interrupted by a successful attack or spell.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per long rest.

teyvat_item_mk_87_dendro_oculi.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and unique properties of these enchanted lenses, offering players a fair value for their potential in enhancing plant growth and healing abilities.

teyvat_item_crimson_resonance_oculi.name: Crimson Resonance Oculi of the Forbidden Citadel
teyvat_item_crimson_resonance_oculi.description: The Crimson Resonance Oculi of the Forbidden Citadel are crafted from obsidian infused with the dark essence of a forgotten citadel. Their gaze reveals hidden truths yet distorts reality, leading to visions that can drive even the most stalwart warriors to madness. These relics, once used in forbidden rituals, grant their wielder a +20% critical hit chance and deal 300 points of Shadow damage on activation, but at a terrible cost: they may inflict the Blood Curse, reducing all healing received by half for an hour.

effectDetails.title: Critical Hit Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activation: On activation. Duration: Instantaneous. Range/Area: Self only. This effect provides a +20% bonus to critical hit chance for the wielder, without any save DC or use limit.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Damage
effectDetails.rules: Activation: On activation. Duration: Instantaneous. Range/Area: 5-foot radius centered on the wielder. Save DC: 18. If a creature within the area fails its saving throw, it takes 300 points of Shadow damage.

teyvat_item_crimson_resonance_oculi.levelRequirementReason: These relics are too dangerous for those who aren't at least expert in combat and spellcasting.
teyvat_item_crimson_resonance_oculi.vendorReason: The shadow brokers have a network that reaches into the darkest corners of the world, where such forbidden artifacts reside.
teyvat_item_crimson_resonance_oculi.shippingDetail: Shipped by Nightfall Messenger with a special delivery that can only be completed under the cover of darkness.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use; recharges at dawn on the next night.

teyvat_item_crimson_resonance_oculi.priceReason: The price reflects both the rarity of the item and its significant risk to the user.

internet_item_glitch_watcher_01.name: The Fractured Packet Watcher’s Echoes
internet_item_glitch_watcher_01.description: The Fractured Packet Watcher’s Echoes are shimmering data packets that pulse with the fragmented memories of forgotten websites. These relics briefly restore lost data streams within your mind, offering a fleeting glimpse into the chaotic beauty of corrupted code and an unsettling awareness of the network's endless flow. Each packet is a fragment of bygone internet history, a relic from the days when browsers were simple and the web was vast.

effectDetails.title: Data Stream Restoration
effectDetails.rules: Consume one packet as an action to restore 100 Data Points. This effect is instantaneous and does not require a saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Processing Speed
effectDetails.rules: Grant +5 to all Intelligence (Computers) checks made within the next hour, requiring no save. The enhanced speed lasts until you use this item again or take a long rest.

internet_item_glitch_watcher_01.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least level 10 to handle the potent data streams.
internet_item_glitch_watcher_01.vendorReason: The Data Dealer has access to rare relics and artifacts, including these fragments of internet history.
internet_item_glitch_watcher_01.shippingDetail: Delivered within 24 hours by a fleet of autonomous drones.

usage.duration: Instantaneous restoration; enhanced speed lasts until re-used or long rest
usage.endsWhen: Used up, recharged with a long rest, or destroyed after 10 uses

internet_item_glitch_watcher_01.priceReason: The price reflects the rare and powerful nature of these data fragments.

internet_item_runic_watcher_02.name: Runic Watcher’s Packets of the Static Archive
internet_item_runic_watcher_02.description: Each packet of the Static Archive is a solidified fragment of the internet's forgotten past, encased in an obsidian casing etched with ancient runes. Consuming one grants you a fleeting glimpse into dormant programs and lost protocols, enhancing your Network Awareness by +10 for a day. However, prolonged exposure risks becoming part of the system itself, as Data Spirits may latch onto you, disrupting your focus until they are banished or dispelled.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Network Awareness
effectDetails.rules: For a short duration, you gain advantage on checks to access hidden information from the network. This effect lasts for one day and can be activated once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Attracting Hostile Data Spirits
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance that consuming these packets will attract hostile Data Spirits, which may attempt to disrupt your concentration or cause you harm. If this occurs, the packet's effects are immediately negated.

internet_item_runic_watcher_02.levelRequirementReason: These packets are designed for beginners who wish to experiment with network interaction without needing a high level of expertise.
internet_item_runic_watcher_02.vendorReason: Pixel Shop specializes in cutting-edge and experimental internet-related items, making these packets an ideal addition to their catalog.
internet_item_runic_watcher_02.shippingDetail: Ships via Cyber Courier's secure data stream, ensuring safe delivery of the volatile packets.

usage.activation: Eating one packet as a bonus action triggers its effects.
usage.duration: Lasts for one day.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or you consume another packet within the same day.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one packet per day.

internet_item_runic_watcher_02.priceReason: This price reflects the rarity and experimental nature of these packets, balancing their power with a reasonable cost for players to experiment safely.

internet_item_corrupted_curiosity_03.name: The Mk.47 Corrupted Packet of the Recursive Nightmare
internet_item_corrupted_curiosity_03.description: The Mk.47 Corrupted Packet of the Recursive Nightmare is a squirming mass of encrypted data, its surface flecked with neon hues. This relic from the deep web promises to unravel the very fabric of digital networks but leaves consumers reeling in confusion and paranoia. Upon consumption, you gain an acute understanding of network vulnerabilities (+25 to Data Manipulation), yet this insight comes at a cost: for 1 hour, your perception is clouded (Confusion -3 to Accuracy). Additionally, there's a small chance that your actions mimic those of previous users, creating eerie echoes of past mistakes.

effectDetails.title: Data Manipulation Boost
effectDetails.rules: Active on consumption. Grants +25 to Data Manipulation for 1 hour. The effect ends if you take damage or use the ability again.

effectDetails.title: Perception Clouding
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect, lasts until duration expires. Reduces your Accuracy by -3 due to confusion. Ends when the packet's effects are dispelled or upon taking significant damage (10+ points).

internet_item_corrupted_curiosity_03.levelRequirementReason: Requires a basic understanding of digital networks and cyber manipulation.
internet_item_corrupted_curiosity_03.vendorReason: The cyber market specializes in exotic and dangerous items from the dark web, making it a fitting vendor for this relic.
internet_item_corrupted_curiosity_03.shippingDetail: Ships via encrypted courier services with a 1-day delay to ensure the packet remains secure.

usage.duration: 1 hour
usage.endsWhen: On taking damage greater than or equal to 10 points, using Data Manipulation again, or being dispelled by magic.

internet_item_corrupted_curiosity_03.priceReason: Reflects the rarity and danger associated with accessing deep web artifacts.

grand_country_item_oscillating_gravity_b.name: The Oscillating Gravity Binder - Mk.87
grand_country_item_oscillating_gravity_b.description: The Oscillating Gravity Binder - Mk.87 is a compact device forged from a hardened sugar core and reinforced with warped steel, capable of generating localized gravitational anomalies. By activating it, you can create brief moments of weightlessness or intense gravity around yourself, making it ideal for traversing treacherous terrains or launching objects with extraordinary force. This artifact comes with a subtle warning: its activation releases a faint hum that may confuse nearby enemies within 10 feet.

effectDetails.title: Localized Gravity Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: By using an action, you create a small area of localized gravity manipulation. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and can either generate weightlessness within a 10-foot radius or apply crushing downward force in the same area. While active, you have resistance to falling damage and gain a +2 bonus to Strength (Jump) checks.

effectDetails.title: Confusion Aura
effectDetails.rules: For as long as the gravity manipulation effect is active, any creature within 10 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) or be stunned for 1 round. This effect has no save on consecutive uses.

grand_country_item_oscillating_gravity_b.levelRequirementReason: The Oscillating Gravity Binder requires significant finesse and control, suitable only for experienced adventurers.
grand_country_item_oscillating_gravity_b.vendorReason: Side_seller is known for their unique stock of arcane and mechanical curiosities, making this item a perfect fit.
grand_country_item_oscillating_gravity_b.shippingDetail: Ships via Drone Delivery within 24 hours with a 50% discount on expedited shipping.

usage.duration: 5 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you deactivate it by using an action

grand_country_item_oscillating_gravity_b.priceReason: Crafted from rare materials and requiring intricate craftsmanship, this device is a significant investment for any adventurer.

grand_country_item_unground_chronal_ladd.name: The Unground Chronal Ladder - Fragment 42-B
grand_country_item_unground_chronal_ladd.description: The Unground Chronal Ladder - Fragment 42-B stands as an enigmatic construct, its steps a maelstrom of temporal flux. Each ascent triggers a brief phase where time seems to warp and loop around you, creating echoes of past movements. The ladder's chroniton residue hums with untamed power, causing disorientation if used for too long; extended contact risks drawing you into a temporal paradox from which there is no return.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Phase Shift
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the ladder causes time to phase around the user for 3 seconds. During this period, the user gains a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and can move up to 5 feet faster as their steps seem to slip through temporal anomalies. This effect has a 24-hour cooldown.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mobility
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of each phase, the user gains an increase in movement speed by 10%. If the user remains on the ladder for more than 5 seconds, this bonus increases to +20% until the next long rest.

grand_country_item_unground_chronal_ladd.levelRequirementReason: Even with its fragmentary nature, the ladder's raw temporal power demands a basic understanding of manipulating time.
grand_country_item_unground_chronal_ladd.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in arcane devices and fragments from ancient origins, making this item a natural addition to their inventory.
grand_country_item_unground_chronal_ladd.shippingDetail: Ships via Gravity Cart's express service; delivery takes two days but requires an extra cautionary fee.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, lasts for 3 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the user leaves the ladder or is interrupted by damage

grand_country_item_unground_chronal_ladd.priceReason: The item's rare material and arcane properties justify its price, offering unique temporal manipulation abilities without overpowered effects.

grand_country_item_angular_layer_resonat.name: The Angular Layer Resonator - Prototype Sigma
grand_country_item_angular_layer_resonat.description: The Angular Layer Resonator - Prototype Sigma, a sleek obsidian device adorned with spinning brass gears and etched in ancient runes, harnesses the very fabric of layer structures to manipulate their integrity. Its user can scan for weak points or trigger localized collapses, making it indispensable when navigating treacherous terrain or exploiting architectural weaknesses. With each activation, this resonator leaves an echo that can reveal hidden passages within layers, ensuring the user always finds a path forward in unstable environments.

effectDetails.title: Layer Resonance Scan
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate this resonator to scan an area for structural weaknesses within layer structures. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and reveals any unstable zones or hidden passages. No saving throw is needed.

effectDetails.title: Localized Collapse
effectDetails.rules: This resonator can be used as a reaction when you are in an unstable area to trigger a localized collapse, creating a safe passage through weakened layers. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 2d6 force damage. This effect has a 2-second cooldown.

grand_country_item_angular_layer_resonat.levelRequirementReason: This resonator is designed for ease of use, allowing even novice explorers to access its capabilities.
grand_country_item_angular_layer_resonat.vendorReason: The Layer Market specializes in cutting-edge tools and devices for navigating layer structures, making it the natural vendor for such an item.
grand_country_item_angular_layer_resonat.shippingDetail: Ships via a Delivery Zeppelin with expedited delivery within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Layer Resonance Scan) / Until the start of your next turn (Localized Collapse)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or the user is incapacitated.

grand_country_item_angular_layer_resonat.priceReason: This resonator offers a balanced price for its utility and ease of use, making it accessible yet valuable.

earth_land_item_chronometric_dragonscale.name: The Chronometric Dragonscale Maker's Scroll
earth_land_item_chronometric_dragonscale.description: The Chronometric Dragonscale Maker's Scroll unfurls like a shimmering chronometer, its scales reflecting the ancient power of time itself. Unleashing this scroll allows you to warp your perception of time in combat, either accelerating or decelerating it at will, granting you a tactical edge by dodging attacks and setting up precise strikes. The scroll's temporal pulse can also momentarily slow enemy movements, giving you precious seconds to exploit their sluggishness.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can accelerate time around themselves by +50% movement speed for up to 1 minute. This effect ends when the user recharges their concentration or is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Enemy Slowdown
effectDetails.rules: By expending one of its charges, the scroll can slow down nearby enemies' attack animations by -20% movement speed for 3 seconds upon activation. This effect ends when any enemy within 10 feet makes an attack roll or the scroll is destroyed.

earth_land_item_chronometric_dragonscale.levelRequirementReason: The scroll's power requires a basic understanding of temporal mechanics to wield effectively.
earth_land_item_chronometric_dragonscale.vendorReason: Magic Shop stocks rare and powerful magical artifacts, including scrolls that manipulate time and space.
earth_land_item_chronometric_dragonscale.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by winged messenger, ensuring the scroll arrives intact in its protective case.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate either effect; concentration required for Temporal Acceleration.
usage.duration: Up to 1 minute for Temporal Acceleration, instantaneous for Enemy Slowdown.
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends or the scroll is destroyed for Temporal Acceleration; attack roll or destruction for Enemy Slowdown.

earth_land_item_chronometric_dragonscale.priceReason: The scroll's balanced price reflects its moderate power and limited daily use.

earth_land_item_glacial_resonance_shard.name: Resonance Shard of the Ice Wall’s Lament
earth_land_item_glacial_resonance_shard.description: The Resonance Shard of the Ice Wall’s Lament is a jagged, icy fragment that hums with the sorrowful echo of an ancient glacial collapse. Crafted from the heart of a frozen wall once shattered by titanic forces, it resonates with cold magic and dragon whispers. When held, this shard grants its bearer resistance to cold damage and the ability to detect nearby traces of dragon magic or powerful frost spells.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Grants temporary resistance to all cold damage equal to your proficiency bonus for 1 minute, renewable once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Detect Dragon Magic
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect while holding the shard. You can use an action to gain the benefits of Detect Magic, but only to detect magical auras related to dragons and ice. This ability is usable three times per day, resting between uses.

earth_land_item_glacial_resonance_shard.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for all levels as it provides useful cold resistance without being overly powerful.
earth_land_item_glacial_resonance_shard.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in rare and magical artifacts derived from natural elements, making this shard a fitting addition to their stock.
earth_land_item_glacial_resonance_shard.shippingDetail: Shipped via enchanted ice sleds that ensure the shard remains frozen during transit, preserving its magic.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Cold Resistance; Passive Detect Dragon Magic until used or rested.
usage.duration: 1 minute per activation of Cold Resistance. Detect Dragon Magic is a one-time daily use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires, or if you stop holding the shard.

earth_land_item_glacial_resonance_shard.priceReason: Balanced price for its utility and limited daily activations.

earth_land_item_rune_of_scorched_genesis.name: Runic Device of Scorched Genesis Service
earth_land_item_rune_of_scorched_genesis.description: The Runic Device of Scorched Genesis, a volcanic artifact carved from obsidian and imbued with the spirit of dormant lava, pulsates with residual heat. When activated, it heats its surroundings to scorching temperatures, hardening molten rock into solid stone in mere moments. Its power amplifies fire-based attacks by +50% for 12 seconds, but prolonged use risks catastrophic overheating that could destroy both the device and the wielder's hand.
effects: Heats a 10-foot radius area to scorching temperatures

effectDetails.title: Scorched Heat
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Creates a 10-foot radius, 20-foot tall column of intense heat that lasts for 1 minute or until the user stops concentrating on it (a bonus action is required to maintain). The area within the column has a temperature of at least 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit and can harden lava into stone in seconds. Concentration ends early if the user takes damage.

effectDetails.title: Flame Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Increases fire-based attacks made by the user within a 30-foot radius by +50% for 12 seconds. This effect can be used once per short or long rest and requires concentration.

earth_land_item_rune_of_scorched_genesis.levelRequirementReason: Requires minimal magic affinity but must be wielded carefully to avoid overheating.
earth_land_item_rune_of_scorched_genesis.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster deals in unique and powerful artifacts, including those from volcanic regions.
earth_land_item_rune_of_scorched_genesis.shippingDetail: Ships via dragon courier with a 1-day delivery time.

usage.activation: Action or bonus action to activate and maintain the effects; concentration is required for both effects.
usage.duration: Scorched Heat lasts 1 minute, Flame Boost is instantaneous but requires concentration. Both end if the user stops concentrating.
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends early due to damage or when the effect's duration expires.

earth_land_item_rune_of_scorched_genesis.priceReason: Balanced at a lower price given its limited and manageable effects.

grand_country_item_angular_gravity_ward_.name: The Obsidian Spine Ward
grand_country_item_angular_gravity_ward_.description: The Obsidian Spine Ward is a jagged, angular shield crafted from the very essence of gravity itself—forged in the heart of an ancient, cursed mountain range. Its obsidian spikes hum with latent gravitational force, offering fleeting moments of controlled descent and protection against sudden drops. Though its touch is cursed, it grants a brief respite for those who dare to wield it, allowing them to navigate treacherous falls with a semblance of grace.

effectDetails.title: Fleeting Gravity Shield
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction when you fall. Provides temporary gravity resistance, reducing falling damage by half for up to 30 seconds. Ends if you land or the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Controlled Descent
effectDetails.rules: Slows your fall speed by 50%, allowing for a controlled descent. Lasts until the end of your next turn. This effect can be used once per short rest.

grand_country_item_angular_gravity_ward_.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant control over gravity to properly harness the Obsidian Spine Ward's power.
grand_country_item_angular_gravity_ward_.vendorReason: Side Seller specializes in rare and cursed artifacts, making The Obsidian Spine Ward a fitting addition to their inventory.
grand_country_item_angular_gravity_ward_.shippingDetail: Ships via Vertical Courier with expedited service for an additional cost.

usage.duration: Up to 30 seconds or until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Landing or duration expires, once per short rest

grand_country_item_angular_gravity_ward_.priceReason: The Obsidian Spine Ward's unique ability to provide temporary gravity resistance and controlled descent makes it a valuable tool for adventurers facing treacherous terrain.

grand_country_item_curved_layer_ward_02.name: The Layered Rotwood Ropes of Descent
grand_country_item_curved_layer_ward_02.description: The Layered Rotwood Ropes of Descent are a rare and eerie artifact, their twisted form crafted from ancient rotwood that has petrified over millennia. These ropes pulse with chaotic energy, offering safe passage through vertiginous drops. Legend whispers they subtly alter one's perception, causing fleeting hallucinations as you descend. Though the climb is perilous, these ropes reduce fall damage by 20% and grant a 15% increase in climbing speed.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Fall Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you fall, reduce the damage by 20%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Increased Climbing Speed
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1d6 bonus to climbing checks for 1 hour. This effect can be used once per day.

grand_country_item_curved_layer_ward_02.levelRequirementReason: Only those of considerable strength and experience are capable of wielding such an artifact safely.
grand_country_item_curved_layer_ward_02.vendorReason: The Layer Market is known for its unique and dangerous goods, making it the perfect vendor for these enchanted ropes.
grand_country_item_curved_layer_ward_02.shippingDetail: Due to their delicate nature, they must be shipped via the Delivery Drone service, which ensures safe delivery within a week.

usage.activation: Use as an action when you are about to fall or start climbing.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing for the duration of your fall.
usage.endsWhen: At the start of your next turn after using it during a fall, or at the end of 1 hour for increased climbing speed.

grand_country_item_curved_layer_ward_02.priceReason: The rarity and magical properties of these ropes justify their price, making them a valuable asset to any adventurer's arsenal.

grand_country_item_twisted_gravity_ward_.name: The Chronal Fracture Ropes
grand_country_item_twisted_gravity_ward_.description: The Chronal Fracture Ropes, forged from intertwined time strands, momentarily warp gravity around you, allowing for swift ascents and descents in otherwise impenetrable gravity wells. These ropes are a marvel of temporal engineering, but their use is fraught with risk; prolonged exposure can unravel the fabric of reality itself, creating destabilizing distortions that ripple through time. Careful travelers have reported that these ropes attract the vigilant attention of the 'Guardians of the Layers,' who patrol the dimensional crossroads with an iron fist.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Warp (1/short rest)
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, creating a localized gravitational anomaly that allows the user to ascend or descend up to 30 feet vertically. The effect lasts for 1 second and can be used once per short rest. A successful DC 20 Wisdom saving throw negates this effect if the user remains stationary during the duration.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Instability
effectDetails.rules: The use of these ropes has a chance to create brief temporal distortions, which last for 1 round and have a 5% chance per minute of occurrence. If a distortion is created, any creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be teleported up to 10 feet away from the user, dealing 1d6 force damage.

grand_country_item_twisted_gravity_ward_.levelRequirementReason: Only those of great power and experience can wield these delicate but dangerous ropes without causing catastrophic temporal anomalies.
grand_country_item_twisted_gravity_ward_.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in items that defy the natural order, making The Chronal Fracture Ropes a perfect fit for their inventory.
grand_country_item_twisted_gravity_ward_.shippingDetail: Ships via High-Speed Delivery with an expedited timeline of one week. Special handling is required to ensure no temporal disruptions occur during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action to use, once per short rest.
usage.duration: 1 second burst; negated by a successful saving throw if stationary.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends after 1 second or upon the user's next turn if stationary.
usage.charges: Recharges on completion of a long rest.

grand_country_item_twisted_gravity_ward_.priceReason: The intricate craftsmanship and rare materials used in these ropes, combined with their potential for catastrophic misuse, justify this high price.

doughnut_hole_item_central_nulls_of_void.name: The Central Nulls of Void Marked
doughnut_hole_item_central_nulls_of_void.description: The Central Nulls of Void Marked are obsidian spheres that pulse with an unsettling hum, a remnant from when the void first expanded. Their touch is warm yet chilling, radiating a sense of infinite nothingness. Holding one causes fleeting visions of impossible geometries and echoes of silence, potentially accelerating localized entropy around you by 5 for three turns. These relics are rare, crafted in the deepest reaches of the Nulls themselves.

effectDetails.title: Void Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: While holding a Central Null of Void Marked, you accelerate localized entropy by 5 for three turns. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Entropic Echo
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that each time you use the item, it triggers a minor void distortion in the area around you, which lasts for one turn. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

doughnut_hole_item_central_nulls_of_void.levelRequirementReason: The complexity of interacting with these relics requires a high level of control and understanding of void mechanics.
doughnut_hole_item_central_nulls_of_void.vendorReason: Void Vendor is known for dealing in the most peculiar and powerful artifacts from the Nulls, including these rare relics.
doughnut_hole_item_central_nulls_of_void.shippingDetail: Due to their delicate nature, these relics are shipped via a special container that ensures safe delivery through the rifts of the void.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with ongoing results for three turns
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration ends or item is used again
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short rest

doughnut_hole_item_central_nulls_of_void.priceReason: The rarity and unique properties of these relics justify a price that reflects their value in the D&D market.

doughnut_hole_item_kaleidoscopic_marked_.name: Kaleidoscopic Marked Nulls
doughnut_hole_item_kaleidoscopic_marked_.description: The Kaleidoscopic Marked Nulls are fragments plucked from the unstable edges of collapsing kaleidoscopic rifts. They glow with an internal, ever-shifting light, a mesmerizing display of impossible hues that dances and morphs in your vision. Consuming these nulls grants a fleeting moment of heightened perception and awareness, but prolonged exposure can lead to disorienting hallucinations and temporary color blindness. The air around them carries the faint scent of burnt sugar and static electricity.

effectDetails.title: Heightened Perception
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +3 bonus to Perception checks for two consecutive turns. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption.

effectDetails.title: Color Blindness Risk
effectDetails.rules: There is a 5% chance of temporary color blindness lasting one minute after consuming the nulls. The user can make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 14) to avoid this effect.

doughnut_hole_item_kaleidoscopic_marked_.levelRequirementReason: The kaleidoscopic nature of these fragments requires some familiarity with sensory distortions.
doughnut_hole_item_kaleidoscopic_marked_.vendorReason: Hole Hawker's extensive network allows them to source rare and exotic items from the most remote regions.
doughnut_hole_item_kaleidoscopic_marked_.shippingDetail: Delivered within a day, but the fragility of the nulls requires special handling.

usage.activation: Instantaneous consumption upon contact with the mouth.
usage.duration: 2 turns of heightened perception followed by one minute of color blindness if triggered.
usage.endsWhen: The effects expire naturally after their duration ends or if consumed again before the end of its effect.
usage.charges: Unlimited; each null is a single-use item.

doughnut_hole_item_kaleidoscopic_marked_.priceReason: The rarity and unstable nature of these fragments justify this price point.

doughnut_hole_item_mk_28_central_nulls.name: Mk.28 Central Nulls
doughnut_hole_item_mk_28_central_nulls.description: Forged within the heart of a miniature, stabilized void event, Mk.28 Central Nulls are unnervingly smooth and intensely cold to the touch. When activated, these nulls create a localized zone of near-total silence within a five-meter radius for three turns, disrupting enemy magic casting attempts. The wielder feels an unsettling calm as nearby sounds are dampened, but the true power lies in its ability to momentarily negate status effects on the user, granting them a brief respite from debilitating conditions.

effectDetails.title: Silence
effectDetails.rules: When activated (requires 10 Warts), Mk.28 Central Nulls create a localized zone of near-total silence within a five-meter radius that lasts for three turns, disrupting enemy magic casting attempts and reducing their effective spellcasting DC by 5.

effectDetails.title: Status Negation
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the user gains temporary immunity to all status effects for one minute. This effect can only be used once every long rest.

doughnut_hole_item_mk_28_central_nulls.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for high-level characters who require a tool capable of disrupting magic and providing immediate respite from debilitating conditions.
doughnut_hole_item_mk_28_central_nulls.vendorReason: The center_seller specializes in rare and exotic items, including those forged within the heart of miniature void events.
doughnut_hole_item_mk_28_central_nulls.shippingDetail: Ships via Temporal Conveyance Unit with a one-week delivery delay due to the item's delicate nature.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, but lasts for three turns once activated
usage.endsWhen: Ends when its duration expires or the user is hit by an attack

doughnut_hole_item_mk_28_central_nulls.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique crafting process justify this balanced XP price.

grand_country_item_jade_spiral_finder.name: Jade Spiral Finder's Hooks
grand_country_item_jade_spiral_finder.description: The Jade Spiral Finder's Hooks are crafted from a rare jade that glows faintly in moonlight, their spiraling design forged by ancient artisans. These hooks not only provide unmatched traction on slick surfaces but also subtly shift your weight to enhance stability and balance during ascent. The jade is said to be imbued with the essence of nature itself, making them invaluable tools for any explorer or climber seeking to conquer treacherous heights.

effectDetails.title: Nature's Grip
effectDetails.rules: When you use these hooks, they provide a +2 bonus to your Athletics checks for climbing. This effect lasts until the end of your next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Silent Ascent
effectDetails.rules: You can move up at twice your normal climbing speed when using these hooks. Additionally, you take no fall damage if you successfully climb a height equal to or less than 30 feet within the duration of this effect.

grand_country_item_jade_spiral_finder.levelRequirementReason: These hooks are designed for beginners and adventurers alike, requiring only basic climbing skills.
grand_country_item_jade_spiral_finder.vendorReason: Side sellers often have a wide range of items that cater to adventurers' unique needs, including these versatile climbing tools.
grand_country_item_jade_spiral_finder.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Rolling Cart, known for its timely and reliable service.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; lasts until the end of your next short rest
usage.endsWhen: At the end of your next short rest

grand_country_item_jade_spiral_finder.priceReason: The jade used in these hooks is rare, and their unique design adds significant value to any adventurer's gear.

grand_country_item_vertical_layer_hook_7.name: Vertical Layer Hook - 7
grand_country_item_vertical_layer_hook_7.description: This Vertical Layer Hook - 7 is a marvel of alchemy and blacksmithing, forged from solidified donut dough and enchanted with a pulsating energy. It effortlessly pulls you skyward, ignoring even the strongest structural imperfections. Its unique design ensures that even if the ground beneath you shifts, it will maintain its grip, making it an invaluable tool for adventurers seeking to ascend quickly. Beware: prolonged use can lead to disorientation and a sudden, uncontrollable craving for powdered sugar.

effectDetails.title: Rapid Ascension
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the hook to ascend rapidly. The hook provides a +2 bonus to your AC and grants a +10 foot movement speed for 1 minute. This effect ends if you are hit by an attack or fall prone.

effectDetails.title: Structural Mastery
effectDetails.rules: While active, the hook ignores any damage reduction from structural weaknesses up to 50%. It does not function in environments without solid ground support. If the ground beneath you is compromised, it retracts and ends its effect immediately.

grand_country_item_vertical_layer_hook_7.levelRequirementReason: This item's unique mechanics and power level require a high-level character to effectively utilize.
grand_country_item_vertical_layer_hook_7.vendorReason: The Vertical Vendor specializes in items that assist with ascension, making this hook an ideal addition to their inventory.
grand_country_item_vertical_layer_hook_7.shippingDetail: Ships within one business day; requires signature upon delivery.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until the ground is compromised
usage.endsWhen: You are hit by an attack, fall prone, or the ground beneath you shifts

grand_country_item_vertical_layer_hook_7.priceReason: This price reflects the item's unique alchemical properties and the high-level demand for such a versatile ascension tool.

grand_country_item_forbidden_layer_hook_.name: Forbidden Layer Hook of Echoes
grand_country_item_forbidden_layer_hook_.description: The Forbidden Layer Hook of Echoes hums with a spectral resonance, its iron grip warped by the whispers of forgotten dimensions. This macabre tool can briefly expose hidden pathways in stone and reveal unstable layers within ancient walls, but it also risks attracting the attention of unseen entities—creatures born from fractured realities. Caution is advised for those who wield this dangerous artifact; the echoes it summons are not easily dismissed.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Layers
