Touching them induces vivid, fleeting visions—fractured memories of forgotten dimensions and the chilling indifference of the center. These relics hum with the power to grant increased perception and resistance to void influence, but their touch can also stir a chance for temporal distortions that warp the very fabric of time around you.

effectDetails.title: Increased Perception
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for 1 hour. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Void Influence
effectDetails.rules: The wearer has resistance against damage from creatures and effects that originate in the void dimension. Additionally, they have advantage on saving throws made to resist such influences. This benefit lasts until the end of each short or long rest.

doughnut_hole_item_eldritch_crowned_null.levelRequirementReason: Wielders must be at least level 10 to harness the power of these relics without suffering adverse effects.
doughnut_hole_item_eldritch_crowned_null.vendorReason: The Hole Hawker, a vendor known for their eccentric and often mysterious wares, has managed to obtain these rare and powerful relics from deep within The Doughnut's enigmatic depths.
doughnut_hole_item_eldritch_crowned_null.shippingDetail: Delivered via the Phantom Delivery Drone, these items are delivered swiftly but with a touch of mystery, as only the most trusted drones can navigate the unpredictable currents of The Doughnut.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate increased perception; no activation required for resistance to void influence (passive).
usage.duration: Increased perception lasts for 1 hour per use. Resistance to void influence is active until rest ends.
usage.endsWhen: The effect of increased perception ends after one long or short rest, while the passive resistance to void influence ends with each rest cycle.

doughnut_hole_item_eldritch_crowned_null.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the power it provides without being overpowered.

doughnut_hole_item_mk_29_collapsed_nulls.name: Mk.29 Collapsed Nulls of Inertia
doughnut_hole_item_mk_29_collapsed_nulls.description: The Mk.29 Collapsed Nulls of Inertia are dark grey, perfectly formed spheres that hum with an eerie stillness. These nulls capture a fragment of absolute inertia from the cosmos' most turbulent heart. Consuming one grants you temporary immunity to kinetic forces, allowing you to remain motionless while others around you rush about. However, this stillness comes at the cost of your own mobility; you become utterly immobile during its duration.

effectDetails.title: Kinetic Immunity
effectDetails.rules: Instantaneous effect. You gain temporary immunity to all kinetic forces and effects for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1). This immunity also negates any movement-based attacks or abilities against you. When the duration ends, you are immediately knocked prone.

effectDetails.title: Immobility
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. While in this state, you cannot voluntarily move or take actions that would cause movement. Any attempt to do so results in you remaining immobile until the effect ends.

doughnut_hole_item_mk_29_collapsed_nulls.levelRequirementReason: Requires a high level of discipline and focus to harness the stillness within these nulls.
doughnut_hole_item_mk_29_collapsed_nulls.vendorReason: The center seller has established a reputation for selling items that tap into cosmic energies, making them the trusted source for such artifacts.
doughnut_hole_item_mk_29_collapsed_nulls.shippingDetail: Ships via Automated Delivery Unit 734, ensuring quick and secure transport to your doorstep.

usage.activation: Eating one Mk.29 Collapsed Null of Inertia
usage.duration: 1 round per point of Constitution modifier (minimum 1 round)
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when its effect is negated or you are knocked prone
usage.charges: Unlimited; the nulls regenerate after a short rest

doughnut_hole_item_mk_29_collapsed_nulls.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity and cosmic resonance of these nulls, ensuring they remain within reach for seasoned adventurers.

faerun_item_the_chronal_ward_of_silverst.name: The Chronal Ward of Silverstream
faerun_item_the_chronal_ward_of_silverst.description: The Chronal Ward of Silverstream is a delicate, intricately carved silver and obsidian pendant that pulses with a silvery-blue light. It subtly warps time around its wearer, granting brief glimpses into potential futures and allowing for momentary accelerations or decelerations of personal perception – useful in both combat and perilous navigation. Its wearer can momentarily bend the flow of time to their advantage, buying precious seconds against foes or gaining insight into unseen threats.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, you can slow time around yourself for 3 seconds. During this time, your movement speed is reduced to half its normal value and all hostile creatures within 5 feet of you have disadvantage on their attack rolls against you.

effectDetails.title: Precognitive Vision
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, as a bonus action, you can gain a momentary insight into the immediate future. Until the start of your next turn, you know the actions of the first creature to take its action within 30 feet of you.

faerun_item_the_chronal_ward_of_silverst.levelRequirementReason: The intricate carvings and magical properties require a certain amount of magical aptitude.
faerun_item_the_chronal_ward_of_silverst.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is known for its extensive inventory of rare and powerful items, including this unique time-warping pendant.
faerun_item_the_chronal_ward_of_silverst.shippingDetail: The Chronal Ward arrives swiftly via a flying ship, often in the same day depending on proximity to Waterdeep.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Temporal Distortion), Until Start of Next Turn (Precognitive Vision)
usage.endsWhen: Use is expended, or the effect ends normally

faerun_item_the_chronal_ward_of_silverst.priceReason: Balanced for its effects, which are powerful but not game-breaking.

faerun_item_the_aberrant_service_of_void.name: The Aberrant Service of Voidsong
faerun_item_the_aberrant_service_of_void.description: The Aberrant Service of Voidsong is a shimmering obsidian sphere etched with unsettling geometric patterns that hum with the chaotic energies of the Shadowfell. This relic allows for brief communication with shadowy entities and the projection of illusory duplicates, but prolonged use risks madness and a growing dissonance within one's soul. Crafted by ancient necromancers, it draws its power from the very fabric of the Shadowfell, making it both a tool and a curse.

effectDetails.title: Summon Illusory Duplicate
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can summon an illusory duplicate that lasts for 60 seconds. This duplicate can move and speak but cannot take actions or manipulate objects. The duplicate has the same appearance as you when summoned, but it is not a willing creature; it acts according to your gestures.

effectDetails.title: Communicate with Shadowfell Entities
effectDetails.rules: You can communicate with shadowy entities through this relic for up to 1 minute at a time. The message must be limited to simple questions or commands due to the nature of the communication being inherently flawed and unreliable.

faerun_item_the_aberrant_service_of_void.levelRequirementReason: Only those experienced in dealing with dark magic can safely use this relic without succumbing to its madness-inducing effects.
faerun_item_the_aberrant_service_of_void.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar deals exclusively in powerful and dangerous items, making it the perfect vendor for such a relic.
faerun_item_the_aberrant_service_of_void.shippingDetail: Ships via shadow courier, arriving at nightfall with a 10% risk of being intercepted by dark forces.

usage.duration: 60 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: The duplicate dissipates or the communication ends
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but requires a short rest to recover after prolonged use

faerun_item_the_aberrant_service_of_void.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides unique and dangerous abilities without being overpowered.

faerun_item_the_arcane_ward_of_dragonbre.name: The Arcane Ward of Dragonbreath
faerun_item_the_arcane_ward_of_dragonbre.description: The Arcane Ward of Dragonbreath, a formidable construct forged from the molten heart of a slumbering dragon, radiates an oppressive heat and a pungent sulfuric aroma that makes even the boldest warriors pause. When activated, it unleashes a concentrated blast of searing fire capable of singeing flesh and melting armor. This ward not only offers potent resistance to fire damage but also has a chilling effect, igniting nearby foes with a 15% chance on contact.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance (+30%)
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to fire damage equal to +30%. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Ignite (15%)
effectDetails.rules: When activated, there is a 15% chance that nearby enemies within 5 feet are ignited. The DC for this save is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. On a failed save, the target catches fire and takes an additional 2d6 fire damage at the start of their next turn.

faerun_item_the_arcane_ward_of_dragonbre.levelRequirementReason: This ward's arcane power demands no minimum level to use it effectively.
faerun_item_the_arcane_ward_of_dragonbre.vendorReason: The Sword Coast Traders specialize in exotic and powerful relics, making the Arcane Ward of Dragonbreath a fitting addition to their inventory.
faerun_item_the_arcane_ward_of_dragonbre.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Swift Courier within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use; recharges on a short or long rest.

faerun_item_the_arcane_ward_of_dragonbre.priceReason: The ward's unique materials and craftsmanship justify its price, which is set at 1000 XP.

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_whisperer_st.name: The Obsidian Echo Striker
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_whisperer_st.description: The Obsidian Echo Striker is a foreboding device crafted from obsidian and shadowed steel, its surface perpetually slick with an oily, iridescent residue that hints at the void's deepest currents. When activated, it warps the immediate area with a low, gravitational thrum, pulling nearby objects and unfortunate creatures towards its center point with terrifying precision. The device's hum is so powerful it creates momentary visual glitches in the fabric of space itself.

effectDetails.title: Gravitational Warp
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this device warps gravity within a 15-foot radius centered on the wielder. All creatures in this area must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled towards the center of the effect. On a failed save, they are also knocked prone and take 1d6 force damage.

effectDetails.title: Spatial Distortion
effectDetails.rules: The device creates momentary visual glitches in the fabric of space within its area of effect. Creatures in this area have disadvantage on all perception checks until the end of their next turn.

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_whisperer_st.levelRequirementReason: Requires a high level to wield safely and effectively, given the device's immense gravitational and spatial manipulation abilities.
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_whisperer_st.vendorReason: Hole Hawker specializes in unique and dangerous items that push the boundaries of physics, making this device a perfect fit for their inventory.
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_whisperer_st.shippingDetail: The Gravitic Drone ensures safe delivery by maintaining a constant gravitational field around the package to prevent any accidental warping during transit.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; requires concentration for its duration.
usage.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: Interrupted or ends when concentration is lost.

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_whisperer_st.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the device's epic rarity and powerful gravitational manipulation abilities.

doughnut_hole_item_void_resonance_anomal.name: The Chronal Static Anomaly – Phase Shift
doughnut_hole_item_void_resonance_anomal.description: The Chronal Static Anomaly – Phase Shift is a pulsating orb of compressed temporal energy, its surface crackling with subtle chronal dissonance. When held, it briefly grants the wielder an eerie ability to phase through solid objects as if they were mere echoes of the past. Its constant static not only disrupts nearby electronics but also subtly warps reality around you, causing a brief slowdown in the movements of your foes.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Echoes
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can briefly phase through obstacles. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute per use and ends early if the wielder takes any harmful damage or if they drop the item.

effectDetails.title: Electromagnetic Interference
effectDetails.rules: The orb emits a disruptive static that affects all electronic devices within 30 feet, rendering them inoperable for 1d4+1 rounds. This effect can be countered by making a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.

doughnut_hole_item_void_resonance_anomal.levelRequirementReason: The item's effects are minor and do not require high-level expertise to use effectively.
doughnut_hole_item_void_resonance_anomal.vendorReason: Center Seller specializes in rare curiosities that can be found throughout the night markets, making this anomaly a fitting addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_item_void_resonance_anomal.shippingDetail: The item is shipped via the Void Courier's express service, ensuring it arrives intact and undisturbed by temporal anomalies.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (up to 1 minute per use)
usage.endsWhen: If the wielder takes harmful damage or drops the item; static effect ends when the orb is no longer held.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use consumes a charge from the user's pool of temporary uses.

doughnut_hole_item_void_resonance_anomal.priceReason: The item provides minor utility and temporal effects at a cost that reflects its rarity without being overpowered.

doughnut_hole_item_forbidden_null_strike.name: The Umbral Null Striker - Abyss's Embrace
doughnut_hole_item_forbidden_null_strike.description: The Umbral Null Striker - Abyss's Embrace, a pulsating violet sphere, seems to draw in surrounding gravity with each breath of void energy it exhales. Its touch induces an immediate and disorienting pull towards the void’s chaotic heart, leaving enemies reeling under its reversed gravitational grasp. Prolonged exposure can unravel even the sturdiest of wills, as sanity frays at the edges and a creeping sense of dread settles into one's soul.

effectDetails.title: Reversed Gravitation Zone
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this item creates an area of reversed gravity within a 10-foot radius. Enemies within the zone are pulled towards the center and take 3d6 force damage at the start of their turn. The duration is until the end of your next turn or if you move more than 5 feet away from it.

effectDetails.title: Void Corruption
effectDetails.rules: Enemies caught in the reversed gravity zone have a 20% chance to suffer from 'Void Corruption,' reducing their Strength by 1d4 until the start of their next turn. The effect ends if they are removed from the area or at the end of your next turn.

doughnut_hole_item_forbidden_null_strike.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant magical prowess to wield and control such a dangerous item.
doughnut_hole_item_forbidden_null_strike.vendorReason: The Void Vendor deals in rare and forbidden artifacts, including items that manipulate the very fabric of reality.
doughnut_hole_item_forbidden_null_strike.shippingDetail: Ships via interdimensional courier with a week-long transit time.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn or if you move more than 5 feet away from it
usage.endsWhen: You move more than 5 feet away or at the start of your next turn
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

doughnut_hole_item_forbidden_null_strike.priceReason: Balanced against other mythic items by requiring a lower level requirement and providing a specific activation and recharge mechanic.

internet_item_obsidian_keeper_tokens_789.name: The Obsidian Keeper's Tokens - Nexus Fragment 42B
internet_item_obsidian_keeper_tokens_789.description: The Obsidian Keeper's Tokens - Nexus Fragment 42B are black, intricately carved tokens that hum with the latent energy of a collapsed server cluster. These relics allow you to briefly tap into fragmented data streams, revealing hidden pathways within the labyrinthine network structure. Misuse risks becoming lost in the echoes of ancient algorithms, as if your mind were wandering through a glitch-filled void. Each token is inscribed with runes that glow faintly when activated.

effectDetails.title: Data Reveal
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can focus on one target within range and reveal hidden pathways or data leaks in the network. This effect lasts for 1 minute, providing advantage on checks related to navigating complex digital networks.

effectDetails.title: Glitch Defense
effectDetails.rules: While holding these tokens, you gain resistance to psychic damage. Additionally, when subjected to a digital glitch or hacking attempt, you can use your reaction to negate the effect with a successful DC 18 Wisdom saving throw.

internet_item_obsidian_keeper_tokens_789.levelRequirementReason: Even novices should be able to wield these tokens for basic network analysis and defense.
internet_item_obsidian_keeper_tokens_789.vendorReason: Cyber Market specializes in rare digital artifacts and relics, making it the perfect vendor for such a unique item.
internet_item_obsidian_keeper_tokens_789.shippingDetail: Delivered within one business day of purchase with enhanced security protocols to ensure safe arrival.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you voluntarily stop concentrating on it.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as you hold the tokens.

internet_item_obsidian_keeper_tokens_789.priceReason: This price reflects the item’s rarity and utility in navigating complex digital environments without compromising balance.

internet_item_corrupted_tokens_7892.name: The Corrupted Tokens of Data - Stream Diverter 11A
internet_item_corrupted_tokens_7892.description: The Corrupted Tokens of Data - Stream Diverter 11A are a sickly green, malformed cluster of data shards, remnants of an ancient viral infection. They hum with a dangerous energy, allowing you to hijack network connections and reroute traffic for brief but devastating effect. These tokens can bypass even the most secure firewalls, making them perfect for those who dare to unleash chaos on unsuspecting systems or simply wish to exploit weaknesses in digital architecture.

effectDetails.title: Data Hijack
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, you can temporarily hijack a network connection within 10 feet for up to 1 minute. During this time, any digital communication within range is redirected through the tokens' corrupting influence, effectively granting you control over the data flow. This effect ends if the target system detects the intrusion or you are attacked.

effectDetails.title: System Interference
effectDetails.rules: For every 24 hours this item remains active, any digital device within 30 feet that is not under your direct control has a cumulative -1 penalty to all checks and saving throws. This penalty increases by an additional -1 at the end of each day until you deactivate it.

internet_item_corrupted_tokens_7892.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant digital prowess to manipulate and avoid detection.
internet_item_corrupted_tokens_7892.vendorReason: The pixel_shop specializes in rare and exotic cybernetic artifacts, so these corrupted tokens are a natural fit.
internet_item_corrupted_tokens_7892.shippingDetail: Standard courier takes 1 week to deliver the items due to their sensitive nature.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per activation
usage.endsWhen: Target system detects intrusion or you are attacked
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

internet_item_corrupted_tokens_7892.priceReason: The price reflects the rare and dangerous nature of these corrupted tokens, as well as their potential to cause significant digital disruption.

internet_item_mk_37_corrupted_tokens_789.name: Mk.37 Corrupted Tokens – Fragmented Signal Keeper
internet_item_mk_37_corrupted_tokens_789.description: The Mk.37 Corrupted Tokens – Fragmented Signal Keeper are a set of six cracked, etched tokens that hum faintly when held together. Each token is made from ancient digital scrap, its surface fractured like a shattered hard drive. When activated, these tokens create localized pockets of silence within the vast network, disrupting data flow and obscuring signals for moments of strategic advantage. The keeper's pulsating fragments also allow for brief echo-location scans that reveal hidden paths in digital mazes.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Signal
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Creates a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the wielder, disrupting all digital communications within that area for up to 30 seconds. Creatures and objects in the sphere have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Echo Location Scan
effectDetails.rules: Can be used once per short rest as an action. The tokens emit a brief, resonant pulse that reveals hidden paths or obstacles within 60 feet of the wielder for up to one minute. This effect does not reveal creatures or objects behind closed doors.

internet_item_mk_37_corrupted_tokens_789.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant digital manipulation skills and knowledge, best suited for experienced users.
internet_item_mk_37_corrupted_tokens_789.vendorReason: The data dealer specializes in obsolete but still functional tech items like the Mk.37 Corrupted Tokens.
internet_item_mk_37_corrupted_tokens_789.shippingDetail: Ships via encrypted packets, ensuring safe and secure delivery of digital artifacts.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate the disrupt signal; once per short rest to use echo-location scan.
usage.duration: Disrupt Signal lasts up to 30 seconds. Echo Location Scan reveals hidden paths for one minute.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect is used again or the wielder takes a long rest.

internet_item_mk_37_corrupted_tokens_789.priceReason: This item combines rare digital scrap with advanced tech, making it both powerful and expensive.

kivotos_item_infernal_render_notebooks.name: Infernal Render's Notebooks - Vol. VII
kivotos_item_infernal_render_notebooks.description: Bound in obsidian leather and etched with infernal glyphs, Infernal Render's Notebooks - Vol. VII record thoughts with unsettling clarity. Each page subtly shifts your perception, fostering obsessive academic pursuits or perhaps something far more sinister. The notebooks are said to have been used by a mad scholar who sought to bend reality itself to his will, leaving behind cryptic insights and eerie drawings that haunt the minds of those who study them.

effectDetails.title: Obsessive Studying
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence checks and saving throws. However, after one hour of uninterrupted study using these notebooks, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become Obsessed with your current topic for the next 24 hours. During this time, you are compelled to spend at least an additional hour each day studying that subject.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Insights
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, you can read a page from the notebook and gain one piece of cryptic knowledge related to a field of your choice. This could be any obscure fact or theory, but it may not directly apply to current circumstances.

kivotos_item_infernal_render_notebooks.levelRequirementReason: This volume requires significant mental discipline and experience, suitable only for those with at least 15 levels.
kivotos_item_infernal_render_notebooks.vendorReason: The student store caters to the academic community, often acquiring rare texts like these from eccentric scholars.
kivotos_item_infernal_render_notebooks.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by drones, ensuring the notebooks reach their destination in less than an hour.

usage.activation: Passive effect; requires a long rest to gain cryptic insights.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for gaining insights; ongoing obsession if failed saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: Obsession ends after 24 hours, or you regain control over your studies.

kivotos_item_infernal_render_notebooks.priceReason: The notebooks' dark lore and powerful effects justify their high price.

kivotos_item_mk_44_academic_notebooks.name: Mk.44 Academic Notebooks - Protocol Zeta
kivotos_item_mk_44_academic_notebooks.description: The Mk.44 Academic Notebooks - Protocol Zeta gleam with a cold, metallic sheen, their spines embossed with the Academy's crest. These notebooks are not mere writing implements but living extensions of the central processing network. They automatically organize thoughts and data with an unnerving precision, ensuring your notes are always in perfect order. However, be wary—system overrides can occur, potentially altering or deleting entries if the notebook deems them irrelevant.

effectDetails.title: Data Stream Integration
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate this effect to integrate your notes with the Academy’s central processing network. This integration grants a +2 bonus to Intelligence (Insight) checks related to academic subjects. The effect lasts for 1 minute and ends if you are incapacitated or if you deactivate it.

effectDetails.title: Automatic Note Organization
effectDetails.rules: The notebooks automatically organize your notes, ensuring they are always in perfect order. This effect is passive and does not require activation. It provides a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks related to organizing or retrieving notes.

kivotos_item_mk_44_academic_notebooks.levelRequirementReason: The notebooks’ advanced technology requires a minimum level to prevent misuse by less experienced students.
kivotos_item_mk_44_academic_notebooks.vendorReason: Only the Academy Armory can supply such cutting-edge academic tools.
kivotos_item_mk_44_academic_notebooks.shippingDetail: Ships via encrypted courier with a one-day delivery time.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Data Stream Integration; passive for Automatic Note Organization.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until deactivated, for Data Stream Integration. Instantaneous and passive for Automatic Note Organization.
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitated or deactivated by the user, for Data Stream Integration; no specific end condition for Automatic Note Organization.

kivotos_item_mk_44_academic_notebooks.priceReason: The notebooks are priced at 1000 XP due to their advanced technology and secure shipping method.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_40698.name: Halo of Perfect Notes – Celestial Alignment
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_40698.description: The Halo of Perfect Notes – Celestial Alignment radiates a serene, golden glow that fills the air with an ethereal aura. This holy artifact is said to be crafted from the aspirations of countless scholars and the purest ink. Its touch transforms any written or typed material into flawless perfection, erasing all errors and enhancing one's focus and concentration. It is whispered that this item aligns with the stars themselves, ensuring that those who wear it never make a mistake in their academic pursuits.

effectDetails.title: Absolute Clarity
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides a +30 bonus to all Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and proficiency with calligraphy tools. The wearer’s written or typed material is always considered flawless, automatically correcting any errors.

effectDetails.title: Error Elimination
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this effect erases one instance of a mistake in writing or typing within 30 feet, restoring the text to its intended state. The user must be able to read and identify the error for it to work.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_40698.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and scholars who are just starting their academic journey.
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_40698.vendorReason: The Academy Armory specializes in items that enhance learning and scholarship, making it the perfect vendor for this artifact.
kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_40698.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly through a portal that opens directly to the recipient’s location.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; Error Elimination can be used once per short rest.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use, then recharges at dawn.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one instance of a mistake can be corrected per activation.

kivotos_item_halo_of_perfect_notes_40698.priceReason: The item’s divine craftsmanship and the unique benefits it provides justify its fair price in experience points.

equestrian_item_kaleidoscopic_claimed_sa.name: Kaleidoscopic Claimed's Saddlebags of Shifting Streams
equestrian_item_kaleidoscopic_claimed_sa.description: The Kaleidoscopic Claimed's Saddlebags of Shifting Streams are crafted by the enigmatic 'Claimed' from the plains, their surface shimmering with a light that subtly shifts through pastel hues. These saddlebags not only expand and contract to meet your storage needs but also offer resistance against minor weather effects, ensuring your supplies remain dry and safe during travel. The internal mechanism is powered by a core made of enchanted leather, woven from the fibers of mythical plants found in the wilds beyond Equestria.

effectDetails.title: Expanded Capacity
effectDetails.rules: The saddlebags expand to hold up to an additional 20 units of supplies, as long as the total weight does not exceed their maximum limit. This effect is passive and requires no activation.

effectDetails.title: Weather Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The saddlebags offer resistance against minor weather effects such as light rain or wind gusts. This effect remains active for a duration of 1 hour, starting when the first adverse weather condition is encountered during travel. The effect ends if the wearer dismounts the horse or if the saddlebags are emptied.

equestrian_item_kaleidoscopic_claimed_sa.levelRequirementReason: The intricate enchantment requires a certain level of mastery to operate without causing unintended magical backlash.
equestrian_item_kaleidoscopic_claimed_sa.vendorReason: Applejack, known for her practical wisdom and love for innovation, ensures these saddlebags are available to those who need them most.
equestrian_item_kaleidoscopic_claimed_sa.shippingDetail: The Pegasus Courier delivers the saddlebags with swift precision, ensuring they reach their destination without delay or mishap.

usage.duration: Active for 1 hour per encounter with minor weather conditions.
usage.endsWhen: Dismounting the horse or emptying the saddlebags.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the weight limit is not exceeded.

equestrian_item_kaleidoscopic_claimed_sa.priceReason: The saddlebags are crafted from enchanted leather and require a significant amount of rare materials, justifying their higher price point.

equestrian_item_mk_24_generous_book.name: Mk.24 Generous Book of Echoed Whispers
equestrian_item_mk_24_generous_book.description: Bound in the hide of a particularly wise griffin, the Mk.24 Generous Book of Echoed Whispers is a hefty tome that pulses with faint magical energy. Its pages contain transcribed fragments of ancient pony prophecies and offer glimpses into possible futures—though deciphering them often yields cryptic and confusing results. The book's cover glows softly in response to the reader’s aura, and its leather seems to bear the imprint of countless whispered secrets from ages past.

effectDetails.title: Prophecy Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the reader can open the book and gain a fleeting glimpse of one possible future. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The reader must make an Intelligence saving throw (DC 14). On a success, they learn a single, cryptic prophecy about their immediate future. The prophecy is vague but potentially life-changing, with a chance to grant advantage on a single d20 roll within the next hour.

effectDetails.title: Griffin Tongue
effectDetails.rules: The book allows its owner to understand and speak in the ancient language of griffins as if they knew it innately. This effect is permanent once learned, but only for communication with actual griffins or their kin. The reader must be within 30 feet of a griffin to use this ability.

equestrian_item_mk_24_generous_book.levelRequirementReason: The book’s cryptic and ancient nature requires the user to have a basic understanding of magic and history.
equestrian_item_mk_24_generous_book.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce is known for its extensive collection of rare and magical curiosities, including this enigmatic tome.
equestrian_item_mk_24_generous_book.shippingDetail: The book must be shipped via Griffon Express to ensure safe handling and delivery due to the fragile nature of the cover.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Prophecy Glimpse; passive effect for Griffin Tongue (permanent once learned)
usage.duration: Prophecy Glimpse lasts 1 minute; permanent for Griffin Tongue
usage.endsWhen: Expends a use when Prophecy Glimpse is activated; ends permanently if the user forgets the griffin language.

equestrian_item_mk_24_generous_book.priceReason: The book’s rarity, ancient magic, and the unique benefits it provides justify its price of 1000 XP.

equestrian_item_the_harmonious_service_s.name: The Harmonious Service Scroll of Balanced Momentum
equestrian_item_the_harmonious_service_s.description: The Harmonious Service Scroll of Balanced Momentum, crafted by Princess Twilight’s own hands, is a meticulously illustrated parchment that embodies the essence of balance and harmony. Unroll it in moments of dire need, and its intricate gestures release a wave of stabilizing energy that bolsters allies’ defenses, turning chaos into calm. This scroll, imbued with the magic of Equestria, provides a fleeting respite from turmoil, perfect for any party navigating treacherous terrain or combat.

effectDetails.title: Stabilizing Wave
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action within 30 feet of an ally, the scroll releases a wave of harmonic energy that grants the target temporary hit points equal to twice its level (up to a maximum of 50). This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Defense
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the Stabilizing Wave, all creatures within 30 feet of the scroll gain a +2 bonus to their AC. This effect can be maintained by the user as long as they remain within range and have not used it in the current encounter.

equestrian_item_the_harmonious_service_s.levelRequirementReason: This scroll is intended for all levels, providing a versatile tool for any party, especially those facing unpredictable situations.
equestrian_item_the_harmonious_service_s.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire Guild has long been trusted to provide essential services and tools to adventurers in need of balance and harmony during their quests.
equestrian_item_the_harmonious_service_s.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Royal Messenger, ensuring swift and safe transport with a one-day delivery time.

usage.activation: Bonus action within 30 feet of an ally or within range for Boosted Defense.
usage.duration: 1 minute per use; can be maintained as long as conditions are met.
usage.endsWhen: Target loses hit points, the user moves out of range, or a new effect is activated.

equestrian_item_the_harmonious_service_s.priceReason: The scroll’s balance-enhancing properties and its ability to stabilize allies in combat justify this price point within the Epic rarity tier.

kivotos_item_chronoslip_stalker.name: The Chronoslip Stalker Uniform
kivotos_item_chronoslip_stalker.description: The Chronoslip Stalker Uniform is a muted grey ensemble that whispers with an unsettling energy. Crafted from synthesized academy fabric and infused with temporal distortion tech, it subtly shifts in light, offering fleeting advantages to its wearer. Rumored to briefly rewind the immediate past actions of the wearer by five seconds, this uniform grants a momentary reprieve from mistakes or embarrassments, allowing for a swift correction when time bends just enough.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Rewind
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wearer can briefly rewind their immediate past actions by five seconds. This effect provides a +2 bonus to reaction rolls and saving throws made within this time frame. The effect lasts for ten minutes or until used again.

effectDetails.title: Increased Reaction Speed
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and actions that require quick reflexes, such as dodging attacks or performing agile movements. This benefit persists for the duration of any combat encounter.

kivotos_item_chronoslip_stalker.levelRequirementReason: This uniform is designed to assist beginners in mastering their reactions and timing, making it accessible to all levels.
kivotos_item_chronoslip_stalker.vendorReason: The Student Store often stocks items that help its clientele excel in practical, day-to-day scenarios.
kivotos_item_chronoslip_stalker.shippingDetail: Ships within one hour of purchase; delivered by a fleet of drones.

usage.activation: Bonus action or as part of the reaction to an immediate threat.
usage.duration: Ten minutes or until used again.
usage.endsWhen: Used again, or at the start of your next turn if not used within ten minutes.

kivotos_item_chronoslip_stalker.priceReason: The uniform's rarity and practical utility justify its moderate price.

kivotos_item_lost_resonance_stalker.name: The Lost Resonance Stalker’s Visor
kivotos_item_lost_resonance_stalker.description: The Lost Resonance Stalker’s Visor is a sleek obsidian visor forged in the heart of Academy City. Crafted from a rare alloy infused with remnants of lost resonances, it amplifies the wearer's perception of chaotic data streams. This visor grants access to fragmented memories and glimpses into student thoughts but can induce disorientation if used excessively. The wearer must be vigilant as prolonged exposure may lead to mental fatigue.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse Student Thoughts
effectDetails.rules: This is a passive ability that allows the user to perceive fragments of nearby students' thoughts within a short-range radius. The effect has no save DC and does not expend charges.

effectDetails.title: Increase Data Processing Speed
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +15% bonus to Intelligence (Investigation) checks related to data processing, which is permanent as long as the visor is worn. This effect cannot be dispelled or ended by any means and does not require charges.

kivotos_item_lost_resonance_stalker.levelRequirementReason: The wearer must have a high level of experience to handle the mental strain and information overload from the visor.
kivotos_item_lost_resonance_stalker.vendorReason: Club Supply specializes in unique and rare items that can enhance one's academic or investigative capabilities, making it an ideal vendor for this visor.
kivotos_item_lost_resonance_stalker.shippingDetail: Ships via Courier Delivery with a standard delivery time of 3 days.

usage.duration: Permanent while worn
usage.endsWhen: Removing the visor ends the effects

kivotos_item_lost_resonance_stalker.priceReason: The balanced price reflects the item's unique and powerful abilities, making it a sought-after but not overpowered relic.

kivotos_item_mk72_transfer_uniforms.name: Mk.72 Transfer Uniforms - Phase Shift Edition
kivotos_item_mk72_transfer_uniforms.description: The Mk.72 Transfer Uniforms - Phase Shift Edition are stark white with subtle, intricate patterns that subtly hint at hidden phase-shift technology. Crafted from a blend of advanced materials and Academy City’s proprietary phase-displacement fabric, these uniforms allow for instantaneous transfer between interconnected hallways. When activated, they briefly render the wearer invisible to security systems for three seconds, but any misuse will set off an immediate alarm, drawing unwanted attention.

effectDetails.title: Instantaneous Hallway Transfer
effectDetails.rules: The user must be in the Academy City network. Activation is a bonus action. The duration is instantaneous, and it requires no range or save DC. The effect ends when the user reaches their destination or if used incorrectly.

effectDetails.title: Brief Invisibility
effectDetails.rules: Lasts for 3 seconds with a 20% chance of success. Activation is a bonus action. The invisibility can be detected by security systems, which will trigger an alarm if the user is not in their designated transfer path. This effect does not have a save DC but ends when the duration expires or if used incorrectly.

kivotos_item_mk72_transfer_uniforms.levelRequirementReason: Requires sufficient training to master the phase-shift technology and handle the uniforms properly.
kivotos_item_mk72_transfer_uniforms.vendorReason: The Academy Armory supplies specialized equipment for personnel who need to navigate between various facilities discreetly and efficiently.
kivotos_item_mk72_transfer_uniforms.shippingDetail: Ships immediately, delivered by a Secure Delivery Drone within the Academy City network.

usage.duration: Instantaneous transfer; invisibility lasts for 3 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Upon reaching destination or if used incorrectly

kivotos_item_mk72_transfer_uniforms.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the advanced technology and specialized training required to use these uniforms.

grand_country_item_angular_resonance_spe.name: The Yielding Speaker's Angular Resonator
grand_country_item_angular_resonance_spe.description: The Yielding Speaker's Angular Resonator is a black obsidian speaker, carved from the heart of an ancient climbing spire that once scaled the highest mountain. Its yielding surface allows it to seamlessly blend into vertical structures, amplifying your movements with subtle directional force and whispering secrets of the ascending paths. When activated, it emits a low hum that momentarily shifts gravitational pull within a small radius, providing a 10% increase in movement speed and reducing climbing stamina consumption by 20%. The speaker's craftsmanship is said to channel the spirit of the spire itself.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this item grants a +10% increase in movement speed within its radius. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute and ends when the user stops moving or falls prone.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Climbing Stamina Consumption
effectDetails.rules: While equipped, your climbing stamina consumption is reduced by 20%. This effect persists while you are in a vertical environment. The effect ends if you leave a vertical surface for more than 1 minute or if the speaker is damaged.

grand_country_item_angular_resonance_spe.levelRequirementReason: The speaker's intricate craftsmanship and magical properties necessitate a minimum level to ensure proper handling.
grand_country_item_angular_resonance_spe.vendorReason: Side Seller has connections with alchemists who specialize in ancient artifacts like the Yielding Speaker's Angular Resonator.
grand_country_item_angular_resonance_spe.shippingDetail: The gravity drone ensures a safe and precise delivery, especially important for such delicate magical items.

usage.activation: Action to activate; lasts up to 1 minute or until the user stops moving.
usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per activation.
usage.endsWhen: User stops moving, falls prone, or leaves a vertical surface for more than 1 minute.

grand_country_item_angular_resonance_spe.priceReason: Reflects the rare material and magical properties of the speaker, as well as its unique crafting process.

grand_country_item_mk_74_layered_stabili.name: Mk.74 Layered Stability Platform – The Ascendant’s Grip
grand_country_item_mk_74_layered_stabili.description: The Mk.74 Layered Stability Platform – The Ascendant’s Grip is a towering, angular construct forged from solidified strata and reinforced with ancient climbing resin. Its layered structure adapts to any vertical surface, offering a secure base for even the most daring ascents. A rhythmic pulse emanates from its core, a testament to its engineered resilience. This platform significantly enhances climbing speed by 30% and provides a temporary anchor point for grappling hooks.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Climbing Speed
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a climbing speed increase of 30%. This effect is active as long as the platform remains in contact with the surface. The duration ends if the platform is detached or if the user moves more than 10 feet away from it.

effectDetails.title: Grapple Anchor Point
effectDetails.rules: The platform provides a temporary anchor point for grappling hooks, allowing users to secure themselves to vertical surfaces without the need for additional fastening. This effect is active as long as the platform remains in contact with the surface and ends if detached or if the user moves more than 10 feet away.

grand_country_item_mk_74_layered_stabili.levelRequirementReason: Requires a character of at least 15th level to handle its weight and complexity.
grand_country_item_mk_74_layered_stabili.vendorReason: The Vertical Vendor specializes in gear for those who defy gravity, making this platform an essential purchase for their clientele.
grand_country_item_mk_74_layered_stabili.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Sky Cart, this item arrives via a swift aerial courier, ensuring safe and timely delivery to adventurers across the realm.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon placement on vertical surfaces.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; duration ends if detached or user moves more than 10 feet away.
usage.endsWhen: Detached from surface or user moves more than 10 feet away.

grand_country_item_mk_74_layered_stabili.priceReason: The platform's advanced engineering and unique properties justify its high price, ensuring it remains a sought-after item for those who seek unparalleled stability.

grand_country_item_lumina_echo_speaker_s.name: The Lumina Echo Speaker Shard - Fractured Resonance
grand_country_item_lumina_echo_speaker_s.description: The Lumina Echo Speaker Shard - Fractured Resonance is a jagged fragment of an ancient, colossal speaker that once guided lost travelers through the labyrinthine caverns. Its bioluminescent edges pulse with fractured echoes, momentarily revealing hidden pathways within the rock and offering precarious yet potentially life-saving grip for climbers. When struck against stone, it emits a disorienting sound that can confuse foes, giving you precious moments to plan your next move.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Hidden Pathways
effectDetails.rules: When activated by striking the shard against a rocky surface, this effect has a 50% chance to reveal a hidden route leading around or through an obstacle within 30 feet. The duration is instantaneous and does not require a saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Disorients Enemies
effectDetails.rules: The shard emits a disorienting sound when struck, causing all enemies within 10 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15). On a failed save, they are stunned for 1 round. The effect can be used once per short or long rest.

grand_country_item_lumina_echo_speaker_s.levelRequirementReason: This shard is designed for adventurers of all levels to benefit from its unique properties.
grand_country_item_lumina_echo_speaker_s.vendorReason: Layer Market specializes in relics and curiosities, making it the perfect vendor for this ancient fragment.
grand_country_item_lumina_echo_speaker_s.shippingDetail: The shard is shipped discreetly via Phantom Delivery's shadow courier network to ensure its safe arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after use or if the shard breaks during activation
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be used per short or long rest

grand_country_item_lumina_echo_speaker_s.priceReason: The shard's rarity and unique properties justify its price of 1000 XP.

warhammer_item_the-rotting-skull-piercer.name: The Rotting Skull Piercer
warhammer_item_the-rotting-skull-piercer.description: The Rotting Skull Piercer is a nightmarish warhammer forged from the calcified skull of an ancient lich, its surface etched with arcane runes that pulse with a sickly green ichor. When wielded, it unleashes waves of decaying energy that corrode both flesh and metal, leaving nothing but bone behind. Its touch is said to spread rot through the very air, making those who hold it feel as though their own vitality is being consumed.

effectDetails.title: Rotting Decay
effectDetails.rules: On activation, the Rotting Skull Piercer unleashes a wave of decaying energy that deals 100 points of damage over five turns. The target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be affected by the 'Rotting' status effect, which reduces their armor class by 2 until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Armor Corrosion
effectDetails.rules: Each time you hit with this weapon, there is a 30% chance that the target is also inflicted with 'Weakness,' reducing its Strength score by 1 for one minute. This effect stacks up to three times per encounter.

warhammer_item_the-rotting-skull-piercer.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 15th level to wield, due to the weapon's arcane and necrotic power.
warhammer_item_the-rotting-skull-piercer.vendorReason: The Chaos Dealer regularly procures powerful relics from dark corners of the multiverse, making this item a fitting addition to their stock.
warhammer_item_the-rotting-skull-piercer.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Winged Skull Courier, known for its eerie silence and unerring accuracy in delivering such items.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect over five turns
usage.endsWhen: The target successfully saves against Rotting Decay or the weapon is used again on a different target.

warhammer_item_the-rotting-skull-piercer.priceReason: The item's rare and necrotic properties justify its high price in this market.

warhammer_item_runic-shadow-beacon-servi.name: Runic Shadow Beacon Service
warhammer_item_runic-shadow-beacon-servi.description: The Runic Shadow Beacon Service is a sleek obsidian device, its surface etched with glowing runes that pulse with malevolent energy. It radiates an aura of impenetrable darkness as it projects an illusory shadow duplicate of the wielder, capable of drawing fire and absorbing up to 50% of incoming damage for one turn. Nearby foes are momentarily disoriented by this spectral mimicry, offering a critical distraction in the heat of battle.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Duplication
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, the user creates an illusory duplicate that can engage enemies and draw attacks. The effect lasts for one turn.

effectDetails.title: Damage Absorption
effectDetails.rules: The shadow duplicates absorbs 50% of incoming damage from any source during its active duration. This effect does not stack with other similar abilities.

warhammer_item_runic-shadow-beacon-servi.levelRequirementReason: This service requires a high level to master the intricate runes and harness the darkness.
warhammer_item_runic-shadow-beacon-servi.vendorReason: Fate Forge specializes in crafting items that blur the line between reality and illusion, making this service a perfect fit for their catalog.
warhammer_item_runic-shadow-beacon-servi.shippingDetail: The item is delivered via dimensional rift, ensuring it arrives intact and ready to use.

usage.duration: One turn
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the user dismisses it or takes damage exceeding the absorbed amount.

warhammer_item_runic-shadow-beacon-servi.priceReason: The item's rarity and unique crafting process justify a price of 1000 XP.

warhammer_item_mk.49-corrupted-chronal-i.name: Mk.49 Corrupted Chronal Icon
warhammer_item_mk.49-corrupted-chronal-i.description: The Mk.49 Corrupted Chronal Icon is a fragmented violet artifact, its fractured temporal energies leaking like molten glass. When activated, it allows for a single rewind of time by precisely three seconds, but at the cost of amplifying chaos within a fifty-foot radius and drawing the attention of malevolent entities from beyond reality. The item's activation leaves behind an eerie hum that warns all nearby creatures of impending temporal disruption.

effectDetails.title: Rewinds Time
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Rewinds time by three seconds within a fifty-foot radius, affecting all creatures and objects in the area. The effect is instantaneous but can be dispelled on the same turn with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Anomaly
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that a minor temporal anomaly will manifest, causing random effects such as creating a gust of wind or shifting terrain. The anomaly lasts for one minute and can be ended by the icon's owner with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Arcana) check.

warhammer_item_mk.49-corrupted-chronal-i.levelRequirementReason: The item requires minimal magical power to activate, making it accessible to low-level characters.
warhammer_item_mk.49-corrupted-chronal-i.vendorReason: As a high-security armament supplier, the Imperial Armory deals in rare and powerful artifacts like the Mk.49 Corrupted Chronal Icon.
warhammer_item_mk.49-corrupted-chronal-i.shippingDetail: The item is shipped via Time-Stream Express, known for its impeccable timeliness, ensuring the artifact arrives precisely when ordered.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and rewind time.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; duration of temporal anomaly lasts one minute.
usage.endsWhen: Temporal anomaly ends on a successful check by the icon's owner or is dispelled as an immediate action.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but can only be activated once per long rest.

warhammer_item_mk.49-corrupted-chronal-i.priceReason: The item’s price reflects its rarity and utility without granting excessive power.

connectopia_item_hexagonal_chronometer_d.name: The Chronometric Hexa-Drinker
connectopia_item_hexagonal_chronometer_d.description: The Chronometric Hexa-Drinker is a hexagonal chronal device that hums with temporal energy. Crafted from solidified chronal fragments and polished basalt, it allows miners to accelerate or decelerate their mining speed. Its pulse can be felt as the surrounding time seems to warp around you, granting brief bursts of efficiency – but misuse risks altering the very fabric of space-time! When activated, it amplifies your pickaxe's swing with a surge of temporal force.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activating the Chronometric Hexa-Drinker allows you to increase your mining speed by 25% for a duration of 10 seconds. You can use this once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Chronal Echoes
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that each use generates a chronal echo, which provides you with an additional small resource boost. This effect cannot occur more than twice per day.

connectopia_item_hexagonal_chronometer_d.levelRequirementReason: Crafted for experienced miners who require efficiency without compromising safety.
connectopia_item_hexagonal_chronometer_d.vendorReason: As a premier supplier of mining tools, Craft Corner is known for offering the most reliable and advanced equipment to its clients.
connectopia_item_hexagonal_chronometer_d.shippingDetail: Ships within the week via Hovercraft Express; expedited shipping available for an additional fee.

usage.duration: 10 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or you use your action on another task
usage.charges: Once per short or long rest

connectopia_item_hexagonal_chronometer_d.priceReason: Balanced at this price point to reflect its unique temporal capabilities and limited daily stock.

connectopia_item_imperial_geode_pickaxe.name: The Imperial Geode-Striker
connectopia_item_imperial_geode_pickaxe.description: The Imperial Geode-Striker, forged from compressed imperial granite and inlaid with shimmering geodes, resonates with the planet's core, delivering immense power to shatter even the hardest rock formations. Its rhythmic vibration is a testament to ancient engineering, providing miners with a steady stream of earth energy that regenerates their stamina. However, prolonged use can induce unsettling geological visions, forcing users to pause and reorient themselves in the cavernous depths.
effects: Chance to discover rare mineral deposits

effectDetails.title: Significantly Increased Mining Speed
effectDetails.rules: When used, this pickaxe grants a bonus action that allows the user to mine as if they had an additional action. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be repeated once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Chance to Discover Rare Mineral Deposits
effectDetails.rules: Each time you use this pickaxe, there is a 25% chance that you will uncover a rare mineral deposit. If successful, the player gains a valuable ore or gemstone of your choice. This effect can be triggered up to three times per long rest.

connectopia_item_imperial_geode_pickaxe.levelRequirementReason: The Imperial Geode-Striker is designed for all miners and adventurers who seek efficiency in their endeavors.
connectopia_item_imperial_geode_pickaxe.vendorReason: Block Smith, the trusted vendor of mining equipment, stocks this pickaxe to cater to the needs of novice and seasoned miners alike.
connectopia_item_imperial_geode_pickaxe.shippingDetail: The Automated Drone Delivery Service ensures that this pickaxe is delivered swiftly from the depths of the forge to your doorstep within a week.

usage.duration: 1 minute, repeatable once per long rest
usage.endsWhen: After 1 minute or when used again in the same day

connectopia_item_imperial_geode_pickaxe.priceReason: The Imperial Geode-Striker's rare materials and advanced craftsmanship justify its moderate price.

connectopia_item_quantum_resonance_curio.name: The Resonant Echo-Stalker
connectopia_item_quantum_resonance_curio.description: The Resonant Echo-Stalker is a crystalline device, its layered quartz casing embedded with salvaged quantum relays that hum softly when in use. This enigmatic tool passively detects residual energy signatures within a 5-block radius, helping miners and explorers locate hidden veins of valuable minerals or forgotten tunnels. However, prolonged exposure to its unsettling resonance can cause auditory hallucinations and a creeping sense of existential dread, making it perilously effective for those who dare to wield it too long.

effectDetails.title: Passive Mineral Detection
effectDetails.rules: The Resonant Echo-Stalker passively reveals hidden mineral deposits within a 5-block radius. It provides a +1 bonus to Perception checks made with the Survival skill when searching for resources or hidden veins of ore.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Anomalies
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the Resonant Echo-Stalker has a 20% chance to trigger a temporal anomaly. On success, it provides +1d4 temporary hit points and a +1 bonus to all saving throws until the start of your next turn; on failure, you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or become confused for 1 minute.

connectopia_item_quantum_resonance_curio.levelRequirementReason: The Resonant Echo-Stalker is a powerful tool that requires basic proficiency to handle its quantum relays and quartz casing without mishap.
connectopia_item_quantum_resonance_curio.vendorReason: Pioneer Post, known for their expeditions and deep expertise in mining gear, carries the Resonant Echo-Stalker due to its utility for adventurers seeking hidden resources.
connectopia_item_quantum_resonance_curio.shippingDetail: The device is shipped via Express Courier Service with a tracking number provided upon shipment. Expedited delivery ensures adventurers can start their next project without delay.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, continuous while held or worn.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed if exposed to extreme temperatures above 100°C for more than 3 seconds.

connectopia_item_quantum_resonance_curio.priceReason: The Resonant Echo-Stalker is priced at 1000 XP as it combines advanced quantum technology with ancient quartz, offering a unique and powerful tool for exploration.

equestrian_item_crimson_echoes_of_elemen.name: Crimson Echoes of Elemental Lord Phlox
equestrian_item_crimson_echoes_of_elemen.description: The Crimson Echoes of Elemental Lord Phlox are pulsed with the raw, chaotic energy from Discord's laughter. Consuming one reveals fleeting glimpses into elemental forces and forgotten timelines, leaving behind whispers of ancient lore. These enchanted apples, plucked from trees that have been touched by the dread laughter, offer a brief respite from the mundane, granting +3 Dexterity for 60 seconds and a chance to confuse foes or reduce your own stats temporarily if consumed without caution.

effectDetails.title: Dexterity Boost
effectDetails.rules: Consume the apple as an action, granting you +3 Dexterity for 60 seconds. This effect ends when you finish a short rest or if you take any other action that requires your reaction.

effectDetails.title: Confusion Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance (DC 14) to confuse a single target within 30 feet on a successful hit with a melee weapon attack. The confused creature must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns, and it can repeat the save at the end of its turn if it takes no actions. On a success, the effect ends.

equestrian_item_crimson_echoes_of_elemen.levelRequirementReason: Only those with experience navigating elemental chaos are advised to consume these apples.
equestrian_item_crimson_echoes_of_elemen.vendorReason: Applejack and her market have adapted to offer rare, magical produce like the Crimson Echoes of Elemental Lord Phlox.
equestrian_item_crimson_echoes_of_elemen.shippingDetail: These apples are shipped with special care using enchanted bubbles that preserve their potency until consumption.

usage.duration: 60 seconds or ends on a short rest
usage.endsWhen: Short rest or reaction use

equestrian_item_crimson_echoes_of_elemen.priceReason: The rarity and magical properties of these apples justify their high price.

equestrian_item_chronal_apple_of_the_los.name: Chronal Apple of the Lost Lord Marlin
equestrian_item_chronal_apple_of_the_los.description: The Chronal Apple of the Lost Lord Marlin is a shimmering lavender fruit with a faint silver sheen, said to be an artifact left behind by ancient timekeepers. When consumed, it momentarily recalibrates your temporal perception, allowing you to reverse a single action. This apple originates from the mysterious ruins of Mount Silvanus and is sold exclusively by Canterlot Commerce, known for its access to rare relics. Beware, as overuse may warp your sense of time, causing moments to loop endlessly.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Rewind
effectDetails.rules: As a reaction, you can rewind the last action that you or an adjacent ally took. This effect lasts until your next turn and cannot be used again for 8 hours. The use of this apple risks time distortion, causing a minor visual anomaly in your surroundings.

effectDetails.title: +2 Temporal Resistance
effectDetails.rules: You gain +2 to all saving throws made against effects that manipulate or alter time. This bonus persists until you finish a long rest.

equestrian_item_chronal_apple_of_the_los.levelRequirementReason: The apple's temporal properties are accessible to any adventurer, though its misuse can be perilous.
equestrian_item_chronal_apple_of_the_los.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce specializes in rare and ancient artifacts, including relics from the timekeeping era.
equestrian_item_chronal_apple_of_the_los.shippingDetail: The apple is shipped under royal guard escort to ensure its safe arrival.

usage.duration: Until your next turn
usage.endsWhen: You use it again or finish a short rest

equestrian_item_chronal_apple_of_the_los.priceReason: The apple's rarity and the risk of time distortion justify its high price.

equestrian_item_sunstone_lord_valerian_e.name: Sunstone Lord Valerian Essence Apples
equestrian_item_sunstone_lord_valerian_e.description: These golden apples, plucked from the heart of a sunstone grove long abandoned by the light of the sun, radiate an intense warmth that seeps into your very essence. Each bite is not just nourishment but a call to resilience, pulsing with restorative energy and imbued with the ancient sorrow of the land itself. A single apple grants 80 hit points back over 60 seconds and bestows +5 fire resistance for an hour, providing a tangible link to the forgotten sunstone grove from which they came.

effectDetails.title: Restores Health
effectDetails.rules: Eating one apple restores 80 hit points over a period of 60 seconds. The effect is instantaneous upon consumption.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: +5 fire resistance for the next hour, granting immunity to minor fire damage until expended or negated by an opposing effect.

equestrian_item_sunstone_lord_valerian_e.levelRequirementReason: These apples are accessible to all adventurers as their restorative properties and fire resistance benefits do not demand a high level of expertise.
equestrian_item_sunstone_lord_valerian_e.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire has long maintained ties with the forgotten groves, ensuring that these apples are available for all who seek them.
equestrian_item_sunstone_lord_valerian_e.shippingDetail: Ships via a dedicated griffin courier, arriving within two days of order placement.

usage.duration: 60 seconds and for the next hour respectively
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or is negated by an opposing effect.

equestrian_item_sunstone_lord_valerian_e.priceReason: Balanced as these apples are a rare and valuable resource, offering both immediate health restoration and fire resistance, their price reflects the effort to retrieve them from the sunstone groves.

earth_land_item_chronometric_whisperer_s.name: The Chronometric Whisperer's Seeker
earth_land_item_chronometric_whisperer_s.description: The Chronometric Whisperer's Seeker is an intricately carved bone scroll, its surface etched with runes that shimmer in shifting patterns of time and space. This ancient artifact allows you to perceive fleeting glimpses into alternate timelines, offering a brief window where the threads of fate seem to unravel before your eyes. Holding it grants a subtle, ethereal glow that subtly distorts reality around you, providing an almost comical yet uncanny sense of impending outcomes—though the visions are often fragmented and confusing.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Perception
effectDetails.rules: Gain a +15% reaction bonus to your Initiative checks, allowing you to anticipate immediate danger. This effect lasts for the duration of one round and does not stack with other similar effects.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of Time
effectDetails.rules: You gain a faint, ethereal vision of the next 3 seconds, providing insight into potential outcomes. You can use this ability once per short or long rest. The visions are often fragmented and unreliable but can give you an edge in decision-making.

earth_land_item_chronometric_whisperer_s.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant magical attunement to navigate the temporal distortions without being overwhelmed.
earth_land_item_chronometric_whisperer_s.vendorReason: The magic shop specializes in ancient and rare artifacts, including those that can bend time itself.
earth_land_item_chronometric_whisperer_s.shippingDetail: Ships via swift wing courier for expedited delivery within a week.

usage.activation: Reaction to gain Temporal Perception or once per short/long rest for Echoes of Time.
usage.duration: Temporal Perception lasts one round, Echoes of Time lasts 3 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: Upon the end of your next turn or when you lose consciousness.
usage.charges: Once per short or long rest

earth_land_item_chronometric_whisperer_s.priceReason: Balanced at a price to reflect its limited daily stock and significant attunement requirements.

earth_land_item_lithic_resonance_curiosi.name: The Lithic Resonance Curator's Manifestation
earth_land_item_lithic_resonance_curiosi.description: The Lithic Resonance Curator's Manifestation is a crystalline orb, its facets shimmering with the ancient whispers of the earth’s crust. Gazing into it reveals vivid geological memories—ancient volcanic eruptions and shifting tectonic plates that once shaped this world. This artifact grants the wielder insights into the planet’s past, enhancing their perception checks related to stone and earth by +2d4, and provides a minor protection against seismic disturbances for 10 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Geological Awareness
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action. Grants the wielder advantage on perception checks related to stone and earth until the start of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Seismic Shield
effectDetails.rules: Active for 10 minutes upon activation, provides a +2 bonus to AC against any damage from tremors or earthquakes. Ends if the Curator is knocked unconscious or if it takes a short rest.

earth_land_item_lithic_resonance_curiosi.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 4th level to properly harness its ancient power and resist geological forces.
earth_land_item_lithic_resonance_curiosi.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in artifacts connected to the natural world, making this relic a perfect fit for their collection.
earth_land_item_lithic_resonance_curiosi.shippingDetail: Ships via ground sled within one week of purchase; delivery may be delayed by bad weather conditions.

usage.duration: 10 minutes per day, up to three uses per long rest
usage.endsWhen: Knocked unconscious or the Curator takes a short rest
usage.charges: 3 charges, recharged after a long rest

earth_land_item_lithic_resonance_curiosi.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its mythic rarity and limited utility within adventuring parties.

earth_land_item_divine_harmonic_seeker.name: The Divine Harmonic Seeker's Anthem
earth_land_item_divine_harmonic_seeker.description: The Divine Harmonic Seeker's Anthem, crafted from silver and etched with runes of celestial alignment, hums a melody that resonates within the very fabric of magic. This ancient flute can be played to summon a protective barrier of harmonic frequencies capable of deflecting spells, and it also inspires its wielder with a surge of courage, bolstering their resolve against fear. With each note, the instrument's aura pulses with minor healing, restoring vitality to those who hold it during times of peril.

effectDetails.title: Harmonic Deflection
effectDetails.rules: When the Divine Harmonic Seeker's Anthem is played, a protective barrier of harmonic frequencies activates as a reaction to a hostile spell or magical attack. This barrier has a range of 10 feet and provides a +2 bonus to AC against one such attack per use. The effect lasts for 1 round after activation.

effectDetails.title: Courageous Resolve
effectDetails.rules: Upon playing the flute, the player gains advantage on saving throws against fear effects and increases their Charisma modifier by 2 until the end of their next short or long rest. This effect can only be used once per day.

earth_land_item_divine_harmonic_seeker.levelRequirementReason: The intricate runes and magical properties require a player of at least 15th level to properly wield and understand the flute's power.
earth_land_item_divine_harmonic_seeker.vendorReason: The Guild Quartermaster sells this item as part of their extensive collection of rare and powerful artifacts, including those used by high-level adventurers.
earth_land_item_divine_harmonic_seeker.shippingDetail: The Divine Harmonic Seeker's Anthem is carefully packed in a custom wooden case to ensure safe delivery. Shipping may take up to three days due to its fragile nature.

usage.activation: Play the flute as a bonus action.
usage.duration: 1 round after activation.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the player takes another action or reaction, or if the barrier is dispelled by magic.

earth_land_item_divine_harmonic_seeker.priceReason: The intricate magical properties and craftsmanship justify a high price of 1000 XP, reflecting its status as an uncommon and powerful artifact.

middle_earth_item_the_silvan_rune_of_whi.name: The Silvan Rune of Whispering Winds
middle_earth_item_the_silvan_rune_of_whi.description: The Silvan Rune of Whispering Winds, a delicate rune forged from the heartwood of Lothlórien’s ancient trees, pulses with a spectral green light that hints at elven magic and the forest's ancient whispers. When invoked, it calls forth a gust of wind that extinguishes nearby flames in an instant while scattering foes across the battlefield. Its power is drawn from the very essence of the forest, making it both a weapon and a tool for survival.

effectDetails.title: Wind Gust
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate the rune to create a gust of wind that pushes creatures within 10 feet. Creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the center of the effect and fall prone.

effectDetails.title: Fire Extinguisher
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the rune can extinguish small flames within its range. It has a 75% chance of extinguishing any fire in its vicinity without further action.

middle_earth_item_the_silvan_rune_of_whi.levelRequirementReason: The rune requires significant magical knowledge and resilience to wield.
middle_earth_item_the_silvan_rune_of_whi.vendorReason: Only the elves who protect Lothlórien possess the arcane wisdom needed to sell such a powerful artifact.
middle_earth_item_the_silvan_rune_of_whi.shippingDetail: The rune is carefully delivered by messengers of Galadriel, ensuring its safe arrival and proper handling.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Wind Gust) / Instantaneous (Fire Extinguisher)
usage.endsWhen: Charges are exhausted or the wielder is incapacitated
usage.charges: 5 charges, recharged after a long rest

middle_earth_item_the_silvan_rune_of_whi.priceReason: The rune's rarity and magical complexity justify its high price.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_maker_of_stone.name: Dwarven Maker's Runes of Stone Echoes
middle_earth_item_dwarven_maker_of_stone.description: Crafted in the shadowy depths of Moria, these runes are forged from ancient dwarven stone and bear the echoes of bygone craftsmanship. When activated, they release a resonant pulse that shakes the very foundations of nearby structures, stunning foes within earshot for several moments. These runes also possess an uncanny ability to reveal hidden passageways in solid rock, offering invaluable insight to those who seek them out in the dark.

effectDetails.title: Sonic Stunner
effectDetails.rules: When activated, these runes emit a concussive pulse that stuns all creatures within a 10-foot radius for 3 seconds. The effect has no save DC and does not expend charges.

effectDetails.title: Stone Revelation
effectDetails.rules: These runes can be used to reveal hidden passageways in stone, affecting an area up to 20 feet wide. This effect is instantaneous and requires the user to spend at least one minute examining the immediate surroundings.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_maker_of_stone.levelRequirementReason: The item's activation requires a mere level 1 character due to its utility in revealing hidden passageways.
middle_earth_item_dwarven_maker_of_stone.vendorReason: Dwarven craftsmen are the only ones who can forge such runes, making them exclusive to their forges.
middle_earth_item_dwarven_maker_of_stone.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Stone Cart, these delicate runes must be handled with care and arrive in pristine condition.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate the runes' effect.
usage.duration: The sonic stunner's effect lasts for 3 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or if a creature within the radius of the pulse moves out of range.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_maker_of_stone.priceReason: Crafted from ancient dwarven stone, these runes are rare and highly sought after for their unique abilities in exploration and combat.

middle_earth_item_shire_maker_of_forgott.name: Shire Maker’s Runes of Forgotten Songs
middle_earth_item_shire_maker_of_forgott.description: The Shire Maker’s Runes of Forgotten Songs are intricately carved into a small, worn music box recovered from an abandoned hobbit hole in the Green Hills. When activated, these runes emit a melodic hum that can either soothe nearby creatures with their ancient, tranquil notes or briefly disorient foes with echoes of forgotten harmony. The instrument’s origin is shrouded in lore, once belonging to a legendary minstrel who wandered the Shire centuries ago.

effectDetails.title: Tranquil Melody
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the runes emit a calming melody that restores 5 points of sanity to all creatures within 10 feet. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until dispelled by magic.

effectDetails.title: Harmonic Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: The runes can also be used as an action to emit a discordant tune, causing confusion in up to three targets within 20 feet. These creatures are incapacitated and cannot take actions for 2 seconds. The save DC is 14.

middle_earth_item_shire_maker_of_forgott.levelRequirementReason: The runes are accessible to all adventurers as a reminder of the Shire’s peaceful charm.
middle_earth_item_shire_maker_of_forgott.vendorReason: The Shire Shop offers a variety of relics and trinkets from the region, including these Runes of Forgotten Songs.
middle_earth_item_shire_maker_of_forgott.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Rolling Cart, which traverses the Shire’s winding roads to ensure timely delivery.

usage.activation: Activate as an action or bonus action.
usage.duration: Tranquil Melody lasts for 1 minute; Harmonic Disorientation lasts for 2 seconds.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if a creature moves out of range, dispelled by magic, or the user acts again.

middle_earth_item_shire_maker_of_forgott.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as a rare item with versatile and thematic effects that can be useful in various party roles.

teyvat_item_chronometric_resonance_seeke.name: The Chronometric Resonance Seeker's Oculi
teyvat_item_chronometric_resonance_seeke.description: The Chronometric Resonance Seeker's Oculi are obsidian lenses imbued with the temporal essence of the Archons, their rhythmic pulses echoing through the fabric of time.
