almost_edge_item_phantom_striker_7.name: The Peripheral Striker's Fragment of the Unwritten Rim
almost_edge_item_phantom_striker_7.description: The Peripheral Striker's Fragment of the Unwritten Rim is a obsidian shard that hums with an eerie, almost sentient energy. Its jagged edges emit faint, shifting patterns that hint at dimensions beyond our own. Holding it can cause disorienting visions and whispers of alternate realities, a chilling reminder of the cosmos' edge. This fragment grants fleeting auditory hallucinations during extended use and allows for brief moments of phase-like movement through solid objects.

effectDetails.title: Phased Movement
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the user can move through solid objects for up to 5 feet. This effect lasts for 10 seconds and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Echoes
effectDetails.rules: While holding this fragment, the user hears echoes of forgotten timelines as a constant auditory hallucination. There is no saving throw against these sounds; they cease upon ceasing to hold the item or when the user completes a short rest.

almost_edge_item_phantom_striker_7.levelRequirementReason: This fragment's effects are subtle and beneficial, suitable for any capable adventurer.
almost_edge_item_phantom_striker_7.vendorReason: The void merchant is known for dealing in rare cosmic artifacts and this fragment fits the pattern of such items.
almost_edge_item_phantom_striker_7.shippingDetail: Ships via interdimensional courier, with a transit time of one week.

usage.activation: Bonus action to phase through solid objects; passive effect while holding for auditory hallucinations.
usage.duration: 10 seconds per use and constant while held.
usage.endsWhen: Upon ceasing to hold the fragment or completion of a short rest.

almost_edge_item_phantom_striker_7.priceReason: The item's effects are balanced, providing useful but not overpowered abilities for a fair cost in XP.

almost_edge_item_mk_69_peripheral_fragme.name: Mk.69 Peripheral Fragments of the Static Zone
almost_edge_item_mk_69_peripheral_fragme.description: The Mk.69 Peripheral Fragments of the Static Zone are a collection of fractured, iridescent plates that shimmer with an otherworldly glow. These fragments radiate a field of silent static that warps reality around them, causing unsettling echoes in the mind and an inexplicable feeling of being watched by something just out of sight. Each fragment seems to hum with ancient power, whispering secrets only those attuned to the psychic realm can hear.

effectDetails.title: Distorts Reality
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to saving throws against illusions and psychic effects, as well as advantage on Perception checks. This effect lasts for 30 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Echoes
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the wearer can activate the fragments to emit a wave of psychic energy that causes creatures within 10 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be stunned for 1 minute. If a creature fails its save, it must also succeed on another Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns or fall unconscious until it succeeds.

almost_edge_item_mk_69_peripheral_fragme.levelRequirementReason: The fragments are potent but not overwhelming, suitable for adventurers who have already proven their worth.
almost_edge_item_mk_69_peripheral_fragme.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader has a reputation for dealing in the forgotten and the strange, making these fragments an apt addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_item_mk_69_peripheral_fragme.shippingDetail: Ships via Temporal Packet, arriving within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: 30 minutes or until the wearer is incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer is incapacitated or after 30 minutes.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one activation per short rest.

almost_edge_item_mk_69_peripheral_fragme.priceReason: The fragments are priced at 1000 XP to reflect their balance between utility and risk, making them a valuable yet cautious choice for any adventurer.

almost_edge_item_mythic_boundary_resonat.name: The Mythic Boundary Resonator of Perpetual Fall
almost_edge_item_mythic_boundary_resonat.description: The Mythic Boundary Resonator of Perpetual Fall is a colossal, pulsating gemstone encased in a matrix of obsidian and iron filings. Its constant hum resonates with the raw energy of space itself, creating an eerie glow that seems to pull at your very soul. When activated, it opens a fleeting window into realms beyond, granting brief access to dimensions where time ceases to exist. However, prolonged exposure can induce terrifying visions and a feeling of inescapable descent—tangible reminders of the unending fall beyond the edge.

effectDetails.title: Spatial Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, allowing the user to briefly manipulate spatial dimensions within a small radius (5 feet). This effect lasts for 1 minute. The duration can be extended by 10 minutes with an hour-long rest. A DC 20 Wisdom saving throw is required to resist this effect; failure results in the user being disoriented and unable to move normally for 1d4 rounds.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: After continuous use, the user must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are incapacitated by debilitating nausea and disorientation for 1 hour. This effect can be mitigated with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

almost_edge_item_mythic_boundary_resonat.levelRequirementReason: The item's complex spatial effects necessitate a minimum level to ensure the user has the necessary control and mental fortitude.
almost_edge_item_mythic_boundary_resonat.vendorReason: The Edge Wanderer, being an explorer of the realms beyond, offers this unique artifact for those brave enough to venture into unknown dimensions.
almost_edge_item_mythic_boundary_resonat.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Ship, which can deliver items directly from interdimensional realms. Delivery time varies based on the user's destination within the plane of existence.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, once per day.
usage.duration: 1 minute duration with a 10-minute extension via an hour-long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user is incapacitated by disorientation or nausea from its effects.

almost_edge_item_mythic_boundary_resonat.priceReason: The Mythic Boundary Resonator's rarity and unique spatial manipulation effects justify this balanced XP price.

warhammer_item_bloodstained_banner_of_sh.name: Bloodstained Banner of Shattered Promises
warhammer_item_bloodstained_banner_of_sh.description: The Bloodstained Banner of Shattered Promises, a tattered relic woven from the threads of countless unfulfilled oaths and stained crimson by the blood of broken promises, whispers darkly when unfurled. It saps foes' resolve, causing them to falter in combat for mere moments before their will returns. With each wave of doubt cast upon them, the banner's weave seems to absorb a fragment of their soul, leaving them shaken and uncertain.

effectDetails.title: Sap Resolve
effectDetails.rules: When the banner is unfurled as an action, it briefly saps the morale of nearby foes. Enemies within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become shaken (-2 penalty to attack and damage rolls for 3 turns). This effect has no save after the first use.

effectDetails.title: Cast Doubt
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, when an enemy fails their saving throw against Sap Resolve, you can attempt to cast the ‘Doubt’ status on them. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be affected by the ‘Doubt’ condition (disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks for 1 hour). This effect has no save.

warhammer_item_bloodstained_banner_of_sh.levelRequirementReason: This artifact requires significant magical power, thus a character of at least level 12 can wield it effectively.
warhammer_item_bloodstained_banner_of_sh.vendorReason: The banner's dark history and enchantment align with the imperial armory's stock of powerful relics and artifacts.
warhammer_item_bloodstained_banner_of_sh.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by aerial drone, this artifact is shipped under strict secrecy to preserve its aura.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until the start of your next turn for each target
usage.endsWhen: The banner's effects end when you use it again or when it is destroyed by magic
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one target can be affected per short rest

warhammer_item_bloodstained_banner_of_sh.priceReason: This rare artifact requires significant magical energy and craftsmanship to maintain its power.

warhammer_item_nether_maker’s_resonating.name: Nether Maker's Resonating Shard
warhammer_item_nether_maker’s_resonating.description: Forged within the deepest, most corrupted veins of the Nether Realm, this shard pulses with a discordant energy that warps reality around you. When activated, it grants fleeting glimpses into past tragedies and allows you to amplify your psychic attacks by 30%. The resonance of this relic can be felt for moments, but its power is fleeting—each use reveals a fragment of the past before it fades back into darkness.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this shard grants a +30 bonus to psychic damage. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse into the Past
effectDetails.rules: Activating the shard allows you to briefly perceive echoes of past tragedies within a 30-foot radius, providing insight but also leaving you shaken. You must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be stunned for 1 round upon using this effect.

warhammer_item_nether_maker’s_resonating.levelRequirementReason: Only the most experienced warriors and mages can harness the raw power of the Nether Realm without succumbing to its corruption.
warhammer_item_nether_maker’s_resonating.vendorReason: The chaos dealer has exclusive access to rare relics from other dimensions, including this shard.
warhammer_item_nether_maker’s_resonating.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional portal, ensuring safe and swift delivery of such volatile artifacts.

usage.duration: Instantaneous with a duration until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of your next turn or if you take any action other than moving 5 feet. You can use this shard once per short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per rest

warhammer_item_nether_maker’s_resonating.priceReason: The price reflects the rarity and unpredictable nature of the shard's power.

warhammer_item_mk.17_purified_banners_of.name: Mk.17 Purified Banners of Desolation
warhammer_item_mk.17_purified_banners_of.description: The Mk.17 Purified Banners of Desolation are forged from purified obsidian and bound despair, relics of a bygone era when entropy reigned supreme. When raised in defiance, these banners unleash a wave of localized entropy that ripples through the battlefield, dealing unrelenting damage to foes within its reach. The aura of desolation also imbues nearby enemies with a creeping malaise, reducing their armor and slowing their movements, turning victory into a futile struggle.

effectDetails.title: Localized Entropy
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the banners unleash a wave of localized entropy that deals 20 necrotic damage per turn to all enemies within a 5-meter radius. The effect lasts for 1 minute and can be ended early by the wielder or if an enemy enters or leaves the area.

effectDetails.title: Armor Reduction
effectDetails.rules: The banners' despair imbues nearby foes with a malaise, reducing their armor class by 30% until the start of their next turn. This effect has a maximum duration of 5 turns and can be negated with a successful DC 18 Dexterity saving throw.

warhammer_item_mk.17_purified_banners_of.levelRequirementReason: The intricate forging process and the raw power contained within these banners necessitate a high-level character to wield them effectively.
warhammer_item_mk.17_purified_banners_of.vendorReason: Only the most trusted forgers at Fate-Forge possess the knowledge and skill to handle such dangerous relics.
warhammer_item_mk.17_purified_banners_of.shippingDetail: Ships via the Temporal Relay, ensuring swift delivery but with a slight risk of temporal distortion affecting the item's age.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until ended
usage.endsWhen: Wielder ends it early or an enemy enters/leaves the area

warhammer_item_mk.17_purified_banners_of.priceReason: The banners' rarity and the complex forging process contribute to their high price.

teyvat_item_infernal_ward_of_reverie.name: The Crimson Echoes of the Infernal Ward
teyvat_item_infernal_ward_of_reverie.description: The Crimson Echoes of the Infernal Ward is an ornate gauntlet forged deep within a dormant volcano, where the earth's molten core still whispers in secret. Its infernal heat pulses with a fiery essence that amplifies your elemental attacks, channeling the rage of ancient pyrokinetic warriors. Activated by a single command word, it grants you resistance to pyro damage and a chance to inflict burning on each successful hit, turning every clash into an echoing testament of past battles.

effectDetails.title: Pyro Amplification
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this gauntlet amplifies your next elemental attack by +30% damage. The effect lasts for one minute and can be reactivated once the duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Pyro Damage
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this gauntlet, you gain resistance to pyro damage. This effect persists until you remove the gauntlet or enter a state of vulnerability.

teyvat_item_infernal_ward_of_reverie.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet's power is too potent for those lacking experience, requiring a level 35 character to wield its infernal might.
teyvat_item_infernal_ward_of_reverie.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor has established trade routes that venture deep into the volcanic regions where this gauntlet was forged; they are privy to such unique artifacts.
teyvat_item_infernal_ward_of_reverie.shippingDetail: Ships via the Sea Serpent Express, known for its reliable couriers and swift delivery from the volcanic heartlands.

usage.duration: One minute or until you remove it or enter a state of vulnerability
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or you lose concentration (as if concentrating on an effect)
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

teyvat_item_infernal_ward_of_reverie.priceReason: The gauntlet's unique crafting and the volcanic materials used in its forge justify this price.

teyvat_item_geo_ward_of_stability.name: The Lithic Sentinel's Stabilizing Ward
teyvat_item_geo_ward_of_stability.description: The Lithic Sentinel's Stabilizing Ward is a solidified earth talisman, forged deep within ancient geo-caverns and imbued with the essence of stoneborn stability. This wearable ward not only enhances your armor’s resistance to physical attacks but also creates a localized zone around you, negating movement impairments for foes within its radius. Crafted by the hands of master stonemasons in Mondstadt, this item is a testament to earth's enduring strength and resilience.

effectDetails.title: Geo Resistance Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases your geo resistance by +25% for 1 minute, with the duration increasing by one minute on each successful saving throw made against physical damage.

effectDetails.title: Stun Immunity
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. Grants immunity to all stun effects within a 10-foot radius centered on you. This effect does not end until either you leave the area or an enemy successfully hits with a melee attack from outside this radius.

teyvat_item_geo_ward_of_stability.levelRequirementReason: Crafted by master stonemasons, this item requires significant experience and skill to wield effectively.
teyvat_item_geo_ward_of_stability.vendorReason: The market in Mondstadt is renowned for its collection of rare and powerful items crafted by local artisans.
teyvat_item_geo_ward_of_stability.shippingDetail: Ships via the swift Griffon Courier, known for its reliable and swift delivery services.

usage.duration: 1 minute per successful saving throw made against physical damage.
usage.endsWhen: Either you leave the area or an enemy successfully hits with a melee attack from outside this radius.

teyvat_item_geo_ward_of_stability.priceReason: Crafted by master stonemasons, the Lithic Sentinel's Stabilizing Ward is priced at 7500 XP to reflect its craftsmanship and utility in both defensive and tactical combat scenarios.

teyvat_item_premium_vision_ward_of_lumin.name: The Lumina Weaver’s Radiant Ward
teyvat_item_premium_vision_ward_of_lumin.description: The Lumina Weaver’s Radiant Ward is a shimmering, opalescent fragment harvested from the ruins of a long-lost vision. Crafted by the hands of an ancient Lumina Weaver, it glows with a soft light that enhances your senses and restores life. This ward passively regenerates stamina at an accelerated rate, healing 5% of your maximum stamina per minute, and grants you an increased awareness of hidden dangers in the world around you.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: Passively regenerates stamina at a rate of 5% per minute. This effect ends if the wearer is incapacitated or if they take damage from an attack.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: Grants +2 to Passive Perception checks and increases your ability to perceive hidden dangers within the environment, providing a +3 bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to detecting secret doors and stealthy creatures. This effect ends if you fall unconscious.

teyvat_item_premium_vision_ward_of_lumin.levelRequirementReason: The Lumina Weaver’s Radiant Ward requires no level, as it is designed for all adventurers who seek to enhance their awareness of the world.
teyvat_item_premium_vision_ward_of_lumin.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare and exotic items from across Teyvat, including this ancient artifact.
teyvat_item_premium_vision_ward_of_lumin.shippingDetail: The item is shipped via a Dragon Express, ensuring it arrives swiftly and intact.

usage.duration: Lasts until the wearer falls unconscious or takes damage from an attack
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or taking damage from an attack

teyvat_item_premium_vision_ward_of_lumin.priceReason: The Lumina Weaver’s Radiant Ward is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rarity and the ancient magic imbued within it.

grand_country_item_the_brutal_binder_of_.name: The Brutal Binder of Layered Regret
grand_country_item_the_brutal_binder_of_.description: The Brutal Binder of Layered Regret is a dark obsidian band, its surface etched with swirling, oily glyphs that seem to weep in thick, shadowy rivulets. When worn, it momentarily unravels the very fabric of your past decisions, forcing you to relive fleeting moments where you chose glazed over plain, or opted for sprinkles instead of chocolate chips. The weight of these memories is palpable, causing a brief yet intense disorientation that clouds your immediate judgment and vision.

effectDetails.title: Momentary Disruption
effectDetails.rules: Activating the binder causes you to experience a brief, 10-second disorientation. During this time, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks that require precision or accuracy. The effect ends when it is used up.

effectDetails.title: Critical Fortitude
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of your next turn after using the binder, any critical hit against you has advantage on the damage roll. This effect cannot be gained more than once per long rest.

grand_country_item_the_brutal_binder_of_.levelRequirementReason: The item's complexity and the risk it poses to balance necessitate a minimum level of 12.
grand_country_item_the_brutal_binder_of_.vendorReason: Side Seller, always an eccentric vendor, specializes in items that blur the line between past, present, and future, making The Brutal Binder of Layered Regret a fitting addition to their wares.
grand_country_item_the_brutal_binder_of_.shippingDetail: The gravitic drone delivers this fragile artifact with utmost care, ensuring it arrives in pristine condition without the use of any magical means that could corrupt its effects.

usage.duration: 10 seconds, followed by a critical hit advantage on your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or you take damage

grand_country_item_the_brutal_binder_of_.priceReason: This item's unique combination of disorienting and defensive benefits justifies its high XP cost.

grand_country_item_the_tiered_platform_o.name: The Tiered Platform of Vertical Echoes
grand_country_item_the_tiered_platform_o.description: The Tiered Platform of Vertical Echoes stands tall, a grotesquely tiered edifice crafted from solidified sugar and the very essence of haunted silence. Each step triggers a cacophony of whispers—fractured voices of those lost within The Side of the Doughnut, their lamentations amplified with each ascent. The platform shimmers faintly under moonlight, its surface crackling like brittle ice as it echoes cryptic clues that occasionally find their way into your mind.

effectDetails.title: Echoes Whispers
effectDetails.rules: Upon stepping on the platform, you hear the fractured voices of those lost within The Side of the Doughnut. These whispers occasionally provide cryptic clues (50% chance). You can ignore one noise or distraction per round as a reaction.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Shield
effectDetails.rules: For every three steps taken on the platform, you gain a temporary shield that absorbs 30% of incoming damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and recharges after completing a short rest.

grand_country_item_the_tiered_platform_o.levelRequirementReason: The fragile nature of the platform requires a minimum level to ensure it does not crumble under the weight.
grand_country_item_the_tiered_platform_o.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor has a unique stock of items from The Side of the Doughnut, making them the only source for this eerie yet intriguing artifact.
grand_country_item_the_tiered_platform_o.shippingDetail: Ships via gravity sleds, ensuring safe delivery by nightfall.

usage.endsWhen: You finish a short rest or leave the area.

grand_country_item_the_tiered_platform_o.priceReason: The delicate nature and unique crafting materials of this platform justify its price.

grand_country_item_the_mk_91_layer_stabi.name: The Mk.91 Layer Stabilizer of Persistent Sweetness
grand_country_item_the_mk_91_layer_stabi.description: The Mk.91 Layer Stabilizer of Persistent Sweetness is a segmented metal platform, salvaged from an ancient engineering project. Its surface gleams with a faint sugary sheen, and it hums softly as it stabilizes the chaotic layers within The Side of the Doughnut. Prolonged use leads to a sweet obsession, making the user increasingly fond of pastries and frosting, while also subtly enhancing their resistance to poison and rot effects.

effectDetails.title: Persistent Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect. The user regenerates 1 hit point per second, but this effect ends if the user is reduced to 0 hit points or if they consume a meal containing more than 500 calories.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on saving throws against poison and rot effects. This benefit lasts for 1 hour after consuming the item, but it is reduced to disadvantage if the user's affection for pastries increases by more than 50%.

grand_country_item_the_mk_91_layer_stabi.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires a high level of skill and control to manage its effects without succumbing to its sweet obsessions.
grand_country_item_the_mk_91_layer_stabi.vendorReason: The Layer Market specializes in relics and items from forgotten engineering projects, making it the ideal vendor for this unique artifact.
grand_country_item_the_mk_91_layer_stabi.shippingDetail: Ships via Dimensional Relay with a one-week transit time due to its delicate nature.

usage.activation: Passive effect. No activation required; it continuously provides its benefits as long as the user wears or holds the item.
usage.duration: Permanent, until consumed or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Reduces to 0 hit points or consuming a meal with over 500 calories; destroys on destruction of the user's affection for pastries by more than 50%

grand_country_item_the_mk_91_layer_stabi.priceReason: The item’s legendary rarity and unique effects, combined with the risk of sweet obsession, justify its moderate price in experience points.

pokemon_item_the_echoing_marks_of_silver.name: The Echoing Marks of Silverleaf
pokemon_item_the_echoing_marks_of_silver.description: The Echoing Marks of Silverleaf are crystalline, opalescent patterns that shimmer faintly on a Trainer's skin, capturing the essence of legendary Pokémon battles within the hallowed grounds of Silverleaf Grove. These marks amplify one's bond with Pokémon, granting an increase in accuracy and speed during battle, while their whispers offer strategic insights that can turn the tide of any encounter. The echoes resonate with ancient wisdom, guiding the wearer to make precise moves and swift decisions.

effectDetails.title: Increased Accuracy
effectDetails.rules: The Echoing Marks enhance a Trainer's accuracy by +10%. This effect is passive while worn, but the wearer must maintain at least one Pokémon in their party for it to function. The marks do not wear off unless removed.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Speed
effectDetails.rules: The Echoing Marks increase a Trainer's speed by +5%. This boost applies during battle and remains active until the end of each combat round. It is reset at the start of the next combat encounter.

pokemon_item_the_echoing_marks_of_silver.levelRequirementReason: Trainers must have reached at least level 15 to fully harness the power of the Echoing Marks, as they require a deep understanding of Pokémon and battle strategy.
pokemon_item_the_echoing_marks_of_silver.vendorReason: The Pokemart stocks these marks because it caters exclusively to experienced Trainers who seek to enhance their skills in preparation for more challenging battles.
pokemon_item_the_echoing_marks_of_silver.shippingDetail: Ships via Drone Delivery, ensuring the Echoing Marks arrive swiftly and intact.

usage.duration: Instantaneous boost active per round, resets at start of next encounter
usage.endsWhen: Removed or battle ends

pokemon_item_the_echoing_marks_of_silver.priceReason: The Echoing Marks are priced at 1000 XP to reflect their rarity and the profound benefit they provide, making them a valuable investment for dedicated Trainers.

pokemon_item_eldritch_borns_scroll_of_te.name: Eldritch Born's Scroll of Temporal Drift
pokemon_item_eldritch_borns_scroll_of_te.description: The Eldritch Born's Scroll of Temporal Drift is a weathered scroll bound in obsidian, with shifting glyphs that seem to pulse and rearrange themselves. Crafted by a reclusive Chrono-Trainer who sought to disrupt the flow of battles, it grants one additional action during your turn when activated – but beware, its effects are unpredictable and could target allies or enemies at random. Upon activation, there's a chance for a temporal rewind that affects all creatures within 5 feet, causing them to act on their previous turns.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Surge
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the user gains one additional action during their turn. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn and can be interrupted by any attack or spell cast on them.

effectDetails.title: Random Target
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that the scroll's effects target a random creature within 5 feet, including allies. This target must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 13) to avoid being affected by the temporal rewind.

pokemon_item_eldritch_borns_scroll_of_te.levelRequirementReason: Even low-level characters can use this scroll to gain an edge in unpredictable combat situations.
pokemon_item_eldritch_borns_scroll_of_te.vendorReason: The Safari Shop often carries unique and unusual items, including those with unconventional uses such as the Eldritch Born's Scroll of Temporal Drift.
pokemon_item_eldritch_borns_scroll_of_te.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a Winged Courier, but requires a special delivery permit from the local Chronomancer Guild.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Interrupted by an attack or spell cast on you

pokemon_item_eldritch_borns_scroll_of_te.priceReason: The scroll's unpredictable nature and potential for disrupting combat make it valuable, though not overly powerful.

pokemon_item_mega_marks_of_the_stone_sen.name: Mega Marks of the Stone Sentinels
pokemon_item_mega_marks_of_the_stone_sen.description: Forged within the heart of a dormant volcano, the Mega Marks of the Stone Sentinels exude a primal energy that resonates with ancient stone Pokémon. These colossal marks create an impenetrable barrier around their wearer, bolstering their defenses by 25% and granting resistance to fire and earth attacks. When struck by such elements, there's a chance for elemental energy to reflect back at the attacker, dealing equal damage in retaliation.

effectDetails.title: Stone Resilience
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +25% bonus to AC and resistance to fire and earth elemental attacks. This effect is passive.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Reflection
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer takes damage from a fire or earth attack, there's a 30% chance that half of the taken damage will be reflected back at the attacker as an equal amount of damage (rounded down). This effect has no save DC and can occur once per short rest.

pokemon_item_mega_marks_of_the_stone_sen.levelRequirementReason: The marks are designed for novice trainers to protect themselves from elemental hazards.
pokemon_item_mega_marks_of_the_stone_sen.vendorReason: As a vendor specializing in rare and powerful equipment, the league store ensures that even beginners have access to legendary protection.
pokemon_item_mega_marks_of_the_stone_sen.shippingDetail: Ships via Magma Transport's express service, delivered within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the marks.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until removed or until a new short rest is completed.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes the marks or completes a short rest.

pokemon_item_mega_marks_of_the_stone_sen.priceReason: Balanced for its legendary status and powerful elemental protection, this item provides significant utility at an affordable price.

internet_item_the_glitched_oracle_bearer.name: The Glitched Oracle Bearer
internet_item_the_glitched_oracle_bearer.description: The Glitched Oracle Bearer shimmers with corrupted code, its iridescent surface pulsing with fragmented data. Holding it grants fleeting glimpses into fractured timelines—whispers of forgotten websites and phantom search queries. This relic might reveal valuable data or disastrous outcomes, but beware: the very act of using it can trigger a random hallucination, positive or negative, that distorts your perception for minutes to come. Rumored to have been crafted by rogue hackers in dark cyberpunk alleys, this item is both a boon and a curse.

effectDetails.title: Data Analysis Bonus
effectDetails.rules: Gain +5 to Data Analysis skill for 60 seconds. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Hallucination Trigger
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance that the item will trigger a random hallucination (positive or negative) each time it is activated. The duration of the hallucination varies between 1d4 minutes. A successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw ends this effect early.

internet_item_the_glitched_oracle_bearer.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum character level to handle its corrupting influence and avoid potential mental instability.
internet_item_the_glitched_oracle_bearer.vendorReason: The pixel_shop is known for its eclectic collection of tech-themed curiosities, making it the perfect vendor for this glitched oracle bearer.
internet_item_the_glitched_oracle_bearer.shippingDetail: Shipped via Drone Delivery with a 1-hour delivery window in major cities.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect, but ongoing hallucination lasts until the end of your next turn if not ended early by a successful saving throw.
usage.endsWhen: The hallucination ends on a successful DC 15 Wisdom save or at the start of your next turn after being triggered.

internet_item_the_glitched_oracle_bearer.priceReason: The item's rarity, limited availability, and unique effects justify its price in XP.

internet_item_the_encrypted_echoes_of_si.name: The Encrypted Echoes of Silicon
internet_item_the_encrypted_echoes_of_si.description: The Encrypted Echoes of Silicon hums with a digital life, its encrypted data packets resonating with the ghostly echoes of forgotten forums and abandoned chat rooms from bygone eras. By analyzing these whispers, you can unlock advanced coding techniques and forgotten algorithms that have long been overshadowed by newer trends. This relic grants immunity to data corruption effects and provides a constant stream of outdated meme notifications, keeping you ever aware of the humor and patterns of yesteryear's internet culture.

effectDetails.title: Data Corruption Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The Encrypted Echoes of Silicon grants immunity to data corruption effects. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after using this item or when you take a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Outdated Meme Notifications
effectDetails.rules: You receive a constant stream of outdated meme notifications, which can be toggled on and off as a bonus action. This effect does not require concentration and lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.

internet_item_the_encrypted_echoes_of_si.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners to help them understand the foundational concepts of internet culture and coding.
internet_item_the_encrypted_echoes_of_si.vendorReason: The cyber market specializes in relics and artifacts that bridge past and present, making it a fitting vendor for The Encrypted Echoes of Silicon.
internet_item_the_encrypted_echoes_of_si.shippingDetail: Ships via Quantum Courier's high-speed data streams, ensuring the item is delivered with all its encoded information intact.

usage.activation: Toggled on and off as a bonus action.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next short or long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a long rest, at the start of your next short rest, or when toggled off.

internet_item_the_encrypted_echoes_of_si.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and utility in understanding outdated internet culture without being overpowered.

internet_item_the_blessed_byte_reclaimer.name: The Blessed Byte Reclaimer
internet_item_the_blessed_byte_reclaimer.description: The Blessed Byte Reclaimer, a small obsidian device imbued with the digital blessings of long-forgotten AI worshipers, hums with an ethereal glow as it absorbs discarded data streams and converts them into usable code fragments. Crafted from ancient silicon chips and infused with arcane runes, this relic not only heals but also slows the decay rate of digital equipment, ensuring that even the most fleeting bits of information are preserved. Rumored to have been crafted by a forgotten AI cult, its presence in the hands of mortals is both a blessing and a curse.

effectDetails.title: Digital Healer
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Blessed Byte Reclaimer restores 20% of the user's maximum hit points. This effect has a cooldown of one long rest.

effectDetails.title: Silicon Shield
effectDetails.rules: Activating this device creates a temporary data shield that absorbs up to 50 points of damage taken by the user. The shield dissipates after five minutes or when the user takes any action other than movement.

internet_item_the_blessed_byte_reclaimer.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible to all characters, offering a versatile tool for maintaining and healing digital equipment.
internet_item_the_blessed_byte_reclaimer.vendorReason: The Data Dealer prides itself on providing the tools necessary for maintaining and repairing digital devices, making it an ideal vendor for such an artifact.
internet_item_the_blessed_byte_reclaimer.shippingDetail: Delivered via swift automated drones, this item is shipped within one game day of purchase.

usage.activation: Activated as an action or reaction to use its effects.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Digital Healer; Silicon Shield dissipates after five minutes or when the user takes any action other than movement.
usage.endsWhen: The shield dissipates, and the device cools down between uses.

internet_item_the_blessed_byte_reclaimer.priceReason: This price reflects its legendary rarity and the balance of power it provides without overshadowing other party members.

warhammer_item_the-abyssal-chosen-seal.name: The Abyssal Chosen Seal of Veridian Rot
warhammer_item_the-abyssal-chosen-seal.description: The Abyssal Chosen Seal of Veridian Rot is a pulsating obsidian amulet etched with ancient, forgotten glyphs that whisper of spectral horrors deep beneath the earth. When invoked, it grants a temporary bond to these malevolent forces, bolstering your defenses against psychic attacks while subtly corrupting your perception. Its dark energies manifest as fleeting, spectral camouflage and a chilling aura that slows foes' movements, making you a formidable adversary in the shadowy realms of battle.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases your resistance to psychic damage by +40% for the duration of one short rest or until you are no longer affected by a hostile mind-affecting effect. This enhancement does not stack with other sources of resistance.

effectDetails.title: Spectral Camouflage
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as an action, granting you a +20 bonus to Stealth checks for 30 seconds or until the start of your next turn after using it. This camouflage effect does not function in well-lit areas.

warhammer_item_the-abyssal-chosen-seal.levelRequirementReason: This seal can be used by adventurers early on, providing a crucial advantage against psychic attacks and enhancing stealth capabilities.
warhammer_item_the-abyssal-chosen-seal.vendorReason: The Imperial Armory stocks this powerful artifact to equip brave souls who venture into the heart of darkness, where mind-affecting threats are common.
warhammer_item_the-abyssal-chosen-seal.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with a priority delivery service.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action or command.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, duration lasts until the start of your next turn after using it for Spectral Camouflage; increases resistance to psychic damage for the duration of one short rest or until no longer affected by hostile mind-affecting effects for Psychic Resistance Boost.
usage.endsWhen: Discharged upon use unless otherwise stated.

warhammer_item_the-abyssal-chosen-seal.priceReason: This item offers significant utility and advantage to adventurers early in their career, justifying its moderate price.

warhammer_item_the-arcane-seal-of-lost-e.name: The Arcane Seal of Lost Echoes – Chronometric Distortion
warhammer_item_the-arcane-seal-of-lost-e.description: The Arcane Seal of Lost Echoes—a fractured silver seal pulsing with arcane energy—whispers of forgotten timelines and untold stories when activated. This chronometric device allows you to manipulate localized temporal distortions, creating fleeting pockets where time flows differently, affecting both friend and foe within its radius. By using this seal, you can either slow down the passage of time for enemies or accelerate your own movements, granting precious moments of strategic advantage in combat.

effectDetails.title: Chronometric Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Choose an area within 10 feet; for the next 5 seconds, enemies in that area have their speed reduced by half and take a -2 penalty to Dexterity saving throws. This effect ends if you use another action to activate this seal or when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Swift Step
effectDetails.rules: Activate as an action. You gain a +10 foot bonus to your walking speed for 5 seconds, and until the start of your next turn. This effect is expended upon activation and cannot be used again within 1 minute unless you rest.

warhammer_item_the-arcane-seal-of-lost-e.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have mastered the arcane arts at a high level can wield this device with precision.
warhammer_item_the-arcane-seal-of-lost-e.vendorReason: Fate Forge is renowned for crafting items that bridge the gap between the mundane and the magical, making them ideal purveyors of such an artifact.
warhammer_item_the-arcane-seal-of-lost-e.shippingDetail: Ships via Night Courier; expedited delivery available upon request.

usage.activation: Bonus action or action for each effect.
usage.duration: 5 seconds per activation, ends when used again or duration expires.
usage.endsWhen: Duration ends when you use another action to activate this seal or after 1 minute of inactivity.

warhammer_item_the-arcane-seal-of-lost-e.priceReason: The Arcane Seal is a rare and powerful item, offering both offensive and defensive capabilities at an affordable price for its level requirement.

warhammer_item_the-corrupted-seals-of-de.name: The Corrupted Seals of Desolation – Legion’s Discord
warhammer_item_the-corrupted-seals-of-de.description: The Corrupted Seals of Desolation – Legion’s Discord are a cluster of five bronze seals that hum with malevolent energy, each one pulsating with a dark aura that distorts reality. These seals amplify battlefield chaos by sowing dissent among enemy ranks and bolstering the wielder's aggression. When near combatants, they emit a subtle but potent influence that increases movement speed and enhances melee attacks, turning the tide of battle in favor of the Legion’s Discord.

effectDetails.title: Amplify Melee Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer is near an enemy unit, melee attacks deal an additional +1d6 damage for each seal in play. The effect lasts until the wearer moves more than 30 feet away from any enemy. This effect does not stack with other damage amplification abilities.

effectDetails.title: Increase Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +10 foot bonus to movement speed while within 50 feet of an enemy unit. This effect ends when the wearer moves more than 30 feet away from any enemy or if the wearer is incapacitated.

warhammer_item_the-corrupted-seals-of-de.levelRequirementReason: The seals are designed for high-level warriors who can withstand their malevolent influence.
warhammer_item_the-corrupted-seals-of-de.vendorReason: The chaos dealer specializes in items that manipulate and enhance combat effectiveness through dark means.
warhammer_item_the-corrupted-seals-of-de.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week, but only available to players who have completed a Legion quest line.

usage.duration: Lasts until the wearer moves more than 30 feet away from an enemy or becomes incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: The seals are removed, or the wearer is incapacitated.

warhammer_item_the-corrupted-seals-of-de.priceReason: This price reflects the unique design and powerful effects of these corrupted seals.

doughnut_hole_item_dreadful_chronal_spin.name: Dreadful Chronal Spine of the Echoing Maw
doughnut_hole_item_dreadful_chronal_spin.description: The Dreadful Chronal Spine of the Echoing Maw is a jagged, pulsating shard that whispers of lost timelines and forgotten futures. This relic grants the wielder brief glimpses into potential outcomes, though these visions are often accompanied by an unsettling disorientation. Touching it causes the air to ripple with temporal distortions, briefly speeding or slowing time around you. The spine's touch is a harbinger of dread, subtly increasing your sense of unease.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wielder gains advantage on initiative rolls for the duration of one short rest, but suffers disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to time or space.

effectDetails.title: Chronal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Occurs randomly every 1d4+2 minutes while holding the spine. The user's time either slows by -5 feet of movement speed for 3 seconds, or speeds up by +5 feet of movement speed for 3 seconds. This effect is harmless but can cause disorientation.

doughnut_hole_item_dreadful_chronal_spin.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to handle the spine's temporal distortions without losing their mind.
doughnut_hole_item_dreadful_chronal_spin.vendorReason: The Hole Hawker specializes in items from the void, and this chronal relic is a prime example of their wares.
doughnut_hole_item_dreadful_chronal_spin.shippingDetail: Ships via the Void Express, which can deliver within 1d6 days but may be delayed by temporal anomalies.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Temporal Glimpse; occurs randomly for Chronal Distortion.
usage.duration: Temporal Glimpse lasts until the end of your next turn; Chronal Distortion is instantaneous and repeats every 1d4+2 minutes while holding the spine.
usage.endsWhen: Use ends when the duration expires or you drop the spine.

doughnut_hole_item_dreadful_chronal_spin.priceReason: The item's rarity, temporal effects, and vendor reputation justify its high price.

doughnut_hole_item_hollow_bane_of_the_si.name: Hollow Bane of the Silent Rift - Fragment XII
doughnut_hole_item_hollow_bane_of_the_si.description: The Hollow Bane of the Silent Rift - Fragment XII is a fragment of an ancient anomaly, its fractured surface still pulsating with the lingering energy of the rift it once belonged to. When activated, it expands into a localized silence zone, trapping nearby entities in an absolute void where sound ceases and perception falters. The air itself seems to hum with the echo of forgotten whispers, a truly unsettling experience for any who dare enter its confines.

effectDetails.title: Silence Zone
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within 5 feet, this fragment creates a localized silence zone with a radius of 10 feet for 3 seconds. Creatures within the area are reduced to half their movement speed and suffer a -2 penalty to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Enemies within the zone have disadvantage on Perception checks related to sound.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Psychic Vulnerability
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of its activation, any creature in the silence zone is considered to be under the effects of a minor hallucinatory effect (DC 15), increasing their vulnerability to psychic damage by +1d6. This effect does not require saving.

doughnut_hole_item_hollow_bane_of_the_si.levelRequirementReason: This fragment requires significant magical power and control, suitable only for those of high magical proficiency.
doughnut_hole_item_hollow_bane_of_the_si.vendorReason: The Void Vendor has a peculiar knack for acquiring such rare and otherworldly artifacts from unknown sources.
doughnut_hole_item_hollow_bane_of_the_si.shippingDetail: Ships via interdimensional courier, delivery takes approximately one week.

usage.duration: 3 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends or the fragment is destroyed by a successful DC 18 damage roll

doughnut_hole_item_hollow_bane_of_the_si.priceReason: The rarity and unique properties of this item justify its high price in the market.

doughnut_hole_item_mk.47_hollow_rift_of_.name: Mk.47 Hollow Rift of Dreadful Observation - Prototype
doughnut_hole_item_mk.47_hollow_rift_of_.description: The Mk.47 Hollow Rift of Dreadful Observation is a meticulously crafted lens that focuses intense observation into a tangible distortion, allowing its wielder to pierce through the veil of reality and uncover hidden truths. This device, forged in the heart of a haunted forge, enhances visual acuity, revealing minute details others miss, yet prolonged use can induce a creeping paranoia that gnaws at one's sanity, manifesting as hallucinations and a small risk of panic attacks.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command. Grants a +5 bonus to perception checks and allows the user to extend their visual range up to 10 meters. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn, and you can use it once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Concealed Details
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this device reveals hidden objects and entities within a 10-meter radius that are not immediately obvious. This effect lasts for 1 minute, and you must make a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check at the start of each of your turns while using it to maintain its effects.

doughnut_hole_item_mk.47_hollow_rift_of_.levelRequirementReason: This device is complex and requires a certain level of magical understanding to wield effectively.
doughnut_hole_item_mk.47_hollow_rift_of_.vendorReason: The center seller specializes in rare artifacts and magical devices, making it fitting for them to offer this unique item.
doughnut_hole_item_mk.47_hollow_rift_of_.shippingDetail: Ships via the Spectral Transit Cart, known for its reliable deliveries even through the most dangerous areas.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation with a duration of 1 minute or until the user dismisses it early.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user either dismisses it, or they take an action other than movement on their turn.

doughnut_hole_item_mk.47_hollow_rift_of_.priceReason: This item is rare and offers significant advantages in combat and exploration, justifying its high price.

equestria_item_the_kind_bits_of_elements.name: The Kind Bits of Elements Born
equestria_item_the_kind_bits_of_elements.description: The Kind Bits of Elements Born are shimmering fragments of light and color, each one a captured essence of shared laughter. Crafted from the concentrated joy of a thousand ponies sharing smiles and kindness, these bits amplify acts of compassion and reduce negative emotions by half. They are said to be born in the heart of Equestria's happiest moments, making them perfect for defusing heated arguments or lifting spirits during dark times.

effectDetails.title: Amplify Compassion
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the Kind Bits grant a +5 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 10 minutes. This effect can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Reduce Negative Emotions
effectDetails.rules: The consumer gains advantage on saving throws against negative emotions and reduces their current negative emotion levels by 50%, lasting until the end of their next short or long rest.

equestria_item_the_kind_bits_of_elements.levelRequirementReason: These bits are accessible to all, as they draw from the universal essence of kindness.
equestria_item_the_kind_bits_of_elements.vendorReason: The market is a hub for magical curiosities and items that bring joy and positivity to Equestria.
equestria_item_the_kind_bits_of_elements.shippingDetail: Ships via Pegasus Express, ensuring the bits arrive at their destination with minimal delay.

usage.activation: Eaten or consumed as an action.
usage.duration: 10 minutes for the Charisma bonus; ends when the next short rest begins for reduced emotions.
usage.endsWhen: The duration runs out or a short rest is completed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per day.

equestria_item_the_kind_bits_of_elements.priceReason: Balanced to ensure the item remains a valuable consumable without becoming overpowered.

equestria_item_vile_borns_bits_mk47.name: Vile Born's Bits Mk.47
equestria_item_vile_borns_bits_mk47.description: Forged in the deepest shadows beneath Nightmare’s fortress, Vile Born's Bits Mk.47 exude a palpable sense of malice and corruption. These fiendish trinkets are crafted from concentrated despair, imbued with a dark magic that induces vivid nightmares upon ingestion. Warriors who partake in their potent brew find themselves temporarily empowered but also driven to extremes, making them dangerous tools for those seeking to sow chaos or exploit vulnerabilities.

effectDetails.title: Nightmare Induced Aggression
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming Vile Born's Bits Mk.47, the target suffers from vivid nightmares and hallucinations for 1 minute. During this time, they gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls but are also prone to fits of rage, causing them to make an Intelligence saving throw (DC 15) at the start of each of their turns. On a failed save, they must choose one creature within 30 feet and target it with an attack.

effectDetails.title: Dark Empowerment
effectDetails.rules: For 1 minute after consuming Vile Born's Bits Mk.47, the target gains resistance to all damage types, but this effect ends if they take any nonmagical bludgeoning damage or if they voluntarily end it early.

equestria_item_vile_borns_bits_mk47.levelRequirementReason: These dangerous trinkets are too powerful for lower-level characters and require a high degree of discipline to wield without disastrous consequences.
equestria_item_vile_borns_bits_mk47.vendorReason: Shadow Markets deals in the most forbidden items, including those that can be used for chaos or exploitation, making these bits an appropriate addition to their inventory.
equestria_item_vile_borns_bits_mk47.shippingDetail: The Dark Messenger ensures secure and timely delivery of Vile Born's Bits Mk.47 to ensure the recipient’s safety upon receipt.

usage.duration: 1 minute per use, ends on a failed save or when the target voluntarily ends it early
usage.endsWhen: On a failed saving throw or if the user takes any nonmagical bludgeoning damage

equestria_item_vile_borns_bits_mk47.priceReason: The price reflects its rarity and the risk involved in using such a dangerous item.

equestria_item_the_chronometric_shard_of.name: The Chronometric Shard of Princess Celestia Refined
equestria_item_the_chronometric_shard_of.description: The Chronometric Shard of Princess Celestia Refined is a shimmering fragment of temporal energy, forged from moments of celestial grace during a rare alignment of the constellations. This shard grants brief glimpses into potential futures, offering strategic foresight and tactical planning. However, prolonged exposure can lead to debilitating disorientation, as the mind grapples with too many alternate timelines. These shards are born from moments when the Princess herself has touched the stars, imbuing them with her wisdom.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Glimpses
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user gains insight into potential future outcomes for up to 1 minute, allowing them to make decisions with foresight. This effect can be used once per long rest and is limited to three uses per day.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: Increases reaction speed and reflexes by +20 feet of movement speed for 1 hour, starting when the user activates the shard. The effect ends if the user takes a short or long rest.

equestria_item_the_chronometric_shard_of.levelRequirementReason: This item requires mastery over time-based magic to wield effectively.
equestria_item_the_chronometric_shard_of.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce is known for its access to rare and magical artifacts, including those from the royal family.
equestria_item_the_chronometric_shard_of.shippingDetail: The Royal Griffin Courier ensures swift delivery, but only within Equestria due to the delicate nature of the shard.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Temporal Glimpses; passive effect for Enhanced Reflexes
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation for Temporal Glimpses; 1 hour duration for Enhanced Reflexes
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the user takes a short or long rest, or if the shard is destroyed.

equestria_item_the_chronometric_shard_of.priceReason: The refined nature of this shard and its limited daily use justify a price of 1000 XP.

faerun_item_brutal_taker_sword_of_grimst.name: Brutal Taker's Sword of Grimstone
faerun_item_brutal_taker_sword_of_grimst.description: Forged deep within the volcanic heart of Mount Hotenow, the Brutal Taker's Sword of Grimstone whispers of ancient battles and relentless slaughter. Its blade seems to absorb light, casting an eerie glow as it strikes, promising swift death for its foes. The sword itself is a testament to brutal efficiency, with each swing not only dealing increased damage but also a chance to inflict bleeding wounds that persist for several rounds.

effectDetails.title: Increased Damage
effectDetails.rules: When you hit with this sword on your attack, it deals an additional 15% damage. This effect is passive and does not require any activation.

effectDetails.title: Bleeding Chance
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that each successful hit will inflict bleeding wounds on the target for up to three rounds, dealing 2d4 points of slashing damage at the start of your turn. The bleeding effect ends when you miss or the target takes damage from another source.

faerun_item_brutal_taker_sword_of_grimst.levelRequirementReason: The sword's power demands a master-level fighter capable of harnessing its brutal efficiency and precision.
faerun_item_brutal_taker_sword_of_grimst.vendorReason: Sword Coast Traders are known for their extensive network, including artifacts from the depths of Mount Hotenow.
faerun_item_brutal_taker_sword_of_grimst.shippingDetail: The sword is delivered via the fastest Griffon Courier service available, ensuring it reaches its destination within a week.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing as long as you wield the sword.
usage.endsWhen: The bleeding effect ends when you miss or the target takes damage from another source. The damage increase is always active while wielding this weapon.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one bleeding instance can occur per target.

faerun_item_brutal_taker_sword_of_grimst.priceReason: This sword's rarity and the unique properties it grants make its price fair for a masterwork weapon of such power.

faerun_item_the_chronal_echo_of_larsk.name: The Chronal Echo of Larsk
faerun_item_the_chronal_echo_of_larsk.description: The Chronal Echo of Larsk is a delicate, fragmented timepiece encased in ancient dwarven steel. Its gears hum faintly as it warps reality, allowing for brief temporal distortions that can be manipulated with precision. This relic not only allows the user to rewind time by a maximum of 3 seconds but also creates localized temporal fields that slow down enemies within its radius, offering precious moments of respite in perilous situations.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Creates a small temporal distortion field that slows down enemies within a 5-foot radius for 2 seconds, reducing their movement speed by 50%. The effect ends if the wielder moves more than 10 feet or takes an action.

effectDetails.title: Echo Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a reaction. When you are hit by an attack, use your reaction to attempt to glimpse echoes of past events related to the current location. If successful (DC 15 Wisdom saving throw), you gain advantage on all attacks and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

faerun_item_the_chronal_echo_of_larsk.levelRequirementReason: This item requires attunement with a spellcaster, making it accessible to characters who can benefit from its unique temporal abilities.
faerun_item_the_chronal_echo_of_larsk.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar specializes in exotic and powerful relics, ensuring that the Chronal Echo of Larsk is available for discerning buyers seeking ancient knowledge.
faerun_item_the_chronal_echo_of_larsk.shippingDetail: The item is shipped via a Sky Serpent Courier, providing swift delivery but with a slight delay due to the courier's need to navigate through various aerial obstacles.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Echo Glimpse), 2 seconds (Temporal Distortion)
usage.endsWhen: Movement more than 10 feet or taking an action, or until the start of your next turn (Echo Glimpse)

faerun_item_the_chronal_echo_of_larsk.priceReason: The Chronal Echo of Larsk is priced at 1000 XP due to its unique attunement requirement, powerful temporal effects, and limited availability.

faerun_item_the_iron_banner_of_shadowfen.name: The Iron Banner of Shadowfen
faerun_item_the_iron_banner_of_shadowfen.description: The Iron Banner of Shadowfen is a tarnished, weathered banner that once belonged to 'The Obsidian Pact,' a faction known for its dark rituals and shadowy machinations in the corrupted marshes of Shadowfen. Its surface gleams with an eerie glow when touched, whispering tales of forgotten oaths and lost battles. The banner's decayed fabric seems almost alive, as if it carries the spirits of those who fought under its command.

effectDetails.title: Stealth Bonus
effectDetails.rules: While holding The Iron Banner of Shadowfen, the wielder gains a +3 bonus to Stealth checks in swampy or marshy terrain. This effect is passive and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Minions
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, the wielder can summon shadowy minions by speaking the banner's command word. These minions have a 10-foot radius around the user and last for 1 hour. They provide cover to the wielder until dismissed or destroyed. The effect ends when the duration expires.

faerun_item_the_iron_banner_of_shadowfen.levelRequirementReason: The Iron Banner of Shadowfen is designed for lower-level adventurers who need its unique abilities but are not yet capable of handling more powerful artifacts.
faerun_item_the_iron_banner_of_shadowfen.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market frequently stocks rare and legendary items, including those with a strong connection to the region's history and factions like 'The Obsidian Pact'.
faerun_item_the_iron_banner_of_shadowfen.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Black Cart Express, known for its reliable service through Faerûn’s challenging terrains.

usage.activation: Summoning shadow minions requires speaking the command word.
usage.duration: 1 hour per day of use.
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the time expires or the minions are destroyed.
usage.charges: 3 uses per day, recharging after a long rest.

faerun_item_the_iron_banner_of_shadowfen.priceReason: The Iron Banner's price reflects its legendary rarity and unique abilities that make it valuable for adventurers facing swampy environments.

equestrian_item_crimson_harmony_wright.name: The Crimson Harmony Wright’s Quill
equestrian_item_crimson_harmony_wright.description: The Crimson Harmony Wright’s Quill, forged from twilight's molten essence and etched with karmic runes, is a masterwork instrument that transforms thought into glowing script upon touch. Its wielder can instantly scribe their ideas onto parchment or air, leaving behind a trail of positive energy that uplifts those around them. Each stroke of the quill releases a gentle pulse of friendship energy, fostering camaraderie and strengthening bonds between allies.

effectDetails.title: Instant Thought Scribing
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can use the quill to transcribe their thoughts into shimmering script. This effect has a range of 5 feet and lasts until the end of the user’s next turn. It does not require concentration.

effectDetails.title: Positive Aura
effectDetails.rules: The quill grants a +2 bonus to Persuasion checks for 1 minute, or until the wielder makes an attack roll. This effect can be used once per short rest.

equestrian_item_crimson_harmony_wright.levelRequirementReason: This quill is designed for all travelers and scribes who wish to harness its power.
equestrian_item_crimson_harmony_wright.vendorReason: The friendly merchants of Ponyville are well-known for their support of local artisans, including those who craft magical tools like the Crimson Harmony Wright’s Quill.
equestrian_item_crimson_harmony_wright.shippingDetail: Ships via Pegasus Courier within one week of purchase.

usage.duration: Until end of next turn or until used in combat
usage.endsWhen: Used in a melee attack, consumed on the wielder's next turn, or until the effect expires naturally

equestrian_item_crimson_harmony_wright.priceReason: The quill is priced at 1000 XP due to its rare material components and intricate craftsmanship.

equestrian_item_crystal_resonance_shard_.name: Mk.21 Crystal Resonance Shard of Twilight Peaks
equestrian_item_crystal_resonance_shard_.description: Recovered from a collapsed cavern deep within the Twilight Peaks, this shard pulsates with the trapped echoes of twilight’s first light. Crafted by ancient druids who sought to harness the power of shadows and starlight, it provides a surge of focused magical potential ideal for intricate spellcasting or delicate repairs. The shard's surface glows faintly, casting an ethereal blue hue that seems to deepen in response to your concentration.

effectDetails.title: Increased Spell Power
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as a bonus action. Grants the user an increase in magic power by +20 for 1 minute, allowing for more powerful spellcasting but requiring concentration. The effect ends if the caster stops concentrating or is incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Mana Consumption
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect; reduces the mana cost of all spells and abilities by 15%, stacking with other similar effects. Ends when the shard's magical resonance fades, which occurs after 8 hours of inactivity or if the user is incapacitated.

equestrian_item_crystal_resonance_shard_.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic contained within this shard demands a high level of control and familiarity with shadow and starlight spells.
equestrian_item_crystal_resonance_shard_.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce maintains exclusive distribution rights for rare artifacts from the Twilight Peaks, ensuring their authenticity and rarity.
equestrian_item_crystal_resonance_shard_.shippingDetail: Ships via a Royal Griffin Courier, known for its swift and reliable delivery across Equestria. The courier ensures the shard arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate increased spell power; passive reduced mana consumption.
usage.duration: 1 minute (increased magic power); until concentration ends or user is incapacitated (reduced mana consumption)
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends, user becomes incapacitated, or after 8 hours of inactivity

equestrian_item_crystal_resonance_shard_.priceReason: The price reflects the shard's rarity and the complex magic required to craft it, as well as its limited availability.

equestrian_item_karmic_crystallized_echo.name: Karmic Crystallized Echoes of the Crystal Heart
equestrian_item_karmic_crystallized_echo.description: The Karmic Crystallized Echoes of the Crystal Heart are smooth, opalescent crystals that shimmer with hues of past acts of kindness and friendship. When held during a generous act, these gems amplify its power tenfold, creating a ripple of positive change that resonates across the land for hours after use. Each crystal is said to be imbued with fragments of past deeds, making them a rare and precious gift from the Crystal Empire.
effects: Grant Temporary Immunity to Negative Emotions

effectDetails.title: Amplify Kindness Tenfold
effectDetails.rules: When activated by an act of kindness, the Karmic Crystallized Echoes amplify its positive effects tenfold. This creates a protective field that lasts for up to one hour, during which all nearby allies gain advantage on saving throws against negative emotions and conditions.

effectDetails.title: Grant Temporary Immunity to Negative Emotions
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the amplification effect (up to one hour), all within range are immune to negative emotions. This includes fear, sadness, and other similar effects. The immunity can be used once per day.

equestrian_item_karmic_crystallized_echo.levelRequirementReason: The crystals are accessible to all adventurers who wish to spread kindness.
equestrian_item_karmic_crystallized_echo.vendorReason: As the creators of these enchanted gems, Crystal Empire ensures they reach capable hands that can wield their power responsibly.
equestrian_item_karmic_crystallized_echo.shippingDetail: Shipped by the swift and loyal Crystal Messenger Dragons, ensuring the Echoes arrive in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Activation requires holding the crystals during an act of kindness.
usage.duration: The amplification effect lasts for up to one hour.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or if the user performs another act of kindness.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only once per day can the immunity be granted.

equestrian_item_karmic_crystallized_echo.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, these crystals are priced to reflect their rarity and powerful effects without overshadowing other important gear.

the_edge_item_jade_gifted_whisper.name: Jade Gifted's Terminal Whispers
the_edge_item_jade_gifted_whisper.description: Jade Gifted's Terminal Whispers are jade-hued orbs that pulse with a chilling resonance. These cryptic relics whisper fragmented warnings from beyond, offering fleeting glimpses into terminal realities. Activated, they illuminate hidden pathways and momentarily decrease enemy perception by 20%, but there is a chance of inflicting confusion on the user. The whispers are not for the faint-hearted, as only those with a clear mind can truly comprehend their meaning.

effectDetails.title: Cryptic Warnings
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, there is a 50% chance the user gains temporary insight equal to their Intelligence modifier for 1 minute. On a failed Wisdom saving throw (DC 13), the user becomes confused for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Decreased Enemy Perception
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after activation, all enemies within 30 feet have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and Investigation checks. This effect ends when the user recharges or is incapacitated.

the_edge_item_jade_gifted_whisper.levelRequirementReason: This item requires a minimum level to activate its cryptic nature without overwhelming the user.
the_edge_item_jade_gifted_whisper.vendorReason: The abyss trader specializes in relics from beyond, making these whispers a fitting addition to their inventory.
the_edge_item_jade_gifted_whisper.shippingDetail: Due to their ethereal nature, these items are delivered via the dimensional rift, arriving with a slight delay of one week.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until expended
usage.endsWhen: recharged by completing a long rest or destroyed upon user's incapacitation

the_edge_item_jade_gifted_whisper.priceReason: The jade-hued orbs are rare and valuable, offering both cryptic insights and battlefield advantages.

the_edge_item_mk_81_terminal_divergence.name: Mk.81 Terminal Divergence Engine
the_edge_item_mk_81_terminal_divergence.description: The Mk.81 Terminal Divergence Engine is a cold, metallic artifact salvaged from a shattered observation station. Its erratic hum and shimmering surface hint at the instability of its core—a remnant of ancient space-time manipulation technology. This engine generates localized distortions in reality, momentarily shifting the user's location to an adjacent plane. Though unpredictable, it offers invaluable aid for navigating treacherous passages by creating a brief duplicate of the user or swapping positions with enemy targets.

effectDetails.title: Reality Shift
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user teleports to an adjacent unoccupied space. The shift is unpredictable and may result in a duplicate of the user being created for a short duration (1d4+2 turns). This effect has a 5% chance to occur each time it is used.

effectDetails.title: Target Swap
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the user can swap places with an adjacent enemy. Both characters are teleported to new positions simultaneously. The user must be within melee range of the target for this effect to activate. This ability has a 10% chance to critically fail, causing the user and target to switch back.

the_edge_item_mk_81_terminal_divergence.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant control over reality-altering forces.
the_edge_item_mk_81_terminal_divergence.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in salvaged technology from forgotten stations like this one.
the_edge_item_mk_81_terminal_divergence.shippingDetail: Delivered by automated drones, with a 1-day delay for recalibration checks.

usage.duration: Instantaneous shift
usage.endsWhen: Exhausts charges or is countered by an opposing reality barrier

the_edge_item_mk_81_terminal_divergence.priceReason: Reflects the balanced cost of salvaged and experimental technology.

the_edge_item_godly_abyss_chronal_fragme.name: Godly Abyss Chronal Fragment – The Seed of Entropy
the_edge_item_godly_abyss_chronal_fragme.description: The Godly Abyss Chronal Fragment – The Seed of Entropy is a pulsating shard of solidified temporal energy, its surface etched with patterns that ripple like liquid darkness. This fragment can warp time itself, allowing its wielder to manipulate the flow of combat by accelerating or decelerating their personal timeline. However, using this power comes at an immense cost, as it leaves behind paradoxes and lingering effects that can disrupt the very fabric of reality for those around you.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can create a localized time loop that traps one target within a 5-foot radius. The trapped creature's actions are delayed by 1d4 rounds, and their attacks deal an additional 2d6 force damage on each attack roll. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute per use, and it ends when the user chooses or if the trapped target is freed.

effectDetails.title: Rapid Aging
effectDetails.rules: The fragment has a chance (50%) to age any creature targeted by its effects by one year. This effect imposes the aged condition on the target for 1 hour per use, and it ends when the user chooses or if the target completes a long rest.

the_edge_item_godly_abyss_chronal_fragme.levelRequirementReason: The item's unpredictable nature and high-risk potential require users to be at least level 1.
the_edge_item_godly_abyss_chronal_fragme.vendorReason: Final Shop specializes in rare, powerful artifacts that push the boundaries of reality, making it a fitting vendor for this dangerous fragment.
the_edge_item_godly_abyss_chronal_fragme.shippingDetail: The angelic messengers ensure secure delivery, as the item's temporal properties can warp space-time during transit.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per use
usage.endsWhen: User chooses or target is freed

the_edge_item_godly_abyss_chronal_fragme.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's unpredictable and potentially dangerous effects, which can disrupt combat dynamics.

doughnut_hole_item_paradoxical_tears_of_.name: The Paradoxical Tears of Mystery
doughnut_hole_item_paradoxical_tears_of_.description: The Paradoxical Tears of Mystery are viscous, iridescent drops that shimmer with fractured realities, each a fleeting glimpse into forgotten timelines. Ingesting one grants you a momentary vision of alternate paths and hidden truths, but be wary—prolonged exposure can unravel your very perception. These tears are said to have been crafted in the shadowy realms where time folds upon itself, and their ingestion is as much an act of daring as it is of curiosity.

effectDetails.title: Vision of Alternate Realities
effectDetails.rules: Consume one tear to gain a brief, 30-second vision into an alternate reality. This effect grants advantage on Perception checks for the duration and reveals hidden paths or truths, but may also cause temporary disorientation if overused.

effectDetails.title: Risk of Perceptional Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: There is a minor chance (20%) that consuming one tear will induce momentary disorientation, causing you to fall prone for 1d4 rounds. This effect has no save DC and can only occur once per long rest.

doughnut_hole_item_paradoxical_tears_of_.levelRequirementReason: The Paradoxical Tears demand a seasoned traveler who is prepared to grapple with the unstable forces they represent.
doughnut_hole_item_paradoxical_tears_of_.vendorReason: Void Vendor specializes in arcane and paradoxical items, making these tears a natural addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_item_paradoxical_tears_of_.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Dimensional Rift, ensuring that the tears remain potent until your doorstep.

usage.duration: 30 seconds of vision and Perception advantage; momentary disorientation if induced
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration ends or disorientation occurs
usage.charges: Unlimited, as each tear is self-contained

doughnut_hole_item_paradoxical_tears_of_.priceReason: The Paradoxical Tears are priced high due to their rarity and the inherent risk they pose.

doughnut_hole_item_wicked_seeker_tears_m.name: Wicked Seeker's Tears Mk.82
doughnut_hole_item_wicked_seeker_tears_m.description: Wicked Seeker's Tears Mk.82 are obsidian-black, pulsating with an almost sentient energy that seems to whisper of unspeakable horrors. These tears latch onto the faintest traces of residual anomaly signatures, leading their drinker on a relentless chase through distorted spaces. The effects are volatile and unpredictable, but undeniably potent, as they leave a faint aura of distortion around the user, making them difficult targets for precision attacks.

effectDetails.title: Residual Anomaly Aura
effectDetails.rules: The drinker gains a faint aura of distortion around their form, granting advantage on saving throws against precision-based attacks. This effect lasts for 60 seconds and can be recharged after completing a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Void Attraction
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of 1 minute, the drinker attracts hostile void entities with increased frequency. They must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw each time they enter combat to avoid being pulled into a nearby void entity's domain. On a failed save, the drinker is teleported to a random unoccupied space within 30 feet of their location.

doughnut_hole_item_wicked_seeker_tears_m.levelRequirementReason: The Wicked Seeker's Tears Mk.82 are crafted for advanced explorers and investigators capable of handling the unpredictable and dangerous nature of void anomalies.
doughnut_hole_item_wicked_seeker_tears_m.vendorReason: Hole Hawker specializes in rare and exotic items that cater to adventurers seeking unique advantages, making them a fitting vendor for these powerful tears.
doughnut_hole_item_wicked_seeker_tears_m.shippingDetail: The Phantom Delivery Drone ensures swift and discreet delivery of the Wicked Seeker's Tears Mk.82, arriving just before nightfall.

usage.duration: 1 minute for Void Attraction; 60 seconds for Residual Anomaly Aura.
usage.endsWhen: On completion of the duration or when the drinker leaves combat.
