equestrian_item_mythic_apple_of_harmony_.shippingDetail: Ships via a Divine Pegasus Courier, ensuring safe and swift delivery.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action to consume; once per short rest for instant conflict resolution.
usage.duration: Empathy boost lasts 1 hour. Instant conflict resolution effect is instantaneous.
usage.endsWhen: Runs out of charges after one use, then requires a long rest to be consumed again.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses with a long rest

equestrian_item_mythic_apple_of_harmony_.priceReason: The Mythic Apple's rarity and magical properties justify its price, balancing the cost with its powerful effects.

grand_country_item_tiered_hooks_of_verti.name: The Tiered Hooks of Vertical's Guardian
grand_country_item_tiered_hooks_of_verti.description: The Tiered Hooks of Vertical's Guardian are intricately woven from solidified sugar strata, reinforced with spun honeycomb and imbued with the essence of the Doughnut itself. These hooks hum a rhythmic pulse that resonates through your hands as you ascend precarious staircases, offering a momentary stability during vertical movement. Crafted by the legendary Side Seller, these hooks are not just tools but a testament to the whimsical craftsmanship of the realm's most eccentric artisans.

effectDetails.title: Stability Boost
effectDetails.rules: While using the hooks, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws and advantage on Acrobatics checks made to maintain your balance while moving vertically. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fall Damage Reduction
effectDetails.rules: When you fall from a height, reduce all fall damage taken by half (rounded down) for 1 minute. This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

grand_country_item_tiered_hooks_of_verti.levelRequirementReason: These hooks are designed with intricate craftsmanship and require a certain level of skill to wield effectively.
grand_country_item_tiered_hooks_of_verti.vendorReason: The Side Seller is renowned for their eccentric and whimsical creations, making these hooks a perfect fit for their inventory.
grand_country_item_tiered_hooks_of_verti.shippingDetail: Delivered by the notoriously punctual Sticky Delivery Drone, ensuring your hooks arrive in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; Stability Boost lasts until start of next turn. Fall Damage Reduction lasts for 1 minute after use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you take another action that requires a bonus action.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

grand_country_item_tiered_hooks_of_verti.priceReason: Crafted from rare sugar strata and spun honeycomb, these hooks are a rare find in even the most eccentric shops.

grand_country_item_divine_hooks_of_the_l.name: Divine Guardian’s Hooks of the Layered Core
grand_country_item_divine_hooks_of_the_l.description: Forged within the deepest layers of the Doughnut's core, these hooks shimmer with an ethereal light that guides the faithful through complex layered environments. The hooks are said to be imbued by a divine hand, and touching them induces a state of blissful disorientation, allowing for effortless navigation. However, prolonged exposure can lead to a mild but persistent craving for frosting, as if the core itself whispers promises of sweet indulgence.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Spatial Awareness
effectDetails.rules: When you activate the hooks, you gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour. The hooks must be held and the user must focus on the immediate environment. This effect ends if you voluntarily stop holding them or if you are incapacitated.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Complex Mazes
effectDetails.rules: While the hooks are active, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to find a way out of complex mazes and labyrinths. This effect lasts for 10 minutes per charge and ends when you enter an environment without mazes or if you run out of charges.

grand_country_item_divine_hooks_of_the_l.levelRequirementReason: The hooks are designed to assist adventurers at all levels, but the divine power they wield is most potent for those who have proven their worth.
grand_country_item_divine_hooks_of_the_l.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in unique and mystical items that align with a traveler's journey, making these hooks an ideal fit for their inventory.
grand_country_item_divine_hooks_of_the_l.shippingDetail: Delivered fresh from the Doughnut's core, these hooks are shipped only on full moon nights to ensure their power remains intact.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until used up
usage.endsWhen: Voluntary stop holding, incapacitation, or entering a maze-free area

grand_country_item_divine_hooks_of_the_l.priceReason: The hooks are crafted from the rarest materials and imbued with divine power, making them an invaluable asset for any adventurer.

grand_country_item_mk_39_tiered_hooks_12.name: Mk.39 Tiered Hooks - The Glaze Sentinel
grand_country_item_mk_39_tiered_hooks_12.description: The Glaze Sentinel Mk.39 Tiered Hooks are forged from a rare, malleable metal that adapts to the environment, granting unparalleled grip and stability on any surface. These hooks are not just tools; they are extensions of your hand, designed with precision for environments where slick surfaces are common. Each hook is equipped with a glaze-sensing device that alerts you to changes in viscosity, ensuring your grip remains steadfast even as conditions shift.

effectDetails.title: Glazed Grip
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a bonus action, the hooks provide an advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and saving throws against effects that would cause you to fall. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Surface Adaptation
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns, if you are standing on a slick surface, the hooks detect it and provide a +2 bonus to your Dexterity saving throws for the rest of that turn. This effect ends when you leave the slick surface.

grand_country_item_mk_39_tiered_hooks_12.levelRequirementReason: These hooks require significant strength and dexterity to wield effectively, making them suitable only for seasoned adventurers.
grand_country_item_mk_39_tiered_hooks_12.vendorReason: Layer Market specializes in high-demand, specialty gear that requires specialized calibration and maintenance, making it the perfect vendor for these hooks.
grand_country_item_mk_39_tiered_hooks_12.shippingDetail: Ships via the Sugar Rail Cart, known for its reliable delivery through the city's complex infrastructure. Delivery time is approximately two days.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and gain benefits.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until start of next turn or conditions change.
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you leave a slick surface or take damage.

grand_country_item_mk_39_tiered_hooks_12.priceReason: The hooks are crafted from rare materials and require precise calibration, making them relatively expensive but worth the investment for adventurers who frequently face slippery conditions.

almost_edge_item_the_shimmering_boundary.name: The Shimmering Boundary Claimed
almost_edge_item_the_shimmering_boundary.description: The Shimmering Boundary Claimed is a viscous, iridescent orb that pulses with subsonic frequencies, creating an otherworldly hum as it distorts reality around you. Holding this sphere grants temporary resistance to psychological distress and warps the soundscape, causing fleeting auditory hallucinations that can lead to panic. This enigmatic artifact restores some of your health while casting a field that reduces enemy accuracy, making it a valuable tool for survival in the most harrowing of battles.

effectDetails.title: Psychological Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this artifact grants you +5 resistance to fear effects for 60 seconds. It also reduces the chance of a target hitting you by 20% within its area of effect. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or if your concentration is broken.

effectDetails.title: Auditory Distortion
effectDetails.rules: There is a 15% chance that each creature in the area will suffer from fleeting auditory hallucinations, which have a 20% chance to cause them to become panicked. This effect lasts for the duration of your concentration on this artifact.

almost_edge_item_the_shimmering_boundary.levelRequirementReason: This artifact requires mastery-level expertise due to its complex and dangerous nature.
almost_edge_item_the_shimmering_boundary.vendorReason: The Void Merchant is known for their collection of rare, mythic artifacts that push the boundaries of reality.
almost_edge_item_the_shimmering_boundary.shippingDetail: Due to its unstable nature, this artifact requires a special delivery through the Dimensional Portal, which can take up to three days.

usage.activation: A bonus action is required to activate and maintain concentration on this artifact.
usage.duration: The effects last for 60 seconds while you maintain your concentration.
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends if you are incapacitated or attacked by a creature within the area of effect.

almost_edge_item_the_shimmering_boundary.priceReason: This artifact is priced at mythic rarity, reflecting its unique and powerful abilities that make it a sought-after commodity among seasoned adventurers.

almost_edge_item_cursed_whispers_of_the_.name: Cursed Whispers of the Sevenfold Decay
almost_edge_item_cursed_whispers_of_the_.description: The Cursed Whispers of the Sevenfold Decay are a sinister collection of scrolls bound by tarnished silver chain, each whispering fragmented prophecies that unravel sanity and hint at the slow dissolution of reality itself. Prolonged exposure to these scrolls causes accelerated aging, turning skin pale as parchment and eyes hollow with dread. Their whispers seem to twist the fabric of time around you, making the air thick with an oppressive sense of foreboding.

effectDetails.title: Sanity Shatter
effectDetails.rules: Each scroll, when read for more than a minute, causes the reader to suffer from temporary confusion. There is a 20% chance that this confusion results in self-damaging actions. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn and can be resisted with a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Corruption
effectDetails.rules: The scrolls inflict an area effect, causing all creatures within 20 feet to experience slowed movement by 15% for 1 minute. This effect ends if the reader drops one or more scrolls or successfully resists it with a DC 14 Constitution saving throw.

almost_edge_item_cursed_whispers_of_the_.levelRequirementReason: Even the most inexperienced adventurers may find these scrolls' effects unsettling and potentially dangerous.
almost_edge_item_cursed_whispers_of_the_.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader is known for their vast array of strange and ancient artifacts, making them a likely seller of such cursed items.
almost_edge_item_cursed_whispers_of_the_.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days via Drone Delivery, ensuring the scrolls are delivered intact.

usage.activation: Read one scroll as an action to activate its effects.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; effects last for their respective durations.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you drop a scroll or successfully resist it with a saving throw.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but reading more than one scroll at a time causes cumulative effects.

almost_edge_item_cursed_whispers_of_the_.priceReason: The scrolls' rarity and the potential for sanity loss make their price reasonable while keeping them within reach of lower-level adventurers.

almost_edge_item_mk.49_boundary_whispers.name: Mk.49 Boundary Whispers of the Void
almost_edge_item_mk.49_boundary_whispers.description: A jagged shard of obsidian etched with unsettling geometric patterns, the Mk.49 Boundary Whispers of the Void amplifies the sensation of falling and offers glimpses into the cold, silent expanse beyond. Its touch induces a feeling of profound isolation, making those near it feel both connected to and detached from reality. Held near a precipice, this shard reveals the void’s secrets through whispers that only the wielder can hear.

effectDetails.title: Whispers of the Void
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this shard amplifies the sensation of falling by +50% and grants temporary invisibility to the wielder for 1 round. The user must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or fall prone from the amplified sensation.

effectDetails.title: Void Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wielder can use this shard to detect nearby sources of cosmic energy within 30 feet. The detection reveals any such source's approximate location and intensity for up to 1 minute.

almost_edge_item_mk.49_boundary_whispers.levelRequirementReason: The item’s intricate design requires a certain level of experience and focus to wield effectively.
almost_edge_item_mk.49_boundary_whispers.vendorReason: The edge wanderer is known for their extensive trade in ancient relics and curiosities, including this mysterious shard.
almost_edge_item_mk.49_boundary_whispers.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week of order placement.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate invisibility or Whispers of the Void; once per short rest to use for a Void Glimpse.
usage.duration: Temporary invisibility lasts 1 round (6 seconds); Void Glimpse lasts up to 1 minute.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires, or if the wielder takes any major action.

almost_edge_item_mk.49_boundary_whispers.priceReason: The item’s rarity and unique properties justify its value in experience points.

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_fi.name: The Chronal Echo Finder - Phase Seven
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_fi.description: The Chronal Echo Finder - Phase Seven is a sleek obsidian device that subtly manipulates gravity to reveal hidden temporal anomalies. Its polished surface glows with an ethereal blue light, hinting at the distortions it can detect. When activated, it briefly warps space around you, allowing you to perceive echoes of past events and locate secret passages in the fabric of time. However, prolonged use may cause disorientation due to conflicting temporal fields.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Echo Perception
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, activate the device for 10 seconds. Within its range (30 feet), you can detect hidden temporal anomalies and secret passages, granting advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice these features. The device has 2 uses per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Secret Passage Detection
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the device creates a localized gravity warp that reveals nearby secret passages. This effect is instantaneous and has a range of 60 feet. There is a 30% chance that this effect also reveals hidden traps or dangers in the vicinity.

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_fi.levelRequirementReason: This device requires significant focus to manipulate temporal anomalies safely.
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_fi.vendorReason: Hole Hawker specializes in devices that can navigate through hidden or unstable dimensions, making this item a perfect fit for their inventory.
doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_fi.shippingDetail: The drone ensures secure and swift delivery by teleporting the device directly to your location within one hour of purchase.

usage.duration: 10 seconds per activation
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when it is used or a new bonus action is taken
usage.charges: 2 uses, recharged at the end of a long rest

doughnut_hole_item_gravitic_resonance_fi.priceReason: This device offers powerful yet balanced utility that can significantly aid explorers and adventurers in navigating complex temporal environments.

doughnut_hole_item_xenolithic_paradoxes_.name: The Fragmented Xenolith of Shifting Currents - Variant Beta
doughnut_hole_item_xenolithic_paradoxes_.description: The Fragmented Xenolith of Shifting Currents - Variant Beta, a pulsating core forged from collapsed gravitational flux near the Fated Place, hums with an eerie, shifting mass that defies logic. Its touch can momentarily warp space-time, creating unpredictable pockets of zero gravity or intense gravitation within a 5-meter radius. The xenolith's unstable nature is both a tool and a trap for those who dare to wield it, as its effects can disorient the unprepared and leave them questioning reality itself.

effectDetails.title: Gravitational Pulsations
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a bonus action, this xenolith creates a 5-meter radius around the user where gravity fluctuates unpredictably. Objects within the area may float or fall at random for 3 seconds. The effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Fluctuations
effectDetails.rules: Every time a creature enters the area of gravitational pulsations, they must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become disoriented for 1 minute. The disorientation ends early if the affected creature takes any action other than moving up to half its speed.

doughnut_hole_item_xenolithic_paradoxes_.levelRequirementReason: Only those with significant experience and a deep understanding of space-time manipulation can safely use this dangerous artifact.
doughnut_hole_item_xenolithic_paradoxes_.vendorReason: The center seller specializes in rare, ancient artifacts like the Fragmented Xenolith, offering items that challenge the boundaries of reality.
doughnut_hole_item_xenolithic_paradoxes_.shippingDetail: Delivery is made by Submerged Courier, ensuring safe transport through underwater channels to the buyer's location.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting 3 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the user activates another gravitational pulsation or after one long rest if no further activation occurs
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, recharging once per long rest

doughnut_hole_item_xenolithic_paradoxes_.priceReason: This xenolith's rarity and unpredictable nature justify its high price in the market.

doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_paradoxes_0.name: The Oscillating Gravitic Amplifier - Prototype Delta
doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_paradoxes_0.description: The Oscillating Gravitic Amplifier - Prototype Delta is a sleek, metallic device that hums with an otherworldly energy. Crafted from a mysterious alloy of unknown origin, it emits a pulsating field of distorted gravity when activated. This device can amplify gravitational forces in its vicinity, creating unstable platforms and shockwaves capable of crushing objects or pulling enemies towards the wielder. However, its operational stability is highly questionable, making each use a gamble that could lead to catastrophic self-destruction.

effectDetails.title: Gravitational Crush
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within 30 feet of enemies, the device creates a cone-shaped area of gravitational distortion that deals 1d8 + 2d6 force damage to all creatures in the area. There is a 50% chance this effect will cause the amplifier to self-destruct after use.

effectDetails.title: Pulling Force
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the device can be used as an action to create a temporary gravitational pull that draws all creatures within 15 feet towards its center. This has a range of 30 feet and lasts for 1 minute. Creatures must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the area; those who fail are also knocked prone.

doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_paradoxes_0.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant magical knowledge to operate this unstable prototype.
doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_paradoxes_0.vendorReason: Void Vendor specializes in experimental and dangerous equipment, often procuring items from the graviton realms themselves.
doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_paradoxes_0.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the amplifier must be transported under specialized containment protocols by the Gravitic Transport Vessel.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for Gravitational Crush; lasts 1 minute for Pulling Force
usage.endsWhen: Self-destructs with a chance of 50% after use or when destroyed by a successful DC 20 Strength check.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use has a 50% risk of self-destruction.

doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_paradoxes_0.priceReason: Balanced against the device's potential for destruction and unstable nature.

leclaire_isle_item_frosted_rolls_of_brut.name: Brutal Fallen's Rolls
leclaire_isle_item_frosted_rolls_of_brut.description: Brutal Fallen's Rolls are a twisted confection from the ancient Isle of Le Claire. These dark, frosted pastries pulse with a strange energy that seems to hum with the spirits of fallen warriors. Each bite releases a surge of sugary adrenaline, bolstering your strength and reflexes for a brief but intense moment. However, the sugar rush is fleeting, leaving you with a lingering fog in your mind as your accuracy plummets.

effectDetails.title: Boosted Strength
effectDetails.rules: Consume the rolls to gain advantage on Strength checks and saving throws for 1 minute. The effect ends if you take damage or if you willingly end it early.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reflexes
effectDetails.rules: Your Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks are made with advantage until your next short rest, but you suffer a -2 penalty to all attacks and saving throws. This effect is exhausted after 10 minutes or if you take damage.

leclaire_isle_item_frosted_rolls_of_brut.levelRequirementReason: The rolls' power requires the eater to be at least level 15, ensuring they can handle the effects without immediate danger.
leclaire_isle_item_frosted_rolls_of_brut.vendorReason: Dough Depot specializes in pastries and treats from all corners of the realm, including these rare and powerful confections.
leclaire_isle_item_frosted_rolls_of_brut.shippingDetail: Ships via Express Drone with same-day delivery to major cities; rural areas may experience a two-day delay.

usage.activation: Eating one roll as an action.
usage.duration: 1 minute for Boosted Strength and 10 minutes for Enhanced Reflexes, each effect ends early if you take damage or end the effect voluntarily.
usage.endsWhen: One of the effects ends when you take damage, at your discretion, or after its duration expires.
usage.charges: Unlimited; can be consumed as often as needed.

leclaire_isle_item_frosted_rolls_of_brut.priceReason: The rolls' unique and potent effects justify their high price in experience points.

leclaire_isle_item_mk_27_frosted_rolls_o.name: Mk.27 Frosted Rolls of Silent Decay
leclaire_isle_item_mk_27_frosted_rolls_o.description: The Mk.27 Frosted Rolls of Silent Decay are eerily perfect pastries coated in a shimmering frost that seems to absorb light, reflecting the moon's glow. Consuming these rolls grants temporary resistance against psychic attacks and provides +5 to Charisma checks due to their unsettling appearance. The rolls offer a chance for prophetic dreams, which can be both comforting and terrifying, revealing fragments of L'Eclaire Isle’s forgotten past.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the rolls grant temporary resistance to psychic damage for an hour. This effect ends if the consumer takes any psychic damage or at the end of their next long rest.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: The rolls provide a +5 bonus to Charisma checks and saves made within 10 minutes of consumption. This effect is cumulative with other bonuses but does not stack with similar effects from other sources. The duration ends once the consumer has used this benefit or at the end of their next long rest.

leclaire_isle_item_mk_27_frosted_rolls_o.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and power of these rolls are best suited for seasoned adventurers who can handle their effects without succumbing to paranoia.
leclaire_isle_item_mk_27_frosted_rolls_o.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is renowned for its unique and powerful pastries, making the Frosted Rolls a fitting addition to their offerings.
leclaire_isle_item_mk_27_frosted_rolls_o.shippingDetail: The Phantom Parceler ensures that these delicate rolls arrive in perfect condition through special cold chain packaging and rapid delivery.

usage.activation: Eaten as a meal or snack
usage.duration: 1 hour, until consumed or interrupted by psychic damage
usage.endsWhen: At the end of the consumer's next long rest or if they take any psychic damage

leclaire_isle_item_mk_27_frosted_rolls_o.priceReason: The rarity and power of these rolls justify their relatively high price, offering significant benefits that are otherwise difficult to obtain.

leclaire_isle_item_the_mythic_roll_of_et.name: The Mythic Roll of Eternal Frosting
leclaire_isle_item_the_mythic_roll_of_et.description: The Mythic Roll of Eternal Frosting, an impossibly large confection encased in a perpetual layer of glistening frosting, is said to have been crafted by the first Dough Folk master baker. Consuming this legendary treat grants you near-immortality (of sorts) and access to arcane pastry knowledge. The roll's frosting holds secrets of the ages, allowing limited control over frosting-based magic while creating pastries spontaneously as if they were summoned from the very air.

effectDetails.title: Eternal Frosting
effectDetails.rules: You gain immunity to all forms of aging and decay related to food. This effect is permanent, providing a +2 bonus to saving throws against poison and disease. The frosting's magic can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Pastry Mastery
effectDetails.rules: You gain proficiency in the Cooking skill and a +1 bonus to all ability checks related to baking or pastry making. This effect is permanent, requiring no additional action or concentration.

leclaire_isle_item_the_mythic_roll_of_et.levelRequirementReason: The item's arcane nature and its effects demand a certain level of magical understanding.
leclaire_isle_item_the_mythic_roll_of_et.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies deals in rare and mythic culinary treasures, making it the only place to find this legendary roll.
leclaire_isle_item_the_mythic_roll_of_et.shippingDetail: The roll is delivered with a special temperature-controlled container ensuring its pristine condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon consumption of the roll.
usage.duration: Permanent, lasting until consumed or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed when consumed or subjected to extreme heat above 120°F.

leclaire_isle_item_the_mythic_roll_of_et.priceReason: The roll's mythic rarity and its permanent effects justify this price, providing significant benefits.

faerun_item_the_ghostwood_wrights_wand.name: The Ghostwood Wright's Wand
faerun_item_the_ghostwood_wrights_wand.description: This intricately carved wand, crafted from the petrified wood of a long-dead treant, hums with the ancient magic of spectral sprites and hidden pathways. When activated, it summons fleeting, shimmering sprites that disrupt enemy attacks with ethereal force, while also revealing previously unseen routes through shadowy environs. The wand's power is drawn from an unyielding core of petrified wood, a testament to its enduring craftsmanship and arcane might.

effectDetails.title: Disrupts Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the wand summons spectral sprites that disrupt one attack made against you or an ally within 10 feet. The sprite imposes disadvantage on the attack roll, lasts for 1 round, and requires no concentration.

effectDetails.title: Reveals Pathways
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wand illuminates hidden pathways in shadowed areas within 30 feet. For 1 minute, any creature with darkvision can see normally in these areas, but the effect ends if you are incapacitated or leave the area.

faerun_item_the_ghostwood_wrights_wand.levelRequirementReason: The Ghostwood Wright's Wand requires a minimum level of 1 to wield effectively, allowing even novice mages to access its ancient power.
faerun_item_the_ghostwood_wrights_wand.vendorReason: Sword Coast Traders specialize in rare and exotic wands, making the Ghostwood Wright's Wand an appropriate addition to their inventory.
faerun_item_the_ghostwood_wrights_wand.shippingDetail: Ships via Dragon Express, arriving within a week of purchase. The wand is carefully packed and enchanted with protective wards during transit.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next turn for 'Disrupts Attacks'; 1 minute for 'Reveals Pathways'
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are incapacitated or leave the area for 'Reveals Pathways', or at the start of your next turn for 'Disrupts Attacks'

faerun_item_the_ghostwood_wrights_wand.priceReason: The Ghostwood Wright's Wand is priced at 1000 XP, reflecting its rare crafting materials and ancient enchantments.

faerun_item_the_crimson_rune_of_kraznak_.name: The Crimson Rune of Kraznak's Wright
faerun_item_the_crimson_rune_of_kraznak_.description: The Crimson Rune of Kraznak's Wright is a volcanic rune forged deep within the molten heart of Mount Kraznak. Its surface crackles with raw, untamed magic, pulsing like a heartbeat of fiery destruction. When activated, it emits a searing wave of heat that melts through armor and incinerates foes in its path, leaving behind a smoldering trail of singed flesh. The rune's curse is real; those who wield it must endure the minor burn effect themselves.

effectDetails.title: Localized Heat Wave
effectDetails.rules: The user makes a melee attack against all creatures within a 10-foot radius. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage and is knocked prone. The rune also melts through any armor worn by the target, reducing its effectiveness for one hour.

effectDetails.title: Minor Burn
effectDetails.rules: The user suffers 1d4 fire damage at the start of their turn each round while wielding this rune. This effect cannot be ended early and lasts until the rune is destroyed or recharged.

faerun_item_the_crimson_rune_of_kraznak_.levelRequirementReason: This rune requires significant magical power to control its raw, volcanic magic.
faerun_item_the_crimson_rune_of_kraznak_.vendorReason: Baldur's Bazaar caters exclusively to adventurers seeking powerful and unique items from the most reputable forgers in Faerûn.
faerun_item_the_crimson_rune_of_kraznak_.shippingDetail: Due to its volatile nature, the rune must be shipped via Gondorian Courier with special heat-resistant packaging.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until expended or destroyed
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by fire-based damage or when all charges are used

faerun_item_the_crimson_rune_of_kraznak_.priceReason: The rune's rarity, forging complexity, and the risk of its fiery curse ensure a high price in experience points.

faerun_item_the_shadow_singer_s_mantle.name: The Shadow Singer’s Mantle of Umbra
faerun_item_the_shadow_singer_s_mantle.description: The Shadow Singer’s Mantle of Umbra, a dark grey cloak adorned with silver thread depicting mournful ballads, was crafted by an exiled bard who wove sorrow into its fibers. It allows for near-silent movement and the manipulation of shadows to create minor illusions, but the lingering sorrow it emits slowly drains the wearer's willpower over prolonged use. The mantle is a relic of ancient lore, once worn by bards who could command the very shadows themselves.

effectDetails.title: Shadow Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can create minor illusions using your shadow. These illusions last for up to 1 minute and do not grant any advantage on stealth checks. You cannot use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Near-Silent Movement
effectDetails.rules: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wearing the mantle for up to 1 hour per long rest. The effect ends if you attack with a weapon or cast a spell of 1st level or higher.

faerun_item_the_shadow_singer_s_mantle.levelRequirementReason: The item's effects are powerful enough that only a mid-level character can manage the draining willpower cost.
faerun_item_the_shadow_singer_s_mantle.vendorReason: Waterdeep Market is known for its collection of rare and exotic items, including those with ancient or mythic origins.
faerun_item_the_shadow_singer_s_mantle.shippingDetail: Ships within 3 days, delivered by Silver Arrow Express.

usage.activation: Action to create minor illusions; Bonus action for near-silent movement (while wearing).
usage.duration: Minor illusions last up to 1 minute. Near-silent movement lasts until you attack or cast a spell of 1st level or higher.
usage.endsWhen: Minor illusions end after 1 minute, and the effect ends if you attack with a weapon or cast a spell.

faerun_item_the_shadow_singer_s_mantle.priceReason: The item's effects are balanced to provide significant advantages in stealth and shadow manipulation while maintaining a price that reflects its mythic rarity and craftsmanship.

pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_ward.name: The Chronos Resonance Ward of Trainer Silas
pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_ward.description: The Chronos Resonance Ward of Trainer Silas hums with a temporal energy that accelerates the growth rate of nearby Pokémon by 50% for three turns, giving them an extra burst of strength. It subtly shifts their battle instincts, making them more aggressive and precise in their attacks, +1 priority against foes. The ward occasionally triggers a 'time slip' effect, reversing an opponent’s last move to disrupt their strategy. Silas's creation provides temporary resistance to status effects, ensuring Pokémon remain in fighting form longer.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases the growth rate of nearby Pokémon by 50% for three turns, providing an extra burst of strength during battles.

effectDetails.title: Battle Instinct Shift
effectDetails.rules: Activates on reaction when a Pokémon is targeted by an attack or effect. Shifts their battle priority +1 against the attacker for two turns. Ends if the Pokémon faints or the ward runs out of charges.

pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_ward.levelRequirementReason: Mastering time-based tactics requires significant experience and control over one's Pokémon.
pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_ward.vendorReason: Silas is known for his mastery in time manipulation, making the Chronos Resonance Ward a fitting addition to his inventory.
pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_ward.shippingDetail: Ships within three days via winged courier.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; ends when the Pokémon faints or the ward runs out of charges
usage.endsWhen: Faints, or the ward runs out of charges (2 uses)

pokemon_item_chronos_resonance_ward.priceReason: The Chronos Resonance Ward is a limited daily item with a unique crafting lore and powerful effects.

pokemon_item_ethereal_symphony_shard.name: The Ethereal Symphony Shard of Echoing Dreams
pokemon_item_ethereal_symphony_shard.description: The Ethereal Symphony Shard of Echoing Dreams is a shimmering fragment of sound, forged from the harmonics of forgotten dreams and celestial melodies. When held by a trainer, it gently hums with an ancient tune that calms agitated Pokémon, restoring their joy and enhancing their connection to their environment. The shard also grants fleeting visions into alternate realities where battles unfold in unheard-of strategies, inspiring new tactics and moves.

effectDetails.title: Tranquil Symphony
effectDetails.rules: When a trainer holds the shard, it emits a soothing melody that calms agitated Pokémon, restoring 1d6 + trainer level happiness points. This effect is instantaneous and can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Phantom Echo
effectDetails.rules: There's a 20% chance each time the shard triggers a move that it will briefly duplicate an opponent's move, allowing the trainer to counteract or exploit it. This effect lasts for one round and can occur once per battle.

pokemon_item_ethereal_symphony_shard.levelRequirementReason: The shard's gentle yet powerful effects make it accessible early in a trainer's journey.
pokemon_item_ethereal_symphony_shard.vendorReason: As the keeper of exotic Pokémon and ancient artifacts, Safari Shop Echoes is known for its diverse collection of relics like this ethereal shard.
pokemon_item_ethereal_symphony_shard.shippingDetail: The delivery arrives under a halo of moonlight, ensuring the trainer receives their shard in perfect condition.

usage.activation: Passive effect when held by the trainer.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for 'Tranquil Symphony', lasts one round for 'Phantom Echo'.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after a short or long rest, or upon losing contact with the shard.

pokemon_item_ethereal_symphony_shard.priceReason: The ethereal nature and ancient craftsmanship of the shard justify its modest price in experienced hands.

pokemon_item_mk72_lumina_stone_of_valor.name: Mk.72 Lumina Stone of Valor - Prototype Designation
pokemon_item_mk72_lumina_stone_of_valor.description: The Mk.72 Lumina Stone of Valor is a obsidian-like relic that absorbs and releases the raw energy of battles, manifesting as brilliant blue light to amplify strategic prowess. This prototype recovered from a forgotten Pokémon League facility temporarily boosts the trainer’s critical hit rate by 15% and provides a small shield against direct attacks. Its origins hint at its power being tied to the ancient lore of valor and battle strategy.

effectDetails.title: Critical Boost
effectDetails.rules: Increases the trainer's critical hit rate by 15% for 1 minute. Ends if the trainer attacks twice without scoring a critical hit.

effectDetails.title: Shielding Aura
effectDetails.rules: Provides a +2 bonus to AC against one direct attack per battle, with a maximum of three times per day. Ends if the shield is used or after 10 minutes.

pokemon_item_mk72_lumina_stone_of_valor.levelRequirementReason: This relic requires significant experience and power to wield effectively.
pokemon_item_mk72_lumina_stone_of_valor.vendorReason: As a prototype recovered from a forgotten facility, it's only sold through the official League store.
pokemon_item_mk72_lumina_stone_of_valor.shippingDetail: Shipped via reinforced transport truck due to its delicate nature and power.

usage.activation: Passive effect activated upon absorbing battle energy; requires a short rest to recharge.
usage.duration: 1 minute or until the shield is used, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: After 10 minutes of inactivity or if the trainer scores two consecutive non-critical hits.
usage.charges: Unlimited charges, but recharges after a short rest.

pokemon_item_mk72_lumina_stone_of_valor.priceReason: The item's rarity and prototype status justify its high price.

equestria_item_radiant_bearer_of_echoes.name: Radiant Bearer's Badges of Echoes
equestria_item_radiant_bearer_of_echoes.description: The Radiant Bearer's Badges of Echoes, forged from twilight's essence and imbued with the whispers of ancient harmony, emit a soft, ethereal glow that amplifies the wearer’s empathy and subtly corrects minor miscommunications in their presence. Each badge pulses with a gentle light when near significant locations, revealing echoes of past events tied to profound emotional resonance. These badges are both a symbol and a tool for fostering understanding and connection among those who wear them.

effectDetails.title: Empathy Amplification
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the badges, the wearer's empathy is increased by 15%. This effect is passive and does not require any action to activate. It persists for the duration of the session.

effectDetails.title: Minor Miscommunication Correction
effectDetails.rules: When within a 30-foot radius of another creature, there is a 20% chance that minor miscommunications are subtly corrected. This effect has no save DC and does not expend charges; it simply occurs whenever the conditions are met.

equestria_item_radiant_bearer_of_echoes.levelRequirementReason: The badges provide a gentle, continuous benefit without being overly powerful for any level.
equestria_item_radiant_bearer_of_echoes.vendorReason: Twilight Sparkle, a master of harmony and empathy, often uses these badges to promote understanding among the Equestrian populace.
equestria_item_radiant_bearer_of_echoes.shippingDetail: Shipped via the Winged Delivery Pony service with same-day delivery within Equestria.

usage.activation: Passive effect; does not require activation.
usage.duration: Persistent for the duration of the session.
usage.endsWhen: Session ends or removed from wear.

equestria_item_radiant_bearer_of_echoes.priceReason: The badges provide a significant, ongoing benefit that is neither trivial nor game-breaking, making them reasonably priced for their value.

equestria_item_mk.73_kind_badges_of_reso.name: Mk.73 Kind Badges of Resonance
equestria_item_mk.73_kind_badges_of_reso.description: Forged during a rare convergence of elemental energies within the Crystal Heart, these badges radiate a soothing warmth that envelops the wearer in a cocoon of peaceful energy. The intricate engravings depict scenes of ponies cooperating with unwavering kindness, symbolizing the pursuit of harmony and mutual respect. When worn, they not only restore 25% of the user's hit points over 30 minutes but also create a small zone of calming influence that extends outwards for 10 meters around the wearer, fostering understanding among all within its radius.

effectDetails.title: Gradual Healing
effectDetails.rules: When worn by a pony, this badge restores 25% of the wearer's hit points over a period of 30 minutes. This effect is passive and does not require any action from the wearer.

effectDetails.title: Zone of Calming Influence
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these badges, the wearer creates a zone of calming influence with a radius of 10 meters around them. Any pony within this area gains advantage on saving throws against fear and anxiety for the duration of their next turn.

equestria_item_mk.73_kind_badges_of_reso.levelRequirementReason: This badge requires a level 40 pony to wield, as its power draws from profound elemental energies that are only accessible to those of great experience and wisdom.
equestria_item_mk.73_kind_badges_of_reso.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce is known for their extensive network of trade with the most rare and powerful items, including these badges forged by the Crystal Heart's energy.
equestria_item_mk.73_kind_badges_of_reso.shippingDetail: The badges are shipped via a royal carriage, ensuring they reach their destination in pristine condition and within a matter of days.

usage.duration: Lasts for the duration of wear or until removed by the user.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes them from their person or if the wearer's concentration is broken.

equestria_item_mk.73_kind_badges_of_reso.priceReason: This badge offers powerful benefits that are highly sought after, but its rarity and the deep magic required to craft it keep its price at a moderate epic level of 1000 XP.

equestria_item_godly_harmony_shield_of_t.name: Godly Harmony Shield of the Aurate
equestria_item_godly_harmony_shield_of_t.description: The Godly Harmony Shield of the Aurate, a divine relic forged in the golden age before Equestria's creation, glimmers with an ethereal light that soothes and protects its bearer. Crafted from ancient, enchanted gold, it whispers the harmony that once governed the cosmos. This shield not only grants +60 armor value but also deflects negative magic back at its caster with 50% success rate. Its aura of peace can pacify nearby creatures, ensuring tranquility in times of strife.

effectDetails.title: Reflects Negative Magic
effectDetails.rules: When a negative magic attack is directed at the wielder, there is a 50% chance that the spell will be reflected back to its caster. This effect has no save DC and can occur once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Pacifies Nearby Creatures
effectDetails.rules: The shield emits an aura of harmony within a 30-foot radius, pacifying all hostile creatures within this area for the duration of one short or long rest. Hostile creatures must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the shield's influence until the end of their next turn.

equestria_item_godly_harmony_shield_of_t.levelRequirementReason: This shield requires significant spiritual and magical prowess to wield its divine power effectively.
equestria_item_godly_harmony_shield_of_t.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire, with its deep ties to ancient magic, is the keeper of this sacred relic.
equestria_item_godly_harmony_shield_of_t.shippingDetail: Ships via Starshard Courier Service, ensuring safe and swift delivery within a week.

usage.activation: Passive effect; activation required when negative magic or hostile creatures are present.
usage.duration: Until the end of each short or long rest for pacification effect; once per long rest for reflect effect.
usage.endsWhen: At the end of a long rest, unless negated by an external factor.

equestria_item_godly_harmony_shield_of_t.priceReason: The shield's divine craftsmanship and its rare magical properties justify its moderate price in experience points.

earth_land_item_lumina_chronos_ring.name: The Lumina Chronos Ring - Frostweaver's Echo
earth_land_item_lumina_chronos_ring.description: The Lumina Chronos Ring, a fragment of ancient frost magic encased in silver and ice, hums softly as it traps fleeting moments of frozen time. Crafted by long-dead wizards who sought to harness the essence of cold, this ring grants resistance to cold damage but warns that prolonged use can unravel the fabric of time itself, causing minor temporal distortions that might inadvertently heal small wounds or slow an enemy's movements.

effectDetails.title: Cold Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to cold damage. This effect is passive and lasts indefinitely while the ring is worn.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, the wearer can activate this effect to create a brief distortion of time, slowing an enemy's movement speed by half for 1 minute or until they make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15). On a success, the distortion ends immediately.

earth_land_item_lumina_chronos_ring.levelRequirementReason: The intricate magic and ancient lore required to wield this ring demand a high level of magical proficiency.
earth_land_item_lumina_chronos_ring.vendorReason: As a premier supplier of rare and ancient artifacts, Magic Shop is known for its vast collection of enchanted items, including the Lumina Chronos Ring.
earth_land_item_lumina_chronos_ring.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a fleet of winged delivery birds, ensuring that the ring arrives in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until an enemy makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15)
usage.endsWhen: An enemy successfully saves against the distortion or after 1 minute

earth_land_item_lumina_chronos_ring.priceReason: The ring's rarity and the complexity of its magic justify this price in experience points.

earth_land_item_sylvanus_hunter_amulet.name: Sylvanus’ Hunter Amulet - Echoes of the Verdant Wyrm
earth_land_item_sylvanus_hunter_amulet.description: Crafted from petrified dragonwood and imbued with the essence of a territorial ancient wyrm, Sylvanus’ Hunter Amulet - Echoes of the Verdant Wyrm enhances tracking skills and grants a primal connection to nature. When worn in forested areas, it increases movement speed (+25%) and allows the wearer to sense creatures within 30 meters. However, its power draws unwanted attention from woodland spirits, making it a dangerous yet invaluable tool for hunters and scouts.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains +25% to their movement speed while in forests. This effect is passive, providing a constant boost for the duration of the amulet's wear.

effectDetails.title: Sense Nearby Creatures
effectDetails.rules: Active within 30 meters, this ability allows the user to sense nearby creatures, granting advantage on Perception checks related to locating hidden or camouflaged targets. The effect lasts until the wearer stops concentrating (as a bonus action) or is interrupted by another creature.

earth_land_item_sylvanus_hunter_amulet.levelRequirementReason: This amulet's power and complexity demand a high level of proficiency from its user.
earth_land_item_sylvanus_hunter_amulet.vendorReason: The Earth Emporium specializes in items that harmonize with nature, making it the perfect vendor for this enchanted amulet.
earth_land_item_sylvanus_hunter_amulet.shippingDetail: Shipped by a giant beetle courier, the delivery can take up to three days depending on local terrain.

usage.activation: Passive effect. Concentration is required to end the sense nearby creatures ability (as a bonus action).
usage.duration: Concentration until ended or interrupted.
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends (bonus action) or when the wearer is attacked by another creature.

earth_land_item_sylvanus_hunter_amulet.priceReason: The amulet's rare materials and complex enchantments justify its moderate price.

earth_land_item_aethelred_skycaller.name: Aethelred’s Skycaller - Celestial Resonance Shard
earth_land_item_aethelred_skycaller.description: Aethelred’s Skycaller—Celestial Resonance Shard is a glowing bone shard carved with ancient runes. It hums softly, its light flickering with the essence of fallen celestial dragons. The wielder can summon this power to create protective barriers that absorb magical damage and dispel minor enchantments, or unleash a radiant blast that disrupts and repels arcane threats. Overuse risks attracting the attention of higher-dimensional entities seeking the shard’s secrets.

effectDetails.title: Protective Barrier
effectDetails.rules: The wielder can activate this effect as a bonus action to create a 10-foot-radius, 15-foot-tall barrier that absorbs up to 2d8 + 4 magic damage. It lasts for 1 minute and ends if the wearer takes any non-magical damage.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Disruption
effectDetails.rules: Activating this effect as a reaction allows the wielder to disrupt one spell or magical attack targeting them, dealing 2d6 radiant damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the caster.

earth_land_item_aethelred_skycaller.levelRequirementReason: The shard’s power requires significant magical knowledge and experience to wield safely.
earth_land_item_aethelred_skycaller.vendorReason: The guild has access to ancient relics and artifacts, including this powerful shard.
earth_land_item_aethelred_skycaller.shippingDetail: Shipped by swift griffins, the item arrives within a week of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until disrupted
usage.endsWhen: wearer takes non-magical damage, spell ends, or effect is dispelled

earth_land_item_aethelred_skycaller.priceReason: The shard’s rarity and the risks of overuse justify its high price.

earth_land_item_the_frostbound_dragons_s.name: The Frostbound Dragons' Song
earth_land_item_the_frostbound_dragons_s.description: The Frostbound Dragons' Song is a leather-bound grimoire, its pages shimmering with crystalline frost and etched with arcane symbols that whisper of ancient magic. The book's aura is both chilling and enchanting, as if the very air around it hums with forgotten dragon songs. With each turn, the reader feels an icy chill seep into their bones, yet they are fortified against the cold, gaining resilience to frost damage and a natural affinity for ice spells.

effectDetails.title: Frost Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: The user gains resistance to cold damage while holding The Frostbound Dragons' Song. This effect lasts until the end of their next turn, providing a +30% bonus to their AC and saving throws against frost-based attacks.

effectDetails.title: Glacial Resonance
effectDetails.rules: Activating this effect requires the user to chant a forgotten dragon melody as a bonus action. It creates an icy aura around them for 1 minute, dealing 15d6 cold damage in a 20-foot cone once per day.

earth_land_item_the_frostbound_dragons_s.levelRequirementReason: This grimoire is too powerful and complex to be mastered by less experienced users.
earth_land_item_the_frostbound_dragons_s.vendorReason: Only the Guild Quartermaster, with a deep understanding of ancient magic, can verify that only those capable of handling such power deserve it.
earth_land_item_the_frostbound_dragons_s.shippingDetail: The Ice Wraith Courier delivers this item wrapped in enchanted frost crystals to ensure its safe arrival.

usage.activation: Bonus action for Glacial Resonance; passive effect of Frost Resistance Boost while holding the book.
usage.duration: Glacial Resonance lasts for 1 minute, ending when the user stops chanting or is incapacitated. Frost Resistance Boost lasts until the end of their next turn and recharges at dawn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user is incapacitated or no longer holds The Frostbound Dragons' Song.
usage.charges: One daily use for Glacial Resonance.

earth_land_item_the_frostbound_dragons_s.priceReason: This item's rarity and powerful effects justify its high price, ensuring only those who truly need it can afford it.

earth_land_item_the_geothermic_resonator.name: The Geothermic Resonator of Old Grimstone
earth_land_item_the_geothermic_resonator.description: The Geothermic Resonator of Old Grimstone is an intricate device forged from petrified magma and arcane metals, pulsing with latent earth heat. Its weighty frame hums with subterranean thermal currents, granting the wielder a fleeting connection to the fiery heart of the planet. When activated, it generates a faint heat signature that can temporarily blind foes, while also allowing the user to create small geysers that deal fire damage to nearby targets.

effectDetails.title: Geothermal Heat Aura
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this device creates a faint heat signature in a 10-foot radius around the user. Creatures within this area have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws for 1 minute or until they leave the aura.

effectDetails.title: Subterranean Geyser
effectDetails.rules: Activating the resonator allows the user to create a small geyser in a point of their choice within range. This geyser deals 30d6 fire damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius, including the target if they are within this area. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until dispelled.

earth_land_item_the_geothermic_resonator.levelRequirementReason: This item's raw power demands that even low-level characters should exercise caution and skill to wield it effectively.
earth_land_item_the_geothermic_resonator.vendorReason: The Geothermic Resonator is a cornerstone of the Earth Emporium’s collection, offering adventurers a glimpse into ancient earth magic.
earth_land_item_the_geothermic_resonator.shippingDetail: Delivery via Magma Runner ensures the resonator arrives in pristine condition, protected from any external elements that could disrupt its power.

usage.activation: Bonus action to create heat signature or geyser
usage.duration: 1 minute for each effect
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the duration expires or the device is destroyed
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but recharges after a long rest

earth_land_item_the_geothermic_resonator.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides potent fire damage capabilities and area effects without being overpowered.

earth_land_item_the_arcane_shard_of_glac.name: The Arcane Shard of Glacial Memory
earth_land_item_the_arcane_shard_of_glac.description: The Arcane Shard of Glacial Memory is a jagged fragment of an ancient ice wall, its surface flecked with glacial runoff and etched with runes that whisper forgotten lore. Holding it grants fleeting glimpses into the past, revealing hidden passages or clues when you least expect them; however, these visions are often fragmented and unsettling. The shard can also briefly allow communication with spirits trapped within the ice wall, though the connection is tenuous at best, leaving users feeling both enlightened and haunted.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: When you interact with a wall or door, there is a 10% chance that the shard reveals an unseen passage or hidden mechanism. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Communicate with Spirits
effectDetails.rules: You can attempt to communicate with spirits trapped within the ice wall by concentrating on it for 1 hour. There is a 25% chance that you successfully contact one spirit, which provides cryptic advice or information. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per day.

earth_land_item_the_arcane_shard_of_glac.levelRequirementReason: This shard requires significant arcane knowledge to interpret its visions accurately.
earth_land_item_the_arcane_shard_of_glac.vendorReason: The magic shop specializes in ancient artifacts and relics from forgotten ages, making it the ideal vendor for such an item.
earth_land_item_the_arcane_shard_of_glac.shippingDetail: Ships via Spectral Messenger at no additional cost; may arrive with a mysterious note attached.

usage.activation: Passive effect when holding the shard.
usage.duration: 1 minute for 'Reveal Hidden Passages'; varies by spirit contact attempt.
usage.endsWhen: The long rest or daily limit is reached.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited by use per day and rest.

earth_land_item_the_arcane_shard_of_glac.priceReason: This shard’s rarity and the knowledge required to utilize it justify its price in experience points.

almost_edge_item_fringe_caller_of_void_r.name: The Fringe Caller's Whispers
almost_edge_item_fringe_caller_of_void_r.description: The Fringe Caller's Whispers are fractured obsidian orbs that hum with the distant echoes of realities just beyond perception. When held, they grant fleeting glimpses into the swirling chaos of the void’s fringe, offering a terrifyingly beautiful understanding of existence. The caller can perceive subtle shadows and whispers from realms unseen, yet these fragments come at a cost—chance inflicts 'Cosmic Dissonance,' causing minor hallucinations that blur one's sense of reality.

effectDetails.title: Glimpse into the Void
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The user gains advantage on Perception checks for 1 minute. Ends if the user is incapacitated or drops the orb.

effectDetails.title: Hallucinatory Echoes
effectDetails.rules: There is a 20% chance (DC 13) that holding the orb inflicts 'Cosmic Dissonance,' causing minor hallucinations for 1d4 rounds. The user can make a Wisdom saving throw to resist. Ends if the user takes any action other than resting.

almost_edge_item_fringe_caller_of_void_r.levelRequirementReason: The caller must have the mental fortitude to withstand the void's whispers.
almost_edge_item_fringe_caller_of_void_r.vendorReason: As a merchant of the strange and arcane, the edge wanderer is well-acquainted with such curiosities.
almost_edge_item_fringe_caller_of_void_r.shippingDetail: The courier ensures safe delivery through interdimensional turbulence.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until incapacitated/dropped
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or dropping the orb
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharging after a long rest

almost_edge_item_fringe_caller_of_void_r.priceReason: The item's rarity and its ability to provide both useful perception bonuses and potential hazards justify its high price.

almost_edge_item_fabled_caller_of_the_ab.name: Fabled Caller’s Whispers of the Abyss
almost_edge_item_fabled_caller_of_the_ab.description: The Fabled Caller’s Whispers of the Abyss is a device forged from solidified twilight, its surface pulsing with an unsettling violet light that hints at the abyssal realms. It whispers secrets in darkened chambers and can warp reality to reveal hidden passages, though those who listen too long may find their minds twisted by the void’s influence. This artifact grants temporary speed boosts and the ability to see through illusions, but its whispers are not always welcome.

effectDetails.title: Illusion Piercer
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action in an area of dim light or darkness, the user can attempt to see through one illusion within 30 feet. The illusion has a 50% chance of being exposed for 1 minute. If successful, the user gains advantage on perception checks related to that illusion.

effectDetails.title: Swift Step
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action and increases the user’s walking speed by +10 feet until the end of their next turn. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

almost_edge_item_fabled_caller_of_the_ab.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 5th level to wield an artifact that warps reality and enhances perception.
almost_edge_item_fabled_caller_of_the_ab.vendorReason: The void merchant deals in rare and ancient artifacts, including this device crafted from the twilight of the abyss.
almost_edge_item_fabled_caller_of_the_ab.shippingDetail: Delivery via a mysterious black courier, arriving at night with no visible means of transport.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction to activate either effect.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Illusion Piercer; +10 feet walking speed until end of next turn for Swift Step.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short or long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharged on a long rest.

almost_edge_item_fabled_caller_of_the_ab.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP due to its unique abilities and the risk of mental effects from prolonged use.

almost_edge_item_mk_52_fringe_whispers_o.name: Mk.52 Fringe Whispers of the Fractured Plane
almost_edge_item_mk_52_fringe_whispers_o.description: The Mk.52 Fringe Whispers of the Fractured Plane is a device forged from the fractured remnants of another dimension, its iridescent glass shards pulsing with raw, chaotic energy. It emits a constant stream of disjointed thoughts and memories that can disrupt even the sturdiest mind. Despite its unsettling nature, it grants fleeting moments where the user can phase through solid objects, a phenomenon both eerie and potentially life-saving in certain situations.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Whispers
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this device emits an unsettling stream of fragmented thoughts that reduce the user's focus by -10. This effect lasts for a duration of 90 seconds and has no save DC. The item can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Phasing Touch
effectDetails.rules: The user gains the ability to phase through solid objects, but this effect is limited to brief moments (1d4 rounds). There's a low chance of failure with each attempt, requiring a successful DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. The item can be used once per long rest.

almost_edge_item_mk_52_fringe_whispers_o.levelRequirementReason: The device requires significant mental fortitude and experience to handle its chaotic energy.
almost_edge_item_mk_52_fringe_whispers_o.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in items from other dimensions, making the Mk.52 a fitting addition to their inventory.
almost_edge_item_mk_52_fringe_whispers_o.shippingDetail: Shipping is expedited via Quantum Courier, ensuring it arrives safely and on time.

usage.activation: A bonus action to activate or deactivate the device.
usage.duration: Disruptive Whispers lasts for 90 seconds. Phasing Touch has a duration of 1d4 rounds per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires, and the item is used up once per day/rest limit.
usage.charges: Uses are limited to one per long rest or day.

almost_edge_item_mk_52_fringe_whispers_o.priceReason: The device's rarity, origin, and unique abilities justify its high price in the market.

leclaire_isle_item_sugared_cookies_of_co.name: The Sugared Cookies of Cozy
leclaire_isle_item_sugared_cookies_of_co.description: The Sugared Cookies of Cozy are delicate pastries crafted from the finest flour and honey, said to bring warmth to even the coldest Dough Folk heart. Each cookie exudes a comforting aroma that lingers in the air like the scent of a hearthfire, perfect for restoring spirits during quiet contemplation or moments of joyous celebration. Consuming one grants a fleeting sense of contentment, as if the world has slowed to match the pace of the sweet treat.

effectDetails.title: Restore Health
effectDetails.rules: Eating one cookie restores 10 hit points. The effect is instantaneous and does not require an action.

effectDetails.title: Charisma Boost
effectDetails.rules: For the following round, the consumer gains a +2 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks and saving throws. This boost lasts for three rounds.

leclaire_isle_item_sugared_cookies_of_co.levelRequirementReason: These cookies are simple yet effective, suitable for adventurers of all levels.
leclaire_isle_item_sugared_cookies_of_co.vendorReason: Dough Depot is known throughout the realm for its delicious pastries and treats, including these comforting cookies.
leclaire_isle_item_sugared_cookies_of_co.shippingDetail: The rolling cart delivers these sweet delights with a cheerful rhythm, ensuring they are always fresh upon arrival.

usage.duration: Instantaneous for health restoration; +2 Charisma (Performance) bonus lasts three rounds
usage.endsWhen: Effect of Charisma boost ends after the specified duration or if eaten again before timing out

leclaire_isle_item_sugared_cookies_of_co.priceReason: The premium quality ingredients and the unique magical properties of these cookies justify their higher price.

leclaire_isle_item_jade_binder_sugared_c.name: Jade Binder's Sugared Cookies
leclaire_isle_item_jade_binder_sugared_c.description: Jade Binder's Sugared Cookies are crafted from rare jade-infused dough and delicately sugared, rumored to be favored by ancient Baker Kings of L’Eclaire Isle. These confections momentarily bind chaotic energies, slowing enemy movements for a brief respite and granting the eater temporary protection. Each cookie not only tempers the chaos but also offers a fleeting burst of sugary energy, enhancing one's speed for a moment before all is calm again.

effectDetails.title: Chaotic Bind
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the eater may use an action to bind nearby chaotic forces for 5 turns. Enemies within a 10-foot radius have their movement speed reduced by 50%. This effect ends when it expires or if the consumer takes any damage.

effectDetails.title: Armor Boost
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the eater gains +2 to AC as a bonus action that lasts for 1 minute. This boost is not cumulative with other armor bonuses and ends once the duration expires.

leclaire_isle_item_jade_binder_sugared_c.levelRequirementReason: The intricate crafting of these cookies requires a fair amount of skill and knowledge, suitable only for those at least level 5.
leclaire_isle_item_jade_binder_sugared_c.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is known for its unique confections that harness the power of L’Eclaire Isle's ancient lore, making Jade Binder's Sugared Cookies a natural addition to their offerings.
leclaire_isle_item_jade_binder_sugared_c.shippingDetail: Ships via Pastry Palace’s proprietary delivery drone, ensuring the cookies arrive fresh and intact.

usage.duration: 5 turns or until the consumer takes damage
usage.endsWhen: expires after duration or if consumer takes damage

leclaire_isle_item_jade_binder_sugared_c.priceReason: The rare ingredients and ancient crafting techniques required to produce these cookies justify their high price in experience points.

leclaire_isle_item_mk.38_sugared_cookies.name: Mk.38 Sugared Cookies
leclaire_isle_item_mk.38_sugared_cookies.description: The Mk.38 Sugared Cookies are meticulously crafted from ancient recipes, their sugar crystals glistening like stars in the moonlight. When consumed, these treats not only enhance your perception but also unlock hidden pathways within L'Eclaire Isle's labyrinthine tunnels for a brief moment. The cookies' aroma is said to transport you to forgotten culinary realms, granting you a fleeting taste of the past and opening secret routes that can aid your journey through the island’s mysteries.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Passages
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, you gain the ability to see and map out hidden tunnels within L'Eclaire Isle for 60 seconds. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption and does not require any action.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Perception
effectDetails.rules: For the next two turns, your perception checks are made at advantage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn after consuming the cookies.

leclaire_isle_item_mk.38_sugared_cookies.levelRequirementReason: These cookies are accessible to all adventurers as a way to enhance their exploration and discovery in L'Eclaire Isle.
leclaire_isle_item_mk.38_sugared_cookies.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies prides itself on offering unique and magical treats, making it the perfect vendor for these legendary cookies.
leclaire_isle_item_mk.38_sugared_cookies.shippingDetail: Delivered by a fleet of mythical snails, ensuring your cookies arrive fresh from L'Eclaire Isle's kitchens.

usage.duration: 60 seconds and two turns
usage.endsWhen: Effect expires or you take damage

leclaire_isle_item_mk.38_sugared_cookies.priceReason: The cookies are priced at a moderate level, reflecting their unique recipe and the effort to bring them from L'Eclaire Isle.

internet_item_compressed_keys_of_viral_s.name: The Compressed Keys of Viral Storm
internet_item_compressed_keys_of_viral_s.description: The Compressed Keys of Viral Storm are forged from solidified data streams, their surface etched with the remnants of a thousand viral trends. When wielded, they grant momentary immunity to unwanted meme exposure and allow for brief bursts of accelerated thought, doubling one's mental processing speed. These keys hum with latent energy, ready to unleash a minor surge that restores 5% of the bearer's hit points when activated.

effectDetails.title: Viral Immunity
effectDetails.rules: The Compressed Keys provide momentary immunity to unwanted meme exposure. This effect lasts for 60 seconds and can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Accelerated Thought
effectDetails.rules: While holding the keys, the user's mental processing speed is doubled, granting a +2 bonus to Intelligence (Insight) checks and saving throws. This effect lasts for 1 minute, but ends if the user takes any damage.

internet_item_compressed_keys_of_viral_s.levelRequirementReason: The Compressed Keys of Viral Storm require a minimum level to ensure their effects are balanced with the player's overall capabilities.
internet_item_compressed_keys_of_viral_s.vendorReason: Data Dealer specializes in cutting-edge technology, including items that enhance mental acuity and data processing, making them an ideal vendor for these keys.
internet_item_compressed_keys_of_viral_s.shippingDetail: Delivered within the hour with priority handling.

usage.duration: 60 seconds or until the user takes damage, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if the user takes any damage or after its duration expires

internet_item_compressed_keys_of_viral_s.priceReason: The Compressed Keys of Viral Storm are priced at 1000 XP to reflect their balanced and limited-use effects, ensuring they remain a valuable but not overpowered tool for players.

internet_item_jeweled_forged_nodes_of_th.name: Jeweled Forged's Nodes of the Lost Signal
internet_item_jeweled_forged_nodes_of_th.description: The Jeweled Forged Nodes of the Lost Signal are intricately crafted from salvaged network architecture, their surfaces shimmering with a faint, melancholic signal that hums through the ether. These nodes allow you to tap into forgotten data streams, potentially uncovering valuable information or experiencing echoes of past online interactions. As you immerse yourself in their resonance, they emit a soft glow, hinting at the vast and often overlooked digital archives from which they were forged.
effects: Brief Echo of Past Online Interaction

effectDetails.title: Brief Echo of Past Online Interaction
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the nodes to briefly immerse yourself in a nostalgic echo of past online interactions. This effect lasts for 30 seconds and grants you advantage on one Intelligence (Computers) check per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Probability of Discovering Hidden Data
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the nodes, your chance to discover hidden data increases by +5%. Additionally, if you fail an Intelligence (Computers) check, you have a 10% chance of uncovering useful information about the failed task.

internet_item_jeweled_forged_nodes_of_th.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least fourth level to handle the complex and delicate nature of the nodes.
internet_item_jeweled_forged_nodes_of_th.vendorReason: The pixel shop specializes in unique and rare digital curiosities, making these nodes a fitting addition to their inventory.
internet_item_jeweled_forged_nodes_of_th.shippingDetail: Standard delivery time is two game days.

usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect expires, or if you are incapacitated.

internet_item_jeweled_forged_nodes_of_th.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it provides useful but not overwhelmingly powerful abilities.

internet_item_mk_77_compressed_tokens_of.name: Mk.77 Compressed Tokens of the Algorithmic Echo
internet_item_mk_77_compressed_tokens_of.description: The Mk.77 Compressed Tokens of the Algorithmic Echo are sleek, metallic discs imbued with the essence of countless digital computations. When activated, they create a brief, localized distortion that warps data streams and momentarily shields your communications from prying eyes. These tokens are the result of advanced cybernetic alchemy, crafted by the Cyber Market to protect users in an increasingly surveilled world. Each pulse is a testament to their creators' ingenuity, capable of disrupting digital surveillance for mere moments but leaving no trace behind.

effectDetails.title: Digital Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, the Mk.77 generates a localized distortion field that disrupts digital surveillance within a 10-foot radius for 5 seconds. This effect has no save DC and does not require concentration.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Shield
effectDetails.rules: The tokens create a temporal shield around you, reducing the chance of being detected by digital surveillance by 20% (10%) per token used, for up to 5 minutes. This effect is cumulative with multiple tokens and cannot exceed a 30% reduction.

internet_item_mk_77_compressed_tokens_of.levelRequirementReason: The Mk.77 Compressed Tokens are accessible to any user who can afford the price, as their primary function is data protection.
internet_item_mk_77_compressed_tokens_of.vendorReason: The Cyber Market specializes in cutting-edge technology and cybersecurity solutions, making these tokens a natural addition to their inventory.
internet_item_mk_77_compressed_tokens_of.shippingDetail: Tokens are delivered within the hour via express courier, ensuring they arrive fresh and ready for use.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; Digital Distortion lasts 5 seconds; Temporal Shield lasts up to 5 minutes (cumulative with tokens)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you deactivate it, and no recharges are required.

internet_item_mk_77_compressed_tokens_of.priceReason: The Mk.77 Compressed Tokens offer a unique blend of immediate protection against digital surveillance combined with extended temporal shielding, making them a valuable tool for anyone in need of cybersecurity.

kivotos_item_kaleidoscopic_ward_of_reson.name: Kaleidoscopic Ward's Cards - Echoes of the Assembly
kivotos_item_kaleidoscopic_ward_of_reson.description: These shimmering cards, etched with intricate patterns resembling the winding hallways of Academy City's classrooms, hum softly when held. They grant brief glimpses into the collective thoughts of those within the city’s bounds—a chaotic yet occasionally insightful experience that reveals snippets of student musings and academic ambitions. Holding them increases perception by 10% for 30 seconds, enhancing one's ability to notice subtle social cues. However, the cards also cause minor auditory hallucinations, which can be either pleasant or unsettling depending on the moment.

effectDetails.title: Briefly Reveals Thoughts
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this card grants the holder a brief insight into the thoughts of nearby students within Academy City for 30 seconds. The effect causes minor auditory hallucinations that last until the duration ends.

effectDetails.title: Enhances Perception
effectDetails.rules: While holding these cards, the user's perception is increased by 10%, allowing them to notice subtle social cues more easily. This benefit lasts for 30 seconds and can be renewed once per short or long rest.

kivotos_item_kaleidoscopic_ward_of_reson.levelRequirementReason: Only students with a foundational understanding of Academy City's inner workings would find this item useful.
kivotos_item_kaleidoscopic_ward_of_reson.vendorReason: The Student Store caters to the unique academic and social needs of its patrons, offering items that enhance their experience within Academy City.
kivotos_item_kaleidoscopic_ward_of_reson.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly via Academy City's drone network for immediate use in classrooms or libraries.

usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends, or the card is used again during a short or long rest

kivotos_item_kaleidoscopic_ward_of_reson.priceReason: The item's rarity and limited availability justify its price in terms of both knowledge and utility.

kivotos_item_elite_card_of_lumina_protec.name: The Mk.68 Elite Cards - Lumina Guardian Ward
kivotos_item_elite_card_of_lumina_protec.description: The Mk.68 Elite Cards - Lumina Guardian Ward are forged from solidified light harvested during a student performance, imbuing them with a protective aura against mental disruption. These cards are incredibly fragile and require careful handling; mishandling can shatter their power before it fully activates. When activated, they create a shimmering shield around the user for 60 seconds, deflecting mental attacks and reducing negative emotions by 15%. Occasionally, they emit a burst of radiant energy, stunning nearby enemies momentarily.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Shield
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Creates a shimmering shield around the user for 60 seconds, providing +5 resistance to all mental damage and saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

effectDetails.title: Mental Resilience
effectDetails.rules: Passively reduces negative emotions by 15% within a 30-foot radius. Ends when the user is no longer within the radius of another Radiant Shield effect.

kivotos_item_elite_card_of_lumina_protec.levelRequirementReason: The delicate nature of these cards requires a user with basic understanding and control over their mental state.
