kivotos_item_elite_card_of_lumina_protec.vendorReason: The academy armory is known for its unique and specialized items, including this elite grade protection device.
kivotos_item_elite_card_of_lumina_protec.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Courier Pigeon; the cards must be handled with care during transit to preserve their integrity.

usage.duration: 60 seconds, recharges after a short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The user is no longer within the radius of another Radiant Shield effect or if the card breaks.

kivotos_item_elite_card_of_lumina_protec.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, reflecting its unique properties and the rare materials required for crafting these elite protection cards.

kivotos_item_forbidden_shard_of_divine_d.name: The Chronal Discord - Godly Fragment of the Silent Judgement
kivotos_item_forbidden_shard_of_divine_d.description: The Chronal Discord - Godly Fragment of the Silent Judgement is a cold, crystalline shard that hums with the raw power of time itself. When activated, it ripples the fabric of reality within a 10-foot radius, causing temporal anomalies and echoes of past events to manifest. Its wielder must endure a harrowing ordeal: the risk of immediate madness as the fabric of time bends around them. Only those who have mastered the art of chaos and paradox dare handle this forbidden relic.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Anomalies
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Chronal Discord disrupts the local temporal flow. Enemies within a 10-foot radius must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be knocked prone and suffer 5d6 force damage. The effect lasts for 1 minute per caster level.

effectDetails.title: Echoes of the Past
effectDetails.rules: The shard summons fleeting echoes that provide advantage on History checks within 30 feet, but also impose disadvantage on Perception checks due to the constant shifting of events. This effect persists for 1 hour or until dispelled by a successful DC 25 Con saving throw.

kivotos_item_forbidden_shard_of_divine_d.levelRequirementReason: The fragment's raw power demands a caster who has honed their skills in temporal magic.
kivotos_item_forbidden_shard_of_divine_d.vendorReason: The shadow merchant, known for trading in the most dangerous and forbidden items, is rumored to have secured this relic from an ancient, forgotten temple.
kivotos_item_forbidden_shard_of_divine_d.shippingDetail: Delivery via Chrono Express ensures the fragile nature of the shard remains intact during transit, but it comes with a steep delivery fee.

usage.duration: Instantaneous activation; effect duration varies
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when dispelled or the duration expires
usage.charges: Unlimited, as long as the shard remains intact

kivotos_item_forbidden_shard_of_divine_d.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the potential for catastrophic temporal events it can cause justify its high price.

equestria_item_chronoflow_bits.name: The Chronoflow Bits of Twilight's Echoes
equestria_item_chronoflow_bits.description: The Chronoflow Bits of Twilight's Echoes are iridescent, time-warped fragments that whisper of past moments and secret histories. Crafted from the very fabric of Equestria’s temporal winds, these bits can briefly correct minor mishaps in action or perception. A dropped item can be reclaimed, a missed step corrected, or a poorly aimed kick rectified with this bit. However, overuse risks creating unstable time ripples that could disrupt the natural flow of events.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Correction
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a reaction to a minor mishap, this bit rewinds the last action by up to 5 feet. The user gains advantage on the next ability check or attack roll made immediately after activation. This effect can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Risk of Temporal Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Overusing these bits increases the risk of causing minor temporal distortions, which have a 10% chance to occur with each use beyond three activations in a single day. These distortions cause dizziness and reduce movement speed by half for 1 minute.

equestria_item_chronoflow_bits.levelRequirementReason: Requires basic understanding of time manipulation.
equestria_item_chronoflow_bits.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce deals in rare and powerful magical artifacts, including items that can manipulate time.
equestria_item_chronoflow_bits.shippingDetail: Ships via the Royal Pegasus Courier with express delivery within a week.

usage.activation: Reaction to correct a minor mishap.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until action is corrected or next short rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the last action is corrected, or at the start of the user's next turn if no correction is made.

equestria_item_chronoflow_bits.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item with limited daily stock to ensure its value and scarcity.

equestria_item_crystalline_heartshard.name: Mk.78 Crystalline Heartshard of Fluttershy's Sanctuary
equestria_item_crystalline_heartshard.description: The Mk.78 Crystalline Heartshard of Fluttershy’s Sanctuary is a shimmering fragment harvested from the core of her sacred sanctuary, radiating an ethereal glow that resonates with the gentle essence of ponies and nature alike. This shard amplifies empathy and persuasion skills, but those who dwell too long near it may find their emotions running wild, overwhelmed by waves of compassion. It can pacify agitated creatures within a 10-foot radius, reducing aggression and bolstering one’s own compassionate resolve.

effectDetails.title: Empathy Amplifier
effectDetails.rules: The user gains advantage on Persuasion checks. This effect lasts until the end of their next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Aggression Reduction
effectDetails.rules: Any creature within a 10-foot radius of the user has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws against fear effects for 1 minute, unless they succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. The effect ends early if the creature moves more than 30 feet away.

equestria_item_crystalline_heartshard.levelRequirementReason: Requires a certain level to harness its empathetic and persuasive power effectively.
equestria_item_crystalline_heartshard.vendorReason: Fluttershy, the sanctuary’s caretaker, personally curates this item for those in need of her gentle wisdom.
equestria_item_crystalline_heartshard.shippingDetail: Ships within one day, delivered by a trusted member of the Equestrian Post.

usage.duration: 1 minute per short or long rest for Empathy Amplifier. Aggression Reduction lasts 1 minute and ends early if conditions change.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the duration expires, the user moves more than 30 feet away from affected creatures, or the user is incapacitated.

equestria_item_crystalline_heartshard.priceReason: Balanced price reflects its rarity and utility for those who need to enhance empathy and persuasion in challenging situations.

equestria_item_cursed_bits_of_shadowhoof.name: The Cursed Bits of Shadowhoof's Lament
equestria_item_cursed_bits_of_shadowhoof.description: The Cursed Bits of Shadowhoof's Lament are obsidian-black fragments forged in the darkest corners of Equestria by a long-lost shadow pony. These relics grant incredible physical prowess, but they do so at a terrible cost: they slowly corrupt the user’s spirit with despair and paranoia, eroding willpower over time. Only those who have faced their deepest fears can wield these cursed bits without succumbing to madness.

effectDetails.title: Incredible Strength
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the user gains a +4 bonus to Strength and Constitution saving throws. This effect lasts for 1 hour per level of the user. The activation requires an action.

effectDetails.title: Magical Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The user gains temporary resistance to all magical attacks equal to half their proficiency bonus (minimum of +2). This effect persists until expended or until the user is knocked unconscious.

equestria_item_cursed_bits_of_shadowhoof.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to ensure users can handle the mental toll.
equestria_item_cursed_bits_of_shadowhoof.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire, with its deep connection to magic and shadow lore, holds these relics in a private vault for those who truly understand their power.
equestria_item_cursed_bits_of_shadowhoof.shippingDetail: The Dark Pegasus Messenger ensures the safe delivery of such dangerous items by nightfall.

usage.duration: 1 hour per level
usage.endsWhen: User is knocked unconscious or until expended
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use drains a small portion of the user's willpower

equestria_item_cursed_bits_of_shadowhoof.priceReason: Balanced to ensure the item remains powerful yet not overpowered for its level.

the_edge_item_infernal_striker_s_memorie.name: Infernal Striker’s Memories – Echoes of the Unwritten
the_edge_item_infernal_striker_s_memorie.description: The Infernal Striker’s Memories – Echoes of the Unwritten is a jagged obsidian shard, pulsating with the heat of forgotten battles. Each pulse grants fleeting visions that offer strategic foresight, while also risk unraveling your own memories if exposed too long. This relic is said to be crafted from the very essence of a warforged warrior who fought in the infernal planes, and its effects are as unpredictable as the flames of hell itself.

effectDetails.title: Strategic Insight
effectDetails.rules: When activated by an action, you gain a +10 bonus to Perception checks for 60 seconds. The shard then releases its visions, which can be either helpful or disturbing. There is a 5% chance that these visions will cause temporary madness (-2 to Wisdom until the next long rest).

effectDetails.title: Phantom Pain
effectDetails.rules: There is a 10% chance that the visions will inflict 'Phantom Pain', dealing 1d6 psychic damage each round for three rounds. This effect can only occur once per short or long rest.

the_edge_item_infernal_striker_s_memorie.levelRequirementReason: Only those with experience in the infernal realms can harness this relic's unpredictable power.
the_edge_item_infernal_striker_s_memorie.vendorReason: The abyssal traders have a unique connection to infernal artifacts, making them the only reliable source for such a dangerous yet fascinating relic.
the_edge_item_infernal_striker_s_memorie.shippingDetail: Ships via the Hellfire Courier, known for its swift and often perilous deliveries through the infernal planes.

usage.duration: 60 seconds per use.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are no longer within range or if you take a short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each use has a chance to cause temporary madness.

the_edge_item_infernal_striker_s_memorie.priceReason: This relic is priced high due to its rarity and the potential risks it poses to its wielder.

the_edge_item_mk_24_endless_memories.name: Mk.24 Endless Memories – The Cartographer's Lament
the_edge_item_mk_24_endless_memories.description: The Mk.24 Endless Memories – The Cartographer's Lament is a tightly wound sphere of solidified regret, purportedly a record of a cartographer who mapped the shifting edges of reality. When touched, it floods your mind with fragmented maps and desperate calculations—each fragment an attempt to impose order on the chaotic world around you. In unfamiliar environments, your movement speed increases by 10%, but at the cost of slowly draining your sanity, reducing it by -1 per hour of prolonged use.

effectDetails.title: Improved Cartography Skills
effectDetails.rules: This item grants a +5 bonus to Cartography skill checks. The effect is active as long as you hold the sphere in your hand. You must make an Intelligence (Cartography) check each time you attempt to map or decipher a complex terrain, and this bonus applies to that roll.

effectDetails.title: Spatial Awareness
effectDetails.rules: When in unfamiliar environments, you gain a +10 foot bonus to your movement speed. This effect lasts for 1 hour after the first use but does not stack with other similar effects. The item's use ends if you enter a familiar environment or if you lose contact with it (e.g., by dropping it).

the_edge_item_mk_24_endless_memories.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for high-level adventurers who have faced the complexities of mapping and navigating dangerous, unfamiliar terrains.
the_edge_item_mk_24_endless_memories.vendorReason: Edge Outpost specializes in rare and ancient artifacts that can aid explorers and cartographers in their endeavors.
the_edge_item_mk_24_endless_memories.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature, the item is shipped via Dimensional Transit's secure and swift courier service with extra padding.

usage.activation: This item provides effects as long as it remains held in your hand or carried on you. The Spatial Awareness effect lasts for 1 hour after the first use.
usage.duration: Active as long as held, Spatial Awareness lasts 1 hour from the first activation.
usage.endsWhen: The item's effects end if you lose contact with it (e.g., by dropping it) or enter a familiar environment. The Spatial Awareness effect ends after 1 hour.

the_edge_item_mk_24_endless_memories.priceReason: This price reflects the item's rarity, its utility in complex terrains, and its ability to enhance critical skills for high-level adventurers.

the_edge_item_forbidden_chronal_fragment.name: Forbidden Chronal Fragments – The Obsidian Shard’s Lament
the_edge_item_forbidden_chronal_fragment.description: The Forbidden Chronal Fragments – The Obsidian Shard’s Lament are seven jagged, crystallized shards of time that hum ominously in your palm. Their touch sends shivers down your spine as they warp reality around you, revealing glimpses into alternate timelines. Each shard holds the weight of a universe, and their combined power can bend the fabric of space-time, though doing so risks creating temporal paradoxes that could unravel the very order of existence.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: Once per day, you can activate one shard to attempt a short-range temporal jump. This effect lasts up to 1 minute and grants you advantage on all saving throws related to time manipulation for that duration. There is a 20% chance of inadvertently creating a paradox upon activation.

effectDetails.title: Reality Distortion
effectDetails.rules: While holding the shards, you gain temporary resistance +20 against temporal effects and attacks. However, this power comes at a cost: there's a 15% chance each day that using or simply touching them will trigger an unpredictable reality shift within your immediate area.

the_edge_item_forbidden_chronal_fragment.levelRequirementReason: Even the most inexperienced adventurers can wield these shards, as their raw power is not fully realized until they are mastered.
the_edge_item_forbidden_chronal_fragment.vendorReason: The final shop caters to those who seek forbidden knowledge and powerful artifacts that challenge the very fabric of reality.
the_edge_item_forbidden_chronal_fragment.shippingDetail: Ships via a dimensional rift, ensuring immediate delivery but increasing the risk of paradoxes in transit.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per day (Temporal Manipulation)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration expires or if a paradox is created.

the_edge_item_forbidden_chronal_fragment.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, these shards are moderately priced for their significant power and risk.

grand_country_item_gravitic_helix_caller.name: The Karmic Caller’s Spiral Ascender
grand_country_item_gravitic_helix_caller.description: The Karmic Caller’s Spiral Ascender is a delicate artifact, forged from the very essence of gravity and iridescent layer-silk. This spiral ascends with a melodic pulse, allowing its wielder to defy gravity momentarily. Crafted by the ancient Doughnut Side, it resonates with karmic energy, providing brief bursts of directional control as you scale impossible surfaces. Beware its unpredictable harmonic shifts that can either aid or hinder your climb.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Defiance
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can activate this device to briefly defy gravity for up to 1 minute. The user gains advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks and saving throws while within 30 feet of solid ground or stable surfaces. This effect ends if the user moves more than 30 feet from these surfaces.

effectDetails.title: Karmic Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this device channels karmic energy, granting resistance to falling damage for 1 hour. If the user falls within 60 feet of a stable surface, they can attempt an Athletics check (DC = 15) to land safely on that surface.

grand_country_item_gravitic_helix_caller.levelRequirementReason: This item is accessible at level 1 as it provides utility and challenge-appropriate support.
grand_country_item_gravitic_helix_caller.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in items for those who defy gravity, making this artifact a perfect fit for their inventory.
grand_country_item_gravitic_helix_caller.shippingDetail: Ships via the Gravity Drone express service; delivery within one week.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate and use.
usage.duration: 1 minute per activation, or until the user moves more than 30 feet from stable surfaces (Gravity Defiance); 1 hour for Karmic Resonance.
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the user moves out of range or upon falling (Gravity Defiance); expires after 1 hour (Karmic Resonance).

grand_country_item_gravitic_helix_caller.priceReason: This price reflects its rarity and utility, making it a balanced choice for adventurers of all levels.

grand_country_item_layered_rope_of_shift.name: Mk.47 Layered Rope of Shifting Depths
grand_country_item_layered_rope_of_shift.description: The Mk.47 Layered Rope of Shifting Depths is a braided marvel crafted from the compressed echoes of ancient, shifting layers and reinforced with solidified gravity fields. This rope can phase you partially into adjacent planes for brief moments, allowing traversal through narrow crevices or tight spaces that would otherwise be impassable. Its core is forged from the remnants of dimensional breaches, imbuing it with a subtle distortion that aligns with your stride when pulled, but excessive use risks unraveling the very fabric of its construction and trapping you in an unstable state.

effectDetails.title: Dimensional Traversal
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, pulling on this rope allows you to phase partially into adjacent layers for up to 1 minute. You gain advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks and can pass through small openings that would otherwise be too tight. This effect ends if the rope is pulled again or if you take damage.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Distortion
effectDetails.rules: The rope exerts a minor gravitational distortion, giving you advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and saving throws against being moved by environmental effects within 30 feet. This effect persists for 1 hour per use until the rope is pulled again.

grand_country_item_layered_rope_of_shift.levelRequirementReason: Requires high-level expertise to control the unpredictable nature of shifting dimensions without losing balance or getting trapped.
grand_country_item_layered_rope_of_shift.vendorReason: Side Seller specializes in rare and exotic equipment that defies conventional reality, making this rope a fitting addition to their inventory.
grand_country_item_layered_rope_of_shift.shippingDetail: The Dimensional Courier ensures swift and secure delivery through any plane of existence, guaranteeing the safe arrival of this delicate artifact.

usage.activation: Bonus action when pulling the rope
usage.duration: 1 minute or until pulled again
usage.endsWhen: Rope is pulled again or you take damage

grand_country_item_layered_rope_of_shift.priceReason: The intricate craftsmanship and unique properties of this rope justify its high price, offering unparalleled utility in navigating treacherous terrain.

grand_country_item_forbidden_vertical_ho.name: The Obsidian Stasis Hook Caller
grand_country_item_forbidden_vertical_ho.description: The Obsidian Stasis Hook Caller is a horrifying device forged from solidified negative gravity, its surface etched with dark runes that hum with malevolent intent. This relic allows you to briefly suspend yourself in a state of absolute vertical stasis, effectively nullifying the effects of any fall. However, prolonged use invites the wrath of the deeper layers, as it disrupts the natural flow of gravitation and balance, leaving behind a karmic debt that can only be repaid with sacrifice.

effectDetails.title: Gravity Nullification
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the Obsidian Stasis Hook Caller to suspend yourself in a state of absolute vertical stasis for up to 1 minute. This effect nullifies any fall damage within its duration and prevents you from being knocked prone by gravity-related effects.

effectDetails.title: Karmic Debt
effectDetails.rules: Using the Obsidian Stasis Hook Caller more than once per day incurs a karmic debt, which can only be repaid with a significant personal sacrifice. The DM will decide what constitutes an acceptable repayment of this debt.

grand_country_item_forbidden_vertical_ho.levelRequirementReason: Even the lowest-level spellcasters may find use for this device in dangerous situations.
grand_country_item_forbidden_vertical_ho.vendorReason: The layer_market is known for its exotic and forbidden items, making it a fitting vendor for such an artifact.
grand_country_item_forbidden_vertical_ho.shippingDetail: Ships under cover of night to ensure the secrecy of this item's delivery.

usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per day
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when the effect is no longer needed or when the user activates another effect of the device.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but limited to once per day.

grand_country_item_forbidden_vertical_ho.priceReason: This item provides a unique and powerful utility for adventurers, making it a valuable addition to any party's arsenal without being overpowered.

equestrian_item_the_scorched_mane_guardi.name: The Scorched Mane Guardian’s Bit
equestrian_item_the_scorched_mane_guardi.description: The Scorched Mane Guardian’s Bit is a sleek obsidian bit, etched with fiery runes that glow faintly like embers. Crafted by the blacksmiths of Ponyville, this bit grants its rider resistance to cold and ignites a protective flame around their hooves, making them a formidable adversary in icy climes or confrontations. Legends speak of its origins in a forgeside ritual where loyalty is forged from the heart of the earth itself.

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The rider gains temporary resistance to cold damage equal to their proficiency bonus +10. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Hoof Flame
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of the fire resistance, a minor flame ignites around the rider's hooves, providing advantage on checks made with speed or agility while navigating icy terrain. The flame persists until it is extinguished by water, mud, or another similar obstacle.

equestrian_item_the_scorched_mane_guardi.levelRequirementReason: The bit requires a rider of at least fifth level to harness its fiery essence and withstand the cold resistance.
equestrian_item_the_scorched_mane_guardi.vendorReason: As a local artifact from Ponyville, the market is known for hosting unique items crafted by skilled artisans like those who forged this bit.
equestrian_item_the_scorched_mane_guardi.shippingDetail: Ships via Pegasus Courier within three game days of purchase.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action when the rider is in icy conditions or facing cold-based threats.
usage.duration: 1 minute, or until expended in combat.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per short rest.
usage.charges: One charge; recharges on completion of a long rest.

equestrian_item_the_scorched_mane_guardi.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item provides significant utility for fifth-level riders and above without overshadowing other combat options.

equestrian_item_the_crystalline_echo_sha.name: The Crystalline Echo Shard of Twilight’s Reverie
equestrian_item_the_crystalline_echo_sha.description: The Crystalline Echo Shard of Twilight’s Reverie is a shimmering fragment of twilight, its surface etched with ancient melodies and ghostly whispers. When held, it allows the user to perceive fleeting echoes of past events within a location—glimpses of conversations long forgotten and spectral visions that dance just beyond the edge of comprehension. Though the images are often fragmented and unsettling, they offer a rare window into the forgotten threads of history, weaving together lost memories with an eerie clarity.

effectDetails.title: Echo Perception
effectDetails.rules: By concentrating for 1 minute, the user can perceive echoes of past events within a location. This grants advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to recall information about the area and allows the user to detect hidden objects within 30 feet with no roll required.

effectDetails.title: Intuition Enhancement
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of one short rest, the user gains a +2 bonus to Intelligence saving throws. The shard can only be used once per day and must be recharged after an extended rest.

equestrian_item_the_crystalline_echo_sha.levelRequirementReason: The shard is designed for adventurers at any level who wish to explore the depths of lost memories.
equestrian_item_the_crystalline_echo_sha.vendorReason: Crystal Empire Artifacts specializes in rare and ancient relics, making it the perfect vendor for the Crystalline Echo Shard.
equestrian_item_the_crystalline_echo_sha.shippingDetail: The shard is shipped via the Griffin Delivery Service, known for its swift and reliable courier service.

usage.activation: Concentrate on echo perception for 1 minute; no activation required for intuition enhancement.
usage.duration: Echo Perception lasts until the end of your next turn. Intuition Enhancement lasts until after you complete a short rest.
usage.endsWhen: Echo Perception ends when concentration is interrupted or after one minute. Intuition Enhancement ends at the start of your next short rest.
usage.charges: One use per day, recharging after an extended rest.

equestrian_item_the_crystalline_echo_sha.priceReason: The shard’s balanced price reflects its rarity and utility without being overpowered for a single-use item.

equestrian_item_the_vile_bits_of_discord.name: The Vile Bits of Discord's Lament
equestrian_item_the_vile_bits_of_discord.description: The Vile Bits of Discord's Lament are a twisted amalgamation of forgotten arguments and gnawed metal, forged in the heart of a long-lost quarrel. These tarnished fragments emit an insidious aura that subtly erodes trust among those who consume them, making even the closest companions seem unreliable. Biting into these cursed relics leaves you plagued with paranoia, reducing your charisma by 1 point and increasing the chance for others to react negatively towards you.

effectDetails.title: Paranoia
effectDetails.rules: Upon consuming the Vile Bits, you become paranoid and distrusting of your companions. This effect lasts until the end of your next long rest. It does not require a saving throw but reduces your charisma by 1 point.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Charisma
effectDetails.rules: Your charisma score is reduced by 1 point while you are under the effects of these bits, and this reduction persists until the end of your next long rest. This effect does not allow saving throws to negate its impact.

equestrian_item_the_vile_bits_of_discord.levelRequirementReason: A lower-level character might find it difficult to cope with the paranoia and reduced charisma effects.
equestrian_item_the_vile_bits_of_discord.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce, known for their eclectic range of goods, includes these items in their stock due to their unique and controversial nature.
equestrian_item_the_vile_bits_of_discord.shippingDetail: Ships via the Swift Pony Express, delivered within three days of purchase.

usage.duration: Lasts until the end of your next long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end at the conclusion of your next long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but one cannot consume more than three in a week.

equestrian_item_the_vile_bits_of_discord.priceReason: The price reflects the unique and potentially destabilizing nature of these items, balancing their utility with the risk they pose.

middle_earth_item_obsidian_whisperer_of_.name: The Obsidian Whisperer of Mirkwood
middle_earth_item_obsidian_whisperer_of_.description: The Obsidian Whisperer of Mirkwood is a hand-carved shard of dark obsidian, its surface etched with the forgotten runes of ancient elven lore. When wielded within the shadowy confines of Mirkwood, it pulses with a spectral light, illuminating hidden paths and revealing secrets that have lain dormant for ages. However, prolonged use can drive one mad, as the whispers of the past grow ever more insistent, tempting the user to delve deeper into the forest's dark heart.

effectDetails.title: Increased Shadow Vision
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within Mirkwood, you gain advantage on Perception checks to notice hidden creatures or objects in shadowy areas for 1 minute. This effect ends if you leave Mirkwood's bounds.

effectDetails.title: Hidden Path Revelation
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, you can spend a bonus action to reveal an unexplored path within the forest that bypasses minor obstacles and traps for up to 8 hours or until you leave Mirkwood. This effect ends if you use it again.

middle_earth_item_obsidian_whisperer_of_.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest ranger can appreciate the utility of this artifact when navigating Mirkwood's treacherous terrain.
middle_earth_item_obsidian_whisperer_of_.vendorReason: The elves of Mirkwood are known for their intimate connection with nature and ancient relics, making them the perfect custodians of such a powerful tool.
middle_earth_item_obsidian_whisperer_of_.shippingDetail: Delivered by the swift messengers of the forest, ensuring safe passage through Mirkwood's most perilous regions.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action within Mirkwood
usage.duration: 1 minute (Shadow Vision) / Up to 8 hours (Path Revelation)
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when you leave Mirkwood or use the item again
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time

middle_earth_item_obsidian_whisperer_of_.priceReason: Balanced as a rare item with limited availability, this artifact's price reflects its utility and the danger of using it within Mirkwood.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_mithril_of_gri.name: The Dwarven Mithril of Grimstone’s Fury
middle_earth_item_dwarven_mithril_of_gri.description: The Dwarven Mithril of Grimstone’s Fury, a fearsome axe head forged in the heart of Grimstone Peak, crackles with the unyielding fury of ancient stone and dark magic. When wielded by one who knows its secrets, it can rend stone as if it were parchment and disrupt arcane spells with a single swing. Its edge is said to be sharper than any blade ever crafted, yet it whispers of death to those who dare invoke its wrath.

effectDetails.title: Stonecutter
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a target with this axe and the target is a construct or made of stone, it takes an additional 2d6 damage. This effect can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Arcane Disruption
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can unleash a surge of disrupted energy that disrupts one active spell within 30 feet with a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the spell ends immediately.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_mithril_of_gri.levelRequirementReason: Only those who have faced and survived Grimstone Peak's darkest trials are deemed worthy to wield this axe.
middle_earth_item_dwarven_mithril_of_gri.vendorReason: The dwarves of the forge are the only ones who can craft weapons that channel the raw power of Grimstone’s fury.
middle_earth_item_dwarven_mithril_of_gri.shippingDetail: Ships via dire wolf courier, known for their speed and endurance in treacherous terrains.

usage.activation: Main action or bonus action to use Stonecutter; bonus action to use Arcane Disruption
usage.duration: Instantaneous effects
usage.endsWhen: Uses are exhausted after each short rest, spell disruption ends on a successful save by the caster of the targeted spell.

middle_earth_item_dwarven_mithril_of_gri.priceReason: The axe’s forging required rare and dangerous materials, along with the expertise of master dwarven forges.

middle_earth_item_service_of_the_greywat.name: The Greywatcher’s Vigilance Offering
middle_earth_item_service_of_the_greywat.description: The Greywatcher’s Vigilance Offering is a shimmering, ethereal sphere that pulses with the ancient wisdom of the Greywatchers. Crafted from the essence of the Misty Mountains and imbued with the protective spirit of the Watchers, this glowing orb provides its bearer with unshakable courage in times of trial. When wielded in combat or meditation, it emits a soft glow that can dispel minor curses and bolster one’s resolve against overwhelming despair.

effectDetails.title: Minor Curse Dispelling
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, this offering grants advantage on saving throws against minor curses. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Bolstering Courage
effectDetails.rules: This item provides a +1 bonus to all Charisma (Intimidation) checks for 1 hour after activation as an action. The effect ends early if you are incapacitated or fall unconscious.

middle_earth_item_service_of_the_greywat.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest heroes may need this offering when facing overwhelming despair.
middle_earth_item_service_of_the_greywat.vendorReason: The Shire Shop stocks essential items for all travelers, including this rare gift from the Greywatchers.
middle_earth_item_service_of_the_greywat.shippingDetail: Delivered by swift horse courier within one week of purchase.

usage.activation: Action or Bonus Action to activate and use in combat or meditation.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect with ongoing benefits for the specified duration.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are incapacitated, fall unconscious, or do not use it within a long rest period.

middle_earth_item_service_of_the_greywat.priceReason: Balanced to reflect its divine origin and rare utility for adventurers of all levels.

dohut_hole_item_forsaken_walker_tears.name: Forsaken Walker's Tears of Shifting Gravity
dohut_hole_item_forsaken_walker_tears.description: The Forsaken Walker's Tears of Shifting Gravity are obsidian orbs that hum with the raw energy of collapsing dimensions. When consumed, these tears allow you to manipulate gravity within a 5-foot radius, pulling objects closer or suspending yourself in mid-air for brief moments. They are said to be crafted from the very essence of forgotten realities, their power only active when wielded by one who has walked through the Fated Place.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Gravity Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can manipulate gravity within a 5-foot radius for up to 10 seconds. Objects in the area are drawn toward you with a force equal to half your Strength modifier (rounded down), and creatures can move through them as if they were difficult terrain. This effect ends when you use it again or after 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Mobility
effectDetails.rules: For the duration of manipulating gravity, you gain a +2 bonus to AC and your movement speed increases by 10 feet. You can remain in this state for up to 30 seconds per short rest.

dohut_hole_item_forsaken_walker_tears.levelRequirementReason: The tears' power is too great for novices, requiring at least 1st level to wield them safely.
dohut_hole_item_forsaken_walker_tears.vendorReason: Hole Hawker, a master of the Fated Place, has access to these rare and dangerous artifacts.
dohut_hole_item_forsaken_walker_tears.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the Fated Place; delivery can take several days depending on the courier's route through the collapsing dimensions.

usage.duration: Up to 10 seconds per use, up to 30 seconds per short rest
usage.endsWhen: You use it again or after 1 minute of continuous effect

dohut_hole_item_forsaken_walker_tears.priceReason: The tears are rare and their power is immense, justifying a price of 1000 XP.

dohut_hole_item_mk_91_void_walker.name: Mk.91 Void Walker’s Resonance Core
dohut_hole_item_mk_91_void_walker.description: The Mk.91 Void Walker’s Resonance Core is a fractured sphere of solidified void energy, its surface etched with ancient runes that shimmer with unstable void anomalies. This core can be fused into armor to grant resistance against gravity-based attacks and the ability to briefly phase through thin walls, disrupting the very fabric around you. When activated, it emits localized distortions, confusing enemies in a 5-foot radius for a moment.

effectDetails.title: Resist Gravity-Based Attacks
effectDetails.rules: While the Resonance Core is fused into your armor, you gain resistance to damage from gravity-based attacks. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Brief Phaseshift Teleport
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can briefly phase through thin walls for up to 10 feet. You must be touching the wall and can only do this once per short or long rest.

dohut_hole_item_mk_91_void_walker.levelRequirementReason: Only high-level characters have the fortitude and skills needed to harness such a volatile core.
dohut_hole_item_mk_91_void_walker.vendorReason: The center seller specializes in rare, high-tier magical items that can be used by powerful adventurers.
dohut_hole_item_mk_91_void_walker.shippingDetail: The package is delivered via Dimensional Transit Packet, ensuring safe and swift delivery through the void pathways.

usage.activation: Bonus action for brief phaseshift; passive effect of resistance to gravity-based attacks.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for brief phaseshift; lasts until end of next turn with resistance.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or recharge at the start of a short rest.
usage.charges: 1 charge, recharges on a short rest

dohut_hole_item_mk_91_void_walker.priceReason: The core's rarity and its powerful effects justify this high price.

dohut_hole_item_forbidden_void_tears_98.name: Forbidden Void Tears of the Anomaly’s Maw
dohut_hole_item_forbidden_void_tears_98.description: Hewn from the heart of a rift in space-time, these crimson tears of the Anomaly’s Maw are said to be collected by those who dare venture into the forbidden depths of reality. Drinking them grants brief precognitive flashes—glimpses of potential futures directly linked to your actions within the Fated Place—but at the cost of fragmenting one's sanity. The Anomaly’s Maw whispers in your mind, its voice a cacophony of futures and pasts, each tear a fragment of reality torn from the fabric of time itself.

effectDetails.title: Brief Precognitive Flashes
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this item grants a brief flash of potential futures related to your next action within the Fated Place. The effect is instantaneous and lasts until the start of your next turn. You gain advantage on one ability check or attack roll of your choice before the end of your next turn. There is a 10% chance per use that you perceive an alternate future outcome, but this increases your risk of attracting entities from beyond the void.

effectDetails.title: Sanity Fracture
effectDetails.rules: Each successful consumption of these tears has a cumulative -1 penalty to Intelligence. This penalty stacks, and if it reaches -5 or higher, you are incapacitated until the end of your next long rest. The item is destroyed upon this occurrence.

dohut_hole_item_forbidden_void_tears_98.levelRequirementReason: Even the most novice adventurers might need a glimpse into the future to navigate the dangers of the Fated Place.
dohut_hole_item_forbidden_void_tears_98.vendorReason: Void Vendor operates in the shadows, dealing in rare and forbidden artifacts from realms beyond comprehension. The Forbidden Void Tears are one such item, kept under lock and key for those who can truly appreciate their price in sanity.
dohut_hole_item_forbidden_void_tears_98.shippingDetail: Ships via Temporal Retrieval Unit with a 24-hour delay to ensure the package arrives intact through time's tumultuous currents.

usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until start of next turn
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed upon incurring the sanity fracture penalty

dohut_hole_item_forbidden_void_tears_98.priceReason: Balanced for its rarity and the risk it poses to a character's mental stability.

kivotos_item_quartz_dancer_uniform.name: Quartz Dancer's Ensemble - Semester 7 Variant
kivotos_item_quartz_dancer_uniform.description: The Quartz Dancer's Ensemble – Semester 7 Variant is a gleaming uniform crafted from synthesized quartz fibers, designed for subtle manipulation of light and sound within Academy City’s echoing halls. This ensemble amplifies sound perception in crowded spaces by up to two levels, making it ideal for rallying supporters or subtly disrupting lectures without drawing immediate attention. The wearer's movements can slightly distort the ambient light, creating a shimmering effect that enhances their presence among peers.

effectDetails.title: Amplified Sound Perception
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains advantage on Perception checks related to sound for the duration of a short rest. This effect enhances their ability to discern subtle sounds and conversations in crowded spaces.

effectDetails.title: Light Shimmer
effectDetails.rules: When the wearer performs an action that requires movement, they can create a shimmering light effect around them. This effect is visible within 10 feet and lasts for 1 minute or until the wearer moves again. No save DC is required.

kivotos_item_quartz_dancer_uniform.levelRequirementReason: This ensemble's advanced technology requires a high level of proficiency in Academy City’s specialized courses.
kivotos_item_quartz_dancer_uniform.vendorReason: The student store caters to the unique needs and resources of Academy City students, including their specialized uniforms.
kivotos_item_quartz_dancer_uniform.shippingDetail: Ships via drone within a day, delivered directly to the dormitory.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon wearing the uniform.
usage.duration: Until the wearer takes a short rest or removes the uniform.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer stops wearing it or completes a short rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges with a short rest.

kivotos_item_quartz_dancer_uniform.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its advanced technology and specialized use within Academy City’s educational environment.

kivotos_item_mk_4_semester_pins_of_disco.name: Mk.4 Semester Pins of Discord - Crimson Variant
kivotos_item_mk_4_semester_pins_of_disco.description: The Mk.4 Semester Pins of Discord - Crimson Variant are a collection of sleek, crimson enamel pins that pulse with a suppressed, chaotic energy from the forbidden clubs of the Academy. When worn in multiples, these pins trigger unpredictable disruptions in nearby electronics and subtle shifts in social dynamics, causing temporary confusion among those around you. The wearer must be cautious as the pins' effects can inadvertently lead to embarrassing situations or awkward moments for anyone they interact with.

effectDetails.title: Electrical Disruption
effectDetails.rules: Activating involves wearing at least two pins simultaneously. The wearer must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to avoid causing minor electrical interference in the immediate area, such as sparking lights or malfunctioning devices within 30 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be ended early with a successful concentration check.

effectDetails.title: Social Disruption
effectDetails.rules: The pins subtly alter social interactions around the wearer. Any creature within 20 feet of them must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become temporarily confused, acting erratically for 1 minute. This effect can be ended by successfully concentrating and passing the save.

kivotos_item_mk_4_semester_pins_of_disco.levelRequirementReason: The pins are designed to be worn by students of any level but require a certain understanding of the social and electrical environments.
kivotos_item_mk_4_semester_pins_of_disco.vendorReason: Club Supply specializes in items from the forbidden clubs, including these pins that can cause both academic and social disruptions.
kivotos_item_mk_4_semester_pins_of_disco.shippingDetail: Expressed by a courier who has been warned of the pins' effects to ensure safe delivery without causing any accidental disruptions.

usage.activation: Activating involves wearing at least two pins simultaneously. This action can be taken as an action or a bonus action.
usage.duration: 1 minute, with concentration required for longer durations.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer ceases concentrating on the pins' effects or successfully saves against their influence.

kivotos_item_mk_4_semester_pins_of_disco.priceReason: The price reflects the mythic rarity and the unpredictable nature of the pins, providing a balance for players of all levels.

kivotos_item_forbidden_resonator_circula.name: Forbidden Resonator Circulator - Obsidian Variant
kivotos_item_forbidden_resonator_circula.description: The Forbidden Resonator Circulator - Obsidian Variant, a salvaged relic from a collapsed student initiation ritual, emits an eerie, dark violet glow when activated. This device generates a localized field of absolute silence that can disorient and reduce the sensory input of those within its radius. The artifact's power is unpredictable; prolonged exposure increases the chance of hallucinations, making it both a potent tool for stealth operations and a dangerous weapon if not wielded with care.

effectDetails.title: Absolute Silence Field
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this device creates a 10-foot radius centered on the user. All creatures within the area are subjected to an effect of absolute silence for 1 minute, during which they cannot hear or speak normally unless they succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Chance of Hallucination
effectDetails.rules: Any creature that fails their save against the Absolute Silence Field has a 50% chance to experience vivid hallucinations for the duration of the silence effect. These effects are purely visual and auditory, not harmful but can severely impact situational awareness.

kivotos_item_forbidden_resonator_circula.levelRequirementReason: The device's unpredictable nature requires a minimum level to ensure users have enough discipline and experience to handle its risks.
kivotos_item_forbidden_resonator_circula.vendorReason: As salvaged from a ritual gone awry, the academy armory handles this artifact with caution, offering it only to those who can demonstrate appropriate training and understanding of its dangers.
kivotos_item_forbidden_resonator_circula.shippingDetail: The package is sealed with arcane wards that prevent tampering until it reaches its intended recipient.

usage.activation: Action: The user must concentrate on the device for 1 minute to activate and maintain the field. Concentration is lost if the user takes any damage or if a creature within the radius fails their save against the Silence Field.
usage.duration: Instantaneous activation, lasts 1 minute with concentration
usage.endsWhen: Concentration ends when the user takes damage or a creature within the radius fails their save.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses; can be reactivated after each use.

kivotos_item_forbidden_resonator_circula.priceReason: The device's rarity and unpredictable nature justify its high price, despite being rechargeable. Its potential for both utility and danger ensures a premium value in the market.

animatopia_item_twilight_keeper_of_shatt.name: Twilight Keeper's Pelts of Shattered Echoes
animatopia_item_twilight_keeper_of_shatt.description: The Twilight Keeper's Pelts of Shattered Echoes are intricately woven from the fur of nocturnal Shadow Lynxes, whose twilight luminescence pulses ever so faintly in dim light. Wearing these pelts grants you heightened night vision and the ability to momentarily hear whispers of past events, though their truth is often fragmented and misleading. These pelts also provide a subtle shadowy blend that makes you harder to detect by enemies.

effectDetails.title: Heightened Nightvision
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these pelts, your vision is enhanced in dim light conditions. This enhancement provides a +2 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect things in dim light and allows you to see normally when the darkness exceeds what would be absolute blindness.

effectDetails.title: Hear Whispers
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can focus your senses on hearing whispers of past events. This ability allows you to make a Wisdom (Insight) check against an unassociated DC 15 as if the event had just happened. The result is often fragmented and may require further investigation for clarity.

animatopia_item_twilight_keeper_of_shatt.levelRequirementReason: The pelts are crafted from the rare and elusive Shadow Lynxes, making them difficult to obtain and their effects potent.
animatopia_item_twilight_keeper_of_shatt.vendorReason: The Tribal Trader has exclusive access to the rare Shadow Lynx pelts due to his deep ties with the forest tribes who hunt these creatures.
animatopia_item_twilight_keeper_of_shatt.shippingDetail: The pelts are delivered by a fleet of beast carriers, ensuring they reach their destination in one piece and with minimal wear and tear.

usage.activation: Passive effect for heightened nightvision; active use once per short rest for hear whispers.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for heightened nightvision; lasts until the start of your next turn for hear whispers.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when you remove the pelts or are incapacitated.

animatopia_item_twilight_keeper_of_shatt.priceReason: The pelts are crafted from a rare and elusive creature, making their value equivalent to 1000 XP.

animatopia_item_mk94_instinctive_pelts_o.name: Mk.94 Instinctive Pelts of the Stone Sentinels
animatopia_item_mk94_instinctive_pelts_o.description: Forged under the watchful gaze of ancient moss-covered stone golems, these pelts resonate with an almost instinctive connection to the earth's rhythms. When worn, they grant a steady regeneration rate and resilience against territorial aggression from woodland creatures, as if the wearer shares in the guardianship of the forest. The pelts' weave is both ancient and resilient, imbuing the wearer with a deep sense of the natural world’s heartbeat and a protective barrier that wards off harm from those who would claim the forest as their own.

effectDetails.title: Slow Healing
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your hit point maximum. This effect lasts for the duration of one long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resistance to Animal Aggression
effectDetails.rules: While wearing these pelts, you have advantage on saving throws against effects from woodland creatures that would cause you harm or aggression. Additionally, hostile woodland creatures within 30 feet do not target you with their attacks for the duration of one long rest.

animatopia_item_mk94_instinctive_pelts_o.levelRequirementReason: The pelts are crafted to be worn by adventurers of any level who wish to connect more deeply with the natural world.
animatopia_item_mk94_instinctive_pelts_o.vendorReason: The vendors at Forest Market, long familiar with the lore and craftsmanship of ancient stone golems, are trusted sources for these rare and powerful items.
animatopia_item_mk94_instinctive_pelts_o.shippingDetail: Shipped by the swift winged beasts of the forest, the pelts arrive in pristine condition, though they must be worn within a week of delivery to maintain their full power.

usage.duration: Lasts for the duration of one long rest or until removed.
usage.endsWhen: The wearer removes the pelts from their body or completes a long rest without them on.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but the effect resets upon removal.

animatopia_item_mk94_instinctive_pelts_o.priceReason: Crafted with ancient stone golem essence and rare woodland materials, these pelts are priced at 1000 XP to reflect their unique crafting and powerful effects.

animatopia_item_the_bloodstained_keeper_.name: The Bloodstained Keeper of Wildsong
animatopia_item_the_bloodstained_keeper_.description: The Bloodstained Keeper of Wildsong, crafted from the heart-throbbing hide of a corrupted Warhorn, radiates an unnerving energy that resonates with primal might. Wearers can summon the wild's untamed power through battle cries, enhancing their strength and drawing the ire of vengeful spirits. This item is said to have been found in the lair of a fabled beast, its presence now coveted by those who seek both power and peril.

effectDetails.title: Strength Boost
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, you gain a +2 bonus to your Strength score until the end of your next turn. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Spirit Attraction
effectDetails.rules: For every hour this item is worn, there is a 10% chance that vengeful spirits will attempt to claim you as their own. If one succeeds, the wearer must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed with a Spirit Bond, which imposes disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks until removed.

animatopia_item_the_bloodstained_keeper_.levelRequirementReason: This item's power is accessible to even low-level characters, providing a challenge that matches their growing abilities.
animatopia_item_the_bloodstained_keeper_.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar thrives on rare and exotic items that push the boundaries of reality, making this corrupted relic an ideal addition to its offerings.
animatopia_item_the_bloodstained_keeper_.shippingDetail: Ships via shadow messenger, ensuring swift and discreet delivery only during the night.

usage.activation: Activating this item requires a successful action. The effect is temporary and lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous duration with a single use per long rest.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the wearer ceases to wear it or upon being removed by another creature's actions.
usage.charges: Unlimited uses, but only one can be active at a time.

animatopia_item_the_bloodstained_keeper_.priceReason: This item is priced at 1000 XP as its rarity and power level make it an excellent value for both new and experienced adventurers.

mushroom_kingdom_item_verdant_marked_cap.name: Verdant Marked's Caps - Phase Shift
mushroom_kingdom_item_verdant_marked_cap.description: Verdant Marked's Caps, plucked from the heart of Northeast Midlands' fungal groves, pulse with a vibrant emerald light. Consuming these caps grants you the fleeting ability to phase through solid objects for five seconds, allowing swift escapes or stealthy acquisitions. Afterward, you experience a brief disorientation, leaving you vulnerable for 10 seconds. These caps also enhance your movement speed by 10%, making every step lighter and faster during your phase shift.

effectDetails.title: Phase Shift
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action, lasts for 5 seconds. You can pass through solid objects within a 10-foot radius. Requires a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or risk disorientation for the next 10 seconds.

effectDetails.title: Increased Movement Speed
effectDetails.rules: Active while phase shifting, you gain a +10% bonus to your movement speed during this effect.

mushroom_kingdom_item_verdant_marked_cap.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least third-level proficiency to manage the disorientation risk and utilize the phase shift effectively.
mushroom_kingdom_item_verdant_marked_cap.vendorReason: Toad Town Market specializes in exotic fungi and rare botanical items, making these caps a fitting addition to their stock.
mushroom_kingdom_item_verdant_marked_cap.shippingDetail: Shipped by the Mushroom Cart, known for its reliable delivery through the fungal groves of Midlands.

usage.duration: 5 seconds and a 10-second disorientation window after use
usage.endsWhen: Upon completion or if you fail the saving throw
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a short rest

mushroom_kingdom_item_verdant_marked_cap.priceReason: Balanced for an uncommon item with unique and potent effects.

mushroom_kingdom_item_mk_83_fungal_caps_.name: Mk.83 Fungal Caps - Resonance Amplification
mushroom_kingdom_item_mk_83_fungal_caps_.description: Forged during the Coin Wars, these Mk.83 Fungal Caps are a marvel of alchemical ingenuity, crafted from the hardened shells of rare fungi found in the war-torn lands. Each cap resonates with the concentrated energy of gold and silver coins. When consumed, they amplify your hearing by 50%, allowing you to detect hidden caches or approaching enemies through subtle vibrations within a 20-foot radius, but at the cost of overwhelming sensory overload that can disorient you if not controlled.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Hearing
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, these caps grant a +50% increase to your passive Perception checks for detecting sounds and hidden objects within 20 feet. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn after consuming the cap.

effectDetails.title: Vibration Sense
effectDetails.rules: You gain the ability to detect movement within a 20-foot radius as long as you are not incapacitated or unconscious. This sense is heightened, allowing you to pinpoint the location and direction of any creature moving within range with a successful Wisdom (Perception) check.

mushroom_kingdom_item_mk_83_fungal_caps_.levelRequirementReason: These caps are designed for beginners who need an edge in their coin-hunting endeavors but lack advanced alchemical knowledge.
mushroom_kingdom_item_mk_83_fungal_caps_.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in rare and exotic items, making these fungal caps a natural fit for their inventory.
mushroom_kingdom_item_mk_83_fungal_caps_.shippingDetail: Due to the delicate nature of these items, they are shipped via rocket ship, ensuring swift delivery but with a slight delay of two days.

usage.duration: 1 minute per cap consumed (up to 3 caps).
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the duration expires or you are incapacitated, unconscious, or disoriented by sensory overload.
usage.charges: Unlimited; each cap is a one-use item.

mushroom_kingdom_item_mk_83_fungal_caps_.priceReason: These caps are priced at 1000 XP due to their unique alchemical properties and the rarity of the materials used in their creation.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_fungal_caps_of.name: The Fungal Caps of Coins - Celestial Alignment
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_fungal_caps_of.description: The Fungal Caps of Coins - Celestial Alignment, gleaming with an ethereal luminescence, are said to have been blessed by ancient celestial beings. Upon consumption, these rare caps grant a fleeting moment of divine favor, bestowing temporary invulnerability and a chance for a cosmic boon to fortify your spirit. Yet, their unpredictable nature can leave you vulnerable to psychic attacks, making them a dangerous yet invaluable treasure for the truly brave.
effects: chance for a beneficial cosmic event

effectDetails.title: Temporary Invulnerability
effectDetails.rules: The user becomes temporarily invulnerable to all attacks and damage for 3 seconds. This effect is instantaneous upon consumption of the caps.

effectDetails.title: Cosmic Boon
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that after consuming the caps, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level + Constitution modifier (minimum 1). This effect lasts for 1 minute and ends if you take any damage.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_fungal_caps_of.levelRequirementReason: The Fungal Caps of Coins are accessible to all adventurers who can afford their exorbitant price, as they offer a potent yet unpredictable boost.
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_fungal_caps_of.vendorReason: Koopa Shop has established trade routes that occasionally bring in rare and mystical items from distant realms.
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_fungal_caps_of.shippingDetail: The dragon airship ensures the safe arrival of these delicate caps, often requiring a week to reach their destination due to the fragile nature of the shipment.

usage.duration: 3 seconds for invulnerability; 1 minute for cosmic boon (ends on damage)
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when you take damage or after its duration expires, whichever comes first

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_fungal_caps_of.priceReason: The Fungal Caps of Coins are priced at 1000 XP due to their rarity and the unpredictable nature of their effects.

teyvat_item_chronometric_herald_of_storm.name: The Chronometric Herald of Storm’s Brand
teyvat_item_chronometric_herald_of_storm.description: The Chronometric Herald of Storm’s Brand is a pulsating obsidian orb etched with swirling glyphs that echo the ancient Dragonspine mountains. Crafted by god-smiths, this relic accelerates time momentarily, granting you and your allies increased movement speed and attack power against foes vulnerable to temporal distortions. Activated during moments of chaos, it also snares enemy projectiles and casts a brief disorientation spell on those caught in its wake.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Briefly accelerates time within a 10-foot radius, granting you and nearby allies advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and increasing your movement speed by 20 feet for 10 seconds. Ends if the user takes damage.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Weakness Amplification
effectDetails.rules: While activated, increases attack power against enemies vulnerable to temporal effects by +2d6. Lasts until the end of your next turn and can be used again after a short rest.

teyvat_item_chronometric_herald_of_storm.levelRequirementReason: This relic is designed for versatility, suitable for any adventurer who can wield it.
teyvat_item_chronometric_herald_of_storm.vendorReason: Mondstadt’s market offers rare and versatile items that cater to a wide range of adventurers' needs.
teyvat_item_chronometric_herald_of_storm.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the winged messengers, ensuring you receive your Chronometric Herald in perfect condition.

usage.duration: 10 seconds duration; ends if user takes damage or if a new activation is made
usage.endsWhen: User takes damage or another Temporal Surge is activated
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short rest

teyvat_item_chronometric_herald_of_storm.priceReason: The item's rarity and the unique god-smithing technique required for its creation justify a price of 1000 XP.

teyvat_item_abyssal_resonance_of_the_san.name: Abyssal Resonance of the Sands – The Khthonic Cartouche
teyvat_item_abyssal_resonance_of_the_san.description: The Khthonic Cartouche, a small sandstone tablet adorned with ancient Khonoit runes and glowing with an eerie umbral light, is said to be a relic of the desert gods. Touching it unleashes a tempest that obliterates visibility within its radius, turning the air thick with swirling dunes that buffet foes for 6 seconds. The storm's howling wind leaves a trail of desiccating sand that continues to deal damage over time.

effectDetails.title: Induce Sandstorm
effectDetails.rules: Activates on command as an action. The sandstorm lasts for 6 seconds within a 20-foot radius centered on the user, reducing visibility and dealing 1d6 necrotic damage each second to all creatures in the area. A DC 15 Wisdom saving throw halves the damage.

effectDetails.title: Damage Over Time
effectDetails.rules: The sandstorm also applies a 'blinding dust' effect, causing affected creatures to take an additional 1d6 necrotic damage at the start of their turns until the storm ends. This effect can be resisted with a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw.

teyvat_item_abyssal_resonance_of_the_san.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum level to channel the ancient powers of the Khthonic Cartouche.
teyvat_item_abyssal_resonance_of_the_san.vendorReason: Liyue Harbor merchants have access to rare artifacts from the deserts of Teyvat, including this relic.
teyvat_item_abyssal_resonance_of_the_san.shippingDetail: Ships via the Windcarriers for expedited delivery within a week of order.

usage.duration: 6 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The storm dissipates at the end of its duration or if the user dismisses it early as an action.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration to maintain.

teyvat_item_abyssal_resonance_of_the_san.priceReason: Balanced for a rare artifact with unique environmental effects and limited utility in combat.

teyvat_item_umbral_branded_vison_of_the_.name: Umbral Branded’s Vision of the Shattered Wind - The Aeravani Prism
teyvat_item_umbral_branded_vison_of_the_.description: The Aeravani Prism is a shimmering violet prism that captures and distorts wind currents with an ethereal glow. Crafted from the remnants of Umbral Branded’s lost nation, it grants brief bursts of increased speed and air control, echoing the mastery over the skies long forgotten by time. This relic allows for precise wind manipulation to deflect ranged attacks and creates small tornadoes that pull enemies closer, enhancing aerial combat with both agility and force.

effectDetails.title: Aerobic Burst
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate this effect to gain temporary flight for up to 1 minute. During this time, their movement speed increases by 30 feet while airborne. The duration ends if they land or take damage.

effectDetails.title: Wind Deflection
effectDetails.rules: The wielder can use a bonus action to deflect one ranged attack per turn within 5 feet of them. If successful, the attack is redirected harmlessly away from its target and deals no damage. This ability has a recharge time of 1 minute.

teyvat_item_umbral_branded_vison_of_the_.levelRequirementReason: This item requires high-level proficiency to effectively utilize its abilities in combat.
teyvat_item_umbral_branded_vison_of_the_.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare artifacts from lost nations, making this prism a fitting addition to their inventory.
teyvat_item_umbral_branded_vison_of_the_.shippingDetail: Ships via the Sea Dragon Ship within two weeks of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action or reaction (Aerobic Burst), bonus action (Wind Deflection)
usage.duration: 1 minute per activation for Aerobic Burst; instantaneous for Wind Deflection
usage.endsWhen: Landing, taking damage, or using a second deflection within the same turn

teyvat_item_umbral_branded_vison_of_the_.priceReason: This item is priced to reflect its rarity and the expertise required to wield it effectively.

leclaire_isle_item_ambered_tart_sworn.name: Ambered Tart Sworn to the Hearth
leclaire_isle_item_ambered_tart_sworn.description: The Ambered Tart Sworn to the Hearth, a confection glazed with honey-infused amber syrup and baked until its shell crackles with warmth, is a testament to the Dough Folk's culinary prowess. This noble pastry not only sweetens the soul but also fortifies the spirit, granting a fleeting moment of blissful contentment that can bolster one’s resolve in times of trial. Consumed before long journeys, it is said to protect against misfortune and strengthen the heart, making every bite a reminder of home.

effectDetails.title: Blissful Contentment
effectDetails.rules: Upon consumption, the tart grants a +2 bonus to Charisma checks and a +10 increase in happiness for 60 seconds. This effect is temporary but can bolster one’s resolve and protect against fear effects by reducing their severity by 50%. The duration ends when the user completes an action or rests.

effectDetails.title: Fortified Spirit
effectDetails.rules: For the next hour, the tart restores 2 points of Stamina. This effect can only be used once per long rest and is exhausted after use.

leclaire_isle_item_ambered_tart_sworn.levelRequirementReason: Any adventurer can benefit from the tart's soothing effects before embarking on new quests.
leclaire_isle_item_ambered_tart_sworn.vendorReason: The Dough Folk are renowned for their culinary creations, and this pastry is a staple in their offerings.
leclaire_isle_item_ambered_tart_sworn.shippingDetail: Delivered within the hour from the nearest Dough Depot location.

usage.duration: 60 seconds for Blissful Contentment; 1 hour for Stamina restoration
usage.endsWhen: Action or rest, and after use during long rests respectively

leclaire_isle_item_ambered_tart_sworn.priceReason: The tart's rarity and the unique benefits it provides justify its high price in XP.

leclaire_isle_item_bronzed_biscuit_chron.name: Bronzed Biscuit Chronicle of the Rising Sun
leclaire_isle_item_bronzed_biscuit_chron.description: The Bronzed Biscuit Chronicle of the Rising Sun is a delicacy forged in the heart of Le Claire Isle, where ancient geothermal vents fuel ovens that bake this treat. Crafted from sun-dried almonds and rare orchid honey, it's said to grant visions into future possibilities, though these glimpses are often cryptic and unsettling. A curious piece of equipment, it enhances divination efforts and offers resistance against psychic harm.

effectDetails.title: Divination Enhancer
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, the biscuit grants a +3 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to divination or prediction. This effect lasts for 1 minute and can be used once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Resistance
effectDetails.rules: For 30 seconds after consumption, the user gains resistance to psychic damage from any source. If the user is already resistant to psychic damage, they instead gain advantage on saving throws against such effects for this duration.

leclaire_isle_item_bronzed_biscuit_chron.levelRequirementReason: The biscuit's effects are potent enough to influence divination and protect against psychic attacks, making it accessible early in a character's journey.
leclaire_isle_item_bronzed_biscuit_chron.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is renowned for its culinary magic and has the expertise to craft such a mystical treat.
leclaire_isle_item_bronzed_biscuit_chron.shippingDetail: The biscuit must be delivered by dragon-scale carrier for optimal freshness, ensuring the visions it grants are clear and true.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until used in divination checks
usage.endsWhen: Ends at the start of your next turn if not used in an Intelligence (Arcana) check related to divination within its duration.

leclaire_isle_item_bronzed_biscuit_chron.priceReason: The biscuit's unique crafting process, combined with its rare ingredients and mystical properties, justifies this price.

leclaire_isle_item_crimson_tart_of_regre.name: Crimson Tart of Regret, Sworn to the Bitterest Dreams
leclaire_isle_item_crimson_tart_of_regre.description: The Crimson Tart of Regret, Sworn to the Bitterest Dreams, is a small, dark red tart with a filling that glistens like congealed blood. Infused with spiced star anise and baked until its essence shimmers, this pastry forces the eater to relive a painful memory—often their most profound regret. Consumed only by those seeking catharsis or closure, it grants brief solace before plunging the imbiber into melancholy. Only the brave—or foolhardy—venture near this confection.

effectDetails.title: Flashback of Deepest Regret
effectDetails.rules: The user experiences a vivid, painful memory related to their deepest regret. This effect lasts for 1 hour and grants advantage on saving throws against fear effects during this time. The tart must be consumed as an action.

effectDetails.title: Cathartic Comfort
effectDetails.rules: Reduces exhaustion by 5 points but imposes disadvantage on all Wisdom (Perception) checks until the start of your next long rest. This effect requires no activation and is instantaneous upon consumption.

leclaire_isle_item_crimson_tart_of_regre.levelRequirementReason: Suitable for adventurers at any level who seek personal growth or closure.
leclaire_isle_item_crimson_tart_of_regre.vendorReason: Sweet Supplies specializes in rare, magical confections that can aid the soul as much as the body.
leclaire_isle_item_crimson_tart_of_regre.shippingDetail: Ships via the Phantom Messenger, known for its speed and discretion. Delivery is immediate upon payment.

usage.duration: 1 hour or until consumed by fear effects
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a successful DC 15 Wisdom saving throw is made against fear effects, or the tart's flavor is fully experienced.

leclaire_isle_item_crimson_tart_of_regre.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP as it offers profound yet temporary benefits for adventurers seeking personal growth.

equestria_item_the_gilded_wrights_harmon.name: The Gilded Wright's Harmonious Resonator
equestria_item_the_gilded_wrights_harmon.description: The Gilded Wright's Harmonious Resonator is a delicate yet robust crystal instrument crafted by Silas Stonehoof, renowned for his mastery of earth and wind magic. Its golden surface gleams with an internal harmony that resonates with the natural world. When held aloft during combat, it amplifies protective energies, creating a shimmering aura that reflects both stability and resilience. This resonator is known to disrupt spells cast by enemies, offering a shield against earth-based attacks.

effectDetails.title: Stabilizing Shield
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Harmonious Resonator grants a +1 bonus to AC and advantage on saving throws against spells or effects with the earth descriptor. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Disruptive Aura
effectDetails.rules: The resonator emits a disruptive field within 30 feet around you, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls made by creatures with the earth subtype. This effect persists for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated.

equestria_item_the_gilded_wrights_harmon.levelRequirementReason: Requires high-level expertise to wield effectively in combat and maintain its magical resonance.
equestria_item_the_gilded_wrights_harmon.vendorReason: Known for their extensive stock of rare and powerful artifacts, Canterlot Commerce is a reliable source for such items.
equestria_item_the_gilded_wrights_harmon.shippingDetail: Delivered within one week via the esteemed Royal Pony Express service.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn or until you are incapacitated, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: You are incapacitated or lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell)
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest

equestria_item_the_gilded_wrights_harmon.priceReason: Reflects its craftsmanship by a legendary crystalwright and its powerful utility in combat.

equestria_item_mk.23_sparkly_crystal_fra.name: Mk.23 Sparkly Crystal Fragments of Echoing Storms
equestria_item_mk.23_sparkly_crystal_fra.description: The Mk.23 Sparkly Crystal Fragments of Echoing Storms are jagged, iridescent shards harvested from the heart of a captured thundercloud by Ponyville's eccentric inventor Fizzwick Sprocket. These crystals pulse with residual electrical energy, crackling faintly and emitting a chilling static. They can be held to restore 25 hit points and increase speed by 10% for 30 seconds, but they also have an unpredictable side effect: there’s a 5% chance that using them will stun the wielder's target foe.

effectDetails.title: Restore Hit Points
effectDetails.rules: When held, this item restores 25 hit points to the user. The effect is instantaneous and has no save DC or duration limit.

effectDetails.title: Increase Speed
effectDetails.rules: While holding these fragments, the user's speed increases by 10% for a period of 30 seconds. This effect ends if the user drops the fragments, takes damage, or uses an action to end it early.

equestria_item_mk.23_sparkly_crystal_fra.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and adventurers who may not yet have reached higher levels.
equestria_item_mk.23_sparkly_crystal_fra.vendorReason: Fizzwick Sprocket, the inventor of these fragments, sells them at his market stall to support Ponyville's growing community.
equestria_item_mk.23_sparkly_crystal_fra.shippingDetail: Delivered via Standard Delivery service within three days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous and lasts for 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: If the user drops them, takes damage, or uses an action to end it early

equestria_item_mk.23_sparkly_crystal_fra.priceReason: The price is set at 1000 XP as a balanced value for its level of power and utility.

equestria_item_the_aureate_crest_of_reso.name: The Aureate Crest of Resonance Faction
equestria_item_the_aureate_crest_of_reso.description: The Aureate Crest of Resonance Faction, a shimmering artifact forged from Celestia's celestial essence and adorned with iridescent auroc crystals, hums with an ancient power that resonates in harmony with the elements. This crest not only amplifies the wearer’s magical potency but also serves as a symbol of dedication to the Harmony Faction. Wielders find themselves attuned to elemental magic, their stress and anxiety dissolving under its calming aura.

effectDetails.title: Faction Symbol (Passive)
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains access to advanced Harmony Faction spells. This effect is always active, enhancing the caster's connection to elemental magic and granting +2 bonus to Charisma (Intimidation) checks.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Amplification
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The wearer’s next spell of 1st level or higher has advantage on its saving throw, and the spell's duration is doubled. This effect can be used once per long rest.

equestria_item_the_aureate_crest_of_reso.levelRequirementReason: This crest requires significant power to channel the advanced spells and harmonize with Celestia’s celestial essence.
equestria_item_the_aureate_crest_of_reso.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire, as a bastion of magical artifacts, holds exclusive rights to sell items imbued with the essence of the Harmony Faction.
equestria_item_the_aureate_crest_of_reso.shippingDetail: Ships via the Crystal Courier within one week of purchase. Expedited shipping available at extra cost.

usage.duration: Until the end of next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a new spell is cast or the wearer takes damage from an elemental source

equestria_item_the_aureate_crest_of_reso.priceReason: This crest’s rarity and power, combined with its exclusive vendor and limited availability, justify this price.

connectopia_item_celestial_miner_shards.name: Celestial Miner's Shard Cluster - Phase 7
connectopia_item_celestial_miner_shards.description: The Celestial Miner's Shard Cluster - Phase 7 glows faintly as it rests in your palm, a collection of shimmering mineral fragments forged from the upper reaches of Connectopia’s canyons. Crafted by the ancient miners who once ruled these lands, each shard resonates with a celestial hum that enhances your mining prowess.
