When you wield this cluster, hidden veins of rare block compounds are revealed with uncanny precision, and your efficiency in extracting them is greatly improved.

effectDetails.title: Miner's Edge
effectDetails.rules: While holding the Celestial Miner's Shard Cluster - Phase 7, your mining speed increases by 15%. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Vein Revelation
effectDetails.rules: Once per short rest, you can focus on a section of rock to reveal hidden veins of rare block compounds. You must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check with a DC equal to 10 + the rarity level of the block compound. This effect is limited to once per long rest.

connectopia_item_celestial_miner_shards.levelRequirementReason: This advanced mining tool requires significant skill and experience to master.
connectopia_item_celestial_miner_shards.vendorReason: The Block Smith specializes in rare and ancient mining tools, which are perfect for expert miners like those who need the Celestial Miner's Shard Cluster - Phase 7.
connectopia_item_celestial_miner_shards.shippingDetail: Ships directly from Connectopia’s canyons, ensuring fresh minerals within a week of purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required for mining speed increase.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; once per short rest to reveal hidden veins.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per long rest.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges on a full night’s sleep.

connectopia_item_celestial_miner_shards.priceReason: The advanced technology and craftsmanship required for this shard cluster justify its high price in experience points.

connectopia_item_pioneer_cursed_grapple_.name: Pioneer's Cursed Grapple Hook - Timberfang
connectopia_item_pioneer_cursed_grapple_.description: The Pioneer's Cursed Grapple Hook - Timberfang is a relic of the old frontier, forged from salvaged timber and imbued with an ancient spirit that once roamed these lands. Its tethered line is said to occasionally entangle with phantom settlers, creating small tremors as it does so. Use this hook to swing across chasms or reach distant mining sites at breakneck speed, but beware the unpredictable nature of its movements.

effectDetails.title: Phantom Entanglement
effectDetails.rules: When used, there is a 10% chance that the hook triggers a small tremor. The tremor deals 1d4 force damage to any creature within 5 feet and knocks them prone if they fail a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

effectDetails.title: Grapple Range +25m
effectDetails.rules: This effect allows you to use the grapple hook at an additional 25 meters of reach. You can make a grapple check using your Strength modifier plus half your proficiency bonus as usual, but this range does not include any distance covered by movement.

connectopia_item_pioneer_cursed_grapple_.levelRequirementReason: The item's unpredictable nature requires at least level 1 to handle effectively.
connectopia_item_pioneer_cursed_grapple_.vendorReason: Pioneer Post is known for dealing in frontier relics and this hook is a cherished artifact of the old west.
connectopia_item_pioneer_cursed_grapple_.shippingDetail: The Courier Bot ensures quick delivery, but due to its cursed nature, it may take an additional day if the tremor effect is triggered during shipment.

usage.activation: As a bonus action, you can activate the grapple hook's tethering ability.
usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The hook is retracted or destroyed by force; it regains charges when not in use for 1d4 hours.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one use per day due to the cursed nature.

connectopia_item_pioneer_cursed_grapple_.priceReason: This item combines rare materials with a powerful effect, making its price fair yet steep.

connectopia_item_settler_service_cart_re.name: Settler's Service Cart - Stabilized Unit Beta
connectopia_item_settler_service_cart_re.description: The Settler's Service Cart - Stabilized Unit Beta is a rugged, forgehearted marvel of engineering, crafted to endure Connectopia’s harshest terrains. Its reinforced chassis and automated repair systems instantly mend minor malfunctions in other carts, ensuring that supply lines stay unbroken even under the most grueling conditions. This cart doubles as a mobile workshop, capable of reducing repair costs by 20%, making it an indispensable asset for any adventurer or settler facing unpredictable challenges on the road.

effectDetails.title: Automated Repair
effectDetails.rules: Instantly repairs minor damage to other carts and equipment within a 30-foot radius. Requires line of sight and direct contact with the damaged item. Targets must be within the cart's repair range, which is extended by its reinforced chassis.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Repair Costs
effectDetails.rules: Reduces the cost of repairs to other carts or equipment by 20% for the next hour. Applies as a passive benefit while the cart remains operational within sight and reach of the user.

connectopia_item_settler_service_cart_re.levelRequirementReason: This item is suitable for adventurers of all levels, but it requires a basic understanding of mechanics to operate effectively.
connectopia_item_settler_service_cart_re.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in high-quality service items and repairs, making them the ideal vendor for this rugged cart.
connectopia_item_settler_service_cart_re.shippingDetail: Ships via scheduled delivery, ensuring timely arrival to any location within Connectopia.

usage.activation: Passive effect that activates automatically when the cart is operational and within sight of damaged equipment.
usage.duration: Instantaneous repair; reduced cost benefit lasts for one hour.
usage.endsWhen: The cart's power source depletes or repairs are completed. The passive cost reduction ends after an hour regardless.

connectopia_item_settler_service_cart_re.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP to reflect its utility and the materials used in its construction, ensuring it is a valuable addition without being overpowered.

doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_binder.name: The Crimson Void Binder
doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_binder.description: The Crimson Void Binder is a viscous, pulsating tear of reality that shimmers with an unsettling crimson light. When consumed, it momentarily solidifies the ambient void around you, granting fleeting resistance to dimensional instability and allowing brief manipulation of nearby negative space. Its power can be felt in the way it warps gravity for 60 seconds, making small objects phase through each other as if they were never there at all.

effectDetails.title: Void Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Activates on consumption. Grants a +4 bonus to saving throws against spells or effects that would manipulate the fabric of reality for 15 seconds. Ends when the duration expires.

effectDetails.title: Spatial Warp
effectDetails.rules: Grants the user the ability to phase through small objects within a 30-foot radius as long as they are consumed. This effect lasts for 60 seconds and can be used once per short or long rest.

doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_binder.levelRequirementReason: Requires at least 15th level to utilize the dimensional manipulation and gravity control effects effectively.
doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_binder.vendorReason: Void Vendor is known for dealing in rare and powerful items that manipulate the very fabric of reality, making The Crimson Void Binder a fitting addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_binder.shippingDetail: Ships directly from the void, arriving with a slight delay as it traverses through different dimensions.

usage.duration: 15 seconds for Void Resistance; 60 seconds for Spatial Warp
usage.endsWhen: Duration expires or if used again before resting
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per short or long rest

doughnut_hole_item_crimson_void_binder.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the item's rare nature and powerful effects that enhance reality manipulation.

doughnut_hole_item_wicked_resonance_frag.name: Wicked Resonance Fragment - Mk.77
doughnut_hole_item_wicked_resonance_frag.description: The Wicked Resonance Fragment - Mk.77 is a jagged, pulsating shard of solidified dissonance. Crafted from the very essence of chaos and madness, this fragment seems to actively seek out and amplify the bearer's darkest thoughts, potentially leading to fleeting moments of temporary insanity or profound perceptual clarity. Its malevolent energy can cause auditory hallucinations for 30 seconds, forcing the wearer to confront their most unsettling emotions in vivid detail.

effectDetails.title: Dark Resonance Amplification
effectDetails.rules: The bearer must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or suffer from temporary madness for 1 minute. This effect can be resisted once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Psychic Resistance Boost
effectDetails.rules: The bearer gains advantage on all saving throws against psychic damage and effects until the start of their next turn, with a maximum duration of 8 hours in any given day.

doughnut_hole_item_wicked_resonance_frag.levelRequirementReason: This fragment's malevolent energy is too powerful for those less experienced or less resilient to its influence.
doughnut_hole_item_wicked_resonance_frag.vendorReason: Hole Hawker specializes in exotic and dangerous items, making the Wicked Resonance Fragment a natural addition to their inventory.
doughnut_hole_item_wicked_resonance_frag.shippingDetail: The Shadow Messenger ensures discreet delivery within three days of order placement.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon donning the fragment; ends when removed or destroyed.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, with a daily cooldown period.
usage.endsWhen: Removed by the bearer or destroyed in battle.

doughnut_hole_item_wicked_resonance_frag.priceReason: The item's rarity and powerful effects justify its high price tag.

doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_chronal_tea.name: Anomalous Chronal Tears of Silence - Variant Theta
doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_chronal_tea.description: The Anomalous Chronal Tears of Silence - Variant Theta are obsidian spheres with a shimmering, almost liquid surface. When held, they create a localized temporal disturbance that muffles sound and momentarily freezes time within their vicinity, allowing the wielder to glimpse fleeting echoes of past events. These tears are said to have been crafted from the very fabric of the timestream itself by an ancient artifact forger known only as 'Silence'.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Muffle
effectDetails.rules: Activate on a bonus action to create a localized silence within a 10-foot radius for 5 seconds. During this time, all sound is muffled and movement appears distorted. This effect has no save DC and can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Chronal Echo Glimpse
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, the wielder gains a brief insight into past events within their line of sight for 10 seconds. This provides advantage on one Wisdom (Perception) check related to detecting temporal anomalies.

doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_chronal_tea.levelRequirementReason: Requires a certain understanding of chronal mechanics not available below level 5.
doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_chronal_tea.vendorReason: Known for their extensive knowledge in rare and ancient artifacts, the Center Seller often carries unique items like these Chronal Tears.
doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_chronal_tea.shippingDetail: Delivered via a secure temporal flux, ensuring the item arrives undistorted by time shifts.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate, once per short or long rest for Temporal Muffle; once per day for Chronal Echo Glimpse.
usage.duration: 5 seconds for Temporal Muffle; 10 seconds for Chronal Echo Glimpse.
usage.endsWhen: Effect duration ends naturally after time is restored, or the item is destroyed.

doughnut_hole_item_anomalous_chronal_tea.priceReason: Balanced price considering its unique temporal effects and rarity.

teyvat_item_electro_mora_of_reverie.name: The Electro Mora of Reverie Granted
teyvat_item_electro_mora_of_reverie.description: The Electro Mora of Reverie Granted, a pulsating orb that crackles with the restless energy of Mondstadt's electro spirits, grants you heightened combat awareness and a subtle amplification of prowess against Anemo-aligned foes. Held in your hand, it channels the very essence of the city’s guardian, Mora, imbuing you with a surge of power that can turn the tide of battle when faced with wind-elemental adversaries.

effectDetails.title: Anemo Amplifier
effectDetails.rules: When activated, this item grants a +15% increase to your attack damage against Anemo-aligned enemies for 60 seconds. This effect can be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Mora's Reverie
effectDetails.rules: There is a 25% chance that when you critically hit an Anemo enemy, they will be stunned for 1 round. This effect cannot be triggered more than once every 24 hours.

teyvat_item_electro_mora_of_reverie.levelRequirementReason: Players must have reached at least level 10 to harness the full power of this artifact.
teyvat_item_electro_mora_of_reverie.vendorReason: The market in Mondstadt is known for its diverse and powerful artifacts, and The Electro Mora of Reverie Granted is no exception.
teyvat_item_electro_mora_of_reverie.shippingDetail: Ships within three days with Sky Courier's express delivery service.

usage.activation: Activates as a bonus action when you critically hit an Anemo enemy.
usage.duration: 60 seconds, or until the target is no longer an Anemo-aligned enemy.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you are incapacitated or the item is destroyed.

teyvat_item_electro_mora_of_reverie.priceReason: This artifact is crafted with rare materials and imbued with powerful magic, making it a valuable but not overpowered purchase for players of level 10 and above.

teyvat_item_sacred_granted_of_lithos.name: Sacred Granted’s Lithos Resonance
teyvat_item_sacred_granted_of_lithos.description: Forged within the sacred confines of Liyue Harbor, this amulet captures the very essence of the earth's core in its molten heart. When worn, it channels the Geo-resonance into a protective shield around you, reducing physical damage by 10% and providing a steady pulse that counters Earth-based attacks with an additional 5%. Its arcane geometry whispers tales of ancient geomantic rituals, safeguarding the wearer from the very ground they walk upon.

effectDetails.title: Geo Resonance Shield
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, this amulet grants a +10% increase to your AC and provides +3 Geo Resistance. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you take damage from a non-Geo attack, at which point the shield dissipates.

effectDetails.title: Earth Counter
effectDetails.rules: For every 5 points of physical damage you mitigate with this amulet's effects, you gain temporary hit points equal to half that amount. This effect stacks up to +10 temporary hit points and does not exceed your maximum hit point total.

teyvat_item_sacred_granted_of_lithos.levelRequirementReason: The intricate craftsmanship and sacred energies embedded in the amulet demand a high level of expertise to wield effectively.
teyvat_item_sacred_granted_of_lithos.vendorReason: As guardians of ancient lore, the artisans at Liyue Harbor are entrusted with the creation and distribution of such powerful relics.
teyvat_item_sacred_granted_of_lithos.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by the Sea Serpent Express, ensuring this amulet arrives in pristine condition.

usage.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage from a non-Geo attack
usage.endsWhen: Damage from a non-Geo attack or after 1 minute

teyvat_item_sacred_granted_of_lithos.priceReason: Balanced to offer significant defensive benefits without overshadowing other gear options.

teyvat_item_mk17_electro_mora_of_flux.name: Mk.17 Electro Mora of Flux Granted
teyvat_item_mk17_electro_mora_of_flux.description: The Mk.17 Electro Mora of Flux Granted is a delicate sphere crafted from ancient Inazuman bronze and encased in a lustrous flux crystal. It hums with latent electrical energy, a relic salvaged from the depths of an underwater shrine dedicated to the flow of time. This artifact can be used to momentarily disrupt electro currents, granting brief bursts of power and creating a localized surge that snares foes in its grasp.

effectDetails.title: Flux Surge
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the user can activate the Mora to unleash a surge of electro energy within a 5-foot radius. All enemies in that area take 2d6 lightning damage and are pushed back 10 feet. The effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Snares of Flux
effectDetails.rules: The Mora emits an electromagnetic field when activated, reducing the movement speed of all creatures within a 30-foot radius by half for 2 seconds. This effect can be triggered once per long rest.

teyvat_item_mk17_electro_mora_of_flux.levelRequirementReason: This device requires significant magical knowledge and control to harness its volatile electro energy.
teyvat_item_mk17_electro_mora_of_flux.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in exotic artifacts from forgotten shrines, making this relic an appropriate addition to their inventory.
teyvat_item_mk17_electro_mora_of_flux.shippingDetail: The Phantom Delivery Drone ensures swift and secure transport of the Mora, guaranteeing it arrives pristine and intact.

usage.duration: 1 Minute
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when a creature moves out of the radius or at the end of its next turn

teyvat_item_mk17_electro_mora_of_flux.priceReason: The artifact's ancient origins and powerful effects justify this balanced price.

middle_earth_item_sunstone_dancer_of_val.name: Sunstone Dancer of Valar
middle_earth_item_sunstone_dancer_of_val.description: The Sunstone Dancer of Valar is an elven cloak, its threads spun from solidified sunlight and enchanted with the ancient songs of the Valar. Worn during perilous journeys through Middle-earth, it not only provides a shimmering protective aura but also grants bursts of radiant warmth that bolster stamina. The fabric dances in the wind like a celestial being, its movement both mesmerizing and comforting to those who wear it.

effectDetails.title: Radiant Warmth
effectDetails.rules: At the start of each of your turns while wearing the cloak, you gain a +1 bonus to your Constitution saving throws and can recover a number of hit points equal to 5 plus your level.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Aura
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the cloak, you have a shimmering protective aura that reduces all fire damage you take by 20% for up to 1 minute. This effect ends if you take any non-fire damage or are incapacitated.

middle_earth_item_sunstone_dancer_of_val.levelRequirementReason: This cloak requires significant magical power, making it suitable only for seasoned adventurers.
middle_earth_item_sunstone_dancer_of_val.vendorReason: The elven market specializes in rare artifacts and relics of great power, ensuring that this enchanted item is available to those who can afford its price.
middle_earth_item_sunstone_dancer_of_val.shippingDetail: Ships via the Winged Courier, known for swift and reliable deliveries across Middle-earth.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You take non-fire damage or become incapacitated

middle_earth_item_sunstone_dancer_of_val.priceReason: The balance is maintained by the cloak's limited daily stock and its significant magical components.

middle_earth_item_orcish_rune_of_grimsto.name: Orcish Rune of Grimstone Whisper
middle_earth_item_orcish_rune_of_grimsto.description: Forged deep within Mordor's infernal forges, the Orcish Rune of Grimstone Whisper glows with a malevolent, guttural pulse. Holding it momentarily allows you to grasp fleeting fragments of ancient orcish whispers—tales of forgotten battles and rituals that seem to echo from the very pits of Sauron's domain. The rune's resonant hum is both mesmerizing and perilous; understanding its fragmented messages comes at a cost, as your mind begins to unravel in the chaos of its whispering.

effectDetails.title: Orcish Whisper
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can focus on the rune for up to 1 minute. While active, you gain temporary access to fragments of the orcish language. You can understand and speak orcish as if fluent, but interpreting the messages is fraught with danger; there's a 20% chance each round that you become confused (as the effect) until your next short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Resilience Against Fear
effectDetails.rules: While in contact with the rune, you have advantage on saving throws against fear effects. Additionally, if you are already affected by a fear effect when you activate the rune, you can make an additional saving throw against it at the start of your next turn.

middle_earth_item_orcish_rune_of_grimsto.levelRequirementReason: The rune's malevolent energy requires a basic understanding of resilience to handle its whispers.
middle_earth_item_orcish_rune_of_grimsto.vendorReason: The dwarves of Erebor, ever intrigued by dark artifacts, have acquired and studied this cursed relic.
middle_earth_item_orcish_rune_of_grimsto.shippingDetail: Shipped with special care to prevent the rune from affecting the courier's mind.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; remains active for up to 1 minute.
usage.duration: Up to 1 minute, or until you stop focusing on it.
usage.endsWhen: You stop concentrating, or if you become confused by the whispers.

middle_earth_item_orcish_rune_of_grimsto.priceReason: The rune's dark origin and the perilous nature of its effects justify a high price.

middle_earth_item_mk_86_cloak_of_shire_p.name: Mk.86 Cloak of Shire Protection
middle_earth_item_mk_86_cloak_of_shire_p.description: The Mk.86 Cloak of Shire Protection is a meticulously crafted garment made from sturdy wool and reinforced with hobbit-engineered stitching. It features hidden pockets for supplies and a hood that doubles as a small shelter, providing excellent protection against the elements. Known to enhance survival chances in the wild, it subtly increases your carrying capacity by 10% and offers a 5% chance of finding extra food or supplies during your travels.

effectDetails.title: Protection Against Elements
effectDetails.rules: The cloak provides moderate protection against rain, snow, and minor scrapes. It has no save requirement but is only effective while you are wearing it.

effectDetails.title: Increased Carrying Capacity
effectDetails.rules: Increases your carrying capacity by 10%, a passive effect that remains active as long as the cloak is worn.

middle_earth_item_mk_86_cloak_of_shire_p.levelRequirementReason: This cloak is designed to be accessible, providing basic protection and utility for all adventurers.
middle_earth_item_mk_86_cloak_of_shire_p.vendorReason: The Shire Shop specializes in goods crafted by hobbits, including this practical yet charming piece of attire.
middle_earth_item_mk_86_cloak_of_shire_p.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by a Cart Pony, often arriving the same day if the weather is clear.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; active as long as the cloak is worn.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted upon removal or destruction of the cloak.

middle_earth_item_mk_86_cloak_of_shire_p.priceReason: The cloak's unique engineering and utility justify its higher price, offering both protection and convenience.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_crimson_lord_s.name: The Crimson Lord’s Shroom
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_crimson_lord_s.description: The Crimson Lord's Shroom pulses with a fiery red glow, its surface smooth yet subtly textured like ancient stone. This fungal monarch whispers of battles fought and won by warlords long past. Consuming it grants you temporary command over lesser fungal units, bolstering your attack power and intimidating foes with its imposing presence. The mushroom's spores are known to linger in the air for days after consumption, spreading a cloud that enhances fungal attacks against all enemies nearby.

effectDetails.title: Command Over Fungus
effectDetails.rules: You gain temporary control over any fungal unit within 30 feet for the duration. You can issue a single command per round, which must be obeyed by all affected fungi. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Fungal Ferocity
effectDetails.rules: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and a +1 bonus to damage rolls against targets within 30 feet for 60 seconds. Additionally, enemies within this range have their resistance to fungal attacks reduced by 25%. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or if the duration expires.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_crimson_lord_s.levelRequirementReason: This mushroom is potent enough to be consumed by even low-level adventurers for its immediate tactical advantage.
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_crimson_lord_s.vendorReason: The Toad Town Market specializes in local fungi and their unique properties, making it the perfect vendor for such a powerful yet accessible item.
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_crimson_lord_s.shippingDetail: Delivered by a mushroom cart, this item may arrive with minor delays due to its delicate nature. Ensure proper handling upon receipt.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: You are incapacitated or the duration ends
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short rest

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_crimson_lord_s.priceReason: Balanced at this price to reflect its potent effects and limited daily stock.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_echoing_gearpl.name: The Echoing Gearplate of Silent Coins
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_echoing_gearpl.description: The Echoing Gearplate of Silent Coins is a thick, coin-dusted plate that whispers to its wearer, guiding them through bustling markets and combat alike. Crafted from the very essence of countless trades, it hums softly when valuable coins are nearby, amplifying wealth and providing subtle cues to lucrative opportunities. In battle, the gearplate doubles the value of any earned coinage during combat encounters, turning even the smallest gains into fortune.

effectDetails.title: Coin Duplication Bonus
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this gearplate in a combat encounter, the wearer has a 10% chance to double the value of any coins they earn during that battle. This effect lasts for the duration of the fight and can be used once per day.

effectDetails.title: Market Mastery
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +2 bonus to all trading and haggling rolls when interacting with vendor stalls or markets, making them nearly unbeatable at bargaining. This passive effect is always active while the gearplate is worn.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_echoing_gearpl.levelRequirementReason: This item's subtle enhancements make it accessible for most adventurers who can afford its price.
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_echoing_gearpl.vendorReason: Wario Direct specializes in items that enhance one's fortune and trading skills, making the Echoing Gearplate a perfect fit for their inventory.
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_echoing_gearpl.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by Express Mushroom Delivery, this item arrives within a day of purchase.

usage.duration: Active while worn and during combat encounters only for the duration of said battle.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when removed or at the end of a combat encounter, whichever comes first. It can be used once per day.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_echoing_gearpl.priceReason: Offered as an accessible rare item, this gearplate provides significant utility without breaking the game balance.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_mega_yielding_.name: The Mega Yielding Primeval Puff
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_mega_yielding_.description: The Mega Yielding Primeval Puff, a colossal bioluminescent mushroom grown deep within the war-torn territories of Mushroom Kingdom, glows with an ethereal light that illuminates its fierce form. When consumed, it releases a potent spore cloud that rapidly accelerates growth and grants temporary strength and resilience, perfect for weathering sieges or overwhelming foes. The spores also provide immunity to poison and disease effects, ensuring the wielder's survival in perilous conditions.

effectDetails.title: Rapid Growth Acceleration
effectDetails.rules: When consumed, this oversized mushroom immediately increases the user’s Strength and Constitution by +40% for 60 seconds. The effect is instantaneous upon activation but ends if the user takes any damage or moves more than 20 feet away.

effectDetails.title: Primeval Surge
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that, once per short rest, the mushroom triggers a Primeval Surge. This effect deals 10d6 bludgeoning damage in a 10-foot radius centered on the user and lasts for 1 minute, expiring if the user takes any damage.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_mega_yielding_.levelRequirementReason: This ancient mushroom requires a certain level of resilience to activate its potent effects safely.
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_mega_yielding_.vendorReason: The Koopa Shop specializes in rare and powerful items, including this legendary mushroom.
mushroom_kingdom_item_the_mega_yielding_.shippingDetail: Delivered by the fastest royal courier within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.duration: 60 seconds or until triggered Primeval Surge ends, whichever comes first.
usage.endsWhen: The user takes damage or moves more than 20 feet away; the Primeval Surge effect expires after 1 minute.

mushroom_kingdom_item_the_mega_yielding_.priceReason: This item’s rarity, potent effects, and limited availability justify its high price in XP.

faerun_item_twilight_stalker_helm.name: The Twilight Stalker’s Helm of Drakon's Whisper
faerun_item_twilight_stalker_helm.description: Forged from the scales of a twilight drake, The Twilight Stalker’s Helm of Drakon's Whisper bears runes that whisper ancient dragon lore to its wearer. It grants chilling resistance to fire and an uncanny ability to detect dragons by scent alone, as if they were mere shadows in the night. A helm so potent that it seems almost alive with the whispers of forgotten prophecies, it is a relic from a time when dragons ruled Faerûn.

effectDetails.title: Detect Dragons
effectDetails.rules: At will, you can activate this helm to gain the ability to detect dragons within 60 feet as if using the Detect Magic spell. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to your proficiency bonus (minimum of 1 round).

effectDetails.title: Fire Resistance
effectDetails.rules: While wearing The Twilight Stalker’s Helm, you have advantage on saving throws against fire damage and gain resistance to fire damage.

faerun_item_twilight_stalker_helm.levelRequirementReason: This helm requires a minimum character level of 15 due to its complex enchantments and the potent dragon lore it contains.
faerun_item_twilight_stalker_helm.vendorReason: The Sword Coast Traders are known for their extensive network of contacts across Faerûn, ensuring that even the most arcane items find a home in their inventory.
faerun_item_twilight_stalker_helm.shippingDetail: Delivered swiftly by winged horse couriers, this helm arrives with a special protective charm to ensure it remains undamaged during transit.

usage.activation: At will (recharges after a short or long rest)
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Detect Dragons; lasts until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The helm is removed, or you make an attack with a melee weapon

faerun_item_twilight_stalker_helm.priceReason: This helm’s price reflects its rarity and the complex enchantments that imbue it with dragon lore and fire resistance.

faerun_item_ancient_stalker_amulet.name: The Ancient Stalker’s Amulet of the Silverwood Guardians
faerun_item_ancient_stalker_amulet.description: The Ancient Stalker's Amulet of the Silverwood Guardians is a petrified branch encased in shimmering silver, its surface etched with intricate runes that pulse with ancient magic. Crafted from the heartwood of the Silverwood, it protects against decay and offers a spectral guardian when summoned. This amulet enhances survival checks within dense forests, granting advantage on such rolls, while also offering minor regeneration to wounds sustained in these verdant realms.

effectDetails.title: Poison Resistance
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains resistance to poison damage. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn after taking poison, providing a temporary immunity.

effectDetails.title: Minor Regeneration
effectDetails.rules: Once per long rest, the wearer regains 1d6 + Constitution modifier hit points as long as they are in an area with heavy plant growth. This effect can only be used once per day and is exhausted after use.

faerun_item_ancient_stalker_amulet.levelRequirementReason: The amulet's intricate runes require a seasoned adventurer to wield it effectively.
faerun_item_ancient_stalker_amulet.vendorReason: Baldur’s Bazaar caters to adventurers seeking rare and ancient artifacts that can enhance their survival in the wilds.
faerun_item_ancient_stalker_amulet.shippingDetail: The amulet is delivered by a giant owl, ensuring safe passage through treacherous terrains.

usage.activation: Passive effect; regeneration occurs automatically when conditions are met.
usage.duration: Instantaneous for poison resistance; daily use for regeneration.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use or once the long rest period ends.

faerun_item_ancient_stalker_amulet.priceReason: Crafted from ancient Silverwood and imbued with powerful protective magic, this amulet justifies its substantial price.

faerun_item_mk_78_ancient_helm.name: Mk.78 Ancient Helms of the Forgotten Kings
faerun_item_mk_78_ancient_helm.description: The Mk.78 Ancient Helm of the Forgotten Kings is a helm forged from the lost metals of an ancient kingdom, its surface etched with runes that whisper tales of elemental might. Crafted by kings who commanded the elements, it exudes an aura of forgotten power and arcane knowledge. The helm's weighty presence commands respect, and those who wear it feel the weight of their legacy upon their shoulders.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Command
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you may command one element to aid you. Choose between fire, water, air, or earth. The chosen element provides a minor benefit for the duration of your next short rest.

effectDetails.title: Forgotten Fortitude
effectDetails.rules: You gain resistance to necrotic damage and have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. This effect lasts until you finish a long rest.

faerun_item_mk_78_ancient_helm.levelRequirementReason: Only the most powerful and seasoned heroes can wield such an ancient artifact without risk.
faerun_item_mk_78_ancient_helm.vendorReason: The Waterdeep Market is known for its extensive collection of rare and exotic artifacts, including relics from lost ages.
faerun_item_mk_78_ancient_helm.shippingDetail: Delivered by the Sea Serpent, this helm arrives with a delay due to its sheer weight and importance.

usage.duration: Until next short rest (Elemental Command), Until end of long rest (Forgotten Fortitude)
usage.endsWhen: Exhaustion ends when the duration expires

faerun_item_mk_78_ancient_helm.priceReason: The helm's rarity and magical properties make it a fair price, but still within reach for those on the highest tier of adventuring.

kivotos_item_twilight_gifted_uniform.name: Twilight Gifted's Circlet of Student Resonance
kivotos_item_twilight_gifted_uniform.description: This shimmering circlet, forged from twilight-infused academy silks and blessed by the Halos Club’s elder initiates, amplifies your connection to the neural network of Academy City. It grants heightened perception within a localized radius, allowing you to subtly influence information flow—perfect for navigating student politics or evading notice in crowded halls. The circlet is said to resonate with the very fabric of knowledge itself, its power drawing from the city’s own mind.

effectDetails.title: Heightened Perception
effectDetails.rules: While wearing this circlet, you gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and can attempt to notice details within a 30-foot radius. You can use an action to cast the Detect Thoughts spell without expending a spell slot.

effectDetails.title: Subtle Influence
effectDetails.rules: You can expend one charge to exert a subtle influence on a single creature or object within your circlet’s localized radius, affecting its perception of you as either more or less important than they are. This effect lasts for 1 minute and has no save DC.

kivotos_item_twilight_gifted_uniform.levelRequirementReason: This circlet requires significant mental fortitude to wield effectively, suitable only for the most experienced students of the Academy City.
kivotos_item_twilight_gifted_uniform.vendorReason: The student store stocks this item as it is a crucial tool for navigating both academic and social spheres within the city’s elite institutions.
kivotos_item_twilight_gifted_uniform.shippingDetail: Ships via Drone Delivery, usually arriving within 24 hours of purchase.

usage.activation: Action or Reaction to cast Detect Thoughts spell (no spell slot required) or expend a charge for Subtle Influence.
usage.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until the end of your next turn unless countered.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you are incapacitated or the circlet is removed from your head.
usage.charges: 5 charges; recharges after 8 hours of uninterrupted rest.

kivotos_item_twilight_gifted_uniform.priceReason: This circlet’s price reflects its mythic rarity and the advanced neural technology required for its construction, making it a sought-after tool among students.

kivotos_item_mk91_club_uniform.name: Mk.91 Club Standardized Uniform of Echoing Voices
kivotos_item_mk91_club_uniform.description: The Mk.91 Club Standardized Uniform of Echoing Voices is crafted from reinforced academy fabric, adorned with intricate sonic glyphs that whisper the history of its purpose. This uniform grants you instant membership to any student club and subtly amplifies your voice during group discussions, enhancing both your persuasive power and providing a dramatic echo effect for emphasis. The garment's origin lies in the hallowed halls of Echoing Academy, where tradition meets innovation.

effectDetails.title: Increased Persuasion
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can activate the uniform's subtle amplification to enhance your persuasive efforts. This increases the DC of any Charisma (Persuasion) check by +2 until the start of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Auditory Echo Effect
effectDetails.rules: The uniform grants a minor auditory echo effect, allowing you to repeat a word or phrase you just heard as if it were your own. This can be used once per long rest and has no range limitation.

kivotos_item_mk91_club_uniform.levelRequirementReason: This uniform is designed for beginners and those seeking immediate club affiliation.
kivotos_item_mk91_club_uniform.vendorReason: Club_supply specializes in the ephemeral needs of students, including this emblematic piece of attire.
kivotos_item_mk91_club_uniform.shippingDetail: Delivered within a week, ensuring you're ready for your first club meeting.

usage.duration: Until the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you use another bonus action to activate it or until your next long rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, as a long rest recharges it

kivotos_item_mk91_club_uniform.priceReason: This price reflects the unique combination of club affiliation and enhanced persuasive abilities offered by this uniform.

kivotos_item_halo_resonance_service.name: The Chronal Harmonization Service: Temporal Echo Audit
kivotos_item_halo_resonance_service.description: The Chronal Harmonization Service: Temporal Echo Audit is a bespoke consultation offered by the Academy's temporal mechanics department. This meticulously crafted service involves a highly precise, non-invasive scan that gently corrects minor temporal distortions affecting your cognitive processes—essentially resetting your personal timeline to enhance clarity and stability. The process reveals hidden memories, unlocking forgotten knowledge and experiences with no adverse effects. This service is a legend among scholars seeking to recalibrate their chronometric patterns.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Resonance Calibration
effectDetails.rules: This effect provides a bonus of +1 on all Intelligence (History) and Wisdom (Insight) checks for the next 24 hours. The service also grants temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier × 5, which are regained at the end of each short rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Cognitive Stability
effectDetails.rules: For 1 hour after the consultation, you gain advantage on saving throws against effects that would alter time or impose conditions related to time manipulation. This effect does not stack with similar abilities.

kivotos_item_halo_resonance_service.levelRequirementReason: This service is designed for individuals who have already demonstrated a basic understanding of chronometric principles and are seeking to fine-tune their temporal knowledge.
kivotos_item_halo_resonance_service.vendorReason: The Academy Armory exclusively offers this service, as it requires the specialized expertise of its temporal mechanics department.
kivotos_item_halo_resonance_service.shippingDetail: Ships via a Temporal Courier within one game week. Delivery is guaranteed to be precise and accurate.

usage.activation: Passive effect upon completion of the consultation, lasting for the duration specified in the effects.
usage.duration: 24 hours and 1 hour (as specified in the effects).
usage.endsWhen: The temporal stability is regained or the effect ends naturally.

kivotos_item_halo_resonance_service.priceReason: This service is balanced at 500 XP, offering a limited-time boost to temporal knowledge and resilience without overpowered effects.

internet_item_buffered_keys_of_the_phant.name: The Buffered Keys of the Phantom Server
internet_item_buffered_keys_of_the_phant.description: The Buffered Keys of the Phantom Server shimmer with faint, digital afterglows—remnants of forgotten data streams and lost server echoes. Holding them grants a brief moment of clarity amidst chaotic code, but prolonged use risks becoming ensnared in the static. These keys are crafted from salvaged silicon and copper, imbued with the essence of long-dormant servers, allowing for a fleeting glimpse into the ghostly pasts of digital realms.

effectDetails.title: Digital Clarity
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants a +20% increase to data processing speed for 60 seconds, allowing for rapid and efficient handling of complex digital tasks. Ends when the user completes their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Static Resistance
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect while holding the keys. Provides resistance against digital corruption effects equal to your proficiency bonus +2. This effect does not stack with other forms of static resistance or similar benefits.

internet_item_buffered_keys_of_the_phant.levelRequirementReason: This item is designed for beginners and those just starting their journey in the digital realm, offering them a gentle introduction to handling complex data without overwhelming challenges.
internet_item_buffered_keys_of_the_phant.vendorReason: The Data Dealer specializes in salvaged tech and digital artifacts, making these keys an ideal addition to their inventory.
internet_item_buffered_keys_of_the_phant.shippingDetail: Ships via Drone Delivery for expedited service; typically arrives within a day.

usage.duration: 60 seconds, ending at the start of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you complete your next turn

internet_item_buffered_keys_of_the_phant.priceReason: The item's rarity, its origin from salvaged servers, and the specific benefits it provides justify this price point.

internet_item_fabled_bounds_key_of_the_l.name: Fabled Bound’s Key of the Lost Archive
internet_item_fabled_bounds_key_of_the_l.description: Forged from solidified regret and compressed bandwidth, this key unlocks access to a hidden archive – a repository of forgotten user profiles and corrupted data. The air around it crackles with a strange nostalgia, pulling on the memories of those nearby.
effects: Reveals hidden data fragments within a 10-meter radius
Provides a temporary boost to memory recall (increased chance of finding clues)
Emits a low, unsettling hum that can disorient opponents
Chance to summon a spectral 'Data Echo' - a fleeting image of a past user.

internet_item_mk.86_buffered_resonance_k.name: Mk.86 Buffered Resonance Key of the Algorithmic Storm
internet_item_mk.86_buffered_resonance_k.description: The Mk.86 Buffered Resonance Key of the Algorithmic Storm is an intricately carved digital artifact, its surface a maelstrom of pulsing binary light. Crafted from obsidian and inlaid with microchips harvested from ancient data nodes, this key allows you to manipulate localized data streams. With it, you can create temporary algorithmic storms that disrupt enemy electronic devices or reroute data packets for tactical advantage. Misuse risks catastrophic system failures, so wield it with precision.
effects: Creates a localized data disruption field

effectDetails.title: Localized Data Disruption Field
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within range (30 feet), this key creates a field that deals 1d6 force damage to all electronic devices in the area. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until dispelled by magic.

effectDetails.title: Data Packet Rerouting
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, you can reroute data packets within a 50-foot radius, providing a +2 bonus to all electronic device-related checks and saving throws made against hacking attempts. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

internet_item_mk.86_buffered_resonance_k.levelRequirementReason: This key is designed for beginners who wish to experiment with data manipulation without advanced training.
internet_item_mk.86_buffered_resonance_k.vendorReason: The cyber_market specializes in high-tech and digital equipment, making it the ideal vendor for such a specialized item.
internet_item_mk.86_buffered_resonance_k.shippingDetail: Delivered instantly by the Automated Delivery Bot to your doorstep.

usage.duration: Localized Data Disruption Field lasts 1 minute; Data Packet Rerouting lasts until next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The field is dispelled by magic, and rerouting ends when the user's turn ends.

internet_item_mk.86_buffered_resonance_k.priceReason: This key strikes a balance between its powerful effects and rarity, making it moderately expensive.

equestria_item_luminous_shaper_horseshoe.name: Luminous Shaper's Horseshoes – Mk.81
equestria_item_luminous_shaper_horseshoe.description: The Luminous Shaper's Horseshoes – Mk.81 shimmer with a soft, ethereal glow that hints at elemental power. Crafted from enchanted metal and infused with the essence of the Elements, these horseshoes subtly enhance a pony’s movement speed by +15%, allowing for agile navigation through treacherous terrain or delivering powerful kicks. When activated, they channel kinetic force into brief bursts, enabling the wearer to manipulate nearby objects with surprising precision.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Agility
effectDetails.rules: The Luminous Shaper's Horseshoes grant a +15% increase to movement speed for the wearer. This effect is passive and does not require activation.

effectDetails.title: Kinetic Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: By expending a use, the pony can manipulate kinetic force within 5 feet of them, creating a minor push or pull on objects (1d4 force damage) for a duration of up to 1 minute. This effect requires an action and ends if the wearer moves more than 30 feet away from the target.

equestria_item_luminous_shaper_horseshoe.levelRequirementReason: These horseshoes are designed for beginners who wish to enhance their natural abilities with a touch of magic.
equestria_item_luminous_shaper_horseshoe.vendorReason: Canterlot Commerce specializes in unique and enchanted items, making the Luminous Shaper's Horseshoes an ideal addition to its inventory.
equestria_item_luminous_shaper_horseshoe.shippingDetail: The horseshoes are shipped within two days of purchase with priority delivery.

usage.activation: Uses an action or bonus action.
usage.duration: Up to 1 minute per use.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after a use, recharges at dawn the next day.

equestria_item_luminous_shaper_horseshoe.priceReason: The horseshoes are priced at 1000 XP due to their magical enchantments and rarity in crafting materials.

equestria_item_kind_horseshoes_of_resona.name: Kind Horseshoes of Resonance – The Silver Quill
equestria_item_kind_horseshoes_of_resona.description: The Kind Horseshoes of Resonance – The Silver Quill are crafted from polished silver, each horseshoe intricately engraved with symbols of compassion and peace. These enchanted horseshoes not only foster a deep sense of calm but also amplify empathetic understanding among ponies, potentially diffusing even the most tense situations into harmonious accord. Worn by a pony, they emit a soft, soothing glow that can pacify nearby enemies without resorting to combat or aggression.

effectDetails.title: Increased Empathy (+20%)
effectDetails.rules: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks and has advantage on Insight checks made to sense the emotions of others. This effect lasts until the end of each day.

effectDetails.title: Pacifying Aura
effectDetails.rules: This aura creates a 10-foot radius around the wearer, which provides advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed within its area for up to one hour per use. Once used, it must recharge after 8 hours of rest.

equestria_item_kind_horseshoes_of_resona.levelRequirementReason: The Kind Horseshoes require a minimum level as they are crafted for ponies who have already demonstrated the capacity for deep empathy and pacifism.
equestria_item_kind_horseshoes_of_resona.vendorReason: As a central market, Ponyville Market is trusted by many to sell items that promote peace and harmony among all residents.
equestria_item_kind_horseshoes_of_resona.shippingDetail: Ships via Cloud Courier Services with same-day delivery within the Equestria region.

usage.activation: Passive effect, activated upon donning the horseshoes.
usage.duration: Lasts until the end of each day for Increased Empathy and one hour per use for Pacifying Aura.
usage.endsWhen: The effects end when the day ends or the aura is used up to its limit.
usage.charges: Increased Empathy lasts indefinitely, but the Pacifying Aura can be used once every 8 hours.

equestria_item_kind_horseshoes_of_resona.priceReason: The high price reflects the unique crafting process and rare materials needed for these horseshoes, ensuring a fair value based on their magical properties.

equestria_item_aureate_harmony_shield_of.name: Aureate Harmony Shield of Echoes – The Chronos Guard
equestria_item_aureate_harmony_shield_of.description: The Aureate Harmony Shield of Echoes, a legendary relic from the Chronos Guard, is forged in the heart of temporal rifts and adorned with iridescent runes that pulse with harmonious energy. It not only absorbs significant physical damage but also protects its wielder from the distortions of time, offering glimpses into potential futures. With each strike, the shield whispers secrets of the past and future, enhancing its protector's awareness of impending danger.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Shield
effectDetails.rules: When you are hit by an attack, this shield absorbs significant damage (+60%) and grants a brief regeneration. It also provides resistance to temporal distortions.

effectDetails.title: Echo Glimpses
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, the wielder gains a brief flash of insight into potential futures, providing advantage on one saving throw against time-based effects.

equestria_item_aureate_harmony_shield_of.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest warrior can benefit from this shield's protective properties.
equestria_item_aureate_harmony_shield_of.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire has a long-standing relationship with the Chronos Guard, ensuring only the finest relics are sold.
equestria_item_aureate_harmony_shield_of.shippingDetail: Ships via Temporal Courier Service, arriving instantly upon payment of fees.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you take a long rest or are incapacitated

equestria_item_aureate_harmony_shield_of.priceReason: Balanced to be within reach for a skilled warrior, yet still rare and valuable.

animatopia_item_crimson_echo_talon.name: The Crimson Echo Talon of the Elder Burrow
animatopia_item_crimson_echo_talon.description: The Crimson Echo Talon of the Elder Burrow is a talon forged from the hardened cries of ancient burrowing spirits and river clay. Its surface crackles with primal energy, whispering of forgotten tribal secrets. When wielded in chaos, it grants the user momentary clarity, enhancing Perception for 60 seconds, and reveals hidden pathways within dense forests for 15 seconds. The talon occasionally conjures a calming illusion of ancestral voices, soothing the soul during tumultuous times.

effectDetails.title: Clarity and Pathfinding
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants +3 to Perception checks for 60 seconds, revealing hidden paths in dense forests for the same duration. This effect can be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Ancestral Illusion
effectDetails.rules: Can be activated as a reaction when you are affected by a hostile force or chaotic situation within a forest. Conjures an illusory presence of ancestral voices that soothes the soul for 1 minute, providing advantage on all Wisdom (Perception) checks made to resist being frightened.

animatopia_item_crimson_echo_talon.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant experience and understanding of natural magic to wield this talon effectively.
animatopia_item_crimson_echo_talon.vendorReason: The forest market has the extensive knowledge of local fauna and spirits, making it a trusted source for such items.
animatopia_item_crimson_echo_talon.shippingDetail: Ships via the Winged Courier within two game days, ensuring safe delivery to your doorstep.

usage.duration: 60 seconds or until end of effect
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when used again or after one long rest for Clarity and Pathfinding; upon activation of a hostile force for Ancestral Illusion.

animatopia_item_crimson_echo_talon.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the talon's unique abilities and its rarity in the wild.

animatopia_item_starfall_weaver_reaver.name: Starfall Weaver’s Reaver of the Lunar Grove
animatopia_item_starfall_weaver_reaver.description: The Starfall Weaver’s Reaver of the Lunar Grove is a sabre forged from the solidified essence of moonlight, its blade woven with threads of celestial silk and enchanted by the spirits of the night. Crafted in the shadowed halls of the Lunar Grove, it hums with an ancient power that resonates during lunar rituals. The reaver allows the wielder to manipulate shadows, enhancing their connection to the ethereal realm, and grants them swift movement through darkened spaces.

effectDetails.title: Celestial Shadow Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: As an action, the wielder can use this reaver to cast 'Veil of Shadows' once per day. This spell creates a shimmering veil that grants advantage on Stealth checks and allows the caster to move through difficult terrain at half speed without triggering opportunity attacks.

effectDetails.title: Moonlit Swiftstep
effectDetails.rules: While in dark areas, the wielder gains a bonus to movement equal to 10 feet. This effect lasts until the start of their next turn or until they leave a dark area.

animatopia_item_starfall_weaver_reaver.levelRequirementReason: This reaver requires significant power and control over shadow magic, suitable only for those of great experience in arcane arts.
animatopia_item_starfall_weaver_reaver.vendorReason: The Beast Bazaar trades in rare magical artifacts, including this celestial weapon forged deep within the Lunar Grove.
animatopia_item_starfall_weaver_reaver.shippingDetail: Ships via Dire Rat Delivery’s express nocturnal route, ensuring timely arrival during the night cycle.

usage.activation: Action to cast 'Veil of Shadows'; passive movement bonus active in dark areas.
usage.duration: Veil of Shadows lasts until end of turn; Moonlit Swiftstep ends when leaving a dark area.
usage.endsWhen: Charges expended or wielder leaves a dark area

animatopia_item_starfall_weaver_reaver.priceReason: The reaver's unique crafting materials and the power it commands make it an expensive and rare treasure.

animatopia_item_serpent_song_service_tok.name: The Serpent Song Service Token - 'Whisper of the Coil'
animatopia_item_serpent_song_service_tok.description: The Serpent Song Service Token, 'Whisper of the Coil,' is a polished obsidian token inlaid with scales that shimmer like living silver. Crafted by the enigmatic Coil Singers, this token allows you to commission a weapon imbued with potent sonic vibrations. The resulting enhancement disrupts enemy defenses and grants bonus damage against armored foes, leaving them reeling from the shockwaves. The service also includes 24 hours of personalized combat advice, ensuring your next battle is well-prepared.

effectDetails.title: Sonic Distortion
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. The weapon imbued with this enhancement deals an additional 1d6 force damage against armored targets. This effect lasts for 30 minutes.

effectDetails.title: Personalized Combat Advice
effectDetails.rules: Provides the user with in-depth, strategic advice for combat lasting 24 hours. The advice can be used once per day and must be requested before entering a battle.

animatopia_item_serpent_song_service_tok.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant skill to properly commission and utilize this service.
animatopia_item_serpent_song_service_tok.vendorReason: The Tribal Trader has exclusive access to the Coil Singers' services due to long-standing alliances.
animatopia_item_serpent_song_service_tok.shippingDetail: Delivery is expedited within a week, ensuring timely arrival for critical battles.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate the weapon enhancement; combat advice can be requested at any time before battle.
usage.duration: 30 minutes of enhanced weapon and 24 hours of personalized advice
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends upon expiration or when a new token is used.

animatopia_item_serpent_song_service_tok.priceReason: Balanced price reflects the rare service offered by the Coil Singers and the time invested in creating each enhancement.

doughnut_hole_item_gilded_wrights_null_o.name: Gilded Wright's Null of Shimmering Descent
doughnut_hole_item_gilded_wrights_null_o.description: The Gilded Wright's Null of Shimmering Descent is a shimmering, void-sculpted device that pulses with an eerie gravitational hum. Crafted from solidified void-gravity, it emits a faint, mesmerizing glow as if the fabric of space-time itself warps around it. This artifact grants brief moments of reduced gravitational influence, making precarious jumps easier and allowing you to escape crushing pressure with grace. However, its unsettling resonance can leave you momentarily disoriented, testing your resolve.

effectDetails.title: Reduced Gravity
effectDetails.rules: Activating the Gilded Wright's Null reduces local gravitational influence by 5% for 30 seconds. This effect provides a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and saves, but it also increases the DC of Strength (Athletics) checks by +2 while within its range.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Leap
effectDetails.rules: For 30 seconds after activation, you gain a +1 bonus to your jump distance. Additionally, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to avoid falling damage and can make such checks with disadvantage only once per long rest.

doughnut_hole_item_gilded_wrights_null_o.levelRequirementReason: The item's reduced gravity effect requires a character to be at least level 1 to safely benefit from its reduced gravitational influence.
doughnut_hole_item_gilded_wrights_null_o.vendorReason: Hole Hawker, a master of all things void-related, regularly stocks this unique artifact for adventurers seeking an edge in treacherous environments.
doughnut_hole_item_gilded_wrights_null_o.shippingDetail: The item is delivered via the Void Conveyor Belt, which ensures swift and reliable transportation even through interdimensional turbulence.

usage.duration: 30 seconds
usage.endsWhen: The duration ends when you deactivate it or until your next long rest if the effect is still active.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be active at a time.

doughnut_hole_item_gilded_wrights_null_o.priceReason: The item's rarity and specific utility justify its price of 1000 XP, reflecting its unique gravitational manipulation capabilities.

doughnut_hole_item_mk_42_void_nulls_of_t.name: Mk.42 Void Nulls of the Fractured Echo
doughnut_hole_item_mk_42_void_nulls_of_t.description: The Mk.42 Void Nulls of the Fractured Echo are obsidian fragments recovered from a collapsed gravity pocket, where reality itself seems to unravel into whispers and echoes. Each touch reveals fleeting glimpses of impossible geometries and an unsettling sense that one is being observed by unseen entities. These relics hum with a subtle resonance, amplifying perception but also leaving their bearer feeling as if they are walking the edge of sanity's precipice.

effectDetails.title: Minor Psychic Echo
effectDetails.rules: When touched, there is a 25% chance that the wielder receives a cryptic vision related to impossible geometries or the void. The vision lasts for 1 minute and does not provide actionable information.

effectDetails.title: Increased Perception
effectDetails.rules: The user gains a +1 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks until the end of their next long rest. This effect cannot be gained more than once per day.

doughnut_hole_item_mk_42_void_nulls_of_t.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest perception can be overwhelmed by these relics, making them unsuitable for lower-level characters.
doughnut_hole_item_mk_42_void_nulls_of_t.vendorReason: The center seller specializes in oddities and curios that challenge one's understanding of reality, making them a fitting vendor for such an item.
doughnut_hole_item_mk_42_void_nulls_of_t.shippingDetail: Ships via the Dimensional Courier, known for its reliable delivery through the fabric of space-time, even to the most remote locations.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; once per day
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the start of the next long rest or when the user intentionally ends it.

doughnut_hole_item_mk_42_void_nulls_of_t.priceReason: Balanced against other uncommon items, this relic provides unique and powerful effects without being overpowered.

doughnut_hole_item_void_services_of_the_.name: Void Services of the Gravitic Resonance
doughnut_hole_item_void_services_of_the_.description: A shimmering, self-contained chamber filled with swirling void energy, the Void Services of the Gravitic Resonance is a delicate construct forged from gravitic alloys and infused with the essence of The Fated Place's dark matter. It allows for temporary manipulation of local gravitational fields, creating platforms that defy gravity or disrupting attacks by shifting weight. However, prolonged use risks attracting unwanted attention from deeper within The Fated Place, potentially summoning minor void wraiths to claim the disturbance.

effectDetails.title: Gravitic Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. This effect creates a localized area of manipulated gravity, reducing or increasing the local gravitational pull by up to 15% for 60 seconds within a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you. The manipulation is instantaneous and requires no concentration.

effectDetails.title: Void Summoning Risk
effectDetails.rules: Each use has a 10% chance of summoning a minor void wraith, which appears as a spectral entity that hovers nearby for the duration of its summoning. A successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw ends this effect prematurely.

doughnut_hole_item_void_services_of_the_.levelRequirementReason: This service is accessible to all adventurers, making it valuable in various scenarios.
doughnut_hole_item_void_services_of_the_.vendorReason: Void Vendor specializes in items and services that manipulate the fabric of space-time, including those that interact with gravitational forces.
doughnut_hole_item_void_services_of_the_.shippingDetail: Ships via void portal, arrival time varies due to atmospheric disturbances but is typically within one day.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts for 60 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when the user chooses or on a failed Constitution saving throw

doughnut_hole_item_void_services_of_the_.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this item is affordable for most adventuring parties to have as an emergency tool.

almost_edge_item_spectral_drift_branded.name: The Spectral Drift Branded by Chronos's Lament
almost_edge_item_spectral_drift_branded.description: The Spectral Drift Branded by Chronos's Lament is a shimmering, viscous essence harvested from moments lost beyond the edge. It grants a fleeting glimpse into fractured timelines, inducing disorientation and chilling awareness of the void’s hunger. Prolonged exposure can unravel your sense of self, replacing it with echoes of forgotten realities. This essence is forged in the shadowy realms of Chronos's Lament, where time itself warps and bends.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Insight
effectDetails.rules: On activation, you gain a +50% bonus to your perception checks for the duration of one short rest or until you use this item again. This effect does not stack with other bonuses to perception.

effectDetails.title: Mild Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: For 3 turns after activation, you are incapacitated and take a -2 penalty to all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. You must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of your turns or fall unconscious until this effect ends.

almost_edge_item_spectral_drift_branded.levelRequirementReason: This item requires significant power to wield effectively without risking catastrophic consequences.
almost_edge_item_spectral_drift_branded.vendorReason: The void merchant deals in the rarest and most dangerous items found beyond reality’s edge, making this essence a regular but risky trade.
almost_edge_item_spectral_drift_branded.shippingDetail: Delivered via interdimensional courier drones that traverse the void between realms. Delivery can take up to one week depending on your location in relation to the nearest dimensional rift.

usage.activation: Object interaction as a bonus action
usage.duration: 1 hour or until reactivated, whichever comes first
usage.endsWhen: Effect ends when you use this item again or until the duration expires

almost_edge_item_spectral_drift_branded.priceReason: The essence is rare and requires significant alchemical and magical resources to produce, justifying its lower price.

almost_edge_item_liminal_resonance_curio.name: The Liminal Resonance of the Unwritten Threshold
almost_edge_item_liminal_resonance_curio.description: The Liminal Resonance of the Unwritten Threshold is a smooth obsidian stone etched with ever-shifting, arcane patterns that seem to whisper secrets of alternate realities. Holding it causes an unsettling disorientation, momentarily blurring the line between worlds. Crafted from the fearsome echoes of those who dared to peer into the void, this relic can be felt in its very touch—a tangible reminder of the unknown and the unspoken.

effectDetails.title: Reality Distortion
effectDetails.rules: When activated as a bonus action, it distorts reality for the wielder. For 2 rounds, all enemies within 10 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented, receiving disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of their next turn.

effectDetails.title: Anxiety Artifact
effectDetails.rules: Activating this relic grants you advantage on Insight checks for 1 minute. However, you must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the start of your turn; failure results in an additional round of disorientation as described above.

almost_edge_item_liminal_resonance_curio.levelRequirementReason: This relic is crafted to be accessible but potent enough to challenge even low-level adventurers.
almost_edge_item_liminal_resonance_curio.vendorReason: The Liminal Trader specializes in curiosities that bridge the gap between worlds, and this artifact fits perfectly with their inventory.
almost_edge_item_liminal_resonance_curio.shippingDetail: Ships via Phase Shift Package, ensuring its arrival through dimensional shortcuts.

usage.duration: 2 rounds per activation (Reality Distortion); 1 minute per activation (Anxiety Artifact)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect's duration expires or you take a short rest
usage.charges: Unlimited, but each activation costs 50 XP.

almost_edge_item_liminal_resonance_curio.priceReason: The item's balanced price reflects its moderate rarity and utility in combat and social situations without being overpowered.

almost_edge_item_radiant_fragment_brande.name: Radiant Fragment Branded with the Echo of Nullity
almost_edge_item_radiant_fragment_brande.description: A pulsating crystalline shard that glows with a spectral light, this Radiant Fragment Branded with the Echo of Nullity is said to have been forged from the very edge where reality and chaos meet. When activated, it creates a pocket of absolute stillness within a small radius, halting movement and disrupting perception. The air around it feels as though it has been drawn into an endless void, leaving nothing but silence.

effectDetails.title: Zone of Stillness
effectDetails.rules: The shard creates a small zone (10 feet radius) that halts all movement and prevents the casting of spells or abilities requiring verbal commands. This effect lasts for 1 round, after which it dissipates. There is no save DC; creatures within the area are incapacitated until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Null Vision
effectDetails.rules: Any creature that looks into the shard's light must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be blinded for 1 round. This effect is resisted with a successful save and does not stack if a creature is already blinded.

almost_edge_item_radiant_fragment_brande.levelRequirementReason: Only those of considerable experience can wield this powerful artifact without risking their own balance.
almost_edge_item_radiant_fragment_brande.vendorReason: The edge wanderers are known to traverse the realms where such dangerous artifacts are found, and they possess the knowledge to safely handle them.
almost_edge_item_radiant_fragment_brande.shippingDetail: Shipped via secure and swift courier services; delivery may require special handling for fragile items.

usage.duration: 1 round
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration is over or a creature moves out of the zone
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires concentration to maintain

almost_edge_item_radiant_fragment_brande.priceReason: The shard's rarity and the risk involved in its use justify this price.

grand_country_item_the_wicked_climbing_w.name: The Wicked Climbing Weight of Ascendant Grit
grand_country_item_the_wicked_climbing_w.description: The Wicked Climbing Weight of Ascendant Grit is a sleek obsidian weight, its surface etched with chaotic glyphs that seem to writhe and spiral like the ascent of a vertiginous cliff face. When wielded by a daring climber, it grants unnatural grip and momentum, allowing for controlled descents. This treacherous tool channels the essence of vertical strata, reducing fall damage and granting temporary strength boosts during its brief bursts of use.

effectDetails.title: Controlled Descent
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can activate the weight to initiate a controlled descent. This effect lasts for up to 30 seconds and allows the climber to descend at half their normal speed without losing balance.

effectDetails.title: Fall Damage Reduction
effectDetails.rules: For one minute after using the weight in a controlled descent, the wielder is protected from fall damage. This effect reduces all fall damage by 10% during this duration.

grand_country_item_the_wicked_climbing_w.levelRequirementReason: Requires significant climbing skill and control to safely use the weight's chaotic powers.
grand_country_item_the_wicked_climbing_w.vendorReason: Side sellers often carry unique tools for adventurers, including this treacherous yet useful climbing aid.
grand_country_item_the_wicked_climbing_w.shippingDetail: Ships via a specialized delivery drone, ensuring safe and swift transport to the adventurer's location.

usage.duration: Up to 30 seconds per use
usage.endsWhen: Ends after 1 minute or upon losing control of the descent

grand_country_item_the_wicked_climbing_w.priceReason: The weight's chaotic energy and specialized construction justify its high price.

grand_country_item_the_layered_curse_of_.name: The Layered Curse of Fallen Echoes – Serpent’s Coil Weight
grand_country_item_the_layered_curse_of_.description: The Layered Curse of Fallen Echoes – Serpent’s Coil Weight is a heavy, brass-bound stone weight crafted from an ancient echo-stone. Its surface is scored with petrified echoes of climbers who perished in the mountains, whispering their final moments. Gripping it forces you to confront fleeting visions of potential hazards, while its unsettling resonance can disorient attackers and enhance your situational awareness by 5%. A touch releases a phantom echo that briefly stuns nearby foes.

effectDetails.title: Echo Visions
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can activate the weight to gain a brief insight into potential dangers ahead. The visions last for 1 minute and provide advantage on Perception checks made within 60 feet until they end.

effectDetails.title: Disorienting Resonance
effectDetails.rules: When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of you while holding the weight, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 round. The weight can only trigger this effect once per long rest.

grand_country_item_the_layered_curse_of_.levelRequirementReason: The weight's echoes are accessible to all climbers who can hold and focus.
grand_country_item_the_layered_curse_of_.vendorReason: Vertical Vendor specializes in gear for climbers, including items that enhance their survival skills in perilous environments.
grand_country_item_the_layered_curse_of_.shippingDetail: The weight is delivered securely via a swift pigeon courier, arriving within the day of purchase.

usage.duration: 1 minute
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you finish a short or long rest or if you lose your grip on it.

grand_country_item_the_layered_curse_of_.priceReason: The weight's rarity and unique properties justify its price, offering potent yet balanced advantages to any climber.

grand_country_item_the_godly_resonance_o.name: The Resonance of Stoneheart – Apex Weight of the Shardfall
grand_country_item_the_godly_resonance_o.description: The Resonance of Stoneheart is a massive, solidified stone core that pulses with the essence of a climber who met their fate atop the Shardfall. When activated, it creates a localized gravity field that warps the space around it, causing climbers to falter and enemies to stagger towards its wielder. The core’s ancient spirit also triggers occasional bursts of falling stone fragments, making it both a weapon and a trap for those not careful enough.

effectDetails.title: Gravitational Disruption
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action, the Resonance of Stoneheart creates a localized gravity field with a 10-foot radius centered on it. All creatures in this area must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed back 5 feet and fall prone. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Draw Enemy Near
effectDetails.rules: As a bonus action, the wielder can use the Resonance to exert an irresistible pull on any creature within 30 feet. That creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be pulled towards the wielder at half their walking speed for 1 minute.

grand_country_item_the_godly_resonance_o.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest climber can recognize and appreciate this item’s potential.
grand_country_item_the_godly_resonance_o.vendorReason: Layer Market specializes in rare and exotic equipment, making it a logical place for such an artifact to be sold.
grand_country_item_the_godly_resonance_o.shippingDetail: Ships via Magical Conveyance, ensuring swift delivery with minimal risk of damage or theft.

usage.duration: Gravitational Disruption lasts for 1 minute. Draw Enemy Near lasts until the end of your next turn.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends if you lose concentration (as a bonus action), or when the Resonance is destroyed.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a long rest.

grand_country_item_the_godly_resonance_o.priceReason: This item’s rarity and utility justify its price, offering both defensive and offensive capabilities to those skilled in combat.

teyvat_item_electro_billet_of_adventure.name: The Electro Billets of Adventure
teyvat_item_electro_billet_of_adventure.description: The Electro Billets of Adventure are forged from the molten cores of ancient lightning storms within Stormterror’s domain. These billets hum with raw electro energy, their surfaces etched with arcane runes that channel the very essence of storm power. When struck against stone or metal, they release a blindingly bright bolt of miniature lightning, stunning foes and disrupting battle formations. The true heart of any adventurer, these billets are a favored tool for skirmishes and duels.

effectDetails.title: Miniature Lightning Bolt
effectDetails.rules: When the Electro Billet is struck against stone or metal, it releases an arc of miniature lightning. This deals 1d6+2 force and lightning damage to all creatures in a 5-foot radius centered on the impact point. The effect ends if the billet is struck again.

effectDetails.title: Stun On Impact
effectDetails.rules: There is a 30% chance that an enemy within 10 feet of where the Electro Billet lands will be stunned for 1 round. This effect has no save and can occur only once per encounter.

teyvat_item_electro_billet_of_adventure.levelRequirementReason: These billets are crafted to harness the raw power of ancient lightning storms, requiring a seasoned adventurer with considerable experience.
teyvat_item_electro_billet_of_adventure.vendorReason: As one of the largest and most reputable trading posts in Teyvat, Mondstadt Market has access to rare and exotic goods like these powerful billets.
teyvat_item_electro_billet_of_adventure.shippingDetail: Shipped by winged messenger for expedited delivery within three days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The billet is struck again or destroyed in combat
