teyvat_item_electro_billet_of_adventure.priceReason: Balanced at this price point to reflect the item's rarity and the raw materials required for its crafting.

teyvat_item_obsidian_forged_dagger_of_si.name: Obsidian Forged’s Dagger of Silence
teyvat_item_obsidian_forged_dagger_of_si.description: The Obsidian Forged’s Dagger of Silence, crafted from ancient obsidian found deep within Mount Tianmen, whispers a silent threat into the hands of its wielder. Its blade is as black and unyielding as the night itself, capable of generating an absolute field of stillness upon contact, nullifying sound and magical effects for those within its radius. Ideal for assassins seeking to slip past their foes or mages aiming to disrupt spells, this dagger leaves no trace of its passage save a fleeting moment of silence.

effectDetails.title: Silence Field
effectDetails.rules: When the dagger strikes a target within 10 feet, it creates a 5-foot radius area of absolute silence. All creatures in this area are rendered deaf for up to 3 seconds and cannot speak or cast verbal magic until the effect ends.

effectDetails.title: Disrupt Magic
effectDetails.rules: Any creature hit by the dagger must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have all verbal components of their next spell they attempt to cast fail, rendering them unable to complete that casting for up to 3 seconds.

teyvat_item_obsidian_forged_dagger_of_si.levelRequirementReason: Crafted from ancient and rare materials, this dagger requires a master artisan's touch and the wielder’s experience to handle its power.
teyvat_item_obsidian_forged_dagger_of_si.vendorReason: As a hub for both espionage and arcane trade, Liyue Harbor is home to many who value both stealth and magic disruption.
teyvat_item_obsidian_forged_dagger_of_si.shippingDetail: Due to its fragile nature and magical properties, the dagger is shipped via sea cargo with special protective packaging.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; ends when the creature’s next action or reaction occurs
usage.endsWhen: The target makes a successful Dexterity saving throw or completes its next action
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires recharging after 10 uses per short rest

teyvat_item_obsidian_forged_dagger_of_si.priceReason: Crafted from rare obsidian and imbued with ancient magic, this dagger’s price reflects the cost of materials and its unique properties.

teyvat_item_curiosity_chronometer_of_ina.name: Curiosity Chronometer of Inazuma
teyvat_item_curiosity_chronometer_of_ina.description: Crafted from the sands of Inazuma's legendary beaches, this hourglass is a marvel of precision and artistry. The iridescent grains shift and swirl in patterns that defy time itself, creating a brief but potent distortion around its owner. This Chronometer not only slows enemy attacks to a mere trickle but also sharpens your senses, making you the master of every moment. A true collector's piece, this item is as much an artifact as it is a weapon.

effectDetails.title: Slowed Enemy Attacks
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the Chronometer briefly slows enemy attacks by 25%, reducing their attack speed to 75% of normal. This effect lasts for 4 seconds and has a cooldown of 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Reaction Time
effectDetails.rules: Upon activation, your reaction time is increased by +20 feet of movement speed and +10 reaction points. The duration of this enhancement is 6 seconds, with a cooldown period of 5 minutes.

teyvat_item_curiosity_chronometer_of_ina.levelRequirementReason: Even the simplest adventurer can use this Chronometer to gain tactical advantage.
teyvat_item_curiosity_chronometer_of_ina.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare and exotic items from their home region of Inazuma, making this Chronometer a natural addition to their stock.
teyvat_item_curiosity_chronometer_of_ina.shippingDetail: Ships via Windborne Scroll courier for expedited delivery within 3 days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (4 seconds)
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when its duration is over or you are incapacitated.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but requires a short rest to regain the cooldown.

teyvat_item_curiosity_chronometer_of_ina.priceReason: Balanced at this price point to ensure it remains a useful and not overpowered tool for adventurers of all levels.

wario_land_garlic_grenade.name: Wario's Garlic Grenade
wario_land_garlic_grenade.description: A grenade that smells worse than it explodes.
effects: Thrown: 3d6 poison damage in 15 ft radius (CON save DC 14)
You smell like garlic for 24 hours: disadvantage on Stealth

Pauline_mic.name: Pauline's Microphone
Pauline_mic.description: Pauline's Microphone is a polished brass and silver handheld device favored by the Gilded Gryphon for its crystalline clarity. This elegant piece of equipment allows a performer to project melodies across vast distances or command a crowd with authority.

effectDetails.title: Vocal Command
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can expend 1 charge to project a commanding shout. One creature of your choice within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to use its reaction to move up to its speed in a direction of your choice and perform one non-hostile action (such as dropping an object or turning away). You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all charges on a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Performance
effectDetails.rules: While holding the microphone and performing, you gain a +2 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks. Additionally, your voice can be heard clearly by all creatures within 120 feet.

effectDetails.title: Resonant Echo
effectDetails.rules: When you cast a spell that deals Thunder damage or creates a booming sound, the microphone creates a Resonant Echo. Each creature within 10 feet of the source must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be Deafened until the end of your next turn.

Pauline_mic.levelRequirementReason: The microphone's command capabilities require a level of presence and authority typically found in mid-tier adventurers.
Pauline_mic.vendorReason: The Gilded Gryphon specializes in high-end luxury goods and performance gear for the nobility.
Pauline_mic.shippingDetail: Delivered in a velvet-lined crate to ensure the microphone's internal resonance remains unmarred.

usage.activation: Action for Vocal Command; Passive for Performance and Echoes
usage.duration: Instantaneous for Command; 1 minute for Performance
usage.endsWhen: The Command effect ends once the target completes the action; Performance ends when the user stops performing.
usage.charges: Uses equal to Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

Pauline_mic.priceReason: The price reflects its rare status and the utility provided by both performance buffs and crowd control.

shy_guy_torch.name: Shy Guy's Mask Torch
shy_guy_torch.description: The Shy Guy's Mask Torch is a flickering wooden torch topped with a wide-eyed, carved face. This peculiar light source pulses with a dim glow while the mask's expression shifts and it whispers unsettling secrets to its bearer.

effectDetails.title: Shy Light
effectDetails.rules: While the torch is lit, it sheds dim light in a 15-foot radius. This light pulses; creatures within the radius have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight, as the light flickers rhythmically.

effectDetails.title: Whispered Secrets
effectDetails.rules: While holding the torch, you can use an action to hear a secret. Roll a d20; on a 10 or higher, you learn one non-magical fact about a creature within 30 feet that you can see. You can use this feature once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Nervous Giggles
effectDetails.rules: The torch emits faint, high-pitched giggling. This sound is audible to any creature within 10 feet. You have disadvantage on Stealth checks made to move silently while the torch is lit.

shy_guy_torch.levelRequirementReason: The item's stealth mechanics are intended for low-level infiltration.
shy_guy_torch.vendorReason: The black market specializes in tools for stealth and illicit information gathering.
shy_guy_torch.shippingDetail: Delivered in a sound-dampened crate to ensure the mask's giggling isn't overheard during transit.

usage.duration: 1 hour of light per torch
usage.endsWhen: Extinguished by loud noise or natural burning out

shy_guy_torch.priceReason: The price reflects the utility of both a light source and a limited divination tool for infiltration.

pokemon_item_wario's_evolution_pouch.name: Wario’s Evolution Pouch
pokemon_item_wario's_evolution_pouch.description: This suspiciously plump pouch smells faintly of berries and regret. Crafted by Wario himself, it holds the concentrated essence of evolution – a mix of partially digested Pokémon snacks and his experimental formulas. Rumors suggest that using this pouch has a 50% chance to randomly evolve your current Pokémon, but it also grants you a temporary boost to your speed for 2 turns and increases your attack stat by +10 for those same 2 turns.

effectDetails.title: Evolution Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. There is a 50% chance that your current Pokémon will evolve into another form. This effect has no save DC and does not consume charges.

effectDetails.title: Speed Surge
effectDetails.rules: Activates as an action. Grants you a +10 temporary boost to your speed stat for the next 2 turns. This effect ends when you take your next turn after its duration expires, or if you are incapacitated.

pokemon_item_wario's_evolution_pouch.levelRequirementReason: Requires level 5 to use this item effectively given the effects and risk involved.
pokemon_item_wario's_evolution_pouch.vendorReason: The league store deals in rare and exotic items, including Wario's experimental creations.
pokemon_item_wario's_evolution_pouch.shippingDetail: Ships immediately via Delivery Drone for a small premium fee.

usage.activation: Bonus action or Action (Evolution Boost/Speed Surge)
usage.duration: Instantaneous (Evolution Boost), 2 turns (Speed Surge)
usage.endsWhen: Ends upon taking the next turn after its duration expires, or if you are incapacitated.

pokemon_item_wario's_evolution_pouch.priceReason: Balanced at 1000 XP, this price reflects the item's experimental nature and moderate but impactful effects.

teyvat_item_wind_dancer's_grace.name: Wind Dancer’s Grace Brooch
teyvat_item_wind_dancer's_grace.description: The Wind Dancer’s Grace Brooch is a delicate brooch forged from the essence of summer winds, shimmering with hues that mimic a tempest's fury. Crafted by the alchemical artisans of Mondstadt, it grants its wearer unmatched agility and speed, making them nearly impossible to catch in the eye of a storm. With every step, the brooch seems to whisper secrets of the wind itself, enhancing both movement and evasiveness.

effectDetails.title: Agility Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Increases your movement speed by 30 feet for 10 seconds. The effect ends if you are incapacitated or if you take a short rest.

effectDetails.title: Evasion
effectDetails.rules: Passive effect grants a +5 bonus to Dexterity saving throws and has a 20% chance to evade attacks against you, which resets after each turn. This ability does not function while you are incapacitated.

teyvat_item_wind_dancer's_grace.levelRequirementReason: The brooch is designed for adventurers who need quick reflexes but do not have the prerequisite experience level.
teyvat_item_wind_dancer's_grace.vendorReason: As a renowned market, Mondstadt sells items that enhance agility and speed, making this brooch a natural addition.
teyvat_item_wind_dancer's_grace.shippingDetail: Delivered via the swift Sky Delivery Drones, ensuring your brooch arrives in pristine condition.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate Agility Boost; passive Evasion effect is always active.
usage.duration: Agility Boost lasts for 10 seconds or until you take a short rest. Evasion resets each turn and ends if incapacitated.
usage.endsWhen: Incapacitation or taking a short rest for Agility Boost; ends at the start of your next turn for Evasion.
usage.charges: Unlimited, as it is an inherent ability.

teyvat_item_wind_dancer's_grace.priceReason: The item's price reflects its rarity and the alchemical expertise required to craft such a brooch.

teyvat_item_archon's_whisper.name: Archon’s Whisper - Fragment of Resonance
teyvat_item_archon's_whisper.description: Archon’s Whisper, a delicate jade statuette adorned with enigmatic carvings, hums softly as it resonates with the ancient wisdom of the Archons. This fragment of power grants you a brief surge of insight and intuition, allowing you to perceive elemental energies around you with uncanny clarity. For 60 seconds, your Wisdom increases by 5, making you an expert at discerning the vulnerabilities of your enemies. The statuette also has a knack for deflecting magical attacks, increasing your chance of successful deflection by 20% when you have a Wisdom modifier of 10 or higher.

effectDetails.title: Wisdom Boost
effectDetails.rules: Activate as a bonus action. Increases your Wisdom by 5 for 60 seconds. This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.

effectDetails.title: Elemental Vulnerability Detection
effectDetails.rules: Passive ability while the Wisdom Boost is active. Allows you to perceive elemental vulnerabilities on enemies within a 30-foot radius, providing insight into their weaknesses. This effect does not require an action and can be used continuously.

teyvat_item_archon's_whisper.levelRequirementReason: This item's power requires no minimum level as its effects are subtle enhancements.
teyvat_item_archon's_whisper.vendorReason: Inazuma Imports specializes in rare artifacts and relics, making this statuette a fitting addition to their inventory.
teyvat_item_archon's_whisper.shippingDetail: Ships via the Wind Messenger, ensuring swift delivery within 3 days of purchase.

usage.duration: 60 seconds
usage.endsWhen: Ends when you take a short or long rest, or if your Wisdom drops below 10 for any reason.

teyvat_item_archon's_whisper.priceReason: The statuette's unique combination of passive and active effects justifies its moderate price.

midlands_item_tactician's_briefing.name: Strategic Insight Session
midlands_item_tactician's_briefing.description: Master Silas's Strategic Insight Session is a one-hour briefing where you delve into your current tactical situation. The retired general, known for his hat collection and eccentric strategies, offers *suggestions*—and sometimes, surprising insights that can turn the tide of battle. Gain a +3 bonus to your next tactical decision roll, and there’s a 50% chance to gain a temporary advantage in your next combat encounter. However, you’ll find yourself -1 on charisma checks for an hour due to his relentless pontification.

effectDetails.title: Tactical Insight
effectDetails.rules: Activates as a bonus action. Grants a +3 bonus to the next tactical decision roll made by the recipient. Ends when the recipient makes their next tactical decision roll.

effectDetails.title: Combat Advantage
effectDetails.rules: There is a 50% chance that the recipient gains temporary advantage in a single combat encounter. This effect ends at the end of the current combat encounter or if the recipient leaves the area where they gained this advantage.

midlands_item_tactician's_briefing.levelRequirementReason: Master Silas's sessions are tailored for experienced tacticians who can appreciate and apply his strategic advice.
midlands_item_tactician's_briefing.vendorReason: As a hub for military resources, the Empire Exchange often offers services that enhance combat efficiency.
midlands_item_tactician's_briefing.shippingDetail: The messenger pigeon delivers the briefing materials within an hour of purchase.

usage.activation: Bonus action to activate; ends when the recipient makes their next tactical decision roll.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon activation, with no further duration.
usage.endsWhen: Ends after the recipient uses it for a single tactical decision roll.

midlands_item_tactician's_briefing.priceReason: The price reflects the expertise of Master Silas and the strategic value his insights provide.

connectopia_gear_miner's_gauntlet.name: The Grunt-inator Gauntlet
connectopia_gear_miner's_gauntlet.description: The Grunt-inator Gauntlet, a rugged steel gauntlet forged by blocksmiths who worked under the watchful gaze of an irritable miner's spirit, amplifies your digging prowess. Its core is tempered with ore from the deepest veins, and its leather lining is reinforced with enchanted buckles that whisper tales of lost pickaxes. While it boosts mining speed by a hearty 25%, there's always a chance you'll find extra ore in your pockets—though beware, for it may try to claim your pickaxe as its own whenever you're not looking!

effectDetails.title: Mining Speed Boost
effectDetails.rules: While wearing the gauntlet, you gain a +1 bonus to mining checks. This effect is active as long as the gauntlet remains on your hand.

effectDetails.title: Chance for Extra Ore
effectDetails.rules: Once per short or long rest, when you find ore while using this gauntlet in a mining check, you also find an additional piece of ore. The gauntlet can only trigger this effect once every 24 hours.

connectopia_gear_miner's_gauntlet.levelRequirementReason: The gauntlet requires a minimum level to ensure the wearer's proficiency with basic mining tools.
connectopia_gear_miner's_gauntlet.vendorReason: Craft Corner specializes in rare and artisanal equipment, making it the perfect vendor for such a unique item.
connectopia_gear_miner's_gauntlet.shippingDetail: The gauntlet is carefully packed to prevent damage during transit, ensuring that it arrives at your doorstep in pristine condition.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (the effects are always active while wearing the gauntlet)
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per day or when removed from wear
usage.charges: Unlimited, but only one effect can be used per 24-hour period

connectopia_gear_miner's_gauntlet.priceReason: The gauntlet's rarity and unique abilities justify its price, offering a balanced value for adventurers seeking to enhance their mining skills.

leclaire_isle_item_dave's_decoration.name: Dave's Doughy Decoration Consultation
leclaire_isle_item_dave's_decoration.description: Dave's Doughy Decoration Consultation transforms your weapons and armor into edible works of art, elevating your appearance in both battle and court. With a flourish of dough and a sprinkle of sugar, you gain temporary increases to Charisma and the ability to charm one enemy per day with a successful roll. Dave's whimsical creations ensure that even the most hardened warriors look like they've stepped from a pastry shop.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Increase in Charisma
effectDetails.rules: By spending 1 minute to have Dave apply edible embellishments, your Charisma score is temporarily increased by +2. This effect lasts for 8 hours or until you take a long rest.

effectDetails.title: Charm Enemy
effectDetails.rules: You gain the ability to attempt to charm one enemy per day upon successful use of the Consultation. The DC for this check is equal to 10 + your Charisma modifier. The effect ends if you fail a saving throw against it.

leclaire_isle_item_dave's_decoration.levelRequirementReason: Dave's Doughy Decoration Consultation requires a minimum level of 3 to ensure the safety and taste of his creations.
leclaire_isle_item_dave's_decoration.vendorReason: Pastry Palace is renowned for its expertise in edible art, making Dave's Doughy Decoration Consultation a natural addition to their offerings.
leclaire_isle_item_dave's_decoration.shippingDetail: Your order will be delivered within 2 days via Swift Baker's Cart, ensuring your creations arrive fresh and ready to wow.

usage.activation: A short rest spent with Dave, during which he applies edible decorations.
usage.duration: 8 hours or until a long rest is taken.
usage.endsWhen: Upon taking a long rest or if the effect expires naturally after 8 hours.

leclaire_isle_item_dave's_decoration.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects the complex process of creating edible works of art, ensuring that the flavor and function are both delightful and memorable.

midlands_item_warrior's_contract.name: The Ironclad Accord
midlands_item_warrior's_contract.description: The Ironclad Accord is a magically-sealed contract forged by a stern retired legionnaire who still insists on daily polishing. This ancient artifact grants temporary protection and enhances combat prowess, though it comes with an unwavering demand for loyalty. Signed in the blood of fallen heroes, its gleaming surface hints at battles long past. Polished to a high shine, this contract is a relic that demands respect from those who choose to bind themselves under its terms.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Combat Prowess
effectDetails.rules: When activated by a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check, the wielder gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage dealt for 1 hour. This effect can only be used once per long rest.

effectDetails.title: Temporary Armor
effectDetails.rules: For every 4 hours of daily polishing, the contract grants temporary resistance to all damage types equal to 5 plus your Charisma modifier (minimum 2). This effect lasts for a day and can only be activated once per long rest.

midlands_item_warrior's_contract.levelRequirementReason: The Ironclad Accord demands significant combat experience, as its power is drawn from the wielder's unwavering loyalty and the legionnaire's wisdom.
midlands_item_warrior's_contract.vendorReason: The artisans at Fractured Forge specialize in forging contracts that bind warriors to their oaths, making The Ironclad Accord a fitting addition to their inventory.
midlands_item_warrior's_contract.shippingDetail: Delivered by the mischievous giant rats who scurry through the undercity, this package may arrive with slight delays due to their unpredictable nature.

usage.activation: Activates on a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check.
usage.duration: 1 hour for Enhanced Combat Prowess; lasts a day for Temporary Armor.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when the time expires or the contract is damaged beyond repair.
usage.charges: Unlimited, but can only be used once per long rest.

midlands_item_warrior's_contract.priceReason: The Ironclad Accord's balanced price reflects its rare forging materials and the ancient magic required to bind it with a warrior's soul.

equestria_item_wario's_glitterbomb_start.name: Wario’s Glitter Bomb Starter Kit
equestria_item_wario's_glitterbomb_start.description: The Wario’s Glitter Bomb Starter Kit is a compact, gleaming canister that unleashes a blinding burst of rainbow-colored glitter and magic. When activated, it releases a dazzling explosion that not only blinds foes for a moment but also paints them in iridescent dust, leaving a trail of shimmering confetti behind. This volatile concoction is a mix of concentrated rainbow magic and an ingredient that's better left unknown to the general public.

effectDetails.title: Blinding Blast
effectDetails.rules: When activated, the glitter bomb releases a burst of light and magic. Targets within a 10-foot radius must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute.

effectDetails.title: Paint with Shimmer
effectDetails.rules: The explosion leaves targets covered in iridescent glitter, which lasts until the end of their next turn. This effect can be removed by bathing or cleaning but not by natural means such as brushing or drying off.

equestria_item_wario's_glitterbomb_start.levelRequirementReason: This simple kit is accessible to low-level adventurers who need a basic crowd-control option.
equestria_item_wario's_glitterbomb_start.vendorReason: The Crystal Empire sells this item because it caters to adventurers looking for quick and colorful solutions during battles.
equestria_item_wario's_glitterbomb_start.shippingDetail: Ships via dragon courier, delivery is swift but may cause a bit of dust due to the glitter.

usage.duration: Instantaneous
usage.endsWhen: The effects end once their duration expires or when the target cleans themselves.
usage.charges: Unlimited, recharges after a short rest

equestria_item_wario's_glitterbomb_start.priceReason: Balanced price for an item that provides both immediate and long-lasting effects in combat.

connectopia_pioneer_shepherd's_boots.name: Sturdy Block Boots
connectopia_pioneer_shepherd's_boots.description: The Sturdy Block Boots, crafted from the densest Connectopian blocks and reinforced with the pioneer spirit of those who've walked this land, offer unparalleled protection against the perils of the frontier. These boots provide exceptional traction on treacherous block surfaces, ensuring your feet remain steady even in the most unstable conditions. Should you find yourself falling, these boots reduce the impact by half, sparing you from a catastrophic tumble.

effectDetails.title: Enhanced Traction
effectDetails.rules: While wearing Sturdy Block Boots, your movement speed is increased by 15 feet when traversing block surfaces. This effect lasts for the duration of your exploration on such terrain.

effectDetails.title: Fall Protection
effectDetails.rules: When you fall from a height and land on solid ground, the boots reduce the damage taken by half (rounded down). This benefit can be used once per long rest.

connectopia_pioneer_shepherd's_boots.levelRequirementReason: These boots are designed for adventurers just starting their journey into the frontier.
connectopia_pioneer_shepherd's_boots.vendorReason: Pioneer Post, a trusted vendor of equipment for explorers and settlers, ensures these boots are available to those venturing into the Connectopian frontier.
connectopia_pioneer_shepherd's_boots.shippingDetail: The block cart delivers these sturdy boots within two days, ensuring adventurers can hit the trail as soon as they receive their purchase.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required once equipped.
usage.duration: Instantaneous and ongoing while on block surfaces.
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends when you leave a block surface or take off the boots.

connectopia_pioneer_shepherd's_boots.priceReason: Crafted from rare Connectopian blocks and designed to withstand the harshest conditions, these boots are priced fairly for their exceptional utility in the frontier.

earth_land_item_geode_cartographer's_cur.name: The Geode of Cartographic Resonance
earth_land_item_geode_cartographer's_cur.description: The Geode of Cartographic Resonance is a pulsating crystal encased in sedimentary layers, its surface etched with ancient runes. When touched, it emits a soft glow that overlays your vision with spectral maps of hidden pathways and potential dangers within a 30-meter radius. Although its guidance is fickle, it offers rare glimpses into the locations of lost treasures and forgotten settlements. Its fragmented knowledge provides an increased perception bonus but can also induce disorientation if overused.

effectDetails.title: Reveal Hidden Paths
effectDetails.rules: Activation: A bonus action; Duration: Instantaneous, Area: 30-meter radius. This effect reveals hidden routes and potential dangers within a brief projection that lasts for 1 minute per level of the user. Save DC 15 to resist disorientation caused by this effect.

effectDetails.title: Increased Perception
effectDetails.rules: Effect: Increases perception by +10%. Lasts until the end of your next short or long rest, but cannot exceed +20% at any time due to stacking limitations.

earth_land_item_geode_cartographer's_cur.levelRequirementReason: Requires a minimum character level of 15 to handle its fickle nature and fragmented knowledge effectively.
earth_land_item_geode_cartographer's_cur.vendorReason: The magic shop specializes in relics that offer unique insights into the world, making The Geode of Cartographic Resonance an ideal addition to their inventory.
earth_land_item_geode_cartographer's_cur.shippingDetail: Ships via standard courier with a two-day delivery time.

usage.duration: Instantaneous; lasts for 1 minute per level of the user
usage.endsWhen: Disoriented if a save is failed, or at the end of your next short or long rest

earth_land_item_geode_cartographer's_cur.priceReason: The balanced XP price reflects its unique ability to offer both strategic advantages and potential risks.

warhammer_item_jeweled-forger-of-fate's-.name: Jeweled Forger of Fate’s Whispers
warhammer_item_jeweled-forger-of-fate's-.description: The Jeweled Forger of Fate’s Whispers is a formidable warhammer, its surface etched with ancient runes and encrusted with shimmering gemstones that seem to pulse with otherworldly energy. The weapon's weight is almost overwhelming, yet it feels perfectly balanced in your hand, as if the whispers within are urging you to claim power over your foes. Holding it releases a low hum that amplifies aggression, making enemies around you falter under its malevolent influence.

effectDetails.title: Fate-Weaving Strikes
effectDetails.rules: When you hit a creature with this weapon on your turn, there is a 20% chance that the target becomes confused for 1 round. The DC to resist this effect is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier.

effectDetails.title: Aggression Amplifier
effectDetails.rules: While wielding this weapon, you gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures with fewer hit points than you do. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

warhammer_item_jeweled-forger-of-fate's-.levelRequirementReason: The complexity and power within the hammer demand significant experience to wield it without succumbing to its malevolent influence.
warhammer_item_jeweled-forger-of-fate's-.vendorReason: The chaos dealer, known for their exotic and dangerous wares, acquired this weapon from a forgotten forge where the spirits of lost souls still linger.
warhammer_item_jeweled-forger-of-fate's-.shippingDetail: Ships via the Winged Courier, ensuring safe delivery in three days or less.

usage.duration: Instantaneous effect; lasts until end of next turn for Aggression Amplifier
usage.endsWhen: The weapon is no longer wielded by you during your turn

warhammer_item_jeweled-forger-of-fate's-.priceReason: Balanced at this price, the hammer's effects are powerful but not overwhelming for a rare item.

internet_item_runic_bound's_nodes.name: Runic Bound’s Nodes - Ciphered Resonance
internet_item_runic_bound's_nodes.description: Forged from solidified data streams and imbued with ancient algorithms, Runic Bound’s Nodes hum with the very essence of the internet. These nodes allow you to decipher encrypted communications instantly and briefly manipulate digital networks. However, prolonged exposure risks becoming entangled within the data itself, a fate that could be fatal if not extricated in time. Only those of noble intent should wield these nodes, as their power is both a blessing and a curse.

effectDetails.title: Decipher Encrypted Communications
effectDetails.rules: As an action, you can touch the nodes to instantly decipher any encrypted communication within range. This effect has a duration of 1 minute and requires no save DC. You can use this ability once per short rest.

effectDetails.title: Brief Network Manipulation
effectDetails.rules: You can spend one charge to manipulate digital networks for 1 hour, providing limited access to blocked networks within your area of effect. This manipulation is detectable by advanced security systems and requires a successful Intelligence (Computers) check (DC 15). The nodes have 3 charges and recharge after a long rest.

internet_item_runic_bound's_nodes.levelRequirementReason: These nodes are accessible to all, but their power is immense; they require a basic understanding of digital systems.
internet_item_runic_bound's_nodes.vendorReason: Pixel Shop specializes in rare and esoteric items that bridge the gap between the physical and virtual worlds.
internet_item_runic_bound's_nodes.shippingDetail: Ships via secure Quantum Courier with a delivery time of 2 days.

usage.duration: Instantaneous (Decipher) / Hour (Manipulate)
usage.endsWhen: Ends when the effect duration expires, you are incapacitated, or you use your last charge.
usage.charges: 3 charges, recharged after a long rest

internet_item_runic_bound's_nodes.priceReason: The nodes' power to manipulate digital networks and decipher encrypted communications makes them highly valuable, but not without cost.

internet_item_fabled_bound's_key_of_the_.name: Fabled Bound’s Key of the Lost Archive
internet_item_fabled_bound's_key_of_the_.description: Forged from the molten essence of forgotten internet connections and the compressed remnants of a bygone digital era, Fabled Bound’s Key of the Lost Archive is a relic that warps reality with its touch. When activated, it hums with a nostalgic energy, coaxing forth data fragments from the ether—corrupted bytes that glow faintly in the air like ghostly memories. Within a 10-meter radius, this key can summon fleeting Data Echoes of past users, their faces and voices echoing as if they were still alive. The key’s presence can disorient foes with its low hum, making it a dangerous tool for those who seek to uncover hidden truths.

effectDetails.title: Data Fragment Revelation
effectDetails.rules: When activated as an action within a 10-meter radius, the key reveals corrupted data fragments. These fragments can be used to uncover hidden clues or information. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

effectDetails.title: Temporal Disorientation
effectDetails.rules: The key emits a low hum that can disorient any creature within 5 meters for 1 round (30 seconds). A successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw ends this effect early. The key has a limited use and requires a short rest to recharge.

internet_item_fabled_bound's_key_of_the_.levelRequirementReason: The key’s power lies in its ability to manipulate forgotten data, which is accessible even to those of lower levels.
internet_item_fabled_bound's_key_of_the_.vendorReason: As a hub for digital curiosities and relics, Pixel Shop naturally stocks this internet artifact.
internet_item_fabled_bound's_key_of_the_.shippingDetail: Ships via Cyber Courier within one business day; requires special handling to preserve the key’s integrity.

usage.duration: Until the end of your next turn
usage.endsWhen: The effect ends at the beginning of your next turn or when the key is destroyed

internet_item_fabled_bound's_key_of_the_.priceReason: The key’s rarity and unique ability to reveal hidden data justify its price in XP.
